name: Submission.TamedField.orbitFrameClass_eq_of_closedHomotopy
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_eq_of_closedHomotopy
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) {modelLoop : C(I, SOGroup (n + 1))}
    (model_closed : modelLoop 0 = modelLoop 1)
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (V.orbitFrameLoop O) modelLoop)
    (H_closed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1)) :
    V.orbitFrameClass O = loopClassZ2 modelLoop model_closed
proof:
:= by
  exact loopClassZ2_congr (V.orbitFrameLoop_closed O) model_closed H H_closed

name: Submission.StandardBirth.actual_orbitFrameClass_eq_one
statement:
theorem actual_orbitFrameClass_eq_one
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : TamedField X) (O : V.OrbitIndex)
    (Vmodel : TamedField (targetFLS m))
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (V.orbitFrameLoop O)
      (simpleClosedOrbitParam m Vmodel).paramFrameLoop)
    (H_closed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1)) :
    V.orbitFrameClass O = 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    V.orbitFrameClass O =
        loopClassZ2 (simpleClosedOrbitParam m Vmodel).paramFrameLoop
          (simpleClosedOrbitParam m Vmodel).paramFrameLoop_closed :=
      V.orbitFrameClass_eq_of_closedHomotopy O
        (simpleClosedOrbitParam m Vmodel).paramFrameLoop_closed H H_closed
    _ = 1 := unitCircle_paramFrameClass_of_pos hm Vmodel

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.actual_orbitFrameClass_splice
statement:
theorem actual_orbitFrameClass_splice
    (Vbefore : TamedField Xbefore) (Vafter : TamedField Xafter)
    (O₁ O₂ : Vbefore.OrbitIndex) (Ohat : Vafter.OrbitIndex)
    (Vsource : TamedField (sourceFLS m))
    (Vtarget : TamedField (targetFLS m))
    (H₁ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop O₁)
      (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop)
    (H₂ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop O₂)
      (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop)
    (Hhat : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (Vafter.orbitFrameLoop Ohat)
      (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vtarget).paramFrameLoop)
    (H₁_closed : ∀ s : I, H₁ (s, 0) = H₁ (s, 1))
    (H₂_closed : ∀ s : I, H₂ (s, 0) = H₂ (s, 1))
    (Hhat_closed : ∀ s : I, Hhat (s, 0) = Hhat (s, 1)) :
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
      Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ =
      loopClassZ2
        (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop
        (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed :=
    Vbefore.orbitFrameClass_eq_of_closedHomotopy O₁
      (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed
      H₁ H₁_closed
  have h₂ : Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ =
      loopClassZ2
        (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop
        (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed :=
    Vbefore.orbitFrameClass_eq_of_closedHomotopy O₂
      (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed
      H₂ H₂_closed
  have hhat : Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
      loopClassZ2 (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vtarget).paramFrameLoop
        (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vtarget).paramFrameLoop_closed :=
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass_eq_of_closedHomotopy Ohat
      (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vtarget).paramFrameLoop_closed
      Hhat Hhat_closed
  calc
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
        loopClassZ2 (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vtarget).paramFrameLoop
          (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vtarget).paramFrameLoop_closed := hhat
    _ = loopClassZ2
          (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop
          (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed +
        loopClassZ2
          (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop
          (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed + 1 :=
      cassini_saddle_frame_class_splice m Vsource Vtarget
    _ = Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + 1 := by
      rw [h₁, h₂]

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.levelMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
lemma levelMap_eq_zero_iff (v : A) :

proof:
:= by

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.spatial_bounded_levelMap
statement:
lemma spatial_bounded_levelMap :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ v : A, D.levelMap v = 0 → ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := D.exterior_south
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  by_contra hout
  have hfar : R < ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ := lt_of_not_ge hout
  have hsouth : D.sphere v = southPole n := hR v hfar
  have hhoriz : initCLM n (D.sphere v : E) = 0 := by
    have hsouth' := congrArg Subtype.val hsouth
    rw [hsouth']
    rw [show ((southPole n : UnitSphere E) : E) = -eLast n from rfl,
      map_neg, initCLM_eLast]
    exact neg_zero
  have htarget : D.target = 0 := by
    rw [← (D.levelMap_eq_zero_iff v).mp hv]
    exact hhoriz
  exact D.target_ne_zero htarget

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.regular_levelMap
statement:
lemma regular_levelMap (v : A) (hv : D.levelMap v = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ D.levelMap v)
proof:
:= by
  have hreg := D.regular v ((D.levelMap_eq_zero_iff v).mp hv)
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ D.levelMap v =
      fderiv ℝ (fun q => initCLM n (D.sphere q : E)) v := by
    exact fderiv_sub_const D.target
  rwa [hfd]

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.vertical_ne_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma vertical_ne_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero (v : A)
    (hv : D.levelMap v = 0) : D.vertical v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hsplit := norm_sq_split (D.sphere v : E)
  have hhoriz := (D.levelMap_eq_zero_iff v).mp hv
  change vertC (D.sphere v : E) = 0 at hz
  rw [UnitSphere.norm_coe, hhoriz, hz] at hsplit
  have hnorm0 : 0 ≤ ‖D.target‖ := norm_nonneg _
  nlinarith [D.target_norm_lt_one]

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.sphere_eq_northPoint_iff
statement:
theorem sphere_eq_northPoint_iff (v : A) :
    (D.sphere v : E) = northPoint D.target ↔
      D.levelMap v = 0 ∧ 0 < D.vertical v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hnorth
    constructor
    · apply (D.levelMap_eq_zero_iff v).mpr
      rw [hnorth, initCLM_northPoint]
    · change 0 < vertC (D.sphere v : E)
      rw [hnorth]
      exact vertC_northPoint_pos D.target_norm_lt_one
  · rintro ⟨hlevel, hpos⟩
    have hinit := (D.levelMap_eq_zero_iff v).mp hlevel
    have hsheets :=
      (init_eq_iff (UnitSphere.norm_coe (D.sphere v)) D.target).mp hinit
    rcases hsheets with hnorth | hsouth
    · exact hnorth
    · have hneg : D.vertical v < 0 := by
        change vertC (D.sphere v : E) < 0
        rw [hsouth]
        exact vertC_southPointOf_neg D.target_norm_lt_one
      linarith

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.sphere_eq_southPoint_iff
statement:
theorem sphere_eq_southPoint_iff (v : A) :
    (D.sphere v : E) = southPointOf D.target ↔
      D.levelMap v = 0 ∧ D.vertical v < 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsouth
    constructor
    · apply (D.levelMap_eq_zero_iff v).mpr
      rw [hsouth, initCLM_southPointOf]
    · change vertC (D.sphere v : E) < 0
      rw [hsouth]
      exact vertC_southPointOf_neg D.target_norm_lt_one
  · rintro ⟨hlevel, hneg⟩
    have hinit := (D.levelMap_eq_zero_iff v).mp hlevel
    have hsheets :=
      (init_eq_iff (UnitSphere.norm_coe (D.sphere v)) D.target).mp hinit
    rcases hsheets with hnorth | hsouth
    · have hpos : 0 < D.vertical v := by
        change 0 < vertC (D.sphere v : E)
        rw [hnorth]
        exact vertC_northPoint_pos D.target_norm_lt_one
      linarith
    · exact hsouth

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.source_northFiber_eq_positivePart
statement:
theorem source_northFiber_eq_positivePart :
    {x : E | (D.sphere (spaceTime x 0) : E) = northPoint D.target} =
      S₀.positivePart
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rw [mem_setOf_eq, D.sphere_eq_northPoint_iff]
  change
    (initCLM n (D.sphere (spaceTime x 0) : E) - D.target = 0 ∧
      0 < vertC (D.sphere (spaceTime x 0) : E)) ↔
      X₀.g x = 0 ∧ 0 < S₀ x
  rw [
    D.horizontal_collar_zero x 0 (by norm_num),
    D.vertical_collar_zero x 0 (by norm_num)]

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.contDiff_inverseRaw
statement: theorem contDiff_inverseRaw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a.inverseRaw
proof:
:= by
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v => -a.toFun (a.diffeomorph.symm v))
  exact (a.smooth.comp a.diffeomorph.symm.contDiff).neg

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.inverseRaw_collar_zero
statement:
theorem inverseRaw_collar_zero (v : E')
    (hv : tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v) :
    a.inverseRaw v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have ha : a v = 0 := a.toVerticalAmplitude.collar_zero v hv
  have hfix : a.diffeomorph v = v := by
    rw [a.diffeomorph_apply]
    simp [verticalShift, ha]
  have hinv : a.diffeomorph.symm v = v := by
    calc
      a.diffeomorph.symm v =
          a.diffeomorph.symm (a.diffeomorph v) := congrArg _ hfix.symm
      _ = v := a.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply v
  simp [inverseRaw, hinv, ha]

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.verticalShift_inverseRaw
statement:
theorem verticalShift_inverseRaw (v : E') :
    verticalShift a.inverseRaw v = a.diffeomorph.symm v
proof:
:= by
  let x : E' := a.diffeomorph.symm v
  have hx : verticalShift a x = v := by
    change a.diffeomorph x = v
    exact a.diffeomorph.apply_symm_apply v
  calc
    verticalShift a.inverseRaw v = v - a x • timeVec := by
      simp [verticalShift, inverseRaw, x, sub_eq_add_neg]
    _ = x := by
      rw [← hx]
      simp only [verticalShift]
      abel

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.antilipschitzWith_two_verticalShift
statement:
theorem antilipschitzWith_two_verticalShift (hsmall : 2 * a.K < 1) :
    AntilipschitzWith 2 (verticalShift a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [antilipschitzWith_iff_le_mul_dist]
  intro x z
  have hsub : x - z =
      (verticalShift a x - verticalShift a z) -
        ((a x - a z) • timeVec) := by
    simp only [verticalShift]
    rw [sub_smul]
    abel
  have htriangle : dist x z ≤
      dist (verticalShift a x) (verticalShift a z) + dist (a x) (a z) := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, Real.dist_eq, hsub]
    calc
      ‖(verticalShift a x - verticalShift a z) -
          (a x - a z) • timeVec‖ ≤
          ‖verticalShift a x - verticalShift a z‖ +
            ‖(a x - a z) • timeVec‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ = ‖verticalShift a x - verticalShift a z‖ + |a x - a z| := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_timeVec, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have ha := a.lipschitz.dist_le_mul x z
  have hsmallR : 2 * (a.K : ℝ) < 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast hsmall
  have hKnonneg : 0 ≤ (a.K : ℝ) := a.K.coe_nonneg
  have hdistnonneg : 0 ≤ dist x z := dist_nonneg
  have hprod : 0 ≤ (1 - 2 * (a.K : ℝ)) * dist x z :=
    mul_nonneg (by linarith) hdistnonneg
  norm_num
  nlinarith

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.lipschitzWith_two_diffeomorph_symm
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_two_diffeomorph_symm (hsmall : 2 * a.K < 1) :
    LipschitzWith 2 a.diffeomorph.symm
proof:
:= by
  apply (a.antilipschitzWith_two_verticalShift hsmall).to_rightInverse
  intro v
  change a.diffeomorph (a.diffeomorph.symm v) = v
  exact a.diffeomorph.apply_symm_apply v

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.lipschitzWith_inverseRaw
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_inverseRaw (hsmall : 2 * a.K < 1) :
    LipschitzWith (2 * a.K) a.inverseRaw
proof:
:= by
  rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
  intro x z
  have ha := a.lipschitz.dist_le_mul
    (a.diffeomorph.symm x) (a.diffeomorph.symm z)
  have hinv := (a.lipschitzWith_two_diffeomorph_symm hsmall).dist_le_mul x z
  rw [inverseRaw, inverseRaw, dist_neg_neg]
  calc
    dist (a (a.diffeomorph.symm x)) (a (a.diffeomorph.symm z)) ≤
        (a.K : ℝ) * dist (a.diffeomorph.symm x) (a.diffeomorph.symm z) := ha
    _ ≤ (a.K : ℝ) * (2 * dist x z) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hinv a.K.coe_nonneg
    _ = ((2 * a.K : NNReal) : ℝ) * dist x z := by
      push_cast
      ring

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.inverse_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem inverse_apply (hsmall : 2 * a.K < 1) (v : E') :
    a.inverse hsmall v = a.inverseRaw v
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.inverse_diffeomorph
statement:
theorem inverse_diffeomorph (hsmall : 2 * a.K < 1) :
    (a.inverse hsmall).diffeomorph = a.diffeomorph.symm
proof:
:= by
  apply Diffeomorph.ext
  intro v
  rw [diffeomorph_apply]
  change verticalShift a.inverseRaw v = a.diffeomorph.symm v
  exact a.verticalShift_inverseRaw v

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.coordinatePerm_zero
statement:
theorem coordinatePerm_zero (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    coordinatePerm m hm (0 : Fin (m + 3)) = ⟨2, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinatePerm, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
  apply Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne
  · intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num at hv
  · intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num at hv

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.coordinatePerm_one
statement:
theorem coordinatePerm_one (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    coordinatePerm m hm (1 : Fin (m + 3)) = ⟨3, by omega⟩
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinatePerm, Equiv.trans_apply]
  have h10 : (1 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num at hv
  have h12 : (1 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ ⟨2, by omega⟩ := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num at hv
  rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h10 h12, Equiv.swap_apply_left]

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.coordinatePerm_two
statement:
theorem coordinatePerm_two (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    coordinatePerm m hm (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin (m + 3)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinatePerm, Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.swap_apply_right]
  apply Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne
  · intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num at hv
  · intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num at hv

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.coordinatePerm_three
statement:
theorem coordinatePerm_three (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    coordinatePerm m hm (⟨3, by omega⟩ : Fin (m + 3)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coordinatePerm, Equiv.trans_apply]
  have h30 : (⟨3, by omega⟩ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num at hv
  have h32 : (⟨3, by omega⟩ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ ⟨2, by omega⟩ := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num at hv
  rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne h30 h32, Equiv.swap_apply_right]

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.coordinateCLE_single
statement:
theorem coordinateCLE_single (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (i : Fin (m + 3)) (a : ℝ) :
    coordinateCLE m hm (EuclideanSpace.single i a) =
      EuclideanSpace.single (coordinatePerm m hm i) a
proof:
:= by
  exact LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft_single (p := 2) (𝕜 := ℝ)
    (E := ℝ) (coordinatePerm m hm) i a

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.coordinateCLE_norm
statement:
theorem coordinateCLE_norm (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (x : Ambient m) :
    ‖coordinateCLE m hm x‖ = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  exact (LinearIsometryEquiv.piLpCongrLeft 2 ℝ ℝ
    (coordinatePerm m hm)).norm_map x

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.coordinateCLE_symm_norm
statement:
theorem coordinateCLE_symm_norm (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (x : Ambient m) :
    ‖(coordinateCLE m hm).symm x‖ = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  have h := coordinateCLE_norm m hm ((coordinateCLE m hm).symm x)
  rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.coordinateCLE_e₀
statement:
theorem coordinateCLE_e₀ (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    coordinateCLE m hm (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega)) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂,
    coordinatePerm_zero] using
      coordinateCLE_single m hm (0 : Fin (m + 3)) 1

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.coordinateCLE_e₁
statement:
theorem coordinateCLE_e₁ (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    coordinateCLE m hm (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega)) =
      e₃ m hm
proof:
:= by
  simpa [CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁, e₃, coordinatePerm_one] using
    coordinateCLE_single m hm (1 : Fin (m + 3)) 1

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.coordinateCLE_e₂
statement:
theorem coordinateCLE_e₂ (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    coordinateCLE m hm (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂,
    coordinatePerm_two] using

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.coordinateCLE_e₃
statement:
theorem coordinateCLE_e₃ (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) :
    coordinateCLE m hm (e₃ m hm) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁, e₃, coordinatePerm_three] using
    coordinateCLE_single m hm (⟨3, by omega⟩ : Fin (m + 3)) 1

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.localRadialSq_eq_norm_sq
statement:
theorem localRadialSq_eq_norm_sq (m : ℕ) (x : Ambient m) :
    SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRadialSq (m := m + 1) x = ‖x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, (x i) ^ 2 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq,
      Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg ‖x i‖)]
    simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  have hsum : (∑ i : Fin (m + 3), (x i) ^ 2) =
      x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 +
        ∑ i : Fin (m + 1), x i.succ.succ ^ 2 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
    simp only [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
    ring
  rw [hnorm, hsum]
  unfold SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRadialSq
  rfl

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.axisCircle_norm_sq
statement:
theorem axisCircle_norm_sq (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (a c s : ℝ) (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    ‖c • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        s • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        a • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)‖ ^ 2 =
      1 + a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← localRadialSq_eq_norm_sq m]
  unfold SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRadialSq
  simp [CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁,
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂, hunit]
  have h1 : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1),
      i.succ.succ ≠ (1 : Fin (m + 3)) := by
    intro i h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp at hv
  have h2 : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1),
      i.succ.succ = (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin (m + 3)) ↔ i = 0 := by
    intro i
    constructor
    · intro h
      apply Fin.ext
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp at hv ⊢
      omega
    · intro h
      subst i
      apply Fin.ext
      simp
  simp_rw [if_neg (h1 _), h2]
  simp

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.rotate_pi_axisCircle
statement:
theorem rotate_pi_axisCircle (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (a c s : ℝ) :
    SO2FrameGauge.rotate Real.pi
      (a • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        c • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        s • e₃ m hm) =
      (-a) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        c • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        s • e₃ m hm
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    simp [CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂, e₃,
      SO2FrameGauge.rotate_apply_zero, Real.cos_pi, Real.sin_pi]
  · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
    · subst j
      simp [CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂, e₃,
        SO2FrameGauge.rotate_apply_one, Real.cos_pi, Real.sin_pi]
    · rw [SO2FrameGauge.rotate_apply_other _ _ hj0 hj1]
      simp [CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀, hj0]

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.swapChart_symm_apply
statement:
theorem swapChart_symm_apply (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (x : Ambient m) :
    (swapChart m hm).symm x = (coordinateCLE m hm).symm
      ((SmoothAmbientIsotopy.dilationCLE 3 (by norm_num)).symm x)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.swapChart_circle_mem_inner
statement:
theorem swapChart_circle_mem_inner (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (a c s : ℝ) (ha : a ^ 2 = 4) (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRadialSq (m := m + 1)
      ((swapChart m hm).symm
        (c • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
          s • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
          a • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega))) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [localRadialSq_eq_norm_sq, swapChart_symm_apply,
    coordinateCLE_symm_norm,
    SmoothAmbientIsotopy.dilationCLE_symm_apply, norm_smul,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv]
  have hv := axisCircle_norm_sq m hm a c s hunit
  rw [ha] at hv
  norm_num at hv ⊢
  nlinarith

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.swapChart_circle_mem_outer
statement:
theorem swapChart_circle_mem_outer (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (a c s : ℝ) (ha : 18 ≤ a ^ 2) (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    2 ≤ SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRadialSq (m := m + 1)
      ((swapChart m hm).symm
        (c • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
          s • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
          a • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [localRadialSq_eq_norm_sq, swapChart_symm_apply,
    coordinateCLE_symm_norm,
    SmoothAmbientIsotopy.dilationCLE_symm_apply, norm_smul,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv]
  have hv := axisCircle_norm_sq m hm a c s hunit
  norm_num at hv ⊢
  nlinarith

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.swapChart_rotate_pi
statement:
theorem swapChart_rotate_pi (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (a c s : ℝ) :
    swapChart m hm (SO2FrameGauge.rotate Real.pi
      ((swapChart m hm).symm
        (c • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
          s • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
          a • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)))) =
      c • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        s • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        (-a) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  rw [swapChart_symm_apply]
  simp only [swapChart, ContinuousLinearEquiv.trans_apply,
    map_add, map_smul, SmoothAmbientIsotopy.dilationCLE_apply,
    SmoothAmbientIsotopy.dilationCLE_symm_apply]
  rw [show (coordinateCLE m hm).symm
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega)) =
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega) by
      rw [← coordinateCLE_e₂ m hm,
        ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]]
  rw [show (coordinateCLE m hm).symm
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega)) = e₃ m hm by
      rw [← coordinateCLE_e₃ m hm,
        ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]]
  rw [show (coordinateCLE m hm).symm
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)) =
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) by
      rw [← coordinateCLE_e₀ m hm,
        ContinuousLinearEquiv.symm_apply_apply]]
  rw [show (3 : ℝ)⁻¹ = 1 / 3 by norm_num]
  rw [show c • (1 / 3 : ℝ) •
          CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        s • (1 / 3 : ℝ) • e₃ m hm +
        a • (1 / 3 : ℝ) •
          CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) =
      (a / 3) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        (c / 3) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        (s / 3) • e₃ m hm by module]
  rw [rotate_pi_axisCircle m hm (a / 3) (c / 3) (s / 3)]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul]
  rw [coordinateCLE_e₀, coordinateCLE_e₂, coordinateCLE_e₃]
  module

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.slotPoint_sub_midpoint_left
statement:
theorem slotPoint_sub_midpoint_left (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2))
    (k : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) :
    slotPoint X k c s - midpoint X k =
      c • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        s • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        (-2 : ℝ) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  unfold slotPoint midpoint
  module

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.slotPoint_sub_midpoint_right
statement:
theorem slotPoint_sub_midpoint_right (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2))
    (k : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) :
    slotPoint X (k + 1) c s - midpoint X k =
      c • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        s • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        (2 : ℝ) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  unfold slotPoint midpoint
  module

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.slotPoint_sub_midpoint
statement:
theorem slotPoint_sub_midpoint (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2))
    (k l : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) :
    slotPoint X l c s - midpoint X k =
      c • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        s • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        (4 * (l : ℝ) - 4 * (k : ℝ) - 2) •
          CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  unfold slotPoint midpoint
  module

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.adjacentMove_slotPoint_left
statement:
theorem adjacentMove_slotPoint_left (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2))
    (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    (adjacentMove X hm k).forward 1 (slotPoint X k c s) =
      slotPoint X (k + 1) c s
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjacentMove,
    SmoothAmbientIsotopy.affineLocalizedPlaneRotation_endpoint_of_le_one]
  · rw [slotPoint_sub_midpoint_left,
      swapChart_rotate_pi m hm (-2) c s]
    unfold slotPoint midpoint
    module
  · rw [slotPoint_sub_midpoint_left]
    exact swapChart_circle_mem_inner m hm (-2) c s (by norm_num) hunit

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.adjacentMove_slotPoint_right
statement:
theorem adjacentMove_slotPoint_right (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2))
    (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) (c s : ℝ) (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    (adjacentMove X hm k).forward 1 (slotPoint X (k + 1) c s) =
      slotPoint X k c s
proof:
:= by
  rw [adjacentMove,
    SmoothAmbientIsotopy.affineLocalizedPlaneRotation_endpoint_of_le_one]
  · rw [slotPoint_sub_midpoint_right,
      swapChart_rotate_pi m hm 2 c s]
    unfold slotPoint midpoint
    module
  · rw [slotPoint_sub_midpoint_right]
    exact swapChart_circle_mem_inner m hm 2 c s (by norm_num) hunit

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.adjacentMove_slotPoint_fixed_of_left
statement:
theorem adjacentMove_slotPoint_fixed_of_left
    (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (k l : ℕ) (hl : l + 1 ≤ k) (c s : ℝ)
    (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (adjacentMove X hm k).forward t (slotPoint X l c s) =
      slotPoint X l c s
proof:
:= by
  apply (SmoothAmbientIsotopy.affineLocalizedPlaneRotation_fixedOn
    (m := m + 1) Real.pi (swapChart m hm) (midpoint X k))
      t ht (slotPoint X l c s)
  change 2 ≤ SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRadialSq
    ((swapChart m hm).symm (slotPoint X l c s - midpoint X k))
  rw [slotPoint_sub_midpoint]
  apply swapChart_circle_mem_outer m hm _ c s _ hunit
  have hlR : (l : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (4 * (l : ℝ) - 4 * (k : ℝ) - 2 + 6)]

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.adjacentMove_slotPoint_fixed_of_right
statement:
theorem adjacentMove_slotPoint_fixed_of_right
    (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (k l : ℕ) (hl : k + 2 ≤ l) (c s : ℝ)
    (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    (adjacentMove X hm k).forward t (slotPoint X l c s) =
      slotPoint X l c s
proof:
:= by
  apply (SmoothAmbientIsotopy.affineLocalizedPlaneRotation_fixedOn
    (m := m + 1) Real.pi (swapChart m hm) (midpoint X k))
      t ht (slotPoint X l c s)
  change 2 ≤ SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRadialSq
    ((swapChart m hm).symm (slotPoint X l c s - midpoint X k))
  rw [slotPoint_sub_midpoint]
  apply swapChart_circle_mem_outer m hm _ c s _ hunit
  have hlR : (k : ℝ) + 2 ≤ (l : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hl
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (4 * (l : ℝ) - 4 * (k : ℝ) - 2 - 6)]

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.addCircleCartesian_sq
statement:
private theorem addCircleCartesian_sq (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    (addCircleCartesian a).1 ^ 2 + (addCircleCartesian a).2 ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℂ := (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero a : Circle)
  have hz : ‖z‖ = 1 := by
    simpa [z, Submonoid.unitSphere] using
      (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero a : Circle).property
  have hs := Complex.sq_norm z
  rw [hz, one_pow, Complex.normSq_apply] at hs
  simp [addCircleCartesian, z, pow_two, hs]

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.circlePoint_eq_slotPoint
statement:
theorem circlePoint_eq_slotPoint (V : TamedField X)
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) O a =
      slotPoint X (V.orbitSlot O) (addCircleCartesian a).1
        (addCircleCartesian a).2
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.adjacentMove_circlePoint_left
statement:
theorem adjacentMove_circlePoint_left (V : TamedField X) (hm : 0 < m)
    (k : ℕ) (O P : V.OrbitIndex)
    (hO : (V.orbitSlot O : ℕ) = k)
    (hP : (V.orbitSlot P : ℕ) = k + 1)
    (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    (adjacentMove X hm k).forward 1
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) O a) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) P a
proof:
:= by
  rw [circlePoint_eq_slotPoint, circlePoint_eq_slotPoint, hO, hP]
  exact adjacentMove_slotPoint_left X hm k _ _ (addCircleCartesian_sq a)

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.adjacentMove_circlePoint_right
statement:
theorem adjacentMove_circlePoint_right (V : TamedField X) (hm : 0 < m)
    (k : ℕ) (O P : V.OrbitIndex)
    (hO : (V.orbitSlot O : ℕ) = k)
    (hP : (V.orbitSlot P : ℕ) = k + 1)
    (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    (adjacentMove X hm k).forward 1
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) P a) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) O a
proof:
:= by
  rw [circlePoint_eq_slotPoint, circlePoint_eq_slotPoint, hO, hP]
  exact adjacentMove_slotPoint_right X hm k _ _ (addCircleCartesian_sq a)

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.adjacentMove_fixedOn_target_of_slot_ne
statement:
theorem adjacentMove_fixedOn_target_of_slot_ne
    (V : TamedField X) (hm : 0 < m) (k : ℕ) (Q : V.OrbitIndex)
    (hQleft : (V.orbitSlot Q : ℕ) ≠ k)
    (hQright : (V.orbitSlot Q : ℕ) ≠ k + 1) :
    (adjacentMove X hm k).FixedOn
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V (by omega) Q)
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht x hx
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [circlePoint_eq_slotPoint]
  have hcases : (V.orbitSlot Q : ℕ) + 1 ≤ k ∨
      k + 2 ≤ (V.orbitSlot Q : ℕ) := by
    omega
  rcases hcases with hleft | hright
  · exact adjacentMove_slotPoint_fixed_of_left X hm k
      (V.orbitSlot Q) hleft _ _ (addCircleCartesian_sq a) t ht
  · exact adjacentMove_slotPoint_fixed_of_right X hm k
      (V.orbitSlot Q) hright _ _ (addCircleCartesian_sq a) t ht

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.adjacentMove_target_left
statement:
theorem adjacentMove_target_left (V : TamedField X) (hm : 0 < m)
    (k : ℕ) (O P : V.OrbitIndex)
    (hO : (V.orbitSlot O : ℕ) = k)
    (hP : (V.orbitSlot P : ℕ) = k + 1) :
    (adjacentMove X hm k).forward 1 ''
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V (by omega) O =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V (by omega) P
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a, (adjacentMove_circlePoint_left V hm k O P hO hP a).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) O a,
      ⟨a, rfl⟩, adjacentMove_circlePoint_left V hm k O P hO hP a⟩

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitAdjacentSlotSwap.adjacentMove_target_right
statement:
theorem adjacentMove_target_right (V : TamedField X) (hm : 0 < m)
    (k : ℕ) (O P : V.OrbitIndex)
    (hO : (V.orbitSlot O : ℕ) = k)
    (hP : (V.orbitSlot P : ℕ) = k + 1) :
    (adjacentMove X hm k).forward 1 ''
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V (by omega) P =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V (by omega) O
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a, (adjacentMove_circlePoint_right V hm k O P hO hP a).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) P a,
      ⟨a, rfl⟩, adjacentMove_circlePoint_right V hm k O P hO hP a⟩

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeInDim_northDelta

    (n : ℕ) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) :
    (tubeExplicitBridgeInDim n h2 k).northDelta = (k : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeInDim_ledger_delta
statement:
@[simp] theorem tubeExplicitBridgeInDim_ledger_delta
    (n : ℕ) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (k : ℕ) :
    ((tubeExplicitBridgeInDim n h2 k).northFrameLedger
      (tubeExplicitBridgeInDim n h2 k).canonicalTamedField).delta =
        (k : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  let B := tubeExplicitBridgeInDim n h2 k
  let V := B.canonicalTamedField
  calc
    (B.northFrameLedger V).delta = B.northFramedDelta V :=
      B.northFrameLedger_delta V
    _ = B.northDelta := (B.northDelta_eq V).symm
    _ = (k : ZMod 2) := tubeExplicitBridgeInDim_northDelta n h2 k

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.coreMap_apply_zero

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.contDiff_coreMap
statement: theorem contDiff_coreMap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (coreMap m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    simpa only [coreMap_apply_zero] using
      ((contDiff_radSq (m := m)).sub contDiff_const).div_const 2
  · simp only [coreMap_apply_ne_zero m _ hi]
    change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (EuclideanSpace.proj i.succ : E → ℝ)
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i.succ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.contDiff_levelMap
statement: theorem contDiff_levelMap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (levelMap m)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub CompactBirth.contDiff_cutoff).smul
    (contDiff_coreMap m)).add
    (CompactBirth.contDiff_cutoff.smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem levelMap_apply_zero (x : E) :
    levelMap m x 0 =
      (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) * ((radSq x - 1) / 2) +
        CompactBirth.cutoff x
proof:
:= by
  simp [levelMap]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap_apply_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem levelMap_apply_ne_zero (x : E) {i : Fin (m + 2)} (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    levelMap m x i = (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) * x i.succ
proof:
:= by
  simp [levelMap, hi]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.cutoff_ne_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cutoff_ne_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero {x : E}
    (hx : levelMap m x = 0) : CompactBirth.cutoff x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
  rw [levelMap_apply_zero, hc] at h0
  norm_num at h0

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.cutoff_lt_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem cutoff_lt_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero {x : E}
    (hx : levelMap m x = 0) : CompactBirth.cutoff x < 1
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (CompactBirth.cutoff_le_one x)
    (cutoff_ne_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx)

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.transverse_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hout := congrArg (fun q : F => q i) hx
  rw [levelMap_apply_ne_zero m x hi] at hout
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hout
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hout).resolve_left
    (sub_ne_zero.mpr (cutoff_lt_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx).ne')

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.normSq_eq_radSq_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem normSq_eq_radSq_of_levelMap_eq_zero {x : E}
    (hx : levelMap m x = 0) : CompactBirth.normSq x = radSq x
proof:
:= by
  unfold CompactBirth.normSq radSq
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
  have htail : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), x i.succ.succ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    intro i
    let j : Fin (m + 2) := i.succ
    have hj : j ≠ 0 := Fin.succ_ne_zero i
    have hz : x j.succ = 0 := transverse_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx hj
    simpa [j, hz]
  simp only [htail, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle
statement:
theorem levelMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle (x : E) :
    levelMap m x = 0 ↔ x ∈ standardCircle
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hc_lt := cutoff_lt_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx
    have hnorm := normSq_eq_radSq_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx
    have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
    rw [levelMap_apply_zero] at h0
    simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h0
    have hrs_lt : radSq x < 2 := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hrs_ge : 2 ≤ radSq x := not_lt.mp hnot
      have hc0 := CompactBirth.cutoff_nonneg x
      have hfac : 0 < 1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x := sub_pos.mpr hc_lt
      nlinarith
    have hc0 : CompactBirth.cutoff x = 0 := by
      apply CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero
      rw [hnorm]
      exact hrs_lt.le
    rw [hc0] at h0
    norm_num at h0
    have hrs : radSq x = 1 := by linarith
    have hgood : x ∈ tubeGood := by
      change 0 < radSq x
      rw [hrs]
      norm_num
    apply (wCoord_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle (m := m) 0 hgood).mp
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      rw [wCoord_apply_zero, cosK, sinK, rotP_zero]
      simp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd, one_mul, zero_mul, zero_add]
      have hr : rad x = 1 := by
        rw [rad, hrs, Real.sqrt_one]
      simp [hr]
    · by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (m + 1)
      · rw [hil, wCoord_apply_last, cosK, sinK, rotP_zero]
        simp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd, one_mul, zero_mul, sub_zero]
        exact transverse_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx
          (by exact lastW_ne_zero)
      · rw [wCoord_apply_mid 0 x hi hil]
        exact transverse_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx hi
  · rintro ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    have hnorm : CompactBirth.normSq (circleAt (m := m) theta) = 1 := by
      rw [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq, norm_circleAt, one_pow]
    have hc : CompactBirth.cutoff (circleAt (m := m) theta) = 0 :=
      CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero (by linarith)
    rw [levelMap, hc]
    simp only [sub_zero, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [coreMap, radSq_circleAt]
    · rw [coreMap_apply_ne_zero m _ hi]
      apply circleAt_apply_other theta
      · exact Fin.succ_ne_zero i
      · intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_one] at hv
        apply hi
        apply Fin.ext
        simp only [Fin.val_zero]
        omega

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap_eventuallyEq_coreMap
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen {y : E | CompactBirth.normSq y < 2} :=
    isOpen_lt CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.continuous continuous_const
  exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hx) fun y hy => by
    rw [levelMap, CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero hy.le]
    simp

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.coreMap_normalSlice
statement:
theorem coreMap_normalSlice (theta : ℝ) (w : F) :
    coreMap m (normalSlice 0 theta w) = normalModel m w
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [coreMap_apply_zero]
    unfold radSq normalSlice
    rw [tubeMap_apply_zero, tubeMap_apply_one]
    simp only [tubeA, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero,
      mul_one, mul_zero, sub_zero]
    simp [normalModel, PiLp.single_apply]
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta]
  · rw [coreMap_apply_ne_zero m _ hi]
    by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (m + 1)
    · subst i
      have hs : ((Fin.last (m + 1)).succ : Fin (m + 3)) =
          Fin.last (m + 2) := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp
      rw [normalSlice, hs, tubeMap_apply_last]
      simp [tubeB, normalModel, PiLp.single_apply, lastW_ne_zero]
    · rw [normalSlice, tubeMap_apply_mid 0 theta w hi hil]
      simp [normalModel, PiLp.single_apply, hi]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.hasFDerivAt_normalModel_zero
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_normalModel_zero :
    HasFDerivAt (normalModel m) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F) 0
proof:
:= by
  let p : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  have hp : HasFDerivAt (fun w : F => w 0) p 0 := by
    change HasFDerivAt (p : F → ℝ) p 0
    exact p.hasFDerivAt
  have hsq : HasFDerivAt (fun w : F => w 0 ^ 2 / 2)
      (0 : F →L[ℝ] ℝ) (0 : F) := by
    have hsq' : HasFDerivAt (fun w : F => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * w 0 ^ 2)
        (0 : F →L[ℝ] ℝ) (0 : F) := by
      simpa using (hp.pow 2).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
    convert hsq' using 1
    funext w
    ring
  unfold normalModel
  have hadd := (hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : F)).add
    (hsq.smul_const (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin (m + 2)) 1))
  have hder : ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F +
      (0 : F →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight
        (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin (m + 2)) 1) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F := by simp
  rw [hder] at hadd
  apply hadd.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards with w
  rfl

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_comp_normalSumCLM
statement:
theorem fderiv_coreMap_comp_normalSumCLM (theta : ℝ) :
    (fderiv ℝ (coreMap m) (circleAt theta)).comp (normalSumCLM 0 theta) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F
proof:
:= by
  have hcore : HasFDerivAt (coreMap m)
      (fderiv ℝ (coreMap m) (circleAt theta)) (normalSlice 0 theta 0) := by
    simpa only [normalSlice_zero] using
      ((contDiff_coreMap m).differentiable (by simp) (circleAt theta)).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp := hcore.comp (0 : F) (hasFDerivAt_normalSlice 0 theta 0)
  have heq : (coreMap m ∘ normalSlice 0 theta) = normalModel m := by
    funext w
    exact coreMap_normalSlice m theta w
  have hsame : HasFDerivAt (coreMap m ∘ normalSlice 0 theta)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F) 0 := by
    rw [heq]
    exact hasFDerivAt_normalModel_zero m
  exact hcomp.unique hsame

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_nuVec
statement:
theorem fderiv_coreMap_nuVec (theta : ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    fderiv ℝ (coreMap m) (circleAt theta) (nuVec 0 theta i) =
      EuclideanSpace.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun L : F →L[ℝ] F =>
      L (EuclideanSpace.single i 1))
    (fderiv_coreMap_comp_normalSumCLM m theta)
  simpa [normalSumCLM_single] using h

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.surjective_fderiv_coreMap_circleAt
statement:
theorem surjective_fderiv_coreMap_circleAt (theta : ℝ) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (coreMap m) (circleAt theta))
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  refine ⟨normalSumCLM 0 theta y, ?_⟩
  have h := congrArg (fun L : F →L[ℝ] F => L y)
    (fderiv_coreMap_comp_normalSumCLM m theta)
  exact h

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.X_fiber
statement: theorem X_fiber : (X m).fiber = standardCircle
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact levelMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle m x

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.flatOutside
statement:
theorem flatOutside :
    (X m).FlatOutside (background m) 0 2
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hn : 2 ≤ ‖x‖ := by simpa [dist_zero_right] using hx
  have hs : 4 ≤ CompactBirth.normSq x := by
    rw [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
  have hc := CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_one hs
  simp [X, levelMap, hc]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.fderiv_levelMap_nuVec
statement:
theorem fderiv_levelMap_nuVec (theta : ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    fderiv ℝ (levelMap m) (circleAt theta) (nuVec 0 theta i) =
      EuclideanSpace.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : CompactBirth.normSq (circleAt (m := m) theta) < 2 := by
    rw [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq, norm_circleAt, one_pow]
    norm_num
  rw [(levelMap_eventuallyEq_coreMap m hnorm).fderiv_eq]
  exact fderiv_coreMap_nuVec m theta i

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.fderiv_levelMap_tangentAt
statement:
theorem fderiv_levelMap_tangentAt (theta : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (levelMap m) (circleAt theta) (tangentAt theta) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let g := levelMap m
  have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (circleAt (m := m) theta) :=
    (contDiff_levelMap m).differentiable (by simp) |>.differentiableAt
  have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (circleAt (m := m)) theta :=
    contDiff_circleAt.differentiable (by simp) |>.differentiableAt
  have hcomp := fderiv_comp (x := theta) hg hc
  have happ := congrArg
    (fun L : ℝ →L[ℝ] F => L 1) hcomp
  have hzero : fderiv ℝ (g ∘ circleAt (m := m)) theta 1 = 0 := by
    have heq : g ∘ circleAt (m := m) = fun _ : ℝ => (0 : F) := by
      funext t
      exact (levelMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle m _).mpr
        (circleAt_mem_standardCircle t)
    rw [heq]
    simp
  rw [hzero, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, fderiv_circleAt_one] at happ
  exact happ.symm

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.gradVec_levelMap_circleAt
statement:
theorem gradVec_levelMap_circleAt (theta : ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    gradVec (levelMap m) i (circleAt theta) = nuVec 0 theta i
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right_basis (tubeFullONBasis m 0 theta).toBasis
  intro j
  change ⟪gradVec (levelMap m) i (circleAt theta),
      tubeFullONBasis m 0 theta j⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪nuVec 0 theta i, tubeFullONBasis m 0 theta j⟫_ℝ
  rw [tubeFullONBasis_apply]
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_zero, inner_gradVec,
      map_neg, fderiv_levelMap_tangentAt, neg_zero,
      inner_neg_right, inner_nuVec_tangentAt, neg_zero]
    rfl
  · rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_succ, inner_gradVec,
      fderiv_levelMap_nuVec, inner_nuVec_nuVec]
    simp [PiLp.single_apply]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.kerCross_levelMap_circleAt
statement:
theorem kerCross_levelMap_circleAt (theta : ℝ) :
    kerCross (levelMap m) (circleAt theta) = -(tangentAt theta)
proof:
:= by
  rw [kerCross, show (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m) i (circleAt theta)) =
      nuVec (m := m) 0 theta from
    funext fun i => gradVec_levelMap_circleAt m theta i]
  exact crossVec_nuVec m 0 theta

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.tauField_levelMap_circleAt
statement:
theorem tauField_levelMap_circleAt (theta : ℝ) :
    tauField (levelMap m) (circleAt theta) = -(tangentAt theta)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauField, kerCross_levelMap_circleAt, norm_neg, norm_tangentAt,
    inv_one, one_smul]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.frameAt_X_circleAt
statement:
theorem frameAt_X_circleAt (theta : ℝ) :
    frameAt (X m) (circleAt theta) = tubeFullFrame m 0 theta
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · simp [frameAt, X, tubeFullFrame, tauField_levelMap_circleAt]
  · simp [frameAt, X, tubeFullFrame, gradVec_levelMap_circleAt]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_X_circleAt
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_X_circleAt (theta : ℝ) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt (X m) (circleAt theta)) =
      tubeFullFrame m 0 theta
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameAt_X_circleAt, gramSchmidtNormed_tubeFullFrame]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.circleCurve_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem circleCurve_zero : circleCurve m 0 = circleAt (m := m) 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [circleCurve]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.circleCurve_closed
statement: theorem circleCurve_closed : circleCurve m 0 = circleCurve m 1
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    simp [circleCurve]
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      simp [circleCurve]
    · simp [circleCurve, circleAt_apply_other _ hi0 hi1]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.circleAt_eq_iff_mod
proof:
:= by
  have hcos : Real.cos theta = Real.cos theta' := by
    simpa using congrArg (fun x : E => x 0) h
  have hsin : Real.sin theta = Real.sin theta' := by
    simpa using congrArg (fun x : E => x 1) h
  have hone : Real.cos (theta' - theta) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.cos_sub, ← hcos, ← hsin]
    linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff _).mp hone
  exact ⟨z, by linarith⟩

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.circleCurve_eq_cases
statement:
theorem circleCurve_eq_cases {u v : I} (huv : circleCurve m u = circleCurve m v) :
    u = v ∨ (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := circleAt_eq_iff_mod (m := m) huv
  have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
  have huvZ : (v : ℝ) = (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) := by
    change 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ) =
      2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) at hz
    nlinarith
  have hzLowerR : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  have hzUpperR : (z : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
  have hzLower : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast hzLowerR
  have hzUpper : z ≤ (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hzUpperR
  rcases (show z = -1 ∨ z = 0 ∨ z = 1 by omega) with hzv | hzv | hzv
  · right; right
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hzv] at huvZ
    norm_num at huvZ
    exact huvZ.symm
  · right; left
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.circleAt_mem_X_fiber
statement:
theorem circleAt_mem_X_fiber (theta : ℝ) :
    circleAt (m := m) theta ∈ (X m).fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_fiber]
  exact circleAt_mem_standardCircle theta

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.circleAt_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem circleAt_mem_orbit (V : TamedField (X m)) (theta : ℝ) :
    circleAt (m := m) theta ∈ V.orbit (circleAt (m := m) 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact V.continuousCurve_mem_orbit (circleAt (m := m))
    contDiff_circleAt.continuous (circleAt_mem_X_fiber m) theta

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.paramFrameLoop_eq_tubeFrameLoop
statement:
theorem paramFrameLoop_eq_tubeFrameLoop (V : TamedField (X m)) :
    (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop = tubeFrameLoop m 0
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop (X m) (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).realCurve (u : ℝ) =
    rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m 0 (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)))
  unfold frameLoop
  rw [(simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).realCurve_coe]
  change rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
    (frameAt (X m) (circleAt (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))) = _
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_X_circleAt]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.orbitFrameClass_eq_one
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_eq_one (V : TamedField (X m)) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    V.orbitFrameClass O = 1
proof:
:= by
  let p : E := circleAt (m := m) 0
  let hp : p ∈ (X m).fiber := circleAt_mem_X_fiber m 0
  have hpoint : V.orbitPoint O ∈ V.orbit p := by
    have hmem := V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
    rw [X_fiber] at hmem
    obtain ⟨theta, htheta⟩ := hmem
    rw [← htheta]
    exact circleAt_mem_orbit m V theta
  calc
    V.orbitFrameClass O =
        V.fundamentalFrameClass (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) := rfl
    _ = V.fundamentalFrameClass hp :=
      V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit hp hpoint
    _ = loopClassZ2 (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
        (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed :=
      ((simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental).symm
    _ = loopClassZ2 (tubeFrameLoop m 0) (tubeFrameLoop_closed m 0) := by
      apply loopClassZ2_congr_fun
      exact paramFrameLoop_eq_tubeFrameLoop m V
    _ = 1 := by simpa using loopClassZ2_tubeFrameLoop m 0

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.orbitContribution_eq_zero
statement:
theorem orbitContribution_eq_zero (V : TamedField (X m)) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    V.orbitContribution O = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold TamedField.orbitContribution
  rw [orbitFrameClass_eq_one]
  decide

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.positiveSign_positiveDelta_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveSign_positiveDelta_eq_zero :
    (positiveSign m).positiveDelta = 0
proof:
:= by
  let V : TamedField (X m) := (X m).exists_tamedField.some
  rw [(positiveSign m).positiveDelta_eq V]
  unfold FiberSign.positiveFramedDelta TamedField.deltaOn
  apply Fintype.sum_eq_zero
  intro O
  split_ifs
  · exact orbitContribution_eq_zero m V O
  · rfl

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.negativeSign_negativeDelta_eq_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem negativeSign_negativeDelta_eq_zero :
    (negativeSign m).negativeDelta = 0
proof:
:= by
  change (negativeSign m).neg.positiveDelta = 0
  have heq : (negativeSign m).neg = positiveSign m := by
    apply FiberSign.eq_of_toFun_eq
    funext x
    simp [negativeSign, positiveSign]
  rw [heq, positiveSign_positiveDelta_eq_zero]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.orbitIndex_eq_circleOrbit
statement:
theorem orbitIndex_eq_circleOrbit (O : (field m).OrbitIndex) :
    O = circleOrbit m
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint : (field m).orbitPoint O ∈
      (field m).orbit (circleAt (m := m) 0) := by
    have hmem := (field m).orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
    rw [X_fiber] at hmem
    obtain ⟨theta, htheta⟩ := hmem
    rw [← htheta]
    exact circleAt_mem_orbit m (field m) theta
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [(field m).orbitPoint_orbit O]

name: Submission.CompactTubeConfiguration.positiveFrameLedger_eq_single_one
statement:
theorem positiveFrameLedger_eq_single_one :
    (positiveSign m).positiveFrameLedger (field m) = [(1 : ZMod 2)]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := (positiveSign m).positiveOrbitCollection (field m)
  let O₀ := circleOrbit m
  have hO₀ : ((O₀ : (field m).OrbitIndex) : Set E) ∈ A := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨(field m).orbit_subset_fiber
      (circleAt_mem_X_fiber m 0) hx, ?_⟩
    simp [positiveSign]
  have hcard : Fintype.card ((field m).SelectedOrbitIndex A) = 1 := by
    rw [Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]
    refine ⟨⟨O₀, hO₀⟩, ?_⟩
    intro Q
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact orbitIndex_eq_circleOrbit m Q.1
  let L := (field m).selectedFrameLedger A
  have hlength : L.length = 1 := by
    simp [L, TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, hcard]
  have hall : ∀ beta ∈ L, beta = (1 : ZMod 2) := by
    intro beta hbeta
    simp only [L, TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, List.mem_ofFn] at hbeta
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hbeta
    let Q := (Fintype.equivFin ((field m).SelectedOrbitIndex A)).symm i
    simpa [Q, orbitIndex_eq_circleOrbit m Q.1, O₀] using
      circleOrbit_frameClass m
  change L = [(1 : ZMod 2)]
  rw [L.eq_cons_of_length_one hlength]
  congr
  exact hall _ (by simp)

name: Submission.SameFiberGaugeAlignment.bijective_one_sub_of_norm_lt
statement:
theorem bijective_one_sub_of_norm_lt
    {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [CompleteSpace G]
    (T : G →L[ℝ] G) (h : ‖T‖ < 1) :
    Function.Bijective ((1 : G →L[ℝ] G) - T)
proof:
:= by
  let U : (G →L[ℝ] G)ˣ := Units.oneSub T h
  have hleft : Function.LeftInverse (↑U⁻¹ : G →L[ℝ] G)
      ((1 : G →L[ℝ] G) - T) := fun u => by
    exact congrArg (fun S : G →L[ℝ] G => S u) U.inv_mul
  have hright : Function.RightInverse (↑U⁻¹ : G →L[ℝ] G)
      ((1 : G →L[ℝ] G) - T) := fun u => by
    exact congrArg (fun S : G →L[ℝ] G => S u) U.mul_inv
  exact ⟨hleft.injective, hright.surjective⟩

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.cos_arctan_div
statement:
theorem cos_arctan_div {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :
    Real.cos (Real.arctan (v / u)) =
      u / Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := hu.ne'
  have hsum : 0 < u ^ 2 + v ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v]
  have haux : 0 < 1 + (v / u) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hsqrtAux : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + (v / u) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsqrtSum : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hquotNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / u :=
    div_nonneg hsqrtSum hu.le
  have hsqAux : Real.sqrt (1 + (v / u) ^ 2) ^ 2 =
      1 + (v / u) ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt haux.le
  have hsqQuot : (Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / u) ^ 2 =
      1 + (v / u) ^ 2 := by
    rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hsum.le]
    field_simp [hu0]
  have hsqrtEq : Real.sqrt (1 + (v / u) ^ 2) =
      Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / u := by
    nlinarith
  rw [Real.cos_arctan, hsqrtEq]
  field_simp [hu0, (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hsum).ne']

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sin_arctan_div
statement:
theorem sin_arctan_div {u v : ℝ} (hu : 0 < u) :

      v / Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := hu.ne'
  have hsum : 0 < u ^ 2 + v ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg v]
  have haux : 0 < 1 + (v / u) ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hsqrtAux : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + (v / u) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsqrtSum : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hquotNonneg : 0 ≤ Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / u :=
    div_nonneg hsqrtSum hu.le
  have hsqAux : Real.sqrt (1 + (v / u) ^ 2) ^ 2 =
      1 + (v / u) ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt haux.le
  have hsqQuot : (Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / u) ^ 2 =
      1 + (v / u) ^ 2 := by
    rw [div_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hsum.le]
    field_simp [hu0]
  have hsqrtEq : Real.sqrt (1 + (v / u) ^ 2) =
      Real.sqrt (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / u := by
    nlinarith
  rw [Real.sin_arctan, hsqrtEq]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_nonzero_pos_iff_zero
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ht
    by_contra hzero
    have hd0neg : d 0 < 0 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hzero) (hne 0)
    have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (d 0) (d t) :=
      ⟨hd0neg.le, ht.le⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := intermediate_value_univ 0 t hd hmem
    exact hne s hs
  · intro hzero
    by_contra ht
    have hdtneg : d t < 0 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt ht) (hne t)
    have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (d t) (d 0) :=
      ⟨hdtneg.le, hzero.le⟩
    obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := intermediate_value_univ t 0 hd hmem
    exact hne s hs

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_endpointOrientationRaw
statement:
theorem continuous_endpointOrientationRaw (a : ℝ) :
    Continuous (endpointOrientationRaw m a)
proof:
:= by
  unfold endpointOrientationRaw crossDet
  apply Continuous.matrix_det
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · simp only [crossRows, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.cons_zero]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp
      (continuous_planarTangent m)
  · simp only [crossRows, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.cons_succ]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp
      (contDiff_gradVec (levelMap m a) (contDiff_levelMap m a) i).continuous

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpointOrientationRaw_ne_zero_of_endpoint
statement:
theorem endpointOrientationRaw_ne_zero_of_endpoint
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hreg : x ∈ regularSet (levelMap m a))
    (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    endpointOrientationRaw m a x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hunit := crossDet_unitPlanarTangent_ne_zero m hreg hx ha
  apply hunit
  rw [unitPlanarTangent, crossDet_smul]
  change ‖planarTangent m x‖⁻¹ * endpointOrientationRaw m a x = 0
  rw [hzero, mul_zero]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.tangentOrientationSign_eq_of_curve
statement:
theorem tangentOrientationSign_eq_of_curve
    (a : ℝ) (p : ℝ → E) (hpcont : Continuous p)
    (hp : ∀ t, levelMap m a (p t) = 0)
    (hreg : ∀ t, p t ∈ regularSet (levelMap m a))
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) (t : ℝ) :
    tangentOrientationSign m a (p t) =
      tangentOrientationSign m a (p 0)
proof:
:= by
  let d : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => endpointOrientationRaw m a (p s)
  have hd : Continuous d :=
    (continuous_endpointOrientationRaw m a).comp hpcont
  have hdne : ∀ s, d s ≠ 0 := fun s =>
    endpointOrientationRaw_ne_zero_of_endpoint m (hreg s) (hp s) ha
  have hraw := continuous_nonzero_pos_iff_zero hd hdne t
  have hunitPos : ∀ s,
      0 < crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i (p s))
          (unitPlanarTangent m (p s)) ↔ 0 < d s := by
    intro s
    rw [unitPlanarTangent, crossDet_smul]
    change 0 < ‖planarTangent m (p s)‖⁻¹ * d s ↔ 0 < d s
    rw [mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left]
    exact inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr
      (planarTangent_ne_zero_of_endpoint m (hp s) ha))
  have hpos :
      (0 < crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i (p t))
          (unitPlanarTangent m (p t))) ↔
        0 < crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i (p 0))
          (unitPlanarTangent m (p 0)) := by
    rw [hunitPos t, hunitPos 0]
    exact hraw
  unfold tangentOrientationSign
  by_cases ht : 0 < crossDet
      (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i (p t))
      (unitPlanarTangent m (p t))
  · rw [if_pos ht, if_pos (hpos.mp ht)]
  · rw [if_neg ht, if_neg (fun h0 => ht (hpos.mpr h0))]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.anglePlanarTangent_rotation
statement:
theorem anglePlanarTangent_rotation (phi psi : ℝ) :
    anglePlanarTangent m psi =
      Real.cos (psi - phi) • anglePlanarTangent m phi -
        Real.sin (psi - phi) • anglePlanarNormal m phi
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext j
  have hAB : planeFirst m ≠ planeSecond m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
  by_cases hjA : j = planeFirst m
  · subst j
    simp [anglePlanarTangent, anglePlanarNormal, Real.cos_sub, Real.sin_sub,
      hAB]
    have hmul := congrArg (fun z : ℝ => Real.sin psi * z)
      (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq phi)
    ring_nf at hmul ⊢
    linarith
  · by_cases hjB : j = planeSecond m
    · subst j
      simp [anglePlanarTangent, anglePlanarNormal, Real.cos_sub, Real.sin_sub,
        hAB.symm]
      have hmul := congrArg (fun z : ℝ => Real.cos psi * z)
        (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq phi)
      ring_nf at hmul ⊢
      linarith
    · simp [anglePlanarTangent, anglePlanarNormal, hjA, hjB]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.anglePlanarNormal_rotation
statement:
theorem anglePlanarNormal_rotation (phi psi : ℝ) :
    anglePlanarNormal m psi =
      Real.sin (psi - phi) • anglePlanarTangent m phi +
        Real.cos (psi - phi) • anglePlanarNormal m phi
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext j
  have hAB : planeFirst m ≠ planeSecond m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
  by_cases hjA : j = planeFirst m
  · subst j
    simp [anglePlanarTangent, anglePlanarNormal, Real.cos_sub, Real.sin_sub,
      hAB]
    have hmul := congrArg (fun z : ℝ => Real.cos psi * z)
      (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq phi)
    ring_nf at hmul ⊢
    linarith
  · by_cases hjB : j = planeSecond m
    · subst j
      simp [anglePlanarTangent, anglePlanarNormal, Real.cos_sub, Real.sin_sub,
        hAB.symm]
      have hmul := congrArg (fun z : ℝ => Real.sin psi * z)
        (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq phi)
      ring_nf at hmul ⊢
      linarith
    · simp [anglePlanarTangent, anglePlanarNormal, hjA, hjB]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.unitPlanarNormal_eq_anglePlanarNormal
statement:
theorem unitPlanarNormal_eq_anglePlanarNormal {x : E} {phi : ℝ}
    (hfirst : unitPlanarNormal m x (planeFirst m) = Real.cos phi)
    (hsecond : unitPlanarNormal m x (planeSecond m) = Real.sin phi) :
    unitPlanarNormal m x = anglePlanarNormal m phi
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      change unitPlanarNormal m x (planeSecond m) =
        anglePlanarNormal m phi (planeSecond m)
      rw [hsecond]
      have hBA : planeSecond m ≠ planeFirst m := by
        intro h
        have := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
      simp [anglePlanarNormal, hBA]
  | cast i =>
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          change unitPlanarNormal m x (planeFirst m) =
            anglePlanarNormal m phi (planeFirst m)
          rw [hfirst]
          have hAB : planeFirst m ≠ planeSecond m := by
            intro h
            have := congrArg Fin.val h
            simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
          simp [anglePlanarNormal, hAB]
      | cast j =>
          change unitPlanarNormal m x j.castSucc.castSucc =
            anglePlanarNormal m phi j.castSucc.castSucc
          rw [unitPlanarNormal]
          have hjA : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ planeFirst m := by
            intro h
            have := congrArg Fin.val h
            simp [planeFirst] at this
            omega
          have hjB : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ planeSecond m := by
            intro h
            have := congrArg Fin.val h
            simp [planeSecond] at this
            omega
          simp [anglePlanarNormal, planarNormal_apply_transverse, hjA, hjB]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.unitPlanarTangent_apply_planeFirst
statement:

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.unitPlanarTangent_eq_anglePlanarTangent
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      change unitPlanarTangent m x (planeSecond m) =
        anglePlanarTangent m phi (planeSecond m)
      rw [unitPlanarTangent_apply_planeSecond, hnormal]
      have hBA : planeSecond m ≠ planeFirst m := by
        intro h
        have := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
      simp [anglePlanarTangent, anglePlanarNormal, hBA]
  | cast i =>
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          change unitPlanarTangent m x (planeFirst m) =
            anglePlanarTangent m phi (planeFirst m)
          rw [unitPlanarTangent_apply_planeFirst, hnormal]
          have hAB : planeFirst m ≠ planeSecond m := by
            intro h
            have := congrArg Fin.val h
            simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
          simp [anglePlanarTangent, anglePlanarNormal, hAB]
      | cast j =>
          change unitPlanarTangent m x j.castSucc.castSucc =
            anglePlanarTangent m phi j.castSucc.castSucc
          rw [unitPlanarTangent]
          have hjA : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ planeFirst m := by
            intro h
            have := congrArg Fin.val h
            simp [planeFirst] at this
            omega
          have hjB : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ planeSecond m := by
            intro h
            have := congrArg Fin.val h
            simp [planeSecond] at this
            omega
          simp [anglePlanarTangent, planarTangent_apply_transverse, hjA, hjB]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.orientedUnitPlanarTangent_rotation_of_angle
statement:
theorem orientedUnitPlanarTangent_rotation_of_angle
    {a : ℝ} {x y : E} {phi psi : ℝ}
    (hnormalX : unitPlanarNormal m x = anglePlanarNormal m phi)
    (hnormalY : unitPlanarNormal m y = anglePlanarNormal m psi)
    (hsign : tangentOrientationSign m a y =
      tangentOrientationSign m a x) :
    orientedUnitPlanarTangent m a y =
      Real.cos (tangentOrientationSign m a x * (psi - phi)) •
          orientedUnitPlanarTangent m a x -
        Real.sin (tangentOrientationSign m a x * (psi - phi)) •
          unitPlanarNormal m x
proof:
:= by
  have htangentX := unitPlanarTangent_eq_anglePlanarTangent m hnormalX
  have htangentY := unitPlanarTangent_eq_anglePlanarTangent m hnormalY
  rw [orientedUnitPlanarTangent, orientedUnitPlanarTangent,
    htangentX, htangentY, hnormalX, hsign]
  rcases tangentOrientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one m a x with hs | hs
  · rw [hs]
    norm_num
    exact anglePlanarTangent_rotation m phi psi
  · rw [hs]
    simp only [neg_mul, one_mul, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg, neg_smul,
      one_smul, sub_eq_add_neg, neg_neg]
    rw [anglePlanarTangent_rotation m phi psi]
    module

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.unitPlanarNormal_rotation_of_angle
statement:
theorem unitPlanarNormal_rotation_of_angle
    {a : ℝ} {x y : E} {phi psi : ℝ}
    (hnormalX : unitPlanarNormal m x = anglePlanarNormal m phi)
    (hnormalY : unitPlanarNormal m y = anglePlanarNormal m psi) :
    unitPlanarNormal m y =
      Real.sin (tangentOrientationSign m a x * (psi - phi)) •
          (tangentOrientationSign m a x • unitPlanarTangent m x) +
        Real.cos (tangentOrientationSign m a x * (psi - phi)) •
          unitPlanarNormal m x
proof:
:= by
  have htangentX := unitPlanarTangent_eq_anglePlanarTangent m hnormalX
  rw [hnormalX, hnormalY, htangentX]
  rcases tangentOrientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one m a x with hs | hs
  · rw [hs]
    norm_num
    exact anglePlanarNormal_rotation m phi psi
  · rw [hs]
    simp only [neg_mul, one_mul, Real.sin_neg, Real.cos_neg, neg_smul,
      one_smul, smul_neg, neg_neg]
    exact anglePlanarNormal_rotation m phi psi

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame_middle_eq
statement:
theorem endpointUnitFrame_middle_eq (a : ℝ) (x y : E)
    {i : Fin (m + 3)} (hi0 : i ≠ 0)
    (hilast : i ≠ Fin.last (m + 2)) :
    endpointUnitFrame m a x i = endpointUnitFrame m a y i
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Fin.eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi0
  induction k using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      exfalso
      apply hilast
      apply Fin.ext
      simp
  | cast k =>

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame_zero

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.rowsMatrix_endpointUnitFrame_rotation_of_angle
statement:
theorem rowsMatrix_endpointUnitFrame_rotation_of_angle
    {a : ℝ} {x y : E} {phi psi : ℝ}
    (hnormalX : unitPlanarNormal m x = anglePlanarNormal m phi)
    (hnormalY : unitPlanarNormal m y = anglePlanarNormal m psi)
    (hsign : tangentOrientationSign m a y =
      tangentOrientationSign m a x) :
    rowsMatrix (endpointUnitFrame m a y) =
      twistMat m (tangentOrientationSign m a x * (psi - phi)) *
        rowsMatrix (endpointUnitFrame m a x)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [StandardBirth.twistMat_mul_apply_birth]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    simp only [rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, endpointUnitFrame_zero]
    rw [endpointUnitFrame_last]
    have hrot := congrArg (fun v : E => v j)
      (orientedUnitPlanarTangent_rotation_of_angle m
        hnormalX hnormalY hsign)
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using hrot
  · rw [if_neg hi0]
    by_cases hilast : i = Fin.last (m + 2)
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      simp only [rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, endpointUnitFrame_last]
      have hrot := congrArg (fun v : E => v j)
        (unitPlanarNormal_rotation_of_angle m (a := a) hnormalX hnormalY)
      simpa [endpointUnitFrame_zero, orientedUnitPlanarTangent] using hrot
    · rw [if_neg hilast]
      simp only [rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun v : E => v j)
        (endpointUnitFrame_middle_eq m a y x hi0 hilast)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.normalFirst_sourcePointRight
statement:
theorem normalFirst_sourcePointRight (theta : ℝ) :
    normalFirst m (sourcePointRight m theta) =
      4 * sourceScale * Real.sqrt (sourceRadicandNorm theta) *
        Real.cos (sourceNormalAngle theta)
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalFirst, sourcePointRight_apply_planeFirst]
  have hradius : radiusSq m (sourcePointRight m theta) =
      sourceRadicandNorm theta := by
    simp [radiusSq, sourceRoot_normSq]
  rw [hradius, sourceNormalAngle_cos]
  have hsqrt0 : Real.sqrt (sourceRadicandNorm theta) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (sourceRadicandNorm_pos theta)).ne'
  have hfirst := sourceRoot_sq_sub_sq theta
  have hsecond := two_mul_sourceRootFirst_mul_sourceRootSecond theta
  have hnorm := sourceRoot_normSq theta
  unfold sourceRadicandFirst at hfirst
  unfold sourceRadicandSecond at hsecond
  field_simp [hsqrt0]
  linear_combination
    sourceRootFirst theta * hfirst +
      sourceRootSecond theta * hsecond - sourceRootFirst theta * hnorm

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.normalSecond_sourcePointRight
statement:
theorem normalSecond_sourcePointRight (theta : ℝ) :
    normalSecond m (sourcePointRight m theta) =
      4 * sourceScale * Real.sqrt (sourceRadicandNorm theta) *
        Real.sin (sourceNormalAngle theta)
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalSecond, sourcePointRight_apply_planeSecond]
  have hradius : radiusSq m (sourcePointRight m theta) =
      sourceRadicandNorm theta := by
    simp [radiusSq, sourceRoot_normSq]
  rw [hradius, sourceNormalAngle_sin]
  have hsqrt0 : Real.sqrt (sourceRadicandNorm theta) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (sourceRadicandNorm_pos theta)).ne'
  have hfirst := sourceRoot_sq_sub_sq theta
  have hsecond := two_mul_sourceRootFirst_mul_sourceRootSecond theta
  have hnorm := sourceRoot_normSq theta
  unfold sourceRadicandFirst at hfirst
  unfold sourceRadicandSecond at hsecond
  field_simp [hsqrt0]
  linear_combination
    sourceRootFirst theta * hsecond -
      sourceRootSecond theta * hfirst - sourceRootSecond theta * hnorm

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.norm_planarNormal_sourcePointRight
statement:
theorem norm_planarNormal_sourcePointRight (theta : ℝ) :
    ‖planarNormal m (sourcePointRight m theta)‖ =
      4 * sourceScale * Real.sqrt (sourceRadicandNorm theta)
proof:
:= by
  let K := 4 * sourceScale * Real.sqrt (sourceRadicandNorm theta)
  have hK : 0 < K := by
    dsimp [K]
    exact mul_pos (mul_pos (by norm_num) sourceScale_pos)
      (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (sourceRadicandNorm_pos theta))
  have hsq : ‖planarNormal m (sourcePointRight m theta)‖ ^ 2 = K ^ 2 := by
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
      inner_planarNormal_self,
      normalFirst_sourcePointRight, normalSecond_sourcePointRight]
    calc
      (4 * sourceScale * Real.sqrt (sourceRadicandNorm theta) *
              Real.cos (sourceNormalAngle theta)) ^ 2 +
            (4 * sourceScale * Real.sqrt (sourceRadicandNorm theta) *
              Real.sin (sourceNormalAngle theta)) ^ 2 =
          K ^ 2 * (Real.cos (sourceNormalAngle theta) ^ 2 +
            Real.sin (sourceNormalAngle theta) ^ 2) := by
              dsimp [K]
              ring
      _ = K ^ 2 := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (planarNormal m (sourcePointRight m theta))]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.unitPlanarNormal_sourcePointRight_planeFirst
statement:

    unitPlanarNormal m (sourcePointRight m theta) (planeFirst m) =
      Real.cos (sourceNormalAngle theta)
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitPlanarNormal, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    planarNormal_apply_planeFirst]
  rw [norm_planarNormal_sourcePointRight, normalFirst_sourcePointRight]
  have hK : 4 * sourceScale * Real.sqrt (sourceRadicandNorm theta) ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) sourceScale_pos.ne')
      (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (sourceRadicandNorm_pos theta)).ne'
  rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hK, one_mul]

    planarNormal_apply_planeSecond]
  rw [norm_planarNormal_sourcePointRight, normalSecond_sourcePointRight]

    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) sourceScale_pos.ne')
      (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (sourceRadicandNorm_pos theta)).ne'
  rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hK, one_mul]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpointFrameWinding_mod_two
proof:

  rcases hsigma with rfl | rfl
  · simp [endpointFrameWinding]
  · rw [endpointFrameWinding, if_neg (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) ≠ 1)]
    change (-1 : ZMod 2) = 1
    decide

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRightFrameAngle_closed
statement:
theorem sourceRightFrameAngle_closed :
    sourceRightFrameAngle m 1 = sourceRightFrameAngle m 0 +
      2 * Real.pi * endpointFrameWinding
        (tangentOrientationSign m (-1 / 2) (sourcePointRight m 0))
proof:
:= by
  let sigma := tangentOrientationSign m (-1 / 2) (sourcePointRight m 0)
  have hsigma := tangentOrientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one m (-1 / 2)
    (sourcePointRight m 0)
  have hcast := endpointFrameWinding_cast hsigma
  change sigma * (sourceNormalAngle (2 * Real.pi * (1 : ℝ)) -
      sourceNormalAngle 0) =
    sigma * (sourceNormalAngle (2 * Real.pi * (0 : ℝ)) -
      sourceNormalAngle 0) +
      2 * Real.pi * ((endpointFrameWinding sigma : ℤ) : ℝ)
  norm_num
  rw [sourceNormalAngle_two_pi]
  rw [hcast]
  ring

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpointPlaneLoop_coe

theorem endpointPlaneLoop_coe (L : SO2AngleLoop) (u : I) :
    (endpointPlaneLoop m L u : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) =
      twistMat m (L.angle u)
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.loopClassZ2_endpointPlaneLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_endpointPlaneLoop (L : SO2AngleLoop) :
    loopClassZ2 (endpointPlaneLoop m L) (endpointPlaneLoop_closed m L) =
      (L.winding : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : 3 ≤ m + 3 := by omega
  have hbase := L.loopClassZ2_frame hdim
  have hconj := loopClassZ2_const_conj (swapRotSO m)
    (L.frame (m + 3)) (L.frame_closed (m + 3))
  calc
    loopClassZ2 (endpointPlaneLoop m L) (endpointPlaneLoop_closed m L) =
        loopClassZ2 (L.frame (m + 3)) (L.frame_closed (m + 3)) := by
          simpa only [endpointPlaneLoop] using hconj
    _ = (L.winding : ZMod 2) := hbase

          ((sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop 0)
proof:

  intro u

  rw [sourceRight_paramFrameLoop_apply]
  change rowsMatrix (endpointUnitFrame m (-1 / 2)
      (sourcePointRight m (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)))) =
    (endpointPlaneLoop m (sourceRightSO2AngleLoop m) u :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *
      ((sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop 0 :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRight_paramFrameClass_eq_one
statement:
theorem sourceRight_paramFrameClass_eq_one
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    loopClassZ2 (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
        (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed = 1
proof:
:= by
  let P := sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V
  let L := sourceRightSO2AngleLoop m
  let R := endpointPlaneLoop m L * ContinuousMap.const I (P.paramFrameLoop 0)
  have hRclosed : R 0 = R 1 := by
    change endpointPlaneLoop m L 0 * P.paramFrameLoop 0 =
      endpointPlaneLoop m L 1 * P.paramFrameLoop 0
    rw [endpointPlaneLoop_closed]
  have heq : P.paramFrameLoop = R :=
    sourceRight_paramFrameLoop_eq_plane_mul_const m V
  calc
    loopClassZ2 P.paramFrameLoop P.paramFrameLoop_closed =
        loopClassZ2 R hRclosed :=
      loopClassZ2_congr_fun P.paramFrameLoop_closed hRclosed heq
    _ = loopClassZ2 (endpointPlaneLoop m L)
        (endpointPlaneLoop_closed m L) := by
      exact loopClassZ2_mul_const_right (endpointPlaneLoop m L)
        (endpointPlaneLoop_closed m L) (P.paramFrameLoop 0)
    _ = (L.winding : ZMod 2) := loopClassZ2_endpointPlaneLoop m L
    _ = 1 := sourceRightSO2AngleLoop_winding_mod_two m

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.ChronologicalSaddleOrientedArcFlowData.positiveEndpoint_mem_branchOrbit
statement:
theorem positiveEndpoint_mem_branchOrbit
    (F : ChronologicalSaddleOrientedArcFlowData
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    spacePart (F.field.base.flow
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho)
        (a ^ 2)) ∈
      ((D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex p.1 :
        (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁)
proof:
:= by
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hend, hsign, hquad⟩ := F.positiveEndpoint p
  have hmem := T.saddlePositiveParam_mem_branch_orbit_full H hindex p.1
    rho a u hquad hsign
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq t ht)
    hu
    ((D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      T.radius_le)
    (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
    (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht)
  rw [hend] at hmem
  simpa [T, chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit,
    StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex]
    using hmem
