name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.ChronologicalSaddleOrientedArcFlowData.positiveMateOrbit_eq
statement:
theorem positiveMateOrbit_eq
    (F : ChronologicalSaddleOrientedArcFlowData
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex p.1 =
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex (A.mate p).1
proof:
:= by
  let gamma := A.chosenMateArc p
  let V := D.chronologicalAfterField t ht
  have hsafe : |a ^ 2| ≤ F.field.safeTime := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg a)]
    exact F.safe
  have hflow := F.field.flowSlicePath_endpoints_mem_same_orbit
    gamma.toPath (F.chosenMateArc_mem p)
    (fun u => (gamma.mem_exterior u).2.1)
    (fun u => (gamma.mem_exterior u).1)
    hsafe (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht) V
  have hmem₁ := positiveEndpoint_mem_branchOrbit
    (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) (hindex := hindex) F p
  have hmem₂ := positiveEndpoint_mem_branchOrbit
    (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) (hindex := hindex) F (A.mate p)
  have heq₁ := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hmem₁
  have heq₂ := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hmem₂
  have heqflow := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hflow
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact heq₁.symm.trans (heqflow.symm.trans heq₂)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.ChronologicalSaddleOrientedArcFlowData.negativeMateOrbit_eq
statement:
theorem negativeMateOrbit_eq
    (F : ChronologicalSaddleOrientedArcFlowData
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A)

    D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex p.2 =

proof:
:= by
  let gamma := A.chosenMateArc p
  let V := D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht
  have hsafe : |-(a ^ 2)| ≤ F.field.safeTime := by
    rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg a)]
    exact F.safe
  have hflow := F.field.flowSlicePath_endpoints_mem_same_orbit
    gamma.toPath (F.chosenMateArc_mem p)
    (fun u => (gamma.mem_exterior u).2.1)
    (fun u => (gamma.mem_exterior u).1)
    hsafe (by
      simpa only [chronologicalBeforeTime, sub_eq_add_neg,
        FramedLevelCobordism.toLevelCobordismData] using
        D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht) V
  have hmem₁ := negativeEndpoint_mem_branchOrbit
    (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) (hindex := hindex) F p
  have hmem₂ := negativeEndpoint_mem_branchOrbit
    (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) (hindex := hindex) F (A.mate p)
  have heq₁ := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hmem₁
  have heq₂ := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hmem₂
  have heqflow := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hflow
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact heq₁.symm.trans (heqflow.symm.trans heq₂)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.ChronologicalSaddleRegularOrbitArcRecovery.positive_ne_of_mate_eq_flipSecond
statement:
theorem positive_ne_of_mate_eq_flipSecond
    (H : ChronologicalSaddleRegularOrbitArcRecovery
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) (hindex := hindex))
    (hmate : ∀ p, A.mate p = saddleBranchEndFlipSecond p) :
    D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .negative ≠
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .positive
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  let p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch := (.negative, .negative)
  let q : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch := (.positive, .negative)
  have harc : Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
      (fun r => (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r rho)
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
        D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) p q) := by
    simpa [p, q] using H.positiveArc heq
  have hq : q = A.mate p :=
    A.eq_mate_of_ne_arc (by simp [p, q]) harc
  rw [hmate p] at hq
  simp [p, q, saddleBranchEndFlipSecond] at hq

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleTopologyDichotomy_of_orientedExteriorArcs
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleTopologyDichotomy_of_orientedExteriorArcs
    (A :
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData rho)
    (F : ChronologicalSaddleOrientedArcFlowData
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A)
    (H : ChronologicalSaddleRegularOrbitArcRecovery
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) (hindex := hindex)) :
    D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeTopology t ht hindex ∨
      D.ChronologicalSaddleSplitTopology t ht hindex
proof:
:= by
  have hdich := StandardMorseEventAt.saddleExteriorArcPairing_eq_flipSecond_or_eq_flipFirst
    (D.position.eventModel t ht)
    (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
      D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
    rho (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) A
  rcases hdich with hsecond | hfirst
  · right
    refine {
      positive_ne := ChronologicalSaddleRegularOrbitArcRecovery.positive_ne_of_mate_eq_flipSecond
        (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) (hindex := hindex) H hsecond
      negative_eq := ?_ }
    let p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch := (.negative, .negative)
    have h := ChronologicalSaddleOrientedArcFlowData.negativeMateOrbit_eq
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) (hindex := hindex) F p
    rw [hsecond p] at h
    simpa [p, saddleBranchEndFlipSecond] using h
  · left
    refine {

  rcases hsigns with hccw | hcw | hs | he | hw
  · obtain ⟨s₁, s₂, s₂', s₃, s₄, s₄', s₅, s₆, s₆', s₇, s₈, s₈'⟩ := hccw
    exact Or.inl ⟨fullChartWindingLoop_of_octagonPlacement T hr P s₁ s₂ s₂' s₃
      s₄ s₄' s₅ s₆ s₆' s₇ s₈ s₈'⟩

    exact Or.inr ⟨fullChartWindingLoop_rev_of_octagonPlacement T hr P s₁ s₂ s₂'
      s₃ s₄ s₄' s₅ s₆ s₆' s₇ s₈ s₈'⟩
  · obtain ⟨s₁, s₂, s₂', s₃, s₄, s₄', s₅, s₆, s₆', s₇, s₈, s₈'⟩ := hs
    exact Or.inl ⟨fullChartWindingLoop_of_octagonPlacement_south T hr P s₁ s₂

  · obtain ⟨s₁, s₂, s₂', s₃, s₄, s₄', s₅, s₆, s₆', s₇, s₈, s₈'⟩ := he
    exact Or.inl ⟨fullChartWindingLoop_of_octagonPlacement_east T hr P s₁ s₂

statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_incoming₁
    (F : SaddleRelativeFrameSpliceData Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat) :
    Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ =
      F.exteriorClass₁ +
        loopClassZ2 (F.model.incoming₁.frame (n + 1))
          (F.model.incoming₁.frame_closed (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hprod := F.incoming₁_product_closed
  have hcongr :
      loopClassZ2 (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop O₁)
          (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop_closed O₁) =
        loopClassZ2 (F.exterior₁ * F.model.incoming₁.frame (n + 1)) hprod :=
    loopClassZ2_congr (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop_closed O₁) hprod
      F.incoming₁Homotopy F.incoming₁_closed
  have hmul :=
    loopClassZ2_mul F.exterior₁ (F.model.incoming₁.frame (n + 1))
      F.exterior₁_closed (F.model.incoming₁.frame_closed (n + 1)) hprod
  exact hcongr.trans hmul

    loopClassZ2_congr (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop_closed O₂) hprod

  have hmul :=
    loopClassZ2_mul F.exterior₂ (F.model.incoming₂.frame (n + 1))

name: Submission.SaddleRelativeFrameSpliceData.orbitFrameClass_outgoing
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_outgoing
    (F : SaddleRelativeFrameSpliceData Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat) :
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
      F.exteriorClass₁ + F.exteriorClass₂ +
        loopClassZ2 (F.model.outgoing.frame (n + 1))
          (F.model.outgoing.frame_closed (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hext := F.exterior_product_closed
  have hprod := F.outgoing_product_closed
  have hcongr :
      loopClassZ2 (Vafter.orbitFrameLoop Ohat)
          (Vafter.orbitFrameLoop_closed Ohat) =
        loopClassZ2 ((F.exterior₁ * F.exterior₂) *
          F.model.outgoing.frame (n + 1)) hprod :=
    loopClassZ2_congr (Vafter.orbitFrameLoop_closed Ohat) hprod
      F.outgoingHomotopy F.outgoing_closed
  have hmulOut :=
    loopClassZ2_mul (F.exterior₁ * F.exterior₂)
      (F.model.outgoing.frame (n + 1))
      hext (F.model.outgoing.frame_closed (n + 1)) hprod
  have hmulExt :=
    loopClassZ2_mul F.exterior₁ F.exterior₂
      F.exterior₁_closed F.exterior₂_closed hext
  calc
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
        loopClassZ2 ((F.exterior₁ * F.exterior₂) *
          F.model.outgoing.frame (n + 1)) hprod := hcongr
    _ = loopClassZ2 (F.exterior₁ * F.exterior₂) hext +
          loopClassZ2 (F.model.outgoing.frame (n + 1))
            (F.model.outgoing.frame_closed (n + 1)) := hmulOut
    _ = F.exteriorClass₁ + F.exteriorClass₂ +
          loopClassZ2 (F.model.outgoing.frame (n + 1))
            (F.model.outgoing.frame_closed (n + 1)) := by
      rw [hmulExt]; rfl

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.exists_scaled_twice_K_lt_one
statement:
theorem exists_scaled_twice_K_lt_one
    (raw : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) → ℝ)
    (hraw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ raw)
    (hsupp : HasCompactSupport raw)
    (hcollar : ∀ v, tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v → raw v = 0) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n),
      2 * a.K < 1 ∧ a.toFun = fun v => ε * raw v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hraw.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hsupp (by simp)
  let ε : ℝ := 1 / (4 * ((K : ℝ) + 1))
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) := K.coe_nonneg
  have hden : 0 < 4 * ((K : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hε : 0 < ε := one_div_pos.mpr hden
  have htwiceReal : 2 * (ε * (K : ℝ)) < 1 := by
    have hnum : 2 * (K : ℝ) < 4 * ((K : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith
    calc
      2 * (ε * (K : ℝ)) =
          (2 * (K : ℝ)) / (4 * ((K : ℝ) + 1)) := by
            dsimp [ε]
            field_simp
      _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hden).2 hnum
  let κ : NNReal := ⟨ε * (K : ℝ), mul_nonneg hε.le hK0⟩
  have htwiceκ : 2 * κ < 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast htwiceReal
  have hκ : κ < 1 := by
    have hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ := bot_le
    nlinarith
  let scaled : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) → ℝ := fun v => ε * raw v
  have hscaled : ContDiff ℝ ∞ scaled := contDiff_const.mul hraw
  have hscaledLip : LipschitzWith κ scaled := by
    rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
    intro x z
    have h := hK.dist_le_mul x z
    have h' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hε.le
    dsimp [scaled, κ]
    rw [Real.dist_eq, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hε]
    change ε * |raw x - raw z| ≤ (ε * (K : ℝ)) * dist x z
    exact h'.trans_eq (by ring)
  have hfd (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :
      fderiv ℝ scaled v = ε • fderiv ℝ raw v := by
    exact ((hraw.differentiable (by simp) v).hasFDerivAt.const_mul ε).fderiv
  have hsmall (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :
      ‖fderiv ℝ scaled v‖ < 1 := by
    rw [hfd, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε]
    have hderiv : ‖fderiv ℝ raw v‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) :=
      norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ hK
    have hhalf : ε * (K : ℝ) < 1 := by nlinarith
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hderiv hε.le).trans_lt hhalf
  let base := VerticalAmplitude.ofNormFDerivLtOne scaled hscaled
    (fun v hv => by simp [scaled, hcollar v hv]) hsmall
  refine ⟨ε, hε, {
    toVerticalAmplitude := base
    K := κ
    K_lt_one := hκ
    lipschitz := hscaledLip }, htwiceκ, rfl⟩

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.exists_scaled_twice_K_lt_one_below
statement:
theorem exists_scaled_twice_K_lt_one_below
    (raw : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) → ℝ)
    (hraw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ raw)
    (hsupp : HasCompactSupport raw)
    (hcollar : ∀ v, tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v → raw v = 0)
    {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ε < δ ∧ ∃ a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n),
      2 * a.K < 1 ∧ a.toFun = fun v => ε * raw v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hraw.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hsupp (by simp)
  let baseScale : ℝ := 1 / (4 * ((K : ℝ) + 1))
  let ε : ℝ := min (δ / 2) baseScale
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) := K.coe_nonneg
  have hden : 0 < 4 * ((K : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hbase : 0 < baseScale := one_div_pos.mpr hden
  have hε : 0 < ε := by
    exact lt_min (half_pos hδ) hbase
  have hεδ : ε < δ := by
    have hle : ε ≤ δ / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    linarith
  have htwiceBase : 2 * (baseScale * (K : ℝ)) < 1 := by
    have hnum : 2 * (K : ℝ) < 4 * ((K : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith
    calc
      2 * (baseScale * (K : ℝ)) =
          (2 * (K : ℝ)) / (4 * ((K : ℝ) + 1)) := by
            dsimp [baseScale]
            field_simp
      _ < 1 := (div_lt_one hden).2 hnum
  have htwiceReal : 2 * (ε * (K : ℝ)) < 1 := by
    have hle : ε * (K : ℝ) ≤ baseScale * (K : ℝ) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (min_le_right _ _) hK0
    linarith
  let κ : NNReal := ⟨ε * (K : ℝ), mul_nonneg hε.le hK0⟩
  have htwiceκ : 2 * κ < 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast htwiceReal
  have hκ : κ < 1 := by
    have hκ0 : 0 ≤ κ := bot_le
    nlinarith
  let scaled : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) → ℝ := fun v => ε * raw v
  have hscaled : ContDiff ℝ ∞ scaled := contDiff_const.mul hraw
  have hscaledLip : LipschitzWith κ scaled := by
    rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
    intro x z
    have h := hK.dist_le_mul x z
    have h' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hε.le
    dsimp [scaled, κ]
    rw [Real.dist_eq, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hε]
    change ε * |raw x - raw z| ≤ (ε * (K : ℝ)) * dist x z
    exact h'.trans_eq (by ring)
  have hfd (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :
      fderiv ℝ scaled v = ε • fderiv ℝ raw v := by
    exact ((hraw.differentiable (by simp) v).hasFDerivAt.const_mul ε).fderiv
  have hsmall (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :
      ‖fderiv ℝ scaled v‖ < 1 := by
    rw [hfd, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε]
    have hderiv : ‖fderiv ℝ raw v‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) :=
      norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ hK
    have hhalf : ε * (K : ℝ) < 1 := by nlinarith
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hderiv hε.le).trans_lt hhalf
  let base := VerticalAmplitude.ofNormFDerivLtOne scaled hscaled
    (fun v hv => by simp [scaled, hcollar v hv]) hsmall
  refine ⟨ε, hε, hεδ, {
    toVerticalAmplitude := base
    K := κ
    K_lt_one := hκ
    lipschitz := hscaledLip }, htwiceκ, rfl⟩

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.eventuallyEq_diffeomorph_symm_translation
statement:
theorem eventuallyEq_diffeomorph_symm_translation
    (a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n))
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} {c : ℝ}
    (ha : a.toFun =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun _ => c)) :
    (fun w => a.diffeomorph.symm w) =ᶠ[nhds (a.diffeomorph x)]
      (fun w => w - c • timeVec)
proof:
:= by
  have htend : Tendsto (fun w => a.diffeomorph.symm w)
      (nhds (a.diffeomorph x)) (nhds x) := by
    have hc := (a.diffeomorph.symm.continuous.continuousAt :
      ContinuousAt (fun w => a.diffeomorph.symm w) (a.diffeomorph x))
    change Tendsto (fun w => a.diffeomorph.symm w)
      (nhds (a.diffeomorph x))
      (nhds (a.diffeomorph.symm (a.diffeomorph x))) at hc
    rw [a.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply] at hc
    exact hc
  have hacomp : ∀ᶠ w in nhds (a.diffeomorph x),
      a (a.diffeomorph.symm w) = c := htend.eventually ha
  filter_upwards [hacomp] with w hw
  have hinv : a.diffeomorph (a.diffeomorph.symm w) = w :=
    a.diffeomorph.apply_symm_apply w
  rw [SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply] at hinv
  change a.diffeomorph.symm w = w - c • timeVec
  change a.diffeomorph.symm w + a (a.diffeomorph.symm w) • timeVec = w at hinv
  rw [hw] at hinv
  calc
    a.diffeomorph.symm w =
        (a.diffeomorph.symm w + c • timeVec) - c • timeVec := by abel
    _ = w - c • timeVec := by rw [hinv]

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.forward_mem_inversePullback_timeCritical_iff_of_eventuallyEq
statement:
theorem forward_mem_inversePullback_timeCritical_iff_of_eventuallyEq
    (a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n))
    (hsmall : 2 * a.K < 1) (D : FramedLevelCobordism n)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} {c : ℝ}
    (ha : a.toFun =ᶠ[nhds x] (fun _ => c)) :
    a.diffeomorph x ∈
        timeCritical ((a.inverse hsmall).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback D).G ↔
      x ∈ timeCritical D.G
proof:
:= by
  let y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) := a.diffeomorph x
  let translate : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) := fun w => w - c • timeVec
  have hsymm : (fun w => a.diffeomorph.symm w) =ᶠ[nhds y] translate := by
    simpa [y, translate] using a.eventuallyEq_diffeomorph_symm_translation ha
  have hshift : (fun w => verticalShift (a.inverse hsmall) w) =ᶠ[nhds y]
      translate := by
    filter_upwards [hsymm] with w hw
    rw [← SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply,
      a.inverse_diffeomorph hsmall]
    exact hw
  have hlocal :
      (fun w => ((a.inverse hsmall).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback D).G w)
          =ᶠ[nhds y] (fun w => D.G (translate w)) := by
    filter_upwards [hshift] with w hw
    rw [VerticalAmplitude.pullback_G, hw]
  have hax : a x = c := ha.self_of_nhds
  have hy : y = x + c • timeVec := by
    dsimp [y]
    rw [verticalShift, hax]
  have htranslate : translate y = x := by
    dsimp [translate]
    rw [hy]
    abel
  have hvalue :
      ((a.inverse hsmall).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback D).G y = D.G x := by
    have h := hlocal.self_of_nhds
    change ((a.inverse hsmall).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback D).G y =
      D.G (translate y) at h
    rw [h, htranslate]
  have htranslateDeriv :
      HasFDerivAt translate (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) y := by
    exact (hasFDerivAt_id y).sub_const (c • timeVec)
  have hcomposedDeriv :
      fderiv ℝ (fun w => D.G (translate w)) y = fderiv ℝ D.G x := by
    have hD := (D.smooth.differentiable (by simp) (translate y)).hasFDerivAt
    have hcomp := hD.comp y htranslateDeriv
    calc
      fderiv ℝ (fun w => D.G (translate w)) y =
          fderiv ℝ D.G (translate y) := by
            simpa [Function.comp_def] using hcomp.fderiv
      _ = fderiv ℝ D.G x := by rw [htranslate]
  have hderiv :
      fderiv ℝ ((a.inverse hsmall).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback D).G y =
        fderiv ℝ D.G x := by
    rw [hlocal.fderiv_eq, hcomposedDeriv]
  change
    (((a.inverse hsmall).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback D).G y = 0 ∧
        ¬Surjective
          (spatialDeriv
            ((a.inverse hsmall).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback D).G y)) ↔
      D.G x = 0 ∧ ¬Surjective (spatialDeriv D.G x)
  have hspatial :
      spatialDeriv ((a.inverse hsmall).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback D).G y =
        spatialDeriv D.G x := by
    unfold spatialDeriv
    rw [hderiv]
  rw [hvalue, hspatial]

name: Submission.FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.exists_twiceSmall_of_finite
statement:
theorem exists_twiceSmall_of_finite
    (raw : Ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) → ℝ)
    (core : Ι → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
    (hsmooth : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (raw i))
    (hsupp : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (raw i))
    (hcollar : ∀ i v,
      tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v → raw i v = 0)
    (noninterference : ∀ i v, v ∈ core i →
      ∀ j, j ≠ i → raw j v = 0) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n),
      2 * a.K < 1 ∧
      a.toFun = (fun v => ε * totalRaw raw v) ∧
      ∀ i v, v ∈ core i → a v = ε * raw i v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, a, htwice, ha⟩ :=
    SmallVerticalAmplitude.exists_scaled_twice_K_lt_one
      (totalRaw raw) (contDiff_totalRaw raw hsmooth)
      (hasCompactSupport_totalRaw raw hsupp)
      (totalRaw_collar_zero raw hcollar)
  refine ⟨ε, hε, a, htwice, ha, ?_⟩
  intro i v hv
  rw [show a.toFun v = ε * totalRaw raw v by rw [ha]]
  rw [totalRaw_eq_on_core raw core noninterference i hv]

proof:
:= by

    by_contra h

      ((D.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter (le_of_not_gt h)) v hv.1.1 rfl)
  have hupper : tcoord v < (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    by_contra h

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.covers_fiber_within_morseRadius
statement:
theorem covers_fiber_within_morseRadius
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (p : Σ _ : I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hp : p ∈ R.criticalParameters)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v (R.center p) < ε →
      R.output.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < r ∧
        R.criticalAmbientParam p hp u = v
proof:
:= by
  let P := B.chart p.1
  let f := P.cutoffAffineHeight χ R.covector
  let M := R.localMorseNormalForm p hp
  let a := R.amplitude
  let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) := P.param p.2
  let c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) := R.center p
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f :=
    P.contDiff_cutoffAffineHeight χ R.covector
  have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (recenter f p.2) 0 :=
    contDiffAt_infty.mp (contDiff_recenter hsmooth p.2).contDiffAt 2
  have hcrit : fderiv ℝ (recenter f p.2) 0 = 0 :=
    fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero
      (nondegenerateCriticalAt_recenter hsmooth
        (R.critical_nondegenerate p hp)).1
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hM⟩ := M.exists_preimage_norm_lt hf hcrit hr
  have hpdom : p.2 ∈ P.domain :=
    B.core_subset_domain p.1 (R.critical_mem_core p hp)
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hP⟩ :=
    P.exists_param_of_fiber_near (B.domain_open p.1) hpdom
      (ball_mem_nhds p.2 hδ)
  have hac : a.diffeomorph c = x := by
    have haeq : a.diffeomorph = R.forward.diffeomorph.symm := by
      simpa [a] using R.amplitude_diffeomorph
    rw [haeq]
    dsimp [c, x, center]
    exact R.forward.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply _
  have htendsto : Tendsto (fun v => a.diffeomorph v)
      (nhds c) (nhds x) := by
    rw [← hac]
    exact a.diffeomorph.continuous.continuousAt
  have hnear : (fun v => a.diffeomorph v) ⁻¹' ball x ε₀ ∈ nhds c :=
    htendsto (ball_mem_nhds x hε₀)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnear
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hzero
  have hvball : v ∈ ball c ε := by
    simpa [mem_ball, c] using hv
  have haBall : a.diffeomorph v ∈ ball x ε₀ := hball hvball
  have haDist : dist (a.diffeomorph v) (P.param p.2) < ε₀ := by
    simpa [mem_ball, x] using haBall
  have haZero : C.G (a.diffeomorph v) = 0 := by
    simpa [output, VerticalAmplitude.pullback_G,
      SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply, a] using hzero
  obtain ⟨z, hzball, _hzdom, hzparam⟩ :=
    hP (a.diffeomorph v) haDist haZero
  have hy : ‖z - p.2‖ < δ := by
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hzball
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hMu⟩ := hM (z - p.2) hy
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
  change R.forward.diffeomorph (P.param (p.2 + M.param u)) = v
  rw [← R.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm]
  calc
    a.diffeomorph.symm (P.param (p.2 + M.param u)) =
        a.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z) := by
          congr 2
          rw [hMu, add_sub_cancel]
    _ = a.diffeomorph.symm (a.diffeomorph v) := by rw [hzparam]
    _ = v := a.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply v

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.contDiff_separatedChartGradient
statement:
theorem contDiff_separatedChartGradient
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (D : FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs R.criticalEventCenter)
    (i : I) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (R.separatedChartGradient D i)
proof:
:= by
  exact (scalarAdjointCLM.contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_rightFDeriv (R.contDiff_separatedChartTimeUncurried D i))).clm_apply
      contDiff_const

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.separatedChartGradient_eq_chartGradient
statement:
theorem separatedChartGradient_eq_chartGradient
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (D : FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs R.criticalEventCenter)
    (i : I) (ε : ℝ) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    R.separatedChartGradient D i (ε, z) =
      chartGradient (fun u => R.separatedChartTimeUncurried D i (ε, u)) z
proof:
:= by
  unfold separatedChartGradient chartGradient
  have h := fderiv_section_eq_rightFDeriv
    (R.contDiff_separatedChartTimeUncurried D i) ε z
  change fderiv ℝ (fun u => R.separatedChartTimeUncurried D i (ε, u)) z =
    rightFDeriv (R.separatedChartTimeUncurried D i) (ε, z) at h
  rw [h]

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.separatedChartGradient_zero_scale
statement:
theorem separatedChartGradient_zero_scale
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (D : FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs R.criticalEventCenter)
    (i : I) (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    R.separatedChartGradient D i (0, z) =
      (B.chart i).cutoffAffineGradient χ (R.covector, z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.separatedChartGradient_eq_chartGradient]
  rw [(B.chart i).cutoffAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient]
  congr 2
  funext u
  simp [separatedChartTimeUncurried]

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.isOpen_chartProtectedParameters
statement:
theorem isOpen_chartProtectedParameters
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (D : FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs R.criticalEventCenter) (i : I) :
    IsOpen (R.chartProtectedParameters D i)
proof:
:= by
  apply isOpen_iUnion
  intro e
  exact Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage
    (R.forward.diffeomorph.continuous.comp (B.chart i).param_smooth.continuous)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.isCompact_chartAwayParameters
statement:
theorem isCompact_chartAwayParameters
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (D : FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs R.criticalEventCenter) (i : I) :
    IsCompact (R.chartAwayParameters D i)
proof:
:=
  (B.compact_core i).diff (R.isOpen_chartProtectedParameters D i)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.separatedChartGradient_zero_ne_zero_on_away
statement:
theorem separatedChartGradient_zero_ne_zero_on_away
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (D : FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs R.criticalEventCenter)
    (i : I) {z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
    (hz : z ∈ R.chartAwayParameters D i) :
    R.separatedChartGradient D i (0, z) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hcutoff :
      (B.chart i).cutoffAffineGradient χ (R.covector, z) = 0 := by
    rw [← R.separatedChartGradient_zero_scale D i z]
    exact hzero
  have hdom : (B.chart i).domain ∈ nhds z :=
    (B.domain_open i).mem_nhds (B.core_subset_domain i hz.1)
  have hwcrit : R.firstOutputParam i z ∈ timeCritical R.output.G := by
    exact ((B.chart i).forwardParam_mem_inversePullback_timeCritical_iff_cutoffGradient_eq_zero
      χ R.covector R.forward R.forward_toFun R.twice_K_lt_one hdom).2 hcutoff
  have hlower : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < tcoord (R.firstOutputParam i z) := by
    by_contra h
    exact hwcrit.2
      ((R.output.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter (le_of_not_gt h))
        (R.firstOutputParam i z) hwcrit.1 rfl)
  have hupper : tcoord (R.firstOutputParam i z) < (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    by_contra h
    exact hwcrit.2
      ((R.output.sliceRegular_of_three_quarter_le (le_of_not_gt h))
        (R.firstOutputParam i z) hwcrit.1 rfl)
  have hwcore : R.firstOutputParam i z ∈ coreCriticalPoints R.output :=
    ⟨hwcrit, hlower.le, hupper.le⟩
  let e : GlobalCriticalEvent R :=
    ⟨R.firstOutputParam i z, R.mem_criticalCenters_iff.mpr hwcore⟩
  have hprotected : z ∈ R.chartProtectedParameters D i := by
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    change R.firstOutputParam i z ∈
      ball (R.firstOutputParam i z) (D.radius e / 2)
    rw [mem_ball, dist_self]
    linarith [D.radius_pos e]
  exact hz.2 hprotected

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.eventually_separatedChartGradient_ne_zero_on_away
statement:
theorem eventually_separatedChartGradient_ne_zero_on_away
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (D : FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs R.criticalEventCenter) (i : I) :
    ∀ᶠ ε in nhds (0 : ℝ), ∀ z ∈ R.chartAwayParameters D i,
      R.separatedChartGradient D i (ε, z) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (R.isCompact_chartAwayParameters D i).eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
  intro z hz
  exact (isClosed_singleton.isOpen_compl.preimage
      (R.contDiff_separatedChartGradient D i).continuous).mem_nhds
    (R.separatedChartGradient_zero_ne_zero_on_away D i hz)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.exists_uniform_valueSeparation_stabilityRadius
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_valueSeparation_stabilityRadius
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (D : FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs R.criticalEventCenter) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ {ε : ℝ}, |ε| < δ → ∀ i z,
      z ∈ R.chartAwayParameters D i →
        R.separatedChartGradient D i (ε, z) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hall : ∀ᶠ ε in nhds (0 : ℝ), ∀ i z,
      z ∈ R.chartAwayParameters D i →
        R.separatedChartGradient D i (ε, z) ≠ 0 := by
    exact Filter.eventually_all.mpr fun i =>
      R.eventually_separatedChartGradient_ne_zero_on_away D i
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hall
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro ε hε i z hz
  have hεball : ε ∈ ball (0 : ℝ) δ := by
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hε
  exact hball hεball i z hz

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.nonempty_criticalValueShiftData
statement:
theorem nonempty_criticalValueShiftData
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ) :
    Nonempty (CriticalValueShiftData R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := R.nonempty_disjointCriticalCutoffs
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, a, htwice, ha, hacore⟩ :=
    FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.exists_twiceSmall_of_finite
      (R.criticalValueRaw D) (R.criticalEventCore D)
      (R.criticalValueRaw_smooth D)
      (R.criticalValueRaw_compactSupport D)
      (R.criticalValueRaw_collar_zero D)
      (R.criticalValueRaw_noninterference D)
  refine ⟨{
    cutoffs := D
    scale := ε
    scale_pos := hε
    forward := a
    twice_K_lt_one := htwice
    forward_toFun := ha
    forward_eq_rank_on_core := ?_ }⟩
  intro e v hv
  rw [hacore e v hv, R.criticalValueRaw_eq_rank_on_core D e hv]

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.nonempty_stableCriticalValueShiftData
statement:
theorem nonempty_stableCriticalValueShiftData
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ) :
    Nonempty (StableCriticalValueShiftData R)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨D⟩ := R.nonempty_disjointCriticalCutoffs
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hstable⟩ :=
    R.exists_uniform_valueSeparation_stabilityRadius D
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεδ, a, htwice, ha⟩ :=
    SmallVerticalAmplitude.exists_scaled_twice_K_lt_one_below
      (FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.totalRaw (R.criticalValueRaw D))
      (FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.contDiff_totalRaw
        (R.criticalValueRaw D) (R.criticalValueRaw_smooth D))
      (FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.hasCompactSupport_totalRaw
        (R.criticalValueRaw D) (R.criticalValueRaw_compactSupport D))
      (FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.totalRaw_collar_zero
        (R.criticalValueRaw D) (R.criticalValueRaw_collar_zero D)) hδ
  let T : CriticalValueShiftData R := {
    cutoffs := D
    scale := ε
    scale_pos := hε
    forward := a
    twice_K_lt_one := htwice
    forward_toFun := ha
    forward_eq_rank_on_core := by
      intro e v hv
      rw [show a.toFun v = ε *
          FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.totalRaw (R.criticalValueRaw D) v by
        rw [ha]]
      rw [FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.totalRaw_eq_on_core
        (R.criticalValueRaw D) (R.criticalEventCore D)
        (R.criticalValueRaw_noninterference D) e hv]
      rw [R.criticalValueRaw_eq_rank_on_core D e hv] }
  refine ⟨{
    toCriticalValueShiftData := T
    noNewOnAway := ?_ }⟩
  intro i z hz
  apply hstable
  · change |ε| < δ
    rw [abs_of_pos hε]
    exact hεδ
  · exact hz

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.amplitude_diffeomorph
statement:
theorem amplitude_diffeomorph (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) :
    S.amplitude.diffeomorph = S.forward.diffeomorph.symm
proof:
:=
  S.forward.inverse_diffeomorph S.twice_K_lt_one

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm
statement:
theorem amplitude_diffeomorph_symm (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) :
    S.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm = S.forward.diffeomorph
proof:
:= by

  rfl

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter_time
statement:
theorem shiftedCenter_time (S : CriticalValueShiftData R)
    (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R) :
    tcoord (S.shiftedCenter e) = R.shiftedCriticalTime S.scale e
proof:
:= by
  rw [shiftedCenter, SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply,
    tcoord_verticalShift]
  rw [S.forward_eq_rank_on_core e _
    (R.criticalEventCenter_mem_core S.cutoffs e)]
  rfl

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter_time_injective
statement:
theorem shiftedCenter_time_injective (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) :

proof:
:= by

  apply R.shiftedCriticalTime_injective S.scale_pos
  simpa only [S.shiftedCenter_time] using hef

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter_injective
statement:
theorem shiftedCenter_injective (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) :

proof:
:= by

  exact S.shiftedCenter_time_injective (congrArg tcoord hef)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.forward_eventuallyEq_rank_of_mem_openCore
statement:
theorem forward_eventuallyEq_rank_of_mem_openCore
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    (hx : x ∈ ball (R.criticalEventCenter e) (S.cutoffs.radius e / 2)) :
    S.forward.toFun =ᶠ[nhds x]
      (fun _ => S.scale * R.criticalEventRank e)
proof:
:= by
  have hnhds : ball (R.criticalEventCenter e) (S.cutoffs.radius e / 2) ∈
      nhds x := Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hx
  filter_upwards [hnhds] with w hw
  exact S.forward_eq_rank_on_core e w (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hw)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.shifted_mem_timeCritical_iff_of_mem_openCore
statement:
theorem shifted_mem_timeCritical_iff_of_mem_openCore
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    (hx : x ∈ ball (R.criticalEventCenter e) (S.cutoffs.radius e / 2)) :
    S.forward.diffeomorph x ∈ timeCritical S.output.G ↔
      x ∈ timeCritical R.output.G
proof:
:= by
  simpa [output, amplitude] using
    S.forward.forward_mem_inversePullback_timeCritical_iff_of_eventuallyEq
      S.twice_K_lt_one R.output
      (S.forward_eventuallyEq_rank_of_mem_openCore e hx)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter_mem_timeCritical
statement:
theorem shiftedCenter_mem_timeCritical
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R) :
    S.shiftedCenter e ∈ timeCritical S.output.G
proof:
:= by
  apply (S.shifted_mem_timeCritical_iff_of_mem_openCore e ?_).2
  · exact e.2 |> R.mem_criticalCenters_iff.mp |>.1
  · rw [mem_ball, dist_self]
    linarith [S.cutoffs.radius_pos e]

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter_mem_openMiddle
statement:
theorem shiftedCenter_mem_openMiddle
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R) :
    1 / 4 < tcoord (S.shiftedCenter e) ∧
      tcoord (S.shiftedCenter e) < 3 / 4
proof:
:= by
  let x := R.criticalEventCenter e
  have hx := R.criticalEventCenter_mem_openMiddle e
  have hleft := S.forward.abs_apply_lt_sub_quarter hx.1
  have hright := S.forward.abs_apply_lt_threeQuarter_sub hx.2
  have hneg : -|S.forward x| ≤ S.forward x := neg_abs_le _
  have hpos : S.forward x ≤ |S.forward x| := le_abs_self _
  change 1 / 4 < tcoord (S.forward.diffeomorph x) ∧
    tcoord (S.forward.diffeomorph x) < 3 / 4
  rw [SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply, tcoord_verticalShift]
  constructor <;> linarith

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter_mem_coreCriticalPoints
statement:
theorem shiftedCenter_mem_coreCriticalPoints
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R) :
    S.shiftedCenter e ∈ coreCriticalPoints S.output
proof:
:=
  ⟨S.shiftedCenter_mem_timeCritical e,
    (S.shiftedCenter_mem_openMiddle e).1.le,
    (S.shiftedCenter_mem_openMiddle e).2.le⟩

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.separatedChartParam_time
statement:
theorem separatedChartParam_time
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (i : I)
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    tcoord (S.separatedChartParam i z) =
      R.separatedChartTimeUncurried S.cutoffs i (S.scale, z)
proof:
:= by
  rw [separatedChartParam, SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply,
    tcoord_verticalShift, S.forward_toFun]
  rw [firstOutputParam, R.installedChartTime]
  rfl

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.separatedChartParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_gradient_eq_zero
statement:
theorem separatedChartParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_gradient_eq_zero
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (i : I)
    {z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
    (hdom : (B.chart i).domain ∈ nhds z) :
    S.separatedChartParam i z ∈ timeCritical S.output.G ↔
      R.separatedChartGradient S.cutoffs i (S.scale, z) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let P := B.chart i
  let param : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) := S.separatedChartParam i
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ param := by
    exact S.forward.diffeomorph.contDiff.comp
      (R.forward.diffeomorph.contDiff.comp P.param_smooth)
  have hfiber : ∀ᶠ u in nhds z, S.output.G (param u) = 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hdom] with u hu
    rw [CriticalValueShiftData.output, VerticalAmplitude.pullback_G]
    change R.output.G
      (verticalShift S.amplitude
        (S.forward.diffeomorph (R.firstOutputParam i u))) = 0
    rw [← SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply,
      S.amplitude_diffeomorph,
      S.forward.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply]
    rw [FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.output,
      VerticalAmplitude.pullback_G]
    change C.G
      (verticalShift R.amplitude
        (R.forward.diffeomorph (P.param u))) = 0
    rw [← SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply,
      R.amplitude_diffeomorph,
      R.forward.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply]
    exact P.param_fiber u hu
  have hinjective : Injective (fderiv ℝ param z) := by
    have hfun : param = fun u =>
        S.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
          (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param u)) := by
      funext u
      rw [S.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm, R.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm]
      rfl
    rw [hfun]
    have hinner :
        fderiv ℝ (fun u => R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param u)) z =
          (fderiv ℝ R.amplitude.equiv.symm (P.param z)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ P.param z) := by
      exact ((R.amplitude.contDiff_equiv_symm.differentiable (by simp)
        (P.param z)).hasFDerivAt.comp z
          ((P.param_smooth.differentiable (by simp) z).hasFDerivAt)).fderiv
    have houter :
        fderiv ℝ
            (fun u => S.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
              (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param u))) z =
          (fderiv ℝ S.amplitude.equiv.symm
              (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z))).comp
            (fderiv ℝ
              (fun u => R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param u)) z) := by
      exact ((S.amplitude.contDiff_equiv_symm.differentiable (by simp)
          (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z))).hasFDerivAt.comp z
        (((R.amplitude.contDiff_equiv_symm.comp P.param_smooth).differentiable
          (by simp) z).hasFDerivAt)).fderiv
    rw [houter, hinner]
    exact (S.amplitude.fderiv_equiv_symm_injective
      (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z))).comp
        ((R.amplitude.fderiv_equiv_symm_injective (P.param z)).comp
          (P.fderiv_param_injective hdom))
  have hcritical := surfaceParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
    S.output param z hsmooth hfiber hinjective
  have htime : (fun u => tcoord (param u)) =
      (fun u => R.separatedChartTimeUncurried S.cutoffs i (S.scale, u)) := by
    funext u
    simpa [param] using S.separatedChartParam_time i u
  rw [hcritical, R.separatedChartGradient_eq_chartGradient]
  rw [htime]

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.exists_separatedChartParameter_of_coreCritical
statement:
theorem exists_separatedChartParameter_of_coreCritical
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R)
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    (hv : v ∈ coreCriticalPoints S.output) :
    ∃ i z, z ∈ B.core i ∧ S.separatedChartParam i z = v
proof:
:= by
  have hvfiber : v ∈ S.output.fiber :=
    coreCriticalPoints_subset_fiber S.output hv
  have hwfiber : S.amplitude.diffeomorph v ∈ R.output.fiber := by
    exact S.amplitude.verticalShift_mem_fiber hvfiber
  obtain ⟨i, z, hz, hparam⟩ :=
    B.exists_pullback_chart_parameter R.amplitude hwfiber
  refine ⟨i, z, hz, ?_⟩
  rw [separatedChartParam, ← S.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm]
  rw [firstOutputParam, ← R.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm]
  rw [hparam]
  exact S.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply v

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.nonempty_eventTransportShrink
statement:
theorem nonempty_eventTransportShrink
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R) :
    Nonempty (EventTransportShrink S e)
proof:
:= by
  let M := S.ownerModel e
  have hcenter : M.param 0 = R.criticalEventCenter e := by
    rw [M.param_zero]
    exact R.criticalEventOwner_center e
  have htend : Tendsto M.param (nhds (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
      (nhds (R.criticalEventCenter e)) := by
    have hcont := M.param_smooth.continuousAt
    change Tendsto M.param (nhds (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
      (nhds (M.param 0)) at hcont
    rw [hcenter] at hcont
    exact hcont
  have hhalf : 0 < S.cutoffs.radius e / 2 := by
    linarith [S.cutoffs.radius_pos e]
  have hpre : M.param ⁻¹'
      ball (R.criticalEventCenter e) (S.cutoffs.radius e / 2) ∈ nhds 0 :=
    htend (ball_mem_nhds _ hhalf)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hpre
  let r := min δ M.radius
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hδ M.radius_pos
  refine ⟨{
    radius := r
    radius_pos := hr
    radius_le := min_le_right _ _
    param_mem_openCore := ?_ }⟩
  intro u hu
  apply hball
  rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
  exact hu.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.transportedParam_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem transportedParam_zero
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R) :
    S.transportedParam e 0 = S.shiftedCenter e
proof:
:= by
  rw [transportedParam, (S.ownerModel e).param_zero, shiftedCenter]
  exact congrArg S.forward.diffeomorph (R.criticalEventOwner_center e)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.transportedParam_fiber
statement:
theorem transportedParam_fiber
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hu : ‖u‖ < (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius) :
    S.output.G (S.transportedParam e u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let M := S.ownerModel e
  have huM : ‖u‖ < M.radius :=
    hu.trans_le (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius_le
  rw [output, VerticalAmplitude.pullback_G]
  change R.output.G
    (verticalShift S.amplitude
      (S.forward.diffeomorph (M.param u))) = 0
  rw [← SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply,
    S.amplitude_diffeomorph,
    S.forward.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply]
  exact M.param_fiber u huM

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.transportedParam_time_model
statement:
theorem transportedParam_time_model
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hu : ‖u‖ < (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius) :
    tcoord (S.transportedParam e u) =
      tcoord (S.shiftedCenter e) +
        morseQuadratic (S.ownerModel e).index (u 0, u 1)
proof:
:= by
  let M := S.ownerModel e
  have huM : ‖u‖ < M.radius :=
    hu.trans_le (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius_le
  have hopen := (S.eventTransportShrink e).param_mem_openCore u hu
  have hcore : M.param u ∈ R.criticalEventCore S.cutoffs e :=
    Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hopen
  rw [transportedParam, SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply,
    tcoord_verticalShift,
    S.forward_eq_rank_on_core e (M.param u) hcore,
    M.time_model u huM,
    S.shiftedCenter_time, shiftedCriticalTime]
  have hcenterTime :
      tcoord (R.center (R.criticalEventOwner e).1) =
        tcoord (R.criticalEventCenter e) :=
    congrArg tcoord (R.criticalEventOwner_center e)
  rw [hcenterTime]
  ring

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.transportedParam_critical_model
statement:
theorem transportedParam_critical_model
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R)
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hu : ‖u‖ < (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius) :
    (S.transportedParam e u ∈ timeCritical S.output.G ↔ u = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let M := S.ownerModel e
  have huM : ‖u‖ < M.radius :=
    hu.trans_le (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius_le
  have hopen := (S.eventTransportShrink e).param_mem_openCore u hu
  exact (S.shifted_mem_timeCritical_iff_of_mem_openCore e hopen).trans
    (M.critical_model u huM)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.transportedParam_covers_fiber
statement:
theorem transportedParam_covers_fiber
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v (S.shiftedCenter e) < ε →
      S.output.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖u‖ < (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius ∧
          S.transportedParam e u = v
proof:
:= by
  let p := (R.criticalEventOwner e).1
  let hp : p ∈ R.criticalParameters := R.criticalEventOwner_mem e
  let T := S.eventTransportShrink e
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hcover⟩ :=
    R.covers_fiber_within_morseRadius p hp T.radius_pos
  have hac : S.amplitude.diffeomorph (S.shiftedCenter e) = R.center p := by
    rw [S.amplitude_diffeomorph, shiftedCenter, ← R.criticalEventOwner_center e]
    exact S.forward.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply _
  have htend : Tendsto (fun v => S.amplitude.diffeomorph v)
      (nhds (S.shiftedCenter e)) (nhds (R.center p)) := by
    rw [← hac]
    exact S.amplitude.diffeomorph.continuous.continuousAt
  have hnear : (fun v => S.amplitude.diffeomorph v) ⁻¹'
      ball (R.center p) ε₀ ∈ nhds (S.shiftedCenter e) :=
    htend (ball_mem_nhds _ hε₀)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnear
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hzero
  have hvball : v ∈ ball (S.shiftedCenter e) ε := by
    simpa [mem_ball] using hv
  have haBall : S.amplitude.diffeomorph v ∈ ball (R.center p) ε₀ :=
    hball hvball
  have haDist : dist (S.amplitude.diffeomorph v) (R.center p) < ε₀ := by
    simpa [mem_ball] using haBall
  have haZero : R.output.G (S.amplitude.diffeomorph v) = 0 := by
    simpa [output, VerticalAmplitude.pullback_G,
      SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply] using hzero
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hparam⟩ := hcover (S.amplitude.diffeomorph v) haDist haZero
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
  change S.forward.diffeomorph (R.criticalAmbientParam p hp u) = v
  rw [hparam, ← S.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm]
  exact S.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply v

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.StableCriticalValueShiftData.coreCriticalPoints_subset_range_shiftedCenter
statement:
theorem coreCriticalPoints_subset_range_shiftedCenter
    (S : StableCriticalValueShiftData R) :
    coreCriticalPoints S.toCriticalValueShiftData.output ⊆
      Set.range S.toCriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter
proof:
:= by
  let T := S.toCriticalValueShiftData
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨i, z, hzcore, hzv⟩ :=
    T.exists_separatedChartParameter_of_coreCritical hv
  have hdom : (B.chart i).domain ∈ nhds z :=
    (B.domain_open i).mem_nhds (B.core_subset_domain i hzcore)
  have hvparam : T.separatedChartParam i z ∈ timeCritical T.output.G := by
    rw [hzv]
    exact hv.1
  by_cases hprotected : z ∈ R.chartProtectedParameters T.cutoffs i
  · obtain ⟨e, heball⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hprotected
    have hxcrit : R.firstOutputParam i z ∈ timeCritical R.output.G := by
      exact (T.shifted_mem_timeCritical_iff_of_mem_openCore e heball).1
        (by simpa [CriticalValueShiftData.separatedChartParam] using hvparam)
    have hecore : R.firstOutputParam i z ∈
        closedBall (R.criticalEventCenter e) (T.cutoffs.radius e / 2) :=
      Metric.ball_subset_closedBall heball
    have hxmiddle : R.firstOutputParam i z ∈
        tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ) :=
      T.cutoffs.support_subset_middle e
        (T.cutoffs.core_subset_support e hecore)
    have hxcore : R.firstOutputParam i z ∈ coreCriticalPoints R.output :=
      ⟨hxcrit, hxmiddle.1.le, hxmiddle.2.le⟩
    let f : GlobalCriticalEvent R :=
      ⟨R.firstOutputParam i z, R.mem_criticalCenters_iff.mpr hxcore⟩
    have hfe : f = e := by
      by_contra hne
      have hxf : R.firstOutputParam i z ∈
          ball (R.criticalEventCenter f) (T.cutoffs.radius f) := by
        change dist (R.firstOutputParam i z) (R.firstOutputParam i z) <
          T.cutoffs.radius f
        simpa using T.cutoffs.radius_pos f
      have hxe : R.firstOutputParam i z ∈
          ball (R.criticalEventCenter e) (T.cutoffs.radius e) :=
        T.cutoffs.core_subset_support e hecore
      exact Set.disjoint_left.1
        (T.cutoffs.pairwise_disjoint_support hne) hxf hxe
    have hxcenter :
        R.firstOutputParam i z = R.criticalEventCenter e := by
      change R.criticalEventCenter f = R.criticalEventCenter e
      rw [hfe]
    refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
    rw [← hzv, CriticalValueShiftData.separatedChartParam,
      hxcenter, CriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter]
  · have hzaway : z ∈ R.chartAwayParameters T.cutoffs i :=
      ⟨hzcore, hprotected⟩
    have hgradient :
        R.separatedChartGradient T.cutoffs i (T.scale, z) = 0 :=
      (T.separatedChartParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_gradient_eq_zero i hdom).1
        hvparam
    exact (S.noNewOnAway i z hzaway hgradient).elim

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.StableCriticalValueShiftData.range_shiftedCenter_eq_coreCriticalPoints
statement:
theorem range_shiftedCenter_eq_coreCriticalPoints
    (S : StableCriticalValueShiftData R) :
    Set.range S.toCriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter =
      coreCriticalPoints S.toCriticalValueShiftData.output
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro v ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact S.toCriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter_mem_coreCriticalPoints e
  · exact S.coreCriticalPoints_subset_range_shiftedCenter

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.StableCriticalValueShiftData.toMorseAtlas
statement:
theorem toMorseAtlas (S : StableCriticalValueShiftData R) :
    MorseAtlas S.toCriticalValueShiftData.output where
  localModel
proof:
:= by
    intro v hv
    rw [← S.range_shiftedCenter_eq_coreCriticalPoints] at hv
    rcases hv with ⟨e, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨S.toCriticalValueShiftData.transportedStandardMorseEvent e⟩
  distinct_times := by
    intro v hv w hw hvw
    rw [← S.range_shiftedCenter_eq_coreCriticalPoints] at hv hw
    rcases hv with ⟨e, rfl⟩
    rcases hw with ⟨f, rfl⟩
    exact congrArg S.toCriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter
      (S.toCriticalValueShiftData.shiftedCenter_time_injective hvw)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.exists_valueSeparatedMorsePosition
statement:
theorem exists_valueSeparatedMorsePosition
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C I) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, ∃ U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))),
      ∃ χ : SmoothCutoff (compactInteriorFiber C a b) U,
        ∃ R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ,
          ∃ S : StableCriticalValueShiftData R,
            Nonempty (MorsePosition S.toCriticalValueShiftData.output)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, U, χ, _ha, _hab, _hb, _hU, hR⟩ :=
    exists_globalCutoffMorseData B
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := hR
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := R.nonempty_stableCriticalValueShiftData
  exact ⟨a, b, U, χ, R, S, ⟨S.toMorsePosition⟩⟩

name: Submission.exists_genericIFTSurfaceCoverData
statement:
theorem exists_genericIFTSurfaceCoverData (C : FramedLevelCobordism n)
    {epsilonGrad epsilonTime : ℝ}
    (hGrad : 0 < epsilonGrad) (hTime : 0 < epsilonTime) :
    ∃ s : Finset C.fiber, Nonempty (GenericIFTSurfaceCoverData C s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨B⟩⟩ := exists_finiteIFTSurfaceCover C
  obtain ⟨G⟩ := exists_genericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas B.toSurfaceChartFamily
    hGrad hTime
  exact ⟨s, ⟨⟨B, G⟩⟩⟩

name: Submission.nonempty_genericIFTSurfaceCoverData
statement:
theorem nonempty_genericIFTSurfaceCoverData (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) :
    ∃ s : Finset C.fiber, Nonempty (GenericIFTSurfaceCoverData C s)
proof:
:= by
  exact exists_genericIFTSurfaceCoverData C (epsilonGrad := 1)
    (epsilonTime := 1) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridge_circle_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridge_circle_mem_orbit (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) (θ : ℝ) :
    tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y θ ∈
      V.orbit (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0)
proof:
:= by
  let B := tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k
  let γ : ℝ → E := tubeBridgeCirclePoint k B.y
  change γ θ ∈ V.orbit (γ 0)
  have hγ : Continuous γ := (contDiff_tubeBridgeCirclePoint k B.y).continuous
  have hγnorth : ∀ t, nprep B.approx (WithLp.ofLp (γ t)) = northPoint B.y := by
    intro t
    have ht : γ t ∈ Set.range (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k B.y) := ⟨t, rfl⟩
    rw [← tubeExplicitBridge_north_fiber_eq_range (m := m) k] at ht
    exact ht
  have hγfiber : ∀ t, γ t ∈ B.fls.fiber := by
    intro t
    rw [B.fiber_eq]
    exact Or.inl (hγnorth t)
  let A : Set ℝ := γ ⁻¹' V.orbit (γ 0)
  have hp : γ 0 ∈ B.fls.fiber := hγfiber 0
  have hAS : A ⊆ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _
  have hAclosed : IsClosed A :=
    (V.isCompact_orbit hp).isClosed.preimage hγ
  have hAopen : ∀ t ∈ A, ∃ r > 0,
      (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ∩ Metric.ball t r ⊆ A := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrsub⟩ := V.orbit_isOpen_in_fiber hp ht
    have hopen : IsOpen (γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (γ t) r) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hγ
    have htmem : t ∈ γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (γ t) r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen t htmem
    refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
    rintro u ⟨-, hut⟩
    exact hrsub ⟨hγfiber u, hεsub hut⟩
  have hA0 : A.Nonempty := ⟨0, V.mem_orbit_self (γ 0)⟩
  have hAll : (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ⊆ A :=
    subset_of_relOpen_closed isPreconnected_univ hAS hAclosed hAopen hA0
  exact hAll (Set.mem_univ θ)

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridge_orbit_subset_circle
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridge_orbit_subset_circle (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    V.orbit (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0) ⊆
      Set.range (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y)
proof:
:= by
  let B := tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k
  let γ : ℝ → E := tubeBridgeCirclePoint k B.y
  change V.orbit (γ 0) ⊆ Set.range γ
  have hγnorth : ∀ t, nprep B.approx (WithLp.ofLp (γ t)) = northPoint B.y := by
    intro t
    have ht : γ t ∈ Set.range (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k B.y) := ⟨t, rfl⟩
    rw [← tubeExplicitBridge_north_fiber_eq_range (m := m) k] at ht
    exact ht
  have hp : γ 0 ∈ B.fls.fiber := by
    rw [B.fiber_eq]
    exact Or.inl (hγnorth 0)
  have hppos : 0 < B.fiberSign (γ 0) := by
    rw [B.fiberSign_apply, hγnorth]
    exact vertC_northPoint_pos B.norm_y_lt_one
  intro x hx
  have hxfiber : x ∈ B.fls.fiber := V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hx
  have hxpos : 0 < B.fiberSign x :=
    (B.fiberSign.pos_iff_of_mem_orbit V hp hx).mp hppos
  have hxnorth : nprep B.approx (WithLp.ofLp x) = northPoint B.y :=
    (B.mem_north_iff hxfiber).mpr (by simpa using hxpos)
  have hxset : x ∈ {z : E |
      nprep B.approx (WithLp.ofLp z) = northPoint B.y} := hxnorth
  rw [tubeExplicitBridge_north_fiber_eq_range (m := m) k] at hxset
  exact hxset

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridge_north_orbit_eq_range
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridge_north_orbit_eq_range (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    V.orbit (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0) =
      Set.range (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact tubeExplicitBridge_orbit_subset_circle k V
  · rintro x ⟨θ, rfl⟩
    exact tubeExplicitBridge_circle_mem_orbit k V θ

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridge_northPart_eq_range
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridge_northPart_eq_range (k : ℕ) :
    (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).northPart =
      Set.range
        (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y)
proof:
:= by
  let B := tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k
  let γ : ℝ → E := tubeBridgeCirclePoint k B.y
  change B.northPart = Set.range γ
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hxnorth := (B.mem_northPart_iff.mp hx).2
    have hxset : x ∈ {z : E |
        nprep B.approx (WithLp.ofLp z) = northPoint B.y} := hxnorth
    rw [tubeExplicitBridge_north_fiber_eq_range (m := m) k] at hxset
    exact hxset
  · intro hx
    have hxnorth : nprep B.approx (WithLp.ofLp x) = northPoint B.y := by
      have hxset : x ∈ Set.range (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k B.y) := hx
      rw [← tubeExplicitBridge_north_fiber_eq_range (m := m) k] at hxset
      exact hxset
    apply B.mem_northPart_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, hxnorth⟩
    rw [B.fiber_eq]
    exact Or.inl hxnorth

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridge_northPart_eq_orbit
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridge_northPart_eq_orbit (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).northPart =
      V.orbit
        (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tubeExplicitBridge_northPart_eq_range (m := m) k]
  exact (tubeExplicitBridge_north_orbit_eq_range k V).symm

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeNorthOrbitIndex_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem tubeExplicitBridgeNorthOrbitIndex_coe (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    ((tubeExplicitBridgeNorthOrbitIndex k V : V.OrbitIndex) : Set E) =
      V.orbit
        (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridge_mem_northOrbitCollection_iff
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridge_mem_northOrbitCollection_iff (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    (O : Set E) ∈
        (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).northOrbitCollection V ↔
      O = tubeExplicitBridgeNorthOrbitIndex k V
proof:
:= by
  let B := tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k
  let p : E := tubeBridgeCirclePoint k B.y 0
  change (O : Set E) ⊆ B.northPart ↔
    O = tubeExplicitBridgeNorthOrbitIndex k V
  rw [tubeExplicitBridge_northPart_eq_orbit k V]
  constructor
  · intro hO
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (O : Set E) = V.orbit p
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O]
    apply V.orbit_eq_of_mem
    apply hO
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self (V.orbitPoint O)
  · intro hO
    subst O
    exact Set.Subset.rfl

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridge_northFramedDelta_eq_orbitContribution
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridge_northFramedDelta_eq_orbitContribution (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).northFramedDelta V =
      V.orbitContribution (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthOrbitIndex k V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [(tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).northFramedDelta_eq_deltaOn]
  unfold TamedField.deltaOn
  simp_rw [tubeExplicitBridge_mem_northOrbitCollection_iff k V]
  simp

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_circleLift
statement: theorem contDiff_circleLift : ContDiff ℝ ∞ circleLift
proof:
:= by
  exact (Real.contDiff_cos.comp
    (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)).prodMk
      (Real.contDiff_sin.comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id))

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.periodic_circleLift
statement: theorem periodic_circleLift : Function.Periodic circleLift 1
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  apply Prod.ext
  · change Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (u + 1)) = Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u)
    rw [show 2 * Real.pi * (u + 1) = 2 * Real.pi * u + 2 * Real.pi by ring,
      Real.cos_add_two_pi]
  · change Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (u + 1)) = Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u)
    rw [show 2 * Real.pi * (u + 1) = 2 * Real.pi * u + 2 * Real.pi by ring,
      Real.sin_add_two_pi]

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.circleLift_eq_addCircleCartesian
statement:
theorem circleLift_eq_addCircleCartesian (u : ℝ) :
    circleLift u = addCircleCartesian (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u) =
      ((AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero
        (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) : Circle) : ℂ).re
    rw [AddCircle.homeomorphCircle_apply, AddCircle.toCircle_apply_mk,
      Circle.coe_exp]
    norm_num only [div_one]
    rw [Complex.exp_mul_I]
    simp only [Complex.add_re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.cos_ofReal_re,
      Complex.cos_ofReal_im, Complex.sin_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    ring
  · change Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) =
      ((AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero
        (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) : Circle) : ℂ).im
    rw [AddCircle.homeomorphCircle_apply, AddCircle.toCircle_apply_mk,
      Circle.coe_exp]
    norm_num only [div_one]
    rw [Complex.exp_mul_I]
    simp only [Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_im, Complex.cos_ofReal_re,
      Complex.cos_ofReal_im, Complex.sin_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_im,
      Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
    ring

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.injective_addCircleCartesian
statement:
theorem injective_addCircleCartesian :
    Function.Injective addCircleCartesian
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  apply (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero).injective
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Complex.ext
  · simpa [addCircleCartesian] using congrArg Prod.fst hab
  · simpa [addCircleCartesian] using congrArg Prod.snd hab

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.addCircleCartesian_sub_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [sub_ne_zero]
  exact fun h => hab (injective_addCircleCartesian h)

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.circleLift_sub_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleLift_eq_addCircleCartesian, circleLift_eq_addCircleCartesian]
  exact addCircleCartesian_sub_ne_zero huv

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.circleTangent_ne_zero
statement: theorem circleTangent_ne_zero (u : ℝ) : circleTangent u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h₁ : -Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) = 0 :=
    congrArg Prod.fst h
  have h₂ : Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u) = 0 :=
    congrArg Prod.snd h
  have hs : Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u) = 0 := by linarith
  have hunit := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (2 * Real.pi * u)
  rw [hs, h₂] at hunit
  norm_num at hunit

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.surjective_pairCombination
statement:
theorem surjective_pairCombination {d : ℝ × ℝ} (hd : d ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (pairCombination (E := E) d)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  by_cases h₁ : d.1 = 0
  · have h₂ : d.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hd
      exact Prod.ext h₁ h
    refine ⟨(0, d.2⁻¹ • y), ?_⟩
    simp [pairCombination, h₁, h₂]
  · refine ⟨(d.1⁻¹ • y, 0), ?_⟩
    simp [pairCombination, h₁]

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.surjective_secantCombination
statement:
theorem surjective_secantCombination {u v : ℝ}
    (huv : (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) ≠ (v : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) :
    Function.Surjective
      (pairCombination (E := E) (circleLift u - circleLift v))
proof:
:=
  surjective_pairCombination (circleLift_sub_ne_zero huv)

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.surjective_tangentCombination
statement:
theorem surjective_tangentCombination (u : ℝ) :
    Function.Surjective
      (pairCombination (E := E) (circleTangent u))
proof:
:=
  surjective_pairCombination (circleTangent_ne_zero u)

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.hasDerivAt_perturbation
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_perturbation (p : Parameter E) (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (perturbation p)
      ((2 * Real.pi) • pairCombination (circleTangent u) p) u
proof:
:= by
  have harg : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => 2 * Real.pi * z)
      (2 * Real.pi) u := by
    simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (2 * Real.pi)
  have hcos := (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (2 * Real.pi * u)).scomp u harg
  have hsin := (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (2 * Real.pi * u)).scomp u harg
  have h := (hcos.smul_const p.1).add (hsin.smul_const p.2)
  have hder :
      ((2 * Real.pi) • -Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * u)) • p.1 +
          ((2 * Real.pi) • Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * u)) • p.2 =
        (2 * Real.pi) • pairCombination (circleTangent u) p := by
    unfold pairCombination circleTangent
    module
  rw [hder] at h
  change HasDerivAt
    (fun y : ℝ =>
      Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * y) • p.1 +
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * y) • p.2)
    ((2 * Real.pi) • pairCombination (circleTangent u) p) u
  apply h.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards with y
  rfl

    Disjoint C.positiveSlabFiber C.negativeSlabFiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro v ⟨hv, hp⟩ ⟨-, hn⟩
  have hz : C v = 0 := le_antisymm hn hp
  exact C.nonzero v hv.1 hz

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.nonempty
statement: theorem nonempty : Nonempty (SignedSlabCutoff C)
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen C.negativeSlabFiberᶜ :=
    C.isClosed_negativeSlabFiber.isOpen_compl
  have hsub : C.positiveSlabFiber ⊆ C.negativeSlabFiberᶜ := by
    intro v hp hn
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp C.disjoint_signedSlabFibers hp hn
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδsub⟩ :=
    C.isCompact_positiveSlabFiber.exists_cthickening_subset_open hopen hsub
  let U : Set A := Metric.thickening δ C.positiveSlabFiber
  have hKU : C.positiveSlabFiber ⊆ U :=
    Metric.self_subset_thickening hδpos _
  have hUc : IsCompact (closure U) := by
    apply IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset C.isCompact_positiveSlabFiber.cthickening
      isClosed_closure
    exact closure_minimal
      (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _) Metric.isClosed_cthickening
  obtain ⟨χ⟩ := SmoothCutoff.exists_of_isClosed_isOpen
    C.isClosed_positiveSlabFiber Metric.isOpen_thickening hKU hUc
  refine ⟨⟨χ, χ.smooth, χ.range, χ.eq_one, ?_, χ.compact_support⟩⟩
  intro v hv
  apply χ.eq_zero
  intro hvU
  exact hδsub (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _ hvU) hv

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.raw_ne_zero_of_mem_timeSlab
statement:
lemma raw_ne_zero_of_mem_timeSlab (χ : SignedSlabCutoff C) {v : A}
    (hv : vertC v ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) : raw C χ v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hlast := congrArg (fun z : E => z (Fin.last n)) hzero
  rw [raw_last C χ, PiLp.zero_apply] at hlast
  have hχ : χ v = 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hhoriz := congrArg (initCLM n) hzero
  rw [initCLM_raw C χ, map_zero] at hhoriz
  have hχ0 : χ v ≠ 0 := by rw [hχ]; norm_num
  have hG : C.cobordism.G v = 0 := (smul_eq_zero.mp hhoriz).resolve_left hχ0
  have hvfib : v ∈ C.cobordism.fiber := ⟨hG, hv.1, hv.2⟩
  rcases lt_trichotomy (C v) 0 with hneg | heq | hpos
  · have hz := χ.negative_zero v ⟨hvfib, hneg.le⟩
    rw [hχ] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  · exact C.nonzero v hG heq
  · have ho := χ.positive_one v ⟨hvfib, hpos.le⟩
    rw [hχ] at ho
    norm_num at ho

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.fderiv_initCLM_raw_of_positiveFiber
statement:
theorem fderiv_initCLM_raw_of_positiveFiber (χ : SignedSlabCutoff C) {v : A}
    (hv : v ∈ C.positiveSlabFiber) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => initCLM n (raw C χ q)) v =
      fderiv ℝ C.cobordism.G v
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun q => initCLM n (raw C χ q)) =
      fun q => χ q • C.cobordism.G q := by
    funext q
    exact initCLM_raw C χ q
  rw [hfun]
  have hχd : DifferentiableAt ℝ χ v :=
    χ.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ C.cobordism.G v :=
    C.cobordism.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  rw [fderiv_fun_smul hχd hGd, hv.1.1, χ.positive_one v hv]
  simp

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.normalizedHorizontalRaw_eq
statement:
lemma normalizedHorizontalRaw_eq (χ : SignedSlabCutoff C) (v : A) :
    normalizedHorizontalRaw C χ v =
      (‖raw C χ v‖⁻¹ * χ v) • C.cobordism.G v
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedHorizontalRaw, map_smul, initCLM_raw C χ, smul_smul]

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.fderiv_normalizedHorizontalRaw_of_positiveFiber
statement:
theorem fderiv_normalizedHorizontalRaw_of_positiveFiber
    (χ : SignedSlabCutoff C) {v : A} (hv : v ∈ C.positiveSlabFiber) :
    fderiv ℝ (normalizedHorizontalRaw C χ) v =
      fderiv ℝ C.cobordism.G v
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : normalizedHorizontalRaw C χ = fun q =>
      (‖raw C χ q‖⁻¹ * χ q) • C.cobordism.G q := by
    funext q
    exact normalizedHorizontalRaw_eq C χ q
  rw [hfun]
  have hraw0 : raw C χ v ≠ 0 := by
    rw [raw_of_positiveFiber C χ hv]
    exact (norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by rw [norm_eLast]; norm_num))
  have hrnorm : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q => ‖raw C χ q‖) v :=
    (contDiff_raw C χ).differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt |>.norm
      ℝ hraw0
  have hscalar : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun q => ‖raw C χ q‖⁻¹ * χ q) v :=
    (hrnorm.inv (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hraw0)).mul
      (χ.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt)
  have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ C.cobordism.G v :=
    C.cobordism.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  rw [fderiv_fun_smul hscalar hGd, hv.1.1,
    raw_of_positiveFiber C χ hv, norm_eLast, χ.positive_one v hv]
  simp

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.surjective_fderiv_normalizedHorizontalRaw_of_positiveFiber
statement:
theorem surjective_fderiv_normalizedHorizontalRaw_of_positiveFiber
    (χ : SignedSlabCutoff C) {v : A} (hv : v ∈ C.positiveSlabFiber) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (normalizedHorizontalRaw C χ) v)
proof:

  exact C.cobordism.regular v hv.1.1

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.continuous_slabSpaceTime
statement: lemma continuous_slabSpaceTime : Continuous (slabSpaceTime (n := n))

      ((G w : SOGroup r) : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)) z)

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.loopClassZ2_inv
statement:
private theorem loopClassZ2_inv
    (L : LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop r) :
    loopClassZ2 (inv L).loop (inv L).closed =
      loopClassZ2 L.loop L.closed
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : (L.loop * (inv L).loop) 0 =
      (L.loop * (inv L).loop) 1 := by
    change L.loop 0 * (L.loop 0)⁻¹ = L.loop 1 * (L.loop 1)⁻¹
    simp
  have hprodEq : L.loop * (inv L).loop =
      ContinuousMap.const I (1 : SOGroup r) := by
    ext u
    simp [inv]
  have hzero : loopClassZ2 (L.loop * (inv L).loop) hprod = 0 := by
    calc
      loopClassZ2 (L.loop * (inv L).loop) hprod =
          loopClassZ2 (ContinuousMap.const I (1 : SOGroup r)) rfl :=
        loopClassZ2_congr_fun hprod rfl hprodEq
      _ = 0 := loopClassZ2_const 1
  have hadd := loopClassZ2_mul L.loop (inv L).loop
    L.closed (inv L).closed hprod
  have hsum : loopClassZ2 L.loop L.closed +
      loopClassZ2 (inv L).loop (inv L).closed = 0 := by
    rw [← hadd, hzero]
  have hz2 : ∀ a b : ZMod 2, a + b = 0 → a = b := by decide
  exact (hz2 _ _ hsum).symm

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.discrepancy_loopClassZ2_eq_zero
statement:
theorem discrepancy_loopClassZ2_eq_zero
    (source target : LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop r)
    (hclass : loopClassZ2 source.loop source.closed =
      loopClassZ2 target.loop target.closed) :
    loopClassZ2 (discrepancy source target).loop
      (discrepancy source target).closed = 0
proof:
:= by
  change loopClassZ2 (target.loop * (inv source).loop) _ = 0
  have hmul := loopClassZ2_mul target.loop (inv source).loop
    target.closed (inv source).closed (discrepancy source target).closed
  rw [hmul, loopClassZ2_inv, ← hclass]
  exact (by decide : ∀ a : ZMod 2, a + a = 0) _

name: Submission.concreteConfigurationIndex_of_delta_eq
statement:
@[simp] theorem concreteConfigurationIndex_of_delta_eq
    {P N : MorseLedger} (_h : P.delta = N.delta) :
    concreteConfigurationIndex P N = P.delta
proof:

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationMoveKit.Data.mergePos
statement:
theorem mergePos (_D : Data m) (beta1 beta2 : ZMod 2)

      (configSign m (beta1 :: beta2 :: P) N)
      (configSign m ((beta1 + beta2 + 1) :: P) N))
proof:
:= by
  have hP : MorseLedger.delta (beta1 :: beta2 :: P) =
      MorseLedger.delta ((beta1 + beta2 + 1) :: P) :=
    (MorseLedgerStep.saddleMerge beta1 beta2
      (beta1 + beta2 + 1) P rfl).delta_eq
  have hi := concreteConfigurationIndex_eq_of_delta_eq hP
    (show N.delta = N.delta from rfl)
  exact nonempty_standardSign_cobordism_of_eq m _ _ hi

name: Submission.blockSOMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockSOMap_apply (A : SOGroup n) :
    blockSOMap n A = SmoothSOGauge.blockSO A
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.blockSO_one
statement: theorem blockSO_one : SmoothSOGauge.blockSO (1 : SOGroup n) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change tangentNormalBlock 1 ((1 : SOGroup n) :
    Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) = 1
  ext i j
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩ <;>
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · simp [Matrix.one_apply]
  · simp [Matrix.one_apply, (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm]
  · simp [Matrix.one_apply, Fin.succ_ne_zero i]
  · rw [tangentNormalBlock_succ_succ]
    change (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i j = _
    rw [Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · subst h; simp
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h (Fin.succ_injective n hc))]

name: Submission.blockLoop_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem blockLoop_apply (γ : C(I, SOGroup n)) (u : I) :
    blockLoop γ u = SmoothSOGauge.blockSO (γ u)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.blockLoop_closed
statement:
theorem blockLoop_closed {γ : C(I, SOGroup n)} (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) :
    blockLoop γ 0 = blockLoop γ 1
proof:
:= by
  change SmoothSOGauge.blockSO (γ 0) = SmoothSOGauge.blockSO (γ 1)
  rw [hγ]

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_blockLoop_congr
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_blockLoop_congr (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (gamma delta : C(I, SOGroup n))
    (hgamma : gamma 0 = gamma 1) (hdelta : delta 0 = delta 1)
    (h : loopClassZ2 gamma hgamma = loopClassZ2 delta hdelta) :
    loopClassZ2 (blockLoop gamma) (blockLoop_closed hgamma) =
      loopClassZ2 (blockLoop delta) (blockLoop_closed hdelta)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := exists_loopHomotopy_of_loopClassZ2_eq hn hgamma hdelta h
  refine loopClassZ2_congr _ _ (mapLoopHomotopy H (blockSOMap n)) ?_
  intro s
  change blockSOMap n (H (s, 0)) = blockSOMap n (H (s, 1))
  rw [hH s]

name: Submission.tangentNormalBlock_rotBlock
statement:
theorem tangentNormalBlock_rotBlock : ∀ (k : ℕ) (theta : ℝ),
    tangentNormalBlock 1 (rotBlock (k + 2) theta) =
      ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.fullCoefficientBlock k
        (Real.cos theta) (Real.sin theta)
  | 0, theta => by
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> rfl
  | k + 1, theta => by
      have hrot : rotBlock (k + 1 + 2) theta =
          incMatrix (rotBlock (k + 2) theta)
proof:
:=
        rotBlock_succ (k + 2) (by omega) theta
      have hfull :
          ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.fullCoefficientBlock (k + 1)
              (Real.cos theta) (Real.sin theta) =
            incMatrix
              (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.fullCoefficientBlock k
                (Real.cos theta) (Real.sin theta)) := rfl
      rw [hrot, hfull,
        ← ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.incMatrix_tangentNormalBlock,
        tangentNormalBlock_rotBlock k theta]

name: Submission.blockLoop_frame_eq
statement:
theorem blockLoop_frame_eq (k : ℕ) (L : SO2AngleLoop) :
    blockLoop (L.frame (k + 2)) =
      ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.normalPlaneLoop k L
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.normalPlaneLoop_coe]
  change tangentNormalBlock 1 (rotBlock (k + 2) (L.angle u)) = _
  exact tangentNormalBlock_rotBlock k (L.angle u)

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_blockLoop_frame
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_blockLoop_frame (k : ℕ) (L : SO2AngleLoop) :
    loopClassZ2 (blockLoop (L.frame (k + 2)))
        (blockLoop_closed (L.frame_closed (k + 2))) =
      (L.winding : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun _
      (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.normalPlaneLoop_closed k L)
      (blockLoop_frame_eq k L),
    ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.loopClassZ2_normalPlaneLoop]

name: Submission.zmod_two_eq_one_of_ne_zero
statement: theorem zmod_two_eq_one_of_ne_zero {c : ZMod 2} (h : c ≠ 0) : c = 1
proof:
:= by
  revert h
  revert c
  decide

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_blockLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_blockLoop (hn : 3 ≤ n) (gamma : C(I, SOGroup n))
    (hgamma : gamma 0 = gamma 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (blockLoop gamma) (blockLoop_closed hgamma) =
      loopClassZ2 gamma hgamma
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, n = k + 2 := ⟨n - 2, by omega⟩
  by_cases h0 : loopClassZ2 gamma hgamma = 0
  · have hconstclass :
        loopClassZ2 (ContinuousMap.const I (1 : SOGroup (k + 2))) rfl = 0 :=
      loopClassZ2_const 1
    have hcongr := loopClassZ2_blockLoop_congr hn gamma
      (ContinuousMap.const I (1 : SOGroup (k + 2))) hgamma rfl
      (by rw [h0, hconstclass])
    have hblockconst :
        blockLoop (ContinuousMap.const I (1 : SOGroup (k + 2))) =
          ContinuousMap.const I (1 : SOGroup (k + 3)) := by
      apply ContinuousMap.ext
      intro u
      change SmoothSOGauge.blockSO (1 : SOGroup (k + 2)) = 1
      exact blockSO_one
    rw [hcongr, h0, loopClassZ2_congr_fun _ rfl hblockconst,
      loopClassZ2_const]
  · have h1 : loopClassZ2 gamma hgamma = 1 := zmod_two_eq_one_of_ne_zero h0
    have hLclass :
        loopClassZ2 ((SO2AngleLoop.linear 1).frame (k + 2))
            ((SO2AngleLoop.linear 1).frame_closed (k + 2)) = 1 := by
      rw [(SO2AngleLoop.linear 1).loopClassZ2_frame hn]
      norm_num [SO2AngleLoop.linear]
    have hcongr := loopClassZ2_blockLoop_congr hn gamma
      ((SO2AngleLoop.linear 1).frame (k + 2)) hgamma
      ((SO2AngleLoop.linear 1).frame_closed (k + 2))
      (by rw [h1, hLclass])
    rw [hcongr, h1, loopClassZ2_blockLoop_frame]
    norm_num [SO2AngleLoop.linear]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointAction_nil
statement:
@[simp] theorem endpointAction_nil (x : E) :

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointAction_cons

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointFoldFrom_cons

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointFoldFrom_forward_one
statement:
theorem endpointFoldFrom_forward_one (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n) :
    ∀ (moves : List (SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)) (x : E),
      (endpointFoldFrom A moves).forward 1 x =
        A.forward 1 (endpointAction moves x)
  | [], x => rfl
  | B :: tail, x => by
      rw [endpointFoldFrom_cons,
        endpointFoldFrom_forward_one
          (A.followedBy (B.conjugateByEndpoint A)) tail x,
        followedBy_conjugateByEndpoint_forward_one]
      rfl

@[simp] theorem endpointFold_forward_one
    (moves : List (SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)) (x : E) :
    (endpointFold moves).forward 1 x = endpointAction moves x
proof:
:= by
  rw [endpointFold, endpointFoldFrom_forward_one, refl_forward]

proof:
