name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointAction_eq_of_fixedOn
statement:
theorem endpointAction_eq_of_fixedOn {K : Set E} :
    ∀ (moves : List (SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)),
      (∀ B ∈ moves, B.FixedOn K) →
      ∀ x ∈ K, endpointAction moves x = x
  | [], _, x, _ => rfl
  | B :: tail, h, x, hx => by
      rw [endpointAction_cons,
        endpointAction_eq_of_fixedOn tail
          (fun C hC => h C (by simp [hC])) x hx]
      exact h B (by simp) 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ x hx

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointAction_image_eq_of_fixedOn
statement:
theorem endpointAction_image_eq_of_fixedOn {K : Set E}
    (moves : List (SmoothAmbientIsotopy n))
    (h : ∀ B ∈ moves, B.FixedOn K) :
    endpointAction moves '' K = K
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rwa [endpointAction_eq_of_fixedOn moves h y hy]
  · intro hx
    exact ⟨x, hx, endpointAction_eq_of_fixedOn moves h x hx⟩

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.image_comp_eq
statement:
private theorem image_comp_eq (f g : E → E) (K : Set E) :
    (fun x => f (g x)) '' K = f '' (g '' K)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨g y, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.ComponentMove.mutuallyRelative_comm
statement:
theorem mutuallyRelative_comm {P Q : ComponentMove n} :
    MutuallyRelative P Q ↔ MutuallyRelative Q P
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;> intro h <;> exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.ComponentMove.head_fixedOn_target
statement:
private theorem head_fixedOn_target
    {P Q : ComponentMove n} (h : MutuallyRelative P Q) :
    P.move.FixedOn Q.target
proof:
:=
  h.1.mono subset_union_right

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.ComponentMove.tail_fixedOn_source
statement:
private theorem tail_fixedOn_source
    (P : ComponentMove n) {tail : List (ComponentMove n)}
    (h : ∀ Q ∈ tail, MutuallyRelative P Q) :
    ∀ B ∈ tail.map ComponentMove.move, B.FixedOn P.source
proof:
:= by
  intro B hB
  rw [List.mem_map] at hB
  obtain ⟨Q, hQt, rfl⟩ := hB
  exact (h Q hQt).2.mono subset_union_left

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.ComponentMove.endpointAction_image_source
statement:
theorem endpointAction_image_source :
    ∀ {schedule : List (ComponentMove n)},
      schedule.Pairwise MutuallyRelative →
      ∀ P ∈ schedule,
        endpointAction (schedule.map ComponentMove.move) '' P.source = P.target
  | [], _, P, hP => by simp at hP
  | head :: tail, hpair, P, hP => by
      rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hpair
      rcases hpair with ⟨hhead, htail⟩
      rw [List.mem_cons] at hP
      rcases hP with rfl | hP
      · rw [List.map_cons]
        calc
          endpointAction (P.move :: tail.map ComponentMove.move) '' P.source =
              P.move.forward 1 ''
                (endpointAction (tail.map ComponentMove.move) '' P.source)
proof:
:= by
            change (fun x => P.move.forward 1
              (endpointAction (tail.map ComponentMove.move) x)) '' P.source = _
            exact image_comp_eq _ _ _
          _ = P.move.forward 1 '' P.source := by
            rw [endpointAction_image_eq_of_fixedOn
              (tail.map ComponentMove.move)
              (tail_fixedOn_source P hhead)]
          _ = P.target := P.endpoint_image
      · have ih := endpointAction_image_source htail P hP
        have hfix : head.move.FixedOn P.target :=
          head_fixedOn_target (hhead P hP)
        rw [List.map_cons]
        calc
          endpointAction (head.move :: tail.map ComponentMove.move) '' P.source =
              head.move.forward 1 ''
                (endpointAction (tail.map ComponentMove.move) '' P.source) := by
            change (fun x => head.move.forward 1
              (endpointAction (tail.map ComponentMove.move) x)) '' P.source = _
            exact image_comp_eq _ _ _
          _ = head.move.forward 1 '' P.target := by rw [ih]
          _ = P.target := by
            ext x
            constructor
            · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
              rwa [hfix 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ y hy]
            · intro hx
              exact ⟨x, hx,
                hfix 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ x hx⟩

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.ComponentMove.endpointFold_forward_image_source
statement:
theorem endpointFold_forward_image_source
    {schedule : List (ComponentMove n)}
    (hpair : schedule.Pairwise MutuallyRelative)
    (P : ComponentMove n) (hP : P ∈ schedule) :
    (endpointFold (schedule.map ComponentMove.move)).forward 1 '' P.source =
      P.target
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (endpointFold (schedule.map ComponentMove.move)).forward 1 =
      endpointAction (schedule.map ComponentMove.move) by
    funext x
    exact endpointFold_forward_one _ x]
  exact endpointAction_image_source hpair P hP

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.ComponentMove.transportedMove_fixedOn_currentImage

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.OrbitMoveFamily.ambientSchedule_endpoint_image

name: Submission.TamedField.selectedFrameLedger_coe
statement:
theorem selectedFrameLedger_coe {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    (A : Set (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) :
    ((V.selectedFrameLedger A : List (ZMod 2)) : Multiset (ZMod 2)) =
      Multiset.map (fun O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A => V.orbitFrameClass O.1)
        Finset.univ.val
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold TamedField.selectedFrameLedger
  rw [← Fin.univ_val_map]
  have huniv :
      Multiset.map (⇑(Fintype.equivFin (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A)).symm)
        Finset.univ.val = Finset.univ.val := by
    have h := congrArg Finset.val
      (Finset.map_univ_equiv (Fintype.equivFin (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A)).symm)
    simp only [Finset.map_val, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding] at h
    exact h
  calc
    Multiset.map (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A)) =>
        V.orbitFrameClass
          ((Fintype.equivFin (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A)).symm i).1)
      Finset.univ.val =
        Multiset.map ((fun O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A => V.orbitFrameClass O.1)
          ∘ ⇑(Fintype.equivFin (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A)).symm)
          Finset.univ.val := rfl
    _ = Multiset.map (fun O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A => V.orbitFrameClass O.1)
          (Multiset.map (⇑(Fintype.equivFin (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A)).symm)
            Finset.univ.val) := (Multiset.map_map _ _ _).symm
    _ = _ := by rw [huniv]

name: Submission.TamedField.selectedFrameLedger_perm_append_of_sumEquiv
statement:
theorem selectedFrameLedger_perm_append_of_sumEquiv
    {X X₁ X₂ : FramedLevelSet n}
    (V : TamedField X) (V₁ : TamedField X₁) (V₂ : TamedField X₂)
    (A A₁ A₂ : Set (Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (e : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A ≃
      (V₁.SelectedOrbitIndex A₁ ⊕ V₂.SelectedOrbitIndex A₂))
    (hclass : ∀ O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A,
      V.orbitFrameClass O.1 =
        Sum.elim
          (fun P : V₁.SelectedOrbitIndex A₁ => V₁.orbitFrameClass P.1)
          (fun P : V₂.SelectedOrbitIndex A₂ => V₂.orbitFrameClass P.1)
          (e O)) :
    (V.selectedFrameLedger A).Perm
      (V₁.selectedFrameLedger A₁ ++ V₂.selectedFrameLedger A₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Multiset.coe_eq_coe, ← Multiset.coe_add,
    selectedFrameLedger_coe, selectedFrameLedger_coe, selectedFrameLedger_coe]
  have huniv : Multiset.map (⇑e) Finset.univ.val = Finset.univ.val := by
    have h := congrArg Finset.val (Finset.map_univ_equiv e)
    simp only [Finset.map_val, Equiv.coe_toEmbedding] at h
    exact h
  have hsum : (Finset.univ.val :
      Multiset (V₁.SelectedOrbitIndex A₁ ⊕ V₂.SelectedOrbitIndex A₂)) =
      Multiset.map Sum.inl Finset.univ.val +
        Multiset.map Sum.inr Finset.univ.val := by
    rw [← Finset.univ_disjSum_univ, Finset.val_disjSum]
    rfl
  calc
    Multiset.map (fun O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A => V.orbitFrameClass O.1)
        Finset.univ.val =
        Multiset.map
          ((Sum.elim
            (fun P : V₁.SelectedOrbitIndex A₁ => V₁.orbitFrameClass P.1)
            (fun P : V₂.SelectedOrbitIndex A₂ => V₂.orbitFrameClass P.1))
            ∘ ⇑e) Finset.univ.val :=
      Multiset.map_congr rfl fun O _ => hclass O
    _ = Multiset.map
          (Sum.elim
            (fun P : V₁.SelectedOrbitIndex A₁ => V₁.orbitFrameClass P.1)
            (fun P : V₂.SelectedOrbitIndex A₂ => V₂.orbitFrameClass P.1))
          (Multiset.map (⇑e) Finset.univ.val) := (Multiset.map_map _ _ _).symm
    _ = Multiset.map
          (Sum.elim
            (fun P : V₁.SelectedOrbitIndex A₁ => V₁.orbitFrameClass P.1)
            (fun P : V₂.SelectedOrbitIndex A₂ => V₂.orbitFrameClass P.1))
          (Multiset.map Sum.inl Finset.univ.val +
            Multiset.map Sum.inr Finset.univ.val) := by rw [huniv, hsum]
    _ = _ := by
        rw [Multiset.map_add, Multiset.map_map, Multiset.map_map,
          Sum.elim_comp_inl, Sum.elim_comp_inr]

name: Submission.frameAt_eq_of_fderiv_eq
statement:
theorem frameAt_eq_of_fderiv_eq
    {X Y : FramedLevelSet n} {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hfd : fderiv ℝ X.g x = fderiv ℝ Y.g y) :
    frameAt X x = frameAt Y y
proof:
:= by
  funext j
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun i => ?_) j
  · simp only [frameAt, Fin.cons_zero]
    exact tauField_eq_of_fderiv_eq hfd
  · simp only [frameAt, Fin.cons_succ]
    exact gradVec_eq_of_fderiv_eq hfd i

name: Submission.fderiv_eq_of_eqOn_open

theorem fderiv_eq_of_eqOn_open

    {U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))} (hU : IsOpen U)
    (heq : Set.EqOn g h U) {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : x ∈ U) :
    fderiv ℝ g x = fderiv ℝ h x
proof:
:=
  Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq
    (Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hx) heq)

name: Submission.juxtapose_balls_disjoint
statement:
theorem juxtapose_balls_disjoint (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂) :
    Disjoint (Metric.ball p₁ R₁) (Metric.ball p₂ R₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro v h1 h2
  rw [Metric.mem_ball] at h1 h2
  have htri := dist_triangle p₁ v p₂
  rw [dist_comm p₁ v] at htri
  linarith

name: Submission.juxtapose_fderiv_left
statement:
theorem juxtapose_fderiv_left (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hv : R₂ < dist v p₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).g v = fderiv ℝ X₁.g v
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) |
      R₂ < dist w p₂} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)
  exact fderiv_eq_of_eqOn_open hopen
    (fun w hw => FramedLevelSet.juxtMap_eq_left X₁ X₂ h₂ (le_of_lt hw)) hv

name: Submission.juxtapose_fderiv_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_fderiv_right (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hv : R₁ < dist v p₁) :
    fderiv ℝ (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).g v = fderiv ℝ X₂.g v
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) |
      R₁ < dist w p₁} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)
  exact fderiv_eq_of_eqOn_open hopen
    (fun w hw => FramedLevelSet.juxtMap_eq_right X₁ X₂ h₁ (le_of_lt hw)) hv

name: Submission.juxtapose_fiber_left_far
statement:
theorem juxtapose_fiber_left_far (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hv : v ∈ X₁.fiber) :
    R₂ < dist v p₂
proof:
:=
  sep_dist_right hsep (le_of_lt (Metric.mem_ball.mp
    (h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc hv)))

name: Submission.juxtapose_fiber_right_far
statement:
theorem juxtapose_fiber_right_far (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hv : v ∈ X₂.fiber) :
    R₁ < dist v p₁
proof:
:=
  sep_dist_left hsep (le_of_lt (Metric.mem_ball.mp
    (h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc hv)))

name: Submission.juxtapose_orbit_left_or_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_orbit_left_or_right (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep))
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hp : p ∈ (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber) :
    W.orbit p ⊆ X₁.fiber ∨ W.orbit p ⊆ X₂.fiber
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : W.orbit p ⊆ X₁.fiber ∪ X₂.fiber := by
    rw [← FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose X₁ X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
    exact W.orbit_subset_fiber hp
  have hballs : W.orbit p ⊆ Metric.ball p₁ R₁ ∪ Metric.ball p₂ R₂ :=
    hsub.trans (Set.union_subset_union (h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc)
      (h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc))
  have hconn : IsPreconnected (W.orbit p) :=
    isPreconnected_range (W.continuous_flow p)
  have hdisj := juxtapose_balls_disjoint (p₁ := p₁) (p₂ := p₂) hsep
  rcases hconn.subset_or_subset Metric.isOpen_ball Metric.isOpen_ball
      hdisj hballs with hL | hR
  · left
    intro x hx
    rcases hsub hx with hx1 | hx2
    · exact hx1
    · exact absurd ((h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc) hx2)
        (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj (hL hx))
  · right
    intro x hx
    rcases hsub hx with hx1 | hx2
    · exact absurd (hR hx)
        (Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj ((h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc) hx1))
    · exact hx2

name: Submission.juxtapose_flow_left
statement:
theorem juxtapose_flow_left (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₁ : TamedField X₁)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X₁.fiber) :
    W.flow p = V₁.flow p
proof:
:= by
  have hpj : p ∈ (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber := by
    rw [FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose X₁ X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
    exact Or.inl hp
  have horb : ∀ t, W.flow p t ∈ X₁.fiber := by
    rcases juxtapose_orbit_left_or_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W hpj with hL | hR
    · exact fun t => hL (W.flow_mem_orbit p t)
    · exfalso
      have hp2 : p ∈ X₂.fiber := hR (W.mem_orbit_self p)
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (juxtapose_balls_disjoint hsep)
        ((h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc) hp) ((h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc) hp2)
  apply V₁.solution_unique (t₀ := 0)
  · intro t
    have hder := W.hasDerivAt_flow p t
    have hx1 : W.flow p t ∈ X₁.fiber := horb t
    have hxj : W.flow p t ∈ (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber := by
      rw [FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose X₁ X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
      exact Or.inl hx1
    have hval : W.v (W.flow p t) = V₁.v (W.flow p t) := by
      rw [W.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber hxj, V₁.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber hx1]
      exact tauField_eq_of_fderiv_eq
        (juxtapose_fderiv_left hc h₁ h₂ hsep
          (juxtapose_fiber_left_far hc h₁ hsep hx1))
    rwa [hval] at hder
  · exact V₁.hasDerivAt_flow p
  · rw [W.flow_zero, V₁.flow_zero]

name: Submission.juxtapose_flow_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_flow_right (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₂ : TamedField X₂)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X₂.fiber) :
    W.flow p = V₂.flow p
proof:
:= by
  have hpj : p ∈ (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber := by
    rw [FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose X₁ X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
    exact Or.inr hp
  have horb : ∀ t, W.flow p t ∈ X₂.fiber := by
    rcases juxtapose_orbit_left_or_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W hpj with hL | hR
    · exfalso
      have hp1 : p ∈ X₁.fiber := hL (W.mem_orbit_self p)
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (juxtapose_balls_disjoint hsep)
        ((h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc) hp1) ((h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc) hp)
    · exact fun t => hR (W.flow_mem_orbit p t)
  apply V₂.solution_unique (t₀ := 0)
  · intro t
    have hder := W.hasDerivAt_flow p t
    have hx2 : W.flow p t ∈ X₂.fiber := horb t
    have hxj : W.flow p t ∈ (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber := by
      rw [FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose X₁ X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
      exact Or.inr hx2
    have hval : W.v (W.flow p t) = V₂.v (W.flow p t) := by
      rw [W.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber hxj, V₂.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber hx2]
      exact tauField_eq_of_fderiv_eq
        (juxtapose_fderiv_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep
          (juxtapose_fiber_right_far hc h₂ hsep hx2))
    rwa [hval] at hder
  · exact V₂.hasDerivAt_flow p
  · rw [W.flow_zero, V₂.flow_zero]

name: Submission.juxtapose_orbit_left
statement:
theorem juxtapose_orbit_left (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₁ : TamedField X₁)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X₁.fiber) :
    W.orbit p = V₁.orbit p
proof:
:= by
  unfold TamedField.orbit
  rw [juxtapose_flow_left hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ hp]

name: Submission.juxtapose_orbit_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_orbit_right (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₂ : TamedField X₂)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X₂.fiber) :
    W.orbit p = V₂.orbit p
proof:

  rw [juxtapose_flow_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₂ hp]

name: Submission.juxtapose_fundamentalPeriod_left
statement:
theorem juxtapose_fundamentalPeriod_left (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₁ : TamedField X₁)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X₁.fiber)
    (hpj : p ∈ (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber) :
    W.fundamentalPeriod hpj = V₁.fundamentalPeriod hp
proof:
:= by
  have hflow : W.flow p = V₁.flow p :=
    juxtapose_flow_left hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ hp
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply W.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hpj (V₁.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp)
    rw [hflow]
    exact V₁.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp
  · apply V₁.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hp (W.fundamentalPeriod_pos hpj)
    rw [← hflow]
    exact W.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hpj

name: Submission.juxtapose_fundamentalPeriod_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_fundamentalPeriod_right (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₂ : TamedField X₂)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X₂.fiber)
    (hpj : p ∈ (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber) :
    W.fundamentalPeriod hpj = V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp
proof:
:= by
  have hflow : W.flow p = V₂.flow p :=
    juxtapose_flow_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₂ hp
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply W.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hpj (V₂.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp)
    rw [hflow]
    exact V₂.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp
  · apply V₂.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hp (W.fundamentalPeriod_pos hpj)
    rw [← hflow]
    exact W.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hpj

name: Submission.juxtapose_fundamentalFrameClass_left
statement:
theorem juxtapose_fundamentalFrameClass_left (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₁ : TamedField X₁)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X₁.fiber)
    (hpj : p ∈ (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber) :
    W.fundamentalFrameClass hpj = V₁.fundamentalFrameClass hp
proof:
:= by
  have hflow : W.flow p = V₁.flow p :=
    juxtapose_flow_left hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ hp
  have hper : W.fundamentalPeriod hpj = V₁.fundamentalPeriod hp :=
    juxtapose_fundamentalPeriod_left hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ hp hpj
  apply loopClassZ2_congr_fun (W.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hpj)
    (V₁.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp)
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep) (W.flow p)
      ((u : ℝ) * W.fundamentalPeriod hpj) =
    frameLoop X₁ (V₁.flow p) ((u : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod hp)
  rw [hflow, hper]
  unfold frameLoop
  rw [frameAt_eq_of_fderiv_eq
    (juxtapose_fderiv_left hc h₁ h₂ hsep
      (juxtapose_fiber_left_far hc h₁ hsep
        (V₁.flow_mem_fiber hp ((u : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod hp))))]

name: Submission.juxtapose_fundamentalFrameClass_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_fundamentalFrameClass_right (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₂ : TamedField X₂)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X₂.fiber)
    (hpj : p ∈ (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber) :
    W.fundamentalFrameClass hpj = V₂.fundamentalFrameClass hp
proof:
:= by
  have hflow : W.flow p = V₂.flow p :=
    juxtapose_flow_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₂ hp
  have hper : W.fundamentalPeriod hpj = V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp :=
    juxtapose_fundamentalPeriod_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₂ hp hpj
  apply loopClassZ2_congr_fun (W.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hpj)
    (V₂.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp)
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep) (W.flow p)
      ((u : ℝ) * W.fundamentalPeriod hpj) =
    frameLoop X₂ (V₂.flow p) ((u : ℝ) * V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp)
  rw [hflow, hper]
  unfold frameLoop
  rw [frameAt_eq_of_fderiv_eq
    (juxtapose_fderiv_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep
      (juxtapose_fiber_right_far hc h₂ hsep
        (V₂.flow_mem_fiber hp ((u : ℝ) * V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp))))]

name: Submission.juxtapose_orbitIndex_subset
statement:
theorem juxtapose_orbitIndex_subset (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (O : W.OrbitIndex) :
    (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ⊆ X₁.fiber ∨
      (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ⊆ X₂.fiber
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpj, hOr⟩ := W.mem_orbitFinset.mp O.2
  rw [hOr]
  exact juxtapose_orbit_left_or_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W hpj

name: Submission.juxtapose_mem_orbitFinset_left
statement:
theorem juxtapose_mem_orbitFinset_left (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₁ : TamedField X₁)
    {O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
    (hO : O ∈ W.orbitFinset) (hsub : O ⊆ X₁.fiber) :
    O ∈ V₁.orbitFinset
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpj, rfl⟩ := W.mem_orbitFinset.mp hO
  have hp1 : p ∈ X₁.fiber := hsub (W.mem_orbit_self p)
  rw [V₁.mem_orbitFinset]
  exact ⟨p, hp1, juxtapose_orbit_left hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ hp1⟩

name: Submission.juxtapose_mem_orbitFinset_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_mem_orbitFinset_right (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₂ : TamedField X₂)
    {O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
    (hO : O ∈ W.orbitFinset) (hsub : O ⊆ X₂.fiber) :
    O ∈ V₂.orbitFinset
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpj, rfl⟩ := W.mem_orbitFinset.mp hO
  have hp2 : p ∈ X₂.fiber := hsub (W.mem_orbit_self p)
  rw [V₂.mem_orbitFinset]
  exact ⟨p, hp2, juxtapose_orbit_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₂ hp2⟩

name: Submission.juxtapose_mem_orbitFinset_of_left
statement:
theorem juxtapose_mem_orbitFinset_of_left (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₁ : TamedField X₁)
    {O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))} (hO : O ∈ V₁.orbitFinset) :
    O ∈ W.orbitFinset ∧ O ⊆ X₁.fiber
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp1, rfl⟩ := V₁.mem_orbitFinset.mp hO
  refine ⟨?_, V₁.orbit_subset_fiber hp1⟩
  rw [W.mem_orbitFinset]
  refine ⟨p, ?_, (juxtapose_orbit_left hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ hp1).symm⟩
  rw [FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose X₁ X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
  exact Or.inl hp1

name: Submission.juxtapose_mem_orbitFinset_of_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_mem_orbitFinset_of_right (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₂ : TamedField X₂)
    {O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))} (hO : O ∈ V₂.orbitFinset) :
    O ∈ W.orbitFinset ∧ O ⊆ X₂.fiber
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp2, rfl⟩ := V₂.mem_orbitFinset.mp hO
  refine ⟨?_, V₂.orbit_subset_fiber hp2⟩
  rw [W.mem_orbitFinset]
  refine ⟨p, ?_, (juxtapose_orbit_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₂ hp2).symm⟩
  rw [FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose X₁ X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
  exact Or.inr hp2

name: Submission.juxtapose_not_subset_left_of_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_not_subset_left_of_right (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂) {V₂ : TamedField X₂}
    {O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))} (hO : O ∈ V₂.orbitFinset) :
    ¬O ⊆ X₁.fiber
proof:
:= by
  intro hsub
  obtain ⟨p, hp2, rfl⟩ := V₂.mem_orbitFinset.mp hO
  have hp1 : p ∈ X₁.fiber := hsub (V₂.mem_orbit_self p)
  have hp2' : p ∈ X₂.fiber := V₂.orbit_subset_fiber hp2 (V₂.mem_orbit_self p)
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (juxtapose_balls_disjoint hsep)
    ((h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc) hp1) ((h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc) hp2')

name: Submission.juxtapose_orbitFrameClass_left
statement:
theorem juxtapose_orbitFrameClass_left (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₁ : TamedField X₁)
    (O : W.OrbitIndex)
    (_hsub : (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ⊆ X₁.fiber)
    (hmem : (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∈ V₁.orbitFinset) :
    W.orbitFrameClass O = V₁.orbitFrameClass ⟨O.1, hmem⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hq1 : V₁.orbitPoint ⟨O.1, hmem⟩ ∈ X₁.fiber :=
    V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber ⟨O.1, hmem⟩
  have hqO : V₁.orbitPoint ⟨O.1, hmem⟩ ∈
      (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    have h := V₁.orbitPoint_orbit ⟨O.1, hmem⟩
    change (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      V₁.orbit (V₁.orbitPoint ⟨O.1, hmem⟩) at h
    exact h.symm.subset (V₁.mem_orbit_self _)
  have hp := W.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  have hqW : V₁.orbitPoint ⟨O.1, hmem⟩ ∈ W.orbit (W.orbitPoint O) := by
    rw [← W.orbitPoint_orbit O]
    exact hqO
  have hqj : V₁.orbitPoint ⟨O.1, hmem⟩ ∈
      (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber :=
    W.orbit_subset_fiber hp hqW
  calc
    W.orbitFrameClass O = W.fundamentalFrameClass hp := rfl
    _ = W.fundamentalFrameClass (W.orbit_subset_fiber hp hqW) :=
      (W.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit hp hqW).symm
    _ = V₁.fundamentalFrameClass hq1 :=
      juxtapose_fundamentalFrameClass_left hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ hq1 hqj
    _ = V₁.orbitFrameClass ⟨O.1, hmem⟩ := rfl

name: Submission.juxtapose_orbitFrameClass_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_orbitFrameClass_right (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₂ : TamedField X₂)
    (O : W.OrbitIndex)
    (_hsub : (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ⊆ X₂.fiber)
    (hmem : (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∈ V₂.orbitFinset) :
    W.orbitFrameClass O = V₂.orbitFrameClass ⟨O.1, hmem⟩
proof:
:= by
  have hq2 : V₂.orbitPoint ⟨O.1, hmem⟩ ∈ X₂.fiber :=
    V₂.orbitPoint_mem_fiber ⟨O.1, hmem⟩
  have hqO : V₂.orbitPoint ⟨O.1, hmem⟩ ∈
      (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    have h := V₂.orbitPoint_orbit ⟨O.1, hmem⟩
    change (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      V₂.orbit (V₂.orbitPoint ⟨O.1, hmem⟩) at h
    exact h.symm.subset (V₂.mem_orbit_self _)
  have hp := W.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  have hqW : V₂.orbitPoint ⟨O.1, hmem⟩ ∈ W.orbit (W.orbitPoint O) := by
    rw [← W.orbitPoint_orbit O]
    exact hqO
  have hqj : V₂.orbitPoint ⟨O.1, hmem⟩ ∈
      (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber :=
    W.orbit_subset_fiber hp hqW
  calc
    W.orbitFrameClass O = W.fundamentalFrameClass hp := rfl
    _ = W.fundamentalFrameClass (W.orbit_subset_fiber hp hqW) :=
      (W.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit hp hqW).symm
    _ = V₂.fundamentalFrameClass hq2 :=
      juxtapose_fundamentalFrameClass_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₂ hq2 hqj
    _ = V₂.orbitFrameClass ⟨O.1, hmem⟩ := rfl

name: Submission.juxtapose_positive_mem_left
statement:
theorem juxtapose_positive_mem_left (S₁ : FiberSign X₁) (S₂ : FiberSign X₂)
    (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₁ : TamedField X₁)
    {O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))} (hsub : O ⊆ X₁.fiber) :
    O ∈ (S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).positiveOrbitCollection W ↔
      O ∈ S₁.positiveOrbitCollection V₁
proof:
:= by
  change O ⊆ (S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).positivePart ↔
    O ⊆ S₁.positivePart
  rw [FiberSign.positivePart_juxtapose S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    rcases h hx with hx1 | hx2
    · exact hx1
    · exfalso
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (juxtapose_balls_disjoint hsep)
        ((h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc) (hsub hx))
        ((h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc) (S₂.positivePart_subset_fiber hx2))
  · intro h
    exact h.trans Set.subset_union_left

name: Submission.juxtapose_positive_mem_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_positive_mem_right (S₁ : FiberSign X₁) (S₂ : FiberSign X₂)
    (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep)) (V₂ : TamedField X₂)
    {O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))} (hsub : O ⊆ X₂.fiber) :
    O ∈ (S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).positiveOrbitCollection W ↔
      O ∈ S₂.positiveOrbitCollection V₂
proof:
:= by
  change O ⊆ (S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).positivePart ↔
    O ⊆ S₂.positivePart
  rw [FiberSign.positivePart_juxtapose S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    rcases h hx with hx1 | hx2
    · exfalso
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (juxtapose_balls_disjoint hsep)
        ((h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc) (S₁.positivePart_subset_fiber hx1))
        ((h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc) (hsub hx))
    · exact hx2
  · intro h
    exact h.trans Set.subset_union_right

name: Submission.juxtaposeSelectedOrbitEquiv_frameClass
statement:
theorem juxtaposeSelectedOrbitEquiv_frameClass (S₁ : FiberSign X₁)
    (S₂ : FiberSign X₂) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep))
    (V₁ : TamedField X₁) (V₂ : TamedField X₂)
    (O : W.SelectedOrbitIndex
      ((S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).positiveOrbitCollection W)) :
    W.orbitFrameClass O.1 =
      Sum.elim
        (fun P : V₁.SelectedOrbitIndex (S₁.positiveOrbitCollection V₁) =>
          V₁.orbitFrameClass P.1)
        (fun P : V₂.SelectedOrbitIndex (S₂.positiveOrbitCollection V₂) =>
          V₂.orbitFrameClass P.1)
        (juxtaposeSelectedOrbitEquiv S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ V₂ O)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hsub : (O.1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ⊆ X₁.fiber
  · have hgoal :
        juxtaposeSelectedOrbitEquiv S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ V₂ O =
        Sum.inl ⟨⟨O.1.1,
            juxtapose_mem_orbitFinset_left hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ O.1.2 hsub⟩,
          (juxtapose_positive_mem_left S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ hsub).mp
            O.2⟩ := by
      change (if hsub' : (O.1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ⊆
          X₁.fiber then _ else _) = _
      rw [dif_pos hsub]
    rw [hgoal, Sum.elim_inl]
    exact juxtapose_orbitFrameClass_left hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ O.1 hsub _
  · have hsub₂ : (O.1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ⊆ X₂.fiber :=
      (juxtapose_orbitIndex_subset hc h₁ h₂ hsep W O.1).resolve_left hsub
    have hgoal :
        juxtaposeSelectedOrbitEquiv S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ V₂ O =
        Sum.inr ⟨⟨O.1.1,
            juxtapose_mem_orbitFinset_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₂ O.1.2
              ((juxtapose_orbitIndex_subset hc h₁ h₂ hsep W O.1).resolve_left
                hsub)⟩,
          (juxtapose_positive_mem_right S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₂
            ((juxtapose_orbitIndex_subset hc h₁ h₂ hsep W O.1).resolve_left
              hsub)).mp O.2⟩ := by
      change (if hsub' : (O.1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ⊆
          X₁.fiber then _ else _) = _
      rw [dif_neg hsub]
    rw [hgoal, Sum.elim_inr]
    exact juxtapose_orbitFrameClass_right hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₂ O.1 hsub₂ _

name: Submission.FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger_juxtapose
statement:
theorem positiveFrameLedger_juxtapose (S₁ : FiberSign X₁) (S₂ : FiberSign X₂)
    (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep))
    (V₁ : TamedField X₁) (V₂ : TamedField X₂) :
    ((S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).positiveFrameLedger W).Perm
      (S₁.positiveFrameLedger V₁ ++ S₂.positiveFrameLedger V₂)
proof:
:=
  TamedField.selectedFrameLedger_perm_append_of_sumEquiv W V₁ V₂ _ _ _
    (juxtaposeSelectedOrbitEquiv S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ V₂)
    (juxtaposeSelectedOrbitEquiv_frameClass S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ V₂)

name: Submission.FiberSign.neg_juxtapose
statement:
theorem neg_juxtapose (S₁ : FiberSign X₁) (S₂ : FiberSign X₂) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂) :
    (S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).neg =
      S₁.neg.juxtapose S₂.neg hc h₁ h₂ hsep
proof:
:= by
  apply FiberSign.eq_of_toFun_eq
  funext v
  show -(sepWeight p₁ p₂ R₁ R₂ v * S₁ v +
      (1 - sepWeight p₁ p₂ R₁ R₂ v) * S₂ v) =
    sepWeight p₁ p₂ R₁ R₂ v * (-S₁ v) +
      (1 - sepWeight p₁ p₂ R₁ R₂ v) * (-S₂ v)
  ring

name: Submission.FiberSign.negativeFrameLedger_juxtapose
statement:
theorem negativeFrameLedger_juxtapose (S₁ : FiberSign X₁) (S₂ : FiberSign X₂)
    (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (W : TamedField (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep))
    (V₁ : TamedField X₁) (V₂ : TamedField X₂) :
    ((S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).neg.positiveFrameLedger W).Perm
      (S₁.neg.positiveFrameLedger V₁ ++ S₂.neg.positiveFrameLedger V₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [neg_juxtapose S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
  exact positiveFrameLedger_juxtapose S₁.neg S₂.neg hc h₁ h₂ hsep W V₁ V₂

name: Submission.FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger_eq_nil_of_positivePart_eq_empty
statement:
theorem positiveFrameLedger_eq_nil_of_positivePart_eq_empty
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} (S : FiberSign X) (V : TamedField X)
    (h : S.positivePart = ∅) :
    S.positiveFrameLedger V = []
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hempty : IsEmpty
      (V.SelectedOrbitIndex (S.positiveOrbitCollection V)) := by
    constructor
    intro O
    have hsub : (O.1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ⊆
        S.positivePart := O.2
    obtain ⟨p, hp, hOr⟩ := V.mem_orbitFinset.mp O.1.2
    have hpO : p ∈ (O.1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
      rw [hOr]
      exact V.mem_orbit_self p
    have := hsub hpO
    rw [h] at this
    exact this
  have hlen : (S.positiveFrameLedger V).length = 0 := by
    unfold FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger TamedField.selectedFrameLedger
    rw [List.length_ofFn]
    exact Fintype.card_eq_zero
  exact List.eq_nil_of_length_eq_zero hlen

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_minimum_circle
statement:
@[simp] theorem morseQuadratic_minimum_circle (r θ : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .minimum (morseCircle r θ) = r ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  change (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2
  calc
    (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2
        = r ^ 2 * (Real.cos θ ^ 2 + Real.sin θ ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = r ^ 2 := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_maximum_circle
statement:
@[simp] theorem morseQuadratic_maximum_circle (r θ : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .maximum (morseCircle r θ) = -(r ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  change -((r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2) - (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = -(r ^ 2)
  have hcircle : (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
    simpa [morseQuadratic, morseCircle] using morseQuadratic_minimum_circle r θ
  calc
    -((r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2) - (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2
        = -((r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = -(r ^ 2) := congrArg Neg.neg hcircle

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_saddle_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem morseQuadratic_saddle_eq_zero_iff (x y : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .saddle (x, y) = 0 ↔ x = y ∨ x = -y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hmul : (x - y) * (x + y) = 0 := by
      change x ^ 2 - y ^ 2 = 0 at h
      nlinarith
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hmul with hxy | hxy
    · exact Or.inl (sub_eq_zero.mp hxy)
    · exact Or.inr (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hxy)
  · rintro (rfl | rfl) <;> simp [morseQuadratic]

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_saddle_pos_iff
statement:
theorem morseQuadratic_saddle_pos_iff (x y : ℝ) :
    0 < morseQuadratic .saddle (x, y) ↔ y ^ 2 < x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [morseQuadratic]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_saddle_neg_iff
statement:
theorem morseQuadratic_saddle_neg_iff (x y : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .saddle (x, y) < 0 ↔ x ^ 2 < y ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [morseQuadratic]
  constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: Submission.signedBranch_sq
statement:
@[simp] theorem signedBranch_sq (b : SaddleBranch) (x : ℝ) :
    signedBranch b x ^ 2 = x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> simp [signedBranch]

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_saddlePositiveArc
statement:
@[simp] theorem morseQuadratic_saddlePositiveArc
    (b : SaddleBranch) (a u : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .saddle (saddlePositiveArc b a u) = a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + u ^ 2)) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + u ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  simp only [morseQuadratic, saddlePositiveArc, signedBranch_sq, hsqrt]
  ring

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_saddleNegativeArc
statement:
@[simp] theorem morseQuadratic_saddleNegativeArc
    (b : SaddleBranch) (a u : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .saddle (saddleNegativeArc b a u) = -(a ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + u ^ 2)) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + u ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  simp only [morseQuadratic, saddleNegativeArc, signedBranch_sq, hsqrt]
  ring

name: Submission.modelFrameNumerator_normSq
statement:
@[simp] theorem modelFrameNumerator_normSq (e : MorseIndexTwo) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (modelFrameNumerator e p).1 ^ 2 + (modelFrameNumerator e p).2 ^ 2
      = p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> simp [modelFrameNumerator]

name: Submission.modelFrameUnit_normSq
statement:
theorem modelFrameUnit_normSq (e : MorseIndexTwo) (p : ℝ × ℝ)
    (hp : 0 < p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) :
    (modelFrameUnit e p).1 ^ 2 + (modelFrameUnit e p).2 ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)) ^ 2 = p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt hp.le
  dsimp [modelFrameUnit]
  calc
    ((modelFrameNumerator e p).1 / Real.sqrt (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)) ^ 2
        + ((modelFrameNumerator e p).2 / Real.sqrt (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)) ^ 2
        = ((modelFrameNumerator e p).1 ^ 2 + (modelFrameNumerator e p).2 ^ 2)
            / (Real.sqrt (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) / (Real.sqrt (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [modelFrameNumerator_normSq]
    _ = 1 := by rw [hsqrt, div_self (ne_of_gt hp)]

name: Submission.modelFrameUnit_minimum_circle
statement:
theorem modelFrameUnit_minimum_circle {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (θ : ℝ) :
    modelFrameUnit .minimum (morseCircle r θ) = (Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcircle :
      (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
    simpa [morseQuadratic, morseCircle] using morseQuadratic_minimum_circle r θ
  apply Prod.ext <;>
    simp [modelFrameUnit, modelFrameNumerator, morseCircle, hcircle,
      Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr] <;> field_simp [hr.ne']

name: Submission.modelFrameUnit_maximum_circle
statement:
theorem modelFrameUnit_maximum_circle {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (θ : ℝ) :
    modelFrameUnit .maximum (morseCircle r θ) = (-Real.cos θ, -Real.sin θ)
proof:
:= by
  have hcircle :
      (r * Real.cos θ) ^ 2 + (r * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 = r ^ 2 := by
    simpa [morseQuadratic, morseCircle] using morseQuadratic_minimum_circle r θ
  apply Prod.ext <;>
    simp [modelFrameUnit, modelFrameNumerator, morseCircle, hcircle,

name: Submission.morseLocalDelta_saddle_merge
statement:
theorem morseLocalDelta_saddle_merge (β₁ β₂ βhat : ZMod 2)
    (hβ : βhat = β₁ + β₂ + 1) :
    morseLocalDelta (β₁ + β₂) 2 = morseLocalDelta βhat 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [hβ]
  unfold morseLocalDelta
  have h2 : ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) = 0 := by decide
  have h1 : ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) = 1 := by decide
  have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
  rw [h2, h1, add_zero]
  calc
    β₁ + β₂ = β₁ + β₂ + (1 + 1) := by rw [h11, add_zero]
    _ = β₁ + β₂ + 1 + 1 := by abel

name: Submission.morseLocalDelta_saddle_split
statement:

    (hβ : βhat = β₁ + β₂ + 1) :
    morseLocalDelta βhat 1 = morseLocalDelta (β₁ + β₂) 2
proof:
:=
  (morseLocalDelta_saddle_merge β₁ β₂ βhat hβ).symm

        (loopClassZ2 (S.incoming₁.frame m) (S.incoming₁.frame_closed m)
          + loopClassZ2 (S.incoming₂.frame m) (S.incoming₂.frame_closed m)) 2
      = morseLocalDelta
        (loopClassZ2 (S.outgoing.frame m) (S.outgoing.frame_closed m)) 1
proof:
:= by
  apply morseLocalDelta_saddle_merge
  exact S.frame_class_splice hm

name: Submission.exists_contDiff_cartesianSOHomotopy
statement:
theorem exists_contDiff_cartesianSOHomotopy
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (R : P → SOGroup m) (hR : Continuous R)
    (hRzero : ∀ z, R (0, z) = 1)
    {U : Set P} (hU : U ∈ nhdsSet cartesianSORelativeSet)
    (hRU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p => matrixToEuclidean
        ((R p : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) U) :
    ∃ Q : P → SOGroup m,
      (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p =>
        ((Q p : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) i j) ∧
      (∀ z, Q (0, z) = 1) ∧
      (∀ z, z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1 → Q (1, z) = R (1, z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hEq⟩ := exists_contDiff_SO_approx_and_eqOn
    hm hR isClosed_cartesianSORelativeSet hU hRU
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro z
    rw [hEq (timeZero_mem_cartesianSORelativeSet z), hRzero]
  · intro z hz
    exact hEq (endpointCircle_mem_cartesianSORelativeSet hz)

name: Submission.exists_contDiff_curriedCartesianSOHomotopy
statement:
theorem exists_contDiff_curriedCartesianSOHomotopy
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (R : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m)
    (hR : Continuous fun p : P => R p.1 p.2)
    (hRzero : ∀ z, R 0 z = 1)
    {U : Set P} (hU : U ∈ nhdsSet cartesianSORelativeSet)
    (hRU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : P => matrixToEuclidean
        ((R p.1 p.2 : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) U) :
    ∃ Q : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m,
      (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : P =>
        ((Q p.1 p.2 : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) i j) ∧
      (∀ z, Q 0 z = 1) ∧
      (∀ z, z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1 → Q 1 z = R 1 z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQzero, hQone⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_cartesianSOHomotopy hm
      (fun p => R p.1 p.2) hR hRzero hU hRU
  exact ⟨fun s z => Q (s, z), hQ, hQzero, hQone⟩

proof:
:= by
  subst N

name: Submission.exists_contDiff_positiveDet_approx_and_eqOn
statement:
theorem exists_contDiff_positiveDet_approx_and_eqOn
    {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ P]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {f : P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m × Fin m)}
    (hf : Continuous f)
    (hpos : ∀ x, 0 < (euclideanToMatrix (f x)).det)
    {S U : Set P} (hS : IsClosed S) (hU : U ∈ nhdsSet S)
    (hfU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) :
    ∃ g : P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m × Fin m),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ g ∧
        (∀ x, 0 < (euclideanToMatrix (g x)).det) ∧ EqOn g f S
proof:
:= by
  let bad : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m × Fin m)) :=
    {v | (euclideanToMatrix v).det ≤ 0}
  have hbadClosed : IsClosed bad := by
    exact isClosed_le continuous_det_euclideanToMatrix continuous_const
  haveI : Nonempty (Fin m) := Fin.pos_iff_nonempty.mp hm
  have hbadNonempty : bad.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    change (euclideanToMatrix (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m × Fin m))).det ≤ 0
    change (0 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ).det ≤ 0
    simp
  have hfNotBad : ∀ x, f x ∉ bad := by
    intro x hx
    exact (not_le_of_gt (hpos x)) hx
  let eps : P → ℝ := fun x => Metric.infDist (f x) bad / 2
  have hepsContinuous : Continuous eps := by
    exact (Metric.continuous_infDist_pt bad).comp hf |>.div_const 2
  have hepsPos : ∀ x, 0 < eps x := by
    intro x
    have hd : 0 < Metric.infDist (f x) bad :=
      (hbadClosed.notMem_iff_infDist_pos hbadNonempty).mp (hfNotBad x)
    dsimp [eps]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hclose, heq, -⟩ :=
    hf.exists_contDiff_approx_and_eqOn (ε := eps) (⊤ : ℕ∞)
      hepsContinuous hepsPos hS hU hfU
  refine ⟨g, hg, ?_, heq⟩
  intro x
  have hgNotBad : g x ∉ bad := by
    intro hgBad
    have hle : Metric.infDist (f x) bad ≤ dist (f x) (g x) :=
      Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem hgBad
    have hlt := hclose x
    rw [dist_comm] at hlt
    dsimp [eps] at hlt
    have hd : 0 < Metric.infDist (f x) bad :=
      (hbadClosed.notMem_iff_infDist_pos hbadNonempty).mp (hfNotBad x)
    linarith
  exact lt_of_not_ge hgNotBad

name: Submission.exists_contDiff_SO_approx_and_eqOn
statement:
theorem exists_contDiff_SO_approx_and_eqOn
    {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    [FiniteDimensional ℝ P]
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    {R : P → SOGroup m} (hR : Continuous R)
    {S U : Set P} (hS : IsClosed S) (hU : U ∈ nhdsSet S)
    (hRU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p => matrixToEuclidean
        ((R p : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) U) :
    ∃ Q : P → SOGroup m,
      (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p =>
        ((Q p : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) i j) ∧
      EqOn Q R S
proof:
:= by
  let f : P → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m × Fin m) := fun p =>
    matrixToEuclidean
      ((R p : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
  have hf : Continuous f :=
    continuous_matrixToEuclidean.comp
      (continuous_SOGroup_val.comp hR)
  have hfpos : ∀ p, 0 < (euclideanToMatrix (f p)).det := by
    intro p
    change 0 < (euclideanToMatrix (matrixToEuclidean
      ((R p : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))).det
    rw [euclideanToMatrix_matrixToEuclidean]
    exact SOGroup_det_pos (R p)
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hgpos, hgeq⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_positiveDet_approx_and_eqOn hm hf hfpos hS hU hRU
  let Q : P → SOGroup m := fun p =>
    matrixGramSchmidtSO (euclideanToMatrix (g p)) (hgpos p)
  refine ⟨Q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i j
    apply contDiff_matrixGramSchmidtSO_apply
    intro a b
    exact contDiff_euclideanToMatrix_apply hg a b
  · intro p hp
    have hgp : g p = f p := hgeq hp
    have hmatrix : euclideanToMatrix (g p) =
        ((R p : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) := by
      rw [hgp]
      exact euclideanToMatrix_matrixToEuclidean _
    apply Subtype.ext
    change ((matrixGramSchmidtSO (euclideanToMatrix (g p)) (hgpos p) :
      SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) =
        ((R p : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    calc
      ((matrixGramSchmidtSO (euclideanToMatrix (g p)) (hgpos p) :
          SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) =
          ((matrixGramSchmidtSO
            ((R p : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
            (SOGroup_det_pos (R p)) : SOGroup m) :
              Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) :=
        congrArg Subtype.val
          (matrixGramSchmidtSO_congr hmatrix (hgpos p)
            (SOGroup_det_pos (R p)))
      _ = ((R p : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) :=
        congrArg Subtype.val (matrixGramSchmidtSO_of_SOGroup (R p))

proof:
:= by

      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign).delta =
        B.northDelta := by
    calc
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign).delta =
          B.fiberSign.positiveDelta :=
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveDelta_eq_positiveLedger_delta
          m B.fiberSign).symm
      _ = B.northDelta := B.northDelta_eq_positiveDelta.symm

    D.initial D.plan.nonempty_toDiagonal
  rw [hindex] at h
  exact h

name: Submission.normSq_fromIm
statement:
theorem normSq_fromIm (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    normSq (fromIm v) = v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 + v 2 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Quaternion.normSq_def']
  simp [fromIm]

name: Submission.conj_fromIm
statement:
theorem conj_fromIm (q : ℍ) (v : Fin 3 → ℝ) :
    q * fromIm v * star q = fromIm (rotMatrix q *ᵥ v)
proof:
:= by
  ext <;>
    simp [fromIm, rotMatrix, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Fin.sum_univ_three,
      Quaternion.re_mul, Quaternion.imI_mul, Quaternion.imJ_mul, Quaternion.imK_mul] <;>
    ring

name: Submission.rotMatrix_mul
statement: theorem rotMatrix_mul (p q : ℍ) : rotMatrix (p * q) = rotMatrix p * rotMatrix q
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [rotMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three,
      Quaternion.re_mul, Quaternion.imI_mul, Quaternion.imJ_mul, Quaternion.imK_mul] <;>
    ring

name: Submission.rotMatrix_star
statement: theorem rotMatrix_star (q : ℍ) : rotMatrix (star q) = (rotMatrix q)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [rotMatrix, Matrix.transpose_apply] <;> ring

name: Submission.rotMatrix_coe
statement: theorem rotMatrix_coe (r : ℝ) : rotMatrix (r : ℍ) = r ^ 2 • (1 : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [rotMatrix, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] <;> ring

name: Submission.rotMatrix_one
statement: theorem rotMatrix_one : rotMatrix (1 : ℍ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Quaternion.coe_one, rotMatrix_coe]
  norm_num

name: Submission.rotMatrix_neg
statement: theorem rotMatrix_neg (q : ℍ) : rotMatrix (-q) = rotMatrix q
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [rotMatrix] <;> ring

name: Submission.det_rotMatrix
statement: theorem det_rotMatrix (q : ℍ) : (rotMatrix q).det = normSq q ^ 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_three, Quaternion.normSq_def']
  simp [rotMatrix]
  ring

name: Submission.rotMatrix_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem rotMatrix_mul_transpose {q : ℍ} (hq : normSq q = 1) :
    rotMatrix q * (rotMatrix q)ᵀ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← rotMatrix_star, ← rotMatrix_mul, Quaternion.self_mul_star, hq, rotMatrix_coe]
  norm_num

name: Submission.rotMatrix_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
statement:
theorem rotMatrix_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup {q : ℍ} (hq : normSq q = 1) :
    rotMatrix q ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin 3) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff]
    exact rotMatrix_mul_transpose hq
  · rw [det_rotMatrix, hq, one_pow]

name: Submission.spinToSO_apply_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem spinToSO_apply_coe (q : SpinOne) :
    (spinToSO q : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) = rotMatrix (q : ℍ)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.continuous_rotMatrix
statement: theorem continuous_rotMatrix : Continuous rotMatrix
proof:
:= by
  have a : Continuous fun q : ℍ => q.re := Quaternion.continuous_re
  have b : Continuous fun q : ℍ => q.imI := Quaternion.continuous_imI
  have c : Continuous fun q : ℍ => q.imJ := Quaternion.continuous_imJ
  have d : Continuous fun q : ℍ => q.imK := Quaternion.continuous_imK
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp only [rotMatrix, Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
      Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.head_fin_const, Matrix.of_apply,
      Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Function.comp_apply]
  · exact (((a.pow 2).add (b.pow 2)).sub (c.pow 2)).sub (d.pow 2)
  · exact continuous_const.mul ((b.mul c).sub (a.mul d))
  · exact continuous_const.mul ((b.mul d).add (a.mul c))
  · exact continuous_const.mul ((b.mul c).add (a.mul d))
  · exact (((a.pow 2).sub (b.pow 2)).add (c.pow 2)).sub (d.pow 2)
  · exact continuous_const.mul ((c.mul d).sub (a.mul b))
  · exact continuous_const.mul ((b.mul d).sub (a.mul c))
  · exact continuous_const.mul ((c.mul d).add (a.mul b))
  · exact (((a.pow 2).sub (b.pow 2)).sub (c.pow 2)).add (d.pow 2)

name: Submission.continuous_spinToSO
statement: theorem continuous_spinToSO : Continuous spinToSO
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact continuous_rotMatrix.comp continuous_subtype_val

name: Submission.spinToSO_neg_one
statement: theorem spinToSO_neg_one : spinToSO (-1 : SpinOne) = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show rotMatrix ((-1 : SpinOne) : ℍ) = 1
  rw [show ((-1 : SpinOne) : ℍ) = -(1 : ℍ) from rfl, rotMatrix_neg, rotMatrix_one]

name: Submission.rotMatrix_eq_one_iff
statement:
theorem rotMatrix_eq_one_iff {q : ℍ} (hq : normSq q = 1) :
    rotMatrix q = 1 ↔ q = 1 ∨ q = -1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h00 := congr_fun (congr_fun h 0) 0
    have h11 := congr_fun (congr_fun h 1) 1
    simp [rotMatrix, Matrix.one_apply] at h00 h11
    rw [Quaternion.normSq_def'] at hq
    have hJK : q.imJ ^ 2 + q.imK ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    have hIK : q.imI ^ 2 + q.imK ^ 2 = 0 := by linarith
    have hJ : q.imJ = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg q.imJ, sq_nonneg q.imK]
    have hK : q.imK = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg q.imJ, sq_nonneg q.imK]
    have hI : q.imI = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg q.imI, sq_nonneg q.imK]
    have hre : q.re ^ 2 = 1 := by nlinarith
    rcases sq_eq_one_iff.mp hre with h1 | h1
    · left; ext <;> simp [h1, hI, hJ, hK]
    · right; ext <;> simp [h1, hI, hJ, hK]
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact rotMatrix_one
    · rw [rotMatrix_neg, rotMatrix_one]

name: Submission.spinToSO_mem_ker_iff
statement:
theorem spinToSO_mem_ker_iff (q : SpinOne) :
    q ∈ spinToSO.ker ↔ q = 1 ∨ q = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [MonoidHom.mem_ker]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have h' : rotMatrix (q : ℍ) = 1 := congr_arg Subtype.val h
    rcases (rotMatrix_eq_one_iff (normSq_of_mem_sphere q.2)).mp h' with h1 | h1
    · left; exact Subtype.ext h1
    · right
      apply Subtype.ext
      rw [h1, show ((-1 : SpinOne) : ℍ) = -(1 : ℍ) from rfl]
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact map_one spinToSO
    · exact spinToSO_neg_one

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.transverseSq_nonneg
statement: lemma transverseSq_nonneg (v : A) : 0 ≤ transverseSq m v
proof:
:= by
  exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.twistShift_nonneg
statement: lemma twistShift_nonneg (v : A) : 0 ≤ twistShift m v
proof:
:= by
  have hden : 0 ≤ 2 * (1 + transverseSq m v) := by
    nlinarith [transverseSq_nonneg m v]
  exact div_nonneg (transverseSq_nonneg m v) hden

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.twistShift_lt_half
statement: lemma twistShift_lt_half (v : A) : twistShift m v < 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hr := transverseSq_nonneg m v
  have hden : 0 < 2 * (1 + transverseSq m v) := by positivity
  rw [twistShift, div_lt_iff₀ hden]
  linarith

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_apply_rowZero
statement:
@[simp] lemma eventMap_apply_rowZero (v : A) :
    eventMap m v (rowZero m) =
      (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistRe m v + twistShift m v) *
          CompactSaddle.eventMap m v (rowZero m) -
        ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistIm m v *
          CompactSaddle.eventMap m v (rowOne m)
proof:
:= by
  simp [eventMap, ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.rowZero,
    ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.rowOne]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_apply_rowOne
statement:
@[simp] lemma eventMap_apply_rowOne (v : A) :
    eventMap m v (rowOne m) =
      ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistIm m v *
          CompactSaddle.eventMap m v (rowZero m) +
        (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistRe m v + twistShift m v) *
          CompactSaddle.eventMap m v (rowOne m)
proof:
:= by
  simp [eventMap, ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.rowZero,
    ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.rowOne]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_apply_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  simp [eventMap, hi₀, hi₁]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.contDiff_compactEventMap_coord
statement:
lemma contDiff_compactEventMap_coord (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v => CompactSaddle.eventMap m v i)
proof:
:= by
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i : F →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp
    (CompactSaddle.contDiff_eventMap m)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.contDiff_transverseSq
statement: lemma contDiff_transverseSq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (transverseSq m)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((contDiff_compactEventMap_coord m (rowZero m)).pow 2).add
    ((contDiff_compactEventMap_coord m (rowOne m)).pow 2)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.one_add_transverseSq_ne_zero
statement:
lemma one_add_transverseSq_ne_zero (v : A) :
    1 + transverseSq m v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr := transverseSq_nonneg m v
  linarith

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.contDiff_twistShift
statement: lemma contDiff_twistShift : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (twistShift m)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : A => 2 * (1 + transverseSq m v)) :=
    contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_transverseSq m))
  have hden0 : ∀ v : A, 2 * (1 + transverseSq m v) ≠ 0 := by
    intro v
    exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (one_add_transverseSq_ne_zero m v)
  exact (contDiff_transverseSq m).div hden hden0

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.contDiff_eventMap
statement: theorem contDiff_eventMap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (eventMap m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro i
  by_cases hi₀ : i = rowZero m
  · subst i
    simp only [eventMap_apply_rowZero]
    exact ((ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.contDiff_twistRe m).add
        (contDiff_twistShift m)).mul
          (contDiff_compactEventMap_coord m (rowZero m)) |>.sub
      ((ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.contDiff_twistIm m).mul
        (contDiff_compactEventMap_coord m (rowOne m)))
  · by_cases hi₁ : i = rowOne m
    · subst i
      simp only [eventMap_apply_rowOne]
      exact (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.contDiff_twistIm m).mul
          (contDiff_compactEventMap_coord m (rowZero m)) |>.add
        (((ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.contDiff_twistRe m).add
          (contDiff_twistShift m)).mul
            (contDiff_compactEventMap_coord m (rowOne m)))
    · simpa only [eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁] using
        contDiff_compactEventMap_coord m i

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_eq_polynomial_of_cutoff_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : CompactSaddle.eventMap m v =
      StandardSaddle.eventMap m v := by
    simp [CompactSaddle.eventMap, hc]
  have hsq : transverseSq m v =
      ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.transverseSq m v := by
    simp only [transverseSq,
      ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.transverseSq, hbase]
  have hshift : twistShift m v =
      ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistShift m v := by
    simp only [twistShift, ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistShift, hsq]
  ext i
  by_cases hi₀ : i = rowZero m
  · subst i
    rw [eventMap_apply_rowZero,
      ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_apply_rowZero,
      hbase, hshift]
  · by_cases hi₁ : i = rowOne m
    · subst i
      rw [eventMap_apply_rowOne,
        ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_apply_rowOne,
        hbase, hshift]
    · rw [eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁,
        ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁,
        hbase]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_eq_polynomial_of_normSq_le_four
proof:
:=
  eventMap_eq_polynomial_of_cutoff_eq_zero m
    (CompactSaddle.cutoff_eq_zero hv)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_eventuallyEq_polynomial_of_standard_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hslt : CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) v) < 4 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (CompactSaddle.standard_event_normSq_le_three m hv)
      (by norm_num)
  have hopen : IsOpen
      {w : A | CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) w) < 4} :=
    isOpen_lt
      (CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.continuous.comp
        (initCLM (m + 3)).continuous) continuous_const
  exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hslt) fun w hw =>
    eventMap_eq_polynomial_of_normSq_le_four m hw.le

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_eq_zero_of_standard_zero
statement:
lemma eventMap_eq_zero_of_standard_zero (hm : 0 < m) {v : A}
    (hv : StandardSaddle.eventMap m v = 0) : eventMap m v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(eventMap_eventuallyEq_polynomial_of_standard_zero m hv).eq_of_nhds]
  exact (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_eq_zero_iff m hm v).mpr hv

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_regular_at_standard_zero
proof:
:= by
  have htwisted : ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap m v = 0 :=
    (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_eq_zero_iff m hm v).mpr hv
  rw [(eventMap_eventuallyEq_polynomial_of_standard_zero m hv).fderiv_eq]
  exact ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_regular m hm htwisted

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_spaceTime_eq_of_compact_eq
statement:
lemma eventMap_spaceTime_eq_of_compact_eq (x : E) (t s : ℝ)
    (hbase : CompactSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x t) =
      CompactSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x s)) :
    eventMap m (spaceTime x t) = eventMap m (spaceTime x s)
proof:
:= by
  have hre := ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistRe_spaceTime m x t s
  have him := ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistIm_spaceTime m x t s
  have hsq : transverseSq m (spaceTime x t) =
      transverseSq m (spaceTime x s) := by
    simp only [transverseSq, hbase]
  have hshift : twistShift m (spaceTime x t) =
      twistShift m (spaceTime x s) := by
    simp only [twistShift, hsq]
  ext i
  by_cases hi₀ : i = rowZero m
  · subst i
    simp only [eventMap_apply_rowZero, hre, him, hshift, hbase]
  · by_cases hi₁ : i = rowOne m
    · subst i
      simp only [eventMap_apply_rowOne, hre, him, hshift, hbase]
    · rw [eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁,
        eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁, hbase]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_collar_zero
statement:
lemma eventMap_collar_zero (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 4) :
    eventMap m (spaceTime x t) = eventMap m (spaceTime x 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply eventMap_spaceTime_eq_of_compact_eq m x t 0
  rw [CompactSaddle.eventMap_spaceTime, CompactSaddle.eventMap_spaceTime,
    StandardSaddle.height_of_le_quarter ht,
    StandardSaddle.height_of_le_quarter (by norm_num)]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_collar_one
statement:
lemma eventMap_collar_one (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t) :
    eventMap m (spaceTime x t) = eventMap m (spaceTime x 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply eventMap_spaceTime_eq_of_compact_eq m x t 1
  rw [CompactSaddle.eventMap_spaceTime, CompactSaddle.eventMap_spaceTime,
    StandardSaddle.height_of_threeQuarter_le ht,
    StandardSaddle.height_of_threeQuarter_le (by norm_num)]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.background_apply_rowZero
statement:
@[simp] lemma background_apply_rowZero :
    CompactSaddle.background m (rowZero m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simpa [ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.rowZero] using
    CompactSaddle.background_apply_castSucc m (0 : Fin (m + 1))

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.background_apply_rowOne
statement:
@[simp] lemma background_apply_rowOne (hm : 0 < m) :
    CompactSaddle.background m (rowOne m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let j : Fin (m + 1) := ⟨1, by omega⟩
  simpa [j, ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.rowOne] using
    CompactSaddle.background_apply_castSucc m j

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_eq_background_of_compact_eq_background
statement:
lemma eventMap_eq_background_of_compact_eq_background
    (hm : 0 < m) {v : A}
    (hv : CompactSaddle.eventMap m v = CompactSaddle.background m) :
    eventMap m v = CompactSaddle.background m
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ : CompactSaddle.eventMap m v (rowZero m) = 0 := by
    rw [hv]
    exact background_apply_rowZero m
  have h₁ : CompactSaddle.eventMap m v (rowOne m) = 0 := by
    rw [hv]
    exact background_apply_rowOne m hm
  ext i
  by_cases hi₀ : i = rowZero m
  · subst i
    rw [eventMap_apply_rowZero, h₀, h₁]
    simpa using (background_apply_rowZero m).symm
  · by_cases hi₁ : i = rowOne m
    · subst i
      rw [eventMap_apply_rowOne, h₀, h₁]
      simpa using (background_apply_rowOne m hm).symm
    · rw [eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁, hv]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCompactTwist.eventMap_spatialFlatOutside
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 9 ≤ CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) v) := by
    rw [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (initCLM (m + 3) v)]
  have hc : CompactSaddle.cutoff (initCLM (m + 3) v) = 1 :=
    CompactSaddle.cutoff_eq_one hs
  apply eventMap_eq_background_of_compact_eq_background m hm
  simp [CompactSaddle.eventMap, hc]

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.toEuclideanCLM_clmMatrix
statement:
@[simp] theorem toEuclideanCLM_clmMatrix
    (Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.toEuclideanCLM_mul

theorem toEuclideanCLM_mul (M N : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ)) (M * N) =
      ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ)) M).comp
        ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ)) N)
proof:
:= by
