name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.clm_apply_coord
statement:
theorem clm_apply_coord (Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) (i : Fin k) :
    Φ u i = ∑ j : Fin k, clmMatrix Φ i j * u j
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← toEuclideanCLM_clmMatrix Φ]
  rfl

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.bijective_toEuclideanCLM_of_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem bijective_toEuclideanCLM_of_det_ne_zero
    {M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (h : M.det ≠ 0) :
    Function.Bijective (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ) M)
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit M.det := isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr h
  have h1 : M * M⁻¹ = 1 := Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv M hunit
  have h2 : M⁻¹ * M = 1 := Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul M hunit
  refine Function.bijective_iff_has_inverse.mpr
    ⟨fun x => (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ) M⁻¹) x, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x
    have := congrArg (fun N => (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ) N) x) h2
    simpa [toEuclideanCLM_mul] using this
  · intro x
    have := congrArg (fun N => (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ) N) x) h1
    simpa [toEuclideanCLM_mul] using this

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.bijective_of_det_clmMatrix_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have := bijective_toEuclideanCLM_of_det_ne_zero h
  rwa [toEuclideanCLM_clmMatrix] at this

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.bijective_one_sub_smul_of_upperTriangular
statement:
theorem bijective_one_sub_smul_of_upperTriangular
    {A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (hupper : ∀ i j : Fin k, j < i → clmMatrix A i j = 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ i : Fin k, 0 < clmMatrix A i i)
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) -
        s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) - A))
proof:
:= by
  set M := clmMatrix A with hM
  have hpath : clmMatrix
      ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) -
        s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) - A))
      = (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) -
        s • ((1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - M) := by
    rw [clmMatrix_sub, clmMatrix_smul, clmMatrix_sub, clmMatrix_one]
  apply bijective_of_det_clmMatrix_ne_zero
  rw [hpath]
  have hup : ∀ i j : Fin k, j < i →
      ((1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) -
        s • ((1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - M)) i j = 0 := by
    intro i j hij
    have hne : i ≠ j := ne_of_gt hij
    have hone : (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j = 0 := Matrix.one_apply_ne hne
    simp [hone, hupper i j hij]
  have hdiagpath : ∀ i : Fin k,
      ((1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) -
        s • ((1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - M)) i i = 1 - s + s * M i i := by
    intro i
    simp [Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    ring
  have hdetpos : 0 < ((1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) -
      s • ((1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) - M)).det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular hup]
    apply Finset.prod_pos
    intro i _
    rw [hdiagpath i]
    have hMi : 0 < M i i := hdiag i
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs1 with heq | hlt
    · subst heq
      simpa using hMi
    · have h1 : 0 < 1 - s := by linarith
      have h2 : 0 ≤ s * M i i := mul_nonneg hs0 hMi.le
      linarith
  exact ne_of_gt hdetpos

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_transpose
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨horth, hdet⟩ := Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp hQ
  have hmul : Q * Qᵀ = 1 := (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin k) ℝ).mp horth
  refine Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mpr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin k) ℝ).mpr
      (by simpa using mul_eq_one_comm.mp hmul)
  · rwa [Matrix.det_transpose]

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.det_transpose_clmMatrix_pos
statement:
theorem det_transpose_clmMatrix_pos (h : 0 < (clmMatrix Φ).det) :
    0 < ((clmMatrix Φ)ᵀ).det
proof:
:= by
  rwa [Matrix.det_transpose]

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.qrSO_coe
statement:
theorem qrSO_coe (h : 0 < (clmMatrix Φ).det) :
    ((qrSO Φ h : SOGroup k) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
      = (rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows ((clmMatrix Φ)ᵀ))))ᵀ
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_qrUpper
statement:
@[simp] theorem clmMatrix_qrUpper :
    clmMatrix (qrUpper Φ) = qrUpperMatrix Φ
proof:
:=
  clmMatrix_toEuclideanCLM _

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.linearIndependent_matrixRows_transpose
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_matrixRows_transpose (h : 0 < (clmMatrix Φ).det) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (matrixRows ((clmMatrix Φ)ᵀ))
proof:
:=
  linearIndependent_matrixRows_of_det_ne_zero
    (ne_of_gt (det_transpose_clmMatrix_pos h))

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpperMatrix_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem qrUpperMatrix_eq_zero_of_lt (Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) {i j : Fin k} (hij : j < i) :
    qrUpperMatrix Φ i j = 0
proof:
:=
  GramSchmidtTriangular.gsLower_eq_zero_of_lt _ hij

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpperMatrix_diag_pos
statement:
theorem qrUpperMatrix_diag_pos (h : 0 < (clmMatrix Φ).det) (i : Fin k) :
    0 < qrUpperMatrix Φ i i
proof:
:=
  GramSchmidtTriangular.gsLower_diag_pos
    (linearIndependent_matrixRows_transpose h) i

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.qr_factorization
statement:
theorem qr_factorization (h : 0 < (clmMatrix Φ).det) :
    Φ = (SOFrameGauge.toCLM (qrSO Φ h)).comp (qrUpper Φ)
proof:
:= by
  have hfac : (clmMatrix Φ)ᵀ
      = GramSchmidtTriangular.gsLower (matrixRows ((clmMatrix Φ)ᵀ)) *
          rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows ((clmMatrix Φ)ᵀ))) := by
    have := GramSchmidtTriangular.rowsMatrix_eq_gsLower_mul
      (linearIndependent_matrixRows_transpose h)
    rwa [rowsMatrix_matrixRows] at this
  have hmat : clmMatrix Φ
      = ((qrSO Φ h : SOGroup k) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) * qrUpperMatrix Φ := by
    have := congrArg Matrix.transpose hfac
    rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose, Matrix.transpose_mul] at this
    rw [this, qrSO_coe, qrUpperMatrix]
  calc Φ = (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ)) (clmMatrix Φ) :=
        (toEuclideanCLM_clmMatrix Φ).symm
    _ = (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ))
          (((qrSO Φ h : SOGroup k) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) *
            qrUpperMatrix Φ) := by rw [hmat]
    _ = (SOFrameGauge.toCLM (qrSO Φ h)).comp (qrUpper Φ) := toEuclideanCLM_mul _ _

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.bijective_one_sub_smul_qrUpper
statement:
theorem bijective_one_sub_smul_qrUpper (h : 0 < (clmMatrix Φ).det)
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) -
        s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) -
          qrUpper Φ))
proof:
:= by
  apply bijective_one_sub_smul_of_upperTriangular
  · intro i j hij
    rw [clmMatrix_qrUpper]
    exact qrUpperMatrix_eq_zero_of_lt Φ hij
  · intro i
    rw [clmMatrix_qrUpper]
    exact qrUpperMatrix_diag_pos h i
  · exact hs0
  · exact hs1

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem clmMatrix_apply
    (Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    (i j : Fin k) :
    clmMatrix Φ i j = Φ (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) i
proof:
:= by
  conv_rhs => rw [← toEuclideanCLM_clmMatrix Φ]
  change clmMatrix Φ i j =
    (WithLp.toLp 2 (clmMatrix Φ *ᵥ
      WithLp.ofLp (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)))) i
  simp [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, EuclideanSpace.single]

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.contDiff_clmMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem contDiff_clmMatrix_apply {Ψ : T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)} (hΨ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψ) (i j : Fin k) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => clmMatrix (Ψ t) i j
proof:
:= by
  have hrw : (fun t => clmMatrix (Ψ t) i j)
      = fun t => (EuclideanSpace.proj i) (Ψ t (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) := by
    funext t
    exact clmMatrix_apply (Ψ t) i j
  rw [hrw]
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i).contDiff.comp
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
      (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))).contDiff.comp hΨ)

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.contDiff_toEuclideanCLM_of_entries
statement:
theorem contDiff_toEuclideanCLM_of_entries
    {M : T → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => M t i j) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ)) (M t)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_clm_apply_iff]
  intro y
  rw [contDiff_euclidean]
  intro i
  have hrw : (fun t => ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ)) (M t)) y i)
      = fun t => ∑ l : Fin k, M t i l * (WithLp.ofLp y) l := by
    funext t
    rfl
  rw [hrw]
  exact ContDiff.sum fun l _ => (hM i l).mul contDiff_const

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.contDiff_qrSOMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem contDiff_qrSOMatrix_apply
    {Ψ : T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (hΨ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψ) (h : ∀ t, 0 < (clmMatrix (Ψ t)).det) (i j : Fin k) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t =>
      ((qrSO (Ψ t) (h t) : SOGroup k) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j
proof:
:= by
  have hrw : (fun t => ((qrSO (Ψ t) (h t) : SOGroup k) :
        Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j)
      = fun t => ((matrixGramSchmidtSO ((clmMatrix (Ψ t))ᵀ)
        (det_transpose_clmMatrix_pos (h t)) : SOGroup k) :
          Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) j i := by
    funext t
    rfl
  rw [hrw]
  exact contDiff_matrixGramSchmidtSO_apply (fun t => (clmMatrix (Ψ t))ᵀ)
    (fun a b => contDiff_clmMatrix_apply hΨ b a)
    (fun t => det_transpose_clmMatrix_pos (h t)) j i

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.contDiff_qrUpperMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem contDiff_qrUpperMatrix_apply
    {Ψ : T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (hΨ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψ) (h : ∀ t, 0 < (clmMatrix (Ψ t)).det) (i j : Fin k) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => qrUpperMatrix (Ψ t) i j
proof:
:= by
  have hrw : (fun t => qrUpperMatrix (Ψ t) i j)
      = fun t => ∑ l : Fin k, clmMatrix (Ψ t) l j *
          ((matrixGramSchmidtSO ((clmMatrix (Ψ t))ᵀ)
            (det_transpose_clmMatrix_pos (h t)) : SOGroup k) :
              Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i l := by
    funext t
    show (GramSchmidtTriangular.gsLower
      (matrixRows ((clmMatrix (Ψ t))ᵀ))) j i = _
    rw [GramSchmidtTriangular.gsLower, Matrix.mul_apply]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    rfl
  rw [hrw]
  refine ContDiff.sum fun l _ => ?_
  exact (contDiff_clmMatrix_apply hΨ l j).mul
    (contDiff_matrixGramSchmidtSO_apply (fun t => (clmMatrix (Ψ t))ᵀ)
      (fun a b => contDiff_clmMatrix_apply hΨ b a)
      (fun t => det_transpose_clmMatrix_pos (h t)) i l)

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.contDiff_qrUpper
statement:
theorem contDiff_qrUpper
    {Ψ : T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (hΨ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Ψ) (h : ∀ t, 0 < (clmMatrix (Ψ t)).det) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => qrUpper (Ψ t)
proof:
:=
  contDiff_toEuclideanCLM_of_entries
    (fun i j => contDiff_qrUpperMatrix_apply hΨ h i j)

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.mulVec_injective_of_mul_eq_one
statement:
theorem mulVec_injective_of_mul_eq_one {A B : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    (h : B * A = 1) : Function.Injective A.mulVec
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z => B *ᵥ z) hxy
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, h, Matrix.one_mulVec] at h1
  exact h1

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.posDefSqrt_mul_self
statement:
theorem posDefSqrt_mul_self {M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (hM : M.PosDef) :
    posDefSqrt hM * posDefSqrt hM = M
proof:
:= by
  have hmul := map_mul (Unitary.conjStarAlgAut ℝ (Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
      hM.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary)
    (Matrix.diagonal fun i => Real.sqrt (hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i))
    (Matrix.diagonal fun i => Real.sqrt (hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i))
  rw [posDefSqrt, ← hmul, Matrix.diagonal_mul_diagonal]
  have hd : (fun i => Real.sqrt (hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i) *
      Real.sqrt (hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i))
      = (RCLike.ofReal ∘ hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues) := by
    funext i
    exact Real.mul_self_sqrt (hM.eigenvalues_pos i).le
  rw [hd]
  exact hM.isHermitian.spectral_theorem.symm

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.posDefSqrt_posDef
statement:
theorem posDefSqrt_posDef {M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (hM : M.PosDef) :
    (posDefSqrt hM).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  set U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ :=
    (hM.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) with hU
  have hUU : U * star U = 1 :=
    Matrix.mem_unitaryGroup_iff.mp hM.isHermitian.eigenvectorUnitary.property
  have hdiag : (Matrix.diagonal fun i =>
      Real.sqrt (hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)).PosDef := by
    rw [Matrix.posDef_diagonal_iff]
    intro i
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (hM.eigenvalues_pos i)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (star U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ).mulVec :=
    mulVec_injective_of_mul_eq_one hUU
  have hconj := hdiag.conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hinj
  have hstar : (star U : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᴴ = U := star_star U
  rw [hstar] at hconj
  have hrw : posDefSqrt hM = U *
      (Matrix.diagonal fun i => Real.sqrt (hM.isHermitian.eigenvalues i)) *
      star U := by
    rw [posDefSqrt, Unitary.conjStarAlgAut_apply]
  rw [hrw]
  exact hconj

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.posDef_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem posDef_conjTranspose_mul_self (h : (clmMatrix Φ).det ≠ 0) :
    ((clmMatrix Φ)ᴴ * clmMatrix Φ).PosDef
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Function.Injective (clmMatrix Φ).mulVec :=
    mulVec_injective_of_mul_eq_one
      (Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr h))
  have := (Matrix.PosDef.one (n := Fin k) (R := ℝ)).conjTranspose_mul_mul_same hinj
  simpa using this

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.polarPosMatrix_posDef
statement:
theorem polarPosMatrix_posDef (h : (clmMatrix Φ).det ≠ 0) :
    (polarPosMatrix Φ h).PosDef
proof:
:=
  posDefSqrt_posDef _

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.polarPosMatrix_mul_self
statement:
theorem polarPosMatrix_mul_self (h : (clmMatrix Φ).det ≠ 0) :
    polarPosMatrix Φ h * polarPosMatrix Φ h = (clmMatrix Φ)ᴴ * clmMatrix Φ
proof:
:=
  posDefSqrt_mul_self _

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.polarPosMatrix_det_pos
statement:
theorem polarPosMatrix_det_pos (h : (clmMatrix Φ).det ≠ 0) :
    0 < (polarPosMatrix Φ h).det
proof:
:=
  (polarPosMatrix_posDef h).det_pos

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.polarOrthMatrix_mul_polarPosMatrix
statement:
theorem polarOrthMatrix_mul_polarPosMatrix (h : (clmMatrix Φ).det ≠ 0) :
    polarOrthMatrix Φ h * polarPosMatrix Φ h = clmMatrix Φ
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (polarPosMatrix Φ h).det :=
    isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (polarPosMatrix_det_pos h))
  rw [polarOrthMatrix, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hunit, Matrix.mul_one]

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.polarOrthMatrix_conjTranspose_mul_self
statement:
theorem polarOrthMatrix_conjTranspose_mul_self (h : (clmMatrix Φ).det ≠ 0) :
    (polarOrthMatrix Φ h)ᴴ * polarOrthMatrix Φ h = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hunit : IsUnit (polarPosMatrix Φ h).det :=
    isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (polarPosMatrix_det_pos h))
  have hherm : (polarPosMatrix Φ h)ᴴ = polarPosMatrix Φ h :=
    (polarPosMatrix_posDef h).isHermitian
  have hinvherm : ((polarPosMatrix Φ h)⁻¹)ᴴ = (polarPosMatrix Φ h)⁻¹ := by
    rw [Matrix.conjTranspose_nonsing_inv, hherm]
  rw [polarOrthMatrix, Matrix.conjTranspose_mul, hinvherm, Matrix.mul_assoc,
    ← Matrix.mul_assoc (clmMatrix Φ)ᴴ, ← polarPosMatrix_mul_self h,
    Matrix.mul_assoc, Matrix.mul_nonsing_inv _ hunit, Matrix.mul_one,
    Matrix.nonsing_inv_mul _ hunit]

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.polarOrthMatrix_mem_orthogonalGroup
statement:
theorem polarOrthMatrix_mem_orthogonalGroup (h : (clmMatrix Φ).det ≠ 0) :
    polarOrthMatrix Φ h ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin k) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  refine (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin k) ℝ).mpr ?_
  exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp (polarOrthMatrix_conjTranspose_mul_self h)

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.polarOrthMatrix_det_pos
statement:
theorem polarOrthMatrix_det_pos (h : 0 < (clmMatrix Φ).det) :
    0 < (polarOrthMatrix Φ (ne_of_gt h)).det
proof:
:= by
  have hP := polarPosMatrix_det_pos (ne_of_gt h)
  have hmul := congrArg Matrix.det
    (polarOrthMatrix_mul_polarPosMatrix (ne_of_gt h))
  rw [Matrix.det_mul] at hmul
  nlinarith [hmul, hP, h]

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.polarOrthMatrix_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
statement:
theorem polarOrthMatrix_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup (h : 0 < (clmMatrix Φ).det) :
    polarOrthMatrix Φ (ne_of_gt h) ∈
      Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin k) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  refine Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mpr
    ⟨polarOrthMatrix_mem_orthogonalGroup (ne_of_gt h), ?_⟩
  have hdetsq : (polarOrthMatrix Φ (ne_of_gt h)).det *
      (polarOrthMatrix Φ (ne_of_gt h)).det = 1 := by
    have hmul := congrArg Matrix.det
      ((Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin k) ℝ).mp
        (polarOrthMatrix_mem_orthogonalGroup (ne_of_gt h)))
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at hmul
    exact hmul
  rcases mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp hdetsq with hone | hneg
  · exact hone
  · have := polarOrthMatrix_det_pos h
    rw [hneg] at this
    linarith

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.polar_factorization
statement:
theorem polar_factorization (h : 0 < (clmMatrix Φ).det) :
    Φ = (SOFrameGauge.toCLM (polarSO Φ h)).comp (polarPos Φ (ne_of_gt h))
proof:
:= by
  calc Φ = (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ)) (clmMatrix Φ) :=
        (toEuclideanCLM_clmMatrix Φ).symm
    _ = (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ))
          (polarOrthMatrix Φ (ne_of_gt h) * polarPosMatrix Φ (ne_of_gt h)) := by
        rw [polarOrthMatrix_mul_polarPosMatrix]
    _ = (SOFrameGauge.toCLM (polarSO Φ h)).comp (polarPos Φ (ne_of_gt h)) :=
        toEuclideanCLM_mul _ _

name: Submission.PolarDecompositionCLM.polarPos_inner_pos
statement:
theorem polarPos_inner_pos (h : (clmMatrix Φ).det ≠ 0)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) (hv : v ≠ 0) :
    0 < ⟪polarPos Φ h v, v⟫
proof:
:= by
  have hx : (WithLp.ofLp v : Fin k → ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hv
    exact (WithLp.ofLp_eq_zero (p := 2)).mp hzero
  have hpos := (polarPosMatrix_posDef h).dotProduct_mulVec_pos hx
  rw [GramSchmidtTriangular.inner_eq_dotProduct]
  have hrw : WithLp.ofLp (polarPos Φ h v)
      = polarPosMatrix Φ h *ᵥ (WithLp.ofLp v) := rfl
  rw [hrw, dotProduct_comm]
  simpa using hpos

name: Submission.MorseLedgerGeometricGenerators.realizeTrace
statement:
theorem realizeTrace (G : MorseLedgerGeometricGenerators n) :
    ∀ {L R : MorseLedger} (trace : MorseLedgerTrace L R),
      Nonempty ((G.standard L).Cobordism (G.standard R))
proof:
:= by
  intro L R trace
  induction trace with
  | refl L =>
      exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_refl (G.standard L).sign
  | @cons L M R step tail ih =>
      exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
        (G.realizeStep step) ih

name: Submission.MorseLedgerGeometricGenerators.realizeBetween
statement:
theorem realizeBetween (G : MorseLedgerGeometricGenerators n)
    {L R : MorseLedger} (A : SignedLedgerState n L)
    (B : SignedLedgerState n R) (trace : MorseLedgerTrace L R) :
    Nonempty (A.Cobordism B)
proof:
:=
  SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans (G.normalize A)
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans (G.realizeTrace trace)
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_symm (G.normalize B)))

name: Submission.MorseLedgerGeometricGenerators.realizeBridgeTrace
statement:
theorem realizeBridgeTrace (G : MorseLedgerGeometricGenerators n)
    {z z' : StableSpherePi n} (B : BridgeData n z) (B' : BridgeData n z')
    (V : TamedField B.fls) (V' : TamedField B'.fls)
    (trace : MorseLedgerTrace (B.northFrameLedger V)
      (B'.northFrameLedger V')) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism B.fiberSign B'.fiberSign)
proof:
:=
  G.realizeBetween (SignedLedgerState.ofBridge B V)
    (SignedLedgerState.ofBridge B' V') trace

name: Submission.MorseLedgerGeometricGenerators.pi_succ_sphere_n_mulEquiv_zmod_two_of_generators
statement:
theorem pi_succ_sphere_n_mulEquiv_zmod_two_of_generators
    (G : MorseLedgerGeometricGenerators n)
    (zeroClass oneClass : StableSpherePi n)
    (zero_ledger_value :

name: Submission.ConfigurationReductionKit.reducePos
statement:
theorem reducePos (K : ConfigurationReductionKit n) :
    ∀ (P N : MorseLedger),
      Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (K.configSign P N)
        (K.configSign (MorseLedger.canonical P.delta) N))
  | [], N => by
      rw [MorseLedger.delta_nil, MorseLedger.canonical_zero]
      exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_refl _
  | [beta], N => by
      rcases (by decide : ∀ b : ZMod 2, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) beta with hb | hb
      · subst hb
        have h : MorseLedger.canonical (MorseLedger.delta [(0 : ZMod 2)]) =
            [0]
proof:
:= by decide
        rw [h]
        exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_refl _
      · subst hb
        have h : MorseLedger.canonical (MorseLedger.delta [(1 : ZMod 2)]) =
            [] := by decide
        rw [h]
        exact K.deathPos [] N
  | beta1 :: beta2 :: P, N => by
      have hstep := K.mergePos beta1 beta2 P N
      have hdelta : MorseLedger.delta ((beta1 + beta2 + 1) :: P) =
          MorseLedger.delta (beta1 :: beta2 :: P) :=
        (MorseLedgerStep.saddleMerge beta1 beta2 _ P rfl).delta_eq.symm
      have htail := reducePos K ((beta1 + beta2 + 1) :: P) N
      rw [hdelta] at htail
      exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hstep htail
  termination_by P _ => P.length
  decreasing_by simp_wf

name: Submission.ConfigurationReductionKit.reduceNeg
statement:
theorem reduceNeg (K : ConfigurationReductionKit n) :
    ∀ (P N : MorseLedger),
      Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (K.configSign P N)
        (K.configSign P (MorseLedger.canonical N.delta)))
  | P, [] => by
      rw [MorseLedger.delta_nil, MorseLedger.canonical_zero]
      exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_refl _
  | P, [beta] => by
      rcases (by decide : ∀ b : ZMod 2, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) beta with hb | hb
      · subst hb
        have h : MorseLedger.canonical (MorseLedger.delta [(0 : ZMod 2)]) =
            [0]
proof:
:= by decide
        rw [h]
        exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_refl _
      · subst hb
        have h : MorseLedger.canonical (MorseLedger.delta [(1 : ZMod 2)]) =
            [] := by decide
        rw [h]
        exact K.deathNeg P []
  | P, beta1 :: beta2 :: N => by
      have hstep := K.mergeNeg beta1 beta2 P N
      have hdelta : MorseLedger.delta ((beta1 + beta2 + 1) :: N) =
          MorseLedger.delta (beta1 :: beta2 :: N) :=
        (MorseLedgerStep.saddleMerge beta1 beta2 _ N rfl).delta_eq.symm
      have htail := reduceNeg K P ((beta1 + beta2 + 1) :: N)
      rw [hdelta] at htail
      exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hstep htail
  termination_by _ N => N.length
  decreasing_by simp_wf

name: Submission.map_freeToBased_cast
statement:
private theorem map_freeToBased_cast {x : SOGroup m} (α : Path x x)
    (hone : x = rightMul x (1 : SOGroup m)) :
    ((freeToBased α.toContinuousMap (pathLoop_closed α)).map
        (rightMul x).continuous).cast hone hone = α
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  show α t * (α.toContinuousMap 0)⁻¹ * x = α t
  have h0 : α.toContinuousMap 0 = x := α.source
  rw [h0]
  group

  have hcast := homotopic_cast (hfb.map (rightMul x)) hone hone
  rwa [map_freeToBased_cast α hone, map_freeToBased_cast β hone] at hcast

name: Submission.SaddleFrameBandMarkingData.marks_mem_range_so2Coset_of_cosetBandLift
statement:
theorem SaddleFrameBandMarkingData.marks_mem_range_so2Coset_of_cosetBandLift
    {O₁ O₂ : Vbefore.OrbitIndex} {Ohat : Vafter.OrbitIndex}
    (M : SaddleFrameBandMarkingData Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat)
    (h : M.CosetBandLift) :
    ∃ U V : SOGroup (n + 1),
      M.before₁FrameLoop M.before₁Cut₀ ∈ Set.range (so2Coset U V) ∧
      M.before₁FrameLoop M.before₁Cut₁ ∈ Set.range (so2Coset U V) ∧
      M.before₂FrameLoop M.before₂Cut₀ ∈ Set.range (so2Coset U V) ∧
      M.before₂FrameLoop M.before₂Cut₁ ∈ Set.range (so2Coset U V) ∧
      M.afterFrameLoop M.afterCut₀ ∈ Set.range (so2Coset U V) ∧
      M.afterFrameLoop M.afterCut₁ ∈ Set.range (so2Coset U V) ∧
      M.afterFrameLoop M.afterCut₂ ∈ Set.range (so2Coset U V) ∧
      M.afterFrameLoop M.afterCut₃ ∈ Set.range (so2Coset U V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R⟩ := M.nonempty_bandWinding_of_cosetBandLift h
  refine ⟨R.chartLeft, R.chartRight, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨R.angleMark₀, ?_⟩
    have hlift := R.local₁_lift 0
    simp only [Path.source, Path.target] at hlift
    exact hlift.symm
  · refine ⟨R.angleMark₁, ?_⟩
    have hlift := R.local₁_lift 1
    simp only [Path.source, Path.target] at hlift
    exact hlift.symm
  · refine ⟨R.angleMark₄, ?_⟩
    have hlift := R.connector₂_lift 1
    simp only [Path.source, Path.target] at hlift
    exact hlift.symm
  · refine ⟨R.angleMark₅, ?_⟩
    have hlift := R.local₂_lift 1
    simp only [Path.source, Path.target] at hlift
    exact hlift.symm
  · refine ⟨R.angleMark₇, ?_⟩
    have hlift := R.connector₀_lift 0
    simp only [Path.source, Path.target] at hlift
    exact hlift.symm
  · refine ⟨R.angleMark₂, ?_⟩
    have hlift := R.connector₁_lift 1
    simp only [Path.source, Path.target] at hlift
    exact hlift.symm
  · refine ⟨R.angleMark₃, ?_⟩
    have hlift := R.band₁_lift 1
    simp only [Path.source, Path.target] at hlift
    exact hlift.symm
  · refine ⟨R.angleMark₆, ?_⟩
    have hlift := R.connector₃_lift 1
    simp only [Path.source, Path.target] at hlift
    exact hlift.symm

name: Submission.orbitFrameClass_splice_of_conjugateCosetBandLift
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_splice_of_conjugateCosetBandLift
    {O₁ O₂ : Vbefore.OrbitIndex} {Ohat : Vafter.OrbitIndex}
    (hn : 3 ≤ n + 1)
    (M : SaddleFrameBandMarkingData Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat)
    (h : M.ConjugateCosetBandLift) :
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
      Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + 1

:= by
  have huniv := M.pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop
  rw [M.pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_of_conjugateCosetBandLift hn h]
    at huniv
  have hsolve : ∀ x y z : ZMod 2, 1 = x + y + z → z = x + y + 1 := by decide
  exact hsolve _ _ _ huniv

  refine M.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hn ?_
  have huniv := M.pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop

    {a : ℕ} (K : ProductionMorseSaddleChartFrameSpliceInputs a) :

  intro C center Mev T hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
  obtain ⟨hmerge, hsplit⟩ :=
    K T hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
  have hdim : 3 ≤ a + 2 + 1 := by omega
  refine ⟨fun hne heq => ?_, fun hne heq => ?_⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_signed_flowbox
statement:
theorem TamedField.exists_signed_flowbox {X : FramedLevelSet n}
    (V : TamedField X)
    {q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hq : q ∈ X.fiber)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ x ∈ X.fiber ∩ ball q r, ∃ s : ℝ,
      |s| < c ∧ V.flow q s = x ∧
      (0 < s ↔ 0 < ⟪tauField X.g q, x - q⟫) ∧
      (s < 0 ↔ ⟪tauField X.g q, x - q⟫ < 0)
proof:
:= by
  let τ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) := tauField X.g q
  let h : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ⟪τ, V.flow q s - q⟫
  let h' : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ⟪τ, V.v (V.flow q s)⟫
  have hder : ∀ s, HasDerivAt h (h' s) s := by
    intro s
    have h₁ : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => τ) 0 s := hasDerivAt_const s τ
    have h₂ : HasDerivAt (fun u => V.flow q u - q)
        (V.v (V.flow q s)) s :=
      (V.hasDerivAt_flow q s).sub_const q
    simpa [h, h'] using h₁.inner ℝ h₂
  have h'cont : Continuous h' := by
    exact continuous_const.inner
      (V.smooth.continuous.comp (V.continuous_flow q))
  have h'zero : h' 0 = 1 := by
    dsimp [h', τ]
    rw [V.flow_zero, V.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber hq,
      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
      norm_tauField (X.fiber_subset_regularSet hq)]
    norm_num
  have hopen : IsOpen {s : ℝ | 0 < h' s} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const h'cont
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ {s : ℝ | 0 < h' s} := by
    change 0 < h' 0
    rw [h'zero]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen 0 hzero
  let d : ℝ := min (ε / 2) (c / 2)
  have hd : 0 < d := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hdc : d < c := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact (min_le_right _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)
  have hdε : d < ε := by
    dsimp [d]
    exact (min_le_left _ _).trans_lt (by linarith)
  have hmono : StrictMonoOn h (Ioo (-d) d) := by
    apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Ioo (-d) d)
    · exact fun s hs => (hder s).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro s hs
      rw [interior_Ioo] at hs
      rw [(hder s).deriv]
      apply hεsub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero]
      exact (abs_lt.mpr hs).trans (by simpa using hdε)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hbox⟩ := V.exists_flowbox hq hd
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hsx⟩ := hbox x hx
  refine ⟨s, hs.trans hdc, hsx, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hsI : s ∈ Ioo (-d) d := (abs_lt.mp hs)
    have hzeroI : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (-d) d := by
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hhzero : h 0 = 0 := by
      simp [h, V.flow_zero]
    constructor
    · intro hspos
      have hlt := hmono hzeroI hsI hspos
      rw [hhzero] at hlt
      simpa [h, hsx] using hlt
    · intro hdisp
      by_contra hnpos
      have hsle : s ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt hnpos
      rcases hsle.eq_or_lt with hseq | hsneg
      · subst s
        have hxq : x = q := by simpa using hsx.symm
        subst x
        simp at hdisp
      · have hlt := hmono hsI hzeroI hsneg
        rw [hhzero] at hlt
        have : ⟪tauField X.g q, x - q⟫ < 0 := by
          simpa [h, τ, hsx] using hlt
        linarith
  · have hsI : s ∈ Ioo (-d) d := (abs_lt.mp hs)
    have hzeroI : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (-d) d := by
      constructor <;> linarith
    have hhzero : h 0 = 0 := by
      simp [h, V.flow_zero]
    constructor
    · intro hsneg
      have hlt := hmono hsI hzeroI hsneg
      rw [hhzero] at hlt
      simpa [h, τ, hsx] using hlt
    · intro hdisp
      by_contra hnneg
      have hsge : 0 ≤ s := le_of_not_gt hnneg
      rcases hsge.eq_or_lt with hseq | hspos
      · subst s
        have hxq : x = q := by simpa using hsx.symm
        subst x
        simp at hdisp
      · have hlt := hmono hzeroI hsI hspos
        rw [hhzero] at hlt
        have : 0 < ⟪tauField X.g q, x - q⟫ := by
          simpa [h, τ, hsx] using hlt
        linarith

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleBeforeOrbit_mem_exterior_of_ne_branches
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleBeforeOrbit_mem_exterior_of_ne_branches
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (O : (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex)
    (hnePositive : (O : Set E₁) ≠
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .positive :
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁))
    (hneNegative : (O : Set E₁) ≠
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .negative :
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁)) :
    (O : Set E₁) ∈ D.chronologicalExteriorOrbitCollection t ht
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxO
  by_contra houtside
  have hxFiber : x ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice t ht).fiber := by
    apply (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit_subset_fiber
      ((D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
    rwa [← (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O]
  have hxzero : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (cobSpaceTime x (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)) = 0 := by
    rw [chronologicalBeforeSlice,
      SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber] at hxFiber
    exact hxFiber
  have hxCovered : x ∈ (D.position.eventModel t ht).coveredSliceFiber
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) :=
    ⟨lt_of_not_ge houtside, hxzero⟩
  have hxLocal :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBeforeCoveredSliceFiber_subset_union_orbits
      t ht hindex hxCovered
  have hxO' : x ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit
      ((D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint O) := by
    rwa [← (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O]
  rcases hxLocal with hxPositive | hxNegative
  · apply hnePositive
    calc
      (O : Set E₁) = (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit
          ((D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint O) :=
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O
      _ = (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit x :=
        ((D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit_eq_of_mem hxO').symm
      _ = ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .positive :
          (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) :=
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit_eq_of_mem hxPositive
  · apply hneNegative
    calc
      (O : Set E₁) = (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit
          ((D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint O) :=
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O
      _ = (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit x :=
        ((D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit_eq_of_mem hxO').symm
      _ = ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .negative :
          (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) :=
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit_eq_of_mem hxNegative

name: Submission.lift_trans_left
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  have ht0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (t : ℝ) := t.2.1
  have ht1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 := t.2.2
  obtain ⟨s, hcoe⟩ : ∃ s : I, (s : ℝ) = (t : ℝ) / 2 :=
    ⟨⟨(t : ℝ) / 2, ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩⟩, rfl⟩
  have hle : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [hcoe]; linarith
  have h1 : (p.trans q) s = p t := by
    rw [Path.trans_apply, dif_pos hle]
    refine congrArg _ (Subtype.ext ?_)
    show 2 * (s : ℝ) = (t : ℝ)
    rw [hcoe]; ring
  have h2 : Set.Icc.convexComb u w s = Set.Icc.convexComb u v t := by
    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_convexComb, Set.Icc.coe_convexComb, hcoe]
    have hv : (v : ℝ) = ((u : ℝ) + (w : ℝ)) / 2 := by linarith
    rw [hv]; ring
  rw [← h1, h s, h2]

name: Submission.lift_trans_right
proof:
:= by
  have hmid' : 2 * (v : ℝ) = (w : ℝ) + (u : ℝ) := by linarith
  have h' : ∀ t : I, (q.symm.trans p.symm) t
      = Φ (Set.Icc.convexComb w u t) := by
    intro t
    have hstep : (q.symm.trans p.symm) t
        = (p.trans q) (unitInterval.symm t) := by
      rw [← Path.trans_symm]
      rfl
    rw [hstep, h, Set.Icc.convexComb_symm]
  have hq := lift_trans_left Φ (p := q.symm) (q := p.symm)
    (u := w) (v := v) (w := u) hmid' h'
  intro t
  have hqt := hq (unitInterval.symm t)
  rw [Set.Icc.convexComb_symm] at hqt
  have hback : q.symm (unitInterval.symm t) = q t := by
    show q (unitInterval.symm (unitInterval.symm t)) = q t
    rw [unitInterval.symm_symm]
  rw [← hback, hqt]

proof:
:= by

    ((R.angleLocal₁.trans R.angleConnector₁).trans
        (R.angleBand₁.trans R.angleConnector₂)).trans

          ((R.angleLocal₁.trans R.angleConnector₁) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight)
      R.local₁_lift R.connector₁_lift
  have hB : ∀ t : I, (afterBand₁.trans connector₂.symm) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight
          ((R.angleBand₁.trans R.angleConnector₂) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight)
      R.band₁_lift R.connector₂_lift
  have hC : ∀ t : I, (beforeLocal₂.symm.trans connector₃) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight
          ((R.angleLocal₂.trans R.angleConnector₃) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight)
      R.local₂_lift R.connector₃_lift
  have hD : ∀ t : I, (afterBand₂.trans connector₀.symm) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight
          ((R.angleBand₂.trans R.angleConnector₀) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight)
      R.band₂_lift R.connector₀_lift
  have hAB : ∀ t : I,
      ((beforeLocal₁.symm.trans connector₁).trans
        (afterBand₁.trans connector₂.symm)) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight
          (((R.angleLocal₁.trans R.angleConnector₁).trans
            (R.angleBand₁.trans R.angleConnector₂)) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight) hA hB
  have hCD : ∀ t : I,
      ((beforeLocal₂.symm.trans connector₃).trans
        (afterBand₂.trans connector₀.symm)) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight
          (((R.angleLocal₂.trans R.angleConnector₃).trans
            (R.angleBand₂.trans R.angleConnector₀)) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight) hC hD
  have hloop : ∀ t : I,
      (((beforeLocal₁.symm.trans connector₁).trans
          (afterBand₁.trans connector₂.symm)).trans
        ((beforeLocal₂.symm.trans connector₃).trans
          (afterBand₂.trans connector₀.symm))) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight (Θ t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight) hAB hCD
  refine ⟨R.chartLeft, R.chartRight, Θ.toContinuousMap, R.winding,
    R.winding_odd, ?_, hloop⟩
  show Θ 1 = Θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi * (R.winding : ℝ)
  rw [Θ.target, Θ.source]
  exact R.winding_closed

lemma tubeRegion_subset_tubeGood {r : ℝ} (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hr1 : r < 1) :

proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hd : tubeDistSq v < r ^ 2 := hv
  have hs : (rad v - 1) ^ 2 ≤ tubeDistSq v := sq_rad_le_tubeDistSq v
  have hr2 : r ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
  have hrad : 0 < rad v := by
    have hn := rad_nonneg v

  exact (Real.sqrt_pos.mp hrad)

name: Submission.contDiff_tubeCutoff
statement: theorem contDiff_tubeCutoff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tubeCutoff (m := m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro v
  by_cases hv : v ∈ tubeGood
  · have hd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (tubeDistSq (m := m)) v :=
      contDiffOn_tubeDistSq.contDiffAt (isOpen_tubeGood.mem_nhds hv)
    exact contDiff_tubeCutoffScalar.contDiffAt.comp v hd
  · have hrs : radSq v = 0 := by
      have hn := radSq_nonneg v
      have : ¬0 < radSq v := hv
      linarith
    have hr : rad v = 0 := by rw [rad, hrs, Real.sqrt_zero]
    have hd : 1 ≤ tubeDistSq v := by
      rw [tubeDistSq, hr]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖v‖]
    have hgt : 1 / 9 < tubeDistSq v := by linarith
    have hnhds : {x : E | 1 / 9 < tubeDistSq x} ∈ 𝓝 v :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_tubeDistSq).mem_nhds hgt
    apply (contDiffAt_const (x := v) (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [hnhds] with x hx
    exact tubeCutoff_of_ge hx.le

    exact contDiff_tubeCutoff.contDiffAt.smul hw
  · have hrs : radSq v = 0 := by
      have hn := radSq_nonneg v
      have : ¬0 < radSq v := hv
      linarith
    have hr : rad v = 0 := by rw [rad, hrs, Real.sqrt_zero]
    have hd : 1 ≤ tubeDistSq v := by
      rw [tubeDistSq, hr]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖v‖]
    have hgt : 1 / 9 < tubeDistSq v := by linarith
    have hnhds : {x : E | 1 / 9 < tubeDistSq x} ∈ 𝓝 v :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_tubeDistSq).mem_nhds hgt
    apply (contDiffAt_const (x := v) (c := (0 : F))).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [hnhds] with x hx
    rw [tubeCollapseHorizontal, tubeCutoff_of_ge hx.le, zero_smul]

  have heq : normalSlice (m := m) k θ = fun w : F =>

name: Submission.fderiv_wCoord_comp_normalSumCLM
statement:
theorem fderiv_wCoord_comp_normalSumCLM (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (fderiv ℝ (wCoord (m := m) k) (circleAt θ)).comp (normalSumCLM k θ)
      = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F
proof:
:= by
  have hwDiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (wCoord (m := m) k) (circleAt θ) :=
    (contDiffAt_wCoord_circleAt k θ).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hwDeriv : HasFDerivAt (wCoord (m := m) k)
      (fderiv ℝ (wCoord k) (circleAt θ)) (normalSlice k θ 0) := by
    simpa only [normalSlice_zero] using hwDiff.hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp := hwDeriv.comp (0 : F) (hasFDerivAt_normalSlice k θ 0)
  have heq : ((wCoord (m := m) k) ∘ normalSlice k θ) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] id := by
    change (fun w : F => wCoord k (normalSlice k θ w)) =ᶠ[𝓝 0] fun w => w
    exact wCoord_normalSlice_eventuallyEq k θ
  have hsame : HasFDerivAt ((wCoord (m := m) k) ∘ normalSlice k θ)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F) 0 :=
    (hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : F)).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  exact hcomp.unique hsame

  change w i * coordVec i.castSucc (Fin.last (m + 2)) = 0
  rw [coordVec_apply, if_neg, mul_zero]
  exact (castSucc_ne_last i).symm

name: Submission.tubeGood_of_tubeCutoff_ne_zero

lemma tubeGood_of_tubeCutoff_ne_zero {v : E} (hv : tubeCutoff v ≠ 0) :
    v ∈ tubeGood
proof:
:= by
  have hd : tubeDistSq v < 1 / 9 := by
    by_contra h
    exact hv (tubeCutoff_of_ge (not_lt.mp h))
  apply outerTube_subset_tubeGood
  change tubeDistSq v < (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ 2
  norm_num at hd ⊢
  exact hd

name: Submission.tubeCollapseRaw_ne_zero
statement: lemma tubeCollapseRaw_ne_zero (k : ℕ) (v : E) : tubeCollapseRaw k v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hlast := congrArg (fun z : E => z (Fin.last (m + 2))) hzero
  rw [tubeCollapseRaw_last, PiLp.zero_apply] at hlast
  have hc : tubeCutoff v = 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hc0 : tubeCutoff v ≠ 0 := by rw [hc]; norm_num
  have hhoriz : tubeCollapseHorizontal k v = 0 := by
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext i
    have hi := congrArg (fun z : E => z i.castSucc) hzero
    rw [tubeCollapseRaw_coord, PiLp.zero_apply] at hi
    exact hi
  have hw : wCoord k v = 0 := by
    rw [tubeCollapseHorizontal, hc] at hhoriz
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hhoriz).resolve_left (by norm_num)
  have hvGood : v ∈ tubeGood := tubeGood_of_tubeCutoff_ne_zero hc0
  have hvCircle : v ∈ standardCircle :=
    (wCoord_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle k hvGood).mp hw
  have hvInner : v ∈ tubeRegion (1 / 4) := standardCircle_subset_innerTube hvCircle
  have hc1 : tubeCutoff v = 1 := tubeCutoff_eq_one_on_inner hvInner
  linarith

name: Submission.contDiff_tubeCollapseRaw
statement:
theorem contDiff_tubeCollapseRaw (k : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tubeCollapseRaw (m := m) k)
proof:
:= by
  have hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun v : E =>
      targetHorizontalCLM (tubeCollapseHorizontal k v) :=
    targetHorizontalCLM.contDiff.comp (contDiff_tubeCollapseHorizontal k)
  have hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun v : E => (2 * tubeCutoff v - 1) • eVert (m := m) :=
    ((contDiff_const.mul contDiff_tubeCutoff).sub contDiff_const).smul contDiff_const
  exact hh.add hv

name: Submission.contDiff_tubeThomVec
statement:
theorem contDiff_tubeThomVec (k : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tubeThomVec (m := m) k)
proof:

  intro v
  have hr : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (tubeCollapseRaw (m := m) k) v :=
    (contDiff_tubeCollapseRaw (m := m) k).contDiffAt
  have hn : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => ‖tubeCollapseRaw k x‖) v :=
    hr.norm ℝ (tubeCollapseRaw_ne_zero k v)
  exact (hn.inv (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (tubeCollapseRaw_ne_zero k v))).smul hr

name: Submission.tubeThomCollapse_eq_north_iff
statement:
theorem tubeThomCollapse_eq_north_iff (k : ℕ) {v : E} :
    tubeThomCollapse k v = tubeNorth ↔ v ∈ standardCircle
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hcollapse
    have hvec : tubeThomVec k v = eVert := congrArg Subtype.val hcollapse
    have hraw : tubeCollapseRaw k v ≠ 0 := tubeCollapseRaw_ne_zero k v
    have hnorm : ‖tubeCollapseRaw k v‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hraw
    have hinv : ‖tubeCollapseRaw k v‖⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hnorm
    have hhoriz : tubeCollapseHorizontal k v = 0 := by
      apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
      funext i
      have hi := congrArg (fun z : E => z i.castSucc) hvec
      change ‖tubeCollapseRaw k v‖⁻¹ * tubeCollapseRaw k v i.castSucc
          = eVert i.castSucc at hi
      rw [tubeCollapseRaw_coord, eVert_apply_ne (castSucc_ne_last i)] at hi
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hi).resolve_left hinv
    have hc0 : tubeCutoff v ≠ 0 := by
      intro hc
      have hlast := congrArg (fun z : E => z (Fin.last (m + 2))) hvec
      change ‖tubeCollapseRaw k v‖⁻¹
          * tubeCollapseRaw k v (Fin.last (m + 2)) = eVert (Fin.last (m + 2)) at hlast
      rw [tubeCollapseRaw_last, eVert_apply_last, hc] at hlast
      have hpos : 0 < ‖tubeCollapseRaw k v‖⁻¹ := inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hraw)
      norm_num at hlast
      linarith
    have hw : wCoord k v = 0 := by
      rw [tubeCollapseHorizontal] at hhoriz
      exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hhoriz).resolve_left hc0
    exact (wCoord_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle k
      (tubeGood_of_tubeCutoff_ne_zero hc0)).mp hw
  · rintro ⟨θ, rfl⟩
    exact tubeThomCollapse_circleAt k θ

name: Submission.radSq_add_coordSq_le_normSq
proof:
:= by
  rw [normSq_eq_sum_sq]
  have hsub : ({0, 1, j} : Finset (Fin (m + 3))) ⊆ Finset.univ :=
    Finset.subset_univ _
  have hsum : ∑ i ∈ ({0, 1, j} : Finset (Fin (m + 3))), v i ^ 2
      = radSq v + v j ^ 2 := by
    have hset : ({0, 1, j} : Finset (Fin (m + 3))) = {j, 0, 1} := by
      ext i
      simp [or_comm, or_left_comm, or_assoc]
    rw [hset, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hj0, hj1]),
      Finset.sum_insert
        (by simp : (0 : Fin (m + 3)) ∉ ({1} : Finset (Fin (m + 3)))),
      Finset.sum_singleton]
    unfold radSq
    ring
  rw [← hsum]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub fun i _ _ => sq_nonneg _

proof:
:= by
  have hcoord := radSq_add_coordSq_le_normSq v hj0 hj1

  rw [tubeDistSq]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (rad v - 1)]

name: Submission.cubeToTubeAmbient_boundary_abs
proof:
:= by
  rcases hj with hj | hj
  · rw [cubeToTubeAmbient_apply, hj, Set.Icc.coe_zero]
    norm_num
  · rw [cubeToTubeAmbient_apply, hj, Set.Icc.coe_one]

name: Submission.cubeToTubeAmbient_boundary_off_outer
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := ht
  have habs := cubeToTubeAmbient_boundary_abs (m := m) hj
  have hsq : cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t j ^ 2 = 9 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t j)]
  have hd : 1 / 9 ≤ tubeDistSq (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t) := by
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      have hrsq := rad_sq (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t)
      have hr0 := rad_nonneg (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t)
      have hrad : 3 ≤ rad (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t) := by
        rw [radSq] at hrsq
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t 1)]
      have hdist := sq_rad_le_tubeDistSq (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t)
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (rad (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t) - 1)]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        have hrsq := rad_sq (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t)
        have hr0 := rad_nonneg (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t)
        have hrad : 3 ≤ rad (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t) := by
          rw [radSq] at hrsq
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t 0)]
        have hdist := sq_rad_le_tubeDistSq (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t)
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (rad (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t) - 1)]
      · have hdist := coordSq_le_tubeDistSq_of_ne
          (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t) hj0 hj1
        nlinarith
  intro hin
  change tubeDistSq (cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) t) < (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ 2 at hin
  norm_num at hin
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hd) hin

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.bandCoverRadius_le_dist_outerNegativeBoundaryEnd
statement:
theorem bandCoverRadius_le_dist_outerNegativeBoundaryEnd
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) (b e : SaddleBranch) :
    D.bandCoverRadius t ht ≤
      dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b e
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  have hnorm : ‖saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)‖ =
      D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht :=
    norm_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.outerScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht hb hbw)
  refine (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).le_dist_of_cover_of_le_norm
    (D.bandCoverRadius_cover t ht) ?_ ?_
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) ?_
  · rw [hnorm]
    exact (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_endpointParamRadius t ht).le
  · rw [hnorm]
    exact D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  · exact (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_fiber b e
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.outerScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht hb hbw)
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_flowedOuterNegativeBoundaryEnd_chartParam
statement:
theorem exists_flowedOuterNegativeBoundaryEnd_chartParam
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (hsmall : D.ChronologicalSaddleOuterEndpointSmallness t ht)
    (b e : SaddleBranch) :
    ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleOuterParamRadius t ht ∧
      D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht < ‖u‖ ∧
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u =
        (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b e
            (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
          (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) ∧
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  have hρ' : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht
  have hs' : D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
    D.outerScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht hb hbw
  have hρ'M : D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  set x₀ := (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b e
    (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
    (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) with hx₀
  have hfib : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x₀ = 0 :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_fiber b e hρ' hs' hρ'M
  have htime : tcoord x₀ =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_time hindex b e
      hρ' hs' hρ'M
  have hfar := D.bandCoverRadius_le_dist_outerNegativeBoundaryEnd t ht b e
  have hflowlt := D.bandCaptureScale_flowDistance_lt t ht
  have habs : |D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2| = D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 :=
    abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
  have habsn : |(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) : ℝ)| =
      D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by rw [abs_neg, habs]
  
  have hdisp : dist ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))) x₀ ≤
      2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
    have h := (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.dist_flow_self_le x₀
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) 0
    rw [(D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow_zero, sub_zero] at h
    have hval : |D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)| =
        2 * D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
      rw [sub_neg_eq_add, ← two_mul, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    rw [hval] at h
    calc dist _ x₀ ≤ ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        (2 * D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) := h
      _ = 2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by ring
  have hfibflow : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))) = 0 :=
    (D.bandTimeField t ht).flow_mem_fiber hfib _
  have hsm := (hsmall (e, b)).2
  rw [← hx₀] at hsm
  have hclose : dist ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)))
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd (e, b)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) <
      D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht (e, b) := by
    have htri := dist_triangle ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))) x₀
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd (e, b)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht))
    linarith
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hlow, hup⟩ :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin_cover t ht (e, b) _ hclose hfibflow
  
  have hsafe : D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht
  have hdafter : |(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) : ℝ)| ≤
      (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime := by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe
  have hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) -
        D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 →
      D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2 ≤ dist x (D.position.eventCenter t ht) →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime →
        tcoord ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d :=
    fun x hx ht' hf d hd => D.bandExterior_tcoord_flow_before t ht hb hbw x hx
      ht' hf d hd
  have hfar' : D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2 +
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        |(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) : ℝ)| ≤
      dist x₀ (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    rw [habsn]; linarith
  have hcore := slabFlowBack_mem_core
    (R := D.bandTimeField t ht) (eps := D.bandCoverRadius t ht)
    (dafter := -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))
    (tafter := tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) -
      D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)
    hunit (by ring) hdafter hfib htime hfar'
  have hcore' := hcore
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore] at hcore'
  have hstep : (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) =
      (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
        ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
          (-(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))))
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) :=
    flow_sub_eq_flow_flow x₀ (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)
      (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))
  have hdpos : |(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 : ℝ)| ≤
      (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime := by rw [habs]; exact hsafe
  have htcoord : tcoord ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
    rw [hstep, (D.bandTimeField t ht).tcoord_flow hcore hdpos, hcore'.2.1]
  refine ⟨u, hu, hlow, hup, ?_⟩
  have huM : ‖u‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    (hu.trans (D.chronologicalSaddleOuterParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)).trans_le
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hq := (D.position.eventModel t ht).time_model u huM
  rw [hindex, hup, htcoord] at hq
  linarith

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_flowedOuterPositiveBoundaryEnd_chartParam
statement:
theorem exists_flowedOuterPositiveBoundaryEnd_chartParam
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (hsmall : D.ChronologicalSaddleOuterEndpointSmallness t ht)
    (b e : SaddleBranch) :
    ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleOuterParamRadius t ht ∧
      D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht < ‖u‖ ∧
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u =
        (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b e
            (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
          (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) ∧
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  have hρ' : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht
  have hs' : D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
    D.outerScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht hb hbw
  have hρ'M : D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  set x₀ := (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b e
    (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
    (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) with hx₀
  have hfib : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x₀ = 0 :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_fiber b e hρ' hs' hρ'M
  have htime : tcoord x₀ =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex b e
      hρ' hs' hρ'M
  have hfar := D.bandCoverRadius_le_dist_outerPositiveBoundaryEnd t ht b e
  have hflowlt := D.bandCaptureScale_flowDistance_lt t ht
  have habs : |D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2| = D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 :=
    abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)
  have hdisp : dist ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
        (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) x₀ ≤
      2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
    have h := (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.dist_flow_self_le x₀
      (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) 0
    rw [(D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow_zero, sub_zero] at h
    have hval : |(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) -
        D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 : ℝ)| =
        2 * D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
      rw [show (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 :
        ℝ) = -(2 * D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) by ring, abs_neg,
        abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    rw [hval] at h
    calc dist _ x₀ ≤ ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        (2 * D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) := h
      _ = 2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by ring
  have hfibflow : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
        (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) = 0 :=
    (D.bandTimeField t ht).flow_mem_fiber hfib _
  have hsm := (hsmall (b, e)).1
  rw [← hx₀] at hsm
  have hclose : dist ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
      (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd (b, e)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) <
      D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht (b, e) := by
    have htri := dist_triangle ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
      (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) x₀
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd (b, e)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht))
    linarith
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hlow, hup⟩ :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin_cover t ht (b, e) _ hclose hfibflow
  have hsafe : D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht
  have hdafter : |(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 : ℝ)| ≤
      (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime := by rw [habs]; exact hsafe
  have hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) +
        D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 →
      D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2 ≤ dist x (D.position.eventCenter t ht) →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime →
        tcoord ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d :=
    fun x hx ht' hf d hd => D.bandExterior_tcoord_flow_after t ht hb hbw x hx
      ht' hf d hd
  have hfar' : D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2 +
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        |(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 : ℝ)| ≤
      dist x₀ (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    rw [habs]; linarith
  have hcore := slabFlowBack_mem_core
    (R := D.bandTimeField t ht) (eps := D.bandCoverRadius t ht)
    (dafter := D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)
    (tafter := tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) +
      D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)
    hunit rfl hdafter hfib htime hfar'
  have hcore' := hcore
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore] at hcore'
  have hstep : (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
      (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) =
      (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
        ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
          (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)))
        (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) :=
    flow_sub_eq_flow_flow x₀ (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)
  have hdneg : |(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) : ℝ)| ≤
      (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime := by rw [abs_neg, habs]; exact hsafe
  have htcoord : tcoord ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀
      (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
    rw [hstep, (D.bandTimeField t ht).tcoord_flow hcore hdneg, hcore'.2.1]
    ring
  refine ⟨u, hu, hlow, hup, ?_⟩
  have huM : ‖u‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    (hu.trans (D.chronologicalSaddleOuterParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)).trans_le
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hq := (D.position.eventModel t ht).time_model u huM
  rw [hindex, hup, htcoord] at hq
  linarith

name: Submission.SOFrameGauge.toCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem toCLM_apply (A : SOGroup n) (x : F) :
    toCLM A x =
      (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n) (𝕜 := ℝ)) (A : M) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.SOFrameGauge.toCLM_apply_coord
statement:
@[simp] theorem toCLM_apply_coord (A : SOGroup n) (x : F) (i : Fin n) :
    toCLM A x i = ∑ j : Fin n, (A : M) i j * x j
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.toLpLin 2 2 (A : M) x) i = _
  rw [Matrix.toLpLin_apply]
  rfl

name: Submission.SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem toCLM_one :
    toCLM (1 : SOGroup n) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro x
  change (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n) (𝕜 := ℝ)) (1 : M) x = x
  simp

name: Submission.SOFrameGauge.toCLM_inv_apply
statement:
theorem toCLM_inv_apply (A : SOGroup n) (x : F) :
    toCLM A⁻¹ (toCLM A x) = x
proof:
:= by
  change (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n) (𝕜 := ℝ)) ((↑A⁻¹ : M))
    ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n) (𝕜 := ℝ)) (A : M) x) = x
  change
    (((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n) (𝕜 := ℝ)) ((↑A⁻¹ : M))) *
      ((Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n) (𝕜 := ℝ)) (A : M))) x = x
  rw [← map_mul]
  change (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin n) (𝕜 := ℝ))
    ((↑(A⁻¹ * A) : M)) x = x
  rw [inv_mul_cancel A]
  simp

name: Submission.SOFrameGauge.toCLM_apply_inv
statement:
theorem toCLM_apply_inv (A : SOGroup n) (x : F) :
    toCLM A (toCLM A⁻¹ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  simpa using toCLM_inv_apply A⁻¹ x

name: Submission.SOFrameGauge.toCLM_bijective
statement: theorem toCLM_bijective (A : SOGroup n) : Bijective (toCLM A)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    have h := congrArg (toCLM A⁻¹) hxy
    simpa only [toCLM_inv_apply] using h
  · intro y
    exact ⟨toCLM A⁻¹ y, toCLM_apply_inv A y⟩

name: Submission.SOFrameGauge.contDiff_toCLM
statement:
theorem contDiff_toCLM {P : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup P] [NormedSpace ℝ P]
    {R : P → SOGroup n}
    (hR : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p => ((R p : SOGroup n) : M) i j)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p => toCLM (R p))
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_clm_apply_iff]
  intro x
  rw [contDiff_euclidean]
  intro i
  simp_rw [toCLM_apply_coord]
  exact ContDiff.sum (s := Finset.univ)
    (fun j _ => (hR i j).mul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.SOFrameGauge.homotopy_H
statement:
@[simp] theorem homotopy_H (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (R : ℝ → E → SOGroup n)
    (hR : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => ((R p.1 p.2 : SOGroup n) : M) i j))
    (hRzero : ∀ x, R 0 x = 1) (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    (homotopy X R hR hRzero).H s x = toCLM (R s x) (X.g x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.saddleBandOctagonReading_merge_twoRadius
statement:
theorem saddleBandOctagonReading_merge_twoRadius
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (Hs : M.FullRadiusSmooth) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s rE rA : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius) (hErad : rE < T.radius)
    (hArad : rA < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    {e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch} (hlab : e₁ ≠ e₂)
    (hne : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg ≠
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg)
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos))
    (hprov : T.RebasedMergeBandProvenance hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos
      Vneg Vpos R F)
    (hconn : ∀ (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
      (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (dt : C(I, ℝ)),
      x₀ ∈ criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2) →
      x₀ = R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) (-(s ^ 2)) →
      (∀ w : I, |dt w| ≤ s ^ 2) →
      ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ w : I, ‖η w‖ ≤ rE) ∧
        (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.1 (η w 0)) ∧
        (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.2 (η w 1)) ∧
        (∀ w : I, M.localPoint (η w) = R.base.flow x₀ (dt w)))
    (harc₁ : ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ rA) ∧
      ∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₁ F) u)
    (harc₅ : ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ rA) ∧
      ∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₅ F) u) :
    SaddleBandOctagonReading T F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hb
  have hρM : ρ < M.radius := hρrad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hAM : rA < M.radius := hArad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hEM : rE < M.radius := hErad.trans_le T.radius_le
  obtain ⟨hdb, hda, hcut3, hafter3, hafter7, hafterEnd,
    ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩, ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩, ⟨p₂, hp₂⟩, ⟨p₃, hp₃⟩⟩ := hprov
  
  have hafterSpace : ∀ v : I,
      spacePart (((F.ambientAfterLoop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = F.afterParam.curve v := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientAfterLoop_coe v]
    exact spacePart_spaceTime _ _
  have hafterTime : ∀ v : I,
      tcoord (((F.ambientAfterLoop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientAfterLoop_coe v]
    exact tcoord_spaceTime _ _
  
  have hmem₃ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro u
    have h : ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop
          (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ u) :
          ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) := rfl
    rw [h, hafterSpace]
    exact hafter3 u
  have htime₃ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u) = tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    have h : ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop
          (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ u) :
          ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) := rfl
    rw [h, hafterTime]
  obtain ⟨eta₃, hn₃, hsg₃, hc₃⟩ :=
    T.exists_chartMap_sign_of_saddlePositiveSpatialSegment hindex .positive hρ
      hs0 hs hρrad (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F)) hmem₃ htime₃
  have hx₃ : ∀ u : I, 0 < eta₃ u 0 := fun u => hsg₃ u
  
  have harc₇val : ∀ u : I, ∃ v : I,
      ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop v : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) ∧
      F.afterParam.curve v ∈
        Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro u
    show ∃ v : I,
      ((((Submission.loopWrap F.ambientAfterLoop F.afterCut₃ F.afterCut₀) u :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = _ ∧ _
    rw [Submission.loopWrap, Path.trans_apply]
