statement:
theorem saddleBandOctagonReading_split_twoRadius
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (Hs : M.FullRadiusSmooth) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s rE rA : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius) (hErad : rE < T.radius)
    (hArad : rA < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    {e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch} (hlab : e₁ ≠ e₂)
    (hne : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos ≠
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos)
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregpos hregneg Vpos Vneg
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos)
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos)
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg))
    (hprov : T.RebasedSplitBandProvenance hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos
      Vneg Vpos R F)
    (hconn : ∀ (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
      (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (dt : C(I, ℝ)),
      x₀ ∈ criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2) →
      x₀ = R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) (-(-(s ^ 2))) →
      (∀ w : I, |dt w| ≤ s ^ 2) →
      ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ w : I, ‖η w‖ ≤ rE) ∧
        (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.1 (η w 0)) ∧
        (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.2 (η w 1)) ∧
        (∀ w : I, M.localPoint (η w) = R.base.flow x₀ (dt w)))
    (harc₁ : ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ rA) ∧
      ∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₁ F) u)
    (harc₅ : ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ rA) ∧
      ∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₅ F) u) :
    SaddleBandOctagonReading T F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hb
  have hρM : ρ < M.radius := hρrad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hAM : rA < M.radius := hArad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hEM : rE < M.radius := hErad.trans_le T.radius_le
  obtain ⟨hdb, hda, hcut3, hafter3, hafter7, hafterEnd,
    ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩, ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩, ⟨p₂, hp₂⟩, ⟨p₃, hp₃⟩⟩ := hprov
  have hafterSpace : ∀ v : I,
      spacePart (((F.ambientAfterLoop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = F.afterParam.curve v := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientAfterLoop_coe v]
    exact spacePart_spaceTime _ _
  have hafterTime : ∀ v : I,
      tcoord (((F.ambientAfterLoop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = tcoord center - s ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientAfterLoop_coe v]
    exact tcoord_spaceTime _ _
  
  have hmem₃ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro u
    have h : ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop
          (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ u) :
          ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) := rfl
    rw [h, hafterSpace]
    exact hafter3 u
  have htime₃ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u) = tcoord center - s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    have h : ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop
          (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ u) :
          ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) := rfl
    rw [h, hafterTime]
  obtain ⟨eta₃, hn₃, hsg₃, hc₃⟩ :=
    T.exists_chartMap_sign_of_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment hindex .positive hρ
      hs0 hs hρrad (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F)) hmem₃ htime₃
  have hx₃ : ∀ u : I, 0 < eta₃ u 1 := fun u => hsg₃ u
  
  have harc₇val : ∀ u : I, ∃ v : I,
      ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop v : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) ∧
      F.afterParam.curve v ∈
        Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro u
    show ∃ v : I,
      ((((Submission.loopWrap F.ambientAfterLoop F.afterCut₃ F.afterCut₀) u :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = _ ∧ _
    rw [Submission.loopWrap, Path.trans_apply]
    split_ifs with hcase
    · refine ⟨Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₃ (1 : I) _, rfl, ?_⟩
      have hone : Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₃ (1 : I)
          (⟨2 * (u : ℝ), by constructor <;> [linarith [u.2.1]; linarith]⟩ : I)
            = (1 : I) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show (1 - (2 * (u : ℝ))) * (F.afterCut₃ : ℝ) + (2 * (u : ℝ)) * 1 = 1
        rw [hcut3]
        show (1 - (2 * (u : ℝ))) * (1 : ℝ) + (2 * (u : ℝ)) * 1 = 1
        ring
      rw [hone]
      exact hafterEnd
    · exact ⟨Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) F.afterCut₀ _, rfl, hafter7 _⟩
  have hmem₇ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F) u) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvmem⟩ := harc₇val u
    rw [hv, hafterSpace]
    exact hvmem
  have htime₇ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F) u) = tcoord center - s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := harc₇val u
    rw [hv, hafterTime]
  obtain ⟨eta₇, hn₇, hsg₇, hc₇⟩ :=
    T.exists_chartMap_sign_of_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment hindex .negative hρ
      hs0 hs hρrad (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F)) hmem₇ htime₇
  have hx₇ : ∀ u : I, eta₇ u 1 < 0 := fun u =>
    neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative (hsg₇ u)
  
  have hdtbound : ∀ w : I, |bandConnectorTime F w| ≤ s ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    rw [bandConnectorTime_apply, hdb, hda, abs_le]
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (w : ℝ) := w.2.1
    have h1 : (w : ℝ) ≤ 1 := w.2.2
    have hsq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ s ^ 2 := sq_nonneg s
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hdtbound' : ∀ w : I, |bandConnectorTimeRev F w| ≤ s ^ 2 := fun w =>
    hdtbound _
  
  obtain ⟨eta₂, hn₂, hq₂a, hq₂b, hc₂⟩ :=
    hconn p₁ (F.coreArc₁ 1) (bandConnectorTime F) (F.coreArc₁_mem 1) hp₁ hdtbound
  obtain ⟨eta₄, hn₄, hq₄a, hq₄b, hc₄⟩ :=
    hconn p₂ (F.coreArc₂ 0) (bandConnectorTimeRev F) (F.coreArc₂_mem 0) hp₂ hdtbound'
  obtain ⟨eta₆, hn₆, hq₆a, hq₆b, hc₆⟩ :=
    hconn p₃ (F.coreArc₂ 1) (bandConnectorTime F) (F.coreArc₂_mem 1) hp₃ hdtbound
  obtain ⟨eta₈, hn₈, hq₈a, hq₈b, hc₈⟩ :=
    hconn p₀ (F.coreArc₁ 0) (bandConnectorTimeRev F) (F.coreArc₁_mem 0) hp₀ hdtbound'
  
  obtain ⟨eta₁, hn₁, hc₁⟩ := harc₁
  obtain ⟨eta₅, hn₅, hc₅⟩ := harc₅
  have hbeforeSpace : ∀ v : I,
      spacePart (((F.ambientBefore₁Loop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = F.before₁Param.curve v := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₁Loop_coe v]
    exact spacePart_spaceTime _ _
  have hbeforeSpace₂ : ∀ v : I,
      spacePart (((F.ambientBefore₂Loop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = F.before₂Param.curve v := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₂Loop_coe v]
    exact spacePart_spaceTime _ _
  have hlvl₁ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      tcoord ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = tcoord center + s ^ 2)
      F.ambientBefore₁Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₁Loop_coe v]
    exact tcoord_spaceTime _ _
  have hlvl₂ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      tcoord ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = tcoord center + s ^ 2)
      F.ambientBefore₂Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₂Loop_coe v]
    exact tcoord_spaceTime _ _
  have hOrb₁ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      spacePart ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) F.ambientBefore₁Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [hbeforeSpace v, Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit _]
    exact (Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem F.before₁Param_orbit).ge
      (F.before₁Param.curve_mem_orbit v)
  have hOrb₂ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      spacePart ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) F.ambientBefore₂Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [hbeforeSpace₂ v, Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit _]
    exact (Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem F.before₂Param_orbit).ge
      (F.before₂Param.curve_mem_orbit v)
  have htime₁ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (M.localPoint (eta₁ u)) = tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₁ u]
    exact ((hlvl₁.loopWrap F.before₁Cut₁ F.before₁Cut₀).symm) u
  have htime₅ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (M.localPoint (eta₅ u)) = tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₅ u]
    exact ((hlvl₂.loopWrap F.before₂Cut₁ F.before₂Cut₀).symm) u
  have hmemO₁ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (M.localPoint (eta₁ u)) ∈
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
        Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₁ u]
    exact ((hOrb₁.loopWrap F.before₁Cut₁ F.before₁Cut₀).symm) u
  have hmemO₂ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (M.localPoint (eta₅ u)) ∈
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
        Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₅ u]
    exact ((hOrb₂.loopWrap F.before₂Cut₁ F.before₂Cut₀).symm) u
  have hnorm₁ : ∀ u : I, ‖eta₁ u‖ < M.radius := fun u => (hn₁ u).trans_lt hAM
  have hnorm₅ : ∀ u : I, ‖eta₅ u‖ < M.radius := fun u => (hn₅ u).trans_lt hAM
  have hsg : (∀ u : I, 0 < eta₁ u 0) ∨ (∀ u : I, eta₁ u 0 < 0) :=
    chartMap_after_fst_sign (M := M) hindex hs0 eta₁ hnorm₁ htime₁
  have htg : (∀ u : I, 0 < eta₅ u 0) ∨ (∀ u : I, eta₅ u 0 < 0) :=
    chartMap_after_fst_sign (M := M) hindex hs0 eta₅ hnorm₅ htime₅
  have hbranch₁ : ∀ b : SaddleBranch, 0 < signedBranch b (eta₁ 0 0) →
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos =
        T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos := by
    intro b hbsign
    have hmemb : spacePart (M.param (eta₁ 0)) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :=
      T.mem_saddlePositiveBranchOrbit_of_chartParam Hs hindex b ρ s (eta₁ 0)
        (chartParam_quadratic_after (M := M) hindex (hnorm₁ 0) (htime₁ 0))
        hbsign hρ hs hρrad (hnorm₁ 0) hregpos Vpos rfl
    by_contra hcon
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (Vpos.orbitFinset_pairwise_disjoint _
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos).property _
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos).property (fun h => hcon (Subtype.ext h)))
      (hmemO₁ 0) hmemb
  have hbranch₅ : ∀ b : SaddleBranch, 0 < signedBranch b (eta₅ 0 0) →
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos =
        T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos := by
    intro b hbsign
    have hmemb : spacePart (M.param (eta₅ 0)) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :=
      T.mem_saddlePositiveBranchOrbit_of_chartParam Hs hindex b ρ s (eta₅ 0)
        (chartParam_quadratic_after (M := M) hindex (hnorm₅ 0) (htime₅ 0))
        hbsign hρ hs hρrad (hnorm₅ 0) hregpos Vpos rfl
    by_contra hcon
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (Vpos.orbitFinset_pairwise_disjoint _
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos).property _
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos).property (fun h => hcon (Subtype.ext h)))
      (hmemO₂ 0) hmemb
  have hnoteq : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos =
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
        Vpos → False := by
    intro heq12
    cases e₁ <;> cases e₂ <;>
      first
        | exact hlab rfl
        | exact hne heq12
        | exact hne heq12.symm
  set r : ℝ := max (max ρ rE) rA with hrdef
  have hr : r < T.radius := max_lt (max_lt hρrad hErad) hArad
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  set P : OctagonPlacement T F r :=
    { eta₁ := eta₁, eta₂ := eta₂, eta₃ := eta₃, eta₄ := eta₄,
      eta₅ := eta₅, eta₆ := eta₆, eta₇ := eta₇, eta₈ := eta₈
      norm₁ := fun u => (hn₁ u).trans (le_max_right (max ρ rE) rA)
      norm₂ := fun u => (hn₂ u).trans ((le_max_right ρ rE).trans (le_max_left (max ρ rE) rA))
      norm₃ := fun u => (hn₃ u).trans ((le_max_left ρ rE).trans (le_max_left (max ρ rE) rA))
      norm₄ := fun u => (hn₄ u).trans ((le_max_right ρ rE).trans (le_max_left (max ρ rE) rA))
      norm₅ := fun u => (hn₅ u).trans (le_max_right (max ρ rE) rA)
      norm₆ := fun u => (hn₆ u).trans ((le_max_right ρ rE).trans (le_max_left (max ρ rE) rA))
      norm₇ := fun u => (hn₇ u).trans ((le_max_left ρ rE).trans (le_max_left (max ρ rE) rA))
      norm₈ := fun u => (hn₈ u).trans ((le_max_right ρ rE).trans (le_max_left (max ρ rE) rA))
      chart₁ := hc₁
      chart₂ := fun u => (hc₂ u).trans rfl
      chart₃ := hc₃
      chart₄ := fun u => (hc₄ u).trans rfl
      chart₅ := hc₅
      chart₆ := fun u => (hc₆ u).trans rfl
      chart₇ := hc₇
      chart₈ := fun u => (hc₈ u).trans rfl } with hPdef
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  have j12 : eta₁ 1 = eta₂ 0 := P.join₁₂ hr
  have j23 : eta₂ 1 = eta₃ 0 := P.join₂₃ hr
  have j34 : eta₃ 1 = eta₄ 0 := P.join₃₄ hr
  have j45 : eta₄ 1 = eta₅ 0 := P.join₄₅ hr
  have j56 : eta₅ 1 = eta₆ 0 := P.join₅₆ hr
  have j67 : eta₆ 1 = eta₇ 0 := P.join₆₇ hr
  have j78 : eta₇ 1 = eta₈ 0 := P.join₇₈ hr
  have j81 : eta₈ 1 = eta₁ 0 := P.join₈₁ hr
  have hlq₁ : p₁.2 = .positive := by
    refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₂b 1) ?_
    rw [j23]; exact hx₃ 0
  have hlq₂ : p₂.2 = .positive := by
    refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₄b 0) ?_
    rw [← j34]; exact hx₃ 1
  have hlq₃ : p₃.2 = .negative := by
    refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₆b 1) ?_
    rw [j67]; exact hx₇ 0
  have hlq₀ : p₀.2 = .negative := by
    refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₈b 0) ?_
    rw [← j78]; exact hx₇ 1
  have hy₂ : ∀ u : I, 0 < eta₂ u 1 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₂b u; rw [hlq₁] at h; exact h
  have hy₄ : ∀ u : I, 0 < eta₄ u 1 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₄b u; rw [hlq₂] at h; exact h
  have hy₆ : ∀ u : I, eta₆ u 1 < 0 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₆b u; rw [hlq₃] at h
    exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
  have hy₈ : ∀ u : I, eta₈ u 1 < 0 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₈b u; rw [hlq₀] at h
    exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
  rcases hsg with hsg | hsg <;> rcases htg with htg | htg
  · exfalso
    refine hnoteq ?_
    rw [hbranch₁ .positive (hsg 0), hbranch₅ .positive (htg 0)]
  · 
    have hlp₁ : p₁.1 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₂a 0) ?_
      rw [← j12]; exact hsg 1
    have hlp₂ : p₂.1 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₄a 1) ?_
      rw [j45]; exact htg 0
    have hlp₃ : p₃.1 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₆a 0) ?_
      rw [← j56]; exact htg 1
    have hlp₀ : p₀.1 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₈a 1) ?_
      rw [j81]; exact hsg 0
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl
      ⟨hsg, ?_, hy₂, hx₃, ?_, hy₄, htg, ?_, hy₆, hx₇, ?_, hy₈⟩)))
    · intro u; have h := hq₂a u; rw [hlp₁] at h; exact h
    · intro u; have h := hq₄a u; rw [hlp₂] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
    · intro u; have h := hq₆a u; rw [hlp₃] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
    · intro u; have h := hq₈a u; rw [hlp₀] at h; exact h
  · 
    have hlp₁ : p₁.1 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₂a 0) ?_
      rw [← j12]; exact hsg 1
    have hlp₂ : p₂.1 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₄a 1) ?_
      rw [j45]; exact htg 0
    have hlp₃ : p₃.1 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₆a 0) ?_
      rw [← j56]; exact htg 1
    have hlp₀ : p₀.1 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₈a 1) ?_
      rw [j81]; exact hsg 0
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr
      ⟨hsg, ?_, hy₂, hx₃, ?_, hy₄, htg, ?_, hy₆, hx₇, ?_, hy₈⟩)))
    · intro u; have h := hq₂a u; rw [hlp₁] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
    · intro u; have h := hq₄a u; rw [hlp₂] at h; exact h
    · intro u; have h := hq₆a u; rw [hlp₃] at h; exact h
    · intro u; have h := hq₈a u; rw [hlp₀] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
  · exfalso
    refine hnoteq ?_
    rw [hbranch₁ .negative (by
        have := hsg 0
        show (0:ℝ) < -(eta₁ 0 0)
        linarith),
      hbranch₅ .negative (by
        have := htg 0
        show (0:ℝ) < -(eta₅ 0 0)
        linarith)]

name: Submission.initCLM_spaceTime
statement:
lemma initCLM_spaceTime (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (t : ℝ) :
    initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x t) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext j
  show (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℝ) (WithLp.ofLp x) t) j.castSucc = x j
  exact Fin.snoc_castSucc _ _ j

name: Submission.vertC_spaceTime
statement:
lemma vertC_spaceTime (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (t : ℝ) :
    vertC (spaceTime x t) = t
proof:
:= by
  show (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℝ) (WithLp.ofLp x) t) (Fin.last (n + 1)) = t
  exact Fin.snoc_last _ _

name: Submission.spaceTime_eq_affine
statement:
lemma spaceTime_eq_affine (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (t : ℝ) :
    spaceTime x t = embedCLM (n + 1) x + t • eLast (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
    show (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℝ) (WithLp.ofLp x) t) (Fin.last (n + 1)) = _
    rw [Fin.snoc_last]
    simp [eLast]
  | cast j =>
    have hne : (j.castSucc : Fin (n + 1 + 1)) ≠ Fin.last (n + 1) :=
      (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j).ne
    show (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℝ) (WithLp.ofLp x) t) j.castSucc = _
    rw [Fin.snoc_castSucc]
    simp [eLast, hne]

name: Submission.surjective_initCLM_succ
statement:
lemma surjective_initCLM_succ :
    Function.Surjective (initCLM (n + 1) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
proof:
:=
  fun x => ⟨spaceTime x 0, initCLM_spaceTime x 0⟩

name: Submission.hasFDerivAt_spaceTime
statement:
lemma hasFDerivAt_spaceTime (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (t : ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun x' => spaceTime x' t) (embedCLM (n + 1)) x
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => spaceTime x' t)
      = fun x' => embedCLM (n + 1) x' + t • eLast (n + 1) :=
    funext fun x' => spaceTime_eq_affine x' t
  rw [h]
  exact (embedCLM (n + 1)).hasFDerivAt.add_const _

name: Submission.spaceTime_init_vert
statement:
lemma spaceTime_init_vert (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1))) :
    spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) w) (vertC w) = w
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  show Fin.snoc (Fin.init (WithLp.ofLp w)) (vertC w) = WithLp.ofLp w
  exact Fin.snoc_init_self _

name: Submission.reparamCLM_apply
statement:
lemma reparamCLM_apply (s : ℝ) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1))) :
    reparamCLM n s v
      = embedCLM (n + 1) (initCLM (n + 1) v) + (s * vertC v) • eLast (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (n + 1)) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) →L[ℝ] ℝ) v = vertC v := rfl
  simp only [reparamCLM, add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp,
    Function.comp_apply, smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, h1, smul_smul]

name: Submission.reparamMap_eq_affine
statement:
lemma reparamMap_eq_affine (s c : ℝ) :
    reparamMap n s c = fun v => reparamCLM n s v + c • eLast (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  funext v
  rw [reparamMap, spaceTime_eq_affine, reparamCLM_apply, add_smul]
  exact (add_assoc _ _ _).symm

name: Submission.contDiff_reparamMap

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.isBounded_fiber
statement: lemma isBounded_fiber : Bornology.IsBounded C.fiber
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := C.spatial_bounded
  apply (Metric.isBounded_closedBall
    (x := (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)))) (r := |R| + 1)).subset
  rintro v ⟨hv0, hvt0, hvt1⟩
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  have h1 : ‖v‖ ^ 2 = ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ ^ 2 + vertC v ^ 2 := norm_sq_split v
  have h2 : ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ ≤ |R| := (hR v hv0).trans (le_abs_self R)
  have h3 : vertC v ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have h4 : ‖v‖ ^ 2 ≤ (|R| + 1) ^ 2 := by
    have h5 : ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ ^ 2 ≤ |R| ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (initCLM (n + 1) v), abs_nonneg R]
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg R]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg v, abs_nonneg R]

name: Submission.fderiv_comp_spaceTime
statement:
lemma fderiv_comp_spaceTime {G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (t : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun x' => G (spaceTime x' t)) x
      = (fderiv ℝ G (spaceTime x t)).comp (embedCLM (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hGd : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G (spaceTime x t)) (spaceTime x t) :=
    (hG.differentiable infty_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
  exact (hGd.comp x (hasFDerivAt_spaceTime x t)).fderiv

name: Submission.surjective_fderiv_of_time_collar
statement:
theorem surjective_fderiv_of_time_collar
    {G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    {g₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} {c : ℝ}
    (hcol : ∀ x' t', t' ≤ c → G (spaceTime x' t') = g₀ x')
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ c)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ g₀ x)) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G (spaceTime x t))
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : g₀ = fun x' => G (spaceTime x' t) :=
    funext fun x' => (hcol x' t ht).symm
  have hEq : fderiv ℝ g₀ x
      = (fderiv ℝ G (spaceTime x t)).comp (embedCLM (n + 1)) := by
    rw [hfun]
    exact fderiv_comp_spaceTime hG x t
  rw [hEq, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] at hsurj
  exact hsurj.of_comp

name: Submission.surjective_fderiv_of_time_collar_right
statement:
theorem surjective_fderiv_of_time_collar_right
    {G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    {g₁ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} {c : ℝ}
    (hcol : ∀ x' t', c ≤ t' → G (spaceTime x' t') = g₁ x')
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} {t : ℝ} (ht : c ≤ t)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ g₁ x)) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ G (spaceTime x t))
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : g₁ = fun x' => G (spaceTime x' t) :=
    funext fun x' => (hcol x' t ht).symm
  have hEq : fderiv ℝ g₁ x
      = (fderiv ℝ G (spaceTime x t)).comp (embedCLM (n + 1)) := by
    rw [hfun]
    exact fderiv_comp_spaceTime hG x t
  rw [hEq, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] at hsurj
  exact hsurj.of_comp

name: Submission.transFun_middle
statement:
lemma transFun_middle {C₁ C₂ : FramedLevelCobordism n} (h : C₁.X₁ = C₂.X₀)
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1))}
    (h1 : 5 / 12 < vertC v) (h2 : vertC v < 7 / 12) :
    transFun C₁ C₂ v = C₂.X₀.g (initCLM (n + 1) v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [transFun]
  by_cases hv : vertC v < 1 / 2
  · rw [if_pos hv]
    have hcol := C₁.collar_one (initCLM (n + 1) v) (3 * vertC v + -(1 / 2))
      (by linarith)
    rw [reparamMap, hcol, h]
  · rw [if_neg hv]
    exact C₂.collar_zero (initCLM (n + 1) v) (3 * vertC v + -(3 / 2)) (by linarith)

name: Submission.contDiff_transFun
statement:
lemma contDiff_transFun {C₁ C₂ : FramedLevelCobordism n} (h : C₁.X₁ = C₂.X₀) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (transFun C₁ C₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro v
  rcases lt_trichotomy (vertC v) (1 / 2) with hv | hv | hv
  · refine ((C₁.smooth.comp (contDiff_reparamMap 3 (-(1 / 2)))).contDiffAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_vert_lt (1 / 2)).mem_nhds hv)
      fun w hw => if_pos hw
  · refine ((C₂.X₀.smooth.comp (initCLM (n + 1)).contDiff).contDiffAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((isOpen_vert_between (5 / 12) (7 / 12)).mem_nhds ⟨by rw [hv]; norm_num, by rw [hv]; norm_num⟩)
      fun w hw => transFun_middle h hw.1 hw.2
  · refine ((C₂.smooth.comp (contDiff_reparamMap 3 (-(3 / 2)))).contDiffAt).congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_lt_vert (1 / 2)).mem_nhds hv)
      fun w hw => if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hw))

name: Submission.transFun_regular
statement:
lemma transFun_regular {C₁ C₂ : FramedLevelCobordism n} (h : C₁.X₁ = C₂.X₀) :
    ∀ v, transFun C₁ C₂ v = 0 →
      Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (transFun C₁ C₂) v)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rcases lt_trichotomy (vertC v) (1 / 2) with hlt | heq | hgt
  · have hEv : transFun C₁ C₂ =ᶠ[𝓝 v]
        fun w => C₁.G (reparamMap n 3 (-(1 / 2)) w) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_vert_lt (1 / 2)).mem_nhds hlt)
        fun w hw => if_pos hw
    have hval : C₁.G (reparamMap n 3 (-(1 / 2)) v) = 0 := by
      rw [← hv, transFun, if_pos hlt]
    have hGd : HasFDerivAt C₁.G (fderiv ℝ C₁.G (reparamMap n 3 (-(1 / 2)) v))
        (reparamMap n 3 (-(1 / 2)) v) :=
      (C₁.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (transFun C₁ C₂) v
        = (fderiv ℝ C₁.G (reparamMap n 3 (-(1 / 2)) v)).comp (reparamCLM n 3) := by
      rw [hEv.fderiv_eq]
      exact (hGd.comp v (hasFDerivAt_reparamMap 3 (-(1 / 2)) v)).fderiv
    rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp]
    exact (C₁.regular _ hval).comp (surjective_reparamCLM (by norm_num))
  · have hmem : (5 : ℝ) / 12 < vertC v ∧ vertC v < 7 / 12 :=
      ⟨by rw [heq]; norm_num, by rw [heq]; norm_num⟩
    have hEv : transFun C₁ C₂ =ᶠ[𝓝 v]
        fun w => C₂.X₀.g (initCLM (n + 1) w) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
        ((isOpen_vert_between (5 / 12) (7 / 12)).mem_nhds hmem)
        fun w hw => transFun_middle h hw.1 hw.2
    have hval : C₂.X₀.g (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 0 := by
      rw [← transFun_middle h hmem.1 hmem.2]
      exact hv
    have hGd : HasFDerivAt C₂.X₀.g (fderiv ℝ C₂.X₀.g (initCLM (n + 1) v))
        (initCLM (n + 1) v) :=
      (C₂.X₀.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (transFun C₁ C₂) v
        = (fderiv ℝ C₂.X₀.g (initCLM (n + 1) v)).comp (initCLM (n + 1)) := by
      rw [hEv.fderiv_eq]
      exact (hGd.comp v (initCLM (n + 1)).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
    rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp]
    exact (C₂.X₀.regular _ hval).comp surjective_initCLM_succ
  · have hEv : transFun C₁ C₂ =ᶠ[𝓝 v]
        fun w => C₂.G (reparamMap n 3 (-(3 / 2)) w) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_lt_vert (1 / 2)).mem_nhds hgt)
        fun w hw => if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hw))
    have hval : C₂.G (reparamMap n 3 (-(3 / 2)) v) = 0 := by
      rw [← hv, transFun, if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hgt))]
    have hGd : HasFDerivAt C₂.G (fderiv ℝ C₂.G (reparamMap n 3 (-(3 / 2)) v))
        (reparamMap n 3 (-(3 / 2)) v) :=
      (C₂.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (transFun C₁ C₂) v
        = (fderiv ℝ C₂.G (reparamMap n 3 (-(3 / 2)) v)).comp (reparamCLM n 3) := by
      rw [hEv.fderiv_eq]
      exact (hGd.comp v (hasFDerivAt_reparamMap 3 (-(3 / 2)) v)).fderiv
    rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp]
    exact (C₂.regular _ hval).comp (surjective_reparamCLM (by norm_num))

name: Submission.nraw_cubeClamp
statement:
lemma nraw_cubeClamp {p : Ω^ (Fin (n + 1)) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
    (southPole n)} (a : Approximation p) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :
    nraw a (fun i => ((cubeClamp x i : ℝ))) = nraw a x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hin : ∀ i, 0 ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ 1
  · have hco : (fun i => ((cubeClamp x i : ℝ))) = x := by
      funext i
      show ((Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one (x i) : I) : ℝ) = x i
      rw [Set.coe_projIcc, min_eq_right (hin i).2, max_eq_right (hin i).1]
    rw [hco]
  · rw [not_forall] at hin
    obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := hin
    rcases not_and_or.mp hi with hi | hi
    · rw [not_le] at hi
      have h1 : x ∈ closedAmbientCollar (Fin (n + 1)) := ⟨i, Or.inl (by linarith)⟩
      have h2 : (fun i => ((cubeClamp x i : ℝ))) ∈ closedAmbientCollar (Fin (n + 1)) := by
        refine ⟨i, Or.inl ?_⟩
        show ((Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one (x i) : I) : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 5
        rw [projIcc_eq_zero (le_of_lt hi), Set.Icc.coe_zero]
        norm_num
      show ‖a.raw _‖⁻¹ • a.raw _ = ‖a.raw x‖⁻¹ • a.raw x
      rw [a.raw_eq_basepoint_on_collar _ h2, a.raw_eq_basepoint_on_collar _ h1]
    · rw [not_le] at hi
      have h1 : x ∈ closedAmbientCollar (Fin (n + 1)) := ⟨i, Or.inr (by linarith)⟩
      have h2 : (fun i => ((cubeClamp x i : ℝ))) ∈ closedAmbientCollar (Fin (n + 1)) := by
        refine ⟨i, Or.inr ?_⟩
        show (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ ((Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one (x i) : I) : ℝ)
        rw [projIcc_eq_one (le_of_lt hi), Set.Icc.coe_one]
        norm_num
      show ‖a.raw _‖⁻¹ • a.raw _ = ‖a.raw x‖⁻¹ • a.raw x
      rw [a.raw_eq_basepoint_on_collar _ h2, a.raw_eq_basepoint_on_collar _ h1]

name: Submission.exists_cobApproximation
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H⟩ := hpq
  
  set Q : (Fin (n + 1 + 1) → ℝ) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) := fun v =>
    ((H (cobSchedule (piTime v), cubeClamp (piInit v)) :
      UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) with hQdef
  have hQc : Continuous Q := by
    apply continuous_subtype_val.comp
    apply (map_continuous H.toHomotopy.toContinuousMap).comp
    exact (continuous_cobSchedule.comp continuous_piTime).prodMk
      (continuous_cubeClamp.comp continuous_piInit)
  have hQnorm : ∀ v, ‖Q v‖ = 1 := fun v => UnitSphere.norm_coe _
  have hQ_left : ∀ v, piTime v ≤ 3 / 8 → Q v = nraw a₁ (piInit v) := by
    intro v hv
    rw [hQdef]
    show ((H (cobSchedule (piTime v), cubeClamp (piInit v)) : _) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) = _
    rw [cobSchedule_of_le hv]
    have h0 : H (0, cubeClamp (piInit v)) = a₁.representative (cubeClamp (piInit v)) :=
      H.apply_zero _
    rw [h0, a₁.representative_coe]
    exact nraw_cubeClamp a₁ (piInit v)
  have hQ_right : ∀ v, 5 / 8 ≤ piTime v → Q v = nraw a₂ (piInit v) := by
    intro v hv
    rw [hQdef]
    show ((H (cobSchedule (piTime v), cubeClamp (piInit v)) : _) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) = _
    rw [cobSchedule_of_ge hv]
    have h1 : H (1, cubeClamp (piInit v)) = a₂.representative (cubeClamp (piInit v)) :=
      H.apply_one _
    rw [h1, a₂.representative_coe]
    exact nraw_cubeClamp a₂ (piInit v)
  have hQ_south : ∀ v, (∃ j, piInit v j ≤ 0 ∨ 1 ≤ piInit v j) → Q v = -eLast n := by
    intro v hj
    obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hj
    have hbd : cubeClamp (piInit v) ∈ Cube.boundary (Fin (n + 1)) := by
      rcases hj with hj | hj
      · exact ⟨j, Or.inl (projIcc_eq_zero hj)⟩
      · exact ⟨j, Or.inr (projIcc_eq_one hj)⟩
    have heq : H (cobSchedule (piTime v), cubeClamp (piInit v))
        = a₁.representative (cubeClamp (piInit v)) :=
      H.eq_fst _ hbd
    have hbase : a₁.representative (cubeClamp (piInit v)) = southPole n :=
      a₁.representative.2 _ hbd
    rw [hQdef]
    show ((H (cobSchedule (piTime v), cubeClamp (piInit v)) : _) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) = _
    rw [heq, hbase, southPole_coe]
  
  set U : Set (Fin (n + 1 + 1) → ℝ) :=
    {v | piTime v < 3 / 8} ∪ {v | 5 / 8 < piTime v} with hUdef
  have hUopen : IsOpen U :=
    (isOpen_lt continuous_piTime continuous_const).union
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_piTime)
  set Sc : Set (Fin (n + 1 + 1) → ℝ) :=
    {v | piTime v ≤ 1 / 4} ∪ {v | 3 / 4 ≤ piTime v} with hScdef
  have hScclosed : IsClosed Sc :=
    (isClosed_le continuous_piTime continuous_const).union
      (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_piTime)
  have hSU : Sc ⊆ U := by
    rintro v (hv | hv)
    · exact Or.inl (by simp only [mem_setOf_eq] at *; linarith)
    · exact Or.inr (by simp only [mem_setOf_eq] at *; linarith)
  have hQU : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Q U := by
    rintro v (hv | hv)
    · refine (ContDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (((contDiff_nraw a₁).comp contDiff_piInit).contDiffAt) ?_).contDiffWithinAt
      exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_piTime continuous_const).mem_nhds hv)
        fun w hw => hQ_left w (le_of_lt hw)
    · refine (ContDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
        (((contDiff_nraw a₂).comp contDiff_piInit).contDiffAt) ?_).contDiffWithinAt
      exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
        ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_piTime).mem_nhds hv)
        fun w hw => hQ_right w (le_of_lt hw)
  obtain ⟨g, g_smooth, g_close, g_eq, -⟩ :=
    hQc.exists_contDiff_approx_and_eqOn (ε := fun _ => 1 / 8) ⊤
      continuous_const (fun _ => by norm_num) hScclosed
      (hUopen.mem_nhdsSet.mpr hSU) hQU
  refine ⟨⟨g, g_smooth, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · intro v h0
    have h := g_close v
    rw [h0, dist_zero_left, hQnorm] at h
    norm_num at h
  · intro v hv
    rw [g_eq (Or.inl hv), hQ_left v (by linarith)]
  · intro v hv
    rw [g_eq (Or.inr hv), hQ_right v (by linarith)]
  · intro v hj
    have h := g_close v
    rwa [hQ_south v hj] at h

name: Submission.norm_normalize_sub_le
statement:
lemma norm_normalize_sub_le {E' : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E']
    [InnerProductSpace ℝ E'] {w s : E'} (hw : w ≠ 0) (hs : ‖s‖ = 1) :
    ‖‖w‖⁻¹ • w - s‖ ≤ 2 * ‖w - s‖
proof:
:= by
  have hw0 : (0 : ℝ) < ‖w‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hw
  have h1 : ‖‖w‖⁻¹ • w - w‖ = |1 - ‖w‖| := by
    have h2 : ‖w‖⁻¹ • w - w = (‖w‖⁻¹ - 1) • w := by
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul]
    rw [h2, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [show (‖w‖⁻¹ - 1) = (1 - ‖w‖) / ‖w‖ by field_simp]
    rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos hw0, div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hw0)]
  have h3 : |1 - ‖w‖| ≤ ‖w - s‖ := by
    have h4 : |‖s‖ - ‖w‖| ≤ ‖s - w‖ := abs_norm_sub_norm_le s w
    rw [hs] at h4
    rwa [norm_sub_rev] at h4
  calc ‖‖w‖⁻¹ • w - s‖ ≤ ‖‖w‖⁻¹ • w - w‖ + ‖w - s‖ := by
        have := dist_triangle (‖w‖⁻¹ • w) w s
        simpa [dist_eq_norm] using this
    _ ≤ ‖w - s‖ + ‖w - s‖ := by rw [h1]; linarith [h3]
    _ = 2 * ‖w - s‖ := by ring

name: Submission.hMapCob_south
statement:
lemma hMapCob_south (c : CobApproximation a₁ a₂) {v : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → ℝ}
    (hj : ∃ j, piInit v j ≤ 0 ∨ 1 ≤ piInit v j) : hMapCob c v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hdist : dist (c.rawC v) (-eLast n) < 1 / 8 := c.rawC_south v hj
  have hnorm : ‖(-eLast n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))‖ = 1 := by
    rw [norm_neg, norm_eLast]
  have h2 : ‖nrawCob c v - -eLast n‖ ≤ 2 * ‖c.rawC v - -eLast n‖ :=
    norm_normalize_sub_le (c.rawC_ne_zero v) hnorm
  have h3 : ‖nrawCob c v - -eLast n‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hdist
    linarith
  have h4 : |vertC (nrawCob c v) + 1| ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    have h5 : (nrawCob c v - -eLast n) (Fin.last n) = vertC (nrawCob c v) + 1 := by
      have h6 : (nrawCob c v - -eLast n) (Fin.last n)
          = nrawCob c v (Fin.last n) - (-eLast n) (Fin.last n) := rfl
      rw [h6]
      have h7 : (-eLast n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (Fin.last n) = -1 := by
        show -(eLast n) (Fin.last n) = -1
        simp [eLast]
      rw [h7, vertC]
      ring
    calc |vertC (nrawCob c v) + 1|
        = |(nrawCob c v - -eLast n) (Fin.last n)| := by rw [h5]
      _ ≤ ‖nrawCob c v - -eLast n‖ := abs_coord_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ 1 / 4 := h3
  have hvert : vertC (nrawCob c v) ≤ -(1 / 2) := by
    rcases abs_le.mp h4 with ⟨hlo, hhi⟩
    linarith
  have h8 : prawCob c v = -eLast n := plateauAux_of_le hvert
  rw [hMapCob, nprepCob, h8, norm_neg, norm_eLast]
  simp only [inv_one, one_smul, map_neg]
  rw [initCLM_eLast, neg_zero]

name: Submission.hMapCob_eq_iff
statement:
lemma hMapCob_eq_iff (c : CobApproximation a₁ a₂) (v : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → ℝ)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    hMapCob c v = y ↔ nprepCob c v = northPoint y ∨ nprepCob c v = southPointOf y
proof:
:=
  init_eq_iff (norm_nprepCob c v) y

name: Submission.nprepCob_eq_northPoint_iff
statement:
lemma nprepCob_eq_northPoint_iff (c : CobApproximation a₁ a₂)
    {v : Fin (n + 1 + 1) → ℝ} {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} (hy : ‖y‖ < 1)
    (hfib : hMapCob c v = y) :
    nprepCob c v = northPoint y ↔ 0 < vertC (nprepCob c v)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    exact vertC_northPoint_pos hy
  · intro h
    rcases (hMapCob_eq_iff c v y).mp hfib with hn | hs
    · exact hn
    · exfalso
      rw [hs] at h
      exact absurd h (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt (vertC_southPointOf_neg hy)))

name: Submission.exists_small_regular_value
statement:
theorem exists_small_regular_value {m : ℕ} (hn : 0 < n)
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      0 < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 1 / 8 ∧ 0 < y ⟨0, hn⟩ ∧ IsRegularValue f y
proof:
:= by
  set z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (1 / 16 : ℝ) with hz₀
  have hz₀norm : ‖z₀‖ = 1 / 16 := by
    rw [hz₀, PiLp.norm_single, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨y, hy_ball, hy_reg⟩ :=
    sard_exists_regular_value_in_ball hf z₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 32)
  have hdist : ‖y - z₀‖ < 1 / 32 := by
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    exact mem_ball.mp hy_ball
  have habs : |‖y‖ - ‖z₀‖| ≤ ‖y - z₀‖ := abs_norm_sub_norm_le y z₀
  rw [abs_le] at habs
  have hcoord : |y ⟨0, hn⟩ - 1 / 16| < 1 / 32 := by
    have hle := PiLp.norm_apply_le (y - z₀) ⟨0, hn⟩
    have hval : (y - z₀) ⟨0, hn⟩ = y ⟨0, hn⟩ - 1 / 16 := by
      simp [hz₀]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hval] at hle
    exact hle.trans_lt hdist
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_, ?_, hy_reg⟩
  · rw [hz₀norm] at habs
    linarith [habs.1]
  · rw [hz₀norm] at habs
    linarith [habs.2]
  · rw [abs_lt] at hcoord
    linarith [hcoord.1]

name: Submission.isRegularValue_left_of_cob
statement:
theorem isRegularValue_left_of_cob (c : CobApproximation a₁ a₂)
    {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} (hy : IsRegularValue (hMapCobE c) y) :
    IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a₁) y
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  set X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) := spaceTime x 0 with hXdef
  have hXt : vertC X = 0 := vertC_spaceTime x 0
  have hslab : ∀ X' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)), vertC X' < 1 / 4 →
      hMapCobE c X' = bridgeHMapE a₁ (initCLM (n + 1) X') := by
    intro X' hX'
    rw [hMapCobE, hMapCob_left c (v := WithLp.ofLp X')
      (by rw [piTime_ofLp]; linarith)]
    rfl
  have hval : hMapCobE c X = y := by
    rw [hslab X (by rw [hXt]; norm_num), initCLM_spaceTime]
    exact hx
  have hsurj := hy X hval
  have hEv : hMapCobE c =ᶠ[𝓝 X]
      fun X' => bridgeHMapE a₁ (initCLM (n + 1) X') :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((isOpen_vert_lt (1 / 4)).mem_nhds (by rw [mem_setOf_eq, hXt]; norm_num))
      fun X' hX' => hslab X' hX'
  have hgd : HasFDerivAt (bridgeHMapE a₁)
      (fderiv ℝ (bridgeHMapE a₁) (initCLM (n + 1) X)) (initCLM (n + 1) X) :=
    ((contDiff_bridgeHMapE a₁).differentiable infty_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (hMapCobE c) X
      = (fderiv ℝ (bridgeHMapE a₁) (initCLM (n + 1) X)).comp (initCLM (n + 1)) := by
    rw [hEv.fderiv_eq]
    exact (hgd.comp X (initCLM (n + 1)).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] at hsurj
  have := hsurj.of_comp
  rwa [hXdef, initCLM_spaceTime] at this

name: Submission.isRegularValue_right_of_cob
statement:
theorem isRegularValue_right_of_cob (c : CobApproximation a₁ a₂)
    {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} (hy : IsRegularValue (hMapCobE c) y) :
    IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a₂) y
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  set X : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) := spaceTime x 1 with hXdef
  have hXt : vertC X = 1 := vertC_spaceTime x 1
  have hslab : ∀ X' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)), 3 / 4 < vertC X' →
      hMapCobE c X' = bridgeHMapE a₂ (initCLM (n + 1) X') := by
    intro X' hX'
    rw [hMapCobE, hMapCob_right c (v := WithLp.ofLp X')
      (by rw [piTime_ofLp]; linarith)]
    rfl
  have hval : hMapCobE c X = y := by
    rw [hslab X (by rw [hXt]; norm_num), initCLM_spaceTime]
    exact hx
  have hsurj := hy X hval
  have hEv : hMapCobE c =ᶠ[𝓝 X]
      fun X' => bridgeHMapE a₂ (initCLM (n + 1) X') :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((isOpen_lt_vert (3 / 4)).mem_nhds (by rw [mem_setOf_eq, hXt]; norm_num))
      fun X' hX' => hslab X' hX'
  have hgd : HasFDerivAt (bridgeHMapE a₂)
      (fderiv ℝ (bridgeHMapE a₂) (initCLM (n + 1) X)) (initCLM (n + 1) X) :=
    ((contDiff_bridgeHMapE a₂).differentiable infty_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (hMapCobE c) X
      = (fderiv ℝ (bridgeHMapE a₂) (initCLM (n + 1) X)).comp (initCLM (n + 1)) := by
    rw [hEv.fderiv_eq]
    exact (hgd.comp X (initCLM (n + 1)).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] at hsurj
  have := hsurj.of_comp
  rwa [hXdef, initCLM_spaceTime] at this

name: Submission.exists_middle_cobordism
statement:
theorem exists_middle_cobordism (hn : 0 < n)
    {a₁ : Approximation p₁} {a₂ : Approximation p₂}
    (hpq : GenLoop.Homotopic a₁.representative a₂.representative) :
    ∃ (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
      (h₁ : IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a₁) y)
      (h₂ : IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a₂) y),
      0 < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 1 / 8 ∧ 0 < y ⟨0, hn⟩ ∧
      ∃ C : FramedLevelCobordism n,
        C.X₀ = bridgeFLS a₁ y hy0 h₁ ∧ C.X₁ = bridgeFLS a₂ y hy0 h₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := exists_cobApproximation hpq
  obtain ⟨y, hypos, hy8, hyaxis, hyreg⟩ :=
    exists_small_regular_value hn (contDiff_hMapCobE c)
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, norm_zero] at hypos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hypos
  exact ⟨y, hy0, isRegularValue_left_of_cob c hyreg,
    isRegularValue_right_of_cob c hyreg, hypos, hy8, hyaxis,
    middleCob c y hy0 hyreg, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Submission.isOpen_valueTransition
statement: lemma isOpen_valueTransition : IsOpen (valueTransition (n := n))
proof:
:=
  isOpen_vert_between (1 / 4) (3 / 4)

name: Submission.contDiff_valueWeight
statement: lemma contDiff_valueWeight : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (valueWeight (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) =>
      timeProfile (vertC v) := contDiff_timeProfile.comp contDiff_vertC
  exact hs.mul (contDiff_const.sub hs)

name: Submission.valueWeight_pos
statement:
lemma valueWeight_pos {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1))}
    (hv : v ∈ valueTransition (n := n)) : 0 < valueWeight v
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : 0 < timeProfile (vertC v) := by
    apply Real.smoothTransition.pos_of_pos
    change 0 < 2 * vertC v - 1 / 2
    linarith [hv.1]
  have hs1 : timeProfile (vertC v) < 1 := by
    apply Real.smoothTransition.lt_one_of_lt_one
    change 2 * vertC v - 1 / 2 < 1
    linarith [hv.2]
  exact mul_pos hs0 (sub_pos.mpr hs1)

name: Submission.valueWeight_nonneg
statement:
lemma valueWeight_nonneg (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1))) :
    0 ≤ valueWeight v
proof:
:= by
  rw [valueWeight]
  exact mul_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _)
    (sub_nonneg.mpr (Real.smoothTransition.le_one _))

name: Submission.valueWeight_le_one
statement:
lemma valueWeight_le_one (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1))) :
    valueWeight v ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (2 * vertC v - 1 / 2)
  have hs1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (2 * vertC v - 1 / 2)
  rw [valueWeight, timeProfile]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (Real.smoothTransition (2 * vertC v - 1 / 2))]

name: Submission.contDiff_valueBase
statement:
lemma contDiff_valueBase
    {p : Ω^ (Fin (n + 1)) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
      (southPole n)} (a : Approximation p) (y y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (valueBase a y y')
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) =>
      timeProfile (vertC v) := contDiff_timeProfile.comp contDiff_vertC
  exact ((contDiff_bridgeHMapE a).comp (initCLM (n + 1)).contDiff).sub
    (((contDiff_const.sub hs).smul contDiff_const).add (hs.smul contDiff_const))

name: Submission.contDiffOn_valueQuot
statement:
lemma contDiffOn_valueQuot
    {p : Ω^ (Fin (n + 1)) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
      (southPole n)} (a : Approximation p) (y y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (valueQuot a y y') (valueTransition (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  exact (contDiff_valueWeight.contDiffOn.inv
      (fun v hv => (valueWeight_pos hv).ne')).smul
    (contDiff_valueBase a y y').contDiffOn

name: Submission.contDiff_valueCobFun
statement:
lemma contDiff_valueCobFun
    {p : Ω^ (Fin (n + 1)) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
      (southPole n)} (a : Approximation p) (y y' w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (valueCobFun a y y' w)
proof:
:=
  (contDiff_valueBase a y y').sub (contDiff_valueWeight.smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.valueCobFun_eq_weight_smul
statement:
lemma valueCobFun_eq_weight_smul
    {p : Ω^ (Fin (n + 1)) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
      (southPole n)} (a : Approximation p) (y y' w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1))} (hv : v ∈ valueTransition (n := n)) :
    valueCobFun a y y' w v = valueWeight v • (valueQuot a y y' v - w)
proof:
:= by
  simp [valueCobFun, valueQuot, smul_sub, smul_smul, (valueWeight_pos hv).ne']

name: Submission.valueCobFun_collar_zero
statement:
lemma valueCobFun_collar_zero
    {p : Ω^ (Fin (n + 1)) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
      (southPole n)} (a : Approximation p) (y y' w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 4) :
    valueCobFun a y y' w (spaceTime x t) = bridgeHMapE a x - y
proof:
:= by
  rw [valueCobFun, valueBase, valueWeight, vertC_spaceTime, initCLM_spaceTime,
    timeProfile_of_le ht]
  simp

name: Submission.valueCobFun_collar_one
statement:
lemma valueCobFun_collar_one
    {p : Ω^ (Fin (n + 1)) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
      (southPole n)} (a : Approximation p) (y y' w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t) :
    valueCobFun a y y' w (spaceTime x t) = bridgeHMapE a x - y'

name: Submission.valueTarget_axis_pos
statement:
lemma valueTarget_axis_pos (i : Fin n) {y y' w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (hy : 0 < y i) (hy' : 0 < y' i)
    (hw : ‖w‖ < min (y i) (y' i) / 2)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1))) : 0 < valueTarget y y' w v i
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (2 * vertC v - 1 / 2)
  have hs1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (2 * vertC v - 1 / 2)
  have hwiNorm := PiLp.norm_apply_le w i
  rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hwiNorm
  have hwlower : -‖w‖ ≤ w i := (neg_le_of_abs_le hwiNorm)
  have hbase : min (y i) (y' i) ≤
      (1 - timeProfile (vertC v)) * y i + timeProfile (vertC v) * y' i := by
    rw [timeProfile]
    rcases le_total (y i) (y' i) with hle | hle
    · rw [min_eq_left hle]
      nlinarith
    · rw [min_eq_right hle]
      nlinarith
  have hpert : -‖w‖ ≤ valueWeight v * w i := by
    by_cases hwi : 0 ≤ w i
    · exact (neg_nonpos.mpr (norm_nonneg w)).trans
        (mul_nonneg (valueWeight_nonneg v) hwi)
    · have hmul : w i ≤ valueWeight v * w i := by
        have := mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_right (valueWeight_le_one v) (le_of_not_ge hwi)
        simpa using this
      exact hwlower.trans hmul
  have hmin : 0 < min (y i) (y' i) := lt_min hy hy'
  show 0 < (1 - timeProfile (vertC v)) * y i + timeProfile (vertC v) * y' i +
    valueWeight v * w i
  nlinarith

name: Submission.bridgeHMapE_norm_le_of_eq_ne_zero
statement:
lemma bridgeHMapE_norm_le_of_eq_ne_zero
    {p : Ω^ (Fin (n + 1)) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
      (southPole n)} (a : Approximation p)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} {z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (hfx : bridgeHMapE a x = z) (hz : z ≠ 0) : ‖x‖ ≤ n + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hnc : WithLp.ofLp x ∉ closedAmbientCollar (Fin (n + 1)) := by
    intro hc
    apply hz
    rw [← hfx]
    exact (bridgeHMap_of_mem_collar a hc).symm ▸ rfl
  have hcoord : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    have h1 : ¬(x i ≤ 1 / 5 ∨ 4 / 5 ≤ x i) := fun h => hnc ⟨i, h⟩
    rw [not_or, not_le, not_le] at h1
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [h1.1], by linarith [h1.2]⟩
  have h1 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := norm_sq_eq_sum x
  have h2 : (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℝ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro i _
    have := hcoord i
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (x i), sq_abs (x i)]
  have h3 : (∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℝ)) = n + 1 := by simp
  have h4 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
    have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
    calc ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := h1
      _ ≤ n + 1 := h2.trans_eq h3
      _ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg x, hn0]

name: Submission.exists_valueChange_cobordism_spec
statement:
theorem exists_valueChange_cobordism_spec (hn : 0 < n)
    {p : Ω^ (Fin (n + 1)) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
      (southPole n)} (a : Approximation p) (i : Fin n)
    {y y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} (hypos : 0 < y i) (hy'pos : 0 < y' i)
    (hy0 : y ≠ 0) (hy'0 : y' ≠ 0)
    (h : IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a) y)
    (h' : IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a) y') :
    ∃ (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
      C.X₀ = bridgeFLS a y hy0 h ∧ C.X₁ = bridgeFLS a y' hy'0 h' ∧
      ‖w‖ < min (y i) (y' i) / 2 ∧ C.G = valueCobFun a y y' w
proof:
:= by
  let r : ℝ := min (y i) (y' i) / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact half_pos (lt_min hypos hy'pos)
  obtain ⟨w, hwreg, hwball⟩ :=
    (sard_dense_regular_values_on (isOpen_valueTransition (n := n))
      (contDiffOn_valueQuot a y y')).exists_mem_open Metric.isOpen_ball
      (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr hr : (Metric.ball
        (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) r).Nonempty)
  have hw : ‖w‖ < r := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hwball
    exact hwball
  refine ⟨{
    X₀ := bridgeFLS a y hy0 h
    X₁ := bridgeFLS a y' hy'0 h'
    G := valueCobFun a y y' w
    smooth := contDiff_valueCobFun a y y' w
    spatial_bounded := ?_
    regular := ?_
    collar_zero := valueCobFun_collar_zero a y y' w
    collar_one := valueCobFun_collar_one a y y' w
  }, w, rfl, rfl, hw, rfl⟩
  · refine ⟨n + 1, fun v hv => ?_⟩
    have hfx0 : bridgeHMapE a (initCLM (n + 1) v) - valueTarget y y' w v = 0 := by
      simpa [valueCobFun, valueBase, valueTarget, sub_sub] using hv
    have hfx : bridgeHMapE a (initCLM (n + 1) v) = valueTarget y y' w v :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp hfx0
    have htarget : valueTarget y y' w v ≠ 0 := by
      intro hz
      have hpos := valueTarget_axis_pos i hypos hy'pos (by simpa [r] using hw) v
      rw [hz] at hpos
      exact lt_irrefl 0 hpos
    exact bridgeHMapE_norm_le_of_eq_ne_zero a hfx htarget
  · intro v hv
    by_cases hleft : vertC v ≤ 1 / 4
    · have hv0 : (bridgeFLS a y hy0 h).g (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 0 := by
        show bridgeHMapE a (initCLM (n + 1) v) - y = 0
        have hc := valueCobFun_collar_zero a y y' w
          (initCLM (n + 1) v) hleft
        rw [spaceTime_init_vert] at hc
        rw [← hc]
        exact hv
      have hs := surjective_fderiv_of_time_collar
        (contDiff_valueCobFun a y y' w)
        (valueCobFun_collar_zero a y y' w) hleft
        ((bridgeFLS a y hy0 h).regular _ hv0)
      rwa [spaceTime_init_vert] at hs
    · by_cases hright : 3 / 4 ≤ vertC v
      · have hv1 : (bridgeFLS a y' hy'0 h').g (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 0 := by
          show bridgeHMapE a (initCLM (n + 1) v) - y' = 0
          have hc := valueCobFun_collar_one a y y' w
            (initCLM (n + 1) v) hright
          rw [spaceTime_init_vert] at hc
          rw [← hc]
          exact hv
        have hs := surjective_fderiv_of_time_collar_right
          (contDiff_valueCobFun a y y' w)
          (valueCobFun_collar_one a y y' w) hright
          ((bridgeFLS a y' hy'0 h').regular _ hv1)
        rwa [spaceTime_init_vert] at hs
      · have hvU : v ∈ valueTransition (n := n) :=
          ⟨lt_of_not_ge hleft, lt_of_not_ge hright⟩
        have hweighted : valueWeight v • (valueQuot a y y' v - w) = 0 := by
          rw [← valueCobFun_eq_weight_smul a y y' w hvU]
          exact hv
        have hsub : valueQuot a y y' v - w = 0 := by
          exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hweighted).resolve_left (valueWeight_pos hvU).ne'
        have hPhi : valueQuot a y y' v = w := sub_eq_zero.mp hsub
        have hsurjWithin := hwreg v hvU hPhi
        have hsurj : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (valueQuot a y y') v) := by
          rwa [fderivWithin_of_isOpen isOpen_valueTransition hvU] at hsurjWithin
        have hEv : valueCobFun a y y' w =ᶠ[𝓝 v]
            fun z => valueWeight z • (valueQuot a y y' z - w) :=
          Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_valueTransition.mem_nhds hvU)
            fun _ hz => valueCobFun_eq_weight_smul a y y' w hz
        have hqdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (valueWeight (n := n)) v :=
          contDiff_valueWeight.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
        have hPhidiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (valueQuot a y y') v :=
          ((contDiffOn_valueQuot a y y').contDiffAt
            (isOpen_valueTransition.mem_nhds hvU)).differentiableAt infty_ne_zero
        have hsubdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => valueQuot a y y' z - w) v :=
          hPhidiff.sub (differentiableAt_const (c := w))
        have hfd : fderiv ℝ (valueCobFun a y y' w) v =
            valueWeight v • fderiv ℝ (valueQuot a y y') v := by
          rw [hEv.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_smul hqdiff hsubdiff,
            fderiv_sub_const w, hPhi, sub_self]
          simp
        rw [hfd]
        intro z
        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsurj ((valueWeight v)⁻¹ • z)
        refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hu, smul_smul,
          mul_inv_cancel₀ (valueWeight_pos hvU).ne', one_smul]

name: Submission.exists_valueChange_cobordism
statement:
theorem exists_valueChange_cobordism (hn : 0 < n)
    {p : Ω^ (Fin (n + 1)) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
      (southPole n)} (a : Approximation p) (i : Fin n)
    {y y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} (hypos : 0 < y i) (hy'pos : 0 < y' i)
    (hy0 : y ≠ 0) (hy'0 : y' ≠ 0)
    (h : IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a) y)
    (h' : IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a) y') :
    ∃ C : FramedLevelCobordism n,
      C.X₀ = bridgeFLS a y hy0 h ∧ C.X₁ = bridgeFLS a y' hy'0 h'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, w, hC₀, hC₁, hw, hCG⟩ :=
    exists_valueChange_cobordism_spec hn a i hypos hy'pos hy0 hy'0 h h'
  exact ⟨C, hC₀, hC₁⟩

name: Submission.exists_bridge_cobordism
statement:
theorem exists_bridge_cobordism (hn : 0 < n)
    {z : HomotopyGroup (Fin (n + 1))
      (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) (southPole n)}
    (B₁ B₂ : BridgeData n z) :
    ∃ C : FramedLevelCobordism n, C.X₀ = B₁.fls ∧ C.X₁ = B₂.fls
proof:
:= by
  have hclass : (⟦B₁.approx.representative⟧ :
      HomotopyGroup (Fin (n + 1))
        (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) (southPole n))
      = ⟦B₂.approx.representative⟧ :=
    B₁.class_eq.symm.trans B₂.class_eq
  have hpq : GenLoop.Homotopic B₁.approx.representative B₂.approx.representative :=
    Quotient.exact hclass
  obtain ⟨y, hy0, h₁, h₂, -, -, hyaxis, Cmid, hmid₀, hmid₁⟩ :=
    exists_middle_cobordism hn hpq
  obtain ⟨CV₁, hCV₁₀, hCV₁₁⟩ :=
    exists_valueChange_cobordism hn B₁.approx ⟨0, hn⟩ (B₁.axis_pos hn) hyaxis
      B₁.y_ne_zero hy0 B₁.regular_y h₁
  obtain ⟨CV₂, hCV₂₀, hCV₂₁⟩ :=
    exists_valueChange_cobordism hn B₂.approx ⟨0, hn⟩ hyaxis (B₂.axis_pos hn)
      hy0 B₂.y_ne_zero h₂ B₂.regular_y
  have hglue₁ : CV₁.X₁ = Cmid.X₀ := hCV₁₁.trans hmid₀.symm
  have hglue₂ : (CV₁.trans Cmid hglue₁).X₁ = CV₂.X₀ := by
    rw [FramedLevelCobordism.trans_X₁]
    exact hmid₁.trans hCV₂₀.symm
  refine ⟨(CV₁.trans Cmid hglue₁).trans CV₂ hglue₂, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [FramedLevelCobordism.trans_X₀, FramedLevelCobordism.trans_X₀]
    exact hCV₁₀
  · rw [FramedLevelCobordism.trans_X₁]
    exact hCV₂₁

name: Submission.fderiv_eq_zero_of_iteratedFDeriv_one_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fderiv_eq_zero_of_iteratedFDeriv_one_eq_zero
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {f : E → F} {x : E}
    (h : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 f x = 0) : fderiv ℝ f x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  have h2 : fderiv ℝ f x v = iteratedFDeriv ℝ 1 f x (fun _ => v) := by
    rw [iteratedFDeriv_one_apply]
  rw [h2, h]
  simp

name: Submission.iteratedFDeriv_fderiv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem iteratedFDeriv_fderiv_eq_zero
    {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {f : E → F} {x : E} {j : ℕ}
    (h : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (j + 1) f x = 0) :
    iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fderiv ℝ f) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext fun m => ?_
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  have h2 := iteratedFDeriv_succ_apply_right (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := f) (x := x)
    (Fin.snoc m v)
  rw [h] at h2
  simp only [Fin.init_snoc, Fin.snoc_last, zero_apply] at h2
  exact h2.symm.trans rfl

name: Submission.norm_sub_le_of_vanishing_derivs
statement:
theorem norm_sub_le_of_vanishing_derivs
    {E : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] (k : ℕ) :
    ∀ {F : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
      {U : Set E}, IsOpen U → ∀ {f : E → F}, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U →
      ∀ {s : Set E}, Convex ℝ s → s ⊆ U → ∀ {M : ℝ},
      (∀ z ∈ s, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f z‖ ≤ M) →
      ∀ {x : E}, x ∈ s → (∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → iteratedFDeriv ℝ j f x = 0) →
      ∀ {y : E}, y ∈ s → ‖f y - f x‖ ≤ M * ‖y - x‖ ^ (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    intro F _ _ U hU f hf s hs hsU M hM x hx _ y hy
    have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ f z := fun z hz =>
      (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hsU hz))).differentiableAt infty_ne_zero
    have hbound : ∀ z ∈ s, ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ ≤ M := by
      intro z hz
      have h1 := hM z hz
      rwa [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv, norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at h1
    have h2 := hs.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff hbound hx hy
    simpa using h2
  | succ k IH =>
    intro F _ _ U hU f hf s hs hsU M hM x hx hvan y hy
    have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) (hM x hx)
    
    have hg : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) U :=
      hf.fderiv_of_isOpen hU (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    have hM' : ∀ z ∈ s, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) (fderiv ℝ f) z‖ ≤ M := by
      intro z hz
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_fderiv]
      exact hM z hz
    have hvan' : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k → iteratedFDeriv ℝ j (fderiv ℝ f) x = 0 :=
      fun j h1 h2 => iteratedFDeriv_fderiv_eq_zero
        (hvan (j + 1) (by omega) (by omega))
    have hgx : fderiv ℝ f x = 0 :=
      fderiv_eq_zero_of_iteratedFDeriv_one_eq_zero (hvan 1 le_rfl (by omega))
    have hIH : ∀ z ∈ s, ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ ≤ M * ‖z - x‖ ^ (k + 1) := by
      intro z hz
      have h1 := IH hU hg hs hsU hM' hx hvan' hz
      rwa [hgx, sub_zero] at h1
    
    have hseg : segment ℝ x y ⊆ s := hs.segment_subset hx hy
    have hzx_le : ∀ z ∈ segment ℝ x y, ‖z - x‖ ≤ ‖y - x‖ := by
      rintro z ⟨a, b, ha, hb, hab, rfl⟩
      have hb1 : b ≤ 1 := by linarith
      have ha1 : a = 1 - b := by linarith
      have hz' : a • x + b • y - x = b • (y - x) := by
        rw [ha1, sub_smul, one_smul, smul_sub]
        abel
      rw [hz', norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) hb1
    have hbound : ∀ z ∈ segment ℝ x y,
        ‖fderiv ℝ f z‖ ≤ M * ‖y - x‖ ^ (k + 1) := by
      intro z hz
      refine (hIH z (hseg hz)).trans ?_
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hzx_le z hz) (k + 1)) hM0
    have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ segment ℝ x y, DifferentiableAt ℝ f z := fun z hz =>
      (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds (hsU (hseg hz)))).differentiableAt
        infty_ne_zero
    have h2 := (convex_segment x y).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le hdiff
      hbound (left_mem_segment ℝ x y) (right_mem_segment ℝ x y)
    calc ‖f y - f x‖ ≤ M * ‖y - x‖ ^ (k + 1) * ‖y - x‖ := h2
      _ = M * ‖y - x‖ ^ (k + 2) := by rw [mul_assoc, ← pow_succ]

name: Submission.exists_grid_index
proof:
:= by
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := Nat.cast_pos.2 hm
  set t : ℝ := u * m / (2 * ρ) with htdef
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := by positivity
  have htm : t ≤ m := by
    rw [htdef, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    calc u * m ≤ (2 * ρ) * m := by gcongr
      _ = (m : ℝ) * (2 * ρ) := by ring
  set j : ℕ := min ⌊t⌋₊ (m - 1) with hjdef
  have hjm : j < m := by
    have h1 : j ≤ m - 1 := min_le_right _ _
    omega
  have hjt : (j : ℝ) ≤ t := by
    rcases le_or_gt ⌊t⌋₊ (m - 1) with h | h
    · have : j = ⌊t⌋₊ := by rw [hjdef, min_eq_left h]
      rw [this]
      exact Nat.floor_le ht0
    · have hj' : j = m - 1 := by rw [hjdef, min_eq_right (le_of_lt h)]
      have h2' : (m : ℝ) ≤ ⌊t⌋₊ := by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt_succ (by omega)
      have h3 : (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ t + 1 := by
        have := Nat.lt_floor_add_one t
        linarith [Nat.floor_le ht0]
      rw [hj']
      have : ((m - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) = (m : ℝ) - 1 := by
        have : (1 : ℕ) ≤ m := hm
        push_cast [Nat.cast_sub this]
        ring
      rw [this]
      have h4 : (⌊t⌋₊ : ℝ) ≤ t := Nat.floor_le ht0
      linarith
  have htj1 : t ≤ j + 1 := by
    rcases le_or_gt ⌊t⌋₊ (m - 1) with h | h
    · have hj' : j = ⌊t⌋₊ := by rw [hjdef, min_eq_left h]
      rw [hj']
      exact le_of_lt (Nat.lt_floor_add_one t)
    · have hj' : j = m - 1 := by rw [hjdef, min_eq_right (le_of_lt h)]
      have : (j : ℝ) + 1 = m := by
        rw [hj']
        have h1 : (1 : ℕ) ≤ m := hm
        push_cast [Nat.cast_sub h1]
        ring
      rw [this]
      exact htm
  refine ⟨j, hjm, ?_⟩
  have hu : u = t * (2 * ρ) / m := by
    rw [htdef]
    field_simp
  have hexpr : u - (2 * j + 1) * ρ / m = (2 * ρ / m) * (t - j - 1 / 2) := by
    rw [hu]
    field_simp
    ring
  rw [hexpr, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < 2 * ρ / m)]
  have habs : |t - j - 1 / 2| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor <;> [linarith; linarith]
  calc 2 * ρ / m * |t - j - 1 / 2| ≤ 2 * ρ / m * (1 / 2) := by gcongr
    _ = ρ / m := by ring

name: Submission.closedBall_subset_iUnion_grid
statement:
theorem closedBall_subset_iUnion_grid {x₀ : Fin p → ℝ} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) :
    closedBall x₀ ρ ⊆
      ⋃ v : Fin p → Fin m, closedBall (gridCenter x₀ ρ m v) (ρ / m)
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  have hy' : ∀ i, |y i - x₀ i| ≤ ρ := by
    intro i
    have h1 : dist (y i) (x₀ i) ≤ ρ :=
      (dist_pi_le_iff hρ.le).1 (mem_closedBall.1 hy) i
    rwa [Real.dist_eq] at h1
  have hchoice : ∀ i : Fin p, ∃ j : ℕ, j < m ∧
      |y i - x₀ i + ρ - (2 * j + 1) * ρ / m| ≤ ρ / m := by
    intro i
    have h0 : 0 ≤ y i - x₀ i + ρ := by have := (abs_le.1 (hy' i)).1; linarith
    have h2 : y i - x₀ i + ρ ≤ 2 * ρ := by
      have := (abs_le.1 (hy' i)).2; linarith
    exact exists_grid_index hρ hm h0 h2
  choose jf hjf1 hjf2 using hchoice
  refine mem_iUnion.2 ⟨fun i => ⟨jf i, hjf1 i⟩, ?_⟩
  rw [mem_closedBall]
  refine (dist_pi_le_iff (by positivity)).2 fun i => ?_
  rw [Real.dist_eq, gridCenter]
  have h3 := hjf2 i
  have h4 : y i - (x₀ i - ρ + (2 * ↑(jf i) + 1) * ρ / ↑m)
      = y i - x₀ i + ρ - (2 * ↑(jf i) + 1) * ρ / ↑m := by ring
  rw [h4]
  exact h3

name: Submission.grid_subset_closedBall
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < m := Nat.cast_pos.2 hm
  have hz' : ∀ i, |z i - gridCenter x₀ ρ m v i| ≤ ρ / m := by
    intro i
    have h1 : dist (z i) (gridCenter x₀ ρ m v i) ≤ ρ / m :=
      (dist_pi_le_iff (by positivity)).1 (mem_closedBall.1 hz) i
    rwa [Real.dist_eq] at h1
  rw [mem_closedBall]
  refine (dist_pi_le_iff hρ.le).2 fun i => ?_
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  have hcb : |gridCenter x₀ ρ m v i - x₀ i| ≤ ρ - ρ / m := by
    rw [gridCenter]
    have hw0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ρ / m := by positivity
    have hmw : (m : ℝ) * (ρ / m) = ρ := by field_simp
    have hv0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((v i : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    have hv1 : ((v i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 ≤ m := by exact_mod_cast (v i).2
    have hexpr : x₀ i - ρ + (2 * ↑(v i : ℕ) + 1) * ρ / ↑m - x₀ i
        = 2 * (((v i : ℕ) : ℝ) * (ρ / m)) + ρ / m - ρ := by ring
    have hvw0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((v i : ℕ) : ℝ) * (ρ / m) := mul_nonneg hv0 hw0
    have hvw1 : ((v i : ℕ) : ℝ) * (ρ / m) + ρ / m ≤ ρ := by
      have h9 : (((v i : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1) * (ρ / m) ≤ (m : ℝ) * (ρ / m) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hv1 hw0
      rw [hmw] at h9
      nlinarith
    rw [hexpr, abs_le]
    constructor
    · linarith
    · linarith
  calc |z i - x₀ i| ≤ |z i - gridCenter x₀ ρ m v i|
        + |gridCenter x₀ ρ m v i - x₀ i| := abs_sub_le _ _ _
    _ ≤ ρ / m + (ρ - ρ / m) := add_le_add (hz' i) hcb
    _ = ρ := by ring

name: Submission.step3_ball
statement:
theorem step3_ball {U : Set (Fin p → ℝ)} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {f : (Fin p → ℝ) → Fin q → ℝ} (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : p + 1 ≤ (k + 1) * q) {x₀ : Fin p → ℝ} {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hball : closedBall x₀ ρ ⊆ U) :
    volume (f '' (vanishSet U f k ∩ closedBall x₀ ρ)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hcw : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ (k + 1) f U) U :=
    hf.continuousOn_iteratedFDerivWithin (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
      hU.uniqueDiffOn
  have hc : ContinuousOn (iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f) U :=
    hcw.congr ((iteratedFDerivWithin_of_isOpen (k + 1) hU).symm)
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall x₀ ρ).exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (hc.mono hball)
  set M : ℝ := max C 0 with hMdef
  have hM0 : 0 ≤ M := le_max_right _ _
  have hM : ∀ z ∈ closedBall x₀ ρ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (k + 1) f z‖ ≤ M :=
    fun z hz => (hC z hz).trans (le_max_left _ _)
  set Cst : ℝ := (2 * M) ^ q * (2 * ρ) ^ ((k + 1) * q) with hCstdef
  
  have key : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m →
      volume (f '' (vanishSet U f k ∩ closedBall x₀ ρ))
        ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Cst / m) := by
    intro m hm
    have hb0 : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.2 hm
    have hb1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
    set R : ℝ := M * (2 * ρ / m) ^ (k + 1) with hRdef
    have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := by positivity
    
    have percube : ∀ v : Fin p → Fin m,
        volume (f '' (vanishSet U f k
          ∩ closedBall (gridCenter x₀ ρ m v) (ρ / m)))
          ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * R) ^ q) := by
      intro v
      rcases eq_empty_or_nonempty
        (vanishSet U f k ∩ closedBall (gridCenter x₀ ρ m v) (ρ / m)) with
        hemp | ⟨xh, hxhK, hxhB⟩
      · rw [hemp, image_empty, measure_empty]
        simp
      have hBU : closedBall (gridCenter x₀ ρ m v) (ρ / m) ⊆ U :=
        (grid_subset_closedBall hρ hm v).trans hball
      have himg : f '' (vanishSet U f k
          ∩ closedBall (gridCenter x₀ ρ m v) (ρ / m))
          ⊆ closedBall (f xh) R := by
        rintro _ ⟨y, ⟨hyK, hyB⟩, rfl⟩
        rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm]
        have htay := norm_sub_le_of_vanishing_derivs k hU hf
          (convex_closedBall (gridCenter x₀ ρ m v) (ρ / m)) hBU
          (fun z hz => hM z (grid_subset_closedBall hρ hm v hz)) hxhB
          (fun j h1 h2 => hxhK.2 j h1 h2) hyB
        refine htay.trans ?_
        rw [hRdef]
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ hM0
        refine pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) ?_ (k + 1)
        have hd : dist y xh ≤ 2 * ρ / m := by
          calc dist y xh ≤ dist y (gridCenter x₀ ρ m v)
              + dist (gridCenter x₀ ρ m v) xh :=
                dist_triangle _ _ _
            _ ≤ ρ / m + ρ / m := add_le_add (mem_closedBall.1 hyB)
                (by rw [dist_comm]; exact mem_closedBall.1 hxhB)
            _ = 2 * ρ / m := by ring
        rwa [← dist_eq_norm]
      refine (measure_mono himg).trans ?_
      rw [Real.volume_pi_closedBall (f xh) hR0]
      simp
    
    have hcover : f '' (vanishSet U f k ∩ closedBall x₀ ρ)
        ⊆ ⋃ v : Fin p → Fin m, f '' (vanishSet U f k
          ∩ closedBall (gridCenter x₀ ρ m v) (ρ / m)) := by
      rintro _ ⟨y, ⟨hyK, hyB⟩, rfl⟩
      obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := mem_iUnion.1 (closedBall_subset_iUnion_grid hρ hm hyB)
      exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨v, ⟨y, ⟨hyK, hv⟩, rfl⟩⟩
    have hcount : volume (f '' (vanishSet U f k ∩ closedBall x₀ ρ))
        ≤ (m ^ p : ℕ) * ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * R) ^ q) := by
      refine (measure_mono hcover).trans ?_
      refine (measure_iUnion_le _).trans ?_
      calc ∑' v : Fin p → Fin m, volume (f '' (vanishSet U f k
            ∩ closedBall (gridCenter x₀ ρ m v) (ρ / m)))
          ≤ ∑' _ : Fin p → Fin m, ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * R) ^ q) :=
            ENNReal.tsum_le_tsum percube
        _ = (Fintype.card (Fin p → Fin m) : ENNReal)
            * ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * R) ^ q) := by
            rw [tsum_fintype]
            simp [Finset.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
        _ = (m ^ p : ℕ) * ENNReal.ofReal ((2 * R) ^ q) := by
            have hcard : Fintype.card (Fin p → Fin m) = m ^ p := by
              simp
            rw [hcard]
    refine hcount.trans ?_
    
    have hcast : ((m ^ p : ℕ) : ENNReal) = ENNReal.ofReal ((m : ℝ) ^ p) := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_natCast]
      congr 1
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hcast, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by positivity)]
    refine ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal ?_
    have hcalc : (m : ℝ) ^ p * (2 * R) ^ q
        = Cst * ((m : ℝ) ^ p / (m : ℝ) ^ ((k + 1) * q)) := by
      have h1 : 2 * R = (2 * M) * ((2 * ρ) ^ (k + 1) / (m : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)) := by
        rw [hRdef, div_pow]
        ring
      rw [h1, mul_pow, div_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, hCstdef]
      ring
    have hfrac : (m : ℝ) ^ p / (m : ℝ) ^ ((k + 1) * q) ≤ 1 / m := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) hb0]
      calc (m : ℝ) ^ p * m = (m : ℝ) ^ (p + 1) := (pow_succ _ _).symm
        _ ≤ (m : ℝ) ^ ((k + 1) * q) := pow_le_pow_right₀ hb1 hk
        _ = 1 * (m : ℝ) ^ ((k + 1) * q) := (one_mul _).symm
    have hCst0 : 0 ≤ Cst := by positivity
    calc (m : ℝ) ^ p * (2 * R) ^ q
        = Cst * ((m : ℝ) ^ p / (m : ℝ) ^ ((k + 1) * q)) := hcalc
      _ ≤ Cst * (1 / m) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hfrac hCst0
      _ = Cst / m := by ring
  
  have hlim : Tendsto (fun m : ℕ => ENNReal.ofReal (Cst / m)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have h1 := ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal
      (tendsto_const_div_atTop_nhds_zero_nat Cst)
    rwa [ENNReal.ofReal_zero] at h1
  have h0 : volume (f '' (vanishSet U f k ∩ closedBall x₀ ρ)) ≤ 0 := by
    refine ge_of_tendsto hlim ?_
    filter_upwards [eventually_gt_atTop 0] with m hm
    exact key m hm
  exact le_zero_iff.1 h0

name: Submission.step3
statement:
theorem step3 {U : Set (Fin p → ℝ)} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {f : (Fin p → ℝ) → Fin q → ℝ} (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) {k : ℕ}
    (hk : p + 1 ≤ (k + 1) * q) :
    volume (f '' vanishSet U f k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply image_null_of_locally_image_null
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hball⟩ : ∃ ρ > 0, closedBall x ρ ⊆ U :=
    Metric.nhds_basis_closedBall.mem_iff.1 (hU.mem_nhds hx.1)
  exact ⟨closedBall x ρ, Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x hρ,
    step3_ball hU hf hk hρ hball⟩

name: Submission.SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant.northDelta_eq_of_nonempty
statement:
theorem northDelta_eq_of_nonempty (I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant n)
    {z z' : StableSpherePi n} (B : BridgeData n z) (B' : BridgeData n z')
    (h : Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism B.fiberSign B'.fiberSign)) :
    B.northDelta = B'.northDelta
proof:
:= by
  rw [B.northDelta_eq_positiveDelta, B'.northDelta_eq_positiveDelta]
  exact I.eq_of_nonempty B.fiberSign B'.fiberSign h

name: Submission.SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant.tubeDeltaZeroLedger_value
statement:
theorem tubeDeltaZeroLedger_value (I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant n)
    (hn : 0 < n) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) :
    (tubeDeltaZeroLedger n hn h2).delta = 0
proof:
:= by
  let B := tubeExplicitDeltaZeroBridge n h2
  have hcob : Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism B.fiberSign
      (tubeDeltaZeroBridge n hn h2).fiberSign) :=
    exists_signedCobordism_to_tubeDeltaZeroBridge n hn h2 B
  calc
    (tubeDeltaZeroLedger n hn h2).delta =
        (tubeDeltaZeroBridge n hn h2).northDelta :=
      tubeDeltaZeroLedger_delta_eq_northDelta n hn h2
    _ = B.northDelta := (I.northDelta_eq_of_nonempty B
      (tubeDeltaZeroBridge n hn h2) hcob).symm
    _ = 0 := tubeExplicitBridgeInDim_northDelta n h2 0

    exists_signedCobordism_to_tubeDeltaOneBridge n hn h2 B
  calc

        (tubeDeltaOneBridge n hn h2).northDelta :=
