name: Submission.SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant.tubeBridgeLedgerValues
statement:
theorem tubeBridgeLedgerValues (I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant n)
    (hn : 0 < n) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) :
    ((chosenBridge hn (tubeDeltaZeroClass n h2)).northFrameLedger
        (chosenBridge hn (tubeDeltaZeroClass n h2)).canonicalTamedField).delta = 0 ∧
      ((chosenBridge hn (tubeDeltaOneClass n h2)).northFrameLedger
        (chosenBridge hn (tubeDeltaOneClass n h2)).canonicalTamedField).delta = 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨I.tubeDeltaZeroLedger_value hn h2, I.tubeDeltaOneLedger_value hn h2⟩

name: Submission.SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant.pi_succ_sphere_n_mulEquiv_zmod_two_of_geometric_kernels
statement:
theorem pi_succ_sphere_n_mulEquiv_zmod_two_of_geometric_kernels
    (I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant n)
    (G : SignedDeltaNormalizationData n)
    (south_matches : ∀ {z z' : StableSpherePi n}
      (B : BridgeData n z) (B' : BridgeData n z'),
      B.northDelta = B'.northDelta → B.southDelta = B'.southDelta)
    (hn : 0 < n) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (x : UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :
    Nonempty
      (HomotopyGroup.Pi (n + 1)
          (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) x ≃*
        Multiplicative (ZMod 2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hzero, hone⟩ := I.tubeBridgeLedgerValues hn h2
  exact G.pi_succ_sphere_n_mulEquiv_zmod_two_of_normalization south_matches
    (tubeDeltaZeroClass n h2) (tubeDeltaOneClass n h2) hzero hone x

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalMinimumForwardNoncollision
statement:
theorem chronologicalMinimumForwardNoncollision
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hpositive : D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .minimum) :
    D.ChronologicalMinimumForwardNoncollision t ht hpositive hindex
proof:
:= by
  intro O hcollision
  let F := ChronologicalMinimumExteriorFlowControl.canonical
    (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht)
    (hpositive := hpositive) (hindex := hindex)
  let H := D.chronologicalMinimumExteriorFlowCore
    t ht F.safe F.midpointCapture
  let L := D.chronologicalMinimumLocalParam t ht hindex
  let p : E' := (D.position.eventModel t ht).definiteCircle
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0
  have hpL : spacePart p = L.p := by
    change spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).definiteCircle
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0) =
      spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).definiteCircle
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
        (2 * Real.pi * (((0 : I) : ℝ))))
    norm_num
  have hpTarget : L.p ∈ (H.targetOrbit O : Set Eₐ) := by
    rw [hcollision]
    change L.p ∈ (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbit L.p
    exact (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).mem_orbit_self L.p
  rw [H.targetOrbit_coe O] at hpTarget
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
    (H.positiveParam O).exists_curve_eq_of_mem_orbit hpTarget
  change H.positiveCurve O q = L.p at hq
  have hend : H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) H.ε = p := by
    calc
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) H.ε =
          cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O q) (H.t + H.ε) := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O q]
        exact (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime L.p (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) := by
        rw [hq]
        rfl
      _ = p := by
        rw [← hpL, chronologicalAfterTime]
        rw [← (D.position.eventModel t ht).minimumCircle_time hindex
          (theta := 0) (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht).le
          ((D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
            (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le)]
        exact spaceTime_spacePart p
  have hyfar : (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius ≤
      dist (H.coreLoop O q) (D.position.eventCenter t ht) :=
    (mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore H.C H.criticalCenter
      (H.coreLoop O q) H.t H.r).mp (H.coreLoop_mem O q) |>.2.2
  have hmove : dist (H.coreLoop O q) p ≤
      (H.R.base.bound : ℝ) * D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 := by
    calc
      dist (H.coreLoop O q) p =
          dist (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) 0)
            (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) H.ε) := by
        simp [hend]
      _ ≤ (H.R.base.bound : ℝ) * |0 - H.ε| :=
        H.R.base.dist_flow_self_le (H.coreLoop O q) 0 H.ε
      _ = (H.R.base.bound : ℝ) *
          D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 := by
        rw [show H.ε = D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 by rfl]
        rw [sub_eq_neg_add, add_zero, abs_neg,
          abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  have hpclose : dist p (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 :=
    D.chronologicalDefiniteCircle_dist_lt_half_cover t ht 0
  have hmoveshort : (H.R.base.bound : ℝ) *
        D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 :=
    D.chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_half_cover t ht
  have htriangle := dist_triangle (H.coreLoop O q) p
    (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
  nlinarith

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalMaximumReverseNoncollision
statement:
theorem chronologicalMaximumReverseNoncollision
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hpositive : D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .maximum) :
    D.ChronologicalMaximumReverseNoncollision t ht hpositive hindex
proof:
:= by
  intro O hcollision
  let H := D.chronologicalMaximumReverseExteriorFlowCore t ht hindex
  let eSource := D.chronologicalMaximumReverseSourceEquiv t ht
  let eTarget := D.chronologicalMaximumReverseTargetOrbitEquiv t ht
  let OH := eSource O
  let Q := eTarget.symm (H.targetOrbit OH)
  let V := D.chronologicalMaximumLocalField t ht
  let L := D.chronologicalMaximumLocalParam t ht hindex
  let p : E' := (D.position.eventModel t ht).definiteCircle
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0
  have hpL : spacePart p = L.p := by
    change spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).definiteCircle
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0) =
      spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).definiteCircle
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
        (2 * Real.pi * (((0 : I) : ℝ))))
    norm_num
  have hpQ : L.p ∈ (Q : Set Eₐ) := by
    change L.p ∈
      (D.chronologicalMaximumReverseTargetOrbit t ht hindex O : Set Eₐ)
    rw [hcollision]
    change L.p ∈ V.orbit L.p
    exact V.mem_orbit_self L.p
  have hQtarget : (Q : Set Eₐ) = (H.targetOrbit OH : Set Eₐ) := by
    change ((((V.orbitIndexTransportEquiv
      (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)).symm
        (H.targetOrbit OH)) : V.OrbitIndex) : Set Eₐ) = _
    exact V.orbitIndexTransportEquiv_symm_val
      (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)
      (H.targetOrbit OH)
  rw [hQtarget, H.targetOrbit_coe OH] at hpQ
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
    (H.positiveParam OH).exists_curve_eq_of_mem_orbit hpQ
  change H.positiveCurve OH q = L.p at hq
  have hend : H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH q) H.ε = p := by
    calc
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH q) H.ε =
          cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH q) (H.t + H.ε) := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time OH q]
        exact (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime L.p (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) := by
        rw [hq]
        rfl
      _ = p := by
        rw [← hpL, chronologicalBeforeTime]
        rw [← (D.position.eventModel t ht).maximumCircle_time hindex
          (theta := 0) (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht).le
          ((D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
            (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le)]
        exact spaceTime_spacePart p
  have hyfar : (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius ≤
      dist (H.coreLoop OH q) (D.position.eventCenter t ht) :=
    (mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore H.C H.criticalCenter
      (H.coreLoop OH q) H.t H.r).mp (H.coreLoop_mem OH q) |>.2.2
  have hmove : dist (H.coreLoop OH q) p ≤
      (H.R.base.bound : ℝ) * D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 := by
    calc
      dist (H.coreLoop OH q) p =
          dist (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH q) 0)
            (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH q) H.ε) := by
        simp [hend]
      _ ≤ (H.R.base.bound : ℝ) * |0 - H.ε| :=
        H.R.base.dist_flow_self_le (H.coreLoop OH q) 0 H.ε
      _ = (H.R.base.bound : ℝ) *
          D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 := by
        rw [show H.ε = -(D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2) by rfl]
        rw [sub_neg_eq_add, zero_add,
          abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  have hpclose : dist p (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 :=
    D.chronologicalDefiniteCircle_dist_lt_half_cover t ht 0
  have hmoveshort : (H.R.base.bound : ℝ) *
        D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 :=
    D.chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_half_cover t ht
  have htriangle := dist_triangle (H.coreLoop OH q) p
    (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
  nlinarith

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.exists_criticalModelShrink
statement:
theorem exists_criticalModelShrink
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    ∃ S : R.CriticalModelShrink p hp,
      ContDiffOn ℝ (1 : ℕ∞ω) (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param
        (ball (0 : E₂) S.radius)
proof:
:= by
  have hcore : p.2 ∈ B.core p.1 :=
    ((G.criticalPoints_spec p).mp hp).2
  have hdomain : p.2 ∈ (B.chart p.1).domain :=
    B.core_subset_domain p.1 hcore
  exact LocalMorseNormalForm.exists_iftChartCutoffShrink_contDiffOn_of_isOpen
      (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp) 1 (B.chart p.1) p.2
      (B.domain_open p.1) hdomain (R.cutoffs.radius ⟨p, hp⟩)
      (R.cutoffs.radius_pos ⟨p, hp⟩)

theorem time_install_of_criticalModelShrink
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (S : R.CriticalModelShrink p hp) (u : E₂)
    (hu : ‖u‖ < S.radius) :
    tcoord (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
      ((B.chart p.1).param
        (p.2 + (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param u))) =
      G.localSeparatedTime p
        (p.2 + (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param u)
proof:
:= by
  apply R.time_install ⟨p, hp⟩
  · exact LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.ift_param_mem_domain
      (M := G.localMorseNormalForm p hp) S u hu
  · exact LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.ift_lifted_mem_closedBall
      (M := G.localMorseNormalForm p hp) S u hu

statement:
theorem time_model_of_criticalModelShrink
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)

    (S : R.CriticalModelShrink p hp) (u : E₂)
    (hu : ‖u‖ < S.radius) :
    tcoord (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
      ((B.chart p.1).param
        (p.2 + (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param u))) =
      G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 +
        morseQuadratic (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index (u 0, u 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.time_install_of_criticalModelShrink p hp S u hu]
  simpa [recenter] using (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).exact u
    (hu.trans_le S.radius_le)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.eventuallyEq_installedChartTime
statement:
theorem eventuallyEq_installedChartTime
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : GenericMorseEvent G) {z : E₂}
    (hdom : (B.chart p.1.1).domain ∈ nhds z)
    (hcore : (B.chart p.1.1).param z ∈
      ball ((B.chart p.1.1).param p.1.2)
        (R.cutoffs.radius p / 2)) :
    (fun w : E₂ => tcoord (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
      ((B.chart p.1.1).param w))) =ᶠ[nhds z]
        G.localSeparatedTime p.1
proof:
:= by
  have hcoreEventually : ∀ᶠ w in nhds z,
      (B.chart p.1.1).param w ∈
        ball ((B.chart p.1.1).param p.1.2)
          (R.cutoffs.radius p / 2) :=
    (B.chart p.1.1).param_smooth.continuous.continuousAt
      (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hcore)
  filter_upwards [hdom, hcoreEventually] with w hwd hwc
  exact R.time_install p w hwd (ball_subset_closedBall hwc)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.critical_model_of_criticalModelShrink
statement:
theorem critical_model_of_criticalModelShrink
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (S : R.CriticalModelShrink p hp)
    (hparam : ContDiffOn ℝ (1 : ℕ∞ω)
      (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param (ball (0 : E₂) S.radius))
    (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < S.radius) :
    (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
        ((B.chart p.1).param
          (p.2 + (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param u)) ∈
      timeCritical (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G ↔ u = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let M := G.localMorseNormalForm p hp
  let P := B.chart p.1
  let z : E₂ := p.2 + M.param u
  have hdom : P.domain ∈ nhds z := by
    exact LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.ift_domain_mem_nhds
      (M := M) S (B.domain_open p.1) u hu
  have hcore : P.param z ∈
      ball (P.param p.2) (R.cutoffs.radius ⟨p, hp⟩ / 2) := by
    exact LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.ift_lifted_mem
      (M := M) S u hu
  have htime := R.eventuallyEq_installedChartTime ⟨p, hp⟩ hdom hcore
  have hgradient :
      chartGradient
          (fun w : E₂ => tcoord
            (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param w))) z =
        chartGradient (G.localSeparatedTime p) z := by
    rw [chartGradient, chartGradient, htime.fderiv_eq]
  have hquadratic :
      chartGradient (G.localSeparatedTime p) (p.2 + M.param u) = 0 ↔
        u = 0 := by
    exact LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.chartGradient_shifted_param_eq_zero_iff_of_contDiffOn_one
        M S ((localSeparatedTime_contDiff (G := G) p).differentiable (by simp))
        (G.localSeparatedTime_nondegenerate p hp).1 hparam u hu
  calc
    R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z) ∈
          timeCritical (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
        ↔ chartGradient
            (fun w : E₂ => tcoord
              (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param w))) z = 0 :=
          P.pullbackParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
            R.amplitude hdom
    _ ↔ chartGradient (G.localSeparatedTime p) z = 0 := by rw [hgradient]
    _ ↔ u = 0 := by simpa [z, M] using hquadratic

    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius) :
    (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
        ((B.chart p.1).param
          (p.2 + (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param u)) ∈

name: Submission.CompactBirth.birthHeight_le_one
statement: lemma birthHeight_le_one (t : ℝ) : birthHeight t ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : t < 1 / 2
  · exact (birthHeight_neg_of_lt_half ht).le.trans (by norm_num)
  · by_cases hthree : 3 / 4 ≤ t
    · rw [birthHeight_of_threeQuarter_le hthree]
    · rw [birthHeight, if_neg ht, birthHeightRight]
      have hc0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (8 * (t - 5 / 8))
      have hc1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (8 * (t - 5 / 8))
      change (1 - birthRightCutoff t) * (t - 1 / 2) +
        birthRightCutoff t ≤ 1
      change 0 ≤ birthRightCutoff t at hc0
      change birthRightCutoff t ≤ 1 at hc1
      have ht0 : 0 ≤ t - 1 / 2 := by linarith
      have ht1 : t - 1 / 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith
      nlinarith

name: Submission.CompactBirth.transverse_eq_zero_of_eventMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun q : F => q j.castSucc) hv
  rw [eventMap_apply_castSucc] at hcoord
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hcoord
  have hc : cutoff (initCLM (m + 2) v) < 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (cutoff_le_one _) (eventMap_cutoff_ne_one m hv)
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hcoord).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hc.ne')

name: Submission.CompactBirth.normSq_init_eq_radialSq_of_eventMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma normSq_init_eq_radialSq_of_eventMap_eq_zero {v : E'}
    (hv : eventMap m v = 0) :
    normSq (initCLM (m + 2) v) =
      StandardBirth.radialSq m (initCLM (m + 2) v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold normSq StandardBirth.radialSq
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp only [initCLM_apply]
  have hz : ∀ j : Fin m, v j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc ^ 2 = 0 :=
    fun j => by rw [transverse_eq_zero_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv j, zero_pow (by norm_num)]
  simp only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
  rfl

name: Submission.CompactBirth.eventMap_zero_iff
statement:
theorem eventMap_zero_iff (v : E') :
    eventMap m v = 0 ↔ StandardBirth.eventMap m v = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hc_lt : cutoff (initCLM (m + 2) v) < 1 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (cutoff_le_one _) (eventMap_cutoff_ne_one m hv)
    have hr := normSq_init_eq_radialSq_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv
    have hlast := congrArg (fun q : F => q (Fin.last m)) hv
    rw [eventMap_apply_last] at hlast
    simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hlast
    have hslt : normSq (initCLM (m + 2) v) < 2 := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hsge : 2 ≤ normSq (initCLM (m + 2) v) := not_lt.mp hnot
      have hheight := birthHeight_le_one (vertC v)
      have hc0 := cutoff_nonneg (initCLM (m + 2) v)
      rw [hr] at hsge
      nlinarith
    have hc0 : cutoff (initCLM (m + 2) v) = 0 :=
      cutoff_eq_zero hslt.le
    simpa [eventMap, hc0] using hv
  · intro hv
    have hbound := StandardBirth.eventMap_spatial_bound_one m v hv
    have hs : normSq (initCLM (m + 2) v) ≤ 2 := by
      rw [normSq_eq_norm_sq]
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (initCLM (m + 2) v)]
    have hc0 : cutoff (initCLM (m + 2) v) = 0 := cutoff_eq_zero hs
    simp [eventMap, hc0, hv]

name: Submission.CompactBirth.levelMap_neg_one_zero_iff
statement:
theorem levelMap_neg_one_zero_iff (x : E) :
    levelMap m (-1) x = 0 ↔ StandardBirth.circleMap m (-1) x = 0
proof:

  have hheight : birthHeight 0 = -1 := birthHeight_of_le_quarter (by norm_num)
  rw [← hheight]

name: Submission.CompactBirth.levelMap_eventuallyEq_circleMap
proof:

name: Submission.CompactBirth.eventMap_eventuallyEq_standard
proof:
:= by
  have hbound := StandardBirth.eventMap_spatial_bound_one m v hv

name: Submission.SaddleCriticalExteriorArcPairingData.ofMate

theorem ofMate
    (mate : P → P)
    (mate_ne : ∀ p, mate p ≠ p)
    (mate_arc : ∀ p,
      Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc endpoint K p (mate p)))
    (unique : ∀ {p q}, q ≠ p →
      Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc endpoint K p q) → q = mate p)
    (mate_orientation : ∀ p,
      boundaryRaw p * boundaryRaw (mate p) < 0) :
    SaddleCriticalExteriorArcPairingData endpoint K boundaryRaw where
  paired p
proof:
:= ⟨mate p, ⟨mate_ne p, mate_arc p⟩, by
    intro q hq
    exact unique hq.1 hq.2⟩
  orientation_opposite := by
    intro p q hne harc
    rw [unique hne harc]
    exact mate_orientation p

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd_mem_puncturedCriticalSlice
statement:
theorem saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd_mem_puncturedCriticalSlice
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) {rho : ℝ}
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (hrho_radius : rho < T.radius) :
    M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho ∈ puncturedCriticalSlice C center
proof:
:= by
  rcases p with ⟨b, e⟩
  have hrho_sq : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 < rho ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hrho]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_fiber b e hrho hrho_sq
      (hrho_radius.trans_le T.radius_le)
  · simpa [saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd] using
      M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex b e hrho
      hrho_sq (hrho_radius.trans_le T.radius_le)
  · intro hend
    have hu_mem : saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e rho 0 ∈
        Metric.ball (0 : E₂) T.radius := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right,
        norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e hrho hrho_sq]
      exact hrho_radius
    have hzero_mem : (0 : E₂) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E₂) T.radius := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using T.radius_pos
    have hparam : saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e rho 0 = 0 :=
      T.param_injOn hu_mem hzero_mem (by
        simpa [saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd, saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
          localPoint, M.param_zero] using hend)
    have hnorm := norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e hrho hrho_sq
    rw [hparam, norm_zero] at hnorm
    linarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.fderiv_levelMap_apply_castSucc
statement:
theorem fderiv_levelMap_apply_castSucc (a : ℝ) (x h : E)
    (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x h j.castSucc = h j.castSucc.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc
  let inProj : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc.castSucc
  have hG : HasFDerivAt (levelMap m a) (fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x) x :=
    ((contDiff_levelMap m a).differentiable infty_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun w => levelMap m a w j.castSucc)
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x)) x := by
    exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (levelMap m a x) j.castSucc).comp x hG
  have hcoord : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E => w j.castSucc.castSucc) inProj x :=
    inProj.hasFDerivAt
  have hfun : (fun w => levelMap m a w j.castSucc) =
      fun w : E => w j.castSucc.castSucc := by
    funext w
    simp [levelMap]
  have hmaps : outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x) = inProj := by
    rw [← hcomp.fderiv, hfun, hcoord.fderiv]
  exact congrArg (fun A : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => A h) hmaps

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.fderiv_levelMap_apply_last
statement:
theorem fderiv_levelMap_apply_last (a : ℝ) (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x h (Fin.last (m + 1)) =
      4 * x (planeFirst m) * (radiusSq m x - 1) * h (planeFirst m) +
        4 * x (planeSecond m) * (radiusSq m x + 1) * h (planeSecond m)
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (m + 1))
  have hG : HasFDerivAt (levelMap m a) (fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x) x :=
    ((contDiff_levelMap m a).differentiable infty_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun w => levelMap m a w (Fin.last (m + 1)))
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x)) x := by
    exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (levelMap m a x)
      (Fin.last (m + 1))).comp x hG
  let pA : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (planeFirst m)
  let pB : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (planeSecond m)
  have hA := (pA.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt pA pA x)
  have hB := (pB.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt pB pB x)
  have hq :=
    ((((hA.sub_const 1).pow 2).add (hB.pow 2)).mul
      (((hA.add_const 1).pow 2).add (hB.pow 2))).sub_const 1
  change HasFDerivAt
    (fun w : E =>
      ((pA w - 1) ^ 2 + pB w ^ 2) *
        ((pA w + 1) ^ 2 + pB w ^ 2) - 1) _ x at hq
  have hdirect := hq.sub_const a
  have hfun : (fun w => levelMap m a w (Fin.last (m + 1))) = fun w : E =>
      (((pA w - 1) ^ 2 + (pB w) ^ 2) *
        ((pA w + 1) ^ 2 + (pB w) ^ 2) - 1) - a := by
    funext w
    simp [levelMap, cassiniQ, pA, pB]
  have happ := congrArg (fun A : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => A h) hcomp.fderiv.symm
  rw [hfun, hdirect.fderiv] at happ
  simp [outProj, pA, pB, radiusSq] at happ
  convert happ using 1 <;> simp [radiusSq] <;> ring

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.gradVec_levelMap_castSucc
statement:
theorem gradVec_levelMap_castSucc (a : ℝ) (x : E) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    gradVec (levelMap m a) j.castSucc x =
      EuclideanSpace.single j.castSucc.castSucc 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right_basis (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).toBasis
  intro k
  simp only [OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  change inner ℝ (gradVec (levelMap m a) j.castSucc x)
      (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) =
    inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single j.castSucc.castSucc 1)
      (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)
  rw [inner_gradVec, fderiv_levelMap_apply_castSucc]
  simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, PiLp.single_apply]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.gradVec_levelMap_last
statement:
theorem gradVec_levelMap_last (a : ℝ) (x : E) :
    gradVec (levelMap m a) (Fin.last (m + 1)) x = planarNormal m x
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right_basis (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).toBasis
  intro k
  simp only [OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  change inner ℝ (gradVec (levelMap m a) (Fin.last (m + 1)) x)
      (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) =
    inner ℝ (planarNormal m x) (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)
  rw [inner_gradVec, fderiv_levelMap_apply_last]
  rw [planarNormal, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left,
    real_inner_smul_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left,
    EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  simp [normalFirst, normalSecond, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left,
    PiLp.single_apply]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.normalFirst_ne_zero_or_normalSecond_ne_zero_of_level
statement:
theorem normalFirst_ne_zero_or_normalSecond_ne_zero_of_level
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha0 : a ≠ 0) (ha1 : a ≠ -1) :
    normalFirst m x ≠ 0 ∨ normalSecond m x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  rcases h with ⟨hA, hB⟩
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ radiusSq m x := by
    simp [radiusSq]
    positivity
  have hrp : 0 < radiusSq m x + 1 := by linarith
  have hy0 : x (planeSecond m) = 0 := by
    unfold normalSecond at hB
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hB with h4x | hr
    · norm_num at h4x
      exact h4x
    · exact False.elim ((ne_of_gt hrp) hr)
  have hx0_or_r1 : x (planeFirst m) = 0 ∨ radiusSq m x = 1 := by
    unfold normalFirst at hA
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hA with h4x | hr
    · norm_num at h4x
      exact Or.inl h4x
    · exact Or.inr (sub_eq_zero.mp hr)
  have hlevel := cassiniQ_eq_level_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx
  rw [cassiniQ_eq] at hlevel
  rcases hx0_or_r1 with hx0 | hr1
  · apply ha0
    simp [radiusSq, hx0, hy0] at hlevel
    exact hlevel.symm
  · apply ha1
    have hxSq : x (planeFirst m) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      simpa [radiusSq, hy0] using hr1
    nlinarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpoint_normal_coefficients_ne_zero
statement:
theorem endpoint_normal_coefficients_ne_zero
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    normalFirst m x ≠ 0 ∨ normalSecond m x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply normalFirst_ne_zero_or_normalSecond_ne_zero_of_level m hx
  · rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num
  · rcases ha with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.planarNormal_ne_zero_of_endpoint
statement:
theorem planarNormal_ne_zero_of_endpoint
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    planarNormal m x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain hA | hB := endpoint_normal_coefficients_ne_zero m hx ha
  · intro hzero
    have hcoord := congrArg (fun q : E => q (planeFirst m)) hzero
    have hAB : planeFirst m ≠ planeSecond m := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
    simp [planarNormal, PiLp.single_apply, hAB] at hcoord
    exact hA hcoord
  · intro hzero
    have hcoord := congrArg (fun q : E => q (planeSecond m)) hzero
    have hBA : planeSecond m ≠ planeFirst m := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
    simp [planarNormal, PiLp.single_apply, hBA] at hcoord
    exact hB hcoord

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.planarTangent_ne_zero_of_endpoint
statement:
theorem planarTangent_ne_zero_of_endpoint
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :

proof:

  · intro hzero

    have hBA : planeSecond m ≠ planeFirst m := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
    simp [planarTangent, PiLp.single_apply, hBA] at hcoord
    exact hA hcoord
  · intro hzero
    have hcoord := congrArg (fun q : E => q (planeFirst m)) hzero
    have hAB : planeFirst m ≠ planeSecond m := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
    simp [planarTangent, PiLp.single_apply, hAB] at hcoord
    exact hB hcoord

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.inner_planarTangent_planarNormal
statement:

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.fderiv_levelMap_planarTangent
statement:
theorem fderiv_levelMap_planarTangent (a : ℝ) (x : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x (planarTangent m x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      change fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x (planarTangent m x)
        (Fin.last (m + 1)) = 0
      rw [fderiv_levelMap_apply_last]
      simp [normalFirst, normalSecond]
      ring
  | cast j =>
      change fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x (planarTangent m x) j.castSucc = 0
      rw [fderiv_levelMap_apply_castSucc]
      exact planarTangent_apply_transverse m x j

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.crossDet_unitPlanarTangent_ne_zero
statement:
theorem crossDet_unitPlanarTangent_ne_zero
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hreg : x ∈ regularSet (levelMap m a))
    (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i x)
        (unitPlanarTangent m x) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let q := unitPlanarTangent m x
  have hkernel : fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x q = 0 :=
    fderiv_levelMap_unitPlanarTangent m a x
  have hmem : q ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {tauField (levelMap m a) x} :=
    (fderiv_eq_zero_iff_mem_span_tauField hreg _).mp hkernel
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
  have hqnorm : ‖q‖ = 1 := norm_unitPlanarTangent_of_endpoint m hx ha
  have hc0 : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hczero
    rw [hczero, zero_smul] at hc
    have := congrArg norm hc
    simp [hqnorm] at this
  have hdetTau :
      crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i x)
          (tauField (levelMap m a) x) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (crossDet_tauField_pos hreg)
  have hdetEq := congrArg
    (crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i x)) hc
  rw [crossDet_smul] at hdetEq
  rw [← hdetEq]
  exact mul_ne_zero hc0 hdetTau

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.crossDet_orientedUnitPlanarTangent_pos
statement:
theorem crossDet_orientedUnitPlanarTangent_pos
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hreg : x ∈ regularSet (levelMap m a))
    (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    0 < crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i x)
      (orientedUnitPlanarTangent m a x)
proof:
:= by
  let d := crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i x)
    (unitPlanarTangent m x)
  have hd0 : d ≠ 0 := crossDet_unitPlanarTangent_ne_zero m hreg hx ha
  by_cases hd : 0 < d
  · rw [orientedUnitPlanarTangent, tangentOrientationSign, if_pos hd,
      crossDet_smul]
    simpa [d] using hd
  · have hdneg : d < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hd) hd0
    have hpos : 0 < -d := neg_pos.mpr hdneg
    rw [orientedUnitPlanarTangent, tangentOrientationSign, if_neg hd,
      crossDet_smul]
    simpa [d] using hpos

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.tauField_eq_of_unit_kernel_crossDet_pos
statement:
theorem tauField_eq_of_unit_kernel_crossDet_pos
    {a : ℝ} {x q : E} (hreg : x ∈ regularSet (levelMap m a))
    (hkernel : fderiv ℝ (levelMap m a) x q = 0)
    (hnorm : ‖q‖ = 1)
    (hdet : 0 < crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i x) q) :
    tauField (levelMap m a) x = q
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : q ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {tauField (levelMap m a) x} :=
    (fderiv_eq_zero_iff_mem_span_tauField hreg _).mp hkernel
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
  have hdetTau : 0 < crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i x)
      (tauField (levelMap m a) x) := crossDet_tauField_pos hreg
  have hdetEq := congrArg
    (crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i x)) hc
  rw [crossDet_smul] at hdetEq
  have hprod : 0 < c * crossDet (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i x)
      (tauField (levelMap m a) x) := by
    rw [hdetEq]
    exact hdet
  have hcPos : 0 < c := by
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hprod with hp | hn
    · exact hp.1
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt hdetTau)) hn.2)
  have hnormEq := congrArg norm hc
  rw [norm_smul, norm_tauField hreg, mul_one, hnorm,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hcPos] at hnormEq
  have hcOne : c = 1 := hnormEq
  rw [hcOne, one_smul] at hc
  exact hc

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.tauField_levelMap_eq_orientedUnitPlanarTangent
statement:
theorem tauField_levelMap_eq_orientedUnitPlanarTangent
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hreg : x ∈ regularSet (levelMap m a))
    (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    tauField (levelMap m a) x = orientedUnitPlanarTangent m a x

  apply tauField_eq_of_unit_kernel_crossDet_pos m hreg
  · exact fderiv_levelMap_orientedUnitPlanarTangent m a x
  · exact norm_orientedUnitPlanarTangent_of_endpoint m hx ha
  · exact crossDet_orientedUnitPlanarTangent_pos m hreg hx ha

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.inner_transverse_transverse
statement:
theorem inner_transverse_transverse (j k : Fin (m + 1)) :
    inner ℝ (EuclideanSpace.single j.castSucc.castSucc (1 : ℝ))
      (EuclideanSpace.single k.castSucc.castSucc 1) =
        if j = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  by_cases h : j = k
  · subst k
    simp
  · have hcast : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ k.castSucc.castSucc := by
      intro heq
      apply h
      apply Fin.ext
      simpa using congrArg (fun z : Fin (m + 3) => z.val) heq
    simp [h, hcast]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpointNormalUnit_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem endpointNormalUnit_last (x : E) :
    endpointNormalUnit m x (Fin.last (m + 1)) = unitPlanarNormal m x
proof:
:= by
  simp [endpointNormalUnit]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpointNormalUnit_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] theorem endpointNormalUnit_castSucc (x : E) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    endpointNormalUnit m x j.castSucc =
      EuclideanSpace.single j.castSucc.castSucc 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [endpointNormalUnit]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.orthonormal_endpointNormalUnit
statement:
theorem orthonormal_endpointNormalUnit
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    Orthonormal ℝ (endpointNormalUnit m x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  intro i j
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          rw [endpointNormalUnit_last, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
            norm_unitPlanarNormal_of_endpoint m hx ha]
          simp
      | cast j =>
          rw [endpointNormalUnit_last, endpointNormalUnit_castSucc,
            real_inner_comm, inner_transverse_unitPlanarNormal]
          simp [Fin.castSucc_lt_last j |>.ne']
  | cast i =>
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          rw [endpointNormalUnit_castSucc, endpointNormalUnit_last,
            inner_transverse_unitPlanarNormal]
          simp [Fin.castSucc_lt_last i |>.ne]
      | cast j =>
          rw [endpointNormalUnit_castSucc, endpointNormalUnit_castSucc,
            inner_transverse_transverse]
          simp

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.orthonormal_endpointUnitFrame
statement:
theorem orthonormal_endpointUnitFrame
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    Orthonormal ℝ (endpointUnitFrame m a x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  intro i j
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · rw [endpointUnitFrame, Fin.cons_zero, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
        norm_orientedUnitPlanarTangent_of_endpoint m hx ha]
      simp
    · induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          rw [endpointUnitFrame, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ,
            endpointNormalUnit_last,
            inner_orientedUnitPlanarTangent_unitPlanarNormal]
          simp
      | cast j =>
          rw [endpointUnitFrame, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ,
            endpointNormalUnit_castSucc, real_inner_comm,
            inner_transverse_orientedUnitPlanarTangent]
          simp [Ne.symm (Fin.succ_ne_zero j.castSucc)]
  · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          rw [endpointUnitFrame, Fin.cons_succ, endpointNormalUnit_last,
            Fin.cons_zero, real_inner_comm,
            inner_orientedUnitPlanarTangent_unitPlanarNormal]
          simp
      | cast i =>
          rw [endpointUnitFrame, Fin.cons_succ,
            endpointNormalUnit_castSucc, Fin.cons_zero,
            inner_transverse_orientedUnitPlanarTangent]
          simp
    · rw [endpointUnitFrame, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ]
      simpa only [Fin.succ_inj] using
        orthonormal_iff_ite.mp (orthonormal_endpointNormalUnit m hx ha) i j

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpointRawFrame_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem endpointRawFrame_last (a : ℝ) (x : E) :
    endpointRawFrame m a x (Fin.last (m + 2)) = planarNormal m x
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (Fin.last (m + 1)).succ =
      (Fin.last (m + 2) : Fin (m + 3)) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  rw [← hs]
  simp [endpointRawFrame, endpointRawNormal]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem endpointUnitFrame_last (a : ℝ) (x : E) :
    endpointUnitFrame m a x (Fin.last (m + 2)) = unitPlanarNormal m x
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (Fin.last (m + 1)).succ =
      (Fin.last (m + 2) : Fin (m + 3)) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  rw [← hs]
  simp [endpointUnitFrame]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.levelMap_frame_eq_endpointRawFrame
statement:
theorem levelMap_frame_eq_endpointRawFrame
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hreg : x ∈ regularSet (levelMap m a))
    (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    Fin.cons (tauField (levelMap m a) x)
      (fun i => gradVec (levelMap m a) i x) = endpointRawFrame m a x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · rw [Fin.cons_zero, endpointRawFrame, Fin.cons_zero,
      tauField_levelMap_eq_orientedUnitPlanarTangent m hreg hx ha]
  · rw [Fin.cons_succ, endpointRawFrame, Fin.cons_succ]
    induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
        rw [endpointRawNormal]
        simp only [Fin.lastCases_last]
        exact gradVec_levelMap_last m a x
    | cast i =>
        rw [endpointRawNormal]
        simp only [Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
        exact gradVec_levelMap_castSucc m a x i

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.frameAt_source_eq_endpointRawFrame
statement:
theorem frameAt_source_eq_endpointRawFrame
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ (sourceFLS m).fiber) :
    frameAt (sourceFLS m) x = endpointRawFrame m (-1 / 2) x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [frameAt, sourceFLS, Nat.add_assoc] using
    levelMap_frame_eq_endpointRawFrame m
      ((sourceFLS m).fiber_subset_regularSet hx) hx (Or.inl rfl)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.frameAt_target_eq_endpointRawFrame
statement:
theorem frameAt_target_eq_endpointRawFrame
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ (targetFLS m).fiber) :
    frameAt (targetFLS m) x = endpointRawFrame m (1 / 2) x
proof:
:= by
  simpa only [frameAt, targetFLS, Nat.add_assoc] using
    levelMap_frame_eq_endpointRawFrame m
      ((targetFLS m).fiber_subset_regularSet hx) hx (Or.inr rfl)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpointFrameScale_pos
statement:
theorem endpointFrameScale_pos
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (i : Fin (m + 3)) : 0 < endpointFrameScale m x i
proof:
:= by
  unfold endpointFrameScale
  split_ifs
  · exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (planarNormal_ne_zero_of_endpoint m hx ha)
  · norm_num

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.endpointRawFrame_eq_smul_endpointUnitFrame
statement:
theorem endpointRawFrame_eq_smul_endpointUnitFrame
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (i : Fin (m + 3)) :
    endpointRawFrame m a x i = endpointFrameScale m x i •
      endpointUnitFrame m a x i
proof:
:= by
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · have h0 : (0 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ Fin.last (m + 2) := by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp at this
    simp [endpointRawFrame, endpointUnitFrame, endpointFrameScale, h0]
  · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
        have hs : (Fin.last (m + 1)).succ =
            (Fin.last (m + 2) : Fin (m + 3)) := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp
        rw [hs]
        rw [endpointRawFrame_last, endpointUnitFrame_last]
        simp only [endpointFrameScale, if_pos]
        rw [unitPlanarNormal, smul_smul]
        have hn : ‖planarNormal m x‖ ≠ 0 :=
          norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (planarNormal_ne_zero_of_endpoint m hx ha)
        rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hn, one_smul]
    | cast i =>
        have hil : (i.castSucc.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ Fin.last (m + 2) := by
          intro h
          have hv := congrArg (fun z : Fin (m + 3) => z.val) h
          simp at hv
          omega
        simp [endpointRawFrame, endpointUnitFrame, endpointRawNormal,
          endpointNormalUnit, endpointFrameScale, hil]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.gramSchmidtNormed_endpointRawFrame
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_endpointRawFrame
    {a : ℝ} {x : E} (hx : levelMap m a x = 0)
    (ha : a = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ a = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (endpointRawFrame m a x) =
      endpointUnitFrame m a x
proof:
:= by
  have hon : Orthonormal ℝ (endpointUnitFrame m a x) :=
    orthonormal_endpointUnitFrame m hx ha
  have horth : Pairwise
      (fun i j => inner ℝ (endpointRawFrame m a x i)
        (endpointRawFrame m a x j) = 0) := by
    intro i j hij
    rw [endpointRawFrame_eq_smul_endpointUnitFrame m hx ha,
      endpointRawFrame_eq_smul_endpointUnitFrame m hx ha,
      real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, hon.2 hij,
      mul_zero, mul_zero]
  funext i
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed, gramSchmidt_of_orthogonal ℝ horth,
    endpointRawFrame_eq_smul_endpointUnitFrame m hx ha, norm_smul,
    hon.1 i, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (endpointFrameScale_pos m hx ha i), smul_smul]
  simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ (endpointFrameScale_pos m hx ha i).ne']

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_source
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_source
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ (sourceFLS m).fiber) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt (sourceFLS m) x) =
      endpointUnitFrame m (-1 / 2) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameAt_source_eq_endpointRawFrame m hx]
  exact gramSchmidtNormed_endpointRawFrame m hx (Or.inl rfl)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_target
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_target
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ (targetFLS m).fiber) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt (targetFLS m) x) =
      endpointUnitFrame m (1 / 2) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameAt_target_eq_endpointRawFrame m hx]
  exact gramSchmidtNormed_endpointRawFrame m hx (Or.inr rfl)

name: Submission.spaceTime_apply_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma spaceTime_apply_castSucc (x : E₁) (t : ℝ) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    spaceTime x t (Fin.castSucc i) = x i
proof:
:= by
  simp [cobSpaceTime, Fin.snoc_castSucc]

name: Submission.spacePart_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma spacePart_apply (v : E') (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    spacePart v i = v (Fin.castSucc i)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.spacePart_spaceTime
statement: @[simp] lemma spacePart_spaceTime (x : E₁) (t : ℝ) : spacePart (spaceTime x t) = x
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  simp [spacePart, cobSpaceTime, Fin.init_snoc]

name: Submission.spaceTime_spacePart
statement: lemma spaceTime_spacePart (v : E') : spaceTime (spacePart v) (tcoord v) = v
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext j
  rcases Fin.eq_castSucc_or_eq_last j with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | rfl
  · show spaceTime (spacePart v) (tcoord v) (Fin.castSucc i) = v (Fin.castSucc i)
    rw [spaceTime_apply_castSucc, spacePart_apply]
  · show spaceTime (spacePart v) (tcoord v) (Fin.last (n + 1)) = v (Fin.last (n + 1))
    rw [spaceTime_apply_last]
    rfl

name: Submission.tcoord_smul

proof:

lemma timeVec_apply (j : Fin (n + 2)) :
    timeVec (n := n) j = if j = Fin.last (n + 1) then 1 else 0
proof:
:=
  PiLp.single_apply 2 ℝ (Fin.last (n + 1)) (1 : ℝ) j

name: Submission.spaceInclL_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma spaceInclL_apply (x : E₁) : spaceInclL x = spaceTime x 0
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.tcoord_spaceInclL
statement: @[simp] lemma tcoord_spaceInclL (x : E₁) : tcoord (spaceInclL x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [spaceInclL_apply, tcoord_spaceTime]

name: Submission.spaceTime_eq
statement: lemma spaceTime_eq (x : E₁) (t : ℝ) : spaceTime x t = spaceInclL x + t • timeVec
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext j
  show spaceTime x t j = ((spaceInclL x + t • timeVec : E')) j
  rw [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, spaceInclL_apply, timeVec_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rcases Fin.eq_castSucc_or_eq_last j with ⟨i, rfl⟩ | rfl
  · rw [spaceTime_apply_castSucc, spaceTime_apply_castSucc,
      if_neg (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i).ne, mul_zero, add_zero]
  · rw [spaceTime_apply_last, spaceTime_apply_last, if_pos rfl, mul_one, zero_add]

name: Submission.spaceInclL_spacePart
statement: lemma spaceInclL_spacePart {v : E'} (h : tcoord v = 0) : spaceInclL (spacePart v) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [spaceInclL_apply, ← h, spaceTime_spacePart]

name: Submission.norm_spacePart_le
statement: lemma norm_spacePart_le (v : E') : ‖spacePart v‖ ≤ ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
  have h : ∑ j : Fin (n + 2), ‖v j‖ ^ 2
      = (∑ i : Fin (n + 1), ‖v (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2) + ‖v (Fin.last (n + 1))‖ ^ 2 :=
    Fin.sum_univ_castSucc (f := fun j => ‖v j‖ ^ 2)
  rw [h]
  have h2 : ∀ i : Fin (n + 1), ‖spacePart v i‖ ^ 2 = ‖v (Fin.castSucc i)‖ ^ 2 := fun i => rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => h2 i]
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity)

name: Submission.norm_spaceInclL
statement: lemma norm_spaceInclL (x : E₁) : ‖spaceInclL (n := n) x‖ = ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [spaceInclL_apply, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  congr 1
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp [spaceTime_apply_castSucc, spaceTime_apply_last]

name: Submission.hasFDerivAt_cobSpaceTime
statement:
lemma hasFDerivAt_cobSpaceTime (t : ℝ) (x : E₁) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun y : E₁ => spaceTime y t) (spaceInclL (n := n)) x
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun y : E₁ => spaceTime y t) = fun y => spaceInclL y + t • timeVec :=
    funext fun y => spaceTime_eq y t
  rw [heq]
  exact (spaceInclL (n := n)).hasFDerivAt.add_const _

name: Submission.contDiff_spaceTime_pair
statement:
lemma contDiff_spaceTime_pair :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E₁ => spaceTime p.2 p.1)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun p : ℝ × E₁ => spaceTime p.2 p.1)
      = fun p : ℝ × E₁ => spaceInclL p.2 + p.1 • timeVec :=
    funext fun p => spaceTime_eq p.2 p.1
  rw [heq]
  apply ContDiff.add
  · have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Prod.snd : ℝ × E₁ → E₁) := contDiff_snd
    have h := (spaceInclL (n := n)).contDiff.comp h2
    exact h
  · exact contDiff_fst.smul contDiff_const

name: Submission.inner_gramCLM_self
statement:
lemma inner_gramCLM_self (G : E' → F) (v : E') (x : F) :
    ⟪x, gramCLM G v x⟫ = ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (fderiv ℝ G v)
    (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) x) x
  calc ⟪x, gramCLM G v x⟫
      = ⟪ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) x,
          ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) x⟫ := h.symm
    _ = ‖ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) x‖ ^ 2 :=
        real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _

name: Submission.inner_gramCLM_left
statement:
lemma inner_gramCLM_left (G : E' → F) (v : E') (x y : F) :
    ⟪gramCLM G v x, y⟫ = ⟪x, gramCLM G v y⟫
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (fderiv ℝ G v)
    (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) x) y
  have h2 := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left (fderiv ℝ G v)
    (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) y) x
  calc ⟪gramCLM G v x, y⟫
      = ⟪y, fderiv ℝ G v (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) x)⟫ :=
        real_inner_comm _ _
    _ = ⟪ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) y,
          ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) x⟫ := h1.symm
    _ = ⟪ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) x,
          ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) y⟫ := real_inner_comm _ _
    _ = ⟪x, gramCLM G v y⟫ := h2

name: Submission.adjoint_fderiv_injective
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hz : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) (x - y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hv (x - y)
  have h0 : ⟪x - y, x - y⟫ = 0 := by
    nth_rewrite 2 [← hw]
    rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, hz, inner_zero_left]
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (inner_self_eq_zero.mp h0)

name: Submission.isUnit_gramCLM
statement:
lemma isUnit_gramCLM {G : E' → F} {v : E'} (hv : Surjective (fderiv ℝ G v)) :
    IsUnit (gramCLM G v)
proof:
:= by
  have hinj : Injective (gramCLM G v) := by
    intro x y hxy
    have h0 : gramCLM G v (x - y) = 0 := by rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
    have h1 : ⟪x - y, gramCLM G v (x - y)⟫ = 0 := by rw [h0, inner_zero_right]
    rw [inner_gramCLM_self] at h1
    have h2 : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) (x - y) = 0 :=
      norm_eq_zero.mp (pow_eq_zero_iff (n := 2) (by norm_num) |>.mp h1)
    have h3 : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) (x - y)
        = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v) 0 := by rw [h2, map_zero]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (adjoint_fderiv_injective hv h3)
  have hsurj : Surjective (gramCLM G v) := by
    have h := LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective
      (f := ((gramCLM G v : F →L[ℝ] F) : F →ₗ[ℝ] F))
    exact h.mp hinj
  exact ⟨(LinearEquiv.ofBijective ((gramCLM G v : F →L[ℝ] F) : F →ₗ[ℝ] F)
    ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩).toContinuousLinearEquiv.toUnit, ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => rfl⟩

name: Submission.surjective_of_isUnit_gramCLM
statement:
lemma surjective_of_isUnit_gramCLM {G : E' → F} {v : E'}
    (hu : IsUnit (gramCLM G v)) : Surjective (fderiv ℝ G v)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  refine ⟨ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v)
    (Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v) y), ?_⟩
  have h := Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hu
  calc fderiv ℝ G v (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v)
        (Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v) y))
      = (gramCLM G v * Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v)) y := rfl
    _ = (1 : F →L[ℝ] F) y := by rw [h]
    _ = y := rfl

name: Submission.surjective_iff_isUnit_gramCLM
statement:
lemma surjective_iff_isUnit_gramCLM (G : E' → F) (v : E') :
    Surjective (fderiv ℝ G v) ↔ IsUnit (gramCLM G v)
proof:
:=
  ⟨isUnit_gramCLM, surjective_of_isUnit_gramCLM⟩

name: Submission.gramCLM_ringInverse_apply
proof:
:= by
  have h := Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hu
  calc gramCLM G v (Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v) y)
      = (gramCLM G v * Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v)) y := rfl
    _ = (1 : F →L[ℝ] F) y := by rw [h]
    _ = y := rfl

name: Submission.inner_ringInverse_gramCLM
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ⟪Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v) x, gramCLM G v (Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v) y)⟫
      = ⟪gramCLM G v (Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v) x), Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v) y⟫ :=
    (inner_gramCLM_left G v _ _).symm
  rw [gramCLM_ringInverse_apply hu x, gramCLM_ringInverse_apply hu y] at h1
  exact h1

name: Submission.kerProj_apply
statement:
lemma kerProj_apply (G : E' → F) (v w : E') :
    kerProj G v w = w - ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v)
      (Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v) (fderiv ℝ G v w))
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.fderiv_kerProj
statement:
lemma fderiv_kerProj {G : E' → F} {v : E'} (hv : Surjective (fderiv ℝ G v)) (w : E') :
    fderiv ℝ G v (kerProj G v w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hu := isUnit_gramCLM hv
  rw [kerProj_apply, map_sub]
  have hg : fderiv ℝ G v (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G v)
      (Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v) (fderiv ℝ G v w)))
      = gramCLM G v (Ring.inverse (gramCLM G v) (fderiv ℝ G v w)) := rfl
  rw [hg, gramCLM_ringInverse_apply hu, sub_self]

name: Submission.kerProj_of_fderiv_eq_zero
statement:
lemma kerProj_of_fderiv_eq_zero {G : E' → F} {v w : E'}
    (hw : fderiv ℝ G v w = 0) : kerProj G v w = w
proof:
:= by
  rw [kerProj_apply, hw, map_zero, map_zero, sub_zero]

name: Submission.kerProj_idem
statement:
lemma kerProj_idem {G : E' → F} {v : E'} (hv : Surjective (fderiv ℝ G v)) (w : E') :
    kerProj G v (kerProj G v w) = kerProj G v w
proof:
:=
  kerProj_of_fderiv_eq_zero (fderiv_kerProj hv w)

name: Submission.inner_kerProj_left
statement:
lemma inner_kerProj_left {G : E' → F} {v : E'} (hv : Surjective (fderiv ℝ G v))
    (u w : E') : ⟪kerProj G v u, w⟫ = ⟪u, kerProj G v w⟫
proof:
:= by
  have hu := isUnit_gramCLM hv
  rw [kerProj_apply, kerProj_apply, inner_sub_left, inner_sub_right]
  congr 1
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, inner_ringInverse_gramCLM hu,
    ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right]

name: Submission.inner_timeVec_kerProj_timeVec
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← kerProj_idem hv (timeVec (n := n)), ← inner_kerProj_left hv]
  exact real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _

name: Submission.kerProj_eq_self_iff
statement:
lemma kerProj_eq_self_iff {G : E' → F} {v : E'} (hv : Surjective (fderiv ℝ G v))
    (w : E') : kerProj G v w = w ↔ fderiv ℝ G v w = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have := fderiv_kerProj hv w
    rwa [h] at this
  · exact kerProj_of_fderiv_eq_zero

name: Submission.adjointCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma adjointCLM_apply (A : E' →L[ℝ] F) :
    adjointCLM A = ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.contDiff_fderivCLM
statement:
lemma contDiff_fderivCLM {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :

proof:

name: Submission.contDiff_adjointFderiv
statement:
lemma contDiff_adjointFderiv {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun w => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G w))
proof:

  have h := (adjointCLM (n := n)).contDiff.comp (contDiff_fderivCLM hG)

name: Submission.contDiff_gramCLM
statement:
lemma contDiff_gramCLM {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (gramCLM G)
proof:
:= by
  have h := ContDiff.clm_comp (contDiff_fderivCLM hG) (contDiff_adjointFderiv hG)

name: Submission.contDiffAt_kerProj
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_kerProj {G : E' → F} {v : E'} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (hv : Surjective (fderiv ℝ G v)) : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (kerProj G) v
proof:
:= by
  have hD : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ G) v := (contDiff_fderivCLM hG).contDiffAt
  have hAdj : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G w)) v :=
    (contDiff_adjointFderiv hG).contDiffAt
  have hginv : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => Ring.inverse (gramCLM G w)) v := by
    have hu := isUnit_gramCLM hv
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Ring.inverse (M₀ := F →L[ℝ] F)) (gramCLM G v) := by
      have := contDiffAt_ringInverse ℝ (n := (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞)) hu.unit
      rwa [hu.unit_spec] at this
    exact h1.comp v (contDiff_gramCLM hG).contDiffAt
  have h := ContDiffAt.sub
    (contDiffAt_const (c := ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))))
    (hAdj.clm_comp (hginv.clm_comp hD))
  exact h

name: Submission.contDiffAt_kerProj_timeVec
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_kerProj_timeVec {G : E' → F} {v : E'} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)

name: Submission.isOpen_slabRegularSet
statement:
lemma isOpen_slabRegularSet {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    IsOpen (slabRegularSet G)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
  rintro v ⟨hsurj, hne⟩
  have h1 : {w : E' | IsUnit (gramCLM G w)} ∈ 𝓝 v := by
    have hopen : IsOpen {w : E' | IsUnit (gramCLM G w)} :=
      Units.isOpen.preimage (contDiff_gramCLM hG).continuous
    exact hopen.mem_nhds (isUnit_gramCLM hsurj)
  have h2 : {w : E' | kerProj G w timeVec ≠ 0} ∈ 𝓝 v := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt (fun w => kerProj G w timeVec) v :=
      (contDiffAt_kerProj_timeVec hG hsurj).continuousAt
    have hmem : ({0}ᶜ : Set E') ∈ 𝓝 (kerProj G v timeVec) :=
      isOpen_compl_singleton.mem_nhds hne
    exact hc.preimage_mem_nhds hmem
  filter_upwards [h1, h2] with w hw1 hw2
  exact ⟨surjective_of_isUnit_gramCLM hw1, hw2⟩

name: Submission.contDiffAt_timeField
statement:
lemma contDiffAt_timeField {G : E' → F} {v : E'} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (hv : v ∈ slabRegularSet G) : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (timeField G) v
proof:
:= by
  have hP : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => kerProj G w timeVec) v :=
    contDiffAt_kerProj_timeVec hG hv.1
  have hinner : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => ⟪(timeVec : E'), kerProj G w timeVec⟫) v :=
    ContDiffAt.inner ℝ contDiffAt_const hP
  have hval : ⟪(timeVec : E'), kerProj G v timeVec⟫ ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt (inner_timeVec_kerProj_pos hv)
  exact (hinner.inv hval).smul hP

name: Submission.spatialDeriv_apply
statement:
lemma spatialDeriv_apply (G : E' → F) (v : E') (x : E₁) :
    spatialDeriv G v x = fderiv ℝ G v (spaceInclL x)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.kerProj_timeVec_eq_zero_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · 
    
    intro h0 hs
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hs (fderiv ℝ G v timeVec)
    set u : E' := timeVec - spaceInclL x with hu
    have hDu : fderiv ℝ G v u = 0 := by
      rw [hu, map_sub, ← spatialDeriv_apply, hx, sub_self]
    have hPu : kerProj G v u = u := kerProj_of_fderiv_eq_zero hDu
    have htu : ⟪timeVec, u⟫ = 1 := by
      rw [inner_timeVec, hu, tcoord_sub, tcoord_timeVec, tcoord_spaceInclL, sub_zero]
    have hcontra : (1 : ℝ) = 0 := by
      calc (1 : ℝ) = ⟪timeVec, u⟫ := htu.symm
        _ = ⟪timeVec, kerProj G v u⟫ := by rw [hPu]
        _ = ⟪kerProj G v timeVec, u⟫ := (inner_kerProj_left hv _ _).symm
        _ = 0 := by rw [h0, inner_zero_left]
    norm_num at hcontra
  · 
    
    intro hns
    by_contra hne
    apply hns
    intro y
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hv y
    set u : E' := kerProj G v timeVec with hudef
    have hDu : fderiv ℝ G v u = 0 := fderiv_kerProj hv timeVec
    have htu : tcoord u ≠ 0 := by
      rw [← inner_timeVec, hudef, inner_timeVec_kerProj_timeVec hv]
      have h : 0 < ‖kerProj G v timeVec‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
      positivity
    set w' : E' := w - (tcoord w / tcoord u) • u with hw'def
    have hDw' : fderiv ℝ G v w' = y := by
      rw [hw'def, map_sub, map_smul, hDu, smul_zero, sub_zero, hw]
    have htw' : tcoord w' = 0 := by
      rw [hw'def, tcoord_sub, tcoord_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ _ htu, sub_self]
    refine ⟨spacePart w', ?_⟩
    rw [spatialDeriv_apply, spaceInclL_spacePart htw', hDw']

name: Submission.mem_slabRegularSet_of_spatial_surjective
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hv, ?_⟩
  intro h0
  exact (kerProj_timeVec_eq_zero_iff hv).mp h0 hs

name: Submission.sliceRegular_iff_notMem_criticalTimes
statement:
lemma sliceRegular_iff_notMem_criticalTimes (G : E' → F) (t : ℝ) :
    sliceRegular G t ↔ t ∉ criticalTimes G
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro h ⟨v, ⟨hf, hns⟩, rfl⟩
    exact hns (h v hf rfl)
  · intro h v hf ht
    by_contra hns
    exact h ⟨v, ⟨hf, hns⟩, ht⟩

name: Submission.regularSlab.sliceRegular
statement:
lemma regularSlab.sliceRegular {G : E' → F} {a b : ℝ} (h : regularSlab G a b)

proof:

name: Submission.contDiff_sliceMap
statement:
lemma contDiff_sliceMap {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (t : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (sliceMap G t)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E₁ => spaceTime x t) := by
    have heq : (fun x : E₁ => spaceTime x t) = fun x => spaceInclL x + t • timeVec :=
      funext fun x => spaceTime_eq x t
    rw [heq]
    apply ContDiff.add
    · exact (spaceInclL (n := n)).contDiff
    · exact contDiff_const
  exact hG.comp h1

name: Submission.fderiv_sliceMap
statement:
lemma fderiv_sliceMap {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (t : ℝ) (x : E₁) :
    fderiv ℝ (sliceMap G t) x = spatialDeriv G (spaceTime x t)
proof:
:= by
  have hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun y : E₁ => spaceTime y t) x :=
    (hasFDerivAt_cobSpaceTime t x).differentiableAt
  have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ G (spaceTime x t) :=
    (hG.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
  have h := fderiv_comp x hg hf
  rw [(hasFDerivAt_cobSpaceTime t x).fderiv] at h
  exact h

name: Submission.isBounded_sliceFiber
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hb
  apply isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr
  refine ⟨C, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hmem : spaceTime x t ∈ {v | G v = 0} := hx
  simpa using hC (spaceTime x t) hmem

name: Submission.contDiff_sliceGrad
statement:
lemma contDiff_sliceGrad {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (i : Fin n) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E₁ => gradVec (sliceMap G p.1) i p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun p : ℝ × E₁ => gradVec (sliceMap G p.1) i p.2)
      = fun p : ℝ × E₁ => (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ
          (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))).symm
          ((EuclideanSpace.proj i).comp (spatialDeriv G (spaceTime p.2 p.1))) := by
    funext p
    rw [gradVec, fderiv_sliceMap hG]
  rw [heq]
  apply (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ
    (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))).symm.contDiff.comp
  have hst : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E₁ => fderiv ℝ G (spaceTime p.2 p.1)) := by
    have h := (contDiff_fderivCLM hG).comp contDiff_spaceTime_pair
    exact h
  have hsd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E₁ => spatialDeriv G (spaceTime p.2 p.1)) := by
    have h := hst.clm_comp (contDiff_const (c := spaceInclL (n := n)))
    exact h
  have h2 : (fun p : ℝ × E₁ =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp (spatialDeriv G (spaceTime p.2 p.1)))
      = fun p : ℝ × E₁ => (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
          (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj i))
          (spatialDeriv G (spaceTime p.2 p.1)) := rfl
  rw [h2]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.contDiff _).comp hsd

name: Submission.contDiff_sliceKerCross
statement:
lemma contDiff_sliceKerCross {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :

name: Submission.continuousAt_sliceTau
proof:
:= by
  have hne : kerCross (sliceMap G p.1) p.2 ≠ 0 :=
    (kerCross_ne_zero_iff _ _).mpr hp
  have hker : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × E₁ => kerCross (sliceMap G q.1) q.2) p :=
    (contDiff_sliceKerCross hG).continuous.continuousAt
  have hnorm : ContinuousAt
      (fun q : ℝ × E₁ => ‖kerCross (sliceMap G q.1) q.2‖⁻¹) p :=
    (hker.norm).inv₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hne)
  exact hnorm.smul hker

name: Submission.OrientedSaddleEndPairing.eq_flipSecond_or_eq_flipFirst
statement:
theorem eq_flipSecond_or_eq_flipFirst (P : OrientedSaddleEndPairing) :
    (∀ p, P.mate p = saddleEndFlipSecond p) ∨
      (∀ p, P.mate p = saddleEndFlipFirst p)
proof:
:= by
  have h00 := P.mate_involutive (false, false)
  have h01 := P.mate_involutive (false, true)
  have h10 := P.mate_involutive (true, false)
  have h11 := P.mate_involutive (true, true)
  have c00 := P.checker_reversing (false, false)
  have c01 := P.checker_reversing (false, true)
  have c10 := P.checker_reversing (true, false)
  have c11 := P.checker_reversing (true, true)
  rcases hP00 : P.mate (false, false) with ⟨a00, b00⟩
  rcases hP01 : P.mate (false, true) with ⟨a01, b01⟩
  rcases hP10 : P.mate (true, false) with ⟨a10, b10⟩
  rcases hP11 : P.mate (true, true) with ⟨a11, b11⟩
  cases a00 <;> cases b00 <;> cases a01 <;> cases b01 <;>
    cases a10 <;> cases b10 <;> cases a11 <;> cases b11 <;>
    simp_all [saddleEndChecker, saddleEndFlipSecond, saddleEndFlipFirst]

name: Submission.OrientedSaddleBranchEndPairing.eq_flipSecond_or_eq_flipFirst
statement:
theorem eq_flipSecond_or_eq_flipFirst (P : OrientedSaddleBranchEndPairing) :
    (∀ p, P.mate p = saddleBranchEndFlipSecond p) ∨
      (∀ p, P.mate p = saddleBranchEndFlipFirst p)
proof:
:= by
  have hnn := P.mate_involutive (.negative, .negative)
  have hnp := P.mate_involutive (.negative, .positive)
  have hpn := P.mate_involutive (.positive, .negative)
  have hpp := P.mate_involutive (.positive, .positive)
  have cnn := P.checker_reversing (.negative, .negative)
  have cnp := P.checker_reversing (.negative, .positive)
  have cpn := P.checker_reversing (.positive, .negative)
  have cpp := P.checker_reversing (.positive, .positive)
  rcases hPnn : P.mate (.negative, .negative) with ⟨ann, bnn⟩
  rcases hPnp : P.mate (.negative, .positive) with ⟨anp, bnp⟩
  rcases hPpn : P.mate (.positive, .negative) with ⟨apn, bpn⟩
  rcases hPpp : P.mate (.positive, .positive) with ⟨app, bpp⟩
  cases ann <;> cases bnn <;> cases anp <;> cases bnp <;>
    cases apn <;> cases bpn <;> cases app <;> cases bpp <;>
    simp_all [saddleBranchEndChecker, saddleBranchEndFlipSecond,
      saddleBranchEndFlipFirst, SaddleBranch.other]
  all_goals
    by_cases h : P.mate (SaddleBranch.negative, SaddleBranch.negative) =
        (SaddleBranch.negative, SaddleBranch.positive)
    · left
      intro a b
      cases a <;> cases b <;>
        simp_all
    · right
      intro a b
      cases a <;> cases b <;>
        simp_all

    Disjoint S.nonnegativeFiber S.nonpositiveFiber
