name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.nonempty
statement: theorem nonempty : Nonempty (PTCutoff S)
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen S.nonpositiveFiberᶜ :=
    S.isClosed_nonpositiveFiber.isOpen_compl
  have hsub : S.nonnegativeFiber ⊆ S.nonpositiveFiberᶜ := by
    intro x hp hn
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp S.disjoint_nonnegativeFiber_nonpositiveFiber hp hn
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδsub⟩ :=
    S.isCompact_nonnegativeFiber.exists_cthickening_subset_open hopen hsub
  let U : Set E := Metric.thickening δ S.nonnegativeFiber
  have hKU : S.nonnegativeFiber ⊆ U :=
    Metric.self_subset_thickening hδpos _
  have hUc : IsCompact (closure U) := by
    apply IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset S.isCompact_nonnegativeFiber.cthickening
      isClosed_closure
    exact closure_minimal
      (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _) Metric.isClosed_cthickening
  have hs : IsClosed Uᶜ := Metric.isOpen_thickening.isClosed_compl
  have hd : Disjoint Uᶜ S.nonnegativeFiber := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxU hxK
    exact hxU (hKU hxK)
  obtain ⟨χ, hχ0, hχ1, hχ01⟩ :=
    exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_of_isClosed
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) hs
      S.isClosed_nonnegativeFiber hd
  have hχsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (⇑χ) := by
    rw [← contMDiff_iff_contDiff]
    exact χ.contMDiff
  have hχsupport : HasCompactSupport (⇑χ) := by
    have hsupport : support (⇑χ) ⊆ U := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxU
      exact hx (hχ0 hxU)
    have htsupport : tsupport (⇑χ) ⊆ closure U :=
      closure_minimal (hsupport.trans subset_closure) isClosed_closure
    exact IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset hUc isClosed_closure htsupport
  refine ⟨⟨⇑χ, hχsmooth, hχ01, ?_, ?_, hχsupport⟩⟩
  · rintro x ⟨hxfib, hxpos⟩
    exact hχ1 ⟨hxfib, hxpos.le⟩
  · rintro x ⟨hxfib, hxneg⟩
    apply hχ0
    intro hxU
    exact hδsub (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _ hxU)
      ⟨hxfib, hxneg.le⟩

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.sphereMap_eq_signedPTNorthPole_iff
statement:
theorem sphereMap_eq_signedPTNorthPole_iff (κ : PTCutoff S) (x : E) :
    sphereMap S κ x =
        SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.signedPTNorthPole ↔
      x ∈ S.positivePart
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hmap
    have hnorm : 0 < ‖raw S κ x‖ :=
      norm_pos_iff.mpr (raw_ne_zero S κ x)
    have hcoe : ‖raw S κ x‖⁻¹ • raw S κ x = eLast n := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val hmap
      simpa [sphereMap_coe,
        SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.signedPTNorthPole] using this
    have hraw : raw S κ x = ‖raw S κ x‖ • eLast n := by
      calc
        raw S κ x = ‖raw S κ x‖ •
            (‖raw S κ x‖⁻¹ • raw S κ x) := by
              rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hnorm.ne', one_smul]
        _ = ‖raw S κ x‖ • eLast n := by rw [hcoe]
    have hlast := congrArg (fun z : E => z (Fin.last n)) hraw
    rw [raw_last] at hlast
    have hlast' : 2 * κ x - 1 = ‖raw S κ x‖ := by
      simpa [PiLp.smul_apply, eLast] using hlast
    have hκpos : 0 < κ x := by linarith
    have hinit := congrArg (initCLM n) hraw
    rw [initCLM_raw, map_smul, initCLM_eLast, smul_zero] at hinit
    have hg : X.g x = 0 :=
      (smul_eq_zero.mp hinit).resolve_left hκpos.ne'
    refine ⟨hg, ?_⟩
    by_contra hSpos
    have hSneg : S x < 0 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hSpos) (S.nonzero x hg)
    have hκzero := κ.negative_zero x ⟨hg, hSneg⟩
    linarith
  · exact sphereMap_of_positivePart S κ

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.normalizedHorizontalRaw_eq
statement:
lemma normalizedHorizontalRaw_eq (κ : PTCutoff S) (x : E) :
    normalizedHorizontalRaw S κ x =
      (‖raw S κ x‖⁻¹ * κ x) • X.g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalizedHorizontalRaw, map_smul, initCLM_raw, smul_smul]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.fderiv_normalizedHorizontalRaw_of_positivePart
statement:
theorem fderiv_normalizedHorizontalRaw_of_positivePart
    (κ : PTCutoff S) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ S.positivePart) :
    fderiv ℝ (normalizedHorizontalRaw S κ) x = fderiv ℝ X.g x
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : normalizedHorizontalRaw S κ = fun q =>
      (‖raw S κ q‖⁻¹ * κ q) • X.g q := by
    funext q
    exact normalizedHorizontalRaw_eq S κ q
  rw [hfun]
  have hraw0 : raw S κ x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [raw_of_positivePart S κ hx]
    exact (norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (by rw [norm_eLast]; norm_num))
  have hrnorm : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q => ‖raw S κ q‖) x :=
    (contDiff_raw S κ).differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt |>.norm
      ℝ hraw0
  have hscalar : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun q => ‖raw S κ q‖⁻¹ * κ q) x :=
    (hrnorm.inv (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hraw0)).mul
      (κ.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt)
  have hGd : DifferentiableAt ℝ X.g x :=
    X.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  rw [fderiv_fun_smul hscalar hGd, hx.1, raw_of_positivePart S κ hx,
    norm_eLast, κ.positive_one x hx]
  simp

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.surjective_fderiv_normalizedHorizontalRaw_of_positivePart
statement:
theorem surjective_fderiv_normalizedHorizontalRaw_of_positivePart
    (κ : PTCutoff S) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ S.positivePart) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (normalizedHorizontalRaw S κ) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fderiv_normalizedHorizontalRaw_of_positivePart S κ hx]
  exact X.regular x hx.1

name: Submission.StandardBirth.fderiv_circleMap_apply_castSucc
statement:
theorem fderiv_circleMap_apply_castSucc (a : ℝ) (x h : E) (j : Fin m) :
    fderiv ℝ (circleMap m a) x h j.castSucc = h j.castSucc.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc
  let inProj : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc.castSucc
  have hG : HasFDerivAt (circleMap m a) (fderiv ℝ (circleMap m a) x) x :=
    ((contDiff_circleMap m a).differentiable infty_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun w => circleMap m a w j.castSucc)
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (circleMap m a) x)) x := by
    exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (circleMap m a x) j.castSucc).comp x hG
  have hcoord : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E => w j.castSucc.castSucc) inProj x :=
    inProj.hasFDerivAt
  have hfun : (fun w => circleMap m a w j.castSucc) =
      fun w : E => w j.castSucc.castSucc := by
    funext w
    simp [circleMap]
  have hmaps : outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (circleMap m a) x) = inProj := by
    rw [← hcomp.fderiv, hfun, hcoord.fderiv]
  exact congrArg (fun A : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => A h) hmaps

name: Submission.StandardBirth.fderiv_circleMap_apply_last
statement:
theorem fderiv_circleMap_apply_last (a : ℝ) (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (circleMap m a) x h (Fin.last m) =
      2 * x (radialFirst m) * h (radialFirst m) +
        2 * x (radialSecond m) * h (radialSecond m)
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last m)
  have hG : HasFDerivAt (circleMap m a) (fderiv ℝ (circleMap m a) x) x :=
    ((contDiff_circleMap m a).differentiable infty_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun w => circleMap m a w (Fin.last m))
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (circleMap m a) x)) x := by
    exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (circleMap m a x) (Fin.last m)).comp x hG
  have hfun : (fun w => circleMap m a w (Fin.last m)) = fun w : E =>
      w (radialFirst m) ^ 2 + w (radialSecond m) ^ 2 - a := by
    funext w
    simp [circleMap, radialSq]
  have happ := congrArg (fun A : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => A h) hcomp.fderiv.symm
  rw [hfun] at happ
  let pA : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (radialFirst m)
  let pB : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (radialSecond m)
  have hA := (pA.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt pA pA x).pow 2
  have hB := (pB.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt pB pB x).pow 2
  have hdirect := (hA.add hB).sub (hasFDerivAt_const a x)
  have hscalarEq :
      (((fun z => pA z ^ 2) + fun z => pB z ^ 2) - fun _ : E => a) =
        (fun w : E =>
          w (radialFirst m) ^ 2 + w (radialSecond m) ^ 2 - a) := by
    funext w
    rfl
  rw [hscalarEq] at hdirect
  rw [hdirect.fderiv] at happ
  simpa [outProj, pA, pB, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using happ

name: Submission.StandardBirth.gradVec_circleMap_castSucc
statement:
theorem gradVec_circleMap_castSucc (a : ℝ) (x : E) (j : Fin m) :
    gradVec (circleMap m a) j.castSucc x =
      EuclideanSpace.single j.castSucc.castSucc 1
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right_basis (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (m + 2)) ℝ).toBasis
  intro k
  simp only [OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  change ⟪gradVec (circleMap m a) j.castSucc x,
      EuclideanSpace.single k 1⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪EuclideanSpace.single j.castSucc.castSucc 1,
      EuclideanSpace.single k 1⟫_ℝ
  rw [inner_gradVec, fderiv_circleMap_apply_castSucc]
  simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, PiLp.single_apply]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.gradVec_circleMap_last
statement:
theorem gradVec_circleMap_last (a : ℝ) (x : E) :
    gradVec (circleMap m a) (Fin.last m) x =
      (((2 : ℝ) * x (radialFirst m)) •
        EuclideanSpace.single (radialFirst m) 1) +
      (((2 : ℝ) * x (radialSecond m)) •
        EuclideanSpace.single (radialSecond m) 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right_basis (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (m + 2)) ℝ).toBasis
  intro k
  simp only [OrthonormalBasis.coe_toBasis, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply]
  change ⟪gradVec (circleMap m a) (Fin.last m) x,
      EuclideanSpace.single k 1⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪(((2 : ℝ) * x (radialFirst m)) •
        EuclideanSpace.single (radialFirst m) 1) +
      (((2 : ℝ) * x (radialSecond m)) •
        EuclideanSpace.single (radialSecond m) 1),
      EuclideanSpace.single k 1⟫_ℝ
  rw [inner_gradVec, fderiv_circleMap_apply_last]
  rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
    EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  simp [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left, PiLp.single_apply]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.tangentPoint_apply_radialFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem tangentPoint_apply_radialFirst (theta : ℝ) :
    tangentPoint m theta (radialFirst m) = -Real.sin theta
proof:
:= by
  have hAB : radialFirst m ≠ radialSecond m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [radialFirst, radialSecond] at this
  simp [tangentPoint, hAB]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.tangentPoint_apply_radialSecond
statement:
@[simp] theorem tangentPoint_apply_radialSecond (theta : ℝ) :
    tangentPoint m theta (radialSecond m) = Real.cos theta
proof:
:= by
  have hBA : radialSecond m ≠ radialFirst m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [radialFirst, radialSecond] at this
  simp [tangentPoint, hBA]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.tangentPoint_apply_transverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem tangentPoint_apply_transverse (theta : ℝ) (j : Fin m) :
    tangentPoint m theta j.castSucc.castSucc = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hjA : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ radialFirst m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [radialFirst] at this
    omega
  have hjB : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ radialSecond m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [radialSecond] at this
    omega
  simp [tangentPoint, hjA, hjB]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.norm_tangentPoint
statement: theorem norm_tangentPoint (theta : ℝ) : ‖tangentPoint m theta‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)]
  rw [normSq_eq_sum_sq]
  have hsum : (∑ j, tangentPoint m theta j ^ 2) =
      (-Real.sin theta) ^ 2 + (Real.cos theta) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    change (∑ j : Fin (m + 1), tangentPoint m theta j.castSucc ^ 2) +
      tangentPoint m theta (radialSecond m) ^ 2 = _
    rw [tangentPoint_apply_radialSecond]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    change (∑ j : Fin m, tangentPoint m theta j.castSucc.castSucc ^ 2) +
      tangentPoint m theta (radialFirst m) ^ 2 + Real.cos theta ^ 2 = _
    rw [tangentPoint_apply_radialFirst]
    simp [tangentPoint_apply_transverse]
  rw [hsum]
  nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.norm_circlePoint
statement: theorem norm_circlePoint (theta : ℝ) : ‖circlePoint m theta‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← sq_eq_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) (by norm_num)]
  rw [normSq_eq_sum_sq]
  have hsum : (∑ j, circlePoint m theta j ^ 2) =
      (Real.cos theta) ^ 2 + (Real.sin theta) ^ 2 := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    change (∑ j : Fin (m + 1), circlePoint m theta j.castSucc ^ 2) +
      circlePoint m theta (radialSecond m) ^ 2 = _
    rw [circlePoint_apply_radialSecond]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    change (∑ j : Fin m, circlePoint m theta j.castSucc.castSucc ^ 2) +
      circlePoint m theta (radialFirst m) ^ 2 + Real.sin theta ^ 2 = _
    rw [circlePoint_apply_radialFirst]
    simp [circlePoint_apply_transverse]
  rw [hsum]
  nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.inner_tangentPoint_circlePoint
statement:
theorem inner_tangentPoint_circlePoint (theta : ℝ) :
    ⟪tangentPoint m theta, circlePoint m theta⟫_ℝ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  change (∑ j : Fin (m + 1),
      circlePoint m theta j.castSucc * tangentPoint m theta j.castSucc) +
    circlePoint m theta (radialSecond m) *
      tangentPoint m theta (radialSecond m) = 0
  rw [tangentPoint_apply_radialSecond, circlePoint_apply_radialSecond]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  change (∑ j : Fin m, circlePoint m theta j.castSucc.castSucc *
      tangentPoint m theta j.castSucc.castSucc) +
    circlePoint m theta (radialFirst m) * tangentPoint m theta (radialFirst m) +
      Real.sin theta * Real.cos theta = 0
  rw [tangentPoint_apply_radialFirst, circlePoint_apply_radialFirst]
  simp [tangentPoint_apply_transverse, circlePoint_apply_transverse]
  ring

name: Submission.StandardBirth.inner_transverse_tangentPoint
statement:
theorem inner_transverse_tangentPoint (theta : ℝ) (j : Fin m) :
    ⟪EuclideanSpace.single j.castSucc.castSucc 1,
      tangentPoint m theta⟫_ℝ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  simp

name: Submission.StandardBirth.inner_transverse_circlePoint
statement:
theorem inner_transverse_circlePoint (theta : ℝ) (j : Fin m) :
    ⟪EuclideanSpace.single j.castSucc.castSucc 1,
      circlePoint m theta⟫_ℝ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  simp

name: Submission.StandardBirth.inner_transverse_transverse
statement:
theorem inner_transverse_transverse (j k : Fin m) :
    ⟪EuclideanSpace.single j.castSucc.castSucc (1 : ℝ),
      EuclideanSpace.single k.castSucc.castSucc (1 : ℝ)⟫_ℝ =
        if j = k then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.inner_single_left]
  by_cases h : j = k
  · subst k
    simp
  · have hcast : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ k.castSucc.castSucc := by
      intro heq
      apply h
      apply Fin.ext
      have hv : (j.castSucc.castSucc : Fin (m + 2)).val =
          (k.castSucc.castSucc : Fin (m + 2)).val :=
        congrArg (fun z : Fin (m + 2) => z.val) heq
      exact hv
    simp [h, hcast]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.normalUnit_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalUnit_last (theta : ℝ) :
    normalUnit m theta (Fin.last m) = circlePoint m theta
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalUnit]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.normalUnit_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalUnit_castSucc (theta : ℝ) (j : Fin m) :
    normalUnit m theta j.castSucc =
      EuclideanSpace.single j.castSucc.castSucc 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [normalUnit]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.orthonormal_normalUnit
statement:
theorem orthonormal_normalUnit (theta : ℝ) :
    Orthonormal ℝ (normalUnit m theta)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  intro i j
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          rw [normalUnit_last, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, norm_circlePoint]
          simp
      | cast j =>
          rw [normalUnit_last, normalUnit_castSucc, real_inner_comm,
            inner_transverse_circlePoint]
          simp [Fin.castSucc_lt_last j |>.ne']
  | cast i =>
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          rw [normalUnit_castSucc, normalUnit_last,
            inner_transverse_circlePoint]
          simp [Fin.castSucc_lt_last i |>.ne]
      | cast j =>
          rw [normalUnit_castSucc, normalUnit_castSucc,
            inner_transverse_transverse]
          simp

name: Submission.StandardBirth.orthonormal_unitFrame
statement:
theorem orthonormal_unitFrame (theta : ℝ) :
    Orthonormal ℝ (unitFrame m theta)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  intro i j
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · rw [unitFrame, Fin.cons_zero, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
        norm_tangentPoint]
      simp
    · induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          rw [unitFrame, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, normalUnit_last,
            inner_tangentPoint_circlePoint]
          simp
      | cast j =>
          rw [unitFrame, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, normalUnit_castSucc,
            real_inner_comm, inner_transverse_tangentPoint]
          simp only [if_neg (Fin.succ_ne_zero j.castSucc).symm]
  · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          rw [unitFrame, Fin.cons_succ, normalUnit_last, Fin.cons_zero,
            real_inner_comm, inner_tangentPoint_circlePoint]
          simp
      | cast i =>
          rw [unitFrame, Fin.cons_succ, normalUnit_castSucc, Fin.cons_zero,
            inner_transverse_tangentPoint]
          simp
    · rw [unitFrame, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ]
      simpa only [Fin.succ_inj] using
        orthonormal_iff_ite.mp (orthonormal_normalUnit m theta) i j

name: Submission.StandardBirth.tangentPoint_rotation
statement:
theorem tangentPoint_rotation (theta : ℝ) :
    tangentPoint m theta =
      Real.cos theta • tangentPoint m 0 -
        Real.sin theta • circlePoint m 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext j
  change tangentPoint m theta j =
    (Real.cos theta • tangentPoint m 0 -
      Real.sin theta • circlePoint m 0) j
  simp [tangentPoint, circlePoint, Pi.single_apply, smul_smul]
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: Submission.StandardBirth.circlePoint_rotation
statement:
theorem circlePoint_rotation (theta : ℝ) :
    circlePoint m theta =
      Real.sin theta • tangentPoint m 0 +
        Real.cos theta • circlePoint m 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext j
  change circlePoint m theta j =
    (Real.sin theta • tangentPoint m 0 +
      Real.cos theta • circlePoint m 0) j
  simp [tangentPoint, circlePoint, Pi.single_apply, smul_smul]
  split_ifs <;> ring

name: Submission.StandardBirth.unitFrame_zero
statement:
theorem unitFrame_zero (theta : ℝ) :
    unitFrame m theta 0 = tangentPoint m theta
proof:
:= by
  simp [unitFrame]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.unitFrame_last
statement:
theorem unitFrame_last (theta : ℝ) :
    unitFrame m theta (Fin.last (m + 1)) = circlePoint m theta
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (Fin.last m).succ = (Fin.last (m + 1) : Fin (m + 2)) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  rw [← hs, unitFrame, Fin.cons_succ, normalUnit_last]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.unitFrame_middle_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Fin.eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi0
  induction k using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      exfalso
      apply hil
      apply Fin.ext
      simp
  | cast k =>
      simp [unitFrame, normalUnit]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.twistMat_mul_apply_birth
statement:
lemma twistMat_mul_apply_birth
    (theta : ℝ) (A : Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (a + 3)) :
    (twistMat a theta * A) i j =
      if i = 0 then
        Real.cos theta * A 0 j - Real.sin theta * A (Fin.last (a + 2)) j
      else if i = Fin.last (a + 2) then
        Real.sin theta * A 0 j + Real.cos theta * A (Fin.last (a + 2)) j
      else A i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    simp only [twistMat_entries, if_pos]
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using
      sum_two_ite (m := a) (Ne.symm (lastA_ne_zero (m := a)))
        (fun x => Real.cos theta * A x j)
        (fun x => -(Real.sin theta * A x j))
  · rw [if_neg hi0]
    by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (a + 2)
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      simp only [twistMat_entries, if_neg (lastA_ne_zero (m := a)), if_pos]
      simpa using
        sum_two_ite (m := a) (Ne.symm (lastA_ne_zero (m := a)))
          (fun x => Real.sin theta * A x j)
          (fun x => Real.cos theta * A x j)
    · rw [if_neg hil]
      simp only [twistMat_entries, if_neg hi0, if_neg hil]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
      · simp
      · intro c _ hc
        simp [hc]
      · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h

name: Submission.StandardBirth.rowsMatrix_unitFrame_rotation
statement:
theorem rowsMatrix_unitFrame_rotation (theta : ℝ) :
    rowsMatrix (unitFrame (a + 1) theta) =
      twistMat a theta * rowsMatrix (unitFrame (a + 1) 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [twistMat_mul_apply_birth]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    simp only [rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, unitFrame_zero]
    have hlast : unitFrame (a + 1) 0 (Fin.last (a + 2)) =
        circlePoint (a + 1) 0 := by
      exact unitFrame_last (a + 1) 0
    rw [hlast]
    have h := congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 3)) => v j)
      (tangentPoint_rotation (a + 1) theta)
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h
  · rw [if_neg hi0]
    by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (a + 2)
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      simp only [rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, unitFrame_last]
      have hzero : unitFrame (a + 1) 0 0 = tangentPoint (a + 1) 0 := by
        exact unitFrame_zero (a + 1) 0
      rw [hzero]
      have h := congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 3)) => v j)
        (circlePoint_rotation (a + 1) theta)
      simpa using h
    · rw [if_neg hil]
      simp only [rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 3)) => v j)
        (unitFrame_middle_eq_zero (a + 1) theta hi0 hil)

name: Submission.StandardBirth.det_twistMat
statement: theorem det_twistMat (theta : ℝ) : (twistMat a theta).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistMat, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose,
    det_swapRotMat]
  have hrot : (rotAmbient a theta).det = 1 := by
    rw [← rotBlock_eq_rotAmbient]
    exact (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp
      (rotBlock_mem (a + 3) theta)).2
  rw [hrot]
  ring

name: Submission.StandardBirth.det_rowsMatrix_unitFrame
statement:
theorem det_rowsMatrix_unitFrame (theta : ℝ) :
    (rowsMatrix (unitFrame (a + 1) theta)).det = unitFrameDet a
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowsMatrix_unitFrame_rotation, Matrix.det_mul, det_twistMat]
  simp [unitFrameDet]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.unitFrameDet_mul_self
statement: theorem unitFrameDet_mul_self : unitFrameDet a * unitFrameDet a = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hmul := rowsMatrix_mul_transpose_of_orthonormal
    (orthonormal_unitFrame (a + 1) 0)
  have hdet := congrArg Matrix.det hmul
  simpa [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, unitFrameDet] using hdet

name: Submission.StandardBirth.unitFrameDet_ne_zero
statement: theorem unitFrameDet_ne_zero : unitFrameDet a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hself := unitFrameDet_mul_self a
  rw [h, zero_mul] at hself
  norm_num at hself

name: Submission.StandardBirth.orientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
theorem orientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one :
    orientationSign a = 1 ∨ orientationSign a = -1
proof:
:= by
  unfold orientationSign
  split_ifs <;> simp

name: Submission.StandardBirth.abs_orientationSign
statement: theorem abs_orientationSign : |orientationSign a| = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases orientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one a with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: Submission.StandardBirth.orientationSign_ne_zero
statement: theorem orientationSign_ne_zero : orientationSign a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases orientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one a with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: Submission.StandardBirth.orientationSign_mul_unitFrameDet_pos
statement:
theorem orientationSign_mul_unitFrameDet_pos :
    0 < orientationSign a * unitFrameDet a
proof:
:= by
  unfold orientationSign
  split_ifs with hpos
  · simpa using hpos
  · have hneg : unitFrameDet a < 0 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.mp hpos) (unitFrameDet_ne_zero a)
    simpa using neg_pos.mpr hneg

name: Submission.StandardBirth.scaledNormal_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaledNormal_last (theta : ℝ) :
    scaledNormal a theta (Fin.last (a + 1)) =
      (2 : ℝ) • circlePoint (a + 1) theta
proof:
:= by
  simp [scaledNormal]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.scaledNormal_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] theorem scaledNormal_castSucc (theta : ℝ) (j : Fin (a + 1)) :
    scaledNormal a theta j.castSucc =
      EuclideanSpace.single j.castSucc.castSucc 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [scaledNormal]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.scaledFrame_eq_smul
statement:
theorem scaledFrame_eq_smul (theta : ℝ) (i : Fin (a + 3)) :
    scaledFrame a theta i =
      frameScale a i • unitFrame (a + 1) theta i
proof:
:= by
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · simp [scaledFrame, frameScale, unitFrame, lastA_ne_zero,
      orientationSign_ne_zero]
  · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
        have hs : (Fin.last (a + 1)).succ =
            (Fin.last (a + 2) : Fin (a + 3)) := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp
        rw [hs]
        simp [scaledFrame, frameScale, unitFrame, scaledNormal,
          normalUnit, lastA_ne_zero]
    | cast i =>
        have hi0 : (i.castSucc.succ : Fin (a + 3)) ≠ 0 :=
          (Fin.succ_ne_zero i.castSucc)
        have hil : (i.castSucc.succ : Fin (a + 3)) ≠ Fin.last (a + 2) := by
          intro h
          have hv := congrArg (fun z : Fin (a + 3) => z.val) h
          simp at hv
          omega
        simp [scaledFrame, frameScale, unitFrame, scaledNormal,
          normalUnit, hi0, hil]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.prod_frameScale
statement: theorem prod_frameScale : ∏ i, frameScale a i = 2 * orientationSign a
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold frameScale
  rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
  have hzero : (∏ i : Fin (a + 3),
      if i = 0 then orientationSign a else 1) = orientationSign a := by
    simp
  have hlast : (∏ i : Fin (a + 3),
      if i = Fin.last (a + 2) then (2 : ℝ) else 1) = 2 := by
    simp
  rw [hzero, hlast]
  ring

name: Submission.StandardBirth.rowsMatrix_scaledFrame
statement:
theorem rowsMatrix_scaledFrame (theta : ℝ) :
    rowsMatrix (scaledFrame a theta) =
      Matrix.of fun i j => frameScale a i *
        rowsMatrix (unitFrame (a + 1) theta) i j
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, scaledFrame_eq_smul]
  rfl

name: Submission.StandardBirth.det_rowsMatrix_scaledFrame
statement:
theorem det_rowsMatrix_scaledFrame (theta : ℝ) :
    (rowsMatrix (scaledFrame a theta)).det =
      2 * orientationSign a * unitFrameDet a
proof:
:= by
  rw [rowsMatrix_scaledFrame, Matrix.det_mul_column,
    prod_frameScale, det_rowsMatrix_unitFrame]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.det_rowsMatrix_scaledFrame_pos
statement:
theorem det_rowsMatrix_scaledFrame_pos (theta : ℝ) :
    0 < (rowsMatrix (scaledFrame a theta)).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [det_rowsMatrix_scaledFrame]
  nlinarith [orientationSign_mul_unitFrameDet_pos a]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.gradVec_target_circle
statement:
theorem gradVec_target_circle (theta : ℝ) (i : Fin (a + 2)) :
    gradVec (targetFLS (a + 1)).g i (circlePoint (a + 1) theta) =
      scaledNormal a theta i
proof:
:= by
  change gradVec (circleMap (a + 1) 1) i (circlePoint (a + 1) theta) = _
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      rw [gradVec_circleMap_last, scaledNormal_last]
      have hAB : radialFirst (a + 1) ≠ radialSecond (a + 1) := by
        intro h
        have := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [radialFirst, radialSecond] at this
      simp [circlePoint, hAB, hAB.symm, smul_add, smul_smul]
  | cast i =>
      rw [gradVec_circleMap_castSucc, scaledNormal_castSucc]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.fderiv_target_circle_oriented_tangent
statement:
theorem fderiv_target_circle_oriented_tangent (theta : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (targetFLS (a + 1)).g (circlePoint (a + 1) theta)
        (orientationSign a • tangentPoint (a + 1) theta) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  change fderiv ℝ (circleMap (a + 1) 1) (circlePoint (a + 1) theta)
      (orientationSign a • tangentPoint (a + 1) theta) i = 0
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      rw [fderiv_circleMap_apply_last]
      simp
      ring
  | cast i =>
      rw [fderiv_circleMap_apply_castSucc]
      simp

name: Submission.StandardBirth.norm_oriented_tangent
statement:
theorem norm_oriented_tangent (theta : ℝ) :
    ‖orientationSign a • tangentPoint (a + 1) theta‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_orientationSign,
    norm_tangentPoint, one_mul]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.tauField_target_circle
statement:
theorem tauField_target_circle (theta : ℝ) :
    tauField (targetFLS (a + 1)).g (circlePoint (a + 1) theta) =
      orientationSign a • tangentPoint (a + 1) theta
proof:
:= by
  let X := targetFLS (a + 1)
  let x := circlePoint (a + 1) theta
  let q := orientationSign a • tangentPoint (a + 1) theta
  have hxFiber : x ∈ X.fiber := circlePoint_mem_target_fiber (a + 1) theta
  have hreg : x ∈ regularSet X.g := X.fiber_subset_regularSet hxFiber
  have hgrads : (fun i => gradVec X.g i x) = scaledNormal a theta := by
    funext i
    exact gradVec_target_circle a theta i
  have hdetQ : 0 < crossDet (fun i => gradVec X.g i x) q := by
    rw [hgrads]
    have hrows : crossRows (scaledNormal a theta) q =
        rowsMatrix (scaledFrame a theta) := by
      ext i j
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩ <;>
        simp [crossRows, rowsMatrix, scaledFrame, q]
    rw [crossDet, hrows]
    exact det_rowsMatrix_scaledFrame_pos a theta
  have hkernel : fderiv ℝ X.g x q = 0 :=
    fderiv_target_circle_oriented_tangent a theta
  have hmem : q ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {tauField X.g x} :=
    (fderiv_eq_zero_iff_mem_span_tauField hreg _).mp hkernel
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
  have hdetTau : 0 < crossDet (fun i => gradVec X.g i x) (tauField X.g x) :=
    crossDet_tauField_pos hreg
  have hdetEq := congrArg (crossDet (fun i => gradVec X.g i x)) hc
  rw [crossDet_smul] at hdetEq
  have hprod : 0 < c * crossDet (fun i => gradVec X.g i x) (tauField X.g x) := by
    rw [hdetEq]
    exact hdetQ
  have hcPos : 0 < c := by
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hprod with hp | hn
    · exact hp.1
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt hdetTau)) hn.2)
  have hnormEq := congrArg norm hc
  rw [norm_smul, norm_tauField hreg, mul_one, norm_oriented_tangent,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hcPos] at hnormEq
  have hcOne : c = 1 := hnormEq
  rw [hcOne, one_smul] at hc
  exact hc

name: Submission.StandardBirth.frameAt_target_circle
statement:
theorem frameAt_target_circle (theta : ℝ) :
    frameAt (targetFLS (a + 1)) (circlePoint (a + 1) theta) =
      scaledFrame a theta
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · rw [frameAt, Fin.cons_zero, scaledFrame, Fin.cons_zero,
      tauField_target_circle]
  · rw [frameAt, Fin.cons_succ, scaledFrame, Fin.cons_succ,
      gradVec_target_circle]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.gramSchmidtNormed_scaledFrame
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_scaledFrame (theta : ℝ) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (scaledFrame a theta) = orientedUnitFrame a theta
proof:
:= by
  have horth : Pairwise
      (fun i j => ⟪scaledFrame a theta i, scaledFrame a theta j⟫_ℝ = 0) := by
    intro i j hij
    rw [scaledFrame_eq_smul, scaledFrame_eq_smul,
      real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
      (orthonormal_unitFrame (a + 1) theta).2 hij, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  funext i
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed, gramSchmidt_of_orthogonal ℝ horth,
    scaledFrame_eq_smul, norm_smul,
    (orthonormal_unitFrame (a + 1) theta).1 i]
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · simp [frameScale, orientedUnitFrame, unitFrame, abs_orientationSign,
      orientationSign_ne_zero, smul_smul]
  · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
        have hs : (Fin.last (a + 1)).succ =
            (Fin.last (a + 2) : Fin (a + 3)) := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp
        rw [hs]
        simp [frameScale, orientedUnitFrame, unitFrame, smul_smul,
          lastA_ne_zero]
    | cast i =>
        have hi0 : (i.castSucc.succ : Fin (a + 3)) ≠ 0 :=
          Fin.succ_ne_zero i.castSucc
        have hil : (i.castSucc.succ : Fin (a + 3)) ≠ Fin.last (a + 2) := by
          intro h
          have hv := congrArg (fun z : Fin (a + 3) => z.val) h
          simp at hv
          omega
        simp [frameScale, orientedUnitFrame, unitFrame, hi0, hil]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_target_circle
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_target_circle (theta : ℝ) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
        (frameAt (targetFLS (a + 1)) (circlePoint (a + 1) theta)) =
      orientedUnitFrame a theta
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameAt_target_circle, gramSchmidtNormed_scaledFrame]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.orientedTangent_rotation
statement:
theorem orientedTangent_rotation (theta : ℝ) :
    orientationSign a • tangentPoint (a + 1) theta =
      Real.cos (orientationSign a * theta) •
          (orientationSign a • tangentPoint (a + 1) 0) -
        Real.sin (orientationSign a * theta) • circlePoint (a + 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases orientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one a with h | h
  · rw [h]
    simp only [one_mul, one_smul]
    exact tangentPoint_rotation (a + 1) theta
  · rw [h]
    simp only [neg_mul, neg_smul, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg, one_mul]
    rw [tangentPoint_rotation]
    module

name: Submission.StandardBirth.circlePoint_signed_rotation
statement:
theorem circlePoint_signed_rotation (theta : ℝ) :
    circlePoint (a + 1) theta =
      Real.sin (orientationSign a * theta) •
          (orientationSign a • tangentPoint (a + 1) 0) +
        Real.cos (orientationSign a * theta) • circlePoint (a + 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases orientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one a with h | h
  · rw [h]
    simp only [one_mul, one_smul]
    exact circlePoint_rotation (a + 1) theta
  · rw [h]
    simp only [neg_mul, neg_smul, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg, one_mul]
    rw [circlePoint_rotation]
    module

name: Submission.StandardBirth.orientedUnitFrame_zero
statement:
theorem orientedUnitFrame_zero (theta : ℝ) :
    orientedUnitFrame a theta 0 =
      orientationSign a • tangentPoint (a + 1) theta
proof:
:= by
  simp [orientedUnitFrame]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.orientedUnitFrame_last
statement:
theorem orientedUnitFrame_last (theta : ℝ) :
    orientedUnitFrame a theta (Fin.last (a + 2)) =
      circlePoint (a + 1) theta
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (Fin.last (a + 1)).succ =
      (Fin.last (a + 2) : Fin (a + 3)) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  rw [← hs, orientedUnitFrame, Fin.cons_succ, normalUnit_last]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.orientedUnitFrame_middle_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Fin.eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi0
  induction k using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      exfalso
      apply hil
      apply Fin.ext
      simp
  | cast k =>
      simp [orientedUnitFrame, normalUnit]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.rowsMatrix_orientedUnitFrame_rotation
statement:
theorem rowsMatrix_orientedUnitFrame_rotation (theta : ℝ) :
    rowsMatrix (orientedUnitFrame a theta) =
      twistMat a (orientationSign a * theta) *
        rowsMatrix (orientedUnitFrame a 0)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [twistMat_mul_apply_birth]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    simp only [rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, orientedUnitFrame_zero]
    have hlast : orientedUnitFrame a 0 (Fin.last (a + 2)) =
        circlePoint (a + 1) 0 := orientedUnitFrame_last a 0
    rw [hlast]
    have h := congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 3)) => v j)
      (orientedTangent_rotation a theta)
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h
  · rw [if_neg hi0]
    by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (a + 2)
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      simp only [rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply, orientedUnitFrame_last]
      have hzero : orientedUnitFrame a 0 0 =
          orientationSign a • tangentPoint (a + 1) 0 :=
        orientedUnitFrame_zero a 0
      rw [hzero]
      have h := congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 3)) => v j)
        (circlePoint_signed_rotation a theta)
      simpa using h
    · rw [if_neg hil]
      simp only [rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
      exact congrArg (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 3)) => v j)
        (orientedUnitFrame_middle_eq_zero a theta hi0 hil)

name: Submission.StandardBirth.birthFrameAngle_closed
statement:
theorem birthFrameAngle_closed :
    birthFrameAngle a 1 = birthFrameAngle a 0 +
      2 * Real.pi * birthFrameWinding a
proof:
:= by
  rcases orientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one a with h | h
  · rw [birthFrameWinding, if_pos h]
    simp [birthFrameAngle, h]
  · have hne : orientationSign a ≠ 1 := by rw [h]; norm_num
    rw [birthFrameWinding, if_neg hne]
    simp [birthFrameAngle, h]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.birthFrameWinding_mod_two
statement:
theorem birthFrameWinding_mod_two :
    (birthFrameWinding a : ZMod 2) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases orientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one a with h | h
  · simp [birthFrameWinding, h]
  · simp [birthFrameWinding, h]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.birthPlaneLoop_closed
statement: theorem birthPlaneLoop_closed : birthPlaneLoop a 0 = birthPlaneLoop a 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [birthPlaneLoop, ContinuousMap.mul_apply, ContinuousMap.const_apply]
  rw [(birthSO2AngleLoop a).frame_closed]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.birthPlaneLoop_coe
statement:
theorem birthPlaneLoop_coe (u : I) :
    (birthPlaneLoop a u : Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ) =
      twistMat a (birthFrameAngle a u)
proof:
:= by
  change swapRotMat a * rotBlock (a + 3) (birthFrameAngle a u) *
      (swapRotMat a)ᵀ = _
  rw [rotBlock_eq_rotAmbient]
  rfl

name: Submission.StandardBirth.loopClassZ2_birthPlaneLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_birthPlaneLoop :
    loopClassZ2 (birthPlaneLoop a) (birthPlaneLoop_closed a) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 3 ≤ a + 3 := by omega
  have hbase :
      loopClassZ2 ((birthSO2AngleLoop a).frame (a + 3))
          ((birthSO2AngleLoop a).frame_closed (a + 3)) = 1 := by
    rw [(birthSO2AngleLoop a).loopClassZ2_frame hr]
    change (birthFrameWinding a : ZMod 2) = 1
    exact birthFrameWinding_mod_two a
  have hconj := loopClassZ2_const_conj (swapRotSO a)
    ((birthSO2AngleLoop a).frame (a + 3))
    ((birthSO2AngleLoop a).frame_closed (a + 3))
  have hplane :
      loopClassZ2 (birthPlaneLoop a) (birthPlaneLoop_closed a) =
        loopClassZ2 ((birthSO2AngleLoop a).frame (a + 3))
          ((birthSO2AngleLoop a).frame_closed (a + 3)) := by
    simpa only [birthPlaneLoop] using hconj
  exact hplane.trans hbase

name: Submission.StandardBirth.paramFrameLoop_apply
statement:
theorem paramFrameLoop_apply (V : TamedField (targetFLS (a + 1))) (u : I) :
    ((simpleClosedOrbitParam (a + 1) V).paramFrameLoop u :
        Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ) =
      rowsMatrix (orientedUnitFrame a (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  change frameLoop (targetFLS (a + 1))
      (simpleClosedOrbitParam (a + 1) V).realCurve (u : ℝ) = _
  unfold frameLoop
  rw [(simpleClosedOrbitParam (a + 1) V).realCurve_coe]
  change rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
      (frameAt (targetFLS (a + 1))
        (circlePoint (a + 1) (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))) = _
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_target_circle]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.paramFrameLoop_eq_plane_mul_const
statement:
theorem paramFrameLoop_eq_plane_mul_const
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS (a + 1))) :
    (simpleClosedOrbitParam (a + 1) V).paramFrameLoop =
      birthPlaneLoop a * ContinuousMap.const I
        ((simpleClosedOrbitParam (a + 1) V).paramFrameLoop 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [paramFrameLoop_apply]
  change rowsMatrix (orientedUnitFrame a (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))) =
    (birthPlaneLoop a u : Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ) *
      ((simpleClosedOrbitParam (a + 1) V).paramFrameLoop 0 :
        Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ)
  rw [birthPlaneLoop_coe, paramFrameLoop_apply]
  simp only [Set.Icc.coe_zero, mul_zero]
  rw [rowsMatrix_orientedUnitFrame_rotation]
  congr 2

name: Submission.StandardBirth.unitCircle_paramFrameClass
statement:
theorem unitCircle_paramFrameClass (V : TamedField (targetFLS (a + 1))) :
    loopClassZ2 (simpleClosedOrbitParam (a + 1) V).paramFrameLoop
        (simpleClosedOrbitParam (a + 1) V).paramFrameLoop_closed = 1
proof:
:= by
  let P := simpleClosedOrbitParam (a + 1) V
  let R := birthPlaneLoop a * ContinuousMap.const I (P.paramFrameLoop 0)
  have hRclosed : R 0 = R 1 := by
    change birthPlaneLoop a 0 * P.paramFrameLoop 0 =
      birthPlaneLoop a 1 * P.paramFrameLoop 0
    rw [birthPlaneLoop_closed]
  have heq : P.paramFrameLoop = R :=
    paramFrameLoop_eq_plane_mul_const a V
  calc
    loopClassZ2 P.paramFrameLoop P.paramFrameLoop_closed =
        loopClassZ2 R hRclosed :=
      loopClassZ2_congr_fun P.paramFrameLoop_closed hRclosed heq
    _ = loopClassZ2 (birthPlaneLoop a) (birthPlaneLoop_closed a) := by
      exact loopClassZ2_mul_const_right (birthPlaneLoop a)
        (birthPlaneLoop_closed a) (P.paramFrameLoop 0)
    _ = 1 := loopClassZ2_birthPlaneLoop a

name: Submission.StandardBirth.targetSign_positiveDelta_eq_zero
statement:
theorem targetSign_positiveDelta_eq_zero
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS (a + 1))) :
    (targetSign (a + 1)).positiveDelta = 0
proof:
:=
  targetSign_positiveDelta_eq_zero_of_paramFrameClass (a + 1) V
    (unitCircle_paramFrameClass a V)

name: Submission.StandardBirth.source_target_positiveDelta_eq
statement:
theorem source_target_positiveDelta_eq
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS (a + 1))) :
    (sourceSign (a + 1)).positiveDelta =
      (targetSign (a + 1)).positiveDelta
proof:
:=
  source_target_positiveDelta_eq_of_paramFrameClass (a + 1) V
    (unitCircle_paramFrameClass a V)

name: Submission.StandardBirth.unitCircle_paramFrameClass_of_pos
statement:
theorem unitCircle_paramFrameClass_of_pos {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS m)) :
    loopClassZ2 (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop

name: Submission.saddleBandOctagonReading_split
statement:
theorem saddleBandOctagonReading_split
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (Hs : M.FullRadiusSmooth) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s rE : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius) (hErad : rE < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    {e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch} (hlab : e₁ ≠ e₂)
    (hne : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos ≠
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos)
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregpos hregneg Vpos Vneg
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos)
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos)
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg))
    (hprov : T.RebasedSplitBandProvenance hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos
      Vneg Vpos R F)
    (hconn : ∀ (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
      (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (dt : C(I, ℝ)),
      x₀ ∈ criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2) →
      x₀ = R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) (-(-(s ^ 2))) →
      (∀ w : I, |dt w| ≤ s ^ 2) →
      ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ w : I, ‖η w‖ ≤ rE) ∧
        (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.1 (η w 0)) ∧
        (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.2 (η w 1)) ∧
        (∀ w : I, M.localPoint (η w) = R.base.flow x₀ (dt w)))
    (harc₁ : ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ ρ) ∧
      ∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₁ F) u)
    (harc₅ : ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ ρ) ∧
      ∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₅ F) u) :
    SaddleBandOctagonReading T F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hb
  have hρM : ρ < M.radius := hρrad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hEM : rE < M.radius := hErad.trans_le T.radius_le
  obtain ⟨hdb, hda, hcut3, hafter3, hafter7, hafterEnd,
    ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩, ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩, ⟨p₂, hp₂⟩, ⟨p₃, hp₃⟩⟩ := hprov
  have hafterSpace : ∀ v : I,
      spacePart (((F.ambientAfterLoop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = F.afterParam.curve v := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientAfterLoop_coe v]
    exact spacePart_spaceTime _ _
  have hafterTime : ∀ v : I,
      tcoord (((F.ambientAfterLoop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = tcoord center - s ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientAfterLoop_coe v]
    exact tcoord_spaceTime _ _
  
  have hmem₃ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro u
    have h : ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop
          (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ u) :
          ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) := rfl
    rw [h, hafterSpace]
    exact hafter3 u
  have htime₃ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u) = tcoord center - s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    have h : ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop
          (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ u) :
          ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) := rfl
    rw [h, hafterTime]
  obtain ⟨eta₃, hn₃, hsg₃, hc₃⟩ :=
    T.exists_chartMap_sign_of_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment hindex .positive hρ
      hs0 hs hρrad (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F)) hmem₃ htime₃
  have hx₃ : ∀ u : I, 0 < eta₃ u 1 := fun u => hsg₃ u
  
  have harc₇val : ∀ u : I, ∃ v : I,
      ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop v : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) ∧
      F.afterParam.curve v ∈
        Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro u
    show ∃ v : I,
      ((((Submission.loopWrap F.ambientAfterLoop F.afterCut₃ F.afterCut₀) u :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = _ ∧ _
    rw [Submission.loopWrap, Path.trans_apply]
    split_ifs with hcase
    · refine ⟨Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₃ (1 : I) _, rfl, ?_⟩
      have hone : Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₃ (1 : I)
          (⟨2 * (u : ℝ), by constructor <;> [linarith [u.2.1]; linarith]⟩ : I)
            = (1 : I) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show (1 - (2 * (u : ℝ))) * (F.afterCut₃ : ℝ) + (2 * (u : ℝ)) * 1 = 1
        rw [hcut3]
        show (1 - (2 * (u : ℝ))) * (1 : ℝ) + (2 * (u : ℝ)) * 1 = 1
        ring
      rw [hone]
      exact hafterEnd
    · exact ⟨Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) F.afterCut₀ _, rfl, hafter7 _⟩
  have hmem₇ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F) u) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvmem⟩ := harc₇val u
    rw [hv, hafterSpace]
    exact hvmem
  have htime₇ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F) u) = tcoord center - s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := harc₇val u
    rw [hv, hafterTime]
  obtain ⟨eta₇, hn₇, hsg₇, hc₇⟩ :=
    T.exists_chartMap_sign_of_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment hindex .negative hρ
      hs0 hs hρrad (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F)) hmem₇ htime₇
  have hx₇ : ∀ u : I, eta₇ u 1 < 0 := fun u =>
    neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative (hsg₇ u)
  
  have hdtbound : ∀ w : I, |bandConnectorTime F w| ≤ s ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    rw [bandConnectorTime_apply, hdb, hda, abs_le]
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (w : ℝ) := w.2.1
    have h1 : (w : ℝ) ≤ 1 := w.2.2
    have hsq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ s ^ 2 := sq_nonneg s
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hdtbound' : ∀ w : I, |bandConnectorTimeRev F w| ≤ s ^ 2 := fun w =>
    hdtbound _
  
  obtain ⟨eta₂, hn₂, hq₂a, hq₂b, hc₂⟩ :=
    hconn p₁ (F.coreArc₁ 1) (bandConnectorTime F) (F.coreArc₁_mem 1) hp₁ hdtbound
  obtain ⟨eta₄, hn₄, hq₄a, hq₄b, hc₄⟩ :=
    hconn p₂ (F.coreArc₂ 0) (bandConnectorTimeRev F) (F.coreArc₂_mem 0) hp₂ hdtbound'
  obtain ⟨eta₆, hn₆, hq₆a, hq₆b, hc₆⟩ :=
    hconn p₃ (F.coreArc₂ 1) (bandConnectorTime F) (F.coreArc₂_mem 1) hp₃ hdtbound
  obtain ⟨eta₈, hn₈, hq₈a, hq₈b, hc₈⟩ :=
    hconn p₀ (F.coreArc₁ 0) (bandConnectorTimeRev F) (F.coreArc₁_mem 0) hp₀ hdtbound'
  
  obtain ⟨eta₁, hn₁, hc₁⟩ := harc₁
  obtain ⟨eta₅, hn₅, hc₅⟩ := harc₅
  have hbeforeSpace : ∀ v : I,
      spacePart (((F.ambientBefore₁Loop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = F.before₁Param.curve v := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₁Loop_coe v]
    exact spacePart_spaceTime _ _
  have hbeforeSpace₂ : ∀ v : I,
      spacePart (((F.ambientBefore₂Loop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = F.before₂Param.curve v := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₂Loop_coe v]
    exact spacePart_spaceTime _ _
  have hlvl₁ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      tcoord ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = tcoord center + s ^ 2)
      F.ambientBefore₁Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₁Loop_coe v]
    exact tcoord_spaceTime _ _
  have hlvl₂ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      tcoord ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = tcoord center + s ^ 2)
      F.ambientBefore₂Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₂Loop_coe v]
    exact tcoord_spaceTime _ _
  have hOrb₁ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      spacePart ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) F.ambientBefore₁Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [hbeforeSpace v, Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit _]
    exact (Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem F.before₁Param_orbit).ge
      (F.before₁Param.curve_mem_orbit v)
  have hOrb₂ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      spacePart ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) F.ambientBefore₂Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [hbeforeSpace₂ v, Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit _]
    exact (Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem F.before₂Param_orbit).ge
      (F.before₂Param.curve_mem_orbit v)
  have htime₁ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (M.localPoint (eta₁ u)) = tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₁ u]
    exact ((hlvl₁.loopWrap F.before₁Cut₁ F.before₁Cut₀).symm) u
  have htime₅ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (M.localPoint (eta₅ u)) = tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₅ u]
    exact ((hlvl₂.loopWrap F.before₂Cut₁ F.before₂Cut₀).symm) u
  have hmemO₁ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (M.localPoint (eta₁ u)) ∈
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
        Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₁ u]
    exact ((hOrb₁.loopWrap F.before₁Cut₁ F.before₁Cut₀).symm) u
  have hmemO₂ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (M.localPoint (eta₅ u)) ∈
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
        Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₅ u]
    exact ((hOrb₂.loopWrap F.before₂Cut₁ F.before₂Cut₀).symm) u
  have hnorm₁ : ∀ u : I, ‖eta₁ u‖ < M.radius := fun u => (hn₁ u).trans_lt hρM
  have hnorm₅ : ∀ u : I, ‖eta₅ u‖ < M.radius := fun u => (hn₅ u).trans_lt hρM
  have hsg : (∀ u : I, 0 < eta₁ u 0) ∨ (∀ u : I, eta₁ u 0 < 0) :=
    chartMap_after_fst_sign (M := M) hindex hs0 eta₁ hnorm₁ htime₁
  have htg : (∀ u : I, 0 < eta₅ u 0) ∨ (∀ u : I, eta₅ u 0 < 0) :=
    chartMap_after_fst_sign (M := M) hindex hs0 eta₅ hnorm₅ htime₅
  have hbranch₁ : ∀ b : SaddleBranch, 0 < signedBranch b (eta₁ 0 0) →
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos =
        T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos := by
    intro b hbsign
    have hmemb : spacePart (M.param (eta₁ 0)) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :=
      T.mem_saddlePositiveBranchOrbit_of_chartParam Hs hindex b ρ s (eta₁ 0)
        (chartParam_quadratic_after (M := M) hindex (hnorm₁ 0) (htime₁ 0))
        hbsign hρ hs hρrad (hnorm₁ 0) hregpos Vpos rfl
    by_contra hcon
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (Vpos.orbitFinset_pairwise_disjoint _
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos).property _
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos).property (fun h => hcon (Subtype.ext h)))
      (hmemO₁ 0) hmemb
  have hbranch₅ : ∀ b : SaddleBranch, 0 < signedBranch b (eta₅ 0 0) →
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos =
        T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos := by
    intro b hbsign
    have hmemb : spacePart (M.param (eta₅ 0)) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :=
      T.mem_saddlePositiveBranchOrbit_of_chartParam Hs hindex b ρ s (eta₅ 0)
        (chartParam_quadratic_after (M := M) hindex (hnorm₅ 0) (htime₅ 0))
        hbsign hρ hs hρrad (hnorm₅ 0) hregpos Vpos rfl
    by_contra hcon
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (Vpos.orbitFinset_pairwise_disjoint _
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos).property _
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos).property (fun h => hcon (Subtype.ext h)))
      (hmemO₂ 0) hmemb
  have hnoteq : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos =
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
        Vpos → False := by
    intro heq12
    cases e₁ <;> cases e₂ <;>
      first
        | exact hlab rfl
        | exact hne heq12
        | exact hne heq12.symm
  set r : ℝ := max ρ rE with hrdef
  have hr : r < T.radius := max_lt hρrad hErad
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  set P : OctagonPlacement T F r :=
    { eta₁ := eta₁, eta₂ := eta₂, eta₃ := eta₃, eta₄ := eta₄,
      eta₅ := eta₅, eta₆ := eta₆, eta₇ := eta₇, eta₈ := eta₈
      norm₁ := fun u => (hn₁ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
      norm₂ := fun u => (hn₂ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
      norm₃ := fun u => (hn₃ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
      norm₄ := fun u => (hn₄ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
      norm₅ := fun u => (hn₅ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
      norm₆ := fun u => (hn₆ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
      norm₇ := fun u => (hn₇ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
      norm₈ := fun u => (hn₈ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
      chart₁ := hc₁
      chart₂ := fun u => (hc₂ u).trans rfl
      chart₃ := hc₃
      chart₄ := fun u => (hc₄ u).trans rfl
      chart₅ := hc₅
      chart₆ := fun u => (hc₆ u).trans rfl
      chart₇ := hc₇
      chart₈ := fun u => (hc₈ u).trans rfl } with hPdef
  refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
  have j12 : eta₁ 1 = eta₂ 0 := P.join₁₂ hr
  have j23 : eta₂ 1 = eta₃ 0 := P.join₂₃ hr
  have j34 : eta₃ 1 = eta₄ 0 := P.join₃₄ hr
  have j45 : eta₄ 1 = eta₅ 0 := P.join₄₅ hr
  have j56 : eta₅ 1 = eta₆ 0 := P.join₅₆ hr
  have j67 : eta₆ 1 = eta₇ 0 := P.join₆₇ hr
  have j78 : eta₇ 1 = eta₈ 0 := P.join₇₈ hr
  have j81 : eta₈ 1 = eta₁ 0 := P.join₈₁ hr
  have hlq₁ : p₁.2 = .positive := by
    refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₂b 1) ?_
    rw [j23]; exact hx₃ 0
  have hlq₂ : p₂.2 = .positive := by
    refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₄b 0) ?_
    rw [← j34]; exact hx₃ 1
  have hlq₃ : p₃.2 = .negative := by
    refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₆b 1) ?_
    rw [j67]; exact hx₇ 0
  have hlq₀ : p₀.2 = .negative := by
    refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₈b 0) ?_
    rw [← j78]; exact hx₇ 1
  have hy₂ : ∀ u : I, 0 < eta₂ u 1 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₂b u; rw [hlq₁] at h; exact h
  have hy₄ : ∀ u : I, 0 < eta₄ u 1 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₄b u; rw [hlq₂] at h; exact h
  have hy₆ : ∀ u : I, eta₆ u 1 < 0 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₆b u; rw [hlq₃] at h
    exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
  have hy₈ : ∀ u : I, eta₈ u 1 < 0 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₈b u; rw [hlq₀] at h
    exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
  rcases hsg with hsg | hsg <;> rcases htg with htg | htg
  · exfalso
    refine hnoteq ?_
    rw [hbranch₁ .positive (hsg 0), hbranch₅ .positive (htg 0)]
  · 
    have hlp₁ : p₁.1 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₂a 0) ?_
      rw [← j12]; exact hsg 1
    have hlp₂ : p₂.1 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₄a 1) ?_
      rw [j45]; exact htg 0
    have hlp₃ : p₃.1 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₆a 0) ?_
      rw [← j56]; exact htg 1
    have hlp₀ : p₀.1 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₈a 1) ?_
      rw [j81]; exact hsg 0
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl
      ⟨hsg, ?_, hy₂, hx₃, ?_, hy₄, htg, ?_, hy₆, hx₇, ?_, hy₈⟩)))
    · intro u; have h := hq₂a u; rw [hlp₁] at h; exact h
    · intro u; have h := hq₄a u; rw [hlp₂] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
    · intro u; have h := hq₆a u; rw [hlp₃] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
    · intro u; have h := hq₈a u; rw [hlp₀] at h; exact h
  · 
    have hlp₁ : p₁.1 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₂a 0) ?_
      rw [← j12]; exact hsg 1
    have hlp₂ : p₂.1 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₄a 1) ?_
      rw [j45]; exact htg 0
    have hlp₃ : p₃.1 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₆a 0) ?_
      rw [← j56]; exact htg 1
    have hlp₀ : p₀.1 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₈a 1) ?_
      rw [j81]; exact hsg 0
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr
      ⟨hsg, ?_, hy₂, hx₃, ?_, hy₄, htg, ?_, hy₆, hx₇, ?_, hy₈⟩)))
    · intro u; have h := hq₂a u; rw [hlp₁] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
    · intro u; have h := hq₄a u; rw [hlp₂] at h; exact h
    · intro u; have h := hq₆a u; rw [hlp₃] at h; exact h
    · intro u; have h := hq₈a u; rw [hlp₀] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
  · exfalso
    refine hnoteq ?_
    rw [hbranch₁ .negative (by
        have := hsg 0
        show (0:ℝ) < -(eta₁ 0 0)
        linarith),
      hbranch₅ .negative (by
        have := htg 0
        show (0:ℝ) < -(eta₅ 0 0)
        linarith)]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.forwardQuot_zero
statement: theorem forwardQuot_zero : A.forwardQuot 0 = id
proof:
:= by
  funext q
  rcases q with ⟨a, z⟩
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  rw [A.forwardQuot_coe, A.forward_zero]
  rfl

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.quot_left_inv
statement:
theorem quot_left_inv (s : ℝ) :
    LeftInverse (A.inverseQuot s) (A.forwardQuot s)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  rcases q with ⟨a, z⟩
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  rw [A.forwardQuot_coe, A.inverseQuot_coe, A.left_inv]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.quot_right_inv
statement:
theorem quot_right_inv (s : ℝ) :
    RightInverse (A.inverseQuot s) (A.forwardQuot s)
proof:
:= by
  intro q
  rcases q with ⟨a, z⟩
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  rw [A.inverseQuot_coe, A.forwardQuot_coe, A.right_inv]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.forwardQuot_mem_tube
statement:
theorem forwardQuot_mem_tube (s : ℝ) (q : C × N)
    (hq : q.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius) :
    (A.forwardQuot s q).2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius
proof:
:= by
  rcases q with ⟨a, z⟩
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  rw [A.forwardQuot_coe]
  exact A.forward_mem_tube s u z hq

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.inverseQuot_mem_tube
statement:
theorem inverseQuot_mem_tube (s : ℝ) (q : C × N)

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.forwardQuot_eq_self_of_support_le
statement:
theorem forwardQuot_eq_self_of_support_le (s : ℝ) (q : C × N)
    (hq : A.supportRadius ≤ ‖q.2‖) :

proof:
:= by
  rcases q with ⟨a, z⟩
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  rw [A.forwardQuot_coe, A.forward_collar s u z hq]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.inverseQuot_eq_self_of_support_le
statement:
theorem inverseQuot_eq_self_of_support_le (s : ℝ) (q : C × N)

proof:
:= by

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.isClosed_supportCore
statement: theorem isClosed_supportCore : IsClosed A.supportCore
proof:
:= by
  have hcompact : IsCompact
      ((Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ
        Metric.closedBall (0 : N) A.supportRadius) :=
    isCompact_univ.prod (isCompact_closedBall (0 : N) A.supportRadius)
  exact (hcompact.image (V.continuous_orbitTube O)).isClosed

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.orbitTube_inverse_right
statement:
theorem orbitTube_inverse_right {x : E} (hx : x ∈ A.tubeImage) :
    V.orbitTube O ((V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse x) = x
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
  rw [(V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse_left q hq]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.inverse_mem_tubeDomain
statement:
theorem inverse_mem_tubeDomain {x : E} (hx : x ∈ A.tubeImage) :
    (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse x ∈ A.tubeDomain
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
  rw [(V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse_left q hq]
  exact hq

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.ambientForward_orbitTube
statement:
theorem ambientForward_orbitTube (s : ℝ) (q : C × N)
    (hq : q ∈ A.tubeDomain) :
    A.ambientForward s (V.orbitTube O q) =
      V.orbitTube O (A.forwardQuot s q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ambientForward, if_pos ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩,
    (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse_left q hq]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.ambientInverse_orbitTube
statement:
theorem ambientInverse_orbitTube (s : ℝ) (q : C × N)
    (hq : q ∈ A.tubeDomain) :
    A.ambientInverse s (V.orbitTube O q) =
      V.orbitTube O (A.inverseQuot s q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ambientInverse, if_pos ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩,
    (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse_left q hq]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.ambientForward_eq_self_of_not_mem_tubeImage
statement:
theorem ambientForward_eq_self_of_not_mem_tubeImage (s : ℝ) {x : E}
    (hx : x ∉ A.tubeImage) : A.ambientForward s x = x
proof:
:= by
  simp [ambientForward, hx]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.ambientInverse_eq_self_of_not_mem_tubeImage
statement:
theorem ambientInverse_eq_self_of_not_mem_tubeImage (s : ℝ) {x : E}

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.ambientForward_eq_self_of_not_mem_supportCore
statement:
theorem ambientForward_eq_self_of_not_mem_supportCore (s : ℝ) {x : E}
    (hx : x ∉ A.supportCore) : A.ambientForward s x = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : x ∈ A.tubeImage
  · let q : C × N := (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse x
    have hq : q ∈ A.tubeDomain := A.inverse_mem_tubeDomain ht
    have houter : A.supportRadius ≤ ‖q.2‖ := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hle : ‖q.2‖ ≤ A.supportRadius := le_of_not_ge hnot
      apply hx
      refine ⟨q, ⟨Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩, A.orbitTube_inverse_right ht⟩
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_left] using hle
    rw [ambientForward, if_pos ht,
      A.forwardQuot_eq_self_of_support_le s q houter,
      A.orbitTube_inverse_right ht]
  · exact A.ambientForward_eq_self_of_not_mem_tubeImage s ht

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.ambientInverse_eq_self_of_not_mem_supportCore
statement:
theorem ambientInverse_eq_self_of_not_mem_supportCore (s : ℝ) {x : E}
    (hx : x ∉ A.supportCore) : A.ambientInverse s x = x
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : x ∈ A.tubeImage
  · let q : C × N := (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse x
    have hq : q ∈ A.tubeDomain := A.inverse_mem_tubeDomain ht
    have houter : A.supportRadius ≤ ‖q.2‖ := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hle : ‖q.2‖ ≤ A.supportRadius := le_of_not_ge hnot
      apply hx
      refine ⟨q, ⟨Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩, A.orbitTube_inverse_right ht⟩
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_left] using hle
    rw [ambientInverse, if_pos ht,
      A.inverseQuot_eq_self_of_support_le s q houter,
      A.orbitTube_inverse_right ht]
  · exact A.ambientInverse_eq_self_of_not_mem_tubeImage s ht

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.ambient_left_inv
statement:
theorem ambient_left_inv (s : ℝ) :
    LeftInverse (A.ambientInverse s) (A.ambientForward s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ A.tubeImage
  · let q : C × N := (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse x
    have hq : q ∈ A.tubeDomain := A.inverse_mem_tubeDomain hx
    have hfq : A.forwardQuot s q ∈ A.tubeDomain :=
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, A.forwardQuot_mem_tube s q hq.2⟩
    rw [show A.ambientForward s x = V.orbitTube O (A.forwardQuot s q) by
      rw [ambientForward, if_pos hx]]
    rw [A.ambientInverse_orbitTube s (A.forwardQuot s q) hfq,
      A.quot_left_inv s q, A.orbitTube_inverse_right hx]
  · rw [A.ambientForward_eq_self_of_not_mem_tubeImage s hx,
      A.ambientInverse_eq_self_of_not_mem_tubeImage s hx]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.ambient_right_inv
statement:
theorem ambient_right_inv (s : ℝ) :
    RightInverse (A.ambientInverse s) (A.ambientForward s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ A.tubeImage
  · let q : C × N := (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse x
    have hq : q ∈ A.tubeDomain := A.inverse_mem_tubeDomain hx
    have hiq : A.inverseQuot s q ∈ A.tubeDomain :=
      ⟨Set.mem_univ _, A.inverseQuot_mem_tube s q hq.2⟩
    rw [show A.ambientInverse s x = V.orbitTube O (A.inverseQuot s q) by
      rw [ambientInverse, if_pos hx]]
    rw [A.ambientForward_orbitTube s (A.inverseQuot s q) hiq,
      A.quot_right_inv s q, A.orbitTube_inverse_right hx]
  · rw [A.ambientInverse_eq_self_of_not_mem_tubeImage s hx,
      A.ambientForward_eq_self_of_not_mem_tubeImage s hx]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.contDiffAt_joint_ambientForward_orbitTubeLift
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_joint_ambientForward_orbitTubeLift
    (s u : ℝ) (z : N)
    (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => A.ambientForward p.1 p.2)
      (s, V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, g₀, hf, hg₀, hg₀deriv, hg₀center, hg₀local⟩ :=
    (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).local_smooth_lift u z hz
  let chart : OpenPartialHomeomorph (ℝ × N) E :=
    (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).contDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph
      (V.orbitTubeLift O) hf (by simp)
  let g : E → ℝ × N := chart.symm
  have hsource : (u, z) ∈ chart.source := by
    exact (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).contDiffAt
      |>.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hf (by simp)
  have htarget : V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z) ∈ chart.target :=
    chart.map_source hsource
  have hgcenter : g (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z) := by
    change chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z)
    rw [← show (chart : (ℝ × N) → E) = V.orbitTubeLift O by rfl]
    exact chart.left_inv hsource
  have hforwardDeriv : HasFDerivAt chart
      (e : (ℝ × N) →L[ℝ] E)
      (chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z) by
      exact hgcenter]
    exact hf
  have hforwardSmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ chart
      (chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z) by
      exact hgcenter]
    exact (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).contDiffAt
  have hgsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g
      (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) := by
    exact chart.contDiffAt_symm htarget hforwardDeriv hforwardSmooth
  have hgball : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)),
      (g y).2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
        (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius := by
    have hg2continuous : ContinuousAt (fun y : E => (g y).2)
        (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) :=
      (show Continuous (fun p : ℝ × N => p.2) from continuous_snd)
        |>.continuousAt.comp' hgsmooth.continuousAt
    have hzcenter : (g (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z))).2 ∈
        Metric.ball (0 : N) (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius := by
      rw [hgcenter]
      exact hz
    exact hg2continuous.eventually
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzcenter)
  have hright : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)),
      V.orbitTubeLift O (g y) = y := by
    filter_upwards [chart.eventually_right_inverse htarget] with y hy
    exact hy
  have hlocal : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)), ∀ t : ℝ,
      A.ambientForward t y =
        V.orbitTubeLift O (A.forwardLift t (g y)) := by
    filter_upwards [hright, hgball] with y hy hgy t
    let q : C × N := (((g y).1 : C), (g y).2)
    have hq : q ∈ A.tubeDomain := ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hgy⟩
    have hyq : V.orbitTube O q = y := by
      rw [V.orbitTube_coe O (g y).1 (g y).2]
      exact hy
    have hytube : y ∈ A.tubeImage := ⟨q, hq, hyq⟩
    have hinv : (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse y = q := by
      rw [← hyq]
      exact (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse_left q hq
    rw [ambientForward, if_pos hytube, hinv, A.forwardQuot_coe,
      V.orbitTube_coe]
  have hpair : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => (p.1, g p.2))
      (s, V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) := by
    exact contDiffAt_fst.prodMk
      (hgsmooth.comp (s, V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z))
        (show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => p.2)
            (s, V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) from contDiffAt_snd))
  have hlift : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => A.forwardLift p.1 (g p.2))
      (s, V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) :=
    A.forwardLift_smooth.contDiffAt.comp _ hpair
  have hsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E =>
        V.orbitTubeLift O (A.forwardLift p.1 (g p.2)))
      (s, V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) :=
    (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).contDiffAt.comp _ hlift
  apply hsmooth.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  have hpull :=
    (show ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × E => p.2)
        (s, V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) from continuous_snd.continuousAt)
      |>.eventually hlocal
  filter_upwards [hpull] with p hp
  exact hp p.1

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.contDiff_joint_ambientForward
statement:
theorem contDiff_joint_ambientForward :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => A.ambientForward p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  rintro ⟨s, x⟩
  by_cases hx : x ∈ A.supportCore
  · rcases hx with ⟨⟨a, z⟩, hzcore, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
    have hzle : ‖z‖ ≤ A.supportRadius := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_left] using hzcore.2
    have hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
        (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_left] using
        (lt_of_le_of_lt hzle A.supportRadius_lt)
    simpa only [V.orbitTube_coe] using
      A.contDiffAt_joint_ambientForward_orbitTubeLift s u z hz
  · have hxcompl : x ∈ A.supportCoreᶜ := hx
    have hnear : A.supportCoreᶜ ∈ 𝓝 x :=
      A.isClosed_supportCore.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxcompl
    have hpull :=
      (show ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × E => p.2) (s, x) from
        continuous_snd.continuousAt) |>.eventually hnear
    apply (show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => p.2) (s, x) from
      contDiffAt_snd).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [hpull] with p hp
    exact A.ambientForward_eq_self_of_not_mem_supportCore p.1 hp

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy.ambientInverse_fderiv_surjective
statement:
theorem ambientInverse_fderiv_surjective (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    Surjective (fderiv ℝ (A.ambientInverse s) x)
proof:
:= by
  let f : E → E := A.ambientForward s
  let g : E → E := A.ambientInverse s
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f := A.contDiff_ambientForward_slice s
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g := A.contDiff_ambientInverse_slice s
  let y : E := g x
  have hfy : f y = x := A.ambient_right_inv s x
  have hgf : (fun z => g (f z)) = id := by
    funext z
    exact A.ambient_left_inv s z
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun z => g (f z))
      ((fderiv ℝ g (f y)).comp (fderiv ℝ f y)) y :=
    ((hg.differentiable (by simp) (f y)).hasFDerivAt.comp y
      (hf.differentiable (by simp) y).hasFDerivAt)
  rw [hgf] at hcomp
  have hderiv0 : (fderiv ℝ g (f y)).comp (fderiv ℝ f y) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E :=
    hcomp.fderiv.symm.trans (hasFDerivAt_id y).fderiv
  have hderiv : (fderiv ℝ g x).comp (fderiv ℝ f y) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E := by
    rwa [hfy] at hderiv0
  intro z
  refine ⟨fderiv ℝ f y z, ?_⟩
  have hz := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] E => L z) hderiv
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] using hz

name: Submission.CanonicalRotationField.addCircleCartesian_coe_real
statement:
theorem addCircleCartesian_coe_real (t : ℝ) :
    addCircleCartesian ((t : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) =
      (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * t), Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * t))
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change (((AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero
        ((t : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) : Circle) : ℂ).re) = _
    rw [AddCircle.homeomorphCircle_apply, AddCircle.toCircle_apply_mk,
      Circle.coe_exp, Complex.exp_mul_I]
    norm_num
    have harg : (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) =
        ((2 * Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ) := by norm_num
    rw [harg, Complex.cos_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_im]
    simp
  · change (((AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero
        ((t : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) : Circle) : ℂ).im) = _
    rw [AddCircle.homeomorphCircle_apply, AddCircle.toCircle_apply_mk,
      Circle.coe_exp, Complex.exp_mul_I]
    norm_num
    have harg : (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ) * (t : ℂ) =
        ((2 * Real.pi * t : ℝ) : ℂ) := by norm_num
    rw [harg, Complex.cos_ofReal_im, Complex.sin_ofReal_re]
    simp

name: Submission.CanonicalRotationField.exists_theta_of_mem_target
statement:
theorem exists_theta_of_mem_target (V : TamedField X) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hp : p ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 P) :
    ∃ theta : ℝ, p = CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hp
  induction a using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H t =>
      refine ⟨2 * Real.pi * t, ?_⟩
      rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint, CanonicalRoundOrbit.point,
        addCircleCartesian_coe_real t]

name: Submission.CanonicalRotationField.point_mem_target
statement:
theorem point_mem_target (V : TamedField X) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta ∈
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 P
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨((theta / (2 * Real.pi) : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)), ?_⟩
  rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint, addCircleCartesian_coe_real]
  have hpi : (2 : ℝ) * Real.pi ≠ 0 := by
    have := Real.pi_pos
    positivity
  rw [mul_div_cancel₀ theta hpi]
  rfl

name: Submission.CanonicalRotationField.exists_canonicalPoint_of_mem_targetUnion
statement:
theorem exists_canonicalPoint_of_mem_targetUnion (V : TamedField X)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ n) {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hp : p ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2) :
    ∃ (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      p = CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hp
  obtain ⟨theta, htheta⟩ := exists_theta_of_mem_target V h2 P hP
  exact ⟨P, theta, htheta⟩

name: Submission.CanonicalRotationField.not_mem_tubeRegion_of_norm
statement:
theorem not_mem_tubeRegion_of_norm
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))} (hv : 4 / 3 ≤ ‖v‖) :
    v ∉ tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 3)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hlt : tubeDistSq v < (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ 2 := hmem
  have hrad : rad v ≤ ‖v‖ := rad_le_norm v
  have hval : tubeDistSq v = ‖v‖ ^ 2 + 1 - 2 * rad v := rfl
  nlinarith

name: Submission.CanonicalRotationField.norm_center_le
statement:
theorem norm_center_le {X₀ : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} (V₀ : TamedField X₀)
    (O : V₀.OrbitIndex) :
    ‖CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega : 2 ≤ m + 2) O‖ ≤
      X₀.fiberBoundingRadius + 3 + 4 * (Fintype.card V₀.OrbitIndex : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have he : ‖CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega : 2 ≤ m + 2)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂]
    simp
  have hslot : ((V₀.orbitSlot O : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V₀.OrbitIndex : ℝ) := by
    have h : (V₀.orbitSlot O : ℕ) ≤ Fintype.card V₀.OrbitIndex :=
      le_of_lt (V₀.orbitSlot O).isLt
    exact_mod_cast h
  have hnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ X₀.fiberBoundingRadius + 3 + 4 * (V₀.orbitSlot O : ℕ) := by
    have h1 := X₀.fiberBoundingRadius_nonneg
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((V₀.orbitSlot O : ℕ) : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
    linarith
  rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.center, norm_smul, he, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg hnn]
  linarith

name: Submission.CanonicalRotationField.listSpatialGauge_eq_one_of_forall_not_mem
statement:
theorem listSpatialGauge_eq_one_of_forall_not_mem
    (tl : List V₀.OrbitIndex) (s : ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))
    (h : ∀ O ∈ tl, x - CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O ∉
      tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 3)) :
    SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.listSpatialGauge
      V₀ L₀ D₀ tl s x = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction tl with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons O tl ih =>
      rw [SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.listSpatialGauge,
        (D₀ O).centeredSpatialGauge_eq_one_off_outer
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O) s
          (h O (by simp)),
        ih (fun Q hQ => h Q (by simp [hQ])), mul_one]

name: Submission.CanonicalRotationField.spatialGauge_eq_one_of_outerRadius_le
statement:
theorem spatialGauge_eq_one_of_outerRadius_le
    (s : ℝ) {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))}
    (hx : outerRadius V₀ ≤ ‖x‖) :
    SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
      V₀ L₀ D₀ s x = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply listSpatialGauge_eq_one_of_forall_not_mem
  intro O _
  apply not_mem_tubeRegion_of_norm
  have hc := norm_center_le V₀ O
  have hsub : ‖x‖ - ‖CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O‖ ≤
      ‖x - CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O‖ :=
    norm_sub_norm_le _ _
  rw [outerRadius] at hx
  linarith

name: Submission.CanonicalRotationField.spatialGauge_one_point
statement:
theorem spatialGauge_one_point (h2 : 2 ≤ m + 2)
    (P : V₀.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge V₀ L₀ D₀ 1
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V₀ h2 P theta) =
      (L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta)
proof:
