  SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge_one_canonicalPoint
    V₀ L₀ D₀ P theta

name: Submission.CanonicalRotationField.cartesian_smoothCartesianSOLoopOfClassZero
statement:
theorem cartesian_smoothCartesianSOLoopOfClassZero
    {r : ℕ} (L : LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop r) (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (hclass : loopClassZ2 L.loop L.closed = 0)
    {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1) :
    (LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.smoothCartesianSOLoopOfClassZero
        L hr hclass).cartesian z = L.cartesian z

:=
  (LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.nullGaugeDataOfClassZero L hr hclass).endpoint_circle
    z hz

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationEntryRotationField.harmonized_fiber_eq_targetUnion
statement:
theorem harmonized_fiber_eq_targetUnion
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m)) :
    (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega)
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationEntryRotationField.fderiv_harmonizedEndpoint_canonicalPoint
statement:
theorem fderiv_harmonizedEndpoint_canonicalPoint
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
          (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta) =
      (G.gauge 1 (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
          (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)).comp
        ((SOFrameGauge.toCLM
            ((F.discrepancyLoop P).cartesian
              (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (matchedPlacedX hm M).g
            (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)))
proof:
:= by
  have hmemUnion : CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta ∈
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) :=
    Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      ⟨P, CanonicalRotationField.point_mem_target _ _ P theta⟩
  have hmem₁ : CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta ∈
      (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.fiber := by
    rw [gaugeEndpoint_fiber hm M F]
    exact hmemUnion
  have hmem₀ : CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta ∈
      (matchedPlacedX hm M).fiber := by
    rw [matchedPlacedX_fiber hm M]
    exact hmemUnion
  have h₁ := SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.fderiv_gaugeTransform_eq
    (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁
    (G.gauge 1)
    (contDiff_gauge_slice G.gauge_smooth 1)
    (fun x => G.gauge_bijective 1 x)
    hmem₁
  have h₂ := SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.fderiv_gaugeTransform_eq
    (matchedPlacedX hm M)
    (fun x => SOFrameGauge.toCLM
      (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
        (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm) (F.smoothNullGauge hm) 1 x))
    (SOFrameGauge.contDiff_toCLM (fun i j =>
      ((SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge_smooth
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
        (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm) (F.smoothNullGauge hm) i j)).comp
        (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)))
    (fun x => SOFrameGauge.toCLM_bijective _)
    hmem₀
  have hloop : (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm P).cartesian
      (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta) =
      (F.discrepancyLoop P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta) :=
    (F.nullGauge hm P).endpoint_circle _ (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq theta)
  have h₁' : fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
          (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta) =
      (G.gauge 1 (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
          (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)) := h₁
  have h₂' : fderiv ℝ (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
          (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta) =
      (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
            (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm) (F.smoothNullGauge hm) 1
            (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta))).comp
        (fderiv ℝ (matchedPlacedX hm M).g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)) := h₂
  rw [h₁', h₂', CanonicalRotationField.spatialGauge_one_point
    (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
    (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm) (F.smoothNullGauge hm)
    (by omega) P theta, hloop]

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationEntryRotationField.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopPathJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopPathJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (L₀ : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex →
      SmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (D₀ : ∀ P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex,
      (L₀ P).NullGaugeData)
    (A : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) => A p.1 p.2))
    (hAzero : ∀ x, A 0 x =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (hAbij : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x, Function.Bijective (A s x))
    (RA : ℝ)
    (hAout : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), RA ≤ ‖x‖ →
      A 1 x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
          r • (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ (P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          ((L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          ((A 1 (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
              (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
                (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)))) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:= by
  have hsmoothSO : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) =>
        SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail) L₀ D₀ p.1 p.2)) :=
    SOFrameGauge.contDiff_toCLM
      (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge_smooth
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail) L₀ D₀)
  refine ConcreteConfigurationEntryFrameJet.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_gaugePathJet
    hm M F G
    (fun s x => (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
      (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail) L₀ D₀ s x)).comp (A s x))
    (hsmoothSO.clm_comp hA) ?_ ?_
    (max R (max (CanonicalRotationField.outerRadius
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)) RA))
    eps eps_pos ?_ ?_
  · intro x
    rw [SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge_zero,
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one, hAzero x]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.id_comp _
  · intro s hs x
    have hcoe : ⇑((SOFrameGauge.toCLM
        (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
          (firstSourceField Z kind tail) L₀ D₀ s x)).comp (A s x)) =
        ⇑(SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail) L₀ D₀ s x)) ∘ ⇑(A s x) := rfl
    rw [hcoe]
    exact (SOFrameGauge.toCLM_bijective _).comp (hAbij s hs x)
  · refine SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.outer_of_gauge_eq_id_outside
      (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G)
      (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX
      (fun x => (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
        (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
          (firstSourceField Z kind tail) L₀ D₀ 1 x)).comp (A 1 x))
      R (max (CanonicalRotationField.outerRadius
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail)) RA)
      eps ?_ outer
    intro x hx
    rw [CanonicalRotationField.spatialGauge_eq_one_of_outerRadius_le
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail) L₀ D₀ 1
        (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx),
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one,
      hAout x (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hx)]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.id_comp _
  · intro p hp
    have hp' : p ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) := by
      rw [← harmonized_fiber_eq_targetUnion hm M F G]
      exact hp
    obtain ⟨P, theta, rfl⟩ :=
      CanonicalRotationField.exists_canonicalPoint_of_mem_targetUnion
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) hp'
    rw [CanonicalRotationField.spatialGauge_one_point
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail) L₀ D₀ (by omega) P theta,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_assoc]
    exact hjet P theta

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationEntryRotationField.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (L₀ : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex →
      SmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (D₀ : ∀ P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex,
      (L₀ P).NullGaugeData)
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
          r • (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ (P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          ((L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
            (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta))) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:= by
  refine nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopPathJet hm M F G L₀ D₀
    (fun _ _ => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    contDiff_const (fun _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ _ => Function.bijective_id) 0 (fun _ _ => rfl)
    R eps eps_pos outer ?_
  intro P theta
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.id_comp]
  exact hjet P theta

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationEntryRotationField.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopDistortedJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopDistortedJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (L₀ : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex →
      SmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (D₀ : ∀ P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex,
      (L₀ P).NullGaugeData)
    (A₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hA₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A₀)
    (hA₀norm : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)),
      ‖(1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x‖ < 1)
    (RA : ℝ)
    (hA₀out : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), RA ≤ ‖x‖ →
      A₀ x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
          r • (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ (P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          ((L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          ((A₀ (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
              (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
                (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)))) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:= by
  have hone : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)),
      (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) -
        (1 : ℝ) • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x) = A₀ x := by
    intro x
    rw [one_smul, sub_sub_cancel]
  refine nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopPathJet hm M F G L₀ D₀
    (fun s x => (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) -
      s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x))
    (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_fst.smul
      (contDiff_const.sub (hA₀.comp contDiff_snd))))
    ?_ ?_ RA ?_ R eps eps_pos outer ?_
  · intro x
    ext v
    simp
  · intro s hs x
    refine SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.bijective_of_one_sub_norm_lt _ ?_
    have hsimp : (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) -
        ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) -
          s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
            EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x)) =
        s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x) := by
      rw [sub_sub_cancel]
    rw [hsimp, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs.1]
    have h1 := hA₀norm x
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x), hs.1, hs.2]
  · intro x hx
    rw [hone x]
    exact hA₀out x hx
  · intro P theta
    rw [hone]
    exact hjet P theta

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationEntryRotationField.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_circleJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_circleJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (L : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex →
      LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (hclass : ∀ P, loopClassZ2 (L P).loop (L P).closed = 0)
    (A₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hA₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A₀)
    (hA₀norm : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)),
      ‖(1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x‖ < 1)
    (RA : ℝ)
    (hA₀out : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), RA ≤ ‖x‖ →
      A₀ x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
          r • (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ (P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          ((L P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          ((A₀ (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
              (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
                (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)))) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:= by
  refine nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopDistortedJet hm M F G
    (fun P => LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.smoothCartesianSOLoopOfClassZero
      (L P) (by omega) (hclass P))
    (fun P => LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.smoothNullGaugeDataOfClassZero
      (L P) (by omega) (hclass P))
    A₀ hA₀ hA₀norm RA hA₀out R eps eps_pos outer ?_
  intro P theta
  rw [CanonicalRotationField.cartesian_smoothCartesianSOLoopOfClassZero
    (L P) (by omega) (hclass P) (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq theta)]
  exact hjet P theta

name: Submission.FiberSign.allPositive_positiveFramedDelta
statement:
theorem allPositive_positiveFramedDelta (V : TamedField X) :
    (allPositive X).positiveFramedDelta V = V.framedDelta
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold positiveFramedDelta TamedField.deltaOn TamedField.framedDelta
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro O _
  have hmem : (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∈
      (allPositive X).positiveOrbitCollection V := by
    rw [(allPositive X).mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff V O]
    simp
  rw [if_pos hmem]

name: Submission.FiberSign.positiveFramedDelta_add_neg
statement:
theorem positiveFramedDelta_add_neg (S : FiberSign X) (V : TamedField X) :
    S.positiveFramedDelta V + S.neg.positiveFramedDelta V = V.framedDelta
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold positiveFramedDelta TamedField.deltaOn TamedField.framedDelta
  rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro O _
  let p := V.orbitPoint O
  have hp : p ∈ X.fiber := V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  have hne : S p ≠ 0 := S.nonzero p hp
  rw [S.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff V O,
    S.neg.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff V O, S.neg_apply]
  by_cases hpos : 0 < S p
  · have hnpos : ¬0 < -S p := by linarith
    simp [p, hpos, hnpos]
  · have hneg : S p < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) hne
    have hnpos : 0 < -S p := neg_pos.mpr hneg
    simp [p, hpos, hnpos]

name: Submission.BridgeData.exists_allPositive_cobordism_to_far
statement:
theorem exists_allPositive_cobordism_to_far (B : BridgeData n z) (hn : 0 < n) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (FiberSign.allPositive B.fls)
      (FiberSign.allPositive
        (bridgeFLS B.approx (B.farValue hn) (B.farValue_ne_zero hn)
          (B.farValue_regular hn))))
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin n := ⟨0, hn⟩
  obtain ⟨C, hC0, hC1⟩ := exists_valueChange_cobordism hn B.approx i
    (B.axis_pos hn) (by simp [i]) B.y_ne_zero (B.farValue_ne_zero hn)
    B.regular_y (B.farValue_regular hn)
  refine ⟨{
    cobordism := C
    source_eq := ?_
    target_eq := hC1
    toFun := fun _ => 1
    continuous := continuous_const
    nonzero := fun _ _ => one_ne_zero
    collar_zero := by intros; rfl
    collar_one := by intros; rfl
  }⟩
  exact hC0

name: Submission.SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant.bridge_allPositive_delta_eq_zero
statement:
theorem bridge_allPositive_delta_eq_zero (I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant n)
    {z : StableSpherePi n} (B : BridgeData n z) (hn : 0 < n) :
    (FiberSign.allPositive B.fls).positiveDelta = 0
proof:
:= by
  let Y := bridgeFLS B.approx (B.farValue hn) (B.farValue_ne_zero hn)
    (B.farValue_regular hn)
  let T := FiberSign.allPositive Y
  have hcob : Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (FiberSign.allPositive B.fls) T) :=
    B.exists_allPositive_cobordism_to_far hn
  calc
    (FiberSign.allPositive B.fls).positiveDelta = T.positiveDelta :=
      I.eq_of_nonempty _ _ hcob
    _ = 0 := FiberSign.positiveDelta_eq_zero_of_fiber_eq_empty T
      (B.farFLS_fiber_eq_empty hn)

name: Submission.SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant.bridge_southDelta_eq_northDelta
statement:
theorem bridge_southDelta_eq_northDelta (I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant n)
    {z : StableSpherePi n} (B : BridgeData n z) (hn : 0 < n) :
    B.southDelta = B.northDelta
proof:
:= by
  let V := B.canonicalTamedField
  let S := B.fiberSign
  have htotal : V.framedDelta = 0 := by
    rw [← FiberSign.allPositive_positiveFramedDelta V,
      ← (FiberSign.allPositive B.fls).positiveDelta_eq V]
    exact I.bridge_allPositive_delta_eq_zero B hn
  have hpartition :
      S.positiveFramedDelta V + S.neg.positiveFramedDelta V = 0 := by
    rw [FiberSign.positiveFramedDelta_add_neg S V, htotal]
  have heq : S.neg.positiveFramedDelta V = S.positiveFramedDelta V := by
    exact (show ∀ a b : ZMod 2, a + b = 0 → b = a by decide)
      (S.positiveFramedDelta V) (S.neg.positiveFramedDelta V) hpartition
  rw [BridgeData.southDelta, FiberSign.negativeDelta_eq S V,
    B.northDelta_eq_positiveDelta, S.positiveDelta_eq V]
  exact heq

name: Submission.SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant.bridge_south_matches
statement:
theorem bridge_south_matches (I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∀ {z z' : StableSpherePi n} (B : BridgeData n z) (B' : BridgeData n z'),
      B.northDelta = B'.northDelta → B.southDelta = B'.southDelta
proof:
:= by
  intro z z' B B' h
  rw [I.bridge_southDelta_eq_northDelta B hn,
    I.bridge_southDelta_eq_northDelta B' hn]
  exact h

    (I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant n)
    (G : SignedDeltaNormalizationData n)
    (hn : 0 < n) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)

      (HomotopyGroup.Pi (n + 1)
          (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) x ≃*
        Multiplicative (ZMod 2))

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.minimumSimpleClosedOrbitParam_positive_of_center
statement:
theorem minimumSimpleClosedOrbitParam_positive_of_center
    {center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt C.cobordism center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hcenter : 0 < C center)
    (hindex : M.index = .minimum)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.cobordism.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.minimumPositiveSlice a hreg)) :
    0 < (C.sliceSign (tcoord center + a ^ 2) hreg)
      (T.minimumSimpleClosedOrbitParam hindex a ha har hreg V).p
proof:
:= by
  simp only [minimumSimpleClosedOrbitParam, definiteSpatialCircle,
    definiteCircleCurve, SignedFramedLevelCobordism.sliceSign]
  change 0 < C (cobSpaceTime
    (spacePart (M.definiteCircle a (2 * Real.pi * ((0 : I) : ℝ))))
      (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
  norm_num
  rw [← M.minimumCircle_time hindex ha.le (har.trans_le T.radius_le),
    spaceTime_spacePart]
  apply T.localPoint_positive_of_center hcenter
  rw [norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
  exact har

proof:

  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
    rw [V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding_coe, M.endpoint_lift,

name: Submission.tubeApproxAmbient_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tubeApproxAmbient_apply (v : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ)
    (i : Fin (m + 3)) :
    tubeApproxAmbient (m := m) v i = 12 * v i - 6
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.contDiff_tubeApproxAmbient
statement:
theorem contDiff_tubeApproxAmbient :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tubeApproxAmbient (m := m))
proof:
:= by
  have h : tubeApproxAmbient (m := m) = fun v =>
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).symm
        (fun i => 12 * v i - 6) := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp <| by

name: Submission.tubeApproxAmbient_off_outer_of_outer_coord
statement:
theorem tubeApproxAmbient_off_outer_of_outer_coord
    {v : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ} {j : Fin (m + 3)}
    (hj : v j ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ v j) :
    tubeApproxAmbient (m := m) v ∉ tubeRegion (1 / 3)
proof:
:= by
  let x : E := tubeApproxAmbient (m := m) v
  have habs : 3 ≤ |x j| := by
    change 3 ≤ |12 * v j - 6|
    rcases hj with hj | hj
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
      linarith
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
      linarith
  have hsq : 9 ≤ x j ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_abs (x j)]
  have hd : 1 / 9 ≤ tubeDistSq x := by
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      have hrsq := rad_sq x
      have hr0 := rad_nonneg x
      have hrad : 3 ≤ rad x := by
        rw [radSq] at hrsq
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 1)]
      have hdist := sq_rad_le_tubeDistSq x
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (rad x - 1)]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        have hrsq := rad_sq x
        have hr0 := rad_nonneg x
        have hrad : 3 ≤ rad x := by
          rw [radSq] at hrsq
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0)]
        have hdist := sq_rad_le_tubeDistSq x
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (rad x - 1)]
      · have hdist := coordSq_le_tubeDistSq_of_ne x hj0 hj1
        linarith
  intro hin
  change tubeDistSq x < (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ 2 at hin
  norm_num at hin
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hd) hin

name: Submission.contDiff_tubeApproxRaw

name: Submission.tubeApproxRaw_eq_southPole_on_collar
statement:
theorem tubeApproxRaw_eq_southPole_on_collar (k : ℕ)
    {v : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ}
    (hv : v ∈ closedAmbientCollar (Fin (m + 3))) :
    tubeApproxRaw (m := m) k v =
      ((southPole (m + 2) : UnitSphere E) : E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := hv
  have hj' : v j ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ v j := by
    rcases hj with hj | hj
    · exact Or.inl (hj.trans (by norm_num))
    · have h34 : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 4 / 5 := by norm_num
      exact Or.inr (h34.trans hj)
  rw [tubeApproxRaw,
    tubeThomVec_off_outer k (tubeApproxAmbient_off_outer_of_outer_coord hj')]
  show -eVert (m := m) = -eLast (m + 2)
  rw [eVert_eq_eLast]

name: Submission.cubeToTubeAmbient_collarMap_cubeClamp_eq
statement:
theorem cubeToTubeAmbient_collarMap_cubeClamp_eq
    {v : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ}
    (hv : ∀ i, 1 / 4 < v i ∧ v i < 3 / 4) :
    cubeToTubeAmbient (m := m) (collarMap (cubeClamp v)) =
      tubeApproxAmbient v
proof:
:= by
  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).injective
  funext i
  have h0 : 0 ≤ v i := by linarith [(hv i).1]
  have h1 : v i ≤ 1 := by linarith [(hv i).2]
  have hc : ((cubeClamp v i : I) : ℝ) = v i := by
    rw [cubeClamp, Set.coe_projIcc, min_eq_right h1, max_eq_right h0]
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ 2 * v i - 1 / 2 := by linarith [(hv i).1]
  have hs1 : 2 * v i - 1 / 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith [(hv i).2]
  change 6 * (((collarMap (cubeClamp v) i : I) : ℝ)) - 3 =
    12 * v i - 6
  rw [collarMap, Set.coe_projIcc, hc, min_eq_right hs1,
    max_eq_right hs0]
  ring

name: Submission.tubeApproxRaw_eq_extended
statement:
theorem tubeApproxRaw_eq_extended (k : ℕ) (v : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ) :
    tubeApproxRaw (m := m) k v =
      extended (tubeThomStableGenLoop (m := m) k) v
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hv : ∀ i, 1 / 4 < v i ∧ v i < 3 / 4
  · change tubeThomVec k (tubeApproxAmbient v) =
      tubeThomVec k (cubeToTubeAmbient (collarMap (cubeClamp v)))
    rw [cubeToTubeAmbient_collarMap_cubeClamp_eq hv]
  · obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Classical.not_forall.mp hv
    have hj' : v j ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ v j := by
      by_cases hlo : v j ≤ 1 / 4
      · exact Or.inl hlo
      · by_cases hhi : 3 / 4 ≤ v j
        · exact Or.inr hhi
        · exact False.elim (hj ⟨lt_of_not_ge hlo, lt_of_not_ge hhi⟩)
    have hraw : tubeApproxRaw (m := m) k v =
        ((southPole (m + 2) : UnitSphere E) : E) := by
      rw [tubeApproxRaw,
        tubeThomVec_off_outer k (tubeApproxAmbient_off_outer_of_outer_coord hj')]
      show -eVert (m := m) = -eLast (m + 2)
      rw [eVert_eq_eLast]
    have hcollar : ∃ i, ((cubeClamp v i : I) : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4 ∨
        3 / 4 ≤ ((cubeClamp v i : I) : ℝ) := by
      refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
      rcases hj' with hj' | hj'
      · exact Or.inl (cubeClamp_coe_le hj')
      · exact Or.inr (le_cubeClamp_coe hj')
    rw [hraw, extended]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (collared_eq_basepoint (tubeThomStableGenLoop (m := m) k) hcollar).symm

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.contDiff_endpointConjugateForward
statement:
theorem contDiff_endpointConjugateForward (B A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E =>
      endpointConjugateForward B A p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hAinv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => A.inverse 1 p.2) :=
    (A.contDiff_inverse_slice 1).comp contDiff_snd
  have hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => B.forward p.1 (A.inverse 1 p.2)) :=
    B.forward_smooth.comp (contDiff_fst.prodMk hAinv)
  exact (A.contDiff_forward_slice 1).comp hB

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.contDiff_endpointConjugateInverse

proof:
:= by
  have hAinv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => A.inverse 1 p.2) :=
    (A.contDiff_inverse_slice 1).comp contDiff_snd
  have hB : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => B.inverse p.1 (A.inverse 1 p.2)) :=
    B.inverse_smooth.comp (contDiff_fst.prodMk hAinv)
  exact (A.contDiff_forward_slice 1).comp hB

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointConjugate_leftInverse

theorem endpointConjugate_leftInverse (B A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)

      (endpointConjugateForward B A s)
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.conjugateByEndpoint_forward_image

theorem conjugateByEndpoint_forward_image (B A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.fderiv_translate_g
statement:
theorem fderiv_translate_g (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (w x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    fderiv ℝ (X.translate w).g x = fderiv ℝ X.g (x - w)
proof:
:= by
  have hgd : HasFDerivAt X.g (fderiv ℝ X.g (x - w)) (x - w) :=
    (X.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
  have haff : HasFDerivAt
      (fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => u - w)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) x := (hasFDerivAt_id x).sub_const w
  have hEq : fderiv ℝ (fun u => X.g (u - w)) x =
      (fderiv ℝ X.g (x - w)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) :=
    (hgd.comp x haff).fderiv
  rw [show (X.translate w).g = fun u => X.g (u - w) from rfl, hEq,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_id]

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.fiber_translate_eq_image
statement:
theorem fiber_translate_eq_image (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    (X.translate w).fiber =
      (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => y + w) '' X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  rw [X.mem_fiber_translate]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨v - w, h, sub_add_cancel v w⟩
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    simpa [add_sub_cancel_right] using hy

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.isometry_add_const

proof:
:=
  Isometry.of_dist_eq fun a b => by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]

statement:
@[simp] theorem translate_v (V : TamedField X)
    (w x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :

proof:
:=

name: Submission.TamedField.translate_flow
statement:
theorem translate_flow (V : TamedField X)
    (w p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    (V.translate w).flow p = fun t => V.flow (p - w) t + w
proof:
:= by
  apply (V.translate w).solution_unique (t₀ := 0)
  · exact (V.translate w).hasDerivAt_flow p
  · intro t
    have h := (V.hasDerivAt_flow (p - w) t).add_const w
    have hval : V.v (V.flow (p - w) t) =
        (V.translate w).v (V.flow (p - w) t + w) := by
      rw [translate_v, add_sub_cancel_right]
    rwa [hval] at h
  · rw [(V.translate w).flow_zero, V.flow_zero, sub_add_cancel]

name: Submission.TamedField.translate_orbit
statement:
theorem translate_orbit (V : TamedField X)
    (w p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    (V.translate w).orbit p =
      (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))
        => y + w) '' V.orbit (p - w)
proof:
:= by
  unfold TamedField.orbit
  rw [V.translate_flow w p]
  exact Set.range_comp
    (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => y + w) (V.flow (p - w))

name: Submission.TamedField.periodic_add_const_iff
statement:
private theorem periodic_add_const_iff
    {f : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} {T : ℝ} :
    Function.Periodic (fun t => f t + w) T ↔ Function.Periodic f T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h t
    exact add_right_cancel (h t)
  · intro h t
    show f (t + T) + w = f t + w
    rw [h t]

name: Submission.TamedField.translate_fundamentalPeriod
statement:
theorem translate_fundamentalPeriod (V : TamedField X)
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    {q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hq : q ∈ (X.translate w).fiber) :
    (V.translate w).fundamentalPeriod hq =
      V.fundamentalPeriod (X.mem_fiber_translate.mp hq)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : q - w ∈ X.fiber := X.mem_fiber_translate.mp hq
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply (V.translate w).fundamentalPeriod_le_period hq
      (V.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp)
    rw [V.translate_flow w q]
    exact periodic_add_const_iff.mpr (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp)
  · apply V.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hp
      ((V.translate w).fundamentalPeriod_pos hq)
    have h := (V.translate w).fundamentalPeriod_periodic hq
    rw [V.translate_flow w q] at h
    exact periodic_add_const_iff.mp h

name: Submission.TamedField.translate_fundamentalFrameClass
statement:
theorem translate_fundamentalFrameClass (V : TamedField X)
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    {q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hq : q ∈ (X.translate w).fiber) :
    (V.translate w).fundamentalFrameClass hq =
      V.fundamentalFrameClass (X.mem_fiber_translate.mp hq)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : q - w ∈ X.fiber := X.mem_fiber_translate.mp hq
  apply loopClassZ2_congr_fun ((V.translate w).fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hq)
    (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp)
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop (X.translate w) ((V.translate w).flow q)
      ((u : ℝ) * (V.translate w).fundamentalPeriod hq) =
    frameLoop X (V.flow (q - w)) ((u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp)
  rw [V.translate_fundamentalPeriod w hq, V.translate_flow w q]
  unfold frameLoop
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (X.translate w).g
      (V.flow (q - w) ((u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp) + w) =
      fderiv ℝ X.g (V.flow (q - w) ((u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp)) := by
    rw [X.fderiv_translate_g w, add_sub_cancel_right]
  rw [frameAt_eq_of_fderiv_eq hfd]

name: Submission.translate_image_mem_orbitFinset
statement:
theorem translate_image_mem_orbitFinset (V : TamedField X)
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    {O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))} (hO : O ∈ V.orbitFinset) :
    (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))
      => y + w) '' O ∈ (V.translate w).orbitFinset
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := V.mem_orbitFinset.mp hO
  rw [(V.translate w).mem_orbitFinset]
  refine ⟨p + w, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [X.mem_fiber_translate, add_sub_cancel_right]
    exact hp
  · rw [V.translate_orbit w (p + w), add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Submission.translate_preimage_mem_orbitFinset
statement:
theorem translate_preimage_mem_orbitFinset (V : TamedField X)
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    {P : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
    (hP : P ∈ (V.translate w).orbitFinset) :
    (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))
      => y - w) '' P ∈ V.orbitFinset
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩ := (V.translate w).mem_orbitFinset.mp hP
  rw [V.mem_orbitFinset]
  refine ⟨q - w, X.mem_fiber_translate.mp hq, ?_⟩
  rw [V.translate_orbit w q, Set.image_image]
  have : (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => x + w - w) = id := by
    funext x
    simp
  rw [this, Set.image_id]

name: Submission.image_sub_add_cancel
statement:
private theorem image_sub_add_cancel
    (A : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => y + w) ''
      ((fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))
        => y - w) '' A) = A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.image_image]
  have : (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => x - w + w) = id := by
    funext x
    simp
  rw [this, Set.image_id]

name: Submission.image_add_sub_cancel
statement:
private theorem image_add_sub_cancel
    (A : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => y - w) ''
      ((fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))
        => y + w) '' A) = A
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.image_image]
  have : (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => x + w - w) = id := by
    funext x
    simp
  rw [this, Set.image_id]

name: Submission.translate_image_subset_positivePart_iff
statement:
theorem translate_image_subset_positivePart_iff (S : FiberSign X)
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :
    (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => y + w) '' O ⊆
        (S.translate w).positivePart ↔ O ⊆ S.positivePart
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h x hx
    have hmem := h ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [S.mem_positivePart_translate] at hmem
    rwa [add_sub_cancel_right] at hmem
  · rintro h y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    rw [S.mem_positivePart_translate, add_sub_cancel_right]
    exact h hx

name: Submission.translate_orbitFrameClass
statement:
theorem translate_orbitFrameClass (V : TamedField X)
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (O : V.OrbitIndex)
    (hmem : (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => y + w) ''
      (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∈
        (V.translate w).orbitFinset) :
    V.orbitFrameClass O =
      (V.translate w).orbitFrameClass ⟨_, hmem⟩
proof:
:= by
  set q := (V.translate w).orbitPoint ⟨_, hmem⟩ with hqdef
  have hqfib : q ∈ (X.translate w).fiber :=
    (V.translate w).orbitPoint_mem_fiber ⟨_, hmem⟩
  have hqmem : q ∈ (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => y + w) ''
      (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    have h := (V.translate w).orbitPoint_orbit ⟨_, hmem⟩
    exact h.symm.subset ((V.translate w).mem_orbit_self q)
  obtain ⟨x, hxO, hxq⟩ := hqmem
  have hx : q - w ∈ (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    rw [← hxq, add_sub_cancel_right]
    exact hxO
  have hp := V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  have hxOrbit : q - w ∈ V.orbit (V.orbitPoint O) := by
    rw [← V.orbitPoint_orbit O]
    exact hx
  calc
    V.orbitFrameClass O = V.fundamentalFrameClass hp := rfl
    _ = V.fundamentalFrameClass (V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hxOrbit) :=
      (V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit hp hxOrbit).symm
    _ = (V.translate w).fundamentalFrameClass hqfib :=
      (V.translate_fundamentalFrameClass w hqfib).symm
    _ = (V.translate w).orbitFrameClass ⟨_, hmem⟩ := rfl

name: Submission.translateSelectedOrbitEquiv_frameClass
statement:
theorem translateSelectedOrbitEquiv_frameClass (S : FiberSign X)
    (V : TamedField X) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex (S.positiveOrbitCollection V)) :
    V.orbitFrameClass O.1 =
      (V.translate w).orbitFrameClass
        ((translateSelectedOrbitEquiv S V w O).1)

:=
  translate_orbitFrameClass V w O.1 _

name: Submission.FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger_translate
statement:
theorem positiveFrameLedger_translate (S : FiberSign X)
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (W : TamedField (X.translate w)) (V : TamedField X) :
    ((S.translate w).positiveFrameLedger W).Perm
      (S.positiveFrameLedger V)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ((S.translate w).positiveFrameLedger W).Perm
      ((S.translate w).positiveFrameLedger (V.translate w)) :=
    (S.translate w).positiveFrameLedger_perm_of_tamedField W (V.translate w)
  have h2 : (S.positiveFrameLedger V).Perm
      ((S.translate w).positiveFrameLedger (V.translate w)) :=
    V.selectedFrameLedger_perm_of_equiv (V.translate w) _ _
      (translateSelectedOrbitEquiv S V w)
      (translateSelectedOrbitEquiv_frameClass S V w)
  exact h1.trans h2.symm

name: Submission.FlatSignedConfiguration.positiveLedger_juxtapose
statement:
theorem positiveLedger_juxtapose (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (A B : FlatSignedConfiguration n c)
    (hsep : A.radius + B.radius < dist A.center B.center) :
    ((juxtapose hc A B hsep).positiveLedger).Perm
      (A.positiveLedger ++ B.positiveLedger)
proof:
:=
  FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger_juxtapose A.sign B.sign hc
    A.flatOutside B.flatOutside hsep
    (juxtapose hc A B hsep).X.exists_tamedField.some
    A.X.exists_tamedField.some B.X.exists_tamedField.some

proof:
:= by
  refine (positiveLedger_juxtapose hc A (placeAfter A B)
    (separated_placeAfter A B)).trans ?_
  exact (List.Perm.refl A.positiveLedger).append
    (B.positiveLedger_recenter
      (axisPoint A.center (A.radius + B.radius + 1)))

name: Submission.FlatSignedConfiguration.positiveLedger_assembleFrom
statement:
theorem positiveLedger_assembleFrom (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (A : FlatSignedConfiguration n c)
    (tail : List (FlatSignedConfiguration n c)) :
    ((assembleFrom hc A tail).positiveLedger).Perm
      (A.positiveLedger ++ (tail.map positiveLedger).flatten)
proof:
:= by
  induction tail generalizing A with
  | nil =>
      exact List.Perm.of_eq (by simp)
  | cons B t ih =>
      rw [assembleFrom_cons]
      refine (ih (cons hc A B)).trans ?_
      refine ((positiveLedger_cons hc A B).append
        (List.Perm.refl (t.map positiveLedger).flatten)).trans ?_
      exact List.Perm.of_eq
        (by rw [List.map_cons, List.flatten_cons, List.append_assoc])

name: Submission.FlatSignedConfiguration.negativeLedger_assembleFrom

theorem negativeLedger_assembleFrom (hc : c ≠ 0)

      (A.negativeLedger ++ (tail.map negativeLedger).flatten)
proof:
:= by
  induction tail generalizing A with
  | nil =>
      exact List.Perm.of_eq (by simp)
  | cons B t ih =>
      rw [assembleFrom_cons]
      refine (ih (cons hc A B)).trans ?_
      refine ((negativeLedger_cons hc A B).append
        (List.Perm.refl (t.map negativeLedger).flatten)).trans ?_
      exact List.Perm.of_eq
        (by rw [List.map_cons, List.flatten_cons, List.append_assoc])

name: Submission.FlatSignedConfiguration.positiveLedger_assemble
statement:
theorem positiveLedger_assemble (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (pieces : List (FlatSignedConfiguration n c)) :
    ((assemble c hc pieces).positiveLedger).Perm
      (pieces.map positiveLedger).flatten
proof:
:= by
  cases pieces with
  | nil =>
      exact List.Perm.of_eq (by simp [empty_positiveLedger hc])
  | cons A tail =>
      rw [assemble_cons]
      refine (positiveLedger_assembleFrom hc A tail).trans ?_
      exact List.Perm.of_eq
        (by rw [List.map_cons, List.flatten_cons])

      exact List.Perm.of_eq
        (by rw [List.map_cons, List.flatten_cons])

name: Submission.spatialDerivPi_surjective_iff
statement:
theorem spatialDerivPi_surjective_iff (G : E' → F) (v : E') :
    Surjective (spatialDerivPi G v) ↔ Surjective (spatialDeriv G v)
proof:
:= by
  let e := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin n) ℝ : F ≃L[ℝ] (Fin n → ℝ))
  constructor
  · intro h y
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := h (e y)
    refine ⟨x, e.injective ?_⟩
    exact hx
  · intro h
    exact e.surjective.comp h

name: Submission.contDiff_spatialDerivPi
statement:
theorem contDiff_spatialDerivPi {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (spatialDerivPi G)
proof:
:= by
  have hsp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (spatialDeriv G) := by
    exact ContDiff.clm_comp (contDiff_fderivCLM hG) contDiff_const
  exact ContDiff.clm_comp contDiff_const hsp

name: Submission.isClosed_timeCritical
statement:
theorem isClosed_timeCritical {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) :
    IsClosed (timeCritical G)
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : IsClosed {v : E' | G v = 0} :=
    isClosed_singleton.preimage hG.continuous
  have hnonsurj : IsClosed {v : E' | ¬Surjective (spatialDerivPi G v)} :=
    (isClosed_setOf_not_surjective (E := E₁) (q := n)).preimage
      (contDiff_spatialDerivPi hG).continuous
  have heq : timeCritical G =
      {v : E' | G v = 0} ∩ {v : E' | ¬Surjective (spatialDerivPi G v)} := by
    ext v
    simp only [timeCritical, mem_setOf_eq, mem_inter_iff,
      spatialDerivPi_surjective_iff]
  rw [heq]
  exact hzero.inter hnonsurj

name: Submission.isClosed_coreCriticalPoints

name: Submission.coreCriticalPoints_subset_fiber
statement:

proof:
:= by
  rintro v ⟨⟨hv, -⟩, ht⟩
  refine ⟨hv, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change 0 ≤ tcoord v
    linarith [ht.1]
  · change tcoord v ≤ 1
    linarith [ht.2]

name: Submission.isCompact_coreCriticalPoints

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter
statement:
theorem FramedLevelCobordism.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 4) :
    sliceRegular C.G t
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv htv
  have hvst : cobSpaceTime (spacePart v) t = v := by
    rw [← htv]
    exact spaceTime_spacePart v
  have hslice : sliceMap C.G t = C.X₀.g := by
    funext x
    exact C.collar_zero x t ht
  rw [← hvst, ← fderiv_sliceMap C.smooth, hslice]
  apply C.X₀.regular
  have h0 : sliceMap C.G t (spacePart v) = 0 := by
    rw [sliceMap, hvst]
    exact hv
  rwa [hslice] at h0

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.sliceRegular_of_three_quarter_le
statement:
theorem FramedLevelCobordism.sliceRegular_of_three_quarter_le
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t) :
    sliceRegular C.G t
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv htv
  have hvst : cobSpaceTime (spacePart v) t = v := by
    rw [← htv]
    exact spaceTime_spacePart v
  have hslice : sliceMap C.G t = C.X₁.g := by
    funext x
    exact C.collar_one x t ht
  rw [← hvst, ← fderiv_sliceMap C.smooth, hslice]
  apply C.X₁.regular
  have h0 : sliceMap C.G t (spacePart v) = 0 := by
    rw [sliceMap, hvst]
    exact hv
  rwa [hslice] at h0

    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) : (1 / 4 : ℝ) ∉ coreCriticalTimes C
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨v, ⟨hcrit, -⟩, ht⟩

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.threeQuarter_notMem_coreCriticalTimes

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.regularSlab_of_disjoint_coreCriticalTimes
statement:
theorem FramedLevelCobordism.regularSlab_of_disjoint_coreCriticalTimes
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 1 / 4 ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ 3 / 4)
    (hdis : Disjoint (Icc a b) (coreCriticalTimes C)) :
    regularSlab C.G a b
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht hcritical
  rcases hcritical with ⟨v, hvcrit, hvt⟩
  have hcore : v ∈ coreCriticalPoints C := by
    refine ⟨hvcrit, ?_⟩
    change tcoord v ∈ Icc (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ)
    rw [hvt]
    exact ⟨ha.trans ht.1, ht.2.trans hb⟩
  exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hdis ht ⟨v, hcore, hvt⟩

name: Submission.FiberSide.fiber_eq_positive_union_negative
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (L.nonzero_on_fiber v hv) with hvneg | hvpos
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hv, hvneg⟩
    · exact Or.inl ⟨hv, hvpos⟩
  · rintro (hv | hv) <;> exact hv.1

statement:

    ∃ U : Set E', IsOpen U ∧ L.positiveFiber = {v | C.G v = 0} ∩ U

name: Submission.FiberSide.positive_on_preconnected
statement:
theorem positive_on_preconnected {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (L : FiberSide C)
    {S : Set E'} (hS : IsPreconnected S) (hsub : S ⊆ {v | C.G v = 0})
    {x : E'} (hx : x ∈ S) (hxpos : 0 < L.side x) :
    S ⊆ L.positiveFiber
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  refine ⟨hsub hy, ?_⟩
  by_contra hypos
  have hyne : L.side y ≠ 0 := L.nonzero_on_fiber y (hsub hy)
  have hylt : L.side y < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hypos) hyne
  have hzrange : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (L.side y) (L.side x) := ⟨hylt.le, hxpos.le⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hzS, hz0⟩ :=
    hS.intermediate_value hy hx L.continuous.continuousOn hzrange
  exact (L.nonzero_on_fiber z (hsub hzS)) hz0

name: Submission.FiberSide.negative_on_preconnected
statement:
theorem negative_on_preconnected {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (L : FiberSide C)
    {S : Set E'} (hS : IsPreconnected S) (hsub : S ⊆ {v | C.G v = 0})
    {x : E'} (hx : x ∈ S) (hxneg : L.side x < 0) :
    S ⊆ L.negativeFiber
proof:
:= by
  intro y hy
  refine ⟨hsub hy, ?_⟩
  by_contra hyneg
  have hyne : L.side y ≠ 0 := L.nonzero_on_fiber y (hsub hy)
  have hypos : 0 < L.side y := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hyneg) (Ne.symm hyne)
  have hzrange : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (L.side x) (L.side y) := ⟨hxneg.le, hypos.le⟩
  obtain ⟨z, hzS, hz0⟩ :=
    hS.intermediate_value hx hy L.continuous.continuousOn hzrange
  exact (L.nonzero_on_fiber z (hsub hzS)) hz0

name: Submission.FiberSide.preconnected_side_dichotomy
statement:
theorem preconnected_side_dichotomy {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (L : FiberSide C)
    {S : Set E'} (hS : IsPreconnected S) (hsub : S ⊆ {v | C.G v = 0})
    (hne : S.Nonempty) :
    S ⊆ L.positiveFiber ∨ S ⊆ L.negativeFiber
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (L.nonzero_on_fiber x (hsub hx)) with hxneg | hxpos
  · exact Or.inr (L.negative_on_preconnected hS hsub hx hxneg)
  · exact Or.inl (L.positive_on_preconnected hS hsub hx hxpos)

name: Submission.FiberSide.exists_positive_neighborhood
statement:
theorem exists_positive_neighborhood {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (L : FiberSide C)
    {v : E'} (hv : 0 < L.side v) :
    ∃ U : Set E', IsOpen U ∧ v ∈ U ∧ ∀ w ∈ U, 0 < L.side w
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨L.side ⁻¹' Ioi 0, isOpen_Ioi.preimage L.continuous, hv, ?_⟩
  intro w hw
  exact hw

name: Submission.FiberSide.exists_negative_neighborhood
statement:
theorem exists_negative_neighborhood {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (L : FiberSide C)
    {v : E'} (hv : L.side v < 0) :
    ∃ U : Set E', IsOpen U ∧ v ∈ U ∧ ∀ w ∈ U, L.side w < 0
proof:

  intro w hw
  exact hw

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.center_mem_timeCritical
statement:
theorem center_mem_timeCritical {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} {center : E'}
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) : center ∈ timeCritical C.G
proof:
:= by
  rw [← M.param_zero]
  have hm : M.param 0 ∈ timeCritical C.G ↔ (0 : E₂) = 0 := by
    have hfun : ‖(0 : E₂)‖ < M.radius →
        (M.param 0 ∈ timeCritical C.G ↔ (0 : E₂) = 0) := M.critical_model 0
    exact hfun (by simpa using M.radius_pos)
  exact hm.2 rfl

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.exists_isolating_open
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hcover⟩ := M.covers_fiber
  refine ⟨Metric.ball center ε, Metric.isOpen_ball, ?_⟩
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hvball, hvcrit⟩
    obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := hcover v hvball hvcrit.1
    have hm : M.param u ∈ timeCritical C.G ↔ u = 0 := by
      have hfun : ‖u‖ < M.radius →
          (M.param u ∈ timeCritical C.G ↔ u = 0) := M.critical_model u
      exact hfun hu
    have hu0 : u = 0 := hm.1 (huv ▸ hvcrit)
    rw [← huv, hu0, M.param_zero]
    exact mem_singleton center
  · intro hv
    rw [mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    subst v
    exact ⟨Metric.mem_ball_self hε, M.center_mem_timeCritical⟩

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.exists_isolating_open_core
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hUcrit⟩ := M.exists_isolating_open
  refine ⟨U, hU, ?_⟩
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · intro v hv
    exact hUcrit ▸ ⟨hv.1, hv.2.1⟩
  · intro v hv
    rw [mem_singleton_iff] at hv
    subst v
    have hcUcrit : center ∈ U ∩ timeCritical C.G := by
      rw [hUcrit]
      exact mem_singleton center
    exact ⟨hcUcrit.1, hc⟩

name: Submission.MorseAtlas.finite_coreCriticalPoints
statement:
theorem MorseAtlas.finite_coreCriticalPoints {C : FramedLevelCobordism n}
    (A : MorseAtlas C) : (coreCriticalPoints C).Finite
proof:
:= by
  apply (isCompact_coreCriticalPoints C).finite
  rw [isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen]
  intro v hv
  exact (A.localModel v hv).some.exists_isolating_open_core hv

name: Submission.MorsePosition.mem_eventTimes_iff
statement:
theorem mem_eventTimes_iff {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : MorsePosition C) (t : ℝ) :
    t ∈ P.eventTimes ↔ t ∈ coreCriticalTimes C
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ht
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvt⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ht
    exact ⟨v, P.centers_exact ▸ hv, hvt⟩
  · rintro ⟨v, hv, hvt⟩
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    have hv' : v ∈ P.centers := by
      change v ∈ (P.centers : Set E')
      rw [P.centers_exact]
      exact hv
    exact ⟨v, hv', hvt⟩

name: Submission.MorsePosition.coe_eventTimes
statement:
theorem coe_eventTimes {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : MorsePosition C) :
    (P.eventTimes : Set ℝ) = coreCriticalTimes C
proof:
:= by
  ext t
  exact P.mem_eventTimes_iff t

name: Submission.MorsePosition.mem_orderedEventTimes_iff
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.MorsePosition.orderedEventTimes_nodup
statement:

name: Submission.MorsePosition.regularSlab_of_cell
statement:
theorem regularSlab_of_cell {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : MorsePosition C)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 / 4 ≤ a) (hb : b ≤ 3 / 4)
    (havoid : ∀ t ∈ P.eventTimes, t ∉ Icc a b) :
    regularSlab C.G a b
proof:
:= by
  apply C.regularSlab_of_disjoint_coreCriticalTimes ha hb
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro t ht htc
  have ht' : t ∈ P.eventTimes := by
    rw [P.mem_eventTimes_iff]
    exact htc
  exact havoid t ht' ht

name: Submission.LabeledMorsePosition.event_side_ne_zero
statement:
theorem event_side_ne_zero {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : LabeledMorsePosition C)

proof:

name: Submission.LabeledMorsePosition.event_mem_positive_or_negative
proof:
:= by

  · exact Or.inr (P.mem_negativeCenters_iff.mpr ⟨hv, hvneg⟩)
  · exact Or.inl (P.mem_positiveCenters_iff.mpr ⟨hv, hvpos⟩)

name: Submission.LabeledMorsePosition.positiveCenters_union_negativeCenters
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rcases Finset.mem_union.mp hv with hvp | hvn
    · exact (P.mem_positiveCenters_iff.mp hvp).1
    · exact (P.mem_negativeCenters_iff.mp hvn).1
  · intro hv
    exact Finset.mem_union.mpr (P.event_mem_positive_or_negative hv)

name: Submission.LabeledMorsePosition.disjoint_positiveCenters_negativeCenters
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.disjoint_left]
  intro v hvp hvn
  have hp := (P.mem_positiveCenters_iff.mp hvp).2
  have hn := (P.mem_negativeCenters_iff.mp hvn).2
  linarith

name: Submission.LabeledMorsePosition.mem_positiveEventTimes_iff
statement:
theorem mem_positiveEventTimes_iff {C : FramedLevelCobordism n}
    (P : LabeledMorsePosition C) (t : ℝ) :
    t ∈ P.positiveEventTimes ↔
      ∃ v ∈ coreCriticalPoints C, 0 < P.sideLabel.side v ∧ tcoord v = t
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro ht
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvt⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp ht
    have hvp := P.mem_positiveCenters_iff.mp hv
    refine ⟨v, ?_, hvp.2, hvt⟩
    rw [← P.position.centers_exact]
    exact hvp.1
  · rintro ⟨v, hvcore, hvpos, hvt⟩
    apply Finset.mem_image.mpr
    refine ⟨v, P.mem_positiveCenters_iff.mpr ⟨?_, hvpos⟩, hvt⟩
    change v ∈ (P.position.centers : Set E')
    rw [P.position.centers_exact]
    exact hvcore

name: Submission.LabeledMorsePosition.mem_orderedPositiveEventTimes_iff
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_orderedPositiveEventTimes_iff {C : FramedLevelCobordism n}
    (P : LabeledMorsePosition C) (t : ℝ) :
    t ∈ P.orderedPositiveEventTimes ↔
      ∃ v ∈ coreCriticalPoints C, 0 < P.sideLabel.side v ∧ tcoord v = t
proof:
:= by
  rw [orderedPositiveEventTimes, Finset.mem_sort, mem_positiveEventTimes_iff]

name: Submission.LabeledMorsePosition.orderedPositiveEventTimes_nodup

name: Submission.LabeledMorsePosition.positive_event_neighborhood
statement:
theorem positive_event_neighborhood {C : FramedLevelCobordism n}
    (P : LabeledMorsePosition C) {v : E'} (hv : v ∈ P.positiveCenters) :
    ∃ U : Set E', IsOpen U ∧ v ∈ U ∧
      ∀ w ∈ U, 0 < P.sideLabel.side w
proof:
:= by
  exact P.sideLabel.exists_positive_neighborhood
    (P.mem_positiveCenters_iff.mp hv).2

name: Submission.LabeledMorsePosition.negative_event_neighborhood_disjoint_positiveFiber
statement:
theorem negative_event_neighborhood_disjoint_positiveFiber
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : LabeledMorsePosition C)
    {v : E'} (hv : v ∈ P.negativeCenters) :
    ∃ U : Set E', IsOpen U ∧ v ∈ U ∧ Disjoint U P.sideLabel.positiveFiber
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hUopen, hvU, hUneg⟩ :=
    P.sideLabel.exists_negative_neighborhood
      (P.mem_negativeCenters_iff.mp hv).2
  refine ⟨U, hUopen, hvU, ?_⟩
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro w hwU hwpos
  linarith [hUneg w hwU, hwpos.2]

name: Submission.LabeledMorsePosition.event_sign_neighborhood
statement:
theorem event_sign_neighborhood {C : FramedLevelCobordism n}
    (P : LabeledMorsePosition C) {v : E'} (hv : v ∈ P.position.centers) :
    (∃ U : Set E', IsOpen U ∧ v ∈ U ∧
        ∀ w ∈ U, 0 < P.sideLabel.side w) ∨
      (∃ U : Set E', IsOpen U ∧ v ∈ U ∧
        ∀ w ∈ U, P.sideLabel.side w < 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases P.event_mem_positive_or_negative hv with hvp | hvn
  · exact Or.inl (P.positive_event_neighborhood hvp)
  · exact Or.inr (P.sideLabel.exists_negative_neighborhood
      (P.mem_negativeCenters_iff.mp hvn).2)

name: Submission.exists_small_regular_chartGradient

    {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :

name: Submission.isDiscrete_preimage_singleton_of_regularValue
proof:
:= by
  rw [isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen]
  intro x hx
  have hfx : f x = q := by simpa using hx
  have hsurj : Surjective (fderiv ℝ f x) := hq x hfx
  have hinj : Injective (fderiv ℝ f x) := by
    exact LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mpr hsurj
  let e : E₂ ≃L[ℝ] E₂ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective (fderiv ℝ f x)
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hinj) (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj)
  have hderiv : HasFDerivAt f (e : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) x := by
    have h := (hf.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
    simpa [e, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_ofBijective] using h
  let φ := hf.contDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph f hderiv (by simp)
  refine ⟨φ.source, φ.open_source, ?_⟩
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hyU, hyq⟩
    rw [mem_preimage, mem_singleton_iff] at hyq
    have hxU : x ∈ φ.source :=
      hf.contDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hderiv (by simp)
    have hφ : (φ : E₂ → E₂) = f := by rfl
    have hφyx : φ y = φ x := by
      rw [hφ, hyq, hfx]
    have hxy : y = x := φ.injOn hyU hxU hφyx
    simpa [hxy]
  · intro hy
    rw [mem_singleton_iff] at hy
    subst y
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hf.contDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hderiv (by simp)
    · simpa [hfx]

name: Submission.finite_regularValue_preimage_inter_compact
statement:
theorem finite_regularValue_preimage_inter_compact
    {f : E₂ → E₂} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) {q : E₂}
    (hq : IsRegularValue f q) {K : Set E₂} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    (f ⁻¹' ({q} : Set E₂) ∩ K).Finite
proof:
:= by
  rw [inter_comm]
  apply (hK.inter_right (isClosed_singleton.preimage hf.continuous)).finite
  exact (isDiscrete_preimage_singleton_of_regularValue hf hq).mono inter_subset_right

name: Submission.exists_scalar_regular_value_between
statement:
theorem exists_scalar_regular_value_between {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    {a b : ℝ} (hab : a < b) :
    ∃ c ∈ Ioo a b, ∀ x, f x = c → fderiv ℝ f x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hvol : volume (Ioo a b) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [Real.volume_Ioo]
    rw [Ne, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero, not_le]
    exact sub_pos.mpr hab
  exact Measure.exists_mem_of_measure_ne_zero_of_ae hvol
    (ae_restrict_of_ae (regular_value_ae f hf))

name: Submission.FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger_backgroundTransport_perm
statement:
theorem positiveFrameLedger_backgroundTransport_perm
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} (S : FiberSign X) (V : TamedField X)
    (c₁ c₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (h₁ : c₁ ≠ 0) (h₂ : c₂ ≠ 0) :
    (S.positiveFrameLedger V).Perm
      ((S.codomainEquiv (backgroundEquiv c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂)).positiveFrameLedger
        (V.backgroundTransport c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂))
proof:
:= by
  apply TamedField.SelectedDeltaTransport.selectedFrameLedger_perm V
    (V.backgroundTransport c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂)
  refine TamedField.SelectedDeltaTransport.ofDeltaTransport
    (V.backgroundDeltaTransport c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂) ?_
  intro O
  change ((O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ⊆ S.positivePart) ↔
    (((V.backgroundDeltaTransport c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂).orbitEquiv O :
      (V.backgroundTransport c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂).OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ⊆
      (S.codomainEquiv (backgroundEquiv c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂)).positivePart
  rw [V.backgroundDeltaTransport_orbitEquiv_coe,
    S.positivePart_codomainEquiv]

name: Submission.FiberSign.negativeFrameLedger_backgroundTransport_perm
statement:
theorem negativeFrameLedger_backgroundTransport_perm
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} (S : FiberSign X) (V : TamedField X)
    (c₁ c₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (h₁ : c₁ ≠ 0) (h₂ : c₂ ≠ 0) :
    (S.neg.positiveFrameLedger V).Perm
      ((S.codomainEquiv (backgroundEquiv c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂)).neg.positiveFrameLedger
        (V.backgroundTransport c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂))
proof:
:= by
  rw [S.codomainEquiv_neg (backgroundEquiv c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂)]
  exact S.neg.positiveFrameLedger_backgroundTransport_perm V c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂

        (componentSign k).positiveOrbitCollection V) ↔

  constructor
  · intro hpos

    · exact h
    · exfalso
      rw [h] at hpos
      obtain ⟨theta, htheta⟩ := orbitPoint_secondOrbitIndex_mem k V
      rw [← htheta, componentSign_second] at hpos

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.componentSign_positiveFrameLedger
statement:
theorem componentSign_positiveFrameLedger
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) (Nat.succ_pos k))) :
    (componentSign k).positiveFrameLedger V = [(0 : ZMod 2)]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := (componentSign k).positiveOrbitCollection V
  have hcard : Fintype.card (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A) = 1 := by
    rw [Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]
    refine ⟨⟨firstOrbitIndex k V,
      (componentSign_mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff k V _).mpr rfl⟩, ?_⟩
    intro Q
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (componentSign_mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff k V Q.1).mp Q.2
  let L := V.selectedFrameLedger A
  have hlength : L.length = 1 := by
    simp [L, TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, hcard]
  have hall : ∀ beta ∈ L, beta = (0 : ZMod 2) := by
    intro beta hbeta
    simp only [L, TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, List.mem_ofFn] at hbeta
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hbeta
    exact orbitFrameClass_eq_zero k V _
  change L = [(0 : ZMod 2)]
  rw [L.eq_cons_of_length_one hlength]
  congr
  exact hall _ (by simp)

  let L := V.selectedFrameLedger A
  have hlength : L.length = 1 := by

  have hall : ∀ beta ∈ L, beta = (0 : ZMod 2) := by

statement: private theorem zmod_two_cases : ∀ beta : ZMod 2, beta = 0 ∨ beta = 1

name: Submission.StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.delta_eq_count_zero
statement:
theorem delta_eq_count_zero (L : MorseLedger) :
    L.delta = ((L.count (0 : ZMod 2) : ℕ) : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp [MorseLedger.delta]
  | cons beta L ih =>
      rcases zmod_two_cases beta with rfl | rfl
      · rw [MorseLedger.delta_cons, ih, List.count_cons_self]
        push_cast
        ring
      · rw [MorseLedger.delta_cons, ih,
          List.count_cons_of_ne (by decide : (1 : ZMod 2) ≠ 0)]
        have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
        rw [h11, zero_add]

name: Submission.StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.count_flatten_replicate
statement:
private theorem count_flatten_replicate {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (a : α) (N : ℕ) (l : List α) :
    ((List.replicate N l).flatten).count a = N * l.count a
proof:
:= by
  induction N with
  | zero => simp
  | succ N ih =>
      rw [List.replicate_succ, List.flatten_cons, List.count_append, ih,
        Nat.succ_mul]
      ring

name: Submission.StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.perm_of_count_zero_one
proof:
:= by
  rw [List.perm_iff_count]
  intro a
  rcases zmod_two_cases a with rfl | rfl
  · exact h0
  · exact h1

name: Submission.StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.count_zero_mod_two_eq
statement:
theorem count_zero_mod_two_eq {P N : MorseLedger} (hdelta : P.delta = N.delta) :
    P.count 0 % 2 = N.count 0 % 2
proof:
:= by
  have hcast : ((P.count (0 : ZMod 2) : ℕ) : ZMod 2) =
      ((N.count (0 : ZMod 2) : ℕ) : ZMod 2) := by
    rw [← delta_eq_count_zero, ← delta_eq_count_zero]
    exact hdelta
  have := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff _ _ _).mp hcast
  exact this

  refine (FlatSignedConfiguration.positiveLedger_assemble
    (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2)) (pieces k P N)).trans ?_
  apply perm_of_count_zero_one
  · simp only [pieces, List.map_append, List.map_replicate,
      List.flatten_append, List.count_append, count_flatten_replicate,
      onePos_positiveLedger, oneNeg_positiveLedger,
      zeroPairPos_positiveLedger, zeroPairNeg_positiveLedger,
      zeroSplit_positiveLedger, List.count_nil, c1, c3, c5]

  · simp only [pieces, List.map_append, List.map_replicate,
      List.flatten_append, List.count_append, count_flatten_replicate,
      onePos_positiveLedger, oneNeg_positiveLedger,

      onePos_negativeLedger, oneNeg_negativeLedger,
      zeroPairPos_negativeLedger, zeroPairNeg_negativeLedger,
      zeroSplit_negativeLedger, List.count_nil, c1, c3, c5]

      onePos_negativeLedger, oneNeg_negativeLedger,

name: Submission.CompactTimeTamedField.ofEmptyCore_safeTime

    {d : ℝ} (hd : 0 < d) :
    (R.ofEmptyCore hK hd).safeTime =
      d / (2 * ((R.base.bound : ℝ) + 1))
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.CompactTimeTamedField.exists_large_safeTime_of_empty
statement:
theorem exists_large_safeTime_of_empty (R : CompactTimeTamedField C K)
    (hK : K = ∅) (b : ℝ) :
    ∃ R' : CompactTimeTamedField C K, b ≤ R'.safeTime
proof:
:= by
  have hbnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) := R.base.bound.coe_nonneg
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * ((R.base.bound : ℝ) + 1) := by linarith
  refine ⟨R.ofEmptyCore hK (d := 2 * ((R.base.bound : ℝ) + 1) * (|b| + 1))
    (by positivity), ?_⟩
  rw [ofEmptyCore_safeTime]
  have hval : 2 * ((R.base.bound : ℝ) + 1) * (|b| + 1) /
      (2 * ((R.base.bound : ℝ) + 1)) = |b| + 1 := by
    field_simp
  rw [hval]
  have := le_abs_self b
  linarith

name: Submission.exists_empty_criticalSliceExteriorCore
statement:
theorem exists_empty_criticalSliceExteriorCore (C : LevelCobordismData n)
    (center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (t : ℝ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ criticalSliceExteriorCore C center t r = ∅
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀⟩ :=
    (isCompact_slabFiber C t t).isBounded.subset_closedBall center
  have hmax : (0 : ℝ) ≤ max R₀ 0 := le_max_right R₀ 0
  refine ⟨max R₀ 0 + 1, by linarith, ?_⟩
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore] at hv
    exfalso
    have hmem : v ∈ slabFiber C t t := by
      refine ⟨hv.1, ?_⟩
      simp [hv.2.1]
    have hd := hR₀ hmem
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall] at hd
    have hle : R₀ ≤ max R₀ 0 := le_max_left R₀ 0
    have := hv.2.2
    linarith
  · intro hv
    exact hv.elim

name: Submission.not_chartBandPlaneWindingInputs_merge
statement:
theorem not_chartBandPlaneWindingInputs_merge
    {a : ℕ} (KB : ProductionMorseSaddleChartBandPlaneWindingInputs a)
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism (a + 2)}
    {center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2))}
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (ρ s : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (hne : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg ≠
        T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg)
    (heq : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos =
        T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hempty⟩ := exists_empty_criticalSliceExteriorCore
    C.toLevelCobordismData center (tcoord center)
  have hnot : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2)),
      x ∉ criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) r := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hempty] at hx
    exact hx.elim
  have hsub : criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
      (tcoord center) r ⊆ slabRegularSet C.G := fun x hx => (hnot x hx).elim
  obtain ⟨R₀⟩ := exists_compactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
    (isCompact_criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
      (tcoord center) r) hsub
  obtain ⟨R, hsafe⟩ := R₀.exists_large_safeTime_of_empty hempty (s ^ 2)
  obtain ⟨hmerge, -⟩ :=
    KB T hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos r hr R hsafe
  obtain ⟨F, -⟩ := hmerge hne heq
  exact hnot _ (F.coreArc₁_mem 0)

name: Submission.not_chartBandPlaneWindingInputs_split
statement:
theorem not_chartBandPlaneWindingInputs_split
    {a : ℕ} (KB : ProductionMorseSaddleChartBandPlaneWindingInputs a)
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism (a + 2)}
    {center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2))}
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (ρ s : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (hne : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos ≠
        T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos)
    (heq : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg =
        T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg) :
    False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hempty⟩ := exists_empty_criticalSliceExteriorCore
    C.toLevelCobordismData center (tcoord center)
  have hnot : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2)),
      x ∉ criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) r := by
    intro x hx
    rw [hempty] at hx
    exact hx.elim
  have hsub : criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
      (tcoord center) r ⊆ slabRegularSet C.G := fun x hx => (hnot x hx).elim
  obtain ⟨R₀⟩ := exists_compactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
    (isCompact_criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
      (tcoord center) r) hsub
  obtain ⟨R, hsafe⟩ := R₀.exists_large_safeTime_of_empty hempty (s ^ 2)
  obtain ⟨-, hsplit⟩ :=
    KB T hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos r hr R hsafe
  obtain ⟨F, -⟩ := hsplit hne heq
  exact hnot _ (F.coreArc₁_mem 0)

name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_chartBandCoverAmbient
statement:
theorem productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_chartBandCoverAmbient
    {a : ℕ} (KB : ProductionMorseSaddleChartBandCoverAmbientInputs a) :
    ProductionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies a
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y SX SY SC D t ht hpositive hindex
  have hcov : 0 < (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius_pos
  have hsafe : D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 ≤
      (D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).safeTime := by
    rw [D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField_safeTime t ht]
    have h := D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime t ht
    rwa [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)] at h
  have hcoverprop : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2)),
      dist v (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius →
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖u‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius ∧
          (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u = v :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).covers_fiber.choose_spec.2
  obtain ⟨hmergeCase, hsplitCase⟩ :=
    KB (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht)
      (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht)
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2) (by linarith)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht) hsafe
      (fun v hv hzero => hcoverprop v (by linarith) hzero)
      (fun u hu =>
        D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink_param_dist_lt_half_cover t ht hu)
      (by
        have h := D.chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_half_cover t ht
        rw [D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField_base t ht]
        exact h)
  have hdim : 3 ≤ a + 2 + 1 := by omega
  have hcircle := productionMorseSaddleChartCircleFrameClassOne a
    (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  constructor
  · intro Htop
    obtain ⟨F, H, hreg, hHclosed⟩ := hmergeCase Htop.negative_ne Htop.positive_eq
    have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) F H hreg hHclosed
    exact ⟨orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim F
      (F.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
        (hF.trans hcircle))⟩
  · intro Htop
    obtain ⟨F, H, hreg, hHclosed⟩ := hsplitCase Htop.positive_ne Htop.negative_eq
    have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) F H hreg hHclosed
    exact ⟨orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim F
      (F.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
        (hF.trans hcircle))⟩

name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleSupplies_of_chartBandCoverAmbient
statement:
theorem productionMorseSaddleSupplies_of_chartBandCoverAmbient
    {a : ℕ} (KB : ProductionMorseSaddleChartBandCoverAmbientInputs a) :

proof:

name: Submission.chartWindingLoop_forces_core_chart_point
proof:
:= by
  have hK0 := F.coreArc₁_mem 0
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore] at hK0
  
  have htb : tbefore = tcoord center + F.dbefore := by
    have h1 := R.tcoord_flow (F.coreArc₁_mem 0) F.dbefore_safe
    rw [F.coreArc₁_before 0, tcoord_spaceTime, hK0.2.1] at h1
    exact h1
  have hta : tafter = tcoord center + F.dafter := by
    have h1 := R.tcoord_flow (F.coreArc₁_mem 0) F.dafter_safe
    rw [F.coreArc₁_after 0, tcoord_spaceTime, hK0.2.1] at h1
    exact h1
  have hopp : F.dbefore + F.dafter = 0 := by
    linarith only [htb, hta, hsym]
  
  set w : I := ⟨1 / 2, by constructor <;> norm_num⟩ with hw
  have hwval : (w : ℝ) = 1 / 2 := rfl
  have hzero : (1 - (w : ℝ)) * F.dbefore + (w : ℝ) * F.dafter = 0 := by
    rw [hwval]
    linarith
  have hconn : ((F.ambientConnector₀ w :
      ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2))) = F.coreArc₁ 0 := by
    rw [SaddleFlowBandMarking.ambientConnector₀_coe, hzero]
    exact R.base.flow_zero _
  
  have hsub : Set.range F.ambientConnector₀ ⊆ Set.range F.ambientBandLoop := by
    unfold SaddleFlowBandMarking.ambientBandLoop
    simp only [Path.trans_range, Path.symm_range]
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_union]
    tauto
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ := hsub ⟨w, rfl⟩
  have hcurve : F.ambientBandCurve u₀ = F.coreArc₁ 0 := by
    show ((F.ambientBandLoop u₀ :
      ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2))) = F.coreArc₁ 0
    rw [hu₀]
    exact hconn
  refine ⟨W.chartMap u₀, W.norm_lt u₀, ?_⟩
  have hch := W.chart u₀
  rw [hcurve] at hch
  exact hch

name: Submission.not_chartWindingLoop_of_chart_inside_ball
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hpu⟩ := chartWindingLoop_forces_core_chart_point F hsym W
  have hK0 := F.coreArc₁_mem 0
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore] at hK0
  have h1 := hchart u hu
  rw [hpu] at h1
  linarith [hK0.2.2]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.contDiff_leftCutoff
statement: lemma contDiff_leftCutoff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ leftCutoff
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.contDiff_rightCutoff
statement: lemma contDiff_rightCutoff : ContDiff ℝ ∞ rightCutoff
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.contDiff_heightLeft
statement: lemma contDiff_heightLeft : ContDiff ℝ ∞ heightLeft
proof:
:= by
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_leftCutoff).mul contDiff_const).add
    (contDiff_leftCutoff.mul (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.contDiff_heightRight
