name: Submission.StandardSaddle.leftCutoff_eq_one
statement: lemma leftCutoff_eq_one {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 8 ≤ t) : leftCutoff t = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
  linarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.rightCutoff_eq_zero
statement: lemma rightCutoff_eq_zero {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 5 / 8) : rightCutoff t = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
  linarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.heightLeft_eq_linear
statement:
lemma heightLeft_eq_linear {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 8 ≤ t) :
    heightLeft t = t - 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [heightLeft, leftCutoff_eq_one ht]
  ring

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.heightRight_eq_linear
statement:
lemma heightRight_eq_linear {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 5 / 8) :
    heightRight t = t - 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [heightRight, rightCutoff_eq_zero ht]
  ring

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.height_eq_linear
statement:
lemma height_eq_linear {t : ℝ} (ht₀ : 3 / 8 ≤ t) (ht₁ : t ≤ 5 / 8) :
    height t = t - 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [height]
  split_ifs
  · exact heightLeft_eq_linear ht₀
  · exact heightRight_eq_linear ht₁

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.contDiff_height
statement: theorem contDiff_height : ContDiff ℝ ∞ height
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro t
  rcases lt_trichotomy t (1 / 2) with ht | ht | ht
  · refine contDiff_heightLeft.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Iio_mem_nhds ht) fun s hs => by
      change s < 1 / 2 at hs
      rw [height, if_pos hs]
  · have hlinear : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => s - 1 / 2) :=
      contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const
    refine hlinear.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    have hmem : t ∈ Ioo (3 / 8 : ℝ) (5 / 8 : ℝ) := by
      rw [ht]
      norm_num
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hmem) fun s hs => by
      rw [height_eq_linear hs.1.le hs.2.le]
  · refine contDiff_heightRight.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds ht) fun s hs => by
      rw [height, if_neg (not_lt.mpr hs.le)]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.height_of_le_quarter
statement: lemma height_of_le_quarter {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 4) : height t = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : t < 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hcut : leftCutoff t = 0 := by
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    linarith
  rw [height, if_pos hhalf, heightLeft, hcut]
  ring

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.height_of_threeQuarter_le
statement: lemma height_of_threeQuarter_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t) : height t = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : ¬ t < 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hcut : rightCutoff t = 1 := by
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    linarith
  rw [height, if_neg hhalf, heightRight, hcut]
  ring

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.height_neg_of_lt_half
statement: lemma height_neg_of_lt_half {t : ℝ} (ht : t < 1 / 2) : height t < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [height, if_pos ht, heightLeft]
  have hc0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (8 * (t - 1 / 4))
  have hc1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (8 * (t - 1 / 4))
  change (1 - leftCutoff t) * (-1) + leftCutoff t * (t - 1 / 2) < 0
  have htlin : t - 1 / 2 < 0 := sub_neg.mpr ht
  by_cases hc : leftCutoff t = 1
  · rw [hc]
    simpa using htlin
  · have hc' : leftCutoff t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hc1 hc
    have hfirst : (1 - leftCutoff t) * (-1) < 0 :=
      mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sub_pos.mpr hc') (by norm_num)
    have hsecond : leftCutoff t * (t - 1 / 2) ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hc0 htlin.le
    linarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.height_pos_of_half_lt
statement: lemma height_pos_of_half_lt {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 / 2 < t) : 0 < height t
proof:
:= by
  rw [height, if_neg (not_lt.mpr ht.le), heightRight]
  have hc0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (8 * (t - 5 / 8))
  have hc1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (8 * (t - 5 / 8))
  change 0 < (1 - rightCutoff t) * (t - 1 / 2) + rightCutoff t
  have htlin : 0 < t - 1 / 2 := sub_pos.mpr ht
  by_cases hc : rightCutoff t = 1
  · rw [hc]
    norm_num
  · have hc' : rightCutoff t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hc1 hc
    have hfirst : 0 < (1 - rightCutoff t) * (t - 1 / 2) :=
      mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hc') htlin
    have hsecond : 0 ≤ rightCutoff t := hc0
    exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg hfirst hsecond

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.height_half
statement: @[simp] lemma height_half : height (1 / 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [height_eq_linear (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  ring

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.height_eq_zero_iff
statement: lemma height_eq_zero_iff {t : ℝ} : height t = 0 ↔ t = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases lt_trichotomy t (1 / 2) with ht | ht | ht
    · exact False.elim ((height_neg_of_lt_half ht).ne h)
    · exact ht
    · exact False.elim ((height_pos_of_half_lt ht).ne' h)
  · rintro rfl
    exact height_half

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.hasDerivAt_height_half
statement: lemma hasDerivAt_height_half : HasDerivAt height 1 (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply (hasDerivAt_id (1 / 2)).sub_const (1 / 2) |>.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
    (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (3 / 8) (5 / 8) by norm_num))
    fun t ht => height_eq_linear ht.1.le ht.2.le

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.neg_one_le_height
statement: lemma neg_one_le_height (t : ℝ) : -1 ≤ height t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : t ≤ 1 / 4
  · rw [height_of_le_quarter ht]
  · by_cases hh : t < 1 / 2
    · rw [height, if_pos hh, heightLeft]
      have hc0 : 0 ≤ leftCutoff t := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      have hc1 : leftCutoff t ≤ 1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
      have hlin : 0 ≤ t - 1 / 2 + 1 := by linarith
      have hp : 0 ≤ leftCutoff t * (t - 1 / 2 + 1) := mul_nonneg hc0 hlin
      nlinarith
    · rw [height, if_neg hh, heightRight]
      have hc0 : 0 ≤ rightCutoff t := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      have hc1 : rightCutoff t ≤ 1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
      have hlin : 0 ≤ t - 1 / 2 := by linarith
      have hfirst : 0 ≤ (1 - rightCutoff t) * (t - 1 / 2) :=
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hc1) hlin
      linarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.height_le_one
statement: lemma height_le_one (t : ℝ) : height t ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t
  · rw [height_of_threeQuarter_le ht]
  · by_cases hh : t < 1 / 2
    · exact (height_neg_of_lt_half hh).le.trans (by norm_num)
    · rw [height, if_neg hh, heightRight]
      have hc0 : 0 ≤ rightCutoff t := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
      have hc1 : rightCutoff t ≤ 1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
      have hlin0 : 0 ≤ t - 1 / 2 := by linarith
      have hlin1 : t - 1 / 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith
      have hp : 0 ≤ (1 - rightCutoff t) * (1 - (t - 1 / 2)) :=
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hc1) (sub_nonneg.mpr hlin1)
      nlinarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_eq

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.contDiff_cassiniQ
statement: lemma contDiff_cassiniQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cassiniQ m)
proof:
:= by
  exact (((((EuclideanSpace.proj (planeFirst m) : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.sub
      contDiff_const).pow 2).add
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj (planeSecond m) : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.pow 2)).mul
    ((((EuclideanSpace.proj (planeFirst m) : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.add
      contDiff_const).pow 2).add
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj (planeSecond m) : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.pow 2))).sub
    contDiff_const

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.contDiff_levelMap
statement: lemma contDiff_levelMap (a : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (levelMap m a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => simpa using (contDiff_cassiniQ m).sub contDiff_const
  | cast j =>
      simpa using (EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc.castSucc : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.eventMap_spaceTime
statement:
lemma eventMap_spaceTime (x : E) (t : ℝ) :

proof:

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.contDiff_eventMap
statement: lemma contDiff_eventMap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (eventMap m)
proof:

  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      simp only [eventMap, levelMap_apply_last]
      exact (contDiff_cassiniQ m).comp (initCLM (m + 3)).contDiff |>.sub
        ((contDiff_height.comp contDiff_vertC).div_const 2)
  | cast j =>
      simp only [eventMap, levelMap_apply_castSucc, initCLM_apply]
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_zero

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.transverse_eq_zero_of_eventMap_eq_zero

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_eq_height_of_eventMap_eq_zero

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.fderiv_eventMap_apply_castSucc
statement:
lemma fderiv_eventMap_apply_castSucc (v h : E') (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h j.castSucc = h j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc
  let inProj : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc
  have hG : HasFDerivAt (eventMap m) (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v) v :=
    ((contDiff_eventMap m).differentiable infty_ne_zero v).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun w => eventMap m w j.castSucc)
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v)) v :=
    by exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (eventMap m v) j.castSucc).comp v hG
  have hcoord : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E' => w j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc)
      inProj v := inProj.hasFDerivAt
  have hfun : (fun w => eventMap m w j.castSucc) =
      fun w : E' => w j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc := by
    funext w
    simp [eventMap]
  have hmaps : outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v) = inProj := by
    rw [← hcomp.fderiv, hfun, hcoord.fderiv]
  exact congrArg (fun A : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ => A h) hmaps

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.fderiv_eventMap_apply_last
statement:
lemma fderiv_eventMap_apply_last (v h : E') :
    fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h (Fin.last (m + 1)) =
      4 * v (planeFirst m).castSucc *
          ((v (planeFirst m).castSucc) ^ 2 + (v (planeSecond m).castSucc) ^ 2 - 1) *
          h (planeFirst m).castSucc +
        4 * v (planeSecond m).castSucc *
          ((v (planeFirst m).castSucc) ^ 2 + (v (planeSecond m).castSucc) ^ 2 + 1) *
          h (planeSecond m).castSucc -
        (deriv height (vertC v) / 2) * h (Fin.last (m + 3))
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (m + 1))
  have hG : HasFDerivAt (eventMap m) (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v) v :=
    ((contDiff_eventMap m).differentiable infty_ne_zero v).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun w => eventMap m w (Fin.last (m + 1)))
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v)) v :=
    by exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (eventMap m v) (Fin.last (m + 1))).comp v hG
  let pA : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (planeFirst m).castSucc
  let pB : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (planeSecond m).castSucc
  let pT : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (m + 3))
  have hA := (pA.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt pA pA v)
  have hB := (pB.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt pB pB v)
  have hq :=
    ((((hA.sub_const 1).pow 2).add (hB.pow 2)).mul
      (((hA.add_const 1).pow 2).add (hB.pow 2))).sub_const 1
  change HasFDerivAt
    (fun w : E' =>
      ((pA w - 1) ^ 2 + pB w ^ 2) * ((pA w + 1) ^ 2 + pB w ^ 2) - 1) _ v at hq
  have hb : HasDerivAt height (deriv height (vertC v)) (vertC v) :=
    (contDiff_height.differentiable infty_ne_zero (vertC v)).hasDerivAt
  have hT := (hb.div_const 2).hasFDerivAt.comp v
    (pT.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt pT pT v)
  have hdirect := hq.sub hT
  change HasFDerivAt
    (fun w : E' =>
      ((pA w - 1) ^ 2 + pB w ^ 2) * ((pA w + 1) ^ 2 + pB w ^ 2) - 1 -
        height (vertC w) / 2) _ v at hdirect
  have hfun : (fun w => eventMap m w (Fin.last (m + 1))) = fun w : E' =>
      (((pA w - 1) ^ 2 + (pB w) ^ 2) * ((pA w + 1) ^ 2 + (pB w) ^ 2) - 1) -
        height (vertC w) / 2 := by
    funext w
    simp [eventMap, cassiniQ, pA, pB]
  have happ := congrArg (fun A : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ => A h) hcomp.fderiv.symm
  rw [hfun, hdirect.fderiv] at happ
  simp [outProj, pA, pB, pT] at happ
  convert happ using 1 <;> ring

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.eventMap_regular
statement:
theorem eventMap_regular (v : E') (hv : eventMap m v = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  let a : ℝ := v (planeFirst m).castSucc
  let b : ℝ := v (planeSecond m).castSucc
  let r : ℝ := a ^ 2 + b ^ 2
  let ca : ℝ := 4 * a * (r - 1)
  let cb : ℝ := 4 * b * (r + 1)
  by_cases ha : ca ≠ 0
  · let h : E' := transverseLift m y +
        EuclideanSpace.single (planeFirst m).castSucc (y (Fin.last (m + 1)) / ca)
    refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext i
    induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | cast j =>
        change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h j.castSucc = y j.castSucc
        rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_castSucc]
        have hjA : (j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) ≠
            (planeFirst m).castSucc := by
          simp [planeFirst, Fin.ext_iff]
          omega
        simp [h, PiLp.single_apply, hjA]
    | last =>
        change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h (Fin.last (m + 1)) = y (Fin.last (m + 1))
        rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_last]
        simp only [h, PiLp.add_apply, transverseLift_apply_planeFirst,
          transverseLift_apply_planeSecond, transverseLift_apply_time,
          PiLp.single_apply]
        have hAB : ((planeFirst m).castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) ≠
            (planeSecond m).castSucc := by
          simp [planeFirst, planeSecond, Fin.ext_iff]
        have hAT : ((planeFirst m).castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) ≠ Fin.last (m + 3) := by
          simp [planeFirst, Fin.ext_iff]
        simp only [if_true, zero_add]
        rw [if_neg hAB.symm, if_neg hAT.symm]
        simp only [mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero]
        change ca * (y (Fin.last (m + 1)) / ca) = y (Fin.last (m + 1))
        field_simp
  · by_cases hb : cb ≠ 0
    · let h : E' := transverseLift m y +
          EuclideanSpace.single (planeSecond m).castSucc (y (Fin.last (m + 1)) / cb)
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
      funext i
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | cast j =>
          change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h j.castSucc = y j.castSucc
          rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_castSucc]
          have hjB : (j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) ≠
              (planeSecond m).castSucc := by
            simp [planeSecond, Fin.ext_iff]
            omega
          simp [h, PiLp.single_apply, hjB]
      | last =>
          change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h (Fin.last (m + 1)) = y (Fin.last (m + 1))
          rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_last]
          simp only [h, PiLp.add_apply, transverseLift_apply_planeFirst,
            transverseLift_apply_planeSecond, transverseLift_apply_time,
            PiLp.single_apply]
          have hBA : ((planeSecond m).castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) ≠
              (planeFirst m).castSucc := by
            simp [planeFirst, planeSecond, Fin.ext_iff]
          have hBT : ((planeSecond m).castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) ≠ Fin.last (m + 3) := by
            simp [planeSecond, Fin.ext_iff]
          simp only [if_true, zero_add]
          rw [if_neg hBA.symm, if_neg hBT.symm]
          simp only [mul_zero, add_zero, zero_add, sub_zero]
          change cb * (y (Fin.last (m + 1)) / cb) = y (Fin.last (m + 1))
          field_simp
    · have hca : ca = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp ha
      have hcb : cb = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hb
      have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by
        dsimp [r]
        positivity
      have hb0 : b = 0 := by
        dsimp [cb] at hcb
        have hrp : 0 < r + 1 := by linarith
        rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hcb with h4 | hrest
        · norm_num at h4
          exact h4
        · exact False.elim ((ne_of_gt hrp) hrest)
      have ha0 : a = 0 := by
        by_contra hane
        have hr1 : r = 1 := by
          dsimp [ca] at hca
          rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hca with h4 | hrest
          · norm_num at h4
            exact False.elim (hane h4)
          · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hrest
        have hq := cassiniQ_eq_height_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv
        have hqform := cassiniQ_eq m (initCLM (m + 3) v)
        have hlow := neg_one_le_height (vertC v)
        dsimp [a, b, r] at hr1 hb0
        rw [hqform] at hq
        simp [radiusSq] at hq
        nlinarith
      have ht : vertC v = 1 / 2 := by
        apply height_eq_zero_iff.mp
        have hq := cassiniQ_eq_height_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv
        have hqform := cassiniQ_eq m (initCLM (m + 3) v)
        rw [hqform] at hq
        simp [radiusSq] at hq
        dsimp [a, b] at ha0 hb0
        rw [ha0, hb0] at hq
        linarith
      let h : E' := transverseLift m y +
        EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.last (m + 3)) (-2 * y (Fin.last (m + 1)))
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
      funext i
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | cast j =>
          change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h j.castSucc = y j.castSucc
          rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_castSucc]
          have hjT : (j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) ≠
              Fin.last (m + 3) := by
            simp [Fin.ext_iff]
            omega
          simp [h, PiLp.single_apply, hjT]
      | last =>
          change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h (Fin.last (m + 1)) = y (Fin.last (m + 1))
          rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_last]
          simp only [h, PiLp.add_apply, transverseLift_apply_planeFirst,
            transverseLift_apply_planeSecond, transverseLift_apply_time,
            PiLp.single_apply]
          have hTA : (Fin.last (m + 3) : Fin (m + 4)) ≠ (planeFirst m).castSucc := by
            simp [planeFirst, Fin.ext_iff]
          have hTB : (Fin.last (m + 3) : Fin (m + 4)) ≠ (planeSecond m).castSucc := by
            simp [planeSecond, Fin.ext_iff]
          simp [hTA, hTB]
          rw [ht, hasDerivAt_height_half.deriv]
          ring

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.eventMap_spatial_bounded
statement:
lemma eventMap_spatial_bounded :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ v, eventMap m v = 0 → ‖initCLM (m + 3) v‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨2, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  have hq := cassiniQ_eq_height_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv
  have hqform := cassiniQ_eq m (initCLM (m + 3) v)
  rw [hqform] at hq
  simp [radiusSq] at hq
  have hupper := height_le_one (vertC v)
  let a : ℝ := v (planeFirst m).castSucc
  let b : ℝ := v (planeSecond m).castSucc
  let r : ℝ := a ^ 2 + b ^ 2
  have hr_nonneg : 0 ≤ r := by
    dsimp [r]
    positivity
  have hr_le : r ≤ 3 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hr_gt : 3 < r := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    dsimp [a, b, r] at hr_gt ⊢
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v (planeFirst m).castSucc),
      sq_nonneg (v (planeSecond m).castSucc)]
  have hnormsq : ‖initCLM (m + 3) v‖ ^ 2 = r := by
    rw [norm_sq_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [initCLM_apply]
    have hz : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), v j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc ^ 2 = 0 :=
      fun j => by
        rw [transverse_eq_zero_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv j, zero_pow (by norm_num)]
    simp only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
    rfl
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (initCLM (m + 3) v)]

name: Submission.FiberSign.pos_iff_of_path
statement:
theorem pos_iff_of_path (γ : C(I, E)) (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ X.fiber) :
    0 < S (γ 0) ↔ 0 < S (γ 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous fun t : I => S (γ t) := S.continuous.comp γ.continuous
  constructor
  · intro h0
    by_contra h1
    have h1neg : S (γ 1) < 0 := by
      have hle : S (γ 1) ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt h1
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle (S.nonzero (γ 1) (hγ 1))
    have hz : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (S (γ 1)) (S (γ 0)) := ⟨h1neg.le, h0.le⟩
    obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ :=
      intermediate_value_Icc' (show (0 : I) ≤ 1 by simp) hcont.continuousOn hz
    exact S.nonzero (γ t) (hγ t) ht
  · intro h1
    by_contra h0
    have h0neg : S (γ 0) < 0 := by
      have hle : S (γ 0) ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt h0
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle (S.nonzero (γ 0) (hγ 0))
    have hz : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (S (γ 0)) (S (γ 1)) := ⟨h0neg.le, h1.le⟩
    obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ :=
      intermediate_value_Icc (show (0 : I) ≤ 1 by simp) hcont.continuousOn hz
    exact S.nonzero (γ t) (hγ t) ht

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.transFun_middle
statement:
lemma transFun_middle
    {X₂ : FramedLevelSet n} {S₂ : FiberSign X₂}
    (C₁ : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    (C₂ : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₁ S₂)
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1))}
    (h1 : 5 / 12 < vertC v) (h2 : vertC v < 7 / 12) :
    transFun C₁ C₂ v = S₁ (initCLM (n + 1) v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [transFun]
  by_cases hv : vertC v < 1 / 2
  · rw [if_pos hv]
    have hcol := C₁.collar_one (initCLM (n + 1) v)
      (3 * vertC v + -(1 / 2)) (by linarith)
    change C₁ (spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v)
      (3 * vertC v + -(1 / 2))) = S₁ (initCLM (n + 1) v)
    exact hcol
  · rw [if_neg hv]
    have hcol := C₂.collar_zero (initCLM (n + 1) v)
      (3 * vertC v + -(3 / 2)) (by linarith)
    change C₂ (spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v)
      (3 * vertC v + -(3 / 2))) = S₁ (initCLM (n + 1) v)
    exact hcol

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.continuous_transFun
statement:
lemma continuous_transFun
    {X₂ : FramedLevelSet n} {S₂ : FiberSign X₂}
    (C₁ : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    (C₂ : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₁ S₂) :
    Continuous (transFun C₁ C₂)
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro v
  rcases lt_trichotomy (vertC v) (1 / 2) with hv | hv | hv
  · refine (C₁.continuous.comp
      (contDiff_reparamMap 3 (-(1 / 2))).continuous).continuousAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_vert_lt (1 / 2)).mem_nhds hv)
      fun w hw => if_pos hw
  · refine (S₁.continuous.comp (initCLM (n + 1)).continuous).continuousAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((isOpen_vert_between (5 / 12) (7 / 12)).mem_nhds
        ⟨by rw [hv]; norm_num, by rw [hv]; norm_num⟩) ?_
    intro w hw
    exact transFun_middle C₁ C₂ hw.1 hw.2
  · refine (C₂.continuous.comp
      (contDiff_reparamMap 3 (-(3 / 2))).continuous).continuousAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_lt_vert (1 / 2)).mem_nhds hv)
      fun w hw => if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hw))

name: Submission.PieceKill.rotTo_uPt_mulVec_apply
statement:
theorem rotTo_uPt_mulVec_apply {N : ℕ} {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (w : Fin N → ℝ) (j : Fin N) :
    (((rotTo (uPt p) (uPt q) : SOGroup N) :
        Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) *ᵥ w) j =
      if j = p then -w q else if j = q then w p else w j

name: Submission.PieceKill.rotAmb_mulVec_apply
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hA1 : iA m ≠ i1 m := by
    intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp at this; omega
  have hA0 : iA m ≠ i0 m := iA_ne_i0 m
  have hAB : iA m ≠ iB m := iA_ne_iB m
  have h0B : i0 m ≠ iB m := i0_ne_iB m
  have h01 : i0 m ≠ i1 m := i0_ne_i1 m
  have hB1 : iB m ≠ i1 m := iB_ne_i1 m
  by_cases he : P.eps = 1
  · have hval : ((rotAmb m P : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *ᵥ x =
        ((rotTo (uPt (iA m)) (uPt (i0 m)) : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
          Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *ᵥ
        (((rotTo (uPt (iB m)) (uPt (i1 m)) : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
          Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *ᵥ x) := by
      rw [rotAmb, if_pos he, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      rfl
    rw [hval]
    rw [rotTo_uPt_mulVec_apply (iA_ne_i0 m)]
    rw [rotTo_uPt_mulVec_apply (iB_ne_i1 m),
      rotTo_uPt_mulVec_apply (iB_ne_i1 m),
      rotTo_uPt_mulVec_apply (iB_ne_i1 m)]
    simp only [if_neg (fun h : i0 m = iB m => h0B h),
      if_neg (fun h : i0 m = i1 m => h01 h),
      if_neg (fun h : iA m = iB m => hAB h),
      if_neg (fun h : iA m = i1 m => hA1 h)]
    
    by_cases hjA : j = iA m
    · have hn0 : ¬j = i0 m := by rw [hjA]; exact hA0
      have hn1 : ¬j = i1 m := by rw [hjA]; exact hA1
      simp only [if_pos hjA, if_neg hn0, if_neg hn1]
    · by_cases hj0 : j = i0 m
      · have hn1 : ¬j = i1 m := by rw [hj0]; exact h01
        simp only [if_neg hjA, if_pos hj0, if_neg hn1]
      · by_cases hjB : j = iB m
        · have hn1 : ¬j = i1 m := by rw [hjB]; exact hB1
          simp only [if_neg hjA, if_neg hj0, if_pos hjB, if_neg hn1, he,
            one_mul]
        · by_cases hj1 : j = i1 m
          · simp only [if_neg hjA, if_neg hj0, if_neg hjB, if_pos hj1, he,
              one_mul]
          · simp only [if_neg hjA, if_neg hj0, if_neg hjB, if_neg hj1]
  · have he' : P.eps = -1 := P.heps.resolve_left he
    have hval : ((rotAmb m P : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *ᵥ x =
        ((rotTo (uPt (iA m)) (uPt (i0 m)) : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
          Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *ᵥ
        (((rotTo (uPt (i1 m)) (uPt (iB m)) : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
          Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *ᵥ x) := by
      rw [rotAmb, if_neg he, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec]
      rfl
    rw [hval]
    rw [rotTo_uPt_mulVec_apply (iA_ne_i0 m)]
    rw [rotTo_uPt_mulVec_apply (i1_ne_iB m),
      rotTo_uPt_mulVec_apply (i1_ne_iB m),
      rotTo_uPt_mulVec_apply (i1_ne_iB m)]
    simp only [if_neg (fun h : i0 m = i1 m => h01 h),
      if_neg (fun h : i0 m = iB m => h0B h),
      if_neg (fun h : iA m = i1 m => hA1 h),
      if_neg (fun h : iA m = iB m => hAB h)]
    by_cases hjA : j = iA m
    · have hn0 : ¬j = i0 m := by rw [hjA]; exact hA0
      have hn1 : ¬j = i1 m := by rw [hjA]; exact hA1
      simp only [if_pos hjA, if_neg hn0, if_neg hn1]
    · by_cases hj0 : j = i0 m
      · have hn1 : ¬j = i1 m := by rw [hj0]; exact h01
        simp only [if_neg hjA, if_pos hj0, if_neg hn1]
      · by_cases hj1 : j = i1 m
        · have hnB : ¬j = iB m := by rw [hj1]; exact i1_ne_iB m
          simp only [if_neg hjA, if_neg hj0, if_pos hj1, if_neg hnB, he']
          ring
        · by_cases hjB : j = iB m
          · simp only [if_neg hjA, if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1, if_pos hjB, he']
            ring
          · simp only [if_neg hjA, if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1, if_neg hjB]

name: Submission.PieceKill.rho_one
statement: theorem rho_one (P : Params m) (x : E) : rho m P 1 x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [rho, show (1 : ℝ) - 1 = 0 by norm_num, (pathA m P).zero,
    SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one]
  rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.rho_zero_apply
proof:
:= by
  have h : rho m P 0 x = SOFrameGauge.toCLM (rotAmb m P) x := by
    rw [rho, show (1 : ℝ) - 0 = 1 by norm_num, (pathA m P).one]
  rw [h]
  have hc : SOFrameGauge.toCLM (rotAmb m P) x j =
      (((rotAmb m P : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x) j := by
    rw [Matrix.mulVec]
    exact SOFrameGauge.toCLM_apply_coord _ _ _
  rw [hc, rotAmb_mulVec_apply m P hm]

name: Submission.PieceKill.normSq_rho
statement:
theorem normSq_rho (P : Params m) (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    CompactBirth.normSq (rho m P s x) = CompactBirth.normSq x
proof:
:=
  normSq_toCLM _ x

name: Submission.PieceKill.tp_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tp_apply (w : F) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    tp m w j = w j.castSucc
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.tp_add
statement: theorem tp_add (w w' : F) : tp m (w + w') = tp m w + tp m w'
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro j
  simp [tp, PiLp.add_apply]

name: Submission.PieceKill.tp_smul
statement: theorem tp_smul (c : ℝ) (w : F) : tp m (c • w) = c • tp m w
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro j
  simp [tp, PiLp.smul_apply]

name: Submission.PieceKill.lam_pos
statement: theorem lam_pos {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) : 0 < lam s
proof:
:= by
  rw [lam]; linarith

name: Submission.PieceKill.mact_apply_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem mact_apply_last (P : Params m) (s : ℝ) (w : F) :
    mact m P s w (Fin.last (m + 1)) = lam s * w (Fin.last (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  simp [mact]

name: Submission.PieceKill.mact_apply_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] theorem mact_apply_castSucc (P : Params m) (s : ℝ) (w : F)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    mact m P s w i.castSucc =
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathT m P).Q (1 - s)) (tp m w) i
proof:
:= by
  simp [mact]

name: Submission.PieceKill.mact_one
statement: theorem mact_one (P : Params m) (w : F) : mact m P 1 w = w
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro j
  induction j using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      rw [mact_apply_last, lam]
      norm_num
  | cast i =>
      rw [mact_apply_castSucc, show (1 : ℝ) - 1 = 0 by norm_num,
        (pathT m P).zero, SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one]
      rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.mact_zero_castSucc
statement:
theorem mact_zero_castSucc (P : Params m) (w : F) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    mact m P 0 w i.castSucc =
      blockEta m P.eta P.eps i * w ((finRotate (m + 1) i).castSucc)
proof:
:= by
  rw [mact_apply_castSucc, show (1 : ℝ) - 0 = 1 by norm_num, (pathT m P).one]
  rw [SOFrameGauge.toCLM_apply_coord]
  have hterm : ∀ j' : Fin (m + 1),
      ((P.block m : SOGroup (m + 1)) :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) i j' * tp m w j' =
      if j' = finRotate (m + 1) i then
        blockEta m P.eta P.eps i * tp m w j' else 0 := by
    intro j'
    have hcoe : ((P.block m : SOGroup (m + 1)) :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) i j' =
        if j' = finRotate (m + 1) i then blockEta m P.eta P.eps i else 0 :=
      rfl
    rw [hcoe]
    by_cases hj : j' = finRotate (m + 1) i
    · rw [if_pos hj, if_pos hj]
    · rw [if_neg hj, if_neg hj, zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j' _ => hterm j']
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (finRotate (m + 1) i)
    (fun j' => blockEta m P.eta P.eps i * tp m w j')]
  simp

name: Submission.PieceKill.mactInv_apply_last
statement:
@[simp] theorem mactInv_apply_last (P : Params m) (s : ℝ) (y : F) :
    mactInv m P s y (Fin.last (m + 1)) = y (Fin.last (m + 1)) / lam s
proof:
:= by
  simp [mactInv]

name: Submission.PieceKill.mactInv_apply_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] theorem mactInv_apply_castSucc (P : Params m) (s : ℝ) (y : F)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    mactInv m P s y i.castSucc =
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathT m P).Q (1 - s))⁻¹ (tp m y) i
proof:
:= by
  simp [mactInv]

name: Submission.PieceKill.mact_surjective
statement:
theorem mact_surjective (P : Params m) {s : ℝ} (hs : 0 ≤ s) :
    Function.Surjective (mact m P s)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  refine ⟨mactInv m P s y, ?_⟩
  have htp : tp m (mactInv m P s y) =
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathT m P).Q (1 - s))⁻¹ (tp m y) := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro j
    rw [tp_apply, mactInv_apply_castSucc]
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro j
  induction j using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      rw [mact_apply_last, mactInv_apply_last,
        mul_div_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt (lam_pos hs))]
  | cast i =>
      rw [mact_apply_castSucc, htp, SOFrameGauge.toCLM_apply_inv, tp_apply]

name: Submission.PieceKill.level_one
statement:
theorem level_one (P : Params m) (x : E) :
    level m P 1 x = CompactBirth.levelMap (m + 1) 1 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [level, rho_one, mact_one]
  rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.level_eq_background
proof:
:= by
  rw [level, CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_one hx]
  simp

name: Submission.PieceKill.normSq_eq_radialSq_of_transverse
statement:
theorem normSq_eq_radialSq_of_transverse (y : E)
    (htr : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), y (i.castSucc.castSucc) = 0) :
    CompactBirth.normSq y = StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) y
proof:
:= by
  unfold CompactBirth.normSq StandardBirth.radialSq
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  have hz : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), y (i.castSucc.castSucc) ^ 2 = 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [htr i]
    norm_num
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hz i]
  simp [StandardBirth.radialFirst, StandardBirth.radialSecond]

name: Submission.PieceKill.circleMap_zero_normSq
proof:
:= by
  have htr : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), y (i.castSucc.castSucc) = 0 := by
    intro i
    have h := congrArg (fun q : F => q i.castSucc) hy
    simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h
    rwa [StandardBirth.circleMap_apply_castSucc] at h
  have hrad : StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) y = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun q : F => q (Fin.last (m + 1))) hy
    simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h
    rw [StandardBirth.circleMap_apply_last] at h
    linarith
  rw [normSq_eq_radialSq_of_transverse m y htr, hrad]

name: Submission.PieceKill.cutoff_pos_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem cutoff_pos_of_ne_zero {y : E} (h : CompactBirth.cutoff y ≠ 0) :
    2 < CompactBirth.normSq y
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn
  exact h (CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero (not_lt.mp hn))

name: Submission.PieceKill.level_zero_analysis
statement:
theorem level_zero_analysis (P : Params m) {s : ℝ} {x : E} (hs : 0 ≤ s)
    (h : level m P s x = 0) :
    CompactBirth.cutoff x = 0 ∧
      StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1 (rho m P s x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  set u := CompactBirth.cutoff x with hu
  set y := rho m P s x with hy
  set w := StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1 y with hwdef
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ u := CompactBirth.cutoff_nonneg x
  have hu1 : u ≤ 1 := CompactBirth.cutoff_le_one x
  
  have hlast : (1 - u) * (lam s * w (Fin.last (m + 1))) + u = 0 := by
    have hcoord := congrArg (fun q : F => q (Fin.last (m + 1))) h
    simp only [level, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      PiLp.zero_apply] at hcoord
    rw [mact_apply_last, CompactBirth.background_apply_last] at hcoord
    rw [← hu, ← hy, ← hwdef] at hcoord
    linarith [hcoord]
  have hune : u ≠ 1 := by
    intro hueq
    rw [hueq] at hlast
    norm_num at hlast
  have hult : u < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hu1 hune
  
  have htrans : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1),
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathT m P).Q (1 - s)) (tp m w) i = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hcoord := congrArg (fun q : F => q i.castSucc) h
    simp only [level, PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      PiLp.zero_apply] at hcoord
    rw [mact_apply_castSucc, CompactBirth.background_apply_castSucc] at hcoord
    rw [← hu, ← hy, ← hwdef] at hcoord
    have hfac : (1 - u) ≠ 0 := by linarith
    have hprod0 : (1 - u) *
        SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathT m P).Q (1 - s)) (tp m w) i = 0 := by
      linarith [hcoord]
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hprod0).resolve_left hfac
  have htpzero : tp m w = 0 := by
    have happ : SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathT m P).Q (1 - s)) (tp m w) = 0 := by
      apply PiLp.ext
      intro i
      rw [htrans i, PiLp.zero_apply]
    have hinj := (SOFrameGauge.toCLM_bijective ((pathT m P).Q (1 - s))).1
    apply hinj
    rw [happ, map_zero]
  have htr : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), y (i.castSucc.castSucc) = 0 := by
    intro i
    have hcoord := congrArg
      (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1)) => q i) htpzero
    simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hcoord
    rw [tp_apply] at hcoord
    rwa [hwdef, StandardBirth.circleMap_apply_castSucc] at hcoord
  have hnormrad : CompactBirth.normSq y = StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) y :=
    normSq_eq_radialSq_of_transverse m y htr
  have hnormxy : CompactBirth.normSq y = CompactBirth.normSq x := by
    rw [hy]
    exact normSq_rho m P s x
  have hwlast : w (Fin.last (m + 1)) = StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) y - 1 :=
    StandardBirth.circleMap_apply_last (m + 1) 1 y
  have hu0eq : u = 0 := by
    by_contra hune0
    have hgt : 2 < CompactBirth.normSq x := by
      apply cutoff_pos_of_ne_zero
      rw [← hu]
      exact hune0
    have hradgt : 2 < StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) y := by
      rw [← hnormrad, hnormxy]
      exact hgt
    have hlampos := lam_pos hs
    have hupos : 0 < u := lt_of_le_of_ne hu0 (Ne.symm hune0)
    rw [hwlast] at hlast
    have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - u := by linarith
    have h2 : (0 : ℝ) < StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) y - 1 := by linarith
    have h3 : (0 : ℝ) < lam s * (StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) y - 1) :=
      mul_pos hlampos h2
    have h4 : (0 : ℝ) < (1 - u) *
        (lam s * (StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) y - 1)) := mul_pos h1 h3
    linarith
  refine ⟨hu0eq, ?_⟩
  have hrad1 : StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) y = 1 := by
    rw [hu0eq, hwlast] at hlast
    have hlampos := lam_pos hs
    have hzero : lam s * (StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) y - 1) = 0 := by
      linarith
    have := (mul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hlampos)
    linarith
  show w = 0
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro j
  induction j using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      rw [hwdef, StandardBirth.circleMap_apply_last, hrad1, PiLp.zero_apply]
      ring
  | cast i =>
      rw [hwdef, StandardBirth.circleMap_apply_castSucc, htr i,
        PiLp.zero_apply]

name: Submission.PieceKill.rho_smooth
statement:
theorem rho_smooth (P : Params m) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => rho m P p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro j
  have heq : (fun p : ℝ × E => rho m P p.1 p.2 j) =
      fun p : ℝ × E => ∑ k, (((pathA m P).Q (1 - p.1) : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) j k * p.2 k := by
    funext p
    exact SOFrameGauge.toCLM_apply_coord _ _ _
  rw [heq]
  apply ContDiff.sum
  intro k _
  have hentry : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E =>
      (((pathA m P).Q (1 - p.1) : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) j k) :=
    ((pathA m P).smooth j k).comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_fst)
  exact hentry.mul ((EuclideanSpace.proj k :
    EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp contDiff_snd)

name: Submission.PieceKill.level_smooth
statement:
theorem level_smooth (P : Params m) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => level m P p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hcut : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => CompactBirth.cutoff p.2) :=
    CompactBirth.contDiff_cutoff.comp contDiff_snd
  have hcircle : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E =>
      StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1 (rho m P p.1 p.2)) :=
    (StandardBirth.contDiff_circleMap (m + 1) 1).comp (rho_smooth m P)
  have hmact : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E =>
      mact m P p.1 (StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1 (rho m P p.1 p.2))) := by
    rw [contDiff_piLp]
    intro j
    induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
        have heq : (fun p : ℝ × E =>
            mact m P p.1 (StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1
              (rho m P p.1 p.2)) (Fin.last (m + 1))) =
            fun p : ℝ × E => lam p.1 *
              (StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1 (rho m P p.1 p.2))
                (Fin.last (m + 1)) := by
          funext p
          rw [mact_apply_last]
        rw [heq]
        have hlam : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => lam p.1) := by
          unfold lam
          fun_prop
        exact hlam.mul ((EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (m + 1)) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hcircle)
    | cast i =>
        have heq : (fun p : ℝ × E =>
            mact m P p.1 (StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1
              (rho m P p.1 p.2)) i.castSucc) =
            fun p : ℝ × E => ∑ k,
              (((pathT m P).Q (1 - p.1) : SOGroup (m + 1)) :
                Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) i k *
              (StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1 (rho m P p.1 p.2))
                k.castSucc := by
          funext p
          rw [mact_apply_castSucc, SOFrameGauge.toCLM_apply_coord]
          exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => rfl
        rw [heq]
        apply ContDiff.sum
        intro k _
        have hentry : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E =>
            (((pathT m P).Q (1 - p.1) : SOGroup (m + 1)) :
              Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) i k) :=
          ((pathT m P).smooth i k).comp (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_fst)
        exact hentry.mul ((EuclideanSpace.proj k.castSucc :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hcircle)
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub hcut).smul hmact).add (hcut.smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.PieceKill.mactCLM_apply
statement:
theorem mactCLM_apply (P : Params m) (s : ℝ) (w : F) :
    mactCLM m P s w = mact m P s w
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.bigG_def
statement:
theorem bigG_def (P : Params m) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2 + 1 + 1))) :
    bigG m P v = level m P (normRamp (vertC v)) (initCLM (m + 3) v)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.bigG_spaceTime
statement:
theorem bigG_spaceTime (P : Params m) (x : E) (t : ℝ) :
    bigG m P (spaceTime x t) = level m P (normRamp t) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [bigG_def, initCLM_spaceTime, vertC_spaceTime]

name: Submission.PieceKill.bigG_smooth
statement: theorem bigG_smooth (P : Params m) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (bigG m P)
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2 + 1 + 1)) =>
        ((normRamp (vertC v), initCLM (m + 3) v) : ℝ × E)) :=
    (contDiff_normRamp.comp contDiff_vertC).prodMk (initCLM (m + 3)).contDiff
  show ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2 + 1 + 1)) =>
    level m P (normRamp (vertC v)) (initCLM (m + 3) v))
  simpa only [Function.comp_def] using (level_smooth m P).comp hpair

name: Submission.PieceKill.level_slice_surjective
statement:
theorem level_slice_surjective (P : Params m) {s₀ : ℝ} {x₀ : E}
    (hs : 0 ≤ s₀)
    (hw : StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1 (rho m P s₀ x₀) = 0) :
    Function.Surjective
      (fderiv ℝ (fun x' : E => level m P s₀ x') x₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hx₀normSq : CompactBirth.normSq x₀ = 1 := by
    have h1 : CompactBirth.normSq (rho m P s₀ x₀) = 1 :=
      circleMap_zero_normSq m hw
    rw [← normSq_rho m P s₀, h1]
  have hopen : IsOpen {z : E | CompactBirth.normSq z < 2} :=
    isOpen_lt CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.continuous continuous_const
  have hx₀mem : x₀ ∈ {z : E | CompactBirth.normSq z < 2} := by
    rw [mem_setOf_eq, hx₀normSq]
    norm_num
  have hev : (fun x' : E => level m P s₀ x') =ᶠ[nhds x₀]
      (fun x' : E => mactCLM m P s₀ (StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀)) x'))) := by
    refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hx₀mem) fun z hz => ?_
    have hcz : CompactBirth.cutoff z = 0 :=
      CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero (le_of_lt hz)
    rw [level, hcz, mactCLM_apply]
    simp [rho]
  rw [hev.fderiv_eq]
  
  have hF₁ : HasFDerivAt
      (fun x' : E => SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀)) x')
      (SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀))) x₀ :=
    (SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀))).hasFDerivAt
  have hcirc : HasFDerivAt (StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1)
      (fderiv ℝ (StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1)
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀)) x₀))
      (SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀)) x₀) :=
    ((StandardBirth.contDiff_circleMap (m + 1) 1).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
  have hF₃ : HasFDerivAt (fun w : F => mactCLM m P s₀ w)
      (mactCLM m P s₀)
      (StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀)) x₀)) :=
    (mactCLM m P s₀).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp := hF₃.comp x₀ (hcirc.comp x₀ hF₁)
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun x' : E =>
      mactCLM m P s₀ (StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀)) x'))) x₀ =
      (mactCLM m P s₀).comp
        ((fderiv ℝ (StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1)
          (SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀)) x₀)).comp
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀)))) := hcomp.fderiv
  rw [hfd]
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp]
  apply Function.Surjective.comp
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨w, hwsurj⟩ := mact_surjective m P hs y
    exact ⟨w, by rw [mactCLM_apply]; exact hwsurj⟩
  apply Function.Surjective.comp
  · have hzero : StandardBirth.circleMap (m + 1) 1
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀)) x₀) = 0 := hw
    exact (StandardBirth.targetFLS (m + 1)).regular _ hzero
  · exact (SOFrameGauge.toCLM_bijective ((pathA m P).Q (1 - s₀))).2

name: Submission.PieceKill.signedCob_flat
statement:
theorem signedCob_flat (P : Params m) {X₀ : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)}
    (S : FiberSign X₀) (hS : ∀ x, S x = 1)
    (hg : ∀ x, X₀.g x = level m P 0 x) :
    (signedCob m P S hS hg).SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 (5 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  show bigG m P v = ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m
  rw [bigG_def]
  apply level_eq_background
  have hnorm : (5 : ℝ) / 2 ≤ ‖initCLM (m + 3) v‖ := by
    simpa [dist_zero_right] using hv
  rw [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  nlinarith

name: Submission.PieceKill.i0_eq_zero
statement: theorem i0_eq_zero : i0 m = (0 : Fin (m + 3))
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.i1_eq_one
statement: theorem i1_eq_one : i1 m = (1 : Fin (m + 3))
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.iA_ne_i1
statement: theorem iA_ne_i1 (hm : 0 < m) : iA m ≠ i1 m
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
  rw [iA_val, i1_val] at hv
  omega

name: Submission.PieceKill.radialFirst_eq_iA
statement: theorem radialFirst_eq_iA : StandardBirth.radialFirst (m + 1) = iA m
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.radialSecond_eq_iB
statement: theorem radialSecond_eq_iB : StandardBirth.radialSecond (m + 1) = iB m
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.val_castSucc_succ
statement:
theorem val_castSucc_succ (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    ((i.castSucc.succ : Fin (m + 3)) : ℕ) = (i : ℕ) + 1
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.rho_zero_iA
statement:
theorem rho_zero_iA (P : Params m) (hm : 0 < m) (x : E) :
    rho m P 0 x (iA m) = -(x (0 : Fin (m + 3)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rho_zero_apply m P hm x (iA m), if_neg (iA_ne_i0 m),
    if_neg (iA_ne_i1 m hm), if_pos rfl, i0_eq_zero]

name: Submission.PieceKill.rho_zero_iB
statement:
theorem rho_zero_iB (P : Params m) (hm : 0 < m) (x : E) :
    rho m P 0 x (iB m) = -(P.eps * x (1 : Fin (m + 3)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [rho_zero_apply m P hm x (iB m), if_neg (Ne.symm (i0_ne_iB m)),
    if_neg (iB_ne_i1 m), if_neg (Ne.symm (iA_ne_iB m)), if_pos rfl, i1_eq_one]

name: Submission.PieceKill.radialSq_rho_zero
statement:
theorem radialSq_rho_zero (P : Params m) (hm : 0 < m) (x : E) :
    StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) (rho m P 0 x) = radSq x
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : P.eps ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [sq]
    exact P.eps_sq
  rw [StandardBirth.radialSq, radialFirst_eq_iA, radialSecond_eq_iB,
    rho_zero_iA m P hm x, rho_zero_iB m P hm x, radSq, neg_sq, neg_sq,
    mul_pow, hsq, one_mul]

name: Submission.PieceKill.level_zero_apply_last
statement:
theorem level_zero_apply_last (P : Params m) (hm : 0 < m) (x : E) :
    level m P 0 x (Fin.last (m + 1)) =
      (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) * ((radSq x - 1) / 2) +
        CompactBirth.cutoff x
proof:
:= by
  rw [level]
  simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mact_apply_last,
    CompactBirth.background_apply_last, StandardBirth.circleMap_apply_last,
    radialSq_rho_zero m P hm x, lam]
  ring

name: Submission.PieceKill.finRotate_val_eq
statement:
theorem finRotate_val_eq (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    ((finRotate (m + 1) i : Fin (m + 1)) : ℕ) =
      if i = Fin.last m then 0 else (i : ℕ) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [finRotate_apply, Fin.val_add_one]

name: Submission.PieceKill.rho_zero_index
statement:
theorem rho_zero_index (P : Params m) (hm : 0 < m) (x : E) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    rho m P 0 x ((finRotate (m + 1) i).castSucc.castSucc) =
      (if i = 0 then P.eps * x (iB m) else x (i.castSucc.succ))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst hi0
    have hnl : ((0 : Fin (m + 1))) ≠ Fin.last m := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      rw [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero] at hv
      omega
    have hj : (((finRotate (m + 1) (0 : Fin (m + 1))).castSucc.castSucc) :
        Fin (m + 3)) = i1 m := by
      apply Fin.ext
      show ((finRotate (m + 1) (0 : Fin (m + 1)) : Fin (m + 1)) : ℕ) = 1
      rw [finRotate_val_eq m (0 : Fin (m + 1)), if_neg hnl, Fin.val_zero]
    rw [hj, rho_zero_apply m P hm x (i1 m), if_neg (Ne.symm (i0_ne_i1 m)),
      if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl]
  · rw [if_neg hi0]
    have hi0' : (i : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      apply hi0
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [h, Fin.val_zero]
    by_cases hil : i = Fin.last m
    · have hj : (((finRotate (m + 1) i).castSucc.castSucc) : Fin (m + 3)) =
          i0 m := by
        apply Fin.ext
        show ((finRotate (m + 1) i : Fin (m + 1)) : ℕ) = 0
        rw [finRotate_val_eq m i, if_pos hil]
      have hval : (i : ℕ) = m := by
        rw [hil]
        rfl
      have hsucc : ((i.castSucc.succ : Fin (m + 3))) = iA m := by
        apply Fin.ext
        rw [val_castSucc_succ m i, iA_val, hval]
      rw [hj, rho_zero_apply m P hm x (i0 m), if_pos rfl, hsucc]
    · have hle := i.isLt
      have hlt : (i : ℕ) < m := by
        by_contra hcon
        refine hil (Fin.ext ?_)
        rw [Fin.val_last]
        omega
      have hj : (((finRotate (m + 1) i).castSucc.castSucc) : Fin (m + 3)) =
          i.castSucc.succ := by
        apply Fin.ext
        show ((finRotate (m + 1) i : Fin (m + 1)) : ℕ) =
          ((i.castSucc.succ : Fin (m + 3)) : ℕ)
        rw [finRotate_val_eq m i, if_neg hil, val_castSucc_succ m i]
      have hn0 : (i.castSucc.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ i0 m := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        rw [val_castSucc_succ m i, i0_val] at hv
        omega
      have hn1 : (i.castSucc.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ i1 m := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        rw [val_castSucc_succ m i, i1_val] at hv
        omega
      have hnA : (i.castSucc.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ iA m := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        rw [val_castSucc_succ m i, iA_val] at hv
        omega
      have hnB : (i.castSucc.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ iB m := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        rw [val_castSucc_succ m i, iB_val] at hv
        omega
      rw [hj, rho_zero_apply m P hm x (i.castSucc.succ), if_neg hn0,
        if_neg hn1, if_neg hnA, if_neg hnB]

name: Submission.PieceKill.level_zero_apply_castSucc
statement:
theorem level_zero_apply_castSucc (P : Params m) (hm : 0 < m) (x : E)
    (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    level m P 0 x i.castSucc =
      (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) *
        (P.eta i * (if i = 0 then x (iB m) else x (i.castSucc.succ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [level]
  simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    CompactBirth.background_apply_castSucc, mact_zero_castSucc,
    StandardBirth.circleMap_apply_castSucc, rho_zero_index m P hm x i,
    blockEta]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · rw [if_pos hi0, if_pos hi0, if_pos hi0]
    have he := P.eps_sq
    linear_combination
      ((1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) * P.eta i * x (iB m)) * he
  · rw [if_neg hi0, if_neg hi0, if_neg hi0]
    ring

name: Submission.PieceKill.tube_background_apply
statement:
theorem tube_background_apply (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    CompactTubeConfiguration.background m i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · rw [if_pos hi, hi]
    exact CompactTubeConfiguration.background_apply_zero m
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    exact CompactTubeConfiguration.background_apply_ne_zero m hi

name: Submission.PieceKill.compactBackground_apply
statement:
theorem compactBackground_apply (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m i =
      if i = Fin.last (m + 1) then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      exact CompactBirth.background_apply_last (m + 1)
  | cast j =>
      rw [if_neg (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j).ne]
      exact CompactBirth.background_apply_castSucc (m + 1) j

name: Submission.PieceKill.last_ne_zero_F
statement: theorem last_ne_zero_F : (Fin.last (m + 1) : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp at hv

name: Submission.PieceKill.tubeSwap_apply
statement:
theorem tubeSwap_apply (g : F) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    backgroundEquiv (CompactTubeConfiguration.background m)
        (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)
        (CompactTubeConfiguration.background_ne_zero m)
        (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1)) g i =
      if i = 0 then g (Fin.last (m + 1))
      else if i = Fin.last (m + 1) then g 0 else g i
proof:
:=
  backgroundEquiv_swap_apply (k := m) _ _ (tube_background_apply m)
    (compactBackground_apply m) _ _ g i

name: Submission.PieceKill.onePos_g_eq
statement:
theorem onePos_g_eq (x : E) :
    (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos m).X.g x =
      backgroundEquiv (CompactTubeConfiguration.background m)
        (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)
        (CompactTubeConfiguration.background_ne_zero m)
        (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1))
        (CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap m x)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.onePos_g_apply
statement:
theorem onePos_g_apply (x : E) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos m).X.g x i =
      if i = 0 then CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap m x (Fin.last (m + 1))
      else if i = Fin.last (m + 1) then CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap m x 0
      else CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap m x i
proof:
:= by
  rw [onePos_g_eq]
  exact tubeSwap_apply m (CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap m x) i

name: Submission.PieceKill.last_succ_eq_iB
statement: theorem last_succ_eq_iB : ((Fin.last (m + 1)).succ : Fin (m + 3)) = iB m
proof:
:= by
  apply Fin.ext
  simp

name: Submission.PieceKill.oneParams_eta
statement: @[simp] theorem oneParams_eta (i : Fin (m + 1)) : (oneParams m).eta i = 1
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.onePos_g_eq_level
statement:
theorem onePos_g_eq_level (hm : 0 < m) (x : E) :
    (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos m).X.g x =
      level m (oneParams m) 0 x
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      rw [onePos_g_apply m x (Fin.last (m + 1)), if_neg (last_ne_zero_F m),
        if_pos rfl, CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap_apply_zero m x,
        level_zero_apply_last m (oneParams m) hm x]
  | cast j =>
      have hjl : (j.castSucc : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ Fin.last (m + 1) :=
        (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j).ne
      rw [onePos_g_apply m x j.castSucc,
        level_zero_apply_castSucc m (oneParams m) hm x j, oneParams_eta]
      by_cases hj0 : j = 0
      · subst hj0
        rw [Fin.castSucc_zero, if_pos rfl,
          CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap_apply_ne_zero m x
            (last_ne_zero_F m),
          if_pos rfl, last_succ_eq_iB, one_mul]
      · have hjne0 : (j.castSucc : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          apply hj0
          apply Fin.ext
          have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
          simpa using hv
        rw [if_neg hjne0, if_neg hjl,
          CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap_apply_ne_zero m x hjne0,
          if_neg hj0, one_mul]

name: Submission.PieceKill.oneKillCob_flat
statement:
theorem oneKillCob_flat (hm : 0 < m) :
    (oneKillCob m hm).SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 (5 / 2)
proof:
:=
  signedCob_flat m (oneParams m)
    (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos m).sign (fun _ => rfl)
    (onePos_g_eq_level m hm)

name: Submission.PieceKill.exists_oneKill
statement:
theorem exists_oneKill (hm : 0 < m) :
    ∃ C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos m).sign
      (CompactBirth.targetSign (m + 1)),
      C.SpatialFlatOutside
        (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 (5 / 2)
proof:
:=
  ⟨oneKillCob m hm, oneKillCob_flat m hm⟩

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.exists_angle
statement:
theorem exists_angle {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 1) :
    ∃ theta : ℝ, Real.cos theta = a ∧ Real.sin theta = b
proof:
:= by
  have ha : -1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 1 := by
    constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg b, sq_nonneg (a + 1), sq_nonneg (a - 1)]
  rcases le_or_gt 0 b with hb | hb
  · refine ⟨Real.arccos a, Real.cos_arccos ha.1 ha.2, ?_⟩
    rw [Real.sin_arccos]
    have h1 : 1 - a ^ 2 = b ^ 2 := by linarith
    rw [h1, Real.sqrt_sq hb]
  · refine ⟨-Real.arccos a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Real.cos_neg]
      exact Real.cos_arccos ha.1 ha.2
    · rw [Real.sin_neg, Real.sin_arccos]
      have h1 : 1 - a ^ 2 = b ^ 2 := by linarith
      rw [h1, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_neg hb]
      ring

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.cpoint_cos_sin
statement:
theorem cpoint_cos_sin (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    cpoint V h2 P (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.contDiff_cpoint
statement: theorem contDiff_cpoint (P : V.OrbitIndex) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cpoint V h2 P)
proof:
:= by
  refine (contDiff_const.add ?_).add ?_
  · exact (contDiff_fst.smul contDiff_const)
  · exact (contDiff_snd.smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.hasDerivAt_point
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_point (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t => CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P t) (cvel h2 theta)
      theta
proof:
:= by
  have hc : HasDerivAt Real.cos (-Real.sin theta) theta := Real.hasDerivAt_cos theta
  have hs : HasDerivAt Real.sin (Real.cos theta) theta := Real.hasDerivAt_sin theta
  exact ((hc.smul_const (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ h2)).const_add
    (CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V h2 P)).add
      (hs.smul_const (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ h2))

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.cvel_ne_zero
statement: theorem cvel_ne_zero (theta : ℝ) : cvel h2 theta ≠ (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 : cvel h2 theta (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
  have h1 : cvel h2 theta (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) = 0 := by rw [h]; rfl
  simp [cvel, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁] at h0 h1
  have := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta
  rw [h0, h1] at this
  norm_num at this

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.point_mem_targetUnion
statement:
theorem point_mem_targetUnion (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta ∈
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2
proof:
:=
  Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨P, CanonicalRotationField.point_mem_target V h2 P theta⟩

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.exists_point_of_mem_targetUnion
statement:
theorem exists_point_of_mem_targetUnion {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hx : x ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2) :
    ∃ (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta = x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hP
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  refine ⟨P, 2 * Real.pi * t, ?_⟩
  show CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P (2 * Real.pi * t) =
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V h2 P _
  rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint,
    CanonicalRotationField.addCircleCartesian_coe_real t]
  rfl

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.point_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem point_mem_fiber
    (hfib : X.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta ∈ X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [hfib]
  exact point_mem_targetUnion V h2 P theta

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.surjective_fderiv_at_point
statement:
theorem surjective_fderiv_at_point
    (hfib : X.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    Function.Surjective
      (fderiv ℝ X.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta))
proof:
:=
  X.regular _ (point_mem_fiber V h2 X hfib P theta)

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.fderiv_cvel_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fderiv_cvel_eq_zero
    (hfib : X.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ X.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta) (cvel h2 theta) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : (fun t => X.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P t))
      = fun _ : ℝ => (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    funext t
    exact point_mem_fiber V h2 X hfib P t
  have hcomp : HasDerivAt (fun t => X.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P t))
      (fderiv ℝ X.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta) (cvel h2 theta))
      theta :=
    ((X.smooth.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt).comp_hasDerivAt
      theta (hasDerivAt_point V h2 P theta)
  have hconst : HasDerivAt (fun t => X.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P t))
      0 theta := by
    rw [hzero]
    exact hasDerivAt_const theta _
  exact hcomp.unique hconst

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.continuousAt_det_transition
statement:
theorem continuousAt_det_transition {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hx : x ∈ unitSet Xh) :
    ContinuousAt
      (fun y => (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (transition Xh Yt y)).det) x
proof:
:= by
  have htr : ContinuousAt (transition Xh Yt) x :=
    ((contDiffOn_transition Xh Yt).contDiffAt
      ((isOpen_unitSet Xh).mem_nhds hx)).continuousAt
  have hmat : ContinuousAt
      (fun y => PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (transition Xh Yt y)) x := by
    refine continuousAt_pi.mpr fun i => continuousAt_pi.mpr fun j => ?_
    have heq : (fun y => PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (transition Xh Yt y) i j)
        = fun y => (EuclideanSpace.proj i)
          ((transition Xh Yt y) (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) := by
      funext y
      exact PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_apply _ i j
    rw [heq]
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj i).continuous.continuousAt).comp
      (((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))).continuous.continuousAt).comp htr)
  exact ((Continuous.matrix_det continuous_id).continuousAt).comp hmat

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.isOpen_goodSet
statement: theorem isOpen_goodSet : IsOpen (goodSet Xh Yt)
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
  intro x hx
  have hU : unitSet Xh ∈ nhds x := (isOpen_unitSet Xh).mem_nhds hx.1
  have hpre : (fun y => (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix
      (transition Xh Yt y)).det) ⁻¹' (Set.Ioi 0) ∈ nhds x :=
    (continuousAt_det_transition Xh Yt hx.1).preimage_mem_nhds
      (Ioi_mem_nhds hx.2)
  exact Filter.inter_mem hU hpre

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.mem_goodSet_iff
statement:
theorem mem_goodSet_iff {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} :
    x ∈ goodSet Xh Yt ↔ x ∈ unitSet Xh ∧
      0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (transition Xh Yt x)).det
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.contDiffOn_transition_goodSet
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_transition_goodSet :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (transition Xh Yt) (goodSet Xh Yt)
proof:
:=
  (contDiffOn_transition Xh Yt).mono (fun _ hx => hx.1)

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.det_pos_on_goodSet
statement:
theorem det_pos_on_goodSet : ∀ x ∈ goodSet Xh Yt,
    0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (transition Xh Yt x)).det
proof:
:=
  fun _ hx => hx.2

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.exists_bigRadius
statement:
theorem exists_bigRadius (X : FramedLevelSet n) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ ∀ x ∈ X.fiber, ‖x‖ < R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mp X.fiber_bounded
  refine ⟨|C| + 1, by positivity, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have h1 := hC x hx
  have h2 : C ≤ |C| := le_abs_self C
  linarith

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.bigRadius_pos
statement: theorem bigRadius_pos (X : FramedLevelSet n) : 0 < bigRadius X
proof:
:=
  (exists_bigRadius X).choose_spec.1

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.norm_lt_bigRadius
statement:
theorem norm_lt_bigRadius (X : FramedLevelSet n) {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hx : x ∈ X.fiber) : ‖x‖ < bigRadius X
proof:
:=
  (exists_bigRadius X).choose_spec.2 x hx

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.exists_eta
statement:
theorem exists_eta (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt) :
    ∃ eta : ℝ, 0 < eta ∧ ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)),
      ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * bigRadius Xh ^ 2 → x ∉ goodSet Xh Yt →
        3 * eta ≤ ‖Xh.g x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  set K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :=
    {x | ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * bigRadius Xh ^ 2} \ goodSet Xh Yt with hK
  by_cases hne : K.Nonempty
  · have hclosed : IsClosed K := by
      refine IsClosed.inter ?_ ?_
      · exact isClosed_le (continuous_norm.pow 2) continuous_const
      · exact (isOpen_goodSet Xh Yt).isClosed_compl
    have hbdd : Bornology.IsBounded K := by
      refine Bornology.IsBounded.subset (Metric.isBounded_closedBall
        (x := (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
        (r := Real.sqrt (2 * bigRadius Xh ^ 2))) ?_
      intro x hx
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      have h1 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * bigRadius Xh ^ 2 := hx.1
      have h2 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
      nlinarith [Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ 2 * bigRadius Xh ^ 2),
        Real.sqrt_nonneg (2 * bigRadius Xh ^ 2)]
    have hcompact : IsCompact K := Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hclosed hbdd
    obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀, hmin⟩ := hcompact.exists_isMinOn hne
      ((Xh.smooth.continuous.norm.pow 2).continuousOn :
        ContinuousOn (fun x => ‖Xh.g x‖ ^ 2) K)
    have hpos : 0 < ‖Xh.g x₀‖ ^ 2 := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (by positivity : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖Xh.g x₀‖ ^ 2) with h | h
      · exfalso
        have hg : Xh.g x₀ = 0 := by
          have : ‖Xh.g x₀‖ = 0 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg (Xh.g x₀)]
          exact norm_eq_zero.mp this
        exact hx₀.2 (hgood hg)
      · exact h
    refine ⟨‖Xh.g x₀‖ ^ 2 / 3, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro x hx hxn
    have hxK : x ∈ K := ⟨hx, hxn⟩
    have hle : ‖Xh.g x₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖Xh.g x‖ ^ 2 := isMinOn_iff.mp hmin x hxK
    linarith
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
    intro x hx hxn
    exact absurd ⟨x, hx, hxn⟩ hne

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.eta_pos
statement: theorem eta_pos (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt) : 0 < eta Xh Yt hgood
proof:
:=
  (exists_eta Xh Yt hgood).choose_spec.1

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.three_eta_le
statement:
theorem three_eta_le (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hx : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * bigRadius Xh ^ 2) (hxn : x ∉ goodSet Xh Yt) :
    3 * eta Xh Yt hgood ≤ ‖Xh.g x‖ ^ 2
proof:
:=
  (exists_eta Xh Yt hgood).choose_spec.2 x hx hxn

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.contDiff_chi
statement:
theorem contDiff_chi (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (chi Xh Yt hgood)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContDiff.mul ?_ ?_
  · exact contDiff_const.sub (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
      ((((contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).comp Xh.smooth).div_const _).sub contDiff_const))
  · exact contDiff_const.sub (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
      (((contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).div_const _).sub contDiff_const))

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.chi_nonneg
statement:
theorem chi_nonneg (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) : 0 ≤ chi Xh Yt hgood x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one
    (‖Xh.g x‖ ^ 2 / eta Xh Yt hgood - 1)
  have h2 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one
    (‖x‖ ^ 2 / bigRadius Xh ^ 2 - 1)
  exact mul_nonneg (by linarith) (by linarith)

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.chi_le_one
statement:
theorem chi_le_one (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) : chi Xh Yt hgood x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one
    (‖Xh.g x‖ ^ 2 / eta Xh Yt hgood - 1)
  have h2 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one
    (‖x‖ ^ 2 / bigRadius Xh ^ 2 - 1)
  have h1' := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg
    (‖Xh.g x‖ ^ 2 / eta Xh Yt hgood - 1)
  have h2' := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg
    (‖x‖ ^ 2 / bigRadius Xh ^ 2 - 1)
  rw [chi]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg h1' h2']

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.chi_eq_one_of_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem chi_eq_one_of_mem_fiber (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : x ∈ Xh.fiber) :
    chi Xh Yt hgood x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hg : Xh.g x = 0 := hx
  have h1 : ‖Xh.g x‖ ^ 2 / eta Xh Yt hgood - 1 ≤ 0 := by
    rw [hg]
    simp
  have hnorm : ‖x‖ < bigRadius Xh := norm_lt_bigRadius Xh hx
  have h2 : ‖x‖ ^ 2 / bigRadius Xh ^ 2 - 1 ≤ 0 := by
    have hR := bigRadius_pos Xh
    have h0 : (0:ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖ := norm_nonneg x
    rw [sub_nonpos, div_le_one (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  rw [chi, Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos h1,
    Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos h2]
  norm_num

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.chi_eq_zero_of_large
proof:
:= by
  have hR := bigRadius_pos Xh
  have h2 : 1 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 / bigRadius Xh ^ 2 - 1 := by
    rw [le_sub_iff_add_le, show (1:ℝ) + 1 = 2 by norm_num,
      le_div_iff₀ (by positivity : (0:ℝ) < bigRadius Xh ^ 2)]
    linarith
  rw [chi, Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le h2]
  norm_num

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.chi_eq_zero_of_far_field
proof:
:= by
  have he := eta_pos Xh Yt hgood
  have h1 : 1 ≤ ‖Xh.g x‖ ^ 2 / eta Xh Yt hgood - 1 := by
    rw [le_sub_iff_add_le, show (1:ℝ) + 1 = 2 by norm_num,
      le_div_iff₀ he]
    linarith
  rw [chi, Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le h1]
  norm_num

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.mem_goodSet_of_chi_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mem_goodSet_of_chi_ne_zero (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : chi Xh Yt hgood x ≠ 0) :
    x ∈ goodSet Xh Yt
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hmem
  rcases le_or_gt (‖x‖ ^ 2) (2 * bigRadius Xh ^ 2) with h | h
  · have h3 := three_eta_le Xh Yt hgood x h hmem
    have he := eta_pos Xh Yt hgood
    exact hx (chi_eq_zero_of_far_field Xh Yt hgood (by linarith))
  · exact hx (chi_eq_zero_of_large Xh Yt hgood h)

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.distortion_eq_one_of_chi_eq_zero
statement:
theorem distortion_eq_one_of_chi_eq_zero
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : chi Xh Yt hgood x = 0) :
    distortion Xh Yt hgood x =
      (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (0 : ℝ) •
      ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) -
        PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpper (transition Xh Yt x)) = 0 := by
    ext v
    simp
  rw [distortion, hx, hz, sub_zero]

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.distortion_eq_qrUpper_of_chi_eq_one
statement:
theorem distortion_eq_qrUpper_of_chi_eq_one
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : chi Xh Yt hgood x = 1) :
    distortion Xh Yt hgood x =
      PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpper (transition Xh Yt x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [distortion, hx, one_smul, sub_sub_cancel]

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.contDiff_distortion
statement: theorem contDiff_distortion : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (distortion Xh Yt hgood)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ goodSet Xh Yt
  · have hq : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun y => PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpper (transition Xh Yt y)) x :=
      contDiffAt_qrUpper_of_contDiffOn (transition Xh Yt)
        (isOpen_goodSet Xh Yt) (contDiffOn_transition_goodSet Xh Yt)
        (det_pos_on_goodSet Xh Yt) hx
    exact contDiffAt_const.sub
      (((contDiff_chi Xh Yt hgood).contDiffAt).smul (contDiffAt_const.sub hq))
  · 
    have hnbhd : ∀ᶠ y in nhds x, chi Xh Yt hgood y = 0 := by
      rcases le_or_gt (‖x‖ ^ 2) (2 * bigRadius Xh ^ 2) with h | h
      · have h3 := three_eta_le Xh Yt hgood x h hx
        have he := eta_pos Xh Yt hgood
        have hopen : IsOpen {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) |
            2 * eta Xh Yt hgood < ‖Xh.g y‖ ^ 2} := by
          refine isOpen_lt continuous_const ?_
          exact (Xh.smooth.continuous.norm).pow 2
        have hmemx : x ∈ {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) |
            2 * eta Xh Yt hgood < ‖Xh.g y‖ ^ 2} := by
          simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq]
          linarith
        filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hmemx] with y hy
        exact chi_eq_zero_of_far_field Xh Yt hgood hy
      · have hopen : IsOpen {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) |
            2 * bigRadius Xh ^ 2 < ‖y‖ ^ 2} :=
          isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_norm.pow 2)
        filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds h] with y hy
        exact chi_eq_zero_of_large Xh Yt hgood hy
    refine ContDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq
      (contDiffAt_const
        (c := (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))) ?_
    filter_upwards [hnbhd] with y hy
    exact distortion_eq_one_of_chi_eq_zero Xh Yt hgood hy

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.clmMatrix_distortion
statement:
theorem clmMatrix_distortion (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (i j : Fin n) :
    PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (distortion Xh Yt hgood x) i j =
      (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i j -
        chi Xh Yt hgood x *
          ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i j -
            PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpperMatrix (transition Xh Yt x) i j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [distortion, PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_sub,
    PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_smul, PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_sub,
    PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_one, PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_qrUpper]
  simp

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.distortion_upper
statement:
theorem distortion_upper (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (i j : Fin n)
    (hij : j < i) :
    PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (distortion Xh Yt hgood x) i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [clmMatrix_distortion Xh Yt hgood x i j,
    Matrix.one_apply_ne (ne_of_gt hij),
    PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpperMatrix_eq_zero_of_lt _ hij]
  ring

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.distortion_diag_pos
statement:
theorem distortion_diag_pos (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (i : Fin n) :
    0 < PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (distortion Xh Yt hgood x) i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [clmMatrix_distortion Xh Yt hgood x i i, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
  by_cases hc : chi Xh Yt hgood x = 0
  · rw [hc]; norm_num
  · have hmem := mem_goodSet_of_chi_ne_zero Xh Yt hgood hc
    have hpos := PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpperMatrix_diag_pos
      (det_pos_on_goodSet Xh Yt x hmem) i
    have h0 := chi_nonneg Xh Yt hgood x
    have h1 := chi_le_one Xh Yt hgood x
    have hc' : 0 < chi Xh Yt hgood x := lt_of_le_of_ne h0 (Ne.symm hc)
    nlinarith [mul_pos hc' hpos]

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.distortion_eq_id_outside
statement:
theorem distortion_eq_id_outside (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hx : 2 * bigRadius Xh ≤ ‖x‖) :
    distortion Xh Yt hgood x =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  have hR := bigRadius_pos Xh
  have h : 2 * bigRadius Xh ^ 2 < ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  rw [distortion_eq_one_of_chi_eq_zero Xh Yt hgood
    (chi_eq_zero_of_large Xh Yt hgood h)]
  rfl

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.tauField_eq_of_fderiv_comp
statement:
theorem tauField_eq_of_fderiv_comp {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hC : fderiv ℝ Yt.g p = C.comp (fderiv ℝ Xh.g p))
    (hdet : 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C).det) :
    tauField Yt.g p = tauField Xh.g p
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : (fun j => gradVec Yt.g j p)
      = normalRowAction (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C)
        (fun j => gradVec Xh.g j p) := by
    funext j
    exact FrameGaugeDictionary.gradVec_eq_sum_of_fderiv_comp Xh Yt p C hC j
  have hker : kerCross Yt.g p
      = (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C).det • kerCross Xh.g p := by
    show crossVec (fun j => gradVec Yt.g j p) = _
    rw [hrow]
    exact crossVec_frameRowAction_normals _ _
  set d : ℝ := (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C).det with hd
  set kk : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) := kerCross Xh.g p with hkk
  show ‖kerCross Yt.g p‖⁻¹ • kerCross Yt.g p = ‖kk‖⁻¹ • kk
  rw [hker, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hdet, smul_smul,
    mul_inv, mul_comm d⁻¹ ‖kk‖⁻¹, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hdet),
    mul_one]

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.continuousAt_of_contDiffAt_matrixToEuclidean
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ContinuousAt (fun w => euclideanToMatrix
      (matrixToEuclidean ((G w : SOGroup r) :
        Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ))) z :=
    continuous_euclideanToMatrix.continuousAt.comp hG.continuousAt
  simp only [euclideanToMatrix_matrixToEuclidean] at h1
  refine Topology.IsInducing.subtypeVal.continuousAt_iff.mpr ?_
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using h1

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.cpoint_mem_goodSet
statement:
theorem cpoint_mem_goodSet
    (hXfib : Xh.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) {w : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hw : w.1 ^ 2 + w.2 ^ 2 = 1) : cpoint V h2 P w ∈ goodSet Xh Yt
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨theta, hc, hs⟩ := exists_angle hw
  have hw' : w = (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta) := by rw [hc, hs]
  rw [hw', cpoint_cos_sin]
  exact hgood (point_mem_fiber V h2 Xh hXfib P theta)

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.contDiffAt_soCartesian_entry
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_soCartesian_entry
    (hXfib : Xh.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) {z : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hz : z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1) (i j : Fin n) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => ((soCartesian V h2 Xh Yt P w : SOGroup n) :
      Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i j) z
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := cpoint_mem_goodSet V h2 Xh Yt hXfib hgood P hz
  have hbase := contDiffAt_qrSOTotal_of_contDiffOn (transition Xh Yt)
    (isOpen_goodSet Xh Yt) (contDiffOn_transition_goodSet Xh Yt)
    (det_pos_on_goodSet Xh Yt) hmem i j
  exact hbase.comp z (contDiff_cpoint V h2 P).contDiffAt

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.contDiffAt_soCartesian
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_soCartesian
    (hXfib : Xh.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) {z : ℝ × ℝ}
    (hz : z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w => matrixToEuclidean
      ((soCartesian V h2 Xh Yt P w : SOGroup n) :
        Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) z
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiffAt_piLp]
  intro ij
  change ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun w =>
    ((soCartesian V h2 Xh Yt P w : SOGroup n) :
      Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) ij.1 ij.2) z
  exact contDiffAt_soCartesian_entry V h2 Xh Yt hXfib hgood P hz ij.1 ij.2

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.soLoop_cartesian
statement:
theorem soLoop_cartesian
    (hXfib : Xh.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt) (P : V.OrbitIndex) (w : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (soLoop V h2 Xh Yt hXfib hgood P).cartesian w =
      soCartesian V h2 Xh Yt P w
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.transition_comp_at_point
statement:
theorem transition_comp_at_point
    (hXfib : Xh.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (hYfib : Yt.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    (transition Xh Yt (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ Xh.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta))
      = fderiv ℝ Yt.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta)
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj := surjective_fderiv_at_point V h2 Xh hXfib P theta
  have hu : IsUnit (gram Xh (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta)) :=
    isUnit_gram Xh hsurj
  refine transition_comp Xh Yt hu ?_
  exact fderiv_eq_zero_of_ker Xh Yt hsurj (cvel h2 theta) (cvel_ne_zero h2 theta)
    (fderiv_cvel_eq_zero V h2 Xh hXfib P theta)
    (fderiv_cvel_eq_zero V h2 Yt hYfib P theta)

    CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta ∈ goodSet Xh Yt
proof:
