name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.fderiv_factorization
statement:
theorem fderiv_factorization
    (hXfib : Xh.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (hYfib : Yt.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt) (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ Yt.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta) =
      (SOFrameGauge.toCLM ((soLoop V h2 Xh Yt hXfib hgood P).cartesian
          (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
        ((distortion Xh Yt hgood
            (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta)).comp
          (fderiv ℝ Xh.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta)))
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := point_mem_goodSet V h2 Xh Yt hXfib hgood P theta
  have hdetp : 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix
      (transition Xh Yt (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta))).det :=
    det_pos_on_goodSet Xh Yt _ hmem
  have hchi : chi Xh Yt hgood (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta) = 1 :=
    chi_eq_one_of_mem_fiber Xh Yt hgood (point_mem_fiber V h2 Xh hXfib P theta)
  have hdist : distortion Xh Yt hgood
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta)
      = PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpper
        (transition Xh Yt (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta)) :=
    distortion_eq_qrUpper_of_chi_eq_one Xh Yt hgood hchi
  have hso : (soLoop V h2 Xh Yt hXfib hgood P).cartesian
      (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta)
      = qrSOTotal (transition Xh Yt
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta)) := rfl
  rw [hdist, hso, ← ContinuousLinearMap.comp_assoc,
    ← qr_factorization_total _ hdetp]
  exact (transition_comp_at_point V h2 Xh Yt hXfib hYfib P theta).symm

theorem tauField_eq_at_point
    (hXfib : Xh.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (hYfib : Yt.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (hgood : Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt) (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    tauField Yt.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta) =
      tauField Xh.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta)
proof:

  exact tauField_eq_of_fderiv_comp Xh Yt _
    (transition_comp_at_point V h2 Xh Yt hXfib hYfib P theta).symm
    (det_pos_on_goodSet Xh Yt _ hmem)

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.kerCross_eq_of_fderiv_comp
statement:
theorem kerCross_eq_of_fderiv_comp {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hC : fderiv ℝ Yt.g p = C.comp (fderiv ℝ Xh.g p)) :
    kerCross Yt.g p
      = (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C).det • kerCross Xh.g p
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : (fun j => gradVec Yt.g j p)
      = normalRowAction (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C)
        (fun j => gradVec Xh.g j p) := by
    funext j
    exact FrameGaugeDictionary.gradVec_eq_sum_of_fderiv_comp Xh Yt p C hC j
  show crossVec (fun j => gradVec Yt.g j p) = _
  rw [hrow]
  exact crossVec_frameRowAction_normals _ _

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.det_transition_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_transition_ne_zero {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hC : fderiv ℝ Yt.g p = C.comp (fderiv ℝ Xh.g p))
    (hY : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ Yt.g p)) :
    (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hsurjC : Function.Surjective C := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hY v
    refine ⟨fderiv ℝ Xh.g p u, ?_⟩
    rw [← hu, hC]
    rfl
  have hinjC : Function.Injective C :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective (f := (C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))).mpr hsurjC
  exact det_clmMatrix_ne_zero_of_injective hinjC

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.det_pos_of_tauField_eq
statement:
theorem det_pos_of_tauField_eq {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hC : fderiv ℝ Yt.g p = C.comp (fderiv ℝ Xh.g p))
    (hY : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ Yt.g p))
    (hX : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ Xh.g p))
    (htau : tauField Yt.g p = tauField Xh.g p) :
    0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C).det
proof:
:= by
  have hne := det_transition_ne_zero Xh Yt C hC hY
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hneg | hpos
  · exfalso
    have hker := kerCross_eq_of_fderiv_comp Xh Yt C hC
    have hreg : p ∈ regularSet Xh.g := hX
    have hknz : kerCross Xh.g p ≠ 0 := (kerCross_ne_zero_iff Xh.g p).mpr hreg
    have hknorm : ‖kerCross Xh.g p‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hknz
    have hflip : tauField Yt.g p = -tauField Xh.g p := by
      show ‖kerCross Yt.g p‖⁻¹ • kerCross Yt.g p
        = -(‖kerCross Xh.g p‖⁻¹ • kerCross Xh.g p)
      rw [hker, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_neg hneg, smul_smul,
        ← neg_smul]
      congr 1
      field_simp
    rw [hflip] at htau
    have hsum : tauField Xh.g p + tauField Xh.g p = 0 := by
      nth_rewrite 1 [← htau]
      exact neg_add_cancel (tauField Xh.g p)
    have htwo : (2 : ℝ) • tauField Xh.g p = 0 := by
      rw [two_smul]
      exact hsum
    have hzero : tauField Xh.g p = 0 := by
      rcases smul_eq_zero.mp htwo with h | h
      · exact absurd h (by norm_num)
      · exact h
    have := norm_tauField hreg
    rw [hzero, norm_zero] at this
    norm_num at this
  · exact hpos

name: Submission.CircleTransitionDatum.goodSet_of_tauField_eq
statement:
theorem goodSet_of_tauField_eq
    (hXfib : Xh.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (hYfib : Yt.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (htau : ∀ (P : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      tauField Yt.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta) =
        tauField Xh.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta)) :
    Xh.fiber ⊆ goodSet Xh Yt
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hx' : x ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2 := by
    rw [← hXfib]; exact hx
  obtain ⟨P, theta, rfl⟩ := exists_point_of_mem_targetUnion V h2 hx'
  have hXs := surjective_fderiv_at_point V h2 Xh hXfib P theta
  have hYs := surjective_fderiv_at_point V h2 Yt hYfib P theta
  refine ⟨mem_unitSet_of_surjective Xh hXs, ?_⟩
  exact det_pos_of_tauField_eq Xh Yt _
    (transition_comp_at_point V h2 Xh Yt hXfib hYfib P theta).symm
    hYs hXs (htau P theta)

name: Submission.BridgeData.bridgeCubeInterpolation_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma bridgeCubeInterpolation_apply (R : ℝ) (p : I × Q)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    bridgeCubeInterpolation (n := n) R p i =
      (1 - (p.1 : ℝ)) * (2 * R * (p.2 i : ℝ) - R) +
        (p.1 : ℝ) * (p.2 i : ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.BridgeData.continuous_bridgeCubeInterpolation
statement:
lemma continuous_bridgeCubeInterpolation (R : ℝ) :
    Continuous (bridgeCubeInterpolation (n := n) R)
proof:
:= by
  have h : bridgeCubeInterpolation (n := n) R = fun p =>
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).symm (fun i =>
        (1 - (p.1 : ℝ)) * (2 * R * (p.2 i : ℝ) - R) +
          (p.1 : ℝ) * (p.2 i : ℝ)) := rfl
  rw [h]
  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  have hs : Continuous fun p : I × Q => (p.1 : ℝ) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
  have ht : Continuous fun p : I × Q => (p.2 i : ℝ) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd)
  exact ((continuous_const.sub hs).mul
    (((continuous_const.mul continuous_const).mul ht).sub continuous_const)).add
      (hs.mul ht)

name: Submission.BridgeData.bridgeCubeInterpolation_mem_collar
statement:
lemma bridgeCubeInterpolation_mem_collar {R : ℝ} (hR : 1 ≤ R)
    (s : I) {t : Q} (ht : t ∈ Cube.boundary (Fin (n + 1))) :
    WithLp.ofLp (bridgeCubeInterpolation (n := n) R (s, t)) ∈
      closedAmbientCollar (Fin (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ := ht
  · refine ⟨i, Or.inl ?_⟩
    change (1 - (s : ℝ)) * (2 * R * (t i : ℝ) - R) +
      (s : ℝ) * (t i : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 5
    rw [hi, Set.Icc.coe_zero]
    have hs1 : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.2.2
    have hR0 : 0 ≤ R := le_trans (by norm_num) hR
    have hmul : 0 ≤ (1 - (s : ℝ)) * R :=
      mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs1) hR0
    nlinarith
  · refine ⟨i, Or.inr ?_⟩
    change (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤
      (1 - (s : ℝ)) * (2 * R * (t i : ℝ) - R) +
        (s : ℝ) * (t i : ℝ)
    rw [hi, Set.Icc.coe_one]
    have hs0 : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.2.1
    have hs1 : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.2.2
    have hmul : (1 - (s : ℝ)) * 1 ≤ (1 - (s : ℝ)) * R :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hR (sub_nonneg.mpr hs1)
    nlinarith

      B.northEndpointPTCutoff R) :
    (⟦FiberSign.PTCutoff.centeredLoop B.fiberSign B.northEndpointPTCutoff R
        hR0 hsupp⟧ :
      HomotopyGroup (Fin (n + 1)) (UnitSphere E) (southPole n)) = z
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ⟦FiberSign.PTCutoff.centeredLoop B.fiberSign B.northEndpointPTCutoff R
        hR0 hsupp⟧ = ⟦B.northEndpointPTCutoffLoop⟧ :=

name: Submission.BridgeData.eq_of_signedCobordism
statement:
theorem BridgeData.eq_of_signedCobordism
    {z z' : HomotopyGroup (Fin (n + 1))
      (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) (southPole n)}
    (B : BridgeData n z) (B' : BridgeData n z')
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism B.fiberSign B'.fiberSign) : z = z'
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨χ⟩ :=
    SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.nonempty C
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hR1, h₀, h₁, hhom⟩ :=
    SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.exists_endpointCutoffHomotopy
      C χ B.northEndpointPTCutoff B'.northEndpointPTCutoff
  have hz := B.centeredLoop_class_eq R hR.le hR1 h₀
  have hz' := B'.centeredLoop_class_eq R hR.le hR1 h₁
  have hclasses :
      (⟦FiberSign.PTCutoff.centeredLoop B.fiberSign
          B.northEndpointPTCutoff R hR.le h₀⟧ :
        HomotopyGroup (Fin (n + 1))
          (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) (southPole n)) =
      ⟦FiberSign.PTCutoff.centeredLoop B'.fiberSign
          B'.northEndpointPTCutoff R hR.le h₁⟧ :=
    Quotient.sound hhom
  exact hz.symm.trans (hclasses.trans hz')

statement:
theorem twistIm_sourceLeft (theta : ℝ) :
    twistIm m (spaceTime (StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft m theta) 0) =
      StandardSaddle.sourceScale * Real.sin theta
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistIm_spaceTime_eq_spatial,
    StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft_apply_planeFirst,
    StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft_apply_planeSecond]
  calc
    2 * -StandardSaddle.sourceRootFirst theta *
          -StandardSaddle.sourceRootSecond theta =
        2 * StandardSaddle.sourceRootFirst theta *
          StandardSaddle.sourceRootSecond theta := by ring
    _ = StandardSaddle.sourceRadicandSecond theta :=
      StandardSaddle.two_mul_sourceRootFirst_mul_sourceRootSecond theta
    _ = StandardSaddle.sourceScale * Real.sin theta := rfl

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniWinding.twistShift_sourceRight
statement:
theorem twistShift_sourceRight (theta : ℝ) :
    twistShift m (spaceTime (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m theta) 0) = 0
proof:
:=

    (standard_eventMap_sourceRight_zero m theta)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniWinding.twistShift_sourceLeft
statement:

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniWinding.source_coefficient_normSq
statement:
theorem source_coefficient_normSq (theta : ℝ) :
    twistRe m (spaceTime (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m theta) 0) ^ 2 +
        twistIm m (spaceTime (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m theta) 0) ^ 2 =
      1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistRe_sourceRight, twistIm_sourceRight]
  calc
    (StandardSaddle.sourceScale * Real.cos theta) ^ 2 +
        (StandardSaddle.sourceScale * Real.sin theta) ^ 2 =
      StandardSaddle.sourceScale ^ 2 *
        (Real.cos theta ^ 2 + Real.sin theta ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = 1 / 2 := by
      rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one, StandardSaddle.sourceScale_sq]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniWinding.target_coefficient_normSq
statement:
theorem target_coefficient_normSq (theta : ℝ) :
    targetCoeffRe 1 theta ^ 2 + targetCoeffIm theta ^ 2 = 3 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm := ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twist_normSq m
    (spaceTime (StandardSaddle.targetPoint m theta) 1)
  rw [twistRe_target, twistIm_target, initCLM_spaceTime,
    StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_targetPoint] at hnorm
  norm_num at hnorm ⊢
  exact hnorm

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniWinding.target_coefficient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem target_coefficient_ne_zero (theta : ℝ) :
    targetCoeffRe 1 theta ≠ 0 ∨ targetCoeffIm theta ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hnorm := target_coefficient_normSq m theta
  rw [h.1, h.2] at hnorm
  norm_num at hnorm

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniWinding.targetCoeff_ne_zero_during_homotopy
proof:
:= by
  by_contra h
  push_neg at h
  have hwSq : targetCoeffRe 1 theta ^ 2 + targetCoeffIm theta ^ 2 =
      (s - 1) ^ 2 := by
    have hre : targetCoeffRe 1 theta = s - 1 := by
      dsimp only [targetCoeffRe] at h ⊢
      linarith [h.1]
    rw [hre, h.2]
    ring
  rw [target_coefficient_normSq m theta] at hwSq
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (s - 1)]

name: Submission.projVec_dotProduct_self
statement: theorem projVec_dotProduct_self (A : SOGroup (n + 1)) : projVec A ⬝ᵥ projVec A = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hO : (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
      * (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)ᵀ = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).mp
      ((Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp A.2).1)
  have hOT : (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)ᵀ
      * (A : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hO
  have h := congr_fun (congr_fun hOT (Fin.last n)) (Fin.last n)
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq] at h
  simpa [projVec, dotProduct] using h

name: Submission.clampT_zero_idx
statement: theorem clampT_zero_idx (N : ℕ) (t : I) : clampT N 0 t = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show min t.1 (((0 : ℕ) : ℝ) / N) = 0
  rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_div]
  exact min_eq_right t.2.1

name: Submission.clampT_last
statement: theorem clampT_last (N : ℕ) (hN : N ≠ 0) (t : I) : clampT N N t = t
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show min t.1 ((N : ℝ) / N) = t.1
  rw [div_self (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr hN)]
  exact min_eq_left t.2.2

name: Submission.clampT_of_zero
statement: theorem clampT_of_zero (N i : ℕ) : clampT N i 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show min ((0 : I) : ℝ) ((i : ℝ) / N) = 0
  exact min_eq_left (by positivity)

name: Submission.continuous_clampT
statement: theorem continuous_clampT (N i : ℕ) : Continuous (clampT N i)
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact continuous_subtype_val.min continuous_const

name: Submission.dist_clampT_succ
statement:
theorem dist_clampT_succ (N i : ℕ) (t : I) :
    dist (clampT N i t) (clampT N (i + 1) t) ≤ 1 / N
proof:
:= by
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq]
  show |min t.1 ((i : ℝ) / N) - min t.1 (((i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / N)| ≤ 1 / N
  have hcast : (((i + 1 : ℕ)) : ℝ) = (i : ℝ) + 1 := by push_cast; ring
  rw [hcast]
  rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos N with rfl | hNpos
  · simp
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := by exact_mod_cast hNpos
  have hbc : (i : ℝ) / N ≤ ((i : ℝ) + 1) / N := by gcongr; linarith
  have h1 : min t.1 ((i : ℝ) / N) ≤ min t.1 (((i : ℝ) + 1) / N) := min_le_min le_rfl hbc
  have h2 : min t.1 (((i : ℝ) + 1) / N) ≤ min t.1 ((i : ℝ) / N) + 1 / N := by
    rcases le_total t.1 ((i : ℝ) / N) with h | h
    · rw [min_eq_left h]
      calc min t.1 (((i : ℝ) + 1) / N) ≤ t.1 := min_le_left _ _
        _ ≤ t.1 + 1 / N := le_add_of_nonneg_right (by positivity)
    · rw [min_eq_right h]
      calc min t.1 (((i : ℝ) + 1) / N) ≤ ((i : ℝ) + 1) / N := min_le_right _ _
        _ = (i : ℝ) / N + 1 / N := by ring
  rw [abs_sub_comm, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h1)]
  linarith

name: Submission.Fine.dom
statement:
theorem Fine.dom (hfine : Fine f N) (i : ℕ) (q : P × I) :
    -1 < coords (f (q.1, clampT N i q.2)) ⬝ᵥ coords (f (q.1, clampT N (i + 1) q.2))
proof:
:=
  neg_one_lt_coords_dot_of_dist_lt_two
    (lt_trans (hfine q.1 _ _ (dist_clampT_succ N i q.2)) one_lt_two)

name: Submission.continuous_liftSeq
statement:
theorem continuous_liftSeq (hf : Continuous f) (hA₀ : Continuous A₀)
    (hfine : Fine f N) : ∀ i, Continuous (liftSeq f A₀ N i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => exact hA₀.comp continuous_fst
  | succ i ih =>
    exact Continuous.mul
      (continuous_rotTo
        (hf.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk ((continuous_clampT N i).comp continuous_snd)))
        (hf.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk ((continuous_clampT N (i + 1)).comp continuous_snd)))
        (hfine.dom i))
      ih

name: Submission.liftSeq_proj
statement:
theorem liftSeq_proj (h₀ : ∀ p, proj (A₀ p) = f (p, 0))
    (hfine : Fine f N) : ∀ i (q : P × I),
      proj (liftSeq f A₀ N i q) = f (q.1, clampT N i q.2)
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero =>
    intro q
    show proj (A₀ q.1) = _
    rw [clampT_zero_idx, h₀]
  | succ i ih =>
    intro q
    exact proj_rotTo_mul (hfine.dom i q) (ih q)

name: Submission.liftSeq_apply_zero
statement: theorem liftSeq_apply_zero : ∀ i (p : P), liftSeq f A₀ N i (p, 0) = A₀ p
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro p; rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    intro p
    show rotTo (f (p, clampT N i 0)) (f (p, clampT N (i + 1) 0)) * liftSeq f A₀ N i (p, 0)
      = A₀ p
    rw [clampT_of_zero, clampT_of_zero, rotTo_self, one_mul, ih]

name: Submission.liftSeq_apply_const
statement:
theorem liftSeq_apply_const {p : P} (hp : ∀ t, f (p, t) = f (p, 0)) :
    ∀ i t, liftSeq f A₀ N i (p, t) = A₀ p
proof:
:= by
  intro i
  induction i with
  | zero => intro t; rfl
  | succ i ih =>
    intro t
    show rotTo (f (p, clampT N i t)) (f (p, clampT N (i + 1) t)) * liftSeq f A₀ N i (p, t)
      = A₀ p
    rw [hp (clampT N i t), hp (clampT N (i + 1) t), rotTo_self, one_mul, ih]

name: Submission.exists_pathFamilyLift
statement:
theorem exists_pathFamilyLift
    {f : P × I → UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))} (hf : Continuous f)
    {A₀ : P → SOGroup (n + 1)} (hA₀ : Continuous A₀)
    (h₀ : ∀ p, proj (A₀ p) = f (p, 0)) :
    ∃ L : P × I → SOGroup (n + 1),
      Continuous L ∧ (∀ q, proj (L q) = f q) ∧ (∀ p, L (p, 0) = A₀ p) ∧
        ∀ p, (∀ t, f (p, t) = f (p, 0)) → ∀ t, L (p, t) = A₀ p
proof:
:= by
  have huc : UniformContinuous f := CompactSpace.uniformContinuous_of_continuous hf
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hH⟩ := Metric.uniformContinuous_iff.mp huc 1 one_pos
  obtain ⟨N, hNgt⟩ := exists_nat_gt (1 / δ)
  have hN0 : (0 : ℝ) < N := lt_of_le_of_lt (by positivity) hNgt
  have hNpos : 0 < N := by exact_mod_cast hN0
  have hN : N ≠ 0 := hNpos.ne'
  have hstep : (1 : ℝ) / N < δ := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hN0]
    have h1 : 1 < N * δ := by
      have := (div_lt_iff₀ hδ).mp hNgt
      linarith
    linarith [h1]
  have hfine : Fine f N := by
    intro p s t hst
    apply hH
    rw [Prod.dist_eq]
    have hps : dist p p = 0 := dist_self p
    rw [hps, max_eq_right dist_nonneg]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hst hstep
  refine ⟨liftSeq f A₀ N N, continuous_liftSeq hf hA₀ hfine N, ?_, liftSeq_apply_zero N,
    fun p hp t => liftSeq_apply_const hp N t⟩
  intro q
  rw [liftSeq_proj h₀ hfine N q, clampT_last N hN]

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.source_collar_unit_constraint
statement:
theorem source_collar_unit_constraint (x : E) :
    ‖X₀.g x + D.target‖ ^ 2 + S₀ x ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hh := D.horizontal_collar_zero x 0 (by norm_num)
  have hinit : initCLM n (D.sphere (spaceTime x 0) : E) = X₀.g x + D.target := by
    have := congrArg (fun z : F => z + D.target) hh
    simpa using this
  have hvert := D.vertical_collar_zero x 0 (by norm_num)
  calc
    ‖X₀.g x + D.target‖ ^ 2 + S₀ x ^ 2 =
        ‖initCLM n (D.sphere (spaceTime x 0) : E)‖ ^ 2 +
          vertC (D.sphere (spaceTime x 0) : E) ^ 2 := by
            rw [hinit, hvert]
    _ = ‖(D.sphere (spaceTime x 0) : E)‖ ^ 2 :=
      (norm_sq_split _).symm
    _ = 1 := by rw [UnitSphere.norm_coe]; norm_num

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.target_collar_unit_constraint
statement:
theorem target_collar_unit_constraint (x : E) :
    ‖X₁.g x + D.target‖ ^ 2 + S₁ x ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hh := D.horizontal_collar_one x 1 (by norm_num)
  have hinit : initCLM n (D.sphere (spaceTime x 1) : E) = X₁.g x + D.target := by
    have := congrArg (fun z : F => z + D.target) hh
    simpa using this
  have hvert := D.vertical_collar_one x 1 (by norm_num)
  calc
    ‖X₁.g x + D.target‖ ^ 2 + S₁ x ^ 2 =
        ‖initCLM n (D.sphere (spaceTime x 1) : E)‖ ^ 2 +
          vertC (D.sphere (spaceTime x 1) : E) ^ 2 := by
            rw [hinit, hvert]
    _ = ‖(D.sphere (spaceTime x 1) : E)‖ ^ 2 :=
      (norm_sq_split _).symm
    _ = 1 := by rw [UnitSphere.norm_coe]; norm_num

name: Submission.CollaredSphereHomotopy.isRegularValue_source
statement:
theorem isRegularValue_source {y : F} (hy : IsRegularValue H.horizontal y) :
    IsRegularValue H.sourceHorizontal y
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let X : A := spaceTime x 0
  have hXt : vertC X = 0 := vertC_spaceTime x 0
  have hslab : ∀ X' : A, vertC X' < 1 / 4 →
      H.horizontal X' = H.sourceHorizontal (initCLM (n + 1) X') := by
    intro X' hX'
    calc
      H.horizontal X' = H.horizontal
          (spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) X') (vertC X')) :=
        congrArg H.horizontal (spaceTime_init_vert X').symm
      _ = H.sourceHorizontal (initCLM (n + 1) X') :=
        H.horizontal_collar_zero _ (le_of_lt hX')
  have hval : H.horizontal X = y := by
    rw [hslab X (by rw [hXt]; norm_num), initCLM_spaceTime]
    exact hx
  have hsurj := hy X hval
  have hEv : H.horizontal =ᶠ[𝓝 X]
      fun X' => H.sourceHorizontal (initCLM (n + 1) X') :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((isOpen_vert_lt (1 / 4)).mem_nhds
        (by rw [mem_setOf_eq, hXt]; norm_num))
      fun X' hX' => hslab X' hX'
  have hgd : HasFDerivAt H.sourceHorizontal
      (fderiv ℝ H.sourceHorizontal (initCLM (n + 1) X))
      (initCLM (n + 1) X) :=
    (H.contDiff_sourceHorizontal.differentiable infty_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ H.horizontal X =
      (fderiv ℝ H.sourceHorizontal (initCLM (n + 1) X)).comp
        (initCLM (n + 1)) := by
    rw [hEv.fderiv_eq]
    exact (hgd.comp X (initCLM (n + 1)).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] at hsurj
  have hs := hsurj.of_comp
  simpa [X, initCLM_spaceTime] using hs

name: Submission.CollaredSphereHomotopy.isRegularValue_target
statement:
theorem isRegularValue_target {y : F} (hy : IsRegularValue H.horizontal y) :
    IsRegularValue H.targetHorizontal y
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let X : A := spaceTime x 1
  have hXt : vertC X = 1 := vertC_spaceTime x 1
  have hslab : ∀ X' : A, 3 / 4 < vertC X' →
      H.horizontal X' = H.targetHorizontal (initCLM (n + 1) X') := by
    intro X' hX'
    calc
      H.horizontal X' = H.horizontal
          (spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) X') (vertC X')) :=
        congrArg H.horizontal (spaceTime_init_vert X').symm
      _ = H.targetHorizontal (initCLM (n + 1) X') :=
        H.horizontal_collar_one _ (le_of_lt hX')
  have hval : H.horizontal X = y := by
    rw [hslab X (by rw [hXt]; norm_num), initCLM_spaceTime]
    exact hx
  have hsurj := hy X hval
  have hEv : H.horizontal =ᶠ[𝓝 X]
      fun X' => H.targetHorizontal (initCLM (n + 1) X') :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      ((isOpen_lt_vert (3 / 4)).mem_nhds
        (by rw [mem_setOf_eq, hXt]; norm_num))
      fun X' hX' => hslab X' hX'
  have hgd : HasFDerivAt H.targetHorizontal
      (fderiv ℝ H.targetHorizontal (initCLM (n + 1) X))
      (initCLM (n + 1) X) :=
    (H.contDiff_targetHorizontal.differentiable infty_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ H.horizontal X =
      (fderiv ℝ H.targetHorizontal (initCLM (n + 1) X)).comp
        (initCLM (n + 1)) := by
    rw [hEv.fderiv_eq]
    exact (hgd.comp X (initCLM (n + 1)).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  rw [hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp] at hsurj
  have hs := hsurj.of_comp
  simpa [X, initCLM_spaceTime] using hs

name: Submission.CollaredSphereHomotopy.sourceFiber_bounded
statement:
lemma sourceFiber_bounded {y : F} (hy0 : y ≠ 0) :
    Bornology.IsBounded {x : E | H.sourceHorizontal x - y = 0}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := H.exterior_south
  rw [Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0]
  refine ⟨max R 0, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  have hxy : H.sourceHorizontal x = y := sub_eq_zero.mp hx
  have hxR : ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hfar : R < ‖initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x 0)‖ := by
      rw [initCLM_spaceTime]
      exact lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hsouth := hR (spaceTime x 0) hfar
    apply hy0
    rw [← hxy, sourceHorizontal, horizontal, hsouth, southPole_coe,
      map_neg, initCLM_eLast, neg_zero]
  exact hxR.trans (le_max_left _ _)

name: Submission.CollaredSphereHomotopy.targetFiber_bounded
statement:
lemma targetFiber_bounded {y : F} (hy0 : y ≠ 0) :
    Bornology.IsBounded {x : E | H.targetHorizontal x - y = 0}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := H.exterior_south
  rw [Metric.isBounded_iff_subset_closedBall 0]
  refine ⟨max R 0, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
  have hxy : H.targetHorizontal x = y := sub_eq_zero.mp hx
  have hxR : ‖x‖ ≤ R := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hfar : R < ‖initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x 1)‖ := by
      rw [initCLM_spaceTime]
      exact lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hsouth := hR (spaceTime x 1) hfar
    apply hy0
    rw [← hxy, targetHorizontal, horizontal, hsouth, southPole_coe,
      map_neg, initCLM_eLast, neg_zero]
  exact hxR.trans (le_max_left _ _)

name: Submission.CollaredSphereHomotopy.vertical_ne_zero_of_horizontal_eq
proof:
:= by
  intro hz
  have hsplit := norm_sq_split (H.sphere v : E)
  rw [UnitSphere.norm_coe, show initCLM n (H.sphere v : E) = y from hv,
    hz] at hsplit
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg y]

name: Submission.CollaredSphereHomotopy.exists_small_transverse_signedCobordism
statement:
theorem exists_small_transverse_signedCobordism (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ (y : F) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
      (hreg : IsRegularValue H.horizontal y) (hy : ‖y‖ < 1),
      0 < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 1 / 8 ∧
      Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
        (H.sourceSign y hy0 hreg hy) (H.targetSign y hy0 hreg hy))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hypos, hy8, -, hreg⟩ :=
    exists_small_regular_value hn H.contDiff_horizontal
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (ne_of_gt hypos)
  have hy : ‖y‖ < 1 := hy8.trans (by norm_num)
  exact ⟨y, hy0, hreg, hy, hypos, hy8,
    PTTransverseHomotopyData.nonempty_signedFramedLevelCobordism
      (H.toPTTransverseHomotopyData y hy0 hreg hy)⟩

name: Submission.StandardBirth.circlePoint_apply_radialFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_apply_radialFirst (theta : ℝ) :
    circlePoint m theta (radialFirst m) = Real.cos theta
proof:
:= by
  have hAB : radialFirst m ≠ radialSecond m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [radialFirst, radialSecond] at this
  simp [circlePoint, Pi.single_apply, hAB]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.circlePoint_apply_radialSecond
statement:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_apply_radialSecond (theta : ℝ) :
    circlePoint m theta (radialSecond m) = Real.sin theta
proof:
:= by
  have hBA : radialSecond m ≠ radialFirst m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [radialFirst, radialSecond] at this
  simp [circlePoint, Pi.single_apply, hBA]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.circlePoint_apply_transverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem circlePoint_apply_transverse (theta : ℝ) (j : Fin m) :
    circlePoint m theta j.castSucc.castSucc = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hjA : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ radialFirst m :=
    by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [radialFirst] at this
      omega
  have hjB : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ radialSecond m :=
    by
      intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [radialSecond] at this
      omega
  simp [circlePoint, Pi.single_apply, hjA, hjB]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.continuous_circlePoint
statement: theorem continuous_circlePoint : Continuous (circlePoint m)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Real.continuous_cos.smul continuous_const).add
    (Real.continuous_sin.smul continuous_const)

name: Submission.StandardBirth.circlePoint_mem_target_fiber
statement:
theorem circlePoint_mem_target_fiber (theta : ℝ) :
    circlePoint m theta ∈ (targetFLS m).fiber
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      simp [targetFLS, circleMap, radialSq, Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]
  | cast j =>
      simp [targetFLS, circleMap]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.circlePoint_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem circlePoint_mem_orbit (V : TamedField (targetFLS m)) (theta : ℝ) :
    circlePoint m theta ∈ V.orbit (circlePoint m 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact V.continuousCurve_mem_orbit (circlePoint m) (continuous_circlePoint m)
    (circlePoint_mem_target_fiber m) theta

name: Submission.StandardBirth.circlePoint_eq_iff_mod
proof:
:= by
  have hcos : Real.cos theta = Real.cos theta' := by
    simpa using congrArg (fun x : E => x (radialFirst m)) h
  have hsin : Real.sin theta = Real.sin theta' := by
    simpa using congrArg (fun x : E => x (radialSecond m)) h
  have hone : Real.cos (theta' - theta) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.cos_sub, ← hcos, ← hsin]
    linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff _).mp hone
  exact ⟨z, by linarith⟩

name: Submission.StandardBirth.unitCircleCurve_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem unitCircleCurve_zero : unitCircleCurve m 0 = circlePoint m 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [unitCircleCurve]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.unitCircleCurve_closed
statement: theorem unitCircleCurve_closed : unitCircleCurve m 0 = unitCircleCurve m 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  by_cases hiA : i = radialFirst m
  · subst i
    simp [unitCircleCurve]
  · by_cases hiB : i = radialSecond m
    · subst i
      simp [unitCircleCurve]
    · have hi : ∀ theta, circlePoint m theta i = 0 := by
        intro theta
        simp [circlePoint, Pi.single_apply, hiA, hiB]
      simp [unitCircleCurve, hi]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.unitCircleCurve_eq_cases
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := circlePoint_eq_iff_mod m huv
  have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
  have huvZ : (v : ℝ) = (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) := by
    change 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ) =
      2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) at hz
    nlinarith
  have hzLowerR : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  have hzUpperR : (z : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
  have hzLower : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast hzLowerR
  have hzUpper : z ≤ (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hzUpperR
  rcases (show z = -1 ∨ z = 0 ∨ z = 1 by omega) with hzv | hzv | hzv
  · right; right
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hzv] at huvZ
    norm_num at huvZ
    exact huvZ.symm
  · right; left
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.unitCircle_paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental
statement:
theorem unitCircle_paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS m)) :
    loopClassZ2 (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
        (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed =
      V.fundamentalFrameClass (circlePoint_mem_target_fiber m 0)
proof:
:=
  (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental

name: Submission.StandardBirth.exists_angle_of_sq_add_sq_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  have ha : -1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 1 := by
    constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg b, sq_nonneg (a + 1), sq_nonneg (a - 1)]
  rcases le_or_gt 0 b with hb | hb
  · refine ⟨Real.arccos a, Real.cos_arccos ha.1 ha.2, ?_⟩
    rw [Real.sin_arccos]
    have h1 : 1 - a ^ 2 = b ^ 2 := by linarith
    rw [h1, Real.sqrt_sq hb]
  · refine ⟨-Real.arccos a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Real.cos_neg]
      exact Real.cos_arccos ha.1 ha.2
    · rw [Real.sin_neg, Real.sin_arccos]
      have h1 : 1 - a ^ 2 = b ^ 2 := by linarith
      rw [h1, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos hb.le, neg_neg]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.target_fiber_eq_range
statement:
theorem target_fiber_eq_range :
    (targetFLS m).fiber = Set.range (circlePoint m)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hr : x (radialFirst m) ^ 2 + x (radialSecond m) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q => q (Fin.last m)) hx
      simp [targetFLS, circleMap, radialSq] at h
      linarith
    obtain ⟨theta, hcos, hsin⟩ := exists_angle_of_sq_add_sq_eq_one hr
    refine ⟨theta, ?_⟩
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext i
    induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
        change circlePoint m theta (radialSecond m) = x (radialSecond m)
        rw [circlePoint_apply_radialSecond, hsin]
    | cast i =>
        induction i using Fin.lastCases with
        | last =>
            change circlePoint m theta (radialFirst m) = x (radialFirst m)
            rw [circlePoint_apply_radialFirst, hcos]
        | cast j =>
            have hj := congrArg (fun q => q j.castSucc) hx
            have hxj : x j.castSucc.castSucc = 0 := by
              simpa [targetFLS, circleMap] using hj
            change circlePoint m theta j.castSucc.castSucc =
              x j.castSucc.castSucc
            rw [hxj]
            exact circlePoint_apply_transverse m theta j
  · rintro ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    exact circlePoint_mem_target_fiber m theta

name: Submission.StandardBirth.target_orbit_eq_fiber
statement:
theorem target_orbit_eq_fiber (V : TamedField (targetFLS m)) :
    V.orbit (circlePoint m 0) = (targetFLS m).fiber
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact V.orbit_subset_fiber (circlePoint_mem_target_fiber m 0)
  · rw [target_fiber_eq_range m]
    rintro x ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    exact circlePoint_mem_orbit m V theta

name: Submission.StandardBirth.targetOrbitIndex_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem targetOrbitIndex_coe (V : TamedField (targetFLS m)) :
    ((targetOrbitIndex m V : V.OrbitIndex) : Set E) =
      V.orbit (circlePoint m 0)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.StandardBirth.orbitIndex_eq_targetOrbitIndex
statement:
theorem orbitIndex_eq_targetOrbitIndex (V : TamedField (targetFLS m))
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) : O = targetOrbitIndex m V
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (O : Set E) = V.orbit (circlePoint m 0)
  rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O, V.orbit_eq_of_mem]
  rw [target_orbit_eq_fiber m V]
  exact V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O

name: Submission.StandardBirth.target_framedDelta_eq_orbitContribution
statement:
theorem target_framedDelta_eq_orbitContribution
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS m)) :
    V.framedDelta = V.orbitContribution (targetOrbitIndex m V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  letI : Unique V.OrbitIndex := {
    default := targetOrbitIndex m V
    uniq := orbitIndex_eq_targetOrbitIndex m V }
  simp [TamedField.framedDelta]
  exact congrArg V.orbitContribution
    (orbitIndex_eq_targetOrbitIndex m V default)

name: Submission.StandardBirth.target_framedDelta_eq_paramFrameClass_add_one
statement:
theorem target_framedDelta_eq_paramFrameClass_add_one
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS m)) :
    V.framedDelta =
      loopClassZ2 (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
        (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [target_framedDelta_eq_orbitContribution]
  unfold TamedField.orbitContribution TamedField.orbitFrameClass
  have hpoint : V.orbitPoint (targetOrbitIndex m V) ∈
      V.orbit (circlePoint m 0) := by
    rw [← targetOrbitIndex_coe m V, V.orbitPoint_orbit]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  have hbase :
      V.fundamentalFrameClass (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (targetOrbitIndex m V)) =
        V.fundamentalFrameClass (circlePoint_mem_target_fiber m 0) :=
    V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit
      (circlePoint_mem_target_fiber m 0) hpoint
  change V.fundamentalFrameClass
      (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (targetOrbitIndex m V)) + 1 = _
  rw [hbase, ← unitCircle_paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental m V]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.targetSign_positiveFramedDelta_eq_framedDelta
statement:
theorem targetSign_positiveFramedDelta_eq_framedDelta
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS m)) :
    (targetSign m).positiveFramedDelta V = V.framedDelta
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold FiberSign.positiveFramedDelta TamedField.deltaOn TamedField.framedDelta
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro O _
  have hselected : (O : Set E) ∈
      (targetSign m).positiveOrbitCollection V := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O] at hx
      exact V.orbit_subset_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) hx
    · simp [targetSign]
  simp [hselected]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.targetSign_positiveDelta_eq_framedDelta
statement:
theorem targetSign_positiveDelta_eq_framedDelta
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS m)) :
    (targetSign m).positiveDelta = V.framedDelta
proof:
:= by
  rw [(targetSign m).positiveDelta_eq V,
    targetSign_positiveFramedDelta_eq_framedDelta]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.targetSign_positiveDelta_eq_zero_of_paramFrameClass
statement:
theorem targetSign_positiveDelta_eq_zero_of_paramFrameClass
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS m))
    (hframe : loopClassZ2 (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
      (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed = 1) :
    (targetSign m).positiveDelta = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [targetSign_positiveDelta_eq_framedDelta m V,
    target_framedDelta_eq_paramFrameClass_add_one m V, hframe]
  decide

name: Submission.StandardBirth.source_fiber_eq_empty
statement: theorem source_fiber_eq_empty : (sourceFLS m).fiber = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [FramedLevelSet.fiber, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_empty_iff_false,
    iff_false]
  intro hx
  have h := congrArg (fun q => q (Fin.last m)) hx
  simp [sourceFLS, circleMap, radialSq] at h
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x (radialFirst m)), sq_nonneg (x (radialSecond m))]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.sourceSign_positiveDelta
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceSign_positiveDelta :
    (sourceSign m).positiveDelta = 0
proof:
:=
  FiberSign.positiveDelta_eq_zero_of_fiber_eq_empty _ (source_fiber_eq_empty m)

name: Submission.StandardBirth.source_target_positiveDelta_eq_of_paramFrameClass
statement:
theorem source_target_positiveDelta_eq_of_paramFrameClass
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS m))
    (hframe : loopClassZ2 (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
      (simpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed = 1) :
    (sourceSign m).positiveDelta = (targetSign m).positiveDelta
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceSign_positiveDelta,
    targetSign_positiveDelta_eq_zero_of_paramFrameClass m V hframe]

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.positiveSlabCore_eq
statement:
theorem positiveSlabCore_eq
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁) (a b : ℝ) :
    C.positiveSlabCore a b =
      slabFiber C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData a b ∩ C ⁻¹' Ici 0
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  simp only [positiveSlabCore, slabFiber, LevelCobordismData.fiber,
    Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_inter_iff, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ici]
  change (C.cobordism.G v = 0 ∧ tcoord v ∈ Icc a b ∧ 0 ≤ C v) ↔
    ((C.cobordism.G v = 0 ∧ tcoord v ∈ Icc a b) ∧ 0 ≤ C v)
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hv, ht, hs⟩
    exact ⟨⟨hv, ht⟩, hs⟩
  · rintro ⟨⟨hv, ht⟩, hs⟩
    exact ⟨hv, ht, hs⟩

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.isCompact_positiveSlabCore
statement:
theorem isCompact_positiveSlabCore
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁) (a b : ℝ) :
    IsCompact (C.positiveSlabCore a b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [C.positiveSlabCore_eq]
  exact (isCompact_slabFiber C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData a b).inter_right
    (isClosed_Ici.preimage C.continuous)

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.positive_of_mem_positiveSlabCore
proof:
:= by
  exact lt_of_le_of_ne hv.2.2 (C.nonzero v hv.1).symm

name: Submission.MorsePosition.spatialDeriv_surjective_on_positive_of_negative_event
statement:
theorem spatialDeriv_surjective_on_positive_of_negative_event
    (P : MorsePosition C.cobordism) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ P.eventTimes)
    (hnegative : P.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (C.labelMorsePosition P).negativeCenters)
    {v : E'} (hvzero : C.cobordism.G v = 0)
    (hvtime : tcoord v ∈
      Icc (P.eventBracket t ht).before (P.eventBracket t ht).after)
    (hvpositive : 0 < C v) :
    Surjective (spatialDeriv C.cobordism.G v)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hsurj
  have hvcritical : v ∈ timeCritical C.cobordism.G := ⟨hvzero, hsurj⟩
  have hcenter : v = P.eventCenter t ht :=
    (P.eventBracket t ht).isolates v hvcritical hvtime
  have hcenter_negative : C (P.eventCenter t ht) < 0 := by
    exact ((C.labelMorsePosition P).mem_negativeCenters_iff.mp hnegative).2
  rw [hcenter] at hvpositive
  linarith

name: Submission.MorsePosition.positiveSlabCore_subset_slabRegularSet_of_negative_event
statement:
theorem positiveSlabCore_subset_slabRegularSet_of_negative_event
    (P : MorsePosition C.cobordism) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ P.eventTimes)
    (hnegative : P.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (C.labelMorsePosition P).negativeCenters) :
    C.positiveSlabCore (P.eventBracket t ht).before
        (P.eventBracket t ht).after ⊆
      slabRegularSet C.cobordism.G
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hspatial : Surjective (spatialDeriv C.cobordism.G v) :=
    P.spatialDeriv_surjective_on_positive_of_negative_event ht hnegative
      hv.1 hv.2.1 (C.positive_of_mem_positiveSlabCore hv)
  exact mem_slabRegularSet_of_spatial_surjective
    (C.cobordism.regular v hv.1) hspatial

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coord_apply
statement:
private lemma fderiv_coord_apply
    (G : E → F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => G q i) x h = fderiv ℝ G x h i
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj i
  have hG' : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G x) x :=
    (hG.differentiable infty_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun q => G q i)
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ G x)) x := by
    exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (G x) i).comp x hG'
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hcomp.fderiv
  simpa [outProj] using happ

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_apply_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_coreMap_apply_zero (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (coreMap m hm) x h 0 = ⟪x, h⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (coreMap m hm) (contDiff_coreMap m hm) 0 x h]
  have hfun : (fun q : E => coreMap m hm q 0) =
      fun q => (‖q‖ ^ 2 - 1) / 2 := by
    funext q
    rw [coreMap_apply_zero, CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
  rw [hfun]
  have hnorm : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => ‖q‖ ^ 2)
      (2 • innerSL ℝ x) x := by
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q : E => ‖q‖ ^ 2) x := by
      rw [show (fun q : E => ‖q‖ ^ 2) = CompactBirth.normSq from by
        funext q
        exact (CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq q).symm]
      exact CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.differentiable
        infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
    rw [← fderiv_norm_sq_apply x]
    exact hd.hasFDerivAt
  have hder' := (hnorm.sub_const 1).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  rw [show (fun q : E => (‖q‖ ^ 2 - 1) / 2) =
      fun q => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (‖q‖ ^ 2 - 1) from by
    funext q
    ring]
  have hder : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E =>
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (‖q‖ ^ 2 - 1)) (innerSL ℝ x) x := by
    have hmap : (1 / 2 : ℝ) • (2 • innerSL ℝ x) = innerSL ℝ x := by
      ext v
      simp
    rw [hmap] at hder'
    exact hder'
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hder.fderiv
  simpa [innerSL_apply_apply] using happ

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_apply_one
statement:
lemma fderiv_coreMap_apply_one (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (coreMap m hm) x h 1 =
      h 0 * x 2 + x 0 * h 2 + h 1 * x 3 + x 1 * h 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (coreMap m hm) (contDiff_coreMap m hm) 1 x h]
  have hfun : (fun q : E => coreMap m hm q 1) =
      fun q => q 0 * q 2 + q 1 * q 3 := by
    funext q
    rw [coreMap_apply_one]
    rfl
  rw [hfun]
  let p0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  let p2 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 2
  let p3 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 3
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 0) p0 x := p0.hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 1) p1 x := p1.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 2) p2 x := p2.hasFDerivAt
  have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 3) p3 x := p3.hasFDerivAt
  have hd := (h0.mul h2).add (h1.mul h3)
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hd.fderiv
  change fderiv ℝ (((fun q : E => q 0) * fun q => q 2) +
      ((fun q : E => q 1) * fun q => q 3)) x h = _
  calc
    _ = x 0 * h 2 + x 2 * h 0 +
        (x 1 * h 3 + x 3 * h 1) := by
      simpa [p0, p1, p2, p3] using happ
    _ = _ := by ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_apply_two
statement:
lemma fderiv_coreMap_apply_two (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (coreMap m hm) x h 2 =
      h 1 * x 2 + x 1 * h 2 - h 0 * x 3 - x 0 * h 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (coreMap m hm) (contDiff_coreMap m hm) 2 x h]
  have hfun : (fun q : E => coreMap m hm q 2) =
      fun q => q 1 * q 2 - q 0 * q 3 := by
    funext q
    rw [coreMap_apply_two]
    rfl
  rw [hfun]
  let p0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  let p2 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 2
  let p3 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 3
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 0) p0 x := p0.hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 1) p1 x := p1.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 2) p2 x := p2.hasFDerivAt
  have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 3) p3 x := p3.hasFDerivAt
  have hd := (h1.mul h2).sub (h0.mul h3)
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hd.fderiv
  change fderiv ℝ (((fun q : E => q 1) * fun q => q 2) -
      ((fun q : E => q 0) * fun q => q 3)) x h = _
  calc
    _ = x 1 * h 2 + x 2 * h 1 -
        (x 0 * h 3 + x 3 * h 0) := by
      simpa [p0, p1, p2, p3] using happ
    _ = _ := by ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_apply_tail
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (coreMap m hm) (contDiff_coreMap m hm) i x h]
  have hfun : (fun q : E => coreMap m hm q i) = fun q => q i.succ := by
    funext q
    exact coreMap_apply_tail m hm q hi0 hi1 hi2
  rw [hfun]
  exact congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h)
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i.succ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.fderiv

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coordinate_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin (m + 2) := j.pred hj0
  have hji : i.succ = j := Fin.succ_pred j hj0
  have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hi
    apply hj1
    rw [← hji, hi]
    rfl
  have hi1 : i ≠ 1 := by
    intro hi
    apply hj2
    rw [← hji, hi]
    rfl
  have hi2 : i ≠ 2 := by
    intro hi
    apply hj3
    rw [← hji, hi]
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)]
  have hout := congrArg (fun q : F => q i) hx
  rw [coreMap_apply_tail m hm x hi0 hi1 hi2] at hout
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hout
  rwa [hji] at hout

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.first_branch_normSq
statement:
lemma first_branch_normSq {x : E} (hx : coreMap m hm x = 0)
    (hu : x 2 = 0 ∧ x 3 = 0) : x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn := normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  unfold CompactBirth.normSq at hn
  have hrest : ∀ j : Fin (m + 3), j ≠ 0 → j ≠ 1 → x j ^ 2 = 0 := by
    intro j hj0 hj1
    by_cases hj2 : j = 2
    · subst j
      simp [hu.1]
    · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
      · subst j
        simp [hu.2]
      · rw [coordinate_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx hj0 hj1 hj2 hj3]
        norm_num
  have hkey : ∀ j : Fin (m + 3), x j ^ 2 =
      (if j = 0 then x 0 ^ 2 else 0) +
        (if j = 1 then x 1 ^ 2 else 0) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      simp
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        simp [hj0]
      · rw [if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1, add_zero, hrest j hj0 hj1]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hkey j,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (0 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => x 0 ^ 2),
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (1 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => x 1 ^ 2),
    if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)] at hn
  exact hn

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.second_branch_normSq
statement:
lemma second_branch_normSq {x : E} (hx : coreMap m hm x = 0)
    (hz : x 0 = 0 ∧ x 1 = 0) : x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hn := normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  unfold CompactBirth.normSq at hn
  have hkey : ∀ j : Fin (m + 3), x j ^ 2 =
      (if j = 2 then x 2 ^ 2 else 0) +
        (if j = 3 then x 3 ^ 2 else 0) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj2 : j = 2
    · subst j
      have h23 : (2 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 3 := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3),
          Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)] at hv
      simp [h23]
    · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
      · subst j
        simp [hj2]
      · rw [if_neg hj2, if_neg hj3, add_zero]
        by_cases hj0 : j = 0
        · subst j
          simp [hz.1]
        · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
          · subst j
            simp [hz.2]
          · rw [coordinate_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx hj0 hj1 hj2 hj3]
            norm_num
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hkey j,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (2 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => x 2 ^ 2),
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (3 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => x 3 ^ 2),
    if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)] at hn
  exact hn

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstPreimage_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma firstPreimage_apply_zero (x : E) (y : F) :
    firstPreimage m hm x y 0 = x 0 * y 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [firstPreimage]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstPreimage_apply_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma firstPreimage_apply_succ (x : E) (y : F) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    firstPreimage m hm x y i.succ =
      if i = 0 then x 1 * y 0
      else if i = 1 then x 0 * y 1 + x 1 * y 2
      else if i = 2 then x 1 * y 1 - x 0 * y 2
      else y i
proof:
:= by
  simp [firstPreimage]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstPreimage_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma firstPreimage_apply_one (x : E) (y : F) :
    firstPreimage m hm x y 1 = x 1 * y 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : Fin (m + 3)) = (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  calc
    firstPreimage m hm x y 1 =
        firstPreimage m hm x y (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => firstPreimage m hm x y j) h1
    _ = _ := by
      simpa using firstPreimage_apply_succ m hm x y (0 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstPreimage_apply_two
statement:
@[simp] lemma firstPreimage_apply_two (x : E) (y : F) :
    firstPreimage m hm x y 2 = x 0 * y 1 + x 1 * y 2
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : Fin (m + 3)) = (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3)]
  have h10 : (1 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2)] at hv
  calc
    firstPreimage m hm x y 2 =
        firstPreimage m hm x y (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => firstPreimage m hm x y j) h2
    _ = _ := by
      simpa [h10] using firstPreimage_apply_succ m hm x y (1 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstPreimage_apply_three
statement:
@[simp] lemma firstPreimage_apply_three (x : E) (y : F) :
    firstPreimage m hm x y 3 = x 1 * y 1 - x 0 * y 2
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : (3 : Fin (m + 3)) = (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)]
  have h20 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at hv
  have h21 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2)] at hv
  calc
    firstPreimage m hm x y 3 =
        firstPreimage m hm x y (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => firstPreimage m hm x y j) h3
    _ = _ := by
      simpa [h20, h21] using
        firstPreimage_apply_succ m hm x y (2 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstPreimage_apply_tail
proof:
:= by
  simp [firstPreimage, hi0, hi1, hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondPreimage_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma secondPreimage_apply_zero (x : E) (y : F) :
    secondPreimage m hm x y 0 = x 2 * y 1 - x 3 * y 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [secondPreimage]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondPreimage_apply_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma secondPreimage_apply_succ (x : E) (y : F) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    secondPreimage m hm x y i.succ =
      if i = 0 then x 3 * y 1 + x 2 * y 2
      else if i = 1 then x 2 * y 0
      else if i = 2 then x 3 * y 0
      else y i
proof:
:= by
  simp [secondPreimage]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondPreimage_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma secondPreimage_apply_one (x : E) (y : F) :
    secondPreimage m hm x y 1 = x 3 * y 1 + x 2 * y 2
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : Fin (m + 3)) = (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  calc
    secondPreimage m hm x y 1 =
        secondPreimage m hm x y (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => secondPreimage m hm x y j) h1
    _ = _ := by
      simpa using secondPreimage_apply_succ m hm x y (0 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondPreimage_apply_two
statement:
@[simp] lemma secondPreimage_apply_two (x : E) (y : F) :
    secondPreimage m hm x y 2 = x 2 * y 0
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : Fin (m + 3)) = (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3)]
  have h10 : (1 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2)] at hv
  calc
    secondPreimage m hm x y 2 =
        secondPreimage m hm x y (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => secondPreimage m hm x y j) h2
    _ = _ := by
      simpa [h10] using secondPreimage_apply_succ m hm x y (1 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondPreimage_apply_three
statement:
@[simp] lemma secondPreimage_apply_three (x : E) (y : F) :
    secondPreimage m hm x y 3 = x 3 * y 0
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : (3 : Fin (m + 3)) = (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)]
  have h20 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at hv
  have h21 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2)] at hv
  calc
    secondPreimage m hm x y 3 =
        secondPreimage m hm x y (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => secondPreimage m hm x y j) h3
    _ = _ := by
      simpa [h20, h21] using
        secondPreimage_apply_succ m hm x y (2 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondPreimage_apply_tail
proof:
:= by
  simp [secondPreimage, hi0, hi1, hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.inner_eq_sum_local
statement:
private lemma inner_eq_sum_local (x h : E) :
    ⟪x, h⟫_ℝ = ∑ j, x j * h j
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by
    simp [RCLike.inner_apply, mul_comm]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.inner_firstPreimage
statement:
lemma inner_firstPreimage {x : E} (hx : coreMap m hm x = 0)
    (hu : x 2 = 0 ∧ x 3 = 0) (y : F) :
    ⟪x, firstPreimage m hm x y⟫_ℝ = y 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_eq_sum_local]
  have hpoint : ∀ j : Fin (m + 3),
      x j * firstPreimage m hm x y j = x j ^ 2 * y 0 := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      simp [pow_two, mul_assoc]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        simp [pow_two, mul_assoc]
      · by_cases hj2 : j = 2
        · subst j
          simp [hu.1]
        · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
          · subst j
            simp [hu.2]
          · rw [coordinate_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx hj0 hj1 hj2 hj3]
            simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hpoint j, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  change CompactBirth.normSq x * y 0 = y 0
  rw [normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx, one_mul]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.inner_secondPreimage
statement:
lemma inner_secondPreimage {x : E} (hx : coreMap m hm x = 0)
    (hz : x 0 = 0 ∧ x 1 = 0) (y : F) :
    ⟪x, secondPreimage m hm x y⟫_ℝ = y 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_eq_sum_local]
  have hpoint : ∀ j : Fin (m + 3),
      x j * secondPreimage m hm x y j = x j ^ 2 * y 0 := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      simp [hz.1]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        simp [hz.2]
      · by_cases hj2 : j = 2
        · subst j
          simp [pow_two, mul_assoc]
        · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
          · subst j
            simp [pow_two, mul_assoc]
          · rw [coordinate_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx hj0 hj1 hj2 hj3]
            simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hpoint j, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  change CompactBirth.normSq x * y 0 = y 0
  rw [normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx, one_mul]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_firstPreimage
statement:
lemma fderiv_coreMap_firstPreimage {x : E} (hx : coreMap m hm x = 0)
    (hu : x 2 = 0 ∧ x 3 = 0) (y : F) :
    fderiv ℝ (coreMap m hm) x (firstPreimage m hm x y) = y
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_zero, inner_firstPreimage m hm hx hu y]
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_one]
      simp only [firstPreimage_apply_zero, firstPreimage_apply_one,
        firstPreimage_apply_two, firstPreimage_apply_three, hu.1, hu.2,
        mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]
      have hn := first_branch_normSq m hm hx hu
      calc
        _ = (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * y 1 := by ring
        _ = y 1 := by rw [hn, one_mul]
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_two]
        simp only [firstPreimage_apply_zero, firstPreimage_apply_one,
          firstPreimage_apply_two, firstPreimage_apply_three, hu.1, hu.2,
          mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, sub_zero]
        have hn := first_branch_normSq m hm hx hu
        calc
          _ = (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * y 2 := by ring
          _ = y 2 := by rw [hn, one_mul]
      · rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_tail m hm x _ hi0 hi1 hi2,
          firstPreimage_apply_tail m hm x y hi0 hi1 hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_secondPreimage
statement:
lemma fderiv_coreMap_secondPreimage {x : E} (hx : coreMap m hm x = 0)
    (hz : x 0 = 0 ∧ x 1 = 0) (y : F) :
    fderiv ℝ (coreMap m hm) x (secondPreimage m hm x y) = y
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_zero, inner_secondPreimage m hm hx hz y]
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_one]
      simp only [secondPreimage_apply_zero, secondPreimage_apply_one,
        secondPreimage_apply_two, secondPreimage_apply_three, hz.1, hz.2,
        mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]
      have hn := second_branch_normSq m hm hx hz
      calc
        _ = (x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2) * y 1 := by ring
        _ = y 1 := by rw [hn, one_mul]
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_two]
        simp only [secondPreimage_apply_zero, secondPreimage_apply_one,
          secondPreimage_apply_two, secondPreimage_apply_three, hz.1, hz.2,
          mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, sub_zero]
        have hn := second_branch_normSq m hm hx hz
        calc
          _ = (x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2) * y 2 := by ring
          _ = y 2 := by rw [hn, one_mul]
      · rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_tail m hm x _ hi0 hi1 hi2,
          secondPreimage_apply_tail m hm x y hi0 hi1 hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.surjective_fderiv_coreMap_of_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  rcases plane_dichotomy_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx with hz | hu
  · exact ⟨secondPreimage m hm x y,
      fderiv_coreMap_secondPreimage m hm hx hz y⟩
  · exact ⟨firstPreimage m hm x y,
      fderiv_coreMap_firstPreimage m hm hx hu y⟩

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.levelMap_eventuallyEq_coreMap
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen {z : E | CompactBirth.normSq z < 2} :=
    isOpen_lt CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.continuous continuous_const
  exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hx) fun z hz => by
    rw [levelMap, CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero hz.le]
    simp

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.surjective_fderiv_levelMap_of_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hxcore := (levelMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero m hm x).mp hx
  have hn := normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hxcore
  have hlt : CompactBirth.normSq x < 2 := by rw [hn]; norm_num
  rw [(levelMap_eventuallyEq_coreMap m hm hlt).fderiv_eq]
  exact surjective_fderiv_coreMap_of_eq_zero m hm hxcore

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.X_fiber
statement: theorem X_fiber (x : E) : x ∈ (X m hm).fiber ↔ coreMap m hm x = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact levelMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero m hm x

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.flatOutside
statement:
theorem flatOutside :
    (X m hm).FlatOutside (background m hm) 0 2
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hn : 2 ≤ ‖x‖ := by simpa [dist_zero_right] using hx
  exact levelMap_flatOutside m hm hn

name: Submission.projIcc_eq_zero
statement:
theorem projIcc_eq_zero {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≤ 0) :
    Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one r = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Set.coe_projIcc, Set.Icc.coe_zero, min_eq_right (hr.trans zero_le_one),
    max_eq_left hr]

name: Submission.projIcc_eq_one
statement:
theorem projIcc_eq_one {r : ℝ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) :
    Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one r = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Set.coe_projIcc, Set.Icc.coe_one, min_eq_left hr, max_eq_right zero_le_one]

name: Submission.continuous_collarMap
statement: theorem continuous_collarMap : Continuous (collarMap (N := N))
proof:
:=
  continuous_pi fun _ => continuous_projIcc.comp <| by fun_prop

name: Submission.collarMap_mem_boundary
statement:
theorem collarMap_mem_boundary {t : I^N} (ht : t ∈ Cube.boundary N) :
    collarMap t ∈ Cube.boundary N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ := ht
  · have h0 : (t i : ℝ) = 0 := by rw [hi, Set.Icc.coe_zero]
    exact ⟨i, Or.inl (by simp only [collarMap, h0]; exact projIcc_eq_zero (by norm_num))⟩
  · have h1 : (t i : ℝ) = 1 := by rw [hi, Set.Icc.coe_one]
    exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by simp only [collarMap, h1]; exact projIcc_eq_one (by norm_num))⟩

name: Submission.collared_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem collared_apply (p : Ω^ N X x) (t : I^N) : collared p t = p (collarMap t)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.collared_eq_basepoint
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ := h
  · exact p.2 (collarMap t)
      ⟨i, Or.inl (by simp only [collarMap]; exact projIcc_eq_zero (by linarith))⟩
  · exact p.2 (collarMap t)
      ⟨i, Or.inr (by simp only [collarMap]; exact projIcc_eq_one (by linarith))⟩

name: Submission.continuous_collarHomotopyMap
statement:
theorem continuous_collarHomotopyMap :
    Continuous fun st : I × (I^N) => collarHomotopyMap st.1 st.2
proof:
:=
  continuous_pi fun _ => continuous_projIcc.comp <| by fun_prop

name: Submission.collarHomotopyMap_zero
statement: theorem collarHomotopyMap_zero (t : I^N) : collarHomotopyMap 0 t = t
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  have h : (1 + ((0 : I) : ℝ)) * (t i : ℝ) - ((0 : I) : ℝ) / 2 = (t i : ℝ) := by
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_zero]; ring
  simp only [collarHomotopyMap]
  rw [h]
  exact Set.projIcc_val zero_le_one (t i)

name: Submission.collarHomotopyMap_one
statement: theorem collarHomotopyMap_one (t : I^N) : collarHomotopyMap 1 t = collarMap t
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  have h : (1 + ((1 : I) : ℝ)) * (t i : ℝ) - ((1 : I) : ℝ) / 2
      = 2 * (t i : ℝ) - 1 / 2 := by
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_one]; ring
  simp only [collarHomotopyMap, collarMap]
  rw [h]

name: Submission.collarHomotopyMap_mem_boundary
statement:
theorem collarHomotopyMap_mem_boundary (s : I) {t : I^N} (ht : t ∈ Cube.boundary N) :
    collarHomotopyMap s t ∈ Cube.boundary N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ := ht
  · have h0 : (t i : ℝ) = 0 := by rw [hi, Set.Icc.coe_zero]
    refine ⟨i, Or.inl ?_⟩
    simp only [collarHomotopyMap, h0]
    exact projIcc_eq_zero (by have := s.2.1; linarith)
  · have h1 : (t i : ℝ) = 1 := by rw [hi, Set.Icc.coe_one]
    refine ⟨i, Or.inr ?_⟩
    simp only [collarHomotopyMap, h1]
    exact projIcc_eq_one (by have := s.2.1; linarith)

name: Submission.homotopic_collared
statement: theorem homotopic_collared (p : Ω^ N X x) : GenLoop.Homotopic p (collared p)

name: Submission.FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger_cast_eq_of_heq
statement:
theorem positiveFrameLedger_cast_eq_of_heq
    {X Y : FramedLevelSet n} (hXY : X = Y)
    {S : FiberSign X} {T : FiberSign Y} (hST : HEq S T)
    (V : TamedField Y) :
    S.positiveFrameLedger (V.cast hXY.symm) = T.positiveFrameLedger V
proof:
:= by
  subst Y
  have h : S = T := eq_of_heq hST
  subst T
  rfl

name: Submission.FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger_eq_allPositive_of_pos
statement:
theorem positiveFrameLedger_eq_allPositive_of_pos
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} (S : FiberSign X) (V : TamedField X)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ X.fiber, 0 < S x) :
    S.positiveFrameLedger V = (allPositive X).positiveFrameLedger V
proof:
:= by
  unfold positiveFrameLedger
  congr 1
  apply Set.ext
  intro O
  constructor
  · intro hO x hx
    exact ⟨hO hx |>.1, by simp⟩
  · intro hO x hx
    exact ⟨hO hx |>.1, hpos x (hO hx).1⟩

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.sliceSign_positiveFrameLedger_perm_of_regularSlab
statement:
theorem sliceSign_positiveFrameLedger_perm_of_regularSlab
    {a b t₀ t₁ : ℝ}
    (hreg : regularSlab C.cobordism.G a b)
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b)
    (V₀ : TamedField
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData t₀
        (hreg.sliceRegular ht₀)))
    (V₁ : TamedField
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData t₁
        (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁))) :
    ((C.sliceSign t₀ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₀)).positiveFrameLedger V₀).Perm
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).positiveFrameLedger V₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := exists_slabTamedField C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData hreg
  let T : V₀.DeltaTransport V₁ :=
    (C.concreteRegularSlabFrameTransport W hreg ht₀ ht₁ V₀ V₁).toDeltaTransport
  let Tpos : V₀.SelectedDeltaTransport V₁
      ((C.sliceSign t₀ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₀)).positiveOrbitCollection V₀)
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).positiveOrbitCollection V₁) :=
    TamedField.SelectedDeltaTransport.ofDeltaTransport T
      (C.sliceOrbitEquiv_mem_positive_iff W hreg ht₀ ht₁ V₀ V₁)
  exact TamedField.SelectedDeltaTransport.selectedFrameLedger_perm V₀ V₁ Tpos

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.positiveFrameLedger_perm_of_regularSlab
statement:
theorem positiveFrameLedger_perm_of_regularSlab
    (hreg : regularSlab C.cobordism.G 0 1)
    (V₀ : TamedField X₀) (V₁ : TamedField X₁) :
    (S₀.positiveFrameLedger V₀).Perm (S₁.positiveFrameLedger V₁)
proof:
:= by
  let ht₀ : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 := by norm_num
  let ht₁ : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 := by norm_num
  let Xzero := SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt
    C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData 0 (hreg.sliceRegular ht₀)
  let Xone := SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt
    C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData 1 (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)
  have hXzero : Xzero = X₀ := C.sliceFLSAt_zero_eq
  have hXone : Xone = X₁ := C.sliceFLSAt_one_eq
  let W₀ : TamedField Xzero := V₀.cast hXzero.symm
  let W₁ : TamedField Xone := V₁.cast hXone.symm
  have hp := C.sliceSign_positiveFrameLedger_perm_of_regularSlab
    hreg ht₀ ht₁ W₀ W₁
  have hz :
      (C.sliceSign 0 (hreg.sliceRegular ht₀)).positiveFrameLedger W₀ =
        S₀.positiveFrameLedger V₀ :=
    FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger_cast_eq_of_heq hXzero
      C.sliceSign_zero_heq V₀
  have ho :
      (C.sliceSign 1 (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).positiveFrameLedger W₁ =
        S₁.positiveFrameLedger V₁ :=
    FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger_cast_eq_of_heq hXone
      C.sliceSign_one_heq V₁
  rwa [hz, ho] at hp

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.sliceSign_positiveFrameLedger_eq_pair_zero_of_regularSlab
statement:
theorem sliceSign_positiveFrameLedger_eq_pair_zero_of_regularSlab
    {a b t₀ t₁ : ℝ}
    (hreg : regularSlab C.cobordism.G a b)
    (ht₀ : t₀ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b)
    (V₀ : TamedField
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData t₀
        (hreg.sliceRegular ht₀)))
    (V₁ : TamedField
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData t₁
        (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)))
    (hledger :
      (C.sliceSign t₀ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₀)).positiveFrameLedger V₀ =
        [(0 : ZMod 2), 0]) :
    (C.sliceSign t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).positiveFrameLedger V₁ =
      [(0 : ZMod 2), 0]
proof:
:= by
  have hp := C.sliceSign_positiveFrameLedger_perm_of_regularSlab
    hreg ht₀ ht₁ V₀ V₁
  rw [hledger] at hp
  have hcount := hp.length_eq
  have hall : ∀ z ∈
      (C.sliceSign t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).positiveFrameLedger V₁,
      z = (0 : ZMod 2) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzsrc : z ∈ [(0 : ZMod 2), 0] := hp.mem_iff.mpr hz
    simpa using hzsrc
  calc
    (C.sliceSign t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).positiveFrameLedger V₁ =
        List.replicate
          ((C.sliceSign t₁
            (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).positiveFrameLedger V₁).length 0 :=
      List.eq_replicate_length.mpr hall
    _ = [(0 : ZMod 2), 0] := by rw [← hcount]; rfl

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.target_positiveFrameLedger_eq_pair_zero_of_regularSlab
statement:
theorem target_positiveFrameLedger_eq_pair_zero_of_regularSlab
    (hreg : regularSlab C.cobordism.G 0 1)
