name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.transverseSq_nonneg
statement: lemma transverseSq_nonneg (v : A) : 0 ≤ transverseSq m v
proof:
:= by
  exact add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistShift_nonneg
statement: lemma twistShift_nonneg (v : A) : 0 ≤ twistShift m v
proof:
:= by
  have hr := transverseSq_nonneg m v
  exact div_nonneg hr (by positivity)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistShift_lt_half
statement: lemma twistShift_lt_half (v : A) : twistShift m v < 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hr := transverseSq_nonneg m v
  have hden : 0 < 2 * (1 + transverseSq m v) := by positivity
  rw [twistShift, div_lt_iff₀ hden]
  linarith

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_apply_rowZero
statement:
@[simp] lemma eventMap_apply_rowZero (v : A) :
    eventMap m v (rowZero m) =
      (twistRe m v + twistShift m v) *
          StandardSaddle.eventMap m v (rowZero m) -
        twistIm m v * StandardSaddle.eventMap m v (rowOne m)
proof:
:= by
  simp [eventMap, rowZero, rowOne]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_apply_rowOne
statement:
@[simp] lemma eventMap_apply_rowOne (v : A) :
    eventMap m v (rowOne m) =
      twistIm m v * StandardSaddle.eventMap m v (rowZero m) +
        (twistRe m v + twistShift m v) *
          StandardSaddle.eventMap m v (rowOne m)
proof:
:= by
  simp [eventMap, rowZero, rowOne]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_apply_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  simp [eventMap, hi₀, hi₁]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twist_normSq
statement:
lemma twist_normSq (v : A) :
    twistRe m v ^ 2 + twistIm m v ^ 2 =
      StandardSaddle.cassiniQ m (initCLM (m + 3) v) + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_eq]
  simp only [StandardSaddle.radiusSq, initCLM_apply]
  simp only [twistRe, twistIm]
  ring

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.contDiff_twistRe
statement: lemma contDiff_twistRe : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (twistRe m)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((((EuclideanSpace.proj
      (StandardSaddle.planeFirst m).castSucc : A →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.pow 2).sub
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj
      (StandardSaddle.planeSecond m).castSucc : A →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.pow 2)).sub
    contDiff_const)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.contDiff_twistIm
statement: lemma contDiff_twistIm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (twistIm m)
proof:
:= by
  exact (contDiff_const.mul
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj
      (StandardSaddle.planeFirst m).castSucc : A →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff)).mul
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj
      (StandardSaddle.planeSecond m).castSucc : A →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.contDiff_eventMap_coord
statement:
lemma contDiff_eventMap_coord (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v => StandardSaddle.eventMap m v i)
proof:
:= by
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i : F →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp
    (StandardSaddle.contDiff_eventMap m)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.contDiff_transverseSq
statement: lemma contDiff_transverseSq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (transverseSq m)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((contDiff_eventMap_coord m (rowZero m)).pow 2).add
    ((contDiff_eventMap_coord m (rowOne m)).pow 2)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.one_add_transverseSq_ne_zero
statement:
lemma one_add_transverseSq_ne_zero (v : A) :
    1 + transverseSq m v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hr := transverseSq_nonneg m v
  linarith

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.contDiff_twistShift
statement: lemma contDiff_twistShift : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (twistShift m)
proof:
:= by
  have hden : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : A => 2 * (1 + transverseSq m v)) :=
    contDiff_const.mul (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_transverseSq m))
  have hden0 : ∀ v : A, 2 * (1 + transverseSq m v) ≠ 0 := by
    intro v
    exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (one_add_transverseSq_ne_zero m v)
  exact (contDiff_transverseSq m).div hden hden0

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.contDiff_eventMap
statement: theorem contDiff_eventMap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (eventMap m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro i
  by_cases hi₀ : i = rowZero m
  · subst i
    simp only [eventMap_apply_rowZero]
    exact ((contDiff_twistRe m).add (contDiff_twistShift m)).mul
        (contDiff_eventMap_coord m (rowZero m)) |>.sub
      ((contDiff_twistIm m).mul (contDiff_eventMap_coord m (rowOne m)))
  · by_cases hi₁ : i = rowOne m
    · subst i
      simp only [eventMap_apply_rowOne]
      exact (contDiff_twistIm m).mul
          (contDiff_eventMap_coord m (rowZero m)) |>.add
        (((contDiff_twistRe m).add (contDiff_twistShift m)).mul
          (contDiff_eventMap_coord m (rowOne m)))
    · simpa only [eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁] using
        contDiff_eventMap_coord m i

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistRe_spaceTime
statement:
lemma twistRe_spaceTime (x : E) (t s : ℝ) :
    twistRe m (spaceTime x t) = twistRe m (spaceTime x s)
proof:
:= by
  change
    initCLM (m + 3) (spaceTime x t) (StandardSaddle.planeFirst m) ^ 2 -
          initCLM (m + 3) (spaceTime x t) (StandardSaddle.planeSecond m) ^ 2 - 1 =
      initCLM (m + 3) (spaceTime x s) (StandardSaddle.planeFirst m) ^ 2 -
          initCLM (m + 3) (spaceTime x s) (StandardSaddle.planeSecond m) ^ 2 - 1
  rw [initCLM_spaceTime, initCLM_spaceTime]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistIm_spaceTime
statement:
lemma twistIm_spaceTime (x : E) (t s : ℝ) :
    twistIm m (spaceTime x t) = twistIm m (spaceTime x s)
proof:
:= by
  change
    2 * initCLM (m + 3) (spaceTime x t) (StandardSaddle.planeFirst m) *
          initCLM (m + 3) (spaceTime x t) (StandardSaddle.planeSecond m) =
      2 * initCLM (m + 3) (spaceTime x s) (StandardSaddle.planeFirst m) *
          initCLM (m + 3) (spaceTime x s) (StandardSaddle.planeSecond m)
  rw [initCLM_spaceTime, initCLM_spaceTime]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.transverseSq_spaceTime_eq_of_standard_eq
statement:
lemma transverseSq_spaceTime_eq_of_standard_eq (x : E) (t s : ℝ)
    (hstd : StandardSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x t) =
      StandardSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x s)) :
    transverseSq m (spaceTime x t) = transverseSq m (spaceTime x s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [transverseSq, hstd]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistShift_spaceTime_eq_of_standard_eq
statement:
lemma twistShift_spaceTime_eq_of_standard_eq (x : E) (t s : ℝ)
    (hstd : StandardSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x t) =
      StandardSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x s)) :
    twistShift m (spaceTime x t) = twistShift m (spaceTime x s)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [twistShift,
    transverseSq_spaceTime_eq_of_standard_eq m x t s hstd]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_spaceTime_eq_of_standard_eq
statement:
lemma eventMap_spaceTime_eq_of_standard_eq (x : E) (t s : ℝ)
    (hstd : StandardSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x t) =
      StandardSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x s)) :
    eventMap m (spaceTime x t) = eventMap m (spaceTime x s)
proof:
:= by
  have hre := twistRe_spaceTime m x t s
  have him := twistIm_spaceTime m x t s
  have hshift := twistShift_spaceTime_eq_of_standard_eq m x t s hstd
  ext i
  by_cases hi₀ : i = rowZero m
  · subst i
    simp only [eventMap_apply_rowZero, hre, him, hshift, hstd]
  · by_cases hi₁ : i = rowOne m
    · subst i
      simp only [eventMap_apply_rowOne, hre, him, hshift, hstd]
    · rw [eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁,
        eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁, hstd]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_collar_zero
statement:
lemma eventMap_collar_zero (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 4) :
    eventMap m (spaceTime x t) = eventMap m (spaceTime x 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply eventMap_spaceTime_eq_of_standard_eq m x t 0
  rw [StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_zero m x ht,
    StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_zero m x (by norm_num)]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_collar_one
statement:
lemma eventMap_collar_one (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t) :
    eventMap m (spaceTime x t) = eventMap m (spaceTime x 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply eventMap_spaceTime_eq_of_standard_eq m x t 1
  rw [StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_one m x ht,
    StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_one m x (by norm_num)]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twist_normSq_ge_half_of_eventMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma twist_normSq_ge_half_of_eventMap_eq_zero
    (hm : 0 < m) {v : A} (hv : eventMap m v = 0) :
    1 / 2 ≤ twistRe m v ^ 2 + twistIm m v ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let ilast : Fin (m + 2) := Fin.last (m + 1)
  have hilast₀ : ilast ≠ rowZero m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [ilast, rowZero] at this
  have hilast₁ : ilast ≠ rowOne m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [ilast, rowOne] at this
    omega
  have hlast : StandardSaddle.eventMap m v ilast = 0 := by
    have h := congrArg (fun q : F => q ilast) hv
    rw [eventMap_apply_of_ne m hilast₀ hilast₁] at h
    simpa using h
  have hq : StandardSaddle.cassiniQ m (initCLM (m + 3) v) =
      StandardSaddle.height (vertC v) / 2 := by
    have h := hlast
    simp [ilast, StandardSaddle.eventMap] at h
    linarith
  rw [twist_normSq, hq]
  have hheight := StandardSaddle.neg_one_le_height (vertC v)
  linarith

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistCoefficient_normSq_pos_of_eventMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma twistCoefficient_normSq_pos_of_eventMap_eq_zero
    (hm : 0 < m) {v : A} (hv : eventMap m v = 0) :
    0 < (twistRe m v + twistShift m v) ^ 2 + twistIm m v ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hlarge := twist_normSq_ge_half_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hm hv
  have hs₀ := twistShift_nonneg m v
  have hs₁ := twistShift_lt_half m v
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤
      (twistRe m v + twistShift m v) ^ 2 + twistIm m v ^ 2 :=
    add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)
  refine lt_of_le_of_ne hnonneg ?_
  intro hzero
  have ha : twistRe m v + twistShift m v = 0 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (twistRe m v + twistShift m v),
      sq_nonneg (twistIm m v)]
  have hb : twistIm m v = 0 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (twistRe m v + twistShift m v),
      sq_nonneg (twistIm m v)]
  have hre : twistRe m v = -twistShift m v := by linarith
  rw [hre, hb] at hlarge
  nlinarith

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem eventMap_eq_zero_iff (hm : 0 < m) (v : A) :
    eventMap m v = 0 ↔ StandardSaddle.eventMap m v = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    let a := twistRe m v + twistShift m v
    let b := twistIm m v
    let u := StandardSaddle.eventMap m v (rowZero m)
    let w := StandardSaddle.eventMap m v (rowOne m)
    have h₀ : a * u - b * w = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : F => q (rowZero m)) hv
      simpa [a, b, u, w] using h
    have h₁ : b * u + a * w = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun q : F => q (rowOne m)) hv
      simpa [a, b, u, w] using h
    have hdet : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
      simpa [a, b] using
        twistCoefficient_normSq_pos_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hm hv
    have huProd : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * u = 0 := by
      calc
        (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * u = a * (a * u - b * w) +
            b * (b * u + a * w) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h₀, h₁]; ring
    have hwProd : (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * w = 0 := by
      calc
        (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) * w = -b * (a * u - b * w) +
            a * (b * u + a * w) := by ring
        _ = 0 := by rw [h₀, h₁]; ring
    have hu : u = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp huProd).resolve_left hdet.ne'
    have hw : w = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp hwProd).resolve_left hdet.ne'
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext i
    by_cases hi₀ : i = rowZero m
    · subst i
      simpa [u] using hu
    · by_cases hi₁ : i = rowOne m
      · subst i
        simpa [w] using hw
      · have hi := congrArg (fun q : F => q i) hv
        rw [eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁] at hi
        simpa using hi
  · intro hv
    ext i
    by_cases hi₀ : i = rowZero m
    · subst i
      simp [hv]
    · by_cases hi₁ : i = rowOne m
      · subst i
        simp [hv]
      · rw [eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁]
        simpa using congrArg (fun q : F => q i) hv

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.fderiv_coord_apply
statement:
private lemma fderiv_coord_apply
    (G : A → F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) (v h : A) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => G q i) v h = fderiv ℝ G v h i
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj i
  have hG' : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G v) v :=
    (hG.differentiable infty_ne_zero v).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun q => G q i)
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ G v)) v := by
    exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (G v) i).comp v hG'
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : A →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hcomp.fderiv
  simpa [outProj] using happ

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.fderiv_eventMap_apply_rowZero_of_standard_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_eventMap_apply_rowZero_of_standard_zero
    {v : A} (hv : StandardSaddle.eventMap m v = 0) (h : A) :
    fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h (rowZero m) =
      (twistRe m v + twistShift m v) *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.eventMap m) v h (rowZero m) -
        twistIm m v *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.eventMap m) v h (rowOne m)
proof:
:= by
  let aa : A → ℝ := fun q => twistRe m q + twistShift m q
  let bb : A → ℝ := twistIm m
  let g₀ : A → ℝ := fun q => StandardSaddle.eventMap m q (rowZero m)
  let g₁ : A → ℝ := fun q => StandardSaddle.eventMap m q (rowOne m)
  have haa : DifferentiableAt ℝ aa v :=
    (((contDiff_twistRe m).add (contDiff_twistShift m)).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero).differentiableAt
  have hbb : DifferentiableAt ℝ bb v :=
    ((contDiff_twistIm m).differentiable infty_ne_zero).differentiableAt
  have hg₀ : DifferentiableAt ℝ g₀ v :=
    ((contDiff_eventMap_coord m (rowZero m)).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero).differentiableAt
  have hg₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ g₁ v :=
    ((contDiff_eventMap_coord m (rowOne m)).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero).differentiableAt
  have hg₀v : g₀ v = 0 := by
    simpa [g₀] using congrArg (fun q : F => q (rowZero m)) hv
  have hg₁v : g₁ v = 0 := by
    simpa [g₁] using congrArg (fun q : F => q (rowOne m)) hv
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (eventMap m) (contDiff_eventMap m)
    (rowZero m) v h]
  have hfun : (fun q => eventMap m q (rowZero m)) =
      fun q => aa q • g₀ q - bb q • g₁ q := by
    funext q
    simp [aa, bb, g₀, g₁, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hfun]
  change (fderiv ℝ
    (fun q => aa q • g₀ q - bb q • g₁ q) v) h = _
  have hd₀ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q => aa q • g₀ q) v :=
    haa.smul hg₀
  have hd₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q => bb q • g₁ q) v :=
    hbb.smul hg₁
  rw [fderiv_fun_sub hd₀ hd₁,
    fderiv_fun_smul haa hg₀, fderiv_fun_smul hbb hg₁]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    hg₀v, hg₁v, smul_zero, add_zero]
  rw [fderiv_coord_apply m (StandardSaddle.eventMap m)
    (StandardSaddle.contDiff_eventMap m) (rowZero m) v h,
    fderiv_coord_apply m (StandardSaddle.eventMap m)
      (StandardSaddle.contDiff_eventMap m) (rowOne m) v h]
  rfl

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.fderiv_eventMap_apply_rowOne_of_standard_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_eventMap_apply_rowOne_of_standard_zero
    {v : A} (hv : StandardSaddle.eventMap m v = 0) (h : A) :
    fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h (rowOne m) =
      twistIm m v *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.eventMap m) v h (rowZero m) +
        (twistRe m v + twistShift m v) *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.eventMap m) v h (rowOne m)
proof:
:= by
  let aa : A → ℝ := fun q => twistRe m q + twistShift m q
  let bb : A → ℝ := twistIm m
  let g₀ : A → ℝ := fun q => StandardSaddle.eventMap m q (rowZero m)
  let g₁ : A → ℝ := fun q => StandardSaddle.eventMap m q (rowOne m)
  have haa : DifferentiableAt ℝ aa v :=
    (((contDiff_twistRe m).add (contDiff_twistShift m)).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero).differentiableAt
  have hbb : DifferentiableAt ℝ bb v :=
    ((contDiff_twistIm m).differentiable infty_ne_zero).differentiableAt
  have hg₀ : DifferentiableAt ℝ g₀ v :=
    ((contDiff_eventMap_coord m (rowZero m)).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero).differentiableAt
  have hg₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ g₁ v :=
    ((contDiff_eventMap_coord m (rowOne m)).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero).differentiableAt
  have hg₀v : g₀ v = 0 := by
    simpa [g₀] using congrArg (fun q : F => q (rowZero m)) hv
  have hg₁v : g₁ v = 0 := by
    simpa [g₁] using congrArg (fun q : F => q (rowOne m)) hv
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (eventMap m) (contDiff_eventMap m)
    (rowOne m) v h]
  have hfun : (fun q => eventMap m q (rowOne m)) =
      fun q => bb q • g₀ q + aa q • g₁ q := by
    funext q
    simp [aa, bb, g₀, g₁, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hfun]
  change (fderiv ℝ
    (fun q => bb q • g₀ q + aa q • g₁ q) v) h = _
  have hd₀ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q => bb q • g₀ q) v :=
    hbb.smul hg₀
  have hd₁ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q => aa q • g₁ q) v :=
    haa.smul hg₁
  rw [fderiv_fun_add hd₀ hd₁,
    fderiv_fun_smul hbb hg₀, fderiv_fun_smul haa hg₁]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, hg₀v, hg₁v, smul_zero,
    add_zero]
  rw [fderiv_coord_apply m (StandardSaddle.eventMap m)
    (StandardSaddle.contDiff_eventMap m) (rowZero m) v h,
    fderiv_coord_apply m (StandardSaddle.eventMap m)
      (StandardSaddle.contDiff_eventMap m) (rowOne m) v h]
  rfl

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.fderiv_eventMap_apply_of_ne
statement:
lemma fderiv_eventMap_apply_of_ne {i : Fin (m + 2)}
    (hi₀ : i ≠ rowZero m) (hi₁ : i ≠ rowOne m) (v h : A) :
    fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h i =
      fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.eventMap m) v h i
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun q => eventMap m q i) =
      fun q => StandardSaddle.eventMap m q i := by
    funext q
    exact eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁ q
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (eventMap m) (contDiff_eventMap m) i v h,
    ← fderiv_coord_apply m (StandardSaddle.eventMap m)
      (StandardSaddle.contDiff_eventMap m) i v h, hfun]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.untwistTarget_apply_rowZero
statement:
@[simp] lemma untwistTarget_apply_rowZero (a b : ℝ) (y : F) :
    untwistTarget m a b y (rowZero m) =
      (a * y (rowZero m) + b * y (rowOne m)) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [untwistTarget, rowZero, rowOne]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.untwistTarget_apply_rowOne
statement:
@[simp] lemma untwistTarget_apply_rowOne (a b : ℝ) (y : F) :
    untwistTarget m a b y (rowOne m) =
      (-b * y (rowZero m) + a * y (rowOne m)) / (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp [untwistTarget, rowZero, rowOne]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.untwistTarget_apply_of_ne
proof:
:= by
  simp [untwistTarget, hi₀, hi₁]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap_regular
statement:
theorem eventMap_regular (hm : 0 < m) {v : A} (hv : eventMap m v = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v)
proof:
:= by
  have hvStd : StandardSaddle.eventMap m v = 0 :=
    (eventMap_eq_zero_iff m hm v).mp hv
  let a := twistRe m v + twistShift m v
  let b := twistIm m v
  have hdet : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
    simpa [a, b] using
      twistCoefficient_normSq_pos_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hm hv
  intro y
  obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ := StandardSaddle.eventMap_regular m v hvStd
    (untwistTarget m a b y)
  refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
  ext i
  by_cases hi₀ : i = rowZero m
  · subst i
    have hh₀ := congrArg (fun q : F => q (rowZero m)) hh
    have hh₁ := congrArg (fun q : F => q (rowOne m)) hh
    rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_rowZero_of_standard_zero m hvStd h, hh₀, hh₁,
      untwistTarget_apply_rowZero, untwistTarget_apply_rowOne]
    change a * ((a * y (rowZero m) + b * y (rowOne m)) /
          (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) -
        b * ((-b * y (rowZero m) + a * y (rowOne m)) /
          (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) = y (rowZero m)
    field_simp [hdet.ne']
    ring
  · by_cases hi₁ : i = rowOne m
    · subst i
      have hh₀ := congrArg (fun q : F => q (rowZero m)) hh
      have hh₁ := congrArg (fun q : F => q (rowOne m)) hh
      rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_rowOne_of_standard_zero m hvStd h, hh₀, hh₁,
        untwistTarget_apply_rowZero, untwistTarget_apply_rowOne]
      change b * ((a * y (rowZero m) + b * y (rowOne m)) /
            (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) +
          a * ((-b * y (rowZero m) + a * y (rowOne m)) /
            (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) = y (rowOne m)
      field_simp [hdet.ne']
      ring
    · have hhi := congrArg (fun q : F => q i) hh
      rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁ v h, hhi,
        untwistTarget_apply_of_ne m hi₀ hi₁]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.contDiff_spaceTime_fixed
statement:

      fun x => embedCLM (m + 3) x + t • eLast (m + 3) := by

theorem goodSet_of_residual (hres : Residual m hm Iv)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_continuous_chartParam_of_param_image_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_continuous_chartParam_of_param_image_ne_zero
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) {r : ℝ} (hr : r < T.radius)
    (ζ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, ∃ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ ≤ r ∧ v ≠ 0 ∧
      M.param v = ζ u) :
    ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ r) ∧
      (∀ u : I, η u ≠ 0) ∧ (∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ζ u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨η, hle, hchart⟩ :=
    T.exists_continuous_chartParam_of_param_image hr ζ
      (fun u => by obtain ⟨v, hv, _, hpv⟩ := hmem u; exact ⟨v, hv, hpv⟩)
  refine ⟨η, hle, fun u => ?_, hchart⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvne, hpv⟩ := hmem u
  have hball : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖w‖ ≤ r →
      w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    intro w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hw.trans_lt hr
  have heq : η u = v :=
    T.param_injOn (hball _ (hle u)) (hball _ hv) ((hchart u).trans hpv.symm)
  rw [heq]
  exact hvne

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_saddleEndpointLevelParamCapture
statement:
theorem exists_saddleEndpointLevelParamCapture
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht))
    {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData K)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} (hx₀K : x₀ ∈ K)
    (hx₀fiber : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x₀ = 0)
    {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hclose : dist x₀
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
        (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |d| <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p) :
    ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht ∧
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u = R.base.flow x₀ d ∧
      0 < signedBranch p.1 (u 0) ∧ 0 < signedBranch p.2 (u 1)
proof:
:= by
  set M := D.position.eventModel t ht with hM
  set w := R.base.flow x₀ d with hw
  have hw_move : dist w x₀ ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |d| := by
    calc
      dist w x₀ = dist (R.base.flow x₀ d) (R.base.flow x₀ 0) := by
        rw [hw, R.base.flow_zero]
      _ ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |d - 0| := R.base.dist_flow_self_le x₀ d 0
      _ = (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |d| := by rw [sub_zero]
  have hw_crit : dist w (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p := by
    calc
      dist w (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) ≤
          dist w x₀ + dist x₀ (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p := by
        have := hw_move
        linarith
  have hwfiber : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G w = 0 :=
    R.flow_mem_fiber hx₀fiber d
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := L.cover p w
    (hw_crit.trans_le (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin_le_cover t ht L p))
    hwfiber
  have hcritParam : M.param (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) =
      M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) := rfl
  have hdistu : dist (M.param u)
      (M.param (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))) <
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranchRadius t ht p := by
    rw [hup, hcritParam]
    exact hw_crit.trans_le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin_le_positiveBranch t ht L p)
  have hdistu' : dist (M.param u)
      (M.param (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))) <
      D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeBranchRadius t ht p := by
    rw [hup, hcritParam]
    exact hw_crit.trans_le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin_le_negativeBranch t ht L p)
  exact ⟨u, hu, hup,
    D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranchRadius_spec t ht p u hu hdistu,
    D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeBranchRadius_spec t ht p u hu hdistu'⟩

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_chartMap_flowLine
statement:
theorem exists_chartMap_flowLine
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht))
    {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData K)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} (hx₀K : x₀ ∈ K)
    (hx₀fiber : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x₀ = 0)
    (dt : C(I, ℝ)) (hd : ∀ w : I, |dt w| ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hclose : ∀ w : I, dist x₀
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
        (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |dt w| <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p)
    (ζ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
    (hζ : ∀ w : I, ζ w = R.base.flow x₀ (dt w)) :
    ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      (∀ w : I, ‖η w‖ ≤ D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) ∧
      (∀ w : I, η w ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ w : I, (D.position.eventModel t ht).localPoint (η w) = ζ w)
proof:
:= by
  refine (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
      ht).exists_continuous_chartParam_of_param_image_ne_zero
    (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht) ζ ?_
  intro w
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup, hs1, _hs2⟩ :=
    D.exists_saddleEndpointLevelParamCapture t ht hindex L R p hx₀K hx₀fiber
      (hd w) (hclose w)
  have hu0 : u 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have hsq : signedBranch p.1 (u 0) ^ 2 = (u 0) ^ 2 := signedBranch_sq _ _
    rw [h0] at hsq hs1
    nlinarith [hs1, hsq]
  refine ⟨u, hu.le, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hzero
    apply hu0
    rw [hzero]
    rfl
  · rw [hup, hζ w]

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.circleLift_ne_zero
statement: theorem circleLift_ne_zero (u : ℝ) : circleLift u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hcos := congrArg Prod.fst hzero
  have hsin := congrArg Prod.snd hzero
  simp only [circleLift, Prod.fst_zero, Prod.snd_zero] at hcos hsin
  have htrig := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (2 * Real.pi * u)
  rw [hsin, hcos] at htrig
  norm_num at htrig

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.obstacleCoefficient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem obstacleCoefficient_ne_zero (q : BadDomain E) :
    obstacleCoefficient q ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  circleLift_ne_zero _

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.obstacle_equation_of_collision
statement:
theorem obstacle_equation_of_collision
    (H Q : ℝ → ℝ → E) (p : Parameter E)
    {s u v : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (hcoll : perturbedTrack H p s u = Q s v) :
    pairCombination (circleLift u) p = rawObstacleRhs H Q s u v
proof:
:= by
  let c := endpointWeight s
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero
    · exact hs0.ne'
    · exact (sub_pos.mpr hs1).ne'
  have hrel : c • perturbation p u = Q s v - H s u := by
    dsimp [c]
    unfold perturbedTrack at hcoll
    linear_combination (norm := module) hcoll
  change perturbation p u = rawObstacleRhs H Q s u v
  calc
    perturbation p u = c⁻¹ • (c • perturbation p u) := by
      simp [smul_smul, hc]
    _ = c⁻¹ • (Q s v - H s u) :=
      congrArg (fun z : E => c⁻¹ • z) hrel
    _ = rawObstacleRhs H Q s u v := by
      unfold rawObstacleRhs
      rfl

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.mem_range_obstacleBadMap_of_collision
statement:
theorem mem_range_obstacleBadMap_of_collision
    (H Q : ℝ → ℝ → E) (p : Parameter E)
    {s u v : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (hcoll : perturbedTrack H p s u = Q s v) :
    p ∈ Set.range (obstacleBadMap H Q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ts, hts⟩ := exists_badTime_eq hs0 hs1
  let coeff := circleLift u
  have hcoeff : coeff ≠ 0 := circleLift_ne_zero u
  have heq : pairCombination coeff p = rawObstacleRhs H Q s u v :=
    obstacle_equation_of_collision H Q p hs0 hs1 hcoll
  let q : BadDomain E := (((ts, u), v), freeCoordinate coeff p)
  have hcoeffq : obstacleCoefficient q = coeff := by rfl
  have hrhs : obstacleRhs H Q q = rawObstacleRhs H Q s u v := by
    simp only [obstacleRhs, rawObstacleRhs, badTime, badPhase,
      obstaclePhase, q, hts]
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  rw [obstacleBadMap, hcoeffq, hrhs]
  exact solvePair_eq_of_pairCombination_eq hcoeff p _ heq

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.ne_obstacle_of_avoids_range
statement:
theorem ne_obstacle_of_avoids_range
    (H Q : ℝ → ℝ → E) (p : Parameter E)
    (hp : p ∉ Set.range (obstacleBadMap H Q))
    {s u v : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) :
    perturbedTrack H p s u ≠ Q s v
proof:
:= by
  intro hcoll
  exact hp (mem_range_obstacleBadMap_of_collision
    H Q p hs0 hs1 hcoll)

statement:

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_obstacleCoefficient
statement:
theorem contDiff_obstacleCoefficient :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (obstacleCoefficient : BadDomain E → ℝ × ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact contDiff_circleLift.comp contDiff_badPhase

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_obstacleRhs
statement:
theorem contDiff_obstacleRhs (H Q : ℝ → ℝ → E)
    (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => H z.1 z.2))
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Q z.1 z.2)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (obstacleRhs H Q : BadDomain E → E)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : BadDomain E => endpointWeight (badTime q)) :=
    contDiff_endpointWeight.comp contDiff_badTime
  have hwinv : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : BadDomain E => (endpointWeight (badTime q))⁻¹) :=
    hw.inv fun q => endpointWeight_badTime_ne_zero q
  have hfixed : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : BadDomain E => Q (badTime q) (obstaclePhase q)) :=
    hQ.comp (contDiff_badTime.prodMk contDiff_obstaclePhase)
  have hmoving : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : BadDomain E => H (badTime q) (badPhase q)) :=
    hH.comp (contDiff_badTime.prodMk contDiff_badPhase)
  exact hwinv.smul (hfixed.sub hmoving)

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_obstacleBadMap
statement:
theorem contDiff_obstacleBadMap (H Q : ℝ → ℝ → E)
    (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => H z.1 z.2))
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Q z.1 z.2)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (obstacleBadMap H Q)
proof:
:= by
  exact contDiff_solvePair_comp obstacleCoefficient (obstacleRhs H Q) badFree
    contDiff_obstacleCoefficient (contDiff_obstacleRhs H Q hH hQ)
    (by unfold badFree; fun_prop) obstacleCoefficient_ne_zero

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.exists_parameter_avoiding_badRanges_and_obstacles
statement:
theorem exists_parameter_avoiding_badRanges_and_obstacles
    (H K : ℝ → ℝ → E) (Q : ι → ℝ → ℝ → E)
    (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => H z.1 z.2))
    (hK : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => K z.1 z.2))
    (hQ : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => Q i z.1 z.2))
    (hE : 4 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E)
    {U : Set (Parameter E)} (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hUne : U.Nonempty) :
    ∃ p ∈ U,
      p ∉ Set.range (secantBadMap H) ∧
      p ∉ Set.range (tangentBadMap K) ∧
      ∀ i, p ∉ Set.range (obstacleBadMap H (Q i))
proof:
:= by
  let f : (Fin 2 ⊕ ι) → BadDomain E → Parameter E
    | Sum.inl j => if j = 0 then secantBadMap H else tangentBadMap K
    | Sum.inr i => obstacleBadMap H (Q i)
  have hf : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (f j) := by
    intro j
    rcases j with j | i
    · fin_cases j
      · simpa [f] using (contDiff_secantBadMap H hH).of_le (by simp)
      · simpa [f] using (contDiff_tangentBadMap K hK).of_le (by simp)
    · simpa [f] using (contDiff_obstacleBadMap H (Q i) hH (hQ i)).of_le (by simp)
  obtain ⟨p, hpU, hp⟩ := exists_mem_open_avoid_iUnion_range f hf
    (finrank_badDomain_lt_parameter hE) hUopen hUne
  refine ⟨p, hpU, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [f] using hp (Sum.inl 0)
  · simpa [f] using hp (Sum.inl 1)
  · intro i
    simpa [f] using hp (Sum.inr i)

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.slotPermutation_orbitSlot_val

    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv V W S T) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :

      (W.orbitSlot (M.orbitEquiv O)).val

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.numericSlotMatch_orbitPerm
statement:
theorem numericSlotMatch_orbitPerm
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv V W S T) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    M.numericSlotMatch.orbitEquiv
        (orbitPerm V M.slotPermutation O) =
      M.orbitEquiv O
proof:
:= by
  apply W.orbitSlot_injective
  apply Fin.ext
  calc
    (W.orbitSlot (M.numericSlotMatch.orbitEquiv
        (orbitPerm V M.slotPermutation O))).val =
        (V.orbitSlot (orbitPerm V M.slotPermutation O)).val :=
      (M.numericSlotMatch.slot_eq
        (orbitPerm V M.slotPermutation O)).symm
    _ = (M.slotPermutation (V.orbitSlot O)).val := by
      rw [orbitSlot_orbitPerm]
    _ = (W.orbitSlot (M.orbitEquiv O)).val :=
      M.slotPermutation_orbitSlot_val O

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.matchingAmbient_circlePoint
statement:
theorem matchingAmbient_circlePoint
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv V W S T) (hm : 0 < m)
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    (M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) O a) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint W (by omega) (M.orbitEquiv O) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [matchingAmbient, SmoothAmbientIsotopy.followedBy_forward,
    permutationAmbient_circlePoint,
    M.numericSlotMatch.ambient_circlePoint,
    M.numericSlotMatch_orbitPerm]

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.matchingAmbient_target
statement:
theorem matchingAmbient_target
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv V W S T) (hm : 0 < m)
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    (M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 ''
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V (by omega) O =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target W (by omega) (M.orbitEquiv O)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a, (M.matchingAmbient_circlePoint hm O a).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) O a,
      ⟨a, rfl⟩, M.matchingAmbient_circlePoint hm O a⟩

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.matchingAmbient_targetUnion
statement:
theorem matchingAmbient_targetUnion
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv V W S T) (hm : 0 < m) :
    (M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 ''
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V (by omega) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion W (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion] at hy ⊢
    obtain ⟨O, hyO⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨M.orbitEquiv O, ?_⟩
    have himage : (M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 y ∈
        (M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 ''
          CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V (by omega) O :=
      ⟨y, hyO, rfl⟩
    rwa [M.matchingAmbient_target hm O] at himage
  · intro hx
    rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion] at hx
    obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    let O : V.OrbitIndex := M.orbitEquiv.symm P
    have hxP' : x ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.target W (by omega)
        (M.orbitEquiv O) := by
      simpa [O] using hxP
    rw [← M.matchingAmbient_target hm O] at hxP'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hxP'
    refine ⟨y, ?_, hyx⟩
    rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨O, hy⟩

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.matchingAmbient_pullback_fiber
statement:
theorem matchingAmbient_pullback_fiber
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv V W S T) (hm : 0 < m)
    (Z : FramedLevelSet (m + 2))
    (hZ : Z.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V (by omega)) :
    ((M.matchingAmbient hm).pullback Z).fiber =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion W (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  rw [SmoothAmbientIsotopy.pullback_fiber, hZ,
    M.matchingAmbient_targetUnion hm]

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_saddleEndpointLevelCapture
statement:
theorem exists_saddleEndpointLevelCapture
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht))
    {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData K)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} (hx₀K : x₀ ∈ K)
    (hx₀fiber : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x₀ = 0)
    {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hclose : dist x₀
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
        (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |d| <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p) :
    ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖u‖ < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius ∧
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u = R.base.flow x₀ d ∧
      0 < signedBranch p.1 (u 0) ∧ 0 < signedBranch p.2 (u 1) ∧
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) =
        tcoord x₀ + d - tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
proof:
:= by
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let w := R.base.flow x₀ d
  have hw_move : dist w x₀ ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |d| := by
    calc
      dist w x₀ = dist (R.base.flow x₀ d) (R.base.flow x₀ 0) := by simp [w]
      _ ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |d - 0| := R.base.dist_flow_self_le x₀ d 0
      _ = (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |d| := by rw [sub_zero]
  have hw_crit : dist w (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p := by
    calc
      dist w (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) ≤
          dist w x₀ + dist x₀ (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p := by
        have := hw_move
        linarith
  have hwfiber : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G w = 0 :=
    R.flow_mem_fiber hx₀fiber d
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := L.cover p w
    (hw_crit.trans_le (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin_le_cover t ht L p))
    hwfiber
  have hcritParam : M.param (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) =
      M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) := rfl
  have hdistu : dist (M.param u)
      (M.param (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))) <
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranchRadius t ht p := by
    rw [hup, hcritParam]
    exact hw_crit.trans_le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin_le_positiveBranch t ht L p)
  have hdistu' : dist (M.param u)
      (M.param (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))) <
      D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeBranchRadius t ht p := by
    rw [hup, hcritParam]
    exact hw_crit.trans_le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin_le_negativeBranch t ht L p)
  have hsign1 : 0 < signedBranch p.1 (u 0) :=
    D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranchRadius_spec t ht p u hu hdistu
  have hsign2 : 0 < signedBranch p.2 (u 1) :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeBranchRadius_spec t ht p u hu hdistu'
  have huM : ‖u‖ < M.radius :=
    hu.trans_le (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_le_eventRadius t ht)
  have htw : tcoord w = tcoord x₀ + d := R.tcoord_flow hx₀K hd
  have hq := M.time_model u huM
  rw [hindex] at hq
  rw [hup, htw] at hq
  have hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) =
      tcoord x₀ + d - tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by linarith
  exact ⟨u,
    hu.trans (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht),
    hup, hsign1, hsign2, hquad⟩

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_bandCaptureScale
statement:
theorem exists_bandCaptureScale (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ∧
      s ^ 2 ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime ∧
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * s ^ 2 <
        D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2 ∧
      (∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
        dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s)
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
          2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * s ^ 2 <
        D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht
          (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht) p) ∧
      (∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
        dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s)
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
          2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * s ^ 2 <
        D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht
          (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht) p) ∧
      (∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
        (dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) s)
            ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) +
            2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * s ^ 2 <
          D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p) ∧
        (dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) s)
            ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) +
            2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * s ^ 2 <
          D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let L := D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht
  let Rb := D.bandTimeField t ht
  let B : ℝ := (Rb.base.bound : ℝ)
  have hB0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ B := Rb.base.bound.coe_nonneg
  have hcov : 0 < D.bandCoverRadius t ht := D.bandCoverRadius_pos t ht
  let posGap : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => saddleFourEndMin (fun p =>
    D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p -
      (dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) x)
        (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * x ^ 2))
  let negGap : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => saddleFourEndMin (fun p =>
    D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p -
      (dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) x)
        (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * x ^ 2))
  let outerPosGap : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => saddleFourEndMin (fun p =>
    D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p -
      (dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
          (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) x)
        (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * x ^ 2))
  let outerNegGap : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => saddleFourEndMin (fun p =>
    D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p -
      (dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
          (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) x)
        (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * x ^ 2))
  have hcomp : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ =>
        D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p -
          (dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) x)
            (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * x ^ 2)) 0 :=
    fun p => continuousAt_const.sub
      (((D.continuousAt_saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_scale t ht p).dist
          continuousAt_const).add
        (continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_id.pow 2)))
  have hcompN : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ =>
        D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p -
          (dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) x)
            (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * x ^ 2)) 0 :=
    fun p => continuousAt_const.sub
      (((D.continuousAt_saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_scale t ht p).dist
          continuousAt_const).add
        (continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_id.pow 2)))
  have hcompOP : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ =>
        D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p -
          (dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) x)
            (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) +
              2 * B * x ^ 2)) 0 :=
    fun p => continuousAt_const.sub
      (((D.continuousAt_outerSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_scale t ht p).dist
          continuousAt_const).add
        (continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_id.pow 2)))
  have hcompON : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ =>
        D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p -
          (dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) x)
            (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) +
              2 * B * x ^ 2)) 0 :=
    fun p => continuousAt_const.sub
      (((D.continuousAt_outerSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_scale t ht p).dist
          continuousAt_const).add
        (continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_id.pow 2)))
  have hposCont : ContinuousAt posGap 0 := by
    simp only [posGap, saddleFourEndMin]
    exact (hcomp _).min ((hcomp _).min ((hcomp _).min (hcomp _)))
  have hnegCont : ContinuousAt negGap 0 := by
    simp only [negGap, saddleFourEndMin]
    exact (hcompN _).min ((hcompN _).min ((hcompN _).min (hcompN _)))
  have hOPCont : ContinuousAt outerPosGap 0 := by
    simp only [outerPosGap, saddleFourEndMin]
    exact (hcompOP _).min ((hcompOP _).min ((hcompOP _).min (hcompOP _)))
  have hONCont : ContinuousAt outerNegGap 0 := by
    simp only [outerNegGap, saddleFourEndMin]
    exact (hcompON _).min ((hcompON _).min ((hcompON _).min (hcompON _)))
  have hOPVal : 0 < outerPosGap 0 := by
    show 0 < saddleFourEndMin (fun p =>
      D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p -
        (dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
            (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) (0 : ℝ))
          (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
            (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) +
            2 * B * (0 : ℝ) ^ 2))
    apply saddleFourEndMin_pos
    intro p
    have h0 : M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) (0 : ℝ) =
        M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) :=
      D.outerSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_zero_eq_criticalBoundaryEnd t ht p
    rw [h0, dist_self]
    simpa using D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin_pos t ht p
  have hONVal : 0 < outerNegGap 0 := by
    show 0 < saddleFourEndMin (fun p =>
      D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p -
        (dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
            (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) (0 : ℝ))
          (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
            (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) +
            2 * B * (0 : ℝ) ^ 2))
    apply saddleFourEndMin_pos
    intro p
    have h0 : M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) (0 : ℝ) =
        M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) :=
      D.outerSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_zero_eq_criticalBoundaryEnd t ht p
    rw [h0, dist_self]
    simpa using D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin_pos t ht p
  have hposVal : 0 < posGap 0 := by
    show 0 < saddleFourEndMin (fun p =>
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p -
        (dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (0 : ℝ))
          (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * (0 : ℝ) ^ 2))
    apply saddleFourEndMin_pos
    intro p
    have h0 : M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (0 : ℝ) =
        M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) := rfl
    rw [h0, dist_self]
    simpa using D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin_pos t ht L p
  have hnegVal : 0 < negGap 0 := by
    show 0 < saddleFourEndMin (fun p =>
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p -
        (dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (0 : ℝ))
          (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * (0 : ℝ) ^ 2))
    apply saddleFourEndMin_pos
    intro p
    have h0 : M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (0 : ℝ) =
        M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) :=
      D.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_zero_eq_criticalBoundaryEnd t ht p
    rw [h0, dist_self]
    simpa using D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin_pos t ht L p
  have hposMem : posGap ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∈ nhds (0 : ℝ) :=
    hposCont.preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hposVal)
  have hnegMem : negGap ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∈ nhds (0 : ℝ) :=
    hnegCont.preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hnegVal)
  have hOPMem : outerPosGap ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∈ nhds (0 : ℝ) :=
    hOPCont.preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hOPVal)
  have hONMem : outerNegGap ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∈ nhds (0 : ℝ) :=
    hONCont.preimage_mem_nhds (Ioi_mem_nhds hONVal)
  have hsafeN : {x : ℝ | x ^ 2 < Rb.safeTime} ∈ nhds (0 : ℝ) := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) 0 := continuousAt_id.pow 2
      simpa using hcont.tendsto
    exact hlim (Iio_mem_nhds Rb.safeTime_pos)
  have hflowN : {x : ℝ | B * x ^ 2 < D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2} ∈
      nhds (0 : ℝ) := by
    have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => B * x ^ 2) 0 :=
      continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_id.pow 2)
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => B * x ^ 2) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using hcont.tendsto
    exact hlim (Iio_mem_nhds (by linarith))
  have hgood : {x : ℝ | x ^ 2 < Rb.safeTime} ∩
      ({x : ℝ | B * x ^ 2 < D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2} ∩
        (posGap ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∩
          (negGap ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∩
            (outerPosGap ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ) ∩
              outerNegGap ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))))) ∈
        nhds (0 : ℝ) :=
    Filter.inter_mem hsafeN
      (Filter.inter_mem hflowN
        (Filter.inter_mem hposMem
          (Filter.inter_mem hnegMem (Filter.inter_mem hOPMem hONMem))))
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hgood
  let c := min (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) δ
  let b := c / 2
  have hc : 0 < c := lt_min (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht) hδ
  have hb : 0 < b := div_pos hc (by norm_num)
  have hbc : b < c := by
    dsimp [b]
    linarith
  have hba : b < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    hbc.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hbδ : dist b (0 : ℝ) < δ := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hb]
    exact hbc.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hbGood := hball hbδ
  refine ⟨b, hb, hba, hbGood.1.le, hbGood.2.1, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro p
    have hgap' : (0 : ℝ) < posGap b := hbGood.2.2.1
    have hle := saddleFourEndMin_le (fun p =>
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p -
        (dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) b)
          (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * b ^ 2)) p
    have hfin : (0 : ℝ) <
        D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p -
          (dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) b)
            (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * b ^ 2) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hgap' hle
    linarith
  · intro p
    have hgap' : (0 : ℝ) < negGap b := hbGood.2.2.2.1
    have hle := saddleFourEndMin_le (fun p =>
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p -
        (dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) b)
          (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * b ^ 2)) p
    have hfin : (0 : ℝ) <
        D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p -
          (dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) b)
            (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) + 2 * B * b ^ 2) :=
      lt_of_lt_of_le hgap' hle
    linarith
  · intro p
    constructor
    · have hgap' : (0 : ℝ) < outerPosGap b := hbGood.2.2.2.2.1
      have hle := saddleFourEndMin_le (fun p =>
        D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p -
          (dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) b)
            (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) +
              2 * B * b ^ 2)) p
      have hfin : (0 : ℝ) <
          D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p -
            (dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
                (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) b)
              (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
                (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) +
                2 * B * b ^ 2) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hgap' hle
      linarith
    · have hgap' : (0 : ℝ) < outerNegGap b := hbGood.2.2.2.2.2
      have hle := saddleFourEndMin_le (fun p =>
        D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p -
          (dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) b)
            (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
              (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) +
              2 * B * b ^ 2)) p
      have hfin : (0 : ℝ) <
          D.chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalMargin t ht p -
            (dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
                (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) b)
              (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
                (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) +
                2 * B * b ^ 2) :=
        lt_of_lt_of_le hgap' hle
      linarith

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.bandCaptureScale_pos
statement:
theorem bandCaptureScale_pos (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht
proof:
:=
  (D.exists_bandCaptureScale t ht).choose_spec.1

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.bandCaptureScale_positive_close

theorem bandCaptureScale_positive_close
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
      2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 <
    D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht) p
proof:
:=
  (D.exists_bandCaptureScale t ht).choose_spec.2.2.2.2.1 p

    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)

    dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
      2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.fderiv_param_time
statement:
theorem fderiv_param_time (T : M.CenterImmersion)
    (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < T.radius) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => tcoord (M.param z)) u =
      fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ =>
        tcoord center + morseQuadratic M.index (z 0, z 1)) u
proof:
:= by
  have huball : u ∈ ball (0 : E₂) T.radius := by
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
  have heq :
      (fun z : E₂ => tcoord (M.param z)) =ᶠ[nhds u]
        (fun z : E₂ =>
          tcoord center + morseQuadratic M.index (z 0, z 1)) := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds huball] with z hz
    apply M.time_model z
    have hzr : ‖z‖ < T.radius := by
      simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz
    exact hzr.trans_le T.radius_le
  exact heq.fderiv_eq

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.fderiv_param_time_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_param_time_apply (T : M.CenterImmersion)
    (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < T.radius) (w : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => tcoord (M.param z)) u w =
      tcoord (fderiv ℝ M.param u w)
proof:
:= by
  let proj : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (a + 3)) (𝕜 := ℝ)
  have h := proj.hasFDerivAt.comp u
    (T.param_differentiableAt u hu).hasFDerivAt
  have hfd := h.fderiv
  change fderiv ℝ (proj ∘ M.param) u =
      proj.comp (fderiv ℝ M.param u) at hfd
  change (fderiv ℝ (proj ∘ M.param) u) w =
    proj (fderiv ℝ M.param u w)
  rw [hfd]
  rfl

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.fderiv_param_mem_ker
statement:
theorem fderiv_param_mem_ker (T : M.CenterImmersion)
    (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < T.radius) (w : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ C.G (M.param u) (fderiv ℝ M.param u w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have huball : u ∈ ball (0 : E₂) T.radius := by
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
  have hzeroEventually :
      (fun z : E₂ => C.G (M.param z)) =ᶠ[nhds u]
        (fun _ : E₂ => (0 : F)) := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds huball] with z hz
    apply M.param_fiber z
    have hzr : ‖z‖ < T.radius := by
      simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz
    exact hzr.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hzero : fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => C.G (M.param z)) u = 0 := by
    rw [hzeroEventually.fderiv_eq]
    exact (hasFDerivAt_const (𝕜 := ℝ) (0 : F) u).fderiv
  have hchain : fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => C.G (M.param z)) u =
      (fderiv ℝ C.G (M.param u)).comp (fderiv ℝ M.param u) := by
    exact ((C.smooth.differentiable (by simp) (M.param u)).hasFDerivAt.comp u
      (T.param_differentiableAt u hu).hasFDerivAt).fderiv
  have hcomp :
      (fderiv ℝ C.G (M.param u)).comp (fderiv ℝ M.param u) = 0 := by
    rw [← hchain]
    exact hzero
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E₂ →L[ℝ] F => L w) hcomp
  simpa using happ

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.tcoord_fderiv_param_zero
statement:
theorem tcoord_fderiv_param_zero (T : M.CenterImmersion) (w : E₂) :
    tcoord (fderiv ℝ M.param 0 w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ‖(0 : E₂)‖ < T.radius := by
    simpa using T.radius_pos
  rw [← fderiv_param_time_apply T 0 hzero w,
    fderiv_param_time T 0 hzero]
  rw [fderiv_const_add_morseQuadratic_apply]
  cases M.index <;> simp [morseHessianPairing]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.centerSpatialTangent_zero_ne_zero
statement:
theorem centerSpatialTangent_zero_ne_zero (T : M.CenterImmersion)
    {w : E₂} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    M.centerSpatialTangent 0 w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ‖(0 : E₂)‖ < T.radius := by
    simpa using T.radius_pos
  have hfullinj := T.fderiv_param_injective 0 hzero
  intro hspace
  let z := fderiv ℝ M.param 0 w
  have htime : tcoord z = 0 := tcoord_fderiv_param_zero T w
  have hz : z = 0 := by
    calc
      z = cobSpaceTime (spacePart z) (tcoord z) :=
        (spaceTime_spacePart z).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime 0 0 := by
        rw [show spacePart z = 0 by exact hspace, htime]
      _ = 0 := by
        ext i
        refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · rw [spaceTime_apply_last]
          rfl
        · rw [spaceTime_apply_castSucc]
          rfl
  exact hw (hfullinj (by simpa [z] using hz))

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.centerNormalMap_contDiffAt_zero
statement:
theorem centerNormalMap_contDiffAt_zero
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ M.centerNormalMap 0
proof:
:= by
  have hspatial : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (spatialDeriv C.G) := by
    change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => (fderiv ℝ C.G z).comp spaceInclL)
    exact ContDiff.clm_comp (contDiff_fderivCLM C.smooth) contDiff_const
  have hadjoint : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun z => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (spatialDeriv C.G z)) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      (ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.spatialAdjointCLM
        (n := a + 2)).contDiff.comp hspatial
  have happly : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun z => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (spatialDeriv C.G z)
        M.centerCokernelVector) :=
    hadjoint.clm_apply contDiff_const
  exact happly.contDiffAt.comp 0 M.param_smooth

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.centerTimeNormalCoefficient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem centerTimeNormalCoefficient_ne_zero
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) :
    M.centerTimeNormalCoefficient ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let c := M.centerCokernelVector
  let L := fderiv ℝ C.G center
  let A := spatialDeriv C.G center
  intro htime
  have hsurj : Surjective L := C.regular center M.center_mem_timeCritical.1
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hsurj c
  have hadjoint : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A c = 0 :=
    adjoint_spatialDeriv_criticalOutputCokernelVector
      C center M.center_mem_timeCritical
  have hdecomp : L z = A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec := by
    calc
      L z = L (cobSpaceTime (spacePart z) (tcoord z)) := by
        rw [spaceTime_spacePart]
      _ = L (spaceInclL (spacePart z) + tcoord z • timeVec) := by
        rw [spaceTime_eq]
      _ = A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec := by
        rw [map_add, map_smul]
        rfl
  have hspace : ⟪c, A (spacePart z)⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, hadjoint, inner_zero_left]
  have htime' : ⟪c, tcoord z • L timeVec⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    rw [real_inner_smul_right]
    change tcoord z * M.centerTimeNormalCoefficient = 0
    rw [htime, mul_zero]
  have hself : ⟪c, c⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    calc
      ⟪c, c⟫_ℝ = ⟪c, L z⟫_ℝ := by rw [hz]
      _ = ⟪c, A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec⟫_ℝ := by
        rw [hdecomp]
      _ = 0 := by rw [inner_add_right, hspace, htime', add_zero]
  exact M.centerCokernelVector_ne_zero (inner_self_eq_zero.mp hself)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.inner_centerNormalMap_centerSpatialTangent
statement:
theorem inner_centerNormalMap_centerSpatialTangent
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < T.radius)
    (w : E₂) :
    ⟪M.centerNormalMap u, M.centerSpatialTangent u w⟫_ℝ =
      -(fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ =>
          tcoord center + morseQuadratic M.index (z 0, z 1)) u w *
        M.centerTimeNormalCoefficientAt u)
proof:
:= by
  let z := fderiv ℝ M.param u w
  let A := spatialDeriv C.G (M.param u)
  let L := fderiv ℝ C.G (M.param u)
  have hzero : L z = 0 := fderiv_param_mem_ker T u hu w
  have hdecomp : A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec = 0 := by
    calc
      A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec =
          L (spaceInclL (spacePart z) + tcoord z • timeVec) := by
            rw [map_add, map_smul]
            rfl
      _ = L (cobSpaceTime (spacePart z) (tcoord z)) := by
            rw [spaceTime_eq]
      _ = L z := by rw [spaceTime_spacePart]
      _ = 0 := hzero
  have hspatial : A (spacePart z) = -(tcoord z • L timeVec) :=
    eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hdecomp
  have htime := fderiv_param_time_apply T u hu w
  have hmodel := congrArg (fun D : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => D w)
    (fderiv_param_time T u hu)
  calc
    ⟪M.centerNormalMap u, M.centerSpatialTangent u w⟫_ℝ =
        ⟪M.centerCokernelVector, A (spacePart z)⟫_ℝ := by
          exact ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left A (spacePart z)
            M.centerCokernelVector
    _ = ⟪M.centerCokernelVector, -(tcoord z • L timeVec)⟫_ℝ := by
          rw [hspatial]
    _ = -(tcoord z * ⟪M.centerCokernelVector, L timeVec⟫_ℝ) := by
          rw [inner_neg_right, real_inner_smul_right]
    _ = -(fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ =>
          tcoord center + morseQuadratic M.index (z 0, z 1)) u w *
        M.centerTimeNormalCoefficientAt u) := by
          congr 1
          rw [← htime, hmodel]
          rfl

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.inner_centerNormalLinearization_centerSpatialTangent_zero
statement:
theorem inner_centerNormalLinearization_centerSpatialTangent_zero
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (v w : E₂) :
    ⟪M.centerNormalLinearization v, M.centerSpatialTangent 0 w⟫_ℝ =
      -(morseHessianPairing M.index v w *
        M.centerTimeNormalCoefficient)
proof:
:= by
  let Φ := M.param
  let e := M.index
  let c₀ := tcoord center
  let qdiff : E₂ → ℝ := fun u =>
    fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => c₀ + morseQuadratic e (z 0, z 1)) u w
  let k : E₂ → ℝ := M.centerTimeNormalCoefficientAt
  let pair : E₂ → ℝ := M.centerNormalTangentPairing w
  have hDΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Φ) 0 :=
    M.param_smooth.fderiv_right (by simp)
  have htangentCD : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (M.centerSpatialTangent · w) 0 := by
    have heval : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun u => fderiv ℝ Φ u w) 0 :=
      hDΦ.clm_apply contDiffAt_const
    have hproj :=
      (ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalSpacePartCLM
        (n := a + 2)).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp 0 heval
    simpa [centerSpatialTangent, Φ, Function.comp_def] using hproj
  have htangent : DifferentiableAt ℝ (M.centerSpatialTangent · w) 0 :=
    htangentCD.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hnormal : DifferentiableAt ℝ M.centerNormalMap 0 :=
    M.centerNormalMap_contDiffAt_zero.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hleft : fderiv ℝ pair 0 v =
      ⟪M.centerNormalLinearization v, M.centerSpatialTangent 0 w⟫_ℝ := by
    change fderiv ℝ (fun u =>
      ⟪M.centerNormalMap u, M.centerSpatialTangent u w⟫_ℝ) 0 v = _
    rw [fderiv_inner_apply ℝ hnormal htangent v]
    simp [centerNormalLinearization]
  have hqeq : qdiff = morseHessianPairingLeft e w := by
    funext u
    exact fderiv_const_add_morseQuadratic_apply e c₀ u w
  have hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ qdiff 0 := by
    rw [hqeq]
    exact (morseHessianPairingLeft e w).differentiableAt
  have hqzero : qdiff 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hqeq]
    cases e <;> simp [morseHessianPairing]
  have hqderiv : fderiv ℝ qdiff 0 v = morseHessianPairing e v w :=
    fderiv_morseDifferential_apply e c₀ v w
  have hkCD : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ k 0 := by
    have hDG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ C.G) := contDiff_fderivCLM C.smooth
    have hcomp : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun u => fderiv ℝ C.G (Φ u)) 0 :=
      hDG.contDiffAt.comp 0 M.param_smooth
    have heval : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun u => fderiv ℝ C.G (Φ u) timeVec) 0 :=
      hcomp.clm_apply contDiffAt_const
    have hinner := (contDiffAt_const : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun _u : E₂ => M.centerCokernelVector) 0).inner ℝ heval
    exact hinner
  have hk : DifferentiableAt ℝ k 0 := hkCD.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hkzero : k 0 = M.centerTimeNormalCoefficient :=
    M.centerTimeNormalCoefficientAt_zero
  have hevent : pair =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun u => -(qdiff u * k u) := by
    have hball : ball (0 : E₂) T.radius ∈ nhds 0 :=
      ball_mem_nhds 0 T.radius_pos
    filter_upwards [hball] with u hu
    exact inner_centerNormalMap_centerSpatialTangent T u
      (by simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu) w
  have hright : fderiv ℝ (fun u => -(qdiff u * k u)) 0 v =
      -(morseHessianPairing e v w * M.centerTimeNormalCoefficient) := by
    have hderiv := (hq.hasFDerivAt.mul hk.hasFDerivAt).neg.fderiv
    change (fderiv ℝ (-(qdiff * k)) 0) v = _
    rw [hderiv]
    simp only [hqzero, zero_smul, zero_add, hkzero]
    change -(M.centerTimeNormalCoefficient * fderiv ℝ qdiff 0 v) = _
    rw [hqderiv]
    ring
  have hfdEq := congrArg (fun D : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => D v) hevent.fderiv_eq
  rw [hleft, hright] at hfdEq
  exact hfdEq

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.centerAdjointOnRange_injective
statement:
theorem centerAdjointOnRange_injective
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) :
    Injective M.centerAdjointOnRange
proof:
:= by
  let A := spatialDeriv C.G center
  intro y z hyz
  have hadj : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A (y.1 - z.1) = 0 := by
    change M.centerAdjointOnRange (y - z) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hyz, sub_self]
  have hyrange : y.1 - z.1 ∈ LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap :=
    sub_mem y.2 z.2
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hyrange
  have hself : ⟪y.1 - z.1, y.1 - z.1⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    calc
      ⟪y.1 - z.1, y.1 - z.1⟫_ℝ = ⟪y.1 - z.1, A x⟫_ℝ := by
        congr 1
        exact hx.symm
      _ = ⟪ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A (y.1 - z.1), x⟫_ℝ := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hadj, inner_zero_left]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (inner_self_eq_zero.mp hself)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.linearIndependent_centerTransverseNormal
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_centerTransverseNormal
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ M.centerTransverseNormal
proof:
:= by
  let b := M.centerTransverseRangeBasis
  have hb : LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i => b i) :=
    b.toBasis.linearIndependent
  have hker : M.centerAdjointOnRange.ker = ⊥ :=
    LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr M.centerAdjointOnRange_injective
  have hmapped := hb.map' M.centerAdjointOnRange hker
  change LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i =>
    M.centerAdjointOnRange (M.centerTransverseRangeBasis i))
  simpa [b, Function.comp_def] using hmapped

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.spatialDeriv_centerSpatialTangent_zero
statement:
theorem spatialDeriv_centerSpatialTangent_zero
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (w : E₂) :
    spatialDeriv C.G center (M.centerSpatialTangent 0 w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ‖(0 : E₂)‖ < T.radius := by
    simpa using T.radius_pos
  have hfull := fderiv_param_mem_ker T 0 hzero w
  rw [M.param_zero] at hfull
  let z := fderiv ℝ M.param 0 w
  let A := spatialDeriv C.G center
  let L := fderiv ℝ C.G center
  have hdecomp : A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec = 0 := by
    calc
      A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec =
          L (spaceInclL (spacePart z) + tcoord z • timeVec) := by
            rw [map_add, map_smul]
            rfl
      _ = L (cobSpaceTime (spacePart z) (tcoord z)) := by
            rw [spaceTime_eq]
      _ = L z := by rw [spaceTime_spacePart]
      _ = 0 := by simpa [L, z] using hfull
  have htime : tcoord z = 0 := by
    simpa [z] using tcoord_fderiv_param_zero T w
  rw [htime, zero_smul, add_zero] at hdecomp
  simpa [A, z, centerSpatialTangent] using hdecomp

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.inner_centerTransverseNormal_spatialTangent_zero
statement:
theorem inner_centerTransverseNormal_spatialTangent_zero

    spatialDeriv_centerSpatialTangent_zero T w, inner_zero_right]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.inner_centerMinimumNormalRadialLast_radialTest_pos
statement:
theorem inner_centerMinimumNormalRadialLast_radialTest_pos
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .minimum)
    (s : I) (theta : ℝ) :
    0 < ⟪M.centerMinimumNormalRadialLast s theta,
      M.centerMinimumRadialTest theta⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  have hpair := inner_centerNormalRow_minimumRadialTest T hindex theta
  have hnormal : 0 <
      nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar *
        M.centerMinimumPairingScalar :=
    nonzeroOrientationSign_mul_pos M.centerMinimumPairingScalar_ne_zero
  have hradialEq := inner_radial_tangentOrthogonalRadial_eq_self
    (M.centerUnitTangent theta) (M.centerRadialTangent theta)
    (centerUnitTangent_ne_zero T theta)
  have hradial : 0 < ⟪M.centerRadialTangent theta,
      M.centerMinimumRadialTest theta⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [centerMinimumRadialTest, hradialEq]
    exact real_inner_self_pos.mpr
      (centerMinimumRadialTest_ne_zero T hindex theta)
  rw [centerMinimumNormalRadialLast, inner_add_left,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
    real_inner_smul_left, hpair]
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.property.1
  have hs1 : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.property.2
  by_cases hsone : (s : ℝ) = 1
  · simpa [hsone] using hradial
  have hslt : (s : ℝ) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hsone
  exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
    (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hslt) hnormal)
    (mul_nonneg hs0 hradial.le)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.inner_centerMaximumNormalRadialLast_radialTest_pos

  have hs0 : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.property.1

  by_cases hsone : (s : ℝ) = 1

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.linearIndependent_centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows
statement:

  · exact smul_ne_zero (StandardBirth.orientationSign_ne_zero a)

      inner_centerTransverseNormal_unitTangent_zero T i theta, mul_zero]
  · intro i

  · rw [real_inner_smul_left,
      inner_centerUnitTangent_minimumRadialTest T theta, mul_zero]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.centerUnitTangent_rotation
statement:
theorem centerUnitTangent_rotation
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) (theta : ℝ) :
    M.centerUnitTangent theta =
      Real.cos theta • M.centerUnitTangent 0 -
        Real.sin theta • M.centerRadialTangent 0
proof:
:= by
  let L : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₁ :=
    (ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalSpacePartCLM
      (n := a + 2)).comp (fderiv ℝ M.param 0)
  change L (definiteCircleTangentParam 1 theta) =
    Real.cos theta • L (definiteCircleTangentParam 1 0) -
      Real.sin theta • L (definiteCircleParam 1 0)
  rw [definiteCircleTangentParam_unit_rotation, map_sub,
    map_smul, map_smul]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.centerRadialTangent_rotation
statement:
theorem centerRadialTangent_rotation
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) (theta : ℝ) :
    M.centerRadialTangent theta =
      Real.sin theta • M.centerUnitTangent 0 +
        Real.cos theta • M.centerRadialTangent 0
proof:
:= by
  let L : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₁ :=
    (ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalSpacePartCLM
      (n := a + 2)).comp (fderiv ℝ M.param 0)
  change L (definiteCircleParam 1 theta) =
    Real.sin theta • L (definiteCircleTangentParam 1 0) +
      Real.cos theta • L (definiteCircleParam 1 0)
  rw [definiteCircleParam_unit_rotation, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.centerOrientedTangent_rotation
statement:
theorem centerOrientedTangent_rotation
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) (theta : ℝ) :
    StandardBirth.orientationSign a • M.centerUnitTangent theta =
      Real.cos (StandardBirth.orientationSign a * theta) •
          (StandardBirth.orientationSign a • M.centerUnitTangent 0) -
        Real.sin (StandardBirth.orientationSign a * theta) •
          M.centerRadialTangent 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases StandardBirth.orientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one a with h | h
  · rw [h]
    simp only [one_mul, one_smul]
    exact M.centerUnitTangent_rotation theta
  · rw [h]
    simp only [neg_mul, neg_smul, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg, one_mul]
    rw [M.centerUnitTangent_rotation theta]
    module

          (StandardBirth.orientationSign a • M.centerUnitTangent 0) +

          M.centerRadialTangent 0

  · rw [h]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.centerMinimumOrientedRadialMatrix_rotation
statement:
theorem centerMinimumOrientedRadialMatrix_rotation
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) (theta : ℝ) :
    M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix 1 theta =
      twistMat a (StandardBirth.orientationSign a * theta) *
        M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix 1 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [StandardBirth.twistMat_mul_apply_birth]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    simp only [centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix, rowsMatrix,
      Matrix.of_apply, M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_zero,
      M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_last]
    simp only [centerMinimumNormalRadialLast, Set.Icc.coe_one]
    simp
    have h := congrArg (fun v : E₁ => v j)
      (M.centerOrientedTangent_rotation theta)
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h
  · rw [if_neg hi0]
    by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (a + 2)
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      simp only [centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix, rowsMatrix,
        Matrix.of_apply, M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_zero,
        M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_last]
      simp [centerMinimumNormalRadialLast]
      have h := congrArg (fun v : E₁ => v j)
        (M.centerOrientedRadial_rotation theta)
      simpa using h
    · rw [if_neg hil]
      simp only [centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix, rowsMatrix,
        Matrix.of_apply]
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Fin.eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi0
      induction k using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          exfalso
          apply hil
          apply Fin.ext
          simp
      | cast k =>
          rw [M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_middle,
            M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_middle]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.centerMaximumOrientedRadialMatrix_rotation
statement:
theorem centerMaximumOrientedRadialMatrix_rotation
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) (theta : ℝ) :
    M.centerMaximumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix 1 theta =
      twistMat a (StandardBirth.orientationSign a * theta) *
        M.centerMaximumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix 1 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrows (x : ℝ) : M.centerMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows 1 x =
      M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows 1 x := by
    funext i
    simp [centerMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows,
      centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows, centerUnitTangentRev,
      centerMaximumNormalRadialLast, centerMinimumNormalRadialLast]
  rw [centerMaximumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix,
    centerMaximumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix, hrows theta, hrows 0,
    ← centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix,
    ← centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix]
  exact M.centerMinimumOrientedRadialMatrix_rotation theta
