name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.continuous_centerMinimumNormalRadialLast
statement:
theorem continuous_centerMinimumNormalRadialLast
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) :
    Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      M.centerMinimumNormalRadialLast q.1 q.2
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ => (q.1 : ℝ) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
  have hn : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ => M.centerNormalRow 0 q.2 :=
    M.continuous_centerNormalRow_zero.comp continuous_snd
  have hr : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ => M.centerRadialTangent q.2 :=
    M.continuous_centerRadialTangent.comp continuous_snd
  have hsign : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
      (nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar : ℝ) :=
    continuous_const
  unfold centerMinimumNormalRadialLast
  exact ((continuous_const.sub hs).smul (hsign.smul hn)).add (hs.smul hr)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.continuous_centerMaximumNormalRadialLast
statement:
theorem continuous_centerMaximumNormalRadialLast
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) :
    Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      M.centerMaximumNormalRadialLast q.1 q.2
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ => (q.1 : ℝ) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
  have hn : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ => M.centerNormalRow 0 q.2 :=
    M.continuous_centerNormalRow_zero.comp continuous_snd
  have hr : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ => M.centerRadialTangent q.2 :=
    M.continuous_centerRadialTangent.comp continuous_snd
  have hsign : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
      (nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMaximumPairingScalar : ℝ) :=
    continuous_const
  unfold centerMaximumNormalRadialLast
  exact ((continuous_const.sub hs).smul (hsign.smul hn)).add (hs.smul hr)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.continuous_centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix
statement:
theorem continuous_centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) :
    Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix q.1 q.2
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      StandardBirth.orientationSign a • M.centerUnitTangent q.2 :=
    (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
      (StandardBirth.orientationSign a : ℝ)).smul
      (M.continuous_centerUnitTangent.comp continuous_snd)
  have hl := M.continuous_centerMinimumNormalRadialLast
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  have hrow : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows q.1 q.2 i := by
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_zero] using ht
    · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          have hlast : (Fin.last (a + 1)).succ =
              (Fin.last (a + 2) : Fin (a + 3)) := by
            apply Fin.ext
            simp
          rw [hlast]
          simpa only [M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_last] using hl
      | cast i =>
          simpa only [M.centerMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_middle] using
            (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
              M.centerTransverseNormal i)
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp hrow

    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) :

    (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
      (-StandardBirth.orientationSign a : ℝ)).smul
      (M.continuous_centerUnitTangentRev.comp continuous_snd)
  have hl := M.continuous_centerMaximumNormalRadialLast
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  have hrow : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      M.centerMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows q.1 q.2 i := by
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · simpa [centerMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows,
        centerRowsWith] using ht
    · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          simpa [centerMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows,
            centerRowsWith] using hl
      | cast i =>
          simpa [centerMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows,
            centerRowsWith] using
            (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>

  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp hrow

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.det_centerMinimumNormalizedMatrix_pos
statement:
theorem det_centerMinimumNormalizedMatrix_pos
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .minimum)
    (s : I) (theta : ℝ) :
    0 < (centerMinimumNormalizedMatrix T hindex s theta).det
proof:
:= by
  let d : I → ℝ := fun u =>
    (centerMinimumNormalizedMatrix T hindex u theta).det
  change 0 < d s
  have hd : Continuous d := by
    exact ((continuous_centerMinimumNormalizedMatrix T hindex).comp
      (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).matrix_det
  have hdne : ∀ u, d u ≠ 0 := fun u =>
    det_centerMinimumNormalizedMatrix_ne_zero T hindex u theta
  have hd1 : d 1 = 1 := by
    dsimp [d]
    rw [centerMinimumNormalizedMatrix_one T hindex theta,
      StandardBirth.det_twistMat]
  by_contra hpos
  have hsneg : d s < 0 :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hdne s)
  have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (d s) (d 1) := by
    rw [hd1]
    exact ⟨hsneg.le, by norm_num⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ s 1 hd hmem
  exact hdne u hu

proof:

    D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.eventExteriorSlabCore_subset_slabRegularSet
statement:
theorem eventExteriorSlabCore_subset_slabRegularSet
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q) :
    D.eventExteriorSlabCore t ht q ⊆
      slabRegularSet D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [eventExteriorSlabCore] at hv
  have hspatial : Surjective
      (spatialDeriv D.signedOutput.cobordism.G v) := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hcritical : v ∈ timeCritical D.signedOutput.cobordism.G :=
      ⟨hv.1.1, hnot⟩
    have hvc : v = D.position.eventCenter t ht :=
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).isolates v hcritical hv.1.2
    have hdist : q ≤ dist v (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := hv.2
    rw [hvc, dist_self] at hdist
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hdist) hq
  exact mem_slabRegularSet_of_spatial_surjective
    (D.signedOutput.cobordism.regular v hv.1.1) hspatial

        (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) q ⊆
      D.eventExteriorSlabCore t ht q
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore] at hv
  refine ⟨⟨hv.1, ?_⟩, hv.2.2⟩
  show tcoord v ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
    (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after
  rw [hv.2.1]

    (D.position.eventBracket t ht).lt_after.le⟩

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.eventExterior_tcoord_flow
statement:
theorem eventExterior_tcoord_flow (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) {q : ℝ} (hq : 0 < q)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hbw : b < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))
    (hfib : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x = 0)
    (htime : tcoord x = D.shortBeforeTimeAt t ht b ∨
      tcoord x = D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht b)
    (hfar : q ≤ dist x (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
    (d : ℝ) (hd : |d| ≤ (D.eventCriticalExteriorTimeFieldAt t ht hq).safeTime) :
    tcoord ((D.eventCriticalExteriorTimeFieldAt t ht hq).base.flow x d) =
      tcoord x + d
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : x ∈ D.eventExteriorSlabCore t ht q := by
    refine ⟨⟨hfib, ?_⟩, hfar⟩
    show tcoord x ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after
    have hsq := D.shortScale_sq_lt_window_sq t ht hb hbw
    rcases htime with h | h
    · have hb1 := (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_bracket t ht).1
      have hb2 := (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_bracket t ht).2
      rw [h]
      constructor
      · have : D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht ≤ D.shortBeforeTimeAt t ht b := by
          rw [chronologicalBeforeTime, shortBeforeTimeAt]
          linarith
        linarith
      · have : D.shortBeforeTimeAt t ht b ≤ D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht +
            D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 := by
          rw [chronologicalBeforeTime, shortBeforeTimeAt]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
        have hb3 : D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht +
            D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 =
            tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
          rw [chronologicalBeforeTime]; ring
        have hcb : tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
            (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
          have := (D.position.eventBracket t ht).lt_after
          linarith
        linarith
    · have ha1 := (D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht).1
      have ha2 := (D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht).2
      rw [h]
      constructor
      · have hca : (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before <
            tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
          have := (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before_lt
          linarith
        have : tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) ≤
            D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht b := by
          rw [shortAfterTimeAt]
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg b]
        linarith
      · have : D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht b ≤ D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht := by
          rw [shortAfterTimeAt, chronologicalAfterTime]
          linarith
        linarith
  exact (D.eventExteriorSlabTimeField t ht hq).tcoord_flow hmem hd

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.bandCoverRadius_pos
statement:

:=
  (D.eventModel_covers_fiber_within_morseRadius t ht
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)).choose_spec.1

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.bandCoverRadius_cover
statement:
theorem bandCoverRadius_cover (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)

    ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v (D.position.eventCenter t ht) < D.bandCoverRadius t ht →
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G v = 0 →

proof:

    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)).choose_spec.2

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.bandScaleMin_pos
statement:
private theorem bandScaleMin_pos (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    0 < min
      (min (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
        (Real.sqrt (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime))
      (Real.sqrt (D.bandCoverRadius t ht /
        (2 * (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  have hbound : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) :=
    (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound.coe_nonneg
  refine lt_min (lt_min (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht)
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime_pos))
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 ?_)
  exact div_pos (D.bandCoverRadius_pos t ht) (by linarith)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.bandScale_pos
statement:
theorem bandScale_pos (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) : 0 < D.bandScale t ht
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.bandScaleMin_pos t ht
  rw [bandScale]
  linarith

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.bandScale_lt_window
statement:
theorem bandScale_lt_window (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    D.bandScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.bandScaleMin_pos t ht
  have hle : min
      (min (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
        (Real.sqrt (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime))
      (Real.sqrt (D.bandCoverRadius t ht /
        (2 * (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) + 1)))) ≤
      D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  rw [bandScale]
  linarith

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.bandScale_sq_le_safeTime
statement:
theorem bandScale_sq_le_safeTime (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    D.bandScale t ht ^ 2 ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime
proof:
:= by
  have hm := D.bandScaleMin_pos t ht
  set m := min
      (min (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
        (Real.sqrt (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime))
      (Real.sqrt (D.bandCoverRadius t ht /
        (2 * (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) + 1)))) with hmdef
  have hle : m ≤ Real.sqrt (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime :=
    (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hsq : m ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime) ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ hm.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).2 hle
  have hroot : (Real.sqrt (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime) ^ 2 =
      (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime_pos.le
  have hband : D.bandScale t ht = m / 2 := rfl
  rw [hband]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg m]

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.bandScale_flowDistance_lt
statement:
theorem bandScale_flowDistance_lt (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ)) * D.bandScale t ht ^ 2 <
      D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hm := D.bandScaleMin_pos t ht
  have hbound : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) :=
    (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound.coe_nonneg
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) + 1) := by
    linarith
  have hcov := D.bandCoverRadius_pos t ht
  set m := min
      (min (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
        (Real.sqrt (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime))
      (Real.sqrt (D.bandCoverRadius t ht /
        (2 * (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) + 1)))) with hmdef
  have hle : m ≤ Real.sqrt (D.bandCoverRadius t ht /
      (2 * (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) + 1))) := min_le_right _ _
  have hquot : (0 : ℝ) ≤ D.bandCoverRadius t ht /
      (2 * (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) + 1)) :=
    (div_pos hcov hden).le
  have hsq : m ^ 2 ≤ D.bandCoverRadius t ht /
      (2 * (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) + 1)) := by
    have h1 : m ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt (D.bandCoverRadius t ht /
        (2 * (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) + 1)))) ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ hm.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).2 hle
    rwa [Real.sq_sqrt hquot] at h1
  have hmul : D.bandCoverRadius t ht /
      (2 * (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) + 1)) *
        (2 * (((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) + 1)) =
      D.bandCoverRadius t ht := div_mul_cancel₀ _ (ne_of_gt hden)
  have hband : D.bandScale t ht = m / 2 := rfl
  rw [hband]
  have hquarter : (m / 2) ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg m]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg m, sq_nonneg (m / 2)]

name: Submission.le_dist_center_of_saddlePositive_chart_avoid
statement:
theorem le_dist_center_of_saddlePositive_chart_avoid {n : ℕ}
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} {center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center} (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρM : ρ < M.radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} (hfib : C.G x = 0)
    (htime : tcoord x = tcoord center + s ^ 2)
    (havoid : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = s ^ 2 → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ≠ spacePart x) :
    eps ≤ dist x center
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  rw [not_le] at hlt
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := hcover x hlt hfib
  have huM : ‖u‖ < M.radius := hu.trans hρM
  have hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = s ^ 2 := by
    have htm := M.time_model u huM
    rw [hindex, hup, htime] at htm
    linarith
  exact havoid u hquad hu (congrArg spacePart hup)

name: Submission.le_dist_center_of_saddleNegative_chart_avoid
statement:
theorem le_dist_center_of_saddleNegative_chart_avoid {n : ℕ}
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} {center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center} (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρM : ρ < M.radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} (hfib : C.G x = 0)
    (htime : tcoord x = tcoord center - s ^ 2)
    (havoid : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(s ^ 2) → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ≠ spacePart x) :
    eps ≤ dist x center
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  rw [not_le] at hlt
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := hcover x hlt hfib
  have huM : ‖u‖ < M.radius := hu.trans hρM
  have hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(s ^ 2) := by
    have htm := M.time_model u huM
    rw [hindex, hup, htime] at htm
    linarith
  exact havoid u hquad hu (congrArg spacePart hup)

name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_bandScale
statement:
theorem productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_bandScale
    {a : ℕ} (KB : ProductionMorseSaddleBandScaleInputs a) :
    ProductionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies a
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y SX SY SC D t ht hpositive hindex
  have hcov : 0 < D.bandCoverRadius t ht := D.bandCoverRadius_pos t ht
  have hb : 0 < D.bandScale t ht := D.bandScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandScale_lt_window t ht
  obtain ⟨Vpos⟩ := (D.shortAfterSlice t ht hb hbw).exists_tamedField
  obtain ⟨Vneg⟩ := (D.shortBeforeSlice t ht hb hbw).exists_tamedField
  obtain ⟨hmergeCase, hsplitCase⟩ :=
    KB (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
      (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandScale t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
      hb
      (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
      (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
      Vneg Vpos
      (D.bandCoverRadius t ht) hcov
      (D.bandTimeField t ht)
      (D.bandScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
      (D.bandScale_flowDistance_lt t ht)
      (D.bandCoverRadius_cover t ht)
      (fun x hfib htime hfar d hd =>
        D.eventExterior_tcoord_flow t ht
          (q := D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2) (by linarith) hb hbw x hfib htime
          hfar d hd)
      (D.chronologicalCriticalSlice_isolated t ht)
  have hdim : 3 ≤ a + 2 + 1 := by omega
  have hcircle := productionMorseSaddleChartCircleFrameClassOne a
    (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  constructor
  · intro Htop
    have hposEq :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      apply (D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw Vpos).injective
      rw [D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.positive]
      exact Htop.positive_eq
    have hnegNe :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg ≠
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      intro heq
      apply Htop.negative_ne
      rw [← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.positive, heq]
    obtain ⟨Bd, ⟨W⟩⟩ := hmergeCase hnegNe hposEq
    obtain ⟨H, hregH, hHclosed⟩ :=
      exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartWindingLoop
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) W
    have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) Bd.marking H
      hregH hHclosed
    have hsplice := orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim
      Bd.marking
      (Bd.marking.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
        (hF.trans hcircle))
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg]
    exact hsplice
  · intro Htop
    have hnegEq :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      apply (D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw Vneg).injective
      rw [D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.positive]
      exact Htop.negative_eq
    have hposNe :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos ≠
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      intro heq
      apply Htop.positive_ne
      rw [← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.positive, heq]
    obtain ⟨Bd, ⟨W⟩⟩ := hsplitCase hposNe hnegEq
    obtain ⟨H, hregH, hHclosed⟩ :=
      exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartWindingLoop
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) W
    have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) Bd.marking H
      hregH hHclosed
    have hsplice := orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim
      Bd.marking
      (Bd.marking.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
        (hF.trans hcircle))
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos]
    exact hsplice

name: Submission.saddleBandOctagonReading_merge
statement:
theorem saddleBandOctagonReading_merge
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (Hs : M.FullRadiusSmooth) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s rE : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius) (hErad : rE < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    {e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch} (hlab : e₁ ≠ e₂)
    (hne : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg ≠
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg)
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos))
    (hprov : T.RebasedMergeBandProvenance hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos
      Vneg Vpos R F)
    (hconn : ∀ (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
      (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (dt : C(I, ℝ)),
      x₀ ∈ criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2) →
      x₀ = R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) (-(s ^ 2)) →
      (∀ w : I, |dt w| ≤ s ^ 2) →
      ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ w : I, ‖η w‖ ≤ rE) ∧
        (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.1 (η w 0)) ∧
        (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.2 (η w 1)) ∧
        (∀ w : I, M.localPoint (η w) = R.base.flow x₀ (dt w)))
    (harc₁ : ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ ρ) ∧
      ∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₁ F) u)
    (harc₅ : ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ ρ) ∧
      ∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₅ F) u) :
    SaddleBandOctagonReading T F
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hb
  have hρM : ρ < M.radius := hρrad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hEM : rE < M.radius := hErad.trans_le T.radius_le
  obtain ⟨hdb, hda, hcut3, hafter3, hafter7, hafterEnd,
    ⟨p₀, hp₀⟩, ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩, ⟨p₂, hp₂⟩, ⟨p₃, hp₃⟩⟩ := hprov
  
  have hafterSpace : ∀ v : I,
      spacePart (((F.ambientAfterLoop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = F.afterParam.curve v := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientAfterLoop_coe v]
    exact spacePart_spaceTime _ _
  have hafterTime : ∀ v : I,
      tcoord (((F.ambientAfterLoop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientAfterLoop_coe v]
    exact tcoord_spaceTime _ _
  
  have hmem₃ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro u
    have h : ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop
          (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ u) :
          ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) := rfl
    rw [h, hafterSpace]
    exact hafter3 u
  have htime₃ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u) = tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    have h : ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop
          (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ u) :
          ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) := rfl
    rw [h, hafterTime]
  obtain ⟨eta₃, hn₃, hsg₃, hc₃⟩ :=
    T.exists_chartMap_sign_of_saddlePositiveSpatialSegment hindex .positive hρ
      hs0 hs hρrad (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₃ F)) hmem₃ htime₃
  have hx₃ : ∀ u : I, 0 < eta₃ u 0 := fun u => hsg₃ u
  
  have harc₇val : ∀ u : I, ∃ v : I,
      ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F) u =
        (((F.ambientAfterLoop v : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) ∧
      F.afterParam.curve v ∈
        Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro u
    show ∃ v : I,
      ((((Submission.loopWrap F.ambientAfterLoop F.afterCut₃ F.afterCut₀) u :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = _ ∧ _
    rw [Submission.loopWrap, Path.trans_apply]
    split_ifs with hcase
    · refine ⟨Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₃ (1 : I) _, rfl, ?_⟩
      have hone : Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₃ (1 : I)
          (⟨2 * (u : ℝ), by constructor <;> [linarith [u.2.1]; linarith]⟩ : I)
            = (1 : I) := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        show (1 - (2 * (u : ℝ))) * (F.afterCut₃ : ℝ) + (2 * (u : ℝ)) * 1 = 1
        rw [hcut3]
        show (1 - (2 * (u : ℝ))) * (1 : ℝ) + (2 * (u : ℝ)) * 1 = 1
        ring
      rw [hone]
      exact hafterEnd
    · exact ⟨Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) F.afterCut₀ _, rfl, hafter7 _⟩
  have hmem₇ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F) u) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvmem⟩ := harc₇val u
    rw [hv, hafterSpace]
    exact hvmem
  have htime₇ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F) u) = tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨v, hv, -⟩ := harc₇val u
    rw [hv, hafterTime]
  obtain ⟨eta₇, hn₇, hsg₇, hc₇⟩ :=
    T.exists_chartMap_sign_of_saddlePositiveSpatialSegment hindex .negative hρ
      hs0 hs hρrad (ambientOfRegularPath (bandArc₇ F)) hmem₇ htime₇
  have hx₇ : ∀ u : I, eta₇ u 0 < 0 := fun u =>
    neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative (hsg₇ u)
  
  have hdtbound : ∀ w : I, |bandConnectorTime F w| ≤ s ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    rw [bandConnectorTime_apply, hdb, hda, abs_le]
    have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (w : ℝ) := w.2.1
    have h1 : (w : ℝ) ≤ 1 := w.2.2
    have hsq : (0 : ℝ) ≤ s ^ 2 := sq_nonneg s
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  have hdtbound' : ∀ w : I, |bandConnectorTimeRev F w| ≤ s ^ 2 := fun w =>
    hdtbound _
  
  obtain ⟨eta₂, hn₂, hq₂a, hq₂b, hc₂⟩ :=
    hconn p₁ (F.coreArc₁ 1) (bandConnectorTime F) (F.coreArc₁_mem 1) hp₁ hdtbound
  obtain ⟨eta₄, hn₄, hq₄a, hq₄b, hc₄⟩ :=
    hconn p₂ (F.coreArc₂ 0) (bandConnectorTimeRev F) (F.coreArc₂_mem 0) hp₂ hdtbound'
  obtain ⟨eta₆, hn₆, hq₆a, hq₆b, hc₆⟩ :=
    hconn p₃ (F.coreArc₂ 1) (bandConnectorTime F) (F.coreArc₂_mem 1) hp₃ hdtbound
  obtain ⟨eta₈, hn₈, hq₈a, hq₈b, hc₈⟩ :=
    hconn p₀ (F.coreArc₁ 0) (bandConnectorTimeRev F) (F.coreArc₁_mem 0) hp₀ hdtbound'
  
  obtain ⟨eta₁, hn₁, hc₁⟩ := harc₁
  obtain ⟨eta₅, hn₅, hc₅⟩ := harc₅
  
  set r : ℝ := max ρ rE with hrdef
  have hr : r < T.radius := max_lt hρrad hErad
  have hbeforeSpace : ∀ v : I,
      spacePart (((F.ambientBefore₁Loop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = F.before₁Param.curve v := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₁Loop_coe v]
    exact spacePart_spaceTime _ _
  have hbeforeSpace₂ : ∀ v : I,
      spacePart (((F.ambientBefore₂Loop v :
        ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = F.before₂Param.curve v := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₂Loop_coe v]
    exact spacePart_spaceTime _ _
  have hlvl₁ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      tcoord ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = tcoord center - s ^ 2)
      F.ambientBefore₁Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₁Loop_coe v]
    exact tcoord_spaceTime _ _
  have hlvl₂ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      tcoord ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) = tcoord center - s ^ 2)
      F.ambientBefore₂Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [F.ambientBefore₂Loop_coe v]
    exact tcoord_spaceTime _ _
  have hOrb₁ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      spacePart ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
          Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) F.ambientBefore₁Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [hbeforeSpace v, Vneg.orbitPoint_orbit _]
    exact (Vneg.orbit_eq_of_mem F.before₁Param_orbit).ge
      (F.before₁Param.curve_mem_orbit v)
  have hOrb₂ : PathAll (fun x : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints =>
      spacePart ((x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
          Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) F.ambientBefore₂Loop := by
    intro v
    rw [hbeforeSpace₂ v, Vneg.orbitPoint_orbit _]
    exact (Vneg.orbit_eq_of_mem F.before₂Param_orbit).ge
      (F.before₂Param.curve_mem_orbit v)
  have htime₁ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (M.localPoint (eta₁ u)) = tcoord center - s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₁ u]
    exact ((hlvl₁.loopWrap F.before₁Cut₁ F.before₁Cut₀).symm) u
  have htime₅ : ∀ u : I,
      tcoord (M.localPoint (eta₅ u)) = tcoord center - s ^ 2 := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₅ u]
    exact ((hlvl₂.loopWrap F.before₂Cut₁ F.before₂Cut₀).symm) u
  have hmemO₁ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (M.localPoint (eta₁ u)) ∈
      ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
        Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₁ u]
    exact ((hOrb₁.loopWrap F.before₁Cut₁ F.before₁Cut₀).symm) u
  have hmemO₂ : ∀ u : I, spacePart (M.localPoint (eta₅ u)) ∈
      ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
        Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro u
    rw [hc₅ u]
    exact ((hOrb₂.loopWrap F.before₂Cut₁ F.before₂Cut₀).symm) u
  have hnorm₁ : ∀ u : I, ‖eta₁ u‖ < M.radius := fun u => (hn₁ u).trans_lt hρM
  have hnorm₅ : ∀ u : I, ‖eta₅ u‖ < M.radius := fun u => (hn₅ u).trans_lt hρM
  have hsg : (∀ u : I, 0 < eta₁ u 1) ∨ (∀ u : I, eta₁ u 1 < 0) :=
    chartMap_before_snd_sign (M := M) hindex hs0 eta₁ hnorm₁ htime₁
  have htg : (∀ u : I, 0 < eta₅ u 1) ∨ (∀ u : I, eta₅ u 1 < 0) :=
    chartMap_before_snd_sign (M := M) hindex hs0 eta₅ hnorm₅ htime₅
  
  
  have hbranch₁ : ∀ b : SaddleBranch, 0 < signedBranch b (eta₁ 0 1) →
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg =
        T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
          Vneg := by
    intro b hbsign
    have hmemb : spacePart (M.param (eta₁ 0)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
          Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :=
      T.mem_saddleNegativeBranchOrbit_of_chartParam Hs hindex b ρ s (eta₁ 0)
        (chartParam_quadratic_before (M := M) hindex (hnorm₁ 0) (htime₁ 0))
        hbsign hρ hs hρrad (hnorm₁ 0) hregneg Vneg rfl
    by_contra hcon
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (Vneg.orbitFinset_pairwise_disjoint _
        (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
          Vneg).property _
        (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
          Vneg).property (fun h => hcon (Subtype.ext h)))
      (hmemO₁ 0) hmemb
  have hbranch₅ : ∀ b : SaddleBranch, 0 < signedBranch b (eta₅ 0 1) →
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg =
        T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
          Vneg := by
    intro b hbsign
    have hmemb : spacePart (M.param (eta₅ 0)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
          Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :=
      T.mem_saddleNegativeBranchOrbit_of_chartParam Hs hindex b ρ s (eta₅ 0)
        (chartParam_quadratic_before (M := M) hindex (hnorm₅ 0) (htime₅ 0))
        hbsign hρ hs hρrad (hnorm₅ 0) hregneg Vneg rfl
    by_contra hcon
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (Vneg.orbitFinset_pairwise_disjoint _
        (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
          Vneg).property _
        (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
          Vneg).property (fun h => hcon (Subtype.ext h)))
      (hmemO₂ 0) hmemb
  have hnoteq : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg =
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
        Vneg → False := by
    intro heq12
    cases e₁ <;> cases e₂ <;>
      first
        | exact hlab rfl
        | exact hne heq12
        | exact hne heq12.symm
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  refine ⟨{ eta₁ := eta₁, eta₂ := eta₂, eta₃ := eta₃, eta₄ := eta₄,
            eta₅ := eta₅, eta₆ := eta₆, eta₇ := eta₇, eta₈ := eta₈
            norm₁ := fun u => (hn₁ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
            norm₂ := fun u => (hn₂ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
            norm₃ := fun u => (hn₃ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
            norm₄ := fun u => (hn₄ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
            norm₅ := fun u => (hn₅ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
            norm₆ := fun u => (hn₆ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
            norm₇ := fun u => (hn₇ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
            norm₈ := fun u => (hn₈ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
            chart₁ := hc₁
            chart₂ := fun u => (hc₂ u).trans rfl
            chart₃ := hc₃
            chart₄ := fun u => (hc₄ u).trans rfl
            chart₅ := hc₅
            chart₆ := fun u => (hc₆ u).trans rfl
            chart₇ := hc₇
            chart₈ := fun u => (hc₈ u).trans rfl }, ?_⟩
  set P : OctagonPlacement T F r :=
    { eta₁ := eta₁, eta₂ := eta₂, eta₃ := eta₃, eta₄ := eta₄,
      eta₅ := eta₅, eta₆ := eta₆, eta₇ := eta₇, eta₈ := eta₈
      norm₁ := fun u => (hn₁ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
      norm₂ := fun u => (hn₂ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
      norm₃ := fun u => (hn₃ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
      norm₄ := fun u => (hn₄ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
      norm₅ := fun u => (hn₅ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
      norm₆ := fun u => (hn₆ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
      norm₇ := fun u => (hn₇ u).trans (le_max_left ρ rE)
      norm₈ := fun u => (hn₈ u).trans (le_max_right ρ rE)
      chart₁ := hc₁
      chart₂ := fun u => (hc₂ u).trans rfl
      chart₃ := hc₃
      chart₄ := fun u => (hc₄ u).trans rfl
      chart₅ := hc₅
      chart₆ := fun u => (hc₆ u).trans rfl
      chart₇ := hc₇
      chart₈ := fun u => (hc₈ u).trans rfl } with hPdef
  have j12 : eta₁ 1 = eta₂ 0 := P.join₁₂ hr
  have j23 : eta₂ 1 = eta₃ 0 := P.join₂₃ hr
  have j34 : eta₃ 1 = eta₄ 0 := P.join₃₄ hr
  have j45 : eta₄ 1 = eta₅ 0 := P.join₄₅ hr
  have j56 : eta₅ 1 = eta₆ 0 := P.join₅₆ hr
  have j67 : eta₆ 1 = eta₇ 0 := P.join₆₇ hr
  have j78 : eta₇ 1 = eta₈ 0 := P.join₇₈ hr
  have j81 : eta₈ 1 = eta₁ 0 := P.join₈₁ hr
  
  have hlp₁ : p₁.1 = .positive := by
    refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₂a 1) ?_
    rw [j23]; exact hx₃ 0
  have hlp₂ : p₂.1 = .positive := by
    refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₄a 0) ?_
    rw [← j34]; exact hx₃ 1
  have hlp₃ : p₃.1 = .negative := by
    refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₆a 1) ?_
    rw [j67]; exact hx₇ 0
  have hlp₀ : p₀.1 = .negative := by
    refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₈a 0) ?_
    rw [← j78]; exact hx₇ 1
  have hx₂ : ∀ u : I, 0 < eta₂ u 0 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₂a u; rw [hlp₁] at h; exact h
  have hx₄ : ∀ u : I, 0 < eta₄ u 0 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₄a u; rw [hlp₂] at h; exact h
  have hx₆ : ∀ u : I, eta₆ u 0 < 0 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₆a u; rw [hlp₃] at h
    exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
  have hx₈ : ∀ u : I, eta₈ u 0 < 0 := by
    intro u; have h := hq₈a u; rw [hlp₀] at h
    exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
  rcases hsg with hsg | hsg <;> rcases htg with htg | htg
  · exfalso
    refine hnoteq ?_
    rw [hbranch₁ .positive (hsg 0), hbranch₅ .positive (htg 0)]
  · 
    have hlq₁ : p₁.2 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₂b 0) ?_
      rw [← j12]; exact hsg 1
    have hlq₂ : p₂.2 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₄b 1) ?_
      rw [j45]; exact htg 0
    have hlq₃ : p₃.2 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₆b 0) ?_
      rw [← j56]; exact htg 1
    have hlq₀ : p₀.2 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₈b 1) ?_
      rw [j81]; exact hsg 0
    refine Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hsg, hx₂, ?_, hx₃, hx₄, ?_, htg, hx₆, ?_, hx₇,
      hx₈, ?_⟩)
    · intro u; have h := hq₂b u; rw [hlq₁] at h; exact h
    · intro u; have h := hq₄b u; rw [hlq₂] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
    · intro u; have h := hq₆b u; rw [hlq₃] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
    · intro u; have h := hq₈b u; rw [hlq₀] at h; exact h
  · 
    have hlq₁ : p₁.2 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₂b 0) ?_
      rw [← j12]; exact hsg 1
    have hlq₂ : p₂.2 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₄b 1) ?_
      rw [j45]; exact htg 0
    have hlq₃ : p₃.2 = .positive := by
      refine eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₆b 0) ?_
      rw [← j56]; exact htg 1
    have hlq₀ : p₀.2 = .negative := by
      refine eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos (hq₈b 1) ?_
      rw [j81]; exact hsg 0
    refine Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨hsg, hx₂, ?_, hx₃, hx₄, ?_, htg, hx₆, ?_,
      hx₇, hx₈, ?_⟩))
    · intro u; have h := hq₂b u; rw [hlq₁] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
    · intro u; have h := hq₄b u; rw [hlq₂] at h; exact h
    · intro u; have h := hq₆b u; rw [hlq₃] at h; exact h
    · intro u; have h := hq₈b u; rw [hlq₀] at h
      exact neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative h
  · exfalso
    refine hnoteq ?_
    rw [hbranch₁ .negative (by
        have := hsg 0
        show (0:ℝ) < -(eta₁ 0 1)
        linarith),
      hbranch₅ .negative (by
        have := htg 0
        show (0:ℝ) < -(eta₅ 0 1)
        linarith)]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.det_pos_of_upperTriangular
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_of_upperTriangular hupper]
  exact Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => hdiag i

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.clmMatrix_comp
statement:
theorem clmMatrix_comp
    (Φ Ψ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Φ.comp Ψ)
      = PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix Φ * PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix Ψ
proof:
:= by
  have h := PolarDecompositionCLM.toEuclideanCLM_mul
    (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix Φ) (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix Ψ)
  rw [PolarDecompositionCLM.toEuclideanCLM_clmMatrix,
    PolarDecompositionCLM.toEuclideanCLM_clmMatrix] at h
  rw [← h, PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_toEuclideanCLM]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.triPath_apply
statement:
theorem triPath_apply (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (s : ℝ) (i j : Fin k) :
    triPath M s i j =
      (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j -
        s * ((1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j - M i j)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.triPath_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem triPath_zero (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    triPath M 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [triPath, zero_smul, sub_zero]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.triPath_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem triPath_one (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    triPath M 1 = M
proof:
:= by
  rw [triPath, one_smul, sub_sub_cancel]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.triPath_upper
proof:
:= by
  rw [triPath_apply, Matrix.one_apply_ne (ne_of_gt hij), hupper i j hij]
  ring

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.triPath_diag
statement:
theorem triPath_diag {M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (s : ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    triPath M s i i = 1 - s + s * M i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [triPath_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
  ring

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.triPath_diag_pos
proof:
:= by
  rw [triPath_diag]
  have hMi : 0 < M i i := hdiag i
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs1 with heq | hlt
  · subst heq
    simpa using hMi
  · have h1 : 0 < 1 - s := by linarith
    have h2 : 0 ≤ s * M i i := mul_nonneg hs0 hMi.le
    linarith

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.triPath_det_pos
statement:
theorem triPath_det_pos {M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    (hupper : ∀ i j : Fin k, j < i → M i j = 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ i : Fin k, 0 < M i i) {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    0 < (triPath M s).det
proof:
:=
  det_pos_of_upperTriangular (fun i j hij => triPath_upper hupper s i j hij)
    (fun i => triPath_diag_pos hdiag hs0 hs1 i)

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.gsSO_one
statement: theorem gsSO_one : gsSO (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : ((1 : SOGroup k) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
      = (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) := rfl
  rw [← h, gsSO_coe_SOGroup]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.loopClassZ2_gsQLoop_eq_zero_of_upperTriangular
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_gsQLoop_eq_zero_of_upperTriangular
    (A : I → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hAcont : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => A t i j)
    (hupper : ∀ (t : I) (i j : Fin k), j < i → A t i j = 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ (t : I) (i : Fin k), 0 < A t i i)
    (hAdet : ∀ t, 0 < (A t).det)
    (hAloop : A 0 = A 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (gsQLoop A hAcont hAdet)
      (gsQLoop_closed A hAcont hAdet hAloop) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ((0 : I) : ℝ) = 0 := rfl
  have h1 : ((1 : I) : ℝ) = 1 := rfl
  have hPcont : ∀ i j : Fin k,
      Continuous fun z : I × I => triPath (A z.2) ((z.1 : ℝ)) i j := by
    intro i j
    have hs : Continuous fun z : I × I => ((z.1 : ℝ)) :=
      continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
    have ha : Continuous fun z : I × I => A z.2 i j :=
      (hAcont i j).comp continuous_snd
    have hrw : (fun z : I × I => triPath (A z.2) ((z.1 : ℝ)) i j)
        = fun z : I × I => (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j -
            (z.1 : ℝ) * ((1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j - A z.2 i j) := by
      funext z
      exact triPath_apply (A z.2) ((z.1 : ℝ)) i j
    rw [hrw]
    exact continuous_const.sub (hs.mul (continuous_const.sub ha))
  have hPdet : ∀ z : I × I, 0 < (triPath (A z.2) ((z.1 : ℝ))).det := fun z =>
    triPath_det_pos (fun i j hij => hupper z.2 i j hij) (fun i => hdiag z.2 i)
      (unitInterval.nonneg z.1) (unitInterval.le_one z.1)
  have hHcont : Continuous fun z : I × I => gsSO (triPath (A z.2) ((z.1 : ℝ))) :=
    continuous_gsSO (fun z : I × I => triPath (A z.2) ((z.1 : ℝ))) hPcont hPdet
  have hkey : loopClassZ2 (ContinuousMap.const I (1 : SOGroup k)) rfl
      = loopClassZ2 (gsQLoop A hAcont hAdet)
          (gsQLoop_closed A hAcont hAdet hAloop) := by
    refine loopClassZ2_congr rfl (gsQLoop_closed A hAcont hAdet hAloop)
      { toFun := fun z : I × I => gsSO (triPath (A z.2) ((z.1 : ℝ)))
        continuous_toFun := hHcont
        map_zero_left := ?_
        map_one_left := ?_ } ?_
    · intro t
      show gsSO (triPath (A t) (((0 : I) : ℝ))) = (1 : SOGroup k)
      rw [h0, triPath_zero, gsSO_one]
    · intro t
      show gsSO (triPath (A t) (((1 : I) : ℝ))) = gsSO (A t)
      rw [h1, triPath_one]
    · intro s
      show gsSO (triPath (A 0) ((s : ℝ))) = gsSO (triPath (A 1) ((s : ℝ)))
      rw [hAloop]
  rw [← hkey, loopClassZ2_const]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.normalBlock_mul
statement:
theorem normalBlock_mul (eps : ℝ) (S D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    normalBlock eps (S * D) = normalBlock eps S * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) D
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩
  · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩
    · simp
    · simp
  · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩
    · simp
    · simp [Matrix.mul_apply]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.normalBlock_one_upper
proof:
:= by
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩
  · exact absurd hij (by simp)
  · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩
    · exact normalBlock_succ_zero (1 : ℝ) D i'
    · rw [normalBlock_succ_succ]
      exact hupper i' j' (Fin.succ_lt_succ_iff.mp hij)

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.normalBlock_one_diag_pos
proof:
:= by
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩
  · rw [normalBlock_zero_zero]
    exact one_pos
  · rw [normalBlock_succ_succ]
    exact hdiag i'

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.normalBlock_one_SOGroup
statement:
theorem normalBlock_one_SOGroup (Q : SOGroup n) :
    normalBlock (1 : ℝ) ((Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ))
      = ((SmoothSOGauge.blockSO Q : SOGroup (n + 1)) :
          Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.gsSO_normalBlock_one_SOGroup
statement:
theorem gsSO_normalBlock_one_SOGroup (Q : SOGroup n) :
    gsSO (normalBlock (1 : ℝ) ((Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)))
      = SmoothSOGauge.blockSO Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalBlock_one_SOGroup, gsSO_coe_SOGroup]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.det_normalBlock_one_SOGroup_pos
statement:
theorem det_normalBlock_one_SOGroup_pos (Q : SOGroup n) :
    0 < (normalBlock (1 : ℝ) ((Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ))).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [normalBlock_one_SOGroup]
  exact SOGroup_det_pos _

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.continuous_normalBlock_one_of_entries
statement:
theorem continuous_normalBlock_one_of_entries {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T]
    {D : T → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ}
    (hD : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => D t i j) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Continuous fun t => normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (D t) i j
proof:
:= by
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩
  · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩
    · exact continuous_const
    · exact continuous_const
  · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j', rfl⟩
    · exact continuous_const
    · exact hD i' j'

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.continuous_normalBlockLoop
statement:
theorem continuous_normalBlockLoop (S : C(I, SOGroup n)) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Continuous fun t => normalBlockLoop S t i j
proof:
:=
  continuous_normalBlock_one_of_entries
    (fun a b => (continuous_apply b).comp
      ((continuous_apply a).comp
        (continuous_subtype_val.comp S.continuous))) i j

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.det_normalBlockLoop_pos
statement:
theorem det_normalBlockLoop_pos (S : C(I, SOGroup n)) (t : I) :
    0 < (normalBlockLoop S t).det
proof:
:=
  det_normalBlock_one_SOGroup_pos (S t)

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.normalBlockLoop_loop
statement:
theorem normalBlockLoop_loop {S : C(I, SOGroup n)} (hSloop : S 0 = S 1) :
    normalBlockLoop S 0 = normalBlockLoop S 1
proof:
:= by
  show normalBlock (1 : ℝ) ((S 0 : SOGroup n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    = normalBlock (1 : ℝ) ((S 1 : SOGroup n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
  rw [hSloop]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.loopClassZ2_gsQLoop_normalBlockLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_gsQLoop_normalBlockLoop (hn : 3 ≤ n) (S : C(I, SOGroup n))
    (hSloop : S 0 = S 1) :
    loopClassZ2
        (gsQLoop (normalBlockLoop S) (continuous_normalBlockLoop S)
          (det_normalBlockLoop_pos S))
        (gsQLoop_closed (normalBlockLoop S) (continuous_normalBlockLoop S)
          (det_normalBlockLoop_pos S) (normalBlockLoop_loop hSloop))
      = loopClassZ2 S hSloop
proof:
:= by
  have hsame : gsQLoop (normalBlockLoop S) (continuous_normalBlockLoop S)
      (det_normalBlockLoop_pos S) = blockLoop S := by
    refine ContinuousMap.ext fun t => ?_
    show gsSO (normalBlock (1 : ℝ) ((S t : SOGroup n) :
      Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) = SmoothSOGauge.blockSO (S t)
    exact gsSO_normalBlock_one_SOGroup (S t)
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun _ (blockLoop_closed hSloop) hsame]
  exact loopClassZ2_blockLoop hn S hSloop

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_of_triangularComparison
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_of_triangularComparison (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (X Y : FramedLevelSet n) (γ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hγc : Continuous γ) (hX : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet X.g)
    (hY : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet Y.g) (hloop : γ 0 = γ 1)
    (S : C(I, SOGroup n)) (hSloop : S 0 = S 1)
    (A : I → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hAcont : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => A t i j)
    (hupper : ∀ (t : I) (i j : Fin n), j < i → A t i j = 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ (t : I) (i : Fin n), 0 < A t i i)
    (hAloop : A 0 = A 1)
    (hcomp : ∀ t, rowsMatrix (frameAt Y (γ t))
      = normalBlock (1 : ℝ)
          (((S t : SOGroup n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) * A t) *
        rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t))) :
    loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop Y γ hγc hY) (frameSOLoop_closed Y γ hγc hY hloop)
      = loopClassZ2 S hSloop
        + loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop X γ hγc hX)
            (frameSOLoop_closed X γ hγc hX hloop)
proof:
:= by
  
  have hBScont := continuous_normalBlockLoop S
  have hBSdet := det_normalBlockLoop_pos S
  have hBSloop := normalBlockLoop_loop hSloop
  have hBAcont := continuous_normalBlock_one_of_entries (n := n) hAcont
  have hBAupper : ∀ (t : I) (i j : Fin (n + 1)), j < i →
      normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t) i j = 0 := fun t i j hij =>
    normalBlock_one_upper (fun a b hab => hupper t a b hab) i j hij
  have hBAdiag : ∀ (t : I) (i : Fin (n + 1)),
      0 < normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t) i i := fun t i =>
    normalBlock_one_diag_pos (fun a => hdiag t a) i
  have hBAdet : ∀ t : I, 0 < (normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t)).det := fun t =>
    det_pos_of_upperTriangular (fun i j hij => hBAupper t i j hij)
      (fun i => hBAdiag t i)
  have hBAloop : (fun t : I => normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t)) 0
      = (fun t : I => normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t)) 1 := by
    show normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A 0) = normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A 1)
    rw [hAloop]
  
  have hGcont : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t : I =>
      (normalBlockLoop S t * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t)) i j := by
    intro i j
    have hrw : (fun t : I =>
        (normalBlockLoop S t * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t)) i j)
        = fun t : I => ∑ l : Fin (n + 1),
            normalBlockLoop S t i l * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t) l j := by
      funext t
      exact Matrix.mul_apply
    rw [hrw]
    exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun l _ => (hBScont i l).mul (hBAcont l j)
  have hGdet : ∀ t : I,
      0 < (normalBlockLoop S t * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t)).det := by
    intro t
    rw [Matrix.det_mul]
    exact mul_pos (hBSdet t) (hBAdet t)
  have hGloop : (fun t : I => normalBlockLoop S t * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t)) 0
      = (fun t : I => normalBlockLoop S t * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t)) 1 := by
    show normalBlockLoop S 0 * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A 0)
      = normalBlockLoop S 1 * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A 1)
    rw [hBSloop, hAloop]
  have hGeq : ∀ t, rowsMatrix (frameAt Y (γ t))
      = (normalBlockLoop S t * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t)) *
        rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t)) := by
    intro t
    rw [show normalBlockLoop S t * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t)
        = normalBlock (1 : ℝ)
            (((S t : SOGroup n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) * A t) from
      (normalBlock_mul (1 : ℝ) _ _).symm]
    exact hcomp t
  
  rw [loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_of_comparison X Y γ hγc hX hY hloop
    (fun t => normalBlockLoop S t * normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t))
    hGcont hGdet hGloop hGeq]
  congr 1
  
  rw [loopClassZ2_gsQLoop_mul (normalBlockLoop S)
    (fun t => normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t))
    hBScont hBAcont hBSdet hBAdet hGcont hGdet hBSloop hBAloop hGloop,
    loopClassZ2_gsQLoop_eq_zero_of_upperTriangular
      (fun t => normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (A t)) hBAcont hBAupper hBAdiag hBAdet
      hBAloop,
    add_zero]
  exact loopClassZ2_gsQLoop_normalBlockLoop hn S hSloop

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.loopClassZ2_eq_zero_of_triangularComparison
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_eq_zero_of_triangularComparison (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (X Y : FramedLevelSet n) (γ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hγc : Continuous γ) (hX : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet X.g)
    (hY : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet Y.g) (hloop : γ 0 = γ 1)
    (S : C(I, SOGroup n)) (hSloop : S 0 = S 1)
    (A : I → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hAcont : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => A t i j)
    (hupper : ∀ (t : I) (i j : Fin n), j < i → A t i j = 0)
    (hdiag : ∀ (t : I) (i : Fin n), 0 < A t i i)
    (hAloop : A 0 = A 1)
    (hcomp : ∀ t, rowsMatrix (frameAt Y (γ t))
      = normalBlock (1 : ℝ)
          (((S t : SOGroup n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) * A t) *
        rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t)))
    (hclass : loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop Y γ hγc hY)
        (frameSOLoop_closed Y γ hγc hY hloop)
      = loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop X γ hγc hX)
          (frameSOLoop_closed X γ hγc hX hloop)) :
    loopClassZ2 S hSloop = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_of_triangularComparison hn X Y γ hγc hX hY
    hloop S hSloop A hAcont hupper hdiag hAloop hcomp
  rw [hclass] at h
  have h' : loopClassZ2 S hSloop +
      loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop X γ hγc hX)
        (frameSOLoop_closed X γ hγc hX hloop) -
      loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop X γ hγc hX)
        (frameSOLoop_closed X γ hγc hX hloop) =
      loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop X γ hγc hX)
        (frameSOLoop_closed X γ hγc hX hloop) -
      loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop X γ hγc hX)
        (frameSOLoop_closed X γ hγc hX hloop) := by
    rw [← h]
  simpa using h'

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularTransition.rowsMatrix_frameAt_eq_of_triangularJet
statement:
theorem rowsMatrix_frameAt_eq_of_triangularJet
    (X Y : FramedLevelSet n) (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (Q : SOGroup n)
    (Aop : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hjet : fderiv ℝ Y.g p =
      ((SOFrameGauge.toCLM Q).comp Aop).comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p))
    (htau : tauField Y.g p = tauField X.g p) :
    rowsMatrix (frameAt Y p)
      = normalBlock (1 : ℝ)
          (((Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) *
            PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix Aop) *
        rowsMatrix (frameAt X p)
proof:
:= by
  have hmat : PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix
      ((SOFrameGauge.toCLM Q).comp Aop)
      = ((Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) *
        PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix Aop := by
    have hQ : PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (SOFrameGauge.toCLM Q)
        = ((Q : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)) :=
      PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_toEuclideanCLM _
    rw [clmMatrix_comp, hQ]
  have h := rowsMatrix_frameAt_eq_normalBlock_mul X Y p
    ((SOFrameGauge.toCLM Q).comp Aop) hjet (1 : ℝ) (by rw [htau, one_smul])
  rw [h, hmat]

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_quarter_cover
statement:
theorem chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_quarter_cover
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    ((D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 4
proof:
:= by
  let b : ℝ :=
    ((D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ)
  let rho := (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius
  let q := D.chronologicalExteriorFlowSeparationTime t ht
  let m := min
    (min
      (min (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).modelRadius)
      (Real.sqrt
        (D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).safeTime))
    (Real.sqrt q)
  have hb : 0 ≤ b :=
    (D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.bound.coe_nonneg
  have hrho : 0 < rho :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius_pos
  have hq : 0 < q := D.chronologicalExteriorFlowSeparationTime_pos t ht
  have hmsqrt : m ≤ Real.sqrt q := min_le_right _ _
  have hm : 0 < m := lt_min
    (lt_min
      (lt_min
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_pos
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).modelRadius_pos)
      (Real.sqrt_pos.2
        (D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).safeTime_pos))
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hq)
  have hmnonneg : 0 ≤ m := hm.le
  have hmsq : m ^ 2 ≤ q := by
    calc
      m ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt q) ^ 2 :=
        (sq_le_sq₀ hmnonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg q)).2 hmsqrt
      _ = q := Real.sq_sqrt hq.le
  have hhalf : (m / 2) ^ 2 ≤ q / 4 := by
    nlinarith
  have hqeq : q * (b + 1) = rho := by
    dsimp [q, chronologicalExteriorFlowSeparationTime, b, rho]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by nlinarith)
  have hbq : b * q < rho := by
    nlinarith
  have hbhalf : b * (m / 2) ^ 2 ≤ b * (q / 4) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf hb
  change b * (m / 2) ^ 2 < rho / 4
  nlinarith

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalWindowRadius_doubleFlowDistance_lt_half_cover
statement:
theorem chronologicalWindowRadius_doubleFlowDistance_lt_half_cover
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    ((D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        |2 * D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2| <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_quarter_cover t ht
  have hs : 0 ≤ D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity :
    0 ≤ 2 * D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2)]
  nlinarith

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowCore.targetOrbit_ne_of_source_far_and_inner_point
statement:
theorem targetOrbit_ne_of_source_far_and_inner_point
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowCore (a + 2))
    (O : {O // O ∈ H.Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset H.A})
    (Q : Set E₁) (p : E')
    (hpQ : spacePart p ∈ Q)
    (hptime : tcoord p = H.t + H.ε)
    (hpclose : dist p H.criticalCenter < H.r)
    (hsourceFar : ∀ q : I,
      2 * H.r ≤ dist ((H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q)
        H.criticalCenter)
    (hmove : (H.R.base.bound : ℝ) * |2 * H.ε| < H.r) :
    ((H.targetOrbit O : H.Vpos.OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) ≠ Q
proof:
:= by
  intro hcollision
  have hpTarget : spacePart p ∈
      ((H.targetOrbit O : H.Vpos.OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) := by
    rw [hcollision]
    exact hpQ
  rw [H.targetOrbit_coe O] at hpTarget
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
    (H.positiveParam O).exists_curve_eq_of_mem_orbit hpTarget
  change H.positiveCurve O q = spacePart p at hq
  have hend : H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) H.ε = p := by
    calc
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) H.ε =
          cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O q) (H.t + H.ε) := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O q]
        exact (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime (spacePart p) (tcoord p) := by rw [hq, hptime]
      _ = p := spaceTime_spacePart p
  let x := (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q
  have hflow2 : H.R.base.flow x (2 * H.ε) = p := by
    calc
      H.R.base.flow x (2 * H.ε) =
          H.R.base.flow (H.R.base.flow x H.ε) H.ε := by
        simpa [two_mul] using
          (congrFun (H.R.base.flow_shift x H.ε) H.ε).symm
      _ = p := by
        change H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) H.ε = p
        exact hend
  have hdist : dist x p ≤ (H.R.base.bound : ℝ) * |2 * H.ε| := by
    rw [← hflow2]
    simpa using H.R.base.dist_flow_self_le x 0 (2 * H.ε)
  have htriangle := dist_triangle x p H.criticalCenter
  have hfar := hsourceFar q
  nlinarith

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleMergeForwardTargetOrbit_ne_branch
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleMergeForwardTargetOrbit_ne_branch
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (O : {O // O ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
      (D.chronologicalSaddleMergeExteriorSourceFamily t ht hindex)})
    (b : SaddleBranch) :
    (((D.chronologicalSaddleMergeExteriorFlowCore t ht hindex
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleMergeExteriorMidpointCapture t ht hindex)
      ).targetOrbit O : (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) :
        Set E₁) ≠
      ((D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex b :
        (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁)
proof:
:= by
  let hm := D.chronologicalSaddleMergeExteriorMidpointCapture t ht hindex
  let H := D.chronologicalSaddleMergeExteriorFlowCore t ht hindex
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime t ht) hm
  let p : E' := (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBranch b
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0
  apply H.targetOrbit_ne_of_source_far_and_inner_point O
    ((D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex b :
      (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) p
  · exact D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranch_mem_distinguishedOrbit
      t ht hindex b
  · have hu : ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b
          (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0)‖ <
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius := by
      have hsq := norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b
          (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0)‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hnorm : ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b
          (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0)‖ =
          D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht := by
        norm_num at hsq
        nlinarith [D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht]
      rw [hnorm]
      exact (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
    have hpTime : tcoord p = D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht := by
      calc
        tcoord p = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) +
            D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
          (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBranch_time
            hindex b (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0 hu
        _ = D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht := rfl
    calc
      tcoord p = D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht := hpTime
      _ = H.t + H.ε := rfl
  · exact D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranch_dist_lt_half_cover t ht b
  · intro q
    have hx : (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q ∈
        D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht := by
      apply D.chronologicalSaddleMergeSourcePoint_mem_exteriorSlabCore
        t ht hindex O
      rw [(D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O.1]
      exact (H.negativeParam O).curve_mem_orbit q
    rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore] at hx
    have hr : H.r =
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 := rfl
    calc
      2 * H.r = (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius := by
        rw [hr]
        ring
      _ ≤ dist ((H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q)
          (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := hx.2
      _ = dist ((H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q)
          H.criticalCenter := rfl
  · change
      ((D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          |2 * D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2| <
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2
    exact D.chronologicalWindowRadius_doubleFlowDistance_lt_half_cover t ht

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleSplitForwardTargetOrbit_ne_branch
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleSplitForwardTargetOrbit_ne_branch
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (Htop : D.ChronologicalSaddleSplitTopology t ht hindex)
    (O : {O // O ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
      (D.chronologicalSaddleSplitExteriorSourceFamily t ht hindex)})
    (b : SaddleBranch) :
    (((D.chronologicalSaddleSplitExteriorFlowCore t ht hindex
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleSplitExteriorMidpointCapture t ht hindex Htop)
      ).targetOrbit O : (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) :
        Set E₁) ≠
      ((D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex b :
        (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁)
proof:
:= by
  let hm := D.chronologicalSaddleSplitExteriorMidpointCapture
    t ht hindex Htop
  let H := D.chronologicalSaddleSplitExteriorFlowCore t ht hindex
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime t ht) hm
  let p : E' := (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBranch b
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0
  apply H.targetOrbit_ne_of_source_far_and_inner_point O
    ((D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex b :
      (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) p
  · exact D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranch_mem_distinguishedOrbit
      t ht hindex b
  · have hu : ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b
          (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0)‖ <
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius := by
      have hsq := norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0
      have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b
          (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0)‖ := norm_nonneg _
      have hnorm : ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b
          (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0)‖ =
          D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht := by
        norm_num at hsq
        nlinarith [D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht]
      rw [hnorm]
      exact (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
    have hpTime : tcoord p = D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht := by
      calc
        tcoord p = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) +
            D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
          (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBranch_time
            hindex b (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0 hu
        _ = D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht := rfl
    calc
      tcoord p = D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht := hpTime
      _ = H.t + H.ε := rfl
  · exact D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranch_dist_lt_half_cover t ht b
  · intro q
    have hx : (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q ∈
        D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht := by
      apply D.chronologicalSaddleSplitSourcePoint_mem_exteriorSlabCore
        t ht hindex Htop.negative_eq O
      rw [(D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O.1]
      exact (H.negativeParam O).curve_mem_orbit q
    rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore] at hx
    have hr : H.r =
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 := rfl
    calc
      2 * H.r = (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius := by
        rw [hr]
        ring
      _ ≤ dist ((H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q)
          (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := hx.2
      _ = dist ((H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q)
          H.criticalCenter := rfl
  · change
      ((D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          |2 * D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2| <
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2
    exact D.chronologicalWindowRadius_doubleFlowDistance_lt_half_cover t ht

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleReverseTargetOrbit_ne_branch
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleReverseTargetOrbit_ne_branch
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (A : Set (Set E₁))
    (hmidpoint : D.ChronologicalSaddleReverseMidpointCapture t ht A)
    (O : {O // O ∈ (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset A})
    (hexterior : (O.1 : Set E₁) ∈
      D.chronologicalExteriorOrbitCollection t ht
        (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht))
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) :
    ((D.chronologicalSaddleReverseTargetOrbit t ht A hmidpoint O :
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) ≠
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex b :
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁)
proof:
:= by
  let H := D.chronologicalSaddleReverseExteriorFlowCore t ht A hmidpoint
  let eSource := D.chronologicalSaddleReverseSourceEquiv t ht A
  let eTarget := D.chronologicalSaddleReverseTargetOrbitEquiv t ht
  let OH := eSource O
  let Q := eTarget.symm (H.targetOrbit OH)
  let p : E' := (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBranch b
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0
  have hcoreNe :
      ((H.targetOrbit OH : H.Vpos.OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) ≠
        ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex b :
          (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) := by
    apply H.targetOrbit_ne_of_source_far_and_inner_point OH
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex b :
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) p
    · exact D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeBranch_mem_distinguishedOrbit
        t ht hindex b
    · calc
        tcoord p = D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht :=
          D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeBranch_time t ht hindex b
        _ = H.t + H.ε := rfl
    · exact D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeBranch_dist_lt_half_cover t ht b
    · intro q
      let P := (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht
        |>.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam O.1)
      have hloop : (H.negativeParam OH).exteriorAmbientLoop q =
          P.exteriorAmbientLoop q := by
        change cobSpaceTime
            ((D.chronologicalSaddleReverseSourceField t ht
              |>.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam OH.1).curve q)
            (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) -
              -(D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2)) =
          cobSpaceTime (P.curve q) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
        apply congrArg₂ cobSpaceTime
        · change
            ((D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).transport
              (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)
                |>.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam OH.1).curve q = P.curve q
          calc
            _ = (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht
                  |>.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam
                    (((D.chronologicalAfterField t ht
                      |>.selectedOrbitTransportEquiv
                        (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)
                        A).symm OH).1)).curve q :=
              (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).transportedIntrinsicCurve_symm
                (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)
                A OH q
            _ = P.curve q := by
              have hO : (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht
                  |>.selectedOrbitTransportEquiv
                    (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht) A
                  ).symm OH = O := by
                change eSource.symm OH = O
                exact eSource.symm_apply_apply O
              rw [hO]
        · exact D.chronologicalReverseAfterTime_eq t ht
      have hx : P.exteriorAmbientLoop q ∈
          D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht := by
        apply D.chronologicalOrbitPoint_mem_exteriorSlabCore
          t ht (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
          ⟨(D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht).1.le,
            (D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht).2.le⟩
          (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
          (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht) O.1
        · rw [(D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O.1]
          exact P.curve_mem_orbit q
        · exact hexterior
      rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore] at hx
      have hr : H.r =
          (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 := rfl
      calc
        2 * H.r = (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius := by
          rw [hr]
          ring
        _ ≤ dist (P.exteriorAmbientLoop q)
            (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := hx.2
        _ = dist ((H.negativeParam OH).exteriorAmbientLoop q)
            H.criticalCenter := by
          change dist (P.exteriorAmbientLoop q)
              (D.position.eventCenter t ht) =
            dist ((H.negativeParam OH).exteriorAmbientLoop q)
              (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
          rw [hloop]
    · change
        ((D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
            |2 * (-(D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2))| <
          (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2
      simpa only [mul_neg, abs_neg] using
        D.chronologicalWindowRadius_doubleFlowDistance_lt_half_cover t ht
  have hQtarget : (Q : Set E₁) =
      ((H.targetOrbit OH : H.Vpos.OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) := by
    change ((((D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitIndexTransportEquiv
      (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)).symm
        (H.targetOrbit OH) :
          (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) = _
    exact (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitIndexTransportEquiv_symm_val
      (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)
      (H.targetOrbit OH)
  change (Q : Set E₁) ≠
    ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex b :
      (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁)
  intro hcollision
  apply hcoreNe
  exact hQtarget.symm.trans hcollision

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.pairToMorseParam_coordinates

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.norm_sq_eq_coordinates
statement:
theorem norm_sq_eq_coordinates (u : E₂) :
    ‖u‖ ^ 2 = (u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2

    ‖u‖ ^ 2 = ‖pairToMorseParam (u 0, u 1)‖ ^ 2 := by
