name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.definite_coveredSliceFiber_at_critical_eq_center
statement:
theorem definite_coveredSliceFiber_at_critical_eq_center
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center)
    (hindex : M.index = .minimum ∨ M.index = .maximum)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hx : x ∈ M.coveredSliceFiber (tcoord center)) :
    cobSpaceTime (n := n) x (tcoord center) = center
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := M.exists_param_of_mem_coveredSliceFiber hx
  have htime := M.time_model u hu
  have hs : tcoord (M.param u) = tcoord center := by
    rw [huv, tcoord_spaceTime]
  have hq : morseQuadratic M.index (u 0, u 1) = 0 := by
    rw [htime] at hs
    linarith
  have hu0 : u = 0 := by
    rcases hindex with hmin | hmax
    · rw [hmin] at hq
      simp only [morseQuadratic] at hq
      have h0 : u 0 = 0 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 0), sq_nonneg (u 1)]
      have h1 : u 1 = 0 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 0), sq_nonneg (u 1)]
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [h0, h1]
    · rw [hmax] at hq
      simp only [morseQuadratic] at hq
      have h0 : u 0 = 0 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 0), sq_nonneg (u 1)]
      have h1 : u 1 = 0 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 0), sq_nonneg (u 1)]
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [h0, h1]
  rw [← huv, hu0, M.param_zero]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.norm_morseParamComplex

  rw [Complex.norm_def, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.eq_definiteCircleParam_arg
proof:
:= by
  let z := morseParamComplex u
  have hre := Complex.norm_mul_cos_arg z
  have him := Complex.norm_mul_sin_arg z
  rw [norm_morseParamComplex, hnorm] at hre him
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · simpa [z] using hre.symm
  · simpa [z] using him.symm

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.minimum_coveredSliceFiber_before_eq_empty
statement:
theorem minimum_coveredSliceFiber_before_eq_empty
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center)
    (hindex : M.index = .minimum)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) :
    M.coveredSliceFiber (tcoord center - a ^ 2) = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := M.exists_param_of_mem_coveredSliceFiber hx
  have htime := M.time_model u hu
  have hs : tcoord (M.param u) = tcoord center - a ^ 2 := by
    rw [huv, tcoord_spaceTime]
  rw [hindex] at htime
  simp only [morseQuadratic] at htime
  rw [htime] at hs
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 0), sq_nonneg (u 1), sq_pos_of_pos ha]

    rw [huv, tcoord_spaceTime]

  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 0), sq_nonneg (u 1), sq_pos_of_pos ha]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.definiteSpatialAnglePath_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem definiteSpatialAnglePath_zero (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < T.radius) (theta : ℝ) :
    T.definiteSpatialAnglePath a ha har theta 0 =
      spacePart (M.definiteCircle a 0)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.minimum_coveredSliceFiber_after_subset_orbit
statement:
theorem minimum_coveredSliceFiber_after_subset_orbit
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (hindex : M.index = .minimum)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.minimumPositiveSlice a hreg)) :
    M.coveredSliceFiber (tcoord center + a ^ 2) ⊆
      V.orbit (spacePart (M.definiteCircle a 0))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := M.exists_param_of_mem_coveredSliceFiber hx
  have htime := M.time_model u hu
  have hs : tcoord (M.param u) = tcoord center + a ^ 2 := by
    rw [huv, tcoord_spaceTime]
  rw [hindex] at htime
  simp only [morseQuadratic] at htime
  have hcoord : (u 0) ^ 2 + (u 1) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [htime, hs]
  have hnormsq := norm_sq_eq_coordinates u
  have hnorm : ‖u‖ = a := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg u]
  let theta := Complex.arg (morseParamComplex u)
  have hcircle : u = definiteCircleParam a theta :=
    eq_definiteCircleParam_arg hnorm
  have hspace := congrArg spacePart huv
  have hxEq : x = spacePart (M.definiteCircle a theta) := by
    calc
      x = spacePart (M.param u) := by simpa using hspace.symm
      _ = spacePart (M.definiteCircle a theta) := by
        rw [hcircle]
        rfl
  rw [hxEq]
  exact T.minimumDefiniteSpatialPoint_mem_same_orbit
    hindex a ha har hreg V theta

        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0)

      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2
proof:

  apply D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink_param_dist_lt_half_cover t ht
  have hsq := norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0
  have hnorm :

          (saddlePositiveArc b (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0)‖ =

        (saddlePositiveArc b (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0)‖ :=
      norm_nonneg _
    have hpos := D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht
    norm_num at hsq
    nlinarith
  rw [hnorm]
  exact D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_embedded t ht

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranch_mem_distinguishedOrbit
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranch_mem_distinguishedOrbit
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) :
    spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBranch b
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0) ∈
      ((D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex b :
        (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  let rho := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  let a := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht
  let u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) :=
    pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a 0)
  have ha : 0 < a := D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht
  have hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = a ^ 2 := by
    simpa [u] using morseQuadratic_saddlePositiveArc b a 0
  have hsign : 0 < signedBranch b (u 0) := by
    have hsqrt : 0 < Real.sqrt (a ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.2 (sq_pos_of_pos ha)
    cases b <;> simpa [u, saddlePositiveArc, signedBranch] using hsqrt
  have hu : ‖u‖ < M.radius := by
    have hsq := norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a 0
    have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ‖u‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hnorm : ‖u‖ = a := by
      change ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a 0)‖ = a
      norm_num at hsq
      nlinarith
    rw [hnorm]
    exact (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le T.radius_le
  have hmem := T.saddlePositiveParam_mem_branch_orbit_full H hindex
    b rho a u hquad hsign
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq t ht)
    hu
    ((D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      T.radius_le)
    (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
    (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht)
  simpa [M, T, H, rho, a, u, chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit,
    StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex,
    StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBranch,
    StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint] using hmem

    cases b <;> simpa [u, saddleNegativeArc, signedBranch] using hsqrt

    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq t ht)
    hu
    ((D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      T.radius_le)
    (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)
    (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht)
  simpa [M, T, H, rho, a, u, chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit,
    StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex,
    StandardMorseEventAt.saddleNegativeBranch,
    StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint] using hmem

name: Submission.definiteRadiusInterpolation_pos
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.property.1
  have hs1 : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.property.2
  unfold definiteRadiusInterpolation
  by_cases hs : (s : ℝ) = 0
  · simp [hs, ha]
  exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos
    (mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs1) ha.le)
    (mul_pos (lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hs)) hb)

name: Submission.definiteRadiusInterpolation_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.property.1
  have hs1 : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.property.2
  by_cases hsone : (s : ℝ) = 1
  · simp [definiteRadiusInterpolation, hsone, hbr]
  have hslt : (s : ℝ) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hsone
  have hleft : (1 - (s : ℝ)) * a < (1 - (s : ℝ)) * r :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left har (sub_pos.mpr hslt)
  have hright : (s : ℝ) * b ≤ (s : ℝ) * r :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hbr.le hs0
  unfold definiteRadiusInterpolation
  calc
    (1 - (s : ℝ)) * a + (s : ℝ) * b <
        (1 - (s : ℝ)) * r + (s : ℝ) * r :=
      add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le hleft hright
    _ = r := by ring

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy_regular
statement:
theorem criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy_regular
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hradA : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hradB : b < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (q : I × I) :
    Surjective
      (spatialDeriv (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
        (R.criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy p hp a b ha hb
          hradA hradB q))
proof:
:= by
  exact R.criticalDefiniteCircle_regular p hp
    (definiteRadiusInterpolation_pos ha hb q.1)
    (definiteRadiusInterpolation_lt hradA hradB q.1)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy_closed
statement:
theorem criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy_closed
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hradA : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hradB : b < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (s : I) :
    R.criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy p hp a b ha hb
        hradA hradB (s, 0) =
      R.criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy p hp a b ha hb
        hradA hradB (s, 1)
proof:
:= by
  change (R.criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy p hp a b ha hb
      hradA hradB).toFun (s, 0) =
    (R.criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy p hp a b ha hb
      hradA hradB).toFun (s, 1)
  simp only [criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy]
  norm_num
  change R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp
      (definiteRadiusInterpolation a b s) 0 =
    R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp
      (definiteRadiusInterpolation a b s) (2 * Real.pi)
  unfold criticalDefiniteCircle
  congr 1
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [definiteCircleParam, pairToMorseParam,
      Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.loopClassZ2_criticalDefiniteCircle_radius_congr
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_criticalDefiniteCircle_radius_congr
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b)
    (hradA : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hradB : b < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius) :
    let zA
proof:
:= R.criticalDefiniteCircleCurve p hp a ha hradA
    let zB := R.criticalDefiniteCircleCurve p hp b hb hradB
    let hregA : ∀ u, Surjective
        (spatialDeriv (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
          (zA u)) := fun u => by
      exact R.criticalDefiniteCircle_regular p hp ha hradA
    let hregB : ∀ u, Surjective
        (spatialDeriv (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
          (zB u)) := fun u => by
      exact R.criticalDefiniteCircle_regular p hp hb hradB
    loopClassZ2
        (regularZeroFrame
          (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).smooth zA hregA)
        (regularZeroFrame_closed
          (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).smooth zA hregA
          (R.criticalDefiniteCircleCurve_closed p hp a ha hradA)) =
      loopClassZ2
        (regularZeroFrame
          (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).smooth zB hregB)
        (regularZeroFrame_closed
          (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).smooth zB hregB
          (R.criticalDefiniteCircleCurve_closed p hp b hb hradB)) := by
  dsimp only
  exact loopClassZ2_regularZeroFrame_congr
    (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).smooth
    (R.criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy p hp a b ha hb hradA hradB)
    (R.criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy_regular p hp a b ha hb
      hradA hradB)
    (R.criticalDefiniteCircleCurve_closed p hp a ha hradA)
    (R.criticalDefiniteCircleCurve_closed p hp b hb hradB)
    (R.criticalDefiniteCircleRadiusHomotopy_closed p hp a b ha hb
      hradA hradB)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit_mem_positive
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit_mem_positive
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hpositive : D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) :
    ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex b :
      (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) ∈
      (D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
        (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)).positiveOrbitCollection
          (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht)
proof:
:= by
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let ρ := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  let a := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht
  let V := D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht
  let O := D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex b
  let S := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)
  apply (S.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff V O).2
  have hbasePositive : 0 < S
      (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase b ρ a)) := by
    change 0 < D.signedOutput (cobSpaceTime
      (spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd
        b .negative ρ a)) (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht))
    rw [chronologicalBeforeTime]
    rw [← (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_time
      hindex b .negative
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq t ht)
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
        T.radius_le), spaceTime_spacePart]
    exact T.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_positive_of_center
      (D.chronologicalEventCenter_positive t ht hpositive) b .negative
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  have hbaseFiber : spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase b ρ a) ∈
      (T.saddleNegativeSlice a
        (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)).fiber :=
    T.saddleNegativeBranchBase_mem_fiber hindex b
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)
  have hmem : V.orbitPoint O ∈
      V.orbit (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase b ρ a)) := by
    change V.orbitPoint O ∈ (O : Set E₁)
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  exact (S.pos_iff_of_mem_orbit V hbaseFiber hmem).mp hbasePositive

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit_mem_positive
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit_mem_positive
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)

    ((D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex b :
      (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) ∈
      (D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
        (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)).positiveOrbitCollection
          (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht)
proof:
:= by
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let ρ := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  let a := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht
  let V := D.chronologicalAfterField t ht

  let S := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
  apply (S.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff V O).2
  have hbasePositive : 0 < S
      (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase b ρ a)) := by
    change 0 < D.signedOutput (cobSpaceTime
      (spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd
        b .negative ρ a)) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht))

    exact T.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_positive_of_center

  have hbaseFiber : spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase b ρ a) ∈

        (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)).fiber :=
    T.saddlePositiveBranchBase_mem_fiber hindex b
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
  have hmem : V.orbitPoint O ∈
      V.orbit (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase b ρ a)) := by

:= by

  constructor
  · intro hx
    exact D.homotopy.fiber_subset hx
  · intro hx
    have hx0 : X.g x = 0 := hx
    have h := D.endpoint x
    rw [hx0] at h
    show Y.g x = 0
    rw [← h]
    simp

theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_alignment
    (hm : 0 < m)

      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)

    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (A : HarmonizedGaugeAlignment hm M F G) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_toFirstSource_of_chain hm M F

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationHarmonizedSegmentExistence.harmonizedSegmentData_of_noAntiparallel_firstJet
statement:
theorem harmonizedSegmentData_of_noAntiparallel_firstJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (hno : ∀ x ∉ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber,
      ∀ c : ℝ, c < 0 →
        (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x ≠
          c • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x)
    (hjet : ∀ x ∈ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber,
      fderiv ℝ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x =
        fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x) :
    HarmonizedSegmentData hm M F G
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hno, ?_⟩
  intro s hs0 hs1 x hx
  rw [hjet x hx]
  have hcomb : (1 - s) • fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
      s • fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x =
      fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x := by
    module
  rw [hcomb]
  exact (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).regular x hx

name: Submission.exists_finiteIFTSurfaceCover_of_pointwise
statement:
theorem exists_finiteIFTSurfaceCover_of_pointwise
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n)
    (hlocal : ∀ v, v ∈ C.fiber → Nonempty (CompactIFTSurfacePatchAt C v)) :
    ∃ s : Finset C.fiber, Nonempty (FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C (↥s))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let patch : ∀ q : C.fiber, CompactIFTSurfacePatchAt C q.1 :=
    fun q => Classical.choice (hlocal q.1 q.2)
  have hcover : C.fiber ⊆ ⋃ q : C.fiber, (patch q).ambient := by
    intro v hv
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      ⟨⟨v, hv⟩, (patch ⟨v, hv⟩).center_mem_ambient⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := C.isCompact_slabFiber.elim_finite_subcover
    (fun q : C.fiber => (patch q).ambient)
    (fun q => (patch q).ambient_open) hcover
  refine ⟨s, ⟨{
    chart := fun i => (patch i.1).chart
    core := fun i => (patch i.1).core
    compact_core := fun i => (patch i.1).compact_core
    core_subset_domain := fun i => (patch i.1).core_subset_domain
    domain_open := fun i => (patch i.1).chart_domain_open
    ambient := fun i => (patch i.1).ambient
    ambient_open := fun i => (patch i.1).ambient_open
    fiber_subset_ambient := ?_
    fiber_patch := fun i => (patch i.1).fiber_inter_ambient_subset
  }⟩⟩
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨q, hqs, hvq⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (hs hv)
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨⟨q, hqs⟩, hvq⟩

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.unitPair_sq_add_sq
statement:
theorem unitPair_sq_add_sq (z : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (unitPair z).1 ^ 2 + (unitPair z).2 ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hz : z = 0
  · simp [unitPair, hz]
  · rw [unitPair, dif_neg hz, normalizedCartesian]
    change (z.1 / pairRadius z) ^ 2 + (z.2 / pairRadius z) ^ 2 = 1
    rw [div_pow, div_pow, ← add_div, ← pairRadius_sq]
    field_simp [pairRadius_eq_zero_iff.not.mpr hz]

proof:

    subst z

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.contDiffAt_unitPair_of_sq
proof:

  have hevent : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 z, unitPair w = normalizedCartesian w := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hz0] with w hw
    rw [unitPair, dif_neg hw]
  exact (contDiffAt_normalizedCartesian hz0).congr_of_eventuallyEq hevent

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.pairRotBlock_mem
statement:
theorem pairRotBlock_mem : ∀ (r : ℕ) (z : ℝ × ℝ),
    z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1 →
      pairRotBlock r z ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin r) ℝ
  | 0, _, _ => one_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup 0
  | 1, _, _ => one_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup 1
  | 2, z, hz => by
      rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
      constructor
      · rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff]
        ext i j
        fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
          simp [pairRotBlock, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two,
            Matrix.transpose_apply] <;> nlinarith
      · change (!![z.1, -z.2; z.2, z.1] : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ).det = 1
        rw [Matrix.det_fin_two_of]
        simpa [pow_two] using hz
  | k + 3, z, hz => incMatrix_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
      (pairRotBlock_mem (k + 2) z hz)

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.pairRotBlock_cos_sin
statement:
theorem pairRotBlock_cos_sin : ∀ (r : ℕ) (theta : ℝ),
    pairRotBlock r (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta) = rotBlock r theta
  | 0, _ => rfl
  | 1, _ => rfl
  | 2, _ => rfl
  | k + 3, theta => by
      change incMatrix (pairRotBlock (k + 2)
        (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta)) =
        incMatrix (rotBlock (k + 2) theta)
      rw [pairRotBlock_cos_sin (k + 2) theta]

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.contDiff_pairRotBlock_entry
statement:
theorem contDiff_pairRotBlock_entry : ∀ (r : ℕ)
    (i j : Fin r),
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => pairRotBlock r z i j)
  | 0, i, _ => i.elim0
  | 1, _, _ => by
      simp only [pairRotBlock]
      exact contDiff_const
  | 2, i, j => by
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp only [pairRotBlock]
      · exact contDiff_fst
      · exact contDiff_snd.neg
      · exact contDiff_snd
      · exact contDiff_fst
  | k + 3, i, j => by
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          induction j using Fin.lastCases with
          | last =>
              simp only [pairRotBlock, incMatrix_apply_last_last]
              exact contDiff_const
          | cast j =>
              simp only [pairRotBlock, incMatrix_apply_last_castSucc]
              exact contDiff_const
      | cast i =>
          induction j using Fin.lastCases with
          | last =>
              simp only [pairRotBlock, incMatrix_apply_castSucc_last]
              exact contDiff_const
          | cast j =>
              simpa only [pairRotBlock, incMatrix_apply_castSucc_castSucc] using
                contDiff_pairRotBlock_entry (k + 2) i j

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.contDiff_pairRotBlock

proof:
:= by

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.addCircleCartesian_coe
statement:
private theorem addCircleCartesian_coe (u : I) :
    addCircleCartesian (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) =
      (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)),
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · change (((AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero
        (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) : Circle) : ℂ).re) = _
    rw [AddCircle.homeomorphCircle_apply, AddCircle.toCircle_apply_mk,
      Circle.coe_exp, Complex.exp_mul_I]
    norm_num
    have harg : (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ) * ((u : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        ((2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by norm_num
    rw [harg, Complex.cos_ofReal_re, Complex.sin_ofReal_im]
    simp
  · change (((AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero
        (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) : Circle) : ℂ).im) = _
    rw [AddCircle.homeomorphCircle_apply, AddCircle.toCircle_apply_mk,
      Circle.coe_exp, Complex.exp_mul_I]
    norm_num
    have harg : (2 : ℂ) * (Real.pi : ℂ) * ((u : ℝ) : ℂ) =
        ((2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by norm_num
    rw [harg, Complex.cos_ofReal_im, Complex.sin_ofReal_re]
    simp

name: Submission.rotMatrix_half
statement:
theorem rotMatrix_half (s : ℝ) :
    rotMatrix (⟨Real.cos s, 0, 0, Real.sin s⟩ : ℍ) = rzMatrix (2 * s)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Real.cos s ^ 2 - Real.sin s ^ 2 = Real.cos (2 * s) := by
    rw [Real.cos_two_mul]
    linear_combination -Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq s
  have h2 : 2 * (Real.cos s * Real.sin s) = Real.sin (2 * s) := by
    rw [Real.sin_two_mul]; ring
  have h2' : 2 * (Real.sin s * Real.cos s) = Real.sin (2 * s) := by
    rw [Real.sin_two_mul]; ring
  have h3 : Real.cos s ^ 2 + Real.sin s ^ 2 = 1 := by
    linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq s
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [rotMatrix, rzMatrix] <;>
    linarith [h1, h2, h2', h3]

  have h := rotMatrix_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup hn
  rwa [rotMatrix_half, show 2 * (θ / 2) = θ by ring] at h

      ⟨(1 : SpinOne), spinToSO_one_mem_fiber⟩ (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦rzPath⟧) = 1 := by
    rw [h, map_one]

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.rows_mul_transpose_gramSchmidtNormed
statement:
theorem rows_mul_transpose_gramSchmidtNormed
    {v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)} (hv : LinearIndependent ℝ v) :
    rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v) * (rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v))ᵀ
      = 1
proof:
:= by
  have horthonormal : Orthonormal ℝ (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v) :=
    gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hv
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  have hentries : ∀ l, rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v) i l *
      (rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v))ᵀ l j =
      (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v i) l * (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v j) l := by
    intro l
    rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]
    rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => hentries l]
  have hinner := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp horthonormal i j
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply] at hinner
  simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial] at hinner
  rw [← hinner]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => mul_comm _ _

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.transpose_mul_rows_gramSchmidtNormed
statement:
theorem transpose_mul_rows_gramSchmidtNormed
    {v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)} (hv : LinearIndependent ℝ v) :
    (rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v))ᵀ * rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v)
      = 1
proof:
:=
  mul_eq_one_comm.mp (rows_mul_transpose_gramSchmidtNormed hv)

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.inner_eq_zero_of_mem_span_gramSchmidt_Iio
proof:
:= by
  induction hw using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := hx
      exact gramSchmidt_orthogonal ℝ v (ne_of_lt hl)
  | zero => exact inner_zero_left _
  | add x y _ _ hx hy => rw [inner_add_left, hx, hy, add_zero]
  | smul c x _ hx => rw [real_inner_smul_left, hx, mul_zero]

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.inner_gramSchmidt_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem inner_gramSchmidt_eq_zero_of_lt
    {v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)} {i j : Fin k} (hij : i < j) :
    ⟪v i, gramSchmidt ℝ v j⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply inner_eq_zero_of_mem_span_gramSchmidt_Iio
  rw [span_gramSchmidt_Iio ℝ v j]
  exact Submodule.subset_span ⟨i, hij, rfl⟩

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.inner_self_gramSchmidt
statement:
theorem inner_self_gramSchmidt (v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    (i : Fin k) :
    ⟪v i, gramSchmidt ℝ v i⟫ = ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ⟪gramSchmidt ℝ v i - v i, gramSchmidt ℝ v i⟫ = 0 :=
    inner_eq_zero_of_mem_span_gramSchmidt_Iio (gramSchmidt_sub_mem_span v i)
  rw [inner_sub_left] at hzero
  have hself : ⟪gramSchmidt ℝ v i, gramSchmidt ℝ v i⟫ = ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ ^ 2 :=
    real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _
  rw [hself] at hzero
  linarith

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.gsLower_apply
statement:
theorem gsLower_apply (v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) (i j : Fin k) :
    gsLower v i j = ⟪v i, gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v j⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [gsLower, Matrix.mul_apply, PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => mul_comm _ _

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.gsLower_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem gsLower_eq_zero_of_lt (v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i < j) : gsLower v i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gsLower_apply, gramSchmidtNormed, real_inner_smul_right,
    inner_gramSchmidt_eq_zero_of_lt hij, mul_zero]

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.gsLower_diag
proof:
:= by
  have hne : gramSchmidt ℝ v i ≠ 0 := gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hv
  have hpos : 0 < ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
  rw [gsLower_apply, gramSchmidtNormed, real_inner_smul_right,
    inner_self_gramSchmidt]
  have key : (‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖)⁻¹ * ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ ^ 2
      = ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ := by
    rw [pow_two, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hpos), one_mul]
  exact key

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.gsLower_diag_pos
statement:
theorem gsLower_diag_pos {v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (hv : LinearIndependent ℝ v) (i : Fin k) : 0 < gsLower v i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [gsLower_diag hv i]
  exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hv)

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.rowsMatrix_eq_gsLower_mul
proof:
:= by
  rw [gsLower, Matrix.mul_assoc, transpose_mul_rows_gramSchmidtNormed hv,
    Matrix.mul_one]

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.gsInterp_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem gsInterp_eq_zero_of_lt (v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) (s : ℝ)
    {i j : Fin k} (hij : i < j) : gsInterp v s i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hone : (1 : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j = 0 :=
    Matrix.one_apply_ne (ne_of_lt hij)
  simp [gsInterp, gsLower_eq_zero_of_lt v hij, hone]

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.gsInterp_diag
proof:
:= by
  simp [gsInterp, gsLower_diag hv i, Matrix.one_apply_eq]

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.det_gsInterp_pos
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_of_lowerTriangular _ (fun i j hij => gsInterp_eq_zero_of_lt v s hij)]
  apply Finset.prod_pos
  intro i _
  rw [gsInterp_diag hv s i]
  have hpos : 0 < ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr (gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hv)
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs1 with heq | hlt
  · subst heq; norm_num
  · have h1 : 0 < (1 - s) * ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ := mul_pos (by linarith) hpos
    linarith

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.frameInterp_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem frameInterp_zero (v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    frameInterp v 0 = v
proof:
:= by
  funext i; simp [frameInterp]

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.frameInterp_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem frameInterp_one (v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    frameInterp v 1 = gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v
proof:
:= by
  funext i; simp [frameInterp]

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.rowsMatrix_frameInterp
statement:
theorem rowsMatrix_frameInterp {v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (hv : LinearIndependent ℝ v) (s : ℝ) :
    rowsMatrix (frameInterp v s)
      = gsInterp v s * rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v)
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : rowsMatrix (frameInterp v s)
      = (1 - s) • rowsMatrix v + s • rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v) := by
    ext i j
    rfl
  rw [hsplit, gsInterp, Matrix.add_mul, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.smul_mul,
    Matrix.one_mul, ← rowsMatrix_eq_gsLower_mul hv]

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.det_rowsMatrix_frameInterp_pos
statement:
theorem det_rowsMatrix_frameInterp_pos {v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (hv : LinearIndependent ℝ v) (hdet : 0 < (rowsMatrix v).det)
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    0 < (rowsMatrix (frameInterp v s)).det
proof:
:= by
  have hQ : 0 < (rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v)).det := by
    rw [det_rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed]
    apply mul_pos
    · apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro i _
      have hpos : 0 < ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ :=
        norm_pos_iff.mpr (gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hv)
      positivity
    · exact hdet
  rw [rowsMatrix_frameInterp hv s, Matrix.det_mul]
  exact mul_pos (det_gsInterp_pos hv hs0 hs1) hQ

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.linearIndependent_frameInterp
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_frameInterp {v : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (hv : LinearIndependent ℝ v) (hdet : 0 < (rowsMatrix v).det)
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (frameInterp v s)
proof:
:= by
  have h := det_rowsMatrix_frameInterp_pos hv hdet hs0 hs1
  have := linearIndependent_matrixRows_of_det_ne_zero (ne_of_gt h)
  rwa [show matrixRows (rowsMatrix (frameInterp v s)) = frameInterp v s from rfl] at this

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.gramSchmidt_comp_isometry
statement:
theorem gramSchmidt_comp_isometry (f : E →ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (v : Fin k → E) (i : Fin k) :
    gramSchmidt ℝ (fun j => f (v j)) i = f (gramSchmidt ℝ v i)
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin k, (i : ℕ) = N →
      gramSchmidt ℝ (fun j => f (v j)) i = f (gramSchmidt ℝ v i) := by
    intro N
    induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ N IH =>
      intro i hi
      rw [gramSchmidt_def ℝ (fun j => f (v j)) i, gramSchmidt_def ℝ v i,
        map_sub, map_sum]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
      have hjN : (j : ℕ) < N := by
        have hji : j < i := Finset.mem_Iio.mp hj
        omega
      have hIH : gramSchmidt ℝ (fun l => f (v l)) j = f (gramSchmidt ℝ v j) :=
        IH (j : ℕ) hjN j rfl
      rw [Submodule.starProjection_singleton, Submodule.starProjection_singleton,
        hIH, f.inner_map_map, f.norm_map, f.map_smul]
  exact key (i : ℕ) i rfl

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.gramSchmidtNormed_comp_isometry
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_comp_isometry (f : E →ₗᵢ[ℝ] E) (v : Fin k → E)
    (i : Fin k) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (fun j => f (v j)) i = f (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed, gramSchmidtNormed, gramSchmidt_comp_isometry f v i,
    f.norm_map, map_smul]

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.inner_eq_dotProduct
statement:
theorem inner_eq_dotProduct (a b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    ⟪a, b⟫ = (WithLp.ofLp a) ⬝ᵥ (WithLp.ofLp b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
  show ∑ x, (WithLp.ofLp b) x * (WithLp.ofLp a) x
    = ∑ x, (WithLp.ofLp a) x * (WithLp.ofLp b) x
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => mul_comm _ _

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.dotProduct_vecMul_of_mul_transpose
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec, ← Matrix.mulVec_transpose, Matrix.mulVec_mulVec,
    hQ, Matrix.one_mulVec]

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.rowVecMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rowVecMap_apply (Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    rowVecMap Q x = WithLp.toLp 2 ((WithLp.ofLp x) ᵥ* Q)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.rowVecIsometry_apply
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.matrixRows_mul
statement:
theorem matrixRows_mul (M Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (i : Fin k) :
    matrixRows (M * Q) i = WithLp.toLp 2 ((WithLp.ofLp (matrixRows M i)) ᵥ* Q)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.rowsMatrix_rowVecMap
statement:
theorem rowsMatrix_rowVecMap (Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (w : Fin k → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    rowsMatrix (fun i => WithLp.toLp 2 ((WithLp.ofLp (w i)) ᵥ* Q))
      = rowsMatrix w * Q
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rfl

name: Submission.GramSchmidtTriangular.rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed_matrixRows_mul
statement:
theorem rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed_matrixRows_mul
    {Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (hQ : Q * Qᵀ = 1)
    (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows (M * Q)))
      = rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows M)) * Q
proof:
:= by
  have hfam : (fun i => matrixRows (M * Q) i)
      = fun i => rowVecIsometry hQ (matrixRows M i) := by
    funext i
    rw [rowVecIsometry_apply]
    exact matrixRows_mul M Q i
  have hstep : ∀ i, gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows (M * Q)) i
      = rowVecIsometry hQ (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows M) i) := by
    intro i
    rw [show (matrixRows (M * Q)) = fun i => rowVecIsometry hQ (matrixRows M i) from hfam]
    exact gramSchmidtNormed_comp_isometry (rowVecIsometry hQ) (matrixRows M) i
  rw [show gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows (M * Q))
      = fun i => WithLp.toLp 2
        ((WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows M) i)) ᵥ* Q) from
    funext hstep]
  exact rowsMatrix_rowVecMap Q (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows M))

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.badTime_lt_one

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.badGap_lt_one

statement:
theorem endpointWeight_badTime_ne_zero (q : BadDomain E) :

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.pairSq_pos
statement: theorem pairSq_pos {d : ℝ × ℝ} (hd : d ≠ 0) : 0 < pairSq d
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord : d.1 ≠ 0 ∨ d.2 ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra h
    push_neg at h
    exact hd (Prod.ext h.1 h.2)
  rcases hcoord with h₁ | h₂
  · exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg (sq_pos_of_ne_zero h₁) (sq_nonneg d.2)
  · exact add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (sq_nonneg d.1) (sq_pos_of_ne_zero h₂)

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.pairCombination_solvePair
statement:
theorem pairCombination_solvePair {d : ℝ × ℝ} (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (y w : E) : pairCombination d (solvePair d y w) = y
proof:
:= by
  have hr : pairSq d ≠ 0 := (pairSq_pos hd).ne'
  unfold pairCombination solvePair
  have hscalar : (pairSq d)⁻¹ * pairSq d = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hr
  have hscalar' : d.1 ^ 2 * (pairSq d)⁻¹ +
      d.2 ^ 2 * (pairSq d)⁻¹ = 1 := by
    rw [← add_mul, mul_comm]
    exact hscalar
  rw [smul_smul, smul_smul]
  unfold pairSq at hscalar hscalar' ⊢
  linear_combination (norm := module) hscalar' • y

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.solvePair_eq_of_pairCombination_eq
statement:
theorem solvePair_eq_of_pairCombination_eq {d : ℝ × ℝ} (hd : d ≠ 0)
    (p : Parameter E) (y : E) (hp : pairCombination d p = y) :
    solvePair d y (freeCoordinate d p) = p
proof:
:= by
  have hr : pairSq d ≠ 0 := (pairSq_pos hd).ne'
  apply Prod.ext
  · dsimp [solvePair, freeCoordinate]
    rw [← hp]
    unfold pairCombination pairSq
    have hscalar : (d.1 ^ 2 + d.2 ^ 2)⁻¹ *
        (d.1 ^ 2 + d.2 ^ 2) = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hr
    have hscalar' : d.1 ^ 2 * (d.1 ^ 2 + d.2 ^ 2)⁻¹ +
        d.2 ^ 2 * (d.1 ^ 2 + d.2 ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := by
      rw [← add_mul, mul_comm]
      exact hscalar
    linear_combination (norm := module) hscalar' • p.1
  · dsimp [solvePair, freeCoordinate]
    rw [← hp]
    unfold pairCombination pairSq
    have hscalar : (d.1 ^ 2 + d.2 ^ 2)⁻¹ *
        (d.1 ^ 2 + d.2 ^ 2) = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hr
    have hscalar' : d.1 ^ 2 * (d.1 ^ 2 + d.2 ^ 2)⁻¹ +
        d.2 ^ 2 * (d.1 ^ 2 + d.2 ^ 2)⁻¹ = 1 := by
      rw [← add_mul, mul_comm]
      exact hscalar
    linear_combination (norm := module) hscalar' • p.2

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.badGap_coe_ne_zero
statement:
theorem badGap_coe_ne_zero (q : BadDomain E) :
    (badGap q : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hmem : badGap q ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨(badGap_pos q).le, badGap_lt_one q⟩
  have := (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff_of_mem_Ico hmem).mp hzero
  exact (badGap_pos q).ne' this

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.badPhase_ne_add_badGap
statement:
theorem badPhase_ne_add_badGap (q : BadDomain E) :
    (badPhase q : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) ≠
      (badPhase q + badGap q : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  rw [AddCircle.coe_add] at h
  have hz : (badGap q : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) = 0 := by
    have h' : (badPhase q : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) + 0 =
        (badPhase q : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) + (badGap q : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := by
      simpa using h
    exact (add_left_cancel h').symm
  exact badGap_coe_ne_zero q hz

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.secantCoefficient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem secantCoefficient_ne_zero (q : BadDomain E) :
    secantCoefficient q ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  circleLift_sub_ne_zero (badPhase_ne_add_badGap q)

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.pairCombination_sub
statement:
theorem pairCombination_sub (a b : ℝ × ℝ) (p : Parameter E) :
    pairCombination (a - b) p =
      pairCombination a p - pairCombination b p
proof:
:= by
  rcases a with ⟨a₁, a₂⟩
  rcases b with ⟨b₁, b₂⟩
  change (a₁ - b₁) • p.1 + (a₂ - b₂) • p.2 =
    (a₁ • p.1 + a₂ • p.2) - (b₁ • p.1 + b₂ • p.2)
  module

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.exists_positive_circleGap
statement:
theorem exists_positive_circleGap {u v : ℝ}
    (huv : (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) ≠ (v : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) :
    ∃ d : ℝ, 0 < d ∧ d < 1 ∧
      ((u + d : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) = (v : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) ∧
      circleLift (u + d) = circleLift v
proof:
:= by
  let a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ) :=
    (v : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) - (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
  obtain ⟨d, hdmem, hdcoe⟩ := AddCircle.eq_coe_Ico a
  have hdne : d ≠ 0 := by
    intro hd0
    apply huv
    have ha0 : a = 0 := by
      rw [← hdcoe, hd0]
      simp
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp (by simpa [a] using ha0)).symm
  have hdpos : 0 < d :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne hdmem.1 (Ne.symm hdne)
  have hquot : (u + d : ℝ) = (v : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := by
    rw [AddCircle.coe_add, hdcoe]
    dsimp [a]
    abel
  refine ⟨d, hdpos, hdmem.2, hquot, ?_⟩
  rw [circleLift_eq_addCircleCartesian,
    circleLift_eq_addCircleCartesian, hquot]

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.secant_equation_of_collision
statement:
theorem secant_equation_of_collision
    (H : ℝ → ℝ → E) (p : Parameter E)
    {s u v : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (hcoll : perturbedTrack H p s u = perturbedTrack H p s v) :
    pairCombination (circleLift u - circleLift v) p =
      rawSecantRhs H s u v
proof:
:= by
  let c := endpointWeight s
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero
    · exact hs0.ne'
    · exact (sub_pos.mpr hs1).ne'
  have hrel : c • (perturbation p u - perturbation p v) =
      -(H s u - H s v) := by
    dsimp [c]
    unfold perturbedTrack at hcoll
    linear_combination (norm := module) hcoll
  rw [pairCombination_sub]
  change perturbation p u - perturbation p v = rawSecantRhs H s u v
  calc
    perturbation p u - perturbation p v =
        c⁻¹ • (c • (perturbation p u - perturbation p v)) := by
      simp [smul_smul, hc]
    _ = c⁻¹ • (-(H s u - H s v)) := congrArg (fun z : E => c⁻¹ • z) hrel
    _ = rawSecantRhs H s u v := by
      unfold rawSecantRhs
      dsimp [c]
      module

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.mem_range_secantBadMap_of_collision
statement:
theorem mem_range_secantBadMap_of_collision
    (H : ℝ → ℝ → E) (hHperiodic : ∀ s, Function.Periodic (H s) 1)
    (p : Parameter E)
    {s u v : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (huv : (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) ≠ (v : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))
    (hcoll : perturbedTrack H p s u = perturbedTrack H p s v) :
    p ∈ Set.range (secantBadMap H)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd0, hd1, hquot, hcircle⟩ := exists_positive_circleGap huv
  obtain ⟨ts, hts⟩ := exists_badTime_eq hs0 hs1
  obtain ⟨td, htd⟩ := exists_badGap_eq hd0 hd1
  let coeff := circleLift u - circleLift v
  have hcoeff : coeff ≠ 0 := circleLift_sub_ne_zero huv
  have heq : pairCombination coeff p = rawSecantRhs H s u v :=
    secant_equation_of_collision H p hs0 hs1 hcoll
  let q : BadDomain E := (((ts, u), td), freeCoordinate coeff p)
  have hsec : secantCoefficient q = coeff := by
    simp only [secantCoefficient, badPhase, badGap, q, htd]
    rw [hcircle]
  have hHcircle : H s (u + d) = H s v := by
    have h := congrArg (hHperiodic s).lift hquot
    simpa only [Function.Periodic.lift_coe] using h
  have hrhs : secantRhs H q = rawSecantRhs H s u v := by
    simp only [secantRhs, rawSecantRhs, badTime, badPhase, badGap, q, hts, htd]
    rw [hHcircle]
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  rw [secantBadMap, hsec, hrhs]
  exact solvePair_eq_of_pairCombination_eq hcoeff p _ heq

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.addCircle_eq_of_perturbedTrack_eq
statement:
theorem addCircle_eq_of_perturbedTrack_eq
    (H : ℝ → ℝ → E) (hHperiodic : ∀ s, Function.Periodic (H s) 1)
    (p : Parameter E)
    (hp : p ∉ Set.range (secantBadMap H))
    {s u v : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (hcoll : perturbedTrack H p s u = perturbedTrack H p s v) :
    (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) = (v : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  by_contra huv
  exact hp (mem_range_secantBadMap_of_collision H hHperiodic p hs0 hs1 huv hcoll)

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.tangent_equation_of_failure
statement:
theorem tangent_equation_of_failure
    (K : ℝ → ℝ → E) (p : Parameter E)
    {s u : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (hfail : K s u + endpointWeight s •
      ((2 * Real.pi) • pairCombination (circleTangent u) p) = 0) :
    pairCombination (circleTangent u) p = rawTangentRhs K s u
proof:
:= by
  let c := endpointWeight s * (2 * Real.pi)
  have hc : c ≠ 0 := by
    apply mul_ne_zero
    · apply mul_ne_zero
      · exact hs0.ne'
      · exact (sub_pos.mpr hs1).ne'
    · exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero
  have hrel : c • pairCombination (circleTangent u) p = -K s u := by
    dsimp [c]
    rw [← smul_smul]
    linear_combination (norm := module) hfail
  calc
    pairCombination (circleTangent u) p =
        c⁻¹ • (c • pairCombination (circleTangent u) p) := by
      simp [smul_smul, hc]
    _ = c⁻¹ • (-K s u) := congrArg (fun z : E => c⁻¹ • z) hrel
    _ = rawTangentRhs K s u := by
      unfold rawTangentRhs
      dsimp [c]
      module

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.mem_range_tangentBadMap_of_failure
statement:
theorem mem_range_tangentBadMap_of_failure
    (K : ℝ → ℝ → E) (p : Parameter E)
    {s u : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (hfail : K s u + endpointWeight s •
      ((2 * Real.pi) • pairCombination (circleTangent u) p) = 0) :
    p ∈ Set.range (tangentBadMap K)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ts, hts⟩ := exists_badTime_eq hs0 hs1
  let coeff := circleTangent u
  have hcoeff : coeff ≠ 0 := circleTangent_ne_zero u
  have heq : pairCombination coeff p = rawTangentRhs K s u :=
    tangent_equation_of_failure K p hs0 hs1 hfail
  let q : BadDomain E := (((ts, u), 0), freeCoordinate coeff p)
  have htangent : circleTangent (badPhase q) = coeff := by rfl
  have hrhs : tangentRhs K q = rawTangentRhs K s u := by
    simp only [tangentRhs, rawTangentRhs, badTime, badPhase, q, hts]
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  rw [tangentBadMap, htangent, hrhs]
  exact solvePair_eq_of_pairCombination_eq hcoeff p _ heq

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.tangent_ne_zero_of_avoids_range
statement:
theorem tangent_ne_zero_of_avoids_range
    (K : ℝ → ℝ → E) (p : Parameter E)
    (hp : p ∉ Set.range (tangentBadMap K))
    {s u : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) :
    K s u + endpointWeight s •
      ((2 * Real.pi) • pairCombination (circleTangent u) p) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hfail
  exact hp (mem_range_tangentBadMap_of_failure K p hs0 hs1 hfail)

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_badTime
statement: theorem contDiff_badTime : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (badTime : BadDomain E → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold badTime
  exact (contDiff_sigmoid.of_le (by simp)).comp
    contDiff_fst.fst.fst

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_badPhase
statement: theorem contDiff_badPhase : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (badPhase : BadDomain E → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold badPhase
  fun_prop

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_badGap
statement: theorem contDiff_badGap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (badGap : BadDomain E → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold badGap
  exact (contDiff_sigmoid.of_le (by simp)).comp
    contDiff_fst.snd

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_secantCoefficient
statement:
theorem contDiff_secantCoefficient :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (secantCoefficient : BadDomain E → ℝ × ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold secantCoefficient
  exact (contDiff_circleLift.comp contDiff_badPhase).sub
    (contDiff_circleLift.comp (contDiff_badPhase.add contDiff_badGap))

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_circleTangent
statement: theorem contDiff_circleTangent : ContDiff ℝ ∞ circleTangent
proof:
:= by
  exact (Real.contDiff_sin.comp
    (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)).neg.prodMk
      (Real.contDiff_cos.comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id))

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_secantRhs
statement:
theorem contDiff_secantRhs (H : ℝ → ℝ → E)
    (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => H p.1 p.2)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (secantRhs H : BadDomain E → E)
proof:
:= by
  unfold secantRhs
  have hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : BadDomain E => endpointWeight (badTime q)) :=
    contDiff_endpointWeight.comp contDiff_badTime
  have hwinv : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : BadDomain E => (endpointWeight (badTime q))⁻¹) :=
    hw.inv fun q => endpointWeight_badTime_ne_zero q
  have hleft : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : BadDomain E => H (badTime q) (badPhase q)) :=
    hH.comp (contDiff_badTime.prodMk contDiff_badPhase)
  have hright : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : BadDomain E =>
        H (badTime q) (badPhase q + badGap q)) :=
    hH.comp (contDiff_badTime.prodMk (contDiff_badPhase.add contDiff_badGap))
  exact hwinv.neg.smul (hleft.sub hright)

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_tangentRhs
statement:
theorem contDiff_tangentRhs (K : ℝ → ℝ → E)
    (hK : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => K p.1 p.2)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tangentRhs K : BadDomain E → E)
proof:
:= by
  unfold tangentRhs
  have hden : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : BadDomain E => endpointWeight (badTime q) * (2 * Real.pi)) :=
    (contDiff_endpointWeight.comp contDiff_badTime).mul contDiff_const
  have hden0 : ∀ q : BadDomain E,
      endpointWeight (badTime q) * (2 * Real.pi) ≠ 0 := fun q =>
    mul_ne_zero (endpointWeight_badTime_ne_zero q)
      (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) Real.pi_ne_zero)
  have hinv := hden.inv hden0
  have hfield : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : BadDomain E => K (badTime q) (badPhase q)) :=
    hK.comp (contDiff_badTime.prodMk contDiff_badPhase)
  exact hinv.neg.smul hfield

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_solvePair_comp
statement:
theorem contDiff_solvePair_comp
    (d : BadDomain E → ℝ × ℝ) (y w : BadDomain E → E)
    (hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ d) (hy : ContDiff ℝ ∞ y)
    (hw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w) (hd0 : ∀ q, d q ≠ 0) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q => solvePair (d q) (y q) (w q))
proof:
:= by
  unfold solvePair pairSq
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q => (d q).1 ^ 2 + (d q).2 ^ 2) :=
    (hd.fst.pow 2).add (hd.snd.pow 2)
  have hr0 : ∀ q, (d q).1 ^ 2 + (d q).2 ^ 2 ≠ 0 := fun q =>
    (pairSq_pos (hd0 q)).ne'
  exact ((hr.inv hr0).smul ((hd.fst.smul hy).sub (hd.snd.smul hw))).prodMk
    ((hr.inv hr0).smul ((hd.snd.smul hy).add (hd.fst.smul hw)))

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_secantBadMap
statement:
theorem contDiff_secantBadMap (H : ℝ → ℝ → E)
    (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => H p.1 p.2)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (secantBadMap H)
proof:
:= by
  exact contDiff_solvePair_comp secantCoefficient (secantRhs H) badFree
    contDiff_secantCoefficient (contDiff_secantRhs H hH) (by unfold badFree; fun_prop)
    secantCoefficient_ne_zero

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_tangentBadMap
statement:
theorem contDiff_tangentBadMap (K : ℝ → ℝ → E)
    (hK : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => K p.1 p.2)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tangentBadMap K)
proof:
:= by
  apply contDiff_solvePair_comp
      (fun q : BadDomain E => circleTangent (badPhase q))
      (tangentRhs K) badFree
  · exact contDiff_circleTangent.comp contDiff_badPhase
  · exact contDiff_tangentRhs K hK
  · unfold badFree
    fun_prop
  · intro q
    exact circleTangent_ne_zero _

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.finrank_badDomain_lt_parameter
statement:
theorem finrank_badDomain_lt_parameter
    (hE : 4 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E) :
    Module.finrank ℝ (BadDomain E) < Module.finrank ℝ (Parameter E)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [BadDomain, Parameter, Module.finrank_prod, Module.finrank_self]
  omega

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingFourier.exists_parameter_avoiding_badRanges
statement:
theorem exists_parameter_avoiding_badRanges
    (H K : ℝ → ℝ → E)
    (hH : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => H p.1 p.2))
    (hK : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => K p.1 p.2))
    (hE : 4 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E)
    {U : Set (Parameter E)} (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hUne : U.Nonempty) :
    ∃ p ∈ U,
      p ∉ Set.range (secantBadMap H) ∧
      p ∉ Set.range (tangentBadMap K)
proof:
:= by
  let f : Fin 2 → BadDomain E → Parameter E := fun i =>
    if i = 0 then secantBadMap H else tangentBadMap K
  have hf : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (f i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [f] using (contDiff_secantBadMap H hH).of_le (by simp)
    · simpa [f] using (contDiff_tangentBadMap K hK).of_le (by simp)
  obtain ⟨p, hpU, hp⟩ := exists_mem_open_avoid_iUnion_range f hf
    (finrank_badDomain_lt_parameter hE) hUopen hUne
  refine ⟨p, hpU, hp 0, ?_⟩
  simpa [f] using hp 1

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SlotMatch.ambient_circlePoint
statement:
theorem ambient_circlePoint (M : SlotMatch V W) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    (M.ambient h2).forward 1 (CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V h2 O a) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint W h2 (M.orbitEquiv O) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [ambient, SmoothAmbientIsotopy.translation_forward_endpoint]
  unfold shift CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint CanonicalRoundOrbit.center
  rw [M.slot_eq O]
  module

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SlotMatch.ambient_target
statement:
theorem ambient_target (M : SlotMatch V W) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    (M.ambient h2).forward 1 '' CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 O =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target W h2 (M.orbitEquiv O)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a, (M.ambient_circlePoint h2 O a).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V h2 O a, ⟨a, rfl⟩,
      M.ambient_circlePoint h2 O a⟩

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SlotMatch.ambient_targetUnion
statement:
theorem ambient_targetUnion (M : SlotMatch V W) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) :
    (M.ambient h2).forward 1 '' CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2 =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion W h2
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion] at hy ⊢
    obtain ⟨O, hyO⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨M.orbitEquiv O, ?_⟩
    have himage : (M.ambient h2).forward 1 y ∈
        (M.ambient h2).forward 1 '' CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 O :=
      ⟨y, hyO, rfl⟩
    rwa [M.ambient_target h2 O] at himage
  · intro hx
    rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion] at hx
    obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    let O : V.OrbitIndex := M.orbitEquiv.symm P
    have hxP' : x ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.target W h2 (M.orbitEquiv O) := by
      simpa [O] using hxP
    rw [← M.ambient_target h2 O] at hxP'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hxP'
    refine ⟨y, ?_, hyx⟩
    rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨O, hy⟩

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SlotMatch.pullback_fiber_eq_targetUnion
statement:
theorem pullback_fiber_eq_targetUnion (M : SlotMatch V W) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)

name: Submission.SaddleCriticalExteriorArc.exists_pos_lt_dist_center
statement:
theorem exists_pos_lt_dist_center
    (A : SaddleCriticalExteriorArc endpoint
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice C center) p q) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ u : I, ε < dist (A.toPath u) center
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) := Set.range A.toPath
  have hK : IsCompact K := by
    simpa [K] using isCompact_univ.image A.toPath.continuous
  have hdisjoint : Disjoint K ({center} : Set
      (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxK hxcenter
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hxK
    exact (A.mem_exterior u).2.2 (by simpa using hxcenter)
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hsep⟩ :=
    exists_pos_forall_lt_edist hK isClosed_singleton hdisjoint
  refine ⟨(r : ℝ), by exact_mod_cast hr, ?_⟩
  intro u
  have h := hsep (A.toPath u) ⟨u, rfl⟩ center (by simp)
  rw [edist_nndist] at h
  exact_mod_cast h

name: Submission.SaddleCriticalExteriorArc.exists_chartRadius_lt_dist_center
statement:
theorem exists_chartRadius_lt_dist_center
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (A : SaddleCriticalExteriorArc endpoint
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice C center) p q) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < T.radius ∧
      ∀ u : I, r < dist (A.toPath u) center
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hdist⟩ := A.exists_pos_lt_dist_center
  let r : ℝ := min ε T.radius / 2
  have hmin : 0 < min ε T.radius := lt_min hε T.radius_pos
  have hr : 0 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  have hrε : r < ε := by
    dsimp [r]
    have hle := min_le_left ε T.radius
    linarith
  have hrradius : r < T.radius := by
    dsimp [r]
    have hle := min_le_right ε T.radius
    linarith
  exact ⟨r, hr, hrradius, fun u => hrε.trans (hdist u)⟩

name: Submission.SaddleCriticalExteriorArc.exists_chartRadius_path_disjoint_paramBall
statement:
theorem exists_chartRadius_path_disjoint_paramBall
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (A : SaddleCriticalExteriorArc endpoint
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice C center) p q) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < T.radius ∧
      ∀ s : I, ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖u‖ < r → A.toPath s ≠ M.param u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hdist⟩ := A.exists_pos_lt_dist_center
  have hzero : ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ < T.radius := by
    simpa using T.radius_pos
  have hcont : ContinuousAt M.param 0 :=
    (T.param_differentiableAt 0 hzero).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨eta, heta, hclose⟩ :=
    (Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont) (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  let r : ℝ := min T.radius eta / 2
  have hmin : 0 < min T.radius eta := lt_min T.radius_pos heta
  have hr : 0 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  have hrradius : r < T.radius := by
    dsimp [r]
    have hle := min_le_left T.radius eta
    linarith
  have hre : r < eta := by
    dsimp [r]
    have hle := min_le_right T.radius eta
    linarith
  refine ⟨r, hr, hrradius, ?_⟩
  intro s u hu heq
  have hueta : dist u 0 < eta := by
    rw [dist_zero_right]
    exact hu.trans hre
  have hp := hclose hueta
  have hpcenter : dist (M.param u) center < ε / 2 := by
    simpa [M.param_zero] using hp
  rw [← heq] at hpcenter
  have hs := hdist s
  linarith

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.nonempty_saddlePositiveLedgerMove_of_canonicalGeometry
statement:
theorem nonempty_saddlePositiveLedgerMove_of_canonicalGeometry
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hpositive : D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (G : D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeCanonicalGeometry
          t ht hpositive hindex ⊕
        D.ChronologicalSaddleSplitCanonicalGeometry
          t ht hpositive hindex) :
    Nonempty (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData
      D.signedOutput D.position t ht)
proof:
:=

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_const_mul_left
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_const_mul_left (g : SOGroup r)
    (γ : C(I, SOGroup r)) (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (ContinuousMap.const I g * γ) (by
      change g * γ 0 = g * γ 1
      rw [hγ]) =
      loopClassZ2 γ hγ
proof:
:= by
  rw [loopClassZ2_mul (ContinuousMap.const I g) γ rfl hγ]
  simp

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_mul_const_right
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_mul_const_right
    (γ : C(I, SOGroup r)) (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) (g : SOGroup r) :
    loopClassZ2 (γ * ContinuousMap.const I g) (by
      change γ 0 * g = γ 1 * g
      rw [hγ]) =
      loopClassZ2 γ hγ
proof:
:= by
  rw [loopClassZ2_mul γ (ContinuousMap.const I g) hγ rfl]
  simp

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_const_conj
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_const_conj (g : SOGroup r)
    (γ : C(I, SOGroup r)) (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) :
    loopClassZ2
        ((ContinuousMap.const I g * γ) * ContinuousMap.const I g⁻¹)
        (by
          change (g * γ 0) * g⁻¹ = (g * γ 1) * g⁻¹
          rw [hγ]) =
      loopClassZ2 γ hγ
proof:
:= by
  rw [loopClassZ2_mul_const_right]
  exact loopClassZ2_const_mul_left g γ hγ

name: Submission.tubeClockwiseAngle_winding
statement:
theorem tubeClockwiseAngle_winding (k : ℕ) :
    tubeClockwiseAngle k 1 = tubeClockwiseAngle k 0 +
      2 * Real.pi * (-(k : ℤ))
proof:
:= by
  change -(2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * (1 : ℝ)) =
    -(2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * (0 : ℝ)) +
      2 * Real.pi * (-(k : ℤ))
  push_cast
  ring

name: Submission.tubeClockwiseLoop_closed
statement:
theorem tubeClockwiseLoop_closed (r k : ℕ) :
    tubeClockwiseLoop r k 0 = tubeClockwiseLoop r k 1
proof:
:=
  so2Loop_closed r (tubeClockwiseAngle k) (-(k : ℤ))
    (by simpa only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast] using
      tubeClockwiseAngle_winding k)

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_tubeClockwiseLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_tubeClockwiseLoop (hr : 3 ≤ r) (k : ℕ) :
    loopClassZ2 (tubeClockwiseLoop r k) (tubeClockwiseLoop_closed r k) =
      (k : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  calc
    loopClassZ2 (tubeClockwiseLoop r k) (tubeClockwiseLoop_closed r k) =
        ((-(k : ℤ) : ℤ) : ZMod 2) :=
      loopClassZ2_so2_winding hr (tubeClockwiseAngle k) (-(k : ℤ))
        (by simpa only [Int.cast_neg, Int.cast_natCast] using
          tubeClockwiseAngle_winding k) _
    _ = (k : ZMod 2) := by
      push_cast
      exact ZMod.neg_eq_self_mod_two (k : ZMod 2)

name: Submission.tubeInitialSO_mul_apply
statement:
lemma tubeInitialSO_mul_apply
    (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    ((tubeInitialSO m : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) * A) i j =
      if i = 0 then -A 1 j else if i = 1 then A 0 j else A i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (1 : Fin (m + 3))]
    · simp [tubeInitialSO_apply]
    · intro c _ hc
      simp_all [tubeInitialSO_apply]
    · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ (1 : Fin (m + 3))) h
  · rw [if_neg hi0]
    by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0 : Fin (m + 3))]
      · simp [tubeInitialSO_apply]
      · intro c _ hc
        simp_all [tubeInitialSO_apply]
      · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin (m + 3))) h
    · rw [if_neg hi1]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
      · simp [tubeInitialSO_apply, hi0, hi1]
      · intro c _ hc
        simp [tubeInitialSO_apply, hi0, hi1, hc]
      · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) h

name: Submission.mul_tubeInitialSO_transpose_apply
statement:
lemma mul_tubeInitialSO_transpose_apply
    (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    (A * (tubeInitialSO m : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)ᵀ) i j =
      if j = 0 then -A i 1 else if j = 1 then A i 0 else A i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (1 : Fin (m + 3))]
    · simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, tubeInitialSO_apply]
    · intro c _ hc
      simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, tubeInitialSO_apply, hc]
    · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ (1 : Fin (m + 3))) h
  · rw [if_neg hj0]
    by_cases hj1 : j = 1
    · subst j
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0 : Fin (m + 3))]
      · simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, tubeInitialSO_apply]
      · intro c _ hc
        simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, tubeInitialSO_apply, hc]
      · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin (m + 3))) h
    · rw [if_neg hj1]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, tubeInitialSO_apply, hj0, hj1]
      · intro c _ hc
        simp [Matrix.transpose_apply, tubeInitialSO_apply, hj0, hj1, hc]
      · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) h

name: Submission.mul_tubeInitialSO_apply
statement:
lemma mul_tubeInitialSO_apply
    (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    (A * (tubeInitialSO m : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)) i j =
      if j = 0 then A i 1 else if j = 1 then -A i 0 else A i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (1 : Fin (m + 3))]
    · simp [tubeInitialSO_apply]
    · intro c _ hc
      by_cases hc0 : c = 0
      · subst c; simp [tubeInitialSO_apply]
      · by_cases hc1 : c = 1
        · exact (hc hc1).elim
        · simp [tubeInitialSO_apply, hc0, hc1]
          intro h
          exact (hc0 h.symm).elim
    · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ (1 : Fin (m + 3))) h
  · rw [if_neg hj0]
    by_cases hj1 : j = 1
    · subst j
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0 : Fin (m + 3))]
      · simp [tubeInitialSO_apply]
      · intro c _ hc
        by_cases hc0 : c = 0
        · exact (hc hc0).elim
        · by_cases hc1 : c = 1
          · subst c; simp [tubeInitialSO_apply]
          · simp [tubeInitialSO_apply, hc0, hc1]
            intro h
            exact (hc1 h.symm).elim
      · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin (m + 3))) h
    · rw [if_neg hj1]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
      · simp [tubeInitialSO_apply, hj0, hj1]
      · intro c _ hc
        by_cases hc0 : c = 0
        · subst c
          simp [tubeInitialSO_apply]
          intro h
          exact (hj1 h).elim
        · by_cases hc1 : c = 1
          · subst c
            simp [tubeInitialSO_apply]
            intro h
            exact (hj0 h).elim
          · simp [tubeInitialSO_apply, hc0, hc1, hc, Ne.symm hc]
      · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ j) h

name: Submission.tubeInitialSO_inv_coe
statement:
lemma tubeInitialSO_inv_coe :
    (((tubeInitialSO m)⁻¹ : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) =
      (tubeInitialSO m : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  let Q := tubeInitialSO m
  have horth :
      (Q : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *
          (Q : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)ᵀ = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).mp
      ((Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp Q.2).1)
  have htrans :
      (Q : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)ᵀ ∈
        Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ := by
    rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
    constructor
    · rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
      exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp horth
    · rw [Matrix.det_transpose]
      exact (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp Q.2).2
  have hmul : Q * ⟨(Q : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)ᵀ, htrans⟩ = 1 :=
    Subtype.ext horth
  have hinv := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hmul
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hinv.symm

name: Submission.sum_two_ite
statement:
lemma sum_two_ite {a b : Fin (m + 3)} (hab : a ≠ b)
    (f g : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ) :
    ∑ x, (if x = a then f x else if x = b then g x else 0) = f a + g b
proof:
:= by
  classical
  calc
    ∑ x, (if x = a then f x else if x = b then g x else 0) =
        ∑ x, ((if x = a then f x else 0) + (if x = b then g x else 0)) := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _
      by_cases hxa : x = a
      · subst x
        simp [hab]
      · simp [hxa]
    _ = f a + g b := by simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Submission.tubeNormalTwistLoop_coe

lemma tubeNormalTwistLoop_coe (t : I) :
    (tubeNormalTwistLoop m k t :

      (tubeInitialSO m : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *
        twistMat m (tubeClockwiseAngle k t) *
          (tubeInitialSO m : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)ᵀ

name: Submission.tubeNormalTwistLoop_apply
statement:
lemma tubeNormalTwistLoop_apply (t : I) (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    (tubeNormalTwistLoop m k t :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) i j =
      if i = 1 then
        (if j = 1 then Real.cos (tubeClockwiseAngle k t)
          else if j = Fin.last (m + 2) then
            -Real.sin (tubeClockwiseAngle k t) else 0)
      else if i = Fin.last (m + 2) then
        (if j = 1 then Real.sin (tubeClockwiseAngle k t)
          else if j = Fin.last (m + 2) then
            Real.cos (tubeClockwiseAngle k t) else 0)
      else if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tubeNormalTwistLoop_coe]
  rw [mul_tubeInitialSO_transpose_apply]
  simp_rw [tubeInitialSO_mul_apply]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0 <;> by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;>
      by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 2) <;>
      simp [twistMat_entries, hj0, hj1, hjl, lastA_ne_zero,
        lastA_ne_one, Ne.symm lastA_ne_zero, Ne.symm lastA_ne_one]
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      by_cases hj0 : j = 0 <;> by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;>
        by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 2) <;>
        simp [twistMat_entries, hj0, hj1, hjl, lastA_ne_zero,
          lastA_ne_one, Ne.symm lastA_ne_zero, Ne.symm lastA_ne_one]
    · by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (m + 2)
      · subst i
        by_cases hj0 : j = 0 <;> by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;>
          by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 2) <;>
          simp [twistMat_entries, hj0, hj1, hjl, lastA_ne_zero,
            lastA_ne_one, Ne.symm lastA_ne_zero, Ne.symm lastA_ne_one]
      · have hi0' : (0 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ i := Ne.symm hi0
        have hi1' : (1 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ i := Ne.symm hi1
        by_cases hj0 : j = 0 <;> by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;>
          by_cases hji : j = i <;>
          simp_all [twistMat_entries]

name: Submission.tubeTangentLoop_coe
statement:
lemma tubeTangentLoop_coe (t : I) :
    (tubeTangentLoop m t :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) =
      rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m 0 (2 * Real.pi * (t : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  change rotBlock (m + 3) (tubeClockwiseAngle 1 t) *
      (tubeInitialSO m : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) = _
  rw [rotBlock_eq_rotAmbient]
  ext i j
  rw [mul_tubeInitialSO_apply, rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply,
    tubeFullFrame_apply, rotAmbient_apply]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases hi1 : i = 1 <;>
    by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (m + 2) <;>
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0 <;> by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;>
    by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 2) <;> by_cases hji : j = i <;>
    simp_all [eq_comm, tubeClockwiseAngle, rotAmbient_apply, Real.sin_neg, Real.cos_neg,
      lastA_ne_zero, lastA_ne_one, Ne.symm lastA_ne_zero,
      Ne.symm lastA_ne_one]

statement:

    tubeFrameModelLoop m k 0 = tubeFrameModelLoop m k 1

name: Submission.tubeNormalTwistLoop_mul_apply
statement:
lemma tubeNormalTwistLoop_mul_apply (t : I)
    (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    ((tubeNormalTwistLoop m k t :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) * A) i j =
      if i = 1 then
        Real.cos (tubeClockwiseAngle k t) * A 1 j -
          Real.sin (tubeClockwiseAngle k t) * A (Fin.last (m + 2)) j
      else if i = Fin.last (m + 2) then
        Real.sin (tubeClockwiseAngle k t) * A 1 j +
          Real.cos (tubeClockwiseAngle k t) * A (Fin.last (m + 2)) j
      else A i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  by_cases hi1 : i = 1
  · subst i
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    simp only [tubeNormalTwistLoop_apply]
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using
      sum_two_ite (m := m) (Ne.symm lastA_ne_one)
        (fun x => Real.cos (tubeClockwiseAngle k t) * A x j)
        (fun x => -(Real.sin (tubeClockwiseAngle k t) * A x j))
  · rw [if_neg hi1]
    by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (m + 2)
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      simp only [tubeNormalTwistLoop_apply]
      simp only [if_neg lastA_ne_one]
      simpa using
        sum_two_ite (m := m) (Ne.symm lastA_ne_one)
          (fun x => Real.sin (tubeClockwiseAngle k t) * A x j)
          (fun x => Real.cos (tubeClockwiseAngle k t) * A x j)
    · rw [if_neg hil]
      simp only [tubeNormalTwistLoop_apply]
      simp [hi1, hil]

name: Submission.tubeFrameLoop_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma tubeFrameLoop_apply (t : I) :
    (tubeFrameLoop m k t : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) =
      rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k (2 * Real.pi * (t : ℝ)))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.tubeFrameLoop_closed
statement: theorem tubeFrameLoop_closed : tubeFrameLoop m k 0 = tubeFrameLoop m k 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [tubeFrameLoop_apply, tubeFrameLoop_apply]
  simp only [Set.Icc.coe_zero, Set.Icc.coe_one, mul_zero, mul_one]
  ext i j
  change tubeFullFrame m k 0 i j = tubeFullFrame m k (2 * Real.pi) i j
  rw [tubeFullFrame_apply, tubeFullFrame_apply]
  have hsin : Real.sin ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) = 0 := by
    convert Real.sin_add_nat_mul_two_pi 0 k using 1 <;> simp <;> ring
  have hcos : Real.cos ((k : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)) = 1 := by
    simpa using Real.cos_nat_mul_two_pi k
  simp [Real.sin_two_pi, Real.cos_two_pi, hsin, hcos]

name: Submission.tubeFrameModelLoop_eq_tubeFrameLoop
statement:
theorem tubeFrameModelLoop_eq_tubeFrameLoop :
    tubeFrameModelLoop m k = tubeFrameLoop m k
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro t
  apply Subtype.ext
  change ((tubeNormalTwistLoop m k t :
      Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *
        (tubeTangentLoop m t :
          Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)) =
    rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k (2 * Real.pi * (t : ℝ)))
  ext i j
  rw [tubeNormalTwistLoop_mul_apply, tubeTangentLoop_coe]
  simp only [rowsMatrix, Matrix.of_apply]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases hi1 : i = 1 <;>
    by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (m + 2) <;>
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0 <;> by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;>
    by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 2) <;> by_cases hji : j = i <;>
    simp_all [eq_comm, tubeClockwiseAngle, tubeFrameLoop, tubeFullFrame_apply,
      Real.sin_neg, Real.cos_neg, lastA_ne_zero, lastA_ne_one,
      Ne.symm lastA_ne_zero, Ne.symm lastA_ne_one]
  all_goals try ring
  all_goals exact Or.inl True.intro

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_tubeFrameModelLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_tubeFrameModelLoop :
    loopClassZ2 (tubeFrameModelLoop m k) (tubeFrameModelLoop_closed m k) =
      (k : ZMod 2) + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hr : 3 ≤ m + 3 := by omega
  have hlast :
      loopClassZ2 (tubeLastPlaneLoop m k) (tubeLastPlaneLoop_closed m k) =
        (k : ZMod 2) := by
    simpa only [tubeLastPlaneLoop] using
      (loopClassZ2_const_conj (swapRotSO m)
      (tubeClockwiseLoop (m + 3) k)
      (tubeClockwiseLoop_closed (m + 3) k)).trans
        (loopClassZ2_tubeClockwiseLoop hr k)
  have hnormal :
      loopClassZ2 (tubeNormalTwistLoop m k)
          (tubeNormalTwistLoop_closed m k) = (k : ZMod 2) := by
    simpa only [tubeNormalTwistLoop] using
      (loopClassZ2_const_conj (tubeInitialSO m)
      (tubeLastPlaneLoop m k) (tubeLastPlaneLoop_closed m k)).trans hlast
  have htangent :
      loopClassZ2 (tubeTangentLoop m) (tubeTangentLoop_closed m) = 1 := by
    simpa only [tubeTangentLoop] using
      (loopClassZ2_mul_const_right
      (tubeClockwiseLoop (m + 3) 1)
      (tubeClockwiseLoop_closed (m + 3) 1) (tubeInitialSO m)).trans
        (by simpa using loopClassZ2_tubeClockwiseLoop hr 1)
  simpa only [tubeFrameModelLoop, hnormal, htangent] using
    loopClassZ2_mul (tubeNormalTwistLoop m k) (tubeTangentLoop m)
      (tubeNormalTwistLoop_closed m k) (tubeTangentLoop_closed m)
      (tubeFrameModelLoop_closed m k)

name: Submission.tubeFrameModelDelta
statement:
theorem tubeFrameModelDelta :
    loopClassZ2 (tubeFrameModelLoop m k) (tubeFrameModelLoop_closed m k) + 1 =
      (k : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [loopClassZ2_tubeFrameModelLoop]
  change (k : ZMod 2) + 1 + 1 = (k : ZMod 2)
  have htwo : (1 + 1 : ZMod 2) = 0 := by decide
  rw [add_assoc, htwo, add_zero]

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_tubeFrameLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_tubeFrameLoop :
    loopClassZ2 (tubeFrameLoop m k) (tubeFrameLoop_closed m k) =
      (k : ZMod 2) + 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (loopClassZ2_congr_fun (tubeFrameLoop_closed m k)
    (tubeFrameModelLoop_closed m k)
    (tubeFrameModelLoop_eq_tubeFrameLoop m k).symm).trans
  exact loopClassZ2_tubeFrameModelLoop m k

name: Submission.tubeFrameDelta
statement:
theorem tubeFrameDelta :
    loopClassZ2 (tubeFrameLoop m k) (tubeFrameLoop_closed m k) + 1 =
      (k : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [loopClassZ2_tubeFrameLoop]
  have htwo : (1 + 1 : ZMod 2) = 0 := by decide
  rw [add_assoc, htwo, add_zero]
