name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.definiteCircleCurve_closed
statement:
theorem definiteCircleCurve_closed (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < T.radius) :
    T.definiteCircleCurve a ha har 0 =
      T.definiteCircleCurve a ha har 1
proof:
:= by
  change M.param (definiteCircleParamCurve a 0) =
    M.param (definiteCircleParamCurve a 1)
  rw [definiteCircleParamCurve_closed]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.minimumSpatialCircle_eq_cases
statement:
theorem minimumSpatialCircle_eq_cases (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (hindex : M.index = .minimum)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < T.radius)
    {u v : I}
    (huv : T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har u =
      T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har v) :
    u = v ∨ (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let thetaU : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)
  let thetaV : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)
  change spacePart (M.definiteCircle a thetaU) =
    spacePart (M.definiteCircle a thetaV) at huv
  have hrad : a < M.radius := har.trans_le T.radius_le
  have htimeU := M.minimumCircle_time hindex
    (theta := thetaU) ha.le hrad
  have htimeV := M.minimumCircle_time hindex
    (theta := thetaV) ha.le hrad
  have hamb : M.definiteCircle a thetaU = M.definiteCircle a thetaV := by
    calc
      M.definiteCircle a thetaU =
          cobSpaceTime (spacePart (M.definiteCircle a thetaU))
            (tcoord (M.definiteCircle a thetaU)) :=
        (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime (spacePart (M.definiteCircle a thetaV))
            (tcoord (M.definiteCircle a thetaV)) := by
        rw [huv, htimeU, htimeV]
      _ = M.definiteCircle a thetaV := spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hmemU : definiteCircleParam a thetaU ∈ ball (0 : E₂) T.radius := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact har
  have hmemV : definiteCircleParam a thetaV ∈ ball (0 : E₂) T.radius := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact har
  have hparam : definiteCircleParam a thetaU =
      definiteCircleParam a thetaV :=
    T.param_injOn hmemU hmemV hamb
  exact definiteCircleParamCurve_eq_cases ha.ne' hparam

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.maximumSpatialCircle_eq_cases
statement:
theorem maximumSpatialCircle_eq_cases (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (hindex : M.index = .maximum)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < T.radius)
    {u v : I}
    (huv : T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har u =
      T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har v) :
    u = v ∨ (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let thetaU : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)
  let thetaV : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)
  change spacePart (M.definiteCircle a thetaU) =
    spacePart (M.definiteCircle a thetaV) at huv
  have hrad : a < M.radius := har.trans_le T.radius_le
  have htimeU := M.maximumCircle_time hindex
    (theta := thetaU) ha.le hrad
  have htimeV := M.maximumCircle_time hindex
    (theta := thetaV) ha.le hrad
  have hamb : M.definiteCircle a thetaU = M.definiteCircle a thetaV := by
    calc
      M.definiteCircle a thetaU =
          cobSpaceTime (spacePart (M.definiteCircle a thetaU))
            (tcoord (M.definiteCircle a thetaU)) :=
        (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime (spacePart (M.definiteCircle a thetaV))
            (tcoord (M.definiteCircle a thetaV)) := by
        rw [huv, htimeU, htimeV]
      _ = M.definiteCircle a thetaV := spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hmemU : definiteCircleParam a thetaU ∈ ball (0 : E₂) T.radius := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact har
  have hmemV : definiteCircleParam a thetaV ∈ ball (0 : E₂) T.radius := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact har
  have hparam : definiteCircleParam a thetaU =
      definiteCircleParam a thetaV :=
    T.param_injOn hmemU hmemV hamb
  exact definiteCircleParamCurve_eq_cases ha.ne' hparam

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.minimumSpatialCircle_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem minimumSpatialCircle_mem_fiber (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (hindex : M.index = .minimum)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2)) (u : I) :
    T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har u ∈
      (T.minimumPositiveSlice a hreg).fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [minimumPositiveSlice, SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber]
  change C.G (cobSpaceTime
    (spacePart (M.definiteCircle a (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))
    (tcoord center + a ^ 2)) = 0
  rw [← M.minimumCircle_time hindex
      (theta := 2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) ha.le
      (har.trans_le T.radius_le),
    spaceTime_spacePart]
  exact M.definiteCircle_fiber ha.le (har.trans_le T.radius_le)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.maximumSpatialCircle_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem maximumSpatialCircle_mem_fiber (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (hindex : M.index = .maximum)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - a ^ 2)) (u : I) :
    T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har u ∈
      (T.maximumNegativeSlice a hreg).fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [maximumNegativeSlice, SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber]
  change C.G (cobSpaceTime
    (spacePart (M.definiteCircle a (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))
    (tcoord center - a ^ 2)) = 0
  rw [← M.maximumCircle_time hindex
      (theta := 2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) ha.le
      (har.trans_le T.radius_le),
    spaceTime_spacePart]
  exact M.definiteCircle_fiber ha.le (har.trans_le T.radius_le)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.minimumSpatialCircle_mem_same_orbit
statement:
theorem minimumSpatialCircle_mem_same_orbit (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (hindex : M.index = .minimum)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.minimumPositiveSlice a hreg)) (u : I) :
    T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har u ∈
      V.orbit (T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply V.continuousMap_mem_orbit (T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har)
  intro v
  exact T.minimumSpatialCircle_mem_fiber hindex a ha har hreg v

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.maximumSpatialCircle_mem_same_orbit
statement:
theorem maximumSpatialCircle_mem_same_orbit (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (hindex : M.index = .maximum)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.maximumNegativeSlice a hreg)) (u : I) :
    T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har u ∈
      V.orbit (T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply V.continuousMap_mem_orbit (T.definiteSpatialCircle a ha har)
  intro v
  exact T.maximumSpatialCircle_mem_fiber hindex a ha har hreg v

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.exists_localMorseParam_injective_radius
statement:
theorem exists_localMorseParam_injective_radius
    {K U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    {χ : SmoothCutoff K U}
    (R : @FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData
      n C ι instι B K U χ)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ R.criticalParameters) :
    ∃ r > 0, r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius ∧
      ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r →
        Injective (fderiv ℝ (R.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param u)
proof:
:= by
  let P := B.chart p.1
  let f := P.cutoffAffineHeight χ R.covector
  let M := R.localMorseNormalForm p hp
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f :=
    P.contDiff_cutoffAffineHeight χ R.covector
  have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (recenter f p.2) 0 :=
    contDiffAt_infty.mp (contDiff_recenter hsmooth p.2).contDiffAt 2
  have hcrit : fderiv ℝ (recenter f p.2) 0 = 0 :=
    fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero
      (nondegenerateCriticalAt_recenter hsmooth
        (R.critical_nondegenerate p hp)).1
  simpa [M, f, P] using
    M.exists_fderiv_param_injective_radius hf hcrit
      (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius_pos

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.nonempty_installedEventEmbeddedShrink
statement:
theorem nonempty_installedEventEmbeddedShrink
    {K U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    {χ : SmoothCutoff K U}
    (R : @FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData
      n C ι instι B K U χ)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ R.criticalParameters) :
    Nonempty ((R.installedStandardMorseEvent p hp).EmbeddedShrink)
proof:
:= by
  let M := R.localMorseNormalForm p hp
  let Q := R.criticalModelShrink p hp
  let P := B.chart p.1
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀, hr₀Q, hMderiv⟩ :=
    R.exists_localMorseParam_injective_radius p hp
  have hJinj : Injective (fderiv ℝ M.param 0) := by
    apply hMderiv 0
    simpa using hr₀
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrr₀, hMinj⟩ :=
    M.exists_param_injOn_ball_of_fderiv_injective hJinj hr₀
  refine ⟨{
    radius := r
    radius_pos := hr
    radius_le := ?_
    param_differentiableAt := ?_
    fderiv_param_injective := ?_
    param_injOn := ?_ }⟩
  · change r ≤ Q.radius
    exact hrr₀.trans hr₀Q
  · intro u hu
    have huQ : ‖u‖ < Q.radius := hu.trans_le (hrr₀.trans hr₀Q)
    have hMdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ M.param u :=
      LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.param_differentiableAt_of_contDiffOn_one
        M Q (by simpa [M, Q] using R.criticalModelShrink_contDiffOn p hp) u huQ
    have hshift : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z : E₂ => p.2 + M.param z) u :=
      differentiableAt_const (c := p.2).add hMdiff
    have hchart : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z : E₂ => P.param (p.2 + M.param z)) u :=
      (P.param_smooth.differentiable (by simp) _).comp u hshift
    change DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun z : E₂ => R.forward.diffeomorph
        (P.param (p.2 + M.param z))) u
    exact (R.forward.diffeomorph.contDiff.differentiable (by simp) _).comp u hchart
  · intro u hu
    have huQ : ‖u‖ < Q.radius := hu.trans_le (hrr₀.trans hr₀Q)
    have hur₀ : ‖u‖ < r₀ := hu.trans_le hrr₀
    let q : E₂ := p.2 + M.param u
    let J : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂ := fderiv ℝ M.param u
    have hMdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ M.param u :=
      LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.param_differentiableAt_of_contDiffOn_one
        M Q (by simpa [M, Q] using R.criticalModelShrink_contDiffOn p hp) u huQ
    have hshift : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E₂ => p.2 + M.param z) J u := by
      simpa [J] using hMdiff.hasFDerivAt.const_add p.2
    have hqdom : q ∈ P.domain :=
      LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.ift_param_mem_domain
        (M := M) Q u huQ
    have hP : Injective (fderiv ℝ P.param q) :=
      P.fderiv_param_injective ((B.domain_open p.1).mem_nhds hqdom)
    have hchart : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E₂ => P.param (p.2 + M.param z))
        ((fderiv ℝ P.param q).comp J) u :=
      (P.param_smooth.differentiable (by simp) q).hasFDerivAt.comp u hshift
    have hout : HasFDerivAt
        (fun z : E₂ => R.forward.diffeomorph
          (P.param (p.2 + M.param z)))
        ((fderiv ℝ R.forward.diffeomorph (P.param q)).comp
          ((fderiv ℝ P.param q).comp J)) u := by
      exact (R.forward.diffeomorph.contDiff.differentiable (by simp)
        (P.param q)).hasFDerivAt.comp u hchart
    change Injective (fderiv ℝ
      (fun z : E₂ => R.forward.diffeomorph
        (P.param (p.2 + M.param z))) u)
    rw [hout.fderiv]
    have hforward : Injective
        (fderiv ℝ R.forward.diffeomorph (P.param q)) := by
      rw [← R.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm]
      exact R.amplitude.fderiv_equiv_symm_injective (P.param q)
    exact hforward.comp (hP.comp (hMderiv u hur₀))
  · intro u hu v hv huv
    apply hMinj hu hv
    have huQ : ‖u‖ < Q.radius := by
      have hur : ‖u‖ < r := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
      exact hur.trans_le (hrr₀.trans hr₀Q)
    have hvQ : ‖v‖ < Q.radius := by
      have hvr : ‖v‖ < r := by
        simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hv
      exact hvr.trans_le (hrr₀.trans hr₀Q)
    have huDom : p.2 + M.param u ∈ P.domain :=
      LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.ift_param_mem_domain
        (M := M) Q u huQ
    have hvDom : p.2 + M.param v ∈ P.domain :=
      LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.ift_param_mem_domain
        (M := M) Q v hvQ
    change R.criticalAmbientParam p hp u =
      R.criticalAmbientParam p hp v at huv
    have hparam : P.param (p.2 + M.param u) =
        P.param (p.2 + M.param v) := by
      have h := congrArg R.forward.diffeomorph.symm huv
      change R.forward.diffeomorph.symm
          (R.forward.diffeomorph (P.param (p.2 + M.param u))) =
        R.forward.diffeomorph.symm
          (R.forward.diffeomorph (P.param (p.2 + M.param v))) at h
      rw [R.forward.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply,
        R.forward.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply] at h
      exact h
    have hshift : p.2 + M.param u = p.2 + M.param v :=
      P.param_injOn_domain huDom hvDom hparam
    exact add_left_cancel hshift

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc
statement:
theorem morseQuadratic_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc
    (b : SaddleBranch) (a c : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .saddle
      (pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc b a c) 0,
        pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc b a c) 1) = -(a ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairToMorseParam_apply_zero, pairToMorseParam_apply_one]
  exact morseQuadratic_saddleNegativeArc b a c

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam
statement:
theorem morseQuadratic_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam
    (b e : SaddleBranch) (ρ a : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .saddle
      (saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a 0,
        saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a 1) = -(a ^ 2)
proof:
:=
  morseQuadratic_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc b a _

name: Submission.saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam_second_sign'
statement:
theorem saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam_second_sign'
    (b e : SaddleBranch) {ρ a : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) :
    0 < signedBranch b (saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hbp := saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)
  have hkey : 0 < a ^ 2 +
      signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 := by
    rw [signedBranch_sq, hbp]
    nlinarith
  rw [saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam, pairToMorseParam_apply_one]
  cases b
  · simpa [saddleNegativeArc, signedBranch] using Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hkey
  · simpa [saddleNegativeArc, signedBranch] using Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hkey

name: Submission.saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam_first_sign'
statement:
theorem saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam_first_sign'
    (b e : SaddleBranch) {ρ a : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) :
    0 < signedBranch e (saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam, pairToMorseParam_apply_zero]
  have hbp_pos : 0 < saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := by
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
    apply div_pos _ (by norm_num)
    linarith
  cases e
  · simpa [saddleNegativeArc, signedBranch] using hbp_pos
  · simpa [saddleNegativeArc, signedBranch] using hbp_pos

name: Submission.norm_saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam_ge_min
statement:
theorem norm_saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam_ge_min
    (b e : SaddleBranch) {ρ a : ℝ} (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = a ^ 2)
    (hsign : 0 < signedBranch b (u 0))
    (hsigne : 0 < signedBranch e (u 1))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (q : I) :
    min ρ ‖u‖ ≤ ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖
proof:
:= by
  have hclass :=
    eq_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_of_signedBranch b a u hquad hsign
  have hstart : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + 2 * (u 1) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖u‖ ^ 2 = ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a (u 1))‖ ^ 2 :=
        congrArg (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ‖z‖ ^ 2) hclass
      _ = a ^ 2 + 2 * (u 1) ^ 2 :=
        norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a (u 1)
  have hend : a ^ 2 +
      2 * signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by
    rw [signedBranch_sq, saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)]
    ring
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := q.property.1
  have hq1 : (q : ℝ) ≤ 1 := q.property.2
  have hcsq : min (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2)
      ((u 1) ^ 2) ≤ saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1)
        (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)) q ^ 2 := by
    have hbp_pos : 0 < saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := by
      apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
      apply div_pos _ (by norm_num)
      linarith
    cases e
    · have hu1 : 0 < u 1 := by simpa [signedBranch] using hsigne
      have hs₁ : signedBranch SaddleBranch.positive
          (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) = saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := rfl
      rw [hs₁]
      rw [saddleAffineCoordinate]
      rcases le_total (u 1) (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) with hle | hle
      · have hlow : u 1 ≤ (1 - (q : ℝ)) * u 1 +
            (q : ℝ) * saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := by nlinarith
        have hmin : min (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a ^ 2) ((u 1) ^ 2) ≤
            (u 1) ^ 2 := min_le_right _ _
        nlinarith
      · have hlow : saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a ≤ (1 - (q : ℝ)) * u 1 +
            (q : ℝ) * saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := by nlinarith
        have hmin : min (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a ^ 2) ((u 1) ^ 2) ≤
            saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a ^ 2 := min_le_left _ _
        nlinarith
    · have hu1 : u 1 < 0 := by
        have h := hsigne
        simp only [signedBranch] at h
        linarith
      have hs₁ : signedBranch SaddleBranch.negative
          (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) = -saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := rfl
      rw [hs₁]
      rw [saddleAffineCoordinate]
      rcases le_total (u 1) (-saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) with hle | hle
      · have hhigh : (1 - (q : ℝ)) * u 1 +
            (q : ℝ) * -saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a ≤
            -saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := by nlinarith
        have hmin : min ((-saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2) ((u 1) ^ 2) ≤
            (-saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 := min_le_left _ _
        nlinarith
      · have hhigh : (1 - (q : ℝ)) * u 1 +
            (q : ℝ) * -saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a ≤ u 1 := by nlinarith
        have hmin : min ((-saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2) ((u 1) ^ 2) ≤
            (u 1) ^ 2 := min_le_right _ _
        nlinarith
  have hnormSq : ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖ ^ 2 =
      a ^ 2 + 2 * saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1)
        (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)) q ^ 2 := by
    change ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a
      (saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1)
        (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)) q))‖ ^ 2 = _
    exact norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a _
  have hminsq : min ρ ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤
      ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖ ^ 2 := by
    rcases le_total ρ ‖u‖ with hle | hle
    · rw [min_eq_left hle]
      have hsq : ρ ^ 2 ≤ ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)
          (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg u) hρ.le)]
      have hs₁u : signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 ≤
          (u 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      rw [min_eq_left hs₁u] at hcsq
      nlinarith
    · rw [min_eq_right hle]
      have hsq : ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)
          (add_nonneg hρ.le (norm_nonneg u))]
      have hs₁u : (u 1) ^ 2 ≤
          signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      rw [min_eq_right hs₁u] at hcsq
      nlinarith
  have hminpos : 0 ≤ min ρ ‖u‖ := le_min hρ.le (norm_nonneg u)
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q)]

name: Submission.norm_saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam_le_max
statement:
theorem norm_saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam_le_max
    (b e : SaddleBranch) {ρ a : ℝ} (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = a ^ 2)
    (hsign : 0 < signedBranch b (u 0))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (q : I) :
    ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖ ≤ max ρ ‖u‖
proof:
:= by
  have hclass :=
    eq_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_of_signedBranch b a u hquad hsign
  have hstart : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + 2 * (u 1) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖u‖ ^ 2 = ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a (u 1))‖ ^ 2 :=
        congrArg (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ‖z‖ ^ 2) hclass
      _ = a ^ 2 + 2 * (u 1) ^ 2 :=
        norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a (u 1)
  have hend : a ^ 2 +
      2 * signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by
    rw [signedBranch_sq, saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)]
    ring
  have hcoord := saddleAffineCoordinate_sq_le (u 1)
    (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)) q
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := q.property.1
  have hq1 : (q : ℝ) ≤ 1 := q.property.2
  have hnormSq : ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖ ^ 2 =
      a ^ 2 + 2 * saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1)
        (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)) q ^ 2 := by
    change ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a
      (saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1)
        (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)) q))‖ ^ 2 = _
    exact norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a _
  have hmaxsq : ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖ ^ 2 ≤
      max ρ ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
    rcases le_total ρ ‖u‖ with hle | hle
    · rw [max_eq_right hle]
      have hsq : ρ ^ 2 ≤ ‖u‖ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)
          (add_nonneg (norm_nonneg u) hρ.le)]
      nlinarith
    · rw [max_eq_left hle]
      have hsq : ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hle)
          (add_nonneg hρ.le (norm_nonneg u))]
      nlinarith
  have hmaxpos : 0 ≤ max ρ ‖u‖ := le_max_of_le_left hρ.le
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q)]

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.negativeBranchOrbitIndex_eq_of_window_merge
statement:
theorem negativeBranchOrbitIndex_eq_of_window_merge
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (hneg : D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .negative =
      D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .positive)
    (Cov : ChronologicalSaddleSmallEndCover D t ht)
    {p₀ q₀ : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch} {B : SaddleArcCutArc Cov p₀ q₀}
    (S : SaddleArcCutScale Cov B)
    (hsσ : S.scale < Cov.sigma) :
    (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
        hindex SaddleBranch.negative Cov.sigma S.scale Cov.sigma_pos
        (by nlinarith [S.scale_pos, Cov.sigma_pos])
        Cov.sigma_lt_embedded (saddleArcCutBeforeTime_regular S)
        (saddleArcCutBeforeField S) =
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
        hindex SaddleBranch.positive Cov.sigma S.scale Cov.sigma_pos
        (by nlinarith [S.scale_pos, Cov.sigma_pos])
        Cov.sigma_lt_embedded (saddleArcCutBeforeTime_regular S)
        (saddleArcCutBeforeField S)
proof:
:= by
  have hsq_σ : S.scale ^ 2 < Cov.sigma ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [S.scale_pos, Cov.sigma_pos]
  have hslab := regularSlab_window_to_saddleArcCutBefore S
  have hsrcI : saddleArcCutBeforeTime S ∈
      Set.Icc (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) (saddleArcCutBeforeTime S) :=
    ⟨window_le_saddleArcCutBeforeTime S, le_rfl⟩
  have htgtI : D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht ∈
      Set.Icc (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) (saddleArcCutBeforeTime S) :=
    ⟨le_rfl, window_le_saddleArcCutBeforeTime S⟩
  have hrhoC_pos := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hrhoC_T := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  have hrhoC_M : D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    hrhoC_T.trans_le (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hs_rhoC : S.scale ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
    saddleArcCutScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq S
  have hfib_s : ∀ bb : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
        bb (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) S.scale) ∈
        SlabTamedField.sliceFiber
          D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
          (saddleArcCutBeforeTime S) := by
    intro bb
    have h := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase_mem_fiber
      hindex bb hrhoC_pos hs_rhoC hrhoC_T (saddleArcCutBeforeTime_regular S)
    rwa [StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeSlice,
      SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber] at h
  have hnegSet : (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit
      (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
        SaddleBranch.negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht))) =
      (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit
      (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
        SaddleBranch.positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht))) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val hneg
  have hwn := saddleArcCut_negativeBase_window_orbit hindex S
    SaddleBranch.negative
  have hwp := saddleArcCut_negativeBase_window_orbit hindex S
    SaddleBranch.positive
  have h1 := (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit_eq_of_mem hwn
  have h2 := (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit_eq_of_mem hwp
  have htransMem : (saddleArcCutBeforeSlabField S).sliceTransport
      (saddleArcCutBeforeTime S) (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
      (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
        SaddleBranch.positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
        S.scale)) ∈
      (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit
        ((saddleArcCutBeforeSlabField S).sliceTransport
          (saddleArcCutBeforeTime S) (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
          (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
            SaddleBranch.negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            S.scale))) := by
    rw [← h1, hnegSet, h2]
    exact (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).mem_orbit_self _
  have hback := (saddleArcCutBeforeSlabField S).sliceTransport_mapsTo_orbit
    hslab htgtI hsrcI (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht)
    (saddleArcCutBeforeField S)
    (p := (saddleArcCutBeforeSlabField S).sliceTransport
      (saddleArcCutBeforeTime S) (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
      (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
        SaddleBranch.negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
        S.scale)))
    (by
      rw [SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber]
      exact (saddleArcCutBeforeSlabField S).sliceTransport_mapsTo hslab
        hsrcI htgtI (hfib_s SaddleBranch.negative))
    htransMem
  rw [(saddleArcCutBeforeSlabField S).sliceTransport_leftInverse hslab
      hsrcI htgtI (hfib_s SaddleBranch.positive),
    (saddleArcCutBeforeSlabField S).sliceTransport_leftInverse hslab
      hsrcI htgtI (hfib_s SaddleBranch.negative)] at hback
  
  have hbase_mem : ∀ bb : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
        bb Cov.sigma S.scale) ∈
        (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit
          (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
            bb (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) S.scale)) := by
    intro bb
    have h := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeParam_mem_branch_orbit_full
      (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) hindex bb
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) S.scale
      (saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam bb SaddleBranch.negative Cov.sigma
        S.scale)
      (morseQuadratic_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam bb
        SaddleBranch.negative Cov.sigma S.scale)
      (saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam_second_sign' bb SaddleBranch.negative
        Cov.sigma_pos hsq_σ)
      hrhoC_pos hs_rhoC
      (by
        rw [norm_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam bb SaddleBranch.negative
          Cov.sigma_pos hsq_σ]
        exact Cov.sigma_lt_embedded.trans_le
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le)
      hrhoC_M (saddleArcCutBeforeTime_regular S)
      (saddleArcCutBeforeField S)
    have hb : (D.position.eventModel t ht).param
        (saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam bb SaddleBranch.negative Cov.sigma
          S.scale) =
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
          bb Cov.sigma S.scale := by
      simp [StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeBranchBase,
        StandardMorseEventAt.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd,
        StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint]
    rwa [hb] at h
  apply Subtype.ext
  show (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit
      (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
        SaddleBranch.negative Cov.sigma S.scale)) =
    (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit
      (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
        SaddleBranch.positive Cov.sigma S.scale))
  calc
    (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit
        (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
          SaddleBranch.negative Cov.sigma S.scale)) =
        (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit
          (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
            SaddleBranch.negative
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) S.scale)) :=
      (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit_eq_of_mem
        (hbase_mem SaddleBranch.negative)
    _ = (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit
          (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
            SaddleBranch.positive
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) S.scale)) :=
      ((saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit_eq_of_mem hback).symm
    _ = (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit
          (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchBase
            SaddleBranch.positive Cov.sigma S.scale)) :=
      ((saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit_eq_of_mem
        (hbase_mem SaddleBranch.positive)).symm

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleMergeTargetOrbit_mem_exterior
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleMergeTargetOrbit_mem_exterior
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (Htop : D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeTopology t ht hindex)
    (O : (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex)
    (hO : (O : Set Eₐ) ∈
      D.chronologicalSaddleMergeExteriorTargetFamily t ht hindex) :
    (O : Set Eₐ) ∈ D.chronologicalExteriorOrbitCollection t ht
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
proof:
:= by
  have hneNegative : (O : Set Eₐ) ≠
      ((D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .negative :
        (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set Eₐ) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hO.2
  have hbranches :
      ((D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .negative :
        (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set Eₐ) =
      ((D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .positive :
        (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set Eₐ) :=
    congrArg (fun Q : (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex =>
      (Q : Set Eₐ)) Htop.positive_eq
  have hnePositive : (O : Set Eₐ) ≠
      ((D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .positive :
        (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set Eₐ) := by
    intro h
    exact hneNegative (h.trans hbranches.symm)
  exact D.chronologicalSaddleAfterOrbit_mem_exterior_of_ne_branches
    t ht hindex O hnePositive hneNegative

statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleMergeReverseMidpointCapture
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (Htop : D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeTopology t ht hindex) :
    D.ChronologicalSaddleReverseMidpointCapture t ht
      (D.chronologicalSaddleMergeExteriorTargetFamily t ht hindex)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  intro O q
  apply D.chronologicalExteriorSlabReverseMidpoint_mem_halfCriticalCore t ht
  · let P := D.chronologicalAfterField t ht
        |>.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam O.1
    apply D.chronologicalOrbitPoint_mem_exteriorSlabCore
      t ht (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
      ⟨(D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht).1.le,
        (D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht).2.le⟩
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
      (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht) O.1
    · rw [(D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O.1]
      exact P.curve_mem_orbit q
    · apply D.chronologicalSaddleMergeTargetOrbit_mem_exterior
        t ht hindex Htop O.1
      exact ((D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).mem_selectedOrbitFinset O.1).mp O.2
  · simp [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.exteriorAmbientLoop]

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleReverseTargetOrbit_mem_positive
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleReverseTargetOrbit_mem_positive
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (A : Set (Set Eₐ))
    (hmidpoint : D.ChronologicalSaddleReverseMidpointCapture t ht A)
    (O : {O // O ∈ (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset A})
    (hsourcePositive : (O.1 : Set Eₐ) ∈
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveCollection t ht) :
    D.chronologicalSaddleReverseTargetOrbit t ht A hmidpoint O ∈
      (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
        (D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeCollection t ht)
proof:
:= by
  let H := D.chronologicalSaddleReverseExteriorFlowCore t ht A hmidpoint
  let eSource := D.chronologicalSaddleReverseSourceEquiv t ht A
  let eTarget := D.chronologicalSaddleReverseTargetOrbitEquiv t ht
  let OH := eSource O
  let Q := eTarget.symm (H.targetOrbit OH)
  let Vneg := D.chronologicalAfterField t ht
  let Vpos := D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht
  let Sneg := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
  let Spos := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)
  change Q ∈ Vpos.selectedOrbitFinset (Spos.positiveOrbitCollection Vpos)
  have hsourceSign : 0 < Sneg (Vneg.orbitPoint O.1) :=
    (Sneg.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff Vneg O.1).mp hsourcePositive
  let P := Vneg.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam O.1
  let p := P.exteriorAmbientLoop 0
  have hpEq : p = cobSpaceTime (Vneg.orbitPoint O.1)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) := by
    change cobSpaceTime (P.curve 0) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) = _
    rw [P.curve_zero]
    rfl
  have hstartSign : 0 < D.signedOutput p := by
    rw [hpEq]
    exact hsourceSign
  have hpFiber : H.C.G p = 0 := P.exteriorAmbientLoop_fiber 0
  have hsourceLoop : (H.negativeParam OH).exteriorAmbientLoop 0 = p := by
    change cobSpaceTime
        ((D.chronologicalSaddleReverseSourceField t ht
          |>.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam OH.1).curve 0)
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) -
          -(D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2)) =
      cobSpaceTime (P.curve 0) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
    apply congrArg₂ cobSpaceTime
    · change
        ((Vneg.transport
          (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)
            |>.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam OH.1).curve 0) = P.curve 0
      calc
        _ = (Vneg.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam
              (((Vneg.selectedOrbitTransportEquiv
                (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)
                A).symm OH).1)).curve 0 :=
          Vneg.transportedIntrinsicCurve_symm
            (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht) A OH 0
        _ = P.curve 0 := by
          have hO : (Vneg.selectedOrbitTransportEquiv
              (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht) A).symm OH = O := by
            change eSource.symm OH = O
            exact eSource.symm_apply_apply O
          rw [hO]
    · exact D.chronologicalReverseAfterTime_eq t ht
  have hthrough : 0 < D.signedOutput (H.R.base.flow p (2 * H.ε)) :=
    D.compactTimeTamedField_flow_positive H.R hpFiber hstartSign _
  have hdouble : H.R.base.flow p (2 * H.ε) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.R.base.flow p H.ε) H.ε := by
    simpa [two_mul] using
      (congrFun (H.R.base.flow_shift p H.ε) H.ε).symm
  have hcore : H.coreLoop OH 0 = H.R.base.flow p H.ε := by
    change H.R.base.flow ((H.negativeParam OH).exteriorAmbientLoop 0) H.ε = _
    rw [hsourceLoop]
  have hendSign : 0 < D.signedOutput
      (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH 0) H.ε) := by
    rw [hcore, ← hdouble]
    exact hthrough
  have hendEq : cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH 0) H.ε := by
    calc
      cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
          (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) =
          cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0) (H.t + H.ε) :=
        congrArg₂ cobSpaceTime rfl
          (D.chronologicalReverseBeforeTime_eq t ht).symm
      _ = H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH 0) H.ε := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time OH 0]
        exact spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hbaseSign : 0 < Spos (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
    change 0 < D.signedOutput (cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht))
    rw [hendEq]
    exact hendSign
  have hpositiveFiber : H.positiveCurve OH 0 ∈
      (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice t ht).fiber := by
    rw [chronologicalBeforeSlice, SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber]
    change D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
        (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)) = 0
    rw [hendEq]
    exact H.R.flow_mem_fiber (H.coreLoop_fiber OH 0) H.ε
  have htargetSet : (Q : Set Eₐ) =
      Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
    calc
      (Q : Set Eₐ) = (H.targetOrbit OH : Set Eₐ) := by
        change ((((Vpos.orbitIndexTransportEquiv
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)).symm
            (H.targetOrbit OH)) : Vpos.OrbitIndex) : Set Eₐ) = _
        exact Vpos.orbitIndexTransportEquiv_symm_val
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)
          (H.targetOrbit OH)
      _ = H.Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := H.targetOrbit_coe OH
      _ = Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
        change (Vpos.transport
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)).orbit
            (H.positiveCurve OH 0) = Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
        exact Vpos.transport_orbit
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)
          (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
  have htargetPoint : Vpos.orbitPoint Q ∈
      Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
    rw [← htargetSet, Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit]
    exact Vpos.mem_orbit_self _
  have htargetSign : 0 < Spos (Vpos.orbitPoint Q) :=
    (Spos.pos_iff_of_mem_orbit Vpos hpositiveFiber htargetPoint).mp hbaseSign
  apply (Vpos.mem_selectedOrbitFinset Q).mpr
  exact (Spos.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff Vpos Q).mpr htargetSign

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleMergeReverseTargetOrbit_mem_positive
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleMergeReverseTargetOrbit_mem_positive
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (Htop : D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeTopology t ht hindex)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleMergeReverseTargetMap_injective
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleMergeReverseTargetMap_injective
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (Htop : D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeTopology t ht hindex)
    (hnoncollision : D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeReverseNoncollision
      t ht hindex Htop) :
    Function.Injective (D.chronologicalSaddleMergeReverseTargetMap
      t ht hindex Htop hnoncollision)
proof:
:= by
  intro O P hOP
  let A := D.chronologicalSaddleMergeExteriorTargetFamily t ht hindex
  let hm := D.chronologicalSaddleMergeReverseMidpointCapture t ht hindex Htop
  let H := D.chronologicalSaddleReverseExteriorFlowCore t ht A hm
  let eSource := D.chronologicalSaddleReverseSourceEquiv t ht A
  let eTarget := D.chronologicalSaddleReverseTargetOrbitEquiv t ht
  have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hOP
  change eTarget.symm (H.targetOrbit (eSource O)) =
    eTarget.symm (H.targetOrbit (eSource P)) at hval
  apply eSource.injective
  apply H.targetOrbit_injective
  exact eTarget.symm.injective hval

statement:
theorem signedCobordismDeltaInvariant_of_valueSeparatedPositiveMoves
    (positive : ∀ {X Y : FramedLevelSet n}
      {S : FiberSign X} {T : FiberSign Y}
      (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
      (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage C)

      D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
          (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters →
        Nonempty
          (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData
            D.signedOutput D.position t ht)) :
    SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant n where
  eq_of_nonempty
proof:
:= by
    intro X Y S T hC

name: Submission.signedCobordismDeltaInvariant_of_valueSeparatedIndexedPositiveMoves
statement:
theorem signedCobordismDeltaInvariant_of_valueSeparatedIndexedPositiveMoves
    (minimum : ∀ {X Y : FramedLevelSet n}
      {S : FiberSign X} {T : FiberSign Y}
      (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
      (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage C)
      (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes),
      D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
          (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters →
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .minimum →
        Nonempty
          (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData
            D.signedOutput D.position t ht))
    (saddle : ∀ {X Y : FramedLevelSet n}
      {S : FiberSign X} {T : FiberSign Y}
      (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
      (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage C)
      (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes),
      D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
          (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters →
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle →
        Nonempty
          (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData
            D.signedOutput D.position t ht))
    (maximum : ∀ {X Y : FramedLevelSet n}
      {S : FiberSign X} {T : FiberSign Y}
      (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
      (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage C)
      (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes),
      D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
          (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters →
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .maximum →
        Nonempty
          (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData
            D.signedOutput D.position t ht)) :
    SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant n
proof:
:=
  signedCobordismDeltaInvariant_of_valueSeparatedPositiveMoves
    fun C D t ht hpositive => by
      cases hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index with
      | minimum => exact minimum C D t ht hpositive hindex
      | saddle => exact saddle C D t ht hpositive hindex
      | maximum => exact maximum C D t ht hpositive hindex

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.critical_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem critical_nondegenerate (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ criticalParameters R) :
    NondegenerateCriticalAt
      ((B.chart p.1).cutoffAffineHeight χ R.covector) p.2
proof:
:= by
  let P := B.chart p.1
  have hzero : P.cutoffAffineGradient χ (R.covector, p.2) = 0 :=
    critical_gradient_eq_zero R p hp
  have hgood := R.morseOn p.1 p.2 (critical_mem_core R p hp)
  change P.cutoffAffineGradient χ (R.covector, p.2) ≠ 0 ∨
    Bijective (P.cutoffAffineHessian χ (R.covector, p.2)) at hgood
  have hbij : Bijective (P.cutoffAffineHessian χ (R.covector, p.2)) := by
    rcases hgood with hne | hbij
    · exact (hne hzero).elim
    · exact hbij
  constructor
  · rw [← P.cutoffAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient]
    exact hzero
  · rw [← P.cutoffAffineHessian_eq_fderiv_chartGradient]
    exact hbij

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.critical_model
statement:
theorem critical_model (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ criticalParameters R)
    (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < (criticalNormalForm R p hp).radius) :
    (criticalAmbientParam R p hp u ∈ timeCritical (output R).G ↔
      u = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let P := B.chart p.1
  let f := P.cutoffAffineHeight χ R.covector
  let M := localMorseNormalForm R p hp
  let S := criticalModelShrink R p hp
  let z : E₂ := p.2 + M.param u
  have huS : ‖u‖ < S.radius := by simpa [S, criticalNormalForm] using hu
  have hdom : P.domain ∈ nhds z := by
    exact LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.ift_domain_mem_nhds
      (M := M) S (B.domain_open p.1) u huS
  have hgradient : chartGradient f z = 0 ↔ u = 0 := by
    exact LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.chartGradient_shifted_param_eq_zero_iff_of_contDiffOn_one
        M S
        ((P.contDiff_cutoffAffineHeight χ R.covector).differentiable
          infty_ne_zero)
        (critical_nondegenerate R p hp).1
        (criticalModelShrink_contDiffOn R p hp) u huS
  change R.forward.diffeomorph (P.param z) ∈
      timeCritical
        ((R.forward.inverse R.twice_K_lt_one).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G ↔
    u = 0
  calc
    R.forward.diffeomorph (P.param z) ∈
          timeCritical
            ((R.forward.inverse R.twice_K_lt_one).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
        ↔ P.cutoffAffineGradient χ (R.covector, z) = 0 :=
          P.forwardParam_mem_inversePullback_timeCritical_iff_cutoffGradient_eq_zero
            χ R.covector R.forward R.forward_toFun R.twice_K_lt_one hdom
    _ ↔ chartGradient f z = 0 := by
      rw [P.cutoffAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient]
    _ ↔ u = 0 := hgradient

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.covers_fiber
statement:
theorem covers_fiber (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ criticalParameters R) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ v : E',
      dist v (center R p) < ε →
      (output R).G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < (criticalNormalForm R p hp).radius ∧
        criticalAmbientParam R p hp u = v
proof:
:= by
  let P := B.chart p.1
  let f := P.cutoffAffineHeight χ R.covector
  let M := localMorseNormalForm R p hp
  let S := criticalModelShrink R p hp
  let a := amplitude R
  let x : E' := P.param p.2
  let c : E' := center R p
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f :=
    P.contDiff_cutoffAffineHeight χ R.covector
  have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (recenter f p.2) 0 :=
    contDiffAt_infty.mp (contDiff_recenter hsmooth p.2).contDiffAt 2
  have hcrit : fderiv ℝ (recenter f p.2) 0 = 0 :=
    fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero
      (nondegenerateCriticalAt_recenter hsmooth
        (critical_nondegenerate R p hp)).1
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hM⟩ := M.exists_preimage_norm_lt hf hcrit S.radius_pos
  have hpdom : p.2 ∈ P.domain :=
    B.core_subset_domain p.1 (critical_mem_core R p hp)
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hP⟩ :=
    P.exists_param_of_fiber_near (B.domain_open p.1) hpdom
      (ball_mem_nhds p.2 hδ)
  have hac : a.diffeomorph c = x := by
    have haeq : a.diffeomorph = R.forward.diffeomorph.symm := by
      simpa [a] using amplitude_diffeomorph R
    rw [haeq]
    dsimp [c, x, center]
    exact R.forward.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply _
  have htendsto : Tendsto (fun v : E' => a.diffeomorph v)
      (nhds c) (nhds x) := by
    rw [← hac]
    exact a.diffeomorph.continuous.continuousAt
  have hnear : (fun v : E' => a.diffeomorph v) ⁻¹' ball x ε₀ ∈ nhds c :=
    htendsto (ball_mem_nhds x hε₀)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnear
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hzero
  have hvball : v ∈ ball c ε := by
    simpa [mem_ball, c] using hv
  have haBall : a.diffeomorph v ∈ ball x ε₀ := hball hvball
  have haDist : dist (a.diffeomorph v) (P.param p.2) < ε₀ := by
    simpa [mem_ball, x] using haBall
  have haZero : C.G (a.diffeomorph v) = 0 := by
    simpa [output, VerticalAmplitude.pullback_G,
      SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply, a] using hzero
  obtain ⟨z, hzball, _hzdom, hzparam⟩ :=
    hP (a.diffeomorph v) haDist haZero
  have hy : ‖z - p.2‖ < δ := by
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hzball
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hMu⟩ := hM (z - p.2) hy
  refine ⟨u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [criticalNormalForm, S] using hu
  · change R.forward.diffeomorph (P.param (p.2 + M.param u)) = v
    rw [← amplitude_diffeomorph_symm R]
    calc
      a.diffeomorph.symm (P.param (p.2 + M.param u)) =
          a.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z) := by
            congr 2
            rw [hMu, add_sub_cancel]
      _ = a.diffeomorph.symm (a.diffeomorph v) := by rw [hzparam]
      _ = v := a.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply v

name: Submission.fderiv_const_add_morseQuadratic_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_const_add_morseQuadratic_apply
    (e : MorseIndexTwo) (c : ℝ) (u w : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => c + morseQuadratic e (z 0, z 1)) u w =
      morseHessianPairing e u w
proof:
:= by
  let p0 : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  have h0 := (p0.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt p0 p0 u).pow 2
  have h1 := (p1.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt p1 p1 u).pow 2
  have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun _ : E₂ => c) (0 : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) u :=
    hasFDerivAt_const c u
  cases e with
  | minimum =>
      have h := hc.add (h0.add h1)
      change HasFDerivAt
        (fun z : E₂ => c + (z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2)) _ u at h
      change (fderiv ℝ
        (fun z : E₂ => c + (z 0 ^ 2 + z 1 ^ 2)) u) w = _
      rw [h.fderiv]
      simp [morseHessianPairing, p0, p1]
      ring
  | saddle =>
      have h := hc.add (h0.sub h1)
      change HasFDerivAt
        (fun z : E₂ => c + (z 0 ^ 2 - z 1 ^ 2)) _ u at h
      change (fderiv ℝ
        (fun z : E₂ => c + (z 0 ^ 2 - z 1 ^ 2)) u) w = _
      rw [h.fderiv]
      simp [morseHessianPairing, p0, p1]
      ring
  | maximum =>
      have h := hc.add (h0.neg.sub h1)
      change HasFDerivAt
        (fun z : E₂ => c + (-(z 0 ^ 2) - z 1 ^ 2)) _ u at h
      change (fderiv ℝ
        (fun z : E₂ => c + (-(z 0 ^ 2) - z 1 ^ 2)) u) w = _
      rw [h.fderiv]
      simp [morseHessianPairing, p0, p1]
      ring

    (e : MorseIndexTwo) (c : ℝ) (v w : E₂) :

        (fun u : E₂ =>
          fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => c + morseQuadratic e (z 0, z 1)) u w)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficient_ne_zero
statement:
theorem criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficient_ne_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficient p hp ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let C' := R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C
  let center := R.criticalCenter p
  let c := R.criticalDefiniteCokernelVector p hp
  let L := fderiv ℝ C'.G center
  let A := spatialDeriv C'.G center
  intro htime
  have hcenter : center ∈ timeCritical C'.G :=
    R.criticalCenter_mem_timeCritical p hp
  have hsurj : Surjective L := C'.regular center hcenter.1
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hsurj c
  have hadjoint : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A c = 0 := by
    exact adjoint_spatialDeriv_criticalOutputCokernelVector
      C' center hcenter
  have hdecomp :
      L z = A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec := by
    calc
      L z = L (cobSpaceTime (spacePart z) (tcoord z)) := by
        rw [spaceTime_spacePart]
      _ = L (spaceInclL (spacePart z) + tcoord z • timeVec) := by
        rw [spaceTime_eq]
      _ = A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec := by
        rw [map_add, map_smul]
        rfl
  have hspace : ⟪c, A (spacePart z)⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left, hadjoint, inner_zero_left]
  have htime' : ⟪c, tcoord z • L timeVec⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    rw [real_inner_smul_right]
    change tcoord z * R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficient p hp = 0
    rw [htime, mul_zero]
  have hself : ⟪c, c⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    calc
      ⟪c, c⟫_ℝ = ⟪c, L z⟫_ℝ := by rw [hz]
      _ = ⟪c, A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec⟫_ℝ := by rw [hdecomp]
      _ = 0 := by rw [inner_add_right, hspace, htime', add_zero]
  exact (R.criticalDefiniteCokernelVector_ne_zero p hp)
    (inner_self_eq_zero.mp hself)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficientAt_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficientAt_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficientAt p hp 0 =
      R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficient p hp
proof:
:= by
  simp [criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficientAt,
    criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficient]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.inner_criticalDefiniteNormalMap_criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent
statement:
theorem inner_criticalDefiniteNormalMap_criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (w : E₂) :
    ⟪R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap p hp u,
      R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent p hp u w⟫_ℝ =
      -(fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ =>
          G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 +
            morseQuadratic (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index (z 0, z 1))
        u w * R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficientAt p hp u)
proof:
:= by
  let C' := R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C
  let Φ := R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp
  let c := R.criticalDefiniteCokernelVector p hp
  let z := fderiv ℝ Φ u w
  let A := spatialDeriv C'.G (Φ u)
  let L := fderiv ℝ C'.G (Φ u)
  have hzero : L z = 0 := by
    exact R.fderiv_criticalSurfaceParam_mem_ker p hp u hu w
  have hdecomp :
      A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec = 0 := by
    calc
      A (spacePart z) + tcoord z • L timeVec =
          L (spaceInclL (spacePart z) + tcoord z • timeVec) := by
            rw [map_add, map_smul]
            rfl
      _ = L (cobSpaceTime (spacePart z) (tcoord z)) := by
            rw [spaceTime_eq]
      _ = L z := by rw [spaceTime_spacePart]
      _ = 0 := hzero
  have hspatial : A (spacePart z) = -(tcoord z • L timeVec) :=
    eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hdecomp
  have htime := R.fderiv_criticalSurfaceParam_time_apply p hp u hu w
  have hmodel := congrArg (fun D : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => D w)
    (R.fderiv_criticalSurfaceParam_time p hp u hu)
  calc
    ⟪R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap p hp u,
        R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent p hp u w⟫_ℝ =
        ⟪c, A (spacePart z)⟫_ℝ := by
          exact ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left A (spacePart z) c
    _ = ⟪c, -(tcoord z • L timeVec)⟫_ℝ := by rw [hspatial]
    _ = -(tcoord z * ⟪c, L timeVec⟫_ℝ) := by
          rw [inner_neg_right, real_inner_smul_right]
    _ = -(fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ =>
          G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 +
            morseQuadratic (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index (z 0, z 1))
        u w * R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficientAt p hp u) := by
          congr 1
          rw [← htime, hmodel]
          rfl

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.inner_criticalDefiniteNormalLinearization_surfaceTangent_zero
statement:
theorem inner_criticalDefiniteNormalLinearization_surfaceTangent_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (v w : E₂) :
    ⟪R.criticalDefiniteNormalLinearization p hp v,
      R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent p hp 0 w⟫_ℝ =
      -(morseHessianPairing
          (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index v w *
        R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficient p hp)
proof:
:= by
  let Φ := R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp
  let e := (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index
  let c₀ := G.localSeparatedTime p p.2
  let qdiff : E₂ → ℝ := fun u =>
    fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => c₀ + morseQuadratic e (z 0, z 1)) u w
  let k : E₂ → ℝ := R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficientAt p hp
  let pair : E₂ → ℝ := R.criticalNormalTangentPairing p hp w
  have hΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Φ 0 :=
    R.criticalSurfaceParam_contDiffAt_zero p hp
  have hDΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ Φ) 0 :=
    hΦ.fderiv_right (by simp)
  have htangentCD : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent p hp · w) 0 := by
    have heval : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun u => fderiv ℝ Φ u w) 0 :=
      hDΦ.clm_apply contDiffAt_const
    have hproj := (criticalSpacePartCLM (n := n)).contDiff.contDiffAt.comp 0 heval
    simpa [criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent, Φ, Function.comp_def] using hproj
  have htangent : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent p hp · w) 0 :=
    htangentCD.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hnormal : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap p hp) 0 :=
    R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap_differentiableAt_zero p hp
  have hleft :
      fderiv ℝ pair 0 v =
        ⟪R.criticalDefiniteNormalLinearization p hp v,
          R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent p hp 0 w⟫_ℝ := by
    change fderiv ℝ (fun u =>
      ⟪R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap p hp u,
        R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent p hp u w⟫_ℝ) 0 v = _
    rw [fderiv_inner_apply ℝ hnormal htangent v]
    simp [criticalDefiniteNormalLinearization]
  have hqeq : qdiff = morseHessianPairingLeft e w := by
    funext u
    exact fderiv_const_add_morseQuadratic_apply e c₀ u w
  have hq : DifferentiableAt ℝ qdiff 0 := by
    rw [hqeq]
    exact (morseHessianPairingLeft e w).differentiableAt
  have hqzero : qdiff 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hqeq]
    cases e <;> simp [morseHessianPairing]
  have hqderiv : fderiv ℝ qdiff 0 v = morseHessianPairing e v w := by
    exact fderiv_morseDifferential_apply e c₀ v w
  have hkCD : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ k 0 := by
    let C' := R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C
    have hDG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ C'.G) := contDiff_fderivCLM C'.smooth
    have hcomp : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun u => fderiv ℝ C'.G (Φ u)) 0 :=
      hDG.contDiffAt.comp 0 hΦ
    have heval : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun u => fderiv ℝ C'.G (Φ u) timeVec) 0 :=
      hcomp.clm_apply contDiffAt_const
    have hinner := (contDiffAt_const : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun _u : E₂ => R.criticalDefiniteCokernelVector p hp) 0).inner ℝ heval
    change ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun u : E₂ =>
      ⟪R.criticalDefiniteCokernelVector p hp,
        fderiv ℝ C'.G (Φ u) timeVec⟫_ℝ) 0
    exact hinner
  have hk : DifferentiableAt ℝ k 0 := hkCD.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hkzero : k 0 = R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficient p hp := by
    exact R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficientAt_zero p hp
  have hevent :
      pair =ᶠ[nhds 0] fun u => -(qdiff u * k u) := by
    have hball : Metric.ball (0 : E₂) (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius ∈
        nhds 0 := Metric.ball_mem_nhds 0
          (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius_pos
    filter_upwards [hball] with u hu
    have hu' : ‖u‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
    exact R.inner_criticalDefiniteNormalMap_criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent
      p hp u hu' w
  have hright :
      fderiv ℝ (fun u => -(qdiff u * k u)) 0 v =
        -(morseHessianPairing e v w *
          R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficient p hp) := by
    have hderiv := (hq.hasFDerivAt.mul hk.hasFDerivAt).neg.fderiv
    change (fderiv ℝ (-(qdiff * k)) 0) v = _
    rw [hderiv]
    simp only [neg_apply, smul_apply, hqzero, zero_smul, zero_add,
      hqderiv, hkzero]
    ring
  have hfdEq := congrArg (fun D : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => D v) hevent.fderiv_eq
  rw [hleft] at hfdEq
  rw [hright] at hfdEq
  exact hfdEq

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent_zero_tangent_eq
statement:
theorem criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent_zero_tangent_eq
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (theta : ℝ) :
    R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent p hp 0
        (definiteCircleTangentParam 1 theta) =
      R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp 0 theta
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : definiteCircleParam 0 theta = (0 : E₂) := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp
  rw [criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent, criticalDefiniteUnitTangent, hzero]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.inner_criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero_radial_minimum
statement:
theorem inner_criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero_radial_minimum
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    (theta : ℝ) :
    ⟪R.criticalDefiniteNormalRow p hp 0 theta,
      R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent p hp theta⟫_ℝ =
      -(2 * R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficient p hp)
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero p hp theta]
  unfold criticalDefiniteRadialTangent
  rw [R.inner_criticalDefiniteNormalLinearization_surfaceTangent_zero
    p hp (definiteCircleParam 1 theta) (definiteCircleParam 1 theta), hindex]
  simp

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.inner_criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero_radial_minimum_ne_zero
statement:
theorem inner_criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero_radial_minimum_ne_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)

      R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent p hp theta⟫_ℝ ≠ 0
proof:

  exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num)
    (R.criticalDefiniteTimeNormalCoefficient_ne_zero p hp))

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.inner_criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero_radial_maximum_ne_zero

    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
