name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_rebasedSplitBandMarking_of_marking
statement:
theorem exists_rebasedSplitBandMarking_of_marking
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hflowlt : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 < eps / 2)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord center - s ^ 2 → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (hcap : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) center →
      spacePart (R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s)
          (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex p.1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hne : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos ≠
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos)
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg) Vneg)
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3)
    (hpoint : ∀ l : Fin 4, A.point l =
      spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s))
    (hsort0 : A.sortedMark 0 = 0)
    (hcut0 : A.cyclicCutRange 0 =
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hcut2 : A.cyclicCutRange 2 =
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hother : ∀ r : Fin 4, r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 → ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(s ^ 2) → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ∉ A.cyclicCutRange r)
    (hafterOrbit : Vneg.orbitPoint
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg) ∈ Vneg.orbit P.p) :
    ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
      ∃ F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregpos hregneg Vpos Vneg
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos)
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos)
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg),
        F.dbefore = s ^ 2 ∧ F.dafter = -(s ^ 2) ∧ F.afterCut₃ = 1 ∧
        F.afterParam = P ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) F.afterCut₀ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        F.afterParam.curve 1 ∈
          Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) (-(-(s ^ 2)))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) (-(-(s ^ 2)))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) (-(-(s ^ 2)))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s)
            (-(-(s ^ 2))))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hρM : ρ < M.radius := hρrad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have habs : |s ^ 2| = s ^ 2 := abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg s)
  have habsn : |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| = s ^ 2 := by rw [abs_neg, habs]
  
  have e1c : ((1 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (1 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e1s : ((1 : Fin 3).succ) = (2 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e2c : ((2 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (2 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e2s : ((2 : Fin 3).succ) = (3 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e0c : ((0 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (0 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e0s : ((0 : Fin 3).succ) = (1 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have elast : (Fin.last 3) = (3 : Fin 4) := by decide
  
  have hcutFib : ∀ (r : Fin 4) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
      y ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      C.G (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) = 0 := by
    intro r y hy
    rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r] at hy
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact A.cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w
  
  have hcutFar : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), y ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) center := by
    intro r hr0 hr2 y hy
    have h : eps ≤ dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) center := by
      refine le_dist_center_of_saddleChart_avoid (w := -(s ^ 2)) hindex hρM
        hcover (hcutFib r y hy) (by rw [tcoord_spaceTime]; ring) ?_
      intro u hquad hnorm hEq
      rw [spacePart_spaceTime] at hEq
      exact hother r hr0 hr2 u hquad hnorm (hEq ▸ hy)
    linarith
  
  have hmarkAmb : ∀ l : Fin 4,
      cobSpaceTime (A.point l) (tcoord center - s ^ 2) =
        M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s := by
    intro l
    have htX : tcoord (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s) =
        tcoord center - s ^ 2 :=
      M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hρ hs hρM
    rw [hpoint l, ← htX, spaceTime_spacePart]
  
  have hlabelOrbit : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 → ∀ l : Fin 4,
      A.point l ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime (A.point l) (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
        (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos :
          Vpos.OrbitIndex) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro r hr0 hr2 l hl
    have hfar := hcutFar r hr0 hr2 _ hl
    rw [hmarkAmb l] at hfar ⊢
    exact hcap (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l) hfar
  have hmemEq : ∀ {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
      {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}, x = y → y ∈ S → x ∈ S :=
    fun h hy => h ▸ hy
  
  have hlabelEq : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).1 =
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).1 := by
    intro r hr0 hr2
    by_contra hlab
    have hsrcMem : A.point (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r := by
      rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]
      exact ⟨0, (A.cyclicCutPath r).source⟩
    have htgtMem : A.point (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r := by
      rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]
      exact ⟨1, (A.cyclicCutPath r).target⟩
    have hO := orbitIndex_eq_of_slabFlowFamily
      (R := R) (eps := eps) (dbefore := s ^ 2) (dafter := -(s ^ 2))
      (tbefore := tcoord center + s ^ 2)
      (tafter := tcoord center - s ^ 2)
      (hbefore := hregpos) (Vbefore := Vpos)
      (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).toContinuousMap
      (fun w => A.cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w)
      (fun w => by
        show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (A.cyclicCutPath r w)
          (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) = tcoord center - s ^ 2
        rw [tcoord_spaceTime])
      (fun w => by
        have h := hcutFar r hr0 hr2 (A.cyclicCutPath r w)
          (by rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]; exact ⟨w, rfl⟩)
        rw [habsn]
        exact h)
      hunit rfl (by ring) (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe)
      (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe)
      (O := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).1 ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregpos Vpos)
      (O' := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).1 ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregpos Vpos)
      (w := 0) (w' := 1)
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))))
          (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).source)
        (hlabelOrbit r hr0 hr2 _ hsrcMem))
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))))
          (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).target)
        (hlabelOrbit r hr0 hr2 _ htgtMem))
    apply hne
    rcases hp : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).1 with
      _ | _ <;>
      rcases hq : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).1 with
        _ | _ <;> rw [hp, hq] at hO hlab
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
    · exact hO.symm
    · exact hO
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
  
  have hsrcLab1 : A.cyclicCutSourceLabel 1 = A.sortedLabel 1 := by
    rw [← e1c]
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
  have htgtLab1 : A.cyclicCutTargetLabel 1 = A.sortedLabel 2 := by
    rw [← e1c, ← e1s]
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
  have hsrcLab3 : A.cyclicCutSourceLabel (Fin.last 3) =
      A.sortedLabel (Fin.last 3) := by
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_last]
  have htgtLab3 : A.cyclicCutTargetLabel (Fin.last 3) = A.sortedLabel 0 := by
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_last]
  rw [elast] at hsrcLab3 htgtLab3
  have hlabels :
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).1 ≠
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3)).1 := by
    intro hEq
    have h1 := hlabelEq 1 (by decide) (by decide)
    have h3 := hlabelEq 3 (by decide) (by decide)
    rw [hsrcLab1, htgtLab1] at h1
    rw [hsrcLab3, htgtLab3] at h3
    refine saddleFourLabel_fst_not_constant
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).1
      (A.sortedLabel 1) (A.sortedLabel 2) (A.sortedLabel 3) (A.sortedLabel 0)
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      rfl h1.symm hEq.symm ?_
    rw [← h3, ← hEq]
  refine ⟨_, _, hlabels, ?_⟩
  
  have hin₁ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) q) ∈
      A.cyclicCutRange 1 := by
    intro q
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (1 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e1c, e1s] at h
    exact h
  have hin₂ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) q) ∈
      A.cyclicCutRange 3 := by
    intro q
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_last_mem_cyclicCutRange q
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  
  have hcomp₁ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 2) (A.sortedMark 3) q) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro q
    rw [← hcut2]
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (2 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e2c, e2s] at h
    exact h
  have hcomp₀ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) (A.sortedMark 1) q) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro q
    rw [← hcut0]
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (0 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e0c, e0s, hsort0] at h
    exact h
  have hcurveMark : ∀ i : Fin 4, P.curve (A.sortedMark i) =
      A.point (A.sortedLabel i) := fun i => A.curve_mark (A.sortedLabel i)
  have hzeroMark : P.curve 1 = A.point (A.sortedLabel 0) := by
    have h := hcurveMark 0
    rw [hsort0] at h
    rw [← P.curve_closed]
    exact h
  have hcompEnd : P.curve 1 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    rw [← hcut0, hzeroMark, ← hcurveMark 0]
    have h := A.curve_sortedMark_castSucc_mem (0 : Fin 3)
    rw [e0c] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨hne₁, hz₁, ho₁⟩ := A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (1 : Fin 3)
  rw [e1c, e1s] at hne₁ hz₁ ho₁
  have hlastne : A.sortedMark 3 ≠ 1 := by
    have h := A.sortedMark_ne_one (Fin.last 3)
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  have hlastnz : A.sortedMark 3 ≠ 0 := by
    have h := A.sortedMark_last_ne_zero
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  have hzeroone : (0 : I) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Subtype.val h
    norm_num at this
  
  have hinj₁ : Function.Injective
      (fun q : I =>
        P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) q)) :=
    injective_curve_convexComb P hne₁ hz₁ ho₁
  have hinj₂ : Function.Injective
      (fun q : I => P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) q)) :=
    injective_curve_convexComb P hlastne (by rintro ⟨h, -⟩; exact hlastnz h)
      (by rintro ⟨-, h⟩; exact hzeroone h.symm)
  
  have hstep : ∀ (r : Fin 4) (a b : I), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      (∀ q : I, P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb a b q) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r) →
      (∀ q : I, R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) (-(-(s ^ 2))) ∈
        criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
          (tcoord center) (eps / 2)) := by
    intro r a b hr0 hr2 hmem q
    have hfib : C.G (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) = 0 :=
      sliceAmbientSubarc_mem_fiber P a b q
    have htime : tcoord (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) =
        tcoord center - s ^ 2 := by
      show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb a b q))
        (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) = _
      rw [tcoord_spaceTime]
    have hfar : eps / 2 + (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| ≤
        dist (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) center := by
      rw [habsn]
      exact hcutFar r hr0 hr2 _ (hmem q)
    exact slabFlowBack_mem_core (R := R) hunit (by ring)
      (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe) hfib htime hfar
  have hcore₁ := hstep 1 (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) (by decide)
    (by decide) hin₁
  have hcore₂ := hstep 3 (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) (by decide) (by decide) hin₂
  
  have hhit₁ : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2)
      (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2)) 0 ∈
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    have hval : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2)
        (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2)) 0 =
        spacePart (R.base.flow
          (cobSpaceTime (A.point (A.sortedLabel 1)) (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
          (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) := by
      rw [transportedSubarc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero]
      exact congrArg (fun y => spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))))
        (hcurveMark 1)
    refine hmemEq hval ?_
    have hmemcut : A.point (A.sortedLabel 1) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange 1 := by
      rw [← hcurveMark 1]
      have h := A.curve_sortedMark_castSucc_mem (1 : Fin 3)
      rw [e1c] at h
      exact h
    exact hlabelOrbit 1 (by decide) (by decide) _ hmemcut
  have hhit₂ : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
      (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2)) 0 ∈
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3)).1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    have hval : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
        (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2)) 0 =
        spacePart (R.base.flow
          (cobSpaceTime (A.point (A.sortedLabel 3)) (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
          (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) := by
      rw [transportedSubarc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero]
      exact congrArg (fun y => spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))))
        (hcurveMark 3)
    refine hmemEq hval ?_
    have hmemcut : A.point (A.sortedLabel 3) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange 3 := by
      rw [← hcurveMark 3]
      have h := A.curve_sortedMark_last_mem_last
      rw [elast] at h
      exact h
    exact hlabelOrbit 3 (by decide) (by decide) _ hmemcut
  refine ⟨SaddleFlowBandMarking.ofAfterArcsFreeBefore (s ^ 2) (-(s ^ 2))
      (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe) (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe) P hafterOrbit
      (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
      hcore₁ hcore₂
      (coreTime_criticalSliceExteriorCore_split C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (eps / 2) s)
      hinj₁ hinj₂ (orbitPoint_mem_orbit_of_mem hhit₁)
      (orbitPoint_mem_orbit_of_mem hhit₂),
    rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, hcomp₁, hcomp₀, hcompEnd, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow
      (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) 0)
      (-(-(s ^ 2))) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hcurveMark 1, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 2), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow
      (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) 1)
      (-(-(s ^ 2))) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hcurveMark 2, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) 0)
      (-(-(s ^ 2))) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hcurveMark 3, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 0), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) 1)
      (-(-(s ^ 2))) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hzeroMark, hmarkAmb]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_rebasedSplitBandMarking
statement:
theorem exists_rebasedSplitBandMarking
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hflowlt : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 < eps / 2)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord center - s ^ 2 → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (hcap : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) center →
      spacePart (R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s)
          (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex p.1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hne : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos ≠
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos)
    (heq : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg =
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg) :
    ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
      ∃ F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregpos hregneg Vpos Vneg
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos)
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos)
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg),
        F.dbefore = s ^ 2 ∧ F.dafter = -(s ^ 2) ∧ F.afterCut₃ = 1 ∧
        F.afterParam =
          T.saddleNegativeRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) F.afterCut₀ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        F.afterParam.curve 1 ∈
          Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) (-(-(s ^ 2)))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) (-(-(s ^ 2)))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) (-(-(s ^ 2)))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s)
            (-(-(s ^ 2))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcut0, hcut2, hother⟩ :=
    T.saddleNegativeRebased_exteriorCuts hindex hρ hb hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq
  obtain ⟨hsort0, -, -⟩ :=
    T.saddleNegativeRebased_structure hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq
  refine T.exists_rebasedSplitBandMarking_of_marking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos
    hregneg Vpos Vneg R hsafe hflowlt hcover hunit hcap hne
    (T.saddleNegativeRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq)
    (T.saddleNegativeRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq)
    (fun l => rfl) hsort0 hcut0 hcut2 hother ?_
  have hbase :
      (T.saddleNegativeRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq).p =
        T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad 0 := rfl
  rw [hbase, Vneg.orbit_eq_of_mem
    (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_mem_commonParamOrbit hindex ρ s hρ hs
      hρrad hregneg Vneg heq .negative 0)]
  exact Vneg.mem_orbit_self _

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniPTMiddle.transverseValue_nonempty
statement: theorem transverseValue_nonempty : Nonempty (TransverseValue m hm)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨y, hypos, hy8, -, hreg⟩ :=
    exists_small_regular_value (n := m + 2) (by omega)
      (sphereHomotopy m hm).contDiff_horizontal
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mp (ne_of_gt hypos)
  exact ⟨{
    target := y
    target_ne_zero := hy0
    target_norm_lt_one := hy8.trans (by norm_num)
    regular := hreg
    norm_pos := hypos
    norm_lt_eighth := hy8
  }⟩

name: Submission.continuous_matrixRows_family
statement:
theorem continuous_matrixRows_family
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] {m : ℕ}
    {M : P → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ} (hM : Continuous M)
    (i : Fin m) :
    Continuous fun p => matrixRows (M p) i
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : Continuous fun p => M p i :=
    (continuous_apply i).comp hM
  unfold matrixRows
  change Continuous (WithLp.toLp 2 ∘ fun p => M p i)
  exact (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 (fun _ : Fin m => ℝ)).comp hrow

name: Submission.positiveMatrixSOMap_eq_of_eq
statement:
theorem positiveMatrixSOMap_eq_of_eq
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] {m : ℕ}
    (M : C(P, Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))

name: Submission.positiveMatrixSOHomotopy_closed
statement:
theorem positiveMatrixSOHomotopy_closed
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] {m : ℕ}
    {M₀ M₁ : C(P, Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)}
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy M₀ M₁)
    (hdet₀ : ∀ p, 0 < (M₀ p).det)
    (hdet₁ : ∀ p, 0 < (M₁ p).det)
    (hdetH : ∀ q, 0 < (H q).det)
    {p q : P} (hpq : ∀ s : I, H (s, p) = H (s, q)) (s : I) :
    positiveMatrixSOHomotopy H hdet₀ hdet₁ hdetH (s, p) =
      positiveMatrixSOHomotopy H hdet₀ hdet₁ hdetH (s, q)
proof:
:= by
  exact matrixGramSchmidtSO_congr (hpq s)

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixHomotopy_congr
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixHomotopy_congr
    {m : ℕ}
    {M₀ M₁ : C(I, Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)}
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy M₀ M₁)
    (hdet₀ : ∀ p, 0 < (M₀ p).det)
    (hdet₁ : ∀ p, 0 < (M₁ p).det)
    (hdetH : ∀ q, 0 < (H q).det)
    (hclosed₀ : M₀ 0 = M₀ 1)
    (hclosed₁ : M₁ 0 = M₁ 1)
    (hclosedH : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1)) :
    loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap M₀ hdet₀)
        (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed M₀ hdet₀ hclosed₀) =
      loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap M₁ hdet₁)
        (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed M₁ hdet₁ hclosed₁)
proof:
:= by
  exact loopClassZ2_congr
    (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed M₀ hdet₀ hclosed₀)
    (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed M₁ hdet₁ hclosed₁)
    (positiveMatrixSOHomotopy H hdet₀ hdet₁ hdetH)
    (positiveMatrixSOHomotopy_closed H hdet₀ hdet₁ hdetH hclosedH)

      (field m : TamedField (G.transform X)).orbitFrameClass O' =

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.gauge_of_orbitGaugeLoop
statement:
theorem gauge_of_orbitGaugeLoop (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (G : SmoothSOGauge (m + 2))
    (L : LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (O : (field m : TamedField X).OrbitIndex)
    (hL : L.loop = G.orbitGaugeLoop (field m) O) :
    ∃ O' : (field m :
        TamedField (X.gaugeTransform G.clm G.contDiff_clm G.bijective_clm)).OrbitIndex,
      (field m : TamedField
            (X.gaugeTransform G.clm G.contDiff_clm G.bijective_clm)).orbitFrameClass O' =
        (field m : TamedField X).orbitFrameClass O +
          loopClassZ2 L.loop L.closed
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨O', hO'⟩ := orbitFrameClass_gaugeTransform m hm X G O
  refine ⟨O', hO'.trans ?_⟩
  congr 1
  exact (loopClassZ2_congr_fun L.closed
    (G.orbitGaugeLoop_closed (field m) O) hL).symm

      ∃ O' : (field m : TamedField (Phi.pullback X)).OrbitIndex,
        (field m : TamedField (Phi.pullback X)).orbitFrameClass O' =

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.signedNormalizationCobordism_productOn
statement:
theorem signedNormalizationCobordism_productOn
    (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n) {X Y : FramedLevelSet n}
    (D : DefiningMapHomotopy (A.pullback X) Y)
    (S : FiberSign X) (T : FiberSign Y)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Y.fiber,
      (0 < (A.pullbackSign S).restrict D.fiber_subset x ↔ 0 < T x))
    {K : Set E} (hA : A.FixedOn K)
    (hD : D.FixedOn K X.g) (hT : ∀ x ∈ K, T x = S x) :
    (signedNormalizationCobordism A D S T hpos).ProductOn K X.g S
proof:
:= by
  let C₁ := A.signedCobordism S
  let C₂ := D.signedCobordism (A.pullbackSign S)
  let C₃ := signInterpolationCobordism
    ((A.pullbackSign S).restrict D.fiber_subset) T hpos
  have hC₁ : C₁.ProductOn K X.g S :=
    hA.signedCobordism_productOn S
  have hC₂ : C₂.ProductOn K X.g S := by
    constructor
    · intro x hx t
      change D.cobMap (spaceTime x t) = X.g x
      rw [D.cobMap_spaceTime]
      exact hD (normRamp t) ⟨normRamp_nonneg t, normRamp_le_one t⟩ x hx
    · intro x hx t
      change A.pullbackSign S (initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x t)) = S x
      rw [initCLM_spaceTime]
      exact hA.pullbackSign_eq S hx
  have hYg : ∀ x ∈ K, Y.g x = X.g x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← congrFun D.H_one x]
    exact hD 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ x hx
  have hC₃ : C₃.ProductOn K X.g S := by
    constructor
    · intro x hx t
      change Y.g (initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x t)) = X.g x
      rw [initCLM_spaceTime, hYg x hx]
    · intro x hx t
      change
        (1 - normRamp (vertC (spaceTime x t))) *
              A.pullbackSign S (initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x t)) +
            normRamp (vertC (spaceTime x t)) *
              T (initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x t)) = S x
      rw [vertC_spaceTime, initCLM_spaceTime,
        hA.pullbackSign_eq S hx, hT x hx]
      ring
  exact hC₁.trans (hC₂.trans hC₃)

          D.fiber_subset x ↔ 0 < T x))
    {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))}
    (hK : K ⊆ {x | 2 ≤ localRadialSq x})
    (hD : D.FixedOn K X.g) (hT : ∀ x ∈ K, T x = S x) :
    (signedNormalizationCobordism (localizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ)
      D S T hpos).ProductOn K X.g S
proof:
:= by
  apply signedNormalizationCobordism_productOn
    (A := localizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ) (D := D)
    (S := S) (T := T) hpos
  · exact (localizedPlaneRotation_fixedOn (m := m) θ).mono hK
  · exact hD
  · exact hT

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_vanishesOutside
statement:
theorem exists_vanishesOutside (κ : PTCutoff S) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ VanishesOutside S κ R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := κ.compact_support.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : E)
  let R : ℝ := |r| + 1
  have hR : 0 < R := by
    dsimp [R]
    linarith [abs_nonneg r]
  refine ⟨R, hR, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  by_contra hκ
  have hxt : x ∈ tsupport κ := subset_tsupport κ hκ
  have hball := hr hxt
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hball
  have hrR : r < R := by
    dsimp [R]
    linarith [le_abs_self r]
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hball) (hrR.trans_le hx)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.continuous_centeredCube

lemma continuous_centeredCube (R : ℝ) :
    Continuous (centeredCube (n := n) R)
proof:
:= by
  have h : centeredCube (n := n) R = fun t =>
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).symm
        (fun i => 2 * R * (t i : ℝ) - R) := rfl
  rw [h]
  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  exact (continuous_const.mul
    (continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_apply i))).sub continuous_const

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.radius_le_norm_centeredCube
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ := ht
  · have hcoord : centeredCube (n := n) R t i = -R := by
      rw [centeredCube_apply, hi, Set.Icc.coe_zero]
      ring
    have hle := PiLp.norm_apply_le (p := (2 : ENNReal))
      (centeredCube (n := n) R t) i
    rw [hcoord] at hle
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hR] using hle
  · have hcoord : centeredCube (n := n) R t i = R := by
      rw [centeredCube_apply, hi, Set.Icc.coe_one]
      ring
    have hle := PiLp.norm_apply_le (p := (2 : ENNReal))
      (centeredCube (n := n) R t) i
    rw [hcoord] at hle
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hR] using hle

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.centeredLoop_homotopic

theorem centeredLoop_homotopic (κ₀ κ₁ : PTCutoff S) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (h₀ : VanishesOutside S κ₀ R) (h₁ : VanishesOutside S κ₁ R) :
    GenLoop.Homotopic (centeredLoop S κ₀ R hR h₀)
      (centeredLoop S κ₁ R hR h₁)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_common_centeredLoop_homotopy
statement:
theorem exists_common_centeredLoop_homotopy (κ₀ κ₁ : PTCutoff S) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∃ hR : 0 < R,
      ∃ h₀ : VanishesOutside S κ₀ R,
      ∃ h₁ : VanishesOutside S κ₁ R,
        GenLoop.Homotopic (centeredLoop S κ₀ R hR.le h₀)
          (centeredLoop S κ₁ R hR.le h₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀, h₀⟩ := exists_vanishesOutside S κ₀
  obtain ⟨R₁, hR₁, h₁⟩ := exists_vanishesOutside S κ₁
  let R := max R₀ R₁
  have hR : 0 < R := hR₀.trans_le (le_max_left _ _)
  have h₀' : VanishesOutside S κ₀ R :=
    vanishesOutside_mono S κ₀ h₀ (le_max_left _ _)
  have h₁' : VanishesOutside S κ₁ R :=
    vanishesOutside_mono S κ₁ h₁ (le_max_right _ _)
  exact ⟨R, hR, h₀', h₁', centeredLoop_homotopic S κ₀ κ₁ R hR.le h₀' h₁'⟩

proof:

  refine ⟨R, hR, ?_⟩
  let φ : C(Q, E) := ⟨centeredCube (n := n) R, continuous_centeredCube (n := n) R⟩
  exact ⟨cubicalLoop S κ φ fun t ht =>
    centeredCube_boundary_zero S κ hR.le hsupp ht⟩

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.exists_spatialVanishesOutside
statement:
theorem exists_spatialVanishesOutside (χ : SignedSlabCutoff C) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 < R ∧ SpatialVanishesOutside C χ R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := χ.compact_support.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : A)
  let R : ℝ := |r| + 1
  have hR : 0 < R := by
    dsimp [R]
    linarith [abs_nonneg r]
  refine ⟨R, hR, ?_⟩
  intro t x hx
  by_contra hχ
  have hst : spaceTime x (t : ℝ) ∈ tsupport χ := subset_tsupport χ hχ
  have hball := hr hst
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hball
  have hxspace : ‖x‖ ≤ ‖spaceTime x (t : ℝ)‖ := by
    have hinit : initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x (t : ℝ)) = x :=
      initCLM_spaceTime x (t : ℝ)
    calc
      ‖x‖ = ‖initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x (t : ℝ))‖ := congrArg norm hinit.symm
      _ ≤ ‖spaceTime x (t : ℝ)‖ := by
        simpa [spacePart, initCLM, initLM] using
          norm_spacePart_le (spaceTime x (t : ℝ))
  have hrR : r < R := by
    dsimp [R]
    linarith [le_abs_self r]
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hball) (hrR.trans_le (hx.trans hxspace))

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.centered_endpointLoops_homotopic

theorem centered_endpointLoops_homotopic (χ : SignedSlabCutoff C)
    (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (hs : SpatialVanishesOutside C χ R) :
    GenLoop.Homotopic
      (FiberSign.PTCutoff.centeredLoop S₀ (sourcePTCutoff C χ) R hR
        (source_vanishesOutside C χ hs))
      (FiberSign.PTCutoff.centeredLoop S₁ (targetPTCutoff C χ) R hR
        (target_vanishesOutside C χ hs))
proof:
:=
  ⟨centeredSlabHomotopy C χ R hR hs⟩

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.exists_endpointCutoffHomotopy
statement:
theorem exists_endpointCutoffHomotopy (χ : SignedSlabCutoff C)
    (κ₀ : FiberSign.PTCutoff S₀) (κ₁ : FiberSign.PTCutoff S₁) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∃ hR : 0 < R,
      ∃ hR1 : 1 ≤ R,
      ∃ h₀ : FiberSign.PTCutoff.VanishesOutside S₀ κ₀ R,
      ∃ h₁ : FiberSign.PTCutoff.VanishesOutside S₁ κ₁ R,
        GenLoop.Homotopic
          (FiberSign.PTCutoff.centeredLoop S₀ κ₀ R hR.le h₀)
          (FiberSign.PTCutoff.centeredLoop S₁ κ₁ R hR.le h₁)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀, h₀⟩ := FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_vanishesOutside S₀ κ₀
  obtain ⟨R₁, hR₁, h₁⟩ := FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_vanishesOutside S₁ κ₁
  obtain ⟨Rs, hRs, hs⟩ := exists_spatialVanishesOutside C χ
  let R : ℝ := max (max (max R₀ R₁) Rs) 1
  have hR : 0 < R := hR₀.trans_le
    (((le_max_left R₀ R₁).trans (le_max_left (max R₀ R₁) Rs)).trans
      (le_max_left (max (max R₀ R₁) Rs) 1))
  have hR1 : 1 ≤ R := le_max_right _ _
  have h₀' : FiberSign.PTCutoff.VanishesOutside S₀ κ₀ R :=
    FiberSign.PTCutoff.vanishesOutside_mono S₀ κ₀ h₀
      (((le_max_left R₀ R₁).trans (le_max_left (max R₀ R₁) Rs)).trans
        (le_max_left (max (max R₀ R₁) Rs) 1))
  have h₁' : FiberSign.PTCutoff.VanishesOutside S₁ κ₁ R :=
    FiberSign.PTCutoff.vanishesOutside_mono S₁ κ₁ h₁
      (((le_max_right R₀ R₁).trans (le_max_left (max R₀ R₁) Rs)).trans
        (le_max_left (max (max R₀ R₁) Rs) 1))
  have hs' : SpatialVanishesOutside C χ R :=
    spatialVanishesOutside_mono C χ hs
      ((le_max_right (max R₀ R₁) Rs).trans
        (le_max_left (max (max R₀ R₁) Rs) 1))
  have hleft := FiberSign.PTCutoff.centeredLoop_homotopic S₀ κ₀
    (sourcePTCutoff C χ) R hR.le h₀' (source_vanishesOutside C χ hs')
  have hmiddle := centered_endpointLoops_homotopic C χ R hR.le hs'
  have hright := FiberSign.PTCutoff.centeredLoop_homotopic S₁
    (targetPTCutoff C χ) κ₁ R hR.le (target_vanishesOutside C χ hs') h₁'
  exact ⟨R, hR, hR1, h₀', h₁', hleft.trans (hmiddle.trans hright)⟩

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.ActualFrameLoopMatch.matched_frameClass
statement:
theorem matched_frameClass
    (F : ActualFrameLoopMatch M) (P : W.OrbitIndex) :
    loopClassZ2 (F.source (M.orbitEquiv.symm P)).loop
        (F.source (M.orbitEquiv.symm P)).closed =
      loopClassZ2 (F.target P).loop (F.target P).closed
proof:
:= by
  calc
    loopClassZ2 (F.source (M.orbitEquiv.symm P)).loop
        (F.source (M.orbitEquiv.symm P)).closed =
        V.orbitFrameClass (M.orbitEquiv.symm P) :=
      F.source_class (M.orbitEquiv.symm P)
    _ = W.orbitFrameClass P := by
      simpa using M.orbitEquiv_frameClass (M.orbitEquiv.symm P)
    _ = loopClassZ2 (F.target P).loop (F.target P).closed :=
      (F.target_class P).symm

@[simp] theorem discrepancyHomotopy_H_one_canonicalPoint
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv Vᴮ W B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch) (P : W.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :

        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point W (by omega) P theta) =

        ((F.discrepancyLoop P).cartesian
          (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))
        ((matchedPlacedX hm M).g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point W (by omega) P theta))
proof:

    SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.homotopy_H_one_canonicalPoint]
  change SOFrameGauge.toCLM
      ((F.nullGauge hm P).Q 1 (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta)) _ = _

    (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq theta)]

statement:

    (T.saddleNegativeRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg
        heq).sortedMark 0 = 0 ∧
      (T.saddleNegativeRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg
        heq).sortedMark 1 = halfI ∧
      (T.saddleNegativeRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg
          heq).cyclicCutRange 0 =
        Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
proof:
:=
  SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.rebased_structure
    (T.saddleNegativeRebasedParam_curve_convexComb hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg
      Vneg heq)
    (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_injective hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
    (l₀ := finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (SaddleBranch.negative, .negative))
    (l₁ := finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (SaddleBranch.positive, .negative))
    (by
      show T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad 0 = _
      simp [saddleNegativeRebasedMarking, saddleNegativeSpatialSegment,
        saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking])

      show T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad 1 = _

        saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking])

proof:
:= by
  refine (T.saddleNegativeRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg
    heq).exists_cyclicCutRange_eq_of_adjacent_or_wrap _ ?_
  refine (T.saddleNegativeRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg
      heq).range_eq_adjacentSubpath_or_wrap_of_embedded_arc_four _
    (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_mem_own_orbit hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg
      Vneg heq .negative .positive)
    (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_injective hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
    (finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (SaddleBranch.negative, .positive))
    (finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (SaddleBranch.positive, .positive)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · show T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad 0 = _
    simp [saddleNegativeRebasedMarking, saddleNegativeSpatialSegment,
      saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking]
  · show T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad 1 = _
    simp [saddleNegativeRebasedMarking, saddleNegativeSpatialSegment,
      saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking]
  · intro u hu l

      hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq .positive hu l

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeRebased_exteriorCuts
statement:
theorem saddleNegativeRebased_exteriorCuts :
    (T.saddleNegativeRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg
          heq).cyclicCutRange 0 =
        Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) ∧
      (T.saddleNegativeRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg
          heq).cyclicCutRange 2 =
        Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) ∧
      ∀ r : Fin 4, r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 → ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(s ^ 2) → ‖u‖ < ρ →
        spacePart (M.param u) ∉
          (T.saddleNegativeRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg
            heq).cyclicCutRange r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := T.saddleNegativeRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq
    with hA
  obtain ⟨-, -, hcut0⟩ :=
    T.saddleNegativeRebased_structure hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq
  have hdisj : Disjoint
      (Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
      (Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad)) :=
    T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegments_disjoint hindex ρ s hρ hb hs hρrad
  obtain ⟨i', j', hij', hi', hj', hav⟩ :=
    A.exists_distinct_localCutRanges_and_otherCuts_avoid_unmarkedLocal
      (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
      (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) hdisj
      ⟨0, hcut0.symm⟩
      (T.saddleNegativeRebased_exists_cutRange_positive hindex hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg heq)
  
  have hhalfIoo : (halfI : I) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : I) 1 := by
    constructor
    · show ((0 : I) : ℝ) < ((halfI : I) : ℝ)
      rw [halfI_coe]; norm_num
    · show ((halfI : I) : ℝ) < ((1 : I) : ℝ)
      rw [halfI_coe]; norm_num
  have hi'0 : i' = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hmem0 :
        T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad halfI ∈
          A.cyclicCutRange 0 := by
      rw [hcut0]; exact ⟨halfI, rfl⟩
    have hmemi :
        T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad halfI ∈
          A.cyclicCutRange i' := by
      rw [← hi']; exact ⟨halfI, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := A.mem_inter_cyclicCutRange_is_mark (Ne.symm hne) hmem0
      hmemi
    exact T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_ne_commonMark_of_mem_Ioo hindex ρ s hρ
      hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq .negative hhalfIoo l hl
  subst hi'0
  have hdisj' : Disjoint (A.cyclicCutRange 0) (A.cyclicCutRange j') := by
    rw [← hi', ← hj']; exact hdisj
  have hj'2 : j' = 2 := by
    rcases A.exterior_pair_of_disjoint_cyclicCutRange hdisj' with
      ⟨h0i, -, -, -⟩ | ⟨-, h1j, -, h3j⟩
    · exact absurd rfl h0i
    · have hj0 : j' ≠ 0 := Ne.symm hij'
      have e0 : ((0 : Fin 4) : ℕ) = 0 := rfl
      have e1 : ((1 : Fin 4) : ℕ) = 1 := rfl
      have e2 : ((2 : Fin 4) : ℕ) = 2 := rfl
      have e3 : ((3 : Fin 4) : ℕ) = 3 := rfl
      have n0 : (j' : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hj0 (Fin.ext (h.trans e0.symm))
      have n1 : (j' : ℕ) ≠ 1 := fun h => h1j (Fin.ext (e1.trans h.symm))
      have n3 : (j' : ℕ) ≠ 3 := fun h => h3j (Fin.ext (e3.trans h.symm))
      have hlt : (j' : ℕ) < 4 := j'.isLt
      refine Fin.ext ?_
      rw [e2]
      omega
  subst hj'2
  refine ⟨hcut0, hj'.symm, ?_⟩
  intro r hr0 hr2 u hquad hnorm
  refine hav ?_ ?_ r hr0 hr2
  · exact T.spacePart_param_mem_union_saddleNegativeSpatialSegments_of_norm_le
      ρ s hρ hb hs hρrad u hquad hnorm.le
  · intro l
    exact T.spacePart_param_ne_saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_of_norm_lt hindex
      ((saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2, (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1) ρ s hρ
      hs hρrad u hquad hnorm

name: Submission.polarFirstQuotient_eq_linear_add_remainder
statement:
theorem polarFirstQuotient_eq_linear_add_remainder
    {E F T : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    (f : E → F) (D : E →L[ℝ] F) (v : T → E)
    (hf0 : f 0 = 0) (q : ℝ × T) :
    polarFirstQuotient f D v q =
      D (v q.2) + q.1⁻¹ • (f (q.1 • v q.2) - D (q.1 • v q.2))
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hr : q.1 = 0
  · simp [polarFirstQuotient, hr, hf0]
  · rw [polarFirstQuotient, if_neg hr]
    calc
      q.1⁻¹ • f (q.1 • v q.2) =
          q.1⁻¹ • (D (q.1 • v q.2) +
            (f (q.1 • v q.2) - D (q.1 • v q.2))) := by
              congr 1
              abel
      _ = q.1⁻¹ • D (q.1 • v q.2) +
          q.1⁻¹ • (f (q.1 • v q.2) - D (q.1 • v q.2)) := by
            rw [smul_add]
      _ = D (v q.2) +
          q.1⁻¹ • (f (q.1 • v q.2) - D (q.1 • v q.2)) := by
            rw [D.map_smul]
            simp [hr]

name: Submission.tendsto_polarFirstRemainder_div
statement:
theorem tendsto_polarFirstRemainder_div
    {E F T : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    [TopologicalSpace T]
    (f : E → F) (D : E →L[ℝ] F) (v : T → E) (t₀ : T)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f D 0) (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (hv : ContinuousAt v t₀) :
    Tendsto
      (fun q : ℝ × T =>
        q.1⁻¹ • (f (q.1 • v q.2) - D (q.1 • v q.2)))
      (nhds (0, t₀)) (nhds 0)
proof:
:= by
  let x : ℝ × T → E := fun q => q.1 • v q.2
  let r : ℝ × T → ℝ := fun q => q.1
  have hv_snd :
      ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × T => v q.2) (0, t₀) := by
    change ContinuousAt (v ∘ Prod.snd) (0, t₀)
    exact hv.comp continuousAt_snd
  have hx_tendsto : Tendsto x (nhds (0, t₀)) (nhds 0) := by
    have hr_fst :
        ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × T => q.1) (0, t₀) :=
      continuousAt_fst
    have h := hr_fst.smul hv_snd
    have h' :
        Tendsto (fun q : ℝ × T => q.1 • v q.2)
          (nhds (0, t₀)) (nhds ((0 : ℝ) • v t₀)) := by
      refine h.congr' ?_
      exact Eventually.of_forall fun _q => rfl
    simpa [x] using h'
  have hrem : (fun y : E => f y - D y) =o[nhds 0] (fun y => y) := by
    simpa [hf0] using (hasFDerivAt_iff_isLittleO_nhds_zero.mp hf)
  have hrem_comp :
      (fun q : ℝ × T => f (x q) - D (x q)) =o[nhds (0, t₀)] x := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hrem.comp_tendsto hx_tendsto
  have hv_tendsto :
      Tendsto (fun q : ℝ × T => v q.2) (nhds (0, t₀)) (nhds (v t₀)) :=
    hv_snd
  have hv_bigO :
      (fun q : ℝ × T => v q.2) =O[nhds (0, t₀)]
        (fun _q : ℝ × T => (1 : ℝ)) :=
    hv_tendsto.isBigO_one ℝ
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hv_bigO.bound
  have hx_bigO : x =O[nhds (0, t₀)] r := by
    apply Asymptotics.IsBigO.of_bound c
    filter_upwards [hc] with q hq
    have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (norm_nonneg q.1)
    simpa [x, r, norm_smul, mul_comm] using hmul
  have hrem_radius :
      (fun q : ℝ × T => f (x q) - D (x q)) =o[nhds (0, t₀)] r :=
    hrem_comp.trans_isBigO hx_bigO
  simpa [x, r] using hrem_radius.tendsto_inv_smul_nhds_zero

name: Submission.continuousAt_polarFirstQuotient
statement:
theorem continuousAt_polarFirstQuotient
    {E F T : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F]
    [TopologicalSpace T]
    (f : E → F) (D : E →L[ℝ] F) (v : T → E) (t₀ : T)
    (hf : HasFDerivAt f D 0) (hf0 : f 0 = 0)
    (hv : ContinuousAt v t₀) :
    ContinuousAt (polarFirstQuotient f D v) (0, t₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hv_snd :
      ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × T => v q.2) (0, t₀) := by
    change ContinuousAt (v ∘ Prod.snd) (0, t₀)
    exact hv.comp continuousAt_snd
  have hlinear :
      Tendsto (fun q : ℝ × T => D (v q.2))
        (nhds (0, t₀)) (nhds (D (v t₀))) := by
    have hD : ContinuousAt D (v t₀) := D.continuous.continuousAt
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      (Filter.Tendsto.comp (f := fun q : ℝ × T => v q.2) (g := D)
        hD hv_snd)
  have hremainder := tendsto_polarFirstRemainder_div f D v t₀ hf hf0 hv
  have hsum :
      Tendsto
        (fun q : ℝ × T =>
          D (v q.2) +
            q.1⁻¹ • (f (q.1 • v q.2) - D (q.1 • v q.2)))
        (nhds (0, t₀)) (nhds (D (v t₀))) := by
    simpa using hlinear.add hremainder
  have heq :
      polarFirstQuotient f D v = fun q : ℝ × T =>
        D (v q.2) +
          q.1⁻¹ • (f (q.1 • v q.2) - D (q.1 • v q.2)) := by
    funext q
    exact polarFirstQuotient_eq_linear_add_remainder f D v hf0 q
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [ContinuousAt, Prod.fst, Prod.snd, inv_zero, zero_smul,
    add_zero] using hsum

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.fiberBoundingRadius_nonneg

theorem fiberBoundingRadius_nonneg (X : FramedLevelSet n) :

:=

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.fiber_subset_closedBall_fiberBoundingRadius
statement:
theorem fiber_subset_closedBall_fiberBoundingRadius (X : FramedLevelSet n) :
    X.fiber ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) X.fiberBoundingRadius
proof:
:= by
  let R := Classical.choose (X.fiber_bounded.subset_closedBall (0 : E))
  have hR : X.fiber ⊆ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) R :=
    Classical.choose_spec (X.fiber_bounded.subset_closedBall (0 : E))
  exact hR.trans (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall (le_max_right 0 R))

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbit.point_apply_two
statement:
@[simp] theorem point_apply_two (O : V.OrbitIndex) (θ : ℝ) :
    point V h2 O θ (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) =
      (X.fiberBoundingRadius + 3 + 4 * (V.orbitSlot O : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint_apply_two

    (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    circlePoint V h2 O a (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) =
      (X.fiberBoundingRadius + 3 + 4 * (V.orbitSlot O : ℕ) : ℝ)

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbit.continuous_circlePoint

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbit.target_disjoint
statement:
theorem target_disjoint {O P : V.OrbitIndex} (hOP : O ≠ P) :
    Disjoint (target V h2 O) (target V h2 P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxO hxP
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hxO
  obtain ⟨b, heq⟩ := hxP
  have hcoord := congrArg
    (fun x : E => x (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1))) heq
  simp only [circlePoint_apply_two] at hcoord
  have hslotNat : (V.orbitSlot O : ℕ) = (V.orbitSlot P : ℕ) := by
    exact_mod_cast (by linarith :
      (V.orbitSlot O : ℝ) = (V.orbitSlot P : ℝ))
  have hslot : V.orbitSlot O = V.orbitSlot P := Fin.ext hslotNat
  exact hOP (V.orbitSlot_injective hslot)

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbit.target_disjoint_fiber
statement:
theorem target_disjoint_fiber (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    Disjoint (target V h2 O) X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxTarget hxFiber
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hxTarget
  have hball := X.fiber_subset_closedBall_fiberBoundingRadius hxFiber
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hball
  have hcoord := PiLp.norm_apply_le (circlePoint V h2 O a)
    (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1))
  have hcenter_nonneg :
      0 ≤ (X.fiberBoundingRadius + 3 +
        4 * (V.orbitSlot O : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    have hslot : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((V.orbitSlot O : ℕ) : ℝ) :=
      Nat.cast_nonneg _
    nlinarith [X.fiberBoundingRadius_nonneg]
  rw [circlePoint_apply_two, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg hcenter_nonneg] at hcoord
  nlinarith [X.fiberBoundingRadius_nonneg]

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion_disjoint_fiber
statement:
theorem targetUnion_disjoint_fiber :
    Disjoint (targetUnion V h2) X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxTarget hxFiber
  obtain ⟨O, hxO⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxTarget
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (target_disjoint_fiber V h2 O) hxO hxFiber

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.SupportedCanonicalRoundUnknotting.ambient_endpoint_orbit

      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 O

  U.toOrbitMoveFamily.ambientSchedule_endpoint_image O

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.SupportedCanonicalRoundUnknotting.ambient_pullback_fiber
statement:
theorem ambient_pullback_fiber (U : SupportedCanonicalRoundUnknotting
    (X := X) (V := V) h2) :
    U.endpointX.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2
proof:

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.SupportedCanonicalRoundUnknotting.endpointSign_forward
statement:
@[simp] theorem endpointSign_forward (U : SupportedCanonicalRoundUnknotting
    (X := X) (V := V) h2) (S : FiberSign X) (x : E) :
    U.endpointSign S (U.ambient.forward 1 x) = S x
proof:
:= by
  rw [endpointSign, SmoothAmbientIsotopy.pullbackSign_apply,
    U.ambient.left_inv 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.SupportedCanonicalRoundUnknotting.target_subset_positivePart_iff
statement:
theorem target_subset_positivePart_iff
    (U : SupportedCanonicalRoundUnknotting
      (X := X) (V := V) h2) (S : FiberSign X) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 O ⊆ (U.endpointSign S).positivePart ↔
      (O : Set E) ∈ S.positiveOrbitCollection V
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro htarget
    rw [S.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff V O]
    have hxO : V.orbitPoint O ∈ (O : Set E) := by
      rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit]
      exact V.mem_orbit_self _
    have himage : U.ambient.forward 1 (V.orbitPoint O) ∈
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 O := by
      rw [← U.ambient_endpoint_orbit O]
      exact ⟨V.orbitPoint O, hxO, rfl⟩
    exact (by simpa using (htarget himage).2)
  · intro hsource y hy
    rw [← U.ambient_endpoint_orbit O] at hy
    obtain ⟨x, hxO, rfl⟩ := hy
    have hpositive : 0 < S x := by
      have hsource' := hsource hxO
      exact hsource'.2
    exact ⟨by
      rw [U.ambient_pullback_fiber]
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨O,
        (by rw [← U.ambient_endpoint_orbit O]; exact ⟨x, hxO, rfl⟩)⟩,
      by simpa using hpositive⟩

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.SupportedCanonicalRoundUnknotting.target_pairwise_disjoint

theorem target_pairwise_disjoint (_U : SupportedCanonicalRoundUnknotting

        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 P)
proof:

  exact fun O P hOP => CanonicalRoundOrbit.target_disjoint V h2 hOP

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.exists_pullback_chart_parameter
statement:
theorem exists_pullback_chart_parameter (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    (a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n)) {v : E'}
    (hv : v ∈ (a.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).fiber) :
    ∃ i : ι, ∃ u : E₂, u ∈ B.core i ∧
      a.diffeomorph.symm ((B.chart i).param u) = v
proof:
:= by
  have hw : verticalShift a v ∈ C.fiber := a.verticalShift_mem_fiber hv
  obtain ⟨i, u, hu, huv⟩ := B.exists_chart_parameter hw
  refine ⟨i, u, hu, ?_⟩
  rw [huv]
  change a.diffeomorph.symm (a.diffeomorph v) = v
  exact a.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply v

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.exists_pullback_chart_parameter_of_coreCritical
statement:
theorem exists_pullback_chart_parameter_of_coreCritical
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    (a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n)) {v : E'}
    (hv : v ∈ coreCriticalPoints (a.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C)) :
    ∃ i : ι, ∃ u : E₂, u ∈ B.core i ∧
      a.diffeomorph.symm ((B.chart i).param u) = v
proof:
:= by
  exact B.exists_pullback_chart_parameter a
    (coreCriticalPoints_subset_fiber _ hv)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.pullback_fiber_subset_iUnion_core_image
statement:
theorem pullback_fiber_subset_iUnion_core_image
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    (a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n)) :
    (a.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).fiber ⊆
      ⋃ i : ι, a.diffeomorph.symm '' (B.chart i).param '' B.core i
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨i, u, hu, huv⟩ := B.exists_pullback_chart_parameter a hv
  apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
  refine ⟨i, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨(B.chart i).param u, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, huv⟩

name: Submission.continuous_cutReparam
statement: theorem continuous_cutReparam (c : ℝ) : Continuous (cutReparam c)
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.if_le
  · exact continuous_projIcc.comp' (by fun_prop)
  · exact continuous_projIcc.comp' (by fun_prop)
  · exact continuous_subtype_val
  · exact continuous_const
  · intro u hu
    have h : c * (2 * (u : ℝ)) = c + (1 - c) * (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) := by rw [hu]; ring
    rw [h]

name: Submission.cutReparam_zero
statement: theorem cutReparam_zero (c : ℝ) : cutReparam c 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cutReparam, Set.Icc.coe_zero]
  rw [if_pos (by norm_num)]
  exact projIcc_eq_zero (by norm_num)

name: Submission.cutReparam_one
statement: theorem cutReparam_one (c : ℝ) : cutReparam c 1 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [cutReparam, Set.Icc.coe_one]
  rw [if_neg (by norm_num)]
  have h : c + (1 - c) * (2 * (1 : ℝ) - 1) = 1 := by ring
  rw [h]
  exact projIcc_eq_one le_rfl

name: Submission.leftGenLoop_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem leftGenLoop_apply (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
    (hcut : ∀ t : I^N, (t i : ℝ) = c → p t = x) (t : I^N) :
    leftGenLoop p i c hc0 hc1 hcut t
      = p (Function.update t i (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one (c * (t i : ℝ))))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.rightGenLoop_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rightGenLoop_apply (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
    (hcut : ∀ t : I^N, (t i : ℝ) = c → p t = x) (t : I^N) :
    rightGenLoop p i c hc0 hc1 hcut t
      = p (Function.update t i
          (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one (c + (1 - c) * (t i : ℝ))))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.transAt_left_right_apply
statement:
theorem transAt_left_right_apply (hc0 : 0 ≤ c) (hc1 : c ≤ 1)
    (hcut : ∀ t : I^N, (t i : ℝ) = c → p t = x) (t : I^N) :
    GenLoop.transAt i (leftGenLoop p i c hc0 hc1 hcut) (rightGenLoop p i c hc0 hc1 hcut) t
      = p (Function.update t i (cutReparam c (t i)))
proof:
:= by
  simp only [GenLoop.transAt, GenLoop.coe_copy, cutReparam]
  split_ifs with h
  · rw [leftGenLoop_apply, Function.update_self, Function.update_idem]
    have ha : ((Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one (2 * ((t i : I) : ℝ)) : I) : ℝ)
        = 2 * ((t i : I) : ℝ) := by
      rw [Set.coe_projIcc, min_eq_right (by linarith),
        max_eq_right (by nlinarith [unitInterval.nonneg (t i)])]
    rw [ha]
  · rw [rightGenLoop_apply, Function.update_self, Function.update_idem]
    rw [not_le] at h
    have ha : ((Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one (2 * ((t i : I) : ℝ) - 1) : I) : ℝ)
        = 2 * ((t i : I) : ℝ) - 1 := by
      rw [Set.coe_projIcc, min_eq_right (by nlinarith [unitInterval.le_one (t i)]),
        max_eq_right (by linarith)]
    rw [ha]

name: Submission.continuous_splitHomotopyMap
statement:
theorem continuous_splitHomotopyMap :
    Continuous fun st : I × I^N => splitHomotopyMap i c st.1 st.2
proof:
:= by
  refine continuous_snd.update i (continuous_projIcc.comp' ?_)
  have hc : Continuous fun st : I × I^N => ((cutReparam c (st.2 i) : I) : ℝ) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp
      ((continuous_cutReparam c).comp ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd))
  exact ((continuous_const.sub (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst)).mul
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_snd))).add
    ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).mul hc)

name: Submission.splitHomotopyMap_zero
statement: theorem splitHomotopyMap_zero (t : I^N) : splitHomotopyMap i c 0 t = t
proof:
:= by
  have h : (1 - ((0 : I) : ℝ)) * (t i : ℝ) + ((0 : I) : ℝ) * ((cutReparam c (t i) : I) : ℝ)
      = (t i : ℝ) := by
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_zero]; ring
  simp only [splitHomotopyMap]
  rw [h, Set.projIcc_val, Function.update_eq_self]

name: Submission.splitHomotopyMap_one
statement:
theorem splitHomotopyMap_one (t : I^N) :
    splitHomotopyMap i c 1 t = Function.update t i (cutReparam c (t i))
proof:
:= by
  have h : (1 - ((1 : I) : ℝ)) * (t i : ℝ) + ((1 : I) : ℝ) * ((cutReparam c (t i) : I) : ℝ)
      = ((cutReparam c (t i) : I) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_one]; ring
  simp only [splitHomotopyMap]
  rw [h, Set.projIcc_val]

name: Submission.splitHomotopyMap_mem_boundary
statement:
theorem splitHomotopyMap_mem_boundary (s : I) {t : I^N} (ht : t ∈ Cube.boundary N) :
    splitHomotopyMap i c s t ∈ Cube.boundary N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := ht
  rcases eq_or_ne j i with rfl | hne
  · rcases hj with h0 | h1
    · refine ⟨j, Or.inl ?_⟩
      simp only [splitHomotopyMap]
      rw [Function.update_self, h0, cutReparam_zero]
      have h : (1 - (s : ℝ)) * ((0 : I) : ℝ) + (s : ℝ) * ((0 : I) : ℝ) = 0 := by
        rw [Set.Icc.coe_zero]; ring
      rw [h]
      exact projIcc_eq_zero le_rfl
    · refine ⟨j, Or.inr ?_⟩
      simp only [splitHomotopyMap]
      rw [Function.update_self, h1, cutReparam_one]
      have h : (1 - (s : ℝ)) * ((1 : I) : ℝ) + (s : ℝ) * ((1 : I) : ℝ) = 1 := by
        rw [Set.Icc.coe_one]; ring
      rw [h]
      exact projIcc_eq_one le_rfl
  · refine ⟨j, ?_⟩
    simp only [splitHomotopyMap]
    rwa [Function.update_of_ne hne]

name: Submission.homotopic_transAt_restrictions
statement:
theorem homotopic_transAt_restrictions (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hcut : ∀ t : I^N, (t i : ℝ) = c → p t = x) :
    GenLoop.Homotopic p
      (GenLoop.transAt i (leftGenLoop p i c hc0.le hc1.le hcut)
        (rightGenLoop p i c hc0.le hc1.le hcut))
proof:
:=
  ⟨splitHomotopy p i c hc0.le hc1.le hcut⟩

name: Submission.genLoopClass_eq_right_mul_left
statement:
theorem genLoopClass_eq_right_mul_left [Nonempty N] (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc1 : c < 1)
    (hcut : ∀ t : I^N, (t i : ℝ) = c → p t = x) :
    (⟦p⟧ : HomotopyGroup N X x)
      = ((· * ·) : HomotopyGroup N X x → HomotopyGroup N X x → HomotopyGroup N X x)
          ⟦rightGenLoop p i c hc0.le hc1.le hcut⟧
          ⟦leftGenLoop p i c hc0.le hc1.le hcut⟧
proof:
:= by
  simp only [HomotopyGroup.mul_spec (i := i)]
  exact Quotient.sound (homotopic_transAt_restrictions p i c hc0 hc1 hcut)

name: Submission.exists_convexComb_eq_of_between
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
  · exact ⟨_, (Set.Icc.eq_convexComb h1 h2).symm⟩
  · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ : ∃ q : I, Set.Icc.convexComb y x q = u :=
      ⟨_, (Set.Icc.eq_convexComb h1 h2).symm⟩
    exact ⟨unitInterval.symm q, by rw [Set.Icc.convexComb_symm]; exact hq⟩

name: Submission.exists_convexComb_eq_four
statement:
theorem exists_convexComb_eq_four (a b c u : I) :
    (∃ q : I, Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) a q = u) ∨
      (∃ q : I, Set.Icc.convexComb a b q = u) ∨
      (∃ q : I, Set.Icc.convexComb b c q = u) ∨
      (∃ q : I, Set.Icc.convexComb c (1 : I) q = u)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total u a with hua | hau
  · exact Or.inl (exists_convexComb_eq_of_between
      (Or.inl ⟨unitInterval.nonneg', hua⟩))
  rcases le_total c u with hcu | huc
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr (exists_convexComb_eq_of_between
      (Or.inl ⟨hcu, unitInterval.le_one'⟩))))
  rcases le_total u b with hub | hbu
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inl (exists_convexComb_eq_of_between (Or.inl ⟨hau, hub⟩)))
  · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl (exists_convexComb_eq_of_between
      (Or.inl ⟨hbu, huc⟩))))

name: Submission.SaddleFlowBandMarking.flow_back
statement:
theorem flow_back
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hbefore hafter Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :
    R.base.flow (R.base.flow x (F.dafter - F.dbefore))
        (F.dbefore - F.dafter) = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [congrFun (R.base.flow_shift x (F.dafter - F.dbefore))
    (F.dbefore - F.dafter)]
  have hz : F.dafter - F.dbefore + (F.dbefore - F.dafter) = 0 := by ring
  rw [hz, R.base.flow_zero]

name: Submission.SaddleFlowBandMarking.spacePart_eq_halfArc_before₁
statement:
theorem spacePart_eq_halfArc_before₁
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hbefore hafter Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat)
    (hp0 : F.before₁Cut₀ = 0) (hp1 : F.before₁Cut₁ = halfI)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} {q : I}
    (htc : tcoord (R.base.flow x (F.dafter - F.dbefore)) = tafter)
    (hsp : spacePart (R.base.flow x (F.dafter - F.dbefore)) =
      F.afterParam.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₀ F.afterCut₁ q)) :
    spacePart x = halfArc F.before₁Param q
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : R.base.flow x (F.dafter - F.dbefore) =
      cobSpaceTime (spacePart (R.base.flow x (F.dafter - F.dbefore)))
        (tcoord (R.base.flow x (F.dafter - F.dbefore))) :=
    (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
  rw [hsp, htc] at h2
  have hy : R.base.flow x (F.dafter - F.dbefore) =
      R.base.flow (F.coreArc₁ q) F.dafter := by
    rw [h2, F.coreArc₁_after q]
  have hx : x = R.base.flow (F.coreArc₁ q) F.dbefore := by
    rw [← F.flow_back x, hy,
      congrFun (R.base.flow_shift (F.coreArc₁ q) F.dafter)
        (F.dbefore - F.dafter)]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [hx, F.coreArc₁_before q, spacePart_spaceTime, hp0, hp1]
  rfl

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.mem_beforeArcs_of_transport_merge
statement:
theorem mem_beforeArcs_of_transport_merge
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    {e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch}
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos))
    (hprov : T.RebasedMergeBandProvenance hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos
      Vneg Vpos R F)
    (hpin : SaddleBandBeforeCutsPinned F)
    (heq : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos =
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    (htc : tcoord (R.base.flow x (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) = tcoord center + s ^ 2)
    (hmem : ∃ b' : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart (R.base.flow x (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b' ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hnotseg : ∀ b'' : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart (R.base.flow x (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∉
        Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b'' ρ s hρ hs hρrad)) :
    (∃ q : I, spacePart x = halfArc F.before₁Param q) ∨
      (∃ q : I, spacePart x = halfArc F.before₂Param q)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hdb, hda, hcut3, hseg2, hseg0, -, -, -, -, -⟩ := hprov
  have hdd : F.dafter - F.dbefore = s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2) := by rw [hdb, hda]
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := hmem
  have hOhat : spacePart (R.base.flow x (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    cases b' with
    | positive => rw [heq]; exact hb'
    | negative => exact hb'
  have h1 : ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      Vpos.orbit (Vpos.orbitPoint
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos)) :=
    Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit _
  have h2 : Vpos.orbit (Vpos.orbitPoint
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos)) =
      Vpos.orbit F.afterParam.p :=
    Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem F.afterParam_orbit
  rw [h1, h2] at hOhat
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := F.afterParam.exists_curve_eq_of_mem_orbit hOhat
  rcases exists_convexComb_eq_four F.afterCut₀ F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ u with
    ⟨q, hq⟩ | ⟨q, hq⟩ | ⟨q, hq⟩ | ⟨q, hq⟩
  · refine absurd ?_ (hnotseg .negative)
    rw [← hu, ← hq]
    exact hseg0 q
  · refine Or.inl ⟨q, F.spacePart_eq_halfArc_before₁ hpin.1 hpin.2.1 ?_ ?_⟩
    · rw [hdd]; exact htc
    · rw [hdd, hq]; exact hu.symm
  · refine absurd ?_ (hnotseg .positive)
    rw [← hu, ← hq]
    exact hseg2 q
  · refine Or.inr ⟨q, F.spacePart_eq_halfArc_before₂ hpin.2.2.1 hpin.2.2.2 ?_ ?_⟩
    · rw [hdd]; exact htc
    · rw [hdd, hcut3, hq]; exact hu.symm

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.mem_beforeArcs_of_transport_split
statement:
theorem mem_beforeArcs_of_transport_split
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)

  have hdd : F.dafter - F.dbefore = -(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2 := by rw [hdb, hda]
  obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := hmem
  have hOhat : spacePart (R.base.flow x (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
      ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    cases b' with
    | positive => rw [heq]; exact hb'
    | negative => exact hb'
  have h1 : ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      Vneg.orbit (Vneg.orbitPoint
        (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg)) :=
    Vneg.orbitPoint_orbit _
  have h2 : Vneg.orbit (Vneg.orbitPoint
        (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg)) =
      Vneg.orbit F.afterParam.p :=
    Vneg.orbit_eq_of_mem F.afterParam_orbit
  rw [h1, h2] at hOhat
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := F.afterParam.exists_curve_eq_of_mem_orbit hOhat
  rcases exists_convexComb_eq_four F.afterCut₀ F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ u with
    ⟨q, hq⟩ | ⟨q, hq⟩ | ⟨q, hq⟩ | ⟨q, hq⟩
  · refine absurd ?_ (hnotseg .negative)
    rw [← hu, ← hq]
    exact hseg0 q
  · refine Or.inl ⟨q, F.spacePart_eq_halfArc_before₁ hpin.1 hpin.2.1 ?_ ?_⟩
    · rw [hdd]; exact htc
    · rw [hdd, hq]; exact hu.symm
  · refine absurd ?_ (hnotseg .positive)
    rw [← hu, ← hq]
    exact hseg2 q
  · refine Or.inr ⟨q, F.spacePart_eq_halfArc_before₂ hpin.2.2.1 hpin.2.2.2 ?_ ?_⟩

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.tcoord_flowedOuterNegativeBoundaryEnd
statement:
theorem tcoord_flowedOuterNegativeBoundaryEnd
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (b e : SaddleBranch) :
    tcoord ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b e
          (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu, -, hup, hquad⟩ :=
    D.exists_flowedOuterNegativeBoundaryEnd_chartParam t ht hindex
      (D.chronologicalSaddleOuterEndpointSmallness t ht) b e
  have huM : ‖u‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    (hu.trans (D.chronologicalSaddleOuterParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)).trans_le
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hq := (D.position.eventModel t ht).time_model u huM
  rw [hindex, hquad] at hq
  rw [← hup]
  exact hq
