name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleBeforeArcSeedMarkBandTwoRadius
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleBeforeArcSeedMarkBandTwoRadius
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle) :
    D.ChronologicalSaddleBeforeArcSeedMarkBandTwoRadius t ht hindex
proof:
:= by
  intro Vneg Vpos
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  have hs0 : D.bandCaptureScale t ht ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hb
  have hρ : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hs : D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
    D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw
  have hρrad : D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht <
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  have hρ' : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht
  have hs' : D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
    D.shortScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht hb hbw
  have hρ'rad : D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht <
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  have hle : D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht ≤
      D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht :=
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_endpointParamRadius t ht).le
  have hsmall := D.chronologicalSaddleOuterEndpointSmallness t ht
  constructor
  · intro hnegNe hposEq
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin⟩ :=
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBeforeArcBandPart t ht hindex Vneg Vpos).1
        hnegNe hposEq
    
    have hne12 : (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
          hρ hs hρrad (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg ≠
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
          hρ hs hρrad (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      cases e₁ <;> cases e₂
      · exact absurd rfl hlab
      · exact Ne.symm hnegNe
      · exact hnegNe
      · exact absurd rfl hlab
    
    have key : ∀ b : SaddleBranch,
        (∃ q : I, spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd
            b .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) = halfArc F.before₁Param q) ∨
        (∃ q : I, spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd
            b .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) = halfArc F.before₂Param q) := by
      intro b
      obtain ⟨hmem, hnotseg⟩ :=
        D.flowedOuterNegativeBoundaryEnd_transport t ht hindex hsmall b
          .negative Vpos
      exact (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).mem_beforeArcs_of_transport_merge hindex hρ hs hρrad
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
        (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg Vpos
        (D.bandTimeField t ht) F hprov hpin hposEq
        (D.tcoord_flowedOuterNegativeBoundaryEnd t ht hindex b .negative)
        hmem hnotseg
    
    have hOb : ∀ b : SaddleBranch,
        spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd
            b .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) ∈
          (((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
            Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
      intro b
      have hidx := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le hindex b hs0 hρ hs hρrad
        hρ' hs' hρ'rad hle (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg
      rw [hidx]
      exact Vneg.mem_orbit_self _
    
    have harc : ∀ (b : SaddleBranch)
        (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam
          ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeSlice
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)) Vneg),
        Vneg.orbitPoint ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) ∈
          Vneg.orbit P.p →
        ∀ q : I, halfArc P q ∈
          (((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
            Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
      intro b P hP q
      rw [Vneg.orbitPoint_orbit _, Vneg.orbit_eq_of_mem hP]
      exact P.curve_mem_orbit _
    have hcontra : ∀ (b₁ b₂ : SaddleBranch)
        (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam
          ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeSlice
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)) Vneg) (q : I),
        spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd
            b₁ .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) = halfArc P q →
        Vneg.orbitPoint ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b₂
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) ∈
          Vneg.orbit P.p →
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b₁
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b₂
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      intro b₁ b₂ P q hq hP
      have hm1 := hOb b₁
      have hm2 := harc b₂ P hP q
      rw [← hq] at hm2
      refine Subtype.ext ?_
      rw [Vneg.orbitPoint_orbit _, Vneg.orbitPoint_orbit _] at *
      rw [← Vneg.orbit_eq_of_mem hm1, ← Vneg.orbit_eq_of_mem hm2]
    refine ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases key e₁ with ⟨q, hq⟩ | ⟨q, hq⟩
      · exact ⟨q, hq.symm⟩
      · exact absurd (hcontra e₁ e₂ F.before₂Param q hq F.before₂Param_orbit)
          hne12
    · rcases key e₂ with ⟨q, hq⟩ | ⟨q, hq⟩
      · exact absurd
          (hcontra e₂ e₁ F.before₁Param q hq F.before₁Param_orbit).symm hne12
      · exact ⟨q, hq.symm⟩
  · intro hposNe hnegEq
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin⟩ :=
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBeforeArcBandPart t ht hindex Vneg Vpos).2
        hposNe hnegEq
    have hne12 : (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
          hρ hs hρrad (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos ≠
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
          hρ hs hρrad (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      cases e₁ <;> cases e₂
      · exact absurd rfl hlab
      · exact Ne.symm hposNe
      · exact hposNe
      · exact absurd rfl hlab
    have key : ∀ b : SaddleBranch,
        (∃ q : I, spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd
            b .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) = halfArc F.before₁Param q) ∨
        (∃ q : I, spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd
            b .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) = halfArc F.before₂Param q) := by
      intro b
      obtain ⟨hmem, hnotseg⟩ :=
        D.flowedOuterPositiveBoundaryEnd_transport t ht hindex hsmall b
          .negative Vneg
      exact (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).mem_beforeArcs_of_transport_split hindex hρ hs hρrad
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
        (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg Vpos
        (D.bandTimeField t ht) F hprov hpin hnegEq
        (D.tcoord_flowedOuterPositiveBoundaryEnd t ht hindex b .negative)
        hmem hnotseg
    have hOb : ∀ b : SaddleBranch,
        spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd
            b .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) ∈
          (((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
            Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
      intro b
      have hidx := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le hindex b hs0 hρ hs hρrad
        hρ' hs' hρ'rad hle (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos
      rw [hidx]
      exact Vpos.mem_orbit_self _
    have harc : ∀ (b : SaddleBranch)
        (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam
          ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSlice
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)) Vpos),
        Vpos.orbitPoint ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) ∈
          Vpos.orbit P.p →
        ∀ q : I, halfArc P q ∈
          (((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
            Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
      intro b P hP q
      rw [Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit _, Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem hP]
      exact P.curve_mem_orbit _
    have hcontra : ∀ (b₁ b₂ : SaddleBranch)
        (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam
          ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSlice
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)) Vpos) (q : I),
        spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd
            b₁ .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) = halfArc P q →
        Vpos.orbitPoint ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b₂
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) ∈
          Vpos.orbit P.p →
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b₁
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b₂
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ hs hρrad
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      intro b₁ b₂ P q hq hP
      have hm1 := hOb b₁
      have hm2 := harc b₂ P hP q
      rw [← hq] at hm2
      refine Subtype.ext ?_
      rw [Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit _, Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit _] at *
      rw [← Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem hm1, ← Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem hm2]
    refine ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rcases key e₁ with ⟨q, hq⟩ | ⟨q, hq⟩
      · exact ⟨q, hq.symm⟩
      · exact absurd (hcontra e₁ e₂ F.before₂Param q hq F.before₂Param_orbit)
          hne12
    · rcases key e₂ with ⟨q, hq⟩ | ⟨q, hq⟩
      · exact absurd
          (hcontra e₂ e₁ F.before₁Param q hq F.before₁Param_orbit).symm hne12
      · exact ⟨q, hq.symm⟩

name: Submission.definiteCircleTangentParam_unit_ne_zero
statement:

    definiteCircleTangentParam 1 theta ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hsq := congrArg (fun u : E₂ => ‖u‖ ^ 2) hzero
  have hnorm : ‖definiteCircleTangentParam 1 theta‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [definiteCircleTangentParam]
    simp only [norm_pairToMorseParam_sq]
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta]
  rw [hnorm, norm_zero] at hsq

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalSurfaceParam_contDiffAt_zero
statement:
theorem criticalSurfaceParam_contDiffAt_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun u : E₂ => p.2 + (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param u) 0 :=
    contDiffAt_const.add (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param_contDiffAt
  have hchart : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun u : E₂ => (B.chart p.1).param
        (p.2 + (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param u)) 0 :=
    (B.chart p.1).param_smooth.contDiffAt.comp 0 hshift
  exact R.amplitude.contDiff_equiv_symm.contDiffAt.comp 0 hchart

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.continuousAt_criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_zero
statement:
theorem continuousAt_criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) (theta₀ : ℝ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp q.1 q.2) (0, theta₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hparam : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      definiteCircleParam q.1 q.2) := by
    have heq : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => definiteCircleParam q.1 q.2) =
        fun q => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm (fun i =>
          if i = 0 then q.1 * Real.cos q.2 else q.1 * Real.sin q.2) := by
      funext q
      apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).injective
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [definiteCircleParam, pairToMorseParam]
    rw [heq]
    apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
    apply continuous_pi
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · convert continuous_fst.mul (Real.continuous_cos.comp continuous_snd) using 1 <;>
        funext q <;> simp [Function.comp_apply]
    · convert continuous_fst.mul (Real.continuous_sin.comp continuous_snd) using 1 <;>
        funext q <;> simp [Function.comp_apply]
  have htangent : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      definiteCircleTangentParam 1 q.2) := by
    have heq : (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => definiteCircleTangentParam 1 q.2) =
        fun q => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm (fun i =>
          if i = 0 then -Real.sin q.2 else Real.cos q.2) := by
      funext q
      apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).injective
      ext i
      fin_cases i <;> simp [definiteCircleTangentParam, pairToMorseParam]
    rw [heq]
    apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 2) ℝ).symm.continuous.comp
    apply continuous_pi
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · convert (Real.continuous_sin.comp continuous_snd).neg using 1 <;>
        funext q <;> simp [Function.comp_apply]
    · convert Real.continuous_cos.comp continuous_snd using 1 <;>
        funext q <;> simp [Function.comp_apply]
  have hparam0 : definiteCircleParam (0 : ℝ) theta₀ = 0 := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [definiteCircleParam, pairToMorseParam]
  have hD : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp)
        (definiteCircleParam q.1 q.2)) (0, theta₀) :=
    (R.continuousAt_fderiv_criticalSurfaceParam_zero p hp).comp_of_eq
      hparam.continuousAt hparam0
  exact continuous_spacePart.continuousAt.comp
    (hD.clm_apply htangent.continuousAt)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.smul_criticalDefiniteUnitTangent
statement:
theorem smul_criticalDefiniteUnitTangent
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (a theta : ℝ) :
    a • R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp a theta =
      spacePart (fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp)
        (definiteCircleParam a theta)
        (definiteCircleTangentParam a theta))
proof:
:= by
  rw [definiteCircleTangentParam_eq_smul_unit, map_smul]
  change a • spacePart
      ((fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) (definiteCircleParam a theta))
        (definiteCircleTangentParam 1 theta)) =
    spacePart (a •
      (fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) (definiteCircleParam a theta))
        (definiteCircleTangentParam 1 theta))
  unfold spacePart
  ext i
  rfl

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_mem_span_tauField
statement:
theorem criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_mem_span_tauField
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    {a theta : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hrad : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius) :
    R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp a theta ∈
      Submodule.span ℝ {
        tauField
          (sliceMap (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
            (tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta)))
          (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta))}
proof:
:= by
  let u := definiteCircleParam a theta
  have hu : ‖u‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius := by
    rw [show ‖u‖ = a by
      dsimp [u]
      exact norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact hrad
  have hreg := R.criticalDefiniteCircle_regular p hp
    (theta := theta) ha hrad
  have hmem :=
    R.spacePart_fderiv_criticalSurfaceParam_morseLevelTangent_mem_span_tauField
      p hp u hu hreg
  rw [hindex, morseLevelTangent_minimum_definiteCircleParam] at hmem
  have hscaled := (Submodule.span ℝ {
      tauField
        (sliceMap (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
          (tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta)))
        (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta))}).smul_mem
          a⁻¹ hmem
  rw [← R.smul_criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp a theta] at hscaled
  simpa [inv_smul_smul₀ ha.ne'] using hscaled

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_ne_zero
statement:
theorem criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_ne_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    {r a theta : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < r)
    (hradius : r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hinj : ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r →
      Injective (fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) u)) :
    R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp a theta ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let u := definiteCircleParam a theta
  have hu : ‖u‖ < r := by
    rw [show ‖u‖ = a by
      dsimp [u]
      exact norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact har
  have huShrink : ‖u‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius :=
    hu.trans_le hradius
  have hquad : morseQuadratic (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index
      (u 0, u 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hindex]
    dsimp [u]
    rw [morseQuadratic_minimum_definiteCircleParam]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 ha.ne'
  have hnonzero :=
    R.spacePart_fderiv_criticalSurfaceParam_morseLevelTangent_ne_zero
      p hp u huShrink (hinj u hu) hquad
  rw [hindex, morseLevelTangent_minimum_definiteCircleParam] at hnonzero
  intro hzero
  apply hnonzero
  rw [← R.smul_criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp a theta, hzero, smul_zero]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalMinimumTangentScale_smul_tauField
statement:
theorem criticalMinimumTangentScale_smul_tauField
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    {a theta : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hrad : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius) :
    R.criticalMinimumTangentScale p hp a theta •
        tauField
          (sliceMap (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
            (tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta)))
          (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta)) =
      R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp a theta
proof:
:= by
  let τ := tauField
    (sliceMap (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
      (tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta)))
    (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta))
  have hmem := R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_mem_span_tauField
    p hp hindex (theta := theta) ha hrad
  change R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp a theta ∈
    Submodule.span ℝ {τ} at hmem
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
  have hreg := R.criticalDefiniteCircle_regular p hp
    (theta := theta) ha hrad
  have hxreg : spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta) ∈
      regularSet (sliceMap (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
        (tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta))) :=
    spacePart_mem_regularSet_of_spatialDeriv_surjective
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).smooth hreg
  have hτnorm : ‖τ‖ = 1 := norm_tauField hxreg
  have hcinner := congrArg (fun v : E₁ => ⟪v, τ⟫_ℝ) hc
  have hcscale : c = R.criticalMinimumTangentScale p hp a theta := by
    simpa [criticalMinimumTangentScale, τ, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hτnorm] using hcinner
  rw [← hcscale]
  exact hc

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalMinimumTangentScale_ne_zero
statement:
theorem criticalMinimumTangentScale_ne_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    {r a theta : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < r)
    (hradius : r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hinj : ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r →
      Injective (fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) u)) :
    R.criticalMinimumTangentScale p hp a theta ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have heq := R.criticalMinimumTangentScale_smul_tauField
    p hp hindex (theta := theta) ha (har.trans_le hradius)
  rw [hzero, zero_smul] at heq
  exact R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_ne_zero
    p hp hindex ha har hradius hinj heq.symm

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_avoid_between
statement:
theorem sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_avoid_between
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    (P : MorsePosition C.cobordism) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : sliceRegular C.cobordism.G a)
    (hb : sliceRegular C.cobordism.G b)
    (havoid : ∀ t ∈ P.eventTimes, t ∉ Icc (min a b) (max a b)) :
    (C.sliceSign a ha).positiveDelta = (C.sliceSign b hb).positiveDelta
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_total a b with hab | hba
  · apply C.sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_avoid_eventTimes P hab ha hb
    intro t ht htab
    exact havoid t ht (by
      simpa [min_eq_left hab, max_eq_right hab] using htab)
  · symm
    apply C.sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_avoid_eventTimes P hba hb ha
    intro t ht htba
    exact havoid t ht (by
      simpa [min_eq_right hba, max_eq_left hba] using htba)

name: Submission.MorsePosition.eq_eventTime_of_mem_comparison_interval
statement:
theorem eq_eventTime_of_mem_comparison_interval
    (P : MorsePosition C.cobordism)
    (K : P.EventDeltaCrossings)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ P.eventTimes) {u : ℝ}
    (hu : u ∈ P.eventTimes)
    (huI : u ∈ Icc (K t ht).some.before (K t ht).some.after) :
    u = t
proof:
:= by
  let E := (K t ht).some
  let q := P.eventCenter u hu
  have hqcore : q ∈ coreCriticalPoints C.cobordism :=
    P.eventCenter_mem_coreCriticalPoints u hu
  have hqtime : tcoord q ∈ Icc E.before E.after := by
    rw [P.eventCenter_time u hu]
    exact huI
  have hqeq : q = P.eventCenter t ht := by
    exact E.isolates q hqcore.1 hqtime
  calc
    u = tcoord q := (P.eventCenter_time u hu).symm
    _ = tcoord (P.eventCenter t ht) := congrArg tcoord hqeq
    _ = t := P.eventCenter_time t ht

name: Submission.MorsePosition.slice_positiveDelta_eq_of_remainingEvents
statement:
private theorem slice_positiveDelta_eq_of_remainingEvents
    (P : MorsePosition C.cobordism)
    (K : P.EventDeltaCrossings) :
    ∀ (k : ℕ) (s : Finset ℝ) (a b : ℝ),
      s.card = k →
      a < b →
      s ⊆ P.eventTimes →
      (∀ t ∈ s, a < t ∧ t < b) →
      (∀ t ∈ P.eventTimes, t ∈ Icc a b → t ∈ s) →
      (ha : sliceRegular C.cobordism.G a) →
      (hb : sliceRegular C.cobordism.G b) →
      (C.sliceSign a ha).positiveDelta =
        (C.sliceSign b hb).positiveDelta
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k using Nat.strong_induction_on with
  | h k ih =>
      intro s a b hcard hab hsub hinside hexact ha hb
      by_cases hs : s = ∅
      · subst s
        apply C.sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_avoid_between P ha hb
        intro u hu huI
        have huab : u ∈ Icc a b := by
          simpa [min_eq_left hab.le, max_eq_right hab.le] using huI
        simpa using hexact u hu huab
      · have hsne : s.Nonempty := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hs
        let t := s.min' hsne
        have hts : t ∈ s := Finset.min'_mem s hsne
        have htevent : t ∈ P.eventTimes := hsub hts
        let E := (K t htevent).some
        have htinside : a < t ∧ t < b := hinside t hts
        have hEbefore : E.before < t := by
          calc
            E.before < tcoord (P.eventCenter t htevent) := E.before_lt
            _ = t := P.eventCenter_time t htevent
        have hEafter : t < E.after := by
          calc
            t = tcoord (P.eventCenter t htevent) :=
              (P.eventCenter_time t htevent).symm
            _ < E.after := E.lt_after
        have hleftAvoid :
            ∀ u ∈ P.eventTimes,
              u ∉ Icc (min a E.before) (max a E.before) := by
          intro u hu huI
          rcases le_total a E.before with habe | heba
          · have hua : a ≤ u := by
              have := huI.1
              simpa [min_eq_left habe] using this
            have hube : u ≤ E.before := by
              have := huI.2
              simpa [max_eq_right habe] using this
            have hub : u ≤ b := hube.trans (hEbefore.trans htinside.2).le
            have hus : u ∈ s := hexact u hu ⟨hua, hub⟩
            have htu : t ≤ u := Finset.min'_le s u hus
            linarith [hEbefore]
          · have hueb : E.before ≤ u := by
              have := huI.1
              simpa [min_eq_right heba] using this
            have hua : u ≤ a := by
              have := huI.2
              simpa [max_eq_left heba] using this
            have huInterval : u ∈ Icc E.before E.after :=
              ⟨hueb, hua.trans (htinside.1.trans hEafter).le⟩
            have hut := P.eq_eventTime_of_mem_comparison_interval K
              t htevent hu huInterval
            linarith [hua, htinside.1, hut]
        have hleft :
            (C.sliceSign a ha).positiveDelta =
              (C.sliceSign E.before E.before_regular).positiveDelta :=
          C.sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_avoid_between P ha
            E.before_regular hleftAvoid
        have hlocal :
            (C.sliceSign E.before E.before_regular).positiveDelta =
              (C.sliceSign E.after E.after_regular).positiveDelta :=
          E.delta_eq
        let s' := s.erase t
        by_cases hs' : s' = ∅
        · have hrightAvoid :
              ∀ u ∈ P.eventTimes,
                u ∉ Icc (min E.after b) (max E.after b) := by
            intro u hu huI
            rcases le_total E.after b with heab | hbae
            · have hue : E.after ≤ u := by
                have := huI.1
                simpa [min_eq_left heab] using this
              have hub : u ≤ b := by
                have := huI.2
                simpa [max_eq_right heab] using this
              have hua : a ≤ u :=
                htinside.1.le.trans (hEafter.le.trans hue)
              have hus : u ∈ s := hexact u hu ⟨hua, hub⟩
              have hut : u = t := by
                by_contra hut
                have hu' : u ∈ s' := by
                  exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hut, hus⟩
                have : u ∉ s' := by simp [hs']
                exact this hu'
              linarith [hEafter, hue, hut]
            · have hub : b ≤ u := by
                have := huI.1
                simpa [min_eq_right hbae] using this
              have hue : u ≤ E.after := by
                have := huI.2
                simpa [max_eq_left hbae] using this
              have huInterval : u ∈ Icc E.before E.after :=
                ⟨(hEbefore.trans htinside.2).le.trans hub, hue⟩
              have hut := P.eq_eventTime_of_mem_comparison_interval K
                t htevent hu huInterval
              linarith [htinside.2, hub, hut]
          have hright :
              (C.sliceSign E.after E.after_regular).positiveDelta =
                (C.sliceSign b hb).positiveDelta :=
            C.sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_avoid_between P
              E.after_regular hb hrightAvoid
          exact hleft.trans (hlocal.trans hright)
        · have hs'card : s'.card < k := by
            rw [← hcard]
            exact Finset.card_erase_lt_of_mem hts
          have hs'sub : s' ⊆ P.eventTimes := by
            intro u hu
            exact hsub (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hu)
          have hs'after : ∀ u ∈ s', E.after < u := by
            intro u hu
            have hus : u ∈ s := Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hu
            have hutne : u ≠ t := (Finset.mem_erase.mp hu).1
            have htu : t ≤ u := Finset.min'_le s u hus
            have htult : t < u := lt_of_le_of_ne htu hutne.symm
            by_contra hnot
            have huInterval : u ∈ Icc E.before E.after :=
              ⟨(hEbefore.trans htult).le, le_of_not_gt hnot⟩
            exact hutne (P.eq_eventTime_of_mem_comparison_interval K
              t htevent (hsub hus) huInterval)
          obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀⟩ := Finset.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hs'
          have hafterb : E.after < b :=
            (hs'after u₀ hu₀).trans (hinside u₀
              (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hu₀)).2
          have hs'inside : ∀ u ∈ s', E.after < u ∧ u < b := by
            intro u hu
            exact ⟨hs'after u hu,
              (hinside u (Finset.mem_of_mem_erase hu)).2⟩
          have hs'exact : ∀ u ∈ P.eventTimes,
              u ∈ Icc E.after b → u ∈ s' := by
            intro u hu huI
            have hua : a ≤ u :=
              htinside.1.le.trans (hEafter.le.trans huI.1)
            have hus : u ∈ s := hexact u hu ⟨hua, huI.2⟩
            have hut : u ≠ t := by
              intro hut
              subst u
              linarith [hEafter, huI.1]
            exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hut, hus⟩
          have hright := ih s'.card hs'card s' E.after b rfl hafterb
            hs'sub hs'inside hs'exact E.after_regular hb
          exact hleft.trans (hlocal.trans hright)

name: Submission.MorsePosition.endpoint_positiveDelta_eq_of_eventCrossings
statement:
theorem endpoint_positiveDelta_eq_of_eventCrossings
    (P : MorsePosition C.cobordism)
    (K : P.EventDeltaCrossings) :
    S₀.positiveDelta = S₁.positiveDelta
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : sliceRegular C.cobordism.G 0 :=
    C.cobordism.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter (by norm_num)
  have h1 : sliceRegular C.cobordism.G 1 :=
    C.cobordism.sliceRegular_of_three_quarter_le (by norm_num)
  have heventInside : ∀ t ∈ P.eventTimes, (0 : ℝ) < t ∧ t < 1 := by
    intro t ht
    rw [P.mem_eventTimes_iff] at ht
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hvt⟩ := ht
    have hlower : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < t := by
      by_contra h
      exact hv.1.2
        ((C.cobordism.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter (le_of_not_gt h))
          v hv.1.1 hvt)
    have hupper : t < (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
      by_contra h
      exact hv.1.2
        ((C.cobordism.sliceRegular_of_three_quarter_le (le_of_not_gt h))
          v hv.1.1 hvt)
    constructor <;> linarith
  have hslices :
      (C.sliceSign 0 h0).positiveDelta = (C.sliceSign 1 h1).positiveDelta := by
    apply slice_positiveDelta_eq_of_remainingEvents P K
      P.eventTimes.card P.eventTimes 0 1 rfl (by norm_num)
      (fun _ h => h) heventInside
    · intro t ht _
      exact ht
  calc
    S₀.positiveDelta = (C.sliceSign 0 h0).positiveDelta :=
      C.sliceSign_zero_positiveDelta.symm
    _ = (C.sliceSign 1 h1).positiveDelta := hslices
    _ = S₁.positiveDelta := C.sliceSign_one_positiveDelta

name: Submission.MorsePosition.endpoint_positiveDelta_eq_of_eventComparisons
statement:
theorem endpoint_positiveDelta_eq_of_eventComparisons
    (P : MorsePosition C.cobordism) (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (K : P.EventDeltaComparisons hn) :
    S₀.positiveDelta = S₁.positiveDelta
proof:
:=
  P.endpoint_positiveDelta_eq_of_eventCrossings
    (P.eventDeltaCrossingsOfComparisons hn K)

name: Submission.dist_spaceTime_same_space
statement:
theorem dist_spaceTime_same_space (v : E') (t : ℝ) :
    dist v (spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) t) = |tcoord v - t|
proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  have hdiff :
      v - spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) t =
        (tcoord v - t) • timeVec := by
    conv_lhs =>
      lhs
      rw [← spaceTime_init_vert v]
    rw [spaceTime_eq_affine, spaceTime_eq_affine, sub_smul]
    abel
  rw [hdiff, norm_smul, norm_timeVec, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.abs_apply_lt_sub_quarter
statement:
theorem abs_apply_lt_sub_quarter {v : E'} (hv : 1 / 4 < tcoord v) :
    |a v| < tcoord v - 1 / 4
proof:
:= by
  let w : E' := spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) (1 / 4)
  have hwt : tcoord w = 1 / 4 := by
    change tcoord (spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) (1 / 4)) = 1 / 4
    exact tcoord_spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) (1 / 4)
  have haw : a w = 0 :=
    a.toVerticalAmplitude.collar_zero w (Or.inl (by rw [hwt]))
  have hlip := a.lipschitz.dist_le_mul v w
  have hK : (a.K : ℝ) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast a.K_lt_one
  have hdist : dist v w = tcoord v - 1 / 4 := by
    change dist v (spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) (1 / 4)) = _
    rw [dist_spaceTime_same_space, abs_of_pos (by linarith)]
  rw [Real.dist_eq, haw, sub_zero, hdist] at hlip
  exact hlip.trans_lt (by
    have hpos : 0 < tcoord v - 1 / 4 := by linarith
    nlinarith [a.K.coe_nonneg])

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.abs_apply_lt_threeQuarter_sub
statement:
theorem abs_apply_lt_threeQuarter_sub {v : E'} (hv : tcoord v < 3 / 4) :
    |a v| < 3 / 4 - tcoord v
proof:
:= by
  let w : E' := spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) (3 / 4)
  have hwt : tcoord w = 3 / 4 := by
    change tcoord (spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) (3 / 4)) = 3 / 4
    exact tcoord_spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) (3 / 4)
  have haw : a w = 0 :=
    a.toVerticalAmplitude.collar_zero w (Or.inr (by rw [hwt]))
  have hlip := a.lipschitz.dist_le_mul v w
  have hK : (a.K : ℝ) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast a.K_lt_one
  have hdist : dist v w = 3 / 4 - tcoord v := by
    change dist v (spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) (3 / 4)) = _
    rw [dist_spaceTime_same_space, abs_of_neg (by linarith)]
    ring
  rw [Real.dist_eq, haw, sub_zero, hdist] at hlip
  exact hlip.trans_lt (by
    have hpos : 0 < 3 / 4 - tcoord v := by linarith
    nlinarith [a.K.coe_nonneg])

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.zero_le_tcoord_verticalShift
statement:
theorem zero_le_tcoord_verticalShift {v : E'} (hv : 0 ≤ tcoord v) :
    0 ≤ tcoord (verticalShift a v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [tcoord_verticalShift]
  by_cases hleft : tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4
  · rw [a.toVerticalAmplitude.collar_zero v (Or.inl hleft), add_zero]
    exact hv
  · have habs := a.abs_apply_lt_sub_quarter (lt_of_not_ge hleft)
    have hneg : -|a v| ≤ a v := neg_abs_le _
    linarith

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.tcoord_verticalShift_le_one
statement:
theorem tcoord_verticalShift_le_one {v : E'} (hv : tcoord v ≤ 1) :
    tcoord (verticalShift a v) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tcoord_verticalShift]
  by_cases hright : 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v
  · rw [a.toVerticalAmplitude.collar_zero v (Or.inr hright), add_zero]
    exact hv
  · have habs := a.abs_apply_lt_threeQuarter_sub (lt_of_not_ge hright)
    have hpos : a v ≤ |a v| := le_abs_self _
    linarith

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.verticalShift_mem_timeSlab
statement:
theorem verticalShift_mem_timeSlab {v : E'}
    (hv : 0 ≤ tcoord v ∧ tcoord v ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ tcoord (verticalShift a v) ∧
      tcoord (verticalShift a v) ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  ⟨a.zero_le_tcoord_verticalShift hv.1,
    a.tcoord_verticalShift_le_one hv.2⟩

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.verticalShift_mem_fiber
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨hv.1, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact a.zero_le_tcoord_verticalShift hv.2.1
  · exact a.tcoord_verticalShift_le_one hv.2.2

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.symm_mem_timeSlab
statement:
theorem symm_mem_timeSlab {w : E'} (hw : 0 ≤ tcoord w ∧ tcoord w ≤ 1) :
    0 ≤ tcoord (a.diffeomorph.symm w) ∧
      tcoord (a.diffeomorph.symm w) ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  let v : E' := a.diffeomorph.symm w
  have hshift : verticalShift a v = w := by
    change a.diffeomorph v = w
    exact a.diffeomorph.apply_symm_apply w
  constructor
  · by_cases hleft : tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4
    · have ha : a v = 0 :=
        a.toVerticalAmplitude.collar_zero v (Or.inl hleft)
      have htime : tcoord v = tcoord w := by
        rw [← hshift, tcoord_verticalShift, ha, add_zero]
      change 0 ≤ tcoord v
      rw [htime]
      exact hw.1
    · have : 1 / 4 < tcoord v := lt_of_not_ge hleft
      change 0 ≤ tcoord v
      linarith
  · by_cases hright : 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v
    · have ha : a v = 0 :=
        a.toVerticalAmplitude.collar_zero v (Or.inr hright)
      have htime : tcoord v = tcoord w := by
        rw [← hshift, tcoord_verticalShift, ha, add_zero]
      change tcoord v ≤ 1
      rw [htime]
      exact hw.2
    · have : tcoord v < 3 / 4 := lt_of_not_ge hright
      change tcoord v ≤ 1
      linarith

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.symm_mem_pullback_fiber
proof:
:= by
  have hshift : verticalShift a (a.diffeomorph.symm w) = w := by
    change a.diffeomorph (a.diffeomorph.symm w) = w
    exact a.diffeomorph.apply_symm_apply w
  refine ⟨?_, (a.symm_mem_timeSlab hw.2).1, (a.symm_mem_timeSlab hw.2).2⟩
  rw [VerticalAmplitude.pullback_G, hshift]
  exact hw.1

name: Submission.basedHomotopic_of_basedClassZ2_eq
statement:
theorem basedHomotopic_of_basedClassZ2_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    {alpha beta : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1}
    (hclass : basedClassZ2 alpha = basedClassZ2 beta) :
    alpha.Homotopic beta
proof:
:= by
  unfold basedClassZ2 at hclass
  have hw :
      wHom m (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦alpha⟧) =
        wHom m (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦beta⟧) := by
    exact Multiplicative.toAdd.injective hclass
  have hpi :
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦alpha⟧ =
        FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦beta⟧ :=
    (wHom_bijective hm).1 hw
  exact Quotient.exact hpi

name: Submission.freeToBased_homotopic_of_loopClassZ2_eq
statement:
theorem freeToBased_homotopic_of_loopClassZ2_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    {gamma delta : C(I, SOGroup m)}
    (hgamma : gamma 0 = gamma 1) (hdelta : delta 0 = delta 1)
    (hclass : loopClassZ2 gamma hgamma = loopClassZ2 delta hdelta) :
    (freeToBased gamma hgamma).Homotopic (freeToBased delta hdelta)
proof:
:= by
  exact basedHomotopic_of_basedClassZ2_eq hm hclass

name: Submission.exists_loopHomotopy_of_loopClassZ2_eq
statement:
theorem exists_loopHomotopy_of_loopClassZ2_eq {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    {gamma delta : C(I, SOGroup m)}
    (hgamma : gamma 0 = gamma 1) (hdelta : delta 0 = delta 1)
    (hclass : loopClassZ2 gamma hgamma = loopClassZ2 delta hdelta) :
    ∃ H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy gamma delta,
      ∀ s, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Hb⟩ := freeToBased_homotopic_of_loopClassZ2_eq
    hm hgamma hdelta hclass
  let c : Path (gamma 0) (delta 0) :=
    PathConnectedSpace.somePath (gamma 0) (delta 0)
  let H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy gamma delta :=
    { toFun := fun q => Hb q * c q.1
      continuous_toFun := Hb.continuous.mul
        (c.continuous.comp continuous_fst)
      map_zero_left := by
        intro t
        show Hb (0, t) * c 0 = gamma t
        rw [Hb.apply_zero, c.source]
        change gamma t * (gamma 0)⁻¹ * gamma 0 = gamma t
        group
      map_one_left := by
        intro t
        show Hb (1, t) * c 1 = delta t
        rw [Hb.apply_one, c.target]
        change delta t * (delta 0)⁻¹ * delta 0 = delta t
        group }
  refine ⟨H, ?_⟩
  intro s
  change Hb (s, 0) * c s = Hb (s, 1) * c s
  have hzero := Hb.eq_fst s (show (0 : I) ∈ ({0, 1} : Set I) by simp)
  have hone := Hb.eq_fst s (show (1 : I) ∈ ({0, 1} : Set I) by simp)
  rw [hzero, hone]
  congr 1
  change (freeToBased gamma hgamma) 0 = (freeToBased gamma hgamma) 1
  rw [(freeToBased gamma hgamma).source,
    (freeToBased gamma hgamma).target]

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.matrixGramSchmidtSO_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.matrixGramSchmidtSO_mul_SOGroup
statement:
theorem matrixGramSchmidtSO_mul_SOGroup (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hM : 0 < M.det) (Q : SOGroup k)
    (hMQ : 0 < (M * (Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)).det) :
    matrixGramSchmidtSO (M * (Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)) hMQ
      = matrixGramSchmidtSO M hM * Q
proof:
:= by
  have hQorth : (Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) *
      (Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᵀ = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin k) ℝ).mp
      (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp Q.property).1
  apply Subtype.ext
  show rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
      (matrixRows (M * (Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)))) = _
  rw [GramSchmidtTriangular.rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed_matrixRows_mul hQorth M]
  rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.interpMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem interpMatrix_apply (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) (s : ℝ) (i j : Fin k) :
    interpMatrix M s i j
      = (1 - s) * M i j + s * (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows M) i) j
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.interpMatrix_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem interpMatrix_zero (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    interpMatrix M 0 = M
proof:
:= by
  rw [interpMatrix, frameInterp_zero, rowsMatrix_matrixRows]

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.interpMatrix_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem interpMatrix_one (M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) :
    interpMatrix M 1 = rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows M))
proof:
:= by
  rw [interpMatrix, frameInterp_one]

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.det_interpMatrix_pos
statement:
theorem det_interpMatrix_pos {M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (hdet : 0 < M.det)
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) : 0 < (interpMatrix M s).det
proof:
:= by
  have hInd : LinearIndependent ℝ (matrixRows M) :=
    linearIndependent_matrixRows_of_det_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hdet)
  have hd : 0 < (rowsMatrix (matrixRows M)).det := by rwa [rowsMatrix_matrixRows]
  exact det_rowsMatrix_frameInterp_pos hInd hd hs0 hs1

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.continuous_matrixRows_of_entries
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : Continuous fun t => M t i := continuous_pi fun j => hM i j
  exact (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 (fun _ : Fin k => ℝ)).comp hrow

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_matrixRows
statement:
theorem continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_matrixRows
    {M : T → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => M t i j) (hdet : ∀ t, 0 < (M t).det)
    (i j : Fin k) :
    Continuous fun t => (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows (M t)) i) j
proof:
:= by
  have hfam := continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_family
    (A := fun t => matrixRows (M t)) (continuous_matrixRows_of_entries hM)
    (fun t => linearIndependent_matrixRows_of_det_ne_zero (ne_of_gt (hdet t))) i
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp hfam

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.continuous_matrixGramSchmidtSO
statement:
theorem continuous_matrixGramSchmidtSO (M : T → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => M t i j) (hdet : ∀ t, 0 < (M t).det) :
    Continuous fun t => (matrixGramSchmidtSO (M t) (hdet t) : SOGroup k)
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  exact continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_matrixRows hM hdet i j

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.gsSO_eq_of_det_pos
statement:
theorem gsSO_eq_of_det_pos {M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (h : 0 < M.det) :
    gsSO M = matrixGramSchmidtSO M h
proof:
:=
  dif_pos h

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.gsSO_coe_SOGroup
statement:
@[simp] theorem gsSO_coe_SOGroup (Q : SOGroup k) :
    gsSO ((Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)) = Q
proof:
:= by
  rw [gsSO_eq_of_det_pos (SOGroup_det_pos Q), matrixGramSchmidtSO_of_SOGroup]

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.gsSO_mul_SOGroup
statement:
theorem gsSO_mul_SOGroup {M : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ} (hM : 0 < M.det)
    (Q : SOGroup k) :
    gsSO (M * (Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)) = gsSO M * Q
proof:
:= by
  have hdetQ : 0 < (M * (Q : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)).det := by
    rw [Matrix.det_mul,
      (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp Q.property).2]
    simpa using hM
  rw [gsSO_eq_of_det_pos hdetQ, gsSO_eq_of_det_pos hM,
    matrixGramSchmidtSO_mul_SOGroup M hM Q hdetQ]

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.continuous_gsSO
statement:
theorem continuous_gsSO (M : T → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => M t i j) (hdet : ∀ t, 0 < (M t).det) :
    Continuous fun t => gsSO (M t)
proof:
:= by
  have hrw : (fun t => gsSO (M t)) = fun t => matrixGramSchmidtSO (M t) (hdet t) := by
    funext t
    exact gsSO_eq_of_det_pos (hdet t)
  rw [hrw]
  exact continuous_matrixGramSchmidtSO M hM hdet

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.gsQLoop_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem gsQLoop_apply (M : I → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => M t i j) (hdet : ∀ t, 0 < (M t).det)
    (t : I) : gsQLoop M hM hdet t = gsSO (M t)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.gsQLoop_closed
statement:
theorem gsQLoop_closed (M : I → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => M t i j) (hdet : ∀ t, 0 < (M t).det)
    (hloop : M 0 = M 1) : gsQLoop M hM hdet 0 = gsQLoop M hM hdet 1
proof:
:= by
  show gsSO (M 0) = gsSO (M 1)
  rw [hloop]

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.loopClassZ2_gsQLoop_mul
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_gsQLoop_mul
    (G A : I → Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)
    (hG : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => G t i j)
    (hA : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => A t i j)
    (hGdet : ∀ t, 0 < (G t).det) (hAdet : ∀ t, 0 < (A t).det)
    (hGA : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => (G t * A t) i j)
    (hGAdet : ∀ t, 0 < (G t * A t).det)
    (hGloop : G 0 = G 1) (hAloop : A 0 = A 1)
    (hGAloop : (fun t => G t * A t) 0 = (fun t => G t * A t) 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (gsQLoop (fun t => G t * A t) hGA hGAdet)
        (gsQLoop_closed _ hGA hGAdet hGAloop)
      = loopClassZ2 (gsQLoop G hG hGdet) (gsQLoop_closed _ hG hGdet hGloop)
        + loopClassZ2 (gsQLoop A hA hAdet)
            (gsQLoop_closed _ hA hAdet hAloop)
proof:
:= by
  have hKcont : Continuous fun t : I => gsSO (G t * A t) * (gsSO (A t))⁻¹ :=
    (continuous_gsSO (fun t => G t * A t) hGA hGAdet).mul
      ((continuous_gsSO A hA hAdet).inv)
  set K : C(I, SOGroup k) :=
    ⟨fun t => gsSO (G t * A t) * (gsSO (A t))⁻¹, hKcont⟩ with hKdef
  have hKclosed : K 0 = K 1 := by
    show gsSO (G 0 * A 0) * (gsSO (A 0))⁻¹ = gsSO (G 1 * A 1) * (gsSO (A 1))⁻¹
    rw [hGloop, hAloop]
  have hsplit : gsQLoop (fun t => G t * A t) hGA hGAdet
      = K * gsQLoop A hA hAdet := by
    refine ContinuousMap.ext fun t => ?_
    show gsSO (G t * A t) = gsSO (G t * A t) * (gsSO (A t))⁻¹ * gsSO (A t)
    rw [inv_mul_cancel_right]
  have hprodclosed : (K * gsQLoop A hA hAdet) 0 = (K * gsQLoop A hA hAdet) 1 := by
    show K 0 * gsQLoop A hA hAdet 0 = K 1 * gsQLoop A hA hAdet 1
    rw [hKclosed, gsQLoop_closed A hA hAdet hAloop]
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun (gsQLoop_closed _ hGA hGAdet hGAloop) hprodclosed
      hsplit,
    loopClassZ2_mul K (gsQLoop A hA hAdet) hKclosed
      (gsQLoop_closed A hA hAdet hAloop) hprodclosed]
  congr 1
  
  have hIcont : ∀ i j : Fin k, Continuous fun z : I × I =>
      interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ) i j := by
    intro i j
    have h1 : Continuous fun z : I × I => ((z.1 : ℝ)) :=
      continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
    have h2 : Continuous fun z : I × I => A z.2 i j :=
      (hA i j).comp continuous_snd
    have h3 : Continuous fun z : I × I =>
        (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows (A z.2)) i) j :=
      (continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_matrixRows hA hAdet i j).comp continuous_snd
    have hrw : (fun z : I × I => interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ) i j)
        = fun z : I × I => (1 - (z.1 : ℝ)) * A z.2 i j +
          (z.1 : ℝ) * (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows (A z.2)) i) j := by
      funext z
      exact interpMatrix_apply (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ) i j
    rw [hrw]
    exact ((continuous_const.sub h1).mul h2).add (h1.mul h3)
  have hIdet : ∀ z : I × I, 0 < (interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ)).det := fun z =>
    det_interpMatrix_pos (hAdet z.2) (unitInterval.nonneg z.1)
      (unitInterval.le_one z.1)
  have hGIcont : ∀ i j : Fin k, Continuous fun z : I × I =>
      (G z.2 * interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ)) i j := by
    intro i j
    have hrw : (fun z : I × I => (G z.2 * interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ)) i j)
        = fun z : I × I => ∑ l : Fin k, G z.2 i l *
            interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ) l j := by
      funext z
      exact Matrix.mul_apply
    rw [hrw]
    exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun l _ =>
      ((hG i l).comp continuous_snd).mul (hIcont l j)
  have hGIdet : ∀ z : I × I, 0 < (G z.2 * interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ)).det := by
    intro z
    rw [Matrix.det_mul]
    exact mul_pos (hGdet z.2) (hIdet z)
  have hHcont : Continuous fun z : I × I =>
      gsSO (G z.2 * interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ)) *
        (gsSO (interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ)))⁻¹ :=
    (continuous_gsSO (fun z : I × I => G z.2 * interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ))
        hGIcont hGIdet).mul
      ((continuous_gsSO (fun z : I × I => interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ))
        hIcont hIdet).inv)
  refine loopClassZ2_congr hKclosed (gsQLoop_closed _ hG hGdet hGloop)
    { toFun := fun z : I × I =>
        gsSO (G z.2 * interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ)) *
          (gsSO (interpMatrix (A z.2) (z.1 : ℝ)))⁻¹
      continuous_toFun := hHcont
      map_zero_left := ?_
      map_one_left := ?_ } ?_
  · intro t
    show gsSO (G t * interpMatrix (A t) (((0 : I) : ℝ))) *
        (gsSO (interpMatrix (A t) (((0 : I) : ℝ))))⁻¹ = K t
    have h0 : interpMatrix (A t) (((0 : I) : ℝ)) = A t := interpMatrix_zero (A t)
    rw [h0, hKdef]
    rfl
  · intro t
    show gsSO (G t * interpMatrix (A t) (((1 : I) : ℝ))) *
        (gsSO (interpMatrix (A t) (((1 : I) : ℝ))))⁻¹ = gsSO (G t)
    have h1 : interpMatrix (A t) (((1 : I) : ℝ))
        = ((gsSO (A t) : SOGroup k) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) := by
      rw [gsSO_eq_of_det_pos (hAdet t)]
      exact interpMatrix_one (A t)
    rw [h1, gsSO_mul_SOGroup (hGdet t), gsSO_coe_SOGroup, mul_inv_cancel_right]
  · intro s
    show gsSO (G 0 * interpMatrix (A 0) ((s : ℝ))) *
        (gsSO (interpMatrix (A 0) ((s : ℝ))))⁻¹
      = gsSO (G 1 * interpMatrix (A 1) ((s : ℝ))) *
        (gsSO (interpMatrix (A 1) ((s : ℝ))))⁻¹
    rw [hGloop, hAloop]

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.continuous_rowsMatrix_frameAt
statement:
theorem continuous_rowsMatrix_frameAt (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T]
    {γ : T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hγc : Continuous γ)
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet X.g) (i j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Continuous fun t => rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t)) i j
proof:
:=
  (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp (continuous_frameAt_comp X hγc hγ i)

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.det_rowsMatrix_frameAt_pos'
statement:
theorem det_rowsMatrix_frameAt_pos' (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T]
    {γ : T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet X.g) (t : T) :
    0 < (rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t))).det
proof:
:=
  det_rowsMatrix_frameAt_pos X (hγ t)

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.frameSOLoop_coe
statement:
theorem frameSOLoop_coe (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (γ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hγc : Continuous γ) (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet X.g) (t : I) :
    ((frameSOLoop X γ hγc hγ t : SOGroup (n + 1)) :
        Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
      = rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X (γ t)))
proof:
:= by
  show ((gsSO (rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t))) : SOGroup (n + 1)) :
      Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) = _
  rw [gsSO_eq_of_det_pos (det_rowsMatrix_frameAt_pos X (hγ t))]
  rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.frameSOLoop_closed
statement:
theorem frameSOLoop_closed (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (γ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hγc : Continuous γ) (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet X.g) (hloop : γ 0 = γ 1) :
    frameSOLoop X γ hγc hγ 0 = frameSOLoop X γ hγc hγ 1
proof:
:=
  gsQLoop_closed _ _ _ (by rw [hloop])

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.det_pos_of_rowsMatrix_frameAt_eq
proof:
:= by
  have hXd : 0 < (rowsMatrix (frameAt X p)).det := det_rowsMatrix_frameAt_pos X hX
  have hYd : 0 < (rowsMatrix (frameAt Y p)).det := det_rowsMatrix_frameAt_pos Y hY
  rw [h, Matrix.det_mul] at hYd
  nlinarith [hXd, hYd]

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_of_comparison
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_of_comparison
    (X Y : FramedLevelSet n) (γ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (hγc : Continuous γ) (hX : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet X.g)
    (hY : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet Y.g) (hloop : γ 0 = γ 1)
    (G : I → Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hGcont : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => G t i j)
    (hGdet : ∀ t, 0 < (G t).det) (hGloop : G 0 = G 1)
    (hGeq : ∀ t, rowsMatrix (frameAt Y (γ t))
      = G t * rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t))) :
    loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop Y γ hγc hY) (frameSOLoop_closed Y γ hγc hY hloop)
      = loopClassZ2 (gsQLoop G hGcont hGdet)
          (gsQLoop_closed G hGcont hGdet hGloop)
        + loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop X γ hγc hX)
            (frameSOLoop_closed X γ hγc hX hloop)
proof:
:= by
  have hAcont := continuous_rowsMatrix_frameAt X hγc hX
  have hAdet := det_rowsMatrix_frameAt_pos' X hX
  have hGAcont : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t =>
      (G t * rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t))) i j := by
    intro i j
    have hrw : (fun t => (G t * rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t))) i j)
        = fun t => rowsMatrix (frameAt Y (γ t)) i j := by
      funext t
      rw [← hGeq t]
    rw [hrw]
    exact continuous_rowsMatrix_frameAt Y hγc hY i j
  have hGAdet : ∀ t, 0 < (G t * rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t))).det := by
    intro t
    rw [← hGeq t]
    exact det_rowsMatrix_frameAt_pos Y (hY t)
  have hGAloop : (fun t => G t * rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t))) 0
      = (fun t => G t * rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t))) 1 := by
    show G 0 * rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ 0)) = G 1 * rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ 1))
    rw [hGloop, hloop]
  have hsame : frameSOLoop Y γ hγc hY
      = gsQLoop (fun t => G t * rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t))) hGAcont hGAdet := by
    refine ContinuousMap.ext fun t => ?_
    show gsSO (rowsMatrix (frameAt Y (γ t)))
      = gsSO (G t * rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t)))
    rw [hGeq t]
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun (frameSOLoop_closed Y γ hγc hY hloop)
      (gsQLoop_closed _ hGAcont hGAdet hGAloop) hsame]
  exact loopClassZ2_gsQLoop_mul G (fun t => rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ t)))
    hGcont hAcont hGdet hAdet hGAcont hGAdet hGloop
    (by rw [hloop]) hGAloop

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.gradVec_eq_sum_of_fderiv_comp
statement:
theorem gradVec_eq_sum_of_fderiv_comp (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hC : fderiv ℝ Y.g p = C.comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p)) (i : Fin n) :
    gradVec Y.g i p
      = ∑ j : Fin n, PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C i j • gradVec X.g j p
proof:
:= by
  refine ext_inner_right ℝ fun w => ?_
  rw [inner_gradVec, sum_inner, hC]
  have hstep : (C.comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p)) w i
      = ∑ j : Fin n, PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C i j *
          (fderiv ℝ X.g p w) j :=
    PolarDecompositionCLM.clm_apply_coord C (fderiv ℝ X.g p w) i
  rw [hstep]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  rw [real_inner_smul_left, inner_gradVec]

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.normalBlock_zero_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalBlock_zero_zero (eps : ℝ) (D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    normalBlock eps D 0 0 = eps
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.normalBlock_zero_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalBlock_zero_succ (eps : ℝ) (D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (j : Fin n) : normalBlock eps D 0 j.succ = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.normalBlock_succ_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalBlock_succ_zero (eps : ℝ) (D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (i : Fin n) : normalBlock eps D i.succ 0 = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.normalBlock_succ_succ
statement:
@[simp] theorem normalBlock_succ_succ (eps : ℝ) (D : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (i j : Fin n) : normalBlock eps D i.succ j.succ = D i j
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.rowsMatrix_frameAt_eq_normalBlock_mul
statement:
theorem rowsMatrix_frameAt_eq_normalBlock_mul (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (C : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hC : fderiv ℝ Y.g p = C.comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p))
    (eps : ℝ) (htau : tauField Y.g p = eps • tauField X.g p) :
    rowsMatrix (frameAt Y p)
      = normalBlock eps (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C) *
        rowsMatrix (frameAt X p)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i', rfl⟩
  · have hlhs : rowsMatrix (frameAt Y p) 0 j = eps * (tauField X.g p) j := by
      show WithLp.ofLp (frameAt Y p 0) j = _
      rw [show frameAt Y p 0 = tauField Y.g p from rfl, htau]
      rfl
    rw [hlhs]
    have hzero : ∀ l : Fin n,
        normalBlock eps (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C) 0 l.succ *
          rowsMatrix (frameAt X p) l.succ j = 0 := by
      intro l
      rw [normalBlock_zero_succ, zero_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => hzero l, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero,
      normalBlock_zero_zero]
    rfl
  · have hlhs : rowsMatrix (frameAt Y p) i'.succ j = (gradVec Y.g i' p) j := by
      show WithLp.ofLp (frameAt Y p i'.succ) j = _
      rw [show frameAt Y p i'.succ = gradVec Y.g i' p from rfl]
    rw [hlhs, gradVec_eq_sum_of_fderiv_comp X Y p C hC i']
    rw [normalBlock_succ_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]
    have hsum : (∑ l : Fin n, PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C i' l •
        gradVec X.g l p) j
        = ∑ l : Fin n, PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix C i' l *
          (gradVec X.g l p) j := by
      simp
    rw [hsum]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun l _ => ?_
    rw [normalBlock_succ_succ]
    rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.frameSOLoop_congr
statement:
theorem frameSOLoop_congr (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {γ δ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hγc : Continuous γ) (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet X.g)
    (hδc : Continuous δ) (hδ : ∀ t, δ t ∈ regularSet X.g) (h : γ = δ) :
    frameSOLoop X γ hγc hγ = frameSOLoop X δ hδc hδ
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.continuous_flowLoop
statement:
theorem continuous_flowLoop {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (T : ℝ) :
    Continuous fun u : I => V.flow p ((u : ℝ) * T)
proof:
:=
  (V.continuous_flow p).comp (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.flowLoop_mem_regularSet
statement:
theorem flowLoop_mem_regularSet {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) (T : ℝ) (u : I) :
    V.flow p ((u : ℝ) * T) ∈ regularSet X.g
proof:
:=
  X.fiber_subset_regularSet (V.flow_mem_fiber hp _)

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.fundamentalFrameLoop_eq_frameSOLoop
statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameLoop_eq_frameSOLoop {X : FramedLevelSet n}
    (V : TamedField X) {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    V.fundamentalFrameLoop hp
      = frameSOLoop X (fun u : I => V.flow p ((u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp))
          (continuous_flowLoop V p _)
          (fun u => flowLoop_mem_regularSet V hp _ u)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousMap.ext fun u => ?_
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [frameSOLoop_coe]
  rfl

name: Submission.FrameGaugeDictionary.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_comparison
statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_comparison
    {X Y : FramedLevelSet n} (VX : TamedField X) (VY : TamedField Y)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hpX : p ∈ X.fiber) (hpY : p ∈ Y.fiber)
    (hflow : VY.flow p = VX.flow p)
    (hper : VY.fundamentalPeriod hpY = VX.fundamentalPeriod hpX)
    (G : I → Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
    (hGcont : ∀ i j, Continuous fun t => G t i j)
    (hGdet : ∀ t, 0 < (G t).det) (hGloop : G 0 = G 1)
    (hGeq : ∀ u : I,
      rowsMatrix (frameAt Y
          (VX.flow p ((u : ℝ) * VX.fundamentalPeriod hpX)))
        = G u * rowsMatrix (frameAt X
            (VX.flow p ((u : ℝ) * VX.fundamentalPeriod hpX)))) :
    VY.fundamentalFrameClass hpY
      = loopClassZ2 (gsQLoop G hGcont hGdet)
          (gsQLoop_closed G hGcont hGdet hGloop)
        + VX.fundamentalFrameClass hpX
proof:
:= by
  set T := VX.fundamentalPeriod hpX with hT
  set γ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) :=
    fun u : I => VX.flow p ((u : ℝ) * T) with hγdef
  have hγc : Continuous γ := continuous_flowLoop VX p T
  have hγX : ∀ u, γ u ∈ regularSet X.g := fun u =>
    flowLoop_mem_regularSet VX hpX T u
  have hγY : ∀ u, γ u ∈ regularSet Y.g := by
    intro u
    apply Y.fiber_subset_regularSet
    have h := VY.flow_mem_fiber hpY ((u : ℝ) * T)
    rwa [hflow] at h
  have hloop : γ 0 = γ 1 := by
    show VX.flow p (((0 : I) : ℝ) * T) = VX.flow p (((1 : I) : ℝ) * T)
    have h0 : (((0 : I) : ℝ)) * T = 0 := by norm_num
    have h1 : (((1 : I) : ℝ)) * T = 0 + T := by
      rw [zero_add]
      norm_num
    rw [h0, h1]
    exact (VX.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hpX 0).symm
  have hYloop : VY.fundamentalFrameLoop hpY = frameSOLoop Y γ hγc hγY := by
    rw [fundamentalFrameLoop_eq_frameSOLoop VY hpY]
    exact frameSOLoop_congr Y _ _ _ _ (by
      funext u
      rw [hγdef, hflow, hper])
  have hXloop : VX.fundamentalFrameLoop hpX = frameSOLoop X γ hγc hγX :=
    fundamentalFrameLoop_eq_frameSOLoop VX hpX
  rw [TamedField.fundamentalFrameClass, TamedField.fundamentalFrameClass,
    loopClassZ2_congr_fun (VY.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hpY)
      (frameSOLoop_closed Y γ hγc hγY hloop) hYloop,
    loopClassZ2_congr_fun (VX.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hpX)
      (frameSOLoop_closed X γ hγc hγX hloop) hXloop]
  exact loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_of_comparison X Y γ hγc hγX hγY hloop
    G hGcont hGdet hGloop hGeq

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_orbitTube_global_injOn
statement:
theorem exists_orbitTube_global_injOn (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    ∃ r > 0, Set.InjOn (V.orbitTube O)
      ((Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N) r)
proof:
:= by
  let Z : Set (C × N) := Set.range fun a : C => (a, (0 : N))
  have hZinj : Set.InjOn (V.orbitTube O) Z := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩ _ ⟨b, rfl⟩ hab
    have hab' : V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding O a =
        V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding O b := by
      simpa using hab
    have habase : a = b :=
      (V.isEmbedding_intrinsicOrbitEmbedding O).injective hab'
    subst b
    rfl
  have hZcompact : IsCompact Z :=
    isCompact_range (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hlocal : ∀ q ∈ Z, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 q, Set.InjOn (V.orbitTube O) U := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
    exact ⟨V.orbitTubeQuotientBox O u,
      (V.isOpen_orbitTubeQuotientBox O u).mem_nhds
        (V.orbitTube_zero_mem_quotientBox O u),
      V.orbitTube_injOn_quotientBox O u⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hTopen, hZT, hTinj⟩ := hZinj.exists_isOpen_superset
    hZcompact
    (fun _ _ => (V.continuous_orbitTube O).continuousAt)
    hlocal
  have hzeroSection :
      (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ ({0} : Set N) ⊆ T := by
    rintro ⟨a, z⟩ ⟨-, hz⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    change z = 0 at hz
    subst z
    exact hZT ⟨a, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨U, W, hUopen, hWopen, hCU, hzeroW, hUWT⟩ :=
    generalized_tube_lemma (X := C) (Y := N)
      isCompact_univ isCompact_singleton hTopen hzeroSection
  have hzero_mem_W : (0 : N) ∈ W := hzeroW (Set.mem_singleton 0)
  rcases (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hWopen) 0 hzero_mem_W with
    ⟨r, hr, hrW⟩
  refine ⟨r, hr, hTinj.mono ?_⟩
  exact (prod_mono hCU hrW).trans hUWT

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_orbitTube_global_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_orbitTube_global_embedding (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    ∃ r > 0,
      Set.InjOn (V.orbitTube O)
        ((Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N) r) ∧
      Topology.IsEmbedding
        (fun q : ↥((Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N) r) =>
          V.orbitTube O q.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRinj⟩ := V.exists_orbitTube_global_injOn O
  let r : ℝ := R / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := by
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  have hrR : r < R := by
    dsimp [r]
    linarith
  let Dopen : Set (C × N) :=
    (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N) r
  let Dclosed : Set (C × N) :=
    (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : N) r
  have hopenClosed : Dopen ⊆ Dclosed := by
    exact prod_mono Subset.rfl Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have hclosedBig : Dclosed ⊆
      (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N) R := by
    exact prod_mono Subset.rfl (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hrR)
  have hinjClosed : Set.InjOn (V.orbitTube O) Dclosed :=
    hRinj.mono hclosedBig
  have hcompact : IsCompact Dclosed := by
    exact isCompact_univ.prod (isCompact_closedBall (0 : N) r)
  letI : CompactSpace Dclosed := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hcompact
  have hcontClosed : Continuous
      (fun q : Dclosed => V.orbitTube O q.1) :=
    (V.continuous_orbitTube O).comp continuous_subtype_val
  have hinjClosed' : Function.Injective
      (fun q : Dclosed => V.orbitTube O q.1) := by
    intro p q hpq
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hinjClosed p.property q.property hpq
  have hembClosed : Topology.IsEmbedding
      (fun q : Dclosed => V.orbitTube O q.1) :=
    (hcontClosed.isClosedEmbedding hinjClosed').isEmbedding
  have hembOpen : Topology.IsEmbedding
      (fun q : Dopen => V.orbitTube O q.1) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Set.inclusion] using
      hembClosed.comp (Topology.IsEmbedding.inclusion hopenClosed)
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply hRinj.mono
    exact prod_mono Subset.rfl
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hrR))
  · exact hembOpen

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonCore_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma comparisonCore_apply_zero (s : ℝ) (x : E) :

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonCore_apply_one

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonCore_apply_two
statement:
lemma comparisonCore_apply_two (hm' : 0 < m) (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    comparisonCore m s x 2 =
      comparisonQ m s x * x 2 - comparisonP m s x * x 3
proof:
:= by
  have h20 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at this
  have h21 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at this
  simp [comparisonCore, h20, h21]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonCore_apply_tail
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonMap_smooth
statement:
lemma comparisonMap_smooth :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => comparisonMap m hm p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hcore : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => comparisonCore m p.1 p.2) := by
    rw [contDiff_piLp]
    intro i
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp only [comparisonCore_apply_zero]
      unfold comparisonNormSq
      exact (((contDiff_radSq (m := m)).comp contDiff_snd).add
        (contDiff_fst.mul
          ((CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.comp contDiff_snd).sub
            ((contDiff_radSq (m := m)).comp contDiff_snd)))).sub
              contDiff_const |>.div_const 2
    · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
      · subst i
        simp only [comparisonCore_apply_one]
        unfold comparisonP comparisonQ
        fun_prop
      · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
        · subst i
          simp only [comparisonCore_apply_two m hm]
          unfold comparisonP comparisonQ
          fun_prop
        · simp only [comparisonCore_apply_tail m _ _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
          fun_prop
  unfold comparisonMap
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub (CompactBirth.contDiff_cutoff.comp contDiff_snd)).smul
      hcore).add
    ((CompactBirth.contDiff_cutoff.comp contDiff_snd).smul contDiff_const)

statement:

    CompactHopfPairConfiguration.background m hm =
      CompactTubeConfiguration.background m
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · subst i

  · simp [CompactHopfPairConfiguration.background_apply_ne_zero m hm hi,
      CompactTubeConfiguration.background_apply_ne_zero m hi]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonCore_zero
statement:
lemma comparisonCore_zero (x : E) :
    comparisonCore m 0 x =
      coordinateReflection (reflectionIndex m hm)
        (CompactTubeConfiguration.coreMap m x)
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    have h0r : (0 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ reflectionIndex m hm := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [reflectionIndex] at hv
    rw [coordinateReflection_apply_ne _ _ h0r]
    simp
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      have h1r : (1 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ reflectionIndex m hm := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [reflectionIndex, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2)] at hv
      rw [coordinateReflection_apply_ne _ _ h1r]
      simp
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        have h2r : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) = reflectionIndex m hm := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp [reflectionIndex, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)]
        rw [← h2r, coordinateReflection_apply_same]
        have h20 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
          simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at hv
        rw [CompactTubeConfiguration.coreMap_apply_ne_zero m x h20]
        rw [comparisonCore_apply_two m hm]
        simp only [comparisonP_zero,
          comparisonQ_zero, zero_mul, one_mul, zero_sub, neg_inj]
        apply congrArg (fun j : Fin (m + 3) => x j)
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)]
        all_goals exact hm
      · have hir : i ≠ reflectionIndex m hm := by
          intro h
          apply hi2
          apply Fin.ext
          have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
          simpa [reflectionIndex, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] using hv
        rw [coordinateReflection_apply_ne _ _ hir]
        rw [comparisonCore_apply_tail m 0 x hi0 hi1 hi2,
          CompactTubeConfiguration.coreMap_apply_ne_zero m x hi0]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.coordinateReflection_tube_background
statement:
lemma coordinateReflection_tube_background :
    coordinateReflection (reflectionIndex m hm)
        (CompactTubeConfiguration.background m) =
      CompactTubeConfiguration.background m
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hir : i = reflectionIndex m hm
  · rw [hir, coordinateReflection_apply_same]
    have hr0 : reflectionIndex m hm ≠ (0 : Fin (m + 2)) := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [reflectionIndex] at hv
    simp [CompactTubeConfiguration.background_apply_ne_zero m hr0]
  · rw [coordinateReflection_apply_ne _ _ hir]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonMap_zero
statement: lemma comparisonMap_zero : comparisonMap m hm 0 = (reflectedTubeFLS m hm).g
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  change comparisonMap m hm 0 x =
    coordinateReflection (reflectionIndex m hm)
      (CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap m x)
  rw [comparisonMap, CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap,
    comparisonCore_zero m hm x, hopf_background_eq_tube_background m hm]
  rw [map_add, map_smul, map_smul,
    coordinateReflection_tube_background m hm]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonCore_one
statement:
lemma comparisonCore_one (x : E) :
    comparisonCore m 1 x = CompactHopfPairPants.coreMap m hm 2 0 x
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    simp
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      simp [CompactHopfPairPants.pairRe,
        CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfRe]
      ring
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        simp [comparisonCore_apply_two m hm,
          CompactHopfPairPants.pairIm,
          CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfIm]
        ring
      · rw [comparisonCore_apply_tail m 1 x hi0 hi1 hi2,
          CompactHopfPairPants.coreMap_apply_tail m hm 2 0 x hi0 hi1 hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonMap_one

:= by

    CompactHopfPairPants.levelMap m hm 2 0 x
  rw [comparisonMap, CompactHopfPairPants.levelMap,
    comparisonCore_one m hm x]

statement:
@[simp] lemma comparisonMap_apply_zero (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    comparisonMap m hm s x 0 =
      (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) *
          ((comparisonNormSq m s x - 1) / 2) +
        CompactBirth.cutoff x
proof:
:= by
  simp [comparisonMap]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonMap_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma comparisonMap_apply_one (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    comparisonMap m hm s x 1 =

        (comparisonP m s x * x 2 + comparisonQ m s x * x 3)
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonMap_apply_two
statement:
lemma comparisonMap_apply_two (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    comparisonMap m hm s x 2 =
      (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) *
        (comparisonQ m s x * x 2 - comparisonP m s x * x 3)
proof:
:= by
  rw [comparisonMap]
  simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, comparisonCore_apply_two m hm]
  have h20 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at hv
  rw [CompactHopfPairConfiguration.background_apply_ne_zero m hm h20]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonMap_apply_tail

lemma comparisonMap_apply_tail (s : ℝ) (x : E) {i : Fin (m + 2)}
    (hi0 : i ≠ 0) (hi1 : i ≠ 1) (hi2 : i ≠ 2) :
    comparisonMap m hm s x i =
      (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) * x i.succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [comparisonMap]
  simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply,
    comparisonCore_apply_tail m s x hi0 hi1 hi2]
