name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.cutoff_lt_one_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma cutoff_lt_one_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero {s : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : comparisonMap m hm s x = 0) : CompactBirth.cutoff x < 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
  rw [comparisonMap_apply_zero] at h0
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h0
  have hc1 := CompactBirth.cutoff_le_one x
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne hc1
  intro hc
  rw [hc] at h0
  norm_num at h0

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonNormSq_le_one_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma comparisonNormSq_le_one_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero {s : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : comparisonMap m hm s x = 0) : comparisonNormSq m s x ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
  rw [comparisonMap_apply_zero] at h0
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h0
  have hc_lt := cutoff_lt_one_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have hc0 := CompactBirth.cutoff_nonneg x
  by_contra hn
  have hrad : 0 < (comparisonNormSq m s x - 1) / 2 := by linarith
  have hprod : 0 < (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) *
      ((comparisonNormSq m s x - 1) / 2) :=
    mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hc_lt) hrad
  linarith

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.radSq_le_comparisonNormSq
statement:
lemma radSq_le_comparisonNormSq (s : ℝ) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (x : E) :
    radSq x ≤ comparisonNormSq m s x
proof:
:= by
  have htail : 0 ≤ CompactBirth.normSq x - radSq x := by
    rw [sub_nonneg, CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    exact radSq_le_normSq x
  unfold comparisonNormSq
  exact le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg hs0 htail)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonP_pos_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma comparisonP_pos_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s)
    {x : E} (hx : comparisonMap m hm s x = 0) :
    0 < comparisonP m s x
proof:
:= by
  have hQ := comparisonNormSq_le_one_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have hrs := radSq_le_comparisonNormSq m s hs0 x
  have hx0sq : x 0 ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    unfold radSq at hrs
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 1)]
  have hx0 : -1 ≤ x 0 := by nlinarith
  unfold comparisonP
  nlinarith

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.pair_coordinates_eq_zero_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hc_lt := cutoff_lt_one_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have hfac : 1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hc_lt)
  have h1 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 1) hx
  rw [comparisonMap_apply_one] at h1
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h1
  have hA : comparisonP m s x * x 2 + comparisonQ m s x * x 3 = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp h1).resolve_left hfac
  have h2 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 2) hx
  rw [comparisonMap_apply_two] at h2
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h2
  have hB : comparisonQ m s x * x 2 - comparisonP m s x * x 3 = 0 :=
    (mul_eq_zero.mp h2).resolve_left hfac
  have hp := comparisonP_pos_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm hs0 hx
  have hden : 0 < comparisonP m s x ^ 2 + comparisonQ m s x ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (comparisonQ m s x)]
  have hx2prod :
      (comparisonP m s x ^ 2 + comparisonQ m s x ^ 2) * x 2 = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = comparisonP m s x *
            (comparisonP m s x * x 2 + comparisonQ m s x * x 3) +
          comparisonQ m s x *
            (comparisonQ m s x * x 2 - comparisonP m s x * x 3) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hA, hB]; ring
  have hx3prod :
      (comparisonP m s x ^ 2 + comparisonQ m s x ^ 2) * x 3 = 0 := by
    calc
      _ = comparisonQ m s x *
            (comparisonP m s x * x 2 + comparisonQ m s x * x 3) -
          comparisonP m s x *
            (comparisonQ m s x * x 2 - comparisonP m s x * x 3) := by ring
      _ = 0 := by rw [hA, hB]; ring
  exact ⟨(mul_eq_zero.mp hx2prod).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hden),
    (mul_eq_zero.mp hx3prod).resolve_left (ne_of_gt hden)⟩

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.transverse_eq_zero_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi1 : i = 1
  · subst i
    have hz := (pair_coordinates_eq_zero_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm hs0 hx).1
    simpa using hz
  · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
    · subst i
      have hz := (pair_coordinates_eq_zero_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm hs0 hx).2
      let j3 : Fin (m + 3) := ⟨3, by omega⟩
      have hj : (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ = j3 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [j3, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)]
      rw [hj]
      change x j3 = 0
      convert hz using 1
      apply congrArg (fun j : Fin (m + 3) => x j)
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [j3, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)]
    · have hout := congrArg (fun q : F => q i) hx
      rw [comparisonMap_apply_tail m hm s x hi hi1 hi2] at hout
      simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hout
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hout).resolve_left
        (sub_ne_zero.mpr
          (cutoff_lt_one_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm hx).ne')

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.normSq_eq_radSq_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  unfold CompactBirth.normSq radSq
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
  have htail : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1), x i.succ.succ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    intro i
    let j : Fin (m + 2) := i.succ
    have hj : j ≠ 0 := Fin.succ_ne_zero i
    have hz : x j.succ = 0 :=
      transverse_eq_zero_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm hs0 hx hj
    simpa [j, hz]
  simp only [htail, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle
statement:
theorem comparisonMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle (s : ℝ)
    (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) (x : E) :
    comparisonMap m hm s x = 0 ↔ x ∈ standardCircle
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hnorm := normSq_eq_radSq_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm hs0 hx
    have hQ := comparisonNormSq_le_one_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm hx
    have hrs : radSq x ≤ 1 := by
      unfold comparisonNormSq at hQ
      rw [hnorm] at hQ
      simpa using hQ
    have hc : CompactBirth.cutoff x = 0 := by
      apply CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero
      rw [hnorm]
      linarith
    have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
    rw [comparisonMap_apply_zero, hc] at h0
    simp only [sub_zero, one_mul, zero_add, PiLp.zero_apply] at h0
    have hrs1 : radSq x = 1 := by
      unfold comparisonNormSq at h0
      rw [hnorm] at h0
      simpa using (show radSq x = 1 by linarith)
    apply (CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle m x).mp
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap, hc, hrs1]
    · simp [CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap, hc,
        CompactTubeConfiguration.coreMap_apply_ne_zero m x hi,
        transverse_eq_zero_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm hs0 hx hi]
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨theta, rfl⟩ := hx
    have hnorm : CompactBirth.normSq (circleAt (m := m) theta) = 1 := by
      rw [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq, norm_circleAt, one_pow]
    have hc : CompactBirth.cutoff (circleAt (m := m) theta) = 0 :=
      CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero (by rw [hnorm]; norm_num)
    have hx2 : circleAt (m := m) theta 2 = 0 := by
      apply circleAt_apply_other theta
      · intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3)] at hv
      · intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3)] at hv
    have hx3 : circleAt (m := m) theta 3 = 0 := by
      apply circleAt_apply_other theta
      · intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)] at hv
      · intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)] at hv
    rw [comparisonMap, hc]
    simp only [sub_zero, one_smul, zero_smul, add_zero]
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [comparisonCore, comparisonNormSq, hnorm, radSq_circleAt]
    · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
      · subst i
        rw [comparisonCore_apply_one, hx2, hx3]
        simp
      · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
        · subst i
          rw [comparisonCore_apply_two m hm]
          rw [hx2, hx3]
          simp
        · rw [comparisonCore_apply_tail m s _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
          apply circleAt_apply_other theta
          · exact Fin.succ_ne_zero i
          · intro h
            apply hi0
            apply Fin.succ_injective
            simpa using h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.contDiff_comparisonCore
statement:
lemma contDiff_comparisonCore (hm' : 0 < m) (s : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (comparisonCore m s)
proof:
:= by
  
  
  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    simp only [comparisonCore_apply_zero]
    unfold comparisonNormSq
    exact ((contDiff_radSq (m := m)).add
      (contDiff_const.mul
        (CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.sub (contDiff_radSq (m := m))))).sub
          contDiff_const |>.div_const 2
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      simp only [comparisonCore_apply_one]
      unfold comparisonP comparisonQ
      fun_prop
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        simp only [comparisonCore_apply_two m hm']
        unfold comparisonP comparisonQ
        fun_prop
      · simp only [comparisonCore_apply_tail m s _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i.succ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.fderiv_coord_apply
statement:
private lemma fderiv_coord_apply
    (G : E → F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => G q i) x h = fderiv ℝ G x h i
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj i
  have hG' : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G x) x :=
    (hG.differentiable infty_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun q => G q i)
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ G x)) x := by
    exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (G x) i).comp x hG'
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hcomp.fderiv
  simpa [outProj] using happ

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_one
statement:
lemma fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_one (hm' : 0 < m) (s : ℝ) (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (comparisonCore m s) x h 1 =
      s * h 0 * x 2 + comparisonP m s x * h 2 +
        s * h 1 * x 3 + comparisonQ m s x * h 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (comparisonCore m s)
    (contDiff_comparisonCore m hm' s) 1 x h]
  let p0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  let p2 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 2
  let p3 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 3
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 0) p0 x := p0.hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 1) p1 x := p1.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 2) p2 x := p2.hasFDerivAt
  have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 3) p3 x := p3.hasFDerivAt
  have hd := h2.add
    ((((h0.mul h2).add h2).add (h1.mul h3)).const_mul s)
  have hevent : (fun q : E =>
      q 2 + s * (q 0 * q 2 + q 2 + q 1 * q 3)) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      ((fun q : E => q 2) + fun q =>
        s * (q 0 * q 2 + q 2 + q 1 * q 3)) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl
  have hd' := hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hevent
  have hfun : (fun q : E => comparisonCore m s q 1) = fun q =>
      q 2 + s * (q 0 * q 2 + q 2 + q 1 * q 3) := by
    funext q
    rw [comparisonCore_apply_one]
    simp [comparisonP, comparisonQ]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hd'.fderiv
  simp [p0, p1, p2, p3] at happ
  rw [happ]
  unfold comparisonP comparisonQ
  ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_two
statement:
lemma fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_two (hm' : 0 < m) (s : ℝ) (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (comparisonCore m s) x h 2 =
      s * h 1 * x 2 + comparisonQ m s x * h 2 -
        s * h 0 * x 3 - comparisonP m s x * h 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (comparisonCore m s)
    (contDiff_comparisonCore m hm' s) 2 x h]
  let p0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  let p2 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 2
  let p3 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 3
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 0) p0 x := p0.hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 1) p1 x := p1.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 2) p2 x := p2.hasFDerivAt
  have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 3) p3 x := p3.hasFDerivAt
  have hd := h3.neg.add
    ((((h1.mul h2).sub (h0.mul h3)).sub h3).const_mul s)
  have hevent : (fun q : E =>
      -q 3 + s * (q 1 * q 2 - q 0 * q 3 - q 3)) =ᶠ[nhds x]
      ((- fun q : E => q 3) + fun q =>
        s * (q 1 * q 2 - q 0 * q 3 - q 3)) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl
  have hd' := hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hevent
  have hfun : (fun q : E => comparisonCore m s q 2) = fun q =>
      -q 3 + s * (q 1 * q 2 - q 0 * q 3 - q 3) := by
    funext q
    rw [comparisonCore_apply_two m hm']
    simp [comparisonP, comparisonQ]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hd'.fderiv
  simp [p0, p1, p2, p3] at happ
  rw [happ]
  unfold comparisonP comparisonQ
  ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_tail
statement:
lemma fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_tail (hm' : 0 < m) (s : ℝ) (x h : E)
    {i : Fin (m + 2)} (hi0 : i ≠ 0) (hi1 : i ≠ 1) (hi2 : i ≠ 2) :
    fderiv ℝ (comparisonCore m s) x h i = h i.succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (comparisonCore m s)
    (contDiff_comparisonCore m hm' s) i x h]
  have hfun : (fun q : E => comparisonCore m s q i) = fun q => q i.succ := by
    funext q
    exact comparisonCore_apply_tail m s q hi0 hi1 hi2
  rw [hfun]
  exact congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h)
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i.succ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.fderiv

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.fderiv_radialCore_apply
statement:
lemma fderiv_radialCore_apply (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q : E => (radSq q - 1) / 2) x h =
      x 0 * h 0 + x 1 * h 1
proof:
:= by
  let p0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 0) p0 x := p0.hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 1) p1 x := p1.hasFDerivAt
  have hd := (((h0.pow 2).add (h1.pow 2)).sub_const 1).const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  have hfun : (fun q : E => (radSq q - 1) / 2) = fun q =>
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (q 0 ^ 2 + q 1 ^ 2 - 1) := by
    funext q
    simp [radSq]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hd.fderiv
  calc
    _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (2 * x 0 * h 0) +
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (2 * x 1 * h 1) := by
      simpa [p0, p1] using happ
    _ = x 0 * h 0 + x 1 * h 1 := by ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_zero_of_standardCircle
statement:
lemma fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_zero_of_standardCircle
    (hm' : 0 < m) (s : ℝ) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ standardCircle) (h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (comparisonCore m s) x h 0 = ⟪x, h⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (comparisonCore m s)
    (contDiff_comparisonCore m hm' s) 0 x h]
  have hfun : (fun q : E => comparisonCore m s q 0) = fun q =>
      (1 - s) * ((radSq q - 1) / 2) +
        s * (CompactHopfPairPants.coreMap m hm' 2 0 q 0) := by
    funext q
    simp [comparisonNormSq]
    ring
  rw [hfun]
  let radial : E → ℝ := fun q => (radSq q - 1) / 2
  let targetRow : E → ℝ := fun q =>
    CompactHopfPairPants.coreMap m hm' 2 0 q 0
  have hradDiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ radial x :=
    (((contDiff_radSq (m := m)).sub contDiff_const).div_const 2).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero x
  have htargetDiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ targetRow x :=
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj 0 : F →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp
      (CompactHopfPairPants.contDiff_coreMap m hm' 2 0)).differentiable
        infty_ne_zero x
  have hd := (hradDiff.hasFDerivAt.const_mul (1 - s)).add
    (htargetDiff.hasFDerivAt.const_mul s)
  have hevent :
      (fun q : E => (1 - s) * radial q + s * targetRow q) =ᶠ[nhds x]
        ((fun q : E => (1 - s) * radial q) + fun q => s * targetRow q) :=
    Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl
  have hd' := hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq hevent
  have hdval := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hd'.fderiv
  have hderiv :
      fderiv ℝ (fun q : E => (1 - s) * radial q + s * targetRow q) x h =
        (1 - s) * fderiv ℝ radial x h +
          s * fderiv ℝ targetRow x h := by
    simpa using hdval
  rw [show (fun q : E =>
      (1 - s) * ((radSq q - 1) / 2) +
        s * CompactHopfPairPants.coreMap m hm' 2 0 q 0) =
      (fun q : E => (1 - s) * radial q + s * targetRow q) by rfl]
  rw [hderiv]
  have htarget : fderiv ℝ targetRow x h = ⟪x, h⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [fderiv_coord_apply m (CompactHopfPairPants.coreMap m hm' 2 0)
      (CompactHopfPairPants.contDiff_coreMap m hm' 2 0)]
    exact CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_zero m hm' x h
  have hrad := fderiv_radialCore_apply m x h
  have hradInner : x 0 * h 0 + x 1 * h 1 = ⟪x, h⟫_ℝ := by
    obtain ⟨theta, rfl⟩ := hx
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
    have hsum : ∑ j : Fin (m + 3),
        ⟪circleAt (m := m) theta j, h j⟫_ℝ =
          circleAt (m := m) theta 0 * h 0 +
            circleAt (m := m) theta 1 * h 1 := by
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
      have htail : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1),
          ⟪circleAt (m := m) theta j.succ.succ,
            h j.succ.succ⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
        intro j
        rw [circleAt_apply_other theta]
        · simp [RCLike.inner_apply]
        · exact Fin.succ_ne_zero _
        · intro hj
          have hv := congrArg Fin.val hj
          simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_one] at hv
          omega
      simp only [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, htail, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
      simp [RCLike.inner_apply]
      ring
    exact hsum.symm
  rw [htarget, hrad, hradInner]
  ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonPreimage_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma comparisonPreimage_apply_zero (s : ℝ) (x : E) (y : F) :
    comparisonPreimage m s x y 0 = x 0 * y 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [comparisonPreimage]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonPreimage_apply_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma comparisonPreimage_apply_succ (s : ℝ) (x : E) (y : F)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    comparisonPreimage m s x y i.succ =
      if i = 0 then x 1 * y 0
      else if i = 1 then
        (comparisonP m s x * y 1 + comparisonQ m s x * y 2) /
          (comparisonP m s x ^ 2 + comparisonQ m s x ^ 2)
      else if i = 2 then
        (comparisonQ m s x * y 1 - comparisonP m s x * y 2) /
          (comparisonP m s x ^ 2 + comparisonQ m s x ^ 2)
      else y i
proof:
:= by
  simp [comparisonPreimage]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonPreimage_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma comparisonPreimage_apply_one (s : ℝ) (x : E) (y : F) :
    comparisonPreimage m s x y 1 = x 1 * y 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : Fin (m + 3)) = (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  calc
    comparisonPreimage m s x y 1 =
        comparisonPreimage m s x y (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => comparisonPreimage m s x y j) h1
    _ = _ := by
      simpa using comparisonPreimage_apply_succ m s x y (0 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonPreimage_apply_two
statement:
@[simp] lemma comparisonPreimage_apply_two (hm' : 0 < m)
    (s : ℝ) (x : E) (y : F) :
    comparisonPreimage m s x y 2 =
      (comparisonP m s x * y 1 + comparisonQ m s x * y 2) /
        (comparisonP m s x ^ 2 + comparisonQ m s x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : Fin (m + 3)) = (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3)]
  have h10 : (1 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2)] at hv
  calc
    comparisonPreimage m s x y 2 =
        comparisonPreimage m s x y (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => comparisonPreimage m s x y j) h2
    _ = _ := by
      simpa [h10] using
        comparisonPreimage_apply_succ m s x y (1 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonPreimage_apply_three
statement:
@[simp] lemma comparisonPreimage_apply_three (hm' : 0 < m)
    (s : ℝ) (x : E) (y : F) :
    comparisonPreimage m s x y 3 =
      (comparisonQ m s x * y 1 - comparisonP m s x * y 2) /
        (comparisonP m s x ^ 2 + comparisonQ m s x ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : (3 : Fin (m + 3)) = (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)]
  have h20 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at hv
  have h21 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at hv
  calc
    comparisonPreimage m s x y 3 =
        comparisonPreimage m s x y (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => comparisonPreimage m s x y j) h3
    _ = _ := by
      simpa [h20, h21] using
        comparisonPreimage_apply_succ m s x y (2 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonPreimage_apply_tail
statement:
lemma comparisonPreimage_apply_tail (s : ℝ) (x : E) (y : F)
    {i : Fin (m + 2)} (hi0 : i ≠ 0) (hi1 : i ≠ 1) (hi2 : i ≠ 2) :
    comparisonPreimage m s x y i.succ = y i
proof:
:= by
  simp [comparisonPreimage, hi0, hi1, hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.inner_eq_sum_local
statement:
private lemma inner_eq_sum_local (x h : E) :
    ⟪x, h⟫_ℝ = ∑ j, x j * h j
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by
    simp [RCLike.inner_apply, mul_comm]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparison_denominator_pos
statement:
lemma comparison_denominator_pos (hm' : 0 < m)
    (s : ℝ) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ standardCircle) :
    0 < comparisonP m s x ^ 2 + comparisonQ m s x ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hzero :=
    (comparisonMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle m hm' s hs0 hs1 x).mpr hx
  have hp := comparisonP_pos_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm' hs0 hzero
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (comparisonQ m s x)]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.inner_comparisonPreimage
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨theta, rfl⟩ := hx
  rw [inner_eq_sum_local]
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.succ_zero_eq_one, comparisonPreimage_apply_zero,
    comparisonPreimage_apply_one]
  have htail : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1),
      circleAt (m := m) theta j.succ.succ *
        comparisonPreimage m s (circleAt theta) y j.succ.succ = 0 := by
    intro j
    rw [circleAt_apply_other theta]
    · ring
    · exact Fin.succ_ne_zero _
    · intro hj
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val hj
      simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_one] at hv
      omega
  simp only [htail, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  rw [circleAt_apply_zero, circleAt_apply_one]
  calc
    Real.cos theta * (Real.cos theta * y 0) +
        Real.sin theta * (Real.sin theta * y 0) =
      (Real.sin theta ^ 2 + Real.cos theta ^ 2) * y 0 := by ring
    _ = y 0 := by rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq, one_mul]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.fderiv_comparisonCore_comparisonPreimage
statement:
lemma fderiv_comparisonCore_comparisonPreimage
    (hm' : 0 < m) (s : ℝ) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ standardCircle) (y : F) :
    fderiv ℝ (comparisonCore m s) x (comparisonPreimage m s x y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have hzero :=
    (comparisonMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle m hm' s hs0 hs1 x).mpr hx
  have hu := pair_coordinates_eq_zero_of_comparisonMap_eq_zero m hm' hs0 hzero
  have hden := comparison_denominator_pos m hm' s hs0 hs1 hx
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_zero_of_standardCircle m hm' s hx,
      inner_comparisonPreimage m s hx y]
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      rw [fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_one m hm']
      simp only [comparisonPreimage_apply_zero, comparisonPreimage_apply_one,
        comparisonPreimage_apply_two m hm', comparisonPreimage_apply_three m hm',
        hu.1, hu.2, mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]
      field_simp
      ring
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        rw [fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_two m hm']
        simp only [comparisonPreimage_apply_zero, comparisonPreimage_apply_one,
          comparisonPreimage_apply_two m hm', comparisonPreimage_apply_three m hm',
          hu.1, hu.2, mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, sub_zero]
        field_simp
        ring
      · rw [fderiv_comparisonCore_apply_tail m hm' s x _ hi0 hi1 hi2,
          comparisonPreimage_apply_tail m s x y hi0 hi1 hi2]

theorem reflectedTube_positiveFrameLedger_eq_single_one :
    (FiberSign.allPositive (reflectedTubeFLS m hm)).positiveFrameLedger
      (reflectedTubeField m hm) = [(1 : ZMod 2)]
proof:
:= by
  let V := CompactTubeConfiguration.field m
  let W := reflectedTubeField m hm
  let T := V.coordinateReflectionDeltaTransport (reflectionIndex m hm)
  let Tselected : V.SelectedDeltaTransport W
      ((FiberSign.allPositive (CompactTubeConfiguration.X m)).positiveOrbitCollection V)
      ((FiberSign.allPositive (reflectedTubeFLS m hm)).positiveOrbitCollection W) :=
    TamedField.SelectedDeltaTransport.ofDeltaTransport T (by
      intro O
      constructor <;> intro _
      · exact allPositive_selects_orbit m W (T.orbitEquiv O)
      · exact allPositive_selects_orbit m V O)
  have hp := TamedField.SelectedDeltaTransport.selectedFrameLedger_perm V W Tselected
  have hsource := tube_allPositive_ledger m
  change ((FiberSign.allPositive
      (CompactTubeConfiguration.X m)).positiveFrameLedger V).Perm
    ((FiberSign.allPositive
      (reflectedTubeFLS m hm)).positiveFrameLedger W) at hp
  dsimp [V, W] at hp
  rw [hsource] at hp
  have hcount := hp.length_eq
  have hall : ∀ z ∈
      (FiberSign.allPositive (reflectedTubeFLS m hm)).positiveFrameLedger W,
      z = (1 : ZMod 2) := by
    intro z hz
    have hzsrc : z ∈ [(1 : ZMod 2)] := hp.mem_iff.mpr hz
    simpa using hzsrc
  calc
    (FiberSign.allPositive (reflectedTubeFLS m hm)).positiveFrameLedger W =
        List.replicate
          ((FiberSign.allPositive
            (reflectedTubeFLS m hm)).positiveFrameLedger W).length 1 :=
      List.eq_replicate_length.mpr hall
    _ = [(1 : ZMod 2)] := by rw [← hcount]; rfl

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleBandBeforeArcsChartLocal_of_positiveSegments

name: Submission.fderiv_gauge_apply_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fderiv_gauge_apply_of_eq_zero
    {Q : E → F →L[ℝ] F} {g : E → F}
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    {x : E} (hx : g x = 0) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => Q y (g y)) x =
      (Q x).comp (fderiv ℝ g x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fderiv_clm_apply
    (hQ.differentiable (by simp) x)
    (hg.differentiable (by simp) x), hx]
  simp

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.gaugeTransform_g
statement:
@[simp] theorem gaugeTransform_g (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (Q : E → F →L[ℝ] F) (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q)
    (hQbij : ∀ x, Bijective (Q x)) (x : E) :
    (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij).g x = Q x (X.g x)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.gaugeTransform_fiber
statement:
theorem gaugeTransform_fiber (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (Q : E → F →L[ℝ] F) (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q)
    (hQbij : ∀ x, Bijective (Q x)) :
    (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij).fiber = X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change Q x (X.g x) = 0 at hx
    apply (hQbij x).1
    simpa using hx
  · intro hx
    change X.g x = 0 at hx
    change Q x (X.g x) = 0
    simp [hx]

name: Submission.contDiff_gauge_slice
statement:
theorem contDiff_gauge_slice
    {Q : ℝ → E → F →L[ℝ] F}
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => Q p.1 p.2)) (s : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Q s)
proof:

  hQ.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)

name: Submission.DefiningMapHomotopy.ofGauge_H
statement:
@[simp] theorem ofGauge_H (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (Q : ℝ → E → F →L[ℝ] F)
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => Q p.1 p.2))
    (hQzero : ∀ x, Q 0 x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F)
    (hQbij : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x, Bijective (Q s x))
    (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    (ofGauge X Q hQ hQzero hQbij).H s x = Q s x (X.g x)

:=

name: Submission.DefiningMapHomotopy.ofGauge_restrict_eq_gaugeTransform
statement:
theorem ofGauge_restrict_eq_gaugeTransform
    (X : FramedLevelSet n) (S : FiberSign X)
    (Q : ℝ → E → F →L[ℝ] F)
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => Q p.1 p.2))
    (hQzero : ∀ x, Q 0 x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F)
    (hQbij : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x, Bijective (Q s x)) :
    S.restrict (ofGauge X Q hQ hQzero hQbij).fiber_subset =
      S.gaugeTransform (Q 1) (contDiff_gauge_slice hQ 1)
        (fun x => hQbij 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ x)

:= by
  cases S
  rfl

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeExactReduction.ExactCompactTrace.nonempty_cobordism
statement:
theorem nonempty_cobordism (D : ExactCompactTrace m Z S T) :

proof:
:= by
  induction D with
  | refl S =>
      exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_refl S
  | @step kind tail Y T next ih =>
      exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeExactReduction.DeterministicPlan.nonempty_toDiagonal
statement:
theorem nonempty_toDiagonal (D : DeterministicPlan m Z P N) :
    Nonempty
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism D.source.sign
        (DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard m P.delta).sign)
proof:
:=
  SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
    D.trace.nonempty_cobordism D.finalRefl.nonempty_cobordism

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeExactReduction.Data.nonempty_normalize
statement:
theorem nonempty_normalize (D : Data m B) :
    Nonempty
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism B.fiberSign
        (DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard m B.northDelta).sign)
proof:
:= by
  have hindex :
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign).delta =
        B.northDelta := by
    calc
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign).delta =
          B.fiberSign.positiveDelta :=
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveDelta_eq_positiveLedger_delta
          m B.fiberSign).symm
      _ = B.northDelta := B.northDelta_eq_positiveDelta.symm
  have h := SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
    D.initial D.plan.nonempty_toDiagonal
  rw [hindex] at h
  exact h

name: Submission.positiveOrbitCollection_mem_of_slice_transport

    (S : FiberSign X) (T : FiberSign Y) (hST : HEq S T)
    (V : TamedField X)

    (hA : A ∈ S.positiveOrbitCollection V) :
    A ∈ T.positiveOrbitCollection (hXY ▸ V)

  subst Y
  have hST' : S = T := eq_of_heq hST
  subst T

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalSurfaceRadialPath_fiber
statement:
theorem criticalSurfaceRadialPath_fiber
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (q : I) :
    (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
      (R.criticalSurfaceRadialPath p hp u hu q) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply R.criticalSurfaceParam_fiber
  have hqnorm : ‖(q : ℝ) • u‖ ≤ ‖u‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg q.2.1]
    nlinarith [q.2.2, norm_nonneg u]
  exact hqnorm.trans_lt hu

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.exists_positiveFlowEndpoint_criticalSaddleBoundaryEnd
statement:
theorem exists_positiveFlowEndpoint_criticalSaddleBoundaryEnd
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    {K : Set E'}
    (T : CompactTimeTamedField
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C₀.cobordism).toLevelCobordismData K)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .saddle)
    (b e : SaddleBranch) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hρrad : ρ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hu₀K : R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0 ∈ K)
    {r εcover εbranch A : ℝ}
    (hrShrink : r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : E', dist v (R.criticalCenter p) < εcover →
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C₀.cobordism).G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧ R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp u = v)
    (hbranch : ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r →
      dist (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp u)
        (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0) < εbranch →
      0 < signedBranch b (u 0))
    (hAsafe : A ^ 2 ≤ T.safeTime)
    (hcenterClose : dist
        (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0)
        (R.criticalCenter p) + (T.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εcover)
    (hbranchClose : (T.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εbranch) :
    ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧
      R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp u =
        T.base.flow
          (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0) (A ^ 2) ∧
      0 < signedBranch b (u 0) ∧
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  apply R.exists_positiveFlowEndpoint_morseParam T p hp hindex b 0
    (saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e ρ 0)
  · rw [norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e hρ]
    · exact hρrad
    · nlinarith
  · simp [saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam]
  · simpa [criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd] using hu₀K
  · exact hrShrink
  · exact hcover
  · simpa [criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd] using hbranch
  · exact hAsafe
  · simpa [criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd] using hcenterClose
  · exact hbranchClose

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.exists_negativeFlowEndpoint_criticalSaddleBoundaryEnd
statement:
theorem exists_negativeFlowEndpoint_criticalSaddleBoundaryEnd
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    {K : Set E'}
    (T : CompactTimeTamedField
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C₀.cobordism).toLevelCobordismData K)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .saddle)
    (b e : SaddleBranch) (ρ : ℝ)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hρrad : ρ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hu₀K : R.criticalSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0 ∈ K)
    {r εcover εbranch A : ℝ}
    (hrShrink : r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : E', dist v (R.criticalCenter p) < εcover →
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C₀.cobordism).G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧ R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp u = v)
    (hbranch : ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r →
      dist (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp u)
        (R.criticalSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0) < εbranch →
      0 < signedBranch b (u 1))
    (hAsafe : A ^ 2 ≤ T.safeTime)
    (hcenterClose : dist
        (R.criticalSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0)
        (R.criticalCenter p) + (T.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εcover)
    (hbranchClose : (T.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εbranch) :
    ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧
      R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp u =
        T.base.flow
          (R.criticalSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0) (-(A ^ 2)) ∧
      0 < signedBranch b (u 1) ∧
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(A ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply R.exists_negativeFlowEndpoint_morseParam T p hp hindex b 1
    (saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e ρ 0)
  · rw [norm_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e hρ]
    · exact hρrad
    · nlinarith
  · simp [saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam]
  · simpa [criticalSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd] using hu₀K
  · exact hrShrink
  · exact hcover
  · simpa [criticalSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd] using hbranch
  · exact hAsafe
  · simpa [criticalSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd] using hcenterClose
  · exact hbranchClose

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.exists_positiveBoundaryEnd_shortFlowContract
statement:
theorem exists_positiveBoundaryEnd_shortFlowContract
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    {K : Set E'}
    (T : CompactTimeTamedField
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C₀.cobordism).toLevelCobordismData K)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .saddle)
    (b e : SaddleBranch) (r rInj ρ : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrrInj : r < rInj)
    (hrInjShrink : rInj ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp)
      (ball (0 : E₂) rInj))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρrInj : ρ < rInj)
    (hu₀K : R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0 ∈ K) :
    ∃ εcover > 0, ∃ εbranch > 0,
      ∀ {A : ℝ}, A ^ 2 ≤ T.safeTime →
        dist (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0)
            (R.criticalCenter p) + (T.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εcover →
        (T.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εbranch →
        ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧
          R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp u =
            T.base.flow
              (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0) (A ^ 2) ∧
          0 < signedBranch b (u 0) ∧
          morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let u₀ := saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e ρ 0
  have hu₀ : ‖u₀‖ < rInj := by
    rw [norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e hρ]
    · exact hρrInj
    · nlinarith
  have hσ : 0 < saddleBoundaryParameter ρ 0 := by
    unfold saddleBoundaryParameter
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hρ])
  have hsqrtσ : Real.sqrt (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ 0 ^ 2) =
      saddleBoundaryParameter ρ 0 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hσ]
  have hu₀sign : 0 < signedBranch b (u₀ 0) := by
    cases b <;> cases e <;>
      simpa [u₀, saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam, saddlePositiveArc, hsqrtσ,
        signedBranch, abs_of_pos hσ] using hσ
  obtain ⟨εcover, hεcover, hcover⟩ :=
    R.covers_fiber_within_criticalSurfaceParam_radius p hp hr
  obtain ⟨εbranch, hεbranch, hbranch⟩ :=
    R.exists_criticalSurfaceParam_signedBranch_neighborhood
      p hp b 0 u₀ hr hrrInj hrInjShrink hinj hu₀ hu₀sign
  refine ⟨εcover, hεcover, εbranch, hεbranch, ?_⟩
  intro A hAsafe hcenterClose hbranchClose
  apply R.exists_positiveFlowEndpoint_criticalSaddleBoundaryEnd
    T p hp hindex b e ρ hρ (hρrInj.trans_le hrInjShrink) hu₀K
      (hrrInj.le.trans hrInjShrink) hcover
  · simpa [u₀, criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd] using hbranch
  · exact hAsafe
  · exact hcenterClose
  · exact hbranchClose

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.exists_negativeBoundaryEnd_shortFlowContract
statement:
theorem exists_negativeBoundaryEnd_shortFlowContract
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    {K : Set E'}
    (T : CompactTimeTamedField
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C₀.cobordism).toLevelCobordismData K)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .saddle)
    (b e : SaddleBranch) (r rInj ρ : ℝ)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrrInj : r < rInj)
    (hrInjShrink : rInj ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp)
      (ball (0 : E₂) rInj))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρrInj : ρ < rInj)
    (hu₀K : R.criticalSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0 ∈ K) :
    ∃ εcover > 0, ∃ εbranch > 0,
      ∀ {A : ℝ}, A ^ 2 ≤ T.safeTime →
        dist (R.criticalSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0)
            (R.criticalCenter p) + (T.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εcover →
        (T.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εbranch →
        ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧
          R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp u =
            T.base.flow
              (R.criticalSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p hp b e ρ 0) (-(A ^ 2)) ∧
          0 < signedBranch b (u 1) ∧
          morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(A ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let u₀ := saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e ρ 0
  have hu₀ : ‖u₀‖ < rInj := by
    rw [norm_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e hρ]
    · exact hρrInj
    · nlinarith
  have hσ : 0 < saddleBoundaryParameter ρ 0 := by
    unfold saddleBoundaryParameter
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hρ])
  have hsqrtσ : Real.sqrt (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ 0 ^ 2) =
      saddleBoundaryParameter ρ 0 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hσ]
  have hu₀sign : 0 < signedBranch b (u₀ 1) := by
    cases b <;> cases e <;>
      simpa [u₀, saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam, saddleNegativeArc, hsqrtσ,
        signedBranch, abs_of_pos hσ] using hσ
  obtain ⟨εcover, hεcover, hcover⟩ :=
    R.covers_fiber_within_criticalSurfaceParam_radius p hp hr
  obtain ⟨εbranch, hεbranch, hbranch⟩ :=
    R.exists_criticalSurfaceParam_signedBranch_neighborhood
      p hp b 1 u₀ hr hrrInj hrInjShrink hinj hu₀ hu₀sign
  refine ⟨εcover, hεcover, εbranch, hεbranch, ?_⟩
  intro A hAsafe hcenterClose hbranchClose
  apply R.exists_negativeFlowEndpoint_criticalSaddleBoundaryEnd
    T p hp hindex b e ρ hρ (hρrInj.trans_le hrInjShrink) hu₀K
      (hrrInj.le.trans hrInjShrink) hcover
  · simpa [u₀, criticalSaddleNegativeBoundaryEnd] using hbranch
  · exact hAsafe
  · exact hcenterClose
  · exact hbranchClose

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.positiveBoundaryEnd_mem_of_criticalExteriorPath_zero
statement:
theorem positiveBoundaryEnd_mem_of_criticalExteriorPath_zero

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.positiveBranch_mem_positiveOrbitCollection
statement:
theorem positiveBranch_mem_positiveOrbitCollection
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .saddle)
    (hcenterPositive :
      0 < (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C₀)
        (R.criticalCenter p))
    (b : SaddleBranch) (ρ A : ℝ)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hA : A ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C₀.cobordism).G
      (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + A ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (R.criticalSaddlePositiveSlice p hp A hreg)) :
    ((R.criticalSaddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex p hp hindex b ρ A
      hρ hA hρrad hreg V : V.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∈
      ((R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C₀).sliceSign
        (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + A ^ 2) hreg).positiveOrbitCollection V
proof:
:= by
  let Cinstalled := R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C₀
  change 0 < Cinstalled (R.criticalCenter p) at hcenterPositive
  let u₀ := saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b .negative ρ 0
  have hzeroLevel : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hu₀ : ‖u₀‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius := by
    rw [norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b .negative hρ hzeroLevel]
    exact hρrad
  let γcenter := R.criticalSurfaceRadialPath p hp u₀ hu₀
  have hcenterPathFiber : ∀ q,
      Cinstalled.cobordism.G (γcenter q) = 0 := by
    intro q
    exact R.criticalSurfaceRadialPath_fiber p hp u₀ hu₀ q
  have hcriticalPositive :
      0 < Cinstalled (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp u₀) := by
    have hsign := Cinstalled.pos_iff_of_zeroFiber_path
      γcenter hcenterPathFiber
    have hstart : 0 < Cinstalled (γcenter 0) := by
      simpa [γcenter] using hcenterPositive
    have hend := hsign.mp hstart
    simpa [γcenter] using hend
  let γtrack := R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryTrack p hp
    b .negative ρ A hρ hA hρrad
  have htrackFiber : ∀ q, Cinstalled.cobordism.G (γtrack q) = 0 := by
    intro q
    exact R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryTrack_fiber p hp
      b .negative ρ A hρ hA hρrad q
  have hboundaryPositive :
      0 < Cinstalled
        (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b .negative ρ A) := by
    have hsign := Cinstalled.pos_iff_of_zeroFiber_path γtrack htrackFiber
    have hstart : 0 < Cinstalled (γtrack 0) := by
      simpa [γtrack, u₀, criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd] using
        hcriticalPositive
    have hend := hsign.mp hstart
    simpa [γtrack] using hend
  let O := R.criticalSaddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex p hp hindex b ρ A
    hρ hA hρrad hreg V
  let S := Cinstalled.sliceSign
    (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + A ^ 2) hreg
  apply (S.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff V O).2
  have hpointFiber : spacePart
      (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b .negative ρ A) ∈
      (R.criticalSaddlePositiveSlice p hp A hreg).fiber :=
    R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_mem_slice_fiber p hp hindex
      b .negative ρ A hρ hA hρrad hreg
  have hpointPositive : 0 < S (spacePart
      (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b .negative ρ A)) := by
    change 0 < Cinstalled (cobSpaceTime (spacePart
      (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b .negative ρ A))
        (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + A ^ 2))
    rw [← R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time p hp hindex
      b .negative hρ hA hρrad, spaceTime_spacePart]
    exact hboundaryPositive
  have hmem : V.orbitPoint O ∈ V.orbit (spacePart
      (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p hp b .negative ρ A)) := by
    change V.orbitPoint O ∈ (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  exact (S.pos_iff_of_mem_orbit V hpointFiber hmem).mp hpointPositive

theorem positiveSliceSign_heq_eventAfter
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (P : MorsePosition
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C₀.cobordism))
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ P.eventTimes)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (A : ℝ)
    (hafter : (P.eventBracket t ht).after =
      G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + A ^ 2) :
    HEq
      ((R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C₀).sliceSign
        (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + A ^ 2) (by
          rw [← hafter]
          exact (P.eventBracket t ht).after_regular))
      ((R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C₀).sliceSign
        (P.eventBracket t ht).after
        (P.eventBracket t ht).after_regular)
proof:
:= by
  apply FiberSign.heq_of_eq_toFun
    (R.criticalSaddlePositiveSlice_eq_eventAfter P t ht p hp A hafter)
  apply heq_of_eq

  change (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C₀)
      (cobSpaceTime x (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + A ^ 2)) =
    (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C₀)
      (cobSpaceTime x (P.eventBracket t ht).after)
  rw [hafter]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.negativeTwo_orbitFrameClass_splice_of_relativeContractHomotopies
statement:
theorem negativeTwo_orbitFrameClass_splice_of_relativeContractHomotopies
    (hn : 3 ≤ n + 1)
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .saddle)
    (ρ A : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hA : A ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hregNegative : sliceRegular
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C₀.cobordism).G
      (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 - A ^ 2))
    (Vnegative : TamedField
      (R.criticalSaddleNegativeSlice p hp A hregNegative))
    (hregPositive : sliceRegular
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C₀.cobordism).G
      (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + A ^ 2))
    (Vpositive : TamedField
      (R.criticalSaddlePositiveSlice p hp A hregPositive))
    (exterior₁ exterior₂ : C(I, SOGroup (n + 1)))
    (hext₁ : exterior₁ 0 = exterior₁ 1)
    (hext₂ : exterior₂ 0 = exterior₂ 1)
    (S : SaddleModelContract)
    (H₁ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy
      (Vnegative.orbitFrameLoop
        (R.criticalSaddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex p hp hindex .negative ρ A
          hρ hA hρrad hregNegative Vnegative))
      (exterior₁ * S.incoming₁.frame (n + 1)))
    (H₂ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy
      (Vnegative.orbitFrameLoop
        (R.criticalSaddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex p hp hindex .positive ρ A
          hρ hA hρrad hregNegative Vnegative))
      (exterior₂ * S.incoming₂.frame (n + 1)))
    (Hhat : ContinuousMap.Homotopy
      (Vpositive.orbitFrameLoop
        (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex p hp hindex .negative ρ A
          hρ hA hρrad hregPositive Vpositive))
      ((exterior₁ * exterior₂) * S.outgoing.frame (n + 1)))
    (H₁_closed : ∀ s : I, H₁ (s, 0) = H₁ (s, 1))
    (H₂_closed : ∀ s : I, H₂ (s, 0) = H₂ (s, 1))
    (Hhat_closed : ∀ s : I, Hhat (s, 0) = Hhat (s, 1)) :
    Vpositive.orbitFrameClass
        (R.criticalSaddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex p hp hindex .negative ρ A
          hρ hA hρrad hregPositive Vpositive) =
      Vnegative.orbitFrameClass
          (R.criticalSaddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex p hp hindex .negative ρ A
            hρ hA hρrad hregNegative Vnegative) +
        Vnegative.orbitFrameClass
          (R.criticalSaddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex p hp hindex .positive ρ A
            hρ hA hρrad hregNegative Vnegative) + 1
proof:
:= by
  exact TamedField.orbitFrameClass_relative_saddle_splice hn
    Vnegative Vpositive
    (R.criticalSaddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex p hp hindex .negative ρ A
      hρ hA hρrad hregNegative Vnegative)
    (R.criticalSaddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex p hp hindex .positive ρ A

statement:
theorem positiveTwo_orbitFrameClass_splice_of_relativeContractHomotopies

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.ramp_denom_pos
statement: theorem ramp_denom_pos (t : ℝ) : 0 < 1 + t * Real.smoothTransition (t - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt t 1 with h | h
  · rw [Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), mul_zero, add_zero]
    norm_num
  · have h0 : 0 ≤ t := by linarith
    have h1 : 0 ≤ Real.smoothTransition (t - 1) :=
      Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
    nlinarith

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.ramp_denom_one_le
statement:
theorem ramp_denom_one_le (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    1 ≤ 1 + t * Real.smoothTransition (t - 1)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : 0 ≤ Real.smoothTransition (t - 1) := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
  nlinarith

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.contDiff_ramp
statement: theorem contDiff_ramp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ ramp
proof:
:= by
  have hden : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t : ℝ => 1 + t * Real.smoothTransition (t - 1) :=
    contDiff_const.add (contDiff_id.mul
      (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)))
  exact hden.inv fun t => (ramp_denom_pos t).ne'

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.ramp_pos
statement: theorem ramp_pos (t : ℝ) : 0 < ramp t
proof: := inv_pos.mpr (ramp_denom_pos t)

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.ramp_eq_one_of_le_one
statement: theorem ramp_eq_one_of_le_one {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1) : ramp t = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ramp, Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), mul_zero,
    add_zero, inv_one]

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.ramp_le_one
statement: theorem ramp_le_one {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : ramp t ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ramp]
  exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (ramp_denom_one_le t ht)

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.mul_ramp_sq_le
statement: theorem mul_ramp_sq_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 0 ≤ t) : t * ramp t ^ 2 ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt t 2 with h | h
  · have h1 : ramp t ≤ 1 := ramp_le_one ht
    have h2 : 0 < ramp t := ramp_pos t
    nlinarith
  · have h3 : Real.smoothTransition (t - 1) = 1 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)
    have hr : ramp t = (1 + t)⁻¹ := by rw [ramp, h3, mul_one]
    have hpos : 0 < 1 + t := by linarith
    rw [hr, inv_pow, ← div_eq_mul_inv, div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.contDiff_squash
statement:
theorem contDiff_squash (c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) (r : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (squash c r)
proof:
:= by
  have hsub : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) => y - c :=
    contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const
  have hnorm : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) => ‖y - c‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2 :=
    ((contDiff_norm_sq ℝ).comp hsub).div_const _
  exact contDiff_const.add ((contDiff_ramp.comp hnorm).smul hsub)

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.squash_eq_self
statement:
theorem squash_eq_self {c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)} (hy : ‖y - c‖ ≤ r) : squash c r y = y
proof:
:= by
  have ht : ‖y - c‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_one (by positivity)]
    have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖y - c‖ := norm_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  rw [squash, ramp_eq_one_of_le_one ht, one_smul, add_sub_cancel]

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.norm_squash_sub_lt
statement:
theorem norm_squash_sub_lt {c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)} {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)) : ‖squash c r y - c‖ < 2 * r
proof:
:= by
  set t : ℝ := ‖y - c‖ ^ 2 / r ^ 2 with htdef
  have ht0 : 0 ≤ t := by positivity
  have hval : squash c r y - c = ramp t • (y - c) := by
    rw [squash, add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hsq : ‖squash c r y - c‖ ^ 2 = ramp t ^ 2 * ‖y - c‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hval, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs]
  have hyt : ‖y - c‖ ^ 2 = t * r ^ 2 := by
    rw [htdef, div_mul_cancel₀]
    positivity
  have hbound : ‖squash c r y - c‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * r ^ 2 := by
    rw [hsq, hyt]
    have := mul_ramp_sq_le ht0
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ramp t), sq_nonneg r]
  have hnn : 0 ≤ ‖squash c r y - c‖ := norm_nonneg _
  nlinarith

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.exists_global_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem exists_global_of_contDiffOn
    (Phi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    {V : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N))} (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hPhi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Phi V)
    (hdet : ∀ x ∈ V, 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Phi x)).det)
    {c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)} (hc : c ∈ V) :
    ∃ Psi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N) →
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k),
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ Psi ∧
        (∀ x, 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Psi x)).det) ∧
        Psi =ᶠ[nhds c] Phi
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hV c hc
  have hr : 0 < d / 4 := by linarith
  have hmem : ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N), squash c (d / 4) y ∈ V := by
    intro y
    apply hball
    have := norm_squash_sub_lt (c := c) hr y
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm]
    linarith
  refine ⟨fun y => Phi (squash c (d / 4) y), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [← contDiffOn_univ]
    exact hPhi.comp (contDiff_squash c (d / 4)).contDiffOn
      fun y _ => hmem y
  · intro x
    exact hdet _ (hmem x)
  · refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      (Metric.ball_mem_nhds c (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < d / 4)) ?_
    intro y hy
    have : ‖y - c‖ ≤ d / 4 := by
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hy
      exact hy.le
    exact congrArg Phi (squash_eq_self hr this)

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.qrSOTotal_eq
statement:
theorem qrSOTotal_eq (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    (h : 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix A).det) :
    qrSOTotal A = PolarDecompositionCLM.qrSO A h
proof: := dif_pos h

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.qr_factorization_total
statement:
theorem qr_factorization_total
    (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    (h : 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix A).det) :
    A = (SOFrameGauge.toCLM (qrSOTotal A)).comp
      (PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpper A)
proof:
:= by
  rw [qrSOTotal_eq A h]
  exact PolarDecompositionCLM.qr_factorization h

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.contDiffAt_qrUpper_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_qrUpper_of_contDiffOn (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hPhi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Phi V)
    (hdet : ∀ x ∈ V, 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Phi x)).det)
    {c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)} (hc : c ∈ V) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpper (Phi x)) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Psi, hPsi, hPsidet, hEq⟩ :=
    exists_global_of_contDiffOn Phi hV hPhi hdet hc
  have hglob : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x => PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpper (Psi x) :=
    PolarDecompositionCLM.contDiff_qrUpper hPsi hPsidet
  refine hglob.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
  filter_upwards [hEq] with x hx
  rw [hx]

name: Submission.TransitionQRLocalization.contDiffAt_qrSOTotal_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_qrSOTotal_of_contDiffOn (hV : IsOpen V)
    (hPhi : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ Phi V)
    (hdet : ∀ x ∈ V, 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Phi x)).det)
    {c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N)} (hc : c ∈ V) (i j : Fin k) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun x => ((qrSOTotal (Phi x) : SOGroup k) :
        Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j) c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Psi, hPsi, hPsidet, hEq⟩ :=
    exists_global_of_contDiffOn Phi hV hPhi hdet hc
  have hglob : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x =>
      ((PolarDecompositionCLM.qrSO (Psi x) (hPsidet x) : SOGroup k) :
        Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j :=
    PolarDecompositionCLM.contDiff_qrSOMatrix_apply hPsi hPsidet i j
  have hglob' : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x =>
      ((qrSOTotal (Psi x) : SOGroup k) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j := by
    have : (fun x => ((qrSOTotal (Psi x) : SOGroup k) :
          Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j)
        = fun x => ((PolarDecompositionCLM.qrSO (Psi x) (hPsidet x) :
          SOGroup k) : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) i j := by
      funext x
      rw [qrSOTotal_eq (Psi x) (hPsidet x)]
    rw [this]
    exact hglob
  refine hglob'.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
  filter_upwards [hEq] with x hx
  rw [hx]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.contDiff_endpointVertical
statement: lemma contDiff_endpointVertical : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (endpointVertical S κ)
proof:
:=
  (contDiff_const.mul κ.smooth).sub contDiff_const

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.continuous_endpointVertical
statement: lemma continuous_endpointVertical : Continuous (endpointVertical S κ)
proof:
:=
  (contDiff_endpointVertical S κ).continuous

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.isOpen_signAgreement
statement: lemma isOpen_signAgreement : IsOpen (signAgreement S κ)
proof:
:= by
  have hSpos : IsOpen {x : E | 0 < S x} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const S.continuous
  have hSneg : IsOpen {x : E | S x < 0} :=
    isOpen_lt S.continuous continuous_const
  have hVpos : IsOpen {x : E | 0 < endpointVertical S κ x} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_endpointVertical S κ)
  have hVneg : IsOpen {x : E | endpointVertical S κ x < 0} :=
    isOpen_lt (continuous_endpointVertical S κ) continuous_const
  exact (hSpos.inter hVpos).union (hSneg.inter hVneg)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.fiber_subset_signAgreement
statement: lemma fiber_subset_signAgreement : X.fiber ⊆ signAgreement S κ
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (S.nonzero x hx) with hneg | hpos
  · right
    refine ⟨hneg, ?_⟩
    rw [endpointVertical, κ.negative_zero x ⟨hx, hneg⟩]
    norm_num
  · left
    refine ⟨hpos, ?_⟩
    rw [endpointVertical, κ.positive_one x ⟨hx, hpos⟩]
    norm_num

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.EndpointPatchLocalizer.nonneg
statement: lemma nonneg (P : EndpointPatchLocalizer S κ) (x : E) : 0 ≤ P x
proof:
:=
  (P.range x).1

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.EndpointPatchLocalizer.le_one
statement: lemma le_one (P : EndpointPatchLocalizer S κ) (x : E) : P x ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  (P.range x).2

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.EndpointPatchLocalizer.nonempty
statement: theorem nonempty : Nonempty (EndpointPatchLocalizer S κ)
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen (signAgreement S κ) := isOpen_signAgreement S κ
  have hsub : X.fiber ⊆ signAgreement S κ := fiber_subset_signAgreement S κ
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδsub⟩ :=
    X.isCompact_fiber.exists_cthickening_subset_open hopen hsub
  let U : Set E := Metric.thickening δ X.fiber
  have hKU : X.fiber ⊆ U := Metric.self_subset_thickening hδpos _
  have hUc : IsCompact (closure U) := by
    apply IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset X.isCompact_fiber.cthickening
      isClosed_closure
    exact closure_minimal
      (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _) Metric.isClosed_cthickening
  have hs : IsClosed Uᶜ := Metric.isOpen_thickening.isClosed_compl
  have hd : Disjoint Uᶜ X.fiber := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxU hxK
    exact hxU (hKU hxK)
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam0, hlam1, hlam01⟩ :=
    exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_of_isClosed
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) hs X.isClosed_fiber hd
  have hlamsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (⇑lam) := by
    rw [← contMDiff_iff_contDiff]
    exact lam.contMDiff
  have hlamsupport : HasCompactSupport (⇑lam) := by
    have hsupport : support (⇑lam) ⊆ U := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxU
      exact hx (hlam0 hxU)
    have htsupport : tsupport (⇑lam) ⊆ closure U :=
      closure_minimal (hsupport.trans subset_closure) isClosed_closure
    exact IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset hUc isClosed_closure htsupport
  refine ⟨⟨⇑lam, hlamsmooth, hlam01, hlam1, ?_, hlamsupport⟩⟩
  intro x hx
  have hxU : x ∈ U := by
    by_contra hnot
    exact hx (hlam0 hnot)
  exact hδsub (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _ hxU)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.contDiff_patchScale
statement: lemma contDiff_patchScale : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (patchScale S κ)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.contDiff_patchWeight
statement: lemma contDiff_patchWeight : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (patchWeight S κ P)

    (P.smooth.comp (initCLM (n + 1)).contDiff)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.contDiff_patchBase
statement: lemma contDiff_patchBase : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (patchBase S κ)
proof:
:= by

    (X.smooth.comp (initCLM (n + 1)).contDiff)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.contDiff_patchCobMap
statement: lemma contDiff_patchCobMap (y : F) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (patchCobMap S κ P y)

:= by

    ((contDiff_patchWeight S κ P).smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchScale_pos
statement: lemma patchScale_pos (v : A) : 0 < patchScale S κ v
proof:
:= by
  have hs := normRamp_nonneg (vertC v)
  have hκ := (κ.range (initCLM (n + 1) v)).1
  dsimp [patchScale]
  nlinarith

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchWeight_nonneg
statement: lemma patchWeight_nonneg (v : A) : 0 ≤ patchWeight S κ P v
proof:
:=

    (EndpointPatchLocalizer.nonneg S κ P (initCLM (n + 1) v))

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.isOpen_patchTransition
statement: lemma isOpen_patchTransition : IsOpen (patchTransition S κ P)
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.normRamp_pos_of_mem_patchTransition
statement:
lemma normRamp_pos_of_mem_patchTransition {v : A}
    (hv : v ∈ patchTransition S κ P) : 0 < normRamp (vertC v)
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.smoothTransition.pos_of_pos
  change 0 < 2 * (vertC v - 1 / 4)
  linarith [hv.1]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchWeight_pos
statement:
lemma patchWeight_pos {v : A} (hv : v ∈ patchTransition S κ P) :
    0 < patchWeight S κ P v
proof:
:=
  mul_pos (normRamp_pos_of_mem_patchTransition S κ P hv) hv.2

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.contDiffOn_patchQuotient
statement:
lemma contDiffOn_patchQuotient :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (patchQuotient S κ P) (patchTransition S κ P)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hw : patchWeight S κ P v ≠ 0 :=
    (patchWeight_pos S κ P hv).ne'
  exact (((contDiff_patchWeight S κ P).contDiffAt.inv hw).smul
    (contDiff_patchBase S κ).contDiffAt).contDiffWithinAt

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchCobMap_eq_weight_smul
statement:
lemma patchCobMap_eq_weight_smul (y : F) {v : A}
    (hv : v ∈ patchTransition S κ P) :
    patchCobMap S κ P y v =
      patchWeight S κ P v • (patchQuotient S κ P v - y)
proof:
:= by
  have hw : patchWeight S κ P v ≠ 0 :=
    (patchWeight_pos S κ P hv).ne'
  rw [patchCobMap, patchQuotient, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hw, one_smul]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.contDiff_patchTargetMap
statement: lemma contDiff_patchTargetMap (y : F) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (patchTargetMap S κ P y)

:= by
