    (P.smooth.smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchCobMap_collar_zero
statement:
lemma patchCobMap_collar_zero (y : F) (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 4) :
    patchCobMap S κ P y (spaceTime x t) = X.g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [patchCobMap, patchBase, patchScale, patchWeight, vertC_spaceTime,
    initCLM_spaceTime, normRamp_of_le_quarter ht]
  simp

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchCobMap_collar_one
statement:
lemma patchCobMap_collar_one (y : F) (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t) :
    patchCobMap S κ P y (spaceTime x t) = patchTargetMap S κ P y x
proof:
:= by
  rw [patchCobMap, patchBase, patchScale, patchWeight, patchTargetMap,
    vertC_spaceTime, initCLM_spaceTime, normRamp_of_three_quarter_le ht]
  simp

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.spatial_mem_fiber_or_tsupport
statement:
lemma spatial_mem_fiber_or_tsupport {y : F} {v : A}
    (hv : patchCobMap S κ P y v = 0) :
    initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ X.fiber ∨
      initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ tsupport P
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hP : P (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 0
  · left
    have hw : patchWeight S κ P v = 0 := by simp [patchWeight, hP]
    have hb : patchBase S κ v = 0 := by
      simpa [patchCobMap, hw] using hv
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hb).resolve_left (patchScale_pos S κ v).ne'
  · right
    exact subset_tsupport P hP

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchCobMap_spatial_bounded
statement:
lemma patchCobMap_spatial_bounded (y : F) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ v : A, patchCobMap S κ P y v = 0 →
      ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀⟩ := X.fiber_bounded.subset_closedBall 0
  obtain ⟨R₁, hR₁⟩ := P.compact_support.isBounded.subset_closedBall 0
  refine ⟨max R₀ R₁, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  rcases spatial_mem_fiber_or_tsupport S κ P hv with h | h
  · have := hR₀ h
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at this
    exact this.trans (le_max_left _ _)
  · have := hR₁ h
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at this
    exact this.trans (le_max_right _ _)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchCobMap_regular
statement:
theorem patchCobMap_regular {y : F}
    (hreg : IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S κ P)
      (patchTransition S κ P) y) :
    ∀ v : A, patchCobMap S κ P y v = 0 →
      Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (patchCobMap S κ P y) v)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  by_cases hw0 : patchWeight S κ P v = 0
  · have hb : patchBase S κ v = 0 := by
      simpa [patchCobMap, hw0] using hv
    have hg : X.g (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 0 :=
      (smul_eq_zero.mp hb).resolve_left (patchScale_pos S κ v).ne'
    have hPone : P (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 1 := P.fiber_one _ hg
    have hs0 : normRamp (vertC v) = 0 := by
      rw [patchWeight, hPone, mul_one] at hw0
      exact hw0
    apply surjective_fderiv_of_slice (contDiff_patchCobMap S κ P y)
    have hslice : (fun x' : E =>
        patchCobMap S κ P y (spaceTime x' (vertC v))) = X.g := by
      funext x'
      rw [patchCobMap, patchBase, patchScale, patchWeight,
        vertC_spaceTime, initCLM_spaceTime, hs0]
      simp
    rw [hslice]
    exact X.regular _ hg
  · have hwpos : 0 < patchWeight S κ P v :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (patchWeight_nonneg S κ P v) (Ne.symm hw0)
    have hsne : normRamp (vertC v) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hs
      exact hw0 (by simp [patchWeight, hs])
    have hPne : P (initCLM (n + 1) v) ≠ 0 := by
      intro hP
      exact hw0 (by simp [patchWeight, hP])
    have ht : 1 / 4 < vertC v := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hs := normRamp_of_le_quarter (le_of_not_gt hnot)
      exact hsne hs
    have hPpos : 0 < P (initCLM (n + 1) v) :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne
        (EndpointPatchLocalizer.nonneg S κ P (initCLM (n + 1) v))
        (Ne.symm hPne)
    have hvU : v ∈ patchTransition S κ P := ⟨ht, hPpos⟩
    have hweighted : patchWeight S κ P v •
        (patchQuotient S κ P v - y) = 0 := by
      rw [← patchCobMap_eq_weight_smul S κ P y hvU]
      exact hv
    have hsub : patchQuotient S κ P v - y = 0 :=
      (smul_eq_zero.mp hweighted).resolve_left hwpos.ne'
    have hPhi : patchQuotient S κ P v = y := sub_eq_zero.mp hsub
    have hsurjWithin := hreg v hvU hPhi
    have hsurj : Function.Surjective
        (fderiv ℝ (patchQuotient S κ P) v) := by
      rwa [fderivWithin_of_isOpen (isOpen_patchTransition S κ P) hvU]
        at hsurjWithin
    have hEv : patchCobMap S κ P y =ᶠ[𝓝 v]
        fun z => patchWeight S κ P z • (patchQuotient S κ P z - y) :=
      Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
        ((isOpen_patchTransition S κ P).mem_nhds hvU)
        fun _ hz => patchCobMap_eq_weight_smul S κ P y hz
    have hwdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (patchWeight S κ P) v :=
      (contDiff_patchWeight S κ P).differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
    have hQdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (patchQuotient S κ P) v :=
      ((contDiffOn_patchQuotient S κ P).contDiffAt
        ((isOpen_patchTransition S κ P).mem_nhds hvU)).differentiableAt
        infty_ne_zero
    have hsubdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ
        (fun z => patchQuotient S κ P z - y) v :=
      hQdiff.sub (differentiableAt_const (c := y))
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (patchCobMap S κ P y) v =
        patchWeight S κ P v • fderiv ℝ (patchQuotient S κ P) v := by
      rw [hEv.fderiv_eq, fderiv_fun_smul hwdiff hsubdiff,
        fderiv_sub_const y, hPhi, sub_self]
      simp
    rw [hfd]
    intro z
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsurj ((patchWeight S κ P v)⁻¹ • z)
    refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
    rw [smul_apply, hu, smul_smul,
      mul_inv_cancel₀ hwpos.ne', one_smul]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.continuous_patchLabel
statement: lemma continuous_patchLabel : Continuous (patchLabel S κ)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Continuous fun v : A => normRamp (vertC v) :=
    contDiff_normRamp.continuous.comp contDiff_vertC.continuous
  exact ((continuous_const.sub hs).mul
      (S.continuous.comp (initCLM (n + 1)).continuous)).add
    (hs.mul ((continuous_endpointVertical S κ).comp
      (initCLM (n + 1)).continuous))

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.spatial_signAgreement_of_patchCobMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hP : P (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 0
  · have hw : patchWeight S κ P v = 0 := by simp [patchWeight, hP]
    have hb : patchBase S κ v = 0 := by
      simpa [patchCobMap, hw] using hv
    have hg : initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ X.fiber :=
      (smul_eq_zero.mp hb).resolve_left (patchScale_pos S κ v).ne'
    exact fiber_subset_signAgreement S κ hg
  · exact P.nonzero_agrees _ hP

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchLabel_ne_zero_of_patchCobMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma patchLabel_ne_zero_of_patchCobMap_eq_zero {y : F} {v : A}
    (hv : patchCobMap S κ P y v = 0) : patchLabel S κ v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hagree := spatial_signAgreement_of_patchCobMap_eq_zero S κ P hv
  have hs0 := normRamp_nonneg (vertC v)
  have hs1 := normRamp_le_one (vertC v)
  rcases hagree with hpos | hneg
  · have h1 : 0 ≤ (1 - normRamp (vertC v)) *
        S (initCLM (n + 1) v) := mul_nonneg (by linarith) hpos.1.le
    have h2 : 0 ≤ normRamp (vertC v) *
        endpointVertical S κ (initCLM (n + 1) v) :=
      mul_nonneg hs0 hpos.2.le
    rcases le_total (normRamp (vertC v)) (1 / 2) with hs | hs
    · have hstrict : 0 < (1 - normRamp (vertC v)) *
          S (initCLM (n + 1) v) := mul_pos (by linarith) hpos.1
      exact ne_of_gt (by dsimp [patchLabel]; linarith)
    · have hstrict : 0 < normRamp (vertC v) *
          endpointVertical S κ (initCLM (n + 1) v) :=
        mul_pos (by linarith) hpos.2
      exact ne_of_gt (by dsimp [patchLabel]; linarith)
  · have h1 : (1 - normRamp (vertC v)) *
        S (initCLM (n + 1) v) ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith) hneg.1.le
    have h2 : normRamp (vertC v) *
        endpointVertical S κ (initCLM (n + 1) v) ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hs0 hneg.2.le
    rcases le_total (normRamp (vertC v)) (1 / 2) with hs | hs
    · have hstrict : (1 - normRamp (vertC v)) *
          S (initCLM (n + 1) v) < 0 := mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) hneg.1
      exact ne_of_lt (by dsimp [patchLabel]; linarith)
    · have hstrict : normRamp (vertC v) *
          endpointVertical S κ (initCLM (n + 1) v) < 0 :=
        mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) hneg.2
      exact ne_of_lt (by dsimp [patchLabel]; linarith)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_small_patch_regular_value
statement:
theorem exists_small_patch_regular_value (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ y : F, 0 < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 1 / 8 ∧
      IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S κ P) (patchTransition S κ P) y
proof:
:= by
  let z₀ : F := EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (1 / 16 : ℝ)
  have hz₀norm : ‖z₀‖ = 1 / 16 := by
    rw [show z₀ = EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (1 / 16 : ℝ) from rfl,
      PiLp.norm_single, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨y, hyreg, hyball⟩ :=
    (sard_dense_regular_values_on (isOpen_patchTransition S κ P)
      (contDiffOn_patchQuotient S κ P)).exists_mem_open Metric.isOpen_ball
      (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 32))
  have hdist : ‖y - z₀‖ < 1 / 32 := by
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    exact hyball
  have habs : |‖y‖ - ‖z₀‖| ≤ ‖y - z₀‖ := abs_norm_sub_norm_le y z₀
  rw [hz₀norm, abs_le] at habs
  exact ⟨y, by linarith [habs.1], by linarith [habs.2], hyreg⟩

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_signedCobordism_to_patchTarget
statement:
theorem exists_signedCobordism_to_patchTarget (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ (P : EndpointPatchLocalizer S κ) (y : F)
      (hreg : IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S κ P)
        (patchTransition S κ P) y),
      0 < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 1 / 8 ∧
      Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism S
        (patchTargetSign S κ P y hreg))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := EndpointPatchLocalizer.nonempty S κ
  obtain ⟨y, hypos, hy8, hreg⟩ :=
    exists_small_patch_regular_value S κ P hn
  exact ⟨P, y, hreg, hypos, hy8, ⟨patchSignedCobordism S κ P y hreg⟩⟩

name: Submission.surjective_add_of_norm_comp_rightInverse_lt_one
statement:
theorem surjective_add_of_norm_comp_rightInverse_lt_one
    (L Q : E →L[ℝ] F) (hL : Surjective L)
    (hsmall : ‖Q.comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.HasRightInverse.rightInverse
        (ContinuousLinearMap.HasRightInverse.of_surjective_of_finiteDimensional
          hL))‖ < 1) :
    Surjective (L + Q)
proof:
:= by
  let hR : L.HasRightInverse :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.HasRightInverse.of_surjective_of_finiteDimensional hL
  let R : F →L[ℝ] E := hR.rightInverse
  let A : F →L[ℝ] F := -(Q.comp R)
  have hA : ‖A‖ < 1 := by
    simpa [A, R, hR, norm_neg] using hsmall
  have hunit : IsUnit (1 - A) := isUnit_one_sub_of_norm_lt_one hA
  let U : (F →L[ℝ] F)ˣ := IsUnit.unit hunit
  intro z
  refine ⟨R ((↑(U⁻¹) : F →L[ℝ] F) z), ?_⟩
  have hLR : Function.RightInverse R L := hR.rightInverse_rightInverse
  have hU : (↑U : F →L[ℝ] F) = 1 - A := IsUnit.unit_spec hunit
  have hcomp : (L + Q).comp R = (↑U : F →L[ℝ] F) := by
    ext w
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
      hLR w, hU]
    simp [A]
  rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hcomp]
  rw [← mul_apply_eq_comp, Units.mul_inv, one_apply_eq_self]

name: Submission.isOpen_surjective_continuousLinearMap
statement:
theorem isOpen_surjective_continuousLinearMap :
    IsOpen {L : E →L[ℝ] F | Surjective L}
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
  intro L hL
  let R : F →L[ℝ] E :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.HasRightInverse.rightInverse
      (ContinuousLinearMap.HasRightInverse.of_surjective_of_finiteDimensional
        hL)
  let q : (E →L[ℝ] F) → E →L[ℝ] F := fun M => M - L
  have hc : Continuous (fun M : E →L[ℝ] F => ‖(q M).comp R‖) :=
    ((continuous_id.sub continuous_const).clm_comp continuous_const).norm
  have hlim0 : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun M : E →L[ℝ] F => ‖(q M).comp R‖) (𝓝 L)
        (𝓝 ‖(q L).comp R‖) :=
    hc.continuousAt
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun M : E →L[ℝ] F => ‖(q M).comp R‖) (𝓝 L) (𝓝 0) := by
    simpa [q] using hlim0
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ M in 𝓝 L, ‖(q M).comp R‖ < 1 :=
    hlim.eventually_lt_const zero_lt_one
  filter_upwards [hsmall] with M hM
  have hsurj := surjective_add_of_norm_comp_rightInverse_lt_one
    L (q M) hL (by simpa [R] using hM)
  simpa [q] using hsurj

name: Submission.eventually_surjective_fderiv_of_surjective
statement:
theorem eventually_surjective_fderiv_of_surjective
    (g : E → F) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) {x : E}
    (hx : Surjective (fderiv ℝ g x)) :
    ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, Surjective (fderiv ℝ g z)
proof:
:= by
  let L : E →L[ℝ] F := fderiv ℝ g x
  let R : F →L[ℝ] E :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.HasRightInverse.rightInverse
      (ContinuousLinearMap.HasRightInverse.of_surjective_of_finiteDimensional
        hx)
  let q : E → E →L[ℝ] F := fun z => fderiv ℝ g z - L
  have hq : Continuous q :=
    (hg.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).sub continuous_const
  have hc : Continuous (fun z => (q z).comp R) :=
    hq.clm_comp continuous_const
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun z => ‖(q z).comp R‖) (𝓝 x) (𝓝 0) := by
    apply hc.norm.tendsto'
    simp [q, L]
  have hsmall : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x, ‖(q z).comp R‖ < 1 :=
    hlim.eventually_lt_const zero_lt_one
  filter_upwards [hsmall] with z hz
  have hsurj := surjective_add_of_norm_comp_rightInverse_lt_one
    L (q z) hx (by simpa [R, L] using hz)
  simpa [q, L] using hsurj

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.exists_regularValueRadiusOnCompact
statement:
theorem FramedLevelSet.exists_regularValueRadiusOnCompact
    (X : FramedLevelSet n) {K : Set E} (hK : IsCompact K) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ‖X.g x‖ < ε →
      Surjective (fderiv ℝ X.g x)
proof:
:= by
  let U : Set E := {x | Surjective (fderiv ℝ X.g x)}
  have hU : IsOpen U := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro x hx
    exact eventually_surjective_fderiv_of_surjective X.g X.smooth hx
  have hC : IsCompact (K \ U) := hK.diff hU
  have hpos : ∀ x ∈ K \ U, 0 < ‖X.g x‖ := by
    intro x hx
    rw [norm_pos_iff]
    intro hg
    exact hx.2 (X.regular x hg)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hbound⟩ :=
    hC.exists_forall_le' X.smooth.continuous.norm.continuousOn hpos
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro x hxK hxsmall
  by_contra hnot
  exact (not_lt_of_ge (hbound x ⟨hxK, hnot⟩)) hxsmall

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.contDiff_patchSliceMap
statement:
lemma contDiff_patchSliceMap (y : F) (s : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (patchSliceMap S κ P y s)
proof:
:= by
  exact (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul κ.smooth)).smul X.smooth |>.sub
    ((contDiff_const.mul P.smooth).smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.continuous_patchSliceMap
statement:
theorem continuous_patchSliceMap :
    Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) =>
      patchSliceMap S κ P q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hκ : Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) => κ q.2.2) :=
    κ.smooth.continuous.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)
  have hP : Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) => P q.2.2) :=
    P.smooth.continuous.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)
  have hg : Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) => X.g q.2.2) :=
    X.smooth.continuous.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)
  exact
    (continuous_const.add ((continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).mul hκ)).smul hg
      |>.sub (((continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).mul hP).smul continuous_fst)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.fderiv_patchSliceMap_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_patchSliceMap_apply (y : F) (s : ℝ) (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (patchSliceMap S κ P y s) x h =
      (1 + s * κ x) • fderiv ℝ X.g x h +
        (s * fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => κ z) x h) • X.g x -
          (s * fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => P z) x h) • y
proof:
:= by
  let a : E → ℝ := fun z => 1 + s * κ z
  let b : E → ℝ := fun z => s * P z
  have ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ a x :=
    (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul κ.smooth)).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  have hb : DifferentiableAt ℝ b x :=
    (contDiff_const.mul P.smooth).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ X.g x :=
    X.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  have hy : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun _z : E => y) x :=
    differentiableAt_const (c := y)
  have hleft : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => a z • X.g z) x := ha.smul hg
  have hright : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z => b z • y) x := hb.smul hy
  have hfun : patchSliceMap S κ P y s =
      fun z => a z • X.g z - b z • y := by
    funext z
    rfl
  rw [hfun, fderiv_fun_sub hleft hright,
    fderiv_fun_smul ha hg, fderiv_fun_smul hb hy,
    fderiv_const_apply]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply, smul_zero, zero_add]
  dsimp only [a, b]
  change
    (1 + s * κ x) • fderiv ℝ X.g x h +
          (fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => 1 + s * κ z) x h) • X.g x -
        (fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => s * P z) x h) • y = _
  have hκ : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : E => κ z) x :=
    κ.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  have hP : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : E => P z) x :=
    P.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  have hfa : fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => 1 + s * κ z) x =
      s • fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => κ z) x := by
    rw [fderiv_const_add (1 : ℝ), fderiv_const_mul hκ s]
  have hfb : fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => s * P z) x =
      s • fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => P z) x := by
    rw [fderiv_const_mul hP s]
  rw [hfa, hfb]
  simp [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchSliceDerivative_apply
statement:
theorem patchSliceDerivative_apply (y : F) (s : ℝ) (x h : E) :
    patchSliceDerivative S κ P y s x h =
      fderiv ℝ (patchSliceMap S κ P y s) x h
proof:
:= by
  rw [fderiv_patchSliceMap_apply S κ P y s x h]
  simp [patchSliceDerivative, smul_apply]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.continuous_patchSliceDerivative
statement:
theorem continuous_patchSliceDerivative :
    Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) =>
      patchSliceDerivative S κ P q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hDg : Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) =>
      fderiv ℝ X.g q.2.2) :=
    (X.smooth.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).comp
      (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)
  have hDκ : Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) =>
      q.2.1 • fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => κ z) q.2.2) :=
    (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).smul
      ((κ.smooth.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).comp
        (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd))
  have hDP : Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) =>
      q.2.1 • fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => P z) q.2.2) :=
    (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).smul
      ((P.smooth.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).comp
        (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd))
  have hg : Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) => X.g q.2.2) :=
    X.smooth.continuous.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)
  have hfirst : Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) =>
      (1 + q.2.1 * κ q.2.2) • fderiv ℝ X.g q.2.2) := by
    have ha : Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) =>
        1 + q.2.1 * κ q.2.2) := by
      exact continuous_const.add
        ((continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd).mul
          (κ.smooth.continuous.comp
            (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd)))
    exact ha.smul hDg
  have hκrank : Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) =>
      (q.2.1 • fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => κ z) q.2.2).smulRight
        (X.g q.2.2)) :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ E F).continuous₂.comp₂ hDκ hg
  have hPrank : Continuous (fun q : F × (ℝ × E) =>
      (q.2.1 • fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => P z) q.2.2).smulRight q.1) :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRightL ℝ E F).continuous₂.comp₂ hDP continuous_fst
  exact (hfirst.add hκrank).sub hPrank

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchSliceDerivative_eq_fderiv
statement:
theorem patchSliceDerivative_eq_fderiv (y : F) (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    patchSliceDerivative S κ P y s x =
      fderiv ℝ (patchSliceMap S κ P y s) x
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro h
  exact patchSliceDerivative_apply S κ P y s x h

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.g_eq_smul_target_of_patchSliceMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem g_eq_smul_target_of_patchSliceMap_eq_zero
    (y : F) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) {x : E}
    (hx : patchSliceMap S κ P y s x = 0) :
    X.g x = ((1 + s * κ x)⁻¹ * (s * P x)) • y
proof:
:= by
  have hscale : 0 < 1 + s * κ x := by
    have hκ : 0 ≤ κ x := (κ.range x).1
    nlinarith [hs.1]
  have heq : (1 + s * κ x) • X.g x = (s * P x) • y := by
    change (1 + s * κ x) • X.g x - (s * P x) • y = 0 at hx
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hx
  calc
    X.g x = (1 + s * κ x)⁻¹ • ((1 + s * κ x) • X.g x) := by
      rw [smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hscale.ne', one_smul]
    _ = (1 + s * κ x)⁻¹ • ((s * P x) • y) := by rw [heq]
    _ = ((1 + s * κ x)⁻¹ * (s * P x)) • y := by rw [smul_smul]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.norm_g_le_norm_target_of_patchSliceMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem norm_g_le_norm_target_of_patchSliceMap_eq_zero
    (y : F) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) {x : E}
    (hx : patchSliceMap S κ P y s x = 0) :
    ‖X.g x‖ ≤ ‖y‖
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := (1 + s * κ x)⁻¹ * (s * P x)
  have hscale : 1 ≤ 1 + s * κ x := by
    have hκ : 0 ≤ κ x := (κ.range x).1
    nlinarith [hs.1]
  have hscalePos : 0 < 1 + s * κ x := lt_of_lt_of_le zero_lt_one hscale
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ a := by
    dsimp [a]
    exact mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hscalePos.le)
      (mul_nonneg hs.1 (EndpointPatchLocalizer.nonneg S κ P x))
  have hnum : s * P x ≤ 1 + s * κ x := by
    have hP1 : P x ≤ 1 := EndpointPatchLocalizer.le_one S κ P x
    have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := hs.2
    have hnum1 : s * P x ≤ 1 := by
      nlinarith [EndpointPatchLocalizer.nonneg S κ P x]
    exact hnum1.trans hscale
  have ha1 : a ≤ 1 := by
    dsimp [a]
    rw [inv_mul_le_one₀ hscalePos]
    exact hnum
  rw [g_eq_smul_target_of_patchSliceMap_eq_zero S κ P y hs hx,
    norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg ha0]
  exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg y) ha1

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.mem_fiber_union_tsupport_of_patchSliceMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_fiber_union_tsupport_of_patchSliceMap_eq_zero
    (y : F) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) {x : E}
    (hx : patchSliceMap S κ P y s x = 0) :
    x ∈ X.fiber ∪ tsupport (fun z : E => P z)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hP : x ∈ tsupport (fun z : E => P z)
  · exact Or.inr hP
  · apply Or.inl
    have hP0 : P x = 0 := image_eq_zero_of_notMem_tsupport hP
    have hscale : 0 < 1 + s * κ x := by
      have hκ : 0 ≤ κ x := (κ.range x).1
      nlinarith [hs.1]
    change X.g x = 0
    change (1 + s * κ x) • X.g x - (s * P x) • y = 0 at hx
    rw [hP0] at hx
    simpa using (smul_eq_zero.mp (by simpa using hx)).resolve_left hscale.ne'

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.fderiv_patchSliceMap_apply_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fderiv_patchSliceMap_apply_of_eq_zero
    (y : F) {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) {x : E}
    (hx : patchSliceMap S κ P y s x = 0) (h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (patchSliceMap S κ P y s) x h =
      (1 + s * κ x) • fderiv ℝ X.g x h +
        ((s * fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => κ z) x h) *
            ((1 + s * κ x)⁻¹ * (s * P x)) -
          s * fderiv ℝ (fun z : E => P z) x h) • y
proof:
:= by
  rw [fderiv_patchSliceMap_apply S κ P y s x h,
    g_eq_smul_target_of_patchSliceMap_eq_zero S κ P y hs hx,
    smul_smul]
  module

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.sliceMap_patchCobMap
statement:
lemma sliceMap_patchCobMap (y : F) (t : ℝ) :
    sliceMap (patchCobMap S κ P y) t =
      patchSliceMap S κ P y (normRamp t)
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  change patchCobMap S κ P y (cobSpaceTime x t) = _
  have hspace : cobSpaceTime x t = spaceTime x t := rfl
  rw [hspace]
  simp [patchCobMap, patchBase, patchScale, patchWeight, patchSliceMap,
    vertC_spaceTime, initCLM_spaceTime]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchSpatiallyRegular_zero
statement:
theorem patchSpatiallyRegular_zero :
    PatchSpatiallyRegular S κ P (0 : F)
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs x hx
  have hscale : 0 < 1 + s * κ x := by
    have hκ : 0 ≤ κ x := (κ.range x).1
    nlinarith [hs.1]
  have hg : X.g x = 0 := by
    change (1 + s * κ x) • X.g x - (s * P x) • (0 : F) = 0 at hx
    simp only [smul_zero, sub_zero] at hx
    exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hx).resolve_left hscale.ne'
  have hfun : patchSliceMap S κ P (0 : F) s =
      fun z => (1 + s * κ z) • X.g z := by
    funext z
    simp [patchSliceMap]
  rw [hfun]
  have ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : E => 1 + s * κ z) x :=
    (contDiff_const.add (contDiff_const.mul κ.smooth)).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  have hgdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ X.g x :=
    X.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  rw [fderiv_fun_smul ha hgdiff, hg]
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_zero, add_zero]
  intro z
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := X.regular x hg ((1 + s * κ x)⁻¹ • z)
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  rw [smul_apply, hu, smul_smul,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hscale.ne', one_smul]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_patchSpatiallyRegular_radius
statement:
theorem exists_patchSpatiallyRegular_radius :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ y : F, ‖y‖ < ε →
      PatchSpatiallyRegular S κ P y
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set E := X.fiber ∪ tsupport (fun z : E => P z)
  have hK : IsCompact K := by
    exact X.isCompact_fiber.union P.compact_support
  let C : Set (F × (ℝ × E)) :=
    Metric.closedBall (0 : F) 1 ×ˢ (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ K)
  have hC : IsCompact C := by
    exact (isCompact_closedBall (0 : F) 1).prod (isCompact_Icc.prod hK)
  let Z : Set (F × (ℝ × E)) := {q |
    patchSliceMap S κ P q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 = 0}
  have hZ : IsClosed Z := by
    change IsClosed ((fun q : F × (ℝ × E) =>
      patchSliceMap S κ P q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) ⁻¹' ({0} : Set F))
    exact isClosed_singleton.preimage (continuous_patchSliceMap S κ P)
  let N : Set (F × (ℝ × E)) := {q |
    ¬ Surjective (patchSliceDerivative S κ P q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2)}
  have hNS : IsClosed {L : E →L[ℝ] F | ¬ Surjective L} := by
    simpa only [Set.compl_setOf] using
      (isOpen_surjective_continuousLinearMap (n := n)).isClosed_compl
  have hN : IsClosed N := by
    change IsClosed ((fun q : F × (ℝ × E) =>
      patchSliceDerivative S κ P q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) ⁻¹'
        {L : E →L[ℝ] F | ¬ Surjective L})
    exact hNS.preimage (continuous_patchSliceDerivative S κ P)
  let B : Set (F × (ℝ × E)) := (C ∩ Z) ∩ N
  have hB : IsCompact B := by
    exact (hC.inter_right hZ).inter_right hN
  have hpos : ∀ q ∈ B, 0 < ‖q.1‖ := by
    intro q hq
    rcases hq with ⟨⟨hqC, hqZ⟩, hqN⟩
    rw [norm_pos_iff]
    intro hy0
    have hs : q.2.1 ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      exact hqC.2.1
    have hz : patchSliceMap S κ P (0 : F) q.2.1 q.2.2 = 0 := by
      change patchSliceMap S κ P q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2 = 0 at hqZ
      simpa [hy0] using hqZ
    have hsurj : Surjective
        (fderiv ℝ (patchSliceMap S κ P (0 : F) q.2.1) q.2.2) :=
      patchSpatiallyRegular_zero S κ P q.2.1 hs q.2.2 hz
    have hsurj' : Surjective
        (patchSliceDerivative S κ P q.1 q.2.1 q.2.2) := by
      rw [patchSliceDerivative_eq_fderiv S κ P]
      simpa [hy0] using hsurj
    exact hqN hsurj'
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hmin⟩ :=
    hB.exists_forall_le' continuous_fst.norm.continuousOn hpos
  refine ⟨min ε 1, lt_min hε zero_lt_one, ?_⟩
  intro y hy s hs x hx
  by_contra hnot
  have hxK : x ∈ K :=
    mem_fiber_union_tsupport_of_patchSliceMap_eq_zero S κ P y hs hx
  have hyBall : y ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : F) 1 := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    exact hy.le.trans (min_le_right ε 1)
  have hqC : (y, (s, x)) ∈ C := by
    exact ⟨hyBall, hs, hxK⟩
  have hqZ : (y, (s, x)) ∈ Z := by
    exact hx
  have hqN : (y, (s, x)) ∈ N := by
    change ¬ Surjective (patchSliceDerivative S κ P y s x)
    rw [patchSliceDerivative_eq_fderiv S κ P]
    exact hnot
  have hqB : (y, (s, x)) ∈ B := ⟨⟨hqC, hqZ⟩, hqN⟩
  have hlower : ε ≤ ‖y‖ := by
    simpa using hmin (y, (s, x)) hqB
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hlower) (hy.trans_le (min_le_left ε 1))

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchCobMap_regularSlab_of_patchSpatiallyRegular
statement:
theorem patchCobMap_regularSlab_of_patchSpatiallyRegular
    (y : F) (hsp : PatchSpatiallyRegular S κ P y) :
    regularSlab (patchCobMap S κ P y) 0 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularSlab]
  intro t ht htcrit
  obtain ⟨v, hvcrit, hvt⟩ := htcrit
  apply hvcrit.2
  let x : E := spacePart v
  have hvrepr : cobSpaceTime x t = v := by
    rw [← hvt]
    exact spaceTime_spacePart v
  have hs : normRamp t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨normRamp_nonneg t, normRamp_le_one t⟩
  have hz : patchSliceMap S κ P y (normRamp t) x = 0 := by
    have hz' := hvcrit.1
    rw [← hvrepr] at hz'
    change sliceMap (patchCobMap S κ P y) t x = 0 at hz'
    rwa [sliceMap_patchCobMap S κ P y t] at hz'
  have hsurj := hsp (normRamp t) hs x hz
  rw [← hvrepr]
  rw [← fderiv_sliceMap (contDiff_patchCobMap S κ P y) t x]
  rwa [sliceMap_patchCobMap S κ P y t]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchSignedCobordism_regularSlab_of_patchSpatiallyRegular
statement:
theorem patchSignedCobordism_regularSlab_of_patchSpatiallyRegular
    (y : F)
    (hreg : IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S κ P)
      (patchTransition S κ P) y)
    (hsp : PatchSpatiallyRegular S κ P y) :
    regularSlab (patchSignedCobordism S κ P y hreg).cobordism.G 0 1
proof:
:=
  patchCobMap_regularSlab_of_patchSpatiallyRegular S κ P y hsp

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.regularSlab_patchCobMap_iff_patchSpatiallyRegularOnRamp
statement:
theorem regularSlab_patchCobMap_iff_patchSpatiallyRegularOnRamp (y : F) :
    regularSlab (patchCobMap S κ P y) 0 1 ↔
      PatchSpatiallyRegularOnRamp S κ P y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hreg t ht x hx
    have hslice := hreg.sliceRegular ht
    have hs := hslice (cobSpaceTime x t)
    have hzero : patchCobMap S κ P y (cobSpaceTime x t) = 0 := by
      change sliceMap (patchCobMap S κ P y) t x = 0
      rwa [sliceMap_patchCobMap S κ P y t]
    have hsurj := hs hzero (tcoord_spaceTime x t)
    rw [← fderiv_sliceMap (contDiff_patchCobMap S κ P y) t x] at hsurj
    rwa [sliceMap_patchCobMap S κ P y t] at hsurj
  · intro hsp
    rw [regularSlab]
    intro t ht htcrit
    obtain ⟨v, hvcrit, hvt⟩ := htcrit
    apply hvcrit.2
    let x : E := spacePart v
    have hvrepr : cobSpaceTime x t = v := by
      rw [← hvt]
      exact spaceTime_spacePart v
    have hz : patchSliceMap S κ P y (normRamp t) x = 0 := by
      have hz' := hvcrit.1
      rw [← hvrepr] at hz'
      change sliceMap (patchCobMap S κ P y) t x = 0 at hz'
      rwa [sliceMap_patchCobMap S κ P y t] at hz'
    have hsurj := hsp t ht x hz
    rw [← hvrepr]
    rw [← fderiv_sliceMap (contDiff_patchCobMap S κ P y) t x]
    rwa [sliceMap_patchCobMap S κ P y t]

name: Submission.contDiff_normRamp
statement: lemma contDiff_normRamp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ normRamp
proof:
:=
  Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp

proof:

name: Submission.DefiningMapHomotopy.cobMap_regular
statement:
theorem cobMap_regular :
    ∀ v, D.cobMap v = 0 → Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ D.cobMap v)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv y
  have hxfib : initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ X₀.fiber :=
    D.mem_fiber_of_cobMap_eq_zero hv
  obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀⟩ :=
    D.regular (normRamp (vertC v)) (normRamp_nonneg _) (normRamp_le_one _)
      (initCLM (n + 1) v) hxfib y
  refine ⟨embedCLM (n + 1) h₀, ?_⟩
  
  have hGd : HasFDerivAt D.cobMap (fderiv ℝ D.cobMap v)
      (spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) (vertC v)) := by
    rw [spaceTime_init_vert]
    exact (D.contDiff_cobMap.differentiable infty_ne_zero v).hasFDerivAt
  have hA : HasFDerivAt
      (fun x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => spaceTime x' (vertC v))
      (embedCLM (n + 1)) (initCLM (n + 1) v) :=
    hasFDerivAt_spaceTime _ _
  have hcomp := hGd.comp (initCLM (n + 1) v) hA
  have hfun : (D.cobMap ∘
      fun x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => spaceTime x' (vertC v)) =
      D.H (normRamp (vertC v)) := by
    funext x'
    show D.cobMap (spaceTime x' (vertC v)) = _
    rw [cobMap_spaceTime]
  rw [hfun] at hcomp
  have hslice : fderiv ℝ (D.H (normRamp (vertC v))) (initCLM (n + 1) v) =
      (fderiv ℝ D.cobMap v).comp (embedCLM (n + 1)) :=
    hcomp.fderiv
  rw [hslice] at hh₀
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] using hh₀

name: Submission.surjective_fderiv_of_slice
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  obtain ⟨h₀, hh₀⟩ := hslice y
  refine ⟨embedCLM (n + 1) h₀, ?_⟩
  have hGd : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G v)
      (spaceTime (initCLM (n + 1) v) (vertC v)) := by
    rw [spaceTime_init_vert]
    exact (hG.differentiable infty_ne_zero v).hasFDerivAt
  have hA : HasFDerivAt
      (fun x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => spaceTime x' (vertC v))
      (embedCLM (n + 1)) (initCLM (n + 1) v) := hasFDerivAt_spaceTime _ _
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun x' => G (spaceTime x' (vertC v)))
      ((fderiv ℝ G v).comp (embedCLM (n + 1))) (initCLM (n + 1) v) :=
    hGd.comp (initCLM (n + 1) v) hA

name: Submission.slideScale_pos

lemma slideScale_pos {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) {r : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ r) (h1 : r ≤ 1) :

proof:
:= by
  unfold slideScale
  by_cases hr : r = 1
  · subst hr
    simpa using hc
  · have hrlt : r < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne h1 hr
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le (sub_pos.mpr hrlt)
      (le_add_of_nonneg_right (mul_nonneg h0 hc.le))

name: Submission.contDiff_slideTrack
statement:
lemma contDiff_slideTrack (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (slideTrack c b (n := n))
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) => normRamp (vertC v) :=
    contDiff_normRamp.comp contDiff_vertC
  have hscale : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) =>
        slideScale c (normRamp (vertC v)) :=
    (contDiff_const.sub hr).add (hr.mul contDiff_const)
  have hinv : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) =>
        (slideScale c (normRamp (vertC v)))⁻¹ :=
    hscale.inv fun v =>
      (slideScale_pos hc (normRamp_nonneg _) (normRamp_le_one _)).ne'
  have hvec : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) =>
        initCLM (n + 1) v - normRamp (vertC v) • b :=
    (initCLM (n + 1)).contDiff.sub (hr.smul contDiff_const)
  exact hinv.smul hvec

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.surjective_fderiv_affine
statement:
lemma FramedLevelSet.surjective_fderiv_affine (X : FramedLevelSet n) {a : ℝ}
    (ha : a ≠ 0) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : X.g (a⁻¹ • (x - w)) = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (fun x' => X.g (a⁻¹ • (x' - w))) x)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : HasFDerivAt
      (fun x' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => a⁻¹ • (x' - w))
      (a⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) x :=
    ((hasFDerivAt_id x).sub_const w).const_smul a⁻¹
  have hg : HasFDerivAt X.g (fderiv ℝ X.g (a⁻¹ • (x - w))) (a⁻¹ • (x - w)) :=
    (X.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero _).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun x' => X.g (a⁻¹ • (x' - w)))
      ((fderiv ℝ X.g (a⁻¹ • (x - w))).comp
        (a⁻¹ • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) x :=
    hg.comp x hA
  rw [hcomp.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_comp]
  apply (X.regular _ hx).comp
  intro y
  refine ⟨a • y, ?_⟩
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply, smul_smul,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.affinePullback_fiber
statement:
theorem FramedLevelSet.affinePullback_fiber (X : FramedLevelSet n) (c : ℝ)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (b : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    (X.affinePullback c hc b).fiber = (fun z => c • z + b) '' X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    refine ⟨c⁻¹ • (x - b), hx, ?_⟩
    change c • (c⁻¹ • (x - b)) + b = x
    rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
    abel
  · rintro ⟨z, hz, rfl⟩
    show X.g (c⁻¹ • (c • z + b - b)) = 0
    rw [add_sub_cancel_right, smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hc, one_smul]
    exact hz

name: Submission.BridgeData.flatOutside_native
statement:
theorem flatOutside_native (B : BridgeData n z) :
    B.fls.FlatOutside B.flatBackground 0 (n + 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hcollar : WithLp.ofLp x ∈ closedAmbientCollar (Fin (n + 1)) := by
    by_contra hnc
    have hcoord : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 1 := by
      intro i
      have hnot : ¬(x i ≤ 1 / 5 ∨ 4 / 5 ≤ x i) :=
        fun h => hnc ⟨i, h⟩
      rw [not_or, not_le, not_le] at hnot
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hnot.1], by linarith [hnot.2]⟩
    have hnorm : ‖x‖ ≤ n + 1 := by
      have hsq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := norm_sq_eq_sum x
      have hsum : (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℝ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have hi := hcoord i
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (x i), sq_abs (x i)]
      have hone : (∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℝ)) = n + 1 := by simp
      have hsq' : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
        have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
        have hn1 : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        calc
          ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := hsq
          _ ≤ n + 1 := hsum.trans_eq hone
          _ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := hn1
      have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
    rw [dist_zero_right] at hx
    linarith
  change bridgeHMapE B.approx x - B.y = -B.y
  have hzero : bridgeHMapE B.approx x = 0 :=
    bridgeHMap_of_mem_collar B.approx hcollar
  rw [hzero, zero_sub]

name: Submission.FiberSign.allPositiveFrameLedger_ne_single_zero_of_delta_eq_zero

name: Submission.ZeroFramedConfiguration.positiveFrameLedger_eq_single_zero
statement:
theorem positiveFrameLedger_eq_single_zero :
    (sign m).positiveFrameLedger (field m) = [(0 : ZMod 2)]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let A := (sign m).positiveOrbitCollection (field m)
  let O₀ := zeroOrbit m
  have hO₀ : ((O₀ : (field m).OrbitIndex) :
      Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))) ∈ A := by
    exact zeroOrbit_mem_positiveCollection m
  have hcard : Fintype.card ((field m).SelectedOrbitIndex A) = 1 := by
    rw [Fintype.card_eq_one_iff]
    refine ⟨⟨O₀, hO₀⟩, ?_⟩
    intro Q
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact (mem_positiveCollection_iff m Q.1).mp Q.2
  let L := (field m).selectedFrameLedger A
  have hlength : L.length = 1 := by
    simp [L, TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, hcard]
  have hall : ∀ beta ∈ L, beta = (0 : ZMod 2) := by
    intro beta hbeta
    simp only [L, TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, List.mem_ofFn] at hbeta
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hbeta
    let Q := (Fintype.equivFin ((field m).SelectedOrbitIndex A)).symm i
    have hQ : Q.1 = O₀ := (mem_positiveCollection_iff m Q.1).mp Q.2
    simpa [Q, hQ, O₀] using zeroOrbit_frameClass m
  change L = [(0 : ZMod 2)]
  rw [L.eq_cons_of_length_one hlength]
  congr
  exact hall _ (by simp)

  have hp := V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O

  rw [hS] at hmem

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitTube_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem orbitTube_zero (O : V.OrbitIndex) (a : C) :
    V.orbitTube O (a, 0) = V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding O a
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  simp

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_orbitTube_local_box
statement:
theorem exists_orbitTube_local_box (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ r > 0,
      Ioo (u - ε) (u + ε) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N) r ⊆
        (V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph O u).source
proof:
:= by
  have hnhds : (V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph O u).source ∈
      𝓝 (u, (0 : N)) :=
    (V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph O u).open_source.mem_nhds
      (V.orbitTube_center_mem_localSource O u)
  rcases mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp hnhds with ⟨U, hU, W, hW, hUW⟩
  rcases Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU with ⟨ε, hε, hεU⟩
  rcases Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hW with ⟨r, hr, hrW⟩
  refine ⟨ε, hε, r, hr, ?_⟩
  rw [← Real.ball_eq_Ioo]
  exact (prod_mono hεU hrW).trans hUW

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_orbitTube_injective_local_box
statement:
theorem exists_orbitTube_injective_local_box (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ r > 0,
      Set.InjOn (V.orbitTubeLift O)
        (Ioo (u - ε) (u + ε) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N) r)
proof:
:= by
  rcases V.exists_orbitTube_local_box O u with
    ⟨ε, hε, r, hr, hbox⟩
  exact ⟨ε, hε, r, hr,
    (V.orbitTube_injOn_localSource O u).mono hbox⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.nonempty_orbitTubeLocalBoxData
statement:
theorem nonempty_orbitTubeLocalBoxData (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    Nonempty (V.OrbitTubeLocalBoxData O u)
proof:
:= by
  rcases V.exists_orbitTube_local_box O u with
    ⟨ε, hε, r, hr, hbox⟩
  exact ⟨{
    phaseRadius := ε
    phaseRadius_pos := hε
    normalRadius := r
    normalRadius_pos := hr
    box_subset_source := hbox
  }⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.mem_orbitTubeLocalBox_phase
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_orbitTubeLocalBox_phase (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    u ∈ Ioo
      (u - (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius)
      (u + (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius)
proof:
:= by
  constructor <;>
    linarith [(V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius_pos]

name: Submission.TamedField.isOpen_orbitTubeQuotientBox
statement:
theorem isOpen_orbitTubeQuotientBox (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    IsOpen (V.orbitTubeQuotientBox O u)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpen.prod
  · exact QuotientAddGroup.isOpenMap_coe _ isOpen_Ioo
  · exact Metric.isOpen_ball

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitTube_zero_mem_quotientBox
statement:
@[simp] theorem orbitTube_zero_mem_quotientBox (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    ((u : C), (0 : N)) ∈ V.orbitTubeQuotientBox O u
proof:
:= by
  exact ⟨⟨u, V.mem_orbitTubeLocalBox_phase O u, rfl⟩,
    Metric.mem_ball_self
      (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).normalRadius_pos⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitTube_injOn_quotientBox
statement:
theorem orbitTube_injOn_quotientBox (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    Set.InjOn (V.orbitTube O) (V.orbitTubeQuotientBox O u)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, z⟩ ⟨⟨ua, hua, rfl⟩, hz⟩
    ⟨b, w⟩ ⟨⟨ub, hub, rfl⟩, hw⟩ heq
  have heqLift : V.orbitTubeLift O (ua, z) =
      V.orbitTubeLift O (ub, w) := by
    simpa using heq
  have hmema : (ua, z) ∈ (V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph O u).source :=
    (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).box_subset_source ⟨hua, hz⟩
  have hmemb : (ub, w) ∈ (V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph O u).source :=
    (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).box_subset_source ⟨hub, hw⟩
  have hpair : (ua, z) = (ub, w) :=
    V.orbitTube_injOn_localSource O u hmema hmemb heqLift
  cases hpair
  rfl

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_finite_orbitTube_quotientBox_cover
statement:
theorem exists_finite_orbitTube_quotientBox_cover (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    ∃ s : Finset ℝ,
      Set.range (fun a : C => (a, (0 : N))) ⊆
        ⋃ u ∈ s, V.orbitTubeQuotientBox O u
proof:
:= by
  have hcompact : IsCompact (Set.range fun a : C => (a, (0 : N))) :=
    isCompact_range (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hcover : Set.range (fun a : C => (a, (0 : N))) ⊆
      ⋃ u : ℝ, V.orbitTubeQuotientBox O u := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, V.orbitTube_zero_mem_quotientBox O u⟩
  exact hcompact.elim_finite_subcover
    (fun u : ℝ => V.orbitTubeQuotientBox O u)
    (V.isOpen_orbitTubeQuotientBox O) hcover

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_finite_orbitTube_uniform_quotientBox_cover
statement:
theorem exists_finite_orbitTube_uniform_quotientBox_cover
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    ∃ (s : Finset ℝ) (r : ℝ), s.Nonempty ∧ 0 < r ∧
      Set.range (fun a : C => (a, (0 : N))) ⊆
        ⋃ u ∈ s,
          ((fun t : ℝ => (t : C)) '' Ioo
              (u - (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius)
              (u + (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius)) ×ˢ
            Metric.ball (0 : N) r ∧
      ∀ u ∈ s, Set.InjOn (V.orbitTube O)
        (((fun t : ℝ => (t : C)) '' Ioo
            (u - (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius)
            (u + (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius)) ×ˢ
          Metric.ball (0 : N) r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := V.exists_finite_orbitTube_quotientBox_cover O
  have hsne : s.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h] at hs
    have hzero := hs
      (show ((0 : C), (0 : N)) ∈
        Set.range (fun a : C => (a, (0 : N))) by exact ⟨0, rfl⟩)
    simpa using hzero
  let radii : Finset ℝ :=
    s.image fun u => (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).normalRadius
  have hradii : radii.Nonempty := hsne.image _
  let r : ℝ := radii.min' hradii
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by
    have hrmem : r ∈ radii := radii.min'_mem hradii
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hrmem with ⟨u, hu, hur⟩
    rw [← hur]
    exact (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).normalRadius_pos
  refine ⟨s, r, hsne, hrpos, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q hq
    have hq' := hs hq
    rcases mem_iUnion.mp hq' with ⟨u, hq'⟩
    rcases mem_iUnion.mp hq' with ⟨hu, hq'⟩
    rcases hq with ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨hu,
      ⟨hq'.1, Metric.mem_ball_self hrpos⟩⟩⟩
  · intro u hu
    have hrle : r ≤ (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).normalRadius := by
      apply radii.min'_le
      exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
    apply (V.orbitTube_injOn_quotientBox O u).mono
    exact prod_mono Subset.rfl (Metric.ball_subset_ball hrle)

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_finite_orbitTube_box_cover
statement:
theorem exists_finite_orbitTube_box_cover (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    ∃ (s : Finset ℝ) (r : ℝ), s.Nonempty ∧ 0 < r ∧
      Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆
        ⋃ u ∈ s, Ioo
          (u - (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius)
          (u + (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius) ∧
      ∀ u ∈ s, Set.InjOn (V.orbitTubeLift O)
        (Ioo
            (u - (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius)
            (u + (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius) ×ˢ
          Metric.ball (0 : N) r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let U : ℝ → Set ℝ := fun u => Ioo
    (u - (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius)
    (u + (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).phaseRadius)
  have hcover : Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ ⋃ u : ℝ, U u := by
    intro u hu
    exact mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨u, V.mem_orbitTubeLocalBox_phase O u⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := isCompact_Icc.elim_finite_subcover U
    (fun _ => isOpen_Ioo) hcover
  have hsne : s.Nonempty := by
    by_contra h
    rw [Finset.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp h] at hs
    have hzero := hs (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc 0 1 by norm_num)
    simpa using hzero
  let radii : Finset ℝ :=
    s.image fun u => (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).normalRadius
  have hradii : radii.Nonempty := hsne.image _
  let r : ℝ := radii.min' hradii
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by
    have hrmem : r ∈ radii := radii.min'_mem hradii
    rcases Finset.mem_image.mp hrmem with ⟨u, hu, hur⟩
    rw [← hur]
    exact (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).normalRadius_pos
  refine ⟨s, r, hsne, hrpos, hs, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  have hrle : r ≤ (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).normalRadius := by
    apply radii.min'_le
    exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩
  apply (V.orbitTube_injOn_localSource O u).mono
  exact (prod_mono Subset.rfl (Metric.ball_subset_ball hrle)).trans
    (V.orbitTubeLocalBoxData O u).box_subset_source

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.forward_mem_pullbackI_fiber

  X.smooth.comp (A.inverse_smooth.comp

      fderiv ℝ (fun y => X.g (A.inverse q.1 y)) q.2)
proof:
:=
  ContDiff.fderiv
    (f := fun (q : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
      (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) => X.g (A.inverse q.1 y))
    (g := fun q : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => q.2)
    (A.contDiff_famUncurry X) contDiff_snd (by simp)

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.contDiff_famGradVec
statement:
theorem contDiff_famGradVec (j : Fin n) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) =>
      gradVec (fun y => X.g (A.inverse q.1 y)) j q.2)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun q : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) =>
        (EuclideanSpace.proj j).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => X.g (A.inverse q.1 y)) q.2)) =
      fun q : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) =>
        (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
          (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj j))
          (fderiv ℝ (fun y => X.g (A.inverse q.1 y)) q.2) := rfl
  have hstep : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) =>
      (EuclideanSpace.proj j).comp
        (fderiv ℝ (fun y => X.g (A.inverse q.1 y)) q.2)) := by
    rw [heq]
    exact (ContinuousLinearMap.contDiff _).comp (A.contDiff_famFDeriv X)
  exact (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ
    (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))).symm.contDiff.comp hstep

proof:
:= by
  have hpair : Continuous fun t => (((sf t : ℝ)), γ t) :=
    (continuous_subtype_val.comp hsf).prodMk hγ
  simp only [A.pullbackI_g_fun X]
  exact (A.contDiff_famGradVec X j).continuous.comp' hpair

    Continuous fun t => kerCross (A.pullbackI X (sf t)).g (γ t)

    (continuous_pi fun j => A.continuous_pullbackI_gradVec X hsf hγ j)

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.continuous_pullbackI_tauField
statement:
theorem continuous_pullbackI_tauField (hsf : Continuous sf) (hγ : Continuous γ)
    (hreg : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet (A.pullbackI X (sf t)).g) :
    Continuous fun t => tauField (A.pullbackI X (sf t)).g (γ t)
proof:
:= by
  have hK : Continuous fun t => kerCross (A.pullbackI X (sf t)).g (γ t) :=
    A.continuous_pullbackI_kerCross X hsf hγ
  have hne : ∀ t, kerCross (A.pullbackI X (sf t)).g (γ t) ≠ 0 := fun t =>
    (kerCross_ne_zero_iff _ _).mpr (hreg t)
  have heq : (fun t => tauField (A.pullbackI X (sf t)).g (γ t)) =
      fun t => ‖kerCross (A.pullbackI X (sf t)).g (γ t)‖⁻¹ •
        kerCross (A.pullbackI X (sf t)).g (γ t) := rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact (hK.norm.inv₀ fun t => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hne t)).smul hK

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.continuous_pullbackI_frameAt
statement:
theorem continuous_pullbackI_frameAt (hsf : Continuous sf) (hγ : Continuous γ)
    (hreg : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet (A.pullbackI X (sf t)).g) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Continuous fun t => frameAt (A.pullbackI X (sf t)) (γ t) i
proof:
:= by
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
  · have heq : (fun t => frameAt (A.pullbackI X (sf t)) (γ t) 0) =
        fun t => tauField (A.pullbackI X (sf t)).g (γ t) := by
      funext t
      simp [frameAt]
    rw [heq]
    exact A.continuous_pullbackI_tauField X hsf hγ hreg
  · have heq : (fun t => frameAt (A.pullbackI X (sf t)) (γ t) k.succ) =
        fun t => gradVec (A.pullbackI X (sf t)).g k (γ t) := by
      funext t
      simp [frameAt]
    rw [heq]
    exact A.continuous_pullbackI_gradVec X hsf hγ k

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.loopClassZ2_isotopyRawLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_isotopyRawLoop (hγ : ∀ u : I, γ u ∈ X.fiber)
    (hcl : γ 0 = γ 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap (A.isotopyRawLoop X γ hγ 0)
          (A.isotopyRawLoop_det_pos X γ hγ 0))
        (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed _ _
          (A.isotopyRawLoop_closed X γ hγ hcl 0)) =
      loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap (A.isotopyRawLoop X γ hγ 1)
          (A.isotopyRawLoop_det_pos X γ hγ 1))
        (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed _ _
          (A.isotopyRawLoop_closed X γ hγ hcl 1))
proof:
:= by
  refine loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixHomotopy_congr
    (A.isotopyRawHomotopy X γ hγ)
    (A.isotopyRawLoop_det_pos X γ hγ 0)
    (A.isotopyRawLoop_det_pos X γ hγ 1)
    (fun q => A.isotopyRawMatrix_det_pos X γ hγ q.1 q.2)
    (A.isotopyRawLoop_closed X γ hγ hcl 0)
    (A.isotopyRawLoop_closed X γ hγ hcl 1) ?_
  intro s
  show A.isotopyRawMatrix X γ s 0 = A.isotopyRawMatrix X γ s 1
  unfold isotopyRawMatrix
  rw [hcl]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.loopClassZ2_transportParam
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_transportParam {X : FramedLevelSet n} {V : TamedField X}
    (U : TamedField (A.pullback X)) (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    loopClassZ2 (A.transportParam U P).paramFrameLoop
        (A.transportParam U P).paramFrameLoop_closed =
      loopClassZ2 P.paramFrameLoop P.paramFrameLoop_closed
proof:
:= by
  set γ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :=
    { toFun := fun u => P.realCurve (u : ℝ)
      continuous_toFun := P.continuous_realCurve.comp continuous_subtype_val }
    with hγdef
  have hγfib : ∀ u : I, γ u ∈ X.fiber := fun u => P.realCurve_mem_fiber _
  have hγcl : γ 0 = γ 1 := by
    show P.realCurve (((0 : I) : ℝ)) = P.realCurve (((1 : I) : ℝ))
    rw [P.realCurve_coe 0, P.realCurve_coe 1]
    exact P.curve_closed
  have hzero : P.paramFrameLoop =
      positiveMatrixSOMap (A.isotopyRawLoop X γ hγfib 0)
        (A.isotopyRawLoop_det_pos X γ hγfib 0) := by
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro u
    apply Subtype.ext
    show rowsMatrix (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X (P.realCurve (u : ℝ)))) =
      rowsMatrix (InnerProductSpace.gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
        (matrixRows (A.isotopyRawMatrix X γ 0 u)))
    rw [A.isotopyRawMatrix_zero X γ u]
    rfl
  have hone : (A.transportParam U P).paramFrameLoop =
      positiveMatrixSOMap (A.isotopyRawLoop X γ hγfib 1)
        (A.isotopyRawLoop_det_pos X γ hγfib 1) := by
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro u
    apply Subtype.ext
    rfl
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun (A.transportParam U P).paramFrameLoop_closed
      (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed _ (A.isotopyRawLoop_det_pos X γ hγfib 1)
        (A.isotopyRawLoop_closed X γ hγfib hγcl 1)) hone,
    loopClassZ2_congr_fun P.paramFrameLoop_closed
      (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed _ (A.isotopyRawLoop_det_pos X γ hγfib 0)
        (A.isotopyRawLoop_closed X γ hγfib hγcl 0)) hzero]
  exact (A.loopClassZ2_isotopyRawLoop X γ hγfib hγcl).symm

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.orbitFrameClass_pullback
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_pullback {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    (U : TamedField (A.pullback X)) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    ∃ O' : U.OrbitIndex, U.orbitFrameClass O' = V.orbitFrameClass O
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let P₁ : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (A.pullback X) U :=
    A.transportParam U (V.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam O)
  have hmemFinset : U.orbit P₁.p ∈ U.orbitFinset :=
    U.mem_orbitFinset.mpr ⟨P₁.p, P₁.hp, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨O', hO'⟩ : ∃ O' : U.OrbitIndex,
      ((O' : U.OrbitIndex) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
        U.orbit P₁.p :=
    ⟨⟨U.orbit P₁.p, hmemFinset⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨O', ?_⟩
  have hclass : loopClassZ2 P₁.paramFrameLoop P₁.paramFrameLoop_closed =
      V.orbitFrameClass O := by
    rw [A.loopClassZ2_transportParam U (V.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam O)]
    exact V.intrinsicParamFrameClass O
  have hfund : U.fundamentalFrameClass P₁.hp = V.orbitFrameClass O := by
    rw [← P₁.paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental]
    exact hclass
  have hmem : U.orbitPoint O' ∈ U.orbit P₁.p := by
    rw [← hO', U.orbitPoint_orbit O']
    exact U.mem_orbit_self _
  have hbase := U.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit P₁.hp hmem
  show U.fundamentalFrameClass (U.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O') = _
  rw [show U.fundamentalFrameClass (U.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O') =
      U.fundamentalFrameClass (U.orbit_subset_fiber P₁.hp hmem) from rfl,
    hbase, hfund]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalAdjointOnRange_injective
statement:
theorem criticalAdjointOnRange_injective
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) :
    Injective (R.criticalAdjointOnRange p)
proof:
:= by
  let A := spatialDeriv (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
    (R.criticalCenter p)
  intro y z hyz
  have hadj : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A (y.1 - z.1) = 0 := by
    change R.criticalAdjointOnRange p (y - z) = 0
    rw [map_sub, hyz, sub_self]
  have hyrange : y.1 - z.1 ∈ LinearMap.range A.toLinearMap := by
    exact sub_mem y.2 z.2
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hyrange
  have hself : ⟪y.1 - z.1, y.1 - z.1⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    calc
      ⟪y.1 - z.1, y.1 - z.1⟫_ℝ = ⟪y.1 - z.1, A x⟫_ℝ := by
        congr 1
        exact hx.symm
      _ = ⟪ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A (y.1 - z.1), x⟫_ℝ := by
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hadj, inner_zero_left]
  have hsub : y.1 - z.1 = 0 := inner_self_eq_zero.mp hself
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hsub

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.linearIndependent_criticalTransverseNormal
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_criticalTransverseNormal
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (R.criticalTransverseNormal p hp)
proof:
:= by
  let b := R.criticalTransverseRangeBasis p hp
  have hb : LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i => b i) :=
    b.toBasis.linearIndependent
  have hker : (R.criticalAdjointOnRange p).ker = ⊥ :=
    LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr (R.criticalAdjointOnRange_injective p)
  have hmapped := hb.map' (R.criticalAdjointOnRange p) hker
  change LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i =>
    R.criticalAdjointOnRange p (R.criticalTransverseRangeBasis p hp i))
  simpa [b, Function.comp_def] using hmapped

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.spatialDeriv_criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent_zero
statement:
theorem spatialDeriv_criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (w : E₂) :
    spatialDeriv (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
        (R.criticalCenter p)
        (R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent p hp 0 w) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ‖(0 : E₂)‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius := by
    simpa using (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius_pos
  have hmodel :
      fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ =>
        G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 +
          morseQuadratic (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index (z 0, z 1))
        0 w = 0 := by
    rw [fderiv_const_add_morseQuadratic_apply]
    cases (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index <;>
      simp [morseHessianPairing]
  have h := R.spatialDeriv_criticalSurfaceParam_eq_zero_of_model_tangent
    p hp 0 hzero w hmodel
  simpa [criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent,
    R.criticalSurfaceParam_zero p hp] using h

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.tcoord_fderiv_criticalSurfaceParam_zero
statement:
theorem tcoord_fderiv_criticalSurfaceParam_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)

proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ‖(0 : E₂)‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius := by
    simpa using (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius_pos
  rw [← R.fderiv_criticalSurfaceParam_time_apply p hp 0 hzero w]
  have hmodel := congrArg (fun L : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L w)
    (R.fderiv_criticalSurfaceParam_time p hp 0 hzero)
  rw [hmodel, fderiv_const_add_morseQuadratic_apply]

    simp [morseHessianPairing]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent_zero_ne_zero
statement:
theorem criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent_zero_ne_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    {w : E₂} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent p hp 0 w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, _hrle, hinj⟩ :=
    R.exists_criticalSurfaceParam_injective_radius p hp
  have hzeroRadius : ‖(0 : E₂)‖ < r := by simpa using hr
  have hfullinj : Injective
      (fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) 0) := hinj 0 hzeroRadius
  intro hspace
  change spacePart (fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) 0 w) = 0 at hspace
  let z := fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) 0 w
  have htime : tcoord z = 0 := by
    exact R.tcoord_fderiv_criticalSurfaceParam_zero p hp w
  have hz : z = 0 := by
    calc
      z = cobSpaceTime (spacePart z) (tcoord z) :=
        (spaceTime_spacePart z).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime 0 0 := by rw [hspace, htime]
      _ = 0 := by
        ext i
        refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
        · rw [spaceTime_apply_last]
          rfl
        · rw [spaceTime_apply_castSucc]
          rfl
  apply hw
  apply hfullinj
  simpa [z] using hz

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.linearIndependent_centerRowsWith
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_centerRowsWith
    (transverse : Fin m → E₁) (tangent normal radial : E₁)
    (htransverse : LinearIndependent ℝ transverse)
    (htangent : tangent ≠ 0)
    (htransverseTangent : ∀ i, ⟪transverse i, tangent⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (htransverseRadial : ∀ i, ⟪transverse i, radial⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hnormalTangent : ⟪normal, tangent⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hnormalRadial : ⟪normal, radial⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (centerRowsWith transverse tangent normal)
proof:
:= by
  have hnormalSpan : normal ∉ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range transverse) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hmem
    have hpair : ⟪normal, radial⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
      calc
        ⟪normal, radial⟫_ℝ =
            ⟪∑ i, c i • transverse i, radial⟫_ℝ := by rw [hc]
        _ = ∑ i, ⟪c i • transverse i, radial⟫_ℝ := by rw [sum_inner]
        _ = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro i _hi
          rw [real_inner_smul_left, htransverseRadial i, mul_zero]
    exact hnormalRadial hpair
  have htail : LinearIndependent ℝ (Fin.snoc transverse normal) :=
    linearIndependent_fin_snoc.mpr ⟨htransverse, hnormalSpan⟩
  have htangentSpan :
      tangent ∉ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (Fin.snoc transverse normal)) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hmem
    have hrowPair : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1),
        ⟪(Fin.snoc transverse normal : Fin (m + 1) → E₁) i,
          tangent⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
      intro i
      refine Fin.lastCases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simpa only [Fin.snoc_last] using hnormalTangent
      · simpa only [Fin.snoc_castSucc] using htransverseTangent j
    have hself : ⟪tangent, tangent⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
      calc
        ⟪tangent, tangent⟫_ℝ =
            ⟪∑ i, c i • Fin.snoc transverse normal i, tangent⟫_ℝ := by
              rw [hc]
        _ = ∑ i, ⟪c i • Fin.snoc transverse normal i, tangent⟫_ℝ := by
              rw [sum_inner]
        _ = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro i _hi
          rw [real_inner_smul_left, hrowPair i, mul_zero]
    exact htangent (inner_self_eq_zero.mp hself)
  exact linearIndependent_fin_cons.mpr ⟨htail, htangentSpan⟩

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.linearIndependent_centerRowsWith_test
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_centerRowsWith_test
    (transverse : Fin m → E₁) (tangent last test : E₁)
    (htransverse : LinearIndependent ℝ transverse)
    (htangent : tangent ≠ 0)
    (htransverseTangent : ∀ i, ⟪transverse i, tangent⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (htransverseTest : ∀ i, ⟪transverse i, test⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (htangentTest : ⟪tangent, test⟫_ℝ = 0)
    (hlastTest : ⟪last, test⟫_ℝ ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (centerRowsWith transverse tangent last)
proof:
:= by
  have htangentSpan : tangent ∉ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range transverse) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hmem
    have hself : ⟪tangent, tangent⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
      calc
        ⟪tangent, tangent⟫_ℝ =
            ⟪∑ i, c i • transverse i, tangent⟫_ℝ := by rw [hc]
        _ = ∑ i, ⟪c i • transverse i, tangent⟫_ℝ := by rw [sum_inner]
        _ = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro i _hi
          rw [real_inner_smul_left, htransverseTangent i, mul_zero]
    exact htangent (inner_self_eq_zero.mp hself)
  have hfront : LinearIndependent ℝ (Fin.cons tangent transverse) :=
    linearIndependent_fin_cons.mpr ⟨htransverse, htangentSpan⟩
  have hlastSpan :
      last ∉ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (Fin.cons tangent transverse)) := by
    intro hmem
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
      (Submodule.mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun ℝ).mp hmem
    have hfrontPair : ∀ i : Fin (m + 1),
        ⟪(Fin.cons tangent transverse : Fin (m + 1) → E₁) i,
          test⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
      intro i
      refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun j => ?_) i
      · simpa only [Fin.cons_zero] using htangentTest
      · simpa only [Fin.cons_succ] using htransverseTest j
    have hpair : ⟪last, test⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
      calc
        ⟪last, test⟫_ℝ =
            ⟪∑ i, c i • Fin.cons tangent transverse i, test⟫_ℝ := by rw [hc]
        _ = ∑ i, ⟪c i • Fin.cons tangent transverse i, test⟫_ℝ := by
              rw [sum_inner]
        _ = 0 := by
          apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
          intro i _hi
          rw [real_inner_smul_left, hfrontPair i, mul_zero]
    exact hlastTest hpair
  have hsnoc : LinearIndependent ℝ
      (Fin.snoc (Fin.cons tangent transverse) last) :=
    linearIndependent_fin_snoc.mpr ⟨hfront, hlastSpan⟩
  rw [centerRowsWith, Fin.cons_snoc_eq_snoc_cons]
  exact hsnoc

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.inner_tangent_tangentOrthogonalRadial
statement:
theorem inner_tangent_tangentOrthogonalRadial
    (tangent radial : E₁) (htangent : tangent ≠ 0) :
    ⟪tangent, tangentOrthogonalRadial tangent radial⟫_ℝ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hself : ⟪tangent, tangent⟫_ℝ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact htangent (inner_self_eq_zero.mp h)

    real_inner_comm tangent radial]
  field_simp

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.inner_left_tangentOrthogonalRadial_eq
statement:
theorem inner_left_tangentOrthogonalRadial_eq
    (tangent radial left : E₁)
    (hleft : ⟪left, tangent⟫_ℝ = 0) :
    ⟪left, tangentOrthogonalRadial tangent radial⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪left, radial⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [tangentOrthogonalRadial, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right,
    hleft, mul_zero, sub_zero]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.inner_radial_tangentOrthogonalRadial_eq_self
statement:
theorem inner_radial_tangentOrthogonalRadial_eq_self
    (tangent radial : E₁) (htangent : tangent ≠ 0) :
    ⟪radial, tangentOrthogonalRadial tangent radial⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪tangentOrthogonalRadial tangent radial,
        tangentOrthogonalRadial tangent radial⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  let q := tangentOrthogonalRadial tangent radial
  let c := ⟪radial, tangent⟫_ℝ / ⟪tangent, tangent⟫_ℝ
  have hq : ⟪tangent, q⟫_ℝ = 0 :=
    inner_tangent_tangentOrthogonalRadial tangent radial htangent
  have hdecomp : radial = q + c • tangent := by
    dsimp [q, c, tangentOrthogonalRadial]
    module
  have hcalc : ⟪radial, q⟫_ℝ = ⟪q, q⟫_ℝ := by
    calc
      ⟪radial, q⟫_ℝ = ⟪q + c • tangent, q⟫_ℝ :=
        congrArg (fun x : E₁ => ⟪x, q⟫_ℝ) hdecomp
      _ = ⟪q, q⟫_ℝ + c * ⟪tangent, q⟫_ℝ := by
        rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left]
      _ = ⟪q, q⟫_ℝ := by rw [hq, mul_zero, add_zero]
  simpa [q] using hcalc

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.nonzeroOrientationSign_ne_zero

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.linearIndependent_criticalMinimumCenterRows
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_criticalMinimumCenterRows
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    (theta : ℝ) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (R.criticalMinimumCenterRows p hp theta)
proof:
:= by
  apply linearIndependent_centerRowsWith
  · exact R.linearIndependent_criticalTransverseNormal p hp
  · exact R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_zero_ne_zero p hp theta
  · intro i
    exact R.inner_criticalTransverseNormal_unitTangent_zero p hp i theta
  · intro i
    exact R.inner_criticalTransverseNormal_radial_zero p hp i theta
  · exact R.inner_criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero_unitTangent_minimum
      p hp hindex theta
  · exact R.inner_criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero_radial_minimum_ne_zero
      p hp hindex theta

statement:
theorem linearIndependent_criticalMaximumCenterRows

  · exact neg_ne_zero.mpr
      (R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_zero_ne_zero p hp theta)
  · intro i

      neg_zero]
  · intro i

  · rw [criticalDefiniteUnitTangentRev, inner_neg_right,

        p hp hindex theta,

theorem dist_cobSpaceTime_same (x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))

proof:
:= by
  rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
  have h : cobSpaceTime x τ - cobSpaceTime y τ = spaceInclL (x - y) := by
    rw [spaceTime_eq x τ, spaceTime_eq y τ, map_sub]

name: Submission.inner_spaceInclL_left
statement:
theorem inner_spaceInclL_left (a : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :
    ⟪spaceInclL a, w⟫ = ⟪a, spacePart w⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply, PiLp.inner_apply, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  have hlast : (spaceInclL a) (Fin.last (n + 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [spaceInclL_apply]
    exact spaceTime_apply_last a 0
  rw [hlast, inner_zero_left, add_zero]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  have h1 : (spaceInclL a) (Fin.castSucc i) = a i := by
    rw [spaceInclL_apply]
    exact spaceTime_apply_castSucc a 0 i
  rw [h1]
  rfl

name: Submission.TamedField.dist_flow_le
statement:
theorem dist_flow_le (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (d : ℝ) :
    dist (V.flow p d) p ≤ |d|
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ u u' : ℝ, u' ≤ u →
      ‖V.flow p u - V.flow p u'‖ ≤ 1 * (u - u') := by
    intro u u' huu
    exact norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment'
      (f := V.flow p) (f' := fun z => V.v (V.flow p z)) (a := u') (b := u)
      (C := 1)
      (fun z _ => (V.hasDerivAt_flow p z).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun z _ => V.norm_le _)
      u ⟨huu, le_refl u⟩
  rcases le_total 0 d with h | h
  · rw [dist_eq_norm, abs_of_nonneg h]
    have h1 := key d 0 h
    rw [V.flow_zero] at h1
    linarith [h1]
  · rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, abs_of_nonpos h]
    have h1 := key 0 d h
    rw [V.flow_zero] at h1
    linarith [h1]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_param_separation_gap
statement:
theorem exists_param_separation_gap (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    {rmax : ℝ} (hrT : rmax < T.radius) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ u v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ ≤ rmax → ‖v‖ ≤ rmax →
      ε ≤ dist u v → δ ≤ dist (M.param u) (M.param v)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
    {p | ‖p.1‖ ≤ rmax ∧ ‖p.2‖ ≤ rmax ∧ ε ≤ dist p.1 p.2} with hKdef
  rcases K.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hKe | hKne
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos, ?_⟩
    intro u v hu hv huv
    exact absurd (show (u, v) ∈ K from ⟨hu, hv, huv⟩) (by
      rw [hKe]; exact Set.notMem_empty _)
  · obtain ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩ := hKne
    have hrmax0 : 0 ≤ rmax := le_trans (norm_nonneg _) hp₁.1
    have hKclosed : IsClosed K := by
      have h1 : IsClosed {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ×
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) | ‖p.1‖ ≤ rmax} :=
        isClosed_le continuous_fst.norm continuous_const
      have h2 : IsClosed {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ×
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) | ‖p.2‖ ≤ rmax} :=
        isClosed_le continuous_snd.norm continuous_const
      have h3 : IsClosed {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ×
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) | ε ≤ dist p.1 p.2} :=
        isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_fst.dist continuous_snd)
      have heq : K = {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ×
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) | ‖p.1‖ ≤ rmax} ∩
          ({p | ‖p.2‖ ≤ rmax} ∩ {p | ε ≤ dist p.1 p.2}) := rfl
      rw [heq]
      exact h1.inter (h2.inter h3)
    have hKbounded : Bornology.IsBounded K := by
      apply Bornology.IsBounded.subset
        (Metric.isBounded_closedBall (x := ((0, 0) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
          (r := rmax + rmax))
      intro p hp
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall]
      have h1 : dist p.1 (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ≤ rmax := by
        rw [dist_zero_right]; exact hp.1
      have h2 : dist p.2 (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ≤ rmax := by
        rw [dist_zero_right]; exact hp.2.1
      calc
        dist p ((0, 0) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) ×
            EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) =
            max (dist p.1 0) (dist p.2 0) := Prod.dist_eq
        _ ≤ rmax + rmax :=
          max_le (h1.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_right hrmax0))
            (h2.trans (le_add_of_nonneg_left hrmax0))
    have hKcompact : IsCompact K :=
      Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hKclosed hKbounded
    have hf : ContinuousOn
        (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          dist (M.param p.1) (M.param p.2)) K := by
      have h1 : ContinuousOn
          (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            M.param p.1) K := by
        apply (T.continuousOn_param hrT).comp continuousOn_fst
        intro p hp
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        exact hp.1
      have h2 : ContinuousOn
          (fun p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            M.param p.2) K := by
        apply (T.continuousOn_param hrT).comp continuousOn_snd
        intro p hp
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
        exact hp.2.1
      exact continuous_dist.comp_continuousOn (h1.prodMk h2)
    obtain ⟨p₀, hp₀K, hp₀min⟩ := hKcompact.exists_isMinOn ⟨p₁, hp₁⟩ hf
    have hp₀pos : 0 < dist (M.param p₀.1) (M.param p₀.2) := by
      rw [dist_pos]
      intro heq
      have hne : p₀.1 ≠ p₀.2 := by
        intro h
        have := hp₀K.2.2
        rw [h, dist_self] at this
        linarith
      apply hne
      apply T.param_injOn _ _ heq
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hp₀K.1 hrT
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hp₀K.2.1 hrT
    refine ⟨dist (M.param p₀.1) (M.param p₀.2), hp₀pos, ?_⟩
    intro u v hu hv huv
    exact isMinOn_iff.mp hp₀min (u, v) ⟨hu, hv, huv⟩

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_shell_center_gap
statement:
theorem exists_shell_center_gap (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    {r₁ rmax : ℝ} (h1 : 0 < r₁) (hrT : rmax < T.radius) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), r₁ ≤ ‖u‖ → ‖u‖ ≤ rmax →
      δ ≤ dist (M.param u) center
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hgap⟩ := T.exists_param_separation_gap hrT h1
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro u hu1 humax
  have h0 : ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ ≤ rmax := by
    simp only [norm_zero]
    exact le_trans h1.le (le_trans hu1 humax)
  have h := hgap u 0 humax h0 (by rw [dist_zero_right]; exact hu1)
  rwa [M.param_zero] at h

name: Submission.inner_sliceKerCross_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (sliceMap G τ) x = spatialDeriv G (cobSpaceTime x τ) :=
    fderiv_sliceMap hG τ x
  have hregSet : x ∈ regularSet (sliceMap G τ) := by
    show Surjective (fderiv ℝ (sliceMap G τ) x)
    rw [hfd]
    exact hreg
  have hvker : fderiv ℝ (sliceMap G τ) x v = 0 := by
    rw [hfd]
    exact hv
  have hvspan : v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {tauField (sliceMap G τ) x} :=
    (fderiv_eq_zero_iff_mem_span_tauField hregSet v).mp hvker
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hvspan
  have hkc : kerCross (sliceMap G τ) x ≠ 0 :=
    (kerCross_ne_zero_iff _ _).mpr hregSet
  have hcne : c ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    apply hv0
    rw [← hc, h0, zero_smul]
  have hinner : ⟪kerCross (sliceMap G τ) x, v⟫ =
      c * (‖kerCross (sliceMap G τ) x‖⁻¹ *
        ‖kerCross (sliceMap G τ) x‖ ^ 2) := by
    rw [← hc, tauField, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right,
      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    try ring
  rw [hinner]
  apply mul_ne_zero hcne
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · exact inv_ne_zero (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hkc)
  · have : 0 < ‖kerCross (sliceMap G τ) x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hkc
    positivity

name: Submission.inner_tauField_eq_smul_inner_kerCross

name: Submission.hasFDerivAt_saddleQuadratic
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_saddleQuadratic (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
      morseQuadratic .saddle (w 0, w 1))
      ((2 * u 0) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ) -
        (2 * u 1) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) u
proof:
:= by
  have hfun0 : (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => w 0) =
      ⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) (𝕜 := ℝ)) := rfl
  have hfun1 : (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => w 1) =
      ⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) (𝕜 := ℝ)) := rfl
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => w 0)
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ) u := by
    rw [hfun0]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) (𝕜 := ℝ)).hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => w 1)
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ) u := by
    rw [hfun1]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) (𝕜 := ℝ)).hasFDerivAt
  have hsq0 := h0.mul h0
  have hsq1 := h1.mul h1
  have hdiff := hsq0.sub hsq1
  have heq : ((fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => w 0) *
      (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => w 0) -
      (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => w 1) *
      fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => w 1) =
      fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        morseQuadratic .saddle (w 0, w 1) := by
    funext w
    simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.mul_apply, morseQuadratic]
    ring
  rw [heq] at hdiff
  have hDeq : ((2 * u 0) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ) -
      (2 * u 1) • (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ)) =
      (u 0 • (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ) +
        u 0 • (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ) -
        (u 1 • (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) :
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ) +
          u 1 • (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) :
            EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] ℝ))) := by
    ext w
    show (2 * u 0) * w 0 - (2 * u 1) * w 1 =
      (u 0 * w 0 + u 0 * w 0) - (u 1 * w 1 + u 1 * w 1)
    ring
  rw [hDeq]
  exact hdiff

name: Submission.saddleQuadratic_fderiv_saddleChartTangent
statement:
theorem saddleQuadratic_fderiv_saddleChartTangent
    (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :

      morseQuadratic .saddle (w 0, w 1)) u (saddleChartTangent u) = 0
proof:
:= by

  show (2 * u 0) * saddleChartTangent u 0 -
    (2 * u 1) * saddleChartTangent u 1 = 0
  rw [saddleChartTangent_apply_zero, saddleChartTangent_apply_one]

name: Submission.hasDerivAt_sign_prod
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_sign_prod {ψ : ℝ → ℝ} {y₀ dψ : ℝ}
    (hψ : HasDerivAt ψ dψ y₀) (hψ0 : ψ y₀ = 0) (hd : dψ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ y : ℝ, |y - y₀| < δ → y ≠ y₀ →
      0 < ψ y * (y - y₀) * dψ
proof:
:= by
  have hlim := hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp hψ
  have habs : 0 < |dψ| / 2 := by positivity
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hclose⟩ :=
    Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds.mp hlim (|dψ| / 2) habs
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro y hy hyne
  have hymem : y ∈ ({y₀}ᶜ : Set ℝ) := hyne
  have hdist : dist y y₀ < δ := by rwa [Real.dist_eq]
  have h := hclose hymem hdist
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at h
  have hyne' : y - y₀ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hyne
  have hslope : slope ψ y₀ y = ψ y / (y - y₀) := by
    rw [slope_def_field, hψ0, sub_zero]
  have hkey : |ψ y / (y - y₀) - dψ| < |dψ| / 2 := by
    rw [← hslope]
    exact h
  have hratio : 0 < ψ y / (y - y₀) * dψ := by
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hd with hneg | hpos
    · have h1 : ψ y / (y - y₀) < dψ / 2 := by
        have h2 := abs_lt.mp hkey
        rw [abs_of_neg hneg] at h2
        linarith [h2.2]
      have h2 : ψ y / (y - y₀) < 0 := by linarith
      exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg h2 hneg
    · have h1 : dψ / 2 < ψ y / (y - y₀) := by
        have h2 := abs_lt.mp hkey
        rw [abs_of_pos hpos] at h2
        linarith [h2.1]
      have h2 : 0 < ψ y / (y - y₀) := by linarith
      exact mul_pos h2 hpos
  have hsq : 0 < (y - y₀) ^ 2 := by
    have := abs_pos.mpr hyne'
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (y - y₀), sq_abs (y - y₀)]
  have hexp : ψ y / (y - y₀) * dψ * (y - y₀) ^ 2 =
      ψ y * (y - y₀) * dψ := by
    field_simp
    try ring
  nlinarith [mul_pos hratio hsq]

name: Submission.pos_of_continuousOn_Icc_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hne b ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩) with hneg | hpos
  · exfalso
    have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (g b) (g a) := ⟨hneg.le, ha.le⟩
    have hIV := intermediate_value_Icc' hab hg hmem
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy0⟩ := hIV
    exact hne y hy hy0
