name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeEntryClosure.harmonizedSign_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem harmonizedSign_apply
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))) :
    harmonizedSign hm M F G x = gaugeEndpointSign hm M F x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeEntryClosure.harmonized_mul_pos_on_fiber
statement:
theorem harmonized_mul_pos_on_fiber
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m)) :
    ∀ x ∈ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber,
      0 < harmonizedSign hm M F G x * placedSign hm Z kind tail x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxP : x ∈ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.fiber := by
    rw [placed_fiber_eq_harmonized_fiber hm M F G]
    exact hx
  have hxU := hxP
  rw [(firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpoint_fiber] at hxU
  obtain ⟨P, hxPmem⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxU
  have hiff : 0 < gaugeEndpointSign hm M F x ↔
      0 < placedSign hm Z kind tail x := by
    simpa [placedSign] using
      ConcreteConfigurationFirstHeadPlacedGaugeEntry.PlacedGaugeHomotopy.gaugeEndpointSign_pos_iff_firstPlacement
        (B := B) (hm := hm) (M := M) (F := F) P hxPmem
  have hSne : harmonizedSign hm M F G x ≠ 0 :=
    (harmonizedSign hm M F G).nonzero x hx
  have hTne : placedSign hm Z kind tail x ≠ 0 :=
    (placedSign hm Z kind tail).nonzero x hxP
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hSne with hSneg | hSpos
  · have hTnpos : ¬0 < placedSign hm Z kind tail x := by
      intro hTpos
      have : 0 < gaugeEndpointSign hm M F x := hiff.mpr hTpos
      rw [← harmonizedSign_apply hm M F G] at this
      linarith
    have hTneg : placedSign hm Z kind tail x < 0 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hTnpos) hTne
    exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hSneg hTneg
  · have hTpos : 0 < placedSign hm Z kind tail x := by
      apply hiff.mp
      rw [← harmonizedSign_apply hm M F G]
      exact hSpos
    exact mul_pos hSpos hTpos

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeEntryClosure.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_shellData
statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_shellData
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (D : ShellData hm M F G) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:= by
  exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
    ⟨(legOne hm M F G).signedCobordism (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)⟩
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
      D.nonempty_harmonizedToPlaced

      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖segMap (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G)
          (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX r x‖)
    (hno : ∀ x ∉ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber, ∀ c : ℝ, c < 0 →
      (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x ≠
        c • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x) :

      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_toFirstSource_of_shellData hm M F G
    (ShellData.ofNoAntiparallel hm M F G R eps eps_pos outer hno)

proof:

name: Submission.BridgeData.inner_northThomRaw_source
statement:
lemma inner_northThomRaw_source (x : E) :
    ⟪B.northThomRaw x, B.northSource x⟫ =
      plateauA (vertC (B.northSource x)) *
        (1 + vertC (B.northSource x) -
          ⟪B.y, initCLM n (B.northSource x)⟫) -
        vertC (B.northSource x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [northThomRaw, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left,
    inner_plateauAux_self (B.norm_northSource x),
    inner_embedCLM_left (n := n), northCutoff]
  ring

name: Submission.BridgeData.inner_northThomRaw_source_pos
statement:
lemma inner_northThomRaw_source_pos (x : E) :
    0 < ⟪B.northThomRaw x, B.northSource x⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [B.inner_northThomRaw_source]
  let u := B.northSource x
  let t := vertC u
  let h := initCLM n u
  have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := B.norm_northSource x
  have ht_abs : |t| ≤ 1 := abs_vertC_le_one hu
  have ht_lower : -1 ≤ t := neg_le_of_abs_le ht_abs
  have hh : ‖h‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have hs := norm_sq_split u
    rw [hu] at hs
    have hh0 := norm_nonneg h
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
  have hip_abs : |⟪B.y, h⟫| < 1 / 8 := by
    calc
      |⟪B.y, h⟫| ≤ ‖B.y‖ * ‖h‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ ‖B.y‖ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (norm_nonneg B.y)
      _ < 1 / 8 := by simpa using B.norm_y_lt
  by_cases hlow : t ≤ -(1 / 2)
  · rw [plateauA_of_le hlow]
    linarith
  by_cases hhigh : -(1 / 4) ≤ t
  · rw [plateauA_of_ge hhigh]
    have hip_lt : ⟪B.y, h⟫ < 1 / 8 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) hip_abs
    linarith
  · have htneg : t < -(1 / 4) := lt_of_not_ge hhigh
    have httrans : -(1 / 2) < t := lt_of_not_ge hlow
    have hip_lt : ⟪B.y, h⟫ < 1 / 8 :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) hip_abs
    have hbracket : 0 < 1 + t - ⟪B.y, h⟫ := by linarith
    have hprod : 0 ≤ plateauA t * (1 + t - ⟪B.y, h⟫) :=
      mul_nonneg (plateauA_nonneg t) hbracket.le
    linarith

name: Submission.BridgeData.initCLM_northThomRaw
statement:
lemma initCLM_northThomRaw (x : E) :
    initCLM n (B.northThomRaw x) = B.northCutoff x • B.fls.g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [northThomRaw, map_sub, map_smul, initCLM_embedCLM, plateauAux]
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, map_sub, initCLM_eLast, smul_zero, sub_zero,
    add_zero]
  change plateauA (vertC (B.northSource x)) •
      initCLM n (B.northSource x) - B.northCutoff x • B.y = _
  rw [northCutoff]
  change _ = plateauA (vertC (B.northSource x)) •
    (bridgeHMapE B.approx x - B.y)
  change _ = plateauA (vertC (B.northSource x)) •
    (initCLM n (B.northSource x) - B.y)
  exact (smul_sub _ _ _).symm

name: Submission.BridgeData.northCutoff_of_northFiber
statement:
lemma northCutoff_of_northFiber {x : E}
    (hx : B.northSource x = northPoint B.y) : B.northCutoff x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [northCutoff, hx]
  exact plateauA_of_ge (by
    have := vertC_northPoint_pos B.norm_y_lt_one
    linarith)

name: Submission.BridgeData.fls_g_of_northFiber

lemma fls_g_of_northFiber {x : E}
    (hx : B.northSource x = northPoint B.y) : B.fls.g x = 0
proof:
:= by
  change bridgeHMapE B.approx x - B.y = 0
  apply sub_eq_zero.mpr
  change initCLM n (B.northSource x) = B.y
  rw [hx, initCLM_northPoint]

name: Submission.BridgeData.fderiv_initCLM_northThomRaw_of_northFiber
statement:
theorem fderiv_initCLM_northThomRaw_of_northFiber {x : E}
    (hx : B.northSource x = northPoint B.y) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => initCLM n (B.northThomRaw q)) x =
      fderiv ℝ B.fls.g x
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun q => initCLM n (B.northThomRaw q)) =
      fun q => B.northCutoff q • B.fls.g q := by
    funext q
    exact B.initCLM_northThomRaw q
  rw [hfun]
  have hcd : DifferentiableAt ℝ B.northCutoff x :=
    B.contDiff_northCutoff.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  have hgd : DifferentiableAt ℝ B.fls.g x :=
    B.fls.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  rw [fderiv_fun_smul hcd hgd, B.fls_g_of_northFiber hx,
    B.northCutoff_of_northFiber hx]
  simp

name: Submission.BridgeData.surjective_fderiv_initCLM_northThomRaw_of_northFiber
statement:
theorem surjective_fderiv_initCLM_northThomRaw_of_northFiber {x : E}
    (hx : B.northSource x = northPoint B.y) :
    Function.Surjective
      (fderiv ℝ (fun q => initCLM n (B.northThomRaw q)) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [B.fderiv_initCLM_northThomRaw_of_northFiber hx]
  exact B.fls.regular x (B.fls_g_of_northFiber hx)

name: Submission.BridgeData.fderiv_northThomHorizontal_of_northFiber
statement:
theorem fderiv_northThomHorizontal_of_northFiber {x : E}
    (hx : B.northSource x = northPoint B.y) :
    fderiv ℝ B.northThomHorizontal x =
      ‖B.northThomRaw x‖⁻¹ • fderiv ℝ B.fls.g x
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : B.northThomHorizontal = fun q =>
      (‖B.northThomRaw q‖⁻¹ * B.northCutoff q) • B.fls.g q := by
    funext q
    exact B.northThomHorizontal_eq q
  rw [hfun]
  have hrnorm : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun q => ‖B.northThomRaw q‖) x :=
    B.contDiff_northThomRaw.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt |>.norm
      ℝ (B.northThomRaw_ne_zero x)
  have hscalar : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun q => ‖B.northThomRaw q‖⁻¹ * B.northCutoff q) x :=
    (hrnorm.inv (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (B.northThomRaw_ne_zero x))).mul
      (B.contDiff_northCutoff.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt)
  have hgdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ B.fls.g x :=
    B.fls.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
  rw [fderiv_fun_smul hscalar hgdiff, B.fls_g_of_northFiber hx,
    B.northCutoff_of_northFiber hx]
  simp

name: Submission.BridgeData.surjective_fderiv_northThomHorizontal_of_northFiber

    mul_inv_cancel₀ (B.northThom_frameScale_pos x).ne', one_smul]

name: Submission.BridgeData.northThom_eq_ptNorthPole_iff
statement:
theorem northThom_eq_ptNorthPole_iff (x : E) :
    B.northThom x = ptNorthPole ↔
      B.northSource x = northPoint B.y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hc
    have hnorm : 0 < ‖B.northThomRaw x‖ :=
      norm_pos_iff.mpr (B.northThomRaw_ne_zero x)
    have hcoe : ‖B.northThomRaw x‖⁻¹ • B.northThomRaw x = eLast n := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val hc
      simpa [northThom_coe, ptNorthPole_coe] using this
    have hraw : B.northThomRaw x = ‖B.northThomRaw x‖ • eLast n := by
      calc
        B.northThomRaw x = ‖B.northThomRaw x‖ •
            (‖B.northThomRaw x‖⁻¹ • B.northThomRaw x) := by
              rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hnorm.ne', one_smul]
        _ = ‖B.northThomRaw x‖ • eLast n := by rw [hcoe]
    have hpair := B.inner_northThomRaw_source_pos x
    rw [hraw, real_inner_smul_left, inner_eLast_left] at hpair
    have ht : 0 < vertC (B.northSource x) := by
      have hn := norm_nonneg (B.northThomRaw x)
      nlinarith
    have hcut : B.northCutoff x = 1 := by
      rw [northCutoff]
      exact plateauA_of_ge (by linarith)
    have hinit : initCLM n (B.northThomRaw x) = 0 := by
      rw [hraw, map_smul, initCLM_eLast, smul_zero]
    rw [B.initCLM_northThomRaw, hcut, one_smul] at hinit
    have hhor : initCLM n (B.northSource x) = B.y := by
      change bridgeHMapE B.approx x - B.y = 0 at hinit
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hinit
    rcases (init_eq_iff (B.norm_northSource x) B.y).mp hhor with hn | hs
    · exact hn
    · exfalso
      rw [hs] at ht
      exact (not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt (vertC_southPointOf_neg B.norm_y_lt_one))) ht
  · exact B.northThom_of_northFiber

    (B.northSourcePoint x : E) = B.northSource x
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.BridgeData.inner_northThom_source_pos
statement:
lemma inner_northThom_source_pos (x : E) :
    0 < ⟪(B.northThom x : E), B.northSource x⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [northThom_coe, real_inner_smul_left]
  exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr (B.northThomRaw_ne_zero x)))
    (B.inner_northThomRaw_source_pos x)

name: Submission.BridgeData.northSourcePoint_ne_neg_northThom
statement:
lemma northSourcePoint_ne_neg_northThom (x : E) :
    B.northSourcePoint x ≠ -B.northThom x
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hcoe : B.northSource x = -(B.northThom x : E) := by
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hc
    simpa [northSourcePoint_coe, coe_neg_sphere] using this
  have hpos := B.inner_northThom_source_pos x
  rw [hcoe, inner_neg_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
    UnitSphere.norm_coe] at hpos
  norm_num at hpos

name: Submission.BridgeData.dist_northSourcePoint_northThom_lt_two

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc
statement:
theorem morseQuadratic_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc
    (b : SaddleBranch) (a c : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .saddle
      (pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a c) 0,
        pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a c) 1) = a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [pairToMorseParam_apply_zero, pairToMorseParam_apply_one]
  exact morseQuadratic_saddlePositiveArc b a c

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam
statement:
theorem morseQuadratic_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam
    (b e : SaddleBranch) (ρ a : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .saddle
      (saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a 0,
        saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a 1) = a ^ 2
proof:
:=
  morseQuadratic_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc b a _

name: Submission.saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam_first_sign'
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam_first_sign'
    (b e : SaddleBranch) {ρ a : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) :
    0 < signedBranch b (saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hbp := saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)
  have hkey : 0 < a ^ 2 +
      signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 := by
    rw [signedBranch_sq, hbp]
    nlinarith
  rw [saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam, pairToMorseParam_apply_zero]
  cases b
  · simpa [saddlePositiveArc, signedBranch] using Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hkey
  · simpa [saddlePositiveArc, signedBranch] using Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hkey

name: Submission.norm_saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam_gt
statement:
theorem norm_saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam_gt
    (b e : SaddleBranch) {ρ a : ℝ} (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = a ^ 2)
    (hsign : 0 < signedBranch b (u 0))
    (hsigne : 0 < signedBranch e (u 1))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hu : ρ < ‖u‖)
    {q : I} (hq : (q : ℝ) < 1) :
    ρ < ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖
proof:
:= by
  have hclass :=
    eq_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_of_signedBranch b a u hquad hsign
  have hstart : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + 2 * (u 1) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖u‖ ^ 2 = ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a (u 1))‖ ^ 2 :=
        congrArg (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ‖z‖ ^ 2) hclass
      _ = a ^ 2 + 2 * (u 1) ^ 2 :=
        norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a (u 1)
  have hend : a ^ 2 +
      2 * signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by
    rw [signedBranch_sq, saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)]
    ring
  have huSq : ρ ^ 2 < ‖u‖ ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hρ.le (norm_nonneg u)).2 hu
  have hu1sq : signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 <
      (u 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hbp_pos : 0 < saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := by
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
    apply div_pos _ (by norm_num)
    linarith
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := q.property.1
  have hcsq : signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 <
      saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1)
        (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)) q ^ 2 := by
    cases e
    · 
      have hu1 : 0 < u 1 := by simpa [signedBranch] using hsigne
      have hs₁ : signedBranch SaddleBranch.positive
          (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) = saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := rfl
      rw [hs₁] at hu1sq ⊢
      have hgt : saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a < u 1 := by nlinarith
      have hcgt : saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a <
          saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1) (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) q := by
        rw [saddleAffineCoordinate]
        nlinarith
      nlinarith
    · 
      have hu1 : u 1 < 0 := by
        have h := hsigne
        simp only [signedBranch] at h
        linarith
      have hs₁ : signedBranch SaddleBranch.negative
          (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) = -saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := rfl
      rw [hs₁] at hu1sq ⊢
      have hgt : u 1 < -saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := by nlinarith
      have hclt : saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1)
          (-saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) q < -saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a := by
        rw [saddleAffineCoordinate]
        nlinarith
      nlinarith
  have hnormSq : ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖ ^ 2 =
      a ^ 2 + 2 * saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1)
        (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)) q ^ 2 := by
    change ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a
      (saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1)
        (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)) q))‖ ^ 2 = _
    exact norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a _
  have hfinal : ρ ^ 2 <
      ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [hnormSq]
    nlinarith
  exact (sq_lt_sq₀ hρ.le (norm_nonneg _)).1 hfinal

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_saddleArcCutScale_scale_lt
statement:
theorem exists_saddleArcCutScale_scale_lt
    (Cov : ChronologicalSaddleSmallEndCover D t ht)
    {p q : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch} (B : SaddleArcCutArc Cov p q)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ S : SaddleArcCutScale Cov B, S.scale < c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := nonempty_saddleArcCutScale Cov B
  have hmin_pos : 0 < min S.scale (c / 2) :=
    lt_min S.scale_pos (by linarith)
  have hminle : min S.scale (c / 2) ≤ S.scale := min_le_left _ _
  have hsq' : min S.scale (c / 2) ^ 2 ≤ S.scale ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [hmin_pos.le]
  have hbd : (0 : ℝ) ≤ ((saddleArcCutTimeField Cov B).base.bound : ℝ) :=
    (saddleArcCutTimeField Cov B).base.bound.coe_nonneg
  refine ⟨{
    scale := min S.scale (c / 2)
    scale_pos := hmin_pos
    scale_lt_window := lt_of_le_of_lt hminle S.scale_lt_window
    safe := le_trans hsq' S.safe
    cover_close :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq' hbd) S.cover_close
    positive_branch_close := fun r =>
      lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq' hbd)
        (S.positive_branch_close r)
    negative_branch_close := fun r =>
      lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hsq' hbd)
        (S.negative_branch_close r) }, ?_⟩
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.false_of_positiveMerge_of_flipSecondArcWitness
statement:
theorem false_of_positiveMerge_of_flipSecondArcWitness
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (hpos : D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .negative =
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .positive)
    (Cov : ChronologicalSaddleSmallEndCover D t ht)
    (W : ChronologicalSaddleFlipSecondArcWitness D t ht Cov) : False
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨b, eps, heps_pos, B, havoidW⟩ := W
  
  let R := saddleArcCutTimeField Cov B
  let Bd : ℝ := (R.base.bound : ℝ)
  have hBd : 0 ≤ Bd := R.base.bound.coe_nonneg
  
  have hcont : ContinuousAt (D.position.eventModel t ht).param 0 :=
    ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).param_differentiableAt 0 (by simpa using (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_pos)).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨η, hη, hηball⟩ :=
    (Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont) (eps / 4) (by positivity)
  have hsg_pos : 0 < min (η / 2) (Cov.sigma / 2) :=
    lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith [Cov.sigma_pos])
  set sg : ℝ := min (η / 2) (Cov.sigma / 2) with hsgdef
  have hsgη : sg < η :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith)
  have hsg_lt_Cov : sg < Cov.sigma :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith [Cov.sigma_pos])
  have hsg_rad : sg < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius := hsg_lt_Cov.trans Cov.sigma_lt_embedded
  have hsgM : sg < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius := hsg_rad.trans_le (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hsg_chart : ∀ u' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u'‖ ≤ sg →
      dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u') (D.position.eventCenter t ht) < eps / 4 := by
    intro u' hu'
    have hd : dist u' 0 < η := by
      rw [dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hu' hsgη
    have h := hηball hd
    rwa [(D.position.eventModel t ht).param_zero] at h
  
  have hc_pos : 0 < min sg (min 1 (eps / (4 * (Bd + 1)))) := by
    apply lt_min hsg_pos
    apply lt_min one_pos
    positivity
  obtain ⟨S, hS_small⟩ := exists_saddleArcCutScale_scale_lt Cov B hc_pos
  have hssg : S.scale < sg := lt_of_lt_of_le hS_small (min_le_left _ _)
  have hs1 : S.scale < 1 :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hS_small ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hsEps : S.scale < eps / (4 * (Bd + 1)) :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hS_small ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
  have hs_pos := S.scale_pos
  have hsq_sg : S.scale ^ 2 < sg ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hBd1 : (0 : ℝ) < Bd + 1 := by linarith
  have hscale_key : (Bd + 1) * S.scale < eps / 4 := by
    have h3 : (Bd + 1) * S.scale < (Bd + 1) * (eps / (4 * (Bd + 1))) :=
      mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left hsEps hBd1
    have h4 : (Bd + 1) * (eps / (4 * (Bd + 1))) = eps / 4 := by
      field_simp
    linarith [h4 ▸ h3]
  have hsq_lt_scale : S.scale ^ 2 < S.scale := by nlinarith
  have hsBd : Bd * S.scale ^ 2 < eps / 4 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hBd (sub_nonneg.mpr hsq_lt_scale.le)]
  have hsq_eps : S.scale ^ 2 < eps / 4 := by
    nlinarith [mul_nonneg hBd hs_pos.le]
  
  have hupR := D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_le_eventRadius t ht
  have hupT := D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  
  have hsafe_abs : |S.scale ^ 2| ≤ R.safeTime := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact S.safe
  have hcore : ∀ w : I, B.toPath w ∈
      SaddleCriticalExteriorArc.recoveryCore (n := n) B := fun w => ⟨w, rfl⟩
  have hflowdist : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist (R.base.flow x (S.scale ^ 2)) x ≤ Bd * S.scale ^ 2 := by
    intro x
    have h := R.base.dist_flow_self_le x (S.scale ^ 2) 0
    simpa [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg S.scale)] using h
  have harc_time : ∀ w : I,
      tcoord (B.toPath w) = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) :=
    fun w => (B.mem_exterior w).2.1
  have harc_fiber : ∀ w : I,
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (B.toPath w) = 0 :=
    fun w => (B.mem_exterior w).1
  have hflowed_time : ∀ w : I,
      tcoord (R.base.flow (B.toPath w) (S.scale ^ 2)) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + S.scale ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    have h := R.tcoord_flow (hcore w) hsafe_abs
    rw [h, harc_time w]
  have hflowed_fiber : ∀ w : I,
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (R.base.flow (B.toPath w) (S.scale ^ 2)) = 0 :=
    fun w => R.flow_mem_fiber (harc_fiber w) _
  have hflowed_dist : ∀ w : I, eps / 2 ≤
      dist (R.base.flow (B.toPath w) (S.scale ^ 2))
        (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    intro w
    have h1 := havoidW w
    have h2 := hflowdist (B.toPath w)
    have h3 := dist_triangle (B.toPath w)
      (R.base.flow (B.toPath w) (S.scale ^ 2))
      (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
    rw [dist_comm (B.toPath w)
      (R.base.flow (B.toPath w) (S.scale ^ 2))] at h3
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨up, hup_norm, hup_end, hup_sign0, hup_quad⟩ :=
    exists_saddleArcCutPositiveCapture hindex S (b, SaddleBranch.negative)
      (saddleArcCut_source_mem_core Cov B)
  obtain ⟨uq, huq_norm, huq_end, huq_sign0, huq_quad⟩ :=
    exists_saddleArcCutPositiveCapture hindex S (b, SaddleBranch.positive)
      (saddleArcCut_target_mem_core Cov B)
  have hBEcrit : ∀ r : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r Cov.sigma =
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).param (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam r Cov.sigma) := by
    intro r
    simp [StandardMorseEventAt.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd,
      saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint]
  have hup_close : dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param up)
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam
        (b, SaddleBranch.negative) Cov.sigma)) <
      saddleArcCutNegativeBranchRadius Cov (b, SaddleBranch.negative) := by
    rw [hup_end, ← hBEcrit (b, SaddleBranch.negative)]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hflowdist _)
      (S.negative_branch_close (b, SaddleBranch.negative))
  have huq_close : dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param uq)
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam
        (b, SaddleBranch.positive) Cov.sigma)) <
      saddleArcCutNegativeBranchRadius Cov (b, SaddleBranch.positive) := by
    rw [huq_end, ← hBEcrit (b, SaddleBranch.positive)]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hflowdist _)
      (S.negative_branch_close (b, SaddleBranch.positive))
  have hup_sign1 : 0 < signedBranch SaddleBranch.negative (up 1) :=
    saddleArcCutNegativeBranchRadius_spec Cov (b, SaddleBranch.negative)
      up hup_norm hup_close
  have huq_sign1 : 0 < signedBranch SaddleBranch.positive (uq 1) :=
    saddleArcCutNegativeBranchRadius_spec Cov (b, SaddleBranch.positive)
      uq huq_norm huq_close
  have hupM : ‖up‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius := hup_norm.trans_le hupR
  have huqM : ‖uq‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius := huq_norm.trans_le hupR
  have hupT' : ‖up‖ < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius := hup_norm.trans hupT
  have huqT' : ‖uq‖ < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius := huq_norm.trans hupT
  
  have hflowed_zero : R.base.flow (B.toPath 0) (S.scale ^ 2) = (D.position.eventModel t ht).param up := by
    rw [B.toPath.source]
    exact hup_end.symm
  have hflowed_one : R.base.flow (B.toPath 1) (S.scale ^ 2) = (D.position.eventModel t ht).param uq := by
    rw [B.toPath.target]
    exact huq_end.symm
  have hup_far : eps / 2 ≤
      dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param up) (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    rw [← hflowed_zero]
    exact hflowed_dist 0
  have huq_far : eps / 2 ≤
      dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param uq) (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    rw [← hflowed_one]
    exact hflowed_dist 1
  have hup_gt : sg < ‖up‖ := by
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    have h := hsg_chart up hle
    linarith
  have huq_gt : sg < ‖uq‖ := by
    by_contra hle
    push_neg at hle
    have h := hsg_chart uq hle
    linarith
  
  have hreg_s : sliceRegular D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + S.scale ^ 2) :=
    saddleArcCutAfterTime_regular S
  let Vs : TamedField ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSlice S.scale hreg_s) :=
    saddleArcCutAfterField S
  
  have hslab := regularSlab_saddleArcCutAfter_to_window S
  have hsrcI : saddleArcCutAfterTime S ∈
      Set.Icc (saddleArcCutAfterTime S) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) :=
    ⟨le_rfl, saddleArcCutAfterTime_le_window S⟩
  have htgtI : D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht ∈
      Set.Icc (saddleArcCutAfterTime S) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) :=
    ⟨saddleArcCutAfterTime_le_window S, le_rfl⟩
  have hrhoC_pos := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hrhoC_T := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  have hrhoC_M : D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    hrhoC_T.trans_le (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hs_rhoC : S.scale ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
    saddleArcCutScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq S
  have hfib_s : ∀ bb : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchBase bb
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) S.scale) ∈
        ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSlice S.scale hreg_s).fiber :=
    fun bb => (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchBase_mem_fiber hindex bb
      hrhoC_pos hs_rhoC hrhoC_T hreg_s
  have hfib_s' : ∀ bb : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchBase bb
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) S.scale) ∈
        SlabTamedField.sliceFiber
          D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
          (saddleArcCutAfterTime S) := by
    intro bb
    have h := hfib_s bb
    rwa [StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveSlice,
      SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber] at h
  have hposSet : (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).orbit
      (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchBase SaddleBranch.negative
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht))) =
      (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).orbit
      (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchBase SaddleBranch.positive
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht))) := by
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hpos
  have hwn := saddleArcCut_positiveBase_window_orbit hindex S
    SaddleBranch.negative
  have hwp := saddleArcCut_positiveBase_window_orbit hindex S
    SaddleBranch.positive
  have h1 := (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).orbit_eq_of_mem hwn
  have h2 := (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).orbit_eq_of_mem hwp
  have htransMem : (saddleArcCutAfterSlabField S).sliceTransport
      (saddleArcCutAfterTime S) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
      (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchBase SaddleBranch.positive
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) S.scale)) ∈
      (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).orbit
        ((saddleArcCutAfterSlabField S).sliceTransport
          (saddleArcCutAfterTime S) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
          (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchBase SaddleBranch.negative
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) S.scale))) := by

        exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hi⟩)
      (by
        intro i j hijne
        rw [Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem]
        rintro x ⟨hxΓ, hxi, hxj⟩
        obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := A.mem_inter_cyclicCutRange_is_mark hijne hxi hxj
        exact hΓ_nomark x hxΓ l hl)
      ⟨spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param up), Or.inl ⟨0, h0mem, hpieceP_zero⟩⟩
  
  have h01 : (0 : I) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg (fun x : I => (x : ℝ)) h
    norm_num at this
  have hmark_mem : ∀ (ee : SaddleBranch)
      (piece : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))),
      (piece '' Set.Ico 0 1) ⊆ Γ →
      piece 1 = spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b ee sg S.scale) →
      spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b ee sg S.scale) ∈
        A.cyclicCutRange rstar := by
    intro ee piece hsub hone
    have hclosure : spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b ee sg
        S.scale) ∈ closure (piece '' Set.Ico 0 1) := by
      have h1 : (1 : I) ∈ closure (Set.Ico (0 : I) 1) := by
        rw [closure_Ico h01]
        exact ⟨by
          change (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1
          norm_num, le_rfl⟩
      have h2 : piece 1 ∈ piece '' closure (Set.Ico (0 : I) 1) :=
        ⟨1, h1, rfl⟩
      have h3 := image_closure_subset_closure_image piece.continuous h2
      rwa [hone] at h3
    have h4 : closure (piece '' Set.Ico 0 1) ⊆ A.cyclicCutRange rstar := by
      rw [← (hclosedCut rstar).closure_eq]
      exact closure_mono (hsub.trans hrstar)
    exact h4 hclosure
  have hmarkP_mem : spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
      SaddleBranch.negative sg S.scale) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange rstar :=
    hmark_mem SaddleBranch.negative pieceP
      (fun x hx => Or.inl hx) hpieceP_one
  have hmarkQ_mem : spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
      SaddleBranch.positive sg S.scale) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange rstar :=
    hmark_mem SaddleBranch.positive pieceQ
      (fun x hx => Or.inr (Or.inr hx)) hpieceQ_one
  
  have hsegcut : ∃ cIdx : Fin 4,
      Set.range ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b sg S.scale hsg_pos hsq_sg
        hsg_rad) = A.cyclicCutRange cIdx := by
    cases b
    · exact ⟨cj, hcj⟩
    · exact ⟨ci, hci⟩
  obtain ⟨cb, hcb⟩ := hsegcut
  have hmarkP_seg : spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
      SaddleBranch.negative sg S.scale) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange cb := by
    rw [← hcb]
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    show spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSegment b sg S.scale hsg_pos hsq_sg
      hsg_rad 0) = _
    rw [(D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSegment_zero]
  have hmarkQ_seg : spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
      SaddleBranch.positive sg S.scale) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange cb := by
    rw [← hcb]
    refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
    show spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSegment b sg S.scale hsg_pos hsq_sg
      hsg_rad 1) = _
    rw [(D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSegment_one]
  
  have hApointP : A.point (finFourOfSaddleBranchPair
      (b, SaddleBranch.negative)) = spacePart
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b SaddleBranch.negative sg S.scale) :=
    hApoint (b, SaddleBranch.negative)
  have hApointQ : A.point (finFourOfSaddleBranchPair
      (b, SaddleBranch.positive)) = spacePart
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b SaddleBranch.positive sg S.scale) :=
    hApoint (b, SaddleBranch.positive)
  have hlPQ : finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (b, SaddleBranch.negative) ≠
      finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (b, SaddleBranch.positive) := by
    intro h
    have h2 := congrArg saddleBranchPairOfFinFour h
    rw [saddleBranchPairOfFinFour_finFourOfSaddleBranchPair,
      saddleBranchPairOfFinFour_finFourOfSaddleBranchPair] at h2
    have h3 := congrArg Prod.snd h2
    exact SaddleBranch.noConfusion h3
  have hcasesP1 := A.point_mem_cyclicCutRange_cases
    (l := finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (b, SaddleBranch.negative))
    (i := rstar) (by rw [hApointP]; exact hmarkP_mem)
  have hcasesQ1 := A.point_mem_cyclicCutRange_cases
    (l := finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (b, SaddleBranch.positive))
    (i := rstar) (by rw [hApointQ]; exact hmarkQ_mem)
  have hcasesP2 := A.point_mem_cyclicCutRange_cases
    (l := finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (b, SaddleBranch.negative))
    (i := cb) (by rw [hApointP]; exact hmarkP_seg)
  have hcasesQ2 := A.point_mem_cyclicCutRange_cases
    (l := finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (b, SaddleBranch.positive))
    (i := cb) (by rw [hApointQ]; exact hmarkQ_seg)
  
  have hreq : rstar = cb := by
    apply A.cyclicCut_eq_of_endpointPair_eq
    rcases hcasesP1 with h1 | h1 <;> rcases hcasesQ1 with h2 | h2
    · exact absurd (h1.trans h2.symm) hlPQ
    · 
      rcases hcasesP2 with h3 | h3 <;> rcases hcasesQ2 with h4 | h4
      · exact absurd (h3.trans h4.symm) hlPQ
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h1.symm.trans h3, h2.symm.trans h4⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h1.symm.trans h3, h2.symm.trans h4⟩
      · exact absurd (h3.trans h4.symm) hlPQ
    · 
      rcases hcasesP2 with h3 | h3 <;> rcases hcasesQ2 with h4 | h4
      · exact absurd (h3.trans h4.symm) hlPQ
      · exact Or.inr ⟨h2.symm.trans h4, h1.symm.trans h3⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨h2.symm.trans h4, h1.symm.trans h3⟩
      · exact absurd (h3.trans h4.symm) hlPQ
    · exact absurd (h1.trans h2.symm) hlPQ
  
  
  have hyP_mem : spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param up) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange rstar :=
    hrstar (Or.inl ⟨0, h0mem, hpieceP_zero⟩)
  rw [hreq, ← hcb] at hyP_mem
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hyP_mem
  
  have hseg_time := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSegment_time hindex b sg S.scale hsg_pos
    hsq_sg hsg_rad w
  have hup_time : tcoord ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param up) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + S.scale ^ 2 :=
    htime_param up hupM hup_quad
  have hamb : (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSegment b sg S.scale hsg_pos hsq_sg hsg_rad w =
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).param up := by
    calc
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSegment b sg S.scale hsg_pos hsq_sg hsg_rad w =
          cobSpaceTime (spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSegment b sg S.scale
            hsg_pos hsq_sg hsg_rad w))
            (tcoord ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSegment b sg S.scale hsg_pos hsq_sg
              hsg_rad w)) := (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime (spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param up))
            (tcoord ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param up)) := by
        rw [hseg_time, hup_time]
        have hw' : spacePart ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSegment b sg S.scale hsg_pos
            hsq_sg hsg_rad w) = spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param up) := hw
        rw [hw']
      _ = (D.position.eventModel t ht).param up := spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hsegdist : dist ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSegment b sg S.scale hsg_pos hsq_sg
      hsg_rad w) (D.position.eventCenter t ht) < eps / 4 := by
    show dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b sg S.scale w))
      (D.position.eventCenter t ht) < eps / 4
    apply hsg_chart
    exact norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_le b hsg_pos hsq_sg w
  rw [hamb] at hsegdist
  linarith

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.sphere_coe
statement:
@[simp] lemma sphere_coe (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) (v : A) :
    (sphereMap c v : E) = nprepCob c (WithLp.ofLp v)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.contDiff_sphere_coe
statement:
lemma contDiff_sphere_coe (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun v => (sphereMap c v : E)
proof:
:=
  (contDiff_nprepCob c).comp
    (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (n + 1 + 1)) ℝ).contDiff

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.sphere_eq_south_of_outside_cube
statement:
lemma sphere_eq_south_of_outside_cube
    (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) {v : A}
    (hv : ∃ j, piInit (WithLp.ofLp v) j ≤ 0 ∨
      1 ≤ piInit (WithLp.ofLp v) j) :
    sphereMap c v = southPole n
proof:
:= by
  have hdist : dist (c.rawC (WithLp.ofLp v)) (-eLast n) < 1 / 8 :=
    c.rawC_south (WithLp.ofLp v) hv
  have hnorm : ‖(-eLast n : E)‖ = 1 := by
    rw [norm_neg, norm_eLast]
  have h2 : ‖nrawCob c (WithLp.ofLp v) - -eLast n‖ ≤
      2 * ‖c.rawC (WithLp.ofLp v) - -eLast n‖ :=
    norm_normalize_sub_le (c.rawC_ne_zero _) hnorm
  have h3 : ‖nrawCob c (WithLp.ofLp v) - -eLast n‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hdist
    linarith
  have h4 : |vertC (nrawCob c (WithLp.ofLp v)) + 1| ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    have hcoord := abs_coord_le_norm
      (nrawCob c (WithLp.ofLp v) - -eLast n) (Fin.last n)
    have hval : (nrawCob c (WithLp.ofLp v) - -eLast n) (Fin.last n) =
        vertC (nrawCob c (WithLp.ofLp v)) + 1 := by
      simp [vertC, eLast]
    rw [hval] at hcoord
    exact hcoord.trans h3
  have hvert : vertC (nrawCob c (WithLp.ofLp v)) ≤ -(1 / 2) := by
    rcases abs_le.mp h4 with ⟨-, hhi⟩
    linarith
  have hpraw : prawCob c (WithLp.ofLp v) = -eLast n :=
    plateauAux_of_le hvert
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [sphere_coe, nprepCob, hpraw, southPole_coe, norm_neg, norm_eLast]
  simp

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.outside_cube_of_spatial_norm_gt
statement:
lemma outside_cube_of_spatial_norm_gt
    {v : A} (hv : (n : ℝ) + 1 < ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖) :
    ∃ j, piInit (WithLp.ofLp v) j ≤ 0 ∨
      1 ≤ piInit (WithLp.ofLp v) j
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnot
  rw [not_exists] at hnot
  have hcoord : ∀ j : Fin (n + 1),
      |initCLM (n + 1) v j| ≤ 1 := by
    intro j
    have hj := hnot j
    rw [not_or, not_le, not_le] at hj
    have hpi : piInit (WithLp.ofLp v) j = initCLM (n + 1) v j := rfl
    rw [hpi] at hj
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hj.1], by linarith [hj.2]⟩
  have hsq : ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ ^ 2 =
      ∑ j, initCLM (n + 1) v j ^ 2 := norm_sq_eq_sum _
  have hsum : (∑ j, initCLM (n + 1) v j ^ 2) ≤
      ∑ _j : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℝ) := by
    apply Finset.sum_le_sum
    intro j _
    have hj := hcoord j
    nlinarith [abs_nonneg (initCLM (n + 1) v j),
      sq_abs (initCLM (n + 1) v j)]
  have hone : (∑ _j : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℝ)) = n + 1 := by simp
  have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ n := Nat.cast_nonneg n
  have hnormsq : ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ ^ 2 =
          ∑ j, initCLM (n + 1) v j ^ 2 := hsq
      _ ≤ n + 1 := hsum.trans_eq hone
      _ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (initCLM (n + 1) v)]

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.sphere_exterior_south
statement:
lemma sphere_exterior_south (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ v : A,
    R < ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ →
      sphereMap c v = southPole n
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨n + 1, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  exact sphere_eq_south_of_outside_cube c
    (outside_cube_of_spatial_norm_gt (by simpa using hv))

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.sphere_collar_zero
statement:
lemma sphere_collar_zero (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁)
    (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 4) :
    sphereMap c (spaceTime x t) = sphereMap c (spaceTime x 0)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [sphere_coe]
  rw [nprepCob_left c (by rw [piTime_ofLp_spaceTime]; exact ht),
    nprepCob_left c (by rw [piTime_ofLp_spaceTime]; norm_num),
    piInit_ofLp_spaceTime, piInit_ofLp_spaceTime]

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.sphere_collar_one
statement:
lemma sphere_collar_one (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁)
    (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t) :
    sphereMap c (spaceTime x t) = sphereMap c (spaceTime x 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [sphere_coe]
  rw [nprepCob_right c (by rw [piTime_ofLp_spaceTime]; exact ht),
    nprepCob_right c (by rw [piTime_ofLp_spaceTime]; norm_num),
    piInit_ofLp_spaceTime, piInit_ofLp_spaceTime]

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.sourceHorizontal_eq_bridgeHMapE
statement:
lemma sourceHorizontal_eq_bridgeHMapE
    (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) (x : E) :
    (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).sourceHorizontal x = bridgeHMapE a₀ x
proof:
:= by
  change initCLM n (nprepCob c (WithLp.ofLp (spaceTime x 0))) =
    bridgeHMap a₀ (WithLp.ofLp x)
  rw [nprepCob_left c (by rw [piTime_ofLp_spaceTime]; norm_num),
    piInit_ofLp_spaceTime]
  rfl

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.targetHorizontal_eq_bridgeHMapE
statement:
lemma targetHorizontal_eq_bridgeHMapE
    (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) (x : E) :
    (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).targetHorizontal x = bridgeHMapE a₁ x
proof:
:= by
  change initCLM n (nprepCob c (WithLp.ofLp (spaceTime x 1))) =
    bridgeHMap a₁ (WithLp.ofLp x)
  rw [nprepCob_right c (by rw [piTime_ofLp_spaceTime]; norm_num),
    piInit_ofLp_spaceTime]
  rfl

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.isRegularValue_source_bridgeHMapE
statement:
lemma isRegularValue_source_bridgeHMapE
    (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) {y : F}
    (hreg : IsRegularValue (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).horizontal y) :
    IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a₀) y
proof:
:= by
  have hsource := (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).isRegularValue_source hreg
  have hfun : (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).sourceHorizontal = bridgeHMapE a₀ :=
    funext (sourceHorizontal_eq_bridgeHMapE c)
  rwa [hfun] at hsource

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.isRegularValue_target_bridgeHMapE
statement:
lemma isRegularValue_target_bridgeHMapE
    (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) {y : F}
    (hreg : IsRegularValue (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).horizontal y) :
    IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a₁) y
proof:
:= by
  have htarget := (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).isRegularValue_target hreg
  have hfun : (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).targetHorizontal = bridgeHMapE a₁ :=
    funext (targetHorizontal_eq_bridgeHMapE c)
  rwa [hfun] at htarget

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.sourceLevelSet_eq_bridgeFLS
statement:
lemma sourceLevelSet_eq_bridgeFLS
    (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) (y : F) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hreg : IsRegularValue (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).horizontal y) :
    (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).sourceLevelSet y hy0 hreg =
      bridgeFLS a₀ y hy0
        (isRegularValue_source_bridgeHMapE c hreg)
proof:
:= by
  apply FramedLevelSet.eq_of_g_eq
  funext x
  change (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).sourceHorizontal x - y =
    bridgeHMapE a₀ x - y
  rw [sourceHorizontal_eq_bridgeHMapE]

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.targetLevelSet_eq_bridgeFLS
statement:
lemma targetLevelSet_eq_bridgeFLS
    (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) (y : F) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hreg : IsRegularValue (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).horizontal y) :
    (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).targetLevelSet y hy0 hreg =
      bridgeFLS a₁ y hy0
        (isRegularValue_target_bridgeHMapE c hreg)
proof:
:= by
  apply FramedLevelSet.eq_of_g_eq
  funext x
  change (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).targetHorizontal x - y =
    bridgeHMapE a₁ x - y
  rw [targetHorizontal_eq_bridgeHMapE]

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.sourceSign_heq_bridgeFiberSignOf
statement:
lemma sourceSign_heq_bridgeFiberSignOf
    (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) (y : F) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hreg : IsRegularValue (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).horizontal y)
    (hylt : ‖y‖ < 1) :
    HEq ((toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).sourceSign y hy0 hreg hylt)
      (bridgeFiberSignOf a₀ y hy0
        (isRegularValue_source_bridgeHMapE c hreg) hylt)
proof:
:= by
  apply FiberSign.heq_of_eq_toFun
    (sourceLevelSet_eq_bridgeFLS c y hy0 hreg)
  apply heq_of_eq
  funext x
  change vertC (nprepCob c (WithLp.ofLp (spaceTime x 0))) =
    vertC (nprep a₀ (WithLp.ofLp x))
  rw [nprepCob_left c (by rw [piTime_ofLp_spaceTime]; norm_num),
    piInit_ofLp_spaceTime]

name: Submission.CobApproximationPT.targetSign_heq_bridgeFiberSignOf
statement:
lemma targetSign_heq_bridgeFiberSignOf
    (c : Submission.CobApproximation a₀ a₁) (y : F) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hreg : IsRegularValue (toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).horizontal y)
    (hylt : ‖y‖ < 1) :
    HEq ((toCollaredSphereHomotopy c).targetSign y hy0 hreg hylt)
      (bridgeFiberSignOf a₁ y hy0
        (isRegularValue_target_bridgeHMapE c hreg) hylt)
proof:
:= by
  apply FiberSign.heq_of_eq_toFun
    (targetLevelSet_eq_bridgeFLS c y hy0 hreg)
  apply heq_of_eq
  funext x
  change vertC (nprepCob c (WithLp.ofLp (spaceTime x 1))) =
    vertC (nprep a₁ (WithLp.ofLp x))
  rw [nprepCob_right c (by rw [piTime_ofLp_spaceTime]; norm_num),
    piInit_ofLp_spaceTime]

name: Submission.exists_collaredSphereHomotopy_of_homotopic
statement:
theorem exists_collaredSphereHomotopy_of_homotopic
    (hpq : GenLoop.Homotopic a₀.representative a₁.representative) :
    Nonempty (CollaredSphereHomotopy n)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := exists_cobApproximation hpq
  exact ⟨CobApproximationPT.toCollaredSphereHomotopy c⟩

name: Submission.FiberSign.transport_rfl
statement:
@[simp] theorem transport_rfl (S : FiberSign X) :
    S.transport rfl = S
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.FiberSign.transport_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem transport_apply (hXY : X = Y) (S : FiberSign X)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    S.transport hXY x = S x
proof:
:= by
  subst Y
  rfl

name: Submission.transported_signPattern_of_pos_smul
statement:
lemma transported_signPattern_of_pos_smul
    {X Y : FramedLevelSet n} (S : FiberSign X) (T : FiberSign Y)
    (hXY : X = Y) (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (hq : ∀ x, 0 < q x)
    (hfun : ∀ x, T x = q x * S.transport hXY x) :
    ∀ x ∈ Y.fiber, (0 < S.transport hXY x ↔ 0 < T x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x _
  rw [hfun x]
  exact ⟨fun hx => mul_pos (hq x) hx,
    fun hx => by nlinarith [hq x]⟩

name: Submission.exists_eq_zero_of_norm_gt_of_hasCompactSupport
statement:
lemma exists_eq_zero_of_norm_gt_of_hasCompactSupport
    {f : E → ℝ} (hf : HasCompactSupport f) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ x : E, R < ‖x‖ → f x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hf.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : E)
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  by_contra hne
  have hxt : x ∈ tsupport f := subset_tsupport f hne
  have hball := hr hxt
  rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hball
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hball) hx

name: Submission.CollaredSphereHomotopy.eventually_sourceHorizontal_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eventually_sourceHorizontal_eq_zero (H : CollaredSphereHomotopy n) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ x : E, R < ‖x‖ → H.sourceHorizontal x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := H.exterior_south
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hfar : R < ‖initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x 0)‖ := by
    rw [initCLM_spaceTime]
    exact hx
  have hsouth := hR (spaceTime x 0) hfar
  rw [sourceHorizontal, horizontal, hsouth, southPole_coe, map_neg,
    initCLM_eLast, neg_zero]

name: Submission.CollaredSphereHomotopy.eventually_targetHorizontal_eq_zero
statement:
lemma eventually_targetHorizontal_eq_zero (H : CollaredSphereHomotopy n) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ x : E, R < ‖x‖ → H.targetHorizontal x = 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := H.exterior_south
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hfar : R < ‖initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x 1)‖ := by
    rw [initCLM_spaceTime]
    exact hx
  have hsouth := hR (spaceTime x 1) hfar
  rw [targetHorizontal, horizontal, hsouth, southPole_coe, map_neg,
    initCLM_eLast, neg_zero]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.sphereMap_initCLM
statement:
lemma sphereMap_initCLM (x : E) :
    initCLM n (sphereMap S κpos x : E) =
      ‖raw S κpos x‖⁻¹ • (κpos x • X.g x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sphereMap_coe, map_smul, initCLM_raw]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.sphereMap_vertical_eq_pos_smul
statement:
lemma sphereMap_vertical_eq_pos_smul (x : E) :
    vertC (sphereMap S κpos x : E) =
      ‖raw S κpos x‖⁻¹ * endpointVertical S κpos x
proof:
:= by
  change ‖raw S κpos x‖⁻¹ * (raw S κpos x) (Fin.last n) = _
  rw [raw_last]
  rfl

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.sphereMap_normalizationFactor_pos
statement:
lemma sphereMap_normalizationFactor_pos (x : E) :
    0 < ‖raw S κpos x‖⁻¹
proof:
:=
  inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr (raw_ne_zero S κpos x))

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_common_endpointPatchLocalizer
statement:
theorem exists_common_endpointPatchLocalizer :
    ∃ (Ppos : EndpointPatchLocalizer S κpos)
      (Pneg : EndpointPatchLocalizer S.neg κneg),
      Ppos.toFun = Pneg.toFun
proof:
:= by
  let V : Set E := signAgreement S κpos ∩ signAgreement S.neg κneg
  have hopen : IsOpen V :=
    (isOpen_signAgreement S κpos).inter (isOpen_signAgreement S.neg κneg)
  have hsub : X.fiber ⊆ V := by
    intro x hx
    exact ⟨fiber_subset_signAgreement S κpos hx,
      fiber_subset_signAgreement S.neg κneg hx⟩
  obtain ⟨δ, hδpos, hδsub⟩ :=
    X.isCompact_fiber.exists_cthickening_subset_open hopen hsub
  let U : Set E := Metric.thickening δ X.fiber
  have hKU : X.fiber ⊆ U := Metric.self_subset_thickening hδpos _
  have hUc : IsCompact (closure U) := by
    apply IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset X.isCompact_fiber.cthickening
      isClosed_closure
    exact closure_minimal
      (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _) Metric.isClosed_cthickening
  have hs : IsClosed Uᶜ := Metric.isOpen_thickening.isClosed_compl
  have hd : Disjoint Uᶜ X.fiber := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxU hxK
    exact hxU (hKU hxK)
  obtain ⟨lam, hlam0, hlam1, hlam01⟩ :=
    exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_of_isClosed
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) hs X.isClosed_fiber hd
  have hlamsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (⇑lam) := by
    rw [← contMDiff_iff_contDiff]
    exact lam.contMDiff
  have hlamsupport : HasCompactSupport (⇑lam) := by
    have hsupport : support (⇑lam) ⊆ U := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxU
      exact hx (hlam0 hxU)
    have htsupport : tsupport (⇑lam) ⊆ closure U :=
      closure_minimal (hsupport.trans subset_closure) isClosed_closure
    exact IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset hUc isClosed_closure htsupport
  have hlamV : ∀ x, lam x ≠ 0 → x ∈ V := by
    intro x hx
    have hxU : x ∈ U := by
      by_contra hnot
      exact hx (hlam0 hnot)
    exact hδsub (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _ hxU)
  let Ppos : EndpointPatchLocalizer S κpos := {
    toFun := ⇑lam
    smooth := hlamsmooth
    range := hlam01
    fiber_one := hlam1
    nonzero_agrees := fun x hx => (hlamV x hx).1
    compact_support := hlamsupport
  }
  let Pneg : EndpointPatchLocalizer S.neg κneg := {
    toFun := ⇑lam
    smooth := hlamsmooth
    range := hlam01
    fiber_one := hlam1
    nonzero_agrees := fun x hx => (hlamV x hx).2
    compact_support := hlamsupport
  }
  exact ⟨Ppos, Pneg, rfl⟩

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.cutoff_toFun_ne_of_mem_positivePart
statement:
theorem cutoff_toFun_ne_of_mem_positivePart
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ S.positivePart) :
    κpos.toFun ≠ κneg.toFun
proof:
:= by
  intro hfun
  have hpos : κpos x = 1 := κpos.positive_one x hx
  have hxneg : x ∈ S.neg.negativePart := by
    exact ⟨hx.1, by
      rw [FiberSign.neg_apply]
      exact neg_lt_zero.mpr hx.2⟩
  have hneg : κneg x = 0 := κneg.negative_zero x hxneg
  have happ := congrFun hfun x
  rw [hpos, hneg] at happ
  norm_num at happ

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchTargetLevelSet_eq_source_iff
statement:
theorem patchTargetLevelSet_eq_source_iff
    (P₀ : EndpointPatchLocalizer S₀ κ₀) (y₀ : F)
    (hregular₀ : IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀)
      (patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀) y₀)
    (H : CollaredSphereHomotopy n) (y : F) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hregular : IsRegularValue H.horizontal y) :
    patchTargetLevelSet S₀ κ₀ P₀ y₀ hregular₀ =
        H.sourceLevelSet y hy0 hregular ↔
      patchTargetMap S₀ κ₀ P₀ y₀ = fun x => H.sourceHorizontal x - y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa [patchTargetLevelSet, CollaredSphereHomotopy.sourceLevelSet] using
      congrArg FramedLevelSet.g h
  · intro h
    apply FramedLevelSet.eq_of_g_eq
    simpa [patchTargetLevelSet, CollaredSphereHomotopy.sourceLevelSet] using h

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchTargetLevelSet_eq_target_iff
statement:
theorem patchTargetLevelSet_eq_target_iff
    (P₁ : EndpointPatchLocalizer S₁ κ₁) (y₁ : F)
    (hregular₁ : IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁)
      (patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁) y₁)
    (H : CollaredSphereHomotopy n) (y : F) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hregular : IsRegularValue H.horizontal y) :
    patchTargetLevelSet S₁ κ₁ P₁ y₁ hregular₁ =
        H.targetLevelSet y hy0 hregular ↔
      patchTargetMap S₁ κ₁ P₁ y₁ = fun x => H.targetHorizontal x - y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa [patchTargetLevelSet, CollaredSphereHomotopy.targetLevelSet] using
      congrArg FramedLevelSet.g h
  · intro h
    apply FramedLevelSet.eq_of_g_eq
    simpa [patchTargetLevelSet, CollaredSphereHomotopy.targetLevelSet] using h

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_common_small_regular_value
statement:
theorem exists_common_small_regular_value
    (P₀ : EndpointPatchLocalizer S₀ κ₀)
    (P₁ : EndpointPatchLocalizer S₁ κ₁)
    (H : CollaredSphereHomotopy n) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ y : F, 0 < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 1 / 8 ∧
      IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀)
        (patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀) y ∧
      IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁)
        (patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁) y ∧
      IsRegularValue H.horizontal y
proof:
:= by
  let C₀ : Set F := patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀ ''
    {v | v ∈ patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀ ∧
      ¬Function.Surjective
        (fderivWithin ℝ (patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀)
          (patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀) v)}
  let C₁ : Set F := patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁ ''
    {v | v ∈ patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁ ∧
      ¬Function.Surjective
        (fderivWithin ℝ (patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁)
          (patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁) v)}
  let CH : Set F := H.horizontal ''
    {v | v ∈ (Set.univ : Set A) ∧
      ¬Function.Surjective
        (fderivWithin ℝ H.horizontal (Set.univ : Set A) v)}
  have hC₀ : volume C₀ = 0 := by
    dsimp [C₀]
    exact sard (isOpen_patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀)
      (contDiffOn_patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀)
  have hC₁ : volume C₁ = 0 := by
    dsimp [C₁]
    exact sard (isOpen_patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁)
      (contDiffOn_patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁)
  have hCH : volume CH = 0 := by
    dsimp [CH]
    exact sard isOpen_univ H.contDiff_horizontal.contDiffOn
  have hbad : volume ((C₀ ∪ C₁) ∪ CH) = 0 :=
    measure_union_null (measure_union_null hC₀ hC₁) hCH
  let z₀ : F := EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (1 / 16 : ℝ)
  let O : Set F := Metric.ball z₀ (1 / 32)
  have hOpos : 0 < volume O := by
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos volume
      (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 32))
  have hnotSub : ¬O ⊆ (C₀ ∪ C₁) ∪ CH := by
    intro hsub
    exact hOpos.ne' (measure_mono_null hsub hbad)
  obtain ⟨y, hyO, hybad⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hnotSub
  have hreg₀ : IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀)
      (patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀) y := by
    intro v hvU hvy
    by_contra hns
    apply hybad
    exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨v, ⟨hvU, hns⟩, hvy⟩)
  have hreg₁ : IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁)
      (patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁) y := by
    intro v hvU hvy
    by_contra hns
    apply hybad
    exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨v, ⟨hvU, hns⟩, hvy⟩)
  have hregOn : IsRegularValueOn H.horizontal Set.univ y := by
    intro v _ hvy
    by_contra hns
    apply hybad
    exact Or.inr ⟨v, ⟨Set.mem_univ v, hns⟩, hvy⟩
  have hreg : IsRegularValue H.horizontal y := by
    intro v hvy
    have hs := hregOn v (Set.mem_univ v) hvy
    rwa [fderivWithin_univ] at hs
  have hz₀norm : ‖z₀‖ = 1 / 16 := by
    rw [show z₀ = EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (1 / 16 : ℝ) from rfl,
      PiLp.norm_single, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    norm_num
  have hdist : ‖y - z₀‖ < 1 / 32 := by
    change dist y z₀ < 1 / 32 at hyO
    rwa [dist_eq_norm] at hyO
  have habs : |‖y‖ - ‖z₀‖| ≤ ‖y - z₀‖ := abs_norm_sub_norm_le y z₀
  rw [hz₀norm, abs_le] at habs
  exact ⟨y, by linarith [habs.1], by linarith [habs.2], hreg₀, hreg₁, hreg⟩

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_common_regular_value_lt
statement:
theorem exists_common_regular_value_lt
    (P₀ : EndpointPatchLocalizer S₀ κ₀)
    (P₁ : EndpointPatchLocalizer S₁ κ₁)
    (H : CollaredSphereHomotopy n) (hn : 0 < n)
    (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ y : F, 0 < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < r ∧
      IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀)
        (patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀) y ∧
      IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁)
        (patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁) y ∧
      IsRegularValue H.horizontal y
proof:
:= by
  let C₀ : Set F := patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀ ''
    {v | v ∈ patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀ ∧
      ¬Function.Surjective
        (fderivWithin ℝ (patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀)
          (patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀) v)}
  let C₁ : Set F := patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁ ''
    {v | v ∈ patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁ ∧
      ¬Function.Surjective
        (fderivWithin ℝ (patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁)
          (patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁) v)}
  let CH : Set F := H.horizontal ''
    {v | v ∈ (Set.univ : Set A) ∧
      ¬Function.Surjective
        (fderivWithin ℝ H.horizontal (Set.univ : Set A) v)}
  have hC₀ : volume C₀ = 0 := by
    dsimp [C₀]
    exact sard (isOpen_patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀)
      (contDiffOn_patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀)
  have hC₁ : volume C₁ = 0 := by
    dsimp [C₁]
    exact sard (isOpen_patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁)
      (contDiffOn_patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁)
  have hCH : volume CH = 0 := by
    dsimp [CH]
    exact sard isOpen_univ H.contDiff_horizontal.contDiffOn
  have hbad : volume ((C₀ ∪ C₁) ∪ CH) = 0 :=
    measure_union_null (measure_union_null hC₀ hC₁) hCH
  let z₀ : F := EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (r / 2)
  let O : Set F := Metric.ball z₀ (r / 4)
  have hquarter : 0 < r / 4 := div_pos hr (by norm_num)
  have hOpos : 0 < volume O := by
    exact Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos volume
      (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr hquarter)
  have hnotSub : ¬O ⊆ (C₀ ∪ C₁) ∪ CH := by
    intro hsub
    exact hOpos.ne' (measure_mono_null hsub hbad)
  obtain ⟨y, hyO, hybad⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hnotSub
  have hreg₀ : IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀)
      (patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀) y := by
    intro v hvU hvy
    by_contra hns
    apply hybad
    exact Or.inl (Or.inl ⟨v, ⟨hvU, hns⟩, hvy⟩)
  have hreg₁ : IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁)
      (patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁) y := by
    intro v hvU hvy
    by_contra hns
    apply hybad
    exact Or.inl (Or.inr ⟨v, ⟨hvU, hns⟩, hvy⟩)
  have hregOn : IsRegularValueOn H.horizontal Set.univ y := by
    intro v _ hvy
    by_contra hns
    apply hybad
    exact Or.inr ⟨v, ⟨Set.mem_univ v, hns⟩, hvy⟩
  have hreg : IsRegularValue H.horizontal y := by
    intro v hvy
    have hs := hregOn v (Set.mem_univ v) hvy
    rwa [fderivWithin_univ] at hs
  have hz₀norm : ‖z₀‖ = r / 2 := by
    rw [show z₀ = EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (r / 2) from rfl,
      PiLp.norm_single, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (div_pos hr (by norm_num))]
  have hdist : ‖y - z₀‖ < r / 4 := by
    change dist y z₀ < r / 4 at hyO
    rwa [dist_eq_norm] at hyO
  have habs : |‖y‖ - ‖z₀‖| ≤ ‖y - z₀‖ := abs_norm_sub_norm_le y z₀
  rw [hz₀norm, abs_le] at habs
  exact ⟨y, by linarith [habs.1], by linarith [habs.2], hreg₀, hreg₁, hreg⟩

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.source_level_eq_forces_eventually_g_eq_neg
statement:
theorem source_level_eq_forces_eventually_g_eq_neg
    (P₀ : EndpointPatchLocalizer S₀ κ₀) (y₀ : F)
    (hregular₀ : IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀)
      (patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀) y₀)
    (H : CollaredSphereHomotopy n) (y : F) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hregular : IsRegularValue H.horizontal y)
    (hlevel : patchTargetLevelSet S₀ κ₀ P₀ y₀ hregular₀ =
      H.sourceLevelSet y hy0 hregular) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ x : E, R < ‖x‖ → X₀.g x = -y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Rκ, hRκ⟩ :=
    exists_eq_zero_of_norm_gt_of_hasCompactSupport κ₀.compact_support
  obtain ⟨RP, hRP⟩ :=
    exists_eq_zero_of_norm_gt_of_hasCompactSupport P₀.compact_support
  obtain ⟨RH, hRH⟩ := H.eventually_sourceHorizontal_eq_zero
  refine ⟨max (max Rκ RP) RH, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hκx : κ₀ x = 0 := hRκ x
    ((le_max_left Rκ RP |>.trans (le_max_left (max Rκ RP) RH)).trans_lt hx)
  have hPx : P₀ x = 0 := hRP x
    ((le_max_right Rκ RP |>.trans (le_max_left (max Rκ RP) RH)).trans_lt hx)
  have hHx : H.sourceHorizontal x = 0 := hRH x
    ((le_max_right (max Rκ RP) RH).trans_lt hx)
  have hmaps := congrArg FramedLevelSet.g hlevel
  have hmapsx := congrFun hmaps x
  change patchTargetMap S₀ κ₀ P₀ y₀ x = H.sourceHorizontal x - y at hmapsx
  simpa [patchTargetMap, hκx, hPx, hHx] using hmapsx

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.target_level_eq_forces_eventually_g_eq_neg
statement:
theorem target_level_eq_forces_eventually_g_eq_neg
    (P₁ : EndpointPatchLocalizer S₁ κ₁) (y₁ : F)
    (hregular₁ : IsRegularValueOn (patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁)
      (patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁) y₁)
    (H : CollaredSphereHomotopy n) (y : F) (hy0 : y ≠ 0)
    (hregular : IsRegularValue H.horizontal y)
    (hlevel : patchTargetLevelSet S₁ κ₁ P₁ y₁ hregular₁ =
      H.targetLevelSet y hy0 hregular) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ x : E, R < ‖x‖ → X₁.g x = -y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Rκ, hRκ⟩ :=
    exists_eq_zero_of_norm_gt_of_hasCompactSupport κ₁.compact_support
  obtain ⟨RP, hRP⟩ :=
    exists_eq_zero_of_norm_gt_of_hasCompactSupport P₁.compact_support
  obtain ⟨RH, hRH⟩ := H.eventually_targetHorizontal_eq_zero
  refine ⟨max (max Rκ RP) RH, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  have hκx : κ₁ x = 0 := hRκ x
    ((le_max_left Rκ RP |>.trans (le_max_left (max Rκ RP) RH)).trans_lt hx)
  have hPx : P₁ x = 0 := hRP x
    ((le_max_right Rκ RP |>.trans (le_max_left (max Rκ RP) RH)).trans_lt hx)
  have hHx : H.targetHorizontal x = 0 := hRH x
    ((le_max_right (max Rκ RP) RH).trans_lt hx)
  have hmaps := congrArg FramedLevelSet.g hlevel
  have hmapsx := congrFun hmaps x
  change patchTargetMap S₁ κ₁ P₁ y₁ x = H.targetHorizontal x - y at hmapsx
  simpa [patchTargetMap, hκx, hPx, hHx] using hmapsx

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.PatchedTransverseLane.source_eventually_g_eq_neg
statement:

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeReduction.Data.nonempty_normalize
statement:
theorem nonempty_normalize (D : Data m h3 B) :
    Nonempty
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism B.fiberSign
        (DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard m B.northDelta).sign)
proof:
:= by
  have hconfigure :=
    (ConcreteConfigurationReducedGeometry.geometryOfReduction
      m h3 B.fiberSign D).nonempty_configureCobordism
  have hindex :
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign).delta =
        B.northDelta := by
    calc
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign).delta =
          B.fiberSign.positiveDelta :=
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveDelta_eq_positiveLedger_delta
          m B.fiberSign).symm
      _ = B.northDelta := B.northDelta_eq_positiveDelta.symm
  change Nonempty
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism B.fiberSign
      (DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard m
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger
          m B.fiberSign).delta).sign) at hconfigure
  rw [hindex] at hconfigure
  exact hconfigure

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeReduction.negativeDelta_eq_positiveDelta_of_reduction
statement:
theorem negativeDelta_eq_positiveDelta_of_reduction
    (I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant (m + 2))
    {X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} (S : FiberSign X)
    {P : ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.ComponentPlacementData m X}
    {G : ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.FrameGaugeData m P}
    (D : ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.ReductionData m S P G) :
    S.negativeDelta = S.positiveDelta
proof:
:= by
  let PL := ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m S
  let NL := ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.negativeLedger m S
  have hcob := D.toGeometry.nonempty_configureCobordism
  have hneg := I.eq_of_nonempty S.neg
    (ConcreteConfigurationMoveKit.configSign m PL NL).neg
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_neg hcob)
  change S.negativeDelta =
    (ConcreteConfigurationMoveKit.configSign m PL NL).negativeDelta at hneg
  calc
    S.negativeDelta =
        (ConcreteConfigurationMoveKit.configSign m PL NL).negativeDelta := hneg
    _ = PL.delta := by
      exact DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard_negativeDelta m I PL.delta
    _ = S.positiveDelta :=
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveDelta_eq_positiveLedger_delta
        m S).symm

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.exists_curve_eq_of_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem exists_curve_eq_of_mem_orbit
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) {x : E₁}
    (hx : x ∈ V.orbit P.p) :
    ∃ u : I, P.curve u = x
proof:
:= by
  let T : ℝ := V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp
  letI : Fact (0 < T) := ⟨by
    dsimp [T]
    exact V.fundamentalPeriod_pos P.hp⟩
  let y : V.orbit P.p := ⟨x, hx⟩
  let θ : AddCircle T := (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp).symm y
  have finish : ∀ {u : I}, P.phase u = θ → P.curve u = x := by
    intro u hu
    have horbit : P.orbitPath u = y := by
      calc
        P.orbitPath u = V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp (P.phase u) :=
          (P.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phase u).symm
        _ = V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp θ := by rw [hu]
        _ = y := (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp).apply_symm_apply y
    exact congrArg Subtype.val horbit
  rcases P.phaseLift_one_eq_period_or_neg with hpositive | hnegative
  · have hθ : θ ∈
        ((↑) : ℝ → AddCircle T) '' Icc (0 : ℝ) (0 + T) := by
      rw [AddCircle.coe_image_Icc_eq]
      exact Set.mem_univ θ
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsθ⟩ := hθ
    have hsrange : s ∈ Icc (P.phaseLift 0) (P.phaseLift 1) := by
      rw [P.phaseLift_zero, hpositive]
      simpa [T] using hs
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (0 : I) (1 : I)
      P.phaseLift.continuous hsrange
    refine ⟨u, finish ?_⟩
    rw [← P.phaseLift_coe u, hu]
    exact hsθ
  · have hθ : θ ∈
        ((↑) : ℝ → AddCircle T) '' Icc (-T) (-T + T) := by
      rw [AddCircle.coe_image_Icc_eq]
      exact Set.mem_univ θ
    obtain ⟨s, hs, hsθ⟩ := hθ
    have hsrange : s ∈ Icc (P.phaseLift 1) (P.phaseLift 0) := by
      rw [P.phaseLift_zero, hnegative]
      simpa [T] using hs
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (1 : I) (0 : I)
      P.phaseLift.continuous hsrange
    refine ⟨u, finish ?_⟩
    rw [← P.phaseLift_coe u, hu]
    exact hsθ

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.range_curve
statement:

    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    Set.range P.curve = V.orbit P.p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact P.curve_mem_orbit u
  · intro hx
    exact P.exists_curve_eq_of_mem_orbit hx

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowCore.positiveCurve_eq_cases
statement:
theorem positiveCurve_eq_cases
    (O : {O // O ∈ H.Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset H.A}) {u v : I}
    (huv : H.positiveCurve O u = H.positiveCurve O v) :
    u = v ∨ (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hambient :
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O u) H.ε =
        H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O v) H.ε := by
    calc
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O u) H.ε =
          cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O u) (H.t + H.ε) := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O u]
        exact (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O v) (H.t + H.ε) := by rw [huv]
      _ = H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O v) H.ε := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O v]
        exact spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hcore : H.coreLoop O u = H.coreLoop O v :=
    H.R.flow_apply_injective H.ε hambient
  have hnegativeAmbient :
      (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop u =
        (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop v := by
    apply H.R.flow_apply_injective H.ε
    exact hcore
  apply (H.negativeParam O).curve_eq_cases
  simpa [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.exteriorAmbientLoop] using
    congrArg spacePart hnegativeAmbient

theorem positive_base_mem_targetOrbit

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowCore.targetOrbit_injective
statement: theorem targetOrbit_injective : Function.Injective H.targetOrbit
proof:
:= by
  intro O P hOP
  have hPtarget : H.positiveCurve P 0 ∈
      H.Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve O 0) := by
    rw [← H.targetOrbit_coe O, hOP, H.targetOrbit_coe P]
    exact H.Vpos.mem_orbit_self _
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ :=
    (H.positiveParam O).exists_curve_eq_of_mem_orbit hPtarget
  change H.positiveCurve O u = H.positiveCurve P 0 at hu
  have hambient :
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O u) H.ε =
        H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop P 0) H.ε := by
    calc
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O u) H.ε =
          cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O u) (H.t + H.ε) := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O u]
        exact (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve P 0) (H.t + H.ε) := by rw [hu]
      _ = H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop P 0) H.ε := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time P 0]
        exact spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hcore : H.coreLoop O u = H.coreLoop P 0 :=
    H.R.flow_apply_injective H.ε hambient
  have hnegativeAmbient :
      (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop u =
        (H.negativeParam P).exteriorAmbientLoop 0 := by
    apply H.R.flow_apply_injective H.ε
    exact hcore
  have hnegative :
      (H.negativeParam O).curve u = (H.negativeParam P).curve 0 := by
    simpa [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.exteriorAmbientLoop] using
      congrArg spacePart hnegativeAmbient
  have hmem : H.Vneg.orbitPoint P.1 ∈
      H.Vneg.orbit (H.Vneg.orbitPoint O.1) := by
    have hPzero : (H.negativeParam P).curve 0 =
        H.Vneg.orbitPoint P.1 := by
      exact H.Vneg.intrinsicOrbitCurve_zero P.1
    rw [← hPzero, ← hnegative]
    exact (H.negativeParam O).curve_mem_orbit u
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  calc
    (O.1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
        H.Vneg.orbit (H.Vneg.orbitPoint O.1) :=
      H.Vneg.orbitPoint_orbit O.1
    _ = H.Vneg.orbit (H.Vneg.orbitPoint P.1) :=
      (H.Vneg.orbit_eq_of_mem hmem).symm
    _ = (P.1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :=
      (H.Vneg.orbitPoint_orbit P.1).symm

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalMinimumTargetOrbit_mem_positive
statement:
theorem chronologicalMinimumTargetOrbit_mem_positive
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hsafe : D.ChronologicalExteriorSafe t ht)
    (hmidpoint : D.ChronologicalMinimumExteriorMidpointCapture t ht)
    (O : {O // O ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
      (D.chronologicalMinimumExteriorSourceFamily t ht)}) :
    let H
proof:
:= D.chronologicalMinimumExteriorFlowCore t ht hsafe hmidpoint
    H.targetOrbit O ∈
      (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
        ((D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
          (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)).positiveOrbitCollection
            (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht)) := by
  let H := D.chronologicalMinimumExteriorFlowCore t ht hsafe hmidpoint
  let Sneg := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)
  let Spos := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
  let O' : {Q // Q ∈ H.Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset H.A} :=
    ⟨O.1, by
      change O.1 ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
        (D.chronologicalMinimumExteriorSourceFamily t ht)
      exact O.2⟩
  change H.targetOrbit O' ∈ H.Vpos.selectedOrbitFinset
    (Spos.positiveOrbitCollection H.Vpos)
  let p := (H.negativeParam O').exteriorAmbientLoop 0
  have hsourceCollection : (O'.1 : Set Eₐ) ∈
      Sneg.positiveOrbitCollection H.Vneg :=
    (H.Vneg.mem_selectedOrbitFinset O'.1).mp O'.2
  have hsourceSign : 0 < Sneg (H.Vneg.orbitPoint O'.1) :=
    (Sneg.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff H.Vneg O'.1).mp hsourceCollection
  have hpEq : p = cobSpaceTime (H.Vneg.orbitPoint O'.1)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) := by
    change cobSpaceTime ((H.negativeParam O').curve 0) (H.t - H.ε) = _
    apply congrArg₂ cobSpaceTime
    · exact H.Vneg.intrinsicOrbitCurve_zero O'.1
    · rfl
  have hstartSign : 0 < D.signedOutput p := by
    rw [hpEq]
    exact hsourceSign
  let γ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 4))) :=
    ⟨fun u => H.R.base.flow p ((u : ℝ) * (2 * H.ε)),
      (H.R.base.continuous_flow p).comp
        (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)⟩
  have hpFiber : H.C.G p = 0 :=
    (H.negativeParam O').exteriorAmbientLoop_fiber 0
  have hγFiber : ∀ u, D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (γ u) = 0 := by
    intro u
    exact H.R.flow_mem_fiber hpFiber _
  have hthrough : 0 < D.signedOutput (γ 1) :=
    (D.signedOutput.pos_iff_of_zeroFiber_path γ hγFiber).mp
      (by simpa [γ] using hstartSign)
  have hdouble : H.R.base.flow p (2 * H.ε) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.R.base.flow p H.ε) H.ε := by
    simpa [two_mul] using
      (congrFun (H.R.base.flow_shift p H.ε) H.ε).symm
  have hendSign : 0 < D.signedOutput
      (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O' 0) H.ε) := by
    change 0 < D.signedOutput
      (H.R.base.flow (H.R.base.flow p H.ε) H.ε)
    rw [← hdouble]
    simpa [γ] using hthrough
  have hendEq : cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O' 0)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O' 0) H.ε := by
    rw [show D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht = H.t + H.ε by rfl]
    rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O' 0]
    change cobSpaceTime
      (spacePart (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O' 0) H.ε))
      (tcoord (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O' 0) H.ε)) = _
    exact spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hbaseSign : 0 < Spos (H.positiveCurve O' 0) := by
    change 0 < D.signedOutput (cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O' 0)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht))
    rw [hendEq]
    exact hendSign
  apply (H.Vpos.mem_selectedOrbitFinset (H.targetOrbit O')).mpr
  rw [Spos.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff]
  have htargetPoint : H.Vpos.orbitPoint (H.targetOrbit O') ∈
      H.Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve O' 0) := by
    rw [← H.targetOrbit_coe O', H.Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit]
    exact H.Vpos.mem_orbit_self _
  exact (Spos.pos_iff_of_mem_orbit H.Vpos
    (H.positiveCurve_mem_fiber O' 0) htargetPoint).mp hbaseSign

      (D.chronologicalMaximumExteriorSourceFamily t ht hpositive hindex)}) :

  change H.targetOrbit O' ∈ H.Vpos.selectedOrbitFinset
    (Spos.positiveOrbitCollection H.Vpos)
  let p := (H.negativeParam O').exteriorAmbientLoop 0
  have hsourceCollection : (O'.1 : Set Eₐ) ∈

    ((H.Vneg.mem_selectedOrbitFinset O'.1).mp O'.2).1
  have hsourceSign : 0 < Sneg (H.Vneg.orbitPoint O'.1) :=

  have hpEq : p = cobSpaceTime (H.Vneg.orbitPoint O'.1)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) := by
    change cobSpaceTime ((H.negativeParam O').curve 0) (H.t - H.ε) = _
    apply congrArg₂ cobSpaceTime
    · exact H.Vneg.intrinsicOrbitCurve_zero O'.1
    · rfl
  have hstartSign : 0 < D.signedOutput p := by
    rw [hpEq]
    exact hsourceSign
  let γ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 4))) :=
    ⟨fun u => H.R.base.flow p ((u : ℝ) * (2 * H.ε)),
      (H.R.base.continuous_flow p).comp
        (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)⟩
  have hpFiber : H.C.G p = 0 :=
    (H.negativeParam O').exteriorAmbientLoop_fiber 0
  have hγFiber : ∀ u, D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (γ u) = 0 := by
    intro u
    exact H.R.flow_mem_fiber hpFiber _
  have hthrough : 0 < D.signedOutput (γ 1) :=
    (D.signedOutput.pos_iff_of_zeroFiber_path γ hγFiber).mp
      (by simpa [γ] using hstartSign)
  have hdouble : H.R.base.flow p (2 * H.ε) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.R.base.flow p H.ε) H.ε := by
    simpa [two_mul] using
      (congrFun (H.R.base.flow_shift p H.ε) H.ε).symm
  have hendSign : 0 < D.signedOutput
      (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O' 0) H.ε) := by
    change 0 < D.signedOutput
      (H.R.base.flow (H.R.base.flow p H.ε) H.ε)
    rw [← hdouble]
    simpa [γ] using hthrough
  have hendEq : cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O' 0)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O' 0) H.ε := by
    rw [show D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht = H.t + H.ε by rfl]
    rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O' 0]
    change cobSpaceTime
      (spacePart (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O' 0) H.ε))
      (tcoord (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O' 0) H.ε)) = _
    exact spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hbaseSign : 0 < Spos (H.positiveCurve O' 0) := by
    change 0 < D.signedOutput (cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O' 0)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht))
    rw [hendEq]
    exact hendSign
  apply (H.Vpos.mem_selectedOrbitFinset (H.targetOrbit O')).mpr
  rw [Spos.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff]
  have htargetPoint : H.Vpos.orbitPoint (H.targetOrbit O') ∈
      H.Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve O' 0) := by
    rw [← H.targetOrbit_coe O', H.Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit]
