name: Submission.exists_common_regularValue_in_ball
statement:
theorem exists_common_regularValue_in_ball
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p q : ℕ}
    (f : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q))
    (hf : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (f i))
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ y ∈ ball z r, ∀ i, IsRegularValue (f i) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let bad : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)) :=
    ⋃ i : ι, f i '' {x | ¬Surjective (fderiv ℝ (f i) x)}
  have hbad : volume bad = 0 := by
    dsimp [bad]
    exact measure_iUnion_null fun i => sard_global (hf i)
  have hballPos : 0 < volume (ball z r) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos volume (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr hr)
  have hnsub : ¬ball z r ⊆ bad := by
    intro hsub
    exact hballPos.ne' (measure_mono_null hsub hbad)
  obtain ⟨y, hyball, hybad⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hnsub
  refine ⟨y, hyball, ?_⟩
  intro i x hfx
  by_contra hsurj
  apply hybad
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ⟨x, hsurj, hfx⟩⟩

name: Submission.exists_common_regularValueOn_in_ball
statement:
theorem exists_common_regularValueOn_in_ball
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {p q : ℕ}
    (U : ι → Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p)))
    (hU : ∀ i, IsOpen (U i))
    (f : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q))
    (hf : ∀ i, ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f i) (U i))
    (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ y ∈ ball z r, ∀ i, IsRegularValueOn (f i) (U i) y
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let bad : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)) :=
    ⋃ i : ι, f i '' {x | x ∈ U i ∧
      ¬Surjective (fderivWithin ℝ (f i) (U i) x)}
  have hbad : volume bad = 0 := by
    dsimp [bad]
    exact measure_iUnion_null fun i => sard (hU i) (hf i)
  have hballPos : 0 < volume (ball z r) :=
    Metric.isOpen_ball.measure_pos volume (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr hr)
  have hnsub : ¬ball z r ⊆ bad := by
    intro hsub
    exact hballPos.ne' (measure_mono_null hsub hbad)
  obtain ⟨y, hyball, hybad⟩ := Set.not_subset.mp hnsub
  refine ⟨y, hyball, ?_⟩
  intro i x hxU hfx
  by_contra hsurj
  apply hybad
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, ⟨x, ⟨hxU, hsurj⟩, hfx⟩⟩

name: Submission.eventually_uniform_surjective
statement:
theorem eventually_uniform_surjective
    {P X E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] [TopologicalSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {q : ℕ} {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (L : P → X → E →L[ℝ] (Fin q → ℝ))
    (hL : Continuous fun z : P × X => L z.1 z.2)
    {p₀ : P} (hzero : ∀ x ∈ K, Surjective (L p₀ x)) :
    ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 p₀, ∀ x ∈ K, Surjective (L p x)
proof:
:= by
  apply hK.eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
  intro x hx
  have hmem : L p₀ x ∈
      {A : E →L[ℝ] (Fin q → ℝ) | Surjective A} := hzero x hx
  exact hL.continuousAt
    (isOpen_setOf_surjective.mem_nhds hmem)

name: Submission.eventually_uniform_surjective_add_smul
statement:
theorem eventually_uniform_surjective_add_smul
    {X E : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    {q : ℕ} {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (L₀ Δ : X → E →L[ℝ] (Fin q → ℝ))
    (hL₀ : Continuous L₀) (hΔ : Continuous Δ)
    (hsurj : ∀ x ∈ K, Surjective (L₀ x)) :
    ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in 𝓝 0, ∀ x ∈ K,
      Surjective (L₀ x + s • Δ x)
proof:
:= by
  let L : ℝ → X → E →L[ℝ] (Fin q → ℝ) :=
    fun s x => L₀ x + s • Δ x
  have hL : Continuous fun z : ℝ × X => L z.1 z.2 := by
    exact (hL₀.comp continuous_snd).add
      (continuous_fst.smul (hΔ.comp continuous_snd))
  have hzero : ∀ x ∈ K, Surjective (L 0 x) := by
    intro x hx
    simpa [L] using hsurj x hx
  simpa [L] using
    (eventually_uniform_surjective hK L hL hzero)

name: Submission.isOpen_morseJetGood
statement: theorem isOpen_morseJetGood : IsOpen MorseJetGood
proof:
:= by
  have hgrad : IsOpen {J : E₂ × (E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) | J.1 ≠ 0} := by
    have hzero : IsClosed ({0} : Set E₂) := isClosed_singleton
    have heq : {J : E₂ × (E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) | J.1 ≠ 0} =
        Prod.fst ⁻¹' ({0} : Set E₂)ᶜ := by
      ext J
      simp
    rw [heq]
    exact hzero.isOpen_compl.preimage
      (continuous_fst : Continuous fun J : E₂ × (E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) => J.1)
  have hhess : IsOpen {J : E₂ × (E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) | Bijective J.2} := by
    have hopen : IsOpen {A : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂ | IsUnit A} := Units.isOpen
    have hpre := hopen.preimage
      (continuous_snd : Continuous fun J : E₂ × (E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) => J.2)
    have heq : {J : E₂ × (E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) | Bijective J.2} =
        Prod.snd ⁻¹' {A : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂ | IsUnit A} := by
      ext J
      simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage,
        ContinuousLinearMap.isUnit_iff_bijective]
    rw [heq]
    exact hpre
  exact hgrad.union hhess

name: Submission.eventually_uniform_morseJetGood
statement:
theorem eventually_uniform_morseJetGood
    {P X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] [TopologicalSpace X]
    {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (jet : P → X → E₂ × (E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂))
    (hjet : Continuous fun z : P × X => jet z.1 z.2)
    {p₀ : P} (hgood : ∀ x ∈ K, jet p₀ x ∈ MorseJetGood) :
    ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 p₀, ∀ x ∈ K, jet p x ∈ MorseJetGood
proof:
:= by
  apply hK.eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
  intro x hx
  exact hjet.continuousAt
    (isOpen_morseJetGood.mem_nhds (hgood x hx))

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.eventRaw_noninterference
statement:
theorem eventRaw_noninterference (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)

    (hv : v ∈ closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint p) (R.cutoffs.radius p / 2))

proof:

    SmoothCutoff.affineJet (-((B.chart e.1.1).liftCovector (G.tilt e.1.1).q))

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.sum_K_lt_one
statement:
theorem sum_K_lt_one (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G) :
    (∑ p, R.K p) < 1
proof:
:= by
  have htwice : 2 * ((∑ p, R.K p : NNReal) : ℝ) < 1 := by
    exact_mod_cast R.twice_sum_K_lt_one
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ((∑ p, R.K p : NNReal) : ℝ) := NNReal.coe_nonneg _
  have hreal : ((∑ p, R.K p : NNReal) : ℝ) < 1 := by linarith
  exact_mod_cast hreal

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm
statement:
theorem amplitude_diffeomorph_symm
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G) :
    R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm = R.forwardAmplitude.diffeomorph
proof:
:= by
  apply Diffeomorph.ext
  intro v
  have hinv := R.forwardAmplitude.inverse_diffeomorph
    R.forwardAmplitude_twice_K_lt_one
  change (R.forwardAmplitude.inverse
    R.forwardAmplitude_twice_K_lt_one).diffeomorph.symm v = _
  rw [hinv]
  exact R.forwardAmplitude.diffeomorph.symm_symm_apply v

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.forwardAmplitude_eq_eventRaw_on_core
statement:
theorem forwardAmplitude_eq_eventRaw_on_core
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : GenericMorseEvent G) {v : E'}
    (hv : v ∈ closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint p) (R.cutoffs.radius p / 2)) :
    R.forwardAmplitude v = R.eventRaw p v
proof:
:= by
  exact FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.ofFiniteLipschitz_eq_on_core
    R.eventRaw
    (fun p => closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint p) (R.cutoffs.radius p / 2))
    (fun p => R.eventRaw_smooth p)
    (fun p v hv => R.eventRaw_collar_zero p v hv)
    (fun p v hv q hqp => R.eventRaw_noninterference p v hv q hqp)
    R.K R.sum_K_lt_one R.lipschitz p hv

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.time_install
statement:
theorem time_install
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : GenericMorseEvent G) (u : E₂)
    (hud : u ∈ (B.chart p.1.1).domain)
    (hu : (B.chart p.1.1).param u ∈
      closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint p) (R.cutoffs.radius p / 2)) :
    tcoord (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm ((B.chart p.1.1).param u)) =
      G.localSeparatedTime p.1 u
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm]
  rw [SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply]
  have ha : R.forwardAmplitude ((B.chart p.1.1).param u) =
      R.eventRaw p ((B.chart p.1.1).param u) :=
    R.forwardAmplitude_eq_eventRaw_on_core p hu
  have hshift : verticalShift R.forwardAmplitude ((B.chart p.1.1).param u) =
      verticalShift (R.eventRaw p) ((B.chart p.1.1).param u) := by
    simp only [verticalShift]
    rw [ha]
  rw [hshift]
  have hlocal := (B.chart p.1.1).verticalShift_time_eq_chartLinearTilt_add_const
    (R.cutoffs.cutoff p) (G.tilt p.1.1).q (G.valueShift p.1) hud hu
  simpa [eventRaw, GenericFiniteIFTAtlas.localSeparatedTime,
    (G.tilt p.1.1).tilted_eq,
    FiniteIFTSurfaceChartFamily.toFiniteIFTChartFamily] using hlocal

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.installed_time_install
statement:
theorem installed_time_install
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (hdom : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) u,
      ‖u‖ < (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).radius →
        p.2 + G.installedMorseParam p u ∈ (B.chart p.1).domain)
    (hcore : ∀ p (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) u,
      ‖u‖ < (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).radius →
        (B.chart p.1).param (p.2 + G.installedMorseParam p u) ∈
          closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint ⟨p, hp⟩)
            (R.cutoffs.radius ⟨p, hp⟩ / 2)) :
    ∀ p (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) u,
      ‖u‖ < (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).radius →
      tcoord (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
        ((B.chart p.1).param (p.2 + G.installedMorseParam p u))) =
          G.localSeparatedTime p (p.2 + G.installedMorseParam p u)
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp u hu
  exact R.time_install ⟨p, hp⟩ (p.2 + G.installedMorseParam p u)
    (hdom p hp u hu) (hcore p hp u hu)

name: Submission.GenericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas.nonempty_disjointEventCutoffs
statement:
theorem nonempty_disjointEventCutoffs
    (G : GenericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas B)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn
      (fun p : Σ _ : ι, E₂ => (B.chart p.1).param p.2)
      (G.criticalPoints : Set (Σ _ : ι, E₂)))
    (hinterior : ∀ p (_hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints),
      1 / 4 < tcoord ((B.chart p.1).param p.2) ∧
        tcoord ((B.chart p.1).param p.2) < 3 / 4) :
    Nonempty (FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs G.eventAmbientPoint)
proof:
:= by
  apply FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs.exists_of_injective_interior
  · intro p q hpq
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hinj p.2 q.2 hpq
  · intro p
    exact hinterior p.1 p.2

name: Submission.enumeratedEquivOfListEq_value
statement:
private theorem enumeratedEquivOfListEq_value
    {alpha beta gamma : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta]
    (f : alpha → gamma) (g : beta → gamma)
    (h : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card alpha) =>
      f ((Fintype.equivFin alpha).symm i)) =
      (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card beta) =>
      g ((Fintype.equivFin beta).symm i)))
    (a : alpha) :
    f a = g (enumeratedEquivOfListEq f g h a)
proof:
:= by
  let p := Fintype.card alpha
  let q := Fintype.card beta
  let F : Fin p → gamma := fun i => f ((Fintype.equivFin alpha).symm i)
  let G : Fin q → gamma := fun i => g ((Fintype.equivFin beta).symm i)
  have hpq : p = q := by
    simpa [p, q, F, G] using congrArg List.length h
  have hsigma : (⟨p, F⟩ : Σ n, Fin n → gamma) = ⟨q, G⟩ := by
    apply List.ofFn_inj'.mp
    simpa [p, q, F, G] using h
  obtain ⟨hpq', hfun'⟩ := Fin.sigma_eq_iff_eq_comp_cast.mp hsigma
  have hproof : hpq = hpq' := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  have hfun : F = G ∘ finCongr hpq := by
    rw [hproof]
    exact hfun'
  have ha := congrFun hfun (Fintype.equivFin alpha a)
  simpa [enumeratedEquivOfListEq, p, q, F, G] using ha

name: Submission.TamedField.selectedOrbitEquivOfFrameLedgerEq_frameClass

    (fun O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A => V.orbitFrameClass O.1)
    (fun O : W.SelectedOrbitIndex B => W.orbitFrameClass O.1)

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.orbitEquiv_frameClass
statement:
theorem orbitEquiv_frameClass (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv V W S T)
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    V.orbitFrameClass O = W.orbitFrameClass (M.orbitEquiv O)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ :=
    (ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.selectedSumEquiv S V).surjective O
  cases Q with
  | inl P =>
      rw [M.orbitEquiv_selectedSumEquiv_inl P]
      simpa [
        ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.selectedSumEquiv,
        ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.positiveSelectedEquiv,
        ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.negativeSelectedEquiv]
        using M.positive_frameClass P
  | inr P =>
      rw [M.orbitEquiv_selectedSumEquiv_inr P]
      simpa [
        ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.selectedSumEquiv,
        ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.positiveSelectedEquiv,
        ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.negativeSelectedEquiv]

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.not_mem_positiveOrbitCollection_of_mem_neg
statement:
private theorem not_mem_positiveOrbitCollection_of_mem_neg
    (S : FiberSign X) (V : TamedField X) (O : V.OrbitIndex)
    (hneg : (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∈
      S.neg.positiveOrbitCollection V) :
    (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∉
      S.positiveOrbitCollection V
proof:
:= by
  rw [S.neg.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff V O, FiberSign.neg_apply] at hneg
  rw [S.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff V O]
  linarith

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.orbitEquiv_positive_iff
statement:
theorem orbitEquiv_positive_iff
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv V W S T) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∈
        S.positiveOrbitCollection V ↔
      ((M.orbitEquiv O : W.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∈
          T.positiveOrbitCollection W
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, rfl⟩ :=
    (ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.selectedSumEquiv S V).surjective O
  cases Q with
  | inl P =>
      rw [M.orbitEquiv_selectedSumEquiv_inl P]
      constructor
      · intro _
        simpa [
          ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.selectedSumEquiv,
          ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.positiveSelectedEquiv,
          ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.negativeSelectedEquiv]
          using (M.positiveEquiv P).2
      · intro _
        simpa [
          ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.selectedSumEquiv,
          ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.positiveSelectedEquiv,
          ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.negativeSelectedEquiv]
          using P.2
  | inr P =>
      rw [M.orbitEquiv_selectedSumEquiv_inr P]
      have hsource :
          (P.1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∉
            S.positiveOrbitCollection V :=
        not_mem_positiveOrbitCollection_of_mem_neg S V P.1 P.2
      have htarget :
          ((M.negativeEquiv P).1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∉
            T.positiveOrbitCollection W :=
        not_mem_positiveOrbitCollection_of_mem_neg T W
          (M.negativeEquiv P).1 (M.negativeEquiv P).2
      simpa [
        ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.selectedSumEquiv,
        ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.positiveSelectedEquiv,
        ConcreteConfigurationCanonicalRematching.SignedOrbitCount.negativeSelectedEquiv]
        using iff_of_false hsource htarget

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.orbitEquivOfSignedLedgerEq_positive_iff
statement:
theorem orbitEquivOfSignedLedgerEq_positive_iff
    (hpos : S.positiveFrameLedger V = T.positiveFrameLedger W)

name: Submission.SignedFramedOrbitEquiv.orbitEquivOfSignedLedgerEq_frameClass

    (hn : 0 < n) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.exteriorAmbientLoop_fiber
statement:
theorem exteriorAmbientLoop_fiber
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C t hreg) V) (u : I) :
    C.G (P.exteriorAmbientLoop u) = 0
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.regularZeroFrame_exteriorAmbientLoop

name: Submission.CriticalExteriorFlowCapture.orbitFrameClass_eq
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_eq
    (H : CriticalExteriorFlowCapture C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) :
    Vneg.orbitFrameClass O.1 =
      Vpos.orbitFrameClass (H.orbitEquiv O).1
proof:
:= by
  let Pneg := H.negativeParam O
  let Ppos := H.positiveParam O
  have hcyl := R.loopClassZ2_flowSlice_congr
    (H.coreLoop O) (H.core_mem O) (H.core_fiber O)
    (H.core_closed O) H.safe
  dsimp only at hcyl
  have hnegFrame :
      regularZeroFrame C.smooth (R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) (-ε))
          (fun q => by
            rw [H.negativeFlowSlice_eq O]
            exact Pneg.exteriorAmbientLoop_regular q) =
        Pneg.paramFrameLoop := by
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro q
    apply Subtype.ext
    change regularZeroFrameMatrix C.G
        (R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) (-ε)) q = _
    have hpoint : R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) (-ε) q =
        Pneg.exteriorAmbientLoop q := by
      change R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) (-ε) =
        Pneg.exteriorAmbientLoop q
      exact H.negative_boundary O q
    unfold regularZeroFrameMatrix
    rw [hpoint]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val <|
      congrArg (fun z => z q) Pneg.regularZeroFrame_exteriorAmbientLoop
  have hposFrame :
      regularZeroFrame C.smooth (R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) ε)
          (fun q => by
            rw [H.positiveFlowSlice_eq O]
            exact Ppos.exteriorAmbientLoop_regular q) =
        Ppos.paramFrameLoop := by
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro q
    apply Subtype.ext
    change regularZeroFrameMatrix C.G
        (R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) ε) q = _
    have hpoint : R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) ε q =
        Ppos.exteriorAmbientLoop q := by
      change R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) ε =
        Ppos.exteriorAmbientLoop q
      exact H.positive_boundary O q
    unfold regularZeroFrameMatrix
    rw [hpoint]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val <|
      congrArg (fun z => z q) Ppos.regularZeroFrame_exteriorAmbientLoop
  rw [← H.negative_orbit O, ← H.positive_orbit O,
    Pneg.orbitFrameClass_eq_paramFrameClass,
    Ppos.orbitFrameClass_eq_paramFrameClass]
  have hnegClosed : R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) (-ε) 0 =
      R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) (-ε) 1 := by
    change R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O 0) (-ε) =
      R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O 1) (-ε)
    rw [H.negative_boundary O 0, H.negative_boundary O 1]
    exact Pneg.exteriorAmbientLoop_closed
  have hposClosed : R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) ε 0 =
      R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) ε 1 := by
    change R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O 0) ε =
      R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O 1) ε
    rw [H.positive_boundary O 0, H.positive_boundary O 1]
    exact Ppos.exteriorAmbientLoop_closed
  exact (loopClassZ2_congr_fun Pneg.paramFrameLoop_closed
      (regularZeroFrame_closed C.smooth
        (R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) (-ε)) _ hnegClosed)
      hnegFrame.symm).trans <|
    hcyl.trans <|
      loopClassZ2_congr_fun
        (regularZeroFrame_closed C.smooth
          (R.flowSlice (H.coreLoop O) ε) _ hposClosed)
        Ppos.paramFrameLoop_closed hposFrame

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalMinimumBeforeOrbit_mem_exterior
statement:
theorem chronologicalMinimumBeforeOrbit_mem_exterior
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .minimum)
    (O : (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) :
    (O : Set E₁) ∈ D.chronologicalExteriorOrbitCollection t ht
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxO
  by_contra houtside
  have hxFiber : x ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice t ht).fiber := by
    apply (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit_subset_fiber
      ((D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
    rwa [← (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O]
  have hxzero : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (cobSpaceTime x (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)) = 0 := by
    rw [chronologicalBeforeSlice,
      SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber] at hxFiber
    change D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (cobSpaceTime x (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)) = 0 at hxFiber
    exact hxFiber
  have hxCovered : x ∈ (D.position.eventModel t ht).coveredSliceFiber
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) :=
    ⟨lt_of_not_ge houtside, hxzero⟩
  rw [D.chronologicalMinimumBeforeCoveredSliceFiber_eq_empty
    t ht hindex] at hxCovered
  exact hxCovered

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalMinimumAfterOrbit_mem_exterior_of_ne_local
statement:
theorem chronologicalMinimumAfterOrbit_mem_exterior_of_ne_local
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hpositive : D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .minimum)
    (O : (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).OrbitIndex)
    (hne : (O : Set E₁) ≠
      (((D.chronologicalMinimumLocalOrbit t ht hpositive hindex).1 :
        (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁)) :
    (O : Set E₁) ∈ D.chronologicalExteriorOrbitCollection t ht
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hxO
  by_contra houtside
  have hxFiber : x ∈ (D.chronologicalAfterSlice t ht).fiber := by
    apply (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbit_subset_fiber
      ((D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
    rwa [← (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O]
  have hxzero : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (cobSpaceTime x (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)) = 0 := by
    rw [chronologicalAfterSlice,
      SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber] at hxFiber
    change D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (cobSpaceTime x (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)) = 0 at hxFiber
    exact hxFiber
  have hxCovered : x ∈ (D.position.eventModel t ht).coveredSliceFiber
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) :=
    ⟨lt_of_not_ge houtside, hxzero⟩
  have hxLocal := D.chronologicalMinimumAfterCoveredSliceFiber_subset_orbit
    t ht hindex (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht) hxCovered
  have hxO' : x ∈ (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbit
      ((D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbitPoint O) := by
    rwa [← (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O]
  apply hne
  calc
    (O : Set E₁) = (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbit
        ((D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbitPoint O) :=
      (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O
    _ = (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbit x :=
      ((D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbit_eq_of_mem hxO').symm
    _ = (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbit
        (spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).definiteCircle
          (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0)) :=
      (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbit_eq_of_mem hxLocal
    _ = (((D.chronologicalMinimumLocalOrbit t ht hpositive hindex).1 :
          (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) := by
      change (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbit
          (spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).definiteCircle
            (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0)) =
        (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbit
          (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalParam t ht hindex).p
      apply congrArg ((D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).orbit)
      change spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).definiteCircle
          (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) 0) =
        spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).definiteCircle
          (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
          (2 * Real.pi * (((0 : I) : ℝ))))
      norm_num

name: Submission.EventDeltaComparison.slice_positiveDelta_eq
statement:
theorem slice_positiveDelta_eq
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    {center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C.cobordism center)
    (D : LocalSignedEventModel n)
    (K : EventDeltaComparison C M D) :
    (C.sliceSign K.before K.before_regular).positiveDelta =
      (C.sliceSign K.after K.after_regular).positiveDelta
proof:
:= by
  calc
    (C.sliceSign K.before K.before_regular).positiveDelta =
        D.sourceSign.positiveDelta := K.source_delta
    _ = D.targetSign.positiveDelta := D.delta_eq
    _ = (C.sliceSign K.after K.after_regular).positiveDelta := K.target_delta.symm

      (C.sliceSign E.after E.after_regular).positiveDelta := by
  dsimp
  exact (K t ht).some.slice_positiveDelta_eq C (P.eventModel t ht)
    (P.eventDeltaModel hn t ht)

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.eq_zero_of_ambientCoordinates_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h' : (kernelEquiv C hreg).symm ((implicitData C hreg).rightDeriv x) = 0 := by
    simpa [ambientCoordinates] using h
  have hrd : (implicitData C hreg).rightDeriv x = 0 := by
    have h0 : (kernelEquiv C hreg).symm ((implicitData C hreg).rightDeriv x) =
        (kernelEquiv C hreg).symm 0 := by

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.criticalAmbientParam_contDiffAt_one
statement:
theorem criticalAmbientParam_contDiffAt_one
    {K U : Set E'} {χ : SmoothCutoff K U}
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ R.criticalParameters)
    (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (R.criticalAmbientParam p hp) u
proof:
:= by
  let M := R.localMorseNormalForm p hp
  let P := B.chart p.1
  have huball : u ∈ ball (0 : E₂) (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius := by
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
  have hM : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 M.param u :=
    (R.criticalModelShrink_contDiffOn p hp).contDiffAt
      (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds huball)
  have hshift : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun z : E₂ => p.2 + M.param z) u :=
    (contDiffAt_const (c := p.2)).add hM
  have hchart : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun z : E₂ => P.param (p.2 + M.param z)) u :=
    ContDiffAt.comp u (P.param_smooth.contDiffAt.of_le (by simp)) hshift
  change ContDiffAt ℝ 1
    (fun z : E₂ => R.forward.diffeomorph (P.param (p.2 + M.param z))) u
  exact ContDiffAt.comp u
    (R.forward.diffeomorph.contDiff.contDiffAt.of_le (by simp)) hchart

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.transportedParam_contDiffAt_one
proof:
:= by
  let p := (R.criticalEventOwner e).1
  let hp : p ∈ R.criticalParameters := R.criticalEventOwner_mem e
  have huOwner : ‖u‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius := by
    have hle := (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius_le
    change ‖u‖ < (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius at hu
    change (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius ≤
      (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius at hle
    exact hu.trans_le hle
  have hbase := R.criticalAmbientParam_contDiffAt_one p hp u huOwner
  change ContDiffAt ℝ 1
    (fun z : E₂ => S.forward.diffeomorph (R.criticalAmbientParam p hp z)) u
  exact ContDiffAt.comp u
    (S.forward.diffeomorph.contDiff.contDiffAt.of_le (by simp)) hbase

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_endpointLocalFiberCover
statement:
theorem exists_endpointLocalFiberCover
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} {center : E'}
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (hCD : ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < M.radius → ContDiffAt ℝ 1 M.param u)
    (u₀ : E₂) (hu₀T : ‖u₀‖ < T.radius)
    {r : ℝ} (hu₀r : ‖u₀‖ < r) (hrM : r ≤ M.radius) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ v : E', dist v (M.param u₀) < δ → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧ M.param u = v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hu₀M : ‖u₀‖ < M.radius := hu₀r.trans_le hrM
  have hfib : C.G (M.param u₀) = 0 := M.param_fiber u₀ hu₀M
  
  have hpc : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 M.param u₀ := hCD u₀ hu₀M
  have hPdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ M.param u₀ := hpc.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hstrict : HasStrictFDerivAt M.param (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀) u₀ :=
    hpc.hasStrictFDerivAt (by simp)
  have hgstrict : HasStrictFDerivAt
      (fun u : E₂ => LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
        (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib) (M.param u - M.param u₀))
      ((LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
        (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib)).comp (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀)) u₀ :=
    (LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
      (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib)).hasStrictFDerivAt.comp u₀
      (hstrict.sub_const (M.param u₀))
  
  have hball₀ : ball (0 : E₂) M.radius ∈ 𝓝 u₀ := by
    apply isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu₀M
  have hev : (C.G ∘ M.param) =ᶠ[𝓝 u₀]
      (fun _ : E₂ => (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) := by
    filter_upwards [hball₀] with u hu
    exact M.param_fiber u (by simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu)
  have hGdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ C.G (M.param u₀) :=
    (C.smooth.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
  have hcompzero : (fderiv ℝ C.G (M.param u₀)).comp (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀) = 0 := by
    have hcomp := fderiv_comp u₀ hGdiff hPdiff
    have hzero : fderiv ℝ (C.G ∘ M.param) u₀ = 0 :=
      (Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ) hev).trans (by simp)
    rw [← hcomp]
    exact hzero
  have hkermem : ∀ w : E₂,
      (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀) w ∈ (fderiv ℝ C.G (M.param u₀)).ker := by
    intro w
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    have happ : ((fderiv ℝ C.G (M.param u₀)).comp (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀)) w =
        (0 : E₂ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) w := by
      rw [hcompzero]
    simpa using happ
  
  have hdginj : Function.Injective
      ((LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
        (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib)).comp (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀)) := by
    intro w w' hww'
    have hz : ((LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
        (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib)).comp (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀)) (w - w') = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, hww', sub_self]
    have hx0 : (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀) (w - w') = 0 := by
      apply LocalIFTSurfaceChart.eq_zero_of_ambientCoordinates_eq_zero C
        (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib) (hkermem (w - w'))
      simpa using hz
    have hinj0 : (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀) (w - w') = (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀) 0 := by
      rw [hx0, map_zero]
    have hww0 : w - w' = 0 := T.fderiv_param_injective u₀ hu₀T hinj0
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp hww0
  have hrange : ((LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
      (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib)).comp (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀)).range = ⊤ := by
    rw [LinearMap.range_eq_top]
    have hinjL : Function.Injective
        ((LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
          (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ M.param u₀)).toLinearMap := hdginj
    exact LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinjL
  
  have hmap : Filter.map
      (fun u : E₂ => LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
        (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib) (M.param u - M.param u₀)) (𝓝 u₀) =
      𝓝 ((fun u : E₂ => LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
        (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib) (M.param u - M.param u₀)) u₀) :=
    hgstrict.map_nhds_eq_of_surj hrange
  
  have hcontP : ContinuousAt M.param u₀ := hPdiff.continuousAt
  have hopenA := LocalIFTSurfaceChart.isOpen_localAmbient C hfib
  have hmemA := LocalIFTSurfaceChart.center_mem_localAmbient C hfib
  have hpre : M.param ⁻¹' LocalIFTSurfaceChart.localAmbient C hfib ∈ 𝓝 u₀ :=
    hcontP.preimage_mem_nhds (hopenA.mem_nhds hmemA)
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁pos, hs₁sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hpre
  have hspos : 0 < min s₁ (r - ‖u₀‖) := lt_min hs₁pos (by linarith)
  have hVnhds : ball u₀ (min s₁ (r - ‖u₀‖)) ∈ 𝓝 u₀ :=
    Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hspos
  have himg : (fun u : E₂ => LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
      (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib) (M.param u - M.param u₀)) ''
        ball u₀ (min s₁ (r - ‖u₀‖)) ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E₂) := by
    have h0 : (fun u : E₂ => LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
        (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib) (M.param u - M.param u₀)) u₀ = 0 := by
      simp
    rw [← h0, ← hmap]
    exact Filter.image_mem_map hVnhds
  
  have hpre2 : (fun x : E' => LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
      (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib) (x - M.param u₀)) ⁻¹'
        ((fun u : E₂ => LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
          (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib) (M.param u - M.param u₀)) ''
            ball u₀ (min s₁ (r - ‖u₀‖))) ∈ 𝓝 (M.param u₀) := by
    apply ContinuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
    · exact ((LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
        (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib)).continuous.comp
          (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)).continuousAt
    · simpa using himg
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁pos, hδ₁sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hpre2
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂pos, hδ₂sub⟩ :=
    Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp (hopenA.mem_nhds hmemA)
  refine ⟨min δ₁ δ₂, lt_min hδ₁pos hδ₂pos, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hGv
  have hvA : v ∈ LocalIFTSurfaceChart.localAmbient C hfib :=
    hδ₂sub (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (hv.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)))
  have hvw := hδ₁sub (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (hv.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)))
  obtain ⟨u, huV, hgu⟩ := hvw
  have hd : dist u u₀ < min s₁ (r - ‖u₀‖) := Metric.mem_ball.mp huV
  have hur : ‖u‖ < r := by
    have hnn := norm_sub_norm_le u u₀
    rw [dist_eq_norm] at hd
    have hd' : ‖u - u₀‖ < r - ‖u₀‖ := hd.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
    linarith
  have huM : ‖u‖ < M.radius := hur.trans_le hrM
  have huA : M.param u ∈ LocalIFTSurfaceChart.localAmbient C hfib :=
    hs₁sub (Metric.mem_ball.mpr (hd.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)))
  refine ⟨u, hur, ?_⟩
  have h1 := LocalIFTSurfaceChart.rawParam_ambientCoordinates_eq C hfib
    (M.param_fiber u huM) huA
  have h2 := LocalIFTSurfaceChart.rawParam_ambientCoordinates_eq C hfib hGv hvA
  have hgu' : LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
      (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib) (M.param u - M.param u₀) =
        LocalIFTSurfaceChart.ambientCoordinates C
          (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib) (v - M.param u₀) := hgu
  exact h1.symm.trans
    ((congrArg (LocalIFTSurfaceChart.rawParam C
      (C.regular (M.param u₀) hfib)) hgu').trans h2)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.eventModel_param_contDiffAt_one
statement:
theorem eventModel_param_contDiffAt_one
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  let S := D.second.toCriticalValueShiftData
  let e := D.chronologicalGlobalEvent t ht
  have hparam : (D.position.eventModel t ht).param = S.transportedParam e := by
    rw [D.eventModel_eq_transportedStandardMorseEvent t ht]
    simpa [S, e,
      FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.transportedStandardMorseEvent] using
      StandardMorseEventAt.castCenter_param
      (D.second.shiftedCenter_chronologicalGlobalEvent t ht)
      (D.second.toCriticalValueShiftData.transportedStandardMorseEvent
        (D.chronologicalGlobalEvent t ht))
  have hradius : (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius =
      (S.productionEvent e).radius := by
    rw [D.eventModel_eq_transportedStandardMorseEvent t ht]
    simpa [S, e,
      FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.transportedStandardMorseEvent] using
      StandardMorseEventAt.castCenter_radius
      (D.second.shiftedCenter_chronologicalGlobalEvent t ht)
      (D.second.toCriticalValueShiftData.transportedStandardMorseEvent
        (D.chronologicalGlobalEvent t ht))
  have hu' : ‖u‖ < (S.productionEvent e).radius := hradius ▸ hu
  have h := S.transportedParam_contDiffAt_one e u hu'
  rw [hparam]
  exact h

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalCover
statement:
theorem exists_chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalCover
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ v : E',
      dist v ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) < δ →
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : E₂,
        ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht ∧
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u = v
proof:
:= by
  have h := StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_endpointLocalFiberCover
    (T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
    (D.eventModel_param_contDiffAt_one t ht)
    (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    (by
      rw [D.norm_chronologicalSaddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam t ht p]
      exact D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
    (r := D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
    (by
      rw [D.norm_chronologicalSaddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam t ht p]
      exact D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_endpointParamRadius t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_le_eventRadius t ht)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hcov⟩ := h
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hGv
  apply hcov v ?_ hGv
  simpa [saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
    StandardMorseEventAt.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd,
    StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
    StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint] using hv

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleTopologyDichotomy_of_pairing_and_arcRecovery

theorem chronologicalSaddleTopologyDichotomy_of_pairing_and_arcRecovery

name: Submission.chartGradient_apply
statement:
theorem chartGradient_apply (f : E₂ → ℝ) (x : E₂) (i : Fin 2) :
    chartGradient f x i =
      fderiv ℝ f x (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  let A : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := fderiv ℝ f x
  have h := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left A
    (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) (1 : ℝ)
  simpa [chartGradient, scalarAdjointCLM, A,
    EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right] using h

name: Submission.fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero {f : E₂ → ℝ} {p : E₂}
    (hgrad : chartGradient f p = 0) : fderiv ℝ f p = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := fderiv ℝ f p
  have hA1 : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A 1 = 0 := by
    simpa [chartGradient, scalarAdjointCLM, A] using hgrad
  have hAadj : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A = 0 := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro r
    calc
      ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A r = r • ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A 1 := by
        rw [← map_smul]
        simp
      _ = 0 := by rw [hA1, smul_zero]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  have hinner := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left A v (1 : ℝ)
  rw [hAadj] at hinner
  simpa [A] using hinner.symm

name: Submission.fderiv_recenter_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fderiv_recenter_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero
    {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) {p : E₂}
    (hgrad : chartGradient f p = 0) :
    fderiv ℝ (recenter f p) 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [fderiv_recenter_zero (hf.differentiable (by simp) p)]
  exact fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero hgrad

name: Submission.fderiv_chartGradient_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_chartGradient_apply {f : E₂ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (x v : E₂) (i : Fin 2) :
    fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) x v i =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x ![v, EuclideanSpace.single i 1]
proof:
:= by
  let ei : E₂ := EuclideanSpace.single i 1
  let proj : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj i
  have hleft : fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartGradient f y i) x v =
      fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) x v i := by
    have hg : HasFDerivAt (chartGradient f)
        (fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) x) x :=
      ((contDiff_chartGradient hf).differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
    have hp := proj.hasFDerivAt.comp x hg
    have happ := congrArg (fun A : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => A v) hp.fderiv
    change fderiv ℝ (proj ∘ chartGradient f) x v = _ at happ
    change fderiv ℝ (proj ∘ chartGradient f) x v = _
    simpa [proj] using happ
  have hright : fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y ei) x v =
      fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x v ei := by
    have hcSmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ f) :=
      hf.fderiv_right (by simp)
    have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x :=
      hcSmooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero x
    have hu : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun _ : E₂ => ei) x :=
      differentiableAt_const ei
    have happ := congrArg (fun A : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => A v)
      (fderiv_clm_apply hc hu)
    simpa [ei] using happ
  calc
    fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) x v i =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => chartGradient f y i) x v := hleft.symm
    _ = fderiv ℝ (fun y => fderiv ℝ f y ei) x v := by
      congr 2
      funext y
      exact chartGradient_apply f y i
    _ = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) x v ei := hright
    _ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x ![v, ei] := by
      simp [iteratedFDeriv_two_apply]
    _ = iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f x ![v, EuclideanSpace.single i 1] := rfl

name: Submission.fderiv_recenter_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_recenter_apply {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (p x : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (recenter f p) x = fderiv ℝ f (p + x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E₂ => f (p + y))
      (fderiv ℝ f (p + x)) x := by
    have hcomp := (hf (p + x)).hasFDerivAt.comp x
      ((hasFDerivAt_id x).const_add p)
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hcomp
  exact h.fderiv

name: Submission.chartGradient_recenter
statement:
theorem chartGradient_recenter {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (p x : E₂) :
    chartGradient (recenter f p) x = chartGradient f (p + x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartGradient, chartGradient, fderiv_recenter_apply hf]

name: Submission.fderiv_chartGradient_recenter
statement:
theorem fderiv_chartGradient_recenter {f : E₂ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (p x : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (chartGradient (recenter f p)) x =
      fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) (p + x)
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : chartGradient (recenter f p) =
      fun y : E₂ => chartGradient f (p + y) := by
    funext y
    exact chartGradient_recenter (hf.differentiable (by simp)) p y
  rw [hfun]
  have h : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E₂ => chartGradient f (p + y))
      (fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) (p + x)) x := by
    have hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ (chartGradient f) (p + x) :=
      (contDiff_chartGradient hf).differentiable (by simp) _
    have hcomp := hd.hasFDerivAt.comp x ((hasFDerivAt_id x).const_add p)
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hcomp
  exact h.fderiv

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.integral_one_sub_zero_one
statement:
private lemma integral_one_sub_zero_one :
    (∫ t : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..1, 1 - t) = (1 / 2 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  change (∫ t : ℝ in (0 : ℝ)..1, (fun _ : ℝ => 1) t - id t) = (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_sub
    (continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 1)
    (continuous_id.intervalIntegrable 0 1), integral_one]
  simp only [id_eq]
  rw [integral_id]
  norm_num

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.integratedHadamardA_zero
statement:
lemma integratedHadamardA_zero (f : E₂ → ℝ) :
    integratedHadamardA f 0 =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0 ![e₀, e₀]
proof:
:= by
  simp [integratedHadamardA, integral_one_sub_zero_one]

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.integratedHadamardB_zero
statement:
lemma integratedHadamardB_zero (f : E₂ → ℝ) :
    integratedHadamardB f 0 =
      (1 / 4 : ℝ) *
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0 ![e₀, e₁] +
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0 ![e₁, e₀])
proof:
:= by
  simp [integratedHadamardB, integral_one_sub_zero_one]
  ring

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.integratedHadamardC_zero
statement:
lemma integratedHadamardC_zero (f : E₂ → ℝ) :
    integratedHadamardC f 0 =
      (1 / 2 : ℝ) * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0 ![e₁, e₁]
proof:
:= by
  simp [integratedHadamardC, integral_one_sub_zero_one]

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.fderiv_chartGradient_apply_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_chartGradient_apply_zero {f : E₂ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (v : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) 0 v 0 =
      2 * integratedHadamardA f 0 * v 0 +
        2 * integratedHadamardB f 0 * v 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [fderiv_chartGradient_apply hf]
  have htwo : (2 : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞ := by
    change ((2 : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω)
    exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (le_of_lt (ENat.coe_lt_top 2))
  have hsym : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0 ![e₀, e₁] =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0 ![e₁, e₀] :=
    (hf.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt
      (by simpa using htwo)).iteratedFDeriv_cons
  let H := iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0
  have hexpand : H ![v, e₀] =
      v 0 * H ![e₀, e₀] + v 1 * H ![e₁, e₀] := by
    change H.curryLeft v (Fin.cons e₀ Fin.elim0) =
      v 0 * H.curryLeft e₀ (Fin.cons e₀ Fin.elim0) +
        v 1 * H.curryLeft e₁ (Fin.cons e₀ Fin.elim0)
    rw [basis_decomposition v, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
    simp [smul_eq_mul]
  change H ![v, e₀] = _
  rw [hexpand]
  rw [integratedHadamardA_zero, integratedHadamardB_zero, hsym]
  ring

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.fderiv_chartGradient_apply_one
statement:
lemma fderiv_chartGradient_apply_one {f : E₂ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (v : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) 0 v 1 =
      2 * integratedHadamardB f 0 * v 0 +
        2 * integratedHadamardC f 0 * v 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [fderiv_chartGradient_apply hf]
  have htwo : (2 : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞ := by
    change ((2 : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω)
    exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (le_of_lt (ENat.coe_lt_top 2))
  have hsym : iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0 ![e₀, e₁] =
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0 ![e₁, e₀] :=
    (hf.contDiffAt.isSymmSndFDerivAt
      (by simpa using htwo)).iteratedFDeriv_cons
  let H := iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0
  have hexpand : H ![v, e₁] =
      v 0 * H ![e₀, e₁] + v 1 * H ![e₁, e₁] := by
    change H.curryLeft v (Fin.cons e₁ Fin.elim0) =
      v 0 * H.curryLeft e₀ (Fin.cons e₁ Fin.elim0) +
        v 1 * H.curryLeft e₁ (Fin.cons e₁ Fin.elim0)
    rw [basis_decomposition v, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]
    simp [smul_eq_mul]
  change H ![v, e₁] = _
  rw [hexpand]
  rw [integratedHadamardB_zero, integratedHadamardC_zero, hsym]
  ring

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.fderiv_chartGradient_zero_expand
statement:
lemma fderiv_chartGradient_zero_expand {f : E₂ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (v : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) 0 v =
      (2 * integratedHadamardA f 0 * v 0 +
          2 * integratedHadamardB f 0 * v 1) • e₀ +
        (2 * integratedHadamardB f 0 * v 0 +
          2 * integratedHadamardC f 0 * v 1) • e₁
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [basis_decomposition (fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) 0 v)]
  rw [fderiv_chartGradient_apply_zero hf, fderiv_chartGradient_apply_one hf]

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.integratedHadamardDet_ne_zero_of_injective
statement:
theorem integratedHadamardDet_ne_zero_of_injective {f : E₂ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hinj : Injective (fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) 0)) :
    integratedHadamardDet f ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hdet
  have hdet' : integratedHadamardA f 0 * integratedHadamardC f 0 -
      integratedHadamardB f 0 ^ 2 = 0 := hdet
  by_cases hA : integratedHadamardA f 0 = 0
  · 
    
    have hb2 : integratedHadamardB f 0 ^ 2 = 0 := by
      linear_combination integratedHadamardC f 0 * hA - hdet'
    have hb0 : integratedHadamardB f 0 = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hb2
    have hker : fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) 0 e₀ = 0 := by
      rw [fderiv_chartGradient_zero_expand hf]
      simp [hA, hb0]
    have he : (e₀ : E₂) = 0 := hinj (hker.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    have h := congrArg (fun w : E₂ => w 0) he
    simp at h
  · 
    set w : E₂ := integratedHadamardB f 0 • e₀ +
        (-integratedHadamardA f 0) • e₁ with hw
    have hw0 : w 0 = integratedHadamardB f 0 := by simp [hw]
    have hw1 : w 1 = -integratedHadamardA f 0 := by simp [hw]
    have hker : fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) 0 w = 0 := by
      rw [fderiv_chartGradient_zero_expand hf, hw0, hw1]
      have h1 : 2 * integratedHadamardA f 0 * integratedHadamardB f 0 +
          2 * integratedHadamardB f 0 * -integratedHadamardA f 0 = 0 := by
        ring
      have h2 : 2 * integratedHadamardB f 0 * integratedHadamardB f 0 +
          2 * integratedHadamardC f 0 * -integratedHadamardA f 0 = 0 := by
        linear_combination (-2 : ℝ) * hdet'
      rw [h1, h2]
      simp
    have hwz : w = 0 := hinj (hker.trans (map_zero _).symm)
    rw [hwz] at hw1
    simp at hw1
    exact hA hw1

name: Submission.spatialKerToAmbientKer_injective
statement:
theorem spatialKerToAmbientKer_injective
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) (v : E')
    (hv : v ∈ timeCritical C.G) :
    Function.Injective (spatialKerToAmbientKer C v hv)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  apply Subtype.ext
  have h := congrArg (spacePart (n := n)) (congrArg Subtype.val hxy)
  simpa [spatialKerToAmbientKer, spaceInclL_apply] using h

name: Submission.spatialKerToAmbientKer_surjective
statement:
theorem spatialKerToAmbientKer_surjective
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) (v : E')
    (hv : v ∈ timeCritical C.G) :
    Function.Surjective (spatialKerToAmbientKer C v hv)
proof:
:= by
  have hregular : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ C.G v) :=
    C.regular v hv.1
  have htime : ∀ w : E', fderiv ℝ C.G v w = 0 → tcoord w = 0 :=
    (mem_timeCritical_iff_tcoord_eq_zero_on_ker hv.1 hregular).mp hv
  intro w
  have hwzero : fderiv ℝ C.G v w.1 = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.mp w.2
  have hwtime : tcoord w.1 = 0 := htime w.1 hwzero
  let x : LinearMap.ker ((spatialDeriv C.G v).toLinearMap) :=
    ⟨spacePart w.1, by
      rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
      change spatialDeriv C.G v (spacePart w.1) = 0
      rw [spatialDeriv_apply, spaceInclL_spacePart hwtime]
      exact hwzero⟩
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact spaceInclL_spacePart hwtime

        (LinearMap.range ((spatialDeriv C.G v).toLinearMap)) = n - 1

name: Submission.one_le_of_mem_timeCritical
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hn

name: Submission.finrank_orthogonal_range_spatialDeriv_of_mem_timeCritical
statement:
theorem finrank_orthogonal_range_spatialDeriv_of_mem_timeCritical
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {v : E'}
    (hv : v ∈ timeCritical C.G) :
    Module.finrank ℝ
        (LinearMap.range ((spatialDeriv C.G v).toLinearMap))ᗮ = 1
proof:
:= by
  let K := LinearMap.range ((spatialDeriv C.G v).toLinearMap)
  have hsum := K.finrank_add_finrank_orthogonal
  have hrange : Module.finrank ℝ K = n - 1 :=
    finrank_range_spatialDeriv_of_mem_timeCritical C hv
  have hn : 1 ≤ n := one_le_of_mem_timeCritical C hv
  rw [hrange, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin] at hsum
  have horth : Module.finrank ℝ Kᗮ = 1 := by omega
  simpa [K] using horth

      (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.fiber

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.gaugeEndpoint_fiber
statement:
theorem gaugeEndpoint_fiber
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch) :
    (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.fiber =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion (targetField m Y) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  let D := discrepancyHomotopy hm M F
  calc
    D.toCobordism.X₁.fiber = {x | D.H 1 x = 0} := by
      rw [D.H_one]
      rfl
    _ = (matchedPlacedX hm M).fiber :=
      D.fiber_eq 1 zero_le_one le_rfl
    _ = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion (targetField m Y) (by omega) :=
      matchedPlacedX_fiber hm M

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.matchedPlacedSign_pos_iff_targetPlacement
statement:
theorem matchedPlacedSign_pos_iff_targetPlacement
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))}
    (hx : x ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.target (targetField m Y) (by omega) P) :
    0 < matchedPlacedSign hm M x ↔ 0 < placedSign hm Y T x
proof:
:= by
  let O : (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
      TamedField B.fls).OrbitIndex := M.orbitEquiv.symm P
  have hMO : M.orbitEquiv O = P := by simp [O]
  have hxImage : x ∈ (M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 ''
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
        (by omega) O := by
    rw [M.matchingAmbient_target hm O, hMO]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hxImage
  calc
    0 < matchedPlacedSign hm M ((M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 y) ↔
        0 < (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpointSign B.fiberSign y := by
      rw [matchedPlacedSign, SmoothAmbientIsotopy.pullbackSign_apply,
        (M.matchingAmbient hm).left_inv 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩]
    _ ↔ (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))) ∈
        B.fiberSign.positiveOrbitCollection
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls) :=
      (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpointSign_pos_iff_of_mem_target
        B.fiberSign O hy
    _ ↔ (P : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))) ∈
        T.positiveOrbitCollection (targetField m Y) := by
      have h := M.orbitEquiv_positive_iff O
      rw [hMO] at h
      exact h
    _ ↔ 0 < placedSign hm Y T ((M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 y) := by
      apply ((targetPlacement hm Y).endpointSign_pos_iff_of_mem_target
        T P ?_).symm
      have htarget : (M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 y ∈
          CanonicalRoundOrbit.target
            (targetField m Y) (by omega) (M.orbitEquiv O) := by
        rw [← M.matchingAmbient_target hm O]
        exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      rw [hMO] at htarget
      exact htarget

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.gaugeEndpointSign_pos_iff_targetPlacement
statement:
theorem gaugeEndpointSign_pos_iff_targetPlacement
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv

      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))}
    (hx : x ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.target (targetField m Y) (by omega) P) :
    0 < gaugeEndpointSign hm M F x ↔ 0 < placedSign hm Y T x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [gaugeEndpointSign] using
    matchedPlacedSign_pos_iff_targetPlacement (B := B) hm M P hx

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.harmonized_mul_pos_on_fiber
statement:
theorem harmonized_mul_pos_on_fiber
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m)) :
    ∀ x ∈ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber,
      0 < harmonizedSign hm M F G x * placedSign hm Y T x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hxP : x ∈ (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.fiber := by
    rw [placed_fiber_eq_harmonized_fiber hm M F G]
    exact hx
  have hxU := hxP
  rw [(targetPlacement hm Y).endpoint_fiber] at hxU
  obtain ⟨P, hxPmem⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hxU
  have hiff : 0 < gaugeEndpointSign hm M F x ↔ 0 < placedSign hm Y T x :=
    gaugeEndpointSign_pos_iff_targetPlacement (B := B) hm M F P hxPmem
  have hSne : harmonizedSign hm M F G x ≠ 0 :=
    (harmonizedSign hm M F G).nonzero x hx
  have hTne : placedSign hm Y T x ≠ 0 := (placedSign hm Y T).nonzero x hxP
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hSne with hSneg | hSpos
  · have hTnpos : ¬0 < placedSign hm Y T x := by
      intro hTpos
      have hpos : 0 < gaugeEndpointSign hm M F x := hiff.mpr hTpos
      rw [← harmonizedSign_apply hm M F G] at hpos
      linarith
    have hTneg : placedSign hm Y T x < 0 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hTnpos) hTne
    exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hSneg hTneg
  · have hTpos : 0 < placedSign hm Y T x := by
      apply hiff.mp
      rw [← harmonizedSign_apply hm M F G]
      exact hSpos
    exact mul_pos hSpos hTpos

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.nonempty_toTarget_of_gaugePathJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toTarget_of_gaugePathJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (Q : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) => Q p.1 p.2))
    (hQzero : ∀ x, Q 0 x =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (hQbij : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x, Function.Bijective (Q s x))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • Q 1 x ((harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x) +
          r • (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ p ∈ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber,
      fderiv ℝ (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g p =
        (Q 1 p).comp (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g p)) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F) T)
proof:
:= by
  refine SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
    ⟨(legOne hm M F G).signedCobordism (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)⟩
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
      (SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.nonempty_signedCobordism_of_gaugePathJet
        (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G)
        (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX
        (harmonizedSign hm M F G)
        (placedSign hm Y T)
        Q hQ hQzero hQbij
        (placed_fiber_eq_harmonized_fiber hm M F G)
        R eps eps_pos outer
        (harmonized_mul_pos_on_fiber hm M F G)
        hjet)
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_symm
        ⟨(targetPlacement hm Y).signedCobordism T⟩))

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.nonempty_toTarget_of_canonicalLoopPathJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toTarget_of_canonicalLoopPathJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (L₀ : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex → SmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (D₀ : ∀ P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex, (L₀ P).NullGaugeData)
    (A : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) => A p.1 p.2))
    (hAzero : ∀ x, A 0 x =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (hAbij : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x, Function.Bijective (A s x))
    (RA : ℝ)
    (hAout : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), RA ≤ ‖x‖ →
      A 1 x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
          r • (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          ((L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          ((A 1 (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
              (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
                (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)))) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F) T)
proof:
:= by
  have hsmoothSO : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) =>
        SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
            (targetField m Y) L₀ D₀ p.1 p.2)) :=
    SOFrameGauge.contDiff_toCLM
      (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge_smooth
        (targetField m Y) L₀ D₀)
  refine nonempty_toTarget_of_gaugePathJet hm M F G
    (fun s x => (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
      (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
        (targetField m Y) L₀ D₀ s x)).comp (A s x))
    (hsmoothSO.clm_comp hA) ?_ ?_
    (max R (max (CanonicalRotationField.outerRadius (targetField m Y)) RA))
    eps eps_pos ?_ ?_
  · intro x
    rw [SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge_zero,
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one, hAzero x]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.id_comp _
  · intro s hs x
    have hcoe : ⇑((SOFrameGauge.toCLM
        (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
          (targetField m Y) L₀ D₀ s x)).comp (A s x)) =
        ⇑(SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
            (targetField m Y) L₀ D₀ s x)) ∘ ⇑(A s x) := rfl
    rw [hcoe]
    exact (SOFrameGauge.toCLM_bijective _).comp (hAbij s hs x)
  · refine SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.outer_of_gauge_eq_id_outside
      (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G)
      (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX
      (fun x => (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
        (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
          (targetField m Y) L₀ D₀ 1 x)).comp (A 1 x))
      R (max (CanonicalRotationField.outerRadius (targetField m Y)) RA)
      eps ?_ outer
    intro x hx
    rw [CanonicalRotationField.spatialGauge_eq_one_of_outerRadius_le
        (targetField m Y) L₀ D₀ 1
        (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx),
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one,
      hAout x (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hx)]
    exact ContinuousLinearMap.id_comp _
  · intro p hp
    have hp' : p ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion
        (targetField m Y) (by omega) := by
      rw [← harmonized_fiber_eq_targetUnion hm M F G]
      exact hp
    obtain ⟨P, theta, rfl⟩ :=
      CanonicalRotationField.exists_canonicalPoint_of_mem_targetUnion
        (targetField m Y) (by omega) hp'
    rw [CanonicalRotationField.spatialGauge_one_point
      (targetField m Y) L₀ D₀ (by omega) P theta,
      ContinuousLinearMap.comp_assoc]
    exact hjet P theta

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.nonempty_toTarget_of_canonicalLoopPositiveJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toTarget_of_canonicalLoopPositiveJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (L₀ : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex → SmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (D₀ : ∀ P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex, (L₀ P).NullGaugeData)
    (A₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hA₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A₀)
    (hA₀pos : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))
      (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))), v ≠ 0 → 0 < ⟪A₀ x v, v⟫)
    (RA : ℝ)
    (hA₀out : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), RA ≤ ‖x‖ →
      A₀ x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
          r • (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          ((L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          ((A₀ (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
              (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
                (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)))) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F) T)
proof:
:= by
  have hone : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)),
      (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) -
        (1 : ℝ) • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x) = A₀ x := by
    intro x
    rw [one_smul, sub_sub_cancel]
  refine nonempty_toTarget_of_canonicalLoopPathJet hm M F G L₀ D₀
    (fun s x => (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) -
      s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x))
    (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_fst.smul
      (contDiff_const.sub (hA₀.comp contDiff_snd))))
    ?_ ?_ RA ?_ R eps eps_pos outer ?_
  · intro x
    ext v
    simp
  · intro s hs x
    exact PositiveDistortion.bijective_one_sub_smul_of_inner_pos (A₀ x)
      (fun v hv => hA₀pos x v hv) hs.1 hs.2
  · intro x hx
    rw [hone x]
    exact hA₀out x hx
  · intro P theta
    rw [hone]
    exact hjet P theta

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.nonempty_toTarget_of_circlePositiveJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toTarget_of_circlePositiveJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (L : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex → LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (hclass : ∀ P, loopClassZ2 (L P).loop (L P).closed = 0)
    (A₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hA₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A₀)
    (hA₀pos : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))
      (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))), v ≠ 0 → 0 < ⟪A₀ x v, v⟫)
    (RA : ℝ)
    (hA₀out : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), RA ≤ ‖x‖ →
      A₀ x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
          r • (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          ((L P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          ((A₀ (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
              (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
                (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)))) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F) T)
proof:
:= by
  refine nonempty_toTarget_of_canonicalLoopPositiveJet hm M F G
    (fun P => LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.smoothCartesianSOLoopOfClassZero
      (L P) (by omega) (hclass P))
    (fun P => LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.smoothNullGaugeDataOfClassZero
      (L P) (by omega) (hclass P))
    A₀ hA₀ hA₀pos RA hA₀out R eps eps_pos outer ?_
  intro P theta
  rw [CanonicalRotationField.cartesian_smoothCartesianSOLoopOfClassZero
    (L P) (by omega) (hclass P) (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq theta)]
  exact hjet P theta

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.fderiv_harmonizedEndpoint_canonicalPoint
statement:
theorem fderiv_harmonizedEndpoint_canonicalPoint
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) =
      (G.gauge 1 (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
          (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)).comp
        ((SOFrameGauge.toCLM
            ((F.discrepancyLoop P).cartesian
              (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (matchedPlacedX hm M).g
            (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)))
proof:
:= by
  have hmemUnion : CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
      (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta ∈
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion (targetField m Y) (by omega) :=
    Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
      ⟨P, CanonicalRotationField.point_mem_target _ _ P theta⟩
  have hmem₁ : CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
      (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta ∈
      (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.fiber := by
    rw [gaugeEndpoint_fiber hm M F]
    exact hmemUnion
  have hmem₀ : CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
      (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta ∈ (matchedPlacedX hm M).fiber := by
    rw [matchedPlacedX_fiber hm M]
    exact hmemUnion
  have h₁ := SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.fderiv_gaugeTransform_eq
    (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁
    (G.gauge 1)
    (contDiff_gauge_slice G.gauge_smooth 1)
    (fun x => G.gauge_bijective 1 x)
    hmem₁
  have h₂ := SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.fderiv_gaugeTransform_eq
    (matchedPlacedX hm M)
    (fun x => SOFrameGauge.toCLM
      (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
        (targetField m Y)
        (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm) (F.smoothNullGauge hm) 1 x))
    (SOFrameGauge.contDiff_toCLM (fun i j =>
      ((SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge_smooth
        (targetField m Y)
        (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm) (F.smoothNullGauge hm) i j)).comp
        (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)))
    (fun x => SOFrameGauge.toCLM_bijective _)
    hmem₀
  have hloop : (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm P).cartesian
      (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta) =
      (F.discrepancyLoop P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta) :=
    (F.nullGauge hm P).endpoint_circle _ (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq theta)
  have h₁' : fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) =
      (G.gauge 1 (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
          (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
            (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)) := h₁
  have h₂' : fderiv ℝ (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) =
      (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
            (targetField m Y)
            (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm) (F.smoothNullGauge hm) 1
            (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta))).comp
        (fderiv ℝ (matchedPlacedX hm M).g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
            (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)) := h₂
  rw [h₁', h₂', CanonicalRotationField.spatialGauge_one_point
    (targetField m Y)
    (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm) (F.smoothNullGauge hm)
    (by omega) P theta, hloop]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.StandardEntryDatum.nonempty_toStandardTarget
statement:
theorem nonempty_toStandardTarget (D : StandardEntryDatum I hm B) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm (standardMatch I hm B)
        (standardFrameMatch I hm B))
      (standardTarget hm B).sign)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_toTarget_of_circlePositiveJet hm (standardMatch I hm B)
    (standardFrameMatch I hm B) (canonicalGaugeData B)
    (fun P => (standardFrameMatch I hm B).discrepancyLoop P)
    (fun P => discrepancyLoop_null (standardMatch I hm B)
      (standardFrameMatch I hm B) P)
    D.A D.A_smooth D.A_positive D.A_radius D.A_eq_id_outside
    D.R D.eps D.eps_pos D.outer D.jet

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.StandardEntryDatum.nonempty_entry
statement:
theorem nonempty_entry (D : StandardEntryDatum I hm B) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism B.fiberSign
      (standardTarget hm B).sign)
proof:
:=
  SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
    (nonempty_toGaugeEndpoint hm (standardMatch I hm B)
      (standardFrameMatch I hm B))
    D.nonempty_toStandardTarget

statement:
theorem entrySupply_of_standardEntryData
    (I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant (m + 2)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (D : ∀ {z : StableSpherePi (m + 2)} (B : BridgeData (m + 2) z),
      StandardEntryDatum I hm B) :

name: Submission.BridgeEntryStandardTarget.pi_succ_sphere_n_mulEquiv_zmod_two_of_standardEntryData
statement:
theorem pi_succ_sphere_n_mulEquiv_zmod_two_of_standardEntryData
    (I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant (m + 2)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (D : ∀ {z : StableSpherePi (m + 2)} (B : BridgeData (m + 2) z),
      StandardEntryDatum I hm B)
    (x : UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2 + 1)))) :
    Nonempty
      (HomotopyGroup.Pi (m + 2 + 1)
          (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2 + 1))) 1) x ≃*
        Multiplicative (ZMod 2))

name: Submission.homotopic_of_square
statement:
theorem homotopic_of_square {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (F : C(I × I, Y)) {a₀ a₁ b₀ b₁ : Y}
    (top : Path a₀ a₁) (bottom : Path b₀ b₁)
    (left : Path a₀ b₀) (right : Path a₁ b₁)
    (htop : ∀ u : I, F (0, u) = top u)
    (hbottom : ∀ u : I, F (1, u) = bottom u)
    (hleft : ∀ s : I, F (s, 0) = left s)
    (hright : ∀ s : I, F (s, 1) = right s) :
    bottom.Homotopic ((left.symm.trans top).trans right)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : ContractibleSpace I :=
    (convex_Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).contractibleSpace (Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr zero_le_one)
  have ha₀ : F (0, 0) = a₀ := (htop 0).trans top.source
  have ha₁ : F (0, 1) = a₁ := (htop 1).trans top.target
  have hb₀ : F (1, 0) = b₀ := (hbottom 0).trans bottom.source
  have hb₁ : F (1, 1) = b₁ := (hbottom 1).trans bottom.target
  subst ha₀ ha₁ hb₀ hb₁
  let eTop : Path ((0, 0) : I × I) ((0, 1) : I × I) :=
    { toContinuousMap := ⟨fun u => (0, u), by fun_prop⟩
      source' := rfl
      target' := rfl }
  let eBottom : Path ((1, 0) : I × I) ((1, 1) : I × I) :=
    { toContinuousMap := ⟨fun u => (1, u), by fun_prop⟩
      source' := rfl
      target' := rfl }
  let eLeft : Path ((0, 0) : I × I) ((1, 0) : I × I) :=
    { toContinuousMap := ⟨fun s => (s, 0), by fun_prop⟩
      source' := rfl
      target' := rfl }
  let eRight : Path ((0, 1) : I × I) ((1, 1) : I × I) :=
    { toContinuousMap := ⟨fun s => (s, 1), by fun_prop⟩
      source' := rfl
      target' := rfl }
  have htop' : top = eTop.map F.continuous := by
    ext u
    exact (htop u).symm
  have hbottom' : bottom = eBottom.map F.continuous := by
    ext u
    exact (hbottom u).symm
  have hleft' : left = eLeft.map F.continuous := by
    ext s
    exact (hleft s).symm
  have hright' : right = eRight.map F.continuous := by
    ext s
    exact (hright s).symm
  have hsq : eBottom.Homotopic ((eLeft.symm.trans eTop).trans eRight) :=
    SimplyConnectedSpace.paths_homotopic _ _
  have hmap := hsq.map F
  rw [Path.map_trans, Path.map_trans, ← Path.map_symm] at hmap
  rw [hbottom', htop', hleft', hright']
  exact hmap

name: Submission.quot_subpath_trans
statement:
private theorem quot_subpath_trans {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {a b : Y} (Γ : Path a b) (u v w : I) :
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (Γ.subpath u v)).trans
        (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (Γ.subpath v w)) =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (Γ.subpath u w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans]
  exact Path.Homotopic.Quotient.eq.mpr
    ⟨Path.Homotopy.subpathTransSubpath Γ u v w⟩

name: Submission.quot_loopWrap_mk
statement:
private theorem quot_loopWrap_mk {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] {y : Y}
    (Γ : Path y y) (v u : I) :
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (loopWrap Γ v u) =
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (Γ.subpath v 1)).trans
        (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
          ((Γ.subpath 0 u).cast (Γ.target.trans Γ.source.symm) rfl))
proof:
:=
  Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans _ _

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_congr_apply
proof:
:=
  loopClassZ2_congr_fun (pathLoop_closed α) (pathLoop_closed β)

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_cast_congr
proof:
:= by
  subst hx
  subst hy

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_loopWrap_self
proof:
:= by
  have h10 : Γ 1 = Γ 0 := Γ.target.trans Γ.source.symm
  have hrot : pathLoopClassZ2 (loopWrap Γ u u) =
      pathLoopClassZ2
        (((Γ.subpath 0 u).cast h10 rfl).trans (Γ.subpath u 1)) := by
    have hcomm := quotLoopClassZ2_comm
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (Γ.subpath u 1))
      (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk ((Γ.subpath 0 u).cast h10 rfl))
    rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans,
      ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans,
      quotLoopClassZ2_mk, quotLoopClassZ2_mk] at hcomm
    exact hcomm
  rw [hrot]
  have hfun : ∀ t : I,
      (((Γ.subpath 0 u).cast h10 rfl).trans (Γ.subpath u 1)) t =
        (((Γ.subpath 0 u).trans (Γ.subpath u 1)).cast h10 rfl) t := by
    intro t
    show (((Γ.subpath 0 u).cast h10 rfl).trans (Γ.subpath u 1)) t =
      ((Γ.subpath 0 u).trans (Γ.subpath u 1)) t
    rw [Path.trans_apply, Path.trans_apply]
    split_ifs <;> rfl
  rw [pathLoopClassZ2_congr_apply hfun,
    pathLoopClassZ2_cast_congr
      ⟨Path.Homotopy.subpathTransSubpath Γ 0 u 1⟩ h10 rfl]
  refine pathLoopClassZ2_congr_apply fun t => ?_
  show Γ (Set.Icc.convexComb 0 1 t) = Γ t
  rw [Set.Icc.convexComb_zero_one]

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_cut_wrap
statement:
theorem pathLoopClassZ2_cut_wrap {g : SOGroup m}
    (Γ : Path g g) (u v : I) :
    pathLoopClassZ2 ((Γ.subpath u v).trans (loopWrap Γ v u)) =
      pathLoopClassZ2 Γ
proof:
:= by
  have hq : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
      ((Γ.subpath u v).trans (loopWrap Γ v u)) =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (loopWrap Γ u u) := by
    rw [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans, quot_loopWrap_mk, quot_loopWrap_mk]
    simp only [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc]
    rw [quot_subpath_trans]
  have hcls := congrArg quotLoopClassZ2 hq
  rw [quotLoopClassZ2_mk, quotLoopClassZ2_mk] at hcls
  rw [hcls, pathLoopClassZ2_loopWrap_self]

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_cut_chain_wrap
statement:
theorem pathLoopClassZ2_cut_chain_wrap {g : SOGroup m}
    (Γ : Path g g) (c₀ c₁ c₂ c₃ : I) :
    pathLoopClassZ2
        (((Γ.subpath c₀ c₁).trans (Γ.subpath c₁ c₂)).trans
          ((Γ.subpath c₂ c₃).trans (loopWrap Γ c₃ c₀))) =
      pathLoopClassZ2 Γ
proof:
:= by
  have hq : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
      (((Γ.subpath c₀ c₁).trans (Γ.subpath c₁ c₂)).trans
        ((Γ.subpath c₂ c₃).trans (loopWrap Γ c₃ c₀))) =
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk (loopWrap Γ c₀ c₀) := by
    rw [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans, Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans, quot_loopWrap_mk, quot_loopWrap_mk]
    simp only [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc]
    rw [quot_subpath_trans, quot_subpath_trans, quot_subpath_trans]
  have hcls := congrArg quotLoopClassZ2 hq
  rw [quotLoopClassZ2_mk, quotLoopClassZ2_mk] at hcls
  rw [hcls, pathLoopClassZ2_loopWrap_self]

name: Submission.BridgeData.hasCompactSupport_northCutoff
statement: theorem hasCompactSupport_northCutoff : HasCompactSupport B.northCutoff
proof:
:= by
  have hsupp : support B.northCutoff ⊆
      Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (n + 1 : ℝ) := by
    intro x hx
    have hnc : WithLp.ofLp x ∉ closedAmbientCollar (Fin (n + 1)) := by
      intro hcollar
      apply hx
      rw [northCutoff, northSource, nprep_of_mem_collar B.approx hcollar]
      apply plateauA_of_le
      show (-eLast n : E) (Fin.last n) ≤ -(1 / 2 : ℝ)
      simp [eLast]
      norm_num
    have hcoord : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 1 := by
      intro i
      have h : ¬(x i ≤ 1 / 5 ∨ 4 / 5 ≤ x i) := fun hi => hnc ⟨i, hi⟩
      rw [not_or, not_le, not_le] at h
      exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [h.1], by linarith [h.2]⟩
    have hnorm : ‖x‖ ≤ n + 1 := by
      have hsq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := norm_sq_eq_sum x
      have hsum : (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℝ) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro i _
        have hi := hcoord i
        nlinarith [abs_nonneg (x i), sq_abs (x i)]
      have hone : (∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℝ)) = n + 1 := by simp
      have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      have hn1 : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have hsq' : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
        calc
          ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := hsq
          _ ≤ n + 1 := hsum.trans_eq hone
          _ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := hn1
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    exact hnorm
  have htsupp : tsupport B.northCutoff ⊆
      Metric.closedBall (0 : E) (n + 1 : ℝ) :=
    closure_minimal hsupp Metric.isClosed_closedBall
  exact IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset
    (ProperSpace.isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) (n + 1 : ℝ)) isClosed_closure htsupp
