name: Submission.BridgeData.inner_signedCollapseRaw_source
statement:
lemma inner_signedCollapseRaw_source (x : E) :
    ⟪B.signedCollapseRaw x, B.northSource x⟫ =
      B.northCutoff x *
          (1 - vertC (B.northSource x) ^ 2 -
            ⟪B.y, initCLM n (B.northSource x)⟫) +
        (2 * B.northCutoff x - 1) * vertC (B.northSource x)
proof:
:= by
  let u := B.northSource x
  let h := initCLM n u
  let t := vertC u
  have hnorm := norm_sq_split u
  rw [B.norm_northSource x] at hnorm
  have hhh : ⟪h, h⟫ = 1 - t ^ 2 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    nlinarith
  rw [signedCollapseRaw, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left,
    real_inner_smul_left, inner_embedCLM_left (n := n), inner_eLast_left,
    B.fls_g_eq_northSource, inner_sub_left, hhh]

name: Submission.BridgeData.inner_signedCollapseRaw_source_pos
statement:
lemma inner_signedCollapseRaw_source_pos (x : E) :
    0 < ⟪B.signedCollapseRaw x, B.northSource x⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [B.inner_signedCollapseRaw_source]
  let u := B.northSource x
  let t := vertC u
  let h := initCLM n u
  let c := B.northCutoff x
  let q := ⟪B.y, h⟫
  have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := B.norm_northSource x
  have htAbs : |t| ≤ 1 := abs_vertC_le_one hu
  have htLower : -1 ≤ t := neg_le_of_abs_le htAbs
  have htUpper : t ≤ 1 := le_of_abs_le htAbs
  have hh : ‖h‖ ≤ 1 := by
    have hs := norm_sq_split u
    rw [hu] at hs
    have hh0 := norm_nonneg h
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg t]
  have hqAbs : |q| < 1 / 8 := by
    calc
      |⟪B.y, h⟫| ≤ ‖B.y‖ * ‖h‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ ≤ ‖B.y‖ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hh (norm_nonneg B.y)
      _ < 1 / 8 := by simpa [q] using B.norm_y_lt
  have hqUpper : q < 1 / 8 := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self q) hqAbs
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := B.northCutoff_nonneg x
  have hc1 : c ≤ 1 := B.northCutoff_le_one x
  change 0 < c * (1 - t ^ 2 - q) + (2 * c - 1) * t
  by_cases hlow : t ≤ -(1 / 2)
  · have hc : c = 0 := by
      dsimp [c, t, u]
      rw [northCutoff, plateauA_of_le hlow]
    rw [hc]
    linarith
  by_cases hhigh : -(1 / 4) ≤ t
  · have hc : c = 1 := by
      dsimp [c, t, u]
      rw [northCutoff, plateauA_of_ge hhigh]
    rw [hc]
    have ht : -(1 / 4) ≤ t := hhigh
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t - 1 / 2)]
  · have htneg : t < -(1 / 4) := lt_of_not_ge hhigh
    have httrans : -(1 / 2) < t := lt_of_not_ge hlow
    by_cases hbr : 0 ≤ 1 + 2 * t - t ^ 2 - q
    · have hp : 0 ≤ c * (1 + 2 * t - t ^ 2 - q) := mul_nonneg hc0 hbr
      nlinarith
    · have hbrneg : 1 + 2 * t - t ^ 2 - q < 0 := lt_of_not_ge hbr
      have hp : 1 + 2 * t - t ^ 2 - q ≤
          c * (1 + 2 * t - t ^ 2 - q) := by
        nlinarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (t + 1 / 2)]

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_chartMap_connector_positive
statement:
theorem exists_chartMap_connector_positive
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    (x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (dt : C(I, ℝ))
    (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ criticalSliceExteriorCore
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
      (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) (D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2))
    (hx₀eq : x₀ = (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
      (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)))
    (hdt : ∀ w : I, |dt w| ≤ D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) :
    ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      (∀ w : I, ‖η w‖ ≤ D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) ∧
      (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.1 (η w 0)) ∧
      (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.2 (η w 1)) ∧
      (∀ w : I, (D.position.eventModel t ht).localPoint (η w) =
        (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀ (dt w))
proof:
:= by
  have hfib : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x₀ = 0 :=
    ((mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore _ _ _ _ _).mp hx₀).1
  have hd : ∀ w : I, |dt w| ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime := fun w =>
    (hdt w).trans (D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
  have hmove : dist x₀ ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd
      p.1 p.2 (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) ≤
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
    rw [hx₀eq]
    calc dist ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow _
          (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))) _
        = dist ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow _
            (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)))
          ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow _ 0) := by
          rw [(D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow_zero]
      _ ≤ ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          |(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) - 0| :=
        (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.dist_flow_self_le _ _ _
      _ = ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
          rw [sub_zero, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  have hclose : ∀ w : I, dist x₀
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |dt w| <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht) p := by
    intro w
    have h0 := D.bandCaptureScale_positive_close t ht p
    have htri := dist_triangle x₀
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    have hb2 : ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |dt w| ≤
        ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdt w) (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound.coe_nonneg
    linarith
  obtain ⟨η, h1, h2, h3, -, h5⟩ :=
    D.exists_chartMap_flowLine_quadrant t ht hindex
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht)
      (D.bandTimeField t ht) p hx₀ hfib dt hd hclose
      ⟨fun w => (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀ (dt w),
        ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.continuous_flow x₀).comp dt.continuous⟩
      (fun w => rfl)
  exact ⟨η, h1, h2, h3, h5⟩

      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |dt w| <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht) p := by
    intro w
    have h0 := D.bandCaptureScale_negative_close t ht p
    have htri := dist_triangle x₀
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    have hb2 : ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |dt w| ≤
        ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hdt w) (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound.coe_nonneg
    linarith
  obtain ⟨η, h1, h2, h3, -, h5⟩ :=
    D.exists_chartMap_flowLine_quadrant t ht hindex
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht)

        hregpos Vpos)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveRebased_structure
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveRebased_structure :
    (T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos
        heq).sortedMark 0 = 0 ∧
      (T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos
        heq).sortedMark 1 = halfI ∧
      (T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos
          heq).cyclicCutRange 0 =
        Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
proof:
:=
  SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.rebased_structure
    (T.saddlePositiveRebasedParam_curve_convexComb hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos
      Vpos heq)
    (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_injective hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
    (l₀ := finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (SaddleBranch.negative, .negative))
    (l₁ := finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (SaddleBranch.negative, .positive))
    (by
      show T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad 0 = _
      simp [saddlePositiveRebasedMarking, saddlePositiveSpatialSegment,
        saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking])
    (by
      show T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad 1 = _
      simp [saddlePositiveRebasedMarking, saddlePositiveSpatialSegment,
        saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking])
    (fun hu i => T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_ne_commonMark_of_mem_Ioo hindex
      ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq .negative hu i)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveRebased_exists_cutRange_positive
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveRebased_exists_cutRange_positive :
    ∃ j : Fin 4,
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) =
        (T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos
          heq).cyclicCutRange j
proof:
:= by
  refine (T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos
    heq).exists_cyclicCutRange_eq_of_adjacent_or_wrap _ ?_
  refine (T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos
      heq).range_eq_adjacentSubpath_or_wrap_of_embedded_arc_four _
    (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_mem_own_orbit hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos
      Vpos heq .negative .positive)
    (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_injective hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
    (finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (SaddleBranch.positive, .negative))
    (finFourOfSaddleBranchPair (SaddleBranch.positive, .positive)) ?_ ?_ ?_
  · show T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad 0 = _
    simp [saddlePositiveRebasedMarking, saddlePositiveSpatialSegment,
      saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking]
  · show T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad 1 = _
    simp [saddlePositiveRebasedMarking, saddlePositiveSpatialSegment,
      saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking]
  · intro u hu l
    exact T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_ne_commonMark_of_mem_Ioo hindex ρ s hρ
      hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq .positive hu l

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveRebased_exteriorCuts
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveRebased_exteriorCuts :
    (T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos
          heq).cyclicCutRange 0 =
        Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) ∧
      (T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos
          heq).cyclicCutRange 2 =
        Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) ∧
      ∀ r : Fin 4, r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 → ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = s ^ 2 → ‖u‖ < ρ →
        spacePart (M.param u) ∉
          (T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos
            heq).cyclicCutRange r
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set A := T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq
    with hA
  obtain ⟨-, -, hcut0⟩ :=
    T.saddlePositiveRebased_structure hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq
  have hdisj : Disjoint
      (Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
      (Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad)) :=
    T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegments_disjoint hindex ρ s hρ hb hs hρrad
  obtain ⟨i', j', hij', hi', hj', hav⟩ :=
    A.exists_distinct_localCutRanges_and_otherCuts_avoid_unmarkedLocal
      (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
      (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) hdisj
      ⟨0, hcut0.symm⟩
      (T.saddlePositiveRebased_exists_cutRange_positive hindex hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos heq)
  
  have hhalfIoo : (halfI : I) ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : I) 1 := by
    constructor
    · show ((0 : I) : ℝ) < ((halfI : I) : ℝ)
      rw [halfI_coe]; norm_num
    · show ((halfI : I) : ℝ) < ((1 : I) : ℝ)
      rw [halfI_coe]; norm_num
  have hi'0 : i' = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hmem0 :
        T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad halfI ∈
          A.cyclicCutRange 0 := by
      rw [hcut0]; exact ⟨halfI, rfl⟩
    have hmemi :
        T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad halfI ∈
          A.cyclicCutRange i' := by
      rw [← hi']; exact ⟨halfI, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨l, hl⟩ := A.mem_inter_cyclicCutRange_is_mark (Ne.symm hne) hmem0
      hmemi
    exact T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_ne_commonMark_of_mem_Ioo hindex ρ s hρ
      hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq .negative hhalfIoo l hl
  subst hi'0
  have hdisj' : Disjoint (A.cyclicCutRange 0) (A.cyclicCutRange j') := by
    rw [← hi', ← hj']; exact hdisj
  have hj'2 : j' = 2 := by
    rcases A.exterior_pair_of_disjoint_cyclicCutRange hdisj' with
      ⟨h0i, -, -, -⟩ | ⟨-, h1j, -, h3j⟩
    · exact absurd rfl h0i
    · have hj0 : j' ≠ 0 := Ne.symm hij'
      have e0 : ((0 : Fin 4) : ℕ) = 0 := rfl
      have e1 : ((1 : Fin 4) : ℕ) = 1 := rfl
      have e2 : ((2 : Fin 4) : ℕ) = 2 := rfl
      have e3 : ((3 : Fin 4) : ℕ) = 3 := rfl
      have n0 : (j' : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h => hj0 (Fin.ext (h.trans e0.symm))
      have n1 : (j' : ℕ) ≠ 1 := fun h => h1j (Fin.ext (e1.trans h.symm))
      have n3 : (j' : ℕ) ≠ 3 := fun h => h3j (Fin.ext (e3.trans h.symm))
      have hlt : (j' : ℕ) < 4 := j'.isLt
      refine Fin.ext ?_
      rw [e2]
      omega
  subst hj'2
  refine ⟨hcut0, hj'.symm, ?_⟩
  intro r hr0 hr2 u hquad hnorm
  refine hav ?_ ?_ r hr0 hr2
  · exact T.spacePart_param_mem_union_saddlePositiveSpatialSegments_of_norm_le
      ρ s hρ hb hs hρrad u hquad hnorm.le
  · intro l
    exact T.spacePart_param_ne_saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_of_norm_lt hindex
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l) ρ s hρ hs hρrad u hquad hnorm

name: Submission.chartComplex_definiteCircleParam
statement:
theorem chartComplex_definiteCircleParam (r a : ℝ) :
    chartComplex (definiteCircleParam r a) =
      (r : ℂ) * Complex.exp ((a : ℂ) * Complex.I)
proof:
:= by
  apply Complex.ext
  · simp only [chartComplex_re, definiteCircleParam_apply_zero, Complex.mul_re,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
      Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, zero_mul, sub_zero]
  · simp only [chartComplex_im, definiteCircleParam_apply_one, Complex.mul_im,
      Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
      Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im, zero_mul, add_zero]

name: Submission.exp_polar_eq_chartComplex
statement:
theorem exp_polar_eq_chartComplex {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (a : ℝ) :
    Complex.exp ((Real.log r : ℂ) + (a : ℂ) * Complex.I) =
      chartComplex (definiteCircleParam r a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.exp_add, chartComplex_definiteCircleParam]
  congr 1
  rw [← Complex.ofReal_exp, Real.exp_log hr]

name: Submission.chartLogLift_eq_polar
statement:
theorem chartLogLift_eq_polar (g : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (hg : ∀ u : I, g u ≠ 0) (rad ang : C(I, ℝ)) (hrad : ∀ u : I, 0 < rad u)
    (hpolar : ∀ u : I, definiteCircleParam (rad u) (ang u) = g u) (u : I) :
    chartLogLift g hg u =
      (Real.log (rad u) : ℂ) + (ang u : ℂ) * Complex.I +
        (Complex.log (chartComplex (g 0)) -
          ((Real.log (rad 0) : ℂ) + (ang 0 : ℂ) * Complex.I))
proof:
:= by
  set c : ℂ := Complex.log (chartComplex (g 0)) -
    ((Real.log (rad 0) : ℂ) + (ang 0 : ℂ) * Complex.I) with hc
  have hgc : chartComplex (g 0) ≠ 0 := chartComplex_ne_zero (hg 0)
  have hexpc : Complex.exp c = 1 := by
    rw [hc, Complex.exp_sub, exp_polar_eq_chartComplex (hrad 0) (ang 0),
      hpolar 0, Complex.exp_log hgc, div_self hgc]
  have hcont : Continuous fun w : I =>
      (Real.log (rad w) : ℂ) + (ang w : ℂ) * Complex.I + c := by
    have hlog : Continuous fun w : I => Real.log (rad w) := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro w
      exact (Real.continuousAt_log (hrad w).ne').comp rad.continuous.continuousAt
    have h1 : Continuous fun w : I => (Real.log (rad w) : ℂ) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hlog
    have h2 : Continuous fun w : I => (ang w : ℂ) :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp ang.continuous
    exact (h1.add (h2.mul continuous_const)).add continuous_const
  set Γ : C(I, ℂ) := ⟨fun w => (Real.log (rad w) : ℂ) + (ang w : ℂ) * Complex.I + c,
    hcont⟩ with hΓ
  have hlifts : (fun z : ℂ => (⟨Complex.exp z, Complex.exp_ne_zero z⟩ :
      {z : ℂ // z ≠ 0})) ∘ Γ = puncturedChartCurve g hg := by
    funext w
    apply Subtype.ext
    show Complex.exp ((Real.log (rad w) : ℂ) + (ang w : ℂ) * Complex.I + c) =
      chartComplex (g w)
    rw [Complex.exp_add, hexpc, mul_one,
      exp_polar_eq_chartComplex (hrad w) (ang w), hpolar w]
  have hzero : Γ 0 = Complex.log (chartComplex (g 0)) := by
    show (Real.log (rad 0) : ℂ) + (ang 0 : ℂ) * Complex.I + c = _
    rw [hc]
    ring
  have hEq : Γ = chartLogLift g hg := by
    unfold chartLogLift
    exact (Complex.isCoveringMap_exp.eq_liftPath_iff' _).mpr ⟨hlifts, hzero⟩
  exact (congrArg (fun f : C(I, ℂ) => f u) hEq).symm

name: Submission.chartAngle_eq_ang_add_const
statement:
theorem chartAngle_eq_ang_add_const (g : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (hg : ∀ u : I, g u ≠ 0) (rad ang : C(I, ℝ)) (hrad : ∀ u : I, 0 < rad u)
    (hpolar : ∀ u : I, definiteCircleParam (rad u) (ang u) = g u) (u : I) :
    chartAngle g hg u =
      ang u + (Complex.log (chartComplex (g 0))).im - ang 0
proof:
:= by
  show (chartLogLift g hg u).im = _
  rw [chartLogLift_eq_polar g hg rad ang hrad hpolar u]
  simp [Complex.add_im, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_I_im, Complex.ofReal_re,
    Complex.ofReal_im]
  ring

name: Submission.chartAngle_sub_chartAngle
statement:
theorem chartAngle_sub_chartAngle (g : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (hg : ∀ u : I, g u ≠ 0) (rad ang : C(I, ℝ)) (hrad : ∀ u : I, 0 < rad u)
    (hpolar : ∀ u : I, definiteCircleParam (rad u) (ang u) = g u) (u v : I) :
    chartAngle g hg u - chartAngle g hg v = ang u - ang v
proof:
:= by
  rw [chartAngle_eq_ang_add_const g hg rad ang hrad hpolar u,
    chartAngle_eq_ang_add_const g hg rad ang hrad hpolar v]
  ring

name: Submission.StableSphereClassification.nonempty_mulEquiv
statement:
theorem nonempty_mulEquiv (C : StableSphereClassification n) :
    Nonempty (StableSpherePi n ≃* Multiplicative (ZMod 2))
proof:
:= by
  let e : StableSpherePi n ≃ Multiplicative (ZMod 2) :=
    Equiv.ofBijective C.invariant C.bijective
  have hcard : Nat.card (StableSpherePi n) = 2 := by
    rw [Nat.card_congr e]
    simp
  exact nonempty_mulEquiv_zmodTwo_of_card_eq_two _ hcard

statement:

    (n : ℕ) (C : StableSphereClassification n)

      (HomotopyGroup.Pi (n + 1)
          (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) x ≃*
        Multiplicative (ZMod 2))
proof:

  obtain ⟨e⟩ := C.nonempty_mulEquiv
  exact ⟨(basepointMulEquiv (southPole n) x).symm.trans e⟩

    inner_left_tangentOrthogonalRadial_eq _ _ _

      R.criticalMinimumCenterPairingScalar p hp := by
    exact R.inner_criticalNormal_minimumRadialTest p hp hindex theta
  have hnormal : 0 < nonzeroOrientationSign
        (R.criticalMinimumCenterPairingScalar p hp) *
      R.criticalMinimumCenterPairingScalar p hp :=
    nonzeroOrientationSign_mul_pos
      (R.criticalMinimumCenterPairingScalar_ne_zero p hp)
  have hradialEq := inner_radial_tangentOrthogonalRadial_eq_self
    (R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp 0 theta)
    (R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent p hp theta)
    (R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_zero_ne_zero p hp theta)
  have hradial : 0 < ⟪R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent p hp theta,
      R.criticalMinimumRadialTest p hp theta⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [criticalMinimumRadialTest, hradialEq]
    exact real_inner_self_pos.mpr
      (R.criticalMinimumRadialTest_ne_zero p hp hindex theta)
  rw [criticalMinimumNormalRadialLast, inner_add_left,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
    real_inner_smul_left, hpair]
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.property.1
  have hs1 : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.property.2
  by_cases hsone : (s : ℝ) = 1
  · simpa [hsone] using hradial
  have hslt : (s : ℝ) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hsone
  exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
    (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hslt) hnormal)
    (mul_nonneg hs0 hradial.le)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.inner_criticalMaximumNormalRadialLast_radialTest_pos
statement:
theorem inner_criticalMaximumNormalRadialLast_radialTest_pos
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .maximum)
    (s : I) (theta : ℝ) :
    0 < ⟪R.criticalMaximumNormalRadialLast p hp s theta,
      R.criticalMaximumRadialTest p hp theta⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : ⟪R.criticalDefiniteNormalRow p hp 0 theta,
      R.criticalMaximumRadialTest p hp theta⟫_ℝ =
      R.criticalMaximumCenterPairingScalar p hp := by
    exact R.inner_criticalNormal_maximumRadialTest p hp hindex theta
  have hnormal : 0 < nonzeroOrientationSign
        (R.criticalMaximumCenterPairingScalar p hp) *
      R.criticalMaximumCenterPairingScalar p hp :=
    nonzeroOrientationSign_mul_pos
      (R.criticalMaximumCenterPairingScalar_ne_zero p hp)
  have htangent : R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangentRev p hp 0 theta ≠ 0 := by
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr
      (R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_zero_ne_zero p hp theta)
  have hradialEq := inner_radial_tangentOrthogonalRadial_eq_self
    (R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangentRev p hp 0 theta)
    (R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent p hp theta) htangent
  have hradial : 0 < ⟪R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent p hp theta,
      R.criticalMaximumRadialTest p hp theta⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [criticalMaximumRadialTest, hradialEq]
    exact real_inner_self_pos.mpr
      (R.criticalMaximumRadialTest_ne_zero p hp hindex theta)
  rw [criticalMaximumNormalRadialLast, inner_add_left,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
    real_inner_smul_left, hpair]
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.property.1
  have hs1 : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.property.2
  by_cases hsone : (s : ℝ) = 1
  · simpa [hsone] using hradial
  have hslt : (s : ℝ) < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hsone
  exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
    (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hslt) hnormal)
    (mul_nonneg hs0 hradial.le)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_zero_rotation
statement:
theorem criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_zero_rotation
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (theta : ℝ) :
    R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp 0 theta =
      Real.cos theta • R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp 0 0 -
        Real.sin theta • R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent p hp 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent_zero_tangent_eq p hp theta,
    ← R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent_zero_tangent_eq p hp 0]
  let L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] E₁a :=
    criticalSpacePartCLM.comp
      (fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) 0)
  change L (definiteCircleTangentParam 1 theta) =
    Real.cos theta • L (definiteCircleTangentParam 1 0) -
      Real.sin theta • L (definiteCircleParam 1 0)
  rw [definiteCircleTangentParam_unit_rotation, map_sub,
    map_smul, map_smul]

      Real.sin theta • R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp 0 0 +
        Real.cos theta • R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent p hp 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [← R.criticalSurfaceSpatialTangent_zero_tangent_eq p hp 0]
  let L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) →L[ℝ] E₁a :=
    criticalSpacePartCLM.comp
      (fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) 0)
  change L (definiteCircleParam 1 theta) =
    Real.sin theta • L (definiteCircleTangentParam 1 0) +
      Real.cos theta • L (definiteCircleParam 1 0)
  rw [definiteCircleParam_unit_rotation, map_add, map_smul, map_smul]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalOrientedTangent_rotation
statement:
theorem criticalOrientedTangent_rotation
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (theta : ℝ) :
    StandardBirth.orientationSign a •
        R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp 0 theta =
      Real.cos (StandardBirth.orientationSign a * theta) •
          (StandardBirth.orientationSign a •
            R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp 0 0) -
        Real.sin (StandardBirth.orientationSign a * theta) •
          R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent p hp 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases StandardBirth.orientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one a with h | h
  · rw [h]
    simp only [one_mul, one_smul]
    exact R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_zero_rotation p hp theta
  · rw [h]
    simp only [neg_mul, neg_smul, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg, one_mul]
    rw [R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_zero_rotation p hp theta]
    module

          (StandardBirth.orientationSign a •
            R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp 0 0) +
        Real.cos (StandardBirth.orientationSign a * theta) •
          R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent p hp 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases StandardBirth.orientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one a with h | h
  · rw [h]
    simp only [one_mul, one_smul]
    exact R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent_rotation p hp theta
  · rw [h]

    rw [R.criticalDefiniteRadialTangent_rotation p hp theta]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalMinimumOrientedRadialMatrix_rotation
statement:
theorem criticalMinimumOrientedRadialMatrix_rotation
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (theta : ℝ) :
    R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix p hp 1 theta =
      twistMat a
          (StandardBirth.orientationSign a * theta) *
        R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix p hp 1 0
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [StandardBirth.twistMat_mul_apply_birth]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    simp only [criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix, rowsMatrix,
      Matrix.of_apply,
      R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_zero,
      R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_last]
    simp only [criticalMinimumNormalRadialLast, Set.Icc.coe_one]
    simp
    have h := congrArg (fun v : E₁a => v j)
      (R.criticalOrientedTangent_rotation p hp theta)
    simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using h
  · rw [if_neg hi0]
    by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (a + 2)
    · subst i
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      simp only [criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix, rowsMatrix,
        Matrix.of_apply,
        R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_zero,
        R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_last]
      simp [criticalMinimumNormalRadialLast]
      have h := congrArg (fun v : E₁a => v j)
        (R.criticalOrientedRadial_rotation p hp theta)
      simpa using h
    · rw [if_neg hil]
      simp only [criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix, rowsMatrix,
        Matrix.of_apply]
      obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ := Fin.eq_succ_of_ne_zero hi0
      induction k using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          exfalso
          apply hil
          apply Fin.ext
          simp
      | cast k =>
          rw [R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_middle,
            R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_middle]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalMaximumOrientedRadialMatrix_rotation
statement:
theorem criticalMaximumOrientedRadialMatrix_rotation
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (theta : ℝ) :
    R.criticalMaximumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix p hp 1 theta =
      twistMat a
          (StandardBirth.orientationSign a * theta) *
        R.criticalMaximumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix p hp 1 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrows (x : ℝ) : R.criticalMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows p hp 1 x =
      R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows p hp 1 x := by
    funext i
    simp [criticalMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows,
      criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows,
      criticalDefiniteUnitTangentRev,
      criticalMaximumNormalRadialLast,
      criticalMinimumNormalRadialLast]
  have hrows0 : R.criticalMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows p hp 1 0 =
      R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows p hp 1 0 := by
    exact hrows 0
  rw [criticalMaximumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix,
    criticalMaximumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix, hrows theta, hrows0,
    ← criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix,
    ← criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix]
  exact R.criticalMinimumOrientedRadialMatrix_rotation p hp theta

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.continuous_criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix
statement:
theorem continuous_criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix p hp q.1 q.2
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      StandardBirth.orientationSign a •
        R.criticalDefiniteUnitTangent p hp 0 q.2 :=
    (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
      (StandardBirth.orientationSign a : ℝ)).smul
      ((R.continuous_criticalDefiniteUnitTangent_zero_angle p hp).comp
        continuous_snd)
  have hl : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      R.criticalMinimumNormalRadialLast p hp q.1 q.2 :=
    R.continuous_criticalMinimumNormalRadialLast p hp
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  have hrow : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows p hp q.1 q.2 i := by
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · simpa only [R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_zero] using ht
    · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          have hlast : (Fin.last (a + 1)).succ =
              (Fin.last (a + 2) : Fin (a + 3)) := by
            apply Fin.ext
            simp
          rw [hlast]
          simpa only [R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_last] using hl
      | cast i =>
          simpa only [R.criticalMinimumOrientedNormalRadialRows_middle] using
            (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
              R.criticalTransverseNormal p hp i)
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp hrow

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.continuous_criticalMaximumOrientedNormalRadialMatrix
statement:

    (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
      (-StandardBirth.orientationSign a : ℝ)).smul
      ((R.continuous_criticalDefiniteUnitTangentRev_zero_angle p hp).comp
        continuous_snd)
  have hl : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      R.criticalMaximumNormalRadialLast p hp q.1 q.2 :=
    R.continuous_criticalMaximumNormalRadialLast p hp
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  have hrow : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      R.criticalMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows p hp q.1 q.2 i := by
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · simpa [criticalMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows,
        centerRowsWith] using ht
    · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>

      | cast i =>
          simpa [criticalMaximumOrientedNormalRadialRows,
            centerRowsWith] using

  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp hrow

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.det_criticalMinimumNormalizedCenterMatrix_pos
statement:
theorem det_criticalMinimumNormalizedCenterMatrix_pos
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    (s : I) (theta : ℝ) :
    0 < (R.criticalMinimumNormalizedCenterMatrix p hp hindex s theta).det
proof:
:= by
  let d : I → ℝ := fun u =>
    (R.criticalMinimumNormalizedCenterMatrix p hp hindex u theta).det
  change 0 < d s
  have hd : Continuous d := by
    change Continuous fun u : I =>
      (R.criticalMinimumNormalizedCenterMatrix p hp hindex u theta).det
    exact ((R.continuous_criticalMinimumNormalizedCenterMatrix p hp hindex).comp
      (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).matrix_det
  have hdne : ∀ u, d u ≠ 0 := fun u =>
    R.det_criticalMinimumNormalizedCenterMatrix_ne_zero
      p hp hindex u theta
  have hd1 : d 1 = 1 := by
    dsimp [d]
    rw [R.criticalMinimumNormalizedCenterMatrix_one p hp hindex theta,
      StandardBirth.det_twistMat]
  by_contra hpos
  have hsneg : d s < 0 :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hdne s)
  have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (d s) (d 1) := by
    rw [hd1]
    exact ⟨hsneg.le, by norm_num⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ s 1 hd hmem
  exact hdne u hu

name: Submission.TamedField.periodic_fderiv_orbitTubeLift
statement:
theorem periodic_fderiv_orbitTubeLift (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    Function.Periodic
      (fun q : ℝ × N => fderiv ℝ (V.orbitTubeLift O) q)
      ((1 : ℝ), (0 : N))
proof:
:= by
  have hfun :
      (fun q : ℝ × N =>
        V.orbitTubeLift O (q + ((1 : ℝ), (0 : N)))) =
      V.orbitTubeLift O := by
    funext q
    rcases q with ⟨u, z⟩
    simpa only [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero] using
      V.periodic_orbitTubeLift O z u
  intro q
  have h := congrArg
    (fun f : (ℝ × N) → E => fderiv ℝ f q) hfun
  simpa only [fderiv_comp_add_right] using h

proof:

  refine ⟨V.orbitTubeDerivEquiv O u, ?_⟩
  rw [V.orbitTubeDerivEquiv_coe O u]

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_orbitTubeLift_uniform_deriv_equiv
statement:
theorem exists_orbitTubeLift_uniform_deriv_equiv (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ (u : ℝ) (z : N), z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N) r →
      ∃ e : (ℝ × N) ≃L[ℝ] E,
        (e : (ℝ × N) →L[ℝ] E) =
          fderiv ℝ (V.orbitTubeLift O) (u, z)
proof:
:= by
  let A := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  let R : Set (ℝ × N) :=
    (fderiv ℝ (V.orbitTubeLift O)) ⁻¹'
      Set.range
        ((↑) : ((ℝ × N) ≃L[ℝ] E) →
          ((ℝ × N) →L[ℝ] E))
  let j : A × N → ℝ × N := fun q => (q.1.1, q.2)
  let T : Set (A × N) := j ⁻¹' R
  have hAcompact : IsCompact A := isCompact_Icc
  letI : CompactSpace A := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hAcompact
  have hj : Continuous j :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst |>.prodMk continuous_snd
  have hTopen : IsOpen T := by
    exact (V.isOpen_orbitTubeLift_regularSet O).preimage hj
  have hzero :
      (Set.univ : Set A) ×ˢ ({0} : Set N) ⊆ T := by
    rintro ⟨a, z⟩ ⟨-, hz⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    change z = 0 at hz
    subst z
    exact V.orbitTubeLift_zero_mem_regularSet O a.1
  obtain ⟨U, W, hUopen, hWopen, hAU, hzeroW, hUWT⟩ :=
    generalized_tube_lemma (X := A) (Y := N)
      isCompact_univ isCompact_singleton hTopen hzero
  have hzero_mem_W : (0 : N) ∈ W := hzeroW (Set.mem_singleton 0)
  rcases (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hWopen) 0 hzero_mem_W with
    ⟨r, hr, hrW⟩
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  intro u z hz
  let a : A := ⟨Int.fract u,
    Int.fract_nonneg u, (Int.fract_lt_one u).le⟩
  have hregFract : (Int.fract u, z) ∈ R := by
    have ht : (a, z) ∈ T :=
      hUWT ⟨hAU (Set.mem_univ a), hrW hz⟩
    exact ht
  have hperiod := (V.periodic_fderiv_orbitTubeLift O).zsmul ⌊u⌋
  have heq :
      fderiv ℝ (V.orbitTubeLift O) (u, z) =
        fderiv ℝ (V.orbitTubeLift O) (Int.fract u, z) := by
    have h := hperiod (Int.fract u, z)
    have hpoint :
        (Int.fract u, z) + ⌊u⌋ • ((1 : ℝ), (0 : N)) =
          (u, z) := by
      ext
      · simpa [add_comm] using Int.fract_add_floor u
      · simp
    rw [hpoint] at h
    exact h
  rw [heq]
  exact hregFract

name: Submission.TamedField.nonempty_orbitTubeGlobalSmoothInverse
statement:
theorem nonempty_orbitTubeGlobalSmoothInverse (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    Nonempty (V.OrbitTubeGlobalSmoothInverse O)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRinj, hRemb⟩ := V.exists_orbitTube_global_embedding O
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hSderiv⟩ :=
    V.exists_orbitTubeLift_uniform_deriv_equiv O
  let r : ℝ := min R S
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hR hS
  have hrR : r ≤ R := min_le_left R S
  have hrS : r ≤ S := min_le_right R S
  let D : Set (C × N) :=
    (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N) r
  let DR : Set (C × N) :=
    (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N) R
  have hDR : D ⊆ DR := by
    exact prod_mono Subset.rfl (Metric.ball_subset_ball hrR)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn (V.orbitTube O) D :=
    hRinj.mono hDR
  have hemb : Topology.IsEmbedding
      (fun q : D => V.orbitTube O q.1) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Set.inclusion, D, DR] using
      hRemb.comp (Topology.IsEmbedding.inclusion hDR)
  have hzeroD : ((0 : C), (0 : N)) ∈ D := by
    exact ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Metric.mem_ball_self hr⟩
  let qzero : D := ⟨((0 : C), (0 : N)), hzeroD⟩
  letI : Nonempty D := ⟨qzero⟩
  let tube : D → E := fun q => V.orbitTube O q.1
  have htube_inj : Function.Injective tube := by
    intro p q hpq
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hinj p.property q.property hpq
  let invTube : E → D := Function.invFun tube
  let inverse : E → C × N := fun y => (invTube y).1
  have hinverse_left : ∀ q ∈ D,
      inverse (V.orbitTube O q) = q := by
    intro q hq
    let qs : D := ⟨q, hq⟩
    have hi : invTube (tube qs) = qs := by
      exact Function.leftInverse_invFun htube_inj qs
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hi
  refine ⟨{
    radius := r
    radius_pos := hr
    inverse := inverse
    injOn := hinj
    embedding := hemb
    inverse_left := hinverse_left
    local_smooth_lift := ?_
  }⟩
  intro u z hz
  have hzS : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N) S :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball hrS hz
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hSderiv u z hzS
  have hf : HasFDerivAt (V.orbitTubeLift O)
      (e : (ℝ × N) →L[ℝ] E) (u, z) := by
    have hf' := (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).differentiable
      (by simp) (u, z) |>.hasFDerivAt
    rw [he]
    exact hf'
  let chart : OpenPartialHomeomorph (ℝ × N) E :=
    (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).contDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph
      (V.orbitTubeLift O) hf (by simp)
  let g : E → ℝ × N := chart.symm
  have hsource : (u, z) ∈ chart.source := by
    exact (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).contDiffAt
      |>.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hf (by simp)
  have htarget : V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z) ∈ chart.target :=
    chart.map_source hsource
  have hgcenter : g (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z) := by
    change chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z)
    rw [← show (chart : (ℝ × N) → E) = V.orbitTubeLift O by rfl]
    exact chart.left_inv hsource
  have hforwardDeriv : HasFDerivAt chart
      (e : (ℝ × N) →L[ℝ] E)
      (chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z) by
      exact hgcenter]
    exact hf
  have hforwardSmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ chart
      (chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z) by
      exact hgcenter]
    exact (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).contDiffAt
  have hgsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g
      (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) := by
    exact chart.contDiffAt_symm htarget hforwardDeriv hforwardSmooth
  have hgderiv : HasFDerivAt g
      (e.symm : E →L[ℝ] (ℝ × N))
      (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) := by
    exact chart.hasFDerivAt_symm htarget hforwardDeriv
  have hlocal : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 (u, z),
      g (V.orbitTubeLift O p) = p := by
    exact chart.eventually_left_inverse hsource
  have hball : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 (u, z),
      p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N) r := by
    exact continuous_snd.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)
  refine ⟨e, g, hf, hgsmooth, hgderiv, hgcenter, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hlocal, hball] with p hp hpr
  have hglobal := hinverse_left (((p.1 : ℝ) : C), p.2)
    ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hpr⟩
  rw [V.orbitTube_coe O p.1 p.2] at hglobal
  simpa [hp] using hglobal

      P.eventCenter t ht ∈ (C.labelMorsePosition P).positiveCenters →

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_coverShrinkRadius
statement:
theorem exists_coverShrinkRadius (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) :
    ∃ r > 0, r ≤ T.radius ∧
      ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < r →
        dist (M.param u) center < M.fiberCoverRadius / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ‖(0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))‖ < T.radius := by
    simpa using T.radius_pos
  have hcont : ContinuousAt M.param 0 :=
    (T.param_differentiableAt 0 hzero).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hclose⟩ := (Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont)
    (M.fiberCoverRadius / 2)
      (div_pos M.fiberCoverRadius_pos (by norm_num))
  let r := min T.radius δ / 2
  have hm : 0 < min T.radius δ := lt_min T.radius_pos hδ
  refine ⟨r, by dsimp [r]; positivity, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [r]
    have hle : min T.radius δ ≤ T.radius := min_le_left _ _
    nlinarith
  · intro u hu
    have hud : dist u 0 < δ := by
      rw [dist_zero_right]
      have hrδ : r < δ := by
        dsimp [r]
        have hle : min T.radius δ ≤ δ := min_le_right _ _
        nlinarith
      exact hu.trans hrδ
    have h := hclose hud
    simpa [M.param_zero] using h

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore_subset_slabRegularSet
statement:
theorem chronologicalExteriorSlabCore_subset_slabRegularSet
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage C)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht ⊆
      slabRegularSet D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore] at hv
  have hspatial : Function.Surjective
      (spatialDeriv D.signedOutput.cobordism.G v) := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hcritical : v ∈ timeCritical D.signedOutput.cobordism.G :=
      ⟨hv.1.1, hnot⟩
    have hvc : v = D.position.eventCenter t ht :=
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).isolates v hcritical hv.1.2
    have hdist := hv.2
    change (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius ≤
      dist v (D.position.eventCenter t ht) at hdist
    rw [hvc, dist_self] at hdist
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hdist)
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius_pos
  exact mem_slabRegularSet_of_spatial_surjective
    (D.signedOutput.cobordism.regular v hv.1.1) hspatial

        (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius ⊆
      D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht

  rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore]
  refine ⟨⟨hv.1, ?_⟩, hv.2.2⟩
  change tcoord v ∈ Icc
    (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
    (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after
  rw [hv.2.1]
  exact ⟨(D.position.eventBracket t ht).before_lt.le,

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime
statement:
theorem chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage C)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    |D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2| ≤
      (D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).safeTime
proof:
:= by
  let s := (D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).safeTime
  let m := min
    (min
      (min (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).modelRadius)
      (Real.sqrt s))
    (Real.sqrt (D.chronologicalExteriorFlowSeparationTime t ht))
  have hs : 0 < s :=
    (D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).safeTime_pos
  have hm : 0 < m := lt_min
    (lt_min
      (lt_min
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_pos
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).modelRadius_pos)
      (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hs))
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2
      (D.chronologicalExteriorFlowSeparationTime_pos t ht))
  have hmsqrt : m ≤ Real.sqrt s :=
    (min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  have hm_sq : m ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt s) ^ 2 :=
    (sq_le_sq₀ hm.le (Real.sqrt_nonneg s)).2 hmsqrt
  have hhalf : (m / 2) ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg m]
  change |(m / 2) ^ 2| ≤ s
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  calc
    (m / 2) ^ 2 ≤ m ^ 2 := hhalf
    _ ≤ (Real.sqrt s) ^ 2 := hm_sq
    _ = s := Real.sq_sqrt hs.le

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_half_cover
statement:
theorem chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_half_cover
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage C)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) :
    ((D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
        D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2
proof:
:= by
  let b : ℝ :=
    ((D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ)
  let rho := (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius
  let q := D.chronologicalExteriorFlowSeparationTime t ht
  let m := min
    (min
      (min (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).modelRadius)
      (Real.sqrt
        (D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).safeTime))
    (Real.sqrt q)
  have hb : 0 ≤ b :=
    (D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.bound.coe_nonneg
  have hrho : 0 < rho :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius_pos
  have hq : 0 < q := D.chronologicalExteriorFlowSeparationTime_pos t ht
  have hmsqrt : m ≤ Real.sqrt q := min_le_right _ _
  have hm : 0 < m := lt_min
    (lt_min
      (lt_min
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_pos
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).modelRadius_pos)
      (Real.sqrt_pos.2
        (D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).safeTime_pos))
    (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hq)
  have hmnonneg : 0 ≤ m := hm.le
  have hmsq : m ^ 2 ≤ q := by
    calc
      m ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt q) ^ 2 :=
        (sq_le_sq₀ hmnonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg q)).2 hmsqrt
      _ = q := Real.sq_sqrt hq.le
  have hhalf : (m / 2) ^ 2 ≤ q / 4 := by
    nlinarith
  have hqeq : q * (b + 1) = rho := by
    dsimp [q, chronologicalExteriorFlowSeparationTime, b, rho]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ (by nlinarith)
  have hbq : b * q < rho := by
    nlinarith
  have hbhalf : b * (m / 2) ^ 2 ≤ b * (q / 4) :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hhalf hb
  change b * (m / 2) ^ 2 < rho / 2
  nlinarith

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalInteriorTime_not_mem_eventTimes
statement:
private theorem chronologicalInteriorTime_not_mem_eventTimes
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage C)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (s : ℝ)
    (hs : s ∈ Ioo (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after)
    (hne : s ≠ t) :
    s ∉ D.position.eventTimes
proof:
:= by
  intro hsEvent
  let v := D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent
  have hvCritical : v ∈ timeCritical D.signedOutput.cobordism.G :=
    (D.position.eventCenter_mem_coreCriticalPoints s hsEvent).1
  have hvInterval : tcoord v ∈ Icc
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
    rw [D.position.eventCenter_time s hsEvent]
    exact ⟨hs.1.le, hs.2.le⟩
  have hvEq : v = D.position.eventCenter t ht :=
    (D.position.eventBracket t ht).isolates v hvCritical hvInterval
  have hvEq' : D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent =
      D.position.eventCenter t ht := by
    simpa [v] using hvEq
  apply hne
  calc
    s = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent) :=
      (D.position.eventCenter_time s hsEvent).symm
    _ = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := congrArg tcoord hvEq'
    _ = t := D.position.eventCenter_time t ht

theorem mark_eq_of_curve_eq (A : P.CyclicMarking k) (i : Fin (k + 1)) {t : I}
    (ht : t ≠ 1) (h : P.curve t = A.point i) : A.mark i = t
proof:
:= by
  have hc : P.curve (A.mark i) = P.curve t := by rw [A.curve_mark i, ← h]
  rcases P.curve_eq_cases hc with heq | ⟨_, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, _⟩
  · exact heq
  · exact absurd hb ht
  · exact absurd ha (A.mark_ne_one i)

proof:
:= by
  have hmem : t ∈ Set.range (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) halfI) := by
    rw [Path.range_subpathAux, Set.uIcc_of_le zero_le_halfI]
    exact ⟨t.property.1, ht⟩
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hmem
  exact ⟨q, by rw [← hcurve q, hq]⟩

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.rebased_structure
statement:
theorem rebased_structure
    (hcurve : ∀ q : I, P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb 0 halfI q) = psi q)
    (hinj : Injective psi) {l₀ l₁ : Fin 4}
    (h0 : psi 0 = A.point l₀) (h1 : psi 1 = A.point l₁)
    (havoid : ∀ {u : I}, u ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1 → ∀ l, psi u ≠ A.point l) :
    A.sortedMark 0 = 0 ∧ A.sortedMark 1 = halfI ∧
      A.cyclicCutRange 0 = Set.range psi
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hc0 : P.curve 0 = psi 0 := by
    rw [← hcurve 0, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero]
  have hchalf : P.curve halfI = psi 1 := by
    rw [← hcurve 1, Set.Icc.convexComb_one]
  have hm0 : A.mark l₀ = 0 :=
    A.mark_eq_of_curve_eq l₀ zero_ne_one_I (hc0.trans h0)
  have hm1 : A.mark l₁ = halfI :=
    A.mark_eq_of_curve_eq l₁ halfI_ne_one (hchalf.trans h1)
  have hs0 : A.sortedMark 0 = 0 :=
    le_antisymm (by rw [← hm0]; exact A.sortedMark_zero_le l₀)
      A.zero_le_sortedMark_zero
  
  have hl01 : l₀ ≠ l₁ := by
    intro h
    have : psi 0 = psi 1 := by rw [h0, h1, h]
    exact zero_ne_one_I (hinj this)
  
  have hbeyond : ∀ l : Fin 4, l ≠ l₀ → l ≠ l₁ → halfI < A.mark l := by
    intro l hla hlb
    by_contra hcon
    have hle : A.mark l ≤ halfI := le_of_not_gt hcon
    obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ :=
      curve_mem_range_of_le_halfI (P := P) psi hcurve hle
    rw [A.curve_mark l] at hq
    by_cases hq0 : q = 0
    · exact hla (A.point_injective ((h0.symm.trans (hq0 ▸ hq)).symm))
    · by_cases hq1 : q = 1
      · exact hlb (A.point_injective ((h1.symm.trans (hq1 ▸ hq)).symm))
      · exact havoid ⟨lt_of_le_of_ne q.property.1 (Ne.symm hq0),
          lt_of_le_of_ne q.property.2 hq1⟩ l hq
  
  have hsl0 : A.sortedLabel 0 = l₀ := by
    apply A.mark_injective
    show A.sortedMark 0 = A.mark l₀
    rw [hs0, hm0]
  
  have hs1 : A.sortedMark 1 = halfI := by
    have hle : A.sortedMark 1 ≤ halfI := by
      have hi : A.sortedMark (A.sortedLabel.symm l₁) = A.mark l₁ := by
        simp [sortedMark]
      have hne : A.sortedLabel.symm l₁ ≠ 0 := by
        intro h
        apply hl01
        rw [← hsl0, ← h, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
      have hone : (1 : Fin 4) ≤ A.sortedLabel.symm l₁ := by
        rw [Fin.le_def]
        have hval : (A.sortedLabel.symm l₁ : ℕ) ≠ 0 := fun h =>
          hne (Fin.ext h)
        show (1 : ℕ) ≤ _
        omega
      calc A.sortedMark 1 ≤ A.sortedMark (A.sortedLabel.symm l₁) :=
            A.sortedMark_strictMono.monotone hone
        _ = halfI := by rw [hi, hm1]
    have hge : halfI ≤ A.sortedMark 1 := by
      by_cases hlab : A.sortedLabel 1 = l₁
      · show halfI ≤ A.mark (A.sortedLabel 1)
        rw [hlab, hm1]
      · have hne0 : A.sortedLabel 1 ≠ l₀ := by
          intro h
          have : (1 : Fin 4) = 0 := A.sortedLabel.injective (h.trans hsl0.symm)
          exact absurd this (by decide)
        exact le_of_lt (hbeyond _ hne0 hlab)
    exact le_antisymm hle hge
  refine ⟨hs0, hs1, ?_⟩
  
  have hidx : (0 : Fin 4) = (0 : Fin 3).castSucc := by decide
  have hidx' : (1 : Fin 4) = (0 : Fin 3).succ := by decide
  rw [hidx, A.cyclicCutRange_castSucc 0, A.range_adjacentSubpath 0, ← hidx,
    ← hidx', hs0, hs1]
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨t, ht, rfl⟩
    exact curve_mem_range_of_le_halfI (P := P) psi hcurve ht.2
  · rintro x ⟨q, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Set.Icc.convexComb 0 halfI q,
      ⟨Set.Icc.le_convexComb zero_le_halfI q,
        Set.Icc.convexComb_le zero_le_halfI q⟩, hcurve q⟩

name: Submission.SameFiberStraightLineComparison.Data.straightMap_smooth
statement:
theorem straightMap_smooth :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => D.straightMap p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_fst).smul
      (X.smooth.comp contDiff_snd)).add
    (contDiff_fst.smul (Y.smooth.comp contDiff_snd))

name: Submission.SameFiberStraightLineComparison.Data.straightMap_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem straightMap_zero : D.straightMap 0 = X.g
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [straightMap]

name: Submission.SameFiberStraightLineComparison.Data.straightMap_one
statement: @[simp] theorem straightMap_one : D.straightMap 1 = Y.g
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [straightMap]

name: Submission.SameFiberStraightLineComparison.Data.straightMap_fiber_eq
statement:
theorem straightMap_fiber_eq (s : ℝ) (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    {x | D.straightMap s x = 0} = X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change D.straightMap s x = 0 at hx
    by_cases hsend : s = 1
    · subst s
      have hy : Y.g x = 0 := by simpa [straightMap] using hx
      have hmem : x ∈ Y.fiber := hy
      rw [D.fiber_eq] at hmem
      exact hmem
    · have hslt : s < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hsend
      have hinner := congrArg (fun v : F => inner ℝ (X.g x) v) hx
      simp only [straightMap, inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right,
        inner_zero_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hinner
      have hpair := D.pairing_nonneg x
      have hterm1 : 0 ≤ (1 - s) * ‖X.g x‖ ^ 2 :=
        mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs1) (sq_nonneg _)
      have hterm2 : 0 ≤ s * inner ℝ (X.g x) (Y.g x) :=
        mul_nonneg hs0 hpair
      have hterm1zero : (1 - s) * ‖X.g x‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
        linarith
      have hnormsq : ‖X.g x‖ ^ 2 = 0 :=
        (mul_eq_zero.mp hterm1zero).resolve_left
          (sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hsend))
      have hnorm : ‖X.g x‖ = 0 := by
        exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hnormsq
      exact norm_eq_zero.mp hnorm
  · intro hx
    have hx0 : X.g x = 0 := hx
    have hyMem : x ∈ Y.fiber := by
      rw [D.fiber_eq]
      exact hx
    have hy0 : Y.g x = 0 := hyMem
    simp [straightMap, hx0, hy0]

name: Submission.SameFiberStraightLineComparison.Data.fderiv_straightMap_of_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem fderiv_straightMap_of_mem_fiber
    (s : ℝ) {x : E} (hx : x ∈ X.fiber) :
    fderiv ℝ (D.straightMap s) x = fderiv ℝ X.g x
proof:
:= by
  change fderiv ℝ ((1 - s) • X.g + s • Y.g) x = fderiv ℝ X.g x
  rw [fderiv_add,
    fderiv_const_smul_field, fderiv_const_smul_field]
  · change (1 - s) • fderiv ℝ X.g x + s • fderiv ℝ Y.g x =
      fderiv ℝ X.g x
    rw [D.firstJet_eq x hx]
    module
  · exact X.smooth.differentiable (by simp) x |>.const_smul _
  · exact Y.smooth.differentiable (by simp) x |>.const_smul _

name: Submission.saddleCornerParam_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem saddleCornerParam_apply_zero
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) (ρ ξ : ℝ) :
    saddleCornerParam p ρ ξ 0 =
      signedBranch p.1 (Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 + ξ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [saddleCornerParam, pairToMorseParam_apply_zero]

name: Submission.saddleCornerParam_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem saddleCornerParam_apply_one
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) (ρ ξ : ℝ) :
    saddleCornerParam p ρ ξ 1 =
      signedBranch p.2 (Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 - ξ) / 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [saddleCornerParam, pairToMorseParam_apply_one]

name: Submission.saddleCornerParam_quad
statement:
theorem saddleCornerParam_quad (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {ρ ξ : ℝ} (h1 : -(ρ ^ 2) ≤ ξ) (h2 : ξ ≤ ρ ^ 2) :
    morseQuadratic .saddle
      (saddleCornerParam p ρ ξ 0, saddleCornerParam p ρ ξ 1) = ξ
proof:
:= by
  rw [saddleCornerParam_apply_zero, saddleCornerParam_apply_one]
  simp only [morseQuadratic, signedBranch_sq]
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith), Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)]
  ring

name: Submission.saddleCornerParam_norm
statement:
theorem saddleCornerParam_norm (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {ρ ξ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 ≤ ρ) (h1 : -(ρ ^ 2) ≤ ξ) (h2 : ξ ≤ ρ ^ 2) :
    ‖saddleCornerParam p ρ ξ‖ = ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ‖saddleCornerParam p ρ ξ‖ ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by
    rw [saddleCornerParam, norm_pairToMorseParam_sq]
    simp only [signedBranch_sq]
    rw [Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith), Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith)]
    ring
  have hn : 0 ≤ ‖saddleCornerParam p ρ ξ‖ := norm_nonneg _
  nlinarith

name: Submission.continuous_signedBranch
statement:
theorem continuous_signedBranch (b : SaddleBranch) :
    Continuous (signedBranch b)
proof:
:= by
  cases b
  · exact continuous_id
  · exact continuous_neg

name: Submission.continuous_saddleCornerParam
statement:
theorem continuous_saddleCornerParam (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    (ρ : ℝ) : Continuous (saddleCornerParam p ρ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold saddleCornerParam pairToMorseParam
  apply Continuous.add
  · exact Continuous.smul ((continuous_signedBranch p.1).comp
      (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (by fun_prop))) continuous_const
  · exact Continuous.smul ((continuous_signedBranch p.2).comp
      (Real.continuous_sqrt.comp (by fun_prop))) continuous_const

name: Submission.saddleCornerParam_first_sign
statement:
theorem saddleCornerParam_first_sign (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {ρ ξ : ℝ} (h1 : -(ρ ^ 2) < ξ) :
    0 < signedBranch p.1 (saddleCornerParam p ρ ξ 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [saddleCornerParam_apply_zero]
  have h : 0 < Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 + ξ) / 2) := by
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
    linarith
  cases hp : p.1 <;> simp [signedBranch] <;> linarith

name: Submission.saddleCornerParam_second_sign
statement:
theorem saddleCornerParam_second_sign (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {ρ ξ : ℝ} (h2 : ξ < ρ ^ 2) :
    0 < signedBranch p.2 (saddleCornerParam p ρ ξ 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [saddleCornerParam_apply_one]
  have h : 0 < Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 - ξ) / 2) := by
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
    linarith
  cases hp : p.2 <;> simp [signedBranch] <;> linarith

name: Submission.saddleCornerParam_ne_zero
statement:
theorem saddleCornerParam_ne_zero (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {ρ ξ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (h1 : -(ρ ^ 2) ≤ ξ) (h2 : ξ ≤ ρ ^ 2) :
    saddleCornerParam p ρ ξ ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hn := saddleCornerParam_norm p hρ.le h1 h2
  rw [h, norm_zero] at hn
  linarith

name: Submission.saddleCornerParam_pos_eq
statement:
theorem saddleCornerParam_pos_eq (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {ρ a : ℝ} (ha : a ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2) :
    saddleCornerParam p ρ (a ^ 2) =
      saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam p.1 p.2 ρ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [saddleCornerParam, saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam]
  congr 1
  have hbp : signedBranch p.2 (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 =
      (ρ ^ 2 - a ^ 2) / 2 := by
    rw [signedBranch_sq]
    exact saddleBoundaryParameter_sq ha
  apply Prod.ext
  · show signedBranch p.1 (Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 + a ^ 2) / 2)) =
      (saddlePositiveArc p.1 a
        (signedBranch p.2 (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a))).1
    show signedBranch p.1 (Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 + a ^ 2) / 2)) =
      signedBranch p.1 (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 +
        signedBranch p.2 (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2))
    rw [hbp]
    congr 2
    ring
  · show signedBranch p.2 (Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 - a ^ 2) / 2)) =
      (saddlePositiveArc p.1 a
        (signedBranch p.2 (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a))).2
    show signedBranch p.2 (Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 - a ^ 2) / 2)) =
      signedBranch p.2 (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)
    rfl

name: Submission.saddleCornerParam_neg_eq
statement:
theorem saddleCornerParam_neg_eq (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {ρ a : ℝ} (ha : a ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2) :
    saddleCornerParam p ρ (-(a ^ 2)) =
      saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam p.2 p.1 ρ a
proof:
:= by
  rw [saddleCornerParam, saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam]
  congr 1
  have hbp : signedBranch p.1 (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2 =
      (ρ ^ 2 - a ^ 2) / 2 := by
    rw [signedBranch_sq]
    exact saddleBoundaryParameter_sq ha
  apply Prod.ext
  · show signedBranch p.1 (Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 + -(a ^ 2)) / 2)) =
      (saddleNegativeArc p.2 a
        (signedBranch p.1 (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a))).1
    show signedBranch p.1 (Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 + -(a ^ 2)) / 2)) =
      signedBranch p.1 (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)
    rw [saddleBoundaryParameter,
      show (ρ ^ 2 + -(a ^ 2)) / 2 = (ρ ^ 2 - a ^ 2) / 2 by ring]
  · show signedBranch p.2 (Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 - -(a ^ 2)) / 2)) =
      (saddleNegativeArc p.2 a
        (signedBranch p.1 (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a))).2
    show signedBranch p.2 (Real.sqrt ((ρ ^ 2 - -(a ^ 2)) / 2)) =
      signedBranch p.2 (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 +
        signedBranch p.1 (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a) ^ 2))
    rw [hbp]
    congr 2
    ring

name: Submission.saddleCornerParam_zero_eq
statement:
theorem saddleCornerParam_zero_eq (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    (ρ : ℝ) :
    saddleCornerParam p ρ 0 = saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p ρ
proof:
:= by
  have h := saddleCornerParam_pos_eq p (ρ := ρ) (a := 0)
    (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ρ])
  rw [saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam]
  simpa using h

name: Submission.signedBranch_mul
statement:
theorem signedBranch_mul (b : SaddleBranch) (x y : ℝ) :
    signedBranch b (x * y) = signedBranch b x * y
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> simp [signedBranch] <;> ring

name: Submission.hasDerivAt_saddleNegativeCurve
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_saddleNegativeCurve (β : SaddleBranch) {s : ℝ}
    (hs : 0 < s) (y₀ : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y => pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc β s y))
      (signedBranch β ((Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2))⁻¹) •
        saddleChartTangent (pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc β s y₀)))
      y₀
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2 := by positivity
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
    apply ne_of_gt
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos
  
  have hinner : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => s ^ 2 + y ^ 2) (2 * y₀) y₀ := by
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_pow 2 y₀).const_add (s ^ 2))
    simpa using h
  have hsqrt : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y ^ 2))
      (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2)) * (2 * y₀)) y₀ := by
    exact (Real.hasDerivAt_sqrt (ne_of_gt hpos)).comp y₀ hinner
  
  have hfirst : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ =>
      y • (EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)))
      ((1 : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)) y₀ :=
    (hasDerivAt_id y₀).smul_const _
  have hsecond : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ =>
      signedBranch β (Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) •
        EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ))
      (signedBranch β (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2)) * (2 * y₀)) •
        EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)) y₀ := by
    cases β
    · exact hsqrt.smul_const _
    · have h := (hsqrt.neg).smul_const
        (EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ))
      simpa [signedBranch] using h
  have hsum := hfirst.add hsecond
  have hcurve : ((fun y : ℝ =>
      y • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)) +
        fun y : ℝ => signedBranch β (Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y ^ 2)) •
          EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)) =
      fun y => pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc β s y) := by
    funext y
    rw [Pi.add_apply, pairToMorseParam]
    rfl
  rw [hcurve] at hsum
  have hDeq : ((1 : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ) +
      signedBranch β (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2)) * (2 * y₀)) •
        EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)) =
      signedBranch β ((Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2))⁻¹) •
        saddleChartTangent (pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc β s y₀)) := by
    apply euclideanFinTwo_ext
    · have hleft : ((1 : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ) +
          signedBranch β (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2)) * (2 * y₀)) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)) 0 = 1 := by
        rw [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply]
        simp
      have hright : (signedBranch β ((Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2))⁻¹) •
          saddleChartTangent (pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc β s y₀)))
            0 = signedBranch β ((Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2))⁻¹) *
              signedBranch β (Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2)) := by
        rw [PiLp.smul_apply, saddleChartTangent_apply_zero, smul_eq_mul]
        congr 1
        rw [pairToMorseParam_apply_one]
        rfl
      rw [hleft, hright]
      cases β <;> simp [signedBranch] <;> field_simp
    · have hleft : ((1 : ℝ) • EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ) +
          signedBranch β (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2)) * (2 * y₀)) •
            EuclideanSpace.single (1 : Fin 2) (1 : ℝ)) 1 =
          signedBranch β (1 / (2 * Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2)) *
            (2 * y₀)) := by
        rw [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, PiLp.smul_apply]
        simp
      have hright : (signedBranch β ((Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2))⁻¹) •
          saddleChartTangent (pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc β s y₀)))
            1 = signedBranch β ((Real.sqrt (s ^ 2 + y₀ ^ 2))⁻¹) * y₀ := by
        rw [PiLp.smul_apply, saddleChartTangent_apply_one, smul_eq_mul]
        congr 1
        rw [pairToMorseParam_apply_zero]
        rfl
      rw [hleft, hright]
      cases β <;> simp [signedBranch] <;> field_simp <;> try ring
  rw [← hDeq]
  exact hsum

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.fderiv_G_fderiv_param_eq_zero
statement:
theorem fderiv_G_fderiv_param_eq_zero
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center)
    {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} (hu : ‖u‖ < M.radius)
    (hCD : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 M.param u) (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    fderiv ℝ C.G (M.param u) (fderiv ℝ M.param u v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hPdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ M.param u :=
    hCD.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hball : Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) M.radius ∈
      𝓝 u := by
    apply Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
  have hev : (C.G ∘ M.param) =ᶠ[𝓝 u]
      (fun _ => (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) := by
    filter_upwards [hball] with w hw
    exact M.param_fiber w (by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hw)
  have hGdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ C.G (M.param u) :=
    (C.smooth.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt
  have hcomp := fderiv_comp u hGdiff hPdiff
  have hzero : fderiv ℝ (C.G ∘ M.param) u = 0 :=
    (Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev).trans (fderiv_const_apply _)
  have happ : (fderiv ℝ C.G (M.param u)).comp (fderiv ℝ M.param u) = 0 := by
    rw [← hcomp, hzero]
  have h := congrArg (fun L => L v) happ
  simpa using h

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.tcoord_fderiv_param_eq_zero
statement:
theorem tcoord_fderiv_param_eq_zero
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center)
    (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} (hu : ‖u‖ < M.radius)
    (hCD : ContDiffAt ℝ 1 M.param u) {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
    (hv : fderiv ℝ (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
      morseQuadratic .saddle (w 0, w 1)) u v = 0) :
    tcoord (fderiv ℝ M.param u v) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hPdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ M.param u :=
    hCD.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hball : Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) M.radius ∈
      𝓝 u := by
    apply Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hu
  have hev : (fun w => tcoord (M.param w)) =ᶠ[𝓝 u]
      (fun w => tcoord center + morseQuadratic .saddle (w 0, w 1)) := by
    filter_upwards [hball] with w hw
    have h := M.time_model w (by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hw)
    rw [hindex] at h
    exact h
  have hproj : HasFDerivAt (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) =>
      tcoord z) (EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (n + 1)) (𝕜 := ℝ))
      (M.param u) := by
    have hfun : (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) => tcoord z) =
        ⇑(EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (n + 1)) (𝕜 := ℝ)) := rfl
    rw [hfun]
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (n + 1)) (𝕜 := ℝ)).hasFDerivAt
  have hcompD : HasFDerivAt (fun w => tcoord (M.param w))
      ((EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (n + 1)) (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ M.param u)) u :=
    hproj.comp u hPdiff.hasFDerivAt
  have hfd1 : fderiv ℝ (fun w => tcoord (M.param w)) u =
      (EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (n + 1)) (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ M.param u) := hcompD.fderiv
  have hfd2 : fderiv ℝ (fun w => tcoord (M.param w)) u =
      fderiv ℝ (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        tcoord center + morseQuadratic .saddle (w 0, w 1)) u :=
    Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq hev
  have hfd3 : fderiv ℝ (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
      tcoord center + morseQuadratic .saddle (w 0, w 1)) u =
      fderiv ℝ (fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        morseQuadratic .saddle (w 0, w 1)) u := by
    have h := fderiv_const_add (𝕜 := ℝ)
      (f := fun w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        morseQuadratic .saddle (w 0, w 1)) (c := tcoord center) (x := u)
    exact h
  have hchain : (EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (n + 1)) (𝕜 := ℝ)).comp
      (fderiv ℝ M.param u) v = 0 := by
    rw [← hfd1, hfd2, hfd3]
    exact hv
  exact hchain

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.continuousOn_chartKernelPairing
statement:
theorem continuousOn_chartKernelPairing
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (hCD : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < M.radius →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 M.param u)
    {U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))}
    (hU : ∀ u ∈ U, ‖u‖ < T.radius) :
    ContinuousOn (chartKernelPairing M) U
proof:
:= by
  have hparam : ContinuousOn M.param U := by
    intro u hu
    exact ((hCD u ((hU u hu).trans_le T.radius_le)).differentiableAt
      (by simp)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hpair : ContinuousOn
      (fun u => ((tcoord (M.param u), spacePart (M.param u)) :
        ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) U :=
    (continuous_tcoord.comp_continuousOn hparam).prodMk
      (continuous_spacePart.comp_continuousOn hparam)
  have hker : ContinuousOn
      (fun u => kerCross (sliceMap C.G (tcoord (M.param u)))
        (spacePart (M.param u))) U := by
    have hcomp : (fun u => kerCross (sliceMap C.G (tcoord (M.param u)))
        (spacePart (M.param u))) =
        (fun q : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) =>
          kerCross (sliceMap C.G q.1) q.2) ∘
          (fun u => ((tcoord (M.param u), spacePart (M.param u)) :
            ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := rfl
    rw [hcomp]
    exact (contDiff_sliceKerCross C.smooth).continuous.comp_continuousOn
      hpair
  have hfder : ContinuousOn (fun u => fderiv ℝ M.param u) U := by
    intro u hu
    exact ((hCD u ((hU u hu).trans_le T.radius_le)).continuousAt_fderiv
      (by simp)).continuousWithinAt
  have htangent : ContinuousOn
      (fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => saddleChartTangent u) U := by
    apply Continuous.continuousOn
    unfold saddleChartTangent pairToMorseParam
    apply Continuous.add
    · exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2) (𝕜 := ℝ)).continuous).smul
        continuous_const
    · exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2) (𝕜 := ℝ)).continuous).smul
        continuous_const
  have happly : ContinuousOn
      (fun u => fderiv ℝ M.param u (saddleChartTangent u)) U :=
    hfder.clm_apply htangent
  have hspace : ContinuousOn
      (fun u => spacePart (fderiv ℝ M.param u (saddleChartTangent u))) U :=
    continuous_spacePart.comp_continuousOn happly
  exact hker.inner hspace

statement:
theorem productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_chartBandCoverWinding
    {a : ℕ} (KB : ProductionMorseSaddleChartBandCoverWindingInputs a) :
    ProductionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies a
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y SX SY SC D t ht hpositive hindex
  have hcov : 0 < (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius_pos
  have hsafe : D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 ≤
      (D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).safeTime := by
    rw [D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField_safeTime t ht]
    have h := D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime t ht
    rwa [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)] at h
  have hcoverprop : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2)),
      dist v (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius →
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖u‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius ∧
          (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u = v :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).covers_fiber.choose_spec.2
  obtain ⟨hmergeCase, hsplitCase⟩ :=
    KB (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
      (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht)
      (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht)
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2) (by linarith)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht) hsafe
      (fun v hv hzero => hcoverprop v (by linarith) hzero)
      (fun u hu =>
        D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink_param_dist_lt_half_cover t ht hu)
      (by
        have h := D.chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_half_cover t ht
        rw [D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField_base t ht]
        exact h)
  have hdim : 3 ≤ a + 2 + 1 := by omega
  have hcircle := productionMorseSaddleChartCircleFrameClassOne a
    (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  constructor
  · intro Htop
    obtain ⟨Bd, ⟨W⟩⟩ := hmergeCase Htop.negative_ne Htop.positive_eq
    obtain ⟨H, hreg, hHclosed⟩ :=
      exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartWindingLoop
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) W
    have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) Bd.marking H
      hreg hHclosed
    exact ⟨orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim Bd.marking
      (Bd.marking.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
        (hF.trans hcircle))⟩
  · intro Htop
    obtain ⟨Bd, ⟨W⟩⟩ := hsplitCase Htop.positive_ne Htop.negative_eq
    obtain ⟨H, hreg, hHclosed⟩ :=
      exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartWindingLoop
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) W
    have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) Bd.marking H
      hreg hHclosed
    exact ⟨orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim Bd.marking
      (Bd.marking.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
        (hF.trans hcircle))⟩

statement:
theorem slabFiber_one_zero
    (D : LevelCobordismData n) : slabFiber D 1 0 = ∅
proof:

  ext v
  simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.nonempty
proof:
:= by
  let D := C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
  let K := C.positiveSlabCore a b
  have hKcompact : IsCompact K := C.isCompact_positiveSlabCore a b
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂pos, hδ₂sub⟩ :=
    hKcompact.exists_cthickening_subset_open
      (isOpen_slabRegularSet C.cobordism.smooth) hKsub
  set δ := δ₂ / 2 with hδdef
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by positivity
  have h2δ : 2 * δ = δ₂ := by rw [hδdef]; ring
  have hsub : Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) K ⊆
      slabRegularSet C.cobordism.G := by
    rw [h2δ]
    exact hδ₂sub
  have hs : IsClosed (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) K)ᶜ :=
    Metric.isOpen_thickening.isClosed_compl
  have ht : IsClosed (Metric.cthickening δ K) :=
    Metric.isClosed_cthickening
  have hd : Disjoint (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) K)ᶜ
      (Metric.cthickening δ K) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hx'
    exact hx (Metric.cthickening_subset_thickening'
      (by positivity) (by linarith) K hx')
  obtain ⟨f, hf0, hf1, hf01⟩ :=
    exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_of_isClosed
      (I := modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E₂) (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) hs ht hd
  have hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (⇑f) := by
    rw [← contMDiff_iff_contDiff]
    exact f.contMDiff
  let w : E₂ → E₂ := fun x => f x • timeField C.cobordism.G x
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ w := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ slabRegularSet C.cobordism.G
    · exact hχ.contDiffAt.smul
        (contDiffAt_timeField C.cobordism.smooth hx)
    · have hxC : x ∈ (Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) K)ᶜ :=
        fun hmem => hx (hsub hmem)
      have hU : IsOpen (Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) K)ᶜ :=
        Metric.isClosed_cthickening.isOpen_compl
      have hzero : ∀ y ∈ (Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) K)ᶜ, w y = 0 := by
        intro y hy
        have hy' : y ∈ (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) K)ᶜ :=
          fun hmem => hy (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _ hmem)
        have hfy : f y = 0 := hf0 hy'
        simp [w, hfy]
      have hev : w =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : E₂)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hxC) hzero
      exact (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : E₂))).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  have hsupp : HasCompactSupport w := by
    have h1 : support w ⊆ Metric.thickening (2 * δ) K := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hmem
      have hfx : f x = 0 := hf0 hmem
      apply hx
      simp [w, hfx]
    have h2 : tsupport w ⊆ Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) K :=
      closure_minimal (h1.trans (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _))
        Metric.isClosed_cthickening
    exact IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset hKcompact.cthickening
      isClosed_closure h2
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (timeField C.cobordism.G)
      (Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) K) := fun x hx =>
    (contDiffAt_timeField C.cobordism.smooth
      (hsub hx)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hKcompact.cthickening.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont
  have hnorm : ∀ x, ‖w x‖ ≤ Real.toNNReal M := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) K
    · have h1 : ‖f x‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
        exact ⟨by linarith [(hf01 x).1], (hf01 x).2⟩
      calc
        ‖w x‖ = ‖f x‖ * ‖timeField C.cobordism.G x‖ := by
          change ‖f x • timeField C.cobordism.G x‖ = _
          rw [norm_smul]
        _ ≤ 1 * M := by
          apply mul_le_mul h1 (hM x hx) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = M := one_mul M
        _ ≤ Real.toNNReal M := Real.le_coe_toNNReal M
    · have hx' : x ∈ (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) K)ᶜ :=
        fun hmem => hx (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _ hmem)
      have hfx : f x = 0 := hf0 hx'
      change ‖f x • timeField C.cobordism.G x‖ ≤ _
      rw [hfx, zero_smul, norm_zero]
      exact (Real.toNNReal M).coe_nonneg
  have heq : ∀ x ∈ Metric.cthickening δ K,
      w x = timeField C.cobordism.G x := by
    intro x hx
    have hfx : f x = 1 := hf1 hx
    simp [w, hfx]
  have hsmallsub : Metric.cthickening δ K ⊆
      slabRegularSet C.cobordism.G := by
    intro x hx
    apply hsub
    exact Metric.cthickening_mono (by linarith) K hx
  have hker : ∀ x, fderiv ℝ C.cobordism.G x (w x) = 0 := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) K
    · have hxr := hsub hx
      change fderiv ℝ C.cobordism.G x
        (f x • timeField C.cobordism.G x) = 0
      rw [map_smul, fderiv_timeField hxr.1, smul_zero]
    · have hx' : x ∈ (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) K)ᶜ :=
        fun hmem => hx (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _ hmem)
      have hfx : f x = 0 := hf0 hx'
      change fderiv ℝ C.cobordism.G x
        (f x • timeField C.cobordism.G x) = 0
      rw [hfx, zero_smul, map_zero]
  have hlip : ∃ L : NNReal, LipschitzWith L w :=
    hsmooth.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hsupp (by simp)
  let W₀ : SlabTamedField D 1 0 :=
    { w := w
      delta := δ
      delta_pos := hδpos
      smooth := hsmooth
      bound := Real.toNNReal M
      norm_le := hnorm
      eq_time := by
        intro x hx
        exfalso
        rw [slabFiber_one_zero D, Metric.cthickening_empty] at hx
        exact hx
      subset_slabRegular := by
        intro x hx
        exfalso
        rw [slabFiber_one_zero D, Metric.cthickening_empty] at hx
        exact hx
      fderiv_zero := hker
      lipschitz := hlip }
  exact ⟨⟨W₀, δ, hδpos, heq, hsmallsub⟩⟩

:= by
  let γ : C(Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, E₂) :=
    ⟨fun u => W.flow p ((u : ℝ) * s),
      (W.continuous_flow p).comp
