name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.tcoord_flow_Icc
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => tcoord (W.flow p s)
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => t₀ + s
  let S : Set ℝ := Icc l u
  let A : Set ℝ := {s | s ∈ S ∧ f s = g s}
  have hSpre : IsPreconnected S := (convex_Icc l u).isPreconnected
  have hAS : A ⊆ S := fun _ hs => hs.1
  have hfcont : Continuous f := continuous_tcoord.comp (W.continuous_flow p)
  have hgcont : Continuous g := continuous_const.add continuous_id
  have hAclosed : IsClosed A :=
    isClosed_Icc.inter (isClosed_eq hfcont hgcont)
  have hAopen : ∀ s ∈ A, ∃ r > 0, S ∩ Metric.ball s r ⊆ A := by
    intro s hsA
    have hsS : s ∈ Icc l u := hsA.1
    have hqFiber : W.flow p s ∈
        C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber :=
      W.flow_mem_fiber hp s
    have hqTime : tcoord (W.flow p s) = t₀ + s := hsA.2
    have hqPos : 0 < C (W.flow p s) := (W.pos_iff_flow hp s).mp hppos
    have hqCore : W.flow p s ∈ C.positiveSlabCore a b := by
      refine ⟨hqFiber, ?_, hqPos.le⟩
      rw [hqTime]
      constructor <;> linarith [hsS.1, hsS.2]
    have hopen : IsOpen ((W.flow p) ⁻¹'
        Metric.ball (W.flow p s) W.delta) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (W.continuous_flow p)
    have hmem : s ∈ (W.flow p) ⁻¹'
        Metric.ball (W.flow p s) W.delta :=
      Metric.mem_ball_self W.delta_pos
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen s hmem
    refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
    have hcollar : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball s r,
        W.flow p q ∈ Metric.cthickening W.delta
          (C.positiveSlabCore a b) := by
      intro q hq
      have hqBall : W.flow p q ∈ Metric.ball (W.flow p s) W.delta :=
        hrsub hq
      apply Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening
      exact Metric.mem_thickening_iff.mpr
        ⟨W.flow p s, hqCore, hqBall⟩
    have hfderiv : ∀ q ∈ Metric.ball s r, HasDerivAt f 1 q := by
      intro q hq
      have hflow := W.base.hasDerivAt_flow p q
      have hproj :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (n + 1)) (𝕜 := ℝ)).hasFDerivAt.comp
          q hflow.hasFDerivAt
      have ht : HasDerivAt f (tcoord (W.base.w (W.flow p q))) q := by
        simpa [f, tcoord, Function.comp_def] using hproj.hasDerivAt
      have hc := hcollar q hq
      have hspeed : tcoord (W.base.w (W.flow p q)) = 1 := by
        rw [W.eq_time _ hc]
        exact tcoord_timeField (W.subset_slabRegular hc)
      rwa [hspeed] at ht
    have hfg : Set.EqOn f g (Metric.ball s r) := by
      apply Metric.isOpen_ball.eqOn_of_deriv_eq
        (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
      · intro q hq
        exact (hfderiv q hq).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      · exact ((differentiable_const t₀).add differentiable_id).differentiableOn
      · intro q hq
        rw [(hfderiv q hq).deriv]
        simp [g]
      · exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr
      · exact hsA.2
    rintro q ⟨hqS, hqBall⟩
    exact ⟨hqS, hfg hqBall⟩
  have hA0 : A.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨0, ⟨⟨hl, hu⟩, ?_⟩⟩
    simp [f, g, hpt]
  have hSA : S ⊆ A :=
    subset_of_relOpen_closed hSpre hAS hAclosed hAopen hA0
  intro s hs
  exact (hSA hs).2

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.sliceTransport_mapsTo
statement:
theorem sliceTransport_mapsTo {t₁ t₂ : ℝ}
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b) :
    MapsTo (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂)
      (positiveSliceFiber C t₁) (positiveSliceFiber C t₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let p : E₂ := cobSpaceTime x t₁
  let d : ℝ := t₂ - t₁
  have hp : p ∈ C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber := hx.1
  have hppos : 0 < C p := hx.2
  have hpt : tcoord p = t₁ := tcoord_spaceTime x t₁
  have htflow : tcoord (W.flow p d) = t₂ := by
    rcases le_total t₁ t₂ with hle | hle
    · have hd : 0 ≤ d := by dsimp [d]; linarith
      have hb' : t₁ + d ≤ b := by dsimp [d]; linarith [ht₂.2]
      have h := W.tcoord_flow_segment hp hppos hpt hd ht₁.1 hb'
        d ⟨hd, le_rfl⟩
      dsimp [d] at h ⊢
      linarith
    · have hd : d ≤ 0 := by dsimp [d]; linarith
      have ha' : a ≤ t₁ + d := by dsimp [d]; linarith [ht₂.1]
      have hb' : t₁ + 0 ≤ b := by linarith [ht₁.2]
      have h := W.tcoord_flow_Icc hp hppos hpt hd hd le_rfl
        ha' hb' d ⟨le_rfl, hd⟩
      dsimp [d] at h ⊢
      linarith
  have hqFiber := W.flow_mem_fiber hp d
  have hqPos : 0 < C (W.flow p d) := (W.pos_iff_flow hp d).mp hppos
  have hspace : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (W.flow p d)) t₂ = W.flow p d := by
    rw [← htflow, spaceTime_spacePart]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change C.cobordism.G
      (cobSpaceTime (spacePart (W.flow p d)) t₂) = 0
    rw [hspace]
    exact hqFiber
  · change 0 < C (cobSpaceTime (spacePart (W.flow p d)) t₂)
    rw [hspace]
    exact hqPos

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.cobSpaceTime_sliceTransport
statement:
theorem cobSpaceTime_sliceTransport {t₁ t₂ : ℝ}
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    {x : E₁} (hx : x ∈ positiveSliceFiber C t₁) :
    cobSpaceTime (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ x) t₂ =
      W.flow (cobSpaceTime x t₁) (t₂ - t₁)
proof:
:= by
  let p : E₂ := cobSpaceTime x t₁
  let d : ℝ := t₂ - t₁
  have hp : p ∈ C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber := hx.1
  have hppos : 0 < C p := hx.2
  have hpt : tcoord p = t₁ := tcoord_spaceTime x t₁
  have htflow : tcoord (W.flow p d) = t₂ := by
    rcases le_total t₁ t₂ with hle | hle
    · have hd : 0 ≤ d := by dsimp [d]; linarith
      have hb' : t₁ + d ≤ b := by dsimp [d]; linarith [ht₂.2]
      have h := W.tcoord_flow_segment hp hppos hpt hd ht₁.1 hb'
        d ⟨hd, le_rfl⟩
      dsimp [d] at h ⊢
      linarith
    · have hd : d ≤ 0 := by dsimp [d]; linarith
      have ha' : a ≤ t₁ + d := by dsimp [d]; linarith [ht₂.1]
      have hb' : t₁ + 0 ≤ b := by linarith [ht₁.2]
      have h := W.tcoord_flow_Icc hp hppos hpt hd hd le_rfl
        ha' hb' d ⟨le_rfl, hd⟩
      dsimp [d] at h ⊢
      linarith
  unfold sliceTransport
  change cobSpaceTime (spacePart (W.flow p d)) t₂ = W.flow p d
  rw [← htflow, spaceTime_spacePart]

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.sliceTransport_leftInverse
statement:
theorem sliceTransport_leftInverse {t₁ t₂ : ℝ}
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    {x : E₁} (hx : x ∈ positiveSliceFiber C t₁) :
    W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁ (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  let p : E₂ := cobSpaceTime x t₁
  let d : ℝ := t₂ - t₁
  have hspace := W.cobSpaceTime_sliceTransport ht₁ ht₂ hx
  unfold sliceTransport
  change spacePart (W.flow
    (cobSpaceTime (spacePart (W.flow p d)) t₂) (t₁ - t₂)) = x
  change cobSpaceTime (spacePart (W.flow p d)) t₂ = W.flow p d at hspace
  rw [hspace]
  have hshift := congrFun (W.base.flow_shift p d) (t₁ - t₂)
  have hshift' : W.flow (W.flow p d) (t₁ - t₂) =
      W.flow p (d + (t₁ - t₂)) := hshift
  rw [hshift']
  have htime : d + (t₁ - t₂) = 0 := by dsimp [d]; ring
  rw [htime, W.flow_zero]
  exact spacePart_spaceTime x t₁

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.sliceTransport_bijOn
statement:
theorem sliceTransport_bijOn {t₁ t₂ : ℝ}
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b) :
    Set.BijOn (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂)
      (positiveSliceFiber C t₁) (positiveSliceFiber C t₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨W.sliceTransport_mapsTo ht₁ ht₂, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    have h := congrArg (W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁) hxy
    simpa [W.sliceTransport_leftInverse ht₁ ht₂ hx,
      W.sliceTransport_leftInverse ht₁ ht₂ hy] using h
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁ y,
      W.sliceTransport_mapsTo ht₂ ht₁ hy, ?_⟩
    exact W.sliceTransport_leftInverse ht₂ ht₁ hy

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.exists_continuous_bijOn_positiveSlices_of_negative_event
statement:
theorem exists_continuous_bijOn_positiveSlices_of_negative_event
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    (P : MorsePosition C.cobordism) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ P.eventTimes)
    (hnegative : P.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (C.labelMorsePosition P).negativeCenters) :
    ∃ f : E₁ → E₁,
      Continuous f ∧
      Set.BijOn f
        ((C.sliceSign (P.eventBracket t ht).before
          (P.eventBracket t ht).before_regular).positivePart)
        ((C.sliceSign (P.eventBracket t ht).after
          (P.eventBracket t ht).after_regular).positivePart)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := nonempty_of_negative_event C P ht hnegative
  let hab : (P.eventBracket t ht).before ≤
      (P.eventBracket t ht).after :=
    ((P.eventBracket t ht).before_lt.trans
      (P.eventBracket t ht).lt_after).le
  let hbefore : (P.eventBracket t ht).before ∈
      Icc (P.eventBracket t ht).before (P.eventBracket t ht).after :=
    ⟨le_rfl, hab⟩
  let hafter : (P.eventBracket t ht).after ∈
      Icc (P.eventBracket t ht).before (P.eventBracket t ht).after :=
    ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩
  refine ⟨W.sliceTransport (P.eventBracket t ht).before
      (P.eventBracket t ht).after,
    W.continuous_sliceTransport _ _, ?_⟩
  rw [← positiveSliceFiber_eq_positivePart C _
      (P.eventBracket t ht).before_regular,
    ← positiveSliceFiber_eq_positivePart C _
      (P.eventBracket t ht).after_regular]
  exact W.sliceTransport_bijOn hbefore hafter

name: Submission.doubleClampI_coe

name: Submission.halfPoint_coe

name: Submission.doubleClampI_halfPoint

  apply Subtype.ext

name: Submission.doubleClampI_zero

name: Submission.doubleClampI_mono

name: Submission.doubleClampCombine_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem doubleClampCombine_apply (f : C(I, ℝ)) (c : ℝ) (u : I) :
    doubleClampCombine f c u =
      f (doubleClampI u) + c * max (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) 0
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.doubleClampCombine_halfPoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem doubleClampCombine_halfPoint (f : C(I, ℝ)) (c : ℝ) (q : I) :
    doubleClampCombine f c (halfPoint q) = f q
proof:
:= by
  rw [doubleClampCombine_apply, doubleClampI_halfPoint, halfPoint_coe,
    show 2 * ((q : ℝ) / 2) - 1 = (q : ℝ) - 1 by ring,
    max_eq_right (by linarith [q.2.2])]
  ring

name: Submission.doubleClampCombine_zero

@[simp] theorem doubleClampCombine_zero (f : C(I, ℝ)) (c : ℝ) :

proof:
:= by

name: Submission.doubleClampCombine_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem doubleClampCombine_one (f : C(I, ℝ)) (c : ℝ) :
    doubleClampCombine f c 1 = f 1 + c
proof:

name: Submission.strictMono_doubleClampCombine
statement:
theorem strictMono_doubleClampCombine {f : C(I, ℝ)} (hf : StrictMono f)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) : StrictMono (doubleClampCombine f c)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  have hlt : (u : ℝ) < (v : ℝ) := huv
  have hramp : max (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) 0 ≤ max (2 * (v : ℝ) - 1) 0 :=
    max_le_max (by linarith) le_rfl
  have hdbl : doubleClampI u ≤ doubleClampI v := doubleClampI_mono huv.le
  rw [doubleClampCombine_apply, doubleClampCombine_apply]
  rcases lt_or_ge (u : ℝ) (1 / 2) with hu | hu
  · have hstrict : doubleClampI u < doubleClampI v := by
      rw [← Subtype.coe_lt_coe, doubleClampI_coe, doubleClampI_coe]
      have h1 : min (2 * (u : ℝ)) 1 = 2 * (u : ℝ) := min_eq_left (by linarith)
      rw [h1]
      rcases le_or_gt (2 * (v : ℝ)) 1 with hv | hv
      · rw [min_eq_left hv]; linarith
      · rw [min_eq_right hv.le]; linarith
    have := hf hstrict
    have hmul : c * max (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) 0 ≤ c * max (2 * (v : ℝ) - 1) 0 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hramp hc.le
    linarith
  · have hv : 1 / 2 < (v : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hmu : max (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) 0 = 2 * (u : ℝ) - 1 :=
      max_eq_left (by linarith)
    have hmv : max (2 * (v : ℝ) - 1) 0 = 2 * (v : ℝ) - 1 :=
      max_eq_left (by linarith)
    have hstrict : c * max (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) 0 < c * max (2 * (v : ℝ) - 1) 0 := by
      rw [hmu, hmv]
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by linarith) hc
    have := hf.monotone hdbl
    linarith

name: Submission.strictAnti_doubleClampCombine
statement:
theorem strictAnti_doubleClampCombine {f : C(I, ℝ)} (hf : StrictAnti f)
    {c : ℝ} (hc : c < 0) : StrictAnti (doubleClampCombine f c)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  have hlt : (u : ℝ) < (v : ℝ) := huv
  have hramp : max (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) 0 ≤ max (2 * (v : ℝ) - 1) 0 :=
    max_le_max (by linarith) le_rfl
  have hdbl : doubleClampI u ≤ doubleClampI v := doubleClampI_mono huv.le
  rw [doubleClampCombine_apply, doubleClampCombine_apply]
  rcases lt_or_ge (u : ℝ) (1 / 2) with hu | hu
  · have hstrict : doubleClampI u < doubleClampI v := by
      rw [← Subtype.coe_lt_coe, doubleClampI_coe, doubleClampI_coe]
      have h1 : min (2 * (u : ℝ)) 1 = 2 * (u : ℝ) := min_eq_left (by linarith)
      rw [h1]
      rcases le_or_gt (2 * (v : ℝ)) 1 with hv | hv
      · rw [min_eq_left hv]; linarith
      · rw [min_eq_right hv.le]; linarith
    have := hf hstrict
    have hmul : c * max (2 * (v : ℝ) - 1) 0 ≤ c * max (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) 0 := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hramp (neg_nonneg.mpr hc.le)
      nlinarith
    linarith
  · have hv : 1 / 2 < (v : ℝ) := by linarith
    have hmu : max (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) 0 = 2 * (u : ℝ) - 1 :=
      max_eq_left (by linarith)
    have hmv : max (2 * (v : ℝ) - 1) 0 = 2 * (v : ℝ) - 1 :=
      max_eq_left (by linarith)
    have hstrict : c * max (2 * (v : ℝ) - 1) 0 < c * max (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) 0 := by
      rw [hmu, hmv]
      have : (2 : ℝ) * (u : ℝ) - 1 < 2 * (v : ℝ) - 1 := by linarith
      nlinarith
    have := hf.antitone hdbl
    linarith

name: Submission.eq_cases_of_strictMono_period
statement:
theorem eq_cases_of_strictMono_period {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T) {Phi : I → ℝ}
    (hmono : StrictMono Phi) (h0 : Phi 0 = 0) (h1 : Phi 1 = T)
    {u v : I} {k : ℤ} (hk : Phi u - Phi v = (k : ℝ) * T) :
    u = v ∨ (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ Phi u := by rw [← h0]; exact hmono.monotone u.2.1
  have hu1 : Phi u ≤ T := by rw [← h1]; exact hmono.monotone u.2.2
  have hv0 : 0 ≤ Phi v := by rw [← h0]; exact hmono.monotone v.2.1
  have hv1 : Phi v ≤ T := by rw [← h1]; exact hmono.monotone v.2.2
  have hkle : (k : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hkge : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by nlinarith
  have hkle' : k ≤ 1 := by exact_mod_cast hkle
  have hkge' : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ k := by exact_mod_cast hkge
  interval_cases k
  · 
    right; left
    have hPu : Phi u = 0 := by push_cast at hk; linarith
    have hPv : Phi v = T := by push_cast at hk; linarith
    exact ⟨hmono.injective (by rw [hPu, h0]), hmono.injective (by rw [hPv, h1])⟩
  · 
    left
    apply hmono.injective
    push_cast at hk
    linarith
  · 
    right; right
    have hPu : Phi u = T := by push_cast at hk; linarith
    have hPv : Phi v = 0 := by push_cast at hk; linarith
    exact ⟨hmono.injective (by rw [hPu, h1]), hmono.injective (by rw [hPv, h0])⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.coe_orbitCircleHomeomorph_add
statement:
theorem coe_orbitCircleHomeomorph_add
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber)
    (c : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod hp)) (t : ℝ) :
    ((V.orbitCircleHomeomorph hp
          (c + (t : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod hp))) :
        ↥(V.orbit p)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) =
      V.flow ((V.orbitCircleHomeomorph hp c : ↥(V.orbit p)) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective c
  have h1 : ((s : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod hp)) +
      (t : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod hp))) =
      ((s + t : ℝ) : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod hp)) := rfl
  rw [h1, V.orbitCircleHomeomorph_coe, V.orbitCircleHomeomorph_coe,
    congrFun (V.flow_shift p s) t]

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitCircleHomeomorph_arcPhase
statement:
theorem orbitCircleHomeomorph_arcPhase (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) (u : I) :
    ((V.orbitCircleHomeomorph hp (V.arcPhase psi hp hmem u) :
        ↥(V.orbit (psi 0))) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) = psi u
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val ((V.orbitCircleHomeomorph hp).apply_symm_apply _)

name: Submission.TamedField.arcPhase_zero
statement:
theorem arcPhase_zero (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) :
    V.arcPhase psi hp hmem 0 = ((0 : ℝ) : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod hp))
proof:
:= by
  apply (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph hp).injective
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [V.orbitCircleHomeomorph_arcPhase psi hp hmem 0, V.orbitCircleHomeomorph_coe,
    V.flow_zero]

name: Submission.TamedField.arcLift_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem arcLift_zero (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) :
    V.arcLift psi hp hmem 0 = 0
proof:

name: Submission.TamedField.arcLift_coe
statement:
theorem arcLift_coe (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) (u : I) :
    ((V.arcLift psi hp hmem u : ℝ) : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod hp)) =
      V.arcPhase psi hp hmem u
proof:
:= by
  letI : Fact (0 < V.fundamentalPeriod hp) := ⟨V.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp⟩
  have h := congrFun
    ((AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe (V.fundamentalPeriod hp)).liftPath_lifts
      (V.arcPhase psi hp hmem) 0 (V.arcPhase_zero psi hp hmem)) u
  simpa [arcLift] using h

name: Submission.TamedField.arc_eq_flow_arcLift
statement:
theorem arc_eq_flow_arcLift (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) (u : I) :
    V.flow (psi 0) (V.arcLift psi hp hmem u) = psi u
proof:
:= by
  rw [← V.orbitCircleHomeomorph_coe hp (V.arcLift psi hp hmem u),
    V.arcLift_coe psi hp hmem u]
  exact V.orbitCircleHomeomorph_arcPhase psi hp hmem u

name: Submission.TamedField.arcLift_injective
statement:
theorem arcLift_injective (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) (hinj : Injective psi) :
    Injective (V.arcLift psi hp hmem)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  apply hinj
  rw [← V.arc_eq_flow_arcLift psi hp hmem u, ← V.arc_eq_flow_arcLift psi hp hmem v,
    huv]

name: Submission.TamedField.arcLift_strictMono_or_strictAnti
statement:
theorem arcLift_strictMono_or_strictAnti (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) (hinj : Injective psi) :
    StrictMono (V.arcLift psi hp hmem) ∨ StrictAnti (V.arcLift psi hp hmem)
proof:
:=
  (V.arcLift psi hp hmem).continuous.strictMono_of_inj_boundedOrder'
    (V.arcLift_injective psi hp hmem hinj)

name: Submission.TamedField.abs_arcLift_one_lt
statement:
theorem abs_arcLift_one_lt (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) (hinj : Injective psi) :
    |V.arcLift psi hp hmem 1| < V.fundamentalPeriod hp
proof:
:= by
  set T := V.fundamentalPeriod hp with hT
  have hTpos : 0 < T := V.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  
  have hcont : Continuous (V.arcLift psi hp hmem) := (V.arcLift psi hp hmem).continuous
  have hzero : V.arcLift psi hp hmem 0 = 0 := V.arcLift_zero psi hp hmem
  have hkey : ∃ w : I, V.arcLift psi hp hmem w = T ∨
      V.arcLift psi hp hmem w = -T := by
    rcases le_or_gt 0 (V.arcLift psi hp hmem 1) with hpos | hneg
    · have hge : T ≤ V.arcLift psi hp hmem 1 := by
        rwa [abs_of_nonneg hpos] at hcon
      have hmem' : T ∈ Icc (V.arcLift psi hp hmem 0) (V.arcLift psi hp hmem 1) := by
        rw [hzero]; exact ⟨hTpos.le, hge⟩
      obtain ⟨w, -, hw⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (a := (0 : I)) (b := (1 : I))
        (by exact zero_le_one) (Continuous.continuousOn hcont) hmem'
      exact ⟨w, Or.inl hw⟩
    · have hge : T ≤ -V.arcLift psi hp hmem 1 := by
        rwa [abs_of_neg hneg] at hcon
      have hmem' : -T ∈ Icc (V.arcLift psi hp hmem 1) (V.arcLift psi hp hmem 0) := by
        rw [hzero]; constructor <;> linarith
      obtain ⟨w, -, hw⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (a := (0 : I)) (b := (1 : I))
        (by exact zero_le_one) (Continuous.continuousOn hcont) hmem'
      exact ⟨w, Or.inr hw⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hkey
  have hzcoe : ((0 : ℝ) : AddCircle T) = 0 := by
    exact (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff T).mpr ⟨0, by simp⟩
  have hphase : V.arcPhase psi hp hmem w = V.arcPhase psi hp hmem 0 := by
    rw [← V.arcLift_coe psi hp hmem w, ← V.arcLift_coe psi hp hmem 0, hzero, hzcoe]
    rcases hw with hw | hw
    · rw [hw]
      exact (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff T).mpr ⟨1, by simp⟩
    · rw [hw]
      exact (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff T).mpr ⟨-1, by simp⟩
  have hpsi : psi w = psi 0 := by
    have h1 := V.orbitCircleHomeomorph_arcPhase psi hp hmem w
    have h2 := V.orbitCircleHomeomorph_arcPhase psi hp hmem 0
    rw [hphase] at h1
    exact h1.symm.trans h2
  have hw0 : w = 0 := hinj hpsi
  rw [hw0, hzero] at hw
  rcases hw with hw | hw
  · linarith
  · linarith

name: Submission.TamedField.arcLoopLift_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem arcLoopLift_zero (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)

name: Submission.TamedField.arcLoopLift_one
statement:
theorem arcLoopLift_one (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) :
    V.arcLoopLift psi hp hmem 1 =
      if 0 < V.arcLift psi hp hmem 1 then V.fundamentalPeriod hp
        else -V.fundamentalPeriod hp
proof:
:= by
  rw [arcLoopLift, doubleClampCombine_one, arcCloseTime]
  split <;> ring

name: Submission.TamedField.arcLift_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem arcLift_one_ne_zero (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) (hinj : Injective psi) :
    V.arcLift psi hp hmem 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 : V.arcLift psi hp hmem 1 = V.arcLift psi hp hmem 0 := by
    rw [h, V.arcLift_zero]
  have := V.arcLift_injective psi hp hmem hinj h0
  exact one_ne_zero this

name: Submission.TamedField.arcLoopLift_strictMono_or_strictAnti
statement:
theorem arcLoopLift_strictMono_or_strictAnti (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) (hinj : Injective psi) :
    (StrictMono (V.arcLoopLift psi hp hmem) ∧
        V.arcLoopLift psi hp hmem 1 = V.fundamentalPeriod hp) ∨
      (StrictAnti (V.arcLoopLift psi hp hmem) ∧
        V.arcLoopLift psi hp hmem 1 = -V.fundamentalPeriod hp)
proof:
:= by
  have habs := V.abs_arcLift_one_lt psi hp hmem hinj
  have hne := V.arcLift_one_ne_zero psi hp hmem hinj
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hneg | hpos
  · right
    have hanti : StrictAnti (V.arcLift psi hp hmem) := by
      rcases V.arcLift_strictMono_or_strictAnti psi hp hmem hinj with h | h
      · exfalso
        have := h (show (0 : I) < 1 by exact zero_lt_one)
        rw [V.arcLift_zero] at this
        linarith
      · exact h
    have hcpos : V.arcCloseTime psi hp hmem < 0 := by
      rw [arcCloseTime, if_neg (by linarith)]
      have := abs_lt.mp habs
      linarith [this.1]
    refine ⟨strictAnti_doubleClampCombine hanti hcpos, ?_⟩
    rw [V.arcLoopLift_one psi hp hmem, if_neg (by linarith)]
  · left
    have hmono : StrictMono (V.arcLift psi hp hmem) := by
      rcases V.arcLift_strictMono_or_strictAnti psi hp hmem hinj with h | h
      · exact h
      · exfalso
        have := h (show (0 : I) < 1 by exact zero_lt_one)
        rw [V.arcLift_zero] at this
        linarith
    have hcpos : 0 < V.arcCloseTime psi hp hmem := by
      rw [arcCloseTime, if_pos hpos]
      have := abs_lt.mp habs
      linarith [this.2]
    refine ⟨strictMono_doubleClampCombine hmono hcpos, ?_⟩
    rw [V.arcLoopLift_one psi hp hmem, if_pos hpos]

name: Submission.TamedField.arcLoopCurve_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem arcLoopCurve_apply (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) (u : I) :
    V.arcLoopCurve psi hp hmem u =
      V.flow (psi 0) (V.arcLoopLift psi hp hmem u)

statement:
theorem arcLoopCurve_halfPoint (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) (q : I) :
    V.arcLoopCurve psi hp hmem (halfPoint q) = psi q
proof:
:= by
  rw [arcLoopCurve_apply, V.arcLoopLift_halfPoint psi hp hmem q,
    V.arc_eq_flow_arcLift psi hp hmem q]

name: Submission.TamedField.arcLoopCurve_zero
statement:
theorem arcLoopCurve_zero (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) :
    V.arcLoopCurve psi hp hmem 0 = psi 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [arcLoopCurve_apply, V.arcLoopLift_zero psi hp hmem, V.flow_zero]

name: Submission.TamedField.arcLoopCurve_closed
statement:
theorem arcLoopCurve_closed (hp : psi 0 ∈ X.fiber)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, psi u ∈ V.orbit (psi 0)) (hinj : Injective psi) :
    V.arcLoopCurve psi hp hmem 0 = V.arcLoopCurve psi hp hmem 1
proof:
:= by
  have hper := V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp
  rw [arcLoopCurve_apply, arcLoopCurve_apply, V.arcLoopLift_zero psi hp hmem]
  rcases V.arcLoopLift_strictMono_or_strictAnti psi hp hmem hinj with ⟨-, h⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
  · rw [h]
    have := hper 0
    rw [zero_add] at this
    rw [this]
  · rw [h]
    have := hper (-V.fundamentalPeriod hp)
    rw [neg_add_cancel] at this
    rw [← this]

name: Submission.TamedField.arcClosedOrbitParam_p
statement:

name: Submission.sliceAmbientSubarc_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem sliceAmbientSubarc_mem_fiber
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C tafter hafter) Vafter)

proof:

    (P.curve_mem_orbit (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q))

name: Submission.transportedSubarc_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem transportedSubarc_apply (R : CompactTimeTamedField C K)
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C tafter hafter) Vafter)
    (c₀ c₁ : I) (d : ℝ) (q : I) :

      spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime (P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q)) tafter) d)

name: Submission.cobSpaceTime_transportedSubarc
statement:
theorem cobSpaceTime_transportedSubarc (R : CompactTimeTamedField C K)
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C tafter hafter) Vafter)
    (c₀ c₁ : I) (d : ℝ) {tbefore : ℝ} (q : I)
    (htime : tcoord (R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc c₀ c₁ q) d) = tbefore) :
    cobSpaceTime (transportedSubarc R P c₀ c₁ d q) tbefore =
      R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc c₀ c₁ q) d
proof:
:= by
  rw [← htime]

name: Submission.transportedSubarc_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem transportedSubarc_mem_fiber (R : CompactTimeTamedField C K)
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C tafter hafter) Vafter)
    (c₀ c₁ : I) (d : ℝ) {tbefore : ℝ} (hbefore : sliceRegular C.G tbefore) (q : I)
    (htime : tcoord (R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc c₀ c₁ q) d) = tbefore) :
    transportedSubarc R P c₀ c₁ d q ∈
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C tbefore hbefore).fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber]
  show C.G (cobSpaceTime (transportedSubarc R P c₀ c₁ d q) tbefore) = 0
  rw [cobSpaceTime_transportedSubarc R P c₀ c₁ d q htime]
  exact R.base.flow_mem_fiber (sliceAmbientSubarc_mem_fiber P c₀ c₁ q) d

name: Submission.flow_back
statement:
theorem flow_back (R : CompactTimeTamedField C K)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (d : ℝ) :
    R.base.flow (R.base.flow y d) (-d) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [congrFun (R.base.flow_shift y d) (-d), add_neg_cancel, R.base.flow_zero]

name: Submission.injective_transportedSubarc
statement:
theorem injective_transportedSubarc (R : CompactTimeTamedField C K)
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C tafter hafter) Vafter)
    (c₀ c₁ : I) (d : ℝ) {tbefore : ℝ}
    (htime : ∀ q : I,
      tcoord (R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc c₀ c₁ q) d) = tbefore)
    (hcurve : Function.Injective
      (fun q : I => P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q))) :
    Function.Injective (transportedSubarc R P c₀ c₁ d)
proof:
:= by
  intro q q' hqq'
  apply hcurve
  have h1 : R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc c₀ c₁ q) d =
      R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc c₀ c₁ q') d := by
    rw [← cobSpaceTime_transportedSubarc R P c₀ c₁ d q (htime q),
      ← cobSpaceTime_transportedSubarc R P c₀ c₁ d q' (htime q'), hqq']
  have h2 : P.sliceAmbientSubarc c₀ c₁ q = P.sliceAmbientSubarc c₀ c₁ q' := by
    rw [← flow_back R (P.sliceAmbientSubarc c₀ c₁ q) d, h1, flow_back]
  have h3 := congrArg spacePart h2
  show P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q) = P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q')
  simpa [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply] using h3

name: Submission.injective_convexComb
statement:
theorem injective_convexComb {c₀ c₁ : I} (h01 : c₀ ≠ c₁) :
    Function.Injective (fun q : I => Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q)
proof:
:= by
  intro q q' h
  have hc : (1 - (q : ℝ)) * (c₀ : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) * (c₁ : ℝ) =
      (1 - (q' : ℝ)) * (c₀ : ℝ) + (q' : ℝ) * (c₁ : ℝ) :=
    congrArg Subtype.val h
  have hne : (c₀ : ℝ) ≠ (c₁ : ℝ) := fun hcc => h01 (Subtype.ext hcc)
  apply Subtype.ext
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hlt
  · nlinarith [hc, hlt]
  · nlinarith [hc, hlt]

name: Submission.eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_convexComb_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_convexComb_eq_zero {a b : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hb : 0 ≤ b) {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (h : (1 - q) * a + q * b = 0) : a = 0 ∨ b = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hane : a = 0
  · exact Or.inl hane
  · right
    have hapos : 0 < a := lt_of_le_of_ne ha (Ne.symm hane)
    have hz1 : (1 - q) * a = 0 := by nlinarith
    have hz2 : q * b = 0 := by nlinarith
    have hq : q = 1 := by nlinarith
    rw [hq, one_mul] at hz2
    exact hz2

name: Submission.eq_one_or_eq_one_of_convexComb_eq_one
statement:
theorem eq_one_or_eq_one_of_convexComb_eq_one {a b : ℝ} (ha : a ≤ 1)
    (hb : b ≤ 1) {q : ℝ} (hq0 : 0 ≤ q) (hq1 : q ≤ 1)
    (h : (1 - q) * a + q * b = 1) : a = 1 ∨ b = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h' : (1 - q) * (1 - a) + q * (1 - b) = 0 := by ring_nf; nlinarith [h]
  rcases eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_convexComb_eq_zero (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - a)
    (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1 - b) hq0 hq1 h' with h1 | h1
  · exact Or.inl (by linarith)
  · exact Or.inr (by linarith)

name: Submission.injective_curve_convexComb
proof:
:= by
  have hends : ∀ q q' : I, Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q = 0 →
      Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q' = 1 → False := by
    intro q q' hq hq'
    have hz : (1 - (q : ℝ)) * (c₀ : ℝ) + (q : ℝ) * (c₁ : ℝ) = 0 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hq
    have ho : (1 - (q' : ℝ)) * (c₀ : ℝ) + (q' : ℝ) * (c₁ : ℝ) = 1 :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hq'
    have hzz := eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_convexComb_eq_zero c₀.2.1 c₁.2.1
      q.2.1 q.2.2 hz
    have hoo := eq_one_or_eq_one_of_convexComb_eq_one c₀.2.2 c₁.2.2
      q'.2.1 q'.2.2 ho
    rcases hzz with h0 | h0 <;> rcases hoo with h1 | h1
    · rw [h0] at h1; norm_num at h1
    · exact h01 ⟨Subtype.ext h0, Subtype.ext h1⟩
    · exact h10 ⟨Subtype.ext h1, Subtype.ext h0⟩
    · rw [h0] at h1; norm_num at h1
  intro q q' h
  rcases P.curve_eq_cases h with heq | ⟨ha, hb⟩ | ⟨ha, hb⟩
  · exact injective_convexComb hne heq
  · exact absurd (hends q q' ha hb) not_false
  · exact absurd (hends q' q hb ha) not_false

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.compactTimeTamedField_flow_positive
statement:
theorem compactTimeTamedField_flow_positive
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin ((a + 2) + 2)))}
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData K)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin ((a + 2) + 2))}
    (hpFiber : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G p = 0)
    (hp : 0 < D.signedOutput p) (s : ℝ) :
    0 < D.signedOutput (R.base.flow p s)
proof:
:= by
  let γ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin ((a + 2) + 2))) :=
    ⟨fun u => R.base.flow p ((u : ℝ) * s),
      (R.base.continuous_flow p).comp
        (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)⟩
  have hγFiber : ∀ u, D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (γ u) = 0 := by
    intro u
    exact R.flow_mem_fiber hpFiber _
  have h := (D.signedOutput.pos_iff_of_zeroFiber_path γ hγFiber).mp
    (by simpa [γ] using hp)
  simpa [γ] using h

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalMinimumReverseTargetOrbit_mem_positive
statement:
theorem chronologicalMinimumReverseTargetOrbit_mem_positive
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hpositive : D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .minimum)
    (O : {O // O ∈ (D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
      (D.chronologicalMinimumExteriorTargetFamily t ht hpositive hindex)}) :
    D.chronologicalMinimumReverseTargetOrbit t ht hpositive hindex O ∈
      (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
        ((D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
          (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)).positiveOrbitCollection
            (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht))
proof:
:= by
  let H := D.chronologicalMinimumReverseExteriorFlowCore
    t ht hpositive hindex
  let eSource := D.chronologicalMinimumReverseSourceEquiv
    t ht hpositive hindex
  let eTarget := D.chronologicalMinimumReverseTargetOrbitEquiv t ht
  let OH := eSource O
  let Q := eTarget.symm (H.targetOrbit OH)
  let Vneg := D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht
  let Vpos := D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht
  let Sneg := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
  let Spos := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)
  change Q ∈ Vpos.selectedOrbitFinset (Spos.positiveOrbitCollection Vpos)
  have hsourceCollection : (O.1 : Set Eₐ) ∈
      Sneg.positiveOrbitCollection Vneg :=
    ((Vneg.mem_selectedOrbitFinset O.1).mp O.2).1
  have hsourceSign : 0 < Sneg (Vneg.orbitPoint O.1) :=
    (Sneg.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff Vneg O.1).mp hsourceCollection
  let P := Vneg.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam O.1
  let p := P.exteriorAmbientLoop 0
  have hpEq : p = cobSpaceTime (Vneg.orbitPoint O.1)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) := by
    change cobSpaceTime (P.curve 0) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) = _
    rw [P.curve_zero]
    rfl
  have hstartSign : 0 < D.signedOutput p := by
    rw [hpEq]
    exact hsourceSign
  have hpFiber : H.C.G p = 0 := P.exteriorAmbientLoop_fiber 0
  have hsourceLoop : (H.negativeParam OH).exteriorAmbientLoop 0 = p := by
    change cobSpaceTime
        ((D.chronologicalMinimumReverseSourceField t ht).intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam OH.1 |>.curve 0)
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) -
          -(D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2)) =
      cobSpaceTime (P.curve 0) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
    apply congrArg₂ cobSpaceTime
    · change
        (((Vneg.transport
          (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)).intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam OH.1).curve 0) = P.curve 0
      calc
        _ = (Vneg.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam
              (((Vneg.selectedOrbitTransportEquiv
                (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)
                (D.chronologicalMinimumExteriorTargetFamily
                  t ht hpositive hindex)).symm OH).1)).curve 0 :=
          Vneg.transportedIntrinsicCurve_symm
            (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)
            (D.chronologicalMinimumExteriorTargetFamily t ht hpositive hindex)
            OH 0
        _ = P.curve 0 := by
          have hO : (Vneg.selectedOrbitTransportEquiv
              (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)
              (D.chronologicalMinimumExteriorTargetFamily
                t ht hpositive hindex)).symm OH = O := by
            change eSource.symm OH = O
            exact eSource.symm_apply_apply O
          rw [hO]
    · exact D.chronologicalReverseAfterTime_eq t ht
  have hthrough : 0 < D.signedOutput (H.R.base.flow p (2 * H.ε)) :=
    D.compactTimeTamedField_flow_positive H.R hpFiber hstartSign _
  have hdouble : H.R.base.flow p (2 * H.ε) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.R.base.flow p H.ε) H.ε := by
    simpa [two_mul] using
      (congrFun (H.R.base.flow_shift p H.ε) H.ε).symm
  have hcore : H.coreLoop OH 0 = H.R.base.flow p H.ε := by
    change H.R.base.flow ((H.negativeParam OH).exteriorAmbientLoop 0) H.ε = _
    rw [hsourceLoop]
  have hendSign : 0 < D.signedOutput
      (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH 0) H.ε) := by
    rw [hcore, ← hdouble]
    exact hthrough
  have hendEq : cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH 0) H.ε := by
    calc
      cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
          (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) =
          cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0) (H.t + H.ε) :=
        congrArg₂ cobSpaceTime rfl
          (D.chronologicalReverseBeforeTime_eq t ht).symm
      _ = H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH 0) H.ε := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time OH 0]
        exact spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hbaseSign : 0 < Spos (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
    change 0 < D.signedOutput (cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht))
    rw [hendEq]
    exact hendSign
  have hpositiveFiber : H.positiveCurve OH 0 ∈
      (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice t ht).fiber := by
    rw [chronologicalBeforeSlice, SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber]
    change D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
        (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)) = 0
    rw [hendEq]
    exact H.R.flow_mem_fiber (H.coreLoop_fiber OH 0) H.ε
  have htargetSet : (Q : Set Eₐ) =
      Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
    calc
      (Q : Set Eₐ) = (H.targetOrbit OH : Set Eₐ) := by
        change ((((Vpos.orbitIndexTransportEquiv
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)).symm
            (H.targetOrbit OH)) : Vpos.OrbitIndex) : Set Eₐ) = _
        exact Vpos.orbitIndexTransportEquiv_symm_val
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)
          (H.targetOrbit OH)
      _ = H.Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := H.targetOrbit_coe OH
      _ = Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
        change (Vpos.transport
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)).orbit
            (H.positiveCurve OH 0) = Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
        exact Vpos.transport_orbit
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)
          (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
  have htargetPoint : Vpos.orbitPoint Q ∈
      Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
    rw [← htargetSet, Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit]
    exact Vpos.mem_orbit_self _
  have htargetSign : 0 < Spos (Vpos.orbitPoint Q) :=
    (Spos.pos_iff_of_mem_orbit Vpos hpositiveFiber htargetPoint).mp hbaseSign
  apply (Vpos.mem_selectedOrbitFinset Q).mpr
  exact (Spos.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff Vpos Q).mpr htargetSign

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalMaximumReverseTargetOrbit_mem_positive
statement:
theorem chronologicalMaximumReverseTargetOrbit_mem_positive
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .maximum)
    (O : {O // O ∈ (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
      (D.chronologicalMaximumExteriorTargetFamily t ht)}) :
    D.chronologicalMaximumReverseTargetOrbit t ht hindex O ∈
      (D.chronologicalMaximumLocalField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
        ((D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
          (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)).positiveOrbitCollection
            (D.chronologicalMaximumLocalField t ht))
proof:
:= by
  let H := D.chronologicalMaximumReverseExteriorFlowCore t ht hindex
  let eSource := D.chronologicalMaximumReverseSourceEquiv t ht
  let eTarget := D.chronologicalMaximumReverseTargetOrbitEquiv t ht
  let OH := eSource O
  let Q := eTarget.symm (H.targetOrbit OH)
  let Vneg := D.chronologicalAfterField t ht
  let Vpos := D.chronologicalMaximumLocalField t ht
  let Sneg := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
  let Spos := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)
  change Q ∈ Vpos.selectedOrbitFinset (Spos.positiveOrbitCollection Vpos)
  have hsourceCollection : (O.1 : Set Eₐ) ∈
      Sneg.positiveOrbitCollection Vneg :=
    (Vneg.mem_selectedOrbitFinset O.1).mp O.2
  have hsourceSign : 0 < Sneg (Vneg.orbitPoint O.1) :=
    (Sneg.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff Vneg O.1).mp hsourceCollection
  let P := Vneg.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam O.1
  let p := P.exteriorAmbientLoop 0
  have hpEq : p = cobSpaceTime (Vneg.orbitPoint O.1)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) := by
    change cobSpaceTime (P.curve 0) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) = _
    rw [P.curve_zero]
    rfl
  have hstartSign : 0 < D.signedOutput p := by
    rw [hpEq]
    exact hsourceSign
  have hpFiber : H.C.G p = 0 := P.exteriorAmbientLoop_fiber 0
  have hsourceLoop : (H.negativeParam OH).exteriorAmbientLoop 0 = p := by
    change cobSpaceTime
        ((D.chronologicalMaximumReverseSourceField t ht).intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam OH.1 |>.curve 0)
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) -
          -(D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2)) =
      cobSpaceTime (P.curve 0) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
    apply congrArg₂ cobSpaceTime
    · change
        (((Vneg.transport
          (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)).intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam OH.1).curve 0) = P.curve 0
      calc
        _ = (Vneg.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam
              (((Vneg.selectedOrbitTransportEquiv
                (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)
                (D.chronologicalMaximumExteriorTargetFamily t ht)).symm OH).1)).curve 0 :=
          Vneg.transportedIntrinsicCurve_symm
            (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)
            (D.chronologicalMaximumExteriorTargetFamily t ht) OH 0
        _ = P.curve 0 := by
          have hO : (Vneg.selectedOrbitTransportEquiv
              (D.chronologicalAfterSlice_eq_reverseAfterSlice t ht)
              (D.chronologicalMaximumExteriorTargetFamily t ht)).symm OH = O := by
            change eSource.symm OH = O
            exact eSource.symm_apply_apply O
          rw [hO]
    · exact D.chronologicalReverseAfterTime_eq t ht
  have hthrough : 0 < D.signedOutput (H.R.base.flow p (2 * H.ε)) :=
    D.compactTimeTamedField_flow_positive H.R hpFiber hstartSign _
  have hdouble : H.R.base.flow p (2 * H.ε) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.R.base.flow p H.ε) H.ε := by
    simpa [two_mul] using
      (congrFun (H.R.base.flow_shift p H.ε) H.ε).symm
  have hcore : H.coreLoop OH 0 = H.R.base.flow p H.ε := by
    change H.R.base.flow ((H.negativeParam OH).exteriorAmbientLoop 0) H.ε = _
    rw [hsourceLoop]
  have hendSign : 0 < D.signedOutput
      (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH 0) H.ε) := by
    rw [hcore, ← hdouble]
    exact hthrough
  have hendEq : cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH 0) H.ε := by
    calc
      cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
          (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) =
          cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0) (H.t + H.ε) :=
        congrArg₂ cobSpaceTime rfl
          (D.chronologicalReverseBeforeTime_eq t ht).symm
      _ = H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop OH 0) H.ε := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time OH 0]
        exact spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hbaseSign : 0 < Spos (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
    change 0 < D.signedOutput (cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht))
    rw [hendEq]
    exact hendSign
  have hpositiveFiber : H.positiveCurve OH 0 ∈
      (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice t ht).fiber := by
    rw [chronologicalBeforeSlice, SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber]
    change D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
        (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)) = 0
    rw [hendEq]
    exact H.R.flow_mem_fiber (H.coreLoop_fiber OH 0) H.ε
  have htargetSet : (Q : Set Eₐ) =
      Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
    calc
      (Q : Set Eₐ) = (H.targetOrbit OH : Set Eₐ) := by
        change ((((Vpos.orbitIndexTransportEquiv
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)).symm
            (H.targetOrbit OH)) : Vpos.OrbitIndex) : Set Eₐ) = _
        exact Vpos.orbitIndexTransportEquiv_symm_val
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)
          (H.targetOrbit OH)
      _ = H.Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := H.targetOrbit_coe OH
      _ = Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
        change (Vpos.transport
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)).orbit
            (H.positiveCurve OH 0) = Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
        exact Vpos.transport_orbit
          (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice_eq_reverseBeforeSlice t ht)
          (H.positiveCurve OH 0)
  have htargetPoint : Vpos.orbitPoint Q ∈
      Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve OH 0) := by
    rw [← htargetSet, Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit]
    exact Vpos.mem_orbit_self _
  have htargetSign : 0 < Spos (Vpos.orbitPoint Q) :=
    (Spos.pos_iff_of_mem_orbit Vpos hpositiveFiber htargetPoint).mp hbaseSign
  apply (Vpos.mem_selectedOrbitFinset Q).mpr
  exact (Spos.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff Vpos Q).mpr htargetSign

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalMinimumReverseTargetMap_injective
statement:
theorem chronologicalMinimumReverseTargetMap_injective
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)

    (hpositive : D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .minimum) :
    Function.Injective (D.chronologicalMinimumReverseTargetMap
      t ht hpositive hindex)
proof:
:= by
  intro O P hOP
  let H := D.chronologicalMinimumReverseExteriorFlowCore
    t ht hpositive hindex
  let eSource := D.chronologicalMinimumReverseSourceEquiv
    t ht hpositive hindex
  let eTarget := D.chronologicalMinimumReverseTargetOrbitEquiv t ht
  have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hOP
  change eTarget.symm (H.targetOrbit (eSource O)) =
    eTarget.symm (H.targetOrbit (eSource P)) at hval
  apply eSource.injective
  apply H.targetOrbit_injective
  exact eTarget.symm.injective hval

    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)

      (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters)

      t ht hpositive hindex) :
    ((D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
      (D.chronologicalMinimumExteriorSourceFamily t ht)).card =
    ((D.chronologicalMinimumLocalField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
      (D.chronologicalMinimumExteriorTargetFamily t ht hpositive hindex)).card
proof:
:= by
  have hforward := Fintype.card_le_of_injective
    (D.chronologicalMinimumForwardTargetMap
      t ht hpositive hindex hnoncollision)

    (D.chronologicalMinimumReverseTargetMap t ht hpositive hindex)
    (D.chronologicalMinimumReverseTargetMap_injective
      t ht hpositive hindex)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.saddleUnitTangent_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem saddleUnitTangent_zero
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) (theta : ℝ) :
    M.saddleUnitTangent 0 theta = M.centerUnitTangent (-theta)
proof:
:= by
  simp [saddleUnitTangent, centerUnitTangent, definiteCircleParam,
    pairToMorseParam]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.continuousAt_saddleUnitTangent_zero
statement:
theorem continuousAt_saddleUnitTangent_zero
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) (theta₀ : ℝ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => M.saddleUnitTangent q.1 q.2)
      (0, theta₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hparam : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      definiteCircleParam q.1 q.2) := by
    unfold definiteCircleParam pairToMorseParam
    fun_prop
  have htangent : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      definiteCircleTangentParam 1 (-q.2)) := by
    unfold definiteCircleTangentParam pairToMorseParam
    fun_prop
  have hparam0 : definiteCircleParam (0 : ℝ) theta₀ = 0 := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [definiteCircleParam, pairToMorseParam]
  have hD : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      fderiv ℝ M.param (definiteCircleParam q.1 q.2)) (0, theta₀) :=
    M.param_smooth.continuousAt_fderiv (by simp) |>.comp_of_eq
      hparam.continuousAt hparam0
  exact continuous_spacePart.continuousAt.comp
    (hD.clm_apply htangent.continuousAt)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.saddleUnitTangent_two_pi
statement:
theorem saddleUnitTangent_two_pi
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) (r : ℝ) :
    M.saddleUnitTangent r (2 * Real.pi) = M.saddleUnitTangent r 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp : definiteCircleParam r (2 * Real.pi) =
      definiteCircleParam r 0 := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [definiteCircleParam, pairToMorseParam,
        Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi]
  have ht : definiteCircleTangentParam 1 (-(2 * Real.pi)) =
      definiteCircleTangentParam 1 (-0) := by
    ext i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp [definiteCircleTangentParam, pairToMorseParam,
        Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi]
  simp only [saddleUnitTangent]
  rw [hp, ht]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.continuous_saddleUnitTangent_radius_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem continuous_saddleUnitTangent_radius_of_contDiffOn
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) {rho r : ℝ}
    (hC1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 M.param (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) rho))
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrrho : r < rho) :
    Continuous fun theta : ℝ => M.saddleUnitTangent r theta
proof:
:= by
  have hp : Continuous fun theta : ℝ => definiteCircleParam r theta := by
    unfold definiteCircleParam pairToMorseParam
    fun_prop
  have hpmem : ∀ theta : ℝ,
      definiteCircleParam r theta ∈
        ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) rho := by
    intro theta
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_definiteCircleParam hr]
    exact hrrho
  have hD : Continuous fun theta : ℝ =>
      fderiv ℝ M.param (definiteCircleParam r theta) :=
    ContinuousOn.comp_continuous
      (hC1.continuousOn_fderiv_of_isOpen isOpen_ball (by simp))
      hp hpmem
  have ht : Continuous fun theta : ℝ =>
      definiteCircleTangentParam 1 (-theta) := by
    unfold definiteCircleTangentParam pairToMorseParam
    fun_prop
  exact continuous_spacePart.comp (hD.clm_apply ht)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.saddleRescaledRadiusMatrix_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem saddleRescaledRadiusMatrix_zero
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) (theta : ℝ) :
    M.saddleRescaledRadiusMatrix 0 theta =
      M.saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix theta
proof:
:= by
  have htrans : M.centerTransverseNormalAt 0 theta =
      M.centerTransverseNormal := by
    funext i
    exact M.centerTransverseNormalAt_zero theta i
  rw [saddleRescaledRadiusMatrix, saddleRescaledRadiusRows, htrans]
  simp [saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix, saddleCenterActualLimitRows,
    centerMinimumUnitNormalLast]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix_zero
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (theta : ℝ) :
    saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix T hindex 0 theta =
      saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix T hindex 0 theta
proof:
:= by
  simp [saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix, saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.continuousAt_saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix_zero
statement:
theorem continuousAt_saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix_zero
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (theta₀ : ℝ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix T hindex q.1 q.2) (0, theta₀)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousAt.mul
  · let f : (ℝ × ℝ) → Fin (a + 3) → Fin (a + 3) → ℝ :=
      fun q i j => WithLp.ofLp (M.saddleRescaledRadiusRows q.1 q.2 i) j
    have hf : ContinuousAt f (0, theta₀) := by
      apply continuousAt_pi.mpr
      intro i
      apply continuousAt_pi.mpr
      intro j
      have hrow : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
          M.saddleRescaledRadiusRows q.1 q.2 i) (0, theta₀) := by
        rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
        · exact ((continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ × ℝ =>
            M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign).continuousAt.smul
              (M.continuousAt_saddleUnitTangent_zero theta₀))
        · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
          | last =>
              have hn : ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
                  (‖M.centerCokernelVector‖⁻¹ *
                    nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar) •
                      M.centerNormalRow q.1 q.2) (0, theta₀) :=
                (M.continuousAt_centerNormalRow_zero theta₀).const_smul
                  (‖M.centerCokernelVector‖⁻¹ *
                    nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar)
              simpa [saddleRescaledRadiusRows, centerRowsWith,
                smul_smul] using hn
          | cast i =>
              simpa [saddleRescaledRadiusRows, centerRowsWith] using
                M.continuousAt_centerTransverseNormalAt_zero theta₀ i
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.continuousAt.comp hrow
    have hOf : Continuous
        (Matrix.of : (Fin (a + 3) → Fin (a + 3) → ℝ) →
          Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ) := by
      rw [continuous_matrixOf]
      exact continuous_id
    simpa [saddleRescaledRadiusMatrix, rowsMatrix, f,
      Function.comp_def] using hOf.continuousAt.comp hf
  · exact continuousAt_const

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix_two_pi
statement:
theorem saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix_two_pi
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (r : ℝ) :
    saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix T hindex r (2 * Real.pi) =
      saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix T hindex r 0
proof:
:= by
  have htrans : M.centerTransverseNormalAt r (2 * Real.pi) =
      M.centerTransverseNormalAt r 0 := by
    funext i
    exact M.centerTransverseNormalAt_two_pi r i
  unfold saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix saddleRescaledRadiusMatrix
    saddleRescaledRadiusRows
  rw [htrans, M.saddleUnitTangent_two_pi, M.centerNormalRow_two_pi]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.continuous_saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix_radius
statement:
theorem continuous_saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix_radius
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {rho r : ℝ}
    (hC1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 M.param (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) rho))
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrrho : r < rho) (hrradius : r < T.radius) :
    Continuous fun theta : ℝ =>
      saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix T hindex r theta
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.mul
  · apply continuous_matrix
    intro i j
    have hrow : Continuous fun theta : ℝ =>
        M.saddleRescaledRadiusRows r theta i := by
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
      · have ht : Continuous fun theta : ℝ =>
            M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign •
              M.saddleUnitTangent r theta :=
          (continuous_const_smul M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign).comp
            (M.continuous_saddleUnitTangent_radius_of_contDiffOn
              hC1 hr.le hrrho)
        simpa [saddleRescaledRadiusRows, centerRowsWith] using ht
      · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
        | last =>
            have hn : Continuous fun theta : ℝ =>
                (‖M.centerCokernelVector‖⁻¹ *
                  nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar) •
                    M.centerNormalRow r theta :=
              (continuous_const_smul
                (‖M.centerCokernelVector‖⁻¹ *
                  nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar)).comp
                (continuous_centerNormalRow_radius T hr hrradius)
            simpa [saddleRescaledRadiusRows, centerRowsWith,
              smul_smul] using hn
        | cast i =>
            simpa [saddleRescaledRadiusRows, centerRowsWith] using
              continuous_centerTransverseNormalAt_radius T hr.le hrradius i
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp hrow
  · exact continuous_const

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt_closed
statement:
theorem saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt_closed
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {rho r : ℝ}
    (hC1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 M.param (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) rho))
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrrho : r < rho) (hrradius : r < T.radius) :
    saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt T hindex hC1 hr hrrho hrradius 0 =
      saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt T hindex hC1 hr hrrho hrradius 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt] using
    (saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix_two_pi T hindex r).symm

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.eventually_saddleRescaledNormalized_segment_det_pos
statement:
theorem eventually_saddleRescaledNormalized_segment_det_pos
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) :
    ∀ᶠ r in nhds (0 : ℝ), ∀ q : I × I,
      0 < (matrixSegment
        (saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix T hindex r
          (2 * Real.pi * (q.2 : ℝ)))
        (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T hindex q.2) q.1).det
proof:
:= by
  let L : ℝ → I × I → Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ :=
    fun r q => matrixSegment
      (saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix T hindex r
        (2 * Real.pi * (q.2 : ℝ)))
      (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T hindex q.2) q.1
  have hL : ∀ q ∈ (Set.univ : Set (I × I)),
      ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ × (I × I) => L z.1 z.2) (0, q) := by
    intro q _
    have hparam : Continuous fun z : ℝ × (I × I) =>
        (z.1, 2 * Real.pi * (z.2.2 : ℝ)) := by
      fun_prop
    have hA0 :=
      continuousAt_saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix_zero T hindex
        (2 * Real.pi * (q.2 : ℝ))
    have hA : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ × (I × I) =>
        saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix T hindex z.1
          (2 * Real.pi * (z.2.2 : ℝ))) (0, q) := by
      have hmap_eq :
          (fun z : ℝ × (I × I) =>
            (z.1, 2 * Real.pi * (z.2.2 : ℝ))) (0, q) =
            (0, 2 * Real.pi * (q.2 : ℝ)) := rfl
      have hcomp := ContinuousAt.comp_of_eq
        (f := fun z : ℝ × (I × I) =>
          (z.1, 2 * Real.pi * (z.2.2 : ℝ)))
        (g := fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix T hindex p.1 p.2)
        hA0 hparam.continuousAt hmap_eq
      simpa only [Function.comp_def] using hcomp
    have hS : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ × (I × I) =>
        saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T hindex z.2.2) (0, q) :=
      (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T hindex).continuous.continuousAt.comp
        (continuous_snd.comp continuous_snd).continuousAt
    have hs : ContinuousAt (fun z : ℝ × (I × I) =>
        (z.2.1 : ℝ)) (0, q) :=
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp
        (continuous_fst.comp continuous_snd)).continuousAt
    have hone : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℝ × (I × I) => (1 : ℝ)) (0, q) :=
      continuousAt_const
    dsimp only [L]
    unfold matrixSegment
    exact ((hone.sub hs).smul hA).add (hs.smul hS)
  have hpos : ∀ q ∈ (Set.univ : Set (I × I)),
      0 < (L 0 q).det := by
    intro q _
    have heq : saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix T hindex 0
        (2 * Real.pi * (q.2 : ℝ)) =
        saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T hindex q.2 := by
      rw [saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix_zero]
      rfl
    dsimp only [L]
    rw [heq]
    have hseg : matrixSegment
        (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T hindex q.2)
        (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T hindex q.2) q.1 =
        saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T hindex q.2 := by
      unfold matrixSegment
      module
    rw [hseg]
    exact saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop_det_pos T hindex q.2
  change ∀ᶠ r in nhds (0 : ℝ), ∀ q : I × I, 0 < (L r q).det
  simpa only [Set.mem_univ, forall_const] using
    (eventually_uniform_det_pos_of_continuousAt
      isCompact_univ L hL hpos)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.exists_pos_radius_saddleRescaledNormalized_segment_det_pos
statement:
theorem exists_pos_radius_saddleRescaledNormalized_segment_det_pos
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) :
    ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ r < rho ∧ ∀ q : I × I,
      0 < (matrixSegment
        (saddleRescaledNormalizedMatrix T hindex r
          (2 * Real.pi * (q.2 : ℝ)))
        (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T hindex q.2) q.1).det
proof:
:= by
  have hevent := eventually_saddleRescaledNormalized_segment_det_pos T hindex
  obtain ⟨eps, heps, heps_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hevent
  let r := min (rho / 2) (eps / 2)
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min (half_pos hrho) (half_pos heps)
  have hrrho : r < rho :=
    (min_le_left (rho / 2) (eps / 2)).trans_lt (half_lt_self hrho)
  have hreps : r < eps :=
    (min_le_right (rho / 2) (eps / 2)).trans_lt (half_lt_self heps)
  refine ⟨r, hr, hrrho, ?_⟩
  apply heps_sub
  simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr]
    using hreps

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.exists_saddleRescaledNormalizedLoop_class_one
statement:
theorem exists_saddleRescaledNormalizedLoop_class_one
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) :
    ∃ rho : ℝ, ∃ hrho : 0 < rho,
      ∃ hC1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 M.param
        (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) rho),
      ∃ r : ℝ, ∃ hr : 0 < r, ∃ hrrho : r < rho,
      ∃ hrradius : r < T.radius,
      ∃ hpos : ∀ u,
        0 < (saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt T.toCenterImmersion hindex
          hC1 hr hrrho hrradius u).det,
      loopClassZ2
          (positiveMatrixSOMap
            (saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt T.toCenterImmersion hindex
              hC1 hr hrrho hrradius) hpos)
          (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed
            (saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt T.toCenterImmersion hindex
              hC1 hr hrrho hrradius) hpos
            (saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt_closed T.toCenterImmersion hindex
              hC1 hr hrrho hrradius)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rho, hrho, hC1⟩ := exists_param_contDiffOn_ball_one M
  let T₀ := T.toCenterImmersion
  have hbound : 0 < min T.radius rho := lt_min T.radius_pos hrho
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrbound, hsegment⟩ :=
    exists_pos_radius_saddleRescaledNormalized_segment_det_pos T₀ hindex hbound
  have hrradius : r < T.radius := hrbound.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hrrho : r < rho := hrbound.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  let A := saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt T₀ hindex hC1 hr hrrho hrradius
  have hpos : ∀ u, 0 < (A u).det := by
    intro u
    have h := hsegment (0, u)
    simpa [A, saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt] using h
  have hclosed : A 0 = A 1 :=
    saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt_closed T₀ hindex hC1 hr hrrho hrradius
  have hsegA : ∀ q : I × I,
      0 < (matrixSegment (A q.2)
        (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T₀ hindex q.2) q.1).det := by
    simpa [A, saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt] using hsegment
  refine ⟨rho, hrho, hC1, r, hr, hrrho, hrradius, hpos, ?_⟩
  exact loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixSOMap_eq_one_of_segment_pos
    A (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T₀ hindex)
    hpos (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop_det_pos T₀ hindex)
    hclosed (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop_closed T₀ hindex)
    (loopClassZ2_saddleCenterActualNormalized_eq_one T₀ hindex) hsegA

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.saddleRescaledRadiusRows_succ_eq_signedActed
statement:
theorem saddleRescaledRadiusRows_succ_eq_signedActed
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (theta : ℝ) (i : Fin (a + 2)) :
    M.saddleRescaledRadiusRows r theta i.succ =
      M.signedCenterRescaledActedRows
        (nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar)
        (nonzeroOrientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one _)
        r theta i.succ
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      have hlast : (Fin.last (a + 1)).succ =
          (Fin.last (a + 2) : Fin (a + 3)) := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp
      rw [hlast]
      rw [M.signedCenterRescaledActedRows_last
        (nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar)
        (nonzeroOrientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one _) hr.ne' theta]
      simp [saddleRescaledRadiusRows, centerRowsWith]
  | cast i =>
      rw [M.signedCenterRescaledActedRows_transverse
        (nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar)
        (nonzeroOrientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one _) r theta i]
      simp [saddleRescaledRadiusRows, centerRowsWith]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.saddleRescaledRadiusLoopAt_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem saddleRescaledRadiusLoopAt_apply
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {rho r : ℝ}
    (hC1 : ContDiffOn ℝ 1 M.param (ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) rho))
    (hr : 0 < r) (hrrho : r < rho) (hrradius : r < T.radius) (u : I) :
    saddleRescaledRadiusLoopAt T hindex hC1 hr hrrho hrradius u =
      M.saddleRescaledRadiusMatrix r (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  let U := saddleCenterActualRadialBaseUnit T hindex
  change
    (M.saddleRescaledRadiusMatrix r (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) *
        (↑U⁻¹ : Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ)) *
      (↑U : Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ) =
    M.saddleRescaledRadiusMatrix r (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))
  rw [Matrix.mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel,
    Units.val_one, mul_one]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.exists_saddleCircleRawLoop_class_one
statement:
theorem exists_saddleCircleRawLoop_class_one
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, ∃ hr : 0 < r, ∃ hrradius : r < T.radius,
      loopClassZ2
          (positiveMatrixSOMap (definiteCircleRawLoop T r hr hrradius)
            (definiteCircleRawLoop_det_pos T r hr hrradius))
          (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed (definiteCircleRawLoop T r hr hrradius)
            (definiteCircleRawLoop_det_pos T r hr hrradius)
            (definiteCircleRawLoop_closed T r hr hrradius)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rho, hrho, hC1, r, hr, hrrho, hrradius, hNpos, hNclass⟩ :=
    exists_saddleRescaledNormalizedLoop_class_one T hindex
  let T₀ := T.toCenterImmersion
  let N := saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt T₀ hindex hC1 hr hrrho hrradius
  let U := saddleCenterActualRadialBaseUnit T₀ hindex
  let R := saddleRescaledRadiusLoopAt T₀ hindex hC1 hr hrrho hrradius
  let sigma := nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar
  let hsigma : sigma = 1 ∨ sigma = -1 :=
    nonzeroOrientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one _
  let A := signedCenterRescaledActedLoop T sigma hsigma r hr hrradius
  let Z := definiteCircleRawLoop T r hr hrradius
  have hNclosed : N 0 = N 1 :=
    saddleRescaledNormalizedLoopAt_closed T₀ hindex hC1 hr hrrho hrradius
  have hUpos : 0 < ((U : Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ)).det :=
    saddleCenterActualRadialBaseUnit_det_pos T₀ hindex
  have hRpos : ∀ u, 0 < (R u).det :=
    matrixMulRightConst_det_pos N hUpos hNpos
  have hRclosed : R 0 = R 1 :=
    matrixMulRightConst_closed N (U :
      Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ) hNclosed
  have hRclass : loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap R hRpos)
      (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed R hRpos hRclosed) = 1 := by
    have hcongr := loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixSOMap_mulRightConst_congr
      N (U : Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ) hUpos hNpos hNclosed
    exact hcongr.trans hNclass
  have hApos : ∀ u, 0 < (A u).det :=
    signedCenterRescaledActedLoop_det_pos T sigma hsigma r hr hrradius
  have hAclosed : A 0 = A 1 :=
    signedCenterRescaledActedLoop_closed T sigma hsigma r hr hrradius
  have hsegment : ∀ p : I × I,
      0 < (matrixSegment (A p.2) (R p.2) p.1).det := by
    intro p
    apply matrixSegment_det_pos_of_succ_rows_eq
      (A p.2) (R p.2) (hApos p.2) (hRpos p.2) _ p.1
    intro i
    rw [signedCenterRescaledActedLoop_apply, saddleRescaledRadiusLoopAt_apply]
    ext j
    exact congrArg
      (fun v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 3)) => WithLp.ofLp v j)
      (M.saddleRescaledRadiusRows_succ_eq_signedActed
        hr (2 * Real.pi * (p.2 : ℝ)) i).symm
  have hAclass : loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap A hApos)
      (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed A hApos hAclosed) = 1 :=
    loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixSOMap_eq_one_of_segment_pos
      A R hApos hRpos hAclosed hRclosed hRclass hsegment
  have hZpos : ∀ u, 0 < (Z u).det :=
    definiteCircleRawLoop_det_pos T r hr hrradius
  have hZclosed : Z 0 = Z 1 :=
    definiteCircleRawLoop_closed T r hr hrradius
  let O := M.signedCenterOrientationBlock sigma hsigma
  have hleftpos : ∀ u, 0 < (matrixMulLeftSO O Z u).det :=
    matrixMulLeftSO_det_pos O Z hZpos
  have hleftclosed : matrixMulLeftSO O Z 0 = matrixMulLeftSO O Z 1 :=
    matrixMulLeftSO_closed O Z hZclosed
  have hscale := loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixSOMap_scaleLastRow_congr
    (inv_pos.mpr hr) (matrixMulLeftSO O Z) hleftpos hleftclosed
  have hleft := loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixSOMap_mulLeftSO_congr
    O Z hZpos hZclosed
  have hAZ : loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap A hApos)
        (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed A hApos hAclosed) =
      loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap Z hZpos)
        (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed Z hZpos hZclosed) := by
    simpa [A, Z, O, signedCenterRescaledActedLoop] using hscale.trans hleft
  refine ⟨r, hr, hrradius, ?_⟩
  exact hAZ.symm.trans hAclass

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.exists_saddleCircleRegularZeroFrame_class_one
statement:
theorem exists_saddleCircleRegularZeroFrame_class_one
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, ∃ hr : 0 < r, ∃ hrradius : r < T.radius,
      let z
proof:
:= T.definiteCircleCurve r hr hrradius
      let hreg : ∀ u, Surjective (spatialDeriv C.G (z u)) := fun _ =>
        M.definiteCircle_spatialDeriv_surjective hr
          (hrradius.trans_le T.radius_le)
      loopClassZ2 (regularZeroFrame C.smooth z hreg)
        (regularZeroFrame_closed C.smooth z hreg
          (T.definiteCircleCurve_closed r hr hrradius)) = 1 := by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrradius, hclass⟩ := exists_saddleCircleRawLoop_class_one T hindex
  refine ⟨r, hr, hrradius, ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  let z := T.definiteCircleCurve r hr hrradius
  let hreg : ∀ u, Surjective (spatialDeriv C.G (z u)) := fun _ =>
    M.definiteCircle_spatialDeriv_surjective hr
      (hrradius.trans_le T.radius_le)
  have hzclosed : z 0 = z 1 := T.definiteCircleCurve_closed r hr hrradius
  have hframe := regularZeroFrame_eq_positiveMatrixSOMap_raw C.smooth z hreg
  have hrawclosed := regularZeroRawFrame_closed C.smooth z hreg hzclosed
  have hcongr := loopClassZ2_congr_fun
    (regularZeroFrame_closed C.smooth z hreg hzclosed)
    (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed (regularZeroRawFrame C.smooth z hreg)
      (regularZeroRawFrame_det_pos C.smooth z hreg) hrawclosed)
    hframe
  exact hcongr.trans (by
    simpa [z, hreg, definiteCircleRawLoop] using hclass)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleChartCircleFrameClass_eq_one
statement:
theorem EmbeddedShrink.saddleChartCircleFrameClass_eq_one
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) (hrrad : r < T.radius) :
    T.chartCircleFrameClass hr hrrad = 1
proof:

  dsimp only at hcongr hsmall
  exact hcongr.symm.trans hsmall

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstHopfSO_normal_eq_firstPreimage
statement:
lemma firstHopfSO_normal_eq_firstPreimage (theta : ℝ) (i : Fin (k + 3)) :
    matrixRows
        ((firstHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
          Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) i.succ =
      firstPreimage (k + 1) hk (circleAt (m := k + 1) theta)
        (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro j
  have ha01 := amb_zero_ne_one k
  have ha02 := amb_zero_ne_two k
  have ha03 := amb_zero_ne_three k
  have ha12 := amb_one_ne_two k
  have ha13 := amb_one_ne_three k
  have ha23 := amb_two_ne_three k
  have ho01 := out_zero_ne_one k
  have ho02 := out_zero_ne_two k
  have ho12 := out_one_ne_two k
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨q, rfl⟩
  · change ((firstHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) i.succ 0 = _
    rw [firstHopfSO_apply, firstPreimage_apply_zero,
      circleAt_apply_zero]
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases hi1 : i = 1 <;>
      by_cases hi2 : i = 2 <;>
      simp_all [PiLp.single_apply, eq_comm]
  · change ((firstHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) i.succ q.succ = _
    rw [firstHopfSO_apply, firstPreimage_apply_succ]
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases hi1 : i = 1 <;>
      by_cases hi2 : i = 2 <;> by_cases hq0 : q = 0 <;>
      by_cases hq1 : q = 1 <;> by_cases hq2 : q = 2 <;>
      by_cases hqi : q = i <;>
      simp_all [PiLp.single_apply, circleAt_apply, eq_comm]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondHopfSO_normal_eq_secondPreimage
statement:
lemma secondHopfSO_normal_eq_secondPreimage (theta : ℝ) (i : Fin (k + 3)) :
    matrixRows
        ((secondHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
          Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) i.succ =
      secondPreimage (k + 1) hk (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk theta)
        (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro j
  have ha01 := amb_zero_ne_one k
  have ha02 := amb_zero_ne_two k
  have ha03 := amb_zero_ne_three k
  have ha12 := amb_one_ne_two k
  have ha13 := amb_one_ne_three k
  have ha23 := amb_two_ne_three k
  have ho01 := out_zero_ne_one k
  have ho02 := out_zero_ne_two k
  have ho12 := out_one_ne_two k
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨q, rfl⟩
  · change ((secondHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) i.succ 0 = _
    rw [secondHopfSO_apply, secondPreimage_apply_zero,
      secondCircleAt_apply_two, secondCircleAt_apply_three]
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases hi1 : i = 1 <;>
      by_cases hi2 : i = 2 <;>
      simp_all [PiLp.single_apply, eq_comm]
  · change ((secondHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) i.succ q.succ = _
    rw [secondHopfSO_apply, secondPreimage_apply_succ]
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases hi1 : i = 1 <;>
      by_cases hi2 : i = 2 <;> by_cases hq0 : q = 0 <;>
      by_cases hq1 : q = 1 <;> by_cases hq2 : q = 2 <;>
      by_cases hqi : q = i <;>
      simp_all [PiLp.single_apply, secondCircleAt, eq_comm]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_firstHopfSO_row_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_coreMap_firstHopfSO_row_zero (theta : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (coreMap (k + 1) hk) (circleAt (m := k + 1) theta)
        (matrixRows
          ((firstHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
            Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_zero]
    have horth := orthonormal_matrixRows_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
      (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp
        (firstHopfSO k theta).property).1
    have hrow := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp horth
      (1 : Fin (k + 4)) (0 : Fin (k + 4))
    rw [firstHopfSO_row_one] at hrow
    simpa using hrow
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_one]
      change _ * _ + _ * _ + _ * _ + _ * _ = 0
      simp [matrixRows, circleAt_apply, firstHopfSO_apply]
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_two]
        change _ * _ + _ * _ - _ * _ - _ * _ = 0
        simp [matrixRows, circleAt_apply, firstHopfSO_apply]
      · rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_tail (k + 1) hk _ _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
        change ((firstHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
          Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) 0 i.succ = 0
        simp [firstHopfSO_apply, hi0, hi1, hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_secondHopfSO_row_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_coreMap_secondHopfSO_row_zero (theta : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (coreMap (k + 1) hk) (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk theta)
        (matrixRows
          ((secondHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
            Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) 0) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_zero]
    have horth := orthonormal_matrixRows_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
      (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp
        (secondHopfSO k theta).property).1
    have hrow := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp horth
      (1 : Fin (k + 4)) (0 : Fin (k + 4))
    rw [secondHopfSO_row_one] at hrow
    simpa using hrow
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_one]
      change _ * _ + _ * _ + _ * _ + _ * _ = 0
      simp [matrixRows, secondCircleAt, secondHopfSO_apply]
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_two]
        change _ * _ + _ * _ - _ * _ - _ * _ = 0
        simp [matrixRows, secondCircleAt, secondHopfSO_apply]
      · rw [fderiv_coreMap_apply_tail (k + 1) hk _ _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
        change ((secondHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
          Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) 0 i.succ = 0
        simp [secondHopfSO_apply, hi0, hi1, hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_levelMap_firstHopfSO_row_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_levelMap_firstHopfSO_row_zero (theta : ℝ) :

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_levelMap_secondHopfSO_row_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_levelMap_secondHopfSO_row_zero (theta : ℝ) :

proof:

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_levelMap_firstHopfSO_normal
statement:
lemma fderiv_levelMap_firstHopfSO_normal (theta : ℝ) (i : Fin (k + 3)) :
    fderiv ℝ (levelMap (k + 1) hk) (circleAt (m := k + 1) theta)
        (matrixRows
          ((firstHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
            Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) i.succ) =
      EuclideanSpace.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx := coreMap_circleAt_eq_zero (k + 1) hk theta
  rw [fderiv_levelMap_eq_coreMap_of_coreMap_eq_zero k hx,
    firstHopfSO_normal_eq_firstPreimage]
  apply fderiv_coreMap_firstPreimage (k + 1) hk hx
  constructor
  · apply circleAt_apply_other theta
    · exact amb_two_ne_zero k
    · exact amb_two_ne_one k
  · apply circleAt_apply_other theta
    · exact amb_three_ne_zero k
    · exact amb_three_ne_one k

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_levelMap_secondHopfSO_normal
statement:
lemma fderiv_levelMap_secondHopfSO_normal (theta : ℝ) (i : Fin (k + 3)) :
    fderiv ℝ (levelMap (k + 1) hk) (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk theta)
        (matrixRows
          ((secondHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
            Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) i.succ) =
      EuclideanSpace.single i 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx := coreMap_secondCircleAt_eq_zero (k + 1) hk theta
  rw [fderiv_levelMap_eq_coreMap_of_coreMap_eq_zero k hx,
    secondHopfSO_normal_eq_secondPreimage]
  apply fderiv_coreMap_secondPreimage (k + 1) hk hx
  constructor
  · exact secondCircleAt_apply_other (k + 1) hk theta
      (amb_zero_ne_two k) (amb_zero_ne_three k)
  · exact secondCircleAt_apply_other (k + 1) hk theta
      (amb_one_ne_two k) (amb_one_ne_three k)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.first_frameMatrix_eq_firstHopfSO
statement:
theorem first_frameMatrix_eq_firstHopfSO (theta : ℝ) :
    rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
        (frameAt (X (k + 1) hk) (circleAt (m := k + 1) theta))) =
      ((firstHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact frameMatrix_eq_of_SO_rightInverse
    (X (k + 1) hk) (circleAt (m := k + 1) theta)
    (firstHopfSO k theta)
    (fderiv_levelMap_firstHopfSO_row_zero k theta)
    (fderiv_levelMap_firstHopfSO_normal k theta)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.second_frameMatrix_eq_secondHopfSO
statement:
