        (frameAt (X (k + 1) hk)
          (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk theta))) =
      ((secondHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact frameMatrix_eq_of_SO_rightInverse
    (X (k + 1) hk) (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk theta)
    (secondHopfSO k theta)
    (fderiv_levelMap_secondHopfSO_row_zero k theta)
    (fderiv_levelMap_secondHopfSO_normal k theta)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.continuous_secondCircleAt
statement:
theorem continuous_secondCircleAt :
    Continuous (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk)
proof:
:= by
  unfold secondCircleAt
  exact (PiLp.continuous_toLp 2 _).comp <| continuous_pi fun j => by
    by_cases hj2 : j = 2
    · simp [hj2]
      fun_prop
    · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
      · simp [hj2, hj3]
        fun_prop
      · simpa [hj2, hj3] using (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstHopfLoop_closed
statement: theorem firstHopfLoop_closed : firstHopfLoop k 0 = firstHopfLoop k 1
proof:
:= by
  change doubleRotLoop k 1 0 * firstInitialSO k =
    doubleRotLoop k 1 1 * firstInitialSO k
  rw [doubleRotLoop_closed]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondHopfLoop_closed
statement: theorem secondHopfLoop_closed : secondHopfLoop k 0 = secondHopfLoop k 1
proof:
:= by
  change doubleRotLoop k (-1) 0 * secondInitialSO k =
    doubleRotLoop k (-1) 1 * secondInitialSO k
  rw [doubleRotLoop_closed]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstHopfLoop_apply
statement:
theorem firstHopfLoop_apply (u : I) :
    firstHopfLoop k u = firstHopfSO k (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change
    ((doubleRotLoop k 1 u : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) *
        (firstInitialSO k : Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) =
      doubleRotMat k (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) *
        (firstInitialSO k : Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)
  rw [doubleRotLoop_apply]
  simp [linearAngle]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondHopfLoop_apply
statement:
theorem secondHopfLoop_apply (u : I) :
    secondHopfLoop k u = secondHopfSO k (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change
    ((doubleRotLoop k (-1) u : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) *
        (secondInitialSO k : Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) =
      doubleRotMat k (-(2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))) *
        (secondInitialSO k : Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)
  rw [doubleRotLoop_apply]
  simp [linearAngle]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstHopfLoop_class_zero
statement:
theorem firstHopfLoop_class_zero :
    loopClassZ2 (firstHopfLoop k) (firstHopfLoop_closed k) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change loopClassZ2
    (doubleRotLoop k 1 * ContinuousMap.const I (firstInitialSO k)) _ = 0
  rw [loopClassZ2_mul_const_right]
  exact doubleRotLoop_class_zero k 1

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondHopfLoop_class_zero

theorem secondHopfLoop_class_zero :

proof:

    (doubleRotLoop k (-1) * ContinuousMap.const I (secondInitialSO k)) _ = 0
  rw [loopClassZ2_mul_const_right]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircleCurve_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem secondCircleCurve_zero :
    secondCircleCurve k 0 = secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [secondCircleCurve]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircleCurve_closed
statement:
theorem secondCircleCurve_closed :
    secondCircleCurve k 0 = secondCircleCurve k 1
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro j
  by_cases hj2 : j = 2
  · subst j
    simp [secondCircleCurve, secondCircleAt_apply_two]
  · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
    · subst j
      simp [secondCircleCurve, secondCircleAt_apply_three]
    · simp [secondCircleCurve,
        secondCircleAt_apply_other (k + 1) hk _ hj2 hj3]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircleAt_eq_iff_mod
statement:
theorem secondCircleAt_eq_iff_mod {theta theta' : ℝ}
    (h : secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk theta =
      secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk theta') :
    ∃ z : ℤ, theta' = theta + (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have hcos : Real.cos theta = Real.cos theta' := by
    simpa only [secondCircleAt_apply_two] using
      congrArg (fun x : Ek => x 2) h
  have hsin : Real.sin theta = Real.sin theta' := by
    simpa only [secondCircleAt_apply_three] using
      congrArg (fun x : Ek => x 3) h
  have hone : Real.cos (theta' - theta) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.cos_sub, ← hcos, ← hsin]
    linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff _).mp hone
  exact ⟨z, by linarith⟩

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircleCurve_eq_cases
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := secondCircleAt_eq_iff_mod k huv
  have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
  have huvZ : (v : ℝ) = (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) := by
    change 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ) =
      2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) at hz
    nlinarith
  have hzLowerR : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  have hzUpperR : (z : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
  have hzLower : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast hzLowerR
  have hzUpper : z ≤ (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hzUpperR
  rcases (show z = -1 ∨ z = 0 ∨ z = 1 by omega) with hzv | hzv | hzv
  · right; right
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hzv] at huvZ
    norm_num at huvZ
    exact huvZ.symm
  · right; left
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstCircleAt_mem_orbit

theorem firstCircleAt_mem_orbit (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk))
    (theta : ℝ) :
    circleAt (m := k + 1) theta ∈
      V.orbit (circleAt (m := k + 1) 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact V.continuousCurve_mem_orbit (circleAt (m := k + 1))
    contDiff_circleAt.continuous (firstCircleAt_mem_fiber k) theta

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircleAt_mem_orbit

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.first_paramFrameLoop_eq_firstHopfLoop
statement:
theorem first_paramFrameLoop_eq_firstHopfLoop
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    (firstSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop = firstHopfLoop k
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop (X (k + 1) hk)
      (firstSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).realCurve (u : ℝ) =
    ((firstHopfLoop k u : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)
  unfold frameLoop
  rw [(firstSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).realCurve_coe]
  change rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
      (frameAt (X (k + 1) hk)
        (circleAt (m := k + 1) (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))) = _
  rw [first_frameMatrix_eq_firstHopfSO]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (firstHopfLoop_apply k u).symm

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.second_paramFrameLoop_eq_secondHopfLoop
statement:
theorem second_paramFrameLoop_eq_secondHopfLoop
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    (secondSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop = secondHopfLoop k
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop (X (k + 1) hk)
      (secondSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).realCurve (u : ℝ) =
    ((secondHopfLoop k u : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)
  unfold frameLoop
  rw [(secondSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).realCurve_coe]
  change rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
      (frameAt (X (k + 1) hk)
        (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))) = _
  rw [second_frameMatrix_eq_secondHopfSO]
  exact congrArg Subtype.val (secondHopfLoop_apply k u).symm

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.first_paramFrameClass_eq_zero
statement:
theorem first_paramFrameClass_eq_zero
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    loopClassZ2 (firstSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop
        (firstSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop_closed = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    loopClassZ2 (firstSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop
        (firstSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop_closed =
      loopClassZ2 (firstHopfLoop k) (firstHopfLoop_closed k) := by
        apply loopClassZ2_congr_fun
        exact first_paramFrameLoop_eq_firstHopfLoop k V
    _ = 0 := firstHopfLoop_class_zero k

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.second_paramFrameClass_eq_zero

theorem second_paramFrameClass_eq_zero
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :

        (secondSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop_closed = 0
proof:
:= by
  calc
    loopClassZ2 (secondSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop
        (secondSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop_closed =
      loopClassZ2 (secondHopfLoop k) (secondHopfLoop_closed k) := by
        apply loopClassZ2_congr_fun
        exact second_paramFrameLoop_eq_secondHopfLoop k V
    _ = 0 := secondHopfLoop_class_zero k

name: Submission.TamedField.contDiff_flow
statement: theorem contDiff_flow (p : E) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V.flow p)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_infty]
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      exact contDiff_zero.mpr (V.continuous_flow p)
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [show ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞ω) = (k : ℕ∞ω) + 1 by norm_num,
        contDiff_succ_iff_deriv]
      refine ⟨fun t => (V.hasDerivAt_flow p t).differentiableAt, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · have hderiv : deriv (V.flow p) = V.v ∘ V.flow p := by
          funext t
          exact (V.hasDerivAt_flow p t).deriv
        rw [hderiv]
        exact (V.smooth.of_le
          (by exact_mod_cast (le_top : (k : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤))).comp ih

name: Submission.TamedField.deriv_flow
statement:
@[simp] theorem deriv_flow (p : E) (t : ℝ) :
    deriv (V.flow p) t = V.v (V.flow p t)
proof:
:=
  (V.hasDerivAt_flow p t).deriv

name: Submission.TamedField.norm_deriv_flow_of_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem norm_deriv_flow_of_mem_fiber {p : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) (t : ℝ) :
    ‖deriv (V.flow p) t‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [V.deriv_flow, V.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber (V.flow_mem_fiber hp t),
    norm_tauField (X.fiber_subset_regularSet (V.flow_mem_fiber hp t))]

name: Submission.TamedField.contDiff_intrinsicOrbitLift
statement:
theorem contDiff_intrinsicOrbitLift (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O)
proof:
:= by
  exact (V.contDiff_flow (V.orbitPoint O)).comp
    (contDiff_id.mul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.TamedField.hasDerivAt_intrinsicOrbitLift
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_intrinsicOrbitLift (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O)
      (V.orbitPeriod O • V.v (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)) u
proof:
:= by
  have h :=
    (V.hasDerivAt_flow (V.orbitPoint O) (u * V.orbitPeriod O)).scomp u
      ((hasDerivAt_id u).mul_const (V.orbitPeriod O))
  change HasDerivAt
    (fun z : ℝ => V.flow (V.orbitPoint O) (z * V.orbitPeriod O))
    (V.orbitPeriod O •
      V.v (V.flow (V.orbitPoint O) (u * V.orbitPeriod O))) u
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using h

name: Submission.TamedField.norm_deriv_intrinsicOrbitLift
statement:
theorem norm_deriv_intrinsicOrbitLift (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    ‖deriv (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O) u‖ = V.orbitPeriod O
proof:
:= by
  rw [(V.hasDerivAt_intrinsicOrbitLift O u).deriv, norm_smul,
    intrinsicOrbitLift,
    V.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber
      (V.flow_mem_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) (u * V.orbitPeriod O)),
    norm_tauField (X.fiber_subset_regularSet
      (V.flow_mem_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
        (u * V.orbitPeriod O))),
    mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (V.orbitPeriod_pos O)]

name: Submission.TamedField.deriv_intrinsicOrbitLift_ne_zero
statement:
theorem deriv_intrinsicOrbitLift_ne_zero (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    deriv (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O) u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hnorm := V.norm_deriv_intrinsicOrbitLift O u
  rw [hzero, norm_zero] at hnorm
  linarith [V.orbitPeriod_pos O]

name: Submission.TamedField.periodic_intrinsicOrbitLift
statement:
theorem periodic_intrinsicOrbitLift (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    Function.Periodic (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O) 1
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  change V.flow (V.orbitPoint O) ((u + 1) * V.orbitPeriod O) =
    V.flow (V.orbitPoint O) (u * V.orbitPeriod O)
  convert V.flow_periodic_orbitPeriod O (u * V.orbitPeriod O) using 1
  · ring

name: Submission.TamedField.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem intrinsicOrbitEmbedding_coe (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding O (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) =
      V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u
proof:
:= by
  simpa [intrinsicOrbitEmbedding, intrinsicOrbitHomeomorph,
      intrinsicOrbitLift, orbitPeriod, Homeomorph.setCongr,
      AddCircle.homeomorphAddCircle_apply_mk] using
    (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph_coe (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
      (u * V.fundamentalPeriod (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)))

name: Submission.TamedField.isEmbedding_intrinsicOrbitEmbedding
statement:
theorem isEmbedding_intrinsicOrbitEmbedding (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    Topology.IsEmbedding (V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding O)
proof:
:= by
  change Topology.IsEmbedding
    ((fun x : (O : Set E) => (x : E)) ∘ V.intrinsicOrbitHomeomorph O)
  exact Topology.IsEmbedding.subtypeVal.comp
    (V.intrinsicOrbitHomeomorph O).isEmbedding

name: Submission.TamedField.range_intrinsicOrbitEmbedding
statement:
theorem range_intrinsicOrbitEmbedding (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    Set.range (V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding O) = (O : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro x ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact (V.intrinsicOrbitHomeomorph O a).property
  · intro x hx
    let y : (O : Set E) := ⟨x, hx⟩
    refine ⟨(V.intrinsicOrbitHomeomorph O).symm y, ?_⟩
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      ((V.intrinsicOrbitHomeomorph O).apply_symm_apply y)

name: Submission.IsPreconnected.subset_of_finite_closed_cover
statement:
theorem IsPreconnected.subset_of_finite_closed_cover
    {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {s : Set α} {m : ℕ}
    (hs : IsPreconnected s) (F : Fin m → Set α)
    (hF : ∀ i, IsClosed (F i))
    (hcover : s ⊆ ⋃ i, F i)
    (hdisj : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → s ∩ (F i ∩ F j) = ∅)
    (hne : s.Nonempty) :
    ∃ i, s ⊆ F i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hne
  obtain ⟨i₀, hxi₀⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hcover hx)
  refine ⟨i₀, ?_⟩
  have ht'closed : IsClosed (⋃ j ∈ ({j | j ≠ i₀} : Set (Fin m)), F j) := by
    apply Set.Finite.isClosed_biUnion (Set.toFinite _)
    intro j _
    exact hF j
  have hcover' : s ⊆ F i₀ ∪ ⋃ j ∈ ({j | j ≠ i₀} : Set (Fin m)), F j := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨j, hyj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp (hcover hy)
    by_cases hj : j = i₀
    · exact Or.inl (hj ▸ hyj)
    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_biUnion hj hyj)
  have hempty : s ∩ (⋃ j ∈ ({j | j ≠ i₀} : Set (Fin m)), F j) = ∅ := by
    by_contra hcontra
    obtain ⟨y, hys, hyt⟩ := Set.nonempty_iff_ne_empty.mpr hcontra
    have hinter := (isPreconnected_closed_iff.mp hs) (F i₀)
      (⋃ j ∈ ({j | j ≠ i₀} : Set (Fin m)), F j)
      (hF i₀) ht'closed hcover' ⟨x, hx, hxi₀⟩ ⟨y, hys, hyt⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hzs, hzi₀, hzt⟩ := hinter
    obtain ⟨j, hj, hzj⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hzt
    have hd := hdisj i₀ j (Ne.symm hj)
    have hzmem : z ∈ s ∩ (F i₀ ∩ F j) := ⟨hzs, hzi₀, hzj⟩
    rw [hd] at hzmem
    exact Set.notMem_empty z hzmem
  intro y hy
  rcases hcover' hy with h | h
  · exact h
  · have hymem : y ∈ s ∩ ⋃ j ∈ ({j | j ≠ i₀} : Set (Fin m)), F j := ⟨hy, h⟩
    rw [hempty] at hymem
    exact absurd hymem (Set.notMem_empty y)

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.flowSign_mul_self
statement: theorem flowSign_mul_self : P.flowSign * P.flowSign = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [flowSign]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.flowSign_ne_zero
statement: theorem flowSign_ne_zero : P.flowSign ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [flowSign]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.flowSign_eq_one_or_neg_one
statement:
theorem flowSign_eq_one_or_neg_one :
    P.flowSign = 1 ∨ P.flowSign = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [flowSign]
  split_ifs
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · exact Or.inr rfl

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLift_eq_flowSign_mul_forward
statement:
theorem phaseLift_eq_flowSign_mul_forward (w : I) :
    P.phaseLift w = P.flowSign * P.forwardPhaseLift w
proof:
:= by
  rw [flowSign, forwardPhaseLift]
  split_ifs
  · rw [one_mul]
  · simp

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.curve_eq_flow_forwardPhaseLift
statement:
theorem curve_eq_flow_forwardPhaseLift (w : I) :
    P.curve w = V.flow P.p (P.flowSign * P.forwardPhaseLift w)
proof:
:= by
  have hphase : P.phase w = ((P.phaseLift w : ℝ) :
      AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)) := (P.phaseLift_coe w).symm
  have h := P.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phase w
  rw [hphase] at h
  have hcoe := congrArg Subtype.val h
  rw [V.orbitCircleHomeomorph_coe P.hp (P.phaseLift w)] at hcoe
  have hcurve : P.curve w = V.flow P.p (P.phaseLift w) := hcoe.symm
  rw [hcurve, P.phaseLift_eq_flowSign_mul_forward w]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.mem_range_curve_of_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem mem_range_curve_of_mem_orbit {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hx : x ∈ V.orbit P.p) : x ∈ Set.range P.curve
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := P.exists_curve_eq_of_mem_orbit hx
  exact ⟨u, hu⟩

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.exists_mem_cyclicCutRange
statement:
theorem exists_mem_cyclicCutRange (A : P.CyclicMarking k)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : x ∈ V.orbit P.p) :
    ∃ i : Fin (k + 1), x ∈ A.cyclicCutRange i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := P.exists_curve_eq_of_mem_orbit hx
  by_cases hlow : u ≤ A.sortedMark 0
  · refine ⟨Fin.last k, ?_⟩
    rw [A.cyclicCutRange_last, A.range_wrapSubpath]
    exact ⟨u, Or.inr ⟨u.property.1, hlow⟩, hu⟩
  by_cases hhigh : A.sortedMark (Fin.last k) ≤ u
  · refine ⟨Fin.last k, ?_⟩
    rw [A.cyclicCutRange_last, A.range_wrapSubpath]
    exact ⟨u, Or.inl ⟨hhigh, u.property.2⟩, hu⟩
  push_neg at hlow hhigh
  
  let Q : ℕ → Prop := fun m => ∃ h : m < k + 1, A.sortedMark ⟨m, h⟩ ≤ u
  have hQ0 : Q 0 := ⟨Nat.succ_pos k, hlow.le⟩
  have hm₀le : Nat.findGreatest Q k ≤ k := Nat.findGreatest_le (P := Q) k
  have hm₀Q : Q (Nat.findGreatest Q k) :=
    Nat.findGreatest_spec (Nat.zero_le k) hQ0
  obtain ⟨hm₀lt, hm₀mark⟩ := hm₀Q
  have hm₀ne : Nat.findGreatest Q k ≠ k := by
    intro heq
    apply absurd hm₀mark
    push_neg
    have hlast : (⟨Nat.findGreatest Q k, hm₀lt⟩ : Fin (k + 1)) =
        Fin.last k := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simpa using heq
    rw [hlast]
    exact hhigh
  have hm₀ltk : Nat.findGreatest Q k < k := lt_of_le_of_ne hm₀le hm₀ne
  have hnext : ¬ Q (Nat.findGreatest Q k + 1) := by
    intro hQnext
    have hle := Nat.le_findGreatest (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hm₀ltk) hQnext
    omega
  have hunext : u ≤ A.sortedMark
      (⟨Nat.findGreatest Q k, hm₀ltk⟩ : Fin k).succ := by
    by_contra hcon
    push_neg at hcon
    exact hnext ⟨Nat.succ_lt_succ hm₀ltk, hcon.le⟩
  refine ⟨(⟨Nat.findGreatest Q k, hm₀ltk⟩ : Fin k).castSucc, ?_⟩
  rw [A.cyclicCutRange_castSucc, A.range_adjacentSubpath]
  exact ⟨u, ⟨hm₀mark, hunext⟩, hu⟩

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.point_mem_cyclicCutRange_cases
statement:
theorem point_mem_cyclicCutRange_cases (A : P.CyclicMarking k)
    {l : Fin (k + 1)} {i : Fin (k + 1)}
    (h : A.point l ∈ A.cyclicCutRange i) :
    l = A.cyclicCutSourceLabel i ∨ l = A.cyclicCutTargetLabel i
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      rw [A.cyclicCutRange_last] at h
      have hcase := A.point_mem_range_wrapSubpath l h
      rcases hcase with hcase | hcase
      · left
        rw [cyclicCutSourceLabel, Fin.lastCases_last]
        exact hcase
      · right
        rw [cyclicCutTargetLabel, Fin.lastCases_last]
        exact hcase
  | cast r =>
      rw [A.cyclicCutRange_castSucc] at h
      have hcase := A.point_mem_range_adjacentSubpath r l h
      rcases hcase with hcase | hcase
      · left
        rw [cyclicCutSourceLabel, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
        exact hcase
      · right
        rw [cyclicCutTargetLabel, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
        exact hcase

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel_eq_sortedLabel
statement:
theorem cyclicCutSourceLabel_eq_sortedLabel
    (A : P.CyclicMarking k) (i : Fin (k + 1)) :
    A.cyclicCutSourceLabel i = A.sortedLabel i
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => rw [cyclicCutSourceLabel, Fin.lastCases_last]
  | cast r => rw [cyclicCutSourceLabel, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel_eq_sortedLabel
statement:
theorem cyclicCutTargetLabel_eq_sortedLabel
    (A : P.CyclicMarking k) (i : Fin (k + 1)) :
    A.cyclicCutTargetLabel i =
      A.sortedLabel (Fin.lastCases 0 (fun j : Fin k => j.succ) i)
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => rw [cyclicCutTargetLabel, Fin.lastCases_last, Fin.lastCases_last]
  | cast r =>
      rw [cyclicCutTargetLabel, Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.targetIndex_val
statement:
theorem targetIndex_val (A : P.CyclicMarking k) (i : Fin (k + 1)) :
    ((Fin.lastCases 0 (fun j : Fin k => j.succ) i : Fin (k + 1)) : ℕ) =
      ((i : ℕ) + 1) % (k + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      rw [Fin.lastCases_last]
      simp [Nat.mod_self]
  | cast r =>
      rw [Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
      have hlt : (r : ℕ) + 1 < k + 1 := Nat.succ_lt_succ r.isLt
      simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCut_eq_of_endpointPair_eq
statement:
theorem cyclicCut_eq_of_endpointPair_eq (A : P.CyclicMarking 3)
    {i j : Fin 4}
    (h : (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel i = A.cyclicCutSourceLabel j ∧
        A.cyclicCutTargetLabel i = A.cyclicCutTargetLabel j) ∨
      (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel i = A.cyclicCutTargetLabel j ∧
        A.cyclicCutTargetLabel i = A.cyclicCutSourceLabel j)) :
    i = j
proof:
:= by
  rcases h with ⟨h₁, _⟩ | ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  · rw [A.cyclicCutSourceLabel_eq_sortedLabel i,
      A.cyclicCutSourceLabel_eq_sortedLabel j] at h₁
    exact A.sortedLabel.injective h₁
  · rw [A.cyclicCutSourceLabel_eq_sortedLabel i,
      A.cyclicCutTargetLabel_eq_sortedLabel j] at h₁
    rw [A.cyclicCutTargetLabel_eq_sortedLabel i,
      A.cyclicCutSourceLabel_eq_sortedLabel j] at h₂
    have e₁ : (i : ℕ) = ((j : ℕ) + 1) % 4 := by
      have hval := congrArg (fun x : Fin 4 => (x : ℕ))
        (A.sortedLabel.injective h₁)
      simpa [A.targetIndex_val j] using hval
    have e₂ : ((i : ℕ) + 1) % 4 = (j : ℕ) := by
      have hval := congrArg (fun x : Fin 4 => (x : ℕ))
        (A.sortedLabel.injective h₂)
      simpa [A.targetIndex_val i] using hval
    have hi := i.isLt
    have hj := j.isLt
    apply Fin.ext
    omega

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel_injective
statement:
theorem cyclicCutSourceLabel_injective (A : P.CyclicMarking k) :
    Injective A.cyclicCutSourceLabel
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  rw [A.cyclicCutSourceLabel_eq_sortedLabel i,
    A.cyclicCutSourceLabel_eq_sortedLabel j] at hij
  exact A.sortedLabel.injective hij

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel_injective
statement:
theorem cyclicCutTargetLabel_injective (A : P.CyclicMarking 3) :
    Injective A.cyclicCutTargetLabel
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  rw [A.cyclicCutTargetLabel_eq_sortedLabel i,
    A.cyclicCutTargetLabel_eq_sortedLabel j] at hij
  have hval := congrArg (fun x : Fin 4 => (x : ℕ))
    (A.sortedLabel.injective hij)
  simp only [A.targetIndex_val] at hval
  have hi := i.isLt
  have hj := j.isLt
  apply Fin.ext
  omega

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.exists_flow_mem_cyclicCutRange
statement:
theorem exists_flow_mem_cyclicCutRange (A : P.CyclicMarking k)
    (i : Fin (k + 1)) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ d : ℝ, 0 < d → d < δ →
      V.flow (A.point (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel i)) (P.flowSign * d) ∈
        A.cyclicCutRange i ∧
      V.flow (A.point (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel i)) (-(P.flowSign * d)) ∈
        A.cyclicCutRange i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hT : 0 < V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp := V.fundamentalPeriod_pos P.hp
  have hflowshift : ∀ (w : I) (d : ℝ),
      V.flow (P.curve w) d =
        V.flow P.p (P.flowSign * P.forwardPhaseLift w + d) := by
    intro w d
    rw [P.curve_eq_flow_forwardPhaseLift w]
    exact congrFun (V.flow_shift P.p (P.flowSign * P.forwardPhaseLift w)) d
  have hrealize : ∀ (a b : I), a ≤ b → ∀ ℓ : ℝ,
      P.forwardPhaseLift a ≤ ℓ → ℓ ≤ P.forwardPhaseLift b →
      ∃ w : I, w ∈ Set.Icc a b ∧ P.forwardPhaseLift w = ℓ := by
    intro a b hab ℓ hla hlb
    have hIV := intermediate_value_Icc hab
      (P.forwardPhaseLift.continuous.continuousOn (s := Set.Icc a b))
    obtain ⟨w, hw, hwl⟩ := hIV ⟨hla, hlb⟩
    exact ⟨w, hw, hwl⟩
  have hcurve_flow : ∀ ℓ : ℝ, ∀ w : I, P.forwardPhaseLift w = ℓ →
      V.flow P.p (P.flowSign * ℓ) = P.curve w := by
    intro ℓ w hw
    rw [P.curve_eq_flow_forwardPhaseLift w, hw]
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      have hLperiod : P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark (Fin.last k)) <
          V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp :=
        A.forwardSortedMark_lt_period (Fin.last k)
      have h0nonneg : 0 ≤ P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark 0) :=
        A.forwardSortedMark_nonneg 0
      refine ⟨V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp -
        P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark (Fin.last k)), by linarith, ?_⟩
      intro d hd hdlt
      constructor
      · 
        have hsrc : A.point (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel (Fin.last k)) =
            P.curve (A.sortedMark (Fin.last k)) := by
          rw [A.cyclicCutSourceLabel_eq_sortedLabel]
          exact (A.curve_mark _).symm
        rw [hsrc, hflowshift]
        have hmul : P.flowSign * P.forwardPhaseLift
              (A.sortedMark (Fin.last k)) + P.flowSign * d =
            P.flowSign * (P.forwardPhaseLift
              (A.sortedMark (Fin.last k)) + d) := by ring
        rw [hmul]
        obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwl⟩ := hrealize (A.sortedMark (Fin.last k)) 1
          (show A.sortedMark (Fin.last k) ≤ (1 : I) from
            (A.sortedMark (Fin.last k)).property.2)
          (P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark (Fin.last k)) + d)
          (by linarith)
          (by rw [P.forwardPhaseLift_one]; linarith)
        rw [hcurve_flow _ w hwl]
        rw [A.cyclicCutRange_last, A.range_wrapSubpath]
        exact ⟨w, Or.inl hwmem, rfl⟩
      · 
        have htgt : A.point (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel (Fin.last k)) =
            P.curve (A.sortedMark 0) := by
          rw [cyclicCutTargetLabel, Fin.lastCases_last]
          exact (A.curve_mark _).symm
        rw [htgt, hflowshift]
        by_cases hcase : d ≤ P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark 0)
        · have hmul : P.flowSign * P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark 0) +
              -(P.flowSign * d) =
              P.flowSign * (P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark 0) - d) := by
            ring
          rw [hmul]
          obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwl⟩ := hrealize 0 (A.sortedMark 0)
            (show (0 : I) ≤ A.sortedMark 0 from (A.sortedMark 0).property.1)
            (P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark 0) - d)
            (by rw [P.forwardPhaseLift_zero]; linarith)
            (by linarith)
          rw [hcurve_flow _ w hwl]
          rw [A.cyclicCutRange_last, A.range_wrapSubpath]
          exact ⟨w, Or.inr hwmem, rfl⟩
        · push_neg at hcase
          have hper : ∀ s : ℝ, V.flow P.p
              (s - P.flowSign * V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp) =
              V.flow P.p s := by
            intro s
            rcases P.flowSign_eq_one_or_neg_one with hsgn | hsgn
            · rw [hsgn, one_mul]
              exact (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic P.hp).sub_eq s
            · rw [hsgn]
              have h := V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic P.hp s
              simpa [sub_neg_eq_add, neg_mul, one_mul] using h
          have hmul : P.flowSign * P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark 0) +
              -(P.flowSign * d) =
              P.flowSign * (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp +
                P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark 0) - d) -
                P.flowSign * V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp := by
            ring
          rw [hmul, hper]
          obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwl⟩ := hrealize (A.sortedMark (Fin.last k)) 1
            (show A.sortedMark (Fin.last k) ≤ (1 : I) from
              (A.sortedMark (Fin.last k)).property.2)
            (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp +
              P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark 0) - d)
            (by linarith)
            (by rw [P.forwardPhaseLift_one]; linarith)
          rw [hcurve_flow _ w hwl]
          rw [A.cyclicCutRange_last, A.range_wrapSubpath]
          exact ⟨w, Or.inl hwmem, rfl⟩
  | cast r =>
      have hablt : A.sortedMark r.castSucc < A.sortedMark r.succ :=
        A.sortedMark_strictMono Fin.castSucc_lt_succ
      have hliftlt : P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark r.castSucc) <
          P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark r.succ) :=
        P.forwardPhaseLift_strictMono hablt
      refine ⟨P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark r.succ) -
        P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark r.castSucc), by linarith, ?_⟩
      intro d hd hdlt
      constructor
      · have hsrc : A.point (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r.castSucc) =
            P.curve (A.sortedMark r.castSucc) := by
          rw [A.cyclicCutSourceLabel_eq_sortedLabel]
          exact (A.curve_mark _).symm
        rw [hsrc, hflowshift]
        have hmul : P.flowSign * P.forwardPhaseLift
              (A.sortedMark r.castSucc) + P.flowSign * d =
            P.flowSign * (P.forwardPhaseLift
              (A.sortedMark r.castSucc) + d) := by ring
        rw [hmul]
        obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwl⟩ := hrealize (A.sortedMark r.castSucc)
          (A.sortedMark r.succ) hablt.le
          (P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark r.castSucc) + d)
          (by linarith) (by linarith)
        rw [hcurve_flow _ w hwl]
        rw [A.cyclicCutRange_castSucc, A.range_adjacentSubpath]
        exact ⟨w, hwmem, rfl⟩
      · have htgt : A.point (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r.castSucc) =
            P.curve (A.sortedMark r.succ) := by
          rw [cyclicCutTargetLabel, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
          exact (A.curve_mark _).symm
        rw [htgt, hflowshift]
        have hmul : P.flowSign * P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark r.succ) +
            -(P.flowSign * d) =
            P.flowSign * (P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark r.succ) - d) := by
          ring
        rw [hmul]
        obtain ⟨w, hwmem, hwl⟩ := hrealize (A.sortedMark r.castSucc)
          (A.sortedMark r.succ) hablt.le
          (P.forwardPhaseLift (A.sortedMark r.succ) - d)
          (by linarith) (by linarith)
        rw [hcurve_flow _ w hwl]
        rw [A.cyclicCutRange_castSucc, A.range_adjacentSubpath]
        exact ⟨w, hwmem, rfl⟩

name: Submission.BridgeData.mem_closedAmbientCollar_of_bridgeRadius_le_norm
statement:
theorem mem_closedAmbientCollar_of_bridgeRadius_le_norm
    (_B : BridgeData n z) {x : E}
    (hx : (n + 2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖x‖) :
    WithLp.ofLp x ∈ closedAmbientCollar (Fin (n + 1))
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hnc
  have hcoord : ∀ i, |x i| ≤ 1 := by
    intro i
    have hnot : ¬(x i ≤ 1 / 5 ∨ 4 / 5 ≤ x i) := fun h =>
      hnc ⟨i, h⟩
    rw [not_or, not_le, not_le] at hnot
    exact abs_le.mpr ⟨by linarith [hnot.1], by linarith [hnot.2]⟩
  have hnorm : ‖x‖ ≤ n + 1 := by
    have hsq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := norm_sq_eq_sum x
    have hsum : (∑ i, x i ^ 2) ≤ ∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℝ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro i _
      have hi := hcoord i
      nlinarith [abs_nonneg (x i), sq_abs (x i)]
    have hone : (∑ _i : Fin (n + 1), (1 : ℝ)) = n + 1 := by
      simp
    have hsq' : ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
      have hn0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (n : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg n
      have hn1 : (n : ℝ) + 1 ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith
      calc
        ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, x i ^ 2 := hsq
        _ ≤ n + 1 := hsum.trans_eq hone
        _ ≤ ((n : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 := hn1
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
  have hgap : (n + 1 : ℝ) < n + 2 := by norm_num
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hnorm) (hgap.trans_le hx)

name: Submission.BridgeData.fls_flatOutside

    B.fls.FlatOutside (-B.y) 0 (n + 2)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [dist_zero_right] at hx
  have hcollar := B.mem_closedAmbientCollar_of_bridgeRadius_le_norm hx
  change bridgeHMapE B.approx x - B.y = -B.y
  have hzero : bridgeHMapE B.approx x = 0 := by
    change bridgeHMap B.approx (WithLp.ofLp x) = 0
    exact bridgeHMap_of_mem_collar B.approx hcollar
  rw [hzero]
  exact zero_sub B.y

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.eventTime_eq_of_mem_bracket
statement:
private theorem eventTime_eq_of_mem_bracket
    {s : ℝ} (hsEvent : s ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hs : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  let v := D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent
  have hvCritical : v ∈ timeCritical D.signedOutput.cobordism.G :=
    (D.position.eventCenter_mem_coreCriticalPoints s hsEvent).1
  have hvInterval : tcoord v ∈
      Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
    change tcoord (D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent) ∈ _
    rw [D.position.eventCenter_time s hsEvent]
    exact hs
  have hvEq : v = D.position.eventCenter t ht :=
    (D.position.eventBracket t ht).isolates v hvCritical hvInterval
  calc
    s = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent) :=
      (D.position.eventCenter_time s hsEvent).symm
    _ = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := congrArg tcoord hvEq
    _ = t := D.position.eventCenter_time t ht

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.regularSlab_before_chronologicalWindow
statement:
theorem regularSlab_before_chronologicalWindow :
    regularSlab D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.position.regularSlab_iff_avoid_eventTimes]
  intro s hsEvent hs
  have hsBracket : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after :=
    ⟨hs.1, hs.2.trans
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_bracket t ht).2.le⟩
  have hst : s = t := D.eventTime_eq_of_mem_bracket t ht hsEvent hsBracket
  have hinner_lt_t : D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht < t :=
    (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_beforeCenter t ht).2.trans_eq
      (D.position.eventCenter_time t ht)
  exact (not_le_of_gt hinner_lt_t) (calc
    t = s := hst.symm
    _ ≤ D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht := hs.2)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.regularSlab_after_chronologicalWindow
statement:
theorem regularSlab_after_chronologicalWindow :
    regularSlab D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.position.regularSlab_iff_avoid_eventTimes]
  intro s hsEvent hs
  have hsBracket : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after :=
    ⟨(D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht).1.le.trans hs.1, hs.2⟩
  have hst : s = t := D.eventTime_eq_of_mem_bracket t ht hsEvent hsBracket
  have ht_lt_inner : t < D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht := calc
    t = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) :=
      (D.position.eventCenter_time t ht).symm
    _ < D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht :=
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_afterCenter t ht).1
  exact (not_le_of_gt ht_lt_inner) (calc
    D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht ≤ s := hs.1
    _ = t := hst)

name: Submission.nonempty_positiveEventLedgerMove_of_index
statement:
theorem nonempty_positiveEventLedgerMove_of_index
    {X Y : FramedLevelSet n} {S : FiberSign X} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
    (P : SignedMorsePerturbation C)
    (Q : MorsePosition P.signedCobordism.cobordism)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Q.eventTimes)
    (minimum :
      (Q.eventModel t ht).index = .minimum →
        Nonempty
          (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData P.signedCobordism Q t ht))
    (saddle :
      (Q.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle →
        Nonempty
          (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData P.signedCobordism Q t ht))
    (maximum :
      (Q.eventModel t ht).index = .maximum →
        Nonempty
          (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData P.signedCobordism Q t ht)) :
    Nonempty (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData P.signedCobordism Q t ht)
proof:
:= by
  cases hindex : (Q.eventModel t ht).index with
  | minimum => exact minimum hindex
  | saddle => exact saddle hindex
  | maximum => exact maximum hindex

name: Submission.signedCobordismDeltaInvariant_of_indexedPositiveLedgerMoves
statement:
theorem signedCobordismDeltaInvariant_of_indexedPositiveLedgerMoves
    (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (minimum : ∀ {X Y : FramedLevelSet n}
      {S : FiberSign X} {T : FiberSign Y}
      (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
      (P : SignedMorsePerturbation C)
      (Q : MorsePosition P.signedCobordism.cobordism)
      (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Q.eventTimes),
      Q.eventCenter t ht ∈
          (P.signedCobordism.labelMorsePosition Q).positiveCenters →
      (Q.eventModel t ht).index = .minimum →
        Nonempty
          (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData P.signedCobordism Q t ht))
    (saddle : ∀ {X Y : FramedLevelSet n}
      {S : FiberSign X} {T : FiberSign Y}
      (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
      (P : SignedMorsePerturbation C)
      (Q : MorsePosition P.signedCobordism.cobordism)
      (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Q.eventTimes),
      Q.eventCenter t ht ∈
          (P.signedCobordism.labelMorsePosition Q).positiveCenters →
      (Q.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle →
        Nonempty
          (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData P.signedCobordism Q t ht))
    (maximum : ∀ {X Y : FramedLevelSet n}
      {S : FiberSign X} {T : FiberSign Y}
      (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
      (P : SignedMorsePerturbation C)
      (Q : MorsePosition P.signedCobordism.cobordism)
      (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ Q.eventTimes),
      Q.eventCenter t ht ∈
          (P.signedCobordism.labelMorsePosition Q).positiveCenters →
      (Q.eventModel t ht).index = .maximum →
        Nonempty
          (PositiveEventLedgerMoveData P.signedCobordism Q t ht)) :
    SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant n
proof:
:=
  signedCobordismDeltaInvariant_of_positiveLedgerMoves hn fun C P Q t ht hpositive =>
    nonempty_positiveEventLedgerMove_of_index C P Q t ht
      (minimum C P Q t ht hpositive)
      (saddle C P Q t ht hpositive)
      (maximum C P Q t ht hpositive)

name: Submission.BridgeCanonicalGaugeComposition.norm_lt_two_of_mem_outerTube
statement:
theorem norm_lt_two_of_mem_outerTube {v : E}
    (hv : v ∈ tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 3)) : ‖v‖ < 2
proof:
:= by
  have hd : tubeDistSq v < (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ 2 := hv
  have hr := rad_le_norm v
  rw [tubeDistSq] at hd
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖v‖ - 1), norm_nonneg v]

name: Submission.BridgeCanonicalGaugeComposition.sub_center_not_mem_outerTube_of_supportRadius_le_norm
statement:
theorem sub_center_not_mem_outerTube_of_supportRadius_le_norm
    {x : E} (hx : supportRadius V₀ ≤ ‖x‖)
    (O : V₀.OrbitIndex) :
    x - CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O ∉
      tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 3)
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hoff :
      ‖x - CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O‖ < 2 :=
    norm_lt_two_of_mem_outerTube hmem
  have hcenter :
      ‖CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O‖ ≤
        ∑ P : V₀.OrbitIndex,
          ‖CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) P‖ := by
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun P _ => norm_nonneg
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) P))
      (Finset.mem_univ O)
  have htriangle :
      ‖x‖ ≤ ‖x - CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O‖ +
        ‖CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O‖ := by
    simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using
      norm_add_le (x - CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O)
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O)
  have hlt : ‖x‖ < supportRadius V₀ :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt htriangle (add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le hoff hcenter)
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hx) hlt

name: Submission.BridgeCanonicalGaugeComposition.listSpatialGauge_eq_one_of_supportRadius_le_norm
statement:

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.transportedParam_covers_fiber_within_morseRadius
statement:
theorem transportedParam_covers_fiber_within_morseRadius
    {R₀ : B₀.SharedCutoffMorseData χ₀}
    (S : CriticalValueShiftData R₀) (e : GlobalCriticalEvent R₀)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v (S.shiftedCenter e) < ε →
      S.output.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧ S.transportedParam e u = v
proof:
:= by
  let p := (R₀.criticalEventOwner e).1
  let hp : p ∈ R₀.criticalParameters := R₀.criticalEventOwner_mem e
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hcover⟩ :=
    R₀.covers_fiber_within_morseRadius p hp hr
  have hac : S.amplitude.diffeomorph (S.shiftedCenter e) = R₀.center p := by
    rw [S.amplitude_diffeomorph, shiftedCenter,
      ← R₀.criticalEventOwner_center e]
    exact S.forward.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply _
  have htend : Filter.Tendsto (fun v => S.amplitude.diffeomorph v)
      (nhds (S.shiftedCenter e)) (nhds (R₀.center p)) := by
    rw [← hac]
    exact S.amplitude.diffeomorph.continuous.continuousAt
  have hnear : (fun v => S.amplitude.diffeomorph v) ⁻¹'
      Metric.ball (R₀.center p) ε₀ ∈ nhds (S.shiftedCenter e) :=
    htend (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hε₀)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnear
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hzero
  have hvball : v ∈ Metric.ball (S.shiftedCenter e) ε := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hv
  have haBall : S.amplitude.diffeomorph v ∈
      Metric.ball (R₀.center p) ε₀ := hball hvball
  have haDist : dist (S.amplitude.diffeomorph v) (R₀.center p) < ε₀ := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using haBall
  have haZero : R₀.output.G (S.amplitude.diffeomorph v) = 0 := by
    simpa [output, VerticalAmplitude.pullback_G,
      SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply] using hzero
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hparam⟩ :=
    hcover (S.amplitude.diffeomorph v) haDist haZero
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
  change S.forward.diffeomorph (R₀.criticalAmbientParam p hp u) = v
  rw [hparam, ← S.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm]
  exact S.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply v

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.eventModel_covers_fiber_within_morseRadius
statement:
theorem eventModel_covers_fiber_within_morseRadius
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ ε > 0,
      ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
        dist v (D.position.eventCenter t ht) < ε →
        D.signedOutput.cobordism.G v = 0 →
        ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧
          (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u = v
proof:
:= by
  let S := D.second.toCriticalValueShiftData
  let e := D.chronologicalGlobalEvent t ht
  have H := S.transportedParam_covers_fiber_within_morseRadius e hr
  have hc : S.shiftedCenter e = D.position.eventCenter t ht := by
    exact D.second.shiftedCenter_chronologicalGlobalEvent t ht
  have hparam : (D.position.eventModel t ht).param =
      S.transportedParam e := by
    rw [D.eventModel_eq_transportedStandardMorseEvent t ht]
    simpa [S, e,
      FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.transportedStandardMorseEvent] using
      StandardMorseEventAt.castCenter_param
      (D.second.shiftedCenter_chronologicalGlobalEvent t ht)
      (D.second.toCriticalValueShiftData.transportedStandardMorseEvent
        (D.chronologicalGlobalEvent t ht))
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hcover⟩ := H
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hzero
  have hv' : dist v (S.shiftedCenter e) < ε := by
    rw [hc]
    exact hv
  have hzero' : S.output.G v = 0 := by
    simpa [S] using hzero
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := hcover v hv' hzero'
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_⟩
  rw [hparam]
  exact huv

name: Submission.signedBranch_saddleAffineCoordinate_pos
statement:
theorem signedBranch_saddleAffineCoordinate_pos
    (e : SaddleBranch) {s₀ s₁ : ℝ}
    (hs₀ : 0 < signedBranch e s₀)
    (hs₁ : 0 < signedBranch e s₁) (q : I) :
    0 < signedBranch e (saddleAffineCoordinate s₀ s₁ q)
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | positive =>
      simp only [signedBranch] at hs₀ hs₁ ⊢
      by_cases hq : (q : ℝ) = 1
      · simpa [saddleAffineCoordinate, hq] using hs₁
      · have hq_lt : (q : ℝ) < 1 :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne q.property.2 hq
        have hleft : 0 < (1 - (q : ℝ)) * s₀ :=
          mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hq_lt) hs₀
        have hright : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) * s₁ :=
          mul_nonneg q.property.1 hs₁.le
        simp only [saddleAffineCoordinate]
        linarith
  | negative =>
      simp only [signedBranch] at hs₀ hs₁ ⊢
      by_cases hq : (q : ℝ) = 1
      · simpa [saddleAffineCoordinate, hq] using hs₁
      · have hq_lt : (q : ℝ) < 1 :=
          lt_of_le_of_ne q.property.2 hq
        have hleft : (1 - (q : ℝ)) * s₀ < 0 :=
          mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sub_pos.mpr hq_lt) (by linarith)
        have hright : (q : ℝ) * s₁ ≤ 0 :=
          mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos q.property.1 (by linarith)
        simp only [saddleAffineCoordinate]
        linarith

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryFull_mem_puncturedCriticalSlice_zero
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryFull_mem_puncturedCriticalSlice_zero
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (H : M.FullRadiusSmooth)
    (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b e : SaddleBranch) (rho : ℝ) (u : E₂)
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = (0 : ℝ) ^ 2)
    (hfirst : 0 < signedBranch b (u 0))
    (hsecond : 0 < signedBranch e (u 1))
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (hu : ‖u‖ < T.radius)
    (hrho_radius : rho < T.radius) (q : I) :
    M.saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryFull H b e rho 0 u
        hquad hfirst hrho (by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hrho])
        (hu.trans_le T.radius_le) (hrho_radius.trans_le T.radius_le) q ∈
      puncturedCriticalSlice C center
proof:
:= by
  let z := saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e rho 0 u q
  have ha : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 < rho ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hrho]
  have huM : ‖u‖ < M.radius := hu.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hrhoM : rho < M.radius := hrho_radius.trans_le T.radius_le
  refine ⟨M.saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryFull_fiber H b e rho 0 u
      hquad hfirst hrho ha huM hrhoM q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using M.saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryFull_time H hindex b e
      rho 0 u hquad hfirst hrho ha huM hrhoM q
  · intro hcenter
    have hzNorm : ‖z‖ < T.radius := by
      exact norm_saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam_lt b e u hquad hfirst
        hrho ha hu hrho_radius q
    have hzParam : M.param z = M.param 0 := by
      change M.param z = center at hcenter
      rw [M.param_zero]
      exact hcenter
    have hz0 : z = 0 := by
      apply T.param_injOn
      · simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hzNorm
      · simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using T.radius_pos
      · exact hzParam
    have hsigma : 0 < saddleBoundaryParameter rho 0 :=
      saddleBoundaryParameter_pos_at_zero hrho
    have hendSign : 0 < signedBranch e
        (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter rho 0)) := by
      cases e <;> simp [signedBranch, hsigma]
    have hzSign : 0 < signedBranch e (z 1) := by
      simpa [z, saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam, saddlePositiveArc] using
        signedBranch_saddleAffineCoordinate_pos e hsecond hendSign q
    rw [hz0] at hzSign
    cases e <;> simp [signedBranch] at hzSign

statement:

proof:

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_smallSaddleBoundaryRadius_endpointCover
statement:
theorem exists_smallSaddleBoundaryRadius_endpointCover
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (hcover : ∃ ε > 0,
      ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
        dist v center < ε → C.G v = 0 →
        ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < T.radius ∧ M.param u = v) :
    ∃ rho > 0, rho < T.radius ∧ ∃ δ > 0,
      ∀ (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
        (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))),
        dist v (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho) < δ →
        C.G v = 0 →
        ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < T.radius ∧ M.param u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hcover⟩ := hcover
  have hzero : ‖(0 : E₂)‖ < T.radius := by
    simpa using T.radius_pos
  have hcont : ContinuousAt M.param 0 :=
    (T.param_differentiableAt 0 hzero).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨eta, heta, hclose⟩ := (Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont)
    (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  let rho := min T.radius eta / 2
  have hmin : 0 < min T.radius eta := lt_min T.radius_pos heta
  have hrho : 0 < rho := by
    dsimp [rho]
    positivity
  have hrhoT : rho < T.radius := by
    dsimp [rho]
    have hle := min_le_left T.radius eta
    nlinarith
  have hrhoEta : rho < eta := by
    dsimp [rho]
    have hle := min_le_right T.radius eta
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨rho, hrho, hrhoT, ε / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro p v hv hendFiber
  have hendClose : dist (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho) center <
      ε / 2 := by
    let u := saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p rho
    have huEta : dist u 0 < eta := by
      rw [dist_zero_right, show ‖u‖ = rho by
        exact norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam p.1 p.2 hrho
          (by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hrho])]
      exact hrhoEta
    have h := hclose huEta
    simpa [u, M.param_zero,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd,
      saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint] using h
  have hvCenter : dist v center < ε := by
    calc
      dist v center ≤ dist v (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho) +
          dist (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho) center :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < ε := by linarith
  exact hcover v hvCenter hendFiber

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.changeSaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingRadius
statement:
theorem changeSaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingRadius
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (H : M.FullRadiusSmooth)
    (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {rho sigma : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) (hsigma : 0 < sigma)
    (hrho_radius : rho < T.radius)
    (hsigma_radius : sigma < T.radius)
    (A : M.SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData rho) :
    M.SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData sigma where
  paired
proof:
:= by
    intro p
    refine ⟨A.mate p, ⟨A.mate_ne p, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact (A.mate_arc p).map fun B =>
        B.changeSaddleBoundaryRadius T H hindex hrho hsigma
          hrho_radius hsigma_radius
    · intro q hq
      have hback : Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
          (fun r => M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r rho)
          (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice C center) p q) :=
        hq.2.map fun B =>
          B.changeSaddleBoundaryRadius T H hindex hsigma hrho
            hsigma_radius hrho_radius
      exact A.eq_mate_of_ne_arc hq.1 hback
  orientation_opposite := by
    intro p q hne harc
    have hback : Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
        (fun r => M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r rho)
        (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice C center) p q) :=
      harc.map fun B =>
        B.changeSaddleBoundaryRadius T H hindex hsigma hrho
          hsigma_radius hrho_radius
    have hold := A.orientation_opposite hne hback
    have hchecker : saddleBranchEndChecker p ≠ saddleBranchEndChecker q :=
      (saddleCriticalBoundaryOrientation_mul_neg_iff_checker_ne
        p q hrho).mp hold
    exact (saddleCriticalBoundaryOrientation_mul_neg_iff_checker_ne
      p q hsigma).mpr hchecker

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData_of_candidate
statement:
theorem saddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData_of_candidate
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (mate : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch →
      SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    (mate_ne : ∀ p, mate p ≠ p)
    (mate_arc : ∀ p, Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
      (fun r => M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r rho)
      (puncturedCriticalSlice C center) p (mate p)))
    (arc_checker_ne : ∀ {p q}, q ≠ p →
      Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
        (fun r => M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r rho)
        (puncturedCriticalSlice C center) p q) →
      saddleBranchEndChecker p ≠ saddleBranchEndChecker q) :
    M.SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData rho
proof:
:= by
  apply SaddleCriticalExteriorArcPairingData.ofMate mate mate_ne mate_arc
  · intro p q hqp harc
    by_contra hqmate
    have hmateChecker : saddleBranchEndChecker p ≠
        saddleBranchEndChecker (mate p) :=
      arc_checker_ne (mate_ne p) (mate_arc p)
    have hqChecker : saddleBranchEndChecker p ≠
        saddleBranchEndChecker q :=
      arc_checker_ne hqp harc
    have hbridge : Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
        (fun r => M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r rho)
        (puncturedCriticalSlice C center) (mate p) q) :=
      Nonempty.map2 (fun A B => A.symm.trans B) (mate_arc p) harc
    have hbridgeChecker : saddleBranchEndChecker (mate p) ≠
        saddleBranchEndChecker q :=
      arc_checker_ne hqmate hbridge
    cases hp : saddleBranchEndChecker p <;>
      cases hm : saddleBranchEndChecker (mate p) <;>
      cases hq : saddleBranchEndChecker q <;>
      simp_all
  · intro p
    exact (saddleCriticalBoundaryOrientation_mul_neg_iff_checker_ne
      p (mate p) hrho).mpr
        (arc_checker_ne (mate_ne p) (mate_arc p))

statement:

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_smallSaddleBoundaryRadius_endpointCover

name: Submission.MorsePosition.sliceRegular_eventCenter_add_sq
statement:
theorem sliceRegular_eventCenter_add_sq
    (P : MorsePosition C) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ P.eventTimes)
    {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (haBracket : a < (P.eventBracket t ht).modelRadius) :
    sliceRegular C.G (tcoord (P.eventCenter t ht) + a ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let B := P.eventBracket t ht
  have haSq : a ^ 2 < B.modelRadius ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ ha.le B.modelRadius_pos.le).2 haBracket
  apply (P.sliceRegular_iff_not_mem_eventTimes _).2
  intro hs
  let v := P.eventCenter
    (tcoord (P.eventCenter t ht) + a ^ 2) hs
  have hvcrit : v ∈ timeCritical C.G :=
    (P.eventCenter_mem_coreCriticalPoints _ hs).1
  have hvtime : tcoord v = tcoord (P.eventCenter t ht) + a ^ 2 := by
    exact P.eventCenter_time _ hs
  have hvIcc : tcoord v ∈ Set.Icc B.before B.after := by
    rw [hvtime, B.before_eq_center_sub_modelRadius_sq,
      B.after_eq_center_add_modelRadius_sq]
    constructor <;> linarith [sq_pos_of_pos ha]
  have hveq : v = P.eventCenter t ht := B.isolates v hvcrit hvIcc
  have htimeEq := congrArg tcoord hveq
  rw [hvtime] at htimeEq
  nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos ha]

name: Submission.norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_lt
statement:
theorem norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_lt
    (b : SaddleBranch) {rho a : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2) {u : I} (hu : u ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) :
    ‖saddlePositiveSegmentParam b rho a u‖ < rho
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < saddleBoundaryParameter rho a := by
    unfold saddleBoundaryParameter
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
    nlinarith
  have hfactor : (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 < 1 := by
    have hu0 : 0 < (u : ℝ) := hu.1
    have hu1 : (u : ℝ) < 1 := hu.2
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1)]
  have hcoord : saddleSegmentCoordinate rho a u ^ 2 <
      saddleBoundaryParameter rho a ^ 2 := by
    rw [saddleSegmentCoordinate, mul_pow]
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hs]
  have hboundary := saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)
  have hsq := norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a
    (saddleSegmentCoordinate rho a u)
  change ‖saddlePositiveSegmentParam b rho a u‖ ^ 2 =
    a ^ 2 + 2 * saddleSegmentCoordinate rho a u ^ 2 at hsq
  have hnorm := norm_nonneg (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b rho a u)
  rw [hboundary] at hcoord
  nlinarith

name: Submission.norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_eq_rho_iff
statement:
theorem norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_eq_rho_iff
    (b : SaddleBranch) {rho a : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2) (u : I) :
    ‖saddlePositiveSegmentParam b rho a u‖ = rho ↔ u = 0 ∨ u = 1
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hnorm
    by_contra hends
    simp only [not_or] at hends
    have hu0 : (0 : ℝ) < (u : ℝ) := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne u.property.1 ?_
      intro hu
      apply hends.1
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hu.symm
    have hu1 : (u : ℝ) < 1 := by
      refine lt_of_le_of_ne u.property.2 ?_
      intro hu
      apply hends.2
      apply Subtype.ext
      exact hu
    have hlt := norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_lt b hrho ha
      (u := u) ⟨hu0, hu1⟩
    linarith
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · simpa using norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam
        b .negative hrho ha
    · simpa using norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam
        b .positive hrho ha

name: Submission.exists_saddleSegmentCoordinate_eq
statement:
theorem exists_saddleSegmentCoordinate_eq
    {rho a z : ℝ} (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2)
    (hz : z ^ 2 ≤ saddleBoundaryParameter rho a ^ 2) :
    ∃ u : I, saddleSegmentCoordinate rho a u = z
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 0 < saddleBoundaryParameter rho a := by
    unfold saddleBoundaryParameter
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
    nlinarith
  have hzlo : -saddleBoundaryParameter rho a ≤ z := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z + saddleBoundaryParameter rho a)]
  have hzhi : z ≤ saddleBoundaryParameter rho a := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (z - saddleBoundaryParameter rho a)]
  let q : ℝ :=
    (z + saddleBoundaryParameter rho a) /
      (2 * saddleBoundaryParameter rho a)
  have hden : 0 < 2 * saddleBoundaryParameter rho a := by positivity
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := by
    apply div_nonneg
    · linarith
    · exact hden.le
  have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := by
    apply (div_le_one hden).2
    linarith
  let u : I := ⟨q, hq0, hq1⟩
  refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
  simp only [saddleSegmentCoordinate, u, q]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Submission.exists_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_eq_of_norm_le
statement:
theorem exists_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_eq_of_norm_le
    (b : SaddleBranch) {rho a : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2) (u : E₂)
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = a ^ 2)
    (hsign : 0 < signedBranch b (u 0)) (hnorm : ‖u‖ ≤ rho) :
    ∃ q : I, saddlePositiveSegmentParam b rho a q = u
proof:
:= by
  have hnormsq := StandardMorseEventAt.norm_sq_eq_coordinates u
  have hnormsq_le : ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ rho ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg u, sq_nonneg (‖u‖ - rho)]
  have hboundary := saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)
  have hcoord : (u 1) ^ 2 ≤ saddleBoundaryParameter rho a ^ 2 := by
    simp only [morseQuadratic] at hquad
    nlinarith
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := exists_saddleSegmentCoordinate_eq ha hcoord
  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩
  rw [saddlePositiveSegmentParam]
  change pairToMorseParam
      (saddlePositiveArc b a (saddleSegmentCoordinate rho a q)) = u
  rw [hq]
  exact (eq_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_of_signedBranch
    b a u hquad hsign).symm

name: Submission.saddlePositiveSegmentParam_negative_ne_positive
statement:

    {rho a : ℝ} (ha0 : 0 < a) (u v : I) :

proof:

  have hvPos : 0 < Real.sqrt
      (a ^ 2 + saddleSegmentCoordinate rho a v ^ 2) := by
    apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos ha0,
      sq_nonneg (saddleSegmentCoordinate rho a v)]

proof:

  intro p q hpq
  change spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a) =
    spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd q.1 q.2 rho a) at hpq
  apply T.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_injective hrho ha hrho_radius
  calc
    M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a =
        cobSpaceTime
          (spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a))
          (tcoord (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a)) :=

    _ = cobSpaceTime

      rw [hpq,
        M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex p.1 p.2 hrho ha
          (hrho_radius.trans_le T.radius_le),

statement:
theorem saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_eq_boundaryEnd_iff
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    (rho a : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho) (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2)
    (hrho_radius : rho < T.radius) (u : I) :
    T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b rho a hrho ha hrho_radius u =
        spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a) ↔
      (u = 0 ∧ p = (b, .negative)) ∨
        (u = 1 ∧ p = (b, .positive))
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hspace
    change spacePart (T.saddlePositiveSegment b rho a hrho ha
      hrho_radius u) =
        spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a) at hspace
    have hambient :
        T.saddlePositiveSegment b rho a hrho ha hrho_radius u =
          M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a := by
      calc
        T.saddlePositiveSegment b rho a hrho ha hrho_radius u =
            cobSpaceTime
              (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveSegment b rho a hrho ha
                hrho_radius u))
              (tcoord (T.saddlePositiveSegment b rho a hrho ha
                hrho_radius u)) := (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
        _ = cobSpaceTime
              (spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a))
              (tcoord (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a)) := by
          rw [hspace,
            T.saddlePositiveSegment_time hindex b rho a hrho ha
              hrho_radius u,
            M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex p.1 p.2 hrho ha
              (hrho_radius.trans_le T.radius_le)]
        _ = M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a :=
          spaceTime_spacePart _
    have hparam : saddlePositiveSegmentParam b rho a u =
        saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam p.1 p.2 rho a := by
      apply T.param_injOn
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
        exact (norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_le b hrho ha u).trans_lt
          hrho_radius
      · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right,
          norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam p.1 p.2 hrho ha]
        exact hrho_radius
      · simpa [saddlePositiveSegment,
          StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
          StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint] using hambient
    have hnorm : ‖saddlePositiveSegmentParam b rho a u‖ = rho := by
      rw [hparam]
      exact norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam p.1 p.2 hrho ha
    rcases (norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_eq_rho_iff b hrho ha u).mp
      hnorm with hu | hu
    · left
      refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
      have hpairs := T.saddlePositiveSpatialBoundaryEnd_injective hindex
        hrho ha hrho_radius
      exact (hpairs (by simpa [hu] using hspace)).symm
    · right
      refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
      have hpairs := T.saddlePositiveSpatialBoundaryEnd_injective hindex
        hrho ha hrho_radius
      exact (hpairs (by simpa [hu] using hspace)).symm
  · rintro (⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl, rfl⟩) <;>
      simp [saddlePositiveSpatialSegment]

    (hnorm : ‖u‖ < rho) :
    spacePart (M.param u) ≠
      spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a)
proof:
:= by
  intro hspace
  have hu_radius : ‖u‖ < M.radius :=
    (hnorm.trans hrho_radius).trans_le T.radius_le

    rw [M.time_model u hu_radius, hindex, hquad]

    calc
      M.param u = cobSpaceTime (spacePart (M.param u))
          (tcoord (M.param u)) := (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime
          (spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a))
          (tcoord (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 rho a)) := by
        rw [hspace, hutime,
          M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex p.1 p.2 hrho ha
            (hrho_radius.trans_le T.radius_le)]

theorem saddlePositiveSpatialBoundaryEnd_mem_branchOrbit
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b e : SaddleBranch) (rho a : ℝ)

      V.orbit (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase b rho a))
proof:
:= by
  let gamma := T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b rho a hrho ha hrho_radius

        using V.continuousMap_mem_orbit gamma hgamma 1
  | negative =>
      simpa [gamma, saddlePositiveSpatialSegment, saddlePositiveBranchBase]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveSpatialSegments_disjoint
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveSpatialSegments_disjoint
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (rho a : ℝ) (hrho : 0 < rho) (ha0 : 0 < a)
    (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2) (hrho_radius : rho < T.radius) :
    Disjoint
      (Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative rho a
        hrho ha hrho_radius))
      (Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive rho a
        hrho ha hrho_radius))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro x ⟨u, rfl⟩ ⟨v, hv⟩
  have hspace :
      spacePart (T.saddlePositiveSegment .negative rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius u) =
      spacePart (T.saddlePositiveSegment .positive rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius v) := by
    simpa [saddlePositiveSpatialSegment] using hv.symm
  have hambient :
      T.saddlePositiveSegment .negative rho a hrho ha hrho_radius u =
      T.saddlePositiveSegment .positive rho a hrho ha hrho_radius v := by
    calc
      T.saddlePositiveSegment .negative rho a hrho ha hrho_radius u =
          cobSpaceTime
            (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveSegment .negative rho a hrho ha
              hrho_radius u))
            (tcoord (T.saddlePositiveSegment .negative rho a hrho ha
              hrho_radius u)) := (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime
            (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveSegment .positive rho a hrho ha
              hrho_radius v))
            (tcoord (T.saddlePositiveSegment .positive rho a hrho ha
              hrho_radius v)) := by
        rw [hspace,
          T.saddlePositiveSegment_time hindex .negative rho a hrho ha
            hrho_radius u,
          T.saddlePositiveSegment_time hindex .positive rho a hrho ha
            hrho_radius v]
      _ = T.saddlePositiveSegment .positive rho a hrho ha
          hrho_radius v := spaceTime_spacePart _
  apply saddlePositiveSegmentParam_negative_ne_positive ha0 u v
  apply T.param_injOn
  · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact (norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_le .negative hrho ha u).trans_lt
      hrho_radius
  · rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact (norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_le .positive hrho ha v).trans_lt
      hrho_radius
  · simpa [saddlePositiveSegment] using hambient

statement:

    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b c : SaddleBranch) (rho a : ℝ)
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2)
    (hrho_radius : rho < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice a hreg))
    (hne : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius hreg V ≠
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex c rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius hreg V) :
    Disjoint
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius hreg V : V.OrbitIndex) : Set E₁)
      (Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment c rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius))
proof:
:= by
  let Ob := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b rho a hrho ha
    hrho_radius hreg V
  let Oc := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex c rho a hrho ha
    hrho_radius hreg V
  have hneSet : (Ob : Set E₁) ≠ (Oc : Set E₁) := by
    intro hset
    apply hne
    exact Subtype.ext hset
  have hdisj : Disjoint (Ob : Set E₁) (Oc : Set E₁) :=
    V.orbitFinset_pairwise_disjoint (Ob : Set E₁) Ob.property
      (Oc : Set E₁) Oc.property hneSet
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxb hxc
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hxc
  apply Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hxb
  rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit Oc]
  exact T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_mem_branchOrbit hindex c rho a
    hrho ha hrho_radius hreg V u

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.int_translate_forward_normal_form
statement:
theorem int_translate_forward_normal_form
    {T x y : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hxT : x < T) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hyT : y < T)
    (z : ℤ) (hlo : x < y - (z : ℝ) * T)
    (hhi : y - (z : ℝ) * T < x + T) :
    (z = 0 ∧ x < y) ∨ (z = -1 ∧ y < x)
proof:
:= by
  have hzltR : (z : ℝ) < 1 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hzge : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hmul : T ≤ (z : ℝ) * T := by
      simpa using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzge hT.le
    linarith
  have hzgtR : (-2 : ℝ) < (z : ℝ) := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hzle : (z : ℝ) ≤ -2 := le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hmul : (z : ℝ) * T ≤ -2 * T :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzle hT.le
    linarith
  have hzlt : z < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hzltR
  have hzgt : (-2 : ℤ) < z := by exact_mod_cast hzgtR
  have hz : z = 0 ∨ z = -1 := by omega
  rcases hz with rfl | rfl
  · left
    constructor
    · rfl
    · simpa using hlo
  · right
    constructor
    · rfl
    · norm_num at hhi ⊢
      linarith

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.int_translate_backward_normal_form
statement:
theorem int_translate_backward_normal_form
    {T x y : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hxT : x < T) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hyT : y < T)
    (z : ℤ) (hlo : x - T < y - (z : ℝ) * T)
    (hhi : y - (z : ℝ) * T < x) :
    (z = 0 ∧ y < x) ∨ (z = 1 ∧ x < y)
proof:
:= by
  have hzgtR : (-1 : ℝ) < (z : ℝ) := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hzle : (z : ℝ) ≤ -1 := le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hmul : (z : ℝ) * T ≤ -1 * T :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzle hT.le
    linarith
  have hzltR : (z : ℝ) < 2 := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hzge : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := le_of_not_gt hnot
    have hmul : 2 * T ≤ (z : ℝ) * T :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzge hT.le
    linarith
  have hzgt : (-1 : ℤ) < z := by exact_mod_cast hzgtR
  have hzlt : z < 2 := by exact_mod_cast hzltR
  have hz : z = 0 ∨ z = 1 := by omega
  rcases hz with rfl | rfl
  · left
    constructor
    · rfl
    · simpa using hhi
  · right
    constructor
    · rfl
    · norm_num at hlo ⊢
      linarith

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phaseOfOrbitPath
statement:
theorem orbitCircleHomeomorph_phaseOfOrbitPath
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (gamma : C(I, E))
    (hgamma : ∀ u, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p) (u : I) :
    V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp (P.phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma u) =
      ⟨gamma u, hgamma u⟩
proof:
:= by
  exact (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp).apply_symm_apply _

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseOfOrbitPath_eq_phase_of_eq

theorem phaseOfOrbitPath_eq_phase_of_eq
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (gamma : C(I, E))

    (huv : gamma u = P.curve v) :
    P.phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma u = P.phase v
proof:
:= by
  apply (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp).injective
  rw [P.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma,
    P.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phase]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem phaseLiftOfOrbitPath_zero

    (r : ℝ)

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath_coe
statement:
theorem phaseLiftOfOrbitPath_coe
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (gamma : C(I, E))
    (hgamma : ∀ u, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (r : ℝ)
    (hr : P.phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma 0 =
      (r : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp))) (u : I) :
    ((P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma r hr u : ℝ) :
        AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)) =
      P.phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma u
proof:
:= by
  let T := V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp
  letI : Fact (0 < T) := ⟨V.fundamentalPeriod_pos P.hp⟩
  have h := congrFun
    ((AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe T).liftPath_lifts
      (P.phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma) r hr) u
  simpa [phaseLiftOfOrbitPath, T] using h

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath_injective
statement:
theorem phaseLiftOfOrbitPath_injective
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (gamma : C(I, E))
    (hgamma : ∀ u, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (hgamma_inj : Injective gamma)
    (r : ℝ)
    (hr : P.phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma 0 =
      (r : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp))) :
    Injective (P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma r hr)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  apply hgamma_inj
  have hphase : P.phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma u =
      P.phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma v := by
    rw [← P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath_coe gamma hgamma r hr u,
      ← P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath_coe gamma hgamma r hr v, huv]
  have horbit := congrArg (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp) hphase
  simpa only [P.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma,
    Subtype.mk.injEq] using horbit

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath_strictMono_or_strictAnti
statement:
theorem phaseLiftOfOrbitPath_strictMono_or_strictAnti
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (gamma : C(I, E))
    (hgamma : ∀ u, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (hgamma_inj : Injective gamma)
    (r : ℝ)
    (hr : P.phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma 0 =
      (r : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp))) :
    StrictMono (P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma r hr) ∨
      StrictAnti (P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma r hr)
proof:
:=
  (P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma r hr).continuous
    |>.strictMono_of_inj_boundedOrder'
      (P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPath_injective gamma hgamma hgamma_inj r hr)

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve_zero

@[simp] theorem phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve_zero

      P.phaseLift v

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve_coe
statement:
theorem phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve_coe
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (gamma : C(I, E))
    (hgamma : ∀ u, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p) (v : I)
    (hsource : gamma 0 = P.curve v) (u : I) :
    ((P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve gamma hgamma v hsource u : ℝ) :
        AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)) =

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve_target_eq_add_zsmul
statement:
theorem phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve_target_eq_add_zsmul
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (gamma : C(I, E))
    (hgamma : ∀ u, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p) (v w : I)
    (hsource : gamma 0 = P.curve v)
    (htarget : gamma 1 = P.curve w) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, P.phaseLift w =
      P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve gamma hgamma v hsource 1 +
        z • V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp
proof:
:= by
  apply AddCommGroup.modEq_iff_eq_add_zsmul.mp
  apply AddCommGroup.modEq_iff_eq_mod_zmultiples.mpr
  calc
    ((P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve gamma hgamma v hsource 1 : ℝ) :
        AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)) =
        P.phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma 1 :=
      P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve_coe gamma hgamma v hsource 1
    _ = P.phase w :=
      P.phaseOfOrbitPath_eq_phase_of_eq gamma hgamma htarget
    _ = ((P.phaseLift w : ℝ) :
        AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)) := (P.phaseLift_coe w).symm

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve_injective
statement:
theorem phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve_injective
