name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_zero_eq_curve_mark
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_zero_eq_curve_mark
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) (rho a : ℝ)
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2)
    (hrho_radius : rho < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice a hreg)) :
    T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b rho a hrho ha hrho_radius 0 =
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex b rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius hreg V).curve
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchCyclicMarking hindex b rho a hrho ha
          hrho_radius hreg V).mark 0)
proof:
:= by
  let P := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex b rho a hrho ha
    hrho_radius hreg V
  let A := T.saddlePositiveBranchCyclicMarking hindex b rho a hrho ha
    hrho_radius hreg V
  calc
    T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b rho a hrho ha hrho_radius 0 =
        spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b .negative rho a) := by
      simp [saddlePositiveSpatialSegment]
    _ = A.point 0 := by
      simp [A, saddlePositiveBranchCyclicMarking]
    _ = P.curve (A.mark 0) := (A.curve_mark 0).symm

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift_zero
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) (rho a : ℝ)
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2)
    (hrho_radius : rho < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice a hreg)) :
    T.saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift hindex b rho a hrho ha
      hrho_radius hreg V 0 =
    (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex b rho a hrho ha
      hrho_radius hreg V).phaseLift
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchCyclicMarking hindex b rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius hreg V).mark 0)
proof:
:= by
  simp [saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift_one_coe
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift_one_coe
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) (rho a : ℝ)
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2)
    (hrho_radius : rho < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice a hreg)) :
    ((T.saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift hindex b rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius hreg V 1 : ℝ) :
      AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex b rho a hrho ha
          hrho_radius hreg V).hp)) =
    (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex b rho a hrho ha
      hrho_radius hreg V).phase
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchCyclicMarking hindex b rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius hreg V).mark 1)
proof:
:= by
  let P := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex b rho a hrho ha
    hrho_radius hreg V
  let gamma := T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b rho a hrho ha hrho_radius
  let hgamma : ∀ u, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p :=
    fun u => T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_mem_paramOrbit hindex b rho a
      hrho ha hrho_radius hreg V u
  let A := T.saddlePositiveBranchCyclicMarking hindex b rho a hrho ha
    hrho_radius hreg V
  let hsource : gamma 0 = P.curve (A.mark 0) :=
    T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_zero_eq_curve_mark hindex b rho a
      hrho ha hrho_radius hreg V
  have hcoe := P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve_coe gamma hgamma
    (A.mark 0) hsource 1
  have htarget := P.phaseOfOrbitPath_eq_phase_of_eq gamma hgamma
    (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_one_eq_curve_mark hindex b rho a
      hrho ha hrho_radius hreg V)
  calc
    ((T.saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift hindex b rho a hrho ha
          hrho_radius hreg V 1 : ℝ) :
        AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)) =
        P.phaseOfOrbitPath gamma hgamma 1 := by
      simpa only [saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift] using hcoe
    _ = P.phase (A.mark 1) := htarget

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift_strictMono_or_strictAnti
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift_strictMono_or_strictAnti
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) (rho a : ℝ)
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2)
    (hrho_radius : rho < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice a hreg)) :
    StrictMono (T.saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift hindex b rho a hrho ha
      hrho_radius hreg V) ∨
    StrictAnti (T.saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift hindex b rho a hrho ha
      hrho_radius hreg V)
proof:
:= by
  let P := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex b rho a hrho ha
    hrho_radius hreg V
  let gamma := T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b rho a hrho ha hrho_radius
  let hgamma : ∀ u, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p :=
    fun u => T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_mem_paramOrbit hindex b rho a
      hrho ha hrho_radius hreg V u
  let A := T.saddlePositiveBranchCyclicMarking hindex b rho a hrho ha
    hrho_radius hreg V
  simpa only [saddlePositiveSegmentPhaseLift] using
    P.phaseLiftOfOrbitPathAtCurve_strictMono_or_strictAnti gamma hgamma
      (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_injective hindex b rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius) (A.mark 0)
      (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_zero_eq_curve_mark hindex b rho a
        hrho ha hrho_radius hreg V)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_ne_branchMark_of_mem_Ioo
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_ne_branchMark_of_mem_Ioo
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) (rho a : ℝ)
    (hrho : 0 < rho) (ha : a ^ 2 < rho ^ 2)
    (hrho_radius : rho < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice a hreg))
    {u : I} (hu : u ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) (i : Fin 2) :
    T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b rho a hrho ha hrho_radius u ≠
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchCyclicMarking hindex b rho a hrho ha
        hrho_radius hreg V).point i
proof:
:= by
  intro heq
  have hboundary :
      T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b rho a hrho ha hrho_radius u =
        spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
          (saddleBranchOfFinTwo i) rho a) := by
    simpa [saddlePositiveBranchCyclicMarking] using heq
  rcases (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_eq_boundaryEnd_iff hindex b
    (b, saddleBranchOfFinTwo i) rho a hrho ha hrho_radius u).mp hboundary with
    hzero | hone

        ∀ r, r ≠ i → r ≠ j → ∀ u : E₂,
          morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(a ^ 2) → ‖u‖ < rho →
          spacePart (M.param u) ∉ A.cyclicCutRange r := by
  dsimp only
  let A := T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex rho a hrho ha
    hrho_radius hreg V horbit
  let gamma := T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative rho a hrho ha
    hrho_radius
  let delta := T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive rho a hrho ha
    hrho_radius
  have hgamma : ∃ i : Fin 4, Set.range gamma = A.cyclicCutRange i := by
    apply A.exists_cyclicCutRange_eq_of_adjacent_or_wrap gamma
    exact T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbit_localBranch_range_eq_cut hindex rho a
      hrho ha hrho_radius hreg V horbit .negative
  have hdelta : ∃ j : Fin 4, Set.range delta = A.cyclicCutRange j := by
    apply A.exists_cyclicCutRange_eq_of_adjacent_or_wrap delta
    exact T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbit_localBranch_range_eq_cut hindex rho a
      hrho ha hrho_radius hreg V horbit .positive
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hi, hj, hother⟩ :=
    A.exists_distinct_localCutRanges_and_otherCuts_avoid_unmarkedLocal
      gamma delta
      (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegments_disjoint hindex rho a hrho ha0 ha
        hrho_radius) hgamma hdelta
  refine ⟨i, j, hij, hi, hj, ?_⟩
  intro r hri hrj u hquad hnorm
  apply hother
  · exact T.spacePart_param_mem_union_saddleNegativeSpatialSegments_of_norm_le
      rho a hrho ha0 ha hrho_radius u hquad hnorm.le
  · intro l
    let p := saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l
    apply T.spacePart_param_ne_saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_of_norm_lt hindex
      (p.2, p.1) rho a hrho ha hrho_radius u hquad hnorm
  · exact hri
  · exact hrj

name: Submission.MorsePosition.eq_eventCenter_of_timeCritical_of_same_time
statement:
theorem eq_eventCenter_of_timeCritical_of_same_time
    (P : MorsePosition C) (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ P.eventTimes)
    {x : E'} (hx : x ∈ timeCritical C.G)
    (hxt : tcoord x = tcoord (P.eventCenter t ht)) :
    x = P.eventCenter t ht
proof:
:= by
  apply P.eq_eventCenter_of_mem_of_time t ht
  · change x ∈ (P.centers : Set E')
    rw [P.centers_exact]
    exact C.timeCritical_subset_coreCriticalPoints hx
  · rw [hxt, P.eventCenter_time t ht]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice_spatialDeriv_surjective
statement:
theorem puncturedCriticalSlice_spatialDeriv_surjective
    {x : E'}
    (hx : x ∈ puncturedCriticalSlice C (P.eventCenter t ht)) :
    Surjective (spatialDeriv C.G x)
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hsurj
  have hxcrit : x ∈ timeCritical C.G := ⟨hx.1, hsurj⟩
  have hxeq : x = P.eventCenter t ht :=
    P.eq_eventCenter_of_timeCritical_of_same_time t ht hxcrit hx.2.1
  exact hx.2.2 hxeq

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice_subset_spatialRegularZeroSet
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx

    puncturedCriticalSlice_spatialDeriv_surjective
      (P := P) (ht := ht) hx⟩

name: Submission.norm_tauField_le_one
statement: lemma norm_tauField_le_one (g : E → F) (x : E) : ‖tauField g x‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  rcases eq_or_ne (kerCross g x) 0 with h | h
  · rw [tauField, h, smul_zero, norm_zero]; norm_num
  · rw [tauField, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h)]

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.exists_tamedField
statement: theorem exists_tamedField (X : FramedLevelSet n) : Nonempty (TamedField X)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂pos, hδ₂sub⟩ :=
    X.isCompact_fiber.exists_cthickening_subset_open (isOpen_regularSet X.smooth)
      X.fiber_subset_regularSet
  set δ := δ₂ / 2 with hδdef
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by positivity
  have h2δ : 2 * δ = δ₂ := by rw [hδdef]; ring
  have hsub : Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) X.fiber ⊆ regularSet X.g := by
    rw [h2δ]; exact hδ₂sub
  
  have hs : IsClosed (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) X.fiber)ᶜ :=
    Metric.isOpen_thickening.isClosed_compl
  have ht : IsClosed (Metric.cthickening δ X.fiber) := Metric.isClosed_cthickening
  have hd : Disjoint (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) X.fiber)ᶜ
      (Metric.cthickening δ X.fiber) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hx'
    exact hx (Metric.cthickening_subset_thickening' (by positivity) (by linarith) _ hx')
  obtain ⟨f, hf0, hf1, hf01⟩ :=
    exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_of_isClosed
      (I := modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
      (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) hs ht hd
  have hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (⇑f) := by
    rw [← contMDiff_iff_contDiff]
    exact f.contMDiff
  
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x => f x • tauField X.g x := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ regularSet X.g
    · exact hχ.contDiffAt.smul (((contDiffOn_tauField X.smooth) x hx).contDiffAt
        ((isOpen_regularSet X.smooth).mem_nhds hx))
    · 
      have hxC : x ∈ (Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) X.fiber)ᶜ := fun hmem => hx (hsub hmem)
      have hU : IsOpen (Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) X.fiber)ᶜ :=
        Metric.isClosed_cthickening.isOpen_compl
      have hzero : ∀ y ∈ (Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) X.fiber)ᶜ,
          f y • tauField X.g y = 0 := by
        intro y hy
        have hy' : y ∈ (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) X.fiber)ᶜ := fun hmem =>
          hy (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _ hmem)
        have : f y = 0 := hf0 hy'
        rw [this, zero_smul]
      have hev : (fun y => f y • tauField X.g y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : E)) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hxC) hzero
      exact (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : E))).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  
  have hsupp : HasCompactSupport fun x => f x • tauField X.g x := by
    have h1 : support (fun x => f x • tauField X.g x) ⊆
        Metric.thickening (2 * δ) X.fiber := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hmem
      have : f x = 0 := hf0 hmem
      apply hx
      show f x • tauField X.g x = 0
      rw [this, zero_smul]
    have h2 : tsupport (fun x => f x • tauField X.g x) ⊆
        Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) X.fiber :=
      closure_minimal (h1.trans (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _))
        Metric.isClosed_cthickening
    exact IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset (X.isCompact_fiber.cthickening)
      isClosed_closure h2
  
  refine ⟨⟨fun x => f x • tauField X.g x, δ, hδpos, hsmooth, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    intro x
    rw [norm_smul]
    have h1 : ‖f x‖ ≤ 1 := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
      exact ⟨by linarith [(hf01 x).1], (hf01 x).2⟩
    calc ‖f x‖ * ‖tauField X.g x‖ ≤ 1 * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul h1 (norm_tauField_le_one X.g x) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      _ = 1 := by norm_num
  · 
    intro x hx
    have : f x = 1 := hf1 hx
    rw [this, one_smul]
  · 
    intro x
    rw [map_smul, fderiv_tauField_eq_zero, smul_zero]
  · 
    exact hsmooth.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hsupp (by simp)

name: Submission.TamedField.solution_unique
statement:
theorem solution_unique {γ₁ γ₂ : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (h₁ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt γ₁ (V.v (γ₁ t)) t)
    (h₂ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt γ₂ (V.v (γ₂ t)) t)
    {t₀ : ℝ} (heq : γ₁ t₀ = γ₂ t₀) : γ₁ = γ₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := V.lipschitz
  exact ODE_solution_unique_univ (v := fun _ x => V.v x) (s := fun _ => univ)
    (t₀ := t₀) (fun _ => hK.lipschitzOnWith)
    (fun t => ⟨h₁ t, mem_univ _⟩) (fun t => ⟨h₂ t, mem_univ _⟩) heq

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_solution
statement:
theorem exists_solution (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ∃ γ : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)),
      γ 0 = p ∧ ∀ t, HasDerivAt γ (V.v (γ t)) t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := V.lipschitz
  
  have main : ∀ T : ℕ, ∃ α : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)),
      α 0 = p ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-(T + 1 : ℝ)) (T + 1 : ℝ), HasDerivAt α (V.v (α t)) t := by
    intro T
    have h0mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (-(T + 1 : ℝ)) (T + 1 : ℝ) := by
      constructor
      · have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T := T.cast_nonneg
        linarith
      · have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T := T.cast_nonneg
        linarith
    have hpl : IsPicardLindelof (fun (_ : ℝ) x => V.v x)
        (⟨0, h0mem⟩ : Icc (-(T + 1 : ℝ)) (T + 1 : ℝ)) p (T + 2 : ℕ) 0 1 K := by
      constructor
      · exact fun t _ => hK.lipschitzOnWith
      · exact fun x _ => continuousOn_const
      · intro t _ x _
        simpa using V.norm_le x
      · show (1 : ℝ) * max ((T + 1 : ℝ) - 0) (0 - -(T + 1 : ℝ)) ≤ (T + 2 : ℕ) - (0 : ℝ)
        push_cast
        have h0T : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T := T.cast_nonneg
        rw [one_mul]
        apply max_le <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα⟩ := hpl.exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt
      (mem_closedBall_self le_rfl)
    refine ⟨α, hα0, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    exact (hα t (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2)
  choose α hα0 hαs using main
  
  have agree : ∀ (T S : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| < T + 1 → |t| < S + 1 → α T t = α S t := by
    intro T S t hT hS
    set m : ℕ := min T S with hm
    have hmT : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (T : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have : (m : ℕ) ≤ T := min_le_left T S
      exact_mod_cast by omega
    have hmS : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (S : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have : (m : ℕ) ≤ S := min_le_right T S
      exact_mod_cast by omega
    have htm : |t| < (m : ℝ) + 1 := by
      rcases min_choice T S with h | h <;> rw [hm, h]
      · exact hT
      · exact hS
    have hsub : Ioo (-(m + 1 : ℝ)) (m + 1 : ℝ) ⊆ Ioo (-(T + 1 : ℝ)) (T + 1 : ℝ) :=
      Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hsub' : Ioo (-(m + 1 : ℝ)) (m + 1 : ℝ) ⊆ Ioo (-(S + 1 : ℝ)) (S + 1 : ℝ) :=
      Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h0m : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (-(m + 1 : ℝ)) (m + 1 : ℝ) := by
      constructor
      · have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := m.cast_nonneg
        linarith
      · have : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m := m.cast_nonneg
        linarith
    have := ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Ioo (v := fun (_ : ℝ) x => V.v x)
      (s := fun _ => univ) (K := K)
      (fun t _ => hK.lipschitzOnWith) h0m
      (fun u hu => ⟨hαs T u (hsub hu), mem_univ _⟩)
      (fun u hu => ⟨hαs S u (hsub' hu), mem_univ _⟩)
      ((hα0 T).trans (hα0 S).symm)
    exact this ⟨(abs_lt.mp htm).1, (abs_lt.mp htm).2⟩
  
  refine ⟨fun t => α (Nat.floor |t|) t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hα0 (Nat.floor |(0 : ℝ)|)
  · intro t
    set N : ℕ := Nat.floor |t| with hN
    have htN : |t| < (N : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hev : (fun s => α (Nat.floor |s|) s) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] α N := by
      have hUopen : IsOpen {s : ℝ | |s| < (N : ℝ) + 1} :=
        isOpen_lt (continuous_abs) continuous_const
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUopen.mem_nhds htN) fun s hs => ?_
      exact agree (Nat.floor |s|) N s (Nat.lt_floor_add_one _) hs
    have hder : HasDerivAt (α N) (V.v (α N t)) t := by
      apply hαs N t
      have := abs_lt.mp htN
      exact ⟨this.1, this.2⟩
    have : HasDerivAt (fun s => α (Nat.floor |s|) s) (V.v (α N t)) t :=
      (Filter.EventuallyEq.hasDerivAt_iff hev).mpr hder
    simpa [← hN] using this

name: Submission.TamedField.flow_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma flow_zero (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) : V.flow p 0 = p
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (V.exists_solution p)).1

name: Submission.TamedField.hasDerivAt_flow
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_flow (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (V.flow p) (V.v (V.flow p t)) t
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (V.exists_solution p)).2 t

name: Submission.TamedField.continuous_flow
statement: lemma continuous_flow (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) : Continuous (V.flow p)
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun t => (V.hasDerivAt_flow p t).continuousAt

name: Submission.TamedField.solution_mem_fiber
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => X.g (γ s)) 0 t := by
    intro t
    have hgdiff : HasFDerivAt X.g (fderiv ℝ X.g (γ t)) (γ t) :=
      (X.smooth.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
    have := hgdiff.comp_hasDerivAt t (hγ t)
    rwa [V.fderiv_zero (γ t)] at this
  have hconst : ∀ t, X.g (γ t) = X.g (γ 0) := by
    intro t
    exact is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
      (fun s => (hcomp s).differentiableAt)
      (fun s => (hcomp s).deriv) t 0
  intro t
  have := hconst t
  rw [show X.g (γ 0) = 0 from h0] at this
  exact this

name: Submission.TamedField.flow_mem_fiber
statement:
lemma flow_mem_fiber {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) (t : ℝ) :
    V.flow p t ∈ X.fiber
proof:
:=
  V.solution_mem_fiber (V.hasDerivAt_flow p) (by rw [V.flow_zero]; exact hp) t

name: Submission.TamedField.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber
statement:
lemma v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : x ∈ X.fiber) :
    V.v x = tauField X.g x
proof:
:=
  V.eq_tau x (Metric.self_subset_cthickening _ hx)

name: Submission.straightenDeriv_bijective
statement:
lemma straightenDeriv_bijective (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hq : q ∈ X.fiber) :
    Function.Bijective (straightenDeriv X q)
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : q ∈ regularSet X.g := X.fiber_subset_regularSet hq
  have hinj : Function.Injective (straightenDeriv X q) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    intro w hw
    have h1 : fderiv ℝ X.g q w = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst hw
    have h2 : ⟪tauField X.g q, w⟫ = 0 := congrArg Prod.snd hw
    have hmem : w ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {tauField X.g q} :=
      (fderiv_eq_zero_iff_mem_span_tauField hreg w).mp h1
    obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
    have hnorm : ‖tauField X.g q‖ = 1 := norm_tauField hreg
    rw [← ha, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hnorm] at h2
    have : a = 0 := by simpa using h2
    rw [← ha, this, zero_smul]
  constructor
  · exact hinj
  · have hfr : finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
        = finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ) := by
      rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, Module.finrank_prod, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin,
        Module.finrank_self]
    exact (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hfr).mp hinj

name: Submission.contDiff_straighten
statement:
lemma contDiff_straighten (X : FramedLevelSet n) (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (straighten X q)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContDiff.prodMk X.smooth
  exact ContDiff.inner ℝ contDiff_const (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)

name: Submission.hasFDerivAt_straighten
statement:
lemma hasFDerivAt_straighten (X : FramedLevelSet n) (q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    HasFDerivAt (straighten X q) (straightenDeriv X q) q
proof:
:= by
  apply HasFDerivAt.prodMk
  · exact (X.smooth.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
  · have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => y - q)
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ _) q := (hasFDerivAt_id q).sub_const q
    have h2 := (innerSL ℝ (tauField X.g q)).hasFDerivAt.comp q h1
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using h2

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_flowbox
statement:
theorem TamedField.exists_flowbox {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    {q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hq : q ∈ X.fiber) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ x ∈ X.fiber ∩ ball q r, ∃ s : ℝ, |s| < c ∧ V.flow q s = x
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hreg : q ∈ regularSet X.g := X.fiber_subset_regularSet hq
  set τq := tauField X.g q with hτq
  have hτnorm : ‖τq‖ = 1 := norm_tauField hreg
  
  set L₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) ≃ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ :=
    LinearEquiv.ofBijective ((straightenDeriv X q) : _ →ₗ[ℝ] _)
      (straightenDeriv_bijective X hq) with hL₀
  set L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ :=
    L₀.toContinuousLinearEquiv with hL
  have hLcoe : (L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ)
      = straightenDeriv X q := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro w
    rfl
  have hΦq : HasFDerivAt (straighten X q)
      (L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ) q := by
    rw [hLcoe]
    exact hasFDerivAt_straighten X q
  set P := (contDiff_straighten X q).contDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph
    (straighten X q) hΦq (by simp) with hP
  have hPcoe : ⇑P = straighten X q :=
    (contDiff_straighten X q).contDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_coe hΦq (by simp)
  have hqmem : q ∈ P.source :=
    (contDiff_straighten X q).contDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hΦq (by simp)
  have hPinj : InjOn (straighten X q) P.source := by
    rw [← hPcoe]
    intro a ha b hb hab
    rw [← P.left_inv ha, ← P.left_inv hb, hab]
  
  set γ := V.flow q with hγ
  have hγM : ∀ t, γ t ∈ X.fiber := V.flow_mem_fiber hq
  set h : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ⟪τq, γ s - q⟫ with hh
  have hh0 : h 0 = 0 := by
    simp [hh, hγ, V.flow_zero]
  have hder : ∀ s, HasDerivAt h ⟪τq, V.v (γ s)⟫ s := by
    intro s
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => τq) 0 s := hasDerivAt_const s τq
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun u => γ u - q) (V.v (γ s)) s :=
      (V.hasDerivAt_flow q s).sub_const q
    have := h1.inner ℝ h2
    simpa using this
  have hcont' : Continuous fun s => ⟪τq, V.v (γ s)⟫ :=
    continuous_const.inner (V.smooth.continuous.comp (V.continuous_flow q))
  have hder0 : ⟪τq, V.v (γ 0)⟫ = 1 := by
    rw [hγ, V.flow_zero, V.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber hq, ← hτq,
      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hτnorm]
    norm_num
  
  have hSopen : IsOpen {s : ℝ | γ s ∈ P.source ∧ 1 / 2 < ⟪τq, V.v (γ s)⟫} := by
    apply IsOpen.inter
    · exact P.open_source.preimage (V.continuous_flow q)
    · exact isOpen_lt continuous_const hcont'
  have hS0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ {s : ℝ | γ s ∈ P.source ∧ 1 / 2 < ⟪τq, V.v (γ s)⟫} := by
    constructor
    · rw [hγ, V.flow_zero]; exact hqmem
    · rw [hder0]; norm_num
  obtain ⟨ε, hεpos, hεball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hSopen 0 hS0
  set c' := min (ε / 2) (c / 2) with hc'
  have hc'pos : 0 < c' := lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith)
  have hc'lt : c' < c := lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith)
  have hIccS : Icc (-c') c' ⊆ {s : ℝ | γ s ∈ P.source ∧ 1 / 2 < ⟪τq, V.v (γ s)⟫} := by
    intro s hs
    apply hεball
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero]
    have h1 : |s| ≤ c' := abs_le.mpr ⟨hs.1, hs.2⟩
    have h2 : c' ≤ ε / 2 := min_le_left _ _
    linarith
  
  have hdiff : ∀ s, DifferentiableAt ℝ h s := fun s => (hder s).differentiableAt
  have hderiv_gt : ∀ s ∈ interior (Icc (-c') c'), 1 / 2 < deriv h s := by
    intro s hs
    rw [interior_Icc] at hs
    have hmem : s ∈ Icc (-c') c' := Ioo_subset_Icc_self hs
    rw [(hder s).deriv]
    exact (hIccS hmem).2
  have hbound := Convex.mul_sub_lt_image_sub_of_lt_deriv (convex_Icc (-c') c')
    (fun s _ => (hdiff s).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt)
    (fun s _ => (hdiff s).differentiableWithinAt) hderiv_gt
  have hhc' : c' / 2 < h c' := by
    have := hbound 0 (by constructor <;> [linarith; linarith]) c'
      (by constructor <;> [linarith; linarith]) hc'pos
    rw [hh0] at this
    linarith
  have hhmc' : h (-c') < -(c' / 2) := by
    have := hbound (-c') (by constructor <;> [linarith; linarith]) 0
      (by constructor <;> [linarith; linarith]) (by linarith)
    rw [hh0] at this
    linarith
  
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀pos, hr₀ball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp P.open_source q hqmem
  refine ⟨min (c' / 2) r₀, lt_min (by linarith) hr₀pos, ?_⟩
  rintro x ⟨hxM, hxball⟩
  set σ := ⟪τq, x - q⟫ with hσ
  have hσsmall : |σ| < c' / 2 := by
    calc |σ| ≤ ‖τq‖ * ‖x - q‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
      _ = ‖x - q‖ := by rw [hτnorm, one_mul]
      _ < min (c' / 2) r₀ := by
          rw [← dist_eq_norm]
          exact hxball
      _ ≤ c' / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  
  have hcontIcc : ContinuousOn h (Icc (-c') c') :=
    fun s _ => (hdiff s).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have hσmem : σ ∈ Icc (h (-c')) (h c') := by
    have h1 : -(c' / 2) < σ := by
      have := abs_lt.mp hσsmall
      linarith [this.1]
    have h2 : σ < c' / 2 := (abs_lt.mp hσsmall).2
    constructor
    · linarith
    · linarith
  obtain ⟨s, hsmem, hseq⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (by linarith : -c' ≤ c') hcontIcc hσmem
  refine ⟨s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have : |s| ≤ c' := abs_le.mpr ⟨hsmem.1, hsmem.2⟩
    linarith
  
  · have hγsM : γ s ∈ X.fiber := hγM s
    have hγssource : γ s ∈ P.source := (hIccS hsmem).1
    have hxsource : x ∈ P.source := hr₀ball (by
      have : dist x q < min (c' / 2) r₀ := hxball
      exact Metric.mem_ball.mpr (lt_of_lt_of_le this (min_le_right _ _)))
    apply hPinj hγssource hxsource
    show straighten X q (γ s) = straighten X q x
    have e1 : X.g (γ s) = 0 := hγsM
    have e2 : X.g x = 0 := hxM
    show ((X.g (γ s), ⟪τq, γ s - q⟫) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) × ℝ)
        = (X.g x, ⟪τq, x - q⟫)
    rw [e1, e2]
    exact congrArg (Prod.mk (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) hseq

name: Submission.TamedField.hasDerivAt_shift
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℝ => a + w) 1 u := (hasDerivAt_id u).const_add a
  have h2 := (hγ (a + u)).scomp u h1
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using h2

name: Submission.TamedField.flow_shift
statement:
lemma flow_shift (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (a : ℝ) :
    V.flow (V.flow p a) = fun u => V.flow p (a + u)
proof:
:= by
  apply V.solution_unique (t₀ := 0)
  · exact V.hasDerivAt_flow (V.flow p a)
  · exact fun u => V.hasDerivAt_shift (V.hasDerivAt_flow p) a u
  · simp

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_period
statement:
theorem exists_period {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    ∃ T : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ T ∧ Function.Periodic (V.flow p) T
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set γ := V.flow p with hγdef
  have hγM : ∀ t, γ t ∈ X.fiber := V.flow_mem_fiber hp
  
  obtain ⟨q, hqM, φ, hφmono, hφlim⟩ :=
    X.isCompact_fiber.tendsto_subseq (x := fun k : ℕ => γ k) (fun k => hγM k)
  
  obtain ⟨r, hrpos, hbox⟩ := V.exists_flowbox hqM (c := 1 / 4) (by norm_num)
  have hev : ∀ᶠ m in Filter.atTop, dist (γ (φ m)) q < r := by
    have := Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp hφlim r hrpos
    exact this
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp hev
  set k₁ : ℕ := φ K with hk₁
  set k₂ : ℕ := φ (K + 1) with hk₂
  have hk₁₂ : k₁ + 1 ≤ k₂ := by
    have := hφmono (show K < K + 1 by omega)
    omega
  obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁, hγs₁⟩ := hbox (γ k₁) ⟨hγM _, Metric.mem_ball.mpr (hK K le_rfl)⟩
  obtain ⟨s₂, hs₂, hγs₂⟩ := hbox (γ k₂) ⟨hγM _, Metric.mem_ball.mpr (hK (K + 1) (by omega))⟩
  
  have huniq₁ : (fun u => γ (k₁ + u)) = fun u => V.flow q (s₁ + u) := by
    apply V.solution_unique (t₀ := 0)
    · exact fun u => V.hasDerivAt_shift (V.hasDerivAt_flow p) k₁ u
    · exact fun u => V.hasDerivAt_shift (V.hasDerivAt_flow q) s₁ u
    · simpa using hγs₁.symm
  have huniq₂ : (fun u => γ (k₂ + u)) = fun u => V.flow q (s₂ + u) := by
    apply V.solution_unique (t₀ := 0)
    · exact fun u => V.hasDerivAt_shift (V.hasDerivAt_flow p) k₂ u
    · exact fun u => V.hasDerivAt_shift (V.hasDerivAt_flow q) s₂ u
    · simpa using hγs₂.symm
  set T : ℝ := ((k₂ : ℝ) - k₁) + s₁ - s₂ with hT
  have hTpos : 1 / 2 ≤ T := by
    have hcast : (k₁ : ℝ) + 1 ≤ k₂ := by exact_mod_cast hk₁₂
    have h₁ := abs_lt.mp hs₁
    have h₂ := abs_lt.mp hs₂
    rw [hT]
    linarith [h₁.1, h₂.2]
  refine ⟨T, hTpos, ?_⟩
  intro t
  
  have e1 : γ t = V.flow q (s₁ + (t - k₁)) := by
    have := congrFun huniq₁ (t - k₁)
    simpa using this
  have e2 : γ (t + T) = V.flow q (s₂ + (t + T - k₂)) := by
    have := congrFun huniq₂ (t + T - k₂)
    have harg : (k₂ : ℝ) + (t + T - k₂) = t + T := by ring
    rw [harg] at this
    exact this
  have e3 : s₂ + (t + T - k₂) = s₁ + (t - k₁) := by rw [hT]; ring
  rw [e2, e3, ← e1]

name: Submission.TamedField.mem_orbit_self
statement: lemma mem_orbit_self (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) : p ∈ V.orbit p
proof:
:=
  ⟨0, V.flow_zero p⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.flow_mem_orbit
statement:
lemma flow_mem_orbit (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (t : ℝ) :
    V.flow p t ∈ V.orbit p
proof: := ⟨t, rfl⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.orbit_subset_fiber
statement:
lemma orbit_subset_fiber {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    V.orbit p ⊆ X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨t, rfl⟩
  exact V.flow_mem_fiber hp t

name: Submission.TamedField.orbit_eq_of_mem
statement:
lemma orbit_eq_of_mem {p x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : x ∈ V.orbit p) :
    V.orbit x = V.orbit p
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
  have hsh := V.flow_shift p a
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨u, rfl⟩
    rw [congrFun hsh u]
    exact ⟨a + u, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨t - a, ?_⟩
    rw [congrFun hsh (t - a)]
    congr 1
    ring

name: Submission.TamedField.isCompact_orbit
statement:
lemma isCompact_orbit {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    IsCompact (V.orbit p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hper⟩ := V.exists_period hp
  have himg : V.flow p '' Icc 0 (0 + T) = range (V.flow p) :=
    hper.image_Icc (by linarith) 0
  rw [orbit, ← himg]
  exact (isCompact_Icc).image (V.continuous_flow p)

name: Submission.TamedField.orbit_isOpen_in_fiber
proof:
:= by
  have hqM : q ∈ X.fiber := V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hq
  obtain ⟨r, hrpos, hbox⟩ := V.exists_flowbox hqM (c := 1) (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨r, hrpos, ?_⟩
  rintro x ⟨hxM, hxball⟩
  obtain ⟨s, _, hs⟩ := hbox x ⟨hxM, hxball⟩
  have : x ∈ V.orbit q := ⟨s, hs⟩
  rwa [V.orbit_eq_of_mem hq] at this

name: Submission.TamedField.orbit_eq_or_disjoint
statement:
theorem orbit_eq_or_disjoint {p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} :
    V.orbit p = V.orbit q ∨ Disjoint (V.orbit p) (V.orbit q)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : Disjoint (V.orbit p) (V.orbit q)
  · exact Or.inr h
  · left
    obtain ⟨x, hxp, hxq⟩ := Set.not_disjoint_iff.mp h
    rw [← V.orbit_eq_of_mem hxp, ← V.orbit_eq_of_mem hxq]

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_finite_orbit_cover
statement:
theorem exists_finite_orbit_cover :
    ∃ s : Finset (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
      (∀ q ∈ s, q ∈ X.fiber) ∧ X.fiber = ⋃ q ∈ s, V.orbit q
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hkey : ∀ q, q ∈ X.fiber → ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ X.fiber ∩ ball q r ⊆ V.orbit q :=
    fun q hq => by
      obtain ⟨r, hrpos, hsub⟩ := V.orbit_isOpen_in_fiber hq (V.mem_orbit_self q)
      exact ⟨r, hrpos, hsub⟩
  choose! rad hradpos hradsub using hkey
  have hcover : X.fiber ⊆ ⋃ q ∈ X.fiber, ball q (rad q) := by
    intro x hx
    exact mem_biUnion hx (Metric.mem_ball_self (hradpos x hx))
  obtain ⟨b', hb'sub, hb'fin, hb'cover⟩ :=
    X.isCompact_fiber.elim_finite_subcover_image
      (fun q _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) hcover
  refine ⟨hb'fin.toFinset, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q hq
    exact hb'sub (hb'fin.mem_toFinset.mp hq)
  · apply Set.Subset.antisymm
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨q, hqb', hxball⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp (hb'cover hx)
      have hqM : q ∈ X.fiber := hb'sub hqb'
      have : x ∈ V.orbit q := hradsub q hqM ⟨hx, hxball⟩
      exact mem_biUnion (hb'fin.mem_toFinset.mpr hqb') this
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hxq⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.mp hx
      exact V.orbit_subset_fiber (hb'sub (hb'fin.mem_toFinset.mp hq)) hxq

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.ballLocalizedPlaneRotation_signedNormalization_productOn
statement:
theorem ballLocalizedPlaneRotation_signedNormalization_productOn
    (θ r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (b : E)
    {X Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 1)}
    (D : DefiningMapHomotopy
      ((ballLocalizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ r hr b).pullback X) Y)
    (S : FiberSign X) (T : FiberSign Y)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Y.fiber,
      (0 < ((ballLocalizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ r hr b).pullbackSign S).restrict
          D.fiber_subset x ↔ 0 < T x))
    {K : Set E}
    (hK : K ⊆ {x | 2 * r ^ 2 ≤ localRadialSq (x - b)})
    (hD : D.FixedOn K X.g) (hT : ∀ x ∈ K, T x = S x) :
    (signedNormalizationCobordism
      (ballLocalizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ r hr b)
      D S T hpos).ProductOn K X.g S
proof:
:= by
  apply signedNormalizationCobordism_productOn
    (A := ballLocalizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ r hr b)
    (D := D) (S := S) (T := T) hpos
  · exact (ballLocalizedPlaneRotation_fixedOn
      (m := m) θ r hr b).mono hK
  · exact hD
  · exact hT

name: Submission.recenter_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma recenter_zero (f : E₂ → ℝ) (p : E₂) : recenter f p 0 = f p
proof:
:= by
  simp [recenter]

name: Submission.contDiff_recenter
statement:
lemma contDiff_recenter {f : E₂ → ℝ} {k : ℕ∞ω} (hf : ContDiff ℝ k f) (p : E₂) :
    ContDiff ℝ k (recenter f p)
proof:
:= by
  exact hf.comp (contDiff_const.add contDiff_id)

name: Submission.fderiv_recenter_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun _ : E₂ => p) (0 : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) 0 :=
    hasFDerivAt_const (x := (0 : E₂)) p
  have hi : HasFDerivAt (fun x : E₂ => x) (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E₂) 0 :=
    hasFDerivAt_id (x := (0 : E₂))
  have hshift := hc.add hi
  have hfp : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f p) (p + 0) := by simpa using hf.hasFDerivAt
  have h := hfp.comp 0 hshift
  change fderiv ℝ (fun x : E₂ => f (p + x)) 0 = fderiv ℝ f p
  convert h.fderiv using 1 <;> try rfl
  ext v
  simp

name: Submission.map_eq_add_radialHadamardRemainder
proof:
:= by
  have hTaylor := map_add_eq_sum_add_integral_iteratedFDeriv
    (f := f) (x := (0 : E₂)) (y := x) (n := 1) (fun _ _ => by
      exact hf.contDiffAt)
  have hsum :
      ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (1 + 1), (Nat.factorial k : ℝ)⁻¹ •
        (iteratedFDeriv ℝ k f 0 (fun _ => x)) = f 0 := by
    norm_num [Finset.sum_range_succ, iteratedFDeriv_zero_apply,
      iteratedFDeriv_one_apply, hcrit]
  rw [hsum] at hTaylor
  simpa [radialHadamardRemainder, pow_one] using hTaylor

name: Submission.map_add_eq_add_radialHadamardRemainder
proof:
:= by
  have hrec : ContDiff ℝ (1 + 1) (recenter f p) := contDiff_recenter hf p
  have hdiff : Differentiable ℝ f := ContDiff.differentiable hf (by simp)
  have hc : fderiv ℝ (recenter f p) 0 = 0 := by
    rw [fderiv_recenter_zero hdiff.differentiableAt]
    exact hcrit
  simpa [recenter] using map_eq_add_radialHadamardRemainder hrec hc x

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.smooth_det
statement: lemma smooth_det : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H.det 0
proof:
:=
  (H.smooth_a.mul H.smooth_c).sub (H.smooth_b.pow 2)

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.exists_nonzero_pivot_candidate
statement:
theorem exists_nonzero_pivot_candidate (hnd : H.IsNondegenerate) :
    H.a 0 ≠ 0 ∨ H.c 0 ≠ 0 ∨ H.a 0 + 2 * H.b 0 + H.c 0 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ha : H.a 0 = 0
  · by_cases hc : H.c 0 = 0
    · right; right
      intro hp
      apply hnd
      rw [det, ha, hc]
      have hb : H.b 0 = 0 := by linarith
      rw [hb]
      norm_num
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hc)
  · exact Or.inl ha

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.completeSquare
statement:
theorem completeSquare {x : E₂} (ha : H.a x ≠ 0) :
    H.a x * (x 0) ^ 2 + 2 * H.b x * (x 0) * (x 1) + H.c x * (x 1) ^ 2 =
      H.a x * (x 0 + H.b x / H.a x * x 1) ^ 2 +
        H.det x / H.a x * (x 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [det]
  field_simp
  ring

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.basis_decomposition
statement: lemma basis_decomposition (x : E₂) : x = x 0 • e₀ + x 1 • e₁
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.bilinear_expand_coordinates
statement:
theorem bilinear_expand_coordinates (M : E₂ [×2]→L[ℝ] ℝ) (x : E₂) :
    M (fun _ => x) =
      x 0 ^ 2 * M ![e₀, e₀] + x 0 * x 1 * M ![e₀, e₁] +
      x 1 * x 0 * M ![e₁, e₀] + x 1 ^ 2 * M ![e₁, e₁]
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [basis_decomposition x]
  have hv (z : E₂) : (fun _ : Fin 2 => z) = Fin.cons z (Fin.cons z Fin.elim0) := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  rw [hv]
  change M.curryLeft (x 0 • e₀ + x 1 • e₁)
    (Fin.cons (x 0 • e₀ + x 1 • e₁) Fin.elim0) = _
  have hcons (u v : E₂) : Fin.cons u (Fin.cons v Fin.elim0) = ![u, v] := by
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> rfl
  simp only [map_add, map_smul, ContinuousMultilinearMap.cons_add,
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.cons_smul, ContinuousMultilinearMap.curryLeft_apply,
    add_apply, smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [hcons]
  ring

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.exact_integratedHadamard
statement:
theorem exact_integratedHadamard {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (hcrit : fderiv ℝ f 0 = 0) (x : E₂) :
    f x = f 0 +
      (integratedHadamardA f x * (x 0) ^ 2 +
        2 * integratedHadamardB f x * (x 0) * (x 1) +
        integratedHadamardC f x * (x 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have htwo : (2 : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞ := by
    change ((2 : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : ℕ∞ω)
    exact WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr (le_of_lt (ENat.coe_lt_top 2))
  rw [map_eq_add_radialHadamardRemainder
    (hf.of_le (by simpa only [one_add_one_eq_two] using htwo)) hcrit]
  congr 1
  have hM : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x)) :=
    (hf.continuous_iteratedFDeriv htwo).comp
      (continuous_id.smul continuous_const)
  have h00 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x) ![e₀, e₀]) :=
    hM.eval continuous_const
  have h01 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x) ![e₀, e₁]) :=
    hM.eval continuous_const
  have h10 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x) ![e₁, e₀]) :=
    hM.eval continuous_const
  have h11 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x) ![e₁, e₁]) :=
    hM.eval continuous_const
  let A : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (1 - t) * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x) ![e₀, e₀]
  let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (1 - t) *
    ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x) ![e₀, e₁] +
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x) ![e₁, e₀]) / 2)
  let C : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (1 - t) * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x) ![e₁, e₁]
  have hA : Continuous A := (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul h00
  have hB : Continuous B := (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul
    ((h01.add h10).div_const 2)
  have hC : Continuous C := (continuous_const.sub continuous_id).mul h11
  have hAi : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => x 0 ^ 2 * A t) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
    (hA.const_mul _).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hBi : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => (2 * x 0 * x 1) * B t)
      MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
    (hB.const_mul _).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hCi : IntervalIntegrable (fun t => x 1 ^ 2 * C t) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
    (hC.const_mul _).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  have hexpand : ∀ t : ℝ,
      (1 - t) • iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x) (fun _ => x) =
        x 0 ^ 2 * A t + (2 * x 0 * x 1) * B t + x 1 ^ 2 * C t := by
    intro t
    rw [bilinear_expand_coordinates]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, A, B, C]
    ring
  simp_rw [radialHadamardRemainder, hexpand]
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_add (hAi.add hBi) hCi,
    intervalIntegral.integral_add hAi hBi]
  simp only [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, integratedHadamardA,
    integratedHadamardB, integratedHadamardC, A, B, C]
  ring

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.squareCoord_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma squareCoord_apply_zero (α β γ : E₂ → ℝ) (x : E₂) :

  simp [squareCoord]

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.swapCLM_swap
statement: @[simp] lemma swapCLM_swap (v : E₂) : swapCLM (swapCLM v) = v
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.swapCLM_bijective
statement: lemma swapCLM_bijective : Function.Bijective swapCLM
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y h
    calc
      x = swapCLM (swapCLM x) := (swapCLM_swap x).symm
      _ = swapCLM (swapCLM y) := congrArg swapCLM h
      _ = y := swapCLM_swap y
  · intro y
    exact ⟨swapCLM y, swapCLM_swap y⟩

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.swapEquiv_coe
statement: @[simp] lemma swapEquiv_coe : (swapEquiv : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) = swapCLM

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.swapEquiv_apply_one

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.norm_swapCLM
statement: lemma norm_swapCLM (v : E₂) : ‖swapCLM v‖ = ‖v‖
proof:

  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  congr 1
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, add_comm]

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.triangularDeriv_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma triangularDeriv_apply_zero (α β γ : ℝ) (v : E₂) :
    triangularDeriv α β γ v 0 = α * (v 0 + β * v 1)
proof:
:= by
  simp [triangularDeriv, proj₀, proj₁]
  ring

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.triangularDeriv_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma triangularDeriv_apply_one (α β γ : ℝ) (v : E₂) :
    triangularDeriv α β γ v 1 = γ * v 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [triangularDeriv, proj₀, proj₁]

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.triangularDeriv_bijective
statement:
theorem triangularDeriv_bijective {α β γ : ℝ} (hα : α ≠ 0) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    Function.Bijective (triangularDeriv α β γ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · have h0 := congrArg (fun v : E₂ => v 0) hxy
      have h1 := congrArg (fun v : E₂ => v 1) hxy
      simp only [triangularDeriv_apply_zero, triangularDeriv_apply_one] at h0 h1
      have hy1 : x 1 = y 1 := by
        exact mul_left_cancel₀ hγ h1
      rw [hy1] at h0
      have heq := mul_left_cancel₀ hα h0
      exact add_right_cancel heq
    · have h1 := congrArg (fun v : E₂ => v 1) hxy
      simp only [triangularDeriv_apply_one] at h1
      exact mul_left_cancel₀ hγ h1
  · intro y
    let x₁ : ℝ := y 1 / γ
    let x₀ : ℝ := y 0 / α - β * x₁
    let x : E₂ := WithLp.toLp 2 ![x₀, x₁]
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext i
    fin_cases i
    · simp [x, x₀, x₁, div_eq_mul_inv]
      field_simp
    · simp [x, x₁, div_eq_mul_inv]
      field_simp

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.triangularEquiv_coe
statement:
@[simp] lemma triangularEquiv_coe (α β γ : ℝ) (hα : α ≠ 0) (hγ : γ ≠ 0) :
    (triangularEquiv α β γ hα hγ : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) =
      triangularDeriv α β γ
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.hasFDerivAt_squareCoord_zero
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_squareCoord_zero {α β γ : E₂ → ℝ}
    (hα : DifferentiableAt ℝ α 0) (hβ : DifferentiableAt ℝ β 0)
    (hγ : DifferentiableAt ℝ γ 0) :
    HasFDerivAt (squareCoord α β γ) (triangularDeriv (α 0) (β 0) (γ 0)) 0
proof:
:= by
  have h₀ : HasFDerivAt (fun x : E₂ => x 0) proj₀ 0 := proj₀.hasFDerivAt
  have h₁ : HasFDerivAt (fun x : E₂ => x 1) proj₁ 0 := proj₁.hasFDerivAt
  have hfirst := (hα.hasFDerivAt.mul (h₀.add (hβ.hasFDerivAt.mul h₁))).smul_const e₀
  have hsecond := (hγ.hasFDerivAt.mul h₁).smul_const e₁
  convert hfirst.add hsecond using 1 <;> try rfl
  ext v i
  fin_cases i
  · simp [triangularDeriv, proj₀, proj₁]
  · simp [triangularDeriv, proj₀, proj₁]

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.contDiffAt_coord_zero
statement: lemma contDiffAt_coord_zero : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x : E₂ => x 0) 0
proof:
:=
  (EuclideanSpace.proj 0 : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffAt

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.contDiffAt_coord_one
statement: lemma contDiffAt_coord_one : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x : E₂ => x 1) 0
proof:
:=
  (EuclideanSpace.proj 1 : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffAt

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.minimumCoord_contDiffAt
statement:
lemma minimumCoord_contDiffAt (ha : 0 < H.a 0) (hd : 0 < H.det 0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H.minimumCoord 0
proof:
:= by
  have hba : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => H.b x / H.a x) 0 :=
    H.smooth_b.div H.smooth_a ha.ne'
  have hda : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => H.det x / H.a x) 0 :=
    H.smooth_det.div H.smooth_a ha.ne'
  have hdiv : 0 < H.det 0 / H.a 0 := div_pos hd ha
  unfold minimumCoord squareCoord
  exact (((H.smooth_a.sqrt ha.ne').mul
      (contDiffAt_coord_zero.add (hba.mul contDiffAt_coord_one))).smul
        contDiffAt_const).add
    (((hda.sqrt hdiv.ne').mul contDiffAt_coord_one).smul contDiffAt_const)

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.saddleCoord_contDiffAt
statement:
lemma saddleCoord_contDiffAt (ha : 0 < H.a 0) (hd : H.det 0 < 0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H.saddleCoord 0
proof:
:= by
  have hba : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => H.b x / H.a x) 0 :=
    H.smooth_b.div H.smooth_a ha.ne'
  have hda : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => -(H.det x / H.a x)) 0 :=
    (H.smooth_det.div H.smooth_a ha.ne').neg
  have hdiv : 0 < -(H.det 0 / H.a 0) := by
    have := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos hd ha
    linarith
  unfold saddleCoord squareCoord
  exact (((H.smooth_a.sqrt ha.ne').mul
      (contDiffAt_coord_zero.add (hba.mul contDiffAt_coord_one))).smul
        contDiffAt_const).add
    (((hda.sqrt hdiv.ne').mul contDiffAt_coord_one).smul contDiffAt_const)

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.maximumCoord_contDiffAt
statement:
lemma maximumCoord_contDiffAt (ha : H.a 0 < 0) (hd : 0 < H.det 0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H.maximumCoord 0
proof:
:= by
  have hba : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => H.b x / H.a x) 0 :=
    H.smooth_b.div H.smooth_a ha.ne
  have hna : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => -H.a x) 0 := H.smooth_a.neg
  have hda : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => -(H.det x / H.a x)) 0 :=
    (H.smooth_det.div H.smooth_a ha.ne).neg
  have hdiv : 0 < -(H.det 0 / H.a 0) := by
    have := div_neg_of_pos_of_neg hd ha
    linarith
  unfold maximumCoord squareCoord
  exact (((hna.sqrt (by linarith : -H.a 0 ≠ 0)).mul
      (contDiffAt_coord_zero.add (hba.mul contDiffAt_coord_one))).smul
        contDiffAt_const).add
    (((hda.sqrt hdiv.ne').mul contDiffAt_coord_one).smul contDiffAt_const)

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.saddleNegativeCoord_contDiffAt
statement:
lemma saddleNegativeCoord_contDiffAt (ha : H.a 0 < 0) (hd : H.det 0 < 0) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ H.saddleNegativeCoord 0
proof:
:= by
  have hba : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => H.b x / H.a x) 0 :=
    H.smooth_b.div H.smooth_a ha.ne
  have hna : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => -H.a x) 0 := H.smooth_a.neg
  have hda : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => H.det x / H.a x) 0 :=
    H.smooth_det.div H.smooth_a ha.ne
  have hdiv : 0 < H.det 0 / H.a 0 := div_pos_of_neg_of_neg hd ha
  have hsquare : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (squareCoord (fun x => Real.sqrt (-H.a x)) (fun x => H.b x / H.a x)
        (fun x => Real.sqrt (H.det x / H.a x))) 0 := by
    unfold squareCoord
    exact (((hna.sqrt (by linarith : -H.a 0 ≠ 0)).mul
        (contDiffAt_coord_zero.add (hba.mul contDiffAt_coord_one))).smul
          contDiffAt_const).add
      (((hda.sqrt hdiv.ne').mul contDiffAt_coord_one).smul contDiffAt_const)
  unfold saddleNegativeCoord
  exact swapCLM.contDiff.contDiffAt.comp (0 : E₂) hsquare

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.minimumCoord_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem minimumCoord_hasFDerivAt (ha : 0 < H.a 0) (hd : 0 < H.det 0) :
    HasFDerivAt H.minimumCoord
      (triangularDeriv (Real.sqrt (H.a 0)) (H.b 0 / H.a 0)
        (Real.sqrt (H.det 0 / H.a 0))) 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold minimumCoord
  apply hasFDerivAt_squareCoord_zero
  · exact (H.smooth_a.sqrt ha.ne').differentiableAt (by simp)
  · exact (H.smooth_b.div H.smooth_a ha.ne').differentiableAt (by simp)
  · have hdiv : 0 < H.det 0 / H.a 0 := div_pos hd ha
    exact ((H.smooth_det.div H.smooth_a ha.ne').sqrt hdiv.ne').differentiableAt (by simp)

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.saddleCoord_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem saddleCoord_hasFDerivAt (ha : 0 < H.a 0) (hd : H.det 0 < 0) :
    HasFDerivAt H.saddleCoord
      (triangularDeriv (Real.sqrt (H.a 0)) (H.b 0 / H.a 0)
        (Real.sqrt (-(H.det 0 / H.a 0)))) 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold saddleCoord
  apply hasFDerivAt_squareCoord_zero
  · exact (H.smooth_a.sqrt ha.ne').differentiableAt (by simp)
  · exact (H.smooth_b.div H.smooth_a ha.ne').differentiableAt (by simp)
  · have hdiv : 0 < -(H.det 0 / H.a 0) := by
      have := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos hd ha
      linarith
    exact (((H.smooth_det.div H.smooth_a ha.ne').neg).sqrt hdiv.ne').differentiableAt
      (by simp)

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.maximumCoord_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem maximumCoord_hasFDerivAt (ha : H.a 0 < 0) (hd : 0 < H.det 0) :
    HasFDerivAt H.maximumCoord
      (triangularDeriv (Real.sqrt (-H.a 0)) (H.b 0 / H.a 0)
        (Real.sqrt (-(H.det 0 / H.a 0)))) 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold maximumCoord
  apply hasFDerivAt_squareCoord_zero
  · exact (H.smooth_a.neg.sqrt (by linarith : -H.a 0 ≠ 0)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  · exact (H.smooth_b.div H.smooth_a ha.ne).differentiableAt (by simp)
  · have hdiv : 0 < -(H.det 0 / H.a 0) := by
      have := div_neg_of_pos_of_neg hd ha
      linarith
    exact (((H.smooth_det.div H.smooth_a ha.ne).neg).sqrt hdiv.ne').differentiableAt
      (by simp)

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.saddleNegativeCoord_hasFDerivAt
statement:
theorem saddleNegativeCoord_hasFDerivAt (ha : H.a 0 < 0) (hd : H.det 0 < 0) :
    HasFDerivAt H.saddleNegativeCoord
      (swapCLM.comp <| triangularDeriv (Real.sqrt (-H.a 0)) (H.b 0 / H.a 0)
        (Real.sqrt (H.det 0 / H.a 0))) 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold saddleNegativeCoord
  apply swapCLM.hasFDerivAt.comp (0 : E₂)
  apply hasFDerivAt_squareCoord_zero
  · exact (H.smooth_a.neg.sqrt (by linarith : -H.a 0 ≠ 0)).differentiableAt (by simp)
  · exact (H.smooth_b.div H.smooth_a ha.ne).differentiableAt (by simp)
  · have hdiv : 0 < H.det 0 / H.a 0 := div_pos_of_neg_of_neg hd ha
    exact ((H.smooth_det.div H.smooth_a ha.ne).sqrt hdiv.ne').differentiableAt (by simp)

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.exact_minimum
statement:
theorem exact_minimum {x : E₂} (ha : 0 < H.a x) (hd : 0 < H.det x) :
    f x = f 0 + morseQuadratic .minimum (H.minimumCoord x 0, H.minimumCoord x 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.exact, morseQuadratic, minimumCoord, squareCoord_apply_zero,
    squareCoord_apply_one, H.completeSquare ha.ne']
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt ha.le]
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ H.det x / H.a x := div_nonneg hd.le ha.le
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hdiv]

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.exact_saddle
statement:
theorem exact_saddle {x : E₂} (ha : 0 < H.a x) (hd : H.det x < 0) :
    f x = f 0 + morseQuadratic .saddle (H.saddleCoord x 0, H.saddleCoord x 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.exact, morseQuadratic, saddleCoord, squareCoord_apply_zero,
    squareCoord_apply_one, H.completeSquare ha.ne']
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt ha.le]
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ -(H.det x / H.a x) := by
    have : H.det x / H.a x < 0 := div_neg_of_neg_of_pos hd ha
    linarith
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hdiv]
  ring

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.exact_maximum
statement:
theorem exact_maximum {x : E₂} (ha : H.a x < 0) (hd : 0 < H.det x) :
    f x = f 0 + morseQuadratic .maximum (H.maximumCoord x 0, H.maximumCoord x 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.exact, morseQuadratic, maximumCoord, squareCoord_apply_zero,
    squareCoord_apply_one, H.completeSquare ha.ne]
  have hna : 0 ≤ -H.a x := by linarith
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hna]
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ -(H.det x / H.a x) := by
    have : H.det x / H.a x < 0 := div_neg_of_pos_of_neg hd ha
    linarith
  rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hdiv]
  ring

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.exact_saddleNegative
statement:
theorem exact_saddleNegative {x : E₂} (ha : H.a x < 0) (hd : H.det x < 0) :
    f x = f 0 + morseQuadratic .saddle
      (H.saddleNegativeCoord x 0, H.saddleNegativeCoord x 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [H.exact, morseQuadratic, saddleNegativeCoord, swapCLM_apply_zero,
    swapCLM_apply_one, squareCoord_apply_zero, squareCoord_apply_one,
    H.completeSquare ha.ne]
  simp only
  have hna : 0 ≤ -H.a x := by linarith
  have hdiv : 0 ≤ H.det x / H.a x := (div_pos_of_neg_of_neg hd ha).le
  simp_rw [mul_pow]
  rw [Real.sq_sqrt hna, Real.sq_sqrt hdiv]
  ring

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.eventually_exact_minimum
statement:
lemma eventually_exact_minimum (ha : 0 < H.a 0) (hd : 0 < H.det 0) :
    ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0,
      f x = f 0 + morseQuadratic .minimum (H.minimumCoord x 0, H.minimumCoord x 1)
proof:
:= by
  have haev : ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0, 0 < H.a x :=
    H.smooth_a.continuousAt.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds ha)
  have hdev : ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0, 0 < H.det x :=
    H.smooth_det.continuousAt.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hd)
  filter_upwards [haev, hdev] with x hax hdx
  exact H.exact_minimum hax hdx

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.eventually_exact_saddle
statement:
lemma eventually_exact_saddle (ha : 0 < H.a 0) (hd : H.det 0 < 0) :
    ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0,
      f x = f 0 + morseQuadratic .saddle (H.saddleCoord x 0, H.saddleCoord x 1)
proof:
:= by
  have haev : ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0, 0 < H.a x :=
    H.smooth_a.continuousAt.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds ha)
  have hdev : ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0, H.det x < 0 :=
    H.smooth_det.continuousAt.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hd)
  filter_upwards [haev, hdev] with x hax hdx
  exact H.exact_saddle hax hdx

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.eventually_exact_maximum
statement:
lemma eventually_exact_maximum (ha : H.a 0 < 0) (hd : 0 < H.det 0) :
    ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0,
      f x = f 0 + morseQuadratic .maximum (H.maximumCoord x 0, H.maximumCoord x 1)
proof:
:= by
  have haev : ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0, H.a x < 0 :=
    H.smooth_a.continuousAt.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds ha)
  have hdev : ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0, 0 < H.det x :=
    H.smooth_det.continuousAt.eventually (Ioi_mem_nhds hd)
  filter_upwards [haev, hdev] with x hax hdx
  exact H.exact_maximum hax hdx

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.eventually_exact_saddleNegative
statement:
lemma eventually_exact_saddleNegative (ha : H.a 0 < 0) (hd : H.det 0 < 0) :
    ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0,
      f x = f 0 + morseQuadratic .saddle
        (H.saddleNegativeCoord x 0, H.saddleNegativeCoord x 1)
proof:
:= by

  have hdev : ∀ᶠ x in nhds 0, H.det x < 0 :=
    H.smooth_det.continuousAt.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hd)
  filter_upwards [haev, hdev] with x hax hdx

    f (I.param u) = f 0 + morseQuadratic I.index (u 0, u 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmodel : ∀ᶠ u in nhds 0,
      f (I.param u) = f 0 +
        morseQuadratic I.index (I.coord (I.param u) 0, I.coord (I.param u) 1) :=
    I.param_tendsto.eventually I.model_eventually

    f (I.param u) = f 0 + morseQuadratic I.index (u 0, u 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : {u : E₂ | f (I.param u) =
      f 0 + morseQuadratic I.index (u 0, u 1)} ∈ nhds 0 :=
    I.eventually_exact_param
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hmem
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  apply hball
  rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
  exact hu

    (hscalar : ∀ x, f x = τ (surface x)) (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < M.radius) :
    τ (M.liftParam surface u) =
      τ (surface 0) + morseQuadratic M.index (u 0, u 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← hscalar, liftParam, ← hscalar]
  exact M.exact u hu

name: Submission.LocalMorseNormalForm.liftParam_contDiffAt

lemma liftParam_contDiffAt {A : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A]

    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (M.liftParam surface) 0
proof:
:= by
  change ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun u : E₂ => surface (M.param u)) 0
  have hs : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ surface (M.param 0) := by
    simpa [M.param_zero] using hsurface
  exact hs.comp (0 : E₂) M.param_contDiffAt

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.exists_normalForm_of_firstPivot
statement:
theorem exists_normalForm_of_firstPivot (ha : H.a 0 ≠ 0) (hd : H.det 0 ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (LocalMorseNormalForm f)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ha with ha | ha <;>
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hd with hd | hd
  · obtain ⟨M, _⟩ := H.exists_saddle_negative_normalForm ha hd
    exact ⟨M⟩
  · obtain ⟨M, _⟩ := H.exists_maximum_normalForm ha hd
    exact ⟨M⟩
  · obtain ⟨M, _⟩ := H.exists_saddle_normalForm ha hd
    exact ⟨M⟩
  · obtain ⟨M, _⟩ := H.exists_minimum_normalForm ha hd
    exact ⟨M⟩

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.morseLemma2D_of_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem morseLemma2D_of_nondegenerate (hnd : H.IsNondegenerate) :
    Nonempty (LocalMorseNormalForm f)
proof:
:= by
  have hdet : H.det 0 ≠ 0 := hnd
  rcases H.exists_nonzero_pivot_candidate hnd with ha | hc | hs
  · exact H.exists_normalForm_of_firstPivot ha hdet
  · let K := H.swapData
    have hKa : K.a 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [K] using hc
    have hKd : K.det 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [K] using hdet
    obtain ⟨M⟩ := K.exists_normalForm_of_firstPivot hKa hKd
    exact ⟨LocalMorseNormalForm.pushLinear swapEquiv M⟩
  · let K := H.sumShearData
    have hKa : K.a 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [K] using hs
    have hKd : K.det 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [K] using hdet
    obtain ⟨M⟩ := K.exists_normalForm_of_firstPivot hKa hKd
    exact ⟨LocalMorseNormalForm.pushLinear sumShearEquiv M⟩

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.morseLemma2D_saddle
statement:
theorem morseLemma2D_saddle (hd : H.det 0 < 0) :
    ∃ M : LocalMorseNormalForm f, M.index = .saddle
proof:
:= by
  have hnd : H.IsNondegenerate := hd.ne
  rcases H.exists_nonzero_pivot_candidate hnd with ha | hc | hs
  · exact H.exists_saddle_normalForm_of_firstPivot ha hd
  · let K := H.swapData
    have hKa : K.a 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [K] using hc
    have hKd : K.det 0 < 0 := by simpa [K] using hd
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := K.exists_saddle_normalForm_of_firstPivot hKa hKd
    exact ⟨LocalMorseNormalForm.pushLinear swapEquiv M, by simpa using hM⟩
  · let K := H.sumShearData
    have hKa : K.a 0 ≠ 0 := by simpa [K] using hs
    have hKd : K.det 0 < 0 := by simpa [K] using hd
    obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := K.exists_saddle_normalForm_of_firstPivot hKa hKd
    exact ⟨LocalMorseNormalForm.pushLinear sumShearEquiv M, by simpa using hM⟩

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.morseLemma2D_integrated
statement:
theorem morseLemma2D_integrated {g : E₂ → ℝ} (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g)
    (hcrit : fderiv ℝ g 0 = 0)
    (hA : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (integratedHadamardA g) 0)
    (hB : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (integratedHadamardB g) 0)
    (hC : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (integratedHadamardC g) 0)
    (hdet : integratedHadamardDet g ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (LocalMorseNormalForm g)
proof:
:= by
  let K := integratedHadamardData hg hcrit hA hB hC
  have hKdet : K.det 0 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [K, integratedHadamardData, det, integratedHadamardDet] using hdet
  exact K.morseLemma2D_of_nondegenerate hKdet

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeArcMarks_of_escape
statement:
theorem saddleNegativeArcMarks_of_escape
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (b : SaddleBranch)
    {ρ s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hreg))
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hreg) V)
    (hP : V.orbitPoint (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hreg V) ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (hstart : P.curve 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hend : P.curve halfI ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hesc : ∃ q : I, halfArc P q ∉
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad)) :
    ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b e ρ s) ∈
        Set.range (halfArc P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set O := T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V
    with hO
  set A := T.saddleNegativeBranchCyclicMarking hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V
    with hA
  have horbitEq : (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      V.orbit P.p := by
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O, V.orbit_eq_of_mem hP]
  have hbase : (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hreg V).p = V.orbitPoint O := rfl
  have horbitBase : V.orbit
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V).p =
      V.orbit P.p := by
    rw [hbase, ← V.orbitPoint_orbit O, horbitEq]
  have hgamma : ∀ u : I, halfArc P u ∈ V.orbit
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V).p := by
    intro u
    rw [horbitBase]
    exact P.curve_mem_orbit _
  have hinj : Function.Injective (halfArc P) := injective_halfArc P
  have hcut := T.saddleNegativeBranch_localSegment_range_eq_cut hindex b ρ s
    hρ hs hρrad hreg V
  have h0 : halfArc P 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    rw [halfArc_zero]; exact hstart
  have h1 : halfArc P 1 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    rw [halfArc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_one]; exact hend
  have hmain := A.marks_mem_range_of_escape (halfArc P) hgamma hinj hcut h0 h1
    hesc
  have hpoint : ∀ i : Fin 2, A.point i =
      spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b (saddleBranchOfFinTwo i) ρ s) :=
    fun _ => rfl
  intro e
  cases e with
  | negative =>
      have h := hmain 0
      rw [hpoint 0, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_zero] at h
      exact h
  | positive =>
      have h := hmain 1
      rw [hpoint 1, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_one] at h
      exact h

      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    rw [halfArc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_one]; exact hend
  have hs0 : ∀ l : Fin 2, halfArc P 0 ≠ A.point l := by
    intro l
    rw [halfArc_zero, hpoint l]
    exact hstartne _
  have hs1 : ∀ l : Fin 2, halfArc P 1 ≠ A.point l := by
    intro l
    rw [halfArc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hpoint l]
    exact hendne _
  have hseed' : A.point 0 ∈ Set.range (halfArc P) := by
    rw [hpoint 0, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_zero]
    exact hseed
  have hmain := A.marks_mem_range_of_one_mark (halfArc P) hgamma hinj hcut h0 h1
    hs0 hs1 hseed'
  intro e
  cases e with
  | negative =>
      have h := hmain 0
      rw [hpoint 0, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_zero] at h
      exact h
  | positive =>
      have h := hmain 1
      rw [hpoint 1, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_one] at h
      exact h

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveArcMarks_of_seed
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveArcMarks_of_seed
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (b : SaddleBranch)
    {ρ s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hreg))
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hreg) V)
    (hP : V.orbitPoint (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hreg V) ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (hstart : P.curve 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hend : P.curve halfI ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hstartne : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      P.curve 0 ≠ spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b e ρ s))
    (hendne : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      P.curve halfI ≠ spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b e ρ s))
    (hseed : spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b .negative ρ s) ∈
      Set.range (halfArc P)) :
    ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b e ρ s) ∈
        Set.range (halfArc P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set O := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V
    with hO
  set A := T.saddlePositiveBranchCyclicMarking hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V
    with hA
  have horbitEq : (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      V.orbit P.p := by
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O, V.orbit_eq_of_mem hP]
  have hbase : (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hreg V).p = V.orbitPoint O := rfl
  have horbitBase : V.orbit
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V).p =
      V.orbit P.p := by
    rw [hbase, ← V.orbitPoint_orbit O, horbitEq]
  have hgamma : ∀ u : I, halfArc P u ∈ V.orbit
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V).p := by
    intro u
    rw [horbitBase]
    exact P.curve_mem_orbit _
  have hinj : Function.Injective (halfArc P) := injective_halfArc P
  have hcut := T.saddlePositiveBranch_localSegment_range_eq_cut hindex b ρ s
    hρ hs hρrad hreg V
  have hpoint : ∀ i : Fin 2, A.point i =
      spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b (saddleBranchOfFinTwo i) ρ s) :=
    fun _ => rfl
  have h0 : halfArc P 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    rw [halfArc_zero]; exact hstart
  have h1 : halfArc P 1 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    rw [halfArc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_one]; exact hend
  have hs0 : ∀ l : Fin 2, halfArc P 0 ≠ A.point l := by
    intro l
    rw [halfArc_zero, hpoint l]
    exact hstartne _
  have hs1 : ∀ l : Fin 2, halfArc P 1 ≠ A.point l := by
    intro l
    rw [halfArc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hpoint l]
    exact hendne _
  have hseed' : A.point 0 ∈ Set.range (halfArc P) := by
    rw [hpoint 0, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_zero]
    exact hseed
  have hmain := A.marks_mem_range_of_one_mark (halfArc P) hgamma hinj hcut h0 h1
    hs0 hs1 hseed'
  intro e
  cases e with
  | negative =>
      have h := hmain 0
      rw [hpoint 0, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_zero] at h
      exact h
  | positive =>
      have h := hmain 1
      rw [hpoint 1, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_one] at h
      exact h

        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))

    hsrc (by rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)])

    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_endpointParamRadius t ht).le
  constructor
  · intro h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin, hseed⟩ :=
      (KE C D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos).1 h1 h2
    have hpc := hprov
    obtain ⟨hd, -, -, -, -, -, hc₁₀, hc₁₁, hc₂₀, hc₂₁⟩ := hpc

    have hmark₁ := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t

      hbase₂₀.1 hbase₂₁.1 hbase₂₀.2 hbase₂₁.2 hseed.2
    exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin, hmark₁, hmark₂⟩
  · intro h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin, hseed⟩ :=
      (KE C D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos).2 h1 h2
    have hpc := hprov
    obtain ⟨hd, -, -, -, -, -, hc₁₀, hc₁₁, hc₂₀, hc₂₁⟩ := hpc
    obtain ⟨p₁₀, hp₁₀⟩ := hc₁₀
    obtain ⟨p₁₁, hp₁₁⟩ := hc₁₁
    obtain ⟨p₂₀, hp₂₀⟩ := hc₂₀

    have hidxN := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le hindex .negative hs0
      hρ hs hρrad hρ' hs' hρ'rad hle (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos
    have hidxP := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le hindex .positive hs0

          ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ' hs' hρ'rad (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos ≠
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ' hs' hρ'rad (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      intro hEq
      exact h1 (by rw [hidxN, hidxP, hEq])
    have hOrb : ∀ (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam
          ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSlice
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)) Vpos)
        (O : Vpos.OrbitIndex) (c : I),
        Vpos.orbitPoint O ∈ Vpos.orbit P.p → P.curve c ∈ (O : Set _) := by
      intro P O c hO
      rw [Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit O, Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem hO]
      exact P.curve_mem_orbit c
    have hidx₁ := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le hindex e₁ hs0
      hρ hs hρrad hρ' hs' hρ'rad hle (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos
    have hstep₁ : Vpos.orbitPoint ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ' hs' hρ'rad (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) ∈
        Vpos.orbit F.before₁Param.p := by
      rw [← congrArg Vpos.orbitPoint hidx₁]
      exact F.before₁Param_orbit
    have hidx₂ := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le hindex e₂ hs0
      hρ hs hρrad hρ' hs' hρ'rad hle (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos
    have hstep₂ : Vpos.orbitPoint ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ' hs' hρ'rad (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) ∈
        Vpos.orbit F.before₂Param.p := by
      rw [← congrArg Vpos.orbitPoint hidx₂]
      exact F.before₂Param_orbit
    have hflow₁₀ : (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow (F.coreArc₁ 0)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) = cobSpaceTime (F.before₁Param.curve 0)
          (D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) := by
      have h := F.coreArc₁_before 0
      rw [Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hpin.1] at h
      rw [← hd]
      exact h
    have hflow₁₁ : (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow (F.coreArc₁ 1)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) =
        cobSpaceTime (F.before₁Param.curve halfI)
          (D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) := by
      have h := F.coreArc₁_before 1
      rw [Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hpin.2.1] at h
      rw [← hd]
      exact h
    have hflow₂₀ : (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow (F.coreArc₂ 0)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) = cobSpaceTime (F.before₂Param.curve 0)
          (D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) := by
      have h := F.coreArc₂_before 0
      rw [Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hpin.2.2.1] at h
      rw [← hd]
      exact h
    have hflow₂₁ : (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow (F.coreArc₂ 1)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) =
        cobSpaceTime (F.before₂Param.curve halfI)
          (D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) := by
      have h := F.coreArc₂_before 1
      rw [Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hpin.2.2.2] at h
      rw [← hd]
      exact h
    have hbase₁₀ := D.beforeArcPoint_interior_split t ht hindex Vpos hne' e₁
      (hOrb F.before₁Param _ 0 hstep₁) p₁₀ (F.coreArc₁_mem 0) hp₁₀ hflow₁₀
    have hbase₁₁ := D.beforeArcPoint_interior_split t ht hindex Vpos hne' e₁
      (hOrb F.before₁Param _ halfI hstep₁) p₁₁ (F.coreArc₁_mem 1) hp₁₁ hflow₁₁
    have hbase₂₀ := D.beforeArcPoint_interior_split t ht hindex Vpos hne' e₂
      (hOrb F.before₂Param _ 0 hstep₂) p₂₀ (F.coreArc₂_mem 0) hp₂₀ hflow₂₀
    have hbase₂₁ := D.beforeArcPoint_interior_split t ht hindex Vpos hne' e₂
      (hOrb F.before₂Param _ halfI hstep₂) p₂₁ (F.coreArc₂_mem 1) hp₂₁ hflow₂₁
    have hmark₁ := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).saddlePositiveArcMarks_of_seed hindex e₁ hρ' hs' hρ'rad
      (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos F.before₁Param hstep₁
      hbase₁₀.1 hbase₁₁.1 hbase₁₀.2 hbase₁₁.2 hseed.1
    have hmark₂ := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).saddlePositiveArcMarks_of_seed hindex e₂ hρ' hs' hρ'rad
      (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos F.before₂Param hstep₂
      hbase₂₀.1 hbase₂₁.1 hbase₂₀.2 hbase₂₁.2 hseed.2
    exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin, hmark₁, hmark₂⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.contDiff_frameAt_intrinsicOrbitLift
statement:
theorem contDiff_frameAt_intrinsicOrbitLift (O : V.OrbitIndex)
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u => frameAt X (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u) i)
proof:
:= by
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tauField X.g ∘ V.intrinsicOrbitLift O)
    exact (contDiffOn_tauField X.smooth).comp_contDiff
      (V.contDiff_intrinsicOrbitLift O) fun u =>
        X.fiber_subset_regularSet
          (V.flow_mem_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
            (u * V.orbitPeriod O))
  · change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (gradVec X.g j ∘ V.intrinsicOrbitLift O)
    exact (contDiff_gradVec X.g X.smooth j).comp
      (V.contDiff_intrinsicOrbitLift O)

name: Submission.TamedField.contDiff_orbitFrameVector
statement:
theorem contDiff_orbitFrameVector (O : V.OrbitIndex) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u =>
      gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)) i)
proof:
:= by
  let A : ℝ → Fin (n + 1) → E := fun u j =>
    frameAt X (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u) j
  have hA : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u => A u j) := by
    intro j
    exact V.contDiff_frameAt_intrinsicOrbitLift O j
  have hInd : ∀ u, LinearIndependent ℝ (A u) := by
    intro u
    exact linearIndependent_frameAt X (X.fiber_subset_regularSet
      (V.flow_mem_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
        (u * V.orbitPeriod O)))
  exact contDiff_gramSchmidtNormed_family
    (T := ℝ) (m := n + 1) (A := A) hA hInd i

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitFrameVector_zero
statement:
theorem orbitFrameVector_zero (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)) 0 =
      tauField X.g (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u ∈ X.fiber :=
    V.flow_mem_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) (u * V.orbitPeriod O)
  have hnorm : ‖tauField X.g (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)‖ = 1 :=
    norm_tauField (X.fiber_subset_regularSet hmem)
  change gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
      (frameAt X (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)) (⊥ : Fin (n + 1)) = _
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed, gramSchmidt_bot]
  change ‖tauField X.g (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)‖⁻¹ •
      tauField X.g (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u) = _
  rw [hnorm]
  simp

name: Submission.TamedField.contDiff_orbitNormal
statement:

proof:

name: Submission.TamedField.contDiff_orbitTubeLift
statement:
theorem contDiff_orbitTubeLift (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (V.orbitTubeLift O)
proof:
:= by
  apply (V.contDiff_intrinsicOrbitLift O).comp contDiff_fst |>.add
  apply ContDiff.sum
  intro j _
  exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj j).contDiff.comp contDiff_snd).smul
    ((V.contDiff_orbitNormal O j).comp contDiff_fst)

name: Submission.TamedField.periodic_orbitTubeLift
statement:

proof:

  rw [V.periodic_intrinsicOrbitLift O u]

name: Submission.TamedField.hasFDerivAt_orbitTubeLift_zero
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_orbitTubeLift_zero (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (V.orbitTubeLift O) (V.orbitTubeDeriv O u) (u, 0)
proof:
:= by
  have houter : HasFDerivAt (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ
        (V.orbitPeriod O • V.v (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u))) u :=
    (V.hasDerivAt_intrinsicOrbitLift O u).hasFDerivAt
  have hfst : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × N => q.1)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ N) (u, 0) :=
    hasFDerivAt_fst
  have hbase : HasFDerivAt
      (fun q : ℝ × N => V.intrinsicOrbitLift O q.1)
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ
        (V.orbitPeriod O • V.v (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ N)) (u, 0) := by
    change HasFDerivAt
      (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O ∘ fun q : ℝ × N => q.1)
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ
        (V.orbitPeriod O • V.v (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u))).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ N)) (u, 0)
    exact houter.comp (f := fun q : ℝ × N => q.1)
      (g := V.intrinsicOrbitLift O) (u, 0) hfst
  have hnormal' : HasFDerivAt
      (∑ j : Fin n, fun q : ℝ × N =>
        q.2 j • V.orbitNormal O j q.1)
      (∑ j : Fin n,
        (((EuclideanSpace.proj j).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ N)).smulRight
            (V.orbitNormal O j u))) (u, 0) := by
    apply HasFDerivAt.sum
    intro j _
    have hc := ((EuclideanSpace.proj j).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ N)).hasFDerivAt
      (x := (u, (0 : N)))
    have hN : HasFDerivAt
        (fun q : ℝ × N => V.orbitNormal O j q.1)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × N => V.orbitNormal O j q.1) (u, 0))
        (u, 0) :=
      ((V.contDiff_orbitNormal O j).comp contDiff_fst).differentiable
        (by simp) (u, 0) |>.hasFDerivAt
    convert hc.smul hN using 1
    · rfl
    · simp
  have hnormal : HasFDerivAt
      (fun q : ℝ × N =>
        ∑ j : Fin n, q.2 j • V.orbitNormal O j q.1)
      (∑ j : Fin n,
        (((EuclideanSpace.proj j).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ N)).smulRight
            (V.orbitNormal O j u))) (u, 0) := by
    convert hnormal' using 1
    funext q
    simp
  exact hbase.add hnormal

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitTubeDeriv_bijective
statement:
theorem orbitTubeDeriv_bijective (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    Function.Bijective (V.orbitTubeDeriv O u)
proof:
:= by
  let B : Fin (n + 1) → E := fun i => V.orbitFrameVector O i u
  have hmem : V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u ∈ X.fiber :=
    V.flow_mem_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) (u * V.orbitPeriod O)
  have hInd : LinearIndependent ℝ (frameAt X (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)) :=
    linearIndependent_frameAt X (X.fiber_subset_regularSet hmem)
  have horth : Orthonormal ℝ B := gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hInd
  have hinner : ∀ i j, ⟪B i, B j⟫_ℝ = if i = j then 1 else 0 :=
    orthonormal_iff_ite.mp horth
  have hv : V.v (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u) = B 0 := by
    rw [V.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber hmem]
    exact (V.orbitFrameVector_zero O u).symm
  have hinj : Function.Injective (V.orbitTubeDeriv O u) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    rintro ⟨a, z⟩ hzero
    have hformula :
        a • (V.orbitPeriod O • B 0) +
          ∑ j : Fin n, z j • B j.succ = 0 := by
      simpa [hv, orbitNormal] using hzero
    have haeq : a * V.orbitPeriod O = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun x : E => ⟪B 0, x⟫_ℝ) hformula
      simp only [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, inner_sum,
        inner_zero_right] at h
      rw [hinner 0 0] at h
      have hsum : ∑ j : Fin n, z j * ⟪B 0, B j.succ⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro j _
        rw [hinner 0 j.succ]
        rw [if_neg (Ne.symm j.succ_ne_zero)]
        simp
      rw [hsum, add_zero] at h
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h
    have ha : a = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp haeq).resolve_right (ne_of_gt (V.orbitPeriod_pos O))
    have hz : z = 0 := by
      ext j
      have h := congrArg (fun x : E => ⟪B j.succ, x⟫_ℝ) hformula
      simp only [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, inner_sum,
        inner_zero_right] at h
      rw [ha, zero_mul, zero_add] at h
      have hsum :
          ∑ k : Fin n, z k * ⟪B j.succ, B k.succ⟫_ℝ = z j := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
        · rw [hinner j.succ j.succ]
          simp
        · intro k _ hkj
          rw [hinner j.succ k.succ]
          have hjk : j ≠ k := Ne.symm hkj
          rw [if_neg ((Fin.succ_injective n).ne hjk)]
          simp
        · simp
      rw [hsum] at h
      simpa using h
    exact Prod.ext ha hz
  refine ⟨hinj, ?_⟩
  have hfr : finrank ℝ (ℝ × N) = finrank ℝ E := by
    rw [Module.finrank_prod, Module.finrank_self,
      finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    omega
  exact (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hfr).mp hinj

statement:
