name: Submission.CompactTimeTamedField.flowSquare_regular
statement:
theorem flowSquare_regular (R : CompactTimeTamedField C K)
    (z : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) (hzK : ∀ q, z q ∈ K)
    {d₀ d₁ : ℝ} (hd₀ : |d₀| ≤ R.safeTime) (hd₁ : |d₁| ≤ R.safeTime)
    (q : I × I) :
    Function.Surjective (spatialDeriv C.G (R.flowSquare z d₀ d₁ q))
proof:
:= by
  apply R.flow_spatialDeriv_surjective (hzK q.2)
  have hw₀ : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (q.1 : ℝ) := q.1.property.1
  have hw₁ : (q.1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := q.1.property.2
  have h₀ := abs_le.mp hd₀
  have h₁ := abs_le.mp hd₁
  have habs : |(1 - (q.1 : ℝ)) * d₀ + (q.1 : ℝ) * d₁| ≤ R.safeTime := by
    rw [abs_le]
    constructor
    · nlinarith only [h₀.1, h₀.2, h₁.1, h₁.2, hw₀, hw₁]
    · nlinarith only [h₀.1, h₀.2, h₁.1, h₁.2, hw₀, hw₁]
  calc
    |(1 - (q.1 : ℝ)) * d₀ + (q.1 : ℝ) * d₁| ≤ R.safeTime := habs
    _ < 2 * R.safeTime := by linarith [R.safeTime_pos]

name: Submission.CompactTimeTamedField.frameSquare_apply_eq_frameMapCM
statement:
theorem frameSquare_apply_eq_frameMapCM (R : CompactTimeTamedField C K)
    (z : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) (hzK : ∀ q, z q ∈ K)
    {d₀ d₁ : ℝ} (hd₀ : |d₀| ≤ R.safeTime) (hd₁ : |d₁| ≤ R.safeTime)

:= by
  ext <;> simp [h]

name: Submission.sandwich_pure
statement:
theorem sandwich_pure {u w : ℍ} (hu : u.re = 0) (hw : w.re = 0) :
    (u + w) * u * (u + w) =
      ((normSq w - normSq u : ℝ) : ℍ) * u
        - ((2 * normSq u + 2 * (u * star w).re : ℝ) : ℍ) * w
proof:
:= by
  ext <;>
    simp [Quaternion.re_mul, Quaternion.imI_mul, Quaternion.imJ_mul, Quaternion.imK_mul,
      hu, hw] <;>
    (try simp only [Quaternion.normSq_def', hu, hw]) <;>
    ring

name: Submission.conj_of_ne_neg
statement:
theorem conj_of_ne_neg {u w : ℍ} (hu : u.re = 0) (hw : w.re = 0)
    (hu1 : normSq u = 1) (hw1 : normSq w = 1) (hne : w ≠ -u) :
    ∃ n : ℍ, normSq n = 1 ∧ n * u * star n = w
proof:
:= by
  set s : ℍ := u + w with hs_def
  have hs0 : s ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    exact hne (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right h)
  have hsre : s.re = 0 := by simp [hs_def, hu, hw]
  have hstar_s : star s = -s := star_of_re_eq_zero hsre
  have hnorm0 : ‖s‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hs0
  have hnsq : normSq s = ‖s‖ * ‖s‖ := Quaternion.normSq_eq_norm_mul_self s
  have hnsq0 : normSq s ≠ 0 := by rw [hnsq]; exact mul_ne_zero hnorm0 hnorm0
  set c : ℝ := (u * star w).re with hc_def
  have hsq : normSq s = 2 + 2 * c := by
    rw [hs_def, Quaternion.normSq_add, hu1, hw1]; ring
  set r : ℝ := ‖s‖⁻¹ with hr_def
  have hrr : r * r * normSq s = 1 := by
    rw [hnsq, hr_def]
    field_simp
  refine ⟨r • s, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [Quaternion.normSq_eq_norm_mul_self, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_nonneg (by rw [hr_def]; positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ r)]
    calc r * ‖s‖ * (r * ‖s‖) = r * r * (‖s‖ * ‖s‖) := by ring
      _ = r * r * normSq s := by rw [← hnsq]
      _ = 1 := hrr
  · have key : s * u * s = -(((2 + 2 * c : ℝ) : ℍ) * w) := by
      have h := sandwich_pure hu hw
      rw [hu1, hw1, ← hc_def] at h
      rw [hs_def]
      rw [h]
      have h0 : ((1 - 1 : ℝ) : ℍ) = 0 := by norm_num
      have h2 : ((2 * 1 + 2 * c : ℝ) : ℍ) = ((2 + 2 * c : ℝ) : ℍ) := by norm_num
      rw [h0, h2, zero_mul, zero_sub]
    have hstar_n : star (r • s) = r • (-s) := by
      rw [Quaternion.star_smul, hstar_s]
    calc r • s * u * star (r • s)
        = r • s * u * (r • (-s)) := by rw [hstar_n]
      _ = r • (s * u) * (r • (-s)) := by rw [smul_mul_assoc]
      _ = r • (s * u * (r • (-s))) := by rw [smul_mul_assoc]
      _ = r • (r • (s * u * (-s))) := by rw [mul_smul_comm]
      _ = (r * r) • (s * u * (-s)) := by rw [smul_smul]
      _ = (r * r) • (-(s * u * s)) := by rw [mul_neg]
      _ = (r * r) • (((2 + 2 * c : ℝ) : ℍ) * w) := by rw [key, neg_neg]
      _ = (r * r) • ((2 + 2 * c) • w) := by rw [Quaternion.coe_mul_eq_smul]
      _ = (r * r * (2 + 2 * c)) • w := by rw [smul_smul]
      _ = (1 : ℝ) • w := by rw [← hsq, hrr]
      _ = w := one_smul _ _

name: Submission.exists_conj_pure
statement:
theorem exists_conj_pure {u w : ℍ} (hu : u.re = 0) (hw : w.re = 0)
    (hu1 : normSq u = 1) (hw1 : normSq w = 1) :
    ∃ q : ℍ, normSq q = 1 ∧ q * u * star q = w
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨v, hvre, hv1, hvu, hvw⟩ :
      ∃ v : ℍ, v.re = 0 ∧ normSq v = 1 ∧ v ≠ -u ∧ w ≠ -v := by
    have hik : (⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ : ℍ) ≠ ⟨0, 0, 0, 1⟩ := by
      simp [Quaternion.ext_iff]
    have hjk : (⟨0, 0, 1, 0⟩ : ℍ) ≠ ⟨0, 0, 0, 1⟩ := by
      simp [Quaternion.ext_iff]
    have hij : (⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ : ℍ) ≠ ⟨0, 0, 1, 0⟩ := by
      simp [Quaternion.ext_iff]
    have hnsq : ∀ x y z : ℝ, normSq (⟨0, x, y, z⟩ : ℍ) = x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + z ^ 2 := by
      intro x y z
      rw [Quaternion.normSq_def']
      norm_num
    by_cases h1 : (⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ : ℍ) ≠ -u ∧ w ≠ -(⟨0, 1, 0, 0⟩ : ℍ)
    · exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [hnsq]; norm_num, h1.1, h1.2⟩
    by_cases h2 : (⟨0, 0, 1, 0⟩ : ℍ) ≠ -u ∧ w ≠ -(⟨0, 0, 1, 0⟩ : ℍ)
    · exact ⟨_, rfl, by rw [hnsq]; norm_num, h2.1, h2.2⟩
    · rw [not_and_or, not_not, not_not] at h1 h2
      refine ⟨⟨0, 0, 0, 1⟩, rfl, by rw [hnsq]; norm_num, ?_, ?_⟩
      · 
        intro hk
        rcases h1 with h1u | h1w
        · exact hik (h1u.trans hk.symm)
        · rcases h2 with h2u | h2w
          · exact hjk (h2u.trans hk.symm)
          · exact hij (neg_injective (h1w.symm.trans h2w))
      · 
        intro hk
        rcases h1 with h1u | h1w
        · rcases h2 with h2u | h2w
          · exact hij (h1u.trans h2u.symm)
          · exact hjk (neg_injective (h2w.symm.trans hk))
        · exact hik (neg_injective (h1w.symm.trans hk))
  obtain ⟨n₁, hn₁, hc₁⟩ := conj_of_ne_neg hu hvre hu1 hv1 hvu
  obtain ⟨n₂, hn₂, hc₂⟩ := conj_of_ne_neg hvre hw hv1 hw1 hvw
  refine ⟨n₂ * n₁, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_mul normSq, hn₂, hn₁, mul_one]
  · rw [star_mul]
    calc n₂ * n₁ * u * (star n₁ * star n₂)
        = n₂ * (n₁ * u * star n₁) * star n₂ := by simp only [mul_assoc]
      _ = n₂ * v * star n₂ := by rw [hc₁]
      _ = w := hc₂

name: Submission.spinToSO_surjective
statement: theorem spinToSO_surjective : Function.Surjective spinToSO
proof:
:= by
  intro M
  have hM := M.2
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff] at hM
  obtain ⟨hAorth, hAdet⟩ := hM
  set A : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := (M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ) with hA_def
  have hAAT : A * Aᵀ = 1 := by
    have h := hAorth
    rwa [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff] at h
  have hATA : Aᵀ * A = 1 := by
    have h := hAorth
    rwa [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff'] at h
  
  have hu1 : normSq (fromIm fun i => A i 2) = 1 := by
    have h22 := congr_fun (congr_fun hATA 2) 2
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
      at h22
    rw [normSq_fromIm]
    linear_combination h22
  
  obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀, hconj⟩ := exists_conj_pure (fromIm_re _)
    (show (⟨0, 0, 0, 1⟩ : ℍ).re = 0 from rfl) hu1
    (by rw [Quaternion.normSq_def']; norm_num)
  have hMMT : rotMatrix q₀ * (rotMatrix q₀)ᵀ = 1 := rotMatrix_mul_transpose hq₀
  have hMTM : (rotMatrix q₀)ᵀ * rotMatrix q₀ = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hMMT
  set B : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℝ := rotMatrix q₀ * A with hB_def
  
  have hcol : fromIm (fun i => B i 2) = (⟨0, 0, 0, 1⟩ : ℍ) := by
    have h1 : (fun i => B i 2) = rotMatrix q₀ *ᵥ (fun i => A i 2) := by
      funext i
      simp [hB_def, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct]
    rw [h1, ← conj_fromIm, hconj]
  have hB02 : B 0 2 = 0 := congr_arg (fun t : ℍ => t.imI) hcol
  have hB12 : B 1 2 = 0 := congr_arg (fun t : ℍ => t.imJ) hcol
  have hB22 : B 2 2 = 1 := congr_arg (fun t : ℍ => t.imK) hcol
  
  have hBBT : B * Bᵀ = 1 := by
    rw [hB_def, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc A Aᵀ (rotMatrix q₀)ᵀ, hAAT, Matrix.one_mul, hMMT]
  have hBTB : Bᵀ * B = 1 := by
    rw [hB_def, Matrix.transpose_mul, Matrix.mul_assoc,
      ← Matrix.mul_assoc (rotMatrix q₀)ᵀ (rotMatrix q₀) A, hMTM, Matrix.one_mul, hATA]
  have hBdet : B.det = 1 := by
    rw [hB_def, Matrix.det_mul, hAdet, mul_one, det_rotMatrix, hq₀, one_pow]
  
  have hrow := congr_fun (congr_fun hBBT 2) 2
  simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply, hB22]
    at hrow
  have hB20 : B 2 0 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (B 2 0), sq_nonneg (B 2 1)]
  have hB21 : B 2 1 = 0 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (B 2 0), sq_nonneg (B 2 1)]
  
  have hpq : B 0 0 * B 0 0 + B 1 0 * B 1 0 = 1 := by
    have h00 := congr_fun (congr_fun hBTB 0) 0
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
      hB20] at h00
    linear_combination h00
  have hprs : B 0 0 * B 0 1 + B 1 0 * B 1 1 = 0 := by
    have h01 := congr_fun (congr_fun hBTB 0) 1
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
      hB20, hB21] at h01
    linear_combination h01
  have hdet3 : B 0 0 * B 1 1 - B 0 1 * B 1 0 = 1 := by
    rw [Matrix.det_fin_three] at hBdet
    rw [hB02, hB12, hB20, hB21, hB22] at hBdet
    linear_combination hBdet
  have hr : B 0 1 = -(B 1 0) := by
    linear_combination -(B 0 1 * hpq) + B 0 0 * hprs - B 1 0 * hdet3
  have hs : B 1 1 = B 0 0 := by
    linear_combination -(B 1 1 * hpq) + B 1 0 * hprs + B 0 0 * hdet3
  
  set z : ℂ := ⟨B 0 0, B 1 0⟩ with hz_def
  have hznorm : ‖z‖ = 1 := by
    have h1 : Complex.normSq z = 1 := by
      rw [Complex.normSq_apply]
      exact hpq
    have h2 : ‖z‖ * ‖z‖ = 1 := by
      have := Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq z
      rw [h1] at this
      nlinarith
    rcases mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp h2 with h | h
    · exact h
    · nlinarith [norm_nonneg z]
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h, norm_zero] at hznorm
    norm_num at hznorm
  have hcosθ : Real.cos z.arg = B 0 0 := by
    rw [Complex.cos_arg hz0, hznorm, div_one]
  have hsinθ : Real.sin z.arg = B 1 0 := by
    rw [Complex.sin_arg, hznorm, div_one]
  
  set a : ℝ := Real.cos (z.arg / 2) with ha_def
  set d : ℝ := Real.sin (z.arg / 2) with hd_def
  have had : d ^ 2 + a ^ 2 = 1 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (z.arg / 2)
  have hcosd : a ^ 2 - d ^ 2 = B 0 0 := by
    have h1 := Real.cos_two_mul (z.arg / 2)
    rw [show 2 * (z.arg / 2) = z.arg by ring, hcosθ] at h1
    linarith
  have hsind : 2 * (a * d) = B 1 0 := by
    have h1 := Real.sin_two_mul (z.arg / 2)
    rw [show 2 * (z.arg / 2) = z.arg by ring, hsinθ] at h1
    linarith
  
  
  clear_value B z a d
  
  
  
  set qz : ℍ := (⟨a, 0, 0, d⟩ : ℍ) with hqz_def
  have hqz1 : normSq qz = 1 := by
    rw [hqz_def, Quaternion.normSq_def']
    norm_num
    linarith
  
  have hrot : rotMatrix qz = B := by
    rw [hqz_def]
    have hB' : B = !![B 0 0, -(B 1 0), 0; B 1 0, B 0 0, 0; 0, 0, 1] := by
      conv_lhs => rw [Matrix.eta_fin_three B]
      rw [hB02, hB12, hB20, hB21, hB22, hr, hs]
    rw [hB']
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [rotMatrix] <;>
      linarith [hcosd, hsind, had]
  clear_value qz
  
  have hfinal : normSq (star q₀ * qz) = 1 := by
    rw [map_mul normSq, Quaternion.normSq_star, hq₀, hqz1, mul_one]
  refine ⟨⟨star q₀ * qz, mem_sphere_of_normSq hfinal⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [spinToSO_apply_coe]
  show rotMatrix (star q₀ * qz) = A
  rw [rotMatrix_mul, rotMatrix_star, hrot, hB_def, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, hMTM, Matrix.one_mul]

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleMergeSourceOrbit_mem_exterior
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleMergeSourceOrbit_mem_exterior
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (O : (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex)
    (hO : (O : Set E₁) ∈
      D.chronologicalSaddleMergeExteriorSourceFamily t ht hindex) :
    (O : Set E₁) ∈ D.chronologicalExteriorOrbitCollection t ht
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
proof:
:= by
  have hneNegative : (O : Set E₁) ≠
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .negative :
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hO.1.2
  have hnePositive : (O : Set E₁) ≠
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .positive :
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hO.2
  exact D.chronologicalSaddleBeforeOrbit_mem_exterior_of_ne_branches
    t ht hindex O hnePositive hneNegative

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleSplitSourceOrbit_mem_exterior
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleSplitSourceOrbit_mem_exterior
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (hbranches :
      D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .negative =
        D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .positive)
    (O : (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex)
    (hO : (O : Set E₁) ∈
      D.chronologicalSaddleSplitExteriorSourceFamily t ht hindex) :
    (O : Set E₁) ∈ D.chronologicalExteriorOrbitCollection t ht
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
proof:
:= by
  have hneNegative : (O : Set E₁) ≠
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .negative :
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) := by
    simpa only [Set.mem_singleton_iff] using hO.2
  have hbranchSets :
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .negative :
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) =
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .positive :
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) :=
    congrArg (fun Q : (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex =>
      (Q : Set E₁)) hbranches
  have hnePositive : (O : Set E₁) ≠
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .positive :
        (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) := by
    intro h
    exact hneNegative (h.trans hbranchSets.symm)
  exact D.chronologicalSaddleBeforeOrbit_mem_exterior_of_ne_branches
    t ht hindex O hnePositive hneNegative

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleBeforeOrbitPoint_mem_exteriorSlabCore
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleBeforeOrbitPoint_mem_exteriorSlabCore
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (O : (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).OrbitIndex)
    {x : E₁} (hx : x ∈ (O : Set E₁))
    (hexterior : (O : Set E₁) ∈
      D.chronologicalExteriorOrbitCollection t ht
        (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)) :
    cobSpaceTime x (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) ∈
      D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht
proof:
:= by
  rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hexterior x hx⟩
  · have hxFiber : x ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice t ht).fiber := by
      apply (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbit_subset_fiber
        ((D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
      rwa [← (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).orbitPoint_orbit O]
    rw [chronologicalBeforeSlice,
      SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber] at hxFiber
    exact hxFiber
  · change tcoord (cobSpaceTime x (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)) ∈ Set.Icc
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after
    rw [tcoord_spaceTime]
    have hb := D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_bracket t ht
    exact ⟨hb.1.le, hb.2.le⟩

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.normalCoefficientBlock_det
statement:
theorem normalCoefficientBlock_det : ∀ k a b,
    (normalCoefficientBlock k a b).det = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2
  | 0, a, b => by
      rw [normalCoefficientBlock, Matrix.det_fin_two]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.head_fin_const, Matrix.of_apply,
        Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail, Function.comp_apply]
      ring
  | k + 1, a, b => by
      rw [normalCoefficientBlock, incMatrix_det,
        normalCoefficientBlock_det k a b]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.incMatrix_tangentNormalBlock
statement:
theorem incMatrix_tangentNormalBlock {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) :
    incMatrix (tangentNormalBlock a A) =
      tangentNormalBlock a (incMatrix A)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          rw [incMatrix_apply_last_last]
          change 1 = incMatrix A (Fin.last n) (Fin.last n)
          rw [incMatrix_apply_last_last]
      | cast j =>
          rw [incMatrix_apply_last_castSucc]
          rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
          · change 0 = 0
            rfl
          · change 0 = incMatrix A (Fin.last n) (Fin.castSucc j)
            rw [incMatrix_apply_last_castSucc]
  | cast i =>
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          rw [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_last]
          rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
          · change 0 = 0
            rfl
          · change 0 = incMatrix A (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.last n)
            rw [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_last]
      | cast j =>
          rw [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_castSucc]
          rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
          · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
            · change a = a
              rfl
            · change 0 = 0
              rfl
          · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
            · change 0 = 0
              rfl
            · change A i j = incMatrix A (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j)
              rw [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_castSucc]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.fullCoefficientBlock_eq_tangentNormalBlock
statement:
theorem fullCoefficientBlock_eq_tangentNormalBlock : ∀ k a b,
    fullCoefficientBlock k a b =
      tangentNormalBlock 1 (normalCoefficientBlock k a b)
  | 0, a, b => by
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> rfl
  | k + 1, a, b => by
      rw [fullCoefficientBlock, normalCoefficientBlock,
        fullCoefficientBlock_eq_tangentNormalBlock k a b,
        incMatrix_tangentNormalBlock]

                                                                              

def rowAction {n : ℕ} {V : Type*} [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (v : Fin n → V) : Fin n → V
proof:
:=
  fun i => ∑ j, A i j • v j

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.rowAction_incMatrix_castSucc
statement:
theorem rowAction_incMatrix_castSucc {n : ℕ} {V : Type*}
    [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → V) (i : Fin n) :
    rowAction (incMatrix A) v i.castSucc =
      rowAction A (fun j => v j.castSucc) i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold rowAction
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_castSucc,
    incMatrix_apply_castSucc_last]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.rowAction_incMatrix_last
statement:
theorem rowAction_incMatrix_last {n : ℕ} {V : Type*}
    [AddCommMonoid V] [Module ℝ V]
    (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) (v : Fin (n + 1) → V) :
    rowAction (incMatrix A) v (Fin.last n) = v (Fin.last n)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold rowAction
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp [incMatrix_apply_last_castSucc, incMatrix_apply_last_last]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_zero
statement:
theorem rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_zero {V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] : ∀ (k : ℕ) (a b : ℝ)
      (v : Fin (k + 2) → V),
    rowAction (normalCoefficientBlock k a b) v 0 =
      a • v 0 - b • v 1
  | 0, a, b, v => by
      simp [rowAction, normalCoefficientBlock, Fin.sum_univ_two,
        sub_eq_add_neg]
  | k + 1, a, b, v => by
      rw [normalCoefficientBlock,
        show (0 : Fin (k + 3)) = (0 : Fin (k + 2)).castSucc by rfl,
        rowAction_incMatrix_castSucc]
      simpa using rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_zero k a b
        (fun j => v j.castSucc)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_one
statement:
theorem rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_one {V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] : ∀ (k : ℕ) (a b : ℝ)
      (v : Fin (k + 2) → V),
    rowAction (normalCoefficientBlock k a b) v 1 =
      b • v 0 + a • v 1
  | 0, a, b, v => by
      simp [rowAction, normalCoefficientBlock, Fin.sum_univ_two]
  | k + 1, a, b, v => by
      rw [normalCoefficientBlock,
        show (1 : Fin (k + 3)) = (1 : Fin (k + 2)).castSucc by rfl,
        rowAction_incMatrix_castSucc]
      simpa using rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_one k a b
        (fun j => v j.castSucc)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_of_ne
statement:
theorem rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_of_ne {V : Type*}
    [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℝ V] : ∀ (k : ℕ) (a b : ℝ)
      (v : Fin (k + 2) → V) (i : Fin (k + 2)),
    i ≠ 0 → i ≠ 1 →
      rowAction (normalCoefficientBlock k a b) v i = v i
  | 0, a, b, v, i, hi0, hi1 => by
      fin_cases i <;> contradiction
  | k + 1, a, b, v, i, hi0, hi1 => by
      rw [normalCoefficientBlock]
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last => exact rowAction_incMatrix_last _ _
      | cast i =>
          rw [rowAction_incMatrix_castSucc]
          exact rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_of_ne k a b
            (fun j => v j.castSucc) i
            (by
              intro h
              apply hi0
              apply Fin.ext
              exact congrArg (fun z : Fin (k + 2) => z.val) h)
            (by
              intro h
              apply hi1
              apply Fin.ext
              exact congrArg (fun z : Fin (k + 2) => z.val) h)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.fderiv_sourceLevelMap_apply_rowZero
statement:
theorem fderiv_sourceLevelMap_apply_rowZero
    {x : E} (hx : StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2) x = 0)
    (h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (sourceLevelMap m) x h (rowZero m) =
      twistRe m (spaceTime x 0) *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2)) x h (rowZero m) -
        twistIm m (spaceTime x 0) *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2)) x h (rowOne m)
proof:
:= by
  let v : A := spaceTime x 0
  have hv : StandardSaddle.eventMap m v = 0 := by
    exact (StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_zero m x (by norm_num)).trans hx
  have hs := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowZero m))
    (fderiv_sourceLevelMap_eq_event m x)
  have h0 := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowZero m))
    (fderiv_standard_source_eq_event m x)
  have h1 := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowOne m))
    (fderiv_standard_source_eq_event m x)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] at hs h0 h1
  rw [hs, fderiv_eventMap_apply_rowZero_of_standard_zero m hv,
    twistShift_eq_zero_of_standard_zero m hv, add_zero, ← h0, ← h1]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.fderiv_sourceLevelMap_apply_rowOne
statement:
theorem fderiv_sourceLevelMap_apply_rowOne
    {x : E} (hx : StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2) x = 0)
    (h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (sourceLevelMap m) x h (rowOne m) =
      twistIm m (spaceTime x 0) *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2)) x h (rowZero m) +
        twistRe m (spaceTime x 0) *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2)) x h (rowOne m)
proof:
:= by
  let v : A := spaceTime x 0
  have hv : StandardSaddle.eventMap m v = 0 := by
    exact (StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_zero m x (by norm_num)).trans hx
  have hs := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowOne m))
    (fderiv_sourceLevelMap_eq_event m x)
  have h0 := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowZero m))
    (fderiv_standard_source_eq_event m x)
  have h1 := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowOne m))
    (fderiv_standard_source_eq_event m x)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] at hs h0 h1
  rw [hs, fderiv_eventMap_apply_rowOne_of_standard_zero m hv,
    twistShift_eq_zero_of_standard_zero m hv, add_zero, ← h0, ← h1]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.fderiv_sourceLevelMap_apply_of_ne

theorem fderiv_sourceLevelMap_apply_of_ne {i : Fin (m + 2)}

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.fderiv_targetLevelMap_apply_rowZero
statement:
theorem fderiv_targetLevelMap_apply_rowZero
    {x : E} (hx : StandardSaddle.levelMap m (1 / 2) x = 0)
    (h : E) :

      twistRe m (spaceTime x 1) *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (1 / 2)) x h (rowZero m) -
        twistIm m (spaceTime x 1) *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (1 / 2)) x h (rowOne m)
proof:
:= by
  let v : A := spaceTime x 1
  have hv : StandardSaddle.eventMap m v = 0 := by
    exact (StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_one m x (by norm_num)).trans hx
  have hs := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowZero m))
    (fderiv_targetLevelMap_eq_event m x)
  have h0 := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowZero m))
    (fderiv_standard_target_eq_event m x)
  have h1 := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowOne m))
    (fderiv_standard_target_eq_event m x)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] at hs h0 h1
  rw [hs, fderiv_eventMap_apply_rowZero_of_standard_zero m hv,
    twistShift_eq_zero_of_standard_zero m hv, add_zero, ← h0, ← h1]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.fderiv_targetLevelMap_apply_rowOne
statement:
theorem fderiv_targetLevelMap_apply_rowOne
    {x : E} (hx : StandardSaddle.levelMap m (1 / 2) x = 0)
    (h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (targetLevelMap m) x h (rowOne m) =
      twistIm m (spaceTime x 1) *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (1 / 2)) x h (rowZero m) +
        twistRe m (spaceTime x 1) *
          fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (1 / 2)) x h (rowOne m)
proof:
:= by
  let v : A := spaceTime x 1
  have hv : StandardSaddle.eventMap m v = 0 := by
    exact (StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_one m x (by norm_num)).trans hx
  have hs := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowOne m))
    (fderiv_targetLevelMap_eq_event m x)
  have h0 := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowZero m))
    (fderiv_standard_target_eq_event m x)
  have h1 := congrArg
    (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h (rowOne m))
    (fderiv_standard_target_eq_event m x)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] at hs h0 h1
  rw [hs, fderiv_eventMap_apply_rowOne_of_standard_zero m hv,
    twistShift_eq_zero_of_standard_zero m hv, add_zero, ← h0, ← h1]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.fderiv_targetLevelMap_apply_of_ne
statement:
theorem fderiv_targetLevelMap_apply_of_ne {i : Fin (m + 2)}

      fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (1 / 2)) x h i
proof:

  have hs := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h i)
    (fderiv_targetLevelMap_eq_event m x)
  have hstd := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] F => L h i)
    (fderiv_standard_target_eq_event m x)
  simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] at hs hstd
  rw [hs, fderiv_eventMap_apply_of_ne m hi0 hi1, ← hstd]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.source_gradients_eq_rowAction
statement:
theorem source_gradients_eq_rowAction
    {x : E} (hx : StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2) x = 0) :
    (fun i => gradVec (sourceLevelMap m) i x) =
      rowAction (normalCoefficientBlock m
          (twistRe m (spaceTime x 0)) (twistIm m (spaceTime x 0)))
        (fun i => gradVec (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2)) i x)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  by_cases hi0 : i = rowZero m
  · subst i
    simp only [rowZero, rowOne]
    rw [rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_zero]
    simpa only [rowZero, rowOne] using gradVec_source_rowZero m hx
  · by_cases hi1 : i = rowOne m
    · subst i
      simp only [rowZero, rowOne]
      rw [rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_one]
      simpa only [rowZero, rowOne] using gradVec_source_rowOne m hx
    · rw [rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_of_ne m _ _ _ i
          (by simpa [rowZero] using hi0) (by simpa [rowOne] using hi1)]
      exact gradVec_source_of_ne m hi0 hi1 x

    · rw [rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_of_ne m _ _ _ i

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.frameAt_source_eq_coefficientAction
statement:
theorem frameAt_source_eq_coefficientAction (hm : 0 < m)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.sourceFLS m hm).fiber) :
    frameAt (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.sourceFLS m hm) x =
      frameRowAction
        (fullCoefficientBlock m (twistRe m (spaceTime x 0))
          (twistIm m (spaceTime x 0)))
        (frameAt (StandardSaddle.sourceFLS m) x)
proof:
:= by
  have hxstd : x ∈ (StandardSaddle.sourceFLS m).fiber := by
    rw [← source_fiber_eq_standard m hm]
    exact hx
  have hxlevel : StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2) x = 0 := hxstd
  have hv : ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap m (spaceTime x 0) = 0 := hx
  have hvstd : StandardSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x 0) = 0 :=
    (StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_zero m x (by norm_num)).trans hxlevel
  have hc : 0 < twistRe m (spaceTime x 0) ^ 2 +
      twistIm m (spaceTime x 0) ^ 2 := by
    have hp := twistCoefficient_normSq_pos_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hm hv
    rw [twistShift_eq_zero_of_standard_zero m hvstd, add_zero] at hp
    exact hp
  rw [fullCoefficientBlock_eq_tangentNormalBlock,
    show frameAt (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.sourceFLS m hm) x =
        Fin.cons (tauField (sourceLevelMap m) x)
          (fun i => gradVec (sourceLevelMap m) i x) by rfl,
    show frameAt (StandardSaddle.sourceFLS m) x =
        Fin.cons (tauField (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2)) x)
          (fun i => gradVec (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2)) i x) by rfl,
    frameRowAction_tangentNormalBlock,
    tauField_source_eq_standard m hxlevel hc,
    source_gradients_eq_rowAction m hxlevel]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.orthonormal_frameRowAction
statement:
theorem orthonormal_frameRowAction {n : ℕ}
    (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
    (hM : M * Mᵀ = 1)
    (v : Fin n → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hv : Orthonormal ℝ v) :
    Orthonormal ℝ (frameRowAction M v)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  intro i j
  simp only [frameRowAction]
  rw [sum_inner]
  simp_rw [inner_sum, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right,
    orthonormal_iff_ite.mp hv]
  simp only [mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq',
    Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
  have hij := congrArg (fun N : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ => N i j) hM
  simpa [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply] using hij

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.orthonormal_normalizedCoefficient_endpointUnitFrame
statement:
theorem orthonormal_normalizedCoefficient_endpointUnitFrame
    {a b level : ℝ} {x : E}

    Orthonormal ℝ
      (frameRowAction
        (fullCoefficientBlock m (a / coefficientNorm a b)
          (b / coefficientNorm a b))
        (StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame m level x))
proof:
:= by
  apply orthonormal_frameRowAction
  · exact fullCoefficientBlock_mul_transpose_of_normSq_one m _ _
      (normalized_coefficient_normSq hc)
  · exact StandardSaddle.orthonormal_endpointUnitFrame m hx hlevel

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.endpointRawFrame_firstNormal_eq_unit

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.coefficientAction_endpointRawFrame_eq_smul
statement:
theorem coefficientAction_endpointRawFrame_eq_smul (hm : 0 < m)
    {a b level : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hc : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
    (hx : StandardSaddle.levelMap m level x = 0)
    (hlevel : level = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ level = (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    (i : Fin (m + 3)) :
    frameRowAction (fullCoefficientBlock m a b)
        (StandardSaddle.endpointRawFrame m level x) i =
      cassiniFrameScale m x a b i •
        frameRowAction
          (fullCoefficientBlock m (a / coefficientNorm a b)
            (b / coefficientNorm a b))
          (StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame m level x) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [fullCoefficientBlock_eq_tangentNormalBlock,
    fullCoefficientBlock_eq_tangentNormalBlock,
    show StandardSaddle.endpointRawFrame m level x =
        Fin.cons (StandardSaddle.orientedUnitPlanarTangent m level x)
          (StandardSaddle.endpointRawNormal m x) by rfl,
    show StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame m level x =
        Fin.cons (StandardSaddle.orientedUnitPlanarTangent m level x)
          (StandardSaddle.endpointNormalUnit m x) by rfl,
    frameRowAction_tangentNormalBlock,
    frameRowAction_tangentNormalBlock]
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · simp [cassiniFrameScale, StandardSaddle.endpointRawFrame,
      StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame]
  · simp only [Fin.cons_succ]
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · subst i
      rw [rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_zero,
        rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_zero,
        endpointRawFrame_firstNormal_eq_unit m hm hx hlevel,
        endpointRawFrame_secondNormal_eq_unit m hm hx hlevel]
      have hr := coefficientNorm_pos hc
      have ha : coefficientNorm a b * (a / coefficientNorm a b) = a := by
        field_simp [hr.ne']
      have hb : coefficientNorm a b * (b / coefficientNorm a b) = b := by
        field_simp [hr.ne']
      simp only [cassiniFrameScale, Fin.succ_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
        true_or, smul_sub, smul_smul]
      simp [ha, hb]
    · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
      · subst i
        rw [rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_one,
          rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_one,
          endpointRawFrame_firstNormal_eq_unit m hm hx hlevel,
          endpointRawFrame_secondNormal_eq_unit m hm hx hlevel]
        have hr := coefficientNorm_pos hc
        have ha : coefficientNorm a b * (a / coefficientNorm a b) = a := by
          field_simp [hr.ne']
        have hb : coefficientNorm a b * (b / coefficientNorm a b) = b := by
          field_simp [hr.ne']
        simp only [cassiniFrameScale, Fin.succ_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte,
          smul_add, smul_smul]
        simp [ha, hb]
      · rw [rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_of_ne m _ _ _ i hi0 hi1,
          rowAction_normalCoefficientBlock_of_ne m _ _ _ i hi0 hi1]
        have hraw := StandardSaddle.endpointRawFrame_eq_smul_endpointUnitFrame
          m hx hlevel i.succ
        simp only [StandardSaddle.endpointRawFrame,
          StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame, Fin.cons_succ] at hraw
        rw [hraw]
        have hs0 : (i.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 0 := Fin.succ_ne_zero i
        have hs1 : (i.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠
            (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
          intro h
          exact hi0 (Fin.succ_injective (m + 2) h)
        have hs2 : (i.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠
            (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
          intro h
          exact hi1 (Fin.succ_injective (m + 2) h)
        have hspecial : ¬ ((i.succ : Fin (m + 3)) =
            (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ ∨
            (i.succ : Fin (m + 3)) = (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ) :=
          fun h => h.elim hs1 hs2
        rw [cassiniFrameScale, if_neg hs0, if_neg hspecial]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.gramSchmidtNormed_coefficientAction_endpointRawFrame
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_coefficientAction_endpointRawFrame
    (hm : 0 < m) {a b level : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hc : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)
    (hx : StandardSaddle.levelMap m level x = 0)
    (hlevel : level = (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ∨ level = (1 / 2 : ℝ)) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
        (frameRowAction (fullCoefficientBlock m a b)
          (StandardSaddle.endpointRawFrame m level x)) =
      frameRowAction
        (fullCoefficientBlock m (a / coefficientNorm a b)
          (b / coefficientNorm a b))
        (StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame m level x)
proof:
:= by
  let U := frameRowAction
    (fullCoefficientBlock m (a / coefficientNorm a b)
      (b / coefficientNorm a b))
    (StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame m level x)
  have hon : Orthonormal ℝ U :=
    orthonormal_normalizedCoefficient_endpointUnitFrame m hc hx hlevel
  have horth : Pairwise
      (fun i j => inner ℝ
        (frameRowAction (fullCoefficientBlock m a b)
          (StandardSaddle.endpointRawFrame m level x) i)
        (frameRowAction (fullCoefficientBlock m a b)
          (StandardSaddle.endpointRawFrame m level x) j) = 0) := by
    intro i j hij
    rw [coefficientAction_endpointRawFrame_eq_smul m hm hc hx hlevel,
      coefficientAction_endpointRawFrame_eq_smul m hm hc hx hlevel,
      real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, hon.2 hij,
      mul_zero, mul_zero]
  funext i
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed, gramSchmidt_of_orthogonal ℝ horth,
    coefficientAction_endpointRawFrame_eq_smul m hm hc hx hlevel,
    norm_smul, hon.1 i, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (cassiniFrameScale_pos m hc hx hlevel i), smul_smul]
  simp [inv_mul_cancel₀ (cassiniFrameScale_pos m hc hx hlevel i).ne']

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.sourceCoefficient_normSq_pos
statement:
theorem sourceCoefficient_normSq_pos (hm : 0 < m)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.sourceFLS m hm).fiber) :
    0 < twistRe m (spaceTime x 0) ^ 2 +
      twistIm m (spaceTime x 0) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hxstd : x ∈ (StandardSaddle.sourceFLS m).fiber := by
    rw [← source_fiber_eq_standard m hm]
    exact hx
  have hv : ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap m
      (spaceTime x 0) = 0 := hx
  have hvstd : StandardSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x 0) = 0 :=
    (StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_zero m x (by norm_num)).trans hxstd
  have hp := twistCoefficient_normSq_pos_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hm hv
  rwa [twistShift_eq_zero_of_standard_zero m hvstd, add_zero] at hp

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.targetCoefficient_normSq_pos
statement:
theorem targetCoefficient_normSq_pos (hm : 0 < m)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.targetFLS m hm).fiber) :
    0 < twistRe m (spaceTime x 1) ^ 2 +
      twistIm m (spaceTime x 1) ^ 2
proof:
:= by

    rw [← target_fiber_eq_standard m hm]
    exact hx
  have hv : ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.eventMap m
      (spaceTime x 1) = 0 := hx
  have hvstd : StandardSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x 1) = 0 :=
    (StandardSaddle.eventMap_collar_one m x (by norm_num)).trans hxstd
  have hp := twistCoefficient_normSq_pos_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hm hv
  rwa [twistShift_eq_zero_of_standard_zero m hvstd, add_zero] at hp

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_source
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_source (hm : 0 < m)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.sourceFLS m hm).fiber) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
        (frameAt (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.sourceFLS m hm) x) =
      frameRowAction
        ((coefficientSO m (twistRe m (spaceTime x 0))
          (twistIm m (spaceTime x 0)) (sourceCoefficient_normSq_pos m hm hx) :
            SOGroup (m + 3)) : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)
        (StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame m (-1 / 2) x)
proof:
:= by
  have hxstd : x ∈ (StandardSaddle.sourceFLS m).fiber := by
    rw [← source_fiber_eq_standard m hm]
    exact hx
  have hc := sourceCoefficient_normSq_pos m hm hx
  rw [frameAt_source_eq_coefficientAction m hm hx,
    StandardSaddle.frameAt_source_eq_endpointRawFrame m hxstd,
    gramSchmidtNormed_coefficientAction_endpointRawFrame m hm hc hxstd
      (Or.inl rfl), coefficientSO_coe]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameAdapter.gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_target
statement:
theorem gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_target (hm : 0 < m)
    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.targetFLS m hm).fiber) :
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
        (frameAt (ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.targetFLS m hm) x) =
      frameRowAction
        ((coefficientSO m (twistRe m (spaceTime x 1))
          (twistIm m (spaceTime x 1)) (targetCoefficient_normSq_pos m hm hx) :
            SOGroup (m + 3)) : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)
        (StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame m (1 / 2) x)
proof:
:= by
  have hxstd : x ∈ (StandardSaddle.targetFLS m).fiber := by
    rw [← target_fiber_eq_standard m hm]
    exact hx
  have hc := targetCoefficient_normSq_pos m hm hx
  rw [frameAt_target_eq_coefficientAction m hm hx,
    StandardSaddle.frameAt_target_eq_endpointRawFrame m hxstd,
    gramSchmidtNormed_coefficientAction_endpointRawFrame m hm hc hxstd
      (Or.inr rfl), coefficientSO_coe]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.raw_last
statement:
lemma raw_last (κ : PTCutoff S) (x : E) :
    raw S κ x (Fin.last n) = 2 * κ x - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [raw]
  simp [eLast]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.initCLM_raw
statement:
lemma initCLM_raw (κ : PTCutoff S) (x : E) :
    initCLM n (raw S κ x) = κ x • X.g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [raw, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, initCLM_embedCLM, initCLM_eLast,
    smul_zero, add_zero]

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.contDiff_raw
statement: lemma contDiff_raw (κ : PTCutoff S) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (raw S κ)
proof:
:= by
  exact (κ.smooth.smul ((embedCLM n).contDiff.comp X.smooth)).add
    (((contDiff_const.mul κ.smooth).sub contDiff_const).smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.raw_ne_zero
statement: lemma raw_ne_zero (κ : PTCutoff S) (x : E) : raw S κ x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hlast := congrArg (fun z : E => z (Fin.last n)) hzero
  rw [raw_last S κ, PiLp.zero_apply] at hlast
  have hκ : κ x = 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hhoriz := congrArg (initCLM n) hzero
  rw [initCLM_raw S κ, map_zero] at hhoriz
  have hκ0 : κ x ≠ 0 := by rw [hκ]; norm_num
  have hg : X.g x = 0 := (smul_eq_zero.mp hhoriz).resolve_left hκ0
  have hxfib : x ∈ X.fiber := hg
  rcases lt_trichotomy (S x) 0 with hneg | heq | hpos
  · have hz := κ.negative_zero x ⟨hxfib, hneg⟩
    rw [hκ] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  · exact S.nonzero x hxfib heq
  · have ho := κ.positive_one x ⟨hxfib, hpos⟩
    rw [hκ] at ho
    norm_num at ho

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.continuous_lerpRaw
statement:
lemma continuous_lerpRaw (κ₀ κ₁ : PTCutoff S) :
    Continuous (lerpRaw S κ₀ κ₁)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : Continuous fun p : I × E => (p.1 : ℝ) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
  have hκ₀ : Continuous fun p : I × E => κ₀ p.2 :=
    κ₀.smooth.continuous.comp continuous_snd
  have hκ₁ : Continuous fun p : I × E => κ₁ p.2 :=
    κ₁.smooth.continuous.comp continuous_snd
  have hg : Continuous fun p : I × E => X.g p.2 :=
    X.smooth.continuous.comp continuous_snd
  have hcut : Continuous fun p : I × E =>
      (1 - (p.1 : ℝ)) * κ₀ p.2 + (p.1 : ℝ) * κ₁ p.2 :=
    ((continuous_const.sub hs).mul hκ₀).add (hs.mul hκ₁)
  have heq : lerpRaw S κ₀ κ₁ = fun p : I × E =>
      ((1 - (p.1 : ℝ)) * κ₀ p.2 + (p.1 : ℝ) * κ₁ p.2) •
          embedCLM n (X.g p.2) +
        (2 * ((1 - (p.1 : ℝ)) * κ₀ p.2 + (p.1 : ℝ) * κ₁ p.2) - 1) • eLast n := by
    funext p
    rfl
  rw [heq]
  exact (hcut.smul ((embedCLM n).continuous.comp hg)).add
    (((continuous_const.mul hcut).sub continuous_const).smul continuous_const)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.lerpRaw_ne_zero
statement:
lemma lerpRaw_ne_zero (κ₀ κ₁ : PTCutoff S) (p : I × E) :
    lerpRaw S κ₀ κ₁ p ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  raw_ne_zero S (lerp S κ₀ κ₁ p.1) p.2

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.lerpSphereMap_of_zero
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext

    simp [lerpRaw, raw, lerp, h₀, h₁]
  change ‖lerpRaw S κ₀ κ₁ (s, x)‖⁻¹ • lerpRaw S κ₀ κ₁ (s, x) = -eLast n
  rw [hraw, norm_neg, norm_eLast, inv_one, one_smul]

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.contDiff_spaceTime_fixed
statement:
lemma contDiff_spaceTime_fixed (t : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E => spaceTime x t)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun x : E => spaceTime x t) =
      fun x => embedCLM (n + 1) x + t • eLast (n + 1) := by
    funext x
    exact spaceTime_eq_affine x t
  rw [heq]
  exact (embedCLM (n + 1)).contDiff.add contDiff_const

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.hasCompactSupport_comp_spaceTime
statement:
lemma hasCompactSupport_comp_spaceTime (χ : SignedSlabCutoff C) (t : ℝ) :
    HasCompactSupport (fun x : E => χ (spaceTime x t))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := χ.compact_support.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : A)
  rw [hasCompactSupport_def]
  apply IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) R)
    (isClosed_tsupport _)
  apply closure_minimal
  · intro x hx
    have hst : spaceTime x t ∈ tsupport χ :=
      subset_tsupport χ hx
    have hball := hR hst
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hball ⊢
    have hinit : initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x t) = x := initCLM_spaceTime x t
    rw [← hinit]
    exact (norm_spacePart_le (spaceTime x t)).trans hball
  · exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.endpointPTCM_zero_eq
statement:
lemma endpointPTCM_zero_eq (χ : SignedSlabCutoff C) :
    endpointPTCM C χ 0 = FiberSign.PTCutoff.sphereMap S₀ (sourcePTCutoff C χ)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hraw : raw C χ (spaceTime x 0) =
      FiberSign.PTCutoff.raw S₀ (sourcePTCutoff C χ) x := by
    rw [raw, FiberSign.PTCutoff.raw]
    change χ (spaceTime x 0) • embedCLM n (C.cobordism.G (spaceTime x 0)) + _ =
      χ (spaceTime x 0) • embedCLM n (X₀.g x) + _
    rw [C.cobordism.collar_zero x 0 (by norm_num), C.source_eq]
    rfl
  change ‖raw C χ (spaceTime x 0)‖⁻¹ • raw C χ (spaceTime x 0) =
    ‖FiberSign.PTCutoff.raw S₀ (sourcePTCutoff C χ) x‖⁻¹ •
      FiberSign.PTCutoff.raw S₀ (sourcePTCutoff C χ) x
  rw [hraw]

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.endpointPTCM_one_eq
statement:
lemma endpointPTCM_one_eq (χ : SignedSlabCutoff C) :
    endpointPTCM C χ 1 = FiberSign.PTCutoff.sphereMap S₁ (targetPTCutoff C χ)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro x
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hraw : raw C χ (spaceTime x 1) =
      FiberSign.PTCutoff.raw S₁ (targetPTCutoff C χ) x := by
    rw [raw, FiberSign.PTCutoff.raw]
    change χ (spaceTime x 1) • embedCLM n (C.cobordism.G (spaceTime x 1)) + _ =
      χ (spaceTime x 1) • embedCLM n (X₁.g x) + _
    rw [C.cobordism.collar_one x 1 (by norm_num), C.target_eq]
    rfl
  change ‖raw C χ (spaceTime x 1)‖⁻¹ • raw C χ (spaceTime x 1) =
    ‖FiberSign.PTCutoff.raw S₁ (targetPTCutoff C χ) x‖⁻¹ •
      FiberSign.PTCutoff.raw S₁ (targetPTCutoff C χ) x
  rw [hraw]

name: Submission.contDiff_rightFDeriv
statement:
theorem contDiff_rightFDeriv
    {A B D : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup B] [NormedSpace ℝ B]
    [NormedAddCommGroup D] [NormedSpace ℝ D]
    {F : A × B → D} (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rightFDeriv F)
proof:
:= by
  exact ContDiff.clm_comp (hF.fderiv_right (by simp)) contDiff_const

name: Submission.fderiv_section_eq_rightFDeriv
statement:
theorem fderiv_section_eq_rightFDeriv
    {A B D : Type*}
    [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A]
    [NormedAddCommGroup B] [NormedSpace ℝ B]
    [NormedAddCommGroup D] [NormedSpace ℝ D]
    {F : A × B → D} (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F) (a : A) (b : B) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun y => F (a, y)) b = rightFDeriv F (a, b)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((hF.differentiable (by simp) (a, b)).hasFDerivAt.comp b
    (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right a b)).fderiv

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.sharedAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient
statement:
theorem sharedAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (A : Cov) (u : E₂) :
    P.sharedAffineGradient (A, u) = chartGradient (P.sharedAffineHeight A) u
proof:
:= by
  unfold sharedAffineGradient chartGradient
  have h := fderiv_section_eq_rightFDeriv
    P.contDiff_sharedAffineHeightUncurried A u
  change fderiv ℝ (P.sharedAffineHeight A) u =
    rightFDeriv P.sharedAffineHeightUncurried (A, u) at h
  rw [h]

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.sharedAffineHessian_eq_fderiv_chartGradient
statement:
theorem sharedAffineHessian_eq_fderiv_chartGradient
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (A : Cov) (u : E₂) :
    P.sharedAffineHessian (A, u) =
      fderiv ℝ (chartGradient (P.sharedAffineHeight A)) u
proof:
:= by
  have h := fderiv_section_eq_rightFDeriv
    P.contDiff_sharedAffineGradient A u
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y => P.sharedAffineGradient (A, y)) u =
    P.sharedAffineHessian (A, u) at h
  have heq : (fun y => P.sharedAffineGradient (A, y)) =
      chartGradient (P.sharedAffineHeight A) := by
    funext y
    exact P.sharedAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient A y
  rw [← heq, h]

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.sharedAffineHeight_update
statement:
theorem sharedAffineHeight_update
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (A : Cov) (q u : E₂)
    (hu : u ∈ P.domain) :
    P.sharedAffineHeight (P.updateSharedCovector A q) u =
      chartLinearTilt (P.sharedAffineHeight A) q u -
        P.liftCovector q P.center
proof:
:= by
  have hlift : P.liftCovector q (P.param u) =
      (innerSL ℝ q) u + P.liftCovector q P.center := by
    calc
      P.liftCovector q (P.param u) =
          P.liftCovector q ((P.param u - P.center) + P.center) := by
            rw [sub_add_cancel]
      _ = P.liftCovector q (P.param u - P.center) +
          P.liftCovector q P.center := by rw [map_add]
      _ = (innerSL ℝ q) u + P.liftCovector q P.center := by
        rw [P.lift_param q u hu]
  simp only [sharedAffineHeight, updateSharedCovector,
    liftCovectorCLM_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, chartLinearTilt]
  rw [hlift]
  ring

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.eventuallyEq_sharedAffineHeight_update
statement:
theorem eventuallyEq_sharedAffineHeight_update
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (A : Cov) (q : E₂) {u : E₂}
    (hdom : P.domain ∈ 𝓝 u) :
    P.sharedAffineHeight (P.updateSharedCovector A q) =ᶠ[𝓝 u]
      (fun z => chartLinearTilt (P.sharedAffineHeight A) q z -
        P.liftCovector q P.center)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hdom] with z hz
  exact P.sharedAffineHeight_update A q z hz

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.sharedAffineGradient_update
statement:
theorem sharedAffineGradient_update
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (A : Cov) (q : E₂) {u : E₂}
    (hdom : P.domain ∈ 𝓝 u) :
    P.sharedAffineGradient (P.updateSharedCovector A q, u) =
      P.sharedAffineGradient (A, u) - q
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.sharedAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient,
    P.sharedAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient]
  let f : E₂ → ℝ := P.sharedAffineHeight A
  let c : ℝ := P.liftCovector q P.center
  have heq := P.eventuallyEq_sharedAffineHeight_update A q hdom
  have htilt : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (chartLinearTilt f q) :=
    contDiff_chartLinearTilt (P.contDiff_sharedAffineHeight A) q
  have hfdconst :
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => chartLinearTilt f q z - c) u =
        fderiv ℝ (chartLinearTilt f q) u := by
    exact ((htilt.differentiable (by simp) u).hasFDerivAt.sub_const c).fderiv
  calc
    chartGradient (P.sharedAffineHeight (P.updateSharedCovector A q)) u =
        chartGradient (fun z => chartLinearTilt f q z - c) u := by
          unfold chartGradient
          rw [heq.fderiv_eq]
    _ = chartGradient (chartLinearTilt f q) u := by
      unfold chartGradient
      rw [hfdconst]
    _ = chartGradient f u - q :=
      chartGradient_chartLinearTilt
        ((P.contDiff_sharedAffineHeight A).differentiable (by simp)) q u

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.eventuallyEq_sharedAffineGradient_update
statement:
theorem eventuallyEq_sharedAffineGradient_update
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (hopen : IsOpen P.domain)
    (A : Cov) (q : E₂) {u : E₂} (hu : u ∈ P.domain) :
    (fun z => P.sharedAffineGradient (P.updateSharedCovector A q, z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 u]
      (fun z => P.sharedAffineGradient (A, z) - q)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hu] with z hz
  exact P.sharedAffineGradient_update A q (hopen.mem_nhds hz)

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.sharedAffineHessian_update
statement:
theorem sharedAffineHessian_update
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (hopen : IsOpen P.domain)
    (A : Cov) (q : E₂) {u : E₂} (hu : u ∈ P.domain) :
    P.sharedAffineHessian (P.updateSharedCovector A q, u) =
      P.sharedAffineHessian (A, u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.sharedAffineHessian_eq_fderiv_chartGradient,
    P.sharedAffineHessian_eq_fderiv_chartGradient]
  have hnew :
      chartGradient (P.sharedAffineHeight (P.updateSharedCovector A q)) =
        fun z => P.sharedAffineGradient (P.updateSharedCovector A q, z) := by
    funext z
    exact (P.sharedAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient
      (P.updateSharedCovector A q) z).symm
  have hold :
      chartGradient (P.sharedAffineHeight A) =
        fun z => P.sharedAffineGradient (A, z) := by
    funext z
    exact (P.sharedAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient A z).symm
  rw [hnew, hold]
  have heq := P.eventuallyEq_sharedAffineGradient_update hopen A q hu
  rw [heq.fderiv_eq]
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun z => P.sharedAffineGradient (A, z)) :=
    P.contDiff_sharedAffineGradient.comp
      (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  exact (((hsmooth.differentiable (by simp)) u).hasFDerivAt.sub_const q).fderiv

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.sharedAffineMorseOn_update_of_regularValue
statement:
theorem sharedAffineMorseOn_update_of_regularValue
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (hopen : IsOpen P.domain)
    (A : Cov) (q : E₂)
    (hq : IsRegularValue (chartGradient (P.sharedAffineHeight A)) q)
    {K : Set E₂} (hK : K ⊆ P.domain) :
    P.SharedAffineMorseOn (P.updateSharedCovector A q) K
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  change P.sharedAffineGradient (P.updateSharedCovector A q, u) ≠ 0 ∨
    Bijective (P.sharedAffineHessian (P.updateSharedCovector A q, u))
  have huDom : u ∈ P.domain := hK hu
  by_cases hgrad :
      P.sharedAffineGradient (P.updateSharedCovector A q, u) ≠ 0
  · exact Or.inl hgrad
  · right
    have hshift := P.sharedAffineGradient_update A q
      (hopen.mem_nhds huDom)
    have hold : P.sharedAffineGradient (A, u) = q := by
      apply sub_eq_zero.mp
      rw [← hshift]
      exact not_ne_iff.mp hgrad
    have hvalue : chartGradient (P.sharedAffineHeight A) u = q := by
      rw [← P.sharedAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient]
      exact hold
    have hsurjOld : Surjective (P.sharedAffineHessian (A, u)) := by
      rw [P.sharedAffineHessian_eq_fderiv_chartGradient]
      exact hq u hvalue
    have hsurj :
        Surjective (P.sharedAffineHessian
          (P.updateSharedCovector A q, u)) := by
      rw [P.sharedAffineHessian_update hopen A q huDom]
      exact hsurjOld
    exact ⟨LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mpr hsurj, hsurj⟩

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.apply_eq_mulVec
statement:
theorem apply_eq_mulVec
    (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    (v : Fin k → ℝ) :
    A (WithLp.toLp 2 v) =
      WithLp.toLp 2 (Matrix.mulVec (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix A) v)
proof:
:= by
  conv_lhs => rw [← PolarDecompositionCLM.toEuclideanCLM_clmMatrix A]
  rfl

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.det_clmMatrix_ne_zero_of_injective
statement:
theorem det_clmMatrix_ne_zero_of_injective
    {A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (h : Function.Injective A) :
    (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix A).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hdet
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hmul⟩ :=
    (Matrix.exists_mulVec_eq_zero_iff (M := PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix A)).mpr hdet
  have hA : A (WithLp.toLp 2 v) = 0 := by
    rw [apply_eq_mulVec, hmul]
    rfl
  have h0 : A (WithLp.toLp 2 v) = A 0 := by rw [hA, map_zero]
  have := h h0
  apply hv
  have hcoe := congrArg (WithLp.ofLp (p := 2)) this
  simpa using hcoe

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.isUnit_of_det_clmMatrix_ne_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hM : IsUnit (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix A) :=
    (Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mpr (isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr h)
  have hmap := hM.map (Matrix.toEuclideanCLM (n := Fin k) (𝕜 := ℝ))
  rwa [PolarDecompositionCLM.toEuclideanCLM_clmMatrix] at hmap

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.isUnit_of_injective
proof:
:=
  isUnit_of_det_clmMatrix_ne_zero (det_clmMatrix_ne_zero_of_injective h)

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.contDiff_fderiv
statement:
theorem contDiff_fderiv (X : FramedLevelSet n) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x => fderiv ℝ X.g x
proof:
:=
  X.smooth.fderiv_right (by simp)

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.contDiff_coDeriv
statement:
theorem contDiff_coDeriv (X : FramedLevelSet n) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (coDeriv X)
proof:
:= by
  refine ContDiff.sum fun i _ => ?_
  exact contDiff_const.smulRight (contDiff_gradVec X.g X.smooth i)

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.inner_coDeriv
statement:
theorem inner_coDeriv (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ⟪coDeriv X x w, v⟫ = ⟪w, fderiv ℝ X.g x v⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [coDeriv, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, sum_inner]
  have hterm : ∀ i : Fin n,
      ⟪((EuclideanSpace.proj i).smulRight (gradVec X.g i x)) w, v⟫
        = WithLp.ofLp w i * WithLp.ofLp (fderiv ℝ X.g x v) i := by
    intro i
    show ⟪(EuclideanSpace.proj (𝕜 := ℝ) i) w • gradVec X.g i x, v⟫ = _
    rw [real_inner_smul_left, inner_gradVec]
    rfl
  simp_rw [hterm]
  simp [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, mul_comm]

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.contDiff_gram
statement: theorem contDiff_gram (X : FramedLevelSet n) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (gram X)
proof:
:=
  (contDiff_fderiv X).clm_comp (contDiff_coDeriv X)

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.inner_gram_self
statement:
theorem inner_gram_self (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    ⟪w, gram X x w⟫ = ‖coDeriv X x w‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hstep : ⟪w, gram X x w⟫ =
      ⟪coDeriv X x w, coDeriv X x w⟫ := (inner_coDeriv X x w (coDeriv X x w)).symm
  rw [hstep, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.coDeriv_injective
statement:
theorem coDeriv_injective (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hx : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ X.g x)) :
    Function.Injective (coDeriv X x)
proof:
:= by
  intro w₁ w₂ hw
  have hzero : coDeriv X x (w₁ - w₂) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hw, sub_self]
  have hall : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), ⟪w₁ - w₂, u⟫ = 0 := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hx u
    rw [← hv, ← inner_coDeriv X x (w₁ - w₂) v, hzero, inner_zero_left]
  have := hall (w₁ - w₂)
  rw [inner_self_eq_zero] at this
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp this

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.gram_injective
statement:
theorem gram_injective (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hx : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ X.g x)) :
    Function.Injective (gram X x)
proof:
:= by
  intro w₁ w₂ hw
  have hzero : gram X x (w₁ - w₂) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hw, sub_self]
  have hns : ‖coDeriv X x (w₁ - w₂)‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    rw [← inner_gram_self X x (w₁ - w₂), hzero, inner_zero_right]
  have hcd : coDeriv X x (w₁ - w₂) = 0 := by
    have : ‖coDeriv X x (w₁ - w₂)‖ = 0 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (coDeriv X x (w₁ - w₂))]
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp this
  have h0 : coDeriv X x (w₁ - w₂) = coDeriv X x 0 := by rw [hcd, map_zero]
  have := coDeriv_injective X hx h0
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp this

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.isUnit_gram
proof:
:=
  isUnit_of_injective (gram_injective X hx)

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.contDiffOn_transition
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_transition (X Y : FramedLevelSet n) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (transition X Y) (unitSet X)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hinv : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => Ring.inverse (gram X y)) x := by
    have hu : IsUnit (gram X x) := hx
    have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (Ring.inverse :
        (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) →
          (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
        (gram X x) := by
      have := contDiffAt_ringInverse (𝕜 := ℝ) (n := (∞ : WithTop ℕ∞)) hu.unit
      rwa [hu.unit_spec] at this
    exact h1.comp x (contDiff_gram X).contDiffAt
  exact (((contDiff_fderiv Y).contDiffAt.clm_comp
    ((contDiff_coDeriv X).contDiffAt.clm_comp hinv))).contDiffWithinAt

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.transition_comp
statement:
theorem transition_comp (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hu : IsUnit (gram X p))
    (hker : ∀ w, fderiv ℝ X.g p w = 0 → fderiv ℝ Y.g p w = 0) :
    (transition X Y p).comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p) = fderiv ℝ Y.g p
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun v => ?_
  set u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) :=
    coDeriv X p (Ring.inverse (gram X p) (fderiv ℝ X.g p v)) with hu_def
  have hDXu : fderiv ℝ X.g p u = fderiv ℝ X.g p v := by
    have hmul : gram X p * Ring.inverse (gram X p) = 1 :=
      Ring.mul_inverse_cancel _ hu
    have h1 : (gram X p * Ring.inverse (gram X p)) (fderiv ℝ X.g p v)
        = fderiv ℝ X.g p v := by
      rw [hmul]
      rfl
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply] at h1
    exact h1
  have hsub : fderiv ℝ X.g p (v - u) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hDXu, sub_self]
  have hY := hker _ hsub
  rw [map_sub, sub_eq_zero] at hY
  show fderiv ℝ Y.g p u = fderiv ℝ Y.g p v
  exact hY.symm

name: Submission.TransitionPseudoInverse.fderiv_eq_zero_of_ker
statement:
theorem fderiv_eq_zero_of_ker (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ X.g p))
    (t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (ht : t ≠ 0)
    (hXt : fderiv ℝ X.g p t = 0) (hYt : fderiv ℝ Y.g p t = 0) :
    ∀ w, fderiv ℝ X.g p w = 0 → fderiv ℝ Y.g p w = 0
proof:
:= by
  set L : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →ₗ[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    (fderiv ℝ X.g p).toLinearMap with hL
  have hrange : LinearMap.range L = ⊤ := LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj
  have hdim := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker L
  have hE : Module.finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) = n + 1 := by
    simp
  have hF : Module.finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = n := by simp
  have hrk : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.range L) = n := by
    rw [hrange]
    rw [finrank_top]
    exact hF
  have hker : Module.finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker L) = 1 := by
    rw [hrk, hE] at hdim
    omega
  have hmemt : t ∈ LinearMap.ker L := hXt
  have hle : (ℝ ∙ t) ≤ LinearMap.ker L := by
    rw [Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem]
    exact hmemt
  have hspan : Module.finrank ℝ (ℝ ∙ t) = 1 := finrank_span_singleton ht
  have heq : (ℝ ∙ t) = LinearMap.ker L :=
    Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hle (by rw [hspan, hker])
  intro w hw
  have hwmem : w ∈ LinearMap.ker L := hw
  rw [← heq] at hwmem
  obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hwmem
  rw [map_smul, hYt, smul_zero]

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_paramCapture_positiveEnd
statement:
theorem exists_paramCapture_positiveEnd
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} {d : ℝ}
    (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ criticalSliceExteriorCore
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
      (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
      (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) (D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2))
    (hx₀eq : x₀ = (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
      (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)))
    (hd : |d| ≤ D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) :
    ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht ∧
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u =
        (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀ d
proof:
:= by
  have hfib : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x₀ = 0 :=
    ((mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore _ _ _ _ _).mp hx₀).1
  have hd' : |d| ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime :=
    hd.trans (D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
  have hmove : dist x₀ ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd
      p.1 p.2 (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) ≤
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
    rw [hx₀eq]
    calc dist ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow _
          (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))) _
        = dist ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow _
            (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)))
          ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow _ 0) := by
          rw [(D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow_zero]
      _ ≤ ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          |(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) - 0| :=
        (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.dist_flow_self_le _ _ _
      _ = ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
          rw [sub_zero, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  have hclose : dist x₀
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |d| <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht) p := by
    have h0 := D.bandCaptureScale_positive_close t ht p
    have htri := dist_triangle x₀
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    have hb2 : ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |d| ≤
        ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd
        (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound.coe_nonneg
    linarith
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup, -, -⟩ :=
    D.exists_saddleEndpointLevelParamCapture t ht hindex
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht)
      (D.bandTimeField t ht) p hx₀ hfib hd' hclose
  exact ⟨u, hu, hup⟩

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_paramCapture_negativeEnd
statement:
theorem exists_paramCapture_negativeEnd
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} {d : ℝ}
    (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ criticalSliceExteriorCore
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
      (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
      (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) (D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2))
    (hx₀eq : x₀ = (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
      (-(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))))
    (hd : |d| ≤ D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) :
    ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht ∧
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u =
        (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀ d
proof:
:= by
  have hfib : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x₀ = 0 :=
    ((mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore _ _ _ _ _).mp hx₀).1
  have hd' : |d| ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime :=
    hd.trans (D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
  have hmove : dist x₀ ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd
      p.2 p.1 (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) ≤
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
    rw [hx₀eq]
    calc dist ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow _
          (-(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)))) _
        = dist ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow _
            (-(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))))
          ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow _ 0) := by
          rw [(D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow_zero]
      _ ≤ ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          |(-(-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))) - 0| :=
        (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.dist_flow_self_le _ _ _
      _ = ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 := by
          rw [sub_zero, neg_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  have hclose : dist x₀
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |d| <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht) p := by
    have h0 := D.bandCaptureScale_negative_close t ht p
    have htri := dist_triangle x₀
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    have hb2 : ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |d| ≤
        ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) *
          D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hd
        (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound.coe_nonneg
    linarith
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup, -, -⟩ :=
    D.exists_saddleEndpointLevelParamCapture t ht hindex
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht)
      (D.bandTimeField t ht) p hx₀ hfib hd' hclose
  exact ⟨u, hu, hup⟩

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.mem_segment_and_ne_boundaryEnd_of_paramCapture_negative
statement:
theorem mem_segment_and_ne_boundaryEnd_of_paramCapture_negative
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (Vneg : TamedField
      ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeSlice
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))))
    (hne : (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht)) Vneg ≠
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht)) Vneg)
    (b : SaddleBranch) {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
    (hu : ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
    (hup : (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u =
      cobSpaceTime y (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) -
        D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))
    (horb : y ∈ (((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht)) Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
      Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) :
    y ∈ Set.range ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.shortScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)) ∧
    ∀ e : SaddleBranch, y ≠ spacePart
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b e
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  have hρ' : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht
  have hs' : D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
    D.shortScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht hb hbw
  have hρ'rad : D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht <
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  have huM : ‖u‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    (hu.trans hρ'rad).trans_le
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hspace : spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u) = y := by
    rw [hup, spacePart_spaceTime]
  have hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) =
      -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) := by
    have htime := (D.position.eventModel t ht).time_model u huM
    rw [hup, tcoord_spaceTime, hindex] at htime
    linarith
  constructor
  · have hmem := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).spacePart_param_mem_own_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment hindex b
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ' hb hs' hρ'rad
      (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg hne u hquad hu.le
      (by rw [hspace]; exact horb)
    rwa [hspace] at hmem
  · intro e
    have hne' := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).spacePart_param_ne_saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_of_norm_lt hindex
      (b, e) (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
      (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ' hs' hρ'rad u hquad hu
    rwa [hspace] at hne'

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.FixedOn.conjugateByEndpoint_of_fixedOn
statement:
theorem FixedOn.conjugateByEndpoint_of_fixedOn
    {A B : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n} {K : Set E}
    (hB : B.FixedOn K) (hA : A.FixedOn K) :
    (B.conjugateByEndpoint A).FixedOn K
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs x hx
  rw [conjugateByEndpoint_forward,
    hA.inverse_eq (s := (1 : ℝ)) ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ hx,
    hB s hs x hx,
    hA 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ x hx]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointFoldFrom_fixedOn
statement:
theorem endpointFoldFrom_fixedOn {K : Set E}
    (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n) (moves : List (SmoothAmbientIsotopy n))
    (hA : A.FixedOn K) (hMoves : ∀ B ∈ moves, B.FixedOn K) :
    (endpointFoldFrom A moves).FixedOn K
proof:
:= by
  induction moves generalizing A with
  | nil => simpa using hA
  | cons B tail ih =>
      rw [endpointFoldFrom_cons]
      apply ih
      · exact hA.followedBy
          ((hMoves B (by simp)).conjugateByEndpoint_of_fixedOn hA)
      · intro C hC
        exact hMoves C (List.mem_cons_of_mem B hC)

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointFold_fixedOn
statement:
theorem endpointFold_fixedOn {K : Set E}
    (moves : List (SmoothAmbientIsotopy n))
    (hMoves : ∀ B ∈ moves, B.FixedOn K) :
    (endpointFold moves).FixedOn K
proof:
:= by
  exact endpointFoldFrom_fixedOn (refl n) moves (fixedOn_refl K) hMoves

name: Submission.TamedField.OriginalTubeNormalGraphMover.transportedSchedule_fixedOn_commonExterior

statement:
theorem transportedSchedule_forward_eq_self_of_mem_commonExterior
    (moves : List V.OriginalTubeNormalGraphMover)

    {x : E} (hx : x ∈ commonExterior moves) :
    (transportedSchedule moves).forward s x = x
proof:

  transportedSchedule_fixedOn_commonExterior moves s hs x hx
