name: Submission.birthHeight_eq_linear
statement:
lemma birthHeight_eq_linear {t : ℝ} (ht₀ : 3 / 8 ≤ t) (ht₁ : t ≤ 5 / 8) :
    birthHeight t = t - 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [birthHeight]
  split_ifs
  · exact birthHeightLeft_eq_linear ht₀
  · exact birthHeightRight_eq_linear ht₁

name: Submission.contDiff_birthHeight
statement: theorem contDiff_birthHeight : ContDiff ℝ ∞ birthHeight
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro t
  rcases lt_trichotomy t (1 / 2) with ht | ht | ht
  · refine contDiff_birthHeightLeft.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Iio_mem_nhds ht) fun s hs => by
      change s < 1 / 2 at hs
      simp only [birthHeight, if_pos hs]
  · have hlinear : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => s - 1 / 2) :=
      contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const
    refine hlinear.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    have hmem : t ∈ Set.Ioo (3 / 8 : ℝ) (5 / 8 : ℝ) := by
      rw [ht]
      norm_num
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds hmem) fun s hs => by
      rw [birthHeight_eq_linear hs.1.le hs.2.le]
  · refine contDiff_birthHeightRight.contDiffAt.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_
    exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (Ioi_mem_nhds ht) fun s hs => by
      rw [birthHeight, if_neg (not_lt.mpr hs.le)]

name: Submission.birthHeight_of_le_quarter
statement:
lemma birthHeight_of_le_quarter {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 4) :
    birthHeight t = -1
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : t < 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hcut : birthLeftCutoff t = 0 := by
    apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
    linarith
  rw [birthHeight, if_pos hhalf, birthHeightLeft, hcut]
  ring

name: Submission.birthHeight_of_threeQuarter_le
statement:
lemma birthHeight_of_threeQuarter_le {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t) :
    birthHeight t = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hhalf : ¬t < 1 / 2 := by linarith
  have hcut : birthRightCutoff t = 1 := by
    apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
    linarith
  rw [birthHeight, if_neg hhalf, birthHeightRight, hcut]
  ring

name: Submission.birthHeight_neg_of_lt_half
statement:
lemma birthHeight_neg_of_lt_half {t : ℝ} (ht : t < 1 / 2) :
    birthHeight t < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [birthHeight, if_pos ht, birthHeightLeft]
  have hc0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (8 * (t - 1 / 4))
  have hc1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (8 * (t - 1 / 4))
  change (1 - birthLeftCutoff t) * (-1) + birthLeftCutoff t * (t - 1 / 2) < 0
  have htlin : t - 1 / 2 < 0 := sub_neg.mpr ht
  by_cases hc : birthLeftCutoff t = 1
  · rw [hc]
    simpa using htlin
  · have hc' : birthLeftCutoff t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hc1 hc
    have hfirst : (1 - birthLeftCutoff t) * (-1) < 0 := by
      exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (sub_pos.mpr hc') (by norm_num)
    have hsecond : birthLeftCutoff t * (t - 1 / 2) ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hc0 htlin.le
    linarith

name: Submission.birthHeight_pos_of_half_lt
statement:
lemma birthHeight_pos_of_half_lt {t : ℝ} (ht : 1 / 2 < t) :
    0 < birthHeight t
proof:
:= by
  rw [birthHeight, if_neg (not_lt.mpr ht.le), birthHeightRight]
  have hc0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (8 * (t - 5 / 8))
  have hc1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (8 * (t - 5 / 8))
  change 0 < (1 - birthRightCutoff t) * (t - 1 / 2) + birthRightCutoff t
  have htlin : 0 < t - 1 / 2 := sub_pos.mpr ht
  by_cases hc : birthRightCutoff t = 1
  · rw [hc]
    norm_num
  · have hc' : birthRightCutoff t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne hc1 hc
    have hc0' : 0 ≤ birthRightCutoff t := hc0
    have hfirst : 0 < (1 - birthRightCutoff t) * (t - 1 / 2) :=
      mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hc') htlin
    linarith

name: Submission.birthHeight_half
statement: @[simp] lemma birthHeight_half : birthHeight (1 / 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [birthHeight_eq_linear (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
  ring

name: Submission.birthHeight_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem birthHeight_eq_zero_iff {t : ℝ} :
    birthHeight t = 0 ↔ t = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases lt_trichotomy t (1 / 2) with ht | ht | ht
    · exact False.elim ((birthHeight_neg_of_lt_half ht).ne h)
    · exact ht
    · exact False.elim ((birthHeight_pos_of_half_lt ht).ne' h)
  · rintro rfl
    exact birthHeight_half

name: Submission.hasDerivAt_birthHeight_half
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_birthHeight_half :
    HasDerivAt birthHeight 1 (1 / 2)
proof:
:= by
  apply (hasDerivAt_id (1 / 2)).sub_const (1 / 2) |>.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
    (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds (show (1 / 2 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (3 / 8) (5 / 8) by norm_num))
    fun t ht => birthHeight_eq_linear ht.1.le ht.2.le

name: Submission.StandardBirth.circleMap_apply_last
statement:
@[simp] lemma circleMap_apply_last (a : ℝ) (x : E) :
    circleMap m a x (Fin.last m) = radialSq m x - a
proof:
:= by
  simp [circleMap]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.circleMap_apply_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma circleMap_apply_castSucc (a : ℝ) (x : E) (j : Fin m) :
    circleMap m a x j.castSucc = x j.castSucc.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  simp [circleMap]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.contDiff_radialSq
statement: lemma contDiff_radialSq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (radialSq m)
proof:
:= by
  exact (((EuclideanSpace.proj (radialFirst m) : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.pow 2).add
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj (radialSecond m) : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.pow 2))

name: Submission.StandardBirth.contDiff_circleMap
statement: lemma contDiff_circleMap (a : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (circleMap m a)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => simpa using (contDiff_radialSq m).sub contDiff_const
  | cast j =>
      simpa using
        (EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc.castSucc : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff

name: Submission.StandardBirth.eventMap_spaceTime
statement:
lemma eventMap_spaceTime (x : E) (t : ℝ) :
    eventMap m (spaceTime x t) = circleMap m (birthHeight t) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eventMap, initCLM_spaceTime, vertC_spaceTime]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.contDiff_eventMap
statement: lemma contDiff_eventMap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (eventMap m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      simp only [eventMap, circleMap_apply_last, radialSq]
      exact ((((EuclideanSpace.proj ((radialFirst m).castSucc) : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.pow 2).add
        ((EuclideanSpace.proj ((radialSecond m).castSucc) : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.pow 2)).sub
          (contDiff_birthHeight.comp contDiff_vertC))
  | cast j =>
      simp only [eventMap, circleMap_apply_castSucc, initCLM_apply]
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff

name: Submission.StandardBirth.eventMap_collar_zero
statement:
lemma eventMap_collar_zero (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 4) :
    eventMap m (spaceTime x t) = circleMap m (-1) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eventMap_spaceTime, birthHeight_of_le_quarter ht]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.eventMap_collar_one
statement:
lemma eventMap_collar_one (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t) :
    eventMap m (spaceTime x t) = circleMap m 1 x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eventMap_spaceTime, birthHeight_of_threeQuarter_le ht]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.transverse_eq_zero_of_eventMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q : F => q j.castSucc) hv
  simpa [eventMap] using h

name: Submission.StandardBirth.radialSq_eq_birthHeight_of_eventMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma radialSq_eq_birthHeight_of_eventMap_eq_zero {v : E'}
    (hv : eventMap m v = 0) :
    (v (radialFirst m).castSucc) ^ 2 +
      (v (radialSecond m).castSucc) ^ 2 = birthHeight (vertC v)
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q : F => q (Fin.last m)) hv
  simp only [eventMap, circleMap_apply_last, radialSq, PiLp.zero_apply,
    initCLM_apply] at h
  linarith

name: Submission.StandardBirth.fderiv_eventMap_apply_castSucc
statement:
lemma fderiv_eventMap_apply_castSucc (v h : E') (j : Fin m) :
    fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h j.castSucc =
      h j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc
  let inProj : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    EuclideanSpace.proj j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc
  have hG : HasFDerivAt (eventMap m) (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v) v :=
    ((contDiff_eventMap m).differentiable infty_ne_zero v).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun w => eventMap m w j.castSucc)
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v)) v := by
    exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (eventMap m v) j.castSucc).comp v hG
  have hcoord : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E' => w j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc)
      inProj v := inProj.hasFDerivAt
  have hfun : (fun w => eventMap m w j.castSucc) =
      fun w : E' => w j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc := by
    funext w
    simp [eventMap]
  have hmaps : outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v) = inProj := by
    rw [← hcomp.fderiv, hfun, hcoord.fderiv]
  have happ := congrArg (fun A : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ => A h) hmaps
  exact happ

name: Submission.StandardBirth.fderiv_eventMap_apply_last
statement:
lemma fderiv_eventMap_apply_last (v h : E') :
    fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h (Fin.last m) =
      2 * v (radialFirst m).castSucc * h (radialFirst m).castSucc +
        2 * v (radialSecond m).castSucc * h (radialSecond m).castSucc -
          deriv birthHeight (vertC v) * h (Fin.last (m + 2))
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last m)
  have hG : HasFDerivAt (eventMap m) (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v) v :=
    ((contDiff_eventMap m).differentiable infty_ne_zero v).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun w => eventMap m w (Fin.last m))
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v)) v := by
    exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (eventMap m v) (Fin.last m)).comp v hG
  have hfun : (fun w => eventMap m w (Fin.last m)) = fun w : E' =>
      w (radialFirst m).castSucc ^ 2 + w (radialSecond m).castSucc ^ 2 -
        birthHeight (vertC w) := by
    funext w
    simp [eventMap, radialSq]
  have happ := congrArg (fun A : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ => A h) hcomp.fderiv.symm
  rw [hfun] at happ
  let pA : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (radialFirst m).castSucc
  let pB : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (radialSecond m).castSucc
  let pT : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (m + 2))
  have hA := (pA.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt pA pA v).pow 2
  have hB := (pB.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt pB pB v).pow 2
  have hb : HasDerivAt birthHeight (deriv birthHeight (vertC v)) (vertC v) :=
    (contDiff_birthHeight.differentiable infty_ne_zero (vertC v)).hasDerivAt
  have hT := hb.hasFDerivAt.comp v
    (pT.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt pT pT v)
  have hdirect := (hA.add hB).sub hT
  have hscalarEq :
      (((fun x => pA x ^ 2) + fun x => pB x ^ 2) - birthHeight ∘ vertC) =
        (fun w : E' =>
          w (radialFirst m).castSucc ^ 2 + w (radialSecond m).castSucc ^ 2 -
            birthHeight (vertC w)) := by
    funext w
    rfl
  rw [hscalarEq] at hdirect
  rw [hdirect.fderiv] at happ
  simpa [outProj, pA, pB, pT, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using happ

name: Submission.StandardBirth.transverseLift_apply_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma transverseLift_apply_castSucc (y : F) (j : Fin m) :
    transverseLift m y j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc = y j.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  simp [transverseLift, Pi.single_apply]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.transverseLift_apply_radialFirst
statement:
@[simp] lemma transverseLift_apply_radialFirst (y : F) :
    transverseLift m y (radialFirst m).castSucc = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [transverseLift, Pi.single_apply, radialFirst, Fin.ext_iff]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  rw [if_neg]
  omega

name: Submission.StandardBirth.transverseLift_apply_radialSecond
statement:
@[simp] lemma transverseLift_apply_radialSecond (y : F) :
    transverseLift m y (radialSecond m).castSucc = 0
proof:

  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  rw [if_neg]
  omega

name: Submission.StandardBirth.transverseLift_apply_time
statement:
@[simp] lemma transverseLift_apply_time (y : F) :
    transverseLift m y (Fin.last (m + 2)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [transverseLift, Pi.single_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
  apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
  intro j _
  rw [if_neg]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.transverseIndex_lt_radialFirst
statement:
lemma transverseIndex_lt_radialFirst (j : Fin m) :
    j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc < (radialFirst m).castSucc
proof:
:= by
  change j.val < m
  exact j.isLt

name: Submission.StandardBirth.radialFirst_lt_radialSecond
statement:
lemma radialFirst_lt_radialSecond :
    (radialFirst m).castSucc < (radialSecond m).castSucc
proof:
:= by
  change m < m + 1
  omega

name: Submission.StandardBirth.radialSecond_lt_time
statement:
lemma radialSecond_lt_time :
    (radialSecond m).castSucc < Fin.last (m + 2)
proof:
:= by
  change m + 1 < m + 2
  omega

name: Submission.StandardBirth.eventMap_regular
statement:
theorem eventMap_regular (v : E') (hv : eventMap m v = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  by_cases ha : v (radialFirst m).castSucc ≠ 0
  · let h : E' := transverseLift m y +
        EuclideanSpace.single (radialFirst m).castSucc
          (y (Fin.last m) / (2 * v (radialFirst m).castSucc))
    refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext i
    induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | cast j =>
        change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h j.castSucc = y j.castSucc
        rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_castSucc]
        have hjA : j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc ≠ (radialFirst m).castSucc :=
          (transverseIndex_lt_radialFirst m j).ne
        simp [h, hjA]
    | last =>
        change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h (Fin.last m) = y (Fin.last m)
        rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_last]
        simp only [h, PiLp.add_apply, transverseLift_apply_radialFirst,
          transverseLift_apply_radialSecond, transverseLift_apply_time,
          PiLp.single_apply]
        have hBA : (radialSecond m).castSucc ≠ (radialFirst m).castSucc :=
          (radialFirst_lt_radialSecond m).ne'
        have hTA : Fin.last (m + 2) ≠ (radialFirst m).castSucc :=
          ((radialFirst_lt_radialSecond m).trans (radialSecond_lt_time m)).ne'
        simp [hBA, hTA]
        field_simp [ha]
  · by_cases hb : v (radialSecond m).castSucc ≠ 0
    · let h : E' := transverseLift m y +
          EuclideanSpace.single (radialSecond m).castSucc
            (y (Fin.last m) / (2 * v (radialSecond m).castSucc))
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
      funext i
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | cast j =>
          change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h j.castSucc = y j.castSucc
          rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_castSucc]
          have hjB : j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc ≠ (radialSecond m).castSucc :=
            ((transverseIndex_lt_radialFirst m j).trans
              (radialFirst_lt_radialSecond m)).ne
          simp [h, hjB]
      | last =>
          change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h (Fin.last m) = y (Fin.last m)
          rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_last]
          simp only [h, PiLp.add_apply, transverseLift_apply_radialFirst,
            transverseLift_apply_radialSecond, transverseLift_apply_time,
            PiLp.single_apply]
          have hAB : (radialFirst m).castSucc ≠ (radialSecond m).castSucc :=
            (radialFirst_lt_radialSecond m).ne
          have hTB : Fin.last (m + 2) ≠ (radialSecond m).castSucc :=
            (radialSecond_lt_time m).ne'
          simp [hAB, hTB]
          field_simp [hb]
    · have ht : vertC v = 1 / 2 := by
        apply birthHeight_eq_zero_iff.mp
        have hr := radialSq_eq_birthHeight_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv
        rw [not_ne_iff.mp ha, not_ne_iff.mp hb] at hr
        norm_num at hr ⊢
        exact hr.symm
      let h : E' := transverseLift m y +
        EuclideanSpace.single (Fin.last (m + 2)) (-y (Fin.last m))
      refine ⟨h, ?_⟩
      apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
      funext i
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | cast j =>
          change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h j.castSucc = y j.castSucc
          rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_castSucc]
          have hjT : j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc ≠ Fin.last (m + 2) :=
            ((transverseIndex_lt_radialFirst m j).trans
              ((radialFirst_lt_radialSecond m).trans (radialSecond_lt_time m))).ne
          simp [h, hjT]
      | last =>
          change fderiv ℝ (eventMap m) v h (Fin.last m) = y (Fin.last m)
          rw [fderiv_eventMap_apply_last]
          simp only [h, PiLp.add_apply, transverseLift_apply_radialFirst,
            transverseLift_apply_radialSecond, transverseLift_apply_time,
            PiLp.single_apply]
          rw [not_ne_iff.mp ha, not_ne_iff.mp hb, ht,
            hasDerivAt_birthHeight_half.deriv]
          simp [radialFirst, radialSecond, Fin.ext_iff]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.eventMap_spatial_bound_one
statement:
lemma eventMap_spatial_bound_one (v : E') (hv : eventMap m v = 0) :
    ‖initCLM (m + 2) v‖ ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  have hr := radialSq_eq_birthHeight_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv
  have hheight : birthHeight (vertC v) ≤ 1 := by
    by_cases ht : vertC v < 1 / 2
    · exact (birthHeight_neg_of_lt_half ht).le.trans (by norm_num)
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le (not_lt.mp ht) with heq | hgt
      · rw [← heq]
        rw [birthHeight_half]
        norm_num
      · rw [birthHeight, if_neg (not_lt.mpr hgt.le), birthHeightRight]
        have hc0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (8 * (vertC v - 5 / 8))
        have hc1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (8 * (vertC v - 5 / 8))
        change (1 - birthRightCutoff (vertC v)) * (vertC v - 1 / 2) +
          birthRightCutoff (vertC v) ≤ 1
        by_cases ht1 : vertC v ≤ 3 / 4
        · have hlin : vertC v - 1 / 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith
          have hc0' : 0 ≤ birthRightCutoff (vertC v) := hc0
          have hc1' : birthRightCutoff (vertC v) ≤ 1 := hc1
          nlinarith
        · rw [birthRightCutoff]
          rw [Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith)]
          norm_num
  have hnormsq : ‖initCLM (m + 2) v‖ ^ 2 =
      (v (radialFirst m).castSucc) ^ 2 +
        (v (radialSecond m).castSucc) ^ 2 := by
    rw [norm_sq_eq_sum]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [initCLM_apply]
    have hz : ∀ j : Fin m, v j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc ^ 2 = 0 :=
      fun j => by rw [transverse_eq_zero_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv j, zero_pow (by norm_num)]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
    rfl
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (initCLM (m + 2) v), sq_nonneg (v (radialFirst m).castSucc),
    sq_nonneg (v (radialSecond m).castSucc)]

name: Submission.StandardBirth.eventMap_spatial_bounded
statement:
lemma eventMap_spatial_bounded :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ v, eventMap m v = 0 → ‖initCLM (m + 2) v‖ ≤ R
proof:
:=
  ⟨1, eventMap_spatial_bound_one m⟩

statement:
theorem nonempty_signedBirthCobordism :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (sourceSign m) (targetSign m))
proof:
:=
  ⟨signedCobordism m⟩

name: Submission.StandardBirth.nonempty_signedDeathCobordism
statement:
theorem nonempty_signedDeathCobordism :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (targetSign m) (sourceSign m))
proof:
:=
  ⟨signedDeathCobordism m⟩

name: Submission.exists_standardSignedBirth
statement:
theorem exists_standardSignedBirth (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ X₀ : FramedLevelSet n, ∃ X₁ : FramedLevelSet n,
      ∃ S₀ : FiberSign X₀, ∃ S₁ : FiberSign X₁,
        Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
proof:
:= by
  cases n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m =>
      exact ⟨StandardBirth.sourceFLS m, StandardBirth.targetFLS m,
        StandardBirth.sourceSign m, StandardBirth.targetSign m,
        StandardBirth.nonempty_signedBirthCobordism m⟩

name: Submission.sep_dist_right
statement:
theorem sep_dist_right (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hv : dist v p₁ ≤ R₁) :
    R₂ < dist v p₂
proof:
:= by
  have htri := dist_triangle p₁ v p₂
  rw [dist_comm p₁ v] at htri
  linarith

name: Submission.sep_dist_left
statement:
theorem sep_dist_left (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hv : dist v p₂ ≤ R₂) :
    R₁ < dist v p₁
proof:
:= by
  have htri := dist_triangle p₁ v p₂
  rw [dist_comm p₁ v] at htri
  linarith

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.FlatOutside.mono
statement:
theorem FlatOutside.mono {X : FramedLevelSet n} (h : X.FlatOutside c p R)
    {R' : ℝ} (hR : R ≤ R') : X.FlatOutside c p R'
proof:
:=
  fun v hv => h v (hR.trans hv)

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.FlatOutside.fiber_subset_ball
statement:
theorem FlatOutside.fiber_subset_ball {X : FramedLevelSet n}
    (h : X.FlatOutside c p R) (hc : c ≠ 0) : X.fiber ⊆ Metric.ball p R
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [Metric.mem_ball]
  by_contra hlt
  have hcv := h v (not_lt.mp hlt)
  have hv0 : X.g v = 0 := hv
  exact hc (hcv.symm.trans hv0)

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.juxtMap_eq_left
proof:
:= by
  rw [juxtMap, h₂ v hv, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.juxtMap_eq_right
proof:
:= by
  rw [juxtMap, h₁ v hv, add_sub_cancel_left]

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.juxtMap_zero_cases
statement:
theorem juxtMap_zero_cases (X₁ X₂ : FramedLevelSet n) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂) {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hv : juxtMap X₁ X₂ c v = 0) :
    (dist v p₁ < R₁ ∧ X₁.g v = 0) ∨ (dist v p₂ < R₂ ∧ X₂.g v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hd₁ : dist v p₁ < R₁
  · refine Or.inl ⟨hd₁, ?_⟩
    rw [← juxtMap_eq_left X₁ X₂ h₂ (sep_dist_right hsep hd₁.le).le]
    exact hv
  · have hg₂ : X₂.g v = 0 := by
      rw [← juxtMap_eq_right X₁ X₂ h₁ (not_lt.mp hd₁)]
      exact hv
    refine Or.inr ⟨?_, hg₂⟩
    by_contra hd₂
    exact hc ((h₂ v (not_lt.mp hd₂)).symm.trans hg₂)

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose
statement:
theorem fiber_juxtapose (X₁ X₂ : FramedLevelSet n) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂) :
    (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).fiber = X₁.fiber ∪ X₂.fiber
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hv' : juxtMap X₁ X₂ c v = 0 := hv
    rcases juxtMap_zero_cases X₁ X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep hv' with ⟨-, hg⟩ | ⟨-, hg⟩
    · exact Set.mem_union_left _ hg
    · exact Set.mem_union_right _ hg
  · intro hv
    rcases hv with hv | hv
    · have hd : dist v p₁ < R₁ :=
        Metric.mem_ball.mp (h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc hv)
      show juxtMap X₁ X₂ c v = 0
      rw [juxtMap_eq_left X₁ X₂ h₂ (sep_dist_right hsep hd.le).le]
      exact hv
    · have hd : dist v p₂ < R₂ :=
        Metric.mem_ball.mp (h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc hv)
      show juxtMap X₁ X₂ c v = 0
      rw [juxtMap_eq_right X₁ X₂ h₁ (sep_dist_left hsep hd.le).le]
      exact hv

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.flatOutside_juxtapose
statement:
theorem flatOutside_juxtapose (X₁ X₂ : FramedLevelSet n) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂) (hR₂ : 0 ≤ R₂) :
    (X₁.juxtapose X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).FlatOutside c p₁ (dist p₁ p₂ + R₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hd₁ : R₁ ≤ dist v p₁ := by linarith
  have hd₂ : R₂ ≤ dist v p₂ := by
    have htri := dist_triangle v p₂ p₁
    rw [dist_comm p₂ p₁] at htri
    linarith
  show juxtMap X₁ X₂ c v = c
  rw [juxtMap, h₁ v hd₁, h₂ v hd₂, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Submission.sepWeight_denom_pos
statement:
theorem sepWeight_denom_pos (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    0 < max (dist v p₁ - R₁) 0 + max (dist v p₂ - R₂) 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h1 : dist v p₁ ≤ R₁
  · have h2 : R₂ < dist v p₂ := sep_dist_right hsep h1
    have hb : 0 < max (dist v p₂ - R₂) 0 :=
      lt_max_iff.mpr (Or.inl (by linarith))
    have ha : 0 ≤ max (dist v p₁ - R₁) 0 := le_max_right _ _
    linarith
  · have h1' : R₁ < dist v p₁ := not_le.mp h1
    have ha : 0 < max (dist v p₁ - R₁) 0 :=
      lt_max_iff.mpr (Or.inl (by linarith))
    have hb : 0 ≤ max (dist v p₂ - R₂) 0 := le_max_right _ _
    linarith

name: Submission.sepWeight_eq_one
statement:
theorem sepWeight_eq_one (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hv : dist v p₁ ≤ R₁) :
    sepWeight p₁ p₂ R₁ R₂ v = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : R₂ < dist v p₂ := sep_dist_right hsep hv
  have ha : max (dist v p₁ - R₁) 0 = 0 := max_eq_right (by linarith)
  rw [sepWeight, ha, zero_add, div_self]
  exact ne_of_gt (lt_max_iff.mpr (Or.inl (by linarith)))

name: Submission.sepWeight_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sepWeight_eq_zero {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hv : dist v p₂ ≤ R₂) : sepWeight p₁ p₂ R₁ R₂ v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hb : max (dist v p₂ - R₂) 0 = 0 := max_eq_right (by linarith)
  rw [sepWeight, hb, zero_div]

name: Submission.continuous_sepWeight
statement:
theorem continuous_sepWeight (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂) :
    Continuous (sepWeight p₁ p₂ R₁ R₂)
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.div
  · exact ((continuous_id.dist continuous_const).sub continuous_const).max
      continuous_const
  · exact (((continuous_id.dist continuous_const).sub continuous_const).max
      continuous_const).add
      (((continuous_id.dist continuous_const).sub continuous_const).max
        continuous_const)
  · exact fun v => (sepWeight_denom_pos hsep v).ne'

name: Submission.FiberSign.juxtapose_apply_left
statement:
theorem juxtapose_apply_left (S₁ : FiberSign X₁) (S₂ : FiberSign X₂)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂) {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hv : dist v p₁ ≤ R₁) :
    S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep v = S₁ v
proof:
:= by
  show sepWeight p₁ p₂ R₁ R₂ v * S₁ v +
    (1 - sepWeight p₁ p₂ R₁ R₂ v) * S₂ v = S₁ v
  rw [sepWeight_eq_one hsep hv]
  ring

name: Submission.FiberSign.juxtapose_apply_right
statement:
theorem juxtapose_apply_right (S₁ : FiberSign X₁) (S₂ : FiberSign X₂)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂) {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hv : dist v p₂ ≤ R₂) :
    S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep v = S₂ v
proof:
:= by
  show sepWeight p₁ p₂ R₁ R₂ v * S₁ v +
    (1 - sepWeight p₁ p₂ R₁ R₂ v) * S₂ v = S₂ v
  rw [sepWeight_eq_zero hv]
  ring

name: Submission.FiberSign.positivePart_juxtapose
statement:
theorem positivePart_juxtapose (S₁ : FiberSign X₁) (S₂ : FiberSign X₂)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂) :
    (S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep).positivePart =
      S₁.positivePart ∪ S₂.positivePart
proof:
:= by
  ext v
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hfib, hpos⟩
    rw [FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose X₁ X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep] at hfib
    rcases hfib with hv | hv
    · have hd : dist v p₁ ≤ R₁ :=
        (Metric.mem_ball.mp (h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc hv)).le
      rw [juxtapose_apply_left S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep hd] at hpos
      exact Or.inl ⟨hv, hpos⟩
    · have hd : dist v p₂ ≤ R₂ :=
        (Metric.mem_ball.mp (h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc hv)).le
      rw [juxtapose_apply_right S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep hd] at hpos
      exact Or.inr ⟨hv, hpos⟩
  · intro hv
    rcases hv with ⟨hfib, hpos⟩ | ⟨hfib, hpos⟩
    · have hd : dist v p₁ ≤ R₁ :=
        (Metric.mem_ball.mp (h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc hfib)).le
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose X₁ X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
        exact Set.mem_union_left _ hfib
      · rw [juxtapose_apply_left S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep hd]
        exact hpos
    · have hd : dist v p₂ ≤ R₂ :=
        (Metric.mem_ball.mp (h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc hfib)).le
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose X₁ X₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep]
        exact Set.mem_union_right _ hfib
      · rw [juxtapose_apply_right S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep hd]
        exact hpos

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.translate_g
statement:
@[simp] theorem translate_g (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (w v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    (X.translate w).g v = X.g (v - w)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.mem_fiber_translate
statement:
theorem mem_fiber_translate (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {w v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} :
    v ∈ (X.translate w).fiber ↔ v - w ∈ X.fiber
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.FlatOutside.translate
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  show X.g (v - w) = c
  apply h
  have hdist : dist (v - w) p = dist v (p + w) := by
    rw [← dist_add_right (v - w) p w, sub_add_cancel]
  rwa [hdist]

name: Submission.FiberSign.translate_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem translate_apply {X : FramedLevelSet n} (S : FiberSign X)
    (w v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    S.translate w v = S (v - w)
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.FiberSign.mem_positivePart_translate
statement:
theorem mem_positivePart_translate {X : FramedLevelSet n} (S : FiberSign X)
    {w v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} :
    v ∈ (S.translate w).positivePart ↔ v - w ∈ S.positivePart
proof:
:=
  Iff.rfl

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.SpatialFlatOutside.flatOutside_X₀
statement:
theorem SpatialFlatOutside.flatOutside_X₀ {C : FramedLevelCobordism n}
    (h : C.SpatialFlatOutside c p R) : C.X₀.FlatOutside c p R
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have h0 := h (spaceTime x 0) (by rwa [initCLM_spaceTime])
  rwa [C.collar_zero x 0 (by norm_num)] at h0

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.SpatialFlatOutside.flatOutside_X₁
statement:
theorem SpatialFlatOutside.flatOutside_X₁ {C : FramedLevelCobordism n}
    (h : C.SpatialFlatOutside c p R) : C.X₁.FlatOutside c p R
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have h1 := h (spaceTime x 1) (by rwa [initCLM_spaceTime])
  rwa [C.collar_one x 1 (by norm_num)] at h1

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.spatialFlatOutside_refl
proof:
:=
  fun v hv => h _ hv

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.spatialFlatOutside_juxtapose
statement:
theorem spatialFlatOutside_juxtapose (C D : FramedLevelCobordism n)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hC : C.SpatialFlatOutside c p₁ R₁)
    (hD : D.SpatialFlatOutside c p₂ R₂) (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (hR₂ : 0 ≤ R₂) :
    (C.juxtapose D hc hC hD hsep).SpatialFlatOutside c p₁
      (dist p₁ p₂ + R₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hd₁ : R₁ ≤ dist (initCLM (n + 1) v) p₁ := by linarith
  have hd₂ : R₂ ≤ dist (initCLM (n + 1) v) p₂ := by
    have htri := dist_triangle (initCLM (n + 1) v) p₂ p₁
    rw [dist_comm p₂ p₁] at htri
    linarith
  show C.G v + D.G v - c = c
  rw [hC v hd₁, hD v hd₂, add_sub_cancel_right]

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SpatialFlatOutside.flatOutside_source
proof:
:=
  C.source_eq ▸ FramedLevelCobordism.SpatialFlatOutside.flatOutside_X₀ h

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SpatialFlatOutside.flatOutside_target
proof:
:=
  C.target_eq ▸ FramedLevelCobordism.SpatialFlatOutside.flatOutside_X₁ h

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.spatialFlatOutside_refl
statement:
theorem spatialFlatOutside_refl {X : FramedLevelSet n} (S : FiberSign X)
    (h : X.FlatOutside c p R) :
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.refl S).SpatialFlatOutside c p R
proof:
:=
  fun v hv => h _ hv

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_juxtapose_tail
statement:
theorem nonempty_juxtapose_tail (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₁ T₁)
    (hc : c ≠ 0) (hC : C.SpatialFlatOutside c p₁ R₁)
    (S₂ : FiberSign X₂) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (hX₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (hY₁ : Y₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc hX₁ h₂ hsep)
      (T₁.juxtapose S₂ hc hY₁ h₂ hsep))
proof:
:=
  ⟨C.juxtapose (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.refl S₂) hc hC
    (spatialFlatOutside_refl S₂ h₂) hsep⟩

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.contDiff_localRadialSq
statement:
theorem contDiff_localRadialSq :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localRadialSq : E → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  unfold localRadialSq
  fun_prop

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRadialSq_nonneg
statement: theorem localRadialSq_nonneg (x : E) : 0 ≤ localRadialSq x
proof:
:= by
  unfold localRadialSq
  positivity

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRadialSq_rotate
statement:
@[simp] theorem localRadialSq_rotate (α : ℝ) (x : E) :
    localRadialSq (SO2FrameGauge.rotate α x) = localRadialSq x
proof:
:= by
  have htail : ∀ i : Fin m,
      SO2FrameGauge.rotate α x i.succ.succ = x i.succ.succ := by
    intro i
    apply SO2FrameGauge.rotate_apply_other
    · intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp at this
    · intro h
      have := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp at this
  unfold localRadialSq
  rw [SO2FrameGauge.rotate_apply_zero, SO2FrameGauge.rotate_apply_one]
  simp_rw [htail]
  calc
    (Real.cos α * x 0 - Real.sin α * x 1) ^ 2 +
          (Real.sin α * x 0 + Real.cos α * x 1) ^ 2 +
          ∑ i : Fin m, x i.succ.succ ^ 2 =
        (Real.sin α ^ 2 + Real.cos α ^ 2) * (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) +
          ∑ i : Fin m, x i.succ.succ ^ 2 := by ring
    _ = x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + ∑ i : Fin m, x i.succ.succ ^ 2 := by
      rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq, one_mul]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.contDiff_localRotationCutoff
statement:
theorem contDiff_localRotationCutoff :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (localRotationCutoff : E → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact contDiff_const.sub (Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_localRadialSq.sub contDiff_const))

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRotationCutoff_eq_one
statement:
theorem localRotationCutoff_eq_one {x : E} (hx : localRadialSq x ≤ 1) :
    localRotationCutoff x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [localRotationCutoff,
    Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos (by linarith), sub_zero]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRotationCutoff_eq_zero
statement:
theorem localRotationCutoff_eq_zero {x : E} (hx : 2 ≤ localRadialSq x) :
    localRotationCutoff x = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [localRotationCutoff,
    Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le (by linarith), sub_self]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRotationCutoff_rotate
statement:
@[simp] theorem localRotationCutoff_rotate (α : ℝ) (x : E) :
    localRotationCutoff (SO2FrameGauge.rotate α x) = localRotationCutoff x
proof:
:= by
  rw [localRotationCutoff, localRadialSq_rotate]
  rfl

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.contDiff_localizedAngle
statement:
theorem contDiff_localizedAngle (θ : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => localizedAngle θ p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((contDiff_normRamp.comp contDiff_fst).mul contDiff_const).mul
    (contDiff_localRotationCutoff.comp contDiff_snd)

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localizedAngle_rotate
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizedAngle_rotate (θ s α : ℝ) (x : E) :
    localizedAngle θ s (SO2FrameGauge.rotate α x) = localizedAngle θ s x
proof:
:= by
  rw [localizedAngle, localRotationCutoff_rotate]
  rfl

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.contDiff_localizedForward
statement:
theorem contDiff_localizedForward (θ : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => localizedForward θ p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => (localizedAngle θ p.1 p.2, p.2)) :=
    (contDiff_localizedAngle θ).prodMk contDiff_snd
  simpa [localizedForward, Function.comp_def] using
    SO2FrameGauge.contDiff_rotate.comp hpair

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.contDiff_localizedInverse
statement:
theorem contDiff_localizedInverse (θ : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => localizedInverse θ p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hpair : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => (-(localizedAngle θ p.1 p.2), p.2)) :=
    (contDiff_localizedAngle θ).neg.prodMk contDiff_snd
  simpa [localizedInverse, Function.comp_def] using
    SO2FrameGauge.contDiff_rotate.comp hpair

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localized_leftInverse
statement:
theorem localized_leftInverse (θ s : ℝ) :
    LeftInverse (localizedInverse (m := m) θ s)
      (localizedForward (m := m) θ s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rw [localizedInverse, localizedForward,
    localizedAngle_rotate (m := m)]
  exact SO2FrameGauge.rotate_neg_apply (localizedAngle θ s x) x

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localized_rightInverse
statement:
theorem localized_rightInverse (θ s : ℝ) :
    RightInverse (localizedInverse (m := m) θ s)
      (localizedForward (m := m) θ s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  rw [localizedInverse, localizedForward,
    localizedAngle_rotate (m := m)]
  exact SO2FrameGauge.rotate_apply_neg (localizedAngle θ s x) x

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localizedPlaneRotation_forward
statement:
@[simp] theorem localizedPlaneRotation_forward (θ s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    (localizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ).forward s x =
      SO2FrameGauge.rotate (localizedAngle θ s x) x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localizedPlaneRotation_fixed_of_two_le
statement:
theorem localizedPlaneRotation_fixed_of_two_le
    (θ s : ℝ) {x : E} (hx : 2 ≤ localRadialSq x) :
    (localizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ).forward s x = x
proof:
:= by
  rw [localizedPlaneRotation_forward, localizedAngle,
    localRotationCutoff_eq_zero hx, mul_zero, SO2FrameGauge.rotate_zero]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localizedPlaneRotation_fixedOn
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs x hx
  exact localizedPlaneRotation_fixed_of_two_le θ s hx

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localizedPlaneRotation_endpoint_of_le_one
statement:
theorem localizedPlaneRotation_endpoint_of_le_one
    (θ : ℝ) {x : E} (hx : localRadialSq x ≤ 1) :
    (localizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ).forward 1 x =
      SO2FrameGauge.rotate θ x
proof:
:= by
  rw [localizedPlaneRotation_forward, localizedAngle,
    normRamp_of_three_quarter_le (show (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num), one_mul,
    localRotationCutoff_eq_one hx, mul_one]

name: Submission.contDiffOn_radialClosedSOHomotopy_relative_of_circle
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_radialClosedSOHomotopy_relative_of_circle
    {m : ℕ} {f g : C(I, SOGroup m)}
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (hclosed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1))
    (hf : ∀ u : I, f u = 1)
    (G : ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m)
    (hg : ∀ u : I,
      g u = G (addCircleCartesian (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))))
    (hG : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1 →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => matrixToEuclidean
          ((G w : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) z) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => matrixToEuclidean
        ((radialClosedSOHomotopy H hclosed p.1 p.2 : SOGroup m) :
          Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))
      radialSORelativeNeighborhood
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rcases hp with hp | hp
  · change p.1 < 1 / 4 at hp
    have hnear : {q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | q.1 < 1 / 4} ∈ nhds p :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const).mem_nhds hp
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun _ : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => matrixToEuclidean
          (((1 : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))) p :=
      contDiffAt_const
    apply (hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_).contDiffWithinAt
    filter_upwards [hnear] with q hq
    rw [radialClosedSOHomotopy_eq_one_of_time_le_quarter
      H hclosed hf hq.le]
  · change 3 / 4 < p.1 ∧ 3 / 4 < pairRadius p.2 at hp
    have hz0 : p.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hr0 : pairRadius p.2 = 0 := pairRadius_eq_zero_iff.mpr h
      rw [hr0] at hp
      norm_num at hp
    have hr0 : pairRadius p.2 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [ne_eq, pairRadius_eq_zero_iff]
      exact hz0
    have hunit :
        (normalizedCartesian p.2).1 ^ 2 +
            (normalizedCartesian p.2).2 ^ 2 = 1 := by
      rw [normalizedCartesian]
      change (p.2.1 / pairRadius p.2) ^ 2 +
          (p.2.2 / pairRadius p.2) ^ 2 = 1
      rw [div_pow, div_pow, ← add_div, ← pairRadius_sq]
      field_simp
    have hnorm : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => normalizedCartesian q.2) p :=
      (contDiffAt_normalizedCartesian hz0).comp p contDiff_snd.contDiffAt
    let Φ : ℝ × ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m × Fin m) :=
      fun w => matrixToEuclidean
        ((G w : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    have hΦ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Φ (normalizedCartesian p.2) :=
      hG (normalizedCartesian p.2) hunit
    have hcomp' : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (Φ ∘ fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => normalizedCartesian q.2) p :=
      hΦ.comp p hnorm
    have hcomp : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => matrixToEuclidean
          ((G (normalizedCartesian q.2) : SOGroup m) :
            Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) p := by
      simpa [Φ, Function.comp_def] using hcomp'
    have hnear :
        {q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | 3 / 4 < q.1 ∧
          3 / 4 < pairRadius q.2} ∈ nhds p :=
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const
          (continuous_pairRadius.comp continuous_snd))).mem_nhds hp
    apply (hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_).contDiffWithinAt
    filter_upwards [hnear] with q hq
    rw [radialClosedSOHomotopy_eq_endpoint_of_three_quarter_le
      H hclosed G hg hq.1.le hq.2.le]

name: Submission.exists_contDiff_radialClosedSOHomotopy_of_circle
statement:
theorem exists_contDiff_radialClosedSOHomotopy_of_circle
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {f g : C(I, SOGroup m)}
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (hclosed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1))
    (hf : ∀ u : I, f u = 1)
    (G : ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m)
    (hg : ∀ u : I,
      g u = G (addCircleCartesian (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))))
    (hG : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1 →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => matrixToEuclidean
          ((G w : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) z) :
    ∃ Q : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m,
      (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
        ((Q p.1 p.2 : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) i j) ∧
      (∀ z, Q 0 z = 1) ∧
      (∀ z, z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1 → Q 1 z = G z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQzero, hQone⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_curriedCartesianSOHomotopy hm
      (radialClosedSOHomotopy H hclosed)
      (continuous_radialClosedSOHomotopy H hclosed hf)
      (radialClosedSOHomotopy_zero H hclosed hf)
      radialSORelativeNeighborhood_mem_nhdsSet
      (contDiffOn_radialClosedSOHomotopy_relative_of_circle
        H hclosed hf G hg hG)
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, hQzero, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  rw [hQone z hz,
    radialClosedSOHomotopy_one_of_radius_one H hclosed G hg
      (pairRadius_eq_one_of_sq hz)]

name: Submission.exists_contDiff_cartesianSOHomotopy_of_loopClassZ2_eq_of_circle
statement:
theorem exists_contDiff_cartesianSOHomotopy_of_loopClassZ2_eq_of_circle
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) {f g : C(I, SOGroup m)}
    (hfclosed : f 0 = f 1) (hgclosed : g 0 = g 1)
    (hf : ∀ u : I, f u = 1)
    (hclass : loopClassZ2 f hfclosed = loopClassZ2 g hgclosed)
    (G : ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m)
    (hg : ∀ u : I,
      g u = G (addCircleCartesian (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))))
    (hG : ∀ z : ℝ × ℝ, z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1 →
      ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun w : ℝ × ℝ => matrixToEuclidean
          ((G w : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) z) :
    ∃ Q : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m,
      (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
        ((Q p.1 p.2 : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) i j) ∧
      (∀ z, Q 0 z = 1) ∧
      (∀ z, z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1 → Q 1 z = G z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hKclosed⟩ := exists_loopHomotopy_of_loopClassZ2_eq
    hm hfclosed hgclosed hclass
  exact exists_contDiff_radialClosedSOHomotopy_of_circle
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 3) hm)
    K hKclosed hf G hg hG

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.addCircleCartesian_sq
statement:
private theorem addCircleCartesian_sq (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    (addCircleCartesian a).1 ^ 2 + (addCircleCartesian a).2 ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let c : ℂ := (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero a : Circle)
  have hc : ‖c‖ = 1 := by
    simpa [c, Submonoid.unitSphere] using
      (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero a : Circle).property
  have hs := Complex.sq_norm c
  rw [hc, one_pow, Complex.normSq_apply] at hs
  simp [addCircleCartesian, c, pow_two, hs]

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.nonempty_nullGaugeData
statement:
theorem nonempty_nullGaugeData (L : LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop r)
    (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (hclass : loopClassZ2 L.loop L.closed = 0) :
    Nonempty L.NullGaugeData
proof:
:= by
  let e : C(I, SOGroup r) := ContinuousMap.const I 1
  have heclosed : e 0 = e 1 := rfl
  have he : ∀ u : I, e u = 1 := fun _ => rfl
  have hclasses : loopClassZ2 e heclosed = loopClassZ2 L.loop L.closed := by
    rw [loopClassZ2_const, hclass]
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQzero, hQone⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_cartesianSOHomotopy_of_loopClassZ2_eq_of_circle
      hr heclosed L.closed he hclasses L.cartesian
      L.loop_eq_cartesian L.cartesian_smoothAt_circle
  exact ⟨⟨Q, hQ, hQzero, hQone⟩⟩

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.finrank_ker_fderiv
proof:
:= by
  let D : E' →L[ℝ] F := fderiv ℝ C.G v
  have hrange : D.toLinearMap.range = ⊤ :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hreg
  have hrank := D.toLinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker
  rw [hrange, finrank_top] at hrank
  have hF : Module.finrank ℝ F = n := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
  have hE : Module.finrank ℝ E' = n + 2 := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
  change Module.finrank ℝ D.toLinearMap.ker = 2
  rw [hF, hE] at hrank
  omega

statement:
private theorem parameter_tendsto (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {v : E'}
    (hreg : Surjective (fderiv ℝ C.G v)) :
    Tendsto (fun u : E₂ => (C.G v, kernelEquiv C hreg u)) (nhds 0)
      (nhds ((implicitData C hreg).prodFun (implicitData C hreg).pt))
proof:
:= by
  have hconst : ContinuousAt (fun _ : E₂ => C.G v) 0 := continuousAt_const
  have h := hconst.prodMk (kernelEquiv C hreg).continuous.continuousAt
  have hbase : (implicitData C hreg).prodFun (implicitData C hreg).pt =
      (C.G v, kernelEquiv C hreg (0 : E₂)) := by
    simp [ImplicitFunctionData.prodFun]

  exact h

statement:

proof:

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.eventually_ambientCoordinates_rawParam
statement:
theorem eventually_ambientCoordinates_rawParam (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {v : E'}
    (hreg : Surjective (fderiv ℝ C.G v)) :
    ∀ᶠ u : E₂ in nhds 0,
      ambientCoordinates C hreg (rawParam C hreg u - v) = u
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [eventually_rightFun_rawParam C hreg] with u hu
  change (kernelEquiv C hreg).symm
      ((implicitData C hreg).rightDeriv (rawParam C hreg u - v)) = u
  calc
    _ = (kernelEquiv C hreg).symm
        ((implicitData C hreg).rightFun (rawParam C hreg u)) := by
      rfl
    _ = (kernelEquiv C hreg).symm (kernelEquiv C hreg u) := by rw [hu]
    _ = u := (kernelEquiv C hreg).symm_apply_apply u

      (fun x : E' => d.rightDeriv (x - v))
    exact d.rightDeriv.contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const)
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E' => (C.G x, d.rightFun x))

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.continuousAt_rawParam
proof:
:= by
  let d := implicitData C hreg
  have hs : ContinuousAt d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.symm (d.prodFun d.pt) := by
    exact d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.continuousAt_symm
      d.map_pt_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target
  have ht := hs.tendsto.comp (parameter_tendsto C hreg)
  change Tendsto (rawParam C hreg) (nhds 0) (nhds (rawParam C hreg 0))
  convert ht using 1
  · ext u
    rfl
  · rw [rawParam_zero C hreg]
    have hleft :=
      d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.left_inv d.pt_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
    simpa [d, ImplicitFunctionData.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_apply] using hleft.symm

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.smoothDomain_mem_nhds
proof:
:= by
  let d := implicitData C hreg
  have htarget : {u : E₂ | (C.G v, kernelEquiv C hreg u) ∈
      d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.target} ∈ nhds (0 : E₂) :=
    (parameter_tendsto C hreg).eventually
      (d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.open_target.mem_nhds
        d.map_pt_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_target)
  obtain ⟨A₀, hA₀⟩ := d.isInvertible_fderiv_prodFun
  have hinvertible_nhds :
      {L : E' →L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker) |
        ∃ A : E' ≃L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker),
          (A : E' →L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker)) = L} ∈
        nhds (fderiv ℝ d.prodFun v) := by
    change Set.range (fun A : E' ≃L[ℝ]
      (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker) =>
        (A : E' →L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker))) ∈
      nhds (fderiv ℝ d.prodFun v)
    have h := A₀.nhds
    rw [hA₀] at h
    have hdpt : d.pt = v := rfl
    rw [hdpt] at h
    exact h
  have hderiv_at_center :
      {x : E' | ∃ A : E' ≃L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker),
        (A : E' →L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker)) =
          fderiv ℝ d.prodFun x} ∈ nhds v := by
    exact (contDiff_prodFun C hreg).continuous_fderiv (by simp) |>.continuousAt
      |>.preimage_mem_nhds hinvertible_nhds
  have hderiv :
      {u : E₂ | ∃ A : E' ≃L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker),
        (A : E' →L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker)) =
          fderiv ℝ d.prodFun (rawParam C hreg u)} ∈ nhds (0 : E₂) :=
    by
      have hderiv_at_zero :
          {x : E' | ∃ A : E' ≃L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker),
            (A : E' →L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker)) =
              fderiv ℝ d.prodFun x} ∈ nhds (rawParam C hreg 0) := by
        rw [show nhds (rawParam C hreg 0) = nhds v from
          congrArg nhds (rawParam_zero C hreg)]
        exact hderiv_at_center
      exact (continuousAt_rawParam C hreg).preimage_mem_nhds hderiv_at_zero
  exact inter_mem htarget hderiv

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.contDiffAt_rawParam_of_mem
proof:
:= by
  let d := implicitData C hreg
  rcases hu with ⟨htarget, A, hA⟩
  let y : F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker :=
    (C.G v, kernelEquiv C hreg u)
  have hprod : ContDiff ℝ ∞ d.prodFun := contDiff_prodFun C hreg
  have hderiv : HasFDerivAt d.prodFun
      (A : E' →L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker))
      (rawParam C hreg u) := by
    rw [hA]
    exact (hprod.differentiable (by simp) (rawParam C hreg u)).hasFDerivAt
  have hderiv' : HasFDerivAt d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph
      (A : E' →L[ℝ] (F × (fderiv ℝ C.G v).ker))
      (d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.symm y) := by
    simpa [d, y, rawParam, ImplicitFunctionData.implicitFunction_apply] using hderiv
  have hs : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.symm y :=
    d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.contDiffAt_symm htarget hderiv' hprod.contDiffAt
  have hp : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun z : E₂ => (C.G v, kernelEquiv C hreg z)) u :=
    contDiffAt_const.prodMk (kernelEquiv C hreg).contDiff.contDiffAt
  have hc := hs.comp u hp
  apply hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq
  filter_upwards [] with z
  rfl

statement:
theorem nonempty_iftSurfaceChart (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {v : E'}
    (hv : C.G v = 0) : Nonempty (IFTSurfaceChart C)
proof:
:=
  ⟨localChart C hv⟩

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.isCompact_localCore
statement:
theorem isCompact_localCore (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {v : E'}
    (hv : C.G v = 0) : IsCompact (localCore C hv)
proof:
:=
  isCompact_closedBall _ _

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.localCore_subset_chartDomain
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu
  change u ∈ ball (0 : E₂) (extensionRadius C (C.regular v hv) / 2)
  have hu' : dist u 0 ≤ extensionRadius C (C.regular v hv) / 4 := by
    simpa [localCore, dist_comm] using hu
  have hr : extensionRadius C (C.regular v hv) / 4 <
      extensionRadius C (C.regular v hv) / 2 := by
    linarith [extensionRadius_pos C (C.regular v hv)]
  apply mem_ball'.mpr
  simpa [dist_comm] using hu'.trans_lt hr

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.isOpen_localAmbient
statement:
theorem isOpen_localAmbient (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {v : E'}
    (hv : C.G v = 0) : IsOpen (localAmbient C hv)
proof:
:= by
  apply (implicitData C (C.regular v hv)).toOpenPartialHomeomorph.open_source.inter
  apply isOpen_ball.preimage
  exact (ambientCoordinates C (C.regular v hv)).continuous.comp
    (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.center_mem_localAmbient
statement:
theorem center_mem_localAmbient (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {v : E'}
    (hv : C.G v = 0) : v ∈ localAmbient C hv
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨(implicitData C (C.regular v hv)).pt_mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source, ?_⟩
  change ambientCoordinates C (C.regular v hv) (v - v) ∈
    ball (0 : E₂) (extensionRadius C (C.regular v hv) / 4)
  simp only [sub_self, map_zero]
  exact mem_ball_self (div_pos (extensionRadius_pos C (C.regular v hv)) (by norm_num))

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.rawParam_ambientCoordinates_eq
statement:
theorem rawParam_ambientCoordinates_eq (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {v x : E'}
    (hv : C.G v = 0) (hx : C.G x = 0) (hxa : x ∈ localAmbient C hv) :
    rawParam C (C.regular v hv)
      (ambientCoordinates C (C.regular v hv) (x - v)) = x
proof:
:= by
  let d := implicitData C (C.regular v hv)
  let e := kernelEquiv C (C.regular v hv)
  let u : E₂ := ambientCoordinates C (C.regular v hv) (x - v)
  have hpair : (C.G v, e u) = d.prodFun x := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · simpa [d, ImplicitFunctionData.prodFun, hv] using hx.symm
    · change e (e.symm (d.rightDeriv (x - v))) = d.rightFun x
      rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
      rfl
  have hleft := d.toOpenPartialHomeomorph.left_inv hxa.1
  change d.implicitFunction (C.G v) (e u) = x
  rw [ImplicitFunctionData.implicitFunction_apply, hpair]
  exact hleft

name: Submission.LocalIFTSurfaceChart.fiber_localAmbient_subset_param_localCore
statement:
theorem fiber_localAmbient_subset_param_localCore
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {v : E'} (hv : C.G v = 0) :
    {x : E' | C.G x = 0} ∩ localAmbient C hv ⊆
      (localChart C hv).param '' localCore C hv
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let u : E₂ := ambientCoordinates C (C.regular v hv) (x - v)
  have huCore : u ∈ localCore C hv := by
    apply mem_closedBall'.mpr
    have huBall := hx.2.2
    change u ∈ ball (0 : E₂)
      (extensionRadius C (C.regular v hv) / 4) at huBall
    exact (mem_ball'.mp huBall).le
  refine ⟨u, huCore, ?_⟩
  change globalParam C (C.regular v hv) u = x
  rw [globalParam_eq_rawParam_of_mem_chartDomain C (C.regular v hv)
    (localCore_subset_chartDomain C hv huCore)]
  exact rawParam_ambientCoordinates_eq C hv hx.1 hx.2

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitTube_center_mem_localTarget
statement:
theorem orbitTube_center_mem_localTarget (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u ∈
      (V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph O u).target
proof:
:= by
  rw [← V.orbitTubeLift_zero O u]
  rw [← V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph_coe O u]
  exact (V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph O u).map_source
    (V.orbitTube_center_mem_localSource O u)

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitTubeLocalInverse_center
statement:
@[simp] theorem orbitTubeLocalInverse_center (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    V.orbitTubeLocalInverse O u (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u) =
      (u, (0 : N))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← V.orbitTubeLift_zero O u]
  change (V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph O u).symm
      (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N))) = (u, (0 : N))
  rw [← V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph_coe O u]
  exact (V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph O u).left_inv
    (V.orbitTube_center_mem_localSource O u)

name: Submission.TamedField.contDiffAt_orbitTubeLocalInverse_center
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_orbitTubeLocalInverse_center
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (V.orbitTubeLocalInverse O u)
      (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)
proof:
:= by
  let e := V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph O u
  have htarget : V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u ∈ e.target := by
    simpa [e] using V.orbitTube_center_mem_localTarget O u
  have hinverse : e.symm (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u) =
      (u, (0 : N)) := by
    simpa [e, orbitTubeLocalInverse] using
      V.orbitTubeLocalInverse_center O u
  have hderiv : HasFDerivAt e
      (V.orbitTubeDerivEquiv O u : (ℝ × N) →L[ℝ] E)
      (e.symm (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)) := by
    rw [hinverse]
    simpa [e] using V.hasFDerivAt_orbitTubeLift_zero O u
  have hsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ e
      (e.symm (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)) := by
    rw [hinverse]
    simpa [e] using (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).contDiffAt
  change ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ e.symm (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)
  exact e.contDiffAt_symm htarget hderiv hsmooth

name: Submission.TamedField.hasFDerivAt_orbitTubeLocalInverse_center
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_orbitTubeLocalInverse_center
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt (V.orbitTubeLocalInverse O u)
      ((V.orbitTubeDerivEquiv O u).symm : E →L[ℝ] (ℝ × N))
      (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)
proof:
:= by
  let e := V.orbitTubeLocalHomeomorph O u
  have htarget : V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u ∈ e.target := by
    simpa [e] using V.orbitTube_center_mem_localTarget O u
  have hinverse : e.symm (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u) =
      (u, (0 : N)) := by
    simpa [e, orbitTubeLocalInverse] using
      V.orbitTubeLocalInverse_center O u
  have hderiv : HasFDerivAt e
      (V.orbitTubeDerivEquiv O u : (ℝ × N) →L[ℝ] E)
      (e.symm (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)) := by
    rw [hinverse]
    simpa [e] using V.hasFDerivAt_orbitTubeLift_zero O u
  change HasFDerivAt e.symm
    ((V.orbitTubeDerivEquiv O u).symm : E →L[ℝ] (ℝ × N))
    (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u)
  exact e.hasFDerivAt_symm htarget hderiv

name: Submission.TamedField.fderiv_orbitTubeLocalInverse_center
statement:
@[simp] theorem fderiv_orbitTubeLocalInverse_center
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (V.orbitTubeLocalInverse O u)
      (V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u) =
      ((V.orbitTubeDerivEquiv O u).symm : E →L[ℝ] (ℝ × N))
proof:
:= by
  exact (V.hasFDerivAt_orbitTubeLocalInverse_center O u).fderiv

name: Submission.mem_timeCritical_iff_tcoord_eq_zero_on_ker
statement:
theorem mem_timeCritical_iff_tcoord_eq_zero_on_ker
    {G : E' → F} {v : E'} (hv : G v = 0)
    (hregular : Surjective (fderiv ℝ G v)) :
    v ∈ timeCritical G ↔
      ∀ w : E', fderiv ℝ G v w = 0 → tcoord w = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [timeCritical]
  simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, hv, true_and]
  rw [← kerProj_timeVec_eq_zero_iff hregular]
  constructor
  · intro hproj w hw
    rw [← inner_timeVec]
    calc
      ⟪timeVec, w⟫ = ⟪kerProj G v timeVec, w⟫ := by
        rw [inner_kerProj_left hregular, kerProj_of_fderiv_eq_zero hw]
      _ = 0 := by simp [hproj]
  · intro hker
    have hzero : tcoord (kerProj G v timeVec) = 0 :=
      hker _ (fderiv_kerProj hregular timeVec)
    have hnorm : ‖kerProj G v timeVec‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
      rw [← inner_timeVec_kerProj_timeVec hregular, inner_timeVec]
      exact hzero
    exact norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hnorm)

name: Submission.surfaceParam_fderiv_range_eq_ker
statement:
theorem surfaceParam_fderiv_range_eq_ker
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) (param : E₂ → E') (u : E₂)
    (hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ param)
    (hfiber : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 u, C.G (param z) = 0)
    (hinjective : Injective (fderiv ℝ param u)) :
    LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℝ param u).toLinearMap) =
      LinearMap.ker ((fderiv ℝ C.G (param u)).toLinearMap)
proof:
:= by
  have hpu : C.G (param u) = 0 := hfiber.self_of_nhds
  have hregular : Surjective (fderiv ℝ C.G (param u)) :=
    C.regular (param u) hpu
  have hcomp : fderiv ℝ (C.G ∘ param) u =
      (fderiv ℝ C.G (param u)).comp (fderiv ℝ param u) := by
    exact ((C.smooth.differentiable (by simp) (param u)).hasFDerivAt.comp u
      ((hsmooth.differentiable (by simp) u).hasFDerivAt)).fderiv
  have hzero : fderiv ℝ (C.G ∘ param) u = 0 := by
    calc
      fderiv ℝ (C.G ∘ param) u = fderiv ℝ (fun _ : E₂ => (0 : F)) u := by
        apply Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq
        filter_upwards [hfiber] with z hz
        exact hz
      _ = 0 := by simp
  have hrange_le :
      LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℝ param u).toLinearMap) ≤
        LinearMap.ker ((fderiv ℝ C.G (param u)).toLinearMap) := by
    rintro w ⟨z, rfl⟩
    rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
    have happ := congrArg
      (fun L : E₂ →L[ℝ] F => L z) (hcomp.symm.trans hzero)
    simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] using happ
  apply Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_eq hrange_le
  rw [LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj hinjective,
    finrank_euclideanSpace_fin,
    LocalIFTSurfaceChart.finrank_ker_fderiv C hregular]

name: Submission.fderiv_surfaceTime_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_surfaceTime_apply
    (param : E₂ → E') (hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ param) (u w : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z => tcoord (param z)) u w =
      tcoord (fderiv ℝ param u w)
proof:
:= by
  let proj : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (n + 1))
  have hcomp : fderiv ℝ (proj ∘ param) u =
      proj.comp (fderiv ℝ param u) := by
    exact (proj.hasFDerivAt.comp u
      ((hsmooth.differentiable (by simp) u).hasFDerivAt)).fderiv
  change fderiv ℝ (proj ∘ param) u w =
    proj (fderiv ℝ param u w)
  rw [hcomp]
  rfl

name: Submission.surfaceParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_fderiv_time_eq_zero
statement:
theorem surfaceParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_fderiv_time_eq_zero
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) (param : E₂ → E') (u : E₂)
    (hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ param)
    (hfiber : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 u, C.G (param z) = 0)
    (hinjective : Injective (fderiv ℝ param u)) :
    param u ∈ timeCritical C.G ↔
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => tcoord (param z)) u = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hpu : C.G (param u) = 0 := hfiber.self_of_nhds
  have hregular : Surjective (fderiv ℝ C.G (param u)) :=
    C.regular (param u) hpu
  have hrange := surfaceParam_fderiv_range_eq_ker C param u hsmooth
    hfiber hinjective
  rw [mem_timeCritical_iff_tcoord_eq_zero_on_ker hpu hregular]
  constructor
  · intro hcrit
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro w
    rw [fderiv_surfaceTime_apply param hsmooth]
    apply hcrit
    have hwker : fderiv ℝ param u w ∈ LinearMap.ker
        ((fderiv ℝ C.G (param u)).toLinearMap) := by
      rw [← hrange]
      exact ⟨w, rfl⟩
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp hwker
  · intro htime w hw
    have hwker : w ∈ LinearMap.ker
        ((fderiv ℝ C.G (param u)).toLinearMap) := by
      exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr hw
    rw [← hrange] at hwker
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hwker
    calc
      tcoord w = tcoord (fderiv ℝ param u z) := congrArg tcoord hz.symm
      _ = fderiv ℝ (fun q => tcoord (param q)) u z :=
        (fderiv_surfaceTime_apply param hsmooth u z).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [htime]; rfl

name: Submission.chartGradient_eq_zero_iff_fderiv_eq_zero
statement:
theorem chartGradient_eq_zero_iff_fderiv_eq_zero
    {f : E₂ → ℝ} {u : E₂} :
    chartGradient f u = 0 ↔ fderiv ℝ f u = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero
  · intro h
    rw [chartGradient, h]
    simp [scalarAdjointCLM]

name: Submission.surfaceParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
statement:
theorem surfaceParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) (param : E₂ → E') (u : E₂)
    (hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ param)
    (hfiber : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 u, C.G (param z) = 0)
    (hinjective : Injective (fderiv ℝ param u)) :
    param u ∈ timeCritical C.G ↔
      chartGradient (fun z => tcoord (param z)) u = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [surfaceParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_fderiv_time_eq_zero C param u
    hsmooth hfiber hinjective,
    chartGradient_eq_zero_iff_fderiv_eq_zero]

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.fderiv_param_injective
statement:
theorem fderiv_param_injective (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) {u : E₂}
    (hdom : P.domain ∈ 𝓝 u) : Injective (fderiv ℝ P.param u)
proof:
:= by
  intro x y hxy
  have hlift (q : E₂) :
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => P.liftCovector q (P.param z - P.center)) u =
        innerSL ℝ q := by
    calc
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => P.liftCovector q (P.param z - P.center)) u =
          fderiv ℝ (fun z => (innerSL ℝ q) z) u := by
        apply Filter.EventuallyEq.fderiv_eq
        filter_upwards [hdom] with z hz
        exact P.lift_param q z hz
      _ = innerSL ℝ q := by
        exact (innerSL ℝ q).hasFDerivAt.fderiv
  have hchain (q : E₂) :
      fderiv ℝ (fun z => P.liftCovector q (P.param z - P.center)) u =
        (P.liftCovector q).comp (fderiv ℝ P.param u) := by
    exact ((P.liftCovector q).hasFDerivAt.comp u
      (((P.param_smooth.differentiable (by simp) u).hasFDerivAt).sub_const
        P.center)).fderiv
  let w : E₂ := x - y
  have hw : fderiv ℝ P.param u w = 0 := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [map_sub, hxy, sub_self]
  have hinner : (innerSL ℝ w) w = 0 := by
    have hEq := (hchain w).symm.trans (hlift w)
    calc
      (innerSL ℝ w) w =
          P.liftCovector w (fderiv ℝ P.param u w) := by
        exact (congrArg (fun L : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L w) hEq).symm
      _ = 0 := by rw [hw]; simp
  have hnorm : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
    simpa [innerSL_apply_apply] using hinner
  have hwzero : w = 0 := norm_eq_zero.mp (sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hnorm)
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp hwzero

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
statement:
theorem mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) {u : E₂} (hdom : P.domain ∈ 𝓝 u) :
    P.param u ∈ timeCritical C.G ↔ chartGradient P.time u = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply surfaceParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
    C P.param u P.param_smooth
  · filter_upwards [hdom] with z hz
    exact P.param_fiber z hz
  · exact P.fderiv_param_injective hdom

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.fderiv_equiv_symm_injective
statement:
theorem fderiv_equiv_symm_injective
    (a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n)) (y : E') :
    Injective (fderiv ℝ a.equiv.symm y)
proof:
:= by
  have hchain :
      fderiv ℝ (verticalShift a ∘ a.equiv.symm) y =
        (fderiv ℝ (verticalShift a) (a.equiv.symm y)).comp
          (fderiv ℝ a.equiv.symm y) := by
    exact (((contDiff_verticalShift a.smooth).differentiable (by simp)
      (a.equiv.symm y)).hasFDerivAt.comp y
        ((a.contDiff_equiv_symm.differentiable (by simp) y).hasFDerivAt)).fderiv
  have hfun : verticalShift a ∘ a.equiv.symm = id := by
    funext z
    change a.equiv (a.equiv.symm z) = z
    exact a.equiv.apply_symm_apply z
  have hid : fderiv ℝ (verticalShift a ∘ a.equiv.symm) y =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E' := by
    rw [hfun]
    exact hasFDerivAt_id y |>.fderiv
  have hcomp :
      (fderiv ℝ (verticalShift a) (a.equiv.symm y)).comp
          (fderiv ℝ a.equiv.symm y) =
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E' :=
    hchain.symm.trans hid
  intro x z hxz
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  have hzero : fderiv ℝ a.equiv.symm y (x - z) = 0 := by
    rw [map_sub, hxz, sub_self]
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E' →L[ℝ] E' => L (x - z)) hcomp
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hzero] using happ.symm

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.pullbackParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
statement:
theorem pullbackParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n))
    {u : E₂} (hdom : P.domain ∈ 𝓝 u) :
    a.diffeomorph.symm (P.param u) ∈
        timeCritical (a.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G ↔
      chartGradient
        (fun z => tcoord (a.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z))) u = 0
proof:
:= by
  let param' : E₂ → E' := fun z => a.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z)
  apply surfaceParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
    (a.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C) param' u
  · exact a.contDiff_equiv_symm.comp P.param_smooth
  · filter_upwards [hdom] with z hz
    change C.G (verticalShift a (a.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z))) = 0
    rw [← a.diffeomorph_apply, a.diffeomorph.apply_symm_apply]
    exact P.param_fiber z hz
  · have hchain : fderiv ℝ param' u =
        (fderiv ℝ a.equiv.symm (P.param u)).comp
          (fderiv ℝ P.param u) := by
      exact ((a.contDiff_equiv_symm.differentiable (by simp)
        (P.param u)).hasFDerivAt.comp u
          ((P.param_smooth.differentiable (by simp) u).hasFDerivAt)).fderiv
    rw [hchain]
    exact (a.fderiv_equiv_symm_injective (P.param u)).comp
      (P.fderiv_param_injective hdom)

name: Submission.arctan_inv_of_pos
statement:
theorem arctan_inv_of_pos {a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a) :
    Real.arctan a⁻¹ = Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan a
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : Real.arctan a < Real.pi / 2 := Real.arctan_lt_pi_div_two a
  have hgt : 0 < Real.arctan a := Real.arctan_pos.mpr ha
  have htan : Real.tan (Real.pi / 2 - Real.arctan a) = a⁻¹ := by
    rw [Real.tan_pi_div_two_sub, Real.tan_arctan]
  rw [← htan, Real.arctan_tan (by linarith) (by linarith)]

name: Submission.arctan_inv_of_neg
statement:
theorem arctan_inv_of_neg {a : ℝ} (ha : a < 0) :
    Real.arctan a⁻¹ = -(Real.pi / 2) - Real.arctan a
proof:
:= by
  have h := arctan_inv_of_pos (neg_pos.mpr ha)
  rw [inv_neg, Real.arctan_neg, Real.arctan_neg] at h
  linarith

name: Submission.norm_euclidean_two
statement:
theorem norm_euclidean_two (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    ‖v‖ = Real.sqrt (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  congr 1
  simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

name: Submission.norm_euclidean_two_pos_of_fst
statement:
theorem norm_euclidean_two_pos_of_fst {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
    (h : v 0 ≠ 0) : 0 < ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_euclidean_two]
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
  have : 0 < v 0 ^ 2 := by positivity
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 1)]

name: Submission.norm_euclidean_two_pos_of_snd
statement:
theorem norm_euclidean_two_pos_of_snd {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
    (h : v 1 ≠ 0) : 0 < ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_euclidean_two]
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
  have : 0 < v 1 ^ 2 := by positivity
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0)]

name: Submission.sqrt_one_add_sq_div_fst
statement:
theorem sqrt_one_add_sq_div_fst {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} (h : v 0 ≠ 0) :
    Real.sqrt (1 + (v 1 / v 0) ^ 2) = ‖v‖ / |v 0|
proof:
:= by
  have habs : |v 0| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.mpr h
  rw [norm_euclidean_two, eq_div_iff habs,
    ← Real.sqrt_sq (abs_nonneg (v 0)),
    ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
  congr 1
  rw [sq_abs]
  field_simp
  try ring

name: Submission.sqrt_one_add_sq_div_snd
statement:
theorem sqrt_one_add_sq_div_snd {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} (h : v 1 ≠ 0) :
    Real.sqrt (1 + (v 0 / v 1) ^ 2) = ‖v‖ / |v 1|
proof:
:= by
  have habs : |v 1| ≠ 0 := abs_ne_zero.mpr h
  rw [norm_euclidean_two, eq_div_iff habs,
    ← Real.sqrt_sq (abs_nonneg (v 1)),
    ← Real.sqrt_mul (by positivity)]
  congr 1
  rw [sq_abs]
  field_simp
  try ring

name: Submission.definiteCircleParam_of_cos_sin
proof:
:= by
  have e0 : definiteCircleParam ‖v‖ θ 0 = v 0 := by
    rw [definiteCircleParam_apply_zero]; exact hc
  have e1 : definiteCircleParam ‖v‖ θ 1 = v 1 := by
    rw [definiteCircleParam_apply_one]; exact hs
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact e0
  · exact e1

name: Submission.cos_three_pi_div_two
statement: theorem cos_three_pi_div_two : Real.cos (3 * Real.pi / 2) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (3 * Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) = Real.pi + Real.pi / 2 by ring, Real.cos_add,
    Real.cos_pi, Real.sin_pi, Real.cos_pi_div_two, Real.sin_pi_div_two]
  ring

name: Submission.sin_three_pi_div_two
statement: theorem sin_three_pi_div_two : Real.sin (3 * Real.pi / 2) = -1
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (3 * Real.pi / 2 : ℝ) = Real.pi + Real.pi / 2 by ring, Real.sin_add,
    Real.cos_pi, Real.sin_pi, Real.cos_pi_div_two, Real.sin_pi_div_two]
  ring

name: Submission.definiteCircleParam_qangE
statement:
theorem definiteCircleParam_qangE {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
    (h : 0 < v 0) : definiteCircleParam ‖v‖ (qangE v) = v
proof:
:= by
  have hne : v 0 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h
  have hn : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_euclidean_two_pos_of_fst hne
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (1 + (v 1 / v 0) ^ 2) = ‖v‖ / v 0 := by
    rw [sqrt_one_add_sq_div_fst hne, abs_of_pos h]
  refine definiteCircleParam_of_cos_sin ?_ ?_
  · rw [qangE, Real.cos_arctan, hsq]
    field_simp
  · rw [qangE, Real.sin_arctan, hsq]
    field_simp

name: Submission.definiteCircleParam_qangN
statement:
theorem definiteCircleParam_qangN {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
    (h : 0 < v 1) : definiteCircleParam ‖v‖ (qangN v) = v
proof:
:= by
  have hne : v 1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h
  have hn : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_euclidean_two_pos_of_snd hne
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (1 + (v 0 / v 1) ^ 2) = ‖v‖ / v 1 := by
    rw [sqrt_one_add_sq_div_snd hne, abs_of_pos h]
  refine definiteCircleParam_of_cos_sin ?_ ?_
  · rw [qangN, Real.cos_pi_div_two_sub, Real.sin_arctan, hsq]
    field_simp
  · rw [qangN, Real.sin_pi_div_two_sub, Real.cos_arctan, hsq]
    field_simp

name: Submission.definiteCircleParam_qangW
statement:
theorem definiteCircleParam_qangW {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
    (h : v 0 < 0) : definiteCircleParam ‖v‖ (qangW v) = v
proof:
:= by
  have hne : v 0 ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt h
  have hn : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_euclidean_two_pos_of_fst hne
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (1 + (v 1 / v 0) ^ 2) = -(‖v‖ / v 0) := by
    rw [sqrt_one_add_sq_div_fst hne, abs_of_neg h]
    field_simp
  have hcadd : ∀ t : ℝ, Real.cos (Real.pi + t) = -Real.cos t := by
    intro t; rw [Real.cos_add, Real.cos_pi, Real.sin_pi]; ring
  have hsadd : ∀ t : ℝ, Real.sin (Real.pi + t) = -Real.sin t := by
    intro t; rw [Real.sin_add, Real.cos_pi, Real.sin_pi]; ring
  refine definiteCircleParam_of_cos_sin ?_ ?_
  · rw [qangW, hcadd, Real.cos_arctan, hsq]
    field_simp
  · rw [qangW, hsadd, Real.sin_arctan, hsq]
    field_simp

name: Submission.definiteCircleParam_qangS
statement:
theorem definiteCircleParam_qangS {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)}
    (h : v 1 < 0) : definiteCircleParam ‖v‖ (qangS v) = v
proof:
:= by
  have hne : v 1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt h
  have hn : 0 < ‖v‖ := norm_euclidean_two_pos_of_snd hne
  have hsq : Real.sqrt (1 + (v 0 / v 1) ^ 2) = -(‖v‖ / v 1) := by
    rw [sqrt_one_add_sq_div_snd hne, abs_of_neg h]
    field_simp
  have hcsub : ∀ t : ℝ, Real.cos (3 * Real.pi / 2 - t) = -Real.sin t := by
    intro t; rw [Real.cos_sub, cos_three_pi_div_two, sin_three_pi_div_two]; ring
  have hssub : ∀ t : ℝ, Real.sin (3 * Real.pi / 2 - t) = -Real.cos t := by
    intro t; rw [Real.sin_sub, cos_three_pi_div_two, sin_three_pi_div_two]; ring
  refine definiteCircleParam_of_cos_sin ?_ ?_
  · rw [qangS, hcsub, Real.sin_arctan, hsq]
    field_simp
  · rw [qangS, hssub, Real.cos_arctan, hsq]
    field_simp

name: Submission.qangE_eq_qangN
statement:
theorem qangE_eq_qangN {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} (h0 : 0 < v 0)
    (h1 : 0 < v 1) : qangE v = qangN v
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : 0 < v 0 / v 1 := div_pos h0 h1
  have hinv : v 1 / v 0 = (v 0 / v 1)⁻¹ := (inv_div _ _).symm

name: Submission.qangS_eq_qangE_add_two_pi

name: Submission.tubeHorizontalChart_mem_ball
statement:
theorem tubeHorizontalChart_mem_ball (w : F) :

proof:

name: Submission.surjective_fderiv_tubeHorizontalChart
statement:
theorem surjective_fderiv_tubeHorizontalChart (w : F) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ tubeHorizontalChart w)
proof:
:= by
  let e : OpenPartialHomeomorph F F := OpenPartialHomeomorph.univUnitBall
  let y : F := e w
  have hw : w ∈ e.source := by
    change w ∈ (Set.univ : Set F)
    exact Set.mem_univ w
  have hy : y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : F) 1 := by
    exact e.map_source hw
  have hleft : e.symm y = w := by
    exact e.left_inv hw
  have hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (e : F → F) w := by
    have hfcd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (e : F → F) w := by
      have hglobal : ContDiff ℝ ∞
          (OpenPartialHomeomorph.univUnitBall : F → F) :=
        OpenPartialHomeomorph.contDiff_univUnitBall
      simpa [e] using hglobal.contDiffAt
    exact hfcd.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ (e.symm : F → F) y := by
    have hOn : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
        (OpenPartialHomeomorph.univUnitBall.symm : F → F)
        (Metric.ball (0 : F) 1) :=
      OpenPartialHomeomorph.contDiffOn_univUnitBall_symm
    have hgcd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (e.symm : F → F) y := by
      simpa [e] using hOn.contDiffAt (isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy)
    exact hgcd.differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hf' : DifferentiableAt ℝ (e : F → F) (e.symm y) := by
    rwa [hleft]
  have hcomp := fderiv_comp (x := y) hf' hg
  have hright : ((e : F → F) ∘ (e.symm : F → F)) =ᶠ[𝓝 y] id := by
    filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hy] with z hz
    exact e.right_inv hz
  have hid := hright.fderiv_eq (𝕜 := ℝ)
  rw [fderiv_id] at hid
  rw [hleft] at hcomp
  have hmaps :
      (fderiv ℝ (e : F → F) w).comp
          (fderiv ℝ (e.symm : F → F) y) =
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F := by
    rw [← hcomp]
    exact hid
  intro z
  refine ⟨fderiv ℝ (e.symm : F → F) y z, ?_⟩
  have hz := congrArg (fun L : F →L[ℝ] F => L z) hmaps
  simpa [tubeHorizontalChart, e] using hz

name: Submission.fderiv_tubeHorizontalChart_zero
statement:
theorem fderiv_tubeHorizontalChart_zero :
    fderiv ℝ (tubeHorizontalChart (m := m)) 0 =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F
proof:
:= by
  let a : F → ℝ := fun w => (Real.sqrt (1 + ‖w‖ ^ 2))⁻¹
  have ha : DifferentiableAt ℝ a 0 := by
    have hcd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a := by
      dsimp only [a]
      have hpos : ∀ w : F, (0 : ℝ) < 1 + ‖w‖ ^ 2 := fun w => by positivity
      exact ((contDiff_const.add (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ)).sqrt
        fun w => (hpos w).ne').inv fun w => Real.sqrt_ne_zero'.mpr (hpos w)
    exact hcd.differentiable (by simp) 0
  have hid : DifferentiableAt ℝ (id : F → F) 0 := differentiableAt_id
  have heq : tubeHorizontalChart (m := m) = fun w => a w • w := rfl
  rw [heq]
  change fderiv ℝ (fun w => a w • id w) 0 = _
  rw [fderiv_fun_smul ha hid]
  simp [a]

name: Submission.initCLM_tubeThomVec_of_mem_inner
statement:
theorem initCLM_tubeThomVec_of_mem_inner (k : ℕ) {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 4)) :
    initCLM (m + 2) (tubeThomVec k x) =
      tubeHorizontalChart (wCoord k x)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : tubeCutoff x = 1 := tubeCutoff_eq_one_on_inner hx
  have hinitRaw : initCLM (m + 2) (tubeCollapseRaw k x) = wCoord k x := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    change tubeCollapseRaw k x i.castSucc = wCoord k x i
    rw [tubeCollapseRaw_coord,
      tubeCollapseHorizontal_eq_wCoord_of_mem_inner k hx]
  have hvertRaw : vertC (tubeCollapseRaw k x) = 1 := by
    change tubeCollapseRaw k x (Fin.last (m + 2)) = 1
    rw [tubeCollapseRaw_last, hc]
    norm_num
  have hsplit := norm_sq_split (tubeCollapseRaw k x)
  rw [hinitRaw, hvertRaw] at hsplit
  have hnorm : ‖tubeCollapseRaw k x‖ =
      Real.sqrt (1 + ‖wCoord k x‖ ^ 2) := by
    calc
      ‖tubeCollapseRaw k x‖ = Real.sqrt (‖tubeCollapseRaw k x‖ ^ 2) :=
        (Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)).symm
      _ = Real.sqrt (1 + ‖wCoord k x‖ ^ 2) := by
        congr 1
        linarith
  rw [tubeThomVec, map_smul, hinitRaw, hnorm, tubeHorizontalChart_apply]

name: Submission.vertC_tubeThomVec_pos_of_mem_inner
proof:
:= by
  have hc : tubeCutoff x = 1 := tubeCutoff_eq_one_on_inner hx
  change 0 < ‖tubeCollapseRaw k x‖⁻¹ *
    tubeCollapseRaw k x (Fin.last (m + 2))
  rw [tubeCollapseRaw_last, hc]
  norm_num
  exact tubeCollapseRaw_ne_zero k x

name: Submission.tubeApproximation_nprep_eq_tubeThomVec_of_mem_inner
statement:
theorem tubeApproximation_nprep_eq_tubeThomVec_of_mem_inner (k : ℕ)
    (v : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ)
    (hv : tubeApproxAmbient v ∈ tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 4)) :
    nprep (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v =
      tubeThomVec k (tubeApproxAmbient v)
proof:
:= by
  have hvert : 0 < vertC (tubeThomVec k (tubeApproxAmbient v)) :=
    vertC_tubeThomVec_pos_of_mem_inner k hv
  have hvert' : -(1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤
      vertC (tubeThomVec k (tubeApproxAmbient v)) := by
    linarith
  rw [nprep, praw, tubeApproximation_nraw]
  change ‖plateauAux (tubeThomVec k (tubeApproxAmbient v))‖⁻¹ •
      plateauAux (tubeThomVec k (tubeApproxAmbient v)) = _
  rw [plateauAux_of_ge hvert', norm_tubeThomVec, inv_one, one_smul]

name: Submission.bridgeHMapE_tubeApproximation_of_mem_inner
statement:
theorem bridgeHMapE_tubeApproximation_of_mem_inner (k : ℕ) (x : E)
    (hx : tubeApproxAmbient (WithLp.ofLp x) ∈
      tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 4)) :
    bridgeHMapE (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) x =

        (wCoord k (tubeApproxAmbient (WithLp.ofLp x)))
proof:
:= by
