      (nprep (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) (WithLp.ofLp x)) = _
  rw [tubeApproximation_nprep_eq_tubeThomVec_of_mem_inner k _ hx]
  exact initCLM_tubeThomVec_of_mem_inner k hx

name: Submission.fderiv_wCoord_comp_normalSumCLM_tubeMap
statement:
theorem fderiv_wCoord_comp_normalSumCLM_tubeMap (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) {w : F}
    (hw : ‖w‖ < 1 / 4) :
    (fderiv ℝ (wCoord (m := m) k) (tubeMap k θ w)).comp
        (normalSumCLM k θ) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : tubeMap k θ w ∈ tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 4) :=
    tubeMap_mem_inner_of_norm_lt_quarter k θ hw
  have hgood : tubeMap k θ w ∈ tubeGood := innerTube_subset_tubeGood hinner
  have hwDiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (wCoord (m := m) k) (tubeMap k θ w) :=
    ((contDiffOn_wCoord k).contDiffAt (isOpen_tubeGood.mem_nhds hgood)).differentiableAt
      (by simp)
  have hwDeriv : HasFDerivAt (wCoord (m := m) k)
      (fderiv ℝ (wCoord k) (tubeMap k θ w)) (normalSlice k θ w) := by
    simpa only [normalSlice] using hwDiff.hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp := hwDeriv.comp w (hasFDerivAt_normalSlice k θ w)
  have hopen : IsOpen {u : F | ‖u‖ < 1 / 2} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_norm continuous_const
  have hwHalf : w ∈ {u : F | ‖u‖ < 1 / 2} :=
    hw.trans (by norm_num)
  have heq : ((wCoord (m := m) k) ∘ normalSlice k θ) =ᶠ[𝓝 w] id := by
    filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hwHalf] with u hu
    exact wCoord_tubeMap k θ (tubeA_pos k θ hu)
  have hid : HasFDerivAt ((wCoord (m := m) k) ∘ normalSlice k θ)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ F) w :=
    (hasFDerivAt_id (𝕜 := ℝ) w).congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  exact hcomp.unique hid

name: Submission.hasFDerivAt_tubeBridgeAmbient

proof:
:= by
  let c : E := WithLp.toLp 2 fun _ => 6
  have heq : tubeBridgeAmbient (m := m) =
      fun z : E => (12 : ℝ) • z - c := by
    funext z
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i

  rw [heq]

statement:

  intro y
  refine ⟨(12 : ℝ)⁻¹ • y, ?_⟩

name: Submission.surjective_fderiv_tubeBridgeLocalMap
proof:
:= by
  have hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ (tubeBridgeAmbient (m := m)) x :=
    (hasFDerivAt_tubeBridgeAmbient x).differentiableAt
  have hW : DifferentiableAt ℝ (wCoord (m := m) k) (tubeBridgeAmbient x) := by
    rw [hx]
    exact ((contDiffOn_wCoord k).contDiffAt
      (isOpen_tubeGood.mem_nhds
        (innerTube_subset_tubeGood
          (tubeMap_mem_inner_of_norm_lt_quarter k θ hw)))).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hC : DifferentiableAt ℝ (tubeHorizontalChart (m := m))
      (wCoord k (tubeBridgeAmbient x)) := by
    have hglobal : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tubeHorizontalChart (m := m)) := by
      simpa [tubeHorizontalChart] using
        (OpenPartialHomeomorph.contDiff_univUnitBall :
          ContDiff ℝ ∞ (OpenPartialHomeomorph.univUnitBall : F → F))
    exact hglobal.differentiable (by simp) _
  have hCW := fderiv_comp (x := tubeBridgeAmbient x) hC hW
  have hAll := fderiv_comp (x := x) (hC.comp _ hW) hA
  have hsurjA := surjective_fderiv_tubeBridgeAmbient x
  have hsurjW : Function.Surjective
      (fderiv ℝ (wCoord (m := m) k) (tubeBridgeAmbient x)) := by
    rw [hx]
    exact surjective_fderiv_wCoord_tubeMap k θ hw
  have hsurjC := surjective_fderiv_tubeHorizontalChart
    (wCoord k (tubeBridgeAmbient x))
  change Function.Surjective
    (fderiv ℝ ((tubeHorizontalChart ∘ wCoord k) ∘ tubeBridgeAmbient) x)
  rw [hAll, hCW]
  exact hsurjC.comp (hsurjW.comp hsurjA)

      tubeBridgeFrameHomotopyPoint k y p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hTube : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      tubeMap k p.2 (p.1 • tubeNorthOffset y) := by

        (p.2, p.1 • tubeNorthOffset y) := by

name: Submission.fderiv_tubeBridgeLocalMap_core
statement:
theorem fderiv_tubeBridgeLocalMap_core (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (tubeBridgeLocalMap (m := m) k) (tubeBridgeCorePoint k θ) =
      (fderiv ℝ (wCoord (m := m) k) (circleAt θ)).comp
        ((12 : ℝ) • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E)
proof:
:= by
  let x := tubeBridgeCorePoint (m := m) k θ
  have hxA : tubeBridgeAmbient x = circleAt θ :=
    tubeBridgeAmbient_corePoint k θ
  have hA : DifferentiableAt ℝ (tubeBridgeAmbient (m := m)) x :=
    (hasFDerivAt_tubeBridgeAmbient x).differentiableAt
  have hW : DifferentiableAt ℝ (wCoord (m := m) k) (circleAt θ) :=
    (contDiffAt_wCoord_circleAt k θ).differentiableAt (by simp)
  have hC0 : DifferentiableAt ℝ (tubeHorizontalChart (m := m)) 0 := by
    have hglobal : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tubeHorizontalChart (m := m)) := by
      simpa [tubeHorizontalChart] using
        (OpenPartialHomeomorph.contDiff_univUnitBall :
          ContDiff ℝ ∞ (OpenPartialHomeomorph.univUnitBall : F → F))
    exact hglobal.differentiable (by simp) 0
  have hC : DifferentiableAt ℝ (tubeHorizontalChart (m := m))
      (wCoord k (circleAt θ)) := by
    simpa [wCoord_circleAt] using hC0
  have hCW := fderiv_comp (x := circleAt θ) hC hW
  have hOuter : DifferentiableAt ℝ (tubeHorizontalChart ∘ wCoord k)
      (tubeBridgeAmbient x) := by
    rw [hxA]
    exact hC.comp _ hW
  have hAll := fderiv_comp (x := x) hOuter hA
  change fderiv ℝ ((tubeHorizontalChart ∘ wCoord k) ∘ tubeBridgeAmbient) x = _
  rw [hAll, hxA, hCW, wCoord_circleAt, fderiv_tubeHorizontalChart_zero,
    (hasFDerivAt_tubeBridgeAmbient x).fderiv]
  simp

      real_inner_smul_left, inner_neg_right, inner_nuVec_tangentAt,

    det_rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame]
  have hprod : 0 < ∏ i : Fin (m + 3),

name: Submission.tauField_tubeExplicitBridge_core
statement:
theorem tauField_tubeExplicitBridge_core (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    tauField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls.g
        (tubeBridgeCorePoint k θ) =
      -(tangentAt θ)
proof:
:= by
  let B := tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k
  let x := tubeBridgeCorePoint (m := m) k θ
  let g := B.fls.g
  have hreg : x ∈ regularSet g := by
    change Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ g x)
    change Function.Surjective
      (fderiv ℝ (fun z : E =>
        bridgeHMapE (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) z - B.y) x)
    rw [fderiv_sub_const,
      fderiv_bridgeHMapE_tubeApproximation_eq_local k
        (tubeBridgeAmbient_corePoint_mem_inner k θ)]
    apply surjective_fderiv_tubeBridgeLocalMap k θ
      (w := (0 : F)) (by norm_num)
    simpa [x, tubeMap_zero] using tubeBridgeAmbient_corePoint (m := m) k θ
  have hgrads : (fun i => gradVec g i x) =
      fun i => (12 : ℝ) • nuVec (m := m) k θ i := by
    funext i
    exact gradVec_tubeExplicitBridge_core k θ i
  have hdetNeg : 0 < crossDet (fun i => gradVec g i x) (-(tangentAt θ)) := by
    rw [hgrads]
    have hrows : crossRows (fun i => (12 : ℝ) • nuVec (m := m) k θ i)
        (-(tangentAt θ)) = rowsMatrix (tubeBridgeScaledFullFrame m k θ) := by
      ext i j
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩ <;>
        simp [crossRows, rowsMatrix, tubeBridgeScaledFullFrame]
    rw [crossDet, hrows]
    exact det_rowsMatrix_tubeBridgeScaledFullFrame_pos m k θ
  have hkernel : fderiv ℝ g x (-(tangentAt θ)) = 0 := by
    rw [map_neg, fderiv_tubeExplicitBridge_core_tangentAt, neg_zero]
  have hmem : -(tangentAt θ) ∈
      Submodule.span ℝ {tauField g x} :=
    (fderiv_eq_zero_iff_mem_span_tauField hreg _).mp hkernel
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
  have hdetTau : 0 < crossDet (fun i => gradVec g i x) (tauField g x) :=
    crossDet_tauField_pos hreg
  have hdetEq := congrArg (crossDet (fun i => gradVec g i x)) ha
  rw [crossDet_smul] at hdetEq
  have hprod : 0 < a * crossDet (fun i => gradVec g i x) (tauField g x) := by
    rw [hdetEq]
    exact hdetNeg
  have haPos : 0 < a := by
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hprod with hp | hn
    · exact hp.1
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt hdetTau)) hn.2)
  have hnormEq := congrArg norm ha
  rw [norm_smul, norm_tauField hreg, mul_one, norm_neg, norm_tangentAt,
    Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos haPos] at hnormEq
  have haOne : a = 1 := hnormEq
  rw [haOne, one_smul] at ha
  exact ha

    norm_smul_tubeNorthOffset_lt_quarter y hy hs0 hs1
  have hxA : tubeBridgeAmbient x = tubeMap k θ (s • tubeNorthOffset y) :=
    tubeBridgeAmbient_frameHomotopyPoint k y s θ

    rw [hxA]

    surjective_fderiv_tubeBridgeLocalMap k θ hw hxA

    (fderiv ℝ (fun z : E =>
      bridgeHMapE (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) z -

name: Submission.continuous_tubeBridgeFrameHomotopyCurve
statement:
theorem continuous_tubeBridgeFrameHomotopyCurve (k : ℕ) (y : F) :
    Continuous (tubeBridgeFrameHomotopyCurve (m := m) k y)
proof:
:= by
  have hparam : Continuous fun p : I × I =>
      ((p.1 : ℝ), 2 * Real.pi * (p.2 : ℝ)) := by
    fun_prop
  unfold tubeBridgeFrameHomotopyCurve tubeBridgeFrameHomotopyPoint
  apply (PiLp.continuous_toLp (2 : ENNReal)
    (fun _ : Fin (m + 3) => ℝ)).comp
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  have hi := (((EuclideanSpace.proj i : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_tubeBridgeFrameHomotopyPoint k y)).continuous.comp hparam)
  change Continuous fun p : I × I =>
    tubeBridgeFrameHomotopyPoint k y (p.1 : ℝ)
      (2 * Real.pi * (p.2 : ℝ)) i at hi
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, tubeBridgeFrameHomotopyPoint_apply] using hi

name: Submission.tubeBridgeFrameHomotopyCurve_mem_regularSet

name: Submission.tubeBridgeFrameHomotopyCurve_closed

name: Submission.LocalMorseNormalForm.exists_radius_param_mem
statement:
theorem exists_radius_param_mem {U : Set E₂} (hU : U ∈ nhds (0 : E₂)) :
    ∃ r > 0, r ≤ M.radius ∧ ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r → M.param u ∈ U
proof:
:= by
  have hpre : M.param ⁻¹' U ∈ nhds (0 : E₂) := M.param_tendsto_zero hU
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hpre
  let r := min ε M.radius
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hε M.radius_pos
  refine ⟨r, hr, min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  apply hball
  rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
  exact hu.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)

proof:
:= by
  have hk : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : ℕ∞ω) M.param 0 :=
    contDiffAt_infty.mp M.param_contDiffAt k
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hparam⟩ := hk.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU
  let r := min ε M.radius
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hε M.radius_pos
  refine ⟨r, hr, min_le_right _ _, hparam.mono ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  apply hball
  rw [mem_ball] at hu ⊢
  exact hu.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)

name: Submission.LocalMorseNormalForm.fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero_local
statement:
private theorem fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero_local
    {g : E₂ → ℝ} {p : E₂} (hgrad : chartGradient g p = 0) :
    fderiv ℝ g p = 0
proof:
:= by
  let A : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := fderiv ℝ g p
  have hA1 : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A 1 = 0 := by
    simpa [chartGradient, scalarAdjointCLM, A] using hgrad
  have hAadj : ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A = 0 := by
    apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
    intro r
    calc
      ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A r =
          r • ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A 1 := by
        rw [← map_smul]
        simp
      _ = 0 := by rw [hA1, smul_zero]
  apply ContinuousLinearMap.ext
  intro v
  have hinner := ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_left A v (1 : ℝ)
  rw [hAadj] at hinner
  simpa [A] using hinner.symm

name: Submission.LocalMorseNormalForm.eq_zero_of_fderiv_const_add_morseQuadratic_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_fderiv_const_add_morseQuadratic_eq_zero
    (e : MorseIndexTwo) (c : ℝ) (u : E₂)
    (hzero : fderiv ℝ
      (fun z : E₂ => c + morseQuadratic e (z 0, z 1)) u = 0) :
    u = 0
proof:
:= by
  let p0 : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  have hp0 : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E₂ => z 0) p0 u := by
    simpa [p0] using (p0.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt p0 p0 u)
  have hp1 : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E₂ => z 1) p1 u := by
    simpa [p1] using (p1.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt p1 p1 u)
  have hs0 := hp0.mul hp0
  have hs1 := hp1.mul hp1
  have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun _ : E₂ => c) (0 : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) u :=
    hasFDerivAt_const c u
  cases e with
  | minimum =>
      simp only [morseQuadratic, pow_two] at hzero
      have hmodel := hc.add (hs0.add hs1)
      have hfd := hmodel.fderiv
      change fderiv ℝ
        (fun z : E₂ => c + (z 0 * z 0 + z 1 * z 1)) u = _ at hfd
      have h0 := congrArg
        (fun L : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1)) hzero
      have h1 := congrArg
        (fun L : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1)) hzero
      rw [hfd] at h0 h1
      simp [p0, p1] at h0 h1
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · simpa using h0
      · simpa using h1
  | saddle =>
      simp only [morseQuadratic, pow_two] at hzero
      have hmodel := hc.add (hs0.sub hs1)
      have hfd := hmodel.fderiv
      change fderiv ℝ
        (fun z : E₂ => c + (z 0 * z 0 - z 1 * z 1)) u = _ at hfd
      have h0 := congrArg
        (fun L : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1)) hzero
      have h1 := congrArg
        (fun L : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1)) hzero
      rw [hfd] at h0 h1
      simp [p0, p1] at h0 h1
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · simpa using h0
      · simpa using h1
  | maximum =>
      simp only [morseQuadratic, pow_two] at hzero
      have hmodel := hc.add (hs0.neg.sub hs1)
      have hfd := hmodel.fderiv
      change fderiv ℝ
        (fun z : E₂ => c + (-(z 0 * z 0) - z 1 * z 1)) u = _ at hfd
      have h0 := congrArg
        (fun L : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1)) hzero
      have h1 := congrArg
        (fun L : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L (EuclideanSpace.single 1 1)) hzero
      rw [hfd] at h0 h1
      simp [p0, p1] at h0 h1
      ext i
      fin_cases i
      · simpa using h0
      · simpa using h1

name: Submission.LocalMorseNormalForm.chartGradient_shifted_param_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem chartGradient_shifted_param_eq_zero_iff
    {g : E₂ → ℝ} {base : E₂}
    (M : LocalMorseNormalForm (recenter g base))
    (hg : Differentiable ℝ g)
    (hcrit : chartGradient g base = 0)
    (r : ℝ) (hrM : r ≤ M.radius)
    (hparam : ∀ z : E₂, ‖z‖ < r → DifferentiableAt ℝ M.param z)
    (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < r) :
    chartGradient g (base + M.param u) = 0 ↔ u = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hgrad
    have hfdg : fderiv ℝ g (base + M.param u) = 0 :=
      fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero_local hgrad
    have hinner : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun z : E₂ => base + M.param z) u :=
      ((hasFDerivAt_const base u).add (hparam u hu).hasFDerivAt).differentiableAt
    have hcomp := (hg (base + M.param u)).hasFDerivAt.comp u hinner.hasFDerivAt
    have hleft : fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => g (base + M.param z)) u = 0 := by
      change fderiv ℝ (g ∘ fun z : E₂ => base + M.param z) u = 0
      rw [hcomp.fderiv, hfdg]
      simp
    have huball : u ∈ ball (0 : E₂) r := by
      simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have heq : (fun z : E₂ => g (base + M.param z)) =ᶠ[nhds u]
        (fun z : E₂ => g base + morseQuadratic M.index (z 0, z 1)) := by
      filter_upwards [isOpen_ball.mem_nhds huball] with z hz
      have hzr : ‖z‖ < r := by
        simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hz
      simpa [recenter] using M.exact z (hzr.trans_le hrM)
    have hright : fderiv ℝ
        (fun z : E₂ => g base + morseQuadratic M.index (z 0, z 1)) u = 0 := by
      rw [← heq.fderiv_eq]
      exact hleft
    exact eq_zero_of_fderiv_const_add_morseQuadratic_eq_zero
      M.index (g base) u hright
  · rintro rfl
    simpa [M.param_zero] using hcrit

name: Submission.LocalMorseNormalForm.nonempty_simultaneousShrink
statement:
theorem nonempty_simultaneousShrink
    {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    (base : E₂) (surface : E₂ → A) (hsurface : ContinuousAt surface base)
    {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (parameterSet : ι → Set E₂) (liftedSet : κ → Set A)
    (hparameter : ∀ i, parameterSet i ∈ nhds base)
    (hlifted : ∀ j, liftedSet j ∈ nhds (surface base)) :
    Nonempty (M.SimultaneousShrink base surface parameterSet liftedSet)
proof:
:= by
  let shifted : E₂ → E₂ := fun u => base + M.param u
  have hshift : Tendsto shifted (nhds (0 : E₂)) (nhds base) := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt shifted 0 :=
      continuousAt_const.add M.param_continuousAt
    change Tendsto shifted (nhds 0) (nhds (shifted 0)) at hc
    simpa only [shifted, M.param_zero, add_zero] using hc
  have hlift : Tendsto (fun u => surface (shifted u)) (nhds (0 : E₂))
      (nhds (surface base)) := by
    have hs : Tendsto surface (nhds base) (nhds (surface base)) := hsurface
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using hs.comp hshift
  have hparameterAll : ∀ᶠ u in nhds (0 : E₂), ∀ i, shifted u ∈ parameterSet i :=
    Filter.eventually_all.mpr fun i => hshift (hparameter i)
  have hliftedAll : ∀ᶠ u in nhds (0 : E₂), ∀ j, surface (shifted u) ∈ liftedSet j :=
    Filter.eventually_all.mpr fun j => hlift (hlifted j)
  have hboth : {u : E₂ | (∀ i, shifted u ∈ parameterSet i) ∧
      (∀ j, surface (shifted u) ∈ liftedSet j)} ∈ nhds (0 : E₂) :=
    hparameterAll.and hliftedAll
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hboth
  let r := min ε M.radius
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hε M.radius_pos
  refine ⟨{
    radius := r
    radius_pos := hr
    radius_le := min_le_right _ _
    shifted_mem := ?_
    lifted_mem := ?_ }⟩
  · intro i u hu
    exact (hball (by
      rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact hu.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))).1 i
  · intro j u hu
    exact (hball (by
      rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact hu.trans_le (min_le_left _ _))).2 j

name: Submission.LocalMorseNormalForm.exists_simultaneousShrink_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem exists_simultaneousShrink_contDiffOn
    {A : Type*} [TopologicalSpace A]
    (k : ℕ) (base : E₂) (surface : E₂ → A)
    (hsurface : ContinuousAt surface base)
    {ι κ : Type*} [Finite ι] [Finite κ]
    (parameterSet : ι → Set E₂) (liftedSet : κ → Set A)
    (hparameter : ∀ i, parameterSet i ∈ nhds base)
    (hlifted : ∀ j, liftedSet j ∈ nhds (surface base)) :
    ∃ S : M.SimultaneousShrink base surface parameterSet liftedSet,
      ContDiffOn ℝ (k : ℕ∞ω) M.param (ball (0 : E₂) S.radius)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨S₀⟩ := M.nonempty_simultaneousShrink base surface hsurface
    parameterSet liftedSet hparameter hlifted
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrM, hsmooth⟩ := M.exists_radius_param_contDiffOn k
  let r' := min S₀.radius r
  have hr' : 0 < r' := lt_min S₀.radius_pos hr
  let S := SimultaneousShrink.shrink M S₀ r' hr' (min_le_left _ _)
  refine ⟨S, hsmooth.mono ?_⟩
  intro u hu

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeEntryChain.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_chain₃
statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_chain₃
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (C₁ C₂ : FramedLevelSet (m + 2))
    (h₁ : DefiningMapHomotopy
      (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁ C₁)
    (h₂ : DefiningMapHomotopy C₁ C₂)
    (h₃ : DefiningMapHomotopy C₂
      (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:= by
  refine SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
    ⟨h₁.signedCobordism (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)⟩
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
      ⟨h₂.signedCobordism
        ((gaugeEndpointSign hm M F).restrict h₁.fiber_subset)⟩
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
        ⟨h₃.signedCobordism
          (((gaugeEndpointSign hm M F).restrict h₁.fiber_subset).restrict
            h₂.fiber_subset)⟩
        (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
          ⟨signInterpolationCobordism
            ((((gaugeEndpointSign hm M F).restrict h₁.fiber_subset).restrict
                h₂.fiber_subset).restrict h₃.fiber_subset)
            ((firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointSign
              (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
            ?_⟩
          (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_symm
            ⟨(firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).signedCobordism
              (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign⟩))))
  intro x hx
  rw [(firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpoint_fiber] at hx
  obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  simpa using
    ConcreteConfigurationFirstHeadPlacedGaugeEntry.PlacedGaugeHomotopy.gaugeEndpointSign_pos_iff_firstPlacement
      (B := B) (hm := hm) (M := M) (F := F) P hxP

name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_rebasedBandCapture
statement:
theorem productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_rebasedBandCapture
    {a : ℕ} (KW : ProductionMorseSaddleRebasedBandWindingInputs a) :
    ProductionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies a
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y SX SY SC D t ht hpositive hindex
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  obtain ⟨Vpos⟩ := (D.shortAfterSlice t ht hb hbw).exists_tamedField
  obtain ⟨Vneg⟩ := (D.shortBeforeSlice t ht hb hbw).exists_tamedField
  have hdim : 3 ≤ a + 2 + 1 := by omega
  have hcircle := productionMorseSaddleChartCircleFrameClassOne a
    (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  constructor
  · intro Htop
    have hposEq :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      apply (D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw Vpos).injective
      rw [D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.positive]
      exact Htop.positive_eq
    have hnegNe :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg ≠
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      intro heq'
      apply Htop.negative_ne
      rw [← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.positive, heq']
    have hsplice : ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
        Vpos.orbitFrameClass
            ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
              (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
              (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
              (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) =
          Vneg.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) +
            Vneg.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) + 1 := by
      obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov⟩ :=
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).exists_rebasedMergeBand
          hindex (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) hb
          (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
          (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
          (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg Vpos
          (D.bandTimeField t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_flowDistance_lt t ht)
          (D.bandCoverRadius_cover t ht)
          (fun x hx ht' hf d hd => D.bandExterior_tcoord_flow_after t ht hb hbw
            x hx ht' hf d hd)
          (fun p hfar => D.flowedPositiveBoundaryEnd_mem_negativeBranchOrbit
            t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg p
            (D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale_positive_close t ht p) hfar)
          hnegNe hposEq
      obtain ⟨W⟩ := (KW SC D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos e₁ e₂).1 F hprov
      obtain ⟨H, hregH, hHclosed⟩ :=
        exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartWindingLoop
          (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) W
      have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) F H
        hregH hHclosed
      exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab,
        orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim F
          (F.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
            (hF.trans hcircle))⟩
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, hsp⟩ := hsplice
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg]
    cases e₁ <;> cases e₂ <;>
      first
        | exact absurd rfl hlab
        | exact hsp
        | (rw [hsp]; ring)
  · intro Htop
    have hnegEq :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      apply (D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw Vneg).injective
      rw [D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.positive]
      exact Htop.negative_eq
    have hposNe :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos ≠
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      intro heq'
      apply Htop.positive_ne
      rw [← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.positive, heq']
    have hsplice : ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
        Vneg.orbitFrameClass
            ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
              (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
              (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
              (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) =
          Vpos.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) +
            Vpos.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) + 1 := by
      obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov⟩ :=
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).exists_rebasedSplitBand
          hindex (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) hb
          (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
          (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
          (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos Vneg
          (D.bandTimeField t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_flowDistance_lt t ht)
          (D.bandCoverRadius_cover t ht)
          (fun x hx ht' hf d hd => D.bandExterior_tcoord_flow_before t ht hb
            hbw x hx ht' hf d hd)
          (fun p hfar => D.flowedNegativeBoundaryEnd_mem_positiveBranchOrbit
            t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos p
            (D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale_negative_close t ht p) hfar)
          hposNe hnegEq
      obtain ⟨W⟩ := (KW SC D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos e₁ e₂).2 F hprov
      obtain ⟨H, hregH, hHclosed⟩ :=
        exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartWindingLoop
          (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) W
      have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) F H
        hregH hHclosed
      exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab,
        orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim F
          (F.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
            (hF.trans hcircle))⟩
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, hsp⟩ := hsplice
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos]
    cases e₁ <;> cases e₂ <;>
      first
        | exact absurd rfl hlab
        | exact hsp
        | (rw [hsp]; ring)

name: Submission.definiteCircleParam_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem definiteCircleParam_apply_zero (a theta : ℝ) :
    definiteCircleParam a theta 0 = a * Real.cos theta
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.definiteCircleParam_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem definiteCircleParam_apply_one (a theta : ℝ) :
    definiteCircleParam a theta 1 = a * Real.sin theta
proof:
:= by
  simp [definiteCircleParam]

name: Submission.norm_definiteCircleParam_sq
statement:
theorem norm_definiteCircleParam_sq (a theta : ℝ) :
    ‖definiteCircleParam a theta‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [definiteCircleParam, norm_pairToMorseParam_sq]
  change (a * Real.cos theta) ^ 2 + (a * Real.sin theta) ^ 2 = a ^ 2
  calc
    (a * Real.cos theta) ^ 2 + (a * Real.sin theta) ^ 2 =
        a ^ 2 * (Real.sin theta ^ 2 + Real.cos theta ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = a ^ 2 := by rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq, mul_one]

name: Submission.norm_definiteCircleParam
statement:
theorem norm_definiteCircleParam {a theta : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    ‖definiteCircleParam a theta‖ = a
proof:
:= by
  have hsq := norm_definiteCircleParam_sq a theta
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (definiteCircleParam a theta)]

name: Submission.definiteCircleParam_ne_zero
statement:
theorem definiteCircleParam_ne_zero {a theta : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    definiteCircleParam a theta ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hsq := norm_definiteCircleParam_sq a theta
  rw [hzero, norm_zero] at hsq
  have ha2 : a ^ 2 = 0 := by nlinarith
  have haa : a * a = 0 := by simpa [pow_two] using ha2
  exact ha (mul_self_eq_zero.mp haa)

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_minimum_definiteCircleParam
statement:
theorem morseQuadratic_minimum_definiteCircleParam (a theta : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .minimum
        (definiteCircleParam a theta 0, definiteCircleParam a theta 1) =
      a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  simp only [morseQuadratic, definiteCircleParam_apply_zero,
    definiteCircleParam_apply_one]
  calc
    (a * Real.cos theta) ^ 2 + (a * Real.sin theta) ^ 2 =
        a ^ 2 * (Real.sin theta ^ 2 + Real.cos theta ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = a ^ 2 := by rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq, mul_one]

name: Submission.morseQuadratic_maximum_definiteCircleParam
statement:
theorem morseQuadratic_maximum_definiteCircleParam (a theta : ℝ) :
    morseQuadratic .maximum
        (definiteCircleParam a theta 0, definiteCircleParam a theta 1) =
      -(a ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [morseQuadratic, definiteCircleParam_apply_zero,
    definiteCircleParam_apply_one]
  rw [show -(a * Real.cos theta) ^ 2 - (a * Real.sin theta) ^ 2 =
      -((a * Real.cos theta) ^ 2 + (a * Real.sin theta) ^ 2) by ring]
  rw [show (a * Real.cos theta) ^ 2 + (a * Real.sin theta) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 by
    calc
      (a * Real.cos theta) ^ 2 + (a * Real.sin theta) ^ 2 =
          a ^ 2 * (Real.sin theta ^ 2 + Real.cos theta ^ 2) := by ring
      _ = a ^ 2 := by rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq, mul_one]]

name: Submission.definiteCircleParam_eq_iff_mod
statement:
theorem definiteCircleParam_eq_iff_mod {a theta theta' : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0)
    (h : definiteCircleParam a theta = definiteCircleParam a theta') :
    ∃ z : ℤ, theta' = theta + (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have hcos : Real.cos theta = Real.cos theta' := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ ha
    simpa using congrArg (fun x : E₂ => x 0) h
  have hsin : Real.sin theta = Real.sin theta' := by
    apply mul_left_cancel₀ ha
    simpa using congrArg (fun x : E₂ => x 1) h
  have hone : Real.cos (theta' - theta) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.cos_sub, ← hcos, ← hsin]
    linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff _).mp hone
  exact ⟨z, by linarith⟩

name: Submission.definiteCircleParamCurve_eq_cases
proof:
:= by
  change definiteCircleParam a (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) =
    definiteCircleParam a (2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)) at huv
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := definiteCircleParam_eq_iff_mod ha huv
  have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
  have huvZ : (v : ℝ) = (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) := by
    change 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ) =
      2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) at hz
    nlinarith
  have hzLowerR : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  have hzUpperR : (z : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
  have hzLower : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast hzLowerR
  have hzUpper : z ≤ (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hzUpperR
  rcases (show z = -1 ∨ z = 0 ∨ z = 1 by omega) with hzv | hzv | hzv
  · right; right
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hzv] at huvZ
    norm_num at huvZ
    exact huvZ.symm
  · right; left
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteCircle_regular

      (spatialDeriv (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G

  · exact definiteCircleParam_ne_zero ha.ne'

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.exists_radius_for_actual_minimum_circle_tangent_comparison
statement:
theorem exists_radius_for_actual_minimum_circle_tangent_comparison
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum) :
    ∃ r > 0, r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius ∧
      ∀ (a theta : ℝ), 0 < a → a < r →
        ∃ c : ℝ, c ≠ 0 ∧
          c • tauField
              (sliceMap (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
                (tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta)))
              (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta)) =
            spacePart (fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp)
              (definiteCircleParam a theta)
              (definiteCircleTangentParam a theta))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrle, hcompare⟩ :=
    R.exists_radius_for_actual_morse_tangent_comparison p hp
  refine ⟨r, hr, hrle, ?_⟩
  intro a theta ha har
  have hu : ‖definiteCircleParam a theta‖ < r := by
    rw [norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact har
  have hquad : morseQuadratic (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index
      ((definiteCircleParam a theta) 0,
        (definiteCircleParam a theta) 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hindex, morseQuadratic_minimum_definiteCircleParam]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 ha.ne'
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hctau⟩ := hcompare _ hu hquad
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  simpa [criticalDefiniteCircle, hindex,
    morseLevelTangent_minimum_definiteCircleParam] using hctau

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.exists_radius_for_actual_maximum_circle_tangent_comparison
statement:
theorem exists_radius_for_actual_maximum_circle_tangent_comparison
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .maximum) :
    ∃ r > 0, r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius ∧
      ∀ (a theta : ℝ), 0 < a → a < r →
        ∃ c : ℝ, c ≠ 0 ∧
          c • tauField
              (sliceMap (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
                (tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta)))
              (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta)) =
            spacePart (fderiv ℝ (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp)
              (definiteCircleParam a theta)
              (-definiteCircleTangentParam a theta))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrle, hcompare⟩ :=
    R.exists_radius_for_actual_morse_tangent_comparison p hp
  refine ⟨r, hr, hrle, ?_⟩
  intro a theta ha har
  have hu : ‖definiteCircleParam a theta‖ < r := by
    rw [norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact har
  have hquad : morseQuadratic (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index
      ((definiteCircleParam a theta) 0,
        (definiteCircleParam a theta) 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hindex, morseQuadratic_maximum_definiteCircleParam]
    exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (pow_ne_zero 2 ha.ne')
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hctau⟩ := hcompare _ hu hquad
  refine ⟨c, hc, ?_⟩
  simpa [criticalDefiniteCircle, hindex,
    morseLevelTangent_maximum_definiteCircleParam] using hctau

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalMinimumCircle_time
statement:
theorem criticalMinimumCircle_time
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    {a theta : ℝ} (ha : 0 ≤ a)
    (hrad : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius) :
    tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta) =
      G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + a ^ 2
proof:

    R.criticalSurfaceParam_time p hp _ (by
      rw [norm_definiteCircleParam ha]

    morseQuadratic_minimum_definiteCircleParam]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalMaximumCircle_time

theorem criticalMaximumCircle_time
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteCircleCurve_closed
statement:
theorem criticalDefiniteCircleCurve_closed
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hrad : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius) :
    R.criticalDefiniteCircleCurve p hp a ha hrad 0 =
      R.criticalDefiniteCircleCurve p hp a ha hrad 1

  rw [definiteCircleParamCurve_closed]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalMinimumSpatialCircle_eq_cases
statement:
theorem criticalMinimumSpatialCircle_eq_cases
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    {r a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hrad : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius) (har : a < r)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) (Metric.ball 0 r))
    {u v : I}
    (huv : R.criticalDefiniteSpatialCircle p hp a ha hrad u =
      R.criticalDefiniteSpatialCircle p hp a ha hrad v) :
    u = v ∨ (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let thetaU : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)
  let thetaV : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)
  change spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaU) =
    spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaV) at huv
  have htimeU := R.criticalMinimumCircle_time p hp hindex
    (theta := thetaU) ha.le hrad
  have htimeV := R.criticalMinimumCircle_time p hp hindex
    (theta := thetaV) ha.le hrad
  have hamb : R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaU =
      R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaV := by
    calc
      R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaU =
          cobSpaceTime
            (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaU))
            (tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaU)) :=
        (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime
            (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaV))
            (tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaV)) := by
        rw [huv, htimeU, htimeV]
      _ = R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaV :=
        spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hmemU : definiteCircleParam a thetaU ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E₂) r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact har
  have hmemV : definiteCircleParam a thetaV ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E₂) r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact har
  have hparam : definiteCircleParam a thetaU =
      definiteCircleParam a thetaV := by
    exact hinj hmemU hmemV hamb
  apply definiteCircleParamCurve_eq_cases ha.ne'
  exact hparam

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalMaximumSpatialCircle_eq_cases
statement:
theorem criticalMaximumSpatialCircle_eq_cases
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .maximum)
    {r a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hrad : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius) (har : a < r)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) (Metric.ball 0 r))
    {u v : I}
    (huv : R.criticalDefiniteSpatialCircle p hp a ha hrad u =
      R.criticalDefiniteSpatialCircle p hp a ha hrad v) :
    u = v ∨ (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  let thetaU : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)
  let thetaV : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)
  change spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaU) =
    spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaV) at huv
  have htimeU := R.criticalMaximumCircle_time p hp hindex
    (theta := thetaU) ha.le hrad
  have htimeV := R.criticalMaximumCircle_time p hp hindex
    (theta := thetaV) ha.le hrad
  have hamb : R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaU =
      R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaV := by
    calc
      R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaU =
          cobSpaceTime
            (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaU))
            (tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaU)) :=
        (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime
            (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaV))
            (tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaV)) := by
        rw [huv, htimeU, htimeV]
      _ = R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a thetaV :=
        spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hmemU : definiteCircleParam a thetaU ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E₂) r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact har
  have hmemV : definiteCircleParam a thetaV ∈ Metric.ball (0 : E₂) r := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_definiteCircleParam ha.le]
    exact har
  have hparam : definiteCircleParam a thetaU =
      definiteCircleParam a thetaV := by
    exact hinj hmemU hmemV hamb
  apply definiteCircleParamCurve_eq_cases ha.ne'
  exact hparam

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalMinimumSpatialCircle_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem criticalMinimumSpatialCircle_mem_fiber
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a)
    (hrad : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
      (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + a ^ 2)) (u : I) :
    R.criticalDefiniteSpatialCircle p hp a ha hrad u ∈
      (R.criticalMinimumPositiveSlice p hp a hreg).fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [criticalMinimumPositiveSlice, SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber]
  change (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
    (cobSpaceTime
      (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircleCurve p hp a ha hrad u))
      (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + a ^ 2)) = 0
  change (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
    (cobSpaceTime
      (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a
        (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))
      (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + a ^ 2)) = 0
  rw [← R.criticalMinimumCircle_time p hp hindex
      (theta := 2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) ha.le hrad,
    spaceTime_spacePart]
  exact R.criticalDefiniteCircle_fiber p hp
    (theta := 2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) ha.le hrad

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalMaximumSpatialCircle_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem criticalMaximumSpatialCircle_mem_fiber
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)

    (cobSpaceTime
      (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a
        (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))
      (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 - a ^ 2)) = 0

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.exists_radius_for_criticalMinimumSimpleClosedOrbitParam
statement:
theorem exists_radius_for_criticalMinimumSimpleClosedOrbitParam
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum) :
    ∃ r > 0, r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius ∧
      ∀ (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < r)
        (hreg : sliceRegular
          (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
          (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + a ^ 2))
        (V : TamedField (R.criticalMinimumPositiveSlice p hp a hreg)),
        Nonempty (SimpleClosedOrbitParam
          (R.criticalMinimumPositiveSlice p hp a hreg) V)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrle, hinj⟩ :=
    R.exists_criticalSurfaceParam_injOn_radius p hp
  refine ⟨r, hr, hrle, ?_⟩
  intro a ha har hreg V
  let hrad : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius := har.trans_le hrle
  let P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam
      (R.criticalMinimumPositiveSlice p hp a hreg) V := {
    p := R.criticalDefiniteSpatialCircle p hp a ha hrad 0
    hp := R.criticalMinimumSpatialCircle_mem_fiber p hp hindex
      a ha hrad hreg 0
    curve := R.criticalDefiniteSpatialCircle p hp a ha hrad
    curve_zero := rfl
    curve_closed := by
      exact congrArg spacePart
        (R.criticalDefiniteCircleCurve_closed p hp a ha hrad)
    curve_mem_orbit := fun u =>
      R.criticalMinimumSpatialCircle_mem_same_orbit p hp hindex
        a ha hrad hreg V u
    curve_eq_cases := by
      intro u v huv
      exact R.criticalMinimumSpatialCircle_eq_cases p hp hindex
        ha hrad har hinj huv
  }
  exact ⟨P⟩

name: Submission.fderiv_chartGradient_chartLinearTilt
statement:
theorem fderiv_chartGradient_chartLinearTilt {f : E₂ → ℝ}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (q u : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (chartGradient (chartLinearTilt f q)) u =
      fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) u
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : chartGradient (chartLinearTilt f q) =
      fun z => chartGradient f z - q := by
    funext z
    exact chartGradient_chartLinearTilt (hf.differentiable (by simp)) q z
  rw [hfun]
  exact (((contDiff_chartGradient hf).differentiable (by simp) u).hasFDerivAt.sub_const q).fderiv

proof:

name: Submission.exists_genericChartTilt
statement:
theorem exists_genericChartTilt {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    {K : Set E₂} (hK : IsCompact K) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ T : GenericChartTilt f K, T.q ∈ ball (0 : E₂) ε
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q, hqsmall, hqreg⟩ := exists_small_regular_chartGradient hf hε
  refine ⟨{
    q := q
    tilted := chartLinearTilt f q
    tilted_eq := rfl
    q_regular := hqreg
    critical_finite := ?_
    critical_nondegenerate := ?_ }, hqsmall⟩
  · rw [chartCritical_linearTilt (hf.differentiable (by simp))]
    exact finite_regularValue_preimage_inter_compact
      (contDiff_chartGradient hf) hqreg hK
  · intro u hu
    have hgrad : chartGradient f u = q := by
      have hmem : u ∈ chartGradient f ⁻¹' ({q} : Set E₂) := by
        rw [← chartCritical_linearTilt (hf.differentiable (by simp))]
        exact hu.1
      simpa using hmem
    have hsurj : Surjective (fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) u) := hqreg u hgrad
    have hinj : Injective (fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) u) :=
      LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mpr hsurj
    refine ⟨hu.1, ?_⟩
    rw [fderiv_chartGradient_chartLinearTilt hf]
    exact ⟨hinj, hsurj⟩

name: Submission.exists_close_injective_on_finset
statement:
theorem exists_close_injective_on_finset {α : Type*} (s : Finset α)
    (v : α → ℝ) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ w : α → ℝ, (∀ a ∈ s, |w a - v a| < ε) ∧ Set.InjOn w (s : Set α)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      refine ⟨v, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · intro a ha
        simp at ha
  | @insert a s ha ih =>
      obtain ⟨w, hwclose, hwinj⟩ := ih
      let used : Finset ℝ := s.image w
      have hinterval : (Ioo (v a - ε) (v a + ε)).Infinite :=
        Set.Ioo_infinite (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨y, hy, hyused⟩ := hinterval.exists_notMem_finset used
      let w' : α → ℝ := Function.update w a y
      refine ⟨w', ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro b hb
        rcases Finset.mem_insert.mp hb with hba | hb
        · subst b
          simp only [w', Function.update_self]
          exact (abs_lt).2 ⟨by linarith [hy.1], by linarith [hy.2]⟩
        · have hba : b ≠ a := fun h => ha (h ▸ hb)
          simpa [w', hba] using hwclose b hb
      · intro b hb c hc hbc
        have hb' := Finset.mem_insert.mp hb
        have hc' := Finset.mem_insert.mp hc
        rcases hb' with hbaEq | hbS
        · subst b
          rcases hc' with hcaEq | hcS
          · exact hcaEq.symm
          · exfalso
            have hca : c ≠ a := fun h => ha (h ▸ hcS)
            have hbc' : y = w c := by simpa [w', hca] using hbc
            apply hyused
            change y ∈ s.image w
            exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨c, hcS, hbc'.symm⟩
        · rcases hc' with hcaEq | hcS
          · exfalso
            subst c
            have hba : b ≠ a := fun h => ha (h ▸ hbS)
            have hbc' : w b = y := by simpa [w', hba] using hbc
            apply hyused
            change y ∈ s.image w
            exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨b, hbS, hbc'⟩
          · have hba : b ≠ a := fun h => ha (h ▸ hbS)
            have hca : c ≠ a := fun h => ha (h ▸ hcS)
            have hbc' : w b = w c := by simpa [w', hba, hca] using hbc
            exact hwinj hbS hcS hbc'

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.verticalShift_time_eq_chartLinearTilt
statement:
theorem verticalShift_time_eq_chartLinearTilt
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)
    {K U : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (q : E₂) {u : E₂}
    (hud : u ∈ P.domain) (hu : P.param u ∈ K) :
    tcoord (verticalShift (P.ambientTiltRaw χ q) (P.param u)) =
      chartLinearTilt P.time q u
proof:
:= by
  rw [tcoord_verticalShift]
  have hamp : P.ambientTiltRaw χ q (P.param u) = -(innerSL ℝ q) u := by
    rw [ambientTiltRaw, χ.localize_affineJet_eq _ _ _ hu]
    change -(P.liftCovector q (P.param u - P.center)) + 0 = -((innerSL ℝ q) u)
    rw [P.lift_param q u hud, add_zero]
  rw [hamp]
  rw [chartLinearTilt, time, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.verticalShift_time_eq_chartLinearTilt_add_const

    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)
    {K U : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (q : E₂) (c : ℝ) {u : E₂}

      -(innerSL ℝ q) u + c := by
    rw [ambientEventRaw, χ.localize_affineJet_eq _ _ _ hu]
    change -(P.liftCovector q (P.param u - P.center)) + c =
      -((innerSL ℝ q) u) + c
    rw [P.lift_param q u hud]
  rw [hamp]
  rw [chartLinearTilt, time, sub_eq_add_neg]

name: Submission.exists_genericFiniteIFTAtlas
statement:
theorem exists_genericFiniteIFTAtlas {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (A : FiniteIFTChartFamily ι) {εgrad εtime : ℝ}
    (hεgrad : 0 < εgrad) (hεtime : 0 < εtime) :
    Nonempty (GenericFiniteIFTAtlas A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hex : ∀ i, ∃ T : GenericChartTilt (A.time i) (A.core i),
      T.q ∈ ball (0 : E₂) εgrad := fun i =>
    exists_genericChartTilt (A.smooth i) (A.compact_core i) hεgrad
  choose T hT using hex
  let crit : Finset (Σ i, E₂) :=
    Finset.univ.sigma fun i => (T i).critical_finite.toFinset
  have hcrit (p : Σ i, E₂) :
      p ∈ crit ↔ p.2 ∈ ChartCritical (T p.1).tilted ∩ A.core p.1 := by
    simp [crit]
  let baseValue : (Σ i, E₂) → ℝ := fun p => (T p.1).tilted p.2
  obtain ⟨separated, hclose, hinj⟩ :=
    exists_close_injective_on_finset crit baseValue hεtime
  let shift : (Σ i, E₂) → ℝ := fun p => separated p - baseValue p
  refine ⟨{
    tilt := T
    gradient_bound := εgrad
    q_small := hT
    criticalPoints := crit
    criticalPoints_spec := hcrit
    valueShift := shift
    valueShift_bound := εtime
    valueShift_small := ?_
    shiftedValue_injective := ?_
    nondegenerate := ?_ }⟩
  · intro p hp
    exact hclose p hp
  · intro p hp q hq hpq
    apply hinj hp hq
    simpa [shift, baseValue] using hpq
  · intro p hp
    exact (T p.1).critical_nondegenerate p.2 ((hcrit p).mp hp)

name: Submission.exists_genericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas
statement:
theorem exists_genericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas {C : FramedLevelCobordism n}
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceChartFamily C ι)
    {εgrad εtime : ℝ} (hεgrad : 0 < εgrad) (hεtime : 0 < εtime) :
    Nonempty (GenericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas B)
proof:
:=
  exists_genericFiniteIFTAtlas B.toFiniteIFTChartFamily hεgrad hεtime

name: Submission.chartGradient_add_const
statement:
theorem chartGradient_add_const {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : Differentiable ℝ f)
    (c : ℝ) (u : E₂) :
    chartGradient (fun z => f z + c) u = chartGradient f u
proof:
:= by
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun z => f z + c) u = fderiv ℝ f u :=
    ((hf u).hasFDerivAt.add_const c).fderiv
  rw [chartGradient, chartGradient, hfd]

name: Submission.fderiv_chartGradient_add_const
statement:
theorem fderiv_chartGradient_add_const {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (c : ℝ) (u : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (chartGradient (fun z => f z + c)) u =
      fderiv ℝ (chartGradient f) u
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : chartGradient (fun z => f z + c) = chartGradient f := by
    funext z
    exact chartGradient_add_const (hf.differentiable (by simp)) c z
  rw [hfun]

name: Submission.GenericFiniteIFTAtlas.localSeparatedTime_nondegenerate
statement:
theorem localSeparatedTime_nondegenerate {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {A : FiniteIFTChartFamily ι} (G : GenericFiniteIFTAtlas A)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    NondegenerateCriticalAt (G.localSeparatedTime p) p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hnon := G.nondegenerate p hp
  rw [(G.tilt p.1).tilted_eq] at hnon
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · change chartGradient
      (fun u => (G.tilt p.1).tilted u + G.valueShift p) p.2 = 0
    rw [(G.tilt p.1).tilted_eq]
    rw [chartGradient_add_const
      ((contDiff_chartLinearTilt (A.smooth p.1) (G.tilt p.1).q).differentiable
        (by simp))]
    exact hnon.1
  · change Bijective (fderiv ℝ
      (chartGradient (fun u => (G.tilt p.1).tilted u + G.valueShift p)) p.2)
    rw [(G.tilt p.1).tilted_eq]
    rw [fderiv_chartGradient_add_const
      (contDiff_chartLinearTilt (A.smooth p.1) (G.tilt p.1).q)]
    exact hnon.2

name: Submission.GenericFiniteIFTAtlas.localSeparatedTime_value
statement:
theorem localSeparatedTime_value {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {A : FiniteIFTChartFamily ι} (G : GenericFiniteIFTAtlas A)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) :
    G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 =
      (G.tilt p.1).tilted p.2 + G.valueShift p
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.GenericFiniteIFTAtlas.mem_criticalPoints_iff_localSeparatedTime_critical
statement:
theorem mem_criticalPoints_iff_localSeparatedTime_critical
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] {A : FiniteIFTChartFamily ι}
    (G : GenericFiniteIFTAtlas A) (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) :
    p ∈ G.criticalPoints ↔
      p.2 ∈ ChartCritical (G.localSeparatedTime p) ∩ A.core p.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [G.criticalPoints_spec]
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G.tilt p.1).tilted := by
    rw [(G.tilt p.1).tilted_eq]
    exact contDiff_chartLinearTilt (A.smooth p.1) (G.tilt p.1).q
  change
    (chartGradient (G.tilt p.1).tilted p.2 = 0 ∧ p.2 ∈ A.core p.1) ↔
      (chartGradient
        (fun u => (G.tilt p.1).tilted u + G.valueShift p) p.2 = 0 ∧
        p.2 ∈ A.core p.1)
  rw [chartGradient_add_const (hsmooth.differentiable (by simp))]

name: Submission.GenericFiniteIFTAtlas.localCriticalValues_injective
statement:
theorem localCriticalValues_injective {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {A : FiniteIFTChartFamily ι} (G : GenericFiniteIFTAtlas A) :
    Set.InjOn (fun p : Σ _ : ι, E₂ => G.localSeparatedTime p p.2)
      (G.criticalPoints : Set (Σ _ : ι, E₂))
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  exact G.shiftedValue_injective hp hq hpq

name: Submission.GenericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas.localSeparatedTime_realized
statement:
theorem localSeparatedTime_realized
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    {B : FiniteIFTSurfaceChartFamily C ι}
    (G : GenericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas B)
    {K U : ι → Set E'} (χ : ∀ i, SmoothCutoff (K i) (U i))
    (hcore : ∀ i u, u ∈ B.core i → (B.chart i).param u ∈ K i)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    tcoord (verticalShift
      ((B.chart p.1).ambientEventRaw (χ p.1) (G.tilt p.1).q (G.valueShift p))
      ((B.chart p.1).param p.2)) = G.localSeparatedTime p p.2
proof:
:= by
  have hpCore : p.2 ∈ B.core p.1 := by
    have h := (G.criticalPoints_spec p).mp hp
    exact h.2
  rw [(B.chart p.1).verticalShift_time_eq_chartLinearTilt_add_const
    (χ p.1) (G.tilt p.1).q (G.valueShift p)
      (B.core_subset_domain p.1 hpCore) (hcore p.1 p.2 hpCore)]
  rw [GenericFiniteIFTAtlas.localSeparatedTime, (G.tilt p.1).tilted_eq]
  rfl

name: Submission.TamedField.deltaOn_eq_add_sdiff
statement:
theorem deltaOn_eq_add_sdiff {A B : Set (Set E)} (hAB : A ⊆ B) :
    V.deltaOn B = V.deltaOn A + V.deltaOn (B \ A)
proof:
:= by
  have hdis : Disjoint A (B \ A) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro O hOA hOB
    exact hOB.2 hOA
  have hunion : A ∪ (B \ A) = B := by
    ext O
    constructor
    · rintro (hOA | hOB)
      · exact hAB hOA
      · exact hOB.1
    · intro hOB
      by_cases hOA : O ∈ A
      · exact Or.inl hOA
      · exact Or.inr ⟨hOB, hOA⟩
  calc
    V.deltaOn B = V.deltaOn (A ∪ (B \ A)) := congrArg V.deltaOn hunion.symm
    _ = V.deltaOn A + V.deltaOn (B \ A) :=
      V.deltaOn_union_of_disjoint hdis

name: Submission.FramedEventExcisionData.before_positiveDelta_eq_model_add_exterior
statement:
theorem before_positiveDelta_eq_model_add_exterior :
    (C.sliceSign F.before F.before_regular).positiveDelta =
      D.sourceSign.positiveDelta +
        F.beforeField.deltaOn
          ((C.sliceSign F.before F.before_regular).positiveOrbitCollection
            F.beforeField \ F.beforeLocal)
proof:
:= by
  let Sbefore := C.sliceSign F.before F.before_regular
  let A := Sbefore.positiveOrbitCollection F.beforeField
  let Eout := A \ F.beforeLocal
  have hpartition : F.beforeField.deltaOn A =
      F.beforeField.deltaOn F.beforeLocal + F.beforeField.deltaOn Eout :=
    F.beforeField.deltaOn_eq_add_sdiff F.beforeLocal_positive
  have hlocal : F.beforeField.deltaOn F.beforeLocal =
      F.sourceField.deltaOn
        (D.sourceSign.positiveOrbitCollection F.sourceField) :=
    F.sourceLocalTransport.deltaOn_eq
  calc
    Sbefore.positiveDelta = Sbefore.positiveFramedDelta F.beforeField :=
      Sbefore.positiveDelta_eq F.beforeField
    _ = F.beforeField.deltaOn A := rfl
    _ = F.beforeField.deltaOn F.beforeLocal + F.beforeField.deltaOn Eout :=
      hpartition
    _ = F.sourceField.deltaOn
          (D.sourceSign.positiveOrbitCollection F.sourceField) +
          F.beforeField.deltaOn Eout := by rw [hlocal]
    _ = D.sourceSign.positiveFramedDelta F.sourceField +
          F.beforeField.deltaOn Eout := rfl
    _ = D.sourceSign.positiveDelta + F.beforeField.deltaOn Eout := by
      rw [D.sourceSign.positiveDelta_eq F.sourceField]

name: Submission.FramedEventExcisionData.after_positiveDelta_eq_model_add_exterior
statement:
theorem after_positiveDelta_eq_model_add_exterior :
    (C.sliceSign F.after F.after_regular).positiveDelta =
      D.targetSign.positiveDelta +
        F.afterField.deltaOn
          ((C.sliceSign F.after F.after_regular).positiveOrbitCollection
            F.afterField \ F.afterLocal)
proof:
:= by
  let Safter := C.sliceSign F.after F.after_regular
  let A := Safter.positiveOrbitCollection F.afterField
  let Eout := A \ F.afterLocal
  have hpartition : F.afterField.deltaOn A =
      F.afterField.deltaOn F.afterLocal + F.afterField.deltaOn Eout :=
    F.afterField.deltaOn_eq_add_sdiff F.afterLocal_positive
  have hlocal : F.afterField.deltaOn F.afterLocal =
      F.targetField.deltaOn
        (D.targetSign.positiveOrbitCollection F.targetField) :=
    F.targetLocalTransport.deltaOn_eq
  calc
    Safter.positiveDelta = Safter.positiveFramedDelta F.afterField :=
      Safter.positiveDelta_eq F.afterField
    _ = F.afterField.deltaOn A := rfl
    _ = F.afterField.deltaOn F.afterLocal + F.afterField.deltaOn Eout :=
      hpartition
    _ = F.targetField.deltaOn
          (D.targetSign.positiveOrbitCollection F.targetField) +
          F.afterField.deltaOn Eout := by rw [hlocal]
    _ = D.targetSign.positiveFramedDelta F.targetField +
          F.afterField.deltaOn Eout := rfl
    _ = D.targetSign.positiveDelta + F.afterField.deltaOn Eout := by
      rw [D.targetSign.positiveDelta_eq F.targetField]

name: Submission.FramedEventExcisionData.exterior_delta_eq
statement:
theorem exterior_delta_eq :
    F.beforeField.deltaOn
        ((C.sliceSign F.before F.before_regular).positiveOrbitCollection

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircleAt_apply_two
statement:
lemma secondCircleAt_apply_two (theta : ℝ) :
    secondCircleAt m hm theta 2 = Real.cos theta
proof:
:= by
  have h23 : (2 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 3 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)] at hv

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircleAt_apply_three
statement:

    secondCircleAt m hm theta 3 = Real.sin theta
proof:
:= by
  have h32 : (3 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 2 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)] at hv

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircleAt_apply_other
statement:
lemma secondCircleAt_apply_other (theta : ℝ) {j : Fin (m + 3)}
    (hj2 : j ≠ 2) (hj3 : j ≠ 3) : secondCircleAt m hm theta j = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [secondCircleAt, hj2, hj3]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircleAt_mem_secondCircle
statement:
lemma secondCircleAt_mem_secondCircle (theta : ℝ) :
    secondCircleAt m hm theta ∈ secondCircle m hm
proof: := ⟨theta, rfl⟩

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.normSq_secondCircleAt
statement:
lemma normSq_secondCircleAt (theta : ℝ) :
    CompactBirth.normSq (secondCircleAt m hm theta) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold CompactBirth.normSq
  have hkey : ∀ j : Fin (m + 3), secondCircleAt m hm theta j ^ 2 =
      (if j = 2 then Real.cos theta ^ 2 else 0) +
        (if j = 3 then Real.sin theta ^ 2 else 0) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj2 : j = 2
    · subst j
      rw [secondCircleAt_apply_two]
      have h23 : (2 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 3 := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3),
          Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)] at hv
      simp [h23]
    · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
      · subst j
        rw [secondCircleAt_apply_three]
        simp [hj2]
      · rw [secondCircleAt_apply_other m hm theta hj2 hj3,
          if_neg hj2, if_neg hj3]
        norm_num
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hkey j,
    Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (2 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => Real.cos theta ^ 2),
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (3 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => Real.sin theta ^ 2),
    if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]
  exact Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq theta

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap_circleAt_eq_zero
statement:
lemma coreMap_circleAt_eq_zero (theta : ℝ) :
    coreMap m hm (circleAt (m := m) theta) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [coreMap_apply_zero, CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq,
      norm_circleAt, one_pow]
    norm_num
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      rw [coreMap_apply_one]
      have h2 : circleAt (m := m) theta 2 = 0 :=
        circleAt_apply_other theta (fin_two_ne_zero m hm) (fin_two_ne_one m hm)
      have h3 : circleAt (m := m) theta 3 = 0 :=
        circleAt_apply_other theta (fin_three_ne_zero m hm) (fin_three_ne_one m hm)
      rw [hopfRe, h2, h3]
      simp
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        rw [coreMap_apply_two]
        have h2 : circleAt (m := m) theta 2 = 0 :=
          circleAt_apply_other theta (fin_two_ne_zero m hm) (fin_two_ne_one m hm)
        have h3 : circleAt (m := m) theta 3 = 0 :=
          circleAt_apply_other theta (fin_three_ne_zero m hm) (fin_three_ne_one m hm)
        rw [hopfIm, h2, h3]
        simp
      · rw [coreMap_apply_tail m hm _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
        apply circleAt_apply_other theta
        · exact Fin.succ_ne_zero i
        · intro h
          apply hi0
          apply Fin.succ_injective
          simpa using h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap_secondCircleAt_eq_zero
statement:
lemma coreMap_secondCircleAt_eq_zero (theta : ℝ) :
    coreMap m hm (secondCircleAt m hm theta) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [coreMap_apply_zero, normSq_secondCircleAt]
    norm_num
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      rw [coreMap_apply_one]
      have h02 := fin_zero_ne_two m hm
      have h03 := fin_zero_ne_three m hm
      have h12 := fin_one_ne_two m hm
      have h13 := fin_one_ne_three m hm
      simp [hopfRe, secondCircleAt_apply_other m hm theta h02 h03,
        secondCircleAt_apply_other m hm theta h12 h13]
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        rw [coreMap_apply_two]
        have h02 := fin_zero_ne_two m hm
        have h03 := fin_zero_ne_three m hm
        have h12 := fin_one_ne_two m hm
        have h13 := fin_one_ne_three m hm
        simp [hopfIm, secondCircleAt_apply_other m hm theta h02 h03,
          secondCircleAt_apply_other m hm theta h12 h13]
      · rw [coreMap_apply_tail m hm _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
        apply secondCircleAt_apply_other m hm theta
        · intro h
          apply hi1
          apply Fin.succ_injective
          simpa using h
        · intro h
          apply hi2
          apply Fin.succ_injective
          have h3 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ = (3 : Fin (m + 3)) := by
            apply Fin.ext
            simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2),
              Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)]
          simpa [h3] using h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.exists_angle_of_sq_add_sq_eq_one
proof:
:= by
  have ha : -1 ≤ a ∧ a ≤ 1 := by
    constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg b, sq_nonneg (a + 1), sq_nonneg (a - 1)]
  rcases le_or_gt 0 b with hb | hb
  · refine ⟨Real.arccos a, Real.cos_arccos ha.1 ha.2, ?_⟩
    rw [Real.sin_arccos]
    have h1 : 1 - a ^ 2 = b ^ 2 := by linarith
    rw [h1, Real.sqrt_sq hb]
  · refine ⟨-Real.arccos a, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Real.cos_neg]
      exact Real.cos_arccos ha.1 ha.2
    · rw [Real.sin_neg, Real.sin_arccos]
      have h1 : 1 - a ^ 2 = b ^ 2 := by linarith
      rw [h1, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos hb.le, neg_neg]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap_eq_zero_iff_two_circles
statement:
theorem coreMap_eq_zero_iff_two_circles (x : E) :
    coreMap m hm x = 0 ↔
      x ∈ standardCircle ∨ x ∈ secondCircle m hm
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    rcases plane_dichotomy_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx with hz | hu
    · have hn := second_branch_normSq m hm hx hz
      obtain ⟨theta, hcos, hsin⟩ :=
        exists_angle_of_sq_add_sq_eq_one m hm hn
      right
      refine ⟨theta, ?_⟩
      apply PiLp.ext
      intro j
      by_cases hj0 : j = 0
      · subst j
        have h02 := fin_zero_ne_two m hm
        have h03 := fin_zero_ne_three m hm
        simp [hz.1, secondCircleAt_apply_other m hm theta h02 h03]
      · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
        · subst j
          have h12 := fin_one_ne_two m hm
          have h13 := fin_one_ne_three m hm
          simp [hz.2, secondCircleAt_apply_other m hm theta h12 h13]
        · by_cases hj2 : j = 2
          · subst j
            rw [secondCircleAt_apply_two, hcos]
          · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
            · subst j
              rw [secondCircleAt_apply_three, hsin]
            · rw [secondCircleAt_apply_other m hm theta hj2 hj3,
                coordinate_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx hj0 hj1 hj2 hj3]
    · have hn := first_branch_normSq m hm hx hu
      obtain ⟨theta, hcos, hsin⟩ :=
        exists_angle_of_sq_add_sq_eq_one m hm hn
      left
      refine ⟨theta, ?_⟩
      apply PiLp.ext
      intro j
      by_cases hj0 : j = 0
      · subst j
        rw [circleAt_apply_zero, hcos]
      · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
        · subst j
          rw [circleAt_apply_one, hsin]
        · rw [circleAt_apply_other theta hj0 hj1]
          by_cases hj2 : j = 2
          · subst j
            exact hu.1.symm
          · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
            · subst j
              exact hu.2.symm
            · exact (coordinate_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
                hj0 hj1 hj2 hj3).symm
  · rintro (⟨theta, rfl⟩ | ⟨theta, rfl⟩)
    · exact coreMap_circleAt_eq_zero m hm theta
    · exact coreMap_secondCircleAt_eq_zero m hm theta

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.standardCircle_disjoint_secondCircle
statement:
theorem standardCircle_disjoint_secondCircle :
    Disjoint (standardCircle : Set E) (secondCircle m hm)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro x ⟨theta, rfl⟩ ⟨phi, hphi⟩
  have h2 := congrArg (fun q : E => q 2) hphi
  have h3 := congrArg (fun q : E => q 3) hphi
  rw [secondCircleAt_apply_two] at h2
  rw [secondCircleAt_apply_three] at h3
  have hc2 : circleAt (m := m) theta 2 = 0 :=
    circleAt_apply_other theta (fin_two_ne_zero m hm) (fin_two_ne_one m hm)
  have hc3 : circleAt (m := m) theta 3 = 0 :=
    circleAt_apply_other theta (fin_three_ne_zero m hm) (fin_three_ne_one m hm)
  rw [hc2] at h2
  rw [hc3] at h3
  nlinarith [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq phi]

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_so2Coset
statement:
theorem pathLoopClassZ2_so2Coset (hm : 3 ≤ m) {x : SOGroup m}
    (α : Path x x) (U V : SOGroup m) (θ : C(I, ℝ)) (k : ℤ)
    (hθ : θ 1 = θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi * k)
    (hα : ∀ t : I, α t = so2Coset U V (θ t)) :
    pathLoopClassZ2 α = (k : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  set γ : C(I, SOGroup m) :=
    ⟨fun t => so2Coset U V (θ t),
      (continuous_so2Coset U V).comp θ.continuous⟩ with hγdef
  have hγcl : γ 0 = γ 1 := by
    show so2Coset U V (θ 0) = so2Coset U V (θ 1)
    rw [hθ, so2Coset_periodic]
  have hso2cl : so2Loop m θ 0 = so2Loop m θ 1 := so2Loop_closed m θ k hθ
  have hfun : α.toContinuousMap = γ := ContinuousMap.ext fun t => hα t
  have hstep : pathLoopClassZ2 α = loopClassZ2 γ hγcl := by
    unfold pathLoopClassZ2
    exact loopClassZ2_congr_fun (pathLoop_closed α) hγcl hfun
  have hfree : freeToBased γ hγcl
      = conjLoop U (freeToBased (so2Loop m θ) hso2cl) := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    show U * so2Point m (θ t) * V * (U * so2Point m (θ 0) * V)⁻¹
      = U * (so2Point m (θ t) * (so2Point m (θ 0))⁻¹) * U⁻¹
    group
  calc
    pathLoopClassZ2 α = loopClassZ2 γ hγcl := hstep
    _ = basedClassZ2 (conjLoop U (freeToBased (so2Loop m θ) hso2cl)) := by
      unfold loopClassZ2
      rw [hfree]
    _ = basedClassZ2 (freeToBased (so2Loop m θ) hso2cl) :=
      basedClassZ2_homotopic (conjLoop_homotopic U _)
    _ = loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m θ) hso2cl := rfl
    _ = (k : ZMod 2) := loopClassZ2_so2_winding hm θ k hθ hso2cl

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_so2Coset_eq_one

    (hθ : θ 1 = θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi * k) (hk : Odd k)

proof:
