name: Submission.SaddleBandWindingRealization.band_class_eq
proof:
:= by
  set Θ : Path R.angleMark₀ R.angleMark₈ :=
    ((R.angleLocal₁.trans R.angleConnector₁).trans
        (R.angleBand₁.trans R.angleConnector₂)).trans
      ((R.angleLocal₂.trans R.angleConnector₃).trans
        (R.angleBand₂.trans R.angleConnector₀)) with hΘ
  have hA : ∀ t : I, (beforeLocal₁.symm.trans connector₁) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight
          ((R.angleLocal₁.trans R.angleConnector₁) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight)
      R.local₁_lift R.connector₁_lift
  have hB : ∀ t : I, (afterBand₁.trans connector₂.symm) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight
          ((R.angleBand₁.trans R.angleConnector₂) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight)
      R.band₁_lift R.connector₂_lift
  have hC : ∀ t : I, (beforeLocal₂.symm.trans connector₃) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight
          ((R.angleLocal₂.trans R.angleConnector₃) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight)
      R.local₂_lift R.connector₃_lift
  have hD : ∀ t : I, (afterBand₂.trans connector₀.symm) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight
          ((R.angleBand₂.trans R.angleConnector₀) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight)
      R.band₂_lift R.connector₀_lift
  have hAB : ∀ t : I,
      ((beforeLocal₁.symm.trans connector₁).trans
        (afterBand₁.trans connector₂.symm)) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight
          (((R.angleLocal₁.trans R.angleConnector₁).trans
            (R.angleBand₁.trans R.angleConnector₂)) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight) hA hB
  have hCD : ∀ t : I,
      ((beforeLocal₂.symm.trans connector₃).trans
        (afterBand₂.trans connector₀.symm)) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight
          (((R.angleLocal₂.trans R.angleConnector₃).trans
            (R.angleBand₂.trans R.angleConnector₀)) t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight) hC hD
  have hloop : ∀ t : I,
      (((beforeLocal₁.symm.trans connector₁).trans
          (afterBand₁.trans connector₂.symm)).trans
        ((beforeLocal₂.symm.trans connector₃).trans
          (afterBand₂.trans connector₀.symm))) t
      = so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight (Θ t) :=
    trans_lift (so2Coset R.chartLeft R.chartRight) hAB hCD
  have hθ : Θ.toContinuousMap 1 = Θ.toContinuousMap 0
      + 2 * Real.pi * (R.winding : ℝ) := by
    show Θ 1 = Θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi * (R.winding : ℝ)
    rw [Θ.target, Θ.source]
    exact R.winding_closed
  exact pathLoopClassZ2_so2Coset_eq_one hm _ R.chartLeft R.chartRight
    Θ.toContinuousMap R.winding hθ R.winding_odd hloop

name: Submission.SaddleBandWindingRealization.band_class_eq_of_arc_homotopies
proof:
:= by
  have hloop :
      (((beforeLocal₁.symm.trans connector₁).trans
          (afterBand₁.trans connector₂.symm)).trans
        ((beforeLocal₂.symm.trans connector₃).trans
          (afterBand₂.trans connector₀.symm))).Homotopic
      (((mL₁.symm.trans mc₁).trans (mB₁.trans mc₂.symm)).trans
        ((mL₂.symm.trans mc₃).trans (mB₂.trans mc₀.symm))) :=
    Path.Homotopic.hcomp
      (Path.Homotopic.hcomp (Path.Homotopic.hcomp hL₁.symm₂ hc₁)
        (Path.Homotopic.hcomp hB₁ hc₂.symm₂))
      (Path.Homotopic.hcomp (Path.Homotopic.hcomp hL₂.symm₂ hc₃)
        (Path.Homotopic.hcomp hB₂ hc₀.symm₂))
  rw [pathLoopClassZ2_congr hloop]
  exact R.band_class_eq hm

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalDefiniteExteriorMidpoint_mem
statement:
theorem chronologicalDefiniteExteriorMidpoint_mem
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .minimum ∨
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .maximum)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin ((a + 2) + 2))}
    (hp : p ∈ D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht)
    (hptime : tcoord p = D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) :
    (D.chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.flow p
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2) ∈
      criticalSliceExteriorCore
        D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius
proof:
:= by
  let R := D.chronologicalExteriorSlabTimeField t ht
  let s := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2
  change R.base.flow p s ∈ criticalSliceExteriorCore
    D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
    (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
    (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius
  have hsafe : |s| ≤ R.safeTime := by
    simpa [R, s, chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField] using
      D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime t ht
  have hshort : |s| < 2 * R.safeTime := by
    have hpos := R.safeTime_pos
    linarith
  have hp' := hp
  rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore] at hp'
  have hpfiber : p ∈ D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber :=
    hp'.1.1
  have hyfiber : R.base.flow p s ∈
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber :=
    R.flow_mem_fiber hpfiber s
  have hytime : tcoord (R.base.flow p s) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    calc
      tcoord (R.base.flow p s) = tcoord p + s := R.tcoord_flow hp hsafe
      _ = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
        rw [hptime]
        simp only [chronologicalBeforeTime]
        dsimp [s]
        ring
  have hyspatial : Function.Surjective
      (spatialDeriv D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (R.base.flow p s)) :=
    R.flow_spatialDeriv_surjective hp hshort
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore]
  refine ⟨hyfiber, hytime, ?_⟩
  by_contra hdist
  have hlt : dist (R.base.flow p s) (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius :=
    lt_of_not_ge hdist
  have hyrepr : cobSpaceTime
      (spacePart (R.base.flow p s))
      (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) = R.base.flow p s := by
    rw [← hytime, spaceTime_spacePart]
  have hcovered : spacePart (R.base.flow p s) ∈
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).coveredSliceFiber
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) := by
    constructor
    · rw [hyrepr]
      exact hlt
    · rw [hyrepr]
      exact hyfiber
  have hycenter : R.base.flow p s = D.position.eventCenter t ht := by
    exact hyrepr.symm.trans
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).definite_coveredSliceFiber_at_critical_eq_center
        hindex hcovered)
  have hcenterCritical := (D.position.eventModel t ht).center_mem_timeCritical
  rw [hycenter] at hyspatial
  exact hcenterCritical.2 hyspatial

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalBeforeOrbitPoint_mem_exteriorSlabCore
statement:
theorem chronologicalBeforeOrbitPoint_mem_exteriorSlabCore
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (V : TamedField (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice t ht))
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) {x : Eₐ} (hx : x ∈ (O : Set Eₐ))
    (hexterior : (O : Set Eₐ) ∈
      D.chronologicalExteriorOrbitCollection t ht
        (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)) :
    cobSpaceTime x (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) ∈
      D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht
proof:
:= by
  rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hexterior x hx⟩
  · have hxFiber : x ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice t ht).fiber := by
      apply V.orbit_subset_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
      rwa [← V.orbitPoint_orbit O]
    rw [chronologicalBeforeSlice,
      SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber] at hxFiber
    exact hxFiber
  · change tcoord (cobSpaceTime x (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)) ∈ Icc
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after
    rw [tcoord_spaceTime]
    have hb := D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_bracket t ht
    exact ⟨hb.1.le, hb.2.le⟩

name: Submission.maximumGeometry_of_exteriorCardinalityKits
statement:
theorem maximumGeometry_of_exteriorCardinalityKits {a : ℕ}
    (K : ProductionMorseMaximumExteriorCardinalityKits a) :
    ∀ {X Y : FramedLevelSet (a + 2)}
      {S : FiberSign X} {T : FiberSign Y}
      (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
      (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage C)
      (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
      (hpositive : D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
        (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters)
      (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .maximum),
        Nonempty
          (D.ChronologicalMaximumFlowInducedPairing
            t ht hpositive hindex)
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y S T C D t ht hpositive hindex
  obtain ⟨K⟩ := K C D t ht hpositive hindex
  exact ⟨K.toFlowInducedPairing⟩

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel_outgoingRankFour
statement:
private theorem cyclicCutSourceLabel_outgoingRankFour
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3) (r : Fin 4) :
    A.cyclicCutSourceLabel
        (Fin.lastCases (Fin.last 3)
          (fun j : Fin 3 => j.castSucc) r) =
      A.sortedLabel r
proof:
:= by
  induction r using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      simp only [cyclicCutSourceLabel]
      rw [Fin.lastCases_last, Fin.lastCases_last]
  | cast j =>
      simp only [cyclicCutSourceLabel]
      rw [Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel_incomingRankFour
statement:
private theorem cyclicCutTargetLabel_incomingRankFour
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3) (r : Fin 4) :
    A.cyclicCutTargetLabel
        (Fin.cases (Fin.last 3)
          (fun j : Fin 3 => j.castSucc) r) =
      A.sortedLabel r
proof:
:= by
  induction r using Fin.cases with
  | zero =>
      simp only [cyclicCutTargetLabel]
      rw [Fin.cases_zero, Fin.lastCases_last]
  | succ j =>
      simp only [cyclicCutTargetLabel]
      rw [Fin.cases_succ, Fin.lastCases_castSucc]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel_outgoingCutIndexFour
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclicCutSourceLabel_outgoingCutIndexFour
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3) (l : Fin 4) :
    A.cyclicCutSourceLabel (A.outgoingCutIndexFour l) = l
proof:
:= by
  rw [outgoingCutIndexFour,
    A.cyclicCutSourceLabel_outgoingRankFour]
  exact A.sortedLabel.apply_symm_apply l

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel_incomingCutIndexFour
statement:
@[simp] theorem cyclicCutTargetLabel_incomingCutIndexFour
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3) (l : Fin 4) :
    A.cyclicCutTargetLabel (A.incomingCutIndexFour l) = l
proof:
:= by
  rw [incomingCutIndexFour,
    A.cyclicCutTargetLabel_incomingRankFour]
  exact A.sortedLabel.apply_symm_apply l

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel_ne_targetLabel_four
statement:
theorem cyclicCutSourceLabel_ne_targetLabel_four
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3) (i : Fin 4) :
    A.cyclicCutSourceLabel i ≠ A.cyclicCutTargetLabel i
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      intro h
      simp only [cyclicCutSourceLabel, cyclicCutTargetLabel] at h
      rw [Fin.lastCases_last, Fin.lastCases_last] at h
      have h' : A.sortedLabel (Fin.last 3) = A.sortedLabel 0 := by
        exact h
      have hindex := A.sortedLabel.injective h'
      have hval := congrArg Fin.val hindex
      norm_num at hval
  | cast j =>
      intro h
      simp only [cyclicCutSourceLabel, cyclicCutTargetLabel] at h
      rw [Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Fin.lastCases_castSucc] at h
      have h' : A.sortedLabel j.castSucc = A.sortedLabel j.succ := by
        exact h
      exact (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ : j.castSucc < j.succ).ne
        (A.sortedLabel.injective h')

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.outgoingCutIndexFour_ne_incomingCutIndexFour
statement:
theorem outgoingCutIndexFour_ne_incomingCutIndexFour
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3) (l : Fin 4) :
    A.outgoingCutIndexFour l ≠ A.incomingCutIndexFour l
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply A.cyclicCutSourceLabel_ne_targetLabel_four
    (A.outgoingCutIndexFour l)
  calc
    A.cyclicCutSourceLabel (A.outgoingCutIndexFour l) = l := by simp
    _ = A.cyclicCutTargetLabel (A.incomingCutIndexFour l) := by simp
    _ = A.cyclicCutTargetLabel (A.outgoingCutIndexFour l) := by rw [h]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.point_mem_cyclicCutRange_outgoingCutIndexFour
statement:
theorem point_mem_cyclicCutRange_outgoingCutIndexFour
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3) (l : Fin 4) :

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.point_mem_cyclicCutRange_incomingCutIndexFour
statement:
theorem point_mem_cyclicCutRange_incomingCutIndexFour
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3) (l : Fin 4) :
    A.point l ∈ A.cyclicCutRange (A.incomingCutIndexFour l)
proof:

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.exists_incidentCutIndexFour_ne_two
statement:
theorem exists_incidentCutIndexFour_ne_two
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3) (l : Fin 4) (i j : Fin 4)
    (hnotj : A.point l ∉ A.cyclicCutRange j) :
    ∃ r : Fin 4, r ≠ i ∧ r ≠ j ∧
      (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r = l ∨
        A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r = l)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let outgoing := A.outgoingCutIndexFour l
  let incoming := A.incomingCutIndexFour l
  have hne : outgoing ≠ incoming :=
    A.outgoingCutIndexFour_ne_incomingCutIndexFour l
  have houtj : outgoing ≠ j := by
    intro h
    apply hnotj
    rw [← h]
    exact A.point_mem_cyclicCutRange_outgoingCutIndexFour l
  have hinj : incoming ≠ j := by
    intro h
    apply hnotj
    rw [← h]
    exact A.point_mem_cyclicCutRange_incomingCutIndexFour l
  by_cases houti : outgoing = i
  · refine ⟨incoming, ?_, hinj, Or.inr ?_⟩
    · intro hini
      apply hne
      exact houti.trans hini.symm
    · exact A.cyclicCutTargetLabel_incomingCutIndexFour l
  · exact ⟨outgoing, houti, houtj,
      Or.inl (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel_outgoingCutIndexFour l)⟩

statement:
theorem mateArcCore_subset_slabRegularSet
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) :
    L.mateArcCore hindex A ⊆
      slabRegularSet D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨p, u, rfl⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hz
  have hpunct := ((L.pairing hindex A).chosenMateArc p).mem_exterior u
  have hspatial : Surjective
      (spatialDeriv D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (((L.pairing hindex A).chosenMateArc p).toPath u)) := by
    exact StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice_spatialDeriv_surjective
      (P := D.position) (ht := ht) hpunct
  exact mem_slabRegularSet_of_spatial_surjective
    (D.signedOutput.cobordism.regular _ hpunct.1) hspatial

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.ChronologicalSaddleAuxiliaryLocalData.exteriorSlabCore_subset_slabRegularSet
statement:
theorem exteriorSlabCore_subset_slabRegularSet :
    L.exteriorSlabCore ⊆ slabRegularSet D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  rw [exteriorSlabCore] at hz
  have hspatial : Surjective
      (spatialDeriv D.signedOutput.cobordism.G z) := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hcritical : z ∈ timeCritical D.signedOutput.cobordism.G :=
      ⟨hz.1.1, hnot⟩
    have hzc : z = D.position.eventCenter t ht :=
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).isolates z hcritical hz.1.2
    have hdist := hz.2
    change L.centerCoverRadius ≤
      dist z (D.position.eventCenter t ht) at hdist
    rw [hzc, dist_self] at hdist
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hdist) L.centerCoverRadius_pos
  exact mem_slabRegularSet_of_spatial_surjective
    (D.signedOutput.cobordism.regular z hz.1.1) hspatial

name: Submission.surjective_verticalLinear
statement:
theorem surjective_verticalLinear (A : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ)
    (hden : 1 + A timeVec ≠ 0) :
    Surjective (verticalLinear A)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  let x₀ := spaceInclL (spacePart y)
  let s := (tcoord y - A x₀) / (1 + A timeVec)
  refine ⟨x₀ + s • timeVec, ?_⟩
  have hx₀ : x₀ + tcoord y • timeVec = y := by
    rw [← spaceTime_eq, spaceTime_spacePart]
  have hs : s * (1 + A timeVec) = tcoord y - A x₀ := by
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ _ hden
  have hcoef : s + (A x₀ + s * A timeVec) = tcoord y := by
    linarith
  calc
    verticalLinear A (x₀ + s • timeVec)
        = x₀ + s • timeVec + (A x₀ + s * A timeVec) • timeVec := by
            rw [verticalLinear_apply, map_add, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]
    _ = x₀ + (s + (A x₀ + s * A timeVec)) • timeVec := by
          rw [add_assoc, ← add_smul]
    _ = y := by rw [hcoef, hx₀]

name: Submission.vertical_den_ne_zero_of_norm_lt_one

proof:

  intro hzero
  have hval : A timeVec = -1 := by linarith
  have hle := A.le_opNorm (timeVec (n := n))
  rw [norm_timeVec, mul_one, hval, norm_neg, norm_one] at hle
  linarith

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.exists_of_isClosed_isOpen
statement:
theorem exists_of_isClosed_isOpen {K U : Set E'} (hK : IsClosed K)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hKU : K ⊆ U) (hUc : IsCompact (closure U)) :
    Nonempty (SmoothCutoff K U)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : IsClosed Uᶜ := hU.isClosed_compl
  have hd : Disjoint Uᶜ K := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hxU hxK
    exact hxU (hKU hxK)
  obtain ⟨f, hf0, hf1, hf01⟩ :=
    exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_of_isClosed
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E') (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) hs hK hd
  have hf_smooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (⇑f) := by
    rw [← contMDiff_iff_contDiff]
    exact f.contMDiff
  have hsupp : HasCompactSupport (⇑f) := by
    have hsupport : support (⇑f) ⊆ U := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hxU
      exact hx (hf0 hxU)
    have htsupport : tsupport (⇑f) ⊆ closure U :=
      closure_minimal (hsupport.trans subset_closure) isClosed_closure
    exact IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset hUc isClosed_closure htsupport
  exact ⟨⟨⇑f, hf_smooth, hf0, hf1, hf01, hsupp⟩⟩

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.exists_ball
statement:
theorem exists_ball (center : E') {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :

proof:
:= by
  apply exists_of_isClosed_isOpen Metric.isClosed_closedBall Metric.isOpen_ball
  · intro v hv
    rw [mem_closedBall] at hv
    rw [mem_ball]
    linarith
  · apply IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset (isCompact_closedBall center r)
      isClosed_closure
    exact closure_minimal ball_subset_closedBall Metric.isClosed_closedBall

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.abs_tcoord_sub_le_norm_sub
statement:
theorem abs_tcoord_sub_le_norm_sub (v w : E') :
    |tcoord v - tcoord w| ≤ ‖v - w‖
proof:
:= by
  calc
    |tcoord v - tcoord w| = |tcoord (v - w)| := by rw [tcoord_sub]
    _ = |⟪timeVec, v - w⟫| := by rw [inner_timeVec]
    _ ≤ ‖timeVec (n := n)‖ * ‖v - w‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm _ _
    _ = ‖v - w‖ := by rw [norm_timeVec, one_mul]

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.ball_subset_middleSlab
statement:
theorem ball_subset_middleSlab (center : E') {r : ℝ}
    (hleft : r < tcoord center - 1 / 4)
    (hright : r < 3 / 4 - tcoord center) :
    ball center r ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  rw [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] at hv
  have habs : |tcoord v - tcoord center| < r :=
    (abs_tcoord_sub_le_norm_sub v center).trans_lt hv
  have hrange := abs_lt.mp habs
  exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.hasCompactSupport_localize

    (h : E' → ℝ) : HasCompactSupport (χ.localize h)
proof:
:= by
  apply IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset χ.compact_support isClosed_closure
  apply closure_minimal
  · intro v hv

proof:

  intro v hv
  apply χ.localize_eq_zero h
  intro hvU
  have hvt := hU hvU
  rcases hv with hv | hv <;> linarith [hvt.1, hvt.2]

name: Submission.VerticalAmplitude.exists_scaled
statement:
theorem exists_scaled (raw : E' → ℝ) (hraw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ raw)
    (hsupp : HasCompactSupport raw)
    (hcollar : ∀ v, tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v → raw v = 0) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ a : VerticalAmplitude (n := n),
      a.toFun = fun v => ε * raw v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hraw.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hsupp (by simp)
  let ε : ℝ := 1 / (2 * ((K : ℝ) + 1))
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) := K.coe_nonneg
  have hden : 0 < 2 * ((K : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hε : 0 < ε := one_div_pos.mpr hden
  have hεK : ε * (K : ℝ) < 1 := by
    change (1 / (2 * ((K : ℝ) + 1))) * (K : ℝ) < 1
    rw [one_div, inv_mul_eq_div]
    exact (div_lt_one hden).2 (by linarith)
  let scaled : E' → ℝ := fun v => ε * raw v
  have hscaled : ContDiff ℝ ∞ scaled := contDiff_const.mul hraw
  have hfd (v : E') : fderiv ℝ scaled v = ε • fderiv ℝ raw v := by
    exact ((hraw.differentiable (by simp) v).hasFDerivAt.const_mul ε).fderiv
  have hsmall (v : E') : ‖fderiv ℝ scaled v‖ < 1 := by
    rw [hfd, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε]
    have hderiv : ‖fderiv ℝ raw v‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) :=
      norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ hK
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hderiv hε.le).trans_lt hεK
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ofNormFDerivLtOne scaled hscaled ?_ hsmall, rfl⟩
  intro v hv
  simp [scaled, hcollar v hv]

name: Submission.VerticalAmplitude.exists_pullback_localized
statement:
theorem exists_pullback_localized {K U : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff K U)
    (hU : U ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ))
    (h : E' → ℝ) (hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h) (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ a : VerticalAmplitude (n := n),
      a.toFun = (fun v => ε * χ.localize h v) ∧
      (a.pullback C).X₀ = C.X₀ ∧ (a.pullback C).X₁ = C.X₁
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, a, ha⟩ := exists_scaled (χ.localize h)
    (χ.contDiff_localize hh) (χ.hasCompactSupport_localize h)
    (χ.localize_collar_zero hU h)
  exact ⟨ε, hε, a, ha, rfl, rfl⟩

name: Submission.VerticalAmplitude.exists_pullback_affine_at
statement:
theorem exists_pullback_affine_at (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) (center : E')
    {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hleft : r < tcoord center - 1 / 4)
    (hright : r < 3 / 4 - tcoord center)
    (A : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ a : VerticalAmplitude (n := n),
      (a.pullback C).X₀ = C.X₀ ∧ (a.pullback C).X₁ = C.X₁ ∧
      ∀ v ∈ closedBall center (r / 2),
        a v = ε * (A (v - center) + c) ∧
        tcoord (verticalShift a v) =
          tcoord v + ε * (A (v - center) + c)
proof:
:= by
  let χ := (SmoothCutoff.exists_ball center hr).some
  have hU := SmoothCutoff.ball_subset_middleSlab center hleft hright
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, a, ha, hX₀, hX₁⟩ :=
    exists_pullback_localized χ hU (SmoothCutoff.affineJet A center c)
      (SmoothCutoff.contDiff_affineJet A center c) C
  refine ⟨ε, hε, a, hX₀, hX₁, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  have hχ : χ.localize (SmoothCutoff.affineJet A center c) v =
      A (v - center) + c := χ.localize_affineJet_eq A center c hv
  have hav : a v = ε * (A (v - center) + c) := by
    rw [show a.toFun v = ε * χ.localize
      (SmoothCutoff.affineJet A center c) v by rw [ha]]
    rw [hχ]
  exact ⟨hav, by rw [tcoord_verticalShift, hav]⟩

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.lipschitz_inverseIteration
statement:
theorem lipschitz_inverseIteration (a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n)) (y : E') :
    LipschitzWith a.K (a.inverseIteration y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
  intro x z
  have ha := a.lipschitz.dist_le_mul x z
  have hdist : dist (a.inverseIteration y x) (a.inverseIteration y z) =
      dist (a x) (a z) := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    have hsub : (y - a x • timeVec) - (y - a z • timeVec) =
        -((a x - a z) • timeVec) := by
      rw [sub_smul]
      abel
    rw [inverseIteration, inverseIteration, hsub, norm_neg, norm_smul,
      norm_timeVec, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  rw [hdist]
  exact ha

  ⟨a.K_lt_one, a.lipschitz_inverseIteration y⟩

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.surjective_verticalShift
statement:
theorem surjective_verticalShift (a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n)) :
    Surjective (verticalShift a)
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  let hcon := a.contracting_inverseIteration y
  let x : E' := hcon.fixedPoint (a.inverseIteration y)
  have hfix : a.inverseIteration y x = x :=
    hcon.fixedPoint_isFixedPt
  refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
  calc
    verticalShift a x = x + a x • timeVec := rfl
    _ = (y - a x • timeVec) + a x • timeVec :=
      congrArg (fun z => z + a x • timeVec) hfix.symm
    _ = y := sub_add_cancel _ _

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.injective_verticalShift
statement:
theorem injective_verticalShift (a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n)) :
    Injective (verticalShift a)
proof:
:= by
  intro x z hxz
  have hzero : (verticalShift a x) - (verticalShift a z) = 0 := by
    rw [hxz, sub_self]
  have hsub : x - z = -((a x - a z) • timeVec) := by
    calc
      x - z = ((verticalShift a x) - (verticalShift a z)) -
          ((a x - a z) • timeVec) := by
            simp only [verticalShift]
            rw [sub_smul]
            abel
      _ = -((a x - a z) • timeVec) := by rw [hzero, zero_sub]
  have hnorm : ‖x - z‖ = |a x - a z| := by
    rw [hsub, norm_neg, norm_smul, norm_timeVec, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hlip := a.lipschitz.dist_le_mul x z
  rw [Real.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm, ← hnorm] at hlip
  have hK : (a.K : ℝ) < 1 := by exact_mod_cast a.K_lt_one
  have hnorm0 : ‖x - z‖ = 0 := by
    have hn := norm_nonneg (x - z)
    nlinarith
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp (norm_eq_zero.mp hnorm0)

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.exists_scaled
statement:
theorem exists_scaled (raw : E' → ℝ) (hraw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ raw)
    (hsupp : HasCompactSupport raw)
    (hcollar : ∀ v, tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v → raw v = 0) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n),
      a.toFun = fun v => ε * raw v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := hraw.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hsupp (by simp)
  let ε : ℝ := 1 / (2 * ((K : ℝ) + 1))
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) := K.coe_nonneg
  have hden : 0 < 2 * ((K : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hε : 0 < ε := one_div_pos.mpr hden
  have hεK : ε * (K : ℝ) < 1 := by
    change (1 / (2 * ((K : ℝ) + 1))) * (K : ℝ) < 1
    rw [one_div, inv_mul_eq_div]
    exact (div_lt_one hden).2 (by linarith)
  let κ : NNReal := ⟨ε * (K : ℝ), mul_nonneg hε.le hK0⟩
  have hκ : κ < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hεK
  let scaled : E' → ℝ := fun v => ε * raw v
  have hscaled : ContDiff ℝ ∞ scaled := contDiff_const.mul hraw
  have hscaledLip : LipschitzWith κ scaled := by
    rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
    intro x z
    have h := hK.dist_le_mul x z
    have h' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hε.le
    dsimp [scaled, κ]
    rw [Real.dist_eq, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hε]
    change ε * |raw x - raw z| ≤ (ε * (K : ℝ)) * dist x z
    exact h'.trans_eq (by ring)
  have hfd (v : E') : fderiv ℝ scaled v = ε • fderiv ℝ raw v := by
    exact ((hraw.differentiable (by simp) v).hasFDerivAt.const_mul ε).fderiv
  have hsmall (v : E') : ‖fderiv ℝ scaled v‖ < 1 := by
    rw [hfd, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε]
    have hderiv : ‖fderiv ℝ raw v‖ ≤ (K : ℝ) :=
      norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ hK
    exact (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hderiv hε.le).trans_lt hεK
  let base := VerticalAmplitude.ofNormFDerivLtOne scaled hscaled
    (fun v hv => by simp [scaled, hcollar v hv]) hsmall
  refine ⟨ε, hε, {
    toVerticalAmplitude := base
    K := κ
    K_lt_one := hκ
    lipschitz := hscaledLip }, rfl⟩

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.contDiff_equiv_symm
statement:
theorem contDiff_equiv_symm (a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ a.equiv.symm
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro y
  let x : E' := a.equiv.symm y
  have hxy : verticalShift a x = y := by
    change a.equiv x = y
    exact a.equiv.apply_symm_apply y
  have hsurj : Surjective (fderiv ℝ (verticalShift a) x) :=
    a.toVerticalAmplitude.surjective_fderiv_verticalShift x
  have hinj : Injective (fderiv ℝ (verticalShift a) x) :=
    LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mpr hsurj
  let L : E' ≃L[ℝ] E' := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (fderiv ℝ (verticalShift a) x) (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hinj)
      (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hsurj)
  have hLcoe : (L : E' →L[ℝ] E') = fderiv ℝ (verticalShift a) x := rfl
  have hderiv : HasFDerivAt (verticalShift a) (L : E' →L[ℝ] E') x := by
    rw [hLcoe]
    exact ((contDiff_verticalShift a.smooth).differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
  have hcd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (verticalShift a) x :=
    (contDiff_verticalShift a.smooth).contDiffAt
  have hlocal : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (hcd.localInverse hderiv (by simp))
      (verticalShift a x) := hcd.to_localInverse hderiv (by simp)
  have hleft : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 x,
      a.equiv.symm (verticalShift a z) = z := by
    filter_upwards [] with z
    change a.equiv.symm (a.equiv z) = z
    exact a.equiv.symm_apply_apply z
  have hstrict := hcd.hasStrictFDerivAt' hderiv (by simp)
  have heq : a.equiv.symm =ᶠ[𝓝 (verticalShift a x)]
      hcd.localInverse hderiv (by simp) :=
    hstrict.localInverse_unique hleft
  have hinvAt : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ a.equiv.symm (verticalShift a x) :=
    hlocal.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq
  rwa [hxy] at hinvAt

name: Submission.SmallVerticalAmplitude.exists_diffeomorphic_pullback_affine_at
statement:
theorem exists_diffeomorphic_pullback_affine_at
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) (center : E') {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r)
    (hleft : r < tcoord center - 1 / 4)
    (hright : r < 3 / 4 - tcoord center)
    (A : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n),
      (a.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).X₀ = C.X₀ ∧
      (a.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).X₁ = C.X₁ ∧
      (∀ v ∈ closedBall center (r / 2),
        a v = ε * (A (v - center) + c) ∧
        tcoord (a.diffeomorph v) =
          tcoord v + ε * (A (v - center) + c))
proof:
:= by
  let χ := (SmoothCutoff.exists_ball center hr).some
  let raw := χ.localize (SmoothCutoff.affineJet A center c)
  have hU := SmoothCutoff.ball_subset_middleSlab center hleft hright
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, a, ha⟩ := SmallVerticalAmplitude.exists_scaled raw
    (χ.contDiff_localize (SmoothCutoff.contDiff_affineJet A center c))
    (χ.hasCompactSupport_localize _)
    (χ.localize_collar_zero hU _)
  refine ⟨ε, hε, a, rfl, rfl, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  have hraw : raw v = A (v - center) + c := by
    exact χ.localize_affineJet_eq A center c hv
  have hav : a v = ε * (A (v - center) + c) := by
    rw [show a.toFun v = ε * raw v by rw [ha], hraw]
  exact ⟨hav, by rw [diffeomorph_apply, tcoord_verticalShift, hav]⟩

proof:
:= by
  apply (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph
    (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)).injective
  rw [tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_homeomorph_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y
      (2 * Real.pi * (((0 : I) : ℝ))) =

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_closed
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_closed (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase k V 0 =
      tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase k V 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph
    (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)).injective
  rw [tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_homeomorph_apply,
    tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_homeomorph_apply]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y
      (2 * Real.pi * (((0 : I) : ℝ))) =
    tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y
      (2 * Real.pi * (((1 : I) : ℝ)))
  have hoff := (tubeMap_periodic (m := m) k
    (tubeNorthOffset (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y) 0).symm
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  rw [tubeBridgeCirclePoint_apply, tubeBridgeCirclePoint_apply]
  norm_num
  exact congrArg (fun x : E => x i) (by
    simpa [tubeOffsetCirclePoint] using hoff)

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_eq_cases
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_eq_cases (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) {u v : I}
    (huv : tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase k V u =
      tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase k V v) :
    u = v ∨ (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hpoint :
      tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y
          (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) =
        tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y
          (2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ)) := by
    have h := congrArg (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph
      (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)) huv
    rw [tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_homeomorph_apply,
      tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_homeomorph_apply] at h
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  have hamb := congrArg
    (fun x : E => tubeApproxAmbient (WithLp.ofLp x)) hpoint
  rw [tubeApproxAmbient_bridgeCirclePoint,
    tubeApproxAmbient_bridgeCirclePoint] at hamb
  have hq := tubeNorthOffset_norm_lt_quarter
    (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y
    (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).norm_y_lt
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (tubeMap_inj (m := m)
    (hq.trans (by norm_num)) (hq.trans (by norm_num)) hamb).1
  have huvZ : (v : ℝ) = (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) := by
    have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
    nlinarith
  have hzLowerR : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  have hzUpperR : (z : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
  have hzLower : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast hzLowerR
  have hzUpper : z ≤ (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hzUpperR
  rcases (show z = -1 ∨ z = 0 ∨ z = 1 by omega) with hzv | hzv | hzv
  · right; right
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hzv] at huvZ
    norm_num at huvZ
    exact huvZ.symm
  · right; left
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe
statement:

    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) (u : I) :

        AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod
          (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k))) =

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_endpoint_zsmul
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_endpoint_zsmul (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V 1 =
      z • V.fundamentalPeriod
        (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)
proof:
:= by
  let ψ := tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V
  let T := V.fundamentalPeriod
    (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)
  have hcoe : ((ψ 1 : ℝ) : AddCircle T) = 0 := by
    calc
      ((ψ 1 : ℝ) : AddCircle T) =
          tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase k V 1 :=
        tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V 1
      _ = tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase k V 0 :=
        (tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_closed k V).symm
      _ = 0 := tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_zero k V
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff T).mp hcoe
  exact ⟨z, hz.symm⟩

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_one_ne_zero (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let ψ := tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V
  let φ := tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase k V
  let c : I := ⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ), by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
  have hc0 : (0 : I) < c := by change (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2; norm_num
  have hc1 : c < (1 : I) := by change (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1; norm_num
  have hφc : φ c ≠ φ 0 := by
    intro h
    rcases tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_eq_cases k V h with
      hEq | hEnds | hEnds
    · exact (ne_of_gt hc0) hEq
    · exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : I) ≠ 1) hEnds.2
    · exact (ne_of_lt hc1) hEnds.1
  have hψc : ψ c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hφc
    calc
      φ c = ((ψ c : ℝ) : AddCircle
          (V.fundamentalPeriod
            (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k))) :=
        (tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V c).symm
      _ = ((ψ 0 : ℝ) : AddCircle
          (V.fundamentalPeriod
            (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k))) := by
        rw [hzero, tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero]
      _ = φ 0 := tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V 0
  intro hψ1
  have hcont : Continuous ψ :=
    (tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V).continuous
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hψc with hneg | hpos
  · let z : ℝ := ψ c / 2
    have hzL : z ∈ Icc (ψ c) (ψ 0) := by
      rw [tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨u, huI, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (le_of_lt hc0)
      hcont.continuousOn hzL
    have hzR : z ∈ Icc (ψ c) (ψ 1) := by
      rw [hψ1]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨v, hvI, hv⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (le_of_lt hc1)
      hcont.continuousOn hzR
    have hphase : φ u = φ v := by
      rw [← tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V u,
        ← tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V v, hu, hv]
    rcases tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_eq_cases k V hphase with
      huv | hends | hends
    · subst v
      have : u = c := le_antisymm huI.2 hvI.1
      subst u
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1, tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1, hψ1] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
  · let z : ℝ := ψ c / 2
    have hzL : z ∈ Icc (ψ 0) (ψ c) := by
      rw [tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨u, huI, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (le_of_lt hc0)
      hcont.continuousOn hzL
    have hzR : z ∈ Icc (ψ 1) (ψ c) := by
      rw [hψ1]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨v, hvI, hv⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (le_of_lt hc1)
      hcont.continuousOn hzR
    have hphase : φ u = φ v := by
      rw [← tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V u,
        ← tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V v, hu, hv]
    rcases tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_eq_cases k V hphase with
      huv | hends | hends
    · subst v
      have : u = c := le_antisymm huI.2 hvI.1
      subst u
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1, tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1, hψ1] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_injective
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_injective (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    Function.Injective (tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  have hphase : tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase k V u =
      tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase k V v := by
    rw [← tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V u,
      ← tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V v, huv]
  rcases tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_eq_cases k V hphase with
    hEq | hEnds | hEnds
  · exact hEq
  · exfalso
    apply tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_one_ne_zero k V
    rw [← hEnds.2, ← huv, hEnds.1,
      tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero]
  · exfalso
    apply tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_one_ne_zero k V
    rw [← hEnds.1, huv, hEnds.2,
      tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero]

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_one_eq_period_or_neg
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_one_eq_period_or_neg (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V 1 =
        V.fundamentalPeriod
          (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k) ∨
      tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V 1 =
        -V.fundamentalPeriod
          (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)
proof:
:= by
  let ψ := tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V
  let φ := tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase k V
  let T := V.fundamentalPeriod
    (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)
  have hT : 0 < T := V.fundamentalPeriod_pos
    (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_endpoint_zsmul k V
  have hzR : ψ 1 = (z : ℝ) * T := by
    simpa [ψ, T, zsmul_eq_mul] using hz
  have hmonoanti := (tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V).continuous
    |>.strictMono_of_inj_boundedOrder'
      (tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_injective k V)
  rcases hmonoanti with hmono | hanti
  · have hψ1pos : 0 < ψ 1 := by
      have h := hmono (show (0 : I) < 1 by norm_num)
      rwa [tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero] at h
    have hzposR : (0 : ℝ) < (z : ℝ) := by nlinarith
    have hzpos : (0 : ℤ) < z := by exact_mod_cast hzposR
    have hzle : z ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra hznot
      have hzge : (2 : ℤ) ≤ z := by omega
      have hzgeR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hzge
      have hmem : T ∈ Icc (ψ 0) (ψ 1) := by
        rw [tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero, hzR]
        constructor <;> nlinarith
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (0 : I) (1 : I)
        (tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V).continuous hmem
      have hphase : φ u = φ 0 := by
        rw [← tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V u,
          ← tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V 0,
          hu, tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero]
        exact AddCircle.coe_period T
      rcases tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_eq_cases k V hphase with
        hu0 | hbad | hu1
      · rw [hu0, tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero] at hu
        linarith
      · exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : I) ≠ 1) hbad.2
      · rw [hu1.1, hzR] at hu
        nlinarith
    have hzone : z = 1 := by omega
    left
    simpa [T, hzone] using hzR
  · have hψ1neg : ψ 1 < 0 := by
      have h := hanti (show (0 : I) < 1 by norm_num)
      rwa [tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero] at h
    have hznegR : (z : ℝ) < 0 := by nlinarith
    have hzneg : z < (0 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hznegR
    have hzge : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ z := by
      by_contra hznot
      have hzle : z ≤ (-2 : ℤ) := by omega
      have hzleR : (z : ℝ) ≤ -2 := by exact_mod_cast hzle
      have hmem : -T ∈ Icc (ψ 1) (ψ 0) := by
        rw [tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero, hzR]
        constructor <;> nlinarith
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (1 : I) (0 : I)
        (tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V).continuous hmem
      have hphase : φ u = φ 0 := by
        rw [← tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V u,
          ← tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V 0,
          hu, tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero]
        rw [AddCircle.coe_neg, AddCircle.coe_period, neg_zero]
        rfl
      rcases tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhase_eq_cases k V hphase with
        hu0 | hbad | hu1
      · rw [hu0, tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero] at hu
        linarith
      · exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : I) ≠ 1) hbad.2
      · rw [hu1.1, hzR] at hu
        nlinarith
    have hzmone : z = -1 := by omega
    right
    simpa [T, hzmone] using hzR

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeParamPoint_eq_flow_lift
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeParamPoint_eq_flow_lift (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) (u : I) :
    tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y
        (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) =

          (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0)
        (tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V u)
proof:
:= by

  rw [← tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_coe k V u] at h
  have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
  rw [V.orbitCircleHomeomorph_coe] at hv
  simpa [tubeExplicitBridgeParamOrbitPath] using hv.symm

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop_one
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop_one (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop k V 1 =
      V.fundamentalFrameLoop
        (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop _ _ (1 * (u : ℝ) * _) = frameLoop _ _ ((u : ℝ) * _)

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop_neg_one
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop_neg_one (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop k V (-1) =
      reverseLoop (V.fundamentalFrameLoop
        (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k))
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  let hp := tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k
  let F := fun t : ℝ => frameLoop (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls
    (V.flow (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k
      (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0)) t
  have hper : Function.Periodic F (V.fundamentalPeriod hp) :=
    frameLoop_periodic _ (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp)
  change F ((-1 : ℝ) * (u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp) =
    F ((unitInterval.symm u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp)
  have h := hper ((-1 : ℝ) * (u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp)
  rw [show (unitInterval.symm u : ℝ) = 1 - (u : ℝ) by rfl]
  convert h.symm using 1 <;> ring

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop_closed
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop_closed (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop k V 0 =
      tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop k V 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop_eq_lifted k V]
  exact tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop_closed k

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeFrameReparamHomotopy_closed
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeFrameReparamHomotopy_closed (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) (ε : ℝ)
    (hend : tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V 1 =
      ε * V.fundamentalPeriod
        (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k))
    (hperiod : Function.Periodic
      (fun t : ℝ => frameLoop (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls
        (V.flow (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k
          (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0)) t)
      (ε * V.fundamentalPeriod
        (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)))
    (s : I) :
    tubeExplicitBridgeFrameReparamHomotopy k V ε (s, 0) =
      tubeExplicitBridgeFrameReparamHomotopy k V ε (s, 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  let T := V.fundamentalPeriod
    (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)
  let F := fun t : ℝ => frameLoop (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls
    (V.flow (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k
      (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0)) t
  change F ((1 - (s : ℝ)) * tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V 0 +
      (s : ℝ) * (ε * (((0 : I) : ℝ)) * T)) =
    F ((1 - (s : ℝ)) * tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V 1 +
      (s : ℝ) * (ε * (((1 : I) : ℝ)) * T))
  rw [tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_zero, hend]
  norm_num
  change F 0 = F ((1 - (s : ℝ)) * (ε * T) + (s : ℝ) * (ε * T))
  rw [show (1 - (s : ℝ)) * (ε * T) + (s : ℝ) * (ε * T) =
    ε * T by ring]
  simpa [F, T] using (hperiod 0).symm

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop_closed
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop_closed (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) (ε : ℝ)
    (hperiod : Function.Periodic
      (fun t : ℝ => frameLoop (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls
        (V.flow (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k
          (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0)) t)
      (ε * V.fundamentalPeriod
        (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k))) :
    tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop k V ε 0 =
      tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop k V ε 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop _ _ (ε * (((0 : I) : ℝ)) * _) =
    frameLoop _ _ (ε * (((1 : I) : ℝ)) * _)
  norm_num
  convert (hperiod 0).symm using 1 <;> ring

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameClass_eq_fundamental
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameClass_eq_fundamental (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    loopClassZ2 (tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop (m := m) k)
        (tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop_closed k) =
      V.fundamentalFrameClass
        (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k)
proof:
:= by
  let hp := tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k
  let T := V.fundamentalPeriod hp
  let F := fun t : ℝ => frameLoop (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls
    (V.flow (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k
      (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0)) t
  have hper : Function.Periodic F T :=
    frameLoop_periodic _ (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp)
  have hloop := tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop_eq_lifted k V
  rcases tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift_one_eq_period_or_neg k V with
    hplus | hminus
  · have hend : tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V 1 =
        (1 : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp := by simpa using hplus
    have hclosed := tubeExplicitBridgeFrameReparamHomotopy_closed k V 1 hend
      (by simpa [F, T] using hper)
    have horientedClosed := tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop_closed k V 1
      (by simpa [F, T] using hper)
    calc
      loopClassZ2 (tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop (m := m) k)
          (tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop_closed k) =
        loopClassZ2 (tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop k V)
          (tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop_closed k V) :=
        loopClassZ2_congr_fun (tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop_closed k)
          (tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop_closed k V) hloop
      _ = loopClassZ2 (tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop k V 1)
          horientedClosed :=
        loopClassZ2_congr (tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop_closed k V)
          horientedClosed
          (tubeExplicitBridgeFrameReparamHomotopy k V 1) hclosed
      _ = V.fundamentalFrameClass hp := by
        unfold TamedField.fundamentalFrameClass
        exact loopClassZ2_congr_fun horientedClosed
          (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp)
          (tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop_one k V)
  · have hend : tubeExplicitBridgeParamPhaseLift k V 1 =
        (-1 : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp := by simpa using hminus
    have hclosed := tubeExplicitBridgeFrameReparamHomotopy_closed k V (-1) hend
      (by simpa [F, T] using hper.neg)
    have horientedClosed := tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop_closed k V (-1)
      (by simpa [F, T] using hper.neg)
    calc
      loopClassZ2 (tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop (m := m) k)
          (tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop_closed k) =
        loopClassZ2 (tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop k V)
          (tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop_closed k V) :=
        loopClassZ2_congr_fun (tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop_closed k)
          (tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop_closed k V) hloop
      _ = loopClassZ2 (tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop k V (-1))
          horientedClosed :=
        loopClassZ2_congr (tubeExplicitBridgeLiftedFrameLoop_closed k V)
          horientedClosed
          (tubeExplicitBridgeFrameReparamHomotopy k V (-1)) hclosed
      _ = loopClassZ2
          (reverseLoop (V.fundamentalFrameLoop hp))
          (reverseLoop_closed (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp)) := by
        exact loopClassZ2_congr_fun horientedClosed
          (reverseLoop_closed (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp))
          (tubeExplicitBridgeOrientedFrameLoop_neg_one k V)
      _ = V.fundamentalFrameClass hp := by
        exact loopClassZ2_reverse (V.fundamentalFrameLoop hp)
          (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp)

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridge_north_orbitFrameClass
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridge_north_orbitFrameClass (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    V.orbitFrameClass (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthOrbitIndex k V) =
      (k : ZMod 2) + 1
proof:
:= by
  let O := tubeExplicitBridgeNorthOrbitIndex k V
  let p : E := tubeBridgeCirclePoint k
    (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0
  let hp : p ∈ (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls.fiber :=
    tubeExplicitBridgeNorthBase_mem_fiber (m := m) k
  have hpoint : V.orbitPoint O ∈ V.orbit p := by
    change V.orbitPoint O ∈
      V.orbit (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k
        (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y 0)
    rw [← tubeExplicitBridgeNorthOrbitIndex_coe k V]
    change V.orbitPoint O ∈ (O : Set E)
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self (V.orbitPoint O)
  calc
    V.orbitFrameClass O =
        V.fundamentalFrameClass (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) := rfl
    _ = V.fundamentalFrameClass hp :=
      V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit hp hpoint
    _ = loopClassZ2 (tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop (m := m) k)
        (tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop_closed k) :=
      (tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameClass_eq_fundamental k V).symm
    _ = (k : ZMod 2) + 1 :=
      loopClassZ2_tubeExplicitBridgeParamFrameLoop k

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridge_north_orbitContribution
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridge_north_orbitContribution (k : ℕ)
    (V : TamedField (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).fls) :
    V.orbitContribution (tubeExplicitBridgeNorthOrbitIndex k V) =
      (k : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  unfold TamedField.orbitContribution
  rw [tubeExplicitBridge_north_orbitFrameClass]
  rw [add_assoc]
  rw [show (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 by
    exact CharTwo.two_eq_zero, add_zero]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.exists_positiveFlowEndpoint_of_localCover
statement:
theorem exists_positiveFlowEndpoint_of_localCover
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    {K : Set E'}
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData K)
    (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) (i : Fin 2) (u₀ : E₂)
    (hu₀Radius : ‖u₀‖ < M.radius)
    (hquad₀ : morseQuadratic .saddle (u₀ 0, u₀ 1) = 0)
    (hu₀K : M.param u₀ ∈ K)
    {r εcover εbranch A : ℝ}
    (hrRadius : r ≤ M.radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : E', dist v (M.param u₀) < εcover →
      C.G v = 0 → ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hbranch : ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r →
      dist (M.param u) (M.param u₀) < εbranch →
      0 < signedBranch b (u i))
    (hAsafe : A ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hcoverClose : (R.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εcover)
    (hbranchClose : (R.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εbranch) :
    ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧
      M.param u = R.base.flow (M.param u₀) (A ^ 2) ∧
      0 < signedBranch b (u i) ∧
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = A ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let v := R.base.flow (M.param u₀) (A ^ 2)
  have hu₀fiber : C.G (M.param u₀) = 0 :=
    M.param_fiber u₀ hu₀Radius
  have hvfiber : C.G v = 0 :=
    R.flow_mem_fiber hu₀fiber (A ^ 2)
  have hdist : dist v (M.param u₀) ≤
      (R.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 := by
    calc
      dist v (M.param u₀) =
          dist (R.base.flow (M.param u₀) (A ^ 2))
            (R.base.flow (M.param u₀) 0) := by simp [v]
      _ ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |A ^ 2 - 0| :=
        R.base.dist_flow_self_le (M.param u₀) (A ^ 2) 0
      _ = (R.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 := by
        rw [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg A)]
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huParam⟩ :=
    hcover v (hdist.trans_lt hcoverClose) hvfiber
  have hparamDist : dist (M.param u) (M.param u₀) < εbranch := by
    rw [huParam]
    exact hdist.trans_lt hbranchClose
  have husign : 0 < signedBranch b (u i) :=
    hbranch u hu hparamDist
  have huRadius : ‖u‖ < M.radius := hu.trans_le hrRadius
  have htflow : tcoord v = tcoord (M.param u₀) + A ^ 2 := by
    exact R.tcoord_flow hu₀K (s := A ^ 2) (by
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg A)]
      exact hAsafe)
  have htimeEq : tcoord (M.param u) =
      tcoord (M.param u₀) + A ^ 2 := by
    rw [huParam]
    exact htflow
  have htu := M.time_model u huRadius
  have htu₀ := M.time_model u₀ hu₀Radius
  rw [hindex] at htu htu₀
  have huquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = A ^ 2 := by
    rw [htu, htu₀, hquad₀] at htimeEq
    linarith
  exact ⟨u, hu, huParam, husign, huquad⟩

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.exists_negativeFlowEndpoint_of_localCover
statement:
theorem exists_negativeFlowEndpoint_of_localCover
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    {K : Set E'}
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData K)
    (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) (i : Fin 2) (u₀ : E₂)
    (hu₀Radius : ‖u₀‖ < M.radius)
    (hquad₀ : morseQuadratic .saddle (u₀ 0, u₀ 1) = 0)
    (hu₀K : M.param u₀ ∈ K)
    {r εcover εbranch A : ℝ}
    (hrRadius : r ≤ M.radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : E', dist v (M.param u₀) < εcover →
      C.G v = 0 → ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hbranch : ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r →
      dist (M.param u) (M.param u₀) < εbranch →
      0 < signedBranch b (u i))
    (hAsafe : A ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hcoverClose : (R.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εcover)
    (hbranchClose : (R.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 < εbranch) :
    ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧
      M.param u = R.base.flow (M.param u₀) (-(A ^ 2)) ∧
      0 < signedBranch b (u i) ∧
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(A ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let v := R.base.flow (M.param u₀) (-(A ^ 2))
  have hu₀fiber : C.G (M.param u₀) = 0 :=
    M.param_fiber u₀ hu₀Radius
  have hvfiber : C.G v = 0 :=
    R.flow_mem_fiber hu₀fiber (-(A ^ 2))
  have hdist : dist v (M.param u₀) ≤
      (R.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 := by
    calc
      dist v (M.param u₀) =
          dist (R.base.flow (M.param u₀) (-(A ^ 2)))
            (R.base.flow (M.param u₀) 0) := by simp [v]
      _ ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |-(A ^ 2) - 0| :=
        R.base.dist_flow_self_le (M.param u₀) (-(A ^ 2)) 0
      _ = (R.base.bound : ℝ) * A ^ 2 := by
        rw [sub_zero, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg A)]
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huParam⟩ :=
    hcover v (hdist.trans_lt hcoverClose) hvfiber
  have hparamDist : dist (M.param u) (M.param u₀) < εbranch := by
    rw [huParam]
    exact hdist.trans_lt hbranchClose
  have husign : 0 < signedBranch b (u i) :=
    hbranch u hu hparamDist
  have huRadius : ‖u‖ < M.radius := hu.trans_le hrRadius
  have htflow : tcoord v = tcoord (M.param u₀) - A ^ 2 := by
    have h := R.tcoord_flow hu₀K
      (s := -(A ^ 2)) (by
        rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg A)]
        exact hAsafe)
    linarith
  have htimeEq : tcoord (M.param u) =
      tcoord (M.param u₀) - A ^ 2 := by
    rw [huParam]
    exact htflow
  have htu := M.time_model u huRadius
  have htu₀ := M.time_model u₀ hu₀Radius
  rw [hindex] at htu htu₀
  have huquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(A ^ 2) := by
    rw [htu, htu₀, hquad₀] at htimeEq
    linarith
  exact ⟨u, hu, huParam, husign, huquad⟩

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_param_signedBranch_neighborhood
statement:
theorem exists_param_signedBranch_neighborhood
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (H : M.FullRadiusSmooth)
    (b : SaddleBranch) (i : Fin 2) (u₀ : E₂)
    {r rInj : ℝ} (_hr : 0 < r) (hrrInj : r < rInj)
    (hrInj : rInj ≤ T.radius)
    (hu₀ : ‖u₀‖ < rInj)
    (hu₀sign : 0 < signedBranch b (u₀ i)) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r →
      dist (M.param u) (M.param u₀) < ε →
      0 < signedBranch b (u i)
proof:
:= by
  let Φ := M.param
  let bad : Set E₂ :=
    closedBall (0 : E₂) r ∩ {u | signedBranch b (u i) ≤ 0}
  have hcoord : Continuous (fun u : E₂ => signedBranch b (u i)) := by
    cases b <;> simp only [signedBranch] <;> fun_prop
  have hbadCompact : IsCompact bad := by
    apply (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E₂) r).inter_right
    exact isClosed_le hcoord continuous_const
  have hbadSub : bad ⊆ ball (0 : E₂) M.radius := by
    intro u hu
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    have hur : ‖u‖ ≤ r := by
      simpa [bad, mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu.1
    exact (hur.trans_lt hrrInj).trans_le (hrInj.trans T.radius_le)
  have hΦcont : ContinuousOn Φ bad := by
    intro u hu
    exact (H.differentiableAt u
      (by simpa [Φ, mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using
        hbadSub hu)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have himageCompact : IsCompact (Φ '' bad) :=
    hbadCompact.image_of_continuousOn hΦcont
  have hu₀Ball : u₀ ∈ ball (0 : E₂) T.radius := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hu₀.trans_le hrInj
  have hnotmem : Φ u₀ ∉ Φ '' bad := by
    rintro ⟨u, huBad, hu⟩
    have huBall : u ∈ ball (0 : E₂) T.radius := by
      rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      have hur : ‖u‖ ≤ r := by
        simpa [bad, mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using huBad.1
      exact (hur.trans_lt hrrInj).trans_le hrInj
    have heq : u = u₀ := T.param_injOn huBall hu₀Ball hu
    have hbadSign : signedBranch b (u i) ≤ 0 := huBad.2
    rw [heq] at hbadSign
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hbadSign) hu₀sign
  have hnhds : (Φ '' bad)ᶜ ∈ nhds (Φ u₀) :=
    himageCompact.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hnotmem
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnhds
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro u hu hdist
  by_contra hnotpos
  have huBad : u ∈ bad := by
    constructor
    · simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using le_of_lt hu
    · exact le_of_not_gt hnotpos
  have himage : Φ u ∈ Φ '' bad := ⟨u, huBad, rfl⟩
  have hballmem : Φ u ∈ ball (Φ u₀) ε := by
    simpa [mem_ball] using hdist
  exact (hball hballmem) himage

statement:
theorem norm_chronologicalSaddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)

    ‖saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)‖ =
      D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
proof:
:= by
  have hrho : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 <

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam_first_sign
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam_first_sign
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    0 < signedBranch p.1
      ((saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) 0)
proof:
:= by
  let r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  have hr : 0 < r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hσ : 0 < saddleBoundaryParameter r 0 := by
    unfold saddleBoundaryParameter
    exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hr])
  have hsqrtσ : Real.sqrt (saddleBoundaryParameter r 0 ^ 2) =
      saddleBoundaryParameter r 0 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hσ]
  rcases p with ⟨b, e⟩
  have hσsq : 0 < saddleBoundaryParameter r 0 ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hσ
  cases b <;> cases e <;>
    simpa [saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
      saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam, saddlePositiveArc,
      signedBranch, hsqrtσ, abs_of_pos hσ] using hσsq

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranchNeighborhood
statement:
theorem exists_chronologicalSaddlePositiveBranchNeighborhood
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ u : E₂,
      ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht →
      dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u)
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param
            (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))) < ε →
      0 < signedBranch p.1 (u 0)
proof:
:= by
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  apply T.exists_param_signedBranch_neighborhood H p.1 0
    (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
    (le_refl T.radius)
  · rw [D.norm_chronologicalSaddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam t ht p]
    exact D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  · exact D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam_first_sign t ht p
