name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.nonempty_chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale
statement:
theorem nonempty_chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht)) :
    Nonempty (ChronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A L)
proof:
:= by
  let R := D.chronologicalSaddleChosenMateArcTimeField t ht A
  let m := D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointFlowMargin t ht L
  let B : ℝ := (R.base.bound : ℝ)
  have hsafeN : {x : ℝ | x ^ 2 < R.safeTime} ∈ nhds 0 := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) 0 :=
        continuousAt_id.pow 2
      simpa using hcont.tendsto
    exact hlim (Iio_mem_nhds R.safeTime_pos)
  have hmarginN : {x : ℝ | B * x ^ 2 < m} ∈ nhds 0 := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => B * x ^ 2) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => B * x ^ 2) 0 :=
        continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_id.pow 2)
      simpa using hcont.tendsto
    exact hlim (Iio_mem_nhds
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointFlowMargin_pos t ht L))
  have hgood : {x : ℝ | x ^ 2 < R.safeTime ∧ B * x ^ 2 < m} ∈ nhds 0 :=
    Filter.inter_mem hsafeN hmarginN
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hgood
  let c := min (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) δ
  let b := c / 2
  have hc : 0 < c := lt_min
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht) hδ
  have hb : 0 < b := div_pos hc (by norm_num)
  have hbc : b < c := by dsimp [b]; linarith
  have hba : b < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    hbc.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hbδ : dist b (0 : ℝ) < δ := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hb]
    exact hbc.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hbGood := hball hbδ
  refine ⟨{
    scale := b
    scale_pos := hb
    scale_lt_window := hba
    safe := hbGood.1.le
    cover_close := ?_
    positive_branch_close := ?_
    negative_branch_close := ?_ }⟩
  · intro p
    exact hbGood.2.trans_le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointFlowMargin_le_cover t ht L p)
  · intro p
    exact hbGood.2.trans_le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointFlowMargin_le_positiveBranch t ht L p)
  · intro p
    exact hbGood.2.trans_le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointFlowMargin_le_negativeBranch t ht L p)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.eventTime_eq_of_mem_chronologicalBracket
statement:
private theorem eventTime_eq_of_mem_chronologicalBracket
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    {s : ℝ} (hsEvent : s ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hs : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  let v := D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent
  have hvCritical : v ∈ timeCritical D.signedOutput.cobordism.G :=
    (D.position.eventCenter_mem_coreCriticalPoints s hsEvent).1
  have hvInterval : tcoord v ∈
      Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
    change tcoord (D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent) ∈ _
    rw [D.position.eventCenter_time s hsEvent]
    exact hs
  have hvEq : v = D.position.eventCenter t ht :=
    (D.position.eventBracket t ht).isolates v hvCritical hvInterval
  calc
    s = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent) :=
      (D.position.eventCenter_time s hsEvent).symm
    _ = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := congrArg tcoord hvEq
    _ = t := D.position.eventCenter_time t ht

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleShortScale_sq_lt_window_sq
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleShortScale_sq_lt_window_sq
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht)) :
    (D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L).scale ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let Q := D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L
  exact (sq_lt_sq₀ Q.scale_pos.le
    (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht).le).2 Q.scale_lt_window

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.regularSlab_chronologicalSaddleShortAfter_to_window
statement:
theorem regularSlab_chronologicalSaddleShortAfter_to_window
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht)) :
    regularSlab D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime t ht A L)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.position.regularSlab_iff_avoid_eventTimes]
  intro s hsEvent hs
  have hcenterShort : tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
      D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime t ht A L := by
    rw [chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime]
    exact lt_add_of_pos_right _
      (sq_pos_of_pos
        (D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L).scale_pos)
  have hsBracket : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
    constructor
    · exact (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before_lt.le.trans
        (hcenterShort.le.trans hs.1)
    · exact hs.2.trans
        (D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht).2.le
  have hst : s = t :=
    D.eventTime_eq_of_mem_chronologicalBracket t ht hsEvent hsBracket
  have htShort : t < D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime t ht A L :=
    (D.position.eventCenter_time t ht).symm.trans_lt hcenterShort
  exact (not_le_of_gt htShort) (hst ▸ hs.1)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.regularSlab_window_to_chronologicalSaddleShortBefore
statement:
theorem regularSlab_window_to_chronologicalSaddleShortBefore
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht)) :
    regularSlab D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime t ht A L)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.position.regularSlab_iff_avoid_eventTimes]
  intro s hsEvent hs
  have hshortCenter : D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime t ht A L <
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    rw [chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime]
    exact sub_lt_self _
      (sq_pos_of_pos
        (D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L).scale_pos)
  have hsBracket : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
    constructor
    · exact (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_bracket t ht).1.le.trans hs.1
    · exact hs.2.trans
        (hshortCenter.le.trans (D.position.eventBracket t ht).lt_after.le)
  have hst : s = t :=
    D.eventTime_eq_of_mem_chronologicalBracket t ht hsEvent hsBracket
  have hshortT : D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime t ht A L < t :=
    hshortCenter.trans_eq (D.position.eventCenter_time t ht)
  exact (not_le_of_gt hshortT) (hst ▸ hs.2)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime_regular
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime_regular
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht)) :
    sliceRegular D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime t ht A L)
proof:
:=
  (D.regularSlab_chronologicalSaddleShortAfter_to_window t ht A L).sliceRegular
    ⟨le_rfl, by
      rw [chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime, chronologicalAfterTime]
      simpa [add_comm] using add_le_add_left
        (D.chronologicalSaddleShortScale_sq_lt_window_sq t ht A L).le
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))⟩

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime_regular
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime_regular
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht)) :
    sliceRegular D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime t ht A L)
proof:
:=
  (D.regularSlab_window_to_chronologicalSaddleShortBefore t ht A L).sliceRegular
    ⟨by
      rw [chronologicalBeforeTime, chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime]
      exact sub_le_sub_left
        (D.chronologicalSaddleShortScale_sq_lt_window_sq t ht A L).le _, le_rfl⟩

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData.positiveEndpoint_mem_shortBranchOrbit
statement:
theorem positiveEndpoint_mem_shortBranchOrbit
    (F : ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A L)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    spacePart
        ((D.chronologicalSaddleChosenMateArcTimeField t ht A).base.flow
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho)
          ((D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L).scale ^ 2)) ∈
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleShortPositiveOrbit t ht hindex A L p.1 :
        (D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterField t ht A L).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁)
proof:
:= by
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  let Q := D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hend, hsign, hquad⟩ := F.positiveEndpoint p
  have hmem := T.saddlePositiveParam_mem_branch_orbit_full H hindex p.1
    rho Q.scale u hquad hsign
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    ((sq_lt_sq₀ Q.scale_pos.le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht).le).2
      (Q.scale_lt_window.trans
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius t ht)))
    hu
    ((D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      T.radius_le)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime_regular t ht A L)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterField t ht A L)
  rw [hend] at hmem
  simpa [M, T, Q, chronologicalSaddleShortPositiveOrbit,
    StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex]
    using hmem

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData.negativeEndpoint_mem_shortBranchOrbit
statement:
theorem negativeEndpoint_mem_shortBranchOrbit
    (F : ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A L)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    spacePart
        ((D.chronologicalSaddleChosenMateArcTimeField t ht A).base.flow
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho)
          (-((D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L).scale ^ 2))) ∈
      ((D.chronologicalSaddleShortNegativeOrbit t ht hindex A L p.2 :
        (D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeField t ht A L).OrbitIndex) : Set E₁)
proof:
:= by
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  let Q := D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hend, hsign, hquad⟩ := F.negativeEndpoint p
  have hmem := T.saddleNegativeParam_mem_branch_orbit_full H hindex p.2
    rho Q.scale u hquad hsign
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    ((sq_lt_sq₀ Q.scale_pos.le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht).le).2
      (Q.scale_lt_window.trans
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius t ht)))
    hu
    ((D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      T.radius_le)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime_regular t ht A L)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeField t ht A L)
  rw [hend] at hmem
  simpa [M, T, Q, chronologicalSaddleShortNegativeOrbit,
    StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex]
    using hmem

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData.positiveMateShortOrbit_eq
statement:
theorem positiveMateShortOrbit_eq
    (F : ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A L)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    D.chronologicalSaddleShortPositiveOrbit t ht hindex A L p.1 =
      D.chronologicalSaddleShortPositiveOrbit t ht hindex A L (A.mate p).1
proof:
:= by
  let gamma := A.chosenMateArc p
  let Q := D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L
  let R := D.chronologicalSaddleChosenMateArcTimeField t ht A
  let V := D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterField t ht A L
  have hsafe : |Q.scale ^ 2| ≤ R.safeTime := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg Q.scale)]
    exact Q.safe
  have hflow := R.flowSlicePath_endpoints_mem_same_orbit
    gamma.toPath
    (D.chosenMateArc_mem_chronologicalSaddleChosenMateArcCore t ht A p)
    (fun u => (gamma.mem_exterior u).2.1)
    (fun u => (gamma.mem_exterior u).1)
    hsafe (D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime_regular t ht A L) V
  have hmem₁ := F.positiveEndpoint_mem_shortBranchOrbit
    (hindex := hindex) p
  have hmem₂ := F.positiveEndpoint_mem_shortBranchOrbit
    (hindex := hindex) (A.mate p)
  have heq₁ := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hmem₁
  have heq₂ := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hmem₂
  have heqflow := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hflow
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact heq₁.symm.trans (heqflow.symm.trans heq₂)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData.negativeMateShortOrbit_eq
statement:
theorem negativeMateShortOrbit_eq
    (F : ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A L)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    D.chronologicalSaddleShortNegativeOrbit t ht hindex A L p.2 =
      D.chronologicalSaddleShortNegativeOrbit t ht hindex A L (A.mate p).2
proof:
:= by
  let gamma := A.chosenMateArc p
  let Q := D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L
  let R := D.chronologicalSaddleChosenMateArcTimeField t ht A
  let V := D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeField t ht A L
  have hsafe : |-(Q.scale ^ 2)| ≤ R.safeTime := by
    rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg Q.scale)]
    exact Q.safe
  have hflow := R.flowSlicePath_endpoints_mem_same_orbit
    gamma.toPath
    (D.chosenMateArc_mem_chronologicalSaddleChosenMateArcCore t ht A p)
    (fun u => (gamma.mem_exterior u).2.1)
    (fun u => (gamma.mem_exterior u).1)
    hsafe (by
      simpa only [chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime, sub_eq_add_neg,
        FramedLevelCobordism.toLevelCobordismData] using
        D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime_regular t ht A L) V
  have hmem₁ := F.negativeEndpoint_mem_shortBranchOrbit
    (hindex := hindex) p
  have hmem₂ := F.negativeEndpoint_mem_shortBranchOrbit
    (hindex := hindex) (A.mate p)
  have heq₁ := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hmem₁
  have heq₂ := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hmem₂
  have heqflow := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hflow
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact heq₁.symm.trans (heqflow.symm.trans heq₂)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleShortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
    {A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)}
    {L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht)}
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (branch : SaddleBranch) :
    D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht A L
        (D.chronologicalSaddleShortPositiveOrbit t ht hindex A L branch) =
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex branch
proof:
:= by
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  let Q := D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L
  let b := Q.scale
  let afix := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht
  let r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  let sourceTime := D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime t ht A L
  let targetTime := D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht
  let hreg := D.regularSlab_chronologicalSaddleShortAfter_to_window t ht A L
  let W := D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterToWindowSlabField t ht A L
  let Vshort := D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterField t ht A L
  let Vtarget := D.chronologicalAfterField t ht
  let Oshort := D.chronologicalSaddleShortPositiveOrbit
    t ht hindex A L branch
  let c : C(I, ℝ) := {
    toFun := fun q => b + (q : ℝ) * (afix - b)
    continuous_toFun :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const) }
  have hbc (q : I) : b ≤ c q := by
    dsimp [c]
    have hq₀ : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := q.property.1
    have hab : 0 < afix - b := sub_pos.mpr Q.scale_lt_window
    nlinarith
  have hca (q : I) : c q ≤ afix := by
    dsimp [c]
    have hq₁ : (q : ℝ) ≤ 1 := q.property.2
    have hab : 0 < afix - b := sub_pos.mpr Q.scale_lt_window
    nlinarith
  have hcpos (q : I) : 0 < c q := Q.scale_pos.trans_le (hbc q)
  have hcr (q : I) : c q < r :=
    (hca q).trans_lt (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
  have hcsq (q : I) : (c q) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ (hcpos q).le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht).le).2 (hcr q)
  let u : I → E₂ := fun q =>
    saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam branch .negative r (c q)
  have hucont : Continuous u := by
    dsimp [u, c]
    cases branch <;>
      simp [saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam, saddlePositiveArc,
        saddleBoundaryParameter, pairToMorseParam, signedBranch] <;>
      fun_prop
  have huRadius (q : I) : ‖u q‖ < M.radius := by
    rw [show ‖u q‖ = r from
      norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam branch .negative
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) (hcsq q)]
    exact (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      T.radius_le
  let z : C(I, E') := {
    toFun := fun q => M.param (u q)
    continuous_toFun := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro q
      exact (H.differentiableAt (u q) (huRadius q)).continuousAt.comp'
        hucont.continuousAt }
  let tau : C(I, ℝ) := {
    toFun := fun q => afix ^ 2 - (c q) ^ 2
    continuous_toFun := continuous_const.sub (c.continuous.pow 2) }
  let gamma : C(I, E₁) := {
    toFun := fun q => spacePart (W.flow (z q) (tau q))
    continuous_toFun := continuous_spacePart.comp
      (W.continuous_flow_uncurry.comp
        (z.continuous.prodMk tau.continuous)) }
  have hsourceMem (q : I) :
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c q) ^ 2 ∈
        Icc sourceTime targetTime := by
    have hbSq : b ^ 2 ≤ (c q) ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ Q.scale_pos.le (hcpos q).le).2 (hbc q)
    have hcSq : (c q) ^ 2 ≤ afix ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (hcpos q).le
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht).le).2 (hca q)
    constructor
    · simpa [sourceTime, chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime, b, Q] using
        add_le_add_left hbSq (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
    · simpa [targetTime, chronologicalAfterTime, afix] using
        add_le_add_left hcSq (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
  have htargetMem : targetTime ∈ Icc sourceTime targetTime := by
    refine ⟨?_, le_rfl⟩
    simpa [sourceTime, targetTime, chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime,
      chronologicalAfterTime, b, afix, Q, add_comm] using add_le_add_left
        (D.chronologicalSaddleShortScale_sq_lt_window_sq t ht A L).le
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
  have hzFiber (q : I) : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (z q) = 0 := by
    exact M.param_fiber (u q) (huRadius q)
  have hzTime (q : I) : tcoord (z q) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c q) ^ 2 := by
    have htime := M.time_model (u q) (huRadius q)
    rw [hindex] at htime
    simpa [z, u, saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam] using htime
  have hgammaFiber : ∀ q,
      gamma q ∈ (D.chronologicalAfterSlice t ht).fiber := by
    intro q
    have hx : spacePart (z q) ∈ SlabTamedField.sliceFiber
        D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c q) ^ 2) := by
      change D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z q))
          (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c q) ^ 2)) = 0
      rw [← hzTime q, spaceTime_spacePart]
      exact hzFiber q
    have hmap := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg (hsourceMem q) htargetMem hx
    have hzst : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z q))
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c q) ^ 2) = z q := by
      rw [← hzTime q, spaceTime_spacePart]
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceTransport, hzst] at hmap
    change D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.G
      (cobSpaceTime (gamma q) targetTime) = 0
    simpa [SlabTamedField.sliceFiber, gamma, tau, targetTime,
      chronologicalAfterTime, afix] using hmap
  have hgamma₀ : gamma 0 =
      W.sliceTransport sourceTime targetTime
        (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r b)) := by
    have hz₀Time : tcoord (z 0) = sourceTime := by
      simpa [sourceTime, chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime, c, b, Q] using
        hzTime 0
    have hz₀st : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z 0)) sourceTime = z 0 := by
      rw [← hz₀Time, spaceTime_spacePart]
    have hz₀Base : z 0 = T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r b := by
      simp [z, u, c,
        StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchBase,
        StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
        StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, b, r, Q]
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceTransport, ← hz₀Base, hz₀st]
    simp [gamma, tau, z, u, c, sourceTime, targetTime,
      chronologicalSaddleShortAfterTime, chronologicalAfterTime,
      StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchBase,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, afix, b, r, Q]
  have hgamma₁ : gamma 1 =
      spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r afix) := by
    simp [gamma, tau, z, u, c,
      StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchBase,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, afix, b, r, Q]
  have hpath := Vtarget.continuousMap_mem_orbit gamma hgammaFiber 1
  rw [hgamma₀, hgamma₁] at hpath
  have hbaseFiber : spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r b) ∈
      (D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterSlice t ht A L).fiber := by
    apply T.saddlePositiveBranchBase_mem_fiber hindex branch
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      ((sq_lt_sq₀ Q.scale_pos.le
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht).le).2
        (Q.scale_lt_window.trans
          (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius t ht)))
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  have hbaseOrbit : spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r b) ∈
      Vshort.orbit (Vshort.orbitPoint Oshort) := by
    rw [← Vshort.orbitPoint_orbit Oshort]
    exact Vshort.mem_orbit_self _
  have hshortMem : sourceTime ∈ Icc sourceTime targetTime :=
    ⟨le_rfl, htargetMem.1⟩
  have hmapOrbit := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo_orbit hreg
    hshortMem htargetMem Vshort Vtarget
      (Vshort.orbitPoint_mem_fiber Oshort) hbaseOrbit
  have hsame := Vtarget.orbit_eq_of_mem hmapOrbit
  rw [hsame] at hpath
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Vtarget.orbit
      (W.sliceTransport sourceTime targetTime (Vshort.orbitPoint Oshort)) =
    Vtarget.orbit
      (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r afix))
  exact (Vtarget.orbit_eq_of_mem hpath).symm

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
    {A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)}
    {L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht)}
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (branch : SaddleBranch) :
    D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht A L
        (D.chronologicalSaddleShortNegativeOrbit t ht hindex A L branch) =
      D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex branch
proof:
:= by
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  let Q := D.chronologicalSaddleShortFlowScale t ht A L
  let b := Q.scale
  let afix := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht
  let r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  let sourceTime := D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime t ht A L
  let targetTime := D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht
  let hreg := D.regularSlab_window_to_chronologicalSaddleShortBefore t ht A L
  let W := D.chronologicalSaddleWindowToShortBeforeSlabField t ht A L
  let Vshort := D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeField t ht A L
  let Vtarget := D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht
  let Oshort := D.chronologicalSaddleShortNegativeOrbit
    t ht hindex A L branch
  let c : C(I, ℝ) := {
    toFun := fun q => b + (q : ℝ) * (afix - b)
    continuous_toFun :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const) }
  have hbc (q : I) : b ≤ c q := by
    dsimp [c]
    have hq₀ : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := q.property.1
    have hab : 0 < afix - b := sub_pos.mpr Q.scale_lt_window
    nlinarith
  have hca (q : I) : c q ≤ afix := by
    dsimp [c]
    have hq₁ : (q : ℝ) ≤ 1 := q.property.2
    have hab : 0 < afix - b := sub_pos.mpr Q.scale_lt_window
    nlinarith
  have hcpos (q : I) : 0 < c q := Q.scale_pos.trans_le (hbc q)
  have hcr (q : I) : c q < r :=
    (hca q).trans_lt (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
  have hcsq (q : I) : (c q) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ (hcpos q).le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht).le).2 (hcr q)
  let u : I → E₂ := fun q =>
    saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam branch .negative r (c q)
  have hucont : Continuous u := by
    dsimp [u, c]
    cases branch <;>
      simp [saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam, saddleNegativeArc,
        saddleBoundaryParameter, pairToMorseParam, signedBranch] <;>
      fun_prop
  have huRadius (q : I) : ‖u q‖ < M.radius := by
    rw [show ‖u q‖ = r from
      norm_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam branch .negative
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) (hcsq q)]
    exact (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      T.radius_le
  let z : C(I, E') := {
    toFun := fun q => M.param (u q)
    continuous_toFun := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro q
      exact (H.differentiableAt (u q) (huRadius q)).continuousAt.comp'
        hucont.continuousAt }
  let tau : C(I, ℝ) := {
    toFun := fun q => (c q) ^ 2 - afix ^ 2
    continuous_toFun := (c.continuous.pow 2).sub continuous_const }
  let gamma : C(I, E₁) := {
    toFun := fun q => spacePart (W.flow (z q) (tau q))
    continuous_toFun := continuous_spacePart.comp
      (W.continuous_flow_uncurry.comp
        (z.continuous.prodMk tau.continuous)) }
  have hsourceMem (q : I) :
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - (c q) ^ 2 ∈
        Icc targetTime sourceTime := by
    have hbSq : b ^ 2 ≤ (c q) ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ Q.scale_pos.le (hcpos q).le).2 (hbc q)
    have hcSq : (c q) ^ 2 ≤ afix ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (hcpos q).le
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht).le).2 (hca q)
    constructor
    · simpa [targetTime, chronologicalBeforeTime, afix] using
        sub_le_sub_left hcSq (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
    · simpa [sourceTime, chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime, b, Q] using
        sub_le_sub_left hbSq (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
  have htargetMem : targetTime ∈ Icc targetTime sourceTime := by
    refine ⟨le_rfl, ?_⟩
    simpa [sourceTime, targetTime, chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime,
      chronologicalBeforeTime, b, afix, Q] using sub_le_sub_left
        (D.chronologicalSaddleShortScale_sq_lt_window_sq t ht A L).le
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
  have hzFiber (q : I) : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (z q) = 0 := by
    exact M.param_fiber (u q) (huRadius q)
  have hzTime (q : I) : tcoord (z q) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - (c q) ^ 2 := by
    have htime := M.time_model (u q) (huRadius q)
    rw [hindex] at htime
    simpa [z, u, saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam, sub_eq_add_neg] using htime
  have hgammaFiber : ∀ q,
      gamma q ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice t ht).fiber := by
    intro q
    have hx : spacePart (z q) ∈ SlabTamedField.sliceFiber
        D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - (c q) ^ 2) := by
      change D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z q))
          (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - (c q) ^ 2)) = 0
      rw [← hzTime q, spaceTime_spacePart]
      exact hzFiber q
    have hmap := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg (hsourceMem q) htargetMem hx
    have hzst : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z q))
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - (c q) ^ 2) = z q := by
      rw [← hzTime q, spaceTime_spacePart]
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceTransport, hzst] at hmap
    change D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.G
      (cobSpaceTime (gamma q) targetTime) = 0
    simpa [SlabTamedField.sliceFiber, gamma, tau, targetTime,
      chronologicalBeforeTime, afix] using hmap
  have hgamma₀ : gamma 0 =
      W.sliceTransport sourceTime targetTime
        (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase branch r b)) := by
    have hz₀Time : tcoord (z 0) = sourceTime := by
      simpa [sourceTime, chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime, c, b, Q] using
        hzTime 0
    have hz₀st : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z 0)) sourceTime = z 0 := by
      rw [← hz₀Time, spaceTime_spacePart]
    have hz₀Base : z 0 = T.saddleNegativeBranchBase branch r b := by
      simp [z, u, c,
        StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeBranchBase,
        StandardMorseEventAt.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd,
        StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, b, r, Q]
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceTransport, ← hz₀Base, hz₀st]
    simp [gamma, tau, z, u, c, sourceTime, targetTime,
      chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeTime, chronologicalBeforeTime,
      StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeBranchBase,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, afix, b, r, Q]
  have hgamma₁ : gamma 1 =
      spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase branch r afix) := by
    simp [gamma, tau, z, u, c,
      StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeBranchBase,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, afix, b, r, Q]
  have hpath := Vtarget.continuousMap_mem_orbit gamma hgammaFiber 1
  rw [hgamma₀, hgamma₁] at hpath
  have hbaseOrbit : spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase branch r b) ∈
      Vshort.orbit (Vshort.orbitPoint Oshort) := by
    rw [← Vshort.orbitPoint_orbit Oshort]
    exact Vshort.mem_orbit_self _
  have hshortMem : sourceTime ∈ Icc targetTime sourceTime :=
    ⟨htargetMem.2, le_rfl⟩
  have hmapOrbit := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo_orbit hreg
    hshortMem htargetMem Vshort Vtarget
      (Vshort.orbitPoint_mem_fiber Oshort) hbaseOrbit
  have hsame := Vtarget.orbit_eq_of_mem hmapOrbit
  rw [hsame] at hpath
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Vtarget.orbit
      (W.sliceTransport sourceTime targetTime (Vshort.orbitPoint Oshort)) =
    Vtarget.orbit
      (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase branch r afix))
  exact (Vtarget.orbit_eq_of_mem hpath).symm

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData.positiveMateOrbit_eq
statement:
theorem positiveMateOrbit_eq
    {A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)}
    {L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht)}
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (F : ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A L)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex p.1 =
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex (A.mate p).1
proof:
:= by
  let E := D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht A L
  calc
    D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex p.1 =
        E (D.chronologicalSaddleShortPositiveOrbit
          t ht hindex A L p.1) :=
      (D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
        (t := t) (ht := ht) (A := A) (L := L) hindex p.1).symm
    _ = E (D.chronologicalSaddleShortPositiveOrbit
          t ht hindex A L (A.mate p).1) :=
      congrArg E (F.positiveMateShortOrbit_eq (hindex := hindex) p)
    _ = D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit
          t ht hindex (A.mate p).1 :=
      D.chronologicalSaddleShortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
        (t := t) (ht := ht) (A := A) (L := L) hindex (A.mate p).1

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData.negativeMateOrbit_eq
statement:
theorem negativeMateOrbit_eq
    {A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)}
    {L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht)}
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (F : ChronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A L)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex p.2 =
      D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex (A.mate p).2
proof:
:= by
  let E := D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht A L
  calc
    D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex p.2 =
        E (D.chronologicalSaddleShortNegativeOrbit
          t ht hindex A L p.2) :=
      (D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
        (t := t) (ht := ht) (A := A) (L := L) hindex p.2).symm
    _ = E (D.chronologicalSaddleShortNegativeOrbit
          t ht hindex A L (A.mate p).2) :=
      congrArg E (F.negativeMateShortOrbit_eq (hindex := hindex) p)
    _ = D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit
          t ht hindex (A.mate p).2 :=
      D.chronologicalSaddleShortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
        (t := t) (ht := ht) (A := A) (L := L) hindex (A.mate p).2

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleTopologyDichotomy_of_endpointLocalFiberCover
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleTopologyDichotomy_of_endpointLocalFiberCover
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht))
    (H : ChronologicalSaddleRegularOrbitArcRecovery
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) (hindex := hindex)) :
    D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeTopology t ht hindex ∨
      D.ChronologicalSaddleSplitTopology t ht hindex
proof:
:= by
  let F := D.chronologicalSaddleShortMateArcFlowData_of_endpointLocalCover
    (t := t) (ht := ht) hindex A L
  have hdich :=
    StandardMorseEventAt.saddleExteriorArcPairing_eq_flipSecond_or_eq_flipFirst
      (D.position.eventModel t ht)
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
        D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) A
  rcases hdich with hsecond | hfirst
  · right
    refine {
      positive_ne :=
        ChronologicalSaddleRegularOrbitArcRecovery.positive_ne_of_mate_eq_flipSecond
          (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) (hindex := hindex) H hsecond
      negative_eq := ?_ }
    let p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch := (.negative, .negative)
    have h := F.negativeMateOrbit_eq (hindex := hindex) p
    rw [hsecond p] at h
    simpa [p, saddleBranchEndFlipSecond] using h
  · left
    refine {
      negative_ne :=
        ChronologicalSaddleRegularOrbitArcRecovery.negative_ne_of_mate_eq_flipFirst
          (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) (hindex := hindex) H hfirst
      positive_eq := ?_ }
    let p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch := (.negative, .negative)
    have h := F.positiveMateOrbit_eq (hindex := hindex) p
    rw [hfirst p] at h
    simpa [p, saddleBranchEndFlipFirst] using h

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.ComponentPlacementData.endpointSign_pos_iff_of_mem_target
statement:
theorem endpointSign_pos_iff_of_mem_target
    (P : ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.ComponentPlacementData m X)
    (S : FiberSign X)
    (O : (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X).OrbitIndex)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))}
    (hx : x ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.target
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X)
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) O) :
    0 < P.endpointSign S x ↔
      (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))) ∈
        S.positiveOrbitCollection
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.unknotting.ambient_endpoint_orbit O] at hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hx
  change 0 < P.unknotting.endpointSign S
      (P.unknotting.ambient.forward 1 y) ↔ _
  rw [P.unknotting.endpointSign_forward]
  rw [(ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X).orbitPoint_orbit O] at hy
  exact ((S.pos_iff_of_mem_orbit
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X)
    ((ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X).orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
    hy).symm).trans
    (S.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X) O).symm

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationFirstHeadPlacedGaugeEntry.gaugeEndpoint_fiber
statement:
theorem gaugeEndpoint_fiber
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch) :
    (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.fiber =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  let D := discrepancyHomotopy hm M F
  calc
    D.toCobordism.X₁.fiber = {x | D.H 1 x = 0} := by
      rw [D.H_one]
      rfl
    _ = (matchedPlacedX hm M).fiber :=
      D.fiber_eq 1 zero_le_one le_rfl
    _ = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion
        (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) :=
      matchedPlacedX_fiber hm M

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationFirstHeadPlacedGaugeEntry.gaugeEndpoint_fiber_disjoint_firstSource
statement:
theorem gaugeEndpoint_fiber_disjoint_firstSource
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch) :
    Disjoint (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.fiber
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [gaugeEndpoint_fiber hm M F]
  exact CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion_disjoint_fiber
    (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega)

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationFirstHeadPlacedGaugeEntry.PlacedGaugeHomotopy.matchedPlacedSign_pos_iff_firstPlacement
statement:
theorem matchedPlacedSign_pos_iff_firstPlacement
    (P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))}
    (hx : x ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.target
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P) :
    0 < matchedPlacedSign hm M x ↔
      0 < (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign x
proof:
:= by
  let O : (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
      TamedField B.fls).OrbitIndex := M.orbitEquiv.symm P
  have hMO : M.orbitEquiv O = P := by simp [O]
  have hxImage : x ∈ (M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 ''
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
        (by omega) O := by
    rw [M.matchingAmbient_target hm O]
    rw [hMO]
    exact hx
  obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := hxImage
  calc
    0 < matchedPlacedSign hm M ((M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 y) ↔
        0 < (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpointSign B.fiberSign y := by
      rw [matchedPlacedSign, SmoothAmbientIsotopy.pullbackSign_apply,
        (M.matchingAmbient hm).left_inv 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩]
    _ ↔ (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))) ∈
        B.fiberSign.positiveOrbitCollection
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls) :=
      (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpointSign_pos_iff_of_mem_target
        B.fiberSign O hy
    _ ↔ (P : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))) ∈
        (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign.positiveOrbitCollection
          (firstSourceField Z kind tail) := by
      have h := M.orbitEquiv_positive_iff O
      rw [hMO] at h
      exact h
    _ ↔ 0 < (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointSign
        (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign
        ((M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 y) := by
      apply ((firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointSign_pos_iff_of_mem_target
        (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign P ?_).symm
      have htarget : (M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1 y ∈
          CanonicalRoundOrbit.target
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) (M.orbitEquiv O) := by
        rw [← M.matchingAmbient_target hm O]
        exact ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
      rw [hMO] at htarget
      exact htarget

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationFirstHeadPlacedGaugeEntry.PlacedGaugeHomotopy.gaugeEndpointSign_pos_iff_firstPlacement
statement:
theorem gaugeEndpointSign_pos_iff_firstPlacement
    (P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))}
    (hx : x ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.target
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P) :
    0 < gaugeEndpointSign hm M F x ↔
      0 < (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign x
proof:
:= by
  simpa [gaugeEndpointSign] using
    matchedPlacedSign_pos_iff_firstPlacement
      (B := B) (hm := hm) (M := M) P hx

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationFirstHeadPlacedGaugeEntry.PlacedGaugeHomotopy.signPattern
statement:
theorem signPattern (D : PlacedGaugeHomotopy hm M F) :
    ∀ x ∈ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.fiber,
      (0 < (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F).restrict
          D.homotopy.fiber_subset x ↔
        0 < (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign x)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  rw [(firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpoint_fiber] at hx

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_continuous_chartParam_of_param_image_prop
statement:
theorem exists_continuous_chartParam_of_param_image_prop
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) {r : ℝ} (hr : r < T.radius)
    (ζ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
    (P : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) → Prop)
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, ∃ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ ≤ r ∧ P v ∧
      M.param v = ζ u) :
    ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ r) ∧
      (∀ u : I, P (η u)) ∧ (∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ζ u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨η, hle, hchart⟩ :=
    T.exists_continuous_chartParam_of_param_image hr ζ
      (fun u => by obtain ⟨v, hv, _, hpv⟩ := hmem u; exact ⟨v, hv, hpv⟩)
  refine ⟨η, hle, fun u => ?_, hchart⟩
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hvP, hpv⟩ := hmem u
  have hball : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖w‖ ≤ r →
      w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    intro w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hw.trans_lt hr
  have heq : η u = v :=
    T.param_injOn (hball _ (hle u)) (hball _ hv) ((hchart u).trans hpv.symm)
  rw [heq]
  exact hvP

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_chartMap_flowLine_quadrant
statement:
theorem exists_chartMap_flowLine_quadrant
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht))
    {K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData K)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    {x₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} (hx₀K : x₀ ∈ K)
    (hx₀fiber : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x₀ = 0)
    (dt : C(I, ℝ)) (hd : ∀ w : I, |dt w| ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hclose : ∀ w : I, dist x₀
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
        (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |dt w| <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht L p)
    (ζ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
    (hζ : ∀ w : I, ζ w = R.base.flow x₀ (dt w)) :
    ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      (∀ w : I, ‖η w‖ ≤ D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) ∧
      (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.1 (η w 0)) ∧
      (∀ w : I, 0 < signedBranch p.2 (η w 1)) ∧
      (∀ w : I, η w ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ w : I, (D.position.eventModel t ht).localPoint (η w) = ζ w)
proof:
:= by
  have hcap : ∀ w : I, ∃ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      ‖v‖ ≤ D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht ∧
      (0 < signedBranch p.1 (v 0) ∧ 0 < signedBranch p.2 (v 1)) ∧
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).param v = ζ w := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hup, hs1, hs2⟩ :=
      D.exists_saddleEndpointLevelParamCapture t ht hindex L R p hx₀K hx₀fiber
        (hd w) (hclose w)
    exact ⟨u, hu.le, ⟨hs1, hs2⟩, by rw [hup, hζ w]⟩
  obtain ⟨η, hle, hquad, hchart⟩ :=
    (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).exists_continuous_chartParam_of_param_image_prop
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht) ζ
      (fun v => 0 < signedBranch p.1 (v 0) ∧ 0 < signedBranch p.2 (v 1)) hcap
  refine ⟨η, hle, fun w => (hquad w).1, fun w => (hquad w).2, fun w => ?_,
    hchart⟩
  intro hzero
  have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < signedBranch p.1 (η w 0) := (hquad w).1
  rw [hzero, show ((0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) 0) = (0 : ℝ) from rfl,
    signedBranch_zero] at h1
  exact lt_irrefl _ h1

name: Submission.exists_chartReads_of_near_center
statement:
theorem exists_chartReads_of_near_center (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    {ρ eps : ℝ} (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.toLevelCobordismData.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    {x y : ↥C.toLevelCobordismData.regularPoints} (z : Path x y)
    (hfib : ∀ u : I,
      C.toLevelCobordismData.G (ambientOfRegularPath z u) = 0)
    (hnear : ∀ u : I, dist (ambientOfRegularPath z u) center < eps)
    (hcentre : ∀ u : I, ambientOfRegularPath z u ≠ center) :
    ∃ (p q : ℝ × ℝ) (w : Path p q), ChartReads M z w
proof:
:= by
  refine exists_chartReads_of_param_image T hρrad z (fun u => ?_) hcentre
  obtain ⟨v, hv, hpv⟩ := hcover _ (hnear u) (hfib u)
  exact ⟨v, hv.le, hpv⟩

name: Submission.pairComplex_ne_zero_iff
statement:
private theorem pairComplex_ne_zero_iff {z : ℝ × ℝ} :
    pairComplex z ≠ 0 ↔ z ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h hz
    subst z
    exact h rfl
  · intro h hz
    apply h
    apply Prod.ext
    · simpa [pairComplex] using congrArg Complex.re hz
    · simpa [pairComplex] using congrArg Complex.im hz

name: Submission.continuous_nonzeroCartesianCircleDirection
statement:
private theorem continuous_nonzeroCartesianCircleDirection :
    Continuous nonzeroCartesianCircleDirection
proof:

    ((Complex.ofRealCLM.continuous.comp continuous_pairRadius).comp

name: Submission.continuousAt_cartesianCircleDirection
statement:
theorem continuousAt_cartesianCircleDirection {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    ContinuousAt cartesianCircleDirection z
proof:
:= by
  have hOn : ContinuousOn cartesianCircleDirection {w : ℝ × ℝ | w ≠ 0} := by
    rw [continuousOn_iff_continuous_restrict]
    have heq : Set.restrict {w : ℝ × ℝ | w ≠ 0}
        cartesianCircleDirection = nonzeroCartesianCircleDirection := by
      funext w
      change cartesianCircleDirection (w : ℝ × ℝ) =
        nonzeroCartesianCircleDirection w
      apply Circle.ext
      rw [cartesianCircleDirection_of_ne w.property]
      rfl
    rw [heq]
    exact continuous_nonzeroCartesianCircleDirection
  exact hOn.continuousAt (isOpen_ne.mem_nhds hz)

name: Submission.continuous_addCircleCartesian

:= by
  apply Continuous.prodMk
  · exact Complex.reCLM.continuous.comp
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp
        (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero).continuous)
  · exact Complex.imCLM.continuous.comp
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp

name: Submission.addCircleCartesian_cartesianDirection_of_radius_one
statement:
theorem addCircleCartesian_cartesianDirection_of_radius_one
    {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : pairRadius z = 1) :
    addCircleCartesian (cartesianAddCircleDirection z) = z
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    subst z
    have hzero : pairRadius (0 : ℝ × ℝ) = 0 :=
      pairRadius_eq_zero_iff.mpr rfl
    rw [hzero] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  have hc : (cartesianCircleDirection z : ℂ) = pairComplex z := by
    rw [cartesianCircleDirection_of_ne hz0, hz]
    norm_num
  apply Prod.ext
  · simpa [addCircleCartesian, cartesianAddCircleDirection, pairComplex]
      using congrArg Complex.re hc
  · simpa [addCircleCartesian, cartesianAddCircleDirection, pairComplex]
      using congrArg Complex.im hc

name: Submission.addCircleCartesian_cartesianDirection_of_ne
statement:
theorem addCircleCartesian_cartesianDirection_of_ne
    {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    addCircleCartesian (cartesianAddCircleDirection z) = normalizedCartesian z
proof:
:= by
  have hc := cartesianCircleDirection_of_ne hz
  apply Prod.ext
  · simpa [addCircleCartesian, cartesianAddCircleDirection,
      normalizedCartesian, pairComplex]
      using congrArg Complex.re hc
  · simpa [addCircleCartesian, cartesianAddCircleDirection,
      normalizedCartesian, pairComplex]
      using congrArg Complex.im hc

name: Submission.contDiffAt_pairRadius
statement:

name: Submission.contDiffAt_normalizedCartesian

    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ normalizedCartesian z
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : pairRadius z ≠ 0 := by
    rw [ne_eq, pairRadius_eq_zero_iff]
    exact hz
  exact (contDiff_fst.contDiffAt.div (contDiffAt_pairRadius hz) hr0).prodMk
    (contDiff_snd.contDiffAt.div (contDiffAt_pairRadius hz) hr0)

name: Submission.closedHomotopyOnAddCircle_zero_of_constant
statement:
private theorem closedHomotopyOnAddCircle_zero_of_constant
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(I, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (hclosed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1))
    {y₀ : Y} (hf : ∀ u : I, f u = y₀) (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    closedHomotopyOnAddCircle H hclosed (0, a) = y₀
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := AddCircle.eq_coe_Ico (p := (1 : ℝ)) a
  let u : I := ⟨x, ⟨hx.1, hx.2.le⟩⟩
  calc
    closedHomotopyOnAddCircle H hclosed
        (0, ((x : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) = H (0, u) := by
      simpa [u] using closedHomotopyOnAddCircle_coe H hclosed (0 : I) u
    _ = f u := H.apply_zero u
    _ = y₀ := hf u

name: Submission.closedHomotopyOnAddCircle_one_eq_cartesian
statement:
private theorem closedHomotopyOnAddCircle_one_eq_cartesian
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(I, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (hclosed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1))
    (G : ℝ × ℝ → Y)
    (hg : ∀ u : I,
      g u = G (addCircleCartesian (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))))
    (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    closedHomotopyOnAddCircle H hclosed (1, a) = G (addCircleCartesian a)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := AddCircle.eq_coe_Ico (p := (1 : ℝ)) a
  let u : I := ⟨x, ⟨hx.1, hx.2.le⟩⟩
  calc
    closedHomotopyOnAddCircle H hclosed
        (1, ((x : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) = H (1, u) := by
      simpa [u] using closedHomotopyOnAddCircle_coe H hclosed (1 : I) u
    _ = g u := H.apply_one u
    _ = G (addCircleCartesian (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))) := hg u

name: Submission.radialClosedSOHomotopy_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem radialClosedSOHomotopy_zero
    {m : ℕ} {f g : C(I, SOGroup m)}

statement:
theorem radialClosedSOHomotopy_eq_one_of_radius_le_quarter

    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (hclosed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1))

statement:
theorem radialClosedSOHomotopy_eq_one_of_time_le_quarter

    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)

    radialClosedSOHomotopy H hclosed s z = 1

  exact closedHomotopyOnAddCircle_zero_of_constant H hclosed hf _

name: Submission.continuous_radialClosedSOHomotopy
statement:
theorem continuous_radialClosedSOHomotopy
    {m : ℕ} {f g : C(I, SOGroup m)}
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (hclosed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1))
    (hf : ∀ u : I, f u = 1) :
    Continuous fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
      radialClosedSOHomotopy H hclosed p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
  intro p
  by_cases hp : p.2 = 0
  · have hr0 : pairRadius p.2 = 0 := pairRadius_eq_zero_iff.mpr hp
    have hnear : {q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | pairRadius q.2 < 1 / 4} ∈ nhds p :=
      (isOpen_lt (continuous_pairRadius.comp continuous_snd)
        continuous_const).mem_nhds
          (show pairRadius p.2 < 1 / 4 by rw [hr0]; norm_num)
    apply (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt
      (fun _ : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => (1 : SOGroup m)) p).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [hnear] with q hq
    exact radialClosedSOHomotopy_eq_one_of_radius_le_quarter
      H hclosed hf q.1 hq.le
  · exact (closedHomotopyOnAddCircle H hclosed).continuous.continuousAt.comp
      (continuous_radialHomotopyTime.continuousAt.prodMk
        ((continuousAt_cartesianAddCircleDirection hp).comp
          continuous_snd.continuousAt))

name: Submission.radialClosedSOHomotopy_one_of_radius_one
statement:
theorem radialClosedSOHomotopy_one_of_radius_one
    {m : ℕ} {f g : C(I, SOGroup m)}
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (hclosed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1))
    (G : ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m)
    (hg : ∀ u : I,
      g u = G (addCircleCartesian (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))))
    {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hz : pairRadius z = 1) :
    radialClosedSOHomotopy H hclosed 1 z = G z
proof:
:= by
  rw [radialClosedSOHomotopy, radialHomotopyTime_one_of_radius_one hz,
    closedHomotopyOnAddCircle_one_eq_cartesian H hclosed G hg,
    addCircleCartesian_cartesianDirection_of_radius_one hz]

name: Submission.radialClosedSOHomotopy_eq_endpoint_of_three_quarter_le
statement:
theorem radialClosedSOHomotopy_eq_endpoint_of_three_quarter_le
    {m : ℕ} {f g : C(I, SOGroup m)}
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (hclosed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1))
    (G : ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m)
    (hg : ∀ u : I,
      g u = G (addCircleCartesian (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))))
    {s : ℝ} {z : ℝ × ℝ} (hs : 3 / 4 ≤ s)
    (hz : 3 / 4 ≤ pairRadius z) :
    radialClosedSOHomotopy H hclosed s z = G (normalizedCartesian z)
proof:
:= by
  have hz0 : z ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hr0 : pairRadius z = 0 := pairRadius_eq_zero_iff.mpr h
    rw [hr0] at hz
    norm_num at hz
  rw [radialClosedSOHomotopy,
    radialHomotopyTime_eq_one_of_three_quarter_le hs hz,
    closedHomotopyOnAddCircle_one_eq_cartesian H hclosed G hg,
    addCircleCartesian_cartesianDirection_of_ne hz0]

name: Submission.isOpen_radialSORelativeNeighborhood
statement:
theorem isOpen_radialSORelativeNeighborhood :
    IsOpen radialSORelativeNeighborhood
proof:
:= by
  apply IsOpen.union
  · exact isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const
  · exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const
        (continuous_pairRadius.comp continuous_snd))

name: Submission.cartesianSORelativeSet_subset_radialNeighborhood
statement:
theorem cartesianSORelativeSet_subset_radialNeighborhood :
    cartesianSORelativeSet ⊆ radialSORelativeNeighborhood
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rcases hp with hp | hp
  · left
    change p.1 = 0 at hp
    change p.1 < 1 / 4
    rw [hp]
    norm_num
  · right
    change p.1 = 1 ∧ p.2.1 ^ 2 + p.2.2 ^ 2 = 1 at hp
    change 3 / 4 < p.1 ∧ 3 / 4 < pairRadius p.2
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [hp.1]
      norm_num
    · rw [pairRadius_eq_one_of_sq hp.2]
      norm_num

name: Submission.radialSORelativeNeighborhood_mem_nhdsSet
statement:
theorem radialSORelativeNeighborhood_mem_nhdsSet :
    radialSORelativeNeighborhood ∈ nhdsSet cartesianSORelativeSet
proof:
:=
  isOpen_radialSORelativeNeighborhood.mem_nhdsSet.mpr
    cartesianSORelativeSet_subset_radialNeighborhood

name: Submission.contDiffOn_radialClosedSOHomotopy_relative
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_radialClosedSOHomotopy_relative
    {m : ℕ} {f g : C(I, SOGroup m)}
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (hclosed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1))
    (hf : ∀ u : I, f u = 1)
    (G : ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m)
    (hg : ∀ u : I,
      g u = G (addCircleCartesian (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))))
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => matrixToEuclidean
        ((G z : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => matrixToEuclidean
        ((radialClosedSOHomotopy H hclosed p.1 p.2 : SOGroup m) :
          Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))
      radialSORelativeNeighborhood
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  rcases hp with hp | hp
  · change p.1 < 1 / 4 at hp
    have hnear : {q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | q.1 < 1 / 4} ∈ nhds p :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_fst continuous_const).mem_nhds hp
    have hc : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun _ : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => matrixToEuclidean
          (((1 : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))) p :=
      contDiffAt_const
    apply (hc.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_).contDiffWithinAt
    filter_upwards [hnear] with q hq
    rw [radialClosedSOHomotopy_eq_one_of_time_le_quarter
      H hclosed hf hq.le]
  · change 3 / 4 < p.1 ∧ 3 / 4 < pairRadius p.2 at hp
    have hz0 : p.2 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hr0 : pairRadius p.2 = 0 := pairRadius_eq_zero_iff.mpr h
      rw [hr0] at hp
      norm_num at hp
    have hnorm : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => normalizedCartesian q.2) p :=
      (contDiffAt_normalizedCartesian hz0).comp p contDiff_snd.contDiffAt
    have hcomp : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => matrixToEuclidean
          ((G (normalizedCartesian q.2) : SOGroup m) :
            Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) p :=
      hG.contDiffAt.comp p hnorm
    have hnear :
        {q : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) | 3 / 4 < q.1 ∧
          3 / 4 < pairRadius q.2} ∈ nhds p :=
      ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_fst).inter
        (isOpen_lt continuous_const
          (continuous_pairRadius.comp continuous_snd))).mem_nhds hp
    apply (hcomp.congr_of_eventuallyEq ?_).contDiffWithinAt
    filter_upwards [hnear] with q hq
    rw [radialClosedSOHomotopy_eq_endpoint_of_three_quarter_le
      H hclosed G hg hq.1.le hq.2.le]

name: Submission.exists_contDiff_radialClosedSOHomotopy
statement:
theorem exists_contDiff_radialClosedSOHomotopy
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) {f g : C(I, SOGroup m)}
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (hclosed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1))
    (hf : ∀ u : I, f u = 1)
    (G : ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m)
    (hg : ∀ u : I,
      g u = G (addCircleCartesian (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))))
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => matrixToEuclidean
        ((G z : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))) :
    ∃ Q : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m,
      (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
        ((Q p.1 p.2 : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) i j) ∧
      (∀ z, Q 0 z = 1) ∧
      (∀ z, z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1 → Q 1 z = G z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQzero, hQone⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_curriedCartesianSOHomotopy hm
      (radialClosedSOHomotopy H hclosed)
      (continuous_radialClosedSOHomotopy H hclosed hf)
      (radialClosedSOHomotopy_zero H hclosed hf)
      radialSORelativeNeighborhood_mem_nhdsSet
      (contDiffOn_radialClosedSOHomotopy_relative H hclosed hf G hg hG)
  refine ⟨Q, hQ, hQzero, ?_⟩
  intro z hz
  rw [hQone z hz,
    radialClosedSOHomotopy_one_of_radius_one H hclosed G hg
      (pairRadius_eq_one_of_sq hz)]

name: Submission.exists_contDiff_cartesianSOHomotopy_of_loopClassZ2_eq
statement:
theorem exists_contDiff_cartesianSOHomotopy_of_loopClassZ2_eq
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) {f g : C(I, SOGroup m)}
    (hfclosed : f 0 = f 1) (hgclosed : g 0 = g 1)
    (hf : ∀ u : I, f u = 1)
    (hclass : loopClassZ2 f hfclosed = loopClassZ2 g hgclosed)
    (G : ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m)
    (hg : ∀ u : I,
      g u = G (addCircleCartesian (((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)))))
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => matrixToEuclidean
        ((G z : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))) :
    ∃ Q : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup m,
      (∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) =>
        ((Q p.1 p.2 : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) i j) ∧
      (∀ z, Q 0 z = 1) ∧
      (∀ z, z.1 ^ 2 + z.2 ^ 2 = 1 → Q 1 z = G z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H, hHclosed⟩ := exists_loopHomotopy_of_loopClassZ2_eq
    hm hfclosed hgclosed hclass
  exact exists_contDiff_radialClosedSOHomotopy
    (lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num : 0 < 3) hm)
    H hHclosed hf G hg hG

name: Submission.SOLocalRelativeNormalization.signedCobordism_productOn
statement:
theorem signedCobordism_productOn
    (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy (m + 2))
    (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (S : FiberSign X)
    (R : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup (m + 2))
    (hR : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((R p.1 p.2 : SOGroup (m + 2)) : M) i j))
    (hRzero : ∀ z, R 0 z = 1)
    {K : Set E} (hA : A.FixedOn K)
    (hK : K ⊆ {x : E | x ∉ tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 3)}) :
    (signedCobordism A X S R hR hRzero).ProductOn K X.g S
proof:
:= by
  apply SORelativeNormalization.signedCobordism_productOn
    (A := A) (X := X) (S := S)
    (R := SOLocalExtension.extendCircleSOHomotopy R)
    (hR := SOLocalExtension.contDiff_extendCircleSOHomotopy hR hRzero)
    (hRzero := SOLocalExtension.extendCircleSOHomotopy_zero R hRzero)
    hA
  intro s hs x hx
  exact SOLocalExtension.extendCircleSOHomotopy_eq_one_off_outer
    R hRzero s (hK hx)

name: Submission.image_null_of_locally_image_null
statement:
theorem image_null_of_locally_image_null
    {α β : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] [SecondCountableTopology α]
    [MeasurableSpace β] {μ : Measure β} {f : α → β} {S : Set α}
    (h : ∀ x ∈ S, ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 x, μ (f '' (S ∩ V)) = 0) :
    μ (f '' S) = 0
proof:
:= by
  choose! V hV hnull using h
  obtain ⟨t, hts, htc, hcover⟩ :=
    TopologicalSpace.countable_cover_nhdsWithin
      (f := V) (s := S) fun x hx => nhdsWithin_le_nhds (hV x hx)
  have hsub : f '' S ⊆ ⋃ x ∈ t, f '' (S ∩ V x) := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨x, hxt, hyV⟩ := mem_iUnion₂.1 (hcover hy)
    exact mem_iUnion₂.2 ⟨x, hxt, ⟨y, ⟨hy, hyV⟩, rfl⟩⟩
  refine measure_mono_null hsub ?_
  exact (measure_biUnion_null_iff htc).2 fun x hx => hnull x (hts hx)

name: Submission.sum_smul_single
statement:
theorem sum_smul_single {d : ℕ} (c : Fin d → ℝ) :
    ∑ j, c j • Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) = c
proof:
:= by
  have h : ∀ j : Fin d, c j • Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) = Pi.single j (c j) := by
    intro j
    funext i
    rcases eq_or_ne i j with rfl | hij
    · simp
    · simp [hij]
  simp only [h]
  exact Finset.univ_sum_single c

name: Submission.exists_apply_single_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_apply_single_ne_zero {d : ℕ} {F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup F]
    [NormedSpace ℝ F] {ξ : (Fin d → ℝ) →L[ℝ] F} {v : Fin d → ℝ} (hv : ξ v ≠ 0) :
    ∃ s : Fin d, ξ (Pi.single s 1) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hall
  simp only [not_exists, not_not] at hall
  apply hv
  have hv' : v = ∑ j, v j • Pi.single j (1 : ℝ) := (sum_smul_single v).symm
  rw [hv', map_sum]
  simp [hall]

name: Submission.isOpen_setOf_surjective
proof:
:= by
  rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
  intro L₀ hL₀
  choose v hv using fun j : Fin q => hL₀ (Pi.single j 1)
  set V : (Fin q → ℝ) →L[ℝ] E :=
    ∑ j, (ContinuousLinearMap.proj j : (Fin q → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).smulRight (v j) with hV
  have hVc : ∀ c : Fin q → ℝ, V c = ∑ j, c j • v j := by
    intro c
    simp [hV]
  have hL₀V : L₀.comp V = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Fin q → ℝ) := by
    ext c : 1
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hVc, map_sum, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
    simp only [map_smul, hv]
    exact sum_smul_single c
  have hcont : Continuous fun L : E →L[ℝ] (Fin q → ℝ) => L.comp V :=
    continuous_id.clm_comp continuous_const
  have hmem : {L : E →L[ℝ] (Fin q → ℝ) | IsUnit (L.comp V)} ∈ 𝓝 L₀ := by
    refine (Units.isOpen.preimage hcont).mem_nhds ?_
    show IsUnit (L₀.comp V)
    rw [hL₀V]
    exact isUnit_one
  refine mem_of_superset hmem ?_
  intro L hL
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hL
  have hsurj : Surjective (L.comp V) := by
    intro y
    refine ⟨(↑u⁻¹ : (Fin q → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin q → ℝ)) y, ?_⟩
    have h1 : (L.comp V) ((↑u⁻¹ : (Fin q → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin q → ℝ)) y)
        = ((L.comp V) * ↑u⁻¹) y := rfl
    rw [h1, ← hu, u.mul_inv]
    rfl
  have hco : ⇑(L.comp V) = ⇑L ∘ ⇑V := rfl
  rw [hco] at hsurj
  exact hsurj.of_comp

name: Submission.isClosed_setOf_not_surjective
proof:
:= by
  have h := (isOpen_setOf_surjective (E := E) (q := q)).isClosed_compl
  simpa [compl_setOf] using h

name: Submission.not_surjective_zero
statement:
theorem not_surjective_zero {E F : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E]
    [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] [Nontrivial F] :
    ¬Surjective ((0 : E →L[ℝ] F) : E → F)
proof:
:= by
  intro hsurj
  obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := exists_ne (0 : F)
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hsurj y
  exact hy (by simpa using hx.symm)

name: Submission.surjective_iff_ne_zero_fin_one
statement:
theorem surjective_iff_ne_zero_fin_one {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E]
    [NormedSpace ℝ E] (L : E →L[ℝ] (Fin 1 → ℝ)) :
    Surjective L ↔ L ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro hsurj rfl
    exact not_surjective_zero hsurj
  · intro hL y
    have hex : ∃ x, L x ≠ 0 := by
      by_contra hall
      simp only [not_exists, not_not] at hall
      exact hL (ContinuousLinearMap.ext fun x => hall x)
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := hex
    have hx0 : L x 0 ≠ 0 := by
      intro h0
      apply hx
      funext j
      rw [Fin.eq_zero j]
      exact h0
    refine ⟨(y 0 / L x 0) • x, ?_⟩
    funext j
    rw [Fin.eq_zero j]
    simp [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hx0]

name: Submission.splitCLE_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem splitCLE_apply (i : Fin (n + 1)) (x : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) :

name: Submission.measurePreserving_splitCLE

name: Submission.splitCLE_image_null
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : A ⊆ splitCLE n i ⁻¹' B := fun x hx => hAB ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩

name: Submission.volume_singleton_pi
statement:
theorem volume_singleton_pi {q : ℕ} (y : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) :
    volume ({y} : Set (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)) = 0
proof:

name: Submission.critSet_subset
statement:
theorem critSet_subset (U : Set (Fin p → ℝ)) (f : (Fin p → ℝ) → Fin q → ℝ) :
