name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.contDiff_joint_perturbation
statement:
theorem contDiff_joint_perturbation :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => D.perturbation p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact (contDiff_normRamp.comp contDiff_fst).smul
    (D.smooth.comp contDiff_snd)

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.contDiff_joint_forward
statement:
theorem contDiff_joint_forward :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => D.forward p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact contDiff_snd.add D.contDiff_joint_perturbation

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.perturbation_lipschitz
statement:
theorem perturbation_lipschitz (s : ℝ) :
    LipschitzWith D.K (D.perturbation s)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
  intro x y
  have hD := D.lipschitz.dist_le_mul x y
  rw [perturbation, perturbation, dist_eq_norm, ← smul_sub,
    norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (normRamp_nonneg s)]
  calc
    normRamp s * ‖D.field x - D.field y‖ =
        normRamp s * dist (D.field x) (D.field y) := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm]
    _ ≤ normRamp s * ((D.K : ℝ) * dist x y) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hD (normRamp_nonneg s)
    _ ≤ 1 * ((D.K : ℝ) * dist x y) := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (normRamp_le_one s)
        (mul_nonneg D.K.coe_nonneg dist_nonneg)
    _ = (D.K : ℝ) * dist x y := one_mul _

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.inverseOperator_contracting
statement:
theorem inverseOperator_contracting (s : ℝ) (y : E) :
    ContractingWith D.K (D.inverseOperator s y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨D.K_lt_one, ?_⟩
  rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
  intro x z
  simpa [inverseOperator, dist_eq_norm, sub_sub_sub_cancel_left,
    norm_neg, norm_sub_rev] using
    (D.perturbation_lipschitz s).dist_le_mul z x

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.inverse_fixed
statement:
theorem inverse_fixed (s : ℝ) (y : E) :
    D.inverseOperator s y (D.inverse s y) = D.inverse s y
proof:
:=
  (D.inverseOperator_contracting s y).fixedPoint_isFixedPt

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.forward_inverse
statement:
theorem forward_inverse (s : ℝ) (y : E) :
    D.forward s (D.inverse s y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have h := D.inverse_fixed s y
  simp only [inverseOperator] at h
  rw [forward]
  exact (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp h).symm

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.inverse_forward
statement:
theorem inverse_forward (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    D.inverse s (D.forward s x) = x
proof:
:= by
  symm
  exact (D.inverseOperator_contracting s (D.forward s x)).fixedPoint_unique (by
    change x + D.perturbation s x - D.perturbation s x = x
    abel)

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.forward_bijective
statement: theorem forward_bijective (s : ℝ) : Bijective (D.forward s)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x y hxy => by
      rw [← D.inverse_forward s x, ← D.inverse_forward s y, hxy],
    fun y => ⟨D.inverse s y, D.forward_inverse s y⟩⟩

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.contDiff_perturbation_slice
statement:
theorem contDiff_perturbation_slice (s : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (D.perturbation s)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using D.contDiff_joint_perturbation.comp
    (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.contDiff_forward_slice
statement:
theorem contDiff_forward_slice (s : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (D.forward s)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using D.contDiff_joint_forward.comp
    (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.norm_fderiv_perturbation_lt_one
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_perturbation_lt_one (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (D.perturbation s) x‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖fderiv ℝ (D.perturbation s) x‖ ≤ (D.K : ℝ) :=
      norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ (D.perturbation_lipschitz s)
    _ < 1 := by exact_mod_cast D.K_lt_one

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.fderiv_forward_eq
statement:
theorem fderiv_forward_eq (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (D.forward s) x =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E + fderiv ℝ (D.perturbation s) x
proof:
:= by
  have hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (D.perturbation s) x :=
    (D.contDiff_perturbation_slice s).differentiable (by simp) x
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y : E => y + D.perturbation s y) x = _
  exact ((hasFDerivAt_id x).add hp.hasFDerivAt).fderiv

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.fderiv_forward_bijective
statement:
theorem fderiv_forward_bijective (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    Bijective (fderiv ℝ (D.forward s) x)
proof:
:= by
  let L : E →L[ℝ] E := fderiv ℝ (D.perturbation s) x
  have hL : ‖L‖ < 1 := D.norm_fderiv_perturbation_lt_one s x
  have hu : IsUnit (1 - (-L)) := (Units.oneSub (-L) (by simpa)).isUnit
  rw [D.fderiv_forward_eq]
  change Bijective ((1 : E →L[ℝ] E) + L)
  simpa [sub_neg_eq_add] using
    (ContinuousLinearMap.isUnit_iff_bijective.mp hu)

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.fderiv_forward_isInvertible
statement:
theorem fderiv_forward_isInvertible (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    (fderiv ℝ (D.forward s) x).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  have hb := D.fderiv_forward_bijective s x
  let e : E ≃L[ℝ] E := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (fderiv ℝ (D.forward s) x)
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hb.1)
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hb.2)
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  exact ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_ofBijective _ _ _

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.contDiff_inverseEquation
statement: theorem contDiff_inverseEquation : ContDiff ℝ ∞ D.inverseEquation
proof:
:= by
  exact (D.contDiff_joint_forward.comp
    ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd)).sub
      (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_fst)

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.fderiv_inverseEquation_comp_inr
statement:
theorem fderiv_inverseEquation_comp_inr (q : ℝ × E) (z : E) :
    (fderiv ℝ D.inverseEquation (q, z)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (ℝ × E) E) =
      fderiv ℝ (D.forward q.1) z
proof:
:= by
  have htotal :=
    (D.contDiff_inverseEquation.differentiable (by simp) (q, z)).hasFDerivAt
  have hinc : HasFDerivAt (fun w : E => (q, w))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (ℝ × E) E) z :=
    (hasFDerivAt_const (x := z) q).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id z)
  have hcomp := htotal.comp z hinc
  have hslice : fderiv ℝ (fun w : E => D.inverseEquation (q, w)) z =
      fderiv ℝ (D.forward q.1) z := by
    simpa [inverseEquation] using
      (fderiv_sub_const (𝕜 := ℝ) (f := D.forward q.1) (x := z) q.2)
  rw [← hslice]
  exact hcomp.fderiv.symm

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.inverseEquation_partial_isInvertible
statement:
theorem inverseEquation_partial_isInvertible (q : ℝ × E) (z : E) :
    ((fderiv ℝ D.inverseEquation (q, z)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (ℝ × E) E)).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.fderiv_inverseEquation_comp_inr q z]
  exact D.fderiv_forward_isInvertible q.1 z

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.contDiff_inverseSection
statement: theorem contDiff_inverseSection : ContDiff ℝ ∞ D.inverseSection
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro q
  let z : E := D.inverseSection q
  let b : ((ℝ × E) × E) := (q, z)
  let cdf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ D.inverseEquation b :=
    D.contDiff_inverseEquation.contDiffAt
  have hi : ((fderiv ℝ D.inverseEquation b).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (ℝ × E) E)).IsInvertible := by
    simpa [b] using D.inverseEquation_partial_isInvertible q z
  let ψ : ℝ × E → E := cdf.implicitFunction (by simp) hi
  have hψ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ψ q := by
    simpa [ψ, b] using cdf.contDiffAt_implicitFunction (by simp) hi
  have hbzero : D.inverseEquation b = 0 := by
    simp [b, z, inverseSection, inverseEquation, D.forward_inverse]
  have heq : D.inverseSection =ᶠ[nhds q] ψ := by
    have himp := cdf.eventually_apply_implicitFunction (by simp) hi
    filter_upwards [himp] with q' hq'
    have hz' : D.inverseEquation (q', ψ q') = 0 := by
      rw [hq', hbzero]
    have hfwd : D.forward q'.1 (ψ q') = q'.2 := sub_eq_zero.mp hz'
    show D.inverse q'.1 q'.2 = ψ q'
    rw [← hfwd, D.inverse_forward]
  exact hψ.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.contDiff_inverse_slice
statement:
theorem contDiff_inverse_slice (s : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (D.inverse s)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [inverseSection, Function.comp_def] using
    D.contDiff_inverseSection.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.inverse_fderiv_surjective
statement:
theorem inverse_fderiv_surjective (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    Surjective (fderiv ℝ (D.inverse s) x)
proof:
:= by
  let f : E → E := D.forward s
  let g : E → E := D.inverse s
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f := D.contDiff_forward_slice s
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g := D.contDiff_inverse_slice s
  let y : E := g x
  have hfy : f y = x := D.forward_inverse s x
  have hgf : (fun z => g (f z)) = id := by
    funext z
    exact D.inverse_forward s z
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun z => g (f z))
      ((fderiv ℝ g (f y)).comp (fderiv ℝ f y)) y :=
    ((hg.differentiable (by simp) (f y)).hasFDerivAt.comp y
      (hf.differentiable (by simp) y).hasFDerivAt)
  rw [hgf] at hcomp
  have hderiv0 : (fderiv ℝ g (f y)).comp (fderiv ℝ f y) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E :=
    hcomp.fderiv.symm.trans (hasFDerivAt_id y).fderiv
  have hderiv : (fderiv ℝ g x).comp (fderiv ℝ f y) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E := by
    rwa [hfy] at hderiv0
  intro z
  refine ⟨fderiv ℝ f y z, ?_⟩
  have hz := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] E => L z) hderiv
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] using hz

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.forward_zero
statement: theorem forward_zero : D.forward 0 = id
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  simp [forward, perturbation,
    normRamp_of_le_quarter (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4 by norm_num)]

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward
statement:
@[simp] theorem toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward (s : ℝ) (x : E) :

proof: := rfl

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_inverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_inverse (s : ℝ) (x : E) :

proof: := rfl

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward_one
statement:
theorem toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward_one (x : E) :
    D.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.forward 1 x = x + D.field x
proof:
:= by
  simp [toSmoothAmbientIsotopy, forward, perturbation,
    normRamp_of_three_quarter_le (show (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1 by norm_num)]

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.fixedOn_of_field_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs x hx
  simp [toSmoothAmbientIsotopy, forward, perturbation, hzero x hx]

name: Submission.SmallAmbientDisplacement.exists_scaled
statement:
theorem exists_scaled (raw : E → E) (hraw : ContDiff ℝ ∞ raw)
    (hsupp : HasCompactSupport raw) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, ε > 0 ∧ ∃ D : SmallAmbientDisplacement n,
      D.field = fun x => ε • raw x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ :=
    hraw.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hsupp (by simp)
  let ε : ℝ := 1 / (2 * ((K : ℝ) + 1))
  have hK0 : 0 ≤ (K : ℝ) := K.coe_nonneg
  have hden : 0 < 2 * ((K : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
  have hε : 0 < ε := one_div_pos.mpr hden
  have hεK : ε * (K : ℝ) < 1 := by
    change (1 / (2 * ((K : ℝ) + 1))) * (K : ℝ) < 1
    rw [one_div, inv_mul_eq_div]
    exact (div_lt_one hden).2 (by linarith)
  let κ : ℝ≥0 := ⟨ε * (K : ℝ), mul_nonneg hε.le hK0⟩
  have hκ : κ < 1 := by exact_mod_cast hεK
  let scaled : E → E := fun x => ε • raw x
  have hscaled : ContDiff ℝ ∞ scaled := hraw.const_smul ε
  have hscaledLip : LipschitzWith κ scaled := by
    rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
    intro x z
    have h := hK.dist_le_mul x z
    change dist (ε • raw x) (ε • raw z) ≤ (κ : ℝ) * dist x z
    rw [dist_eq_norm, ← smul_sub, norm_smul,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hε]
    calc
      ε * ‖raw x - raw z‖ = ε * dist (raw x) (raw z) := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm]
      _ ≤ ε * ((K : ℝ) * dist x z) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hε.le
      _ = (κ : ℝ) * dist x z := by
        change ε * ((K : ℝ) * dist x z) =
          (ε * (K : ℝ)) * dist x z
        ring
  refine ⟨ε, hε, {
    field := scaled
    smooth := hscaled
    K := κ
    K_lt_one := hκ
    lipschitz := hscaledLip }, rfl⟩

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopf_normSq
statement:
lemma hopf_normSq (x : E) :
    hopfRe m hm x ^ 2 + hopfIm m hm x ^ 2 =
      (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * (x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [hopfRe, hopfIm]
  ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_hopfRe
statement: lemma contDiff_hopfRe : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (hopfRe m hm)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj 0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.mul
    (EuclideanSpace.proj 2 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff).add
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj 1 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.mul
      (EuclideanSpace.proj 3 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_hopfIm
statement: lemma contDiff_hopfIm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (hopfIm m hm)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj 1 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.mul
    (EuclideanSpace.proj 2 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff).sub
    ((EuclideanSpace.proj 0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.mul
      (EuclideanSpace.proj 3 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.background_apply_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma background_apply_zero : background m hm 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [background]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.background_apply_ne_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma background_apply_ne_zero {i : Fin (m + 2)} (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    background m hm i = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [background, hi]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.background_ne_zero
statement: lemma background_ne_zero : background m hm ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) h
  simp at h0

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma coreMap_apply_zero (x : E) :
    coreMap m hm x 0 = (CompactBirth.normSq x - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [coreMap]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma coreMap_apply_one (x : E) :
    coreMap m hm x 1 = hopfRe m hm x
proof:
:= by
  simp [coreMap]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap_apply_two
statement:
@[simp] lemma coreMap_apply_two (x : E) :
    coreMap m hm x 2 = hopfIm m hm x
proof:
:= by
  have hm2 : 2 < m + 2 := by omega
  have h20 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm2] at hv
  have h21 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm2] at hv
  simp [coreMap, h20, h21]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap_apply_tail
proof:
:= by
  simp [coreMap, hi0, hi1, hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_coreMap
statement: lemma contDiff_coreMap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (coreMap m hm)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    simpa only [coreMap_apply_zero] using
      (CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.sub contDiff_const).div_const 2
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      simpa only [coreMap_apply_one] using contDiff_hopfRe m hm
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        simpa only [coreMap_apply_two] using contDiff_hopfIm m hm
      · simp only [coreMap_apply_tail m hm _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i.succ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_levelMap
statement: lemma contDiff_levelMap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (levelMap m hm)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub CompactBirth.contDiff_cutoff).smul
    (contDiff_coreMap m hm)).add
    (CompactBirth.contDiff_cutoff.smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.levelMap_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma levelMap_apply_zero (x : E) :
    levelMap m hm x 0 =
      (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) *
          ((CompactBirth.normSq x - 1) / 2) +
        CompactBirth.cutoff x
proof:
:= by
  simp [levelMap]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.levelMap_apply_ne_zero
statement:
lemma levelMap_apply_ne_zero (x : E) {i : Fin (m + 2)} (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    levelMap m hm x i =
      (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) * coreMap m hm x i
proof:
:= by
  simp [levelMap, hi]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.cutoff_ne_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma cutoff_ne_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero {x : E}
    (hx : levelMap m hm x = 0) : CompactBirth.cutoff x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
  rw [levelMap_apply_zero, hc] at h0
  norm_num at h0

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.cutoff_lt_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma cutoff_lt_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero {x : E}
    (hx : levelMap m hm x = 0) : CompactBirth.cutoff x < 1
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (CompactBirth.cutoff_le_one x)
    (cutoff_ne_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hm hx)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.normSq_lt_two_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma normSq_lt_two_of_levelMap_eq_zero {x : E}
    (hx : levelMap m hm x = 0) : CompactBirth.normSq x < 2
proof:
:= by
  have hc_lt := cutoff_lt_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have hc0 := CompactBirth.cutoff_nonneg x
  have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
  rw [levelMap_apply_zero] at h0
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h0
  by_contra hnot
  have hn : 2 ≤ CompactBirth.normSq x := not_lt.mp hnot
  have hfac : 0 < 1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x := sub_pos.mpr hc_lt
  have hrad : 0 < (CompactBirth.normSq x - 1) / 2 := by linarith
  have hprod : 0 < (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) *
      ((CompactBirth.normSq x - 1) / 2) := mul_pos hfac hrad
  linarith

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.cutoff_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma cutoff_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero {x : E}
    (hx : levelMap m hm x = 0) : CompactBirth.cutoff x = 0
proof:
:=
  CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero
    (normSq_lt_two_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hm hx).le

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.levelMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem levelMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero (x : E) :
    levelMap m hm x = 0 ↔ coreMap m hm x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hc := cutoff_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hm hx
    simpa [levelMap, hc] using hx
  · intro hx
    have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
    rw [coreMap_apply_zero] at h0
    simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h0
    have hn : CompactBirth.normSq x = 1 := by linarith
    have hc : CompactBirth.cutoff x = 0 :=
      CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero (by rw [hn]; norm_num)
    simp [levelMap, hc, hx]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero {x : E}
    (hx : coreMap m hm x = 0) : CompactBirth.normSq x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
  rw [coreMap_apply_zero] at h0
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h0
  linarith

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfRe_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma hopfRe_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero {x : E}
    (hx : coreMap m hm x = 0) : hopfRe m hm x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q : F => q 1) hx
  simpa using h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfIm_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma hopfIm_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero {x : E}
    (hx : coreMap m hm x = 0) : hopfIm m hm x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q : F => q 2) hx
  simpa using h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.plane_dichotomy_of_coreMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hre := hopfRe_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have him := hopfIm_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have hprod : (x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * (x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2) = 0 := by
    rw [← hopf_normSq m hm x, hre, him]
    norm_num
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with hz | hu
  · left
    constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0), sq_nonneg (x 1)]
  · right
    constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 2), sq_nonneg (x 3)]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.levelMap_flatOutside
statement:
theorem levelMap_flatOutside {x : E} (hx : 2 ≤ ‖x‖) :
    levelMap m hm x = background m hm
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 4 ≤ CompactBirth.normSq x := by
    rw [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
  have hc := CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_one hs
  simp [levelMap, hc]

name: Submission.PositiveDistortion.one_sub_smul_apply
statement:
theorem one_sub_smul_apply (s : ℝ)
    (T : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) -
        s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) - T))
      v = v - s • (v - T v)
proof:
:= by
  simp

name: Submission.PositiveDistortion.inner_one_sub_smul
statement:
theorem inner_one_sub_smul (s : ℝ)
    (T : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    ⟪((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) -
          s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) - T))
        v, v⟫ =
      (1 - s) * ⟪v, v⟫ + s * ⟪T v, v⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [one_sub_smul_apply, inner_sub_left, real_inner_smul_left, inner_sub_left]
  ring

name: Submission.PositiveDistortion.bijective_one_sub_smul_of_inner_pos
statement:
theorem bijective_one_sub_smul_of_inner_pos
    (T : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
    (hT : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k), v ≠ 0 → 0 < ⟪T v, v⟫)
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    Function.Bijective
      ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) -
        s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) - T))
proof:
:= by
  set A := (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) -
    s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) - T)
    with hAdef
  have hpos : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k), v ≠ 0 → 0 < ⟪A v, v⟫ := by
    intro v hv
    have hvv : (0 : ℝ) < ⟪v, v⟫ := real_inner_self_pos.mpr hv
    have hTv : (0 : ℝ) < ⟪T v, v⟫ := hT v hv
    rw [hAdef, inner_one_sub_smul]
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs1 with heq | hlt
    · rw [heq]
      linarith
    · have h1 : (0 : ℝ) < (1 - s) * ⟪v, v⟫ :=
        mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hlt) hvv
      have h2 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ s * ⟪T v, v⟫ := mul_nonneg hs0 hTv.le
      linarith
  have hker : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k), A v = 0 → v = 0 := by
    intro v hv0
    by_contra hv
    have hlt := hpos v hv
    rw [hv0, inner_zero_left] at hlt
    exact lt_irrefl (0 : ℝ) hlt
  have hinj : Function.Injective ⇑(A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →ₗ[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) := by
    apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mp
    apply LinearMap.ker_eq_bot'.mpr
    intro v hv
    exact hker v hv
  exact ⟨hinj, LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mp hinj⟩

name: Submission.BridgeEntryPositiveDistortion.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopPositiveJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopPositiveJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (L₀ : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex →
      SmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (D₀ : ∀ P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex,
      (L₀ P).NullGaugeData)
    (A₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hA₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A₀)
    (hA₀pos : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))
      (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))), v ≠ 0 → 0 < ⟪A₀ x v, v⟫)
    (RA : ℝ)
    (hA₀out : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), RA ≤ ‖x‖ →
      A₀ x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
          r • (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ (P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          ((L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          ((A₀ (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
              (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
                (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)))) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:= by
  have hone : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)),
      (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) -
        (1 : ℝ) • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x) = A₀ x := by
    intro x
    rw [one_smul, sub_sub_cancel]
  refine nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopPathJet hm M F G L₀ D₀
    (fun s x => (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) -
      s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x))
    (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_fst.smul
      (contDiff_const.sub (hA₀.comp contDiff_snd))))
    ?_ ?_ RA ?_ R eps eps_pos outer ?_
  · intro x
    ext v
    simp
  · intro s hs x
    exact PositiveDistortion.bijective_one_sub_smul_of_inner_pos (A₀ x)
      (fun v hv => hA₀pos x v hv) hs.1 hs.2
  · intro x hx
    rw [hone x]
    exact hA₀out x hx
  · intro P theta
    rw [hone]
    exact hjet P theta

statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_circlePositiveJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (L : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex →
      LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (hclass : ∀ P, loopClassZ2 (L P).loop (L P).closed = 0)
    (A₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hA₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A₀)
    (hA₀pos : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))
      (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))), v ≠ 0 → 0 < ⟪A₀ x v, v⟫)
    (RA : ℝ)
    (hA₀out : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), RA ≤ ‖x‖ →
      A₀ x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
          r • (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ (P : (firstSourceField Z kind tail).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
            (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          ((L P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          ((A₀ (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
              (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
                (firstSourceField Z kind tail) (by omega) P theta)))) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:= by
  refine nonempty_toFirstSource_of_canonicalLoopPositiveJet hm M F G
    (fun P => LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.smoothCartesianSOLoopOfClassZero
      (L P) (by omega) (hclass P))
    (fun P => LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.smoothNullGaugeDataOfClassZero
      (L P) (by omega) (hclass P))
    A₀ hA₀ hA₀pos RA hA₀out R eps eps_pos outer ?_
  intro P theta
  rw [CanonicalRotationField.cartesian_smoothCartesianSOLoopOfClassZero
    (L P) (by omega) (hclass P) (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq theta)]
  exact hjet P theta

name: Submission.exists_continuous_preimage_of_injective_range
statement:
theorem exists_continuous_preimage_of_injective_range {X Y : Type*}
    [TopologicalSpace X] [CompactSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y]
    (seg : C(X, Y)) (hinj : Injective seg)
    (γ : C(I, Y)) (hmem : ∀ u : I, γ u ∈ Set.range seg) :
    ∃ φ : C(I, X), ∀ u : I, seg (φ u) = γ u
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set f : I → X := fun u => (hmem u).choose with hf
  have hfspec : ∀ u : I, seg (f u) = γ u := fun u => (hmem u).choose_spec
  have hcont : Continuous f := by
    rw [continuous_iff_isClosed]
    intro S hS
    have himg : IsClosed (seg '' S) :=
      ((hS.isCompact.image seg.continuous)).isClosed
    have hpre : f ⁻¹' S = γ ⁻¹' (seg '' S) := by
      ext u
      constructor
      · intro hu
        exact ⟨f u, hu, hfspec u⟩
      · rintro ⟨t, htS, hts⟩
        have : t = f u := hinj (hts.trans (hfspec u).symm)
        rwa [this] at htS
    rw [hpre]
    exact himg.preimage γ.continuous
  exact ⟨⟨f, hcont⟩, hfspec⟩

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_chartMap_of_saddlePositiveSpatialSegment
statement:
theorem exists_chartMap_of_saddlePositiveSpatialSegment (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (b : SaddleBranch) {ρ s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (ζ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, spacePart (ζ u) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (htime : ∀ u : I, tcoord (ζ u) = tcoord center + s ^ 2) :
    ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, η u ≠ 0) ∧
      (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ ρ) ∧ (∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ζ u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_continuous_preimage_of_injective_range
    (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
    (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_injective hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
    ⟨fun u => spacePart (ζ u), continuous_spacePart.comp ζ.continuous⟩ hmem
  refine ⟨(saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s).comp φ, fun u => ?_, fun u => ?_,
    fun u => ?_⟩
  · exact saddlePositiveSegmentParam_ne_zero b hs0 (φ u)
  · exact norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_le b hρ hs (φ u)
  · have hspace : spacePart (M.localPoint
        (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s (φ u))) = spacePart (ζ u) := hφ u
    have htimeseg : tcoord (M.localPoint
        (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s (φ u))) = tcoord center + s ^ 2 :=
      T.saddlePositiveSegment_time hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad (φ u)
    calc M.localPoint (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s (φ u))
        = cobSpaceTime
            (spacePart (M.localPoint (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s (φ u))))
            (tcoord (M.localPoint
              (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s (φ u)))) :=
          (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime (spacePart (ζ u)) (tcoord (ζ u)) := by
          rw [hspace, htimeseg, htime u]
      _ = ζ u := spaceTime_spacePart _

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_continuous_chartParam_of_param_image
statement:
theorem exists_continuous_chartParam_of_param_image (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    {r : ℝ} (hr : r < T.radius)
    (ζ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, ∃ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖v‖ ≤ r ∧
      M.param v = ζ u) :
    ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ r) ∧
      (∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ζ u)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) := Metric.closedBall 0 r with hS
  have hSball : S ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    intro v hv
    rw [hS, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hv
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hv.trans_lt hr
  have hcompact : IsCompact S := isCompact_closedBall _ _
  haveI : CompactSpace ↥S := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hcompact
  have hcontOn : ContinuousOn M.param S := by
    intro v hv
    have hvb : ‖v‖ < T.radius := by
      have := hSball hv
      rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at this
    exact ((T.param_differentiableAt v hvb).continuousAt).continuousWithinAt
  set seg : C(↥S, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :=
    ⟨S.restrict M.param, hcontOn.restrict⟩ with hsegdef
  have hinj : Function.Injective seg := by
    intro a b hab
    exact Subtype.ext (T.param_injOn (hSball a.2) (hSball b.2) hab)
  have hrange : ∀ u : I, ζ u ∈ Set.range seg := by
    intro u
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hpv⟩ := hmem u
    refine ⟨⟨v, ?_⟩, hpv⟩
    rw [hS, Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    exact hv
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ :=
    exists_continuous_preimage_of_injective_range seg hinj ζ hrange
  refine ⟨⟨fun u => ((φ u : ↥S) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
    continuous_subtype_val.comp φ.continuous⟩, fun u => ?_, fun u => ?_⟩
  · have hmem' : ((φ u : ↥S) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ∈
        Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) r := (φ u).2
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hmem'
    exact hmem'
  · exact hφ u

name: Submission.PieceKill.backgroundEquiv_swap_apply
statement:
theorem backgroundEquiv_swap_apply {k : ℕ}
    (c₁ c₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (k + 2)))
    (h₁c : ∀ i, c₁ i = if i = 0 then 1 else 0)
    (h₂c : ∀ i, c₂ i = if i = Fin.last (k + 1) then 1 else 0)
    (h₁ : c₁ ≠ 0) (h₂ : c₂ ≠ 0) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (k + 2)))
    (i : Fin (k + 2)) :
    backgroundEquiv c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ y i =
      if i = 0 then y (Fin.last (k + 1))
      else if i = Fin.last (k + 1) then y 0 else y i
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hlast0 : (Fin.last (k + 1) : Fin (k + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp at this
  
  have hsum₁ : (∑ j, ‖c₁ j‖ ^ 2) = 1 := by
    have hpt : ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), ‖c₁ j‖ ^ 2 =
        (if j = (0 : Fin (k + 2)) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      intro j
      rw [h₁c j]
      by_cases hj : j = 0
      · simp [hj]
      · simp [hj]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hpt j]
    simp
  have hsum₂ : (∑ j, ‖c₂ j‖ ^ 2) = 1 := by
    have hpt : ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), ‖c₂ j‖ ^ 2 =
        (if j = Fin.last (k + 1) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) := by
      intro j
      rw [h₂c j]
      by_cases hj : j = Fin.last (k + 1)
      · simp [hj]
      · simp [hj]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hpt j]
    simp
  have hn₁ : ‖c₁‖ = 1 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, hsum₁]
    exact Real.sqrt_one
  have hn₂ : ‖c₂‖ = 1 := by
    rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, hsum₂]
    exact Real.sqrt_one
  have hscale : backgroundScale c₁ c₂ = 1 := by
    rw [backgroundScale, hn₁, hn₂]
    norm_num
  have hfact := backgroundEquiv_eq_scale_trans_reflection c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂
  have hscaleApply : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (k + 2)),
      positiveScaleEquiv (backgroundScale c₁ c₂)
        (backgroundScale_pos_F h₁ h₂) z = z := by
    intro z
    rw [positiveScaleEquiv_apply, hscale, one_smul]
  have hdiff : backgroundDifference c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ = c₁ - c₂ := by
    rw [backgroundDifference, hscaleApply]
  
  set r : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (k + 2)) :=
    y - y 0 • c₁ - y (Fin.last (k + 1)) • c₂ with hrdef
  have hsplit : y = y 0 • c₁ + y (Fin.last (k + 1)) • c₂ + r := by
    rw [hrdef]
    abel
  have hr0 : r 0 = 0 := by
    rw [hrdef]
    simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [h₁c 0, h₂c 0, if_pos rfl, if_neg (Ne.symm hlast0)]
    ring
  have hrlast : r (Fin.last (k + 1)) = 0 := by
    rw [hrdef]
    simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [h₁c (Fin.last (k + 1)), h₂c (Fin.last (k + 1)),
      if_neg hlast0, if_pos rfl]
    ring
  have hrmem : r ∈ (ℝ ∙ (c₁ - c₂))ᗮ := by
    rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal_singleton_iff_inner_right]
    have hexp : (inner ℝ (c₁ - c₂) r : ℝ) =
        ∑ j, (c₁ - c₂) j * r j := by
      rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
      exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by
        simp [RCLike.inner_apply, mul_comm]
    rw [hexp]
    have hterm : ∀ j : Fin (k + 2), (c₁ - c₂) j * r j =
        (if j = (0 : Fin (k + 2)) then r j else 0) -
          (if j = Fin.last (k + 1) then r j else 0) := by
      intro j
      rw [PiLp.sub_apply, h₁c j, h₂c j]
      by_cases hj0 : j = 0
      · subst hj0
        rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg (Ne.symm hlast0), if_pos rfl,
          if_neg (Ne.symm hlast0)]
        ring
      · by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (k + 1)
        · subst hjl
          rw [if_neg hj0, if_pos rfl, if_neg hj0, if_pos rfl]
          ring
        · rw [if_neg hj0, if_neg hjl, if_neg hj0, if_neg hjl]
          ring
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hterm j, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (0 : Fin (k + 2)) (fun j => r j),
      Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (Fin.last (k + 1)) (fun j => r j)]
    simp [hr0, hrlast]
  
  have hrefl_congr : ∀ (K K' : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (k + 2))))
      [K.HasOrthogonalProjection] [K'.HasOrthogonalProjection], K = K' →
      ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (k + 2)),
        K.reflection z = K'.reflection z := by
    intro K K' _ _ hKK z
    subst hKK
    rfl
  have hrefl_eq : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (k + 2)),
      backgroundReflection c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ z =
        Submodule.reflection (ℝ ∙ (c₁ - c₂))ᗮ z := by
    intro z
    have hKK : (ℝ ∙ (backgroundDifference c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂))ᗮ =
        (ℝ ∙ (c₁ - c₂))ᗮ := by rw [hdiff]
    exact hrefl_congr _ _ hKK z
  
  have hreflc₁ : backgroundReflection c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ c₁ = c₂ := by
    rw [hrefl_eq]
    exact Submodule.reflection_sub (by rw [hn₁, hn₂])
  have hspan : ((ℝ ∙ (c₂ - c₁))ᗮ : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (k + 2)))) =
      (ℝ ∙ (c₁ - c₂))ᗮ := by
    have hneg : c₂ - c₁ = -(c₁ - c₂) := by abel
    rw [hneg]
    have hset : ({-(c₁ - c₂)} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (k + 2)))) =
        -({c₁ - c₂} : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (k + 2)))) := by
      simp
    rw [hset, Submodule.span_neg]
  have hreflc₂ : backgroundReflection c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ c₂ = c₁ := by
    rw [hrefl_eq]
    have h := Submodule.reflection_sub
      (v := c₂) (w := c₁) (by rw [hn₁, hn₂])
    rw [hrefl_congr _ _ hspan c₂] at h
    exact h
  have hreflr : backgroundReflection c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ r = r := by
    rw [hrefl_eq]
    exact Submodule.reflection_mem_subspace_eq_self hrmem
  
  have happ : backgroundEquiv c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ y =
      y 0 • c₂ + y (Fin.last (k + 1)) • c₁ + r := by
    have h1 : backgroundEquiv c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ y =
        backgroundReflection c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ y := by
      rw [hfact, ContinuousLinearEquiv.trans_apply, hscaleApply]
      rfl
    rw [h1]
    conv_lhs => rw [hsplit]
    rw [map_add, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, hreflc₁, hreflc₂, hreflr]
  rw [happ]
  simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [h₁c i, h₂c i]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst hi0
    rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg (Ne.symm hlast0), if_pos rfl]
    rw [hr0]
    ring
  · by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (k + 1)
    · subst hil
      rw [if_neg hlast0, if_pos rfl, if_neg hlast0, if_pos rfl]
      rw [hrlast]
      ring
    · rw [if_neg hil, if_neg hi0, if_neg hi0, if_neg hil]
      rw [hrdef]
      simp only [PiLp.sub_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
      rw [h₁c i, h₂c i, if_neg hi0, if_neg hil]
      ring

name: Submission.PieceKill.rotToAux_mulVec_ortho
statement:
theorem rotToAux_mulVec_ortho {n : ℕ} {u v : Fin n → ℝ}
    (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 1) (hv : v ⬝ᵥ v = 1) (huv : u ⬝ᵥ v = 0)
    (w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    rotToAux u v *ᵥ w =
      w + (u ⬝ᵥ w) • (v - u) - (v ⬝ᵥ w) • (u + v)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (u + v) ⬝ᵥ (u + v) = 2 := by
    rw [add_dotProduct_add hu hv, huv]
    ring
  rw [rotToAux, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, reflMatrix_mulVec,
    reflMatrix_mulVec, hu, hs]
  have hexp : (u + v) ⬝ᵥ (w - (2 / 1 * (u ⬝ᵥ w)) • u) =
      v ⬝ᵥ w - u ⬝ᵥ w := by
    rw [dotProduct_sub, add_dotProduct, add_dotProduct,
      dotProduct_smul, dotProduct_smul, hu, dotProduct_comm v u, huv]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring
  rw [hexp]
  ext i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Submission.PieceKill.ofLp_toCLM
statement:
theorem ofLp_toCLM {k : ℕ} (A : SOGroup k) (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    WithLp.ofLp (SOFrameGauge.toCLM A x) =
      (A : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  rw [Matrix.mulVec]
  exact SOFrameGauge.toCLM_apply_coord A x i

name: Submission.PieceKill.normSq_dotProduct
statement:
theorem normSq_dotProduct {k : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    CompactBirth.normSq x = WithLp.ofLp x ⬝ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x
proof:
:= by
  rw [CompactBirth.normSq, dotProduct]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => sq (x i)

name: Submission.PieceKill.normSq_toCLM
statement:
theorem normSq_toCLM {k : ℕ} (A : SOGroup k)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    CompactBirth.normSq (SOFrameGauge.toCLM A x) = CompactBirth.normSq x
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := A.2
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff] at hmem
  have horth : (A : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)ᵀ *
      (A : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff' (Fin k) ℝ).mp hmem.1
  rw [normSq_dotProduct, normSq_dotProduct, ofLp_toCLM]
  set xf := WithLp.ofLp x
  set M := (A : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ) with hM
  have h1 : M *ᵥ xf ⬝ᵥ (M *ᵥ xf) = ((M *ᵥ xf) ᵥ* M) ⬝ᵥ xf :=
    Matrix.dotProduct_mulVec _ _ _
  have h2 : M *ᵥ xf = xf ᵥ* Mᵀ := by
    rw [Matrix.vecMul_transpose]
  have h3 : (M *ᵥ xf) ᵥ* M = xf ᵥ* (Mᵀ * M) := by
    rw [h2, Matrix.vecMul_vecMul]
  rw [h1, h3, horth, Matrix.vecMul_one]

name: Submission.PieceKill.coords_uPt
statement:
theorem coords_uPt {N : ℕ} (j : Fin N) :
    coords (uPt j) = (Pi.single j 1 : Fin N → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  show (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) i =
    (Pi.single j 1 : Fin N → ℝ) i
  rw [EuclideanSpace.single_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: Submission.PieceKill.single_dot
statement:
theorem single_dot {N : ℕ} (j : Fin N) (w : Fin N → ℝ) :
    (Pi.single j 1 : Fin N → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ w = w j
proof:
:= by
  rw [dotProduct]
  have hpt : ∀ i : Fin N, (Pi.single j 1 : Fin N → ℝ) i * w i =
      if i = j then w i else 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [Pi.single_apply]
    by_cases h : i = j
    · rw [if_pos h, if_pos h, one_mul]
    · rw [if_neg h, if_neg h, zero_mul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hpt i]
  rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ j (fun i => w i)]
  simp

name: Submission.PieceKill.single_dot_single
statement:
theorem single_dot_single {N : ℕ} (p q : Fin N) :
    (Pi.single p 1 : Fin N → ℝ) ⬝ᵥ (Pi.single q 1 : Fin N → ℝ) =
      if p = q then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [single_dot, Pi.single_apply]

name: Submission.PieceKill.rotTo_uPt_mulVec
statement:
theorem rotTo_uPt_mulVec {N : ℕ} {p q : Fin N} (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (w : Fin N → ℝ) :
    ((rotTo (uPt p) (uPt q) : SOGroup N) :
        Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℝ) *ᵥ w =
      fun j => if j = p then -w q else if j = q then w p else w j
proof:
:= by
  have hlt : (-1 : ℝ) < coords (uPt p) ⬝ᵥ coords (uPt q) := by
    rw [coords_uPt, coords_uPt, single_dot_single, if_neg hpq]
    norm_num
  rw [rotTo_coe hlt, coords_uPt, coords_uPt]
  rw [rotToAux_mulVec_ortho
    (by rw [single_dot_single, if_pos rfl])
    (by rw [single_dot_single, if_pos rfl])
    (by rw [single_dot_single, if_neg hpq])]
  rw [single_dot, single_dot]
  funext i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Pi.single_apply]
  by_cases hip : i = p
  · have h1 : (if i = q then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0 :=
      if_neg (by rw [hip]; exact hpq)
    have h2 : (if i = p then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 1 := if_pos hip
    rw [h1, h2, if_pos hip, hip]
    ring
  · by_cases hiq : i = q
    · have h1 : (if i = p then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0 := if_neg hip
      have h2 : (if i = q then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 1 := if_pos hiq
      rw [h1, h2, if_neg hip, if_pos hiq, hiq]
      ring
    · have h1 : (if i = p then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0 := if_neg hip
      have h2 : (if i = q then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0 := if_neg hiq
      rw [h1, h2, if_neg hip, if_neg hiq]
      ring

name: Submission.PieceKill.blockMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem blockMatrix_apply (η : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) (ε : ℝ) (i j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    blockMatrix m η ε i j =
      if j = finRotate (m + 1) i then blockEta m η ε i else 0
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.blockEta_sq
proof:
:= by
  rw [blockEta]
  by_cases hi : i = 0
  · rw [if_pos hi]
    rcases hη i with h | h <;> rcases hε with h' | h' <;>
      rw [h, h'] <;> norm_num
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    rcases hη i with h | h <;> rw [h] <;> norm_num

name: Submission.PieceKill.blockMatrix_mem
statement:
theorem blockMatrix_mem {η : Fin (m + 1) → ℝ} {ε : ℝ}
    (hη : ∀ j, η j = 1 ∨ η j = -1) (hε : ε = 1 ∨ ε = -1)
    (hprod : ε * ∏ j, η j = (-1) ^ m) :
    blockMatrix m η ε ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
  constructor
  · rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff]
    ext i k
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
    have hterm : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1),
        blockMatrix m η ε i j * (blockMatrix m η ε)ᵀ j k =
        if j = finRotate (m + 1) i then
          (blockEta m η ε i *
            (if finRotate (m + 1) i = finRotate (m + 1) k then
              blockEta m η ε k else 0))
        else 0 := by
      intro j
      rw [Matrix.transpose_apply, blockMatrix_apply, blockMatrix_apply]
      by_cases hj : j = finRotate (m + 1) i
      · subst hj
        rw [if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl]
      · rw [if_neg hj, if_neg hj, zero_mul]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hterm j]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (finRotate (m + 1) i)
      (fun _ => blockEta m η ε i *
        (if finRotate (m + 1) i = finRotate (m + 1) k then
          blockEta m η ε k else 0))]
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, if_true]
    by_cases hik : i = k
    · subst hik
      rw [if_pos rfl, blockEta_sq m hη hε, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    · rw [if_neg (fun h => hik ((finRotate (m + 1)).injective h)),
        mul_zero, Matrix.one_apply_ne hik]
  · 
    have hfact : blockMatrix m η ε =
        Matrix.diagonal (blockEta m η ε) *
          Equiv.Perm.permMatrix ℝ (finRotate (m + 1)) := by
      ext i j
      rw [blockMatrix_apply, Matrix.mul_apply]
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
      · rw [Matrix.diagonal_apply_eq]
        rw [Equiv.Perm.permMatrix, PEquiv.toMatrix_apply,
          Equiv.toPEquiv_apply]
        by_cases hj : j = finRotate (m + 1) i
        · rw [if_pos hj, if_pos (Option.mem_some_iff.mpr hj.symm), mul_one]
        · rw [if_neg hj,
            if_neg (fun hmem => hj ((Option.mem_some_iff.mp hmem).symm)),
            mul_zero]
      · intro b _ hb
        rw [Matrix.diagonal_apply_ne _ (Ne.symm hb), zero_mul]
      · intro hi
        exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ i) hi
    have hbprod : (∏ i, blockEta m η ε i) = ε * ∏ j, η j := by
      rw [Finset.prod_eq_mul_prod_sdiff_singleton_of_mem
        (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin (m + 1))) (blockEta m η ε),
        Finset.prod_eq_mul_prod_sdiff_singleton_of_mem
        (Finset.mem_univ (0 : Fin (m + 1))) η]
      have h0 : blockEta m η ε 0 = ε * η 0 := by
        show (if (0 : Fin (m + 1)) = 0 then ε * η 0 else η 0) = ε * η 0
        rw [if_pos rfl]
      have hrest : ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ \ {(0 : Fin (m + 1))},
          blockEta m η ε i =
          ∏ i ∈ Finset.univ \ {(0 : Fin (m + 1))}, η i := by
        apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_singleton] at hi
        show (if i = 0 then ε * η i else η i) = η i
        rw [if_neg hi.2]
      rw [h0, hrest]
      ring
    have hsign : ((Equiv.Perm.sign (finRotate (m + 1)) : ℤ) : ℝ) =
        (-1) ^ m := by
      rw [sign_finRotate, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [hfact, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal,
      Matrix.det_permutation, hbprod, hprod, hsign, ← pow_add]
    exact Even.neg_one_pow ⟨m, rfl⟩

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.codomainEquiv_g
statement:
@[simp] theorem codomainEquiv_g (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.mem_fiber_codomainEquiv
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_fiber_codomainEquiv (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (e : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) ≃L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} :
    x ∈ (X.codomainEquiv e).fiber ↔ x ∈ X.fiber

name: Submission.backgroundScale_ne_zero
statement:
theorem backgroundScale_ne_zero {c₁ c₂ : E} (h₁ : c₁ ≠ 0) (h₂ : c₂ ≠ 0) :
    backgroundScale c₁ c₂ ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  div_ne_zero (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h₂) (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h₁)

name: Submission.norm_backgroundScale_smul
statement:
theorem norm_backgroundScale_smul {c₁ c₂ : E} (h₁ : c₁ ≠ 0) :
    ‖backgroundScale c₁ c₂ • c₁‖ = ‖c₂‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, backgroundScale, abs_of_nonneg
    (div_nonneg (norm_nonneg c₂) (norm_nonneg c₁)),
    div_mul_cancel₀ _ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h₁)]

name: Submission.backgroundEquiv_apply
statement:
theorem backgroundEquiv_apply (c₁ c₂ : E) (h₁ : c₁ ≠ 0) (h₂ : c₂ ≠ 0) :
    backgroundEquiv c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ c₁ = c₂
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝˣ := Units.mk0 (backgroundScale c₁ c₂) (backgroundScale_ne_zero h₁ h₂)
  let scale : E ≃L[ℝ] E := a • (1 : E ≃L[ℝ] E)
  have hscale : scale c₁ = backgroundScale c₁ c₂ • c₁ := by
    change (a : ℝ) • c₁ = backgroundScale c₁ c₂ • c₁
    rfl
  change Submodule.reflection (ℝ ∙ (scale c₁ - c₂))ᗮ (scale c₁) = c₂
  apply Submodule.reflection_sub
  rw [hscale]
  exact norm_backgroundScale_smul h₁

name: Submission.MorseIntegralSmooth.parameterFDeriv_apply
statement:
lemma parameterFDeriv_apply (F : E₂ → ℝ → ℝ) (x : E₂) (t : ℝ) (v : E₂) :
    parameterFDeriv F x t v = fderiv ℝ F.uncurry (x, t) (v, 0)
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Submission.MorseIntegralSmooth.contDiff_parameterFDeriv_apply
proof:
:= by
  have hD : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fderiv ℝ F.uncurry) :=
    hF.fderiv_right (by simp)
  have hv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : E₂ × ℝ => (v, (0 : ℝ))) := contDiff_const
  simpa [parameterFDeriv_apply] using hD.clm_apply hv

name: Submission.MorseIntegralSmooth.continuous_parameterFDeriv
proof:
:= by
  have hD : Continuous (fderiv ℝ F.uncurry) :=
    hF.continuous_fderiv (by simp)
  let R : ((E₂ × ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] (E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ E₂ (E₂ × ℝ) ℝ).flip
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E₂ ℝ)
  exact R.continuous.comp hD

name: Submission.MorseIntegralSmooth.hasFDerivAt_intervalIntegral
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_intervalIntegral {F : E₂ → ℝ → ℝ}
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F.uncurry) (x₀ : E₂) :
    HasFDerivAt (fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F x t)
      (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, parameterFDeriv F x₀ t) x₀
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set (E₂ × ℝ) := closedBall x₀ 1 ×ˢ Icc 0 1
  have hK : IsCompact K := (isCompact_closedBall x₀ 1).prod isCompact_Icc
  have hcontD : Continuous (fun p : E₂ × ℝ => ‖parameterFDeriv F p.1 p.2‖) :=
    (continuous_parameterFDeriv hF).norm
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ := hK.bddAbove_image hcontD.continuousOn
  have hbound : ∀ p ∈ K, ‖parameterFDeriv F p.1 p.2‖ ≤ M := by
    intro p hp
    exact hM (mem_image_of_mem _ hp)
  apply intervalIntegral.hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le
    (s := ball x₀ 1) (bound := fun _ => M) (ball_mem_nhds x₀ zero_lt_one)
  · filter_upwards with x
    exact (hF.continuous.uncurry_left x).aestronglyMeasurable
  · exact (hF.continuous.uncurry_left x₀).intervalIntegrable 0 1
  · exact ((continuous_parameterFDeriv hF).comp
      (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).aestronglyMeasurable
  · filter_upwards with t ht x hx
    have htI : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
      rw [uIoc_of_le zero_le_one] at ht
      exact ⟨ht.1.le, ht.2⟩
    exact hbound (x, t)
      ⟨Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr (Metric.mem_ball.mp hx).le, htI⟩
  · exact continuous_const.intervalIntegrable 0 1
  · filter_upwards with t _ x _
    have hsection : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E₂ => F y t)
        (parameterFDeriv F x t) x := by
      have htotal : HasFDerivAt F.uncurry (fderiv ℝ F.uncurry (x, t)) (x, t) :=
        (hF.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
      have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E₂ => F y t)
          ((fderiv ℝ F.uncurry (x, t)).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.inl ℝ E₂ ℝ)) x := by
        exact htotal.comp x (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_left (𝕜 := ℝ) x t)
      exact hc
    exact hsection

name: Submission.MorseIntegralSmooth.fderiv_intervalIntegral
statement:
lemma fderiv_intervalIntegral {F : E₂ → ℝ → ℝ}
    (hF : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F.uncurry) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F x t) =
      fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, parameterFDeriv F x t
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  exact (hasFDerivAt_intervalIntegral hF x).fderiv

name: Submission.MorseIntegralSmooth.contDiff_intervalIntegral_nat
proof:
:= by
  induction n generalizing F with
  | zero =>
      change ContDiff ℝ (0 : ℕ∞ω) (fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F x t)
      exact contDiff_zero.mpr <|
        intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous'
          (μ := MeasureTheory.volume) hF.continuous 0 1
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [show ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℕ∞ω) = (n : ℕ∞ω) + 1 by simp,
        contDiff_succ_iff_fderiv_apply]
      have hd : Differentiable ℝ (fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, F x t) :=
        fun x => (hasFDerivAt_intervalIntegral hF x).differentiableAt
      refine ⟨hd, ?_, ?_⟩
      · simp
      · intro v
        rw [fderiv_intervalIntegral hF]
        let Fv : E₂ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x t => parameterFDeriv F x t v
        have hFv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Fv.uncurry := by
          change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E₂ × ℝ => parameterFDeriv F p.1 p.2 v)
          exact contDiff_parameterFDeriv_apply hF v
        have hphi (x : E₂) : IntervalIntegrable
            (fun t => parameterFDeriv F x t) MeasureTheory.volume 0 1 :=
          ((continuous_parameterFDeriv hF).comp
            (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).intervalIntegrable 0 1
        have heq :
            (fun x : E₂ => (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, parameterFDeriv F x t) v) =
              fun x => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, parameterFDeriv F x t v := by
          funext x
          exact ContinuousLinearMap.intervalIntegral_apply (hphi x) v
        rw [heq]
        exact ih hFv

name: Submission.MorseIntegralSmooth.contDiff_intervalIntegral
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_infty]
  intro n
  exact contDiff_intervalIntegral_nat n hF

name: Submission.MorseIntegralSmooth.contDiff_radialHessian_eval
statement:
private lemma contDiff_radialHessian_eval {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f)
    (u v : E₂) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E₂ × ℝ =>
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (p.2 • p.1) ![u, v])
proof:
:= by
  have hinf : (∞ : ℕ∞ω) + 2 = ∞ := by
    rw [show (2 : ℕ∞ω) = 1 + 1 by norm_num, ← add_assoc,
      ENat.coe_top_add_one, ENat.coe_top_add_one]
  have hHess : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f) :=
    hf.iteratedFDeriv_right (hinf.le)
  have hrad : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E₂ × ℝ => p.2 • p.1) := by
    fun_prop
  have hcomp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E₂ × ℝ =>
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (p.2 • p.1)) := hHess.comp hrad
  let ev : (E₂ [×2]→L[ℝ] ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin 2 => E₂) ℝ ![u, v]
  exact ev.contDiff.comp hcomp

name: Submission.MorseIntegralSmooth.contDiff_integratedHadamardA
statement:
theorem contDiff_integratedHadamardA {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (HadamardQuadraticData.integratedHadamardA f)
proof:
:= by
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E₂ => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    (1 - t) * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x)
      ![HadamardQuadraticData.e₀, HadamardQuadraticData.e₀])
  apply contDiff_intervalIntegral
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E₂ × ℝ =>
    (1 - p.2) * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (p.2 • p.1)
      ![HadamardQuadraticData.e₀, HadamardQuadraticData.e₀])
  exact (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd).mul
    (contDiff_radialHessian_eval hf _ _)

name: Submission.MorseIntegralSmooth.contDiff_integratedHadamardB
statement:
theorem contDiff_integratedHadamardB {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (HadamardQuadraticData.integratedHadamardB f)
proof:
:= by
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun x : E₂ => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1,
    (1 - t) *
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x)
          ![HadamardQuadraticData.e₀, HadamardQuadraticData.e₁] +
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x)
          ![HadamardQuadraticData.e₁, HadamardQuadraticData.e₀]) / 2))
  apply contDiff_intervalIntegral
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E₂ × ℝ =>
    (1 - p.2) *
      ((iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (p.2 • p.1)
          ![HadamardQuadraticData.e₀, HadamardQuadraticData.e₁] +
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (p.2 • p.1)
          ![HadamardQuadraticData.e₁, HadamardQuadraticData.e₀]) / 2))
  exact (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd).mul
    (((contDiff_radialHessian_eval hf _ _).add
      (contDiff_radialHessian_eval hf _ _)).div_const 2)

name: Submission.MorseIntegralSmooth.contDiff_integratedHadamardC
statement:
theorem contDiff_integratedHadamardC {f : E₂ → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :

proof:

    (1 - t) * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (t • x)

  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : E₂ × ℝ =>
    (1 - p.2) * iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f (p.2 • p.1)
      ![HadamardQuadraticData.e₁, HadamardQuadraticData.e₁])
  exact (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_snd).mul
    (contDiff_radialHessian_eval hf _ _)

name: Submission.HadamardQuadraticData.morseLemma2D_integrated_of_contDiff
statement:
theorem morseLemma2D_integrated_of_contDiff {g : E₂ → ℝ}
    (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (hcrit : fderiv ℝ g 0 = 0)
    (hdet : integratedHadamardDet g ≠ 0) :
    Nonempty (LocalMorseNormalForm g)
proof:

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitSlotPermutation.generatorMove_slotPoint
statement:
theorem generatorMove_slotPoint (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (A : AdjacentSlot N) (i : Fin N) (c s : ℝ)
    (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    (generatorMove X hm A).forward 1 (slotPoint X i.val c s) =
      slotPoint X (A.perm i).val c s
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hiL : i = A.left
  · subst i
    rw [AdjacentSlot.perm_left, AdjacentSlot.right_val]
    exact adjacentMove_slotPoint_left X hm A.left.val c s hunit
  by_cases hiR : i = A.right
  · subst i
    rw [AdjacentSlot.perm_right]
    exact adjacentMove_slotPoint_right X hm A.left.val c s hunit
  have hperm : A.perm i = i := by
    exact Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hiL hiR
  rw [hperm]
  have hcases : i.val + 1 ≤ A.left.val ∨ A.left.val + 2 ≤ i.val := by
    have hneL : i.val ≠ A.left.val := by
      intro h
      exact hiL (Fin.ext h)
    have hneR : i.val ≠ A.left.val + 1 := by
      intro h
      exact hiR (Fin.ext h)
    omega
  rcases hcases with hleft | hright
  · exact adjacentMove_slotPoint_fixed_of_left X hm A.left.val i.val hleft
      c s hunit 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩
  · exact adjacentMove_slotPoint_fixed_of_right X hm A.left.val i.val hright
      c s hunit 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitSlotPermutation.wordPerm_append

proof:
:= by
  simp [wordPerm, List.prod_append]

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitSlotPermutation.exists_wordPerm_eq
statement:
theorem exists_wordPerm_eq {N : ℕ} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) :
    ∃ word : List (AdjacentSlot N), wordPerm word = σ
proof:
:= by
  cases N with
  | zero =>
      exact ⟨[], Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩
  | succ n =>
      have hmem : σ ∈ Submonoid.closure
          (Set.range fun i : Fin n => Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ) := by
        rw [Equiv.Perm.mclosure_swap_castSucc_succ]
        exact Submonoid.mem_top σ
      refine Submonoid.closure_induction
        (motive := fun τ _ =>
          ∃ word : List (AdjacentSlot (n + 1)), wordPerm word = τ)
        ?_ ?_ ?_ hmem
      · intro τ hτ
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hτ
        let A : AdjacentSlot (n + 1) :=
          { left := i.castSucc
            right_mem := by simpa using i.isLt }
        refine ⟨[A], ?_⟩
        change Equiv.swap A.left A.right =
          Equiv.swap i.castSucc i.succ
        rw [show A.left = i.castSucc by rfl,
          show A.right = i.succ by
            apply Fin.ext
            rfl]
      · exact ⟨[], rfl⟩
      · intro τ υ _ _ hτ hυ
        obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hτ
        obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hυ
        refine ⟨u ++ v, ?_⟩
        rw [wordPerm_append, hu, hv]

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitSlotPermutation.endpointAction_wordMoves_slotPoint
statement:
theorem endpointAction_wordMoves_slotPoint
    (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (word : List (AdjacentSlot N)) (i : Fin N) (c s : ℝ)
    (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointAction (wordMoves X hm word)
        (slotPoint X i.val c s) =
      slotPoint X (wordPerm word i).val c s
proof:
:= by
  induction word with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons A tail ih =>
      rw [wordMoves, List.map_cons,
        SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointAction_cons]
      rw [show SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointAction
          (tail.map (generatorMove X hm)) (slotPoint X i.val c s) =
            slotPoint X (wordPerm tail i).val c s by
        simpa [wordMoves] using ih]
      rw [generatorMove_slotPoint X hm A (wordPerm tail i) c s hunit]
      rfl

    (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (hm : 0 < m)

    (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    (wordAmbient X hm word).forward 1 (slotPoint X i.val c s) =
      slotPoint X (wordPerm word i).val c s
proof:
:= by
  rw [wordAmbient, SmoothAmbientIsotopy.endpointFold_forward_one]
  exact endpointAction_wordMoves_slotPoint X hm word i c s hunit

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitSlotPermutation.permutationAmbient_slotPoint
statement:
theorem permutationAmbient_slotPoint
    (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) (i : Fin N) (c s : ℝ)
    (hunit : c ^ 2 + s ^ 2 = 1) :
    (permutationAmbient X hm σ).forward 1 (slotPoint X i.val c s) =
      slotPoint X (σ i).val c s
proof:
:= by
  calc
    _ = slotPoint X (wordPerm (wordFor σ) i).val c s :=
      wordAmbient_slotPoint X hm (wordFor σ) i c s hunit
    _ = slotPoint X (σ i).val c s := by rw [wordPerm_wordFor]

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitSlotPermutation.permutationAmbient_slotCircle
statement:
theorem permutationAmbient_slotCircle
    (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (hm : 0 < m)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin N)) (i : Fin N) :
    (permutationAmbient X hm σ).forward 1 '' slotCircle X i.val =
      slotCircle X (σ i).val
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨c, s, hunit, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨c, s, hunit, permutationAmbient_slotPoint X hm σ i c s hunit⟩
  · rintro ⟨c, s, hunit, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨slotPoint X i.val c s, ⟨c, s, hunit, rfl⟩,
      permutationAmbient_slotPoint X hm σ i c s hunit⟩

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitSlotPermutation.addCircleCartesian_sq
statement:
private theorem addCircleCartesian_sq (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    (addCircleCartesian a).1 ^ 2 + (addCircleCartesian a).2 ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let z : ℂ := (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero a : Circle)
  have hz : ‖z‖ = 1 := by
    simpa [z, Submonoid.unitSphere] using
      (AddCircle.homeomorphCircle one_ne_zero a : Circle).property
  have hs := Complex.sq_norm z
  rw [hz, one_pow, Complex.normSq_apply] at hs
  simp [addCircleCartesian, z, pow_two, hs]

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitSlotPermutation.orbitSlot_orbitPerm
statement:
@[simp] theorem orbitSlot_orbitPerm (V : TamedField X)

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitSlotPermutation.permutationAmbient_circlePoint

theorem permutationAmbient_circlePoint
    (V : TamedField X) (hm : 0 < m)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card V.OrbitIndex)))
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) (a : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :
    (permutationAmbient X hm σ).forward 1
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) O a) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) (orbitPerm V σ O) a
proof:
:= by
  rw [circlePoint_eq_slotPoint, circlePoint_eq_slotPoint,
    orbitSlot_orbitPerm]
  exact permutationAmbient_slotPoint X hm σ (V.orbitSlot O)
    _ _ (addCircleCartesian_sq a)

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitSlotPermutation.permutationAmbient_target
statement:
theorem permutationAmbient_target
    (V : TamedField X) (hm : 0 < m)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card V.OrbitIndex)))
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    (permutationAmbient X hm σ).forward 1 ''
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V (by omega) O =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V (by omega) (orbitPerm V σ O)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨_, ⟨a, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨a, (permutationAmbient_circlePoint V hm σ O a).symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V (by omega) O a,
      ⟨a, rfl⟩, permutationAmbient_circlePoint V hm σ O a⟩

name: Submission.CanonicalRoundOrbitSlotPermutation.permutationAmbient_targetUnion
statement:
theorem permutationAmbient_targetUnion
    (V : TamedField X) (hm : 0 < m)
    (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin (Fintype.card V.OrbitIndex))) :
    (permutationAmbient X hm σ).forward 1 ''
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V (by omega) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion] at hy ⊢
    obtain ⟨O, hyO⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨orbitPerm V σ O, ?_⟩
    have himage : (permutationAmbient X hm σ).forward 1 y ∈
        (permutationAmbient X hm σ).forward 1 ''
          CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V (by omega) O :=
      ⟨y, hyO, rfl⟩
    rwa [permutationAmbient_target V hm σ O] at himage
  · intro hx
    rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion] at hx
    obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
    let O : V.OrbitIndex := (orbitPerm V σ).symm P
    have hxP' : x ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V (by omega)
        (orbitPerm V σ O) := by
      simpa [O] using hxP
    rw [← permutationAmbient_target V hm σ O] at hxP'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hyx⟩ := hxP'
    refine ⟨y, ?_, hyx⟩
    rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion]
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨O, hy⟩

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularAssembly.continuous_circleLoop
statement:
theorem continuous_circleLoop (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) : Continuous (circleLoop V h2 P)
proof:
:= by
  have hθ : Continuous fun u : I => 2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ) :=
    continuous_const.mul continuous_subtype_val
  have hrw : circleLoop V h2 P
      = fun u : I => CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V h2 P +
          Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ h2 +
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ h2 := rfl
  rw [hrw]
  exact ((continuous_const.add
    ((Real.continuous_cos.comp hθ).smul continuous_const)).add
      ((Real.continuous_sin.comp hθ).smul continuous_const))

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularAssembly.circleLoop_closed
statement:
theorem circleLoop_closed (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) : circleLoop V h2 P 0 = circleLoop V h2 P 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ((0 : I) : ℝ) = 0 := rfl
  have h1 : ((1 : I) : ℝ) = 1 := rfl
  show CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P (2 * Real.pi * ((0 : I) : ℝ))
    = CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P (2 * Real.pi * ((1 : I) : ℝ))
  rw [h0, h1, mul_zero, mul_one]
  show CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V h2 P +
      Real.cos (0 : ℝ) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ h2 +
      Real.sin (0 : ℝ) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ h2
    = CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V h2 P +
      Real.cos (2 * Real.pi) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ h2 +
      Real.sin (2 * Real.pi) • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ h2
  rw [Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularAssembly.circleLoop_mem_regularSet
statement:
theorem circleLoop_mem_regularSet (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) (W : FramedLevelSet n)
    (hfib : W.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2) (u : I) :
    circleLoop V h2 P u ∈ regularSet W.g
proof:
:= by
  apply W.fiber_subset_regularSet
  rw [hfib]
  exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    ⟨P, CanonicalRotationField.point_mem_target V h2 P _⟩

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularAssembly.continuous_clmMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem continuous_clmMatrix_apply
    {Ψ : T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (hΨ : Continuous Ψ) (i j : Fin k) :
    Continuous fun t => PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Ψ t) i j
proof:
:= by
  have hrw : (fun t => PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Ψ t) i j)
      = fun t => (EuclideanSpace.proj i)
          (Ψ t (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) := by
    funext t
    exact PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_apply (Ψ t) i j
  rw [hrw]
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i).continuous.comp
    ((ContinuousLinearMap.apply ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
      (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))).continuous.comp hΨ)

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularAssembly.loopClassZ2_eq_zero_of_circleTriangularJet
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_eq_zero_of_circleTriangularJet (hn : 3 ≤ n) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (V : TamedField Xf) (P : V.OrbitIndex)
    (Xh Yt : FramedLevelSet n)
    (hXfib : Xh.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (hYfib : Yt.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (L : LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop n)
    (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hAcont : Continuous A)
    (hAupper : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (i j : Fin n), j < i →
      PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (A x) i j = 0)
    (hAdiag : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (i : Fin n),
      0 < PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (A x) i i)
    (htau : ∀ theta : ℝ,
      tauField Yt.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta) =
        tauField Xh.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta))
    (hjet : ∀ theta : ℝ,
      fderiv ℝ Yt.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
            (L.cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          ((A (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ Xh.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta))))
    (hclass : loopClassZ2
        (frameSOLoop Yt (circleLoop V h2 P) (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P)
          (fun u => circleLoop_mem_regularSet V h2 P Yt hYfib u))
        (frameSOLoop_closed Yt (circleLoop V h2 P)
          (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P)
          (fun u => circleLoop_mem_regularSet V h2 P Yt hYfib u)
          (circleLoop_closed V h2 P))
      = loopClassZ2
        (frameSOLoop Xh (circleLoop V h2 P) (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P)
          (fun u => circleLoop_mem_regularSet V h2 P Xh hXfib u))
        (frameSOLoop_closed Xh (circleLoop V h2 P)
          (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P)
          (fun u => circleLoop_mem_regularSet V h2 P Xh hXfib u)
          (circleLoop_closed V h2 P))) :
    loopClassZ2 L.loop L.closed = 0
proof:
:= by
  set γ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) := circleLoop V h2 P with hγdef
  have hγc : Continuous γ := continuous_circleLoop V h2 P
  have hγX : ∀ u, γ u ∈ regularSet Xh.g := fun u =>
    circleLoop_mem_regularSet V h2 P Xh hXfib u
  have hγY : ∀ u, γ u ∈ regularSet Yt.g := fun u =>
    circleLoop_mem_regularSet V h2 P Yt hYfib u
  have hγloop : γ 0 = γ 1 := circleLoop_closed V h2 P
  
  have hLcart : ∀ u : I, L.loop u =
      L.cartesian (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)),
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))) := by
    intro u
    rw [L.loop_eq_cartesian u,
      CanonicalRotationField.addCircleCartesian_coe_real ((u : ℝ))]
  
  set Amat : I → Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ := fun u =>
    PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (A (γ u)) with hAmatdef
  have hAmatcont : ∀ i j, Continuous fun u => Amat u i j := fun i j =>
    continuous_clmMatrix_apply (hAcont.comp hγc) i j
  have hAmatupper : ∀ (u : I) (i j : Fin n), j < i → Amat u i j = 0 :=
    fun u i j hij => hAupper (γ u) i j hij
  have hAmatdiag : ∀ (u : I) (i : Fin n), 0 < Amat u i i :=
    fun u i => hAdiag (γ u) i
  have hAmatloop : Amat 0 = Amat 1 := by
    show PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (A (γ 0))
      = PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (A (γ 1))
    rw [hγloop]
  
  have hcomp : ∀ u : I, rowsMatrix (frameAt Yt (γ u))
      = normalBlock (1 : ℝ)
          (((L.loop u : SOGroup n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) * Amat u) *
        rowsMatrix (frameAt Xh (γ u)) := by
    intro u
    have hpt : γ u = CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P
        (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) := rfl
    have hjetu : fderiv ℝ Yt.g (γ u) =
        ((SOFrameGauge.toCLM (L.loop u)).comp (A (γ u))).comp
          (fderiv ℝ Xh.g (γ u)) := by
      rw [hpt, hLcart u, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_assoc]
      exact hjet (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))
    have htauu : tauField Yt.g (γ u) = tauField Xh.g (γ u) := by
      rw [hpt]
      exact htau (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))
    exact rowsMatrix_frameAt_eq_of_triangularJet Xh Yt (γ u) (L.loop u)
      (A (γ u)) hjetu htauu
  exact loopClassZ2_eq_zero_of_triangularComparison hn Xh Yt γ hγc hγX hγY
    hγloop L.loop L.closed Amat hAmatcont hAmatupper hAmatdiag hAmatloop
    hcomp hclass

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularAssembly.loopClassZ2_L_eq_zero
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_L_eq_zero
    {I : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant (m + 2)} {hm : 0 < m}
    {B : BridgeData (m + 2) z} (D : TransitionEntryDatum I hm B)
    (hres : CanonicalCircleFrameClassResidual m hm I)
    (P : (targetField m (standardTarget hm B).X).OrbitIndex) :
    loopClassZ2 (D.L P).loop (D.L P).closed = 0
proof:
:=
  loopClassZ2_eq_zero_of_circleTriangularJet (by omega) (by omega)
    (targetField m (standardTarget hm B).X) P
    (harmonizedEndpoint hm (standardMatch I hm B)
      (standardFrameMatch I hm B) (canonicalGaugeData B))
    (targetPlacement hm (standardTarget hm B).X).endpointX
    (harmonized_fiber_eq_targetUnion hm (standardMatch I hm B)
      (standardFrameMatch I hm B) (canonicalGaugeData B))
    (targetPlacement hm (standardTarget hm B).X).endpoint_fiber
    (D.L P) D.A D.A_smooth.continuous
    (fun x i j hij => D.A_triangular.upper x i j hij)
    (fun x i => D.A_triangular.diag_pos x i)
    (D.tau P) (D.jet P) (hres B P)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.criticalAmbientParam_differentiableAt_full
statement:
theorem criticalAmbientParam_differentiableAt_full
    {K U : Set E'} {χ : SmoothCutoff K U}
    (R : B.SharedCutoffMorseData χ)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ R.criticalParameters)
    (u : E₂) (hu : ‖u‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (R.criticalAmbientParam p hp) u
proof:
:= by
  let M := R.localMorseNormalForm p hp
  let Q := R.criticalModelShrink p hp
  let P := B.chart p.1
  have hM : DifferentiableAt ℝ M.param u :=
    LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.param_differentiableAt_of_contDiffOn_one
      M Q (by simpa [M, Q] using R.criticalModelShrink_contDiffOn p hp) u hu
  have hshift : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun z : E₂ => p.2 + M.param z) u :=
    differentiableAt_const (c := p.2).add hM
  have hchart : DifferentiableAt ℝ
      (fun z : E₂ => P.param (p.2 + M.param z)) u :=
    (P.param_smooth.differentiable (by simp) _).comp u hshift
  change DifferentiableAt ℝ
    (fun z : E₂ => R.forward.diffeomorph
      (P.param (p.2 + M.param z))) u
  exact (R.forward.diffeomorph.contDiff.differentiable (by simp) _).comp
    u hchart

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.transportedParam_differentiableAt_full
proof:
:= by
  let p := (R.criticalEventOwner e).1
  let hp : p ∈ R.criticalParameters := R.criticalEventOwner_mem e
  have huOwner : ‖u‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius := by
    have hle := (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius_le
    change ‖u‖ < (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius at hu
    change (S.eventTransportShrink e).radius ≤
      (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius at hle
    exact hu.trans_le hle
  have hbase := R.criticalAmbientParam_differentiableAt_full p hp u huOwner
  change DifferentiableAt ℝ
    (fun z : E₂ => S.forward.diffeomorph
      (R.criticalAmbientParam p hp z)) u
  exact (S.forward.diffeomorph.contDiff.differentiable (by simp) _).comp
    u hbase

theorem saddlePositiveSpatialArcToBoundaryFull_mem_fiber
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (H : FullRadiusSmooth (center := center) M)
    (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b e : SaddleBranch) (ρ a : ℝ) (u : E₂)
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = a ^ 2)
    (hsign : 0 < signedBranch b (u 0))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hu : ‖u‖ < M.radius) (hρrad : ρ < M.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2)) (q : I) :
    M.saddlePositiveSpatialArcToBoundaryFull H b e ρ a u
        hquad hsign hρ ha hu hρrad q ∈
      (T.saddlePositiveSlice a hreg).fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [saddlePositiveSlice, SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber]
  change C.G (cobSpaceTime
    (spacePart (M.saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryFull H b e ρ a u
      hquad hsign hρ ha hu hρrad q))
    (tcoord center + a ^ 2)) = 0
  rw [← M.saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryFull_time H hindex b e ρ a u
    hquad hsign hρ ha hu hρrad q, spaceTime_spacePart]
  exact M.saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryFull_fiber H b e ρ a u
    hquad hsign hρ ha hu hρrad q

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeSpatialArcToBoundaryFull_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem saddleNegativeSpatialArcToBoundaryFull_mem_fiber

    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hu : ‖u‖ < M.radius) (hρrad : ρ < M.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - a ^ 2)) (q : I) :

    (spacePart (M.saddleNegativeArcToBoundaryFull H b e ρ a u

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveParam_mem_branch_orbit_full
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveParam_mem_branch_orbit_full
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (H : FullRadiusSmooth (center := center) M)
    (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (b : SaddleBranch) (ρ a : ℝ) (u : E₂)
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = a ^ 2)
    (hsign : 0 < signedBranch b (u 0))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hu : ‖u‖ < M.radius) (hρrad : ρ < M.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice a hreg)) :
    spacePart (M.param u) ∈
      V.orbit (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase b ρ a))
proof:
:= by
  let γ := M.saddlePositiveSpatialArcToBoundaryFull H b .negative ρ a u
    hquad hsign hρ ha hu hρrad
  have hγfiber : ∀ q, γ q ∈ (T.saddlePositiveSlice a hreg).fiber := by
    intro q
    exact T.saddlePositiveSpatialArcToBoundaryFull_mem_fiber H hindex
      b .negative ρ a u hquad hsign hρ ha hu hρrad hreg q
  have hend := V.continuousMap_mem_orbit γ hγfiber 1
  have hresult : γ 0 ∈ V.orbit (γ 1) := by
    rw [V.orbit_eq_of_mem hend]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  simpa [γ, saddlePositiveSpatialArcToBoundaryFull,
    saddlePositiveBranchBase] using hresult
