name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositive_coveredSliceFiber_subset_union_orbits_full
statement:
theorem saddlePositive_coveredSliceFiber_subset_union_orbits_full
    {center : E'} {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (H : M.FullRadiusSmooth)
    (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (ρ a : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha0 : 0 < a)
    (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < M.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice a hreg)) :
    M.coveredSliceFiber (tcoord center + a ^ 2) ⊆
      V.orbit (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase .positive ρ a)) ∪
      V.orbit (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase .negative ρ a))
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨u, hu, huv⟩ := M.exists_param_of_mem_coveredSliceFiber hx
  have htime := M.time_model u hu
  have hs : tcoord (M.param u) = tcoord center + a ^ 2 := by
    rw [huv, tcoord_spaceTime]
  have hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = a ^ 2 := by
    rw [hindex] at htime
    linarith
  have hu0 : u 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    simp only [morseQuadratic, hz] at hquad
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 1), sq_nonneg a]
  have hxEq : x = spacePart (M.param u) := by
    rw [huv, spacePart_spaceTime]
  rw [hxEq]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hu0 with hneg | hpos
  · right
    apply T.saddlePositiveParam_mem_branch_orbit_full H hindex .negative
      ρ a u hquad
    · simpa [signedBranch] using neg_pos.mpr hneg
    · exact hρ
    · exact ha
    · exact hu
    · exact hρrad
  · left
    apply T.saddlePositiveParam_mem_branch_orbit_full H hindex .positive
      ρ a u hquad
    · simpa [signedBranch] using hpos
    · exact hρ
    · exact ha
    · exact hu
    · exact hρrad

name: Submission.SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.exists_local_inverse_bound
statement:
theorem exists_local_inverse_bound (X : FramedLevelSet n) {p : E}
    (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ∀ x : E, dist x p < r →
      ∃ q : E, q ∈ X.fiber ∧ dist x q ≤ K * ‖X.g x‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp0 : X.g p = 0 := hp
  have hpreg : p ∈ regularSet X.g := X.fiber_subset_regularSet hp
  set tau : E := tauField X.g p with htaudef
  have htau1 : ‖tau‖ = 1 := norm_tauField hpreg
  set L : E →L[ℝ] F := fderiv ℝ X.g p with hLdef
  set Phi' : E →L[ℝ] ℝ × F := (innerSL ℝ tau).prod L with hPhi'def
  
  have hgstrict : HasStrictFDerivAt X.g L p :=
    (X.smooth.contDiffAt).hasStrictFDerivAt infty_ne_zero
  have hfst : HasStrictFDerivAt
      (fun x : E => innerSL ℝ tau x - innerSL ℝ tau p) (innerSL ℝ tau) p :=
    (innerSL ℝ tau).hasStrictFDerivAt.sub_const _
  have hstrict : HasStrictFDerivAt
      (fun x : E => (innerSL ℝ tau x - innerSL ℝ tau p, X.g x)) Phi' p :=
    hfst.prodMk hgstrict
  
  have hker : ∀ v : E, Phi' v = 0 → v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have h1 : innerSL ℝ tau v = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg Prod.fst hv
      simpa [hPhi'def] using h
    have h2 : L v = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg Prod.snd hv
      simpa [hPhi'def] using h
    have hmem : v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ {tauField X.g p} :=
      (fderiv_eq_zero_iff_mem_span_tauField hpreg v).mp h2
    rw [← htaudef] at hmem
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hmem
    have hcv : innerSL ℝ tau (c • tau) = 0 := by
      rw [hc]
      exact h1
    have hc0 : c = 0 := by
      rw [innerSL_apply_apply, real_inner_smul_right,
        real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, htau1] at hcv
      simpa using hcv
    rw [← hc, hc0, zero_smul]
  have hinj : Function.Injective Phi' := by
    intro v w hvw
    have hsub : Phi' (v - w) = 0 := by
      rw [map_sub, hvw, sub_self]
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp (hker _ hsub)
  have hdim : finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) =
      finrank ℝ (ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, Module.finrank_prod,
      finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, Module.finrank_self]
    omega
  
  set eqv : E ≃L[ℝ] ℝ × F :=
    (Phi'.toLinearMap.linearEquivOfInjective hinj hdim).toContinuousLinearEquiv
    with heqvdef
  have hcoefun : ∀ v : E, eqv v = Phi' v := by
    intro v
    have h1 : eqv v =
        Phi'.toLinearMap.linearEquivOfInjective hinj hdim v := rfl
    rw [h1, LinearMap.linearEquivOfInjective_apply]
    rfl
  have hcoe : (eqv : E →L[ℝ] ℝ × F) = Phi' :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.ext hcoefun
  have hPhie : HasStrictFDerivAt
      (fun x : E => (innerSL ℝ tau x - innerSL ℝ tau p, X.g x))
      (eqv : E →L[ℝ] ℝ × F) p := by
    rw [hcoe]
    exact hstrict
  set Phi : E → ℝ × F :=
    fun x : E => (innerSL ℝ tau x - innerSL ℝ tau p, X.g x) with hPhidef
  set ginv : ℝ × F → E := hPhie.localInverse Phi eqv p with hginvdef
  
  obtain ⟨K, s, hs, hK⟩ := hPhie.to_localInverse.exists_lipschitzOnWith
  have hright : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (Phi p), Phi (ginv y) = y :=
    hPhie.eventually_right_inverse
  have hleft : ∀ᶠ x in 𝓝 p, ginv (Phi x) = x :=
    hPhie.eventually_left_inverse
  have hΦp : Phi p = (0 : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := by
    rw [hPhidef]
    simp [hp0, Prod.ext_iff]
  
  have hmem2 : s ∩ {y : ℝ × F | Phi (ginv y) = y} ∈ 𝓝 (Phi p) :=
    Filter.inter_mem hs hright
  obtain ⟨rho, hrhopos, hrhosub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hmem2
  have hPhicont : Continuous Phi := by
    rw [hPhidef]
    exact ((innerSL ℝ tau).continuous.sub continuous_const).prodMk
      X.smooth.continuous
  have hpre : {x : E | ginv (Phi x) = x} ∩
      Phi ⁻¹' Metric.ball (Phi p) rho ∈ 𝓝 p :=
    Filter.inter_mem hleft
      (hPhicont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
        (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hrhopos))
  obtain ⟨r, hrpos, hrsub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hpre
  refine ⟨K, r, hrpos, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨hgx, hxball⟩ := hrsub (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hx)
  have hxball' : dist (Phi x) (Phi p) < rho := Metric.mem_ball.mp hxball
  
  set y0 : ℝ × F := ((Phi x).1, (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) with hy0def
  have hxnorm : ‖Phi x‖ < rho := by
    have h := hxball'
    rwa [hΦp, dist_zero_right] at h
  have hy0close : dist y0 (Phi p) < rho := by
    rw [hΦp, dist_zero_right]
    have hle : ‖y0‖ ≤ ‖Phi x‖ := by
      rw [hy0def, Prod.norm_def, Prod.norm_def]
      simp only [norm_zero]
      exact max_le (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_of_le_right (norm_nonneg _))
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt hle hxnorm
  have hy0mem := hrhosub (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hy0close)
  have hxmem := hrhosub (Metric.mem_ball.mpr hxball')
  set q : E := ginv y0 with hqdef
  have hq : Phi q = y0 := hy0mem.2
  have hqfiber : q ∈ X.fiber := by
    have h := congrArg Prod.snd hq
    have h2 : X.g q = 0 := by
      simpa [hPhidef, hy0def] using h
    exact h2
  refine ⟨q, hqfiber, ?_⟩
  have hdistPhi : dist (Phi x) y0 = ‖X.g x‖ := by
    rw [Prod.dist_eq]
    have h1 : dist (Phi x).1 y0.1 = 0 := by
      rw [hy0def]
      exact dist_self _
    have h2 : dist (Phi x).2 y0.2 = ‖X.g x‖ := by
      show dist (X.g x) (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = ‖X.g x‖
      exact dist_zero_right _
    rw [h1, h2]
    exact max_eq_right (norm_nonneg _)
  calc dist x q = dist (ginv (Phi x)) (ginv y0) := by rw [hgx]
    _ ≤ K * dist (Phi x) y0 := hK.dist_le_mul _ hxmem.1 _ hy0mem.1
    _ = K * ‖X.g x‖ := by rw [hdistPhi]

name: Submission.SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.exists_tube_bound
statement:
theorem exists_tube_bound (X : FramedLevelSet n) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x : E,
      Metric.infDist x X.fiber ≤ δ →
        Metric.infDist x X.fiber ≤ C * ‖X.g x‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  by_cases hne : X.fiber.Nonempty
  · choose K r hr hloc using
      fun p : X.fiber => exists_local_inverse_bound X p.2
    have hcover : X.fiber ⊆
        ⋃ p : X.fiber, Metric.ball (p : E) (r p / 2) := by
      intro q hq
      exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
        ⟨⟨q, hq⟩, Metric.mem_ball_self (half_pos (hr ⟨q, hq⟩))⟩
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := X.isCompact_fiber.elim_finite_subcover
      (fun p : X.fiber => Metric.ball (p : E) (r p / 2))
      (fun _ => Metric.isOpen_ball) hcover
    have htne : t.Nonempty := by
      obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hne
      have hmem := ht hq
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hmem
      obtain ⟨p, hpt, -⟩ := hmem
      exact ⟨p, hpt⟩
    refine ⟨1 + ((t.sup K : ℝ≥0) : ℝ), by positivity,
      t.inf' htne r / 2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · have hall : (0 : ℝ) < t.inf' htne r := by
        rw [Finset.lt_inf'_iff]
        intro p _
        exact hr p
      linarith
    · intro x hx
      obtain ⟨q₀, hq₀mem, hq₀d⟩ :=
        X.isCompact_fiber.exists_infDist_eq_dist hne x
      have hmem := ht hq₀mem
      rw [Set.mem_iUnion₂] at hmem
      obtain ⟨p, hpt, hq₀ball⟩ := hmem
      have hq₀p : dist q₀ (p : E) < r p / 2 := Metric.mem_ball.mp hq₀ball
      have hinf_le : t.inf' htne r ≤ r p := Finset.inf'_le r hpt
      have hxq₀ : dist x q₀ ≤ t.inf' htne r / 2 := by
        rw [← hq₀d]
        exact hx
      have hxp : dist x (p : E) < r p := by
        calc dist x (p : E) ≤ dist x q₀ + dist q₀ (p : E) := dist_triangle _ _ _
          _ < t.inf' htne r / 2 + r p / 2 := by
              exact add_lt_add_of_le_of_lt hxq₀ hq₀p
          _ ≤ r p / 2 + r p / 2 := by linarith
          _ = r p := by ring
      obtain ⟨q, hqfib, hqd⟩ := hloc p x hxp
      have hKle : ((K p : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) ≤ 1 + ((t.sup K : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) := by
        have h1 : (K p : ℝ≥0) ≤ t.sup K := Finset.le_sup hpt
        have h2 : ((K p : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) ≤ ((t.sup K : ℝ≥0) : ℝ) :=
          NNReal.coe_le_coe.mpr h1
        linarith
      calc Metric.infDist x X.fiber ≤ dist x q :=
            Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem hqfib
        _ ≤ (K p : ℝ) * ‖X.g x‖ := hqd
        _ ≤ (1 + ((t.sup K : ℝ≥0) : ℝ)) * ‖X.g x‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hKle (norm_nonneg _)
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos, 1, one_pos, ?_⟩
    intro x _
    rw [Set.not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty.mp hne, Metric.infDist_empty]
    positivity

name: Submission.SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.exists_jet_difference_bound
statement:
theorem exists_jet_difference_bound (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    (hne : X.fiber.Nonempty)
    (fiber_eq : Y.fiber = X.fiber)
    {eps : ℝ}
    (hjet : ∀ x ∈ X.fiber, ‖fderiv ℝ Y.g x - fderiv ℝ X.g x‖ < eps) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x : E, Metric.infDist x X.fiber ≤ δ →
      ‖Y.g x - X.g x‖ ≤ eps * Metric.infDist x X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hcontD : Continuous
      fun z : E => fderiv ℝ Y.g z - fderiv ℝ X.g z :=
    (Y.smooth.continuous_fderiv infty_ne_zero).sub
      (X.smooth.continuous_fderiv infty_ne_zero)
  have hopen : IsOpen
      {z : E | ‖fderiv ℝ Y.g z - fderiv ℝ X.g z‖ < eps} :=
    isOpen_lt hcontD.norm continuous_const
  have hsubset : X.fiber ⊆
      {z : E | ‖fderiv ℝ Y.g z - fderiv ℝ X.g z‖ < eps} :=
    fun z hz => hjet z hz
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀pos, hδ₀sub⟩ :=
    X.isCompact_fiber.exists_thickening_subset_open hopen hsubset
  refine ⟨δ₀ / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨p, hpmem, hpd⟩ := X.isCompact_fiber.exists_infDist_eq_dist hne x
  have hpY : Y.g p = 0 := by
    have hmem : p ∈ Y.fiber := by
      rw [fiber_eq]
      exact hpmem
    exact hmem
  have hpX : X.g p = 0 := hpmem
  have hd0 : 0 ≤ dist x p := dist_nonneg
  
  have hbound : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall p (dist x p),
      ‖fderiv ℝ (fun w => Y.g w - X.g w) z‖ ≤ eps := by
    intro z hz
    have hzp : dist z p ≤ dist x p := Metric.mem_closedBall.mp hz
    have hzfib : Metric.infDist z X.fiber < δ₀ := by
      have h1 : Metric.infDist z X.fiber ≤ dist z p :=
        Metric.infDist_le_dist_of_mem hpmem
      have h2 : dist x p ≤ δ₀ / 2 := by
        rw [← hpd]
        exact hx
      linarith
    have hzmem : z ∈ Metric.thickening δ₀ X.fiber :=
      (Metric.mem_thickening_iff_infDist_lt hne).mpr hzfib
    have hzV := hδ₀sub hzmem
    have hfd : fderiv ℝ (fun w => Y.g w - X.g w) z =
        fderiv ℝ Y.g z - fderiv ℝ X.g z :=
      fderiv_sub (Y.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero z)
        (X.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero z)
    rw [hfd]
    exact le_of_lt hzV
  have hdiff : ∀ z ∈ Metric.closedBall p (dist x p),
      DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun w => Y.g w - X.g w) z :=
    fun z _ => (Y.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero z).sub
      (X.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero z)
  have hmvt := (convex_closedBall p (dist x p)).norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_fderiv_le
    hdiff hbound (Metric.mem_closedBall_self hd0)
    (Metric.mem_closedBall.mpr le_rfl)
  have hmvt' : ‖(Y.g x - X.g x) - (Y.g p - X.g p)‖ ≤ eps * ‖x - p‖ := hmvt
  have hzero : Y.g p - X.g p = 0 := by
    rw [hpY, hpX, sub_zero]
  rw [hzero, sub_zero, ← dist_eq_norm] at hmvt'
  rw [hpd]
  exact hmvt'

name: Submission.SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.exists_tube_threshold
statement:
theorem exists_tube_threshold (X : FramedLevelSet n) :
    ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ Y : FramedLevelSet n, X.fiber.Nonempty →
      Y.fiber = X.fiber →
      (∀ p ∈ X.fiber, ‖fderiv ℝ Y.g p - fderiv ℝ X.g p‖ < c) →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x : E, x ∉ X.fiber →
        Metric.infDist x X.fiber ≤ δ →
          ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 → segMap X Y r x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC, δB, hδB, hB⟩ := exists_tube_bound X
  refine ⟨1 / (2 * C), by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro Y hne fiber_eq hclose
  obtain ⟨δA, hδA, hA⟩ :=
    exists_jet_difference_bound X Y hne fiber_eq hclose
  refine ⟨min δA δB, lt_min hδA hδB, ?_⟩
  intro x hxf hx r hr0 hr1 hzero
  set d : ℝ := Metric.infDist x X.fiber with hddef
  have hd0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ d := by
    rw [hddef]
    exact Metric.infDist_nonneg
  have hdpos : 0 < d := by
    rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hd0 with h | h
    · exact h
    · exfalso
      apply hxf
      have hz : Metric.infDist x X.fiber = 0 := by
        rw [← hddef]
        exact h.symm
      have hcl : x ∈ closure X.fiber :=
        (Metric.mem_closure_iff_infDist_zero hne).mpr hz
      rwa [X.isClosed_fiber.closure_eq] at hcl
  have hXg : d ≤ C * ‖X.g x‖ := hB x (hx.trans (min_le_right _ _))
  have hdiffb : ‖Y.g x - X.g x‖ ≤ 1 / (2 * C) * d :=
    hA x (hx.trans (min_le_left _ _))
  
  have hzero' : (1 - r) • X.g x + r • Y.g x = 0 := hzero
  have hEq : (1 - r) • X.g x + r • Y.g x =
      X.g x + r • (Y.g x - X.g x) := by
    module
  have h1 : X.g x + r • (Y.g x - X.g x) = 0 := by
    rw [← hEq]
    exact hzero'
  have h2 : X.g x = -(r • (Y.g x - X.g x)) :=
    eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left h1
  have hnormX : ‖X.g x‖ ≤ 1 / (2 * C) * d := by
    rw [h2, norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr0]
    calc r * ‖Y.g x - X.g x‖ ≤ 1 * ‖Y.g x - X.g x‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr1 (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = ‖Y.g x - X.g x‖ := one_mul _
      _ ≤ 1 / (2 * C) * d := hdiffb
  have hfinal : d ≤ d / 2 := by
    have hstep : C * ‖X.g x‖ ≤ C * (1 / (2 * C) * d) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hnormX hC.le
    have hCd : C * (1 / (2 * C) * d) = d / 2 := by
      field_simp
    linarith
  linarith

name: Submission.SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.tubeThreshold_pos
statement: theorem tubeThreshold_pos (X : FramedLevelSet n) : 0 < tubeThreshold X
proof:
:=
  (exists_tube_threshold X).choose_spec.1

name: Submission.SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.exists_segMap_ne_zero_of_fderiv_close
statement:
theorem exists_segMap_ne_zero_of_fderiv_close (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    (hne : X.fiber.Nonempty)
    (fiber_eq : Y.fiber = X.fiber)
    (hclose : ∀ p ∈ X.fiber,
      ‖fderiv ℝ Y.g p - fderiv ℝ X.g p‖ < tubeThreshold X) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x : E, x ∉ X.fiber →
      Metric.infDist x X.fiber ≤ δ →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 → segMap X Y r x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  (exists_tube_threshold X).choose_spec.2 Y hne fiber_eq hclose

name: Submission.SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.exists_segMap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem exists_segMap_ne_zero (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    (hne : X.fiber.Nonempty)
    (fiber_eq : Y.fiber = X.fiber)
    (hjet : ∀ x ∈ X.fiber, fderiv ℝ Y.g x = fderiv ℝ X.g x) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x : E, x ∉ X.fiber →
      Metric.infDist x X.fiber ≤ δ →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 → segMap X Y r x ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  exists_segMap_ne_zero_of_fderiv_close X Y hne fiber_eq (by
    intro p hp
    rw [hjet p hp, sub_self, norm_zero]
    exact tubeThreshold_pos X)

name: Submission.SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.exists_shell_radius
statement:
theorem exists_shell_radius (X Y : FramedLevelSet n) (S : FiberSign X)
    (T : FiberSign Y)
    (hne : X.fiber.Nonempty)
    (fiber_eq : Y.fiber = X.fiber)
    (hagree : ∀ x ∈ X.fiber, 0 < S x * T x)
    (hclose : ∀ p ∈ X.fiber,
      ‖fderiv ℝ Y.g p - fderiv ℝ X.g p‖ < tubeThreshold X) :
    ∃ rho : ℝ, 0 < rho ∧
      (∀ x : E, Metric.infDist x X.fiber ≤ rho → 0 < S x * T x) ∧
      (∀ x : E, x ∉ X.fiber → Metric.infDist x X.fiber ≤ rho →
        ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 → segMap X Y r x ≠ 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δseg, hδseg, hseg⟩ :=
    exists_segMap_ne_zero_of_fderiv_close X Y hne fiber_eq hclose
  have hopen : IsOpen {x : E | 0 < S x * T x} :=
    isOpen_lt continuous_const (S.continuous.mul T.continuous)
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, hsub⟩ :=
    X.isCompact_fiber.exists_thickening_subset_open hopen
      fun x hx => hagree x hx
  refine ⟨min (δ₀ / 2) δseg, lt_min (by positivity) hδseg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx
    have h1 : Metric.infDist x X.fiber ≤ δ₀ / 2 := hx.trans (min_le_left _ _)
    have h2 : Metric.infDist x X.fiber < δ₀ := by linarith
    exact hsub ((Metric.mem_thickening_iff_infDist_lt hne).mpr h2)
  · intro x hxf hx r hr0 hr1
    exact hseg x hxf (hx.trans (min_le_right _ _)) r hr0 hr1

name: Submission.SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.bijective_of_one_sub_norm_lt
statement:
theorem bijective_of_one_sub_norm_lt
    {G : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup G] [NormedSpace ℝ G] [CompleteSpace G]
    (T : G →L[ℝ] G) (h : ‖(1 : G →L[ℝ] G) - T‖ < 1) :
    Function.Bijective T
proof:
:= by
  have hb := SameFiberGaugeAlignment.bijective_one_sub_of_norm_lt
    ((1 : G →L[ℝ] G) - T) h
  rwa [sub_sub_cancel] at hb

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeEntryFirstJet.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_fderivClose
statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_fderivClose
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖segMap (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G)
          (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX r x‖)
    (hclose : ∀ x ∈ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber,
      ‖fderiv ℝ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x -
          fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x‖ <
        SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.tubeThreshold
          (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G)) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_toFirstSource_of_shellData hm M F G
    (shellDataOfFderivClose hm M F G R eps eps_pos outer hclose)

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeEntryFirstJet.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_firstJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_firstJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖segMap (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G)
          (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX r x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ x ∈ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber,
      fderiv ℝ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x =
        fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_toFirstSource_of_shellData hm M F G
    (shellDataOfFirstJet hm M F G R eps eps_pos outer hjet)

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationBridgeEntryFirstJet.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_nearIdentityJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_nearIdentityJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A)
    (hnorm : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)),
      ‖(1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A x‖ < 1)
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • A x ((harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x) +
          r • (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ x ∈ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber,
      fderiv ℝ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x =
        fderiv ℝ (fun y => A y ((harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g y)) x) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:= by
  have hAbij : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)),
      Function.Bijective (A x) := fun x =>
    SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.bijective_of_one_sub_norm_lt (A x)
      (hnorm x)
  
  set X' : FramedLevelSet (m + 2) :=
    (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).gaugeTransform A hA hAbij with hX'def
  have hfib : X'.fiber = (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber :=
    FramedLevelSet.gaugeTransform_fiber _ A hA hAbij
  have hP : SameFiberGaugeAlignment.Path
      (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G) X' :=
    SameFiberGaugeAlignment.Path.ofNearIdentity A hA hnorm fun x => rfl
  have h₂ : DefiningMapHomotopy (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G) X' :=
    hP.homotopy
  
  have hdata :=
    SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.dataOfFirstJet X'
      (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX
      ((harmonizedSign hm M F G).restrict h₂.fiber_subset)
      (placedSign hm Z kind tail)
      (by rw [hfib]; exact placed_fiber_eq_harmonized_fiber hm M F G)
      R eps eps_pos
      (fun x hx r hr0 hr1 => outer x hx r hr0 hr1)
      (by
        intro x hx
        rw [hfib] at hx
        simpa using harmonized_mul_pos_on_fiber hm M F G x hx)
      (by
        intro x hx
        rw [hfib] at hx
        exact hjet x hx)
  exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
    ⟨(legOne hm M F G).signedCobordism (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)⟩
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
      ⟨h₂.signedCobordism (harmonizedSign hm M F G)⟩
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
        hdata.nonempty_signedCobordism
        (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_symm
          ⟨(firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).signedCobordism
            (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign⟩)))

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.coreLoop_mem
statement:
theorem coreLoop_mem
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) (q : I) :
    H.coreLoop O q ∈ criticalSliceExteriorCore C criticalCenter t r
proof:
:= by
  exact H.midpoint_mem O q

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.coreLoop_fiber
statement:
theorem coreLoop_fiber
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) (q : I) :
    C.G (H.coreLoop O q) = 0
proof:
:=
  (mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore C criticalCenter (H.coreLoop O q) t r).mp
    (H.coreLoop_mem O q) |>.1

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.coreLoop_time
statement:
theorem coreLoop_time
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) (q : I) :
    tcoord (H.coreLoop O q) = t
proof:
:=
  (mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore C criticalCenter (H.coreLoop O q) t r).mp
    (H.coreLoop_mem O q) |>.2.1

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.positiveEndpoint_time
statement:
theorem positiveEndpoint_time
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) (q : I) :
    tcoord (R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) ε) = t + ε
proof:
:= by
  rw [R.tcoord_flow (H.coreLoop_mem O q) H.safe, H.coreLoop_time O q]

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.positiveCurve_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem positiveCurve_mem_fiber
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) (q : I) :
    H.positiveCurve O q ∈
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C (t + ε) hpos).fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber]
  change C.G (cobSpaceTime
    (spacePart (R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) ε)) (t + ε)) = 0
  rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O q, spaceTime_spacePart]
  exact R.flow_mem_fiber (H.coreLoop_fiber O q) ε

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.positiveCurve_closed
statement:
theorem positiveCurve_closed
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) :
    H.positiveCurve O 0 = H.positiveCurve O 1
proof:
:= by
  change spacePart
      (R.base.flow
        (R.base.flow ((H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop 0) ε) ε) =
    spacePart
      (R.base.flow
        (R.base.flow ((H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop 1) ε) ε)
  rw [(H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop_closed]

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.positiveCurve_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem positiveCurve_mem_orbit
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) (q : I) :
    H.positiveCurve O q ∈ Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve O 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact Vpos.continuousMap_mem_orbit (H.positiveCurve O)
    (H.positiveCurve_mem_fiber O) q

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.positiveCurve_eq_cases
statement:
theorem positiveCurve_eq_cases
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) {u v : I}
    (huv : H.positiveCurve O u = H.positiveCurve O v) :
    u = v ∨ (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hambient :
      R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O u) ε =
        R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O v) ε := by
    calc
      R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O u) ε =
          cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O u) (t + ε) := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O u]
        change R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O u) ε =
          cobSpaceTime (spacePart (R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O u) ε))
            (tcoord (R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O u) ε))
        exact (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O v) (t + ε) := by rw [huv]
      _ = R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O v) ε := by
        rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O v]
        change cobSpaceTime
            (spacePart (R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O v) ε))
            (tcoord (R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O v) ε)) =
          R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O v) ε
        exact spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hcore : H.coreLoop O u = H.coreLoop O v :=
    R.flow_apply_injective ε hambient
  have hnegativeAmbient :
      (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop u =
        (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop v := by
    apply R.flow_apply_injective ε
    exact hcore
  apply (H.negativeParam O).curve_eq_cases
  simpa [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.exteriorAmbientLoop] using
    congrArg spacePart hnegativeAmbient

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.negativeParam_orbitIndex
statement:
theorem negativeParam_orbitIndex
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) :
    (H.negativeParam O).orbitIndex = O.1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact (Vneg.orbitPoint_orbit O.1).symm

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.positiveParam_orbitIndex
statement:
theorem positiveParam_orbitIndex
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) :
    (H.positiveParam O).orbitIndex = (H.orbitEquiv O).1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve O 0) =
    ((H.orbitEquiv O).1 : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
  calc
    Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve O 0) =
        Vpos.orbit (Vpos.orbitPoint (H.orbitEquiv O).1) := by
      apply Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem
      have hb : H.positiveCurve O 0 ∈
          ((H.orbitEquiv O).1 :
            Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
        exact H.positive_base_mem O
      rw [Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit (H.orbitEquiv O).1] at hb
      exact hb
    _ = ((H.orbitEquiv O).1 :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :=
      (Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit (H.orbitEquiv O).1).symm

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.negative_boundary
statement:
theorem negative_boundary
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) (q : I) :
    R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) (-ε) =
      (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q
proof:
:= by
  change R.base.flow
      (R.base.flow ((H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q) ε) (-ε) =
    (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q
  simpa using congrFun (R.base.flow_shift
    ((H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q) ε) (-ε)

name: Submission.CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing.positive_boundary
statement:
theorem positive_boundary
    (H : CanonicalCriticalExteriorFlowPairing C criticalCenter t r ε R
      hneg hpos Vneg Vpos A B)
    (O : {O // O ∈ Vneg.selectedOrbitFinset A}) (q : I) :
    R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) ε =
      (H.positiveParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop q
proof:
:= by
  change R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) ε =
    cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O q) (t + ε)
  rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O q]
  change R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) ε =
    cobSpaceTime (spacePart (R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) ε))
      (tcoord (R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O q) ε))
  exact (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm

name: Submission.pairToMorseParam_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairToMorseParam_apply_zero (q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    pairToMorseParam q 0 = q.1
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairToMorseParam]

name: Submission.pairToMorseParam_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem pairToMorseParam_apply_one (q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    pairToMorseParam q 1 = q.2
proof:
:= by
  simp [pairToMorseParam]

name: Submission.norm_pairToMorseParam_sq
statement:
theorem norm_pairToMorseParam_sq (q : ℝ × ℝ) :
    ‖pairToMorseParam q‖ ^ 2 = q.1 ^ 2 + q.2 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt]
  · simp [Fin.sum_univ_two, sq_abs]
  · positivity

name: Submission.norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq
statement:
theorem norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq
    (b : SaddleBranch) (a s : ℝ) :
    ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a s)‖ ^ 2 =
      a ^ 2 + 2 * s ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_pairToMorseParam_sq]
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + s ^ 2)) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + s ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  simp [saddlePositiveArc, signedBranch_sq, hsqrt]
  ring

name: Submission.norm_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc_sq
statement:
theorem norm_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc_sq
    (b : SaddleBranch) (a s : ℝ) :
    ‖pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc b a s)‖ ^ 2 =
      a ^ 2 + 2 * s ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_pairToMorseParam_sq]
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + s ^ 2)) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + s ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)
  simp [saddleNegativeArc, signedBranch_sq, hsqrt]
  ring

name: Submission.saddleBoundaryParameter_sq
statement:
theorem saddleBoundaryParameter_sq {ρ a : ℝ} (ha : a ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2) :
    saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a ^ 2 = (ρ ^ 2 - a ^ 2) / 2
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.sq_sqrt (by
    apply div_nonneg
    · linarith
    · norm_num)

name: Submission.norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam
statement:
theorem norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam
    (b e : SaddleBranch) {ρ a : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) :
    ‖saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a‖ = ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hs := saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)
  have hsq := norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a
    (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a))
  rw [signedBranch_sq, hs] at hsq
  have hnorm : 0 ≤ ‖saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a‖ := norm_nonneg _
  change ‖saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a‖ ^ 2 =
    a ^ 2 + 2 * ((ρ ^ 2 - a ^ 2) / 2) at hsq
  nlinarith

name: Submission.norm_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam
statement:
theorem norm_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam
    (b e : SaddleBranch) {ρ a : ℝ}
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) :
    ‖saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a‖ = ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hs := saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)
  have hsq := norm_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc_sq b a
    (signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a))
  rw [signedBranch_sq, hs] at hsq
  have hnorm : 0 ≤ ‖saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a‖ := norm_nonneg _
  change ‖saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam b e ρ a‖ ^ 2 =
    a ^ 2 + 2 * ((ρ ^ 2 - a ^ 2) / 2) at hsq
  nlinarith

name: Submission.saddle_boundary_pairing_switch
statement:
theorem saddle_boundary_pairing_switch (b e : SaddleBranch) (ρ : ℝ) :
    saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b e ρ 0 =
      saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam e b ρ 0
proof:
:= by
  have hσ : 0 ≤ saddleBoundaryParameter ρ 0 := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt ((saddleBoundaryParameter ρ 0) ^ 2) =
      saddleBoundaryParameter ρ 0 := by
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hσ]
  ext i
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam,
      saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam, saddlePositiveArc,
      saddleNegativeArc, hsqrt]

name: Submission.euclidean_fin_two_ext
statement:
private theorem euclidean_fin_two_ext {u v : E₂}
    (h₀ : u 0 = v 0) (h₁ : u 1 = v 1) : u = v
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · simpa using h₀
  · simpa using h₁

name: Submission.eq_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_of_signedBranch
statement:
theorem eq_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_of_signedBranch
    (b : SaddleBranch) (a : ℝ) (u : E₂)
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = a ^ 2)
    (hsign : 0 < signedBranch b (u 0)) :
    u = pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a (u 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hsquare : u 0 ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2 := by
    simp only [morseQuadratic] at hquad
    linarith
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2) = |u 0| := by
    rw [← hsquare, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  apply euclidean_fin_two_ext
  · cases b with
    | positive =>
        rw [pairToMorseParam_apply_zero]
        change u 0 = Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2)
        simp only [signedBranch] at hsign
        rw [hsqrt, abs_of_pos hsign]
    | negative =>
        rw [pairToMorseParam_apply_zero]
        change u 0 = -Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + u 1 ^ 2)
        simp only [signedBranch] at hsign
        have hx : u 0 < 0 := by linarith
        rw [hsqrt, abs_of_neg hx]
        ring
  · rw [pairToMorseParam_apply_one]
    rfl

name: Submission.eq_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc_of_signedBranch
statement:
theorem eq_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc_of_signedBranch
    (b : SaddleBranch) (a : ℝ) (u : E₂)
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(a ^ 2))
    (hsign : 0 < signedBranch b (u 1)) :
    u = pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc b a (u 0))
proof:
:= by
  have hsquare : u 1 ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + u 0 ^ 2 := by
    simp only [morseQuadratic] at hquad
    linarith
  have hsqrt : Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + u 0 ^ 2) = |u 1| := by
    rw [← hsquare, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs]
  apply euclidean_fin_two_ext
  · rw [pairToMorseParam_apply_zero]
    rfl
  · cases b with
    | positive =>
        rw [pairToMorseParam_apply_one]
        change u 1 = Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + u 0 ^ 2)
        simp only [signedBranch] at hsign
        rw [hsqrt, abs_of_pos hsign]
    | negative =>
        rw [pairToMorseParam_apply_one]
        change u 1 = -Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + u 0 ^ 2)
        simp only [signedBranch] at hsign
        have hy : u 1 < 0 := by linarith
        rw [hsqrt, abs_of_neg hy]
        ring

name: Submission.saddleAffineCoordinate_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem saddleAffineCoordinate_zero (s₀ s₁ : ℝ) :
    saddleAffineCoordinate s₀ s₁ 0 = s₀
proof:
:= by
  simp [saddleAffineCoordinate]

name: Submission.saddleAffineCoordinate_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem saddleAffineCoordinate_one (s₀ s₁ : ℝ) :
    saddleAffineCoordinate s₀ s₁ 1 = s₁
proof:
:= by
  simp [saddleAffineCoordinate]

name: Submission.saddleAffineCoordinate_sq_le
statement:
theorem saddleAffineCoordinate_sq_le (s₀ s₁ : ℝ) (q : I) :
    saddleAffineCoordinate s₀ s₁ q ^ 2 ≤
      (1 - (q : ℝ)) * s₀ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ) * s₁ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := q.property.1
  have hq1 : (q : ℝ) ≤ 1 := q.property.2
  have hprod : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) * (1 - (q : ℝ)) :=
    mul_nonneg hq0 (sub_nonneg.mpr hq1)
  have hmul : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) * (1 - (q : ℝ)) * (s₀ - s₁) ^ 2 :=
    mul_nonneg hprod (sq_nonneg _)
  simp only [saddleAffineCoordinate]
  nlinarith

name: Submission.norm_saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam_lt
statement:
theorem norm_saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam_lt
    (b e : SaddleBranch) {ρ a R : ℝ} (u : E₂)
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = a ^ 2)
    (hsign : 0 < signedBranch b (u 0))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hu : ‖u‖ < R) (hρR : ρ < R) (q : I) :
    ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖ < R
proof:
:= by
  let s₁ := signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)
  have hclass :=
    eq_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_of_signedBranch b a u hquad hsign
  have hstart : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + 2 * (u 1) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖u‖ ^ 2 = ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a (u 1))‖ ^ 2 :=
        congrArg (fun z : E₂ => ‖z‖ ^ 2) hclass
      _ = a ^ 2 + 2 * (u 1) ^ 2 :=
        norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a (u 1)
  have hend : a ^ 2 + 2 * s₁ ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [s₁]
    rw [signedBranch_sq, saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)]
    ring
  have hcoord := saddleAffineCoordinate_sq_le (u 1) s₁ q
  have hcurve := norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a
    (saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1) s₁ q)
  have hcurveSq :
      ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (1 - (q : ℝ)) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ) * ρ ^ 2 := by
    change ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a
      (saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1) s₁ q))‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
    calc
      ‖pairToMorseParam (saddlePositiveArc b a
          (saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1) s₁ q))‖ ^ 2 =
          a ^ 2 + 2 * saddleAffineCoordinate (u 1) s₁ q ^ 2 := hcurve
      _ ≤ a ^ 2 + 2 *
          ((1 - (q : ℝ)) * (u 1) ^ 2 + (q : ℝ) * s₁ ^ 2) := by
        gcongr
      _ = (1 - (q : ℝ)) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ) * ρ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hstart, ← hend]
        ring
  have hR : 0 < R := (norm_nonneg u).trans_lt hu
  have huSq : ‖u‖ ^ 2 < R ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg u) hR.le).2 hu
  have hρSq : ρ ^ 2 < R ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hρ.le hR.le).2 hρR
  have hweighted :
      (1 - (q : ℝ)) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ) * ρ ^ 2 < R ^ 2 := by
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := q.property.1
    have hq1 : (q : ℝ) ≤ 1 := q.property.2
    have hleft : ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (‖u‖ ^ 2) (ρ ^ 2) := le_max_left _ _
    have hright : ρ ^ 2 ≤ max (‖u‖ ^ 2) (ρ ^ 2) := le_max_right _ _
    calc
      (1 - (q : ℝ)) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ) * ρ ^ 2 ≤
          (1 - (q : ℝ)) * max (‖u‖ ^ 2) (ρ ^ 2) +
            (q : ℝ) * max (‖u‖ ^ 2) (ρ ^ 2) := by
        gcongr
      _ = max (‖u‖ ^ 2) (ρ ^ 2) := by ring
      _ < R ^ 2 := max_lt huSq hρSq
  exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hR.le).1 (hcurveSq.trans_lt hweighted)

name: Submission.norm_saddleNegativeArcToBoundaryParam_lt
statement:
theorem norm_saddleNegativeArcToBoundaryParam_lt
    (b e : SaddleBranch) {ρ a R : ℝ} (u : E₂)
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(a ^ 2))
    (hsign : 0 < signedBranch b (u 1))
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hu : ‖u‖ < R) (hρR : ρ < R) (q : I) :
    ‖saddleNegativeArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖ < R
proof:
:= by
  let s₁ := signedBranch e (saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a)
  have hclass :=
    eq_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc_of_signedBranch b a u hquad hsign
  have hstart : ‖u‖ ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + 2 * (u 0) ^ 2 := by
    calc
      ‖u‖ ^ 2 = ‖pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc b a (u 0))‖ ^ 2 :=
        congrArg (fun z : E₂ => ‖z‖ ^ 2) hclass
      _ = a ^ 2 + 2 * (u 0) ^ 2 :=
        norm_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc_sq b a (u 0)
  have hend : a ^ 2 + 2 * s₁ ^ 2 = ρ ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [s₁]
    rw [signedBranch_sq, saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)]
    ring
  have hcoord := saddleAffineCoordinate_sq_le (u 0) s₁ q
  have hcurve := norm_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc_sq b a
    (saddleAffineCoordinate (u 0) s₁ q)
  have hcurveSq :
      ‖saddleNegativeArcToBoundaryParam b e ρ a u q‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (1 - (q : ℝ)) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ) * ρ ^ 2 := by
    change ‖pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc b a
      (saddleAffineCoordinate (u 0) s₁ q))‖ ^ 2 ≤ _
    calc
      ‖pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc b a
          (saddleAffineCoordinate (u 0) s₁ q))‖ ^ 2 =
          a ^ 2 + 2 * saddleAffineCoordinate (u 0) s₁ q ^ 2 := hcurve
      _ ≤ a ^ 2 + 2 *
          ((1 - (q : ℝ)) * (u 0) ^ 2 + (q : ℝ) * s₁ ^ 2) := by
        gcongr
      _ = (1 - (q : ℝ)) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ) * ρ ^ 2 := by
        rw [hstart, ← hend]
        ring
  have hR : 0 < R := (norm_nonneg u).trans_lt hu
  have huSq : ‖u‖ ^ 2 < R ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg u) hR.le).2 hu
  have hρSq : ρ ^ 2 < R ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ hρ.le hR.le).2 hρR
  have hweighted :
      (1 - (q : ℝ)) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ) * ρ ^ 2 < R ^ 2 := by
    have hq0 : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := q.property.1
    have hq1 : (q : ℝ) ≤ 1 := q.property.2
    have hleft : ‖u‖ ^ 2 ≤ max (‖u‖ ^ 2) (ρ ^ 2) := le_max_left _ _
    have hright : ρ ^ 2 ≤ max (‖u‖ ^ 2) (ρ ^ 2) := le_max_right _ _
    calc
      (1 - (q : ℝ)) * ‖u‖ ^ 2 + (q : ℝ) * ρ ^ 2 ≤
          (1 - (q : ℝ)) * max (‖u‖ ^ 2) (ρ ^ 2) +
            (q : ℝ) * max (‖u‖ ^ 2) (ρ ^ 2) := by
        gcongr
      _ = max (‖u‖ ^ 2) (ρ ^ 2) := by ring
      _ < R ^ 2 := max_lt huSq hρSq
  exact (sq_lt_sq₀ (norm_nonneg _) hR.le).1 (hcurveSq.trans_lt hweighted)

name: Submission.fderiv_morseQuadratic_morseLevelTangent
statement:
theorem fderiv_morseQuadratic_morseLevelTangent
    (e : MorseIndexTwo) (c : ℝ) (u : E₂) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => c + morseQuadratic e (z 0, z 1)) u
      (morseLevelTangent e u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let p0 : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  have hp0 : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E₂ => z 0) p0 u := by
    simpa [p0] using (p0.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt p0 p0 u)
  have hp1 : HasFDerivAt (fun z : E₂ => z 1) p1 u := by
    simpa [p1] using (p1.hasFDerivAt : HasFDerivAt p1 p1 u)
  have hc : HasFDerivAt (fun _ : E₂ => c) (0 : E₂ →L[ℝ] ℝ) u :=
    hasFDerivAt_const c u
  cases e with
  | minimum =>
      simp only [morseQuadratic, pow_two]
      have hmodel := hc.add ((hp0.mul hp0).add (hp1.mul hp1))
      change HasFDerivAt (fun z : E₂ => c +
        (z 0 * z 0 + z 1 * z 1)) _ u at hmodel
      change (fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => c +
        (z 0 * z 0 + z 1 * z 1)) u)
          (morseLevelTangent .minimum u) = 0
      rw [hmodel.fderiv]
      simp [morseLevelTangent, p0, p1]
      ring
  | saddle =>
      simp only [morseQuadratic, pow_two]
      have hmodel := hc.add ((hp0.mul hp0).sub (hp1.mul hp1))
      change HasFDerivAt (fun z : E₂ => c +
        (z 0 * z 0 - z 1 * z 1)) _ u at hmodel
      change (fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => c +
        (z 0 * z 0 - z 1 * z 1)) u)
          (morseLevelTangent .saddle u) = 0
      rw [hmodel.fderiv]
      simp [morseLevelTangent, p0, p1]
      ring
  | maximum =>
      simp only [morseQuadratic, pow_two]
      have hmodel := hc.add ((hp0.mul hp0).neg.sub (hp1.mul hp1))
      change HasFDerivAt (fun z : E₂ => c +
        (-(z 0 * z 0) - z 1 * z 1)) _ u at hmodel
      change (fderiv ℝ (fun z : E₂ => c +
        (-(z 0 * z 0) - z 1 * z 1)) u)
          (morseLevelTangent .maximum u) = 0
      rw [hmodel.fderiv]
      simp [morseLevelTangent, p0, p1]
      ring

name: Submission.morseLevelTangent_ne_zero
statement:
theorem morseLevelTangent_ne_zero (e : MorseIndexTwo) {u : E₂} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    morseLevelTangent e u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> intro hzero <;> apply hu <;> ext i <;> fin_cases i
  all_goals
    have h0 := congrArg (fun z : E₂ => z 0) hzero
    have h1 := congrArg (fun z : E₂ => z 1) hzero
    simp [morseLevelTangent] at h0 h1 ⊢
    assumption

name: Submission.morseLevelTangent_ne_zero_of_morseQuadratic_ne_zero
statement:
theorem morseLevelTangent_ne_zero_of_morseQuadratic_ne_zero
    (e : MorseIndexTwo) (u : E₂)
    (hquad : morseQuadratic e (u 0, u 1) ≠ 0) :
    morseLevelTangent e u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply morseLevelTangent_ne_zero e
  intro hu
  subst u
  cases e <;> simp [morseQuadratic] at hquad

name: Submission.LocalMorseNormalForm.exists_param_injOn_ball_of_fderiv_injective
statement:
theorem exists_param_injOn_ball_of_fderiv_injective
    {f : E₂ → ℝ} (M : LocalMorseNormalForm f)
    (hJinj : Injective (fderiv ℝ M.param 0))
    {r₀ : ℝ} (hr₀ : 0 < r₀) :
    ∃ r > 0, r ≤ r₀ ∧ Set.InjOn M.param (ball (0 : E₂) r)
proof:
:= by
  let J : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂ := fderiv ℝ M.param 0
  have hJsurj : Surjective J :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank rfl).1 hJinj
  let e : E₂ ≃L[ℝ] E₂ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective J
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hJinj) (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hJsurj)
  have he : (e : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) = J := rfl
  have hfd : HasFDerivAt M.param (e : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) 0 := by
    rw [he]
    exact (M.param_contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have hs : HasStrictFDerivAt M.param (e : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) 0 :=
    M.param_contDiffAt.hasStrictFDerivAt' hfd (by simp)
  let inv : E₂ → E₂ := hs.localInverse M.param e 0
  let L : Set E₂ := {u | inv (M.param u) = u}
  have hL : L ∈ nhds (0 : E₂) := by
    exact hs.eventually_left_inverse
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hL
  let r := min δ r₀
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hδ hr₀
  refine ⟨r, hr, min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro u hu v hv huv
  have huδ : u ∈ ball (0 : E₂) δ :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ r₀) hu
  have hvδ : v ∈ ball (0 : E₂) δ :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball (min_le_left δ r₀) hv
  have huL : inv (M.param u) = u := hball huδ
  have hvL : inv (M.param v) = v := hball hvδ
  calc
    u = inv (M.param u) := huL.symm
    _ = inv (M.param v) := congrArg inv huv
    _ = v := hvL

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.param_injOn_domain
statement:
theorem param_injOn_domain {C : FramedLevelCobordism n}
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) : Set.InjOn P.param P.domain
proof:
:= by
  intro u hu v hv huv
  calc
    u = P.recoveryCoordinates (P.param u - P.center) :=
      (P.recoveryCoordinates_param_sub_center hu).symm
    _ = P.recoveryCoordinates (P.param v - P.center) := by rw [huv]
    _ = v := P.recoveryCoordinates_param_sub_center hv

name: Submission.continuous_spacePart
statement: theorem continuous_spacePart : Continuous (spacePart (n := n))
proof:
:= by

    { toFun := spacePart
      map_add' := by
        intro x y
        ext i
        rfl
      map_smul' := by
        intro c x
        ext i
        rfl }
  let Lc : E' →L[ℝ] E₁ := L.mkContinuous 1 (by
    intro x
    simpa [L] using norm_spacePart_le (n := n) x)
  change Continuous (Lc : E' → E₁)
  exact Lc.continuous

name: Submission.TamedField.continuousMap_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem continuousMap_mem_orbit {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    (γ : C(I, E₁)) (hγfiber : ∀ u, γ u ∈ X.fiber)
    (u : I) : γ u ∈ V.orbit (γ 0)
proof:
:= by
  let γreal : ℝ → E₁ :=
    fun t => γ (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one t)
  have hγreal : Continuous γreal :=
    γ.continuous.comp continuous_projIcc
  have hγrealFiber : ∀ t, γreal t ∈ X.fiber :=
    fun t => hγfiber (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one t)
  have h := V.continuousCurve_mem_orbit γreal hγreal hγrealFiber (u : ℝ)

name: Submission.saddleSegmentCoordinate_sq_le
statement:
theorem saddleSegmentCoordinate_sq_le (ρ a : ℝ) (u : I) :
    saddleSegmentCoordinate ρ a u ^ 2 ≤
      saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ (u : ℝ) := u.property.1
  have hu1 : (u : ℝ) ≤ 1 := u.property.2
  have hc : (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  rw [saddleSegmentCoordinate, mul_pow]
  calc
    (2 * (u : ℝ) - 1) ^ 2 * saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a ^ 2 ≤
        1 * saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc (sq_nonneg _)
    _ = saddleBoundaryParameter ρ a ^ 2 := one_mul _

name: Submission.norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_le
statement:
theorem norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_le
    (b : SaddleBranch) {ρ a : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (u : I) :
    ‖saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ a u‖ ≤ ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord := saddleSegmentCoordinate_sq_le ρ a u
  have hboundary := saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)
  have hsq := norm_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc_sq b a
    (saddleSegmentCoordinate ρ a u)
  have hsqle : ‖saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ a u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 := by
    change ‖pairToMorseParam
      (saddlePositiveArc b a (saddleSegmentCoordinate ρ a u))‖ ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2
    rw [hsq]
    rw [hboundary] at hcoord
    nlinarith
  by_contra hnot
  have hgt : ρ < ‖saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ a u‖ := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hprod : 0 <
      (‖saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ a u‖ - ρ) *
        (‖saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ a u‖ + ρ) :=
    mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hgt)
      (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (norm_nonneg _) hρ)
  nlinarith

name: Submission.norm_saddleNegativeSegmentParam_le
statement:
theorem norm_saddleNegativeSegmentParam_le
    (b : SaddleBranch) {ρ a : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ)
    (ha : a ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (u : I) :
    ‖saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ a u‖ ≤ ρ
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord := saddleSegmentCoordinate_sq_le ρ a u
  have hboundary := saddleBoundaryParameter_sq (le_of_lt ha)
  have hsq := norm_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc_sq b a
    (saddleSegmentCoordinate ρ a u)
  have hsqle : ‖saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ a u‖ ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2 := by
    change ‖pairToMorseParam
      (saddleNegativeArc b a (saddleSegmentCoordinate ρ a u))‖ ^ 2 ≤ ρ ^ 2
    rw [hsq]
    rw [hboundary] at hcoord
    nlinarith
  by_contra hnot
  have hgt : ρ < ‖saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ a u‖ := lt_of_not_ge hnot
  have hprod : 0 <
      (‖saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ a u‖ - ρ) *
        (‖saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ a u‖ + ρ) :=
    mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hgt)
      (add_pos_of_nonneg_of_pos (norm_nonneg _) hρ)
  nlinarith

name: Submission.saddleBoundaryTrackAmplitude_sq_lt
proof:
:= by
  have hu0 : 0 ≤ (u : ℝ) := u.property.1
  have hu1 : (u : ℝ) ≤ 1 := u.property.2
  have huSq : (u : ℝ) ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  have hmul : (u : ℝ) ^ 2 * A ^ 2 ≤ A ^ 2 := by
    simpa only [one_mul] using
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right huSq (sq_nonneg A)
  rw [saddleBoundaryTrackAmplitude, mul_pow]

name: Submission.SpatiallyRegularZeroPath.fiber

name: Submission.SpatiallyRegularZeroPath.pos_iff
statement:

    {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    (γ : SpatiallyRegularZeroPath C.cobordism.G x y) :

proof:
:= by
