name: Submission.loopClassZ2_relative_saddle_splice
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_relative_saddle_splice {m : ℕ}
    (γ₁ γ₂ γhat exterior₁ exterior₂ local₁ local₂ localhat :
      C(I, SOGroup m))
    (hγ₁ : γ₁ 0 = γ₁ 1) (hγ₂ : γ₂ 0 = γ₂ 1)
    (hγhat : γhat 0 = γhat 1)
    (hext₁ : exterior₁ 0 = exterior₁ 1)
    (hext₂ : exterior₂ 0 = exterior₂ 1)
    (hloc₁ : local₁ 0 = local₁ 1)
    (hloc₂ : local₂ 0 = local₂ 1)
    (hlochat : localhat 0 = localhat 1)
    (H₁ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy γ₁ (exterior₁ * local₁))
    (H₂ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy γ₂ (exterior₂ * local₂))
    (Hhat : ContinuousMap.Homotopy γhat
      ((exterior₁ * exterior₂) * localhat))
    (H₁_closed : ∀ s : I, H₁ (s, 0) = H₁ (s, 1))
    (H₂_closed : ∀ s : I, H₂ (s, 0) = H₂ (s, 1))
    (Hhat_closed : ∀ s : I, Hhat (s, 0) = Hhat (s, 1))
    (hlocal : loopClassZ2 localhat hlochat =
      loopClassZ2 local₁ hloc₁ + loopClassZ2 local₂ hloc₂ + 1) :
    loopClassZ2 γhat hγhat =
      loopClassZ2 γ₁ hγ₁ + loopClassZ2 γ₂ hγ₂ + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hextprod : (exterior₁ * exterior₂) 0 =
      (exterior₁ * exterior₂) 1 := by
    change exterior₁ 0 * exterior₂ 0 = exterior₁ 1 * exterior₂ 1
    rw [hext₁, hext₂]
  have hprod₁ : (exterior₁ * local₁) 0 = (exterior₁ * local₁) 1 := by
    change exterior₁ 0 * local₁ 0 = exterior₁ 1 * local₁ 1
    rw [hext₁, hloc₁]
  have hprod₂ : (exterior₂ * local₂) 0 = (exterior₂ * local₂) 1 := by
    change exterior₂ 0 * local₂ 0 = exterior₂ 1 * local₂ 1
    rw [hext₂, hloc₂]
  have hprodhat : ((exterior₁ * exterior₂) * localhat) 0 =
      ((exterior₁ * exterior₂) * localhat) 1 := by
    change (exterior₁ 0 * exterior₂ 0) * localhat 0 =
      (exterior₁ 1 * exterior₂ 1) * localhat 1
    rw [hext₁, hext₂, hlochat]
  have hc₁ : loopClassZ2 γ₁ hγ₁ =
      loopClassZ2 exterior₁ hext₁ + loopClassZ2 local₁ hloc₁ := by
    rw [loopClassZ2_congr hγ₁ hprod₁ H₁ H₁_closed]
    exact loopClassZ2_mul exterior₁ local₁ hext₁ hloc₁ hprod₁
  have hc₂ : loopClassZ2 γ₂ hγ₂ =
      loopClassZ2 exterior₂ hext₂ + loopClassZ2 local₂ hloc₂ := by
    rw [loopClassZ2_congr hγ₂ hprod₂ H₂ H₂_closed]
    exact loopClassZ2_mul exterior₂ local₂ hext₂ hloc₂ hprod₂
  have hchat : loopClassZ2 γhat hγhat =
      (loopClassZ2 exterior₁ hext₁ + loopClassZ2 exterior₂ hext₂) +
        loopClassZ2 localhat hlochat := by
    rw [loopClassZ2_congr hγhat hprodhat Hhat Hhat_closed]
    rw [loopClassZ2_mul (exterior₁ * exterior₂) localhat
      hextprod hlochat hprodhat]
    rw [loopClassZ2_mul exterior₁ exterior₂ hext₁ hext₂ hextprod]
  rw [hc₁, hc₂, hchat, hlocal]
  abel

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_relative_saddle_splice_of_contract
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_relative_saddle_splice_of_contract {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    (γ₁ γ₂ γhat exterior₁ exterior₂ : C(I, SOGroup m))
    (hγ₁ : γ₁ 0 = γ₁ 1) (hγ₂ : γ₂ 0 = γ₂ 1)
    (hγhat : γhat 0 = γhat 1)
    (hext₁ : exterior₁ 0 = exterior₁ 1)
    (hext₂ : exterior₂ 0 = exterior₂ 1)
    (S : SaddleModelContract)
    (H₁ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy γ₁
      (exterior₁ * S.incoming₁.frame m))
    (H₂ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy γ₂
      (exterior₂ * S.incoming₂.frame m))
    (Hhat : ContinuousMap.Homotopy γhat
      ((exterior₁ * exterior₂) * S.outgoing.frame m))
    (H₁_closed : ∀ s : I, H₁ (s, 0) = H₁ (s, 1))
    (H₂_closed : ∀ s : I, H₂ (s, 0) = H₂ (s, 1))
    (Hhat_closed : ∀ s : I, Hhat (s, 0) = Hhat (s, 1)) :
    loopClassZ2 γhat hγhat =
      loopClassZ2 γ₁ hγ₁ + loopClassZ2 γ₂ hγ₂ + 1
proof:
:= by
  exact loopClassZ2_relative_saddle_splice
    γ₁ γ₂ γhat exterior₁ exterior₂
    (S.incoming₁.frame m) (S.incoming₂.frame m) (S.outgoing.frame m)
    hγ₁ hγ₂ hγhat hext₁ hext₂
    (S.incoming₁.frame_closed m) (S.incoming₂.frame_closed m)
    (S.outgoing.frame_closed m) H₁ H₂ Hhat H₁_closed H₂_closed Hhat_closed
    (S.frame_class_splice hm)

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitFrameClass_relative_saddle_splice
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_relative_saddle_splice {n : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ n + 1)
    {Xbefore Xafter : FramedLevelSet n}
    (Vbefore : TamedField Xbefore) (Vafter : TamedField Xafter)
    (O₁ O₂ : Vbefore.OrbitIndex) (Ohat : Vafter.OrbitIndex)
    (exterior₁ exterior₂ : C(I, SOGroup (n + 1)))
    (hext₁ : exterior₁ 0 = exterior₁ 1)
    (hext₂ : exterior₂ 0 = exterior₂ 1)
    (S : SaddleModelContract)
    (H₁ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop O₁)
      (exterior₁ * S.incoming₁.frame (n + 1)))
    (H₂ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop O₂)
      (exterior₂ * S.incoming₂.frame (n + 1)))
    (Hhat : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (Vafter.orbitFrameLoop Ohat)
      ((exterior₁ * exterior₂) * S.outgoing.frame (n + 1)))
    (H₁_closed : ∀ s : I, H₁ (s, 0) = H₁ (s, 1))
    (H₂_closed : ∀ s : I, H₂ (s, 0) = H₂ (s, 1))
    (Hhat_closed : ∀ s : I, Hhat (s, 0) = Hhat (s, 1)) :
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
      Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + 1
proof:
:= by
  exact loopClassZ2_relative_saddle_splice_of_contract hm
    (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop O₁) (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop O₂)
    (Vafter.orbitFrameLoop Ohat) exterior₁ exterior₂
    (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop_closed O₁) (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop_closed O₂)
    (Vafter.orbitFrameLoop_closed Ohat) hext₁ hext₂ S
    H₁ H₂ Hhat H₁_closed H₂_closed Hhat_closed

name: Submission.TamedField.saddleOfFn_perm_of_equiv
statement:
private theorem saddleOfFn_perm_of_equiv
    {α : Type*} {p q : ℕ}
    (e : Fin p ≃ Fin q)
    (f : Fin p → α) (g : Fin q → α)
    (hfg : ∀ i, f i = g (e i)) :
    (List.ofFn f).Perm (List.ofFn g)
proof:
:= by
  have hpq : p = q := by
    simpa using Fintype.card_congr e
  subst q
  have hfun : f = g ∘ e := by
    funext i
    exact hfg i
  rw [hfun]
  simpa using Equiv.Perm.ofFn_comp_perm e g

name: Submission.TamedField.saddleEnumeratedValues_perm_of_equiv
statement:
private theorem saddleEnumeratedValues_perm_of_equiv
    {α β γ : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (e : α ≃ β) (f : α → γ) (g : β → γ)
    (hfg : ∀ a, f a = g (e a)) :
    (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card α) =>
      f ((Fintype.equivFin α).symm i)).Perm
    (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card β) =>
      g ((Fintype.equivFin β).symm i))
proof:
:= by
  apply saddleOfFn_perm_of_equiv
    ((Fintype.equivFin α).symm.trans (e.trans (Fintype.equivFin β)))
  intro i
  simpa using hfg ((Fintype.equivFin α).symm i)

name: Submission.TamedField.saddleEnumeratedOptionValues_perm_cons
statement:
private theorem saddleEnumeratedOptionValues_perm_cons
    {α γ : Type*} [Fintype α] (head : γ) (f : α → γ) :
    (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card (Option α)) =>
      (Fintype.equivFin (Option α)).symm i |>.elim head f).Perm
    (head :: List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card α) =>
      f ((Fintype.equivFin α).symm i))
proof:
:= by
  let eα := Fintype.equivFin α
  let eOption := Fintype.equivFin (Option α)
  let sigmaEquiv : Fin (Fintype.card (Option α)) ≃
      Fin (Fintype.card α + 1) :=
    eOption.symm.trans
      ((Equiv.optionCongr eα).trans (finSuccEquiv (Fintype.card α)).symm)
  let g : Fin (Fintype.card α + 1) → γ := fun i =>
    (Equiv.optionCongr eα.symm
      (finSuccEquiv (Fintype.card α) i)).elim head f
  have hperm := saddleOfFn_perm_of_equiv sigmaEquiv
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card (Option α)) =>
      (eOption.symm i).elim head f) g (by
        intro i
        cases hO : eOption.symm i <;>
          simp [sigmaEquiv, g, hO, Equiv.optionCongr])
  refine hperm.trans (List.Perm.of_eq ?_)
  rw [List.ofFn_succ]
  congr 1

name: Submission.TamedField.selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_option_equiv_at
statement:
theorem selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_option_equiv_at
    (A B : Set (Set E)) (β : ZMod 2)
    (e : Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A) ≃ W.SelectedOrbitIndex B)
    (hnone : W.orbitFrameClass (e none).1 = β)
    (hsome : ∀ O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A,
      V.orbitFrameClass O.1 = W.orbitFrameClass (e (some O)).1) :
    (W.selectedFrameLedger B).Perm (β :: V.selectedFrameLedger A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A) → ZMod 2 := fun O =>
    O.elim β (fun P => V.orbitFrameClass P.1)
  let g : W.SelectedOrbitIndex B → ZMod 2 := fun O =>
    W.orbitFrameClass O.1
  have hequiv :
      (List.ofFn fun i : Fin
          (Fintype.card (Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A))) =>
        f ((Fintype.equivFin (Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A))).symm i)).Perm
      (W.selectedFrameLedger B) := by
    unfold selectedFrameLedger
    apply saddleEnumeratedValues_perm_of_equiv e f g
    intro O
    cases O with
    | none => exact hnone.symm
    | some O => exact hsome O
  have hcons :
      (List.ofFn fun i : Fin
          (Fintype.card (Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A))) =>
        f ((Fintype.equivFin (Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A))).symm i)).Perm
      (β :: V.selectedFrameLedger A) := by
    unfold selectedFrameLedger
    simpa [f] using saddleEnumeratedOptionValues_perm_cons
      (α := V.SelectedOrbitIndex A) β
      (fun O => V.orbitFrameClass O.1)
  exact hequiv.symm.trans hcons

name: Submission.TamedField.selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_distinguished_at
statement:
theorem selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_distinguished_at
    (B : Set (Set E)) (new : V.SelectedOrbitIndex B) :
    (V.selectedFrameLedger B).Perm
      (V.orbitFrameClass new.1 ::
        V.selectedFrameLedger
          (B \ {((new.1 : V.OrbitIndex) : Set E)}))
proof:
:= by
  let e : V.SelectedOrbitIndex
        (B \ {((new.1 : V.OrbitIndex) : Set E)}) ≃
      {O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex B // O ≠ new} :=
    V.selectedOrbitIndexSdiffSingletonEquiv B new
  let eOption : Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex
        (B \ {((new.1 : V.OrbitIndex) : Set E)})) ≃
      V.SelectedOrbitIndex B :=
    (Equiv.optionCongr e).trans (Equiv.optionSubtypeNe new)
  apply V.selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_option_equiv_at V
    (B \ {((new.1 : V.OrbitIndex) : Set E)}) B
    (V.orbitFrameClass new.1) eOption
  · rfl
  · intro O
    rfl

name: Submission.SaddleOrbitLedgerDecomposition.before_perm
statement:
theorem before_perm
    (D : SaddleOrbitLedgerDecomposition Vbefore Vafter before after) :
    (Vbefore.selectedFrameLedger before).Perm
      (Vbefore.orbitFrameClass D.incoming₁.1 ::
        Vbefore.orbitFrameClass D.incoming₂.1 ::
          Vbefore.selectedFrameLedger
            ((before \ {((D.incoming₁.1 : Vbefore.OrbitIndex) :
                Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))}) \
              {((D.incoming₂.1 : Vbefore.OrbitIndex) :
                Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))}))
proof:

  have h₁ := Vbefore.selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_distinguished_at
    before D.incoming₁
  have h₂ := Vbefore.selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_distinguished_at
    (before \ {((D.incoming₁.1 : Vbefore.OrbitIndex) :
      Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))})
    D.incoming₂Exterior

name: Submission.SaddleOrbitLedgerDecomposition.after_perm

    (D : SaddleOrbitLedgerDecomposition Vbefore Vafter before after) :
    (Vafter.selectedFrameLedger after).Perm
      (Vafter.orbitFrameClass D.outgoing.1 ::
        Vbefore.selectedFrameLedger
          ((before \ {((D.incoming₁.1 : Vbefore.OrbitIndex) :
              Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))}) \
            {((D.incoming₂.1 : Vbefore.OrbitIndex) :
              Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))}))
proof:

  have hhead := Vafter.selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_distinguished_at
    after D.outgoing
  have htail := D.exteriorTransport.selectedFrameLedger_perm

name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleBeforeArcCoveringTwoRadiusInputs_of_endpoints

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_southPointOf_preimage_of_nonnegative_meridian
statement:
theorem exists_southPointOf_preimage_of_nonnegative_meridian
    (κ : PTCutoff S) (e : F) (he : ‖e‖ = 1) (γ : C(I, E))
    (hγ₀ : γ 0 ∈ S.positivePart) (hγ₁ : κ (γ 1) = 0)
    (hmeridian : ∀ t : I, ∃ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a ∧
      initCLM n (sphereMap S κ (γ t) : E) = a • e)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ₀ : 0 < ρ) (hρ₁ : ρ < 1) :
    ∃ t : I, (sphereMap S κ (γ t) : E) = southPointOf (ρ • e)
proof:
:= by
  let v : I → ℝ := fun t => vertC (sphereMap S κ (γ t) : E)
  have hvcont : Continuous v := by
    dsimp [v]
    exact contDiff_vertC.continuous.comp
      (continuous_subtype_val.comp
        ((map_continuous (sphereMap S κ)).comp γ.continuous))
  have hv₀ : v 0 = 1 := by
    dsimp [v]
    rw [show sphereMap S κ (γ 0) =
        SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.signedPTNorthPole from
      sphereMap_of_positivePart S κ hγ₀]
    exact vertC_eLast
  have hv₁ : v 1 = -1 := by
    dsimp [v]
    rw [show sphereMap S κ (γ 1) = southPole n from
      sphereMap_of_zero S κ hγ₁]
    exact vertC_southPole
  have hrad : 0 < 1 - ρ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsqrt₀ : 0 < Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hrad
  have hsqrtsq : (Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)) ^ 2 = 1 - ρ ^ 2 :=
    Real.sq_sqrt hrad.le
  let z : ℝ := -Real.sqrt (1 - ρ ^ 2)
  have hzmem : z ∈ Icc (v 1) (v 0) := by
    rw [hv₀, hv₁]
    dsimp [z]
    constructor <;> nlinarith
  obtain ⟨t, -, ht⟩ :=
    intermediate_value_Icc' (show (0 : I) ≤ 1 by simp)
      hvcont.continuousOn hzmem
  obtain ⟨a, ha₀, hinit⟩ := hmeridian t
  change vertC (sphereMap S κ (γ t) : E) = z at ht
  have hsplit := norm_sq_split (sphereMap S κ (γ t) : E)
  rw [UnitSphere.norm_coe, hinit, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg ha₀, he, mul_one, ht] at hsplit
  have ha : a = ρ := by
    dsimp [z] at hsplit
    nlinarith
  have hinit_target :
      initCLM n (sphereMap S κ (γ t) : E) = ρ • e := by
    rw [hinit, ha]
  have hcases :=
    (init_eq_iff (UnitSphere.norm_coe (sphereMap S κ (γ t))) (ρ • e)).mp
      hinit_target
  have htarget_norm : ‖ρ • e‖ = ρ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, he, mul_one, abs_of_pos hρ₀]
  rcases hcases with hnorth | hsouth
  · have hnorthpos : 0 < vertC (northPoint (ρ • e)) :=
      vertC_northPoint_pos (by rw [htarget_norm]; exact hρ₁)
    have hvert := ht
    rw [hnorth] at hvert
    dsimp [z] at hvert
    nlinarith
  · exact ⟨t, hsouth⟩

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.normalized_nonnegative_meridian_of_levelMap
statement:
lemma normalized_nonnegative_meridian_of_levelMap
    (κ : PTCutoff S) (e : F) {x : E} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hg : X.g x = c • e) :
    ∃ a : ℝ, 0 ≤ a ∧
      initCLM n (sphereMap S κ x : E) = a • e
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := (‖raw S κ x‖⁻¹ * κ x) * c
  refine ⟨a, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact mul_nonneg
      (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)) (κ.range x).1) hc
  · change normalizedHorizontalRaw S κ x = a • e
    rw [normalizedHorizontalRaw_eq S κ x, hg, smul_smul]

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleTargetOrbit_mem_positive
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleTargetOrbit_mem_positive
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (A : Set (Set E₁))
    (hsafe : D.ChronologicalSaddleExteriorSafe t ht)
    (hmidpoint : D.ChronologicalSaddleExteriorMidpointCapture t ht A)
    (O : {O // O ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset A})
    (hsourcePositive : (O.1 : Set E₁) ∈
      D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeCollection t ht) :
    let H
proof:
:= D.chronologicalSaddleExteriorFlowCore
      t ht A hsafe hmidpoint
    H.targetOrbit O ∈
      (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).selectedOrbitFinset
        (D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveCollection t ht) := by
  let H := D.chronologicalSaddleExteriorFlowCore
    t ht A hsafe hmidpoint
  let Sneg := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)
  let Spos := D.signedOutput.sliceSign (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
    (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
  change H.targetOrbit O ∈ H.Vpos.selectedOrbitFinset
    (Spos.positiveOrbitCollection H.Vpos)
  let p := (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop 0
  have hsourceSign : 0 < Sneg (H.Vneg.orbitPoint O.1) :=
    (Sneg.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff H.Vneg O.1).mp hsourcePositive
  have hpEq : p = cobSpaceTime (H.Vneg.orbitPoint O.1)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) := by
    change cobSpaceTime ((H.negativeParam O).curve 0) (H.t - H.ε) = _
    apply congrArg₂ cobSpaceTime
    · exact H.Vneg.intrinsicOrbitCurve_zero O.1
    · rfl
  have hstartSign : 0 < D.signedOutput p := by
    rw [hpEq]
    exact hsourceSign
  let γ : C(I, E') :=
    ⟨fun u => H.R.base.flow p ((u : ℝ) * (2 * H.ε)),
      (H.R.base.continuous_flow p).comp
        (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)⟩
  have hpFiber : H.C.G p = 0 :=
    (H.negativeParam O).exteriorAmbientLoop_fiber 0
  have hγFiber : ∀ u, D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (γ u) = 0 := by
    intro u
    exact H.R.flow_mem_fiber hpFiber _
  have hthrough : 0 < D.signedOutput (γ 1) :=
    (D.signedOutput.pos_iff_of_zeroFiber_path γ hγFiber).mp
      (by simpa [γ] using hstartSign)
  have hdouble : H.R.base.flow p (2 * H.ε) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.R.base.flow p H.ε) H.ε := by
    simpa [two_mul] using
      (congrFun (H.R.base.flow_shift p H.ε) H.ε).symm
  have hendSign : 0 < D.signedOutput
      (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O 0) H.ε) := by
    change 0 < D.signedOutput
      (H.R.base.flow (H.R.base.flow p H.ε) H.ε)
    rw [← hdouble]
    simpa [γ] using hthrough
  have hendEq : cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O 0)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) =
      H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O 0) H.ε := by
    rw [show D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht = H.t + H.ε by rfl]
    rw [← H.positiveEndpoint_time O 0]
    change cobSpaceTime
      (spacePart (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O 0) H.ε))
      (tcoord (H.R.base.flow (H.coreLoop O 0) H.ε)) = _
    exact spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hbaseSign : 0 < Spos (H.positiveCurve O 0) := by
    change 0 < D.signedOutput (cobSpaceTime (H.positiveCurve O 0)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht))
    rw [hendEq]
    exact hendSign
  apply (H.Vpos.mem_selectedOrbitFinset (H.targetOrbit O)).mpr
  rw [Spos.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff]
  have htargetPoint : H.Vpos.orbitPoint (H.targetOrbit O) ∈
      H.Vpos.orbit (H.positiveCurve O 0) := by
    rw [← H.targetOrbit_coe O, H.Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit]
    exact H.Vpos.mem_orbit_self _
  exact (Spos.pos_iff_of_mem_orbit H.Vpos
    (H.positiveCurve_mem_fiber O 0) htargetPoint).mp hbaseSign

name: Submission.TamedField.ofFn_perm_of_equiv
statement:
private theorem ofFn_perm_of_equiv
    {α : Type*} {p q : ℕ}
    (e : Fin p ≃ Fin q)
    (f : Fin p → α) (g : Fin q → α)
    (hfg : ∀ i, f i = g (e i)) :
    (List.ofFn f).Perm (List.ofFn g)
proof:
:= by
  have hpq : p = q := by
    simpa using Fintype.card_congr e
  subst q
  have hfun : f = g ∘ e := by
    funext i
    exact hfg i
  rw [hfun]
  simpa using Equiv.Perm.ofFn_comp_perm e g

name: Submission.TamedField.enumeratedValues_perm_of_equiv
statement:
private theorem enumeratedValues_perm_of_equiv
    {α β γ : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    (e : α ≃ β) (f : α → γ) (g : β → γ)
    (hfg : ∀ a, f a = g (e a)) :
    (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card α) =>
      f ((Fintype.equivFin α).symm i)).Perm
    (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card β) =>
      g ((Fintype.equivFin β).symm i))
proof:
:= by
  apply ofFn_perm_of_equiv
    ((Fintype.equivFin α).symm.trans (e.trans (Fintype.equivFin β)))
  intro i
  simpa using hfg ((Fintype.equivFin α).symm i)

name: Submission.TamedField.enumeratedOptionValues_perm_cons
statement:
private theorem enumeratedOptionValues_perm_cons
    {α γ : Type*} [Fintype α] (head : γ) (f : α → γ) :
    (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card (Option α)) =>
      (Fintype.equivFin (Option α)).symm i |>.elim head f).Perm
    (head :: List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card α) =>
      f ((Fintype.equivFin α).symm i))
proof:
:= by
  let eα := Fintype.equivFin α
  let eOption := Fintype.equivFin (Option α)
  let σ : Fin (Fintype.card (Option α)) ≃
      Fin (Fintype.card α + 1) :=
    eOption.symm.trans
      ((Equiv.optionCongr eα).trans (finSuccEquiv (Fintype.card α)).symm)
  let g : Fin (Fintype.card α + 1) → γ := fun i =>
    (Equiv.optionCongr eα.symm
      (finSuccEquiv (Fintype.card α) i)).elim head f
  have hperm := ofFn_perm_of_equiv σ
    (fun i : Fin (Fintype.card (Option α)) =>
      (eOption.symm i).elim head f) g (by
        intro i
        cases hO : eOption.symm i <;>
          simp [σ, g, hO, Equiv.optionCongr])
  refine hperm.trans (List.Perm.of_eq ?_)
  rw [List.ofFn_succ]
  congr 1

name: Submission.TamedField.selectedFrameLedger_perm_of_equiv
statement:
theorem selectedFrameLedger_perm_of_equiv
    (A B : Set (Set E))
    (e : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A ≃ W.SelectedOrbitIndex B)
    (hclass : ∀ O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A,
      V.orbitFrameClass O.1 = W.orbitFrameClass (e O).1) :
    (V.selectedFrameLedger A).Perm (W.selectedFrameLedger B)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold selectedFrameLedger
  let eV := Fintype.equivFin (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A)
  let eW := Fintype.equivFin (W.SelectedOrbitIndex B)
  apply ofFn_perm_of_equiv (eV.symm.trans (e.trans eW))
  intro i
  simpa [eV, eW] using hclass (eV.symm i)

name: Submission.TamedField.selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_option_equiv
statement:
theorem selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_option_equiv
    (A B : Set (Set E))
    (e : Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A) ≃ W.SelectedOrbitIndex B)
    (hnone : W.orbitFrameClass (e none).1 = 1)
    (hsome : ∀ O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A,
      V.orbitFrameClass O.1 = W.orbitFrameClass (e (some O)).1) :
    (W.selectedFrameLedger B).Perm (1 :: V.selectedFrameLedger A)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A) → ZMod 2 := fun O =>
    O.elim 1 (fun P => V.orbitFrameClass P.1)
  let g : W.SelectedOrbitIndex B → ZMod 2 := fun O =>
    W.orbitFrameClass O.1
  have hequiv :
      (List.ofFn fun i : Fin
          (Fintype.card (Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A))) =>
        f ((Fintype.equivFin (Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A))).symm i)).Perm
      (W.selectedFrameLedger B) := by
    unfold selectedFrameLedger
    apply enumeratedValues_perm_of_equiv e f g
    intro O
    cases O with
    | none => exact hnone.symm
    | some O => exact hsome O
  have hcons :
      (List.ofFn fun i : Fin
          (Fintype.card (Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A))) =>
        f ((Fintype.equivFin (Option (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A))).symm i)).Perm
      (1 :: V.selectedFrameLedger A) := by
    unfold selectedFrameLedger
    simpa [f] using enumeratedOptionValues_perm_cons
      (α := V.SelectedOrbitIndex A) (1 : ZMod 2)
      (fun O => V.orbitFrameClass O.1)
  exact hequiv.symm.trans hcons

name: Submission.TamedField.selectedFrameLedger_birthTrace_of_option_equiv

theorem selectedFrameLedger_birthTrace_of_option_equiv

proof:

      (1 :: V.selectedFrameLedger A) :=
    V.selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_option_equiv W A B e hnone hsome
  exact .cons (.birth _) (.cons (.perm hperm.symm) (.refl _))

name: Submission.TamedField.selectedFrameLedger_perm_cons_of_distinguished_equiv

    (A B : Set (Set E))
    (new : W.SelectedOrbitIndex B)
    (e : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A ≃
      {O : W.SelectedOrbitIndex B // O ≠ new})

name: Submission.TamedField.SelectedDeltaTransport.orbitFrameClass_eq
statement:

    {A B : Set (Set E)}
    (T : V.SelectedDeltaTransport W A B)

      W.orbitFrameClass ((selectedOrbitIndexEquiv V W T) O).1

  have h' : V.orbitFrameClass O.1 + 1 =
      W.orbitFrameClass ((selectedOrbitIndexEquiv V W T) O).1 + 1 := by

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.toExplicitScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_forward_lift
statement:
theorem toExplicitScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_forward_lift
    (r : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith K D.ambientField)
    (hsmall : ‖r‖₊ * K < 1) (u : ℝ) :
    (SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy
        (D.toExplicitScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement r K hLip hsmall)).forward
      1 (F.lift u) =
      F.lift u + r • D.displacement u
proof:
:= by
  rw [SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward_one]
  change F.lift u + r • D.ambientField (F.lift u) = _
  rw [← F.tubeLift_zero u, D.ambientField_zeroSection]

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.toExplicitScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_fixedOn
statement:
theorem toExplicitScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_fixedOn
    (r : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith K D.ambientField)
    (hsmall : ‖r‖₊ * K < 1) {A : Set E[n]}
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ A, D.ambientField x = 0) :
    (SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy
      (D.toExplicitScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement r K hLip hsmall)).FixedOn A
proof:
:= by
  apply SmallAmbientDisplacement.fixedOn_of_field_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  change r • D.ambientField x = 0
  rw [hzero x hx, smul_zero]

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.toExplicitScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_fixedOn_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem toExplicitScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_fixedOn_of_disjoint
    (r : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith K D.ambientField)
    (hsmall : ‖r‖₊ * K < 1) {A : Set E[n]}
    (hdisj : Disjoint D.supportCore A) :
    (SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy
      (D.toExplicitScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement r K hLip hsmall)).FixedOn A
proof:
:= by
  apply D.toExplicitScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_fixedOn
    r K hLip hsmall
  intro x hx
  apply D.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore
  exact fun hsupp => Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hsupp hx

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.exists_positive_ambientTrackStep_affineChord
statement:
theorem exists_positive_ambientTrackStep_affineChord
    {s t : ℝ} (G : T.SmoothSliceFrame s)
    (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (haffine : ∀ (a u : ℝ),
      T.lift (s + a * (t - s)) u =
        T.lift s u + a • T.chordDisplacement s t u)
    (hzero : ∀ x ∈ OrbitUnknottingSupport.obstacleSet V h2 O,
      (G.chordExtensionData (T := T) hs t).ambientField x = 0) :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧
      Nonempty (AmbientTrackStep T s (s + ε * (t - s)))
proof:
:= by
  let F := G.toFramedPeriodicCircle (T := T) hs
  let D := G.chordExtensionData (T := T) hs t
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, S, hfield, hforward⟩ :=
    D.exists_scaledSmallAmbientDisplacement
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ⟨{
    move := S.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy
    endpoint_lift := ?_
    fixed_obstacle := ?_
  }⟩⟩
  · intro u
    calc
      S.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.forward 1 (T.lift s u) =
          F.lift u + ε • D.displacement u := by
        change S.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.forward 1
            ((G.toFramedPeriodicCircle (T := T) hs).lift u) =
          (G.toFramedPeriodicCircle (T := T) hs).lift u +
            ε • T.chordDisplacement s t u
        exact hforward u
      _ = T.lift (s + ε * (t - s)) u := by
        change T.lift s u + ε • T.chordDisplacement s t u =
          T.lift (s + ε * (t - s)) u
        exact (haffine ε u).symm
  · apply SmallAmbientDisplacement.fixedOn_of_field_eq_zero
    intro x hx
    rw [hfield]
    change ε • D.ambientField x = 0
    rw [show D.ambientField x = 0 by
      simpa [D] using hzero x hx, smul_zero]

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingSupport.activeSet_disjoint_obstacleSet
statement:
theorem activeSet_disjoint_obstacleSet (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    Disjoint (activeSet V h2 O) (obstacleSet V h2 O)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxActive hxObstacle
  rcases hxActive with hxO | hxTargetO
  · have hxFiber : x ∈ X.fiber :=
      SmoothAmbientIsotopy.OrbitMoveFamily.orbit_subset_fiber O hxO
    obtain ⟨P, hPerase, hxP | hxTargetP⟩ :=
      Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hxObstacle
    · have hPO : P ≠ O := by simpa using (Finset.mem_erase.mp hPerase).1
      have hsets : (O : Set E) ≠ (P : Set E) := by
        intro h
        exact hPO (Subtype.ext h).symm
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
        (V.orbitFinset_pairwise_disjoint O O.property P P.property hsets)
        hxO hxP
    · exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.target_disjoint_fiber V h2 P)
        hxTargetP hxFiber
  · obtain ⟨P, hPerase, hxP | hxTargetP⟩ :=
      Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hxObstacle
    · have hxFiber : x ∈ X.fiber :=
        SmoothAmbientIsotopy.OrbitMoveFamily.orbit_subset_fiber P hxP
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.target_disjoint_fiber V h2 O)
        hxTargetO hxFiber
    · have hPO : P ≠ O := by simpa using (Finset.mem_erase.mp hPerase).1
      exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.target_disjoint V h2 hPO.symm)
        hxTargetO hxTargetP

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingSupport.exists_support_thickening
statement:
theorem exists_support_thickening (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      activeSet V h2 O ⊆ Metric.thickening δ (activeSet V h2 O) ∧
      IsOpen (Metric.thickening δ (activeSet V h2 O)) ∧
      Disjoint (closure (Metric.thickening δ (activeSet V h2 O)))
        (obstacleSet V h2 O)
proof:
:= by
  have hactive := isCompact_activeSet V h2 O
  have hobstacle := isCompact_obstacleSet V h2 O
  have hdisjoint := activeSet_disjoint_obstacleSet V h2 O
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hclosed⟩ :=
    hdisjoint.exists_cthickenings hactive hobstacle.isClosed
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, Metric.self_subset_thickening hδ _,
    Metric.isOpen_thickening, ?_⟩
  exact hclosed.mono
    (Metric.closure_thickening_subset_cthickening δ _)
    (Metric.self_subset_cthickening _)

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingSupport.exists_support_thickening_componentwise
statement:
theorem exists_support_thickening_componentwise (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      activeSet V h2 O ⊆ Metric.thickening δ (activeSet V h2 O) ∧
      IsOpen (Metric.thickening δ (activeSet V h2 O)) ∧
      ∀ P : V.OrbitIndex, P ≠ O →
        Disjoint (closure (Metric.thickening δ (activeSet V h2 O)))
            (P : Set E) ∧
          Disjoint (closure (Metric.thickening δ (activeSet V h2 O)))
            (CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 P)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hcore, hopen, hdisjoint⟩ :=
    exists_support_thickening V h2 O
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, hcore, hopen, ?_⟩
  intro P hPO
  exact ⟨hdisjoint.mono_right (source_subset_obstacleSet V h2 O P hPO),
    hdisjoint.mono_right (target_subset_obstacleSet V h2 O P hPO)⟩

name: Submission.SO2FrameGauge.rotate_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem rotate_apply_zero (θ : ℝ) (y : F) :
    rotate θ y 0 = Real.cos θ * y 0 - Real.sin θ * y 1
proof:
:= by

  ring

name: Submission.SO2FrameGauge.rotate_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem rotate_apply_one (θ : ℝ) (y : F) :
    rotate θ y 1 = Real.sin θ * y 0 + Real.cos θ * y 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [rotate, e0, e1]
  ring

name: Submission.SO2FrameGauge.rotate_apply_other
statement:
theorem rotate_apply_other (θ : ℝ) (y : F) {i : Fin (m + 2)}
    (hi0 : i ≠ 0) (hi1 : i ≠ 1) : rotate θ y i = y i
proof:
:= by
  simp [rotate, e0, e1, hi0, hi1]

name: Submission.SO2FrameGauge.rotate_neg_apply
statement: theorem rotate_neg_apply (θ : ℝ) (y : F) : rotate (-θ) (rotate θ y) = y
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    simp only [rotate_apply_zero, rotate_apply_one, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
    calc
      Real.cos θ * (Real.cos θ * y 0 - Real.sin θ * y 1) -
          -Real.sin θ * (Real.sin θ * y 0 + Real.cos θ * y 1) =
          (Real.sin θ ^ 2 + Real.cos θ ^ 2) * y 0 := by ring
      _ = y 0 := by rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq, one_mul]
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      simp only [rotate_apply_zero, rotate_apply_one, Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
      calc
        -Real.sin θ * (Real.cos θ * y 0 - Real.sin θ * y 1) +
            Real.cos θ * (Real.sin θ * y 0 + Real.cos θ * y 1) =
            (Real.sin θ ^ 2 + Real.cos θ ^ 2) * y 1 := by ring
        _ = y 1 := by rw [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq, one_mul]
    · rw [rotate_apply_other _ _ hi0 hi1, rotate_apply_other _ _ hi0 hi1]

name: Submission.SO2FrameGauge.rotate_apply_neg
statement: theorem rotate_apply_neg (θ : ℝ) (y : F) : rotate θ (rotate (-θ) y) = y
proof:
:= by
  simpa using rotate_neg_apply (-θ) y

  · subst i

  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1

name: Submission.SO2FrameGauge.rotateCLM_bijective
statement: theorem rotateCLM_bijective (θ : ℝ) : Bijective (rotateCLM (m := m) θ)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro x y hxy
    change rotate θ x = rotate θ y at hxy
    have h := congrArg (rotate (-θ)) hxy
    simpa only [rotate_neg_apply] using h
  · intro y
    refine ⟨rotate (-θ) y, ?_⟩
    change rotate θ (rotate (-θ) y) = y
    exact rotate_apply_neg θ y

name: Submission.homeoIccQuot_coe_of_mem_Ico
statement:
private theorem homeoIccQuot_coe_of_mem_Ico (x : ℝ)
    (hx : x ∈ Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) (0 + 1)) :
    AddCircle.homeoIccQuot (1 : ℝ) 0 (x : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) =
      Quot.mk (AddCircle.EndpointIdent (1 : ℝ) 0)
        ⟨x, Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hx⟩
proof:
:= by
  change AddCircle.equivIccQuot (1 : ℝ) 0
      (x : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) = _
  have h := congrFun
    (AddCircle.equivIccQuot_comp_mk_eq_toIcoMod (p := (1 : ℝ)) (a := 0)) x
  have hmod : toIcoMod (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num) 0 x = x :=
    (toIcoMod_eq_self (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)).mpr hx
  calc
    AddCircle.equivIccQuot (1 : ℝ) 0 (x : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) =
        Quot.mk (AddCircle.EndpointIdent (1 : ℝ) 0)
          ⟨toIcoMod (show (0 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num) 0 x,
            Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self (toIcoMod_mem_Ico _ _ x)⟩ := by
      simpa using h
    _ = Quot.mk (AddCircle.EndpointIdent (1 : ℝ) 0)
          ⟨x, Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self hx⟩ := by
      congr 1
      exact Subtype.ext hmod

name: Submission.closedHomotopyOnAddCircle_coe
statement:
theorem closedHomotopyOnAddCircle_coe
    {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    {f g : C(I, Y)} (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy f g)
    (hclosed : ∀ s : I, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1))
    (s u : I) :
    closedHomotopyOnAddCircle H hclosed (s, ((u : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) =
      H (s, u)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hu : (u : ℝ) = 1
  · have hu' : u = (1 : I) := Subtype.ext hu
    subst u
    have hcircle : ((((1 : I) : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) =
        ((((0 : I) : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) := by
      simpa using (AddCircle.coe_add_period (1 : ℝ) (0 : ℝ))
    rw [hcircle]
    simp only [closedHomotopyOnAddCircle, ContinuousMap.coe_mk]
    have hq := homeoIccQuot_coe_of_mem_Ico 0 (by norm_num)
    rw [show AddCircle.homeoIccQuot (1 : ℝ) 0
        ((((0 : I) : ℝ) : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))) =
          Quot.mk (AddCircle.EndpointIdent (1 : ℝ) 0)
            ⟨(0 : ℝ), Set.Ico_subset_Icc_self
              (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ico 0 (0 + 1) by norm_num)⟩ by
        simpa using hq]
    change H (s, (0 : I)) = H (s, (1 : I))
    exact hclosed s
  · have huIco : (u : ℝ) ∈ Set.Ico 0 (0 + 1) :=
      ⟨u.2.1, by simpa using lt_of_le_of_ne u.2.2 hu⟩
    simp only [closedHomotopyOnAddCircle, ContinuousMap.coe_mk]
    rw [homeoIccQuot_coe_of_mem_Ico (u : ℝ) huIco]
    rfl

name: Submission.CassiniPTEndpointStability.exists_common_regular_spatial_value
statement:
theorem exists_common_regular_spatial_value
    (κ₀ : FiberSign.PTCutoff S₀) (κ₁ : FiberSign.PTCutoff S₁)
    (P₀ : FiberSign.PTCutoff.EndpointPatchLocalizer S₀ κ₀)
    (P₁ : FiberSign.PTCutoff.EndpointPatchLocalizer S₁ κ₁)
    (H : CollaredSphereHomotopy (m + 2)) :
    ∃ y : F, y ≠ 0 ∧ ‖y‖ < 1 ∧
      IsRegularValueOn
        (FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchQuotient S₀ κ₀ P₀)
        (FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchTransition S₀ κ₀ P₀) y ∧
      IsRegularValueOn
        (FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchQuotient S₁ κ₁ P₁)
        (FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchTransition S₁ κ₁ P₁) y ∧
      IsRegularValue H.horizontal y ∧
      FiberSign.PTCutoff.PatchSpatiallyRegular S₀ κ₀ P₀ y ∧
      FiberSign.PTCutoff.PatchSpatiallyRegular S₁ κ₁ P₁ y
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hsp₀⟩ :=
    FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_patchSpatiallyRegular_radius S₀ κ₀ P₀
  obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, hsp₁⟩ :=
    FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_patchSpatiallyRegular_radius S₁ κ₁ P₁
  let r : ℝ := min ε₀ (min ε₁ 1)
  have hr : 0 < r := by
    exact lt_min hε₀ (lt_min hε₁ zero_lt_one)
  obtain ⟨y, hypos, hyr, hreg₀, hreg₁, hregH⟩ :=
    FiberSign.PTCutoff.exists_common_regular_value_lt
      S₀ S₁ κ₀ κ₁ P₀ P₁ H (by omega) r hr
  have hyr₀ : ‖y‖ < ε₀ := hyr.trans_le (min_le_left ε₀ (min ε₁ 1))
  have hyr₁ : ‖y‖ < ε₁ := hyr.trans_le
    ((min_le_right ε₀ (min ε₁ 1)).trans (min_le_left ε₁ 1))
  have hyrOne : ‖y‖ < 1 := hyr.trans_le
    ((min_le_right ε₀ (min ε₁ 1)).trans (min_le_right ε₁ 1))
  exact ⟨y, norm_pos_iff.mp hypos, hyrOne, hreg₀, hreg₁, hregH,
    hsp₀ y hyr₀, hsp₁ y hyr₁⟩

name: Submission.convexComb_lt_of_lt
statement:
theorem convexComb_lt_of_lt {x y d w : ℝ} (hw0 : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1)
    (hx : x < d) (hy : y < d) : (1 - w) * x + w * y < d
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 - w) * x ≤ (1 - w) * max x y :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_left x y) (by linarith)
  have h2 : w * y ≤ w * max x y :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_max_right x y) hw0
  calc (1 - w) * x + w * y ≤ (1 - w) * max x y + w * max x y := by linarith
    _ = max x y := by ring
    _ < d := max_lt hx hy

name: Submission.lt_convexComb_of_lt
statement:
theorem lt_convexComb_of_lt {x y c w : ℝ} (hw0 : 0 ≤ w) (hw1 : w ≤ 1)
    (hx : c < x) (hy : c < y) : c < (1 - w) * x + w * y
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 - w) * min x y ≤ (1 - w) * x :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_left x y) (by linarith)
  have h2 : w * min x y ≤ w * y :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (min_le_right x y) hw0
  calc c < min x y := lt_min hx hy
    _ = (1 - w) * min x y + w * min x y := by ring
    _ ≤ (1 - w) * x + w * y := by linarith

name: Submission.definiteCircleParam_add_two_pi
statement:
theorem definiteCircleParam_add_two_pi (a theta : ℝ) :

proof:

name: Submission.chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply (rad ang : C(I, ℝ)) (rho : ℝ)
    (q : I × I) :
    chartPolarHomotopyMap rad ang rho q =
      definiteCircleParam
        ((1 - (q.1 : ℝ)) * rad q.2 + (q.1 : ℝ) * rho)
        ((1 - (q.1 : ℝ)) * ang q.2 + (q.1 : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi * (q.2 : ℝ)))

name: Submission.exists_regularHomotopy_of_chartPolarLoop
proof:
:= by
  have hpos : ∀ q : I × I,
      0 < (1 - (q.1 : ℝ)) * P.rad q.2 + (q.1 : ℝ) * rho := fun q =>
    lt_convexComb_of_lt q.1.2.1 q.1.2.2 (P.rad_pos q.2) hrho
  have hlt : ∀ q : I × I,
      (1 - (q.1 : ℝ)) * P.rad q.2 + (q.1 : ℝ) * rho < T.radius := fun q =>
    convexComb_lt_of_lt q.1.2.1 q.1.2.2 (P.rad_lt q.2) hrhorad
  refine exists_regularHomotopy_of_chartHomotopy T hrho hrhorad z
    (chartPolarHomotopyMap P.rad P.ang rho) (fun q => ?_) (fun q => ?_)
    (fun u => ?_) (fun u => ?_) (fun w => ?_)
  · rw [chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply, norm_definiteCircleParam (hpos q).le]
    exact hlt q
  · rw [chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply]
    exact definiteCircleParam_ne_zero (hpos q).ne'
  · have hq : chartPolarHomotopyMap P.rad P.ang rho (0, u) =
        definiteCircleParam (P.rad u) (P.ang u) := by
      rw [chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply]
      norm_num
    rw [hq]
    exact P.chart u
  · rw [chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply]
    norm_num
  · rw [chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply, chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply]
    have hr : ((1 : I) : ℝ) = 1 := rfl
    have h0 : ((0 : I) : ℝ) = 0 := rfl
    simp only [hr, h0, mul_zero, mul_one, P.rad_closed, P.ang_turn]
    rw [show (1 - (w : ℝ)) * (P.ang 0 + 2 * Real.pi) + (w : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) =
        ((1 - (w : ℝ)) * P.ang 0 + (w : ℝ) * 0) + 2 * Real.pi from by ring,
      definiteCircleParam_add_two_pi, mul_zero]

name: Submission.chartComplex_re
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartComplex_re (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    (chartComplex u).re = u 0
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.chartComplex_im
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartComplex_im (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    (chartComplex u).im = u 1
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.norm_chartComplex
statement:
theorem norm_chartComplex (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :
    ‖chartComplex u‖ = ‖u‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [Complex.norm_def, EuclideanSpace.norm_eq]
  congr 1
  simp [Complex.normSq, chartComplex, Fin.sum_univ_two, sq_abs]
  ring

name: Submission.continuous_chartComplex
statement: theorem continuous_chartComplex : Continuous chartComplex
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : Continuous fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => u 0 :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (0 : Fin 2)).continuous
  have h1 : Continuous fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => u 1 :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj (1 : Fin 2)).continuous
  have heq : chartComplex =
      fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
        (u 0 : ℂ) + (u 1 : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    funext u
    apply Complex.ext <;> simp [chartComplex]
  rw [heq]
  exact (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp h0).add
    ((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp h1).mul continuous_const)

name: Submission.chartComplex_ne_zero
statement:
theorem chartComplex_ne_zero {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} (hu : u ≠ 0) :
    chartComplex u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hu
  have hn := norm_chartComplex u
  rw [h, norm_zero] at hn
  exact norm_eq_zero.mp hn.symm

name: Submission.exp_chartLogLift
statement:
theorem exp_chartLogLift (g : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (hg : ∀ u : I, g u ≠ 0) (u : I) :
    Complex.exp (chartLogLift g hg u) = chartComplex (g u)
proof:
:=
  congrArg Subtype.val
    (congrFun (Complex.isCoveringMap_exp.liftPath_lifts
      (puncturedChartCurve g hg) _ _) u)

name: Submission.chartRadius_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem chartRadius_apply (g : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (u : I) : chartRadius g u = ‖g u‖
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.chartRadius_pos
statement:
theorem chartRadius_pos (g : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (hg : ∀ u : I, g u ≠ 0) (u : I) : 0 < chartRadius g u
proof:
:=
  norm_pos_iff.mpr (hg u)

name: Submission.definiteCircleParam_chartRadius_chartAngle
statement:
theorem definiteCircleParam_chartRadius_chartAngle
    (g : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (hg : ∀ u : I, g u ≠ 0) (u : I) :
    definiteCircleParam (chartRadius g u) (chartAngle g hg u) = g u
proof:
:= by
  have hexp := exp_chartLogLift g hg u
  have hnorm : ‖g u‖ = Real.exp (chartLogLift g hg u).re := by
    rw [← norm_chartComplex, ← hexp, Complex.norm_exp]
  have e0 : definiteCircleParam (chartRadius g u) (chartAngle g hg u) 0 =
      g u 0 := by
    rw [definiteCircleParam_apply_zero]
    show ‖g u‖ * Real.cos (chartLogLift g hg u).im = g u 0
    rw [hnorm, ← Complex.exp_re, hexp]
    exact chartComplex_re (g u)
  have e1 : definiteCircleParam (chartRadius g u) (chartAngle g hg u) 1 =
      g u 1 := by
    rw [definiteCircleParam_apply_one]
    show ‖g u‖ * Real.sin (chartLogLift g hg u).im = g u 1
    rw [hnorm, ← Complex.exp_im, hexp]
    exact chartComplex_im (g u)
  ext i
  fin_cases i
  · exact e0
  · exact e1

name: Submission.exists_chartAngle_turn
statement:
theorem exists_chartAngle_turn (g : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (hg : ∀ u : I, g u ≠ 0) (hcl : g 0 = g 1) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, chartAngle g hg 1 = chartAngle g hg 0 + 2 * Real.pi * k
proof:
:= by
  have h : Complex.exp (chartLogLift g hg 1) =
      Complex.exp (chartLogLift g hg 0) := by
    rw [exp_chartLogLift, exp_chartLogLift, hcl]
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := Complex.exp_eq_exp_iff_exists_int.mp h
  refine ⟨k, ?_⟩
  have hI : ((k : ℂ) * (2 * (Real.pi : ℂ) * Complex.I)) =
      ((2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I := by
    push_cast
    ring
  show (chartLogLift g hg 1).im = (chartLogLift g hg 0).im + 2 * Real.pi * k
  rw [hk, hI, Complex.add_im, Complex.mul_I_im, Complex.ofReal_re]

name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleChartBandAmbientInputs_of_chartBandPolar
statement:
theorem productionMorseSaddleChartBandAmbientInputs_of_chartBandPolar
    {a : ℕ} (KB : ProductionMorseSaddleChartBandPolarInputs a) :
    ProductionMorseSaddleChartBandAmbientInputs a
proof:
:= by
  intro C center Mev T hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
    r hr R hsafe
  obtain ⟨hmerge, hsplit⟩ :=
    KB T hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos r hr R hsafe
  refine ⟨fun hne heq => ?_, fun hne heq => ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨F, ⟨P⟩⟩ := hmerge hne heq
    obtain ⟨H, hreg, hcl⟩ :=
      exists_regularHomotopy_of_chartPolarLoop T hρ hρrad P
    exact ⟨F, H, hreg, hcl⟩
  · obtain ⟨F, ⟨P⟩⟩ := hsplit hne heq
    obtain ⟨H, hreg, hcl⟩ :=
      exists_regularHomotopy_of_chartPolarLoop T hρ hρrad P

name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleSupplies_of_chartBandPolar

name: Submission.eventually_uniform_det_pos
statement:
theorem eventually_uniform_det_pos
    {P X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P] [TopologicalSpace X]
    {m : ℕ} {K : Set X} (hK : IsCompact K)
    (A : P → X → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (hA : Continuous fun q : P × X => A q.1 q.2)
    {p₀ : P} (hpos : ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < (A p₀ x).det) :
    ∀ᶠ p in nhds p₀, ∀ x ∈ K, 0 < (A p x).det
proof:
:= by
  apply hK.eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
  intro x hx
  have hdet : Continuous fun q : P × X => (A q.1 q.2).det := by
    fun_prop
  exact hdet.continuousAt
    ((isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_id).mem_nhds (hpos x hx))

name: Submission.eventually_matrixSegment_det_pos_of_zero_eq
statement:
theorem eventually_matrixSegment_det_pos_of_zero_eq
    {m : ℕ}
    (A : C(ℝ × I, Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))
    (S : C(I, Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))
    (hzero : ∀ u, A (0, u) = S u)
    (hSpos : ∀ u, 0 < (S u).det) :
    ∀ᶠ r in nhds (0 : ℝ), ∀ q : I × I,
      0 < (matrixSegment (A (r, q.2)) (S q.2) q.1).det
proof:
:= by
  let L : ℝ → I × I → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ :=
    fun r q => matrixSegment (A (r, q.2)) (S q.2) q.1
  have hL : Continuous fun z : ℝ × (I × I) => L z.1 z.2 := by
    dsimp only [L]
    unfold matrixSegment
    fun_prop
  have hpos : ∀ q ∈ (Set.univ : Set (I × I)),
      0 < (L 0 q).det := by
    intro q _
    dsimp only [L]
    rw [hzero q.2]
    have heq : matrixSegment (S q.2) (S q.2) q.1 = S q.2 := by
      unfold matrixSegment
      module
    rw [heq]
    exact hSpos q.2
  simpa only [Set.mem_univ, forall_const] using
    (eventually_uniform_det_pos isCompact_univ L hL hpos)

name: Submission.exists_pos_radius_matrixSegment_det_pos_of_zero_eq
statement:
theorem exists_pos_radius_matrixSegment_det_pos_of_zero_eq
    {m : ℕ}
    (A : C(ℝ × I, Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))
    (S : C(I, Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))
    (hzero : ∀ u, A (0, u) = S u)
    (hSpos : ∀ u, 0 < (S u).det)
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) :
    ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ r < rho ∧ ∀ q : I × I,
      0 < (matrixSegment (A (r, q.2)) (S q.2) q.1).det
proof:
:= by
  have hevent := eventually_matrixSegment_det_pos_of_zero_eq
    A S hzero hSpos
  obtain ⟨eps, heps, heps_sub⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hevent
  let r := min (rho / 2) (eps / 2)
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min (half_pos hrho) (half_pos heps)
  have hrrho : r < rho :=
    (min_le_left (rho / 2) (eps / 2)).trans_lt (half_lt_self hrho)
  have hreps : r < eps :=
    (min_le_right (rho / 2) (eps / 2)).trans_lt (half_lt_self heps)
  refine ⟨r, hr, hrrho, ?_⟩
  apply heps_sub
  simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hr]
    using hreps

name: Submission.continuous_regularZeroRawFrameMatrix
statement:
theorem continuous_regularZeroRawFrameMatrix
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P]
    {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (z : C(P, E'))
    (hz : ∀ q, Surjective (spatialDeriv G (z q))) :
    Continuous (regularZeroRawFrameMatrix G z)
proof:
:= by
  let τ : P → ℝ := fun q => tcoord (z q)
  let x : P → E₁ := fun q => spacePart (z q)
  let A : P → Fin (n + 1) → E₁ := fun q =>
    SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G (τ q) (x q)
  have hτ : Continuous τ := continuous_tcoord.comp z.continuous
  have hx : Continuous x := continuous_spacePart.comp z.continuous
  have hA : ∀ i, Continuous fun q => A q i := by
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) i
    · change Continuous fun q => tauField (sliceMap G (τ q)) (x q)
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro q
      have hxreg : x q ∈ regularSet (sliceMap G (τ q)) :=
        spacePart_mem_regularSet_of_spatialDeriv_surjective hG (hz q)
      simpa [τ, x, Function.comp_def] using
        (continuousAt_sliceTau hG hxreg).comp
          (hτ.continuousAt.prodMk hx.continuousAt)
    · change Continuous fun q => gradVec (sliceMap G (τ q)) k (x q)
      convert (contDiff_sliceGrad hG k).continuous.comp (hτ.prodMk hx) using 1
      · apply TopologicalSpace.ext
        rfl
      · rfl
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  change Continuous fun q => WithLp.ofLp (A q i) j
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp (hA i)

name: Submission.regularZeroFrame_eq_positiveMatrixSOMap_raw
statement:
theorem regularZeroFrame_eq_positiveMatrixSOMap_raw
    {P : Type*} [TopologicalSpace P]
    {G : E' → F} (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (z : C(P, E'))
    (hz : ∀ q, Surjective (spatialDeriv G (z q))) :
    regularZeroFrame hG z hz =
      positiveMatrixSOMap (regularZeroRawFrame hG z hz)
        (regularZeroRawFrame_det_pos hG z hz)
proof:

  intro q
  apply Subtype.ext
  change rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G
        (tcoord (z q)) (spacePart (z q)))) =
    rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
      (matrixRows (rowsMatrix (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G
        (tcoord (z q)) (spacePart (z q))))))
  rw [matrixRows_rowsMatrix_eq]

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixSOMap_eq_one_of_segment_pos
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixSOMap_eq_one_of_segment_pos
    {m : ℕ}
    (M S : C(I, Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))
    (hMpos : ∀ u, 0 < (M u).det)
    (hSpos : ∀ u, 0 < (S u).det)
    (hMclosed : M 0 = M 1)
    (hSclosed : S 0 = S 1)
    (hSclass : loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap S hSpos)
      (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed S hSpos hSclosed) = 1)
    (hsegment : ∀ q : I × I,
      0 < (matrixSegment (M q.2) (S q.2) q.1).det) :
    loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap M hMpos)
        (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed M hMpos hMclosed) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hclass := loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixHomotopy_congr
    (matrixSegmentHomotopy M S) hMpos hSpos hsegment
    hMclosed hSclosed
    (matrixSegmentHomotopy_closed M S hMclosed hSclosed)
  exact hclass.trans hSclass

name: Submission.exists_pos_radius_loopClassZ2_eq_one_of_zero_eq
statement:
theorem exists_pos_radius_loopClassZ2_eq_one_of_zero_eq
    {m : ℕ}
    (A : C(ℝ × I, Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))
    (S : C(I, Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))
    (hzero : ∀ u, A (0, u) = S u)
    (hclosed : ∀ r, A (r, 0) = A (r, 1))
    (hSpos : ∀ u, 0 < (S u).det)
    (hSclosed : S 0 = S 1)
    (hSclass : loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap S hSpos)
      (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed S hSpos hSclosed) = 1)
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) :
    ∃ r, 0 < r ∧ r < rho ∧
      ∃ hMpos : ∀ u, 0 < (matrixFamilyRadiusSlice A r u).det,
        loopClassZ2
            (positiveMatrixSOMap (matrixFamilyRadiusSlice A r) hMpos)
            (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed (matrixFamilyRadiusSlice A r)
              hMpos (hclosed r)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrrho, hsegment⟩ :=
    exists_pos_radius_matrixSegment_det_pos_of_zero_eq A
      S hzero hSpos hrho
  let M := matrixFamilyRadiusSlice A r
  have hMpos : ∀ u, 0 < (M u).det := by
    intro u
    have h := hsegment (0, u)
    simpa [M, matrixFamilyRadiusSlice] using h
  have hMclosed : M 0 = M 1 := by
    exact hclosed r
  have hMsegment : ∀ q : I × I,
      0 < (matrixSegment (M q.2) (S q.2) q.1).det := by
    simpa [M, matrixFamilyRadiusSlice] using hsegment
  refine ⟨r, hr, hrrho, hMpos, ?_⟩
  exact loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixSOMap_eq_one_of_segment_pos
    M S hMpos hSpos hMclosed hSclosed hSclass hMsegment

name: Submission.exists_pos_radius_loopClassZ2_eq_one_of_zero_eq_standardBirth

            (positiveMatrixSOMap (matrixFamilyRadiusSlice A r) hMpos)
            (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed (matrixFamilyRadiusSlice A r)
              hMpos (hclosed r)) = 1

name: Submission.FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.contDiff_totalRaw
statement:
theorem contDiff_totalRaw (raw : ι → E' → ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (raw i)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (totalRaw raw)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have heq : totalRaw raw = fun v => ∑ i, raw i v := by
    funext v
    simp [totalRaw]
  rw [heq]
  exact ContDiff.sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hsmooth i)

name: Submission.FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.hasCompactSupport_totalRaw
statement:
theorem hasCompactSupport_totalRaw (raw : ι → E' → ℝ)
    (hsupp : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (raw i)) :
    HasCompactSupport (totalRaw raw)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold totalRaw
  induction (Finset.univ : Finset ι) using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa using (HasCompactSupport.zero :
      HasCompactSupport (0 : E' → ℝ))
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      simpa [Finset.sum_insert hi] using (hsupp i).add ih

name: Submission.FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.lipschitzWith_totalRaw
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_totalRaw (raw : ι → E' → ℝ) (K : ι → NNReal)
    (hlip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith (K i) (raw i)) :
    LipschitzWith (∑ i, K i) (totalRaw raw)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold totalRaw
  induction (Finset.univ : Finset ι) using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty =>
      simp
  | @insert i s hi ih =>
      rw [Finset.sum_insert hi, Finset.sum_insert hi]
      have heq : raw i + ∑ j ∈ s, raw j =
          (fun v => raw i v + ∑ j ∈ s, raw j v) := by
        funext v
        simp
      have heqTail : (∑ j ∈ s, raw j) =
          (fun v => ∑ j ∈ s, raw j v) := by
        funext v
        simp
      have ih' : LipschitzWith (∑ j ∈ s, K j)
          (fun v => ∑ j ∈ s, raw j v) := by
        rw [← heqTail]
        exact ih
      rw [heq]
      exact (hlip i).add ih'

name: Submission.FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.totalRaw_collar_zero
statement:
theorem totalRaw_collar_zero (raw : ι → E' → ℝ)
    (hcollar : ∀ i v,
      tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v → raw i v = 0) :
    ∀ v, tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v → totalRaw raw v = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  intro v hv
  rw [totalRaw, Finset.sum_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => hcollar i v hv)

name: Submission.FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.totalRaw_eq_on_core
statement:
theorem totalRaw_eq_on_core (raw : ι → E' → ℝ) (core : ι → Set E')
    (noninterference : ∀ i v, v ∈ core i → ∀ j, j ≠ i → raw j v = 0)
    (i : ι) {v : E'} (hv : v ∈ core i) :
    totalRaw raw v = raw i v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [totalRaw, Finset.sum_apply]
  calc
    ∑ j, raw j v = ∑ j, if j = i then raw i v else 0 := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j _
      by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j
        simp
      · simp [hji, noninterference i v hv j hji]
    _ = raw i v := by simp

    (hsmooth : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (raw i))
    (hcollar : ∀ i v,
      tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v → raw i v = 0)
    (noninterference : ∀ i v, v ∈ core i → ∀ j, j ≠ i → raw j v = 0)
    (K : NNReal) (hK : K < 1)
    (hlip : LipschitzWith K (totalRaw raw))

statement:
theorem ofFiniteLipschitz_eq_on_core
    (raw : ι → E' → ℝ) (core : ι → Set E')
    (hsmooth : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (raw i))
    (hcollar : ∀ i v,
      tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v → raw i v = 0)
    (noninterference : ∀ i v, v ∈ core i → ∀ j, j ≠ i → raw j v = 0)
    (K : ι → NNReal) (hK : (∑ i, K i) < 1)
    (hlip : ∀ i, LipschitzWith (K i) (raw i))
    (i : ι) {v : E'} (hv : v ∈ core i) :
    ofFiniteLipschitz raw hsmooth hcollar K hK hlip v = raw i v

name: Submission.FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.exists_small_of_finite
statement:
theorem exists_small_of_finite
    (raw : ι → E' → ℝ) (core : ι → Set E')
    (hsmooth : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (raw i))
    (hsupp : ∀ i, HasCompactSupport (raw i))
    (hcollar : ∀ i v,
      tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v → raw i v = 0)
    (noninterference : ∀ i v, v ∈ core i → ∀ j, j ≠ i → raw j v = 0) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ a : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n),
      a.toFun = (fun v => ε * totalRaw raw v) ∧
      ∀ i v, v ∈ core i → a v = ε * raw i v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, a, ha⟩ := SmallVerticalAmplitude.exists_scaled
    (totalRaw raw) (contDiff_totalRaw raw hsmooth)
      (hasCompactSupport_totalRaw raw hsupp)
      (totalRaw_collar_zero raw hcollar)
  refine ⟨ε, hε, a, ha, ?_⟩
  intro i v hv
  rw [show a.toFun v = ε * totalRaw raw v by rw [ha]]
  rw [totalRaw_eq_on_core raw core noninterference i hv]

name: Submission.SORelativeNormalization.endpointSign_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem endpointSign_apply (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} (S : FiberSign X)
    (R : ℝ → E → SOGroup n)
    (hR : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => ((R p.1 p.2 : SOGroup n) : M) i j))
    (x : E) : endpointSign A S R hR x = A.pullbackSign S x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.SORelativeNormalization.signedCobordism_productOn
statement:
theorem signedCobordism_productOn
    (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    (X : FramedLevelSet n) (S : FiberSign X)
    (R : ℝ → E → SOGroup n)
    (hR : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => ((R p.1 p.2 : SOGroup n) : M) i j))
    (hRzero : ∀ x, R 0 x = 1)
    {K : Set E} (hA : A.FixedOn K)
    (hRK : ∀ s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ K, R s x = 1) :
    (signedCobordism A X S R hR hRzero).ProductOn K X.g S
proof:
:= by
  let D := SOFrameGauge.homotopy (A.pullback X) R hR hRzero
  have hD : D.FixedOn K X.g := by
    intro s hs x hx
    change SOFrameGauge.toCLM (R s x) ((A.pullback X).g x) = X.g x
    rw [hRK s hs x hx, SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one]
    exact hA.pullback_g_eq X hx
  have hT : ∀ x ∈ K, endpointSign A S R hR x = S x := by
    intro x hx
    rw [endpointSign_apply]
    exact hA.pullbackSign_eq S hx
  apply SmoothAmbientIsotopy.signedNormalizationCobordism_productOn
    (A := A) (D := D) (S := S) (T := endpointSign A S R hR)
    (hpos := by
      intro x hx
      rfl)
  · exact hA
  · exact hD
  · exact hT

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.fderiv_localize
statement:
theorem fderiv_localize {K U : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff K U)
    {h : E' → ℝ} (hh : ContDiff ℝ ∞ h) (v : E') :
    fderiv ℝ (χ.localize h) v =
      χ v • fderiv ℝ h v + h v • fderiv ℝ χ v
proof:
:= by
  have hχ := (χ.smooth.differentiable (by simp) v).hasFDerivAt
  have hh' := (hh.differentiable (by simp) v).hasFDerivAt
  change fderiv ℝ (χ.toFun * h) v = _
  simpa [add_comm] using (hχ.mul hh').fderiv

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.fderiv_localize_affineJet
statement:
theorem fderiv_localize_affineJet {K U : Set E'}
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (A : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ) (center : E') (c : ℝ)
    (v : E') :
    fderiv ℝ (χ.localize (affineJet A center c)) v =
      χ v • A + (A (v - center) + c) • fderiv ℝ χ v
proof:
:= by
  rw [χ.fderiv_localize (contDiff_affineJet A center c)]
  have hAffine : fderiv ℝ (affineJet A center c) v = A := by
    change fderiv ℝ (fun w => A (w - center) + c) v = A
    have hinner : HasFDerivAt (fun w => A (w - center)) A v := by
      have heq : (fun w : E' => A (w - center)) =
          fun w : E' => A w - A center := by
        funext w
        exact map_sub A w center
      rw [heq]
      exact A.hasFDerivAt.sub_const (A center)
    exact (hinner.add_const c).fderiv
  rw [hAffine]
  rfl

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.eventuallyEq_localize_comp_of_eventually_mem_core
statement:
theorem eventuallyEq_localize_comp_of_eventually_mem_core
    {K U : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (h : E' → ℝ)
    (param : E₂ → E') {u : E₂}
    (hcore : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 u, param z ∈ K) :
    (χ.localize h ∘ param) =ᶠ[𝓝 u] (h ∘ param)
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [hcore] with z hz
  exact χ.localize_eq h hz

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.fderiv_localize_comp_of_eventually_mem_core
statement:
theorem fderiv_localize_comp_of_eventually_mem_core
    {K U : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff K U)
    (h : E' → ℝ) (param : E₂ → E') {u : E₂}
    (hcore : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 u, param z ∈ K) :
    fderiv ℝ (χ.localize h ∘ param) u = fderiv ℝ (h ∘ param) u
proof:
:= by
  exact (χ.eventuallyEq_localize_comp_of_eventually_mem_core h param hcore).fderiv_eq

name: Submission.isCompact_compactInteriorFiber
statement:
theorem isCompact_compactInteriorFiber (C : FramedLevelCobordism n)
    (a b : ℝ) : IsCompact (compactInteriorFiber C a b)
proof:
:= by
  exact C.isCompact_slabFiber.inter_right
    (isClosed_Icc.preimage continuous_tcoord)

name: Submission.compactInteriorFiber_subset_middle
statement:
theorem compactInteriorFiber_subset_middle
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 1 / 4 < a) (hb : b < 3 / 4) :
    compactInteriorFiber C a b ⊆
      tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rintro v ⟨_hv, ht⟩
  exact ⟨ha.trans_le ht.1, ht.2.trans_lt hb⟩

name: Submission.exists_interior_bounds_coreCriticalPoints
statement:
theorem exists_interior_bounds_coreCriticalPoints
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ,
      1 / 4 < a ∧ a < b ∧ b < 3 / 4 ∧
      coreCriticalPoints C ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set E' := coreCriticalPoints C
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_coreCriticalPoints C
  have hlower : ∀ v ∈ K, (1 / 4 : ℝ) < tcoord v := by
    intro v hv
    by_contra h
    have hreg := C.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter (le_of_not_gt h)
    exact hv.1.2 (hreg v hv.1.1 rfl)
  have hupper : ∀ v ∈ K, tcoord v < (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    intro v hv
    by_contra h
    have hreg := C.sliceRegular_of_three_quarter_le (le_of_not_gt h)
    exact hv.1.2 (hreg v hv.1.1 rfl)
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀, hamin⟩ :=
    hK.exists_forall_le' continuous_tcoord.continuousOn hlower
  obtain ⟨b₀', hb₀', hbmax'⟩ :=
    hK.exists_forall_le' (α := ℝᵒᵈ)
      continuous_tcoord.continuousOn hupper
  let b₀ : ℝ := b₀'
  have hb₀ : b₀ < (3 / 4 : ℝ) := hb₀'
  have hbmax : ∀ v ∈ K, tcoord v ≤ b₀ := by
    intro v hv
    exact hbmax' v hv
  let a : ℝ := min a₀ (3 / 8)
  let b : ℝ := max b₀ (5 / 8)
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact lt_min ha₀ (by norm_num)
  · have ha : a ≤ (3 / 8 : ℝ) := min_le_right _ _
    have hb : (5 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ b := le_max_right _ _
    linarith
  · exact max_lt hb₀ (by norm_num)
  · intro v hv
    have hva : a ≤ tcoord v :=
      (min_le_left a₀ (3 / 8)).trans (hamin v hv)
    have hvb₀ : tcoord v ≤ b₀ := hbmax v hv
    have hb₀b : b₀ ≤ b := by
      dsimp [b]
      exact le_max_left _ _
    have hvb : tcoord v ≤ b :=
      hvb₀.trans hb₀b
    exact ⟨hva, hvb⟩

name: Submission.exists_strictInterior_bounds_coreCriticalPoints
statement:
theorem exists_strictInterior_bounds_coreCriticalPoints
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ,
      1 / 4 < a ∧ a < b ∧ b < 3 / 4 ∧
      coreCriticalPoints C ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo a b
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a₀, b₀, ha₀, hab₀, hb₀, hcrit⟩ :=
    exists_interior_bounds_coreCriticalPoints C
  let a : ℝ := (1 / 4 + a₀) / 2
  let b : ℝ := (b₀ + 3 / 4) / 2
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · dsimp [a]
    linarith
  · dsimp [a, b]
    linarith
  · dsimp [b]
    linarith
  · intro v hv
    have ht := hcrit hv
    dsimp [a, b]
    constructor <;> linarith [ht.1, ht.2]

name: Submission.timeCritical_subset_strictInterior_of_coreCritical_subset
statement:
theorem timeCritical_subset_strictInterior_of_coreCritical_subset
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {a b : ℝ}
    (hcrit : coreCriticalPoints C ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo a b) :
    timeCritical C.G ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo a b
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hlower : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < tcoord v := by
    by_contra h
    exact hv.2 ((C.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter (le_of_not_gt h)) v hv.1 rfl)
  have hupper : tcoord v < (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    by_contra h
    exact hv.2
      ((C.sliceRegular_of_three_quarter_le (le_of_not_gt h)) v hv.1 rfl)
  exact hcrit ⟨hv, ⟨hlower.le, hupper.le⟩⟩

name: Submission.exists_globalCompactInteriorFiberCutoff
statement:
theorem exists_globalCompactInteriorFiberCutoff
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 1 / 4 < a) (hb : b < 3 / 4) :
    ∃ U : Set E',
      U ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ) ∧
      Nonempty (SmoothCutoff (compactInteriorFiber C a b) U)
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set E' := compactInteriorFiber C a b
  let middle : Set E' := tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ)
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_compactInteriorFiber C a b
  have hopen : IsOpen middle :=
    isOpen_Ioo.preimage contDiff_vertC.continuous
  have hsub : K ⊆ middle :=
    compactInteriorFiber_subset_middle C ha hb
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hthick⟩ :=
    hK.exists_cthickening_subset_open hopen hsub
  let U : Set E' := Metric.thickening δ K
  have hKU : K ⊆ U := Metric.self_subset_thickening hδ K
  have hUsub : U ⊆ middle :=
    (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening δ K).trans hthick
  have hUc : IsCompact (closure U) := by
    apply IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset hK.cthickening isClosed_closure
    exact closure_minimal
      (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening δ K)
      Metric.isClosed_cthickening
  refine ⟨U, hUsub, ?_⟩
  exact SmoothCutoff.exists_of_isClosed_isOpen hK.isClosed
    Metric.isOpen_thickening hKU hUc

name: Submission.exists_globalCutoff_covering_coreCriticalPoints
statement:
theorem exists_globalCutoff_covering_coreCriticalPoints
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) :
    ∃ a b : ℝ, ∃ U : Set E',
      1 / 4 < a ∧ a < b ∧ b < 3 / 4 ∧
      coreCriticalPoints C ⊆ compactInteriorFiber C a b ∧
      U ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ) ∧
      Nonempty (SmoothCutoff (compactInteriorFiber C a b) U)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, b, ha, hab, hb, hcrit⟩ :=
    exists_interior_bounds_coreCriticalPoints C
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hχ⟩ :=
    exists_globalCompactInteriorFiberCutoff C ha hb
  refine ⟨a, b, U, ha, hab, hb, ?_, hU, hχ⟩
  intro v hv
  exact ⟨coreCriticalPoints_subset_fiber C hv, hcrit hv⟩

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.eventually_mem_compactInteriorFiber
statement:
theorem eventually_mem_compactInteriorFiber
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 / 4 < a) (hb : b < 3 / 4)
    {u : E₂} (hdom : P.domain ∈ 𝓝 u)
    (ht : P.time u ∈ Ioo a b) :
    ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 u, P.param z ∈ compactInteriorFiber C a b
proof:
:= by
  have htime : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 u, P.time z ∈ Ioo a b :=
    P.contDiff_time.continuous.continuousAt (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds ht)
  filter_upwards [hdom, htime] with z hzdom hzt
  refine ⟨?_, hzt.1.le, hzt.2.le⟩
  refine ⟨P.param_fiber z hzdom, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change 0 ≤ P.time z
    exact (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4).trans
      (ha.le.trans hzt.1.le)
  · change P.time z ≤ 1
    exact hzt.2.le.trans (hb.le.trans (by norm_num : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ 1))

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.fderiv_globalCutoff_comp_eq
statement:
theorem fderiv_globalCutoff_comp_eq
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 / 4 < a) (hb : b < 3 / 4)
    {U : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff (compactInteriorFiber C a b) U)
    (h : E' → ℝ) {u : E₂} (hdom : P.domain ∈ 𝓝 u)
    (ht : P.time u ∈ Ioo a b) :
    fderiv ℝ (χ.localize h ∘ P.param) u =
      fderiv ℝ (h ∘ P.param) u
proof:
:= by
  exact χ.fderiv_localize_comp_of_eventually_mem_core h P.param
    (P.eventually_mem_compactInteriorFiber ha hb hdom ht)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.eventuallyEq_forwardAmplitude_zero_of_away
statement:
theorem eventuallyEq_forwardAmplitude_zero_of_away
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G) {v : E'}
    (haway : ∀ p : GenericMorseEvent G,
      v ∉ closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint p) (R.cutoffs.radius p)) :
    R.forwardAmplitude =ᶠ[𝓝 v] (0 : E' → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hp : ∀ p : GenericMorseEvent G,
      R.eventRaw p =ᶠ[𝓝 v] (0 : E' → ℝ) := by
    intro p
    have hopen : IsOpen
        (closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint p) (R.cutoffs.radius p))ᶜ :=
      Metric.isClosed_closedBall.isOpen_compl
    have hnhds :
        (closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint p) (R.cutoffs.radius p))ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 v :=
      hopen.mem_nhds (haway p)
    filter_upwards [hnhds] with w hw
    apply (R.cutoffs.cutoff p).localize_eq_zero _
    intro hball
    exact hw (Metric.ball_subset_closedBall hball)
  have hsum :
      (fun w : E' => ∑ p : GenericMorseEvent G, R.eventRaw p w) =ᶠ[𝓝 v]
        (0 : E' → ℝ) := by
    have hall : ∀ᶠ w in 𝓝 v,
        ∀ p : GenericMorseEvent G, R.eventRaw p w = 0 :=
      Filter.eventually_all.mpr hp
    filter_upwards [hall] with w hw
    simpa using Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun p _ => hw p)
  filter_upwards [hsum] with w hw
  change FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.totalRaw R.eventRaw w = 0
  simpa [FiniteGlobalVerticalAmplitude.totalRaw] using hw

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.eventuallyEq_amplitude_symm_identity_of_away
statement:
theorem eventuallyEq_amplitude_symm_identity_of_away
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G) {v : E'}
    (haway : ∀ p : GenericMorseEvent G,
      v ∉ closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint p) (R.cutoffs.radius p)) :
    R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm =ᶠ[𝓝 v] id
proof:
:= by
  have hzero := R.eventuallyEq_forwardAmplitude_zero_of_away haway
  filter_upwards [hzero] with w hw
  rw [R.amplitude_diffeomorph_symm,
    SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply]
  simp [verticalShift, hw]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.pullback_critical_iff_unperturbed_of_away
statement:
theorem pullback_critical_iff_unperturbed_of_away
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G) (i : ι) {u : E₂}
    (hdom : (B.chart i).domain ∈ 𝓝 u)
    (haway : ∀ p : GenericMorseEvent G,
      (B.chart i).param u ∉
        closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint p) (R.cutoffs.radius p)) :
    R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm ((B.chart i).param u) ∈
        timeCritical (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G ↔
      (B.chart i).param u ∈ timeCritical C.G
proof:
:= by
  let P := B.chart i
  have hsymm :
      (fun z : E₂ => R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 u]
        P.param := by
    have hlocal := R.eventuallyEq_amplitude_symm_identity_of_away haway
    have htend : Tendsto P.param (𝓝 u) (𝓝 (P.param u)) :=
      P.param_smooth.continuous.continuousAt
    exact (htend.eventually hlocal).mono fun z hz => by simpa using hz
  have htime :
      (fun z : E₂ => tcoord
        (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z))) =ᶠ[𝓝 u] P.time := by
    exact hsymm.fun_comp tcoord
  rw [P.pullbackParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
      R.amplitude hdom,
    P.mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero hdom]
  unfold chartGradient
  rw [htime.fderiv_eq]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.not_covered_by_criticalNormalForms_of_away
statement:
theorem not_covered_by_criticalNormalForms_of_away
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G) {v : E'}
    (haway : ∀ p : GenericMorseEvent G,
      v ∉ closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint p) (R.cutoffs.radius p)) :
    ¬ ∃ p : Σ _ : ι, E₂, ∃ hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints, ∃ u : E₂,
      ‖u‖ < (R.criticalNormalForm p hp).radius ∧
      R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
        ((B.chart p.1).param
          (p.2 + (R.criticalNormalForm p hp).param u)) = v
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨p, hp, u, hu, huv⟩
  have hu' : ‖u‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius := by
    simpa using hu
  have hball :=
    LocalMorseNormalForm.SimultaneousShrink.ift_lifted_mem
      (M := G.localMorseNormalForm p hp)
      (R.criticalModelShrink p hp) u hu'
  have hsymm : R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm v = v :=
    (R.eventuallyEq_amplitude_symm_identity_of_away haway).self_of_nhds
  have hdiffeo : R.amplitude.diffeomorph v = v := by
    have h := congrArg R.amplitude.diffeomorph hsymm
    simpa using h.symm
  have hparam :
      (B.chart p.1).param
          (p.2 + (R.criticalNormalForm p hp).param u) = v := by
    have h := congrArg R.amplitude.diffeomorph huv
    simpa [hdiffeo] using h
  apply haway ⟨p, hp⟩
  rw [← hparam]
  rw [R.criticalNormalForm_param]
  rw [mem_closedBall]
  rw [mem_ball] at hball
  have hr := R.cutoffs.radius_pos ⟨p, hp⟩
  exact hball.le.trans (by linarith)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.unperturbed_coreCritical_not_covered_of_away
statement:
theorem unperturbed_coreCritical_not_covered_of_away
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G) (i : ι) {u : E₂}
    (hdom : (B.chart i).domain ∈ 𝓝 u)
    (hcrit : (B.chart i).param u ∈ timeCritical C.G)
    (htime : tcoord ((B.chart i).param u) ∈
      Icc (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ))
    (haway : ∀ p : GenericMorseEvent G,
      (B.chart i).param u ∉
        closedBall (G.eventAmbientPoint p) (R.cutoffs.radius p)) :
    (B.chart i).param u ∈
        coreCriticalPoints (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C) ∧
      ¬ ∃ p : Σ _ : ι, E₂, ∃ hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints, ∃ w : E₂,
        ‖w‖ < (R.criticalNormalForm p hp).radius ∧
        R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
          ((B.chart p.1).param
            (p.2 + (R.criticalNormalForm p hp).param w)) =
              (B.chart i).param u
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · refine ⟨?_, htime⟩
    have hpull := (R.pullback_critical_iff_unperturbed_of_away
      (B := B.toSurfaceChartFamily) i hdom haway).2 hcrit
    have hsymm :
        R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm ((B.chart i).param u) =
          (B.chart i).param u :=
      (R.eventuallyEq_amplitude_symm_identity_of_away haway).self_of_nhds
    change R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm ((B.chart i).param u) ∈
      timeCritical (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G at hpull
    rwa [hsymm] at hpull
  · exact R.not_covered_by_criticalNormalForms_of_away haway

name: Submission.coordinateReflection_apply_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateReflection_apply_same (i : Fin n) (x : F) :
    coordinateReflection i x i = -x i
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateReflection]

name: Submission.coordinateReflection_apply_ne
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateReflection_apply_ne (i j : Fin n) (hji : j ≠ i) (x : F) :
    coordinateReflection i x j = x j
proof:
:= by
  simp [coordinateReflection, hji]

name: Submission.coordinateReflection_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateReflection_apply (i j : Fin n) (x : F) :
    coordinateReflection i x j = if j = i then -x j else x j
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : j = i
  · subst j
    simp
  · simp [h]

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.fderiv_codomainEquiv
statement:
theorem fderiv_codomainEquiv (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (e : F ≃L[ℝ] F) (x : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (X.codomainEquiv e).g x =
      e.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (fderiv ℝ X.g x)
proof:
:= by
  have hX : HasFDerivAt X.g (fderiv ℝ X.g x) x :=
    (X.smooth.differentiable infty_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt
  have he : HasFDerivAt (e : F → F) e.toContinuousLinearMap (X.g x) :=
    e.toContinuousLinearMap.hasFDerivAt
  change fderiv ℝ ((e : F → F) ∘ X.g) x = _
  exact (he.comp x hX).fderiv

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.gradVec_coordinateReflection
statement:
theorem gradVec_coordinateReflection (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (i j : Fin n) (x : E) :
    gradVec (X.codomainEquiv (coordinateReflection i)).g j x =
      if j = i then -gradVec X.g j x else gradVec X.g j x
proof:
:= by
  apply InnerProductSpace.ext_inner_right_basis
    (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).toBasis
  intro w
  rw [inner_gradVec, X.fderiv_codomainEquiv]
  by_cases h : j = i
  · subst j
    simp [inner_gradVec]
  · simp [h, inner_gradVec]

name: Submission.crossVec_update_neg
statement:
theorem crossVec_update_neg (v : Fin n → E) (i : Fin n) :
    crossVec (fun j => if j = i then -v j else v j) = -crossVec v
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext k
  change crossDet (fun j => if j = i then -v j else v j)
      (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) =
    -crossDet v (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)
  let A := crossRows v (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)
  have hrows :
      crossRows (fun j => if j = i then -v j else v j)
          (EuclideanSpace.single k 1) =
        A.updateRow i.succ ((-1 : ℝ) • A i.succ) := by
    ext r c
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ r with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · rw [Matrix.updateRow_ne (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm]
      rfl
    · by_cases hji : j = i
      · subst j
        simp [A, crossRows]
      · have hs : j.succ ≠ i.succ := fun h => hji (Fin.succ_injective _ h)
        simp [A, crossRows, hji, hs]
  change (crossRows (fun j => if j = i then -v j else v j)
      (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)).det =
    -(crossRows v (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)).det
  rw [hrows, Matrix.det_updateRow_smul]
  simp [A]

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.kerCross_coordinateReflection
statement:
theorem FramedLevelSet.kerCross_coordinateReflection
    (X : FramedLevelSet n) (i : Fin n) (x : E) :
    kerCross (X.codomainEquiv (coordinateReflection i)).g x =
      -kerCross X.g x
proof:
:= by
  unfold kerCross
  rw [show (fun j => gradVec (X.codomainEquiv (coordinateReflection i)).g j x) =
      fun j => if j = i then -gradVec X.g j x else gradVec X.g j x by
    funext j
    exact X.gradVec_coordinateReflection i j x]
  exact crossVec_update_neg _ i

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.tauField_coordinateReflection
statement:
theorem FramedLevelSet.tauField_coordinateReflection
    (X : FramedLevelSet n) (i : Fin n) (x : E) :
    tauField (X.codomainEquiv (coordinateReflection i)).g x =
      -tauField X.g x
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauField, X.kerCross_coordinateReflection, norm_neg, tauField]
  exact smul_neg _ _

name: Submission.TamedField.coordinateReflection_v
statement:
@[simp] theorem coordinateReflection_v (i : Fin n) (x : E) :
    (V.coordinateReflection i).v x = -V.v x
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.TamedField.coordinateReflection_flow
statement:
theorem coordinateReflection_flow (i : Fin n) (p : E) (t : ℝ) :
    (V.coordinateReflection i).flow p t = V.flow p (-t)
proof:
:= by
  let W := V.coordinateReflection i
  have htraj : ∀ u : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (fun z => V.flow p (-z)) (W.v (V.flow p (-u))) u := by
    intro u
    have hneg : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => -z) (-1) u := (hasDerivAt_id u).neg
    have h := (V.hasDerivAt_flow p (-u)).scomp u hneg
    change HasDerivAt (V.flow p ∘ fun z : ℝ => -z)
      (-V.v (V.flow p (-u))) u
    simpa only [neg_one_smul] using h
  have heq : W.flow p = fun u => V.flow p (-u) := by
    apply W.solution_unique (t₀ := 0)
    · exact W.hasDerivAt_flow p
    · exact htraj
    · simp
  exact congrFun heq t

name: Submission.TamedField.coordinateReflection_orbit
statement:
theorem coordinateReflection_orbit (i : Fin n) (p : E) :
    (V.coordinateReflection i).orbit p = V.orbit p
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨-t, ?_⟩
    rw [V.coordinateReflection_flow]
  · rintro ⟨t, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨-t, ?_⟩
    rw [V.coordinateReflection_flow]
    simp only [neg_neg]

name: Submission.TamedField.periodic_coordinateReflection_iff
statement:
theorem periodic_coordinateReflection_iff (i : Fin n) (p : E) (T : ℝ) :
    Function.Periodic ((V.coordinateReflection i).flow p) T ↔
      Function.Periodic (V.flow p) T
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hh := h.const_sub 0
    simpa only [zero_sub, V.coordinateReflection_flow, neg_neg] using hh
  · intro h t
    rw [V.coordinateReflection_flow, V.coordinateReflection_flow]
    simpa only [zero_sub] using h.const_sub 0 t

name: Submission.TamedField.coordinateReflection_fundamentalPeriod
statement:
theorem coordinateReflection_fundamentalPeriod (i : Fin n) {p : E}
    (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    (V.coordinateReflection i).fundamentalPeriod
        ((X.mem_fiber_codomainEquiv (Submission.coordinateReflection i)).mpr hp) =
      V.fundamentalPeriod hp
proof:
:= by
  let W := V.coordinateReflection i
  let hp' : p ∈ (X.codomainEquiv (Submission.coordinateReflection i)).fiber :=
    (X.mem_fiber_codomainEquiv (Submission.coordinateReflection i)).mpr hp
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply W.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hp' (V.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp)
    exact (V.periodic_coordinateReflection_iff i p _).mpr
      (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp)
  · apply V.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hp (W.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp')
    exact (V.periodic_coordinateReflection_iff i p _).mp
      (W.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp')

name: Submission.doubleSignCoeff_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem doubleSignCoeff_zero (i : Fin n) :

name: Submission.doubleSignCoeff_succ_same
statement:
@[simp] theorem doubleSignCoeff_succ_same (i : Fin n) :

name: Submission.doubleSignCoeff_eq_product
statement:
theorem doubleSignCoeff_eq_product (i : Fin n) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    doubleSignCoeff i j =
      (if j = 0 then -1 else 1) * (if j = i.succ then -1 else 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hne : (0 : Fin (n + 1)) ≠ i.succ := (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm
  by_cases h0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    simp [doubleSignCoeff, hne]
  · by_cases hi : j = i.succ
    · subst j
      simp [doubleSignCoeff]
    · simp [doubleSignCoeff, h0, hi]

name: Submission.doubleSignSO_coe

name: Submission.linearIndependent_rowsMatrix_iff
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_rowsMatrix_iff (v : Fin m → Em) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (rowsMatrix v).row ↔ LinearIndependent ℝ v
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : (rowsMatrix v).row = fun i => WithLp.ofLp (v i) := by
    funext i j
    rfl
