name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_rebasedMergeBandMarking_of_marking
statement:
theorem exists_rebasedMergeBandMarking_of_marking
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hflowlt : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 < eps / 2)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord center + s ^ 2 → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (hcap : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) center →
      spacePart (R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s)
          (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex p.2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hne : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg ≠
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg)
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos) Vpos)
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3)
    (hpoint : ∀ l : Fin 4, A.point l =
      spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s))
    (hsort0 : A.sortedMark 0 = 0)
    (hcut0 : A.cyclicCutRange 0 =
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hcut2 : A.cyclicCutRange 2 =
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hother : ∀ r : Fin 4, r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 → ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = s ^ 2 → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ∉ A.cyclicCutRange r)
    (hafterOrbit : Vpos.orbitPoint
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos) ∈ Vpos.orbit P.p) :
    ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
      ∃ F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg)
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg)
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos),
        F.dbefore = -(s ^ 2) ∧ F.dafter = s ^ 2 ∧ F.afterCut₃ = 1 ∧
        F.afterParam = P ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) F.afterCut₀ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        F.afterParam.curve 1 ∈
          Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) (-(s ^ 2))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) (-(s ^ 2))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) (-(s ^ 2))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s)
            (-(s ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hρM : ρ < M.radius := hρrad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have habs : |s ^ 2| = s ^ 2 := abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg s)
  have habsn : |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| = s ^ 2 := by rw [abs_neg, habs]
  
  have e1c : ((1 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (1 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e1s : ((1 : Fin 3).succ) = (2 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e2c : ((2 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (2 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e2s : ((2 : Fin 3).succ) = (3 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e0c : ((0 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (0 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e0s : ((0 : Fin 3).succ) = (1 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have elast : (Fin.last 3) = (3 : Fin 4) := by decide
  
  have hcutFib : ∀ (r : Fin 4) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
      y ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      C.G (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) = 0 := by
    intro r y hy
    rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r] at hy
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact A.cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w
  
  have hcutFar : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), y ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) center := by
    intro r hr0 hr2 y hy
    have h : eps ≤ dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) center := by
      refine le_dist_center_of_saddleChart_avoid hindex hρM hcover
        (hcutFib r y hy) (by rw [tcoord_spaceTime]) ?_
      intro u hquad hnorm hEq
      rw [spacePart_spaceTime] at hEq
      exact hother r hr0 hr2 u hquad hnorm (hEq ▸ hy)
    linarith
  
  have hmarkAmb : ∀ l : Fin 4,
      cobSpaceTime (A.point l) (tcoord center + s ^ 2) =
        M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s := by
    intro l
    have htX : tcoord (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s) =
        tcoord center + s ^ 2 :=
      M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hρ hs hρM
    rw [hpoint l, ← htX, spaceTime_spacePart]
  
  have hlabelOrbit : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 → ∀ l : Fin 4,
      A.point l ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime (A.point l) (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
        (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg :
          Vneg.OrbitIndex) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro r hr0 hr2 l hl
    have hfar := hcutFar r hr0 hr2 _ hl
    rw [hmarkAmb l] at hfar ⊢
    exact hcap (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l) hfar
  have hmemEq : ∀ {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
      {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}, x = y → y ∈ S → x ∈ S :=
    fun h hy => h ▸ hy
  
  have hlabelEq : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).2 =
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).2 := by
    intro r hr0 hr2
    by_contra hlab
    have hsrcMem : A.point (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r := by
      rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]
      exact ⟨0, (A.cyclicCutPath r).source⟩
    have htgtMem : A.point (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r := by
      rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]
      exact ⟨1, (A.cyclicCutPath r).target⟩
    have hO := orbitIndex_eq_of_slabFlowFamily
      (R := R) (eps := eps) (dbefore := -(s ^ 2)) (dafter := s ^ 2)
      (tbefore := tcoord center - s ^ 2)
      (tafter := tcoord center + s ^ 2)
      (hbefore := hregneg) (Vbefore := Vneg)
      (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).toContinuousMap
      (fun w => A.cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w)
      (fun w => by
        show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (A.cyclicCutPath r w)
          (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) = tcoord center + s ^ 2
        rw [tcoord_spaceTime])
      (fun w => by
        have h := hcutFar r hr0 hr2 (A.cyclicCutPath r w)
          (by rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]; exact ⟨w, rfl⟩)
        rw [habs]
        exact h)
      hunit (by ring) rfl (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe)
      (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe)
      (O := T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).2 ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      (O' := T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).2 ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      (w := 0) (w' := 1)
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)))
          (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).source)
        (hlabelOrbit r hr0 hr2 _ hsrcMem))
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)))
          (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).target)
        (hlabelOrbit r hr0 hr2 _ htgtMem))
    apply hne
    rcases hp : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).2 with
      _ | _ <;>
      rcases hq : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).2 with
        _ | _ <;> rw [hp, hq] at hO hlab
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
    · exact hO.symm
    · exact hO
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
  
  have hsrcLab1 : A.cyclicCutSourceLabel 1 = A.sortedLabel 1 := by
    rw [← e1c]
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
  have htgtLab1 : A.cyclicCutTargetLabel 1 = A.sortedLabel 2 := by
    rw [← e1c, ← e1s]
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
  have hsrcLab3 : A.cyclicCutSourceLabel (Fin.last 3) =
      A.sortedLabel (Fin.last 3) := by
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_last]
  have htgtLab3 : A.cyclicCutTargetLabel (Fin.last 3) = A.sortedLabel 0 := by
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_last]
  rw [elast] at hsrcLab3 htgtLab3
  have hlabels :
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).2 ≠
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3)).2 := by
    intro hEq
    have h1 := hlabelEq 1 (by decide) (by decide)
    have h3 := hlabelEq 3 (by decide) (by decide)
    rw [hsrcLab1, htgtLab1] at h1
    rw [hsrcLab3, htgtLab3] at h3
    refine saddleFourLabel_snd_not_constant
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).2
      (A.sortedLabel 1) (A.sortedLabel 2) (A.sortedLabel 3) (A.sortedLabel 0)
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      rfl h1.symm hEq.symm ?_
    rw [← h3, ← hEq]
  refine ⟨_, _, hlabels, ?_⟩
  
  have hin₁ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) q) ∈
      A.cyclicCutRange 1 := by
    intro q
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (1 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e1c, e1s] at h
    exact h
  have hin₂ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) q) ∈
      A.cyclicCutRange 3 := by
    intro q
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_last_mem_cyclicCutRange q
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  
  have hcomp₁ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 2) (A.sortedMark 3) q) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro q
    rw [← hcut2]
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (2 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e2c, e2s] at h
    exact h
  have hcomp₀ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) (A.sortedMark 1) q) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro q
    rw [← hcut0]
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (0 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e0c, e0s, hsort0] at h
    exact h
  have hcurveMark : ∀ i : Fin 4, P.curve (A.sortedMark i) =
      A.point (A.sortedLabel i) := fun i => A.curve_mark (A.sortedLabel i)
  have hzeroMark : P.curve 1 = A.point (A.sortedLabel 0) := by
    have h := hcurveMark 0
    rw [hsort0] at h
    rw [← P.curve_closed]
    exact h
  have hcompEnd : P.curve 1 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    rw [← hcut0, hzeroMark, ← hcurveMark 0]
    have h := A.curve_sortedMark_castSucc_mem (0 : Fin 3)
    rw [e0c] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨hne₁, hz₁, ho₁⟩ := A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (1 : Fin 3)
  rw [e1c, e1s] at hne₁ hz₁ ho₁
  have hlastne : A.sortedMark 3 ≠ 1 := by
    have h := A.sortedMark_ne_one (Fin.last 3)
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  have hlastnz : A.sortedMark 3 ≠ 0 := by
    have h := A.sortedMark_last_ne_zero
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  have hzeroone : (0 : I) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Subtype.val h
    norm_num at this
  
  have hinj₁ : Function.Injective
      (fun q : I =>
        P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) q)) :=
    injective_curve_convexComb P hne₁ hz₁ ho₁
  have hinj₂ : Function.Injective
      (fun q : I => P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) q)) :=
    injective_curve_convexComb P hlastne (by rintro ⟨h, -⟩; exact hlastnz h)
      (by rintro ⟨-, h⟩; exact hzeroone h.symm)
  
  have hstep : ∀ (r : Fin 4) (a b : I), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      (∀ q : I, P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb a b q) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r) →
      (∀ q : I, R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) (-(s ^ 2)) ∈
        criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
          (tcoord center) (eps / 2)) := by
    intro r a b hr0 hr2 hmem q
    have hfib : C.G (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) = 0 :=
      sliceAmbientSubarc_mem_fiber P a b q
    have htime : tcoord (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) =
        tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
      show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb a b q))
        (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) = _
      rw [tcoord_spaceTime]
    have hfar : eps / 2 + (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |(s ^ 2 : ℝ)| ≤
        dist (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) center := by
      rw [habs]
      exact hcutFar r hr0 hr2 _ (hmem q)
    exact slabFlowBack_mem_core (R := R) hunit rfl (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe)
      hfib htime hfar
  have hcore₁ := hstep 1 (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) (by decide)
    (by decide) hin₁
  have hcore₂ := hstep 3 (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) (by decide) (by decide) hin₂
  
  have hhit₁ : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2)
      (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2) 0 ∈
      ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    have hval : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2)
        (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2) 0 =
        spacePart (R.base.flow
          (cobSpaceTime (A.point (A.sortedLabel 1)) (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
          (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) := by
      rw [transportedSubarc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero]
      exact congrArg (fun y => spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)))
        (hcurveMark 1)
    refine hmemEq hval ?_
    have hmemcut : A.point (A.sortedLabel 1) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange 1 := by
      rw [← hcurveMark 1]
      have h := A.curve_sortedMark_castSucc_mem (1 : Fin 3)
      rw [e1c] at h
      exact h
    exact hlabelOrbit 1 (by decide) (by decide) _ hmemcut
  have hhit₂ : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
      (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2) 0 ∈
      ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3)).2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    have hval : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
        (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2) 0 =
        spacePart (R.base.flow
          (cobSpaceTime (A.point (A.sortedLabel 3)) (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
          (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) := by
      rw [transportedSubarc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero]
      exact congrArg (fun y => spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)))
        (hcurveMark 3)
    refine hmemEq hval ?_
    have hmemcut : A.point (A.sortedLabel 3) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange 3 := by
      rw [← hcurveMark 3]
      have h := A.curve_sortedMark_last_mem_last
      rw [elast] at h
      exact h
    exact hlabelOrbit 3 (by decide) (by decide) _ hmemcut
  refine ⟨SaddleFlowBandMarking.ofAfterArcsFreeBefore (-(s ^ 2)) (s ^ 2)
      (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe) (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe) P hafterOrbit
      (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
      hcore₁ hcore₂
      (coreTime_criticalSliceExteriorCore_merge C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (eps / 2) s)
      hinj₁ hinj₂ (orbitPoint_mem_orbit_of_mem hhit₁)
      (orbitPoint_mem_orbit_of_mem hhit₂),
    rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, hcomp₁, hcomp₀, hcompEnd, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow
      (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) 0)
      (-(s ^ 2)) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hcurveMark 1, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 2), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow
      (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) 1)
      (-(s ^ 2)) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hcurveMark 2, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) 0)
      (-(s ^ 2)) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hcurveMark 3, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 0), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) 1)
      (-(s ^ 2)) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hzeroMark, hmarkAmb]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_rebasedMergeBandMarking
statement:
theorem exists_rebasedMergeBandMarking
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hflowlt : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 < eps / 2)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord center + s ^ 2 → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (hcap : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) center →
      spacePart (R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s)
          (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex p.2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hne : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg ≠
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg)
    (heq : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos =
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos) :
    ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
      ∃ F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg)
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg)
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos),
        F.dbefore = -(s ^ 2) ∧ F.dafter = s ^ 2 ∧ F.afterCut₃ = 1 ∧
        F.afterParam =
          T.saddlePositiveRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) F.afterCut₀ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        F.afterParam.curve 1 ∈
          Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) (-(s ^ 2))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) (-(s ^ 2))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) (-(s ^ 2))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s)
            (-(s ^ 2)))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcut0, hcut2, hother⟩ :=
    T.saddlePositiveRebased_exteriorCuts hindex hρ hb hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq
  obtain ⟨hsort0, -, -⟩ :=
    T.saddlePositiveRebased_structure hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq
  refine T.exists_rebasedMergeBandMarking_of_marking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg
    hregpos Vneg Vpos R hsafe hflowlt hcover hunit hcap hne
    (T.saddlePositiveRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq)
    (T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq)
    (fun l => rfl) hsort0 hcut0 hcut2 hother ?_
  have hbase :
      (T.saddlePositiveRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq).p =
        T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad 0 := rfl
  rw [hbase, Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem
    (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_mem_commonParamOrbit hindex ρ s hρ hs
      hρrad hregpos Vpos heq .negative 0)]
  exact Vpos.mem_orbit_self _

name: Submission.TamedField.flow_eq_iff_sub_mem_zmultiples
statement:
theorem flow_eq_iff_sub_mem_zmultiples {p : E₁} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) (s t : ℝ) :
    V.flow p s = V.flow p t ↔
      s - t ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples (V.fundamentalPeriod hp)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hst
    have hshift : (fun u => V.flow p (s + u)) = fun u => V.flow p (t + u) := by
      rw [← V.flow_shift p s, ← V.flow_shift p t, hst]
    have hper : Function.Periodic (V.flow p) (s - t) := by
      intro u
      have h := congrFun hshift (u - t)
      convert h using 1 <;> ring
    let q : V.flowPeriods p := ⟨s - t, hper⟩
    have hq : q ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples (V.periodGenerator hp) := by
      rw [V.zmultiples_periodGenerator hp]
      exact Set.mem_univ q
    obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp hq
    apply AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mpr
    refine ⟨if 0 ≤ ((V.periodGenerator hp : V.flowPeriods p) : ℝ) then k else -k, ?_⟩
    unfold fundamentalPeriod
    split_ifs with hgen
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hgen]
      exact congrArg Subtype.val hk
    · rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hgen), neg_smul]
      simpa using congrArg Subtype.val hk
  · rintro ⟨k, hk⟩
    have hper := (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp).zsmul k
    have h := hper t
    have harg : t + k • V.fundamentalPeriod hp = s := by linarith
    rwa [harg] at h

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitPeriodicMap
statement:
theorem orbitPeriodicMap {p : E₁} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    Function.Periodic
      (fun t => (⟨V.flow p t, ⟨t, rfl⟩⟩ : V.orbit p))
      (V.fundamentalPeriod hp)
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp t

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.intermediateTime_mem_Icc
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hs₀ : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.2.1
    have hs₁ : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.2.2
    rcases le_total t₁ t₂ with h | h <;>
      dsimp [intermediateTime] <;> nlinarith [ht₁.1, ht₂.1]
  · have hs₀ : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.2.1
    have hs₁ : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.2.2
    rcases le_total t₁ t₂ with h | h <;>
      dsimp [intermediateTime] <;> nlinarith [ht₁.2, ht₂.2]

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.continuous_intermediateTime
statement:
theorem continuous_intermediateTime (W : SlabTamedField C₀ a b) (t₁ t₂ : ℝ) :
    Continuous (W.intermediateTime t₁ t₂)
proof:
:=
  continuous_const.add (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.continuous_transportedOrbitPoint
statement:
theorem continuous_transportedOrbitPoint (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    Continuous (W.transportedOrbitPoint hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O)
proof:
:= by
  let p : E₁ := V₁.orbitPoint O
  let T : ℝ := V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
  have hsource : Continuous fun q : I × I => V₁.flow p ((q.2 : ℝ) * T) :=
    (V₁.continuous_flow p).comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd |>.mul continuous_const)
  have hinit : Continuous fun q : I × I =>
      cobSpaceTime (V₁.flow p ((q.2 : ℝ) * T)) t₁ := by
    have hcob : Continuous fun z : E₁ => cobSpaceTime z t₁ := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      exact fun z => (hasFDerivAt_cobSpaceTime t₁ z).continuousAt
    exact hcob.comp hsource
  have htime : Continuous fun q : I × I =>
      W.intermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1 - t₁ :=
    ((W.continuous_intermediateTime t₁ t₂).comp continuous_fst).sub continuous_const
  have hflow : Continuous fun q : I × I =>
      W.flow (cobSpaceTime (V₁.flow p ((q.2 : ℝ) * T)) t₁)
        (W.intermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1 - t₁) :=
    W.continuous_flow_uncurry.comp (hinit.prodMk htime)
  have hspace : Continuous (spacePart (n := n)) := by
    have hsp : LipschitzWith 1 (spacePart (n := n)) := by
      apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
      intro x y
      rw [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      change ‖spacePart (x - y)‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖
      exact norm_spacePart_le (x - y)
    exact hsp.continuous
  exact hspace.comp hflow

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedOrbitPoint_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem transportedOrbitPoint_mem_fiber (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (q : I × I) :
    W.transportedOrbitPoint hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O q ∈
      (sliceFLSAt C₀ (W.intermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1)
        (hreg.sliceRegular (W.intermediateTime_mem_Icc ht₁ ht₂ q.1))).fiber
proof:
:= by
  apply W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg ht₁
    (W.intermediateTime_mem_Icc ht₁ ht₂ q.1)
  exact V₁.flow_mem_fiber (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) _

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.continuous_transportedFrameMatrix
statement:
theorem continuous_transportedFrameMatrix (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    Continuous (W.transportedFrameMatrix hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O)
proof:
:= by
  let τ : I × I → ℝ := fun q => W.intermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1
  let x : I × I → E₁ := W.transportedOrbitPoint hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O
  let A : I × I → Fin (n + 1) → E₁ := fun q =>
    sliceFrameAt C₀.G (τ q) (x q)
  have hτ : Continuous τ :=
    (W.continuous_intermediateTime t₁ t₂).comp continuous_fst
  have hx : Continuous x := W.continuous_transportedOrbitPoint hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O
  have hA : ∀ i, Continuous fun q => A q i := by
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) i
    · change Continuous fun q => tauField (sliceMap C₀.G (τ q)) (x q)
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro q
      have hxfib := W.transportedOrbitPoint_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O q
      have hxreg : x q ∈ regularSet (sliceMap C₀.G (τ q)) :=
        (sliceFLSAt C₀ (τ q)
          (hreg.sliceRegular (W.intermediateTime_mem_Icc ht₁ ht₂ q.1))).fiber_subset_regularSet
          hxfib
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using
        (continuousAt_sliceTau C₀.smooth hxreg).comp
          (hτ.continuousAt.prodMk hx.continuousAt)
    · change Continuous fun q => gradVec (sliceMap C₀.G (τ q)) k (x q)
      convert (contDiff_sliceGrad C₀.smooth k).continuous.comp (hτ.prodMk hx) using 1
      · apply TopologicalSpace.ext
        rfl
      · rfl
  have hInd : ∀ q, LinearIndependent ℝ (A q) := by
    intro q
    change LinearIndependent ℝ
      (frameAt (sliceFLSAt C₀ (τ q)
        (hreg.sliceRegular (W.intermediateTime_mem_Icc ht₁ ht₂ q.1))) (x q))
    exact linearIndependent_frameAt _
      ((sliceFLSAt C₀ (τ q)
        (hreg.sliceRegular (W.intermediateTime_mem_Icc ht₁ ht₂ q.1))).fiber_subset_regularSet
        (W.transportedOrbitPoint_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O q))
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  have hgs := continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_family' hA hInd i
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp hgs

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedFrameMatrix_mem_SO
statement:
theorem transportedFrameMatrix_mem_SO (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (q : I × I) :
    W.transportedFrameMatrix hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O q ∈
      SOGroup (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  change frameLoop
    (sliceFLSAt C₀ (W.intermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1)
      (hreg.sliceRegular (W.intermediateTime_mem_Icc ht₁ ht₂ q.1)))
    (fun _ => W.transportedOrbitPoint hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O q) 0 ∈
      Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ
  apply frameLoop_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
  intro _
  exact W.transportedOrbitPoint_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O q

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedOrbitPoint_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportedOrbitPoint_zero (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (u : I) :

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedOrbitPoint_one
statement:

theorem transportedOrbitPoint_one (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (u : I) :
    W.transportedOrbitPoint hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O (1, u) =

        (V₁.flow (V₁.orbitPoint O)
          ((u : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)))

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedOrbitPoint_closed
statement:

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedFrameMatrix_zero
statement:
theorem transportedFrameMatrix_zero (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (u : I) :
    W.transportedFrameMatrix hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O (0, u) =
      V₁.orbitFrameLoop O u
proof:
:= by
  unfold transportedFrameMatrix TamedField.orbitFrameLoop
    TamedField.fundamentalFrameLoop frameLoop sliceFrameAt
  rw [W.transportedOrbitPoint_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O u]
  simp [intermediateTime, frameAt, sliceFLSAt, sliceFLS]

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedFrameMatrix_closed
statement:
theorem transportedFrameMatrix_closed (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (s : I) :
    W.transportedFrameMatrix hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O (s, 0) =

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedFrame_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportedFrame_zero (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (u : I) :
    W.transportedFrame hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O (0, u) = V₁.orbitFrameLoop O u

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedFrame_closed
statement:
theorem transportedFrame_closed (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (s : I) :
    W.transportedFrame hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O (s, 0) =

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O ∈
      (sliceFLSAt C₀ t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂)).fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [sliceFLSAt_fiber]
  apply W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg ht₁ ht₂
  rw [← sliceFLSAt_fiber]

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedTargetPhase_homeomorph_apply
statement:
theorem transportedTargetPhase_homeomorph_apply (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (u : I) :
    V₂.orbitCircleHomeomorph
        (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
        (W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u) =
      W.transportedTargetOrbitPath hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u
proof:
:= by
  exact (V₂.orbitCircleHomeomorph
    (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)).apply_symm_apply _

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedTargetPhase_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportedTargetPhase_zero (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (V₂.orbitCircleHomeomorph
    (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)).injective
  rw [W.transportedTargetPhase_homeomorph_apply hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O]
  apply Subtype.ext
  have hhome :
      (V₂.orbitCircleHomeomorph
          (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
          (0 : AddCircle (V₂.fundamentalPeriod
            (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O))) : E₁) =
        V₂.flow (W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O) 0 := by
    exact V₂.orbitCircleHomeomorph_coe
      (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O) 0
  rw [hhome]
  have hpath :
      ((W.transportedTargetOrbitPath hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 0 :
          V₂.orbit (W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)) : E₁) =
        W.transportedOrbitPoint hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O (1, 0) := rfl
  rw [hpath, W.transportedOrbitPoint_one hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O 0]
  change W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂
      (V₁.flow (V₁.orbitPoint O)
        (((0 : I) : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O))) =
    V₂.flow (W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O) 0
  simp [targetTransportedBase]

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedTargetPhase_closed
statement:
theorem transportedTargetPhase_closed (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 0 =
      W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (V₂.orbitCircleHomeomorph
    (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)).injective
  rw [W.transportedTargetPhase_homeomorph_apply hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O,
    W.transportedTargetPhase_homeomorph_apply hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact W.transportedOrbitPoint_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O 1

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedTargetPhase_eq_cases
statement:
theorem transportedTargetPhase_eq_cases (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) {u v : I}
    (huv : W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u =
      W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O v) :
    u = v ∨ (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  have htarget : W.transportedOrbitPoint hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O (1, u) =
      W.transportedOrbitPoint hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O (1, v) := by
    have h := congrArg
      (V₂.orbitCircleHomeomorph
        (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)) huv
    rw [W.transportedTargetPhase_homeomorph_apply hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O,
      W.transportedTargetPhase_homeomorph_apply hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O] at h
    exact congrArg Subtype.val h
  rw [W.transportedOrbitPoint_one hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O,
    W.transportedOrbitPoint_one hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O] at htarget
  have hsource :
      V₁.flow (V₁.orbitPoint O)
          ((u : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)) =
        V₁.flow (V₁.orbitPoint O)
          ((v : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)) := by
    apply (W.sliceTransport_bijOn hreg ht₁ ht₂).injOn
    · exact V₁.flow_mem_fiber (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) _
    · exact V₁.flow_mem_fiber (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) _
    · exact htarget
  have hmem := (V₁.flow_eq_iff_sub_mem_zmultiples
    (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) _ _).mp hsource
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp hmem
  have hTpos := V₁.fundamentalPeriod_pos (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
  have huvInt : (u : ℝ) - (v : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) := by
    have hk' : (k : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) =
        (u : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) -
          (v : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) := by
      simpa [zsmul_eq_mul] using hk
    nlinarith
  rcases lt_trichotomy (u : ℝ) (v : ℝ) with huvlt | huveq | huvgt
  · right; left
    have hknegR : (k : ℝ) < 0 := by rw [← huvInt]; linarith
    have hkneg : k < 0 := by exact_mod_cast hknegR
    have hkge : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ k := by
      have hkgeR : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by rw [← huvInt]; linarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
      exact_mod_cast hkgeR
    have hkval : k = -1 := by omega
    constructor
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change (u : ℝ) = 0
      have hd : (u : ℝ) - (v : ℝ) = -1 := by rw [huvInt, hkval]; norm_num
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change (v : ℝ) = 1
      have hd : (u : ℝ) - (v : ℝ) = -1 := by rw [huvInt, hkval]; norm_num
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
  · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext huveq)
  · right; right
    have hkposR : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by rw [← huvInt]; linarith
    have hkpos : 0 < k := by exact_mod_cast hkposR
    have hkle : k ≤ 1 := by
      have hkleR : (k : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by rw [← huvInt]; linarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
      exact_mod_cast hkleR
    have hkval : k = 1 := by omega
    constructor
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change (u : ℝ) = 1
      have hd : (u : ℝ) - (v : ℝ) = 1 := by rw [huvInt, hkval]; norm_num
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change (v : ℝ) = 0
      have hd : (u : ℝ) - (v : ℝ) = 1 := by rw [huvInt, hkval]; norm_num
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero
statement:
@[simp]
theorem transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold transportedTargetPhaseLift
  apply IsCoveringMap.liftPath_zero

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe
statement:
theorem transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (u : I) :
    ((W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u : ℝ) :
        AddCircle (V₂.fundamentalPeriod
          (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O))) =
      W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u
proof:
:= by
  let hp := W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  let T := V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp
  letI : Fact (0 < T) := ⟨V₂.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp⟩
  have h := congrFun ((AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe T).liftPath_lifts
    (W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O) 0
      (W.transportedTargetPhase_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)) u
  simpa [transportedTargetPhaseLift, hp, T] using h

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedTargetPhaseLift_endpoint_zsmul
statement:
theorem transportedTargetPhaseLift_endpoint_zsmul (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    ∃ k : ℤ, W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1 =
      k • V₂.fundamentalPeriod
        (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
proof:
:= by
  let ψ := W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  let T := V₂.fundamentalPeriod
    (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
  have hcoe : ((ψ 1 : ℝ) : AddCircle T) = 0 := by
    calc
      ((ψ 1 : ℝ) : AddCircle T) =
          W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1 :=
        W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1
      _ = W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 0 :=
        (W.transportedTargetPhase_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O).symm
      _ = 0 := W.transportedTargetPhase_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff T).mp hcoe
  exact ⟨k, hk.symm⟩

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedTargetPhaseLift_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem transportedTargetPhaseLift_one_ne_zero (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let ψ := W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  let φ := W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  let m : I := ⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ), by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
  have hm0 : (0 : I) < m := by change (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2; norm_num
  have hm1 : m < (1 : I) := by change (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1; norm_num
  have hφm : φ m ≠ φ 0 := by
    intro h
    rcases W.transportedTargetPhase_eq_cases hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O h with
      hEq | hEnds | hEnds
    · exact (ne_of_gt hm0) hEq
    · exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : I) ≠ 1) hEnds.2
    · exact (ne_of_lt hm1) hEnds.1
  have hψm : ψ m ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hφm
    calc
      φ m = ((ψ m : ℝ) : AddCircle
          (V₂.fundamentalPeriod
            (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O))) :=
        (W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O m).symm
      _ = ((ψ 0 : ℝ) : AddCircle
          (V₂.fundamentalPeriod
            (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O))) := by
        rw [hzero, W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O]
      _ = φ 0 :=
        W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 0
  intro hψ1
  have hcont : Continuous ψ :=
    (W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O).continuous
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hψm with hneg | hpos
  · let z : ℝ := ψ m / 2
    have hzL : z ∈ Icc (ψ m) (ψ 0) := by
      rw [W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨u, huI, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (le_of_lt hm0)
      hcont.continuousOn hzL
    have hzR : z ∈ Icc (ψ m) (ψ 1) := by
      rw [hψ1]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨v, hvI, hv⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (le_of_lt hm1)
      hcont.continuousOn hzR
    have hphase : φ u = φ v := by
      rw [← W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u,
        ← W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O v,
        hu, hv]
    rcases W.transportedTargetPhase_eq_cases hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O hphase with
      huv | hends | hends
    · subst v
      have : u = m := le_antisymm huI.2 hvI.1
      subst u
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1,
        W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1, hψ1] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
  · let z : ℝ := ψ m / 2
    have hzL : z ∈ Icc (ψ 0) (ψ m) := by
      rw [W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨u, huI, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (le_of_lt hm0)
      hcont.continuousOn hzL
    have hzR : z ∈ Icc (ψ 1) (ψ m) := by
      rw [hψ1]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨v, hvI, hv⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (le_of_lt hm1)
      hcont.continuousOn hzR
    have hphase : φ u = φ v := by
      rw [← W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u,
        ← W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O v,
        hu, hv]
    rcases W.transportedTargetPhase_eq_cases hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O hphase with
      huv | hends | hends
    · subst v
      have : u = m := le_antisymm huI.2 hvI.1
      subst u
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1,
        W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1, hψ1] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedTargetPhaseLift_injective
statement:
theorem transportedTargetPhaseLift_injective (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    Function.Injective
      (W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  have hphase :
      W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u =
        W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O v := by
    rw [← W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u,
      ← W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O v,
      huv]
  rcases W.transportedTargetPhase_eq_cases hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O hphase with
    hEq | hEnds | hEnds
  · exact hEq
  · exfalso
    apply W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_one_ne_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
    rw [← hEnds.2, ← huv, hEnds.1,
      W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O]
  · exfalso
    apply W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_one_ne_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
    rw [← hEnds.1, huv, hEnds.2,
      W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O]

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedTargetPhaseLift_one_eq_period_or_neg
statement:
theorem transportedTargetPhaseLift_one_eq_period_or_neg (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1 =
        V₂.fundamentalPeriod
          (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O) ∨
      W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1 =
        -V₂.fundamentalPeriod
          (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
proof:
:= by
  let ψ := W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  let φ := W.transportedTargetPhase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  let T := V₂.fundamentalPeriod
    (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
  have hT : 0 < T := V₂.fundamentalPeriod_pos
    (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ :=
    W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_endpoint_zsmul hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  have hkR : ψ 1 = (k : ℝ) * T := by simpa [ψ, T, zsmul_eq_mul] using hk
  have hmonoanti :=
    (W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O).continuous
      |>.strictMono_of_inj_boundedOrder'
        (W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_injective hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
  rcases hmonoanti with hmono | hanti
  · have hψ1pos : 0 < ψ 1 := by
      have h := hmono (show (0 : I) < 1 by norm_num)
      rwa [W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O] at h
    have hkposR : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by nlinarith
    have hkpos : (0 : ℤ) < k := by exact_mod_cast hkposR
    have hkle : k ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra hknot
      have hkge : (2 : ℤ) ≤ k := by omega
      have hkgeR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hkge
      have hmem : T ∈ Icc (ψ 0) (ψ 1) := by
        rw [W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O, hkR]
        constructor <;> nlinarith
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (0 : I) (1 : I)
        (W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O).continuous hmem
      have hphase : φ u = φ 0 := by
        rw [← W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u,
          ← W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 0,
          hu, W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O]
        exact AddCircle.coe_period T
      rcases W.transportedTargetPhase_eq_cases hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O hphase with
        hu0 | hbad | hu1
      · rw [hu0, W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O] at hu
        linarith
      · exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : I) ≠ 1) hbad.2
      · rw [hu1.1, hkR] at hu
        nlinarith
    have hkone : k = 1 := by omega
    left
    simpa [T, hkone] using hkR
  · have hψ1neg : ψ 1 < 0 := by
      have h := hanti (show (0 : I) < 1 by norm_num)
      rwa [W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O] at h
    have hknegR : (k : ℝ) < 0 := by nlinarith
    have hkneg : k < (0 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hknegR
    have hkge : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ k := by
      by_contra hknot
      have hkle : k ≤ (-2 : ℤ) := by omega
      have hkleR : (k : ℝ) ≤ -2 := by exact_mod_cast hkle
      have hmem : -T ∈ Icc (ψ 1) (ψ 0) := by
        rw [W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O, hkR]
        constructor <;> nlinarith
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (1 : I) (0 : I)
        (W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O).continuous hmem
      have hphase : φ u = φ 0 := by
        rw [← W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u,
          ← W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 0,
          hu, W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O]
        rw [AddCircle.coe_neg, AddCircle.coe_period, neg_zero]
        rfl
      rcases W.transportedTargetPhase_eq_cases hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O hphase with
        hu0 | hbad | hu1
      · rw [hu0, W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O] at hu
        linarith
      · exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : I) ≠ 1) hbad.2
      · rw [hu1.1, hkR] at hu
        nlinarith
    have hkmone : k = -1 := by omega
    right
    simpa [T, hkmone] using hkR

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedOrbitPoint_one_eq_target_flow_lift
statement:
theorem transportedOrbitPoint_one_eq_target_flow_lift (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (u : I) :
    W.transportedOrbitPoint hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O (1, u) =
      V₂.flow (W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
        (W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u)
proof:
:= by
  have h := W.transportedTargetPhase_homeomorph_apply hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u
  rw [← W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_coe hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u] at h
  have hv := congrArg Subtype.val h
  rw [V₂.orbitCircleHomeomorph_coe] at hv
  simpa [transportedTargetOrbitPath] using hv.symm

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.transportedTargetFrameLoop_eq_liftedTargetFrameLoop
statement:
theorem transportedTargetFrameLoop_eq_liftedTargetFrameLoop (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    W.transportedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O =
      W.liftedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  change W.transportedFrame hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O (1, u) =
    W.liftedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change W.transportedFrameMatrix hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O (1, u) =
    frameLoop (sliceFLSAt C₀ t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂))
      (V₂.flow (W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O))
      (W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u)
  unfold transportedFrameMatrix frameLoop frameAt sliceFrameAt
  rw [W.transportedOrbitPoint_one_eq_target_flow_lift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O u]
  congr 3
  all_goals
    have htime : W.intermediateTime t₁ t₂ (1 : I) = t₂ := by
      simp [intermediateTime]
    rw [htime]
    rfl

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.orientedTargetFrameLoop_one
statement:
theorem orientedTargetFrameLoop_one (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    W.orientedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1 =
      V₂.fundamentalFrameLoop
        (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop _ _ (1 * (u : ℝ) * _) = frameLoop _ _ ((u : ℝ) * _)
  congr 2
  ring

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.orientedTargetFrameLoop_neg_one
statement:
theorem orientedTargetFrameLoop_neg_one (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    W.orientedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O (-1) =
      reverseLoop (V₂.fundamentalFrameLoop
        (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O))
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  let hp := W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  let F := fun t : ℝ => frameLoop (sliceFLSAt C₀ t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂))
    (V₂.flow (W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)) t
  have hper : Function.Periodic F (V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp) :=
    frameLoop_periodic _ (V₂.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp)
  change F ((-1 : ℝ) * (u : ℝ) * V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp) =
    F ((unitInterval.symm u : ℝ) * V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp)
  have h := hper ((-1 : ℝ) * (u : ℝ) * V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp)
  rw [show (unitInterval.symm u : ℝ) = 1 - (u : ℝ) by rfl]
  convert h.symm using 1 <;> ring

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.liftedTargetFrameLoop_closed
statement:
theorem liftedTargetFrameLoop_closed (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    W.liftedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 0 =
      W.liftedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [← W.transportedTargetFrameLoop_eq_liftedTargetFrameLoop
    hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O]
  exact W.transportedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.targetFrameReparamHomotopy_closed
statement:
theorem targetFrameReparamHomotopy_closed (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (ε : ℝ)
    (hend : W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1 =
      ε * V₂.fundamentalPeriod
        (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O))
    (hperiod : Function.Periodic
      (fun t : ℝ => frameLoop (sliceFLSAt C₀ t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂))
        (V₂.flow (W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)) t)
      (ε * V₂.fundamentalPeriod
        (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)))
    (s : I) :
    W.targetFrameReparamHomotopy hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O ε (s, 0) =
      W.targetFrameReparamHomotopy hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O ε (s, 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  let T := V₂.fundamentalPeriod
    (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
  let F := fun t : ℝ => frameLoop (sliceFLSAt C₀ t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂))
    (V₂.flow (W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)) t
  change F ((1 - (s : ℝ)) *
      W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 0 +
      (s : ℝ) * (ε * (((0 : I) : ℝ)) * T)) =
    F ((1 - (s : ℝ)) *
      W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1 +
      (s : ℝ) * (ε * (((1 : I) : ℝ)) * T))
  rw [W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_zero hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O, hend]
  change F ((1 - (s : ℝ)) * 0 + (s : ℝ) * (ε * 0 * T)) =
    F ((1 - (s : ℝ)) * (ε * T) + (s : ℝ) * (ε * 1 * T))
  have hleft : (1 - (s : ℝ)) * 0 + (s : ℝ) * (ε * 0 * T) = 0 := by ring
  have hright : (1 - (s : ℝ)) * (ε * T) + (s : ℝ) * (ε * 1 * T) =
      ε * T := by ring
  rw [hleft, hright]
  simpa [F, T] using (hperiod 0).symm

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.orientedTargetFrameLoop_closed
statement:
theorem orientedTargetFrameLoop_closed (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) (ε : ℝ)
    (hperiod : Function.Periodic
      (fun t : ℝ => frameLoop (sliceFLSAt C₀ t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂))
        (V₂.flow (W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)) t)
      (ε * V₂.fundamentalPeriod
        (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O))) :
    W.orientedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O ε 0 =
      W.orientedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O ε 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop _ _ (ε * (((0 : I) : ℝ)) * _) =
    frameLoop _ _ (ε * (((1 : I) : ℝ)) * _)
  norm_num
  convert (hperiod 0).symm using 1 <;> ring

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.liftedTargetFrameClass_eq_fundamental
statement:
theorem liftedTargetFrameClass_eq_fundamental (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    loopClassZ2
        (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
        (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O) =
      V₂.fundamentalFrameClass
        (W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
proof:
:= by
  let hp := W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  let T := V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp
  let F := fun t : ℝ => frameLoop (sliceFLSAt C₀ t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂))
    (V₂.flow (W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)) t
  have hper : Function.Periodic F T :=
    frameLoop_periodic _ (V₂.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp)
  rcases W.transportedTargetPhaseLift_one_eq_period_or_neg
    hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O with hplus | hminus
  · have hend : W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1 =
        (1 : ℝ) * V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp := by simpa using hplus
    have hclosed := W.targetFrameReparamHomotopy_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
      1 hend (by simpa [F, T] using hper)
    have horientedClosed := W.orientedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
      1 (by simpa [F, T] using hper)
    calc
      loopClassZ2
          (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
          (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O) =
        loopClassZ2
          (W.orientedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1)
          horientedClosed :=
        loopClassZ2_congr
          (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
          horientedClosed
          (W.targetFrameReparamHomotopy hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1)
          hclosed
      _ = V₂.fundamentalFrameClass hp := by
        unfold TamedField.fundamentalFrameClass
        exact loopClassZ2_congr_fun horientedClosed
          (V₂.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp)
          (W.orientedTargetFrameLoop_one hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
  · have hend : W.transportedTargetPhaseLift hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O 1 =
        (-1 : ℝ) * V₂.fundamentalPeriod hp := by simpa using hminus
    have hclosed := W.targetFrameReparamHomotopy_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
      (-1) hend (by simpa [F, T] using hper.neg)
    have horientedClosed := W.orientedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
      (-1) (by simpa [F, T] using hper.neg)
    calc
      loopClassZ2
          (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
          (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O) =
        loopClassZ2
          (W.orientedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O (-1))
          horientedClosed :=
        loopClassZ2_congr
          (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
          horientedClosed
          (W.targetFrameReparamHomotopy hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O (-1))
          hclosed
      _ = loopClassZ2
          (reverseLoop (V₂.fundamentalFrameLoop hp))
          (reverseLoop_closed (V₂.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp)) := by
        exact loopClassZ2_congr_fun horientedClosed
          (reverseLoop_closed (V₂.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp))
          (W.orientedTargetFrameLoop_neg_one hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
      _ = V₂.fundamentalFrameClass hp := by
        exact loopClassZ2_reverse (V₂.fundamentalFrameLoop hp)
          (V₂.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp)

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.orbitFrameClass_eq_liftedTargetFrameClass
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_eq_liftedTargetFrameClass (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    V₁.orbitFrameClass O =
      loopClassZ2
        (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
        (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
proof:
:= by
  unfold TamedField.orbitFrameClass
  calc
    loopClassZ2 (V₁.orbitFrameLoop O) (V₁.orbitFrameLoop_closed O) =
        loopClassZ2
          (W.transportedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O)
          (W.transportedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O) :=
      loopClassZ2_congr
        (V₁.orbitFrameLoop_closed O)
        (W.transportedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O)
        (W.transportedFrameHomotopy hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O)
        (W.transportedFrame_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O)
    _ = loopClassZ2
          (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
          (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O) :=
      loopClassZ2_congr_fun
        (W.transportedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ O)
        (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
        (W.transportedTargetFrameLoop_eq_liftedTargetFrameLoop
          hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.orbitFrameClass_eq_sliceOrbitEquiv
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_eq_sliceOrbitEquiv (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    V₁.orbitFrameClass O =
      V₂.orbitFrameClass (W.sliceOrbitEquiv hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
proof:
:= by
  let e := W.sliceOrbitEquiv hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂
  let y := W.targetTransportedBase hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  let hy := W.targetTransportedBase_mem_fiber hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  let q := V₂.orbitPoint (e O)
  have hqOrbit : q ∈ V₂.orbit y := by
    have hqmem : q ∈ ((e O : V₂.OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) := by
      rw [V₂.orbitPoint_orbit (e O)]
      exact V₂.mem_orbit_self q
    exact hqmem
  calc
    V₁.orbitFrameClass O =
        loopClassZ2
          (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O)
          (W.liftedTargetFrameLoop_closed hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O) :=
      W.orbitFrameClass_eq_liftedTargetFrameClass hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
    _ = V₂.fundamentalFrameClass hy :=
      W.liftedTargetFrameClass_eq_fundamental hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
    _ = V₂.fundamentalFrameClass (V₂.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (e O)) := by
      symm
      exact V₂.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit hy hqOrbit
    _ = V₂.orbitFrameClass (e O) :=
      (V₂.orbitFrameClass_eq_fundamental (e O)).symm

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.doubleRotMat_mul_transpose
statement:
theorem doubleRotMat_mul_transpose : ∀ k theta,
    doubleRotMat k theta * (doubleRotMat k theta)ᵀ = 1
  | 0, theta => by
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
        simp [doubleRotMat, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_four,
          Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply] <;>
        nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta]
  | k + 1, theta => by
      rw [doubleRotMat, incMatrix_transpose, incMatrix_mul,
        doubleRotMat_mul_transpose k theta, incMatrix_one]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.doubleRotMat_det
statement:
theorem doubleRotMat_det : ∀ k theta, (doubleRotMat k theta).det = 1
  | 0, theta => by
      let A : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) ℝ
proof:
:=
        !![Real.cos theta, -Real.sin theta;
           Real.sin theta,  Real.cos theta]
      have hA : A.det = 1 := by
        rw [Matrix.det_fin_two_of]
        simp [A]
        nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta]
      let B : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ :=
        (Matrix.fromBlocks A 0 0 A).submatrix
          (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 ≃ Fin 4).symm
          (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 ≃ Fin 4).symm
      have h0 : (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 ≃ Fin 4).symm 0 =
          Sum.inl 0 := by
        simpa using (finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd
          (n := 2) (0 : Fin 2))
      have h1 : (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 ≃ Fin 4).symm 1 =
          Sum.inl 1 := by
        simpa using (finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_castAdd
          (n := 2) (1 : Fin 2))
      have h2 : (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 ≃ Fin 4).symm 2 =
          Sum.inr 0 := by
        simpa using (finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_natAdd
          (m := 2) (0 : Fin 2))
      have h3 : (finSumFinEquiv : Fin 2 ⊕ Fin 2 ≃ Fin 4).symm 3 =
          Sum.inr 1 := by
        simpa using (finSumFinEquiv_symm_apply_natAdd
          (m := 2) (1 : Fin 2))
      have hblock : doubleRotMat 0 theta = B := by
        ext i j
        fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
          simp [doubleRotMat, B, A, h0, h1, h2, h3, rotBlock]
      rw [hblock]
      dsimp [B]
      rw [Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self,
        Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, hA, mul_one]
  | k + 1, theta => by
      rw [doubleRotMat, incMatrix_det, doubleRotMat_det k theta]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.continuous_doubleRotMat
statement: theorem continuous_doubleRotMat (k : ℕ) : Continuous (doubleRotMat k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      apply continuous_matrix
      intro i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
        simp [doubleRotMat] <;> fun_prop
  | succ k ih =>
      show Continuous fun theta => incMatrix (doubleRotMat k theta)
      exact (ih.matrix_fromBlocks continuous_const continuous_const
        continuous_const).matrix_submatrix _ _

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.doubleRotMat_apply
statement:
lemma doubleRotMat_apply (k : ℕ) (theta : ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (k + 4)) :
    doubleRotMat k theta i j =
      if i = 0 then
        (if j = 0 then Real.cos theta
          else if j = 1 then -Real.sin theta else 0)
      else if i = 1 then
        (if j = 0 then Real.sin theta
          else if j = 1 then Real.cos theta else 0)
      else if i = 2 then
        (if j = 2 then Real.cos theta
          else if j = 3 then -Real.sin theta else 0)
      else if i = 3 then
        (if j = 2 then Real.sin theta
          else if j = 3 then Real.cos theta else 0)
      else if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp [doubleRotMat]
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [doubleRotMat]
      have hcast0 : ((0 : Fin (k + 4)).castSucc : Fin (k + 5)) = 0 := rfl
      have hcast1 : ((1 : Fin (k + 4)).castSucc : Fin (k + 5)) = 1 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < k + 5)]
      have hcast2 : ((2 : Fin (k + 4)).castSucc : Fin (k + 5)) = 2 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < k + 5)]
      have hcast3 : ((3 : Fin (k + 4)).castSucc : Fin (k + 5)) = 3 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < k + 5)]
      have hEq0 (x : Fin (k + 4)) :
          x.castSucc = (0 : Fin (k + 5)) ↔ x = 0 := by
        rw [← hcast0]
        exact Fin.castSucc_inj
      have hEq1 (x : Fin (k + 4)) :
          x.castSucc = (1 : Fin (k + 5)) ↔ x = 1 := by
        rw [← hcast1]
        exact Fin.castSucc_inj
      have hEq2 (x : Fin (k + 4)) :
          x.castSucc = (2 : Fin (k + 5)) ↔ x = 2 := by
        rw [← hcast2]
        exact Fin.castSucc_inj
      have hEq3 (x : Fin (k + 4)) :
          x.castSucc = (3 : Fin (k + 5)) ↔ x = 3 := by
        rw [← hcast3]
        exact Fin.castSucc_inj
      have hlast0 : Fin.last (k + 4) ≠ (0 : Fin (k + 5)) := by
        rw [← hcast0]
        exact Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last 0)
      have hlast1 : Fin.last (k + 4) ≠ (1 : Fin (k + 5)) := by
        rw [← hcast1]
        exact Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last 1)
      have hlast2 : Fin.last (k + 4) ≠ (2 : Fin (k + 5)) := by
        rw [← hcast2]
        exact Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last 2)
      have hlast3 : Fin.last (k + 4) ≠ (3 : Fin (k + 5)) := by
        rw [← hcast3]
        exact Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_ne_last 3)
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          induction j using Fin.lastCases with
          | last =>
              rw [incMatrix_apply_last_last]
              simp [hlast0, hlast1, hlast2, hlast3,
                Fin.castSucc_ne_last, eq_comm]
          | cast j =>
              rw [incMatrix_apply_last_castSucc]
              simp [hlast0, hlast1, hlast2, hlast3, hEq0, hEq1,
                hEq2, hEq3, Fin.castSucc_ne_last, eq_comm]
      | cast i =>
          induction j using Fin.lastCases with
          | last =>
              rw [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_last]
              simp [hlast0, hlast1, hlast2, hlast3, hEq0, hEq1,
                hEq2, hEq3, Fin.castSucc_ne_last, eq_comm]
          | cast j =>
              rw [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_castSucc, ih]
              simp [hEq0, hEq1, hEq2, hEq3, eq_comm]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.planeSwap_conj_apply
statement:
lemma planeSwap_conj_apply
    (A : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) (i j : Fin 4) :
    (planeSwapMat * A * planeSwapMatᵀ) i j =
      A (planeSwapPerm i) (planeSwapPerm j)
proof:
:= by
  have hright := congrFun
    (Matrix.vecMul_permMatrix (R := ℝ) (planeSwapPerm⁻¹)
      (v := fun x => (planeSwapMat * A) i x)) j
  have hleft := congrFun
    (Matrix.permMatrix_mulVec (R := ℝ) planeSwapPerm
      (v := fun x => A x (planeSwapPerm j))) i
  change ((fun x => (planeSwapMat * A) i x) ᵥ* planeSwapMatᵀ) j = _
  rw [show planeSwapMatᵀ = (planeSwapPerm⁻¹).permMatrix ℝ by
    simp [planeSwapMat]]
  rw [hright]
  change (planeSwapMat *ᵥ (fun x => A x (planeSwapPerm j))) i = _
  exact hleft

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.doubleRotLoop_closed
statement:
theorem doubleRotLoop_closed : ∀ k z,
    doubleRotLoop k z 0 = doubleRotLoop k z 1
  | 0, z => by
      simp only [doubleRotLoop, ContinuousMap.mul_apply,
        ContinuousMap.const_apply]
      rw [so2Loop_linearAngle_closed z]
  | k + 1, z => incLoop_closed (doubleRotLoop_closed k z)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.doubleRotLoop_apply
statement:
theorem doubleRotLoop_apply : ∀ k z (u : I),
    ((doubleRotLoop k z u : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) =
      doubleRotMat k (linearAngle z u)
  | 0, z, u => by
      change rotBlock 4 (linearAngle z u) *
          (planeSwapMat * rotBlock 4 (linearAngle z u) *
            (((planeSwapSO)⁻¹ : SOGroup 4) : Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ)) = _
      have hinv : (((planeSwapSO)⁻¹ : SOGroup 4) :
          Matrix (Fin 4) (Fin 4) ℝ) = planeSwapMatᵀ
proof:
:= by
        have hmul : planeSwapSO * ⟨planeSwapMatᵀ, by
            rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
            exact ⟨(Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff _ _).mpr
              (by
                rw [Matrix.transpose_transpose]
                exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp planeSwapMat_mul_transpose), by
                rw [Matrix.det_transpose, planeSwapMat_det]⟩⟩ = 1 :=
          Subtype.ext planeSwapMat_mul_transpose
        exact congrArg Subtype.val (eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hmul).symm
      rw [hinv, ← doubleRotMat_zero_factor]
  | k + 1, z, u => by
      change incMatrix
          (((doubleRotLoop k z u : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
            Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)) = _
      rw [doubleRotLoop_apply k z u]
      rfl

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.doubleRotLoop_class_zero
statement:
theorem doubleRotLoop_class_zero : ∀ k z,
    loopClassZ2 (doubleRotLoop k z) (doubleRotLoop_closed k z) = 0
  | 0, z => by
      let γ
proof:
:= so2Loop 4 (linearAngle z)
      let δ := (ContinuousMap.const I planeSwapSO * γ) *
        ContinuousMap.const I planeSwapSO⁻¹
      have hγ : γ 0 = γ 1 := so2Loop_linearAngle_closed z
      have hδ : δ 0 = δ 1 := by
        change (planeSwapSO * γ 0) * planeSwapSO⁻¹ =
          (planeSwapSO * γ 1) * planeSwapSO⁻¹
        rw [hγ]
      change loopClassZ2 (γ * δ) _ = 0
      rw [loopClassZ2_mul γ δ hγ hδ]
      rw [show loopClassZ2 δ hδ = loopClassZ2 γ hγ by
        exact loopClassZ2_const_conj planeSwapSO γ hγ]
      exact ZModModule.add_self _
  | k + 1, z => by
      exact (loopClassZ2_stable (m := k + 4) (by omega)
        (doubleRotLoop k z) (doubleRotLoop_closed k z)).trans
          (doubleRotLoop_class_zero k z)
