name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstInitialSO_apply
proof:
:= by
  change (doubleSignMatrix (2 : Fin (k + 3)) *
      (tubeInitialSO (k + 1) :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)) i j = _
  rw [doubleSignMatrix, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  have h01 := fin_zero_ne_one k
  have h02 := fin_zero_ne_two k
  have h03 := fin_zero_ne_three k
  have h12 := fin_one_ne_two k
  have h13 := fin_one_ne_three k
  have h23 := fin_two_ne_three k
  have hs : ((2 : Fin (k + 3)).succ : Fin (k + 4)) = 3 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < k + 3),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < k + 4)]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases hi1 : i = 1 <;>
    by_cases hi2 : i = 2 <;> by_cases hi3 : i = 3 <;>
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0 <;> by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;>
    by_cases hj2 : j = 2 <;> by_cases hj3 : j = 3 <;>
    by_cases hji : j = i <;>
    simp_all [doubleSignCoeff, hs, tubeInitialSO_apply]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondInitialSO_apply
proof:
:= by
  change ((tubeInitialSO (k + 1) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) * planeSwapMatN k) i j = _
  rw [mul_planeSwapMatN_apply, tubeInitialSO_apply]
  have h01 := fin_zero_ne_one k
  have h02 := fin_zero_ne_two k
  have h03 := fin_zero_ne_three k
  have h12 := fin_one_ne_two k
  have h13 := fin_one_ne_three k
  have h23 := fin_two_ne_three k
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases hi1 : i = 1 <;>
    by_cases hi2 : i = 2 <;> by_cases hi3 : i = 3 <;>
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0 <;> by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;>
    by_cases hj2 : j = 2 <;> by_cases hj3 : j = 3 <;>
    by_cases hji : j = i <;>
    simp_all [planeSwapPermN_symm_apply_zero,
      planeSwapPermN_symm_apply_one, planeSwapPermN_symm_apply_two,
      planeSwapPermN_symm_apply_three, planeSwapPermN_symm_apply_other,
      eq_comm]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.mul_firstInitialSO_apply
statement:
lemma mul_firstInitialSO_apply
    (A : Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (k + 4)) :
    (A * ((firstInitialSO k : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)) i j =
      if j = 0 then A i 1 else if j = 1 then A i 0
      else if j = 2 then A i 2 else if j = 3 then -A i 3 else A i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  have h01 := fin_zero_ne_one k
  have h02 := fin_zero_ne_two k
  have h03 := fin_zero_ne_three k
  have h12 := fin_one_ne_two k
  have h13 := fin_one_ne_three k
  have h23 := fin_two_ne_three k
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (1 : Fin (k + 4))]
    · simp [firstInitialSO_apply, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
        eq_comm]
    · intro c _ hc
      simp [firstInitialSO_apply, hc, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
        eq_comm] <;> aesop
    · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
  · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
    · subst j
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0 : Fin (k + 4))]
      · simp [firstInitialSO_apply, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
          eq_comm]
      · intro c _ hc
        simp [firstInitialSO_apply, hc, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
          eq_comm] <;> aesop
      · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
    · by_cases hj2 : j = 2
      · subst j
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (2 : Fin (k + 4))]
        · simp [firstInitialSO_apply, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
            eq_comm]
        · intro c _ hc
          simp [firstInitialSO_apply, hc, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
            eq_comm] <;> aesop
        · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
      · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
        · subst j
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (3 : Fin (k + 4))]
          · simp [firstInitialSO_apply, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
              eq_comm]
          · intro c _ hc
            simp [firstInitialSO_apply, hc, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
              eq_comm] <;> aesop
          · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
        · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
          · simp [firstInitialSO_apply, hj0, hj1, hj2, hj3, eq_comm]
          · intro c _ hc
            simp [firstInitialSO_apply, hj0, hj1, hj2, hj3, hc, eq_comm] <;>
              aesop
          · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstHopfSO_apply
statement:
lemma firstHopfSO_apply (theta : ℝ) (i j : Fin (k + 4)) :
    ((firstHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) i j =
      if i = 0 then
        (if j = 0 then -Real.sin theta
          else if j = 1 then Real.cos theta else 0)
      else if i = 1 then
        (if j = 0 then Real.cos theta
          else if j = 1 then Real.sin theta else 0)
      else if i = 2 then
        (if j = 2 then Real.cos theta
          else if j = 3 then Real.sin theta else 0)
      else if i = 3 then
        (if j = 2 then Real.sin theta
          else if j = 3 then -Real.cos theta else 0)
      else if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  change (doubleRotMat k theta *
    ((firstInitialSO k : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)) i j = _
  rw [mul_firstInitialSO_apply]
  simp_rw [doubleRotMat_apply]
  have h01 := fin_zero_ne_one k
  have h02 := fin_zero_ne_two k
  have h03 := fin_zero_ne_three k
  have h12 := fin_one_ne_two k
  have h13 := fin_one_ne_three k
  have h23 := fin_two_ne_three k
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases hi1 : i = 1 <;>
    by_cases hi2 : i = 2 <;> by_cases hi3 : i = 3 <;>
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0 <;> by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;>
    by_cases hj2 : j = 2 <;> by_cases hj3 : j = 3 <;>
    by_cases hji : j = i <;>
    simp_all [eq_comm]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.mul_secondInitialSO_apply
statement:
lemma mul_secondInitialSO_apply
    (A : Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (k + 4)) :
    (A * ((secondInitialSO k : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)) i j =
      if j = 0 then A i 2 else if j = 1 then A i 3
      else if j = 2 then A i 1 else if j = 3 then -A i 0 else A i j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
  have h01 := fin_zero_ne_one k
  have h02 := fin_zero_ne_two k
  have h03 := fin_zero_ne_three k
  have h12 := fin_one_ne_two k
  have h13 := fin_one_ne_three k
  have h23 := fin_two_ne_three k
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (2 : Fin (k + 4))]
    · simp [secondInitialSO_apply, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
        eq_comm]
    · intro c _ hc
      simp [secondInitialSO_apply, hc, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
        eq_comm] <;> aesop
    · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
  · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
    · subst j
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (3 : Fin (k + 4))]
      · simp [secondInitialSO_apply, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
          eq_comm]
      · intro c _ hc
        simp [secondInitialSO_apply, hc, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
          eq_comm] <;> aesop
      · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
    · by_cases hj2 : j = 2
      · subst j
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (1 : Fin (k + 4))]
        · simp [secondInitialSO_apply, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
            eq_comm]
        · intro c _ hc
          simp [secondInitialSO_apply, hc, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
            eq_comm] <;> aesop
        · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
      · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
        · subst j
          rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (0 : Fin (k + 4))]
          · simp [secondInitialSO_apply, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
              eq_comm]
          · intro c _ hc
            simp [secondInitialSO_apply, hc, h01, h02, h03, h12, h13, h23,
              eq_comm] <;> aesop
          · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h
        · rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
          · simp [secondInitialSO_apply, hj0, hj1, hj2, hj3, eq_comm]
          · intro c _ hc
            simp [secondInitialSO_apply, hj0, hj1, hj2, hj3, hc, eq_comm] <;>
              aesop
          · exact fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondHopfSO_apply
statement:
lemma secondHopfSO_apply (theta : ℝ) (i j : Fin (k + 4)) :
    ((secondHopfSO k theta : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ) i j =
      if i = 0 then
        (if j = 2 then Real.sin theta
          else if j = 3 then -Real.cos theta else 0)
      else if i = 1 then
        (if j = 2 then Real.cos theta
          else if j = 3 then Real.sin theta else 0)
      else if i = 2 then
        (if j = 0 then Real.cos theta
          else if j = 1 then Real.sin theta else 0)
      else if i = 3 then
        (if j = 0 then -Real.sin theta
          else if j = 1 then Real.cos theta else 0)
      else if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  change (doubleRotMat k (-theta) *
    ((secondInitialSO k : SOGroup (k + 4)) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 4)) (Fin (k + 4)) ℝ)) i j = _
  rw [mul_secondInitialSO_apply]
  simp_rw [doubleRotMat_apply]
  have h01 := fin_zero_ne_one k
  have h02 := fin_zero_ne_two k
  have h03 := fin_zero_ne_three k
  have h12 := fin_one_ne_two k
  have h13 := fin_one_ne_three k
  have h23 := fin_two_ne_three k
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0 <;> by_cases hi1 : i = 1 <;>
    by_cases hi2 : i = 2 <;> by_cases hi3 : i = 3 <;>
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0 <;> by_cases hj1 : j = 1 <;>
    by_cases hj2 : j = 2 <;> by_cases hj3 : j = 3 <;>
    by_cases hji : j = i <;>
    simp_all [eq_comm, Real.sin_neg, Real.cos_neg]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetRadiusSq_pos
statement: theorem targetRadiusSq_pos (theta : ℝ) : 0 < targetRadiusSq theta
proof:
:= by
  let c := Real.cos (2 * theta)
  let s := Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 + 1 / 2)
  have hinside : 0 ≤ c ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsSq : s ^ 2 = c ^ 2 + 1 / 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hinside
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  change 0 < c + s
  nlinarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetRadius_pos
statement: theorem targetRadius_pos (theta : ℝ) : 0 < targetRadius theta
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (targetRadiusSq_pos theta)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetRadius_sq
statement:
theorem targetRadius_sq (theta : ℝ) :
    targetRadius theta ^ 2 = targetRadiusSq theta
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.sq_sqrt (targetRadiusSq_pos theta).le

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetPoint_apply_planeFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem targetPoint_apply_planeFirst (theta : ℝ) :
    targetPoint m theta (planeFirst m) =
      targetRadius theta * Real.cos theta
proof:
:= by
  have hAB : planeFirst m ≠ planeSecond m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
  simp [targetPoint, hAB]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetPoint_apply_planeSecond
statement:
@[simp] theorem targetPoint_apply_planeSecond (theta : ℝ) :
    targetPoint m theta (planeSecond m) =
      targetRadius theta * Real.sin theta
proof:
:= by
  have hBA : planeSecond m ≠ planeFirst m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
  simp [targetPoint, hBA]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetPoint_apply_transverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem targetPoint_apply_transverse (theta : ℝ)
    (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    targetPoint m theta j.castSucc.castSucc = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hjA : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ planeFirst m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [planeFirst] at this
    omega
  have hjB : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ planeSecond m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [planeSecond] at this
    omega
  simp [targetPoint, hjA, hjB]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.radiusSq_targetPoint
statement:
theorem radiusSq_targetPoint (theta : ℝ) :
    radiusSq m (targetPoint m theta) = targetRadiusSq theta
proof:
:= by
  rw [radiusSq, targetPoint_apply_planeFirst, targetPoint_apply_planeSecond]
  rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, targetRadius_sq]
  calc
    targetRadiusSq theta * Real.cos theta ^ 2 +
        targetRadiusSq theta * Real.sin theta ^ 2 =
      targetRadiusSq theta *
        (Real.cos theta ^ 2 + Real.sin theta ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = targetRadiusSq theta := by
      rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetRadiusSq_equation
statement:
theorem targetRadiusSq_equation (theta : ℝ) :
    targetRadiusSq theta ^ 2 -
        2 * targetRadiusSq theta * Real.cos (2 * theta) = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  let c := Real.cos (2 * theta)
  let s := Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 + 1 / 2)
  have hinside : 0 ≤ c ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsSq : s ^ 2 = c ^ 2 + 1 / 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hinside
  change (c + s) ^ 2 - 2 * (c + s) * c = 1 / 2
  nlinarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.cos_sq_sub_sin_sq
statement:
theorem cos_sq_sub_sin_sq (theta : ℝ) :
    Real.cos theta ^ 2 - Real.sin theta ^ 2 = Real.cos (2 * theta)
proof:
:= by
  exact (Real.cos_two_mul' theta).symm

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_targetPoint
statement:
theorem cassiniQ_targetPoint (theta : ℝ) :
    cassiniQ m (targetPoint m theta) = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [cassiniQ_eq, radiusSq_targetPoint,
    targetPoint_apply_planeFirst, targetPoint_apply_planeSecond]
  rw [mul_pow, mul_pow, targetRadius_sq]
  have htrig := cos_sq_sub_sin_sq theta
  have heq := targetRadiusSq_equation theta
  calc
    targetRadiusSq theta ^ 2 -
          2 * (targetRadiusSq theta * Real.cos theta ^ 2) +
          2 * (targetRadiusSq theta * Real.sin theta ^ 2) =
        targetRadiusSq theta ^ 2 - 2 * targetRadiusSq theta *
          (Real.cos theta ^ 2 - Real.sin theta ^ 2) := by ring
    _ = targetRadiusSq theta ^ 2 -
        2 * targetRadiusSq theta * Real.cos (2 * theta) := by rw [htrig]
    _ = 1 / 2 := heq

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetPoint_mem_target_fiber
statement:
theorem targetPoint_mem_target_fiber (theta : ℝ) :
    targetPoint m theta ∈ (targetFLS m).fiber
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      simp [targetFLS, levelMap, cassiniQ_targetPoint]
  | cast j =>
      simp [targetFLS, levelMap]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_targetRadiusSq
statement: theorem continuous_targetRadiusSq : Continuous targetRadiusSq
proof:
:= by
  unfold targetRadiusSq
  fun_prop

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_targetRadius
statement: theorem continuous_targetRadius : Continuous targetRadius
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp continuous_targetRadiusSq

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_targetPoint
statement: theorem continuous_targetPoint : Continuous (targetPoint m)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((continuous_targetRadius.mul Real.continuous_cos).smul
      continuous_const).add
    ((continuous_targetRadius.mul Real.continuous_sin).smul continuous_const)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetPoint_eq_iff_mod
proof:
:= by
  have hrho : targetRadiusSq theta = targetRadiusSq theta' := by
    have := congrArg (radiusSq m) h
    simpa [radiusSq_targetPoint] using this
  have hr : targetRadius theta = targetRadius theta' := by
    simp only [targetRadius]
    rw [hrho]
  have hr0 : targetRadius theta ≠ 0 := (targetRadius_pos theta).ne'
  have hcos : Real.cos theta = Real.cos theta' := by
    have hc := congrArg (fun x : E => x (planeFirst m)) h
    simp only [targetPoint_apply_planeFirst] at hc
    rw [← hr] at hc
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hr0 hc
  have hsin : Real.sin theta = Real.sin theta' := by
    have hs := congrArg (fun x : E => x (planeSecond m)) h
    simp only [targetPoint_apply_planeSecond] at hs
    rw [← hr] at hs
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hr0 hs
  have hone : Real.cos (theta' - theta) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.cos_sub, ← hcos, ← hsin]
    linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff _).mp hone
  exact ⟨z, by linarith⟩

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetPoint_two_pi
statement:
theorem targetPoint_two_pi :
    targetPoint m (2 * Real.pi) = targetPoint m 0
proof:
:= by
  have hfour : Real.cos (2 * (2 * Real.pi)) = 1 := by
    rw [show 2 * (2 * Real.pi) = 2 * Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi by ring,
      Real.cos_add]
    simp
  unfold targetPoint targetRadius targetRadiusSq
  simp [Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi, hfour]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetCurve_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem targetCurve_zero : targetCurve m 0 = targetPoint m 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [targetCurve]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetCurve_closed
statement: theorem targetCurve_closed : targetCurve m 0 = targetCurve m 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [targetCurve_zero]
  change targetPoint m 0 = targetPoint m (2 * Real.pi * (1 : ℝ))
  norm_num
  exact (targetPoint_two_pi m).symm

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetCurve_eq_cases
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := targetPoint_eq_iff_mod m huv
  have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
  have huvZ : (v : ℝ) = (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) := by
    change 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ) =
      2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) at hz
    nlinarith
  have hzLowerR : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  have hzUpperR : (z : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
  have hzLower : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast hzLowerR
  have hzUpper : z ≤ (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hzUpperR
  rcases (show z = -1 ∨ z = 0 ∨ z = 1 by omega) with hzv | hzv | hzv
  · right; right
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hzv] at huvZ
    norm_num at huvZ
    exact huvZ.symm
  · right; left
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetPoint_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem targetPoint_mem_orbit (V : TamedField (targetFLS m)) (theta : ℝ) :
    targetPoint m theta ∈ V.orbit (targetPoint m 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact V.continuousCurve_mem_orbit (targetPoint m) (continuous_targetPoint m)
    (targetPoint_mem_target_fiber m) theta

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.radiusSq_pos_of_mem_target_fiber
statement:
theorem radiusSq_pos_of_mem_target_fiber {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ (targetFLS m).fiber) : 0 < radiusSq m x
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 : 0 ≤ radiusSq m x := by
    simp [radiusSq]
    positivity
  apply lt_of_le_of_ne hr0
  intro hr
  have hrz : radiusSq m x = 0 := hr.symm
  have hA : x (planeFirst m) = 0 := by
    have hs : x (planeFirst m) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      have := sq_nonneg (x (planeSecond m))
      simp [radiusSq] at hrz
      nlinarith
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hs
  have hB : x (planeSecond m) = 0 := by
    have hs : x (planeSecond m) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      have := sq_nonneg (x (planeFirst m))
      simp [radiusSq] at hrz
      nlinarith
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hs
  have hq := cassiniQ_eq_level_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx
  rw [cassiniQ_eq] at hq
  rw [hrz, hA, hB] at hq
  norm_num at hq

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.targetRadiusSq_eq_of_polar_coordinates
statement:
theorem targetRadiusSq_eq_of_polar_coordinates
    {x : E} {theta : ℝ} (hx : x ∈ (targetFLS m).fiber)
    (hcos : Real.cos theta =
      x (planeFirst m) / Real.sqrt (radiusSq m x))
    (hsin : Real.sin theta =
      x (planeSecond m) / Real.sqrt (radiusSq m x)) :
    radiusSq m x = targetRadiusSq theta
proof:
:= by
  let rho := radiusSq m x
  let c := Real.cos (2 * theta)
  let s := Real.sqrt (c ^ 2 + 1 / 2)
  have hrho : 0 < rho := radiusSq_pos_of_mem_target_fiber m hx
  have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt rho) ^ 2 = rho := Real.sq_sqrt hrho.le
  have hsqrt0 : Real.sqrt rho ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hrho).ne'
  have hxA : x (planeFirst m) = Real.sqrt rho * Real.cos theta := by
    change Real.cos theta = x (planeFirst m) / Real.sqrt rho at hcos
    rw [hcos]
    field_simp
  have hxB : x (planeSecond m) = Real.sqrt rho * Real.sin theta := by
    change Real.sin theta = x (planeSecond m) / Real.sqrt rho at hsin
    rw [hsin]
    field_simp
  have hq := cassiniQ_eq_level_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx
  rw [cassiniQ_eq] at hq
  change rho ^ 2 - 2 * x (planeFirst m) ^ 2 +
      2 * x (planeSecond m) ^ 2 = 1 / 2 at hq
  rw [hxA, hxB, mul_pow, mul_pow, hsqrt] at hq
  have htrig := cos_sq_sub_sin_sq theta
  have hquad : rho ^ 2 - 2 * rho * c = 1 / 2 := by
    change rho ^ 2 - 2 * rho * Real.cos (2 * theta) = 1 / 2
    calc
      rho ^ 2 - 2 * rho * Real.cos (2 * theta) =
          rho ^ 2 - 2 * rho *
            (Real.cos theta ^ 2 - Real.sin theta ^ 2) := by rw [htrig]
      _ = 1 / 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsInside : 0 ≤ c ^ 2 + (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hsSq : s ^ 2 = c ^ 2 + 1 / 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hsInside
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hdiffSq : (rho - c) ^ 2 = s ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hdiffPos : 0 < rho - c := by
    by_cases hc : 0 < c
    · have hprod : 0 < rho * (rho - 2 * c) := by nlinarith
      have : 0 < rho - 2 * c := by
        rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hprod with hp | hn
        · exact hp.2
        · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge hrho.le) hn.1)
      nlinarith
    · have hc0 : c ≤ 0 := not_lt.mp hc
      linarith
  have hdiff : rho - c = s := by
    nlinarith
  change rho = c + s
  linarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.target_fiber_eq_range
statement:
theorem target_fiber_eq_range :
    (targetFLS m).fiber = Set.range (targetPoint m)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    let rho := radiusSq m x
    have hrho : 0 < rho := radiusSq_pos_of_mem_target_fiber m hx
    have hsqrt : (Real.sqrt rho) ^ 2 = rho := Real.sq_sqrt hrho.le
    have hsqrt0 : Real.sqrt rho ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.2 hrho).ne'
    have hunit :
        (x (planeFirst m) / Real.sqrt rho) ^ 2 +
          (x (planeSecond m) / Real.sqrt rho) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      calc
        (x (planeFirst m) / Real.sqrt rho) ^ 2 +
            (x (planeSecond m) / Real.sqrt rho) ^ 2 =
          (x (planeFirst m) ^ 2 + x (planeSecond m) ^ 2) /
            (Real.sqrt rho) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = rho / rho := by rw [hsqrt]; rfl
        _ = 1 := div_self hrho.ne'
    obtain ⟨theta, hcos, hsin⟩ :=
      StandardBirth.exists_angle_of_sq_add_sq_eq_one hunit
    have hrhoTarget : rho = targetRadiusSq theta :=
      targetRadiusSq_eq_of_polar_coordinates m hx hcos hsin
    have hradius : Real.sqrt rho = targetRadius theta := by
      simp only [targetRadius]
      rw [hrhoTarget]
    refine ⟨theta, ?_⟩
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext i
    induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
        change targetPoint m theta (planeSecond m) = x (planeSecond m)
        rw [targetPoint_apply_planeSecond, ← hradius, hsin]
        field_simp
    | cast i =>
        induction i using Fin.lastCases with
        | last =>
            change targetPoint m theta (planeFirst m) = x (planeFirst m)
            rw [targetPoint_apply_planeFirst, ← hradius, hcos]
            field_simp
        | cast j =>
            have hxj := transverse_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx j
            change targetPoint m theta j.castSucc.castSucc =
              x j.castSucc.castSucc
            rw [targetPoint_apply_transverse, hxj]
  · rintro ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    exact targetPoint_mem_target_fiber m theta

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.target_orbit_eq_fiber

    V.orbit (targetPoint m 0) = (targetFLS m).fiber
proof:

  · exact V.orbit_subset_fiber (targetPoint_mem_target_fiber m 0)
  · rw [target_fiber_eq_range m]

    exact targetPoint_mem_orbit m V theta

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.target_framedDelta_eq_paramFrameClass_add_one

    (V : TamedField (targetFLS m)) :
    V.framedDelta =
      loopClassZ2 (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
        (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [target_framedDelta_eq_orbitContribution]
  unfold TamedField.orbitContribution TamedField.orbitFrameClass
  have hpoint : V.orbitPoint (targetOrbitIndex m V) ∈
      V.orbit (targetPoint m 0) := by
    rw [← targetOrbitIndex_coe m V, V.orbitPoint_orbit]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  have hbase :
      V.fundamentalFrameClass
          (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (targetOrbitIndex m V)) =
        V.fundamentalFrameClass (targetPoint_mem_target_fiber m 0) :=
    V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit
      (targetPoint_mem_target_fiber m 0) hpoint
  change V.fundamentalFrameClass
      (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (targetOrbitIndex m V)) + 1 = _
  rw [hbase, ← target_paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental m V]

name: Submission.mem_of_isClosed_of_Ioo
statement:
theorem mem_of_isClosed_of_Ioo {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y]
    (g : C(I, Y)) {S : Set Y} (hS : IsClosed S)
    (h : ∀ w : I, (0 : ℝ) < (w : ℝ) → (w : ℝ) < 1 → g w ∈ S) (q : I) :
    g q ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous
      (fun x : ℝ => g (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one x)) :=
    g.continuous.comp continuous_projIcc
  have hclosed : IsClosed
      ((fun x : ℝ => g (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one x)) ⁻¹' S) :=
    hS.preimage hcont
  have hsub : Set.Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆
      (fun x : ℝ => g (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one x)) ⁻¹' S := by
    intro x hx
    have hmem : x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := ⟨hx.1.le, hx.2.le⟩
    show g (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one x) ∈ S
    rw [Set.projIcc_of_mem _ hmem]
    exact h ⟨x, hmem⟩ hx.1 hx.2
  have hIcc : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆
      (fun x : ℝ => g (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one x)) ⁻¹' S := by
    have h1 := closure_mono hsub
    rw [closure_Ioo (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≠ 1), hclosed.closure_eq] at h1
    exact h1
  have hq : (q : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := q.2
  have h2 : g (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one ((q : I) : ℝ)) ∈ S := hIcc hq
  rwa [Set.projIcc_val] at h2

name: Submission.closingHalf_subset_of_covering
statement:
theorem closingHalf_subset_of_covering (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V)
    {O : V.OrbitIndex} (hO : V.orbitPoint O ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))} (hS : IsClosed S)
    (hcov : ((O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) \ S) ⊆
      Set.range (fun z : I => P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) halfI z)))
    (q : I) : P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb halfI (1 : I) q) ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have hOrb : ∀ c : I,
      P.curve c ∈ (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro c
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O, V.orbit_eq_of_mem hO]
    exact P.curve_mem_orbit c
  have hcoeA : ∀ z : I,
      ((Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) halfI z : I) : ℝ) = (z : ℝ) / 2 := by
    intro z
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_convexComb]
    show (1 - (z : ℝ)) * (0 : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) = (z : ℝ) / 2
    ring
  have hcoeB : ∀ w : I,
      ((Set.Icc.convexComb halfI (1 : I) w : I) : ℝ) = 1 / 2 + (w : ℝ) / 2 := by
    intro w
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_convexComb]
    show (1 - (w : ℝ)) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) + (w : ℝ) * (1 : ℝ) = 1 / 2 + (w : ℝ) / 2
    ring
  refine mem_of_isClosed_of_Ioo
    (P.curve.comp ⟨Set.Icc.convexComb halfI (1 : I),
      Set.Icc.continuous_convexComb _ _⟩) hS ?_ q
  intro w hw0 hw1
  show P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb halfI (1 : I) w) ∈ S
  by_contra hns
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := hcov ⟨hOrb _, hns⟩
  rcases P.curve_eq_cases hz with hcase | ⟨hc1, hc2⟩ | ⟨hc1, hc2⟩
  · have h := congrArg Subtype.val hcase
    rw [hcoeA, hcoeB] at h
    have hz1 : (z : ℝ) ≤ 1 := z.2.2
    linarith
  · have h := congrArg Subtype.val hc2
    rw [hcoeB] at h
    have hone : ((1 : I) : ℝ) = 1 := rfl
    rw [hone] at h
    linarith
  · have h := congrArg Subtype.val hc1
    rw [hcoeA] at h
    have hone : ((1 : I) : ℝ) = 1 := rfl
    rw [hone] at h
    have hz1 : (z : ℝ) ≤ 1 := z.2.2
    linarith

name: Submission.saddleBandBeforeArcsInRange_of_covering
statement:
theorem saddleBandBeforeArcsInRange_of_covering
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hbefore hafter Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat)
    (hpin : SaddleBandBeforeCutsPinned F)
    {S₁ S₂ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
    (hS₁ : IsClosed S₁) (hS₂ : IsClosed S₂)
    (hcov : SaddleBandBeforeArcsCovering F S₁ S₂) :
    SaddleBandBeforeArcsInRange F S₁ S₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p0, p1, q0, q1⟩ := hpin
  obtain ⟨cov1, cov2⟩ := hcov
  rw [p1] at cov1
  rw [q1] at cov2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q
    rw [p1]
    exact closingHalf_subset_of_covering F.before₁Param F.before₁Param_orbit
      hS₁ cov1 q
  · intro q
    have h := closingHalf_subset_of_covering F.before₁Param
      F.before₁Param_orbit hS₁ cov1 (1 : I)
    rw [Set.Icc.convexComb_one] at h
    rw [p0, Set.Icc.convexComb_eq, F.before₁Param.curve_closed]
    exact h
  · intro q
    rw [q1]
    exact closingHalf_subset_of_covering F.before₂Param F.before₂Param_orbit
      hS₂ cov2 q
  · intro q
    have h := closingHalf_subset_of_covering F.before₂Param
      F.before₂Param_orbit hS₂ cov2 (1 : I)
    rw [Set.Icc.convexComb_one] at h
    rw [q0, Set.Icc.convexComb_eq, F.before₂Param.curve_closed]
    exact h

name: Submission.iteratedDeriv_const_add_sq_mul
statement:
private theorem iteratedDeriv_const_add_sq_mul (c a : ℝ) :
    iteratedDeriv 2 (fun x : ℝ => c + x ^ 2 * a) 0 = 2 * a
proof:
:= by
  rw [show iteratedDeriv 2 (fun x : ℝ => c + x ^ 2 * a) 0 =
      deriv (deriv (fun x : ℝ => c + x ^ 2 * a)) 0 by
    rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 by norm_num, iteratedDeriv_succ,
      iteratedDeriv_one]]
  have hfirst : deriv (fun x : ℝ => c + x ^ 2 * a) =
      fun x : ℝ => (2 * x) * a := by
    funext x
    simpa [id_eq, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
      ((hasDerivAt_const (x := x) c).add
        (((hasDerivAt_id x).pow 2).mul_const a)).deriv
  rw [hfirst]
  simpa [id_eq, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using
    (((hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).const_mul 2).mul_const a).deriv

name: Submission.iteratedDeriv_morseLine
statement:
private theorem iteratedDeriv_morseLine
    (e : MorseIndexTwo) (c : ℝ) (v : E₂) :
    iteratedDeriv 2
      (fun t : ℝ => c + morseQuadratic e ((t • v) 0, (t • v) 1)) 0 =
      match e with
      | .minimum => 2 * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2)
      | .saddle => 2 * (v 0 ^ 2 - v 1 ^ 2)
      | .maximum => -2 * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  cases e with
  | minimum =>
      simp only [morseQuadratic, smul_eq_mul, PiLp.smul_apply]
      rw [show (fun t : ℝ => c + ((t * v 0) ^ 2 + (t * v 1) ^ 2)) =
          fun t : ℝ => c + t ^ 2 * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2) by
        funext t; ring]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_const_add_sq_mul]
  | saddle =>
      simp only [morseQuadratic, smul_eq_mul, PiLp.smul_apply]
      rw [show (fun t : ℝ => c + ((t * v 0) ^ 2 - (t * v 1) ^ 2)) =
          fun t : ℝ => c + t ^ 2 * (v 0 ^ 2 - v 1 ^ 2) by
        funext t; ring]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_const_add_sq_mul]
  | maximum =>
      simp only [morseQuadratic, smul_eq_mul, PiLp.smul_apply]
      rw [show (fun t : ℝ => c + (-(t * v 0) ^ 2 - (t * v 1) ^ 2)) =
          fun t : ℝ => c + t ^ 2 * (-(v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2)) by
        funext t; ring]
      rw [iteratedDeriv_const_add_sq_mul]
      ring

name: Submission.LocalMorseNormalForm.fderiv_param_injective
statement:
theorem fderiv_param_injective {f : E₂ → ℝ}
    (M : LocalMorseNormalForm f) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f 0)
    (hcrit : fderiv ℝ f 0 = 0) :
    Injective (fderiv ℝ M.param 0)
proof:
:= by
  let J : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂ := fderiv ℝ M.param 0
  have hparam2 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 M.param 0 :=
    contDiffAt_infty.mp M.param_contDiffAt 2
  have hline (v : E₂) : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun t : ℝ => t • v) 0 := by
    exact (contDiff_id.smul contDiff_const).contDiffAt
  have hcurve (v : E₂) :
      ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun t : ℝ => M.param (t • v)) 0 := by
    let l : ℝ → E₂ := fun t => t • v
    have hl : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 l 0 := hline v
    have hp : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 M.param (l 0) := by
      simpa [l] using hparam2
    exact ContDiffAt.fun_comp (f := l) (g := M.param) 0 hp hl
  have hcurve_deriv (v : E₂) :
      deriv (fun t : ℝ => M.param (t • v)) 0 = J v := by
    have hs : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t • v) v 0 := by
      simpa using (hasDerivAt_id (0 : ℝ)).smul_const v
    have hp : HasFDerivAt M.param J ((0 : ℝ) • v) := by
      simpa [J] using
        (hparam2.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasFDerivAt
    have hc := hp.comp_hasDerivAt 0 hs
    simpa [J, Function.comp_def] using hc.deriv
  have hevent (v : E₂) :
      (fun t : ℝ => f (M.param (t • v))) =ᶠ[nhds 0]
        (fun t : ℝ => f 0 +
          morseQuadratic M.index ((t • v) 0, (t • v) 1)) := by
    have ht : Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => t • v) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa [id_eq] using (continuousAt_id.smul_const v :
        ContinuousAt (fun t : ℝ => t • v) 0)
    have hsmall := ht (ball_mem_nhds (0 : E₂) M.radius_pos)
    filter_upwards [hsmall] with t ht'
    apply M.exact
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using ht'
  have hmodel (v : E₂) :
      iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => f (M.param (t • v))) 0 =
        match M.index with
        | .minimum => 2 * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2)
        | .saddle => 2 * (v 0 ^ 2 - v 1 ^ 2)
        | .maximum => -2 * (v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2) := by
    rw [(hevent v).iteratedDeriv_eq 2]
    exact iteratedDeriv_morseLine M.index (f 0) v
  have hsecond (v : E₂) :
      iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => f (M.param (t • v))) 0 =
        iteratedFDeriv ℝ 2 f 0 (fun _ => J v) := by
    have hf0 : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f (M.param ((0 : ℝ) • v)) := by
      simpa [M.param_zero] using hf
    have hcomp := iteratedDeriv_vcomp_two hf0 (hcurve v)
    change iteratedDeriv 2
      (f ∘ fun t : ℝ => M.param (t • v)) 0 = _
    rw [hcomp]
    simp only [zero_smul, M.param_zero, hcurve_deriv, hcrit, zero_apply,
      add_zero]
  have hker : ∀ v : E₂, J v = 0 → v = 0 := by
    intro v hv
    have hvzero :
        iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => f (M.param (t • v))) 0 = 0 := by
      rw [hsecond, hv]
      exact ContinuousMultilinearMap.map_zero _
    cases hi : M.index with
    | minimum =>
        rw [hmodel] at hvzero
        simp [hi] at hvzero
        have hv0 : v 0 = 0 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0), sq_nonneg (v 1)]
        have hv1 : v 1 = 0 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0), sq_nonneg (v 1)]
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [hv0, hv1]
    | maximum =>
        rw [hmodel] at hvzero
        simp [hi] at hvzero
        have hv0 : v 0 = 0 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0), sq_nonneg (v 1)]
        have hv1 : v 1 = 0 := by
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v 0), sq_nonneg (v 1)]
        ext i
        fin_cases i <;> simp [hv0, hv1]
    | saddle =>
        rw [hmodel] at hvzero
        simp [hi] at hvzero
        let e₀ : E₂ := EuclideanSpace.single 0 1
        have hJadd : J (v + e₀) = J e₀ := by rw [map_add, hv, zero_add]
        have hcompare :
            iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => f (M.param (t • (v + e₀)))) 0 =
              iteratedDeriv 2 (fun t : ℝ => f (M.param (t • e₀))) 0 := by
          rw [hsecond, hsecond, hJadd]
        rw [hmodel, hmodel] at hcompare
        simp [hi, e₀] at hcompare
        have hv0 : v 0 = 0 := by nlinarith [hcompare]
        have hv1 : v 1 = 0 := by
          nlinarith [hvzero, sq_nonneg (v 1)]
        ext i
        fin_cases i
        · exact hv0
        · exact hv1
  intro v w hvw
  apply sub_eq_zero.mp
  apply hker (v - w)
  rw [map_sub, hvw, sub_self]

name: Submission.LocalMorseNormalForm.exists_preimage_norm_lt
statement:
theorem exists_preimage_norm_lt {f : E₂ → ℝ}
    (M : LocalMorseNormalForm f) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f 0)
    (hcrit : fderiv ℝ f 0 = 0) {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 < r) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ y : E₂, ‖y‖ < δ →
      ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧ M.param u = y
proof:
:= by
  let J : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂ := fderiv ℝ M.param 0
  have hJinj : Injective J := M.fderiv_param_injective hf hcrit
  have hJsurj : Surjective J :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank rfl).1 hJinj
  let e : E₂ ≃L[ℝ] E₂ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective J
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hJinj) (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hJsurj)
  have he : (e : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) = J := rfl
  have hfd : HasFDerivAt M.param (e : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) 0 := by
    rw [he]
    exact (M.param_contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
  have hs : HasStrictFDerivAt M.param (e : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) 0 :=
    M.param_contDiffAt.hasStrictFDerivAt' hfd (by simp)
  let inv : E₂ → E₂ := hs.localInverse M.param e 0
  have hright : ∀ᶠ y in nhds (0 : E₂), M.param (inv y) = y := by
    simpa [inv, M.param_zero] using hs.eventually_right_inverse
  have hinv : ∀ᶠ y in nhds (0 : E₂), ‖inv y‖ < r := by
    have ht := hs.localInverse_tendsto (ball_mem_nhds (0 : E₂) hr)
    change (hs.localInverse M.param e 0) ⁻¹' ball (0 : E₂) r ∈
      nhds (M.param 0) at ht
    rw [M.param_zero] at ht
    change inv ⁻¹' ball (0 : E₂) r ∈ nhds (0 : E₂) at ht
    filter_upwards [ht] with y hy
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hy
  have hgood : {y : E₂ | M.param (inv y) = y ∧ ‖inv y‖ < r} ∈
      nhds (0 : E₂) := hright.and hinv
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hgood
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro y hy
  have hyball : y ∈ ball (0 : E₂) δ := by
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hy
  have hy' := hball hyball
  refine ⟨inv y, ?_, hy'.1⟩
  exact hy'.2

name: Submission.LocalMorseNormalForm.exists_fderiv_param_injective_radius
statement:
theorem exists_fderiv_param_injective_radius {f : E₂ → ℝ}
    (M : LocalMorseNormalForm f) (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f 0)
    (hcrit : fderiv ℝ f 0 = 0) {r₀ : ℝ} (hr₀ : 0 < r₀) :
    ∃ r > 0, r ≤ r₀ ∧ ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r →
      Injective (fderiv ℝ M.param u)
proof:
:= by
  let J : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂ := fderiv ℝ M.param 0
  have hJinj : Injective J := M.fderiv_param_injective hf hcrit
  have hJsurj : Surjective J :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank rfl).1 hJinj
  let e : E₂ ≃L[ℝ] E₂ := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective J
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hJinj) (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hJsurj)
  have he : (e : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) = J := rfl
  have hopen : Set.range ((↑) : (E₂ ≃L[ℝ] E₂) → E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) ∈
      nhds (fderiv ℝ M.param 0) := by
    change Set.range ((↑) : (E₂ ≃L[ℝ] E₂) → E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) ∈ nhds J
    rw [← he]
    exact ContinuousLinearEquiv.nhds e
  have hcontinuous : ContinuousAt (fderiv ℝ M.param) 0 :=
    M.param_contDiffAt.continuousAt_fderiv (by simp)
  have hevent : ∀ᶠ u in nhds (0 : E₂),
      fderiv ℝ M.param u ∈
        Set.range ((↑) : (E₂ ≃L[ℝ] E₂) → E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) :=
    hcontinuous hopen
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hevent
  let r := min δ r₀
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hδ hr₀
  refine ⟨r, hr, min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  have hud : ‖u‖ < δ := hu.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have huball : u ∈ ball (0 : E₂) δ := by
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hud
  obtain ⟨e', he'⟩ := hball huball
  rw [← he']
  exact e'.injective

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.recoveryCoordinates_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem recoveryCoordinates_apply
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)

      P.liftCovector (EuclideanSpace.single i 1) v
proof:

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.recoveryCoordinates_param_sub_center
statement:
theorem recoveryCoordinates_param_sub_center
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)
    {u : E₂} (hu : u ∈ P.domain) :
    P.recoveryCoordinates (P.param u - P.center) = u
proof:

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.contDiff_straightening
statement:
theorem contDiff_straightening {C : FramedLevelCobordism n}
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P.straightening
proof:
:= by
  exact C.smooth.prodMk
    (P.recoveryCoordinates.contDiff.comp (contDiff_id.sub contDiff_const))

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.straightening_param
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact P.param_fiber u hu
  · exact P.recoveryCoordinates_param_sub_center hu

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.hasFDerivAt_straightening
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_straightening {C : FramedLevelCobordism n}
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (x : E') :
    HasFDerivAt P.straightening
      ((fderiv ℝ C.G x).prod P.recoveryCoordinates) x
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord : HasFDerivAt
      (fun v : E' => P.recoveryCoordinates (v - P.center))
      P.recoveryCoordinates x := by
    simpa only [map_sub] using
      P.recoveryCoordinates.hasFDerivAt.sub_const
        (P.recoveryCoordinates P.center)
  exact (C.smooth.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt.prodMk hcoord

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.straightening_fderiv_bijective
statement:
theorem straightening_fderiv_bijective
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)
    (hdom : IsOpen P.domain) {z : E₂} (hz : z ∈ P.domain) :
    Bijective (fderiv ℝ P.straightening (P.param z))
proof:
:= by
  let x : E' := P.param z
  let A : E' →L[ℝ] E₂ := P.recoveryCoordinates
  let dG : E' →L[ℝ] F := fderiv ℝ C.G x
  let J : E₂ →L[ℝ] E' := fderiv ℝ P.param z
  let D : E' →L[ℝ] (F × E₂) := dG.prod A
  let ι₂ : E₂ →L[ℝ] (F × E₂) :=
    (0 : E₂ →L[ℝ] F).prod (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E₂)
  have hD : fderiv ℝ P.straightening x = D := by
    exact (P.hasFDerivAt_straightening x).fderiv
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (P.straightening ∘ P.param) (D.comp J) z := by
    exact (P.hasFDerivAt_straightening x).comp z
      (P.param_smooth.differentiable (by simp) z).hasFDerivAt
  have hι : HasFDerivAt (fun u : E₂ => ((0 : F), u)) ι₂ z := by
    simpa [ι₂] using
      ((hasFDerivAt_const (x := z) (0 : F)).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id z))
  have heq : (P.straightening ∘ P.param) =ᶠ[nhds z]
      (fun u : E₂ => ((0 : F), u)) := by
    filter_upwards [hdom.mem_nhds hz] with u hu
    exact P.straightening_param hu
  have hDJ : D.comp J = ι₂ := by
    rw [← hcomp.fderiv, heq.fderiv_eq, hι.fderiv]
  have hpair (u : E₂) : D (J u) = ((0 : F), u) := by
    change (D.comp J) u = ι₂ u
    rw [hDJ]
  have hxzero : C.G x = 0 := P.param_fiber z hz
  have hdGsurj : Surjective dG := by
    exact C.regular x hxzero
  have hDsurj : Surjective D := by
    intro y
    obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hdGsurj y.1
    let q : E₂ := y.2 - A v
    refine ⟨v + J q, ?_⟩
    have hq := hpair q
    have hq0 : dG (J q) = 0 := congrArg Prod.fst hq
    have hqq : A (J q) = q := congrArg Prod.snd hq
    apply Prod.ext
    · change dG (v + J q) = y.1
      rw [map_add, hv, hq0, add_zero]
    · change A (v + J q) = y.2
      rw [map_add, hqq]
      simp [q]
  have hdim : Module.finrank ℝ E' = Module.finrank ℝ (F × E₂) := by
    simp [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
  have hDinj : Injective D :=
    (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hdim).2 hDsurj
  rw [hD]
  exact ⟨hDinj, hDsurj⟩

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.exists_param_of_fiber_near
statement:
theorem exists_param_of_fiber_near
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)
    (hdom : IsOpen P.domain) {z : E₂} (hz : z ∈ P.domain)
    {W : Set E₂} (hW : W ∈ nhds z) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ v : E', dist v (P.param z) < ε → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : E₂, u ∈ W ∧ u ∈ P.domain ∧ P.param u = v
proof:
:= by
  let x : E' := P.param z
  let D : E' →L[ℝ] (F × E₂) := fderiv ℝ P.straightening x
  have hbij : Bijective D := P.straightening_fderiv_bijective hdom hz
  let e : E' ≃L[ℝ] (F × E₂) := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective D
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hbij.1) (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hbij.2)
  have he : (e : E' →L[ℝ] (F × E₂)) = D := rfl
  have hfd : HasFDerivAt P.straightening
      (e : E' →L[ℝ] (F × E₂)) x := by
    rw [he]
    exact (P.contDiff_straightening.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
  have hs : HasStrictFDerivAt P.straightening
      (e : E' →L[ℝ] (F × E₂)) x :=
    P.contDiff_straightening.contDiffAt.hasStrictFDerivAt' hfd (by simp)
  let inv : (F × E₂) → E' :=
    hs.localInverse P.straightening e x
  let L : Set E' := {v | inv (P.straightening v) = v}
  have hL : L ∈ nhds x := by
    exact hs.eventually_left_inverse
  have hparamL : P.param ⁻¹' L ∈ nhds z := by
    have hp : Tendsto P.param (nhds z) (nhds x) := by
      change Tendsto P.param (nhds z) (nhds (P.param z))
      exact P.param_smooth.continuous.continuousAt
    exact hp hL
  let U : Set E₂ := W ∩ P.domain ∩ P.param ⁻¹' L
  have hU : U ∈ nhds z := by
    exact inter_mem (inter_mem hW (hdom.mem_nhds hz)) hparamL
  let coord : E' → E₂ := fun v => P.recoveryCoordinates (v - P.center)
  have hcoordx : coord x = z := by
    exact P.recoveryCoordinates_param_sub_center hz
  have hcoord : Tendsto coord (nhds x) (nhds z) := by
    have hc : ContinuousAt coord x := by
      exact P.recoveryCoordinates.continuous.continuousAt.comp
        (continuousAt_id.sub continuousAt_const)
    rw [← hcoordx]
    exact hc
  have hgood : L ∩ coord ⁻¹' U ∈ nhds x := inter_mem hL (hcoord hU)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hgood
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hzero
  have hvball : v ∈ ball x ε := by
    simpa [mem_ball, x] using hv
  have hvgood := hball hvball
  let u : E₂ := coord v
  have huU : u ∈ U := hvgood.2
  have huW : u ∈ W := huU.1.1
  have hudom : u ∈ P.domain := huU.1.2
  have hparamL' : P.param u ∈ L := huU.2
  have hstraight : P.straightening (P.param u) = P.straightening v := by
    rw [P.straightening_param hudom]
    change ((0 : F), u) = (C.G v, coord v)
    simp [u, hzero]
  have hparam : P.param u = v := by
    calc
      P.param u = inv (P.straightening (P.param u)) := hparamL'.symm
      _ = inv (P.straightening v) := congrArg inv hstraight
      _ = v := hvgood.1
  exact ⟨u, huW, hudom, hparam⟩

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.localSeparatedTime_contDiff_for_exactAssembly
statement:
private theorem localSeparatedTime_contDiff_for_exactAssembly
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G.localSeparatedTime p)
proof:
:= by
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞
    (fun u => (G.tilt p.1).tilted u + G.valueShift p)
  rw [(G.tilt p.1).tilted_eq]
  exact (contDiff_chartLinearTilt
    (B.chart p.1).contDiff_time (G.tilt p.1).q).add contDiff_const

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.exists_criticalModelShrink_fderiv_param_injective_radius
statement:
theorem exists_criticalModelShrink_fderiv_param_injective_radius
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    ∃ r > 0, r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius ∧
      ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r →
        Injective
          (fderiv ℝ (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param u)
proof:
:= by
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G.localSeparatedTime p) :=
    localSeparatedTime_contDiff_for_exactAssembly (G := G) p
  have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2
      (recenter (G.localSeparatedTime p) p.2) 0 :=
    contDiffAt_infty.mp (contDiff_recenter hsmooth p.2).contDiffAt 2
  have hcrit : fderiv ℝ (recenter (G.localSeparatedTime p) p.2) 0 = 0 :=
    fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero
      (nondegenerateCriticalAt_recenter hsmooth
        (G.localSeparatedTime_nondegenerate p hp)).1
  exact (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).exists_fderiv_param_injective_radius
    hf hcrit (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius_pos

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.covers_fiber_of_criticalModelShrink
statement:
theorem covers_fiber_of_criticalModelShrink
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ v : E',
      dist v (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
        ((B.chart p.1).param p.2)) < ε →
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < (R.criticalNormalForm p hp).radius ∧
        R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
          ((B.chart p.1).param
            (p.2 + (R.criticalNormalForm p hp).param u)) = v
proof:
:= by
  let P := B.chart p.1
  let M := G.localMorseNormalForm p hp
  let S := R.criticalModelShrink p hp
  let x : E' := P.param p.2
  let c : E' := R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm x
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G.localSeparatedTime p) :=
    localSeparatedTime_contDiff_for_exactAssembly (G := G) p
  have hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2
      (recenter (G.localSeparatedTime p) p.2) 0 :=
    contDiffAt_infty.mp (contDiff_recenter hsmooth p.2).contDiffAt 2
  have hcrit : fderiv ℝ (recenter (G.localSeparatedTime p) p.2) 0 = 0 :=
    fderiv_eq_zero_of_chartGradient_eq_zero
      (nondegenerateCriticalAt_recenter hsmooth
        (G.localSeparatedTime_nondegenerate p hp)).1
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hM⟩ := M.exists_preimage_norm_lt hf hcrit S.radius_pos
  have hpcore : p.2 ∈ B.core p.1 :=
    ((G.criticalPoints_spec p).mp hp).2
  have hpdom : p.2 ∈ P.domain := B.core_subset_domain p.1 hpcore
  obtain ⟨ε₀, hε₀, hP⟩ :=
    P.exists_param_of_fiber_near (B.domain_open p.1) hpdom
      (ball_mem_nhds p.2 hδ)
  have hforward : Tendsto (fun v : E' => R.amplitude.diffeomorph v)
      (nhds c) (nhds x) := by
    have hcx : R.amplitude.diffeomorph c = x := by
      dsimp [c]
      exact R.amplitude.diffeomorph.apply_symm_apply x
    rw [← hcx]
    exact R.amplitude.diffeomorph.continuous.continuousAt
  have hnear : (fun v : E' => R.amplitude.diffeomorph v) ⁻¹'
      ball x ε₀ ∈ nhds c :=
    hforward (ball_mem_nhds x hε₀)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnear
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hzero
  have hvball : v ∈ ball c ε := by
    simpa [mem_ball, c] using hv
  have hforwardBall : R.amplitude.diffeomorph v ∈ ball x ε₀ :=
    hball hvball
  have hforwardDist : dist (R.amplitude.diffeomorph v) (P.param p.2) < ε₀ := by
    simpa [mem_ball, x] using hforwardBall
  have hforwardZero : C.G (R.amplitude.diffeomorph v) = 0 := by
    simpa [VerticalAmplitude.pullback_G,
      SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply] using hzero
  obtain ⟨z, hzball, _hzdom, hzparam⟩ :=
    hP (R.amplitude.diffeomorph v) hforwardDist hforwardZero
  have hy : ‖z - p.2‖ < δ := by
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_eq_norm] using hzball
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hMu⟩ := hM (z - p.2) hy
  refine ⟨u, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [S] using hu
  · change R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
      (P.param (p.2 + M.param u)) = v
    calc
      R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param (p.2 + M.param u)) =
          R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm (P.param z) := by
            congr 2
            rw [hMu, add_sub_cancel]
      _ = R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
          (R.amplitude.diffeomorph v) := by rw [hzparam]
      _ = v := R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm_apply_apply v

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalAmbientParam_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem criticalAmbientParam_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    R.criticalAmbientParam p hp 0 = R.criticalCenter p
proof:
:= by
  rw [criticalAmbientParam, criticalCenter,
    (R.criticalNormalForm p hp).param_zero, add_zero]

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.regularSlab_zero_one_of_coreCriticalPoints_eq_empty
statement:
theorem regularSlab_zero_one_of_coreCriticalPoints_eq_empty
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    (hcrit : coreCriticalPoints C.cobordism = ∅) :
    regularSlab C.cobordism.G 0 1
proof:
:= by
  intro t ht htcritical
  obtain ⟨v, hvcritical, hvt⟩ := htcritical
  by_cases hleft : t ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ)
  · exact hvcritical.2
      ((C.cobordism.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter hleft) v hvcritical.1 hvt)
  by_cases hright : (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ t
  · exact hvcritical.2
      ((C.cobordism.sliceRegular_of_three_quarter_le hright) v hvcritical.1 hvt)
  · have hvcore : v ∈ coreCriticalPoints C.cobordism := by
      refine ⟨hvcritical, ?_⟩
      change tcoord v ∈ Set.Icc (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ)
      rw [hvt]
      exact ⟨le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hleft), le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hright)⟩
    simpa [hcrit] using hvcore

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.positiveDelta_eq_of_regularSlab
statement:
theorem positiveDelta_eq_of_regularSlab
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    (hreg : regularSlab C.cobordism.G 0 1) :
    S₀.positiveDelta = S₁.positiveDelta
proof:
:= by
  let D := C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
  let h0 : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 := by norm_num
  let h1 : (1 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc 0 1 := by norm_num
  let Xzero := SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt D 0 (hreg.sliceRegular h0)
  let Xone := SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt D 1 (hreg.sliceRegular h1)
  let Vzero : TamedField Xzero := Xzero.exists_tamedField.some
  let Vone : TamedField Xone := Xone.exists_tamedField.some
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := exists_slabTamedField D hreg
  have htransport :
      (C.sliceSign 0 (hreg.sliceRegular h0)).positiveFramedDelta Vzero =
        (C.sliceSign 1 (hreg.sliceRegular h1)).positiveFramedDelta Vone :=
    C.positiveFramedDelta_eq_regularSlab W hreg h0 h1 Vzero Vone
  calc
    S₀.positiveDelta =
        (C.sliceSign 0 (hreg.sliceRegular h0)).positiveDelta :=
      C.sliceSign_zero_positiveDelta.symm
    _ = (C.sliceSign 0 (hreg.sliceRegular h0)).positiveFramedDelta Vzero :=
      (C.sliceSign 0 (hreg.sliceRegular h0)).positiveDelta_eq Vzero
    _ = (C.sliceSign 1 (hreg.sliceRegular h1)).positiveFramedDelta Vone :=
      htransport
    _ = (C.sliceSign 1 (hreg.sliceRegular h1)).positiveDelta :=
      ((C.sliceSign 1 (hreg.sliceRegular h1)).positiveDelta_eq Vone).symm
    _ = S₁.positiveDelta := C.sliceSign_one_positiveDelta

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.positiveDelta_eq_of_coreCriticalPoints_eq_empty
statement:
theorem positiveDelta_eq_of_coreCriticalPoints_eq_empty
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    (hcrit : coreCriticalPoints C.cobordism = ∅) :
    S₀.positiveDelta = S₁.positiveDelta
proof:
:=
  C.positiveDelta_eq_of_regularSlab
    (C.regularSlab_zero_one_of_coreCriticalPoints_eq_empty hcrit)

    (hpt : G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 = t) :
    (⟨p, hp⟩ : {q : Σ _ : ι, E₂ // q ∈ G.criticalPoints}) =
      D.eventCriticalIndex t ht

    G.localSeparatedTime (D.eventCriticalIndex t ht)
      (D.eventCriticalIndex t ht).1.2
  exact hpt.trans (D.eventCriticalIndex_time t ht).symm
