name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_rebasedMergeBandMarking_of_marking_pinned
statement:
theorem exists_rebasedMergeBandMarking_of_marking_pinned
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hflowlt : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 < eps / 2)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord center + s ^ 2 → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (hcap : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) center →
      spacePart (R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s)
          (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex p.2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hne : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg ≠
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg)
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos) Vpos)
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3)
    (hpoint : ∀ l : Fin 4, A.point l =
      spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s))
    (hsort0 : A.sortedMark 0 = 0)
    (hcut0 : A.cyclicCutRange 0 =
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hcut2 : A.cyclicCutRange 2 =
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hother : ∀ r : Fin 4, r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 → ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = s ^ 2 → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ∉ A.cyclicCutRange r)
    (hafterOrbit : Vpos.orbitPoint
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos) ∈ Vpos.orbit P.p) :
    ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
      ∃ F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg)
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg)
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos),
        F.dbefore = -(s ^ 2) ∧ F.dafter = s ^ 2 ∧ F.afterCut₃ = 1 ∧
        F.afterParam = P ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) F.afterCut₀ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        F.afterParam.curve 1 ∈
          Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) (-(s ^ 2))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) (-(s ^ 2))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) (-(s ^ 2))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s)
            (-(s ^ 2))) ∧
        F.before₁Cut₀ = 0 ∧ F.before₁Cut₁ = halfI ∧
        F.before₂Cut₀ = 0 ∧ F.before₂Cut₁ = halfI
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hρM : ρ < M.radius := hρrad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have habs : |s ^ 2| = s ^ 2 := abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg s)
  have habsn : |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| = s ^ 2 := by rw [abs_neg, habs]
  
  have e1c : ((1 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (1 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e1s : ((1 : Fin 3).succ) = (2 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e2c : ((2 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (2 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e2s : ((2 : Fin 3).succ) = (3 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e0c : ((0 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (0 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e0s : ((0 : Fin 3).succ) = (1 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have elast : (Fin.last 3) = (3 : Fin 4) := by decide
  
  have hcutFib : ∀ (r : Fin 4) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
      y ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      C.G (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) = 0 := by
    intro r y hy
    rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r] at hy
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact A.cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w
  
  have hcutFar : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), y ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) center := by
    intro r hr0 hr2 y hy
    have h : eps ≤ dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) center := by
      refine le_dist_center_of_saddleChart_avoid hindex hρM hcover
        (hcutFib r y hy) (by rw [tcoord_spaceTime]) ?_
      intro u hquad hnorm hEq
      rw [spacePart_spaceTime] at hEq
      exact hother r hr0 hr2 u hquad hnorm (hEq ▸ hy)
    linarith
  
  have hmarkAmb : ∀ l : Fin 4,
      cobSpaceTime (A.point l) (tcoord center + s ^ 2) =
        M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s := by
    intro l
    have htX : tcoord (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s) =
        tcoord center + s ^ 2 :=
      M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hρ hs hρM
    rw [hpoint l, ← htX, spaceTime_spacePart]
  
  have hlabelOrbit : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 → ∀ l : Fin 4,
      A.point l ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime (A.point l) (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
        (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg :
          Vneg.OrbitIndex) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro r hr0 hr2 l hl
    have hfar := hcutFar r hr0 hr2 _ hl
    rw [hmarkAmb l] at hfar ⊢
    exact hcap (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l) hfar
  have hmemEq : ∀ {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
      {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}, x = y → y ∈ S → x ∈ S :=
    fun h hy => h ▸ hy
  
  have hlabelEq : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).2 =
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).2 := by
    intro r hr0 hr2
    by_contra hlab
    have hsrcMem : A.point (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r := by
      rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]
      exact ⟨0, (A.cyclicCutPath r).source⟩
    have htgtMem : A.point (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r := by
      rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]
      exact ⟨1, (A.cyclicCutPath r).target⟩
    have hO := orbitIndex_eq_of_slabFlowFamily
      (R := R) (eps := eps) (dbefore := -(s ^ 2)) (dafter := s ^ 2)
      (tbefore := tcoord center - s ^ 2)
      (tafter := tcoord center + s ^ 2)
      (hbefore := hregneg) (Vbefore := Vneg)
      (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).toContinuousMap
      (fun w => A.cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w)
      (fun w => by
        show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (A.cyclicCutPath r w)
          (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) = tcoord center + s ^ 2
        rw [tcoord_spaceTime])
      (fun w => by
        have h := hcutFar r hr0 hr2 (A.cyclicCutPath r w)
          (by rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]; exact ⟨w, rfl⟩)
        rw [habs]
        exact h)
      hunit (by ring) rfl (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe)
      (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe)
      (O := T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).2 ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      (O' := T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).2 ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      (w := 0) (w' := 1)
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)))
          (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).source)
        (hlabelOrbit r hr0 hr2 _ hsrcMem))
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)))
          (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).target)
        (hlabelOrbit r hr0 hr2 _ htgtMem))
    apply hne
    rcases hp : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).2 with
      _ | _ <;>
      rcases hq : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).2 with
        _ | _ <;> rw [hp, hq] at hO hlab
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
    · exact hO.symm
    · exact hO
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
  
  have hsrcLab1 : A.cyclicCutSourceLabel 1 = A.sortedLabel 1 := by
    rw [← e1c]
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
  have htgtLab1 : A.cyclicCutTargetLabel 1 = A.sortedLabel 2 := by
    rw [← e1c, ← e1s]
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
  have hsrcLab3 : A.cyclicCutSourceLabel (Fin.last 3) =
      A.sortedLabel (Fin.last 3) := by
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_last]
  have htgtLab3 : A.cyclicCutTargetLabel (Fin.last 3) = A.sortedLabel 0 := by
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_last]
  rw [elast] at hsrcLab3 htgtLab3
  have hlabels :
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).2 ≠
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3)).2 := by
    intro hEq
    have h1 := hlabelEq 1 (by decide) (by decide)
    have h3 := hlabelEq 3 (by decide) (by decide)
    rw [hsrcLab1, htgtLab1] at h1
    rw [hsrcLab3, htgtLab3] at h3
    refine saddleFourLabel_snd_not_constant
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).2
      (A.sortedLabel 1) (A.sortedLabel 2) (A.sortedLabel 3) (A.sortedLabel 0)
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      rfl h1.symm hEq.symm ?_
    rw [← h3, ← hEq]
  refine ⟨_, _, hlabels, ?_⟩
  
  have hin₁ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) q) ∈
      A.cyclicCutRange 1 := by
    intro q
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (1 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e1c, e1s] at h
    exact h
  have hin₂ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) q) ∈
      A.cyclicCutRange 3 := by
    intro q
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_last_mem_cyclicCutRange q
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  
  have hcomp₁ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 2) (A.sortedMark 3) q) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro q
    rw [← hcut2]
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (2 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e2c, e2s] at h
    exact h
  have hcomp₀ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) (A.sortedMark 1) q) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro q
    rw [← hcut0]
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (0 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e0c, e0s, hsort0] at h
    exact h
  have hcurveMark : ∀ i : Fin 4, P.curve (A.sortedMark i) =
      A.point (A.sortedLabel i) := fun i => A.curve_mark (A.sortedLabel i)
  have hzeroMark : P.curve 1 = A.point (A.sortedLabel 0) := by
    have h := hcurveMark 0
    rw [hsort0] at h
    rw [← P.curve_closed]
    exact h
  have hcompEnd : P.curve 1 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    rw [← hcut0, hzeroMark, ← hcurveMark 0]
    have h := A.curve_sortedMark_castSucc_mem (0 : Fin 3)
    rw [e0c] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨hne₁, hz₁, ho₁⟩ := A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (1 : Fin 3)
  rw [e1c, e1s] at hne₁ hz₁ ho₁
  have hlastne : A.sortedMark 3 ≠ 1 := by
    have h := A.sortedMark_ne_one (Fin.last 3)
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  have hlastnz : A.sortedMark 3 ≠ 0 := by
    have h := A.sortedMark_last_ne_zero
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  have hzeroone : (0 : I) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Subtype.val h
    norm_num at this
  
  have hinj₁ : Function.Injective
      (fun q : I =>
        P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) q)) :=
    injective_curve_convexComb P hne₁ hz₁ ho₁
  have hinj₂ : Function.Injective
      (fun q : I => P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) q)) :=
    injective_curve_convexComb P hlastne (by rintro ⟨h, -⟩; exact hlastnz h)
      (by rintro ⟨-, h⟩; exact hzeroone h.symm)
  
  have hstep : ∀ (r : Fin 4) (a b : I), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      (∀ q : I, P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb a b q) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r) →
      (∀ q : I, R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) (-(s ^ 2)) ∈
        criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
          (tcoord center) (eps / 2)) := by
    intro r a b hr0 hr2 hmem q
    have hfib : C.G (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) = 0 :=
      sliceAmbientSubarc_mem_fiber P a b q
    have htime : tcoord (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) =
        tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
      show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb a b q))
        (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) = _
      rw [tcoord_spaceTime]
    have hfar : eps / 2 + (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |(s ^ 2 : ℝ)| ≤
        dist (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) center := by
      rw [habs]
      exact hcutFar r hr0 hr2 _ (hmem q)
    exact slabFlowBack_mem_core (R := R) hunit rfl (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe)
      hfib htime hfar
  have hcore₁ := hstep 1 (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) (by decide)
    (by decide) hin₁
  have hcore₂ := hstep 3 (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) (by decide) (by decide) hin₂
  
  have hhit₁ : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2)
      (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2) 0 ∈
      ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    have hval : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2)
        (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2) 0 =
        spacePart (R.base.flow
          (cobSpaceTime (A.point (A.sortedLabel 1)) (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
          (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) := by
      rw [transportedSubarc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero]
      exact congrArg (fun y => spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)))
        (hcurveMark 1)
    refine hmemEq hval ?_
    have hmemcut : A.point (A.sortedLabel 1) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange 1 := by
      rw [← hcurveMark 1]
      have h := A.curve_sortedMark_castSucc_mem (1 : Fin 3)
      rw [e1c] at h
      exact h
    exact hlabelOrbit 1 (by decide) (by decide) _ hmemcut
  have hhit₂ : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
      (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2) 0 ∈
      ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3)).2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    have hval : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
        (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2) 0 =
        spacePart (R.base.flow
          (cobSpaceTime (A.point (A.sortedLabel 3)) (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
          (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) := by
      rw [transportedSubarc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero]
      exact congrArg (fun y => spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)))
        (hcurveMark 3)
    refine hmemEq hval ?_
    have hmemcut : A.point (A.sortedLabel 3) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange 3 := by
      rw [← hcurveMark 3]
      have h := A.curve_sortedMark_last_mem_last
      rw [elast] at h
      exact h
    exact hlabelOrbit 3 (by decide) (by decide) _ hmemcut
  refine ⟨SaddleFlowBandMarking.ofAfterArcsFreeBefore (-(s ^ 2)) (s ^ 2)
      (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe) (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe) P hafterOrbit
      (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
      hcore₁ hcore₂
      (coreTime_criticalSliceExteriorCore_merge C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (eps / 2) s)
      hinj₁ hinj₂ (orbitPoint_mem_orbit_of_mem hhit₁)
      (orbitPoint_mem_orbit_of_mem hhit₂),
    rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, hcomp₁, hcomp₀, hcompEnd, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow
      (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) 0)
      (-(s ^ 2)) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hcurveMark 1, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 2), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow
      (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) 1)
      (-(s ^ 2)) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hcurveMark 2, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) 0)
      (-(s ^ 2)) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hcurveMark 3, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 0), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) 1)
      (-(s ^ 2)) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hzeroMark, hmarkAmb]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_rebasedMergeBand_pinned
statement:
theorem exists_rebasedMergeBand_pinned
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hflowlt : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 < eps / 2)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord center + s ^ 2 → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (hcap : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) center →
      spacePart (R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s)
          (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex p.2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hne : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg ≠
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg)
    (heq : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos =
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos) :
    ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
      ∃ F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg)
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg)
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos),
        T.RebasedMergeBandProvenance hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos
            Vneg Vpos R F ∧
          SaddleBandBeforeCutsPinned F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcut0, hcut2, hother⟩ :=
    T.saddlePositiveRebased_exteriorCuts hindex hρ hb hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq
  obtain ⟨hsort0, -, -⟩ :=
    T.saddlePositiveRebased_structure hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq
  have hafterOrbit : Vpos.orbitPoint
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos) ∈
      Vpos.orbit
        (T.saddlePositiveRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq).p := by
    have hbase :
        (T.saddlePositiveRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq).p =
          T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad 0 := rfl
    rw [hbase, Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem
      (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_mem_commonParamOrbit hindex ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregpos Vpos heq .negative 0)]
    exact Vpos.mem_orbit_self _
  obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, h1, h2, h3, -, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11,
    c1, c2, c3, c4⟩ :=
    T.exists_rebasedMergeBandMarking_of_marking_pinned hindex hρ hs hρrad
      hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos R hsafe hflowlt hcover hunit hcap hne
      (T.saddlePositiveRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq)
      (T.saddlePositiveRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq)
      (fun l => rfl) hsort0 hcut0 hcut2 hother hafterOrbit
  exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F,
    ⟨h1, h2, h3, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11⟩, ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4⟩⟩

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_rebasedSplitBandMarking_of_marking_pinned
statement:
theorem exists_rebasedSplitBandMarking_of_marking_pinned
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hflowlt : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 < eps / 2)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord center - s ^ 2 → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (hcap : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) center →
      spacePart (R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s)
          (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex p.1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hne : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos ≠
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos)
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg) Vneg)
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 3)
    (hpoint : ∀ l : Fin 4, A.point l =
      spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s))
    (hsort0 : A.sortedMark 0 = 0)
    (hcut0 : A.cyclicCutRange 0 =
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hcut2 : A.cyclicCutRange 2 =
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hother : ∀ r : Fin 4, r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 → ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(s ^ 2) → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ∉ A.cyclicCutRange r)
    (hafterOrbit : Vneg.orbitPoint
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg) ∈ Vneg.orbit P.p) :
    ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
      ∃ F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregpos hregneg Vpos Vneg
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos)
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos)
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg),
        F.dbefore = s ^ 2 ∧ F.dafter = -(s ^ 2) ∧ F.afterCut₃ = 1 ∧
        F.afterParam = P ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb F.afterCut₁ F.afterCut₂ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        (∀ q : I, F.afterParam.curve
            (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) F.afterCut₀ q) ∈
          Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad)) ∧
        F.afterParam.curve 1 ∈
          Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) (-(-(s ^ 2)))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₁ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) (-(-(s ^ 2)))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 0 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) (-(-(s ^ 2)))) ∧
        (∃ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, F.coreArc₂ 1 =
          R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s)
            (-(-(s ^ 2)))) ∧
        F.before₁Cut₀ = 0 ∧ F.before₁Cut₁ = halfI ∧
        F.before₂Cut₀ = 0 ∧ F.before₂Cut₁ = halfI
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hρM : ρ < M.radius := hρrad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have habs : |s ^ 2| = s ^ 2 := abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg s)
  have habsn : |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| = s ^ 2 := by rw [abs_neg, habs]
  
  have e1c : ((1 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (1 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e1s : ((1 : Fin 3).succ) = (2 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e2c : ((2 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (2 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e2s : ((2 : Fin 3).succ) = (3 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e0c : ((0 : Fin 3).castSucc) = (0 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have e0s : ((0 : Fin 3).succ) = (1 : Fin 4) := by decide
  have elast : (Fin.last 3) = (3 : Fin 4) := by decide
  
  have hcutFib : ∀ (r : Fin 4) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
      y ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      C.G (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) = 0 := by
    intro r y hy
    rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r] at hy
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact A.cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w
  
  have hcutFar : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), y ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) center := by
    intro r hr0 hr2 y hy
    have h : eps ≤ dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) center := by
      refine le_dist_center_of_saddleChart_avoid (w := -(s ^ 2)) hindex hρM
        hcover (hcutFib r y hy) (by rw [tcoord_spaceTime]; ring) ?_
      intro u hquad hnorm hEq
      rw [spacePart_spaceTime] at hEq
      exact hother r hr0 hr2 u hquad hnorm (hEq ▸ hy)
    linarith
  
  have hmarkAmb : ∀ l : Fin 4,
      cobSpaceTime (A.point l) (tcoord center - s ^ 2) =
        M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s := by
    intro l
    have htX : tcoord (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s) =
        tcoord center - s ^ 2 :=
      M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hρ hs hρM
    rw [hpoint l, ← htX, spaceTime_spacePart]
  
  have hlabelOrbit : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 → ∀ l : Fin 4,
      A.point l ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r →
      spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime (A.point l) (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
        (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos :
          Vpos.OrbitIndex) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro r hr0 hr2 l hl
    have hfar := hcutFar r hr0 hr2 _ hl
    rw [hmarkAmb l] at hfar ⊢
    exact hcap (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l) hfar
  have hmemEq : ∀ {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
      {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}, x = y → y ∈ S → x ∈ S :=
    fun h hy => h ▸ hy
  
  have hlabelEq : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).1 =
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).1 := by
    intro r hr0 hr2
    by_contra hlab
    have hsrcMem : A.point (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r := by
      rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]
      exact ⟨0, (A.cyclicCutPath r).source⟩
    have htgtMem : A.point (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r := by
      rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]
      exact ⟨1, (A.cyclicCutPath r).target⟩
    have hO := orbitIndex_eq_of_slabFlowFamily
      (R := R) (eps := eps) (dbefore := s ^ 2) (dafter := -(s ^ 2))
      (tbefore := tcoord center + s ^ 2)
      (tafter := tcoord center - s ^ 2)
      (hbefore := hregpos) (Vbefore := Vpos)
      (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).toContinuousMap
      (fun w => A.cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w)
      (fun w => by
        show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (A.cyclicCutPath r w)
          (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) = tcoord center - s ^ 2
        rw [tcoord_spaceTime])
      (fun w => by
        have h := hcutFar r hr0 hr2 (A.cyclicCutPath r w)
          (by rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r]; exact ⟨w, rfl⟩)
        rw [habsn]
        exact h)
      hunit rfl (by ring) (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe)
      (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe)
      (O := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).1 ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregpos Vpos)
      (O' := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).1 ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregpos Vpos)
      (w := 0) (w' := 1)
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))))
          (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).source)
        (hlabelOrbit r hr0 hr2 _ hsrcMem))
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))))
          (A.cyclicCutAmbientPath r).target)
        (hlabelOrbit r hr0 hr2 _ htgtMem))
    apply hne
    rcases hp : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).1 with
      _ | _ <;>
      rcases hq : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).1 with
        _ | _ <;> rw [hp, hq] at hO hlab
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
    · exact hO.symm
    · exact hO
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
  
  have hsrcLab1 : A.cyclicCutSourceLabel 1 = A.sortedLabel 1 := by
    rw [← e1c]
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
  have htgtLab1 : A.cyclicCutTargetLabel 1 = A.sortedLabel 2 := by
    rw [← e1c, ← e1s]
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_castSucc]
  have hsrcLab3 : A.cyclicCutSourceLabel (Fin.last 3) =
      A.sortedLabel (Fin.last 3) := by
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_last]
  have htgtLab3 : A.cyclicCutTargetLabel (Fin.last 3) = A.sortedLabel 0 := by
    simp only [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutTargetLabel,
      Fin.lastCases_last]
  rw [elast] at hsrcLab3 htgtLab3
  have hlabels :
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).1 ≠
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3)).1 := by
    intro hEq
    have h1 := hlabelEq 1 (by decide) (by decide)
    have h3 := hlabelEq 3 (by decide) (by decide)
    rw [hsrcLab1, htgtLab1] at h1
    rw [hsrcLab3, htgtLab3] at h3
    refine saddleFourLabel_fst_not_constant
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).1
      (A.sortedLabel 1) (A.sortedLabel 2) (A.sortedLabel 3) (A.sortedLabel 0)
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      (fun h => absurd (A.sortedLabel.injective h) (by decide))
      rfl h1.symm hEq.symm ?_
    rw [← h3, ← hEq]
  refine ⟨_, _, hlabels, ?_⟩
  
  have hin₁ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) q) ∈
      A.cyclicCutRange 1 := by
    intro q
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (1 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e1c, e1s] at h
    exact h
  have hin₂ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) q) ∈
      A.cyclicCutRange 3 := by
    intro q
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_last_mem_cyclicCutRange q
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  
  have hcomp₁ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 2) (A.sortedMark 3) q) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro q
    rw [← hcut2]
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (2 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e2c, e2s] at h
    exact h
  have hcomp₀ : ∀ q : I,
      P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) (A.sortedMark 1) q) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    intro q
    rw [← hcut0]
    have h := A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (0 : Fin 3) q
    rw [e0c, e0s, hsort0] at h
    exact h
  have hcurveMark : ∀ i : Fin 4, P.curve (A.sortedMark i) =
      A.point (A.sortedLabel i) := fun i => A.curve_mark (A.sortedLabel i)
  have hzeroMark : P.curve 1 = A.point (A.sortedLabel 0) := by
    have h := hcurveMark 0
    rw [hsort0] at h
    rw [← P.curve_closed]
    exact h
  have hcompEnd : P.curve 1 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    rw [← hcut0, hzeroMark, ← hcurveMark 0]
    have h := A.curve_sortedMark_castSucc_mem (0 : Fin 3)
    rw [e0c] at h
    exact h
  
  obtain ⟨hne₁, hz₁, ho₁⟩ := A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (1 : Fin 3)
  rw [e1c, e1s] at hne₁ hz₁ ho₁
  have hlastne : A.sortedMark 3 ≠ 1 := by
    have h := A.sortedMark_ne_one (Fin.last 3)
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  have hlastnz : A.sortedMark 3 ≠ 0 := by
    have h := A.sortedMark_last_ne_zero
    rw [elast] at h
    exact h
  have hzeroone : (0 : I) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Subtype.val h
    norm_num at this
  
  have hinj₁ : Function.Injective
      (fun q : I =>
        P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) q)) :=
    injective_curve_convexComb P hne₁ hz₁ ho₁
  have hinj₂ : Function.Injective
      (fun q : I => P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) q)) :=
    injective_curve_convexComb P hlastne (by rintro ⟨h, -⟩; exact hlastnz h)
      (by rintro ⟨-, h⟩; exact hzeroone h.symm)
  
  have hstep : ∀ (r : Fin 4) (a b : I), r ≠ 0 → r ≠ 2 →
      (∀ q : I, P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb a b q) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange r) →
      (∀ q : I, R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) (-(-(s ^ 2))) ∈
        criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
          (tcoord center) (eps / 2)) := by
    intro r a b hr0 hr2 hmem q
    have hfib : C.G (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) = 0 :=
      sliceAmbientSubarc_mem_fiber P a b q
    have htime : tcoord (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) =
        tcoord center - s ^ 2 := by
      show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb a b q))
        (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) = _
      rw [tcoord_spaceTime]
    have hfar : eps / 2 + (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| ≤
        dist (P.sliceAmbientSubarc a b q) center := by
      rw [habsn]
      exact hcutFar r hr0 hr2 _ (hmem q)
    exact slabFlowBack_mem_core (R := R) hunit (by ring)
      (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe) hfib htime hfar
  have hcore₁ := hstep 1 (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) (by decide)
    (by decide) hin₁
  have hcore₂ := hstep 3 (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) (by decide) (by decide) hin₂
  
  have hhit₁ : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2)
      (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2)) 0 ∈
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1)).1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    have hval : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2)
        (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2)) 0 =
        spacePart (R.base.flow
          (cobSpaceTime (A.point (A.sortedLabel 1)) (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
          (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) := by
      rw [transportedSubarc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero]
      exact congrArg (fun y => spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))))
        (hcurveMark 1)
    refine hmemEq hval ?_
    have hmemcut : A.point (A.sortedLabel 1) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange 1 := by
      rw [← hcurveMark 1]
      have h := A.curve_sortedMark_castSucc_mem (1 : Fin 3)
      rw [e1c] at h
      exact h
    exact hlabelOrbit 1 (by decide) (by decide) _ hmemcut
  have hhit₂ : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
      (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2)) 0 ∈
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3)).1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    have hval : transportedSubarc R P (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
        (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2)) 0 =
        spacePart (R.base.flow
          (cobSpaceTime (A.point (A.sortedLabel 3)) (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
          (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) := by
      rw [transportedSubarc_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero]
      exact congrArg (fun y => spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))))
        (hcurveMark 3)
    refine hmemEq hval ?_
    have hmemcut : A.point (A.sortedLabel 3) ∈ A.cyclicCutRange 3 := by
      rw [← hcurveMark 3]
      have h := A.curve_sortedMark_last_mem_last
      rw [elast] at h
      exact h
    exact hlabelOrbit 3 (by decide) (by decide) _ hmemcut
  refine ⟨SaddleFlowBandMarking.ofAfterArcsFreeBefore (s ^ 2) (-(s ^ 2))
      (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe) (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe) P hafterOrbit
      (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I)
      hcore₁ hcore₂
      (coreTime_criticalSliceExteriorCore_split C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (eps / 2) s)
      hinj₁ hinj₂ (orbitPoint_mem_orbit_of_mem hhit₁)
      (orbitPoint_mem_orbit_of_mem hhit₂),
    rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl, hcomp₁, hcomp₀, hcompEnd, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_,
    rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 1), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow
      (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) 0)
      (-(-(s ^ 2))) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hcurveMark 1, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 2), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow
      (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 1) (A.sortedMark 2) 1)
      (-(-(s ^ 2))) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hcurveMark 2, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 3), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) 0)
      (-(-(s ^ 2))) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hcurveMark 3, hmarkAmb]
  · refine ⟨saddleBranchPairOfFinFour (A.sortedLabel 0), ?_⟩
    show R.base.flow (P.sliceAmbientSubarc (A.sortedMark 3) (1 : I) 1)
      (-(-(s ^ 2))) = _
    rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      Set.Icc.convexComb_one, hzeroMark, hmarkAmb]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_rebasedSplitBand_pinned
statement:
theorem exists_rebasedSplitBand_pinned
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hflowlt : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 < eps / 2)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord center - s ^ 2 → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (hcap : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) center →
      spacePart (R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s)
          (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex p.1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hne : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos ≠
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos)
    (heq : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg =
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg) :
    ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
      ∃ F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregpos hregneg Vpos Vneg
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos)
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos)
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg),
        T.RebasedSplitBandProvenance hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos
            Vneg Vpos R F ∧
          SaddleBandBeforeCutsPinned F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hcut0, hcut2, hother⟩ :=
    T.saddleNegativeRebased_exteriorCuts hindex hρ hb hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq
  obtain ⟨hsort0, -, -⟩ :=
    T.saddleNegativeRebased_structure hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq
  have hafterOrbit : Vneg.orbitPoint
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg) ∈
      Vneg.orbit
        (T.saddleNegativeRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq).p := by
    have hbase :
        (T.saddleNegativeRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq).p =
          T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad 0 := rfl
    rw [hbase, Vneg.orbit_eq_of_mem
      (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_mem_commonParamOrbit hindex ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregneg Vneg heq .negative 0)]
    exact Vneg.mem_orbit_self _
  obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, h1, h2, h3, -, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11,
    c1, c2, c3, c4⟩ :=
    T.exists_rebasedSplitBandMarking_of_marking_pinned hindex hρ hs hρrad
      hregpos hregneg Vpos Vneg R hsafe hflowlt hcover hunit hcap hne
      (T.saddleNegativeRebasedParam hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq)
      (T.saddleNegativeRebasedMarking hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq)
      (fun l => rfl) hsort0 hcut0 hcut2 hother hafterOrbit
  exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F,
    ⟨h1, h2, h3, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11⟩, ⟨c1, c2, c3, c4⟩⟩

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.spatialAdjointCLM_apply
statement:

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalSurfaceParam_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem criticalSurfaceParam_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp 0 = R.criticalCenter p
proof:
:= by
  rw [criticalSurfaceParam, criticalCenter,
    (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param_zero, add_zero]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalCenter_mem_timeCritical
statement:
theorem criticalCenter_mem_timeCritical
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    R.criticalCenter p ∈
      timeCritical (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ‖(0 : E₂)‖ < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius := by
    simpa using (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius_pos
  have hcritical := (R.critical_model p hp 0 hzero).mpr rfl
  rw [← R.criticalSurfaceParam_zero p hp]
  exact hcritical

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteCokernelVector_ne_zero

theorem criticalDefiniteCokernelVector_ne_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteCokernelVector_mem_orthogonal
statement:
theorem criticalDefiniteCokernelVector_mem_orthogonal
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    R.criticalDefiniteCokernelVector p hp ∈
      (LinearMap.range
        ((spatialDeriv (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G
          (R.criticalCenter p)).toLinearMap))ᗮ

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteNormalMap_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem criticalDefiniteNormalMap_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap p hp 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [criticalDefiniteNormalMap, R.criticalSurfaceParam_zero p hp]
  exact adjoint_spatialDeriv_criticalOutputCokernelVector
    (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C)
    (R.criticalCenter p) (R.criticalCenter_mem_timeCritical p hp)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteNormalMap_contDiffAt_zero
statement:
theorem criticalDefiniteNormalMap_contDiffAt_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap p hp) 0
proof:
:= by
  let C' := R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C
  have hspatial : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (spatialDeriv C'.G) := by
    change ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun z => (fderiv ℝ C'.G z).comp spaceInclL)
    exact ContDiff.clm_comp (contDiff_fderivCLM C'.smooth) contDiff_const
  have hadjoint : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun z => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (spatialDeriv C'.G z)) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using
      (spatialAdjointCLM (n := n)).contDiff.comp hspatial
  have happly : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun z => ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (spatialDeriv C'.G z)
        (R.criticalDefiniteCokernelVector p hp)) :=
    hadjoint.clm_apply contDiff_const
  exact happly.contDiffAt.comp 0
    (R.criticalSurfaceParam_contDiffAt_zero p hp)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteNormalMap_differentiableAt_zero
statement:
theorem criticalDefiniteNormalMap_differentiableAt_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ (R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap p hp) 0
proof:
:=
  (R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap_contDiffAt_zero p hp).differentiableAt (by simp)

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.hasFDerivAt_criticalDefiniteNormalMap_zero
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_criticalDefiniteNormalMap_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    HasFDerivAt (R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap p hp)
      (R.criticalDefiniteNormalLinearization p hp) 0
proof:
:=
  (R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap_differentiableAt_zero p hp).hasFDerivAt

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) (theta : ℝ) :
    R.criticalDefiniteNormalRow p hp 0 theta =
      R.criticalDefiniteNormalLinearization p hp
        (definiteCircleParam 1 theta)
proof:
:= by
  simp [criticalDefiniteNormalRow, polarFirstQuotient]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalDefiniteNormalRow_eq_inv_smul
statement:
theorem criticalDefiniteNormalRow_eq_inv_smul
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    {a theta : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) :
    R.criticalDefiniteNormalRow p hp a theta =
      a⁻¹ • R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap p hp
        (definiteCircleParam a theta)
proof:
:= by
  rw [criticalDefiniteNormalRow, polarFirstQuotient, if_neg ha]
  change a⁻¹ • R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap p hp
      (a • definiteCircleParam 1 theta) = _
  rw [← definiteCircleParam_eq_smul_unit a theta]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.continuousAt_criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero
statement:
theorem continuousAt_criticalDefiniteNormalRow_zero
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) (theta₀ : ℝ) :
    ContinuousAt (fun q : ℝ × ℝ =>
      R.criticalDefiniteNormalRow p hp q.1 q.2) (0, theta₀)
proof:
:= by
  have hdirection : ContinuousAt
      (fun theta : ℝ => definiteCircleParam 1 theta) theta₀ := by
    apply Continuous.continuousAt
    unfold definiteCircleParam pairToMorseParam
    fun_prop
  simpa [criticalDefiniteNormalRow] using
    (continuousAt_polarFirstQuotient
      (R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap p hp)
      (R.criticalDefiniteNormalLinearization p hp)
      (fun theta : ℝ => definiteCircleParam 1 theta) theta₀
      (R.hasFDerivAt_criticalDefiniteNormalMap_zero p hp)
      (R.criticalDefiniteNormalMap_zero p hp) hdirection)

name: Submission.exists_morseParamGlobalizationOfOrder_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem exists_morseParamGlobalizationOfOrder_of_contDiffOn
    {f : E₂ → ℝ} (M : LocalMorseNormalForm f) {k : ℕ∞ω}
    {U : Set E₂} (hU : U ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E₂))
    (hparam : ContDiffOn ℝ k M.param U) (hk : k ≤ ∞) :
    Nonempty (MorseParamGlobalizationOfOrder M k)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨V, hVU, hVopen, h0V⟩ :
      ∃ V : Set E₂, V ⊆ U ∧ IsOpen V ∧ (0 : E₂) ∈ V :=
    mem_nhds_iff.mp hU
  have hVnhds : V ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E₂) := hVopen.mem_nhds h0V
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hVnhds
  let bump : ContDiffBump (0 : E₂) :=
    { rIn := d / 4
      rOut := d / 2
      rIn_pos := by positivity
      rIn_lt_rOut := by linarith }
  let globalParam : E₂ → E₂ := fun u =>
    if u ∈ V then bump u • M.param u else 0
  have hparamV : ContDiffOn ℝ k M.param V := hparam.mono hVU
  have htsupport : tsupport (bump : E₂ → ℝ) ⊆ V := by
    rw [bump.tsupport_eq]
    intro x hx
    apply hball
    rw [mem_closedBall] at hx
    rw [mem_ball]
    change dist x 0 ≤ d / 2 at hx
    linarith
  have hglobal : ContDiff ℝ k globalParam := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hxV : x ∈ V
    · have hpAt : ContDiffAt ℝ k M.param x :=
        (hparamV x hxV).contDiffAt (hVopen.mem_nhds hxV)
      have hbAt : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (bump : E₂ → ℝ) x := bump.contDiffAt
      have hprod : ContDiffAt ℝ k (fun y => bump y • M.param y) x :=
        (hbAt.of_le hk).smul hpAt
      apply hprod.congr_of_eventuallyEq
      filter_upwards [hVopen.mem_nhds hxV] with y hy
      simp [globalParam, hy]
    · have hxTs : x ∉ tsupport (bump : E₂ → ℝ) :=
        fun hx => hxV (htsupport hx)
      have houtside : (tsupport (bump : E₂ → ℝ))ᶜ ∈ 𝓝 x :=
        isClosed_closure.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxTs
      have heqzero : globalParam =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ : E₂ => 0) := by
        filter_upwards [houtside] with y hy
        have hbzero : bump y = 0 := by
          by_contra hb
          exact hy (subset_tsupport (bump : E₂ → ℝ) hb)
        by_cases hyV : y ∈ V <;> simp [globalParam, hyV, hbzero]
      exact (contDiff_const : ContDiff ℝ k (fun _ : E₂ => (0 : E₂))).contDiffAt
        |>.congr_of_eventuallyEq heqzero
  let r : ℝ := min (d / 4) M.radius
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min (by positivity) M.radius_pos
  have hrle : r ≤ M.radius := min_le_right _ _
  have hagree : ∀ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r → globalParam u = M.param u := by
    intro u hu
    have hurIn : ‖u‖ ≤ d / 4 :=
      (hu.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)).le
    have huV : u ∈ V := by
      apply hball
      rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
      exact hurIn.trans_lt (by linarith)
    have hbump : bump u = 1 := by
      apply bump.one_of_mem_closedBall
      rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      exact hurIn
    simp [globalParam, huV, hbump]
  refine ⟨{
    radius := r
    radius_pos := hr
    radius_le := hrle
    globalParam := globalParam
    globalParam_contDiff := hglobal
    agrees := hagree
    param_zero := ?_
    exact := ?_ }⟩
  · rw [hagree 0 (by simpa using hr)]
    exact M.param_zero
  · intro u hu
    rw [hagree u hu]
    exact M.exact u (hu.trans_le hrle)

name: Submission.exists_morseParamGlobalization_of_contDiffOn
statement:
theorem exists_morseParamGlobalization_of_contDiffOn
    {f : E₂ → ℝ} (M : LocalMorseNormalForm f)
    {U : Set E₂} (hU : U ∈ 𝓝 (0 : E₂))
    (hparam : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ M.param U) :
    Nonempty (MorseParamGlobalization M)
proof:
:=
  exists_morseParamGlobalizationOfOrder_of_contDiffOn M hU hparam (by simp)

name: Submission.exists_morseParamGlobalization_of_contDiffAt_omega
statement:
theorem exists_morseParamGlobalization_of_contDiffAt_omega
    {f : E₂ → ℝ} (M : LocalMorseNormalForm f)
    (hparam : ContDiffAt ℝ ω M.param 0) :
    Nonempty (MorseParamGlobalization M)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hUparam⟩ :=
    hparam.contDiffOn (m := (∞ : ℕ∞ω)) (by simp) (by simp)
  exact exists_morseParamGlobalization_of_contDiffOn M hU hUparam

name: Submission.exists_morseParamGlobalization_finiteOrder
statement:
theorem exists_morseParamGlobalization_finiteOrder
    {f : E₂ → ℝ} (M : LocalMorseNormalForm f) (k : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (MorseParamGlobalizationOfOrder M (k : ℕ∞ω))
proof:
:= by
  have hk : ContDiffAt ℝ (k : ℕ∞ω) M.param 0 :=
    contDiffAt_infty.mp M.param_contDiffAt k
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hUparam⟩ := hk.contDiffOn le_rfl (by simp)
  exact exists_morseParamGlobalizationOfOrder_of_contDiffOn M hU hUparam
    (ENat.LEInfty.out : (k : ℕ∞ω) ≤ ∞)

name: Submission.PieceKill.etaR_eq_one_or
statement: theorem etaR_eq_one_or (i : Fin (m + 1)) : etaR m i = 1 ∨ etaR m i = -1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [etaR]
  by_cases h : (if (i : ℕ) = 0 then m + 1 else (i : ℕ)) = 2
  · exact Or.inr (if_pos h)
  · exact Or.inl (if_neg h)

name: Submission.PieceKill.etaR_prod
statement: theorem etaR_prod (hm : 0 < m) : ∏ j, etaR m j = -1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨j₀, hj₀val, hj₀other⟩ : ∃ j : Fin (m + 1),
      (if ((j : ℕ) = 0) then m + 1 else (j : ℕ)) = 2 ∧
        ∀ b : Fin (m + 1), b ≠ j →
          ¬ ((if ((b : ℕ) = 0) then m + 1 else (b : ℕ)) = 2) := by
    by_cases hm1 : m = 1
    · refine ⟨⟨0, by omega⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show (if ((0 : ℕ) = 0) then m + 1 else (0 : ℕ)) = 2
        rw [if_pos rfl, hm1]
      · intro b hb
        have hbv : (b : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          exact hb (Fin.ext (by rw [h]))
        rw [if_neg hbv]
        have hlt := b.isLt
        omega
    · refine ⟨⟨2, by omega⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
      · show (if ((2 : ℕ) = 0) then m + 1 else (2 : ℕ)) = 2
        rw [if_neg (by omega : ¬ ((2 : ℕ) = 0))]
      · intro b hb
        by_cases hb0 : (b : ℕ) = 0
        · rw [if_pos hb0]
          omega
        · rw [if_neg hb0]
          intro hcon
          exact hb (Fin.ext hcon)
  have hsingle : ∏ j, etaR m j = etaR m j₀ :=
    Finset.prod_eq_single j₀
      (fun b _ hb => by
        simp only [etaR]
        exact if_neg (hj₀other b hb))
      (fun h => absurd (Finset.mem_univ j₀) h)
  rw [hsingle]
  simp only [etaR]
  exact if_pos hj₀val

name: Submission.PieceKill.etaR_castSucc_apply

proof:
:= by

name: Submission.PieceKill.etaR_eq_reflSign_last
statement:
theorem etaR_eq_reflSign_last (hm : 0 < m) :
    etaR m 0 = reflSign m hm (Fin.last (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  have hcond : (Fin.last (m + 1) : Fin (m + 2)) =
      CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.reflectionIndex m hm ↔ m + 1 = 2 := by
    constructor
    · intro hc
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val hc
      rw [Fin.val_last, reflectionIndex_val m hm] at hv
      exact hv
    · intro hc
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [Fin.val_last, reflectionIndex_val m hm]
      exact hc
  rw [etaR_zero_apply, reflSign]
  by_cases h : m + 1 = 2
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (hcond.mpr h)]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h (hcond.mp hc))]

name: Submission.PieceKill.etaR_eq_reflSign_castSucc
statement:
theorem etaR_eq_reflSign_castSucc (hm : 0 < m) (i : Fin (m + 1)) (hi : i ≠ 0) :
    etaR m i = reflSign m hm i.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  have hcond : (i.castSucc : Fin (m + 2)) =
      CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.reflectionIndex m hm ↔ (i : ℕ) = 2 := by
    constructor
    · intro hc
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val hc
      rw [val_castSucc m i, reflectionIndex_val m hm] at hv
      exact hv
    · intro hc
      apply Fin.ext
      rw [val_castSucc m i, reflectionIndex_val m hm]
      exact hc
  rw [etaR_castSucc_apply m i hi, reflSign]
  by_cases h : (i : ℕ) = 2
  · rw [if_pos h, if_pos (hcond.mpr h)]
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (fun hc => h (hcond.mp hc))]

name: Submission.PieceKill.reflTube_g_eq
statement:
theorem reflTube_g_eq (hm : 0 < m) (x : E) :
    ((CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.reflectedTubeFLS m hm).codomainEquiv
        (hopfEquiv m hm)).g x =
      hopfEquiv m hm (coordinateReflection
        (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.reflectionIndex m hm)
        (CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap m x))
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.PieceKill.reflTube_g_eq_level
statement:
theorem reflTube_g_eq_level (hm : 0 < m) (x : E) :
    ((CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.reflectedTubeFLS m hm).codomainEquiv
        (hopfEquiv m hm)).g x = level m (reflParams m hm) 0 x
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  rw [reflTube_g_eq m hm x, hopfSwap_apply m hm]
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      rw [if_neg (last_ne_zero_F m), if_pos rfl,
        coordinateReflection_apply_mul m hm, reflSign_zero m hm, one_mul,
        CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap_apply_zero m x,
        level_zero_apply_last m (reflParams m hm) hm x]
  | cast j =>
      have hjl : (j.castSucc : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ Fin.last (m + 1) :=
        (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j).ne
      rw [level_zero_apply_castSucc m (reflParams m hm) hm x j,
        reflParams_eta m hm]
      by_cases hj0 : j = 0
      · subst hj0
        rw [Fin.castSucc_zero, if_pos rfl, coordinateReflection_apply_mul m hm,
          CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap_apply_ne_zero m x
            (last_ne_zero_F m),
          if_pos rfl, last_succ_eq_iB, etaR_eq_reflSign_last m hm]
        ring
      · have hjne0 : (j.castSucc : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          apply hj0
          apply Fin.ext
          have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
          simpa using hv
        rw [if_neg hjne0, if_neg hjl, coordinateReflection_apply_mul m hm,
          CompactTubeConfiguration.levelMap_apply_ne_zero m x hjne0,
          if_neg hj0, etaR_eq_reflSign_castSucc m hm j hj0]
        ring

name: Submission.PieceKill.pantsRevCob_flat
statement:
theorem pantsRevCob_flat (hm : 0 < m) :
    (pantsRevCob m hm).SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 2
proof:
:= by
  have hbase : ((pantsRev m hm).signedCobordism
      (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.pantsTargetSign m hm)).SpatialFlatOutside
      (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.background m hm) 0 2 := by
    intro v hv
    have hnorm : (2 : ℝ) ≤ ‖initCLM (m + 3) v‖ := by
      simpa [dist_zero_right] using hv
    have h4 : (4 : ℝ) ≤ CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) v) := by
      rw [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
      nlinarith
    show CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonMap m hm
      (1 - normRamp (vertC v)) (initCLM (m + 3) v) =
      CompactHopfPairConfiguration.background m hm
    rw [CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.comparisonMap,
      CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_one h4]
    simp
  have h := SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SpatialFlatOutside.codomainEquiv hbase
    (hopfEquiv m hm)
  rwa [hopfEquiv_background m hm] at h

name: Submission.PieceKill.saddleKillCob_flat

      (reflTube_g_eq_level m hm))

  exact StandardCircleMoveKit.retype_flat h'

name: Submission.PieceKill.exists_saddleTargetKill

name: Submission.nonempty_mulEquiv_zmodTwo
statement:
theorem nonempty_mulEquiv_zmodTwo (G : Type*) [Group G] (g : G) (hsq : g * g = 1)
    (hgen : Subgroup.zpowers g = ⊤) (hne : g ≠ 1) :
    Nonempty (G ≃* Multiplicative (ZMod 2))
proof:
:= by
  have hg : ∀ y : G, y ∈ Subgroup.zpowers g := fun y => hgen ▸ Subgroup.mem_top y
  have horder : orderOf g = 2 := orderOf_eq_prime (by rwa [pow_two]) hne
  have hcard : Nat.card G = 2 := by
    rw [← Subgroup.card_top, ← hgen, Nat.card_zpowers, horder]
  exact ⟨(zmodMulEquivOfGenerator hg hcard).symm⟩

name: Submission.nonempty_mulEquiv_zmodTwo_of_orderOf_eq_two
statement:
theorem nonempty_mulEquiv_zmodTwo_of_orderOf_eq_two (G : Type*) [Group G] (g : G)
    (horder : orderOf g = 2) (hgen : Subgroup.zpowers g = ⊤) :
    Nonempty (G ≃* Multiplicative (ZMod 2))
proof:
:= by
  refine nonempty_mulEquiv_zmodTwo G g ?_ hgen ?_
  · have h := pow_orderOf_eq_one g
    rwa [horder, pow_two] at h
  · intro h
    rw [h, orderOf_one] at horder
    norm_num at horder

name: Submission.nonempty_mulEquiv_zmodTwo_of_card_eq_two
statement:
theorem nonempty_mulEquiv_zmodTwo_of_card_eq_two (G : Type*) [Group G]
    (hcard : Nat.card G = 2) :
    Nonempty (G ≃* Multiplicative (ZMod 2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, hg, hunique⟩ := (Nat.card_eq_two_iff' (1 : G)).mp hcard
  have hsq : g * g = 1 := by
    by_contra hgg
    have heq : g * g = g := hunique (g * g) hgg
    have : g = 1 := by
      apply mul_left_cancel (a := g)
      simpa using heq
    exact hg this
  have hgen : Subgroup.zpowers g = ⊤ := by
    apply top_unique
    intro y _
    by_cases hy : y = 1
    · simpa [hy]
    · rw [hunique y hy]
      exact Subgroup.mem_zpowers g
  exact nonempty_mulEquiv_zmodTwo G g hsq hgen hg

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.contDiff_localizeCovector
statement:
theorem contDiff_localizeCovector (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (A : Cov) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A)
proof:
:=
  χ.contDiff_localize (n := n) A.contDiff

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.hasCompactSupport_localizeCovector
statement:
theorem hasCompactSupport_localizeCovector
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (A : Cov) :
    HasCompactSupport (χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A)
proof:
:=
  χ.hasCompactSupport_localize (n := n) A

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.exists_lipschitz_radius_localizeCovector
statement:
theorem exists_lipschitz_radius_localizeCovector
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ A : Cov, ‖A‖ < δ →
      LipschitzWith (⟨1 / 4, by norm_num⟩ : NNReal)
        (χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A)
proof:
:= by
  let weight : E' → ℝ := fun v => ‖v‖ * ‖fderiv ℝ χ v‖
  have hweightContinuous : Continuous weight := by
    exact continuous_norm.mul
      (χ.smooth.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).norm
  have hweightSupport : HasCompactSupport weight := by
    dsimp [weight]
    exact HasCompactSupport.mul_left (f := fun v : E' => ‖v‖)
      (χ.compact_support.fderiv (𝕜 := ℝ)).norm
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
    hweightContinuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support hweightSupport
  let R : ℝ := max M 0
  have hR : 0 ≤ R := le_max_right _ _
  have hweight (v : E') : weight v ≤ R := by
    calc
      weight v = ‖weight v‖ := by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg]
        exact mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ M := hM v
      _ ≤ R := le_max_left _ _
  let δ : ℝ := 1 / (4 * (R + 1))
  have hden : 0 < 4 * (R + 1) := by positivity
  have hδ : 0 < δ := one_div_pos.mpr hden
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro A hA
  have hsmooth := χ.contDiff_localizeCovector (n := n) A
  apply lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_fderiv_le
    (hsmooth.differentiable (by simp))
  intro v
  have hfd :
      fderiv ℝ (χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A) v =
        χ v • A + A v • fderiv ℝ χ v := by
    simpa [localizeCovector] using χ.fderiv_localize (n := n) A.contDiff v
  have hχ : |χ v| ≤ 1 := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (χ.range v).1]
    exact (χ.range v).2
  have hAv : |A v| ≤ ‖A‖ * ‖v‖ := by
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using A.le_opNorm v
  have hbound :
      ‖fderiv ℝ (χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A) v‖ < 1 / 4 := by
    rw [hfd]
    calc
      ‖χ v • A + A v • fderiv ℝ χ v‖ ≤
          ‖χ v • A‖ + ‖A v • fderiv ℝ χ v‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = |χ v| * ‖A‖ + |A v| * ‖fderiv ℝ χ v‖ := by
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ 1 * ‖A‖ + (‖A‖ * ‖v‖) * ‖fderiv ℝ χ v‖ := by
        exact add_le_add
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hχ (norm_nonneg A))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hAv (norm_nonneg _))
      _ = ‖A‖ * (1 + weight v) := by
        dsimp [weight]
        ring
      _ ≤ ‖A‖ * (1 + R) := by
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (norm_nonneg A)
        linarith [hweight v]
      _ < 1 / 4 := by
        have hR1 : 0 < R + 1 := by positivity
        have hm := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hA hR1
        have heq : δ * (R + 1) = 1 / 4 := by
          dsimp [δ]
          field_simp [hR1.ne']
        calc
          ‖A‖ * (1 + R) = ‖A‖ * (R + 1) := by ring
          _ < δ * (R + 1) := hm
          _ = 1 / 4 := heq
  apply NNReal.coe_le_coe.mp
  change ‖fderiv ℝ (χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A) v‖ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ)
  exact hbound.le

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.smallForwardOfCovector_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem smallForwardOfCovector_apply
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U)
    (hcollar : U ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ))
    (A : Cov)
    (hlip : LipschitzWith (⟨1 / 4, by norm_num⟩ : NNReal)
      (χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A)) (v : E') :
    χ.smallForwardOfCovector (n := n) hcollar A hlip v =
      χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A v
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.SmoothCutoff.smallForwardOfCovector_twice_K_lt_one
statement:
theorem smallForwardOfCovector_twice_K_lt_one
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U)
    (hcollar : U ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ))
    (A : Cov)
    (hlip : LipschitzWith (⟨1 / 4, by norm_num⟩ : NNReal)
      (χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A)) :
    2 * (χ.smallForwardOfCovector (n := n) hcollar A hlip).K < 1
proof:
:= by
  change 2 * (⟨1 / 4, by norm_num⟩ : NNReal) < 1
  exact_mod_cast (show 2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) < 1 by norm_num)

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.contDiff_cutoffAffineHeightUncurried

proof:
:= by

    ((χ.smooth.comp (P.param_smooth.comp contDiff_snd)).mul
      (contDiff_fst.clm_apply (P.param_smooth.comp contDiff_snd)))

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.contDiff_cutoffAffineGradient
statement:
theorem contDiff_cutoffAffineGradient (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) :

proof:
:= by

    (contDiff_rightFDeriv
      (P.contDiff_cutoffAffineHeightUncurried χ))).clm_apply contDiff_const

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.cutoffAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient
statement:
theorem cutoffAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (χ : SmoothCutoff K U)
    (A : Cov) (u : E₂) :
    P.cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, u) =
      chartGradient (P.cutoffAffineHeight χ A) u
proof:
:= by
  unfold cutoffAffineGradient chartGradient
  have h := fderiv_section_eq_rightFDeriv
    (P.contDiff_cutoffAffineHeightUncurried χ) A u
  change fderiv ℝ (P.cutoffAffineHeight χ A) u =
    rightFDeriv (P.cutoffAffineHeightUncurried χ) (A, u) at h
  rw [h]

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.cutoffAffineHeight_zero

theorem cutoffAffineHeight_zero (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.cutoffAffineGradient_zero
statement:
theorem cutoffAffineGradient_zero (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (u : E₂) :

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.contDiff_cutoffAffineHessian
statement:
theorem contDiff_cutoffAffineHessian (P : IFTSurfaceChart C)

:=

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.cutoffAffineHessian_eq_fderiv_chartGradient
statement:
theorem cutoffAffineHessian_eq_fderiv_chartGradient
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (χ : SmoothCutoff K U)
    (A : Cov) (u : E₂) :
    P.cutoffAffineHessian χ (A, u) =
      fderiv ℝ (chartGradient (P.cutoffAffineHeight χ A)) u
proof:
:= by
  have h := fderiv_section_eq_rightFDeriv
    (P.contDiff_cutoffAffineGradient χ) A u
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y => P.cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, y)) u =
    P.cutoffAffineHessian χ (A, u) at h
  have heq : (fun y => P.cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, y)) =
      chartGradient (P.cutoffAffineHeight χ A) := by
    funext y
    exact P.cutoffAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient χ A y
  rw [← heq, h]

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.contDiff_cutoffAffineGradient_section
statement:
theorem contDiff_cutoffAffineGradient_section
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (A : Cov) :
