proof:
:=
  P.contDiff_cutoffAffineGradient χ |>.comp
    (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.forwardParam_mem_inversePullback_timeCritical_iff_cutoffGradient_eq_zero
statement:
theorem forwardParam_mem_inversePullback_timeCritical_iff_cutoffGradient_eq_zero
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (A : Cov)
    (forward : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n))
    (hforward : forward.toFun = χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A)
    (hsmall : 2 * forward.K < 1) {u : E₂}
    (hdom : P.domain ∈ nhds u) :
    forward.diffeomorph (P.param u) ∈
        timeCritical
          ((forward.inverse hsmall).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C).G ↔
      P.cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hinverse :
      (forward.inverse hsmall).diffeomorph.symm = forward.diffeomorph := by
    rw [forward.inverse_diffeomorph hsmall]
    rfl
  have hheight :
      (fun z => tcoord (forward.diffeomorph (P.param z))) =
        P.cutoffAffineHeight χ A := by
    funext z
    rw [SmallVerticalAmplitude.diffeomorph_apply, tcoord_verticalShift]
    change P.time z + forward.toFun (P.param z) =
      P.cutoffAffineHeight χ A z
    rw [hforward]
    rfl
  rw [← hinverse,
    P.pullbackParam_mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
      (forward.inverse hsmall) hdom,
    hinverse, hheight,
    ← P.cutoffAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient]

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.finite_cutoffChartCritical_inter_of_morseOn
statement:
theorem finite_cutoffChartCritical_inter_of_morseOn
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (A : Cov)
    {S : Set E₂} (hS : IsCompact S)
    (hMorse : P.CutoffAffineMorseOn χ A S) :
    (P.CutoffChartCritical χ A ∩ S).Finite
proof:
:= by
  let grad : E₂ → E₂ := fun u => P.cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, u)
  have hgrad : ContDiff ℝ ∞ grad :=
    P.contDiff_cutoffAffineGradient_section χ A
  have hclosed : IsClosed (P.CutoffChartCritical χ A) := by
    change IsClosed (grad ⁻¹' ({0} : Set E₂))
    exact isClosed_singleton.preimage hgrad.continuous
  have hdiscrete : IsDiscrete (P.CutoffChartCritical χ A ∩ S) := by
    rw [isDiscrete_iff_forall_mem_exists_isOpen]
    intro x hx
    have hxzero : grad x = 0 := hx.1
    have hbij : Bijective (P.cutoffAffineHessian χ (A, x)) := by
      have hgood := hMorse x hx.2
      rcases hgood with hne | hbij
      · exact (hne hxzero).elim
      · exact hbij
    have hsection :
        fderiv ℝ grad x = P.cutoffAffineHessian χ (A, x) := by
      exact fderiv_section_eq_rightFDeriv
        (P.contDiff_cutoffAffineGradient χ) A x
    have hbij' : Bijective (fderiv ℝ grad x) := by
      rw [hsection]
      exact hbij
    let e : E₂ ≃L[ℝ] E₂ :=
      ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective (fderiv ℝ grad x)
        (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hbij'.1)
        (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hbij'.2)
    have hderiv : HasFDerivAt grad (e : E₂ →L[ℝ] E₂) x := by
      have h := (hgrad.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
      simpa [e, ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_ofBijective] using h
    let φ := hgrad.contDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph grad hderiv (by simp)
    refine ⟨φ.source, φ.open_source, ?_⟩
    ext y
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hySource, hyCritical, _hyS⟩
      have hxSource : x ∈ φ.source :=
        hgrad.contDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hderiv (by simp)
      have hφ : (φ : E₂ → E₂) = grad := by rfl
      have hφyx : φ y = φ x := by
        rw [hφ]
        change grad y = 0 at hyCritical
        rw [hyCritical, hxzero]
      have hyx : y = x := φ.injOn hySource hxSource hφyx
      simpa [hyx]
    · intro hy
      rw [mem_singleton_iff] at hy
      subst y
      refine ⟨?_, hx⟩
      exact hgrad.contDiffAt.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
        hderiv (by simp)
  rw [inter_comm]
  apply (hS.inter_right hclosed).finite
  simpa [inter_comm] using hdiscrete

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.eventuallyEq_cutoffAffineHeight_sharedAffineHeight
statement:
theorem eventuallyEq_cutoffAffineHeight_sharedAffineHeight
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 1 / 4 < a) (hb : b < 3 / 4)
    {V : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff (compactInteriorFiber C a b) V)
    (A : Cov) {u : E₂} (hdom : P.domain ∈ 𝓝 u)
    (ht : P.time u ∈ Ioo a b) :
    P.cutoffAffineHeight χ A =ᶠ[𝓝 u] P.sharedAffineHeight A
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [P.eventually_mem_compactInteriorFiber ha hb hdom ht]
    with z hz
  simp [cutoffAffineHeight, cutoffAffineHeightUncurried,
    sharedAffineHeight, χ.eq_one (P.param z) hz]

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.cutoffAffineGradient_eq_sharedAffineGradient_of_plateau
statement:
theorem cutoffAffineGradient_eq_sharedAffineGradient_of_plateau
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) {a b : ℝ}
    (ha : 1 / 4 < a) (hb : b < 3 / 4)
    {V : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff (compactInteriorFiber C a b) V)
    (A : Cov) {u : E₂} (hdom : P.domain ∈ 𝓝 u)
    (ht : P.time u ∈ Ioo a b) :
    P.cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, u) = P.sharedAffineGradient (A, u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.cutoffAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient,
    P.sharedAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient]
  unfold chartGradient
  rw [(P.eventuallyEq_cutoffAffineHeight_sharedAffineHeight
    ha hb χ A hdom ht).fderiv_eq]

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.eventuallyEq_cutoffAffineGradient_sharedAffineGradient
statement:
theorem eventuallyEq_cutoffAffineGradient_sharedAffineGradient
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (hopen : IsOpen P.domain)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 / 4 < a) (hb : b < 3 / 4)
    {V : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff (compactInteriorFiber C a b) V)
    (A : Cov) {u : E₂} (hu : u ∈ P.domain)
    (ht : P.time u ∈ Ioo a b) :
    (fun z => P.cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, z)) =ᶠ[𝓝 u]
      (fun z => P.sharedAffineGradient (A, z))
proof:
:= by
  have htime : P.time ⁻¹' Ioo a b ∈ 𝓝 u :=
    (isOpen_Ioo.preimage P.contDiff_time.continuous).mem_nhds ht
  filter_upwards [hopen.mem_nhds hu, htime] with z hzDom hzTime
  exact P.cutoffAffineGradient_eq_sharedAffineGradient_of_plateau
    ha hb χ A (hopen.mem_nhds hzDom) hzTime

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.cutoffAffineHessian_eq_sharedAffineHessian_of_plateau
statement:
theorem cutoffAffineHessian_eq_sharedAffineHessian_of_plateau
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (hopen : IsOpen P.domain)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 / 4 < a) (hb : b < 3 / 4)
    {V : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff (compactInteriorFiber C a b) V)
    (A : Cov) {u : E₂} (hu : u ∈ P.domain)
    (ht : P.time u ∈ Ioo a b) :
    P.cutoffAffineHessian χ (A, u) = P.sharedAffineHessian (A, u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.cutoffAffineHessian_eq_fderiv_chartGradient,
    P.sharedAffineHessian_eq_fderiv_chartGradient]
  have hcut : chartGradient (P.cutoffAffineHeight χ A) =
      fun z => P.cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, z) := by
    funext z
    exact (P.cutoffAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient χ A z).symm
  have hshared : chartGradient (P.sharedAffineHeight A) =
      fun z => P.sharedAffineGradient (A, z) := by
    funext z
    exact (P.sharedAffineGradient_eq_chartGradient A z).symm
  rw [hcut, hshared]
  exact (P.eventuallyEq_cutoffAffineGradient_sharedAffineGradient
    hopen ha hb χ A hu ht).fderiv_eq

name: Submission.IFTSurfaceChart.cutoffAffineMorseJet_eq_sharedAffineMorseJet_of_plateau
statement:
theorem cutoffAffineMorseJet_eq_sharedAffineMorseJet_of_plateau
    (P : IFTSurfaceChart C) (hopen : IsOpen P.domain)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 / 4 < a) (hb : b < 3 / 4)
    {V : Set E'} (χ : SmoothCutoff (compactInteriorFiber C a b) V)
    (A : Cov) {u : E₂} (hu : u ∈ P.domain)
    (ht : P.time u ∈ Ioo a b) :
    P.cutoffAffineMorseJet χ (A, u) = P.sharedAffineMorseJet (A, u)
proof:
:= by
  apply Prod.ext
  · exact P.cutoffAffineGradient_eq_sharedAffineGradient_of_plateau
      ha hb χ A (hopen.mem_nhds hu) ht
  · exact P.cutoffAffineHessian_eq_sharedAffineHessian_of_plateau
      hopen ha hb χ A hu ht

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.isCompact_cutoffTransitionCore
statement:
theorem isCompact_cutoffTransitionCore
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι) (i : ι) (a b : ℝ) :
    IsCompact (B.cutoffTransitionCore i a b)
proof:
:= by
  exact (B.compact_core i).inter_right
    ((isClosed_Iic.union isClosed_Ici).preimage
      (B.chart i).contDiff_time.continuous)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.cutoffAffineGradient_zero_ne_on_transitionCore
statement:
theorem cutoffAffineGradient_zero_ne_on_transitionCore
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    {K U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) {a b : ℝ}
    (hcrit : timeCritical C.G ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo a b)
    (i : ι) (u : E₂) (hu : u ∈ B.cutoffTransitionCore i a b) :
    (B.chart i).cutoffAffineGradient χ (0, u) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(B.chart i).cutoffAffineGradient_zero]
  intro hzero
  have huDom : u ∈ (B.chart i).domain := B.core_subset_domain i hu.1
  have hamb : (B.chart i).param u ∈ timeCritical C.G :=
    ((B.chart i).mem_timeCritical_iff_chartGradient_eq_zero
      ((B.domain_open i).mem_nhds huDom)).2 hzero
  have hin := hcrit hamb
  change (B.chart i).time u ∈ Ioo a b at hin
  rcases hu.2 with hle | hge
  · exact (not_lt_of_ge hle) hin.1
  · exact (not_lt_of_ge hge) hin.2

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.eventually_cutoffAffineGradient_ne_on_transitionCore
statement:
theorem eventually_cutoffAffineGradient_ne_on_transitionCore
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    {K U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) {a b : ℝ}
    (hcrit : timeCritical C.G ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo a b)
    (i : ι) :
    ∀ᶠ A : Cov in 𝓝 0, ∀ u ∈ B.cutoffTransitionCore i a b,
      (B.chart i).cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, u) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (B.isCompact_cutoffTransitionCore i a b).eventually_forall_of_forall_eventually
  intro u hu
  have hzero := B.cutoffAffineGradient_zero_ne_on_transitionCore
    χ hcrit i u hu
  exact (B.chart i).contDiff_cutoffAffineGradient χ |>.continuous.continuousAt
    (isClosed_singleton.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hzero)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.eventually_all_cutoffAffineGradient_ne_on_transitionCore
statement:
theorem eventually_all_cutoffAffineGradient_ne_on_transitionCore
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    {K U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) {a b : ℝ}
    (hcrit : timeCritical C.G ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo a b) :
    ∀ᶠ A : Cov in 𝓝 0, ∀ i, ∀ u ∈ B.cutoffTransitionCore i a b,
      (B.chart i).cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, u) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eventually_all]
  intro i
  exact B.eventually_cutoffAffineGradient_ne_on_transitionCore χ hcrit i

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.cutoffAffineMorseOn_core_of_shared_of_noTransition
statement:
theorem cutoffAffineMorseOn_core_of_shared_of_noTransition
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 / 4 < a) (hb : b < 3 / 4)
    {U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (χ : SmoothCutoff (compactInteriorFiber C a b) U)
    (A : Cov)
    (hshared : ∀ i,
      (B.chart i).SharedAffineMorseOn A (B.core i))
    (htransition : ∀ i, ∀ u ∈ B.cutoffTransitionCore i a b,
      (B.chart i).cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, u) ≠ 0) :
    ∀ i, (B.chart i).CutoffAffineMorseOn χ A (B.core i)
proof:
:= by
  intro i u hu
  by_cases ht : (B.chart i).time u ∈ Ioo a b
  · have hjet :=
      (B.chart i).cutoffAffineMorseJet_eq_sharedAffineMorseJet_of_plateau
        (B.domain_open i) ha hb χ A (B.core_subset_domain i hu) ht
    change (B.chart i).cutoffAffineMorseJet χ (A, u) ∈ MorseJetGood
    rw [hjet]
    exact hshared i u hu
  · change (B.chart i).cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, u) ≠ 0 ∨
      Bijective ((B.chart i).cutoffAffineHessian χ (A, u))
    apply Or.inl
    apply htransition i u
    refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
    change (B.chart i).time u ∈ Iic a ∪ Ici b
    by_cases hleft : (B.chart i).time u ≤ a
    · exact Or.inl hleft
    · apply Or.inr
      exact le_of_not_gt fun hright => ht ⟨lt_of_not_ge hleft, hright⟩

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.finite_cutoffCriticalPoints
statement:
theorem finite_cutoffCriticalPoints
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    {K U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (A : Cov)
    (hMorse : ∀ i,
      (B.chart i).CutoffAffineMorseOn χ A (B.core i)) :
    (B.cutoffCriticalPoints χ A).Finite
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hfinite (i : ι) :
      ((B.chart i).CutoffChartCritical χ A ∩ B.core i).Finite :=
    (B.chart i).finite_cutoffChartCritical_inter_of_morseOn
      χ A (B.compact_core i) (hMorse i)
  let s : Finset (Σ _ : ι, E₂) :=
    Finset.univ.sigma fun i => (hfinite i).toFinset
  apply s.finite_toSet.subset
  intro p hp
  change p ∈ s
  simp only [s, Finset.mem_sigma, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
    Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
  exact hp

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.finite_cutoffCoreCriticalParameters
statement:
theorem finite_cutoffCoreCriticalParameters
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    {K U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (A : Cov)
    (forward : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n))
    (hMorse : ∀ i,
      (B.chart i).CutoffAffineMorseOn χ A (B.core i)) :
    (B.cutoffCoreCriticalParameters χ A forward).Finite
proof:
:= by
  apply (B.finite_cutoffCriticalPoints χ A hMorse).subset
  intro p hp
  exact hp.1

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.image_cutoffCoreCriticalParameters_eq_coreCriticalPoints
statement:
theorem image_cutoffCoreCriticalParameters_eq_coreCriticalPoints
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    {K U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U) (A : Cov)
    (forward : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n))
    (hforward : forward.toFun = χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A)
    (hsmall : 2 * forward.K < 1) :
    B.cutoffCriticalCenter forward ''
        B.cutoffCoreCriticalParameters χ A forward =
      coreCriticalPoints
        ((forward.inverse hsmall).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro v ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨?_, hp.2⟩
    have hpCore : p.2 ∈ B.core p.1 := hp.1.2
    exact ((B.chart p.1).forwardParam_mem_inversePullback_timeCritical_iff_cutoffGradient_eq_zero
        χ A forward hforward hsmall
        ((B.domain_open p.1).mem_nhds
          (B.core_subset_domain p.1 hpCore))).2 hp.1.1
  · intro v hv
    obtain ⟨i, u, huCore, huv⟩ :=
      B.exists_pullback_chart_parameter_of_coreCritical
        (forward.inverse hsmall) hv
    have hinverse :
        (forward.inverse hsmall).diffeomorph.symm =
          forward.diffeomorph := by
      rw [forward.inverse_diffeomorph hsmall]
      rfl
    have huv' : B.cutoffCriticalCenter forward ⟨i, u⟩ = v := by
      change forward.diffeomorph ((B.chart i).param u) = v
      rw [← hinverse]
      exact huv
    change forward.diffeomorph ((B.chart i).param u) = v at huv'
    refine ⟨⟨i, u⟩, ?_, huv'⟩
    refine ⟨⟨?_, huCore⟩, ?_⟩
    · exact ((B.chart i).forwardParam_mem_inversePullback_timeCritical_iff_cutoffGradient_eq_zero
          χ A forward hforward hsmall
          ((B.domain_open i).mem_nhds
            (B.core_subset_domain i huCore))).1 (huv'.symm ▸ hv.1)
    · change tcoord (forward.diffeomorph ((B.chart i).param u)) ∈
        Icc (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ)
      exact huv'.symm ▸ hv.2

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.exists_sharedMorse_globalCutoffAmplitude
statement:
theorem exists_sharedMorse_globalCutoffAmplitude
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    {K U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U)
    (hU : U ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ)) :
    ∃ A : Cov,
      (∀ i, (B.chart i).SharedAffineMorseOn A (B.core i)) ∧
      ∃ forward : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n),
        forward.toFun = χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A ∧
          2 * forward.K < 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hsmall⟩ :=
    χ.exists_lipschitz_radius_localizeCovector (n := n)
  obtain ⟨A, hAball, hMorse⟩ :=
    B.exists_sharedAffineMorseCovector_in_ball hδ
  have hAnorm : ‖A‖ < δ := by
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hAball
  have hlip := hsmall A hAnorm
  let forward := χ.smallForwardOfCovector (n := n) hU A hlip
  refine ⟨A, hMorse, forward, rfl, ?_⟩
  exact χ.smallForwardOfCovector_twice_K_lt_one (n := n) hU A hlip

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.exists_sharedMorse_globalCutoffAmplitude_noTransition
statement:
theorem exists_sharedMorse_globalCutoffAmplitude_noTransition
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    {K U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (χ : SmoothCutoff K U)
    (hU : U ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ))
    {a b : ℝ} (hcrit : timeCritical C.G ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo a b) :
    ∃ A : Cov,
      (∀ i, (B.chart i).SharedAffineMorseOn A (B.core i)) ∧
      (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ B.cutoffTransitionCore i a b,
        (B.chart i).cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, u) ≠ 0) ∧
      ∃ forward : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n),
        forward.toFun = χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A ∧
          2 * forward.K < 1
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hsmall⟩ :=
    χ.exists_lipschitz_radius_localizeCovector (n := n)
  have hball : ball (0 : Cov) δ ∈ 𝓝 0 := ball_mem_nhds 0 hδ
  have htransition :=
    B.eventually_all_cutoffAffineGradient_ne_on_transitionCore χ hcrit
  have hchoice :
      {A : Cov | A ∈ ball 0 δ ∧
        ∀ i, ∀ u ∈ B.cutoffTransitionCore i a b,
          (B.chart i).cutoffAffineGradient χ (A, u) ≠ 0} ∈ 𝓝 0 := by
    filter_upwards [hball, htransition] with A hA hAtransition
    exact ⟨hA, hAtransition⟩
  obtain ⟨A, hAchoice, hMorse⟩ :=
    B.exists_sharedAffineMorseCovector_mem_nhds hchoice
  have hAnorm : ‖A‖ < δ := by
    simpa [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using hAchoice.1
  have hlip := hsmall A hAnorm
  let forward := χ.smallForwardOfCovector (n := n) hU A hlip
  refine ⟨A, hMorse, hAchoice.2, forward, rfl, ?_⟩
  exact χ.smallForwardOfCovector_twice_K_lt_one (n := n) hU A hlip

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.exists_sharedMorse_globalCutoffCriticalCover
statement:
theorem exists_sharedMorse_globalCutoffCriticalCover
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι)
    {a b : ℝ} (ha : 1 / 4 < a) (hb : b < 3 / 4)
    {U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (χ : SmoothCutoff (compactInteriorFiber C a b) U)
    (hU : U ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ))
    (hcrit : timeCritical C.G ⊆ tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo a b) :
    ∃ A : Cov, ∃ forward : SmallVerticalAmplitude (n := n),
      ∃ hsmall : 2 * forward.K < 1,
        forward.toFun = χ.localizeCovector (n := n) A ∧
        (∀ i, (B.chart i).CutoffAffineMorseOn χ A (B.core i)) ∧
        (B.cutoffCoreCriticalParameters χ A forward).Finite ∧
        B.cutoffCriticalCenter forward ''
            B.cutoffCoreCriticalParameters χ A forward =
          coreCriticalPoints
            ((forward.inverse hsmall).toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨A, hshared, htransition, forward, hforward, hsmall⟩ :=
    B.exists_sharedMorse_globalCutoffAmplitude_noTransition χ hU hcrit
  have hMorse : ∀ i,
      (B.chart i).CutoffAffineMorseOn χ A (B.core i) :=
    B.cutoffAffineMorseOn_core_of_shared_of_noTransition
      ha hb χ A hshared htransition
  refine ⟨A, forward, hsmall, hforward, hMorse, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact B.finite_cutoffCoreCriticalParameters χ A forward hMorse
  · exact B.image_cutoffCoreCriticalParameters_eq_coreCriticalPoints
      χ A forward hforward hsmall

name: Submission.UnitSphere.norm_coe
statement: theorem UnitSphere.norm_coe (v : UnitSphere E) : ‖(v : E)‖ = 1
proof:
:=
  mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mp v.2

name: Submission.UnitSphere.coe_ne_neg_coe
statement:
theorem UnitSphere.coe_ne_neg_coe {u v : UnitSphere E} (h : u ≠ -v) :
    (u : E) ≠ -(v : E)
proof:
:= fun hc =>
  h (Subtype.ext (hc.trans (coe_neg_sphere v).symm))

name: Submission.dist_lt_two_of_ne_neg
statement: theorem dist_lt_two_of_ne_neg (u v : UnitSphere E) (h : u ≠ -v) : dist u v < 2
proof:
:= by
  have hu : ‖(u : E)‖ = 1 := UnitSphere.norm_coe u
  have hv : ‖(v : E)‖ = 1 := UnitSphere.norm_coe v
  have hne : ⟪(u : E), (v : E)⟫ ≠ -1 := fun hc =>
    UnitSphere.coe_ne_neg_coe h ((inner_eq_neg_one_iff_of_norm_eq_one hu hv).mp hc)
  have hge : -1 ≤ ⟪(u : E), (v : E)⟫ := neg_one_le_real_inner_of_norm_eq_one hu hv
  have hlt : -1 < ⟪(u : E), (v : E)⟫ := lt_of_le_of_ne hge (Ne.symm hne)
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
  refine lt_of_pow_lt_pow_left₀ 2 (by norm_num) ?_
  rw [norm_sub_sq_real, hu, hv]
  nlinarith

name: Submission.ne_neg_of_dist_lt_two
statement: theorem ne_neg_of_dist_lt_two (u v : UnitSphere E) (h : dist u v < 2) : u ≠ -v
proof:
:= by
  rintro rfl
  have hv : ‖(v : E)‖ = 1 := UnitSphere.norm_coe v
  rw [Subtype.dist_eq, coe_neg_sphere, dist_eq_norm] at h
  have : -(v : E) - v = (-2 : ℝ) • (v : E) := by module
  rw [this, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, hv] at h
  norm_num at h

name: Submission.norm_normalize
statement: theorem norm_normalize {v : E} (hv : v ≠ 0) : ‖‖v‖⁻¹ • v‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm]
  exact inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hv)

name: Submission.chord_ne_zero
statement:
theorem chord_ne_zero {u w : E} (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) (hw : ‖w‖ = 1) (h : u ≠ -w) {s : ℝ}
    (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) : (1 - s) • u + s • w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hkey : (1 - s) • u = s • (-w) := by
    rw [smul_neg]
    exact add_eq_zero_iff_eq_neg.mp hc
  have hnorm : 1 - s = s := by
    have h1 : ‖(1 - s) • u‖ = ‖s • (-w)‖ := by rw [hkey]
    rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, hu, norm_neg, hw, mul_one, mul_one,
      Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith),
      abs_of_nonneg hs0] at h1
    exact h1
  have hsne : s ≠ 0 := by intro h0; rw [h0, sub_zero] at hnorm; norm_num at hnorm
  rw [hnorm] at hkey
  exact h (smul_right_injective E hsne hkey)

name: Submission.chordMap_ne_zero
statement:
theorem chordMap_ne_zero (f g : C(A, UnitSphere E)) (h : ∀ a, dist (f a) (g a) < 2)
    (sa : I × A) : chordMap f g sa ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  chord_ne_zero (UnitSphere.norm_coe (f sa.2)) (UnitSphere.norm_coe (g sa.2))
    (UnitSphere.coe_ne_neg_coe (ne_neg_of_dist_lt_two _ _ (h sa.2)))
    (sa.1.2.1) (sa.1.2.2)

statement:

theorem normalizeMap_coe (g : C(A, E)) (hg : ∀ a, g a ≠ 0) (a : A) :

:=

name: Submission.ne_zero_of_dist_lt_one
statement:
theorem ne_zero_of_dist_lt_one {f : C(A, UnitSphere E)} {g : C(A, E)}
    (h : ∀ a, dist ((f a : E)) (g a) < 1) (a : A) : g a ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have := h a
  rw [hc, dist_zero_right, UnitSphere.norm_coe (f a)] at this
  exact lt_irrefl 1 this

name: Submission.inner_pos_of_dist_lt_one
statement:
theorem inner_pos_of_dist_lt_one {f : C(A, UnitSphere E)} {g : C(A, E)}
    (h : ∀ a, dist ((f a : E)) (g a) < 1) (a : A) : 0 < ⟪(f a : E), g a⟫
proof:
:= by
  have hf : ‖(f a : E)‖ = 1 := UnitSphere.norm_coe (f a)
  have h1 : ⟪(f a : E), (f a : E) - g a⟫ ≤ ‖(f a : E)‖ * ‖(f a : E) - g a‖ :=
    real_inner_le_norm _ _
  have h2 : ‖(f a : E) - g a‖ < 1 := by
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]; exact h a
  have h3 : ⟪(f a : E), (f a : E) - g a⟫
      = ⟪(f a : E), (f a : E)⟫ - ⟪(f a : E), g a⟫ := inner_sub_right _ _ _
  have h4 : ⟪(f a : E), (f a : E)⟫ = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hf]; norm_num
  rw [hf, one_mul] at h1
  linarith

name: Submission.normalizedRawHomotopyRel
statement:
theorem normalizedRawHomotopyRel (f : C(A, UnitSphere E)) (g : C(A, E))
    (h : ∀ a, dist ((f a : E)) (g a) < 1) (S : Set A)
    (hS : ∀ a ∈ S, g a = (f a : E)) :
    f.HomotopicRel (normalizeMap g (ne_zero_of_dist_lt_one h)) S
proof:
:= by
  refine homotopicRel_of_dist_lt_two f _ (fun a => ?_) S (fun a ha => ?_)
  · refine dist_lt_two_of_ne_neg _ _ fun hc => ?_
    have hpos : 0 < ⟪(f a : E), g a⟫ := inner_pos_of_dist_lt_one h a
    have hcoe : (f a : E) = -(‖g a‖⁻¹ • g a) := by
      rw [hc, coe_neg_sphere]; rfl
    have hneg : ⟪(f a : E), g a⟫ = -(‖g a‖⁻¹ * ⟪g a, g a⟫) := by
      rw [hcoe, inner_neg_left, real_inner_smul_left]
    have hg0 : (0 : ℝ) < ‖g a‖ :=
      norm_pos_iff.mpr (ne_zero_of_dist_lt_one h a)
    have hgg : ⟪g a, g a⟫ = ‖g a‖ ^ 2 := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _
    rw [hneg, hgg] at hpos
    have hmul : 0 < ‖g a‖⁻¹ * ‖g a‖ ^ 2 := mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hg0) (pow_pos hg0 2)
    linarith
  · apply Subtype.ext
    rw [normalizeMap_coe, hS a ha, UnitSphere.norm_coe (f a)]
    simp

name: Submission.updateRow_crossRows
statement:
lemma updateRow_crossRows (v : Fin n → E) (w w' : E) :
    (crossRows v w).updateRow 0 (WithLp.ofLp w') = crossRows v w'
proof:
:= by
  unfold crossRows
  ext i j
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
  · simp
  · simp

name: Submission.crossDet_add
statement:
lemma crossDet_add (v : Fin n → E) (w w' : E) :
    crossDet v (w + w') = crossDet v w + crossDet v w'
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.det_updateRow_add (crossRows v w) 0
    (WithLp.ofLp w) (WithLp.ofLp w')
  rw [show WithLp.ofLp w + WithLp.ofLp w' = WithLp.ofLp (w + w') from rfl] at h
  simpa only [crossDet, updateRow_crossRows] using h

name: Submission.crossDet_smul
statement:
lemma crossDet_smul (v : Fin n → E) (c : ℝ) (w : E) :
    crossDet v (c • w) = c * crossDet v w
proof:
:= by
  have h := Matrix.det_updateRow_smul (crossRows v w) 0 c (WithLp.ofLp w)
  rw [show c • WithLp.ofLp w = WithLp.ofLp (c • w) from rfl] at h
  simpa only [crossDet, updateRow_crossRows] using h

name: Submission.crossLM_apply
statement: @[simp] lemma crossLM_apply (v : Fin n → E) (w : E) : crossLM v w = crossDet v w
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.crossDet_apply_self
statement:
lemma crossDet_apply_self (v : Fin n → E) (i : Fin n) :
    crossDet v (v i) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq (i := (0 : Fin (n + 1))) (j := i.succ)
  · exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero i).symm
  · show crossRows v (v i) 0 = crossRows v (v i) i.succ
    funext j
    simp [crossRows]

name: Submission.crossVec_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma crossVec_apply (v : Fin n → E) (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
    crossVec v j = crossDet v (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.inner_crossVec
statement:
lemma inner_crossVec (v : Fin n → E) (w : E) :
    ⟪crossVec v, w⟫ = crossDet v w
proof:
:= by
  have hw : w = ∑ j, w j • EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ) := by
    have h := (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).sum_repr w
    simpa [EuclideanSpace.basisFun_apply, EuclideanSpace.basisFun_repr] using h.symm
  calc ⟪crossVec v, w⟫ = ∑ j, w j * crossDet v (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) := by
        simp [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply]
    _ = crossLM v (∑ j, w j • EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) := by
        rw [map_sum]
        simp
    _ = crossDet v w := by rw [← hw]; rfl

name: Submission.crossVec_inner
statement:
lemma crossVec_inner (v : Fin n → E) (w : E) :
    ⟪w, crossVec v⟫ = crossDet v w
proof:
:= by
  rw [real_inner_comm, inner_crossVec]

name: Submission.inner_crossVec_self
statement:
lemma inner_crossVec_self (v : Fin n → E) (i : Fin n) :
    ⟪crossVec v, v i⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_crossVec, crossDet_apply_self]

name: Submission.crossDet_crossVec
statement:
lemma crossDet_crossVec (v : Fin n → E) :
    crossDet v (crossVec v) = ‖crossVec v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← inner_crossVec, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]

name: Submission.row_crossRows
statement:
lemma row_crossRows (v : Fin n → E) (w : E) :
    (crossRows v w).row = fun i => WithLp.ofLp ((Fin.cons w v : Fin (n + 1) → E) i)
proof:
:= by
  funext i j
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩ <;> simp [crossRows, Matrix.row]

name: Submission.linearIndependent_rows_iff
statement:
lemma linearIndependent_rows_iff (v : Fin n → E) (w : E) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (crossRows v w).row ↔
      LinearIndependent ℝ (Fin.cons w v : Fin (n + 1) → E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [row_crossRows]
  exact (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)).toLinearMap.linearIndependent_iff
    (LinearEquiv.ker _) (v := (Fin.cons w v : Fin (n + 1) → E))

name: Submission.crossDet_ne_zero_iff
statement:
lemma crossDet_ne_zero_iff (v : Fin n → E) (w : E) :
    crossDet v w ≠ 0 ↔ LinearIndependent ℝ (Fin.cons w v : Fin (n + 1) → E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← linearIndependent_rows_iff, Matrix.linearIndependent_rows_iff_isUnit,
    Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
  rfl

name: Submission.crossVec_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent
statement:
lemma crossVec_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent {v : Fin n → E}
    (hv : ¬ LinearIndependent ℝ v) : crossVec v = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : ∀ w : E, crossDet v w = 0 := by
    intro w
    by_contra h
    have hcomp := ((crossDet_ne_zero_iff v w).mp h).comp Fin.succ (Fin.succ_injective n)
    rw [show (Fin.cons w v : Fin (n + 1) → E) ∘ Fin.succ = v from
      funext fun i => by simp] at hcomp
    exact hv hcomp
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext j
  simpa using h0 (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)

name: Submission.crossVec_ne_zero_of_linearIndependent
statement:
lemma crossVec_ne_zero_of_linearIndependent {v : Fin n → E}
    (hv : LinearIndependent ℝ v) : crossVec v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hlt : finrank ℝ (span ℝ (range v)) < finrank ℝ E := by
    have h1 : finrank ℝ (span ℝ (range v)) ≤ n := by
      simpa [Set.finrank] using finrank_range_le_card v
    have h2 : finrank ℝ E = n + 1 := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
    omega
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (span ℝ (range v)).exists_of_finrank_lt hlt
  have hwmem : w ∉ span ℝ (range v) := by
    simpa using hw 1 one_ne_zero
  have hcons : LinearIndependent ℝ (Fin.cons w v : Fin (n + 1) → E) :=
    hv.finCons hwmem
  have hdet : crossDet v w ≠ 0 := (crossDet_ne_zero_iff v w).mpr hcons
  intro hzero
  apply hdet
  rw [← inner_crossVec, hzero, inner_zero_left]

name: Submission.crossVec_ne_zero_iff
statement:
lemma crossVec_ne_zero_iff (v : Fin n → E) :
    crossVec v ≠ 0 ↔ LinearIndependent ℝ v
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hv
    exact h (crossVec_eq_zero_of_not_linearIndependent hv)
  · exact crossVec_ne_zero_of_linearIndependent

name: Submission.inner_gradVec
statement:
lemma inner_gradVec (g : E → F) (i : Fin n) (x : E) (w : E) :
    ⟪gradVec g i x, w⟫ = fderiv ℝ g x w i
proof:
:=
  InnerProductSpace.toDual_symm_apply

name: Submission.inner_sum_gradVec
statement:
lemma inner_sum_gradVec (g : E → F) (x : E) (c : F) (w : E) :
    ⟪∑ i, c i • gradVec g i x, w⟫ = ⟪c, fderiv ℝ g x w⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [sum_inner]
  simp only [real_inner_smul_left, inner_gradVec]
  simp only [PiLp.inner_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _

name: Submission.surjective_fderiv_iff_linearIndependent
statement:
lemma surjective_fderiv_iff_linearIndependent (g : E → F) (x : E) :
    Surjective (fderiv ℝ g x) ↔ LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i => gradVec g i x)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hsurj
    rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff]
    intro c hc i
    set c' : F := WithLp.toLp 2 c with hc'
    have hzero : ∀ y : F, ⟪c', y⟫ = 0 := by
      intro y
      obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hsurj y
      rw [← inner_sum_gradVec]
      have : (∑ j, c' j • gradVec g j x) = 0 := hc
      rw [this, inner_zero_left]
    have : c' = 0 := by
      have := hzero c'
      rwa [inner_self_eq_zero] at this
    have : c' i = 0 := by rw [this]; rfl
    exact this
  · intro hind
    
    by_contra hsurj
    have hrange : LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℝ g x) : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) ≠ ⊤ := by
      intro h
      exact hsurj (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mp h)
    have hbot : (LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℝ g x) : E →ₗ[ℝ] F))ᗮ ≠ ⊥ := by
      intro h
      exact hrange (Submodule.orthogonal_eq_bot_iff.mp h)
    obtain ⟨c', hc'mem, hc'ne⟩ := Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot hbot
    have hzero : ∀ w : E, ⟪c', fderiv ℝ g x w⟫ = 0 := fun w => by
      rw [Submodule.mem_orthogonal'] at hc'mem
      exact hc'mem (fderiv ℝ g x w) (LinearMap.mem_range_self _ w)
    have hsum : (∑ i, c' i • gradVec g i x) = 0 := by
      have h := hzero
      have : ⟪∑ i, c' i • gradVec g i x, ∑ i, c' i • gradVec g i x⟫ = 0 := by
        rw [inner_sum_gradVec, hzero]
      rwa [inner_self_eq_zero] at this
    have hall : ∀ i, c' i = 0 := by
      rw [Fintype.linearIndependent_iff] at hind
      exact hind (fun i => c' i) hsum
    apply hc'ne
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext i
    exact hall i

name: Submission.contDiff_crossVec_comp
statement:
lemma contDiff_crossVec_comp {X : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [NormedSpace ℝ X]
    {v : X → Fin n → E} (hv : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x => v x i) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x => crossVec (v x)
proof:
:= by
  have : (fun x => crossVec (v x)) = fun x =>
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).symm
        (fun j => crossDet (v x) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1)) := rfl
  rw [this]
  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp
  rw [contDiff_pi]
  intro j
  
  simp only [crossDet, Matrix.det_apply']
  apply ContDiff.sum
  intro σ _
  apply ContDiff.mul contDiff_const
  apply contDiff_prod
  intro i _
  show ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x => crossRows (v x) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) (σ i) i
  have hentry : ∀ (m : Fin (n + 1)), ContDiff ℝ ∞
      fun x => crossRows (v x) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1) m i := by
    intro m
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ m with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
    · simp only [crossRows, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.cons_zero]
      exact contDiff_const
    · simp only [crossRows, Matrix.of_apply, Fin.cons_succ]
      exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i).contDiff.comp (hv k)
  exact hentry (σ i)

name: Submission.contDiff_gradVec
statement:
lemma contDiff_gradVec (g : E → F) (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) (i : Fin n) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (gradVec g i)
proof:
:= by
  apply (InnerProductSpace.toDual ℝ
    (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))).symm.contDiff.comp
  have : (fun x => (EuclideanSpace.proj i).comp (fderiv ℝ g x)) =
      fun x => (ContinuousLinearMap.compL ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
        (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj i)) (fderiv ℝ g x) := rfl
  rw [this]
  exact (ContinuousLinearMap.contDiff _).comp (hg.fderiv_right (by simp))

name: Submission.contDiff_kerCross
statement:
lemma contDiff_kerCross {g : E → F} (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (kerCross g)
proof:
:=
  contDiff_crossVec_comp fun i => contDiff_gradVec g hg i

name: Submission.kerCross_ne_zero_iff
statement:
lemma kerCross_ne_zero_iff (g : E → F) (x : E) :
    kerCross g x ≠ 0 ↔ x ∈ regularSet g
proof:
:= by
  rw [kerCross, crossVec_ne_zero_iff]
  exact (surjective_fderiv_iff_linearIndependent g x).symm

name: Submission.isOpen_regularSet
statement:
lemma isOpen_regularSet {g : E → F} (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) :
    IsOpen (regularSet g)
proof:
:= by
  have : regularSet g = kerCross g ⁻¹' ({0}ᶜ) := by
    ext x
    simp only [mem_preimage, mem_compl_iff, mem_singleton_iff]
    exact (kerCross_ne_zero_iff g x).symm
  rw [this]
  exact (contDiff_kerCross hg).continuous.isOpen_preimage _ isOpen_compl_singleton

name: Submission.norm_tauField
statement:
lemma norm_tauField {g : E → F} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ regularSet g) :
    ‖tauField g x‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : kerCross g x ≠ 0 := (kerCross_ne_zero_iff g x).mpr hx
  rw [tauField, norm_smul, norm_inv, norm_norm,
    inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h)]

name: Submission.tauField_ne_zero
statement:
lemma tauField_ne_zero {g : E → F} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ regularSet g) :
    tauField g x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := norm_tauField hx
  rw [h, norm_zero] at this
  norm_num at this

name: Submission.fderiv_kerCross_eq_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_kerCross_eq_zero (g : E → F) (x : E) :
    fderiv ℝ g x (kerCross g x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  have h : ⟪kerCross g x, gradVec g i x⟫ = 0 :=
    inner_crossVec_self (fun j => gradVec g j x) i
  rw [real_inner_comm] at h
  rw [inner_gradVec] at h
  exact h

name: Submission.fderiv_tauField_eq_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_tauField_eq_zero (g : E → F) (x : E) :
    fderiv ℝ g x (tauField g x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauField, map_smul, fderiv_kerCross_eq_zero, smul_zero]

name: Submission.crossDet_tauField_pos
statement:
lemma crossDet_tauField_pos {g : E → F} {x : E} (hx : x ∈ regularSet g) :
    0 < crossDet (fun i => gradVec g i x) (tauField g x)
proof:
:= by
  have h : kerCross g x ≠ 0 := (kerCross_ne_zero_iff g x).mpr hx
  rw [tauField, crossDet_smul]
  have h2 : crossDet (fun i => gradVec g i x) (kerCross g x) = ‖kerCross g x‖ ^ 2 :=
    crossDet_crossVec _
  rw [h2]
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < ‖kerCross g x‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr h
  exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr hpos) (pow_pos hpos 2)

name: Submission.fderiv_eq_zero_iff_mem_span_tauField
proof:
:= by
  have hker : LinearMap.ker ((fderiv ℝ g x) : E →ₗ[ℝ] F)
      = Submodule.span ℝ {tauField g x} := by
    have hle : Submodule.span ℝ {tauField g x} ≤
        LinearMap.ker ((fderiv ℝ g x) : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) := by
      rw [Submodule.span_singleton_le_iff_mem, LinearMap.mem_ker]
      exact fderiv_tauField_eq_zero g x
    apply (Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le hle ?_).symm
    
    have hrn := LinearMap.finrank_range_add_finrank_ker ((fderiv ℝ g x) : E →ₗ[ℝ] F)
    have hrange : LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℝ g x) : E →ₗ[ℝ] F) = ⊤ :=
      LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hx
    rw [hrange, finrank_top] at hrn
    have hF : finrank ℝ F = n := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
    have hE : finrank ℝ E = n + 1 := finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
    have hker1 : finrank ℝ (LinearMap.ker ((fderiv ℝ g x) : E →ₗ[ℝ] F)) = 1 := by
      omega
    rw [hker1, finrank_span_singleton (tauField_ne_zero hx)]
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [← hker]
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr h
  · intro h
    rw [← hker] at h
    exact LinearMap.mem_ker.mp h

name: Submission.contDiffOn_tauField
statement:
lemma contDiffOn_tauField {g : E → F} (hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (tauField g) (regularSet g)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  apply ContDiffWithinAt.mono_of_mem_nhdsWithin
    (s := regularSet g) ?_ (self_mem_nhdsWithin)
  have h : kerCross g x ≠ 0 := (kerCross_ne_zero_iff g x).mpr hx
  have hker : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (kerCross g) x := (contDiff_kerCross hg).contDiffAt
  have hnorm : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => ‖kerCross g y‖) x := hker.norm ℝ h
  have hinv : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y => ‖kerCross g y‖⁻¹) x := hnorm.inv
    (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h)
  exact (hinv.smul hker).contDiffWithinAt

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.contDiff_displacement
statement:
theorem contDiff_displacement :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : P => G.displacement p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact (contDiff_normRamp.comp contDiff_fst).smul
    (G.h_smooth.comp contDiff_snd)

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.norm_displacement_le
statement:
theorem norm_displacement_le (s u : ℝ) :
    ‖G.displacement s u‖ ≤ G.normBound
proof:
:= by
  rw [displacement, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (normRamp_nonneg s)]
  calc
    normRamp s * ‖G.h u‖ ≤ 1 * G.normBound :=
      mul_le_mul (normRamp_le_one s) (G.norm_h_le u)
        (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
    _ = G.normBound := one_mul _

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.contDiff_perturbation
statement:
theorem contDiff_perturbation :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : P × N => G.perturbation q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact (G.bump.contDiff.comp contDiff_snd).smul
    (G.contDiff_displacement.comp contDiff_fst)

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.contDiff_forwardNormal

    ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : P × N => G.forwardNormal q.1.1 q.1.2 q.2)
proof:

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.contractionConstant_lt_one
statement: theorem contractionConstant_lt_one : G.contractionConstant < 1
proof:
:= by
  exact_mod_cast G.contraction_lt_one

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.perturbation_lipschitz
statement:
theorem perturbation_lipschitz (s u : ℝ) :
    LipschitzWith G.contractionConstant (G.perturbation s u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
  intro x y
  rw [perturbation, perturbation, dist_eq_norm, ← sub_smul,
    norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hb := G.bump_lipschitz.dist_le_mul x y
  rw [Real.dist_eq] at hb
  calc
    |G.bump x - G.bump y| * ‖G.displacement s u‖ ≤
        ((G.bumpLipschitz : ℝ) * dist x y) * G.normBound :=
      mul_le_mul hb (G.norm_displacement_le s u)
        (norm_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg G.bumpLipschitz.coe_nonneg (dist_nonneg))
    _ = (G.contractionConstant : ℝ) * dist x y := by
      change (G.bumpLipschitz : ℝ) * dist x y * G.normBound =
        (G.normBound * (G.bumpLipschitz : ℝ)) * dist x y
      ring

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.inverseOperator_contracting
statement:
theorem inverseOperator_contracting (s u : ℝ) (y : N) :
    ContractingWith G.contractionConstant (G.inverseOperator s u y)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨G.contractionConstant_lt_one, ?_⟩
  rw [lipschitzWith_iff_dist_le_mul]
  intro x z
  simpa [inverseOperator, dist_eq_norm, sub_sub_sub_cancel_left,
    norm_neg, norm_sub_rev] using
    G.perturbation_lipschitz s u |>.dist_le_mul z x

theorem inverseNormal_fixed (s u : ℝ) (y : N) :

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.forwardNormal_inverseNormal
statement:
theorem forwardNormal_inverseNormal (s u : ℝ) (y : N) :
    G.forwardNormal s u (G.inverseNormal s u y) = y
proof:
:= by
  have h := G.inverseNormal_fixed s u y
  simp only [inverseOperator] at h
  rw [forwardNormal]

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.inverseNormal_forwardNormal
statement:
theorem inverseNormal_forwardNormal (s u : ℝ) (z : N) :
    G.inverseNormal s u (G.forwardNormal s u z) = z
proof:
:= by
  symm
  exact (G.inverseOperator_contracting s u
    (G.forwardNormal s u z)).fixedPoint_unique (by
      change z + G.perturbation s u z - G.perturbation s u z = z
      abel)

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.forwardNormal_bijective
statement:
theorem forwardNormal_bijective (s u : ℝ) :
    Bijective (G.forwardNormal s u)
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x y hxy => by
      rw [← G.inverseNormal_forwardNormal s u x,
        ← G.inverseNormal_forwardNormal s u y, hxy],
    fun y => ⟨G.inverseNormal s u y,
      G.forwardNormal_inverseNormal s u y⟩⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.total_left_inv

proof:
:= by

  simp [totalInverse, totalForward, G.inverseNormal_forwardNormal]

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.total_right_inv

proof:
:= by

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.contDiff_totalForward

proof:
:= by

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.contDiff_perturbation_slice
statement:
theorem contDiff_perturbation_slice (s u : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G.perturbation s u)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : N => ((s, u) : P)) := contDiff_const
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using G.contDiff_perturbation.comp
    (hc.prodMk contDiff_id)

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.contDiff_forwardNormal_slice
statement:
theorem contDiff_forwardNormal_slice (s u : ℝ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (G.forwardNormal s u)
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun _ : N => ((s, u) : P)) := contDiff_const

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.norm_fderiv_perturbation_lt_one
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_perturbation_lt_one (s u : ℝ) (z : N) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ (G.perturbation s u) z‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  calc
    ‖fderiv ℝ (G.perturbation s u) z‖ ≤
        (G.contractionConstant : ℝ) :=
      norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz ℝ (G.perturbation_lipschitz s u)
    _ < 1 := by exact_mod_cast G.contractionConstant_lt_one

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.fderiv_forwardNormal_eq
statement:
theorem fderiv_forwardNormal_eq (s u : ℝ) (z : N) :
    fderiv ℝ (G.forwardNormal s u) z =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ N +
        fderiv ℝ (G.perturbation s u) z
proof:
:= by
  have hp : DifferentiableAt ℝ (G.perturbation s u) z :=
    (G.contDiff_perturbation_slice s u).differentiable (by simp) z
  change fderiv ℝ (fun w : N => w + G.perturbation s u w) z = _
  exact ((hasFDerivAt_id z).add hp.hasFDerivAt).fderiv

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.fderiv_forwardNormal_bijective
statement:
theorem fderiv_forwardNormal_bijective (s u : ℝ) (z : N) :
    Bijective (fderiv ℝ (G.forwardNormal s u) z)
proof:
:= by
  let L : N →L[ℝ] N := fderiv ℝ (G.perturbation s u) z
  have hL : ‖L‖ < 1 := G.norm_fderiv_perturbation_lt_one s u z
  have hu : IsUnit (1 - (-L)) := (Units.oneSub (-L) (by simpa)).isUnit
  rw [G.fderiv_forwardNormal_eq]
  change Bijective ((1 : N →L[ℝ] N) + L)
  simpa [sub_neg_eq_add] using
    (ContinuousLinearMap.isUnit_iff_bijective.mp hu)

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.fderiv_forwardNormal_isInvertible
statement:
theorem fderiv_forwardNormal_isInvertible (s u : ℝ) (z : N) :
    (fderiv ℝ (G.forwardNormal s u) z).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  have hb := G.fderiv_forwardNormal_bijective s u z
  let e : N ≃L[ℝ] N := ContinuousLinearEquiv.ofBijective
    (fderiv ℝ (G.forwardNormal s u) z)
    (LinearMap.ker_eq_bot.mpr hb.1)
    (LinearMap.range_eq_top.mpr hb.2)
  refine ⟨e, ?_⟩
  exact ContinuousLinearEquiv.coe_ofBijective _ _ _

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.contDiff_inverseEquation
statement: theorem contDiff_inverseEquation : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G.inverseEquation
proof:
:= by
  exact (G.contDiff_forwardNormal.comp
    ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd)).sub
      (contDiff_snd.comp contDiff_fst)

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.fderiv_inverseEquation_comp_inr
statement:
theorem fderiv_inverseEquation_comp_inr (q : P × N) (z : N) :
    (fderiv ℝ G.inverseEquation (q, z)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (P × N) N) =
      fderiv ℝ (G.forwardNormal q.1.1 q.1.2) z
proof:
:= by
  have htotal :=
    (G.contDiff_inverseEquation.differentiable (by simp) (q, z)).hasFDerivAt
  have hinc : HasFDerivAt (fun w : N => (q, w))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (P × N) N) z :=
    (hasFDerivAt_const (x := z) q).prodMk (hasFDerivAt_id z)
  have hcomp := htotal.comp z hinc
  have hslice : fderiv ℝ (fun w : N => G.inverseEquation (q, w)) z =
      fderiv ℝ (G.forwardNormal q.1.1 q.1.2) z := by
    simpa [inverseEquation] using
      (fderiv_sub_const (𝕜 := ℝ)
        (f := G.forwardNormal q.1.1 q.1.2) (x := z) q.2)
  rw [← hslice]
  exact hcomp.fderiv.symm

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.inverseEquation_partial_isInvertible
statement:
theorem inverseEquation_partial_isInvertible (q : P × N) (z : N) :
    ((fderiv ℝ G.inverseEquation (q, z)).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (P × N) N)).IsInvertible
proof:
:= by
  rw [G.fderiv_inverseEquation_comp_inr q z]
  exact G.fderiv_forwardNormal_isInvertible q.1.1 q.1.2 z

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.contDiff_inverseSection
statement: theorem contDiff_inverseSection : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G.inverseSection
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro q
  let z : N := G.inverseSection q
  let b : (P × N) × N := (q, z)
  let cdf : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ G.inverseEquation b :=
    G.contDiff_inverseEquation.contDiffAt
  have hi : ((fderiv ℝ G.inverseEquation b).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (P × N) N)).IsInvertible := by
    simpa [b] using G.inverseEquation_partial_isInvertible q z
  let ψ : P × N → N := cdf.implicitFunction (by simp) hi
  have hψ : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ ψ q := by
    simpa [ψ, b] using cdf.contDiffAt_implicitFunction (by simp) hi
  have hbzero : G.inverseEquation b = 0 := by
    simp [b, z, inverseSection, inverseEquation,
      G.forwardNormal_inverseNormal]
  have heq : G.inverseSection =ᶠ[𝓝 q] ψ := by
    have himp := cdf.eventually_apply_implicitFunction (by simp) hi
    filter_upwards [himp] with q' hq'
    have hz' : G.inverseEquation (q', ψ q') = 0 := by
      rw [hq', hbzero]
    have hfwd : G.forwardNormal q'.1.1 q'.1.2 (ψ q') = q'.2 := by
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz'
    show G.inverseNormal q'.1.1 q'.1.2 q'.2 = ψ q'
    rw [← hfwd, G.inverseNormal_forwardNormal]
  exact hψ.congr_of_eventuallyEq heq

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.contDiff_totalInverse
statement: theorem contDiff_totalInverse : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G.totalInverse
proof:
:= by

  exact contDiff_fst.prodMk G.contDiff_inverseSection

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.supportRadius_lt_tube

    (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius
proof:
:=

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.norm_perturbation_le
statement:
theorem norm_perturbation_le (s u : ℝ) (z : N) :
    ‖G.perturbation s u z‖ ≤ G.normBound
proof:
:= by
  rw [perturbation, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg G.bump.nonneg]
  calc
    G.bump z * ‖G.displacement s u‖ ≤ 1 * G.normBound :=
      mul_le_mul G.bump.le_one (G.norm_displacement_le s u)
        (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
    _ = G.normBound := one_mul _

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.forwardNormal_eq_self_of_rOut_le_norm
statement:
theorem forwardNormal_eq_self_of_rOut_le_norm (s u : ℝ) (z : N)
    (hz : G.bump.rOut ≤ ‖z‖) : G.forwardNormal s u z = z
proof:
:= by
  have hb : G.bump z = 0 := G.bump.zero_of_le_dist (by
    simpa [dist_zero_right] using hz)
  simp [forwardNormal, perturbation, hb]

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.forwardNormal_mem_tube
statement:
theorem forwardNormal_mem_tube (s u : ℝ) (z : N)
    (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius) :
    G.forwardNormal s u z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hz ⊢
  by_cases hout : G.bump.rOut ≤ ‖z‖
  · rwa [G.forwardNormal_eq_self_of_rOut_le_norm s u z hout]
  · rw [forwardNormal]
    calc
      ‖z + G.perturbation s u z‖ ≤
          ‖z‖ + ‖G.perturbation s u z‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ ‖z‖ + G.normBound :=
        add_le_add_right (G.norm_perturbation_le s u z) _
      _ < G.bump.rOut + G.normBound := by
        linarith [lt_of_not_ge hout]
      _ < (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius := G.support_lt_tube

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.inverseNormal_eq_self_of_supportRadius_le_norm
statement:
theorem inverseNormal_eq_self_of_supportRadius_le_norm (s u : ℝ) (y : N)
    (hy : G.supportRadius ≤ ‖y‖) : G.inverseNormal s u y = y
proof:
:= by
  let x : N := G.inverseNormal s u y
  have hxout : G.bump.rOut ≤ ‖x‖ := by
    by_contra hnot
    have hxlt : ‖x‖ < G.bump.rOut := lt_of_not_ge hnot
    have hylt : ‖y‖ < G.supportRadius := by
      rw [← G.forwardNormal_inverseNormal s u y]
      rw [forwardNormal]
      calc
        ‖x + G.perturbation s u x‖ ≤
            ‖x‖ + ‖G.perturbation s u x‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ ≤ ‖x‖ + G.normBound :=
          add_le_add_right (G.norm_perturbation_le s u x) _
        _ < G.bump.rOut + G.normBound := by linarith
        _ = G.supportRadius := rfl
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hy) hylt
  calc
    G.inverseNormal s u y = G.forwardNormal s u x := by
      rw [G.forwardNormal_eq_self_of_rOut_le_norm s u x hxout]
    _ = y := G.forwardNormal_inverseNormal s u y

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.inverseNormal_mem_tube
statement:
theorem inverseNormal_mem_tube (s u : ℝ) (y : N)
    (hy : y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius) :
    G.inverseNormal s u y ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hy ⊢
  by_contra hnot
  have hxR : (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius ≤
      ‖G.inverseNormal s u y‖ := le_of_not_gt hnot
  have hrOutR : G.bump.rOut <
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius := by
    calc
      G.bump.rOut ≤ G.bump.rOut + G.normBound :=
        le_add_of_nonneg_right G.normBound_nonneg
      _ < (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius := G.support_lt_tube
  have hxout : G.bump.rOut ≤ ‖G.inverseNormal s u y‖ :=
    (le_of_lt hrOutR).trans hxR
  have hyx : y = G.inverseNormal s u y := by
    exact (G.forwardNormal_inverseNormal s u y).symm.trans
      (G.forwardNormal_eq_self_of_rOut_le_norm s u _ hxout)
  rw [← hyx] at hxR
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hxR) hy

name: Submission.TamedField.SmallPeriodicNormalGraph.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward_orbit_zero
statement:
theorem toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward_orbit_zero (u : ℝ) :
    G.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.forward 1
        (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N))) =
      V.orbitTubeLift O (u, G.h u)
proof:
:= by
  let A : V.PeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy O :=
    G.toPeriodicTubeCoordinateIsotopy
  have hq : ((u : C), (0 : N)) ∈ A.tubeDomain := by
    exact ⟨mem_univ _, mem_ball_self
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius_pos⟩
  change A.ambientForward 1 (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N))) = _
  rw [← V.orbitTube_coe O u (0 : N),
    A.ambientForward_orbitTube 1 ((u : C), (0 : N)) hq]
  change V.orbitTube O (G.forwardQuot 1 ((u : C), (0 : N))) = _
  rw [G.forwardQuot_coe, G.forwardLift_one_zero, V.orbitTube_coe]

statement:
theorem ambientParam_smooth (R : SignedMorseGeometry C B G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (R.ambientParam p) 0
proof:
:= by
  exact R.amplitude.contDiff_equiv_symm.contDiffAt.comp 0
    ((B.chart p.1).param_smooth.contDiffAt.comp 0
      (contDiffAt_const.add (G.installedMorseParam_contDiffAt p hp)))

name: Submission.SignedMorseGeometry.ambientParam_fiber
statement:
theorem ambientParam_fiber (R : SignedMorseGeometry C B G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) (u : E₂)
    (hu : ‖u‖ < (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).radius) :
    R.output.G (R.ambientParam p u) = 0
proof:
:= by
  change C.cobordism.G
    (verticalShift R.amplitude (R.ambientParam p u)) = 0
  have hinv : verticalShift R.amplitude (R.ambientParam p u) =
      (B.chart p.1).param (p.2 + G.installedMorseParam p u) := by
    change R.amplitude.diffeomorph
      (R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm
        ((B.chart p.1).param (p.2 + G.installedMorseParam p u))) = _
    exact R.amplitude.diffeomorph.apply_symm_apply _
  rw [hinv]
  exact (B.chart p.1).param_fiber _ (R.param_domain p hp u hu)

name: Submission.SignedMorseGeometry.time_lift
statement:
theorem time_lift (R : SignedMorseGeometry C B G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) (u : E₂)
    (hu : ‖u‖ < (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).radius) :
    tcoord (R.ambientParam p u) =
      recenter (G.localSeparatedTime p) p.2
        ((G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).param u)
proof:
:= by
  rw [ambientParam]
  rw [R.time_install p hp u hu, G.installedMorseParam_eq p hp]
  rfl

name: Submission.SignedMorseGeometry.center_mem_coreCriticalPoints
statement:
theorem center_mem_coreCriticalPoints (R : SignedMorseGeometry C B G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    R.center p ∈ coreCriticalPoints R.output
proof:
:= by
  let N := G.localMorseNormalForm p hp
  have hzero : ‖(0 : E₂)‖ < N.radius := by simpa [N] using N.radius_pos
  have hcrit : R.center p ∈ timeCritical R.output.G := by
    exact (R.critical_model p hp 0 hzero).2 rfl
  have hfiber : R.output.G (R.center p) = 0 :=
    R.ambientParam_fiber p hp 0 hzero
  have hlower : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < tcoord (R.center p) := by
    by_contra h
    have hle : tcoord (R.center p) ≤ 1 / 4 := le_of_not_gt h
    exact hcrit.2
      ((R.output.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter hle) (R.center p) hfiber rfl)
  have hupper : tcoord (R.center p) < (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    by_contra h
    have hle : 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord (R.center p) := le_of_not_gt h
    exact hcrit.2
      ((R.output.sliceRegular_of_three_quarter_le hle) (R.center p) hfiber rfl)
  exact ⟨hcrit, ⟨hlower.le, hupper.le⟩⟩

name: Submission.SignedMorseGeometry.coreCriticalPoints_subset_center_image
statement:
theorem coreCriticalPoints_subset_center_image
    (R : SignedMorseGeometry C B G) :
    coreCriticalPoints R.output ⊆
      R.center '' (G.criticalPoints : Set (Σ _ : ι, E₂))
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  obtain ⟨p, hp, u, hu, huv⟩ := R.coreCritical_cover v hv
  have hu0 : u = 0 := by
    apply (R.critical_model p hp u hu).1
    rw [huv]
    exact hv.1
  refine ⟨p, hp, ?_⟩
  rw [center, ambientParam]
  rw [hu0] at huv
  exact huv

name: Submission.SignedMorseGeometry.centers_exact
statement:
theorem centers_exact (R : SignedMorseGeometry C B G) :
    R.center '' (G.criticalPoints : Set (Σ _ : ι, E₂)) =
      coreCriticalPoints R.output
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · rintro v ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact R.center_mem_coreCriticalPoints p hp
  · exact R.coreCriticalPoints_subset_center_image

name: Submission.exists_signedMorsePerturbation_of_finiteIFT
statement:
theorem exists_signedMorsePerturbation_of_finiteIFT
    {X₀ X₁ : FramedLevelSet n} {S₀ : FiberSign X₀} {S₁ : FiberSign X₁}
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceChartFamily C.cobordism ι)
    {εgrad εtime : ℝ} (hεgrad : 0 < εgrad) (hεtime : 0 < εtime)
    (hgeometry : ∀ G : GenericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas B,
      Nonempty (SignedMorseGeometry C B G)) :
    ∃ P : SignedMorsePerturbation C,
      Nonempty (MorsePosition P.signedCobordism.cobordism)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G⟩ := exists_genericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas B hεgrad hεtime

name: Submission.exists_labeledMorsePosition_of_finiteIFT
statement:

    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι]
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceChartFamily C.cobordism ι)
    {εgrad εtime : ℝ} (hεgrad : 0 < εgrad) (hεtime : 0 < εtime)
    (hgeometry : ∀ G : GenericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas B,
      Nonempty (SignedMorseGeometry C B G)) :
    ∃ P : SignedMorsePerturbation C,
      Nonempty (LabeledMorsePosition P.signedCobordism.cobordism)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G⟩ := exists_genericFiniteIFTSurfaceAtlas B hεgrad hεtime

name: Submission.exists_signedMorsePerturbation
statement:
theorem exists_signedMorsePerturbation
    {X₀ X₁ : FramedLevelSet n} {S₀ : FiberSign X₀} {S₁ : FiberSign X₁}
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁) :
    ∃ P : SignedMorsePerturbation C,
      Nonempty (MorsePosition P.signedCobordism.cobordism)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨s, ⟨B⟩⟩ := exists_finiteIFTSurfaceCover C.cobordism
  obtain ⟨a, b, U, χ, _ha, _hab, _hb, _hU, ⟨R⟩⟩ :=
    FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.exists_globalCutoffMorseData B
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := R.nonempty_stableCriticalValueShiftData
  let T := S.toCriticalValueShiftData
  let A : VerticalAmplitude (n := n) :=
    R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.after T.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude
  have houtput : A.pullback C.cobordism = T.output := by
    dsimp [A, T]
    rw [FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.CriticalValueShiftData.output,
      FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.SharedCutoffMorseData.output]
    exact VerticalAmplitude.pullback_after_eq C.cobordism
      R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude
      S.toCriticalValueShiftData.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude
  let P : SignedMorsePerturbation C := {
    amplitude := A
    atlas := by
      rw [houtput]
      exact S.toMorseAtlas }
  exact ⟨P, ⟨P.atlas.toMorsePosition⟩⟩

name: Submission.exists_labeledMorsePosition
statement:
theorem exists_labeledMorsePosition
    {X₀ X₁ : FramedLevelSet n} {S₀ : FiberSign X₀} {S₁ : FiberSign X₁}

      Nonempty (LabeledMorsePosition P.signedCobordism.cobordism)
proof:

  obtain ⟨P, _hposition⟩ := exists_signedMorsePerturbation C
  exact ⟨P, ⟨P.labeledPosition⟩⟩

name: Submission.BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.unitVector_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem unitVector_coe (c : F) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ((unitVector c hc : UnitSphere F) : F) = ‖c‖⁻¹ • c
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.norm_smul_unitVector
statement:
theorem norm_smul_unitVector (c : F) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    ‖c‖ • ((unitVector c hc : UnitSphere F) : F) = c
proof:
:= by
  rw [unitVector_coe, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hc), one_smul]

name: Submission.BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.rotation_unitVector
statement:
theorem rotation_unitVector
    (c₁ c₂ : F) (h₁ : c₁ ≠ 0) (h₂ : c₂ ≠ 0)
    (hne : unitVector c₁ h₁ ≠ -unitVector c₂ h₂) :
    SOFrameGauge.toCLM (rotation c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂)
        ((unitVector c₁ h₁ : UnitSphere F) : F) =
      ((unitVector c₂ h₂ : UnitSphere F) : F)
proof:
:= by
  have hdist : dist (unitVector c₁ h₁) (unitVector c₂ h₂) < 2 :=
    dist_lt_two_of_ne_neg _ _ hne
  have hdot : -1 <
      coords (unitVector c₁ h₁) ⬝ᵥ coords (unitVector c₂ h₂) :=
    neg_one_lt_coords_dot_of_dist_lt_two hdist
  ext i
  have hi := congrFun (rotTo_mulVec hdot) i
  simpa [rotation, SOFrameGauge.toCLM_apply_coord, Matrix.mulVec, coords] using hi

name: Submission.BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.scaledRotation_apply
statement:
theorem scaledRotation_apply
    (c₁ c₂ : F) (h₁ : c₁ ≠ 0) (h₂ : c₂ ≠ 0)
    (hne : unitVector c₁ h₁ ≠ -unitVector c₂ h₂) :
    SOFrameGauge.toCLM (rotation c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂)
        (backgroundScale c₁ c₂ • c₁) = c₂
proof:
:= by
  calc
    SOFrameGauge.toCLM (rotation c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂)
        (backgroundScale c₁ c₂ • c₁) =
        backgroundScale c₁ c₂ •
          SOFrameGauge.toCLM (rotation c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂) c₁ := by
            rw [map_smul]
    _ = backgroundScale c₁ c₂ •
          SOFrameGauge.toCLM (rotation c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂)
            (‖c₁‖ • ((unitVector c₁ h₁ : UnitSphere F) : F)) := by
          rw [norm_smul_unitVector c₁ h₁]
    _ = (backgroundScale c₁ c₂ * ‖c₁‖) •
          SOFrameGauge.toCLM (rotation c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂)
            ((unitVector c₁ h₁ : UnitSphere F) : F) := by
          rw [map_smul, smul_smul]
    _ = ‖c₂‖ • ((unitVector c₂ h₂ : UnitSphere F) : F) := by
          rw [rotation_unitVector c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂ hne]
          congr 1
          exact div_mul_cancel₀ ‖c₂‖ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h₁)
    _ = c₂ := norm_smul_unitVector c₂ h₂

name: Submission.BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data.gauge_smooth
statement:
theorem gauge_smooth (D : Data (n := n) c₁ c₂) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) =>
      D.gauge p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hr : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => normRamp s) := contDiff_normRamp
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun s : ℝ => D.scalar s) := by
    exact (contDiff_const.sub hr).add (hr.mul contDiff_const)
  have hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun s : ℝ => SOFrameGauge.toCLM (D.soPath.Q s)) :=
    SOFrameGauge.contDiff_toCLM D.soPath.smooth
  exact (hs.comp contDiff_fst).smul (hQ.comp contDiff_fst)

name: Submission.BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data.gauge_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem gauge_zero (D : Data (n := n) c₁ c₂)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    D.gauge 0 x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  simp [gauge, D.soPath.zero, SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one]

name: Submission.BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data.gauge_bijective
statement:
theorem gauge_bijective (D : Data (n := n) c₁ c₂) (s : ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    Bijective (D.gauge s x)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : D.scalar s ≠ 0 := (D.scalar_pos s).ne'
  have hA := SOFrameGauge.toCLM_bijective (D.soPath.Q s)
  constructor
  · intro u v huv
    apply hA.1
    apply smul_right_injective (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) ha
    simpa [gauge] using huv
  · intro y
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hA.2 ((D.scalar s)⁻¹ • y)
    refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
    change D.scalar s • SOFrameGauge.toCLM (D.soPath.Q s) u = y
    rw [hu, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ ha, one_smul]

name: Submission.BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data.gauge_one_apply_source
statement:
theorem gauge_one_apply_source (D : Data (n := n) c₁ c₂)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    D.gauge 1 x c₁ = c₂
proof:
:= by
  change D.scalar 1 • SOFrameGauge.toCLM (D.soPath.Q 1) c₁ = c₂
  rw [D.scalar_one, D.soPath.one]
  rw [← map_smul]
  exact scaledRotation_apply c₁ c₂ D.source_ne_zero D.target_ne_zero
    D.nonantipodal

name: Submission.BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.bridge_nonantipodal
statement:
theorem bridge_nonantipodal (B : BridgeData (m + 2) z) :
    unitVector (-B.y) B.nativeBackground_ne_zero ≠
      -unitVector (compactBackground m)
        (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  let i0 : Fin (m + 2) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  let j0 : Fin (m + 1) := ⟨0, by omega⟩
  intro h
  have hcoord := congrArg
    (fun q : UnitSphere FB => ((q : FB) i0)) h
  have hcompact : compactBackground m i0 = 0 := by
    change CompactBirth.background (m + 1) i0 = 0
    simpa [i0, j0] using
      (CompactBirth.background_apply_castSucc (m + 1) j0)
  have hypos : 0 < B.y i0 := by
    simpa [i0] using B.axis_pos (by omega : 0 < m + 2)
  have hinv : 0 < ‖-B.y‖⁻¹ :=
    inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr B.nativeBackground_ne_zero)
  have hneg : ‖-B.y‖⁻¹ * (-B.y i0) < 0 := by
    have : -B.y i0 < 0 := by simpa using neg_lt_zero.mpr hypos
    exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg hinv this
  have hzero : ‖-B.y‖⁻¹ * (-B.y i0) = 0 := by
    simpa [unitVector, hcompact] using hcoord
  linarith

name: Submission.BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.nonempty_bridgeData
statement:
theorem nonempty_bridgeData (B : BridgeData (m + 2) z) :
    Nonempty (Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
proof:
:= by
  let A := rotation (-B.y) (compactBackground m)
    B.nativeBackground_ne_zero
    (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1))
  obtain ⟨P⟩ := SmoothSOPath.nonempty (by omega : 0 < m + 2) A
  exact ⟨{
    source_ne_zero := B.nativeBackground_ne_zero
    target_ne_zero := CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1)
    nonantipodal := bridge_nonantipodal B
    soPath := P
  }⟩

name: Submission.BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.nonempty_targetFlat_and_cobordism
statement:
theorem nonempty_targetFlat_and_cobordism (B : BridgeData (m + 2) z) :

proof:
