  let A := D.targetFlat B.flatSignedConfiguration
  refine ⟨⟨A, ?_⟩⟩
  exact ⟨D.signedCobordism B.flatSignedConfiguration⟩

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.sourceOrbit_subset_positiveSliceFiber
statement:
theorem sourceOrbit_subset_positiveSliceFiber
    (O : V₁.OrbitIndex)
    (hO : (O : Set E₁) ∈
      (C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁) :
    (O : Set E₁) ⊆ positiveSliceFiber C t₁
proof:
:= by
  rw [positiveSliceFiber_eq_positivePart C t₁ hreg₁]
  exact hO

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.sliceTransport_mapsTo_positiveOrbit
statement:
theorem sliceTransport_mapsTo_positiveOrbit
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    {p : E₁} (hp : p ∈
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        t₁ hreg₁).fiber)
    (hppos : 0 < C (cobSpaceTime p t₁)) :
    MapsTo (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂) (V₁.orbit p)
      (V₂.orbit (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ p))
proof:
:= by
  let f : E₁ → E₁ := W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂
  let γ : ℝ → E₁ := fun s => f (V₁.flow p s)
  let A : Set ℝ := γ ⁻¹' V₂.orbit (f p)
  have hpPos : p ∈ positiveSliceFiber C t₁ := by
    exact ⟨hp, hppos⟩
  have hqPos : f p ∈ positiveSliceFiber C t₂ :=
    W.sliceTransport_mapsTo ht₁ ht₂ hpPos
  have hq : f p ∈
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        t₂ hreg₂).fiber := hqPos.1
  have hflowPos : ∀ s, V₁.flow p s ∈ positiveSliceFiber C t₁ := by
    intro s
    refine ⟨V₁.flow_mem_fiber hp s, ?_⟩
    let η : C(I, E₂) :=
      ⟨fun u => cobSpaceTime (V₁.flow p ((u : ℝ) * s)) t₁,
        (by
          have hflow : Continuous fun u : I =>
              V₁.flow p ((u : ℝ) * s) :=
            (V₁.continuous_flow p).comp
              (continuous_subtype_val.mul (continuous_const :
                Continuous fun _ : I => s))
          have hcob : Continuous fun x : E₁ => cobSpaceTime x t₁ := by
            rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
            exact fun x => (hasFDerivAt_cobSpaceTime t₁ x).continuousAt
          exact hcob.comp hflow)⟩
    have hη : ∀ u, C.cobordism.G (η u) = 0 := by
      intro u
      exact V₁.flow_mem_fiber hp _
    have hs := C.pos_iff_of_zeroFiber_path η hη
    have hzero : 0 < C (η 0) := by simpa [η] using hppos
    simpa [η] using hs.mp hzero
  have hAS : A ⊆ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _
  have hAclosed : IsClosed A :=
    (V₂.isCompact_orbit hq).isClosed.preimage
      ((W.continuous_sliceTransport t₁ t₂).comp (V₁.continuous_flow p))
  have hAopen : ∀ s ∈ A, ∃ r > 0,
      (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ∩ Metric.ball s r ⊆ A := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrsub⟩ := V₂.orbit_isOpen_in_fiber hq hs
    have hopen : IsOpen (γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (γ s) r) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage
        ((W.continuous_sliceTransport t₁ t₂).comp (V₁.continuous_flow p))
    have hsmem : s ∈ γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (γ s) r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen s hsmem
    refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
    rintro u ⟨-, hus⟩
    apply hrsub
    exact ⟨(W.sliceTransport_mapsTo ht₁ ht₂ (hflowPos u)).1, hεsub hus⟩
  have hA0 : A.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    change f (V₁.flow p 0) ∈ V₂.orbit (f p)
    rw [V₁.flow_zero]
    exact V₂.mem_orbit_self (f p)
  have hAll : (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ⊆ A :=
    subset_of_relOpen_closed isPreconnected_univ hAS hAclosed hAopen hA0
  rintro x ⟨s, rfl⟩
  exact hAll (Set.mem_univ s)

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveOrbitMap_val
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveOrbitMap_val
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) :
    (((W.positiveOrbitMap (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂)
        (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂) ht₁ ht₂ O).1 :
        V₂.OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) =
      V₂.orbit (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ (V₁.orbitPoint O.1))
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveOrbitMap_leftInverse
statement:
theorem positiveOrbitMap_leftInverse
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) :
    W.positiveOrbitMap (hreg₁ := hreg₂) (hreg₂ := hreg₁)
        (V₁ := V₂) (V₂ := V₁) ht₂ ht₁
        (W.positiveOrbitMap (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂)
          (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂) ht₁ ht₂ O) = O
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Subtype.ext
  let p : E₁ := V₁.orbitPoint O.1
  let q : E₁ := W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ p
  let O₂ := (W.positiveOrbitMap (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂)
    (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂) ht₁ ht₂ O).1
  let r : E₁ := V₂.orbitPoint O₂
  have hpPos : p ∈ positiveSliceFiber C t₁ :=
    sourceOrbit_subset_positiveSliceFiber (C := C) hreg₁ V₁ O.1
      ((V₁.mem_selectedOrbitFinset O.1).mp O.2)
      (by rw [V₁.orbitPoint_orbit O.1]; exact V₁.mem_orbit_self p)
  have hqPos : q ∈ positiveSliceFiber C t₂ :=
    W.sliceTransport_mapsTo ht₁ ht₂ hpPos
  have hrOrbit : r ∈ V₂.orbit q := by
    have hself := V₂.mem_orbit_self r
    have hOr : (O₂ : Set E₁) = V₂.orbit r := V₂.orbitPoint_orbit O₂
    have hOq : (O₂ : Set E₁) = V₂.orbit q := rfl
    rwa [← hOq, hOr]
  have hrPos : r ∈ positiveSliceFiber C t₂ := by
    rw [positiveSliceFiber_eq_positivePart C t₂ hreg₂]
    exact ((V₂.mem_selectedOrbitFinset O₂).mp
      (W.positiveOrbitMap (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂)
        (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂) ht₁ ht₂ O).2) (by
        rw [V₂.orbitPoint_orbit O₂]
        exact V₂.mem_orbit_self r)
  have hback := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo_positiveOrbit
    (hreg₁ := hreg₂) (hreg₂ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₂) (V₂ := V₁)
    ht₂ ht₁ (p := q) hqPos.1 hqPos.2 hrOrbit
  have hqp : W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁ q = p := by
    exact W.sliceTransport_leftInverse ht₁ ht₂ hpPos
  have hrSource : W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁ r ∈ V₁.orbit p := by
    rwa [hqp] at hback
  change V₁.orbit (W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁ r) = (O.1 : Set E₁)
  exact (V₁.orbit_eq_of_mem hrSource).trans (V₁.orbitPoint_orbit O.1).symm

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveIntermediateTime_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem positiveIntermediateTime_mem_Icc
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b) (s : I) :
    positiveIntermediateTime t₁ t₂ s ∈ Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · have hs₀ : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.2.1
    have hs₁ : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.2.2
    rcases le_total t₁ t₂ with h | h <;>
      dsimp [positiveIntermediateTime] <;> nlinarith [ht₁.1, ht₂.1]
  · have hs₀ : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.2.1
    have hs₁ : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.2.2
    rcases le_total t₁ t₂ with h | h <;>
      dsimp [positiveIntermediateTime] <;> nlinarith [ht₁.2, ht₂.2]

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.continuous_positiveIntermediateTime
statement:
theorem continuous_positiveIntermediateTime (t₁ t₂ : ℝ) :
    Continuous (positiveIntermediateTime t₁ t₂)
proof:
:=
  continuous_const.add (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.continuous_positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
statement:
theorem continuous_positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) :
    Continuous (W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
      (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O)
proof:
:= by
  let p : E₁ := V₁.orbitPoint O.1
  let T : ℝ := V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O.1)
  have hsource : Continuous fun q : I × I => V₁.flow p ((q.2 : ℝ) * T) :=
    (V₁.continuous_flow p).comp
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const)
  have hinit : Continuous fun q : I × I =>
      cobSpaceTime (V₁.flow p ((q.2 : ℝ) * T)) t₁ := by
    have hcob : Continuous fun z : E₁ => cobSpaceTime z t₁ := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      exact fun z => (hasFDerivAt_cobSpaceTime t₁ z).continuousAt
    exact hcob.comp hsource
  have htime : Continuous fun q : I × I =>
      positiveIntermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1 - t₁ :=
    ((continuous_positiveIntermediateTime t₁ t₂).comp continuous_fst).sub
      continuous_const
  have hflow : Continuous fun q : I × I =>
      W.flow (cobSpaceTime (V₁.flow p ((q.2 : ℝ) * T)) t₁)
        (positiveIntermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1 - t₁) :=
    W.base.continuous_flow_uncurry.comp (hinit.prodMk htime)
  have hspace : Continuous (spacePart (n := n)) := by
    have hsp : LipschitzWith 1 (spacePart (n := n)) := by
      apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
      intro x y
      rw [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
      change ‖spacePart (x - y)‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖
      exact norm_spacePart_le (x - y)
    exact hsp.continuous
  exact hspace.comp hflow

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_mem_positiveSliceFiber
statement:
theorem positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_mem_positiveSliceFiber
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)})
    (q : I × I) :
    W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
      (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O q ∈
      positiveSliceFiber C (positiveIntermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1)
proof:
:= by
  have hsource : V₁.flow (V₁.orbitPoint O.1)
        ((q.2 : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O.1)) ∈
      positiveSliceFiber C t₁ := by
    apply sourceOrbit_subset_positiveSliceFiber (C := C) hreg₁ V₁ O.1
      ((V₁.mem_selectedOrbitFinset O.1).mp O.2)
    rw [V₁.orbitPoint_orbit O.1]
    exact V₁.flow_mem_orbit _ _
  exact W.sliceTransport_mapsTo ht₁
    (positiveIntermediateTime_mem_Icc ht₁ ht₂ q.1) hsource

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_regular
statement:
theorem positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_regular
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)})
    (q : I × I) :
    W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
      (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O q ∈
      regularSet (sliceMap C.cobordism.G
        (positiveIntermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1))
proof:
:= by
  let τ := positiveIntermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1
  let x := W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
    (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O q
  have hxPos : x ∈ positiveSliceFiber C τ :=
    W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_mem_positiveSliceFiber
      (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O q
  have hcore : cobSpaceTime x τ ∈ C.positiveSlabCore a b := by
    refine ⟨hxPos.1, ?_, hxPos.2.le⟩
    simpa [τ] using positiveIntermediateTime_mem_Icc ht₁ ht₂ q.1
  have hcollar : cobSpaceTime x τ ∈
      Metric.cthickening W.delta (C.positiveSlabCore a b) :=
    Metric.self_subset_cthickening (E := C.positiveSlabCore a b) hcore
  have hslab := W.subset_slabRegular hcollar
  have hspatial : Surjective (spatialDeriv C.cobordism.G (cobSpaceTime x τ)) := by
    by_contra hnot
    exact hslab.2 ((kerProj_timeVec_eq_zero_iff hslab.1).mpr hnot)
  change Surjective (fderiv ℝ (sliceMap C.cobordism.G τ) x)
  rw [fderiv_sliceMap C.cobordism.smooth]
  exact hspatial

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.linearIndependent_sliceFrameAt_of_regular
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_sliceFrameAt_of_regular
    (G : E₂ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ) (x : E₁)
    (hx : x ∈ regularSet (sliceMap G t)) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G t x)
proof:
:= by
  unfold SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt
  apply linearIndependent_finCons.mpr
  refine ⟨(surjective_fderiv_iff_linearIndependent (sliceMap G t) x).mp hx, ?_⟩
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).mp hmem
  have hzero : ⟪tauField (sliceMap G t) x, tauField (sliceMap G t) x⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    nth_rewrite 2 [← hc]
    rw [inner_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i _
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, tauField_inner_gradVec, mul_zero]
  have hz : tauField (sliceMap G t) x = 0 := inner_self_eq_zero.mp hzero
  have hnorm : ‖tauField (sliceMap G t) x‖ = 1 := norm_tauField hx
  rw [hz, norm_zero] at hnorm
  norm_num at hnorm

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.det_rowsMatrix_sliceFrameAt_pos
statement:
theorem det_rowsMatrix_sliceFrameAt_pos
    (G : E₂ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ) (x : E₁)
    (hx : x ∈ regularSet (sliceMap G t)) :
    0 < (rowsMatrix (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G t x)).det
proof:
:= by
  have hrows : rowsMatrix (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G t x) =
      crossRows (fun i => gradVec (sliceMap G t) i x)
        (tauField (sliceMap G t) x) := by
    ext i j
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩ <;>
      simp [rowsMatrix, SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt, crossRows]
  rw [hrows]
  exact crossDet_tauField_pos hx

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.sliceFrameMatrix_mem_SO_of_regular
statement:
theorem sliceFrameMatrix_mem_SO_of_regular
    (G : E₂ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (t : ℝ) (x : E₁)
    (hx : x ∈ regularSet (sliceMap G t)) :
    rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G t x)) ∈
      SOGroup (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hInd := linearIndependent_sliceFrameAt_of_regular G t x hx
  have horthonormal : Orthonormal ℝ
      (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G t x)) :=
    gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hInd
  set A := rowsMatrix
    (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G t x)) with hA
  have hmul : A * Aᵀ = 1 := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    have hentries : ∀ k, A i k * Aᵀ k j =
        (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G t x) i) k *
          (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G t x) j) k := by
      intro k
      rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]
      rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => hentries k]
    have hinner := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp horthonormal i j
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply] at hinner
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial] at hinner
    rw [← hinner]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => mul_comm _ _
  have horth : A ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).mpr hmul
  have hdetpos : 0 < A.det := by
    rw [hA, det_rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed]
    apply mul_pos
    · apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro i _
      have hne : gramSchmidt ℝ (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G t x) i ≠ 0 :=
        gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hInd
      have : 0 < ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt G t x) i‖ :=
        norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
      positivity
    · exact det_rowsMatrix_sliceFrameAt_pos G t x hx
  have hdetsq : A.det * A.det = 1 := by
    have hdet := congrArg Matrix.det hmul
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at hdet
    exact hdet
  have hdet1 : A.det = 1 := by
    rcases mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp hdetsq with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [h] at hdetpos
      linarith
  exact Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mpr ⟨horth, hdet1⟩

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_zero
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) (u : I) :
    W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O (0, u) =
      V₁.flow (V₁.orbitPoint O.1)
        ((u : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O.1))
proof:
:= by
  simp [positiveTransportedOrbitPoint, positiveIntermediateTime,
    PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.sliceTransport, SlabTamedField.sliceTransport]

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_one
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_one
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) (u : I) :
    W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O (1, u) =
      W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂
        (V₁.flow (V₁.orbitPoint O.1)
          ((u : ℝ) * V₁.fundamentalPeriod (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O.1)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold positiveTransportedOrbitPoint positiveIntermediateTime

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_closed
statement:
theorem positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_closed
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) (s : I) :
    W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O (s, 0) =
      W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O (s, 1)

    (V₁.fundamentalPeriod_periodic (V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O.1) 0).symm

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveTargetOrbitParam_curve
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveTargetOrbitParam_curve
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) (u : I) :
    (W.positiveTargetOrbitParam
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂) (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂)
        ht₁ ht₂ O).curve u =
      W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O (1, u)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.continuous_positiveTransportedFrameMatrix
statement:
theorem continuous_positiveTransportedFrameMatrix
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) :
    Continuous (W.positiveTransportedFrameMatrix
      (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O)
proof:
:= by
  let τ : I × I → ℝ := fun q => positiveIntermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1
  let x : I × I → E₁ := W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
    (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O
  let A : I × I → Fin (n + 1) → E₁ := fun q =>
    SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt C.cobordism.G (τ q) (x q)
  have hτ : Continuous τ :=
    (continuous_positiveIntermediateTime t₁ t₂).comp continuous_fst
  have hx : Continuous x := W.continuous_positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
    (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O
  have hA : ∀ i, Continuous fun q => A q i := by
    intro i
    refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) i
    · change Continuous fun q => tauField (sliceMap C.cobordism.G (τ q)) (x q)
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro q
      have hxreg : x q ∈ regularSet (sliceMap C.cobordism.G (τ q)) :=
        W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_regular
          (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O q
      simpa [Function.comp_def] using
        (continuousAt_sliceTau C.cobordism.smooth hxreg).comp
          (hτ.continuousAt.prodMk hx.continuousAt)
    · change Continuous fun q => gradVec (sliceMap C.cobordism.G (τ q)) k (x q)
      convert (contDiff_sliceGrad C.cobordism.smooth k).continuous.comp
        (hτ.prodMk hx) using 1
      · apply TopologicalSpace.ext
        rfl
      · rfl
  have hInd : ∀ q, LinearIndependent ℝ (A q) := by
    intro q
    exact linearIndependent_sliceFrameAt_of_regular C.cobordism.G (τ q) (x q)
      (W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_regular
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O q)
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  have hgs := continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_family' hA hInd i
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp hgs

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveTransportedFrameMatrix_mem_SO
statement:
theorem positiveTransportedFrameMatrix_mem_SO
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) (q : I × I) :
    W.positiveTransportedFrameMatrix
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O q ∈
      SOGroup (n + 1)
proof:
:= by
  exact sliceFrameMatrix_mem_SO_of_regular C.cobordism.G
    (positiveIntermediateTime t₁ t₂ q.1)
    (W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint
      (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O q)
    (W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_regular
      (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O q)

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveTransportedFrame_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem positiveTransportedFrame_zero
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) (u : I) :
    W.positiveTransportedFrame
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O (0, u) =
      V₁.orbitFrameLoop O.1 u
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change W.positiveTransportedFrameMatrix
      (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O (0, u) =
    V₁.orbitFrameLoop O.1 u
  unfold positiveTransportedFrameMatrix TamedField.orbitFrameLoop
    TamedField.fundamentalFrameLoop frameLoop SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt
  rw [W.positiveTransportedOrbitPoint_zero
    (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂)]
  simp [positiveIntermediateTime, frameAt, SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt, sliceFLS,
    FramedLevelCobordism.toLevelCobordismData]

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveTransportedFrame_closed
statement:
theorem positiveTransportedFrame_closed
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) (s : I) :
    W.positiveTransportedFrame
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O (s, 0) =
      W.positiveTransportedFrame
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O (s, 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change W.positiveTransportedFrameMatrix
      (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O (s, 0) =
    W.positiveTransportedFrameMatrix
      (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O (s, 1)
  unfold positiveTransportedFrameMatrix

    (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂)]

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop_closed
statement:
theorem positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop_closed
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)

      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) :
    W.positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O 0 =
      W.positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O 1

:=
  W.positiveTransportedFrame_closed
    (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O 1

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop_eq_paramFrameLoop
statement:
theorem positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop_eq_paramFrameLoop
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) :
    W.positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O =
      (W.positiveTargetOrbitParam
        (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂) (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂)
        ht₁ ht₂ O).paramFrameLoop
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  let P := W.positiveTargetOrbitParam
    (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂) (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂)
    ht₁ ht₂ O
  change W.positiveTransportedFrameMatrix
      (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) (t₂ := t₂) O (1, u) =
    P.paramFrameLoop u
  unfold positiveTransportedFrameMatrix SimpleClosedOrbitParam.paramFrameLoop
    frameLoop frameAt SlabTamedField.sliceFrameAt
  change _ = rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
    (frameAt (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData t₂ hreg₂)
      (P.realCurve (u : ℝ))))
  rw [P.realCurve_coe]
  rw [W.positiveTargetOrbitParam_curve
    (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂) (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂)

name: Submission.PositiveSheetSlabTamedField.positiveOrbitFrameClass_eq
statement:
theorem positiveOrbitFrameClass_eq
    (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (O : {O // O ∈ V₁.selectedOrbitFinset
      ((C.sliceSign t₁ hreg₁).positiveOrbitCollection V₁)}) :
    V₁.orbitFrameClass O.1 =
      V₂.orbitFrameClass
        (W.positiveOrbitMap (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂)
          (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂) ht₁ ht₂ O).1
proof:
:= by
  let P := W.positiveTargetOrbitParam
    (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂) (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂)
    ht₁ ht₂ O
  let Q : V₂.OrbitIndex :=
    (W.positiveOrbitMap (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂)
      (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂) ht₁ ht₂ O).1
  have htargetEq := W.positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop_eq_paramFrameLoop
    (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (hreg₂ := hreg₂) (V₁ := V₁) (V₂ := V₂)
    ht₁ ht₂ O
  have hqOrbit : V₂.orbitPoint Q ∈ V₂.orbit P.p := by
    have hself := V₂.mem_orbit_self (V₂.orbitPoint Q)
    have hQpoint : (Q : Set E₁) = V₂.orbit (V₂.orbitPoint Q) :=
      V₂.orbitPoint_orbit Q
    have hQtarget : (Q : Set E₁) = V₂.orbit P.p := by
      rfl
    rwa [← hQtarget, hQpoint]
  unfold TamedField.orbitFrameClass
  calc
    loopClassZ2 (V₁.orbitFrameLoop O.1) (V₁.orbitFrameLoop_closed O.1) =
        loopClassZ2
          (W.positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop
            (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O)
          (W.positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop_closed
            (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O) :=
      loopClassZ2_congr
        (V₁.orbitFrameLoop_closed O.1)
        (W.positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop_closed
          (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O)
        (W.positiveTransportedFrameHomotopy
          (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O)
        (W.positiveTransportedFrame_closed
          (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O)
    _ = loopClassZ2 P.paramFrameLoop P.paramFrameLoop_closed :=
      loopClassZ2_congr_fun
        (W.positiveTransportedTargetFrameLoop_closed
          (hreg₁ := hreg₁) (V₁ := V₁) ht₁ ht₂ O)
        P.paramFrameLoop_closed htargetEq
    _ = V₂.fundamentalFrameClass P.hp := P.paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental
    _ = V₂.fundamentalFrameClass (V₂.orbitPoint_mem_fiber Q) := by
      symm
      exact V₂.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit P.hp hqOrbit
    _ = loopClassZ2 (V₂.orbitFrameLoop Q) (V₂.orbitFrameLoop_closed Q) :=
      (V₂.orbitFrameClass_eq_fundamental Q).symm

name: Submission.contDiff_gramSchmidt_family
statement:
theorem contDiff_gramSchmidt_family
    {T : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup T] [NormedSpace ℝ T]
    {m : ℕ} {A : T → Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)}
    (hA : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => A t i)
    (hInd : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (A t)) (i : Fin m) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin m, (i : ℕ) = N →
      ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i := by
    intro N
    induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ N IH =>
      intro i hi
      have hrw : (fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i) = fun t => A t i -
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Iio i,
            (inner ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j) (A t i) /
              ((‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j‖ : ℝ) ^ 2)) •
                gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j := by
        funext t
        rw [gramSchmidt_def]
        congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
        rw [starProjection_singleton]
        norm_num
      rw [hrw]
      apply (hA i).sub
      apply ContDiff.sum
      intro j hj
      have hjN : (j : ℕ) < N := by
        have hji : j < i := Finset.mem_Iio.mp hj
        omega
      have hgj : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j :=
        IH (j : ℕ) hjN j rfl
      have hquot : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t =>
          inner ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j) (A t i) /
            ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j‖ ^ 2 := by
        apply ContDiff.div (ContDiff.inner ℝ hgj (hA i))
          (ContDiff.norm_sq ℝ hgj)
        intro t
        exact pow_ne_zero 2
          (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (gramSchmidt_ne_zero j (hInd t)))
      exact hquot.smul hgj
  exact key (i : ℕ) i rfl

name: Submission.contDiff_gramSchmidtNormed_family
statement:
theorem contDiff_gramSchmidtNormed_family
    {T : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup T] [NormedSpace ℝ T]
    {m : ℕ} {A : T → Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)}
    (hA : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => A t i)
    (hInd : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (A t)) (i : Fin m) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (A t) i
proof:
:= by
  have hgs := contDiff_gramSchmidt_family hA hInd i
  have hne : ∀ t, gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i ≠ 0 := fun t =>
    gramSchmidt_ne_zero i (hInd t)
  have hnorm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i‖⁻¹ :=
    (ContDiff.norm ℝ hgs hne).inv fun t => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hne t)
  have heq : (fun t => gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (A t) i) =
      fun t => ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i‖⁻¹ • gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i := by
    funext t
    rw [gramSchmidtNormed]
    norm_num
  rw [heq]
  exact hnorm.smul hgs

name: Submission.contDiff_matrixRows
statement:
theorem contDiff_matrixRows
    {T : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup T] [NormedSpace ℝ T]
    {m : ℕ} {M : T → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ}
    (hM : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => M t i j) (i : Fin m) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => matrixRows (M t) i
proof:

    rw [contDiff_pi]

name: Submission.linearIndependent_matrixRows_of_det_ne_zero
statement:
theorem linearIndependent_matrixRows_of_det_ne_zero
    {m : ℕ} {M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ} (hdet : M.det ≠ 0) :
    LinearIndependent ℝ (matrixRows M)
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : LinearIndependent ℝ M.row := by
    rw [Matrix.linearIndependent_rows_iff_isUnit,
      Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det, isUnit_iff_ne_zero]
    exact hdet
  have hiff :
      LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i => WithLp.ofLp (matrixRows M i)) ↔
        LinearIndependent ℝ (matrixRows M) :=
    (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ (Fin m → ℝ)).toLinearMap.linearIndependent_iff
      (LinearEquiv.ker _)
  apply hiff.mp
  have hrow' : LinearIndependent ℝ (fun i => M i) := by
    rw [show (fun i => M i) = M.row by
      funext i j
      rfl]
    exact hrow
  rw [show (fun i => WithLp.ofLp (matrixRows M i)) = fun i => M i by
    funext i j
    rfl]
  exact hrow'

name: Submission.orthonormal_matrixRows_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
statement:
theorem orthonormal_matrixRows_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
    {m : ℕ} {M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ}
    (hM : M ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin m) ℝ) :
    Orthonormal ℝ (matrixRows M)
proof:
:= by
  apply orthonormal_iff_ite.mpr
  intro i j
  have hmul : M * Mᵀ = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin m) ℝ).mp hM
  have hij := congrArg (fun A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ => A i j) hmul
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply] at hij
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial, matrixRows,
    Matrix.transpose_apply] at hij ⊢
  rw [← hij]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => mul_comm _ _

name: Submission.rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
statement:
theorem rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
    {m : ℕ} {v : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)}
    (hInd : LinearIndependent ℝ v)
    (hdet : 0 < (rowsMatrix v).det) :
    rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v) ∈
      Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin m) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  have horthonormal : Orthonormal ℝ (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v) :=
    gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hInd
  let Q := rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v)
  have hmul : Q * Qᵀ = 1 := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    have hentries : ∀ k, Q i k * Qᵀ k j =
        (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v i) k *
          (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v j) k := by
      intro k
      rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]
      rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => hentries k]
    have hinner := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp horthonormal i j
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply] at hinner
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial] at hinner
    rw [← hinner]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => mul_comm _ _
  have horth : Q ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin m) ℝ :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin m) ℝ).mpr hmul
  have hdetpos : 0 < Q.det := by
    change 0 < (rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v)).det
    rw [det_rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed]
    apply mul_pos
    · apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro i _
      have hne : gramSchmidt ℝ v i ≠ 0 := gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hInd
      have hnorm : 0 < ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
      positivity
    · exact hdet
  have hdetsq : Q.det * Q.det = 1 := by
    have h := congrArg Matrix.det hmul
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at h
    exact h
  have hdetone : Q.det = 1 := by
    rcases mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp hdetsq with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [h] at hdetpos
      linarith
  exact Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mpr ⟨horth, hdetone⟩

name: Submission.contDiff_gramSchmidtSO_apply
statement:
theorem contDiff_gramSchmidtSO_apply
    {T : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup T] [NormedSpace ℝ T]
    {m : ℕ} (A : T → Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (hA : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => A t i)
    (hInd : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (A t))
    (hdet : ∀ t, 0 < (rowsMatrix (A t)).det) (i j : Fin m) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t =>
      (((gramSchmidtSO A hInd hdet t : SOGroup m) :
        Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) i j)
proof:
:= by
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t =>
    WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (A t) i) j

    (contDiff_gramSchmidtNormed_family hA hInd i)

name: Submission.matrixGramSchmidtSO_coe
statement:

    (M : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (hdet : 0 < M.det) :

name: Submission.contDiff_matrixGramSchmidtSO_apply
statement:
theorem contDiff_matrixGramSchmidtSO_apply
    {T : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup T] [NormedSpace ℝ T]
    {m : ℕ} (M : T → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    (hM : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t => M t i j)
    (hdet : ∀ t, 0 < (M t).det) (i j : Fin m) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t =>
      (((matrixGramSchmidtSO (M t) (hdet t) : SOGroup m) :
        Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) i j)
proof:
:= by
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t =>
    WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows (M t)) i) j
  have hgs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun t =>
      gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows (M t)) i := by
    apply contDiff_gramSchmidtNormed_family
    · exact contDiff_matrixRows hM
    · intro t
      exact linearIndependent_matrixRows_of_det_ne_zero
        (ne_of_gt (hdet t))
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ ((EuclideanSpace.proj j) ∘ fun t =>
    gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows (M t)) i)
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).contDiff.comp hgs

name: Submission.SOGroup_det_pos
statement:
theorem SOGroup_det_pos {m : ℕ} (Q : SOGroup m) :
    0 < ((Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)).det

name: Submission.matrixGramSchmidtSO_of_SOGroup
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixGramSchmidtSO_of_SOGroup {m : ℕ} (Q : SOGroup m) :
    matrixGramSchmidtSO (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
      (SOGroup_det_pos Q) = Q
proof:
:= by
  have horth : Orthonormal ℝ (matrixRows
      (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)) :=
    orthonormal_matrixRows_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
      (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp Q.property).1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
    (matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ))) =
      (Q : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed_eq_of_orthonormal horth,
    rowsMatrix_matrixRows]

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierTraceSupport.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.continuous_jointCircle
statement:
theorem continuous_jointCircle :
    Continuous (fun q : ℝ × C => R.track.circle q.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hraw : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × C => fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
      R.track.circle q.1 q.2 i) := by
    apply continuous_pi
    intro i
    apply isQuotientMap_quotient_mk'.continuous_lift_prod_right
    have hi : Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => R.track.lift q.1 q.2 i) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i).continuous.comp R.track.smooth_lift.continuous
    apply hi.congr
    intro q
    change R.track.lift q.1 q.2 i =
      R.track.circle q.1 (q.2 : C) i
    rw [R.track.circle_coe]
  have htop :=
    (PiLp.continuous_toLp (2 : ENNReal) (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ)).comp hraw
  apply htop.congr
  intro q
  exact WithLp.toLp_ofLp (2 : ENNReal) (R.track.circle q.1 q.2)

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierTraceSupport.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.trace_disjoint_obstacleSet
statement:
theorem trace_disjoint_obstacleSet :
    Disjoint (trace (V := V) h2 O R)
      (OrbitUnknottingSupport.obstacleSet V h2 O)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hxTrace hxObstacle
  obtain ⟨q, rfl⟩ := hxTrace
  obtain ⟨P, hPerase, hxSource | hxTarget⟩ :=
    Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hxObstacle
  · have hPO : P ≠ O := by
      exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp hPerase).1
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (FourierRelativeTrack.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.range_disjoint_source
        (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) R q.1.property P hPO)
      ⟨q.2, rfl⟩ hxSource
  · have hPO : P ≠ O := by
      exact (Finset.mem_erase.mp hPerase).1
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
      (FourierRelativeTrack.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.range_disjoint_target
        (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) R q.1.property P hPO)
      ⟨q.2, rfl⟩ hxTarget

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierTraceSupport.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.exists_trace_thickening
statement:
theorem exists_trace_thickening :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      trace (V := V) h2 O R ⊆
        Metric.thickening δ (trace (V := V) h2 O R) ∧
      IsOpen (Metric.thickening δ (trace (V := V) h2 O R)) ∧
      Disjoint (closure (Metric.thickening δ (trace (V := V) h2 O R)))
        (OrbitUnknottingSupport.obstacleSet V h2 O)
proof:
:= by
  have htrace := isCompact_trace (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) R
  have hobstacle := OrbitUnknottingSupport.isCompact_obstacleSet V h2 O
  have hdisjoint :=
    trace_disjoint_obstacleSet (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) R
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hclosed⟩ :=
    hdisjoint.exists_cthickenings htrace hobstacle.isClosed
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, Metric.self_subset_thickening hδ _,
    Metric.isOpen_thickening, ?_⟩
  exact hclosed.mono
    (Metric.closure_thickening_subset_cthickening δ _)
    (Metric.self_subset_cthickening _)

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.ComponentMove.endpointAction_apply_of_pairwise
statement:
theorem endpointAction_apply_of_pairwise :
    ∀ {schedule : List (ComponentMove n)},
      schedule.Pairwise MutuallyRelative →
      ∀ P ∈ schedule, ∀ x ∈ P.source,
        endpointAction (schedule.map ComponentMove.move) x =
          P.move.forward 1 x
  | [], _, P, hP, _, _ => by simp at hP
  | head :: tail, hpair, P, hP, x, hx => by
      rw [List.pairwise_cons] at hpair
      rcases hpair with ⟨hhead, htail⟩
      rw [List.mem_cons] at hP
      rcases hP with rfl | hP
      · have hfixtail : ∀ Bm ∈ tail.map ComponentMove.move,
            Bm.FixedOn P.source
proof:
:= by
          intro Bm hB
          rw [List.mem_map] at hB
          obtain ⟨Q, hQt, rfl⟩ := hB
          exact (hhead Q hQt).2.mono subset_union_left
        rw [List.map_cons, endpointAction_cons,
          endpointAction_eq_of_fixedOn (tail.map ComponentMove.move)
            hfixtail x hx]
      · have ih := endpointAction_apply_of_pairwise htail P hP x hx
        have hfix : head.move.FixedOn P.target :=
          (hhead P hP).1.mono subset_union_right
        have hmemT : P.move.forward 1 x ∈ P.target := by
          rw [← P.endpoint_image]
          exact ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
        rw [List.map_cons, endpointAction_cons, ih]
        exact hfix 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ _ hmemT

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.OrbitMoveFamily.ambientSchedule_forward_apply

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.ComponentPlacementData.intrinsicOrbitLift_mem
statement:
theorem intrinsicOrbitLift_mem
    (O : (field m : TamedField X).OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    (field m : TamedField X).intrinsicOrbitLift O u ∈
      (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))))
proof:
:= by
  rw [(field m : TamedField X).orbitPoint_orbit O]
  exact ⟨u * (field m : TamedField X).orbitPeriod O, rfl⟩

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.ComponentPlacementData.ambient_forward_intrinsicOrbitLift
statement:
theorem ambient_forward_intrinsicOrbitLift (P : ComponentPlacementData m X)
    (O : (field m : TamedField X).OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    P.ambient.forward 1
        ((field m : TamedField X).intrinsicOrbitLift O u) =
      TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift
        (V := (field m : TamedField X)) (dimension_ge_two m) O u
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := intrinsicOrbitLift_mem (m := m) (X := X) O u
  have hstep : P.ambient.forward 1
      ((field m : TamedField X).intrinsicOrbitLift O u) =
      (P.unknotting.move O).forward 1
        ((field m : TamedField X).intrinsicOrbitLift O u) :=
    P.unknotting.ambient_forward_apply O hmem
  rw [hstep]
  exact (P.realize O).some.endpoint_lift u

name: Submission.CanonicalPlacementTauField.placement_endpointX_eq

name: Submission.CanonicalPlacementTauField.tauField_placedEndpoint_targetLift
statement:
theorem tauField_placedEndpoint_targetLift {m : ℕ}
    {X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)}
    (P : ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.ComponentPlacementData m X)
    (O : (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X).OrbitIndex)
    (u : ℝ) :
    tauField P.endpointX.g
        (TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift
          (V := (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X))
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) O u) =
      canonTau (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) u
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
      TamedField X).intrinsicOrbitLift O u ∈ X.fiber :=
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X).flow_mem_fiber
      ((ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
        TamedField X).orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) _
  have hderiv : HasDerivAt
      ((ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
        TamedField X).intrinsicOrbitLift O)
      ((ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X).orbitPeriod O •
        tauField X.g ((ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
          TamedField X).intrinsicOrbitLift O u)) u := by
    have h := (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
      TamedField X).hasDerivAt_intrinsicOrbitLift O u
    rwa [(ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
      TamedField X).v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber hmem] at h
  have hcomp : ∀ t : ℝ,
      TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift
          (V := (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X))
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) O t =
        P.ambient.forward 1 ((ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
          TamedField X).intrinsicOrbitLift O t) := fun t =>
    (P.ambient_forward_intrinsicOrbitLift O t).symm
  have hres := P.ambient.tauField_pullback_of_curve X
    (γ := (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
      TamedField X).intrinsicOrbitLift O)
    (δ := TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift
      (V := (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X))
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) O)
    (u := u)
    (a := (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X).orbitPeriod O)
    ((ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
      TamedField X).orbitPeriod_pos O) hmem hderiv hcomp
    (hasDerivAt_targetLift'
      (V := (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField X))
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) O u)
  rw [placement_endpointX_eq, canonTau]
  exact hres

name: Submission.CanonicalPlacementTauField.tauField_placedEndpoint_canonicalPoint
statement:

name: Submission.CanonicalPlacementTauField.tauField_pullback_targetLift
statement:
theorem tauField_pullback_targetLift {X Y Z : FramedLevelSet n}
    {V : TamedField X} {W : TamedField Y}
    (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (O : V.OrbitIndex) (Q : W.OrbitIndex)
    (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    (hfib : ∀ t : ℝ,
      TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := V) h2 O t ∈ Z.fiber)
    (htau : ∀ t : ℝ,
      tauField Z.g (TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := V) h2 O t)
        = canonTau h2 t)
    (hcomp : ∀ t : ℝ,
      TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := W) h2 Q t =
        A.forward 1
          (TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := V) h2 O t))
    (u : ℝ) :
    tauField (A.pullback Z).g
        (TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := W) h2 Q u) =
      canonTau h2 u
proof:
:= by
  have hnpos : 0 < ‖canonVel h2 u‖ := norm_canonVel_pos h2 O u
  have hne : ‖canonVel h2 u‖ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hnpos
  have hderiv : HasDerivAt
      (TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := V) h2 O)
      (‖canonVel h2 u‖ • tauField Z.g
        (TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := V) h2 O u)) u := by
    have hbase := hasDerivAt_targetLift' (V := V) h2 O u
    rw [htau u, canonTau, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ hne, one_smul]
    exact hbase
  have hres := A.tauField_pullback_of_curve Z
    (γ := TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := V) h2 O)
    (δ := TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := W) h2 Q)
    (u := u) (a := ‖canonVel h2 u‖) hnpos (hfib u) hderiv hcomp
    (hasDerivAt_targetLift' (V := W) h2 Q u)
  rw [canonTau]
  exact hres

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalOrbitPoint_mem_exteriorSlabCore
statement:
theorem chronologicalOrbitPoint_mem_exteriorSlabCore
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (s : ℝ)
    (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after)
    (hreg : sliceRegular D.signedOutput.cobordism.G s)
    (V : TamedField (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData s
      hreg))
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) {x : Eₐ} (hx : x ∈ (O : Set Eₐ))
    (hexterior : (O : Set Eₐ) ∈
      D.chronologicalExteriorOrbitCollection t ht s) :
    cobSpaceTime x s ∈ D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht
proof:
:= by
  rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore]
  refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hexterior x hx⟩
  · have hxFiber : x ∈
        (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt
          D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData s
          hreg).fiber := by
      apply V.orbit_subset_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
      rwa [← V.orbitPoint_orbit O]
    rwa [SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber] at hxFiber
  · simpa using hs

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalDefiniteExteriorShift_mem
statement:
theorem chronologicalDefiniteExteriorShift_mem
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .minimum ∨
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .maximum)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin ((a + 2) + 2))} {s : ℝ}
    (hp : p ∈ D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht)
    (hsafe : |s| ≤
      (D.chronologicalExteriorSlabTimeField t ht).safeTime)
    (htime : tcoord p + s =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) :
    (D.chronologicalExteriorSlabTimeField t ht).base.flow p s ∈
      criticalSliceExteriorCore
        D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius
proof:
:= by
  let R := D.chronologicalExteriorSlabTimeField t ht
  have hshort : |s| < 2 * R.safeTime := by
    have hpos := R.safeTime_pos
    linarith
  have hp' := hp
  rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore] at hp'
  have hpfiber : p ∈
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber := hp'.1.1
  have hyfiber : R.base.flow p s ∈
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber :=
    R.flow_mem_fiber hpfiber s
  have hytime : tcoord (R.base.flow p s) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    rw [R.tcoord_flow hp hsafe]
    exact htime
  have hyspatial : Function.Surjective
      (spatialDeriv D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (R.base.flow p s)) :=
    R.flow_spatialDeriv_surjective hp hshort
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore]
  refine ⟨hyfiber, hytime, ?_⟩
  by_contra hdist
  have hlt : dist (R.base.flow p s) (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius :=
    lt_of_not_ge hdist
  have hyrepr : cobSpaceTime
      (spacePart (R.base.flow p s))
      (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) = R.base.flow p s := by
    rw [← hytime, spaceTime_spacePart]
  have hcovered : spacePart (R.base.flow p s) ∈
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).coveredSliceFiber
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) := by
    constructor
    · rwa [hyrepr]
    · rwa [hyrepr]
  have hycenter : R.base.flow p s = D.position.eventCenter t ht := by
    exact hyrepr.symm.trans
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).definite_coveredSliceFiber_at_critical_eq_center
        hindex hcovered)
  have hcenterCritical :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).center_mem_timeCritical
  rw [hycenter] at hyspatial
  exact hcenterCritical.2 hyspatial

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.exists_closedTube_subset_open
statement:
theorem exists_closedTube_subset_open {U : Set E}
    (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hcircle : Set.range F.circle ⊆ U) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧
      F.tube '' ((Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : N) r) ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  let T : Set (C × N) := F.tube ⁻¹' U
  have hTopen : IsOpen T := hUopen.preimage F.continuous_tube
  have hzero : (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ ({0} : Set N) ⊆ T := by
    rintro ⟨a, z⟩ ⟨-, hz⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    change z = 0 at hz
    subst z
    exact hcircle ⟨a, F.tube_zero a |>.symm⟩
  obtain ⟨A, W, hAopen, hWopen, hCA, hzeroW, hAWT⟩ :=
    generalized_tube_lemma (X := C) (Y := N)
      isCompact_univ isCompact_singleton hTopen hzero
  have hzero_mem_W : (0 : N) ∈ W := hzeroW (Set.mem_singleton 0)
  rcases (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hWopen) 0 hzero_mem_W with
    ⟨R, hR, hballW⟩
  let r : ℝ := R / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hrR : r < R := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  rintro x ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩
  exact hAWT ⟨hCA (Set.mem_univ q.1),
    hballW (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hrR hq.2)⟩

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.exists_radialBump_supportCore_subset
statement:
theorem exists_radialBump_supportCore_subset {U : Set E}
    (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hcircle : Set.range F.circle ⊆ U) :
    ∃ b : ContDiffBump (0 : N),
      b.rOut < F.globalSmoothTube.radius ∧
      F.tube '' ((Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ
        Metric.closedBall (0 : N) b.rOut) ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hrU⟩ := F.exists_closedTube_subset_open hUopen hcircle
  let ρ : ℝ := min r F.globalSmoothTube.radius
  have hρ : 0 < ρ := lt_min hr F.globalSmoothTube.radius_pos
  let b : ContDiffBump (0 : N) := {
    rIn := ρ / 3
    rOut := ρ / 2
    rIn_pos := by linarith
    rIn_lt_rOut := by linarith
  }
  have hbρ : b.rOut < ρ := by dsimp [b]; linarith
  have hbr : b.rOut < r := hbρ.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hbTube : b.rOut < F.globalSmoothTube.radius :=
    hbρ.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  refine ⟨b, hbTube, ?_⟩
  intro x hx
  apply hrU
  exact Set.image_mono (Set.prod_mono_right
    (Metric.closedBall_subset_closedBall hbr.le)) hx

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.exists_supportedPeriodicDisplacementExtensionData
statement:
theorem exists_supportedPeriodicDisplacementExtensionData
    (d : ℝ → E) (hd : ContDiff ℝ ∞ d) (hp : Function.Periodic d 1)
    {U : Set E} (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hcircle : Set.range F.circle ⊆ U) :
    ∃ D : F.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData,
      D.supportCore ⊆ U
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨b, hbTube, hbU⟩ :=
    F.exists_radialBump_supportCore_subset hUopen hcircle
  let D : F.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData := {
    displacement := d
    displacement_smooth := hd
    displacement_periodic := hp
    radialBump := b
    radialBump_rOut_lt := hbTube
  }
  exact ⟨D, hbU⟩

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.toSmallAmbientDisplacement_forward_lift
statement:
theorem toSmallAmbientDisplacement_forward_lift
    (K : ℝ≥0) (hK : K < 1)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith K D.ambientField) (u : ℝ) :
    (D.toSmallAmbientDisplacement K hK hLip).toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.forward 1
        (F.lift u) = F.lift u + D.displacement u
proof:
:= by
  rw [SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward_one]
  change F.lift u + D.ambientField (F.lift u) = _
  rw [← F.tubeLift_zero u, D.ambientField_zeroSection]

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.toSmallAmbientDisplacement_fixedOn_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem toSmallAmbientDisplacement_fixedOn_of_disjoint
    (Klip : ℝ≥0) (hKlip : Klip < 1)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith Klip D.ambientField)
    {K : Set E} (hdisj : Disjoint D.supportCore K) :
    (D.toSmallAmbientDisplacement Klip hKlip hLip).toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.FixedOn K
proof:
:= by
  apply SmallAmbientDisplacement.fixedOn_of_field_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  change D.ambientField x = 0
  apply D.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore
  exact fun hcore => Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hcore hx

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.toScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_forward_lift
statement:
theorem toScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_forward_lift
    (r : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith K D.ambientField)
    (hsmall : ‖r‖₊ * K < 1) (u : ℝ) :
    (D.toScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement r K hLip hsmall).toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.forward 1
        (F.lift u) = F.lift u + r • D.displacement u
proof:
:= by
  rw [SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward_one]
  change F.lift u + r • D.ambientField (F.lift u) = _
  rw [← F.tubeLift_zero u, D.ambientField_zeroSection]

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.toScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_fixedOn_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem toScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_fixedOn_of_disjoint
    (r : ℝ) (Klip : ℝ≥0) (hLip : LipschitzWith Klip D.ambientField)
    (hsmall : ‖r‖₊ * Klip < 1)
    {K : Set E} (hdisj : Disjoint D.supportCore K) :
    (D.toScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement r Klip hLip hsmall).toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.FixedOn K
proof:
:= by
  apply SmallAmbientDisplacement.fixedOn_of_field_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  change r • D.ambientField x = 0
  rw [D.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore
    (fun hcore => Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj hcore hx)]
  simp

name: Submission.SaddleRelativeFrameClassData.orbitFrameClass_splice
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_splice
    (F : SaddleRelativeFrameClassData Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat)
    (hn : 2 ≤ n) :
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
      Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hm : 3 ≤ n + 1 := by omega
  calc
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
        F.exterior₁ + F.exterior₂ +
          loopClassZ2 (F.model.outgoing.frame (n + 1))
            (F.model.outgoing.frame_closed (n + 1)) := F.outgoing_class
    _ = F.exterior₁ + F.exterior₂ +
          (loopClassZ2 (F.model.incoming₁.frame (n + 1))
              (F.model.incoming₁.frame_closed (n + 1)) +
            loopClassZ2 (F.model.incoming₂.frame (n + 1))
              (F.model.incoming₂.frame_closed (n + 1)) + 1) := by
      rw [F.model.frame_class_splice hm]
    _ = (F.exterior₁ +
            loopClassZ2 (F.model.incoming₁.frame (n + 1))
              (F.model.incoming₁.frame_closed (n + 1))) +
          (F.exterior₂ +
            loopClassZ2 (F.model.incoming₂.frame (n + 1))
              (F.model.incoming₂.frame_closed (n + 1))) + 1 := by
      abel
    _ = Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ +
          Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + 1 := by
      rw [← F.incoming₁_class, ← F.incoming₂_class]

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.nonempty_saddleCanonicalGeometry_of_frameClassKit
statement:
theorem nonempty_saddleCanonicalGeometry_of_frameClassKit
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hpositive : D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (hn : 2 ≤ n)
    (K : Nonempty
      (D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeFrameClassKit

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.exists_sharedAffineMorse_update
statement:
theorem exists_sharedAffineMorse_update
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι) (s : Finset ι) (i : ι)
    (A : Cov) (hs : B.SharedAffineMorseOnIndices A s)
    {U : Set Cov} (hU : IsOpen U) (hAU : A ∈ U) :
    ∃ A' ∈ U,
      (B.chart i).SharedAffineMorseOn A' (B.core i) ∧
      B.SharedAffineMorseOnIndices A' s
proof:
:= by
  have hprevious :
      ∀ᶠ A' in 𝓝 A, B.SharedAffineMorseOnIndices A' s := by
    change ∀ᶠ A' in 𝓝 A, ∀ j ∈ s,
      (B.chart j).SharedAffineMorseOn A' (B.core j)
    rw [eventually_all_finset]
    intro j hj
    exact (B.chart j).eventually_sharedAffineMorseOn
      (B.compact_core j) A (hs j hj)
  have hstay : ∀ᶠ A' in 𝓝 A, A' ∈ U := hU.mem_nhds hAU
  have hgood :
      ∀ᶠ A' in 𝓝 A,
        A' ∈ U ∧ B.SharedAffineMorseOnIndices A' s :=
    hstay.and hprevious
  let update : E₂ → Cov := (B.chart i).updateSharedCovector A
  have hupdate : Tendsto update (𝓝 0) (𝓝 A) := by
    have hcont : ContinuousAt update 0 :=
      ((B.chart i).continuous_updateSharedCovector A).continuousAt
    rw [← (B.chart i).updateSharedCovector_zero A]
    exact hcont
  have hpre :
      {q | update q ∈ U ∧ B.SharedAffineMorseOnIndices (update q) s} ∈
        𝓝 (0 : E₂) :=
    hupdate hgood
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hpre
  obtain ⟨q, hqball, hqreg⟩ :=
    exists_small_regular_chartGradient
      ((B.chart i).contDiff_sharedAffineHeight A) hδ
  have hpreserved := hball hqball
  refine ⟨update q, hpreserved.1, ?_, hpreserved.2⟩
  exact (B.chart i).sharedAffineMorseOn_update_of_regularValue
    (B.domain_open i) A q hqreg (B.core_subset_domain i)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.exists_sharedAffineMorseCovector_in_ball
statement:
theorem exists_sharedAffineMorseCovector_in_ball
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι) {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ A ∈ ball (0 : Cov) ε,
      ∀ i, (B.chart i).SharedAffineMorseOn A (B.core i)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hind : ∀ s : Finset ι,
      ∃ A ∈ ball (0 : Cov) ε, B.SharedAffineMorseOnIndices A s := by
    intro s
    induction s using Finset.induction_on with
    | empty =>
        refine ⟨0, ?_, ?_⟩
        · simpa using hε
        · intro i hi
          simp at hi
    | @insert i s hi ih =>
        obtain ⟨A, hAball, hAs⟩ := ih
        obtain ⟨A', hA'ball, hAi, hA's⟩ :=
          B.exists_sharedAffineMorse_update s i A hAs
            Metric.isOpen_ball hAball
        refine ⟨A', hA'ball, ?_⟩
        intro j hj
        rw [Finset.mem_insert] at hj
        rcases hj with rfl | hj
        · exact hAi
        · exact hA's j hj
  obtain ⟨A, hAball, hAall⟩ := hind Finset.univ
  refine ⟨A, hAball, ?_⟩
  intro i
  exact hAall i (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: Submission.FiniteIFTSurfaceCover.exists_sharedAffineMorseCovector_mem_nhds
statement:
theorem exists_sharedAffineMorseCovector_mem_nhds
    (B : FiniteIFTSurfaceCover C ι) {V : Set Cov}
    (hV : V ∈ 𝓝 (0 : Cov)) :
    ∃ A ∈ V, ∀ i, (B.chart i).SharedAffineMorseOn A (B.core i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hV
  obtain ⟨A, hA, hMorse⟩ :=
    B.exists_sharedAffineMorseCovector_in_ball hε
  exact ⟨A, hball hA, hMorse⟩

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_regularZeroFrame_revCM
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_regularZeroFrame_revCM
    {G : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G) (z : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
    (hz : ∀ q, Function.Surjective (spatialDeriv G (z q)))
    (hz' : ∀ q, Function.Surjective (spatialDeriv G (revCM z q)))
    (hclosed : z 0 = z 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (regularZeroFrame hG (revCM z) hz')
        (regularZeroFrame_closed hG (revCM z) hz' (revCM_closed hclosed)) =
      loopClassZ2 (regularZeroFrame hG z hz)
        (regularZeroFrame_closed hG z hz hclosed)
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : regularZeroFrame hG (revCM z) hz' =
      reverseLoop (regularZeroFrame hG z hz) :=
    regularZeroFrame_revCM hG z hz hz'
  calc loopClassZ2 (regularZeroFrame hG (revCM z) hz')
          (regularZeroFrame_closed hG (revCM z) hz' (revCM_closed hclosed))
      = loopClassZ2 (reverseLoop (regularZeroFrame hG z hz))
          (reverseLoop_closed
            (regularZeroFrame_closed hG z hz hclosed)) :=
        loopClassZ2_congr_fun _ _ hEq
    _ = loopClassZ2 (regularZeroFrame hG z hz)
          (regularZeroFrame_closed hG z hz hclosed) :=
        loopClassZ2_reverse _ _

name: Submission.SameFiberSegmentComparison.fderiv_segMap
statement:
theorem fderiv_segMap (X Y : FramedLevelSet n) (s : ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    fderiv ℝ (segMap X Y s) x =
      (1 - s) • fderiv ℝ X.g x + s • fderiv ℝ Y.g x
proof:
:= by
  have hX : HasFDerivAt X.g (fderiv ℝ X.g x) x :=
    (X.smooth.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt
  have hY : HasFDerivAt Y.g (fderiv ℝ Y.g x) x :=
    (Y.smooth.differentiable (by simp) x).hasFDerivAt

name: Submission.SameFiberSegmentComparison.Data.segMap_fiber_eq
statement:
theorem segMap_fiber_eq (D : Data X Y) (s : ℝ)
    (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    {x | segMap X Y s x = 0} = X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hx' : (1 - s) • X.g x + s • Y.g x = 0 := hx
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs0 with hs0e | hs0p
    · rw [← hs0e] at hx'
      have hX : X.g x = 0 := by simpa using hx'
      exact hX
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs1 with hs1e | hs1p
      · rw [hs1e] at hx'
        have hY : Y.g x = 0 := by simpa using hx'
        have hmem : x ∈ Y.fiber := hY
        rwa [D.fiber_eq] at hmem
      · by_contra hxf
        have hsne : s ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hs0p
        have h1 : s • Y.g x = (-(1 - s)) • X.g x := by
          rw [neg_smul]
          exact eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_right hx'
        have h2 : Y.g x = (s⁻¹ * -(1 - s)) • X.g x := by
          rw [← inv_smul_smul₀ hsne (Y.g x), h1, smul_smul]
        exact D.no_antiparallel x hxf (s⁻¹ * -(1 - s))
          (mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (inv_pos.mpr hs0p) (by linarith)) h2
  · intro hxf
    have hX0 : X.g x = 0 := hxf
    have hY0 : Y.g x = 0 := by
      have hmem : x ∈ Y.fiber := by
        rw [D.fiber_eq]
        exact hxf
      exact hmem
    have hzero : (1 - s) • X.g x + s • Y.g x = 0 := by
      rw [hX0, hY0]
      simp
    exact hzero

name: Submission.SameFiberSegmentComparison.Data.segMap_regular
statement:
theorem segMap_regular (D : Data X Y) (s : ℝ)
    (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : x ∈ X.fiber) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (segMap X Y s) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [fderiv_segMap]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs0 with hs0e | hs0p
  · have hop : (1 - s) • fderiv ℝ X.g x + s • fderiv ℝ Y.g x =
        fderiv ℝ X.g x := by
      rw [← hs0e]
      module
    rw [hop]
    exact X.regular x hx
  · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs1 with hs1e | hs1p
    · have hmem : x ∈ Y.fiber := by
        rw [D.fiber_eq]
        exact hx
      have hop : (1 - s) • fderiv ℝ X.g x + s • fderiv ℝ Y.g x =
          fderiv ℝ Y.g x := by
        rw [hs1e]
        module
      rw [hop]
      exact Y.regular x hmem
    · exact D.convex_regular s hs0p hs1p x hx

name: Submission.SameFiberSegmentComparison.Data.ofStraightLineComparison
statement:
theorem ofStraightLineComparison
    (D : SameFiberStraightLineComparison.Data X Y) : Data X Y where
  fiber_eq
proof:
:= D.fiber_eq
  no_antiparallel := by
    intro x hxf c hc heq
    have hpair := D.pairing_nonneg x
    rw [heq, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at hpair
    have hXne : X.g x ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hxf h0
    have hpos : 0 < ‖X.g x‖ ^ 2 := pow_pos (norm_pos_iff.mpr hXne) 2
    nlinarith
  convex_regular := by
    intro s hs0 hs1 x hx
    have hjet := D.firstJet_eq x hx
    rw [hjet]
    have hcomb : (1 - s) • fderiv ℝ X.g x + s • fderiv ℝ X.g x =
        fderiv ℝ X.g x := by
      module
    rw [hcomb]
    exact X.regular x hx

name: Submission.SameFiberSegmentComparison.Data.refl
statement:
theorem refl (X : FramedLevelSet n) : Data X X where
  fiber_eq
proof:
:= rfl
  no_antiparallel := by
    intro x hxf c hc heq
    have hXne : X.g x ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hxf h0
    have h1 : (1 - c) • X.g x = 0 := by
      rw [sub_smul, one_smul, ← heq, sub_self]
    have h2 : (1 : ℝ) - c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith)
    rcases smul_eq_zero.mp h1 with h | h
    · exact h2 h
    · exact hXne h
  convex_regular := by
    intro s hs0 hs1 x hx
    have hcomb : (1 - s) • fderiv ℝ X.g x + s • fderiv ℝ X.g x =
        fderiv ℝ X.g x := by
      module
    rw [hcomb]
    exact X.regular x hx

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationStraightLineAdmissibilityExistence.straightLineSegmentData_of_admissibility
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hxf c hc heq
    have hc1 : (0 : ℝ) < 1 - c := by linarith
    have hcne : (1 : ℝ) - c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc1
    set s : ℝ := (1 - c)⁻¹ with hsdef
    have hs0 : 0 < s := inv_pos.mpr hc1
    have hprod : ((1 : ℝ) - c) * s = 1 := by
      rw [hsdef]
      exact mul_inv_cancel₀ hcne
    have hgt : (1 : ℝ) < 1 - c := by linarith
    have hs1 : s < 1 := by nlinarith [hprod, hgt, hs0]
    have hcoef : (1 - s) + s * c = 0 := by
      linear_combination (-1 : ℝ) * hprod
    have hzero : (1 - s) •
          (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.g x +
        s • (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x = 0 := by
      rw [heq, smul_smul, ← add_smul, hcoef, zero_smul]
    have hfiber := (D.zeroFiber_regular s hs0.le hs1.le).1
    have hmem : x ∈ (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.fiber := by
      rw [← hfiber]
      exact hzero
    exact hxf hmem
  · intro s hs0 hs1 x hx
    have h := (D.zeroFiber_regular s hs0.le hs1.le).2 x hx
    have h' : Function.Surjective
        (fderiv ℝ
          (SameFiberSegmentComparison.segMap
            (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁
            (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX s) x) := h
    rw [SameFiberSegmentComparison.fderiv_segMap] at h'
    exact h'

  intro x hx
  rw [(firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpoint_fiber] at hx
  obtain ⟨P, hxP⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hx
  simpa using
    ConcreteConfigurationFirstHeadPlacedGaugeEntry.PlacedGaugeHomotopy.gaugeEndpointSign_pos_iff_firstPlacement
      (B := B) (hm := hm) (M := M) (F := F) P hxP

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularDatum.isTriangularDistortion_id
statement:
theorem isTriangularDistortion_id (m : ℕ) :
    IsTriangularDistortion
      (fun _ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) =>
        ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))) where
  upper
proof:
:= by
    intro _ i j hij
    have h : PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
        = (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℝ) :=
      PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_one
    rw [h]
    exact Matrix.one_apply_ne (ne_of_gt hij)
  diag_pos := by
    intro _ i
    have h : PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix
        (ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
        = (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 2)) (Fin (m + 2)) ℝ) :=
      PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_one
    rw [h, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    exact one_pos

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularDatum.isTriangularDistortion_qrUpper
statement:
theorem isTriangularDistortion_qrUpper {m : ℕ}
    (Φ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hdet : ∀ x, 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Φ x)).det) :
    IsTriangularDistortion (fun x => PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpper (Φ x)) where
  upper
proof:
:= by
    intro x i j hij
    rw [PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_qrUpper]
    exact PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpperMatrix_eq_zero_of_lt (Φ x) hij
  diag_pos := by
    intro x i
    rw [PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_qrUpper]
    exact PolarDecompositionCLM.qrUpperMatrix_diag_pos (hdet x) i

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularDatum.nonempty_toTarget_of_canonicalLoopTriangularJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toTarget_of_canonicalLoopTriangularJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (L₀ : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex → SmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (D₀ : ∀ P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex, (L₀ P).NullGaugeData)
    (A₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hA₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A₀)
    (hA₀tri : IsTriangularDistortion A₀)
    (RA : ℝ)
    (hA₀out : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), RA ≤ ‖x‖ →
      A₀ x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
          r • (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          ((L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          ((A₀ (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
              (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
                (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)))) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F) T)
proof:
:= by
  have hone : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)),
      (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) -
        (1 : ℝ) • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x) = A₀ x := by
    intro x
    rw [one_smul, sub_sub_cancel]
  refine nonempty_toTarget_of_canonicalLoopPathJet hm M F G L₀ D₀
    (fun s x => (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) -
      s • ((1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) - A₀ x))
    (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_fst.smul
      (contDiff_const.sub (hA₀.comp contDiff_snd))))
    ?_ ?_ RA ?_ R eps eps_pos outer ?_
  · intro x
    ext v
    simp
  · intro s hs x
    exact PolarDecompositionCLM.bijective_one_sub_smul_of_upperTriangular
      (fun i j hij => hA₀tri.upper x i j hij)
      (fun i => hA₀tri.diag_pos x i) hs.1 hs.2
  · intro x hx
    rw [hone x]
    exact hA₀out x hx
  · intro P theta
    rw [hone]
    exact hjet P theta

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularDatum.nonempty_toTarget_of_circleTriangularJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toTarget_of_circleTriangularJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (L : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex → LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2))
    (hclass : ∀ P, loopClassZ2 (L P).loop (L P).closed = 0)
    (A₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hA₀ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A₀)
    (hA₀tri : IsTriangularDistortion A₀)
    (RA : ℝ)
    (hA₀out : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), RA ≤ ‖x‖ →
      A₀ x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x +
          r • (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ),
      fderiv ℝ (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX.g
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) =
        (SOFrameGauge.toCLM
          ((L P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))).comp
          ((A₀ (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
              (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)).comp
            (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
              (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
                (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)))) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F) T)
proof:
:= by
  refine nonempty_toTarget_of_canonicalLoopTriangularJet hm M F G
    (fun P => LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.smoothCartesianSOLoopOfClassZero
      (L P) (by omega) (hclass P))
    (fun P => LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.smoothNullGaugeDataOfClassZero
      (L P) (by omega) (hclass P))
    A₀ hA₀ hA₀tri RA hA₀out R eps eps_pos outer ?_
  intro P theta
  rw [CanonicalRotationField.cartesian_smoothCartesianSOLoopOfClassZero
    (L P) (by omega) (hclass P) (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq theta)]
  exact hjet P theta

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularDatum.TriangularEntryDatum.nonempty_toStandardTarget
statement:
theorem nonempty_toStandardTarget (D : TriangularEntryDatum I hm B) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm (standardMatch I hm B)
        (standardFrameMatch I hm B))
      (standardTarget hm B).sign)
proof:

  nonempty_toTarget_of_circleTriangularJet hm (standardMatch I hm B)
    (standardFrameMatch I hm B) (canonicalGaugeData B)
    (fun P => (standardFrameMatch I hm B).discrepancyLoop P)
    (fun P => discrepancyLoop_null (standardMatch I hm B)
      (standardFrameMatch I hm B) P)
    D.A D.A_smooth D.A_triangular D.A_radius D.A_eq_id_outside
    D.R D.eps D.eps_pos D.outer D.jet

name: Submission.BridgeEntryTriangularDatum.TriangularEntryDatum.nonempty_entry

name: Submission.contDiffOn_iteratedFDeriv_of_isOpen
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ f x := hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx)
  have h2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f) x :=
