name: Submission.step2_local
statement:
theorem step2_local {U : Set (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {f : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ} (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U)
    {i : ℕ} (hi : 1 ≤ i)
    (IH : ∀ (U' : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) (g : (Fin n → ℝ) → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ),
      IsOpen U' → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U' → volume (g '' critSet U' g) = 0)
    {x₀ : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ} (hx₀ : x₀ ∈ vanishSet U f i)
    (hx₀' : x₀ ∉ vanishSet U f (i + 1)) :
    ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 x₀, volume (f '' (vanishSet U f i ∩ V)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hx₀U : x₀ ∈ U := hx₀.1
  
  have hne : iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i + 1) f x₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hx₀'
    refine ⟨hx₀U, fun j h1 h2 => ?_⟩
    rcases eq_or_lt_of_le h2 with rfl | hlt
    · exact hzero
    · exact hx₀.2 j h1 (by omega)
  have hm : ∃ m : Fin (i + 1) → (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ),
      iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i + 1) f x₀ m ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hall
    simp only [not_exists, not_not] at hall
    exact hne (ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext hall)
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hm
  obtain ⟨r₀, hr₀⟩ : ∃ r₀, iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i + 1) f x₀ m r₀ ≠ 0 :=
    Function.ne_iff.1 hm
  
  set Λ : ((Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) [×i]→L[ℝ] (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj r₀).comp
      (ContinuousMultilinearMap.apply ℝ (fun _ : Fin i => Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)
        (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) (Fin.tail m)) with hΛdef
  set w : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ := fun y => Λ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f y)
    with hwdef
  have hAsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f) U :=
    contDiffOn_iteratedFDeriv_of_isOpen hU hf i
  have hwsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ w U := Λ.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hAsm
  have hwvanish : ∀ y ∈ vanishSet U f i, w y = 0 := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hwdef]
    simp only [hy.2 i hi le_rfl, map_zero]
  
  have hAdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f) x₀ :=
    (hAsm.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx₀U)).differentiableAt infty_ne_zero
  have hwderiv : HasFDerivAt w
      (Λ.comp (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f) x₀)) x₀ :=
    Λ.hasFDerivAt.comp x₀ hAdiff.hasFDerivAt
  have hdm0 : (Λ.comp (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f) x₀)) (m 0) ≠ 0 := by
    have h1 : (Λ.comp (fderiv ℝ (iteratedFDeriv ℝ i f) x₀)) (m 0)
        = iteratedFDeriv ℝ (i + 1) f x₀ m r₀ := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, hΛdef,
        ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
      congr 1
    rw [h1]
    exact hr₀
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_apply_single_ne_zero hdm0
  have hd : fderiv ℝ w x₀ (Pi.single s 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hwderiv.fderiv]
    exact hs
  
  obtain ⟨V, W, h', hVopen, hWopen, hx₀V, hVU, h'sm, hmapsVW, hleft, hmapsWV,
    hright⟩ := exists_chart hU hwsm hx₀U hd
  refine ⟨V, hVopen.mem_nhds hx₀V, ?_⟩
  
  set φ : (Fin n → ℝ) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ := fun z => Fin.insertNth s 0 z
    with hφdef
  have hφsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ φ := by
    have h1 : φ = fun z => (splitCLE n s).symm ((0 : ℝ), z) := by
      funext z
      rw [hφdef, splitCLE_symm_apply]
    rw [h1]
    exact (splitCLE n s).symm.contDiff.comp (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  set Ω₀ : Set (Fin n → ℝ) := φ ⁻¹' W with hΩ₀def
  have hΩ₀open : IsOpen Ω₀ := hWopen.preimage hφsm.continuous
  set g : (Fin n → ℝ) → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun z => f (h' (φ z)) with hgdef
  have hgsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g Ω₀ := by
    have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (f ∘ h') W :=
      hf.comp h'sm fun w hw => hmapsWV w hw |> hVU
    have h2 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ ((f ∘ h') ∘ φ) Ω₀ :=
      h1.comp (hφsm.contDiffOn) fun z hz => hz
    exact h2
  
  have hincl : f '' (vanishSet U f i ∩ V) ⊆ g '' critSet Ω₀ g := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, ⟨hyK, hyV⟩, rfl⟩
    have hyU : y ∈ U := hVU hyV
    have hwy : w y = 0 := hwvanish y hyK
    have hhy : Function.update y s (w y) ∈ W := hmapsVW y hyV
    rw [hwy] at hhy
    set z : Fin n → ℝ := Fin.removeNth s (Function.update y s (0 : ℝ))
      with hzdef
    have hφz : φ z = Function.update y s (0 : ℝ) := by
      rw [hφdef]
      have h1 : (Function.update y s (0 : ℝ)) s = 0 := Function.update_self ..
      calc Fin.insertNth s 0 z
          = Fin.insertNth s ((Function.update y s (0 : ℝ)) s)
            (Fin.removeNth s (Function.update y s (0 : ℝ))) := by rw [h1]
        _ = Function.update y s (0 : ℝ) := Fin.insertNth_self_removeNth ..
    have hzΩ : z ∈ Ω₀ := by
      rw [hΩ₀def, mem_preimage, hφz]
      exact hhy
    have hh'φz : h' (φ z) = y := by
      rw [hφz, ← hwy]
      exact hleft y hyV
    have hgz : g z = f y := by rw [hgdef]; simp only [hh'φz]
    refine ⟨z, ⟨hzΩ, ?_⟩, hgz⟩
    
    have hfy0 : fderiv ℝ f y = 0 := fderiv_eq_zero_of_mem_vanishSet hi hyK
    have hfydiff : HasFDerivAt f (0 : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)) y := by
      have h1 : DifferentiableAt ℝ f y :=
        (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hyU)).differentiableAt infty_ne_zero
      have h2 := h1.hasFDerivAt
      rwa [hfy0] at h2
    have hh'diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ h' (φ z) := by
      have := (h'sm.contDiffAt (hWopen.mem_nhds hzΩ)).differentiableAt
        infty_ne_zero
      exact this
    have hφdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ z :=
      hφsm.differentiable infty_ne_zero |>.differentiableAt
    have hcomp1 : HasFDerivAt (f ∘ h')
        ((0 : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)).comp
          (fderiv ℝ h' (φ z))) (φ z) := by
      rw [← hh'φz] at hfydiff
      exact hfydiff.comp _ hh'diff.hasFDerivAt
    have hcomp2 : HasFDerivAt ((f ∘ h') ∘ φ)
        (((0 : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)).comp
          (fderiv ℝ h' (φ z))).comp (fderiv ℝ φ z)) z :=
      hcomp1.comp z hφdiff.hasFDerivAt
    have hzero : (((0 : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ h' (φ z))).comp (fderiv ℝ φ z)) = 0 := by
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_comp]
    rw [hzero] at hcomp2
    have hgderiv : fderiv ℝ g z = 0 := hcomp2.fderiv
    rw [hgderiv]
    exact not_surjective_zero
  exact measure_mono_null hincl (IH Ω₀ g hΩ₀open hgsm)

name: Submission.step1_local
statement:
theorem step1_local {U : Set (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ)} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {f : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ} (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U)
    (IH : ∀ (U' : Set (Fin n → ℝ)) (g : (Fin n → ℝ) → Fin q → ℝ),
      IsOpen U' → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g U' → volume (g '' critSet U' g) = 0)
    {x₀ : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ} (hx₀U : x₀ ∈ U) (hfd0 : fderiv ℝ f x₀ ≠ 0) :
    ∃ V ∈ 𝓝 x₀, volume (f '' (critSet U f ∩ V)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hv : ∃ v, fderiv ℝ f x₀ v ≠ 0 := by
    by_contra hall
    simp only [not_exists, not_not] at hall
    exact hfd0 (ContinuousLinearMap.ext hall)
  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := hv
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ : ∃ r, fderiv ℝ f x₀ v r ≠ 0 := Function.ne_iff.1 hv
  set σ : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) → ℝ := fun y => f y r with hσdef
  have hσsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ σ U :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj r :
      (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp_contDiffOn hf
  have hfdiffx₀ : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x₀ :=
    (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hx₀U)).differentiableAt infty_ne_zero
  have hσderiv : HasFDerivAt σ
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj r :
        (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ f x₀)) x₀ :=
    (ContinuousLinearMap.proj r :
      (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.comp x₀ hfdiffx₀.hasFDerivAt
  have hξv : ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj r :
      (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp (fderiv ℝ f x₀)) v ≠ 0 := by
    simpa using hr
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := exists_apply_single_ne_zero hξv
  have hd : fderiv ℝ σ x₀ (Pi.single s 1) ≠ 0 := by
    rw [hσderiv.fderiv]
    exact hs
  
  obtain ⟨V, W, h', hVopen, hWopen, hx₀V, hVU, h'sm, hmapsVW, hleft, hmapsWV,
    hright⟩ := exists_chart hU hσsm hx₀U hd
  
  set g : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun w => f (h' w) with hgdef
  have hgsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ g W :=
    hf.comp h'sm fun w hw => hVU (hmapsWV w hw)
  
  have hkey : ∀ w ∈ W, g w r = w s := by
    intro w hw
    have h1 := congrFun (hright w hw) s
    rw [Function.update_self] at h1
    exact h1
  
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, hballV⟩ : ∃ ρ > 0, closedBall x₀ ρ ⊆ V :=
    Metric.nhds_basis_closedBall.mem_iff.1 (hVopen.mem_nhds hx₀V)
  refine ⟨closedBall x₀ ρ, Metric.closedBall_mem_nhds x₀ hρ, ?_⟩
  set K₀ : Set (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) := critSet U f ∩ closedBall x₀ ρ with hK₀def
  have hK₀U : K₀ ⊆ U := fun y hy => hVU (hballV hy.2)
  have hK₀V : K₀ ⊆ V := fun y hy => hballV hy.2
  have hK₀cpt : IsCompact K₀ :=
    isCompact_critSet_inter hU hf (isCompact_closedBall x₀ ρ)
      fun y hy => hVU (hballV hy)
  
  set h : (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) → Fin (n + 1) → ℝ :=
    fun y => Function.update y s (σ y) with hhdef
  have hhsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ h U := by
    have h1 : h = fun y => y + (σ y - y s) • Pi.single s 1 := by
      funext y
      exact update_eq_add_smul_single y s (σ y)
    rw [h1]
    exact contDiffOn_id.add ((hσsm.sub ((ContinuousLinearMap.proj s :
      (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.contDiffOn)).smul contDiffOn_const)
  set S : Set (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) := h '' K₀ with hSdef
  have hScpt : IsCompact S :=
    hK₀cpt.image_of_continuousOn (hhsm.continuousOn.mono hK₀U)
  have hSW : S ⊆ W := by
    rintro _ ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩
    exact hmapsVW y (hK₀V hy)
  have hgh : ∀ y ∈ V, g (h y) = f y := by
    intro y hy
    rw [hgdef]
    show f (h' (Function.update y s (σ y))) = f y
    rw [hleft y hy]
  have himg : f '' K₀ = g '' S := by
    rw [hSdef, ← image_comp]
    exact image_congr fun y hy => (hgh y (hK₀V hy)).symm
  
  set A' : Set (ℝ × (Fin q → ℝ)) := (fun w => splitCLE q r (g w)) '' S
    with hA'def
  have hA'cpt : IsCompact A' :=
    hScpt.image_of_continuousOn
      ((splitCLE q r).continuous.comp_continuousOn (hgsm.continuousOn.mono hSW))
  
  have hslice : ∀ t : ℝ, volume (Prod.mk t ⁻¹' A') = 0 := by
    intro t
    set Ωt : Set (Fin n → ℝ) := {z | (splitCLE n s).symm (t, z) ∈ W}
      with hΩtdef
    have hΩtopen : IsOpen Ωt := by
      have hcont : Continuous fun z : Fin n → ℝ =>
          (splitCLE n s).symm (t, z) :=
        (splitCLE n s).symm.continuous.comp (continuous_const.prodMk
          continuous_id)
      exact hWopen.preimage hcont
    set gt : (Fin n → ℝ) → Fin q → ℝ :=
      fun z => Fin.removeNth r (g ((splitCLE n s).symm (t, z))) with hgtdef
    have hgtsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ gt Ωt := by
      have h1 : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞
          (fun z : Fin n → ℝ => g ((splitCLE n s).symm (t, z))) Ωt :=
        hgsm.comp (((splitCLE n s).symm.contDiff.comp
          (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)).contDiffOn) fun z hz => hz
      have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ => Fin.removeNth r w := by
        have h3 : (fun w : Fin (q + 1) → ℝ => Fin.removeNth r w)
            = fun w => (splitCLE q r w).2 := rfl
        rw [h3]
        exact contDiff_snd.comp (splitCLE q r).contDiff
      exact h2.comp_contDiffOn h1
    have hincl : Prod.mk t ⁻¹' A' ⊆ gt '' critSet Ωt gt := by
      intro y' hy'
      obtain ⟨w, hwS, hweq⟩ := hy'
      obtain ⟨y₁, hy₁K, rfl⟩ := hwS
      have hwW : h y₁ ∈ W := hSW ⟨y₁, hy₁K, rfl⟩
      have hy₁V : y₁ ∈ V := hK₀V hy₁K
      have hy₁U : y₁ ∈ U := hVU hy₁V
      have hgwr : g (h y₁) r = (h y₁) s := hkey _ hwW
      have ht' : g (h y₁) r = t := congrArg Prod.fst hweq
      have hy'eq : Fin.removeNth r (g (h y₁)) = y' := congrArg Prod.snd hweq
      set z : Fin n → ℝ := Fin.removeNth s (h y₁) with hzdef
      have hφz : (splitCLE n s).symm (t, z) = h y₁ := by
        rw [splitCLE_symm_apply]
        show Fin.insertNth s t (Fin.removeNth s (h y₁)) = h y₁
        rw [← ht', hgwr]
        exact Fin.insertNth_self_removeNth ..
      have hzΩt : z ∈ Ωt := by
        rw [hΩtdef, mem_setOf_eq, hφz]
        exact hwW
      have hgtz : gt z = y' := by
        rw [hgtdef]
        show Fin.removeNth r (g ((splitCLE n s).symm (t, z))) = y'
        rw [hφz]
        exact hy'eq
      refine ⟨z, ⟨hzΩt, ?_⟩, hgtz⟩
      
      intro hsurj
      apply hy₁K.1.2
      
      have hgdiffw : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (h y₁) :=
        (hgsm.contDiffAt (hWopen.mem_nhds hwW)).differentiableAt infty_ne_zero
      have hh'diffw : DifferentiableAt ℝ h' (h y₁) :=
        (h'sm.contDiffAt (hWopen.mem_nhds hwW)).differentiableAt infty_ne_zero
      have hfdiffy : DifferentiableAt ℝ f y₁ :=
        (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hy₁U)).differentiableAt infty_ne_zero
      
      set G : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ × (Fin q → ℝ) :=
        fun p => splitCLE q r (g ((splitCLE n s).symm p)) with hGdef
      set D : (ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ)) →L[ℝ] ℝ × (Fin q → ℝ) :=
        ((splitCLE q r : (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ × (Fin q → ℝ)).comp
          ((fderiv ℝ g (h y₁)).comp
            ((splitCLE n s).symm : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ))))
        with hDdef
      have hD : HasFDerivAt G D (t, z) := by
        have h1 : HasFDerivAt (splitCLE n s).symm
            ((splitCLE n s).symm : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) →L[ℝ] (Fin (n + 1) → ℝ))
            (t, z) := (splitCLE n s).symm.hasFDerivAt
        have h2 : HasFDerivAt g (fderiv ℝ g (h y₁))
            ((splitCLE n s).symm (t, z)) := by
          rw [hφz]
          exact hgdiffw.hasFDerivAt
        have h3 := h2.comp (t, z) h1
        have h4 : HasFDerivAt (splitCLE q r)
            (splitCLE q r : (Fin (q + 1) → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ × (Fin q → ℝ))
            (g ((splitCLE n s).symm (t, z))) := (splitCLE q r).hasFDerivAt
        exact h4.comp (t, z) h3
      
      have hfstD : ∀ ξ : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ), (D ξ).1 = ξ.1 := by
        have hmem : (splitCLE n s).symm ⁻¹' W ∈ 𝓝 ((t, z) : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ)) := by
          refine (hWopen.preimage (splitCLE n s).symm.continuous).mem_nhds ?_
          rw [mem_preimage, hφz]
          exact hwW
        have hev : (fun p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) => (G p).1)
            =ᶠ[𝓝 ((t, z) : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ))] fun p => p.1 := by
          filter_upwards [hmem] with p hp
          have h5 : (G p).1 = g ((splitCLE n s).symm p) r := rfl
          rw [h5, hkey _ hp, splitCLE_symm_apply]
          exact Fin.insertNth_apply_same ..
        have h6 : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) => (G p).1)
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (Fin q → ℝ)).comp D) (t, z) :=
          (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (Fin q → ℝ)).hasFDerivAt.comp (t, z) hD
        have h7 : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) => (G p).1)
            (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ (Fin n → ℝ)) (t, z) :=
          (hasFDerivAt_fst).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
        have h8 := h6.unique h7
        intro ξ
        have h9 := congrArg (fun L => L ξ) h8
        exact h9
      
      have hgtderiv : HasFDerivAt gt
          (((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (Fin q → ℝ)).comp D).comp
            (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ (Fin n → ℝ))) z := by
        have h10 : HasFDerivAt (fun p : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ) => (G p).2)
            ((ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (Fin q → ℝ)).comp D) (t, z) :=
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ (Fin q → ℝ)).hasFDerivAt.comp (t, z) hD
        exact h10.comp z (hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right t z)
      
      have hDsurj : Surjective D := by
        rintro ⟨a, b⟩
        obtain ⟨ζ, hζ⟩ := hsurj (b - (D (a, 0)).2)
        refine ⟨(a, ζ), ?_⟩
        have hsplitp : ((a, ζ) : ℝ × (Fin n → ℝ)) = (a, 0) + (0, ζ) := by
          simp
        rw [hsplitp, map_add]
        have h11 : (D ((0 : ℝ), ζ)).2 = fderiv ℝ gt z ζ := by
          rw [hgtderiv.fderiv]
          rfl
        have h12 : fderiv ℝ gt z ζ = b - (D (a, 0)).2 := hζ
        refine Prod.ext ?_ ?_
        · have ha1 : (D ((a : ℝ), (0 : Fin n → ℝ))).1 = a := hfstD (a, 0)
          have ha2 : (D ((0 : ℝ), ζ)).1 = 0 := hfstD (0, ζ)
          simp [ha1, ha2]
        · simp only [Prod.snd_add, h11, h12]
          abel
      
      have hgsurj : Surjective (fderiv ℝ g (h y₁)) := by
        intro c
        obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ := hDsurj (splitCLE q r c)
        refine ⟨(splitCLE n s).symm ξ, ?_⟩
        have h13 : D ξ = splitCLE q r
            (fderiv ℝ g (h y₁) ((splitCLE n s).symm ξ)) := rfl
        rw [h13] at hξ
        exact (splitCLE q r).injective hξ
      
      have hh'w : h' (h y₁) = y₁ := hleft y₁ hy₁V
      have hcomp : fderiv ℝ g (h y₁)
          = (fderiv ℝ f y₁).comp (fderiv ℝ h' (h y₁)) := by
        have h14 : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f y₁) (h' (h y₁)) := by
          rw [hh'w]
          exact hfdiffy.hasFDerivAt
        exact (h14.comp (h y₁) hh'diffw.hasFDerivAt).fderiv
      rw [hcomp] at hgsurj
      have h15 : ⇑((fderiv ℝ f y₁).comp (fderiv ℝ h' (h y₁)))
          = ⇑(fderiv ℝ f y₁) ∘ ⇑(fderiv ℝ h' (h y₁)) := rfl
      rw [h15] at hgsurj
      exact hgsurj.of_comp
    exact measure_mono_null hincl (IH Ωt gt hΩtopen hgtsm)
  
  have hprod : volume A' = 0 := by
    rw [Measure.volume_eq_prod]
    rw [Measure.measure_prod_null hA'cpt.measurableSet]
    exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall hslice
  have hgS : volume (g '' S) = 0 := by
    refine splitCLE_image_null r ?_ hprod
    rw [hA'def, ← image_comp]
    exact Subset.rfl
  show volume (f '' K₀) = 0
  rw [himg]
  exact hgS

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.CompactMoveKit.reducePos
statement:
theorem reducePos (K : CompactMoveKit m state) :
    ∀ (P N : MorseLedger),
      Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (state P N).sign
        (state (MorseLedger.canonical P.delta) N).sign)
  | [], N => by
      rw [MorseLedger.delta_nil, MorseLedger.canonical_zero]
      exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_refl _
  | [beta], N => by
      rcases (by decide : ∀ b : ZMod 2, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) beta with rfl | rfl
      · have h : MorseLedger.canonical
            (MorseLedger.delta [(0 : ZMod 2)]) = [0]
proof:
:= by decide
        rw [h]
        exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_refl _
      · have h : MorseLedger.canonical
            (MorseLedger.delta [(1 : ZMod 2)]) = [] := by decide
        rw [h]
        simpa using (K.deathPos [] [] N).nonempty_cobordism
  | beta₁ :: beta₂ :: tail, N => by
      rcases (by decide : ∀ b : ZMod 2, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) beta₁ with rfl | rfl
      · rcases (by decide : ∀ b : ZMod 2, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) beta₂ with rfl | rfl
        · have hsaddle :=
            (K.zeroSaddlePos [] tail N).nonempty_cobordism
          have hdeath := (K.deathPos [] tail N).nonempty_cobordism
          have htail := reducePos K tail N
          have hdelta :
              MorseLedger.delta ((0 : ZMod 2) :: 0 :: tail) =
                MorseLedger.delta tail := by
            simp only [MorseLedger.delta_cons, zero_add]
            have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
            calc
              1 + (1 + MorseLedger.delta tail) =
                  (1 + 1) + MorseLedger.delta tail := by abel
              _ = MorseLedger.delta tail := by rw [h11, zero_add]
          rw [hdelta]
          exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hsaddle
            (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hdeath htail)
        · have hdeath := (K.deathPos [0] tail N).nonempty_cobordism
          have htail := reducePos K ((0 : ZMod 2) :: tail) N
          have hdelta :
              MorseLedger.delta ((0 : ZMod 2) :: 1 :: tail) =
                MorseLedger.delta ((0 : ZMod 2) :: tail) := by
            simp only [MorseLedger.delta_cons, zero_add]
            have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
            rw [h11, zero_add]
          rw [hdelta]
          exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hdeath htail
      · rcases (by decide : ∀ b : ZMod 2, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) beta₂ with rfl | rfl
        · have hdeath :=
            (K.deathPos [] ((0 : ZMod 2) :: tail) N).nonempty_cobordism
          have htail := reducePos K ((0 : ZMod 2) :: tail) N
          have hdelta :
              MorseLedger.delta ((1 : ZMod 2) :: 0 :: tail) =
                MorseLedger.delta ((0 : ZMod 2) :: tail) := by
            simp only [MorseLedger.delta_cons]
            have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
            simp only [h11, zero_add]
          rw [hdelta]
          exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hdeath htail
        · have hsaddle :=
            (K.oneSaddlePos [] tail N).nonempty_cobordism
          have hdeath := (K.deathPos [] tail N).nonempty_cobordism
          have htail := reducePos K tail N
          have hdelta :
              MorseLedger.delta ((1 : ZMod 2) :: 1 :: tail) =
                MorseLedger.delta tail := by
            simp only [MorseLedger.delta_cons]
            have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
            simp only [h11, zero_add]
          rw [hdelta]
          exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hsaddle
            (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hdeath htail)
  termination_by P _ => P.length
  decreasing_by all_goals simp_all

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.CompactMoveKit.reduceNeg
statement:
theorem reduceNeg (K : CompactMoveKit m state) :
    ∀ (P N : MorseLedger),
      Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (state P N).sign
        (state P (MorseLedger.canonical N.delta)).sign)
  | P, [] => by
      rw [MorseLedger.delta_nil, MorseLedger.canonical_zero]
      exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_refl _
  | P, [beta] => by
      rcases (by decide : ∀ b : ZMod 2, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) beta with rfl | rfl
      · have h : MorseLedger.canonical
            (MorseLedger.delta [(0 : ZMod 2)]) = [0]
proof:
:= by decide
        rw [h]
        exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_refl _
      · have h : MorseLedger.canonical
            (MorseLedger.delta [(1 : ZMod 2)]) = [] := by decide
        rw [h]
        simpa using (K.deathNeg P [] []).nonempty_cobordism
  | P, beta₁ :: beta₂ :: tail => by
      rcases (by decide : ∀ b : ZMod 2, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) beta₁ with rfl | rfl
      · rcases (by decide : ∀ b : ZMod 2, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) beta₂ with rfl | rfl
        · have hsaddle :=
            (K.zeroSaddleNeg P [] tail).nonempty_cobordism
          have hdeath := (K.deathNeg P [] tail).nonempty_cobordism
          have htail := reduceNeg K P tail
          have hdelta :
              MorseLedger.delta ((0 : ZMod 2) :: 0 :: tail) =
                MorseLedger.delta tail := by
            simp only [MorseLedger.delta_cons, zero_add]
            have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
            calc
              1 + (1 + MorseLedger.delta tail) =
                  (1 + 1) + MorseLedger.delta tail := by abel
              _ = MorseLedger.delta tail := by rw [h11, zero_add]
          rw [hdelta]
          exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hsaddle
            (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hdeath htail)
        · have hdeath := (K.deathNeg P [0] tail).nonempty_cobordism
          have htail := reduceNeg K P ((0 : ZMod 2) :: tail)
          have hdelta :
              MorseLedger.delta ((0 : ZMod 2) :: 1 :: tail) =
                MorseLedger.delta ((0 : ZMod 2) :: tail) := by
            simp only [MorseLedger.delta_cons, zero_add]
            have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
            rw [h11, zero_add]
          rw [hdelta]
          exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hdeath htail
      · rcases (by decide : ∀ b : ZMod 2, b = 0 ∨ b = 1) beta₂ with rfl | rfl
        · have hdeath :=
            (K.deathNeg P [] ((0 : ZMod 2) :: tail)).nonempty_cobordism
          have htail := reduceNeg K P ((0 : ZMod 2) :: tail)
          have hdelta :
              MorseLedger.delta ((1 : ZMod 2) :: 0 :: tail) =
                MorseLedger.delta ((0 : ZMod 2) :: tail) := by
            simp only [MorseLedger.delta_cons]
            have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
            rw [h11, zero_add]
          rw [hdelta]
          exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hdeath htail
        · have hsaddle :=
            (K.oneSaddleNeg P [] tail).nonempty_cobordism
          have hdeath := (K.deathNeg P [] tail).nonempty_cobordism
          have htail := reduceNeg K P tail
          have hdelta :
              MorseLedger.delta ((1 : ZMod 2) :: 1 :: tail) =
                MorseLedger.delta tail := by
            simp only [MorseLedger.delta_cons]
            have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
            simp only [h11, zero_add]
          rw [hdelta]
          exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hsaddle
            (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hdeath htail)
  termination_by _ N => N.length
  decreasing_by all_goals simp_all

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.ReductionData.nonempty_reduction
statement:
theorem nonempty_reduction (D : ReductionData m S P G) :
    Nonempty
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism (G.endpointSign S)
        (ConcreteConfigurationMoveKit.configSign m
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m S)
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.negativeLedger m S)))
proof:
:= by
  let PL := ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m S
  let NL := ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.negativeLedger m S
  have hpos := D.moves.reducePos PL NL
  have hneg := D.moves.reduceNeg (MorseLedger.canonical PL.delta) NL
  exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
    D.initial.nonempty_cobordism
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hpos
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans hneg
        D.final.nonempty_cobordism))

name: Submission.TamedField.continuousCurve_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem continuousCurve_mem_orbit {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    (γ : ℝ → E) (hγ : Continuous γ) (hγfiber : ∀ t, γ t ∈ X.fiber)
    (t : ℝ) : γ t ∈ V.orbit (γ 0)
proof:
:= by
  let A : Set ℝ := γ ⁻¹' V.orbit (γ 0)
  have hp : γ 0 ∈ X.fiber := hγfiber 0
  have hAS : A ⊆ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _
  have hAclosed : IsClosed A := (V.isCompact_orbit hp).isClosed.preimage hγ
  have hAopen : ∀ s ∈ A, ∃ r > 0, (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ∩ Metric.ball s r ⊆ A := by
    intro s hs
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrsub⟩ := V.orbit_isOpen_in_fiber hp hs
    have hopen : IsOpen (γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (γ s) r) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage hγ
    have hsmem : s ∈ γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (γ s) r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen s hsmem
    refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
    rintro u ⟨-, hus⟩
    exact hrsub ⟨hγfiber u, hεsub hus⟩
  have hA0 : A.Nonempty := ⟨0, V.mem_orbit_self (γ 0)⟩
  have hAll : (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ⊆ A :=
    subset_of_relOpen_closed isPreconnected_univ hAS hAclosed hAopen hA0
  exact hAll (Set.mem_univ t)

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phase
statement:
theorem orbitCircleHomeomorph_phase (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (u : I) :
    V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp (P.phase u) = P.orbitPath u
proof:
:= by
  exact (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp).apply_symm_apply _

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phase_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem phase_zero (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) : P.phase 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp).injective
  rw [P.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phase]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change P.curve 0 = V.flow P.p 0
  rw [P.curve_zero, V.flow_zero]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phase_closed
statement:
theorem phase_closed (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    P.phase 0 = P.phase 1
proof:
:= by
  apply (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp).injective
  rw [P.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phase, P.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phase]
  apply Subtype.ext
  exact P.curve_closed

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phase_eq_cases
proof:
:= by
  apply P.curve_eq_cases
  have h := congrArg (V.orbitCircleHomeomorph P.hp) huv
  rw [P.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phase, P.orbitCircleHomeomorph_phase] at h
  exact congrArg Subtype.val h

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLift_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem phaseLift_zero (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    P.phaseLift 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold phaseLift
  apply IsCoveringMap.liftPath_zero

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLift_coe
statement:
theorem phaseLift_coe (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (u : I) :
    ((P.phaseLift u : ℝ) : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)) = P.phase u
proof:
:= by
  let T := V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp
  letI : Fact (0 < T) := ⟨V.fundamentalPeriod_pos P.hp⟩
  have h := congrFun
    ((AddCircle.isCoveringMap_coe T).liftPath_lifts P.phase 0 P.phase_zero) u
  simpa [phaseLift, T] using h

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLift_endpoint_zsmul
statement:
theorem phaseLift_endpoint_zsmul (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, P.phaseLift 1 = z • V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp
proof:
:= by
  let T := V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp
  have hcoe : ((P.phaseLift 1 : ℝ) : AddCircle T) = 0 := by
    calc
      ((P.phaseLift 1 : ℝ) : AddCircle T) = P.phase 1 := P.phaseLift_coe 1
      _ = P.phase 0 := P.phase_closed.symm
      _ = 0 := P.phase_zero
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff T).mp hcoe
  exact ⟨z, hz.symm⟩

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLift_one_ne_zero
statement:
theorem phaseLift_one_ne_zero (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    P.phaseLift 1 ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  let ψ := P.phaseLift
  let φ := P.phase
  let c : I := ⟨(1 / 2 : ℝ), by constructor <;> norm_num⟩
  have hc0 : (0 : I) < c := by change (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2; norm_num
  have hc1 : c < (1 : I) := by change (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1; norm_num
  have hφc : φ c ≠ φ 0 := by
    intro h
    rcases P.phase_eq_cases h with hEq | hEnds | hEnds
    · exact (ne_of_gt hc0) hEq
    · exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : I) ≠ 1) hEnds.2
    · exact (ne_of_lt hc1) hEnds.1
  have hψc : ψ c ≠ 0 := by
    intro hzero
    apply hφc
    calc
      φ c = ((ψ c : ℝ) : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)) :=
        (P.phaseLift_coe c).symm
      _ = ((ψ 0 : ℝ) : AddCircle (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)) := by
        rw [hzero, P.phaseLift_zero]
      _ = φ 0 := P.phaseLift_coe 0
  intro hψ1
  have hcont : Continuous ψ := P.phaseLift.continuous
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hψc with hneg | hpos
  · let z : ℝ := ψ c / 2
    have hzL : z ∈ Icc (ψ c) (ψ 0) := by
      rw [P.phaseLift_zero]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨u, huI, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (le_of_lt hc0)
      hcont.continuousOn hzL
    have hzR : z ∈ Icc (ψ c) (ψ 1) := by
      rw [hψ1]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨v, hvI, hv⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (le_of_lt hc1)
      hcont.continuousOn hzR
    have hphase : φ u = φ v := by
      rw [← P.phaseLift_coe u, ← P.phaseLift_coe v, hu, hv]
    rcases P.phase_eq_cases hphase with huv | hends | hends
    · subst v
      have : u = c := le_antisymm huI.2 hvI.1
      subst u
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1, P.phaseLift_zero] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1, hψ1] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
  · let z : ℝ := ψ c / 2
    have hzL : z ∈ Icc (ψ 0) (ψ c) := by
      rw [P.phaseLift_zero]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨u, huI, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc (le_of_lt hc0)
      hcont.continuousOn hzL
    have hzR : z ∈ Icc (ψ 1) (ψ c) := by
      rw [hψ1]
      constructor <;> dsimp [z] <;> linarith
    obtain ⟨v, hvI, hv⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' (le_of_lt hc1)
      hcont.continuousOn hzR
    have hphase : φ u = φ v := by
      rw [← P.phaseLift_coe u, ← P.phaseLift_coe v, hu, hv]
    rcases P.phase_eq_cases hphase with huv | hends | hends
    · subst v
      have : u = c := le_antisymm huI.2 hvI.1
      subst u
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1, P.phaseLift_zero] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith
    · rw [hends.1, hψ1] at hu
      dsimp [z] at hu
      linarith

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLift_injective
statement:
theorem phaseLift_injective (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    Function.Injective P.phaseLift
proof:
:= by
  intro u v huv
  have hphase : P.phase u = P.phase v := by
    rw [← P.phaseLift_coe u, ← P.phaseLift_coe v, huv]
  rcases P.phase_eq_cases hphase with hEq | hEnds | hEnds
  · exact hEq
  · exfalso
    apply P.phaseLift_one_ne_zero
    rw [← hEnds.2, ← huv, hEnds.1, P.phaseLift_zero]
  · exfalso
    apply P.phaseLift_one_ne_zero
    rw [← hEnds.1, huv, hEnds.2, P.phaseLift_zero]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.phaseLift_one_eq_period_or_neg
statement:
theorem phaseLift_one_eq_period_or_neg (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    P.phaseLift 1 = V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp ∨
      P.phaseLift 1 = -V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp
proof:
:= by
  let ψ := P.phaseLift
  let φ := P.phase
  let T := V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp
  have hT : 0 < T := V.fundamentalPeriod_pos P.hp
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := P.phaseLift_endpoint_zsmul
  have hzR : ψ 1 = (z : ℝ) * T := by
    simpa [ψ, T, zsmul_eq_mul] using hz
  have hmonoanti := P.phaseLift.continuous.strictMono_of_inj_boundedOrder'
    P.phaseLift_injective
  rcases hmonoanti with hmono | hanti
  · have hψ1pos : 0 < ψ 1 := by
      have h := hmono (show (0 : I) < 1 by norm_num)
      rwa [P.phaseLift_zero] at h
    have hzposR : (0 : ℝ) < (z : ℝ) := by nlinarith
    have hzpos : (0 : ℤ) < z := by exact_mod_cast hzposR
    have hzle : z ≤ 1 := by
      by_contra hznot
      have hzge : (2 : ℤ) ≤ z := by omega
      have hzgeR : (2 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hzge
      have hmem : T ∈ Icc (ψ 0) (ψ 1) := by
        rw [P.phaseLift_zero, hzR]
        constructor <;> nlinarith
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (0 : I) (1 : I)
        P.phaseLift.continuous hmem
      have hphase : φ u = φ 0 := by
        rw [← P.phaseLift_coe u, ← P.phaseLift_coe 0, hu, P.phaseLift_zero]
        exact AddCircle.coe_period T
      rcases P.phase_eq_cases hphase with hu0 | hbad | hu1
      · rw [hu0, P.phaseLift_zero] at hu
        linarith
      · exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : I) ≠ 1) hbad.2
      · rw [hu1.1, hzR] at hu
        nlinarith
    have hzone : z = 1 := by omega
    left
    simpa [T, hzone] using hzR
  · have hψ1neg : ψ 1 < 0 := by
      have h := hanti (show (0 : I) < 1 by norm_num)
      rwa [P.phaseLift_zero] at h
    have hznegR : (z : ℝ) < 0 := by nlinarith
    have hzneg : z < (0 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hznegR
    have hzge : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ z := by
      by_contra hznot
      have hzle : z ≤ (-2 : ℤ) := by omega
      have hzleR : (z : ℝ) ≤ -2 := by exact_mod_cast hzle
      have hmem : -T ∈ Icc (ψ 1) (ψ 0) := by
        rw [P.phaseLift_zero, hzR]
        constructor <;> nlinarith
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (1 : I) (0 : I)
        P.phaseLift.continuous hmem
      have hphase : φ u = φ 0 := by
        rw [← P.phaseLift_coe u, ← P.phaseLift_coe 0, hu, P.phaseLift_zero]
        rw [AddCircle.coe_neg, AddCircle.coe_period, neg_zero]
        rfl
      rcases P.phase_eq_cases hphase with hu0 | hbad | hu1
      · rw [hu0, P.phaseLift_zero] at hu
        linarith
      · exact (zero_ne_one : (0 : I) ≠ 1) hbad.2
      · rw [hu1.1, hzR] at hu
        nlinarith
    have hzmone : z = -1 := by omega
    right
    simpa [T, hzmone] using hzR

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.paramFrameLoop_closed
statement:
theorem paramFrameLoop_closed (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    P.paramFrameLoop 0 = P.paramFrameLoop 1
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.orientedFrameLoop_one
statement:
theorem orientedFrameLoop_one (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    P.orientedFrameLoop 1 = V.fundamentalFrameLoop P.hp
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop _ _ (1 * (u : ℝ) * _) = frameLoop _ _ ((u : ℝ) * _)
  congr 2
  ring

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.orientedFrameLoop_neg_one
statement:
theorem orientedFrameLoop_neg_one (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    P.orientedFrameLoop (-1) = reverseLoop (V.fundamentalFrameLoop P.hp)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  let F := fun t : ℝ => frameLoop X (V.flow P.p) t
  have hper : Function.Periodic F (V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp) :=
    frameLoop_periodic _ (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic P.hp)
  change F ((-1 : ℝ) * (u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp) =
    F ((unitInterval.symm u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)
  have h := hper ((-1 : ℝ) * (u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)
  rw [show (unitInterval.symm u : ℝ) = 1 - (u : ℝ) by rfl]
  convert h.symm using 1 <;> ring

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.liftedFrameLoop_closed
statement:

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.frameReparamHomotopy_closed
statement:
theorem frameReparamHomotopy_closed (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (ε : ℝ)
    (hend : P.phaseLift 1 = ε * V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)
    (hperiod : Function.Periodic (fun t : ℝ => frameLoop X (V.flow P.p) t)
      (ε * V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)) (s : I) :
    P.frameReparamHomotopy ε (s, 0) = P.frameReparamHomotopy ε (s, 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  let T := V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp
  let F := fun t : ℝ => frameLoop X (V.flow P.p) t
  change F ((1 - (s : ℝ)) * P.phaseLift 0 +
      (s : ℝ) * (ε * (((0 : I) : ℝ)) * T)) =
    F ((1 - (s : ℝ)) * P.phaseLift 1 +
      (s : ℝ) * (ε * (((1 : I) : ℝ)) * T))
  rw [P.phaseLift_zero, hend]
  norm_num
  change F 0 = F ((1 - (s : ℝ)) * (ε * T) + (s : ℝ) * (ε * T))
  rw [show (1 - (s : ℝ)) * (ε * T) + (s : ℝ) * (ε * T) =
    ε * T by ring]
  simpa [F, T] using (hperiod 0).symm

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.orientedFrameLoop_closed
statement:
theorem orientedFrameLoop_closed (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (ε : ℝ)
    (hperiod : Function.Periodic (fun t : ℝ => frameLoop X (V.flow P.p) t)
      (ε * V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp)) :
    P.orientedFrameLoop ε 0 = P.orientedFrameLoop ε 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop _ _ (ε * (((0 : I) : ℝ)) * _) =
    frameLoop _ _ (ε * (((1 : I) : ℝ)) * _)
  norm_num
  convert (hperiod 0).symm using 1 <;> ring

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental
statement:
theorem paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    loopClassZ2 P.paramFrameLoop P.paramFrameLoop_closed =
      V.fundamentalFrameClass P.hp
proof:
:= by
  let T := V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp
  let F := fun t : ℝ => frameLoop X (V.flow P.p) t
  have hper : Function.Periodic F T :=
    frameLoop_periodic _ (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic P.hp)
  have hloop := P.paramFrameLoop_eq_lifted
  rcases P.phaseLift_one_eq_period_or_neg with hplus | hminus
  · have hend : P.phaseLift 1 = (1 : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp := by
      simpa using hplus
    have hclosed := P.frameReparamHomotopy_closed 1 hend
      (by simpa [F, T] using hper)
    have horientedClosed := P.orientedFrameLoop_closed 1
      (by simpa [F, T] using hper)
    calc
      loopClassZ2 P.paramFrameLoop P.paramFrameLoop_closed =
          loopClassZ2 P.liftedFrameLoop P.liftedFrameLoop_closed :=
        loopClassZ2_congr_fun P.paramFrameLoop_closed P.liftedFrameLoop_closed hloop
      _ = loopClassZ2 (P.orientedFrameLoop 1) horientedClosed :=
        loopClassZ2_congr P.liftedFrameLoop_closed horientedClosed
          (P.frameReparamHomotopy 1) hclosed
      _ = V.fundamentalFrameClass P.hp := by
        unfold TamedField.fundamentalFrameClass
        exact loopClassZ2_congr_fun horientedClosed
          (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed P.hp) P.orientedFrameLoop_one
  · have hend : P.phaseLift 1 = (-1 : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod P.hp := by
      simpa using hminus
    have hclosed := P.frameReparamHomotopy_closed (-1) hend
      (by simpa [F, T] using hper.neg)
    have horientedClosed := P.orientedFrameLoop_closed (-1)
      (by simpa [F, T] using hper.neg)
    calc
      loopClassZ2 P.paramFrameLoop P.paramFrameLoop_closed =
          loopClassZ2 P.liftedFrameLoop P.liftedFrameLoop_closed :=
        loopClassZ2_congr_fun P.paramFrameLoop_closed P.liftedFrameLoop_closed hloop
      _ = loopClassZ2 (P.orientedFrameLoop (-1)) horientedClosed :=
        loopClassZ2_congr P.liftedFrameLoop_closed horientedClosed
          (P.frameReparamHomotopy (-1)) hclosed
      _ = loopClassZ2 (reverseLoop (V.fundamentalFrameLoop P.hp))
          (reverseLoop_closed (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed P.hp)) := by
        exact loopClassZ2_congr_fun horientedClosed
          (reverseLoop_closed (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed P.hp))
          P.orientedFrameLoop_neg_one
      _ = V.fundamentalFrameClass P.hp := by
        exact loopClassZ2_reverse (V.fundamentalFrameLoop P.hp)
          (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed P.hp)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.range_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_mono
statement:
theorem range_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_mono (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (b : SaddleBranch) {ρ₁ ρ₂ a : ℝ} (hs0 : a ≠ 0)
    (hρ₁ : 0 < ρ₁) (ha₁ : a ^ 2 < ρ₁ ^ 2) (hρ₁rad : ρ₁ < T.radius)
    (hρ₂ : 0 < ρ₂) (ha₂ : a ^ 2 < ρ₂ ^ 2) (hρ₂rad : ρ₂ < T.radius)
    (hle : ρ₁ ≤ ρ₂) :
    Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ₁ a hρ₁ ha₁ hρ₁rad) ⊆
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ₂ a hρ₂ ha₂ hρ₂rad)
proof:
:= by
  rintro x ⟨u, rfl⟩
  have hx : T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ₁ a hρ₁ ha₁ hρ₁rad u =
      spacePart (M.param (saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ₁ a u)) := rfl
  rw [hx]
  refine T.spacePart_param_mem_range_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_of_norm_le b
    ρ₂ a hρ₂ ha₂ hρ₂rad _ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact morseQuadratic_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc b a _
  · exact signedBranch_saddleNegativeSegmentParam_apply_one_pos b hs0 u
  · exact (norm_saddleNegativeSegmentParam_le b hρ₁ ha₁ u).trans hle

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchBase_mem_range_segment
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveBranchBase_mem_range_segment (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    (b : SaddleBranch) {ρ₁ ρ₂ a : ℝ} (hs0 : a ≠ 0)
    (hρ₁ : 0 < ρ₁) (ha₁ : a ^ 2 < ρ₁ ^ 2)
    (hρ₂ : 0 < ρ₂) (ha₂ : a ^ 2 < ρ₂ ^ 2) (hρ₂rad : ρ₂ < T.radius)
    (hle : ρ₁ ≤ ρ₂) :

      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ₂ a hρ₂ ha₂ hρ₂rad)
proof:

      M.param (saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b .negative ρ₁ a) := rfl

  refine T.spacePart_param_mem_range_saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_of_norm_le b
    ρ₂ a hρ₂ ha₂ hρ₂rad _ ?_ ?_ ?_
  · exact morseQuadratic_pairToMorseParam_saddlePositiveArc b a _
  · exact (saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam_quadrant b .negative hs0 ha₁).1
  · rw [norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam b .negative hρ₁ ha₁]
    exact hle

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le
statement:
theorem saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (b : SaddleBranch)
    {ρ₁ ρ₂ a : ℝ} (hs0 : a ≠ 0)
    (hρ₁ : 0 < ρ₁) (ha₁ : a ^ 2 < ρ₁ ^ 2) (hρ₁rad : ρ₁ < T.radius)
    (hρ₂ : 0 < ρ₂) (ha₂ : a ^ 2 < ρ₂ ^ 2) (hρ₂rad : ρ₂ < T.radius)
    (hle : ρ₁ ≤ ρ₂)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice a hreg)) :
    T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ₁ a hρ₁ ha₁ hρ₁rad hreg V =
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ₂ a hρ₂ ha₂ hρ₂rad hreg V
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := T.saddleNegativeBranchBase_mem_range_segment b hs0 hρ₁ ha₁
    hρ₂ ha₂ hρ₂rad hle
  have hmem := T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_mem_branchOrbit hindex b ρ₂ a
    hρ₂ ha₂ hρ₂rad hreg V u
  rw [← V.orbitPoint_orbit
    (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ₂ a hρ₂ ha₂ hρ₂rad hreg V),
    hu] at hmem
  have hmem' : spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase b ρ₁ a) ∈
      V.orbit (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase b ρ₂ a)) := hmem
  exact Subtype.ext (V.orbit_eq_of_mem hmem')

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_paramRadius_ball
statement:
theorem exists_paramRadius_ball (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r < T.radius ∧
      ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ ≤ r →
        dist (M.param u) center < δ
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : ContinuousAt M.param 0 :=
    (T.param_differentiableAt 0 (by simpa using T.radius_pos)).continuousAt
  have hmet := Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont δ hδ
  obtain ⟨δ', hδ', hball⟩ := hmet
  have hrp : 0 < T.radius := T.radius_pos
  refine ⟨min (δ' / 2) (T.radius / 2), lt_min (by linarith) (by linarith),
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith), ?_⟩
  intro u hu
  have hu' : dist u 0 < δ' := by
    rw [dist_zero_right]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hu.trans (min_le_left _ _)) (by linarith)
  have h := hball hu'
  rwa [M.param_zero] at h

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_smallRadius_cover
statement:
theorem exists_smallRadius_cover (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) {ρ' ρ eps : ℝ}
    (hρ' : 0 < ρ') (hlt : ρ' < ρ) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius) (heps : 0 < eps)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v) :
    ∃ eps' : ℝ, 0 < eps' ∧ eps' ≤ eps ∧
      ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
        dist v center < eps' → C.G v = 0 →
        ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ' ∧ M.param u = v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
    {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) | ρ' ≤ ‖u‖} ∩
      {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) | ‖u‖ ≤ ρ} with hK
  have hKclosed : IsClosed K :=
    (isClosed_le continuous_const continuous_norm).inter
      (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const)
  have hKcomp : IsCompact K :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ρ).of_isClosed_subset
      hKclosed (fun u hu => by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]; exact hu.2)
  have hKne : K.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) ρ', ?_, ?_⟩
    · show ρ' ≤ ‖EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) ρ'‖
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_single, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hρ']
    · show ‖EuclideanSpace.single (0 : Fin 2) ρ'‖ ≤ ρ
      rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_single, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hρ']
      exact hlt.le
  have hcontOn : ContinuousOn
      (fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => dist (M.param u) center) K := by
    intro u hu
    have hnorm : ‖u‖ ≤ ρ := hu.2
    have h1 : ContinuousAt
        (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => dist (M.param z) center) u :=
      Filter.Tendsto.dist
        (T.param_differentiableAt u (lt_of_le_of_lt hnorm hρrad)).continuousAt
        tendsto_const_nhds
    exact h1.continuousWithinAt
  obtain ⟨u₀, hu₀K, hu₀min⟩ := hKcomp.exists_isMinOn hKne hcontOn
  have hball : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖w‖ ≤ ρ →
      w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    intro w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hw.trans_lt hρrad
  have hzeroball : (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) ∈
      Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_self]
    exact T.radius_pos
  have hu₀ne : u₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have : ρ' ≤ ‖u₀‖ := hu₀K.1
    rw [h, norm_zero] at this
    linarith
  have hdpos : 0 < dist (M.param u₀) center := by
    rw [dist_pos]
    intro hEq
    apply hu₀ne
    apply T.param_injOn (hball _ hu₀K.2) hzeroball
    rw [hEq, M.param_zero]
  refine ⟨min eps (dist (M.param u₀) center), lt_min heps hdpos,
    min_le_left _ _, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hfib
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := hcover v (lt_of_lt_of_le hv (min_le_left _ _)) hfib
  refine ⟨u, ?_, hup⟩
  by_contra hnot
  rw [not_lt] at hnot
  have huK : u ∈ K := ⟨hnot, hu.le⟩
  have hmin : dist (M.param u₀) center ≤ dist (M.param u) center :=
    hu₀min huK
  rw [hup] at hmin
  have := lt_of_lt_of_le hv (min_le_right eps (dist (M.param u₀) center))
  linarith

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.le_dist_of_cover_of_norm_eq
statement:
theorem le_dist_of_cover_of_norm_eq (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) {ρ eps : ℝ}
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} (hw : ‖w‖ = ρ)
    (hfib : C.G (M.param w) = 0) :
    eps ≤ dist (M.param w) center
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  rw [not_le] at hlt
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := hcover (M.param w) hlt hfib
  have hball : ∀ z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖z‖ ≤ ρ →
      z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    intro z hz
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hz.trans_lt hρrad
  have : u = w := T.param_injOn (hball _ hu.le) (hball _ hw.le) hup
  rw [this, hw] at hu
  exact lt_irrefl _ hu

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.le_dist_saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_of_cover
statement:
theorem le_dist_saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_of_cover (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)

    eps ≤ dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b e ρ a) center
proof:

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.le_dist_saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_of_cover
statement:

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_localRadius_cover
statement:
theorem exists_localRadius_cover (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    {u₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} {R r₀ margin : ℝ}
    (hR : R < T.radius) (hu₀ : ‖u₀‖ ≤ R) (hr₀ : 0 < r₀) (hmargin : 0 < margin)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v (M.param u₀) < margin → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < R ∧ M.param u = v) :
    ∃ margin' : ℝ, 0 < margin' ∧ margin' ≤ margin ∧
      ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
        dist v (M.param u₀) < margin' → C.G v = 0 →
        ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < R ∧ dist u u₀ < r₀ ∧
          M.param u = v
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set K : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
    {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) | ‖u‖ ≤ R} ∩
      {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) | r₀ ≤ dist u u₀} with hK
  have hKclosed : IsClosed K :=
    (isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const).inter
      (isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const))
  have hKcomp : IsCompact K :=
    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) R).of_isClosed_subset
      hKclosed (fun u hu => by
        rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]; exact hu.1)
  have hball : ∀ w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖w‖ ≤ R →
      w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    intro w hw
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hw.trans_lt hR
  rcases K.eq_empty_or_nonempty with hKe | hKne
  · refine ⟨margin, hmargin, le_rfl, ?_⟩
    intro v hv hfib
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := hcover v hv hfib
    refine ⟨u, hu, ?_, hup⟩
    by_contra hnot
    rw [not_lt] at hnot
    have : u ∈ K := ⟨hu.le, hnot⟩
    rw [hKe] at this
    exact this
  · have hcontOn : ContinuousOn
        (fun u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
          dist (M.param u) (M.param u₀)) K := by
      intro u hu
      have hnorm : ‖u‖ ≤ R := hu.1
      have h1 : ContinuousAt
          (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) =>
            dist (M.param z) (M.param u₀)) u :=
        Filter.Tendsto.dist
          (T.param_differentiableAt u (lt_of_le_of_lt hnorm hR)).continuousAt
          tendsto_const_nhds
      exact h1.continuousWithinAt
    obtain ⟨w₀, hw₀K, hw₀min⟩ := hKcomp.exists_isMinOn hKne hcontOn
    have hw₀ne : w₀ ≠ u₀ := by
      intro h
      have h2 : r₀ ≤ dist w₀ u₀ := hw₀K.2
      rw [h, dist_self] at h2
      linarith
    have hdpos : 0 < dist (M.param w₀) (M.param u₀) := by
      rw [dist_pos]
      intro hEq
      exact hw₀ne (T.param_injOn (hball _ hw₀K.1) (hball _ hu₀) hEq)
    refine ⟨min margin (dist (M.param w₀) (M.param u₀)),
      lt_min hmargin hdpos, min_le_left _ _, ?_⟩
    intro v hv hfib
    obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ :=
      hcover v (lt_of_lt_of_le hv (min_le_left _ _)) hfib
    refine ⟨u, hu, ?_, hup⟩
    by_contra hnot
    rw [not_lt] at hnot
    have huK : u ∈ K := ⟨hu.le, hnot⟩
    have hmin : dist (M.param w₀) (M.param u₀) ≤
        dist (M.param u) (M.param u₀) := hw₀min huK
    rw [hup] at hmin
    have := lt_of_lt_of_le hv
      (min_le_right margin (dist (M.param w₀) (M.param u₀)))
    linarith

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.le_dist_of_saddleNegativeBranchOrbit_not_mem_segment
statement:
theorem le_dist_of_saddleNegativeBranchOrbit_not_mem_segment
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (b : SaddleBranch)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hreg))
    (hne : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hreg V ≠
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hreg V)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} (hfib : C.G x = 0)
    (htime : tcoord x = tcoord center - s ^ 2)
    (horb : spacePart x ∈
      ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V :
        V.OrbitIndex) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hseg : spacePart x ∉
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad)) :
    eps ≤ dist x center
proof:
:= by
  refine le_dist_center_of_saddleNegative_chart_avoid hindex
    (hρrad.trans_le T.radius_le) hcover hfib htime ?_
  intro u hquad hnorm hEq
  apply hseg
  rw [← hEq]
  refine T.spacePart_param_mem_own_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment hindex b ρ s
    hρ hs0 hs hρrad hreg V hne u hquad hnorm.le ?_
  rw [hEq]
  exact horb

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.le_dist_of_saddlePositiveBranchOrbit_not_mem_segment
statement:

name: Submission.SOLocalExtension.contDiff_circleAngleExtension
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ tubeGood
  · have huC : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (uC (m := m)) x :=
      contDiffOn_uC.contDiffAt (isOpen_tubeGood.mem_nhds hx)
    have huS : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (uS (m := m)) x :=
      contDiffOn_uS.contDiffAt (isOpen_tubeGood.mem_nhds hx)
    exact contDiff_tubeCutoff.contDiffAt.mul
      (ha.contDiffAt.comp x (huC.prodMk huS))
  · have hrs : radSq x = 0 := by
      have hn := radSq_nonneg x
      have hnot : ¬0 < radSq x := hx
      linarith
    have hr : rad x = 0 := by
      rw [rad, hrs, Real.sqrt_zero]
    have hd : 1 ≤ tubeDistSq x := by
      rw [tubeDistSq, hr]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖x‖]
    have hgt : 1 / 9 < tubeDistSq x := by linarith
    have hnhds : {y : E | 1 / 9 < tubeDistSq y} ∈ 𝓝 x :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const continuous_tubeDistSq).mem_nhds hgt
    apply (contDiffAt_const (x := x) (c := (0 : ℝ))).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [hnhds] with y hy
    rw [circleAngleExtension, tubeCutoff_of_ge hy.le, zero_mul]

name: Submission.SOLocalExtension.localHomotopy_fixedOn_off_outer
statement:
theorem localHomotopy_fixedOn_off_outer
    (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (a : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ)
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) :
    (localHomotopy X a ha).FixedOn
      {x : E | x ∉ tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 3)} X.g
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs x hx
  rw [localHomotopy, SO2FrameGauge.homotopy_H,
    circleAngleExtension_eq_zero_off_outer a hx, mul_zero,
    SO2FrameGauge.rotate_zero]

name: Submission.SOLocalExtension.contDiff_extendCircleSOHomotopy
statement:
theorem contDiff_extendCircleSOHomotopy
    {R : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup (m + 2)}
    (hR : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((R p.1 p.2 : SOGroup (m + 2)) : M) i j))
    (hRzero : ∀ z, R 0 z = 1) :
    ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E =>
        ((extendCircleSOHomotopy R p.1 p.2 : SOGroup (m + 2)) : M) i j)
proof:
:= by
  intro i j
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro p
  by_cases hx : p.2 ∈ tubeGood
  · have huCx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (uC (m := m)) p.2 :=
      contDiffOn_uC.contDiffAt (isOpen_tubeGood.mem_nhds hx)
    have huSx : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (uS (m := m)) p.2 :=
      contDiffOn_uS.contDiffAt (isOpen_tubeGood.mem_nhds hx)
    have huC : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × E => uC q.2) p :=
      huCx.comp p contDiff_snd.contDiffAt
    have huS : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × E => uS q.2) p :=
      huSx.comp p contDiff_snd.contDiffAt
    have ht : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
        (fun q : ℝ × E => normRamp q.1 * tubeCutoff q.2) p :=
      (contDiff_normRamp.comp contDiff_fst).contDiffAt.mul
        (contDiff_tubeCutoff.comp contDiff_snd).contDiffAt
    exact (hR i j).contDiffAt.comp p (ht.prodMk (huC.prodMk huS))
  · have hrs : radSq p.2 = 0 := by
      have hn := radSq_nonneg p.2
      have hnot : ¬0 < radSq p.2 := hx
      linarith
    have hr : rad p.2 = 0 := by
      rw [rad, hrs, Real.sqrt_zero]
    have hd : 1 ≤ tubeDistSq p.2 := by
      rw [tubeDistSq, hr]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖p.2‖]
    have hgt : 1 / 9 < tubeDistSq p.2 := by linarith
    have hnhds :
        {q : ℝ × E | 1 / 9 < tubeDistSq q.2} ∈ 𝓝 p :=
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const
        (continuous_tubeDistSq.comp continuous_snd)).mem_nhds hgt
    apply (contDiffAt_const (x := p)
      (c := (((1 : SOGroup (m + 2)) : M) i j))).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [hnhds] with q hq
    rw [extendCircleSOHomotopy, tubeCutoff_of_ge hq.le, mul_zero,
      hRzero]

name: Submission.SOLocalExtension.extendCircleSOHomotopy_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendCircleSOHomotopy_zero
    (R : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup (m + 2))
    (hRzero : ∀ z, R 0 z = 1) (x : E) :
    extendCircleSOHomotopy R 0 x = 1
proof:

    normRamp_of_le_quarter (show (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4 by norm_num),

name: Submission.SOLocalExtension.extendCircleSOHomotopy_circleAt
statement:
@[simp] theorem extendCircleSOHomotopy_circleAt
    (R : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup (m + 2)) (s θ : ℝ) :
    extendCircleSOHomotopy (m := m) R s (circleAt θ) =
      R (normRamp s) (Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [extendCircleSOHomotopy,
    tubeCutoff_eq_one_on_inner
      (standardCircle_subset_innerTube (circleAt_mem_standardCircle θ)),
    mul_one, uC_circleAt, uS_circleAt]

name: Submission.SOLocalExtension.extendCircleSOHomotopy_one_circleAt

      R 1 (Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ)
proof:

name: Submission.SOLocalExtension.localSOHomotopy_H_circleAt
statement:
@[simp] theorem localSOHomotopy_H_circleAt
    (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2))
    (R : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup (m + 2))
    (hR : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((R p.1 p.2 : SOGroup (m + 2)) : M) i j))
    (hRzero : ∀ z, R 0 z = 1) (s θ : ℝ) :
    (localSOHomotopy X R hR hRzero).H s (circleAt θ) =
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM (R (normRamp s) (Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ))
        (X.g (circleAt θ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [localSOHomotopy, SOFrameGauge.homotopy_H,
    extendCircleSOHomotopy_circleAt]

name: Submission.SOLocalExtension.localSOHomotopy_fixedOn_off_outer
statement:
theorem localSOHomotopy_fixedOn_off_outer
    (X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2))
    (R : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ → SOGroup (m + 2))
    (hR : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × (ℝ × ℝ) => ((R p.1 p.2 : SOGroup (m + 2)) : M) i j))
    (hRzero : ∀ z, R 0 z = 1) :
    (localSOHomotopy X R hR hRzero).FixedOn
      {x : E | x ∉ tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 3)} X.g
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs x hx
  rw [localSOHomotopy, SOFrameGauge.homotopy_H,
    extendCircleSOHomotopy_eq_one_off_outer R hRzero s hx,
    SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one]
  rfl

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.fixedOn_composeList

theorem fixedOn_composeList {K : Set E} :
    ∀ (moves : List (SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)),
      (∀ A ∈ moves, A.FixedOn K) → (composeList moves).FixedOn K
  | [], _ => fixedOn_refl K
  | A :: tail, h => by
      apply FixedOn.followedBy
      · exact h A (by simp)
      · apply fixedOn_composeList tail
        intro B hB
        exact h B (by simp [hB])

proof:

name: Submission.FlatSignedConfiguration.nonempty_headMove_juxtapose_tail
statement:
theorem nonempty_headMove_juxtapose_tail
    {X₀ X₁ : FramedLevelSet n} {S₀ : FiberSign X₀} {S₁ : FiberSign X₁}
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hC : C.SpatialFlatOutside c p R)
    (tail : FlatSignedConfiguration n c) :
    let T
proof:
:= placeAfterBound p R tail
    let hsep : R + T.radius < dist p T.center :=
      separated_placeAfterBound p R hR tail
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (S₀.juxtapose T.sign hc hC.flatOutside_source T.flatOutside hsep)
      (S₁.juxtapose T.sign hc hC.flatOutside_target T.flatOutside hsep)) := by
  dsimp only
  exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_juxtapose_tail C hc hC
    (placeAfterBound p R tail).sign (placeAfterBound p R tail).flatOutside
    (separated_placeAfterBound p R hR tail) hC.flatOutside_source
    hC.flatOutside_target

name: Submission.FlatSignedConfiguration.nonempty_headMove_juxtapose_assembledTail
statement:
theorem nonempty_headMove_juxtapose_assembledTail
    {X₀ X₁ : FramedLevelSet n} {S₀ : FiberSign X₀} {S₁ : FiberSign X₁}
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R)
    (hC : C.SpatialFlatOutside c p R)
    (pieces : List (FlatSignedConfiguration n c)) :
    let tail
proof:
:= assemble c hc pieces
    let T := placeAfterBound p R tail
    let hsep : R + T.radius < dist p T.center :=
      separated_placeAfterBound p R hR tail
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (S₀.juxtapose T.sign hc hC.flatOutside_source T.flatOutside hsep)
      (S₁.juxtapose T.sign hc hC.flatOutside_target T.flatOutside hsep)) := by
  dsimp only
  exact nonempty_headMove_juxtapose_tail C hc p R hR hC
    (assemble c hc pieces)
