name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationPlacedPlanAudit.GaugeOnlyFiberMatch.source_fiber_eq_placed
statement:
theorem source_fiber_eq_placed (G : GaugeOnlyFiberMatch m P A) :
    A.X.fiber = P.endpointX.fiber
proof:
:= by
  rw [← G.endpoint_eq]
  change
    (P.endpointX.gaugeTransform (G.gauge.Q 1)
      (contDiff_gauge_slice G.gauge.smooth 1)
      (fun x => G.gauge.bijective 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ x)).fiber =
      P.endpointX.fiber
  exact FramedLevelSet.gaugeTransform_fiber _ _ _ _

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationPlacedPlanAudit.GaugeOnlyFiberMatch.source_fiber_eq_canonicalTargetUnion
statement:
theorem source_fiber_eq_canonicalTargetUnion
    (G : GaugeOnlyFiberMatch m P A) :
    A.X.fiber =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion
        (X := X)
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field (X := X) m)
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [G.source_fiber_eq_placed, P.endpoint_fiber]

name: Submission.SaddleCriticalExteriorArc.isCompact_recoveryCore
statement:
theorem isCompact_recoveryCore
    (A : SaddleCriticalExteriorArc endpoint
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice C
        (P.eventCenter t ht)) p q) :
    IsCompact (recoveryCore (n := n) A)
proof:
:= by
  simpa [recoveryCore] using isCompact_univ.image A.toPath.continuous

name: Submission.SaddleCriticalExteriorArc.mem_recoveryCore
statement:
theorem mem_recoveryCore
    (A : SaddleCriticalExteriorArc endpoint
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice C
        (P.eventCenter t ht)) p q)
    (u : I) :
    A.toPath u ∈ recoveryCore (n := n) A
proof:
:=
  ⟨u, rfl⟩

name: Submission.SaddleCriticalExteriorArc.recoveryCore_subset_slabRegularSet
statement:
theorem recoveryCore_subset_slabRegularSet
    (A : SaddleCriticalExteriorArc endpoint
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice C
        (P.eventCenter t ht)) p q) :
    recoveryCore (n := n) A ⊆
      slabRegularSet C.toLevelCobordismData.G
proof:
:= by
  intro z hz
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hz
  have hpunct := A.mem_exterior u
  exact mem_slabRegularSet_of_spatial_surjective
    (C.regular _ hpunct.1)
    (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice_spatialDeriv_surjective
      (P := P) (ht := ht) hpunct)

name: Submission.SaddleCriticalExteriorArc.flowed_target_mem_source_orbit
statement:
theorem flowed_target_mem_source_orbit
    (A : SaddleCriticalExteriorArc endpoint
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice C
        (P.eventCenter t ht)) p q)
    {d : ℝ} (hd : |d| ≤
      (recoveryTimeField (n := n) (C := C) (P := P) (ht := ht) A).safeTime)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord (P.eventCenter t ht) + d))
    (V : TamedField
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.toLevelCobordismData
        (tcoord (P.eventCenter t ht) + d) hreg)) :
    spacePart ((recoveryTimeField (n := n) (C := C) (P := P) (ht := ht)
      A).base.flow (endpoint q) d) ∈
      V.orbit
        (spacePart ((recoveryTimeField (n := n) (C := C) (P := P) (ht := ht)
          A).base.flow (endpoint p) d))
proof:
:= by
  exact (recoveryTimeField (n := n) (C := C) (P := P) (ht := ht)
    A).flowSlicePath_endpoints_mem_same_orbit
    A.toPath (mem_recoveryCore (n := n) A)
    (fun u => (A.mem_exterior u).2.1)
    (fun u => (A.mem_exterior u).1)
    hd hreg V

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.exists_nonneg_spatialFlatOutside
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_spatialFlatOutside
    (D : PTTransverseHomotopyData S₀ S₁) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R ∧
      D.toFramedLevelCobordism.SpatialFlatOutside (-D.target) 0 R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := D.exterior_south
  refine ⟨max R 0 + 1, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  have hnorm : R < ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ := by
    have hlarge : max R 0 + 1 ≤ ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ := by
      simpa [dist_zero_right] using hv
    have hstrict : R < max R 0 + 1 := by
      have hle : R ≤ max R 0 := le_max_left _ _
      linarith
    exact hstrict.trans_le hlarge
  have hsouth : D.sphere v = southPole n := hR v hnorm
  change D.levelMap v = -D.target
  rw [PTTransverseHomotopyData.levelMap]
  have hsouth' := congrArg Subtype.val hsouth
  rw [hsouth']
  change initCLM n (-eLast n) - D.target = -D.target
  rw [map_neg, initCLM_eLast, neg_zero, zero_sub]

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.exists_nonneg_signedSpatialFlatOutside
statement:
theorem exists_nonneg_signedSpatialFlatOutside
    (D : PTTransverseHomotopyData S₀ S₁) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, 0 ≤ R ∧
      D.toSignedFramedLevelCobordism.SpatialFlatOutside (-D.target) 0 R
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hflat⟩ := D.exists_nonneg_spatialFlatOutside
  refine ⟨R, hR, ?_⟩
  change D.toFramedLevelCobordism.SpatialFlatOutside (-D.target) 0 R
  exact hflat

name: Submission.PTTransverseHomotopyData.neg_target_ne_zero
statement:
theorem neg_target_ne_zero (D : PTTransverseHomotopyData S₀ S₁) :
    -D.target ≠ 0
proof:
:=
  neg_ne_zero.mpr D.target_ne_zero

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.tR_nonneg
statement: lemma tR_nonneg (v : A) : 0 ≤ tR v
proof: := normRamp_nonneg _

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.tR_le_one
statement: lemma tR_le_one (v : A) : tR v ≤ 1
proof: := normRamp_le_one _

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.tW_nonneg
statement: lemma tW_nonneg (v : A) : 0 ≤ tW v
proof:
:=
  mul_nonneg (tR_nonneg v) (by linarith [tR_le_one v])

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.tW_le_quarter
statement: lemma tW_le_quarter (v : A) : tW v ≤ 1 / 4
proof:
:= by
  have h := sq_nonneg (2 * tR v - 1)
  unfold tW
  nlinarith

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.contDiff_tR
statement: lemma contDiff_tR : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tR (n := n))
proof:
:=
  contDiff_normRamp.comp contDiff_vertC

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.contDiff_tW
statement: lemma contDiff_tW : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tW (n := n))
proof:
:=
  contDiff_tR.mul (contDiff_const.sub contDiff_tR)

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.tR_spaceTime
statement: lemma tR_spaceTime (x : E) (t : ℝ) : tR (spaceTime x t) = normRamp t
proof:
:= by
  rw [tR, vertC_spaceTime]

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.tR_eq_zero
statement: lemma tR_eq_zero {v : A} (h : vertC v ≤ 1 / 4) : tR v = 0
proof:
:=
  normRamp_of_le_quarter h

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.tR_eq_one
statement: lemma tR_eq_one {v : A} (h : 3 / 4 ≤ vertC v) : tR v = 1
proof:
:=
  normRamp_of_three_quarter_le h

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.contDiff_bump
statement: lemma contDiff_bump (R : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (bump (n := n) R)
proof:
:=
  Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_const.sub (contDiff_norm_sq ℝ))

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.bump_nonneg
statement: lemma bump_nonneg (R : ℝ) (x : E) : 0 ≤ bump R x
proof:
:=
  Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.bump_le_one
statement: lemma bump_le_one (R : ℝ) (x : E) : bump R x ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  Real.smoothTransition.le_one _

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.bump_eq_one
statement: lemma bump_eq_one {R : ℝ} {x : E} (h : ‖x‖ ≤ R) : bump R x = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.contDiff_cobMap
statement: lemma contDiff_cobMap (y : F) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cobMap D y)
proof:
:= by
  have hseg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun v : A =>
      segMap X Y (tR v) (initCLM (n + 1) v) :=
    (segMap_smooth X Y).comp (contDiff_tR.prodMk (initCLM (n + 1)).contDiff)
  exact hseg.sub
    ((contDiff_tW.mul ((contDiff_bump D.R).comp
      (initCLM (n + 1)).contDiff)).smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.cobMap_collar_zero
statement:
lemma cobMap_collar_zero (y : F) (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 4) :
    cobMap D y (spaceTime x t) = X.g x
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : tR (spaceTime x t) = 0 := by
    rw [tR_spaceTime]
    exact normRamp_of_le_quarter ht
  rw [cobMap, h0, initCLM_spaceTime, tW, h0]
  simp [segMap]

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.cobMap_collar_one
statement:
lemma cobMap_collar_one (y : F) (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t) :
    cobMap D y (spaceTime x t) = Y.g x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : tR (spaceTime x t) = 1 := by
    rw [tR_spaceTime]
    exact normRamp_of_three_quarter_le ht
  rw [cobMap, h1, initCLM_spaceTime, tW, h1]
  simp [segMap]

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.seg_norm_le_of_zero
statement:
lemma seg_norm_le_of_zero {y : F} {v : A} (hv : cobMap D y v = 0) :
    ‖segMap X Y (tR v) (initCLM (n + 1) v)‖ ≤ ‖y‖
proof:
:= by
  have hEq : segMap X Y (tR v) (initCLM (n + 1) v) =
      (tW v * bump D.R (initCLM (n + 1) v)) • y :=
    sub_eq_zero.mp hv
  rw [hEq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (tW_nonneg v) (bump_nonneg _ _))]
  have h1 : tW v * bump D.R (initCLM (n + 1) v) ≤ 1 := by
    have := tW_le_quarter v
    have := bump_le_one D.R (initCLM (n + 1) v)
    have := tW_nonneg v
    have := bump_nonneg D.R (initCLM (n + 1) v)
    nlinarith
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg y]

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.mem_fiber_of_zero_ramp
statement:
lemma mem_fiber_of_zero_ramp {y : F} {v : A} (hv : cobMap D y v = 0)
    (h0 : tR v = 0) : initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  have h : segMap X Y (tR v) (initCLM (n + 1) v) -
      (tW v * bump D.R (initCLM (n + 1) v)) • y = 0 := hv
  rw [h0, tW, h0] at h
  have hg : X.g (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 0 := by simpa [segMap] using h
  exact hg

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.mem_fiberY_of_one_ramp
statement:
lemma mem_fiberY_of_one_ramp {y : F} {v : A} (hv : cobMap D y v = 0)
    (h1 : tR v = 1) : initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ Y.fiber
proof:
:= by
  have h : segMap X Y (tR v) (initCLM (n + 1) v) -
      (tW v * bump D.R (initCLM (n + 1) v)) • y = 0 := hv
  rw [h1, tW, h1] at h
  have hg : Y.g (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 0 := by simpa [segMap] using h
  exact hg

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.isOpen_U
statement: lemma isOpen_U : IsOpen (U D)
proof:
:= by
  exact (isOpen_lt continuous_const contDiff_tW.continuous).inter
    (isOpen_lt ((initCLM (n + 1)).continuous.norm) continuous_const)

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.contDiffOn_quotMap
statement: lemma contDiffOn_quotMap : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (quotMap X Y) (U D)
proof:
:= by
  have hseg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun v : A =>
      segMap X Y (tR v) (initCLM (n + 1) v) :=
    (segMap_smooth X Y).comp (contDiff_tR.prodMk (initCLM (n + 1)).contDiff)
  exact (contDiff_tW.contDiffOn.inv fun v hv => hv.1.ne').smul
    hseg.contDiffOn

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.cobMap_eq_on_U
statement:
lemma cobMap_eq_on_U (y : F) : ∀ v ∈ U D,
    cobMap D y v = tW v • (quotMap X Y v - y)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hb : bump D.R (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 1 := bump_eq_one hv.2.le
  rw [cobMap, hb, mul_one, quotMap, smul_sub, smul_smul,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hv.1.ne', one_smul]

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.quotMap_eq_of_zero
statement:
lemma quotMap_eq_of_zero {y : F} {v : A} (hv : cobMap D y v = 0)
    (hvU : v ∈ U D) : quotMap X Y v = y
proof:
:= by
  have h := cobMap_eq_on_U D y v hvU
  rw [hv] at h
  have h2 : quotMap X Y v - y = 0 :=
    (smul_eq_zero.mp h.symm).resolve_left hvU.1.ne'
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h2

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.zero_spatial
statement:
lemma zero_spatial (W : Witness D) {v : A} (hv : cobMap D W.y v = 0) :
    ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ < D.R
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_ge ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ D.R with h | h
  · exact h
  · exfalso
    have houter := D.outer (initCLM (n + 1) v) h (tR v) (tR_nonneg v)
      (tR_le_one v)
    have hle := seg_norm_le_of_zero D hv
    have := W.small_outer
    linarith

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.zero_not_shell
statement:
lemma zero_not_shell (W : Witness D) {v : A} (hv : cobMap D W.y v = 0) :
    initCLM (n + 1) v ∉ closure D.W₂ \ D.W₁
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  have hlt := W.shell_lt (initCLM (n + 1) v) hmem (tR v) (tR_nonneg v)
    (tR_le_one v)
  have hle := seg_norm_le_of_zero D hv
  linarith

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.zero_mem_U
statement:
lemma zero_mem_U (W : Witness D) {v : A} (hv : cobMap D W.y v = 0)
    (h0 : tR v ≠ 0) (h1 : tR v ≠ 1) : v ∈ U D
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, W.zero_spatial hv⟩
  have hr0 : 0 < tR v := lt_of_le_of_ne (tR_nonneg v) (Ne.symm h0)
  have hr1 : tR v < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne (tR_le_one v) h1
  exact mul_pos hr0 (by linarith)

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.cobMap_regular
statement:
theorem cobMap_regular (W : Witness D) :
    ∀ v : A, cobMap D W.y v = 0 →
      Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (cobMap D W.y) v)
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  by_cases h0 : tR v = 0
  · 
    have hx : initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ X.fiber := mem_fiber_of_zero_ramp D hv h0
    apply surjective_fderiv_of_slice (contDiff_cobMap D W.y)
    have h0' : normRamp (vertC v) = 0 := h0
    have hslice : (fun x' : E => cobMap D W.y (spaceTime x' (vertC v))) =
        X.g := by
      funext x'
      rw [cobMap, tW, tR_spaceTime, h0', initCLM_spaceTime]
      simp [segMap]
    rw [hslice]
    exact X.regular _ hx
  · by_cases h1 : tR v = 1
    · 
      have hx : initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ Y.fiber := mem_fiberY_of_one_ramp D hv h1
      apply surjective_fderiv_of_slice (contDiff_cobMap D W.y)
      have h1' : normRamp (vertC v) = 1 := h1
      have hslice : (fun x' : E => cobMap D W.y (spaceTime x' (vertC v))) =
          Y.g := by
        funext x'
        rw [cobMap, tW, tR_spaceTime, h1', initCLM_spaceTime]
        simp [segMap]
      rw [hslice]
      exact Y.regular _ hx
    · 
      have hvU : v ∈ U D := W.zero_mem_U hv h0 h1
      have hEv : cobMap D W.y =ᶠ[𝓝 v]
          fun v' => tW v' • (quotMap X Y v' - W.y) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem ((isOpen_U D).mem_nhds hvU)
          (cobMap_eq_on_U D W.y)
      have hqv : quotMap X Y v = W.y := quotMap_eq_of_zero D hv hvU
      have hqDiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (quotMap X Y) v :=
        (((contDiffOn_quotMap D).contDiffAt
          ((isOpen_U D).mem_nhds hvU)).differentiableAt infty_ne_zero)
      have hwDiff : HasFDerivAt tW (fderiv ℝ tW v) v :=
        (contDiff_tW.differentiable infty_ne_zero v).hasFDerivAt
      have hprod : HasFDerivAt
          (fun v' => tW v' • (quotMap X Y v' - W.y))
          (tW v • fderiv ℝ (quotMap X Y) v +
            (fderiv ℝ tW v).smulRight (quotMap X Y v - W.y)) v :=
        hwDiff.smul (hqDiff.hasFDerivAt.sub_const W.y)
      have hfd : fderiv ℝ (cobMap D W.y) v =
          tW v • fderiv ℝ (quotMap X Y) v +
            (fderiv ℝ tW v).smulRight (quotMap X Y v - W.y) := by
        rw [hEv.fderiv_eq]
        exact hprod.fderiv
      have hsurjq : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (quotMap X Y) v) := by
        have h := W.hreg v hvU hqv
        rwa [fderivWithin_of_isOpen (isOpen_U D) hvU] at h
      intro z
      obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsurjq ((tW v)⁻¹ • z)
      refine ⟨u, ?_⟩
      rw [hfd]
      have hzero : quotMap X Y v - W.y = 0 := by
        rw [hqv, sub_self]
      simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.add_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply,
        ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight_apply, hzero, smul_zero, add_zero, hu,
        smul_smul]
      rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hvU.1.ne', one_smul]

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.continuous_combo
statement: lemma continuous_combo : Continuous (combo S T)
proof:
:= by
  have hR : Continuous (tR (n := n)) := contDiff_tR.continuous
  exact ((continuous_const.sub hR).mul
      (S.continuous.comp (initCLM (n + 1)).continuous)).add
    (hR.mul (T.continuous.comp (initCLM (n + 1)).continuous))

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.continuous_tauRamp_comp
statement:
lemma continuous_tauRamp_comp (rho : ℝ) :
    Continuous fun v : A => tauRamp rho (tW v)
proof:
:= by
  have h : Continuous fun v : A => (2 * tW v - rho) / rho :=
    ((continuous_const.mul contDiff_tW.continuous).sub
      continuous_const).div_const rho
  exact continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min h)

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.tauRamp_zero
statement: lemma tauRamp_zero {rho : ℝ} (h : 0 < rho) : tauRamp rho 0 = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauRamp]
  have hneg : (2 * 0 - rho) / rho = -1 := by
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) * 0 - rho = -rho by ring, neg_div, div_self h.ne']
  rw [hneg]
  have hmin : min (1 : ℝ) (-1) = -1 := min_eq_right (by norm_num)
  rw [hmin]
  exact max_eq_left (by norm_num)

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.tauRamp_one
statement:
lemma tauRamp_one {rho s : ℝ} (h : 0 < rho) (hs : rho ≤ s) :
    tauRamp rho s = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauRamp]
  have hone : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 * s - rho) / rho := by
    rw [le_div_iff₀ h]
    linarith
  rw [min_eq_left hone]
  exact max_eq_right (by norm_num)

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.continuous_label
statement: lemma continuous_label (W : Witness D) : Continuous (W.label)
proof:
:= by
  exact (continuous_combo).add
    (((continuous_tauRamp_comp W.rho).mul
        (W.chi_continuous.comp (initCLM (n + 1)).continuous)).mul
      (continuous_const.sub continuous_combo))

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.label_collar_zero
statement:
lemma label_collar_zero (W : Witness D) (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 1 / 4) :
    W.label (spaceTime x t) = S x
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : tR (spaceTime x t) = 0 := by
    rw [tR_spaceTime]
    exact normRamp_of_le_quarter ht
  have htW : tW (spaceTime x t) = 0 := by
    rw [tW, h0]
    ring
  rw [label, htW, tauRamp_zero W.rho_pos, combo, h0, initCLM_spaceTime]
  ring

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.label_collar_one
statement:
lemma label_collar_one (W : Witness D) (x : E) {t : ℝ} (ht : 3 / 4 ≤ t) :
    W.label (spaceTime x t) = T x
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : tR (spaceTime x t) = 1 := by
    rw [tR_spaceTime]
    exact normRamp_of_three_quarter_le ht
  have htW : tW (spaceTime x t) = 0 := by
    rw [tW, h1]
    ring
  rw [label, htW, tauRamp_zero W.rho_pos, combo, h1, initCLM_spaceTime]
  ring

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.combo_ne_zero_of_agree
proof:
:= by
  have hr0 := tR_nonneg v
  have hr1 := tR_le_one v
  rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hagree with ⟨hS, hT⟩ | ⟨hS, hT⟩
  · 
    have h1 : 0 ≤ (1 - tR v) * S (initCLM (n + 1) v) :=
      mul_nonneg (by linarith) hS.le
    have h2 : 0 ≤ tR v * T (initCLM (n + 1) v) := mul_nonneg hr0 hT.le
    rcases lt_or_ge (tR v) 1 with hlt | hge
    · have : 0 < (1 - tR v) * S (initCLM (n + 1) v) :=
        mul_pos (by linarith) hS
      exact ne_of_gt (by rw [combo]; linarith)
    · have h1' : tR v = 1 := le_antisymm hr1 hge
      have : 0 < tR v * T (initCLM (n + 1) v) := by
        rw [h1']
        simpa using hT
      exact ne_of_gt (by rw [combo]; linarith)
  · 
    have h1 : (1 - tR v) * S (initCLM (n + 1) v) ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (by linarith) hS.le
    have h2 : tR v * T (initCLM (n + 1) v) ≤ 0 :=
      mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos hr0 hT.le
    rcases lt_or_ge (tR v) 1 with hlt | hge
    · have : (1 - tR v) * S (initCLM (n + 1) v) < 0 :=
        mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (by linarith) hS
      exact ne_of_lt (by rw [combo]; linarith)
    · have h1' : tR v = 1 := le_antisymm hr1 hge
      have : tR v * T (initCLM (n + 1) v) < 0 := by
        rw [h1']
        simpa using hT
      exact ne_of_lt (by rw [combo]; linarith)

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.label_ne_zero
statement:
theorem label_ne_zero (W : Witness D) :
    ∀ v : A, cobMap D W.y v = 0 → W.label v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  by_cases h0 : tR v = 0
  · 
    have hx : initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ X.fiber := mem_fiber_of_zero_ramp D hv h0
    have htW : tW v = 0 := by
      rw [tW, h0]
      ring
    have hL : W.label v = S (initCLM (n + 1) v) := by
      rw [label, htW, tauRamp_zero W.rho_pos, combo, h0]
      ring
    rw [hL]
    exact S.nonzero _ hx
  · by_cases h1 : tR v = 1
    · have hx : initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ Y.fiber := mem_fiberY_of_one_ramp D hv h1
      have htW : tW v = 0 := by
        rw [tW, h1]
        ring
      have hL : W.label v = T (initCLM (n + 1) v) := by
        rw [label, htW, tauRamp_zero W.rho_pos, combo, h1]
        ring
      rw [hL]
      exact T.nonzero _ hx
    · 
      by_cases hx2 : initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ closure D.W₂
      · by_cases hx1 : initCLM (n + 1) v ∈ D.W₁
        · 
          have hchi : W.chi (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 0 :=
            W.chi_zero _ (subset_closure hx1)
          have hL : W.label v = combo S T v := by
            rw [label, hchi]
            ring
          rw [hL]
          exact combo_ne_zero_of_agree
            (D.agree _ (subset_closure hx1))
        · 
          exact absurd ⟨hx2, hx1⟩ (W.zero_not_shell hv)
      · 
        have hxW₂ : initCLM (n + 1) v ∉ D.W₂ := fun h => hx2 (subset_closure h)
        have hxW₁ : initCLM (n + 1) v ∉ D.W₁ := fun h =>
          hx2 (subset_closure (D.closure_subset (subset_closure h)))
        have hchi : W.chi (initCLM (n + 1) v) = 1 := W.chi_one _ hxW₂
        have hrho : W.rho ≤ tW v := by
          have := W.danger (initCLM (n + 1) v) (W.zero_spatial hv).le hxW₁
            (tR v) (tR_nonneg v) (tR_le_one v) (seg_norm_le_of_zero D hv)
          exact this
        have htau : tauRamp W.rho (tW v) = 1 := tauRamp_one W.rho_pos hrho
        have hL : W.label v = 1 := by
          rw [label, htau, hchi]
          ring
        rw [hL]
        exact one_ne_zero

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.exists_shell_bound
statement:
lemma exists_shell_bound :
    ∃ eps₂ : ℝ, 0 < eps₂ ∧ ∀ x ∈ closure D.W₂ \ D.W₁, ∀ r : ℝ,
      0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 → eps₂ ≤ ‖segMap X Y r x‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hKclosed : IsClosed (closure D.W₂ \ D.W₁) := by
    rw [Set.diff_eq]
    exact isClosed_closure.inter D.isOpen_W₁.isClosed_compl
  have hKcompact : IsCompact (closure D.W₂ \ D.W₁) :=
    Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hKclosed
      (D.isBounded_W₂.closure.subset Set.diff_subset)
  have hQcompact : IsCompact
      ((closure D.W₂ \ D.W₁) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
    hKcompact.prod isCompact_Icc
  have hf : Continuous fun p : E × ℝ => ‖segMap X Y p.2 p.1‖ := by
    have hraw : Continuous fun p : E × ℝ =>
        (1 - p.2) • X.g p.1 + p.2 • Y.g p.1 :=
      ((continuous_const.sub continuous_snd).smul
        (X.smooth.continuous.comp continuous_fst)).add
        (continuous_snd.smul (Y.smooth.continuous.comp continuous_fst))
    exact hraw.norm
  by_cases hne : ((closure D.W₂ \ D.W₁) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1).Nonempty
  · obtain ⟨p, hpQ, hmin⟩ := hQcompact.exists_isMinOn hne hf.continuousOn
    rw [Set.mem_prod] at hpQ
    refine ⟨‖segMap X Y p.2 p.1‖, ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact norm_pos_iff.mpr (D.shell p.1 hpQ.1 p.2 hpQ.2.1 hpQ.2.2)
    · intro x hx r hr0 hr1
      exact isMinOn_iff.mp hmin (x, r) (Set.mem_prod.mpr ⟨hx, hr0, hr1⟩)
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos, fun x hx r hr0 hr1 => ?_⟩
    have hmem : (x, r) ∈ (closure D.W₂ \ D.W₁) ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
      Set.mem_prod.mpr ⟨hx, hr0, hr1⟩
    exact absurd (Set.nonempty_of_mem hmem) hne

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.exists_danger_bound
statement:
lemma exists_danger_bound :
    ∃ rho : ℝ, 0 < rho ∧ ∃ eta : ℝ, 0 < eta ∧
      ∀ x : E, ‖x‖ ≤ D.R → x ∉ D.W₁ → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        ‖segMap X Y r x‖ ≤ eta → rho ≤ r * (1 - r)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hKclosed : IsClosed (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) D.R \ D.W₁) := by
    rw [Set.diff_eq]
    exact Metric.isClosed_closedBall.inter D.isOpen_W₁.isClosed_compl
  have hKcompact : IsCompact (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) D.R \ D.W₁) :=
    Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded hKclosed
      (Metric.isBounded_closedBall.subset Set.diff_subset)
  by_cases hne : (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) D.R \ D.W₁).Nonempty
  · have hballne : (Metric.closedBall (0 : E) D.R).Nonempty :=
      hne.mono Set.diff_subset
    obtain ⟨x₁, hx₁, hminX⟩ := hKcompact.exists_isMinOn hne
      (X.smooth.continuous.norm.continuousOn)
    obtain ⟨x₂, hx₂, hminY⟩ := hKcompact.exists_isMinOn hne
      (Y.smooth.continuous.norm.continuousOn)
    obtain ⟨x₃, _, hmaxX⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) D.R).exists_isMaxOn
      hballne (X.smooth.continuous.norm.continuousOn)
    obtain ⟨x₄, _, hmaxY⟩ := (isCompact_closedBall (0 : E) D.R).exists_isMaxOn
      hballne (Y.smooth.continuous.norm.continuousOn)
    set dX : ℝ := ‖X.g x₁‖ with hdX
    set dY : ℝ := ‖Y.g x₂‖ with hdY
    set MX : ℝ := ‖X.g x₃‖ with hMX
    set MY : ℝ := ‖Y.g x₄‖ with hMY
    have hdXpos : 0 < dX := by
      apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
      intro hzero
      exact hx₁.2 (D.fiber_subset hzero)
    have hdYpos : 0 < dY := by
      apply norm_pos_iff.mpr
      intro hzero
      have hxf : x₂ ∈ Y.fiber := hzero
      rw [D.fiber_eq] at hxf
      exact hx₂.2 (D.fiber_subset hxf)
    have hMXnn : 0 ≤ MX := norm_nonneg _
    have hMYnn : 0 ≤ MY := norm_nonneg _
    refine ⟨(dX / (2 * (dX + MY + 1))) * (dY / (2 * (dY + MX + 1))),
      by positivity, min dX dY / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro x hxR hxW r hr0 hr1 hseg
    have hxB : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) D.R := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      exact hxR
    have hxK : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) D.R \ D.W₁ := ⟨hxB, hxW⟩
    have hXlow : dX ≤ ‖X.g x‖ := isMinOn_iff.mp hminX x hxK
    have hYlow : dY ≤ ‖Y.g x‖ := isMinOn_iff.mp hminY x hxK
    have hXhigh : ‖X.g x‖ ≤ MX := isMaxOn_iff.mp hmaxX x hxB
    have hYhigh : ‖Y.g x‖ ≤ MY := isMaxOn_iff.mp hmaxY x hxB
    
    have hsegX : (1 - r) * ‖X.g x‖ ≤ ‖segMap X Y r x‖ + r * ‖Y.g x‖ := by
      have hEq : (1 - r) • X.g x = segMap X Y r x - r • Y.g x := by
        rw [segMap]
        abel
      calc
        (1 - r) * ‖X.g x‖ = ‖(1 - r) • X.g x‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
        _ = ‖segMap X Y r x - r • Y.g x‖ := by rw [hEq]
        _ ≤ ‖segMap X Y r x‖ + ‖r • Y.g x‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = ‖segMap X Y r x‖ + r * ‖Y.g x‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr0]
    have hsegY : r * ‖Y.g x‖ ≤ ‖segMap X Y r x‖ + (1 - r) * ‖X.g x‖ := by
      have hEq : r • Y.g x = segMap X Y r x - (1 - r) • X.g x := by
        rw [segMap]
        abel
      calc
        r * ‖Y.g x‖ = ‖r • Y.g x‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hr0]
        _ = ‖segMap X Y r x - (1 - r) • X.g x‖ := by rw [hEq]
        _ ≤ ‖segMap X Y r x‖ + ‖(1 - r) • X.g x‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
        _ = ‖segMap X Y r x‖ + (1 - r) * ‖X.g x‖ := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
    have hetaX : min dX dY / 2 ≤ dX / 2 := by
      have := min_le_left dX dY
      linarith
    have hetaY : min dX dY / 2 ≤ dY / 2 := by
      have := min_le_right dX dY
      linarith
    
    have hr_low : dX / (2 * (dX + MY + 1)) ≤ r := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have h1 : (1 - r) * dX ≤ (1 - r) * ‖X.g x‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXlow (by linarith)
      have h2 : r * ‖Y.g x‖ ≤ r * MY :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hYhigh hr0
      nlinarith
    
    have hr_high : dY / (2 * (dY + MX + 1)) ≤ 1 - r := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      have h1 : r * dY ≤ r * ‖Y.g x‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hYlow hr0
      have h2 : (1 - r) * ‖X.g x‖ ≤ (1 - r) * MX :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hXhigh (by linarith)
      nlinarith
    exact mul_le_mul hr_low hr_high (by positivity) hr0
  · refine ⟨1, one_pos, 1, one_pos, fun x hxR hxW r _ _ _ => ?_⟩
    have hxB : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) D.R := by
      rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
      exact hxR
    have hmem : x ∈ Metric.closedBall (0 : E) D.R \ D.W₁ := ⟨hxB, hxW⟩
    exact absurd (Set.nonempty_of_mem hmem) hne

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.exists_chi
statement:
lemma exists_chi :
    ∃ chi : E → ℝ, Continuous chi ∧ (∀ x : E, chi x ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) ∧
      (∀ x ∈ closure D.W₁, chi x = 0) ∧ ∀ x ∉ D.W₂, chi x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs : IsClosed (closure D.W₁) := isClosed_closure
  have ht : IsClosed D.W₂ᶜ := D.isOpen_W₂.isClosed_compl
  have hd : Disjoint (closure D.W₁) D.W₂ᶜ := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hxc
    exact hxc (D.closure_subset hx)
  obtain ⟨f, hf0, hf1, hf01⟩ :=
    exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_of_isClosed
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) hs ht hd
  refine ⟨⇑f, ?_, hf01, fun x hx => hf0 hx, fun x hx => hf1 hx⟩
  have hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (⇑f) := by
    rw [← contMDiff_iff_contDiff]
    exact f.contMDiff
  exact hχ.continuous

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Witness.nonempty
statement: theorem Witness.nonempty : Nonempty (Witness D)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨eps₂, heps₂, hshell⟩ := exists_shell_bound D
  obtain ⟨rho, hrho, eta, heta, hdanger⟩ := exists_danger_bound D
  obtain ⟨chi, hchi_cont, hchi_mem, hchi0, hchi1⟩ := exists_chi D
  set delta : ℝ := min (min D.eps eta) eps₂ with hdelta
  have hdeltapos : 0 < delta := by
    apply lt_min (lt_min D.eps_pos heta) heps₂
  have hdense := sard_dense_regular_values_on (isOpen_U D)
    (contDiffOn_quotMap D)
  obtain ⟨y, hyreg, hyball⟩ := hdense.exists_mem_open
    (show IsOpen (Metric.ball (0 : F) delta) from Metric.isOpen_ball)
    (Metric.nonempty_ball.mpr hdeltapos)
  have hynorm : ‖y‖ < delta := by
    rwa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at hyball
  have hy_eps : ‖y‖ < D.eps :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hynorm ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hy_eta : ‖y‖ < eta :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hynorm ((min_le_left _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _))
  have hy_eps₂ : ‖y‖ < eps₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hynorm (min_le_right _ _)
  exact ⟨{
    y := y
    rho := rho
    rho_pos := hrho
    hreg := hyreg
    small_outer := hy_eps
    shell_lt := fun x hx r hr0 hr1 =>
      lt_of_lt_of_le hy_eps₂ (hshell x hx r hr0 hr1)
    danger := fun x hxR hxW r hr0 hr1 hseg =>
      hdanger x hxR hxW r hr0 hr1 (hseg.trans hy_eta.le)
    chi := chi
    chi_continuous := hchi_cont
    chi_mem := hchi_mem
    chi_zero := hchi0
    chi_one := hchi1 }⟩

name: Submission.SameFiberSardInterpolation.Data.nonempty_signedCobordism
statement:
theorem Data.nonempty_signedCobordism (D : Data X Y S T) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := Witness.nonempty D
  exact ⟨W.signedCobordism⟩

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.exists_radius_lt_norm_inverse
statement:
theorem exists_radius_lt_norm_inverse {n : ℕ} (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    (K : ℝ) :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      K < ‖A.inverse 1 x‖
proof:
:= by
  have hcompact : IsCompact (A.forward 1 ''
      Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) K) :=
    (isCompact_closedBall _ _).image (A.contDiff_forward_slice 1).continuous
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀⟩ := hcompact.isBounded.subset_closedBall
    (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
  refine ⟨R₀ + 1, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  by_contra hcon
  have hle : ‖A.inverse 1 x‖ ≤ K := not_lt.mp hcon
  have hmem : A.inverse 1 x ∈
      Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) K := by
    rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right]
    exact hle
  have hximg : x ∈ A.forward 1 ''
      Metric.closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) K :=
    ⟨A.inverse 1 x, hmem, A.right_inv 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ x⟩
  have hball := hR₀ hximg
  rw [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hball
  linarith

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.eventuallyConst_of_flatOutside
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨R + ‖p‖, fun x hx => ?_⟩
  refine h x ?_
  have hsub : ‖x‖ - ‖p‖ ≤ ‖x - p‖ := norm_sub_norm_le x p
  rw [dist_eq_norm]
  linarith

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.eventuallyConst_pullback
statement:
theorem eventuallyConst_pullback {n : ℕ} (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} {c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (h : EventuallyConst X.g c) :
    EventuallyConst (A.pullback X).g c
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := exists_radius_lt_norm_inverse A K
  exact ⟨R, fun x hx => hK _ (hR x hx).le⟩

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.endpointX_eq_pullback
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.eventuallyConst_targetPlacement
statement:
theorem eventuallyConst_targetPlacement (hm : 0 < m)
    (A : FlatSignedConfiguration (m + 2) (compactBackground m)) :
    EventuallyConst (targetPlacement hm A.X).endpointX.g
      (compactBackground m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [endpointX_eq_pullback]
  exact eventuallyConst_pullback _ (eventuallyConst_of_flatOutside A.flatOutside)

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.eventuallyConst_matchedPlacedX
statement:
theorem eventuallyConst_matchedPlacedX {B : BridgeData (m + 2) z} (hm : 0 < m)
    {Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T) :
    EventuallyConst (matchedPlacedX hm M).g (-B.y)
proof:
:= by
  have hB : EventuallyConst B.fls.g (-B.y) :=
    eventuallyConst_of_flatOutside B.fls_flatOutside
  have hSrc : EventuallyConst (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpointX.g (-B.y) := by
    rw [endpointX_eq_pullback]
    exact eventuallyConst_pullback _ hB
  exact eventuallyConst_pullback (M.matchingAmbient hm) hSrc

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.eventuallyConst_harmonizedEndpoint
statement:
theorem eventuallyConst_harmonizedEndpoint {B : BridgeData (m + 2) z}
    (hm : 0 < m) {Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m)) :
    EventuallyConst (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g (compactBackground m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R₀, hR₀⟩ := eventuallyConst_matchedPlacedX hm M
  refine ⟨max R₀ (CanonicalRotationField.outerRadius (targetField m Y)),
    fun x hx => ?_⟩
  have hx1 : R₀ ≤ ‖x‖ := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx
  have hx2 : CanonicalRotationField.outerRadius (targetField m Y) ≤ ‖x‖ :=
    le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hx
  have hgauge : SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
      (targetField m Y) (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm) (F.smoothNullGauge hm)
      1 x = 1 :=
    CanonicalRotationField.spatialGauge_eq_one_of_outerRadius_le
      (targetField m Y) (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm) (F.smoothNullGauge hm)
      1 hx2
  have hstep : (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.g x =
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM
        (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
          (targetField m Y) (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm)
          (F.smoothNullGauge hm) 1 x)
        ((matchedPlacedX hm M).g x) := rfl
  have hstep2 : (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.g x =
      (matchedPlacedX hm M).g x := by
    rw [hstep, hgauge, SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one, ContinuousLinearMap.id_apply]
  rw [harmonizedEndpoint_g hm M F G x, hstep2, hR₀ x hx1]
  exact G.gauge_one_apply_source x

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.residual_outer
statement:
theorem residual_outer (hm : 0 < m)
    (Iv : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant (m + 2))
    (B : BridgeData (m + 2) z) :
    ∃ R eps : ℝ, 0 < eps ∧ ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • (harmonizedEndpoint hm (standardMatch Iv hm B)
              (standardFrameMatch Iv hm B) (canonicalGaugeData B)).g x +
          r • (targetPlacement hm (standardTarget hm B).X).endpointX.g x‖
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R₁, h₁⟩ := eventuallyConst_harmonizedEndpoint hm
    (standardMatch Iv hm B) (standardFrameMatch Iv hm B) (canonicalGaugeData B)
  obtain ⟨R₂, h₂⟩ := eventuallyConst_targetPlacement hm (standardTarget hm B)
  refine ⟨max R₁ R₂, ‖compactBackground m‖, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [norm_pos_iff]
    exact CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1)
  · intro x hx r _ _
    have hone : (1 - r) + r = 1 := by ring
    rw [h₁ x (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hx),
      h₂ x (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hx), ← add_smul, hone, one_smul]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.tauField_matchedPlacedX_targetLift
statement:
theorem tauField_matchedPlacedX_targetLift {B : BridgeData (m + 2) z}
    (hm : 0 < m) {Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) (u : ℝ) :
    tauField (matchedPlacedX hm M).g
        (TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := targetField m Y)
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) P u) =
      canonTau (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨O, rfl⟩ := M.orbitEquiv.surjective P
  have hfib : ∀ t : ℝ,
      TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift
          (V := (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls))
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) O t ∈
        (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpointX.fiber := by
    intro t
    rw [(sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpoint_fiber]
    exact CanonicalCircleFrameClass.point_mem_targetUnion
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m)
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) O (2 * Real.pi * t)
  have htau : ∀ t : ℝ,
      tauField (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpointX.g
          (TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift
            (V := (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls))
            (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) O t) =
        canonTau (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) t :=
    fun t => tauField_placedEndpoint_targetLift (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm) O t
  have hcomp : ∀ t : ℝ,
      TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := targetField m Y)
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m)
          (M.orbitEquiv O) t =
        (M.matchingAmbient hm).forward 1
          (TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift
            (V := (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls))
            (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) O t) := by
    intro t
    rw [TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift_eq_circlePoint,
      TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift_eq_circlePoint]
    exact (M.matchingAmbient_circlePoint hm O (t : AddCircle (1 : ℝ))).symm
  exact tauField_pullback_targetLift
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) O (M.orbitEquiv O)
    (M.matchingAmbient hm) hfib htau hcomp u

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.tauField_matchedPlacedX_canonicalPoint

theorem tauField_matchedPlacedX_canonicalPoint {B : BridgeData (m + 2) z}
    (hm : 0 < m) {Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    tauField (matchedPlacedX hm M).g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y)
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m) P theta) =
      canonTau (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.dimension_ge_two m)
        (theta / (2 * Real.pi))

  exact tauField_matchedPlacedX_targetLift hm M P _

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.det_clmMatrix_toCLM_pos
statement:
theorem det_clmMatrix_toCLM_pos {k : ℕ} (R : SOGroup k) :
    0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix
      (SOFrameGauge.toCLM R :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))).det
proof:
:= by
  have h := CanonicalCircleFrameClass.det_clmMatrix_smul_toCLM_pos
    (1 : ℝ) one_pos R
  rwa [one_smul] at h

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.tauField_harmonizedEndpoint_eq_matchedPlacedX
statement:
theorem tauField_harmonizedEndpoint_eq_matchedPlacedX
    {B : BridgeData (m + 2) z} (hm : 0 < m)
    {Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    tauField (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) =
      tauField (matchedPlacedX hm M).g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : tauField (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) =
      (1 : ℝ) • tauField (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) :=
    CanonicalCircleFrameClass.tauField_gaugeTransform_of_det_pos
      (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁ (G.gauge 1)
      (contDiff_gauge_slice G.gauge_smooth 1)
      (fun x => G.gauge_bijective 1 x)
      (CanonicalCircleFrameClass.point_mem_gaugeEndpoint_fiber hm M F P theta)
      (CanonicalCircleFrameClass.det_clmMatrix_smul_toCLM_pos
        (G.scalar 1) (G.scalar_pos 1) (G.soPath.Q 1))
  have h2 : tauField (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁.g
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) =
      (1 : ℝ) • tauField (matchedPlacedX hm M).g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P theta) :=
    CanonicalCircleFrameClass.tauField_gaugeTransform_of_det_pos
      (matchedPlacedX hm M)
      (fun x => SOFrameGauge.toCLM
        (SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
          (targetField m Y) (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm)
          (F.smoothNullGauge hm) 1 x))
      (SOFrameGauge.contDiff_toCLM (fun i j =>
        ((SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge_smooth
          (targetField m Y) (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm)
          (F.smoothNullGauge hm) i j)).comp
          (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)))
      (fun x => SOFrameGauge.toCLM_bijective _)
      (CanonicalCircleFrameClass.point_mem_matchedPlaced_fiber hm M P theta)
      (det_clmMatrix_toCLM_pos _)
  rw [h1, h2, one_smul, one_smul]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.residual_tau
statement:
theorem residual_tau (hm : 0 < m)
    (Iv : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant (m + 2))
    (B : BridgeData (m + 2) z)
    (P : (targetField m (standardTarget hm B).X).OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    tauField (targetPlacement hm (standardTarget hm B).X).endpointX.g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m (standardTarget hm B).X)
          (by omega) P theta) =
      tauField (harmonizedEndpoint hm (standardMatch Iv hm B)
          (standardFrameMatch Iv hm B) (canonicalGaugeData B)).g
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m (standardTarget hm B).X)
          (by omega) P theta)
proof:
:= by
  have htarget := tauField_placedEndpoint_canonicalPoint
    (targetPlacement hm (standardTarget hm B).X) P theta
  have hsource := tauField_matchedPlacedX_canonicalPoint hm
    (standardMatch Iv hm B) P theta
  have hgauge := tauField_harmonizedEndpoint_eq_matchedPlacedX hm
    (standardMatch Iv hm B) (standardFrameMatch Iv hm B)
    (canonicalGaugeData B) P theta
  rw [hgauge, hsource, htarget]

name: Submission.BridgeEntryResidualExistence.residual
statement:
theorem residual (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (Iv : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant (m + 2)) :
    BridgeEntryTransitionDatumExistence.Residual m hm Iv where
  tau
proof:
:= fun {_z} B P theta => residual_tau hm Iv B P theta
  outer := fun {_z} B => residual_outer hm Iv B

    (m : ℕ) (Iv : SignedCobordismDeltaInvariant (m + 2)) (hm : 0 < m)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.shortEventTime_eq_of_mem_bracket
statement:
theorem shortEventTime_eq_of_mem_bracket
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    {s : ℝ} (hsEvent : s ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hs : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  have hvCritical : D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent ∈
      timeCritical D.signedOutput.cobordism.G :=
    (D.position.eventCenter_mem_coreCriticalPoints s hsEvent).1
  have hvInterval : tcoord (D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent) ∈
      Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
    rw [D.position.eventCenter_time s hsEvent]
    exact hs
  have hvEq : D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent = D.position.eventCenter t ht :=
    (D.position.eventBracket t ht).isolates _ hvCritical hvInterval
  calc
    s = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent) :=
      (D.position.eventCenter_time s hsEvent).symm
    _ = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := congrArg tcoord hvEq
    _ = t := D.position.eventCenter_time t ht

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.regularSlab_shortAfter_to_window
statement:
theorem regularSlab_shortAfter_to_window
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hbw : b < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) :
    regularSlab D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht b) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.position.regularSlab_iff_avoid_eventTimes]
  intro s hsEvent hs
  have hcenterShort : tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
      D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht b := by
    rw [shortAfterTimeAt]
    exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ (sq_pos_of_pos hb)
  have hsBracket : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
    constructor
    · exact (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before_lt.le.trans
        (hcenterShort.le.trans hs.1)
    · exact hs.2.trans (D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht).2.le
  have hst : s = t := D.shortEventTime_eq_of_mem_bracket t ht hsEvent hsBracket
  have htShort : t < D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht b :=
    (D.position.eventCenter_time t ht).symm.trans_lt hcenterShort
  exact (not_le_of_gt htShort) (hst ▸ hs.1)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.regularSlab_window_to_shortBefore
statement:
theorem regularSlab_window_to_shortBefore
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes) {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b)
    (hbw : b < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) :
    regularSlab D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) (D.shortBeforeTimeAt t ht b)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.position.regularSlab_iff_avoid_eventTimes]
  intro s hsEvent hs
  have hshortCenter : D.shortBeforeTimeAt t ht b <
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    rw [shortBeforeTimeAt]
    exact sub_lt_self _ (sq_pos_of_pos hb)
  have hsBracket : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
    constructor
    · exact (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_bracket t ht).1.le.trans hs.1
    · exact hs.2.trans
        (hshortCenter.le.trans (D.position.eventBracket t ht).lt_after.le)
  have hst : s = t := D.shortEventTime_eq_of_mem_bracket t ht hsEvent hsBracket
  have hshortT : D.shortBeforeTimeAt t ht b < t :=
    hshortCenter.trans_eq (D.position.eventCenter_time t ht)
  exact (not_le_of_gt hshortT) (hst ▸ hs.2)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
statement:
theorem shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hbw : b < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
    (V : TamedField (D.shortAfterSlice t ht hb hbw))
    (branch : SaddleBranch) :
    D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw V
        ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
          hindex branch (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) b
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
          (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
          (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) V) =
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex branch
proof:
:= by
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  let afix := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht
  let r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  let sourceTime := D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht b
  let targetTime := D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht
  let hreg := D.regularSlab_shortAfter_to_window t ht hb hbw
  let W := D.shortAfterToWindowSlabField t ht hb hbw
  let Vtarget := D.chronologicalAfterField t ht
  let Oshort := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex branch r b
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
    (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) V
  let c : C(I, ℝ) := {
    toFun := fun q => b + (q : ℝ) * (afix - b)
    continuous_toFun :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const) }
  have hbc (q : I) : b ≤ c q := by
    dsimp [c]
    have hq₀ : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := q.property.1
    have hab : 0 < afix - b := sub_pos.mpr hbw
    nlinarith
  have hca (q : I) : c q ≤ afix := by
    dsimp [c]
    have hq₁ : (q : ℝ) ≤ 1 := q.property.2
    have hab : 0 < afix - b := sub_pos.mpr hbw
    nlinarith
  have hcpos (q : I) : 0 < c q := hb.trans_le (hbc q)
  have hcr (q : I) : c q < r :=
    (hca q).trans_lt (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
  have hcsq (q : I) : (c q) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ (hcpos q).le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht).le).2 (hcr q)
  let u : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun q =>
    saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam branch .negative r (c q)
  have hucont : Continuous u := by
    dsimp [u, c]
    cases branch <;>
      simp [saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam, saddlePositiveArc,
        saddleBoundaryParameter, pairToMorseParam, signedBranch] <;>
      fun_prop
  have huRadius (q : I) : ‖u q‖ < M.radius := by
    rw [show ‖u q‖ = r from
      norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam branch .negative
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) (hcsq q)]
    exact (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      T.radius_le
  let z : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) := {
    toFun := fun q => M.param (u q)
    continuous_toFun := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro q
      exact (H.differentiableAt (u q) (huRadius q)).continuousAt.comp'
        hucont.continuousAt }
  let tau : C(I, ℝ) := {
    toFun := fun q => afix ^ 2 - (c q) ^ 2
    continuous_toFun := continuous_const.sub (c.continuous.pow 2) }
  let gamma : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) := {
    toFun := fun q => spacePart (W.flow (z q) (tau q))
    continuous_toFun := continuous_spacePart.comp
      (W.continuous_flow_uncurry.comp
        (z.continuous.prodMk tau.continuous)) }
  have hsourceMem (q : I) :
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c q) ^ 2 ∈
        Icc sourceTime targetTime := by
    have hbSq : b ^ 2 ≤ (c q) ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ hb.le (hcpos q).le).2 (hbc q)
    have hcSq : (c q) ^ 2 ≤ afix ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (hcpos q).le
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht).le).2 (hca q)
    constructor
    · simpa [sourceTime, shortAfterTimeAt] using
        add_le_add_left hbSq (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
    · simpa [targetTime, chronologicalAfterTime, afix] using
        add_le_add_left hcSq (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
  have htargetMem : targetTime ∈ Icc sourceTime targetTime :=
    D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_Icc t ht hb hbw
  have hzFiber (q : I) : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (z q) = 0 :=
    M.param_fiber (u q) (huRadius q)
  have hzTime (q : I) : tcoord (z q) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c q) ^ 2 := by
    have htime := M.time_model (u q) (huRadius q)
    rw [hindex] at htime
    simpa [z, u, saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam] using htime
  have hgammaFiber : ∀ q,
      gamma q ∈ (D.chronologicalAfterSlice t ht).fiber := by
    intro q
    have hx : spacePart (z q) ∈ SlabTamedField.sliceFiber
        D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c q) ^ 2) := by
      change D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z q))
          (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c q) ^ 2)) = 0
      rw [← hzTime q, spaceTime_spacePart]
      exact hzFiber q
    have hmap := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg (hsourceMem q) htargetMem hx
    have hzst : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z q))
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c q) ^ 2) = z q := by
      rw [← hzTime q, spaceTime_spacePart]
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceTransport, hzst] at hmap
    change D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.G
      (cobSpaceTime (gamma q) targetTime) = 0
    simpa [SlabTamedField.sliceFiber, gamma, tau, targetTime,
      chronologicalAfterTime, afix] using hmap
  have hgamma₀ : gamma 0 =
      W.sliceTransport sourceTime targetTime
        (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r b)) := by
    have hz₀Time : tcoord (z 0) = sourceTime := by
      simpa [sourceTime, shortAfterTimeAt, c] using hzTime 0
    have hz₀st : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z 0)) sourceTime = z 0 := by
      rw [← hz₀Time, spaceTime_spacePart]
    have hz₀Base : z 0 = T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r b := by
      simp [z, u, c,
        StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchBase,
        StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
        StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, r]
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceTransport, ← hz₀Base, hz₀st]
    simp [gamma, tau, z, u, c, sourceTime, targetTime,
      shortAfterTimeAt, chronologicalAfterTime,
      StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchBase,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, afix, r]
  have hgamma₁ : gamma 1 =
      spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r afix) := by
    simp [gamma, tau, z, u, c,
      StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchBase,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, afix, r]
  have hpath := Vtarget.continuousMap_mem_orbit gamma hgammaFiber 1
  rw [hgamma₀, hgamma₁] at hpath
  have hbaseOrbit : spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r b) ∈
      V.orbit (V.orbitPoint Oshort) := by
    rw [← V.orbitPoint_orbit Oshort]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  have hshortMem : sourceTime ∈ Icc sourceTime targetTime :=
    D.shortAfterTimeAt_mem_Icc t ht hb hbw
  have hmapOrbit := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo_orbit hreg
    hshortMem htargetMem V Vtarget (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber Oshort) hbaseOrbit
  have hsame := Vtarget.orbit_eq_of_mem hmapOrbit
  rw [hsame] at hpath
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Vtarget.orbit
      (W.sliceTransport sourceTime targetTime (V.orbitPoint Oshort)) =
    Vtarget.orbit (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r afix))
  exact (Vtarget.orbit_eq_of_mem hpath).symm

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
statement:
theorem shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    {b : ℝ} (hb : 0 < b) (hbw : b < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
    (V : TamedField (D.shortBeforeSlice t ht hb hbw))
    (branch : SaddleBranch) :
    D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw V
        ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
          hindex branch (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) b
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
          (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
          (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) V) =
      D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex branch
proof:
:= by
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  let afix := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht
  let r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  let sourceTime := D.shortBeforeTimeAt t ht b
  let targetTime := D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht
  let hreg := D.regularSlab_window_to_shortBefore t ht hb hbw
  let W := D.windowToShortBeforeSlabField t ht hb hbw
  let Vtarget := D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht
  let Oshort := T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex branch r b
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
    (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) V
  let c : C(I, ℝ) := {
    toFun := fun q => b + (q : ℝ) * (afix - b)
    continuous_toFun :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const) }
  have hbc (q : I) : b ≤ c q := by
    dsimp [c]
    have hq₀ : 0 ≤ (q : ℝ) := q.property.1
    have hab : 0 < afix - b := sub_pos.mpr hbw
    nlinarith
  have hca (q : I) : c q ≤ afix := by
    dsimp [c]
    have hq₁ : (q : ℝ) ≤ 1 := q.property.2
    have hab : 0 < afix - b := sub_pos.mpr hbw
    nlinarith
  have hcpos (q : I) : 0 < c q := hb.trans_le (hbc q)
  have hcr (q : I) : c q < r :=
    (hca q).trans_lt (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
  have hcsq (q : I) : (c q) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ (hcpos q).le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht).le).2 (hcr q)
  let u : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) := fun q =>
    saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam branch .negative r (c q)
  have hucont : Continuous u := by
    dsimp [u, c]
    cases branch <;>
      simp [saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam, saddleNegativeArc,
        saddleBoundaryParameter, pairToMorseParam, signedBranch] <;>
      fun_prop
  have huRadius (q : I) : ‖u q‖ < M.radius := by
    rw [show ‖u q‖ = r from
      norm_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam branch .negative
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) (hcsq q)]
    exact (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      T.radius_le
  let z : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) := {
    toFun := fun q => M.param (u q)
    continuous_toFun := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro q
      exact (H.differentiableAt (u q) (huRadius q)).continuousAt.comp'
        hucont.continuousAt }
  let tau : C(I, ℝ) := {
    toFun := fun q => (c q) ^ 2 - afix ^ 2
    continuous_toFun := (c.continuous.pow 2).sub continuous_const }
  let gamma : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) := {
    toFun := fun q => spacePart (W.flow (z q) (tau q))
    continuous_toFun := continuous_spacePart.comp
      (W.continuous_flow_uncurry.comp
        (z.continuous.prodMk tau.continuous)) }
  have hsourceMem (q : I) :
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - (c q) ^ 2 ∈
        Icc targetTime sourceTime := by
    have hbSq : b ^ 2 ≤ (c q) ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ hb.le (hcpos q).le).2 (hbc q)
    have hcSq : (c q) ^ 2 ≤ afix ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (hcpos q).le
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht).le).2 (hca q)
    constructor
    · simpa [targetTime, chronologicalBeforeTime, afix] using
        sub_le_sub_left hcSq (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
    · simpa [sourceTime, shortBeforeTimeAt] using
        sub_le_sub_left hbSq (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
  have htargetMem : targetTime ∈ Icc targetTime sourceTime :=
    D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_Icc t ht hb hbw
  have hzFiber (q : I) : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (z q) = 0 :=
    M.param_fiber (u q) (huRadius q)
  have hzTime (q : I) : tcoord (z q) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - (c q) ^ 2 := by
    have htime := M.time_model (u q) (huRadius q)
    rw [hindex] at htime
    simpa [z, u, saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam, sub_eq_add_neg] using htime
  have hgammaFiber : ∀ q,
      gamma q ∈ (D.chronologicalBeforeSlice t ht).fiber := by
    intro q
    have hx : spacePart (z q) ∈ SlabTamedField.sliceFiber
        D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - (c q) ^ 2) := by
      change D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z q))
          (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - (c q) ^ 2)) = 0
      rw [← hzTime q, spaceTime_spacePart]
      exact hzFiber q
    have hmap := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg (hsourceMem q) htargetMem hx
    have hzst : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z q))
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - (c q) ^ 2) = z q := by
      rw [← hzTime q, spaceTime_spacePart]
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceTransport, hzst] at hmap
    change D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.G
      (cobSpaceTime (gamma q) targetTime) = 0
    simpa [SlabTamedField.sliceFiber, gamma, tau, targetTime,
      chronologicalBeforeTime, afix] using hmap
  have hgamma₀ : gamma 0 =
      W.sliceTransport sourceTime targetTime
        (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase branch r b)) := by
    have hz₀Time : tcoord (z 0) = sourceTime := by
      simpa [sourceTime, shortBeforeTimeAt, c] using hzTime 0
    have hz₀st : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z 0)) sourceTime = z 0 := by
      rw [← hz₀Time, spaceTime_spacePart]
    have hz₀Base : z 0 = T.saddleNegativeBranchBase branch r b := by
      simp [z, u, c,
        StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeBranchBase,
        StandardMorseEventAt.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd,
        StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, r]
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceTransport, ← hz₀Base, hz₀st]
    simp [gamma, tau, z, u, c, sourceTime, targetTime,
      shortBeforeTimeAt, chronologicalBeforeTime,
      StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeBranchBase,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, afix, r]
  have hgamma₁ : gamma 1 =
      spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase branch r afix) := by
    simp [gamma, tau, z, u, c,
      StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeBranchBase,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, afix, r]
  have hpath := Vtarget.continuousMap_mem_orbit gamma hgammaFiber 1
  rw [hgamma₀, hgamma₁] at hpath
  have hbaseOrbit : spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase branch r b) ∈
      V.orbit (V.orbitPoint Oshort) := by
    rw [← V.orbitPoint_orbit Oshort]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  have hshortMem : sourceTime ∈ Icc targetTime sourceTime :=
    D.shortBeforeTimeAt_mem_Icc t ht hb hbw
  have hmapOrbit := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo_orbit hreg
    hshortMem htargetMem V Vtarget (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber Oshort) hbaseOrbit
  have hsame := Vtarget.orbit_eq_of_mem hmapOrbit
  rw [hsame] at hpath
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Vtarget.orbit
      (W.sliceTransport sourceTime targetTime (V.orbitPoint Oshort)) =
    Vtarget.orbit (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase branch r afix))
  exact (Vtarget.orbit_eq_of_mem hpath).symm

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.smooth_normal
statement: theorem smooth_normal (j : Fin n) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (F.normal j)

:=
  F.smooth_frame j.succ

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.periodic_normal

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.smooth_tubeLift
statement: theorem smooth_tubeLift : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F.tubeLift
proof:
:= by
  apply F.smooth_lift.comp contDiff_fst |>.add
  apply ContDiff.sum
  intro j _
  exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj j).contDiff.comp contDiff_snd).smul
    ((F.smooth_normal j).comp contDiff_fst)

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.tubeLift_zero
statement:

    F.tubeLift (u, 0) = F.lift u

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.periodic_tubeLift
statement:
theorem periodic_tubeLift (z : N[n]) :
    Function.Periodic (fun u => F.tubeLift (u, z)) 1
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  simp only [tubeLift]
  rw [F.periodic_lift u]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro j _
  rw [F.periodic_normal j u]

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.continuous_tube

:= by

      (Prod.map (fun u : ℝ => (u : C)) (id : N[n] → N[n])) :=
    QuotientAddGroup.isOpenQuotientMap_mk.prodMap IsOpenQuotientMap.id

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.tubeDeriv_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tubeDeriv_apply (u a : ℝ) (z : N[n]) :
    F.tubeDeriv u (a, z) =
      a • (F.speed u • F.frame u 0) +
        ∑ j : Fin n, z j • F.normal j u
proof:
:= by
  simp [tubeDeriv]

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.hasFDerivAt_tubeLift_zero
statement:
theorem hasFDerivAt_tubeLift_zero (u : ℝ) :
    HasFDerivAt F.tubeLift (F.tubeDeriv u) (u, 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hfst : HasFDerivAt (fun q : ℝ × N[n] => q.1)
      (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ N[n]) (u, 0) :=
    hasFDerivAt_fst
  have hbase : HasFDerivAt
      (fun q : ℝ × N[n] => F.lift q.1)
      ((ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ
        (F.speed u • F.frame u 0)).comp
        (ContinuousLinearMap.fst ℝ ℝ N[n])) (u, 0) := by
    exact F.hasDerivAt_lift u |>.hasFDerivAt.comp
      (f := fun q : ℝ × N[n] => q.1) (g := F.lift) (u, 0) hfst
  have hnormal' : HasFDerivAt
      (∑ j : Fin n, fun q : ℝ × N[n] =>
        q.2 j • F.normal j q.1)
      (∑ j : Fin n,
        (((EuclideanSpace.proj j).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ N[n])).smulRight
            (F.normal j u))) (u, 0) := by
    apply HasFDerivAt.sum
    intro j _
    have hc := ((EuclideanSpace.proj j).comp
      (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ N[n])).hasFDerivAt
      (x := (u, (0 : N[n])))
    have hN : HasFDerivAt
        (fun q : ℝ × N[n] => F.normal j q.1)
        (fderiv ℝ (fun q : ℝ × N[n] => F.normal j q.1) (u, 0))
        (u, 0) :=
      ((F.smooth_normal j).comp contDiff_fst).differentiable
        (by simp) (u, 0) |>.hasFDerivAt
    convert hc.smul hN using 1
    · rfl
    · simp
  have hnormal : HasFDerivAt
      (fun q : ℝ × N[n] =>
        ∑ j : Fin n, q.2 j • F.normal j q.1)
      (∑ j : Fin n,
        (((EuclideanSpace.proj j).comp
          (ContinuousLinearMap.snd ℝ ℝ N[n])).smulRight
            (F.normal j u))) (u, 0) := by
    convert hnormal' using 1
    funext q
    simp
  exact hbase.add hnormal

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.tubeDeriv_bijective
statement:
theorem tubeDeriv_bijective (u : ℝ) :
    Function.Bijective (F.tubeDeriv u)
proof:
:= by
  let B : Fin (n + 1) → E[n] := F.frame u
  have hinner : ∀ i j, ⟪B i, B j⟫_ℝ = if i = j then 1 else 0 :=
    orthonormal_iff_ite.mp (F.orthonormal_frame u)
  have hinj : Function.Injective (F.tubeDeriv u) := by
    rw [injective_iff_map_eq_zero]
    rintro ⟨a, z⟩ hzero
    have hformula :
        a • (F.speed u • B 0) + ∑ j : Fin n, z j • B j.succ = 0 := by
      simpa [B, normal] using hzero
    have haeq : a * F.speed u = 0 := by
      have h := congrArg (fun x : E[n] => ⟪B 0, x⟫_ℝ) hformula
      simp only [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, inner_sum,
        inner_zero_right] at h
      rw [hinner 0 0] at h
      have hsum : ∑ j : Fin n, z j * ⟪B 0, B j.succ⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
        intro j _
        rw [hinner 0 j.succ, if_neg (Ne.symm j.succ_ne_zero)]
        simp
      rw [hsum, add_zero] at h
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h
    have ha : a = 0 :=
      (mul_eq_zero.mp haeq).resolve_right (ne_of_gt (F.speed_pos u))
    have hz : z = 0 := by
      ext j
      have h := congrArg (fun x : E[n] => ⟪B j.succ, x⟫_ℝ) hformula
      simp only [inner_add_right, real_inner_smul_right, inner_sum,
        inner_zero_right] at h
      rw [ha, zero_mul, zero_add] at h
      have hsum :
          ∑ k : Fin n, z k * ⟪B j.succ, B k.succ⟫_ℝ = z j := by
        rw [Finset.sum_eq_single j]
        · rw [hinner j.succ j.succ]
          simp
        · intro k _ hkj
          rw [hinner j.succ k.succ]
          rw [if_neg ((Fin.succ_injective n).ne (Ne.symm hkj))]
          simp
        · simp
      rw [hsum] at h
      simpa using h
    exact Prod.ext ha hz
  refine ⟨hinj, ?_⟩
  have hfr : finrank ℝ (ℝ × N[n]) = finrank ℝ E[n] := by
    rw [Module.finrank_prod, Module.finrank_self,
      finrank_euclideanSpace_fin, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    omega
  exact (LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective_of_finrank_eq_finrank hfr).mp hinj

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.tubeDerivEquiv_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem tubeDerivEquiv_coe (u : ℝ) :
    (F.tubeDerivEquiv u : (ℝ × N[n]) →L[ℝ] E[n]) = F.tubeDeriv u

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.tubeLocalHomeomorph_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem tubeLocalHomeomorph_coe (u : ℝ) :
    (F.tubeLocalHomeomorph u : (ℝ × N[n]) → E[n]) = F.tubeLift
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.tube_center_mem_localSource
statement:
theorem tube_center_mem_localSource (u : ℝ) :
    (u, (0 : N[n])) ∈ (F.tubeLocalHomeomorph u).source
proof:
:= by
  exact F.smooth_tubeLift.contDiffAt
    |>.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source
      (by
        rw [F.tubeDerivEquiv_coe u]
        exact F.hasFDerivAt_tubeLift_zero u)
      (by simp)

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.tube_injOn_localSource
statement:
theorem tube_injOn_localSource (u : ℝ) :
    Set.InjOn F.tubeLift (F.tubeLocalHomeomorph u).source
proof:
:= by
  rw [← F.tubeLocalHomeomorph_coe u]
  exact (F.tubeLocalHomeomorph u).injOn

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.exists_tube_local_box
statement:
theorem exists_tube_local_box (u : ℝ) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∃ r > 0,
      Ioo (u - ε) (u + ε) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) r ⊆
        (F.tubeLocalHomeomorph u).source
proof:
:= by
  have hnhds : (F.tubeLocalHomeomorph u).source ∈ 𝓝 (u, (0 : N[n])) :=
    (F.tubeLocalHomeomorph u).open_source.mem_nhds
      (F.tube_center_mem_localSource u)
  rcases mem_nhds_prod_iff.mp hnhds with ⟨U, hU, W, hW, hUW⟩
  rcases Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU with ⟨ε, hε, hεU⟩
  rcases Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hW with ⟨r, hr, hrW⟩
  refine ⟨ε, hε, r, hr, ?_⟩
  rw [← Real.ball_eq_Ioo]
  exact (prod_mono hεU hrW).trans hUW

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.isOpen_tubeQuotientBox

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.tube_zero_mem_quotientBox

@[simp] theorem tube_zero_mem_quotientBox (u : ℝ) :

proof:
