name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.tube_injOn_quotientBox
statement:
theorem tube_injOn_quotientBox (u : ℝ) :
    Set.InjOn F.tube (F.tubeQuotientBox u)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨a, z⟩ ⟨⟨ua, hua, rfl⟩, hz⟩
    ⟨b, w⟩ ⟨⟨ub, hub, rfl⟩, hw⟩ heq
  have heqLift : F.tubeLift (ua, z) = F.tubeLift (ub, w) := by
    simpa using heq
  have hmema : (ua, z) ∈ (F.tubeLocalHomeomorph u).source :=
    (F.tubeLocalBoxData u).box_subset_source ⟨hua, hz⟩
  have hmemb : (ub, w) ∈ (F.tubeLocalHomeomorph u).source :=
    (F.tubeLocalBoxData u).box_subset_source ⟨hub, hw⟩
  have hpair := F.tube_injOn_localSource u hmema hmemb heqLift
  cases hpair
  rfl

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.exists_tube_global_injOn
statement:
theorem exists_tube_global_injOn :
    ∃ r > 0, Set.InjOn F.tube
      ((Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) r)
proof:
:= by
  let Z : Set (C × N[n]) := Set.range fun a : C => (a, (0 : N[n]))
  have hZinj : Set.InjOn F.tube Z := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩ _ ⟨b, rfl⟩ hab
    have hab' : F.circle a = F.circle b := by simpa using hab
    have habase : a = b := F.isEmbedding_circle.injective hab'
    subst b
    rfl
  have hZcompact : IsCompact Z :=
    isCompact_range (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hlocal : ∀ q ∈ Z, ∃ U ∈ 𝓝 q, Set.InjOn F.tube U := by
    rintro _ ⟨a, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
    exact ⟨F.tubeQuotientBox u,
      (F.isOpen_tubeQuotientBox u).mem_nhds (F.tube_zero_mem_quotientBox u),
      F.tube_injOn_quotientBox u⟩
  obtain ⟨T, hTopen, hZT, hTinj⟩ := hZinj.exists_isOpen_superset
    hZcompact (fun _ _ => F.continuous_tube.continuousAt) hlocal
  have hzeroSection : (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ ({0} : Set N[n]) ⊆ T := by
    rintro ⟨a, z⟩ ⟨-, hz⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    change z = 0 at hz
    subst z
    exact hZT ⟨a, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨U, W, hUopen, hWopen, hCU, hzeroW, hUWT⟩ :=
    generalized_tube_lemma (X := C) (Y := N[n])
      isCompact_univ isCompact_singleton hTopen hzeroSection
  have hzero_mem_W : (0 : N[n]) ∈ W := hzeroW (Set.mem_singleton 0)
  rcases (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hWopen) 0 hzero_mem_W with ⟨r, hr, hrW⟩
  refine ⟨r, hr, hTinj.mono ?_⟩
  exact (prod_mono hCU hrW).trans hUWT

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.exists_tube_global_embedding
statement:
theorem exists_tube_global_embedding :
    ∃ r > 0,
      Set.InjOn F.tube
        ((Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) r) ∧
      Topology.IsEmbedding
        (fun q : ↥((Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) r) =>
          F.tube q.1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRinj⟩ := F.exists_tube_global_injOn
  let r : ℝ := R / 2
  have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  have hrR : r < R := by dsimp [r]; linarith
  let Dopen : Set (C × N[n]) :=
    (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) r
  let Dclosed : Set (C × N[n]) :=
    (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.closedBall (0 : N[n]) r
  have hopenClosed : Dopen ⊆ Dclosed :=
    prod_mono Subset.rfl Metric.ball_subset_closedBall
  have hclosedBig : Dclosed ⊆
      (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) R :=
    prod_mono Subset.rfl (Metric.closedBall_subset_ball hrR)
  have hinjClosed : Set.InjOn F.tube Dclosed := hRinj.mono hclosedBig
  have hcompact : IsCompact Dclosed :=
    isCompact_univ.prod (isCompact_closedBall (0 : N[n]) r)
  letI : CompactSpace Dclosed := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hcompact
  have hcontClosed : Continuous (fun q : Dclosed => F.tube q.1) :=
    F.continuous_tube.comp continuous_subtype_val
  have hinjClosed' : Function.Injective (fun q : Dclosed => F.tube q.1) := by
    intro p q hpq
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hinjClosed p.property q.property hpq
  have hembClosed : Topology.IsEmbedding (fun q : Dclosed => F.tube q.1) :=
    (hcontClosed.isClosedEmbedding hinjClosed').isEmbedding
  have hembOpen : Topology.IsEmbedding (fun q : Dopen => F.tube q.1) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Set.inclusion] using
      hembClosed.comp (Topology.IsEmbedding.inclusion hopenClosed)
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hRinj.mono (prod_mono Subset.rfl
      (Metric.ball_subset_ball (le_of_lt hrR)))
  · exact hembOpen

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.periodic_fderiv_tubeLift
statement:
theorem periodic_fderiv_tubeLift :
    Function.Periodic (fun q : ℝ × N[n] => fderiv ℝ F.tubeLift q)
      ((1 : ℝ), (0 : N[n]))
proof:
:= by
  have hfun :
      (fun q : ℝ × N[n] => F.tubeLift (q + ((1 : ℝ), (0 : N[n])))) =
      F.tubeLift := by
    funext q
    rcases q with ⟨u, z⟩
    simpa only [Prod.mk_add_mk, add_zero] using F.periodic_tubeLift z u
  intro q
  have h := congrArg (fun f : (ℝ × N[n]) → E[n] => fderiv ℝ f q) hfun
  simpa only [fderiv_comp_add_right] using h

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.isOpen_tubeLift_regularSet
statement:
theorem isOpen_tubeLift_regularSet :
    IsOpen ((fderiv ℝ F.tubeLift) ⁻¹'
      Set.range ((↑) : (((ℝ × N[n]) ≃L[ℝ] E[n]) →
        ((ℝ × N[n]) →L[ℝ] E[n]))))
proof:
:= by
  exact ContinuousLinearEquiv.isOpen.preimage
    (F.smooth_tubeLift.continuous_fderiv (by simp))

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.tubeLift_zero_mem_regularSet
statement:
theorem tubeLift_zero_mem_regularSet (u : ℝ) :
    (u, (0 : N[n])) ∈ (fderiv ℝ F.tubeLift) ⁻¹'
      Set.range ((↑) : (((ℝ × N[n]) ≃L[ℝ] E[n]) →
        ((ℝ × N[n]) →L[ℝ] E[n])))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨F.tubeDerivEquiv u, ?_⟩
  rw [F.tubeDerivEquiv_coe u]
  exact (F.hasFDerivAt_tubeLift_zero u).fderiv.symm

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.exists_tubeLift_uniform_deriv_equiv
statement:
theorem exists_tubeLift_uniform_deriv_equiv :
    ∃ r > 0, ∀ (u : ℝ) (z : N[n]), z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) r →
      ∃ e : (ℝ × N[n]) ≃L[ℝ] E[n],
        (e : (ℝ × N[n]) →L[ℝ] E[n]) = fderiv ℝ F.tubeLift (u, z)
proof:
:= by
  let A := Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  let R : Set (ℝ × N[n]) :=
    (fderiv ℝ F.tubeLift) ⁻¹' Set.range
      ((↑) : (((ℝ × N[n]) ≃L[ℝ] E[n]) →
        ((ℝ × N[n]) →L[ℝ] E[n])))
  let j : A × N[n] → ℝ × N[n] := fun q => (q.1.1, q.2)
  let T : Set (A × N[n]) := j ⁻¹' R
  have hAcompact : IsCompact A := isCompact_Icc
  letI : CompactSpace A := isCompact_iff_compactSpace.mp hAcompact
  have hj : Continuous j :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst |>.prodMk continuous_snd
  have hTopen : IsOpen T := F.isOpen_tubeLift_regularSet.preimage hj
  have hzero : (Set.univ : Set A) ×ˢ ({0} : Set N[n]) ⊆ T := by
    rintro ⟨a, z⟩ ⟨-, hz⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hz
    change z = 0 at hz
    subst z
    exact F.tubeLift_zero_mem_regularSet a.1
  obtain ⟨U, W, hUopen, hWopen, hAU, hzeroW, hUWT⟩ :=
    generalized_tube_lemma (X := A) (Y := N[n])
      isCompact_univ isCompact_singleton hTopen hzero
  have hzero_mem_W : (0 : N[n]) ∈ W := hzeroW (Set.mem_singleton 0)
  rcases (Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hWopen) 0 hzero_mem_W with ⟨r, hr, hrW⟩
  refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
  intro u z hz
  let a : A := ⟨Int.fract u, Int.fract_nonneg u, (Int.fract_lt_one u).le⟩
  have hregFract : (Int.fract u, z) ∈ R := by
    have ht : (a, z) ∈ T := hUWT ⟨hAU (Set.mem_univ a), hrW hz⟩
    exact ht
  have hperiod := F.periodic_fderiv_tubeLift.zsmul ⌊u⌋
  have heq : fderiv ℝ F.tubeLift (u, z) =
      fderiv ℝ F.tubeLift (Int.fract u, z) := by
    have h := hperiod (Int.fract u, z)
    have hpoint :
        (Int.fract u, z) + ⌊u⌋ • ((1 : ℝ), (0 : N[n])) = (u, z) := by
      ext
      · simpa [add_comm] using Int.fract_add_floor u
      · simp
    rw [hpoint] at h
    exact h
  rw [heq]
  exact hregFract

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.nonempty_globalSmoothTube
statement: theorem nonempty_globalSmoothTube : Nonempty F.GlobalSmoothTube
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR, hRinj, hRemb⟩ := F.exists_tube_global_embedding
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hSderiv⟩ := F.exists_tubeLift_uniform_deriv_equiv
  let r : ℝ := min R S
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hR hS
  have hrR : r ≤ R := min_le_left R S
  have hrS : r ≤ S := min_le_right R S
  let D : Set (C × N[n]) :=
    (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) r
  let DR : Set (C × N[n]) :=
    (Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) R
  have hDR : D ⊆ DR := prod_mono Subset.rfl (Metric.ball_subset_ball hrR)
  have hinj : Set.InjOn F.tube D := hRinj.mono hDR
  have hemb : Topology.IsEmbedding (fun q : D => F.tube q.1) := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def, Set.inclusion, D, DR] using
      hRemb.comp (Topology.IsEmbedding.inclusion hDR)
  have hzeroD : ((0 : C), (0 : N[n])) ∈ D :=
    ⟨Set.mem_univ _, Metric.mem_ball_self hr⟩
  let qzero : D := ⟨((0 : C), (0 : N[n])), hzeroD⟩
  letI : Nonempty D := ⟨qzero⟩
  let tubeD : D → E[n] := fun q => F.tube q.1
  have htube_inj : Function.Injective tubeD := by
    intro p q hpq
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact hinj p.property q.property hpq
  let invTube : E[n] → D := Function.invFun tubeD
  let inverse : E[n] → C × N[n] := fun y => (invTube y).1
  have hinverse_left : ∀ q ∈ D, inverse (F.tube q) = q := by
    intro q hq
    let qs : D := ⟨q, hq⟩
    have hi : invTube (tubeD qs) = qs :=
      Function.leftInverse_invFun htube_inj qs
    exact congrArg Subtype.val hi
  refine ⟨{
    radius := r
    radius_pos := hr
    inverse := inverse
    injOn := hinj
    embedding := hemb
    inverse_left := hinverse_left
    local_smooth_lift := ?_
  }⟩
  intro u z hz
  have hzS : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) S :=
    Metric.ball_subset_ball hrS hz
  obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := hSderiv u z hzS
  have hf : HasFDerivAt F.tubeLift (e : (ℝ × N[n]) →L[ℝ] E[n]) (u, z) := by
    have hf' := F.smooth_tubeLift.differentiable (by simp) (u, z) |>.hasFDerivAt
    rw [he]
    exact hf'
  let chart : OpenPartialHomeomorph (ℝ × N[n]) E[n] :=
    F.smooth_tubeLift.contDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph F.tubeLift hf (by simp)
  let g : E[n] → ℝ × N[n] := chart.symm
  have hsource : (u, z) ∈ chart.source :=
    F.smooth_tubeLift.contDiffAt
      |>.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hf (by simp)
  have htarget : F.tubeLift (u, z) ∈ chart.target := chart.map_source hsource
  have hgcenter : g (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z) := by
    change chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z)
    rw [← show (chart : (ℝ × N[n]) → E[n]) = F.tubeLift by rfl]
    exact chart.left_inv hsource
  have hforwardDeriv : HasFDerivAt chart
      (e : (ℝ × N[n]) →L[ℝ] E[n])
      (chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z) by exact hgcenter]
    exact hf
  have hforwardSmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ chart
      (chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z) by exact hgcenter]
    exact F.smooth_tubeLift.contDiffAt
  have hgsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (F.tubeLift (u, z)) :=
    chart.contDiffAt_symm htarget hforwardDeriv hforwardSmooth
  have hgderiv : HasFDerivAt g (e.symm : E[n] →L[ℝ] (ℝ × N[n]))
      (F.tubeLift (u, z)) :=
    chart.hasFDerivAt_symm htarget hforwardDeriv
  have hlocal : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 (u, z), g (F.tubeLift p) = p :=
    chart.eventually_left_inverse hsource
  have hball : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 (u, z), p.2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) r :=
    continuous_snd.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hz)
  refine ⟨e, g, hf, hgsmooth, hgderiv, hgcenter, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hlocal, hball] with p hp hpr
  have hglobal := hinverse_left (((p.1 : ℝ) : C), p.2)
    ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hpr⟩
  rw [F.tube_coe p.1 p.2] at hglobal
  simpa [hp] using hglobal

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.globalSmoothTube_inverse_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem globalSmoothTube_inverse_apply (q : C × N[n])

    (isCompact_closedBall (0 : N[n]) D.radialBump.rOut)).image

statement:
theorem tube_inverse_right {x : E[n]} (hx : x ∈ D.tubeImage) :
    F.tube (F.globalSmoothTube.inverse x) = x
proof:
:= by

theorem ambientField_tube (q : C × N[n]) (hq : q ∈ D.tubeDomain) :
    D.ambientField (F.tube q) =
      D.radialBump q.2 • D.quotientDisplacement q.1
proof:
:= by
  rw [ambientField, if_pos ⟨q, hq, rfl⟩,
    F.globalSmoothTube.inverse_left q hq]

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.ambientField_tubeLift
statement:
theorem ambientField_tubeLift (u : ℝ) (z : N[n])
    (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) F.globalSmoothTube.radius) :
    D.ambientField (F.tubeLift (u, z)) =
      D.radialBump z • D.displacement u
proof:
:= by
  rw [← F.tube_coe u z,
    D.ambientField_tube ((u : C), z) ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hz⟩,
    D.quotientDisplacement_coe]

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.ambientField_zeroSection
statement:
theorem ambientField_zeroSection (u : ℝ) :
    D.ambientField (F.tubeLift (u, (0 : N[n]))) = D.displacement u
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (0 : N[n]) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) F.globalSmoothTube.radius :=
    Metric.mem_ball_self F.globalSmoothTube.radius_pos
  rw [D.ambientField_tubeLift u 0 hz]
  have hb : D.radialBump (0 : N[n]) = 1 := by
    apply D.radialBump.one_of_mem_closedBall
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using D.radialBump.rIn_pos.le
  simp [hb]

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_tubeImage
statement:
theorem ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_tubeImage {x : E[n]}
    (hx : x ∉ D.tubeImage) : D.ambientField x = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [ambientField, hx]

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore
statement:
theorem ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore {x : E[n]}
    (hx : x ∉ D.supportCore) : D.ambientField x = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : x ∈ D.tubeImage
  · let q : C × N[n] := F.globalSmoothTube.inverse x
    have hq : q ∈ D.tubeDomain := D.inverse_mem_tubeDomain ht
    have houter : D.radialBump.rOut ≤ ‖q.2‖ := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hle : ‖q.2‖ ≤ D.radialBump.rOut := (lt_of_not_ge hnot).le
      apply hx
      refine ⟨q, ⟨Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩, D.tube_inverse_right ht⟩
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_left] using hle
    have hb : D.radialBump q.2 = 0 :=
      D.radialBump.zero_of_le_dist (by simpa [dist_zero_right] using houter)
    rw [ambientField, if_pos ht]
    simp [q, hb]
  · exact D.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_tubeImage ht

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.hasCompactSupport_ambientField
statement: theorem hasCompactSupport_ambientField : HasCompactSupport D.ambientField
proof:
:=
  HasCompactSupport.intro D.isCompact_supportCore
    (fun x hx => D.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore hx)

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.contDiffAt_ambientField_tubeLift
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_ambientField_tubeLift (u : ℝ) (z : N[n])
    (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) F.globalSmoothTube.radius) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ D.ambientField (F.tubeLift (u, z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, g₀, hf, hg₀, hg₀deriv, hg₀center, hg₀local⟩ :=
    F.globalSmoothTube.local_smooth_lift u z hz
  let chart : OpenPartialHomeomorph (ℝ × N[n]) E[n] :=
    F.smooth_tubeLift.contDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph F.tubeLift hf (by simp)
  let g : E[n] → ℝ × N[n] := chart.symm
  have hsource : (u, z) ∈ chart.source :=
    F.smooth_tubeLift.contDiffAt
      |>.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hf (by simp)
  have htarget : F.tubeLift (u, z) ∈ chart.target := chart.map_source hsource
  have hgcenter : g (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z) := by
    change chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z)
    rw [← show (chart : (ℝ × N[n]) → E[n]) = F.tubeLift by rfl]
    exact chart.left_inv hsource
  have hforwardDeriv : HasFDerivAt chart
      (e : (ℝ × N[n]) →L[ℝ] E[n])
      (chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z) by exact hgcenter]
    exact hf
  have hforwardSmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ chart
      (chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z) by exact hgcenter]
    exact F.smooth_tubeLift.contDiffAt
  have hgsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (F.tubeLift (u, z)) :=
    chart.contDiffAt_symm htarget hforwardDeriv hforwardSmooth
  have hgball : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (F.tubeLift (u, z)),
      (g y).2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) F.globalSmoothTube.radius := by
    have hg2continuous : ContinuousAt (fun y : E[n] => (g y).2)
        (F.tubeLift (u, z)) :=
      continuous_snd.continuousAt.comp' hgsmooth.continuousAt
    have hzcenter : (g (F.tubeLift (u, z))).2 ∈
        Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) F.globalSmoothTube.radius := by
      rw [hgcenter]
      exact hz
    exact hg2continuous.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzcenter)
  have hright : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (F.tubeLift (u, z)), F.tubeLift (g y) = y := by
    filter_upwards [chart.eventually_right_inverse htarget] with y hy
    exact hy
  have hlocal : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (F.tubeLift (u, z)),
      D.ambientField y =
        D.radialBump (g y).2 • D.displacement (g y).1 := by
    filter_upwards [hright, hgball] with y hy hgy
    let q : C × N[n] := (((g y).1 : C), (g y).2)
    have hq : q ∈ D.tubeDomain := ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hgy⟩
    have hyq : F.tube q = y := by
      rw [F.tube_coe]
      exact hy
    have hytube : y ∈ D.tubeImage := ⟨q, hq, hyq⟩
    have hinv : F.globalSmoothTube.inverse y = q := by
      rw [← hyq]
      exact F.globalSmoothTube.inverse_left q hq
    rw [ambientField, if_pos hytube, hinv, D.quotientDisplacement_coe]
  have hg1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : E[n] => (g y).1)
      (F.tubeLift (u, z)) := contDiffAt_fst.comp _ hgsmooth
  have hg2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : E[n] => (g y).2)
      (F.tubeLift (u, z)) := contDiffAt_snd.comp _ hgsmooth
  have hb : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : E[n] => D.radialBump (g y).2)
      (F.tubeLift (u, z)) := D.radialBump.contDiffAt.comp _ hg2
  have hd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : E[n] => D.displacement (g y).1)
      (F.tubeLift (u, z)) := D.displacement_smooth.contDiffAt.comp _ hg1
  exact (hb.smul hd).congr_of_eventuallyEq hlocal

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.contDiff_ambientField
statement: theorem contDiff_ambientField : ContDiff ℝ ∞ D.ambientField
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ D.supportCore
  · rcases hx with ⟨⟨a, z⟩, hzcore, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
    have hzle : ‖z‖ ≤ D.radialBump.rOut := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_left] using hzcore.2
    have hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) F.globalSmoothTube.radius := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_left] using
        (lt_of_le_of_lt hzle D.radialBump_rOut_lt)
    simpa only [F.tube_coe] using D.contDiffAt_ambientField_tubeLift u z hz
  · have hnear : D.supportCoreᶜ ∈ 𝓝 x :=
      D.isClosed_supportCore.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hx
    apply (show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun _ : E[n] => (0 : E[n])) x from
      contDiffAt_const).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [hnear] with y hy
    exact D.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore hy

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.exists_lipschitzWith_ambientField
statement:
theorem exists_lipschitzWith_ambientField :
    ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K D.ambientField
proof:
:= by
  exact D.contDiff_ambientField.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport
    D.hasCompactSupport_ambientField (by simp)

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.exists_scaledSmallAmbientDisplacement
statement:
theorem exists_scaledSmallAmbientDisplacement :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, ε > 0 ∧ ∃ S : SmallAmbientDisplacement n,
      S.field = (fun x => ε • D.ambientField x) ∧
      ∀ u : ℝ,
        S.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.forward 1 (F.lift u) =
          F.lift u + ε • D.displacement u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, S, hS⟩ := SmallAmbientDisplacement.exists_scaled
    D.ambientField D.contDiff_ambientField D.hasCompactSupport_ambientField
  refine ⟨ε, hε, S, hS, ?_⟩
  intro u
  rw [S.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward_one, hS]
  change F.lift u + ε • D.ambientField (F.lift u) = _
  rw [← F.tubeLift_zero u, D.ambientField_zeroSection]

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.canonicalRadialBump_rOut_lt
statement:
theorem canonicalRadialBump_rOut_lt :
    (canonicalRadialBump F).rOut < F.globalSmoothTube.radius
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [canonicalRadialBump]
  linarith [F.globalSmoothTube.radius_pos]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.eq_of_curve_eq_of_ne_one
statement:
theorem eq_of_curve_eq_of_ne_one {u v : I} (h : P.curve u = P.curve v)
    (hu : u ≠ 1) (hv : v ≠ 1) : u = v
proof:
:= by
  rcases P.curve_eq_cases h with h1 | ⟨-, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, -⟩
  · exact h1
  · exact absurd h2 hv
  · exact absurd h1 hu

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.mem_of_curve_mem_image
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t, htJ, hte⟩ := h
  by_cases ht1 : t = 1
  · have hcz : P.curve (0 : I) = P.curve u := by
      rw [P.curve_closed, ← ht1]; exact hte
    have hzu : (0 : I) = u :=
      P.eq_of_curve_eq_of_ne_one hcz (by
        intro hcon
        have := congrArg Subtype.val hcon
        norm_num at this) hu
    rw [← hzu]
    exact hJ (by rw [← ht1]; exact htJ)
  · have htu : t = u := P.eq_of_curve_eq_of_ne_one hte ht1 hu
    rw [← htu]
    exact htJ

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.sortedMark_lt
statement:
theorem sortedMark_lt (A : P.CyclicMarking 1) :
    A.sortedMark 0 < A.sortedMark 1
proof:
:=
  A.sortedMark_strictMono (by decide)

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.range_adjacentSubpath_eq
statement:
theorem range_adjacentSubpath_eq (A : P.CyclicMarking 1) :
    Set.range (A.adjacentSubpath 0) = P.curve '' A.adjParams
proof:
:= by
  have hc0 : ((0 : Fin 1).castSucc) = (0 : Fin 2) := by decide
  have hc1 : ((0 : Fin 1).succ) = (1 : Fin 2) := by decide
  rw [A.range_adjacentSubpath 0, hc0, hc1]
  rfl

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.range_wrapSubpath_eq
statement:
theorem range_wrapSubpath_eq (A : P.CyclicMarking 1) :
    Set.range A.wrapSubpath = P.curve '' A.wrapParams
proof:
:= by
  have hlast : (Fin.last 1) = (1 : Fin 2) := by decide
  rw [A.range_wrapSubpath, hlast]
  rfl

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.one_mem_adjParams_imp
statement:
theorem one_mem_adjParams_imp (A : P.CyclicMarking 1) :
    (1 : I) ∈ A.adjParams → (0 : I) ∈ A.adjParams
proof:
:= by
  intro hmem
  exact absurd (le_antisymm unitInterval.le_one' (Set.mem_Icc.mp hmem).2)
    (A.sortedMark_ne_one 1)

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.one_mem_wrapParams_imp
statement:
theorem one_mem_wrapParams_imp (A : P.CyclicMarking 1) :
    (1 : I) ∈ A.wrapParams → (0 : I) ∈ A.wrapParams
proof:
:= by
  intro _
  exact Or.inr (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_rfl, unitInterval.nonneg'⟩)

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.exists_sortedMark_point
statement:
theorem exists_sortedMark_point (A : P.CyclicMarking 1) (l : Fin 2) :
    ∃ r : Fin 2, A.point l = P.curve (A.sortedMark r)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨A.sortedLabel.symm l, ?_⟩
  have hmark : A.sortedMark (A.sortedLabel.symm l) = A.mark l := by
    show A.mark (A.sortedLabel (A.sortedLabel.symm l)) = A.mark l
    rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  rw [hmark, A.curve_mark]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.finTwoCases
statement: theorem finTwoCases : ∀ r : Fin 2, r = 0 ∨ r = 1
proof: := by decide

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.two_mark_dichotomy
statement:
theorem two_mark_dichotomy (A B : P.CyclicMarking 1)
    (hb : ∀ r : Fin 2, B.sortedMark r ∈ A.adjParams) :
    B.adjParams ⊆ A.adjParams ∧ ∀ r : Fin 2, A.sortedMark r ∈ B.wrapParams
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := Set.mem_Icc.mp (hb 0)
  have h1 := Set.mem_Icc.mp (hb 1)
  constructor
  · exact Set.Icc_subset_Icc h0.1 h1.2
  · intro r
    rcases finTwoCases r with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨unitInterval.nonneg', h0.1⟩)
    · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h1.2, unitInterval.le_one'⟩)

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.two_mark_dichotomy_wrap
statement:
theorem two_mark_dichotomy_wrap (A B : P.CyclicMarking 1)
    (hb : ∀ r : Fin 2, B.sortedMark r ∈ A.wrapParams) :
    (B.adjParams ⊆ A.wrapParams ∧
        ∀ r : Fin 2, A.sortedMark r ∈ B.wrapParams) ∨
      (B.wrapParams ⊆ A.wrapParams ∧
        ∀ r : Fin 2, A.sortedMark r ∈ B.adjParams)
proof:
:= by
  have haa : A.sortedMark 0 < A.sortedMark 1 := A.sortedMark_lt
  have hbb : B.sortedMark 0 < B.sortedMark 1 := B.sortedMark_lt
  rcases hb 0 with h0 | h0 <;> rcases hb 1 with h1 | h1
  · 
    have h0' := Set.mem_Icc.mp h0
    have h1' := Set.mem_Icc.mp h1
    refine Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (Set.Icc_subset_Icc h0'.1 h1'.2).trans Set.subset_union_left
    · intro r
      rcases finTwoCases r with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_Icc.mpr
          ⟨unitInterval.nonneg', le_trans haa.le h0'.1⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨unitInterval.nonneg', h0'.1⟩)
  · 
    exfalso
    have h0' := Set.mem_Icc.mp h0
    have h1' := Set.mem_Icc.mp h1
    exact absurd (lt_of_lt_of_le (lt_of_le_of_lt h0'.1 hbb) h1'.2)
      (not_lt.mpr haa.le)
  · 
    have h0' := Set.mem_Icc.mp h0
    have h1' := Set.mem_Icc.mp h1
    refine Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact Set.union_subset_union (Set.Icc_subset_Icc h1'.1 le_rfl)
        (Set.Icc_subset_Icc le_rfl h0'.2)
    · intro r
      rcases finTwoCases r with rfl | rfl
      · exact Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h0'.2, le_trans haa.le h1'.1⟩
      · exact Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨le_trans h0'.2 haa.le, h1'.1⟩
  · 
    have h0' := Set.mem_Icc.mp h0
    have h1' := Set.mem_Icc.mp h1
    refine Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (Set.Icc_subset_Icc h0'.1 h1'.2).trans Set.subset_union_right
    · intro r
      rcases finTwoCases r with rfl | rfl
      · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨h1'.2, unitInterval.le_one'⟩)
      · exact Or.inl (Set.mem_Icc.mpr
          ⟨le_trans h1'.2 haa.le, unitInterval.le_one'⟩)

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.inter_adjParams_wrapParams
statement:
theorem inter_adjParams_wrapParams (B : P.CyclicMarking 1)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (h1 : x ∈ P.curve '' B.adjParams) (h2 : x ∈ P.curve '' B.wrapParams) :
    x = P.curve (B.sortedMark 0) ∨ x = P.curve (B.sortedMark 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁, he₁⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨t₂, ht₂, he₂⟩ := h2
  have ht₁' := Set.mem_Icc.mp ht₁
  have ht₁ne : t₁ ≠ 1 := by
    intro hcon
    exact absurd (le_antisymm unitInterval.le_one' (hcon ▸ ht₁'.2))
      (B.sortedMark_ne_one 1)
  by_cases ht₂one : t₂ = 1
  · have hcz : P.curve (0 : I) = P.curve t₁ := by
      rw [P.curve_closed, he₁, ← he₂, ht₂one]
    have hz : (0 : I) = t₁ :=
      P.eq_of_curve_eq_of_ne_one hcz (by
        intro hcon
        have := congrArg Subtype.val hcon
        norm_num at this) ht₁ne
    left
    rw [← he₁, ← hz]
    exact congrArg P.curve (le_antisymm unitInterval.nonneg' (hz ▸ ht₁'.1))
  · have ht : t₂ = t₁ := by
      refine P.eq_of_curve_eq_of_ne_one ?_ ht₂one ht₁ne
      rw [he₂, he₁]
    rcases ht₂ with hup | hlow
    · right
      rw [← he₁]
      exact congrArg P.curve
        (le_antisymm ht₁'.2 (ht ▸ (Set.mem_Icc.mp hup).1))
    · left
      rw [← he₁]
      exact congrArg P.curve
        (le_antisymm (ht ▸ (Set.mem_Icc.mp hlow).2) ht₁'.1)

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.range_subset_cut_or_marks_mem
statement:
theorem range_subset_cut_or_marks_mem
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 1)
    (gamma : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
    (hgamma : ∀ u : I, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (hinj : Function.Injective gamma)
    {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
    (hS : S = Set.range (A.adjacentSubpath 0) ∨ S = Set.range A.wrapSubpath)
    (h0 : gamma 0 ∈ S) (h1 : gamma 1 ∈ S) :
    (Set.range gamma ⊆ S ∧ ∀ l : Fin 2, A.point l ∈ Set.range gamma →
        A.point l = gamma 0 ∨ A.point l = gamma 1) ∨
      (∀ l : Fin 2, A.point l ∈ Set.range gamma)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hzo : (0 : I) ≠ 1 := by
    intro hcon
    have := congrArg Subtype.val hcon
    norm_num at this
  have hne : gamma 0 ≠ gamma 1 := fun h => hzo (hinj h)
  let B : P.CyclicMarking 1 :=
    { point := ![gamma 0, gamma 1]
      point_injective := by
        intro i j hij
        have hij' : (![gamma 0, gamma 1] : Fin 2 → _) i =
            (![gamma 0, gamma 1] : Fin 2 → _) j := hij
        rcases finTwoCases i with rfl | rfl <;>
          rcases finTwoCases j with rfl | rfl
        · rfl
        · exact absurd hij' hne
        · exact absurd hij'.symm hne
        · rfl
      point_mem_orbit := by
        intro i
        rcases finTwoCases i with rfl | rfl
        · exact hgamma 0
        · exact hgamma 1 }
  have hBpoint0 : B.point 0 = gamma 0 := rfl
  have hBpoint1 : B.point 1 = gamma 1 := rfl
  have hBpointS : ∀ l : Fin 2, B.point l ∈ S := by
    intro l
    rcases finTwoCases l with rfl | rfl
    · rw [hBpoint0]; exact h0
    · rw [hBpoint1]; exact h1
  have havoid : ∀ {u : I}, u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : I) 1 →
      ∀ l, gamma u ≠ B.point l := by
    intro u hu l hcon
    rcases finTwoCases l with rfl | rfl
    · rw [hBpoint0] at hcon
      exact absurd (hinj hcon) (ne_of_gt hu.1)
    · rw [hBpoint1] at hcon
      exact absurd (hinj hcon) (ne_of_lt hu.2)
  have hcut := B.range_eq_adjacentSubpath_or_wrap_of_embedded_arc_two gamma
    hgamma hinj 0 1 hBpoint0.symm hBpoint1.symm havoid
  rw [B.range_adjacentSubpath_eq, B.range_wrapSubpath_eq] at hcut
  
  have hcurveB : ∀ r : Fin 2, P.curve (B.sortedMark r) ∈ S := by
    intro r
    have h : P.curve (B.sortedMark r) = B.point (B.sortedLabel r) :=
      B.curve_mark (B.sortedLabel r)
    rw [h]
    exact hBpointS _
  
  have hmain : (P.curve '' B.adjParams ⊆ S ∧
        ∀ r : Fin 2, A.sortedMark r ∈ B.wrapParams) ∨
      (P.curve '' B.wrapParams ⊆ S ∧
        ∀ r : Fin 2, A.sortedMark r ∈ B.adjParams) := by
    rcases hS with hSA | hSA
    · have hSA' : S = P.curve '' A.adjParams := by
        rw [hSA, A.range_adjacentSubpath_eq]
      have hb : ∀ r : Fin 2, B.sortedMark r ∈ A.adjParams := by
        intro r
        refine P.mem_of_curve_mem_image (B.sortedMark_ne_one r)
          A.one_mem_adjParams_imp ?_
        rw [← hSA']
        exact hcurveB r
      obtain ⟨hsub, hm⟩ := two_mark_dichotomy A B hb
      exact Or.inl ⟨by rw [hSA']; exact Set.image_mono hsub, hm⟩
    · have hSA' : S = P.curve '' A.wrapParams := by
        rw [hSA, A.range_wrapSubpath_eq]
      have hb : ∀ r : Fin 2, B.sortedMark r ∈ A.wrapParams := by
        intro r
        refine P.mem_of_curve_mem_image (B.sortedMark_ne_one r)
          A.one_mem_wrapParams_imp ?_
        rw [← hSA']
        exact hcurveB r
      rcases two_mark_dichotomy_wrap A B hb with ⟨hsub, hm⟩ | ⟨hsub, hm⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨by rw [hSA']; exact Set.image_mono hsub, hm⟩
      · exact Or.inr ⟨by rw [hSA']; exact Set.image_mono hsub, hm⟩
  have hBany : ∀ i : Fin 2, B.point i = gamma 0 ∨ B.point i = gamma 1 := by
    intro i
    rcases finTwoCases i with rfl | rfl
    · exact Or.inl hBpoint0
    · exact Or.inr hBpoint1
  have hcm : ∀ r : Fin 2, P.curve (B.sortedMark r) = B.point (B.sortedLabel r) :=
    fun r => B.curve_mark (B.sortedLabel r)
  rcases hcut with hc | hc
  · rcases hmain with ⟨hsub, hm⟩ | ⟨-, hm⟩
    · refine Or.inl ⟨by rw [hc]; exact hsub, ?_⟩
      intro l hl
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := A.exists_sortedMark_point l
      have hin1 : A.point l ∈ P.curve '' B.adjParams := by rw [← hc]; exact hl
      have hin2 : A.point l ∈ P.curve '' B.wrapParams :=
        ⟨A.sortedMark r, hm r, hr.symm⟩
      rcases B.inter_adjParams_wrapParams hin1 hin2 with h | h
      · rw [h, hcm 0]; exact hBany _
      · rw [h, hcm 1]; exact hBany _
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      intro l
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := A.exists_sortedMark_point l
      rw [hr, hc]
      exact ⟨A.sortedMark r, hm r, rfl⟩
  · rcases hmain with ⟨-, hm⟩ | ⟨hsub, hm⟩
    · refine Or.inr ?_
      intro l
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := A.exists_sortedMark_point l
      rw [hr, hc]
      exact ⟨A.sortedMark r, hm r, rfl⟩
    · refine Or.inl ⟨by rw [hc]; exact hsub, ?_⟩
      intro l hl
      obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := A.exists_sortedMark_point l
      have hin2 : A.point l ∈ P.curve '' B.wrapParams := by rw [← hc]; exact hl
      have hin1 : A.point l ∈ P.curve '' B.adjParams :=
        ⟨A.sortedMark r, hm r, hr.symm⟩
      rcases B.inter_adjParams_wrapParams hin1 hin2 with h | h
      · rw [h, hcm 0]; exact hBany _
      · rw [h, hcm 1]; exact hBany _

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.marks_mem_range_of_escape
statement:
theorem marks_mem_range_of_escape
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 1)
    (gamma : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
    (hgamma : ∀ u : I, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (hinj : Function.Injective gamma)
    {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
    (hS : S = Set.range (A.adjacentSubpath 0) ∨ S = Set.range A.wrapSubpath)
    (h0 : gamma 0 ∈ S) (h1 : gamma 1 ∈ S)
    (hesc : ∃ q : I, gamma q ∉ S) :
    ∀ l : Fin 2, A.point l ∈ Set.range gamma
proof:
:= by
  rcases A.range_subset_cut_or_marks_mem gamma hgamma hinj hS h0 h1 with
    ⟨hsub, -⟩ | hm
  · obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hesc
    exact absurd (hsub ⟨q, rfl⟩) hq
  · exact hm

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.marks_mem_range_of_one_mark
statement:
theorem marks_mem_range_of_one_mark
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 1)
    (gamma : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
    (hgamma : ∀ u : I, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (hinj : Function.Injective gamma)
    {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
    (hS : S = Set.range (A.adjacentSubpath 0) ∨ S = Set.range A.wrapSubpath)
    (h0 : gamma 0 ∈ S) (h1 : gamma 1 ∈ S)
    (hs0 : ∀ l : Fin 2, gamma 0 ≠ A.point l)
    (hs1 : ∀ l : Fin 2, gamma 1 ≠ A.point l)
    {l₀ : Fin 2} (hseed : A.point l₀ ∈ Set.range gamma) :
    ∀ l : Fin 2, A.point l ∈ Set.range gamma
proof:
:= by
  rcases A.range_subset_cut_or_marks_mem gamma hgamma hinj hS h0 h1 with
    ⟨-, hm⟩ | hm
  · rcases hm l₀ hseed with h | h
    · exact absurd h.symm (hs0 l₀)
    · exact absurd h.symm (hs1 l₀)
  · exact hm

statement:
theorem center_eq_pullback_chart_point (R : SignedMorseGeometry C B G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) :
    R.center p =
      R.amplitude.diffeomorph.symm ((B.chart p.1).param p.2)
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.SignedMorseGeometry.installed_time_eq_of_chart_overlap
statement:
theorem installed_time_eq_of_chart_overlap
    (R : SignedMorseGeometry C B G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints) (u : E₂)
    (hu : ‖u‖ < (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).radius)
    (q : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hq : q ∈ G.criticalPoints) (w : E₂)
    (hw : ‖w‖ < (G.localMorseNormalForm q hq).radius)
    (hoverlap :
      (B.chart p.1).param (p.2 + G.installedMorseParam p u) =
        (B.chart q.1).param (q.2 + G.installedMorseParam q w)) :
    G.localSeparatedTime p (p.2 + G.installedMorseParam p u) =
      G.localSeparatedTime q (q.2 + G.installedMorseParam q w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← R.time_install p hp u hu, ← R.time_install q hq w hw,
    hoverlap]

name: Submission.SignedMorseGeometry.critical_chart_point_injective
statement:
theorem critical_chart_point_injective (R : SignedMorseGeometry C B G) :
    Set.InjOn (fun p : Σ _ : ι, E₂ => (B.chart p.1).param p.2)
      (G.criticalPoints : Set (Σ _ : ι, E₂))
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp q hq hpq
  change (B.chart p.1).param p.2 = (B.chart q.1).param q.2 at hpq
  apply R.assemblyContract.center_time_injective hp hq
  change tcoord (R.center p) = tcoord (R.center q)
  rw [R.center_eq_pullback_chart_point p hp,
    R.center_eq_pullback_chart_point q hq, hpq]

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel_ne_targetLabel_two
statement:
theorem cyclicCutSourceLabel_ne_targetLabel_two
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 1) (i : Fin 2) :
    A.cyclicCutSourceLabel i ≠ A.cyclicCutTargetLabel i
proof:
:= by
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
      intro h
      simp only [cyclicCutSourceLabel, cyclicCutTargetLabel] at h
      rw [Fin.lastCases_last, Fin.lastCases_last] at h
      have h' : A.sortedLabel (Fin.last 1) = A.sortedLabel 0 := h
      have hindex := A.sortedLabel.injective h'
      have hval := congrArg Fin.val hindex
      norm_num at hval
  | cast j =>
      intro h
      simp only [cyclicCutSourceLabel, cyclicCutTargetLabel] at h
      rw [Fin.lastCases_castSucc, Fin.lastCases_castSucc] at h
      have h' : A.sortedLabel j.castSucc = A.sortedLabel j.succ := h
      exact (Fin.castSucc_lt_succ : j.castSucc < j.succ).ne
        (A.sortedLabel.injective h')

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleDistinctPositive_cutArc
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleDistinctPositive_cutArc
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht))
    (b : SaddleBranch) (e : Fin 2)
    (havoid : ∀ u : E₂,
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) =
        (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale t ht L).scale ^ 2 →
      ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht →
      spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u) ∈
        ((D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryPositiveOrbit t ht hindex L b :
          (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterField t ht L).OrbitIndex) :
            Set E₁) →
      spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u) ∉
        (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryPositiveMarking t ht hindex L
          b).cyclicCutRange e) :
    Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
      (fun p => (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
        D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
      (b, saddleBranchOfFinTwo
        ((D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryPositiveMarking t ht hindex L
          b).cyclicCutSourceLabel e))
      (b, saddleBranchOfFinTwo
        ((D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryPositiveMarking t ht hindex L
          b).cyclicCutTargetLabel e)))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  let Q := D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale t ht L
  let cs : ℝ := Q.scale
  let Laux := D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAuxiliaryData t ht L
  let R := Laux.exteriorSlabTimeField
  let r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  have hrho : 0 < r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hsq : cs ^ 2 < r ^ 2 :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht L
  have hltT : r < T.radius :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  have hrM : r < M.radius := hltT.trans_le T.radius_le
  let A2 := D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryPositiveMarking t ht hindex L b
  
  have hmarkAmb : ∀ l : Fin 2,
      cobSpaceTime (A2.point l)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterTime t ht L) =
        M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs := by
    intro l
    show cobSpaceTime (A2.point l)
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + cs ^ 2) =
      M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs
    have hpt : A2.point l = spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
        (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs) := rfl
    rw [hpt]
    have htX : tcoord (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
        (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + cs ^ 2 :=
      M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hrho hsq hrM
    calc
      cobSpaceTime (spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
          (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs))
          (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + cs ^ 2) =
          cobSpaceTime (spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
            (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs))
            (tcoord (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
              (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs)) := by rw [htX]
      _ = M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs :=
        spaceTime_spacePart _
  
  have hcutMem : ∀ w : I,
      A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w ∈ Laux.exteriorSlabCore := by
    intro w
    have htw : tcoord (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + cs ^ 2 := by
      show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (A2.cyclicCutPath e w)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterTime t ht L)) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + cs ^ 2
      rw [tcoord_spaceTime]
      rfl
    have hfib : D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.G
        (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) = 0 :=
      A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber e w
    refine ⟨⟨hfib, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show tcoord (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) ∈
        Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
          (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after
      rw [htw]
      constructor
      · exact (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before_lt.le.trans
          (le_add_of_nonneg_right (sq_nonneg _))
      · have hc2 : cs ^ 2 ≤ D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
          (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale_sq_lt_window_sq t ht L).le
        have hle : tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + cs ^ 2 ≤
            D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht := by
          rw [chronologicalAfterTime]
          linarith
        exact hle.trans (D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht).2.le
    · show Laux.centerCoverRadius ≤
        dist (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
      by_contra hlt
      rw [not_le] at hlt
      obtain ⟨u', hu', hup⟩ := Laux.centerCover _ hlt hfib
      have huM' : ‖u'‖ < M.radius := hu'.trans hrM
      have hquad' : morseQuadratic .saddle (u' 0, u' 1) = cs ^ 2 := by
        have htm := M.time_model u' huM'
        rw [hindex, hup, htw] at htm
        linarith
      have hsp : spacePart (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) =
          A2.cyclicCutPath e w := by
        show spacePart (cobSpaceTime (A2.cyclicCutPath e w)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterTime t ht L)) =
          A2.cyclicCutPath e w
        rw [spacePart_spaceTime]
      have hmemCut : spacePart (M.param u') ∈ A2.cyclicCutRange e := by
        rw [hup, hsp, ← A2.range_cyclicCutPath e]
        exact ⟨w, rfl⟩
      have horbitMem : spacePart (M.param u') ∈
          ((D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryPositiveOrbit t ht hindex L b :
            (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterField t ht L).OrbitIndex) :
              Set E₁) := by
        have hx := hmemCut
        rw [← A2.range_cyclicCutPath e] at hx
        obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := hx
        rw [(D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterField t ht
          L).orbitPoint_orbit, ← hw']
        exact A2.cyclicCutPath_mem_orbit e w'
      exact havoid u' hquad' hu' horbitMem hmemCut
  
  let gammaZ := A2.cyclicCutRegularZeroPath e
  have hgammaK : ∀ w : I, gammaZ.toPath w ∈ Laux.exteriorSlabCore :=
    hcutMem
  have hd : |(-(cs ^ 2))| ≤ R.safeTime := by
    rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg cs)]
    exact Q.safe
  have habs : |(-(cs ^ 2))| = cs ^ 2 := by
    rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg cs)]
  have htime : ∀ w : I,
      tcoord (gammaZ.toPath w) + (-(cs ^ 2)) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    intro w
    have htw : tcoord (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + cs ^ 2 := by
      show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (A2.cyclicCutPath e w)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterTime t ht L)) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + cs ^ 2
      rw [tcoord_spaceTime]
      rfl
    have hthis : tcoord (gammaZ.toPath w) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + cs ^ 2 := htw
    rw [hthis]
    ring
  
  have hsrcK : M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
      (saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e)) r cs ∈
      Laux.exteriorSlabCore := by
    rw [← hmarkAmb (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e)]
    have h0 := hcutMem 0
    rwa [(A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e).source] at h0
  have htgtK : M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b
      (saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e)) r cs ∈
      Laux.exteriorSlabCore := by
    rw [← hmarkAmb (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e)]
    have h1 := hcutMem 1
    rwa [(A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e).target] at h1
  obtain ⟨u, huT, huP, hu1, hu2, huq⟩ :=
    D.exists_chronologicalSaddleRecoveryCapture t ht hindex L R
      (b, saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e)) hsrcK
      (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_fiber _ _ hrho hsq hrM)
      habs hd
      (by
        rw [M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hrho hsq hrM]
        ring)
      (Q.positive_close
        (b, saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e)))
  obtain ⟨v, hvT, hvP, hv1, hv2, hvq⟩ :=
    D.exists_chronologicalSaddleRecoveryCapture t ht hindex L R
      (b, saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e)) htgtK
      (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_fiber _ _ hrho hsq hrM)
      habs hd
      (by
        rw [M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hrho hsq hrM]
        ring)
      (Q.positive_close
        (b, saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e)))
  
  refine ⟨T.saddleCriticalExteriorArcOfSafeFlowWithLocalCaptures H hindex
    R gammaZ hgammaK (-(cs ^ 2)) hd htime r hrho hltT
    (b, saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e))
    (b, saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e))
    u v huT hvT ?_ ?_ hu1 hu2 hv1 hv2 ?_ ?_⟩
  · rw [huq]
    norm_num
  · rw [hvq]
    norm_num
  · exact (congrArg (fun z => R.base.flow z (-(cs ^ 2)))
      (hmarkAmb (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e))).trans huP.symm
  · exact (congrArg (fun z => R.base.flow z (-(cs ^ 2)))
      (hmarkAmb (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e))).trans hvP.symm

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleDistinctNegative_cutArc
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleDistinctNegative_cutArc
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht))
    (b : SaddleBranch) (e : Fin 2)
    (havoid : ∀ u : E₂,
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) =
        -((D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale t ht L).scale ^ 2) →
      ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht →
      spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u) ∈
        ((D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryNegativeOrbit t ht hindex L b :
          (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryBeforeField t ht L).OrbitIndex) :
            Set E₁) →
      spacePart ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u) ∉
        (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryNegativeMarking t ht hindex L
          b).cyclicCutRange e) :
    Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
      (fun p => (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
        D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
      (saddleBranchOfFinTwo
        ((D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryNegativeMarking t ht hindex L
          b).cyclicCutSourceLabel e), b)
      (saddleBranchOfFinTwo
        ((D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryNegativeMarking t ht hindex L
          b).cyclicCutTargetLabel e), b))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  let Q := D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale t ht L
  let cs : ℝ := Q.scale
  let Laux := D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAuxiliaryData t ht L
  let R := Laux.exteriorSlabTimeField
  let r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  have hrho : 0 < r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hsq : cs ^ 2 < r ^ 2 :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht L
  have hltT : r < T.radius :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  have hrM : r < M.radius := hltT.trans_le T.radius_le
  let A2 := D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryNegativeMarking t ht hindex L b
  
  have hmarkAmb : ∀ l : Fin 2,
      cobSpaceTime (A2.point l)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryBeforeTime t ht L) =
        M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs := by
    intro l
    show cobSpaceTime (A2.point l)
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - cs ^ 2) =
      M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs
    have hpt : A2.point l = spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b
        (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs) := rfl
    rw [hpt]
    have htX : tcoord (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b
        (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - cs ^ 2 :=
      M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hrho hsq hrM
    calc
      cobSpaceTime (spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b
          (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs))
          (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - cs ^ 2) =
          cobSpaceTime (spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b
            (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs))
            (tcoord (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b
              (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs)) := by rw [htX]
      _ = M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b (saddleBranchOfFinTwo l) r cs :=
        spaceTime_spacePart _
  
  have hcutMem : ∀ w : I,
      A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w ∈ Laux.exteriorSlabCore := by
    intro w
    have htw : tcoord (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - cs ^ 2 := by
      show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (A2.cyclicCutPath e w)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryBeforeTime t ht L)) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - cs ^ 2
      rw [tcoord_spaceTime]
      rfl
    have hfib : D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.G
        (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) = 0 :=
      A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber e w
    refine ⟨⟨hfib, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
    · show tcoord (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) ∈
        Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
          (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after
      rw [htw]
      constructor
      · have hc2 : cs ^ 2 ≤ D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
          (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale_sq_lt_window_sq t ht L).le
        have hle : D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht ≤
            tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - cs ^ 2 := by
          rw [chronologicalBeforeTime]
          linarith
        exact (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_bracket t ht).1.le.trans hle
      · exact (sub_le_self _ (sq_nonneg _)).trans
          (D.position.eventBracket t ht).lt_after.le
    · show Laux.centerCoverRadius ≤
        dist (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
      by_contra hlt
      rw [not_le] at hlt
      obtain ⟨u', hu', hup⟩ := Laux.centerCover _ hlt hfib
      have huM' : ‖u'‖ < M.radius := hu'.trans hrM
      have hquad' : morseQuadratic .saddle (u' 0, u' 1) = -(cs ^ 2) := by
        have htm := M.time_model u' huM'
        rw [hindex, hup, htw] at htm
        linarith
      have hsp : spacePart (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) =
          A2.cyclicCutPath e w := by
        show spacePart (cobSpaceTime (A2.cyclicCutPath e w)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryBeforeTime t ht L)) =
          A2.cyclicCutPath e w
        rw [spacePart_spaceTime]
      have hmemCut : spacePart (M.param u') ∈ A2.cyclicCutRange e := by
        rw [hup, hsp, ← A2.range_cyclicCutPath e]
        exact ⟨w, rfl⟩
      have horbitMem : spacePart (M.param u') ∈
          ((D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryNegativeOrbit t ht hindex L b :
            (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryBeforeField t ht L).OrbitIndex) :
              Set E₁) := by
        have hx := hmemCut
        rw [← A2.range_cyclicCutPath e] at hx
        obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := hx
        rw [(D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryBeforeField t ht
          L).orbitPoint_orbit, ← hw']
        exact A2.cyclicCutPath_mem_orbit e w'
      exact havoid u' hquad' hu' horbitMem hmemCut
  
  let gammaZ := A2.cyclicCutRegularZeroPath e
  have hgammaK : ∀ w : I, gammaZ.toPath w ∈ Laux.exteriorSlabCore :=
    hcutMem
  have hd : |cs ^ 2| ≤ R.safeTime := by
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg cs)]
    exact Q.safe
  have habs : |cs ^ 2| = cs ^ 2 := abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg cs)
  have htime : ∀ w : I,
      tcoord (gammaZ.toPath w) + cs ^ 2 =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    intro w
    have htw : tcoord (A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e w) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - cs ^ 2 := by
      show tcoord (cobSpaceTime (A2.cyclicCutPath e w)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryBeforeTime t ht L)) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - cs ^ 2
      rw [tcoord_spaceTime]
      rfl
    have hthis : tcoord (gammaZ.toPath w) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - cs ^ 2 := htw
    rw [hthis]
    ring
  
  have hsrcK : M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b
      (saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e)) r cs ∈
      Laux.exteriorSlabCore := by
    rw [← hmarkAmb (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e)]
    have h0 := hcutMem 0
    rwa [(A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e).source] at h0
  have htgtK : M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b
      (saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e)) r cs ∈
      Laux.exteriorSlabCore := by
    rw [← hmarkAmb (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e)]
    have h1 := hcutMem 1
    rwa [(A2.cyclicCutAmbientPath e).target] at h1
  obtain ⟨u, huT, huP, hu1, hu2, huq⟩ :=
    D.exists_chronologicalSaddleRecoveryCapture t ht hindex L R
      (saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e), b) hsrcK
      (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_fiber _ _ hrho hsq hrM)
      habs hd
      (by
        rw [M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hrho hsq hrM]
        ring)
      (Q.negative_close
        (saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e), b))
  obtain ⟨v, hvT, hvP, hv1, hv2, hvq⟩ :=
    D.exists_chronologicalSaddleRecoveryCapture t ht hindex L R
      (saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e), b) htgtK
      (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_fiber _ _ hrho hsq hrM)
      habs hd
      (by
        rw [M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hrho hsq hrM]
        ring)
      (Q.negative_close
        (saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e), b))
  
  refine ⟨T.saddleCriticalExteriorArcOfSafeFlowWithLocalCaptures H hindex
    R gammaZ hgammaK (cs ^ 2) hd htime r hrho hltT
    (saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e), b)
    (saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e), b)
    u v huT hvT ?_ ?_ hu1 hu2 hv1 hv2 ?_ ?_⟩
  · rw [huq]
    norm_num
  · rw [hvq]
    norm_num
  · exact (congrArg (fun z => R.base.flow z (cs ^ 2))
      (hmarkAmb (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e))).trans huP.symm
  · exact (congrArg (fun z => R.base.flow z (cs ^ 2))
      (hmarkAmb (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e))).trans hvP.symm

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleDistinctPositive_arc
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleDistinctPositive_arc
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (L : ChronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht))
    (hne : D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .negative ≠
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .positive)
    (b : SaddleBranch) :
    Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
      (fun p => (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
        D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
      (b, SaddleBranch.negative) (b, SaddleBranch.positive))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let Q := D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale t ht L
  let cs : ℝ := Q.scale
  let r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  let hreg := D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterTime_regular t ht L
  let V := D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterField t ht L
  
  have hshort : D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryPositiveOrbit t ht hindex
        L .negative ≠
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryPositiveOrbit t ht hindex L .positive := by
    intro h
    apply hne
    have h2 := congrArg
      (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht L) h
    rwa [D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
        t ht hindex L .negative,
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch
        t ht hindex L .positive] at h2
  have hOrbNe : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative r cs
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht L)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) hreg V ≠
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive r cs
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht L)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) hreg V :=
    hshort
  
  have hcut := T.saddlePositiveBranch_exists_uniformExteriorCut hindex b
    r cs (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) Q.scale_pos
    (D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht L)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) hreg V hOrbNe
  let A2 := D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryPositiveMarking t ht hindex L b
  have hlabne := fun e =>
    SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutSourceLabel_ne_targetLabel_two
      A2 e
  have harcCut : ∃ e : Fin 2, Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
      (fun p => (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
        D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
      (b, saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e))
      (b, saddleBranchOfFinTwo (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e))) := by
    rcases hcut with ⟨hlocal, havoid⟩ | ⟨hlocal, havoid⟩
    · refine ⟨Fin.last 1,
        D.chronologicalSaddleDistinctPositive_cutArc t ht hindex L b
          (Fin.last 1) ?_⟩
      intro u hq hn ho
      rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutRange_last]
      exact havoid u hq hn ho
    · refine ⟨(0 : Fin 1).castSucc,
        D.chronologicalSaddleDistinctPositive_cutArc t ht hindex L b
          ((0 : Fin 1).castSucc) ?_⟩
      intro u hq hn ho
      rw [SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cyclicCutRange_castSucc]
      exact havoid u hq hn ho
  obtain ⟨e, harc⟩ := harcCut
  have h01 : ∀ l : Fin 2, l = 0 ∨ l = 1 := by decide
  rcases h01 (A2.cyclicCutSourceLabel e) with hs | hs <;>
    rcases h01 (A2.cyclicCutTargetLabel e) with htg | htg
  · exact absurd (hs.trans htg.symm) (hlabne e)
  · rw [hs, htg, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_zero, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_one]
      at harc
    exact harc
  · rw [hs, htg, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_one, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_zero]
      at harc
    exact harc.map fun B => B.symm
  · exact absurd (hs.trans htg.symm) (hlabne e)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.nonempty_saddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData_of_parity
statement:
theorem nonempty_saddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData_of_parity
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (Par : ChronologicalSaddleOrientedCutParity D t ht hindex) :
    Nonempty ((D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht
  by_cases hpos : D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .negative =
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .positive
  · 
    have hnegne : D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .negative ≠
        D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .positive :=
      Par.positive_common_excludes_negative hpos
    refine ⟨chronologicalSaddlePairingData_of_parity_of_flipFirst_arcs
      D t ht hindex Par ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨b1, b2⟩
    have harc := D.chronologicalSaddleDistinctNegative_arc t ht hindex L
      hnegne b2
    cases b1 with
    | negative =>
        simpa [saddleBranchEndFlipFirst, SaddleBranch.other] using harc
    | positive =>
        simpa [saddleBranchEndFlipFirst, SaddleBranch.other] using
          harc.map fun B => B.symm
  · 
    refine ⟨chronologicalSaddlePairingData_of_parity_of_flipSecond_arcs
      D t ht hindex Par ?_⟩
    rintro ⟨b1, b2⟩
    have harc := D.chronologicalSaddleDistinctPositive_arc t ht hindex L
      hpos b1
    cases b2 with
    | negative =>
        simpa [saddleBranchEndFlipSecond, SaddleBranch.other] using harc
    | positive =>
        simpa [saddleBranchEndFlipSecond, SaddleBranch.other] using
          harc.map fun B => B.symm

name: Submission.SaddleFlowBandMarking.ambientBandCurve_mem
statement:
theorem ambientBandCurve_mem {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))}
    (hbefore₁ : ∀ q : I, cobSpaceTime (F.before₁Param.curve q) tbefore ∈ S)
    (hbefore₂ : ∀ q : I, cobSpaceTime (F.before₂Param.curve q) tbefore ∈ S)
    (hafter' : ∀ q : I, cobSpaceTime (F.afterParam.curve q) tafter ∈ S)
    (hline₀ : ∀ w : I, R.base.flow (F.coreArc₁ 0)
      ((1 - (w : ℝ)) * F.dbefore + (w : ℝ) * F.dafter) ∈ S)
    (hline₁ : ∀ w : I, R.base.flow (F.coreArc₁ 1)
      ((1 - (w : ℝ)) * F.dbefore + (w : ℝ) * F.dafter) ∈ S)
    (hline₂ : ∀ w : I, R.base.flow (F.coreArc₂ 0)
      ((1 - (w : ℝ)) * F.dbefore + (w : ℝ) * F.dafter) ∈ S)
    (hline₃ : ∀ w : I, R.base.flow (F.coreArc₂ 1)
      ((1 - (w : ℝ)) * F.dbefore + (w : ℝ) * F.dafter) ∈ S)
    (u : I) : F.ambientBandCurve u ∈ S
proof:
:= by
  have hb₁ : PathAll (fun w : ↥C.regularPoints =>
      (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) ∈ S) F.ambientBefore₁Loop :=
    fun q => hbefore₁ q
  have hb₂ : PathAll (fun w : ↥C.regularPoints =>
      (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) ∈ S) F.ambientBefore₂Loop :=
    fun q => hbefore₂ q
  have hA : PathAll (fun w : ↥C.regularPoints =>
      (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) ∈ S) F.ambientAfterLoop :=
    fun q => hafter' q
  have hc₀ : PathAll (fun w : ↥C.regularPoints =>
      (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) ∈ S) F.ambientConnector₀ :=
    fun q => hline₀ q
  have hc₁ : PathAll (fun w : ↥C.regularPoints =>
      (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) ∈ S) F.ambientConnector₁ :=
    fun q => hline₁ q
  have hc₂ : PathAll (fun w : ↥C.regularPoints =>
      (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) ∈ S) F.ambientConnector₂ :=
    fun q => hline₂ q
  have hc₃ : PathAll (fun w : ↥C.regularPoints =>
      (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) ∈ S) F.ambientConnector₃ :=
    fun q => hline₃ q
  exact (((hb₁.loopWrap _ _).symm.trans hc₁).trans
    ((hA.subpath _ _).trans hc₂.symm)).trans
      (((hb₂.loopWrap _ _).symm.trans hc₃).trans
        ((hA.loopWrap _ _).trans hc₀.symm)) u

name: Submission.exists_regularHomotopy_of_chartHomotopy
statement:
theorem exists_regularHomotopy_of_chartHomotopy
    {a : ℕ} {C : FramedLevelCobordism (a + 2)}
    {center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2))}
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt C center} (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (z : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2))))
    (h : C(I × I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (hnorm : ∀ q, ‖h q‖ < T.radius)
    (hne : ∀ q, h q ≠ 0)
    (hzero : ∀ u : I, M.localPoint (h (0, u)) = z u)
    (hone : ∀ u : I,
      h (1, u) = definiteCircleParam ρ (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)))
    (hclosed : ∀ w : I, h (w, 0) = h (w, 1)) :
    ∃ H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy z (T.definiteCircleCurve ρ hρ hρrad),
      (∀ q, Function.Surjective (spatialDeriv C.G (H q))) ∧
        ∀ w : I, H (w, 0) = H (w, 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous fun q : I × I => M.localPoint (h q) := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro q
    exact (T.param_differentiableAt _ (hnorm q)).continuousAt.comp
      h.continuous.continuousAt
  refine ⟨{ toFun := fun q => M.localPoint (h q)
            continuous_toFun := hcont
            map_zero_left := hzero
            map_one_left := fun u => ?_ }, fun q => ?_, fun w => ?_⟩
  · show M.localPoint (h (1, u)) = M.definiteCircle ρ (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))
    rw [hone u]
    rfl
  · exact M.localPoint_spatialDeriv_surjective_of_ne_zero (h q)
      ((hnorm q).trans_le T.radius_le) (hne q)
  · show M.localPoint (h (w, 0)) = M.localPoint (h (w, 1))
    rw [hclosed w]

name: Submission.homotopy_class_eq_const_of_succ_lt
statement:
theorem homotopy_class_eq_const_of_succ_lt {m n : ℕ} (h : m + 1 < n)
    (x : UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
    (z : HomotopyGroup (Fin (m + 1)) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) x) :
    z = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, a, hz⟩ := exists_approximation_of_homotopy_class z
  subst hz
  
  have hc1 : ContDiff ℝ 1 fun q : (Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ => q.2 • a.raw q.1 := by
    have hraw : ContDiff ℝ 1 a.raw := a.contDiff_raw.of_le (by exact_mod_cast le_top)
    exact contDiff_snd.smul (hraw.comp contDiff_fst)
  have hdim : finrank ℝ ((Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ)
      < finrank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) := by
    rw [Module.finrank_prod, Module.finrank_fin_fun, Module.finrank_self,
      finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    omega
  have hdense : Dense (Set.range fun q : (Fin (m + 1) → ℝ) × ℝ => q.2 • a.raw q.1)ᶜ :=
    hc1.dense_compl_range_of_finrank_lt_finrank hdim
  
  obtain ⟨w, hwc, hwball⟩ := hdense.exists_mem_open isOpen_ball
    ⟨(x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))), mem_ball_self one_pos⟩
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, mem_ball, dist_zero_left, UnitSphere.norm_coe x] at hwball
    exact lt_irrefl 1 hwball
  have hymem : ‖w‖⁻¹ • w ∈ Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1 :=
    mem_sphere_zero_iff_norm.mpr (norm_normalize hw0)
  
  have hmiss : ∀ t, a.representative t
      ≠ (⟨‖w‖⁻¹ • w, hymem⟩ : UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro t hty
    have hcoe : (a.representative t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) = ‖w‖⁻¹ • w :=
      congrArg Subtype.val hty
    rw [a.representative_coe t] at hcoe
    apply hwc
    refine ⟨((fun i => (t i : ℝ)), ‖w‖ * ‖a.raw (fun i => (t i : ℝ))‖⁻¹), ?_⟩
    show (‖w‖ * ‖a.raw (fun i => (t i : ℝ))‖⁻¹) • a.raw (fun i => (t i : ℝ)) = w
    rw [mul_smul, hcoe, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hw0),
      one_smul]
  exact homotopy_class_eq_const_of_misses a.representative _ hmiss

name: Submission.homotopyGroup_sphere_subsingleton
statement:
theorem homotopyGroup_sphere_subsingleton (k n : ℕ) (h : k < n)
    (x : Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) :
    Subsingleton
      (HomotopyGroup.Pi k (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) x)
proof:
:= by
  have hrank : 1 < Module.rank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) := by
    rw [← Module.finrank_eq_rank, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < n + 1)
  cases k with
  | zero =>
    haveI hpc : PathConnectedSpace (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) :=
      isPathConnected_iff_pathConnectedSpace.mp (isPathConnected_sphere hrank 0 zero_le_one)
    haveI hzs : Subsingleton
        (ZerothHomotopy (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1)) := by
      constructor
      intro a b
      induction a using Quotient.inductionOn with
      | h a =>
        induction b using Quotient.inductionOn with
        | h b => exact Quotient.sound (hpc.joined a b)
    exact (HomotopyGroup.pi0EquivZerothHomotopy (x := x)).subsingleton
  | succ m =>
    constructor
    intro z z'
    rw [homotopy_class_eq_const_of_succ_lt h x z,
      homotopy_class_eq_const_of_succ_lt h x z']

name: Submission.sphere_simplyConnected
statement:
theorem sphere_simplyConnected (n : ℕ) (h : 2 ≤ n) :
    SimplyConnectedSpace (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hrank : 1 < Module.rank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) := by
    rw [← Module.finrank_eq_rank, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < n + 1)
  haveI hpc : PathConnectedSpace (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) :=
    isPathConnected_iff_pathConnectedSpace.mp (isPathConnected_sphere hrank 0 zero_le_one)
  rw [simply_connected_iff_loops_nullhomotopic]
  refine ⟨hpc, fun x γ => ?_⟩
  
  let q : Ω^ (Fin 1) (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) x :=
    ⟨⟨fun c => γ (c 0), by fun_prop⟩, by
      rintro c ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
      · rw [Fin.eq_zero i] at hi
        exact (congrArg γ hi).trans γ.source
      · rw [Fin.eq_zero i] at hi
        exact (congrArg γ hi).trans γ.target⟩
  have hsub : Subsingleton
      (HomotopyGroup.Pi 1 (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) x) :=
    homotopyGroup_sphere_subsingleton 1 n (by omega) x
  have hq : (⟦q⟧ : HomotopyGroup (Fin 1)
      (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) x) = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧ :=
    hsub.elim _ _
  obtain ⟨H⟩ := Quotient.exact hq
  exact
    ⟨{  toFun := fun su => H (su.1, fun _ => su.2)
        map_zero_left := fun u => H.apply_zero _
        map_one_left := fun u => H.apply_one _
        prop' := fun s u hu => H.prop' s (fun _ => u)
          ⟨0, by rcases hu with h0 | h1
                 · exact Or.inl h0
                 · exact Or.inr h1⟩ }⟩

name: Submission.FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs.cutoff_eq_zero_of_mem_core
statement:
theorem cutoff_eq_zero_of_mem_core
    (D : FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs (n := n) center)
    (i : ι) {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    (hv : v ∈ closedBall (center i) (D.radius i / 2))
    (j : ι) (hji : j ≠ i) :
    D.cutoff j v = 0
proof:
:= by
  exact (D.cutoff j).eq_zero v (by
    intro hvj
    have hvi : v ∈ ball (center i) (D.radius i) :=
      D.core_subset_support i hv
    have hd : Disjoint (ball (center j) (D.radius j))
        (ball (center i) (D.radius i)) :=
      D.pairwise_disjoint_support hji
    exact Set.disjoint_left.1 hd hvj hvi)

name: Submission.FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs.localized_eq_zero_of_mem_core
statement:
theorem localized_eq_zero_of_mem_core
    (D : FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs (n := n) center)
    (h : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) → ℝ)
    (i : ι) {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    (hv : v ∈ closedBall (center i) (D.radius i / 2))
    (j : ι) (hji : j ≠ i) :
    (D.cutoff j).localize (h j) v = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [SmoothCutoff.localize, D.cutoff_eq_zero_of_mem_core i hv j hji]
  exact zero_mul _

name: Submission.FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs.localized_properties
statement:
theorem localized_properties
    (D : FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs (n := n) center)
    (h : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) → ℝ)
    (hsmooth : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (h i)) (i : ι) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ ((D.cutoff i).localize (h i)) ∧
      HasCompactSupport ((D.cutoff i).localize (h i)) ∧
      (∀ v, tcoord v ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ tcoord v →
        (D.cutoff i).localize (h i) v = 0)
proof:
:=
  ⟨(D.cutoff i).contDiff_localize (hsmooth i),
    (D.cutoff i).hasCompactSupport_localize (h i),
    (D.cutoff i).localize_collar_zero (D.support_subset_middle i) (h i)⟩

name: Submission.FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs.exists_of_injective_interior
statement:
theorem exists_of_injective_interior
    (center : ι → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))
    (hinj : Injective center)
    (hinterior : ∀ i,
      1 / 4 < tcoord (center i) ∧ tcoord (center i) < 3 / 4) :
    Nonempty (FiniteDisjointMiddleCutoffs (n := n) center)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let middle : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :=
    tcoord ⁻¹' Ioo (1 / 4 : ℝ) (3 / 4 : ℝ)
  have hmiddleOpen : IsOpen middle :=
    isOpen_Ioo.preimage contDiff_vertC.continuous
  have hcenterMiddle : ∀ i, center i ∈ middle := by
    intro i
    exact hinterior i
  obtain ⟨U, hU, hUdisjoint⟩ := (Set.finite_range center).t2_separation
  let V : ι → Set E' := fun i => U (center i) ∩ middle
  have hVopen : ∀ i, IsOpen (V i) := fun i => (hU (center i)).2.inter hmiddleOpen
  have hVmem : ∀ i, center i ∈ V i := fun i =>
    ⟨(hU (center i)).1, hcenterMiddle i⟩
  have hexRadius : ∀ i, ∃ r > 0, ball (center i) r ⊆ V i := by
    intro i
    exact Metric.isOpen_iff.1 (hVopen i) (center i) (hVmem i)
  choose r hr hball using hexRadius
  refine ⟨{
    radius := r
    radius_pos := hr
    support_subset_middle := fun i => (hball i).trans inter_subset_right
    pairwise_disjoint_support := ?_
    cutoff := fun i => (SmoothCutoff.exists_ball (center i) (hr i)).some
  }⟩
  intro i j hij
  have hcij : center i ≠ center j := fun h => hij (hinj h)
  have hdU : Disjoint (U (center i)) (U (center j)) :=
    hUdisjoint (mem_range_self i) (mem_range_self j) hcij
  exact hdU.mono ((hball i).trans inter_subset_left)
    ((hball j).trans inter_subset_left)

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.regularSlab_refl
statement:
theorem regularSlab_refl (X : FramedLevelSet n) :
    regularSlab (FramedLevelCobordism.refl X).G 0 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularSlab]
  intro t _ htcrit
  obtain ⟨v, hvcrit, hvt⟩ := htcrit
  apply hvcrit.2
  let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) := spacePart v
  have hvrepr : cobSpaceTime x t = v := by
    rw [← hvt]
    exact spaceTime_spacePart v
  rw [← hvrepr]
  change Function.Surjective
    (spatialDeriv (FramedLevelCobordism.refl X).G (cobSpaceTime x t))
  rw [← fderiv_sliceMap (FramedLevelCobordism.refl X).smooth t x]
  have hslice : sliceMap (FramedLevelCobordism.refl X).G t = X.g := by
    funext y
    change X.g (initCLM (n + 1) (cobSpaceTime y t)) = X.g y
    have hspace : cobSpaceTime y t = spaceTime y t := rfl
    rw [hspace, initCLM_spaceTime]
  rw [hslice]
  apply X.regular x
  have hz := hvcrit.1
  rw [← hvrepr] at hz
  change X.g (initCLM (n + 1) (cobSpaceTime x t)) = 0 at hz
  have hspace : cobSpaceTime x t = spaceTime x t := rfl
  rwa [hspace, initCLM_spaceTime] at hz

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.regularSlab_trans
statement:
theorem regularSlab_trans
    (C₁ : FramedLevelCobordism n) (C₂ : FramedLevelCobordism n)
    (h : C₁.X₁ = C₂.X₀)
    (h₁ : regularSlab C₁.G 0 1) (h₂ : regularSlab C₂.G 0 1) :
    regularSlab (C₁.trans C₂ h).G 0 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularSlab]
  intro t ht htcrit
  obtain ⟨v, hvcrit, hvt⟩ := htcrit
  apply hvcrit.2
  let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) := spacePart v
  have hvrepr : cobSpaceTime x t = v := by
    rw [← hvt]
    exact spaceTime_spacePart v
  rw [← hvrepr]
  rw [← fderiv_sliceMap (C₁.trans C₂ h).smooth t x]
  by_cases hleft : t < 1 / 2
  · let s : ℝ := 3 * t - 1 / 2
    have hslice : sliceMap (C₁.trans C₂ h).G t = sliceMap C₁.G s := by
      funext y
      change Submission.transFun C₁ C₂ (cobSpaceTime y t) =
        C₁.G (cobSpaceTime y s)
      have htspace : cobSpaceTime y t = spaceTime y t := rfl
      have hsspace : cobSpaceTime y s = spaceTime y s := rfl
      rw [htspace, hsspace]
      rw [Submission.transFun, vertC_spaceTime, if_pos hleft, reparamMap,
        initCLM_spaceTime, vertC_spaceTime]
      rfl
    rw [hslice, fderiv_sliceMap C₁.smooth s x]
    have hsreg : sliceRegular C₁.G s := by
      by_cases hs : s ≤ 1 / 4
      · exact C₁.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter hs
      · apply h₁.sliceRegular
        constructor
        · have hs' : 1 / 4 < s := lt_of_not_ge hs
          linarith
        · dsimp [s]
          linarith
    apply hsreg (cobSpaceTime x s)
    · have hz := hvcrit.1
      rw [← hvrepr] at hz
      change sliceMap (C₁.trans C₂ h).G t x = 0 at hz
      rwa [hslice] at hz
    · exact tcoord_spaceTime x s
  · let s : ℝ := 3 * t - 3 / 2
    have hright : ¬ t < 1 / 2 := hleft
    have hslice : sliceMap (C₁.trans C₂ h).G t = sliceMap C₂.G s := by
      funext y
      change Submission.transFun C₁ C₂ (cobSpaceTime y t) =
        C₂.G (cobSpaceTime y s)
      have htspace : cobSpaceTime y t = spaceTime y t := rfl
      have hsspace : cobSpaceTime y s = spaceTime y s := rfl
      rw [htspace, hsspace]
      rw [Submission.transFun, vertC_spaceTime, if_neg hright, reparamMap,
        initCLM_spaceTime, vertC_spaceTime]
      rfl
    rw [hslice, fderiv_sliceMap C₂.smooth s x]
    have hsreg : sliceRegular C₂.G s := by
      by_cases hs : 3 / 4 ≤ s
      · exact C₂.sliceRegular_of_three_quarter_le hs
      · apply h₂.sliceRegular
        constructor
        · dsimp [s]
          linarith
        · have hs' : s < 3 / 4 := lt_of_not_ge hs
          linarith
    apply hsreg (cobSpaceTime x s)
    · have hz := hvcrit.1
      rw [← hvrepr] at hz
      change sliceMap (C₁.trans C₂ h).G t x = 0 at hz
      rwa [hslice] at hz
    · exact tcoord_spaceTime x s

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.regularSlab_trans
statement:
theorem regularSlab_trans
    (C₁ : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    (C₂ : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₁ S₂)
    (h₁ : regularSlab C₁.cobordism.G 0 1)
    (h₂ : regularSlab C₂.cobordism.G 0 1) :
    regularSlab (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.trans C₁ C₂).cobordism.G 0 1
proof:
:=
  FramedLevelCobordism.regularSlab_trans C₁.cobordism C₂.cobordism
    (C₁.target_eq.trans C₂.source_eq.symm) h₁ h₂

name: Submission.signInterpolationCobordism_regularSlab
statement:
theorem signInterpolationCobordism_regularSlab
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} (S T : FiberSign X)
    (h : ∀ x ∈ X.fiber, (0 < S x ↔ 0 < T x)) :
    regularSlab (signInterpolationCobordism S T h).cobordism.G 0 1
proof:
:=
  FramedLevelCobordism.regularSlab_refl X

name: Submission.signedEndpointConnector_regularSlab
statement:
theorem signedEndpointConnector_regularSlab
    {X Y : FramedLevelSet n} (S : FiberSign X) (T : FiberSign Y)
    (hXY : X = Y)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Y.fiber,
      (0 < S.transport hXY x ↔ 0 < T x)) :
    regularSlab (signedEndpointConnector S T hXY hpos).cobordism.G 0 1
proof:
:= by
  subst Y
  exact signInterpolationCobordism_regularSlab S T hpos

name: Submission.signedEndpointConnectorOfDefiningMapHomotopy_regularSlab
statement:
theorem signedEndpointConnectorOfDefiningMapHomotopy_regularSlab
    {X Y : FramedLevelSet n} (D : DefiningMapHomotopy X Y)
    (S : FiberSign X) (T : FiberSign Y)
    (hpos : ∀ x ∈ Y.fiber,
      (0 < S.restrict D.fiber_subset x ↔ 0 < T x)) :
    regularSlab
      (signedEndpointConnectorOfDefiningMapHomotopy D S T hpos).cobordism.G
      0 1
proof:
:= by
  exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.regularSlab_trans
    (D.signedCobordism S)
    (signInterpolationCobordism (S.restrict D.fiber_subset) T hpos)
    (CompactSaddle.homotopy_regularSlab D)
    (signInterpolationCobordism_regularSlab _ _ hpos)

name: Submission.FiberSign.PTCutoff.patchTargetSign_positive_of_allPositive
statement:
theorem patchTargetSign_positive_of_allPositive
    (κ : PTCutoff (FiberSign.allPositive X))
    (P : EndpointPatchLocalizer (FiberSign.allPositive X) κ)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hreg : IsRegularValueOn
      (patchQuotient (FiberSign.allPositive X) κ P)
      (patchTransition (FiberSign.allPositive X) κ P) y) :
    ∀ x ∈
        (patchTargetLevelSet (FiberSign.allPositive X) κ P y hreg).fiber,
      0 < patchTargetSign (FiberSign.allPositive X) κ P y hreg x
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  change 0 < endpointVertical (FiberSign.allPositive X) κ x
  change patchTargetMap (FiberSign.allPositive X) κ P y x = 0 at hx
  by_cases hP : P x = 0
  · have hb : (1 + κ x) • X.g x = 0 := by
      simpa [patchTargetMap, hP] using hx
    have hscale : (1 + κ x : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
      have hκ := (κ.range x).1
      positivity
    have hg : x ∈ X.fiber :=
      (smul_eq_zero.mp hb).resolve_left hscale
    exact (fiber_subset_signAgreement (FiberSign.allPositive X) κ hg).elim
      (fun hp => hp.2) (fun hn => by
        exfalso
        rw [FiberSign.allPositive_apply] at hn
        linarith [hn.1])
  · have hagree := P.nonzero_agrees x hP
    exact hagree.elim (fun hp => hp.2)
      (fun hn => by
        exfalso
        rw [FiberSign.allPositive_apply] at hn
        linarith [hn.1])
