name: Submission.dense_compl_iUnion_range_of_contDiff
statement:
theorem dense_compl_iUnion_range_of_contDiff
    [Fintype ι] [Countable ι]
    (f : ι → D → P) (hf : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (f i))
    (hDP : Module.finrank ℝ D < Module.finrank ℝ P) :
    Dense (⋃ i, Set.range (f i))ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  apply dense_compl_of_dimH_lt_finrank
  rw [dimH_iUnion]
  apply iSup_lt_iff.mpr
  refine ⟨Module.finrank ℝ D, Nat.cast_lt.2 hDP, ?_⟩
  intro i
  exact (hf i).dimH_range_le

name: Submission.dense_compl_union_range_of_contDiff
statement:
theorem dense_compl_union_range_of_contDiff
    (f g : D → P) (hf : ContDiff ℝ 1 f) (hg : ContDiff ℝ 1 g)
    (hDP : Module.finrank ℝ D < Module.finrank ℝ P) :
    Dense (Set.range f ∪ Set.range g)ᶜ
proof:
:= by
  let F : Fin 2 → D → P := fun i => if i = 0 then f else g
  have hF : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (F i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa [F] using hf
    · simpa [F] using hg
  have hdense := dense_compl_iUnion_range_of_contDiff F hF hDP
  convert hdense using 1
  ext x
  simp [F]

name: Submission.exists_mem_open_avoid_iUnion_range
statement:
theorem exists_mem_open_avoid_iUnion_range
    [Fintype ι] [Countable ι]
    (f : ι → D → P) (hf : ∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (f i))
    (hDP : Module.finrank ℝ D < Module.finrank ℝ P)
    {U : Set P} (hUopen : IsOpen U) (hUne : U.Nonempty) :
    ∃ p ∈ U, ∀ i, p ∉ Set.range (f i)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpbad, hpU⟩ :=
    (dense_compl_iUnion_range_of_contDiff f hf hDP).exists_mem_open hUopen hUne
  refine ⟨p, hpU, ?_⟩
  intro i hpi
  exact hpbad (Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨i, hpi⟩)

name: Submission.SplitDiagonalStandard.killable_zeroPairPos
statement:
theorem killable_zeroPairPos (k : ℕ) (hm : 0 < k + 1) :
    StandardCircleMoveKit.Killable (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k)
proof:
:= by
  apply StandardCircleMoveKit.killable_of_chain (k + 1) rfl rfl
  obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := PieceKill.exists_saddleTargetKill (k + 1) hm
  set Cz := StandardCircleMoveKit.retype
    (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel (k + 1) hm).cobordism
    (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k).sign
    (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel
      (k + 1) hm).target.sign
    rfl rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) with hCzdef
  refine ⟨Cz.trans C', ?_⟩
  have hZflat : (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel
      (k + 1) hm).cobordism.SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground (k + 1)) 0 2 :=
    (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel (k + 1) hm).flatOutside
  have hCzflat : Cz.SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground (k + 1)) 0 2 :=
    StandardCircleMoveKit.retype_flat hZflat
  have h := StandardCircleMoveKit.spatialFlatOutside_trans hCzflat hC'
  apply StandardCircleMoveKit.spatialFlatOutside_mono_radius h
  apply max_le <;> norm_num

name: Submission.SplitDiagonalStandard.killable_zeroPairNeg
statement:
theorem killable_zeroPairNeg (k : ℕ) (hm : 0 < k + 1) :
    StandardCircleMoveKit.Killable (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k)
proof:
:= by
  apply StandardCircleMoveKit.killable_of_chain_neg (k + 1) rfl rfl
  obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := PieceKill.exists_saddleTargetKill (k + 1) hm
  set Cz := StandardCircleMoveKit.retype
    ((CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel
      (k + 1) hm).cobordism.trans C').neg
    (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k).sign
    (CompactBirth.targetSign (k + 2)).neg
    rfl rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) with hCzdef
  refine ⟨Cz, ?_⟩
  have hZflat : (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel
      (k + 1) hm).cobordism.SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground (k + 1)) 0 2 :=
    (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel (k + 1) hm).flatOutside
  have h := StandardCircleMoveKit.spatialFlatOutside_trans hZflat hC'
  have h' := StandardCircleMoveKit.spatialFlatOutside_mono_radius h
    (by apply max_le <;> norm_num :
      max 2 (5 / 2) ≤ (5 / 2 : ℝ))
  have hCzflat : Cz.SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground (k + 1)) 0
      (5 / 2) :=
    StandardCircleMoveKit.retype_flat
      (StandardCircleMoveKit.spatialFlatOutside_neg h')
  exact hCzflat

name: Submission.SplitDiagonalStandard.standardSucc_to_diagonal
statement:
theorem standardSucc_to_diagonal (k : ℕ) (hm : 0 < k + 1) (P N : MorseLedger) :
    SignedConnector
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.flatConfigOfLedgersSucc k P N).sign
      (standardSucc k P.delta).sign
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hkill : ∀ q ∈ (List.replicate (P.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (P.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k)),
      StandardCircleMoveKit.Killable
        (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2)) q := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_replicate] at hq
    rcases hq with ((⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩) | ⟨-, rfl⟩) | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact killable_onePos k hm
    · exact killable_oneNeg k hm
    · exact killable_zeroPairPos k hm
    · exact killable_zeroPairNeg k hm
  have hdelta : P.delta = ((P.count (0 : ZMod 2) % 2 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) :=
    (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.delta_eq_count_zero P).trans
      (ZMod.natCast_mod _ 2).symm
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (P.count (0 : ZMod 2)) with he | he
  · 
    have hd0 : P.delta = 0 := by
      rw [hdelta, he]
      simp
    have hstd : standardSucc k P.delta =
        DiagonalStandardConfiguration.zero (k + 1) := by
      rw [hd0, standardSucc_zero]
    rw [hstd]
    have hlist : StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.pieces k P N =
        List.replicate (P.count 1)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos (k + 1)) ++
        List.replicate (N.count 1)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1)) ++
        List.replicate (P.count 0 / 2)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k) ++
        List.replicate (N.count 0 / 2)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k) := by
      show _ ++ List.replicate (P.count 0 % 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k) = _
      rw [he]
      simp
    show SignedConnector
      (FlatSignedConfiguration.assemble _
        (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.pieces k P N)).sign
      (DiagonalStandardConfiguration.zero (k + 1)).sign
    rw [hlist]
    cases hL : List.replicate (P.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (P.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k) with
      | nil => exact SignedConnector.refl _
      | cons Ahead t =>
        have hK := StandardCircleMoveKit.killable_assembleFrom
          (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2)) Ahead t
          (hkill Ahead (by rw [hL]; simp))
          (fun r hr => hkill r (by rw [hL]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr))
        obtain ⟨C, -⟩ := hK
        exact ⟨C⟩
  · 
    
    have hd1 : P.delta = 1 := by
      rw [hdelta, he]
      simp
    have hstd : standardSucc k P.delta =
        StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k := by
      rw [hd1, standardSucc_one]
    rw [hstd]
    have hsplit : SignedConnector
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k).sign
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k).sign :=
      SignedConnector.refl _
    have hlist : StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.pieces k P N =
        (List.replicate (P.count 1)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos (k + 1)) ++
        List.replicate (N.count 1)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1)) ++
        List.replicate (P.count 0 / 2)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k) ++
        List.replicate (N.count 0 / 2)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k)) ++
        [StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k] := by
      show _ ++ List.replicate (P.count 0 % 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k) = _
      rw [he]
      simp
    show SignedConnector
      (FlatSignedConfiguration.assemble _
        (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.pieces k P N)).sign
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k).sign
    rw [hlist]
    cases hL : List.replicate (P.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (P.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k) with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.nil_append]
        exact hsplit
      | cons Ahead t =>
        have hfold : FlatSignedConfiguration.assemble _
            (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
            ((Ahead :: t) ++ [StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k]) =
            FlatSignedConfiguration.cons
              (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
              (FlatSignedConfiguration.assembleFrom
                (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2)) Ahead t)
              (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k) := by
          show FlatSignedConfiguration.assembleFrom _ Ahead
            (t ++ [StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k]) = _
          rw [FlatSignedConfiguration.assembleFrom, List.foldl_append]
          rfl
        rw [hfold]
        have hKF := StandardCircleMoveKit.killable_assembleFrom
          (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2)) Ahead t
          (hkill Ahead (by rw [hL]; simp))
          (fun r hr => hkill r (by rw [hL]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr))
        exact SignedConnector.trans
          (StandardCircleMoveKit.connector_cons_of_killable
            (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2)) hKF)
          hsplit

name: Submission.SplitDiagonalStandard.nonempty_standard_to_diagonal
statement:
theorem nonempty_standard_to_diagonal (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (P N : MorseLedger) :
    SignedConnector
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.flatConfigOfLedgers m hm P N).sign
      (standard m hm P.delta).sign
proof:
:= by
  match m, hm with
  | (k + 1), hm => exact standardSucc_to_diagonal k hm P N

name: Submission.SplitDiagonalStandard.finish_connector
statement:
theorem finish_connector (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (P N : MorseLedger) :
    SignedConnector
      (ConcreteConfigurationBridgeCobordismTrace.standardState m hm
        (MorseLedger.canonical P.delta) (MorseLedger.canonical N.delta)).sign
      (standard m hm P.delta).sign
proof:
:= by
  have h := nonempty_standard_to_diagonal m hm
    (MorseLedger.canonical P.delta) (MorseLedger.canonical N.delta)
  rw [MorseLedger.delta_canonical] at h
  exact h

name: Submission.SplitDiagonalStandard.nonempty_normalize
statement:
theorem nonempty_normalize {m : ℕ} {z : StableSpherePi (m + 2)}
    {B : BridgeData (m + 2) z} (hm : 0 < m)
    (entry : SignedConnector B.fiberSign
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.flatConfigOfLedgers m hm
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign)
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.negativeLedger m B.fiberSign)).sign) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism B.fiberSign
      (standard m hm B.northDelta).sign)
proof:
:= by
  have hindex :
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign).delta =
        B.northDelta := by
    calc
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign).delta =
          B.fiberSign.positiveDelta :=
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveDelta_eq_positiveLedger_delta
          m B.fiberSign).symm
      _ = B.northDelta := B.northDelta_eq_positiveDelta.symm
  have h := SignedConnector.trans entry
    (nonempty_standard_to_diagonal m hm
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign)
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.negativeLedger m B.fiberSign))
  rw [hindex] at h
  exact h

name: Submission.SplitDiagonalStandard.nonempty_comparison
statement:
theorem nonempty_comparison {m : ℕ}
    {z₁ z₂ : StableSpherePi (m + 2)}
    {B₁ : BridgeData (m + 2) z₁} {B₂ : BridgeData (m + 2) z₂} (hm : 0 < m)
    (entry₁ : SignedConnector B₁.fiberSign
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.flatConfigOfLedgers m hm
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B₁.fiberSign)
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.negativeLedger m B₁.fiberSign)).sign)
    (entry₂ : SignedConnector B₂.fiberSign
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.flatConfigOfLedgers m hm
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B₂.fiberSign)
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.negativeLedger m B₂.fiberSign)).sign)
    (hdelta : B₁.northDelta = B₂.northDelta) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism B₁.fiberSign B₂.fiberSign)
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ := nonempty_normalize hm entry₁
  have h₂ := nonempty_normalize hm entry₂
  rw [hdelta] at h₁
  exact SignedConnector.trans h₁ (SignedConnector.symm h₂)

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.contDiff_cutoff
statement:
lemma contDiff_cutoff {k : ℕ} :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (cutoff : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) → ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.smoothTransition.contDiff.comp
    (((CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq).sub contDiff_const).div_const 5)

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.cutoff_nonneg
statement:
lemma cutoff_nonneg {k : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    0 ≤ cutoff x
proof: := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.cutoff_le_one
statement:
lemma cutoff_le_one {k : ℕ} (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)) :
    cutoff x ≤ 1
proof: := Real.smoothTransition.le_one _

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.cutoff_eq_zero
statement:
lemma cutoff_eq_zero {k : ℕ} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (hx : CompactBirth.normSq x ≤ 4) : cutoff x = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.smoothTransition.zero_of_nonpos
  linarith

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.cutoff_eq_one
statement:
lemma cutoff_eq_one {k : ℕ} {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k)}
    (hx : 9 ≤ CompactBirth.normSq x) : cutoff x = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.smoothTransition.one_of_one_le
  linarith

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.background_apply_last
statement:
@[simp] lemma background_apply_last :
    background m (Fin.last (m + 1)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simp [background]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.background_apply_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma background_apply_castSucc (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    background m j.castSucc = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [background]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.background_ne_zero
statement: lemma background_ne_zero : background m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have := congrArg (fun q : F => q (Fin.last (m + 1))) h
  simp at this

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.contDiff_levelMap
statement: lemma contDiff_levelMap (a : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (levelMap m a)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_cutoff).smul
    (StandardSaddle.contDiff_levelMap m a)).add
    (contDiff_cutoff.smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.levelMap_apply_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma levelMap_apply_castSucc (a : ℝ) (x : E) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    levelMap m a x j.castSucc = (1 - cutoff x) * x j.castSucc.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  simp [levelMap, StandardSaddle.levelMap_apply_castSucc]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.levelMap_apply_last
statement:
@[simp] lemma levelMap_apply_last (a : ℝ) (x : E) :
    levelMap m a x (Fin.last (m + 1)) =
      (1 - cutoff x) * (StandardSaddle.cassiniQ m x - a) + cutoff x
proof:
:= by
  simp [levelMap, StandardSaddle.levelMap_apply_last]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.contDiff_eventMap
statement: lemma contDiff_eventMap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (eventMap m)
proof:
:= by
  have hcut : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun v : E' => cutoff (initCLM (m + 3) v)) :=
    contDiff_cutoff.comp (initCLM (m + 3)).contDiff
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub hcut).smul
    (StandardSaddle.contDiff_eventMap m)).add (hcut.smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.eventMap_apply_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma eventMap_apply_castSucc (v : E') (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    eventMap m v j.castSucc =
      (1 - cutoff (initCLM (m + 3) v)) * v j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc
proof:
:= by
  simp [eventMap, StandardSaddle.eventMap,
    StandardSaddle.levelMap_apply_castSucc]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.eventMap_apply_last
statement:
@[simp] lemma eventMap_apply_last (v : E') :
    eventMap m v (Fin.last (m + 1)) =
      (1 - cutoff (initCLM (m + 3) v)) *
          (StandardSaddle.cassiniQ m (initCLM (m + 3) v) -
            StandardSaddle.height (vertC v) / 2) +
        cutoff (initCLM (m + 3) v)
proof:
:= by
  simp [eventMap, StandardSaddle.eventMap,
    StandardSaddle.levelMap_apply_last]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.eventMap_spaceTime
statement:
lemma eventMap_spaceTime (x : E) (t : ℝ) :
    eventMap m (spaceTime x t) =
      levelMap m (StandardSaddle.height t / 2) x
proof:
:= by
  rw [eventMap, levelMap, initCLM_spaceTime,
    StandardSaddle.eventMap_spaceTime]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.eventMap_cutoff_ne_one
statement:
lemma eventMap_cutoff_ne_one {v : E'} (hv : eventMap m v = 0) :
    cutoff (initCLM (m + 3) v) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hlast := congrArg (fun q : F => q (Fin.last (m + 1))) hv
  rw [eventMap_apply_last, hc] at hlast
  norm_num at hlast

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.transverse_eq_zero_of_eventMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun q : F => q j.castSucc) hv
  rw [eventMap_apply_castSucc] at hcoord
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hcoord
  have hc : cutoff (initCLM (m + 3) v) < 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne (cutoff_le_one _) (eventMap_cutoff_ne_one m hv)
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hcoord).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hc.ne')

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.normSq_init_eq_radiusSq_of_eventMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma normSq_init_eq_radiusSq_of_eventMap_eq_zero {v : E'}
    (hv : eventMap m v = 0) :
    CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) v) =
      StandardSaddle.radiusSq m (initCLM (m + 3) v)
proof:
:= by
  unfold CompactBirth.normSq StandardSaddle.radiusSq
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp only [initCLM_apply]
  have hz : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), v j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc ^ 2 = 0 :=
    fun j => by
      rw [transverse_eq_zero_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv j, zero_pow (by norm_num)]
  simp only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
  rfl

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.standard_event_normSq_le_three
proof:
:= by
  have hq := StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_eq_height_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv
  have hqform := StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_eq m (initCLM (m + 3) v)
  rw [hqform] at hq
  have hupper := StandardSaddle.height_le_one (vertC v)
  have hnorm : CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) v) =
      StandardSaddle.radiusSq m (initCLM (m + 3) v) := by
    unfold CompactBirth.normSq StandardSaddle.radiusSq
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_castSucc, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
    simp only [initCLM_apply]
    have hz : ∀ j : Fin (m + 1), v j.castSucc.castSucc.castSucc ^ 2 = 0 :=
      fun j => by
        rw [StandardSaddle.transverse_eq_zero_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv j,
          zero_pow (by norm_num)]
    simp only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
    rfl
  rw [hnorm]
  unfold StandardSaddle.radiusSq at hq ⊢
  simp only [initCLM_apply] at hq ⊢
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v (StandardSaddle.planeFirst m).castSucc),
    sq_nonneg (v (StandardSaddle.planeSecond m).castSucc)]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.eventMap_zero_iff
statement:
theorem eventMap_zero_iff (v : E') :
    eventMap m v = 0 ↔ StandardSaddle.eventMap m v = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hv
    have hc_lt : cutoff (initCLM (m + 3) v) < 1 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne (cutoff_le_one _) (eventMap_cutoff_ne_one m hv)
    have hr := normSq_init_eq_radiusSq_of_eventMap_eq_zero m hv
    have hlast := congrArg (fun q : F => q (Fin.last (m + 1))) hv
    rw [eventMap_apply_last] at hlast
    simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hlast
    have hslt : CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) v) < 4 := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hsge : 4 ≤ CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) v) := not_lt.mp hnot
      have hheight := StandardSaddle.height_le_one (vertC v)
      have hc0 := cutoff_nonneg (initCLM (m + 3) v)
      have hqform := StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_eq m (initCLM (m + 3) v)
      rw [hr] at hsge
      unfold StandardSaddle.radiusSq at hsge
      simp only [initCLM_apply] at hsge
      have hqpos : 0 <
          StandardSaddle.cassiniQ m (initCLM (m + 3) v) -
            StandardSaddle.height (vertC v) / 2 := by
        rw [hqform]
        unfold StandardSaddle.radiusSq
        simp only [initCLM_apply]
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (v (StandardSaddle.planeFirst m).castSucc),
          sq_nonneg (v (StandardSaddle.planeSecond m).castSucc)]
      have hprod : 0 <
          (1 - cutoff (initCLM (m + 3) v)) *
            (StandardSaddle.cassiniQ m (initCLM (m + 3) v) -
              StandardSaddle.height (vertC v) / 2) :=
        mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hc_lt) hqpos
      nlinarith
    have hc0 : cutoff (initCLM (m + 3) v) = 0 := cutoff_eq_zero hslt.le
    simpa [eventMap, hc0] using hv
  · intro hv
    have hs : CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) v) ≤ 4 :=
      (standard_event_normSq_le_three m hv).trans (by norm_num)
    have hc0 : cutoff (initCLM (m + 3) v) = 0 := cutoff_eq_zero hs
    simp [eventMap, hc0, hv]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.levelMap_neg_half_zero_iff
statement:
theorem levelMap_neg_half_zero_iff (x : E) :
    levelMap m (-1 / 2) x = 0 ↔
      StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hh : StandardSaddle.height 0 / 2 = -1 / 2 := by
    rw [StandardSaddle.height_of_le_quarter (by norm_num)]
  rw [← hh, ← eventMap_spaceTime m x 0, eventMap_zero_iff,
    StandardSaddle.eventMap_spaceTime]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.levelMap_half_zero_iff
statement:
theorem levelMap_half_zero_iff (x : E) :
    levelMap m (1 / 2) x = 0 ↔
      StandardSaddle.levelMap m (1 / 2) x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hh : StandardSaddle.height 1 / 2 = 1 / 2 := by
    rw [StandardSaddle.height_of_threeQuarter_le (by norm_num)]
  rw [← hh, ← eventMap_spaceTime m x 1, eventMap_zero_iff,
    StandardSaddle.eventMap_spaceTime]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.levelMap_eventuallyEq_standard
statement:
lemma levelMap_eventuallyEq_standard {a : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : CompactBirth.normSq x < 4) :
    Filter.EventuallyEq (nhds x) (levelMap m a)
      (StandardSaddle.levelMap m a)
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen {y : E | CompactBirth.normSq y < 4} :=
    isOpen_lt CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.continuous continuous_const
  exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hx) fun y hy => by
    rw [levelMap, cutoff_eq_zero hy.le]
    simp

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.eventMap_eventuallyEq_standard
statement:
lemma eventMap_eventuallyEq_standard {v : E'}
    (hv : StandardSaddle.eventMap m v = 0) :
    Filter.EventuallyEq (nhds v) (eventMap m)
      (StandardSaddle.eventMap m)
proof:
:= by
  have hslt : CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) v) < 4 :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (standard_event_normSq_le_three m hv) (by norm_num)
  have hopen : IsOpen
      {w : E' | CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) w) < 4} :=
    isOpen_lt
      (CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.continuous.comp
        (initCLM (m + 3)).continuous) continuous_const
  exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hslt) fun w hw => by
    rw [eventMap, cutoff_eq_zero hw.le]
    simp

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.source_fiber_eq_standard
statement:
theorem source_fiber_eq_standard :
    (sourceFLS m).fiber = (StandardSaddle.sourceFLS m).fiber
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact levelMap_neg_half_zero_iff m x

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.target_fiber_eq_standard
statement:
theorem target_fiber_eq_standard :
    (targetFLS m).fiber = (StandardSaddle.targetFLS m).fiber
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  exact levelMap_half_zero_iff m x

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.frameAt_source_eq_standard
statement:
theorem frameAt_source_eq_standard {x : E} (hx : x ∈ (sourceFLS m).fiber) :
    frameAt (sourceFLS m) x = frameAt (StandardSaddle.sourceFLS m) x
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2) x = 0 :=
    (levelMap_neg_half_zero_iff m x).mp hx
  have hv : StandardSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x 0) = 0 := by
    rw [StandardSaddle.eventMap_spaceTime,
      StandardSaddle.height_of_le_quarter (by norm_num)]
    exact hx'
  have hsq : CompactBirth.normSq x < 4 := by
    have hle := standard_event_normSq_le_three m hv
    rw [initCLM_spaceTime] at hle
    linarith
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (levelMap m (-1 / 2)) x =
      fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (-1 / 2)) x :=
    (levelMap_eventuallyEq_standard m hsq).fderiv_eq
  simp only [frameAt, sourceFLS, StandardSaddle.sourceFLS]
  simp [tauField, kerCross, gradVec, hfd]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.frameAt_target_eq_standard
statement:
theorem frameAt_target_eq_standard {x : E} (hx : x ∈ (targetFLS m).fiber) :
    frameAt (targetFLS m) x = frameAt (StandardSaddle.targetFLS m) x
proof:
:= by
  have hx' : StandardSaddle.levelMap m (1 / 2) x = 0 :=
    (levelMap_half_zero_iff m x).mp hx
  have hv : StandardSaddle.eventMap m (spaceTime x 1) = 0 := by
    rw [StandardSaddle.eventMap_spaceTime,
      StandardSaddle.height_of_threeQuarter_le (by norm_num)]
    exact hx'
  have hsq : CompactBirth.normSq x < 4 := by
    have hle := standard_event_normSq_le_three m hv
    rw [initCLM_spaceTime] at hle
    linarith
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (levelMap m (1 / 2)) x =
      fderiv ℝ (StandardSaddle.levelMap m (1 / 2)) x :=
    (levelMap_eventuallyEq_standard m hsq).fderiv_eq
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_mul] at hfd
  simp only [frameAt, targetFLS, StandardSaddle.targetFLS]
  simp [tauField, kerCross, gradVec, hfd]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.cobordism_spatialFlatOutside
statement:
theorem cobordism_spatialFlatOutside :
    (cobordism m).SpatialFlatOutside (background m) 0 3
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hn : 3 ≤ ‖initCLM (m + 3) v‖ := by
    simpa [dist_zero_right] using hv
  have hs : 9 ≤ CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) v) := by
    rw [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg (initCLM (m + 3) v)]
  have hc := cutoff_eq_one hs
  simp [cobordism, eventMap, hc]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.signedCobordism_spatialFlatOutside
statement:
theorem signedCobordism_spatialFlatOutside :
    (signedCobordism m).SpatialFlatOutside (background m) 0 3
proof:
:=
  cobordism_spatialFlatOutside m

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.signedSplitCobordism_spatialFlatOutside
statement:
theorem signedSplitCobordism_spatialFlatOutside :
    (signedSplitCobordism m).SpatialFlatOutside (background m) 0 3
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  change eventMap m (reparamMap (m + 2) (-1) 1 v) = background m
  apply cobordism_spatialFlatOutside m
  simpa [reparamMap, initCLM_spaceTime] using hv

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.signedNegativeCobordism_spatialFlatOutside
statement:
theorem signedNegativeCobordism_spatialFlatOutside :
    (signedNegativeCobordism m).SpatialFlatOutside (background m) 0 3
proof:
:=
  cobordism_spatialFlatOutside m

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.nonempty_merge_juxtapose_tail
statement:
theorem nonempty_merge_juxtapose_tail
    {X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} (S : FiberSign X)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))} {R : ℝ}
    (hX : X.FlatOutside (background m) p R)
    (hsep : 3 + R < dist (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))) p) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      ((sourceSign m).juxtapose S (background_ne_zero m)
        (signedCobordism_spatialFlatOutside m).flatOutside_source hX hsep)
      ((targetSign m).juxtapose S (background_ne_zero m)
        (signedCobordism_spatialFlatOutside m).flatOutside_target hX hsep))
proof:
:= by
  exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_juxtapose_tail
    (signedCobordism m) (background_ne_zero m)
    (signedCobordism_spatialFlatOutside m) S hX hsep
    (signedCobordism_spatialFlatOutside m).flatOutside_source
    (signedCobordism_spatialFlatOutside m).flatOutside_target

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.nonempty_negativeMerge_juxtapose_tail
statement:
theorem nonempty_negativeMerge_juxtapose_tail
    {X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} (S : FiberSign X)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))} {R : ℝ}
    (hX : X.FlatOutside (background m) p R)
    (hsep : 3 + R < dist (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))) p) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      ((sourceNegativeSign m).juxtapose S (background_ne_zero m)
        (signedNegativeCobordism_spatialFlatOutside m).flatOutside_source hX hsep)
      ((targetNegativeSign m).juxtapose S (background_ne_zero m)
        (signedNegativeCobordism_spatialFlatOutside m).flatOutside_target hX hsep))
proof:
:= by
  exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_juxtapose_tail
    (signedNegativeCobordism m) (background_ne_zero m)
    (signedNegativeCobordism_spatialFlatOutside m) S hX hsep
    (signedNegativeCobordism_spatialFlatOutside m).flatOutside_source
    (signedNegativeCobordism_spatialFlatOutside m).flatOutside_target

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.contDiff_interpolation
statement:
lemma contDiff_interpolation (a : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞
    (fun p : ℝ × E => interpolation m a p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => StandardSaddle.levelMap m a p.2) :=
    (StandardSaddle.contDiff_levelMap m a).comp contDiff_snd
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => cutoff p.2) :=
    contDiff_cutoff.comp contDiff_snd
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => p.1 * cutoff p.2) :=
    contDiff_fst.mul hc
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub hs).smul ha).add (hs.smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.interpolation_apply_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma interpolation_apply_castSucc (a s : ℝ) (x : E)
    (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    interpolation m a s x j.castSucc =
      (1 - s * cutoff x) * x j.castSucc.castSucc
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.interpolation_coeff_ne_one
statement:
lemma interpolation_coeff_ne_one {a s : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : interpolation m a s x = 0) : s * cutoff x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hlast := congrArg (fun q : F => q (Fin.last (m + 1))) hx
  rw [interpolation_apply_last, hc] at hlast

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.interpolation_transverse_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun q : F => q j.castSucc) hx
  rw [interpolation_apply_castSucc] at hcoord
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hcoord
  have hcoeff0 : 0 ≤ s * cutoff x := mul_nonneg hs0 (cutoff_nonneg x)
  have hcoeff1 : s * cutoff x ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [cutoff_nonneg x, cutoff_le_one x]
  have hcoefflt : s * cutoff x < 1 :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne hcoeff1 (interpolation_coeff_ne_one m hx)
  exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hcoord).resolve_left (sub_ne_zero.mpr hcoefflt.ne')

    fun j => by
      rw [interpolation_transverse_eq_zero m hs0 hs1 hx j,
        zero_pow (by norm_num)]
  simp only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, zero_add]
  rfl

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.interpolation_zero_iff
statement:
lemma interpolation_zero_iff {a s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    (ha : a ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hbound : ∀ x : E, StandardSaddle.levelMap m a x = 0 →
      CompactBirth.normSq x ≤ 3) (x : E) :
    interpolation m a s x = 0 ↔ StandardSaddle.levelMap m a x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hcoeff0 : 0 ≤ s * cutoff x := mul_nonneg hs0 (cutoff_nonneg x)
    have hcoeff1 : s * cutoff x ≤ 1 := by
      nlinarith [cutoff_nonneg x, cutoff_le_one x]
    have hcoefflt : s * cutoff x < 1 :=
      lt_of_le_of_ne hcoeff1 (interpolation_coeff_ne_one m hx)
    have hr := interpolation_normSq_eq_radiusSq m hs0 hs1 hx
    have hlast := congrArg (fun q : F => q (Fin.last (m + 1))) hx
    rw [interpolation_apply_last] at hlast
    simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hlast
    have hslt : CompactBirth.normSq x < 4 := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hsge : 4 ≤ CompactBirth.normSq x := not_lt.mp hnot
      have hqform := StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_eq m x
      rw [hr] at hsge
      have hqpos : 0 < StandardSaddle.cassiniQ m x - a := by
        rw [hqform]
        unfold StandardSaddle.radiusSq at hsge ⊢
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x (StandardSaddle.planeFirst m)),
          sq_nonneg (x (StandardSaddle.planeSecond m))]
      have hprod : 0 < (1 - s * cutoff x) *
          (StandardSaddle.cassiniQ m x - a) :=
        mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hcoefflt) hqpos
      nlinarith
    have hc0 : cutoff x = 0 := cutoff_eq_zero hslt.le
    simpa [interpolation, hc0] using hx
  · intro hx
    have hc0 : cutoff x = 0 := cutoff_eq_zero ((hbound x hx).trans (by norm_num))
    simp [interpolation, hc0, hx]

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.interpolation_eventuallyEq_standard
statement:
lemma interpolation_eventuallyEq_standard {a s : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : CompactBirth.normSq x < 4) :
    Filter.EventuallyEq (nhds x) (interpolation m a s)
      (StandardSaddle.levelMap m a)
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen {y : E | CompactBirth.normSq y < 4} :=
    isOpen_lt CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.continuous continuous_const
  exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hx) fun y hy => by
    rw [interpolation, cutoff_eq_zero hy.le]
    simp

name: Submission.CompactSaddle.homotopy_regularSlab
statement:
theorem homotopy_regularSlab
    {n : ℕ} {X₀ X₁ : FramedLevelSet n} (D : DefiningMapHomotopy X₀ X₁) :
    regularSlab D.toCobordism.G 0 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [regularSlab]
  intro t ht hcritical
  obtain ⟨v, hvcrit, hvt⟩ := hcritical
  apply hvcrit.2
  let x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) := spacePart v
  have hvrepr : cobSpaceTime x t = v := by
    rw [← hvt]
    exact spaceTime_spacePart v
  have hvzero : D.H (normRamp t) x = 0 := by
    have h := hvcrit.1
    rw [← hvrepr] at h
    have hspace : cobSpaceTime x t = spaceTime x t := rfl
    rw [hspace] at h
    change D.cobMap (spaceTime x t) = 0 at h
    rwa [D.cobMap_spaceTime] at h
  have hxfib : x ∈ X₀.fiber := by
    have hmem : x ∈ {y | D.H (normRamp t) y = 0} := hvzero
    rwa [D.fiber_eq _ (normRamp_nonneg _) (normRamp_le_one _)] at hmem
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective
      (fderiv ℝ (D.H (normRamp t)) x) :=
    D.regular _ (normRamp_nonneg _) (normRamp_le_one _) x hxfib
  rw [← hvrepr]
  change Function.Surjective (spatialDeriv D.cobMap (cobSpaceTime x t))
  rw [← fderiv_sliceMap D.contDiff_cobMap t x]
  have hslice : sliceMap D.cobMap t = D.H (normRamp t) := by
    funext y
    change D.cobMap (cobSpaceTime y t) = D.H (normRamp t) y
    have hspace : cobSpaceTime y t = spaceTime y t := rfl
    rw [hspace, D.cobMap_spaceTime]
  rwa [hslice]

name: Submission.subset_of_relOpen_closed
statement:
lemma subset_of_relOpen_closed {α : Type*} [MetricSpace α] {S A : Set α}
    (hS : IsPreconnected S) (hsub : A ⊆ S) (hclosed : IsClosed A)
    (hopen : ∀ z ∈ A, ∃ r > 0, S ∩ Metric.ball z r ⊆ A)
    (hne : A.Nonempty) : S ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose! rad hradpos hradsub using hopen
  set U : Set α := ⋃ z ∈ A, Metric.ball z (rad z) with hU
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := isOpen_biUnion fun z _ => Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hAU : A ⊆ U := fun z hz => Set.mem_biUnion hz (Metric.mem_ball_self (hradpos z hz))
  have hUS : U ∩ S ⊆ A := by
    rintro x ⟨hxU, hxS⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hzA, hxball⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hxU
    exact hradsub z hzA ⟨hxS, hxball⟩
  intro s hs
  by_contra hsA
  have hcover : S ⊆ U ∪ Aᶜ := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
    · exact Or.inl (hAU hxA)
    · exact Or.inr hxA
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0⟩ := hne
  have h1 : (S ∩ U).Nonempty := ⟨z0, hsub hz0, hAU hz0⟩
  have h2 : (S ∩ Aᶜ).Nonempty := ⟨s, hs, hsA⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hwS, hwU, hwA⟩ := hS U Aᶜ hUopen hclosed.isOpen_compl hcover h1 h2
  exact hwA (hUS ⟨hwU, hwS⟩)

name: Submission.continuous_gramSchmidt_family'
statement:
lemma continuous_gramSchmidt_family' {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {A : X → Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)}
    (hA : ∀ i, Continuous fun t => A t i)
    (hInd : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (A t)) (i : Fin m) :
    Continuous fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin m, (i : ℕ) = N →
      Continuous fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i := by
    intro N
    induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ N IH =>
      intro i hi
      have hrw : (fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i) = fun t => A t i -
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Iio i,
            (⟪gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j, A t i⟫ / ((‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j‖ : ℝ) ^ 2)) •
              gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j := by
        funext t
        rw [gramSchmidt_def]
        congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
        rw [starProjection_singleton]
        norm_num
      rw [hrw]
      apply (hA i).sub
      apply continuous_finsetSum
      intro j hj
      have hjN : (j : ℕ) < N := by
        have h1 : j < i := Finset.mem_Iio.mp hj
        have h2 : (j : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) := h1
        omega
      have hcj : Continuous fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j := IH (j : ℕ) hjN j rfl
      have hdiv : Continuous fun t =>
          ⟪gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j, A t i⟫ / ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j‖ ^ 2 := by
        apply Continuous.div
        · exact hcj.inner (hA i)
        · exact (hcj.norm).pow 2
        · intro t
          exact pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (gramSchmidt_ne_zero j (hInd t)))
      exact hdiv.smul hcj
  exact key (i : ℕ) i rfl

name: Submission.continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_family'
statement:
lemma continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_family' {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {A : X → Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)}
    (hA : ∀ i, Continuous fun t => A t i)
    (hInd : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (A t)) (i : Fin m) :
    Continuous fun t => gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (A t) i
proof:
:= by
  have hgs := continuous_gramSchmidt_family' hA hInd i
  have hnorm : Continuous fun t => ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i‖⁻¹ :=
    (hgs.norm).inv₀ fun t =>
      norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (gramSchmidt_ne_zero i (hInd t))
  have heq : (fun t => gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (A t) i)
      = fun t => ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i‖⁻¹ • gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i := by
    funext t
    rw [gramSchmidtNormed]
    norm_num
  rw [heq]
  exact hnorm.smul hgs

name: Submission.isCompact_slabFiber
statement:
lemma isCompact_slabFiber (C : LevelCobordismData n) (a b : ℝ) :
    IsCompact (slabFiber C a b)
proof:
:= by
  apply Metric.isCompact_of_isClosed_isBounded
  · exact C.isClosed_fiber.inter (isClosed_Icc.preimage continuous_tcoord)
  · obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := C.spatial_bounded
    apply isBounded_iff_forall_norm_le.mpr
    refine ⟨|R| + |a| + |b|, fun v hv => ?_⟩
    have hspace : ‖spacePart v‖ ≤ |R| :=
      (hR v hv.1).trans (le_abs_self R)
    have htime : |tcoord v| ≤ |a| + |b| := by
      rw [abs_le]
      constructor
      · have ha := neg_abs_le a
        have habs := abs_nonneg b
        linarith [hv.2.1]
      · have hb := le_abs_self b
        have haabs := abs_nonneg a
        linarith [hv.2.2]
    calc
      ‖v‖ = ‖cobSpaceTime (spacePart v) (tcoord v)‖ := by
        rw [spaceTime_spacePart]
      _ = ‖spaceInclL (spacePart v) + tcoord v • timeVec‖ := by
        rw [spaceTime_eq]
      _ ≤ ‖spaceInclL (spacePart v)‖ + ‖tcoord v • timeVec‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      _ = ‖spacePart v‖ + |tcoord v| := by
        rw [norm_spaceInclL, norm_smul, norm_timeVec, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      _ ≤ |R| + (|a| + |b|) := add_le_add hspace htime
      _ = |R| + |a| + |b| := by ring

name: Submission.exists_slabTamedField
statement:
theorem exists_slabTamedField (C : LevelCobordismData n) {a b : ℝ}
    (hreg : regularSlab C.G a b) : Nonempty (SlabTamedField C a b)
proof:
:= by
  
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂pos, hδ₂sub⟩ :=
    (isCompact_slabFiber C a b).exists_cthickening_subset_open
      (isOpen_slabRegularSet C.smooth) (slabFiber_subset_slabRegularSet C hreg)
  set δ := δ₂ / 2 with hδdef
  have hδpos : 0 < δ := by positivity
  have h2δ : 2 * δ = δ₂ := by rw [hδdef]; ring
  have hsub : Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b) ⊆ slabRegularSet C.G := by
    rw [h2δ]; exact hδ₂sub
  
  have hs : IsClosed (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b))ᶜ :=
    Metric.isOpen_thickening.isClosed_compl
  have ht : IsClosed (Metric.cthickening δ (slabFiber C a b)) := Metric.isClosed_cthickening
  have hd : Disjoint (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b))ᶜ
      (Metric.cthickening δ (slabFiber C a b)) := by
    rw [Set.disjoint_left]
    intro x hx hx'
    exact hx (Metric.cthickening_subset_thickening' (by positivity) (by linarith) _ hx')
  obtain ⟨f, hf0, hf1, hf01⟩ :=
    exists_contMDiffMap_zero_one_of_isClosed
      (I := modelWithCornersSelf ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
      (n := (⊤ : ℕ∞)) hs ht hd
  have hχ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (⇑f) := by
    rw [← contMDiff_iff_contDiff]
    exact f.contMDiff
  
  have hsmooth : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x => f x • timeField C.G x := by
    rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ slabRegularSet C.G
    · exact hχ.contDiffAt.smul (contDiffAt_timeField C.smooth hx)
    · 
      have hxC : x ∈ (Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b))ᶜ := fun hmem =>
        hx (hsub hmem)
      have hU : IsOpen (Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b))ᶜ :=
        Metric.isClosed_cthickening.isOpen_compl
      have hzero : ∀ y ∈ (Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b))ᶜ,
          f y • timeField C.G y = 0 := by
        intro y hy
        have hy' : y ∈ (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b))ᶜ := fun hmem =>
          hy (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _ hmem)
        have hfy : f y = 0 := hf0 hy'
        rw [hfy, zero_smul]
      have hev : (fun y => f y • timeField C.G y) =ᶠ[𝓝 x] (fun _ => (0 : E')) :=
        Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hU.mem_nhds hxC) hzero
      exact (contDiffAt_const (c := (0 : E'))).congr_of_eventuallyEq hev
  
  have hsupp : HasCompactSupport fun x => f x • timeField C.G x := by
    have h1 : support (fun x => f x • timeField C.G x) ⊆
        Metric.thickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b) := by
      intro x hx
      by_contra hmem
      have hfx : f x = 0 := hf0 hmem
      apply hx
      show f x • timeField C.G x = 0
      rw [hfx, zero_smul]
    have h2 : tsupport (fun x => f x • timeField C.G x) ⊆
        Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b) :=
      closure_minimal (h1.trans (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _))
        Metric.isClosed_cthickening
    exact IsCompact.of_isClosed_subset ((isCompact_slabFiber C a b).cthickening)
      isClosed_closure h2
  
  have hcont : ContinuousOn (timeField C.G)
      (Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b)) := fun x hx =>
    (contDiffAt_timeField C.smooth (hsub hx)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  obtain ⟨M, hM⟩ :=
    ((isCompact_slabFiber C a b).cthickening).exists_bound_of_continuousOn hcont
  
  refine ⟨⟨fun x => f x • timeField C.G x, δ, hδpos, hsmooth, Real.toNNReal M, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩⟩
  · 
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b)
    · have h1 : ‖f x‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_le]
        exact ⟨by linarith [(hf01 x).1], (hf01 x).2⟩
      calc ‖f x • timeField C.G x‖ = ‖f x‖ * ‖timeField C.G x‖ := norm_smul _ _
        _ ≤ 1 * M := by
            apply mul_le_mul h1 (hM x hx) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = M := one_mul M
        _ ≤ Real.toNNReal M := Real.le_coe_toNNReal M
    · have hy' : x ∈ (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b))ᶜ := fun hmem =>
        hx (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _ hmem)
      have hfx : f x = 0 := hf0 hy'
      rw [hfx, zero_smul, norm_zero]
      exact (Real.toNNReal M).coe_nonneg
  · 
    intro x hx
    have hfx : f x = 1 := hf1 hx
    rw [hfx, one_smul]
  · 
    intro x hx
    apply hsub
    exact Metric.cthickening_mono (by linarith) _ hx
  · 
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Metric.cthickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b)
    · have hxr : x ∈ slabRegularSet C.G := hsub hx
      rw [map_smul, fderiv_timeField hxr.1, smul_zero]
    · have hy' : x ∈ (Metric.thickening (2 * δ) (slabFiber C a b))ᶜ := fun hmem =>
        hx (Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening _ _ hmem)
      have hfx : f x = 0 := hf0 hy'
      rw [hfx, zero_smul, map_zero]
  · 
    exact hsmooth.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport hsupp (by simp)

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.solution_unique
statement:
theorem solution_unique {γ₁ γ₂ : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    (h₁ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt γ₁ (W.w (γ₁ t)) t)
    (h₂ : ∀ t, HasDerivAt γ₂ (W.w (γ₂ t)) t)
    {t₀ : ℝ} (heq : γ₁ t₀ = γ₂ t₀) : γ₁ = γ₂
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := W.lipschitz
  exact ODE_solution_unique_univ (v := fun _ x => W.w x) (s := fun _ => univ)
    (t₀ := t₀) (fun _ => hK.lipschitzOnWith)
    (fun t => ⟨h₁ t, mem_univ _⟩) (fun t => ⟨h₂ t, mem_univ _⟩) heq

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.exists_solution
statement:
theorem exists_solution (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :
    ∃ γ : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      γ 0 = p ∧ ∀ t, HasDerivAt γ (W.w (γ t)) t
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := W.lipschitz
  
  have main : ∀ T : ℕ, ∃ α : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      α 0 = p ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo (-(T + 1 : ℝ)) (T + 1 : ℝ), HasDerivAt α (W.w (α t)) t := by
    intro T
    have h0mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (-(T + 1 : ℝ)) (T + 1 : ℝ) := by
      constructor
      · have h0T : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T := T.cast_nonneg
        linarith
      · have h0T : (0 : ℝ) ≤ T := T.cast_nonneg
        linarith
    have hpl : IsPicardLindelof (fun (_ : ℝ) x => W.w x)
        (⟨0, h0mem⟩ : Icc (-(T + 1 : ℝ)) (T + 1 : ℝ)) p
        (W.bound * ((T : NNReal) + 2)) 0 W.bound K := by
      constructor
      · exact fun t _ => hK.lipschitzOnWith
      · exact fun x _ => continuousOn_const
      · intro t _ x _
        simpa using W.norm_le x
      · show (W.bound : ℝ) * max ((T + 1 : ℝ) - 0) (0 - -(T + 1 : ℝ))
          ≤ ((W.bound * ((T : NNReal) + 2) : NNReal) : ℝ) - ((0 : NNReal) : ℝ)
        have h1 : max ((T + 1 : ℝ) - 0) (0 - -(T + 1 : ℝ)) = (T + 1 : ℝ) := by
          rw [sub_zero, zero_sub, neg_neg, max_self]
        rw [h1]
        push_cast
        have hb : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (W.bound : ℝ) := W.bound.coe_nonneg
        nlinarith
    obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα⟩ := hpl.exists_eq_forall_mem_Icc_hasDerivWithinAt
      (mem_closedBall_self le_rfl)
    refine ⟨α, hα0, fun t ht => ?_⟩
    exact (hα t (Ioo_subset_Icc_self ht)).hasDerivAt (Icc_mem_nhds ht.1 ht.2)
  choose α hα0 hαs using main
  
  have agree : ∀ (T S : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| < T + 1 → |t| < S + 1 → α T t = α S t := by
    intro T S t hT hS
    set m' : ℕ := min T S with hm
    have hmT : (m' : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (T : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have h1 : (m' : ℕ) ≤ T := min_le_left T S
      exact_mod_cast by omega
    have hmS : (m' : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (S : ℝ) + 1 := by
      have h1 : (m' : ℕ) ≤ S := min_le_right T S
      exact_mod_cast by omega
    have htm : |t| < (m' : ℝ) + 1 := by
      rcases min_choice T S with h | h <;> rw [hm, h]
      · exact hT
      · exact hS
    have hsub : Ioo (-(m' + 1 : ℝ)) (m' + 1 : ℝ) ⊆ Ioo (-(T + 1 : ℝ)) (T + 1 : ℝ) :=
      Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have hsub' : Ioo (-(m' + 1 : ℝ)) (m' + 1 : ℝ) ⊆ Ioo (-(S + 1 : ℝ)) (S + 1 : ℝ) :=
      Ioo_subset_Ioo (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h0m : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (-(m' + 1 : ℝ)) (m' + 1 : ℝ) := by
      constructor
      · have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m' := m'.cast_nonneg
        linarith
      · have h0 : (0 : ℝ) ≤ m' := m'.cast_nonneg
        linarith
    have huniq := ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Ioo (v := fun (_ : ℝ) x => W.w x)
      (s := fun _ => univ) (K := K)
      (fun t _ => hK.lipschitzOnWith) h0m
      (fun u hu => ⟨hαs T u (hsub hu), mem_univ _⟩)
      (fun u hu => ⟨hαs S u (hsub' hu), mem_univ _⟩)
      ((hα0 T).trans (hα0 S).symm)
    exact huniq ⟨(abs_lt.mp htm).1, (abs_lt.mp htm).2⟩
  
  refine ⟨fun t => α (Nat.floor |t|) t, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using hα0 (Nat.floor |(0 : ℝ)|)
  · intro t
    set N : ℕ := Nat.floor |t| with hN
    have htN : |t| < (N : ℝ) + 1 := Nat.lt_floor_add_one _
    have hev : (fun s => α (Nat.floor |s|) s) =ᶠ[𝓝 t] α N := by
      have hUopen : IsOpen {s : ℝ | |s| < (N : ℝ) + 1} :=
        isOpen_lt (continuous_abs) continuous_const
      refine Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hUopen.mem_nhds htN) fun s hs => ?_
      exact agree (Nat.floor |s|) N s (Nat.lt_floor_add_one _) hs
    have hder : HasDerivAt (α N) (W.w (α N t)) t := by
      apply hαs N t
      have habs := abs_lt.mp htN
      exact ⟨habs.1, habs.2⟩
    have hda : HasDerivAt (fun s => α (Nat.floor |s|) s) (W.w (α N t)) t :=
      (Filter.EventuallyEq.hasDerivAt_iff hev).mpr hder
    simpa [← hN] using hda

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.flow_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma flow_zero (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) : W.flow p 0 = p
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (W.exists_solution p)).1

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.hasDerivAt_flow
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_flow (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (W.flow p) (W.w (W.flow p t)) t
proof:
:=
  (Classical.choose_spec (W.exists_solution p)).2 t

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.continuous_flow
statement: lemma continuous_flow (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) : Continuous (W.flow p)
proof:
:=
  continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun t => (W.hasDerivAt_flow p t).continuousAt

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.solution_mem_fiber
proof:
:= by
  have hcomp : ∀ t, HasDerivAt (fun s => C.G (γ s)) 0 t := by
    intro t
    have hgdiff : HasFDerivAt C.G (fderiv ℝ C.G (γ t)) (γ t) :=
      (C.smooth.differentiable (by simp)).differentiableAt.hasFDerivAt
    have h1 := hgdiff.comp_hasDerivAt t (hγ t)
    rwa [W.fderiv_zero (γ t)] at h1
  have hconst : ∀ t, C.G (γ t) = C.G (γ 0) := by
    intro t
    exact is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero
      (fun s => (hcomp s).differentiableAt)
      (fun s => (hcomp s).deriv) t 0
  intro t
  have h2 := hconst t
  rw [show C.G (γ 0) = 0 from h0] at h2
  exact h2

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.flow_mem_fiber
statement:
lemma flow_mem_fiber {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} (hp : p ∈ C.fiber) (t : ℝ) :
    W.flow p t ∈ C.fiber
proof:
:=
  W.solution_mem_fiber (W.hasDerivAt_flow p) (by rw [W.flow_zero]; exact hp) t

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.hasDerivAt_shift
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => c + z) 1 u := (hasDerivAt_id u).const_add c
  have h2 := (hγ (c + u)).scomp u h1
  simpa [Function.comp_def] using h2

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.flow_shift
statement:
lemma flow_shift (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (c : ℝ) :
    W.flow (W.flow p c) = fun u => W.flow p (c + u)
proof:
:= by
  apply W.solution_unique (t₀ := 0)
  · exact W.hasDerivAt_flow (W.flow p c)
  · exact fun u => W.hasDerivAt_shift (W.hasDerivAt_flow p) c u
  · simp

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.dist_flow_flow_le
statement:
lemma dist_flow_flow_le {K : NNReal} (hK : LipschitzWith K W.w)
    (p q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (s : ℝ) :
    dist (W.flow p s) (W.flow q s) ≤ dist p q * Real.exp (K * |s|)
proof:
:= by
  rcases le_or_gt 0 s with hs | hs
  · have h := dist_le_of_trajectories_ODE (v := fun (_ : ℝ) x => W.w x) (K := K)
      (fun _ => hK)
      ((W.continuous_flow p).continuousOn : ContinuousOn (W.flow p) (Icc 0 s))
      (fun t _ => (W.hasDerivAt_flow p t).hasDerivWithinAt)
      ((W.continuous_flow q).continuousOn : ContinuousOn (W.flow q) (Icc 0 s))
      (fun t _ => (W.hasDerivAt_flow q t).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (by simp : dist (W.flow p 0) (W.flow q 0) ≤ dist p q)
      s ⟨hs, le_refl s⟩
    rwa [sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg hs] at *
    
  · 
    have hKn : LipschitzWith K fun x => -W.w x :=
      LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul fun x y => by
        rw [dist_neg_neg]; exact hK.dist_le_mul x y
    have htraj : ∀ (r : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (t : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun z => W.flow r (-z)) (-W.w (W.flow r (-t))) t := by
      intro r t
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z : ℝ => -z) (-1) t := (hasDerivAt_id t).neg
      have h2 := (W.hasDerivAt_flow r (-t)).scomp t h1
      have h3 : HasDerivAt (fun z => W.flow r (-z))
          ((-1 : ℝ) • W.w (W.flow r (-t))) t := h2
      have h4 : ((-1 : ℝ) • W.w (W.flow r (-t))) = -W.w (W.flow r (-t)) :=
        neg_one_smul ℝ _
      rw [h4] at h3
      exact h3
    have h := dist_le_of_trajectories_ODE (v := fun (_ : ℝ) x => -W.w x) (K := K)
      (fun _ => hKn)
      (f := fun z => W.flow p (-z))
      ((W.continuous_flow p).comp continuous_neg).continuousOn
      (fun t _ => (htraj p t).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (g := fun z => W.flow q (-z))
      ((W.continuous_flow q).comp continuous_neg).continuousOn
      (fun t _ => (htraj q t).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (by simp : dist (W.flow p (-(0 : ℝ))) (W.flow q (-(0 : ℝ))) ≤ dist p q)
      (-s) ⟨by linarith, le_refl (-s)⟩
    rw [neg_neg, sub_zero] at h
    rwa [abs_of_neg hs]

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.lipschitzWith_flow_apply
statement:
lemma lipschitzWith_flow_apply {K : NNReal} (hK : LipschitzWith K W.w) (s : ℝ) :
    LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal (Real.exp (K * |s|))) (fun p => W.flow p s)
proof:
:= by
  apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
  intro p q
  calc dist (W.flow p s) (W.flow q s) ≤ dist p q * Real.exp (K * |s|) :=
        W.dist_flow_flow_le hK p q s
    _ = Real.exp (K * |s|) * dist p q := mul_comm _ _
    _ ≤ Real.toNNReal (Real.exp (K * |s|)) * dist p q := by
        have h1 : Real.exp (K * |s|) ≤ Real.toNNReal (Real.exp (K * |s|)) :=
          Real.le_coe_toNNReal _
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 dist_nonneg

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.continuous_flow_apply
statement: lemma continuous_flow_apply (s : ℝ) : Continuous (fun p => W.flow p s)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := W.lipschitz
  exact (W.lipschitzWith_flow_apply hK s).continuous

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.dist_flow_self_le
statement:
lemma dist_flow_self_le (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) (s s' : ℝ) :
    dist (W.flow p s) (W.flow p s') ≤ (W.bound : ℝ) * |s - s'|
proof:
:= by
  
  have key : ∀ u u' : ℝ, u' ≤ u →
      ‖W.flow p u - W.flow p u'‖ ≤ (W.bound : ℝ) * (u - u') := by
    intro u u' huu
    have h := norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_deriv_le_segment'
      (f := W.flow p) (f' := fun z => W.w (W.flow p z)) (a := u') (b := u)
      (C := (W.bound : ℝ))
      (fun z _ => (W.hasDerivAt_flow p z).hasDerivWithinAt)
      (fun z _ => W.norm_le _)
      u ⟨huu, le_refl u⟩
    exact h
  rcases le_total s' s with h | h
  · rw [dist_eq_norm, abs_of_nonneg (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ s - s')]
    exact key s s' h
  · rw [dist_comm, dist_eq_norm, abs_of_nonpos (by linarith : s - s' ≤ 0)]
    have h1 := key s' s h
    calc ‖W.flow p s' - W.flow p s‖ ≤ (W.bound : ℝ) * (s' - s) := h1
      _ = (W.bound : ℝ) * -(s - s') := by ring

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.continuous_flow_uncurry
statement:
lemma continuous_flow_uncurry :
    Continuous fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) × ℝ => W.flow q.1 q.2
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := W.lipschitz
  rw [Metric.continuous_iff]
  rintro ⟨p₀, s₀⟩ ε hε
  set M := Real.exp ((K : ℝ) * (|s₀| + 1)) with hM
  have hMpos : 0 < M := Real.exp_pos _
  set D : ℝ := M + (W.bound : ℝ) + 1 with hD
  have hDpos : 0 < D := by
    have h1 := W.bound.coe_nonneg
    have h2 := hMpos
    rw [hD]; linarith
  refine ⟨min 1 (ε / D), lt_min one_pos (by positivity), ?_⟩
  rintro ⟨p, s⟩ hdist
  have hpair : max (dist p p₀) (dist s s₀) < min 1 (ε / D) := by
    rw [Prod.dist_eq] at hdist
    exact hdist
  have hd1 : dist p p₀ < min 1 (ε / D) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_left _ _) hpair
  have hd2 : dist s s₀ < min 1 (ε / D) := lt_of_le_of_lt (le_max_right _ _) hpair
  have habs : |s - s₀| < min 1 (ε / D) := by
    rw [← Real.dist_eq]
    exact hd2
  have hs1 : |s| ≤ |s₀| + 1 := by
    have h1 : |s - s₀| < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le habs (min_le_left _ _)
    have h2 : |s| - |s₀| ≤ |s - s₀| := abs_sub_abs_le_abs_sub s s₀
    linarith
  have hexp : Real.exp ((K : ℝ) * |s|) ≤ M := by
    rw [hM]
    apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
    have hKnn := K.coe_nonneg
    nlinarith
  have hεD1 : dist p p₀ ≤ ε / D := le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hd1 (min_le_right _ _))
  have hεD2 : |s - s₀| ≤ ε / D := le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le habs (min_le_right _ _))
  calc dist (W.flow p s) (W.flow p₀ s₀)
      ≤ dist (W.flow p s) (W.flow p₀ s) + dist (W.flow p₀ s) (W.flow p₀ s₀) :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
    _ ≤ dist p p₀ * Real.exp ((K : ℝ) * |s|) + (W.bound : ℝ) * |s - s₀| :=
        add_le_add (W.dist_flow_flow_le hK p p₀ s) (W.dist_flow_self_le p₀ s s₀)
    _ ≤ (ε / D) * M + (W.bound : ℝ) * (ε / D) := by
        apply add_le_add
        · exact mul_le_mul hεD1 hexp (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) (by positivity)
        · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hεD2 W.bound.coe_nonneg
    _ = (ε / D) * (M + (W.bound : ℝ)) := by ring
    _ < ε := by
        have h3 : M + (W.bound : ℝ) < D := by rw [hD]; linarith
        have h4 : (ε / D) * (M + (W.bound : ℝ)) < (ε / D) * D :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h3 (by positivity)
        have h5 : (ε / D) * D = ε := div_mul_cancel₀ ε (ne_of_gt hDpos)
        linarith

name: Submission.matrixRowsONBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem matrixRowsONBasis_apply (Q : SOGroup (n + 1))
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    matrixRowsONBasis Q i =
      matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i
proof:
:= by
  simp [matrixRowsONBasis]

name: Submission.crossVec_matrixRows_succ
statement:
theorem crossVec_matrixRows_succ (Q : SOGroup (n + 1)) :
    crossVec (fun i : Fin n =>
      matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i.succ) =
      matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) 0
proof:
:= by
  let b := matrixRowsONBasis Q
  apply ext_inner_right_basis b.toBasis
  intro j
  change inner ℝ
      (crossVec (fun i : Fin n =>
        matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i.succ))
      (b j) =
    inner ℝ
      (matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) 0)
      (b j)
  rw [matrixRowsONBasis_apply]
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · rw [inner_crossVec]
    have hrows :
        crossRows
            (fun i : Fin n =>
              matrixRows
                (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i.succ)
            (matrixRows
              (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) 0) =
          (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) := by
      ext i k
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩ <;>
        rfl
    rw [crossDet, hrows,
      (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp Q.property).2]
    have horth := orthonormal_matrixRows_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
      (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp Q.property).1
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, horth.1 0]
    norm_num
  · rw [inner_crossVec, crossDet_apply_self]
    have horth := orthonormal_matrixRows_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
      (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp Q.property).1
    simpa [show (0 : Fin (n + 1)) ≠ j.succ by
      exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm] using
      (orthonormal_iff_ite.mp horth (0 : Fin (n + 1)) j.succ).symm

name: Submission.gradVec_eq_matrixRows_succ_of_rightInverse
statement:
theorem gradVec_eq_matrixRows_succ_of_rightInverse
    (X : FramedLevelSet n) (x : E) (Q : SOGroup (n + 1))
    (htangent : fderiv ℝ X.g x
      (matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) 0) = 0)
    (hnormal : ∀ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ X.g x
      (matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i.succ) =
        EuclideanSpace.single i 1)
    (i : Fin n) :
    gradVec X.g i x =
      matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i.succ
proof:
:= by
  let b := matrixRowsONBasis Q
  apply ext_inner_right_basis b.toBasis
  intro j
  change inner ℝ (gradVec X.g i x) (b j) =
    inner ℝ
      (matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i.succ)
      (b j)
  rw [matrixRowsONBasis_apply]
  have horth := orthonormal_matrixRows_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
    (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp Q.property).1
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · rw [inner_gradVec, htangent]
    simpa using
      (orthonormal_iff_ite.mp horth i.succ (0 : Fin (n + 1))).symm
  · rw [inner_gradVec, hnormal j]
    have hq := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp horth i.succ j.succ
    simpa [PiLp.single_apply, eq_comm] using hq

name: Submission.frameAt_eq_matrixRows_of_SO_rightInverse
statement:
theorem frameAt_eq_matrixRows_of_SO_rightInverse
    (X : FramedLevelSet n) (x : E) (Q : SOGroup (n + 1))
    (htangent : fderiv ℝ X.g x
      (matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) 0) = 0)
    (hnormal : ∀ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ X.g x
      (matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i.succ) =
        EuclideanSpace.single i 1) :
    frameAt X x =
      matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  have hgrad : (fun i : Fin n => gradVec X.g i x) =
      fun i : Fin n =>
        matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i.succ := by
    funext i
    exact gradVec_eq_matrixRows_succ_of_rightInverse X x Q htangent hnormal i
  have horth := orthonormal_matrixRows_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
    (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp Q.property).1
  funext j
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · change tauField X.g x = _
    rw [tauField, kerCross, hgrad, crossVec_matrixRows_succ Q,
      horth.1 0, inv_one, one_smul]
  · change gradVec X.g j x = _
    exact gradVec_eq_matrixRows_succ_of_rightInverse X x Q htangent hnormal j

name: Submission.frameMatrix_eq_of_SO_rightInverse
statement:
theorem frameMatrix_eq_of_SO_rightInverse
    (X : FramedLevelSet n) (x : E) (Q : SOGroup (n + 1))
    (htangent : fderiv ℝ X.g x
      (matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) 0) = 0)
    (hnormal : ∀ i : Fin n, fderiv ℝ X.g x
      (matrixRows (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) i.succ) =
        EuclideanSpace.single i 1) :
    rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X x)) =
      (Q : Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameAt_eq_matrixRows_of_SO_rightInverse X x Q htangent hnormal]
  have horth := orthonormal_matrixRows_of_mem_orthogonalGroup
    (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp Q.property).1
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed_eq_of_orthonormal horth,
    rowsMatrix_matrixRows]

statement:
theorem contDiff_relativeObstacleLift
    (j : RelativeObstacleIndex (V := V) O) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ => relativeObstacleLift (V := V) h2 O j z.1 z.2)
proof:
:= by
  rcases j with ⟨⟨P, hPO⟩, b⟩
  cases b
  · simpa only [relativeObstacleLift, Function.comp_def] using
      (V.contDiff_intrinsicOrbitLift P).comp contDiff_snd
  · simpa only [relativeObstacleLift, Function.comp_def] using
      (FourierEmbeddingTrack.contDiff_targetLift (V := V) h2 P).comp contDiff_snd

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierRelativeTrack.exists_relativeGoodParameter
statement:
theorem exists_relativeGoodParameter (h3 : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ p : OrbitUnknottingFourier.Parameter E,
      p ∉ Set.range
        (OrbitUnknottingFourier.secantBadMap
          (FourierEmbeddingTrack.baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)) ∧
      p ∉ Set.range
        (OrbitUnknottingFourier.tangentBadMap
          (FourierEmbeddingTrack.baseTangent (V := V) h2 O)) ∧
      ∀ P : V.OrbitIndex, P ≠ O →
        p ∉ Set.range
          (OrbitUnknottingFourier.obstacleBadMap
            (FourierEmbeddingTrack.baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)
            (fun _s v => V.intrinsicOrbitLift P v)) ∧
        p ∉ Set.range
          (OrbitUnknottingFourier.obstacleBadMap
            (FourierEmbeddingTrack.baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)
            (fun _s v => FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := V) h2 P v))
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : 4 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E := by
    rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    omega
  obtain ⟨p, _hpU, hpsec, hptan, hpobs⟩ :=
    OrbitUnknottingFourier.exists_parameter_avoiding_badRanges_and_obstacles
      (FourierEmbeddingTrack.baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)
      (FourierEmbeddingTrack.baseTangent (V := V) h2 O)
      (relativeObstacleLift (V := V) h2 O)
      (FourierEmbeddingTrack.contDiff_baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)
      (FourierEmbeddingTrack.contDiff_baseTangent (V := V) h2 O)
      (contDiff_relativeObstacleLift (V := V) h2 O)
      hdim (U := Set.univ) isOpen_univ Set.univ_nonempty
  refine ⟨p, hpsec, hptan, ?_⟩
  intro P hPO
  have hsource := hpobs
    (⟨⟨P, hPO⟩, false⟩ : RelativeObstacleIndex (V := V) O)
  have htarget := hpobs
    (⟨⟨P, hPO⟩, true⟩ : RelativeObstacleIndex (V := V) O)
  have hsourceLift :
      relativeObstacleLift (V := V) h2 O
        (⟨⟨P, hPO⟩, false⟩ : RelativeObstacleIndex (V := V) O) =
        (fun _s v => V.intrinsicOrbitLift P v) := by
    funext s v
    rfl
  have htargetLift :
      relativeObstacleLift (V := V) h2 O
        (⟨⟨P, hPO⟩, true⟩ : RelativeObstacleIndex (V := V) O) =
        (fun _s v => FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift (V := V) h2 P v) := by
    funext s v
    rfl
  rw [hsourceLift] at hsource
  rw [htargetLift] at htarget
  exact ⟨hsource, htarget⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierRelativeTrack.exists_relativeEmbeddedCircleTrack
statement:

proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hpsec, hptan, hpobs⟩ :=
    exists_relativeGoodParameter (V := V) h2 O h3

    (V := V) h2 O p hpsec hptan hpobs⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierRelativeTrack.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.interior_range_disjoint_source
statement:
theorem interior_range_disjoint_source
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) (hPO : P ≠ O) :
    Disjoint (Set.range (R.track.circle s)) (P : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hx hP
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  rw [← V.range_intrinsicOrbitEmbedding P] at hP
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hP
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective b
  rw [V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding_coe, R.track.circle_coe] at hb
  exact (R.interior_ne_source s u v P hPO hs0 hs1) hb.symm

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierRelativeTrack.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.interior_range_disjoint_target
statement:
theorem interior_range_disjoint_target
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) (hPO : P ≠ O) :
    Disjoint (Set.range (R.track.circle s))
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 P)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  intro x hx hP
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.target] at hP
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hP
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective b
  rw [← FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift_eq_circlePoint (V := V) h2 P,
    R.track.circle_coe] at hb
  exact (R.interior_ne_target s u v P hPO hs0 hs1) hb.symm

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierRelativeTrack.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.range_disjoint_source
statement:
theorem range_disjoint_source
    {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) (hPO : P ≠ O) :
    Disjoint (Set.range (R.track.circle s)) (P : Set E)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs with ⟨hs0, hs1⟩
  by_cases hzero : s = 0
  · subst s
    rw [R.track.start_circle, V.range_intrinsicOrbitEmbedding]
    exact (OrbitUnknottingSupport.activeSet_disjoint_obstacleSet V h2 O).mono
      (fun _ hx => Or.inl hx)
      (OrbitUnknottingSupport.source_subset_obstacleSet V h2 O P hPO)
  by_cases hone : s = 1
  · subst s
    rw [R.track.finish_circle]
    change Disjoint (CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 O) (P : Set E)
    exact (OrbitUnknottingSupport.activeSet_disjoint_obstacleSet V h2 O).mono
      (fun _ hx => Or.inr hx)
      (OrbitUnknottingSupport.source_subset_obstacleSet V h2 O P hPO)
  exact interior_range_disjoint_source (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) R
    (lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hzero))
    (lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hone) P hPO

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierRelativeTrack.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.range_disjoint_target
statement:
theorem range_disjoint_target
    {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) (hPO : P ≠ O) :
    Disjoint (Set.range (R.track.circle s))
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 P)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs with ⟨hs0, hs1⟩
  by_cases hzero : s = 0
  · subst s
    rw [R.track.start_circle, V.range_intrinsicOrbitEmbedding]
    exact (OrbitUnknottingSupport.activeSet_disjoint_obstacleSet V h2 O).mono
      (fun _ hx => Or.inl hx)
      (OrbitUnknottingSupport.target_subset_obstacleSet V h2 O P hPO)
  by_cases hone : s = 1
  · subst s
    rw [R.track.finish_circle]
    change Disjoint (CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 O)
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 P)
    exact (OrbitUnknottingSupport.activeSet_disjoint_obstacleSet V h2 O).mono
      (fun _ hx => Or.inr hx)
      (OrbitUnknottingSupport.target_subset_obstacleSet V h2 O P hPO)
  exact interior_range_disjoint_target (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) R
    (lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hzero))
    (lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hone) P hPO

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.circleAt_eq_canonical_plane
statement:
theorem circleAt_eq_canonical_plane (theta : ℝ) :
    circleAt (m := m) theta =
      Real.cos theta • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := m + 2) (by omega) +
        Real.sin theta • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := m + 2) (by omega)
proof:
:= by
  ext j
  by_cases h0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    simp [circleAt_apply, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀,
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁]
  by_cases h1 : j = 1
  · subst j
    simp [circleAt_apply, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀,
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁]
  · simp [circleAt_apply, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀,
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁, h0, h1]

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.canonical_point_eq_circleAt_add_center
statement:
theorem canonical_point_eq_circleAt_add_center
    {X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} (V : TamedField X)
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V (by omega) O theta =
      circleAt (m := m) theta +
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V (by omega) O
proof:
:= by
  rw [CanonicalRoundOrbit.point, circleAt_eq_canonical_plane]
  abel

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.tubeDistSq_circleAt_add_smul_e₂
statement:
theorem tubeDistSq_circleAt_add_smul_e₂ (theta d : ℝ) :
    tubeDistSq (circleAt (m := m) theta +
      d • CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)) = d ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let e2 : E := CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega)
  have hrad : rad (circleAt (m := m) theta + d • e2) = 1 := by
    rw [rad]
    have hrs : radSq (circleAt (m := m) theta + d • e2) = 1 := by
      simp [radSq, e2, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂,
        Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq]
    rw [hrs, Real.sqrt_one]
  have hinner :
      inner ℝ (circleAt (m := m) theta) (d • e2) = 0 := by
    rw [real_inner_smul_right]
    simp [e2, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂,
      EuclideanSpace.inner_single_right]
  have he2norm : ‖e2‖ = 1 := by
    simp [e2, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂]
  have hnorm := norm_add_sq_real (circleAt (m := m) theta) (d • e2)
  rw [tubeDistSq, hrad, hnorm, hinner, norm_circleAt,
    norm_smul, he2norm]
  simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
  ring

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.canonical_point_sub_center_not_mem_outerTube
statement:
theorem canonical_point_sub_center_not_mem_outerTube
    {X : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} (V : TamedField X)
    {O P : V.OrbitIndex} (hOP : O ≠ P) (theta : ℝ) :
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V (by omega) P theta -
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V (by omega) O ∉
      tubeRegion (m := m) (1 / 3)
proof:
:= by
  let kO : ℕ := V.orbitSlot O
  let kP : ℕ := V.orbitSlot P
  have hslot : V.orbitSlot O ≠ V.orbitSlot P := by
    intro h
    exact hOP (V.orbitSlot_injective h)
  have hnat : kO ≠ kP := by
    intro h
    apply hslot
    exact Fin.ext h
  have hpoint :
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V (by omega) P theta -
          CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V (by omega) O =
        circleAt (m := m) theta +
          (4 * ((kP : ℝ) - (kO : ℝ))) •
            CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂ (n := m + 2) (by omega) := by
    rw [canonical_point_eq_circleAt_add_center]
    simp only [CanonicalRoundOrbit.center, kO, kP]
    module
  rw [hpoint]
  change ¬ tubeDistSq _ < (1 / 3 : ℝ) ^ 2
  rw [tubeDistSq_circleAt_add_smul_e₂]
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hnat with hlt | hgt
  · have hgap : (kO : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (kP : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hlt)
    norm_num
    nlinarith
  · have hgap : (kP : ℝ) + 1 ≤ (kO : ℝ) := by
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.succ_le_iff.mpr hgt)
    norm_num
    nlinarith

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.listSpatialGauge_smooth
statement:
theorem listSpatialGauge_smooth (tail : List V₀.OrbitIndex) :
    ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E =>
        ((listSpatialGauge V₀ L₀ D₀ tail p.1 p.2 :
          SOGroup (m + 2)) : M) i j)
proof:
:= by
  induction tail with
  | nil =>
      intro i j
      exact contDiff_const
  | cons O tail ih =>
      intro i j
      change ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E =>
        ∑ k : Fin (m + 2),
          (((D₀ O).centeredSpatialGauge
            (CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O) p.1 p.2 :
              SOGroup (m + 2)) : M) i k *
            ((listSpatialGauge V₀ L₀ D₀ tail p.1 p.2 :
              SOGroup (m + 2)) : M) k j)
      exact ContDiff.sum fun k _ =>
        ((D₀ O).centeredSpatialGauge_smooth
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) O) i k).mul
            (ih k j)

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.listSpatialGauge_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem listSpatialGauge_zero (tail : List V₀.OrbitIndex)
    (x : E) : listSpatialGauge V₀ L₀ D₀ tail 0 x = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction tail with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons O tail ih =>
      rw [listSpatialGauge, NullGaugeData.centeredSpatialGauge_zero, ih,
        mul_one]

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.listSpatialGauge_eq_one_at_canonicalPoint_of_forall_ne
statement:
theorem listSpatialGauge_eq_one_at_canonicalPoint_of_forall_ne
    (tail : List V₀.OrbitIndex) (P : V₀.OrbitIndex)
    (hne : ∀ O ∈ tail, O ≠ P) (s theta : ℝ) :
    listSpatialGauge V₀ L₀ D₀ tail s
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V₀ (by omega) P theta) = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction tail with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons O tail ih =>
      rw [listSpatialGauge,
        (D₀ O).centeredSpatialGauge_eq_one_off_outer]
      · rw [ih (fun Q hQ => hne Q (by simp [hQ])), one_mul]
      · exact canonical_point_sub_center_not_mem_outerTube V₀
          (hne O (by simp)) theta

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.listSpatialGauge_one_canonicalPoint
statement:
theorem listSpatialGauge_one_canonicalPoint
    (tail : List V₀.OrbitIndex) (hnodup : tail.Nodup)
    (P : V₀.OrbitIndex) (hmem : P ∈ tail) (theta : ℝ) :
    listSpatialGauge V₀ L₀ D₀ tail 1
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V₀ (by omega) P theta) =
        (L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta)
proof:
:= by
  induction tail with
  | nil => simp at hmem
  | cons O tail ih =>
      rw [List.nodup_cons] at hnodup
      rcases hnodup with ⟨hOtail, htail⟩
      by_cases hOP : O = P
      · subst O
        rw [listSpatialGauge]
        rw [show (D₀ P).centeredSpatialGauge
            (CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V₀ (by omega) P) 1
              (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V₀ (by omega) P theta) =
            (L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta) by
          rw [canonical_point_eq_circleAt_add_center,
            (D₀ P).centeredSpatialGauge_one_circleAt]]
        rw [listSpatialGauge_eq_one_at_canonicalPoint_of_forall_ne]
        · rw [mul_one]
        · intro Q hQ hQP
          subst Q
          exact hOtail hQ
      · have hPtail : P ∈ tail := by
          simpa [hOP, Ne.symm hOP] using hmem
        rw [listSpatialGauge,
          (D₀ O).centeredSpatialGauge_eq_one_off_outer]
        · rw [one_mul, ih htail hPtail]
        · exact canonical_point_sub_center_not_mem_outerTube V₀ hOP theta

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge_one_canonicalPoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem spatialGauge_one_canonicalPoint
    (P : V₀.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.homotopy_H_one_canonicalPoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem homotopy_H_one_canonicalPoint
    (Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (P : V₀.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    (homotopy V₀ L₀ D₀ Y).H 1
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V₀ (by omega) P theta) =
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM
        ((L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))
        (Y.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V₀ (by omega) P theta))
proof:
:= by
  rw [homotopy, SOFrameGauge.homotopy_H,
    spatialGauge_one_canonicalPoint]

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.homotopyOfClassZero_H_one_canonicalPoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem homotopyOfClassZero_H_one_canonicalPoint
    (h3 : 3 ≤ m + 2)
    (hclass : ∀ O : V₀.OrbitIndex,
      loopClassZ2 (L₀ O).loop (L₀ O).closed = 0)
    (Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (P : V₀.OrbitIndex) (theta : ℝ) :
    (homotopyOfClassZero V₀ L₀ h3 hclass Y).H 1
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V₀ (by omega) P theta) =
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM
        ((L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos theta, Real.sin theta))
        (Y.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V₀ (by omega) P theta))
proof:
:= by
  exact homotopy_H_one_canonicalPoint V₀ L₀
    (nullGaugeFamilyOfClassZero V₀ L₀ h3 hclass) Y P theta

theorem chartReads_polarPath {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center}

name: Submission.zero_ne_halfI
statement: theorem zero_ne_halfI : (0 : I) ≠ halfI
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' : ((0 : I) : ℝ) = ((halfI : I) : ℝ) := congrArg Subtype.val h
  rw [show ((0 : I) : ℝ) = 0 from rfl, show ((halfI : I) : ℝ) = 1 / 2 from rfl]
    at h'
  norm_num at h'

name: Submission.coe_convexComb_zero_halfI
statement:
theorem coe_convexComb_zero_halfI (z : I) :
    ((Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) halfI z : I) : ℝ) = (z : ℝ) / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.Icc.coe_convexComb]
  show (1 - (z : ℝ)) * (0 : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) = (z : ℝ) / 2
  ring

name: Submission.injective_halfArc
statement:
theorem injective_halfArc (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    Function.Injective
      (fun z : I => P.curve (Set.Icc.convexComb (0 : I) halfI z))
proof:
:= by
  intro z z' h
  have hone : ((1 : I) : ℝ) = 1 := rfl
  rcases P.curve_eq_cases h with hcase | ⟨_, hc2⟩ | ⟨hc1, _⟩
  · exact injective_convexComb zero_ne_halfI hcase
  · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hc2
    rw [coe_convexComb_zero_halfI, hone] at hval
    have := z'.2.2
    linarith
  · have hval := congrArg Subtype.val hc1
    rw [coe_convexComb_zero_halfI, hone] at hval
    have := z.2.2
    linarith

name: Submission.halfArc_apply
statement:
