name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeBranchOrbit_diff_segment_subset_halfArc
statement:
theorem saddleNegativeBranchOrbit_diff_segment_subset_halfArc
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (b : SaddleBranch)
    {ρ s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hreg))
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hreg) V)
    (hP : V.orbitPoint (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hreg V) ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (hstart : P.curve 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hstartne : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      P.curve 0 ≠ spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b e ρ s))
    (hmark : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b e ρ s) ∈
        Set.range (halfArc P)) :
    ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V :
        V.OrbitIndex) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) \
        Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad) ⊆
      Set.range (halfArc P)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set O := T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V
    with hO
  set A := T.saddleNegativeBranchCyclicMarking hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V
    with hA
  
  have horbitEq : (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      V.orbit P.p := by
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O, V.orbit_eq_of_mem hP]
  have hbase : (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hreg V).p = V.orbitPoint O := rfl
  have horbitBase : V.orbit
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V).p =
      V.orbit P.p := by
    rw [hbase, ← V.orbitPoint_orbit O, horbitEq]
  have hgamma : ∀ u : I, halfArc P u ∈ V.orbit
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V).p := by
    intro u
    rw [horbitBase]
    exact P.curve_mem_orbit _
  have hinj : Function.Injective (halfArc P) := injective_halfArc P
  have hpoint : ∀ i : Fin 2, A.point i =
      spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b (saddleBranchOfFinTwo i) ρ s) :=
    fun _ => rfl
  have h0 : A.point 0 ∈ Set.range (halfArc P) := by
    rw [hpoint 0, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_zero]
    exact hmark .negative
  have h1 : A.point 1 ∈ Set.range (halfArc P) := by
    rw [hpoint 1, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_one]
    exact hmark .positive
  have hs0 : halfArc P 0 ≠ A.point 0 := by
    rw [halfArc_zero, hpoint 0, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_zero]
    exact hstartne .negative
  have hs1 : halfArc P 0 ≠ A.point 1 := by
    rw [halfArc_zero, hpoint 1, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_one]
    exact hstartne .positive
  have hcut := T.saddleNegativeBranch_localSegment_range_eq_cut hindex b ρ s
    hρ hs hρrad hreg V
  have hstart' : halfArc P 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    rw [halfArc_zero]; exact hstart
  refine A.orbit_diff_subset_range_of_marks_mem (halfArc P) hgamma hinj h0 h1
    hs0 hs1 hcut hstart' ?_
  intro x hx
  rw [horbitEq] at hx
  rwa [horbitBase]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchOrbit_diff_segment_subset_halfArc
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveBranchOrbit_diff_segment_subset_halfArc
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (b : SaddleBranch)
    {ρ s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hreg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hreg))
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hreg) V)
    (hP : V.orbitPoint (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hreg V) ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (hstart : P.curve 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (hstartne : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      P.curve 0 ≠ spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b e ρ s))
    (hmark : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b e ρ s) ∈

    ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V :
        V.OrbitIndex) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) \
        Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad) ⊆
      Set.range (halfArc P)

  have hgamma : ∀ u : I, halfArc P u ∈ V.orbit
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad hreg V).p := by
    intro u
    rw [horbitBase]
    exact P.curve_mem_orbit _
  have hinj : Function.Injective (halfArc P) := injective_halfArc P
  have hpoint : ∀ i : Fin 2, A.point i =
      spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b (saddleBranchOfFinTwo i) ρ s) :=
    fun _ => rfl
  have h0 : A.point 0 ∈ Set.range (halfArc P) := by
    rw [hpoint 0, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_zero]
    exact hmark .negative
  have h1 : A.point 1 ∈ Set.range (halfArc P) := by
    rw [hpoint 1, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_one]
    exact hmark .positive
  have hs0 : halfArc P 0 ≠ A.point 0 := by
    rw [halfArc_zero, hpoint 0, saddleBranchOfFinTwo_zero]

  have hs1 : halfArc P 0 ≠ A.point 1 := by

  have hcut := T.saddlePositiveBranch_localSegment_range_eq_cut hindex b ρ s
    hρ hs hρrad hreg V
  have hstart' : halfArc P 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad) := by
    rw [halfArc_zero]; exact hstart
  refine A.orbit_diff_subset_range_of_marks_mem (halfArc P) hgamma hinj h0 h1

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleBandBeforeArcsCovering_of_endpoints_merge
statement:
theorem saddleBandBeforeArcsCovering_of_endpoints_merge
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ ρ' s : ℝ} (hs0 : s ≠ 0)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hρ' : 0 < ρ') (hs' : s ^ 2 < ρ' ^ 2) (hρ'rad : ρ' < T.radius)
    (hle : ρ ≤ ρ')
    {hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2)}
    {hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2)}
    {Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg)}
    {Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos)}
    {e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch} {Ohat : Vpos.OrbitIndex}
    {R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData K}
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg)
      Ohat)
    (hpin : SaddleBandBeforeCutsPinned F)
    (hstart₁ : F.before₁Param.curve 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment e₁ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad))
    (hstartne₁ : ∀ e : SaddleBranch, F.before₁Param.curve 0 ≠
      spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd e₁ e ρ' s))
    (hmark₁ : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd e₁ e ρ' s) ∈
        Set.range (halfArc F.before₁Param))
    (hstart₂ : F.before₂Param.curve 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment e₂ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad))
    (hstartne₂ : ∀ e : SaddleBranch, F.before₂Param.curve 0 ≠
      spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd e₂ e ρ' s))
    (hmark₂ : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd e₂ e ρ' s) ∈
        Set.range (halfArc F.before₂Param)) :
    SaddleBandBeforeArcsCovering F
      (Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment e₁ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad))
      (Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment e₂ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hcut₁, -, hcut₂⟩ := hpin
  have hidx₁ := T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le hindex e₁ hs0
    hρ hs hρrad hρ' hs' hρ'rad hle hregneg Vneg
  have hidx₂ := T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le hindex e₂ hs0
    hρ hs hρrad hρ' hs' hρ'rad hle hregneg Vneg
  have hset₁ : ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad
        hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := congrArg Subtype.val hidx₁
  have hset₂ : ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad
        hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := congrArg Subtype.val hidx₂
  have hpt₁ : Vneg.orbitPoint (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ' s
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregneg Vneg) =
      Vneg.orbitPoint (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s
      hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg) := congrArg Vneg.orbitPoint hidx₁.symm
  have horb₁ : Vneg.orbitPoint (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ' s
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregneg Vneg) ∈ Vneg.orbit F.before₁Param.p := by
    rw [hpt₁]
    exact F.before₁Param_orbit
  have hpt₂ : Vneg.orbitPoint (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ' s
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregneg Vneg) =
      Vneg.orbitPoint (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s
      hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg) := congrArg Vneg.orbitPoint hidx₂.symm
  have horb₂ : Vneg.orbitPoint (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ' s
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregneg Vneg) ∈ Vneg.orbit F.before₂Param.p := by
    rw [hpt₂]
    exact F.before₂Param_orbit
  constructor
  · rw [hcut₁, hset₁]
    exact T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbit_diff_segment_subset_halfArc hindex e₁
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregneg Vneg F.before₁Param horb₁ hstart₁ hstartne₁ hmark₁
  · rw [hcut₂, hset₂]
    exact T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbit_diff_segment_subset_halfArc hindex e₂
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregneg Vneg F.before₂Param horb₂ hstart₂ hstartne₂ hmark₂

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleBandBeforeArcsCovering_of_endpoints_split
statement:
theorem saddleBandBeforeArcsCovering_of_endpoints_split
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ ρ' s : ℝ} (hs0 : s ≠ 0)
    (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hρ' : 0 < ρ') (hs' : s ^ 2 < ρ' ^ 2) (hρ'rad : ρ' < T.radius)
    (hle : ρ ≤ ρ')
    {hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2)}
    {hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2)}
    {Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg)}
    {Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos)}
    {e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch} {Ohat : Vneg.OrbitIndex}
    {R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData K}
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregpos hregneg Vpos Vneg
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos)
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos)
      Ohat)
    (hpin : SaddleBandBeforeCutsPinned F)
    (hstart₁ : F.before₁Param.curve 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment e₁ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad))
    (hstartne₁ : ∀ e : SaddleBranch, F.before₁Param.curve 0 ≠
      spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd e₁ e ρ' s))
    (hmark₁ : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd e₁ e ρ' s) ∈
        Set.range (halfArc F.before₁Param))
    (hstart₂ : F.before₂Param.curve 0 ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment e₂ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad))
    (hstartne₂ : ∀ e : SaddleBranch, F.before₂Param.curve 0 ≠
      spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd e₂ e ρ' s))
    (hmark₂ : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd e₂ e ρ' s) ∈
        Set.range (halfArc F.before₂Param)) :
    SaddleBandBeforeArcsCovering F
      (Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment e₁ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad))
      (Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment e₂ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨-, hcut₁, -, hcut₂⟩ := hpin
  have hidx₁ := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le hindex e₁ hs0
    hρ hs hρrad hρ' hs' hρ'rad hle hregpos Vpos
  have hidx₂ := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le hindex e₂ hs0
    hρ hs hρrad hρ' hs' hρ'rad hle hregpos Vpos
  have hset₁ : ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad
        hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := congrArg Subtype.val hidx₁
  have hset₂ : ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ' s hρ' hs' hρ'rad
        hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := congrArg Subtype.val hidx₂
  have hpt₁ : Vpos.orbitPoint (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ' s
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregpos Vpos) =
      Vpos.orbitPoint (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s
      hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos) := congrArg Vpos.orbitPoint hidx₁.symm
  have horb₁ : Vpos.orbitPoint (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ' s
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregpos Vpos) ∈ Vpos.orbit F.before₁Param.p := by
    rw [hpt₁]
    exact F.before₁Param_orbit
  have hpt₂ : Vpos.orbitPoint (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ' s
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregpos Vpos) =
      Vpos.orbitPoint (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s
      hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos) := congrArg Vpos.orbitPoint hidx₂.symm
  have horb₂ : Vpos.orbitPoint (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ' s
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregpos Vpos) ∈ Vpos.orbit F.before₂Param.p := by
    rw [hpt₂]
    exact F.before₂Param_orbit
  constructor
  · rw [hcut₁, hset₁]
    exact T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbit_diff_segment_subset_halfArc hindex e₁
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregpos Vpos F.before₁Param horb₁ hstart₁ hstartne₁ hmark₁
  · rw [hcut₂, hset₂]
    exact T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbit_diff_segment_subset_halfArc hindex e₂
      hρ' hs' hρ'rad hregpos Vpos F.before₂Param horb₂ hstart₂ hstartne₂ hmark₂

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.exists_fderiv_bound_on_fiber
statement:
theorem exists_fderiv_bound_on_fiber (X : FramedLevelSet n) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ p ∈ X.fiber, ‖fderiv ℝ X.g p‖ ≤ C
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := X.isCompact_fiber.exists_bound_of_continuousOn
    (X.smooth.continuous_fderiv infty_ne_zero).continuousOn
  refine ⟨1 + |C|, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro p hp
  have h1 := hC p hp
  have h2 : C ≤ |C| := le_abs_self C
  linarith

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.fderivBound_pos
statement: theorem fderivBound_pos (X : FramedLevelSet n) : 0 < fderivBound X
proof:
:=
  (exists_fderiv_bound_on_fiber X).choose_spec.1

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.norm_fderiv_le_fderivBound
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_le_fderivBound (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ X.g p‖ ≤ fderivBound X
proof:
:=
  (exists_fderiv_bound_on_fiber X).choose_spec.2 p hp

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.jetThreshold_pos
statement: theorem jetThreshold_pos (X : FramedLevelSet n) : 0 < jetThreshold X
proof:
:=
  div_pos (SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.tubeThreshold_pos X)
    (fderivBound_pos X)

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.jetThreshold_mul_fderivBound
statement:
theorem jetThreshold_mul_fderivBound (X : FramedLevelSet n) :
    jetThreshold X * fderivBound X =
      SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.tubeThreshold X
proof:
:= by
  have h : fderivBound X ≠ 0 := (fderivBound_pos X).ne'
  rw [jetThreshold, div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_assoc, div_self h, mul_one]

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.norm_fderiv_sub_le_of_transition
statement:
theorem norm_fderiv_sub_le_of_transition (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    (Phi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (heq : fderiv ℝ Y.g p = (Phi p).comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p)) :
    ‖fderiv ℝ Y.g p - fderiv ℝ X.g p‖ ≤ ‖Phi p - 1‖ * ‖fderiv ℝ X.g p‖
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : fderiv ℝ Y.g p - fderiv ℝ X.g p =
      (Phi p - 1).comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p) := by
    rw [heq]
    ext v
    simp
  rw [hsplit]
  exact ContinuousLinearMap.opNorm_comp_le _ _

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.fderiv_close_of_transition
statement:
theorem fderiv_close_of_transition (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    (Phi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (heq : ∀ p ∈ X.fiber,
      fderiv ℝ Y.g p = (Phi p).comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p))
    (hsmall : ∀ p ∈ X.fiber, ‖Phi p - 1‖ < jetThreshold X) :
    ∀ p ∈ X.fiber, ‖fderiv ℝ Y.g p - fderiv ℝ X.g p‖ <
      SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.tubeThreshold X
proof:
:= by
  intro p hp
  have h1 := norm_fderiv_sub_le_of_transition X Y Phi (heq p hp)
  have h2 : ‖Phi p - 1‖ * ‖fderiv ℝ X.g p‖ ≤ ‖Phi p - 1‖ * fderivBound X :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_fderiv_le_fderivBound X hp) (norm_nonneg _)
  have h3 : ‖Phi p - 1‖ * fderivBound X < jetThreshold X * fderivBound X :=
    mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right (hsmall p hp) (fderivBound_pos X)
  have h4 := jetThreshold_mul_fderivBound X
  linarith

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.transition_unique
statement:
theorem transition_unique (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber)
    (Phi Psi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (h₁ : fderiv ℝ Y.g p = Phi.comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p))
    (h₂ : fderiv ℝ Y.g p = Psi.comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p)) :
    Phi = Psi
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : X.g p = 0 := hp
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ X.g p) := X.regular p hp0
  ext v
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsurj v
  have e₁ : Phi (fderiv ℝ X.g p u) = fderiv ℝ Y.g p u := by
    rw [h₁]; rfl
  have e₂ : Psi (fderiv ℝ X.g p u) = fderiv ℝ Y.g p u := by
    rw [h₂]; rfl
  rw [← hu, e₁, e₂]

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.transition_surjective
statement:
theorem transition_surjective (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber)
    (hpY : p ∈ Y.fiber)
    (Phi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (h : fderiv ℝ Y.g p = Phi.comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p)) :
    Function.Surjective Phi
proof:
:= by
  have hpY0 : Y.g p = 0 := hpY
  have hsurjY : Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ Y.g p) := Y.regular p hpY0
  intro v
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := hsurjY v
  exact ⟨fderiv ℝ X.g p u, by rw [← hu, h]; rfl⟩

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.transition_bijective
statement:
theorem transition_bijective (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber)
    (hpY : p ∈ Y.fiber)
    (Phi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (h : fderiv ℝ Y.g p = Phi.comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p)) :
    Function.Bijective Phi
proof:
:= by
  have hsurj : Function.Surjective Phi := transition_surjective X Y hp hpY Phi h
  have hsurj' : Function.Surjective (Phi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →ₗ[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := hsurj
  exact ⟨LinearMap.injective_iff_surjective.mpr hsurj', hsurj⟩

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.contDiff_dampedGauge
proof:
:=
  contDiff_const.sub (hchi.smul (contDiff_const.sub hPhi))

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.norm_one_sub_dampedGauge
statement:
theorem norm_one_sub_dampedGauge
    (Phi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (chi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ‖(1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) -
        dampedGauge Phi chi x‖ =
      |chi x| * ‖(1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ]
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) - Phi x‖
proof:
:= by
  rw [dampedGauge, sub_sub_cancel, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs]

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.dampedGauge_of_chi_eq_one
statement:
theorem dampedGauge_of_chi_eq_one
    (Phi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (chi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : chi x = 1) :
    dampedGauge Phi chi x = Phi x
proof:
:= by
  rw [dampedGauge, hx, one_smul, sub_sub_cancel]

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.dampedGauge_of_chi_eq_zero
statement:
theorem dampedGauge_of_chi_eq_zero
    (Phi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (chi : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) → ℝ)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : chi x = 0) :
    dampedGauge Phi chi x =
      (1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
proof:
:= by
  ext u
  simp [dampedGauge, hx]

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.fderiv_gaugeTransform_eq
statement:
theorem fderiv_gaugeTransform_eq (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (hQbij : ∀ x, Function.Bijective (Q x))
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    fderiv ℝ (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij).g p =
      (Q p).comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p)
proof:
:= by
  have hp0 : X.g p = 0 := hp
  have hg : (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij).g = fun y => Q y (X.g y) := rfl
  rw [hg]
  exact fderiv_gauge_apply_of_eq_zero hQ X.smooth hp0

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.nonempty_signedCobordism_of_gaugePathJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_signedCobordism_of_gaugePathJet
    (X Y : FramedLevelSet n) (S : FiberSign X) (T : FiberSign Y)
    (Q : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) => Q p.1 p.2))
    (hQzero : ∀ x, Q 0 x =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
    (hQbij : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x, Function.Bijective (Q s x))
    (fiber_eq : Y.fiber = X.fiber)
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • Q 1 x (X.g x) + r • Y.g x‖)
    (hagree : ∀ x ∈ X.fiber, 0 < S x * T x)
    (hjet : ∀ p ∈ X.fiber,
      fderiv ℝ Y.g p = (Q 1 p).comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p)) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
proof:
:= by
  have hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Q 1) := contDiff_gauge_slice hQ 1
  have hAbij : ∀ x, Function.Bijective (Q 1 x) := fun x =>
    hQbij 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩ x
  have hfib : (X.gaugeTransform (Q 1) hA hAbij).fiber = X.fiber :=
    FramedLevelSet.gaugeTransform_fiber X (Q 1) hA hAbij
  have hP : SameFiberGaugeAlignment.Path X (X.gaugeTransform (Q 1) hA hAbij) :=
    { Q := Q
      smooth := hQ
      zero := hQzero
      bijective := hQbij
      endpoint := fun _ => rfl }
  have h₂ : DefiningMapHomotopy X (X.gaugeTransform (Q 1) hA hAbij) :=
    hP.homotopy
  have hdata :=
    SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.dataOfFirstJet
      (X.gaugeTransform (Q 1) hA hAbij) Y
      (S.restrict h₂.fiber_subset) T
      (by rw [hfib]; exact fiber_eq)
      R eps eps_pos
      (fun x hx r hr0 hr1 => outer x hx r hr0 hr1)
      (by
        intro x hx
        rw [hfib] at hx
        simpa using hagree x hx)
      (by
        intro x hx
        rw [hfib] at hx
        rw [fderiv_gaugeTransform_eq X (Q 1) hA hAbij hx]
        exact hjet x hx)
  exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
    ⟨h₂.signedCobordism S⟩ hdata.nonempty_signedCobordism

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.nonempty_signedCobordism_of_rotationJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_signedCobordism_of_rotationJet
    (X Y : FramedLevelSet n) (S : FiberSign X) (T : FiberSign Y)
    (Rot : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) → SOGroup n)
    (hRot : ∀ i j, ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) =>
        ((Rot p.1 p.2 : SOGroup n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i j))
    (hRotZero : ∀ x, Rot 0 x = 1)
    (fiber_eq : Y.fiber = X.fiber)
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • SOFrameGauge.toCLM (Rot 1 x) (X.g x) + r • Y.g x‖)
    (hagree : ∀ x ∈ X.fiber, 0 < S x * T x)
    (hjet : ∀ p ∈ X.fiber, fderiv ℝ Y.g p =
      (SOFrameGauge.toCLM (Rot 1 p)).comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p)) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
proof:
:=
  nonempty_signedCobordism_of_gaugePathJet X Y S T
    (fun s x => SOFrameGauge.toCLM (Rot s x))
    (SOFrameGauge.contDiff_toCLM hRot)
    (fun x => by rw [hRotZero x, SOFrameGauge.toCLM_one])
    (fun s _ x => SOFrameGauge.toCLM_bijective (Rot s x))
    fiber_eq R eps eps_pos outer hagree hjet

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.nonempty_signedCobordism_of_nearIdentityGaugeJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_signedCobordism_of_nearIdentityGaugeJet
    (X Y : FramedLevelSet n) (S : FiberSign X) (T : FiberSign Y)
    (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A)
    (hnorm : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)),
      ‖(1 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        - A x‖ < 1)
    (fiber_eq : Y.fiber = X.fiber)
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • A x (X.g x) + r • Y.g x‖)
    (hagree : ∀ x ∈ X.fiber, 0 < S x * T x)
    (hjet : ∀ p ∈ X.fiber,
      fderiv ℝ Y.g p = (A p).comp (fderiv ℝ X.g p)) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism S T)
proof:
:= by
  have hAbij : ∀ x, Function.Bijective (A x) := fun x =>
    SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.bijective_of_one_sub_norm_lt (A x) (hnorm x)
  have hfib : (X.gaugeTransform A hA hAbij).fiber = X.fiber :=
    FramedLevelSet.gaugeTransform_fiber X A hA hAbij
  have hP : SameFiberGaugeAlignment.Path X (X.gaugeTransform A hA hAbij) :=
    SameFiberGaugeAlignment.Path.ofNearIdentity A hA hnorm (fun _ => rfl)
  have h₂ : DefiningMapHomotopy X (X.gaugeTransform A hA hAbij) := hP.homotopy
  have hdata :=
    SameFiberFirstJetNormalization.dataOfFirstJet
      (X.gaugeTransform A hA hAbij) Y
      (S.restrict h₂.fiber_subset) T
      (by rw [hfib]; exact fiber_eq)
      R eps eps_pos
      (fun x hx r hr0 hr1 => outer x hx r hr0 hr1)
      (by
        intro x hx
        rw [hfib] at hx
        simpa using hagree x hx)
      (by
        intro x hx
        rw [hfib] at hx
        rw [fderiv_gaugeTransform_eq X A hA hAbij hx]
        exact hjet x hx)
  exact SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
    ⟨h₂.signedCobordism S⟩ hdata.nonempty_signedCobordism

name: Submission.SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.outer_of_gauge_eq_id_outside
statement:
theorem outer_of_gauge_eq_id_outside
    (X Y : FramedLevelSet n)
    (A : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (R R₀ eps : ℝ)
    (hA : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), R₀ ≤ ‖x‖ →
      A x = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)))
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 → eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • X.g x + r • Y.g x‖) :
    ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)), max R R₀ ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • A x (X.g x) + r • Y.g x‖
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx r hr0 hr1
  rw [hA x (le_trans (le_max_right R R₀) hx)]
  simpa using outer x (le_trans (le_max_left R R₀) hx) r hr0 hr1

name: Submission.ConcreteConfigurationEntryFrameJet.nonempty_toFirstSource_of_gaugePathJet
statement:
theorem nonempty_toFirstSource_of_gaugePathJet
    (hm : 0 < m)
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (firstSourceField Z kind tail)
      B.fiberSign (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (Q : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) => Q p.1 p.2))
    (hQzero : ∀ x, Q 0 x =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))))
    (hQbij : ∀ s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x, Function.Bijective (Q s x))
    (R eps : ℝ) (eps_pos : 0 < eps)
    (outer : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)), R ≤ ‖x‖ →
      ∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ r → r ≤ 1 →
        eps ≤ ‖(1 - r) • Q 1 x ((harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g x) +
          r • (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g x‖)
    (hjet : ∀ p ∈ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).fiber,
      fderiv ℝ (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX.g p =
        (Q 1 p).comp (fderiv ℝ (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G).g p)) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
      (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)
      (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign)
proof:
:= by
  refine SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
    ⟨(legOne hm M F G).signedCobordism (gaugeEndpointSign hm M F)⟩
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_trans
      (SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.nonempty_signedCobordism_of_gaugePathJet
        (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G)
        (firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).endpointX
        (harmonizedSign hm M F G)
        (placedSign hm Z kind tail)
        Q hQ hQzero hQbij
        (placed_fiber_eq_harmonized_fiber hm M F G)
        R eps eps_pos outer
        (harmonized_mul_pos_on_fiber hm M F G)
        hjet)
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.nonempty_symm
        ⟨(firstSourcePlacement hm Z kind tail).signedCobordism
          (firstSourceFlat Z kind tail).sign⟩))

name: Submission.tauField_inner_gradVec
statement:
lemma tauField_inner_gradVec (g : E → F) (x : E) (i : Fin n) :
    ⟪tauField g x, gradVec g i x⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [tauField, real_inner_smul_left]
  have h : ⟪kerCross g x, gradVec g i x⟫ = 0 :=
    inner_crossVec_self (fun j => gradVec g j x) i

name: Submission.linearIndependent_frameAt
proof:
:= by
  rw [frameAt]
  apply linearIndependent_finCons.mpr
  refine ⟨(surjective_fderiv_iff_linearIndependent X.g x).mp hx, ?_⟩
  intro hmem
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := (mem_span_range_iff_exists_fun _).mp hmem

    intro i _

name: Submission.det_updateRow_add_of_mem_span
statement:
lemma det_updateRow_add_of_mem_span (A : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (j : Fin m)
    {w : Fin m → ℝ} (hw : w ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (A '' {i | i ≠ j})) :
    (A.updateRow j (A j + w)).det = A.det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set L : (Fin m → ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] ℝ :=
    { toFun := fun x => (A.updateRow j x).det
      map_add' := fun x y => Matrix.det_updateRow_add A j x y
      map_smul' := fun c x => Matrix.det_updateRow_smul A j c x } with hL
  have hL0 : ∀ u ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (A '' {i | i ≠ j}), L u = 0 := by
    intro u hu
    induction hu using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem x hx =>
      obtain ⟨i, hij, rfl⟩ := hx
      show (A.updateRow j (A i)).det = 0
      apply Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq (i := i) (j := j) hij
      rw [Matrix.updateRow_ne hij, Matrix.updateRow_self]
    | zero => exact map_zero L
    | add x y hx hy ihx ihy => rw [map_add, ihx, ihy, add_zero]
    | smul c x hx ih => rw [map_smul, ih, smul_zero]
  have hadd : L (A j + w) = L (A j) + L w := map_add L _ _
  have hself : L (A j) = A.det := by
    show (A.updateRow j (A j)).det = A.det
    rw [Matrix.updateRow_eq_self]
  calc (A.updateRow j (A j + w)).det = L (A j + w) := rfl
    _ = L (A j) + L w := hadd
    _ = A.det + 0 := by rw [hself, hL0 w hw]
    _ = A.det := add_zero _

name: Submission.gramSchmidt_sub_mem_span
statement:
lemma gramSchmidt_sub_mem_span (v : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) (i : Fin m) :
    gramSchmidt ℝ v i - v i ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ v '' Set.Iio i)
proof:
:= by
  have h := gramSchmidt_def ℝ v i
  have : gramSchmidt ℝ v i - v i
      = -∑ j ∈ Finset.Iio i, (ℝ ∙ gramSchmidt ℝ v j).starProjection (v i) := by
    rw [h]
    abel
  rw [this]
  apply Submodule.neg_mem
  apply Submodule.sum_mem
  intro j hj
  have hjlt : j < i := Finset.mem_Iio.mp hj
  have hmem : (ℝ ∙ gramSchmidt ℝ v j).starProjection (v i) ∈ ℝ ∙ gramSchmidt ℝ v j :=
    (ℝ ∙ gramSchmidt ℝ v j).starProjection_apply_mem (v i)
  have himg : gramSchmidt ℝ v j ∈ gramSchmidt ℝ v '' Set.Iio i := ⟨j, hjlt, rfl⟩
  exact Submodule.span_mono (Set.singleton_subset_iff.mpr himg) hmem

name: Submission.det_rowsMatrix_gramSchmidt
statement:
lemma det_rowsMatrix_gramSchmidt (v : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    (rowsMatrix (gramSchmidt ℝ v)).det = (rowsMatrix v).det
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  set Mix : ℕ → Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ := fun k =>
    Matrix.of fun i => if (i : ℕ) < k then WithLp.ofLp (v i)
      else WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidt ℝ v i) with hMix
  have hstep : ∀ k, (Mix (k + 1)).det = (Mix k).det := by
    intro k
    by_cases hk : k < m
    · set i₀ : Fin m := ⟨k, hk⟩ with hi₀
      
      have hupdate : Mix k = (Mix (k + 1)).updateRow i₀
          (WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidt ℝ v i₀)) := by
        ext i j
        by_cases hii : i = i₀
        · subst hii
          rw [Matrix.updateRow_self]
          simp [hMix, hi₀]
        · rw [Matrix.updateRow_ne hii]
          have hiff : (i : ℕ) < k ↔ (i : ℕ) < k + 1 := by
            constructor
            · omega
            · intro h
              rcases Nat.lt_succ_iff_lt_or_eq.mp h with h' | h'
              · exact h'
              · exact absurd (Fin.ext h' : i = i₀) hii
          simp only [hMix, Matrix.of_apply]
          by_cases hlt : (i : ℕ) < k
          · rw [if_pos hlt, if_pos (hiff.mp hlt)]
          · rw [if_neg hlt, if_neg (fun h => hlt (hiff.mpr h))]
      have hrow : (Mix (k + 1)) i₀ = WithLp.ofLp (v i₀) := by
        have hlt : (i₀ : ℕ) < k + 1 := by rw [hi₀]; exact Nat.lt_succ_self k
        show (if (i₀ : ℕ) < k + 1 then WithLp.ofLp (v i₀)
          else WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidt ℝ v i₀)) = WithLp.ofLp (v i₀)
        rw [if_pos hlt]
      
      have hw : WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidt ℝ v i₀) - WithLp.ofLp (v i₀)
          ∈ Submodule.span ℝ ((Mix (k + 1)) '' {i | i ≠ i₀}) := by
        have h1 : gramSchmidt ℝ v i₀ - v i₀
            ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (v '' Set.Iio i₀) := by
          rw [← span_gramSchmidt_Iio ℝ v i₀]
          exact gramSchmidt_sub_mem_span v i₀
        have h2 : (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ (Fin m → ℝ)).toLinearMap
              (gramSchmidt ℝ v i₀ - v i₀)
            ∈ Submodule.map (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ (Fin m → ℝ)).toLinearMap
              (Submodule.span ℝ (v '' Set.Iio i₀)) :=
          Submodule.mem_map_of_mem h1
        rw [Submodule.map_span] at h2
        have h3 : (WithLp.linearEquiv 2 ℝ (Fin m → ℝ)).toLinearMap '' (v '' Set.Iio i₀)
            ⊆ (Mix (k + 1)) '' {i | i ≠ i₀} := by
          rintro _ ⟨_, ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
          have hjlt : j < i₀ := hj
          have hjk : (j : ℕ) < k := hjlt
          refine ⟨j, fun h => absurd (h ▸ hjlt) (lt_irrefl i₀), ?_⟩
          have hlt : (j : ℕ) < k + 1 := by omega
          show (if (j : ℕ) < k + 1 then WithLp.ofLp (v j)
            else WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidt ℝ v j)) = _
          rw [if_pos hlt]
          rfl
        exact Submodule.span_mono h3 h2
      have hw' : WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidt ℝ v i₀)
          = (Mix (k + 1)) i₀
            + (WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidt ℝ v i₀) - WithLp.ofLp (v i₀)) := by
        rw [hrow]
        abel
      rw [hupdate, hw']
      exact (det_updateRow_add_of_mem_span (Mix (k + 1)) i₀ hw).symm
    · 
      have : Mix (k + 1) = Mix k := by
        ext i j
        have h1 : (i : ℕ) < k + 1 := by omega
        have h2 : (i : ℕ) < k := by omega
        simp [hMix, h1, h2]
      rw [this]
  have hall : ∀ k, (Mix k).det = (Mix 0).det := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ k ih => rw [hstep k, ih]
  have hm : Mix m = rowsMatrix v := by
    ext i j
    simp [hMix, rowsMatrix, i.isLt]
  have h0 : Mix 0 = rowsMatrix (gramSchmidt ℝ v) := by
    ext i j
    simp [hMix, rowsMatrix]
  rw [← hm, hall m, h0]

name: Submission.det_rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed
statement:
lemma det_rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed (v : Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    (rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v)).det
      = (∏ i, ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖⁻¹) * (rowsMatrix v).det
proof:
:= by
  have h : rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v)
      = Matrix.of fun i j => ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖⁻¹ * rowsMatrix (gramSchmidt ℝ v) i j := by
    ext i j
    show WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v i) j
      = ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖⁻¹ * WithLp.ofLp (gramSchmidt ℝ v i) j
    rw [gramSchmidtNormed]
    rfl
  calc (rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v)).det
      = (Matrix.of fun i j =>
          ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖⁻¹ * rowsMatrix (gramSchmidt ℝ v) i j).det := by rw [h]
    _ = (∏ i, ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖⁻¹) * (rowsMatrix (gramSchmidt ℝ v)).det :=
        Matrix.det_mul_column _ _
    _ = (∏ i, ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖⁻¹) * (rowsMatrix v).det := by
        rw [det_rowsMatrix_gramSchmidt]

name: Submission.continuous_gramSchmidt_family
statement:
lemma continuous_gramSchmidt_family {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T]
    {A : T → Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)}
    (hA : ∀ i, Continuous fun t => A t i)
    (hInd : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (A t)) (i : Fin m) :
    Continuous fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ N : ℕ, ∀ i : Fin m, (i : ℕ) = N →
      Continuous fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i := by
    intro N
    induction N using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ N IH =>
      intro i hi
      have hrw : (fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i) = fun t => A t i -
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.Iio i,
            (⟪gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j, A t i⟫ / ((‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j‖ : ℝ) ^ 2)) •
              gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j := by
        funext t
        rw [gramSchmidt_def]
        congr 1
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j hj => ?_
        rw [starProjection_singleton]
        norm_num
      rw [hrw]
      apply (hA i).sub
      apply continuous_finsetSum
      intro j hj
      have hjN : (j : ℕ) < N := by
        have h1 : j < i := Finset.mem_Iio.mp hj
        have h2 : (j : ℕ) < (i : ℕ) := h1
        omega
      have hcj : Continuous fun t => gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j := IH (j : ℕ) hjN j rfl
      have hdiv : Continuous fun t =>
          ⟪gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j, A t i⟫ / ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) j‖ ^ 2 := by
        apply Continuous.div
        · exact hcj.inner (hA i)
        · exact (hcj.norm).pow 2
        · intro t
          exact pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (gramSchmidt_ne_zero j (hInd t)))
      exact hdiv.smul hcj
  exact key (i : ℕ) i rfl

name: Submission.continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_family
statement:
lemma continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_family {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T]
    {A : T → Fin m → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)}
    (hA : ∀ i, Continuous fun t => A t i)
    (hInd : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (A t)) (i : Fin m) :
    Continuous fun t => gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (A t) i
proof:
:= by
  have hgs := continuous_gramSchmidt_family hA hInd i
  have hnorm : Continuous fun t => ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i‖⁻¹ :=
    (hgs.norm).inv₀ fun t =>
      norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (gramSchmidt_ne_zero i (hInd t))
  have heq : (fun t => gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (A t) i)
      = fun t => ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i‖⁻¹ • gramSchmidt ℝ (A t) i := by
    funext t
    rw [gramSchmidtNormed]
    norm_num
  rw [heq]
  exact hnorm.smul hgs

name: Submission.continuous_frameAt_comp
statement:
lemma continuous_frameAt_comp (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T]
    {γ : T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hγc : Continuous γ)
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet X.g) (i : Fin (n + 1)) :
    Continuous fun t => frameAt X (γ t) i
proof:
:= by
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨k, rfl⟩
  · have heq : (fun t => frameAt X (γ t) 0) = fun t => tauField X.g (γ t) := by
      funext t; simp [frameAt]
    rw [heq]
    exact (contDiffOn_tauField X.smooth).continuousOn.comp_continuous hγc hγ
  · have heq : (fun t => frameAt X (γ t) k.succ) = fun t => gradVec X.g k (γ t) := by
      funext t; simp [frameAt]
    rw [heq]
    exact (contDiff_gradVec X.g X.smooth k).continuous.comp hγc

name: Submission.continuous_frameLoop
statement:
theorem continuous_frameLoop (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {γ : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hγc : Continuous γ)
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ X.fiber) :
    Continuous (frameLoop X γ)
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet X.g := fun t => X.fiber_subset_regularSet (hγ t)
  have hInd : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (frameAt X (γ t)) := fun t =>
    linearIndependent_frameAt X (hreg t)
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  have h := continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_family
    (A := fun t => frameAt X (γ t)) (continuous_frameAt_comp X hγc hreg) hInd i
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp h

name: Submission.continuous_frameMatrix_comp
statement:
theorem continuous_frameMatrix_comp (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T]
    {γ : T → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hγc : Continuous γ)
    (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ regularSet X.g) :
    Continuous fun t =>
      rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X (γ t)))
proof:
:= by
  have hInd : ∀ t, LinearIndependent ℝ (frameAt X (γ t)) := fun t =>
    linearIndependent_frameAt X (hγ t)
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  have h := continuous_gramSchmidtNormed_family
    (A := fun t => frameAt X (γ t)) (continuous_frameAt_comp X hγc hγ) hInd i
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp h

name: Submission.frameLoop_periodic
statement:
theorem frameLoop_periodic (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {γ : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} {T : ℝ}
    (h : Function.Periodic γ T) :
    Function.Periodic (frameLoop X γ) T
proof:
:= by
  intro t
  unfold frameLoop
  rw [h t]

name: Submission.frameLoop_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
statement:
theorem frameLoop_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {γ : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hγ : ∀ t, γ t ∈ X.fiber) (t : ℝ) :
    frameLoop X γ t ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  have hreg : γ t ∈ regularSet X.g := X.fiber_subset_regularSet (hγ t)
  have hInd : LinearIndependent ℝ (frameAt X (γ t)) :=
    linearIndependent_frameAt X hreg
  have horthonormal : Orthonormal ℝ (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X (γ t))) :=
    gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hInd
  set A := frameLoop X γ t with hA
  
  have hmul : A * Aᵀ = 1 := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    have hentries : ∀ k, A i k * Aᵀ k j
        = (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X (γ t)) i) k
          * (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X (γ t)) j) k := by
      intro k
      rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]
      rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => hentries k]
    have hinner := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp horthonormal i j
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply] at hinner
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial] at hinner
    rw [← hinner]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => mul_comm _ _
  have horth : A ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).mpr hmul
  
  have hdetpos : 0 < A.det := by
    rw [hA, frameLoop, det_rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed]
    apply mul_pos
    · apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro i _
      have hne : gramSchmidt ℝ (frameAt X (γ t)) i ≠ 0 := gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hInd
      have : 0 < ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (frameAt X (γ t)) i‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
      positivity
    · exact det_rowsMatrix_frameAt_pos X hreg
  have hdetsq : A.det * A.det = 1 := by
    have h1 := congrArg Matrix.det hmul
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at h1
    exact h1
  have hdet1 : A.det = 1 := by
    rcases mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp hdetsq with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [h] at hdetpos; linarith
  exact Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mpr ⟨horth, hdet1⟩

name: Submission.frameMatrix_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_of_regular
statement:
theorem frameMatrix_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_of_regular (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hreg : x ∈ regularSet X.g) :
    rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X x)) ∈
      Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  have hInd : LinearIndependent ℝ (frameAt X x) :=
    linearIndependent_frameAt X hreg
  have horthonormal : Orthonormal ℝ (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X x)) :=
    gramSchmidtNormed_orthonormal hInd
  set A := rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X x)) with hA
  have hmul : A * Aᵀ = 1 := by
    ext i j
    rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
    have hentries : ∀ k, A i k * Aᵀ k j
        = (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X x) i) k
          * (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X x) j) k := by
      intro k
      rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]
      rfl
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => hentries k]
    have hinner := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp horthonormal i j
    rw [PiLp.inner_apply] at hinner
    simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial] at hinner
    rw [← hinner]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => mul_comm _ _
  have horth : A ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).mpr hmul
  have hdetpos : 0 < A.det := by
    rw [hA, det_rowsMatrix_gramSchmidtNormed]
    apply mul_pos
    · apply Finset.prod_pos
      intro i _
      have hne : gramSchmidt ℝ (frameAt X x) i ≠ 0 := gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hInd
      have : 0 < ‖gramSchmidt ℝ (frameAt X x) i‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
      positivity
    · exact det_rowsMatrix_frameAt_pos X hreg
  have hdetsq : A.det * A.det = 1 := by
    have h1 := congrArg Matrix.det hmul
    rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at h1
    exact h1
  have hdet1 : A.det = 1 := by
    rcases mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp hdetsq with h | h
    · exact h
    · rw [h] at hdetpos
      linarith
  exact Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mpr ⟨horth, hdet1⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_frameLoop
statement:
theorem TamedField.exists_frameLoop {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    ∃ T : ℝ, 1 / 2 ≤ T ∧ Function.Periodic (V.flow p) T ∧
      Continuous (frameLoop X (V.flow p)) ∧
      Function.Periodic (frameLoop X (V.flow p)) T ∧
      ∀ t, frameLoop X (V.flow p) t ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hper⟩ := V.exists_period hp
  exact ⟨T, hT, hper,
    continuous_frameLoop X (V.continuous_flow p) (V.flow_mem_fiber hp),
    frameLoop_periodic X hper,
    frameLoop_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup X (V.flow_mem_fiber hp)⟩

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceScale_pos
statement: theorem sourceScale_pos : 0 < sourceScale
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.sqrt_pos.2 (by norm_num)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceScale_sq
statement: theorem sourceScale_sq : sourceScale ^ 2 = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.sq_sqrt (by norm_num)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceScale_lt_one
statement: theorem sourceScale_lt_one : sourceScale < 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs0 := sourceScale_pos
  have hs2 := sourceScale_sq
  nlinarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRadicandFirst_pos
statement:
theorem sourceRadicandFirst_pos (theta : ℝ) :
    0 < sourceRadicandFirst theta
proof:
:= by
  have hc := Real.neg_one_le_cos theta
  have hs0 := sourceScale_pos
  have hs1 := sourceScale_lt_one
  unfold sourceRadicandFirst
  nlinarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRadicandNorm_sq
statement:
theorem sourceRadicandNorm_sq (theta : ℝ) :
    sourceRadicandNorm theta ^ 2 =
      sourceRadicandFirst theta ^ 2 +
        sourceRadicandSecond theta ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRadicandNorm_pos
statement:
theorem sourceRadicandNorm_pos (theta : ℝ) :
    0 < sourceRadicandNorm theta
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
  have hA := sourceRadicandFirst_pos theta
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (sourceRadicandSecond theta)]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRootFirst_pos
statement: theorem sourceRootFirst_pos (theta : ℝ) : 0 < sourceRootFirst theta
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.2
  have hR := sourceRadicandNorm_pos theta
  have hA := sourceRadicandFirst_pos theta
  positivity

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRootFirst_sq
statement:
theorem sourceRootFirst_sq (theta : ℝ) :
    sourceRootFirst theta ^ 2 =
      (sourceRadicandNorm theta + sourceRadicandFirst theta) / 2
proof:
:= by
  apply Real.sq_sqrt
  have hR := sourceRadicandNorm_pos theta
  have hA := sourceRadicandFirst_pos theta
  positivity

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.two_mul_sourceRootFirst_mul_sourceRootSecond
statement:
theorem two_mul_sourceRootFirst_mul_sourceRootSecond (theta : ℝ) :
    2 * sourceRootFirst theta * sourceRootSecond theta =
      sourceRadicandSecond theta
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceRootSecond]
  field_simp [(sourceRootFirst_pos theta).ne']

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRoot_sq_sub_sq
statement:
theorem sourceRoot_sq_sub_sq (theta : ℝ) :
    sourceRootFirst theta ^ 2 - sourceRootSecond theta ^ 2 =
      sourceRadicandFirst theta
proof:
:= by
  let A := sourceRadicandFirst theta
  let B := sourceRadicandSecond theta
  let R := sourceRadicandNorm theta
  let u := sourceRootFirst theta
  let v := sourceRootSecond theta
  have hR : R ^ 2 = A ^ 2 + B ^ 2 := sourceRadicandNorm_sq theta
  have hU : u ^ 2 = (R + A) / 2 := sourceRootFirst_sq theta
  have hu0 : u ≠ 0 := (sourceRootFirst_pos theta).ne'
  have hV : v = B / (2 * u) := rfl
  change u ^ 2 - v ^ 2 = A
  rw [hV]
  field_simp
  have hU2 : 2 * u ^ 2 = R + A := by nlinarith [hU]
  have hUsq := congrArg (fun z : ℝ => z ^ 2) hU2
  have hU2A := congrArg (fun z : ℝ => 2 * A * z) hU2
  nlinarith [hUsq, hU2A]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_sourceRadicandFirst
statement: theorem continuous_sourceRadicandFirst : Continuous sourceRadicandFirst
proof:
:= by
  unfold sourceRadicandFirst sourceScale
  fun_prop

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_sourceRadicandSecond
statement: theorem continuous_sourceRadicandSecond : Continuous sourceRadicandSecond
proof:
:= by
  unfold sourceRadicandSecond sourceScale
  fun_prop

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_sourceRadicandNorm
statement: theorem continuous_sourceRadicandNorm : Continuous sourceRadicandNorm
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp
    ((continuous_sourceRadicandFirst.pow 2).add
      (continuous_sourceRadicandSecond.pow 2))

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_sourceRootFirst
statement: theorem continuous_sourceRootFirst : Continuous sourceRootFirst
proof:
:= by
  exact Real.continuous_sqrt.comp
    ((continuous_sourceRadicandNorm.add
      continuous_sourceRadicandFirst).div_const 2)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_sourceRootSecond
statement: theorem continuous_sourceRootSecond : Continuous sourceRootSecond
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.div continuous_sourceRadicandSecond
    (continuous_const.mul continuous_sourceRootFirst)
  intro theta
  exact mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) (sourceRootFirst_pos theta).ne'

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight_apply_planeFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePointRight_apply_planeFirst (theta : ℝ) :
    sourcePointRight m theta (planeFirst m) = sourceRootFirst theta
proof:
:= by
  have hAB : planeFirst m ≠ planeSecond m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
  simp [sourcePointRight, hAB]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight_apply_planeSecond
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePointRight_apply_planeSecond (theta : ℝ) :
    sourcePointRight m theta (planeSecond m) = sourceRootSecond theta
proof:
:= by
  have hBA : planeSecond m ≠ planeFirst m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [planeFirst, planeSecond] at this
  simp [sourcePointRight, hBA]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft_apply_planeFirst
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePointLeft_apply_planeFirst (theta : ℝ) :
    sourcePointLeft m theta (planeFirst m) = -sourceRootFirst theta
proof:
:= by
  simp [sourcePointLeft]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft_apply_planeSecond
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePointLeft_apply_planeSecond (theta : ℝ) :
    sourcePointLeft m theta (planeSecond m) = -sourceRootSecond theta
proof:
:= by
  simp [sourcePointLeft]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight_apply_transverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourcePointRight_apply_transverse (theta : ℝ)
    (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    sourcePointRight m theta j.castSucc.castSucc = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hjA : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ planeFirst m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [planeFirst] at this
    omega
  have hjB : j.castSucc.castSucc ≠ planeSecond m := by
    intro h
    have := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [planeSecond] at this
    omega
  simp [sourcePointRight, hjA, hjB]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_eq_complex_square
statement:
theorem cassiniQ_eq_complex_square (x : E) :
    cassiniQ m x =
      (x (planeFirst m) ^ 2 - x (planeSecond m) ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 +
        (2 * x (planeFirst m) * x (planeSecond m)) ^ 2 - 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [cassiniQ_eq]
  simp only [radiusSq]
  ring

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_sourcePointRight
statement:
theorem cassiniQ_sourcePointRight (theta : ℝ) :
    cassiniQ m (sourcePointRight m theta) = -1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [cassiniQ_eq_complex_square, sourcePointRight_apply_planeFirst,
    sourcePointRight_apply_planeSecond, sourceRoot_sq_sub_sq,
    two_mul_sourceRootFirst_mul_sourceRootSecond]
  unfold sourceRadicandFirst sourceRadicandSecond
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left]
  have hs := sourceScale_sq
  calc
    (sourceScale * Real.cos theta) ^ 2 +
          (sourceScale * Real.sin theta) ^ 2 - 1 =
        sourceScale ^ 2 *
          (Real.cos theta ^ 2 + Real.sin theta ^ 2) - 1 := by ring
    _ = -1 / 2 := by rw [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq, mul_one, hs]; ring

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_neg
statement: theorem cassiniQ_neg (x : E) : cassiniQ m (-x) = cassiniQ m x
proof:
:= by
  rw [cassiniQ_eq, cassiniQ_eq]
  simp [radiusSq]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.cassiniQ_sourcePointLeft
statement:
theorem cassiniQ_sourcePointLeft (theta : ℝ) :
    cassiniQ m (sourcePointLeft m theta) = -1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourcePointLeft, cassiniQ_neg, cassiniQ_sourcePointRight]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber
statement:
theorem sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber (theta : ℝ) :
    sourcePointRight m theta ∈ (sourceFLS m).fiber
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => simp [sourceFLS, levelMap, cassiniQ_sourcePointRight]
  | cast j => simp [sourceFLS, levelMap]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft_mem_source_fiber
statement:
theorem sourcePointLeft_mem_source_fiber (theta : ℝ) :
    sourcePointLeft m theta ∈ (sourceFLS m).fiber
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => simp [sourceFLS, levelMap, cassiniQ_sourcePointLeft]
  | cast j => simp [sourceFLS, levelMap, sourcePointLeft]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_sourcePointRight
statement: theorem continuous_sourcePointRight : Continuous (sourcePointRight m)
proof:
:= by
  exact (continuous_sourceRootFirst.smul continuous_const).add
    (continuous_sourceRootSecond.smul continuous_const)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.continuous_sourcePointLeft
statement: theorem continuous_sourcePointLeft : Continuous (sourcePointLeft m)
proof:
:= by
  exact (continuous_sourcePointRight m).neg

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight_eq_iff_mod
proof:
:= by
  have hu : sourceRootFirst theta = sourceRootFirst theta' := by
    simpa using congrArg (fun x : E => x (planeFirst m)) h
  have hv : sourceRootSecond theta = sourceRootSecond theta' := by
    simpa using congrArg (fun x : E => x (planeSecond m)) h
  have hA : sourceRadicandFirst theta = sourceRadicandFirst theta' := by
    rw [← sourceRoot_sq_sub_sq theta, ← sourceRoot_sq_sub_sq theta', hu, hv]
  have hB : sourceRadicandSecond theta = sourceRadicandSecond theta' := by
    rw [← two_mul_sourceRootFirst_mul_sourceRootSecond theta,
      ← two_mul_sourceRootFirst_mul_sourceRootSecond theta', hu, hv]
  have hs0 : sourceScale ≠ 0 := sourceScale_pos.ne'
  have hcos : Real.cos theta = Real.cos theta' := by
    unfold sourceRadicandFirst at hA
    have : sourceScale * Real.cos theta = sourceScale * Real.cos theta' := by
      linarith
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hs0 this
  have hsin : Real.sin theta = Real.sin theta' := by
    unfold sourceRadicandSecond at hB
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hs0 hB
  have hone : Real.cos (theta' - theta) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.cos_sub, ← hcos, ← hsin]
    linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff _).mp hone
  exact ⟨z, by linarith⟩

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft_eq_iff_mod
proof:
:= by
  apply sourcePointRight_eq_iff_mod m
  simpa [sourcePointLeft] using h

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight_two_pi
statement:
theorem sourcePointRight_two_pi :
    sourcePointRight m (2 * Real.pi) = sourcePointRight m 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold sourcePointRight sourceRootSecond sourceRootFirst sourceRadicandNorm
    sourceRadicandFirst sourceRadicandSecond
  simp [Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft_two_pi
statement:
theorem sourcePointLeft_two_pi :
    sourcePointLeft m (2 * Real.pi) = sourcePointLeft m 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourcePointLeft, sourcePointLeft, sourcePointRight_two_pi]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceCurveRight_zero
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceCurveRight_zero :
    sourceCurveRight m 0 = sourcePointRight m 0
proof: := by simp [sourceCurveRight]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceCurveLeft_zero

proof: := by simp [sourceCurveLeft]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceCurveRight_closed
statement: theorem sourceCurveRight_closed : sourceCurveRight m 0 = sourceCurveRight m 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceCurveRight_zero]
  change sourcePointRight m 0 = sourcePointRight m (2 * Real.pi * (1 : ℝ))
  norm_num
  exact (sourcePointRight_two_pi m).symm

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceCurveLeft_closed
statement: theorem sourceCurveLeft_closed : sourceCurveLeft m 0 = sourceCurveLeft m 1

  change sourcePointLeft m 0 = sourcePointLeft m (2 * Real.pi * (1 : ℝ))

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.interval_eq_cases_of_angle_mod
proof:
:= by
  have hzLowerR : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  have hzUpperR : (z : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
  have hzLower : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast hzLowerR
  have hzUpper : z ≤ (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hzUpperR
  rcases (show z = -1 ∨ z = 0 ∨ z = 1 by omega) with hzv | hzv | hzv
  · right; right
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hzv] at huvZ
    norm_num at huvZ
    exact huvZ.symm
  · right; left
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceCurveRight_eq_cases
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := sourcePointRight_eq_iff_mod m huv
  have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
  have huvZ : (v : ℝ) = (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) := by
    change 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ) =
      2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) at hz
    nlinarith
  exact interval_eq_cases_of_angle_mod huvZ

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceCurveLeft_eq_cases
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := sourcePointLeft_eq_iff_mod m huv
  have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
  have huvZ : (v : ℝ) = (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) := by
    change 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ) =
      2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) at hz
    nlinarith
  exact interval_eq_cases_of_angle_mod huvZ

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem sourcePointRight_mem_orbit (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) (theta : ℝ) :
    sourcePointRight m theta ∈ V.orbit (sourcePointRight m 0)
proof:
:= by
  exact V.continuousCurve_mem_orbit (sourcePointRight m)
    (continuous_sourcePointRight m) (sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber m) theta

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem sourcePointLeft_mem_orbit (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) (theta : ℝ) :
    sourcePointLeft m theta ∈ V.orbit (sourcePointLeft m 0)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.source_planeFirst_ne_zero_of_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem source_planeFirst_ne_zero_of_mem_fiber {x : E}
    (hx : x ∈ (sourceFLS m).fiber) : x (planeFirst m) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hq := cassiniQ_eq_level_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx
  rw [cassiniQ_eq_complex_square, hzero] at hq
  norm_num at hq
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x (planeSecond m))]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.source_fiber_eq_range_union
statement:
theorem source_fiber_eq_range_union :
    (sourceFLS m).fiber =
      Set.range (sourcePointRight m) ∪ Set.range (sourcePointLeft m)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    let a := x (planeFirst m)
    let b := x (planeSecond m)
    have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := source_planeFirst_ne_zero_of_mem_fiber m hx
    have hc0 : sourceScale ≠ 0 := sourceScale_pos.ne'
    have hq := cassiniQ_eq_level_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx
    rw [cassiniQ_eq_complex_square] at hq
    have hsum :
        (a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 + (2 * a * b) ^ 2 = 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp [a, b]
      nlinarith
    have hunit :
        ((a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 - 1) / sourceScale) ^ 2 +
            ((2 * a * b) / sourceScale) ^ 2 = 1 := by
      calc
        ((a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 - 1) / sourceScale) ^ 2 +
              ((2 * a * b) / sourceScale) ^ 2 =
            ((a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 - 1) ^ 2 + (2 * a * b) ^ 2) /
              sourceScale ^ 2 := by field_simp [hc0]
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) / (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by
          rw [hsum, sourceScale_sq]
        _ = 1 := by norm_num
    obtain ⟨theta, hcos, hsin⟩ :=
      StandardBirth.exists_angle_of_sq_add_sq_eq_one hunit
    have hfirst : sourceRadicandFirst theta = a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 := by
      unfold sourceRadicandFirst
      rw [hcos]
      field_simp [hc0]
      ring
    have hsecond : sourceRadicandSecond theta = 2 * a * b := by
      unfold sourceRadicandSecond
      rw [hsin]
      field_simp [hc0]
    have hnormSq :
        sourceRadicandNorm theta ^ 2 = (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      rw [sourceRadicandNorm_sq, hfirst, hsecond]
      ring
    have habNonneg : 0 ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by positivity
    have hnorm : sourceRadicandNorm theta = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by
      have hn := (sourceRadicandNorm_pos theta).le
      nlinarith
    have hrootSq := sourceRootFirst_sq theta
    rw [hnorm, hfirst] at hrootSq
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne ha0 with haNeg | haPos
    · right
      have hroot : sourceRootFirst theta = -a := by
        have hr := sourceRootFirst_pos theta
        nlinarith
      have hrootSecond : sourceRootSecond theta = -b := by
        have hmul := two_mul_sourceRootFirst_mul_sourceRootSecond theta
        rw [hsecond, hroot] at hmul
        nlinarith
      have hright : sourcePointRight m theta = -x := by
        apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
        funext i
        induction i using Fin.lastCases with
        | last =>
            change sourcePointRight m theta (planeSecond m) =
              (-x) (planeSecond m)
            rw [sourcePointRight_apply_planeSecond, hrootSecond]
            rfl
        | cast i =>
            induction i using Fin.lastCases with
            | last =>
                change sourcePointRight m theta (planeFirst m) =
                  (-x) (planeFirst m)
                rw [sourcePointRight_apply_planeFirst, hroot]
                rfl
            | cast j =>
                have hxj := transverse_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx j
                change sourcePointRight m theta j.castSucc.castSucc =
                  (-x) j.castSucc.castSucc
                simp [sourcePointRight_apply_transverse, hxj]
      refine ⟨theta, ?_⟩
      simp [sourcePointLeft, hright]
    · left
      have hroot : sourceRootFirst theta = a := by
        have hr := sourceRootFirst_pos theta
        nlinarith
      have hrootSecond : sourceRootSecond theta = b := by
        have hmul := two_mul_sourceRootFirst_mul_sourceRootSecond theta
        rw [hsecond, hroot] at hmul
        nlinarith
      refine ⟨theta, ?_⟩
      apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
      funext i
      induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          change sourcePointRight m theta (planeSecond m) =
            x (planeSecond m)
          rw [sourcePointRight_apply_planeSecond, hrootSecond]
      | cast i =>
          induction i using Fin.lastCases with
          | last =>
              change sourcePointRight m theta (planeFirst m) =
                x (planeFirst m)
              rw [sourcePointRight_apply_planeFirst, hroot]
          | cast j =>
              have hxj := transverse_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hx j
              change sourcePointRight m theta j.castSucc.castSucc =
                x j.castSucc.castSucc
              rw [sourcePointRight_apply_transverse, hxj]
  · rintro (hx | hx)
    · rcases hx with ⟨theta, rfl⟩
      exact sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber m theta
    · rcases hx with ⟨theta, rfl⟩
      exact sourcePointLeft_mem_source_fiber m theta

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceOvalSign_apply_right
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceOvalSign_apply_right (theta : ℝ) :
    sourceOvalSign m (sourcePointRight m theta) = sourceRootFirst theta
proof:
:= by
  change sourcePointRight m theta (planeFirst m) = sourceRootFirst theta
  exact sourcePointRight_apply_planeFirst m theta

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceOvalSign_apply_left
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceOvalSign_apply_left (theta : ℝ) :
    sourceOvalSign m (sourcePointLeft m theta) = -sourceRootFirst theta
proof:
:= by
  change sourcePointLeft m theta (planeFirst m) = -sourceRootFirst theta
  exact sourcePointLeft_apply_planeFirst m theta

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.source_right_orbit_subset_range
statement:
theorem source_right_orbit_subset_range
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    V.orbit (sourcePointRight m 0) ⊆ Set.range (sourcePointRight m)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hp := sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber m 0
  have hxfiber := V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hx
  have hbase : 0 < sourceOvalSign m (sourcePointRight m 0) := by
    simpa using sourceRootFirst_pos 0
  have hxpos : 0 < sourceOvalSign m x :=
    ((sourceOvalSign m).pos_iff_of_mem_orbit V hp hx).mp hbase
  rw [source_fiber_eq_range_union m] at hxfiber
  rcases hxfiber with hright | hleft
  · exact hright
  · rcases hleft with ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    have hr := sourceRootFirst_pos theta
    simp only [sourceOvalSign_apply_left] at hxpos
    nlinarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.source_left_orbit_subset_range
statement:
theorem source_left_orbit_subset_range
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    V.orbit (sourcePointLeft m 0) ⊆ Set.range (sourcePointLeft m)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hp := sourcePointLeft_mem_source_fiber m 0
  have hsign := (sourceOvalSign m).pos_iff_of_mem_orbit V hp hx
  have hbaseNot : ¬ 0 < sourceOvalSign m (sourcePointLeft m 0) := by
    have hr := sourceRootFirst_pos 0
    simp only [sourceOvalSign_apply_left]
    nlinarith
  have hxfiber := V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hx
  rw [source_fiber_eq_range_union m] at hxfiber
  rcases hxfiber with hright | hleft
  · rcases hright with ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    have hrightPos : 0 < sourceOvalSign m (sourcePointRight m theta) := by
      simpa using sourceRootFirst_pos theta
    exact False.elim (hbaseNot (hsign.mpr hrightPos))
  · exact hleft

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.source_right_orbit_eq_range
statement:
theorem source_right_orbit_eq_range (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    V.orbit (sourcePointRight m 0) = Set.range (sourcePointRight m)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact source_right_orbit_subset_range m V
  · rintro x ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    exact sourcePointRight_mem_orbit m V theta

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.source_left_orbit_eq_range
statement:
theorem source_left_orbit_eq_range (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    V.orbit (sourcePointLeft m 0) = Set.range (sourcePointLeft m)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact source_left_orbit_subset_range m V
  · rintro x ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    exact sourcePointLeft_mem_orbit m V theta

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.source_ranges_disjoint
statement:
theorem source_ranges_disjoint :
    Disjoint (Set.range (sourcePointRight m))
      (Set.range (sourcePointLeft m))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.disjoint_left]
  rintro x ⟨theta, rfl⟩ ⟨phi, hphi⟩
  have hcoord := congrArg (fun y : E => y (planeFirst m)) hphi
  simp only [sourcePointLeft_apply_planeFirst,
    sourcePointRight_apply_planeFirst] at hcoord
  have htheta := sourceRootFirst_pos theta
  have hphiPos := sourceRootFirst_pos phi
  nlinarith

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRightOrbitIndex_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceRightOrbitIndex_coe (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    ((sourceRightOrbitIndex m V : V.OrbitIndex) : Set E) =
      V.orbit (sourcePointRight m 0)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceLeftOrbitIndex_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem sourceLeftOrbitIndex_coe (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    ((sourceLeftOrbitIndex m V : V.OrbitIndex) : Set E) =
      V.orbit (sourcePointLeft m 0)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRightOrbitIndex_ne_sourceLeftOrbitIndex
statement:
theorem sourceRightOrbitIndex_ne_sourceLeftOrbitIndex
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    sourceRightOrbitIndex m V ≠ sourceLeftOrbitIndex m V
proof:
:= by
  intro hindex
  have hsets := congrArg (fun O : V.OrbitIndex => (O : Set E)) hindex
  change V.orbit (sourcePointRight m 0) =
    V.orbit (sourcePointLeft m 0) at hsets
  rw [source_right_orbit_eq_range m V,
    source_left_orbit_eq_range m V] at hsets
  have hright : sourcePointRight m 0 ∈ Set.range (sourcePointRight m) :=
    ⟨0, rfl⟩
  have hleft : sourcePointRight m 0 ∈ Set.range (sourcePointLeft m) := by
    rw [← hsets]
    exact hright
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (source_ranges_disjoint m) hright hleft

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.orbitIndex_eq_sourceRight_or_sourceLeft
statement:
theorem orbitIndex_eq_sourceRight_or_sourceLeft
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    O = sourceRightOrbitIndex m V ∨ O = sourceLeftOrbitIndex m V
proof:
:= by
  have hp := V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  rw [source_fiber_eq_range_union m] at hp
  rcases hp with ⟨theta, htheta⟩ | ⟨theta, htheta⟩
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (O : Set E) = V.orbit (sourcePointRight m 0)
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O, ← htheta]
    exact V.orbit_eq_of_mem (sourcePointRight_mem_orbit m V theta)
  · right
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (O : Set E) = V.orbit (sourcePointLeft m 0)
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O, ← htheta]
    exact V.orbit_eq_of_mem (sourcePointLeft_mem_orbit m V theta)

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.source_framedDelta_eq_orbitContributions
statement:
theorem source_framedDelta_eq_orbitContributions
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    V.framedDelta =
      V.orbitContribution (sourceRightOrbitIndex m V) +
        V.orbitContribution (sourceLeftOrbitIndex m V)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold TamedField.framedDelta
  have huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset V.OrbitIndex) =
      {sourceRightOrbitIndex m V, sourceLeftOrbitIndex m V} := by
    ext O
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton,
      true_iff]
    exact orbitIndex_eq_sourceRight_or_sourceLeft m V O
  rw [huniv]
  simp [sourceRightOrbitIndex_ne_sourceLeftOrbitIndex m V]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRight_paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental

        (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed =
      V.fundamentalFrameClass (sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber m 0)
proof:
:=
  (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceLeft_paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental
statement:

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRight_orbitContribution_eq_paramFrameClass_add_one
statement:
theorem sourceRight_orbitContribution_eq_paramFrameClass_add_one
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    V.orbitContribution (sourceRightOrbitIndex m V) =
      loopClassZ2 (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
        (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold TamedField.orbitContribution TamedField.orbitFrameClass
  have hpoint : V.orbitPoint (sourceRightOrbitIndex m V) ∈
      V.orbit (sourcePointRight m 0) := by
    rw [← sourceRightOrbitIndex_coe m V, V.orbitPoint_orbit]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  have hbase :
      V.fundamentalFrameClass
          (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (sourceRightOrbitIndex m V)) =
        V.fundamentalFrameClass (sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber m 0) :=
    V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit
      (sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber m 0) hpoint
  change V.fundamentalFrameClass
      (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (sourceRightOrbitIndex m V)) + 1 = _
  rw [hbase, ← sourceRight_paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental m V]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceLeft_orbitContribution_eq_paramFrameClass_add_one
statement:
theorem sourceLeft_orbitContribution_eq_paramFrameClass_add_one
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    V.orbitContribution (sourceLeftOrbitIndex m V) =
      loopClassZ2 (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
        (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed + 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold TamedField.orbitContribution TamedField.orbitFrameClass
  have hpoint : V.orbitPoint (sourceLeftOrbitIndex m V) ∈
      V.orbit (sourcePointLeft m 0) := by
    rw [← sourceLeftOrbitIndex_coe m V, V.orbitPoint_orbit]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  have hbase :
      V.fundamentalFrameClass
          (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (sourceLeftOrbitIndex m V)) =
        V.fundamentalFrameClass (sourcePointLeft_mem_source_fiber m 0) :=
    V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit
      (sourcePointLeft_mem_source_fiber m 0) hpoint
  change V.fundamentalFrameClass
      (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (sourceLeftOrbitIndex m V)) + 1 = _
  rw [hbase, ← sourceLeft_paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental m V]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.source_framedDelta_eq_paramFrameClass_sum
statement:
theorem source_framedDelta_eq_paramFrameClass_sum
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    V.framedDelta =
      loopClassZ2 (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
          (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed +
        loopClassZ2 (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
          (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed
proof:
:= by
  rw [source_framedDelta_eq_orbitContributions,
    sourceRight_orbitContribution_eq_paramFrameClass_add_one,
    sourceLeft_orbitContribution_eq_paramFrameClass_add_one]
  let betaRight : ZMod 2 :=
    loopClassZ2 (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
      (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed
  let betaLeft : ZMod 2 :=
    loopClassZ2 (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
      (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed
  change (betaRight + 1) + (betaLeft + 1) = betaRight + betaLeft
  have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
  calc
    (betaRight + 1) + (betaLeft + 1) =
        betaRight + betaLeft + (1 + 1) := by abel
    _ = betaRight + betaLeft := by rw [h11, add_zero]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceSign_positiveFramedDelta_eq_framedDelta
statement:
theorem sourceSign_positiveFramedDelta_eq_framedDelta
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    (sourceSign m).positiveFramedDelta V = V.framedDelta
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold FiberSign.positiveFramedDelta TamedField.deltaOn TamedField.framedDelta
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro O _
  have hselected : (O : Set E) ∈
      (sourceSign m).positiveOrbitCollection V := by
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O] at hx
      exact V.orbit_subset_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) hx
    · simp [sourceSign]
  simp [hselected]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceSign_positiveDelta_eq_paramFrameClass_sum
statement:
theorem sourceSign_positiveDelta_eq_paramFrameClass_sum
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) :
    (sourceSign m).positiveDelta =
      loopClassZ2 (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
          (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed +
        loopClassZ2 (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop
          (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop_closed
proof:
:= by
  rw [(sourceSign m).positiveDelta_eq V,
    sourceSign_positiveFramedDelta_eq_framedDelta,
    source_framedDelta_eq_paramFrameClass_sum]

name: Submission.StandardSaddle.sourceRight_paramFrameLoop_apply
statement:
theorem sourceRight_paramFrameLoop_apply
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m)) (u : I) :
    ((sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).paramFrameLoop u :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) =
      rowsMatrix (endpointUnitFrame m (-1 / 2)
        (sourcePointRight m (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  change frameLoop (sourceFLS m)
      (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).realCurve (u : ℝ) = _
  unfold frameLoop
  rw [(sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m V).realCurve_coe]
  change rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
      (frameAt (sourceFLS m)
        (sourcePointRight m (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))) = _
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_source m
    (sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber m _)]

      (frameAt (sourceFLS m)
