name: Submission.MorseLedger.delta_nil
statement: @[simp] theorem delta_nil : delta [] = 0
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.MorseLedger.delta_cons
statement:
@[simp] theorem delta_cons (β : ZMod 2) (L : MorseLedger) :
    delta (β :: L) = β + 1 + delta L
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Submission.MorseLedger.delta_eq_sum_add_length
statement:
theorem delta_eq_sum_add_length (L : MorseLedger) :
    delta L = L.sum + L.length
proof:
:= by
  induction L with
  | nil => simp [delta]
  | cons β L ih =>
      simp only [delta_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons, ih]
      push_cast
      abel

name: Submission.MorseLedger.delta_eq_of_perm
statement:
theorem delta_eq_of_perm {L R : MorseLedger} (h : L.Perm R) :
    delta L = delta R
proof:
:= by
  unfold delta
  exact List.Perm.sum_eq (h.map fun β => β + 1)

name: Submission.MorseLedgerStep.delta_eq
statement:
theorem delta_eq {L R : MorseLedger} (h : MorseLedgerStep L R) :
    L.delta = R.delta
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | perm hperm => exact MorseLedger.delta_eq_of_perm hperm
  | birth tail =>
      simp only [MorseLedger.delta_cons]
      have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
      rw [h11, zero_add]
  | death tail =>
      simp only [MorseLedger.delta_cons]
      have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
      rw [h11, zero_add]
  | saddleMerge β₁ β₂ βhat tail hβ =>
      simp only [MorseLedger.delta_cons]
      rw [hβ]
      have h11 : (1 : ZMod 2) + 1 = 0 := by decide
      calc
        β₁ + 1 + (β₂ + 1 + tail.delta)
            = β₁ + β₂ + (1 + 1) + tail.delta := by abel
        _ = β₁ + β₂ + tail.delta := by rw [h11, add_zero]
        _ = β₁ + β₂ + (1 + 1) + tail.delta := by rw [h11, add_zero]
        _ = β₁ + β₂ + 1 + 1 + tail.delta := by abel
  | saddleSplit β₁ β₂ βhat tail hβ =>
      symm
      exact (saddleMerge β₁ β₂ βhat tail hβ).delta_eq

name: Submission.MorseLedgerStep.symm
statement:
theorem symm {L R : MorseLedger} (h : MorseLedgerStep L R) :
    MorseLedgerStep R L
proof:
:= by
  cases h with
  | perm hperm => exact .perm hperm.symm
  | birth => exact .death _
  | death => exact .birth _
  | saddleMerge β₁ β₂ βhat tail hβ => exact .saddleSplit β₁ β₂ βhat tail hβ
  | saddleSplit β₁ β₂ βhat tail hβ => exact .saddleMerge β₁ β₂ βhat tail hβ

name: Submission.MorseLedgerStep.ofSaddleMerge
statement:
theorem ofSaddleMerge {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) (S : SaddleModelContract)
    (tail : MorseLedger) :
    MorseLedgerStep
      (loopClassZ2 (S.incoming₁.frame m) (S.incoming₁.frame_closed m) ::
        loopClassZ2 (S.incoming₂.frame m) (S.incoming₂.frame_closed m) :: tail)
      (loopClassZ2 (S.outgoing.frame m) (S.outgoing.frame_closed m) :: tail)
proof:
:=
  .saddleMerge _ _ _ tail (S.frame_class_splice hm)

name: Submission.MorseLedgerStep.ofSaddleSplit
statement:
theorem ofSaddleSplit {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) (S : SaddleModelContract)
    (tail : MorseLedger) :
    MorseLedgerStep
      (loopClassZ2 (S.outgoing.frame m) (S.outgoing.frame_closed m) :: tail)
      (loopClassZ2 (S.incoming₁.frame m) (S.incoming₁.frame_closed m) ::
        loopClassZ2 (S.incoming₂.frame m) (S.incoming₂.frame_closed m) :: tail)
proof:
:=
  .saddleSplit _ _ _ tail (S.frame_class_splice hm)

name: Submission.MorseLedgerStep.ofDefiniteBirth
statement:
theorem ofDefiniteBirth {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) (D : DefiniteModelContract)
    (tail : MorseLedger) :
    MorseLedgerStep tail
      (loopClassZ2 (D.frameLoop.frame m) (D.frameLoop.frame_closed m) :: tail)
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.frame_class hm]
  exact .birth tail

name: Submission.MorseLedgerStep.ofDefiniteDeath
statement:
theorem ofDefiniteDeath {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) (D : DefiniteModelContract)
    (tail : MorseLedger) :
    MorseLedgerStep
      (loopClassZ2 (D.frameLoop.frame m) (D.frameLoop.frame_closed m) :: tail) tail
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.frame_class hm]
  exact .death tail

name: Submission.MorseLedgerTrace.trans
proof:
:= by
  induction hLM with
  | refl => exact hMR
  | cons step tail ih => exact .cons step (ih hMR)

name: Submission.MorseLedgerTrace.delta_eq
statement:
theorem delta_eq {L R : MorseLedger} (h : MorseLedgerTrace L R) :
    L.delta = R.delta
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl => rfl
  | cons step tail ih => exact step.delta_eq.trans ih

name: Submission.MorseLedgerTrace.symm
statement:
theorem symm {L R : MorseLedger} (h : MorseLedgerTrace L R) :
    MorseLedgerTrace R L
proof:
:= by
  induction h with
  | refl L => exact .refl L
  | @cons L M R step tail ih =>
      exact ih.trans (.cons step.symm (.refl L))

name: Submission.MorseLedger.canonical_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem canonical_zero : canonical 0 = []
proof: := by simp [canonical]

name: Submission.MorseLedger.canonical_one
statement: @[simp] theorem canonical_one : canonical 1 = [0]
proof: := by simp [canonical]

name: Submission.MorseLedger.delta_canonical
statement: @[simp] theorem delta_canonical (d : ZMod 2) : (canonical d).delta = d
proof:
:= by
  have hle : d.val ≤ 1 := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp d.val_lt
  rcases Nat.le_one_iff_eq_zero_or_eq_one.mp hle with hzero | hone
  · have hd : d = 0 := (ZMod.val_eq_zero d).mp hzero
    subst d
    rw [canonical_zero, delta_nil]
  · have hd : d = 1 := (ZMod.val_eq_one (by norm_num) d).mp hone
    subst d
    rw [canonical_one, delta_cons, delta_nil]
    decide

name: Submission.MorseLedger.trace_to_canonical
statement:
theorem trace_to_canonical : ∀ L : MorseLedger,
    MorseLedgerTrace L (canonical L.delta)
  | [] => by simp; exact .refl []
  | [β] => by
      fin_cases β
      · simp [canonical]
        exact .refl [0]
      · simp [canonical]
        exact .cons (.death []) (.refl [])
  | β₁ :: β₂ :: tail => by
      let βhat : ZMod 2
proof:
:= β₁ + β₂ + 1
      have hstep : MorseLedgerStep (β₁ :: β₂ :: tail) (βhat :: tail) :=
        .saddleMerge β₁ β₂ βhat tail rfl
      have hdelta : MorseLedger.delta (β₁ :: β₂ :: tail) =
          MorseLedger.delta (βhat :: tail) :=
        hstep.delta_eq
      exact .cons hstep (by
        simpa only [hdelta] using trace_to_canonical (βhat :: tail))
  termination_by L => L.length
  decreasing_by simp_wf

name: Submission.MorseLedger.exists_trace_iff_delta_eq
statement:
theorem exists_trace_iff_delta_eq {L R : MorseLedger} :
    Nonempty (MorseLedgerTrace L R) ↔ L.delta = R.delta
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h⟩
    exact h.delta_eq
  · intro hδ
    refine ⟨(trace_to_canonical L).trans ?_⟩
    have hcanon : canonical L.delta = canonical R.delta := congrArg canonical hδ
    rw [hcanon]
    exact (trace_to_canonical R).symm

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.ParametricPeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.contDiffAt_ambientField_tubeLift
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_ambientField_tubeLift (t u : ℝ) (z : N[n])
    (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) F.globalSmoothTube.radius) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ P.ambientField (t, F.tubeLift (u, z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, g₀, hf, hg₀, hg₀deriv, hg₀center, hg₀local⟩ :=
    F.globalSmoothTube.local_smooth_lift u z hz
  let chart : OpenPartialHomeomorph (ℝ × N[n]) E[n] :=
    F.smooth_tubeLift.contDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph F.tubeLift hf (by simp)
  let g : E[n] → ℝ × N[n] := chart.symm
  have hsource : (u, z) ∈ chart.source :=
    F.smooth_tubeLift.contDiffAt
      |>.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hf (by simp)
  have htarget : F.tubeLift (u, z) ∈ chart.target :=
    chart.map_source hsource
  have hgcenter : g (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z) := by
    change chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z)
    rw [← show (chart : (ℝ × N[n]) → E[n]) = F.tubeLift by rfl]
    exact chart.left_inv hsource
  have hforwardDeriv : HasFDerivAt chart
      (e : (ℝ × N[n]) →L[ℝ] E[n])
      (chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z) by exact hgcenter]
    exact hf
  have hforwardSmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ chart
      (chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (F.tubeLift (u, z)) = (u, z) by exact hgcenter]
    exact F.smooth_tubeLift.contDiffAt
  have hgsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g (F.tubeLift (u, z)) :=
    chart.contDiffAt_symm htarget hforwardDeriv hforwardSmooth
  have hgball : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (F.tubeLift (u, z)),
      (g y).2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) F.globalSmoothTube.radius := by
    have hg2continuous : ContinuousAt (fun y : E[n] => (g y).2)
        (F.tubeLift (u, z)) :=
      continuous_snd.continuousAt.comp' hgsmooth.continuousAt
    have hzcenter : (g (F.tubeLift (u, z))).2 ∈
        Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) F.globalSmoothTube.radius := by
      rw [hgcenter]
      exact hz
    exact hg2continuous.eventually (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzcenter)
  have hright : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (F.tubeLift (u, z)), F.tubeLift (g y) = y := by
    filter_upwards [chart.eventually_right_inverse htarget] with y hy
    exact hy
  have hlocal : ∀ᶠ y in 𝓝 (F.tubeLift (u, z)), ∀ a : ℝ,
      P.ambientField (a, y) =
        P.radialBump (g y).2 • P.displacement (a, (g y).1) := by
    filter_upwards [hright, hgball] with y hy hgy
    intro a
    let q : C × N[n] := (((g y).1 : C), (g y).2)
    have hq : q ∈ (P.slice a).tubeDomain := ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hgy⟩
    have hyq : F.tube q = y := by
      rw [F.tube_coe]
      exact hy
    have hytube : y ∈ (P.slice a).tubeImage := ⟨q, hq, hyq⟩
    have hinv : F.globalSmoothTube.inverse y = q := by
      rw [← hyq]
      exact F.globalSmoothTube.inverse_left q hq
    rw [ambientField, PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.ambientField,
      if_pos hytube, hinv, (P.slice a).quotientDisplacement_coe]
    rfl
  have hlocalProd : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 (t, F.tubeLift (u, z)),
      P.ambientField p =
        P.radialBump (g p.2).2 •
          P.displacement (p.1, (g p.2).1) := by
    have hsnd : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × E[n] => p.2)
        (t, F.tubeLift (u, z)) := continuous_snd.continuousAt
    have hpre := hsnd.eventually hlocal
    filter_upwards [hpre] with p hp
    exact hp p.1
  have hgpair : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E[n] => g p.2)
      (t, F.tubeLift (u, z)) :=
    hgsmooth.comp (t, F.tubeLift (u, z))
      (show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E[n] => p.2)
        (t, F.tubeLift (u, z)) from contDiffAt_snd)
  have hb : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E[n] => P.radialBump (g p.2).2)
      (t, F.tubeLift (u, z)) :=
    P.radialBump.contDiffAt.comp _ (contDiffAt_snd.comp _ hgpair)
  have hphase : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E[n] => (p.1, (g p.2).1))
      (t, F.tubeLift (u, z)) :=
    contDiffAt_fst.prodMk (contDiffAt_fst.comp _ hgpair)
  have hd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E[n] => P.displacement (p.1, (g p.2).1))
      (t, F.tubeLift (u, z)) :=
    P.displacement_smooth.contDiffAt.comp _ hphase
  exact (hb.smul hd).congr_of_eventuallyEq hlocalProd

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.ParametricPeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.contDiff_ambientField
statement: theorem contDiff_ambientField : ContDiff ℝ ∞ P.ambientField
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  rintro ⟨t, x⟩
  by_cases hx : x ∈ P.supportCore
  · rcases hx with ⟨⟨a, z⟩, hzcore, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
    have hzle : ‖z‖ ≤ P.radialBump.rOut := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_left] using hzcore.2
    have hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N[n]) F.globalSmoothTube.radius := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_left] using
        (lt_of_le_of_lt hzle P.radialBump_rOut_lt)
    simpa only [F.tube_coe] using
      P.contDiffAt_ambientField_tubeLift t u z hz
  · have hnear : P.supportCoreᶜ ∈ 𝓝 x :=
      P.isClosed_supportCore.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hx
    have hsnd : ContinuousAt (fun p : ℝ × E[n] => p.2) (t, x) :=
      continuous_snd.continuousAt
    have hnearProd : ∀ᶠ p in 𝓝 (t, x), p.2 ∉ P.supportCore :=
      hsnd.eventually hnear
    apply (show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun _ : ℝ × E[n] => (0 : E[n])) (t, x) from
        contDiffAt_const).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [hnearProd] with p hp
    exact P.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore p.1 hp

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.ParametricPeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.continuous_spatialFDeriv
statement: theorem continuous_spatialFDeriv : Continuous P.spatialFDeriv
proof:

  exact (P.contDiff_ambientField.continuous_fderiv (by simp)).clm_comp

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.ParametricPeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.fderiv_at_ambientField
statement:
theorem fderiv_at_ambientField (t : ℝ) (x : E[n]) :
    fderiv ℝ (P.slice t).ambientField x = P.spatialFDeriv (t, x)
proof:
:= by
  have htotal :=
    (P.contDiff_ambientField.differentiable (by simp) (t, x)).hasFDerivAt
  have hin : HasFDerivAt (fun y : E[n] => (t, y))
      (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ ℝ E[n]) x :=
    hasFDerivAt_prodMk_right t x
  have hcomp := htotal.comp x hin
  change fderiv ℝ (fun y : E[n] => P.ambientField (t, y)) x =
    P.spatialFDeriv (t, x)
  simpa [spatialFDeriv, Function.comp_def] using hcomp.fderiv

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.ParametricPeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.fderiv_at_ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore
statement:
theorem fderiv_at_ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore
    (t : ℝ) {x : E[n]} (hx : x ∉ P.supportCore) :
    fderiv ℝ (P.slice t).ambientField x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hnear : P.supportCoreᶜ ∈ 𝓝 x :=
    P.isClosed_supportCore.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hx
  have heq : (P.slice t).ambientField =ᶠ[𝓝 x]
      (fun _ : E[n] => (0 : E[n])) := by
    filter_upwards [hnear] with y hy
    exact P.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore t hy
  rw [heq.fderiv_eq]
  exact fderiv_const_apply 0

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.ParametricPeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.ambientField_base_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : x ∈ (P.slice s).tubeImage
  · let q : C × N[n] := F.globalSmoothTube.inverse x
    obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective q.1
    rw [ambientField, PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.ambientField,
      if_pos ht]
    change P.radialBump q.2 • (P.slice s).quotientDisplacement q.1 = 0
    rw [← hu, (P.slice s).quotientDisplacement_coe]
    change P.radialBump q.2 • P.displacement (s, u) = 0
    rw [hzero u, smul_zero]
  · exact (P.slice s).ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_tubeImage ht

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.ParametricPeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.spatialFDeriv_base_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  rw [← P.fderiv_at_ambientField s x]
  have hfun : (P.slice s).ambientField = fun _ : E[n] => 0 := by
    funext y
    exact P.ambientField_base_eq_zero hzero y
  rw [hfun]
  exact fderiv_const_apply 0

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.ParametricPeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.exists_uniform_lipschitzWith_of_base_zero
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_lipschitzWith_of_base_zero {s : ℝ}
    (hzero : ∀ u : ℝ, P.displacement (s, u) = 0)
    (K : ℝ≥0) (hK : 0 < K) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t - s| < δ →
      LipschitzWith K (P.slice t).ambientField
proof:
:= by
  let W : Set (ℝ × E[n]) :=
    {p | ‖P.spatialFDeriv p‖ < (K : ℝ)}
  have hWopen : IsOpen W := by
    exact isOpen_lt P.continuous_spatialFDeriv.norm continuous_const
  have hbase : ({s} : Set ℝ) ×ˢ P.supportCore ⊆ W := by
    rintro ⟨t, x⟩ ⟨ht, hx⟩
    rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at ht
    change t = s at ht
    subst t
    change ‖P.spatialFDeriv (s, x)‖ < (K : ℝ)
    rw [P.spatialFDeriv_base_eq_zero hzero x, norm_zero]
    exact_mod_cast hK
  obtain ⟨U, Z, hUopen, hZopen, hsU, hcoreZ, hUZ⟩ :=
    generalized_tube_lemma (isCompact_singleton (x := s))
      P.isCompact_supportCore hWopen hbase
  have hs_mem : s ∈ U := hsU (Set.mem_singleton s)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hUopen s hs_mem
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  apply lipschitzWith_of_nnnorm_fderiv_le
    ((P.slice t).contDiff_ambientField.differentiable (by simp))
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ P.supportCore
  · rw [P.fderiv_at_ambientField]
    have htU : t ∈ U := hball (by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using ht)
    have hsmall : ‖P.spatialFDeriv (t, x)‖ < (K : ℝ) :=
      hUZ ⟨htU, hcoreZ hx⟩
    rw [← NNReal.coe_le_coe, coe_nnnorm]
    exact hsmall.le
  · rw [P.fderiv_at_ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore t hx]
    simp

name: Submission.SmoothFramedPeriodicCircle.ParametricPeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.exists_lipschitzWith_lt_one_of_base_zero
statement:
theorem exists_lipschitzWith_lt_one_of_base_zero {s : ℝ}
    (hzero : ∀ u : ℝ, P.displacement (s, u) = 0) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t - s| < δ →
      ∃ K : ℝ≥0, K < 1 ∧ LipschitzWith K (P.slice t).ambientField
proof:
:= by
  let K : ℝ≥0 := 1 / 2
  have hK : 0 < K := by norm_num [K]
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hLip⟩ :=
    P.exists_uniform_lipschitzWith_of_base_zero hzero K hK
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro t ht
  exact ⟨K, by norm_num [K], hLip t ht⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.SmoothSliceFrame.parametricChordExtensionData_slice

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.SmoothSliceFrame.exists_uniform_lipschitzWith_chordExtensionData
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_lipschitzWith_chordExtensionData
    {s : ℝ} (G : T.SmoothSliceFrame s)
    (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (K : ℝ≥0) (hK : 0 < K) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t - s| < δ →
      LipschitzWith K
        (G.chordExtensionData (T := T) hs t).ambientField
proof:
:= by
  have hzero : ∀ u : ℝ,
      (G.parametricChordExtensionData (T := T) hs).displacement (s, u) = 0 := by
    intro u
    simp [parametricChordExtensionData]
  simpa only [G.parametricChordExtensionData_slice (T := T) hs] using
    (G.parametricChordExtensionData (T := T) hs).exists_uniform_lipschitzWith_of_base_zero
      hzero K hK

name: Submission.quot_mk_bandComparisonLoop
statement:
private theorem quot_mk_bandComparisonLoop
    {O₁ O₂ : Vbefore.OrbitIndex} {Ohat : Vafter.OrbitIndex}
    (M : SaddleFrameBandMarkingData Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat) :
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.bandComparisonLoop =
      (((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.beforeLocalPath₁).symm.trans
          (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₁)).trans
        ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.afterBandPath₁).trans
          (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₂).symm)).trans
      (((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.beforeLocalPath₂).symm.trans
          (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₃)).trans
        ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.afterBandPath₂).trans
          (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₀).symm))
proof:
:= by
  show Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk
      (((M.beforeLocalPath₁.symm.trans M.connectorPath₁).trans
          (M.afterBandPath₁.trans M.connectorPath₂.symm)).trans
        ((M.beforeLocalPath₂.symm.trans M.connectorPath₃).trans
          (M.afterBandPath₂.trans M.connectorPath₀.symm))) = _
  simp only [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_symm]

name: Submission.SaddleFrameBandMarkingData.pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop
statement:
theorem SaddleFrameBandMarkingData.pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop
    {O₁ O₂ : Vbefore.OrbitIndex} {Ohat : Vafter.OrbitIndex}
    (M : SaddleFrameBandMarkingData Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat) :
    pathLoopClassZ2 M.bandComparisonLoop =
      Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ +
        Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat
proof:
:= by
  
  have hafter : Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
      pathLoopClassZ2 ((M.afterExteriorPath₁.trans M.afterBandPath₁).trans
        (M.afterExteriorPath₂.trans M.afterBandPath₂)) := by
    rw [← M.afterParam.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_of_orbit Ohat
      M.afterParam_orbit]
    exact (pathLoopClassZ2_cut_chain_wrap M.afterFrameLoop
      M.afterCut₀ M.afterCut₁ M.afterCut₂ M.afterCut₃).symm
  have hbefore₁ : Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ =
      pathLoopClassZ2 (M.beforeExteriorPath₁.trans M.beforeLocalPath₁) := by
    rw [← M.before₁Param.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_of_orbit O₁
      M.before₁Param_orbit]
    exact (pathLoopClassZ2_cut_wrap M.before₁FrameLoop
      M.before₁Cut₀ M.before₁Cut₁).symm
  have hbefore₂ : Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ =
      pathLoopClassZ2 (M.beforeExteriorPath₂.trans M.beforeLocalPath₂) := by
    rw [← M.before₂Param.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_of_orbit O₂
      M.before₂Param_orbit]
    exact (pathLoopClassZ2_cut_wrap M.before₂FrameLoop
      M.before₂Cut₀ M.before₂Cut₁).symm
  
  have htrans₁ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.afterExteriorPath₁ =
      ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₀).symm.trans
          (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.beforeExteriorPath₁)).trans
        (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₁) := by
    rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_symm, ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans,
      ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans]
    exact Path.Homotopic.Quotient.eq.mpr
      (homotopic_of_square M.transport₁ M.beforeExteriorPath₁
        M.afterExteriorPath₁ M.connectorPath₀ M.connectorPath₁
        M.transport₁_before M.transport₁_after (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl))
  have htrans₂ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.afterExteriorPath₂ =
      ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₂).symm.trans
          (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.beforeExteriorPath₂)).trans
        (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₃) := by
    rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_symm, ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans,
      ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans]
    exact Path.Homotopic.Quotient.eq.mpr
      (homotopic_of_square M.transport₂ M.beforeExteriorPath₂
        M.afterExteriorPath₂ M.connectorPath₂ M.connectorPath₃
        M.transport₂_before M.transport₂_after (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl))
  
  have hsplice := quotLoopClassZ2_band_splice
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.afterExteriorPath₁)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.afterBandPath₁)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.afterExteriorPath₂)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.afterBandPath₂)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.beforeExteriorPath₁)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.beforeLocalPath₁)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.beforeExteriorPath₂)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.beforeLocalPath₂)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₀)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₁)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₂)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk M.connectorPath₃)
    htrans₁ htrans₂
  rw [← quot_mk_bandComparisonLoop M] at hsplice
  simp only [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans, quotLoopClassZ2_mk] at hsplice
  rw [← hafter, ← hbefore₁, ← hbefore₂] at hsplice
  rw [hsplice]
  exact zmod_two_band_solve _ _ _

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_calibrated_eq_one
statement:
theorem pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_calibrated_eq_one
    (O₁ O₂ : Vbefore.OrbitIndex) (Ohat : Vafter.OrbitIndex)
    (hsplice : Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
      Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + 1) :
    pathLoopClassZ2
        (calibratedSaddleFrameBandMarkingData O₁ O₂
          Ohat).bandComparisonLoop = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_calibrated, hsplice]
  have htwo : ∀ z : ZMod 2, z + z = 0 := by decide
  calc
    Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ +
        (Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + 1) =
        (Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁) +
          (Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂) + 1 := by
      ring
    _ = 0 + 0 + 1 := by rw [htwo, htwo]
    _ = 1 := by ring

statement:
theorem sourceRight_paramFrameLoop_apply (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m hm)) (u : I) :
    ((sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V).paramFrameLoop u :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) =
      (sourceCoefficientLoop m u :
          Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) *
        rowsMatrix (StandardSaddle.endpointUnitFrame m (-1 / 2)
          (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m
            (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  change frameLoop (sourceFLS m hm)
      (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V).realCurve (u : ℝ) = _
  unfold frameLoop
  rw [(sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V).realCurve_coe]
  change rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ
      (frameAt (sourceFLS m hm)
        (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m
          (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))) = _
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed_frameAt_source m hm
      (sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber m hm _),
    rowsMatrix_frameRowAction]
  have hcoeff :
      ((coefficientSO m
          (twistRe m (spaceTime (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m
            (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))) 0))
          (twistIm m (spaceTime (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m
            (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))) 0))
          (sourceCoefficient_normSq_pos m hm
            (sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber m hm _)) : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) =
      fullCoefficientBlock m
        (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)))
        (Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))) := by
    simpa only [twistRe_sourceRight, twistIm_sourceRight] using
      coefficientSO_smul_polar m StandardSaddle.sourceScale_pos
        (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))
  rw [hcoeff, sourceCoefficientLoop_coe]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameLedger.sourceRight_paramFrameClass_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sourceRight_paramFrameClass_eq_zero (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m hm)) :
    loopClassZ2 (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V).paramFrameLoop
        (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V).paramFrameLoop_closed = 0
proof:
:= by
  let W : TamedField (StandardSaddle.sourceFLS m) :=
    (StandardSaddle.sourceFLS m).exists_tamedField.some
  let P := sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V
  let Q := StandardSaddle.sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m W
  let R := sourceCoefficientLoop m * Q.paramFrameLoop
  have hRclosed : R 0 = R 1 := by
    change sourceCoefficientLoop m 0 * Q.paramFrameLoop 0 =
      sourceCoefficientLoop m 1 * Q.paramFrameLoop 1
    rw [sourceCoefficientLoop_closed, Q.paramFrameLoop_closed]
  have heq : P.paramFrameLoop = R :=
    sourceRight_paramFrameLoop_eq_mul_standard m hm V W
  calc
    loopClassZ2 P.paramFrameLoop P.paramFrameLoop_closed =
        loopClassZ2 R hRclosed :=
      loopClassZ2_congr_fun P.paramFrameLoop_closed hRclosed heq
    _ = loopClassZ2 (sourceCoefficientLoop m)
          (sourceCoefficientLoop_closed m) +
        loopClassZ2 Q.paramFrameLoop Q.paramFrameLoop_closed := by
      exact loopClassZ2_mul _ _ _ _ _
    _ = 1 + 1 := by
      rw [loopClassZ2_sourceCoefficientLoop,
        StandardSaddle.sourceRight_paramFrameClass_eq_one]
    _ = 0 := by decide

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameLedger.sourceLeft_paramFrameClass_eq_zero
statement:
theorem sourceLeft_paramFrameClass_eq_zero (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m hm)) :
    loopClassZ2 (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V).paramFrameLoop
        (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V).paramFrameLoop_closed = 0
proof:
:= by
  let W : TamedField (StandardSaddle.sourceFLS m) :=
    (StandardSaddle.sourceFLS m).exists_tamedField.some
  let P := sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V
  let Q := StandardSaddle.sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m W
  let R := sourceCoefficientLoop m * Q.paramFrameLoop
  have hRclosed : R 0 = R 1 := by
    change sourceCoefficientLoop m 0 * Q.paramFrameLoop 0 =
      sourceCoefficientLoop m 1 * Q.paramFrameLoop 1
    rw [sourceCoefficientLoop_closed, Q.paramFrameLoop_closed]
  have heq : P.paramFrameLoop = R :=
    sourceLeft_paramFrameLoop_eq_mul_standard m hm V W
  calc
    loopClassZ2 P.paramFrameLoop P.paramFrameLoop_closed =
        loopClassZ2 R hRclosed :=
      loopClassZ2_congr_fun P.paramFrameLoop_closed hRclosed heq
    _ = loopClassZ2 (sourceCoefficientLoop m)
          (sourceCoefficientLoop_closed m) +
        loopClassZ2 Q.paramFrameLoop Q.paramFrameLoop_closed := by
      exact loopClassZ2_mul _ _ _ _ _
    _ = 1 + 1 := by
      rw [loopClassZ2_sourceCoefficientLoop,
        StandardSaddle.sourceLeft_paramFrameClass_eq_one]
    _ = 0 := by decide

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameLedger.target_paramFrameClass_eq_one
statement:
theorem target_paramFrameClass_eq_one (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : TamedField (targetFLS m hm)) :
    loopClassZ2 (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V).paramFrameLoop
        (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V).paramFrameLoop_closed = 1
proof:
:= by
  let W : TamedField (StandardSaddle.targetFLS m) :=
    (StandardSaddle.targetFLS m).exists_tamedField.some
  let P := targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm V
  let Q := StandardSaddle.targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m W
  let R := targetCoefficientLoop m * Q.paramFrameLoop
  have hRclosed : R 0 = R 1 := by
    change targetCoefficientLoop m 0 * Q.paramFrameLoop 0 =
      targetCoefficientLoop m 1 * Q.paramFrameLoop 1
    rw [targetCoefficientLoop_closed, Q.paramFrameLoop_closed]
  have heq : P.paramFrameLoop = R :=
    target_paramFrameLoop_eq_mul_standard m hm V W
  calc
    loopClassZ2 P.paramFrameLoop P.paramFrameLoop_closed =
        loopClassZ2 R hRclosed :=
      loopClassZ2_congr_fun P.paramFrameLoop_closed hRclosed heq
    _ = loopClassZ2 (targetCoefficientLoop m)
          (targetCoefficientLoop_closed m) +
        loopClassZ2 Q.paramFrameLoop Q.paramFrameLoop_closed := by
      exact loopClassZ2_mul _ _ _ _ _
    _ = 0 + 1 := by
      rw [loopClassZ2_targetCoefficientLoop,
        StandardSaddle.target_paramFrameClass_eq_one]
    _ = 1 := by decide

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameLedger.cassini_zeroPair_frame_class_splice
statement:
theorem cassini_zeroPair_frame_class_splice (hm : 0 < m)
    (Vsource : TamedField (sourceFLS m hm))
    (Vtarget : TamedField (targetFLS m hm)) :
    loopClassZ2 (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vtarget).paramFrameLoop
        (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vtarget).paramFrameLoop_closed =
      loopClassZ2
          (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop
          (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed +
        loopClassZ2
          (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop
          (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed + 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [target_paramFrameClass_eq_one, sourceRight_paramFrameClass_eq_zero,
    sourceLeft_paramFrameClass_eq_zero]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameLedger.actual_orbitFrameClass_splice
statement:
theorem actual_orbitFrameClass_splice (hm : 0 < m)
    {Xbefore Xafter : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)}
    (Vbefore : TamedField Xbefore) (Vafter : TamedField Xafter)
    (O₁ O₂ : Vbefore.OrbitIndex) (Ohat : Vafter.OrbitIndex)
    (Vsource : TamedField (sourceFLS m hm))
    (Vtarget : TamedField (targetFLS m hm))
    (H₁ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop O₁)
      (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop)
    (H₂ : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop O₂)
      (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop)
    (Hhat : ContinuousMap.Homotopy (Vafter.orbitFrameLoop Ohat)
      (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vtarget).paramFrameLoop)
    (H₁_closed : ∀ s : I, H₁ (s, 0) = H₁ (s, 1))
    (H₂_closed : ∀ s : I, H₂ (s, 0) = H₂ (s, 1))
    (Hhat_closed : ∀ s : I, Hhat (s, 0) = Hhat (s, 1)) :
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
      Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + 1
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ =
      loopClassZ2
        (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop
        (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed :=
    loopClassZ2_congr (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop_closed O₁)
      (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed
      H₁ H₁_closed
  have h₂ : Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ =
      loopClassZ2
        (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop
        (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed :=
    loopClassZ2_congr (Vbefore.orbitFrameLoop_closed O₂)
      (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed
      H₂ H₂_closed
  have hhat : Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
      loopClassZ2 (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vtarget).paramFrameLoop
        (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vtarget).paramFrameLoop_closed :=
    loopClassZ2_congr (Vafter.orbitFrameLoop_closed Ohat)
      (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vtarget).paramFrameLoop_closed
      Hhat Hhat_closed
  calc
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
        loopClassZ2 (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vtarget).paramFrameLoop
          (targetSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vtarget).paramFrameLoop_closed := hhat
    _ = loopClassZ2
          (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop
          (sourceRightSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed +
        loopClassZ2
          (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop
          (sourceLeftSimpleClosedOrbitParam m hm Vsource).paramFrameLoop_closed + 1 :=
      cassini_zeroPair_frame_class_splice m hm Vsource Vtarget
    _ = Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + 1 := by
      rw [h₁, h₂]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameLedger.source_right_orbit_subset_range
statement:
theorem source_right_orbit_subset_range (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m hm)) :
    V.orbit (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m 0) ⊆
      Set.range (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hp := sourcePointRight_mem_source_fiber m hm 0
  have hxfiber := V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hx
  have hbase :
      0 < sourceOvalSign m hm (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m 0) := by
    simpa using StandardSaddle.sourceRootFirst_pos 0
  have hxpos : 0 < sourceOvalSign m hm x :=
    ((sourceOvalSign m hm).pos_iff_of_mem_orbit V hp hx).mp hbase
  rw [source_fiber_eq_range_union m hm] at hxfiber
  rcases hxfiber with hright | hleft
  · exact hright
  · rcases hleft with ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    have hr := StandardSaddle.sourceRootFirst_pos theta
    simp only [sourceOvalSign_apply_left] at hxpos
    nlinarith

    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m hm)) :

      Set.range (StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft m)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hp := sourcePointLeft_mem_source_fiber m hm 0
  have hsign := (sourceOvalSign m hm).pos_iff_of_mem_orbit V hp hx
  have hbaseNot :
      ¬0 < sourceOvalSign m hm (StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft m 0) := by
    have hr := StandardSaddle.sourceRootFirst_pos 0
    simp only [sourceOvalSign_apply_left]
    nlinarith
  have hxfiber := V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hx
  rw [source_fiber_eq_range_union m hm] at hxfiber
  rcases hxfiber with hright | hleft
  · rcases hright with ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    have hrightPos :
        0 < sourceOvalSign m hm
          (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m theta) := by
      simpa using StandardSaddle.sourceRootFirst_pos theta
    exact False.elim (hbaseNot (hsign.mpr hrightPos))
  · exact hleft

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameLedger.sourceRightOrbitIndex_ne_sourceLeftOrbitIndex
statement:
theorem sourceRightOrbitIndex_ne_sourceLeftOrbitIndex (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m hm)) :
    sourceRightOrbitIndex m hm V ≠ sourceLeftOrbitIndex m hm V
proof:
:= by
  intro hindex
  have hsets := congrArg (fun O : V.OrbitIndex => (O : Set E)) hindex
  change V.orbit (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m 0) =
    V.orbit (StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft m 0) at hsets
  rw [source_right_orbit_eq_range m hm V,
    source_left_orbit_eq_range m hm V] at hsets
  have hright : StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m 0 ∈
      Set.range (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m) := ⟨0, rfl⟩
  have hleft : StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m 0 ∈
      Set.range (StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft m) := by
    rw [← hsets]
    exact hright
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp (StandardSaddle.source_ranges_disjoint m)
    hright hleft

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameLedger.orbitIndex_eq_sourceRight_or_sourceLeft
statement:
theorem orbitIndex_eq_sourceRight_or_sourceLeft (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m hm)) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    O = sourceRightOrbitIndex m hm V ∨
      O = sourceLeftOrbitIndex m hm V
proof:
:= by
  have hp := V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  rw [source_fiber_eq_range_union m hm] at hp
  rcases hp with ⟨theta, htheta⟩ | ⟨theta, htheta⟩
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (O : Set E) = V.orbit (StandardSaddle.sourcePointRight m 0)
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O, ← htheta]
    exact V.orbit_eq_of_mem (sourcePointRight_mem_orbit m hm V theta)
  · right
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (O : Set E) = V.orbit (StandardSaddle.sourcePointLeft m 0)
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O, ← htheta]
    exact V.orbit_eq_of_mem (sourcePointLeft_mem_orbit m hm V theta)

theorem source_orbitIndex_card (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m hm)) : Fintype.card V.OrbitIndex = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.card_univ]
  have huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset V.OrbitIndex) =
      {sourceRightOrbitIndex m hm V, sourceLeftOrbitIndex m hm V} := by
    ext O
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton,
      true_iff]
    exact orbitIndex_eq_sourceRight_or_sourceLeft m hm V O
  rw [huniv]
  simp [sourceRightOrbitIndex_ne_sourceLeftOrbitIndex m hm V]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameLedger.sourceRight_orbitFrameClass_eq_zero

  rw [orbitIndex_eq_targetOrbitIndex m hm V O,
    V.orbitFrameClass_eq_fundamental]

    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  have hbase := V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit
    (targetPoint_mem_target_fiber m hm 0) hpoint

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniFrameLedger.source_positiveFrameLedger_eq_pair_zero
statement:
theorem source_positiveFrameLedger_eq_pair_zero (hm : 0 < m)
    (V : TamedField (sourceFLS m hm)) :
    (FiberSign.allPositive (sourceFLS m hm)).positiveFrameLedger V =
      [(0 : ZMod 2), 0]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L := (FiberSign.allPositive (sourceFLS m hm)).positiveFrameLedger V
  have hlen : L.length = 2 := by
    simp only [L, FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger,
      TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, List.length_ofFn]
    rw [Fintype.card_congr (allPositiveSelectedOrbitEquiv m V),
      source_orbitIndex_card m hm V]
  have hall : ∀ z ∈ L, z = (0 : ZMod 2) := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [L, FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger,
      TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, List.mem_ofFn] at hz
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact source_orbitFrameClass_eq_zero m hm V _
  calc
    L = List.replicate L.length 0 := List.eq_replicate_length.mpr hall
    _ = [(0 : ZMod 2), 0] := by rw [hlen]; rfl

  let L := (FiberSign.allPositive (targetFLS m hm)).positiveFrameLedger V
  have hlen : L.length = 1 := by

      TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, List.length_ofFn]
    rw [Fintype.card_congr (allPositiveSelectedOrbitEquiv m V),
      target_orbitIndex_card m hm V]
  have hall : ∀ z ∈ L, z = (1 : ZMod 2) := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [L, FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger,
      TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, List.mem_ofFn] at hz
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact target_orbitFrameClass_eq_one m hm V _
  calc
    L = List.replicate L.length 1 := List.eq_replicate_length.mpr hall
    _ = [(1 : ZMod 2)] := by rw [hlen]; rfl

      (V.backgroundTransport c₁ c₂ h₁ h₂) = [(0 : ZMod 2), 0]

name: Submission.TamedField.intrinsicOrbitCurve_eq_cases
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := (V.flow_eq_iff_sub_mem_zmultiples
    (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)
    ((u : ℝ) * V.orbitPeriod O)
    ((v : ℝ) * V.orbitPeriod O)).mp huv
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp hmem
  have hTpos : 0 < V.orbitPeriod O := V.orbitPeriod_pos O
  have huvInt : (u : ℝ) - (v : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) := by
    have hk' : (k : ℝ) * V.orbitPeriod O =
        (u : ℝ) * V.orbitPeriod O - (v : ℝ) * V.orbitPeriod O := by
      simpa [zsmul_eq_mul, orbitPeriod] using hk
    nlinarith
  rcases lt_trichotomy (u : ℝ) (v : ℝ) with huvlt | huveq | huvgt
  · right; left
    have hknegR : (k : ℝ) < 0 := by rw [← huvInt]; linarith
    have hkneg : k < 0 := by exact_mod_cast hknegR
    have hkge : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ k := by
      have hkgeR : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by
        rw [← huvInt]
        linarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
      exact_mod_cast hkgeR
    have hkval : k = -1 := by omega
    constructor
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change (u : ℝ) = 0
      have hd : (u : ℝ) - (v : ℝ) = -1 := by
        rw [huvInt, hkval]
        norm_num
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change (v : ℝ) = 1
      have hd : (u : ℝ) - (v : ℝ) = -1 := by
        rw [huvInt, hkval]
        norm_num
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
  · exact Or.inl (Subtype.ext huveq)
  · right; right
    have hkposR : (0 : ℝ) < (k : ℝ) := by rw [← huvInt]; linarith
    have hkpos : 0 < k := by exact_mod_cast hkposR
    have hkle : k ≤ 1 := by
      have hkleR : (k : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [← huvInt]
        linarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
      exact_mod_cast hkleR
    have hkval : k = 1 := by omega
    constructor
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change (u : ℝ) = 1
      have hd : (u : ℝ) - (v : ℝ) = 1 := by
        rw [huvInt, hkval]
        norm_num
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
    · apply Subtype.ext
      change (v : ℝ) = 0
      have hd : (u : ℝ) - (v : ℝ) = 1 := by
        rw [huvInt, hkval]
        norm_num
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]

name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_beforeArcBand
statement:
theorem productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_beforeArcBand
    {a : ℕ} (KB : ProductionMorseSaddleBeforeArcBandInputs a) :
    ProductionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies a
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y SX SY SC D t ht hpositive hindex
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  obtain ⟨Vpos⟩ := (D.shortAfterSlice t ht hb hbw).exists_tamedField
  obtain ⟨Vneg⟩ := (D.shortBeforeSlice t ht hb hbw).exists_tamedField
  have hdim : 3 ≤ a + 2 + 1 := by omega
  have hcircle := productionMorseSaddleChartCircleFrameClassOne a
    (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  constructor
  · intro Htop
    have hposEq :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      apply (D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw Vpos).injective
      rw [D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.positive]
      exact Htop.positive_eq
    have hnegNe :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg ≠
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      intro heq'
      apply Htop.negative_ne
      rw [← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.positive, heq']
    have hsplice : ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
        Vpos.orbitFrameClass
            ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
              (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
              (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
              (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) =
          Vneg.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) +
            Vneg.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) + 1 := by
      obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, harcs⟩ :=
        (KB SC D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos).1 hnegNe hposEq
      have hread := saddleBandOctagonReading_merge
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) hindex
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) hb
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)

        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
        (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg Vpos
        (D.bandTimeField t ht) hlab hnegNe F hprov
        (fun p x₀ dt hx₀ hx₀eq hdt =>
          D.exists_chartMap_connector_positive t ht hindex p x₀ dt hx₀ hx₀eq
            hdt)
        harcs.1 harcs.2
      have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass_of_signed
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) F
        (windingLoop_or_rev_of_saddleBandOctagonReading

      exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab,
        orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim F

            (hF.trans hcircle))⟩
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, hsp⟩ := hsplice
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg]
    cases e₁ <;> cases e₂ <;>
      first
        | exact absurd rfl hlab
        | exact hsp
        | (rw [hsp]; ring)
  · intro Htop
    have hnegEq :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      apply (D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw Vneg).injective
      rw [D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.positive]
      exact Htop.negative_eq
    have hposNe :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos ≠
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)

            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by

                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)

      obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, harcs⟩ :=

      have hread := saddleBandOctagonReading_split

        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
        (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg Vpos
        (D.bandTimeField t ht) hlab hposNe F hprov
        (fun p x₀ dt hx₀ hx₀eq hdt =>

        (windingLoop_or_rev_of_saddleBandOctagonReading
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hread)
      exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab,
        orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim F
          (F.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
            (hF.trans hcircle))⟩
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, hsp⟩ := hsplice
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos]
    cases e₁ <;> cases e₂ <;>
      first
        | exact absurd rfl hlab
        | exact hsp
        | (rw [hsp]; ring)

name: Submission.exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartHomotopy
statement:
theorem exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartHomotopy
    {a : ℕ} {C : FramedLevelCobordism (a + 2)}
    {center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2))}
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt C center} (Hs : M.FullRadiusSmooth)
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    {ρ : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (z : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2))))
    (h : C(I × I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)))
    (hnorm : ∀ q, ‖h q‖ < M.radius)
    (hne : ∀ q, h q ≠ 0)
    (hzero : ∀ u : I, M.localPoint (h (0, u)) = z u)
    (hone : ∀ u : I,
      h (1, u) = definiteCircleParam ρ (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)))
    (hclosed : ∀ w : I, h (w, 0) = h (w, 1)) :
    ∃ H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy z (T.definiteCircleCurve ρ hρ hρrad),
      (∀ q, Function.Surjective (spatialDeriv C.G (H q))) ∧
        ∀ w : I, H (w, 0) = H (w, 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous fun q : I × I => M.localPoint (h q) := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro q
    exact (Hs.differentiableAt _ (hnorm q)).continuousAt.comp
      h.continuous.continuousAt
  refine ⟨{ toFun := fun q => M.localPoint (h q)
            continuous_toFun := hcont
            map_zero_left := hzero
            map_one_left := fun u => ?_ }, fun q => ?_, fun w => ?_⟩
  · show M.localPoint (h (1, u)) = M.definiteCircle ρ (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))
    rw [hone u]
    rfl
  · exact M.localPoint_spatialDeriv_surjective_of_ne_zero (h q) (hnorm q) (hne q)
  · show M.localPoint (h (w, 0)) = M.localPoint (h (w, 1))
    rw [hclosed w]

name: Submission.exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartPolarLoop
statement:
theorem exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartPolarLoop
    {a : ℕ} {C : FramedLevelCobordism (a + 2)}
    {center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2))}
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := a + 2) C center} (Hs : M.FullRadiusSmooth)
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) (hrhorad : rho < T.radius)
    {z : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2)))}
    (P : FullChartPolarLoop M z) :
    ∃ H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy z (T.definiteCircleCurve rho hrho hrhorad),
      (∀ q, Function.Surjective (spatialDeriv C.G (H q))) ∧
        ∀ w : I, H (w, 0) = H (w, 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hrhoM : rho < M.radius := hrhorad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hpos : ∀ q : I × I,
      0 < (1 - (q.1 : ℝ)) * P.rad q.2 + (q.1 : ℝ) * rho := fun q =>
    lt_convexComb_of_lt q.1.2.1 q.1.2.2 (P.rad_pos q.2) hrho
  have hlt : ∀ q : I × I,
      (1 - (q.1 : ℝ)) * P.rad q.2 + (q.1 : ℝ) * rho < M.radius := fun q =>
    convexComb_lt_of_lt q.1.2.1 q.1.2.2 (P.rad_lt q.2) hrhoM
  refine exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartHomotopy Hs T hrho hrhorad z
    (chartPolarHomotopyMap P.rad P.ang rho) (fun q => ?_) (fun q => ?_)
    (fun u => ?_) (fun u => ?_) (fun w => ?_)
  · rw [chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply, norm_definiteCircleParam (hpos q).le]
    exact hlt q
  · rw [chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply]
    exact definiteCircleParam_ne_zero (hpos q).ne'
  · have hq : chartPolarHomotopyMap P.rad P.ang rho (0, u) =
        definiteCircleParam (P.rad u) (P.ang u) := by
      rw [chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply]
      norm_num
    rw [hq]
    exact P.chart u
  · rw [chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply]
    norm_num
  · rw [chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply, chartPolarHomotopyMap_apply]
    have hr : ((1 : I) : ℝ) = 1 := rfl
    have h0 : ((0 : I) : ℝ) = 0 := rfl
    simp only [hr, h0, mul_zero, mul_one, P.rad_closed, P.ang_turn]
    rw [show (1 - (w : ℝ)) * (P.ang 0 + 2 * Real.pi) + (w : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) =
        ((1 - (w : ℝ)) * P.ang 0 + (w : ℝ) * 0) + 2 * Real.pi from by ring,
      definiteCircleParam_add_two_pi, mul_zero]

name: Submission.exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartWindingLoop
statement:
theorem exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartWindingLoop
    {a : ℕ} {C : FramedLevelCobordism (a + 2)}
    {center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2))}
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := a + 2) C center} (Hs : M.FullRadiusSmooth)
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink)
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho) (hrhorad : rho < T.radius)

    ∃ H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy z (T.definiteCircleCurve rho hrho hrhorad),
      (∀ q, Function.Surjective (spatialDeriv C.G (H q))) ∧
        ∀ w : I, H (w, 0) = H (w, 1)
proof:

  exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartPolarLoop Hs T hrho hrhorad
    W.toFullChartPolarLoop

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.translateCobordism_flat
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  show C.cobordism.G (v - embedCLM (n + 1) w) = c
  apply h
  have hinit : initCLM (n + 1) (v - embedCLM (n + 1) w) =
      initCLM (n + 1) v - initCLM (n + 1) (embedCLM (n + 1) w) :=
    map_sub _ _ _
  have hie : initCLM (n + 1) (embedCLM (n + 1) w) = w := by
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext j
    show (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℝ) (WithLp.ofLp w) 0) j.castSucc = w j
    exact Fin.snoc_castSucc _ _ j
  rw [hinit, hie]
  have hdist : dist (initCLM (n + 1) v - w) p =
      dist (initCLM (n + 1) v) (p + w) := by
    rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    congr 1
    abel
  rwa [hdist]

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.translationConnector
statement:
theorem translationConnector {c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (A : FlatSignedConfiguration n c)

    SignedConnector A.sign (A.translate w).sign
proof:

    ((SmoothAmbientIsotopy.translation w).signedCobordism A.sign)
    A.sign (A.translate w).sign rfl ?_ (fun _ => rfl) ?_⟩
  · funext x
    show A.X.g ((SmoothAmbientIsotopy.translation w).inverse 1 x) =
      A.X.g (x - w)
    rw [SmoothAmbientIsotopy.translation_inverse_endpoint]
  · intro x
    show A.sign ((SmoothAmbientIsotopy.translation w).inverse 1 x) =
      A.sign (x - w)
    rw [SmoothAmbientIsotopy.translation_inverse_endpoint]

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.juxtapose_sign_eq_on_fiber
statement:
theorem juxtapose_sign_eq_on_fiber
    {X₁ X₂ : FramedLevelSet n} (S₁ : FiberSign X₁) (S₂ : FiberSign X₂)
    {c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    {p₁ p₂ q₁ q₂ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} {R₁ R₂ Q₁ Q₂ : ℝ}
    (h₁ : X₁.FlatOutside c p₁ R₁) (h₂ : X₂.FlatOutside c p₂ R₂)
    (hsep : R₁ + R₂ < dist p₁ p₂)
    (h₁' : X₁.FlatOutside c q₁ Q₁) (h₂' : X₂.FlatOutside c q₂ Q₂)
    (hsep' : Q₁ + Q₂ < dist q₁ q₂)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hx : x ∈ X₁.fiber ∪ X₂.fiber) :
    S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep x =
      S₁.juxtapose S₂ hc h₁' h₂' hsep' x
proof:
:= by
  rcases hx with hx | hx
  · rw [FiberSign.juxtapose_apply_left S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep
        (Metric.mem_ball.mp (h₁.fiber_subset_ball hc hx)).le,
      FiberSign.juxtapose_apply_left S₁ S₂ hc h₁' h₂' hsep'
        (Metric.mem_ball.mp (h₁'.fiber_subset_ball hc hx)).le]
  · rw [FiberSign.juxtapose_apply_right S₁ S₂ hc h₁ h₂ hsep
        (Metric.mem_ball.mp (h₂.fiber_subset_ball hc hx)).le,
      FiberSign.juxtapose_apply_right S₁ S₂ hc h₁' h₂' hsep'
        (Metric.mem_ball.mp (h₂'.fiber_subset_ball hc hx)).le]

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.Killable.cons
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := FlatSignedConfiguration.placeAfter A p with hPdef
  have hPkill : Killable hc P := by
    rw [hPdef]
    exact hp.translate _
  obtain ⟨Cp, hCp⟩ := hPkill
  obtain ⟨CA, hCA⟩ := hA
  have hdist : dist A.center P.center = A.radius + p.radius + 1 :=
    FlatSignedConfiguration.dist_center_placeAfter A p
  have hPrad : P.radius = p.radius := rfl
  
  have hsep₂ : A.radius + (P.radius + 1 / 2) < dist A.center P.center := by
    rw [hdist, hPrad]
    linarith
  
  have hreflFlat :
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.refl A.sign).SpatialFlatOutside
        c A.center A.radius :=
    SignedFramedLevelCobordism.spatialFlatOutside_refl A.sign A.flatOutside
  set Cext := (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.refl A.sign).juxtapose Cp hc
    hreflFlat hCp hsep₂ with hCext
  have hCextFlat := spatialFlatOutside_juxtapose hc hreflFlat hCp hsep₂
  
  have hconsFlat := (FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc A p).flatOutside
  have hstartSign : ∀ x ∈ (A.X.juxtapose P.X hc
        hreflFlat.flatOutside_source hCp.flatOutside_source hsep₂).fiber,
      (0 < (FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc A p).sign x ↔
        0 < (A.sign.juxtapose P.sign hc
          hreflFlat.flatOutside_source hCp.flatOutside_source hsep₂) x) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose] at hx
    show 0 < (A.sign.juxtapose P.sign hc A.flatOutside P.flatOutside
        (FlatSignedConfiguration.separated_placeAfter A p)) x ↔
      0 < (A.sign.juxtapose P.sign hc hreflFlat.flatOutside_source
        hCp.flatOutside_source hsep₂) x
    rw [juxtapose_sign_eq_on_fiber A.sign P.sign hc
      A.flatOutside P.flatOutside
      (FlatSignedConfiguration.separated_placeAfter A p)
      hreflFlat.flatOutside_source hCp.flatOutside_source hsep₂ hx]
  set Cstart := gEqCobordism (rfl :
      (FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc A p).X.g =
        (A.X.juxtapose P.X hc hreflFlat.flatOutside_source
          hCp.flatOutside_source hsep₂).g)
    (FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc A p).sign
    (A.sign.juxtapose P.sign hc
      hreflFlat.flatOutside_source hCp.flatOutside_source hsep₂)
    hstartSign with hCstart
  have hCstartFlat : Cstart.SpatialFlatOutside c
      (FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc A p).center
      (FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc A p).radius :=
    gEqCobordism_flat hconsFlat
  
  have hgend : (A.X.juxtapose
      (FlatSignedConfiguration.empty c hc).X hc
      hreflFlat.flatOutside_target hCp.flatOutside_target hsep₂).g =
      A.X.g := by
    funext v
    show A.X.g v + c - c = A.X.g v
    abel
  have hendSign : ∀ x ∈ A.X.fiber,
      (0 < (A.sign.juxtapose (FlatSignedConfiguration.empty c hc).sign hc
        hreflFlat.flatOutside_target hCp.flatOutside_target hsep₂) x ↔
        0 < A.sign x) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [FiberSign.juxtapose_apply_left A.sign _ hc
      hreflFlat.flatOutside_target hCp.flatOutside_target hsep₂
      (Metric.mem_ball.mp (A.flatOutside.fiber_subset_ball hc hx)).le]
  set Cend := gEqCobordism hgend
    (A.sign.juxtapose (FlatSignedConfiguration.empty c hc).sign hc
      hreflFlat.flatOutside_target hCp.flatOutside_target hsep₂)
    A.sign hendSign with hCend
  have hjuxtFlat : (A.X.juxtapose (FlatSignedConfiguration.empty c hc).X hc
      hreflFlat.flatOutside_target hCp.flatOutside_target
      hsep₂).FlatOutside c A.center A.radius := by
    intro v hv
    show A.X.g v + c - c = c
    rw [A.flatOutside v hv]
    abel
  have hCendFlat : Cend.SpatialFlatOutside c A.center A.radius :=
    gEqCobordism_flat hjuxtFlat
  
  refine ⟨Cstart.trans (Cext.trans (Cend.trans CA)), ?_⟩
  have h34 := spatialFlatOutside_trans hCendFlat hCA
  have h234 := spatialFlatOutside_trans hCextFlat h34
  have hCstartFlat' : Cstart.SpatialFlatOutside c A.center
      (dist A.center P.center + P.radius) := hCstartFlat
  have h1234 := spatialFlatOutside_trans hCstartFlat' h234
  have hcenter : (FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc A p).center = A.center :=
    rfl
  have hradius : (FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc A p).radius =
      dist A.center P.center + P.radius :=
    rfl
  have hgoal : (Cstart.trans (Cext.trans (Cend.trans CA))).SpatialFlatOutside
      c A.center
      (max (dist A.center P.center + P.radius)
        (max (max A.radius (dist A.center P.center + (P.radius + 1 / 2)))
          (max A.radius (A.radius + 1 / 2)))) := h1234
  have hbound : max (dist A.center P.center + P.radius)
      (max (max A.radius (dist A.center P.center + (P.radius + 1 / 2)))
        (max A.radius (A.radius + 1 / 2))) ≤
      (FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc A p).radius + 1 / 2 := by
    rw [hradius, hdist, hPrad]
    have hp0 := p.radius_nonneg
    have hA0 := A.radius_nonneg
    apply max_le
    · linarith
    · apply max_le
      · apply max_le
        · linarith
        · linarith
      · apply max_le
        · linarith
        · linarith
  rw [hcenter]
  intro v hv
  apply hgoal
  have := hbound
  linarith

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.killable_assembleFrom
statement:
theorem killable_assembleFrom {c : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)} (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (B : FlatSignedConfiguration n c)
    (l : List (FlatSignedConfiguration n c))
    (hB : Killable hc B) (hl : ∀ q ∈ l, Killable hc q) :
    Killable hc (FlatSignedConfiguration.assembleFrom hc B l)
proof:
:= by
  induction l using List.reverseRecOn with
  | nil => exact hB
  | append_singleton t q ih =>
      have hfold : FlatSignedConfiguration.assembleFrom hc B (t ++ [q]) =
          FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc
            (FlatSignedConfiguration.assembleFrom hc B t) q := by
        rw [FlatSignedConfiguration.assembleFrom, List.foldl_append]
        rfl
      rw [hfold]
      refine Killable.cons ?_ (hl q (by simp))
      exact ih fun r hr => hl r (by simp [hr])

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.sourceLevelMap_last_ge_one
statement:
theorem sourceLevelMap_last_ge_one (m : ℕ)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))) :
    1 ≤ CompactBirth.levelMap (m + 1) (-1) x (Fin.last (m + 1))
proof:
:= by

  have h1 := CompactBirth.cutoff_nonneg x
  have h2 := CompactBirth.cutoff_le_one x
  have h3 : 0 ≤ StandardBirth.radialSq (m + 1) x := by
