name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.ghost_interp_ne_zero
statement:
theorem ghost_interp_ne_zero (m : ℕ) {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))) :
    (1 - s) • CompactBirth.levelMap (m + 1) (-1) x +
      s • ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have hlast := congrArg (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) =>
    q (Fin.last (m + 1))) h
  simp only [PiLp.add_apply, PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    PiLp.zero_apply] at hlast
  have hbg : ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m
      (Fin.last (m + 1)) = 1 := CompactBirth.background_apply_last (m + 1)
  rw [hbg] at hlast
  have hge := sourceLevelMap_last_ge_one m x
  nlinarith

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.sourceFLS_fiber_eq_empty
statement:
theorem sourceFLS_fiber_eq_empty (m : ℕ) :
    (CompactBirth.sourceFLS (m + 1)).fiber = (∅ : Set _)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [Set.mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false]
  intro hx
  have hx' : CompactBirth.levelMap (m + 1) (-1) x = 0 := hx
  have hlast := congrArg (fun q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) =>
    q (Fin.last (m + 1))) hx'
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hlast
  have hge := sourceLevelMap_last_ge_one m x
  rw [hlast] at hge
  norm_num at hge

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.ghostHomotopy_flat
statement:
theorem ghostHomotopy_flat (m : ℕ)
    (S : FiberSign (CompactBirth.sourceFLS (m + 1))) :
    ((ghostHomotopy m).signedCobordism S).SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 2
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  show (1 - normRamp (vertC v)) •
      CompactBirth.levelMap (m + 1) (-1) (initCLM (m + 2 + 1) v) +
    normRamp (vertC v) •
      ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m =
    ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m
  have hsrc : (CompactBirth.sourceFLS (m + 1)).FlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 2 :=
    (CompactBirth.cobordism_spatialFlatOutside (m + 1)).flatOutside_X₀
  have hval : CompactBirth.levelMap (m + 1) (-1) (initCLM (m + 2 + 1) v) =
      ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m :=
    hsrc _ hv
  rw [hval, ← add_smul, sub_add_cancel, one_smul]

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.killable_of_chain
statement:
theorem killable_of_chain (m : ℕ)
    {A : FlatSignedConfiguration (m + 2)
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)}
    (hcenter : A.center = 0) (hradius : A.radius = 2)
    (h : ∃ C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism A.sign
        (CompactBirth.targetSign (m + 1)),
      C.SpatialFlatOutside
        (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 (5 / 2)) :
    Killable (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1)) A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h
  have hdeath := CompactBirth.signedDeathCobordism_spatialFlatOutside (m + 1)
  have hghost := ghostHomotopy_flat m (CompactBirth.sourceSign (m + 1))
  have hbgflat : (FlatSignedConfiguration.backgroundFLS
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)
      (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1))).FlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 0 :=
    fun v _ => rfl
  have hvac : ∀ x ∈ (FlatSignedConfiguration.backgroundFLS
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)
      (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1))).fiber,
      (0 < (CompactBirth.sourceSign (m + 1)).restrict
        (ghostHomotopy m).fiber_subset x ↔
        0 < (FlatSignedConfiguration.empty
          (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)
          (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1))).sign x) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [backgroundFLS_fiber_eq_empty] at hx
    exact absurd hx (Set.notMem_empty x)
  set Ci := signInterpolationCobordism
    ((CompactBirth.sourceSign (m + 1)).restrict (ghostHomotopy m).fiber_subset)
    (FlatSignedConfiguration.empty
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)
      (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1))).sign hvac with hCi
  have hCiflat : Ci.SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 0 :=
    fun v hv => hbgflat _ hv
  refine ⟨C.trans ((CompactBirth.signedDeathCobordism (m + 1)).trans
    (((ghostHomotopy m).signedCobordism
      (CompactBirth.sourceSign (m + 1))).trans Ci)), ?_⟩
  have h34 := spatialFlatOutside_trans hghost hCiflat
  have h234 := spatialFlatOutside_trans hdeath h34
  have h1234 := spatialFlatOutside_trans hC h234
  rw [hcenter, hradius]
  apply spatialFlatOutside_mono_radius h1234
  apply max_le
  · norm_num
  · apply max_le
    · norm_num
    · apply max_le <;> norm_num

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.killable_of_chain_neg
statement:
theorem killable_of_chain_neg (m : ℕ)
    {A : FlatSignedConfiguration (m + 2)
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)}
    (hcenter : A.center = 0) (hradius : A.radius = 2)
    (h : ∃ C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism A.sign
        (CompactBirth.targetSign (m + 1)).neg,
      C.SpatialFlatOutside
        (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 (5 / 2)) :
    Killable (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1)) A
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := h
  have hdeath : ((CompactBirth.signedDeathCobordism (m + 1)).neg).SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 2 :=
    spatialFlatOutside_neg
      (CompactBirth.signedDeathCobordism_spatialFlatOutside (m + 1))
  have hghost := ghostHomotopy_flat m (CompactBirth.sourceSign (m + 1)).neg
  have hbgflat : (FlatSignedConfiguration.backgroundFLS
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)
      (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1))).FlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 0 :=
    fun v _ => rfl
  have hvac : ∀ x ∈ (FlatSignedConfiguration.backgroundFLS
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)
      (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1))).fiber,
      (0 < (CompactBirth.sourceSign (m + 1)).neg.restrict
        (ghostHomotopy m).fiber_subset x ↔
        0 < (FlatSignedConfiguration.empty
          (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)
          (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1))).sign x) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [backgroundFLS_fiber_eq_empty] at hx
    exact absurd hx (Set.notMem_empty x)
  set Ci := signInterpolationCobordism
    ((CompactBirth.sourceSign (m + 1)).neg.restrict
      (ghostHomotopy m).fiber_subset)
    (FlatSignedConfiguration.empty
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m)
      (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (m + 1))).sign hvac with hCi
  have hCiflat : Ci.SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground m) 0 0 :=
    fun v hv => hbgflat _ hv
  refine ⟨C.trans (((CompactBirth.signedDeathCobordism (m + 1)).neg).trans
    (((ghostHomotopy m).signedCobordism
      (CompactBirth.sourceSign (m + 1)).neg).trans Ci)), ?_⟩
  have h34 := spatialFlatOutside_trans hghost hCiflat
  have h234 := spatialFlatOutside_trans hdeath h34
  have h1234 := spatialFlatOutside_trans hC h234
  rw [hcenter, hradius]
  apply spatialFlatOutside_mono_radius h1234
  apply max_le
  · norm_num
  · apply max_le
    · norm_num
    · apply max_le <;> norm_num

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.killable_onePos
statement:
theorem killable_onePos (k : ℕ) (hm : 0 < k + 1)
    (D : PieceKillInput (k + 1) hm) :
    Killable (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply killable_of_chain (k + 1) rfl rfl
  exact D.oneKill

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.killable_oneNeg
statement:
theorem killable_oneNeg (k : ℕ) (hm : 0 < k + 1)
    (D : PieceKillInput (k + 1) hm) :
    Killable (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1))
proof:
:= by
  apply killable_of_chain_neg (k + 1) rfl rfl
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := D.oneKill
  exact ⟨retype C.neg (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1)).sign
    (CompactBirth.targetSign (k + 2)).neg rfl rfl (fun _ => rfl)
    (fun _ => rfl), retype_flat (spatialFlatOutside_neg hC)⟩

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.killable_zeroPairPos
statement:
theorem killable_zeroPairPos (k : ℕ) (hm : 0 < k + 1)
    (D : PieceKillInput (k + 1) hm) :
    Killable (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k)
proof:
:= by
  apply killable_of_chain (k + 1) rfl rfl
  obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := D.saddleTargetKill
  set Cz := retype
    (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel (k + 1) hm).cobordism
    (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k).sign
    (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel
      (k + 1) hm).target.sign
    rfl rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) with hCzdef
  refine ⟨Cz.trans C', ?_⟩
  have hZflat : (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel
      (k + 1) hm).cobordism.SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground (k + 1)) 0 2 :=
    (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel (k + 1) hm).flatOutside
  have hCzflat : Cz.SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground (k + 1)) 0 2 :=
    retype_flat hZflat
  have h := spatialFlatOutside_trans hCzflat hC'
  apply spatialFlatOutside_mono_radius h
  apply max_le <;> norm_num

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.killable_zeroPairNeg
statement:
theorem killable_zeroPairNeg (k : ℕ) (hm : 0 < k + 1)
    (D : PieceKillInput (k + 1) hm) :
    Killable (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k)
proof:
:= by
  apply killable_of_chain_neg (k + 1) rfl rfl
  obtain ⟨C', hC'⟩ := D.saddleTargetKill
  set Cz := retype
    ((CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel
      (k + 1) hm).cobordism.trans C').neg
    (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k).sign
    (CompactBirth.targetSign (k + 2)).neg
    rfl rfl (fun _ => rfl) (fun _ => rfl) with hCzdef
  refine ⟨Cz, ?_⟩
  have hZflat : (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel
      (k + 1) hm).cobordism.SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground (k + 1)) 0 2 :=
    (CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel (k + 1) hm).flatOutside
  have h := spatialFlatOutside_trans hZflat hC'
  have h' := spatialFlatOutside_mono_radius h
    (by apply max_le <;> norm_num :
      max 2 (5 / 2) ≤ (5 / 2 : ℝ))
  have hCzflat : Cz.SpatialFlatOutside
      (ConcreteConfigurationMorseReduction.compactBackground (k + 1)) 0
      (5 / 2) :=
    retype_flat (spatialFlatOutside_neg h')
  exact hCzflat

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.connector_cons_of_killable
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set P := FlatSignedConfiguration.placeAfter F s with hPdef
  obtain ⟨CF, hCF⟩ := hF
  have hdist : dist F.center P.center = F.radius + s.radius + 1 :=
    FlatSignedConfiguration.dist_center_placeAfter F s
  have hPrad : P.radius = s.radius := rfl
  have hsep : (F.radius + 1 / 2) + P.radius < dist F.center P.center := by
    rw [hdist, hPrad]
    linarith
  have hreflFlat :
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.refl P.sign).SpatialFlatOutside
        c P.center P.radius :=
    SignedFramedLevelCobordism.spatialFlatOutside_refl P.sign P.flatOutside
  set Cext := CF.juxtapose (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.refl P.sign) hc
    hCF hreflFlat hsep with hCext
  have hstart : SignedConnector (FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc F s).sign
      (F.sign.juxtapose P.sign hc hCF.flatOutside_source
        hreflFlat.flatOutside_source hsep) := by
    apply gEqConnector
      (show (FlatSignedConfiguration.cons hc F s).X.g =
        (F.X.juxtapose P.X hc hCF.flatOutside_source
          hreflFlat.flatOutside_source hsep).g from rfl)
    intro x hx
    rw [FramedLevelSet.fiber_juxtapose] at hx
    show 0 < (F.sign.juxtapose P.sign hc F.flatOutside P.flatOutside
        (FlatSignedConfiguration.separated_placeAfter F s)) x ↔
      0 < (F.sign.juxtapose P.sign hc hCF.flatOutside_source
        hreflFlat.flatOutside_source hsep) x
    rw [juxtapose_sign_eq_on_fiber F.sign P.sign hc
      F.flatOutside P.flatOutside
      (FlatSignedConfiguration.separated_placeAfter F s)
      hCF.flatOutside_source hreflFlat.flatOutside_source hsep hx]
  have hgexit : ((FlatSignedConfiguration.empty c hc).X.juxtapose P.X hc
      hCF.flatOutside_target hreflFlat.flatOutside_target hsep).g =
      P.X.g := by
    funext v
    show c + P.X.g v - c = P.X.g v
    abel
  have hexit : SignedConnector
      ((FlatSignedConfiguration.empty c hc).sign.juxtapose P.sign hc
        hCF.flatOutside_target hreflFlat.flatOutside_target hsep)
      P.sign := by
    apply gEqConnector hgexit
    intro x hx
    rw [FiberSign.juxtapose_apply_right _ _ hc
      hCF.flatOutside_target hreflFlat.flatOutside_target hsep
      (Metric.mem_ball.mp (P.flatOutside.fiber_subset_ball hc hx)).le]
  have hback : SignedConnector P.sign s.sign :=
    SignedConnector.symm (translationConnector s _)
  exact SignedConnector.trans hstart
    (SignedConnector.trans ⟨Cext⟩ (SignedConnector.trans hexit hback))

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.standardSucc_to_diagonal
statement:
theorem standardSucc_to_diagonal (k : ℕ) (hm : 0 < k + 1)
    (D : PieceKillInput (k + 1) hm) (P N : MorseLedger) :
    SignedConnector
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.flatConfigOfLedgersSucc k P N).sign
      (DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard (k + 1) P.delta).sign
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hkill : ∀ q ∈ (List.replicate (P.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (P.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k)),
      Killable (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2)) q := by
    intro q hq
    simp only [List.mem_append, List.mem_replicate] at hq
    rcases hq with ((⟨-, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, rfl⟩) | ⟨-, rfl⟩) | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact killable_onePos k hm D
    · exact killable_oneNeg k hm D
    · exact killable_zeroPairPos k hm D
    · exact killable_zeroPairNeg k hm D
  have hdelta : P.delta = ((P.count (0 : ZMod 2) % 2 : ℕ) : ZMod 2) :=
    (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.delta_eq_count_zero P).trans
      (ZMod.natCast_mod _ 2).symm
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (P.count (0 : ZMod 2)) with he | he
  · 
    have hd0 : P.delta = 0 := by
      rw [hdelta, he]
      simp
    have hstd : DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard (k + 1) P.delta =
        DiagonalStandardConfiguration.zero (k + 1) := by
      rw [hd0]
      unfold DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard
      rw [if_pos rfl]
    rw [hstd]
    have hlist : StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.pieces k P N =
        List.replicate (P.count 1)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos (k + 1)) ++
        List.replicate (N.count 1)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1)) ++
        List.replicate (P.count 0 / 2)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k) ++
        List.replicate (N.count 0 / 2)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k) := by
      show _ ++ List.replicate (P.count 0 % 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k) = _
      rw [he]
      simp
    show SignedConnector
      (FlatSignedConfiguration.assemble _
        (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.pieces k P N)).sign
      (DiagonalStandardConfiguration.zero (k + 1)).sign
    rw [hlist]
    cases hL : List.replicate (P.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (P.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k) with
      | nil => exact SignedConnector.refl _
      | cons Ahead t =>
        have hK := killable_assembleFrom
          (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2)) Ahead t
          (hkill Ahead (by rw [hL]; simp))
          (fun r hr => hkill r (by rw [hL]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr))
        obtain ⟨C, -⟩ := hK
        exact ⟨C⟩
  · 
    have hd1 : P.delta = 1 := by
      rw [hdelta, he]
      simp
    have hstd : DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard (k + 1) P.delta =
        DiagonalStandardConfiguration.one (k + 1) := by
      rw [hd1]
      unfold DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard
      rw [if_neg (by decide : (1 : ZMod 2) ≠ 0)]
    rw [hstd]
    have hsplitSrc : StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.flatConfigOfLedgers
        (k + 1) hm [(0 : ZMod 2)] [(0 : ZMod 2)] =
        StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k := by
      show StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.flatConfigOfLedgersSucc k
        [(0 : ZMod 2)] [(0 : ZMod 2)] = _
      have h01 : ([(0 : ZMod 2)]).count (1 : ZMod 2) = 0 := by decide
      have h00 : ([(0 : ZMod 2)]).count (0 : ZMod 2) = 1 := by decide
      show FlatSignedConfiguration.assemble _ _
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.pieces k
          [(0 : ZMod 2)] [(0 : ZMod 2)]) = _
      rw [StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.pieces, h01, h00]
      norm_num
    have hsplit : SignedConnector
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k).sign
        (DiagonalStandardConfiguration.one (k + 1)).sign := by
      have h := D.splitToOne
      rwa [hsplitSrc] at h
    have hlist : StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.pieces k P N =
        (List.replicate (P.count 1)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos (k + 1)) ++
        List.replicate (N.count 1)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1)) ++
        List.replicate (P.count 0 / 2)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k) ++
        List.replicate (N.count 0 / 2)
          (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k)) ++
        [StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k] := by
      show _ ++ List.replicate (P.count 0 % 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k) = _
      rw [he]
      simp
    show SignedConnector
      (FlatSignedConfiguration.assemble _
        (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.pieces k P N)).sign
      (DiagonalStandardConfiguration.one (k + 1)).sign
    rw [hlist]
    cases hL : List.replicate (P.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.onePos (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 1)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.oneNeg (k + 1)) ++
      List.replicate (P.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairPos k) ++
      List.replicate (N.count 0 / 2)
        (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroPairNeg k) with
      | nil =>
        simp only [List.nil_append]
        exact hsplit
      | cons Ahead t =>
        have hfold : FlatSignedConfiguration.assemble _
            (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
            ((Ahead :: t) ++ [StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k]) =
            FlatSignedConfiguration.cons
              (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2))
              (FlatSignedConfiguration.assembleFrom
                (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2)) Ahead t)
              (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k) := by
          show FlatSignedConfiguration.assembleFrom _ Ahead
            (t ++ [StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.zeroSplit k]) = _
          rw [FlatSignedConfiguration.assembleFrom, List.foldl_append]
          rfl
        rw [hfold]
        have hKF := killable_assembleFrom
          (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2)) Ahead t
          (hkill Ahead (by rw [hL]; simp))
          (fun r hr => hkill r (by rw [hL]; exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hr))
        exact SignedConnector.trans
          (connector_cons_of_killable
            (CompactBirth.background_ne_zero (k + 2)) hKF)
          hsplit

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.nonempty_standard_to_diagonal
statement:
theorem nonempty_standard_to_diagonal (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m)
    (D : PieceKillInput m hm) (P N : MorseLedger) :
    SignedConnector
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.flatConfigOfLedgers m hm P N).sign
      (DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard m P.delta).sign
proof:
:=
  match m, hm, D with
  | (k + 1), hm, D => standardSucc_to_diagonal k hm D P N

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.finish_connector
statement:
theorem finish_connector (m : ℕ) (hm : 0 < m) (D : PieceKillInput m hm)
    (P N : MorseLedger) :
    SignedConnector
      (ConcreteConfigurationBridgeCobordismTrace.standardState m hm
        (MorseLedger.canonical P.delta) (MorseLedger.canonical N.delta)).sign
      (DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard m P.delta).sign
proof:
:= by
  have h := nonempty_standard_to_diagonal m hm D
    (MorseLedger.canonical P.delta) (MorseLedger.canonical N.delta)
  rw [MorseLedger.delta_canonical] at h
  exact h

name: Submission.StandardCircleMoveKit.nonempty_bridgeData_of_entry
statement:
theorem nonempty_bridgeData_of_entry {m : ℕ} {z : StableSpherePi (m + 2)}
    {B : BridgeData (m + 2) z} (hm : 0 < m) (D : PieceKillInput m hm)
    (entry : SignedConnector B.fiberSign
      (StandardCircleLedgerConfiguration.flatConfigOfLedgers m hm
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign)
        (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.negativeLedger m B.fiberSign)).sign) :
    Nonempty (ConcreteConfigurationBridgeCobordismTrace.Data m B)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  exact
    { zeroPairSaddle :=
        CompactHopfPairPantsFrameLedger.zeroPairSaddleModel m hm
      plan :=
        { source := DiagonalStandardConfiguration.standard m
            (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign).delta
          trace :=
            ConcreteConfigurationBridgeCobordismTrace.CobordismTrace.refl _ }
      initial := SignedConnector.trans entry
        (nonempty_standard_to_diagonal m hm D
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.positiveLedger m B.fiberSign)
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.negativeLedger m B.fiberSign)) }

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.pos_sliceSign_spacePart_iff
statement:
theorem pos_sliceSign_spacePart_iff
    (D : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} {t : ℝ}
    (ht : sliceRegular D.cobordism.G t) (hvt : tcoord v = t) :
    0 < D v ↔ 0 < D.sliceSign t ht (spacePart v)
proof:
:= by
  change 0 < D v ↔ 0 < D (cobSpaceTime (spacePart v) t)
  rw [← hvt, spaceTime_spacePart]

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.criticalMinimumSimpleClosedOrbitParamAt_p
statement:
@[simp] theorem criticalMinimumSimpleClosedOrbitParamAt_p
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    (r : ℝ) (hrle : r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius)
    (hinj : Set.InjOn (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp) (ball (0 : E₂) r))
    (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < r)
    (hreg : sliceRegular
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C.cobordism).G
      (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + a ^ 2))
    (V : TamedField (R.criticalMinimumPositiveSlice p hp a hreg)) :
    (R.criticalMinimumSimpleClosedOrbitParamAt p hp hindex r hrle hinj
      a ha har hreg V).p =
      R.criticalDefiniteSpatialCircle p hp a ha (har.trans_le hrle) 0

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.exists_radius_criticalDefiniteCircle_positive
statement:
theorem exists_radius_criticalDefiniteCircle_positive
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hcenter : 0 <
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C)
        (R.criticalCenter p)) :
    ∃ r > 0, r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius ∧
      ∀ (a theta : ℝ), 0 ≤ a → a < r →
        0 < (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C)
          (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a theta)
proof:
:= by
  let L := R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C
  let f : E₂ → ℝ := fun u => L (R.criticalSurfaceParam p hp u)
  have hf : ContinuousAt f 0 :=
    L.continuous.continuousAt.comp
      (R.criticalSurfaceParam_contDiffAt_zero p hp).continuousAt
  have hfzero : 0 < f 0 := by
    simpa [f, L] using hcenter
  have hpositive : {u : E₂ | 0 < f u} ∈ nhds 0 :=
    hf (Ioi_mem_nhds hfzero)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hpositive
  let r := min ε (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hε (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius_pos
  refine ⟨r, hr, min_le_right _ _, ?_⟩
  intro a theta ha har
  have haε : a < ε := har.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hu : definiteCircleParam a theta ∈ ball (0 : E₂) ε := by
    rw [mem_ball, dist_zero_right, norm_definiteCircleParam ha]
    exact haε
  have hfu : 0 < f (definiteCircleParam a theta) := hball hu
  simpa [f, L, criticalDefiniteCircle] using hfu

name: Submission.ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation.exists_radius_for_criticalMinimumPositiveSimpleClosedOrbitParam
statement:
theorem exists_radius_for_criticalMinimumPositiveSimpleClosedOrbitParam
    (R : ExactFiniteMorseJetInstallation G)
    (p : Σ _ : ι, E₂) (hp : p ∈ G.criticalPoints)
    (hindex : (G.localMorseNormalForm p hp).index = .minimum)
    (hcenter : 0 <
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C)
        (R.criticalCenter p)) :
    ∃ r > 0, r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius ∧
      ∀ (a : ℝ) (ha : 0 < a) (har : a < r)
        (hreg : sliceRegular
          (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullback C.cobordism).G
          (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + a ^ 2))
        (V : TamedField (R.criticalMinimumPositiveSlice p hp a hreg)),
        Nonempty {P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam
          (R.criticalMinimumPositiveSlice p hp a hreg) V //
          0 < (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C).sliceSign
            (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + a ^ 2) hreg P.p}
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨rInj, hrInj, hrInjle, hinj⟩ :=
    R.exists_criticalSurfaceParam_injOn_radius p hp
  obtain ⟨rSign, hrSign, _hrSignle, hsign⟩ :=
    R.exists_radius_criticalDefiniteCircle_positive p hp hcenter
  let r := min rInj rSign
  have hr : 0 < r := lt_min hrInj hrSign
  have hrle : r ≤ (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius :=
    (min_le_left rInj rSign).trans hrInjle
  refine ⟨r, hr, hrle, ?_⟩
  intro a ha har hreg V
  have harInj : a < rInj := har.trans_le (min_le_left rInj rSign)
  have harSign : a < rSign := har.trans_le (min_le_right rInj rSign)
  have hrad : a < (R.criticalModelShrink p hp).radius :=
    harInj.trans_le hrInjle
  let P := R.criticalMinimumSimpleClosedOrbitParamAt p hp hindex
    rInj hrInjle hinj a ha harInj hreg V
  have hambient : 0 <
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C)
        (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a 0) :=
    hsign a 0 ha.le harSign
  have htime : tcoord (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a 0) =
      G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + a ^ 2 :=
    R.criticalMinimumCircle_time p hp hindex ha.le hrad
  have hslice : 0 <
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C).sliceSign
        (G.localSeparatedTime p p.2 + a ^ 2) hreg
        (spacePart (R.criticalDefiniteCircle p hp a 0)) :=
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.pos_sliceSign_spacePart_iff
      (R.amplitude.toVerticalAmplitude.pullbackSigned C) hreg htime).mp hambient
  refine ⟨⟨P, ?_⟩⟩
  simpa [P, criticalMinimumSimpleClosedOrbitParamAt,
    criticalDefiniteSpatialCircle, criticalDefiniteCircleCurve,
    criticalDefiniteCircle,
    definiteCircleParamCurve] using hslice

name: Submission.pi_succ_sphere_n_mulEquiv_zmod_two_of_uniformProductionSupplies
statement:
theorem pi_succ_sphere_n_mulEquiv_zmod_two_of_uniformProductionSupplies
    (Ksaddle : ∀ a : ℕ, 0 < a → ProductionMorseSaddleSupplies a)
    (Kbridge : ∀ (a : ℕ), 0 < a → ∀ {z : StableSpherePi (a + 2)}
      (B : BridgeData (a + 2) z),
        Nonempty (ConcreteConfigurationBridgeCobordismTrace.Data a B))
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (x : Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) :
    Nonempty
      (HomotopyGroup.Pi (n + 1)
          (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) 1) x ≃*
        Multiplicative (ZMod 2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ : ∃ a : ℕ, n = a + 2 := ⟨n - 2, by omega⟩
  have ha : 0 < a := by omega
  exact pi_succ_sphere_n_mulEquiv_zmod_two_of_saddleCobordismTraceBridgeSupplies
    (Ksaddle a ha) (Kbridge a ha) x

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.nonempty_chronologicalSaddleExteriorGeometry_of_pairing
statement:
theorem nonempty_chronologicalSaddleExteriorGeometry_of_pairing
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hpositive : D.position.eventCenter t ht ∈
      (D.signedOutput.labelMorsePosition D.position).positiveCenters)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (A : (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    (HmergeFrame : D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeTopology t ht hindex →
      D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeActualFrameClassSupply t ht hindex)
    (HsplitFrame : D.ChronologicalSaddleSplitTopology t ht hindex →
      D.ChronologicalSaddleSplitActualFrameClassSupply t ht hindex) :
    Nonempty
      (ChronologicalSaddleMergeGeometry D t ht hpositive hindex ⊕
        ChronologicalSaddleSplitGeometry D t ht hpositive hindex)
proof:
:= by
  rcases D.chronologicalSaddleTopologyDichotomy_of_pairing t ht hindex A
    with Htop | Htop
  · exact ⟨Sum.inl (D.chronologicalSaddleMergeGeometry_of_topology
      t ht hpositive hindex Htop (HmergeFrame Htop))⟩
  · exact ⟨Sum.inr (D.chronologicalSaddleSplitGeometry_of_topology
      t ht hpositive hindex Htop (HsplitFrame Htop))⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.targetLift_eq_circlePoint
statement:
theorem targetLift_eq_circlePoint (u : ℝ) :
    targetLift (V := V) h2 O u =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V h2 O (u : C)
proof:
:= by
  rw [targetLift, CanonicalRoundOrbit.point,
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint,
    ← OrbitUnknottingFourier.circleLift_eq_addCircleCartesian]
  rfl

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.contDiff_targetLift
statement: theorem contDiff_targetLift : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (targetLift (V := V) h2 O)
proof:
:= by
  unfold targetLift CanonicalRoundOrbit.point
  exact (contDiff_const.add
      ((Real.contDiff_cos.comp
        (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)).smul contDiff_const)).add
    ((Real.contDiff_sin.comp
      (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)).smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.periodic_targetLift
statement: theorem periodic_targetLift : Function.Periodic (targetLift (V := V) h2 O) 1
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  rw [targetLift_eq_circlePoint (V := V), targetLift_eq_circlePoint (V := V)]
  congr 1
  simp

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.injective_circlePoint
statement:
theorem injective_circlePoint :
    Function.Injective (CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V h2 O)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  have h₀ := congrArg
    (fun x : E => x (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1))) hab
  have h₁ := congrArg
    (fun x : E => x (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1))) hab
  simp [CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint, CanonicalRoundOrbit.center,
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁,
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂] at h₀ h₁
  apply OrbitUnknottingFourier.injective_addCircleCartesian
  exact Prod.ext h₀ h₁

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.isEmbedding_circlePoint
statement:
theorem isEmbedding_circlePoint :
    Topology.IsEmbedding (CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V h2 O)
proof:
:=
  (CanonicalRoundOrbit.continuous_circlePoint V h2 O).isClosedEmbedding
    (injective_circlePoint (V := V) h2 O) |>.isEmbedding

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.contDiff_baseTrack
statement:
theorem contDiff_baseTrack :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => baseTrack (V := V) h2 O q.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub contDiff_fst).smul
      ((V.contDiff_intrinsicOrbitLift O).comp contDiff_snd)).add
    (contDiff_fst.smul
      ((contDiff_targetLift (V := V) h2 O).comp contDiff_snd))

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.contDiff_baseTangent
statement:
theorem contDiff_baseTangent :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => baseTangent (V := V) h2 O q.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  let f : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ → E := fun q u =>
    baseTrack (V := V) h2 O q.1 u
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry f) := by
    exact (contDiff_baseTrack (V := V) h2 O).comp
      ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd)
  have hd := ContDiff.fderiv_apply (m := ∞) (n := ∞) hf
    (g := fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.2)
    (k := fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
    contDiff_snd contDiff_const (by simp)
  simpa [f, baseTangent, fderiv_apply_one_eq_deriv] using hd

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.periodic_baseTrack
statement:
theorem periodic_baseTrack (s : ℝ) :
    Function.Periodic (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O s) 1
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  rw [baseTrack, baseTrack, V.periodic_intrinsicOrbitLift O u,
    periodic_targetLift (V := V) h2 O u]

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.hasDerivAt_baseTrack
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_baseTrack (s u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O s)
      (baseTangent (V := V) h2 O s u) u
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O s) :=
    (contDiff_baseTrack (V := V) h2 O).comp
      (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  exact (hs.differentiable (by simp) u).hasDerivAt

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.hasDerivAt_perturbedLift
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_perturbedLift
    (p : OrbitUnknottingFourier.Parameter E) (s u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (OrbitUnknottingFourier.perturbedTrack
        (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O) p s)
      (baseTangent (V := V) h2 O s u +
        OrbitUnknottingFourier.endpointWeight s •
          ((2 * Real.pi) •
            OrbitUnknottingFourier.pairCombination
              (OrbitUnknottingFourier.circleTangent u) p)) u
proof:
:= by
  change HasDerivAt
    (fun z : ℝ => baseTrack (V := V) h2 O s z +
      OrbitUnknottingFourier.endpointWeight s •
        OrbitUnknottingFourier.perturbation p z) _ u
  exact (hasDerivAt_baseTrack (V := V) h2 O s u).add
    (HasDerivAt.const_smul
      (OrbitUnknottingFourier.endpointWeight s)
      (OrbitUnknottingFourier.hasDerivAt_perturbation p u))

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.exists_goodParameter
statement:
theorem exists_goodParameter (h3 : 3 ≤ n) :
    ∃ p : OrbitUnknottingFourier.Parameter E,
      p ∉ Set.range
        (OrbitUnknottingFourier.secantBadMap
          (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)) ∧
      p ∉ Set.range
        (OrbitUnknottingFourier.tangentBadMap
          (baseTangent (V := V) h2 O))
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : 4 ≤ Module.finrank ℝ E := by
    rw [finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
    omega
  obtain ⟨p, _hpU, hpsec, hptan⟩ :=
    OrbitUnknottingFourier.exists_parameter_avoiding_badRanges
      (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)
      (baseTangent (V := V) h2 O)
      (contDiff_baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)
      (contDiff_baseTangent (V := V) h2 O)
      hdim (U := Set.univ) isOpen_univ Set.univ_nonempty
  exact ⟨p, hpsec, hptan⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.circleTrack_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem circleTrack_coe
    (p : OrbitUnknottingFourier.Parameter E) (s u : ℝ) :
    circleTrack (V := V) h2 O p s (u : C) =
      OrbitUnknottingFourier.perturbedTrack
        (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O) p s u
proof:
:= by
  rfl

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.continuous_circleTrack
statement:
theorem continuous_circleTrack
    (p : OrbitUnknottingFourier.Parameter E) (s : ℝ) :
    Continuous (circleTrack (V := V) h2 O p s)
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (OrbitUnknottingFourier.perturbedTrack
        (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O) p s) :=
    (OrbitUnknottingFourier.contDiff_perturbedTrack
      (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)
      (contDiff_baseTrack (V := V) h2 O) p).comp
        (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  have hraw : Continuous (fun a : C => fun i : Fin (n + 1) =>
      circleTrack (V := V) h2 O p s a i) := by
    apply continuous_pi
    intro i
    apply isQuotientMap_quotient_mk'.continuous_iff.mpr
    have hi : Continuous (fun u : ℝ =>
        (OrbitUnknottingFourier.perturbedTrack
          (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O) p s u) i) :=
      (EuclideanSpace.proj i).continuous.comp hs.continuous
    apply hi.congr
    intro u
    change
      (OrbitUnknottingFourier.perturbedTrack
        (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O) p s u) i =
      circleTrack (V := V) h2 O p s (u : C) i
    rw [circleTrack_coe]
  have htop :=
    (PiLp.continuous_toLp (2 : ENNReal) (fun _ : Fin (n + 1) => ℝ)).comp hraw
  apply htop.congr
  intro a

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.injective_circleTrack_of_interior
statement:
theorem injective_circleTrack_of_interior
    (p : OrbitUnknottingFourier.Parameter E)
    (hp : p ∉ Set.range
      (OrbitUnknottingFourier.secantBadMap
        (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)))
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) :
    Function.Injective (circleTrack (V := V) h2 O p s)
proof:
:= by
  intro a b hab
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  obtain ⟨v, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective b
  apply OrbitUnknottingFourier.addCircle_eq_of_perturbedTrack_eq
    (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)
    (fun t => periodic_baseTrack (V := V) h2 O t) p hp hs0 hs1
  simpa using hab

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.isEmbedding_circleTrack_of_interior
statement:
theorem isEmbedding_circleTrack_of_interior
    (p : OrbitUnknottingFourier.Parameter E)
    (hp : p ∉ Set.range
      (OrbitUnknottingFourier.secantBadMap
        (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)))
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs1 : s < 1) :
    Topology.IsEmbedding (circleTrack (V := V) h2 O p s)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_circleTrack (V := V) h2 O p s).isClosedEmbedding
    (injective_circleTrack_of_interior (V := V) h2 O p hp hs0 hs1)
    |>.isEmbedding

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.circleTrack_zero
statement:
theorem circleTrack_zero
    (p : OrbitUnknottingFourier.Parameter E) :
    circleTrack (V := V) h2 O p 0 = V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding O
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  rw [circleTrack_coe, V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding_coe]
  simp [OrbitUnknottingFourier.perturbedTrack, baseTrack]

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.circleTrack_one
statement:
theorem circleTrack_one
    (p : OrbitUnknottingFourier.Parameter E) :
    circleTrack (V := V) h2 O p 1 =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V h2 O
proof:
:= by
  funext a
  obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
  rw [circleTrack_coe, ← targetLift_eq_circlePoint (V := V) h2 O]
  simp [OrbitUnknottingFourier.perturbedTrack, baseTrack]

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.isEmbedding_circleTrack
statement:
theorem isEmbedding_circleTrack
    (p : OrbitUnknottingFourier.Parameter E)
    (hp : p ∉ Set.range
      (OrbitUnknottingFourier.secantBadMap
        (baseTrack (V := V) h2 O)))
    {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    Topology.IsEmbedding (circleTrack (V := V) h2 O p s)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs with ⟨hs0, hs1⟩
  by_cases hzero : s = 0
  · rw [hzero, circleTrack_zero]
    exact V.isEmbedding_intrinsicOrbitEmbedding O
  by_cases hone : s = 1
  · rw [hone, circleTrack_one]
    exact isEmbedding_circlePoint (V := V) h2 O
  exact isEmbedding_circleTrack_of_interior (V := V) h2 O p hp
    (lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm hzero))
    (lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hone)

  exact OrbitUnknottingFourier.tangent_ne_zero_of_avoids_range
    (baseTangent (V := V) h2 O) p hp hs0 hs1

      have h := F.coreArc₁_before 0
      rw [Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hpin.1] at h
      rw [← hd]
      exact h
    have hbase₁ := D.beforeArcBase_interior_split t ht hindex Vpos hne' e₁
      F.before₁Param horb₁ p₁ (F.coreArc₁_mem 0) hp₁ hflow₁
    have hidx₂ := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex_radius_le hindex e₂ hs0
      hρ hs hρrad hρ' hs' hρ'rad hle (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos
    have hOrb₂ : ∀ O : Vpos.OrbitIndex,
        Vpos.orbitPoint O ∈ Vpos.orbit F.before₂Param.p →
        F.before₂Param.curve 0 ∈ (O : Set _) := by
      intro O hO
      rw [Vpos.orbitPoint_orbit O, Vpos.orbit_eq_of_mem hO,
        F.before₂Param.curve_zero]
      exact Vpos.mem_orbit_self _
    have hstep₂ : Vpos.orbitPoint ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) hρ' hs' hρ'rad (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) ∈
        Vpos.orbit F.before₂Param.p := by
      rw [← congrArg Vpos.orbitPoint hidx₂]
      exact F.before₂Param_orbit
    have horb₂ := hOrb₂ _ hstep₂
    have hflow₂ : (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow (F.coreArc₂ 0)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) = cobSpaceTime (F.before₂Param.curve 0)
          (D.shortAfterTimeAt t ht (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)) := by
      have h := F.coreArc₂_before 0
      rw [Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, hpin.2.2.1] at h
      rw [← hd]
      exact h
    have hbase₂ := D.beforeArcBase_interior_split t ht hindex Vpos hne' e₂
      F.before₂Param horb₂ p₂ (F.coreArc₂_mem 0) hp₂ hflow₂
    exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin,
      ⟨⟨hbase₁.1, hbase₁.2, hmark.1⟩, ⟨hbase₂.1, hbase₂.2, hmark.2⟩⟩⟩

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.pair_normSq
statement:
lemma pair_normSq (a : ℝ) (x : E) :
    (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfRe m hm x + a * x 2) ^ 2 +
        (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfIm m hm x - a * x 3) ^ 2 =
      ((x 0 + a) ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * (x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  simp only [CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfRe,
    CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfIm]
  ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.contDiff_pairRe
statement: lemma contDiff_pairRe (a ε : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pairRe m hm a ε)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_hopfRe m hm).add
    (contDiff_const.mul
      (EuclideanSpace.proj 2 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff)).sub contDiff_const

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.contDiff_pairIm
statement: lemma contDiff_pairIm (a : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (pairIm m hm a)
proof:
:= by
  exact (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_hopfIm m hm).sub
    (contDiff_const.mul
      (EuclideanSpace.proj 3 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.coreMap_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma coreMap_apply_zero (a ε : ℝ) (x : E) :
    coreMap m hm a ε x 0 = (CompactBirth.normSq x - 1) / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [coreMap]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.coreMap_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma coreMap_apply_one (a ε : ℝ) (x : E) :
    coreMap m hm a ε x 1 = pairRe m hm a ε x
proof:
:= by
  simp [coreMap]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.coreMap_apply_two
statement:
@[simp] lemma coreMap_apply_two (a ε : ℝ) (x : E) :
    coreMap m hm a ε x 2 = pairIm m hm a x
proof:
:= by
  have hm2 : 2 < m + 2 := by omega
  have h20 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm2] at hv
  have h21 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hm2] at hv
  simp [coreMap, h20, h21]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.coreMap_apply_tail
proof:
:= by
  simp [coreMap, hi0, hi1, hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.contDiff_coreMap
statement: lemma contDiff_coreMap (a ε : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (coreMap m hm a ε)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    simpa only [coreMap_apply_zero] using
      (CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.sub contDiff_const).div_const 2
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      simpa only [coreMap_apply_one] using contDiff_pairRe m hm a ε
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        simpa only [coreMap_apply_two] using contDiff_pairIm m hm a
      · simp only [coreMap_apply_tail m hm a ε _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i.succ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.contDiff_levelMap
statement: lemma contDiff_levelMap (a ε : ℝ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (levelMap m hm a ε)
proof:
:= by
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub CompactBirth.contDiff_cutoff).smul
    (contDiff_coreMap m hm a ε)).add
    (CompactBirth.contDiff_cutoff.smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.levelMap_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma levelMap_apply_zero (a ε : ℝ) (x : E) :
    levelMap m hm a ε x 0 =
      (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) *
          ((CompactBirth.normSq x - 1) / 2) +
        CompactBirth.cutoff x
proof:
:= by
  simp [levelMap]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.cutoff_ne_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma cutoff_ne_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero {a ε : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : levelMap m hm a ε x = 0) : CompactBirth.cutoff x ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
  rw [levelMap_apply_zero, hc] at h0
  norm_num at h0

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.cutoff_lt_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma cutoff_lt_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero {a ε : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : levelMap m hm a ε x = 0) : CompactBirth.cutoff x < 1
proof:
:=
  lt_of_le_of_ne (CompactBirth.cutoff_le_one x)
    (cutoff_ne_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hm hx)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.normSq_lt_two_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma normSq_lt_two_of_levelMap_eq_zero {a ε : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : levelMap m hm a ε x = 0) : CompactBirth.normSq x < 2
proof:
:= by
  have hc_lt := cutoff_lt_one_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have hc0 := CompactBirth.cutoff_nonneg x
  have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
  rw [levelMap_apply_zero] at h0
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h0
  by_contra hnot
  have hn : 2 ≤ CompactBirth.normSq x := not_lt.mp hnot
  have hfac : 0 < 1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x := sub_pos.mpr hc_lt
  have hrad : 0 < (CompactBirth.normSq x - 1) / 2 := by linarith
  have hprod : 0 < (1 - CompactBirth.cutoff x) *
      ((CompactBirth.normSq x - 1) / 2) := mul_pos hfac hrad
  linarith

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.cutoff_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma cutoff_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero {a ε : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : levelMap m hm a ε x = 0) : CompactBirth.cutoff x = 0
proof:
:=
  CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero
    (normSq_lt_two_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hm hx).le

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.levelMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero
statement:
theorem levelMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero (a ε : ℝ) (x : E) :
    levelMap m hm a ε x = 0 ↔ coreMap m hm a ε x = 0
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hc := cutoff_eq_zero_of_levelMap_eq_zero m hm hx
    simpa [levelMap, hc] using hx
  · intro hx
    have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
    rw [coreMap_apply_zero] at h0
    simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h0
    have hn : CompactBirth.normSq x = 1 := by linarith
    have hc : CompactBirth.cutoff x = 0 :=
      CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero (by rw [hn]; norm_num)
    simp [levelMap, hc, hx]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.levelMap_flatOutside
statement:
theorem levelMap_flatOutside (a ε : ℝ) {x : E} (hx : 2 ≤ ‖x‖) :
    levelMap m hm a ε x =
      CompactHopfPairConfiguration.background m hm
proof:
:= by
  have hs : 4 ≤ CompactBirth.normSq x := by
    rw [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
  have hc := CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_one hs
  simp [levelMap, hc]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.coreMap_zero_zero_eq_source
statement:
lemma coreMap_zero_zero_eq_source :
    coreMap m hm 0 0 = CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap m hm
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  simp [coreMap, pairRe, pairIm, CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.levelMap_zero_zero_eq_source
statement:
lemma levelMap_zero_zero_eq_source :
    levelMap m hm 0 0 = CompactHopfPairConfiguration.levelMap m hm
proof:
:= by
  funext x
  rw [levelMap, CompactHopfPairConfiguration.levelMap,
    coreMap_zero_zero_eq_source]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero {a ε : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : coreMap m hm a ε x = 0) : CompactBirth.normSq x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h0 := congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
  rw [coreMap_apply_zero] at h0
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at h0
  linarith

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.pairRe_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma pairRe_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero {a ε : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : coreMap m hm a ε x = 0) : pairRe m hm a ε x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q : F => q 1) hx
  simpa using h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.pairIm_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma pairIm_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero {a ε : ℝ} {x : E}
    (hx : coreMap m hm a ε x = 0) : pairIm m hm a x = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg (fun q : F => q 2) hx
  simpa using h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.target_u_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma target_u_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero {x : E}
    (hx : coreMap m hm 2 0 x = 0) : x 2 = 0 ∧ x 3 = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hre := pairRe_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have him := pairIm_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have hprod : ((x 0 + 2) ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2) * (x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2) = 0 := by
    rw [← pair_normSq m hm 2 x]
    simp [pairRe, pairIm] at hre him
    rw [hre, him]
    norm_num
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with hcoef | hu
  · have hn := normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
    have hnormsq : ‖x‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      simpa [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq] using hn
    have hnorm : ‖x‖ = 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg x]
    have hx0 : x 0 = -2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0 + 2), sq_nonneg (x 1)]
    have hcoord := abs_coordinate_le_norm x (0 : Fin (m + 3))
    rw [hx0, hnorm] at hcoord
    norm_num at hcoord
  · constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 2), sq_nonneg (x 3)]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.target_coreMap_eq_source_of_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hu := target_u_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  rw [← coreMap_zero_zero_eq_source]
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    simpa using congrArg (fun q : F => q 0) hx
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      simp [coreMap_apply_one, pairRe,
        CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfRe, hu.1, hu.2]
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        simp [coreMap_apply_two, pairIm,
          CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfIm, hu.1, hu.2]
      · rw [coreMap_apply_tail m hm 0 0 _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
        simpa [coreMap_apply_tail m hm 2 0 _ hi0 hi1 hi2] using
          congrArg (fun q : F => q i) hx

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.target_coreMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle
statement:
theorem target_coreMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle (x : E) :
    coreMap m hm 2 0 x = 0 ↔ x ∈ standardCircle
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hsource := target_coreMap_eq_source_of_eq_zero m hm hx
    have hu := target_u_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
    rcases (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap_eq_zero_iff_two_circles
      m hm x).mp hsource with hfirst | hsecond
    · exact hfirst
    · rcases hsecond with ⟨theta, htheta⟩
      have h2 := congrArg (fun q : E => q 2) htheta.symm
      have h3 := congrArg (fun q : E => q 3) htheta.symm
      rw [CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircleAt_apply_two] at h2
      rw [CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircleAt_apply_three] at h3
      rw [hu.1] at h2
      rw [hu.2] at h3
      exfalso
      nlinarith [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq theta]
  · rintro ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    have h20 : (2 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3)] at hv
    have h21 : (2 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3)] at hv
    have h30 : (3 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)] at hv
    have h31 : (3 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)] at hv
    have hc2 : circleAt (m := m) theta 2 = 0 :=
      circleAt_apply_other theta h20 h21
    have hc3 : circleAt (m := m) theta 3 = 0 :=
      circleAt_apply_other theta h30 h31
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · subst i
      rw [coreMap_apply_zero, CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq,
        norm_circleAt, one_pow]
      norm_num
    · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
      · subst i
        rw [coreMap_apply_one, pairRe,
          CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfRe, hc2, hc3]
        ring_nf
        simp
      · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
        · subst i
          rw [coreMap_apply_two, pairIm,
            CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfIm, hc2, hc3]
          ring_nf
          simp
        · rw [coreMap_apply_tail m hm 2 0 _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
          apply circleAt_apply_other theta
          · exact Fin.succ_ne_zero i
          · intro h
            apply hi0
            apply Fin.succ_injective
            simpa using h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.source_levelMap_eq_zero_iff_two_circles
statement:
theorem source_levelMap_eq_zero_iff_two_circles (x : E) :
    levelMap m hm 0 0 x = 0 ↔
      x ∈ standardCircle ∨
        x ∈ CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondCircle m hm
proof:
:= by
  rw [levelMap_zero_zero_eq_source,
    CompactHopfPairConfiguration.levelMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero,
    CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap_eq_zero_iff_two_circles]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.target_levelMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle
statement:
theorem target_levelMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle (x : E) :
    levelMap m hm 2 0 x = 0 ↔ x ∈ standardCircle
proof:
:= by
  rw [levelMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero,
    target_coreMap_eq_zero_iff_standardCircle]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_coord_apply
statement:
private lemma fderiv_coord_apply
    (G : E → F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => G q i) x h = fderiv ℝ G x h i
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj i
  have hG' : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G x) x :=
    (hG.differentiable infty_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun q => G q i)
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ G x)) x := by
    exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (G x) i).comp x hG'
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hcomp.fderiv
  simpa [outProj] using happ

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_zero (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (coreMap m hm 2 0) x h 0 = ⟪x, h⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (coreMap m hm 2 0)
    (contDiff_coreMap m hm 2 0) 0 x h]
  have hfun : (fun q : E => coreMap m hm 2 0 q 0) =
      fun q => CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap m hm q 0 := by
    funext q
    simp
  rw [hfun, fderiv_coord_apply m
    (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap m hm)
    (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_coreMap m hm) 0 x h]
  exact CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_apply_zero m hm x h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_one
statement:
lemma fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_one (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (coreMap m hm 2 0) x h 1 =
      h 0 * x 2 + (x 0 + 2) * h 2 + h 1 * x 3 + x 1 * h 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (coreMap m hm 2 0)
    (contDiff_coreMap m hm 2 0) 1 x h]
  have hfun : (fun q : E => coreMap m hm 2 0 q 1) =
      fun q => q 0 * q 2 + q 1 * q 3 + 2 * q 2 := by
    funext q
    simp [pairRe, CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfRe]
  rw [hfun]
  let p0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  let p2 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 2
  let p3 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 3
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 0) p0 x := p0.hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 1) p1 x := p1.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 2) p2 x := p2.hasFDerivAt
  have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 3) p3 x := p3.hasFDerivAt
  have hd := ((h0.mul h2).add (h1.mul h3)).add (h2.const_mul 2)
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hd.fderiv
  change fderiv ℝ (((fun q : E => q 0) * fun q => q 2) +
      ((fun q : E => q 1) * fun q => q 3) +
      fun q : E => 2 * q 2) x h = _
  calc
    _ = x 0 * h 2 + x 2 * h 0 +
        (x 1 * h 3 + x 3 * h 1) + 2 * h 2 := by
      simpa [p0, p1, p2, p3] using happ
    _ = _ := by ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_two
statement:
lemma fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_two (x h : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (coreMap m hm 2 0) x h 2 =
      h 1 * x 2 + x 1 * h 2 - h 0 * x 3 - (x 0 + 2) * h 3
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (coreMap m hm 2 0)
    (contDiff_coreMap m hm 2 0) 2 x h]
  have hfun : (fun q : E => coreMap m hm 2 0 q 2) =
      fun q => q 1 * q 2 - q 0 * q 3 - 2 * q 3 := by
    funext q
    simp [pairIm, CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfIm]
  rw [hfun]
  let p0 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  let p2 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 2
  let p3 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 3
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 0) p0 x := p0.hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 1) p1 x := p1.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 2) p2 x := p2.hasFDerivAt
  have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E => q 3) p3 x := p3.hasFDerivAt
  have hd := ((h1.mul h2).sub (h0.mul h3)).sub (h3.const_mul 2)
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hd.fderiv
  change fderiv ℝ (((fun q : E => q 1) * fun q => q 2) -
      ((fun q : E => q 0) * fun q => q 3) -
      fun q : E => 2 * q 3) x h = _
  calc
    _ = x 1 * h 2 + x 2 * h 1 -
        (x 0 * h 3 + x 3 * h 0) - 2 * h 3 := by
      simpa [p0, p1, p2, p3] using happ
    _ = _ := by ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_tail
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_coord_apply m (coreMap m hm 2 0)
    (contDiff_coreMap m hm 2 0) i x h]
  have hfun : (fun q : E => coreMap m hm 2 0 q i) = fun q => q i.succ := by
    funext q
    exact coreMap_apply_tail m hm 2 0 q hi0 hi1 hi2
  rw [hfun]
  exact congrArg (fun L : E →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h)
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i.succ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.fderiv

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.targetPreimage_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma targetPreimage_apply_zero (x : E) (y : F) :
    targetPreimage m hm x y 0 = x 0 * y 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [targetPreimage]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.targetPreimage_apply_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma targetPreimage_apply_succ (x : E) (y : F) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    targetPreimage m hm x y i.succ =
      if i = 0 then x 1 * y 0
      else if i = 1 then
        ((x 0 + 2) * y 1 + x 1 * y 2) /
          ((x 0 + 2) ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)
      else if i = 2 then
        (x 1 * y 1 - (x 0 + 2) * y 2) /
          ((x 0 + 2) ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)
      else y i
proof:
:= by
  simp [targetPreimage]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.targetPreimage_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma targetPreimage_apply_one (x : E) (y : F) :
    targetPreimage m hm x y 1 = x 1 * y 0
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : Fin (m + 3)) = (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  calc
    targetPreimage m hm x y 1 =
        targetPreimage m hm x y (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => targetPreimage m hm x y j) h1
    _ = _ := by
      simpa using targetPreimage_apply_succ m hm x y (0 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.targetPreimage_apply_two
statement:
@[simp] lemma targetPreimage_apply_two (x : E) (y : F) :
    targetPreimage m hm x y 2 =
      ((x 0 + 2) * y 1 + x 1 * y 2) /
        ((x 0 + 2) ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : Fin (m + 3)) = (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3)]
  have h10 : (1 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2)] at hv
  calc
    targetPreimage m hm x y 2 =
        targetPreimage m hm x y (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => targetPreimage m hm x y j) h2
    _ = _ := by
      simpa [h10] using
        targetPreimage_apply_succ m hm x y (1 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.targetPreimage_apply_three
statement:
@[simp] lemma targetPreimage_apply_three (x : E) (y : F) :
    targetPreimage m hm x y 3 =
      (x 1 * y 1 - (x 0 + 2) * y 2) /
        ((x 0 + 2) ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : (3 : Fin (m + 3)) = (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)]
  have h20 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at hv
  have h21 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at hv
  calc
    targetPreimage m hm x y 3 =
        targetPreimage m hm x y (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => targetPreimage m hm x y j) h3
    _ = _ := by
      simpa [h20, h21] using
        targetPreimage_apply_succ m hm x y (2 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.targetPreimage_apply_tail
proof:
:= by
  simp [targetPreimage, hi0, hi1, hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.inner_eq_sum_local
statement:
private lemma inner_eq_sum_local (x h : E) :
    ⟪x, h⟫_ℝ = ∑ j, x j * h j
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by
    simp [RCLike.inner_apply, mul_comm]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.inner_targetPreimage
proof:
:= by
  have hu := target_u_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have hsource := target_coreMap_eq_source_of_eq_zero m hm hx
  rw [inner_eq_sum_local]
  have hpoint : ∀ j : Fin (m + 3),
      x j * targetPreimage m hm x y j = x j ^ 2 * y 0 := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      simp [pow_two, mul_assoc]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        simp [pow_two, mul_assoc]
      · by_cases hj2 : j = 2
        · subst j
          simp [hu.1]
        · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
          · subst j
            simp [hu.2]
          · rw [CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coordinate_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero
              m hm hsource hj0 hj1 hj2 hj3]
            simp
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hpoint j, ← Finset.sum_mul]
  change CompactBirth.normSq x * y 0 = y 0
  rw [normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx, one_mul]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.target_denominator_pos
statement:
lemma target_denominator_pos {x : E} (hx : coreMap m hm 2 0 x = 0) :
    0 < (x 0 + 2) ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hu := target_u_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have hsource := target_coreMap_eq_source_of_eq_zero m hm hx
  have hn := CompactHopfPairConfiguration.first_branch_normSq m hm hsource hu
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x 0 + 1)]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_target_coreMap_targetPreimage
proof:
:= by
  have hu := target_u_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
  have hden := target_denominator_pos m hm hx
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_zero, inner_targetPreimage m hm hx y]
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      rw [fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_one]
      simp only [targetPreimage_apply_zero, targetPreimage_apply_one,
        targetPreimage_apply_two, targetPreimage_apply_three, hu.1, hu.2,
        mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add]
      field_simp
      ring
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        rw [fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_two]
        simp only [targetPreimage_apply_zero, targetPreimage_apply_one,
          targetPreimage_apply_two, targetPreimage_apply_three, hu.1, hu.2,
          mul_zero, zero_mul, zero_add, sub_zero]
        field_simp
        ring
      · rw [fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_tail m hm x _ hi0 hi1 hi2,
          targetPreimage_apply_tail m hm x y hi0 hi1 hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.surjective_fderiv_target_coreMap_of_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  intro y
  exact ⟨targetPreimage m hm x y,
    fderiv_target_coreMap_targetPreimage m hm hx y⟩

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.levelMap_eventuallyEq_coreMap
proof:
:= by
  have hopen : IsOpen {z : E | CompactBirth.normSq z < 2} :=
    isOpen_lt CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.continuous continuous_const
  exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hx) fun z hz => by
    rw [levelMap, CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero hz.le]
    simp

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.surjective_fderiv_target_levelMap_of_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hxcore := (levelMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero m hm 2 0 x).mp hx
  have hn := normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hxcore
  have hlt : CompactBirth.normSq x < 2 := by rw [hn]; norm_num
  rw [(levelMap_eventuallyEq_coreMap m hm 2 0 hlt).fderiv_eq]
  exact surjective_fderiv_target_coreMap_of_eq_zero m hm hxcore

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.epsilon_of_le_quarter
