name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.contDiff_eventMap
statement: lemma contDiff_eventMap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (eventMap m hm)
proof:
:= by
  let p : E' →L[ℝ] E := initCLM (m + 3)
  have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p := p.contDiff
  have ht : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : E' => shift (vertC v)) :=
    contDiff_shift.comp contDiff_vertC
  have he : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : E' => epsilon (vertC v)) :=
    contDiff_epsilon.comp contDiff_vertC
  have hcore : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : E' =>
      coreMap m hm (shift (vertC v)) (epsilon (vertC v)) (p v)) := by
    rw [contDiff_piLp]
    intro i
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · subst i
      simpa [coreMap_apply_zero, Function.comp_apply] using
        ((CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.comp hp).sub contDiff_const).div_const 2
    · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
      · subst i
        have hhopf :=
          (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_hopfRe m hm).comp hp
        have hcoord :=
          (EuclideanSpace.proj 2 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hp
        simpa [coreMap_apply_one, pairRe, Function.comp_apply] using
          (hhopf.add (ht.mul hcoord)).sub he
      · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
        · subst i
          have hhopf :=
            (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_hopfIm m hm).comp hp
          have hcoord :=
            (EuclideanSpace.proj 3 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hp
          simpa [coreMap_apply_two, pairIm, Function.comp_apply] using
            hhopf.sub (ht.mul hcoord)
        · simp only [coreMap_apply_tail m hm _ _ _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
          exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i.succ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hp
  have hcut : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : E' => CompactBirth.cutoff (p v)) :=
    CompactBirth.contDiff_cutoff.comp hp
  unfold eventMap levelMap
  exact ((contDiff_const.sub hcut).smul hcore).add
    (hcut.smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.contDiff_eventCoreMap
statement: lemma contDiff_eventCoreMap : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (eventCoreMap m hm)
proof:
:= by
  let p : E' →L[ℝ] E := initCLM (m + 3)
  have hp : ContDiff ℝ ∞ p := p.contDiff
  have ht : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : E' => shift (vertC v)) :=
    contDiff_shift.comp contDiff_vertC
  have he : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun v : E' => epsilon (vertC v)) :=
    contDiff_epsilon.comp contDiff_vertC
  unfold eventCoreMap
  rw [contDiff_piLp]
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    simpa [coreMap_apply_zero, Function.comp_apply] using
      ((CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.comp hp).sub contDiff_const).div_const 2
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      have hhopf :=
        (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_hopfRe m hm).comp hp
      have hcoord :=
        (EuclideanSpace.proj 2 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hp
      simpa [coreMap_apply_one, pairRe, Function.comp_apply, p, initCLM_apply] using
        (hhopf.add (ht.mul hcoord)).sub he
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        have hhopf :=
          (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_hopfIm m hm).comp hp
        have hcoord :=
          (EuclideanSpace.proj 3 : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hp
        simpa [coreMap_apply_two, pairIm, Function.comp_apply, p, initCLM_apply] using
          hhopf.sub (ht.mul hcoord)
      · simp only [coreMap_apply_tail m hm _ _ _ hi0 hi1 hi2]
        exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i.succ : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp hp

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_event_coord_apply
statement:
private lemma fderiv_event_coord_apply
    (G : E' → F) (hG : ContDiff ℝ ∞ G)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) (v h : E') :
    fderiv ℝ (fun q => G q i) v h = fderiv ℝ G v h i
proof:
:= by
  let outProj : F →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj i
  have hG' : HasFDerivAt G (fderiv ℝ G v) v :=
    (hG.differentiable infty_ne_zero v).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun q => G q i)
      (outProj.comp (fderiv ℝ G v)) v := by
    exact (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2 (G v) i).comp v hG'
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h) hcomp.fderiv
  simpa [outProj] using happ

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_zero
statement:
lemma fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_zero (v h : E') :
    fderiv ℝ (eventCoreMap m hm) v h 0 =
      ⟪initCLM (m + 3) v, initCLM (m + 3) h⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_event_coord_apply m (eventCoreMap m hm)
    (contDiff_eventCoreMap m hm) 0 v h]
  let p : E' →L[ℝ] E := initCLM (m + 3)
  have hfun : (fun q : E' => eventCoreMap m hm q 0) =
      fun q => CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap m hm (p q) 0 := by
    funext q
    simp [eventCoreMap, p]
  rw [hfun]
  have hs : HasFDerivAt (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap m hm)
      (fderiv ℝ (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap m hm) (p v)) (p v) :=
    ((CompactHopfPairConfiguration.contDiff_coreMap m hm).differentiable
      infty_ne_zero (p v)).hasFDerivAt
  have hc := (PiLp.hasFDerivAt_apply 2
    (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap m hm (p v)) (0 : Fin (m + 2))).comp
      (p v) hs
  have hcomp := hc.comp v p.hasFDerivAt
  change (fderiv ℝ (((fun f : F => f 0) ∘
    CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap m hm) ∘ p) v) h = _
  rw [hcomp.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  change fderiv ℝ (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap m hm)
    (p v) (p h) 0 = _
  rw [CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_apply_zero]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_one
statement:
lemma fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_one (v h : E') :
    fderiv ℝ (eventCoreMap m hm) v h 1 =
      h 0 * v 2 + (v 0 + shift (vertC v)) * h 2 +
        h 1 * v 3 + v 1 * h 3 +
        (deriv shift (vertC v) * v 2 - deriv epsilon (vertC v)) * vertC h
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_event_coord_apply m (eventCoreMap m hm)
    (contDiff_eventCoreMap m hm) 1 v h]
  let p0 : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  let p2 : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 2
  let p3 : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 3
  let pT : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (m + 3))
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E' => q 0) p0 v := p0.hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E' => q 1) p1 v := p1.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E' => q 2) p2 v := p2.hasFDerivAt
  have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E' => q 3) p3 v := p3.hasFDerivAt
  have ha0 : HasDerivAt shift (deriv shift (vertC v)) (vertC v) :=
    (contDiff_shift.differentiable infty_ne_zero (vertC v)).hasDerivAt
  have he0 : HasDerivAt epsilon (deriv epsilon (vertC v)) (vertC v) :=
    (contDiff_epsilon.differentiable infty_ne_zero (vertC v)).hasDerivAt
  have ha := ha0.hasFDerivAt.comp v pT.hasFDerivAt
  have he := he0.hasFDerivAt.comp v pT.hasFDerivAt
  have hd := (((h0.mul h2).add (h1.mul h3)).add (ha.mul h2)).sub he
  have h2cast : ((2 : Fin (m + 3)).castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) = 2 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 4)]
  have h3cast : ((3 : Fin (m + 3)).castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) = 3 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 4)]
  have hfun : (fun q : E' => eventCoreMap m hm q 1) = fun q =>
      q 0 * q 2 + q 1 * q 3 + shift (vertC q) * q 2 - epsilon (vertC q) := by
    funext q
    simp [eventCoreMap, pairRe, CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfRe,
      initCLM_apply, h2cast, h3cast]
  have hdEvent := hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q => congrFun hfun q)
  rw [hdEvent.fderiv]
  simp [p0, p1, p2, p3, pT, Function.comp_apply, vertC]
  ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_two
statement:
lemma fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_two (v h : E') :
    fderiv ℝ (eventCoreMap m hm) v h 2 =
      h 1 * v 2 + v 1 * h 2 - h 0 * v 3 -
        (v 0 + shift (vertC v)) * h 3 -
        deriv shift (vertC v) * v 3 * vertC h
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_event_coord_apply m (eventCoreMap m hm)
    (contDiff_eventCoreMap m hm) 2 v h]
  let p0 : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 0
  let p1 : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 1
  let p2 : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 2
  let p3 : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj 3
  let pT : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ := EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (m + 3))
  have h0 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E' => q 0) p0 v := p0.hasFDerivAt
  have h1 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E' => q 1) p1 v := p1.hasFDerivAt
  have h2 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E' => q 2) p2 v := p2.hasFDerivAt
  have h3 : HasFDerivAt (fun q : E' => q 3) p3 v := p3.hasFDerivAt
  have ha0 : HasDerivAt shift (deriv shift (vertC v)) (vertC v) :=
    (contDiff_shift.differentiable infty_ne_zero (vertC v)).hasDerivAt
  have ha := ha0.hasFDerivAt.comp v pT.hasFDerivAt
  have hd := ((h1.mul h2).sub (h0.mul h3)).sub (ha.mul h3)
  have h2cast : ((2 : Fin (m + 3)).castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) = 2 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 4)]
  have h3cast : ((3 : Fin (m + 3)).castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) = 3 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 4)]
  have hfun : (fun q : E' => eventCoreMap m hm q 2) = fun q =>
      q 1 * q 2 - q 0 * q 3 - shift (vertC q) * q 3 := by
    funext q
    simp [eventCoreMap, pairIm, CompactHopfPairConfiguration.hopfIm,
      initCLM_apply, h2cast, h3cast]
  have hdEvent := hd.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun q => congrFun hfun q)
  rw [hdEvent.fderiv]
  simp [p0, p1, p2, p3, pT, Function.comp_apply, vertC]
  ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_tail
proof:
:= by
  rw [← fderiv_event_coord_apply m (eventCoreMap m hm)
    (contDiff_eventCoreMap m hm) i v h]
  have hfun : (fun q : E' => eventCoreMap m hm q i) =
      fun q => q i.succ.castSucc := by
    funext q
    simp [eventCoreMap, coreMap_apply_tail m hm _ _ _ hi0 hi1 hi2,
      initCLM_apply]
  rw [hfun]
  exact congrArg (fun L : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ => L h)
    (EuclideanSpace.proj i.succ.castSucc : E' →L[ℝ] ℝ).hasFDerivAt.fderiv

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.shift_nonneg
statement: lemma shift_nonneg (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ shift t
proof:
:= by
  unfold shift
  linarith [StandardSaddle.neg_one_le_height t]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.shift_le_two
statement: lemma shift_le_two (t : ℝ) : shift t ≤ 2
proof:
:= by
  unfold shift
  linarith [StandardSaddle.height_le_one t]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.epsilon_nonneg
statement: lemma epsilon_nonneg (t : ℝ) : 0 ≤ epsilon t
proof:
:= by
  have hL := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (8 * (t - 1 / 4))
  have hR := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (8 * (t - 5 / 8))
  change 0 ≤ (1 / 1000 : ℝ) * StandardSaddle.leftCutoff t *
    (1 - StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t)
  positivity

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.epsilon_le_small
statement: lemma epsilon_le_small (t : ℝ) : epsilon t ≤ 1 / 1000
proof:
:= by
  have hL0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (8 * (t - 1 / 4))
  have hL1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (8 * (t - 1 / 4))
  have hR0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (8 * (t - 5 / 8))
  have hR1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (8 * (t - 5 / 8))
  change 0 ≤ StandardSaddle.leftCutoff t at hL0
  change StandardSaddle.leftCutoff t ≤ 1 at hL1
  change 0 ≤ StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t at hR0
  change StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t ≤ 1 at hR1
  change (1 / 1000 : ℝ) * StandardSaddle.leftCutoff t *
    (1 - StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t) ≤ 1 / 1000
  have hp : StandardSaddle.leftCutoff t *
      (1 - StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t) ≤ 1 := by
    have hB0 : 0 ≤ 1 - StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t := by linarith
    have hB1 : 1 - StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t ≤ 1 := by linarith
    calc
      _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul hL1 hB1 hB0 (by norm_num)
      _ = 1 := by norm_num
  nlinarith

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.epsilon_eq_zero_time_dichotomy
statement:
lemma epsilon_eq_zero_time_dichotomy {t : ℝ} (he : epsilon t = 0) :
    t ≤ 1 / 4 ∨ 3 / 4 ≤ t
proof:
:= by
  have hprod : StandardSaddle.leftCutoff t *
      (1 - StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t) = 0 := by
    unfold epsilon at he
    norm_num at he ⊢
    exact he
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with hL | hR
  · left
    have harg : 8 * (t - 1 / 4) ≤ 0 :=
      Real.smoothTransition.zero_iff_nonpos.mp hL
    linarith
  · right
    have hReq : StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t = 1 := by linarith
    have harg : 1 ≤ 8 * (t - 5 / 8) :=
      Real.smoothTransition.eq_one_iff_one_le.mp hReq
    linarith

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.shift_le_seven_eighth
statement:
lemma shift_le_seven_eighth {t : ℝ} (ht : t ≤ 3 / 8) :
    shift t ≤ 7 / 8
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : t ≤ 1 / 4
  · rw [shift_of_le_quarter hq]
    norm_num
  · have hh : t < 1 / 2 := by linarith
    rw [shift, StandardSaddle.height, if_pos hh, StandardSaddle.heightLeft]
    have hc0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (8 * (t - 1 / 4))
    have hc1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (8 * (t - 1 / 4))
    change (1 - StandardSaddle.leftCutoff t) * (-1) +
        StandardSaddle.leftCutoff t * (t - 1 / 2) + 1 ≤ 7 / 8
    change 0 ≤ StandardSaddle.leftCutoff t at hc0
    change StandardSaddle.leftCutoff t ≤ 1 at hc1
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ t + 1 / 2 := by linarith
    have hb1 : t + 1 / 2 ≤ 7 / 8 := by linarith
    have hp : StandardSaddle.leftCutoff t * (t + 1 / 2) ≤ 7 / 8 := by
      calc
        _ ≤ 1 * (t + 1 / 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc1 hb0
        _ ≤ 7 / 8 := by linarith
    linarith

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.nine_eighth_le_shift
statement:
lemma nine_eighth_le_shift {t : ℝ} (ht : 5 / 8 ≤ t) :
    9 / 8 ≤ shift t
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hq : 3 / 4 ≤ t
  · rw [shift_of_threeQuarter_le hq]
    norm_num
  · have hh : ¬ t < 1 / 2 := by linarith
    rw [shift, StandardSaddle.height, if_neg hh, StandardSaddle.heightRight]
    have hc0 := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg (8 * (t - 5 / 8))
    have hc1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one (8 * (t - 5 / 8))
    change 0 ≤ StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t at hc0
    change StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t ≤ 1 at hc1
    change 9 / 8 ≤ (1 - StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t) *
        (t - 1 / 2) + StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t + 1
    have hb0 : 0 ≤ 3 / 2 - t := by linarith
    have hb1 : 3 / 2 - t ≤ 7 / 8 := by linarith
    have hp : (1 - StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t) * (3 / 2 - t) ≤ 7 / 8 := by
      have hc : 0 ≤ 1 - StandardSaddle.rightCutoff t := by linarith
      calc
        _ ≤ 1 * (3 / 2 - t) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) hb0
        _ ≤ 7 / 8 := by linarith
    nlinarith

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.epsilon_eq_small_of_middle
proof:
:= by
  rw [epsilon, StandardSaddle.leftCutoff_eq_one ht0,
    StandardSaddle.rightCutoff_eq_zero ht1]
  ring

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.hasDerivAt_shift_of_middle
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_shift_of_middle {t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 3 / 8 < t) (ht1 : t < 5 / 8) : HasDerivAt shift 1 t
proof:
:= by
  have hlinear : shift =ᶠ[nhds t] fun s : ℝ => s + 1 / 2 :=
    Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
      (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds (show t ∈ Ioo (3 / 8 : ℝ) (5 / 8) from ⟨ht0, ht1⟩))
      fun s hs => by
        rw [shift, StandardSaddle.height_eq_linear hs.1.le hs.2.le]
        ring
  exact ((hasDerivAt_id t).add_const (1 / 2)).congr_of_eventuallyEq hlinear

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.hasDerivAt_epsilon_of_middle
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_epsilon_of_middle {t : ℝ}
    (ht0 : 3 / 8 < t) (ht1 : t < 5 / 8) : HasDerivAt epsilon 0 t
proof:
:= by
  apply (hasDerivAt_const t (1 / 1000 : ℝ)).congr_of_eventuallyEq
  exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem
    (isOpen_Ioo.mem_nhds (show t ∈ Ioo (3 / 8 : ℝ) (5 / 8) from ⟨ht0, ht1⟩))
    fun s hs => epsilon_eq_small_of_middle hs.1.le hs.2.le

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.critical_shift_mem_middle
statement:
private lemma critical_shift_mem_middle
    {x y p q a e : ℝ}
    (ha0 : 0 ≤ a) (ha2 : a ≤ 2)
    (he0 : 0 < e) (he1 : e ≤ 1 / 1000)
    (hsphere : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 + p ^ 2 + q ^ 2 = 1)
    (hre : (x + a) * p + y * q = e)
    (him : y * p - (x + a) * q = 0)
    (hrx : x * ((x + a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) -
      (x + a) * (p ^ 2 + q ^ 2) = 0)
    (hry : y * (((x + a) ^ 2 + y ^ 2) - (p ^ 2 + q ^ 2)) = 0) :
    7 / 8 < a ∧ a < 9 / 8
proof:
:= by
  let X : ℝ := x + a
  let W : ℝ := X ^ 2 + y ^ 2
  let U : ℝ := p ^ 2 + q ^ 2
  have hprod : W * U = e ^ 2 := by
    dsimp [W, U, X]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg ((x + a) * p + y * q),
      sq_nonneg (y * p - (x + a) * q)]
  have hW0 : 0 ≤ W := by dsimp [W]; positivity
  have hU0 : 0 ≤ U := by dsimp [U]; positivity
  have hW : 0 < W := by
    by_contra hn
    have : W = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hn) hW0
    rw [this, zero_mul] at hprod
    nlinarith
  have hU : 0 < U := by
    by_contra hn
    have : U = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hn) hU0
    rw [this, mul_zero] at hprod
    nlinarith
  have hcriticalX : x * W - X * U = 0 := by simpa [W, U, X] using hrx
  have hcriticalY : y * (W - U) = 0 := by simpa [W, U, X] using hry
  have hWU : W ≠ U := by
    intro hEq
    have haW : a * W = 0 := by
      rw [hEq] at hcriticalX
      dsimp [X] at hcriticalX
      nlinarith
    have ha : a = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp haW).resolve_right hW.ne'
    have hEq0 : x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 = p ^ 2 + q ^ 2 := by
      simpa [W, U, X, ha] using hEq
    have hhalfW : W = 1 / 2 := by
      dsimp [W, X]
      rw [ha]
      nlinarith
    have hhalfU : U = 1 / 2 := by
      rw [← hEq]
      exact hhalfW
    have hehalf : e = 1 / 2 := by
      rw [hhalfW, hhalfU] at hprod
      nlinarith
    linarith
  have hy : y = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hcriticalY).resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr hWU)
  have hX : X ≠ 0 := by
    intro hX0
    dsimp [W] at hW
    rw [hX0, hy] at hW
    norm_num at hW
  have hq : q = 0 := by
    have hX' : x + a ≠ 0 := by simpa [X] using hX
    rw [hy] at him
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp (by linarith : (x + a) * q = 0)).resolve_left hX'
  have hp2 : p ^ 2 = x * X := by
    have hfactor : X * (x * X - p ^ 2) = 0 := by
      dsimp [W, U] at hcriticalX
      rw [hy, hq] at hcriticalX
      linear_combination hcriticalX
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hfactor).resolve_left hX)).symm
  have hs : x ^ 2 + p ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [hy, hq] at hsphere; nlinarith
  have hpne : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hp
    rw [hy, hq, hp] at hre
    norm_num at hre
    linarith
  have hxp : 0 < x * X := by rw [← hp2]; exact sq_pos_of_ne_zero hpne
  have hxne : x ≠ 0 := by
    intro hx
    rw [hx, zero_mul] at hxp
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hxp
  have hXsign : (0 < x ∧ 0 < X) ∨ (x < 0 ∧ X < 0) :=
    (mul_pos_iff.mp hxp)
  have heSq : e ^ 2 = X ^ 2 * p ^ 2 := by
    have hreX : X * p = e := by simpa [X, hy, hq] using hre
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (X * p)]
  constructor
  · by_contra hnot
    have ha : a ≤ 7 / 8 := not_lt.mp hnot
    rcases hXsign with hpos | hneg
    · have hxX : x ≤ X := by dsimp [X]; linarith
      have hxx : x ^ 2 ≤ x * X := by
        simpa [pow_two] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxX hpos.1.le
      have hhalf1 : 1 / 2 ≤ x * X := by nlinarith
      have hhalf2 : 1 / 2 ≤ X ^ 2 := by
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxX hpos.2.le
        exact hhalf1.trans (by simpa [pow_two] using hmul)
      have hquarter : 1 / 4 ≤ e ^ 2 := by
        rw [heSq, hp2]
        calc
          (1 / 4 : ℝ) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
          _ ≤ X ^ 2 * (x * X) :=
            mul_le_mul hhalf2 hhalf1 (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg X)
      have hesmall : e ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 1000 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        by simpa [pow_two] using mul_self_le_mul_self he0.le he1
      norm_num at hquarter hesmall
      linarith
    · let r : ℝ := -X
      have hr : 0 < r := by dsimp [r]; linarith
      have hxform : -x = r + a := by dsimp [r, X]; ring
      have hpform : p ^ 2 = (r + a) * r := by
        rw [hp2]
        dsimp [r]
        nlinarith
      have hsform : (r + a) * (2 * r + a) = 1 := by
        rw [hpform] at hs
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (r + a)]
      have hr16 : 1 / 16 < r := by
        by_contra hnr
        have hrle : r ≤ 1 / 16 := not_lt.mp hnr
        have h1 : r + a ≤ 15 / 16 := by linarith
        have h2 : 2 * r + a ≤ 1 := by linarith
        have hnon1 : 0 ≤ r + a := by linarith
        have hnon2 : 0 ≤ 2 * r + a := by linarith
        have hpbound : (r + a) * (2 * r + a) ≤ (15 / 16 : ℝ) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h2 hnon2 (by norm_num)
        linarith
      have hpge : r ^ 2 ≤ p ^ 2 := by
        rw [hpform]
        nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha0 hr.le]
      have heform : e ^ 2 = r ^ 2 * p ^ 2 := by
        rw [heSq]
        dsimp [r]
        ring
      have hr2 : (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have heLower : (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ 4 < e ^ 2 := by
        calc
          (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ 4 =
              (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ 2 * (1 / 16 : ℝ) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ < r ^ 2 * r ^ 2 :=
            mul_self_lt_mul_self (by norm_num) hr2
          _ ≤ r ^ 2 * p ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hpge (sq_nonneg r)
          _ = e ^ 2 := heform.symm
      have heUpper : e ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 1000 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        by simpa [pow_two] using mul_self_le_mul_self he0.le he1
      norm_num at heLower heUpper
      linarith
  · by_contra hnot
    have ha : 9 / 8 ≤ a := not_lt.mp hnot
    rcases hXsign with hpos | hneg
    · have hxX : x ≤ X := by dsimp [X]; linarith
      have hxx : x ^ 2 ≤ x * X := by
        simpa [pow_two] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hxX hpos.1.le
      have hhalf1 : 1 / 2 ≤ x * X := by nlinarith
      have hhalf2 : 1 / 2 ≤ X ^ 2 := by
        have hmul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hxX hpos.2.le
        exact hhalf1.trans (by simpa [pow_two] using hmul)
      have hquarter : 1 / 4 ≤ e ^ 2 := by
        rw [heSq, hp2]
        calc
          (1 / 4 : ℝ) = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) := by norm_num
          _ ≤ X ^ 2 * (x * X) :=
            mul_le_mul hhalf2 hhalf1 (by norm_num) (sq_nonneg X)
      have hesmall : e ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 1000 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
        by simpa [pow_two] using mul_self_le_mul_self he0.le he1
      norm_num at hquarter hesmall
      linarith
    · have hxlt : x < -1 := by
        dsimp [X] at hneg
        linarith
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + 1)]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.coordinate_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  let i : Fin (m + 2) := j.pred hj0
  have hji : i.succ = j := Fin.succ_pred j hj0
  have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := by
    intro hi
    apply hj1
    rw [← hji, hi]
    rfl
  have hi1 : i ≠ 1 := by
    intro hi
    apply hj2
    rw [← hji, hi]
    rfl
  have hi2 : i ≠ 2 := by
    intro hi
    apply hj3
    rw [← hji, hi]
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)]
  have hout := congrArg (fun q : F => q i) hx
  rw [coreMap_apply_tail m hm a e x hi0 hi1 hi2] at hout
  simp only [PiLp.zero_apply] at hout
  rwa [hji] at hout

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.eventSpatialLift_apply_zero
statement:
@[simp] lemma eventSpatialLift_apply_zero
    (c0 c1 c2 c3 : ℝ) (y : F) :
    eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y 0 = c0
proof:
:= by
  simp [eventSpatialLift]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.eventSpatialLift_apply_succ
statement:
@[simp] lemma eventSpatialLift_apply_succ
    (c0 c1 c2 c3 : ℝ) (y : F) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y i.succ =
      if i = 0 then c1
      else if i = 1 then c2
      else if i = 2 then c3
      else y i
proof:
:= by
  simp [eventSpatialLift]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.eventSpatialLift_apply_one
statement:
@[simp] lemma eventSpatialLift_apply_one
    (c0 c1 c2 c3 : ℝ) (y : F) :
    eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y 1 = c1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (1 : Fin (m + 3)) = (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  calc
    _ = eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y (0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y j) h1
    _ = _ := by
      simpa using eventSpatialLift_apply_succ m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y
        (0 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.eventSpatialLift_apply_two
statement:
@[simp] lemma eventSpatialLift_apply_two
    (c0 c1 c2 c3 : ℝ) (y : F) :
    eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y 2 = c2
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : (2 : Fin (m + 3)) = (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3)]
  have h10 : (1 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < m + 2)] at hv
  calc
    _ = eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y (1 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y j) h2
    _ = _ := by
      simpa [h10] using eventSpatialLift_apply_succ m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y
        (1 : Fin (m + 2))

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.eventSpatialLift_apply_three
statement:
@[simp] lemma eventSpatialLift_apply_three
    (c0 c1 c2 c3 : ℝ) (y : F) :
    eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y 3 = c3
proof:
:= by
  have h3 : (3 : Fin (m + 3)) = (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)]
  have h20 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at hv
  have h21 : (2 : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2)] at hv
  calc
    _ = eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y (2 : Fin (m + 2)).succ :=
      congrArg (fun j => eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y j) h3
    _ = _ := by simp [h20, h21]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.eventSpatialLift_apply_tail
statement:
lemma eventSpatialLift_apply_tail
    (c0 c1 c2 c3 : ℝ) (y : F) {i : Fin (m + 2)}
    (hi0 : i ≠ 0) (hi1 : i ≠ 1) (hi2 : i ≠ 2) :
    eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y i.succ = y i
proof:
:= by
  simp [eventSpatialLift, hi0, hi1, hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.inner_eventSpatialLift_of_coreMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma inner_eventSpatialLift_of_coreMap_eq_zero
    {a e : ℝ} {x : E} (hx : coreMap m hm a e x = 0)
    (c0 c1 c2 c3 : ℝ) (y : F) :
    ⟪x, eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y⟫_ℝ =
      x 0 * c0 + x 1 * c1 + x 2 * c2 + x 3 * c3
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_eq_sum_local]
  have hpoint : ∀ j : Fin (m + 3),
      x j * eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y j =
        (if j = 0 then x 0 * c0 else 0) +
        (if j = 1 then x 1 * c1 else 0) +
        (if j = 2 then x 2 * c2 else 0) +
        (if j = 3 then x 3 * c3 else 0) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      have h02 : (0 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 2 := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3)] at hv
      have h03 : (0 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 3 := by
        intro h
        have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)] at hv
      simp [h02, h03]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        have h12 : (1 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 2 := by
          intro h
          have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
          simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3)] at hv
        have h13 : (1 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 3 := by
          intro h
          have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
          simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)] at hv
        simp [hj0, h12, h13]
      · by_cases hj2 : j = 2
        · subst j
          have h23 : (2 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 3 := by
            intro h
            have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
            simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3),
              Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)] at hv
          simp [hj0, hj1, h23]
        · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
          · subst j
            simp [hj0, hj1, hj2]
          · rw [coordinate_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
              hj0 hj1 hj2 hj3]
            simp [hj0, hj1, hj2, hj3]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => hpoint j]
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (0 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => x 0 * c0),
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (1 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => x 1 * c1),
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (2 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => x 2 * c2),
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (3 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => x 3 * c3),
    if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]

statement:
lemma eventSpatialLift_spaceTime_apply_tail
    (c0 c1 c2 c3 s : ℝ) (y : F) {i : Fin (m + 2)}

        i.succ.castSucc = y i
proof:

        (initCLM_spaceTime (eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y) s)
      simpa [initCLM_apply] using h

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.first_four_sq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero
statement:
lemma first_four_sq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero
    {a e : ℝ} {x : E} (hx : coreMap m hm a e x = 0) :
    x 0 ^ 2 + x 1 ^ 2 + x 2 ^ 2 + x 3 ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  let z : F := 0
  let w : E := eventSpatialLift m hm (x 0) (x 1) (x 2) (x 3) z
  have hw : w = x := by
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro j
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      simp [w]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        simp [w]
      · by_cases hj2 : j = 2
        · subst j
          simp [w]
        · by_cases hj3 : j = 3
          · subst j
            simp [w]
          · let i : Fin (m + 2) := j.pred hj0
            have hji : i.succ = j := Fin.succ_pred j hj0
            have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := by
              intro hi
              apply hj1
              rw [← hji, hi]
              rfl
            have hi1 : i ≠ 1 := by
              intro hi
              apply hj2
              rw [← hji, hi]
              rfl
            have hi2 : i ≠ 2 := by
              intro hi
              apply hj3
              rw [← hji, hi]
              apply Fin.ext
              simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 2),
                Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3)]
            have hxi : x i.succ = 0 := by
              rw [hji]
              exact coordinate_eq_zero_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
                hj0 hj1 hj2 hj3
            rw [← hji, eventSpatialLift_apply_tail m hm _ _ _ _ z hi0 hi1 hi2]
            simp [z, hxi]
  have hinner := inner_eventSpatialLift_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx
    (x 0) (x 1) (x 2) (x 3) z
  change ⟪x, w⟫_ℝ =
    x 0 * x 0 + x 1 * x 1 + x 2 * x 2 + x 3 * x 3 at hinner
  rw [hw, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
    ← CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq,
    normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hx] at hinner
  nlinarith

        (spaceTime (eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y) s) 0 =
      v 0 * c0 + v 1 * c1 + v 2 * c2 + v 3 * c3
proof:
:= by

    {v : E'} (c0 c1 c2 c3 s : ℝ) (y : F) :

        (spaceTime (eventSpatialLift m hm c0 c1 c2 c3 y) s) 1 =

        c1 * v 3 + v 1 * c3 +
        (deriv shift (vertC v) * v 2 - deriv epsilon (vertC v)) * s

    spaceTime_eventSpatialLift_apply_zero,

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.fderiv_eventCoreMap_spaceTime_zero_eq_source
statement:
lemma fderiv_eventCoreMap_spaceTime_zero_eq_source
    (v : E') (h : E) (ha : shift (vertC v) = 0) :
    fderiv ℝ (eventCoreMap m hm) v (spaceTime h 0) =
      fderiv ℝ (CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap m hm)
        (initCLM (m + 3) v) h
proof:
:= by
  have h2cast : ((2 : Fin (m + 3)).castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) = 2 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 3),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 4)]
  have h3cast : ((3 : Fin (m + 3)).castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) = 3 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 4)]
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_zero,
      CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_apply_zero,
      initCLM_spaceTime]
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_one,
        CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_apply_one,
        spaceTime_apply_spatial_zero, spaceTime_apply_spatial_one,
        spaceTime_apply_spatial_two, spaceTime_apply_spatial_three m hm,
        vertC_spaceTime, ha]
      simp [initCLM_apply, h2cast, h3cast]
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_two,
          CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_apply_two,
          spaceTime_apply_spatial_zero, spaceTime_apply_spatial_one,
          spaceTime_apply_spatial_two, spaceTime_apply_spatial_three m hm,
          vertC_spaceTime, ha]
        simp [initCLM_apply, h2cast, h3cast]
      · rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_tail m hm v _ hi0 hi1 hi2,
          CompactHopfPairConfiguration.fderiv_coreMap_apply_tail
            m hm (initCLM (m + 3) v) h hi0 hi1 hi2]
        have hcoord := congrArg (fun z : E => z i.succ) (initCLM_spaceTime h 0)
        simpa [initCLM_apply] using hcoord

    (v : E') (h : E) (ha : shift (vertC v) = 2) :
    fderiv ℝ (eventCoreMap m hm) v (spaceTime h 0) =
      fderiv ℝ (coreMap m hm 2 0) (initCLM (m + 3) v) h
proof:
:= by

    apply Fin.ext

      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < m + 4)]
  have h3cast : ((3 : Fin (m + 3)).castSucc : Fin (m + 4)) = 3 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 3),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < m + 4)]
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro i
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_zero,
      fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_zero, initCLM_spaceTime]
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_one,
        fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_one,
        spaceTime_apply_spatial_zero, spaceTime_apply_spatial_one,
        spaceTime_apply_spatial_two, spaceTime_apply_spatial_three m hm,
        vertC_spaceTime, ha]
      simp [initCLM_apply, h2cast, h3cast]
    · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
      · subst i
        rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_two,
          fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_two,
          spaceTime_apply_spatial_zero, spaceTime_apply_spatial_one,
          spaceTime_apply_spatial_two, spaceTime_apply_spatial_three m hm,
          vertC_spaceTime, ha]
        simp [initCLM_apply, h2cast, h3cast]
      · rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_apply_tail m hm v _ hi0 hi1 hi2,
          fderiv_target_coreMap_apply_tail m hm (initCLM (m + 3) v) h
            hi0 hi1 hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.surjective_fderiv_eventCoreMap_of_epsilon_eq_zero
statement:
lemma surjective_fderiv_eventCoreMap_of_epsilon_eq_zero
    {v : E'} (hv : eventCoreMap m hm v = 0)
    (he : epsilon (vertC v) = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (eventCoreMap m hm) v)
proof:
:= by
  have hcore : coreMap m hm (shift (vertC v)) (epsilon (vertC v))
      (initCLM (m + 3) v) = 0 := by
    simpa [eventCoreMap] using hv
  rcases epsilon_eq_zero_time_dichotomy he with ht | ht
  · have ha : shift (vertC v) = 0 := shift_of_le_quarter ht
    have hsource : CompactHopfPairConfiguration.coreMap m hm
        (initCLM (m + 3) v) = 0 := by
      rw [← coreMap_zero_zero_eq_source m hm]
      simpa [ha, he] using hcore
    intro y
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ :=
      CompactHopfPairConfiguration.surjective_fderiv_coreMap_of_eq_zero
        m hm hsource y
    refine ⟨spaceTime h 0, ?_⟩
    rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_spaceTime_zero_eq_source m hm v h ha]
    exact hh
  · have ha : shift (vertC v) = 2 := shift_of_threeQuarter_le ht
    have htarget : coreMap m hm 2 0 (initCLM (m + 3) v) = 0 := by
      simpa [ha, he] using hcore
    intro y
    obtain ⟨h, hh⟩ :=
      surjective_fderiv_target_coreMap_of_eq_zero m hm htarget y
    refine ⟨spaceTime h 0, ?_⟩
    rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_spaceTime_zero_eq_target m hm v h ha]
    exact hh

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.surjective_fderiv_eventCoreMap_of_epsilon_pos
statement:
lemma surjective_fderiv_eventCoreMap_of_epsilon_pos
    {v : E'} (hv : eventCoreMap m hm v = 0)
    (he : 0 < epsilon (vertC v)) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (eventCoreMap m hm) v)
proof:
:= by
  let X : ℝ := v 0 + shift (vertC v)
  let W : ℝ := X ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2
  let U : ℝ := v 2 ^ 2 + v 3 ^ 2
  let S : ℝ := W + U
  let RX : ℝ := v 0 * W - X * U
  let RY : ℝ := v 1 * (W - U)
  have hsphere := eventCoreMap_zero_sphere m hm hv
  have hre := eventCoreMap_zero_pairRe m hm hv
  have him := eventCoreMap_zero_pairIm m hm hv
  have hSnonneg : 0 ≤ S := by
    dsimp [S, W, U]
    positivity
  have hS : S ≠ 0 := by
    intro hS0
    have hXsq : X ^ 2 = 0 := by
      dsimp [S, W, U] at hS0
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg X, sq_nonneg (v 1),
        sq_nonneg (v 2), sq_nonneg (v 3)]
    have hysq : v 1 ^ 2 = 0 := by
      dsimp [S, W, U] at hS0
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg X, sq_nonneg (v 1),
        sq_nonneg (v 2), sq_nonneg (v 3)]
    have hX0 : X = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hXsq
    have hy0 : v 1 = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hysq
    change X * v 2 + v 1 * v 3 = epsilon (vertC v) at hre
    rw [hX0, hy0] at hre
    norm_num at hre
    linarith
  have hSpos : 0 < S := lt_of_le_of_ne hSnonneg (Ne.symm hS)
  intro y
  let A : ℝ := y 1 / S
  let B : ℝ := y 2 / S
  let b0 : ℝ := A * v 2 - B * v 3
  let b1 : ℝ := A * v 3 + B * v 2
  let b2 : ℝ := A * X + B * v 1
  let b3 : ℝ := A * v 1 - B * X
  let rbase : ℝ := v 0 * b0 + v 1 * b1 + v 2 * b2 + v 3 * b3
  have hAS : A * S = y 1 := by
    dsimp [A]
    field_simp [hS]
  have hBS : B * S = y 2 := by
    dsimp [B]
    field_simp [hS]
  have hbase1 :
      b0 * v 2 + X * b2 + b1 * v 3 + v 1 * b3 = y 1 := by
    calc
      _ = A * S := by
        dsimp [b0, b1, b2, b3, S, W, U]
        ring
      _ = y 1 := hAS
  have hbase2 :
      b1 * v 2 + v 1 * b2 - b0 * v 3 - X * b3 = y 2 := by
    calc
      _ = B * S := by
        dsimp [b0, b1, b2, b3, S, W, U]
        ring
      _ = y 2 := hBS
  by_cases hRX : RX ≠ 0
  · let c : ℝ := (y 0 - rbase) / RX
    let k2 : ℝ := -X * v 2 + v 1 * v 3
    let k3 : ℝ := -v 1 * v 2 - X * v 3
    have hk0 : v 0 * W + v 2 * k2 + v 3 * k3 = RX := by
      dsimp [k2, k3, RX, W, U, X]
      ring
    have hk1 : W * v 2 + X * k2 + v 1 * k3 = 0 := by
      dsimp [k2, k3, W]
      ring
    have hk2 : v 1 * k2 - W * v 3 - X * k3 = 0 := by
      dsimp [k2, k3, W]
      ring
    refine ⟨spaceTime
      (eventSpatialLift m hm (b0 + c * W) b1
        (b2 + c * k2) (b3 + c * k3) y) 0, ?_⟩
    apply PiLp.ext
    intro i
    by_cases hi0 : i = 0
    · subst i
      rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_zero m hm hv]
      calc
        _ = rbase + c * RX := by
          rw [← hk0]
          dsimp [rbase]
          ring
        _ = y 0 := by
          dsimp [c]
          field_simp [hRX]
          ring
    · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
      · subst i
        rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_one]
        simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
        calc
          _ = (b0 * v 2 + X * b2 + b1 * v 3 + v 1 * b3) +
              c * (W * v 2 + X * k2 + v 1 * k3) := by
            ring
          _ = y 1 := by rw [hbase1, hk1]; ring
      · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
        · subst i
          rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_two]
          simp only [mul_zero, sub_zero]
          calc
            _ = (b1 * v 2 + v 1 * b2 - b0 * v 3 - X * b3) +
                c * (v 1 * k2 - W * v 3 - X * k3) := by
              ring
            _ = y 2 := by rw [hbase2, hk2]; ring
        · rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_tail
            m hm _ _ _ _ _ y hi0 hi1 hi2]
  · have hRX0 : RX = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hRX
    by_cases hRY : RY ≠ 0
    · let c : ℝ := (y 0 - rbase) / RY
      let k2 : ℝ := -X * v 3 - v 1 * v 2
      let k3 : ℝ := -v 1 * v 3 + X * v 2
      have hk0 : v 1 * W + v 2 * k2 + v 3 * k3 = RY := by
        dsimp [k2, k3, RY, W, U]
        ring
      have hk1 : X * k2 + W * v 3 + v 1 * k3 = 0 := by
        dsimp [k2, k3, W]
        ring
      have hk2 : W * v 2 + v 1 * k2 - X * k3 = 0 := by
        dsimp [k2, k3, W]
        ring
      refine ⟨spaceTime
        (eventSpatialLift m hm b0 (b1 + c * W)
          (b2 + c * k2) (b3 + c * k3) y) 0, ?_⟩
      apply PiLp.ext
      intro i
      by_cases hi0 : i = 0
      · subst i
        rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_zero m hm hv]
        calc
          _ = rbase + c * RY := by
            rw [← hk0]
            dsimp [rbase]
            ring
          _ = y 0 := by
            dsimp [c]
            field_simp [hRY]
            ring
      · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
        · subst i
          rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_one]
          simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]
          calc
            _ = (b0 * v 2 + X * b2 + b1 * v 3 + v 1 * b3) +
                c * (X * k2 + W * v 3 + v 1 * k3) := by
              ring
            _ = y 1 := by rw [hbase1, hk1]; ring
        · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
          · subst i
            rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_two]
            simp only [mul_zero, sub_zero]
            calc
              _ = (b1 * v 2 + v 1 * b2 - b0 * v 3 - X * b3) +
                  c * (W * v 2 + v 1 * k2 - X * k3) := by
                ring
              _ = y 2 := by rw [hbase2, hk2]; ring
          · rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_tail
              m hm _ _ _ _ _ y hi0 hi1 hi2]
    · have hRY0 : RY = 0 := not_ne_iff.mp hRY
      have hcrit := critical_shift_mem_middle (m := m) (hm := hm)
        (x := v 0) (y := v 1) (p := v 2) (q := v 3)
        (a := shift (vertC v)) (e := epsilon (vertC v))
        (shift_nonneg (vertC v)) (shift_le_two (vertC v)) he
        (epsilon_le_small (vertC v)) hsphere hre him
        (by simpa [RX, W, U, X] using hRX0)
        (by simpa [RY, W, U, X] using hRY0)
      have ht0 : 3 / 8 < vertC v := by
        by_contra hnot
        have hle : vertC v ≤ 3 / 8 := not_lt.mp hnot
        linarith [shift_le_seven_eighth hle]
      have ht1 : vertC v < 5 / 8 := by
        by_contra hnot
        have hle : 5 / 8 ≤ vertC v := not_lt.mp hnot
        linarith [nine_eighth_le_shift hle]
      have hda : deriv shift (vertC v) = 1 :=
        (hasDerivAt_shift_of_middle ht0 ht1).deriv
      have hde : deriv epsilon (vertC v) = 0 :=
        (hasDerivAt_epsilon_of_middle ht0 ht1).deriv
      have hWnonneg : 0 ≤ W := by
        dsimp [W]
        positivity
      have hWpos : 0 < W := by
        by_contra hnot
        have hW0 : W = 0 := le_antisymm (not_lt.mp hnot) hWnonneg
        have hXsq : X ^ 2 = 0 := by
          dsimp [W] at hW0
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg X, sq_nonneg (v 1)]
        have hysq : v 1 ^ 2 = 0 := by
          dsimp [W] at hW0
          nlinarith [sq_nonneg X, sq_nonneg (v 1)]
        have hX0 : X = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hXsq
        have hy0 : v 1 = 0 := sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hysq
        change X * v 2 + v 1 * v 3 = epsilon (vertC v) at hre
        rw [hX0, hy0] at hre
        norm_num at hre
        linarith
      have hWU : W ≠ U := by
        intro hEq
        have hRX' := hRX0
        dsimp [RX, X] at hRX'
        rw [← hEq] at hRX'
        have haW : shift (vertC v) * W = 0 := by nlinarith
        exact (mul_ne_zero (by linarith [hcrit.1]) hWpos.ne') haW
      have hy0 : v 1 = 0 := by
        have hRY' := hRY0
        dsimp [RY] at hRY'
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hRY').resolve_right (sub_ne_zero.mpr hWU)
      have hX : X ≠ 0 := by
        intro hX0
        have hW' := hWpos
        dsimp [W] at hW'
        rw [hX0, hy0] at hW'
        norm_num at hW'
      have hq0 : v 3 = 0 := by
        have him' := him
        change v 1 * v 2 - X * v 3 = 0 at him'
        rw [hy0] at him'
        have hXq : X * v 3 = 0 := by nlinarith
        exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hXq).resolve_left hX
      have hXp : X * v 2 = epsilon (vertC v) := by
        have hre' := hre
        change X * v 2 + v 1 * v 3 = epsilon (vertC v) at hre'
        simpa [hy0, hq0] using hre'
      have hp : v 2 ≠ 0 := by
        intro hp0
        rw [hp0, mul_zero] at hXp
        linarith
      let k2 : ℝ := -X * v 2 + v 1 * v 3
      let k3 : ℝ := -v 1 * v 2 - X * v 3
      let RT : ℝ := v 2 * k2 + v 3 * k3
      have hRTform : RT = -epsilon (vertC v) * v 2 := by
        dsimp [RT, k2, k3]
        rw [hy0, hq0]
        rw [← hXp]
        ring
      have hRT : RT ≠ 0 := by
        rw [hRTform]
        exact mul_ne_zero (neg_ne_zero.mpr he.ne') hp
      have hk1 : X * k2 + v 1 * k3 = -W * v 2 := by
        dsimp [k2, k3, W]
        ring
      have hk2 : v 1 * k2 - X * k3 = W * v 3 := by
        dsimp [k2, k3, W]
        ring
      let c : ℝ := (y 0 - rbase) / RT
      refine ⟨spaceTime
        (eventSpatialLift m hm b0 b1
          (b2 + c * k2) (b3 + c * k3) y) (c * W), ?_⟩
      apply PiLp.ext
      intro i
      by_cases hi0 : i = 0
      · subst i
        rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_zero m hm hv]
        calc
          _ = rbase + c * RT := by
            dsimp [rbase, RT]
            ring
          _ = y 0 := by
            dsimp [c]
            field_simp [hRT]
            ring
      · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
        · subst i
          rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_one]
          rw [hda, hde]
          calc
            _ = (b0 * v 2 + X * b2 + b1 * v 3 + v 1 * b3) +
                c * (X * k2 + v 1 * k3 + W * v 2) := by
              ring
            _ = y 1 := by rw [hbase1, hk1]; ring
        · by_cases hi2 : i = 2
          · subst i
            rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_two]
            rw [hda]
            calc
              _ = (b1 * v 2 + v 1 * b2 - b0 * v 3 - X * b3) +
                  c * (v 1 * k2 - X * k3 - W * v 3) := by
                ring
              _ = y 2 := by rw [hbase2, hk2]; ring
          · rw [fderiv_eventCoreMap_eventSpatialLift_apply_tail
              m hm _ _ _ _ _ y hi0 hi1 hi2]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.surjective_fderiv_eventCoreMap_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem surjective_fderiv_eventCoreMap_of_eq_zero
    {v : E'} (hv : eventCoreMap m hm v = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (eventCoreMap m hm) v)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases he : epsilon (vertC v) = 0
  · exact surjective_fderiv_eventCoreMap_of_epsilon_eq_zero m hm hv he
  · apply surjective_fderiv_eventCoreMap_of_epsilon_pos m hm hv
    exact lt_of_le_of_ne (epsilon_nonneg (vertC v)) (Ne.symm he)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.eventMap_eventuallyEq_eventCoreMap
proof:
:= by
  have hvlevel : levelMap m hm (shift (vertC v)) (epsilon (vertC v))
      (initCLM (m + 3) v) = 0 := by
    simpa [eventMap] using hv
  have hcore :=
    (levelMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero m hm _ _ _).mp hvlevel
  have hn := normSq_eq_one_of_coreMap_eq_zero m hm hcore
  have hcont : Continuous (fun q : E' =>
      CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) q)) :=
    CompactBirth.contDiff_normSq.continuous.comp
      (initCLM (m + 3)).continuous
  have hopen : IsOpen {q : E' |
      CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) q) < 2} :=
    isOpen_lt hcont continuous_const
  have hvopen : v ∈ {q : E' |
      CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) q) < 2} := by
    change CompactBirth.normSq (initCLM (m + 3) v) < 2
    rw [hn]
    norm_num
  exact Filter.eventuallyEq_of_mem (hopen.mem_nhds hvopen) fun q hq => by
    simp [eventMap, eventCoreMap, levelMap,
      CompactBirth.cutoff_eq_zero hq.le]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.surjective_fderiv_eventMap_of_eq_zero
statement:
theorem surjective_fderiv_eventMap_of_eq_zero
    {v : E'} (hv : eventMap m hm v = 0) :
    Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ (eventMap m hm) v)
proof:
:= by
  have hvlevel : levelMap m hm (shift (vertC v)) (epsilon (vertC v))
      (initCLM (m + 3) v) = 0 := by
    simpa [eventMap] using hv
  have hcore : eventCoreMap m hm v = 0 := by
    simpa [eventCoreMap] using
      (levelMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero m hm _ _ _).mp hvlevel
  rw [(eventMap_eventuallyEq_eventCoreMap m hm hv).fderiv_eq]
  exact surjective_fderiv_eventCoreMap_of_eq_zero m hm hcore

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.eventMap_eq_zero_iff_coreMap_eq_zero

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.eventMap_spatial_normSq_eq_one

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairPants.eventMap_spatial_bounded
statement:
lemma eventMap_spatial_bounded :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ v, eventMap m hm v = 0 → ‖initCLM (m + 3) v‖ ≤ R
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  have hn := eventMap_spatial_normSq_eq_one m hm hv
  rw [CompactBirth.normSq_eq_norm_sq] at hn
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (initCLM (m + 3) v)]

name: Submission.SmoothCartesianSOLoop.nonempty_nullGaugeData
statement:
theorem nonempty_nullGaugeData (L : SmoothCartesianSOLoop r)
    (hr : 3 ≤ r)
    (hclass : loopClassZ2 L.loop L.closed = 0) :
    Nonempty L.NullGaugeData
proof:
:= by
  let e : C(I, SOGroup r) := ContinuousMap.const I 1
  have heclosed : e 0 = e 1 := rfl
  have he : ∀ u : I, e u = 1 := fun _ => rfl
  have hclasses : loopClassZ2 e heclosed = loopClassZ2 L.loop L.closed := by
    rw [loopClassZ2_const, hclass]
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ, hQzero, hQone⟩ :=
    exists_contDiff_cartesianSOHomotopy_of_loopClassZ2_eq
      hr heclosed L.closed he hclasses L.cartesian
      L.loop_eq_cartesian L.cartesian_smooth
  exact ⟨⟨Q, hQ, hQzero, hQone⟩⟩

theorem NullGaugeData.signedCobordism_productOn
    {L : SmoothCartesianSOLoop (m + 2)} (D : L.NullGaugeData)

proof:
:=
  SOLocalRelativeNormalization.signedCobordism_productOn

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.le_dist_of_cover_of_le_norm
statement:
theorem le_dist_of_cover_of_le_norm (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) {ρ eps : ℝ}
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} (hw : ρ ≤ ‖w‖) (hwrad : ‖w‖ < T.radius)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hfib : C.G (M.param w) = 0) :
    eps ≤ dist (M.param w) center
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  rw [not_le] at hlt
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := hcover (M.param w) hlt hfib
  have hballu : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hu.trans hρrad
  have hballw : w ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hwrad
  have huw : u = w := T.param_injOn hballu hballw hup
  rw [huw] at hu
  linarith

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_param_normLower_neighborhood
statement:
theorem exists_param_normLower_neighborhood
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (H : M.FullRadiusSmooth)
    (u₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) {r rInj ρ : ℝ}
    (hrrInj : r < rInj) (hrInj : rInj ≤ T.radius) (hu₀ : ‖u₀‖ < rInj)
    (hρ : ρ < ‖u₀‖) :
    ∃ ε > 0, ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < r →
      dist (M.param u) (M.param u₀) < ε → ρ < ‖u‖
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let Φ := M.param
  let bad : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) :=
    closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) r ∩
      {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) | ‖u‖ ≤ ρ}
  have hbadCompact : IsCompact bad := by
    apply (isCompact_closedBall (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) r).inter_right
    exact isClosed_le continuous_norm continuous_const
  have hbadBall : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), u ∈ bad →
      u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    intro u hu
    have hur : ‖u‖ ≤ r := by
      simpa [bad, mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu.1
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact (hur.trans_lt hrrInj).trans_le hrInj
  have hbadSub : bad ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) M.radius := by
    intro u hu
    have := hbadBall u hu
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] at this ⊢
    exact this.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hΦcont : ContinuousOn Φ bad := by
    intro u hu
    exact (H.differentiableAt u
      (by simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right] using
        hbadSub hu)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
  have himageCompact : IsCompact (Φ '' bad) :=
    hbadCompact.image_of_continuousOn hΦcont
  have hu₀Ball : u₀ ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hu₀.trans_le hrInj
  have hnotmem : Φ u₀ ∉ Φ '' bad := by
    rintro ⟨u, huBad, hu⟩
    have heq : u = u₀ := T.param_injOn (hbadBall u huBad) hu₀Ball hu
    have hbadNorm : ‖u‖ ≤ ρ := huBad.2
    rw [heq] at hbadNorm
    linarith
  have hnhds : (Φ '' bad)ᶜ ∈ nhds (Φ u₀) :=
    himageCompact.isClosed.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hnotmem
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hnhds
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  intro u hu hdist
  by_contra hnot
  rw [not_lt] at hnot
  have huBad : u ∈ bad := by
    constructor
    · simpa [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] using hu.le
    · exact hnot
  have himage : Φ u ∈ Φ '' bad := ⟨u, huBad, rfl⟩
  have hballmem : Φ u ∈ Metric.ball (Φ u₀) ε := by
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball] using hdist
  exact (hball hballmem) himage

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_outerEndpointLocalFiberCover
statement:
theorem exists_outerEndpointLocalFiberCover
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (H : M.FullRadiusSmooth)
    (hCD : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < M.radius →
      ContDiffAt ℝ 1 M.param u)
    (u₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) {R ρ : ℝ}
    (hu₀R : ‖u₀‖ < R) (hR : R < T.radius) (hρ : ρ < ‖u₀‖) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v (M.param u₀) < δ → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < R ∧ ρ < ‖u‖ ∧ M.param u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁, hcov⟩ := T.exists_endpointLocalFiberCover hCD u₀
    (hu₀R.trans hR) hu₀R (hR.le.trans T.radius_le)
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hloc⟩ := T.exists_param_normLower_neighborhood H u₀
    (r := R) (rInj := T.radius) hR le_rfl (hu₀R.trans hR) hρ
  refine ⟨min δ₁ ε, lt_min hδ₁ hε, ?_⟩
  intro v hv hG
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := hcov v (hv.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)) hG
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_, hup⟩
  refine hloc u hu ?_
  rw [hup]
  exact hv.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalCover
statement:
theorem exists_chronologicalSaddleOuterCriticalCover
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    ∃ δ > 0, ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)) < δ →
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleOuterParamRadius t ht ∧
        D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht < ‖u‖ ∧
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u = v
proof:
:= by
  have hρ' : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht
  have hnorm : ‖saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)‖ =
      D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht :=
    norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam p.1 p.2 hρ'
      (by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hρ'])
  exact StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_outerEndpointLocalFiberCover
    (T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
    (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
    (D.eventModel_param_contDiffAt_one t ht)
    (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht))
    (R := D.chronologicalSaddleOuterParamRadius t ht)
    (ρ := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
    (by
      rw [hnorm]
      exact D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_outerParamRadius t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleOuterParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
    (by
      rw [hnorm]
      exact D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_endpointParamRadius t ht)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.continuousAt_outerSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_scale
statement:
theorem continuousAt_outerSaddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_scale
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    ContinuousAt (fun c : ℝ =>
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) c) 0
proof:
:= by
  have hrho : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht
  have hparam : Continuous (fun c : ℝ =>
      saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam p.1 p.2
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) c) := by
    rcases p with ⟨b, e⟩
    cases b <;> cases e <;>
      simp only [saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam, saddlePositiveArc,
        saddleBoundaryParameter, pairToMorseParam, signedBranch] <;>
      fun_prop
  have hnorm0 : ‖saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam p.1 p.2
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) 0‖ <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius := by
    rw [norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam p.1 p.2 hrho
      (by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hrho])]
    exact (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  exact (((D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht).differentiableAt _
    hnorm0).continuousAt).comp hparam.continuousAt

name: Submission.le_dist_center_of_saddleChart_avoid
statement:
theorem le_dist_center_of_saddleChart_avoid {n : ℕ}
    {C : FramedLevelCobordism n} {center : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    {M : StandardMorseEventAt (n := n) C center} (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps w : ℝ} (hρM : ρ < M.radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} (hfib : C.G x = 0)
    (htime : tcoord x = tcoord center + w)
    (havoid : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = w → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ≠ spacePart x) :
    eps ≤ dist x center
proof:
:= by
  by_contra hlt
  rw [not_le] at hlt
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hup⟩ := hcover x hlt hfib
  have huM : ‖u‖ < M.radius := hu.trans hρM
  have hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = w := by
    have htm := M.time_model u huM
    rw [hindex, hup, htime] at htm
    linarith
  exact havoid u hquad hu (congrArg spacePart hup)

name: Submission.SaddleChartAvoidBand.far_of_avoid
statement:
theorem far_of_avoid
    (B : SaddleChartAvoidBand M ρ eps dbefore dafter R hbefore hafter
      Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat) {c₀ c₁ : I}
    (havoid : ∀ (q : I) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = dafter → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ≠
        (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).curve
          (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q)) (q : I) :
    eps / 2 + (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |dafter| ≤
      dist ((Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).sliceAmbientSubarc
        c₀ c₁ q) center
proof:
:= by
  set x := (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).sliceAmbientSubarc
    c₀ c₁ q with hx
  have hfib : C.G x = 0 :=
    sliceAmbientSubarc_mem_fiber
      (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat) c₀ c₁ q
  have htime : tcoord x = tcoord center + dafter := by
    rw [hx, SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply, tcoord_spaceTime,
      B.htafter]
  have hspace : spacePart x =
      (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).curve
        (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q) := by
    rw [hx, SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      spacePart_spaceTime]
  have hdist : eps ≤ dist x center := by
    refine le_dist_center_of_saddleChart_avoid B.hindex B.hρM B.hcover hfib
      htime ?_
    intro u hquad hnorm
    rw [hspace]
    exact havoid q u hquad hnorm
  have hf := B.hflow
  linarith

theorem sortedMark_cut_conditions (A : P.CyclicMarking k) (i : Fin k) :

proof:

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.exterior_pair_of_disjoint_cyclicCutRange
statement:
theorem exterior_pair_of_disjoint_cyclicCutRange (A : P.CyclicMarking 3)
    {i j : Fin 4}
    (hdisj : Disjoint (A.cyclicCutRange i) (A.cyclicCutRange j)) :
    ((0 : Fin 4) ≠ i ∧ (0 : Fin 4) ≠ j ∧
        (2 : Fin 4) ≠ i ∧ (2 : Fin 4) ≠ j) ∨
      ((1 : Fin 4) ≠ i ∧ (1 : Fin 4) ≠ j ∧
        (3 : Fin 4) ≠ i ∧ (3 : Fin 4) ≠ j)
proof:
:= by
  have hkey : ∀ x, x ∈ A.cyclicCutRange i → x ∈ A.cyclicCutRange j → False :=
    fun x h1 h2 => Set.disjoint_left.mp hdisj h1 h2
  have h0a := A.curve_sortedMark_castSucc_mem (0 : Fin 3)
  have h0b := A.curve_sortedMark_succ_mem (0 : Fin 3)
  have h1a := A.curve_sortedMark_castSucc_mem (1 : Fin 3)
  have h1b := A.curve_sortedMark_succ_mem (1 : Fin 3)
  have h2a := A.curve_sortedMark_castSucc_mem (2 : Fin 3)
  have h2b := A.curve_sortedMark_succ_mem (2 : Fin 3)
  have h3a := A.curve_sortedMark_last_mem_last
  have h3b := A.curve_sortedMark_zero_mem_last
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j
  · exact (hkey _ h0a h0a).elim
  · exact (hkey _ h0b h1a).elim
  · exact Or.inr ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩
  · exact (hkey _ h0a h3b).elim
  · exact (hkey _ h1a h0b).elim
  · exact (hkey _ h1a h1a).elim
  · exact (hkey _ h1b h2a).elim
  · exact Or.inl ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩
  · exact Or.inr ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩
  · exact (hkey _ h2a h1b).elim
  · exact (hkey _ h2a h2a).elim
  · exact (hkey _ h2b h3a).elim
  · exact (hkey _ h3b h0a).elim
  · exact Or.inl ⟨by decide, by decide, by decide, by decide⟩
  · exact (hkey _ h3a h2b).elim
  · exact (hkey _ h3a h3a).elim

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.sortedMark_last_ne_zero

theorem sortedMark_last_ne_zero (A : P.CyclicMarking (k + 1)) :
    A.sortedMark (Fin.last (k + 1)) ≠ 0

:= by
  intro h
  have hlt : A.sortedMark 0 < A.sortedMark (Fin.last (k + 1)) := by
    apply A.sortedMark_strictMono
    exact Fin.lt_last_iff_ne_last.mpr (by simp [Fin.ext_iff])
  rw [h] at hlt
  exact absurd hlt (not_lt_of_ge (A.zero_le_sortedMark_zero))

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveCommonOrbit_avoid_of_mem_exteriorCut
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveCommonOrbit_avoid_of_mem_exteriorCut
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (ρ s : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)

  exact hother r hri hrj u hquad hnorm (hEq ▸ hy)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveCommonOrbit_exists_avoidCuts
statement:
theorem saddlePositiveCommonOrbit_exists_avoidCuts
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (ρ s : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs0 : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (horbit : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
          hρrad hregpos Vpos =
        T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs
          hρrad hregpos Vpos) :
    ∃ c₀ c₁ c₂ c₃ : I,
      c₀ ≠ c₁ ∧ ¬(c₀ = 0 ∧ c₁ = 1) ∧ ¬(c₀ = 1 ∧ c₁ = 0) ∧
      c₂ ≠ c₃ ∧ ¬(c₂ = 0 ∧ c₃ = 1) ∧ ¬(c₂ = 1 ∧ c₃ = 0) ∧
      (∀ (q : I) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = s ^ 2 → ‖u‖ < ρ →
        spacePart (M.param u) ≠
          (Vpos.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam
            (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
              hρrad hregpos Vpos)).curve (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q)) ∧
      (∀ (q : I) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = s ^ 2 → ‖u‖ < ρ →
        spacePart (M.param u) ≠
          (Vpos.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam
            (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
              hρrad hregpos Vpos)).curve (Set.Icc.convexComb c₂ c₃ q))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, hi, hj, hother⟩ :=
    T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbit_exists_uniformExteriorCuts hindex ρ s hρ hs0
      hs hρrad hregpos Vpos horbit
  set A := T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
    hregpos Vpos horbit with hA
  have hdisj : Disjoint (A.cyclicCutRange i) (A.cyclicCutRange j) := by
    rw [← hi, ← hj]
    exact T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegments_disjoint hindex ρ s hρ hs0 hs hρrad
  rcases A.exterior_pair_of_disjoint_cyclicCutRange hdisj with
    ⟨h0i, h0j, h2i, h2j⟩ | ⟨h1i, h1j, h3i, h3j⟩
  · refine ⟨A.sortedMark ((0 : Fin 3).castSucc),
      A.sortedMark ((0 : Fin 3).succ),
      A.sortedMark ((2 : Fin 3).castSucc),
      A.sortedMark ((2 : Fin 3).succ),
      (A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (0 : Fin 3)).1,
      (A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (0 : Fin 3)).2.1,
      (A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (0 : Fin 3)).2.2,
      (A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (2 : Fin 3)).1,
      (A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (2 : Fin 3)).2.1,
      (A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (2 : Fin 3)).2.2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro q u hquad hnorm hEq
      exact hother _ h0i h0j u hquad hnorm
        (hEq ▸ A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (0 : Fin 3) q)
    · intro q u hquad hnorm hEq
      exact hother _ h2i h2j u hquad hnorm
        (hEq ▸ A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (2 : Fin 3) q)
  · refine ⟨A.sortedMark ((1 : Fin 3).castSucc),
      A.sortedMark ((1 : Fin 3).succ),
      A.sortedMark (Fin.last 3), 1,
      (A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (1 : Fin 3)).1,
      (A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (1 : Fin 3)).2.1,
      (A.sortedMark_cut_conditions (1 : Fin 3)).2.2,
      A.sortedMark_ne_one (Fin.last 3), ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rintro ⟨h, -⟩
      exact A.sortedMark_last_ne_zero h
    · rintro ⟨-, h⟩
      simp at h
    · intro q u hquad hnorm hEq
      exact hother _ h1i h1j u hquad hnorm
        (hEq ▸ A.curve_convexComb_mem_cyclicCutRange (1 : Fin 3) q)
    · intro q u hquad hnorm hEq
      exact hother _ h3i h3j u hquad hnorm
        (hEq ▸ A.curve_convexComb_last_mem_cyclicCutRange q)

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierFiniteC1Subdivision.EmbeddedCircleTrack.contDiff_phaseDeriv
statement:
theorem contDiff_phaseDeriv :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => D q.1 q.2)
proof:
:= by
  let f : (ℝ × ℝ) → ℝ → E := fun q u => T.lift q.1 u
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Function.uncurry f) := by
    exact T.smooth_lift.comp
      ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd)
  have hd := ContDiff.fderiv_apply (m := ∞) (n := ∞) hf
    (g := fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.2)
    (k := fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => (1 : ℝ))
    contDiff_snd contDiff_const (by simp)
  simpa [f, phaseDeriv, fderiv_apply_one_eq_deriv] using hd

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierFiniteC1Subdivision.EmbeddedCircleTrack.continuous_phaseDeriv
statement:

    Continuous (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => D q.1 q.2)
proof:
:=
  (contDiff_phaseDeriv (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T).continuous

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierFiniteC1Subdivision.EmbeddedCircleTrack.periodic_phaseDeriv
statement:
theorem periodic_phaseDeriv (s : ℝ) :
    Function.Periodic (D s) 1
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (fun u : ℝ => T.lift s (u + 1)) = T.lift s := by
    funext u
    exact T.periodic_lift s u
  intro u
  have h := congrArg (fun f : ℝ → E => deriv f u) hfun
  simpa only [phaseDeriv, deriv_comp_add_const] using h

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierFiniteC1Subdivision.EmbeddedCircleTrack.lift_eq_fract
statement:
theorem lift_eq_fract (s u : ℝ) :
    T.lift s u = T.lift s (Int.fract u)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiod := (T.periodic_lift s).zsmul ⌊u⌋
  have h := hperiod (Int.fract u)
  have hpoint : Int.fract u + ⌊u⌋ • (1 : ℝ) = u := by
    simpa [add_comm] using Int.fract_add_floor u
  rw [hpoint] at h
  exact h

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierFiniteC1Subdivision.EmbeddedCircleTrack.phaseDeriv_eq_fract

theorem phaseDeriv_eq_fract (s u : ℝ) :

proof:
:= by
  have hperiod :=
    (periodic_phaseDeriv (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T s).zsmul ⌊u⌋
  have h := hperiod (Int.fract u)
  have hpoint : Int.fract u + ⌊u⌋ • (1 : ℝ) = u := by
    simpa [add_comm] using Int.fract_add_floor u
  rw [hpoint] at h
  exact h

statement:

proof:

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierFiniteC1Subdivision.EmbeddedCircleTrack.exists_uniformC1_equisubdivision
statement:
theorem exists_uniformC1_equisubdivision
    (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, k < m → ∀ u : ℝ,
        ‖T.lift ((k : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u -
            T.lift (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u‖ < ε ∧
        ‖deriv (T.lift ((k : ℝ) / (m : ℝ))) u -
            deriv (T.lift (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ))) u‖ < ε
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) :=
    Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have huniform : UniformContinuousOn
      (c1Jet (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) (T := T)) K :=
    hK.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous
      (continuous_c1Jet (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T).continuousOn
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hnear⟩ :=
    Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp huniform ε hε
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hδ
  refine ⟨j + 1, Nat.succ_pos j, ?_⟩
  intro k hk u
  let v : ℝ := Int.fract u
  have hv : v ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨Int.fract_nonneg u, (Int.fract_lt_one u).le⟩
  have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hk_le : k ≤ j + 1 := Nat.le_of_lt hk
  have hk_succ_le : k + 1 ≤ j + 1 := by omega
  have htime₀ : (k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ∈
      Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · positivity
    · exact (div_le_one hmpos).2 (by exact_mod_cast hk_le)
  have htime₁ : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ∈
      Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · positivity
    · exact (div_le_one hmpos).2 (by exact_mod_cast hk_succ_le)
  have hstep :
      dist ((k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
          (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
        1 / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have hle :
        (k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ k) hmpos.le
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hle)]
    field_simp
    norm_num
  have hdist :
      dist
        ((k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ), v)
        (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ), v) < δ := by
    rw [dist_prod_same_right, hstep]
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hj
  have hout := hnear
    ((k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ), v) ⟨htime₀, hv⟩
    (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ), v) ⟨htime₁, hv⟩
    hdist
  rw [Prod.dist_eq, max_lt_iff] at hout
  constructor
  · rw [lift_eq_fract (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T _ u,
      lift_eq_fract (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T _ u]
    simpa only [c1Jet, dist_eq_norm, Prod.fst] using hout.1
  · change
      ‖D ((k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) u -
        D (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) /
          ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) u‖ < ε
    rw [phaseDeriv_eq_fract (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T _ u,
      phaseDeriv_eq_fract (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T _ u]
    simpa only [c1Jet, dist_eq_norm, Prod.snd] using hout.2

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.timeCritical_subset_coreCriticalPoints
statement:
theorem FramedLevelCobordism.timeCritical_subset_coreCriticalPoints
    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) :
    timeCritical C.G ⊆ coreCriticalPoints C
proof:
:= by
  intro v hv
  have hlower : (1 / 4 : ℝ) < tcoord v := by
    by_contra h
    exact hv.2 ((C.sliceRegular_of_le_quarter (le_of_not_gt h)) v hv.1 rfl)
  have hupper : tcoord v < (3 / 4 : ℝ) := by
    by_contra h
    exact hv.2
      ((C.sliceRegular_of_three_quarter_le (le_of_not_gt h)) v hv.1 rfl)
  exact ⟨hv, hlower.le, hupper.le⟩

name: Submission.FramedLevelCobordism.timeCritical_eq_coreCriticalPoints

    (C : FramedLevelCobordism n) :

proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm C.timeCritical_subset_coreCriticalPoints
  exact fun _ hv => hv.1

name: Submission.MorsePosition.regularSlab_iff_avoid_eventTimes
statement:
theorem regularSlab_iff_avoid_eventTimes (P : MorsePosition C) (a b : ℝ) :
    regularSlab C.G a b ↔
      ∀ t ∈ P.eventTimes, t ∉ Icc a b
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hreg t htEvent htIcc
    exact hreg t htIcc (by
      rw [C.criticalTimes_eq_coreCriticalTimes, ← P.coe_eventTimes]
      exact htEvent)
  · intro havoid t htIcc htCritical
    have htEvent : t ∈ P.eventTimes := by
      rw [P.mem_eventTimes_iff]
      rw [← C.criticalTimes_eq_coreCriticalTimes]
      exact htCritical
    exact havoid t htEvent htIcc

name: Submission.MorsePosition.regularSlab_iff_disjoint_eventTimes

name: Submission.smul_kerCross_of_fderiv_apply_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set v : Fin n → E := fun i => gradVec g i q with hv
  have hk : kerCross g q = crossVec v := rfl
  have hLI : LinearIndependent ℝ v :=
    (surjective_fderiv_iff_linearIndependent g q).mp hq
  have hkne : kerCross g q ≠ 0 := (kerCross_ne_zero_iff g q).mpr hq
  have hnormsq : (0 : ℝ) < ‖kerCross g q‖ ^ 2 := by
    have := norm_pos_iff.mpr hkne
    positivity
  
  set zvec : E := ‖kerCross g q‖ ^ 2 • w - ⟪kerCross g q, w⟫ • kerCross g q
    with hz
  have hwperp : ∀ i : Fin n, ⟪v i, w⟫ = 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [hv]
    rw [inner_gradVec, hw]
    rfl
  have hkperp : ∀ i : Fin n, ⟪v i, kerCross g q⟫ = 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [real_inner_comm, hk]
    exact inner_crossVec_self v i
  have hzperp : ∀ i : Fin n, ⟪v i, zvec⟫ = 0 := by
    intro i
    rw [hz, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right,
      hwperp i, hkperp i]
    ring
  have hzk : ⟪kerCross g q, zvec⟫ = 0 := by
    rw [hz, inner_sub_right, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right,
      real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    ring
  have hcross : crossDet v zvec = 0 := by
    rw [← inner_crossVec v zvec, ← hk]
    exact hzk
  have hnotLI : ¬ LinearIndependent ℝ (Fin.cons zvec v : Fin (n + 1) → E) := by
    intro hLIcons
    exact ((crossDet_ne_zero_iff v zvec).mpr hLIcons) hcross
  have hspan : zvec ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) := by
    by_contra hmem
    exact hnotLI (linearIndependent_finCons.mpr ⟨hLI, hmem⟩)
  have hker : ∀ x ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v), ⟪zvec, x⟫ = 0 := by
    intro x hx
    induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
    | mem y hy =>
        obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hy
        rw [real_inner_comm]
        exact hzperp i
    | zero => simp
    | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [inner_add_right, ha, hb]; ring
    | smul t a _ ha => rw [real_inner_smul_right, ha]; ring
  have hzz : ⟪zvec, zvec⟫ = 0 := hker zvec hspan
  have hzzero : zvec = 0 := (inner_self_eq_zero (𝕜 := ℝ) (x := zvec)).mp hzz
  have := sub_eq_zero.mp (hz ▸ hzzero)
  exact this

name: Submission.tauField_eq_of_inner_pos
statement:
theorem tauField_eq_of_inner_pos (g : E → F) {q : E}
    (hq : q ∈ regularSet g) {w : E} (hw : fderiv ℝ g q w = 0)
    (hpos : 0 < ⟪tauField g q, w⟫) :
    tauField g q = ‖w‖⁻¹ • w
proof:
:= by
  have hkne : kerCross g q ≠ 0 := (kerCross_ne_zero_iff g q).mpr hq
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < ‖kerCross g q‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hkne
  have htau : tauField g q = ‖kerCross g q‖⁻¹ • kerCross g q := rfl
  have hinner : ⟪tauField g q, w⟫ = ‖kerCross g q‖⁻¹ * ⟪kerCross g q, w⟫ := by
    rw [htau, real_inner_smul_left]
  have hkw : 0 < ⟪kerCross g q, w⟫ := by
    rw [hinner] at hpos
    have hinv : (0 : ℝ) < ‖kerCross g q‖⁻¹ := by positivity
    nlinarith
  have hmain := smul_kerCross_of_fderiv_apply_eq_zero g hq hw
  have hsq : (0 : ℝ) < ‖kerCross g q‖ ^ 2 := by positivity
  set c : ℝ := ⟪kerCross g q, w⟫ / ‖kerCross g q‖ ^ 2 with hc
  have hcpos : 0 < c := by
    rw [hc]
    exact div_pos hkw hsq
  have hcne : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hcpos
  have hkn : ‖kerCross g q‖ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hnpos
  have hweq : w = c • kerCross g q := by
    rw [hc, div_eq_inv_mul, ← smul_smul, ← hmain, smul_smul,
      inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hsq), one_smul]
  have hfinal : ‖w‖⁻¹ • w = ‖kerCross g q‖⁻¹ • kerCross g q := by
    rw [hweq, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hcpos, smul_smul]
    congr 1
    field_simp
  rw [htau, hfinal]

name: Submission.eq_zero_of_inner_tauField_eq_zero
proof:
:= by
  have hkne : kerCross g q ≠ 0 := (kerCross_ne_zero_iff g q).mpr hq
  have hnpos : (0 : ℝ) < ‖kerCross g q‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hkne
  have htau : tauField g q = ‖kerCross g q‖⁻¹ • kerCross g q := rfl
  have hinner : ‖kerCross g q‖⁻¹ * ⟪kerCross g q, w⟫ = 0 := by
    rw [← real_inner_smul_left, ← htau]
    exact h0
  have hkw : ⟪kerCross g q, w⟫ = 0 := by
    have hinv : (‖kerCross g q‖⁻¹ : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hinner).resolve_left hinv
  have hmain := smul_kerCross_of_fderiv_apply_eq_zero g hq hw
  rw [hkw, zero_smul] at hmain
  have hsq : (‖kerCross g q‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  exact (smul_eq_zero.mp hmain).resolve_left hsq

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.contDiff_famForwardFDeriv
statement:
theorem contDiff_famForwardFDeriv :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q : ℝ × E => fderiv ℝ (fun y => A.forward q.1 y) q.2)
proof:
:=
  ContDiff.fderiv
    (f := fun (q : ℝ × E) (y : E) => A.forward q.1 y)
    (g := fun q : ℝ × E => q.2)
    (A.forward_smooth.comp ((contDiff_fst.comp contDiff_fst).prodMk contDiff_snd))
    contDiff_snd (by simp)

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.fderiv_inverse_comp_forward
statement:
theorem fderiv_inverse_comp_forward {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (p : E) :
    (fderiv ℝ (A.inverse s) (A.forward s p)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ (A.forward s) p) = ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E
proof:
:= by
  have hf : HasFDerivAt (A.forward s) (fderiv ℝ (A.forward s) p) p :=
    ((A.contDiff_forward_slice s).differentiable (by simp) p).hasFDerivAt
  have hg : HasFDerivAt (A.inverse s)
      (fderiv ℝ (A.inverse s) (A.forward s p)) (A.forward s p) :=
    ((A.contDiff_inverse_slice s).differentiable (by simp) _).hasFDerivAt
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun x => A.inverse s (A.forward s x))
      ((fderiv ℝ (A.inverse s) (A.forward s p)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ (A.forward s) p)) p := hg.comp p hf
  have hid : (fun x => A.inverse s (A.forward s x)) = id :=
    funext (A.left_inv s hs)
  rw [hid] at hcomp
  exact hcomp.unique (hasFDerivAt_id p)

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.fderiv_inverse_forward_apply
statement:
theorem fderiv_inverse_forward_apply {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (p w : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (A.inverse s) (A.forward s p)
        (fderiv ℝ (A.forward s) p w) = w
proof:
:= by
