name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.fderiv_forward_apply_ne_zero
statement:
theorem fderiv_forward_apply_ne_zero {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
    (p : E) {w : E} (hw : w ≠ 0) :
    fderiv ℝ (A.forward s) p w ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  apply hw
  have hrec := A.fderiv_inverse_forward_apply hs p w
  rw [h, map_zero] at hrec
  exact hrec.symm

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.fderiv_pullbackI
statement:
theorem fderiv_pullbackI (s : I) (q : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (A.pullbackI X s).g q =
      (fderiv ℝ X.g (A.inverse (s : ℝ) q)).comp
        (fderiv ℝ (A.inverse (s : ℝ)) q)
proof:
:= by
  rw [A.pullbackI_g_fun X]
  exact ((X.smooth.differentiable (by simp) _).hasFDerivAt.comp q
    ((A.contDiff_inverse_slice (s : ℝ)).differentiable (by simp) q).hasFDerivAt).fderiv

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.fderiv_pullbackI_forward_tauField
statement:
theorem fderiv_pullbackI_forward_tauField (s : I) (p : E) :
    fderiv ℝ (A.pullbackI X s).g (A.forward (s : ℝ) p)
        (fderiv ℝ (A.forward (s : ℝ)) p (tauField X.g p)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (s : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := mem_Icc_coe s
  rw [A.fderiv_pullbackI X s, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply,
    A.fderiv_inverse_forward_apply hs p (tauField X.g p),
    A.left_inv (s : ℝ) hs p]
  exact fderiv_tauField_eq_zero X.g p

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.inner_tauField_pullbackI_pos
statement:
theorem inner_tauField_pullbackI_pos (s : I) {p : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    0 < ⟪tauField (A.pullbackI X s).g (A.forward (s : ℝ) p),
        fderiv ℝ (A.forward (s : ℝ)) p (tauField X.g p)⟫
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set τ : E := tauField X.g p with hτ
  have hτne : τ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hnorm := norm_tauField (X.fiber_subset_regularSet hp)
    rw [← hτ, h, norm_zero] at hnorm
    norm_num at hnorm
  set fpath : I → ℝ := fun t =>
    ⟪tauField (A.pullbackI X t).g (A.forward (t : ℝ) p),
      fderiv ℝ (A.forward (t : ℝ)) p τ⟫ with hfpath
  have hγc : Continuous fun t : I => A.forward (t : ℝ) p :=
    A.forward_smooth.continuous.comp
      (continuous_subtype_val.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hreg : ∀ t : I, A.forward (t : ℝ) p ∈
      regularSet (A.pullbackI X t).g :=
    fun t => A.forward_mem_pullbackI_regularSet X t hp
  have hcont1 : Continuous fun t : I =>
      tauField (A.pullbackI X t).g (A.forward (t : ℝ) p) :=
    A.continuous_pullbackI_tauField X (sf := fun t : I => t)
      (γ := fun t : I => A.forward (t : ℝ) p) continuous_id hγc hreg
  have hcontL : Continuous fun t : I =>
      fderiv ℝ (fun y => A.forward (t : ℝ) y) p :=
    (A.contDiff_famForwardFDeriv).continuous.comp
      (continuous_subtype_val.prodMk continuous_const)
  have hcont2 : Continuous fun t : I => fderiv ℝ (A.forward (t : ℝ)) p τ :=
    hcontL.clm_apply continuous_const
  have hfc : Continuous fpath := hcont1.inner hcont2
  have hne : ∀ t : I, fpath t ≠ 0 := by
    intro t hzero
    have hw : fderiv ℝ (A.forward (t : ℝ)) p τ ≠ 0 :=
      A.fderiv_forward_apply_ne_zero (mem_Icc_coe t) p hτne
    exact hw (eq_zero_of_inner_tauField_eq_zero _ (hreg t)
      (A.fderiv_pullbackI_forward_tauField X t p) hzero)
  have hzero : fpath 0 = 1 := by
    have hcoe : (((0 : I) : ℝ)) = 0 := rfl
    have h1 : (A.pullbackI X 0).g = X.g := A.pullbackI_zero_g X
    have h2 : A.forward (((0 : I) : ℝ)) p = p := by
      rw [hcoe, A.forward_zero]
      rfl
    have h3 : fderiv ℝ (A.forward (((0 : I) : ℝ))) p τ = τ := by
      rw [hcoe, A.forward_zero, fderiv_id]
      rfl
    rw [hfpath]
    simp only []
    rw [h1, h2, h3, ← hτ, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
      norm_tauField (X.fiber_subset_regularSet hp)]
    norm_num
  by_contra hcon
  push_neg at hcon
  have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (fpath s) (fpath 0) := by
    refine ⟨hcon, ?_⟩
    rw [hzero]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (s : I) (0 : I) hfc hmem
  exact hne t ht

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.tauField_pullback_of_curve
statement:
theorem tauField_pullback_of_curve
    {γ δ : ℝ → E} {u a : ℝ} (ha : 0 < a)
    (hmem : γ u ∈ X.fiber)
    (hγ : HasDerivAt γ (a • tauField X.g (γ u)) u)
    (hcomp : ∀ t, δ t = A.forward 1 (γ t))
    {d : E} (hδ : HasDerivAt δ d u) :
    tauField (A.pullback X).g (δ u) = ‖d‖⁻¹ • d
proof:
:= by
  set τ : E := tauField X.g (γ u) with hτ
  set L : E →L[ℝ] E := fderiv ℝ (A.forward 1) (γ u) with hL
  have hfd : HasFDerivAt (A.forward 1) L (γ u) :=
    ((A.contDiff_forward_slice 1).differentiable (by simp) (γ u)).hasFDerivAt
  have hcompderiv : HasDerivAt (fun t => A.forward 1 (γ t)) (L (a • τ)) u :=
    hfd.comp_hasDerivAt u hγ
  have hδ' : HasDerivAt δ (L (a • τ)) u := by
    have hfun : δ = fun t => A.forward 1 (γ t) := funext hcomp
    rw [hfun]
    exact hcompderiv
  have hdeq : d = a • L τ := by
    rw [hδ.unique hδ', map_smul]
  have hpt : δ u = A.forward 1 (γ u) := hcomp u
  have hpos : 0 < ⟪tauField (A.pullback X).g (A.forward 1 (γ u)), L τ⟫ :=
    A.inner_tauField_pullback_pos X hmem
  have hposd : 0 < ⟪tauField (A.pullback X).g (δ u), d⟫ := by
    rw [hpt, hdeq, real_inner_smul_right]
    exact mul_pos ha hpos
  have hker : fderiv ℝ (A.pullback X).g (δ u) d = 0 := by
    rw [hpt, hdeq, map_smul, A.fderiv_pullback_forward_tauField X (γ u),
      smul_zero]
  have hreg : δ u ∈ regularSet (A.pullback X).g := by
    rw [hpt]
    exact A.forward_mem_pullback_regularSet X hmem
  exact tauField_eq_of_inner_pos _ hreg hker hposd

name: Submission.saddleBandBeforeArcsCovering_mono
statement:
theorem saddleBandBeforeArcsCovering_mono
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hbefore hafter Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat)
    {S₁ S₂ S₁' S₂' : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
    (h₁ : S₁ ⊆ S₁') (h₂ : S₂ ⊆ S₂')
    (h : SaddleBandBeforeArcsCovering F S₁ S₂) :
    SaddleBandBeforeArcsCovering F S₁' S₂'
proof:
:=
  ⟨fun x hx => h.1 ⟨hx.1, fun hc => hx.2 (h₁ hc)⟩,
    fun x hx => h.2 ⟨hx.1, fun hc => hx.2 (h₂ hc)⟩⟩

name: Submission.mem_of_saddleBandBeforeArcsInRange
statement:
theorem mem_of_saddleBandBeforeArcsInRange
    (F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hbefore hafter Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat)
    {S₁ S₂ : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
    (h : SaddleBandBeforeArcsInRange F S₁ S₂) :
    F.before₁Param.curve F.before₁Cut₁ ∈ S₁ ∧
      F.before₁Param.curve 1 ∈ S₁ ∧
      F.before₂Param.curve F.before₂Cut₁ ∈ S₂ ∧
      F.before₂Param.curve 1 ∈ S₂
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h0 := h.1 0
    rwa [Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] at h0
  · have h1 := h.1 1
    rwa [Set.Icc.convexComb_one] at h1
  · have h0 := h.2.2.1 0
    rwa [Set.Icc.convexComb_zero] at h0
  · have h1 := h.2.2.1 1
    rwa [Set.Icc.convexComb_one] at h1

name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleBeforeArcCoveringTwoRadiusInputs_of_covering
statement:
theorem productionMorseSaddleBeforeArcCoveringTwoRadiusInputs_of_covering
    {a : ℕ} (KC : ProductionMorseSaddleBeforeArcCoveringInputs a) :
    ProductionMorseSaddleBeforeArcCoveringTwoRadiusInputs a
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y S T C D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  have hs0 : D.bandCaptureScale t ht ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hb
  have hle : D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht ≤
      D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht :=
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_endpointParamRadius t ht).le
  have hsubNeg : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      Set.range ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddleNegativeSpatialSegment e
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)) ⊆
      Set.range ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddleNegativeSpatialSegment e
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht hb hbw)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)) := by
    intro e
    exact (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).range_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_mono e hs0
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.shortScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht hb hbw)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht) hle
  have hsubPos : ∀ e : SaddleBranch,
      Set.range ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddlePositiveSpatialSegment e
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)) ⊆
      Set.range ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddlePositiveSpatialSegment e
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht hb hbw)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)) := by
    intro e
    exact (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).range_saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_mono e hs0
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.shortScale_sq_lt_endpointParam_sq t ht hb hbw)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht) hle
  constructor
  · intro h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin, hcov⟩ :=
      (KC C D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos).1 h1 h2
    exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin,
      saddleBandBeforeArcsCovering_mono F (hsubNeg e₁) (hsubNeg e₂) hcov⟩
  · intro h1 h2
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin, hcov⟩ :=
      (KC C D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos).2 h1 h2
    exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, hpin,
      saddleBandBeforeArcsCovering_mono F (hsubPos e₁) (hsubPos e₂) hcov⟩

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.initCLM_collaredSpaceTime
statement:

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.vertC_collaredSpaceTime

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.contDiff_collaredSpaceTime
statement: lemma contDiff_collaredSpaceTime : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (collaredSpaceTime C χ)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : collaredSpaceTime C χ = fun v : A =>
      embedCLM (n + 1) (initCLM (n + 1) v) +
        normRamp (vertC v) • eLast (n + 1) := by
    funext v
    exact spaceTime_eq_affine _ _
  rw [heq]
  exact ((embedCLM (n + 1)).contDiff.comp (initCLM (n + 1)).contDiff).add
    ((contDiff_normRamp.comp contDiff_vertC).smul contDiff_const)

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.collaredSpaceTime_mem_timeSlab

    vertC (collaredSpaceTime C χ v) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1

  exact ⟨normRamp_nonneg _, normRamp_le_one _⟩

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.contDiff_collaredRaw

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.collaredRaw_ne_zero

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.norm_collaredSphereVec
statement: lemma norm_collaredSphereVec (v : A) : ‖collaredSphereVec C χ v‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  exact norm_normalize (collaredRaw_ne_zero C χ v)

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.contDiff_collaredSphereVec
statement: lemma contDiff_collaredSphereVec : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (collaredSphereVec C χ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro v
  have hr : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (collaredRaw C χ) v :=
    (contDiff_collaredRaw C χ).contDiffAt
  have hn : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun q => ‖collaredRaw C χ q‖) v :=
    hr.norm ℝ (collaredRaw_ne_zero C χ v)
  exact (hn.inv (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (collaredRaw_ne_zero C χ v))).smul hr

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.collaredSphere_coe

proof: := rfl

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.collaredSphere_exterior_south
statement:
lemma collaredSphere_exterior_south :
    ∃ R : ℝ, ∀ v : A,
      R < ‖initCLM (n + 1) v‖ → collaredSphere C χ v = southPole n
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := χ.compact_support.isBounded.subset_closedBall (0 : A)
  refine ⟨R, ?_⟩
  intro v hv
  let q := collaredSpaceTime C χ v
  have hχq : χ q = 0 := by
    by_contra hne
    have hqmem : q ∈ tsupport χ := subset_tsupport χ hne
    have hqball := hR hqmem
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right] at hqball
    have hsplit := norm_sq_split q
    have hinit : initCLM (n + 1) q = initCLM (n + 1) v := by
      simpa [q] using initCLM_collaredSpaceTime C χ v
    rw [hinit] at hsplit
    nlinarith [norm_nonneg q, norm_nonneg (initCLM (n + 1) v),
      sq_nonneg (vertC q)]
  apply Subtype.ext
  change collaredSphereVec C χ v = (-eLast n : E)
  have hraw : collaredRaw C χ v = -eLast n := by
    simp [collaredRaw, raw, q, hχq]
  rw [collaredSphereVec, hraw, norm_neg, norm_eLast, inv_one, one_smul]

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.collaredSphere_collar_zero
statement:

proof:
:= by

  change collaredSphereVec C χ (spaceTime x t) =
    collaredSphereVec C χ (spaceTime x 0)
  simp [collaredSphereVec, collaredRaw, collaredSpaceTime,
    vertC_spaceTime, initCLM_spaceTime, normRamp_of_le_quarter ht,
    normRamp_of_le_quarter (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4)]

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.SignedSlabCutoff.collaredSphere_collar_one

proof:

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.spacePart_param_not_mem_saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_of_lt_norm
statement:
theorem spacePart_param_not_mem_saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_of_lt_norm
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (b : SaddleBranch)
    {ρ s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} (hu : ‖u‖ < T.radius) (hlow : ρ < ‖u‖)
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = s ^ 2) :
    spacePart (M.param u) ∉
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have hnorm : ‖saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s q‖ ≤ ρ :=
    norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_le b hρ hs q
  have huM : ‖u‖ < M.radius := hu.trans_le T.radius_le
  have htimeu : tcoord (M.param u) =
      tcoord center + s ^ 2 := by
    rw [M.time_model u huM, hindex, hquad]
  have htimeseg : tcoord (M.param (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s q)) =
      tcoord center + s ^ 2 :=
    T.saddlePositiveSegment_time hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad q
  have hspace : spacePart (M.param (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s q)) =
      spacePart (M.param u) := hq
  have hamb : M.param (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s q) = M.param u := by
    calc M.param (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s q)
        = cobSpaceTime
            (spacePart (M.param (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s q)))
            (tcoord (M.param (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s q))) :=
          (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime (spacePart (M.param u)) (tcoord (M.param u)) := by
          rw [hspace, htimeseg, htimeu]
      _ = M.param u := spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hball₁ : saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s q ∈
      Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hnorm.trans_lt hρrad
  have hball₂ : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hu
  have heq : saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s q = u :=
    T.param_injOn hball₁ hball₂ hamb
  rw [heq] at hnorm
  linarith

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.spacePart_param_not_mem_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_of_lt_norm
statement:
theorem spacePart_param_not_mem_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_of_lt_norm
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (b : SaddleBranch)
    {ρ s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2) (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} (hu : ‖u‖ < T.radius) (hlow : ρ < ‖u‖)
    (hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(s ^ 2)) :
    spacePart (M.param u) ∉
      Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
proof:
:= by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  have hnorm : ‖saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ s q‖ ≤ ρ :=
    norm_saddleNegativeSegmentParam_le b hρ hs q
  have huM : ‖u‖ < M.radius := hu.trans_le T.radius_le
  have htimeu : tcoord (M.param u) = tcoord center - s ^ 2 := by
    rw [M.time_model u huM, hindex, hquad]
    ring
  have htimeseg : tcoord (M.param (saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ s q)) =
      tcoord center - s ^ 2 :=
    T.saddleNegativeSegment_time hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad q
  have hspace : spacePart (M.param (saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ s q)) =
      spacePart (M.param u) := hq
  have hamb : M.param (saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ s q) = M.param u := by
    calc M.param (saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ s q)
        = cobSpaceTime
            (spacePart (M.param (saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ s q)))
            (tcoord (M.param (saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ s q))) :=
          (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime (spacePart (M.param u)) (tcoord (M.param u)) := by
          rw [hspace, htimeseg, htimeu]
      _ = M.param u := spaceTime_spacePart _
  have hball₁ : saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ s q ∈
      Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hnorm.trans_lt hρrad
  have hball₂ : u ∈ Metric.ball (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)) T.radius := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_right]
    exact hu
  have heq : saddleNegativeSegmentParam b ρ s q = u :=
    T.param_injOn hball₁ hball₂ hamb
  rw [heq] at hnorm
  linarith

name: Submission.exists_signedBranch_pos
statement:
theorem exists_signedBranch_pos {x : ℝ} (hx : x ≠ 0) :
    ∃ b : SaddleBranch, 0 < signedBranch b x
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_trichotomy x 0 with h | h | h
  · exact ⟨.negative, by simpa [signedBranch] using h⟩
  · exact absurd h hx
  · exact ⟨.positive, by simpa [signedBranch] using h⟩

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.flowedOuterNegativeBoundaryEnd_transport
statement:
theorem flowedOuterNegativeBoundaryEnd_transport
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (hsmall : D.ChronologicalSaddleOuterEndpointSmallness t ht)
    (b e : SaddleBranch)
    (Vpos : TamedField
      ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSlice
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht)))) :
    (∃ b' : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b e
            (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
          (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))) ∈
        (((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
              ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex b'
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht
              (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
              (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht)) Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) ∧
    ∀ b'' : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd b e
            (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
          (D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 - -(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2))) ∉
        Set.range ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b''
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
          (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht
            (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht))
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  have hρ : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hs : D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
    D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw
  have hρrad : D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht <
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hlow, hup, hquad⟩ :=
    D.exists_flowedOuterNegativeBoundaryEnd_chartParam t ht hindex hsmall b e
  have huT : ‖u‖ < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
    hu.trans (D.chronologicalSaddleOuterParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  have huM : ‖u‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    huT.trans_le (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hu0 : u 0 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(u 1) ^ 2 := by
      show (u 0) ^ 2 - (u 1) ^ 2 = -(u 1) ^ 2
      rw [h0]
      ring
    rw [this] at hquad
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 1), sq_nonneg (D.bandCaptureScale t ht), hb]
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := exists_signedBranch_pos hu0
    refine ⟨b', ?_⟩
    exact (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).mem_saddlePositiveBranchOrbit_of_chartParam
      (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) hindex b'
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) u
      hquad hb' hρ hs hρrad huM
      (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos (by rw [hup])
  · intro b''
    have h := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).spacePart_param_not_mem_saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_of_lt_norm
      hindex b'' hρ hs hρrad huT hlow hquad
    rwa [hup] at h

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.flowedOuterPositiveBoundaryEnd_transport
statement:
theorem flowedOuterPositiveBoundaryEnd_transport
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (hsmall : D.ChronologicalSaddleOuterEndpointSmallness t ht)
    (b e : SaddleBranch)
    (Vneg : TamedField
      ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeSlice
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht)))) :
    (∃ b' : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b e
            (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
          (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) ∈
        (((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
              ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex b'
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht
              (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
              (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht)) Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) ∧
    ∀ b'' : SaddleBranch,
      spacePart ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd b e
            (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht))
          (-(D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2) - D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2)) ∉
        Set.range ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
            ht).saddleNegativeSpatialSegment b''
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
          (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht
            (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht))
proof:
:= by
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  have hρ : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hs : D.bandCaptureScale t ht ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
    D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw
  have hρrad : D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht <
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hlow, hup, hquad⟩ :=
    D.exists_flowedOuterPositiveBoundaryEnd_chartParam t ht hindex hsmall b e
  have huT : ‖u‖ < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
    hu.trans (D.chronologicalSaddleOuterParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  have huM : ‖u‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    huT.trans_le (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hu1 : u 1 ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = (u 0) ^ 2 := by
      show (u 0) ^ 2 - (u 1) ^ 2 = (u 0) ^ 2
      rw [h0]
      ring
    rw [this] at hquad
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (u 0), sq_nonneg (D.bandCaptureScale t ht), hb]
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨b', hb'⟩ := exists_signedBranch_pos hu1
    refine ⟨b', ?_⟩
    exact (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).mem_saddleNegativeBranchOrbit_of_chartParam
      (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) hindex b'
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht) u
      hquad hb' hρ hs hρrad huM
      (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg (by rw [hup])
  · intro b''
    have h := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
        ht).spacePart_param_not_mem_saddleNegativeSpatialSegment_of_lt_norm
      hindex b'' hρ hs hρrad huT hlow hquad
    rwa [hup] at h

name: Submission.MorsePosition.exists_eventBracket
statement:
theorem exists_eventBracket (P : MorsePosition C) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : t ∈ P.eventTimes) : Nonempty (MorseEventBracket P t ht)
proof:
:= by
  let other : Set ℝ := ↑(P.eventTimes.erase t)
  have hotherFinite : other.Finite := (P.eventTimes.erase t).finite_toSet
  have hotherClosed : IsClosed other := hotherFinite.isClosed
  have htOther : t ∈ otherᶜ := by
    simp [other]
  obtain ⟨epsilon, hEpsilon, hball⟩ :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hotherClosed.isOpen_compl t htOther
  let before := t - epsilon / 2
  let after := t + epsilon / 2
  have hhalf : 0 < epsilon / 2 := by positivity
  have hbeforeBall : before ∈ Metric.ball t epsilon := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
    dsimp [before]
    rw [show t - epsilon / 2 - t = -(epsilon / 2) by ring,
      abs_neg, abs_of_pos hhalf]
    linarith
  have hafterBall : after ∈ Metric.ball t epsilon := by
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
    dsimp [after]
    rw [show t + epsilon / 2 - t = epsilon / 2 by ring,
      abs_of_pos hhalf]
    linarith
  have hbeforeNot : before ∉ P.eventTimes := by
    intro hmem
    have hne : before ≠ t := by dsimp [before]; linarith
    have herase : before ∈ other := by
      change before ∈ P.eventTimes.erase t
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, hmem⟩
    exact (hball hbeforeBall) herase
  have hafterNot : after ∉ P.eventTimes := by
    intro hmem
    have hne : after ≠ t := by dsimp [after]; linarith
    have herase : after ∈ other := by
      change after ∈ P.eventTimes.erase t
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, hmem⟩
    exact (hball hafterBall) herase
  refine ⟨{
    before := before
    after := after
    before_lt := ?_
    lt_after := ?_
    symmetric := ?_
    before_regular := (P.sliceRegular_iff_not_mem_eventTimes before).2 hbeforeNot
    after_regular := (P.sliceRegular_iff_not_mem_eventTimes after).2 hafterNot
    isolates := ?_
  }⟩
  · rw [P.eventCenter_time t ht]
    dsimp [before]
    linarith
  · rw [P.eventCenter_time t ht]
    dsimp [after]
    linarith
  · rw [P.eventCenter_time t ht]
    dsimp [before, after]
    ring
  · intro v hvCritical hvInterval
    have hvCore : v ∈ coreCriticalPoints C :=
      C.timeCritical_subset_coreCriticalPoints hvCritical
    have hvEvent : tcoord v ∈ P.eventTimes := by
      rw [P.mem_eventTimes_iff]
      exact ⟨v, hvCore, rfl⟩
    have hvTime : tcoord v = t := by
      by_contra hne
      have hvErase : tcoord v ∈ other := by
        change tcoord v ∈ P.eventTimes.erase t
        exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨hne, hvEvent⟩
      have hvAbs : |tcoord v - t| ≤ epsilon / 2 := by
        rw [abs_le]
        dsimp [before, after] at hvInterval
        constructor <;> linarith [hvInterval.1, hvInterval.2]
      have hvBall : tcoord v ∈ Metric.ball t epsilon := by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
        exact hvAbs.trans_lt (by linarith)
      exact (hball hvBall) hvErase
    apply P.distinct_times hvCore (P.eventCenter_mem_coreCriticalPoints t ht)
    rw [hvTime, P.eventCenter_time t ht]

name: Submission.MorseEventBracket.modelRadius_pos
statement:
theorem modelRadius_pos (B : MorseEventBracket P t ht) :
    0 < B.modelRadius
proof:
:= by
  rw [modelRadius, Real.sqrt_pos]
  exact sub_pos.mpr B.before_lt

name: Submission.MorseEventBracket.modelRadius_sq
statement:
theorem modelRadius_sq (B : MorseEventBracket P t ht) :
    B.modelRadius ^ 2 = tcoord (P.eventCenter t ht) - B.before
proof:
:= by
  rw [modelRadius]
  exact Real.sq_sqrt (sub_nonneg.mpr B.before_lt.le)

name: Submission.MorseEventBracket.before_eq_center_sub_modelRadius_sq
statement:
theorem before_eq_center_sub_modelRadius_sq
    (B : MorseEventBracket P t ht) :

proof:
:= by
  rw [B.modelRadius_sq]
  ring

name: Submission.MorseEventBracket.after_eq_center_add_modelRadius_sq
statement:
theorem after_eq_center_add_modelRadius_sq
    (B : MorseEventBracket P t ht) :
    B.after = tcoord (P.eventCenter t ht) + B.modelRadius ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [B.modelRadius_sq]
  linarith [B.symmetric]

statement:

proof:
:= by

  exact ⟨fun F hprov => Or.inl ((KW C D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos e₁ e₂).1 F hprov),

name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_rebasedBandCaptureSigned
statement:
theorem productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_rebasedBandCaptureSigned
    {a : ℕ} (KW : ProductionMorseSaddleRebasedBandWindingSignedInputs a) :
    ProductionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies a
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y SX SY SC D t ht hpositive hindex
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  obtain ⟨Vpos⟩ := (D.shortAfterSlice t ht hb hbw).exists_tamedField
  obtain ⟨Vneg⟩ := (D.shortBeforeSlice t ht hb hbw).exists_tamedField
  have hdim : 3 ≤ a + 2 + 1 := by omega
  have hcircle := productionMorseSaddleChartCircleFrameClassOne a
    (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  constructor
  · intro Htop
    have hposEq :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      apply (D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw Vpos).injective
      rw [D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.positive]
      exact Htop.positive_eq
    have hnegNe :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg ≠
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      intro heq'
      apply Htop.negative_ne
      rw [← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.positive, heq']
    have hsplice : ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
        Vpos.orbitFrameClass
            ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
              (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
              (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
              (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) =
          Vneg.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) +
            Vneg.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) + 1 := by
      obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov⟩ :=
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).exists_rebasedMergeBand
          hindex (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) hb
          (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
          (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
          (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg Vpos
          (D.bandTimeField t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_flowDistance_lt t ht)
          (D.bandCoverRadius_cover t ht)
          (fun x hx ht' hf d hd => D.bandExterior_tcoord_flow_after t ht hb hbw
            x hx ht' hf d hd)
          (fun p hfar => D.flowedPositiveBoundaryEnd_mem_negativeBranchOrbit
            t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg p
            (D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale_positive_close t ht p) hfar)
          hnegNe hposEq
      have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass_of_signed
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) F
        ((KW SC D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos e₁ e₂).1 F hprov)
      exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab,
        orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim F
          (F.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
            (hF.trans hcircle))⟩
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, hsp⟩ := hsplice
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg]
    cases e₁ <;> cases e₂ <;>
      first
        | exact absurd rfl hlab
        | exact hsp
        | (rw [hsp]; ring)
  · intro Htop
    have hnegEq :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      apply (D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw Vneg).injective
      rw [D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.positive]
      exact Htop.negative_eq
    have hposNe :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos ≠
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      intro heq'
      apply Htop.positive_ne
      rw [← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.positive, heq']
    have hsplice : ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
        Vneg.orbitFrameClass
            ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
              (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
              (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
              (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) =
          Vpos.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) +
            Vpos.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) + 1 := by
      obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov⟩ :=
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).exists_rebasedSplitBand
          hindex (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) hb
          (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
          (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
          (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos Vneg
          (D.bandTimeField t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_flowDistance_lt t ht)
          (D.bandCoverRadius_cover t ht)
          (fun x hx ht' hf d hd => D.bandExterior_tcoord_flow_before t ht hb
            hbw x hx ht' hf d hd)
          (fun p hfar => D.flowedNegativeBoundaryEnd_mem_positiveBranchOrbit
            t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos p
            (D.bandCaptureScale_sq_le_safeTime t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale_negative_close t ht p) hfar)
          hposNe hnegEq
      have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass_of_signed
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) F
        ((KW SC D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos e₁ e₂).2 F hprov)
      exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab,
        orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim F
          (F.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
            (hF.trans hcircle))⟩
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, hsp⟩ := hsplice
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos]
    cases e₁ <;> cases e₂ <;>
      first
        | exact absurd rfl hlab
        | exact hsp
        | (rw [hsp]; ring)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.continuous_componentSignFun
statement: theorem continuous_componentSignFun : Continuous (componentSignFun k)
proof:
:= by
  unfold componentSignFun
  fun_prop

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.componentSignFun_first
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentSignFun_first (theta : ℝ) :
    componentSignFun k (circleAt (m := k + 1) theta) = 1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  simp [componentSignFun, circleAt_apply_zero, circleAt_apply_one]
  nlinarith [Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq theta]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.componentSignFun_second
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentSignFun_second (theta : ℝ) :
    componentSignFun k (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk theta) = -1 / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h02 : (0 : Fin (k + 4)) ≠ 2 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < k + 4)] at hv
  have h03 : (0 : Fin (k + 4)) ≠ 3 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < k + 4)] at hv
  have h12 : (1 : Fin (k + 4)) ≠ 2 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < k + 4),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 2 < k + 4)] at hv
  have h13 : (1 : Fin (k + 4)) ≠ 3 := by
    intro h
    have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
    norm_num [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 1 < k + 4),
      Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega : 3 < k + 4)] at hv
  simp [componentSignFun,
    secondCircleAt_apply_other (k + 1) hk theta h02 h03,
    secondCircleAt_apply_other (k + 1) hk theta h12 h13] <;>
    norm_num

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.componentSignFun_nonzero_of_mem_fiber
statement:
theorem componentSignFun_nonzero_of_mem_fiber {x : Ek}
    (hx : x ∈ (X (k + 1) hk).fiber) : componentSignFun k x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [X_fiber_eq_two_circles] at hx
  rcases hx with ⟨theta, rfl⟩ | ⟨theta, rfl⟩
  · rw [componentSignFun_first]
    norm_num
  · rw [componentSignFun_second]
    norm_num

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.componentSign_first
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentSign_first (theta : ℝ) :
    componentSign k (circleAt (m := k + 1) theta) = 1 / 2
proof:
:=
  componentSignFun_first k theta

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.componentSign_second
statement:
@[simp] theorem componentSign_second (theta : ℝ) :
    componentSign k (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk theta) = -1 / 2
proof:
:=
  componentSignFun_second k theta

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.first_orbit_subset_standardCircle
statement:
theorem first_orbit_subset_standardCircle
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    V.orbit (circleAt (m := k + 1) 0) ⊆
      (standardCircle : Set Ek)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hp := firstCircleAt_mem_fiber k 0
  have hxfiber := V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hx
  have hbase : 0 < componentSign k (circleAt (m := k + 1) 0) := by
    rw [componentSign_first]
    norm_num
  have hxpos : 0 < componentSign k x :=
    ((componentSign k).pos_iff_of_mem_orbit V hp hx).mp hbase
  rw [X_fiber_eq_two_circles] at hxfiber
  rcases hxfiber with hfirst | hsecond
  · exact hfirst
  · rcases hsecond with ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    rw [componentSign_second] at hxpos
    norm_num at hxpos

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.second_orbit_subset_secondCircle
statement:
theorem second_orbit_subset_secondCircle
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    V.orbit (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk 0) ⊆
      secondCircle (k + 1) hk
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  have hp := secondCircleAt_mem_fiber k 0
  have hsign := (componentSign k).pos_iff_of_mem_orbit V hp hx
  have hbaseNot :
      ¬0 < componentSign k (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk 0) := by
    rw [componentSign_second]
    norm_num
  have hxfiber := V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hx
  rw [X_fiber_eq_two_circles] at hxfiber
  rcases hxfiber with hfirst | hsecond
  · rcases hfirst with ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    have hfirstPos :
        0 < componentSign k (circleAt (m := k + 1) theta) := by
      rw [componentSign_first]
      norm_num
    exact False.elim (hbaseNot (hsign.mpr hfirstPos))
  · exact hsecond

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.first_orbit_eq_standardCircle
statement:
theorem first_orbit_eq_standardCircle
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    V.orbit (circleAt (m := k + 1) 0) =
      (standardCircle : Set Ek)
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact first_orbit_subset_standardCircle k V
  · rintro x ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    exact firstCircleAt_mem_orbit k V theta

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.second_orbit_eq_secondCircle
statement:
theorem second_orbit_eq_secondCircle
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    V.orbit (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk 0) =
      secondCircle (k + 1) hk
proof:
:= by
  apply Set.Subset.antisymm
  · exact second_orbit_subset_secondCircle k V
  · rintro x ⟨theta, rfl⟩
    exact secondCircleAt_mem_orbit k V theta

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstOrbitIndex_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem firstOrbitIndex_coe (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    ((firstOrbitIndex k V : V.OrbitIndex) : Set Ek) =
      V.orbit (circleAt (m := k + 1) 0)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.secondOrbitIndex_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem secondOrbitIndex_coe (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    ((secondOrbitIndex k V : V.OrbitIndex) : Set Ek) =
      V.orbit (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk 0)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.firstOrbitIndex_ne_secondOrbitIndex
statement:
theorem firstOrbitIndex_ne_secondOrbitIndex
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    firstOrbitIndex k V ≠ secondOrbitIndex k V
proof:
:= by
  intro hindex
  have hsets := congrArg (fun O : V.OrbitIndex => (O : Set Ek)) hindex
  change V.orbit (circleAt (m := k + 1) 0) =
    V.orbit (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk 0) at hsets
  rw [first_orbit_eq_standardCircle k V,
    second_orbit_eq_secondCircle k V] at hsets
  have hfirst : circleAt (m := k + 1) 0 ∈ (standardCircle : Set Ek) :=
    ⟨0, rfl⟩
  have hsecond : circleAt (m := k + 1) 0 ∈
      secondCircle (k + 1) hk := by
    rw [← hsets]
    exact hfirst
  exact Set.disjoint_left.mp
    (standardCircle_disjoint_secondCircle (k + 1) hk) hfirst hsecond

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.orbitIndex_eq_first_or_second
statement:
theorem orbitIndex_eq_first_or_second
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    O = firstOrbitIndex k V ∨ O = secondOrbitIndex k V
proof:
:= by
  have hp := V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  rw [X_fiber_eq_two_circles] at hp
  rcases hp with ⟨theta, htheta⟩ | ⟨theta, htheta⟩
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (O : Set Ek) = V.orbit (circleAt (m := k + 1) 0)
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O, ← htheta]
    exact V.orbit_eq_of_mem (firstCircleAt_mem_orbit k V theta)
  · right
    apply Subtype.ext
    change (O : Set Ek) =
      V.orbit (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk 0)
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O, ← htheta]
    exact V.orbit_eq_of_mem (secondCircleAt_mem_orbit k V theta)

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.orbitIndex_card
statement:
theorem orbitIndex_card (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    Fintype.card V.OrbitIndex = 2
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [← Finset.card_univ]
  have huniv : (Finset.univ : Finset V.OrbitIndex) =
      {firstOrbitIndex k V, secondOrbitIndex k V} := by
    ext O
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton,
      true_iff]
    exact orbitIndex_eq_first_or_second k V O
  rw [huniv]
  simp [firstOrbitIndex_ne_secondOrbitIndex k V]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.first_orbitFrameClass_eq_zero
statement:
theorem first_orbitFrameClass_eq_zero
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    V.orbitFrameClass (firstOrbitIndex k V) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [V.orbitFrameClass_eq_fundamental]
  have hpoint : V.orbitPoint (firstOrbitIndex k V) ∈
      V.orbit (circleAt (m := k + 1) 0) := by
    rw [← firstOrbitIndex_coe k V, V.orbitPoint_orbit]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  have hbase := V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit
    (firstCircleAt_mem_fiber k 0) hpoint
  calc
    V.fundamentalFrameClass
        (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (firstOrbitIndex k V)) =
      V.fundamentalFrameClass (firstCircleAt_mem_fiber k 0) := by
        simpa only using hbase
    _ = loopClassZ2 (firstSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop
        (firstSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop_closed :=
      (firstSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental.symm
    _ = 0 := first_paramFrameClass_eq_zero k V

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.second_orbitFrameClass_eq_zero
statement:
theorem second_orbitFrameClass_eq_zero
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    V.orbitFrameClass (secondOrbitIndex k V) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [V.orbitFrameClass_eq_fundamental]
  have hpoint : V.orbitPoint (secondOrbitIndex k V) ∈
      V.orbit (secondCircleAt (k + 1) hk 0) := by
    rw [← secondOrbitIndex_coe k V, V.orbitPoint_orbit]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  have hbase := V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit
    (secondCircleAt_mem_fiber k 0) hpoint
  calc
    V.fundamentalFrameClass
        (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (secondOrbitIndex k V)) =
      V.fundamentalFrameClass (secondCircleAt_mem_fiber k 0) := by
        simpa only using hbase
    _ = loopClassZ2 (secondSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop
        (secondSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameLoop_closed :=
      (secondSimpleClosedOrbitParam k V).paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental.symm
    _ = 0 := second_paramFrameClass_eq_zero k V

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.orbitFrameClass_eq_zero
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_eq_zero (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk))
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) : V.orbitFrameClass O = 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases orbitIndex_eq_first_or_second k V O with h | h
  · rw [h, first_orbitFrameClass_eq_zero k V]
  · rw [h, second_orbitFrameClass_eq_zero k V]

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.allPositive_selects_orbit
proof:
:= by
  rw [(FiberSign.allPositive Y).mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff V O]
  simp

name: Submission.CompactHopfPairConfiguration.positiveFrameLedger_eq_pair_zero
statement:
theorem positiveFrameLedger_eq_pair_zero
    (V : TamedField (X (k + 1) hk)) :
    (FiberSign.allPositive (X (k + 1) hk)).positiveFrameLedger V =
      [(0 : ZMod 2), 0]
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let L :=
    (FiberSign.allPositive (X (k + 1) hk)).positiveFrameLedger V
  have hlen : L.length = 2 := by
    simp only [L, FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger,
      TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, List.length_ofFn]
    rw [Fintype.card_congr (allPositiveSelectedOrbitEquiv k V),
      orbitIndex_card k V]
  have hall : ∀ z ∈ L, z = (0 : ZMod 2) := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [L, FiberSign.positiveFrameLedger,
      TamedField.selectedFrameLedger, List.mem_ofFn] at hz
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hz
    exact orbitFrameClass_eq_zero k V _
  calc
    L = List.replicate L.length 0 := List.eq_replicate_length.mpr hall
    _ = [(0 : ZMod 2), 0] := by rw [hlen]; rfl

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_regularSlab
statement:
theorem sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_regularSlab
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁) {a b : ℝ}
    (hab : a ≤ b) (hreg : regularSlab C.cobordism.G a b) :
    (C.sliceSign a (hreg.sliceRegular ⟨le_rfl, hab⟩)).positiveDelta =
      (C.sliceSign b (hreg.sliceRegular ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩)).positiveDelta
proof:
:= by
  let D := C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
  let ha : a ∈ Icc a b := ⟨le_rfl, hab⟩
  let hb : b ∈ Icc a b := ⟨hab, le_rfl⟩
  let Xa := SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt D a (hreg.sliceRegular ha)
  let Xb := SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt D b (hreg.sliceRegular hb)
  let Va : TamedField Xa := Xa.exists_tamedField.some
  let Vb : TamedField Xb := Xb.exists_tamedField.some
  obtain ⟨W⟩ := exists_slabTamedField D hreg
  have htransport :
      (C.sliceSign a (hreg.sliceRegular ha)).positiveFramedDelta Va =
        (C.sliceSign b (hreg.sliceRegular hb)).positiveFramedDelta Vb :=
    C.positiveFramedDelta_eq_regularSlab W hreg ha hb Va Vb
  calc
    (C.sliceSign a (hreg.sliceRegular ha)).positiveDelta =
        (C.sliceSign a (hreg.sliceRegular ha)).positiveFramedDelta Va :=
      (C.sliceSign a (hreg.sliceRegular ha)).positiveDelta_eq Va
    _ = (C.sliceSign b (hreg.sliceRegular hb)).positiveFramedDelta Vb :=
      htransport
    _ = (C.sliceSign b (hreg.sliceRegular hb)).positiveDelta :=
      ((C.sliceSign b (hreg.sliceRegular hb)).positiveDelta_eq Vb).symm

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_avoid_eventTimes
statement:
theorem sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_avoid_eventTimes
    (C : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁)
    (P : MorsePosition C.cobordism) {a b : ℝ} (hab : a ≤ b)
    (ha : sliceRegular C.cobordism.G a)
    (hb : sliceRegular C.cobordism.G b)
    (havoid : ∀ t ∈ P.eventTimes, t ∉ Icc a b) :
    (C.sliceSign a ha).positiveDelta = (C.sliceSign b hb).positiveDelta
proof:
:= by
  let hreg : regularSlab C.cobordism.G a b :=
    (P.regularSlab_iff_avoid_eventTimes a b).2 havoid
  simpa only using C.sliceSign_positiveDelta_eq_of_regularSlab hab hreg

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_flipSecondArcWitness_of_negativeMerge
statement:
theorem exists_flipSecondArcWitness_of_negativeMerge
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (hneg : D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .negative =
      D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .positive)
    (Cov : ChronologicalSaddleSmallEndCover D t ht) :
    Nonempty (ChronologicalSaddleFlipSecondArcWitness D t ht Cov)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  
  have hσ_pos := Cov.sigma_pos
  have hσ_T := Cov.sigma_lt_embedded
  have hσ_M : Cov.sigma < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    hσ_T.trans_le (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hepr_pos := D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_pos t ht
  have hepr_T := D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  have hCD := D.eventModel_param_contDiffAt_one t ht
  obtain ⟨εc, hεc, hcenterCov⟩ :=
    D.eventModel_covers_fiber_within_morseRadius t ht hσ_pos
  have hcritnorm : ∀ pl : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      ‖saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam pl Cov.sigma‖ = Cov.sigma := by
    intro pl
    exact norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam pl.1 pl.2 hσ_pos
      (by nlinarith only [hσ_pos])
  have hBEcrit : ∀ pl : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl Cov.sigma =
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).param
          (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam pl Cov.sigma) := by
    intro pl
    simp [StandardMorseEventAt.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd,
      saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint]
  have hcritmem : ∀ pl : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl Cov.sigma ∈
        StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
          D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht) :=
    fun pl =>
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd_mem_puncturedCriticalSlice
        hindex pl hσ_pos hσ_T
  have hgEnd_pos : ∀ pl : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      0 < dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl
        Cov.sigma) (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    intro pl
    rw [dist_pos]
    exact (hcritmem pl).2.2
  set gmin : ℝ := saddleFourEndMin (fun pl =>
    dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl
      Cov.sigma) (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) with hgmindef
  have hgmin_pos : 0 < gmin := saddleFourEndMin_pos hgEnd_pos
  have hgmin_le : ∀ pl, gmin ≤
      dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl
        Cov.sigma) (D.position.eventCenter t ht) :=
    fun pl => saddleFourEndMin_le _ pl
  
  have hsigns : ∀ pl : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, ∃ ε > 0,
      ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht →
        dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u)
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param
            (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam pl Cov.sigma)) < ε →
        0 < signedBranch pl.1 (u 0) ∧ 0 < signedBranch pl.2 (u 1) := by
    intro pl
    obtain ⟨ε₁, hε₁, h₁⟩ :=
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).exists_param_signedBranch_neighborhood
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) pl.1 0
        (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam pl Cov.sigma)
        hepr_pos hepr_T (le_refl _)
        (by rw [hcritnorm pl]; exact hσ_T)
        (StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam_first_sign
          pl hσ_pos)
    obtain ⟨ε₂, hε₂, h₂⟩ :=
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).exists_param_signedBranch_neighborhood
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) pl.2 1
        (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam pl Cov.sigma)
        hepr_pos hepr_T (le_refl _)
        (by rw [hcritnorm pl]; exact hσ_T)
        (StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam_second_sign
          pl hσ_pos)
    refine ⟨min ε₁ ε₂, lt_min hε₁ hε₂, ?_⟩
    intro u hu hd
    exact ⟨h₁ u hu (hd.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)),
      h₂ u hu (hd.trans_le (min_le_right _ _))⟩
  set εsg : ℝ := saddleFourEndMin (fun pl => (hsigns pl).choose)
    with hεsgdef
  have hεsg_pos : 0 < εsg :=
    saddleFourEndMin_pos (fun pl => (hsigns pl).choose_spec.1)
  have hεsg_le : ∀ pl, εsg ≤ (hsigns pl).choose :=
    fun pl => saddleFourEndMin_le _ pl
  set mMar : ℝ := min (Cov.delta / 2) (min (εsg / 2) (gmin / 4))
    with hmMardef
  have hmMar_pos : 0 < mMar :=
    lt_min (by linarith only [Cov.delta_pos])
      (lt_min (by linarith only [hεsg_pos]) (by linarith only [hgmin_pos]))
  have hmMar_delta : mMar ≤ Cov.delta / 2 := min_le_left _ _
  have hmMar_sg : mMar ≤ εsg / 2 :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)
  have hmMar_g : mMar ≤ gmin / 4 :=
    (min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)
  
  have hcornerCont : ∀ pl : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch, ∃ η > 0,
      ∀ ξ : ℝ, |ξ| < η →
        dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param
          (saddleCornerParam pl Cov.sigma ξ))
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl
            Cov.sigma) < mMar := by
    intro pl
    have hφcont : ContinuousAt (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).param
          (saddleCornerParam pl Cov.sigma ξ)) 0 := by
      apply ContinuousAt.comp
      · apply ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).param_differentiableAt
          _ ?_).continuousAt
        rw [saddleCornerParam_zero_eq, hcritnorm pl]
        exact hσ_T
      · exact (continuous_saddleCornerParam pl Cov.sigma).continuousAt
    obtain ⟨η, hη, hball⟩ :=
      Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hφcont mMar hmMar_pos
    refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
    intro ξ hξ
    have hd : dist ξ (0 : ℝ) < η := by rwa [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero]
    have h := hball hd
    rwa [saddleCornerParam_zero_eq, ← hBEcrit pl] at h
  set ηc : ℝ := saddleFourEndMin (fun pl => (hcornerCont pl).choose)
    with hηcdef
  have hηc_pos : 0 < ηc :=
    saddleFourEndMin_pos (fun pl => (hcornerCont pl).choose_spec.1)
  have hηc_le : ∀ pl, ηc ≤ (hcornerCont pl).choose :=
    fun pl => saddleFourEndMin_le _ pl
  
  have hcont0 : ContinuousAt (D.position.eventModel t ht).param 0 :=
    ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).param_differentiableAt 0
      (by simpa using
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_pos)).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨η₀, hη₀, hball₀⟩ :=
    Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont0 (gmin / 4) (by linarith only [hgmin_pos])
  set r₁ : ℝ := min (η₀ / 2) (Cov.sigma / 2) with hr₁def
  have hr₁_pos : 0 < r₁ :=
    lt_min (by linarith only [hη₀]) (by linarith only [hσ_pos])
  have hr₁_σ : r₁ < Cov.sigma :=
    lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_right _ _) (by linarith only [hσ_pos])
  have hr₁ball : ∀ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ ≤ r₁ →
      dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u)
        (D.position.eventCenter t ht) < gmin / 4 := by
    intro u hu
    have hd : dist u 0 < η₀ := by
      rw [dist_zero_right]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt hu (lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _)
        (by linarith only [hη₀]))
    have h := hball₀ hd
    rwa [(D.position.eventModel t ht).param_zero] at h
  
  set rmaxS : ℝ := max Cov.sigma
    (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht) with hrmaxSdef
  have hrmaxS_T : rmaxS < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
    max_lt hσ_T hepr_T
  obtain ⟨gapS, hgapS, hshell⟩ :=
    (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).exists_shell_center_gap
      hr₁_pos hrmaxS_T
  
  set KE : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :=
    slabFiber D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after ∩
      {z | εc ≤ dist z (D.position.eventCenter t ht)} with hKEdef
  have hKEcompact : IsCompact KE := by
    apply (isCompact_slabFiber
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after).inter_right
    exact isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_id.dist continuous_const)
  have hKEreg : KE ⊆ slabRegularSet D.signedOutput.cobordism.G := by
    intro z hz
    have hspatial : Surjective
        (spatialDeriv D.signedOutput.cobordism.G z) := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hcritical : z ∈ timeCritical D.signedOutput.cobordism.G :=
        ⟨hz.1.1, hnot⟩
      have hzc : z = D.position.eventCenter t ht :=
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).isolates z hcritical hz.1.2
      have hdist := hz.2
      change εc ≤ dist z (D.position.eventCenter t ht) at hdist
      rw [hzc, dist_self] at hdist
      exact (not_lt_of_ge hdist) hεc
    exact mem_slabRegularSet_of_spatial_surjective
      (D.signedOutput.cobordism.regular z hz.1.1) hspatial
  set RE : CompactTimeTamedField
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData KE :=
    (exists_compactTimeTamedField
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
      hKEcompact hKEreg).some with hREdef
  set BdE : ℝ := (RE.base.bound : ℝ) with hBdEdef
  have hBdE : 0 ≤ BdE := RE.base.bound.coe_nonneg
  
  set mSmall : ℝ := min (εc / 4) mMar with hmSmalldef
  have hmSmall_pos : 0 < mSmall := lt_min (by linarith only [hεc]) hmMar_pos
  have hthr_pos : 0 < min Cov.sigma (min 1 (min ηc (min RE.safeTime
      (min (D.position.eventBracket t ht).modelRadius
        (mSmall / (BdE + 1)))))) := by
    apply lt_min hσ_pos
    apply lt_min one_pos
    apply lt_min hηc_pos
    apply lt_min RE.safeTime_pos
    apply lt_min (D.position.eventBracket t ht).modelRadius_pos
    positivity
  obtain ⟨S, hSthr⟩ := exists_saddleArcCutScale_scale_lt Cov
    (constantSaddleArcCut Cov hindex (SaddleBranch.negative,
      SaddleBranch.negative)) hthr_pos
  have hs_pos := S.scale_pos
  have hsσ : S.scale < Cov.sigma :=
    lt_of_lt_of_le hSthr (min_le_left _ _)
  have hs1 : S.scale < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hSthr
    ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _))
  have hsηc : S.scale < ηc := lt_of_lt_of_le hSthr

    have humT : ‖u_m‖ < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius := by
      rw [humnorm]; exact hσ_T
    have humM : ‖u_m‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius := by
      rw [humnorm]; exact hσ_M
    have hum0 : u_m ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      rw [h, norm_zero] at humnorm
      linarith only [humnorm, hσ_pos]
    have humquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u_m 0, u_m 1) = -(S.scale ^ 2) :=
      morseQuadratic_saddleNegativeBoundaryEndParam pl.2 pl.1 Cov.sigma
        S.scale
    have htumb : tcoord ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m) =
        tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2 := by
      have h := (D.position.eventModel t ht).time_model u_m humM
      rw [hindex] at h
      rw [h, humquad]
      ring
    have hlift : cobSpaceTime (A.point l)
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2) =
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m := by
      rw [hAl, ← htumb, spaceTime_spacePart]
    
    have hmB_orbit : A.point l ∈ (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit Pb.p :=
      A.point_mem_orbit l
    have hmB_fib : A.point l ∈
        ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeSlice
          S.scale (saddleArcCutBeforeTime_regular S)).fiber :=
      (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit_subset_fiber Pb.hp hmB_orbit
    
    have hsurj_m : Surjective (spatialDeriv D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m)) :=
      hregAt u_m humT hum0 (by
        rw [humquad, abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)])
    
    set tau := tauField
      ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeSlice
        S.scale (saddleArcCutBeforeTime_regular S)).g (A.point l)
      with htaudef
    set y_m : ℝ := signedBranch pl.1 (saddleBoundaryParameter Cov.sigma
      S.scale) with hymdef
    have hum_curve : u_m = pairToMorseParam
        (saddleNegativeArc pl.2 S.scale y_m) := rfl
    have hparamD' : HasFDerivAt (D.position.eventModel t ht).param
        (fderiv ℝ (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m)
        (pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc pl.2 S.scale y_m)) :=
      ((hCD u_m humM).differentiableAt (by simp)).hasFDerivAt
    have hamb := hparamD'.comp_hasDerivAt y_m
      (hasDerivAt_saddleNegativeCurve pl.2 hs_pos y_m)
    set c_m : ℝ := signedBranch pl.2
      ((Real.sqrt (S.scale ^ 2 + y_m ^ 2))⁻¹) with hcmdef
    have hsqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt (S.scale ^ 2 + y_m ^ 2) :=
      Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity)
    set ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
      ⟪spaceInclL tau, (D.position.eventModel t ht).param
        (pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc pl.2 S.scale y))⟫ -
      ⟪spaceInclL tau, (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m⟫ with hψdef
    have hψm : ψ y_m = 0 := by
      rw [hψdef]
      show ⟪spaceInclL tau, (D.position.eventModel t ht).param
        (pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc pl.2 S.scale y_m))⟫ -
        ⟪spaceInclL tau, (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m⟫ = 0
      rw [← hum_curve, sub_self]
    have hψder : HasDerivAt ψ
        (⟪spaceInclL tau, fderiv ℝ (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m
          (signedBranch pl.2 ((Real.sqrt (S.scale ^ 2 + y_m ^ 2))⁻¹) •
            saddleChartTangent (pairToMorseParam
              (saddleNegativeArc pl.2 S.scale y_m)))⟫) y_m := by
      have h₁ : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ =>
          (spaceInclL tau : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))) 0 y_m :=
        hasDerivAt_const _ _
      have h₂ := (h₁.inner ℝ hamb)
      rw [hψdef]
      have h₃ := h₂.sub_const
        ⟪spaceInclL tau, (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m⟫
      simpa using h₃
    
    set W := fderiv ℝ (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m
      (saddleChartTangent u_m) with hWdef
    have hdψ_eq : ⟪spaceInclL tau,
        fderiv ℝ (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m
          (signedBranch pl.2 ((Real.sqrt (S.scale ^ 2 + y_m ^ 2))⁻¹) •
            saddleChartTangent (pairToMorseParam
              (saddleNegativeArc pl.2 S.scale y_m)))⟫ =
        c_m * ⟪tau, spacePart W⟫ := by
      rw [show saddleChartTangent (pairToMorseParam
          (saddleNegativeArc pl.2 S.scale y_m)) =
          saddleChartTangent u_m from by rw [← hum_curve]]
      rw [map_smul, real_inner_smul_right, inner_spaceInclL_left]
    have hkCne : kerCross (sliceMap D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))
        (A.point l) ≠ 0 := by
      apply (kerCross_ne_zero_iff _ _).mpr
      show Surjective (fderiv ℝ (sliceMap D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2)) (A.point l))
      rw [fderiv_sliceMap D.signedOutput.cobordism.smooth, hlift]
      exact hsurj_m
    have htau_eq : tau = tauField (sliceMap D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))
        (A.point l) := rfl
    have hΘm_eq : ⟪kerCross (sliceMap D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2)) (A.point l),
        spacePart W⟫ = Θ u_m := by
      rw [hΘdef]
      show _ = StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.chartKernelPairing
        (D.position.eventModel t ht) u_m
      rw [StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.chartKernelPairing,
        htumb, ← hAl]
    have hWpair : ⟪tau, spacePart W⟫ =
        ‖kerCross (sliceMap D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
          (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))
          (A.point l)‖⁻¹ * Θ u_m := by
      rw [htau_eq, inner_tauField_eq_smul_inner_kerCross, hΘm_eq]
    have hΘmne : Θ u_m ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hΘdef]
      exact (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).chartKernelPairing_ne_zero
        hindex humT hum0 (hCD u_m humM) hsurj_m
    have hninv_pos : 0 < ‖kerCross (sliceMap D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))
        (A.point l)‖⁻¹ := by
      rw [inv_pos]
      exact norm_pos_iff.mpr hkCne
    have hcm_ne : c_m ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hcmdef]
      cases hp2 : pl.2 <;> simp [signedBranch] <;> positivity
    have hdψne : c_m * ⟪tau, spacePart W⟫ ≠ 0 := by
      apply mul_ne_zero hcm_ne
      rw [hWpair]
      exact mul_ne_zero (ne_of_gt hninv_pos) hΘmne
    have hψder' : HasDerivAt ψ (c_m * ⟪tau, spacePart W⟫) y_m := by
      rw [← hdψ_eq]
      exact hψder
    obtain ⟨δψ, hδψ, hsignprod⟩ := hasDerivAt_sign_prod hψder' hψm hdψne
    
    obtain ⟨δgap, hδgap, hgapfn⟩ :=
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).exists_param_separation_gap
        hrmaxS_T hδψ
    have hper_pos := (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).fundamentalPeriod_pos
      hmB_fib
    obtain ⟨r_fb, hr_fb, hbox⟩ :=
      (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).exists_signed_flowbox hmB_fib
        (c := (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).fundamentalPeriod hmB_fib / 2)
        (by linarith only [hper_pos])
    
    set dd : ℝ := min (δflow / 2) (min (r_fb / 2)
      (min ((saddleArcCutBeforeField S).fundamentalPeriod hmB_fib / 4)
        (min (δgap / 2) mMar))) with hdddef
    have hdd_pos : 0 < dd := by
      apply lt_min (by linarith only [hδflow])
      apply lt_min (by linarith only [hr_fb])
      apply lt_min (by linarith only [hper_pos])
      exact lt_min (by linarith only [hδgap]) hmMar_pos
    have hdd_δflow : dd < δflow :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (min_le_left _ _) (by linarith only [hδflow])
    have hdd_rfb : dd < r_fb := lt_of_le_of_lt
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)) (by linarith only [hr_fb])
    have hdd_per : dd < (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).fundamentalPeriod
        hmB_fib / 2 := lt_of_le_of_lt
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans
        (min_le_left _ _))) (by linarith only [hper_pos])
    have hdd_δgap : dd < δgap := lt_of_le_of_lt
      ((min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans
        ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_left _ _)))) (by linarith only [hδgap])
    have hdd_mMar : dd ≤ mMar :=
      (min_le_right _ _).trans ((min_le_right _ _).trans
        ((min_le_right _ _).trans (min_le_right _ _)))
    
    have hx_mem := hflowmem dd hdd_pos hdd_δflow
    set x_d := (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).flow (A.point l)
      (Pb.flowSign * (dir * dd)) with hxddef
    have habs_arg : |Pb.flowSign * (dir * dd)| = dd := by
      rcases Pb.flowSign_eq_one_or_neg_one with hsg | hsg <;>
        rcases hdir with hd1 | hd1 <;>
        rw [hsg, hd1] <;>
        simp [abs_of_pos hdd_pos, abs_of_nonneg hdd_pos.le]
    have hx_orbit : x_d ∈ (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit Pb.p := by
      have hx' := hx_mem
      rw [← A.range_cyclicCutPath r₀] at hx'
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hx'
      rw [← hw]
      exact A.cyclicCutPath_mem_orbit r₀ w
    have hx_fib : x_d ∈
        ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeSlice
          S.scale (saddleArcCutBeforeTime_regular S)).fiber :=
      (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).orbit_subset_fiber Pb.hp hx_orbit
    have hx_dist : dist x_d (A.point l) ≤ dd := by
      have h := (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).dist_flow_le (A.point l)
        (Pb.flowSign * (dir * dd))
      rwa [habs_arg] at h
    
    have hzG : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (cobSpaceTime x_d
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2)) = 0 := by
      have h := hx_fib
      rw [StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddleNegativeSlice,
        SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber] at h
      exact h
    have hz_close : dist (cobSpaceTime x_d
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl
          Cov.sigma) < dd + mMar := by
      have h1 : dist (cobSpaceTime x_d
          (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m) ≤ dd := by
        rw [← hlift, dist_cobSpaceTime_same]
        exact hx_dist
      have h2 := hmark_close pl
      rw [hBEneg pl] at h2
      calc
        dist (cobSpaceTime x_d
            (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))
            ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl
              Cov.sigma) ≤
            dist (cobSpaceTime x_d
              (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))
              ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m) +
            dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m)
              ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl
                Cov.sigma) := dist_triangle _ _ _
        _ < dd + mMar := by
          have h2' : dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m)
              ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl
