            rwa [← humdef] at h2
          linarith only [h1, h2']
    obtain ⟨u_d, hud_norm, hud_eq⟩ := Cov.cover pl _
      (by
        calc
          dist (cobSpaceTime x_d
              (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))
              ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl
                Cov.sigma) < dd + mMar := hz_close
          _ ≤ 2 * mMar := by linarith only [hdd_mMar]
          _ ≤ Cov.delta := by linarith only [hmMar_delta])
      hzG
    have hud_dist : dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_d)
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param
          (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam pl Cov.sigma)) < εsg := by
      rw [hud_eq, ← hBEcrit pl]
      calc
        dist (cobSpaceTime x_d
            (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))
            ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd pl
              Cov.sigma) < dd + mMar := hz_close
        _ ≤ 2 * mMar := by linarith only [hdd_mMar]
        _ ≤ εsg := by linarith only [hmMar_sg]
    have hud_signs := (hsigns pl).choose_spec.2 u_d hud_norm
      (lt_of_lt_of_le hud_dist (hεsg_le pl))
    obtain ⟨hud0, hud1⟩ := hud_signs
    have hudM : ‖u_d‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
      hud_norm.trans_le (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_le_eventRadius t ht)
    have hud_quad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u_d 0, u_d 1) =
        -(S.scale ^ 2) := by
      have h := (D.position.eventModel t ht).time_model u_d hudM
      rw [hindex] at h
      have h2 : tcoord ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_d) =
          tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2 := by
        rw [hud_eq, tcoord_spaceTime]
      rw [h] at h2
      linarith only [h2]
    have hud_curve := eq_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc_of_signedBranch
      pl.2 S.scale u_d hud_quad hud1
    set y_d : ℝ := u_d 0 with hyddef
    have hx_spacePart : x_d = spacePart
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_d) := by
      rw [hud_eq, spacePart_spaceTime]
    
    have hnorm_ge : Cov.sigma ≤ ‖u_d‖ := by
      by_contra h
      push_neg at h
      exact (hother r₀ hr₀i hr₀j u_d hud_quad h)
        (hx_spacePart ▸ hx_mem)
    have hud_normsq : ‖u_d‖ ^ 2 = S.scale ^ 2 + 2 * y_d ^ 2 := by
      calc
        ‖u_d‖ ^ 2 = ‖pairToMorseParam
            (saddleNegativeArc pl.2 S.scale y_d)‖ ^ 2 :=
          congrArg (fun z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2) => ‖z‖ ^ 2) hud_curve
        _ = S.scale ^ 2 + 2 * y_d ^ 2 :=
          norm_pairToMorseParam_saddleNegativeArc_sq pl.2 S.scale y_d
    have hym_sq : y_m ^ 2 = (Cov.sigma ^ 2 - S.scale ^ 2) / 2 := by
      rw [hymdef, signedBranch_sq]
      exact saddleBoundaryParameter_sq hsqm.le
    have hy_ge : y_m ^ 2 ≤ y_d ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : Cov.sigma ^ 2 ≤ ‖u_d‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [pow_two, pow_two]
        exact mul_self_le_mul_self hσ_pos.le hnorm_ge
      linarith only [h1, hud_normsq, hym_sq, hsqm]
    have hym_sign : 0 < signedBranch pl.1 y_m := by
      rw [hymdef]
      have hbp : 0 < saddleBoundaryParameter Cov.sigma S.scale := by
        apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
        apply div_pos _ (by norm_num)
        linarith only [hsqm]
      cases hp1 : pl.1 <;> simpa [signedBranch] using hbp
    have hy_ne : y_d ≠ y_m := by
      intro hyeq
      have hueq : u_d = u_m := by
        rw [hud_curve, hum_curve, hyeq]
      have hxeq : x_d = A.point l := by
        rw [hx_spacePart, hueq, ← hAl]
      have htime_eq := (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).flow_time_eq_of_small
        hmB_fib
        (τ := Pb.flowSign * (dir * dd)) (d := 0)
        (by rw [habs_arg]; linarith only [hdd_per])
        (by simpa using hper_pos)
        (by rw [(saddleArcCutBeforeField S).flow_zero, ← hxddef, hxeq])
      rcases Pb.flowSign_eq_one_or_neg_one with hsg | hsg <;>
        rcases hdir with hd1 | hd1 <;>
        rw [hsg, hd1] at htime_eq <;>
        linarith only [htime_eq, hdd_pos]
    have hside : 0 < signedBranch pl.1 1 * (y_d - y_m) := by
      have hyd_sign : 0 < signedBranch pl.1 y_d := hud0
      cases hp1 : pl.1
      · rw [hp1] at hyd_sign hym_sign
        simp only [signedBranch] at hyd_sign hym_sign ⊢
        have h1 : y_m < y_d := by
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hy_ne with h | h
          · exfalso; nlinarith only [h, hyd_sign, hym_sign, hy_ge]
          · exact h
        linarith only [h1]
      · rw [hp1] at hyd_sign hym_sign
        simp only [signedBranch] at hyd_sign hym_sign ⊢
        have h1 : y_d < y_m := by
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hy_ne with h | h
          · exact h
          · exfalso; nlinarith only [h, hyd_sign, hym_sign, hy_ge]
        linarith only [h1]
    
    have hx_ball : x_d ∈
        ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeSlice
          S.scale (saddleArcCutBeforeTime_regular S)).fiber ∩
        Metric.ball (A.point l) r_fb :=
      ⟨hx_fib, by
        rw [Metric.mem_ball]
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt hx_dist hdd_rfb⟩
    obtain ⟨τx, hτx_abs, hτx_flow, hτx_pos, hτx_neg⟩ := hbox x_d hx_ball
    have hτx_eq : τx = Pb.flowSign * (dir * dd) := by
      apply (saddleArcCutBeforeField S).flow_time_eq_of_small hmB_fib
        (by linarith only [hτx_abs])
        (by rw [habs_arg]; linarith only [hdd_per])
      rw [hτx_flow]
    
    have hψyd : ψ y_d = ⟪tau, x_d - A.point l⟫ := by
      rw [hψdef]
      show ⟪spaceInclL tau, (D.position.eventModel t ht).param
        (pairToMorseParam (saddleNegativeArc pl.2 S.scale y_d))⟫ -
        ⟪spaceInclL tau, (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m⟫ = _
      rw [← hud_curve, inner_spaceInclL_left, inner_spaceInclL_left,
        ← hx_spacePart, ← hAl, inner_sub_right]
    have hsign_flow : 0 < (Pb.flowSign * dir) * ψ y_d := by
      rw [hψyd]
      have htauX : tauField (saddleArcCutBeforeSlice S).g (A.point l) =
          tau := rfl
      rcases Pb.flowSign_eq_one_or_neg_one with hsg | hsg <;>
        rcases hdir with hd1 | hd1
      · have hτpos : 0 < τx := by rw [hτx_eq, hsg, hd1]; simpa using hdd_pos
        have h := hτx_pos.mp hτpos
        rw [htauX] at h
        rw [hsg, hd1]
        simpa using h
      · have hτneg : τx < 0 := by
          rw [hτx_eq, hsg, hd1]
          simpa using hdd_pos
        have h := hτx_neg.mp hτneg
        rw [htauX] at h
        rw [hsg, hd1]
        simpa using h
      · have hτneg : τx < 0 := by
          rw [hτx_eq, hsg, hd1]
          simpa using hdd_pos
        have h := hτx_neg.mp hτneg
        rw [htauX] at h
        rw [hsg, hd1]
        simpa using h
      · have hτpos : 0 < τx := by
          rw [hτx_eq, hsg, hd1]
          simpa using hdd_pos
        have h := hτx_pos.mp hτpos
        rw [htauX] at h
        rw [hsg, hd1]
        simpa using h
    
    have hy_close : |y_d - y_m| < δψ := by
      have h1 : dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_d)
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param u_m) ≤ dd := by
        rw [hud_eq, ← hlift, dist_cobSpaceTime_same]
        exact hx_dist
      by_contra hcon
      push_neg at hcon
      have h2 := hgapfn u_d u_m
        (le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hud_norm (le_max_right _ _)))
        (by rw [humnorm]; exact le_max_left _ _)
        (by
          calc
            δψ ≤ |y_d - y_m| := hcon
            _ = |(u_d - u_m) 0| := by
              rw [hyddef]
              congr 1
              have : (u_d - u_m) 0 = u_d 0 - u_m 0 := rfl
              rw [this]
              congr 1
              rw [hum_curve, pairToMorseParam_apply_zero]
              rfl
            _ ≤ ‖u_d - u_m‖ := abs_coord_le_norm _ _
            _ = dist u_d u_m := (dist_eq_norm u_d u_m).symm)
      linarith only [h2, lt_of_le_of_lt h1 hdd_δgap]
    have hprod := hsignprod y_d hy_close hy_ne
    
    have hbR2 : signedBranch pl.2 1 * signedBranch pl.2 1 = 1 := by
      cases hp2 : pl.2 <;> norm_num [signedBranch]
    have hcm_split : c_m = signedBranch pl.2 1 *
        (Real.sqrt (S.scale ^ 2 + y_m ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [hcmdef]
      cases hp2 : pl.2 <;> simp [signedBranch]
    have hC : 0 < (c_m * ⟪tau, spacePart W⟫) *
        (signedBranch pl.2 1 * Θ u_m) := by
      rw [hWpair, hcm_split]
      have hΘsq : 0 < Θ u_m * Θ u_m := mul_self_pos.mpr hΘmne
      have hinv2 : 0 < (Real.sqrt (S.scale ^ 2 + y_m ^ 2))⁻¹ :=
        inv_pos.mpr hsqrt_pos
      have hexpand : (signedBranch pl.2 1 *
          (Real.sqrt (S.scale ^ 2 + y_m ^ 2))⁻¹ *
          (‖kerCross (sliceMap D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
            (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))
            (A.point l)‖⁻¹ * Θ u_m)) *
          (signedBranch pl.2 1 * Θ u_m) =
          (signedBranch pl.2 1 * signedBranch pl.2 1) *
            ((Real.sqrt (S.scale ^ 2 + y_m ^ 2))⁻¹ *
              (‖kerCross (sliceMap D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
                (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - S.scale ^ 2))

          (leftRay.symm.trans (midPath.trans rightRay)) w) ∨
        (∃ z : I, rightRay z =
          (leftRay.symm.trans (midPath.trans rightRay)) w) := by
      intro w
      have hw : (leftRay.symm.trans (midPath.trans rightRay)) w ∈
          Set.range (leftRay.symm.trans (midPath.trans rightRay)) :=
        ⟨w, rfl⟩
      rw [Path.trans_range, Path.symm_range, Path.trans_range] at hw
      rcases hw with ⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz⟩
      · exact Or.inl ⟨z, hz⟩
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨z, hz⟩)
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨z, hz⟩)
    
    have hmemext : ∀ w : I,
        (leftRay.symm.trans (midPath.trans rightRay)) w ∈
          StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
            D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
      intro w
      rcases hdecomp w with ⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz⟩ <;> rw [← hz]
      · exact (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleCriticalRayToBoundaryPath_mem_puncturedCriticalSlice
          (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) hindex pls.1 pls.2
          Cov.sigma u_p hup_quad hup_s1 hup_s2 hσ_pos hupT' hσ_T z
      · exact hmid_mem z
      · exact (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleCriticalRayToBoundaryPath_mem_puncturedCriticalSlice
          (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) hindex plt.1 plt.2
          Cov.sigma u_q huq_quad huq_s1 huq_s2 hσ_pos huqT' hσ_T z
    
    have hray_bound : ∀ (pp : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
        (uu : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
        morseQuadratic .saddle (uu 0, uu 1) = (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 →
        0 < signedBranch pp.1 (uu 0) → 0 < signedBranch pp.2 (uu 1) →
        r₁ < ‖uu‖ → ‖uu‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht →
        ∀ z' : I, eps ≤ dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param
          (saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam pp.1 pp.2 Cov.sigma 0 uu z'))
          (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
      intro pp uu hqq hs1' hs2' hfloor hnE z'
      have hzero_sq : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 < Cov.sigma ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith only [hσ_pos]
      have hlo := norm_saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam_ge_min pp.1 pp.2
        uu hqq hs1' hs2' hσ_pos hzero_sq z'
      have hhi := norm_saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam_le_max pp.1 pp.2
        uu hqq hs1' hσ_pos hzero_sq z'
      have hlo' : r₁ ≤ ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam pp.1 pp.2
          Cov.sigma 0 uu z'‖ :=
        le_trans (le_min (le_of_lt hr₁_σ) (le_of_lt hfloor)) hlo
      have hhi' : ‖saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam pp.1 pp.2 Cov.sigma 0
          uu z'‖ ≤ rmaxS :=
        le_trans hhi (max_le (le_max_left _ _)
          (le_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le hnE (le_max_right _ _))))
      exact le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (hshell _ hlo' hhi')
    
    have havoidP : ∀ w : I, eps ≤
        dist ((leftRay.symm.trans (midPath.trans rightRay)) w)
          (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
      intro w
      rcases hdecomp w with ⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz⟩ | ⟨z, hz⟩ <;> rw [← hz]
      · show eps ≤ dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param
          (saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam pls.1 pls.2 Cov.sigma 0 u_p z))
          (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
        exact hray_bound pls u_p hup_quad hup_s1 hup_s2 hup_floor
          hup_norm z
      · show eps ≤ dist (RE.base.flow
          ((A.cyclicCutRegularZeroPath r₀).toPath z) (S.scale ^ 2))
          (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
        have h1 : εc ≤ dist ((A.cyclicCutRegularZeroPath r₀).toPath z)
            (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := (hγK z).2
        have h2 := hflowdistE ((A.cyclicCutRegularZeroPath r₀).toPath z)
        have h3 := dist_triangle
          ((A.cyclicCutRegularZeroPath r₀).toPath z)
          (RE.base.flow ((A.cyclicCutRegularZeroPath r₀).toPath z)
            (S.scale ^ 2))
          (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
        have h2' : dist ((A.cyclicCutRegularZeroPath r₀).toPath z)
            (RE.base.flow ((A.cyclicCutRegularZeroPath r₀).toPath z)
              (S.scale ^ 2)) ≤ BdE * S.scale ^ 2 := by
          rw [dist_comm]
          exact h2
        have h4 : BdE * S.scale ^ 2 ≤ εc / 4 := hBds_εc.le
        have h6 : eps ≤ εc / 2 := min_le_left _ _
        linarith
      · show eps ≤ dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).param
          (saddlePositiveArcToBoundaryParam plt.1 plt.2 Cov.sigma 0 u_q z))
          (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
        exact hray_bound plt u_q huq_quad huq_s1 huq_s2 huq_floor
          huq_norm z
    exact ⟨⟨leftRay.symm.trans (midPath.trans rightRay), hmemext⟩, havoidP⟩
  
  obtain ⟨hflip1, hflip2⟩ := hflip
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ : ∃ b, b = pls.1 := ⟨pls.1, rfl⟩
  cases he : pls.2
  · 
    have hq2 : plt.2 = SaddleBranch.negative := by
      cases h : plt.2
      · exact absurd (he.trans h.symm) hflip2
      · rfl
    have hpe : pls = (b, SaddleBranch.positive) := by
      rw [hb, ← he]
    have hqe : plt = (b, SaddleBranch.negative) := by
      rw [hb, hflip1, ← hq2]
    rw [hpe, hqe] at harc
    obtain ⟨arc, havoid⟩ := harc
    exact ⟨⟨b, eps, heps_pos, arc.symm, fun w => havoid (σ w)⟩⟩
  · 
    have hq2 : plt.2 = SaddleBranch.positive := by
      cases h : plt.2
      · rfl
      · exact absurd (he.trans h.symm) hflip2
    have hpe : pls = (b, SaddleBranch.negative) := by
      rw [hb, ← he]
    have hqe : plt = (b, SaddleBranch.positive) := by
      rw [hb, hflip1, ← hq2]
    rw [hpe, hqe] at harc
    obtain ⟨arc, havoid⟩ := harc
    exact ⟨⟨b, eps, heps_pos, arc, havoid⟩⟩

      slabRegularSet
        D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.G

  intro x hx
  have hpunct :=
    chronologicalSaddleChosenMateArcCore_subset_puncturedCriticalSlice
      (D := D) (t := t) (ht := ht) A hx
  have hspatial : Surjective
      (spatialDeriv D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x) := by

      D.chronologicalCriticalSlice_isolated t ht x hcritical hpunct.2.1

statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleCriticalBoundaryEnd_dist_lt_half_cover
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch) :
    dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
        (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2
proof:
:= by
  have hrho : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hrho]
  have hparam :
      ‖saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)‖ <
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius := by
    calc
      ‖saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)‖ =
          D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht := by
        exact norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam p.1 p.2 hrho hzero
      _ < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
        D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  have hdist :=
    D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink_param_dist_lt_half_cover
      t ht hparam
  simpa [StandardMorseEventAt.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd,
    saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
    StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
    StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint] using hdist

name: Submission.exists_last_true
statement:
theorem exists_last_true {P : ℕ → Prop} {m : ℕ} (h0 : P 0) (hm : ¬P m) :
    ∃ i < m, P i ∧ ¬P (i + 1)
proof:
:= by
  induction m with
  | zero => exact absurd h0 hm
  | succ m IH =>
    by_cases hPm : P m
    · exact ⟨m, Nat.lt_succ_self m, hPm, hm⟩
    · obtain ⟨i, hi, h⟩ := IH hPm
      exact ⟨i, by omega, h⟩

name: Submission.critSet_target_zero
statement:
theorem critSet_target_zero {p : ℕ} (U : Set (Fin p → ℝ))
    (f : (Fin p → ℝ) → Fin 0 → ℝ) : critSet U f = ∅
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  simp only [critSet, mem_setOf_eq, mem_empty_iff_false, iff_false, not_and,
    not_not]
  intro _ y
  exact ⟨0, Subsingleton.elim _ _⟩

name: Submission.sard_pi
statement:
theorem sard_pi :
    ∀ (p q : ℕ) (U : Set (Fin p → ℝ)) (f : (Fin p → ℝ) → Fin q → ℝ),
      IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U → volume (f '' critSet U f) = 0
proof:
:= by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | zero =>
    intro q U f _ _
    cases q with
    | zero =>
      rw [critSet_target_zero, image_empty, measure_empty]
    | succ q' =>
      have hsub : f '' critSet U f ⊆ {f default} := by
        rintro _ ⟨x, _, rfl⟩
        have hx : x = default := Subsingleton.elim x default
        rw [hx]
        exact mem_singleton _
      exact measure_mono_null hsub (volume_singleton_pi _)
  | succ n IHn =>
    intro q U f hU hf
    cases q with
    | zero =>
      rw [critSet_target_zero, image_empty, measure_empty]
    | succ q' =>
      
      have hcover : f '' critSet U f ⊆
          (⋃ i : ℕ, f '' (critSet U f
            ∩ (vanishSet U f i \ vanishSet U f (i + 1))))
          ∪ f '' vanishSet U f (n + 1) := by
        rintro _ ⟨x, hxC, rfl⟩
        by_cases hK : x ∈ vanishSet U f (n + 1)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨x, hK, rfl⟩
        · left
          have h0 : x ∈ vanishSet U f 0 :=
            ⟨hxC.1, fun j hj1 hj0 => absurd (hj1.trans hj0) (by omega)⟩
          obtain ⟨i, _, hPi, hPi1⟩ :=
            exists_last_true (P := fun i => x ∈ vanishSet U f i) h0 hK
          exact mem_iUnion.2 ⟨i, ⟨x, ⟨hxC, hPi, hPi1⟩, rfl⟩⟩
      refine measure_mono_null hcover (measure_union_null ?_ ?_)
      · 
        rw [measure_iUnion_null_iff]
        intro i
        cases i with
        | zero =>
          
          apply image_null_of_locally_image_null
          intro x hx
          have hxC : x ∈ critSet U f := hx.1
          have hxK1 : x ∉ vanishSet U f 1 := hx.2.2
          have hfd : fderiv ℝ f x ≠ 0 := by
            intro h0
            apply hxK1
            refine ⟨hxC.1, fun j hj1 hj2 => ?_⟩
            have hj : j = 1 := by omega
            subst hj
            refine ContinuousMultilinearMap.ext fun m => ?_
            rw [iteratedFDeriv_one_apply, h0]
            simp
          obtain ⟨V, hV, hnull⟩ := step1_local hU hf
            (fun U' g hU' hg => IHn q' U' g hU' hg) hxC.1 hfd
          refine ⟨V, hV, measure_mono_null (Set.image_mono ?_) hnull⟩
          exact inter_subset_inter_left _ fun y hy => hy.1
        | succ i =>
          
          apply image_null_of_locally_image_null
          intro x hx
          obtain ⟨V, hV, hnull⟩ := step2_local hU hf
            (Nat.succ_le_succ (Nat.zero_le i))
            (fun U' g hU' hg => IHn (q' + 1) U' g hU' hg) hx.2.1 hx.2.2
          refine ⟨V, hV, measure_mono_null (Set.image_mono ?_) hnull⟩
          exact inter_subset_inter_left _ fun y hy => hy.2.1
      · 
        refine step3 hU hf ?_
        calc n + 1 + 1 = (n + 1 + 1) * 1 := by ring
          _ ≤ (n + 1 + 1) * (q' + 1) := by
            exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ (by omega)

name: Submission.TamedField.selectedFrameLedger_delta
statement:
theorem selectedFrameLedger_delta (A : Set (Set E)) :
    (V.selectedFrameLedger A).delta = V.deltaOn A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let e := Fintype.equivFin (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A)
  calc
    (V.selectedFrameLedger A).delta =
        ∑ i : Fin (Fintype.card (V.SelectedOrbitIndex A)),
          V.orbitContribution (e.symm i).1 := by
            simp [selectedFrameLedger, MorseLedger.delta,
              TamedField.orbitContribution, List.sum_ofFn, e]
    _ = ∑ O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A, V.orbitContribution O.1 := by
          exact e.symm.sum_comp (fun O : V.SelectedOrbitIndex A =>
            V.orbitContribution O.1)
    _ = ∑ O : V.OrbitIndex,
        if (O : Set E) ∈ A then V.orbitContribution O else 0 := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
          exact (Finset.sum_subtype (Finset.univ.filter fun O : V.OrbitIndex =>
            (O : Set E) ∈ A) (by simp) V.orbitContribution).symm
    _ = V.deltaOn A := by rfl

name: Submission.BridgeData.nonempty_northLedgerTrace_iff
statement:
theorem nonempty_northLedgerTrace_iff {z' : StableSpherePi n}
    (B' : BridgeData n z') (V : TamedField B.fls) (V' : TamedField B'.fls) :
    Nonempty (MorseLedgerTrace (B.northFrameLedger V)
      (B'.northFrameLedger V')) ↔
      B.northFramedDelta V = B'.northFramedDelta V'
proof:
:= by
  rw [MorseLedger.exists_trace_iff_delta_eq,
    B.northFrameLedger_delta, B'.northFrameLedger_delta]

name: Submission.SmoothSOGauge.gradVec_transform
statement:
theorem gradVec_transform (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : x ∈ X.fiber) (j : Fin n) :
    gradVec (G.transform X).g j x =
      ∑ k, ((G.mat x : SOGroup n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j k •
        gradVec X.g k x
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : X.g x = 0 := hx
  have hfd : fderiv ℝ (G.transform X).g x =
      (G.clm x).comp (fderiv ℝ X.g x) :=
    fderiv_gauge_apply_of_eq_zero G.contDiff_clm X.smooth hx0
  apply InnerProductSpace.ext_inner_right_basis
    (EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).toBasis
  intro w
  rw [inner_gradVec, hfd, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply]
  change SOFrameGauge.toCLM (G.mat x)
    (fderiv ℝ X.g x ((EuclideanSpace.basisFun (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).toBasis w)) j = _
  rw [SOFrameGauge.toCLM_apply_coord, sum_inner]
  simp_rw [real_inner_smul_left, inner_gradVec]

    kerCross (G.transform X).g x = kerCross X.g x
proof:
:= by
  have hrow : (fun j => gradVec (G.transform X).g j x) =
      normalRowAction ((G.mat x : SOGroup n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ)
        (fun j => gradVec X.g j x) := by
    funext j
    exact G.gradVec_transform X hx j
  unfold kerCross
  rw [hrow, crossVec_frameRowAction_normals,
    (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp (G.mat x).property).2, one_smul]

name: Submission.SmoothSOGauge.frameAt_transform
statement:
theorem frameAt_transform (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hx : x ∈ X.fiber) :
    frameAt (G.transform X) x =
      frameRowAction
        (tangentNormalBlock 1
          ((G.mat x : SOGroup n) : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ))
        (frameAt X x)
proof:
:= by
  funext r
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ r with rfl | ⟨r, rfl⟩
  · simp [frameRowAction, Fin.sum_univ_succ, tangentNormalBlock, frameAt,
      G.tauField_transform X hx]
  · simp only [frameAt, Fin.cons_succ, G.gradVec_transform X hx]
    simp [frameRowAction, Fin.sum_univ_succ, tangentNormalBlock]

  · exact continuous_const
  · exact continuous_const
  · exact continuous_const
  · exact ((continuous_apply j).comp
      ((continuous_apply i).comp continuous_SOGroup_val))

name: Submission.SmoothSOGauge.flow_transform
statement:
theorem flow_transform {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    (U : TamedField (G.transform X))
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    V.flow p = U.flow p
proof:
:= by
  have hp' : p ∈ (G.transform X).fiber := G.mem_transform_fiber hp
  apply V.solution_unique (t₀ := 0)
  · exact V.hasDerivAt_flow p
  · intro t
    have h := U.hasDerivAt_flow p t
    have ht' : U.flow p t ∈ (G.transform X).fiber := U.flow_mem_fiber hp' t
    have ht : U.flow p t ∈ X.fiber := G.mem_fiber_of_mem_transform_fiber ht'
    have hv : V.v (U.flow p t) = U.v (U.flow p t) := by
      rw [V.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber ht, U.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber ht',
        G.tauField_transform X ht]
    rwa [hv]
  · rw [V.flow_zero, U.flow_zero]

statement:

proof:

name: Submission.SmoothSOGauge.fundamentalPeriod_transform
statement:
theorem fundamentalPeriod_transform {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    (U : TamedField (G.transform X))
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    V.fundamentalPeriod hp =
      U.fundamentalPeriod (G.mem_transform_fiber hp)
proof:
:= by
  have hflow : V.flow p = U.flow p := G.flow_transform V U hp
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply V.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hp
      (U.fundamentalPeriod_pos (G.mem_transform_fiber hp))
    simpa [hflow] using
      U.fundamentalPeriod_periodic (G.mem_transform_fiber hp)
  · apply U.fundamentalPeriod_le_period (G.mem_transform_fiber hp)
      (V.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp)
    simpa [← hflow] using V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp

name: Submission.SmoothSOGauge.orbitFinset_transform
statement:
theorem orbitFinset_transform {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    (U : TamedField (G.transform X)) :
    V.orbitFinset = U.orbitFinset
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.ext
  intro O
  simp only [V.mem_orbitFinset, U.mem_orbitFinset]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p, G.mem_transform_fiber hp, G.orbit_transform V U hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    have hp' : p ∈ X.fiber := G.mem_fiber_of_mem_transform_fiber hp
    exact ⟨p, hp', (G.orbit_transform V U hp').symm⟩

name: Submission.rawFrameLoop_closed
statement:
theorem rawFrameLoop_closed {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    rawFrameLoop V hp 0 = rawFrameLoop V hp 1
proof:
:= by
  have hper := V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp 0
  change rowsMatrix (frameAt X (V.flow p (((0 : I) : ℝ) *
      V.fundamentalPeriod hp))) =
    rowsMatrix (frameAt X (V.flow p (((1 : I) : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp)))
  rw [show (((0 : I) : ℝ)) = 0 from rfl, show (((1 : I) : ℝ)) = 1 from rfl,
    zero_mul, one_mul]
  rw [show V.flow p (V.fundamentalPeriod hp) = V.flow p 0 by
    simpa using hper]

name: Submission.SmoothSOGauge.rawFrameLoop_transform
statement:
theorem rawFrameLoop_transform {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    (U : TamedField (G.transform X))
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    rawFrameLoop U (G.mem_transform_fiber hp) =
      soMatrixLeftMul (G.blockGaugeLoop V hp) (rawFrameLoop V hp)
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  have hflow : U.flow p = V.flow p := (G.flow_transform V U hp).symm
  have hper : U.fundamentalPeriod (G.mem_transform_fiber hp) =
      V.fundamentalPeriod hp := (G.fundamentalPeriod_transform V U hp).symm
  change rowsMatrix (frameAt (G.transform X)
      (U.flow p ((u : ℝ) * U.fundamentalPeriod (G.mem_transform_fiber hp)))) =
    _
  rw [hflow, hper]
  have hmem : V.flow p ((u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp) ∈ X.fiber :=
    V.flow_mem_fiber hp _
  rw [G.frameAt_transform X hmem, rowsMatrix_frameRowAction]
  rfl

name: Submission.SmoothSOGauge.fundamentalFrameClass_transform
statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameClass_transform {X : FramedLevelSet n}
    (V : TamedField X) (U : TamedField (G.transform X))
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    U.fundamentalFrameClass (G.mem_transform_fiber hp) =
      loopClassZ2 (G.blockGaugeLoop V hp) (G.blockGaugeLoop_closed V hp) +
        V.fundamentalFrameClass hp
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := loopClassZ2_matrixGramSchmidtSO_leftMul
    (G.blockGaugeLoop V hp) (rawFrameLoop V hp) (det_rawFrameLoop_pos V hp)
    (G.blockGaugeLoop_closed V hp) (rawFrameLoop_closed V hp)
  have hU : U.fundamentalFrameClass (G.mem_transform_fiber hp) =
      loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap
          (soMatrixLeftMul (G.blockGaugeLoop V hp) (rawFrameLoop V hp))
          (det_soMatrixLeftMul_pos _ _ (det_rawFrameLoop_pos V hp)))
        (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed _ _
          (soMatrixLeftMul_closed _ _ (G.blockGaugeLoop_closed V hp)
            (rawFrameLoop_closed V hp))) := by
    unfold TamedField.fundamentalFrameClass
    apply loopClassZ2_congr_fun
    rw [fundamentalFrameLoop_eq U (G.mem_transform_fiber hp)]
    congr 1
    exact G.rawFrameLoop_transform V U hp
  have hV : V.fundamentalFrameClass hp =
      loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap (rawFrameLoop V hp)
          (det_rawFrameLoop_pos V hp))
        (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed _ _ (rawFrameLoop_closed V hp)) := by
    unfold TamedField.fundamentalFrameClass
    apply loopClassZ2_congr_fun
    exact fundamentalFrameLoop_eq V hp
  rw [hU, hV, hmain]

name: Submission.SmoothSOGauge.orbitFrameClass_transform
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_transform {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X)
    (U : TamedField (G.transform X)) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    U.orbitFrameClass (G.orbitIndexTransport V U O) =
      V.orbitFrameClass O +
        loopClassZ2 (G.orbitBlockGaugeLoop V O)
          (G.orbitBlockGaugeLoop_closed V O)
proof:
:= by
  have hp : V.orbitPoint O ∈ X.fiber := V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  have hp' : V.orbitPoint O ∈ (G.transform X).fiber := G.mem_transform_fiber hp
  have hOp : (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      V.orbit (V.orbitPoint O) := V.orbitPoint_orbit O
  have hOq : ((G.orbitIndexTransport V U O : U.OrbitIndex) :
      Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      U.orbit (U.orbitPoint (G.orbitIndexTransport V U O)) :=
    U.orbitPoint_orbit (G.orbitIndexTransport V U O)
  have hsets : ((G.orbitIndexTransport V U O : U.OrbitIndex) :
      Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := rfl
  have hVU : V.orbit (V.orbitPoint O) = U.orbit (V.orbitPoint O) :=
    G.orbit_transform V U hp
  have hqOrbit : U.orbitPoint (G.orbitIndexTransport V U O) ∈
      U.orbit (V.orbitPoint O) := by
    rw [← hVU, ← hOp, ← hsets, hOq]
    exact U.mem_orbit_self _
  have hbase : U.fundamentalFrameClass (U.orbit_subset_fiber hp' hqOrbit) =
      U.fundamentalFrameClass hp' :=
    U.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit hp' hqOrbit
  have hstep : U.fundamentalFrameClass hp' =
      loopClassZ2 (G.blockGaugeLoop V hp) (G.blockGaugeLoop_closed V hp) +
        V.fundamentalFrameClass hp :=
    G.fundamentalFrameClass_transform V U hp
  change U.fundamentalFrameClass
      (U.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (G.orbitIndexTransport V U O)) =
    V.fundamentalFrameClass hp + _
  rw [show U.fundamentalFrameClass
        (U.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (G.orbitIndexTransport V U O)) =
      U.fundamentalFrameClass (U.orbit_subset_fiber hp' hqOrbit) from rfl,
    hbase, hstep, add_comm]
  rfl

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_chronologicalMergeCaptureBand
statement:
theorem exists_chronologicalMergeCaptureBand
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (Vneg : TamedField
      ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeSlice
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))))
    (Vpos : TamedField
      ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSlice
        (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))))
    (hne : (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht
          (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht)) Vneg ≠
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht
          (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht)) Vneg)
    (heq : (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht
          (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht))
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht (D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht)
          (D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht)) Vpos =
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
          ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)

    have hsplice := orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim

      (Bd.marking.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
        (hF.trans hcircle))
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg]
    exact hsplice
  · intro Htop
    have hnegEq :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      apply (D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw Vneg).injective
      rw [D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.positive]
      exact Htop.negative_eq
    have hposNe :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos ≠
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      intro heq'
      apply Htop.positive_ne
      rw [← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.positive, heq']
    obtain ⟨Bd, ⟨W⟩⟩ := hsplitCase hposNe hnegEq
    obtain ⟨H, hregH, hHclosed⟩ :=
      exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartWindingLoop
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) W
    have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) Bd.marking H
      hregH hHclosed
    have hsplice := orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim
      Bd.marking
      (Bd.marking.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
        (hF.trans hcircle))
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos]
    exact hsplice

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.continuous_saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix
statement:
theorem continuous_saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) :
    Continuous M.saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  have hrow : Continuous fun theta => M.saddleCenterActualLimitRows theta i := by
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · have ht : Continuous fun theta : ℝ =>
          M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign • M.centerUnitTangent (-theta) := by
        exact (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ =>
          M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign).smul
            (M.continuous_centerUnitTangent.comp continuous_neg)
      simpa [saddleCenterActualLimitRows, centerRowsWith] using ht
    · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          have hn : Continuous M.centerMinimumUnitNormalLast := by
            unfold centerMinimumUnitNormalLast
            exact (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ =>
              ‖M.centerCokernelVector‖⁻¹).smul
                ((continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ =>
                  nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar).smul
                    M.continuous_centerNormalRow_zero)
          simpa [saddleCenterActualLimitRows, centerRowsWith] using hn
      | cast i =>
          simpa [saddleCenterActualLimitRows, centerRowsWith] using
            (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : ℝ =>
              M.centerTransverseNormal i)
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp hrow

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.det_saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix_pos
statement:
theorem det_saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix_pos
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (theta : ℝ) :
    0 < (M.saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix theta).det
proof:
:= by
  let d : I → ℝ := fun u =>
    (M.saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix ((u : ℝ) * theta)).det
  have hd : Continuous d :=
    (M.continuous_saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix.comp
      (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)).matrix_det
  have hd0 : 0 < d 0 := by
    simpa [d] using det_saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix_zero_pos T hindex
  have hd1ne : d 1 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [d] using det_saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix_ne_zero T hindex theta
  by_contra hpos
  have hpos' : ¬ 0 < d 1 := by simpa [d] using hpos
  have hd1neg : d 1 < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos') hd1ne
  have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (d 1) (d 0) := ⟨hd1neg.le, hd0.le⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ (1 : I) 0 hd hmem
  exact det_saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix_ne_zero T hindex ((u : ℝ) * theta) hu

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.inner_saddleCenterActualNormalRadialLast_test_pos
statement:
theorem inner_saddleCenterActualNormalRadialLast_test_pos
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (s : I) (theta : ℝ) :
    0 < ⟪M.saddleCenterActualNormalRadialLast s theta,
      M.saddleCenterRadialTest theta⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  have hcpos : 0 < ‖M.centerCokernelVector‖⁻¹ :=
    inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr M.centerCokernelVector_ne_zero)
  have hunit : 0 < ⟪M.centerMinimumUnitNormalLast theta,
      M.saddleCenterRadialTest theta⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [centerMinimumUnitNormalLast, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_left, inner_centerNormalRow_saddleRadialTest T hindex theta]
    exact mul_pos hcpos (nonzeroOrientationSign_mul_pos
      M.centerMinimumPairingScalar_ne_zero)
  have hradial : 0 < ⟪M.centerRadialTangent (-theta),
      M.saddleCenterRadialTest theta⟫_ℝ :=
    inner_saddleRadial_saddleRadialTest_pos T hindex theta
  rw [saddleCenterActualNormalRadialLast, inner_add_left,
    real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left]
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ (s : ℝ) := s.property.1
  have hs1 : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.property.2
  by_cases hsone : (s : ℝ) = 1
  · simpa [hsone] using hradial
  exact add_pos_of_pos_of_nonneg
    (mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr (lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 hsone)) hunit)
    (mul_nonneg hs0 hradial.le)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.linearIndependent_saddleCenterActualNormalRadialRows

  · intro i

      inner_centerTransverseNormal_unitTangent_zero T i (-theta), mul_zero]
  · exact fun i => inner_centerTransverseNormal_saddleRadialTest T i theta
  · rw [real_inner_smul_left, inner_saddleTangent_saddleRadialTest T theta,

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.continuous_saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix
statement:
theorem continuous_saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix
    (M : StandardMorseEventAt C center) :
    Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      M.saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix q.1 q.2
proof:
:= by
  have ht : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign • M.centerUnitTangent (-q.2) :=
    (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
      M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign).smul
      (M.continuous_centerUnitTangent.comp (continuous_neg.comp continuous_snd))
  have hl : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      M.saddleCenterActualNormalRadialLast q.1 q.2 := by
    have hs : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ => (q.1 : ℝ) :=
      continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
    unfold saddleCenterActualNormalRadialLast centerMinimumUnitNormalLast
    exact ((continuous_const.sub hs).smul
      ((continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
        ‖M.centerCokernelVector‖⁻¹).smul
        ((continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
          nonzeroOrientationSign M.centerMinimumPairingScalar).smul
          (M.continuous_centerNormalRow_zero.comp continuous_snd)))).add
      ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).smul
        (M.continuous_centerRadialTangent.comp
          (continuous_neg.comp continuous_snd)))
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  have hrow : Continuous fun q : I × ℝ =>
      M.saddleCenterActualNormalRadialRows q.1 q.2 i := by
    rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
    · simpa [saddleCenterActualNormalRadialRows, centerRowsWith] using ht
    · induction i using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
          simpa [saddleCenterActualNormalRadialRows, centerRowsWith] using hl
      | cast i =>
          simpa [saddleCenterActualNormalRadialRows, centerRowsWith] using
            (continuous_const : Continuous fun _ : I × ℝ =>
              M.centerTransverseNormal i)
  exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j).continuous.comp hrow

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.det_saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix_pos
statement:
theorem det_saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix_pos
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (s : I) (theta : ℝ) :
    0 < (M.saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix s theta).det
proof:
:= by
  let d : I → ℝ := fun u =>
    (M.saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix u theta).det
  have hd : Continuous d :=
    (M.continuous_saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix.comp
      (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).matrix_det
  have hd0 : 0 < d 0 := by
    simpa [d] using det_saddleCenterActualLimitMatrix_pos T hindex theta
  have hdne : ∀ u, d u ≠ 0 := fun u =>
    det_saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix_ne_zero T hindex u theta
  by_contra hpos
  have hsneg : d s < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hdne s)
  have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (d s) (d 0) := ⟨hsneg.le, hd0.le⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ s 0 hd hmem
  exact hdne u hu

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.coe_saddleCenterActualRadialBaseUnit

@[simp] theorem coe_saddleCenterActualRadialBaseUnit

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix_one
statement:
theorem saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix_one
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (theta : ℝ) :

      twistMat a (-M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign * theta)

    M.saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix_one,
    M.centerSignedRadialMatrix_rotation _ _
      M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one,
    show M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign * -theta =
      -M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign * theta from by ring,
    ← M.saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix_one_zero,
    ← coe_saddleCenterActualRadialBaseUnit T hindex]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.det_saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix_ne_zero
statement:
theorem det_saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix_ne_zero
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (s : I) (theta : ℝ) :
    (saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix T hindex s theta).det ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix, Matrix.det_mul]
  apply mul_ne_zero
  · exact det_saddleCenterActualNormalRadialMatrix_ne_zero T hindex s theta
  · have hu : IsUnit
        (↑(saddleCenterActualRadialBaseUnit T hindex)⁻¹ :
          Matrix (Fin (a + 3)) (Fin (a + 3)) ℝ) := Units.isUnit _
    exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mp ((Matrix.isUnit_iff_isUnit_det _).mp hu)

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.det_saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix_pos
statement:
theorem det_saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix_pos
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    (s : I) (theta : ℝ) :
    0 < (saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix T hindex s theta).det
proof:
:= by
  let d : I → ℝ := fun u =>
    (saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix T hindex u theta).det
  have hd : Continuous d :=
    ((continuous_saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix T hindex).comp
      (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)).matrix_det
  have hdne : ∀ u, d u ≠ 0 := fun u =>
    det_saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix_ne_zero T hindex u theta
  have hd1 : d 1 = 1 := by
    dsimp [d]
    rw [saddleCenterActualNormalizedMatrix_one, StandardBirth.det_twistMat]
  by_contra hpos
  have hsneg : d s < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hdne s)
  have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (d s) (d 1) := by
    rw [hd1]
    exact ⟨hsneg.le, by norm_num⟩
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := intermediate_value_univ s 1 hd hmem
  exact hdne u hu

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.loopClassZ2_saddleCenterActualNormalized_eq_one
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_saddleCenterActualNormalized_eq_one
    (T : M.CenterImmersion) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) :
    loopClassZ2
        (positiveMatrixSOMap
          (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T hindex)
          (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop_det_pos T hindex))
        (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed
          (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop T hindex)
          (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop_det_pos T hindex)
          (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop_closed T hindex)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hclass := loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixHomotopy_congr
    (saddleCenterActualMatrixHomotopy T hindex)
    (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop_det_pos T hindex)
    (signedCenterPlaneMatrixLoop_det_pos
      (-M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign)
      M.neg_saddleCenterActualOrientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one)
    (saddleCenterActualMatrixHomotopy_det_pos T hindex)
    (saddleCenterActualNormalizedLoop_closed T hindex)
    (signedCenterPlaneMatrixLoop_closed
      (-M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign)
      M.neg_saddleCenterActualOrientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one)
    (saddleCenterActualMatrixHomotopy_closed T hindex)
  exact hclass.trans
    (loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixSOMap_signedCenterPlaneMatrixLoop
      (-M.saddleCenterActualOrientationSign)
      M.neg_saddleCenterActualOrientationSign_eq_one_or_neg_one)
