name: Submission.vertC_plateauAux
statement:
@[simp] theorem vertC_plateauAux (u : E) :
    vertC (plateauAux u) = plateauB (vertC u)
proof:
:= by
  simp [plateauAux, vertC, eLast]

name: Submission.tubeApproximation_nraw
statement:
theorem tubeApproximation_nraw (k : ℕ) (v : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ) :
    nraw (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v = tubeApproxRaw k v
proof:
:= by
  rw [nraw]
  change ‖tubeApproxRaw k v‖⁻¹ • tubeApproxRaw k v = tubeApproxRaw k v
  rw [norm_tubeApproxRaw]
  simp

name: Submission.tubeApproximation_nprep_eq_raw_of_vert_pos
statement:
theorem tubeApproximation_nprep_eq_raw_of_vert_pos (k : ℕ)
    (v : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ)
    (hpos : 0 < vertC (nprep (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v)) :
    nprep (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v = tubeApproxRaw k v
proof:
:= by
  let u : E := tubeApproxRaw k v
  have hu : ‖u‖ = 1 := norm_tubeApproxRaw k v
  have hpraw : praw (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v = plateauAux u := by
    rw [praw, tubeApproximation_nraw]
  have hpraw0 : praw (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v ≠ 0 :=
    praw_ne_zero _ v
  have hnormpos : 0 < ‖praw (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v‖⁻¹ :=
    inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hpraw0)
  have hpvert : 0 < vertC (praw (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v) := by
    change 0 < ‖praw (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v‖⁻¹ *
      vertC (praw (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v) at hpos
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hpos with h | h
    · exact h.2
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt hnormpos)) h.1)
  have hbpos : 0 < plateauB (vertC u) := by
    rw [hpraw, vertC_plateauAux] at hpvert
    exact hpvert
  have htLower : -1 ≤ vertC u :=
    neg_le_of_abs_le (abs_vertC_le_one hu)
  have htUpper : vertC u ≤ 1 :=
    le_of_abs_le (abs_vertC_le_one hu)
  have ha0 : 0 ≤ plateauA (vertC u) := plateauA_nonneg _
  have ha1 : plateauA (vertC u) ≤ 1 := plateauA_le_one _
  have hlat : 0 < vertC u := by
    rw [plateauB] at hbpos
    have hmul : plateauA (vertC u) * (1 + vertC u) ≤
        1 + vertC u := by
      nlinarith
    linarith
  have hplateau : plateauAux u = u :=
    plateauAux_of_ge (by linarith)
  rw [nprep, hpraw, hplateau, hu]
  simp
  rfl

name: Submission.tubeApproximation_nprep_eq_north_iff
statement:
theorem tubeApproximation_nprep_eq_north_iff (k : ℕ)
    (v : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
    (hy : ‖y‖ < 1) :
    nprep (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v = northPoint y ↔
      tubeApproxRaw k v = northPoint y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hpos : 0 < vertC
        (nprep (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) v) := by
      rw [h]
      exact vertC_northPoint_pos hy
    rw [tubeApproximation_nprep_eq_raw_of_vert_pos k v hpos] at h
    exact h
  · intro h
    have hu : ‖tubeApproxRaw (m := m) k v‖ = 1 := norm_tubeApproxRaw k v
    have hvert : -(1 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ vertC (tubeApproxRaw k v) := by
      rw [h]
      rw [vertC_northPoint]
      have hsqrt : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
      linarith
    rw [nprep, praw, tubeApproximation_nraw,
      plateauAux_of_ge hvert, hu]
    simp
    exact h

name: Submission.norm_northPoint_of_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem norm_northPoint_of_norm_lt_one (y : F) (hy : ‖y‖ < 1) :
    ‖northPoint y‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ := norm_nonneg y
  have hsq0 : 0 ≤ 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hsplit := norm_sq_split (northPoint y)
  rw [initCLM_northPoint, vertC_northPoint, Real.sq_sqrt hsq0] at hsplit
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (northPoint y)]

name: Submission.tubeNorthOffset_norm_lt_quarter
statement:
theorem tubeNorthOffset_norm_lt_quarter (y : F) (hy : ‖y‖ < 1 / 8) :
    ‖tubeNorthOffset y‖ < 1 / 4
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2)
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ := norm_nonneg y
  have hsq0 : 0 ≤ 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hsq0
  have hsHalf : 1 / 2 < s := by nlinarith
  have hs : 0 < s := by linarith
  rw [tubeNorthOffset, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs,
    abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs), inv_mul_eq_div, div_lt_iff₀ hs]
  nlinarith

name: Submission.tubeThomVec_eq_northPoint_inner_and_wCoord
statement:
theorem tubeThomVec_eq_northPoint_inner_and_wCoord (k : ℕ) (x : E) (y : F)
    (hy : ‖y‖ < 1 / 8) (h : tubeThomVec k x = northPoint y) :
    x ∈ tubeRegion (1 / 4) ∧ wCoord k x = tubeNorthOffset y
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := ‖tubeCollapseRaw k x‖⁻¹
  let c : ℝ := tubeCutoff x
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2)
  have ha : 0 < a := by
    exact inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr (tubeCollapseRaw_ne_zero k x))
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ := norm_nonneg y
  have hsq0 : 0 ≤ 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hsq0
  have hs : 0 < s := by
    nlinarith
  have hlast : a * (2 * c - 1) = s := by
    have h' := congrArg (fun z : E => z (Fin.last (m + 2))) h
    change ‖tubeCollapseRaw k x‖⁻¹ *
        tubeCollapseRaw k x (Fin.last (m + 2)) =
      northPoint y (Fin.last (m + 2)) at h'
    rw [tubeCollapseRaw_last] at h'
    change ‖tubeCollapseRaw k x‖⁻¹ * (2 * tubeCutoff x - 1) =
      vertC (northPoint y) at h'
    rw [vertC_northPoint] at h'
    exact h'
  have hcHalf : 1 / 2 < c := by
    have hprod : 0 < a * (2 * c - 1) := hlast.symm ▸ hs
    rcases mul_pos_iff.mp hprod with hp | hn
    · linarith [hp.2]
    · exact False.elim ((not_lt_of_ge (le_of_lt ha)) hn.1)
  have hc0 : 0 ≤ c := tubeCutoff_nonneg x
  have hc1 : c ≤ 1 := tubeCutoff_le_one x
  have hgood : x ∈ tubeGood :=
    tubeGood_of_tubeCutoff_ne_zero (by linarith)
  have hinitRaw : initCLM (m + 2) (tubeCollapseRaw k x) =
      tubeCollapseHorizontal k x := by
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext i
    exact tubeCollapseRaw_coord k x i
  have hhoriz : a • tubeCollapseHorizontal k x = y := by
    have h' := congrArg (initCLM (m + 2)) h
    rw [tubeThomVec, map_smul, hinitRaw, initCLM_northPoint] at h'
    exact h'
  have hinner : x ∈ tubeRegion (1 / 4) := by
    by_contra hout
    have hdist : 1 / 16 ≤ tubeDistSq x := by
      change ¬ tubeDistSq x < (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2 at hout
      norm_num at hout ⊢
      exact hout
    have hwSq : ‖wCoord k x‖ ^ 2 = tubeDistSq x :=
      norm_wCoord_sq k hgood
    have hw0 : 0 ≤ ‖wCoord k x‖ := norm_nonneg _
    have hwQuarter : 1 / 4 ≤ ‖wCoord k x‖ := by
      nlinarith
    have hnorm : a * c * ‖wCoord k x‖ = ‖y‖ := by
      have hn := congrArg norm hhoriz
      rw [tubeCollapseHorizontal, norm_smul, norm_smul,
        Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos ha] at hn
      change a * (|c| * ‖wCoord k x‖) = ‖y‖ at hn
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hc0] at hn
      nlinarith
    have hsc : s ≤ a * c := by
      rw [← hlast]
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (le_of_lt ha) (by linarith : 0 ≤ c - (2 * c - 1))]
    have hsy : s ≤ 4 * ‖y‖ := by
      nlinarith [mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt ha) hc0)
        (sub_nonneg.mpr hwQuarter)]
    have hsHalf : 1 / 2 < s := by
      nlinarith
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨hinner, ?_⟩
  have hc : c = 1 := tubeCutoff_eq_one_on_inner hinner
  have hhoriz' : a • wCoord k x = y := by
    simpa [tubeCollapseHorizontal, c, hc] using hhoriz
  have has : a = s := by
    rw [hc] at hlast
    linarith
  change wCoord k x = s⁻¹ • y
  calc
    wCoord k x = (s⁻¹ * s) • wCoord k x := by
      rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hs.ne', one_smul]
    _ = s⁻¹ • (s • wCoord k x) := by rw [smul_smul]
    _ = s⁻¹ • y := by rw [← has, hhoriz']

name: Submission.tubeThomVec_eq_northPoint_of_inner_wCoord
statement:
theorem tubeThomVec_eq_northPoint_of_inner_wCoord (k : ℕ) (x : E) (y : F)
    (hy : ‖y‖ < 1 / 8) (hinner : x ∈ tubeRegion (1 / 4))
    (hw : wCoord k x = tubeNorthOffset y) :
    tubeThomVec k x = northPoint y
proof:
:= by
  let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2)
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ := norm_nonneg y
  have hsq0 : 0 ≤ 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
  have hs_sq : s ^ 2 = 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2 := Real.sq_sqrt hsq0
  have hs : 0 < s := by nlinarith
  have hc : tubeCutoff x = 1 := tubeCutoff_eq_one_on_inner hinner
  have hhoriz : tubeCollapseHorizontal k x = tubeNorthOffset y := by
    rw [tubeCollapseHorizontal, hc, one_smul, hw]
  have hraw : tubeCollapseRaw k x = s⁻¹ • northPoint y := by
    apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
    funext j
    induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
        change tubeCollapseRaw k x (Fin.last (m + 2)) =
          s⁻¹ * vertC (northPoint y)
        rw [tubeCollapseRaw_last, hc, vertC_northPoint]
        change 2 * 1 - 1 = s⁻¹ * s
        rw [inv_mul_cancel₀ hs.ne']
        norm_num
    | cast i =>
        change tubeCollapseRaw k x i.castSucc =
          s⁻¹ * northPoint y i.castSucc
        rw [tubeCollapseRaw_coord, hhoriz, tubeNorthOffset]
        change s⁻¹ * y i = s⁻¹ * northPoint y i.castSucc
        have hi := congrArg (fun z : F => z i) (initCLM_northPoint y)
        change northPoint y i.castSucc = y i at hi
        rw [hi]
  have hnormNorth : ‖northPoint y‖ = 1 :=
    norm_northPoint_of_norm_lt_one y (hy.trans (by norm_num))
  have hnormRaw : ‖tubeCollapseRaw k x‖ = s⁻¹ := by
    rw [hraw, norm_smul, hnormNorth, mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs,
      abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hs)]
  rw [tubeThomVec, hnormRaw, hraw, inv_inv, smul_smul,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ hs.ne', one_smul]

name: Submission.tubeThomVec_eq_northPoint_iff
statement:
theorem tubeThomVec_eq_northPoint_iff (k : ℕ) (x : E) (y : F)
    (hy : ‖y‖ < 1 / 8) :
    tubeThomVec k x = northPoint y ↔
      x ∈ tubeRegion (1 / 4) ∧ wCoord k x = tubeNorthOffset y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact tubeThomVec_eq_northPoint_inner_and_wCoord k x y hy
  · rintro ⟨hinner, hw⟩
    exact tubeThomVec_eq_northPoint_of_inner_wCoord k x y hy hinner hw

name: Submission.tubeMap_mem_inner_of_norm_lt_quarter
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 < tubeA k θ w :=
    tubeA_pos k θ (hw.trans (by norm_num))
  change tubeDistSq (tubeMap k θ w) < (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ 2
  rw [tubeDistSq_tubeMap k θ hA]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg w]

name: Submission.contDiff_tubeOffsetCirclePoint
statement:
theorem contDiff_tubeOffsetCirclePoint (k : ℕ) (y : F) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tubeOffsetCirclePoint k y)
proof:
:= by
  change ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun θ => tubeMap k θ (tubeNorthOffset y)
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, id_eq, tubeNorthOffset] using
    (contDiff_tubeMap k).comp (contDiff_id.prodMk contDiff_const)

name: Submission.tubeOffsetCirclePoint_mem_inner
statement:
theorem tubeOffsetCirclePoint_mem_inner (k : ℕ) (y : F)
    (hy : ‖y‖ < 1 / 8) (θ : ℝ) :
    tubeOffsetCirclePoint k y θ ∈ tubeRegion (1 / 4)
proof:
:= by
  have hq : ‖tubeNorthOffset y‖ < 1 / 4 :=
    tubeNorthOffset_norm_lt_quarter y hy
  exact tubeMap_mem_inner_of_norm_lt_quarter k θ hq

name: Submission.tubeThomVec_offsetCirclePoint
statement:
theorem tubeThomVec_offsetCirclePoint (k : ℕ) (y : F)
    (hy : ‖y‖ < 1 / 8) (θ : ℝ) :
    tubeThomVec k (tubeOffsetCirclePoint k y θ) = northPoint y
proof:
:= by
  apply tubeThomVec_eq_northPoint_of_inner_wCoord k _ y hy
    (tubeOffsetCirclePoint_mem_inner k y hy θ)
  unfold tubeOffsetCirclePoint
  exact wCoord_tubeMap k θ
    (tubeA_pos k θ ((tubeNorthOffset_norm_lt_quarter y hy).trans (by norm_num)))

name: Submission.tubeThomVec_north_fiber_eq_range
statement:
theorem tubeThomVec_north_fiber_eq_range (k : ℕ) (y : F)
    (hy : ‖y‖ < 1 / 8) :
    {x : E | tubeThomVec k x = northPoint y} =
      Set.range (tubeOffsetCirclePoint k y)
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    obtain ⟨hinner, hw⟩ :=
      (tubeThomVec_eq_northPoint_iff k x y hy).mp hx
    have hgood : x ∈ tubeGood := innerTube_subset_tubeGood hinner
    obtain ⟨θ, hc, hs⟩ := exists_angle hgood
    refine ⟨θ, ?_⟩
    unfold tubeOffsetCirclePoint
    rw [← hw]
    exact tubeMap_wCoord k hgood hc hs
  · rintro ⟨θ, rfl⟩
    exact tubeThomVec_offsetCirclePoint k y hy θ

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridge_north_iff
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridge_north_iff (k : ℕ) (x : E) :
    nprep (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).approx (WithLp.ofLp x) =
        northPoint (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y ↔
      tubeApproxRaw k (WithLp.ofLp x) =
        northPoint (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y
proof:
:= by
  change nprep (tubeApproximation (m := m) k) (WithLp.ofLp x) =
      northPoint (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y ↔
    tubeApproxRaw k (WithLp.ofLp x) =
      northPoint (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y
  exact tubeApproximation_nprep_eq_north_iff k _ _
    (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).norm_y_lt_one

name: Submission.contDiff_tubeBridgeCirclePoint
statement:
theorem contDiff_tubeBridgeCirclePoint (k : ℕ) (y : F) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k y)
proof:
:= by
  have h : tubeBridgeCirclePoint k y = fun θ =>
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).symm
        (fun i => (tubeOffsetCirclePoint k y θ i + 6) / 12) := rfl
  rw [h]
  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp
  rw [contDiff_pi]
  intro i
  exact (((EuclideanSpace.proj i : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff.comp
    (contDiff_tubeOffsetCirclePoint k y)).add contDiff_const).div_const 12

name: Submission.tubeBridgeCirclePoint_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem tubeBridgeCirclePoint_apply (k : ℕ) (y : F) (θ : ℝ)
    (i : Fin (m + 3)) :
    tubeBridgeCirclePoint k y θ i =
      (tubeOffsetCirclePoint k y θ i + 6) / 12
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.tubeApproxAmbient_bridgeCirclePoint
statement:
theorem tubeApproxAmbient_bridgeCirclePoint (k : ℕ) (y : F) (θ : ℝ) :
    tubeApproxAmbient (WithLp.ofLp (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k y θ)) =
      tubeOffsetCirclePoint k y θ
proof:
:= by
  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).injective
  funext i
  change 12 * ((tubeOffsetCirclePoint k y θ i + 6) / 12) - 6 =
    tubeOffsetCirclePoint k y θ i
  ring

name: Submission.tubeExplicitBridge_north_fiber_eq_range
statement:
theorem tubeExplicitBridge_north_fiber_eq_range (k : ℕ) :
    {x : E |
      nprep (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).approx (WithLp.ofLp x) =
        northPoint (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y} =
      Set.range (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k (tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k).y)
proof:
:= by
  let B := tubeExplicitBridge (m := m) k
  have hy : ‖B.y‖ < 1 / 8 := B.norm_y_lt
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    have hraw := (tubeExplicitBridge_north_iff (m := m) k x).mp hx
    change tubeThomVec k (tubeApproxAmbient (WithLp.ofLp x)) =
      northPoint B.y at hraw
    have hmem : tubeApproxAmbient (WithLp.ofLp x) ∈
        {z : E | tubeThomVec k z = northPoint B.y} := hraw
    rw [tubeThomVec_north_fiber_eq_range k B.y hy] at hmem
    obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := hmem
    refine ⟨θ, ?_⟩
    apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).injective
    funext i
    have hi := congrArg (fun z : E => z i) hθ.symm
    change 12 * x i - 6 = tubeOffsetCirclePoint k B.y θ i at hi
    change (tubeOffsetCirclePoint k B.y θ i + 6) / 12 = x i
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨θ, rfl⟩
    apply (tubeExplicitBridge_north_iff (m := m) k _).mpr
    change tubeThomVec k
      (tubeApproxAmbient (WithLp.ofLp (tubeBridgeCirclePoint k B.y θ))) =
        northPoint B.y
    rw [tubeApproxAmbient_bridgeCirclePoint]
    exact tubeThomVec_offsetCirclePoint k B.y hy θ

name: Submission.normSq_eq_sum_sq
statement:
lemma normSq_eq_sum_sq {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, (x i) ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)]
  simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

name: Submission.abs_coordinate_le_norm
statement:
lemma abs_coordinate_le_norm {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι)
    (i : ι) : |x i| ≤ ‖x‖
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : (x i) ^ 2 ≤ ‖x‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [normSq_eq_sum_sq]
    exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ => sq_nonneg (x j)) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  calc |x i| = Real.sqrt ((x i) ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs _).symm
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (‖x‖ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
    _ = ‖x‖ := Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg x)

name: Submission.inner_eq_sum
statement: lemma inner_eq_sum (x y : E) : ⟪x, y⟫ = ∑ j, x j * y j
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by
    simp [RCLike.inner_apply, mul_comm]

name: Submission.sum_split_pair01
statement:
lemma sum_split_pair01 (f : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (h0 : f 0 = a) (h1 : f 1 = b)
    (hrest : ∀ j : Fin (m + 3), j ≠ 0 → j ≠ 1 → f j = 0) :
    ∑ j, f j = a + b
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ j, f j
      = (if j = 0 then a else 0) + (if j = 1 then b else 0) := by
    intro j
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst hj0
      rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg (Fin.zero_ne_one (n := m + 1)), add_zero, h0]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst hj1
        rw [if_neg (Fin.zero_ne_one (n := m + 1)).symm, if_pos rfl, zero_add, h1]
      · rw [if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1, add_zero, hrest j hj0 hj1]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => key j, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (0 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => a),
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (1 : Fin (m + 3)) (fun _ => b),
    if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]

name: Submission.lastA_ne_zero
statement: lemma lastA_ne_zero : (Fin.last (m + 2) : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero] at h'
  omega

name: Submission.lastA_ne_one
statement: lemma lastA_ne_one : (Fin.last (m + 2) : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 1
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_one] at h'
  omega

name: Submission.lastW_ne_zero
statement: lemma lastW_ne_zero : (Fin.last (m + 1) : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h
  have h' := congrArg Fin.val h
  simp only [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero] at h'
  omega

name: Submission.rotP_zero
statement: @[simp] lemma rotP_zero (p : ℝ × ℝ) : rotP 0 p = (1, 0)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.rotP_succ
statement:
lemma rotP_succ (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    rotP (k + 1) p
      = (p.1 * (rotP k p).1 - p.2 * (rotP k p).2,
         p.2 * (rotP k p).1 + p.1 * (rotP k p).2)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.rotP_cos_sin
statement:
lemma rotP_cos_sin (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    rotP k (Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ) = (Real.cos (k * θ), Real.sin (k * θ))
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    have harg : ((k : ℝ) + 1) * θ = θ + k * θ := by ring
    rw [rotP_succ, ih]
    push_cast
    rw [harg, Real.cos_add, Real.sin_add]

name: Submission.rotP_sq_add_sq
statement:
lemma rotP_sq_add_sq (k : ℕ) (p : ℝ × ℝ) :
    (rotP k p).1 ^ 2 + (rotP k p).2 ^ 2 = (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) ^ k
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    rw [rotP_succ]
    show (p.1 * (rotP k p).1 - p.2 * (rotP k p).2) ^ 2
        + (p.2 * (rotP k p).1 + p.1 * (rotP k p).2) ^ 2 = _
    rw [pow_succ (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) k]
    linear_combination (p.1 ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2) * ih

name: Submission.contDiff_rotP
statement: lemma contDiff_rotP (k : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (rotP k)
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
    have h : rotP 0 = fun _ : ℝ × ℝ => ((1 : ℝ), (0 : ℝ)) := rfl
    rw [h]
    exact contDiff_const
  | succ k ih =>
    have h1 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (rotP k p).1 := contDiff_fst.comp ih
    have h2 : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (rotP k p).2 := contDiff_snd.comp ih
    have h : rotP (k + 1) = fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        (p.1 * (rotP k p).1 - p.2 * (rotP k p).2,
         p.2 * (rotP k p).1 + p.1 * (rotP k p).2) := rfl
    rw [h]
    exact ((contDiff_fst.mul h1).sub (contDiff_snd.mul h2)).prodMk
      ((contDiff_snd.mul h1).add (contDiff_fst.mul h2))

name: Submission.coordVec_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma coordVec_apply (j₀ j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    coordVec j₀ j = if j = j₀ then (1 : ℝ) else 0
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.circleAt_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma circleAt_apply (θ : ℝ) (j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    circleAt θ j = if j = 0 then Real.cos θ else if j = 1 then Real.sin θ else 0
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.tangentAt_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma tangentAt_apply (θ : ℝ) (j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    tangentAt θ j
      = if j = 0 then -Real.sin θ else if j = 1 then Real.cos θ else 0
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.circleAt_apply_zero
statement: lemma circleAt_apply_zero (θ : ℝ) : circleAt (m := m) θ 0 = Real.cos θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleAt_apply, if_pos rfl]

name: Submission.circleAt_apply_one
statement: lemma circleAt_apply_one (θ : ℝ) : circleAt (m := m) θ 1 = Real.sin θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleAt_apply, if_neg (Fin.zero_ne_one (n := m + 1)).symm, if_pos rfl]

name: Submission.circleAt_apply_other
statement:
lemma circleAt_apply_other (θ : ℝ) {j : Fin (m + 3)} (h0 : j ≠ 0) (h1 : j ≠ 1) :
    circleAt (m := m) θ j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [circleAt_apply, if_neg h0, if_neg h1]

name: Submission.eVert_apply_last
statement: lemma eVert_apply_last : eVert (m := m) (Fin.last (m + 2)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  show (if Fin.last (m + 2) = Fin.last (m + 2) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 1
  rw [if_pos rfl]

name: Submission.eVert_apply_ne
statement:
lemma eVert_apply_ne {j : Fin (m + 3)} (h : j ≠ Fin.last (m + 2)) :
    eVert (m := m) j = 0
proof:
:= by
  show (if j = Fin.last (m + 2) then (1 : ℝ) else 0) = 0
  rw [if_neg h]

name: Submission.addSmul_coord
statement:
lemma addSmul_coord (a b : ℝ) (x y : E) (j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    (a • x + b • y) j = a * x j + b * y j
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.nuVec_zero
statement:
lemma nuVec_zero (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    nuVec (m := m) k θ 0
      = Real.cos (k * θ) • circleAt θ + Real.sin (k * θ) • eVert
proof:
:= by
  rw [nuVec, if_pos rfl]

name: Submission.nuVec_last
statement:
lemma nuVec_last (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    nuVec (m := m) k θ (Fin.last (m + 1))
      = (-Real.sin (k * θ)) • circleAt θ + Real.cos (k * θ) • eVert
proof:
:= by
  rw [nuVec, if_neg lastW_ne_zero, if_pos rfl]

name: Submission.nuVec_mid
statement:
lemma nuVec_mid (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) {i : Fin (m + 2)} (h0 : i ≠ 0)
    (hl : i ≠ Fin.last (m + 1)) :
    nuVec (m := m) k θ i = coordVec i.succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [nuVec, if_neg h0, if_neg hl]

name: Submission.midSucc_ne
statement:
lemma midSucc_ne {i : Fin (m + 2)} (h0 : i ≠ 0) (hl : i ≠ Fin.last (m + 1)) :
    (i.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 0 ∧ (i.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 1
      ∧ (i.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ Fin.last (m + 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hv0 : i.val ≠ 0 := fun h => h0 (Fin.ext h)
  have hvl : i.val ≠ m + 1 := fun h => hl (Fin.ext h)
  refine ⟨Fin.succ_ne_zero i, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_one] at h'
    omega
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_last] at h'
    omega

name: Submission.sum_coord
statement:
lemma sum_coord {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (g : ι → E) (j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    (∑ i, g i) j = ∑ i, (g i) j
proof:
:=
  map_sum (EuclideanSpace.proj j) g Finset.univ

name: Submission.sum_split_pair
statement:
lemma sum_split_pair (f : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (h0 : f 0 = a) (hl : f (Fin.last (m + 1)) = b)
    (hmid : ∀ i : Fin (m + 2), i ≠ 0 → i ≠ Fin.last (m + 1) → f i = 0) :
    ∑ i, f i = a + b
proof:
:= by
  have key : ∀ i, f i
      = (if i = 0 then a else 0) + (if i = Fin.last (m + 1) then b else 0) := by
    intro i
    by_cases h1 : i = 0
    · subst h1
      rw [if_pos rfl, if_neg (Ne.symm lastW_ne_zero), add_zero, h0]
    · by_cases h2 : i = Fin.last (m + 1)
      · subst h2
        rw [if_neg lastW_ne_zero, if_pos rfl, zero_add, hl]
      · rw [if_neg h1, if_neg h2, add_zero, hmid i h1 h2]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => key i, Finset.sum_add_distrib,
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (0 : Fin (m + 2)) (fun _ => a),
    Finset.sum_ite_eq' _ (Fin.last (m + 1)) (fun _ => b),
    if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _), if_pos (Finset.mem_univ _)]

name: Submission.tubeMap_coord
statement:
lemma tubeMap_coord (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (w : F) (j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    tubeMap k θ w j = circleAt θ j + ∑ i, w i * nuVec k θ i j
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : tubeMap k θ w j = circleAt θ j + (∑ i, w i • nuVec k θ i) j := rfl
  rw [h1, sum_coord]
  rfl

name: Submission.tubeMap_apply_zero
statement:
lemma tubeMap_apply_zero (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (w : F) :
    tubeMap k θ w 0 = tubeA k θ w * Real.cos θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [tubeMap_coord, circleAt_apply_zero]
  have hsum : (∑ i, w i * nuVec k θ i 0)
      = w 0 * (Real.cos (k * θ) * Real.cos θ)
        + w (Fin.last (m + 1)) * (-Real.sin (k * θ) * Real.cos θ) := by
    apply sum_split_pair
    · rw [nuVec_zero, addSmul_coord, circleAt_apply_zero,
        eVert_apply_ne (Ne.symm lastA_ne_zero)]
      ring
    · rw [nuVec_last, addSmul_coord, circleAt_apply_zero,
        eVert_apply_ne (Ne.symm lastA_ne_zero)]
      ring
    · intro i h0 hl
      rw [nuVec_mid k θ h0 hl, coordVec_apply,
        if_neg (Ne.symm (midSucc_ne h0 hl).1), mul_zero]
  rw [hsum, tubeA]
  ring

name: Submission.tubeMap_apply_one
statement:
lemma tubeMap_apply_one (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (w : F) :
    tubeMap k θ w 1 = tubeA k θ w * Real.sin θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [tubeMap_coord, circleAt_apply_one]
  have hsum : (∑ i, w i * nuVec k θ i 1)
      = w 0 * (Real.cos (k * θ) * Real.sin θ)
        + w (Fin.last (m + 1)) * (-Real.sin (k * θ) * Real.sin θ) := by
    apply sum_split_pair
    · rw [nuVec_zero, addSmul_coord, circleAt_apply_one,
        eVert_apply_ne (Ne.symm lastA_ne_one)]
      ring
    · rw [nuVec_last, addSmul_coord, circleAt_apply_one,
        eVert_apply_ne (Ne.symm lastA_ne_one)]
      ring
    · intro i h0 hl
      rw [nuVec_mid k θ h0 hl, coordVec_apply,
        if_neg (Ne.symm (midSucc_ne h0 hl).2.1), mul_zero]
  rw [hsum, tubeA]
  ring

name: Submission.tubeMap_apply_last
statement:
lemma tubeMap_apply_last (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (w : F) :
    tubeMap k θ w (Fin.last (m + 2)) = tubeB k θ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [tubeMap_coord, circleAt_apply_other θ lastA_ne_zero lastA_ne_one]
  have hsum : (∑ i, w i * nuVec k θ i (Fin.last (m + 2)))
      = w 0 * Real.sin (k * θ) + w (Fin.last (m + 1)) * Real.cos (k * θ) := by
    apply sum_split_pair
    · rw [nuVec_zero, addSmul_coord,
        circleAt_apply_other θ lastA_ne_zero lastA_ne_one, eVert_apply_last]
      ring
    · rw [nuVec_last, addSmul_coord,
        circleAt_apply_other θ lastA_ne_zero lastA_ne_one, eVert_apply_last]
      ring
    · intro i h0 hl
      rw [nuVec_mid k θ h0 hl, coordVec_apply,
        if_neg (Ne.symm (midSucc_ne h0 hl).2.2), mul_zero]
  rw [hsum, tubeB, zero_add]

name: Submission.tubeMap_apply_mid
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hs0, hs1, hsl⟩ := midSucc_ne h0 hl
  rw [tubeMap_coord, circleAt_apply_other θ hs0 hs1]
  have hzero : ∀ i' ∈ Finset.univ, i' ≠ i
      → w i' * nuVec (m := m) k θ i' (i.succ : Fin (m + 3)) = 0 := by
    intro i' _ hne
    by_cases h'0 : i' = 0
    · subst h'0
      rw [nuVec_zero, addSmul_coord, circleAt_apply_other θ hs0 hs1,
        eVert_apply_ne hsl]
      ring
    · by_cases h'l : i' = Fin.last (m + 1)
      · subst h'l
        rw [nuVec_last, addSmul_coord, circleAt_apply_other θ hs0 hs1,
          eVert_apply_ne hsl]
        ring
      · rw [nuVec_mid k θ h'0 h'l, coordVec_apply, if_neg, mul_zero]
        intro hcontra
        exact hne (Fin.succ_injective _ hcontra.symm)
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem i (Finset.mem_univ i) hzero, nuVec_mid k θ h0 hl,
    coordVec_apply, if_pos rfl, mul_one, zero_add]

name: Submission.wCoord_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma wCoord_apply (k : ℕ) (v : E) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    wCoord k v i
      = if i = 0 then cosK k v * (rad v - 1) + sinK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2))
        else if i = Fin.last (m + 1) then
          cosK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2)) - sinK k v * (rad v - 1)
        else v i.succ
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.wCoord_apply_zero
statement:
lemma wCoord_apply_zero (k : ℕ) (v : E) :
    wCoord k v 0 = cosK k v * (rad v - 1) + sinK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [wCoord_apply, if_pos rfl]

name: Submission.wCoord_apply_last
statement:
lemma wCoord_apply_last (k : ℕ) (v : E) :
    wCoord k v (Fin.last (m + 1))
      = cosK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2)) - sinK k v * (rad v - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rw [wCoord_apply, if_neg lastW_ne_zero, if_pos rfl]

name: Submission.wCoord_apply_mid
statement:
lemma wCoord_apply_mid (k : ℕ) (v : E) {i : Fin (m + 2)} (h0 : i ≠ 0)
    (hl : i ≠ Fin.last (m + 1)) :
    wCoord k v i = v i.succ
proof:
:= by
  rw [wCoord_apply, if_neg h0, if_neg hl]

name: Submission.radSq_nonneg
statement: lemma radSq_nonneg (v : E) : 0 ≤ radSq v
proof: := add_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (sq_nonneg _)

name: Submission.rad_nonneg
statement: lemma rad_nonneg (v : E) : 0 ≤ rad v
proof: := Real.sqrt_nonneg _

name: Submission.rad_pos
statement: lemma rad_pos {v : E} (h : 0 < radSq v) : 0 < rad v
proof: := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h

name: Submission.rad_sq
statement: lemma rad_sq (v : E) : rad v ^ 2 = radSq v
proof: := Real.sq_sqrt (radSq_nonneg v)

name: Submission.uC_sq_add_uS_sq
statement: lemma uC_sq_add_uS_sq {v : E} (h : 0 < radSq v) : uC v ^ 2 + uS v ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [uC, uS, div_pow, div_pow, ← add_div, rad_sq]
  have hnum : v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 = radSq v := rfl
  rw [hnum]
  exact div_self h.ne'

name: Submission.cosK_sq_add_sinK_sq
statement:
lemma cosK_sq_add_sinK_sq {v : E} (h : 0 < radSq v) (k : ℕ) :
    cosK k v ^ 2 + sinK k v ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosK, sinK, rotP_sq_add_sq]
  show (uC v ^ 2 + uS v ^ 2) ^ k = 1
  rw [uC_sq_add_uS_sq h, one_pow]

name: Submission.exists_angle
statement:
lemma exists_angle {v : E} (h : 0 < radSq v) :
    ∃ θ : ℝ, Real.cos θ = uC v ∧ Real.sin θ = uS v
proof:
:= by
  have hsum : uC v ^ 2 + uS v ^ 2 = 1 := uC_sq_add_uS_sq h
  have hC1 : -1 ≤ uC v ∧ uC v ≤ 1 := by
    constructor <;> nlinarith [sq_nonneg (uS v), sq_nonneg (uC v + 1), sq_nonneg (uC v - 1)]
  rcases le_or_gt 0 (uS v) with hs | hs
  · refine ⟨Real.arccos (uC v), Real.cos_arccos hC1.1 hC1.2, ?_⟩
    rw [Real.sin_arccos]
    have h1 : 1 - uC v ^ 2 = uS v ^ 2 := by linarith
    rw [h1, Real.sqrt_sq hs]
  · refine ⟨-Real.arccos (uC v), ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [Real.cos_neg]
      exact Real.cos_arccos hC1.1 hC1.2
    · rw [Real.sin_neg, Real.sin_arccos]
      have h1 : 1 - uC v ^ 2 = uS v ^ 2 := by linarith
      rw [h1, Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, abs_of_nonpos hs.le, neg_neg]

name: Submission.radSq_tubeMap
statement:
lemma radSq_tubeMap (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (w : F) :
    radSq (tubeMap k θ w) = tubeA k θ w ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [radSq, tubeMap_apply_zero, tubeMap_apply_one]
  linear_combination (tubeA k θ w ^ 2) * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ

name: Submission.rad_tubeMap
statement:
lemma rad_tubeMap (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) {w : F} (h : 0 ≤ tubeA k θ w) :
    rad (tubeMap k θ w) = tubeA k θ w
proof:
:= by
  rw [rad, radSq_tubeMap, Real.sqrt_sq h]

name: Submission.radSq_tubeMap_pos
statement:
lemma radSq_tubeMap_pos (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) {w : F} (h : 0 < tubeA k θ w) :
    0 < radSq (tubeMap k θ w)
proof:
:= by
  rw [radSq_tubeMap]
  positivity

name: Submission.uC_tubeMap
statement:
lemma uC_tubeMap (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) {w : F} (h : 0 < tubeA k θ w) :
    uC (tubeMap k θ w) = Real.cos θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [uC, rad_tubeMap k θ h.le, tubeMap_apply_zero, mul_comm, mul_div_assoc,
    div_self h.ne', mul_one]

name: Submission.uS_tubeMap
statement:
lemma uS_tubeMap (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) {w : F} (h : 0 < tubeA k θ w) :
    uS (tubeMap k θ w) = Real.sin θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [uS, rad_tubeMap k θ h.le, tubeMap_apply_one, mul_comm, mul_div_assoc,
    div_self h.ne', mul_one]

name: Submission.cosK_tubeMap
statement:
lemma cosK_tubeMap (k k' : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) {w : F} (h : 0 < tubeA k θ w) :
    cosK k' (tubeMap k θ w) = Real.cos (k' * θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cosK, uC_tubeMap k θ h, uS_tubeMap k θ h, rotP_cos_sin]

name: Submission.sinK_tubeMap
statement:
lemma sinK_tubeMap (k k' : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) {w : F} (h : 0 < tubeA k θ w) :
    sinK k' (tubeMap k θ w) = Real.sin (k' * θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [sinK, uC_tubeMap k θ h, uS_tubeMap k θ h, rotP_cos_sin]

name: Submission.wCoord_tubeMap
statement:
theorem wCoord_tubeMap (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) {w : F} (h : 0 < tubeA k θ w) :
    wCoord k (tubeMap k θ w) = w
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  show wCoord k (tubeMap k θ w) i = w i
  have hcs : Real.cos (k * θ) ^ 2 + Real.sin (k * θ) ^ 2 = 1 :=
    Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq _
  by_cases h0 : i = 0
  · subst h0
    rw [wCoord_apply_zero, cosK_tubeMap k k θ h, sinK_tubeMap k k θ h,
      rad_tubeMap k θ h.le, tubeMap_apply_last, tubeA, tubeB]
    linear_combination (w 0) * hcs
  · by_cases hl : i = Fin.last (m + 1)
    · subst hl
      rw [wCoord_apply_last, cosK_tubeMap k k θ h, sinK_tubeMap k k θ h,
        rad_tubeMap k θ h.le, tubeMap_apply_last, tubeA, tubeB]
      linear_combination (w (Fin.last (m + 1))) * hcs
    · rw [wCoord_apply_mid k _ h0 hl, tubeMap_apply_mid k θ w h0 hl]

name: Submission.tubeMap_wCoord
proof:
:= by
  have hrad : 0 < rad v := rad_pos h
  have hK : rotP k (Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ) = (cosK k v, sinK k v) := by
    rw [hc, hs]; rfl
  have hcos : Real.cos (k * θ) = cosK k v := by
    have h' := rotP_cos_sin k θ
    rw [hK] at h'
    exact (congrArg Prod.fst h').symm
  have hsin : Real.sin (k * θ) = sinK k v := by
    have h' := rotP_cos_sin k θ
    rw [hK] at h'
    exact (congrArg Prod.snd h').symm
  have hcs : cosK k v ^ 2 + sinK k v ^ 2 = 1 := cosK_sq_add_sinK_sq h k
  
  have hA : tubeA k θ (wCoord k v) = rad v := by
    rw [tubeA, hcos, hsin, wCoord_apply_zero, wCoord_apply_last]
    linear_combination (rad v - 1) * hcs
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext j
  show tubeMap k θ (wCoord k v) j = v j
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j.val 2 with hj2 | hj2
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j.val 1 with hj1 | hj1
    · have hj : j = 0 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        rw [Fin.val_zero]
        omega
      subst hj
      rw [tubeMap_apply_zero, hA, hc, uC, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hrad.ne']
    · have hj : j = 1 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        rw [Fin.val_one]
        omega
      subst hj
      rw [tubeMap_apply_one, hA, hs, uS, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hrad.ne']
  · rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j.val (m + 2) with hjm | hjm
    · 
      set i : Fin (m + 2) := ⟨j.val - 1, by omega⟩ with hi
      have hi0 : i ≠ 0 := by
        intro hcon
        have h' := congrArg Fin.val hcon
        simp only [hi, Fin.val_zero] at h'
        omega
      have hil : i ≠ Fin.last (m + 1) := by
        intro hcon
        have h' := congrArg Fin.val hcon
        simp only [hi, Fin.val_last] at h'
        omega
      have hjsucc : (i.succ : Fin (m + 3)) = j := by
        apply Fin.ext
        rw [Fin.val_succ]
        simp only [hi]
        omega
      rw [← hjsucc, tubeMap_apply_mid k θ _ hi0 hil, wCoord_apply_mid k v hi0 hil,
        hjsucc]
    · 
      have hj : j = Fin.last (m + 2) := by
        apply Fin.ext
        rw [Fin.val_last]
        have := j.isLt
        omega
      subst hj
      rw [tubeMap_apply_last, tubeB, hcos, hsin, wCoord_apply_zero,
        wCoord_apply_last]
      linear_combination (v (Fin.last (m + 2))) * hcs

name: Submission.tubeA_pos
statement:
lemma tubeA_pos (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) {w : F} (hw : ‖w‖ < 1 / 2) :
    0 < tubeA k θ w
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : |w 0| ≤ ‖w‖ := abs_coordinate_le_norm w 0
  have hl : |w (Fin.last (m + 1))| ≤ ‖w‖ := abs_coordinate_le_norm w _
  have hc : |Real.cos (k * θ)| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_cos_le_one _
  have hs : |Real.sin (k * θ)| ≤ 1 := Real.abs_sin_le_one _
  have h1 : |w 0 * Real.cos (k * θ)| ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc |w 0| * |Real.cos (k * θ)| ≤ ‖w‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul h0 hc (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg w)
      _ = ‖w‖ := mul_one _
  have h2 : |w (Fin.last (m + 1)) * Real.sin (k * θ)| ≤ ‖w‖ := by
    rw [abs_mul]
    calc |w _| * |Real.sin (k * θ)| ≤ ‖w‖ * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul hl hs (abs_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg w)
      _ = ‖w‖ := mul_one _
  have h1' := abs_le.mp h1
  have h2' := abs_le.mp h2
  rw [tubeA]
  linarith [h1'.1, h2'.2]

name: Submission.tubeMap_inj
statement:
theorem tubeMap_inj {k : ℕ} {θ θ' : ℝ} {w w' : F} (hw : ‖w‖ < 1 / 2)
    (hw' : ‖w'‖ < 1 / 2) (h : tubeMap k θ w = tubeMap k θ' w') :
    (∃ z : ℤ, θ' = θ + z * (2 * π)) ∧ w = w'
proof:
:= by
  have hA : 0 < tubeA k θ w := tubeA_pos k θ hw
  have hA' : 0 < tubeA k θ' w' := tubeA_pos k θ' hw'
  have h0 : tubeA k θ w * Real.cos θ = tubeA k θ' w' * Real.cos θ' := by
    rw [← tubeMap_apply_zero, ← tubeMap_apply_zero, h]
  have h1 : tubeA k θ w * Real.sin θ = tubeA k θ' w' * Real.sin θ' := by
    rw [← tubeMap_apply_one, ← tubeMap_apply_one, h]
  
  have hAA : tubeA k θ w = tubeA k θ' w' := by
    have e1 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ
    have e2 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ'
    have hboth : (tubeA k θ w * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 + (tubeA k θ w * Real.cos θ) ^ 2
        = (tubeA k θ' w' * Real.sin θ') ^ 2 + (tubeA k θ' w' * Real.cos θ') ^ 2 := by
      rw [h0, h1]
    have hsq : tubeA k θ w ^ 2 = tubeA k θ' w' ^ 2 := by
      linear_combination hboth - tubeA k θ w ^ 2 * e1 + tubeA k θ' w' ^ 2 * e2
    have hfac : (tubeA k θ w - tubeA k θ' w') * (tubeA k θ w + tubeA k θ' w') = 0 := by
      linear_combination hsq
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hfac with hz | hz
    · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz
    · have hpos : 0 < tubeA k θ w + tubeA k θ' w' := by positivity
      exact absurd hz hpos.ne'
  have hcos : Real.cos θ = Real.cos θ' := by
    have h' := h0
    rw [hAA] at h'
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hA'.ne' h'
  have hsin : Real.sin θ = Real.sin θ' := by
    have h' := h1
    rw [hAA] at h'
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ hA'.ne' h'
  
  have hone : Real.cos (θ' - θ) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.cos_sub, ← hcos, ← hsin]
    linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff _).mp hone
  refine ⟨⟨z, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · linarith
  · calc w = wCoord k (tubeMap k θ w) := (wCoord_tubeMap k θ hA).symm
      _ = wCoord k (tubeMap k θ' w') := by rw [h]
      _ = w' := wCoord_tubeMap k θ' hA'

name: Submission.tubeMap_periodic
statement:
lemma tubeMap_periodic (k : ℕ) (w : F) :
    Function.Periodic (fun θ => tubeMap (m := m) k θ w) (2 * π)
proof:
:= by
  intro θ
  have hc : Real.cos (θ + 2 * π) = Real.cos θ := Real.cos_add_two_pi θ
  have hs : Real.sin (θ + 2 * π) = Real.sin θ := Real.sin_add_two_pi θ
  have hck : Real.cos (k * (θ + 2 * π)) = Real.cos (k * θ) := by
    have harg : (k : ℝ) * (θ + 2 * π) = k * θ + (k : ℤ) * (2 * π) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [harg, Real.cos_add_int_mul_two_pi]
  have hsk : Real.sin (k * (θ + 2 * π)) = Real.sin (k * θ) := by
    have harg : (k : ℝ) * (θ + 2 * π) = k * θ + (k : ℤ) * (2 * π) := by
      push_cast; ring
    rw [harg, Real.sin_add_int_mul_two_pi]
  have hcircle : circleAt (m := m) (θ + 2 * π) = circleAt θ := by
    rw [circleAt, circleAt, hc, hs]
  show tubeMap k (θ + 2 * π) w = tubeMap k θ w
  rw [tubeMap, tubeMap, hcircle]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i _
  congr 1
  by_cases h0 : i = 0
  · subst h0
    rw [nuVec_zero, nuVec_zero, hck, hsk, hcircle]
  · by_cases hl : i = Fin.last (m + 1)
    · subst hl
      rw [nuVec_last, nuVec_last, hck, hsk, hcircle]
    · rw [nuVec_mid k _ h0 hl, nuVec_mid k _ h0 hl]

name: Submission.radSq_le_normSq
statement: lemma radSq_le_normSq (v : E) : radSq v ≤ ‖v‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [normSq_eq_sum_sq]
  have hsub : ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin (m + 3))) ⊆ Finset.univ :=
    Finset.subset_univ _
  have hpair : ∑ j ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin (m + 3))), (v j) ^ 2 = radSq v := by
    rw [Finset.sum_pair (Fin.zero_ne_one (n := m + 1))]
    rfl
  calc radSq v = ∑ j ∈ ({0, 1} : Finset (Fin (m + 3))), (v j) ^ 2 := hpair.symm
    _ ≤ ∑ j, (v j) ^ 2 :=
        Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg hsub fun j _ _ => sq_nonneg _

name: Submission.rad_le_norm
statement: lemma rad_le_norm (v : E) : rad v ≤ ‖v‖
proof:
:= by
  calc rad v ≤ Real.sqrt (‖v‖ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (radSq_le_normSq v)
    _ = ‖v‖ := Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg v)

name: Submission.tubeDistSq_nonneg
statement: lemma tubeDistSq_nonneg (v : E) : 0 ≤ tubeDistSq v
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := rad_le_norm v
  have h2 := rad_nonneg v
  rw [tubeDistSq]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖v‖ - 1)]

name: Submission.sq_rad_le_tubeDistSq
statement: lemma sq_rad_le_tubeDistSq (v : E) : (rad v - 1) ^ 2 ≤ tubeDistSq v
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := radSq_le_normSq v
  have h2 := rad_sq v
  rw [tubeDistSq]
  nlinarith

name: Submission.midW_ne
statement:
lemma midW_ne (i : Fin m) :
    ((i.castSucc).succ : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ 0
      ∧ ((i.castSucc).succ : Fin (m + 2)) ≠ Fin.last (m + 1)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · exact Fin.succ_ne_zero _
  · intro h
    have h' := congrArg Fin.val h
    simp only [Fin.val_succ, Fin.coe_castSucc, Fin.val_last] at h'
    omega

name: Submission.sum_decomp_w
statement:
lemma sum_decomp_w (f : Fin (m + 2) → ℝ) :
    ∑ i, f i
      = f 0 + (∑ i : Fin m, f ((i.castSucc).succ)) + f (Fin.last (m + 1))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  have hlast : ((Fin.last m).succ : Fin (m + 2)) = Fin.last (m + 1) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_last]
  rw [hlast]
  ring

name: Submission.sum_decomp_a
statement:
lemma sum_decomp_a (f : Fin (m + 3) → ℝ) :
    ∑ j, f j
      = f 0 + f 1 + (∑ i : Fin m, f (((i.castSucc).succ).succ))
        + f (Fin.last (m + 2))
proof:
:= by
  rw [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  have h1 : ((0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ : Fin (m + 3)) = 1 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Fin.val_succ]
  have hlast : (((Fin.last m).succ).succ : Fin (m + 3)) = Fin.last (m + 2) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_last]
  rw [h1, hlast]
  ring

name: Submission.norm_wCoord_sq
statement:
theorem norm_wCoord_sq (k : ℕ) {v : E} (h : 0 < radSq v) :
    ‖wCoord k v‖ ^ 2 = tubeDistSq v
proof:
:= by
  have hcs := cosK_sq_add_sinK_sq h k
  have hradsq := rad_sq v
  rw [normSq_eq_sum_sq, sum_decomp_w, wCoord_apply_zero, wCoord_apply_last]
  have hmid : ∀ i : Fin m,
      (wCoord k v ((i.castSucc).succ)) ^ 2 = (v (((i.castSucc).succ).succ)) ^ 2 :=
    fun i => congrArg (· ^ 2) (wCoord_apply_mid k v (midW_ne i).1 (midW_ne i).2)
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hmid i, tubeDistSq,
    normSq_eq_sum_sq (x := v), sum_decomp_a]
  have hrad : v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 = rad v ^ 2 := by rw [hradsq]; rfl
  linear_combination ((rad v - 1) ^ 2 + (v (Fin.last (m + 2))) ^ 2) * hcs
    - (1 : ℝ) * hrad

name: Submission.norm_tubeMap_sub_circleAt
statement:
theorem norm_tubeMap_sub_circleAt (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (w : F) :
    ‖tubeMap k θ w - circleAt θ‖ ^ 2 = ‖w‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hδ : ∀ j : Fin (m + 3),
      (tubeMap (m := m) k θ w - circleAt (m := m) θ : E) j
        = tubeMap k θ w j - circleAt θ j := fun j => rfl
  rw [normSq_eq_sum_sq, Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => congrArg (· ^ 2) (hδ j),
    sum_decomp_a]
  rw [tubeMap_apply_zero, tubeMap_apply_one, tubeMap_apply_last,
    circleAt_apply_zero, circleAt_apply_one,
    circleAt_apply_other θ lastA_ne_zero lastA_ne_one]
  have hmids : ∀ i : Fin m,
      (tubeMap k θ w (((i.castSucc).succ).succ)
          - circleAt θ (((i.castSucc).succ).succ)) ^ 2
        = (w ((i.castSucc).succ)) ^ 2 := by
    intro i
    obtain ⟨hs0, hs1, _⟩ := midSucc_ne (midW_ne i).1 (midW_ne i).2
    rw [tubeMap_apply_mid k θ w (midW_ne i).1 (midW_ne i).2,
      circleAt_apply_other θ hs0 hs1, sub_zero]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hmids i, normSq_eq_sum_sq (x := w),
    sum_decomp_w, tubeA, tubeB]
  linear_combination
    ((1 + w 0 * Real.cos (k * θ) - w (Fin.last (m + 1)) * Real.sin (k * θ)) - 1) ^ 2
        * Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ
      + (w 0 ^ 2 + w (Fin.last (m + 1)) ^ 2) * Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (k * θ)

name: Submission.tubeDistSq_tubeMap
statement:
lemma tubeDistSq_tubeMap (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) {w : F} (h : 0 < tubeA k θ w) :
    tubeDistSq (tubeMap k θ w) = ‖w‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [← norm_wCoord_sq k (radSq_tubeMap_pos k θ h), wCoord_tubeMap k θ h]

name: Submission.tubeDistSq_le_norm_sub_circleAt
statement:
lemma tubeDistSq_le_norm_sub_circleAt (v : E) (θ : ℝ) :
    tubeDistSq v ≤ ‖v - circleAt θ‖ ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  have hnorm : ‖circleAt (m := m) θ‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [normSq_eq_sum_sq]
    have hz : ∀ j : Fin (m + 3), j ≠ 0 → j ≠ 1 → (circleAt θ j) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      intro j h0 h1
      rw [circleAt_apply_other θ h0 h1]
      ring
    rw [sum_decomp_a]
    have hmid : ∀ i : Fin m, (circleAt θ (((i.castSucc).succ).succ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = 0 := by
      intro i
      obtain ⟨hs0, hs1, _⟩ := midSucc_ne (midW_ne i).1 (midW_ne i).2
      exact hz _ hs0 hs1
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => hmid i, Finset.sum_const, smul_zero,
      hz _ lastA_ne_zero lastA_ne_one, circleAt_apply_zero, circleAt_apply_one]
    linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ
  have hinner : ⟪v, circleAt θ⟫ = v 0 * Real.cos θ + v 1 * Real.sin θ := by
    rw [inner_eq_sum]
    apply sum_split_pair01
    · rw [circleAt_apply_zero]
    · rw [circleAt_apply_one]
    · intro j h0 h1
      rw [circleAt_apply_other θ h0 h1, mul_zero]
  have hCS : v 0 * Real.cos θ + v 1 * Real.sin θ ≤ rad v := by
    have hsq : (v 0 * Real.cos θ + v 1 * Real.sin θ) ^ 2 ≤ radSq v := by
      have h1 := sq_nonneg (v 0 * Real.sin θ - v 1 * Real.cos θ)
      have h2 := Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ
      rw [radSq]
      nlinarith
    calc v 0 * Real.cos θ + v 1 * Real.sin θ
        ≤ |v 0 * Real.cos θ + v 1 * Real.sin θ| := le_abs_self _
      _ = Real.sqrt ((v 0 * Real.cos θ + v 1 * Real.sin θ) ^ 2) :=
          (Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt (radSq v) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hsq
      _ = rad v := rfl
  have hexp : ‖v - circleAt θ‖ ^ 2
      = ‖v‖ ^ 2 - 2 * ⟪v, circleAt θ⟫ + ‖circleAt θ‖ ^ 2 := norm_sub_sq_real v _
  rw [hexp, hnorm, hinner, tubeDistSq]
  linarith

name: Submission.contDiff_coordA
statement: lemma contDiff_coordA (j : Fin (m + 3)) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun v : E => v j
proof:
:=
  (EuclideanSpace.proj j : E →L[ℝ] ℝ).contDiff

name: Submission.contDiff_circleAt
statement: lemma contDiff_circleAt : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (circleAt (m := m))
proof:
:= by
  have h : circleAt (m := m) = fun θ =>
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).symm
        (fun j => if j = 0 then Real.cos θ else if j = 1 then Real.sin θ else 0) :=
    rfl
  rw [h]
  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp
  rw [contDiff_pi]
  intro j
  by_cases h0 : j = 0
  · have heq : (fun θ : ℝ => if j = 0 then Real.cos θ
        else if j = 1 then Real.sin θ else 0) = Real.cos := by
      funext θ
      rw [if_pos h0]
    rw [heq]
    exact Real.contDiff_cos
  · by_cases h1 : j = 1
    · have heq : (fun θ : ℝ => if j = 0 then Real.cos θ
          else if j = 1 then Real.sin θ else 0) = Real.sin := by
        funext θ
        rw [if_neg h0, if_pos h1]
      rw [heq]
      exact Real.contDiff_sin
    · have heq : (fun θ : ℝ => if j = 0 then Real.cos θ
          else if j = 1 then Real.sin θ else 0) = fun _ => (0 : ℝ) := by
        funext θ
        rw [if_neg h0, if_neg h1]
      rw [heq]
      exact contDiff_const

name: Submission.contDiff_cos_k
statement: lemma contDiff_cos_k (k : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun θ : ℝ => Real.cos (k * θ)
proof:
:=
  Real.contDiff_cos.comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)

name: Submission.contDiff_sin_k
statement: lemma contDiff_sin_k (k : ℕ) : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun θ : ℝ => Real.sin (k * θ)
proof:
:=
  Real.contDiff_sin.comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)

name: Submission.contDiff_nuVec
statement:
lemma contDiff_nuVec (k : ℕ) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun θ => nuVec (m := m) k θ i
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h0 : i = 0
  · subst h0
    have heq : (fun θ => nuVec (m := m) k θ 0)
        = fun θ => Real.cos (k * θ) • circleAt θ + Real.sin (k * θ) • eVert := by
      funext θ
      exact nuVec_zero k θ
    rw [heq]
    exact ((contDiff_cos_k k).smul contDiff_circleAt).add
      ((contDiff_sin_k k).smul contDiff_const)
  · by_cases hl : i = Fin.last (m + 1)
    · subst hl
      have heq : (fun θ => nuVec (m := m) k θ (Fin.last (m + 1)))
          = fun θ => (-Real.sin (k * θ)) • circleAt θ + Real.cos (k * θ) • eVert := by
        funext θ
        exact nuVec_last k θ
      rw [heq]
      exact (((contDiff_sin_k k).neg).smul contDiff_circleAt).add
        ((contDiff_cos_k k).smul contDiff_const)
    · have heq : (fun θ => nuVec (m := m) k θ i) = fun _ => coordVec i.succ := by
        funext θ
        exact nuVec_mid k θ h0 hl
      rw [heq]
      exact contDiff_const

name: Submission.contDiff_tubeMap
statement:
theorem contDiff_tubeMap (k : ℕ) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun p : ℝ × F => tubeMap k p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  have h : (fun p : ℝ × F => tubeMap k p.1 p.2)
      = fun p : ℝ × F => circleAt p.1 + ∑ i, p.2 i • nuVec k p.1 i := rfl
  rw [h]
  apply ContDiff.add
  · exact contDiff_circleAt.comp contDiff_fst
  · apply ContDiff.sum
    intro i _
    exact ((EuclideanSpace.proj i).contDiff.comp contDiff_snd).smul
      ((contDiff_nuVec k i).comp contDiff_fst)

name: Submission.contDiff_radSq
statement: lemma contDiff_radSq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (radSq (m := m))
proof:
:= by
  have h : radSq (m := m) = fun v => v 0 ^ 2 + v 1 ^ 2 := rfl
  rw [h]
  exact ((contDiff_coordA 0).pow 2).add ((contDiff_coordA 1).pow 2)

name: Submission.isOpen_tubeGood

name: Submission.contDiffOn_rad

proof:

  intro v hv
  have h1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ Real.sqrt (radSq v) :=
    Real.contDiffAt_sqrt (ne_of_gt hv)
  exact (h1.comp v contDiff_radSq.contDiffAt).contDiffWithinAt

statement: lemma contDiffOn_cosK (k : ℕ) : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (cosK (m := m) k) tubeGood
proof:

  have h : cosK (m := m) k = fun v => (rotP k (uC v, uS v)).1 := rfl

name: Submission.contDiffOn_wCoord
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_wCoord (k : ℕ) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (wCoord (m := m) k) tubeGood
proof:
:= by
  have h : wCoord (m := m) k = fun v =>
      (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 2)) ℝ).symm
        (fun i => if i = 0 then
            cosK k v * (rad v - 1) + sinK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2))
          else if i = Fin.last (m + 1) then
            cosK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2)) - sinK k v * (rad v - 1)
          else v i.succ) := rfl
  rw [h]
  apply (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (m + 2)) ℝ).symm.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn
  rw [contDiffOn_pi]
  intro i
  by_cases h0 : i = 0
  · have heq : (fun v : E => if i = 0 then
        cosK k v * (rad v - 1) + sinK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2))
      else if i = Fin.last (m + 1) then
        cosK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2)) - sinK k v * (rad v - 1)
      else v i.succ)
        = fun v => cosK k v * (rad v - 1) + sinK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2)) := by
      funext v
      rw [if_pos h0]
    rw [heq]
    exact ((contDiffOn_cosK k).mul (contDiffOn_rad.sub contDiffOn_const)).add
      ((contDiffOn_sinK k).mul ((contDiff_coordA (Fin.last (m + 2))).contDiffOn))
  · by_cases hl : i = Fin.last (m + 1)
    · have heq : (fun v : E => if i = 0 then
          cosK k v * (rad v - 1) + sinK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2))
        else if i = Fin.last (m + 1) then
          cosK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2)) - sinK k v * (rad v - 1)
        else v i.succ)
          = fun v => cosK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2)) - sinK k v * (rad v - 1) := by
        funext v
        rw [if_neg h0, if_pos hl]
      rw [heq]
      exact ((contDiffOn_cosK k).mul
          ((contDiff_coordA (Fin.last (m + 2))).contDiffOn)).sub
        ((contDiffOn_sinK k).mul (contDiffOn_rad.sub contDiffOn_const))
    · have heq : (fun v : E => if i = 0 then
          cosK k v * (rad v - 1) + sinK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2))
        else if i = Fin.last (m + 1) then
          cosK k v * v (Fin.last (m + 2)) - sinK k v * (rad v - 1)
        else v i.succ) = fun v => v i.succ := by
        funext v
        rw [if_neg h0, if_neg hl]
      rw [heq]
      exact (contDiff_coordA i.succ).contDiffOn

name: Submission.contDiffOn_tubeDistSq
statement: lemma contDiffOn_tubeDistSq : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (tubeDistSq (m := m)) tubeGood
proof:
:= by
  have h : tubeDistSq (m := m) = fun v => ‖v‖ ^ 2 + 1 - 2 * rad v := rfl
  rw [h]
  apply ContDiffOn.sub
  · apply ContDiffOn.add _ contDiffOn_const
    have hnormsq : ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun v : E => ‖v‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h2 : (fun v : E => ‖v‖ ^ 2) = fun v : E => ⟪v, v⟫ := by
        funext v
        rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      rw [h2]
      exact ContDiff.inner ℝ contDiff_id contDiff_id
    exact hnormsq.contDiffOn
  · exact contDiffOn_const.mul contDiffOn_rad

name: Submission.inner_coordVec_left
statement: lemma inner_coordVec_left (a : Fin (m + 3)) (y : E) : ⟪coordVec a, y⟫ = y a
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_eq_sum]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single_of_mem a (Finset.mem_univ a)]
  · rw [coordVec_apply, if_pos rfl, one_mul]
  · intro j _ hj
    rw [coordVec_apply, if_neg hj, zero_mul]

name: Submission.inner_coordVec_right
statement: lemma inner_coordVec_right (x : E) (a : Fin (m + 3)) : ⟪x, coordVec a⟫ = x a
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.inner_circleAt_circleAt
statement:
lemma inner_circleAt_circleAt (θ θ' : ℝ) :
    ⟪circleAt (m := m) θ, circleAt θ'⟫
      = Real.cos θ * Real.cos θ' + Real.sin θ * Real.sin θ'
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_eq_sum]
  apply sum_split_pair01
  · rw [circleAt_apply_zero, circleAt_apply_zero]
  · rw [circleAt_apply_one, circleAt_apply_one]
  · intro j h0 h1
    rw [circleAt_apply_other θ h0 h1, zero_mul]

name: Submission.inner_circleAt_self
statement: lemma inner_circleAt_self (θ : ℝ) : ⟪circleAt (m := m) θ, circleAt θ⟫ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_circleAt_circleAt]
  linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ

name: Submission.inner_circleAt_eVert
statement: lemma inner_circleAt_eVert (θ : ℝ) : ⟪circleAt (m := m) θ, eVert⟫ = 0

  exact circleAt_apply_other θ lastA_ne_zero lastA_ne_one

name: Submission.inner_eVert_self
statement: lemma inner_eVert_self : ⟪eVert (m := m), eVert⟫ = 1

name: Submission.inner_circleAt_tangentAt
statement:
lemma inner_circleAt_tangentAt (θ : ℝ) :
    ⟪circleAt (m := m) θ, tangentAt θ⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h : ⟪circleAt (m := m) θ, tangentAt θ⟫
      = Real.cos θ * -Real.sin θ + Real.sin θ * Real.cos θ := by
    rw [inner_eq_sum]
    apply sum_split_pair01
    · rw [circleAt_apply_zero, tangentAt_apply, if_pos rfl]
    · rw [circleAt_apply_one, tangentAt_apply,
        if_neg (Fin.zero_ne_one (n := m + 1)).symm, if_pos rfl]
    · intro j h0 h1
      rw [circleAt_apply_other θ h0 h1, zero_mul]
  rw [h]
  ring

name: Submission.inner_eVert_tangentAt
statement: lemma inner_eVert_tangentAt (θ : ℝ) : ⟪eVert (m := m), tangentAt θ⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [eVert, inner_coordVec_left, tangentAt_apply, if_neg lastA_ne_zero,
    if_neg lastA_ne_one]

name: Submission.inner_nuVec_nuVec
statement:
theorem inner_nuVec_nuVec (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (i j : Fin (m + 2)) :
    ⟪nuVec (m := m) k θ i, nuVec k θ j⟫ = if i = j then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hC := inner_circleAt_self (m := m) θ
  have hV := inner_eVert_self (m := m)
  have hCV := inner_circleAt_eVert (m := m) θ
  have hVC : ⟪eVert (m := m), circleAt θ⟫ = 0 := by
    rw [real_inner_comm]; exact hCV
  have expand : ∀ a b c d : ℝ,
      ⟪a • circleAt (m := m) θ + b • eVert, c • circleAt θ + d • eVert⟫
        = a * c + b * d := by
    intro a b c d
    rw [inner_add_left, inner_add_right, inner_add_right,
      real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
      real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right,
      real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_smul_right, hC, hV, hCV, hVC]
    ring
  have expandMixL : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (s : Fin (m + 3)), s ≠ 0 → s ≠ 1
      → s ≠ Fin.last (m + 2)
      → ⟪a • circleAt (m := m) θ + b • eVert, coordVec s⟫ = 0 := by
    intro a b s h0 h1 hlast
    rw [inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
      inner_coordVec_right, inner_coordVec_right,
      circleAt_apply_other θ h0 h1, eVert_apply_ne hlast]
    ring
  have expandMixR : ∀ (a b : ℝ) (s : Fin (m + 3)), s ≠ 0 → s ≠ 1
      → s ≠ Fin.last (m + 2)
      → ⟪coordVec s, a • circleAt (m := m) θ + b • eVert⟫ = 0 := by
    intro a b s h0 h1 hlast
    rw [real_inner_comm]
    exact expandMixL a b s h0 h1 hlast
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst hi0
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst hj0
      rw [if_pos rfl, nuVec_zero, expand]
      linear_combination Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (k * θ)
    · by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 1)
      · subst hjl
        rw [if_neg (Ne.symm lastW_ne_zero), nuVec_zero, nuVec_last, expand]
        ring
      · obtain ⟨hs0, hs1, hsl⟩ := midSucc_ne hj0 hjl
        rw [if_neg (Ne.symm hj0), nuVec_zero, nuVec_mid k θ hj0 hjl,
          expandMixL _ _ _ hs0 hs1 hsl]
  · by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (m + 1)
    · subst hil
      by_cases hj0 : j = 0
      · subst hj0
        rw [if_neg lastW_ne_zero, nuVec_last, nuVec_zero, expand]
        ring
      · by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 1)
        · subst hjl
          rw [if_pos rfl, nuVec_last, expand]
          linear_combination Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (k * θ)
        · obtain ⟨hs0, hs1, hsl⟩ := midSucc_ne hj0 hjl
          rw [if_neg (fun hcon => hjl hcon.symm), nuVec_last,
            nuVec_mid k θ hj0 hjl, expandMixL _ _ _ hs0 hs1 hsl]
    · obtain ⟨hs0, hs1, hsl⟩ := midSucc_ne hi0 hil
      by_cases hj0 : j = 0
      · subst hj0
        rw [if_neg hi0, nuVec_mid k θ hi0 hil, nuVec_zero,
          expandMixR _ _ _ hs0 hs1 hsl]
      · by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 1)
        · subst hjl
          rw [if_neg hil, nuVec_mid k θ hi0 hil, nuVec_last,
            expandMixR _ _ _ hs0 hs1 hsl]
        · rw [nuVec_mid k θ hi0 hil, nuVec_mid k θ hj0 hjl, inner_coordVec_left,
            coordVec_apply]
          by_cases hij : i = j
          · subst hij
            rw [if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl]
          · rw [if_neg (fun hcon => hij (Fin.succ_injective _ hcon)), if_neg hij]

name: Submission.inner_nuVec_tangentAt
statement:
theorem inner_nuVec_tangentAt (k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    ⟪nuVec (m := m) k θ i, tangentAt θ⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst hi0
    rw [nuVec_zero, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
      inner_circleAt_tangentAt, inner_eVert_tangentAt]
    ring
  · by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (m + 1)
    · subst hil
      rw [nuVec_last, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,
        inner_circleAt_tangentAt, inner_eVert_tangentAt]
      ring
    · obtain ⟨hs0, hs1, _⟩ := midSucc_ne hi0 hil
      rw [nuVec_mid k θ hi0 hil, inner_coordVec_left, tangentAt_apply,
        if_neg hs0, if_neg hs1]

name: Submission.flow_mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore_of_far
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore]
  refine ⟨R.flow_mem_fiber (show x ∈ C.fiber from hfib) (-d), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hunit, htime]; ring
  · have hd : dist x (R.base.flow x (-d)) ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |d| := by
      have h := R.base.dist_flow_self_le x 0 (-d)
      simp only [R.base.flow_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg] at h
      exact h
    have htri := dist_triangle x (R.base.flow x (-d)) center
    linarith

name: Submission.far_of_flow_mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore] at hmem
  have hd : dist x (R.base.flow x (-d)) ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |d| := by
    have h := R.base.dist_flow_self_le x 0 (-d)
    simp only [R.base.flow_zero, zero_sub, abs_neg] at h
    exact h
  have htri := dist_triangle (R.base.flow x (-d)) x center
  rw [dist_comm (R.base.flow x (-d)) x] at htri
  linarith [hmem.2.2]

name: Submission.pinned_cut_radius_window
statement:
theorem pinned_cut_radius_window {r b : ℝ} (hb : b < r) :
    r + b < 2 * r
proof: := by linarith

name: Submission.exists_fullChart_param_of_mem_pinnedCore
proof:
:= by
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore] at hx
  exact hcover x hdist hx.1

name: Submission.chronologicalSaddleExterior_tcoord_flow
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleExterior_tcoord_flow {n : ℕ}
    {X₀ X₁ : FramedLevelSet n} {S₀ : FiberSign X₀} {S₁ : FiberSign X₁}
    {SC : SignedFramedLevelCobordism S₀ S₁}
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))
    (hfib : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x = 0)
    (htime : tcoord x = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) -
          D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 ∨
        tcoord x = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) +
          D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2)
    (hfar : (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 ≤
      dist x (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
    (d : ℝ)
    (hd : |d| ≤ (D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).safeTime) :
    tcoord ((D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.flow
        x d) = tcoord x + d
proof:
:= by
  have hmem : x ∈ D.chronologicalHalfExteriorSlabCore t ht := by
    refine ⟨⟨hfib, ?_⟩, hfar⟩
    show tcoord x ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after
    rcases htime with h | h
    · have hb := D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_bracket t ht
      rw [show tcoord x = D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht from h]
      exact ⟨hb.1.le, hb.2.le⟩
    · have hb := D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht
      rw [show tcoord x = D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht from h]
      exact ⟨hb.1.le, hb.2.le⟩
  exact (D.chronologicalHalfExteriorSlabTimeField t ht).tcoord_flow hmem hd

name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_bandFinal
statement:
theorem productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_bandFinal
    {a : ℕ} (KB : ProductionMorseSaddleBandFinalInputs a) :
    ProductionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies a
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y SX SY SC D t ht hpositive hindex
  have hcov : 0 < (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius_pos
  have hsafe : D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2 ≤
      (D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).safeTime := by
    rw [D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField_safeTime t ht]
    have h := D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime t ht
    rwa [abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)] at h
  have hcoverprop : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (a + 2 + 2)),
      dist v (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
        (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius →
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2),
        ‖u‖ < (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius ∧
          (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u = v :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).covers_fiber.choose_spec.2
  obtain ⟨hmergeCase, hsplitCase⟩ :=
    KB (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
      (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
      (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_regular t ht)
      (D.chronologicalAfterTime_regular t ht)
      (D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht)
      (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht) hsafe
      hcoverprop
      (fun u hu =>
        D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink_param_dist_lt_half_cover t ht hu)
      (by
        have h := D.chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_half_cover t ht
        rw [D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField_base t ht]
        exact h)
      (fun x hfib htime hfar d hd =>
        chronologicalSaddleExterior_tcoord_flow D t ht x hfib htime hfar d hd)
      (fun sig hsig => D.eventModel_covers_fiber_within_morseRadius t ht hsig)
      (D.chronologicalCriticalSlice_isolated t ht)
  have hdim : 3 ≤ a + 2 + 1 := by omega
  have hcircle := productionMorseSaddleChartCircleFrameClassOne a
    (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  constructor
  · intro Htop
    obtain ⟨Bd, ⟨W⟩⟩ := hmergeCase Htop.negative_ne Htop.positive_eq
    obtain ⟨H, hreg, hHclosed⟩ :=
      exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartWindingLoop
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) W
    have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) Bd.marking H
      hreg hHclosed
    exact ⟨orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim Bd.marking
      (Bd.marking.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
        (hF.trans hcircle))⟩
  · intro Htop
    obtain ⟨Bd, ⟨W⟩⟩ := hsplitCase Htop.positive_ne Htop.negative_eq
    obtain ⟨H, hreg, hHclosed⟩ :=
      exists_regularHomotopy_of_fullChartWindingLoop
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) W
    have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) Bd.marking H
      hreg hHclosed
    exact ⟨orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim Bd.marking
      (Bd.marking.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
        (hF.trans hcircle))⟩

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_mergeHitBand_of_endCapture
statement:
theorem exists_mergeHitBand_of_endCapture
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hflowlt : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 < eps / 2)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord center + s ^ 2 → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (hcap : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) center →
      spacePart (R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s)
          (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex p.2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hne : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg ≠
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg)
    (heq : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos =
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos) :
    ∃ B : SaddleChartHitBand M ρ eps (-(s ^ 2)) (s ^ 2) R hregneg hregpos
        Vneg Vpos
        (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg)
        (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg)
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos),
      ∃ iloc jloc r₁ r₂ : Fin 4,
        Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) =
          (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange iloc ∧
        Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) =
          (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange jloc ∧
        iloc ≠ jloc ∧ r₁ ≠ r₂ ∧
        r₁ ≠ iloc ∧ r₁ ≠ jloc ∧ r₂ ≠ iloc ∧ r₂ ≠ jloc ∧
        (∀ q : I, (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad hregpos Vpos).curve (Set.Icc.convexComb B.cut₀ B.cut₁ q) ∈
          (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange r₁) ∧
        (∀ q : I, (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad hregpos Vpos).curve (Set.Icc.convexComb B.cut₂ B.cut₃ q) ∈
          (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange r₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hρM : ρ < M.radius := hρrad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hbound : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) := R.base.bound.coe_nonneg
  have habs : |s ^ 2| = s ^ 2 := abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg s)
  have habsn : |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| = s ^ 2 := by rw [abs_neg, habs]
  obtain ⟨iloc, jloc, hijloc, hiloc, hjloc, hother⟩ :=
    T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbit_exists_uniformExteriorCuts hindex ρ s hρ hb hs
      hρrad hregpos Vpos heq
  
  have hcutFib : ∀ (r : Fin 4) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
      y ∈ (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange r →
      C.G (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) = 0 := by
    intro r y hy
    rw [← (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregpos Vpos heq).range_cyclicCutPath r] at hy
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w
  have hcutFar : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ iloc → r ≠ jloc →
      ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)),
      y ∈ (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange r →
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) center := by
    intro r hri hrj y hy
    have h : eps ≤ dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) center := by
      refine le_dist_center_of_saddleChart_avoid hindex hρM hcover
        (hcutFib r y hy) (by rw [tcoord_spaceTime]) ?_
      intro u hquad hnorm hEq
      rw [spacePart_spaceTime] at hEq
      exact hother r hri hrj u hquad hnorm (hEq ▸ hy)
    linarith
  
  have hmarkAmb : ∀ l : Fin 4,
      cobSpaceTime ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs
          hρrad hregpos Vpos heq).point l) (tcoord center + s ^ 2) =
        M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s := by
    intro l
    have hpt : (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos heq).point l =
        spacePart (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s) := rfl
    have htX : tcoord (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s) =
        tcoord center + s ^ 2 :=
      M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hρ hs hρM
    rw [hpt, ← htX, spaceTime_spacePart]
  
  have hsrcMem : ∀ r : Fin 4,
      (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).point
        ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r) ∈
      (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange r := by
    intro r
    rw [← (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregpos Vpos heq).range_cyclicCutPath r]
    exact ⟨0, ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutPath r).source⟩
  have htgtMem : ∀ r : Fin 4,
      (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).point
        ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutTargetLabel r) ∈
      (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange r := by
    intro r
    rw [← (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregpos Vpos heq).range_cyclicCutPath r]
    exact ⟨1, ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutPath r).target⟩
  
  have hlabelOrbit : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ iloc → r ≠ jloc → ∀ l : Fin 4,
      (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos heq).point l ∈
        (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange r →
      spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ
          hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq).point l) (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
        (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg Vneg :
          Vneg.OrbitIndex) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro r hri hrj l hl
    have hfar := hcutFar r hri hrj _ hl
    rw [hmarkAmb l] at hfar ⊢
    exact hcap (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l) hfar
  have hmemEq : ∀ {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
      {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}, x = y → y ∈ S → x ∈ S :=
    fun h hy => h ▸ hy
  have hlabelOrbit' : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ iloc → r ≠ jloc →
      ∀ (l : Fin 4) (e : SaddleBranch), (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 = e →
      (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos heq).point l ∈
        (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange r →
      spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ
          hs hρrad hregpos Vpos heq).point l) (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
        (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregneg
          Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro r hri hrj l e he hl
    subst he
    exact hlabelOrbit r hri hrj l hl
  
  have hlabelEq : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ iloc → r ≠ jloc →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
        ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).2 =
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
        ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).2 := by
    intro r hri hrj
    by_contra hlab
    have hO := orbitIndex_eq_of_slabFlowFamily
      (R := R) (eps := eps) (dbefore := -(s ^ 2)) (dafter := s ^ 2)
      (tbefore := tcoord center - s ^ 2)
      (tafter := tcoord center + s ^ 2)
      (hbefore := hregneg) (Vbefore := Vneg)
      ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutAmbientPath r).toContinuousMap
      (fun w => (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w)
      (fun w => by
        show tcoord (cobSpaceTime
          ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutPath r w)
          (tcoord center + s ^ 2)) = tcoord center + s ^ 2
        rw [tcoord_spaceTime])
      (fun w => by
        have h := hcutFar r hri hrj
          ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutPath r w)
          (by
            rw [← (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs
              hρrad hregpos Vpos heq).range_cyclicCutPath r]
            exact ⟨w, rfl⟩)
        rw [habs]
        exact h)
      hunit (by ring) rfl (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe)
      (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe)
      (O := T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
          ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg)
      (O' := T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
          ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg)
      (w := 0) (w' := 1)
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)))
          ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutAmbientPath r).source)
        (hlabelOrbit r hri hrj _ (hsrcMem r)))
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)))
          ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutAmbientPath r).target)
        (hlabelOrbit r hri hrj _ (htgtMem r)))
    apply hne
    rcases hp : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
      ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).2 with _ | _ <;>
      rcases hq : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
        ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).2 with _ | _ <;>
      rw [hp, hq] at hO hlab
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
    · exact hO.symm
    · exact hO
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
  
  have hassemble : ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Fin 4), r₁ ≠ iloc → r₁ ≠ jloc → r₂ ≠ iloc →
      r₂ ≠ jloc →
      ∀ c₀ c₁ c₂ c₃ : I, c₀ ≠ c₁ → ¬(c₀ = 0 ∧ c₁ = 1) → ¬(c₀ = 1 ∧ c₁ = 0) →
      c₂ ≠ c₃ → ¬(c₂ = 0 ∧ c₃ = 1) → ¬(c₂ = 1 ∧ c₃ = 0) →
      (∀ q : I, (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
          hρrad hregpos Vpos).curve (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q) ∈
        (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange r₁) →
      (∀ q : I, (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
          hρrad hregpos Vpos).curve (Set.Icc.convexComb c₂ c₃ q) ∈
        (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutRange r₂) →
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos).curve c₀ =
        (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).point
          ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r₁) →
      (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos).curve c₂ =
        (T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).point
          ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r₂) →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
        ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r₁)).2 =
          SaddleBranch.negative →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
        ((T.saddlePositiveCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r₂)).2 =
          SaddleBranch.positive →

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.ambientAffineScale_pos
statement:
lemma ambientAffineScale_pos {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c) (s : ℝ) :
    0 < ambientAffineScale c s
proof:
:=
  slideScale_pos hc (normRamp_nonneg s) (normRamp_le_one s)

statement:
@[simp] theorem ambientAffineScale_zero (c : ℝ) :
    ambientAffineScale c 0 = 1
proof:

  rw [ambientAffineScale, normRamp_of_le_quarter (by norm_num), slideScale_zero]
