name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_rebasedMergeBand
statement:
theorem exists_rebasedMergeBand
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hflowlt : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 < eps / 2)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord center + s ^ 2 → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (hcap : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s) center →
      spacePart (R.base.flow (M.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2 ρ s)
          (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
        ((T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex p.2 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hne : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg ≠
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg)
    (heq : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos =
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos) :
    ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
      ∃ F : SaddleFlowBandMarking R hregneg hregpos Vneg Vpos
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg)
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂ ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg)
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos),
        T.RebasedMergeBandProvenance hindex hρ hs hρrad hregneg hregpos
          Vneg Vpos R F
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, h1, h2, h3, -, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11⟩ :=
    T.exists_rebasedMergeBandMarking hindex hρ hb hs hρrad hregneg hregpos
      Vneg Vpos R hsafe hflowlt hcover hunit hcap hne heq
  exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, h1, h2, h3, h5, h6, h7, h8, h9, h10, h11⟩

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_rebasedSplitBand

name: Submission.TamedField.mem_orbit_of_preconnected
statement:
theorem mem_orbit_of_preconnected (V : TamedField X) {A : Type*}
    [TopologicalSpace A] [PreconnectedSpace A]
    {γ : A → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hcont : Continuous γ)
    (hmem : ∀ a, γ a ∈ X.fiber) (a b : A) : γ b ∈ V.orbit (γ a)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  set S : Set A := {c | γ c ∈ V.orbit (γ a)} with hS
  have hopen : IsOpen S := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hsub⟩ := V.orbit_isOpen_in_fiber (hmem a) hc
    have hball : γ ⁻¹' (Metric.ball (γ c) r) ∈ nhds c :=
      hcont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hr)
    filter_upwards [hball] with d hd
    exact hsub ⟨hmem d, hd⟩
  have hclosed : IsOpen Sᶜ := by
    rw [isOpen_iff_mem_nhds]
    intro c hc
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hsub⟩ :=
      V.orbit_isOpen_in_fiber (hmem c) (V.mem_orbit_self (γ c))
    have hball : γ ⁻¹' (Metric.ball (γ c) r) ∈ nhds c :=
      hcont.continuousAt.preimage_mem_nhds (Metric.ball_mem_nhds _ hr)
    filter_upwards [hball] with d hd
    intro hdS
    apply hc
    have hd' : γ d ∈ V.orbit (γ c) := hsub ⟨hmem d, hd⟩
    have h1 : V.orbit (γ d) = V.orbit (γ c) := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hd'
    have h2 : V.orbit (γ d) = V.orbit (γ a) := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hdS
    show γ c ∈ V.orbit (γ a)
    rw [← h2, h1]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self _
  have hclopen : IsClopen S := ⟨isOpen_compl_iff.mp hclosed, hopen⟩
  have ha : a ∈ S := V.mem_orbit_self (γ a)
  rcases isClopen_iff.mp hclopen with h | h
  · rw [h] at ha
    simp at ha
  · have hb : b ∈ S := h ▸ Set.mem_univ b
    exact hb

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitPoint_mem_orbit_of_preconnected
proof:
:= by
  have hab : γ b ∈ V.orbit (γ a) :=
    V.mem_orbit_of_preconnected hcont hmem a b
  rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O] at hhit
  have h1 : V.orbit (γ b) = V.orbit (V.orbitPoint O) := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hhit
  have h2 : V.orbit (γ b) = V.orbit (γ a) := V.orbit_eq_of_mem hab
  rw [← h2, h1]
  exact V.mem_orbit_self _

name: Submission.flow_sub_eq_flow_flow
statement:
theorem flow_sub_eq_flow_flow (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)))
    (dbefore dafter : ℝ) :
    R.base.flow x (dbefore - dafter) =
      R.base.flow (R.base.flow x (-dafter)) dbefore
proof:
:= by
  rw [congrFun (R.base.flow_shift x (-dafter)) dbefore]
  congr 1
  ring

name: Submission.tcoord_flow_sub_of_core
statement:
theorem tcoord_flow_sub_of_core {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))}
    {dbefore dafter tbefore : ℝ}
    (hcore : R.base.flow x (-dafter) ∈
      criticalSliceExteriorCore C center (tcoord center) r)
    (hdbefore : |dbefore| ≤ R.safeTime)
    (htbefore : tbefore = tcoord center + dbefore) :
    tcoord (R.base.flow x (dbefore - dafter)) = tbefore
proof:
:= by
  rw [flow_sub_eq_flow_flow x dbefore dafter, R.tcoord_flow hcore hdbefore]
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore] at hcore
  rw [hcore.2.1, htbefore]

name: Submission.SaddleChartAvoidBand.far_of_avoid_aux
statement:
theorem far_of_avoid_aux (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (hρM : ρ < M.radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hflow : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * |dafter| < eps / 2)
    (htafter : tafter = tcoord center + dafter) {c₀ c₁ : I}
    (havoid : ∀ (q : I) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = dafter → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ≠
        (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).curve
          (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q)) (q : I) :
    eps / 2 + (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |dafter| ≤
      dist ((Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).sliceAmbientSubarc
        c₀ c₁ q) center
proof:
:= by
  set x := (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).sliceAmbientSubarc
    c₀ c₁ q with hx
  have hfib : C.G x = 0 :=
    sliceAmbientSubarc_mem_fiber
      (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat) c₀ c₁ q
  have htime : tcoord x = tcoord center + dafter := by
    rw [hx, SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply, tcoord_spaceTime,
      htafter]
  have hspace : spacePart x =
      (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).curve
        (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q) := by
    rw [hx, SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply,
      spacePart_spaceTime]
  have hdist : eps ≤ dist x center := by
    refine le_dist_center_of_saddleChart_avoid hindex hρM hcover hfib htime ?_
    intro u hquad hnorm
    rw [hspace]
    exact havoid q u hquad hnorm
  linarith

name: Submission.SaddleChartAvoidBand.tcoord_transported_aux
statement:
theorem tcoord_transported_aux (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (hρM : ρ < M.radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hflow : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * |dafter| < eps / 2)
    (htbefore : tbefore = tcoord center + dbefore)
    (htafter : tafter = tcoord center + dafter)
    (hdbefore : |dbefore| ≤ R.safeTime) (hdafter : |dafter| ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tafter → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    {c₀ c₁ : I}
    (havoid : ∀ (q : I) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = dafter → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ≠
        (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).curve
          (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q)) (q : I) :
    tcoord (R.base.flow
      ((Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).sliceAmbientSubarc
        c₀ c₁ q) (dbefore - dafter)) = tbefore
proof:
:= by
  set x := (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).sliceAmbientSubarc
    c₀ c₁ q with hx
  have hfib : C.G x = 0 :=
    sliceAmbientSubarc_mem_fiber
      (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat) c₀ c₁ q
  have htime : tcoord x = tcoord center + dafter := by
    rw [hx, SimpleClosedOrbitParam.sliceAmbientSubarc_apply, tcoord_spaceTime,
      htafter]
  have hfar : eps / 2 + (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |dafter| ≤ dist x center :=
    far_of_avoid_aux hindex hρM hcover hflow htafter havoid q
  have hbnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |dafter| :=
    mul_nonneg R.base.bound.coe_nonneg (abs_nonneg _)
  have hhalf : eps / 2 ≤ dist x center := by linarith
  have hneg : |(-dafter : ℝ)| ≤ R.safeTime := by rwa [abs_neg]
  have hunit' : tcoord (R.base.flow x (-dafter)) = tcoord x + -dafter :=
    hunit x hfib (by rw [htime, htafter]) hhalf (-dafter) hneg
  have hcore := flow_mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore_of_far R hfib htime hunit'
    hfar
  exact tcoord_flow_sub_of_core hcore hdbefore htbefore

name: Submission.SaddleChartAvoidBand.branch_of_hit
statement:
theorem branch_of_hit (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (hρM : ρ < M.radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hflow : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * |dafter| < eps / 2)
    (htbefore : tbefore = tcoord center + dbefore)
    (htafter : tafter = tcoord center + dafter)
    (hdbefore : |dbefore| ≤ R.safeTime) (hdafter : |dafter| ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tafter → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    {c₀ c₁ : I}
    (havoid : ∀ (q : I) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = dafter → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ≠
        (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).curve
          (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q))
    {O : Vbefore.OrbitIndex}
    (hhit : ∃ q : I,
      transportedSubarc R (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat)
        c₀ c₁ (dbefore - dafter) q ∈
      (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) :
    Vbefore.orbitPoint O ∈ Vbefore.orbit
      (transportedSubarc R (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat)
        c₀ c₁ (dbefore - dafter) 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨q₁, hq₁⟩ := hhit
  have htime : ∀ q : I, tcoord (R.base.flow
      ((Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).sliceAmbientSubarc
        c₀ c₁ q) (dbefore - dafter)) = tbefore := fun q =>
    tcoord_transported_aux hindex hρM hcover hflow htbefore htafter hdbefore
      hdafter hunit havoid q
  have hmem : ∀ q : I,
      transportedSubarc R (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat)
        c₀ c₁ (dbefore - dafter) q ∈
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.toLevelCobordismData tbefore hbefore).fiber :=
    fun q => transportedSubarc_mem_fiber R
      (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat) c₀ c₁ (dbefore - dafter)
      hbefore q (htime q)
  exact Vbefore.orbitPoint_mem_orbit_of_preconnected
    (transportedSubarc R (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat)
      c₀ c₁ (dbefore - dafter)).continuous hmem hq₁

name: Submission.SaddleChartAvoidBand.eq_of_two_hits
statement:
theorem eq_of_two_hits (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (hρM : ρ < M.radius)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hflow : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * |dafter| < eps / 2)
    (htbefore : tbefore = tcoord center + dbefore)
    (htafter : tafter = tcoord center + dafter)
    (hdbefore : |dbefore| ≤ R.safeTime) (hdafter : |dafter| ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tafter → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    {c₀ c₁ : I}
    (havoid : ∀ (q : I) (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)),
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = dafter → ‖u‖ < ρ →
      spacePart (M.param u) ≠
        (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).curve
          (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q))
    {O O' : Vbefore.OrbitIndex} {q q' : I}
    (hhit : transportedSubarc R (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat)
      c₀ c₁ (dbefore - dafter) q ∈
      (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hhit' : transportedSubarc R (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat)
      c₀ c₁ (dbefore - dafter) q' ∈
      (O' : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) : O = O'
proof:
:= by
  have htime : ∀ p : I, tcoord (R.base.flow
      ((Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat).sliceAmbientSubarc
        c₀ c₁ p) (dbefore - dafter)) = tbefore := fun p =>
    tcoord_transported_aux hindex hρM hcover hflow htbefore htafter hdbefore
      hdafter hunit havoid p
  have hmem : ∀ p : I,
      transportedSubarc R (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat)
        c₀ c₁ (dbefore - dafter) p ∈
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.toLevelCobordismData tbefore hbefore).fiber :=
    fun p => transportedSubarc_mem_fiber R
      (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat) c₀ c₁ (dbefore - dafter)
      hbefore p (htime p)
  have hsame : transportedSubarc R
      (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat) c₀ c₁ (dbefore - dafter) q'
      ∈ Vbefore.orbit (transportedSubarc R
        (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat) c₀ c₁
        (dbefore - dafter) q) :=
    Vbefore.mem_orbit_of_preconnected
      (transportedSubarc R (Vafter.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam Ohat)
        c₀ c₁ (dbefore - dafter)).continuous hmem q q'
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Vbefore.orbitPoint_orbit O] at hhit
  rw [Vbefore.orbitPoint_orbit O'] at hhit'
  rw [Vbefore.orbitPoint_orbit O, Vbefore.orbitPoint_orbit O',
    ← Vbefore.orbit_eq_of_mem hhit, ← Vbefore.orbit_eq_of_mem hhit',
    Vbefore.orbit_eq_of_mem hsame]

name: Submission.GlobalIFTSurfaceChartContract.exists_ne_zero_timeCoefficient_eq_zero
statement:
theorem exists_ne_zero_timeCoefficient_eq_zero
    (P : GlobalIFTSurfaceChartContract (n := n) C) :
    ∃ q : E₂, q ≠ 0 ∧ P.timeCoefficient q = 0
proof:
:= by
  let a : ℝ := P.timeCoefficient auditE0
  let b : ℝ := P.timeCoefficient auditE1
  by_cases ha : a = 0
  · exact ⟨auditE0, by
      intro h
      have h0 := congrArg (fun q : E₂ => q 0) h
      simp at h0, ha⟩
  · let q : E₂ := b • auditE0 - a • auditE1
    refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro h
      have h1 := congrArg (fun q : E₂ => q 1) h
      simp [q] at h1
      exact ha h1
    · simp [q, a, b]
      ring

name: Submission.GlobalIFTSurfaceChartContract.false_of_global_chart
statement:
theorem false_of_global_chart
    (P : GlobalIFTSurfaceChartContract (n := n) C) : False
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨R, hR⟩ := C.spatial_bounded
  have hR_nonneg : 0 ≤ R := by
    exact le_trans (norm_nonneg (spacePart (P.param 0)))
      (hR (P.param 0) (P.param_fiber 0))
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqtime⟩ := P.exists_ne_zero_timeCoefficient_eq_zero
  let K : ℝ := ‖P.liftCovector q‖ * (R + ‖spacePart P.center‖)
  have hK_nonneg : 0 ≤ K := by
    dsimp [K]
    positivity
  have hqnorm : ‖q‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hq
  have hqnorm_sq : ‖q‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 hqnorm
  let r : ℝ := (K + 1) / ‖q‖ ^ 2
  let u : E₂ := r • q
  let w : E' := P.param u - P.center
  have hw_decomp : w =
      spaceInclL (spacePart w) + tcoord w • timeVec := by
    rw [← spaceTime_eq, spaceTime_spacePart]
  have hw_value : P.liftCovector q w =
      P.liftCovector q (spaceInclL (spacePart w)) := by
    calc
      P.liftCovector q w = P.liftCovector q
          (spaceInclL (spacePart w) + tcoord w • timeVec) :=
        congrArg (P.liftCovector q) hw_decomp
      _ = P.liftCovector q (spaceInclL (spacePart w)) := by
        rw [map_add, map_smul]
        change P.liftCovector q (spaceInclL (spacePart w)) +
          tcoord w * P.timeCoefficient q = _
        rw [hqtime, mul_zero, add_zero]
  have hw_spatial : ‖spacePart w‖ ≤ R + ‖spacePart P.center‖ := by
    have hp_bound : ‖spacePart (P.param u)‖ ≤ R := by
      simpa [spacePart, initCLM, initLM] using
        hR (P.param u) (P.param_fiber u)
    calc
      ‖spacePart w‖ = ‖spacePart (P.param u) - spacePart P.center‖ := rfl
      _ ≤ ‖spacePart (P.param u)‖ + ‖spacePart P.center‖ := norm_sub_le _ _
      _ ≤ R + ‖spacePart P.center‖ := by
        simpa [add_comm] using
          add_le_add_right hp_bound ‖spacePart P.center‖
  have hw_bound : ‖P.liftCovector q w‖ ≤ K := by
    rw [hw_value]
    calc
      ‖P.liftCovector q (spaceInclL (spacePart w))‖ ≤
          ‖P.liftCovector q‖ * ‖spaceInclL (spacePart w)‖ :=
        (P.liftCovector q).le_opNorm _
      _ = ‖P.liftCovector q‖ * ‖spacePart w‖ := by
        rw [norm_spaceInclL]
      _ ≤ ‖P.liftCovector q‖ * (R + ‖spacePart P.center‖) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_spatial (norm_nonneg _)
      _ = K := rfl
  have hrecover : P.liftCovector q w = r * ‖q‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [P.lift_param]
    change inner ℝ q (r • q) = r * ‖q‖ ^ 2
    rw [real_inner_smul_right, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have hr : r * ‖q‖ ^ 2 = K + 1 := by
    dsimp [r]
    exact div_mul_cancel₀ (K + 1) hqnorm_sq
  have hlarge : ‖P.liftCovector q w‖ = K + 1 := by
    rw [hrecover, hr, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg]
    linarith
  rw [hlarge] at hw_bound
  linarith

proof:

proof:

name: Submission.sard
statement:
theorem sard {U : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p))} (hU : IsOpen U)
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)}
    (hf : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ f U) :
    volume (f '' {x ∈ U | ¬Function.Surjective (fderivWithin ℝ f U x)}) = 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have hset : {x ∈ U | ¬Function.Surjective (fderivWithin ℝ f U x)}
      = {x ∈ U | ¬Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ f x)} := by
    ext x
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨hxU, hx⟩
      exact ⟨hxU, by rwa [fderivWithin_of_isOpen hU hxU] at hx⟩
    · rintro ⟨hxU, hx⟩
      exact ⟨hxU, by rwa [fderivWithin_of_isOpen hU hxU]⟩
  rw [hset]
  
  set eP := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin p) ℝ with hePdef
  set eQ := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin q) ℝ with heQdef
  set F : (Fin p → ℝ) → Fin q → ℝ := fun x => eQ (f (eP.symm x)) with hFdef
  set U' : Set (Fin p → ℝ) := ⇑eP.symm ⁻¹' U with hU'def
  have hU'open : IsOpen U' := hU.preimage eP.symm.continuous
  have hFsm : ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ F U' :=
    eQ.contDiff.comp_contDiffOn
      (hf.comp eP.symm.contDiff.contDiffOn fun x hx => hx)
  have hmain := sard_pi p q U' F hU'open hFsm
  refine euclidean_null_of_pi_null ?_ hmain
  rintro _ ⟨x, ⟨hxU, hxcrit⟩, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨eP x, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
  · show eP.symm (eP x) ∈ U
    rw [eP.symm_apply_apply]
    exact hxU
  · 
    intro hsurj
    apply hxcrit
    have hfdiff : DifferentiableAt ℝ f x :=
      (hf.contDiffAt (hU.mem_nhds hxU)).differentiableAt infty_ne_zero
    have hFd : HasFDerivAt F
        ((eQ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q) →L[ℝ] (Fin q → ℝ)).comp
          ((fderiv ℝ f x).comp
            ((eP.symm : (Fin p → ℝ) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p))))) (eP x) := by
      have h1 : HasFDerivAt (⇑eP.symm)
          ((eP.symm : (Fin p → ℝ) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p))) (eP x) :=
        eP.symm.hasFDerivAt
      have h2 : HasFDerivAt f (fderiv ℝ f x) (eP.symm (eP x)) := by
        rw [eP.symm_apply_apply]
        exact hfdiff.hasFDerivAt
      exact (eQ.hasFDerivAt).comp _ (h2.comp _ h1)
    rw [hFd.fderiv] at hsurj
    intro y
    obtain ⟨ξ, hξ⟩ := hsurj (eQ y)
    refine ⟨eP.symm ξ, ?_⟩
    exact eQ.injective hξ
  · show eQ (f (eP.symm (eP x))) = WithLp.ofLp (f x)
    rw [eP.symm_apply_apply]
    rfl

name: Submission.sard_global
proof:
:= by
  have h := sard isOpen_univ hf.contDiffOn
  simpa [fderivWithin_univ, Set.sep_univ] using h

name: Submission.sard_of_lt
proof:
:= by
  set eP := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin p) ℝ with hePdef
  set eQ := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin q) ℝ with heQdef
  set F : (Fin p → ℝ) → Fin q → ℝ := fun x => eQ (f (eP.symm x)) with hFdef
  have hFsm : ContDiff ℝ 1 F := eQ.contDiff.comp (hf.comp eP.symm.contDiff)
  have hdim : dimH (Set.range F) ≤ (p : ENNReal) := by
    have h1 := hFsm.dimH_range_le
    rwa [Module.finrank_fin_fun] at h1
  have hlt : dimH (Set.range F) < ((q : NNReal) : ENNReal) := by
    refine lt_of_le_of_lt hdim ?_
    exact_mod_cast hpq
  have hH : μH[(q : NNReal)] (Set.range F) = 0 := hausdorffMeasure_of_dimH_lt hlt
  have hvol : volume (Set.range F) = 0 := by
    have h2 : (μH[Fintype.card (Fin q)] : Measure (Fin q → ℝ)) = volume :=
      hausdorffMeasure_pi_real
    rw [← h2]
    simpa using hH
  refine euclidean_null_of_pi_null ?_ hvol
  rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨eP x, ?_⟩
  show eQ (f (eP.symm (eP x))) = WithLp.ofLp (f x)
  rw [eP.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

name: Submission.sard_dense_regular_values_on
proof:
:= by
  rw [dense_iff_inter_open]
  intro O hO hOne
  by_contra hemp
  rw [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hemp
  have hsub : O ⊆ f '' {x | x ∈ U ∧
      ¬Function.Surjective (fderivWithin ℝ f U x)} := by
    intro y hyO
    have hyreg : ¬IsRegularValueOn f U y := by
      intro hreg
      have : y ∈ O ∩ {y | IsRegularValueOn f U y} := ⟨hyO, hreg⟩
      rw [hemp] at this
      exact this
    rw [IsRegularValueOn] at hyreg
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := not_forall.mp hyreg
    obtain ⟨hxU, hx⟩ := Classical.not_imp.mp hx
    obtain ⟨hfx, hnsurj⟩ := Classical.not_imp.mp hx
    exact ⟨x, ⟨hxU, hnsurj⟩, hfx⟩
  have hpos : 0 < volume O := hO.measure_pos volume hOne
  exact absurd (measure_mono_null hsub (sard hU hf)) hpos.ne'

name: Submission.sard_dense_regular_values
proof:
:= by
  rw [dense_iff_inter_open]
  intro O hO hOne
  by_contra hemp
  rw [not_nonempty_iff_eq_empty] at hemp
  have hsub : O ⊆ f '' {x | ¬Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ f x)} := by
    intro y hyO
    have hyreg : ¬IsRegularValue f y := by
      intro hreg
      have : y ∈ O ∩ {y | IsRegularValue f y} := ⟨hyO, hreg⟩
      rw [hemp] at this
      exact this
    rw [IsRegularValue] at hyreg
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := not_forall.1 hyreg
    obtain ⟨hfx, hnsurj⟩ := Classical.not_imp.1 hx
    exact ⟨x, hnsurj, hfx⟩
  have hpos : 0 < volume O := hO.measure_pos volume hOne
  exact absurd (measure_mono_null hsub (sard_global hf)) hpos.ne'

name: Submission.sard_exists_regular_value_in_ball
statement:
theorem sard_exists_regular_value_in_ball
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin p) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin q)}

    ∃ y ∈ Metric.ball z r, IsRegularValue f y
proof:

  obtain ⟨y, hy1, hy2⟩ := (sard_dense_regular_values hf).exists_mem_open
    Metric.isOpen_ball (Metric.nonempty_ball.2 hr)

name: Submission.sard_rank_deficient
statement:
theorem sard_rank_deficient {m n : ℕ}
    {f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    volume (f '' {x | Module.finrank ℝ
        (LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℝ f x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) →ₗ[ℝ]
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) < m
      ∧ Module.finrank ℝ
        (LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℝ f x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) →ₗ[ℝ]
          EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) < n}) = 0
proof:
:= by
  refine measure_mono_null (Set.image_mono ?_) (sard_global hf)
  intro x hx
  simp only [mem_setOf_eq] at hx
  intro hsurj
  have h1 : LinearMap.range ((fderiv ℝ f x) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) →ₗ[ℝ]
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) = ⊤ :=
    LinearMap.range_eq_top.2 (by exact hsurj)
  rw [h1] at hx
  have h2 : Module.finrank ℝ
      (⊤ : Submodule ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) = n := by
    rw [finrank_top]
    exact finrank_euclideanSpace_fin
  rw [h2] at hx
  exact absurd hx.2 (lt_irrefl n)

name: Submission.regular_value_ae
statement:
theorem regular_value_ae {m : ℕ} (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) → ℝ)
    (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) :
    ∀ᵐ c ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ x, f x = c → fderiv ℝ f x ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [MeasureTheory.ae_iff]
  set e1 := EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin 1) ℝ with he1def
  set L1 : ℝ →L[ℝ] (Fin 1 → ℝ) :=
    ContinuousLinearMap.pi fun _ => ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ with hL1def
  set F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) :=
    fun x => e1.symm (L1 (f x)) with hFdef
  have hFsm : ContDiff ℝ ∞ F :=
    e1.symm.contDiff.comp (L1.contDiff.comp hf)
  have hnull := sard_global hFsm
  
  set j : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1) :=
    fun c => WithLp.toLp 2 ((MeasurableEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) ℝ).symm c)
    with hjdef
  have hjmp : MeasurePreserving j volume volume := by
    have h1 : MeasurePreserving
        (⇑(MeasurableEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) ℝ).symm)
        (volume : Measure ℝ) (volume : Measure (Fin 1 → ℝ)) :=
      (volume_preserving_funUnique (Fin 1) ℝ).symm
    have h2 : MeasurePreserving (WithLp.toLp (V := Fin 1 → ℝ) 2)
        (volume : Measure (Fin 1 → ℝ))
        (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))) :=
      PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp (Fin 1)
    exact h2.comp h1
  
  have hsub : {c : ℝ | ¬∀ x, f x = c → fderiv ℝ f x ≠ 0}
      ⊆ j ⁻¹' (F '' {x | ¬Function.Surjective (fderiv ℝ F x)}) := by
    intro c hc
    simp only [mem_setOf_eq, not_forall, not_not] at hc
    obtain ⟨x, hfx, hdx⟩ := hc
    have hFx : F x = j c := by
      have h3 : L1 (f x) = (MeasurableEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) ℝ).symm c := by
        funext i
        show f x = c
        exact hfx
      show e1.symm (L1 (f x))
          = WithLp.toLp 2 ((MeasurableEquiv.funUnique (Fin 1) ℝ).symm c)
      rw [h3]
      rfl
    refine ⟨x, ?_, hFx⟩
    
    have hfd : HasFDerivAt f (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) →L[ℝ] ℝ) x := by
      have h4 := (hf.differentiable infty_ne_zero x).hasFDerivAt
      rwa [hdx] at h4
    have hFd : HasFDerivAt F
        (((e1.symm : (Fin 1 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1))).comp
          (L1.comp (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m) →L[ℝ] ℝ))) x :=
      e1.symm.hasFDerivAt.comp x (L1.hasFDerivAt.comp x hfd)
    have hFd0 : fderiv ℝ F x = 0 := by
      rw [hFd.fderiv, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_zero,
        ContinuousLinearMap.comp_zero]
    intro hsurj
    rw [hFd0] at hsurj
    exact not_surjective_zero (E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
      (F := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 1)) hsurj
  refine measure_mono_null hsub ?_
  exact hjmp.quasiMeasurePreserving.preimage_null hnull

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingSupport.exists_smoothCutoffData
statement:
theorem exists_smoothCutoffData (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    Nonempty (SmoothCutoffData V h2 O)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hcore, hopen, hclosure⟩ :=
    exists_support_thickening V h2 O
  obtain ⟨χ, hχsmooth, hχrange, hχsupport, hχone⟩ :=
    exists_contMDiff_support_eq_eq_one_iff
      (modelWithCornersSelf ℝ E) (n := ⊤) hopen
      (isCompact_activeSet V h2 O).isClosed hcore
  refine ⟨{
    radius := δ
    radius_pos := hδ
    cutoff := χ
    contDiff_cutoff := contMDiff_iff_contDiff.mp hχsmooth
    range_cutoff := hχrange
    support_cutoff := hχsupport
    one_iff_active := hχone
    tsupport_disjoint_obstacle := ?_
  }⟩
  rw [tsupport, hχsupport]
  exact hclosure

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingSupport.SmoothCutoffData.cutoff_eq_one_iff

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingSupport.SmoothCutoffData.isCompact_tsupport

    (Metric.closure_thickening_subset_cthickening C.radius _)

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingSupport.SmoothCutoffData.eventuallyEq_zero_of_mem_obstacle
statement:
theorem eventuallyEq_zero_of_mem_obstacle
    (C : SmoothCutoffData V h2 O) {x : E}

    C.cutoff =ᶠ[𝓝 x] 0
proof:

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingSupport.SmoothCutoffData.eventuallyEq_zero_on_other_source

name: Submission.OrbitUnknottingSupport.SmoothCutoffData.eventuallyEq_zero_on_other_target

name: Submission.mem_stereographic_source
statement:
theorem mem_stereographic_source {y z : UnitSphere E} (h : z ≠ y) :
    z ∈ (stereographic (UnitSphere.norm_coe y)).source
proof:
:= by
  rw [stereographic_source, Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff]
  exact fun hz => h (hz.trans (Subtype.ext rfl))

name: Submission.homotopic_const_of_misses
statement:
theorem homotopic_const_of_misses [Nonempty N] (p : Ω^ N (UnitSphere E) x)
    (y : UnitSphere E) (h : ∀ t, p t ≠ y) : GenLoop.Homotopic p GenLoop.const
proof:
:= by
  have hxy : x ≠ y := by
    have hb : (fun _ => 0 : I^N) ∈ Cube.boundary N :=
      ⟨Classical.arbitrary N, Or.inl rfl⟩
    have hpx : p.1 (fun _ => 0) = x := p.2 _ hb
    rw [← hpx]
    exact h _
  exact ⟨missHomotopy p y h hxy⟩

name: Submission.homotopy_class_eq_const_of_misses
statement:
theorem homotopy_class_eq_const_of_misses [Nonempty N] (p : Ω^ N (UnitSphere E) x)
    (y : UnitSphere E) (h : ∀ t, p t ≠ y) :
    (⟦p⟧ : HomotopyGroup N (UnitSphere E) x) = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧
proof:
:=
  Quotient.sound (homotopic_const_of_misses p y h)

name: Submission.homotopy_class_eq_one_of_misses
statement:
theorem homotopy_class_eq_one_of_misses [DecidableEq N] [Nonempty N]
    (p : Ω^ N (UnitSphere E) x) (y : UnitSphere E) (h : ∀ t, p t ≠ y) :
    ⟦p⟧ = (1 : HomotopyGroup N (UnitSphere E) x)
proof:
:= by
  rw [HomotopyGroup.one_def]
  exact homotopy_class_eq_const_of_misses p y h

name: Submission.pathLoop_closed
statement:
theorem pathLoop_closed {x : SOGroup m} (α : Path x x) :
    α.toContinuousMap 0 = α.toContinuousMap 1
proof:
:= by
  show α 0 = α 1
  rw [α.source, α.target]

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_congr
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H⟩ := h
  refine loopClassZ2_congr (pathLoop_closed α) (pathLoop_closed β)
    H.toHomotopy (fun s => ?_)
  show H (s, 0) = H (s, 1)
  rw [H.source, H.target]

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_refl
statement:
theorem pathLoopClassZ2_refl (x : SOGroup m) :
    pathLoopClassZ2 (Path.refl x) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold pathLoopClassZ2
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun (pathLoop_closed (Path.refl x)) rfl
    (by ext t; rfl :
      (Path.refl x).toContinuousMap = ContinuousMap.const I x)]
  exact loopClassZ2_const x

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_symm
statement:
theorem pathLoopClassZ2_symm {x : SOGroup m} (α : Path x x) :
    pathLoopClassZ2 α.symm = pathLoopClassZ2 α
proof:
:= by
  unfold pathLoopClassZ2
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun (pathLoop_closed α.symm)
    (reverseLoop_closed (pathLoop_closed α))
    (by ext t; rfl :
      α.symm.toContinuousMap = reverseLoop α.toContinuousMap)]
  exact loopClassZ2_reverse α.toContinuousMap (pathLoop_closed α)

name: Submission.basedClassZ2_trans
statement:
theorem basedClassZ2_trans (α β : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1) :
    basedClassZ2 (α.trans β) = basedClassZ2 α + basedClassZ2 β
proof:
:= by
  have h := pathMul_homotopic_trans β α
  calc
    basedClassZ2 (α.trans β) = basedClassZ2 (pathMul β α) :=
      (basedClassZ2_homotopic h).symm
    _ = basedClassZ2 β + basedClassZ2 α := basedClassZ2_mul β α
    _ = basedClassZ2 α + basedClassZ2 β := add_comm _ _

name: Submission.freeToBased_pathTrans
statement:
theorem freeToBased_pathTrans {x : SOGroup m} (α β : Path x x) :
    freeToBased (α.trans β).toContinuousMap
        (pathLoop_closed (α.trans β)) =
      (freeToBased α.toContinuousMap (pathLoop_closed α)).trans
        (freeToBased β.toContinuousMap (pathLoop_closed β))
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  show (α.trans β) t * ((α.trans β) 0)⁻¹ = _
  rw [(α.trans β).source, Path.trans_apply, Path.trans_apply]
  split_ifs with h
  · show α ⟨2 * (t : ℝ), _⟩ * x⁻¹ = α ⟨2 * (t : ℝ), _⟩ * (α 0)⁻¹
    rw [α.source]
  · show β ⟨2 * (t : ℝ) - 1, _⟩ * x⁻¹ =
      β ⟨2 * (t : ℝ) - 1, _⟩ * (β 0)⁻¹
    rw [β.source]

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_trans
statement:
theorem pathLoopClassZ2_trans {x : SOGroup m} (α β : Path x x) :
    pathLoopClassZ2 (α.trans β) =
      pathLoopClassZ2 α + pathLoopClassZ2 β
proof:
:= by
  unfold pathLoopClassZ2 loopClassZ2
  rw [freeToBased_pathTrans, basedClassZ2_trans]

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_freeToBased
statement:
theorem pathLoopClassZ2_freeToBased (γ : C(I, SOGroup m))
    (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) :
    pathLoopClassZ2 (freeToBased γ hγ) = loopClassZ2 γ hγ
proof:
:= by
  unfold pathLoopClassZ2
  rw [loopClassZ2_toContinuousMap]
  rfl

name: Submission.projIcc_unit_coe
statement:
private theorem projIcc_unit_coe {v : ℝ} (h0 : 0 ≤ v) (h1 : v ≤ 1) :
    ((Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one v : I) : ℝ) = v
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.coe_projIcc, min_eq_right h1, max_eq_right h0]

name: Submission.pathLoopClassZ2_conj
proof:
:= by
  classical
  let f : I × I → SOGroup m := fun q =>
    if (q.2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4 then
      c (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one
        ((q.1 : ℝ) + 4 * (q.2 : ℝ) * (1 - (q.1 : ℝ))))
    else if (q.2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 then
      α (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one (4 * (q.2 : ℝ) - 1))
    else
      c (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one
        ((q.1 : ℝ) + (2 - 2 * (q.2 : ℝ)) * (1 - (q.1 : ℝ))))
  have hcont1 : Continuous fun q : I × I => (q.1 : ℝ) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
  have hcont2 : Continuous fun q : I × I => (q.2 : ℝ) :=
    continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd
  have hcontc₁ : Continuous fun q : I × I =>
      c (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one
        ((q.1 : ℝ) + 4 * (q.2 : ℝ) * (1 - (q.1 : ℝ)))) :=
    c.continuous.comp (continuous_projIcc.comp
      (hcont1.add ((continuous_const.mul hcont2).mul
        (continuous_const.sub hcont1))))
  have hcontα : Continuous fun q : I × I =>
      α (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one (4 * (q.2 : ℝ) - 1)) :=
    α.continuous.comp (continuous_projIcc.comp
      ((continuous_const.mul hcont2).sub continuous_const))
  have hcontc₂ : Continuous fun q : I × I =>
      c (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one
        ((q.1 : ℝ) + (2 - 2 * (q.2 : ℝ)) * (1 - (q.1 : ℝ)))) :=
    c.continuous.comp (continuous_projIcc.comp
      (hcont1.add ((continuous_const.sub
        (continuous_const.mul hcont2)).mul
          (continuous_const.sub hcont1))))
  have hinner : Continuous fun q : I × I =>
      if (q.2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 then
        α (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one (4 * (q.2 : ℝ) - 1))
      else
        c (Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one
          ((q.1 : ℝ) + (2 - 2 * (q.2 : ℝ)) * (1 - (q.1 : ℝ)))) := by
    refine Continuous.if_le hcontα hcontc₂ hcont2 continuous_const ?_
    intro q hq
    have h1 : (4 * (q.2 : ℝ) - 1) = 1 := by rw [hq]; norm_num
    have h2 : ((q.1 : ℝ) + (2 - 2 * (q.2 : ℝ)) * (1 - (q.1 : ℝ))) = 1 := by
      rw [hq]; ring
    rw [h1, h2, Set.projIcc_right]
    show α 1 = c 1
    rw [α.target, c.target]
  have hf : Continuous f := by
    refine Continuous.if_le hcontc₁ hinner hcont2 continuous_const ?_
    intro q hq
    have h1 : ((q.1 : ℝ) + 4 * (q.2 : ℝ) * (1 - (q.1 : ℝ))) = 1 := by
      rw [hq]; ring
    have hle : (q.2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by rw [hq]; norm_num
    have h2 : (4 * (q.2 : ℝ) - 1) = 0 := by rw [hq]; norm_num
    rw [h1, if_pos hle, h2, Set.projIcc_right, Set.projIcc_left]
    show c 1 = α 0
    rw [α.source, c.target]
  have hzero : ∀ t : I,
      f (0, t) = ((c.trans α).trans c.symm).toContinuousMap t := by
    intro t
    show f (0, t) = ((c.trans α).trans c.symm) t
    have ht0 : (t : ℝ) ≥ 0 := t.2.1
    have ht1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 := t.2.2
    simp only [f]
    rw [Path.trans_apply]
    by_cases h4 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4
    · have hhalf : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := le_trans h4 (by norm_num)
      rw [if_pos h4, dif_pos hhalf, Path.trans_apply]
      have hhalf' : (2 * (t : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
      rw [dif_pos hhalf']
      apply congrArg
      apply Subtype.ext
      show ((Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one
        (((0 : I) : ℝ) + 4 * (t : ℝ) * (1 - ((0 : I) : ℝ))) : I) : ℝ) =
          2 * (2 * (t : ℝ))
      rw [projIcc_unit_coe (by simp; nlinarith) (by simp; nlinarith)]
      simp
      ring
    · by_cases hhalf : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2
      · rw [if_neg h4, if_pos hhalf, dif_pos hhalf, Path.trans_apply]
        have hhalf' : ¬ (2 * (t : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
          intro hcon
          exact h4 (by linarith)
        rw [dif_neg hhalf']
        apply congrArg
        apply Subtype.ext
        show ((Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one
          (4 * (t : ℝ) - 1) : I) : ℝ) = 2 * (2 * (t : ℝ)) - 1
        rw [projIcc_unit_coe (by linarith [not_le.mp h4]) (by linarith)]
        ring
      · rw [if_neg h4, if_neg hhalf, dif_neg hhalf]
        show c _ = c (unitInterval.symm _)
        apply congrArg
        apply Subtype.ext
        show ((Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one
          (((0 : I) : ℝ) + (2 - 2 * (t : ℝ)) * (1 - ((0 : I) : ℝ))) : I) : ℝ) =
            1 - (2 * (t : ℝ) - 1)
        have hhalf' := not_le.mp hhalf
        rw [projIcc_unit_coe (by simp; nlinarith) (by simp; nlinarith)]
        simp
        ring
  have hone : ∀ t : I,
      f (1, t) =
        (((Path.refl y).trans α).trans (Path.refl y)).toContinuousMap t := by
    intro t
    show f (1, t) = (((Path.refl y).trans α).trans (Path.refl y)) t
    have ht0 : (t : ℝ) ≥ 0 := t.2.1
    have ht1 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 := t.2.2
    simp only [f]
    rw [Path.trans_apply]
    by_cases h4 : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4
    · have hhalf : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := le_trans h4 (by norm_num)
      rw [if_pos h4, dif_pos hhalf, Path.trans_apply]
      have hhalf' : (2 * (t : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
      rw [dif_pos hhalf']
      show c _ = y
      have harg : (((1 : I) : ℝ) + 4 * (t : ℝ) * (1 - ((1 : I) : ℝ))) = 1 := by
        simp
      rw [harg, Set.projIcc_right]
      exact c.target
    · by_cases hhalf : (t : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2
      · rw [if_neg h4, if_pos hhalf, dif_pos hhalf, Path.trans_apply]
        have hhalf' : ¬ (2 * (t : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
          intro hcon
          exact h4 (by linarith)
        rw [dif_neg hhalf']
        apply congrArg
        apply Subtype.ext
        show ((Set.projIcc (0 : ℝ) 1 zero_le_one
          (4 * (t : ℝ) - 1) : I) : ℝ) = 2 * (2 * (t : ℝ)) - 1
        rw [projIcc_unit_coe (by linarith [not_le.mp h4]) (by linarith)]
        ring
      · rw [if_neg h4, if_neg hhalf, dif_neg hhalf]
        show c _ = y
        have harg :
            (((1 : I) : ℝ) + (2 - 2 * (t : ℝ)) * (1 - ((1 : I) : ℝ))) = 1 := by
          simp
        rw [harg, Set.projIcc_right]
        exact c.target
  have hclosed : ∀ s : I, f (s, 0) = f (s, 1) := by
    intro s
    simp only [f]
    have h0le : ((0 : I) : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4 := by norm_num
    have h1nle : ¬ ((1 : I) : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4 := by norm_num
    have h1nle' : ¬ ((1 : I) : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2 := by norm_num
    rw [if_pos h0le, if_neg h1nle, if_neg h1nle']
    apply congrArg
    apply Subtype.ext
    have hs0 : (s : ℝ) ≥ 0 := s.2.1
    have hs1 : (s : ℝ) ≤ 1 := s.2.2
    have e1 : ((s : ℝ) + 4 * ((0 : I) : ℝ) * (1 - (s : ℝ))) = (s : ℝ) := by
      simp
    have e2 : ((s : ℝ) + (2 - 2 * ((1 : I) : ℝ)) * (1 - (s : ℝ))) = (s : ℝ) := by
      simp
    rw [e1, e2]
  let H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy
      ((c.trans α).trans c.symm).toContinuousMap
      (((Path.refl y).trans α).trans (Path.refl y)).toContinuousMap :=
    { toContinuousMap := ⟨f, hf⟩
      map_zero_left := hzero
      map_one_left := hone }
  have hstep : pathLoopClassZ2 ((c.trans α).trans c.symm) =
      pathLoopClassZ2 (((Path.refl y).trans α).trans (Path.refl y)) := by
    unfold pathLoopClassZ2
    exact loopClassZ2_congr _ _ H hclosed
  rw [hstep]
  apply pathLoopClassZ2_congr
  exact (Path.Homotopic.trans_refl _).trans (Path.Homotopic.refl_trans α)

name: Submission.quotLoopClassZ2_mk
statement:
@[simp] theorem quotLoopClassZ2_mk {x : SOGroup m} (α : Path x x) :
    quotLoopClassZ2 (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk α) = pathLoopClassZ2 α
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.quotLoopClassZ2_refl
statement:
theorem quotLoopClassZ2_refl (x : SOGroup m) :
    quotLoopClassZ2 (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl x) = 0
proof:
:=
  pathLoopClassZ2_refl x

name: Submission.quotLoopClassZ2_trans
statement:
theorem quotLoopClassZ2_trans {x : SOGroup m}
    (p q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x x) :
    quotLoopClassZ2 (p.trans q) =
      quotLoopClassZ2 p + quotLoopClassZ2 q
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with | mk a =>
  induction q using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with | mk b =>
  rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans]
  exact pathLoopClassZ2_trans a b

name: Submission.quotLoopClassZ2_symm
proof:
:= by
  induction p using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with | mk a =>
  rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_symm]
  exact pathLoopClassZ2_symm a

name: Submission.quotLoopClassZ2_conj
statement:
theorem quotLoopClassZ2_conj {x y : SOGroup m}
    (c : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y)
    (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient y y) :
    quotLoopClassZ2 ((c.trans p).trans c.symm) = quotLoopClassZ2 p
proof:
:= by
  induction c using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with | mk a =>
  induction p using Path.Homotopic.Quotient.ind with | mk b =>
  rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_symm,
    ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans, ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans]
  exact pathLoopClassZ2_conj a b

name: Submission.quot_trans_symm_cancel
statement:
private theorem quot_trans_symm_cancel {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {x y z : X} (γ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y)
    (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x z) :
    γ.trans (γ.symm.trans p) = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_symm,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_trans]

name: Submission.quot_symm_trans_cancel
statement:
private theorem quot_symm_trans_cancel {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X]
    {x y z : X} (γ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y)
    (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient y z) :
    γ.symm.trans (γ.trans p) = p
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.symm_trans,
    Path.Homotopic.Quotient.refl_trans]

name: Submission.quotLoopClassZ2_comm
statement:
theorem quotLoopClassZ2_comm {x y : SOGroup m}
    (p : Path.Homotopic.Quotient x y)
    (q : Path.Homotopic.Quotient y x) :
    quotLoopClassZ2 (p.trans q) = quotLoopClassZ2 (q.trans p)
proof:
:= by
  have h := quotLoopClassZ2_conj q (p.trans q)
  calc
    quotLoopClassZ2 (p.trans q) =
        quotLoopClassZ2 ((q.trans (p.trans q)).trans q.symm) := h.symm
    _ = quotLoopClassZ2 (q.trans p) := by
      congr 1
      rw [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
        Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
        Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_symm,
        Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_refl]

name: Submission.quotLoopClassZ2_band_splice
statement:
theorem quotLoopClassZ2_band_splice
    {a₀ a₁ a₂ a₃ b₀ b₁ b₂ b₃ : SOGroup m}
    (A₁ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient a₀ a₁)
    (B₁ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient a₁ a₂)
    (A₂ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient a₂ a₃)
    (B₂ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient a₃ a₀)
    (E₁ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b₀ b₁)
    (L₁ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b₁ b₀)
    (E₂ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b₂ b₃)
    (L₂ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b₃ b₂)
    (c₀ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b₀ a₀)
    (c₁ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b₁ a₁)
    (c₂ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b₂ a₂)
    (c₃ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b₃ a₃)
    (hA₁ : A₁ = (c₀.symm.trans E₁).trans c₁)
    (hA₂ : A₂ = (c₂.symm.trans E₂).trans c₃) :
    quotLoopClassZ2 ((A₁.trans B₁).trans (A₂.trans B₂)) =
      quotLoopClassZ2 (E₁.trans L₁) + quotLoopClassZ2 (E₂.trans L₂) +
        quotLoopClassZ2
          (((L₁.symm.trans c₁).trans (B₁.trans c₂.symm)).trans
            ((L₂.symm.trans c₃).trans (B₂.trans c₀.symm)))
proof:
:= by
  subst hA₁ hA₂
  set R : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b₀ b₂ :=
    (L₁.symm.trans c₁).trans (B₁.trans c₂.symm) with hR
  set S : Path.Homotopic.Quotient b₂ b₀ :=
    (L₂.symm.trans c₃).trans (B₂.trans c₀.symm) with hS
  have hsplit :
      ((((c₀.symm.trans E₁).trans c₁).trans B₁).trans
          ((((c₂.symm.trans E₂).trans c₃)).trans B₂)) =
        c₀.symm.trans
          ((E₁.trans L₁).trans
            (R.trans ((E₂.trans L₂).trans (S.trans c₀)))) := by
    rw [hR, hS]
    simp only [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
      quot_trans_symm_cancel,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.symm_trans,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_refl]
  rw [hsplit, quotLoopClassZ2_comm]
  have htail :
      ((E₁.trans L₁).trans
          (R.trans ((E₂.trans L₂).trans (S.trans c₀)))).trans c₀.symm =
        (E₁.trans L₁).trans (R.trans ((E₂.trans L₂).trans S)) := by
    simp only [Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_symm,
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_refl]
  rw [htail, quotLoopClassZ2_trans]
  have hmid :
      quotLoopClassZ2 (R.trans ((E₂.trans L₂).trans S)) =
        quotLoopClassZ2 (E₂.trans L₂) + quotLoopClassZ2 (R.trans S) := by
    rw [quotLoopClassZ2_comm R ((E₂.trans L₂).trans S),
      Path.Homotopic.Quotient.trans_assoc,
      quotLoopClassZ2_trans, quotLoopClassZ2_comm S R]
  rw [hmid]
  ring

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.framePath_trans
statement:
theorem FramedLevelSet.framePath_trans (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    {p q r : ↥X.fiber} (γ : Path p q) (δ : Path q r) :

      (X.framePath γ).trans (X.framePath δ)
proof:

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.framePath_symm
statement:
theorem FramedLevelSet.framePath_symm (X : FramedLevelSet n)

name: Submission.FramedLevelSet.framePath_homotopic

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_fiberCurve
statement:
theorem SimpleClosedOrbitParam.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_fiberCurve
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} {V : TamedField X}
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    pathLoopClassZ2 (X.framePath P.fiberCurve) =
      V.fundamentalFrameClass P.hp
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : (X.framePath P.fiberCurve).toContinuousMap =
      P.paramFrameLoop := by
    refine ContinuousMap.ext fun u => Subtype.ext ?_
    show rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt X (P.curve u))) =
      frameLoop X P.realCurve (u : ℝ)
    unfold frameLoop
    rw [P.realCurve_coe]
  unfold pathLoopClassZ2
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun (pathLoop_closed (X.framePath P.fiberCurve))
    P.paramFrameLoop_closed hfun]
  exact P.paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_of_orbit
statement:
theorem SimpleClosedOrbitParam.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_of_orbit
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} {V : TamedField X}
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (O : V.OrbitIndex)
    (hO : V.orbitPoint O ∈ V.orbit P.p) :
    pathLoopClassZ2 (X.framePath P.fiberCurve) =
      V.orbitFrameClass O
proof:
:= by
  rw [P.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_fiberCurve,
    V.orbitFrameClass_eq_fundamental]
  exact (V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit P.hp hO).symm

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_decomposition
statement:
theorem SimpleClosedOrbitParam.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_decomposition
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} {V : TamedField X}
    (P : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) (O : V.OrbitIndex)
    (hO : V.orbitPoint O ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    {z : ↥X.fiber} (c : Path (⟨P.p, P.hp⟩ : ↥X.fiber) z)
    {δ : Path z z}
    (hδ : δ.Homotopic ((c.symm.trans P.fiberCurve).trans c)) :
    pathLoopClassZ2 (X.framePath δ) = V.orbitFrameClass O
proof:
:= by
  rw [pathLoopClassZ2_congr (X.framePath_homotopic hδ)]
  rw [X.framePath_trans, X.framePath_trans, ← X.framePath_symm]
  have hconj := pathLoopClassZ2_conj (X.framePath c).symm
    (X.framePath P.fiberCurve)
  rw [Path.symm_symm] at hconj
  rw [hconj]
  exact P.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_of_orbit O hO

name: Submission.TamedField.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_intrinsic
statement:
theorem TamedField.pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_intrinsic
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} (V : TamedField X) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    pathLoopClassZ2
        (X.framePath (V.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam O).fiberCurve) =
      V.orbitFrameClass O
proof:
:=
  (V.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam O).pathLoopClassZ2_framePath_of_orbit
    O (V.mem_orbit_self _)

name: Submission.SaddleFrameBandSpliceData.frame_splice
statement:
theorem frame_splice
    (F : SaddleFrameBandSpliceData Vbefore Vafter O₁ O₂ Ohat) :
    Vafter.orbitFrameClass Ohat =
      Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₁ + Vbefore.orbitFrameClass O₂ + 1
proof:
:= by
  have hA₁ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.afterExterior₁ =
      ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.connector₀).symm.trans
        (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.beforeExterior₁)).trans
        (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.connector₁) := by
    rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_symm,
      ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans,
      ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans]
    exact Path.Homotopic.Quotient.eq.mpr F.exterior₁_transport
  have hA₂ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.afterExterior₂ =
      ((Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.connector₂).symm.trans
        (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.beforeExterior₂)).trans
        (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.connector₃) := by
    rw [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_symm,
      ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans,
      ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans]
    exact Path.Homotopic.Quotient.eq.mpr F.exterior₂_transport
  have hmain := quotLoopClassZ2_band_splice
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.afterExterior₁)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.afterBand₁)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.afterExterior₂)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.afterBand₂)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.beforeExterior₁)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.beforeLocal₁)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.beforeExterior₂)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.beforeLocal₂)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.connector₀)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.connector₁)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.connector₂)
    (Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk F.connector₃)
    hA₁ hA₂
  simp only [← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_symm,
    ← Path.Homotopic.Quotient.mk_trans, quotLoopClassZ2_mk] at hmain
  rw [F.after_class, F.before₁_class, F.before₂_class, hmain, F.band_class]

name: Submission.initCLM_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma initCLM_apply (m : ℕ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))
    (j : Fin m) : initCLM m w j = w j.castSucc
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.embedCLM_apply_castSucc
statement:
@[simp] lemma embedCLM_apply_castSucc (m : ℕ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m))
    (j : Fin m) : embedCLM m y j.castSucc = y j
proof:
:= by
  show (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℝ) (WithLp.ofLp y) 0) j.castSucc = y j
  exact Fin.snoc_castSucc _ _ j

name: Submission.embedCLM_apply_last
statement:
@[simp] lemma embedCLM_apply_last (m : ℕ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    embedCLM m y (Fin.last m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  show (Fin.snoc (α := fun _ => ℝ) (WithLp.ofLp y) 0) (Fin.last m) = 0
  exact Fin.snoc_last _ _

name: Submission.initCLM_embedCLM
statement:
lemma initCLM_embedCLM (m : ℕ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)) :
    initCLM m (embedCLM m y) = y
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext j
  simp

name: Submission.initCLM_eLast
statement: lemma initCLM_eLast (n : ℕ) : initCLM n (eLast n) = 0
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext j
  have hne : (j.castSucc : Fin (n + 1)) ≠ Fin.last n := (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j).ne
  simp [eLast, hne]

name: Submission.eq_embed_init_add
statement:
lemma eq_embed_init_add {n : ℕ} (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    w = embedCLM n (initCLM n w) + vertC w • eLast n
proof:
:= by
  apply (WithLp.equiv 2 _).injective
  funext i
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => simp [vertC, eLast]
  | cast j =>
    have hne : (j.castSucc : Fin (n + 1)) ≠ Fin.last n := (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j).ne
    simp [eLast, hne]

name: Submission.norm_sq_eq_sum
statement:
lemma norm_sq_eq_sum {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ ι) :
    ‖x‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i, x i ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [EuclideanSpace.norm_eq, Real.sq_sqrt (Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => sq_nonneg _)]
  simp [Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]

name: Submission.norm_sq_split
statement:
lemma norm_sq_split {n : ℕ} (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ‖w‖ ^ 2 = ‖initCLM n w‖ ^ 2 + vertC w ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rw [norm_sq_eq_sum, norm_sq_eq_sum, Fin.sum_univ_castSucc]
  simp [vertC]

name: Submission.initCLM_northPoint
statement:
lemma initCLM_northPoint {n : ℕ} (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    initCLM n (northPoint y) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [northPoint, map_add, map_smul, initCLM_embedCLM, initCLM_eLast, smul_zero,
    add_zero]

name: Submission.initCLM_southPointOf
statement:
lemma initCLM_southPointOf {n : ℕ} (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    initCLM n (southPointOf y) = y
proof:
:= by
  rw [southPointOf, map_sub, map_smul, initCLM_embedCLM, initCLM_eLast, smul_zero,
    sub_zero]

name: Submission.vertC_northPoint
statement:
lemma vertC_northPoint {n : ℕ} (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    vertC (northPoint y) = Real.sqrt (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  show (northPoint y) (Fin.last n) = _
  rw [northPoint]
  simp [eLast]

name: Submission.vertC_southPointOf
statement:
lemma vertC_southPointOf {n : ℕ} (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    vertC (southPointOf y) = -Real.sqrt (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  show (southPointOf y) (Fin.last n) = _
  rw [southPointOf]
  simp [eLast]

name: Submission.init_eq_iff
statement:
lemma init_eq_iff {n : ℕ} {w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hw : ‖w‖ = 1)
    (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    initCLM n w = y ↔ w = northPoint y ∨ w = southPointOf y
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hsplit : ‖w‖ ^ 2 = ‖initCLM n w‖ ^ 2 + vertC w ^ 2 := norm_sq_split w
    rw [hw, h] at hsplit
    have hsq : vertC w ^ 2 = 1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2 := by linarith [hsplit]
    have habs : |vertC w| = Real.sqrt (1 - ‖y‖ ^ 2) := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, hsq]
    have hdecomp : w = embedCLM n (initCLM n w) + vertC w • eLast n :=
      eq_embed_init_add w
    rcases (abs_eq (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)).mp habs with hv | hv
    · left
      rw [northPoint, ← hv, ← h]
      exact hdecomp
    · right
      rw [southPointOf, sub_eq_add_neg, ← neg_smul, ← hv, ← h]
      exact hdecomp
  · rintro (rfl | rfl)
    · exact initCLM_northPoint y
    · exact initCLM_southPointOf y

name: Submission.vertC_northPoint_pos
statement:
lemma vertC_northPoint_pos {n : ℕ} {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (hy : ‖y‖ < 1) : 0 < vertC (northPoint y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertC_northPoint]
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ := norm_nonneg y
  nlinarith

name: Submission.vertC_southPointOf_neg
statement:
lemma vertC_southPointOf_neg {n : ℕ} {y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (hy : ‖y‖ < 1) : vertC (southPointOf y) < 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [vertC_southPointOf, neg_lt, neg_zero]
  apply Real.sqrt_pos.mpr
  have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖y‖ := norm_nonneg y
  nlinarith

name: Submission.contDiff_normalize_comp
statement:
lemma contDiff_normalize_comp {X E' : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup X]
    [NormedSpace ℝ X] [NormedAddCommGroup E'] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E']
    {f : X → E'} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (h0 : ∀ x, f x ≠ 0) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ fun x => ‖f x‖⁻¹ • f x
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro x
  have hnorm : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun x => ‖f x‖) x := hf.contDiffAt.norm ℝ (h0 x)
  exact (hnorm.inv (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (h0 x))).smul hf.contDiffAt

name: Submission.norm_nraw

name: Submission.nprep_of_mem_collar
proof:
:= by
  have hraw : a.raw v = ((southPole n) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :=
    a.raw_eq_basepoint_on_collar v hv
  have hnraw : nraw a v = -eLast n := by
    rw [nraw, hraw, southPole_coe, norm_neg, norm_eLast]
    simp
  have hvert : vertC (-eLast n : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) = -1 := by
    show (-eLast n) (Fin.last n) = -1
    simp [eLast]
  have hpraw : praw a v = -eLast n := by
    rw [praw, hnraw]
    exact plateauAux_of_le (by rw [hvert]; norm_num)
  show ‖praw a v‖⁻¹ • praw a v = -eLast n
  rw [hpraw, norm_neg, norm_eLast]
  simp

name: Submission.contDiff_bridgeHMap

name: Submission.bridgeHMap_eq_iff
statement:
lemma bridgeHMap_eq_iff (v : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :
    bridgeHMap a v = y ↔ nprep a v = northPoint y ∨ nprep a v = southPointOf y
proof:
:=
  init_eq_iff (norm_nprep a v) y

name: Submission.nprep_eq_northPoint_iff
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    exact vertC_northPoint_pos hy
  · intro h
    rcases (bridgeHMap_eq_iff a v y).mp hfib with hn | hs
    · exact hn
    · exfalso
      rw [hs] at h
      exact absurd h (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt (vertC_southPointOf_neg hy)))

name: Submission.prepLoop_coe
statement:
lemma prepLoop_coe (t : I^ (Fin (n + 1))) :
    ((prepLoop a t) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
      = nprep a (fun i => (t i : ℝ))
proof:
:= by
  show ((plateauMap n (a.representative t)) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) = _
  rw [plateauMap_coe]
  have hcoe : ((a.representative t) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
      = nraw a (fun i => (t i : ℝ)) := a.representative_coe t
  rw [hcoe]
  rfl

    (⟦prepLoop a⟧ : HomotopyGroup (Fin (n + 1))
        (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) (southPole n))

name: Submission.exists_bridge_regular_value
statement:
theorem exists_bridge_regular_value (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∃ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      0 < ‖y‖ ∧ ‖y‖ < 1 / 8 ∧ 0 < y ⟨0, hn⟩ ∧
        IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a) y
proof:
:= by
  set z₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
    EuclideanSpace.single (⟨0, hn⟩ : Fin n) (1 / 16 : ℝ) with hz₀
  have hz₀norm : ‖z₀‖ = 1 / 16 := by
    rw [hz₀, PiLp.norm_single, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨y, hy_ball, hy_reg⟩ :=
    sard_exists_regular_value_in_ball (contDiff_bridgeHMapE a) z₀
      (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 32)
  have hdist : ‖y - z₀‖ < 1 / 32 := by
    rw [← dist_eq_norm]
    exact mem_ball.mp hy_ball
  have habs : |‖y‖ - ‖z₀‖| ≤ ‖y - z₀‖ := abs_norm_sub_norm_le y z₀
  rw [abs_le] at habs
  have hcoord : |y ⟨0, hn⟩ - 1 / 16| < 1 / 32 := by
    have hle := PiLp.norm_apply_le (y - z₀) ⟨0, hn⟩
    have hval : (y - z₀) ⟨0, hn⟩ = y ⟨0, hn⟩ - 1 / 16 := by
      simp [hz₀]
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hval] at hle
    exact hle.trans_lt hdist
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_, ?_, hy_reg⟩
  · rw [hz₀norm] at habs
    linarith [habs.1]
  · rw [hz₀norm] at habs
    linarith [habs.2]
  · rw [abs_lt] at hcoord
    linarith [hcoord.1]

name: Submission.bridgeFLS_fiber
statement:
theorem bridgeFLS_fiber (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) (hy : y ≠ 0)
    (hreg : IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a) y) :
    (bridgeFLS a y hy hreg).fiber
      = {x | nprep a (WithLp.ofLp x) = northPoint y
          ∨ nprep a (WithLp.ofLp x) = southPointOf y}
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  show bridgeHMapE a x - y = 0 ↔ _
  rw [sub_eq_zero]
  exact bridgeHMap_eq_iff a (WithLp.ofLp x) y

name: Submission.BridgeData.y_ne_zero
statement: lemma y_ne_zero : B.y ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0

  rw [h0, norm_zero] at this
  exact lt_irrefl 0 this

name: Submission.BridgeData.norm_y_lt_one

proof: := B.norm_y_lt.trans (by norm_num)

proof:

name: Submission.BridgeData.mem_north_iff
statement:
theorem mem_north_iff {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hx : x ∈ B.fls.fiber) :
    nprep B.approx (WithLp.ofLp x) = northPoint B.y
      ↔ 0 < vertC (nprep B.approx (WithLp.ofLp x))
proof:
:= by
  have hfib : bridgeHMap B.approx (WithLp.ofLp x) = B.y := by
    have : bridgeHMapE B.approx x - B.y = 0 := hx
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
  exact nprep_eq_northPoint_iff B.approx B.norm_y_lt_one hfib

name: Submission.exists_bridgeData
statement:
theorem exists_bridgeData (hn : 0 < n)
    (z : HomotopyGroup (Fin (n + 1))
      (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) (southPole n)) :
    Nonempty (BridgeData n z)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, a, hz⟩ := exists_approximation_of_homotopy_class z
  obtain ⟨y, hy0, hy8, hyaxis, hyreg⟩ := exists_bridge_regular_value a hn
  have hyaxis' : ∀ hn' : 0 < n, 0 < y ⟨0, hn'⟩ := by
    intro hn'
    simpa using hyaxis
  exact ⟨⟨p, a, y, hy0, hy8, hyaxis', hyreg, hz⟩⟩

name: Submission.LocallySmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.homotopy_H_one_canonicalPoint
statement:
@[simp] theorem homotopy_H_one_canonicalPoint
    (Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)) (P : V₀.OrbitIndex) (θ : ℝ) :
    (homotopy V₀ (L₀ := L₀) D₀ Y).H 1
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V₀ (by omega) P θ) =
      SOFrameGauge.toCLM
        ((L₀ P).cartesian (Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ))
        (Y.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V₀ (by omega) P θ))
proof:
:= by
  rw [homotopy,
    SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.homotopy_H_one_canonicalPoint]
  change SOFrameGauge.toCLM
      ((D₀ P).Q 1 (Real.cos θ, Real.sin θ))
        (Y.g (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V₀ (by omega) P θ)) = _
  rw [(D₀ P).endpoint_circle _ (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq θ)]

      D.cutoffData.cutoff (V.orbitTube O q) •
        (D.radialBump q.2 • D.quotientDisplacement q.1)

      D.cutoffData.cutoff (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) •

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.ambientField_orbit_zero
statement:
theorem ambientField_orbit_zero (u : ℝ) :
    D.ambientField (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N))) =
      D.displacement u
proof:
:= by
  have hz : (0 : N) ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius :=
    Metric.mem_ball_self (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius_pos
  rw [D.ambientField_orbitTubeLift u 0 hz,
    OrbitUnknottingSupport.SmoothCutoffData.cutoff_eq_one_on_source
      (V := V) D.cutoffData (D.orbitTubeLift_zero_mem_source u)]
  have hb : D.radialBump (0 : N) = 1 := by
    apply D.radialBump.one_of_mem_closedBall
    simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall] using D.radialBump.rIn_pos.le
  simp [hb]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore
statement:
theorem ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore {x : E}
    (hx : x ∉ D.supportCore) : D.ambientField x = 0
proof:
:= by
  by_cases ht : x ∈ D.tubeImage
  · let q : C × N := (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse x
    have hq : q ∈ D.tubeDomain := D.inverse_mem_tubeDomain ht
    have houter : D.radialBump.rOut ≤ ‖q.2‖ := by
      by_contra hnot
      have hle : ‖q.2‖ ≤ D.radialBump.rOut :=
        (lt_of_not_ge hnot).le
      apply hx
      refine ⟨q, ⟨Set.mem_univ _, ?_⟩, D.orbitTube_inverse_right ht⟩
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_left] using hle
    have hb : D.radialBump q.2 = 0 :=
      D.radialBump.zero_of_le_dist (by
        simpa [dist_zero_right] using houter)
    rw [ambientField, if_pos ht]
    simp [q, hb]
  · exact D.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_tubeImage ht
