name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.contDiffAt_ambientField_orbitTubeLift
statement:
theorem contDiffAt_ambientField_orbitTubeLift (u : ℝ) (z : N)
    (hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius) :
    ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ D.ambientField (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨e, g₀, hf, hg₀, hg₀deriv, hg₀center, hg₀local⟩ :=
    (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).local_smooth_lift u z hz
  let chart : OpenPartialHomeomorph (ℝ × N) E :=
    (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).contDiffAt.toOpenPartialHomeomorph
      (V.orbitTubeLift O) hf (by simp)
  let g : E → ℝ × N := chart.symm
  have hsource : (u, z) ∈ chart.source := by
    exact (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).contDiffAt
      |>.mem_toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source hf (by simp)
  have htarget : V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z) ∈ chart.target :=
    chart.map_source hsource
  have hgcenter : g (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z) := by
    change chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z)
    rw [← show (chart : (ℝ × N) → E) = V.orbitTubeLift O by rfl]
    exact chart.left_inv hsource
  have hforwardDeriv : HasFDerivAt chart
      (e : (ℝ × N) →L[ℝ] E)
      (chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z) by
      exact hgcenter]
    exact hf
  have hforwardSmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ chart
      (chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z))) := by
    rw [show chart.symm (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) = (u, z) by
      exact hgcenter]
    exact (V.contDiff_orbitTubeLift O).contDiffAt
  have hgsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ g
      (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) :=
    chart.contDiffAt_symm htarget hforwardDeriv hforwardSmooth
  have hgball : ∀ᶠ y in nhds (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)),
      (g y).2 ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
        (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius := by
    have hg2continuous : ContinuousAt (fun y : E => (g y).2)
        (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) :=
      continuous_snd.continuousAt.comp' hgsmooth.continuousAt
    have hzcenter : (g (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z))).2 ∈
        Metric.ball (0 : N) (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius := by
      rw [hgcenter]
      exact hz
    exact hg2continuous.eventually
      (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzcenter)
  have hright : ∀ᶠ y in nhds (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)),
      V.orbitTubeLift O (g y) = y := by
    filter_upwards [chart.eventually_right_inverse htarget] with y hy
    exact hy
  have hlocal : ∀ᶠ y in nhds (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)),
      D.ambientField y =
        D.cutoffData.cutoff y •
          (D.radialBump (g y).2 • D.displacement (g y).1) := by
    filter_upwards [hright, hgball] with y hy hgy
    let q : C × N := (((g y).1 : C), (g y).2)
    have hq : q ∈ D.tubeDomain := ⟨Set.mem_univ _, hgy⟩
    have hyq : V.orbitTube O q = y := by
      rw [V.orbitTube_coe O (g y).1 (g y).2]
      exact hy
    have hytube : y ∈ D.tubeImage := ⟨q, hq, hyq⟩
    have hinv : (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse y = q := by
      rw [← hyq]
      exact (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).inverse_left q hq
    rw [ambientField, if_pos hytube, hinv,
      D.quotientDisplacement_coe]
  have hg1 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : E => (g y).1)
      (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) :=
    contDiffAt_fst.comp _ hgsmooth
  have hg2 : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun y : E => (g y).2)
      (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) :=
    contDiffAt_snd.comp _ hgsmooth
  have hb : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun y : E => D.radialBump (g y).2)
      (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) :=
    D.radialBump.contDiffAt.comp _ hg2
  have hd : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun y : E => D.displacement (g y).1)
      (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) :=
    D.displacement_smooth.contDiffAt.comp _ hg1
  have hsmooth : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun y : E => D.cutoffData.cutoff y •
        (D.radialBump (g y).2 • D.displacement (g y).1))
      (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, z)) :=
    D.cutoffData.contDiff_cutoff.contDiffAt.smul (hb.smul hd)
  exact hsmooth.congr_of_eventuallyEq hlocal

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.contDiff_ambientField
statement: theorem contDiff_ambientField : ContDiff ℝ ∞ D.ambientField
proof:
:= by
  rw [contDiff_iff_contDiffAt]
  intro x
  by_cases hx : x ∈ D.supportCore
  · rcases hx with ⟨⟨a, z⟩, hzcore, rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := QuotientAddGroup.mk_surjective a
    have hzle : ‖z‖ ≤ D.radialBump.rOut := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_closedBall, dist_zero_left] using hzcore.2
    have hz : z ∈ Metric.ball (0 : N)
        (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius := by
      simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_zero_left] using
        (lt_of_le_of_lt hzle D.radialBump_rOut_lt)
    simpa only [V.orbitTube_coe] using
      D.contDiffAt_ambientField_orbitTubeLift u z hz
  · have hxcompl : x ∈ D.supportCoreᶜ := hx
    have hnear : D.supportCoreᶜ ∈ nhds x :=
      D.isClosed_supportCore.isOpen_compl.mem_nhds hxcompl
    apply (show ContDiffAt ℝ ∞ (fun _ : E => (0 : E)) x from
      contDiffAt_const).congr_of_eventuallyEq
    filter_upwards [hnear] with y hy
    exact D.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore hy

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.exists_lipschitzWith_ambientField
statement:
theorem exists_lipschitzWith_ambientField :
    ∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzWith K D.ambientField
proof:
:= by
  exact D.contDiff_ambientField.lipschitzWith_of_hasCompactSupport
    D.hasCompactSupport_ambientField (by simp)

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.toSmallAmbientDisplacement_forward_orbit_zero
statement:
theorem toSmallAmbientDisplacement_forward_orbit_zero
    (K : ℝ≥0) (hK : K < 1)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith K D.ambientField) (u : ℝ) :
    (D.toSmallAmbientDisplacement K hK hLip).toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.forward 1
        (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N))) =
      V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N)) + D.displacement u
proof:
:= by
  rw [SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward_one
      (D.toSmallAmbientDisplacement K hK hLip)]
  change V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N)) +
      D.ambientField (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N))) = _
  rw [D.ambientField_orbit_zero]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.toSmallAmbientDisplacement_fixedOn_obstacle
statement:
theorem toSmallAmbientDisplacement_fixedOn_obstacle
    (K : ℝ≥0) (hK : K < 1)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith K D.ambientField) :
    (D.toSmallAmbientDisplacement K hK hLip).toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.FixedOn
      (OrbitUnknottingSupport.obstacleSet V h2 O)
proof:
:= by
  apply SmallAmbientDisplacement.fixedOn_of_field_eq_zero
  intro x hx
  change D.ambientField x = 0
  exact D.ambientField_eq_zero_of_mem_obstacle hx

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.toScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_forward_orbit_zero
statement:
theorem toScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement_forward_orbit_zero
    (r : ℝ) (K : ℝ≥0)
    (hLip : LipschitzWith K D.ambientField)
    (hsmall : ‖r‖₊ * K < 1) (u : ℝ) :
    (SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy
      (D.toScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement r K hLip hsmall)).forward 1
          (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N))) =
      V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N)) + r • D.displacement u
proof:
:= by
  rw [SmallAmbientDisplacement.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward_one
      (D.toScaledSmallAmbientDisplacement r K hLip hsmall)]
  change V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N)) +
      r • D.ambientField (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N))) = _
  rw [D.ambientField_orbit_zero]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.exists_scaledSmallAmbientDisplacement
statement:
theorem exists_scaledSmallAmbientDisplacement :
    ∃ ε : ℝ, ε > 0 ∧ ∃ S : SmallAmbientDisplacement n,
      S.field = (fun x => ε • D.ambientField x) ∧
      ∀ u : ℝ,
        S.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy.forward 1
            (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N))) =
          V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N)) + ε • D.displacement u
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, S, hS⟩ := SmallAmbientDisplacement.exists_scaled
    D.ambientField D.contDiff_ambientField D.hasCompactSupport_ambientField
  refine ⟨ε, hε, S, hS, ?_⟩
  intro u
  rw [S.toSmoothAmbientIsotopy_forward_one, hS]
  change V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N)) +
      ε • D.ambientField (V.orbitTubeLift O (u, (0 : N))) = _
  rw [D.ambientField_orbit_zero]

name: Submission.TamedField.PeriodicDisplacementExtensionData.canonicalRadialBump_rOut_lt_tube
statement:
theorem canonicalRadialBump_rOut_lt_tube
    (V : TamedField X) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    (canonicalRadialBump V O).rOut <
      (V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius
proof:
:= by
  dsimp [canonicalRadialBump]
  linarith [(V.globalSmoothOrbitTube O).radius_pos]

name: Submission.StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.exists_splitHitBand_of_endCapture
statement:
theorem exists_splitHitBand_of_endCapture
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle)
    {ρ eps s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hb : 0 < s) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (hregneg : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
    (hregpos : sliceRegular C.G (tcoord center + s ^ 2))
    (Vneg : TamedField (T.saddleNegativeSlice s hregneg))
    (Vpos : TamedField (T.saddlePositiveSlice s hregpos))
    (R : CompactTimeTamedField C.toLevelCobordismData
      (criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)))
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ R.safeTime)
    (hflowlt : ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 < eps / 2)
    (hcover : ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      dist v center < eps → C.G v = 0 →
      ∃ u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2), ‖u‖ < ρ ∧ M.param u = v)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord center - s ^ 2 → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (hcap : ∀ p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch,
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s) center →
      spacePart (R.base.flow (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1 ρ s)
          (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex p.1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hne : T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos ≠
      T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos)
    (heq : T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg =
      T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg) :
    ∃ B : SaddleChartHitBand M ρ eps (s ^ 2) (-(s ^ 2)) R hregpos hregneg
        Vpos Vneg
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos)
        (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregpos Vpos)
        (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg),
      ∃ iloc jloc r₁ r₂ : Fin 4,
        Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad) =
          (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange iloc ∧
        Set.range (T.saddleNegativeSpatialSegment .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad) =
          (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange jloc ∧
        iloc ≠ jloc ∧ r₁ ≠ r₂ ∧
        r₁ ≠ iloc ∧ r₁ ≠ jloc ∧ r₂ ≠ iloc ∧ r₂ ≠ jloc ∧
        (∀ q : I, (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad hregneg Vneg).curve (Set.Icc.convexComb B.cut₀ B.cut₁ q) ∈
          (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange r₁) ∧
        (∀ q : I, (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad hregneg Vneg).curve (Set.Icc.convexComb B.cut₂ B.cut₃ q) ∈
          (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange r₂)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hρM : ρ < M.radius := hρrad.trans_le T.radius_le
  have hbound : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) := R.base.bound.coe_nonneg
  have habs : |s ^ 2| = s ^ 2 := abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg s)
  have habsn : |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| = s ^ 2 := by rw [abs_neg, habs]
  obtain ⟨iloc, jloc, hijloc, hiloc, hjloc, hother⟩ :=
    T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbit_exists_uniformExteriorCuts hindex ρ s hρ hb hs
      hρrad hregneg Vneg heq
  have hcutFib : ∀ (r : Fin 4) (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
      y ∈ (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange r →
      C.G (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) = 0 := by
    intro r y hy
    rw [← (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregneg Vneg heq).range_cyclicCutPath r] at hy
    obtain ⟨w, rfl⟩ := hy
    exact (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w
  have hcutFar : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ iloc → r ≠ jloc →
      ∀ y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)),
      y ∈ (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange r →
      eps / 2 + ((R.base.bound : ℝ)) * s ^ 2 ≤
        dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) center := by
    intro r hri hrj y hy
    have h : eps ≤ dist (cobSpaceTime y (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) center := by
      refine le_dist_center_of_saddleChart_avoid (w := -(s ^ 2)) hindex hρM
        hcover (hcutFib r y hy) (by rw [tcoord_spaceTime]; ring) ?_
      intro u hquad hnorm hEq
      rw [spacePart_spaceTime] at hEq
      exact hother r hri hrj u hquad hnorm (hEq ▸ hy)
    linarith
  have hmarkAmb : ∀ l : Fin 4,
      cobSpaceTime ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs
          hρrad hregneg Vneg heq).point l) (tcoord center - s ^ 2) =
        M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s := by
    intro l
    have hpt : (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg heq).point l =
        spacePart (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s) := rfl
    have htX : tcoord (M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).2 (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s) =
        tcoord center - s ^ 2 :=
      M.saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_time hindex _ _ hρ hs hρM
    rw [hpt, ← htX, spaceTime_spacePart]
  have hsrcMem : ∀ r : Fin 4,
      (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).point
        ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r) ∈
      (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange r := by
    intro r
    rw [← (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregneg Vneg heq).range_cyclicCutPath r]
    exact ⟨0, ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutPath r).source⟩
  have htgtMem : ∀ r : Fin 4,
      (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).point
        ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutTargetLabel r) ∈
      (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange r := by
    intro r
    rw [← (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregneg Vneg heq).range_cyclicCutPath r]
    exact ⟨1, ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
      hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutPath r).target⟩
  have hlabelOrbit : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ iloc → r ≠ jloc → ∀ l : Fin 4,
      (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg heq).point l ∈
        (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange r →
      spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ
          hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq).point l) (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
        (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
          (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos Vpos :
          Vpos.OrbitIndex) : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro r hri hrj l hl
    have hfar := hcutFar r hri hrj _ hl
    rw [hmarkAmb l] at hfar ⊢
    exact hcap (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l) hfar
  have hmemEq : ∀ {x y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
      {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}, x = y → y ∈ S → x ∈ S :=
    fun h hy => h ▸ hy
  have hlabelOrbit' : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ iloc → r ≠ jloc →
      ∀ (l : Fin 4) (e : SaddleBranch), (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l).1 = e →
      (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg heq).point l ∈
        (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange r →
      spacePart (R.base.flow
        (cobSpaceTime ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ
          hs hρrad hregneg Vneg heq).point l) (tcoord center - s ^ 2))
        (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
        ((T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e ρ s hρ hs hρrad hregpos
          Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
    intro r hri hrj l e he hl
    subst he
    exact hlabelOrbit r hri hrj l hl
  have hlabelEq : ∀ (r : Fin 4), r ≠ iloc → r ≠ jloc →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
        ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).1 =
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
        ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).1 := by
    intro r hri hrj
    by_contra hlab
    have hO := orbitIndex_eq_of_slabFlowFamily
      (R := R) (eps := eps) (dbefore := s ^ 2) (dafter := -(s ^ 2))
      (tbefore := tcoord center + s ^ 2)
      (tafter := tcoord center - s ^ 2)
      (hbefore := hregpos) (Vbefore := Vpos)
      ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutAmbientPath r).toContinuousMap
      (fun w => (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs
        hρrad hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutAmbientPath_fiber r w)
      (fun w => by
        show tcoord (cobSpaceTime
          ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutPath r w)
          (tcoord center - s ^ 2)) = tcoord center - s ^ 2
        rw [tcoord_spaceTime])
      (fun w => by
        have h := hcutFar r hri hrj
          ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutPath r w)
          (by
            rw [← (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs
              hρrad hregneg Vneg heq).range_cyclicCutPath r]
            exact ⟨w, rfl⟩)
        rw [habsn]
        exact h)
      hunit rfl (by ring) (by rw [habs]; exact hsafe)
      (by rw [habsn]; exact hsafe)
      (O := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
          ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos)
      (O' := T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex
        (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
          ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).1 ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregpos Vpos)
      (w := 0) (w' := 1)
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))))
          ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutAmbientPath r).source)
        (hlabelOrbit r hri hrj _ (hsrcMem r)))
      (hmemEq
        (congrArg (fun z => spacePart (R.base.flow z (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))))
          ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutAmbientPath r).target)
        (hlabelOrbit r hri hrj _ (htgtMem r)))
    apply hne
    rcases hp : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
      ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
        hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r)).1 with _ | _ <;>
      rcases hq : (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
        ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutTargetLabel r)).1 with _ | _ <;>
      rw [hp, hq] at hO hlab
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
    · exact hO.symm
    · exact hO
    · exact absurd rfl hlab
  have hassemble : ∀ (r₁ r₂ : Fin 4), r₁ ≠ iloc → r₁ ≠ jloc → r₂ ≠ iloc →
      r₂ ≠ jloc →
      ∀ c₀ c₁ c₂ c₃ : I, c₀ ≠ c₁ → ¬(c₀ = 0 ∧ c₁ = 1) → ¬(c₀ = 1 ∧ c₁ = 0) →
      c₂ ≠ c₃ → ¬(c₂ = 0 ∧ c₃ = 1) → ¬(c₂ = 1 ∧ c₃ = 0) →
      (∀ q : I, (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
          hρrad hregneg Vneg).curve (Set.Icc.convexComb c₀ c₁ q) ∈
        (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange r₁) →
      (∀ q : I, (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
          hρrad hregneg Vneg).curve (Set.Icc.convexComb c₂ c₃ q) ∈
        (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange r₂) →
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg).curve c₀ =
        (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).point
          ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r₁) →
      (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg).curve c₂ =
        (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).point
          ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r₂) →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
        ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r₁)).1 =
          SaddleBranch.negative →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour
        ((T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
          hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutSourceLabel r₂)).1 =
          SaddleBranch.positive →
      ∃ B : SaddleChartHitBand M ρ eps (s ^ 2) (-(s ^ 2)) R hregpos hregneg
          Vpos Vneg
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos)
          (T.saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .positive ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregpos Vpos)
          (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg),
        (∀ q : I, (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs
            hρrad hregneg Vneg).curve (Set.Icc.convexComb B.cut₀ B.cut₁ q) ∈
          (T.saddleNegativeCommonOrbitCyclicMarking hindex ρ s hρ hs hρrad
            hregneg Vneg heq).cyclicCutRange r₁) ∧
        (∀ q : I, (T.saddleNegativeBranchOrbitParam hindex .negative ρ s hρ hs

statement:
theorem exists_smallSaddleBoundaryRadius_endpointCoverTarget
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) {r : ℝ}
    (hcover : ∃ ε > 0,
      ∀ v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
        dist v center < ε → C.G v = 0 →
        ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧ M.param u = v) :
    ∃ rho > 0, rho < T.radius ∧ ∃ δ > 0,
      ∀ (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
        (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))),
        dist v (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho) < δ →
        C.G v = 0 →
        ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < r ∧ M.param u = v
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hcover⟩ := hcover
  have hzero : ‖(0 : E₂)‖ < T.radius := by
    simpa using T.radius_pos
  have hcont : ContinuousAt M.param 0 :=
    (T.param_differentiableAt 0 hzero).continuousAt
  obtain ⟨eta, heta, hclose⟩ := (Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hcont)
    (ε / 2) (by positivity)
  let rho := min T.radius eta / 2
  have hmin : 0 < min T.radius eta := lt_min T.radius_pos heta
  have hrho : 0 < rho := by
    dsimp [rho]
    positivity
  have hrhoT : rho < T.radius := by
    dsimp [rho]
    have hle := min_le_left T.radius eta
    nlinarith
  have hrhoEta : rho < eta := by
    dsimp [rho]
    have hle := min_le_right T.radius eta
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨rho, hrho, hrhoT, ε / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro p v hv hendFiber
  have hendClose : dist (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho) center <
      ε / 2 := by
    let u := saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam p rho
    have huEta : dist u 0 < eta := by
      rw [dist_zero_right, show ‖u‖ = rho by
        exact norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam p.1 p.2 hrho
          (by nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hrho])]
      exact hrhoEta
    have h := hclose huEta
    simpa [u, M.param_zero,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd,
      saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint] using h
  have hvCenter : dist v center < ε := by
    calc
      dist v center ≤ dist v (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho) +
          dist (M.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p rho) center :=
        dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ < ε := by linarith
  exact hcover v hvCenter hendFiber

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.nonempty_saddleArcCutScale
statement:
theorem nonempty_saddleArcCutScale
    (Cov : ChronologicalSaddleSmallEndCover D t ht)
    {p q : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch} (B : SaddleArcCutArc Cov p q) :
    Nonempty (SaddleArcCutScale Cov B)
proof:
:= by
  let R := saddleArcCutTimeField Cov B
  let m := saddleArcCutMargin Cov
  let Bd : ℝ := (R.base.bound : ℝ)
  have hsafeN : {x : ℝ | x ^ 2 < R.safeTime} ∈ nhds 0 := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => x ^ 2) 0 :=
        continuousAt_id.pow 2
      simpa using hcont.tendsto
    exact hlim (Iio_mem_nhds R.safeTime_pos)
  have hmarginN : {x : ℝ | Bd * x ^ 2 < m} ∈ nhds 0 := by
    have hlim : Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Bd * x ^ 2) (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
      have hcont : ContinuousAt (fun x : ℝ => Bd * x ^ 2) 0 :=
        continuousAt_const.mul (continuousAt_id.pow 2)
      simpa using hcont.tendsto
    exact hlim (Iio_mem_nhds (saddleArcCutMargin_pos Cov))
  have hgood : {x : ℝ | x ^ 2 < R.safeTime ∧ Bd * x ^ 2 < m} ∈ nhds 0 :=
    Filter.inter_mem hsafeN hmarginN
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hgood
  let c := min (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht) δ
  let b := c / 2
  have hc : 0 < c := lt_min (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht) hδ
  have hb : 0 < b := div_pos hc (by norm_num)
  have hbc : b < c := by dsimp [b]; linarith
  have hba : b < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    hbc.trans_le (min_le_left _ _)
  have hbδ : dist b (0 : ℝ) < δ := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, abs_of_pos hb]
    exact hbc.trans_le (min_le_right _ _)
  have hbGood := hball hbδ
  refine ⟨{
    scale := b
    scale_pos := hb
    scale_lt_window := hba
    safe := hbGood.1.le
    cover_close := ?_
    positive_branch_close := ?_
    negative_branch_close := ?_ }⟩
  · exact hbGood.2.trans_le (saddleArcCutMargin_le_delta Cov)
  · intro r
    exact hbGood.2.trans_le (saddleArcCutMargin_le_positiveBranch Cov r)
  · intro r
    exact hbGood.2.trans_le (saddleArcCutMargin_le_negativeBranch Cov r)

statement:
private theorem saddleArcCut_eventTime_eq_of_mem_bracket
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    {s : ℝ} (hsEvent : s ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hs : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after) :
    s = t
proof:
:= by
  let v := D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent
  have hvCritical : v ∈ timeCritical D.signedOutput.cobordism.G :=
    (D.position.eventCenter_mem_coreCriticalPoints s hsEvent).1
  have hvInterval : tcoord v ∈
      Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
        (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
    change tcoord (D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent) ∈ _
    rw [D.position.eventCenter_time s hsEvent]
    exact hs
  have hvEq : v = D.position.eventCenter t ht :=
    (D.position.eventBracket t ht).isolates v hvCritical hvInterval
  calc
    s = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter s hsEvent) :=
      (D.position.eventCenter_time s hsEvent).symm
    _ = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := congrArg tcoord hvEq
    _ = t := D.position.eventCenter_time t ht

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.regularSlab_saddleArcCutAfter_to_window
proof:
:= by
  rw [D.position.regularSlab_iff_avoid_eventTimes]
  intro s hsEvent hs
  have hcenterShort : tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) <
      saddleArcCutAfterTime S := by
    rw [saddleArcCutAfterTime]
    exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ (sq_pos_of_pos S.scale_pos)
  have hsBracket : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
    constructor
    · exact (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before_lt.le.trans
        (hcenterShort.le.trans hs.1)
    · exact hs.2.trans
        (D.chronologicalAfterTime_mem_bracket t ht).2.le
  have hst : s = t :=
    saddleArcCut_eventTime_eq_of_mem_bracket D t ht hsEvent hsBracket
  have htShort : t < saddleArcCutAfterTime S :=
    (D.position.eventCenter_time t ht).symm.trans_lt hcenterShort
  exact (not_le_of_gt htShort) (hst ▸ hs.1)

proof:
:= by

      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    rw [saddleArcCutBeforeTime]
    exact sub_lt_self _ (sq_pos_of_pos S.scale_pos)
  have hsBracket : s ∈ Icc (D.position.eventBracket t ht).before
      (D.position.eventBracket t ht).after := by
    constructor
    · exact (D.chronologicalBeforeTime_mem_bracket t ht).1.le.trans hs.1
    · exact hs.2.trans
        (hshortCenter.le.trans (D.position.eventBracket t ht).lt_after.le)
  have hst : s = t :=
    saddleArcCut_eventTime_eq_of_mem_bracket D t ht hsEvent hsBracket
  have hshortT : saddleArcCutBeforeTime S < t :=
    hshortCenter.trans_eq (D.position.eventCenter_time t ht)
  exact (not_le_of_gt hshortT) (hst ▸ hs.2)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_saddleArcCutPositiveCapture
statement:
theorem exists_saddleArcCutPositiveCapture
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    {Cov : ChronologicalSaddleSmallEndCover D t ht}
    {p q : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch} {B : SaddleArcCutArc Cov p q}
    (S : SaddleArcCutScale Cov B)
    (r : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    (hmem : (D.position.eventModel t ht).param
        (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam r Cov.sigma) ∈
      SaddleCriticalExteriorArc.recoveryCore (n := n) B) :
    ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht ∧
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u =
        (saddleArcCutTimeField Cov B).base.flow
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r
            Cov.sigma) (S.scale ^ 2) ∧
      0 < signedBranch r.1 (u 0) ∧
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = S.scale ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let R := saddleArcCutTimeField Cov B
  let u₀ := saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam r Cov.sigma
  have hu₀Radius : ‖u₀‖ < M.radius := by
    calc
      ‖u₀‖ = Cov.sigma := saddleArcCutEndParam_norm Cov r
      _ < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
        Cov.sigma_lt_embedded
      _ ≤ M.radius := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hquad₀ : morseQuadratic .saddle (u₀ 0, u₀ 1) = 0 := by
    simp [u₀, saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
      saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam]
  have hex :=
    M.exists_positiveFlowEndpoint_of_localCover R hindex r.1 0 u₀
      hu₀Radius hquad₀ hmem
      (r := D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
      (εcover := Cov.delta)
      (εbranch := saddleArcCutPositiveBranchRadius Cov r)
      (A := S.scale)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_le_eventRadius t ht)
      (by
        intro v hv hfiber
        apply Cov.cover r v
        · simpa [M, u₀, saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
            StandardMorseEventAt.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd,
            StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
            StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint] using hv
        · exact hfiber)
      (by
        intro v hv hdist
        exact saddleArcCutPositiveBranchRadius_spec Cov r v hv hdist)
      S.safe S.cover_close (S.positive_branch_close r)
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hend, hsign, hquad⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_, hsign, hquad⟩
  simpa [M, R, u₀, saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
    StandardMorseEventAt.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd,
    StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
    StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint] using hend

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.exists_saddleArcCutNegativeCapture
statement:
theorem exists_saddleArcCutNegativeCapture
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    {Cov : ChronologicalSaddleSmallEndCover D t ht}
    {p q : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch} {B : SaddleArcCutArc Cov p q}
    (S : SaddleArcCutScale Cov B)
    (r : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    (hmem : (D.position.eventModel t ht).param
        (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam r Cov.sigma) ∈
      SaddleCriticalExteriorArc.recoveryCore (n := n) B) :
    ∃ u : E₂, ‖u‖ < D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht ∧
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).param u =
        (saddleArcCutTimeField Cov B).base.flow
          ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r
            Cov.sigma) (-(S.scale ^ 2)) ∧
      0 < signedBranch r.2 (u 1) ∧
      morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(S.scale ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let R := saddleArcCutTimeField Cov B
  let u₀ := saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam r Cov.sigma
  have hu₀Radius : ‖u₀‖ < M.radius := by
    calc
      ‖u₀‖ = Cov.sigma := saddleArcCutEndParam_norm Cov r
      _ < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
        Cov.sigma_lt_embedded
      _ ≤ M.radius := (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  have hquad₀ : morseQuadratic .saddle (u₀ 0, u₀ 1) = 0 := by
    simp [u₀, saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
      saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam]
  have hex :=
    M.exists_negativeFlowEndpoint_of_localCover R hindex r.2 1 u₀
      hu₀Radius hquad₀ hmem
      (r := D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius t ht)
      (εcover := Cov.delta)
      (εbranch := saddleArcCutNegativeBranchRadius Cov r)
      (A := S.scale)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_le_eventRadius t ht)
      (by
        intro v hv hfiber
        apply Cov.cover r v
        · simpa [M, u₀, saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
            StandardMorseEventAt.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd,
            StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
            StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint] using hv
        · exact hfiber)
      (by
        intro v hv hdist
        exact saddleArcCutNegativeBranchRadius_spec Cov r v hv hdist)
      S.safe S.cover_close (S.negative_branch_close r)
  obtain ⟨u, hu, hend, hsign, hquad⟩ := hex
  refine ⟨u, hu, ?_, hsign, hquad⟩
  simpa [M, R, u₀, saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam,
    StandardMorseEventAt.saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd,
    StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
    StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint] using hend

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.saddleArcCut_positiveFlow_mem_branchOrbit
statement:
theorem saddleArcCut_positiveFlow_mem_branchOrbit
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    {Cov : ChronologicalSaddleSmallEndCover D t ht}
    {p q : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch} {B : SaddleArcCutArc Cov p q}
    (S : SaddleArcCutScale Cov B)
    (r : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    (hmem : (D.position.eventModel t ht).param
        (saddleCriticalBoundaryEndParam r Cov.sigma) ∈
      SaddleCriticalExteriorArc.recoveryCore (n := n) B) :
    spacePart ((saddleArcCutTimeField Cov B).base.flow
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r
          Cov.sigma) (S.scale ^ 2)) ∈
      (saddleArcCutAfterField S).orbit

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.saddleArcCut_positiveBase_window_orbit
statement:
theorem saddleArcCut_positiveBase_window_orbit
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    {Cov : ChronologicalSaddleSmallEndCover D t ht}
    {p q : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch} {B : SaddleArcCutArc Cov p q}
    (S : SaddleArcCutScale Cov B) (branch : SaddleBranch) :
    spacePart
        ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchBase
          branch (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
          (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)) ∈
      (D.chronologicalAfterField t ht).orbit
        ((saddleArcCutAfterSlabField S).sliceTransport
          (saddleArcCutAfterTime S) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
          (spacePart
            ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchBase
              branch (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
              S.scale)))
proof:
:= by
  let M := D.position.eventModel t ht
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let H := D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht
  let b := S.scale
  let afix := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht
  let r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  let sourceTime := saddleArcCutAfterTime S
  let targetTime := D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht
  let hreg := regularSlab_saddleArcCutAfter_to_window S
  let W := saddleArcCutAfterSlabField S
  let Vtarget := D.chronologicalAfterField t ht
  let c : C(I, ℝ) := {
    toFun := fun w => b + (w : ℝ) * (afix - b)
    continuous_toFun :=
      continuous_const.add (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const) }
  have hbc (w : I) : b ≤ c w := by
    dsimp [c]
    have hw₀ : 0 ≤ (w : ℝ) := w.property.1
    have hab : 0 < afix - b := sub_pos.mpr S.scale_lt_window
    nlinarith
  have hca (w : I) : c w ≤ afix := by
    dsimp [c]
    have hw₁ : (w : ℝ) ≤ 1 := w.property.2
    have hab : 0 < afix - b := sub_pos.mpr S.scale_lt_window
    nlinarith
  have hcpos (w : I) : 0 < c w := S.scale_pos.trans_le (hbc w)
  have hcr (w : I) : c w < r :=
    (hca w).trans_lt (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
  have hcsq (w : I) : (c w) ^ 2 < r ^ 2 :=
    (sq_lt_sq₀ (hcpos w).le
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht).le).2 (hcr w)
  let u : I → E₂ := fun w =>
    saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam branch .negative r (c w)
  have hucont : Continuous u := by
    dsimp [u, c]
    cases branch <;>
      simp [saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam, saddlePositiveArc,
        saddleBoundaryParameter, pairToMorseParam, signedBranch] <;>
      fun_prop
  have huRadius (w : I) : ‖u w‖ < M.radius := by
    rw [show ‖u w‖ = r from
      norm_saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam branch .negative
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) (hcsq w)]
    exact (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht).trans_le
      T.radius_le
  let z : C(I, E') := {
    toFun := fun w => M.param (u w)
    continuous_toFun := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro w
      exact (H.differentiableAt (u w) (huRadius w)).continuousAt.comp'
        hucont.continuousAt }
  let tau : C(I, ℝ) := {
    toFun := fun w => afix ^ 2 - (c w) ^ 2
    continuous_toFun := continuous_const.sub (c.continuous.pow 2) }
  let gamma : C(I, E₁) := {
    toFun := fun w => spacePart (W.flow (z w) (tau w))
    continuous_toFun := continuous_spacePart.comp
      (W.continuous_flow_uncurry.comp
        (z.continuous.prodMk tau.continuous)) }
  have hsourceMem (w : I) :
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c w) ^ 2 ∈
        Icc sourceTime targetTime := by
    have hbSq : b ^ 2 ≤ (c w) ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ S.scale_pos.le (hcpos w).le).2 (hbc w)
    have hcSq : (c w) ^ 2 ≤ afix ^ 2 :=
      (sq_le_sq₀ (hcpos w).le
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius_pos t ht).le).2 (hca w)
    constructor
    · simpa [sourceTime, saddleArcCutAfterTime, b] using
        add_le_add_left hbSq (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
    · simpa [targetTime, chronologicalAfterTime, afix] using
        add_le_add_left hcSq (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
  have htargetMem : targetTime ∈ Icc sourceTime targetTime :=
    ⟨saddleArcCutAfterTime_le_window S, le_rfl⟩
  have hzFiber (w : I) : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G (z w) = 0 := by
    exact M.param_fiber (u w) (huRadius w)
  have hzTime (w : I) : tcoord (z w) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c w) ^ 2 := by
    have htime := M.time_model (u w) (huRadius w)
    rw [hindex] at htime
    simpa [z, u, saddlePositiveBoundaryEndParam] using htime
  have hgammaFiber : ∀ w,
      gamma w ∈ (D.chronologicalAfterSlice t ht).fiber := by
    intro w
    have hx : spacePart (z w) ∈ SlabTamedField.sliceFiber
        D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c w) ^ 2) := by
      change D.signedOutput.cobordism.G
        (cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z w))
          (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c w) ^ 2)) = 0
      rw [← hzTime w, spaceTime_spacePart]
      exact hzFiber w
    have hmap := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg (hsourceMem w) htargetMem hx
    have hzst : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z w))
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + (c w) ^ 2) = z w := by
      rw [← hzTime w, spaceTime_spacePart]
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceTransport, hzst] at hmap
    change D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.G
      (cobSpaceTime (gamma w) targetTime) = 0
    simpa [SlabTamedField.sliceFiber, gamma, tau, targetTime,
      chronologicalAfterTime, afix] using hmap
  have hgamma₀ : gamma 0 =
      W.sliceTransport sourceTime targetTime
        (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r b)) := by
    have hz₀Time : tcoord (z 0) = sourceTime := by
      simpa [sourceTime, saddleArcCutAfterTime, c, b] using hzTime 0
    have hz₀st : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (z 0)) sourceTime = z 0 := by
      rw [← hz₀Time, spaceTime_spacePart]
    have hz₀Base : z 0 = T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r b := by
      simp [z, u, c,
        StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchBase,
        StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
        StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, b, r]
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceTransport, ← hz₀Base, hz₀st]
    simp [gamma, tau, z, u, c, sourceTime, targetTime,
      saddleArcCutAfterTime, chronologicalAfterTime,
      StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchBase,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, afix, b, r]
  have hgamma₁ : gamma 1 =
      spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase branch r afix) := by
    simp [gamma, tau, z, u, c,
      StandardMorseEventAt.EmbeddedShrink.saddlePositiveBranchBase,
      StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd,
      StandardMorseEventAt.localPoint, M, T, afix, b, r]
  have hpath := Vtarget.continuousMap_mem_orbit gamma hgammaFiber 1
  rw [hgamma₀, hgamma₁] at hpath
  exact hpath

    (S : SaddleArcCutScale Cov B) :

      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex q.1
proof:

  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  let afix := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht
  let V := saddleArcCutAfterField S
  let Vwin := D.chronologicalAfterField t ht

    ⟨le_rfl, saddleArcCutAfterTime_le_window S⟩
  have htgt : D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht ∈
      Icc (saddleArcCutAfterTime S) (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) :=
    ⟨saddleArcCutAfterTime_le_window S, le_rfl⟩
  have hbase := saddleArcCut_positiveBase_mem hindex S
  have hfib : spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase p.1 r S.scale) ∈
      (T.saddlePositiveSlice S.scale
        (saddleArcCutAfterTime_regular S)).fiber :=
    T.saddlePositiveBranchBase_mem_fiber hindex p.1
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (saddleArcCutScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq S)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
      (saddleArcCutAfterTime_regular S)
  have htrans := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo_orbit hregslab hsrc htgt
    V Vwin hfib hbase
  have hpWin := saddleArcCut_positiveBase_window_orbit hindex S p.1
  have hqWin := saddleArcCut_positiveBase_window_orbit hindex S q.1
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Vwin.orbit (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase p.1 r afix)) =
    Vwin.orbit (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase q.1 r afix))
  calc
    Vwin.orbit (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase p.1 r afix)) =
        Vwin.orbit (W.sliceTransport (saddleArcCutAfterTime S)
          (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
          (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase p.1 r S.scale))) :=
      Vwin.orbit_eq_of_mem hpWin
    _ = Vwin.orbit (W.sliceTransport (saddleArcCutAfterTime S)
          (D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht)
          (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase q.1 r S.scale))) :=
      (Vwin.orbit_eq_of_mem htrans).symm
    _ = Vwin.orbit (spacePart (T.saddlePositiveBranchBase q.1 r afix)) :=
      (Vwin.orbit_eq_of_mem hqWin).symm

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.saddleArcCut_negativeWindowOrbit_eq
statement:
theorem saddleArcCut_negativeWindowOrbit_eq
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    {Cov : ChronologicalSaddleSmallEndCover D t ht}
    {p q : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch} {B : SaddleArcCutArc Cov p q}
    (S : SaddleArcCutScale Cov B) :
    D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex p.2 =
      D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex q.2
proof:
:= by
  let T := D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht
  let r := D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht
  let afix := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht
  let V := saddleArcCutBeforeField S
  let Vwin := D.chronologicalBeforeField t ht
  let W := saddleArcCutBeforeSlabField S
  let hregslab := regularSlab_window_to_saddleArcCutBefore S
  have hsrc : saddleArcCutBeforeTime S ∈
      Icc (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) (saddleArcCutBeforeTime S) :=
    ⟨window_le_saddleArcCutBeforeTime S, le_rfl⟩
  have htgt : D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht ∈
      Icc (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) (saddleArcCutBeforeTime S) :=
    ⟨le_rfl, window_le_saddleArcCutBeforeTime S⟩
  have hbase := saddleArcCut_negativeBase_mem hindex S
  have hfib : spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase p.2 r S.scale) ∈
      (T.saddleNegativeSlice S.scale
        (saddleArcCutBeforeTime_regular S)).fiber :=
    T.saddleNegativeBranchBase_mem_fiber hindex p.2
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
      (saddleArcCutScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundaryRadius_sq S)
      (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
      (saddleArcCutBeforeTime_regular S)
  have htrans := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo_orbit hregslab hsrc htgt
    V Vwin hfib hbase
  have hpWin := saddleArcCut_negativeBase_window_orbit hindex S p.2
  have hqWin := saddleArcCut_negativeBase_window_orbit hindex S q.2
  apply Subtype.ext
  change Vwin.orbit (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase p.2 r afix)) =
    Vwin.orbit (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase q.2 r afix))
  calc
    Vwin.orbit (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase p.2 r afix)) =
        Vwin.orbit (W.sliceTransport (saddleArcCutBeforeTime S)
          (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
          (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase p.2 r S.scale))) :=
      Vwin.orbit_eq_of_mem hpWin
    _ = Vwin.orbit (W.sliceTransport (saddleArcCutBeforeTime S)
          (D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht)
          (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase q.2 r S.scale))) :=
      (Vwin.orbit_eq_of_mem htrans).symm
    _ = Vwin.orbit (spacePart (T.saddleNegativeBranchBase q.2 r afix)) :=
      (Vwin.orbit_eq_of_mem hqWin).symm

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddleOrientedCutParity_of_topologyDichotomy
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddleOrientedCutParity_of_topologyDichotomy
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (h : D.ChronologicalSaddleMergeTopology t ht hindex ∨
      D.ChronologicalSaddleSplitTopology t ht hindex) :
    ChronologicalSaddleOrientedCutParity D t ht hindex where
  positive_common_excludes_negative
proof:
:= by
    intro hposEq
    rcases h with hm | hs
    · exact hm.negative_ne
    · exact absurd hposEq hs.positive_ne

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.saddleArcCut_checker_ne_of_parity
statement:
theorem saddleArcCut_checker_ne_of_parity
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (Par : ChronologicalSaddleOrientedCutParity D t ht hindex)
    {rho : ℝ} (hrho : 0 < rho)
    (hrho_radius : rho < (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius)
    {p q : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch} (hne : q ≠ p)
    (harc : Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
      (fun r => (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r rho)
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
        D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) p q)) :
    saddleBranchEndChecker p ≠ saddleBranchEndChecker q
proof:
:= by
  intro hchecker
  obtain ⟨Cov⟩ := nonempty_chronologicalSaddleSmallEndCover D t ht
  have hBne : Nonempty (SaddleArcCutArc Cov p q) :=
    harc.map fun B0 =>
      B0.changeSaddleBoundaryRadius
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) hindex
        hrho Cov.sigma_pos hrho_radius Cov.sigma_lt_embedded
  obtain ⟨B⟩ := hBne
  obtain ⟨S⟩ := nonempty_saddleArcCutScale Cov B
  have hpos := saddleArcCut_positiveWindowOrbit_eq hindex S
  have hneg := saddleArcCut_negativeWindowOrbit_eq hindex S
  have hlabels : p.1 ≠ q.1 ∧ p.2 ≠ q.2 := by
    rcases p with ⟨p1, p2⟩
    rcases q with ⟨q1, q2⟩
    cases p1 <;> cases p2 <;> cases q1 <;> cases q2 <;>
      simp_all [saddleBranchEndChecker]
  have hposNP : D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .negative =
      D.chronologicalSaddlePositiveOrbit t ht hindex .positive := by
    have h := hpos
    cases hp1 : p.1 <;> cases hq1 : q.1 <;> rw [hp1, hq1] at h
    · exact absurd (hp1.trans hq1.symm) hlabels.1
    · exact h.symm
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (hp1.trans hq1.symm) hlabels.1
  have hnegNP : D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .negative =
      D.chronologicalSaddleNegativeOrbit t ht hindex .positive := by
    have h := hneg
    cases hp2 : p.2 <;> cases hq2 : q.2 <;> rw [hp2, hq2] at h
    · exact absurd (hp2.trans hq2.symm) hlabels.2
    · exact h.symm
    · exact h
    · exact absurd (hp2.trans hq2.symm) hlabels.2
  exact Par.positive_common_excludes_negative hposNP hnegNP

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddle_arc_checker_ne_of_parity
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddle_arc_checker_ne_of_parity
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    (Par : ChronologicalSaddleOrientedCutParity D t ht hindex) :
    ∀ {p q : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch}, q ≠ p →
      Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
        (fun r => (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
        (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
          D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) p q) →
      saddleBranchEndChecker p ≠ saddleBranchEndChecker q
proof:
:= by
  intro p q hne harc
  exact saddleArcCut_checker_ne_of_parity D t ht hindex Par
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) hne harc

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddlePairingData_of_parity_of_flipSecond_arcs
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddlePairingData_of_parity_of_flipSecond_arcs
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)

      (fun r => (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd r
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
      (StandardMorseEventAt.puncturedCriticalSlice
        D.signedOutput.cobordism (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
      p (saddleBranchEndFlipSecond p))) :
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).SaddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData

proof:
:=
  StandardMorseEventAt.saddlePuncturedCriticalArcPairingData_of_flipSecond
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) mate_arc
    (fun {p q} hne harc =>
      chronologicalSaddle_arc_checker_ne_of_parity D t ht hindex Par
        (p := p) (q := q) hne harc)

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalSaddlePairingData_of_parity_of_flipFirst_arcs
statement:
theorem chronologicalSaddlePairingData_of_parity_of_flipFirst_arcs
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)

    (mate_arc : ∀ p, Nonempty (SaddleCriticalExteriorArc
