name: Submission.continuous_cubeClamp
statement: theorem continuous_cubeClamp : Continuous (cubeClamp (N := N))
proof:
:=
  continuous_pi fun i => continuous_projIcc.comp (continuous_apply i)

name: Submission.cubeClamp_coords
statement:
@[simp]
theorem cubeClamp_coords (t : I^N) : cubeClamp (fun i => (t i : ℝ)) = t
proof:
:=
  funext fun i => Set.projIcc_val zero_le_one (t i)

name: Submission.cubeClamp_coe_le
statement:
theorem cubeClamp_coe_le {v : N → ℝ} {i : N} (h : v i ≤ 1 / 4) :
    ((cubeClamp v i : ℝ)) ≤ 1 / 4
proof:
:= by
  rw [cubeClamp, Set.coe_projIcc]
  exact max_le (by norm_num) ((min_le_right _ _).trans h)

name: Submission.le_cubeClamp_coe
statement:
theorem le_cubeClamp_coe {v : N → ℝ} {i : N} (h : 3 / 4 ≤ v i) :
    (3 / 4 : ℝ) ≤ (cubeClamp v i : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [cubeClamp, Set.coe_projIcc]
  exact le_trans (le_min (by norm_num) h) (le_max_right _ _)

name: Submission.isOpen_ambientCollar
statement: theorem isOpen_ambientCollar : IsOpen (ambientCollar N)
proof:
:= by
  have h : ambientCollar N
      = ⋃ i, ({v : N → ℝ | v i < 1 / 4} ∪ {v : N → ℝ | 3 / 4 < v i}) := by
    ext v
    simp only [ambientCollar, mem_setOf_eq, mem_iUnion, mem_union]
  rw [h]
  exact isOpen_iUnion fun i =>
    (isOpen_lt (continuous_apply i) continuous_const).union
      (isOpen_lt continuous_const (continuous_apply i))

name: Submission.isClosed_closedAmbientCollar
statement: theorem isClosed_closedAmbientCollar [Finite N] : IsClosed (closedAmbientCollar N)
proof:
:= by
  have h : closedAmbientCollar N
      = ⋃ i, ({v : N → ℝ | v i ≤ 1 / 5} ∪ {v : N → ℝ | 4 / 5 ≤ v i}) := by
    ext v
    simp only [closedAmbientCollar, mem_setOf_eq, mem_iUnion, mem_union]
  rw [h]
  exact isClosed_iUnion_of_finite fun i =>
    (isClosed_le (continuous_apply i) continuous_const).union
      (isClosed_le continuous_const (continuous_apply i))

name: Submission.closedAmbientCollar_subset
statement: theorem closedAmbientCollar_subset : closedAmbientCollar N ⊆ ambientCollar N
proof:
:= by
  rintro v ⟨i, hi | hi⟩
  · exact ⟨i, Or.inl (by linarith)⟩
  · exact ⟨i, Or.inr (by linarith)⟩

name: Submission.coords_mem_closedAmbientCollar
statement:
theorem coords_mem_closedAmbientCollar {t : I^N} (ht : t ∈ Cube.boundary N) :
    (fun i => (t i : ℝ)) ∈ closedAmbientCollar N
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ := ht
  · refine ⟨i, Or.inl ?_⟩
    show (t i : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 5
    rw [hi, Set.Icc.coe_zero]
    norm_num
  · refine ⟨i, Or.inr ?_⟩
    show (4 / 5 : ℝ) ≤ (t i : ℝ)
    rw [hi, Set.Icc.coe_one]
    norm_num

name: Submission.continuous_extended
statement: theorem continuous_extended (p : Ω^ N (UnitSphere E) x) : Continuous (extended p)
proof:
:=
  continuous_subtype_val.comp ((map_continuous (collared p).1).comp continuous_cubeClamp)

name: Submission.norm_extended
statement:
theorem norm_extended (p : Ω^ N (UnitSphere E) x) (v : N → ℝ) :
    ‖extended p v‖ = 1
proof:
:=
  UnitSphere.norm_coe _

name: Submission.extended_coords
statement:
theorem extended_coords (p : Ω^ N (UnitSphere E) x) (t : I^N) :
    extended p (fun i => (t i : ℝ)) = ((collared p).1 t : E)
proof:
:= by
  show ((collared p).1 (cubeClamp fun i => (t i : ℝ)) : E) = _
  rw [cubeClamp_coords]

name: Submission.extended_eq_basepoint
statement:
theorem extended_eq_basepoint (p : Ω^ N (UnitSphere E) x) {v : N → ℝ}
    (hv : v ∈ ambientCollar N) : extended p v = (x : E)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨i, hi | hi⟩ := hv
  · exact congrArg Subtype.val (collared_eq_basepoint p ⟨i, Or.inl (cubeClamp_coe_le hi.le)⟩)
  · exact congrArg Subtype.val (collared_eq_basepoint p ⟨i, Or.inr (le_cubeClamp_coe hi.le)⟩)

name: Submission.contDiffOn_extended
statement:
theorem contDiffOn_extended [Fintype N] (p : Ω^ N (UnitSphere E) x) :
    ContDiffOn ℝ ∞ (extended p) (ambientCollar N)
proof:
:=
  contDiffOn_const.congr fun _ hv => extended_eq_basepoint p hv

name: Submission.Approximation.raw_ne_zero
statement:
theorem Approximation.raw_ne_zero [Fintype N] {p : Ω^ N (UnitSphere E) x} (a : Approximation p)
    (v : N → ℝ) : a.raw v ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  intro h0
  have h := a.raw_close v
  rw [h0, dist_zero_left, norm_extended] at h
  norm_num at h

name: Submission.exists_approximation
statement:
theorem exists_approximation [Fintype N] (p : Ω^ N (UnitSphere E) x) :
    Nonempty (Approximation p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨g, g_smooth, g_close, g_eq, -⟩ :=
    (continuous_extended p).exists_contDiff_approx_and_eqOn (ε := fun _ => 1 / 8) ⊤
      continuous_const (fun _ => by norm_num)
      isClosed_closedAmbientCollar
      (isOpen_ambientCollar.mem_nhdsSet.mpr closedAmbientCollar_subset)
      (contDiffOn_extended p)
  
  let gI : C(I^N, E) :=
    ⟨fun t => g (fun i => (t i : ℝ)),
      g_smooth.continuous.comp
        (continuous_pi fun i => continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_apply i))⟩
  have hclose1 : ∀ t : I^N, dist (((collared p).1 t : E)) (gI t) < 1 := by
    intro t
    have h8 := g_close (fun i => (t i : ℝ))
    rw [extended_coords] at h8
    have hsymm : dist (((collared p).1 t : E)) (gI t)
        = dist (gI t) (((collared p).1 t : E)) := dist_comm _ _
    rw [hsymm]
    calc dist (gI t) (((collared p).1 t : E)) < 1 / 8 := h8
    _ < 1 := by norm_num
  have hbnd : ∀ t ∈ Cube.boundary N, gI t = (x : E) := by
    intro t ht
    have h1 : gI t = extended p (fun i => (t i : ℝ)) :=
      g_eq (coords_mem_closedAmbientCollar ht)
    rw [h1, extended_coords]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val ((collared p).2 t ht)
  
  refine ⟨⟨g, g_smooth, fun v => by simpa using g_close v,
    fun v hv => (g_eq hv).trans
      (extended_eq_basepoint p (closedAmbientCollar_subset hv)),
    ⟨normalizeMap gI (ne_zero_of_dist_lt_one hclose1), fun t ht => ?_⟩,
    fun t => rfl, ?_⟩⟩
  · apply Subtype.ext
    rw [normalizeMap_coe, hbnd t ht, UnitSphere.norm_coe x, inv_one, one_smul]
  · refine (homotopic_collared p).trans ?_
    exact normalizedRawHomotopyRel (collared p).1 gI hclose1 (Cube.boundary N)
      fun t ht => by
        rw [hbnd t ht]
        exact (congrArg Subtype.val ((collared p).2 t ht)).symm

name: Submission.exists_approximation_of_homotopy_class
statement:
theorem exists_approximation_of_homotopy_class [Fintype N]
    (z : HomotopyGroup N (UnitSphere E) x) :
    ∃ (p : Ω^ N (UnitSphere E) x) (a : Approximation p), z = ⟦a.representative⟧
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, rfl⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep z
  obtain ⟨a⟩ := exists_approximation p
  exact ⟨p, a, Quotient.sound a.homotopic⟩

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.fullCoefficientBlock_det
statement:
theorem fullCoefficientBlock_det : ∀ k a b,
    (fullCoefficientBlock k a b).det = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2
  | 0, a, b => by
      rw [fullCoefficientBlock, Matrix.det_fin_three]
      simp only [Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
        Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.head_fin_const,
        Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
        Function.comp_apply, Matrix.cons_val_fin_one, Matrix.empty_val',
        Fin.succ_zero_eq_one]
      ring
  | k + 1, a, b => by
      rw [fullCoefficientBlock, incMatrix_det,
        fullCoefficientBlock_det k a b]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.fullCoefficientBlock_mul_transpose_of_normSq_one
statement:
theorem fullCoefficientBlock_mul_transpose_of_normSq_one : ∀ k a b,
    a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 1 →
      fullCoefficientBlock k a b * (fullCoefficientBlock k a b)ᵀ = 1
  | 0, a, b, h => by
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
        simp [fullCoefficientBlock, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three,
          Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply] <;> nlinarith
  | k + 1, a, b, h => by
      rw [fullCoefficientBlock, incMatrix_transpose, incMatrix_mul,
        fullCoefficientBlock_mul_transpose_of_normSq_one k a b h,
        incMatrix_one]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.fullCoefficientBlock_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
statement:
theorem fullCoefficientBlock_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
    (k : ℕ) {a b : ℝ} (h : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 1) :
    fullCoefficientBlock k a b ∈
      Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (k + 3)) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
  exact ⟨(Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff _ _).mpr
      (fullCoefficientBlock_mul_transpose_of_normSq_one k a b h),
    (fullCoefficientBlock_det k a b).trans h⟩

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.continuous_fullCoefficientBlock
statement:
theorem continuous_fullCoefficientBlock (k : ℕ) :
    Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => fullCoefficientBlock k p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      apply continuous_matrix
      intro i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
        simp [fullCoefficientBlock] <;> fun_prop
  | succ k ih =>
      show Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        incMatrix (fullCoefficientBlock k p.1 p.2)
      exact (ih.matrix_fromBlocks continuous_const continuous_const
        continuous_const).matrix_submatrix _ _

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.coefficientNorm_pos
statement:
theorem coefficientNorm_pos {a b : ℝ} (h : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) :
    0 < coefficientNorm a b
proof:
:=
  Real.sqrt_pos.2 h

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.coefficientNorm_sq
statement:
theorem coefficientNorm_sq {a b : ℝ} (h : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) :
    coefficientNorm a b ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + b ^ 2
proof:
:=
  Real.sq_sqrt h.le

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.normalized_coefficient_normSq
statement:
theorem normalized_coefficient_normSq {a b : ℝ}
    (h : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) :
    (a / coefficientNorm a b) ^ 2 +
        (b / coefficientNorm a b) ^ 2 = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hr := coefficientNorm_pos h
  rw [div_pow, div_pow, ← add_div, coefficientNorm_sq h]
  exact div_self h.ne'

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.coefficientSO_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem coefficientSO_coe (k : ℕ) (a b : ℝ)
    (h : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) :
    ((coefficientSO k a b h : SOGroup (k + 3)) :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 3)) (Fin (k + 3)) ℝ) =
      fullCoefficientBlock k (a / coefficientNorm a b)
        (b / coefficientNorm a b)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.continuous_coefficientSO
statement:
theorem continuous_coefficientSO {T : Type*} [TopologicalSpace T]
    (k : ℕ) {a b : T → ℝ} (ha : Continuous a) (hb : Continuous b)
    (h : ∀ t, 0 < a t ^ 2 + b t ^ 2) :
    Continuous fun t => coefficientSO k (a t) (b t) (h t)
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  have hnorm : Continuous fun t => coefficientNorm (a t) (b t) := by
    unfold coefficientNorm
    fun_prop
  have hp := (ha.div hnorm
      (fun t => (coefficientNorm_pos (h t)).ne')).prodMk
    (hb.div hnorm (fun t => (coefficientNorm_pos (h t)).ne'))
  change Continuous ((fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      fullCoefficientBlock k p.1 p.2) ∘ fun t =>
        (a t / coefficientNorm (a t) (b t),
          b t / coefficientNorm (a t) (b t)))
  exact (continuous_fullCoefficientBlock k).comp hp

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.coefficientCycleMatrix_mem
statement:
theorem coefficientCycleMatrix_mem : ∀ k,
    coefficientCycleMatrix k ∈
      Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (k + 3)) ℝ
  | 0 => by
      rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
      constructor
      · rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff]
        ext i j
        fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
          simp only [coefficientCycleMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply,
            Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.transpose_apply, Matrix.one_apply,
            Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
            Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.head_fin_const,
            Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
            Function.comp_apply] <;> norm_num
      · rw [coefficientCycleMatrix, Matrix.det_fin_three]
        simp only [Matrix.cons_val', Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
          Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.head_fin_const,
          Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.vecHead, Matrix.vecTail,
          Function.comp_apply]
        norm_num
  | k + 1 =>
      incMatrix_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup (coefficientCycleMatrix_mem k)

def coefficientCycleSO (k : ℕ) : SOGroup (k + 3)
proof:
:=
  ⟨coefficientCycleMatrix k, coefficientCycleMatrix_mem k⟩

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.coefficientCycleMatrix_transpose_mem
statement:
theorem coefficientCycleMatrix_transpose_mem (k : ℕ) :
    (coefficientCycleMatrix k)ᵀ ∈
      Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (k + 3)) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
  constructor
  · rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    have h := (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp
      (coefficientCycleMatrix_mem k)).1
    rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff] at h
    exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp h
  · rw [Matrix.det_transpose]
    exact (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp
      (coefficientCycleMatrix_mem k)).2

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.coefficientCycleSO_inv_coe
statement:
theorem coefficientCycleSO_inv_coe (k : ℕ) :
    (((coefficientCycleSO k)⁻¹ : SOGroup (k + 3)) :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 3)) (Fin (k + 3)) ℝ) =
      (coefficientCycleMatrix k)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have horth := (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp
    (coefficientCycleMatrix_mem k)).1
  have hmul : coefficientCycleSO k *
      ⟨(coefficientCycleMatrix k)ᵀ,
        coefficientCycleMatrix_transpose_mem k⟩ = 1 := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    rwa [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff] at horth
  have hinv := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hmul
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hinv.symm

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.coefficientCycle_conj_rotBlock
statement:
theorem coefficientCycle_conj_rotBlock : ∀ k theta,
    coefficientCycleMatrix k * rotBlock (k + 3) theta *
        (coefficientCycleMatrix k)ᵀ =
      fullCoefficientBlock k (Real.cos theta) (Real.sin theta)
  | 0, theta => by
      rw [rotBlock_three]
      have hleft : coefficientCycleMatrix 0 * rzMatrix theta =
          !![(0 : ℝ), 0, 1;
             Real.cos theta, -Real.sin theta, 0;
             Real.sin theta, Real.cos theta, 0]
proof:
:= by
        ext i j
        fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
          simp [coefficientCycleMatrix, rzMatrix, Matrix.mul_apply,
            Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.transpose_apply]
      rw [hleft]
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
        simp [coefficientCycleMatrix, fullCoefficientBlock,
          Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.transpose_apply]
  | k + 1, theta => by
      change incMatrix (coefficientCycleMatrix k) *
          rotBlock ((k + 3) + 1) theta *
            (incMatrix (coefficientCycleMatrix k))ᵀ =
        incMatrix (fullCoefficientBlock k (Real.cos theta) (Real.sin theta))
      rw [rotBlock_succ (k + 3) (by omega), incMatrix_transpose,
        incMatrix_mul, incMatrix_mul,
        coefficientCycle_conj_rotBlock k theta]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.normalPlaneLoop_closed
statement:
theorem normalPlaneLoop_closed (k : ℕ) (L : SO2AngleLoop) :
    normalPlaneLoop k L 0 = normalPlaneLoop k L 1
proof:
:= by
  simp only [normalPlaneLoop, ContinuousMap.mul_apply,
    ContinuousMap.const_apply]
  rw [L.frame_closed]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.normalPlaneLoop_coe
statement:
theorem normalPlaneLoop_coe (k : ℕ) (L : SO2AngleLoop) (u : I) :
    (normalPlaneLoop k L u : Matrix (Fin (k + 3)) (Fin (k + 3)) ℝ) =
      fullCoefficientBlock k (Real.cos (L.angle u))
        (Real.sin (L.angle u))
proof:
:= by
  change coefficientCycleMatrix k * rotBlock (k + 3) (L.angle u) *
      (((coefficientCycleSO k)⁻¹ : SOGroup (k + 3)) :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 3)) (Fin (k + 3)) ℝ) = _
  rw [coefficientCycleSO_inv_coe,
    coefficientCycle_conj_rotBlock]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.loopClassZ2_normalPlaneLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_normalPlaneLoop (k : ℕ) (L : SO2AngleLoop) :
    loopClassZ2 (normalPlaneLoop k L) (normalPlaneLoop_closed k L) =
      (L.winding : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hdim : 3 ≤ k + 3 := by omega
  have hconj := loopClassZ2_const_conj (coefficientCycleSO k)
    (L.frame (k + 3)) (L.frame_closed (k + 3))
  calc
    loopClassZ2 (normalPlaneLoop k L) (normalPlaneLoop_closed k L) =
        loopClassZ2 (L.frame (k + 3)) (L.frame_closed (k + 3)) := by
          simpa only [normalPlaneLoop] using hconj
    _ = (L.winding : ZMod 2) := L.loopClassZ2_frame hdim

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.sourceCoefficientLoop_closed
statement:
theorem sourceCoefficientLoop_closed (k : ℕ) :
    sourceCoefficientLoop k 0 = sourceCoefficientLoop k 1
proof:
:=
  normalPlaneLoop_closed k (SO2AngleLoop.linear 1)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.sourceCoefficientLoop_coe
statement:
theorem sourceCoefficientLoop_coe (k : ℕ) (u : I) :
    (sourceCoefficientLoop k u :
        Matrix (Fin (k + 3)) (Fin (k + 3)) ℝ) =
      fullCoefficientBlock k
        (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)))
        (Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [sourceCoefficientLoop, normalPlaneLoop_coe]
  congr 2 <;> simp [SO2AngleLoop.linear, linearAngle]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.loopClassZ2_sourceCoefficientLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_sourceCoefficientLoop (k : ℕ) :
    loopClassZ2 (sourceCoefficientLoop k)
        (sourceCoefficientLoop_closed k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  simpa [sourceCoefficientLoop, SO2AngleLoop.linear] using
    (loopClassZ2_normalPlaneLoop k (SO2AngleLoop.linear 1))

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.continuous_targetCoeffRe
statement:
theorem continuous_targetCoeffRe :
    Continuous fun p : ℝ × ℝ => targetCoeffRe p.1 p.2
proof:
:= by
  unfold targetCoeffRe
  exact (((StandardSaddle.continuous_targetRadius.comp continuous_snd).pow 2).mul
      (((Real.continuous_cos.comp continuous_snd).pow 2).sub
        ((Real.continuous_sin.comp continuous_snd).pow 2))).sub continuous_fst

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.continuous_targetCoeffIm
statement: theorem continuous_targetCoeffIm : Continuous targetCoeffIm
proof:
:= by
  unfold targetCoeffIm
  exact (((continuous_const.mul
      (StandardSaddle.continuous_targetRadius.pow 2)).mul
        Real.continuous_cos).mul Real.continuous_sin)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.targetCoeff_normSq_pos_during_homotopy
statement:
theorem targetCoeff_normSq_pos_during_homotopy
    (m : ℕ) {s theta : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) :
    0 < targetCoeffRe s theta ^ 2 + targetCoeffIm theta ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  rcases targetCoeff_ne_zero_during_homotopy m hs0 hs1 with ha | hb
  · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero ha]
  · nlinarith [sq_pos_of_ne_zero hb]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.targetCoeffRe_two_pi
statement:
theorem targetCoeffRe_two_pi (m : ℕ) (s : ℝ) :
    targetCoeffRe s (2 * Real.pi) = targetCoeffRe s 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp := StandardSaddle.targetPoint_two_pi m
  have hre := congrArg
    (fun x => ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistRe m (spaceTime x 1)) hp
  rw [twistRe_target m, twistRe_target m] at hre
  calc
    targetCoeffRe s (2 * Real.pi) =
        targetCoeffRe 1 (2 * Real.pi) + (1 - s) := by
          simp only [targetCoeffRe]
          ring
    _ = targetCoeffRe 1 0 + (1 - s) := by rw [hre]
    _ = targetCoeffRe s 0 := by
      simp only [targetCoeffRe]
      ring

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.targetCoeffIm_two_pi
statement:
theorem targetCoeffIm_two_pi (m : ℕ) :
    targetCoeffIm (2 * Real.pi) = targetCoeffIm 0
proof:
:= by
  have hp := StandardSaddle.targetPoint_two_pi m
  have him := congrArg
    (fun x => ConcreteZeroPairCassiniTwist.twistIm m (spaceTime x 1)) hp
  rwa [twistIm_target m, twistIm_target m] at him

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.targetCoefficientLoop_normSq_pos
statement:
theorem targetCoefficientLoop_normSq_pos (m : ℕ) (u : I) :
    0 < targetCoefficientReLoop u ^ 2 + targetCoefficientImLoop u ^ 2
proof:
:=
  targetCoeff_normSq_pos_during_homotopy m (by norm_num) (by norm_num)

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.targetCoefficientLoop_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem targetCoefficientLoop_coe (m : ℕ) (u : I) :
    (targetCoefficientLoop m u :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) =
      fullCoefficientBlock m
        (targetCoeffRe 1 (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) /
          coefficientNorm
            (targetCoeffRe 1 (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)))
            (targetCoeffIm (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))
        (targetCoeffIm (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)) /
          coefficientNorm
            (targetCoeffRe 1 (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ)))
            (targetCoeffIm (2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ))))
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.targetCoefficientLoop_closed
statement:
theorem targetCoefficientLoop_closed (m : ℕ) :
    targetCoefficientLoop m 0 = targetCoefficientLoop m 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [targetCoefficientLoop_coe, targetCoefficientLoop_coe]
  simp only [Set.Icc.coe_zero, mul_zero, Set.Icc.coe_one, mul_one]
  rw [targetCoeffRe_two_pi m 1, targetCoeffIm_two_pi m]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.coefficientSO_smul_polar
statement:
theorem coefficientSO_smul_polar (k : ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 < c)
    (phi : ℝ) :
    ((coefficientSO k (c * Real.cos phi) (c * Real.sin phi)
        (by
          have htrig := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq phi
          nlinarith [sq_pos_of_pos hc]) : SOGroup (k + 3)) :
      Matrix (Fin (k + 3)) (Fin (k + 3)) ℝ) =
        fullCoefficientBlock k (Real.cos phi) (Real.sin phi)
proof:
:= by
  rw [coefficientSO_coe]
  have hnorm : coefficientNorm (c * Real.cos phi) (c * Real.sin phi) = c := by
    unfold coefficientNorm
    have htrig := Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq phi
    rw [show (c * Real.cos phi) ^ 2 + (c * Real.sin phi) ^ 2 = c ^ 2 by
      nlinarith]
    exact Real.sqrt_sq hc.le
  rw [hnorm]
  congr 2 <;> field_simp [hc.ne']

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.targetCoefficientHomotopy_normSq_pos
statement:
theorem targetCoefficientHomotopy_normSq_pos (m : ℕ) (p : I × I) :
    0 < targetCoefficientHomotopyRe p ^ 2 +
      targetCoefficientHomotopyIm p ^ 2
proof:
:= by
  change 0 < targetCoeffRe (1 - (p.1 : ℝ))
      (2 * Real.pi * (p.2 : ℝ)) ^ 2 +
    targetCoeffIm (2 * Real.pi * (p.2 : ℝ)) ^ 2
  exact targetCoeff_normSq_pos_during_homotopy m
    (sub_nonneg.mpr p.1.2.2) (by linarith [p.1.2.1])

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.targetCoefficientHomotopyMap_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem targetCoefficientHomotopyMap_coe (m : ℕ) (p : I × I) :
    (targetCoefficientHomotopyMap m p :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) =
      fullCoefficientBlock m
        (targetCoeffRe (1 - (p.1 : ℝ))
            (2 * Real.pi * (p.2 : ℝ)) /
          coefficientNorm
            (targetCoeffRe (1 - (p.1 : ℝ))
              (2 * Real.pi * (p.2 : ℝ)))
            (targetCoeffIm (2 * Real.pi * (p.2 : ℝ))))
        (targetCoeffIm (2 * Real.pi * (p.2 : ℝ)) /
          coefficientNorm
            (targetCoeffRe (1 - (p.1 : ℝ))
              (2 * Real.pi * (p.2 : ℝ)))
            (targetCoeffIm (2 * Real.pi * (p.2 : ℝ))))
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.targetCoefficientHomotopy_coe
statement:
@[simp] theorem targetCoefficientHomotopy_coe (m : ℕ) (p : I × I) :
    (targetCoefficientHomotopy m p :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) =
      (targetCoefficientHomotopyMap m p :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.targetCoefficientHomotopy_closed
statement:
theorem targetCoefficientHomotopy_closed (m : ℕ) (s : I) :
    targetCoefficientHomotopy m (s, 0) =
      targetCoefficientHomotopy m (s, 1)
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [targetCoefficientHomotopy_coe, targetCoefficientHomotopy_coe,
    targetCoefficientHomotopyMap_coe,
    targetCoefficientHomotopyMap_coe]
  simp only [Set.Icc.coe_zero, mul_zero, Set.Icc.coe_one, mul_one]
  rw [targetCoeffRe_two_pi m (1 - (s : ℝ)), targetCoeffIm_two_pi m]

name: Submission.ConcreteZeroPairCassiniCoefficientSO.loopClassZ2_targetCoefficientLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_targetCoefficientLoop (m : ℕ) :
    loopClassZ2 (targetCoefficientLoop m)
        (targetCoefficientLoop_closed m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let L := normalPlaneLoop m (SO2AngleLoop.linear 2)
  have hcongr := loopClassZ2_congr (targetCoefficientLoop_closed m)
    (normalPlaneLoop_closed m (SO2AngleLoop.linear 2))
    (targetCoefficientHomotopy m) (targetCoefficientHomotopy_closed m)
  calc
    loopClassZ2 (targetCoefficientLoop m) (targetCoefficientLoop_closed m) =
        loopClassZ2 L (normalPlaneLoop_closed m (SO2AngleLoop.linear 2)) :=
      hcongr
    _ = (((2 : ℤ) : ZMod 2)) :=
      loopClassZ2_normalPlaneLoop m (SO2AngleLoop.linear 2)
    _ = 0 := by decide

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.OrbitMoveFamily.orbit_subset_fiber
statement: theorem orbit_subset_fiber (O : V.OrbitIndex) : (O : Set E) ⊆ X.fiber
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hO⟩ := V.mem_orbitFinset.mp O.property
  rw [hO]
  exact V.orbit_subset_fiber hp

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.OrbitMoveFamily.ambientSchedule_endpoint_fiber
statement:
theorem ambientSchedule_endpoint_fiber (F : OrbitMoveFamily X V) :
    F.ambientSchedule.forward 1 '' X.fiber = F.targetUnion
proof:
:= by
  ext y
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
    let O : V.OrbitIndex :=
      ⟨V.orbit x, V.mem_orbitFinset.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩⟩
    have hxO : x ∈ (O : Set E) := V.mem_orbit_self x
    have himage : F.ambientSchedule.forward 1 x ∈ F.target O := by
      rw [← F.ambientSchedule_endpoint_image O]
      exact ⟨x, hxO, rfl⟩
    exact Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨O, himage⟩
  · intro hy
    obtain ⟨O, hyO⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion.mp hy
    rw [← F.ambientSchedule_endpoint_image O] at hyO
    obtain ⟨x, hxO, rfl⟩ := hyO
    exact ⟨x, orbit_subset_fiber O hxO, rfl⟩

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.OrbitMoveFamily.ambientSchedule_pullback_fiber
statement:
theorem ambientSchedule_pullback_fiber (F : OrbitMoveFamily X V) :
    (F.ambientSchedule.pullback X).fiber = F.targetUnion
proof:
:= by
  rw [F.ambientSchedule.pullback_fiber,
    F.ambientSchedule_endpoint_fiber]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.OrbitMoveFamily.target_disjoint
statement:
theorem target_disjoint (F : OrbitMoveFamily X V)
    {O P : V.OrbitIndex} (hOP : O ≠ P) :
    Disjoint (F.target O) (F.target P)
proof:
:= by
  have hsets : (O : Set E) ≠ (P : Set E) := by
    intro h
    exact hOP (Subtype.ext h)
  have hsource : Disjoint (O : Set E) (P : Set E) :=
    V.orbitFinset_pairwise_disjoint O O.property P P.property hsets
  have hinj : Function.Injective (F.ambientSchedule.forward 1) :=
    (F.ambientSchedule.left_inv 1 ⟨zero_le_one, le_rfl⟩).injective
  rw [← F.ambientSchedule_endpoint_image O,
    ← F.ambientSchedule_endpoint_image P]
  exact hsource.image hinj.injOn (subset_univ _) (subset_univ _)

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.OrbitMoveFamily.target_pairwise_disjoint
statement:
theorem target_pairwise_disjoint (F : OrbitMoveFamily X V) :
    Pairwise fun O P : V.OrbitIndex => Disjoint (F.target O) (F.target P)
proof:
:= by
  intro O P hOP
  exact F.target_disjoint hOP

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.contDiff_affineConjugateForward
statement:
theorem contDiff_affineConjugateForward (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => affineConjugateForward A L b p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => L.symm (p.2 - b)) :=
    L.symm.contDiff.comp (contDiff_snd.sub contDiff_const)
  have hmove : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => A.forward p.1 (L.symm (p.2 - b))) :=
    A.forward_smooth.comp (contDiff_fst.prodMk hinner)
  exact contDiff_const.add (L.contDiff.comp hmove)

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.contDiff_affineConjugateInverse
statement:
theorem contDiff_affineConjugateInverse (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => affineConjugateInverse A L b p.1 p.2)
proof:
:= by
  have hinner : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun p : ℝ × E => L.symm (p.2 - b)) :=
    L.symm.contDiff.comp (contDiff_snd.sub contDiff_const)
  have hmove : ContDiff ℝ ∞
      (fun p : ℝ × E => A.inverse p.1 (L.symm (p.2 - b))) :=
    A.inverse_smooth.comp (contDiff_fst.prodMk hinner)
  exact contDiff_const.add (L.contDiff.comp hmove)

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.affineConjugate_leftInverse
statement:
theorem affineConjugate_leftInverse (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    LeftInverse (affineConjugateInverse A L b s)
      (affineConjugateForward A L b s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  change b + L (A.inverse s
    (L.symm (b + L (A.forward s (L.symm (x - b))) - b))) = x
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, L.symm_apply_apply, A.left_inv s hs,
    L.apply_symm_apply]
  abel

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.affineConjugate_rightInverse
statement:
theorem affineConjugate_rightInverse (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    RightInverse (affineConjugateInverse A L b s)
      (affineConjugateForward A L b s)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  change b + L (A.forward s
    (L.symm (b + L (A.inverse s (L.symm (x - b))) - b))) = x
  rw [add_sub_cancel_left, L.symm_apply_apply, A.right_inv s hs,
    L.apply_symm_apply]
  abel

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.conjugateAffine_forward
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugateAffine_forward (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    (A.conjugateAffine L b).forward s x =
      b + L (A.forward s (L.symm (x - b)))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.conjugateAffine_inverse
statement:
@[simp] theorem conjugateAffine_inverse (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    (L : E ≃L[ℝ] E) (b : E) (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
    (A.conjugateAffine L b).inverse s x =
      b + L (A.inverse s (L.symm (x - b)))
proof:
:=
  rfl

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.FixedOn.conjugateAffine
proof:
:= by
  intro s hs x hx
  rw [conjugateAffine_forward, hA s hs _ hx]
  simp

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.localRadialSq_smul
statement:
theorem localRadialSq_smul (r : ℝ) (x : E₂) :
    localRadialSq (r • x) = r ^ 2 * localRadialSq x
proof:
:= by
  unfold localRadialSq
  simp only [PiLp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  simp_rw [mul_pow]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  ring

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.dilationCLE_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem dilationCLE_apply (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (x : E₂) :
    dilationCLE r hr x = r • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [dilationCLE, ContinuousLinearEquiv.smulLeft_apply_apply, Units.smul_def]
  have hval : (↑(Units.mk0 r hr) : ℝ) = r := rfl
  rw [hval]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.dilationCLE_symm_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem dilationCLE_symm_apply (r : ℝ) (hr : r ≠ 0) (x : E₂) :
    (dilationCLE r hr).symm x = r⁻¹ • x
proof:
:= by
  rw [dilationCLE]
  change (ContinuousLinearEquiv.smulLeft (Units.mk0 r hr)⁻¹) x = r⁻¹ • x
  rw [ContinuousLinearEquiv.smulLeft_apply_apply, Units.smul_def,
    Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
  have hval : (↑(Units.mk0 r hr) : ℝ) = r := rfl
  rw [hval]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.affineLocalizedPlaneRotation_fixedOn
statement:
theorem affineLocalizedPlaneRotation_fixedOn (θ : ℝ)
    (L : E₂ ≃L[ℝ] E₂) (b : E₂) :
    (affineLocalizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ L b).FixedOn
      {x | 2 ≤ localRadialSq (L.symm (x - b))}
proof:
:= by
  exact (localizedPlaneRotation_fixedOn (m := m) θ).conjugateAffine L b

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.affineLocalizedPlaneRotation_endpoint_of_le_one
statement:
theorem affineLocalizedPlaneRotation_endpoint_of_le_one (θ : ℝ)
    (L : E₂ ≃L[ℝ] E₂) (b : E₂) {x : E₂}
    (hx : localRadialSq (L.symm (x - b)) ≤ 1) :
    (affineLocalizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ L b).forward 1 x =
      b + L (SO2FrameGauge.rotate θ (L.symm (x - b)))
proof:
:= by
  rw [affineLocalizedPlaneRotation, conjugateAffine_forward,
    localizedPlaneRotation_endpoint_of_le_one θ hx]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.ballLocalizedPlaneRotation_fixedOn
statement:
theorem ballLocalizedPlaneRotation_fixedOn (θ r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (b : E₂) :
    (ballLocalizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ r hr b).FixedOn
      {x | 2 * r ^ 2 ≤ localRadialSq (x - b)}
proof:
:= by
  apply (affineLocalizedPlaneRotation_fixedOn θ
    (dilationCLE r hr.ne') b).mono
  intro x hx
  change 2 ≤ localRadialSq ((dilationCLE r hr.ne').symm (x - b))
  rw [dilationCLE_symm_apply, localRadialSq_smul]
  have hrsq : 0 < r ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hr
  have hdiv : 2 ≤ localRadialSq (x - b) / r ^ 2 :=
    (le_div_iff₀ hrsq).2 hx
  have hscale : r⁻¹ ^ 2 * localRadialSq (x - b) =
      localRadialSq (x - b) / r ^ 2 := by
    field_simp
  rwa [hscale]

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.ballLocalizedPlaneRotation_endpoint_of_sq_le
statement:
theorem ballLocalizedPlaneRotation_endpoint_of_sq_le (θ r : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r)
    (b : E₂) {x : E₂} (hx : localRadialSq (x - b) ≤ r ^ 2) :
    (ballLocalizedPlaneRotation (m := m) θ r hr b).forward 1 x =
      b + dilationCLE r hr.ne'
        (SO2FrameGauge.rotate θ
          ((dilationCLE r hr.ne').symm (x - b)))
proof:
:= by
  apply affineLocalizedPlaneRotation_endpoint_of_le_one
  rw [dilationCLE_symm_apply, localRadialSq_smul]
  have hrsq : 0 < r ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hr
  have hdiv : localRadialSq (x - b) / r ^ 2 ≤ 1 :=
    (div_le_one hrsq).2 hx
  have hscale : r⁻¹ ^ 2 * localRadialSq (x - b) =
      localRadialSq (x - b) / r ^ 2 := by
    field_simp
  rwa [hscale]

name: Submission.valueTarget_norm_lt_one
statement:
lemma valueTarget_norm_lt_one
    {y y' w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (hy : ‖y‖ < 1 / 8) (hy' : ‖y'‖ < 1 / 8) (hw : ‖w‖ < 1 / 8)
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1 + 1))) :
    ‖valueTarget y y' w v‖ < 1
proof:
:= by
  let s := timeProfile (vertC v)
  let q := valueWeight v
  have hs0 : 0 ≤ s := Real.smoothTransition.nonneg _
  have hs1 : s ≤ 1 := Real.smoothTransition.le_one _
  have hq0 : 0 ≤ q := valueWeight_nonneg v
  have hq1 : q ≤ 1 := valueWeight_le_one v
  have hA : ‖(1 - s) • y‖ = (1 - s) * ‖y‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hs1)]
  have hB : ‖s • y'‖ = s * ‖y'‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hs0]
  have hC : ‖q • w‖ = q * ‖w‖ := by
    rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg hq0]
  change ‖(1 - s) • y + s • y' + q • w‖ < 1
  calc
    ‖(1 - s) • y + s • y' + q • w‖
        ≤ ‖(1 - s) • y + s • y'‖ + ‖q • w‖ := norm_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ (‖(1 - s) • y‖ + ‖s • y'‖) + ‖q • w‖ :=
      add_le_add (norm_add_le _ _) le_rfl
    _ = (1 - s) * ‖y‖ + s * ‖y'‖ + q * ‖w‖ := by rw [hA, hB, hC]
    _ < 1 := by nlinarith [norm_nonneg y, norm_nonneg y', norm_nonneg w]

name: Submission.exists_signedValueCobordism
statement:
theorem exists_signedValueCobordism (hn : 0 < n)
    {p : Ω^ (Fin (n + 1))
      (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) (southPole n)}
    (a : Approximation p) (i : Fin n)
    {y y' : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)}
    (hypos : 0 < y i) (hy'pos : 0 < y' i)
    (hy8 : ‖y‖ < 1 / 8) (hy'8 : ‖y'‖ < 1 / 8)
    (hy0 : y ≠ 0) (hy'0 : y' ≠ 0)
    (h : IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a) y)
    (h' : IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE a) y') :
    Nonempty
      (SignedFramedLevelCobordism
        (bridgeFiberSignOf a y hy0 h (hy8.trans (by norm_num)))
        (bridgeFiberSignOf a y' hy'0 h' (hy'8.trans (by norm_num))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, w, hC₀, hC₁, hw, hCG⟩ :=
    exists_valueChange_cobordism_spec hn a i hypos hy'pos hy0 hy'0 h h'
  have hycoord : y i ≤ ‖y‖ := by
    have hi := PiLp.norm_apply_le y i
    rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hypos] at hi
  have hw8 : ‖w‖ < 1 / 8 := by
    have hmin : min (y i) (y' i) ≤ y i := min_le_left _ _
    nlinarith
  refine ⟨{
    cobordism := C
    source_eq := hC₀
    target_eq := hC₁
    toFun := fun v => vertC (nprep a (WithLp.ofLp (initCLM (n + 1) v)))
    continuous := ?_
    nonzero := ?_
    collar_zero := ?_
    collar_one := ?_
  }⟩
  · exact (EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last n) (𝕜 := ℝ)).continuous.comp
      ((contDiff_nprep a).continuous.comp
        ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ).continuous.comp
          (initCLM (n + 1)).continuous))
  · intro v hv hzero
    have hv' : valueCobFun a y y' w v = 0 := by rwa [← hCG]
    have hfx0 : bridgeHMapE a (initCLM (n + 1) v) - valueTarget y y' w v = 0 := by
      simpa [valueCobFun, valueBase, valueTarget, sub_sub] using hv'
    have hfx : bridgeHMapE a (initCLM (n + 1) v) = valueTarget y y' w v :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp hfx0
    have hsplit := norm_sq_split
      (nprep a (WithLp.ofLp (initCLM (n + 1) v)))
    have hinit : initCLM n (nprep a (WithLp.ofLp (initCLM (n + 1) v))) =
        valueTarget y y' w v := hfx
    rw [norm_nprep a, hinit, hzero] at hsplit
    norm_num at hsplit
    have ht0 := norm_nonneg (valueTarget y y' w v)
    have ht1 := valueTarget_norm_lt_one hy8 hy'8 hw8 v
    nlinarith
  · intro x t ht
    change vertC (nprep a (WithLp.ofLp (initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x t)))) =
      vertC (nprep a (WithLp.ofLp x))
    rw [initCLM_spaceTime]
  · intro x t ht
    change vertC (nprep a (WithLp.ofLp (initCLM (n + 1) (spaceTime x t)))) =
      vertC (nprep a (WithLp.ofLp x))
    rw [initCLM_spaceTime]

name: Submission.exists_signedBridgeCobordism
statement:
theorem exists_signedBridgeCobordism (hn : 0 < n)
    {z : HomotopyGroup (Fin (n + 1))
      (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) (southPole n)}
    (B₁ B₂ : BridgeData n z) :
    Nonempty (SignedFramedLevelCobordism B₁.fiberSign B₂.fiberSign)
proof:
:= by
  have hclass : (⟦B₁.approx.representative⟧ :
      HomotopyGroup (Fin (n + 1))
        (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) (southPole n))
      = ⟦B₂.approx.representative⟧ :=
    B₁.class_eq.symm.trans B₂.class_eq
  have hpq : GenLoop.Homotopic B₁.approx.representative B₂.approx.representative :=
    Quotient.exact hclass
  obtain ⟨c⟩ := exists_cobApproximation hpq
  obtain ⟨y, hypos, hy8, hyaxis, hyreg⟩ :=
    exists_small_regular_value hn (contDiff_hMapCobE c)
  have hy0 : y ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    rw [h0, norm_zero] at hypos
    exact lt_irrefl 0 hypos
  have hy1 : ‖y‖ < 1 := hy8.trans (by norm_num)
  have hleft : IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE B₁.approx) y :=
    isRegularValue_left_of_cob c hyreg
  have hright : IsRegularValue (bridgeHMapE B₂.approx) y :=
    isRegularValue_right_of_cob c hyreg
  obtain ⟨Cleft⟩ :=
    exists_signedValueCobordism hn B₁.approx ⟨0, hn⟩
      (B₁.axis_pos hn) hyaxis B₁.norm_y_lt hy8
      B₁.y_ne_zero hy0 B₁.regular_y hleft
  let Cmid := signedMiddleCob c y hy0 hyreg hy1
  obtain ⟨Cright⟩ :=
    exists_signedValueCobordism hn B₂.approx ⟨0, hn⟩
      hyaxis (B₂.axis_pos hn) hy8 B₂.norm_y_lt
      hy0 B₂.y_ne_zero hright B₂.regular_y
  exact ⟨SignedFramedLevelCobordism.trans
    (SignedFramedLevelCobordism.trans Cleft Cmid) Cright⟩

name: Submission.finSumFinEquiv_symm_castSucc
statement:
theorem finSumFinEquiv_symm_castSucc (i : Fin m) :
    finSumFinEquiv.symm (Fin.castSucc i) = Sum.inl i

:= by

name: Submission.finSumFinEquiv_symm_last
statement:
theorem finSumFinEquiv_symm_last :
    finSumFinEquiv.symm (Fin.last m) = Sum.inr (0 : Fin 1)

name: Submission.incMatrix_apply_castSucc_castSucc
statement:
theorem incMatrix_apply_castSucc_castSucc (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (i j : Fin m) :
    incMatrix B (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j) = B i j
proof:
:= by
  unfold incMatrix
  rw [Matrix.submatrix_apply, finSumFinEquiv_symm_castSucc, finSumFinEquiv_symm_castSucc]
  exact Matrix.fromBlocks_apply₁₁ B 0 0 1 i j

name: Submission.incMatrix_apply_castSucc_last
statement:
theorem incMatrix_apply_castSucc_last (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (i : Fin m) :
    incMatrix B (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.last m) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold incMatrix

  simp

name: Submission.incMatrix_apply_last_castSucc

theorem incMatrix_apply_last_castSucc (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) (j : Fin m) :
    incMatrix B (Fin.last m) (Fin.castSucc j) = 0
proof:
:= by

theorem incMatrix_apply_last_last (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) :

name: Submission.incMatrix_mul
statement:
theorem incMatrix_mul (B C : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) :
    incMatrix B * incMatrix C = incMatrix (B * C)
proof:
:= by
  unfold incMatrix
  rw [Matrix.submatrix_mul_equiv, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply]
  congr 1
  simp

name: Submission.incMatrix_one
statement: theorem incMatrix_one : incMatrix (1 : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold incMatrix
  rw [Matrix.fromBlocks_one, Matrix.submatrix_one_equiv]

name: Submission.incMatrix_transpose
statement:
theorem incMatrix_transpose (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) :
    (incMatrix B)ᵀ = incMatrix Bᵀ
proof:
:= by
