  simp

name: Submission.incMatrix_det
statement: theorem incMatrix_det (B : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ) : (incMatrix B).det = B.det
proof:
:= by
  unfold incMatrix
  rw [Matrix.det_submatrix_equiv_self, Matrix.det_fromBlocks_zero₂₁, Matrix.det_one, mul_one]

name: Submission.incMatrix_injective
statement: theorem incMatrix_injective : Function.Injective (incMatrix (m := m))
proof:
:= by
  intro B C h
  ext i j
  have h2 : incMatrix B (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j)
      = incMatrix C (Fin.castSucc i) (Fin.castSucc j) := by rw [h]
  rwa [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_castSucc, incMatrix_apply_castSucc_castSucc] at h2

name: Submission.incMatrix_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hBO, hBdet⟩ := Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp hB
  have hBO' := (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin m) ℝ).mp hBO
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
  constructor
  · rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff, incMatrix_transpose, incMatrix_mul, hBO', incMatrix_one]
  · rw [incMatrix_det, hBdet]

name: Submission.incHom_coe
statement:
@[simp]
theorem incHom_coe (B : SOGroup m) :
    ((incHom m B : SOGroup (m + 1)) : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)
      = incMatrix B.1
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.continuous_incHom
statement: theorem continuous_incHom (m : ℕ) : Continuous (incHom m)
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact ((continuous_subtype_val.matrix_fromBlocks continuous_const continuous_const
    continuous_const).matrix_submatrix _ _)

name: Submission.incHom_injective
statement: theorem incHom_injective (m : ℕ) : Function.Injective (incHom m)
proof:
:= by
  intro B C h
  exact Subtype.ext (incMatrix_injective (congrArg Subtype.val h))

name: Submission.proj_incHom
statement: theorem proj_incHom (B : SOGroup m) : proj (incHom m B) = basePoint
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show WithLp.toLp 2 (projVec (incHom m B)) = WithLp.toLp 2 (projVec 1)
  congr 1
  funext i
  show incMatrix B.1 i (Fin.last m) = (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) i (Fin.last m)
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last => rw [incMatrix_apply_last_last, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
  | cast i =>
    rw [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_last, Matrix.one_apply_ne (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i).ne]

name: Submission.column_of_proj_eq
statement:
theorem column_of_proj_eq (hA : proj A = basePoint) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) i (Fin.last m)
      = (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) i (Fin.last m)
proof:
:= by
  have h : projVec A = projVec (1 : SOGroup (m + 1)) := by
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z : UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1))) =>
      WithLp.ofLp (z : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))) hA
    exact h2
  exact congr_fun h i

name: Submission.row_of_proj_eq
statement:
theorem row_of_proj_eq (hA : proj A = basePoint) (j : Fin (m + 1)) :
    (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) (Fin.last m) j
      = (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) (Fin.last m) j
proof:
:= by
  have hO : (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)
      * (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)ᵀ = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).mp
      ((Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp A.2).1)
  have hOT : (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)ᵀ
      * (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp hO
  have h : ((A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)ᵀ
        * (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)) j (Fin.last m)
      = (1 : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) j (Fin.last m) := by rw [hOT]
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply] at h
  have hsum : ∑ i, (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)ᵀ j i
        * (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) i (Fin.last m)
      = (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) (Fin.last m) j := by
    have hc : ∀ i ∈ Finset.univ, (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)ᵀ j i
        * (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) i (Fin.last m)
        = if i = Fin.last m
          then (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)ᵀ j i else 0 := by
      intro i _
      rw [column_of_proj_eq hA i]
      by_cases hi : i = Fin.last m
      · subst hi; rw [Matrix.one_apply_eq, mul_one, if_pos rfl]
      · rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne hi, mul_zero, if_neg hi]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl hc, Finset.sum_ite_eq' Finset.univ (Fin.last m)]
    simp [Matrix.transpose_apply]
  rw [hsum] at h
  rw [h]
  by_cases hj : j = Fin.last m
  · subst hj; rfl
  · rw [Matrix.one_apply_ne hj, Matrix.one_apply_ne (Ne.symm hj)]

name: Submission.incMatrix_block
statement:
theorem incMatrix_block (hA : proj A = basePoint) :
    incMatrix ((A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).submatrix
      Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc) = (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  induction i using Fin.lastCases with
  | last =>
    induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      rw [incMatrix_apply_last_last]
      have h := row_of_proj_eq hA (Fin.last m)
      rw [h, Matrix.one_apply_eq]
    | cast j =>
      rw [incMatrix_apply_last_castSucc]
      have h := row_of_proj_eq hA (Fin.castSucc j)
      rw [h, Matrix.one_apply_ne (Ne.symm (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j).ne)]
  | cast i =>
    induction j using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      rw [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_last]
      have h := column_of_proj_eq hA (Fin.castSucc i)
      rw [h, Matrix.one_apply_ne (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i).ne]
    | cast j =>
      rw [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_castSucc, Matrix.submatrix_apply]

name: Submission.block_mem
statement:
theorem block_mem (hA : proj A = basePoint) :
    (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc
      ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin m) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  set B := (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).submatrix Fin.castSucc Fin.castSucc
  have hB : incMatrix B = (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ) := incMatrix_block hA
  have hAO : (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)
      * (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ)ᵀ = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).mp
      ((Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp A.2).1)
  have hAdet : (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 1)) (Fin (m + 1)) ℝ).det = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp A.2).2
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
  constructor
  · rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff]
    apply incMatrix_injective
    rw [← incMatrix_mul, ← incMatrix_transpose, hB, incMatrix_one, hAO]
  · have h := incMatrix_det B
    rw [hB, hAdet] at h
    exact h.symm

name: Submission.continuous_blockMap
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact (continuous_subtype_val.comp hFc).matrix_submatrix _ _

name: Submission.incHom_blockMap
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (incMatrix_block (hF x))

name: Submission.exists_incHom_eq_of_proj
statement:
theorem exists_incHom_eq_of_proj (hA : proj A = basePoint) :
    ∃ B : SOGroup m, incHom m B = A
proof:
:=
  ⟨blockMap (fun _ : Unit => A) (fun _ => hA) (), incHom_blockMap (fun _ => hA) ()⟩

name: Submission.soGroup_zero_eq_one
statement: theorem soGroup_zero_eq_one (A : SOGroup 0) : A = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show (A : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) ℝ) = (1 : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) ℝ)
  ext i j
  exact i.elim0

name: Submission.soGroup_one_eq_one
statement: theorem soGroup_one_eq_one (A : SOGroup 1) : A = 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show (A : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ) = (1 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ)
  have hdet : (A : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ).det = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp A.2).2
  rw [Matrix.det_fin_one] at hdet
  ext i j
  rw [Subsingleton.elim i 0, Subsingleton.elim j 0, hdet, Matrix.one_apply_eq]

name: Submission.joined_one_SO
statement:
theorem joined_one_SO : ∀ (m : ℕ) (A : SOGroup m), Joined 1 A
  | 0, A => by rw [soGroup_zero_eq_one A]
  | 1, A => by rw [soGroup_one_eq_one A]
  | (m + 2), A => by
    
    have hrank : 1 < Module.rank ℝ (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))
proof:
:= by
      rw [← Module.finrank_eq_rank, finrank_euclideanSpace_fin]
      exact_mod_cast (by omega : 1 < m + 2)
    haveI hpc : PathConnectedSpace (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)))) :=
      isPathConnected_iff_pathConnectedSpace.mp (isPathConnected_sphere hrank 0 zero_le_one)
    set sp : Path (proj A) (basePoint (n := m + 1)) := PathConnectedSpace.somePath _ _
    
    obtain ⟨L, hLc, hLproj, hL0, -⟩ := exists_pathFamilyLift (P := I)
      (f := fun q : I × I => sp q.2) (sp.continuous.comp continuous_snd)
      (A₀ := fun _ => A) continuous_const (fun _ => sp.source.symm)
    have hend : proj (L (0, 1)) = basePoint := by
      rw [hLproj (0, 1)]
      exact sp.target
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := exists_incHom_eq_of_proj hend
    
    have hAL : Joined A (incHom (m + 1) C) := by
      rw [hC]
      exact ⟨{ toFun := fun u => L (0, u)
               continuous_toFun := hLc.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
               source' := hL0 0
               target' := rfl }⟩
    
    have hIH : Joined (1 : SOGroup (m + 1)) C := joined_one_SO (m + 1) C
    have h1C : Joined (1 : SOGroup (m + 2)) (incHom (m + 1) C) := by
      obtain ⟨p⟩ := hIH
      have hj : Joined (incHom (m + 1) 1) (incHom (m + 1) C) :=
        ⟨p.map (continuous_incHom (m + 1))⟩
      rwa [map_one] at hj
    exact h1C.trans hAL.symm

name: Submission.conjPath_homotopic
statement:
theorem conjPath_homotopic (g : SOGroup m) (α : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1) :
    Path.Homotopic
      { toFun := fun t => g * α t * g⁻¹
        continuous_toFun := ((continuous_const.mul α.continuous).mul continuous_const : )
        source' := by rw [α.source, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel]
        target' := by rw [α.target, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel] }
      α
proof:
:= by
  set c : Path (1 : SOGroup m) g := PathConnectedSpace.somePath 1 g
  refine ⟨{ toFun := fun q => (c q.1)⁻¹ * (g * α q.2 * g⁻¹) * c q.1
            continuous_toFun := by fun_prop
            map_zero_left := ?_
            map_one_left := ?_
            prop' := ?_ }⟩
  · intro t
    simp only [c.source]
    show (1 : SOGroup m)⁻¹ * (g * α t * g⁻¹) * 1 = _
    rw [inv_one, one_mul, mul_one]
    rfl
  · intro t
    simp only [c.target]
    show g⁻¹ * (g * α t * g⁻¹) * g = α t
    group
  · intro s x hx
    have hαx : α x = 1 := by
      rcases hx with rfl | hx
      · exact α.source
      · rw [Set.mem_singleton_iff] at hx
        subst hx
        exact α.target
    show (c s)⁻¹ * (g * α x * g⁻¹) * c s = g * α x * g⁻¹
    rw [hαx, mul_one, mul_inv_cancel, mul_one, inv_mul_cancel]

name: Submission.exists_inc_loop_homotopic
statement:
theorem exists_inc_loop_homotopic (hm : 2 ≤ m) (γ : Path (1 : SOGroup (m + 1)) 1) :
    ∃ δ : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1,
      γ.Homotopic ((δ.map (continuous_incHom m)).cast (map_one (incHom m)).symm
        (map_one (incHom m)).symm)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : SimplyConnectedSpace (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))) :=
    sphere_simplyConnected m hm
  obtain ⟨H⟩ := SimplyConnectedSpace.paths_homotopic (projLoop γ) (Path.refl basePoint)
  obtain ⟨L, hLc, hLproj, hL0, hLconst⟩ := exists_pathFamilyLift (P := I)
    (f := fun q : I × I => H (q.2, q.1))
    (H.continuous.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_fst))
    (A₀ := fun t => γ t) γ.continuous
    (fun t => (H.apply_zero t).symm)
  
  have hbdry : ∀ t : I, t = 0 ∨ t = 1 → ∀ u : I, L (t, u) = γ t := by
    intro t ht u
    apply hLconst
    intro v
    have hmem : t ∈ ({0, 1} : Set I) := by
      rcases ht with rfl | rfl
      · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
      · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl
    show H (v, t) = H (0, t)
    rw [H.eq_fst v hmem, H.eq_fst 0 hmem]
  
  have hstab : ∀ t : I, proj (L (t, 1)) = basePoint := by
    intro t
    rw [hLproj (t, 1)]
    exact H.apply_one t
  set K : I → SOGroup m := blockMap (fun t => L (t, 1)) hstab with hKdef
  have hK : ∀ t, incHom m (K t) = L (t, 1) := incHom_blockMap hstab
  have hK0 : K 0 = 1 := by
    apply incHom_injective m
    rw [hK 0, map_one, hbdry 0 (Or.inl rfl) 1]
    exact γ.source
  have hK1 : K 1 = 1 := by
    apply incHom_injective m
    rw [hK 1, map_one, hbdry 1 (Or.inr rfl) 1]
    exact γ.target
  refine ⟨{ toFun := K
            continuous_toFun :=
              continuous_blockMap (hLc.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)) hstab
            source' := hK0
            target' := hK1 }, ?_⟩
  exact ⟨{ toFun := fun q => L (q.2, q.1)
           continuous_toFun := hLc.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_fst)
           map_zero_left := fun t => hL0 t
           map_one_left := fun t => (hK t).symm
           prop' := fun u t ht => by
             have ht' : t = 0 ∨ t = 1 := by simpa using ht
             exact hbdry t ht' u }⟩

name: Submission.incPi1_fromPath
statement:
theorem incPi1_fromPath (γ : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1) :
    incPi1 m (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦γ⟧) =
      FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦(γ.map (continuous_incHom m)).cast (map_one (incHom m)).symm
          (map_one (incHom m)).symm⟧
proof:
:= by
  unfold incPi1
  rw [FundamentalGroup.mapOfEq_apply]
  rfl

name: Submission.incPi1_surjective
statement: theorem incPi1_surjective (hm : 2 ≤ m) : Function.Surjective (incPi1 m)
proof:
:= by
  intro x
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep (FundamentalGroup.toPath x)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ⟩ := exists_inc_loop_homotopic hm γ
  refine ⟨FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦δ⟧, ?_⟩
  rw [incPi1_fromPath]
  have h1 : (⟦(δ.map (continuous_incHom m)).cast (map_one (incHom m)).symm
        (map_one (incHom m)).symm⟧
      : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (1 : SOGroup (m + 1)) 1) = ⟦γ⟧ :=
    Quotient.sound hδ.symm
  show FundamentalGroup.fromPath _ = x
  calc FundamentalGroup.fromPath
        ⟦(δ.map (continuous_incHom m)).cast (map_one (incHom m)).symm
          (map_one (incHom m)).symm⟧
      = FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦γ⟧ := congrArg _ h1
    _ = FundamentalGroup.fromPath (FundamentalGroup.toPath x) := congrArg _ hγ
    _ = x := rfl

name: Submission.pairToCube_zero
statement: @[simp] theorem pairToCube_zero (x : I × I) : pairToCube x 0 = x.1
proof: := if_pos rfl

name: Submission.pairToCube_one
statement: @[simp] theorem pairToCube_one (x : I × I) : pairToCube x 1 = x.2
proof:
:=
  if_neg (by decide)

name: Submission.continuous_pairToCube
statement: theorem continuous_pairToCube : Continuous pairToCube
proof:
:= by
  apply continuous_pi
  intro i
  by_cases h : i = 0
  · simpa [pairToCube, h] using continuous_fst
  · simpa [pairToCube, h] using continuous_snd

name: Submission.incPi1_injective
statement: theorem incPi1_injective (hm : 3 ≤ m) : Function.Injective (incPi1 m)
proof:
:= by
  rw [injective_iff_map_eq_one]
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨γ, hγ⟩ := Quotient.exists_rep (FundamentalGroup.toPath x)
  
  suffices h : γ.Homotopic (Path.refl 1) by
    have h2 : (⟦γ⟧ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (1 : SOGroup m) 1) = ⟦Path.refl 1⟧ :=
      Quotient.sound h
    calc x = FundamentalGroup.fromPath (FundamentalGroup.toPath x) := rfl
      _ = FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦γ⟧ := (congrArg _ hγ).symm
      _ = FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦Path.refl 1⟧ := congrArg _ h2
      _ = 1 := rfl
  
  have hx' : FundamentalGroup.fromPath
      ⟦(γ.map (continuous_incHom m)).cast (map_one (incHom m)).symm
        (map_one (incHom m)).symm⟧ = 1 := by
    rw [← incPi1_fromPath]
    have hfx : FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦γ⟧ = x := congrArg _ hγ
    rw [hfx]
    exact hx
  have h1 : (⟦(γ.map (continuous_incHom m)).cast (map_one (incHom m)).symm
        (map_one (incHom m)).symm⟧
      : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (1 : SOGroup (m + 1)) 1) = ⟦Path.refl 1⟧ := hx'
  obtain ⟨G⟩ := Quotient.exact h1
  
  have hG0 : ∀ t, G (0, t) = incHom m (γ t) := fun t => G.apply_zero t
  have hG1 : ∀ t, G (1, t) = 1 := fun t => G.apply_one t
  have hGb : ∀ (u t : I), t = 0 ∨ t = 1 → G (u, t) = 1 := by
    intro u t ht
    have hmem : t ∈ ({0, 1} : Set I) := by
      rcases ht with rfl | rfl
      · exact Set.mem_insert _ _
      · exact Set.mem_insert_of_mem _ rfl
    have h2 := G.eq_fst u hmem
    rcases ht with rfl | rfl
    · rw [h2]
      show incHom m (γ 0) = 1
      rw [γ.source, map_one]
    · rw [h2]
      show incHom m (γ 1) = 1
      rw [γ.target, map_one]
  
  have hφb : ∀ (u t : I), u = 0 ∨ u = 1 ∨ t = 0 ∨ t = 1 →
      proj (G (u, t)) = basePoint := by
    intro u t ht
    rcases ht with rfl | rfl | ht | ht
    · rw [hG0]
      exact proj_incHom (γ t)
    · rw [hG1]
      exact proj_one
    · rw [hGb u t (Or.inl ht)]
      exact proj_one
    · rw [hGb u t (Or.inr ht)]
      exact proj_one
  set q2 : Ω^ (Fin 2) (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))) basePoint :=
    ⟨⟨fun y => proj (G (y 0, y 1)),
      continuous_proj.comp (G.continuous.comp
        ((continuous_apply (0 : Fin 2)).prodMk (continuous_apply (1 : Fin 2))))⟩,
      by
        rintro y ⟨i, hi⟩
        show proj (G (y 0, y 1)) = basePoint
        apply hφb
        fin_cases i
        · rcases hi with h | h
          · exact Or.inl h
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inl h)
        · rcases hi with h | h
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl h))
          · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr h))⟩
    with hq2def
  have hsub : Subsingleton
      (HomotopyGroup.Pi 2 (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))) basePoint) :=
    homotopyGroup_sphere_subsingleton 2 m (by omega) basePoint
  have hq2 : (⟦q2⟧ : HomotopyGroup (Fin 2)
      (UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 1)))) basePoint) = ⟦GenLoop.const⟧ :=
    hsub.elim _ _
  obtain ⟨HR⟩ := Quotient.exact hq2
  
  obtain ⟨L2, hL2c, hL2proj, hL20, hL2const⟩ := exists_pathFamilyLift (P := I × I)
    (f := fun w : (I × I) × I => HR (w.2, pairToCube w.1))
    (HR.continuous.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk (continuous_pairToCube.comp continuous_fst)))
    (A₀ := fun p => G p) G.continuous
    (fun p => by
      rw [HR.apply_zero]
      show proj (G p) = proj (G (pairToCube p 0, pairToCube p 1))
      rw [pairToCube_zero, pairToCube_one])
  
  have hbdry2 : ∀ p : I × I, p.1 = 0 ∨ p.1 = 1 ∨ p.2 = 0 ∨ p.2 = 1 →
      ∀ v : I, L2 (p, v) = G p := by
    intro p hp v
    apply hL2const
    intro w
    have hmem : pairToCube p ∈ Cube.boundary (Fin 2) := by
      rcases hp with h | h | h | h
      · exact ⟨0, Or.inl (by rwa [pairToCube_zero])⟩
      · exact ⟨0, Or.inr (by rwa [pairToCube_zero])⟩
      · exact ⟨1, Or.inl (by rwa [pairToCube_one])⟩
      · exact ⟨1, Or.inr (by rwa [pairToCube_one])⟩
    show HR (w, pairToCube p) = HR (0, pairToCube p)
    rw [HR.eq_fst w hmem, HR.eq_fst 0 hmem]
  
  have hstab2 : ∀ p : I × I, proj (L2 (p, 1)) = basePoint := by
    intro p
    rw [hL2proj (p, 1)]
    show HR (1, pairToCube p) = basePoint
    rw [HR.apply_one]
    rfl
  set κ : I × I → SOGroup m := blockMap (fun p => L2 (p, 1)) hstab2 with hκdef
  have hκ : ∀ p, incHom m (κ p) = L2 (p, 1) := incHom_blockMap hstab2
  have hκc : Continuous κ :=
    continuous_blockMap (hL2c.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)) hstab2
  
  have hκ0 : ∀ t, κ (0, t) = γ t := by
    intro t
    apply incHom_injective m
    rw [hκ (0, t), hbdry2 (0, t) (Or.inl rfl) 1, hG0]
  have hκ1 : ∀ t, κ (1, t) = 1 := by
    intro t
    apply incHom_injective m
    rw [hκ (1, t), map_one, hbdry2 (1, t) (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)) 1, hG1]
  have hκb : ∀ (u t : I), t = 0 ∨ t = 1 → κ (u, t) = 1 := by
    intro u t ht
    apply incHom_injective m
    rw [hκ (u, t), map_one,
      hbdry2 (u, t) (Or.inr (Or.inr (ht.imp (fun h => h) (fun h => h)))) 1, hGb u t ht]
  exact ⟨{ toFun := fun q => κ (q.1, q.2)
           continuous_toFun := hκc.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_snd)
           map_zero_left := fun t => hκ0 t
           map_one_left := fun t => hκ1 t
           prop' := fun u t ht => by
             have ht' : t = 0 ∨ t = 1 := by simpa using ht
             show κ (u, t) = γ t
             rw [hκb u t ht']
             rcases ht' with rfl | rfl
             · exact γ.source.symm
             · exact γ.target.symm }⟩

name: Submission.pi1_SOm
statement:
theorem pi1_SOm (m : ℕ) (hm : 3 ≤ m) :
    Nonempty (FundamentalGroup (Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin m) ℝ) 1 ≃*
      Multiplicative (ZMod 2))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 3 := ⟨m - 3, by omega⟩
  exact ⟨wIso k⟩

name: Submission.wHom_bijective
statement: theorem wHom_bijective {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) : Function.Bijective (wHom m)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 3 := ⟨m - 3, by omega⟩
  exact (wIso k).bijective

name: Submission.wHom_incPi1
statement:
theorem wHom_incPi1 {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) (x : FundamentalGroup (SOGroup m) 1) :
    wHom (m + 1) (incPi1 m x) = wHom m x
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨k, rfl⟩ : ∃ k, m = k + 3 := ⟨m - 3, by omega⟩
  show wIso (k + 1) (incPi1 (k + 3) x) = wIso k x
  show ((incPi1Equiv (k + 3) (by omega)).symm.trans (wIso k)) (incPi1 (k + 3) x) = wIso k x
  rw [MulEquiv.trans_apply]
  congr 1
  exact (incPi1Equiv (k + 3) (by omega)).symm_apply_apply x

name: Submission.one_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
statement:
theorem one_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup (n : ℕ) :
    (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
  constructor
  · rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff, Matrix.transpose_one, mul_one]
  · exact Matrix.det_one

name: Submission.rotBlock_succ
statement:
theorem rotBlock_succ : ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → ∀ θ, rotBlock (m + 1) θ = incMatrix (rotBlock m θ)
  | 0, h, _ => absurd h (by omega)
  | 1, h, _ => absurd h (by omega)
  | 2, _, _ => rfl
  | (_ + 3), _, _ => rfl

name: Submission.rotBlock_zero
statement:
theorem rotBlock_zero : ∀ m : ℕ, rotBlock m 0 = 1
  | 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => by
    show !![Real.cos 0, -Real.sin 0; Real.sin 0, Real.cos 0] = 1
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp
  | (k + 3) => by
    show incMatrix (rotBlock (k + 2) 0) = 1
    rw [rotBlock_zero (k + 2), incMatrix_one]

name: Submission.rotBlock_two_pi
statement:
theorem rotBlock_two_pi : ∀ m : ℕ, rotBlock m (2 * Real.pi) = 1
  | 0 => rfl
  | 1 => rfl
  | 2 => by
    show !![Real.cos (2 * Real.pi), -Real.sin (2 * Real.pi);
      Real.sin (2 * Real.pi), Real.cos (2 * Real.pi)] = 1
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [Real.cos_two_pi, Real.sin_two_pi]
  | (k + 3) => by
    show incMatrix (rotBlock (k + 2) (2 * Real.pi)) = 1
    rw [rotBlock_two_pi (k + 2), incMatrix_one]

name: Submission.rotBlock_add
statement:
theorem rotBlock_add : ∀ (m : ℕ) (α β : ℝ),
    rotBlock m (α + β) = rotBlock m α * rotBlock m β
  | 0, _, _ => by
    show (1 : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) ℝ) = 1 * 1
    rw [one_mul]
  | 1, _, _ => by
    show (1 : Matrix (Fin 1) (Fin 1) ℝ) = 1 * 1
    rw [one_mul]
  | 2, α, β => by
    show !![Real.cos (α + β), -Real.sin (α + β); Real.sin (α + β), Real.cos (α + β)]
      = !![Real.cos α, -Real.sin α; Real.sin α, Real.cos α]
        * !![Real.cos β, -Real.sin β; Real.sin β, Real.cos β]
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Real.cos_add, Real.sin_add] <;> ring
  | (k + 3), α, β => by
    show incMatrix (rotBlock (k + 2) (α + β))
      = incMatrix (rotBlock (k + 2) α) * incMatrix (rotBlock (k + 2) β)
    rw [rotBlock_add (k + 2) α β, ← incMatrix_mul]

name: Submission.rotBlock_neg_two_pi
statement: theorem rotBlock_neg_two_pi (m : ℕ) : rotBlock m (-(2 * Real.pi)) = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h := rotBlock_add m (-(2 * Real.pi)) (2 * Real.pi)
  rw [neg_add_cancel, rotBlock_zero, rotBlock_two_pi, mul_one] at h
  exact h.symm

name: Submission.rotBlock_int_two_pi
statement: theorem rotBlock_int_two_pi (m : ℕ) (k : ℤ) : rotBlock m (2 * Real.pi * k) = 1
proof:
:= by
  induction k using Int.induction_on with
  | zero => rw [show ((0 : ℤ) : ℝ) = 0 by norm_num, mul_zero, rotBlock_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) * Real.pi * ((n : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) = 2 * Real.pi * (n : ℤ) + 2 * Real.pi
      by push_cast; ring]
    rw [rotBlock_add, ih, rotBlock_two_pi, mul_one]
  | pred n ih =>
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) * Real.pi * (-(n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ)
        = 2 * Real.pi * (-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) + -(2 * Real.pi) by push_cast; ring]
    rw [rotBlock_add, ih, rotBlock_neg_two_pi, mul_one]

name: Submission.rotBlock_mem
statement:
theorem rotBlock_mem : ∀ (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ),
    rotBlock m θ ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin m) ℝ
  | 0, _ => one_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup 0
  | 1, _ => one_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup 1
  | 2, θ => by
    have hunfold : rotBlock 2 θ
        = !![Real.cos θ, -Real.sin θ; Real.sin θ, Real.cos θ]
proof:
:= rfl
    rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff, hunfold]
    constructor
    · rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff]
      ext i j
      fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
        simp [Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two, Matrix.transpose_apply] <;>
        nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ]
    · rw [Matrix.det_fin_two_of]
      nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ]
  | (k + 3), θ => incMatrix_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup (rotBlock_mem (k + 2) θ)

name: Submission.continuous_rotBlock
statement:
theorem continuous_rotBlock : ∀ m : ℕ, Continuous (rotBlock m)
  | 0 => continuous_const
  | 1 => continuous_const
  | 2 => by
    apply continuous_matrix
    intro i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;> simp
    · exact Real.continuous_cos
    · exact Real.continuous_sin.neg
    · exact Real.continuous_sin
    · exact Real.continuous_cos
  | (k + 3) => by
    show Continuous fun θ => incMatrix (rotBlock (k + 2) θ)
    exact ((continuous_rotBlock (k + 2)).matrix_fromBlocks continuous_const
      continuous_const continuous_const).matrix_submatrix _ _

                                                                             
                    
def rotationLoop (m : ℕ) : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1 where
  toFun t
proof:
:= ⟨rotBlock m (2 * Real.pi * t), rotBlock_mem m _⟩
  continuous_toFun := by
    apply Continuous.subtype_mk
    exact (continuous_rotBlock m).comp (continuous_const.mul continuous_subtype_val)
  source' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show rotBlock m (2 * Real.pi * ((0 : I) : ℝ)) = 1
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_zero, mul_zero, rotBlock_zero]
  target' := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    show rotBlock m (2 * Real.pi * ((1 : I) : ℝ)) = 1
    rw [Set.Icc.coe_one, mul_one, rotBlock_two_pi]

name: Submission.rotBlock_three
statement: theorem rotBlock_three (θ : ℝ) : rotBlock 3 θ = rzMatrix θ
proof:
:= by
  show incMatrix (rotBlock 2 θ) = rzMatrix θ
  have h2 : rotBlock 2 θ = !![Real.cos θ, -Real.sin θ; Real.sin θ, Real.cos θ] := rfl
  ext i j
  fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
    simp [incMatrix, h2, Matrix.submatrix_apply, rzMatrix,
      show (finSumFinEquiv (m := 2) (n := 1)).symm (0 : Fin 3) = Sum.inl 0 from by decide,
      show (finSumFinEquiv (m := 2) (n := 1)).symm (1 : Fin 3) = Sum.inl 1 from by decide,
      show (finSumFinEquiv (m := 2) (n := 1)).symm (2 : Fin 3) = Sum.inr 0 from by decide]

name: Submission.rotationLoop_three
statement: theorem rotationLoop_three : rotationLoop 3 = rzPath
proof:
:= by
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  apply Subtype.ext
  show rotBlock 3 (2 * Real.pi * t) = rzMatrix (2 * Real.pi * t)
  exact rotBlock_three _

name: Submission.incHom_rotationLoop
statement:
theorem incHom_rotationLoop {m : ℕ} (hm : 2 ≤ m) (t : I) :
    incHom m (rotationLoop m t) = rotationLoop (m + 1) t
proof:
:=
  Subtype.ext (by
    show incMatrix (rotBlock m (2 * Real.pi * t)) = rotBlock (m + 1) (2 * Real.pi * t)
    rw [rotBlock_succ m hm])

name: Submission.wHom_rotationLoop
statement:
theorem wHom_rotationLoop {m : ℕ} (hm : 3 ≤ m) :
    wHom m (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦rotationLoop m⟧) = Multiplicative.ofAdd 1
proof:
:= by
  induction m, hm using Nat.le_induction with
  | base =>
    show pi1SO3MulEquiv (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦rotationLoop 3⟧)
      = Multiplicative.ofAdd 1
    rw [rotationLoop_three]
    have hne : pi1SO3MulEquiv (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦rzPath⟧) ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      apply rzPath_nontrivial
      exact pi1SO3MulEquiv.injective (by rw [map_one]; exact h)
    have htwo : ∀ y : Multiplicative (ZMod 2), y ≠ 1 → y = Multiplicative.ofAdd 1 := by
      decide
    exact htwo _ hne
  | succ m hm ih =>
    have hpaths : rotationLoop (m + 1)
        = ((rotationLoop m).map (continuous_incHom m)).cast (map_one (incHom m)).symm
          (map_one (incHom m)).symm := by
      apply Path.ext
      funext t
      exact (incHom_rotationLoop (by omega) t).symm
    rw [hpaths, ← incPi1_fromPath, wHom_incPi1 hm, ih]

name: Submission.conjLoop_homotopic
statement:
theorem conjLoop_homotopic (g : SOGroup m) (α : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1) :
    (conjLoop g α).Homotopic α
proof:
:=
  conjPath_homotopic g α

name: Submission.homotopic_of_component_homotopies
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨H1⟩ := h1
  obtain ⟨H2⟩ := h2
  exact ⟨{ toFun := fun z => (H1 z, H2 z)
           continuous_toFun := H1.continuous.prodMk H2.continuous
           map_zero_left := fun t => by
             show (H1 (0, t), H2 (0, t)) = p t
             rw [H1.apply_zero, H2.apply_zero]
             rfl
           map_one_left := fun t => by
             show (H1 (1, t), H2 (1, t)) = q t
             rw [H1.apply_one, H2.apply_one]
             rfl
           prop' := fun u t ht => by
             show (H1 (u, t), H2 (u, t)) = p t
             rw [H1.eq_fst u ht, H2.eq_fst u ht]
             rfl }⟩

name: Submission.pathMul_homotopic_trans
statement:
theorem pathMul_homotopic_trans (α β : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1) :
    (pathMul α β).Homotopic (β.trans α)
proof:
:= by
  set μc : C(SOGroup m × SOGroup m, SOGroup m) :=
    ⟨fun z => z.1 * z.2, continuous_mul⟩ with hμc
  set pp : Path ((1, 1) : SOGroup m × SOGroup m) (1, 1) := α.prod β with hpp
  set pl : Path ((1, 1) : SOGroup m × SOGroup m) (1, 1) := α.prod (Path.refl 1) with hpl
  set pr : Path ((1, 1) : SOGroup m × SOGroup m) (1, 1) := (Path.refl 1).prod β with hpr
  have hfst : (pp.map continuous_fst).Homotopic ((pr.trans pl).map continuous_fst) := by
    have e1 : pp.map continuous_fst = α := by
      apply Path.ext; funext t; rfl
    have e2a : pr.map continuous_fst = Path.refl (1 : SOGroup m) := by
      apply Path.ext; funext t; rfl
    have e2b : pl.map continuous_fst = α := by
      apply Path.ext; funext t; rfl
    rw [e1, Path.map_trans, e2a, e2b]
    exact (Path.Homotopic.refl_trans α).symm
  have hsnd : (pp.map continuous_snd).Homotopic ((pr.trans pl).map continuous_snd) := by
    have e1 : pp.map continuous_snd = β := by
      apply Path.ext; funext t; rfl
    have e2a : pr.map continuous_snd = β := by
      apply Path.ext; funext t; rfl
    have e2b : pl.map continuous_snd = Path.refl (1 : SOGroup m) := by
      apply Path.ext; funext t; rfl
    rw [e1, Path.map_trans, e2a, e2b]
    exact (Path.Homotopic.trans_refl β).symm
  have hpair : pp.Homotopic (pr.trans pl) := homotopic_of_component_homotopies hfst hsnd
  have hmul := hpair.map μc
  have h11 : (1 : SOGroup m) = μc (1, 1) := (one_mul 1).symm
  have hcast := Path.Homotopic.pathCast hmul h11 h11
  have e3 : (pp.map μc.continuous).cast h11 h11 = pathMul α β := by
    apply Path.ext; funext t; rfl
  have e4 : ((pr.trans pl).map μc.continuous).cast h11 h11 = β.trans α := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    show ((pr.trans pl).map μc.continuous) t = (β.trans α) t
    rw [Path.map_trans, Path.trans_apply, Path.trans_apply]
    split_ifs
    · exact one_mul _
    · exact mul_one _
  rw [e3, e4] at hcast
  exact hcast

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_congr_fun
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_congr_fun {γ δ : C(I, SOGroup m)} (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) (hδ : δ 0 = δ 1)
    (h : γ = δ) : loopClassZ2 γ hγ = loopClassZ2 δ hδ
proof:
:= by
  subst h
  rfl

name: Submission.basedClassZ2_homotopic
statement:
theorem basedClassZ2_homotopic {α β : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1} (h : α.Homotopic β) :
    basedClassZ2 α = basedClassZ2 β
proof:
:=
  congrArg (fun z => Multiplicative.toAdd (wHom m (FundamentalGroup.fromPath z)))
    (Quotient.sound h)

name: Submission.basedClassZ2_mul
statement:
theorem basedClassZ2_mul (α β : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1) :
    basedClassZ2 (pathMul α β) = basedClassZ2 α + basedClassZ2 β
proof:
:= by
  unfold basedClassZ2
  have h1 : (⟦pathMul α β⟧ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient (1 : SOGroup m) 1)
      = ⟦β.trans α⟧ := Quotient.sound (pathMul_homotopic_trans α β)
  have h2 : FundamentalGroup.fromPath (⟦pathMul α β⟧ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient _ _)
      = FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦α⟧ * FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦β⟧ := by
    rw [FundamentalGroup.mul_def]
    exact congrArg _ h1
  rw [h2, map_mul]
  rfl

name: Submission.basedClassZ2_refl
statement: theorem basedClassZ2_refl : basedClassZ2 (Path.refl (1 : SOGroup m)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold basedClassZ2
  have h : FundamentalGroup.fromPath
      (⟦Path.refl (1 : SOGroup m)⟧ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient _ _) = 1 := rfl
  rw [h, map_one]
  rfl

name: Submission.basedClassZ2_symm
statement:
theorem basedClassZ2_symm (α : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1) :
    basedClassZ2 α.symm = basedClassZ2 α
proof:
:= by
  unfold basedClassZ2
  have h : FundamentalGroup.fromPath (⟦α.symm⟧ : Path.Homotopic.Quotient _ _)
      = (FundamentalGroup.fromPath ⟦α⟧)⁻¹ := rfl
  rw [h, map_inv]
  have htwo : ∀ y : Multiplicative (ZMod 2),
      Multiplicative.toAdd y⁻¹ = Multiplicative.toAdd y := by decide
  exact htwo _

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_congr
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_congr {γ δ : C(I, SOGroup m)} (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) (hδ : δ 0 = δ 1)
    (H : ContinuousMap.Homotopy γ δ) (hH : ∀ s, H (s, 0) = H (s, 1)) :
    loopClassZ2 γ hγ = loopClassZ2 δ hδ
proof:
:= by
  apply basedClassZ2_homotopic
  refine ⟨{ toFun := fun q => H q * (H (q.1, 0))⁻¹
            continuous_toFun := H.continuous.mul
              ((H.continuous.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const)).inv)
            map_zero_left := fun t => by
              show H (0, t) * (H (0, 0))⁻¹ = γ t * (γ 0)⁻¹
              rw [H.apply_zero, H.apply_zero]
            map_one_left := fun t => by
              show H (1, t) * (H (1, 0))⁻¹ = δ t * (δ 0)⁻¹
              rw [H.apply_one, H.apply_one]
            prop' := fun s x hx => by
              have hx' : x = 0 ∨ x = 1 := by simpa using hx
              show H (s, x) * (H (s, 0))⁻¹ = freeToBased γ hγ x
              rcases hx' with rfl | rfl
              · rw [mul_inv_cancel]
                exact (mul_inv_cancel (γ 0)).symm
              · rw [← hH s, mul_inv_cancel]
                show (1 : SOGroup m) = γ 1 * (γ 0)⁻¹
                rw [← hγ, mul_inv_cancel] }⟩

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_const
statement:
@[simp]
theorem loopClassZ2_const (g : SOGroup m) :
    loopClassZ2 (ContinuousMap.const I g) rfl = 0
proof:
:= by
  unfold loopClassZ2
  have h : freeToBased (ContinuousMap.const I g) rfl = Path.refl 1 := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    exact mul_inv_cancel g
  rw [h, basedClassZ2_refl]

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_mul
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_mul (γ δ : C(I, SOGroup m)) (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) (hδ : δ 0 = δ 1)
    (hprod : (γ * δ) 0 = (γ * δ) 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (γ * δ) hprod = loopClassZ2 γ hγ + loopClassZ2 δ hδ
proof:
:= by
  unfold loopClassZ2
  have hdecomp : freeToBased (γ * δ) hprod
      = pathMul (freeToBased γ hγ) (conjLoop (γ 0) (freeToBased δ hδ)) := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    show γ t * δ t * (γ 0 * δ 0)⁻¹
      = (γ t * (γ 0)⁻¹) * (γ 0 * (δ t * (δ 0)⁻¹) * (γ 0)⁻¹)
    rw [_root_.mul_inv_rev]
    group
  rw [hdecomp, basedClassZ2_mul]
  congr 1
  exact basedClassZ2_homotopic (conjLoop_homotopic (γ 0) (freeToBased δ hδ))

name: Submission.incLoop_closed
statement:
theorem incLoop_closed {γ : C(I, SOGroup m)} (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) :
    incLoop γ 0 = incLoop γ 1
proof:
:= by
  show incHom m (γ 0) = incHom m (γ 1)
  rw [hγ]

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_stable
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_stable (hm : 3 ≤ m) (γ : C(I, SOGroup m)) (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (incLoop γ) (incLoop_closed hγ) = loopClassZ2 γ hγ
proof:
:= by
  unfold loopClassZ2 basedClassZ2
  have hpath : freeToBased (incLoop γ) (incLoop_closed hγ)
      = ((freeToBased γ hγ).map (continuous_incHom m)).cast (map_one (incHom m)).symm
        (map_one (incHom m)).symm := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    show incHom m (γ t) * (incHom m (γ 0))⁻¹ = incHom m (γ t * (γ 0)⁻¹)
    rw [map_mul, map_inv]
  rw [hpath, ← incPi1_fromPath, wHom_incPi1 hm]

name: Submission.reverseLoop_closed
statement:
theorem reverseLoop_closed {γ : C(I, SOGroup m)} (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) :
    reverseLoop γ 0 = reverseLoop γ 1
proof:
:= by
  show γ (unitInterval.symm 0) = γ (unitInterval.symm 1)
  rw [unitInterval.symm_zero, unitInterval.symm_one, hγ]

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_reverse
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_reverse (γ : C(I, SOGroup m)) (hγ : γ 0 = γ 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (reverseLoop γ) (reverseLoop_closed hγ) = loopClassZ2 γ hγ
proof:
:= by
  unfold loopClassZ2
  have h : freeToBased (reverseLoop γ) (reverseLoop_closed hγ) = (freeToBased γ hγ).symm := by
    apply Path.ext
    funext t
    show γ (unitInterval.symm t) * (γ (unitInterval.symm 0))⁻¹
      = γ (unitInterval.symm t) * (γ 0)⁻¹
    rw [unitInterval.symm_zero, ← hγ]
  rw [h, basedClassZ2_symm]

name: Submission.based_loop_closed
statement:
theorem based_loop_closed (α : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1) :
    α.toContinuousMap 0 = α.toContinuousMap 1
proof:
:= by
  show α 0 = α 1
  rw [α.source, α.target]

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_toContinuousMap
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_toContinuousMap (α : Path (1 : SOGroup m) 1) :
    loopClassZ2 α.toContinuousMap (based_loop_closed α) = basedClassZ2 α
proof:
:= by
  unfold loopClassZ2
  congr 1
  apply Path.ext
  funext t
  show α t * (α 0)⁻¹ = α t
  rw [α.source, inv_one, mul_one]

name: Submission.basedClassZ2_rotationLoop
statement: theorem basedClassZ2_rotationLoop (hm : 3 ≤ m) : basedClassZ2 (rotationLoop m) = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold basedClassZ2
  rw [wHom_rotationLoop hm]
  rfl

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_rotationLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_rotationLoop (hm : 3 ≤ m) :
    loopClassZ2 (rotationLoop m).toContinuousMap (based_loop_closed _) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [loopClassZ2_toContinuousMap, basedClassZ2_rotationLoop hm]

name: Submission.so2Loop_closed
statement:
theorem so2Loop_closed (m : ℕ) (θ : C(I, ℝ)) (k : ℤ)
    (hk : θ 1 = θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi * k) : so2Loop m θ 0 = so2Loop m θ 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  show rotBlock m (θ 0) = rotBlock m (θ 1)
  rw [hk, rotBlock_add, rotBlock_int_two_pi, mul_one]

name: Submission.so2Loop_mul
statement:
theorem so2Loop_mul (θ₁ θ₂ : C(I, ℝ)) :
    so2Loop m (θ₁ + θ₂) = so2Loop m θ₁ * so2Loop m θ₂
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro t
  apply Subtype.ext
  show rotBlock m ((θ₁ + θ₂) t) = rotBlock m (θ₁ t) * rotBlock m (θ₂ t)
  rw [ContinuousMap.add_apply, rotBlock_add]

name: Submission.linearAngle_closed
statement:
theorem linearAngle_closed (k : ℤ) :
    linearAngle k 1 = linearAngle k 0 + 2 * Real.pi * k
proof:
:= by
  show 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * ((1 : I) : ℝ)
    = 2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * ((0 : I) : ℝ) + 2 * Real.pi * k
  rw [Set.Icc.coe_one, Set.Icc.coe_zero]
  ring

name: Submission.so2Loop_linearAngle_closed
statement:
theorem so2Loop_linearAngle_closed (k : ℤ) :
    so2Loop m (linearAngle k) 0 = so2Loop m (linearAngle k) 1
proof:
:=
  so2Loop_closed m _ k (linearAngle_closed k)

name: Submission.so2Loop_linearAngle_one
statement:
theorem so2Loop_linearAngle_one :
    so2Loop m (linearAngle 1) = (rotationLoop m).toContinuousMap
proof:
:= by
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro t
  apply Subtype.ext
  show rotBlock m (2 * Real.pi * ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ)) = rotBlock m (2 * Real.pi * (t : ℝ))
  norm_num

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_so2_linear_zero
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_so2_linear_zero
    (hcl : so2Loop m (linearAngle 0) 0 = so2Loop m (linearAngle 0) 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle 0)) hcl = 0
proof:
:= by
  have h0 : so2Loop m (linearAngle 0) = ContinuousMap.const I (1 : SOGroup m) := by
    apply ContinuousMap.ext
    intro t
    apply Subtype.ext
    show rotBlock m (2 * Real.pi * ((0 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ))
      = ((1 : SOGroup m) : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) ℝ)
    rw [show (2 : ℝ) * Real.pi * ((0 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) = 0 by norm_num, rotBlock_zero]
    rfl
  calc loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle 0)) hcl
      = loopClassZ2 (ContinuousMap.const I (1 : SOGroup m)) rfl :=
        loopClassZ2_congr_fun hcl rfl h0
    _ = 0 := loopClassZ2_const 1

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_so2_linear_one
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_so2_linear_one (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    (hcl : so2Loop m (linearAngle 1) 0 = so2Loop m (linearAngle 1) 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle 1)) hcl = 1
proof:
:=
  calc loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle 1)) hcl
      = loopClassZ2 (rotationLoop m).toContinuousMap (based_loop_closed _) :=
        loopClassZ2_congr_fun hcl (based_loop_closed _) so2Loop_linearAngle_one
    _ = 1 := loopClassZ2_rotationLoop hm

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_so2_linear_neg_one
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_so2_linear_neg_one (hm : 3 ≤ m)
    (hcl : so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1)) 0 = so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1)) 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1))) hcl = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hadd : linearAngle (-1 : ℤ) + linearAngle 1 = linearAngle 0 := by
    ext t
    show 2 * Real.pi * ((-1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) + 2 * Real.pi * ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ)
      = 2 * Real.pi * ((0 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ)
    push_cast
    ring
  have h0eq : so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1)) * so2Loop m (linearAngle 1)
      = so2Loop m (linearAngle 0) := by
    rw [← so2Loop_mul, hadd]
  have hcl1 : so2Loop m (linearAngle 1) 0 = so2Loop m (linearAngle 1) 1 :=
    so2Loop_linearAngle_closed 1
  have hprodcl : (so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1)) * so2Loop m (linearAngle 1)) 0
      = (so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1)) * so2Loop m (linearAngle 1)) 1 := by
    rw [h0eq]
    exact so2Loop_linearAngle_closed 0
  have hsum := loopClassZ2_mul _ _ hcl hcl1 hprodcl
  have hzero : loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1)) * so2Loop m (linearAngle 1))
      hprodcl = 0 := by
    calc loopClassZ2 _ hprodcl
        = loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle 0)) (so2Loop_linearAngle_closed 0) :=
          loopClassZ2_congr_fun hprodcl (so2Loop_linearAngle_closed 0) h0eq
      _ = 0 := loopClassZ2_so2_linear_zero _
  rw [hsum, loopClassZ2_so2_linear_one hm hcl1] at hzero
  have hsolve : ∀ a : ZMod 2, a + 1 = 0 → a = 1 := by decide
  exact hsolve _ hzero

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_so2_linear
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_so2_linear (hm : 3 ≤ m) (k : ℤ)
    (hcl : so2Loop m (linearAngle k) 0 = so2Loop m (linearAngle k) 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle k)) hcl = (k : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  revert hcl
  induction k using Int.induction_on with
  | zero =>
    intro hcl
    rw [loopClassZ2_so2_linear_zero hcl]
    norm_num
  | succ n ih =>
    intro hcl
    have hsplit : linearAngle ((n : ℤ) + 1) = linearAngle n + linearAngle 1 := by
      ext t
      show 2 * Real.pi * (((n : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ)
        = 2 * Real.pi * ((n : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ) + 2 * Real.pi * ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ)
      push_cast
      ring
    have hprodeq : so2Loop m (linearAngle ((n : ℤ) + 1))
        = so2Loop m (linearAngle n) * so2Loop m (linearAngle 1) := by
      rw [hsplit, so2Loop_mul]
    have hcln : so2Loop m (linearAngle (n : ℤ)) 0 = so2Loop m (linearAngle n) 1 :=
      so2Loop_linearAngle_closed n
    have hcl1 : so2Loop m (linearAngle (1 : ℤ)) 0 = so2Loop m (linearAngle 1) 1 :=
      so2Loop_linearAngle_closed 1
    have hprodcl : (so2Loop m (linearAngle n) * so2Loop m (linearAngle 1)) 0
        = (so2Loop m (linearAngle n) * so2Loop m (linearAngle 1)) 1 := by
      rw [← hprodeq]
      exact so2Loop_linearAngle_closed _
    calc loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle ((n : ℤ) + 1))) hcl
        = loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle n) * so2Loop m (linearAngle 1)) hprodcl :=
          loopClassZ2_congr_fun hcl hprodcl hprodeq
      _ = loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle n)) hcln
          + loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle 1)) hcl1 :=
          loopClassZ2_mul _ _ hcln hcl1 hprodcl
      _ = ((n : ℤ) : ZMod 2) + 1 := by
          rw [ih hcln, loopClassZ2_so2_linear_one hm hcl1]
      _ = (((n : ℤ) + 1 : ℤ) : ZMod 2) := by push_cast; ring
  | pred n ih =>
    intro hcl
    have hsplit : linearAngle (-(n : ℤ) - 1) = linearAngle (-(n : ℤ)) + linearAngle (-1) := by
      ext t
      show 2 * Real.pi * ((-(n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ)
        = 2 * Real.pi * ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ)
          + 2 * Real.pi * ((-1 : ℤ) : ℝ) * (t : ℝ)
      push_cast
      ring
    have hprodeq : so2Loop m (linearAngle (-(n : ℤ) - 1))
        = so2Loop m (linearAngle (-(n : ℤ))) * so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1)) := by
      rw [hsplit, so2Loop_mul]
    have hcln : so2Loop m (linearAngle (-(n : ℤ))) 0
        = so2Loop m (linearAngle (-(n : ℤ))) 1 := so2Loop_linearAngle_closed _
    have hclm1 : so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1 : ℤ)) 0 = so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1)) 1 :=
      so2Loop_linearAngle_closed _
    have hprodcl : (so2Loop m (linearAngle (-(n : ℤ))) * so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1))) 0
        = (so2Loop m (linearAngle (-(n : ℤ))) * so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1))) 1 := by
      rw [← hprodeq]
      exact so2Loop_linearAngle_closed _
    calc loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle (-(n : ℤ) - 1))) hcl
        = loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle (-(n : ℤ)))
            * so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1))) hprodcl :=
          loopClassZ2_congr_fun hcl hprodcl hprodeq
      _ = loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle (-(n : ℤ)))) hcln
          + loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle (-1))) hclm1 :=
          loopClassZ2_mul _ _ hcln hclm1 hprodcl
      _ = ((-(n : ℤ) : ℤ) : ZMod 2) + 1 := by
          rw [ih hcln, loopClassZ2_so2_linear_neg_one hm hclm1]
      _ = ((-(n : ℤ) - 1 : ℤ) : ZMod 2) := by
          push_cast
          have hswap : ∀ a : ZMod 2, a + 1 = a - 1 := by decide
          exact hswap _

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_so2_winding
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_so2_winding (hm : 3 ≤ m) (θ : C(I, ℝ)) (k : ℤ)
    (hk : θ 1 = θ 0 + 2 * Real.pi * k)
    (hcl : so2Loop m θ 0 = so2Loop m θ 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m θ) hcl = (k : ZMod 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hhom : loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m θ) hcl
      = loopClassZ2 (so2Loop m (linearAngle k)) (so2Loop_linearAngle_closed k) := by
    refine loopClassZ2_congr hcl (so2Loop_linearAngle_closed k)
      ({ toFun := fun q =>
          ⟨rotBlock m ((1 - (q.1 : ℝ)) * θ q.2
            + (q.1 : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * (q.2 : ℝ))), rotBlock_mem m _⟩
         continuous_toFun := by
           apply Continuous.subtype_mk
           apply (continuous_rotBlock m).comp
           have h1 : Continuous fun q : I × I => (q.1 : ℝ) :=
             continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst
           have h2 : Continuous fun q : I × I => θ q.2 :=
             θ.continuous.comp continuous_snd
           have h3 : Continuous fun q : I × I => (q.2 : ℝ) :=
             continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd
           exact ((continuous_const.sub h1).mul h2).add
             (h1.mul (continuous_const.mul h3))
         map_zero_left := fun t => by
           apply Subtype.ext
           show rotBlock m ((1 - ((0 : I) : ℝ)) * θ t
             + ((0 : I) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * (t : ℝ))) = rotBlock m (θ t)
           norm_num
         map_one_left := fun t => by
           apply Subtype.ext
           show rotBlock m ((1 - ((1 : I) : ℝ)) * θ t
             + ((1 : I) : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * (t : ℝ)))
             = rotBlock m (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * (t : ℝ))
           norm_num }) ?_
    intro s
    apply Subtype.ext
    show rotBlock m ((1 - (s : ℝ)) * θ 0 + (s : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * ((0 : I) : ℝ)))
      = rotBlock m ((1 - (s : ℝ)) * θ 1 + (s : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * ((1 : I) : ℝ)))
    have heq : (1 - (s : ℝ)) * θ 1 + (s : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * ((1 : I) : ℝ))
        = ((1 - (s : ℝ)) * θ 0 + (s : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi * (k : ℝ) * ((0 : I) : ℝ)))
          + 2 * Real.pi * k := by
      rw [hk, Set.Icc.coe_one, Set.Icc.coe_zero]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    conv_rhs => rw [rotBlock_add]
    rw [rotBlock_int_two_pi, mul_one]
  rw [hhom]
  exact loopClassZ2_so2_linear hm k (so2Loop_linearAngle_closed k)

name: Submission.continuous_SOGroup_val

name: Submission.reflMatrix_apply
statement:
theorem reflMatrix_apply (u : Fin n → ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    reflMatrix u i j = (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i j - 2 / (u ⬝ᵥ u) * (u i * u j)
proof:
:= by
  simp [reflMatrix, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply]

name: Submission.reflMatrix_transpose
statement: theorem reflMatrix_transpose (u : Fin n → ℝ) : (reflMatrix u)ᵀ = reflMatrix u
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, reflMatrix_apply]
  rw [Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  by_cases h : i = j
  · subst h; ring
  · rw [if_neg h, if_neg (Ne.symm h)]; ring

name: Submission.vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec (u v w z : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec u v * Matrix.vecMulVec w z = (v ⬝ᵥ w) • Matrix.vecMulVec u z
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, dotProduct,
    smul_eq_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring

name: Submission.vecMulVec_mulVec
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_mulVec (u v w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec u v *ᵥ w = (v ⬝ᵥ w) • u
proof:
:= by
  ext i
  simp only [Matrix.mulVec, dotProduct, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => by ring

name: Submission.vecMulVec_smul_left
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_smul_left (a : ℝ) (u v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec (a • u) v = a • Matrix.vecMulVec u v
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Submission.vecMulVec_smul_right
statement:
theorem vecMulVec_smul_right (a : ℝ) (u v : Fin n → ℝ) :
    Matrix.vecMulVec u (a • v) = a • Matrix.vecMulVec u v
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  simp only [Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Submission.reflMatrix_smul
statement:
theorem reflMatrix_smul {a : ℝ} (ha : a ≠ 0) (u : Fin n → ℝ) :
    reflMatrix (a • u) = reflMatrix u
proof:
:= by
  have hdot : (a • u) ⬝ᵥ (a • u) = a * a * (u ⬝ᵥ u) := by
    rw [smul_dotProduct, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  have hvv : Matrix.vecMulVec (a • u) (a • u) = (a * a) • Matrix.vecMulVec u u := by
    rw [vecMulVec_smul_left, vecMulVec_smul_right, smul_smul]
  have hcoef : 2 / (a * a * (u ⬝ᵥ u)) * (a * a) = 2 / (u ⬝ᵥ u) := by
    by_cases hu : u ⬝ᵥ u = 0
    · simp [hu]
    · field_simp
  rw [reflMatrix, reflMatrix, hdot, hvv, smul_smul, hcoef]

name: Submission.reflMatrix_mulVec
statement:
theorem reflMatrix_mulVec (u w : Fin n → ℝ) :
    reflMatrix u *ᵥ w = w - (2 / (u ⬝ᵥ u) * (u ⬝ᵥ w)) • u
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflMatrix, Matrix.sub_mulVec, Matrix.one_mulVec, smul_mulVec, vecMulVec_mulVec,
    smul_smul]

name: Submission.reflMatrix_mulVec_self
statement:
theorem reflMatrix_mulVec_self {u : Fin n → ℝ} (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u ≠ 0) :
    reflMatrix u *ᵥ u = -u
proof:
:= by
  rw [reflMatrix_mulVec, div_mul_cancel₀ 2 hu]
  ext i
  simp only [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, Pi.neg_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  ring

name: Submission.reflMatrix_mul_self
statement:
theorem reflMatrix_mul_self {u : Fin n → ℝ} (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u ≠ 0) :
    reflMatrix u * reflMatrix u = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hMM : Matrix.vecMulVec u u * Matrix.vecMulVec u u
      = (u ⬝ᵥ u) • Matrix.vecMulVec u u := vecMulVec_mul_vecMulVec u u u u
  have hs : (2 / (u ⬝ᵥ u) * (2 / (u ⬝ᵥ u))) * (u ⬝ᵥ u)
      = 2 / (u ⬝ᵥ u) + 2 / (u ⬝ᵥ u) := by
    field_simp
    ring
  set c : ℝ := 2 / (u ⬝ᵥ u)
  set M := Matrix.vecMulVec u u
  have expand : (1 - c • M) * (1 - c • M) = 1 - c • M - c • M + (c * c) • (M * M) := by
    simp only [sub_mul, mul_sub, one_mul, mul_one, Matrix.smul_mul, Matrix.mul_smul,
      smul_smul]
    abel
  show (1 - c • M) * (1 - c • M) = 1
  rw [expand, hMM, smul_smul, hs, add_smul]
  abel

name: Submission.reflMatrix_mem_orthogonalGroup
statement:
theorem reflMatrix_mem_orthogonalGroup {u : Fin n → ℝ} (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u ≠ 0) :
    reflMatrix u ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff, reflMatrix_transpose]
  exact reflMatrix_mul_self hu

name: Submission.det_reflMatrix
statement:
theorem det_reflMatrix {u : Fin n → ℝ} (hu : u ⬝ᵥ u ≠ 0) :
    (reflMatrix u).det = -1
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : reflMatrix u
      = 1 + Matrix.replicateCol Unit ((-(2 / (u ⬝ᵥ u))) • u) * Matrix.replicateRow Unit u := by
    rw [← Matrix.vecMulVec_eq, vecMulVec_smul_left, reflMatrix, neg_smul, ← sub_eq_add_neg]
  rw [h1, Matrix.det_one_add_replicateCol_mul_replicateRow, dotProduct_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  field_simp
  norm_num

name: Submission.add_dotProduct_add
statement:
theorem add_dotProduct_add (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (hy : y ⬝ᵥ y = 1) :
    (x + y) ⬝ᵥ (x + y) = 2 + 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ y)
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_dotProduct, dotProduct_add, dotProduct_add, hx, hy, dotProduct_comm y x]
  ring

name: Submission.add_dotProduct_add_ne_zero
statement:
theorem add_dotProduct_add_ne_zero (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (hy : y ⬝ᵥ y = 1)
    (hxy : -1 < x ⬝ᵥ y) : (x + y) ⬝ᵥ (x + y) ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [add_dotProduct_add hx hy]
  nlinarith

name: Submission.rotToAux_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup
statement:
theorem rotToAux_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (hy : y ⬝ᵥ y = 1)
    (hxy : -1 < x ⬝ᵥ y) :
    rotToAux x y ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  have hs : (x + y) ⬝ᵥ (x + y) ≠ 0 := add_dotProduct_add_ne_zero hx hy hxy
  have hx0 : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0 := by rw [hx]; norm_num
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
  constructor
  · exact mul_mem (reflMatrix_mem_orthogonalGroup hs) (reflMatrix_mem_orthogonalGroup hx0)
  · rw [rotToAux, Matrix.det_mul, det_reflMatrix hs, det_reflMatrix hx0]
    norm_num

name: Submission.rotToAux_mulVec_self
statement:
theorem rotToAux_mulVec_self (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) (hy : y ⬝ᵥ y = 1)
    (hxy : -1 < x ⬝ᵥ y) : rotToAux x y *ᵥ x = y
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0 := by rw [hx]; norm_num
  have hs : (x + y) ⬝ᵥ (x + y) = 2 + 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ y) := add_dotProduct_add hx hy
  have hsx : (x + y) ⬝ᵥ x = 1 + x ⬝ᵥ y := by
    rw [add_dotProduct, hx, dotProduct_comm y x]
  have hne1 : (1 : ℝ) + x ⬝ᵥ y ≠ 0 := by nlinarith
  have hcoef : 2 / ((x + y) ⬝ᵥ (x + y)) * ((x + y) ⬝ᵥ x) = 1 := by
    rw [hs, hsx, show (2 : ℝ) + 2 * (x ⬝ᵥ y) = 2 * (1 + x ⬝ᵥ y) by ring]
    field_simp
  rw [rotToAux, ← Matrix.mulVec_mulVec, reflMatrix_mulVec_self hx0, Matrix.mulVec_neg,
    reflMatrix_mulVec, hcoef, one_smul]
  ext i
  simp only [Pi.neg_apply, Pi.sub_apply, Pi.add_apply]
  ring

name: Submission.rotToAux_same
statement: theorem rotToAux_same (hx : x ⬝ᵥ x = 1) : rotToAux x x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hx0 : x ⬝ᵥ x ≠ 0 := by rw [hx]; norm_num
  have h2 : x + x = (2 : ℝ) • x := by
    ext i; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]; ring
  rw [rotToAux, h2, reflMatrix_smul (by norm_num : (2:ℝ) ≠ 0), reflMatrix_mul_self hx0]

name: Submission.continuous_reflMatrix_comp
proof:
:= by
  have happ : ∀ i : Fin n, Continuous fun a => g a i := fun i => (continuous_apply i).comp hg
  have hd : Continuous fun a => g a ⬝ᵥ g a := by
    unfold dotProduct
    exact continuous_finsetSum _ fun j _ => (happ j).mul (happ j)
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  have hc : Continuous fun a => (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i j
      - 2 / (g a ⬝ᵥ g a) * (g a i * g a j) :=
    continuous_const.sub ((continuous_const.div hd hne).mul ((happ i).mul (happ j)))
  simpa only [reflMatrix_apply] using hc

name: Submission.continuous_rotToAux_comp
statement:
theorem continuous_rotToAux_comp {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α] {f g : α → Fin n → ℝ}
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g)
    (hfne : ∀ a, f a ⬝ᵥ f a ≠ 0) (hsne : ∀ a, (f a + g a) ⬝ᵥ (f a + g a) ≠ 0) :
    Continuous fun a => rotToAux (f a) (g a)
proof:
:=
  (continuous_reflMatrix_comp (hf.add hg) hsne).matrix_mul
    (continuous_reflMatrix_comp hf hfne)

name: Submission.continuous_coords
statement: theorem continuous_coords : Continuous (coords (n := n))
proof:
:=
  (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin n) ℝ).continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val

name: Submission.coords_dotProduct
statement:
theorem coords_dotProduct (x y : UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) :
    coords x ⬝ᵥ coords y = ⟪(x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply]
  simp only [coords, dotProduct, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => mul_comm _ _

name: Submission.coords_dotProduct_self
statement:
theorem coords_dotProduct_self (x : UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) :
    coords x ⬝ᵥ coords x = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [coords_dotProduct, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, UnitSphere.norm_coe]
  norm_num

name: Submission.neg_one_lt_coords_dot_of_dist_lt_two
statement:
theorem neg_one_lt_coords_dot_of_dist_lt_two {x y : UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))}
    (h : dist x y < 2) : -1 < coords x ⬝ᵥ coords y
proof:
:= by
  have hd : dist x y = ‖(x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) - (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖ := by
    rw [Subtype.dist_eq, dist_eq_norm]
  have hsq : ‖(x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) - (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))‖ ^ 2
      = 2 - 2 * ⟪(x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), (y : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))⟫ := by
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real, UnitSphere.norm_coe, UnitSphere.norm_coe]
    ring
  rw [coords_dotProduct]
  have hnonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ dist x y := dist_nonneg
  nlinarith [hsq, hd]

name: Submission.rotTo_coe
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotTo, dif_pos h]

name: Submission.rotTo_mulVec
proof:
:= by
  rw [rotTo_coe h]
  exact rotToAux_mulVec_self (coords_dotProduct_self x) (coords_dotProduct_self y) h

name: Submission.rotTo_self
statement:
@[simp]
theorem rotTo_self (x : UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) : rotTo x x = 1
proof:
:= by
  have h : -1 < coords x ⬝ᵥ coords x := by rw [coords_dotProduct_self]; norm_num
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [rotTo_coe h]
  exact rotToAux_same (coords_dotProduct_self x)

name: Submission.continuous_rotTo
statement:
theorem continuous_rotTo {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    {f g : α → UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))}
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : Continuous g)
    (h : ∀ a, -1 < coords (f a) ⬝ᵥ coords (g a)) :
    Continuous fun a => rotTo (f a) (g a)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun a => rotTo (f a) (g a))
      = fun a => (⟨rotToAux (coords (f a)) (coords (g a)),
          rotToAux_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup (coords_dotProduct_self (f a))
            (coords_dotProduct_self (g a)) (h a)⟩ : SOGroup n) := by
    funext a
    exact Subtype.ext (rotTo_coe (h a))
  rw [heq]
  apply Continuous.subtype_mk
  exact continuous_rotToAux_comp (continuous_coords.comp hf) (continuous_coords.comp hg)
    (fun a => by rw [coords_dotProduct_self]; norm_num)
    (fun a => add_dotProduct_add_ne_zero (coords_dotProduct_self (f a))
      (coords_dotProduct_self (g a)) (h a))

name: Submission.continuous_chartCoord
statement:
theorem continuous_chartCoord (η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2))) (i : Fin 2) :
    Continuous (fun u : I => η u i)
proof:
:= by
  first
  | exact (continuous_apply i).comp (WithLp.continuous_ofLp _ _ |>.comp
      η.continuous)
  | exact (EuclideanSpace.proj i).continuous.comp η.continuous

name: Submission.sign_constant_of_ne_zero
statement:
theorem sign_constant_of_ne_zero {f : I → ℝ} (hf : Continuous f)
    (h : ∀ u, f u ≠ 0) : (∀ u, 0 < f u) ∨ (∀ u, f u < 0)
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (h 0) with hneg | hpos
  · right
    intro u
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (h u) with h1 | h1
    · exact h1
    · exact absurd (intermediate_value_univ (0 : I) u hf
        (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (f 0) (f u) from ⟨le_of_lt hneg, le_of_lt h1⟩))
        (by rintro ⟨v, hv⟩; exact h v hv)
  · left
    intro u
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (h u) with h1 | h1
    · exact absurd (intermediate_value_univ u (0 : I) hf
        (show (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (f u) (f 0) from ⟨le_of_lt h1, le_of_lt hpos⟩))
        (by rintro ⟨v, hv⟩; exact h v hv)
    · exact h1

name: Submission.signedBranch_pos_iff
statement:
theorem signedBranch_pos_iff (b : SaddleBranch) (x : ℝ) :
    0 < signedBranch b x ↔ (b = .positive ∧ 0 < x) ∨ (b = .negative ∧ x < 0)
proof:
:= by
  cases b <;> simp [signedBranch] <;> constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith

name: Submission.eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos
statement:
theorem eq_positive_of_signedBranch_pos {b : SaddleBranch} {x : ℝ}
    (h : 0 < signedBranch b x) (hx : 0 < x) : b = .positive
proof:
:= by
  cases b with
  | positive => rfl
  | negative =>
      exfalso
      have : (0 : ℝ) < -x := h
      linarith

name: Submission.eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos
statement:
theorem eq_negative_of_signedBranch_pos {b : SaddleBranch} {x : ℝ}
    (h : 0 < signedBranch b x) (hx : x < 0) : b = .negative
proof:
:= by
  cases b with
  | positive =>
      exfalso
      have : (0 : ℝ) < x := h
      linarith
  | negative => rfl

name: Submission.pos_of_signedBranch_pos_positive
statement:
theorem pos_of_signedBranch_pos_positive {x : ℝ}

name: Submission.neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative
statement:
theorem neg_of_signedBranch_pos_negative {x : ℝ}
    (h : 0 < signedBranch .negative x) : x < 0
proof:

  have : (0 : ℝ) < -x := h
  linarith

name: Submission.chartParam_quadratic_before
statement:
theorem chartParam_quadratic_before (hindex : M.index = .saddle) {s : ℝ}
    {v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)} (hv : ‖v‖ < M.radius)
    (htime : tcoord (M.localPoint v) = tcoord center - s ^ 2) :
    v 0 ^ 2 - v 1 ^ 2 = -(s ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h := M.localPoint_time v hv
  rw [htime, hindex] at h
  have h2 : morseQuadratic .saddle (v 0, v 1) = v 0 ^ 2 - v 1 ^ 2 := rfl
  rw [h2] at h
  linarith

name: Submission.chartParam_quadratic_after

statement:
theorem exists_chartMap_sign_of_saddlePositiveSpatialSegment
    (T : M.EmbeddedShrink) (hindex : M.index = .saddle) (b : SaddleBranch)
    {ρ s : ℝ} (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hs0 : s ≠ 0) (hs : s ^ 2 < ρ ^ 2)
    (hρrad : ρ < T.radius)
    (ζ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
    (hmem : ∀ u : I, spacePart (ζ u) ∈
      Set.range (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad))
    (htime : ∀ u : I, tcoord (ζ u) = tcoord center + s ^ 2) :
    ∃ η : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)), (∀ u : I, ‖η u‖ ≤ ρ) ∧
      (∀ u : I, 0 < signedBranch b (η u 0)) ∧
      (∀ u : I, M.localPoint (η u) = ζ u)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ⟩ := exists_continuous_preimage_of_injective_range
    (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment b ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
    (T.saddlePositiveSpatialSegment_injective hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad)
    ⟨fun u => spacePart (ζ u), continuous_spacePart.comp ζ.continuous⟩ hmem
  refine ⟨(saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s).comp φ, fun u => ?_, fun u => ?_,
    fun u => ?_⟩
  · exact norm_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_le b hρ hs (φ u)
  · exact signedBranch_saddlePositiveSegmentParam_apply_zero_pos b hs0 (φ u)
  · have hspace : spacePart (M.localPoint
        (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s (φ u))) = spacePart (ζ u) := hφ u
    have htimeseg : tcoord (M.localPoint
        (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s (φ u))) = tcoord center + s ^ 2 :=
      T.saddlePositiveSegment_time hindex b ρ s hρ hs hρrad (φ u)
    calc M.localPoint (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s (φ u))
        = cobSpaceTime
            (spacePart (M.localPoint (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s (φ u))))
            (tcoord (M.localPoint
              (saddlePositiveSegmentParam b ρ s (φ u)))) :=
          (spaceTime_spacePart _).symm
      _ = cobSpaceTime (spacePart (ζ u)) (tcoord (ζ u)) := by
          rw [hspace, htimeseg, htime u]
      _ = ζ u := spaceTime_spacePart _

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalExteriorSlabMidpoint_mem_halfCriticalCore
statement:
theorem chronologicalExteriorSlabMidpoint_mem_halfCriticalCore
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    {p : E'}
    (hp : p ∈ D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht)
    (hptime : tcoord p = D.chronologicalBeforeTime t ht) :
    (D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.flow p
        (D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2) ∈
      criticalSliceExteriorCore
        D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2)
proof:
:= by
  let R := D.chronologicalExteriorSlabTimeField t ht
  let s := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2
  change R.base.flow p s ∈ criticalSliceExteriorCore
    D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
    (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
    (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
    ((D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2)
  have hsafe : |s| ≤ R.safeTime := by
    simpa [R, s, chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField] using
      D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime t ht
  have hp' := hp
  rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore] at hp'
  have hpfiber : p ∈
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber :=
    hp'.1.1
  have hyfiber : R.base.flow p s ∈
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber :=
    R.flow_mem_fiber hpfiber s
  have hytime : tcoord (R.base.flow p s) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    calc
      tcoord (R.base.flow p s) = tcoord p + s := R.tcoord_flow hp hsafe
      _ = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
        rw [hptime]
        simp only [chronologicalBeforeTime]
        dsimp [s]
        ring
  have hmove : dist p (R.base.flow p s) ≤
      (R.base.bound : ℝ) * s := by
    calc
      dist p (R.base.flow p s) =
          dist (R.base.flow p 0) (R.base.flow p s) := by simp
      _ ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |0 - s| :=
        R.base.dist_flow_self_le p 0 s
      _ = (R.base.bound : ℝ) * s := by
        rw [sub_eq_neg_add, add_zero, abs_neg,
          abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  have hmoveShort : (R.base.bound : ℝ) * s <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 := by
    simpa [R, s, chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField] using
      D.chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_half_cover t ht
  have hpFar : (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius ≤
      dist p (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := hp'.2
  have htriangle := dist_triangle p (R.base.flow p s)
    (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
  have hyFar : (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 ≤
      dist (R.base.flow p s) (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    nlinarith
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore]
  exact ⟨hyfiber, hytime, hyFar⟩

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.chronologicalExteriorSlabReverseMidpoint_mem_halfCriticalCore
statement:
theorem chronologicalExteriorSlabReverseMidpoint_mem_halfCriticalCore
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    {p : E'}
    (hp : p ∈ D.chronologicalExteriorSlabCore t ht)
    (hptime : tcoord p = D.chronologicalAfterTime t ht) :
    (D.chronologicalSaddleCriticalExteriorTimeField t ht).base.flow p
        (-(D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2)) ∈
      criticalSliceExteriorCore
        D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
        (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
        (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2)
proof:
:= by
  let R := D.chronologicalExteriorSlabTimeField t ht
  let s := D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht ^ 2
  change R.base.flow p (-s) ∈ criticalSliceExteriorCore
    D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
    (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
    (tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht))
    ((D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2)
  have hsafe : |-s| ≤ R.safeTime := by
    simpa [R, s, chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField] using
      D.chronologicalWindowRadius_sq_le_safeTime t ht
  have hp' := hp
  rw [chronologicalExteriorSlabCore] at hp'
  have hpfiber : p ∈
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber :=
    hp'.1.1
  have hyfiber : R.base.flow p (-s) ∈
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber :=
    R.flow_mem_fiber hpfiber (-s)
  have hytime : tcoord (R.base.flow p (-s)) =
      tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    calc
      tcoord (R.base.flow p (-s)) = tcoord p + (-s) :=
        R.tcoord_flow hp hsafe
      _ = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
        rw [hptime]
        simp only [chronologicalAfterTime]
        dsimp [s]
        ring
  have hmove : dist p (R.base.flow p (-s)) ≤
      (R.base.bound : ℝ) * s := by
    calc
      dist p (R.base.flow p (-s)) =
          dist (R.base.flow p 0) (R.base.flow p (-s)) := by simp
      _ ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |0 - (-s)| :=
        R.base.dist_flow_self_le p 0 (-s)
      _ = (R.base.bound : ℝ) * s := by
        rw [sub_neg_eq_add, zero_add, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
  have hmoveShort : (R.base.bound : ℝ) * s <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 := by
    simpa [R, s, chronologicalCriticalExteriorTimeField] using
      D.chronologicalWindowRadius_flowDistance_lt_half_cover t ht
  have hpFar : (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius ≤
      dist p (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := hp'.2
  have htriangle := dist_triangle p (R.base.flow p (-s))
    (D.position.eventCenter t ht)
  have hyFar : (D.position.eventModel t ht).fiberCoverRadius / 2 ≤
      dist (R.base.flow p (-s)) (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    nlinarith
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore]
  exact ⟨hyfiber, hytime, hyFar⟩

          (D.chronologicalSaddleMergeExteriorSourceFamily t ht hindex)})

name: Submission.slabFlowBack_mem_core
statement:
theorem slabFlowBack_mem_core
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tafter → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (htafter : tafter = tcoord center + dafter)
    (hdafter : |dafter| ≤ R.safeTime)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} (hfib : C.G x = 0)
    (htime : tcoord x = tafter)
    (hfar : eps / 2 + (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |dafter| ≤ dist x center) :
    R.base.flow x (-dafter) ∈
      criticalSliceExteriorCore C.toLevelCobordismData center
        (tcoord center) (eps / 2)
proof:
:= by
  have hbnn : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |dafter| :=
    mul_nonneg R.base.bound.coe_nonneg (abs_nonneg _)
  have hhalf : eps / 2 ≤ dist x center := by linarith
  have hneg : |(-dafter : ℝ)| ≤ R.safeTime := by rwa [abs_neg]
  have hunit' : tcoord (R.base.flow x (-dafter)) = tcoord x + -dafter :=
    hunit x hfib htime hhalf (-dafter) hneg
  exact flow_mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore_of_far R hfib
    (by rw [htime, htafter]) hunit' hfar

statement:
theorem tcoord_slabFlow_across

    (htbefore : tbefore = tcoord center + dbefore)
    (htafter : tafter = tcoord center + dafter)
    (hdbefore : |dbefore| ≤ R.safeTime) (hdafter : |dafter| ≤ R.safeTime)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))} (hfib : C.G x = 0)
    (htime : tcoord x = tafter)
    (hfar : eps / 2 + (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |dafter| ≤ dist x center) :
    tcoord (R.base.flow x (dbefore - dafter)) = tbefore
proof:
:=
  tcoord_flow_sub_of_core
    (slabFlowBack_mem_core hunit htafter hdafter hfib htime hfar)
    hdbefore htbefore

name: Submission.orbitIndex_eq_of_slabFlowFamily
statement:
theorem orbitIndex_eq_of_slabFlowFamily
    (ξ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
    (hfib : ∀ w : I, C.G (ξ w) = 0)
    (htime : ∀ w : I, tcoord (ξ w) = tafter)
    (hfar : ∀ w : I,
      eps / 2 + (R.base.bound : ℝ) * |dafter| ≤ dist (ξ w) center)
    (hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)), C.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tafter → eps / 2 ≤ dist x center →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ R.safeTime → tcoord (R.base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d)
    (htbefore : tbefore = tcoord center + dbefore)
    (htafter : tafter = tcoord center + dafter)
    (hdbefore : |dbefore| ≤ R.safeTime) (hdafter : |dafter| ≤ R.safeTime)
    {O O' : Vbefore.OrbitIndex} {w w' : I}
    (hO : spacePart (R.base.flow (ξ w) (dbefore - dafter)) ∈
      (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))))
    (hO' : spacePart (R.base.flow (ξ w') (dbefore - dafter)) ∈
      (O' : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))) :
    O = O'
proof:
:= by
  set γ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) :=
    ⟨fun w => spacePart (R.base.flow (ξ w) (dbefore - dafter)),
      continuous_spacePart.comp
        (R.flowShift ξ (dbefore - dafter)).continuous⟩ with hγ
  have hlevel : ∀ w : I,
      tcoord (R.base.flow (ξ w) (dbefore - dafter)) = tbefore := fun w =>
    tcoord_slabFlow_across hunit htbefore htafter hdbefore hdafter (hfib w)
      (htime w) (hfar w)
  have hmemfib : ∀ w : I, γ w ∈
      (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.toLevelCobordismData tbefore
        hbefore).fiber := by
    intro w
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber]
    show C.toLevelCobordismData.G (cobSpaceTime (γ w) tbefore) = 0
    have hst : cobSpaceTime (γ w) tbefore =
        R.base.flow (ξ w) (dbefore - dafter) := by
      rw [← hlevel w]
      exact spaceTime_spacePart _
    rw [hst]
    exact R.base.flow_mem_fiber (hfib w) _
  have hsame0 : γ w' ∈ Vbefore.orbit (γ w) :=
    Vbefore.mem_orbit_of_preconnected γ.continuous hmemfib w w'
  have hsame : spacePart (R.base.flow (ξ w') (dbefore - dafter)) ∈
      Vbefore.orbit (spacePart (R.base.flow (ξ w) (dbefore - dafter))) := hsame0
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Vbefore.orbitPoint_orbit O] at hO
  rw [Vbefore.orbitPoint_orbit O'] at hO'
  rw [Vbefore.orbitPoint_orbit O, Vbefore.orbitPoint_orbit O',
    ← Vbefore.orbit_eq_of_mem hO, ← Vbefore.orbit_eq_of_mem hO',
    Vbefore.orbit_eq_of_mem hsame]

statement:

    ∀ l₀ l₁ l₂ l₃ : Fin 4,
      l₀ ≠ l₁ → l₀ ≠ l₂ → l₀ ≠ l₃ → l₁ ≠ l₂ → l₁ ≠ l₃ → l₂ ≠ l₃ →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l₀).1 = e →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l₁).1 = e →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l₂).1 = e →
      (saddleBranchPairOfFinFour l₃).1 = e → False
proof:
:= by
  cases e <;> decide
