name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.flowedPositiveBoundaryEnd_mem_negativeBranchOrbit
statement:
theorem flowedPositiveBoundaryEnd_mem_negativeBranchOrbit
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    {s : ℝ} (hb : 0 < s) (hbw : s < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
    (Vneg : TamedField
      ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeSlice s
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)))
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime)
    (hclose : dist
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s)
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
        2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * s ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht) p)
    (hfar : D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2 +
        ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * s ^ 2 ≤
      dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s)
        (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) :
    spacePart ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s)
        (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2)) ∈
      (((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
          hindex p.2 (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
          (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
          (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg : Vneg.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  have hρ : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hs : s ^ 2 < D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
    D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw
  have hρrad : D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht <
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  have hρM : D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    hρrad.trans_le (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  set x₀ := (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd p.1 p.2
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s with hx₀
  have hfib : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x₀ = 0 :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_fiber p.1 p.2
      hρ hs hρM
  have htime : tcoord x₀ = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + s ^ 2 :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddlePositiveBoundaryEnd_time hindex p.1 p.2
      hρ hs hρM
  have habs : |s ^ 2| = s ^ 2 := abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg s)
  have hdafter : |s ^ 2| ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime := by
    rw [habs]; exact hsafe
  have hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + s ^ 2 →
      D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2 ≤ dist x (D.position.eventCenter t ht) →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime →
        tcoord ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d :=
    fun x hx ht' hf d hd => D.bandExterior_tcoord_flow_after t ht hb hbw x hx
      ht' hf d hd
  have hfar' : D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2 +
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |s ^ 2| ≤
      dist x₀ (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    rw [habs]; exact hfar
  have hcore := slabFlowBack_mem_core
    (R := D.bandTimeField t ht) (eps := D.bandCoverRadius t ht)
    (dafter := s ^ 2) (tafter := tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) + s ^ 2)
    hunit rfl hdafter hfib htime hfar'
  have hcore' := hcore
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore] at hcore'
  set w₁ := (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀ (-(s ^ 2)) with hw₁
  have hmove : dist w₁ x₀ ≤ ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * s ^ 2 := by
    have h := (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.dist_flow_self_le x₀ (-(s ^ 2)) 0
    rw [(D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow_zero, sub_zero, abs_neg, habs] at h
    exact h
  have hclose' : dist w₁
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht) p := by
    have htri := dist_triangle w₁ x₀
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    rw [abs_neg, habs]
    linarith
  have hdneg : |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime := by
    rw [abs_neg, habs]; exact hsafe
  obtain ⟨u, huT, hup, _hu1, hu2, huq⟩ :=
    D.exists_saddleEndpointLevelCapture t ht hindex
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht)
      (D.bandTimeField t ht) p hcore
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).flow_mem_fiber hfib (-(s ^ 2))) hdneg hclose'
  have hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = -(s ^ 2) := by
    rw [huq, hcore'.2.1]
    ring
  have hflowEq : (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀ (-(s ^ 2) - s ^ 2) =
      (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow w₁ (-(s ^ 2)) :=
    flow_sub_eq_flow_flow x₀ (-(s ^ 2)) (s ^ 2)
  exact (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
      ht).mem_saddleNegativeBranchOrbit_of_chartParam
    (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) hindex p.2
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s u hquad hu2 hρ hs hρrad
    (huT.trans_le (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le)
    (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg
    (by rw [hup, ← hflowEq])

name: Submission.ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage.flowedNegativeBoundaryEnd_mem_positiveBranchOrbit
statement:
theorem flowedNegativeBoundaryEnd_mem_positiveBranchOrbit
    (D : ValueSeparatedSignedMorsePackage SC)
    (t : ℝ) (ht : t ∈ D.position.eventTimes)
    (hindex : (D.position.eventModel t ht).index = .saddle)
    {s : ℝ} (hb : 0 < s) (hbw : s < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht)
    (Vpos : TamedField
      ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveSlice s
        (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)))
    (p : SaddleBranch × SaddleBranch)
    (hsafe : s ^ 2 ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime)
    (hclose : dist
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s)
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
        2 * ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * s ^ 2 <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht) p)
    (hfar : D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2 +
        ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * s ^ 2 ≤
      dist ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s)
        (D.position.eventCenter t ht)) :
    spacePart ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow
        ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s)
        (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2))) ∈
      (((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
          hindex p.1 (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
          (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
          (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
          (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos : Vpos.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
proof:
:= by
  have hρ : 0 < D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht
  have hs : s ^ 2 < D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht ^ 2 :=
    D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw
  have hρrad : D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht <
      (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius :=
    D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht
  have hρM : D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht <
      (D.position.eventModel t ht).radius :=
    hρrad.trans_le (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le
  set x₀ := (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd p.2 p.1
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s with hx₀
  have hfib : D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x₀ = 0 :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_fiber p.2 p.1
      hρ hs hρM
  have htime : tcoord x₀ = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - s ^ 2 :=
    (D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleNegativeBoundaryEnd_time hindex p.2 p.1
      hρ hs hρM
  have habs : |s ^ 2| = s ^ 2 := abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg s)
  have habsn : |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| = s ^ 2 := by rw [abs_neg, habs]
  have hdafter : |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime := by
    rw [habsn]; exact hsafe
  have hunit : ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)),
      D.signedOutput.cobordism.G x = 0 →
      tcoord x = tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - s ^ 2 →
      D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2 ≤ dist x (D.position.eventCenter t ht) →
      ∀ d : ℝ, |d| ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime →
        tcoord ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x d) = tcoord x + d :=
    fun x hx ht' hf d hd => D.bandExterior_tcoord_flow_before t ht hb hbw x hx
      ht' hf d hd
  have hfar' : D.bandCoverRadius t ht / 2 +
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |(-(s ^ 2) : ℝ)| ≤
      dist x₀ (D.position.eventCenter t ht) := by
    rw [habsn]; exact hfar
  have hcore := slabFlowBack_mem_core
    (R := D.bandTimeField t ht) (eps := D.bandCoverRadius t ht)
    (dafter := -(s ^ 2)) (tafter := tcoord (D.position.eventCenter t ht) - s ^ 2)
    hunit (by ring) hdafter hfib htime hfar'
  have hcore' := hcore
  rw [mem_criticalSliceExteriorCore] at hcore'
  set w₁ := (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀ (-(-(s ^ 2))) with hw₁
  have hmove : dist w₁ x₀ ≤ ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * s ^ 2 := by
    have h := (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.dist_flow_self_le x₀ (-(-(s ^ 2))) 0
    rw [(D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow_zero, sub_zero, abs_neg, habsn] at h
    exact h
  have hclose' : dist w₁
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)) +
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).base.bound : ℝ) * |(s ^ 2 : ℝ)| <
      D.chronologicalSaddleRecoveryMargin t ht
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht) p := by
    have htri := dist_triangle w₁ x₀
      ((D.position.eventModel t ht).saddleCriticalBoundaryEnd p
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht))
    rw [habs]
    linarith
  have hdpos : |(s ^ 2 : ℝ)| ≤ (D.bandTimeField t ht).safeTime := by
    rw [habs]; exact hsafe
  obtain ⟨u, huT, hup, hu1, _hu2, huq⟩ :=
    D.exists_saddleEndpointLevelCapture t ht hindex
      (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointLocalFiberCover t ht)
      (D.bandTimeField t ht) p hcore
      ((D.bandTimeField t ht).flow_mem_fiber hfib (-(-(s ^ 2)))) hdpos hclose'
  have hquad : morseQuadratic .saddle (u 0, u 1) = s ^ 2 := by
    rw [huq, hcore'.2.1]
    ring
  have hflowEq : (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow x₀ (s ^ 2 - -(s ^ 2)) =
      (D.bandTimeField t ht).base.flow w₁ (s ^ 2) :=
    flow_sub_eq_flow_flow x₀ (s ^ 2) (-(s ^ 2))
  exact (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
      ht).mem_saddlePositiveBranchOrbit_of_chartParam
    (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) hindex p.1
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht) s u hquad hu1 hρ hs hρrad
    (huT.trans_le (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).radius_le)
    (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos
    (by rw [hup, ← hflowEq])

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.contDiff_unitPhaseTangent
statement:
theorem contDiff_unitPhaseTangent (s : ℝ)
    (hD : ∀ u, deriv (T.lift s) u ≠ 0) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (T.unitPhaseTangent s)
proof:
:= by
  have hderiv : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun u => deriv (T.lift s) u) := by
    exact (FourierFiniteC1Subdivision.EmbeddedCircleTrack.contDiff_phaseDeriv
      (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T).comp
        (contDiff_const.prodMk contDiff_id)
  exact (ContDiff.norm ℝ hderiv hD).inv
      (fun u => norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hD u)) |>.smul hderiv

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.periodic_unitPhaseTangent
statement:
theorem periodic_unitPhaseTangent (s : ℝ) :
    Function.Periodic (T.unitPhaseTangent s) 1
proof:
:= by
  intro u
  have hperiod :=
    FourierFiniteC1Subdivision.EmbeddedCircleTrack.periodic_phaseDeriv
      (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T s u
  simp only [unitPhaseTangent]
  rw [show deriv (T.lift s) (u + 1) = deriv (T.lift s) u from hperiod]

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.unitPhaseTangent_eq_fract
statement:
theorem unitPhaseTangent_eq_fract (s u : ℝ) :
    T.unitPhaseTangent s u = T.unitPhaseTangent s (Int.fract u)
proof:
:= by
  have hperiod := (T.periodic_unitPhaseTangent s).zsmul ⌊u⌋
  have h := hperiod (Int.fract u)
  have hpoint : Int.fract u + ⌊u⌋ • (1 : ℝ) = u := by
    simpa only [Int.smul_one_eq_cast] using Int.fract_add_floor u
  rw [hpoint] at h
  exact h

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.track_lift_zero
statement:
theorem track_lift_zero (u : ℝ) :
    T.lift 0 u = V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u
proof:
:= by
  calc
    T.lift 0 u = T.circle 0 (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :=
      (T.circle_coe 0 u).symm
    _ = V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding O (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [T.start_circle]
    _ = V.intrinsicOrbitLift O u := V.intrinsicOrbitEmbedding_coe O u

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.track_lift_one
statement:
theorem track_lift_one (u : ℝ) :
    T.lift 1 u = targetLift (V := V) h2 O u
proof:
:= by
  calc
    T.lift 1 u = T.circle 1 (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) :=
      (T.circle_coe 1 u).symm
    _ = CanonicalRoundOrbit.circlePoint V h2 O
        (u : AddCircle (1 : ℝ)) := by
      rw [T.finish_circle]
    _ = targetLift (V := V) h2 O u :=
      (targetLift_eq_circlePoint (V := V) h2 O u).symm

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.hasDerivAt_targetLift
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_targetLift (u : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (targetLift (V := V) h2 O)
      ((2 * Real.pi) • OrbitUnknottingFourier.pairCombination
        (OrbitUnknottingFourier.circleTangent u)
        (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := n) h2,
          CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := n) h2)) u
proof:
:= by
  have hfun : targetLift (V := V) h2 O =
      (fun _ : ℝ => CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V h2 O) +
        OrbitUnknottingFourier.perturbation
          (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := n) h2,
            CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := n) h2) := by
    funext y
    simp [targetLift, CanonicalRoundOrbit.point,
      OrbitUnknottingFourier.perturbation,
      OrbitUnknottingFourier.pairCombination,
      OrbitUnknottingFourier.circleLift]
    abel
  have h := (hasDerivAt_const u (CanonicalRoundOrbit.center V h2 O)).add
    (OrbitUnknottingFourier.hasDerivAt_perturbation
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := n) h2,
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := n) h2) u)
  rw [hfun]
  simpa using h

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.deriv_targetLift_ne_zero
statement:
theorem deriv_targetLift_ne_zero (u : ℝ) :
    deriv (targetLift (V := V) h2 O) u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [(hasDerivAt_targetLift (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) u).deriv]
  intro hzero
  have hpi : (2 * Real.pi : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  have hcomb : OrbitUnknottingFourier.pairCombination
      (OrbitUnknottingFourier.circleTangent u)
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀ (n := n) h2,
        CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁ (n := n) h2) = 0 :=
    (smul_eq_zero.mp hzero).resolve_left hpi
  have h₀ := congrArg
    (fun x : E => x (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1))) hcomb
  have h₁ := congrArg
    (fun x : E => x (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1))) hcomb
  simp [OrbitUnknottingFourier.pairCombination,
    OrbitUnknottingFourier.circleTangent,
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁] at h₀ h₁
  nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (2 * Real.pi * u)]

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.track_deriv_one
statement:
theorem track_deriv_one (u : ℝ) :
    deriv (T.lift 1) u = deriv (targetLift (V := V) h2 O) u
proof:
:= by
  congr 1
  funext v
  exact T.track_lift_one v

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.deriv_ne_zero_of_mem_Icc
statement:
theorem deriv_ne_zero_of_mem_Icc {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (u : ℝ) :
    deriv (T.lift s) u ≠ 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases hs with ⟨hs0, hs1⟩
  by_cases h0 : s = 0
  · subst s
    rw [T.track_deriv_zero]
    exact V.deriv_intrinsicOrbitLift_ne_zero O u
  by_cases h1 : s = 1
  · subst s
    rw [T.track_deriv_one]
    exact deriv_targetLift_ne_zero (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) u
  exact T.interior_deriv_ne_zero s u
    (lt_of_le_of_ne hs0 (Ne.symm h0))
    (lt_of_le_of_ne hs1 h1)

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.contDiff_bisectorReflection
statement:
theorem contDiff_bisectorReflection
    {A : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup A] [NormedSpace ℝ A]
    {a b x : A → E}
    (ha : ContDiff ℝ ∞ a) (hb : ContDiff ℝ ∞ b)
    (hx : ContDiff ℝ ∞ x) (hne : ∀ q, a q + b q ≠ 0) :
    ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q => bisectorReflection (a q) (b q) (x q))
proof:
:= by
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ ∞ (fun q => a q + b q) := ha.add hb
  have hden : ∀ q, ⟪a q + b q, a q + b q⟫_ℝ ≠ 0 := by
    intro q
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    exact pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (hne q))
  exact (((contDiff_const.mul ((ContDiff.inner ℝ hc hx).div
      (ContDiff.inner ℝ hc hc) hden))).smul hc).sub hx

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.bisectorReflection_eq_reflection
statement:
theorem bisectorReflection_eq_reflection {a b x : E} :
    bisectorReflection a b x = (ℝ ∙ (a + b)).reflection x
proof:
:= by
  unfold bisectorReflection
  rw [Submodule.reflection_singleton_apply, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  module

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.add_ne_zero_of_unit_inner_gt_neg_one
proof:
:= by
  intro hzero
  have hinner : ⟪a, a⟫_ℝ + ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    calc
      ⟪a, a⟫_ℝ + ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ = ⟪a, a + b⟫_ℝ := by
        rw [inner_add_right]
      _ = 0 := by rw [hzero, inner_zero_right]
  rw [ha] at hinner
  linarith

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.bisectorReflection_self_to_target
statement:
theorem bisectorReflection_self_to_target {a b : E}
    (ha : ⟪a, a⟫_ℝ = 1) (hb : ⟪b, b⟫_ℝ = 1)
    (hab : -1 < ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ) :
    bisectorReflection a b a = b
proof:
:= by
  have hba : ⟪b, a⟫_ℝ = ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ := (real_inner_comm b a).symm
  have hnum : ⟪a + b, a⟫_ℝ = 1 + ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [inner_add_left, ha, hba]
  have hden : ⟪a + b, a + b⟫_ℝ = 2 * (1 + ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ) := by
    rw [inner_add_left, inner_add_right, inner_add_right, ha, hb,
      hba]
    ring
  have hne : 1 + ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ ≠ 0 := by linarith
  unfold bisectorReflection
  rw [hnum, hden]
  have hcoef : 2 * ((1 + ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ) /
      (2 * (1 + ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ))) = 1 := by
    field_simp
  rw [hcoef, one_smul]
  abel

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.inner_bisectorReflection
statement:
theorem inner_bisectorReflection {a b x y : E} :
    ⟪bisectorReflection a b x, bisectorReflection a b y⟫_ℝ =
      ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [bisectorReflection_eq_reflection,
    bisectorReflection_eq_reflection]
  exact LinearIsometryEquiv.inner_map_map _ _ _

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.continuousOn_unitPhaseTangent_square
statement:
theorem continuousOn_unitPhaseTangent_square :
    ContinuousOn
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => T.unitPhaseTangent q.1 q.2)
      (Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)
proof:
:= by
  intro q hq
  have hderiv : ContDiffAt ℝ ∞
      (fun z : ℝ × ℝ =>
        FourierFiniteC1Subdivision.EmbeddedCircleTrack.phaseDeriv
          (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T z.1 z.2) q :=
    (FourierFiniteC1Subdivision.EmbeddedCircleTrack.contDiff_phaseDeriv
      (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T).contDiffAt
  have hne : FourierFiniteC1Subdivision.EmbeddedCircleTrack.phaseDeriv
      (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) T q.1 q.2 ≠ 0 := by
    exact T.deriv_ne_zero_of_mem_Icc hq.1 q.2
  have hnorm := hderiv.norm ℝ hne
  have hsmooth := (hnorm.inv (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hne)).smul hderiv
  exact hsmooth.continuousAt.continuousWithinAt

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.exists_uniform_unitTangent_equisubdivision
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_unitTangent_equisubdivision :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, k < m → ∀ u : ℝ,
        ‖T.unitPhaseTangent ((k : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u -
          T.unitPhaseTangent (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u‖ < 2
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have huniform : UniformContinuousOn
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => T.unitPhaseTangent q.1 q.2) K :=
    hK.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous
      T.continuousOn_unitPhaseTangent_square
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hnear⟩ :=
    Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp huniform 2 (by norm_num)
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hδ
  refine ⟨j + 1, Nat.succ_pos j, ?_⟩
  intro k hk u
  let v : ℝ := Int.fract u
  have hv : v ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨Int.fract_nonneg u, (Int.fract_lt_one u).le⟩
  have hmpos : (0 : ℝ) < ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
  have hk_le : k ≤ j + 1 := Nat.le_of_lt hk
  have hk_succ_le : k + 1 ≤ j + 1 := by omega
  have htime₀ : (k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · positivity
    · exact (div_le_one hmpos).2 (by exact_mod_cast hk_le)
  have htime₁ : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ∈
      Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · positivity
    · exact (div_le_one hmpos).2 (by exact_mod_cast hk_succ_le)
  have hstep :
      dist ((k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
          (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
        1 / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
    rw [Real.dist_eq]
    have hle :
        (k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤
          ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by
      exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
        (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_succ k) hmpos.le
    rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hle)]
    field_simp
    norm_num
  have hdist :
      dist (((k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)), v)
        ((((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)), v) < δ := by
    rw [dist_prod_same_right, hstep]
    simpa only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one] using hj
  have hout := hnear
    (((k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)), v) ⟨htime₀, hv⟩
    ((((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)), v) ⟨htime₁, hv⟩
    hdist
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hout
  rw [T.unitPhaseTangent_eq_fract
      ((k : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) u,
    T.unitPhaseTangent_eq_fract
      (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((j + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) u]
  exact hout

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.exists_uniform_nonantipodal_equisubdivision
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_nonantipodal_equisubdivision :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧
      ∀ k : ℕ, k < m → ∀ u : ℝ,
        -1 < ⟪T.unitPhaseTangent ((k : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u,
          T.unitPhaseTangent (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hclose⟩ := T.exists_uniform_unitTangent_equisubdivision
  refine ⟨m, hm, ?_⟩
  intro k hk u
  have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
  have hk0 : (k : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · positivity
    · exact (div_le_one hmR).2 (by exact_mod_cast Nat.le_of_lt hk)
  have hk1 : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
    constructor
    · positivity
    · exact (div_le_one hmR).2 (by exact_mod_cast hk)
  let a := T.unitPhaseTangent ((k : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u
  let b := T.unitPhaseTangent (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u
  have ha : ‖a‖ = 1 :=
    T.norm_unitPhaseTangent (T.deriv_ne_zero_of_mem_Icc hk0 u)
  have hb : ‖b‖ = 1 :=
    T.norm_unitPhaseTangent (T.deriv_ne_zero_of_mem_Icc hk1 u)
  have hsq : ‖a - b‖ ^ 2 = 2 - 2 * ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real, ha, hb]
    ring
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ‖a - b‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hlt : ‖a - b‖ < 2 := hclose k hk u
  nlinarith

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.nonempty_smoothSliceFrame_at_equisubdivision
statement:
theorem nonempty_smoothSliceFrame_at_equisubdivision
    {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (hshort : ∀ k : ℕ, k < m → ∀ u : ℝ,
      -1 < ⟪T.unitPhaseTangent ((k : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u,
        T.unitPhaseTangent (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u⟫_ℝ) :
    ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m →
      Nonempty (T.SmoothSliceFrame ((k : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro _
      simpa using (Nonempty.intro (SmoothSliceFrame.initial (T := T)))
  | succ k ih =>
      intro hk
      have hkbase : k ≤ m := Nat.le_trans (Nat.le_succ k) hk
      obtain ⟨F⟩ := ih hkbase
      have hklt : k < m := Nat.lt_of_succ_le hk
      have hmR : (0 : ℝ) < (m : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hm
      have htarget : ((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ) ∈
          Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := by
        constructor
        · positivity
        · exact (div_le_one hmR).2 (by exact_mod_cast hk)
      exact ⟨SmoothSliceFrame.transport (T := T) F
        (fun u => T.deriv_ne_zero_of_mem_Icc htarget u)
        (hshort k hklt)⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.exists_framed_nonantipodal_equisubdivision
statement:
theorem exists_framed_nonantipodal_equisubdivision :
    ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k < m → ∀ u : ℝ,
        -1 < ⟪T.unitPhaseTangent ((k : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u,
          T.unitPhaseTangent (((k + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / (m : ℝ)) u⟫_ℝ) ∧
      (∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ m →
        Nonempty (T.SmoothSliceFrame ((k : ℝ) / (m : ℝ))))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨m, hm, hshort⟩ := T.exists_uniform_nonantipodal_equisubdivision
  exact ⟨m, hm, hshort,
    T.nonempty_smoothSliceFrame_at_equisubdivision hm hshort⟩

name: Submission.count_ofFn_eq_card
proof:

            Fintype.card {i : Fin p // F i.succ = c} := by

name: Submission.card_fiber_eq_count
statement:
private theorem card_fiber_eq_count
    {alpha : Type*} {gamma : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [DecidableEq gamma]
    (f : alpha → gamma) (c : gamma) :
    Fintype.card {a : alpha // f a = c} =
      (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card alpha) =>
        f ((Fintype.equivFin alpha).symm i)).count c
proof:
:= by
  rw [count_ofFn_eq_card]
  exact Fintype.card_congr
    ((Fintype.equivFin alpha).subtypeEquiv fun a => by
      rw [Equiv.symm_apply_apply])

name: Submission.fiberCardEq
statement:
private theorem fiberCardEq
    {alpha beta gamma : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta]
    [DecidableEq gamma]
    (f : alpha → gamma) (g : beta → gamma)
    (h : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card alpha) =>
      f ((Fintype.equivFin alpha).symm i)).Perm
      (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card beta) =>
      g ((Fintype.equivFin beta).symm i)))
    (c : gamma) :
    Fintype.card {a : alpha // f a = c} =
      Fintype.card {b : beta // g b = c}
proof:
:= by
  rw [card_fiber_eq_count, card_fiber_eq_count, h.count_eq]

name: Submission.enumeratedEquivOfListPerm_value
statement:
private theorem enumeratedEquivOfListPerm_value
    {alpha beta gamma : Type*} [Fintype alpha] [Fintype beta]
    [DecidableEq gamma]
    (f : alpha → gamma) (g : beta → gamma)
    (h : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card alpha) =>
      f ((Fintype.equivFin alpha).symm i)).Perm
      (List.ofFn fun i : Fin (Fintype.card beta) =>
      g ((Fintype.equivFin beta).symm i)))
    (a : alpha) :
    f a = g (enumeratedEquivOfListPerm f g h a)
proof:
:=
  ((Fintype.equivOfCardEq (fiberCardEq f g h (f a))) ⟨a, rfl⟩).2.symm

name: Submission.TamedField.exists_flow_injective_Ioo
statement:
theorem exists_flow_injective_Ioo {p : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    ∃ ε > 0, Set.InjOn (V.flow p) (Ioo (-ε) ε)
proof:
:= by
  let τ : E := tauField X.g p
  let h : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ⟪τ, V.flow p s - p⟫
  let h' : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => ⟪τ, V.v (V.flow p s)⟫
  have hder : ∀ s, HasDerivAt h (h' s) s := by
    intro s
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ => τ) 0 s := hasDerivAt_const s τ
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun u => V.flow p u - p) (V.v (V.flow p s)) s :=
      (V.hasDerivAt_flow p s).sub_const p
    simpa [h, h'] using h1.inner ℝ h2
  have h'cont : Continuous h' := by
    exact continuous_const.inner (V.smooth.continuous.comp (V.continuous_flow p))
  have h'zero : h' 0 = 1 := by
    dsimp [h']
    rw [V.flow_zero, V.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber hp]
    change ⟪tauField X.g p, tauField X.g p⟫ = 1
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, norm_tauField (X.fiber_subset_regularSet hp)]
    norm_num
  have hopen : IsOpen {s : ℝ | 0 < h' s} := isOpen_lt continuous_const h'cont
  have hzero : (0 : ℝ) ∈ {s : ℝ | 0 < h' s} := by
    change 0 < h' 0
    rw [h'zero]
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen 0 hzero
  refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
  have hmono : StrictMonoOn h (Ioo (-ε) ε) := by
    apply strictMonoOn_of_deriv_pos (convex_Ioo (-ε) ε)
    · exact fun s hs => (hder s).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · intro s hs
      rw [interior_Ioo] at hs
      rw [(hder s).deriv]
      apply hεsub
      rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq, sub_zero]
      exact abs_lt.mpr hs
  intro s hs t ht hst
  by_contra hne
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hne with hlt | hgt
  · have hlt' := hmono hs ht hlt
    have heq : h s = h t := by dsimp [h]; rw [hst]
    rw [heq] at hlt'
    exact (lt_irrefl _ hlt')
  · have hgt' := hmono ht hs hgt
    have heq : h t = h s := by dsimp [h]; rw [hst]
    rw [heq] at hgt'
    exact (lt_irrefl _ hgt')

name: Submission.TamedField.mem_flowPeriods
statement:
@[simp]
theorem mem_flowPeriods {p : E} {T : ℝ} :
    T ∈ V.flowPeriods p ↔ Function.Periodic (V.flow p) T
proof: := Iff.rfl

name: Submission.TamedField.discreteTopology_flowPeriods
statement:
theorem discreteTopology_flowPeriods {p : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    DiscreteTopology (V.flowPeriods p)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hinj⟩ := V.exists_flow_injective_Ioo hp
  rw [discreteTopology_iff_isOpen_singleton_zero, isOpen_induced_iff]
  refine ⟨Ioo (-ε) ε, isOpen_Ioo, ?_⟩
  ext ⟨T, hT⟩
  change (T ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε) ↔ (⟨T, hT⟩ : V.flowPeriods p) = 0
  constructor
  · intro hTI
    apply Subtype.ext
    have h0I : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Ioo (-ε) ε := by constructor <;> linarith
    apply hinj hTI h0I
    simpa using hT 0
  · intro hEq
    have hT0 : T = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hEq
    rw [hT0]
    constructor <;> linarith

name: Submission.TamedField.zmultiples_periodGenerator
statement:
theorem zmultiples_periodGenerator {p : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    AddSubgroup.zmultiples (V.periodGenerator hp) = ⊤
proof:
:= by
  letI : DiscreteTopology (V.flowPeriods p) := V.discreteTopology_flowPeriods hp
  exact Classical.choose_spec (isAddCyclic_iff_exists_zmultiples_eq_top.mp
    (AddSubgroup.discrete_iff_addCyclic.mpr inferInstance :
      IsAddCyclic (V.flowPeriods p)))

name: Submission.TamedField.fundamentalPeriod_pos
statement:
theorem fundamentalPeriod_pos {p : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    0 < V.fundamentalPeriod hp
proof:
:= by
  rw [fundamentalPeriod, abs_pos]
  intro hgen0
  obtain ⟨T, hT, hper⟩ := V.exists_period hp
  let q : V.flowPeriods p := ⟨T, hper⟩
  have hq : q ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples (V.periodGenerator hp) := by
    rw [V.zmultiples_periodGenerator hp]
    exact Set.mem_univ q
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp hq
  have hzero : V.periodGenerator hp = 0 := Subtype.ext hgen0
  rw [hzero, smul_zero] at hk
  have hT0 : T = 0 := congrArg Subtype.val hk.symm
  linarith

name: Submission.TamedField.fundamentalPeriod_periodic
statement:
theorem fundamentalPeriod_periodic {p : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    Function.Periodic (V.flow p) (V.fundamentalPeriod hp)
proof:
:= by
  have hgen : Function.Periodic (V.flow p) ((V.periodGenerator hp : V.flowPeriods p) : ℝ) :=
    (V.periodGenerator hp).property
  unfold fundamentalPeriod
  rcases le_total 0 ((V.periodGenerator hp : V.flowPeriods p) : ℝ) with h | h
  · rwa [abs_of_nonneg h]
  · rw [abs_of_nonpos h]
    exact hgen.neg

name: Submission.TamedField.fundamentalPeriod_le_period
proof:
:= by
  let q : V.flowPeriods p := ⟨T, hT⟩
  have hq : q ∈ AddSubgroup.zmultiples (V.periodGenerator hp) := by
    rw [V.zmultiples_periodGenerator hp]
    exact Set.mem_univ q
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp hq
  have hval : (k : ℝ) * ((V.periodGenerator hp : V.flowPeriods p) : ℝ) = T := by
    simpa using congrArg Subtype.val hk
  have hgenne : ((V.periodGenerator hp : V.flowPeriods p) : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by
    intro h0
    have := V.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp
    rw [fundamentalPeriod, h0, abs_zero] at this
    exact (lt_irrefl 0 this)
  have hkne : k ≠ 0 := by
    intro hk0
    rw [hk0, Int.cast_zero, zero_mul] at hval
    linarith
  have hkabs : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(k : ℝ)| := by
    calc
      (1 : ℝ) = ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by norm_num
      _ ≤ ((|k| : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Int.one_le_abs hkne
      _ = |(k : ℝ)| := Int.cast_abs
  unfold fundamentalPeriod
  calc
    |((V.periodGenerator hp : V.flowPeriods p) : ℝ)|
        ≤ |(k : ℝ)| * |((V.periodGenerator hp : V.flowPeriods p) : ℝ)| :=
      le_mul_of_one_le_left (abs_nonneg _) hkabs
    _ = |(k : ℝ) * ((V.periodGenerator hp : V.flowPeriods p) : ℝ)| :=
      (abs_mul _ _).symm
    _ = |T| := by rw [hval]
    _ = T := abs_of_pos hTpos

name: Submission.TamedField.periodic_flow_of_mem_orbit
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hq
  intro t
  rw [congrFun (V.flow_shift p a) (t + T), congrFun (V.flow_shift p a) t]
  have h := hT (a + t)
  convert h using 1 <;> ring

name: Submission.TamedField.fundamentalPeriod_eq_of_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem fundamentalPeriod_eq_of_mem_orbit {p q : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber)
    (hq : q ∈ V.orbit p) :
    V.fundamentalPeriod (V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hq) = V.fundamentalPeriod hp
proof:
:= by
  let hqFiber : q ∈ X.fiber := V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hq
  have hpq : p ∈ V.orbit q := by
    rw [V.orbit_eq_of_mem hq]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self p
  apply le_antisymm
  · exact V.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hqFiber (V.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp)
      (V.periodic_flow_of_mem_orbit hq (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp))
  · exact V.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hp (V.fundamentalPeriod_pos hqFiber)
      (V.periodic_flow_of_mem_orbit hpq (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hqFiber))

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitPeriod_pos
statement:
theorem orbitPeriod_pos (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    0 < V.orbitPeriod O
proof:
:=
  V.fundamentalPeriod_pos (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)

name: Submission.TamedField.flow_periodic_orbitPeriod
statement:
theorem flow_periodic_orbitPeriod (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    Function.Periodic (V.flow (V.orbitPoint O)) (V.orbitPeriod O)
proof:
:=
  V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O)

name: Submission.TamedField.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed
statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameLoop_closed {p : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    V.fundamentalFrameLoop hp 0 = V.fundamentalFrameLoop hp 1
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop X (V.flow p) (0 * V.fundamentalPeriod hp) =
    frameLoop X (V.flow p) (1 * V.fundamentalPeriod hp)
  simpa using
    (frameLoop_periodic X (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp) 0).symm

name: Submission.TamedField.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit {p q : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber)
    (hq : q ∈ V.orbit p) :
    V.fundamentalFrameClass (V.orbit_subset_fiber hp hq) =
      V.fundamentalFrameClass hp
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hq
  let hqFiber : V.flow p a ∈ X.fiber := V.flow_mem_fiber hp a
  have hT : V.fundamentalPeriod hqFiber = V.fundamentalPeriod hp :=
    V.fundamentalPeriod_eq_of_mem_orbit hp (V.flow_mem_orbit p a)
  symm
  apply loopClassZ2_congr
    (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp) (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hqFiber)
    ({ toFun := fun z =>
        ⟨frameLoop X (V.flow p)
            ((z.1 : ℝ) * a + (z.2 : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp),
          frameLoop_mem_specialOrthogonalGroup X (V.flow_mem_fiber hp) _⟩
       continuous_toFun := by
         apply Continuous.subtype_mk
         exact (continuous_frameLoop X (V.continuous_flow p) (V.flow_mem_fiber hp)).comp
           ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_fst).mul continuous_const |>.add
             ((continuous_subtype_val.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const))
       map_zero_left := fun u => by
         apply Subtype.ext
         change frameLoop X (V.flow p)
           (((0 : I) : ℝ) * a + (u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp) =
             frameLoop X (V.flow p) ((u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp)
         congr 2
         norm_num
       map_one_left := fun u => by
         apply Subtype.ext
         change frameLoop X (V.flow p)
           (((1 : I) : ℝ) * a + (u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp) =
             frameLoop X (V.flow (V.flow p a))
               ((u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hqFiber)
         rw [hT]
         unfold frameLoop
         rw [congrFun (V.flow_shift p a) ((u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp)]
         congr 2
         norm_num })
  intro s
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop X (V.flow p)
      ((s : ℝ) * a + ((0 : I) : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp) =
    frameLoop X (V.flow p)
      ((s : ℝ) * a + ((1 : I) : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp)
  simpa using
    (frameLoop_periodic X (V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp) ((s : ℝ) * a)).symm

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitFrameLoop_closed
statement:
theorem orbitFrameLoop_closed (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    V.orbitFrameLoop O 0 = V.orbitFrameLoop O 1

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitFrameClass_eq_fundamental
statement:
theorem orbitFrameClass_eq_fundamental (O : V.OrbitIndex) :

proof: := rfl

name: Submission.TamedField.deltaOn_empty
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deltaOn_empty : V.deltaOn (∅ : Set (Set E)) = 0
proof:
:= by
  simp [deltaOn]

name: Submission.TamedField.deltaOn_univ
statement:
@[simp]
theorem deltaOn_univ : V.deltaOn (Set.univ : Set (Set E)) = V.framedDelta
proof:
:= by
  simp [deltaOn, framedDelta]

name: Submission.TamedField.deltaOn_union_of_disjoint
statement:
theorem deltaOn_union_of_disjoint {A B : Set (Set E)} (hAB : Disjoint A B) :
    V.deltaOn (A ∪ B) = V.deltaOn A + V.deltaOn B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  rw [deltaOn, deltaOn, deltaOn, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro O hO
  by_cases hA : (O : Set E) ∈ A
  · have hB : (O : Set E) ∉ B := fun hB => Set.disjoint_left.mp hAB hA hB
    simp [hA, hB]
  · by_cases hB : (O : Set E) ∈ B
    · simp [hA, hB]
    · simp [hA, hB]

name: Submission.TamedField.framedDelta_eq_of_transport
statement:
theorem framedDelta_eq_of_transport {W : TamedField Y}
    (T : V.DeltaTransport W) : V.framedDelta = W.framedDelta
proof:
:= by
  unfold framedDelta
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv T.orbitEquiv _ _ T.contribution_eq

name: Submission.TamedField.deltaOn_eq_of_transport
statement:
theorem deltaOn_eq_of_transport {W : TamedField Y} (T : V.DeltaTransport W)
    {A B : Set (Set E)}
    (hAB : ∀ O : V.OrbitIndex, (O : Set E) ∈ A ↔
      ((T.orbitEquiv O : W.OrbitIndex) : Set E) ∈ B) :
    V.deltaOn A = W.deltaOn B
proof:
:= by
  classical
  unfold deltaOn
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv T.orbitEquiv
  intro O
  by_cases hA : (O : Set E) ∈ A
  · have hB : ((T.orbitEquiv O : W.OrbitIndex) : Set E) ∈ B := (hAB O).mp hA
    simp [hA, hB, T.contribution_eq O]
  · have hB : ((T.orbitEquiv O : W.OrbitIndex) : Set E) ∉ B :=
      fun hB => hA ((hAB O).mpr hB)
    simp [hA, hB]

name: Submission.TamedField.framedDelta_eq_zero_of_fiber_eq_empty
statement:
theorem framedDelta_eq_zero_of_fiber_eq_empty (hX : X.fiber = ∅) :
    V.framedDelta = 0
proof:
:= by
  classical
  have hOrbit : V.orbitFinset = ∅ := by
    ext O
    constructor
    · intro hO
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hOp⟩ := V.mem_orbitFinset.mp hO
      rw [hX] at hp
      exact hp.elim
    · simp
  unfold framedDelta
  change (∑ O ∈ V.orbitFinset.attach, V.orbitContribution O) = 0
  rw [show V.orbitFinset.attach = ∅ by simp [hOrbit]]
  simp

name: Submission.TamedField.framedDelta_eq_zero_of_fiber_empty
statement:
theorem framedDelta_eq_zero_of_fiber_empty (hX : X.fiber = (∅ : Set E)) :
    V.framedDelta = 0
proof:
:=
  V.framedDelta_eq_zero_of_fiber_eq_empty hX

name: Submission.TamedField.mapsTo_orbit_of_continuous
statement:
theorem mapsTo_orbit_of_continuous {Y : FramedLevelSet n} (U : TamedField Y)
    {f : E → E} (hf : Continuous f) (hmap : MapsTo f X.fiber Y.fiber)
    {p : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    MapsTo f (V.orbit p) (U.orbit (f p))
proof:
:= by
  let γ : ℝ → E := fun t => f (V.flow p t)
  let A : Set ℝ := γ ⁻¹' U.orbit (f p)
  have hq : f p ∈ Y.fiber := hmap hp
  have hAS : A ⊆ (Set.univ : Set ℝ) := fun _ _ => Set.mem_univ _
  have hAclosed : IsClosed A :=
    (U.isCompact_orbit hq).isClosed.preimage (hf.comp (V.continuous_flow p))
  have hAopen : ∀ t ∈ A, ∃ r > 0,
      (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ∩ Metric.ball t r ⊆ A := by
    intro t ht
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrsub⟩ := U.orbit_isOpen_in_fiber hq ht
    have hopen : IsOpen (γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (γ t) r) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (hf.comp (V.continuous_flow p))
    have htmem : t ∈ γ ⁻¹' Metric.ball (γ t) r := Metric.mem_ball_self hr
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hεsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen t htmem
    refine ⟨ε, hε, ?_⟩
    rintro u ⟨hu, hut⟩
    apply hrsub
    exact ⟨hmap (V.flow_mem_fiber hp u), hεsub hut⟩
  have hA0 : A.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨0, ?_⟩
    change f (V.flow p 0) ∈ U.orbit (f p)
    rw [V.flow_zero]
    exact U.mem_orbit_self (f p)
  have hAll : (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ⊆ A :=
    subset_of_relOpen_closed isPreconnected_univ hAS hAclosed hAopen hA0
  rintro x ⟨t, rfl⟩
  exact hAll (Set.mem_univ t)

name: Submission.TamedField.flow_eq_of_tamedField
statement:
theorem flow_eq_of_tamedField (U : TamedField X) {p : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    V.flow p = U.flow p
proof:
:= by
  apply V.solution_unique (t₀ := 0)
  · exact V.hasDerivAt_flow p
  · intro t
    have h := U.hasDerivAt_flow p t
    have ht : U.flow p t ∈ X.fiber := U.flow_mem_fiber hp t
    have hv : V.v (U.flow p t) = U.v (U.flow p t) := by
      rw [V.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber ht, U.v_eq_tau_of_mem_fiber ht]
    rwa [hv]
  · rw [V.flow_zero, U.flow_zero]

name: Submission.TamedField.orbit_eq_of_tamedField
statement:
theorem orbit_eq_of_tamedField (U : TamedField X) {p : E} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) :
    V.orbit p = U.orbit p
proof:
:= by
  unfold orbit
  rw [V.flow_eq_of_tamedField U hp]

name: Submission.TamedField.fundamentalPeriod_eq_of_tamedField
statement:
theorem fundamentalPeriod_eq_of_tamedField (U : TamedField X) {p : E}
    (hp : p ∈ X.fiber) : V.fundamentalPeriod hp = U.fundamentalPeriod hp
proof:
:= by
  have hflow : V.flow p = U.flow p := V.flow_eq_of_tamedField U hp
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply V.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hp (U.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp)
    simpa [hflow] using U.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp
  · apply U.fundamentalPeriod_le_period hp (V.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp)
    simpa [← hflow] using V.fundamentalPeriod_periodic hp

name: Submission.TamedField.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_tamedField
proof:
:= by
  apply loopClassZ2_congr_fun
    (V.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp) (U.fundamentalFrameLoop_closed hp)
  apply ContinuousMap.ext
  intro u
  apply Subtype.ext
  change frameLoop X (V.flow p) ((u : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp) =
    frameLoop X (U.flow p) ((u : ℝ) * U.fundamentalPeriod hp)
  rw [V.flow_eq_of_tamedField U hp, V.fundamentalPeriod_eq_of_tamedField U hp]

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitFinset_eq_of_tamedField
statement:
theorem orbitFinset_eq_of_tamedField (U : TamedField X) :
    V.orbitFinset = U.orbitFinset
proof:
:= by
  apply Finset.ext
  intro O
  simp only [V.mem_orbitFinset, U.mem_orbitFinset]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p, hp, V.orbit_eq_of_tamedField U hp⟩
  · rintro ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨p, hp, (V.orbit_eq_of_tamedField U hp).symm⟩

name: Submission.TamedField.framedDelta_eq_of_tamedField
statement:
theorem framedDelta_eq_of_tamedField (U : TamedField X) :
    V.framedDelta = U.framedDelta
proof:
:= by
  let e := V.orbitIndexEquivOfTamedField U
  apply Fintype.sum_equiv e
  intro O
  unfold orbitContribution orbitFrameClass
  have hsets : (O : Set E) = (e O : Set E) := rfl
  let p : E := V.orbitPoint O
  let q : E := U.orbitPoint (e O)
  have hp : p ∈ X.fiber := V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  have hq : q ∈ X.fiber := U.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (e O)
  have hqOrbit : q ∈ V.orbit p := by
    have hOp : (O : Set E) = V.orbit p := V.orbitPoint_orbit O
    have hOq : ((e O : U.OrbitIndex) : Set E) = U.orbit q :=
      U.orbitPoint_orbit (e O)
    have hVU : V.orbit q = U.orbit q := V.orbit_eq_of_tamedField U hq
    rw [← hOp, hsets, hOq, ← hVU]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self q
  have hbase : V.fundamentalFrameClass hq = V.fundamentalFrameClass hp :=
    V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit hp hqOrbit
  have hfield : V.fundamentalFrameClass hq = U.fundamentalFrameClass hq :=
    V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_tamedField U hq
  change V.fundamentalFrameClass hp + 1 = U.fundamentalFrameClass hq + 1
  rw [← hfield, hbase]

name: Submission.TamedField.orbitContribution_eq_of_tamedField
statement:
theorem orbitContribution_eq_of_tamedField (U : TamedField X) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    V.orbitContribution O =
      U.orbitContribution (V.orbitIndexEquivOfTamedField U O)
proof:
:= by
  unfold orbitContribution orbitFrameClass
  let e := V.orbitIndexEquivOfTamedField U
  let p : E := V.orbitPoint O
  let q : E := U.orbitPoint (e O)
  have hp : p ∈ X.fiber := V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  have hq : q ∈ X.fiber := U.orbitPoint_mem_fiber (e O)
  have hsets : (O : Set E) = (e O : Set E) := rfl
  have hqOrbit : q ∈ V.orbit p := by
    have hOp : (O : Set E) = V.orbit p := V.orbitPoint_orbit O
    have hOq : ((e O : U.OrbitIndex) : Set E) = U.orbit q :=
      U.orbitPoint_orbit (e O)
    have hVU : V.orbit q = U.orbit q := V.orbit_eq_of_tamedField U hq
    rw [← hOp, hsets, hOq, ← hVU]
    exact V.mem_orbit_self q
  have hbase : V.fundamentalFrameClass hq = V.fundamentalFrameClass hp :=
    V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit hp hqOrbit
  have hfield : V.fundamentalFrameClass hq = U.fundamentalFrameClass hq :=
    V.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_tamedField U hq
  change V.fundamentalFrameClass hp + 1 = U.fundamentalFrameClass hq + 1
  rw [← hfield, hbase]

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.tcoord_flow_Icc
statement:
theorem tcoord_flow_Icc {p : E₂} (hp : p ∈ C.fiber) {t₀ l u : ℝ}
    (hpt : tcoord p = t₀) (hlu : l ≤ u) (hl : l ≤ 0) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
    (ha : a ≤ t₀ + l) (hb : t₀ + u ≤ b) :
    ∀ s ∈ Icc l u, tcoord (W.flow p s) = t₀ + s
proof:
:= by
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => tcoord (W.flow p s)
  let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => t₀ + s
  let S : Set ℝ := Icc l u
  let A : Set ℝ := {s | s ∈ S ∧ f s = g s}
  have hSpre : IsPreconnected S := convex_Icc l u |>.isPreconnected
  have hAS : A ⊆ S := fun _ hs => hs.1
  have hfcont : Continuous f := continuous_tcoord.comp (W.continuous_flow p)
  have hgcont : Continuous g := continuous_const.add continuous_id
  have hAclosed : IsClosed A := by
    exact isClosed_Icc.inter (isClosed_eq hfcont hgcont)
  have hAopen : ∀ s ∈ A, ∃ r > 0, S ∩ Metric.ball s r ⊆ A := by
    intro s hsA
    have hsS : s ∈ Icc l u := hsA.1
    have hqFiber : W.flow p s ∈ C.fiber := W.flow_mem_fiber hp s
    have hqTime : tcoord (W.flow p s) = t₀ + s := hsA.2
    have hqSlab : W.flow p s ∈ slabFiber C a b := by
      refine ⟨hqFiber, ?_⟩
      change tcoord (W.flow p s) ∈ Icc a b
      rw [hqTime]
      constructor <;> linarith [hsS.1, hsS.2]
    have hopen : IsOpen ((W.flow p) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (W.flow p s) W.delta) :=
      Metric.isOpen_ball.preimage (W.continuous_flow p)
    have hmem : s ∈ (W.flow p) ⁻¹' Metric.ball (W.flow p s) W.delta := by
      exact Metric.mem_ball_self W.delta_pos
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hrsub⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp hopen s hmem
    refine ⟨r, hr, ?_⟩
    have hcollar : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball s r,
        W.flow p u ∈ Metric.cthickening W.delta (slabFiber C a b) := by
      intro u hu
      have huBall : W.flow p u ∈ Metric.ball (W.flow p s) W.delta := hrsub hu
      apply Metric.thickening_subset_cthickening
      exact Metric.mem_thickening_iff.mpr ⟨W.flow p s, hqSlab, huBall⟩
    have hfderiv : ∀ u ∈ Metric.ball s r, HasDerivAt f 1 u := by
      intro u hu
      have hflow := W.hasDerivAt_flow p u
      have hproj := (EuclideanSpace.proj (Fin.last (n + 1)) (𝕜 := ℝ)).hasFDerivAt.comp
        u hflow.hasFDerivAt
      have ht : HasDerivAt f (tcoord (W.w (W.flow p u))) u := by
        simpa [f, tcoord, Function.comp_def] using hproj.hasDerivAt
      have hcu := hcollar u hu
      have hspeed : tcoord (W.w (W.flow p u)) = 1 := by
        rw [W.eq_time _ hcu]
        exact tcoord_timeField (W.subset_slabRegular hcu)
      rwa [hspeed] at ht
    have hfg : Set.EqOn f g (Metric.ball s r) := by
      apply Metric.isOpen_ball.eqOn_of_deriv_eq (convex_ball _ _).isPreconnected
      · intro u hu
        exact (hfderiv u hu).differentiableAt.differentiableWithinAt
      · exact (differentiable_const t₀).add differentiable_id |>.differentiableOn
      · intro u hu
        rw [(hfderiv u hu).deriv]
        simpa [g] using ((hasDerivAt_id u).const_add t₀).deriv
      · exact Metric.mem_ball_self hr
      · exact hsA.2
    rintro u ⟨huS, huBall⟩
    exact ⟨huS, hfg huBall⟩
  have hA0 : A.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨0, ⟨⟨hl, hu⟩, ?_⟩⟩
    simp [f, g, W.flow_zero, hpt]
  have hSA : S ⊆ A := subset_of_relOpen_closed hSpre hAS hAclosed hAopen hA0
  intro s hs
  exact (hSA hs).2

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.tcoord_flow_segment
proof:
:= by
  exact W.tcoord_flow_Icc hp hpt (by linarith) le_rfl hd (by simpa) hb

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sliceFLSAt_fiber (C : LevelCobordismData n) (t : ℝ)
    (ht : sliceRegular C.G t) :
    (sliceFLSAt C t ht).fiber = sliceFiber C t
proof:
:= by
  ext x
  rfl

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.continuous_sliceTransport
statement:
theorem continuous_sliceTransport (t₁ t₂ : ℝ) :
    Continuous (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂)
proof:
:= by
  have hst : Continuous fun x : E₁ => cobSpaceTime x t₁ :=
    continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun x =>
      (hasFDerivAt_cobSpaceTime t₁ x).continuousAt
  have hflow : Continuous fun x : E₁ => W.flow (cobSpaceTime x t₁) (t₂ - t₁) :=
    (W.continuous_flow_apply (t₂ - t₁)).comp hst
  have hsp : LipschitzWith 1 (spacePart (n := n)) := by
    apply LipschitzWith.of_dist_le_mul
    intro x y
    rw [NNReal.coe_one, one_mul, dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm]
    change ‖spacePart (x - y)‖ ≤ ‖x - y‖
    exact norm_spacePart_le (x - y)
  exact hsp.continuous.comp hflow

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.sliceTransport_mapsTo
statement:
theorem sliceTransport_mapsTo (hreg : regularSlab C.G a b)
    {t₁ t₂ : ℝ} (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b) :
    MapsTo (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂) (sliceFiber C t₁) (sliceFiber C t₂)
proof:
:= by
  intro x hx
  let p : E₂ := cobSpaceTime x t₁
  let d : ℝ := t₂ - t₁
  have hp : p ∈ C.fiber := hx
  have hpt : tcoord p = t₁ := tcoord_spaceTime x t₁
  have htflow : tcoord (W.flow p d) = t₂ := by
    rcases le_total t₁ t₂ with hle | hle
    · have hd : 0 ≤ d := by dsimp [d]; linarith
      have hb' : t₁ + d ≤ b := by dsimp [d]; linarith [ht₂.2]
      have h := W.tcoord_flow_segment hp hpt hd ht₁.1 hb'
        d ⟨hd, le_rfl⟩
      dsimp [d] at h ⊢
      linarith
    · have hd : d ≤ 0 := by dsimp [d]; linarith
      have ha' : a ≤ t₁ + d := by dsimp [d]; linarith [ht₂.1]
      have hb' : t₁ + 0 ≤ b := by linarith [ht₁.2]
      have h := W.tcoord_flow_Icc hp hpt hd hd le_rfl
        ha' hb' d ⟨le_rfl, hd⟩
      dsimp [d] at h ⊢
      linarith
  have hq : W.flow p d ∈ C.fiber := W.flow_mem_fiber hp d
  change C.G (cobSpaceTime (spacePart (W.flow p d)) t₂) = 0
  rw [← htflow, spaceTime_spacePart]
  exact hq

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.cobSpaceTime_sliceTransport
statement:
theorem cobSpaceTime_sliceTransport (hreg : regularSlab C.G a b)
    {t₁ t₂ : ℝ} (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    {x : E₁} (hx : x ∈ sliceFiber C t₁) :
    cobSpaceTime (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ x) t₂ =
      W.flow (cobSpaceTime x t₁) (t₂ - t₁)
proof:
:= by
  let p : E₂ := cobSpaceTime x t₁
  let d : ℝ := t₂ - t₁
  have hp : p ∈ C.fiber := hx
  have hpt : tcoord p = t₁ := tcoord_spaceTime x t₁
  have htflow : tcoord (W.flow p d) = t₂ := by
    rcases le_total t₁ t₂ with hle | hle
    · have hd : 0 ≤ d := by dsimp [d]; linarith
      have hb' : t₁ + d ≤ b := by dsimp [d]; linarith [ht₂.2]
      have h := W.tcoord_flow_segment hp hpt hd ht₁.1 hb' d ⟨hd, le_rfl⟩
      dsimp [d] at h ⊢
      linarith
    · have hd : d ≤ 0 := by dsimp [d]; linarith
      have ha' : a ≤ t₁ + d := by dsimp [d]; linarith [ht₂.1]
      have hb' : t₁ + 0 ≤ b := by linarith [ht₁.2]
      have h := W.tcoord_flow_Icc hp hpt hd hd le_rfl ha' hb' d ⟨le_rfl, hd⟩
      dsimp [d] at h ⊢
      linarith
  unfold sliceTransport
  change cobSpaceTime (spacePart (W.flow p d)) t₂ = W.flow p d
  rw [← htflow, spaceTime_spacePart]

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.sliceTransport_leftInverse
statement:
theorem sliceTransport_leftInverse (hreg : regularSlab C.G a b)
    {t₁ t₂ : ℝ} (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    {x : E₁} (hx : x ∈ sliceFiber C t₁) :
    W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁ (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ x) = x
proof:
:= by
  let p : E₂ := cobSpaceTime x t₁
  let d : ℝ := t₂ - t₁
  have hp : p ∈ C.fiber := hx
  have hpt : tcoord p = t₁ := tcoord_spaceTime x t₁
  have htflow : tcoord (W.flow p d) = t₂ := by
    rcases le_total t₁ t₂ with hle | hle
    · have hd : 0 ≤ d := by dsimp [d]; linarith
      have hb' : t₁ + d ≤ b := by dsimp [d]; linarith [ht₂.2]
      have h := W.tcoord_flow_segment hp hpt hd ht₁.1 hb'
        d ⟨hd, le_rfl⟩
      dsimp [d] at h ⊢
      linarith
    · have hd : d ≤ 0 := by dsimp [d]; linarith
      have ha' : a ≤ t₁ + d := by dsimp [d]; linarith [ht₂.1]
      have hb' : t₁ + 0 ≤ b := by linarith [ht₁.2]
      have h := W.tcoord_flow_Icc hp hpt hd hd le_rfl
        ha' hb' d ⟨le_rfl, hd⟩
      dsimp [d] at h ⊢
      linarith
  have hspace : cobSpaceTime (spacePart (W.flow p d)) t₂ = W.flow p d := by
    rw [← htflow, spaceTime_spacePart]
  unfold sliceTransport
  change spacePart
    (W.flow (cobSpaceTime (spacePart (W.flow p d)) t₂) (t₁ - t₂)) = x
  rw [hspace]
  have hshift := congrFun (W.flow_shift p d) (t₁ - t₂)
  rw [hshift]
  have htime : d + (t₁ - t₂) = 0 := by dsimp [d]; ring
  rw [htime, W.flow_zero]
  exact spacePart_spaceTime x t₁

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.sliceTransport_bijOn
statement:
theorem sliceTransport_bijOn (hreg : regularSlab C.G a b)
    {t₁ t₂ : ℝ} (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b) :
    Set.BijOn (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂) (sliceFiber C t₁) (sliceFiber C t₂)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg ht₁ ht₂, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro x hx y hy hxy
    have h := congrArg (W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁) hxy
    simpa [W.sliceTransport_leftInverse hreg ht₁ ht₂ hx,
      W.sliceTransport_leftInverse hreg ht₁ ht₂ hy] using h
  · intro y hy
    refine ⟨W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁ y,
      W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg ht₂ ht₁ hy, ?_⟩
    exact W.sliceTransport_leftInverse hreg ht₂ ht₁ hy

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.sliceOrbitMap_val
statement:
@[simp]
theorem sliceOrbitMap_val (hreg : regularSlab C.G a b)
    {t₁ t₂ : ℝ} (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (V₁ : TamedField (sliceFLSAt C t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)))
    (V₂ : TamedField (sliceFLSAt C t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂)))
    (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    ((W.sliceOrbitMap hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O : V₂.OrbitIndex) : Set E₁) =
      V₂.orbit (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ (V₁.orbitPoint O))
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.sliceTransport_mapsTo_orbit
statement:
theorem sliceTransport_mapsTo_orbit (hreg : regularSlab C.G a b)
    {t₁ t₂ : ℝ} (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (V₁ : TamedField (sliceFLSAt C t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)))
    (V₂ : TamedField (sliceFLSAt C t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂)))
    {p : E₁} (hp : p ∈ (sliceFLSAt C t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).fiber) :
    MapsTo (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂) (V₁.orbit p)
      (V₂.orbit (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ p))
proof:
:= by
  apply V₁.mapsTo_orbit_of_continuous V₂ (W.continuous_sliceTransport t₁ t₂)
  · intro x hx
    rw [sliceFLSAt_fiber] at hx ⊢
    exact W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg ht₁ ht₂ hx
  · exact hp

name: Submission.SlabTamedField.sliceOrbitMap_leftInverse
statement:
theorem sliceOrbitMap_leftInverse (hreg : regularSlab C.G a b)
    {t₁ t₂ : ℝ} (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (V₁ : TamedField (sliceFLSAt C t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)))
    (V₂ : TamedField (sliceFLSAt C t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂)))
    (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    W.sliceOrbitMap hreg ht₂ ht₁ V₂ V₁
        (W.sliceOrbitMap hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O) = O
proof:
:= by
  apply Subtype.ext
  let p : E₁ := V₁.orbitPoint O
  let q : E₁ := W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ p
  let O₂ : V₂.OrbitIndex := W.sliceOrbitMap hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O
  let r : E₁ := V₂.orbitPoint O₂
  have hp : p ∈ (sliceFLSAt C t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).fiber :=
    V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  have hq : q ∈ (sliceFLSAt C t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂)).fiber := by
    rw [sliceFLSAt_fiber] at hp ⊢
    exact W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg ht₁ ht₂ hp
  have hrOrbit : r ∈ V₂.orbit q := by
    have hr : r ∈ V₂.orbit r := V₂.mem_orbit_self r
    have hOr : (O₂ : Set E₁) = V₂.orbit r := V₂.orbitPoint_orbit O₂
    have hOq : (O₂ : Set E₁) = V₂.orbit q := by
      rfl
    rw [← hOq, hOr]
    exact hr
  have hback := W.sliceTransport_mapsTo_orbit hreg ht₂ ht₁ V₂ V₁ hq hrOrbit
  have hqp : W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁ q = p := by
    dsimp [q, p]
    exact W.sliceTransport_leftInverse hreg ht₁ ht₂ hp
  have hrSource : W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁ r ∈ V₁.orbit p := by
    rwa [hqp] at hback
  change V₁.orbit (W.sliceTransport t₂ t₁ r) = (O : Set E₁)
  exact (V₁.orbit_eq_of_mem hrSource).trans (V₁.orbitPoint_orbit O).symm

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.pos_iff_of_zeroFiber_path
statement:
theorem pos_iff_of_zeroFiber_path
    (γ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))))
    (hγ : ∀ u, C.cobordism.G (γ u) = 0) :
    0 < C (γ 0) ↔ 0 < C (γ 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hcont : Continuous fun u : I => C (γ u) := C.continuous.comp γ.continuous
  constructor
  · intro h₀
    by_contra h₁
    have h₁neg : C (γ 1) < 0 := by
      have hle : C (γ 1) ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt h₁
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle (C.nonzero (γ 1) (hγ 1))
    have hz : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (C (γ 1)) (C (γ 0)) := ⟨h₁neg.le, h₀.le⟩
    obtain ⟨u, -, hu⟩ :=
      intermediate_value_Icc' (show (0 : I) ≤ 1 by simp) hcont.continuousOn hz
    exact C.nonzero (γ u) (hγ u) hu
  · intro h₁
    by_contra h₀
    have h₀neg : C (γ 0) < 0 := by
      have hle : C (γ 0) ≤ 0 := le_of_not_gt h₀
      exact lt_of_le_of_ne hle (C.nonzero (γ 0) (hγ 0))
    have hz : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (C (γ 0)) (C (γ 1)) := ⟨h₀neg.le, h₁.le⟩
    obtain ⟨u, -, hu⟩ :=
      intermediate_value_Icc (show (0 : I) ≤ 1 by simp) hcont.continuousOn hz
    exact C.nonzero (γ u) (hγ u) hu

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.sliceSign_transport_pos_iff
statement:
theorem sliceSign_transport_pos_iff {a b : ℝ}
    (W : SlabTamedField C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData a b)
    (hreg : regularSlab C.cobordism.G a b)
    {t₁ t₂ : ℝ} (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    {x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hx : x ∈ (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
      t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).fiber) :
    0 < C.sliceSign t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁) x ↔
      0 < C.sliceSign t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂)
        (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ x)
proof:
:= by
  let p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2)) := cobSpaceTime x t₁
  let d : ℝ := t₂ - t₁
  let γ : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 2))) :=
    ⟨fun u => W.flow p ((u : ℝ) * d),
      (W.continuous_flow p).comp (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)⟩
  have hp : p ∈ C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData.fiber := by
    exact hx
  have hγ : ∀ u, C.cobordism.G (γ u) = 0 := by
    intro u
    exact W.flow_mem_fiber hp ((u : ℝ) * d)
  have hsign := C.pos_iff_of_zeroFiber_path γ hγ
  have htarget := W.cobSpaceTime_sliceTransport hreg ht₁ ht₂ hx
  change 0 < C (cobSpaceTime x t₁) ↔
    0 < C (cobSpaceTime (W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ x) t₂)
  rw [htarget]
  simpa [γ, p, d] using hsign

name: Submission.FiberSign.pos_iff_of_mem_orbit
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hq
  let hpath : C(I, Eₛ) :=
    ⟨fun u => V.flow p ((u : ℝ) * a),
      (V.continuous_flow p).comp
        (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)⟩
  have hpathFiber : ∀ u, hpath u ∈ X.fiber := by
    intro u
    exact V.flow_mem_fiber hp _
  have hsign := S.pos_iff_of_path hpath hpathFiber
  simpa [hpath] using hsign

name: Submission.FiberSign.mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff
statement:
theorem mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff (V : TamedField X) (O : V.OrbitIndex) :
    (O : Set Eₛ) ∈ S.positiveOrbitCollection V ↔ 0 < S (V.orbitPoint O)
proof:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hO
    have hpO : V.orbitPoint O ∈ (O : Set Eₛ) := by
      rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O]
      exact V.mem_orbit_self (V.orbitPoint O)
    exact (hO hpO).2
  · intro hp x hx
    rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O] at hx
    obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := hx
    let hpath : C(I, Eₛ) :=
      ⟨fun u => V.flow (V.orbitPoint O) ((u : ℝ) * a),
        (V.continuous_flow (V.orbitPoint O)).comp
          (continuous_subtype_val.mul continuous_const)⟩
    have hpathFiber : ∀ u, hpath u ∈ X.fiber := by
      intro u
      change V.flow (V.orbitPoint O) ((u : ℝ) * a) ∈ X.fiber
      exact V.flow_mem_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) _
    have hp0 : 0 < S (hpath 0) := by
      simpa [hpath] using hp
    have hpos := (S.pos_iff_of_path hpath hpathFiber).mp hp0
    refine ⟨V.flow_mem_fiber (V.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O) _, ?_⟩
    simpa [hpath] using hpos

name: Submission.FiberSign.positiveFramedDelta_eq_of_tamedField
statement:
theorem positiveFramedDelta_eq_of_tamedField (V U : TamedField X) :
    S.positiveFramedDelta V = S.positiveFramedDelta U
proof:
:= by
  let T := V.deltaTransportOfTamedField U
  apply V.deltaOn_eq_of_transport T
  intro O
  change (O : Set Eₛ) ⊆ S.positivePart ↔
    ((T.orbitEquiv O : U.OrbitIndex) : Set Eₛ) ⊆ S.positivePart
  rfl

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.sliceOrbitEquiv_mem_positive_iff
statement:
theorem sliceOrbitEquiv_mem_positive_iff {a b : ℝ}
    (W : SlabTamedField C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData a b)
    (hreg : regularSlab C.cobordism.G a b)
    {t₁ t₂ : ℝ} (ht₁ : t₁ ∈ Icc a b) (ht₂ : t₂ ∈ Icc a b)
    (V₁ : TamedField (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
      t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)))
    (V₂ : TamedField (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
      t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂)))
    (O : V₁.OrbitIndex) :
    (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∈
        (C.sliceSign t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).positiveOrbitCollection V₁ ↔
      ((W.sliceOrbitEquiv hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ O : V₂.OrbitIndex) :
          Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) ∈
        (C.sliceSign t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂)).positiveOrbitCollection V₂
proof:
:= by
  let e := W.sliceOrbitEquiv hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂
  let p := V₁.orbitPoint O
  let y := W.sliceTransport t₁ t₂ p
  let q := V₂.orbitPoint (e O)
  have hp : p ∈ (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
      t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).fiber := V₁.orbitPoint_mem_fiber O
  have hy : y ∈ (SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt C.cobordism.toLevelCobordismData
      t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂)).fiber := by
    rw [SlabTamedField.sliceFLSAt_fiber] at hp ⊢
    exact W.sliceTransport_mapsTo hreg ht₁ ht₂ hp
  have hqOrbit : q ∈ V₂.orbit y := by
    have hqmem : q ∈ ((e O : V₂.OrbitIndex) :
        Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) := by
      rw [V₂.orbitPoint_orbit (e O)]
      exact V₂.mem_orbit_self q
    exact hqmem
  rw [(C.sliceSign t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁)).mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff,
    (C.sliceSign t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂)).mem_positiveOrbitCollection_iff]
  change 0 < C.sliceSign t₁ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₁) p ↔
    0 < C.sliceSign t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂) q
  exact (C.sliceSign_transport_pos_iff W hreg ht₁ ht₂ hp).trans
    ((C.sliceSign t₂ (hreg.sliceRegular ht₂)).pos_iff_of_mem_orbit
      V₂ hy hqOrbit)

name: Submission.SignedFramedLevelCobordism.RegularSlabFrameHomotopy.toFrameTransport
statement:
theorem toFrameTransport
    (H : C.RegularSlabFrameHomotopy W hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂) :
    C.RegularSlabFrameTransport W hreg ht₁ ht₂ V₁ V₂ where
  frameClass_eq
proof:
:= by
    intro O

name: Submission.SmoothAmbientIsotopy.forward_fderiv_surjective
statement:
theorem forward_fderiv_surjective (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    (s : ℝ) (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (x : E[n]) :
    Surjective (fderiv ℝ (A.forward s) x)
proof:
:= by
  let f : E[n] → E[n] := A.forward s
  let g : E[n] → E[n] := A.inverse s
  have hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f := A.contDiff_forward_slice s
  have hg : ContDiff ℝ ∞ g := A.contDiff_inverse_slice s
  let y : E[n] := f x
  have hgy : g y = x := A.left_inv s hs x
  have hfg : (fun z => f (g z)) = id := by
    funext z
    exact A.right_inv s hs z
  have hcomp : HasFDerivAt (fun z => f (g z))
      ((fderiv ℝ f (g y)).comp (fderiv ℝ g y)) y :=
    ((hf.differentiable (by simp) (g y)).hasFDerivAt.comp y
      (hg.differentiable (by simp) y).hasFDerivAt)
  rw [hfg] at hcomp
  have hderiv0 : (fderiv ℝ f (g y)).comp (fderiv ℝ g y) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E[n] :=
    hcomp.fderiv.symm.trans (hasFDerivAt_id y).fderiv
  have hderiv : (fderiv ℝ f x).comp (fderiv ℝ g y) =
      ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ E[n] := by
    rwa [hgy] at hderiv0
  intro z
  refine ⟨fderiv ℝ g y z, ?_⟩
  have hz := congrArg (fun L : E[n] →L[ℝ] E[n] => L z) hderiv
  simpa [ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply] using hz

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.subset_of_relOpen_closed_metric
statement:
private theorem subset_of_relOpen_closed_metric
    {S A : Set ℝ} (hS : IsPreconnected S) (hsub : A ⊆ S)
    (hclosed : IsClosed A)
    (hopen : ∀ z ∈ A, ∃ r > 0, S ∩ Metric.ball z r ⊆ A)
    (hne : A.Nonempty) : S ⊆ A
proof:
:= by
  classical
  choose! rad hradpos hradsub using hopen
  let U : Set ℝ := ⋃ z ∈ A, Metric.ball z (rad z)
  have hUopen : IsOpen U := isOpen_biUnion fun z _ => Metric.isOpen_ball
  have hAU : A ⊆ U := fun z hz =>
    Set.mem_biUnion hz (Metric.mem_ball_self (hradpos z hz))
  have hUS : U ∩ S ⊆ A := by
    rintro x ⟨hxU, hxS⟩
    obtain ⟨z, hzA, hxball⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hxU
    exact hradsub z hzA ⟨hxS, hxball⟩
  intro s hs
  by_contra hsA
  have hcover : S ⊆ U ∪ Aᶜ := by
    intro x hx
    by_cases hxA : x ∈ A
    · exact Or.inl (hAU hxA)
    · exact Or.inr hxA
  obtain ⟨z₀, hz₀⟩ := hne
  have h₁ : (S ∩ U).Nonempty := ⟨z₀, hsub hz₀, hAU hz₀⟩
  have h₂ : (S ∩ Aᶜ).Nonempty := ⟨s, hs, hsA⟩
  obtain ⟨w, hwS, hwU, hwA⟩ :=
    hS U Aᶜ hUopen hclosed.isOpen_compl hcover h₁ h₂
  exact hwA (hUS ⟨hwU, hwS⟩)

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.exists_uniform_nonantipodal_radius
statement:
theorem exists_uniform_nonantipodal_radius :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
      ∀ {s t : ℝ}, s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 →
        |t - s| < δ → ∀ u : ℝ,
          -1 < ⟪T.unitPhaseTangent s u,
            T.unitPhaseTangent t u⟫_ℝ
proof:
:= by
  let K : Set (ℝ × ℝ) := Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ×ˢ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
  have hK : IsCompact K := isCompact_Icc.prod isCompact_Icc
  have huniform : UniformContinuousOn
      (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => T.unitPhaseTangent q.1 q.2) K :=
    hK.uniformContinuousOn_of_continuous
      T.continuousOn_unitPhaseTangent_square
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hnear⟩ :=
    Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff.mp huniform 2 (by norm_num)
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro s t hs ht hst u
  let v : ℝ := Int.fract u
  have hv : v ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
    ⟨Int.fract_nonneg u, (Int.fract_lt_one u).le⟩
  have hdist : dist (s, v) (t, v) < δ := by
    rw [dist_prod_same_right, Real.dist_eq]
    simpa [abs_sub_comm] using hst
  have hout := hnear (s, v) ⟨hs, hv⟩ (t, v) ⟨ht, hv⟩ hdist
  rw [dist_eq_norm] at hout
  rw [T.unitPhaseTangent_eq_fract s u,
    T.unitPhaseTangent_eq_fract t u]
  let a := T.unitPhaseTangent s v
  let b := T.unitPhaseTangent t v
  have ha : ‖a‖ = 1 :=
    T.norm_unitPhaseTangent (T.deriv_ne_zero_of_mem_Icc hs v)
  have hb : ‖b‖ = 1 :=
    T.norm_unitPhaseTangent (T.deriv_ne_zero_of_mem_Icc ht v)
  have hsq : ‖a - b‖ ^ 2 = 2 - 2 * ⟪a, b⟫_ℝ := by
    rw [norm_sub_sq_real, ha, hb]
    ring
  have hnonneg : 0 ≤ ‖a - b‖ := norm_nonneg _
  have hlt : ‖a - b‖ < 2 := hout
  nlinarith

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.nonempty_smoothSliceFrame_of_mem_Icc
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hshort⟩ := T.exists_uniform_nonantipodal_radius
  let A : Set ℝ :=
    {t | t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∧ Nonempty (T.SmoothSliceFrame t)}
  have hsub : A ⊆ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 := fun _ ht => ht.1
  have hclosed : IsClosed A := by
    rw [← isOpen_compl_iff]
    apply Metric.isOpen_iff.mpr
    intro t htA
    by_cases htI : t ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
    · refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
      intro r hr
      show r ∈ Aᶜ
      intro hrA
      obtain ⟨F⟩ := hrA.2
      have hrt : |t - r| < δ := by
        simpa [Real.dist_eq, abs_sub_comm] using hr
      have G : T.SmoothSliceFrame t :=
        SmoothSliceFrame.transport (T := T) F
          (fun u => T.deriv_ne_zero_of_mem_Icc htI u)
          (hshort hrA.1 htI hrt)
      exact htA ⟨htI, ⟨G⟩⟩
    · obtain ⟨r, hr, hrsub⟩ :=
        Metric.isOpen_iff.mp isClosed_Icc.isOpen_compl t htI
      exact ⟨r, hr, fun x hx => by
        exact fun hxA => hrsub hx hxA.1⟩
  have hopen : ∀ z ∈ A, ∃ r > 0,
      Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ Metric.ball z r ⊆ A := by
    intro z hz
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
    rintro t ⟨htI, htz⟩
    obtain ⟨F⟩ := hz.2
    have hzt : |t - z| < δ := by
      simpa [Real.dist_eq] using htz
    exact ⟨htI, ⟨SmoothSliceFrame.transport (T := T) F
      (fun u => T.deriv_ne_zero_of_mem_Icc htI u)
      (hshort hz.1 htI hzt)⟩⟩
  have hne : A.Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨0, ⟨⟨le_rfl, zero_le_one⟩, ?_⟩⟩
    exact ⟨SmoothSliceFrame.initial (T := T)⟩
  have hall : Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 ⊆ A :=
    subset_of_relOpen_closed_metric isPreconnected_Icc hsub hclosed hopen hne
  exact (hall hs).2

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierRelativeTrack.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.exists_supported_local_ambientTrackStep
statement:
theorem exists_supported_local_ambientTrackStep
    {U : Set E[n]} (hUopen : IsOpen U)
    (htraceU : FourierTraceSupport.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.trace
      (V := V) h2 O R ⊆ U)
    (hUdisj : Disjoint U (OrbitUnknottingSupport.obstacleSet V h2 O))
    {s : ℝ} (hs : s ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t - s| < δ →
      Nonempty (FourierEmbeddingTrack.AmbientTrackStep R.track s t)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨G⟩ := R.track.nonempty_smoothSliceFrame_of_mem_Icc hs
  let F := G.toFramedPeriodicCircle (T := R.track) hs
  have hcircle : Set.range F.circle ⊆ U := by
    rintro x ⟨a, rfl⟩
    apply htraceU
    exact ⟨(⟨s, hs⟩, a), rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hbU⟩ :=
    F.exists_radialBump_supportCore_subset hUopen hcircle
  let P := G.parametricChordExtensionDataWithBump
    (T := R.track) hs b hb
  have hsupport : P.supportCore ⊆ U := by
    change F.tube '' ((Set.univ : Set C) ×ˢ
      Metric.closedBall (0 : N[n]) b.rOut) ⊆ U
    exact hbU
  have hzero : ∀ u : ℝ, P.displacement (s, u) = 0 := by
    intro u
    simp [P,
      FourierEmbeddingTrack.EmbeddedCircleTrack.SmoothSliceFrame.parametricChordExtensionDataWithBump]
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hLip⟩ :=
    P.exists_uniform_lipschitzWith_of_base_zero hzero
      FourierEmbeddingTrack.localChordLipschitzBound
      FourierEmbeddingTrack.localChordLipschitzBound_pos
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, ?_⟩
  intro t hst
  let D := P.slice t
  have hLipD : LipschitzWith
      FourierEmbeddingTrack.localChordLipschitzBound D.ambientField :=
    hLip t hst
  refine ⟨R.track.ambientTrackStepOfExplicitScaledExtension
    F D 1 FourierEmbeddingTrack.localChordLipschitzBound hLipD
    (by simpa using FourierEmbeddingTrack.localChordLipschitzBound_lt_one)
    ?_⟩
  refine {
    source_lift := fun u => rfl
    target_lift := ?_
    field_zero_on_obstacle := ?_
  }
  · intro u
    change R.track.lift t u = R.track.lift s u +
      1 • (R.track.lift t u - R.track.lift s u)
    simp
  · intro x hx
    apply D.ambientField_eq_zero_of_not_mem_supportCore
    intro hxcore
    have hxP : x ∈ P.supportCore := by simpa [D] using hxcore
    exact Set.disjoint_left.mp hUdisj (hsupport hxP) hx

name: Submission.TamedField.FourierRelativeTrack.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.nonempty_adaptive_supported_ambientTrackChain
statement:
theorem nonempty_adaptive_supported_ambientTrackChain :
    Nonempty (FourierEmbeddingTrack.AmbientTrackChain R.track 0 1)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨ρ, hρ, htrace, hUopen, hclosureDisj⟩ :=
    FourierTraceSupport.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.exists_trace_thickening
      (V := V) (h2 := h2) (O := O) R
  let U : Set E[n] := Metric.thickening ρ
    (FourierTraceSupport.RelativeEmbeddedCircleTrack.trace
      (V := V) h2 O R)
  have hUdisj : Disjoint U
      (OrbitUnknottingSupport.obstacleSet V h2 O) :=
    hclosureDisj.mono subset_closure Subset.rfl
  have hlocal : ∀ c : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1,
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, |t - (c : ℝ)| < δ →
        Nonempty (FourierEmbeddingTrack.AmbientTrackStep
          R.track (c : ℝ) t) := by
    intro c
    exact R.exists_supported_local_ambientTrackStep hUopen htrace hUdisj c.property
  choose! rad hrad hstep using hlocal
  let cover : Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → Set (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) :=
    fun c => {x | |(x : ℝ) - (c : ℝ)| < rad c}
  have hopen : ∀ c, IsOpen (cover c) := by
    intro c
    exact isOpen_lt
      ((continuous_subtype_val.sub continuous_const).abs)
      continuous_const
  have hcover : (Set.univ : Set (Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1)) ⊆
      ⋃ c, cover c := by
    intro x _
    apply Set.mem_iUnion.mpr
    refine ⟨x, ?_⟩
    change |(x : ℝ) - (x : ℝ)| < rad x
    simpa using hrad x
  obtain ⟨q, hq₀, hmono, ⟨m, hm⟩, hinter⟩ :=
    exists_monotone_Icc_subset_open_cover_Icc
      (a := (0 : ℝ)) (b := 1) zero_le_one hopen hcover
  have hqm : (q m : ℝ) = 1 := hm m le_rfl
  have hsteps : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Nonempty (FourierEmbeddingTrack.AmbientTrackStep R.track
        (q k : ℝ) (q (k + 1) : ℝ)) := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hinter k
    have hk : q k ≤ q (k + 1) := hmono (Nat.le_succ k)
    have hleft : q k ∈ cover c := hc ⟨le_rfl, hk⟩
    have hright : q (k + 1) ∈ cover c := hc ⟨hk, le_rfl⟩
    obtain ⟨Mleft⟩ := hstep c (q k : ℝ) hleft
    obtain ⟨Mright⟩ := hstep c (q (k + 1) : ℝ) hright
    exact ⟨Mleft.symm.trans Mright⟩
  let chain := FourierEmbeddingTrack.AmbientTrackChain.sequencePrefix
    (T := R.track) (fun k => (q k : ℝ))
      (fun k => Classical.choice (hsteps k)) m
  refine ⟨?_⟩
  simpa [hq₀, hqm] using chain
