name: Submission.productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_beforeArcBandTwoRadius
statement:
theorem productionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies_of_beforeArcBandTwoRadius
    {a : ℕ} (KB : ProductionMorseSaddleBeforeArcBandTwoRadiusInputs a) :
    ProductionMorseSaddleTopologyFrameSupplies a
proof:
:= by
  intro X Y SX SY SC D t ht hpositive hindex
  have hb : 0 < D.bandCaptureScale t ht := D.bandCaptureScale_pos t ht
  have hbw : D.bandCaptureScale t ht < D.chronologicalWindowRadius t ht :=
    D.bandCaptureScale_lt_window t ht
  obtain ⟨Vpos⟩ := (D.shortAfterSlice t ht hb hbw).exists_tamedField
  obtain ⟨Vneg⟩ := (D.shortBeforeSlice t ht hb hbw).exists_tamedField
  have hdim : 3 ≤ a + 2 + 1 := by omega
  have hcircle := productionMorseSaddleChartCircleFrameClassOne a
    (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hindex
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
    (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
  constructor
  · intro Htop
    have hposEq :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      apply (D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw Vpos).injective
      rw [D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.positive]
      exact Htop.positive_eq
    have hnegNe :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg ≠
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      intro heq'
      apply Htop.negative_ne
      rw [← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.positive, heq']
    have hsplice : ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
        Vpos.orbitFrameClass
            ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
              (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
              (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
              (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) =
          Vneg.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) +
            Vneg.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) + 1 := by
      obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, harcs⟩ :=
        (KB SC D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos).1 hnegNe hposEq
      have hread := saddleBandOctagonReading_merge_twoRadius
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) hindex
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) hb
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
        (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg Vpos
        (D.bandTimeField t ht) hlab hnegNe F hprov
        (fun p x₀ dt hx₀ hx₀eq hdt =>
          D.exists_chartMap_connector_positive t ht hindex p x₀ dt hx₀ hx₀eq
            hdt)
        harcs.1 harcs.2
      have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass_of_signed
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) F
        (windingLoop_or_rev_of_saddleBandOctagonReading
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hread)
      exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab,
        orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim F
          (F.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
            (hF.trans hcircle))⟩
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, hsp⟩ := hsplice
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg]
    cases e₁ <;> cases e₂ <;>
      first
        | exact absurd rfl hlab
        | exact hsp
        | (rw [hsp]; ring)
  · intro Htop
    have hnegEq :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg =
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg := by
      apply (D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv t ht hb hbw Vneg).injective
      rw [D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
          SaddleBranch.positive]
      exact Htop.negative_eq
    have hposNe :
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .negative (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos ≠
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex
            hindex .positive (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
            (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
            (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
            (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
            (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos := by
      intro heq'
      apply Htop.positive_ne
      rw [← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.negative,
        ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
          SaddleBranch.positive, heq']
    have hsplice : ∃ e₁ e₂ : SaddleBranch, e₁ ≠ e₂ ∧
        Vneg.orbitFrameClass
            ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                ht).saddleNegativeBranchOrbitIndex hindex .negative
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
              (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
              (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
              (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
              (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg) =
          Vpos.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₁
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) +
            Vpos.orbitFrameClass
              ((D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t
                  ht).saddlePositiveBranchOrbitIndex hindex e₂
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius t ht)
                (D.bandCaptureScale t ht)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
                (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
                (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
                (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vpos) + 1 := by
      obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, F, hprov, harcs⟩ :=
        (KB SC D t ht hindex Vneg Vpos).2 hposNe hnegEq
      have hread := saddleBandOctagonReading_split_twoRadius
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht) hindex
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht) hb
        (D.shortScale_sq_lt_saddleBoundary_sq t ht hb hbw)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleEndpointParamRadius_lt_embedded t ht)
        (D.shortBeforeTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw)
        (D.shortAfterTimeAt_regular t ht hb hbw) Vneg Vpos
        (D.bandTimeField t ht) hlab hposNe F hprov
        (fun p x₀ dt hx₀ hx₀eq hdt =>
          D.exists_chartMap_connector_negative t ht hindex p x₀ dt hx₀ hx₀eq
            hdt)
        harcs.1 harcs.2
      have hF := pathLoopClassZ2_bandComparisonLoop_eq_chartCircleFrameClass_of_signed
        (D.chronologicalEventFullRadiusSmooth t ht)
        (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_pos t ht)
        (D.chronologicalSaddleBoundaryRadius_lt_embedded t ht) F
        (windingLoop_or_rev_of_saddleBandOctagonReading
          (D.chronologicalEventEmbeddedShrink t ht) hread)
      exact ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab,
        orbitFrameClass_splice_of_flowConjugateBandLift hdim F
          (F.toMarking.conjugateCosetBandLift_of_bandClass hdim
            (hF.trans hcircle))⟩
    obtain ⟨e₁, e₂, hlab, hsp⟩ := hsplice
    refine ⟨?_⟩
    rw [← D.shortBeforeToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vneg
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.negative,
      ← D.shortAfterToWindowOrbitEquiv_branch t ht hindex hb hbw Vpos
        SaddleBranch.positive,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortBefore t ht hb hbw Vneg,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos,
      ← D.orbitFrameClass_shortAfter t ht hb hbw Vpos]
    cases e₁ <;> cases e₂ <;>
      first
        | exact absurd rfl hlab
        | exact hsp
        | (rw [hsp]; ring)

name: Submission.mul_pos_of_preconnected_ne_zero
statement:
theorem mul_pos_of_preconnected_ne_zero {α : Type*} [TopologicalSpace α]
    {s : Set α} (hs : IsPreconnected s) {f : α → ℝ}
    (hf : ContinuousOn f s) (hne : ∀ x ∈ s, f x ≠ 0)
    {x y : α} (hx : x ∈ s) (hy : y ∈ s) : 0 < f x * f y
proof:
:= by
  rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hne x hx) with hxneg | hxpos
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hne y hy) with hyneg | hypos
    · exact mul_pos_of_neg_of_neg hxneg hyneg
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩ := hs.intermediate_value₂ hx hy hf
        continuousOn_const (le_of_lt hxneg) (le_of_lt hypos)
      exact hne z hz hz0
  · rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne (hne y hy) with hyneg | hypos
    · exfalso
      obtain ⟨z, hz, hz0⟩ := hs.intermediate_value₂ hy hx hf
        continuousOn_const (le_of_lt hyneg) (le_of_lt hxpos)
      exact hne z hz hz0
    · exact mul_pos hxpos hypos

name: Submission.TamedField.flow_time_eq_of_small
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := (V.flow_eq_iff_sub_mem_zmultiples hp τ d).mp heq
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := AddSubgroup.mem_zmultiples_iff.mp hmem
  have hper : 0 < V.fundamentalPeriod hp := V.fundamentalPeriod_pos hp
  have habs : |τ - d| < V.fundamentalPeriod hp := by
    calc
      |τ - d| ≤ |τ| + |d| := abs_sub _ _
      _ < V.fundamentalPeriod hp := by linarith
  have hz' : (z : ℝ) * V.fundamentalPeriod hp = τ - d := by
    rw [← hz]
    simp [zsmul_eq_mul]
  by_cases hz0 : z = 0
  · rw [hz0] at hz'
    simp at hz'
    linarith [hz'.symm]
  · exfalso
    have hzabs : (1 : ℝ) ≤ |(z : ℝ)| := by
      have h1 : (1 : ℤ) ≤ |z| := Int.one_le_abs hz0
      calc
        (1 : ℝ) = ((1 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by norm_num
        _ ≤ ((|z| : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast h1
        _ = |(z : ℝ)| := by
          rw [Int.cast_abs]
    have h2 : V.fundamentalPeriod hp ≤ |τ - d| := by
      rw [← hz', abs_mul]
      calc
        V.fundamentalPeriod hp = 1 * V.fundamentalPeriod hp := by ring
        _ ≤ |(z : ℝ)| * |V.fundamentalPeriod hp| := by
          rw [abs_of_pos hper]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hzabs hper.le
    linarith

name: Submission.tubeThomCollapse_zero_ne_one
statement:
theorem tubeThomCollapse_zero_ne_one (m : ℕ) :
    tubeThomCollapse (m := m) 0 ≠ tubeThomCollapse 1
proof:
:= by
  intro hmaps
  have hpoint := congrFun hmaps (tubeTwistWitnessPoint m)
  have hcoord := congrArg
    (fun u : UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))) =>
      (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))) (Fin.last (m + 1)).castSucc)
    hpoint
  have hzero : 0 <
      (tubeThomCollapse (m := m) 0 (tubeTwistWitnessPoint m) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))
        (Fin.last (m + 1)).castSucc := by
    change 0 < ‖tubeCollapseRaw 0 (tubeTwistWitnessPoint m)‖⁻¹ *
      tubeCollapseRaw 0 (tubeTwistWitnessPoint m) (Fin.last (m + 1)).castSucc
    rw [tubeCollapseRaw_coord, tubeCollapseHorizontal,
      tubeTwistWitness_cutoff, one_smul, tubeTwistWitness_wCoord_zero_last]
    exact mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr
      (norm_pos_iff.mpr (tubeCollapseRaw_ne_zero 0 _))) (by norm_num)
  have hone :
      (tubeThomCollapse (m := m) 1 (tubeTwistWitnessPoint m) :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))
        (Fin.last (m + 1)).castSucc < 0 := by
    change ‖tubeCollapseRaw 1 (tubeTwistWitnessPoint m)‖⁻¹ *
      tubeCollapseRaw 1 (tubeTwistWitnessPoint m) (Fin.last (m + 1)).castSucc < 0
    rw [tubeCollapseRaw_coord, tubeCollapseHorizontal,
      tubeTwistWitness_cutoff, one_smul, tubeTwistWitness_wCoord_one_last]
    exact mul_neg_of_pos_of_neg (inv_pos.mpr
      (norm_pos_iff.mpr (tubeCollapseRaw_ne_zero 1 _))) (by norm_num)
  rw [hcoord] at hzero
  exact (not_lt_of_ge hzero.le) hone

name: Submission.norm_tangentAt
statement: lemma norm_tangentAt (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) : ‖tangentAt (m := m) θ‖ = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hs : ‖tangentAt (m := m) θ‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
    rw [normSq_eq_sum_sq]
    have hsum : (∑ j, tangentAt (m := m) θ j ^ 2) =
        (-Real.sin θ) ^ 2 + (Real.cos θ) ^ 2 := by
      apply sum_split_pair01
      · rw [tangentAt_apply, if_pos rfl]
      · rw [tangentAt_apply, if_neg (Fin.zero_ne_one (n := m + 1)).symm,
          if_pos rfl]
      · intro j hj0 hj1
        rw [tangentAt_apply, if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1, zero_pow (by norm_num)]
    rw [hsum]
    nlinarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq θ]
  nlinarith [norm_nonneg (tangentAt (m := m) θ)]

name: Submission.orthonormal_tubeFullFrame
statement:
theorem orthonormal_tubeFullFrame (m k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    Orthonormal ℝ (tubeFullFrame m k θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [orthonormal_iff_ite]
  intro i j
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · simp [tubeFullFrame, norm_tangentAt]
    · have horth := inner_nuVec_tangentAt (m := m) k θ j
      rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_zero, Fin.cons_succ, inner_neg_left,
        real_inner_comm, horth, neg_zero]
      simp [show (0 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ j.succ by exact (Fin.succ_ne_zero j).symm]
  · rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
    · have horth := inner_nuVec_tangentAt (m := m) k θ i
      rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_zero, inner_neg_right,
        horth, neg_zero]
      simp
    · rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_succ, Fin.cons_succ,
        inner_nuVec_nuVec]
      simp

name: Submission.tubeFullFrame_zero_apply
proof:
:= by
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨a, rfl⟩
  · by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      simp [tubeFullFrame, tangentAt_apply]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        simp [tubeFullFrame, tangentAt_apply]
      · simp [tubeFullFrame, tangentAt_apply, hj0, hj1]
  · by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · subst a
      by_cases hj0 : j = 0
      · subst j
        simp [tubeFullFrame, nuVec_zero, circleAt_apply]
      · simp [tubeFullFrame, nuVec_zero, circleAt_apply, eVert,
          coordVec_apply, hj0]
    · by_cases hal : a = Fin.last (m + 1)
      · subst a
        have hs : (Fin.last (m + 1)).succ =
            (Fin.last (m + 2) : Fin (m + 3)) := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp
        have h1 : (Fin.last (m + 2) : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 1 := by
          intro h
          have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
          simp at hv
        rw [hs]
        simp [tubeFullFrame, nuVec_last, eVert, coordVec_apply, h1]
      · rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_succ, nuVec_mid k 0 ha0 hal,
          coordVec_apply]
        have ha1 : (a.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 1 := by
          intro h
          apply ha0
          apply Fin.ext
          have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
          simpa using hv
        simp [ha1]

name: Submission.rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame_zero
statement:
lemma rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame_zero (m k : ℕ) :

proof:

    Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  simp only [Equiv.Perm.permMatrix, PEquiv.toMatrix_toPEquiv_apply,
    Pi.single_apply]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst i
    simp [tubeInitDiagonal]
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst i
      simp [tubeInitDiagonal]
    · rw [Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hi0 hi1]
      simp [tubeInitDiagonal, hi0, hi1]

name: Submission.continuous_det_rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame
statement:
lemma continuous_det_rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame (m k : ℕ) :
    Continuous fun θ : ℝ => (rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k θ)).det
proof:
:= by
  apply Continuous.matrix_det
  apply continuous_matrix
  intro i j
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩
  · change Continuous fun θ : ℝ => -(tangentAt (m := m) θ j)
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst j
      simpa [tangentAt_apply] using Real.continuous_sin.neg.neg
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst j
        change Continuous fun θ : ℝ => -Real.cos θ
        exact Real.continuous_cos.neg
      · have heq : (fun θ : ℝ => -(tangentAt (m := m) θ j)) =
            fun _ : ℝ => (0 : ℝ) := by
          funext θ
          rw [tangentAt_apply, if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1, neg_zero]
        rw [heq]
        exact continuous_const
  · change Continuous fun θ : ℝ => nuVec (m := m) k θ i j
    exact (EuclideanSpace.proj j :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →L[ℝ] ℝ).continuous.comp
        (contDiff_nuVec (m := m) k i).continuous

name: Submission.det_rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame_pos
statement:
lemma det_rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame_pos (m k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    0 < (rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k θ)).det
proof:
:= by
  let d : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k t)).det
  have hdcont : Continuous d := continuous_det_rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame m k
  have hdne : ∀ t, d t ≠ 0 := by
    intro t
    have hcross : crossDet (nuVec (m := m) k t) (-(tangentAt t)) ≠ 0 :=
      (crossDet_ne_zero_iff _ _).mpr
        (orthonormal_tubeFullFrame m k t).linearIndependent
    have heq : crossRows (nuVec (m := m) k t) (-(tangentAt t)) =
        rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k t) := by
      ext i j
      rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩ <;>
        simp [crossRows, rowsMatrix, tubeFullFrame]
    change (rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k t)).det ≠ 0
    rw [← heq]
    exact hcross
  have hd0 : d 0 = 1 := det_rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame_zero m k
  by_contra hpos
  have hdθneg : d θ < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (le_of_not_gt hpos) (hdne θ)
  have hmem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Set.Icc (d θ) (d 0) := by
    rw [hd0]
    exact ⟨hdθneg.le, by norm_num⟩
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := intermediate_value_univ θ 0 hdcont hmem
  exact hdne t ht

name: Submission.fderiv_circleAt_one
statement:
lemma fderiv_circleAt_one (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (circleAt (m := m)) θ 1 = tangentAt θ
proof:
:= by
  apply PiLp.ext
  intro j
  have hcircle : DifferentiableAt ℝ (circleAt (m := m)) θ :=
    contDiff_circleAt.differentiable (by simp) |>.differentiableAt
  have hproj : DifferentiableAt ℝ (EuclideanSpace.proj j)
      (circleAt (m := m) θ) :=
    (EuclideanSpace.proj j :
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)) →L[ℝ] ℝ).differentiableAt
  have hcomp := fderiv_comp (x := θ) hproj hcircle
  rw [ContinuousLinearMap.fderiv] at hcomp
  have happ := congrArg (fun L : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ => L 1) hcomp
  have hcoord :
      fderiv ℝ (fun t => circleAt (m := m) t j) θ 1 =
        fderiv ℝ (circleAt (m := m)) θ 1 j := by
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using happ
  rw [← hcoord, fderiv_apply_one_eq_deriv]
  by_cases hj0 : j = 0
  · subst j
    rw [(show (fun t => circleAt (m := m) t 0) = Real.cos by
      funext t
      exact circleAt_apply_zero t)]
    simpa [tangentAt_apply] using (Real.hasDerivAt_cos θ).deriv
  · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
    · subst j
      rw [(show (fun t => circleAt (m := m) t 1) = Real.sin by
        funext t
        exact circleAt_apply_one t)]
      simpa [tangentAt_apply] using (Real.hasDerivAt_sin θ).deriv
    · rw [(show (fun t => circleAt (m := m) t j) = fun _ : ℝ => 0 by
        funext t
        exact circleAt_apply_other t hj0 hj1)]
      simp [tangentAt_apply, hj0, hj1]

name: Submission.fderiv_tubeCollapseHorizontal_tangentAt
statement:
lemma fderiv_tubeCollapseHorizontal_tangentAt (m k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    fderiv ℝ (tubeCollapseHorizontal (m := m) k) (circleAt θ)
      (tangentAt θ) = 0
proof:
:= by
  let g := tubeCollapseHorizontal (m := m) k
  have hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g (circleAt (m := m) θ) :=
    (contDiff_tubeCollapseHorizontal (m := m) k).differentiable
      (by simp) |>.differentiableAt
  have hc : DifferentiableAt ℝ (circleAt (m := m)) θ :=
    contDiff_circleAt.differentiable (by simp) |>.differentiableAt
  have hcomp := fderiv_comp (x := θ) hg hc
  have happ := congrArg
    (fun L : ℝ →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2)) => L 1) hcomp
  have hzero : fderiv ℝ (g ∘ circleAt (m := m)) θ 1 = 0 := by
    have heq : g ∘ circleAt (m := m) =
        fun _ : ℝ => (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 2))) := by
      funext t
      exact tubeCollapseHorizontal_circleAt k t
    rw [heq]
    simp
  rw [hzero, ContinuousLinearMap.comp_apply, fderiv_circleAt_one] at happ
  exact happ.symm

name: Submission.tubeFullONBasis_apply
statement:
@[simp] lemma tubeFullONBasis_apply (m k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    tubeFullONBasis m k θ j = tubeFullFrame m k θ j
proof:
:= by
  change ((tubeFullONBasis m k θ :
    OrthonormalBasis (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ
      (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3)))) :
        Fin (m + 3) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (m + 3))) j = _
  simp [tubeFullONBasis]

name: Submission.gradVec_tubeCollapseHorizontal_circleAt
statement:
theorem gradVec_tubeCollapseHorizontal_circleAt (m k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ)
    (i : Fin (m + 2)) :
    gradVec (tubeCollapseHorizontal (m := m) k) i (circleAt θ) =
      nuVec k θ i
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right_basis (tubeFullONBasis m k θ).toBasis
  intro j
  change ⟪gradVec (tubeCollapseHorizontal (m := m) k) i (circleAt θ),
      tubeFullONBasis m k θ j⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪nuVec k θ i, tubeFullONBasis m k θ j⟫_ℝ
  rw [tubeFullONBasis_apply]
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_zero, inner_gradVec,
      map_neg, fderiv_tubeCollapseHorizontal_tangentAt, neg_zero,
      inner_neg_right, inner_nuVec_tangentAt, neg_zero]
    rfl
  · rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_succ, inner_gradVec,
      fderiv_tubeCollapseHorizontal_nuVec, inner_nuVec_nuVec]
    simp [PiLp.single_apply]

name: Submission.rowsMatrix_mul_transpose_of_orthonormal
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  have hentries : ∀ c, rowsMatrix v i c * (rowsMatrix v)ᵀ c j
      = v i c * v j c := by
    intro c
    rw [Matrix.transpose_apply]
    rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => hentries c]
  have hinner := orthonormal_iff_ite.mp hv i j
  rw [PiLp.inner_apply] at hinner
  simp only [RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial] at hinner
  rw [← hinner]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun c _ => mul_comm _ _

name: Submission.rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame_mem
statement:
theorem rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame_mem (m k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k θ) ∈
      Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  have hmul := rowsMatrix_mul_transpose_of_orthonormal
    (orthonormal_tubeFullFrame m k θ)
  have horth : rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k θ)
      ∈ Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).mpr hmul
  have hdetsq : (rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k θ)).det
      * (rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k θ)).det = 1 := by
    have h1 := congrArg Matrix.det hmul
    rwa [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, Matrix.det_one] at h1
  have hdet1 : (rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k θ)).det = 1 := by
    rcases mul_self_eq_one_iff.mp hdetsq with h | h
    · exact h
    · have hpos := det_rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame_pos m k θ
      rw [h] at hpos
      linarith
  exact Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mpr ⟨horth, hdet1⟩

name: Submission.det_rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame
statement:
theorem det_rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame (m k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    (rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k θ)).det = 1
proof:
:=
  (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp
    (rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame_mem m k θ)).2

name: Submission.crossVec_nuVec
statement:
theorem crossVec_nuVec (m k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    crossVec (nuVec (m := m) k θ) = -(tangentAt θ)
proof:
:= by
  apply ext_inner_right_basis (tubeFullONBasis m k θ).toBasis
  intro j
  change ⟪crossVec (nuVec (m := m) k θ), tubeFullONBasis m k θ j⟫_ℝ =
    ⟪-(tangentAt θ), tubeFullONBasis m k θ j⟫_ℝ
  rw [tubeFullONBasis_apply]
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ j with rfl | ⟨j, rfl⟩
  · rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_zero, inner_crossVec]
    have hdet : crossDet (nuVec (m := m) k θ) (-(tangentAt θ))
        = (rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k θ)).det := by
      have heq : crossRows (nuVec (m := m) k θ) (-(tangentAt θ)) =
          rowsMatrix (tubeFullFrame m k θ) := by
        ext i j
        rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨i, rfl⟩ <;>
          simp [crossRows, rowsMatrix, tubeFullFrame]
      rw [crossDet, heq]
    rw [hdet, det_rowsMatrix_tubeFullFrame]
    rw [inner_neg_neg, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, norm_tangentAt]
    norm_num
  · rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_succ, inner_crossVec, crossDet_apply_self,
      inner_neg_left]
    rw [real_inner_comm, inner_nuVec_tangentAt, neg_zero]

name: Submission.kerCross_tubeCollapseHorizontal_circleAt
statement:
theorem kerCross_tubeCollapseHorizontal_circleAt (m k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    kerCross (tubeCollapseHorizontal (m := m) k) (circleAt θ)

proof:
:= by

      (circleAt θ)) = nuVec (m := m) k θ from
    funext fun i => gradVec_tubeCollapseHorizontal_circleAt m k θ i]

name: Submission.tauField_tubeCollapseHorizontal_circleAt
statement:
theorem tauField_tubeCollapseHorizontal_circleAt (m k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :

name: Submission.tubeFullFrame_apply
statement:
lemma tubeFullFrame_apply (m k : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    tubeFullFrame m k θ i j =
      if i = 0 then
        (if j = 0 then Real.sin θ else if j = 1 then -Real.cos θ else 0)
      else if i = 1 then
        (if j = 0 then Real.cos (k * θ) * Real.cos θ
          else if j = 1 then Real.cos (k * θ) * Real.sin θ
          else if j = Fin.last (m + 2) then Real.sin (k * θ) else 0)
      else if i = Fin.last (m + 2) then
        (if j = 0 then -(Real.sin (k * θ) * Real.cos θ)
          else if j = 1 then -(Real.sin (k * θ) * Real.sin θ)
          else if j = Fin.last (m + 2) then Real.cos (k * θ) else 0)
      else if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  rcases Fin.eq_zero_or_eq_succ i with rfl | ⟨a, rfl⟩
  · rw [if_pos rfl]
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst hj0
      rw [if_pos rfl]
      simp [tubeFullFrame, tangentAt_apply]
    · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst hj1
        rw [if_neg hj0, if_pos rfl]
        simp [tubeFullFrame, tangentAt_apply, hj0]
      · rw [if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1]
        simp [tubeFullFrame, tangentAt_apply, hj0, hj1]
  · have hs0 : (a.succ : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 0 := Fin.succ_ne_zero a
    rw [if_neg hs0]
    by_cases ha0 : a = 0
    · subst ha0
      have h1 : ((0 : Fin (m + 2)).succ : Fin (m + 3)) = 1 := by
        apply Fin.ext
        simp
      rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_succ, nuVec_zero, h1, if_pos rfl, addSmul_coord]
      by_cases hj0 : j = 0
      · subst hj0
        rw [if_pos rfl, circleAt_apply_zero,
          eVert_apply_ne (Ne.symm lastA_ne_zero)]
        ring
      · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
        · subst hj1
          rw [if_neg hj0, if_pos rfl, circleAt_apply_one,
            eVert_apply_ne (Ne.symm lastA_ne_one)]
          ring
        · by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 2)
          · subst hjl
            rw [if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1, if_pos rfl,
              circleAt_apply_other θ lastA_ne_zero lastA_ne_one, eVert_apply_last]
            ring
          · rw [if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1, if_neg hjl,
              circleAt_apply_other θ hj0 hj1, eVert_apply_ne hjl]
            ring
    · by_cases hal : a = Fin.last (m + 1)
      · subst hal
        have hs : ((Fin.last (m + 1)).succ : Fin (m + 3)) = Fin.last (m + 2) := by
          apply Fin.ext
          simp
        rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_succ, nuVec_last, hs, if_neg lastA_ne_one,
          if_pos rfl, addSmul_coord]
        by_cases hj0 : j = 0
        · subst hj0
          rw [if_pos rfl, circleAt_apply_zero,
            eVert_apply_ne (Ne.symm lastA_ne_zero)]
          ring
        · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
          · subst hj1
            rw [if_neg hj0, if_pos rfl, circleAt_apply_one,
              eVert_apply_ne (Ne.symm lastA_ne_one)]
            ring
          · by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 2)
            · subst hjl
              rw [if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1, if_pos rfl,
                circleAt_apply_other θ lastA_ne_zero lastA_ne_one,
                eVert_apply_last]
              ring
            · rw [if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1, if_neg hjl,
                circleAt_apply_other θ hj0 hj1, eVert_apply_ne hjl]
              ring
      · obtain ⟨hm0, hm1, hml⟩ := midSucc_ne ha0 hal
        rw [tubeFullFrame, Fin.cons_succ, nuVec_mid k θ ha0 hal, coordVec_apply,
          if_neg hm1, if_neg hml]

name: Submission.rotAmbient_apply
statement:
lemma rotAmbient_apply (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    rotAmbient m θ i j =
      if i = 0 then (if j = 0 then Real.cos θ else if j = 1 then -Real.sin θ else 0)
      else if i = 1 then
        (if j = 0 then Real.sin θ else if j = 1 then Real.cos θ else 0)
      else if j = i then 1 else 0
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.rotBlock_eq_rotAmbient
statement:
lemma rotBlock_eq_rotAmbient : ∀ (m : ℕ) (θ : ℝ), rotBlock (m + 3) θ = rotAmbient m θ
  | 0, θ => by
    rw [rotBlock_three]
    ext i j
    fin_cases i <;> fin_cases j <;>
      simp [rzMatrix, rotAmbient_apply, Fin.ext_iff]
  | (m + 1), θ => by
    have hsucc : rotBlock (m + 4) θ = incMatrix (rotBlock (m + 3) θ)
proof:
:=
      rotBlock_succ (m + 3) (by omega) θ
    rw [hsucc, rotBlock_eq_rotAmbient m θ]
    have h0 : (Fin.last (m + 3) : Fin (m + 4)) ≠ 0 := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      rw [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_zero] at hv
      omega
    have h1 : (Fin.last (m + 3) : Fin (m + 4)) ≠ 1 := by
      intro h
      have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
      rw [Fin.val_last, Fin.val_one] at hv
      omega
    ext i j
    induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last =>
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        rw [incMatrix_apply_last_last, rotAmbient_apply, if_neg h0, if_neg h1,
          if_pos rfl]
      | cast j =>
        rw [incMatrix_apply_last_castSucc, rotAmbient_apply, if_neg h0, if_neg h1,
          if_neg (Fin.castSucc_lt_last j).ne]
    | cast i =>
      induction j using Fin.lastCases with
      | last =>
        rw [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_last, rotAmbient_apply]
        by_cases hi0 : Fin.castSucc i = 0
        · rw [if_pos hi0, if_neg h0, if_neg h1]
        · by_cases hi1 : Fin.castSucc i = 1
          · rw [if_neg hi0, if_pos hi1, if_neg h0, if_neg h1]
          · rw [if_neg hi0, if_neg hi1, if_neg (Fin.castSucc_lt_last i).ne']
      | cast j =>
        rw [incMatrix_apply_castSucc_castSucc, rotAmbient_apply, rotAmbient_apply]
        have hc0 : ∀ x : Fin (m + 3), Fin.castSucc x = (0 : Fin (m + 4)) ↔ x = 0 := by
          intro x
          rw [← Fin.castSucc_zero]
          exact Fin.castSucc_inj
        have hc1 : ∀ x : Fin (m + 3), Fin.castSucc x = (1 : Fin (m + 4)) ↔ x = 1 := by
          intro x
          rw [← Fin.castSucc_one]
          exact Fin.castSucc_inj
        by_cases hi0 : i = 0
        · subst hi0
          rw [if_pos ((hc0 0).mpr rfl), if_pos rfl]
          by_cases hj0 : j = 0
          · subst hj0
            rw [if_pos ((hc0 0).mpr rfl), if_pos rfl]
          · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
            · subst hj1
              rw [if_neg (fun h => hj0 ((hc0 1).mp h)), if_pos ((hc1 1).mpr rfl),
                if_neg hj0, if_pos rfl]
            · rw [if_neg (fun h => hj0 ((hc0 j).mp h)),
                if_neg (fun h => hj1 ((hc1 j).mp h)), if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1]
        · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
          · subst hi1
            rw [if_neg (fun h => hi0 ((hc0 1).mp h)), if_pos ((hc1 1).mpr rfl),
              if_neg hi0, if_pos rfl]
            by_cases hj0 : j = 0
            · subst hj0
              rw [if_pos ((hc0 0).mpr rfl), if_pos rfl]
            · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
              · subst hj1
                rw [if_neg (fun h => hj0 ((hc0 1).mp h)), if_pos ((hc1 1).mpr rfl),
                  if_neg hj0, if_pos rfl]
              · rw [if_neg (fun h => hj0 ((hc0 j).mp h)),
                  if_neg (fun h => hj1 ((hc1 j).mp h)), if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1]
          · rw [if_neg (fun h => hi0 ((hc0 i).mp h)),
              if_neg (fun h => hi1 ((hc1 i).mp h)), if_neg hi0, if_neg hi1]
            by_cases hji : j = i
            · subst hji
              rw [if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl]
            · rw [if_neg (fun h => hji (Fin.castSucc_inj.mp h)), if_neg hji]

name: Submission.swapRotMat_apply
statement:
lemma swapRotMat_apply (m : ℕ) (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    swapRotMat m i j
      = swapSign m i * (if j = swapRotPerm m i then 1 else 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [swapRotMat, Matrix.diagonal_mul]
  simp only [Equiv.Perm.permMatrix, PEquiv.toMatrix_toPEquiv_apply, Pi.single_apply]

name: Submission.swapRotMat_mul_transpose
statement:
lemma swapRotMat_mul_transpose (m : ℕ) :
    swapRotMat m * (swapRotMat m)ᵀ = 1
proof:
:= by
  ext i j
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.one_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (swapRotPerm m i)]
  · rw [Matrix.transpose_apply, swapRotMat_apply m i, swapRotMat_apply m j]
    by_cases hij : i = j
    · subst hij
      by_cases h1 : i = 1 <;> simp [swapSign, h1]
    · have hσ : swapRotPerm m i ≠ swapRotPerm m j :=
        fun h => hij ((swapRotPerm m).injective h)
      simp [hσ, hij]
  · intro c _ hc
    rw [swapRotMat_apply m i c, if_neg hc, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: Submission.det_swapRotMat
statement: lemma det_swapRotMat (m : ℕ) : (swapRotMat m).det = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [swapRotMat, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_diagonal, swapRotPerm,
    Matrix.det_permutation, Equiv.Perm.sign_swap (Ne.symm (lastA_ne_one (m := m)))]
  simp [swapSign]

name: Submission.swapRotMat_mem
statement:
lemma swapRotMat_mem (m : ℕ) :
    swapRotMat m ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ
proof:
:=
  Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mpr
    ⟨(Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ).mpr
      (swapRotMat_mul_transpose m), det_swapRotMat m⟩

name: Submission.swapRotMat_transpose_mem
statement:
lemma swapRotMat_transpose_mem (m : ℕ) :
    (swapRotMat m)ᵀ ∈ Matrix.specialOrthogonalGroup (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff]
  constructor
  · rw [Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff, Matrix.transpose_transpose]
    exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp (swapRotMat_mul_transpose m)
  · rw [Matrix.det_transpose]
    exact det_swapRotMat m

name: Submission.swapRotSO_inv_coe
statement:
lemma swapRotSO_inv_coe (m : ℕ) :
    (((swapRotSO m)⁻¹ : SOGroup (m + 3)) :
        Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) = (swapRotMat m)ᵀ
proof:
:= by
  have hmul : swapRotSO m * ⟨(swapRotMat m)ᵀ, swapRotMat_transpose_mem m⟩ = 1 :=
    Subtype.ext (swapRotMat_mul_transpose m)
  have hinv := eq_inv_of_mul_eq_one_right hmul
  exact congrArg Subtype.val hinv.symm

name: Submission.swapRotMat_mul_apply
statement:
lemma swapRotMat_mul_apply (m : ℕ) (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ)
    (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    (swapRotMat m * A) i j = swapSign m i * A (swapRotPerm m i) j
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single (swapRotPerm m i)]
  · rw [swapRotMat_apply, if_pos rfl, mul_one]
  · intro c _ hc
    rw [swapRotMat_apply, if_neg hc, mul_zero, zero_mul]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: Submission.mul_swapRotMat_transpose_apply
statement:
lemma mul_swapRotMat_transpose_apply (m : ℕ)
    (A : Matrix (Fin (m + 3)) (Fin (m + 3)) ℝ) (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    (A * (swapRotMat m)ᵀ) i j = swapSign m j * A i (swapRotPerm m j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.mul_apply, Finset.sum_eq_single (swapRotPerm m j)]
  · rw [Matrix.transpose_apply, swapRotMat_apply, if_pos rfl, mul_one, mul_comm]
  · intro c _ hc
    rw [Matrix.transpose_apply, swapRotMat_apply, if_neg hc, mul_zero, mul_zero]
  · intro h
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) h

name: Submission.twistMat_apply
statement:
lemma twistMat_apply (m : ℕ) (φ : ℝ) (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    twistMat m φ i j = swapSign m i * swapSign m j
      * rotAmbient m φ (swapRotPerm m i) (swapRotPerm m j)
proof:
:= by
  rw [twistMat, mul_swapRotMat_transpose_apply, swapRotMat_mul_apply]
  ring

name: Submission.twistMat_entries
statement:
lemma twistMat_entries (m : ℕ) (φ : ℝ) (i j : Fin (m + 3)) :
    twistMat m φ i j =
      if i = 0 then
        (if j = 0 then Real.cos φ
          else if j = Fin.last (m + 2) then -Real.sin φ else 0)
      else if i = Fin.last (m + 2) then
        (if j = 0 then Real.sin φ
          else if j = Fin.last (m + 2) then Real.cos φ else 0)
      else if j = i then 1 else 0
proof:
:= by
  have hone0 : (1 : Fin (m + 3)) ≠ 0 := Ne.symm (Fin.zero_ne_one (n := m + 1))
  have hs0 : swapSign m 0 = 1 := if_neg (Fin.zero_ne_one (n := m + 1))
  have hs1 : swapSign m 1 = -1 := if_pos rfl
  have hsl : swapSign m (Fin.last (m + 2)) = 1 := if_neg lastA_ne_one
  have hσ0 : swapRotPerm m 0 = 0 :=
    Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne (Fin.zero_ne_one (n := m + 1))
      (Ne.symm lastA_ne_zero)
  have hσ1 : swapRotPerm m 1 = Fin.last (m + 2) := Equiv.swap_apply_left _ _
  have hσl : swapRotPerm m (Fin.last (m + 2)) = 1 := Equiv.swap_apply_right _ _
  rw [twistMat_apply]
  by_cases hi0 : i = 0
  · subst hi0
    rw [if_pos rfl, hs0, hσ0]
    by_cases hj0 : j = 0
    · subst hj0
      rw [if_pos rfl, hs0, hσ0, rotAmbient_apply, if_pos rfl, if_pos rfl]
      ring
    · by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 2)
      · subst hjl
        rw [if_neg lastA_ne_zero, if_pos rfl, hsl, hσl, rotAmbient_apply,
          if_pos rfl, if_neg hone0, if_pos rfl]
        ring
      · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
        · subst hj1
          rw [if_neg hone0, if_neg (Ne.symm lastA_ne_one), hs1, hσ1,
            rotAmbient_apply, if_pos rfl, if_neg lastA_ne_zero,
            if_neg lastA_ne_one]
          ring
        · have hσj : swapRotPerm m j = j :=
            Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hj1 hjl
          have hsj : swapSign m j = 1 := if_neg hj1
          rw [if_neg hj0, if_neg hjl, hsj, hσj, rotAmbient_apply, if_pos rfl,
            if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1]
          ring
  · by_cases hi1 : i = 1
    · subst hi1
      rw [if_neg hone0, if_neg (Ne.symm lastA_ne_one), hs1, hσ1]
      by_cases hj1 : j = 1
      · subst hj1
        rw [if_pos rfl, hs1, hσ1, rotAmbient_apply, if_neg lastA_ne_zero,
          if_neg lastA_ne_one, if_pos rfl]
        ring
      · have hcol : rotAmbient m φ (Fin.last (m + 2)) (swapRotPerm m j) = 0 := by
          rw [rotAmbient_apply, if_neg lastA_ne_zero, if_neg lastA_ne_one, if_neg]
          intro h
          exact hj1 ((swapRotPerm m).injective (h.trans hσ1.symm))
        rw [if_neg hj1, hcol]
        ring
    · by_cases hil : i = Fin.last (m + 2)
      · subst hil
        rw [if_neg lastA_ne_zero, if_pos rfl, hsl, hσl]
        by_cases hj0 : j = 0
        · subst hj0
          rw [if_pos rfl, hs0, hσ0, rotAmbient_apply, if_neg hone0, if_pos rfl,
            if_pos rfl]
          ring
        · by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 2)
          · subst hjl
            rw [if_neg lastA_ne_zero, if_pos rfl, hsl, hσl, rotAmbient_apply,
              if_neg hone0, if_pos rfl, if_neg hone0, if_pos rfl]
            ring
          · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
            · subst hj1
              rw [if_neg hone0, if_neg (Ne.symm lastA_ne_one), hs1, hσ1,
                rotAmbient_apply, if_neg hone0, if_pos rfl,
                if_neg lastA_ne_zero, if_neg lastA_ne_one]
              ring
            · have hσj : swapRotPerm m j = j :=
                Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hj1 hjl
              have hsj : swapSign m j = 1 := if_neg hj1
              rw [if_neg hj0, if_neg hjl, hsj, hσj, rotAmbient_apply,
                if_neg hone0, if_pos rfl, if_neg hj0, if_neg hj1]
              ring
      · have hσi : swapRotPerm m i = i := Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hi1 hil
        have hsi : swapSign m i = 1 := if_neg hi1
        rw [if_neg hi0, if_neg hil, hsi, hσi]
        by_cases hji : j = i
        · subst hji
          have hσj : swapRotPerm m j = j := Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hi1 hil
          have hsj : swapSign m j = 1 := if_neg hi1
          rw [if_pos rfl, hsj, hσj, rotAmbient_apply, if_neg hi0, if_neg hi1,
            if_pos rfl]
          ring
        · by_cases hj1 : j = 1
          · subst hj1
            have hentry : rotAmbient m φ i (swapRotPerm m 1) = 0 := by
              rw [hσ1, rotAmbient_apply, if_neg hi0, if_neg hi1,
                if_neg (fun h => hil h.symm)]
            rw [if_neg hji, hentry]
            ring
          · by_cases hjl : j = Fin.last (m + 2)
            · subst hjl
              have hentry : rotAmbient m φ i
                  (swapRotPerm m (Fin.last (m + 2))) = 0 := by
                rw [hσl, rotAmbient_apply, if_neg hi0, if_neg hi1,
                  if_neg (fun h => hi1 h.symm)]
              rw [if_neg hji, hentry]
              ring
            · have hσj : swapRotPerm m j = j :=
                Equiv.swap_apply_of_ne_of_ne hj1 hjl
              have hsj : swapSign m j = 1 := if_neg hj1
              rw [if_neg hji, hsj, hσj, rotAmbient_apply, if_neg hi0, if_neg hi1,
                if_neg hji]
              ring

name: Submission.tubeDeltaZeroLedger_delta_eq_northDelta
statement:
theorem tubeDeltaZeroLedger_delta_eq_northDelta
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) :
    (tubeDeltaZeroLedger n hn h2).delta =
      (tubeDeltaZeroBridge n hn h2).northDelta
proof:
:= by
  let B := tubeDeltaZeroBridge n hn h2
  let V := B.canonicalTamedField
  exact (B.northFrameLedger_delta V).trans (B.northDelta_eq V).symm

name: Submission.tubeDeltaZeroLedger_value_iff
statement:
theorem tubeDeltaZeroLedger_value_iff
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) :
    (tubeDeltaZeroLedger n hn h2).delta = 0 ↔
      stableNorthDelta hn (tubeDeltaZeroClass n h2) =
        Multiplicative.ofAdd 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [stableNorthDelta_apply]
  change (tubeDeltaZeroLedger n hn h2).delta = 0 ↔
    Multiplicative.ofAdd ((tubeDeltaZeroBridge n hn h2).northDelta) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd 0
  rw [tubeDeltaZeroLedger_delta_eq_northDelta]
  exact Multiplicative.ofAdd.injective.eq_iff

name: Submission.tubeDeltaOneLedger_value_iff
statement:
theorem tubeDeltaOneLedger_value_iff
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) :

      stableNorthDelta hn (tubeDeltaOneClass n h2) =
        Multiplicative.ofAdd 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [stableNorthDelta_apply]
  change (tubeDeltaOneLedger n hn h2).delta = 1 ↔
    Multiplicative.ofAdd ((tubeDeltaOneBridge n hn h2).northDelta) =
      Multiplicative.ofAdd 1
  rw [tubeDeltaOneLedger_delta_eq_northDelta]
  exact Multiplicative.ofAdd.injective.eq_iff

name: Submission.exists_signedCobordism_tubeExplicitBridge_to_chosen

theorem exists_signedCobordism_tubeExplicitBridge_to_chosen (m k : ℕ) :

name: Submission.stableNorthDelta_surjective_of_tubeLedger_values
statement:
theorem stableNorthDelta_surjective_of_tubeLedger_values
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (hzero : (tubeDeltaZeroLedger n hn h2).delta = 0)
    (hone : (tubeDeltaOneLedger n hn h2).delta = 1) :
    Function.Surjective (stableNorthDelta hn)

  apply stableNorthDelta_surjective_of_zero_one hn
    (tubeDeltaZeroClass n h2) (tubeDeltaOneClass n h2)

  · exact (tubeDeltaOneLedger_value_iff n hn h2).mp hone

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.point_apply_zero
statement:
theorem point_apply_zero (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (P : V.OrbitIndex)
    (theta : ℝ) :
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) =
      Real.cos theta
proof:
:= by
  simp [CanonicalRoundOrbit.point, CanonicalRoundOrbit.center,
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂,
    Fin.ext_iff]

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.point_apply_one
statement:
theorem point_apply_one (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (P : V.OrbitIndex)
    (theta : ℝ) :
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin (n + 1)) =
      Real.sin theta
proof:
:= by

    CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₀, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₁, CanonicalRoundOrbit.e₂,
    Fin.ext_iff]

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.continuous_point
statement:
theorem continuous_point (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (P : V.OrbitIndex) :
    Continuous (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P)
proof:
:=
  ((continuous_const.add (Real.continuous_cos.smul continuous_const)).add
    (Real.continuous_sin.smul continuous_const))

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.point_eq_iff_mod
statement:
theorem point_eq_iff_mod (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (P : V.OrbitIndex)
    {theta theta' : ℝ}
    (h : CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta') :
    ∃ z : ℤ, theta' = theta + (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi)
proof:
:= by
  have hcos : Real.cos theta = Real.cos theta' := by
    rw [← point_apply_zero V h2 P theta, ← point_apply_zero V h2 P theta', h]
  have hsin : Real.sin theta = Real.sin theta' := by
    rw [← point_apply_one V h2 P theta, ← point_apply_one V h2 P theta', h]
  have hone : Real.cos (theta' - theta) = 1 := by
    rw [Real.cos_sub, ← hcos, ← hsin]
    linear_combination Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq theta
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := (Real.cos_eq_one_iff _).mp hone
  exact ⟨z, by linarith⟩

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.circleLoop_eq_cases
statement:
theorem circleLoop_eq_cases (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (P : V.OrbitIndex)
    {u v : I} (huv : circleLoop V h2 P u = circleLoop V h2 P v) :
    u = v ∨ (u = 0 ∧ v = 1) ∨ (u = 1 ∧ v = 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := point_eq_iff_mod V h2 P huv
  have hpi : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := mul_pos (by norm_num) Real.pi_pos
  have huvZ : (v : ℝ) = (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) := by
    change 2 * Real.pi * (v : ℝ) =
      2 * Real.pi * (u : ℝ) + (z : ℝ) * (2 * Real.pi) at hz
    nlinarith
  have hzLowerR : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ (z : ℝ) := by
    nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  have hzUpperR : (z : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by
    nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
  have hzLower : (-1 : ℤ) ≤ z := by exact_mod_cast hzLowerR
  have hzUpper : z ≤ (1 : ℤ) := by exact_mod_cast hzUpperR
  rcases (show z = -1 ∨ z = 0 ∨ z = 1 by omega) with hzv | hzv | hzv
  · right; right
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.2, v.2.1]
  · left
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [hzv] at huvZ
    norm_num at huvZ
    exact huvZ.symm
  · right; left
    constructor <;> apply Subtype.ext
    · change (u : ℝ) = 0
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]
    · change (v : ℝ) = 1
      rw [hzv] at huvZ
      norm_num at huvZ
      nlinarith [u.2.1, v.2.2]

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.point_mem_targetUnion
statement:
theorem point_mem_targetUnion (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)

      CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2

:=

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.point_mem_fiber

theorem point_mem_fiber (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (P : V.OrbitIndex)

    (hfib : W.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2) (theta : ℝ) :

:= by
  rw [hfib]

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_circleLoop
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_circleLoop (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) {W : FramedLevelSet n} (U : TamedField W)
    (hmem : ∀ theta : ℝ, CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta ∈ W.fiber)
    (hreg : ∀ u : I, circleLoop V h2 P u ∈ regularSet W.g) :
    loopClassZ2
        (frameSOLoop W (circleLoop V h2 P) (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P) hreg)
        (frameSOLoop_closed W (circleLoop V h2 P) (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P)
          hreg (circleLoop_closed V h2 P))
      = U.fundamentalFrameClass (hmem 0)
proof:
:= by
  set Q : SimpleClosedOrbitParam W U := circleParam V h2 P U hmem with hQ
  have hloop :
      frameSOLoop W (circleLoop V h2 P) (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P) hreg
        = Q.paramFrameLoop := by
    refine ContinuousMap.ext fun u => ?_
    apply Subtype.ext
    rw [frameSOLoop_coe]
    show rowsMatrix (gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (frameAt W (circleLoop V h2 P u)))
      = frameLoop W Q.realCurve ((u : ℝ))
    unfold frameLoop
    rw [Q.realCurve_coe]
    rfl
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun
    (frameSOLoop_closed W (circleLoop V h2 P) (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P)
      hreg (circleLoop_closed V h2 P))
    Q.paramFrameLoop_closed hloop]
  exact Q.paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.fundamentalFrameClass_transportParam
statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameClass_transportParam (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    {X : FramedLevelSet n} {V : TamedField X} (U : TamedField (A.pullback X))
    (Pm : SimpleClosedOrbitParam X V) :
    U.fundamentalFrameClass (A.transportParam U Pm).hp =
      V.fundamentalFrameClass Pm.hp
proof:
:= by
  rw [← (A.transportParam U Pm).paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental,
    A.loopClassZ2_transportParam U Pm, Pm.paramFrameClass_eq_fundamental]

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.point_mem_orbit
statement:
theorem point_mem_orbit (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (P : V.OrbitIndex)
    {W : FramedLevelSet n} (U : TamedField W)
    (hmem : ∀ theta : ℝ, CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta ∈ W.fiber)
    (theta : ℝ) :
    CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta ∈
      U.orbit (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P 0)
proof:
:=
  U.continuousCurve_mem_orbit (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P)
    (continuous_point V h2 P) hmem theta

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.mem_orbit_of_mem_target
statement:
theorem mem_orbit_of_mem_target (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n)
    (P : V.OrbitIndex) {W : FramedLevelSet n} (U : TamedField W)
    (hmem : ∀ theta : ℝ, CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P theta ∈ W.fiber)
    {q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hq : q ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 P) :
    q ∈ U.orbit (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 P 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨theta, rfl⟩ :=
    CanonicalRotationField.exists_theta_of_mem_target V h2 P hq
  exact point_mem_orbit V h2 P U hmem theta

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.fundamentalFrameClass_circle_of_orbit
statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameClass_circle_of_orbit {X : FramedLevelSet n}
    (V : TamedField X) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n)
    (U : TamedField (A.pullback X))
    (hfib : (A.pullback X).fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (O : V.OrbitIndex)
    (himg : A.forward 1 '' (O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 O) :
    U.fundamentalFrameClass (point_mem_fiber V h2 O (A.pullback X) hfib 0)
      = V.orbitFrameClass O
proof:
:= by
  have hmem := point_mem_fiber V h2 O (A.pullback X) hfib
  have hq : A.forward 1 (V.orbitPoint O) ∈ CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 O := by
    rw [← himg]
    exact ⟨V.orbitPoint O, by
      rw [V.orbitPoint_orbit O]
      exact V.mem_orbit_self _, rfl⟩
  have hqorb := mem_orbit_of_mem_target V h2 O U hmem hq
  calc U.fundamentalFrameClass (hmem 0)
      = U.fundamentalFrameClass
          (A.transportParam U (V.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam O)).hp :=
        (U.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit (hmem 0) hqorb).symm
    _ = V.fundamentalFrameClass (V.intrinsicSimpleClosedOrbitParam O).hp :=
        fundamentalFrameClass_transportParam A U _
    _ = V.orbitFrameClass O := rfl

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.fundamentalFrameClass_circle_of_circle
statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameClass_circle_of_circle {Xv : FramedLevelSet n}
    (V : TamedField Xv) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) {Xs : FramedLevelSet n}
    (Us : TamedField Xs)
    (hfibs : Xs.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (A : SmoothAmbientIsotopy n) {Xw : FramedLevelSet n} (V' : TamedField Xw)
    (h2' : 2 ≤ n) (Ut : TamedField (A.pullback Xs))
    (hfibt : (A.pullback Xs).fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V' h2')
    (O : V.OrbitIndex) (O' : V'.OrbitIndex)
    (himg : A.forward 1 '' CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V h2 O =
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V' h2' O') :
    Ut.fundamentalFrameClass
        (point_mem_fiber V' h2' O' (A.pullback Xs) hfibt 0)
      = Us.fundamentalFrameClass (point_mem_fiber V h2 O Xs hfibs 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hmems := point_mem_fiber V h2 O Xs hfibs
  have hmemt := point_mem_fiber V' h2' O' (A.pullback Xs) hfibt
  have hq : A.forward 1 (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 O 0) ∈
      CanonicalRoundOrbit.target V' h2' O' := by
    rw [← himg]
    exact ⟨CanonicalRoundOrbit.point V h2 O 0,
      CanonicalRotationField.point_mem_target V h2 O 0, rfl⟩
  have hqorb := mem_orbit_of_mem_target V' h2' O' Ut hmemt hq
  calc Ut.fundamentalFrameClass (hmemt 0)
      = Ut.fundamentalFrameClass
          (A.transportParam Ut (circleParam V h2 O Us hmems)).hp :=
        (Ut.fundamentalFrameClass_eq_of_mem_orbit (hmemt 0) hqorb).symm
    _ = Us.fundamentalFrameClass (circleParam V h2 O Us hmems).hp :=
        fundamentalFrameClass_transportParam A Ut _

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.gaugeCircleLoop_closed
statement:
theorem gaugeCircleLoop_closed (Gg : SmoothSOGauge n)
    {γ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hγc : Continuous γ)
    (hloop : γ 0 = γ 1) :
    gaugeCircleLoop Gg hγc 0 = gaugeCircleLoop Gg hγc 1
proof:
:= by
  show Gg.mat (γ 0) = Gg.mat (γ 1)
  rw [hloop]

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_gaugeTransform
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_gaugeTransform (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (Gg : SmoothSOGauge n) (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (γ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (hγc : Continuous γ)
    (hγfib : ∀ u, γ u ∈ X.fiber) (hloop : γ 0 = γ 1)
    (hregX : ∀ u, γ u ∈ regularSet X.g)
    (hregT : ∀ u, γ u ∈ regularSet (Gg.transform X).g) :
    loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop (Gg.transform X) γ hγc hregT)
        (frameSOLoop_closed (Gg.transform X) γ hγc hregT hloop)
      = loopClassZ2 (gaugeCircleLoop Gg hγc)
          (gaugeCircleLoop_closed Gg hγc hloop)
        + loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop X γ hγc hregX)
            (frameSOLoop_closed X γ hγc hregX hloop)
proof:
:= by
  set Gmat : I → Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ := fun u =>
    ((SmoothSOGauge.blockSO (Gg.mat (γ u)) : SOGroup (n + 1)) :
      Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) with hGmatdef
  have hblockcont : Continuous fun u : I =>
      (SmoothSOGauge.blockSO (Gg.mat (γ u)) : SOGroup (n + 1)) :=
    SmoothSOGauge.continuous_blockSO.comp (Gg.continuous_mat.comp hγc)
  have hGcont : ∀ i j, Continuous fun u => Gmat u i j := fun i j =>
    (continuous_apply j).comp
      ((continuous_apply i).comp (continuous_subtype_val.comp hblockcont))
  have hGdet : ∀ u, 0 < (Gmat u).det := fun u =>
    SOGroup_det_pos (SmoothSOGauge.blockSO (Gg.mat (γ u)))
  have hGloop : Gmat 0 = Gmat 1 := by
    show ((SmoothSOGauge.blockSO (Gg.mat (γ 0)) : SOGroup (n + 1)) :
        Matrix (Fin (n + 1)) (Fin (n + 1)) ℝ) = _
    rw [hloop]
  have hGeq : ∀ u, rowsMatrix (frameAt (Gg.transform X) (γ u))
      = Gmat u * rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ u)) := by
    intro u
    rw [Gg.frameAt_transform X (hγfib u), rowsMatrix_frameRowAction]
    rfl
  rw [loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_of_comparison X (Gg.transform X) γ hγc hregX
    hregT hloop Gmat hGcont hGdet hGloop hGeq]
  congr 1
  have hsplit : gsQLoop Gmat hGcont hGdet
      = blockLoop (gaugeCircleLoop Gg hγc) := by
    refine ContinuousMap.ext fun u => ?_
    show gsSO (Gmat u) = SmoothSOGauge.blockSO (Gg.mat (γ u))
    exact gsSO_coe_SOGroup _
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun (gsQLoop_closed Gmat hGcont hGdet hGloop)
    (blockLoop_closed (gaugeCircleLoop_closed Gg hγc hloop)) hsplit]
  exact loopClassZ2_blockLoop hn (gaugeCircleLoop Gg hγc)
    (gaugeCircleLoop_closed Gg hγc hloop)

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.fundamentalFrameClass_gaugeTransform_circle
statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameClass_gaugeTransform_circle (hn : 3 ≤ n)
    (V : TamedField Xf) (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (P : V.OrbitIndex)
    (Gg : SmoothSOGauge n) (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (hfib : X.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (UX : TamedField X) (UT : TamedField (Gg.transform X)) :
    UT.fundamentalFrameClass
        (point_mem_fiber V h2 P (Gg.transform X)
          ((Gg.transform_fiber X).trans hfib) 0)
      = loopClassZ2 (gaugeCircleLoop Gg (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P))
          (gaugeCircleLoop_closed Gg (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P)
            (circleLoop_closed V h2 P))
        + UX.fundamentalFrameClass (point_mem_fiber V h2 P X hfib 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_circleLoop V h2 P UT
      (point_mem_fiber V h2 P (Gg.transform X)
        ((Gg.transform_fiber X).trans hfib))
      (fun u => circleLoop_mem_regularSet V h2 P (Gg.transform X)
        ((Gg.transform_fiber X).trans hfib) u),
    ← loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_circleLoop V h2 P UX
      (point_mem_fiber V h2 P X hfib)
      (fun u => circleLoop_mem_regularSet V h2 P X hfib u)]
  exact loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_gaugeTransform hn Gg X
    (circleLoop V h2 P) (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P)
    (fun u => point_mem_fiber V h2 P X hfib _)
    (circleLoop_closed V h2 P) _ _

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.det_clmMatrix_smul_toCLM_pos
statement:
theorem det_clmMatrix_smul_toCLM_pos {k : ℕ} (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (R : SOGroup k) :
    0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix
      (c • SOFrameGauge.toCLM R :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))).det
proof:
:= by
  have hmat : PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix
      (c • SOFrameGauge.toCLM R :
        EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k))
      = c • ((R : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin k) ℝ)) := by
    ext i j
    rw [PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix_apply]
    simp [Matrix.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [hmat, Matrix.det_smul,
    (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp R.property).2]
  positivity

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.tauField_gaugeTransform_of_det_pos
statement:
theorem tauField_gaugeTransform_of_det_pos (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (hQbij : ∀ x, Function.Bijective (Q x))
    {p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))} (hp : p ∈ X.fiber)
    (hdet : 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Q p)).det) :
    tauField (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij).g p = (1 : ℝ) • tauField X.g p
proof:
:= by
  have hC := SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.fderiv_gaugeTransform_eq X Q hQ hQbij hp
  have hrow : (fun j => gradVec (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij).g j p)
      = normalRowAction (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Q p))
          (fun j => gradVec X.g j p) := by
    funext j
    exact gradVec_eq_sum_of_fderiv_comp X (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij) p
      (Q p) hC j
  have hker : kerCross (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij).g p
      = (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Q p)).det • kerCross X.g p := by
    show crossVec (fun j => gradVec (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij).g j p) = _
    rw [hrow]
    exact crossVec_frameRowAction_normals _ _
  set d : ℝ := (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Q p)).det with hd
  set kk : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) := kerCross X.g p with hkk
  show ‖kerCross (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij).g p‖⁻¹ •
    kerCross (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij).g p = (1 : ℝ) • (‖kk‖⁻¹ • kk)
  rw [hker, one_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hdet, smul_smul,
    mul_inv, mul_comm d⁻¹ ‖kk‖⁻¹, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hdet),
    mul_one]

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_gaugeTransform_const
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_gaugeTransform_const (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (hQbij : ∀ x, Function.Bijective (Q x))
    (hconst : ∀ x y, Q x = Q y)
    (hdet : ∀ x, 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Q x)).det)
    (γ : I → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) (hγc : Continuous γ)
    (hγfib : ∀ u, γ u ∈ X.fiber) (hloop : γ 0 = γ 1)
    (hregX : ∀ u, γ u ∈ regularSet X.g)
    (hregT : ∀ u, γ u ∈ regularSet (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij).g) :
    loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij) γ hγc hregT)
        (frameSOLoop_closed (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij) γ hγc hregT hloop)
      = loopClassZ2 (frameSOLoop X γ hγc hregX)
          (frameSOLoop_closed X γ hγc hregX hloop)
proof:
:= by
  have hGeq : ∀ u, rowsMatrix (frameAt (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij) (γ u))
      = normalBlock 1 (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Q (γ 0))) *
        rowsMatrix (frameAt X (γ u)) := by
    intro u
    have h := rowsMatrix_frameAt_eq_normalBlock_mul X
      (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij) (γ u) (Q (γ u))
      (SameFiberFrameJetNormalization.fderiv_gaugeTransform_eq X Q hQ hQbij
        (hγfib u)) 1
      (tauField_gaugeTransform_of_det_pos X Q hQ hQbij (hγfib u) (hdet (γ u)))
    rw [h, hconst (γ u) (γ 0)]
  have hGdet : 0 < (normalBlock (1 : ℝ)
      (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Q (γ 0)))).det :=
    det_pos_of_rowsMatrix_frameAt_eq (hregX 0) (hregT 0) (hGeq 0)
  rw [loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_of_comparison X (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij) γ
    hγc hregX hregT hloop
    (fun _ => normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Q (γ 0))))
    (fun _ _ => continuous_const) (fun _ => hGdet) rfl hGeq]
  have hconstloop : gsQLoop
      (fun _ : I =>
        normalBlock (1 : ℝ) (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Q (γ 0))))
      (fun _ _ => continuous_const) (fun _ => hGdet)
      = ContinuousMap.const I
        (gsSO (normalBlock (1 : ℝ)
          (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Q (γ 0))))) := rfl
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun _ rfl hconstloop, loopClassZ2_const, zero_add]

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.fundamentalFrameClass_gaugeTransform_const_circle
statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameClass_gaugeTransform_const_circle (V : TamedField Xf)
    (h2 : 2 ≤ n) (P : V.OrbitIndex) (X : FramedLevelSet n)
    (Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)) →
      EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) →L[ℝ] EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (hQ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ Q) (hQbij : ∀ x, Function.Bijective (Q x))
    (hconst : ∀ x y, Q x = Q y)
    (hdet : ∀ x, 0 < (PolarDecompositionCLM.clmMatrix (Q x)).det)
    (hfib : X.fiber = CanonicalRoundOrbit.targetUnion V h2)
    (UX : TamedField X) (UT : TamedField (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij)) :
    UT.fundamentalFrameClass
        (point_mem_fiber V h2 P (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij)
          ((X.gaugeTransform_fiber Q hQ hQbij).trans hfib) 0)
      = UX.fundamentalFrameClass (point_mem_fiber V h2 P X hfib 0)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_circleLoop V h2 P UT
      (point_mem_fiber V h2 P (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij)
        ((X.gaugeTransform_fiber Q hQ hQbij).trans hfib))
      (fun u => circleLoop_mem_regularSet V h2 P (X.gaugeTransform Q hQ hQbij)
        ((X.gaugeTransform_fiber Q hQ hQbij).trans hfib) u),
    ← loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_circleLoop V h2 P UX
      (point_mem_fiber V h2 P X hfib)
      (fun u => circleLoop_mem_regularSet V h2 P X hfib u)]
  exact loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_gaugeTransform_const X Q hQ hQbij hconst hdet
    (circleLoop V h2 P) (continuous_circleLoop V h2 P)
    (fun u => point_mem_fiber V h2 P X hfib _) (circleLoop_closed V h2 P) _ _

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.canonicalCircle_frameClass_eq_of_fundamental
statement:
theorem canonicalCircle_frameClass_eq_of_fundamental (hm : 0 < m)
    {Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex)
    (hfund :
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
          TamedField (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX).fundamentalFrameClass
            (point_mem_placed_fiber hm Y P 0)
        = (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
          TamedField (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G)).fundamentalFrameClass
            (point_mem_harmonized_fiber hm M F G P 0)) :
    loopClassZ2
        (frameSOLoop (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX
          (circleLoop (targetField m Y) (by omega) P)
          (continuous_circleLoop _ _ P)
          (fun u => circleLoop_mem_regularSet _ _ P _
            (targetPlacement hm Y).endpoint_fiber u))
        (frameSOLoop_closed _ _ _ _ (circleLoop_closed _ _ P))
      = loopClassZ2
        (frameSOLoop (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G)
          (circleLoop (targetField m Y) (by omega) P)
          (continuous_circleLoop _ _ P)
          (fun u => circleLoop_mem_regularSet _ _ P _
            (harmonized_fiber_eq_targetUnion hm M F G) u))
        (frameSOLoop_closed _ _ _ _ (circleLoop_closed _ _ P))
proof:
:= by
  rw [loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_circleLoop (targetField m Y) (by omega) P
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m)
      (fun theta => point_mem_placed_fiber hm Y P theta),
    loopClassZ2_frameSOLoop_circleLoop (targetField m Y) (by omega) P
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m)
      (fun theta => point_mem_harmonized_fiber hm M F G P theta)]
  exact hfund

theorem fundamentalFrameClass_matchedPlaced (hm : 0 < m)
    {Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (O : (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
      TamedField B.fls).OrbitIndex) :
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
        TamedField (matchedPlacedX hm M)).fundamentalFrameClass
        (point_mem_fiber (targetField m Y) (by omega) (M.orbitEquiv O)
          (matchedPlacedX hm M) (matchedPlacedX_fiber hm M) 0)
      = (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
        TamedField (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpointX).fundamentalFrameClass
        (point_mem_fiber
          (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
          (by omega) O (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpointX
          (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpoint_fiber 0)
proof:
:=
  fundamentalFrameClass_circle_of_circle
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls) (by omega)
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m)
    (sourcePlacement (B := B) hm).endpoint_fiber
    (M.matchingAmbient hm) (targetField m Y) (by omega)
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m)
    (matchedPlacedX_fiber hm M) O (M.orbitEquiv O)
    (M.matchingAmbient_target hm O)

statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameClass_placed_eq_matchedPlaced (hm : 0 < m)
    {Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) :
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
        TamedField (targetPlacement hm Y).endpointX).fundamentalFrameClass
        (point_mem_placed_fiber hm Y P 0)
      = (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
        TamedField (matchedPlacedX hm M)).fundamentalFrameClass
        (point_mem_fiber (targetField m Y) (by omega) P
          (matchedPlacedX hm M) (matchedPlacedX_fiber hm M) 0)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨O, rfl⟩ := M.orbitEquiv.surjective P
  rw [fundamentalFrameClass_placed hm Y (M.orbitEquiv O),
    fundamentalFrameClass_matchedPlaced hm M O,
    fundamentalFrameClass_sourcePlaced hm O,
    M.orbitEquiv_frameClass O]

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.gaugeCircleLoop_discrepancySOGauge
statement:
theorem gaugeCircleLoop_discrepancySOGauge (hm : 0 < m)
    {Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch) (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) :
    gaugeCircleLoop (discrepancySOGauge hm M F)
        (continuous_circleLoop (targetField m Y) (by omega) P)
      = (F.discrepancyLoop P).loop
proof:
:= by
  refine ContinuousMap.ext fun u => ?_
  show SmoothCartesianSOLoop.CanonicalFiniteGauge.spatialGauge
      (targetField m Y) (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm)
      (F.smoothNullGauge hm) 1
      (CanonicalRoundOrbit.point (targetField m Y) (by omega) P
        (2 * Real.pi * ((u : ℝ)))) = _
  have hloop : (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm P).cartesian
      (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * ((u : ℝ))),
        Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * ((u : ℝ)))) =
      (F.discrepancyLoop P).cartesian
        (Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * ((u : ℝ))),
          Real.sin (2 * Real.pi * ((u : ℝ)))) :=
    (F.nullGauge hm P).endpoint_circle _
      (Real.cos_sq_add_sin_sq (2 * Real.pi * ((u : ℝ))))
  rw [CanonicalRotationField.spatialGauge_one_point (targetField m Y)
      (F.smoothDiscrepancyLoop hm) (F.smoothNullGauge hm) (by omega) P
      (2 * Real.pi * ((u : ℝ))),
    hloop, (F.discrepancyLoop P).loop_eq_cartesian u,
    CanonicalRotationField.addCircleCartesian_coe_real ((u : ℝ))]

name: Submission.CanonicalCircleFrameClass.fundamentalFrameClass_gaugeEndpoint
statement:
theorem fundamentalFrameClass_gaugeEndpoint (hm : 0 < m)
    {Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch) (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) :
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
        TamedField
          (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁).fundamentalFrameClass
        (point_mem_gaugeEndpoint_fiber hm M F P 0)
      = (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
        TamedField (matchedPlacedX hm M)).fundamentalFrameClass
        (point_mem_matchedPlaced_fiber hm M P 0)
proof:
:= by
  have hz : loopClassZ2 (gaugeCircleLoop (discrepancySOGauge hm M F)
        (continuous_circleLoop (targetField m Y) (by omega) P))
      (gaugeCircleLoop_closed (discrepancySOGauge hm M F)
        (continuous_circleLoop (targetField m Y) (by omega) P)
        (circleLoop_closed (targetField m Y) (by omega) P)) = 0 := by
    rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun _ (F.discrepancyLoop P).closed
      (gaugeCircleLoop_discrepancySOGauge hm M F P)]
    exact discrepancyLoop_null M F P
  have hmain := fundamentalFrameClass_gaugeTransform_circle (by omega)
    (targetField m Y) (by omega) P (discrepancySOGauge hm M F)
    (matchedPlacedX hm M) (matchedPlacedX_fiber hm M)
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m)
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m)
  rw [hz, zero_add] at hmain
  exact hmain

statement:

    {Y : FramedLevelSet (m + 2)} {T : FiberSign Y}
    (M : SignedFramedOrbitEquiv
      (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m : TamedField B.fls)
      (targetField m Y) B.fiberSign T)
    (F : M.ActualFrameLoopMatch)
    (G : BridgeCompactBackgroundGauge.Data (-B.y) (compactBackground m))
    (P : (targetField m Y).OrbitIndex) :
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
        TamedField (harmonizedEndpoint hm M F G)).fundamentalFrameClass
        (point_mem_harmonized_fiber hm M F G P 0)
      = (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m :
        TamedField
          (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁).fundamentalFrameClass
        (point_mem_gaugeEndpoint_fiber hm M F P 0)
proof:
:=
  fundamentalFrameClass_gaugeTransform_const_circle (targetField m Y)
    (by omega) P (discrepancyHomotopy hm M F).toCobordism.X₁
    (G.gauge 1) (contDiff_gauge_slice G.gauge_smooth 1)
    (fun x => G.gauge_bijective 1 x) (fun _ _ => rfl)
    (fun _ => det_clmMatrix_smul_toCLM_pos (G.scalar 1) (G.scalar_pos 1)
      (G.soPath.Q 1))
    (gaugeEndpoint_fiber hm M F)
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m)
    (ConcreteConfigurationConfigure.field m)

name: Submission.abs_coord_le_norm
statement:
lemma abs_coord_le_norm {n : ℕ} (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
    (i : Fin (n + 1)) : |u i| ≤ ‖u‖
proof:
:= by
  have h1 : ‖u i‖ ^ 2 ≤ ∑ j, ‖u j‖ ^ 2 :=
    Finset.single_le_sum (f := fun j => ‖u j‖ ^ 2)
      (fun j _ => sq_nonneg _) (Finset.mem_univ i)
  have h2 : ‖u‖ = Real.sqrt (∑ j, ‖u j‖ ^ 2) := EuclideanSpace.norm_eq u
  calc |u i| = Real.sqrt (‖u i‖ ^ 2) := by
        rw [Real.sqrt_sq_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs]
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt (∑ j, ‖u j‖ ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h1
    _ = ‖u‖ := h2.symm

proof:
:= by
  have huu : ⟪u, u⟫ = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, hu]; norm_num
  have heu : ⟪eLast n, u⟫ = vertC u := inner_eLast_left u
  rw [plateauAux, inner_add_left, real_inner_smul_left, real_inner_smul_left,

name: Submission.inner_plateauAux_pos
statement:
lemma inner_plateauAux_pos {n : ℕ} {u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))}
    (hu : ‖u‖ = 1) : 0 < ⟪plateauAux u, u⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [inner_plateauAux_self hu]
  set t := vertC u with ht
  have habs : |t| ≤ 1 := abs_vertC_le_one hu
  have ht1 : -1 ≤ t := neg_le_of_abs_le habs
  rcases lt_trichotomy t 0 with h | h | h
  · have h1 : 0 ≤ plateauA t * (1 + t) :=
      mul_nonneg (plateauA_nonneg t) (by linarith)
    linarith
  · have h0 : plateauA t = 1 := plateauA_of_ge (by rw [h]; norm_num)
    rw [h0, h]
    norm_num
  · have h0 : plateauA t = 1 := plateauA_of_ge (by linarith)
    rw [h0]
    linarith

  have h := inner_plateauAux_pos hu

name: Submission.plateauMap_ne_neg
statement:
lemma plateauMap_ne_neg {n : ℕ} (u : UnitSphere (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) :
    plateauMap n u ≠ -u
proof:
:= by
  intro hc
  have hcoe : ((plateauMap n u) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))
      = -(u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) := by
    rw [hc, coe_neg_sphere]
  have hpos : 0 < ⟪plateauAux (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
      (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))⟫ :=
    inner_plateauAux_pos (UnitSphere.norm_coe u)
  have hne : plateauAux (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) ≠ 0 :=
    plateauAux_ne_zero (UnitSphere.norm_coe u)
  have hinner : ⟪((plateauMap n u) : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
      (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))⟫
      = ‖plateauAux (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))‖⁻¹ *
          ⟪plateauAux (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
            (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))⟫ := by
    rw [plateauMap_coe, real_inner_smul_left]
  have huu : ⟪(u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
      (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))⟫ = 1 := by
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, UnitSphere.norm_coe]; norm_num
  rw [hcoe, inner_neg_left, huu] at hinner
  have hposinv : 0 < ‖plateauAux (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))‖⁻¹ *
      ⟪plateauAux (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))),
        (u : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))⟫ :=
    mul_pos (inv_pos.mpr (norm_pos_iff.mpr hne)) hpos
  rw [← hinner] at hposinv
  norm_num at hposinv
