name: Submission.inner_gramSchmidt_eq_zero_of_mem_span
proof:
:= by
  induction hx using Submodule.span_induction with
  | mem y hy =>
      obtain ⟨k, hk, rfl⟩ := hy
      refine gramSchmidt_orthogonal ℝ v ?_
      rintro rfl
      exact hj hk
  | zero => exact inner_zero_left _
  | add a b _ _ ha hb => rw [inner_add_left, ha, hb, add_zero]
  | smul c a _ ha => rw [real_inner_smul_left, ha, mul_zero]

name: Submission.inner_gramSchmidtNormed_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem inner_gramSchmidtNormed_eq_zero_of_lt
    {v : Fin r → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin r)} {i j : Fin r} (hij : i < j) :
    ⟪v i, gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v j⟫ = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed, real_inner_smul_right]
  have hmem : v i ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (gramSchmidt ℝ v '' Set.Iic i) :=
    mem_span_gramSchmidt ℝ v le_rfl
  have hnot : j ∉ Set.Iic i := by
    simp only [Set.mem_Iic, not_le]
    exact hij
  rw [inner_gramSchmidt_eq_zero_of_mem_span hnot hmem, mul_zero]

name: Submission.inner_gramSchmidtNormed_self_pos
statement:
theorem inner_gramSchmidtNormed_self_pos
    {v : Fin r → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin r)} (hv : LinearIndependent ℝ v)
    (i : Fin r) :
    0 < ⟪v i, gramSchmidtNormed ℝ v i⟫
proof:
:= by
  have hne : gramSchmidt ℝ v i ≠ 0 := gramSchmidt_ne_zero i hv
  have hnorm : 0 < ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ := norm_pos_iff.mpr hne
  have hnot : i ∉ Set.Iio i := by simp
  have hsub : ⟪gramSchmidt ℝ v i - v i, gramSchmidt ℝ v i⟫ = 0 :=
    inner_gramSchmidt_eq_zero_of_mem_span hnot (gramSchmidt_sub_mem_span v i)
  have hself : ⟪gramSchmidt ℝ v i, gramSchmidt ℝ v i⟫
      = ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ ^ 2 := real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq _
  have hvi : ⟪v i, gramSchmidt ℝ v i⟫ = ‖gramSchmidt ℝ v i‖ ^ 2 := by
    rw [inner_sub_left, hself] at hsub
    linarith
  rw [gramSchmidtNormed, real_inner_smul_right, hvi]
  apply mul_pos _ (pow_pos hnorm 2)
  rw [inv_pos]
  exact_mod_cast hnorm

name: Submission.gsLeftFactor_apply
statement:
theorem gsLeftFactor_apply (M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) (i j : Fin r) :
    gsLeftFactor M i j =
      ⟪matrixRows M i, gramSchmidtNormed ℝ (matrixRows M) j⟫
proof:
:= by
  rw [gsLeftFactor, Matrix.mul_apply, PiLp.inner_apply]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun k _ => ?_
  simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply, RCLike.inner_apply, conj_trivial]
  rw [mul_comm]
  rfl

name: Submission.gsLeftFactor_eq_zero_of_lt
statement:
theorem gsLeftFactor_eq_zero_of_lt (M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) {i j : Fin r}
    (hij : i < j) : gsLeftFactor M i j = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [gsLeftFactor_apply]
  exact inner_gramSchmidtNormed_eq_zero_of_lt hij

name: Submission.gsLeftFactor_diag_pos
statement:
theorem gsLeftFactor_diag_pos {M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ} (hdet : M.det ≠ 0)
    (i : Fin r) : 0 < gsLeftFactor M i i
proof:
:= by
  rw [gsLeftFactor_apply]
  exact inner_gramSchmidtNormed_self_pos
    (linearIndependent_matrixRows_of_det_ne_zero hdet) i

name: Submission.gsLeftFactor_mul_matrixGramSchmidtSO
statement:
theorem gsLeftFactor_mul_matrixGramSchmidtSO (M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
    (hdet : 0 < M.det) :
    gsLeftFactor M *
        ((matrixGramSchmidtSO M hdet : SOGroup r) :
          Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) = M
proof:
:= by
  set R : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ :=
    ((matrixGramSchmidtSO M hdet : SOGroup r) :
      Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) with hR
  have horth : R * Rᵀ = 1 :=
    (Matrix.mem_orthogonalGroup_iff (Fin r) ℝ).mp
      (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp
        (matrixGramSchmidtSO M hdet).property).1
  have horth' : Rᵀ * R = 1 := Matrix.mul_eq_one_comm.mp horth
  have hgs : gsLeftFactor M = M * Rᵀ := rfl
  rw [hgs, Matrix.mul_assoc, horth', Matrix.mul_one]

name: Submission.gsLeftInterp_zero
statement:
theorem gsLeftInterp_zero (M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) :
    gsLeftInterp M 0 = gsLeftFactor M
proof:
:= by

name: Submission.gsLeftInterp_one
statement:
theorem gsLeftInterp_one (M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) :

proof:
:= by

name: Submission.gsLeftInterp_apply
statement:
theorem gsLeftInterp_apply (M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) (s : ℝ) (i j : Fin r) :
    gsLeftInterp M s i j =
      (1 - s) * gsLeftFactor M i j + s * (1 : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) i j
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.gsLeftInterp_blockTriangular
statement:
theorem gsLeftInterp_blockTriangular (M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) (s : ℝ) :
    (gsLeftInterp M s).BlockTriangular OrderDual.toDual
proof:
:= by
  intro i j hij
  have hij' : i < j := hij
  rw [gsLeftInterp_apply, gsLeftFactor_eq_zero_of_lt M hij',
    Matrix.one_apply_ne (ne_of_lt hij')]
  ring

name: Submission.gsLeftInterp_diag_pos
statement:
theorem gsLeftInterp_diag_pos {M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ} (hdet : M.det ≠ 0)
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) (i : Fin r) :
    0 < gsLeftInterp M s i i
proof:
:= by
  have hL : 0 < gsLeftFactor M i i := gsLeftFactor_diag_pos hdet i
  rw [gsLeftInterp_apply, Matrix.one_apply_eq, mul_one]
  rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hs1 with rfl | hlt
  · simp
  · have h1s : 0 < 1 - s := by linarith
    have : 0 < (1 - s) * gsLeftFactor M i i := mul_pos h1s hL
    linarith

name: Submission.det_gsLeftInterp_pos
statement:
theorem det_gsLeftInterp_pos {M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ} (hdet : M.det ≠ 0)
    {s : ℝ} (hs0 : 0 ≤ s) (hs1 : s ≤ 1) : 0 < (gsLeftInterp M s).det
proof:
:= by
  rw [Matrix.det_of_lowerTriangular _ (gsLeftInterp_blockTriangular M s)]
  exact Finset.prod_pos fun i _ => gsLeftInterp_diag_pos hdet hs0 hs1 i

name: Submission.soMatrixLeftMul_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem soMatrixLeftMul_apply (C : C(I, SOGroup r))
    (M : C(I, Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)) (t : I) :

proof: := rfl

name: Submission.det_soMatrixLeftMul
statement:
theorem det_soMatrixLeftMul (C : C(I, SOGroup r))
    (M : C(I, Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)) (t : I) :
    (soMatrixLeftMul C M t).det = (M t).det
proof:

    (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp (C t).property).2, one_mul]

name: Submission.det_soMatrixLeftMul_pos
statement:
theorem det_soMatrixLeftMul_pos (C : C(I, SOGroup r))
    (M : C(I, Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)) (hdet : ∀ t, 0 < (M t).det) (t : I) :
    0 < (soMatrixLeftMul C M t).det
proof:

name: Submission.soMatrixLeftMul_closed
statement:
theorem soMatrixLeftMul_closed (C : C(I, SOGroup r))
    (M : C(I, Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)) (hC : C 0 = C 1) (hM : M 0 = M 1) :
    soMatrixLeftMul C M 0 = soMatrixLeftMul C M 1
proof:
:= by
  change ((C 0 : SOGroup r) : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) * M 0 =
    ((C 1 : SOGroup r) : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) * M 1
  rw [hC, hM]

name: Submission.gsLeftGaugeHomotopy_det_pos
statement:
theorem gsLeftGaugeHomotopy_det_pos (C : C(I, SOGroup r))
    (M : C(I, Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)) (hdet : ∀ t, 0 < (M t).det)
    (q : I × I) : 0 < ((gsLeftGaugeHomotopy C M hdet) q).det
proof:
:= by
  change 0 < (((C q.2 : SOGroup r) : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) *
    (gsLeftInterp (M q.2) ((q.1 : ℝ)) *
      ((positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet q.2 : SOGroup r) :
        Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ))).det
  rw [Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul,
    (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp (C q.2).property).2,
    (Matrix.mem_specialOrthogonalGroup_iff.mp
      (positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet q.2).property).2,
    one_mul, mul_one]
  exact det_gsLeftInterp_pos (ne_of_gt (hdet q.2))
    (unitInterval.nonneg q.1) (unitInterval.le_one q.1)

name: Submission.gsLeftGaugeHomotopy_closed
statement:
theorem gsLeftGaugeHomotopy_closed (C : C(I, SOGroup r))
    (M : C(I, Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)) (hdet : ∀ t, 0 < (M t).det)
    (hC : C 0 = C 1) (hM : M 0 = M 1) (s : I) :
    (gsLeftGaugeHomotopy C M hdet) (s, 0) =
      (gsLeftGaugeHomotopy C M hdet) (s, 1)
proof:
:= by
  have hR : positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet 0 = positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet 1 :=
    positiveMatrixSOMap_closed M hdet hM
  change ((C 0 : SOGroup r) : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) *
      (gsLeftInterp (M 0) ((s : ℝ)) *
        ((positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet 0 : SOGroup r) :
          Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)) =
    ((C 1 : SOGroup r) : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) *
      (gsLeftInterp (M 1) ((s : ℝ)) *
        ((positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet 1 : SOGroup r) :
          Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ))
  rw [hC, hM, hR]

name: Submission.loopClassZ2_matrixGramSchmidtSO_leftMul
statement:
theorem loopClassZ2_matrixGramSchmidtSO_leftMul
    (C : C(I, SOGroup r)) (M : C(I, Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ))
    (hdet : ∀ t, 0 < (M t).det) (hC : C 0 = C 1) (hM : M 0 = M 1) :
    loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap (soMatrixLeftMul C M)
          (det_soMatrixLeftMul_pos C M hdet))
        (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed _ _ (soMatrixLeftMul_closed C M hC hM)) =
      loopClassZ2 C hC +
        loopClassZ2 (positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet)
          (positiveMatrixSOMap_closed M hdet hM)
proof:
:= by
  have hRclosed : positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet 0 = positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet 1 :=
    positiveMatrixSOMap_closed M hdet hM
  have hprodclosed :
      (C * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet) 0 = (C * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet) 1 := by
    change C 0 * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet 0 =
      C 1 * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet 1
    rw [hC, hRclosed]
  have hdet₁ : ∀ p : I,
      0 < ((SOGroupMatrixMap (C * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet)) p).det :=
    fun p => SOGroup_det_pos ((C * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet) p)
  have hclosed₁ :
      (SOGroupMatrixMap (C * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet)) 0 =
        (SOGroupMatrixMap (C * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet)) 1 := by
    change (((C * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet) 0 : SOGroup r) :
        Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ) =
      (((C * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet) 1 : SOGroup r) :
        Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) ℝ)
    rw [hprodclosed]
  have step1 := loopClassZ2_positiveMatrixHomotopy_congr
    (gsLeftGaugeHomotopy C M hdet)
    (det_soMatrixLeftMul_pos C M hdet) hdet₁
    (gsLeftGaugeHomotopy_det_pos C M hdet)
    (soMatrixLeftMul_closed C M hC hM) hclosed₁
    (gsLeftGaugeHomotopy_closed C M hdet hC hM)
  rw [step1]
  have h2 : positiveMatrixSOMap
      (SOGroupMatrixMap (C * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet)) hdet₁ =
      C * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet :=
    positiveMatrixSOMap_SOGroupMatrixMap (C * positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet)
  rw [loopClassZ2_congr_fun _ hprodclosed h2]
  exact loopClassZ2_mul C (positiveMatrixSOMap M hdet) hC hRclosed hprodclosed

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.reparam_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem reparam_apply
    (gamma : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))) (t₀ t₁ : I) (q : I) :
    reparam gamma t₀ t₁ q = gamma (Set.Icc.convexComb t₀ t₁ q)
proof: := rfl

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.cut_subset_range_of_marks_mem
statement:
theorem cut_subset_range_of_marks_mem
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 1)
    (gamma : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
    (hgamma : ∀ u : I, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (hinj : Function.Injective gamma)
    (h0 : A.point 0 ∈ Set.range gamma) (h1 : A.point 1 ∈ Set.range gamma)
    (hs0 : gamma 0 ≠ A.point 0) (hs1 : gamma 0 ≠ A.point 1) :
    (gamma 0 ∈ Set.range (A.adjacentSubpath 0) →
        Set.range A.wrapSubpath ⊆ Set.range gamma) ∧
      (gamma 0 ∈ Set.range A.wrapSubpath →
        Set.range (A.adjacentSubpath 0) ⊆ Set.range gamma)
proof:
:= by
  classical
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀⟩ := h0
  obtain ⟨t₁, ht₁⟩ := h1
  
  have hpointne : A.point 0 ≠ A.point 1 := by
    intro hEq
    have := A.point_injective hEq
    exact absurd this (by decide)
  have htne : t₀ ≠ t₁ := by
    intro hEq
    apply hpointne
    rw [← ht₀, ← ht₁, hEq]
  have ht₀ne : t₀ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hEq
    apply hs0
    rw [← ht₀, hEq]
  have ht₁ne : t₁ ≠ 0 := by
    intro hEq
    apply hs1
    rw [← ht₁, hEq]
  set delta : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))) := reparam gamma t₀ t₁
    with hdelta
  have hdeltamem : ∀ u : I, delta u ∈ V.orbit P.p := fun u => hgamma _
  have hdeltainj : Function.Injective delta := by
    intro a b hab
    exact injective_convexComb htne (hinj hab)
  have hsource : delta 0 = A.point 0 := by
    rw [hdelta, reparam_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_zero, ht₀]
  have htarget : delta 1 = A.point 1 := by
    rw [hdelta, reparam_apply, Set.Icc.convexComb_one, ht₁]
  have havoid : ∀ {u : I}, u ∈ Set.Ioo (0 : I) 1 → ∀ l, delta u ≠ A.point l := by
    have hlall : ∀ j : Fin 2, j = 0 ∨ j = 1 := by decide
    intro u hu l hEq
    rcases hlall l with rfl | rfl
    · have h : delta u = delta 0 := by rw [hEq, hsource]
      exact absurd (hdeltainj h) (ne_of_gt hu.1)
    · have h : delta u = delta 1 := by rw [hEq, htarget]
      exact absurd (hdeltainj h) (ne_of_lt hu.2)
  have hcut := A.range_eq_adjacentSubpath_or_wrap_of_embedded_arc_two delta
    hdeltamem hdeltainj 0 1 hsource htarget havoid
  have hsub : Set.range delta ⊆ Set.range gamma := by
    rintro x ⟨u, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨Set.Icc.convexComb t₀ t₁ u, rfl⟩
  
  have hstart : gamma 0 ∉ Set.range delta := by
    rintro ⟨u, hu⟩
    have h : (0 : I) = Set.Icc.convexComb t₀ t₁ u := hinj hu.symm
    have hzero : (1 - (u : ℝ)) * (t₀ : ℝ) + (u : ℝ) * (t₁ : ℝ) = 0 := by
      have := congrArg Subtype.val h.symm
      rw [Set.Icc.coe_convexComb] at this
      simpa using this
    rcases eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_convexComb_eq_zero t₀.2.1 t₁.2.1
      u.2.1 u.2.2 hzero with hz | hz
    · exact ht₀ne (Subtype.ext hz)
    · exact ht₁ne (Subtype.ext hz)
  constructor
  · intro hmem
    rcases hcut with hc | hc
    · exact absurd (hc ▸ hmem : gamma 0 ∈ Set.range delta) hstart
    · rw [← hc]; exact hsub
  · intro hmem
    rcases hcut with hc | hc
    · rw [← hc]; exact hsub
    · exact absurd (hc ▸ hmem : gamma 0 ∈ Set.range delta) hstart

name: Submission.SimpleClosedOrbitParam.CyclicMarking.orbit_diff_subset_range_of_marks_mem
statement:
theorem orbit_diff_subset_range_of_marks_mem
    (A : P.CyclicMarking 1)
    (gamma : C(I, EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1))))
    (hgamma : ∀ u : I, gamma u ∈ V.orbit P.p)
    (hinj : Function.Injective gamma)
    (h0 : A.point 0 ∈ Set.range gamma) (h1 : A.point 1 ∈ Set.range gamma)
    (hs0 : gamma 0 ≠ A.point 0) (hs1 : gamma 0 ≠ A.point 1)
    {S : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
    (hS : S = Set.range (A.adjacentSubpath 0) ∨ S = Set.range A.wrapSubpath)
    (hstart : gamma 0 ∈ S)
    {O : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (n + 1)))}
    (hO : ∀ x ∈ O, x ∈ V.orbit P.p) :
    O \ S ⊆ Set.range gamma
proof:
:= by
  have hmain := A.cut_subset_range_of_marks_mem gamma hgamma hinj h0 h1 hs0 hs1
  intro x hx
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := A.exists_mem_cyclicCutRange (hO x hx.1)
  have hi' : x ∈ Set.range (A.adjacentSubpath 0) ∨
      x ∈ Set.range A.wrapSubpath := by
    induction i using Fin.lastCases with
    | last => right; rwa [A.cyclicCutRange_last] at hi
    | cast j =>
        left
        rw [A.cyclicCutRange_castSucc] at hi
        have hj : j = 0 := Subsingleton.elim j 0
        rwa [hj] at hi
  rcases hS with rfl | rfl
  · rcases hi' with h | h
    · exact absurd h hx.2
    · exact hmain.1 hstart h
  · rcases hi' with h | h
    · exact hmain.2 hstart h
    · exact absurd h hx.2

name: Submission.SmoothSOPath.nonempty
statement:
theorem nonempty (hn : 0 < n) (A : SOGroup n) :
    Nonempty (SmoothSOPath A)
proof:
:= by
  let p : Path (1 : SOGroup n) A := PathConnectedSpace.somePath 1 A
  let r : ℝ → I := fun s =>
    ⟨normRamp s, normRamp_nonneg s, normRamp_le_one s⟩
  have hr : Continuous r :=
    Continuous.subtype_mk contDiff_normRamp.continuous _
  let R : ℝ → SOGroup n := fun s => p (r s)
  have hR : Continuous R := p.continuous.comp hr
  have hRzero : R 0 = 1 := by
    change p (r 0) = 1
    have h0 : normRamp 0 = 0 := normRamp_of_le_quarter (by norm_num)
    have hr0 : r 0 = 0 := Subtype.ext h0
    rw [hr0]
    exact p.source
  have hRone : R 1 = A := by
